sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen, «Sansie xa mini bɔxi ma. Sansi mɔɔli birin xa bula. Sansi xɔri naxan na a bogi kui, a bulama nɛ birin nun a mɔɔli ra.» A rabaxi na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And grass came up on the earth, and every plant producing seed of its sort, and every tree producing fruit, in which is its seed, of its sort: and God saw that it was good.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi naxa rafe sansi mɔɔli birin na, a bogi nun a sansi xɔri na a bili ma, na fan birin nun a mɔɔli. Ala naxa a mato fa, na birin fanxi.

sentences.english: And there was evening and there was morning, the third day.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ naxa so, kuye naxa iba, lɔxɔɛ saxan nde nan nu na ki.

sentences.english: And God said, Let there be lights in the arch of heaven, for a division between the day and the night, and let them be for signs, and for marking the changes of the year, and for days and for years:
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen, «Yanbasee xa lu koore ma, yanyi nun kɔɛ itaxunfe ra. Waxati birin kolonma yanbasee saabui nan na. Xi yo xi, ɲɛ yo ɲɛ a kolonma yanbasee nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: And let them be for lights in the arch of heaven to give light on the earth: and it was so.
sentences.susu: Yanbase na koore ma bɔxi iyalanse nan na.» A rabaxi na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And God made the two great lights: the greater light to be the ruler of the day, and the smaller light to be the ruler of the night: and he made the stars.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa naiyalanse xungbe firin nafala. Naxan xungbo, na xa yanyi yaamari raba. Naxan xurun, na xa kɔɛ yaamari raba. A naxa tunbuie fan nafala.

sentences.english: And God put them in the arch of heaven, to give light on the earth;
sentences.susu: Ala naxa yanbasee sa koore ma alako e xa bɔxi iyalan,

sentences.english: To have rule over the day and the night, and for a division between the light and the dark: and God saw that it was good.
sentences.susu: e xa yanyi nun kɔɛ yaamari raba, e xa dimi nun naiyalanyi rafatan. Ala naxa a mato fa, a birin fanxi.

sentences.english: And there was evening and there was morning, the fourth day.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ naxa so, kuye naxa iba, lɔxɔɛ naani nde nan nu na ki.

sentences.english: And God said, Let the waters be full of living things, and let birds be in flight over the earth under the arch of heaven.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen, yɛxɛe xa ye ramaxa. Xɔnie xa ɲɛrɛ koore ma.

sentences.english: And God made great sea-beasts, and every sort of living and moving thing with which the waters were full, and every sort of winged bird: and God saw that it was good.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa yɛxɛ xungbe mɔɔli birin daa a nun nimase naxan birin na ye xɔɔra. A naxa xɔni mɔɔli birin fan daa. Ala naxa a mato fa, a birin fanxi.

sentences.english: And God gave them his blessing, saying, Be fertile and have increase, making all the waters of the seas full, and let the birds be increased in the earth.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa barakɛ sa e xa fe. A naxɛ, «Wo xa wuya, wo xa yiriwa alako yɛxɛe xa wuya baa ma. Xɔnie fan xa gbo bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And there was evening and there was morning, the fifth day.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ naxa so, kuye naxa iba, lɔxɔɛ suuli nde nan nu na ki.

sentences.english: And God said, Let the earth give birth to all sorts of living things, cattle and all things moving on the earth, and beasts of the earth after their sort: and it was so.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen, «Nimasee mɔɔli birin xa lu bɔxi ma: xurusee, bubusee, a nun buurunyi subee.» A rabaxi na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And God made the beast of the earth after its sort, and the cattle after their sort, and everything moving on the face of the earth after its sort: and God saw that it was good.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa buurunyi subee mɔɔli birin daa, a naxa xurusee mɔɔli birin daa, a naxa bubusee mɔɔli birin daa. Ala naxa a mato fa, a birin fanxi.

sentences.english: And God said, Let us make man in our image, like us: and let him have rule over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the air and over the cattle and over all the earth and over every living thing which goes flat on the earth.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen, «Won xa adama daa, won xa won fɔxi lu a ma. A xa yaamari raba yɛxɛe xun ma, xɔnie xun ma, xurusee xun ma, bɔxi xun ma, a nun bubusee xun ma.»

sentences.english: And God made man in his image, in the image of God he made him: male and female he made them.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa adama daa ginɛ nun xɛmɛ, a a fɔxi lu e ma.

sentences.english: And God gave them his blessing and said to them, Be fertile and have increase, and make the earth full and be masters of it; be rulers over the fish of the sea and over the birds of the air and over every living thing moving on the earth.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa barakɛ sa e xa fe. A naxɛ, «Wo xa wuya, wo xa yiriwa alako bɔxi xa rafe. Wo xa yaamari raba bɔxi xun ma, yɛxɛe xun ma, xɔnie xun ma, bubusee xun ma.»

sentences.english: And God said, See, I have given you every plant producing seed, on the face of all the earth, and every tree which has fruit producing seed: they will be for your food:
sentences.susu: A naxɛ, «N bara sansi birin nun sansi bogi birin fi wo ma baloe ra.

sentences.english: And to every beast of the earth and to every bird of the air and every living thing moving on the face of the earth I have given every green plant for food: and it was so.
sentences.susu: N bara sansi birin fi sube birin ma naxan na bɔxi ma, a nun xɔni birin ma, a nun bubuse birin ma, nimase birin ma naxee ɲɛngima. Sansi birin bara findi e baloe ra.» A rabaxi na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And God saw everything which he had made and it was very good. And there was evening and there was morning, the sixth day.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a xa daalise birin mato fa, a fanxi han. Kɔɛ naxa so, kuye naxa iba, lɔxɔɛ senni nde nan nu na ki.

sentences.english: And the heaven and the earth and all things in them were complete.
sentences.susu: Koore, bɔxi, nun se birin daa ki nan nu na ki.

sentences.english: And on the seventh day God came to the end of all his work; and on the seventh day he took his rest from all the work which he had done.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ solofere nde Ala xa wali naxa kamali. A naxa a malabu.

sentences.english: And God gave his blessing to the seventh day and made it holy: because on that day he took his rest from all the work which he had made and done.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa tide sa na lɔxɔɛ solofere nde ma, a xa findi lɔxɔɛ sɛniyɛnxi ra barima a a malabu na lɔxɔɛ nɛ a xa wali kamalixi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: These are the generations of the heaven and the earth when they were made.
sentences.susu: Taruxui nan ya, duniɲa daaxi ki naxɛ. Marigi Alatala bɔxi nun koore daa tɛmui naxɛ,

sentences.english: In the day when the Lord God made earth and heaven there were no plants of the field on the earth, and no grass had come up: for the Lord God had not sent rain on the earth and there was no man to do work on the land.
sentences.susu: fɔtɔnyi yo mu nu na. Sansi yo mu nu na naxan bulaxi bɔxi ma barima Marigi Alatala mu nu tunɛ ye ragoroxi sinden. Adama fan mu nu na naxan bɔxi rawalima,

sentences.english: But a mist went up from the earth, watering all the face of the land.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ ye nu luma mini ra bɔxi bun, a fa yensen yɛ yire birin ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord God made man from the dust of the earth, breathing into him the breath of life: and man became a living soul.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa adama yailan bɛndɛ ra. Na dangi xanbi a naxa nii raso a fate a ɲɔɛ kui. A findi adama ra na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord God made a garden in the east, in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had made.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi Marigi Alatala naxa yire fanyi yailan sogetede mabiri. Na yire xili «Eden.» A naxa adama lu mɛnni.

sentences.english: And out of the earth the Lord made every tree to come, delighting the eye and good for food; and in the middle of the garden, the tree of life and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa wuri mɔɔli birin nabula mɛnni, wuri tofanyie, wuri naxee bogi fan a don daaxi ra. Na yire tagi wuri firin nu na. Keren xili «Simaya wuri.» Boore xili «Fe fanyi nun fe ɲaaxi kolon wuri.»

sentences.english: And a river went out of Eden giving water to the garden; and from there it was parted and became four streams.
sentences.susu: Xure naxan ye rasoxi Eden kui sansie bɛ, a to dangixi, a itaxunxi dɔxɔ naani ra.

sentences.english: The name of the first is Pishon, which goes round about all the land of Havilah where there is gold.
sentences.susu: Na singe xili Pison. Na nan dangima Hawila bɔxi birin ma, xɛɛma na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And the gold of that land is good: there is bdellium and the onyx stone.
sentences.susu: Na xɛɛma fan. Wuri ye xiri ɲɔxunmɛ fan na na, a nun gɛmɛ tofanyi naxan xili onixi.

sentences.english: And the name of the second river is Gihon: this river goes round all the land of Cush.
sentences.susu: Na xure firin nde xili Gixon. Na nan dangima Kusi bɔxi birin ma.

sentences.english: And the name of the third river is Tigris, which goes to the east of Assyria. And the fourth river is Euphrates.
sentences.susu: Na xure saxan nde xili Tigiri. Na nan dangima Asuri bɔxi ma a sogetede biri ra. Na xure naani nde xili Efirati.

sentences.english: And the Lord God took the man and put him in the garden of Eden to do work in it and take care of it.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa adama rasabati Eden, alako a xa nɔ na yire rawalide, a man xa mɛɛni na ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord God gave the man orders, saying, You may freely take of the fruit of every tree of the garden:
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa yaamari so adama yi ra, a naxɛ, «I nɔma yi wuri bogi birin donde naxan na Eden kui,

sentences.english: But of the fruit of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you may not take; for on the day when you take of it, death will certainly come to you.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ i naxa ‹Fe fanyi nun fe ɲaaxi kolon wuri› bogi don de, barima i nu na don, i faxama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord God said, It is not good for the man to be by himself: I will make one like himself as a help to him
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa a fala, «A mu fan xɛmɛ xa lu be a keren. N fama malima fanyi daalide a bɛ.»

sentences.english: And from the earth the Lord God made every beast of the field and every bird of the air, and took them to the man to see what names he would give them: and whatever name he gave to any living thing, that was its name.
sentences.susu: Buurunyi sube birin nun xɔni birin Marigi Alatala naxan daalixi bɛndɛ ra, a naxa e xanin adama xɔn ma a xa e xili sa. Adama xili naxee sa e xun ma, nee naxa findi e xilie ra.

sentences.english: And the man gave names to all cattle and to the birds of the air and to every beast of the field; but Adam had no one like himself as a help.
sentences.susu: A naxa xuruse birin, xɔni birin, a nun buurunyi sube birin xili sa. Kɔnɔ na waxati Adama mu a malima fanyi sɔtɔxi sinden.

sentences.english: And the Lord God sent a deep sleep on the man, and took one of the bones from his side while he was sleeping, joining up the flesh again in its place:
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa xi xɔli radangi a ma. A naxa a raxi a fanyi ra. A to xi, Marigi Alatala naxa a ganyanyi xɔri keren ba, a fa mɛnni ragali.

sentences.english: And the bone which the Lord God had taken from the man he made into a woman, and took her to the man.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Marigi Alatala naxa Adama ganyanyi xɔri findi ginɛ ra, a fa na ginɛ fi Adama ma.

sentences.english: And the man said, This is now bone of my bone and flesh of my flesh: let her name be Woman because she was taken out of Man.
sentences.susu: Adama naxa a fala, «Yi ginɛ fatanxi n xɔri nun n sube nan na. A xili nɛ ‹ginɛ›, barima a minixi xɛmɛ nɛ i.»

sentences.english: For this cause will a man go away from his father and his mother and be joined to his wife; and they will be one flesh.
sentences.susu: Na fe na a toxi, xɛmɛ fama nɛ kelide a baba nun a nga xun ma, a maso a xa ginɛ ra, e findi keren na.

sentences.english: And the man and his wife were without clothing, and they had no sense of shame.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ nun a xa ginɛ mageli nan nu a ra, kɔnɔ na fe yaagi mu nu e ma.

sentences.english: Now the snake was wiser than any beast of the field which the Lord God had made. And he said to the woman, Has God truly said that you may not take of the fruit of any tree in the garden?
sentences.susu: Bɔximase nan nu kɔɔta Marigi Alatala xa daalise birin bɛ. A naxa ginɛ maxɔrin, «Ala a fala nɛ wo bɛ a wuri bogi naxan birin na Eden kui, a wo naxa a sese don? Nɔndi na a ra?»

sentences.english: And the woman said, We may take of the fruit of the trees in the garden:
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a yaabi, «Wuri naxee na Eden kui, muxu nɔma e birin bogi donde,

sentences.english: But of the fruit of the tree in the middle of the garden, God has said, If you take of it or put your hands on it, death will come to you.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ wuri naxan na Eden tagi, muxu mu nɔma na tan bogi donde, muxu mu nɔma makɔrɛde a ra yɛtɛ yati, xa na mu a ra muxu faxama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And the snake said, Death will not certainly come to you:
sentences.susu: Bɔximase naxa a fala ginɛ bɛ, «Ade, wo mu faxama.

sentences.english: For God sees that on the day when you take of its fruit, your eyes will be open, and you will be as gods, having knowledge of good and evil.
sentences.susu: Ala a kolon, wo na a don, wo ya rabima nɛ. Wo fama fe fanyi nun fe ɲaaxi kolonde alɔ Ala yɛtɛ.»

sentences.english: And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and a delight to the eyes, and to be desired to make one wise, she took of its fruit, and gave it to her husband.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ to wuri bogi to, a tofan, a fan donse ra, a fan xaxili sɔtɔse ra, a naxa keren ba, a don, a nde so a xa mɔri yi, e nun naxan nu a ra. Na fan naxa a don.

sentences.english: And their eyes were open and they were conscious that they had no clothing and they made themselves coats of leaves stitched together.
sentences.susu: Na waxati e yae naxa rabi. E naxa a kolon, e mageli nan nu a ra. E naxa xɔrɛ burɛxɛe dɛnbɛ e boore ra, e e yɛtɛ sutura a ra.

sentences.english: And there came to them the sound of the Lord God walking in the garden in the evening wind: and the man and his wife went to a secret place among the trees of the garden, away from the eyes of the Lord God.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, xɛmɛ nun a xa ginɛ naxa Marigi Alatala ɲɛrɛ xui mɛ nunmare ra. E naxa e nɔxun wurie xanbi ra.

sentences.english: And the voice of the Lord God came to the man, saying, Where are you?
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa xili ti, «Adama, i na minden?»

sentences.english: And he said, Hearing your voice in the garden I was full of fear, because I was without clothing: and I kept myself from your eyes.
sentences.susu: Adama naxa a yaabi, «N bara i xui mɛ Eden kui, kɔnɔ n bara gaaxu, barima n mageli na a ra. Na nan a ra, n nan n nɔxunxi.»

sentences.english: And he said, Who gave you the knowledge that you were without clothing? Have you taken of the fruit of the tree which I said you were not to take?
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa a maxɔrin, «Nde a masenxi i bɛ i mageli na a ra? Ka i bara na wuri bogi don ba, n naxan ma fe fala i bɛ i naxa a don?»

sentences.english: And the man said, The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me the fruit of the tree and I took it.
sentences.susu: Adama naxɛ, «I ginɛ naxan fixi n ma, na nan yi wuri bogi so n yi ra, n naxa a don.»

sentences.english: And the Lord God said to the woman, What have you done? And the woman said, I was tricked by the deceit of the snake and I took it.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Marigi Alatala naxa ginɛ maxɔrin, «I yi rabaxi munfe ra?» Ginɛ naxa a yaabi, «Bɔximase bara n madaxu han n bara na wuri bogi don.»

sentences.english: And the Lord God said to the snake, Because you have done this you are cursed more than all cattle and every beast of the field; you will go flat on the earth, and dust will be your food all the days of your life:
sentences.susu: Awa, Marigi Alatala naxa a fala bɔximase bɛ, «I to bara yi raba, awa, n fan n bara i danka xuruse nun buurunyi sube birin ya ma. I findima bubuse nan na i furi fari. I xube nan donma i xa duniɲɛigiri kui.

sentences.english: And there will be war between you and the woman and between your seed and her seed: by him will your head be crushed and by you his foot will be wounded.
sentences.susu: N bara dɛɲaaxui raso i tan nun ginɛ tagi. N bara a raso i xa die nun a xa die tagi. Ginɛ xa di i xunyi butuxunma nɛ. I fan a tingilinyi xinma nɛ.»

sentences.english: To the woman he said, Great will be your pain in childbirth; in sorrow will your children come to birth; still your desire will be for your husband, but he will be your master.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa a fala ginɛ bɛ, «I fan, n i tɔɔrɔma nɛ i xa di bari kui. Na tɔɔrɛ gboma nɛ. I birama nɛ i xa mɔri fɔxɔ ra, a i yamari.»

sentences.english: And to Adam he said, Because you gave ear to the voice of your wife and took of the fruit of the tree which I said you were not to take, the earth is cursed on your account; in pain you will get your food from it all your life.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa a fala Adama bɛ, «I bara bira i xa ginɛ fɔxɔ ra. I bara na wuri bogi don, n naxan ma fe fala i bɛ, i naxa a don. Yakɔsi n bara bɔxi danka i xa fe ra. I tɔɔrɔma nɛ baloe sɔtɔde i xa duniɲɛigiri kui.

sentences.english: Thorns and waste plants will come up, and the plants of the field will be your food;
sentences.susu: N tunbe nun baagi raminima nɛ bɔxi ma, i baloe sɔtɔma xɛ nan ma.

sentences.english: With the hard work of your hands you will get your bread till you go back to the earth from which you were taken: for dust you are and to the dust you will go back.
sentences.susu: I baloe sɔtɔma i yilenfure nan na han i gbilenma bɛndɛ tɛmui naxɛ i rafalaxi naxan na. Bɛndɛ nan i ra, i man gbilenma na bɛndɛ nɛ.»

sentences.english: And the man gave his wife the name of Eve because she was the mother of all who have life.
sentences.susu: Adama naxa a xa ginɛ xili sa «Mahawa,» barima a findima nɛ mixi birin nga ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord God made for Adam and for his wife coats of skins for their clothing.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa dugi kiri daaxie dɛgɛ Adama nun a xa ginɛ bɛ, a naxa e ragoro e ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord God said, Now the man has become like one of us, having knowledge of good and evil; and now if he puts out his hand and takes of the fruit of the tree of life, he will go on living for ever.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa a masen, «Adama bara fe fanyi nun fe ɲaaxi tagi raba kolon alɔ won tan. A mu daxa a xa simaya wuri bogi don, xa na mu a ra a mu faxama.»

sentences.english: So the Lord God sent him out of the garden of Eden to be a worker on the earth from which he was taken.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa a ramini Eden, a xa bɔxi rawali Ala a daaxi naxan na.

sentences.english: So he sent the man out; and at the east of the garden of Eden he put winged ones and a flaming sword turning every way to keep the way to the tree of life.
sentences.susu: A Adama keri xanbi, Marigi Alatala naxa malekɛe yaamari, e xa ti Eden sogetede biri ra. E xa nu santidɛgɛma tɛ daaxi malintan, na simaya wuri kantade.

sentences.english: And the man had connection with Eve his wife, and she became with child and gave birth to Cain, and said, I have got a man from the Lord.
sentences.susu: Adama nun Mahawa to kafu, Mahawa naxa tɛɛgɛ. E naxa di sɔtɔ naxan xili Kabila. Mahawa naxɛ, «Alatala bara n mali di xɛmɛ sɔtɔfe ra.»

sentences.english: Then again she became with child and gave birth to Abel, his brother. And Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a farmer.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi Mahawa naxa Kabila xanbiratoe xɛmɛma sɔtɔ naxan xili Habila. Xuruse dɛmadonyi nan nu Habila ra. Bɔxi rawali nan nu Kabila ra.

sentences.english: And after a time, Cain gave to the Lord an offering of the fruits of the earth.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui to dangi, Kabila naxa fa sansi bogi fangadama ra sɛrɛxɛ bade Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And Abel gave an offering of the young lambs of his flock and of their fat. And the Lord was pleased with Abel's offering;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Habila naxa fa xuruse di singee ra nun e ture. Habila nun a xa sɛrɛxɛ naxa rafan Alatala ma,

sentences.english: But in Cain and his offering he had no pleasure. And Cain was angry and his face became sad.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Kabila nun a xa sɛrɛxɛ mu nu rafan Alatala ma. Alatala mu a ya ti Kabila xa sɛrɛxɛ ra. Na na a ra, Kabila naxa xɔnɔ, a yatagi naxa masara.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Cain, Why are you angry? and why is your face sad?
sentences.susu: Na xanbi Alatala naxa Kabila maxɔrin, «I xɔnɔxi munfe ra? I yatagi masaraxi munfe ra?

sentences.english: If you do well, will you not have honour? and if you do wrong, sin is waiting at the door, desiring to have you, but do not let it be your master.
sentences.susu: Xa i fe fanyi raba, n na tongoma nɛ, kɔnɔ xa i fe ɲaaxi raba, Sentanɛ i ratantanma nɛ. I kata, i xa i yɛtɛ ba a yi ra.»

sentences.english: And Cain said to his brother, Let us go into the field: and when they were in the field, Cain made an attack on his brother Abel and put him to death.
sentences.susu: Kabila naxa a fala a xunya bɛ, «Won xɛɛ xɛ ma.» E to so xɛ ma, Kabila naxa a xunya Habila suxu, a naxa a faxa.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Cain, Where is your brother Abel? And he said, I have no idea: am I my brother's keeper?
sentences.susu: Na xanbi Alatala naxa Kabila maxɔrin, «I xunya Habila na minden?» A naxa a yaabi, «N mu a kolon. Fo n xa mɛɛni n xunya ma?»

sentences.english: And he said, What have you done? the voice of your brother's blood is crying to me from the earth.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a fala, «I munse rabaxi? N na i xunya wuli gbelegbele xui mɛfe keli bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And now you are cursed from the earth, whose mouth is open to take your brother's blood from your hand;
sentences.susu: N bara i danka barima i bara i xunya faxa. N i kerima nɛ yi bɔxi ma i xunya wuli na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: No longer will the earth give you her fruit as the reward of your work; you will be a wanderer in flight over the earth.
sentences.susu: I na bɔxi rawali, i mu baloe sɔtɔma. I findima ɲɛrɛti nan na.»

sentences.english: And Cain said, My punishment is greater than my strength.
sentences.susu: Kabila naxa Alatala yaabi, «Na ɲaxankatɛ gbo n tan bɛ.

sentences.english: You have sent me out this day from the face of the earth and from before your face; I will be a wanderer in flight over the earth, and whoever sees me will put me to death.
sentences.susu: Xa i bara n keri yi bɔxi ma to, won tagi ikuyama nɛ. N findima ɲɛrɛti nan na. Mixi naxan na sa n to, a n faxama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said, Truly, if Cain is put to death, seven lives will be taken for his. And the Lord put a mark on Cain so that no one might put him to death.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a yaabi, «Ade, xa mixi yo i faxa, n i gbeɲɔxɔma nɛ dɔxɔ solofere.» Alatala naxa tɔnxuma sa Kabila ma alako xa naxan sa a to a naxa nɔ a gerede.

sentences.english: And Cain went away from before the face of the Lord, and made his living-place in the land of Nod on the east of Eden.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Kabila naxa a makuya Alatala ra. A naxa sabati Nodi bɔxi ma Eden fuge ra.

sentences.english: And Cain had connection with his wife and she became with child and gave birth to Enoch: and he made a town, and gave the town the name of Enoch after his son.
sentences.susu: Kabila nun a xa ginɛ naxa kafu. A xa ginɛ naxa tɛɛgɛ, a naxa di sɔtɔ naxan xili Enoki. Kabila nu na taa tife. A naxa a xa di xili sa na taa xun ma.

sentences.english: And Enoch had a son Irad: and Irad became the father of Mehujael: and Mehujael became the father of Methushael: and Methushael became the father of Lamech.
sentences.susu: Enoki naxa Iradi sɔtɔ. Iradi, Mexuyayeli baba na a ra. Mexuyayeli, Metusayeli baba na a ra. Metusayeli, Lameki baba na a ra.

sentences.english: And Lamech had two wives; the name of the one was Adah, and the name of the other Zillah.
sentences.susu: Lameki naxa ginɛ firin sɔtɔ, keren xili Ada, boore xili Silahi.

sentences.english: And Adah gave birth to Jabal: he was the father of such as are living in tents and keep cattle.
sentences.susu: Ada naxa Yabala sɔtɔ. Yabala, xuruse dɛmadonyie nun kiri banxi kanyie baba na a ra.

sentences.english: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of all players on instruments of music.
sentences.susu: Yabala xunya xili Yubali. Yubali, kɔra bɔnbɔɛe nun xule fee baba na a ra.

sentences.english: And Zillah gave birth to Tubal-cain, who is the father of every maker of cutting instruments of brass and iron: and the sister of Tubal-cain was Naamah.
sentences.susu: Silahi fan naxa di sɔtɔ. A xili Tubali Kabila. Xabui nan nu a tan na. Walise wure gbeeli nun wure daaxi mɔɔli birin xabui nan nu a ra. Tubali Kayini xunya ginɛma xili Nama.

sentences.english: And Lamech said to his wives, Adah and Zillah, give ear to my voice; you wives of Lamech, give attention to my words, for I would put a man to death for a wound, and a young man for a blow;
sentences.susu: Lameki naxa a fala a xa ginɛe bɛ, «Ada nun Silahi wo xa wo haakɛ to n bɛ. Lameki xa ginɛe, wo xa wo tuli mati n ma wɔyɛnyi ra. N bara xɛmɛ nde faxa gbeɲɔxɔɛ ra. N bara na sɛgɛtala faxa barima a bara n maxɔnɔ.

sentences.english: If seven lives are to be taken as punishment for Cain's death, seventy-seven will be taken for Lamech's.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi solofere nan faxama Kabila gbeɲɔxɔfe ra, mixi tongo solofere nun solofere nan faxama n tan Lameki gbeɲɔxɔfe ra.»

sentences.english: And Adam had connection with his wife again, and she gave birth to a son to whom she gave the name of Seth: for she said, God has given me another seed in place of Abel, whom Cain put to death.
sentences.susu: Adama nun a xa ginɛ naxa kafu. Mahawa naxa di sɔtɔ naxan xili Seti. A bara na xili sa a xa di xun ma barima Ala bara a xa di Habila ɲɔxɔɛ so a yi ra Kabila naxan faxa.

sentences.english: And Seth had a son, and he gave him the name of Enosh: at this time men first made use of the name of the Lord in worship.
sentences.susu: Seti fan naxa di sɔtɔ naxan xili Enosi. Na waxati mixie naxa Alatala maxandi fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day when God made man, he made him in the image of God;
sentences.susu: Adama nun a bɔnsɔɛ xa taruxui nan ya. Ala to ibunadama die daa, a naxa a fɔxi lu e ma.

sentences.english: Male and female he made them, naming them Man, and giving them his blessing on the day when they were made.
sentences.susu: A naxa e daa xɛmɛ nun ginɛ. A barakɛ sa e ma. A e xili sa «adama.»

sentences.english: Adam had been living for a hundred and thirty years when he had a son like himself, after his image, and gave him the name of Seth:
sentences.susu: Adama to bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ tongo saxan, a naxa di sɔtɔ a yɛtɛ misaali ra. A naxa a xili sa Seti.

sentences.english: And after the birth of Seth, Adam went on living for eight hundred years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: Seti xa bari dangi xanbi, Adama naxa bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ solomasaxan. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And all the years of Adam's life were nine hundred and thirty: and he came to his end.
sentences.susu: Adama xa simaya naxa siga ɲɛ kɛmɛ solomanaani nun ɲɛ tongo saxan. Na xanbi a naxa faxa.

sentences.english: And Seth was a hundred and five years old when he became the father of Enosh:
sentences.susu: Seti to bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ suuli, a naxa findi Enosi baba ra.

sentences.english: And he went on living after the birth of Enosh for eight hundred and seven years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: Enosi xa bari dangi xanbi, Seti naxa bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ solomasaxan ɲɛ solofere. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And all the years of Seth's life were nine hundred and twelve: and he came to his end.
sentences.susu: Seti xa simaya naxa siga ɲɛ kɛmɛ solomanaani nun ɲɛ fu nun firin. Na xanbi a naxa faxa.

sentences.english: And Enosh was ninety years old when he became the father of Kenan:
sentences.susu: Enosi to bu ɲɛ tongo solomanaani, a naxa findi Kenan baba ra.

sentences.english: And after the birth of Kenan, Enosh went on living for eight hundred and fifteen years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: Kenan xa bari dangi xanbi, Enosi naxa bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ solomasaxan ɲɛ fu nun suuli. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And all the years of Enosh were nine hundred and five: and he came to his end.
sentences.susu: Enosi xa simaya naxa siga ɲɛ kɛmɛ solomanaani nun ɲɛ suuli. Na xanbi a naxa faxa.

sentences.english: And Kenan was seventy years old when he became the father of Mahalalel:
sentences.susu: Kenan to bu ɲɛ tongo solofere, a naxa findi Mahalaleli baba ra.

sentences.english: And after the birth of Mahalalel, Kenan went on living for eight hundred and forty years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: Mahalaleli xa bari dangi xanbi, Kenan naxa bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ solomasaxan ɲɛ tongo naani. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And all the years of Kenan's life were nine hundred and ten; and he came to his end.
sentences.susu: Kenan xa simaya naxa siga ɲɛ kɛmɛ solomanaani nun ɲɛ fu. Na xanbi a naxa faxa.

sentences.english: And Mahalalel was sixty-five years old when he became the father of Jared:
sentences.susu: Mahalaleli to bu ɲɛ tongo senni a nun suuli, a naxa findi Yeredi baba ra.

sentences.english: And after the birth of Jared, Mahalalel went on living for eight hundred and thirty years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: Yeredi xa bari dangi xanbi, Mahalaleli naxa bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ solomasaxan ɲɛ tongo saxan. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And all the years of Mahalalel's life were eight hundred and ninety-five: and he came to his end.
sentences.susu: Mahalaleli xa simaya naxa siga ɲɛ kɛmɛ solomasaxan nun ɲɛ tongo solomanaani nun suuli. Na xanbi a naxa faxa.

sentences.english: And Jared was a hundred and sixty-two years old when he became the father of Enoch:
sentences.susu: Yeredi to bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ tongo senni a nun firin, a naxa findi Enoki baba ra.

sentences.english: And Jared went on living after the birth of Enoch for eight hundred years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: Enoki xa bari dangi xanbi, Yeredi naxa bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ solomasaxan. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And all the years of Jared's life were nine hundred and sixty-two: and he came to his end.
sentences.susu: Yeredi xa simaya naxa siga ɲɛ kɛmɛ solomanaani nun ɲɛ tongo senni a nun firin. Na xanbi a naxa faxa.

sentences.english: And Enoch was sixty-five years old when he became the father of Methuselah:
sentences.susu: Enoki to bu ɲɛ tongo senni a nun suuli, a naxa findi Metusela baba ra.

sentences.english: And after the birth of Methuselah, Enoch went on in God's ways for three hundred years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: Metusela xa bari dangi xanbi, Enoki naxa bira Ala fɔxɔ ra ɲɛ kɛmɛ saxan. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And all the years of Enoch's life were three hundred and sixty-five:
sentences.susu: Enoki xa simaya naxa siga ɲɛ kɛmɛ saxan nun ɲɛ tongo senni a nun suuli.

sentences.english: And Enoch went on in God's ways: and he was not seen again, for God took him.
sentences.susu: Enoki naxa bira Ala fɔxɔ ra. Na xanbi a mu lu na sɔnɔn, barima Ala bara a xanin.

sentences.english: And Methuselah was a hundred and eighty-seven years old when he became the father of Lamech:
sentences.susu: Metusela to bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ tongo solomasaxan a nun solofere, a naxa findi Lameki baba ra.

sentences.english: And after the birth of Lamech, Methuselah went on living for seven hundred and eighty-two years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: Lameki xa bari dangi xanbi, Metusela naxa bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ solofere ɲɛ tongo solomasaxan a nun firin. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And all the years of Methuselah's life were nine hundred and sixty-nine: and he came to his end.
sentences.susu: Metusela xa simaya naxa siga ɲɛ kɛmɛ solomanaani nun ɲɛ tongo senni a nun solomanaani. Na xanbi a naxa faxa.

sentences.english: And Lamech was a hundred and eighty-two years old when he had a son:
sentences.susu: Lameki to bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ tongo solomasaxan a nun firin, a naxa di sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And he gave him the name of Noah, saying, Truly, he will give us rest from our trouble and the hard work of our hands, because of the earth which was cursed by God.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xili sa Nuha. A naxa a fala, «A fama won malide won ma tɔɔrɛ nun won ma wali kui, won naxan nabama bɔxi ma Alatala bara dɛnnaxɛ danka.»

sentences.english: And after the birth of Noah, Lamech went on living for five hundred and ninety-five years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: Nuha xa bari dangi xanbi, Lameki naxa bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ suuli ɲɛ tongo solomanaani a nun suuli. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And all the years of Lamech's life were seven hundred and seventy-seven: and he came to his end.
sentences.susu: Lameki xa simaya naxa siga ɲɛ kɛmɛ solofere nun ɲɛ tongo solofere a nun solofere. Na xanbi a naxa faxa.

sentences.english: And when Noah was five hundred years old, he became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
sentences.susu: Nuha to bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ suuli, a naxa findi Semi, Hami, nun Yefeti baba ra.

sentences.english: And after a time, when men were increasing on the earth, and had daughters,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui xɛmɛe nun e xa di ginɛe naxa wuya fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: The sons of God saw that the daughters of men were fair; and they took wives for themselves from those who were pleasing to them.
sentences.susu: Ala xa malekɛe naxa yabu yi di ginɛe ra e xa tofanyi ma. Malekɛe naxa ndee sugandi, e naxa e findi e xa ginɛe ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said, My spirit will not be in man for ever, for he is only flesh; so the days of his life will be a hundred and twenty years.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Alatala naxa a fala, «N mu tinma nii xa bu adama fate abadan, barima daalise na a ra. A mu dangima ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn na.»

sentences.english: There were men of great strength and size on the earth in those days; and after that, when the sons of God had connection with the daughters of men, they gave birth to children: these were the great men of old days, the men of great name.
sentences.susu: Na waxati, a nun waxati naxan fa na xanbi ra, nabiyoro bɔnsɔɛ nu na duniɲa ma. Na malekɛe nun na di ginɛe nan nee barixi. Geresoe belebelee nun xili xungbe kanyie nan nu nabiyoro bɔnsɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord saw that the sin of man was great on the earth, and that all the thoughts of his heart were evil.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a to adama bara kobi. Tɛmui birin a xa maɲɔxunyie findixi a kobi nan na.

sentences.english: And the Lord had sorrow because he had made man on the earth, and grief was in his heart.
sentences.susu: Na naxa Alatala tɔɔrɔ han a bara a yɛtɛ maxɔrin munfe ra a adama daaxi. Na fe naxa a bɔɲɛ tɔɔrɔ ki fanyi.

sentences.english: And the Lord said, I will take away man, whom I have made, from the face of the earth, even man and beast and that which goes on the earth and every bird of the air; for I have sorrow for having made them.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a fala, «Adama birin n naxan daaxi, n na birin tongoma nɛ duniɲa ma. Mixi yo, sube yo, bubuse yo, xɔni naxan ɲɛrɛma koore ma yo, n na birin tongoma nɛ duniɲa ma, barima n bara nimisa adama daafe ra.»

sentences.english: But Noah had grace in the eyes of God.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Nuha tan nu rafan Alatala ma.

sentences.english: These are the generations of Noah. Noah was an upright man and without sin in his generation: he went in the ways of God.
sentences.susu: Nuha xa taruxui nan ya. Nuha nu findixi tinxintɔɛ nun sɛniyɛntɔɛ nan na na waxati mixie tagi. A nu birama Ala nan fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And Noah had three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
sentences.susu: Di saxan nan nu Nuha yi ra: Semi, Hami, nun Yefeti.

sentences.english: And the earth was evil in God's eyes and full of violent ways.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa nu bara kana Ala ya i, a xa fe ɲaaxi nu bara gbo yɛ.

sentences.english: And God, looking on the earth, saw that it was evil: for the way of all flesh had become evil on the earth.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa duniɲa to, a kanaxi, mixi birin fe ɲaaxi rabafe.

sentences.english: And God said to Noah, The end of all flesh has come; the earth is full of their violent doings, and now I will put an end to them with the earth.
sentences.susu: Na kui Ala naxa a masen Nuha bɛ, «N wama adama birin tongofe duniɲa ma, barima duniɲa bara kobi a ɲaaxi ra. N wama adama birin nun duniɲa birin kanafe.

sentences.english: Make for yourself an ark of gopher wood with rooms in it, and make it safe from the water inside and out.
sentences.susu: A lanma i xa kunkui banban wuri ra, naxan xili goferi. Konkoe xa lu a kui. Dole xa sa a kui nun a fari.

sentences.english: And this is the way you are to make it: it is to be three hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide, and thirty cubits high.
sentences.susu: I xa a yailan yi ki: I xa kunkui rakuya kanke ya tongo senni nun solofere a nun a tagi. I xa a igbo kanke ya fu nun keren. I xa a ite kanke ya senni nun a tagi.

sentences.english: You are to put a window in the ark, a cubit from the roof, and a door in the side of it, and you are to make it with a lower and second and third floors.
sentences.susu: I xa kunkui xunyi yailan, nɔngɔn ya keren xa lu kunkui xunyi nun kunkui dɛ kiri tagi. I xa naadɛ ti a sɛɛti keren ma. I xa a kui rabagan dɔxɔ saxan.»

sentences.english: For truly, I will send a great flow of waters over the earth, for the destruction from under the heaven of all flesh in which is the breath of life; everything on the earth will come to an end.
sentences.susu: «Na xanbi n tan fama ye radinde duniɲa ma. A mixi birin sɔntɔ. Nimase birin faxama nɛ.

sentences.english: But with you I will make an agreement; and you will come into the ark, you and your sons and your wife and your sons' wives with you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n bara saatɛ tongo i bɛ. I soma nɛ yi kunkui kui, i tan nun i xa die, a nun i xa ginɛ, a nun i xa die xa ginɛe.

sentences.english: And you will take with you into the ark two of every sort of living thing, and keep them safe with you; they will be male and female.
sentences.susu: I xa fa nimase mɔɔli birin firin firin na, xɛmɛ nun ginɛ. Na nan a toma e kisima.

sentences.english: Two of every sort of bird and cattle and of every sort of living thing which goes on the earth will you take with you to keep them from destruction.
sentences.susu: Xɔni bɔnsɔɛ birin firin firin, sube bɔnsɔɛ birin firin firin, bubuse bɔnsɔɛ birin firin firin, e fama i xɔn, i xa e rakisi.

sentences.english: And make a store of every sort of food for yourself and them.
sentences.susu: I xa donse mɔɔli birin baki kunkui kui. I xa sa a ragata i tan bɛ a nun e fan bɛ.»

sentences.english: And all these things Noah did; as God said, so he did.
sentences.susu: Nuha naxa a birin naba Ala naxan masenxi a bɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Noah, Take all your family and go into the ark, for you only in this generation have I seen to be upright.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Nuha bɛ, «So kunkui kui, i tan nun i xa denbaya birin, barima i tan tinxintɔɛ nan i ra yi waxati mixie tagi.

sentences.english: Of every clean beast you will take seven males and seven females, and of the beasts which are not clean, two, the male and his female;
sentences.susu: Sube radaxaxi birin, i xa xɛmɛ solofere nun ginɛ solofere baki. Sube raharamuxi birin, i xa xɛmɛ keren nun ginɛ keren baki.

sentences.english: And of the birds of the air, seven males and seven females, so that their seed may still be living on the face of the earth.
sentences.susu: Xɔni fan a mɔɔli birin, i xa xɛmɛ solofere nun ginɛ solofere baki. Na kui sube mɔɔli birin xa nɔ lude duniɲa ma banbaranyi dangi xanbi.»

sentences.english: For after seven days I will send rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights, for the destruction of every living thing which I have made on the face of the earth.
sentences.susu: «Xi solofere na dangi, n tunɛ ragoroma bɔxi ma. Xi tongo naani tunɛ fama kɔɛ nun yanyi. Nimase birin n naxan daaxi, na birin sɔntɔma nɛ.»

sentences.english: And Noah did everything which the Lord said he was to do.
sentences.susu: Nuha naxa na birin naba Alatala naxan masen a bɛ.

sentences.english: And Noah was six hundred years old when the waters came flowing over all the earth.
sentences.susu: Na tunɛ fama tɛmui naxɛ, Nuha xa simaya nu na ɲɛ kɛmɛ senni.

sentences.english: And Noah, with his sons and his wife and his sons' wives, went into the ark because of the flowing of the waters.
sentences.susu: Nuha yo, a xa ginɛ, a xa die nun nee fan xa ginɛe, e birin naxa e gi ye ma, e sa so kunkui kui.

sentences.english: Of clean beasts, and of beasts which are not clean, and of birds, and of everything which goes on the earth,
sentences.susu: Sube radaxaxie, sube raharamuxie, xɔnie, nun bubusee, e birin

sentences.english: In twos, male and female, they went into the ark with Noah, as God had said.
sentences.susu: naxa siga Nuha xɔn ma kunkui kui, xɛmɛe nun ginɛe, e sa so kunkui kui alɔ Ala Nuha yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And after the seven days, the waters came over all the earth.
sentences.susu: Xi solofere dangi xanbi, na banbaranyi naxa din duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, all the fountains of the great deep came bursting through, and the windows of heaven were open;
sentences.susu: Nuha xa simaya nu na ɲɛ kɛmɛ senni, kike firin, xi fu a nun solofere. Na lɔxɔɛ ye naxan na bɔxi bun ma, na naxa te fɔlɔ, ye naxan na koore ma, na fan naxa goro fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: And rain came down on the earth for forty days and forty nights.
sentences.susu: Tunɛ naxa bira bɔxi ma xi tongo naani. Kɔɛ a nun yanyi, tunɛ fama.

sentences.english: On the same day Noah, with Shem, Ham, and Japheth, his sons, and his wife and his sons' wives, went into the ark;
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, Nuha nun a xa die, Semi, Hami, Yefeti, a xa ginɛ, nun a xa di saxanyie xa ginɛe, e birin naxa so kunkui kui.

sentences.english: And with them, every sort of beast and cattle, and every sort of thing which goes on the earth, and every sort of bird.
sentences.susu: Buurunyi sube bɔnsɔɛ birin, xuruse bɔnsɔɛ birin, bubuse bɔnsɔɛ birin, a nun xɔni bɔnsɔɛ birin, e naxa so kunkui kui.

sentences.english: They went with Noah into the ark, two and two of all flesh in which is the breath of life.
sentences.susu: Daalise naxan birin ɲɛngima, a firin firin, e naxa fa Nuha xɔn ma, e sa so kunkui kui.

sentences.english: Male and female of all flesh went in, as God had said, and the ark was shut by the Lord.
sentences.susu: Nimase birin, xɛmɛ nun ginɛ, e soxi nɛ kunkui kui alɔ Ala Nuha yamarixi ki naxɛ. Na xanbi Alatala naxa naadɛ balan.

sentences.english: And for forty days the waters were over all the earth; and the waters were increased so that the ark was lifted up high over the earth.
sentences.susu: Xi tongo naani banbaranyi tema. A naxa kunkui ite.

sentences.english: And the waters overcame everything and were increased greatly on the earth, and the ark was resting on the face of the waters.
sentences.susu: Ye to gbo bɔxi ma, kunkui naxa dɔxɔ ye fari.

sentences.english: And the waters overcame everything on the earth; and all the mountains under heaven were covered.
sentences.susu: Ye naxa te han a naxa geya birin makoto duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: The waters went fifteen cubits higher, till all the mountains were covered.
sentences.susu: Ye naxa dusu geya xun han kanke ya solofere nun a tagi.

sentences.english: And destruction came on every living thing moving on the earth, birds and cattle and beasts and everything which went on the earth, and every man.
sentences.susu: Nimase naxan birin nu ɲɛrɛma duniɲa ma, e birin naxa faxa: xɔnie, xurusee, buurunyi subee, bubusee, a nun adamadie.

sentences.english: Everything on the dry land, in which was the breath of life, came to its end.
sentences.susu: Nimase naxan birin ɲɛngima xare ma, e birin naxa faxa.

sentences.english: Every living thing on the face of all the earth, man and cattle and things moving on the face of the earth, and birds of the air, came to destruction: only Noah and those who were with him in the ark, were kept from death.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa nimase birin ba duniɲa ma. Nimase birin naxa faxa: adamadie, xurusee, bubusee, a nun xɔni naxee ɲɛrɛma koore ma, fo Nuha keren, a nun naxee nu na a xun ma kunkui kui.

sentences.english: And the waters were over the earth a hundred and fifty days.
sentences.susu: Banbaranyi naxa din duniɲa ma xi kɛmɛ xi tongo suuli.

sentences.english: And God kept Noah in mind, and all the living things and the cattle which were with him in the ark: and God sent a wind over the earth, and the waters went down.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala naxa ratu Nuha ma, a nun buurunyi sube nun xuruse naxee nu na a xun ma kunkui kui. Ala naxa foye radin duniɲa ma, ye fa xɔri fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: And the fountains of the deep and the windows of heaven were shut, and the rain from heaven was stopped.
sentences.susu: Ye naxan nu kelima bɔxi bun ma, na naxa dan. Ye naxan nu kelima koore ma, na fan naxa dan.

sentences.english: And the waters went slowly back from the earth, and at the end of a hundred and fifty days the waters were lower.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ fo nde ba ye ra. Xi kɛmɛ xi tongo suuli kamali xanbi, nde naxa ba ye ra ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And on the seventeenth day of the seventh month the ark came to rest on the mountains of Ararat.
sentences.susu: Kike solofere, xi fu nun solofere nde, kunkui naxa dɔxɔ geyae fari, geya naxee na Ararati bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And still the waters went on falling, till on the first day of the tenth month the tops of the mountains were seen.
sentences.susu: Kike fu xi keren kamali xanbi, geyae fari naxa maba.

sentences.english: Then, after forty days, through the open window of the ark which he had made,
sentences.susu: Xi tongo naani dangi xanbi, Nuha naxa wundɛri rabi naxan na kunkui ma.

sentences.english: Noah sent out a raven, which went this way and that till the waters were gone from the earth.
sentences.susu: A naxa xaxa bɛɲin, a nu siga, a nu fa, han ye naxa xurun.

sentences.english: And he sent out a dove, to see if the waters had gone from the face of the earth;
sentences.susu: Na xanbi a naxa ganbɛ bɛɲin, a xa kolon xa ye bara xɔri.

sentences.english: But the dove saw no resting-place for her foot, and came back to the ark, for the waters were still over all the earth; and he put out his hand, and took her into the ark.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na ganbɛ naxa yire mato, santide mu na, barima ye dinxi duniɲa birin ma. A naxa gbilen Nuha yire. Nuha naxa ganbɛ tongo, a a raso kunkui kui.

sentences.english: And after waiting another seven days, he sent the dove out again;
sentences.susu: A naxa mamɛ ti han xi solofere, a man naxa ganbɛ bɛɲin a firin nde.

sentences.english: And the dove came back at evening, and in her mouth was an olive-leaf broken off: so Noah was certain that the waters had gone down on the earth.
sentences.susu: Nunmare, ganbɛ naxa gbilen Nuha yire, oliwi wuri ɲingi suxuxi a dɛkole ra. Na kui Nuha naxa a kolon ye bara ba duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: And after seven days more, he sent the dove out again, but she did not come back to him.
sentences.susu: A naxa mamɛ ti xi solofere. A naxa ganbɛ bɛɲin a saxan nde, kɔnɔ ganbɛ mu gbilen.

sentences.english: And in the six hundred and first year, on the first day of the first month, the waters were dry on the earth: and Noah took the cover off the ark and saw that the face of the earth was dry.
sentences.susu: Nuha xa simaya to siga ɲɛ kɛmɛ senni nun ɲɛ keren, kike keren, xi keren, banbaranyi fa ɲɔn duniɲa ma. Nuha to kunkui xunyi ba naa, a naxa a to xare bara maba.

sentences.english: And on the twenty-seventh day of the second month the earth was dry.
sentences.susu: Kike firin xi mɔxɔɲɛn a nun solofere to dangi, bɔxi nu bara xara a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And God said to Noah,
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen Nuha bɛ,

sentences.english: Go out of the ark, you and your wife and your sons and your sons' wives.
sentences.susu: «Wo mini kunkui kui, i tan nun i xa ginɛ, i xa die nun e xa ginɛe.

sentences.english: Take out with you every living thing which is with you, birds and cattle and everything which goes on the earth, so that they may have offspring and be fertile and be increased on the earth.
sentences.susu: I xa nimase birin namini kunkui kui: xɔnie, subee, bubusee, alako e xa yiriwa, e xa wuya duniɲa ma.»

sentences.english: And Noah went out with his sons and his wife and his sons' wives;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Nuha naxa mini fa, a nun a xa die, a xa ginɛ, nun a xa die xa ginɛe.

sentences.english: And every beast and bird and every living thing of every sort which goes on the earth, went out of the ark.
sentences.susu: Subee fan naxa mini, a nun bubusee, nun xɔnie. Nimase bɔnsɔɛ birin naxa mini e xati xati ma.

sentences.english: And Noah made an altar to the Lord, and from every clean beast and bird he made burned offerings on the altar.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Nuha naxa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan Alatala bɛ. A naxa sube nun xɔni radaxaxi ndee tongo, a nee ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra.

sentences.english: And when the sweet smell came up to the Lord, he said in his heart, I will not again put a curse on the earth because of man, for the thoughts of man's heart are evil from his earliest days; never again will I send destruction on all living things as I have done.
sentences.susu: Na tuuri to te, Alatala naxa na gan xiri mɛ. A naxa rafan a ma. A naxa a fala a bɔɲɛ ma, «N mu bɔxi dankama sɔnɔn adama xa fe ra, barima n na kolon adama bɔɲɛ mu fan kafi a dimɛdi tɛmui. N mu nimase birin sɔntɔma sɔnɔn alɔ n na singe raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: While the earth goes on, seed time and the getting in of the grain, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night, will not come to an end.
sentences.susu: Sansi si tɛmui nun sansi xaba tɛmui, xinbeli nun kuyefure, sogofure nun ɲɛmɛ, yanyi nun kɔɛ, n mu na bama sɔnɔn han duniɲa ɲɔn.»

sentences.english: And God gave his blessing to Noah and his sons, and said, Be fertile, and have increase, and make the earth full.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi Ala naxa barakɛ sa Nuha nun a xa die xa fe. A naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo xa wuya, wo xa yiriwa, wo xa gbo bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the fear of you will be strong in every beast of the earth and every bird of the air; everything which goes on the land, and all the fishes of the sea, are given into your hands.
sentences.susu: Sube naxee na duniɲa ma nun xɔni naxee na koore ma, e gaaxuma nɛ wo ya ra. Bubuse naxee na bɔxi ma nun yɛxɛ naxee na baa ma, e e gima nɛ wo ya ra. N bara e birin sa wo sago,

sentences.english: Every living and moving thing will be food for you; I give them all to you as before I gave you all green things.
sentences.susu: n bara e birin findi baloe ra wo bɛ alɔ sansie n naxan singe fi wo ma donse ra.»

sentences.english: But flesh with the life-blood in it you may not take for food.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ wo naxa sube don, naxan wuli mu baxi, barima a wuli findixi sube nii nan na.

sentences.english: And for your blood, which is your life, will I take payment; from every beast I will take it, and from every man will I take payment for the blood of his brother-man.
sentences.susu: Sube yo naxan wo nii bama, xa na mu a ra mixi yo naxan a boore adamadi nii bama, na kanyi nan gbe na na nii kote sare ra.

sentences.english: Whoever takes a man's life, by man will his life be taken; because God made man in his image.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan adamadi nii bama, mixi nan na kanyi fan nii bama, barima Ala fɔxi bara lu adama ma.

sentences.english: And now, be fertile and have increase; have offspring on the earth and become great in number.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wuya, wo xa yiriwa, wo xa gbo bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And God said to Noah and to his sons,
sentences.susu: Na xanbi Ala naxa a masen Nuha nun a xa die bɛ,

sentences.english: Truly, I will make my agreement with you and with your seed after you,
sentences.susu: «N bara saatɛ tongo wo nun wo xa die bɛ,

sentences.english: And with every living thing with you, all birds and cattle and every beast of the earth which comes out of the ark with you.
sentences.susu: a nun nimase naxan birin nu na kunkui kui: xɔnie, xurusee, buurunyi subee, nimase naxan birin na duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: And I will make my agreement with you; never again will all flesh be cut off by the waters; never again will the waters come over all the earth for its destruction.
sentences.susu: N bara saatɛ tongo wo bɛ, banbaranyi tan mu nii birin bama sɔnɔn, a mu duniɲa birin kanama fa.»

sentences.english: And God said, This is the sign of the agreement which I make between me and you and every living thing with you, for all future generations:
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen, «N bara saatɛ tongo wo nun nimase birin bɛ, saatɛ naxan mu kanama abadan.

sentences.english: I will put my bow in the cloud and it will be for a sign of the agreement between me and the earth.
sentences.susu: Saatɛ tɔnxuma nan ya, n senkui masenma nɛ koore ma.

sentences.english: And whenever I make a cloud come over the earth, the bow will be seen in the cloud,
sentences.susu: Xa n bara kunda sa koore ma, na senkui minima nɛ.

sentences.english: And I will keep in mind the agreement between me and you and every living thing; and never again will there be a great flow of waters causing destruction to all flesh.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n natuma nɛ saatɛ xa fe ma, n saatɛ naxan tongoxi wo nun nimase birin bɛ. N mu nii birin bama duniɲa ma banbaranyi ra sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And the bow will be in the cloud, and looking on it, I will keep in mind the eternal agreement between God and every living thing on the earth.
sentences.susu: Senkui na mini koore ma, n na toma, n natuma saatɛ xa fe ma, saatɛ naxan mu kanama abadan, n saatɛ naxan tongoxi wo nun nimase birin bɛ naxee na duniɲa ma.»

sentences.english: And God said to Noah, This is the sign of the agreement which I have made between me and all flesh on the earth.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen Nuha bɛ, «Saatɛ tɔnxuma nan ya, n na saatɛ naxan tongoxi nimase birin bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the sons of Noah who went out of the ark were Shem, Ham, and Japheth; and Ham is the father of Canaan.
sentences.susu: Nuha xa di naxee kelixi kunkui kui, e xili Semi, Hami, Yefeti. Hami findixi Kanaankae baba nan na.

sentences.english: These three were the sons of Noah and from them all the earth was peopled.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa mixi birin fatanxi Nuha xa di saxanyie nan na.

sentences.english: In those days Noah became a farmer, and he made a vine-garden.
sentences.susu: Nuha to xɛ rawali fɔlɔ, a naxa wɛni sansi si.

sentences.english: And he took of the wine of it and was overcome by drink; and he was uncovered in his tent.
sentences.susu: Na sansi to bogi, Nuha naxa wɛni yailan. A to siisi na ra, a naxa a sa kiri banxi kui a mageli.

sentences.english: And Ham, the father of Canaan, saw his father unclothed, and gave news of it to his two brothers outside.
sentences.susu: Kanaankae benba Hami to a baba mageli to, a naxa na fala a taarae bɛ.

sentences.english: And Shem and Japheth took a robe, and putting it on their backs went in with their faces turned away, and put it over their father so that they might not see him unclothed.
sentences.susu: Na kui Semi nun Yefeti naxa dugi tongo fa, e so e baba xun e xanbi xanbi ma. E naxa dugi felen e baba ma, e mu e ya ti e baba mageli ra.

sentences.english: And, awaking from his wine, Noah saw what his youngest son had done to him, and he said,
sentences.susu: Nuha xun to mabɔɔ a ra, a naxa keli, a naxa a kolon fa a xa di dɔnxɔɛ naxan nabaxi a ra.

sentences.english: Cursed be Canaan; let him be a servant of servants to his brothers.
sentences.susu: Nuha naxa a fala, «N bara Kanaan danka. A xa findi konyi birin dɔnxɔɛ ra a taarae bɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said, Praise to the Lord, the God of Shem; let Canaan be his servant.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a fala, «N bara Semi Marigi Alatala matɔxɔ. Kanaan xa findi Semi xa konyi ra.

sentences.english: May God make Japheth great, and let his living-place be in the tents of Shem, and let Canaan be his servant.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Yefeti xa bɔxi gbo, a xa lu Semi xa niini bun ma, Kanaan xa findi a xa konyi ra.»

sentences.english: And Noah went on living three hundred and fifty years after the great flow of waters;
sentences.susu: Banbaranyi dangi xanbi, Nuha naxa bu duniɲa ma ɲɛ kɛmɛ saxan ɲɛ tongo suuli.

sentences.english: all the years of his life were nine hundred and fifty: and he came to his end.
sentences.susu: Nuha xa simaya to ɲɛ kɛmɛ solomanaani ɲɛ tongo suuli li, a naxa laaxira.

sentences.english: Now these are the generations of the sons of Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth: these are the sons which they had after the great flow of waters
sentences.susu: Nuha xa die, Semi, Hami, nun Yefeti xa taruxui nan ya, a nun e fan xa die e naxee sɔtɔ banbaranyi dangi xanbi.

sentences.english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.
sentences.susu: Yefeti xa die xilie nan ya: Gomeri, Magogo, Madayi, Yawani, Tubali, Meseki, Tirasi.

sentences.english: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz and Riphath and Togarmah.
sentences.susu: Gomeri xa die xilie nan ya: Asikenasi, Rifati, Togarama.

sentences.english: And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish, the Kittim and the Dodanim.
sentences.susu: Yawani xa die xilie nan ya: Elisaha, Tarasisi, Kitimi, Rodanimi.

sentences.english: From these came the nations of the sea-lands, with their different families and languages.
sentences.susu: Yefeti xa mixie naxa sabati baa dɛ ra e xabilɛ ki ma, kankan nun a gbe xui. E naxa findi si dɔxɔ wuyaxi ra e xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the sons of Ham: Cush and Mizraim and Put and Canaan.
sentences.susu: Hami xa die xilie nan ya: Kusi, Misira, Puti, Kanaan.

sentences.english: And the sons of Cush: Seba and Havilah and Sabtah and Raamah and Sabteca; and the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
sentences.susu: Kusi xa die xilie nan ya: Seba, Hawila, Sabata, Raama, Sabiteka. Raama xa die xilie nan ya: Seeba, Dedan.

sentences.english: And Cush was the father of Nimrod, who was the first of the great men of the earth.
sentences.susu: Nimirodi geresoe belebele nan nu a ra. A baba xili Kusi.

sentences.english: He was a very great bowman, so that there is a saying, Like Nimrod, a very great bowman.
sentences.susu: Nimirodi man findi koyinma belebele ra Alatala ya i. Mixie nu a falama, «Koyinma belebele nan Nimirodi ra Alatala ya i.»

sentences.english: And at the first, his kingdom was Babel and Erech and Accad and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya taa singee findi Babilɔn, Ereki, Akadi, nun Kalene nan na, naxee nu na Sinari bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: From that land he went out into Assyria, building Nineveh with its wide streets and Calah,
sentences.susu: A naxa keli Sinari, a siga Asiriya bɔxi ma. Mɛnni a naxa taae ti naxee xili Ninewe, Rehoboti, Iri, Kala,

sentences.english: And Resen between Nineveh and Calah, which is a very great town.
sentences.susu: nun Resen, taa belebele naxan na Ninewe nun Kala tagi.

sentences.english: And Mizraim was the father of the Ludim and Anamim and Lehabim and Naphtuhim;
sentences.susu: Misira naxa findi Ludukae, Anamikae, Lehabakae, Nafatu,

sentences.english: And Pathrusim and Casluhim and Caphtorim, from whom came the Philistines.
sentences.susu: Patirusukae, Kasaluxukae, (Filisitakae keli dɛnnaxɛ), a nun Kafatorokae benba ra.

sentences.english: And Canaan was the father of Zidon, who was his oldest son, and Heth,
sentences.susu: Kanaan naxa findi yi mixie baba ra: Sidɔnkae, a xa di singe, Xitikae,

sentences.english: And the Jebusite and the Amorite and the Girgashite,
sentences.susu: Yebusukae, Amorikae, Girigasakae,

sentences.english: And the Hivite and the Arkite and the Sinite,
sentences.susu: Hiwikae, Arakikae, Sinikae,

sentences.english: And the Arvadite and the Zemarite and the Hamathite; after that the families of the Canaanites went far and wide in all directions;
sentences.susu: Arawadakae, Semarakae, nun Xamatakae. Bɔnsɔɛ naxan birin keli Kanaan, e naxa yensen yɛ.

sentences.english: Their country stretching from Zidon to Gaza, in the direction of Gerar; and to Lasha, in the direction of Sodom and Gomorrah and Admah and Zeboiim.
sentences.susu: Kanaan xa naaninyi naxa keli Sidɔn sigafe Gerara, a naxa siga han Gasa, a dangi Sodoma, Gomora, Adamaha, nun Seboyimi ra, a siga han Lasa.

sentences.english: All these, with their different families, languages, lands, and nations, are the offspring of Ham.
sentences.susu: Hami xa mixie nan ya e xabilɛ ki ma, kankan nun a gbe xui. E naxa findi si dɔxɔ wuyaxi ra e xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Shem, the older brother of Japheth, the father of the children of Eber, had other sons in addition.
sentences.susu: Yefeti xunya Semi fan naxa die sɔtɔ. Eberi xa die benba nan na Semi ra.

sentences.english: These are the sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad and Lud and Aram.
sentences.susu: Semi xa die xilie nan ya: Elama, Asuri, Arafaxadi, Ludu, nun Arami.

sentences.english: And the sons of Aram: Uz and Hul and Gether and Mash.
sentences.susu: Arami xa die xilie nan ya: Usi, Xulu, Geteri, nun Meseki.

sentences.english: And Arpachshad became the father of Shelah; and Shelah became the father of Eber.
sentences.susu: Arafaxadi naxa findi Selaha baba ra. Selaha naxa findi Eberi baba ra.

sentences.english: And Eber had two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, because in his time the peoples of the earth became separate; and his brother's name was Joktan.
sentences.susu: Eberi naxa di firin sɔtɔ. Keren xili Pelegi. Na nan falaxi «maitaxunyi,» barima Ala duniɲa mixie itaxun na waxati nɛ. A xunya xili Yokatan.

sentences.english: And Joktan was the father of Almodad and Sheleph and Hazarmaveth and Jerah
sentences.susu: Yokatan xa die xilie nan ya: Alomodadi, Selefa, Hasaramawete, Yera,

sentences.english: And Hadoram and Uzal and Diklah
sentences.susu: Hadorami, Usali, Dikila,

sentences.english: And Obal and Abimael and Sheba
sentences.susu: Obala, Abimayele, Seeba,

sentences.english: And Ophir and Havilah and Jobab; all these were the sons of Joktan.
sentences.susu: Ofiri, Hawila, nun Yobabo. Yokatan naxa na die birin sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And their country was from Mesha, in the direction of Sephar, the mountain of the east.
sentences.susu: E xa bɔxi kelima Mesa, a siga han Sefare, naxan na geya sogetede mabiri.

sentences.english: These, with their families and their languages and their lands and their nations, are the offspring of Shem.
sentences.susu: Semi xa die nan ya a xabilɛ ki ma, kankan nun a gbe xui. E naxa findi si dɔxɔ wuyaxi ra e xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: These are the families of the sons of Noah, in the order of their generations and their nations: from these came all the nations of the earth after the great flow of waters.
sentences.susu: Nuha xa die bɔnsɔɛe xa taruxui nan na ki. Banbaranyi dangi xanbi, yi bɔnsɔɛ nan findi duniɲa si birin na.

sentences.english: And all the earth had one language and one tongue.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui duniɲa mixi birin nu xui keren nan falama.

sentences.english: And it came about that in their wandering from the east, they came to a stretch of flat country in the land of Shinar, and there they made their living-place.
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee naxa keli, e siga sogetede mabiri, e geya to Sinari bɔxi ma. E naxa sabati kɛnɛ ma naxan na gulunba kui.

sentences.english: And they said one to another, Come, let us make bricks, burning them well. And they had bricks for stone, putting them together with sticky earth.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala e boore bɛ, «Wo fa, won xa biriki bɔnbɔ, won xa e gan.» E naxa biriki findi gɛmɛ ɲɔxɔɛ ra. E naxa mɔta findi dole ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And they said, Come, let us make a town, and a tower whose top will go up as high as heaven; and let us make a great name for ourselves, so that we may not be wanderers over the face of the earth.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi e naxa a fala, «Won wali suxu, won xa taa ti won yɛtɛ bɛ, a nun banxi belebele naxan tema han koore ma, alako won xili xa gbo. Na na a ra, won mu lɔɛma won boore ma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord came down to see the town and the tower which the children of men were building.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala naxa goro na taa matode, a nun na banxi belebele.

sentences.english: And the Lord said, See, they are all one people and have all one language; and this is only the start of what they may do: and now it will not be possible to keep them from any purpose of theirs.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «Xa yi mixie bara kafu e boore ma yi wali rabade, e na xui keren fala, wali birin e wama naxan nabafe, a sɔɔnɛyama nɛ.

sentences.english: Come, let us go down and take away the sense of their language, so that they will not be able to make themselves clear to one another.
sentences.susu: Won xɛɛ, won xa goro e xa xui masunbude alako e naxa e boore wɔyɛn xui fahaamu.»

sentences.english: So the Lord God sent them away into every part of the earth: and they gave up building their town.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala naxa na gali rayensen yɛ. Na banxi tife naxa dan.

sentences.english: So it was named Babel, because there the Lord took away the sense of all languages and from there the Lord sent them away over all the face of the earth.
sentences.susu: Na yire xili naxa sa Babeli, barima Alatala duniɲa mixie xuie rawuya mɛnni nɛ, a fa e rayensen yɛ duniɲa birin ma.

sentences.english: These are the generations of Shem. Shem was a hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad, two years after the great flow of waters;
sentences.susu: Semi xa taruxui nan ya. Banbaranyi dangi xanbi ɲɛ firin, Semi xa simaya naxa ɲɛ kɛmɛ li. A naxa findi Arafaxadi baba ra.

sentences.english: And after the birth of Arpachshad, Shem went on living for five hundred years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: A to Arafaxadi sɔtɔ, Semi naxa ɲɛ kɛmɛ suuli sa a fari. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Arpachshad was thirty-five years old when he became the father of Shelah:
sentences.susu: Arafaxadi to ɲɛ tongo saxan a nun suuli sɔtɔ, a naxa findi Selaha baba ra.

sentences.english: And after the birth of Shelah, Arpachshad went on living for four hundred and three years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: A to Selaha sɔtɔ, Arafaxadi naxa bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ naani nun ɲɛ saxan. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Shelah was thirty years old when he became the father of Eber:
sentences.susu: Selaha to ɲɛ tongo saxan sɔtɔ, a naxa findi Eberi baba ra.

sentences.english: And after the birth of Eber, Shelah went on living for four hundred and three years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: A to Eberi sɔtɔ, Selaha naxa bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ naani nun ɲɛ saxan. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Eber was thirty-four years old when he became the father of Peleg:
sentences.susu: Eberi to ɲɛ tongo saxan nun naani sɔtɔ, a naxa findi Pelegi baba ra.

sentences.english: And after the birth of Peleg, Eber went on living for four hundred and thirty years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: A to Pelegi sɔtɔ, Eberi naxa bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ naani nun ɲɛ tongo saxan. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Peleg was thirty years old when he became the father of Reu:
sentences.susu: Pelegi to ɲɛ tongo saxan sɔtɔ, a naxa findi Ruye baba ra.

sentences.english: And after the birth of Reu, Peleg went on living for two hundred and nine years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: A to Ruye sɔtɔ, Pelegi naxa bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ firin nun ɲɛ solomanaani. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Reu was thirty-two years old when he became the father of Serug:
sentences.susu: Ruye to ɲɛ tongo saxan a nun firin sɔtɔ, a naxa findi Serugu baba ra.

sentences.english: And after the birth of Serug, Reu went on living for two hundred and seven years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: A to Serugu sɔtɔ, Ruye naxa bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ firin nun ɲɛ solofere. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Serug was thirty years old when he became the father of Nahor:
sentences.susu: Serugu to ɲɛ tongo saxan sɔtɔ, a naxa findi Naxori baba ra.

sentences.english: And after the birth of Nahor, Serug went on living for two hundred years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: A to Naxori sɔtɔ, Serugu naxa bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ firin. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Nahor was twenty-nine years old when he became the father of Terah:
sentences.susu: Naxori to ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun solomanaani sɔtɔ, a naxa findi Tera baba ra.

sentences.english: And after the birth of Terah, Nahor went on living for a hundred and nineteen years, and had sons and daughters:
sentences.susu: A to Tera sɔtɔ, Naxori naxa bu ɲɛ kɛmɛ nun ɲɛ fu nun solomanaani. A naxa di xɛmɛ nun di ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Terah was seventy years old when he became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
sentences.susu: Tera to ɲɛ tongo solofere sɔtɔ, a naxa findi Iburama, Naxori, nun Xarani baba ra.

sentences.english: These are the generations of Terah: Terah was the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran was the father of Lot.
sentences.susu: Tera xa taruxui nan ya. Tera naxa findi Iburama, Naxori, nun Xarani baba ra. Xarani naxa findi Loti baba ra.

sentences.english: And death came to Haran when he was with his father Terah in the land of his birth, Ur of the Chaldees.
sentences.susu: Xarani singe naxa faxa a baba Tera bɛ Uru, Kalidi bɔxi ma, a barixi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And Abram and Nahor took wives for themselves: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor's wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah and Iscah.
sentences.susu: Iburama nun Naxori naxa ginɛe fen, e naxa futi xiri. Iburama xa ginɛ xili Sarayi. Naxori xa ginɛ xili Milika. Milika Xarani xa di na a ra. Di firin nu na Xarani yi ra, Milika nun Isika.

sentences.english: And Sarai had no child.
sentences.susu: Sarayi dibaritare nan nu a ra. Di yo mu nu na a bɛ.

sentences.english: And Terah took Abram, his son, and Lot, the son of Haran, and Sarai, his daughter-in-law, the wife of his son Abram and they went out from Ur of the Chaldees, to go to the land of Canaan; and they came to Haran, and were there for some time.
sentences.susu: Tera naxa a xa di Iburama, a xa mamadi Loti, naxan findixi Xarani xa di ra, nun Iburama xa ginɛ Sarayi tongo, e naxa keli Uru Kalidi bɔxi ma sigafe ra Kanaan bɔxi ma. Kɔnɔ e to Xarani li, e naxa sabati mɛnni.

sentences.english: And all the years of Terah's life were two hundred and five: and Terah came to his end in Haran.
sentences.susu: Tera xa simaya to ɲɛ kɛmɛ firin ɲɛ suuli li, a naxa laaxira Xarani.

sentences.english: Now the Lord said to Abram, Go out from your country and from your family and from your father's house, into the land to which I will be your guide:
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Iburama bɛ, «I xa bɔxi bɛɲin, i xa mixie bɛɲin, i xabilɛ bɛɲin. I xa siga bɔxi ma n dɛnnaxɛ masenma i bɛ.

sentences.english: And I will make of you a great nation, blessing you and making your name great; and you will be a blessing:
sentences.susu: N i findima nɛ si belebele ra. N barakɛ sama nɛ i xa fe. N i xili gboma nɛ. Mixie fan barakɛ sɔtɔma i tan nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: To them who are good to you will I give blessing, and on him who does you wrong will I put my curse: and you will become a name of blessing to all the families of the earth.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan dubama i bɛ, n fan barakɛ sama nɛ na kanyi ma. Mixi naxan i dankama, n fan na kanyi dankama nɛ. Duniɲa birin barakɛ sɔtɔma i tan nan saabui ra.»

sentences.english: So Abram went as the Lord had said to him, and Lot went with him: Abram was seventy-five years old when he went away from Haran.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Iburama naxa keli Xarani alɔ Alatala a masenxi a bɛ ki naxɛ. Loti fan naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And Abram took Sarai, his wife, and Lot, his brother's son, and all their goods and the servants which they had got in Haran, and they went out to go to the land of Canaan.
sentences.susu: Iburama to keli Xarani, a xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ tongo solofere nun suuli li. A naxa a xa ginɛ Sarayi, a xunya xa di Loti, a harige birin, nun mixie a naxee sɔtɔ Xarani, a naxa e birin xanin Kanaan bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Abram went through the land till he came to Shechem, to the holy tree of Moreh. At that time, the Canaanites were still living in the land.
sentences.susu: Iburama naxa ɲɛrɛ han a naxa wuri bili belebele nde li dɛnnaxɛ xili More, Sikemi mabiri. Kanaankae nu sabatixi mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord came to Abram, and said, I will give all this land to your seed; then Abram made an altar there to the Lord who had let himself be seen by him.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a yɛtɛ masen Iburama bɛ. A naxa a fala, «N yi bɔxi nan fima i bɔnsɔɛ ma.» Na kui Iburama naxa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan Alatala bɛ naxan minixi a ma.

sentences.english: And moving on from there to the mountain on the east of Beth-el, he put up his tent, having Beth-el on the west and Ai on the east: and there he made an altar and gave worship to the name of the Lord.
sentences.susu: A naxa siga geya ma Beteli fuge ra. A naxa kiri banxi ti mɛnni, Beteli na a sogegorode, Ayi na a sogetede. A naxa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan Alatala bɛ, a fa a maxandi a xili ra.

sentences.english: And he went on, journeying still to the South.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi a naxa siga Negewi gbengberen yire biri.

sentences.english: And because there was little food to be had in that land, he went down into Egypt.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, kaamɛ nu bara din Kanaan bɔxi ra. Iburama naxa siga Misira.

sentences.english: Now when he came near to Egypt, he said to Sarai, his wife, Truly, you are a fair woman and beautiful to the eye;
sentences.susu: Beenu e xa so Misira bɔxi ma, Iburama naxa a fala a xa ginɛ Sarayi bɛ, «N a kolon, ginɛ tofanyi nan i ra.

sentences.english: And I am certain that when the men of Egypt see you, they will say, This is his wife: and they will put me to death and keep you.
sentences.susu: Misirakae na i to ya, e a falama nɛ n ma ginɛ nan i ra. Na xanbi, e n faxama nɛ, alako e xa i tongo.

sentences.english: Say, then, that you are my sister, and so it will be well with me because of you, and my life will be kept safe on your account.
sentences.susu: I xa a fala e bɛ n xunya nan lanxi i ma, alako e xa mɛɛni n ma i xa fe ra. Na kui, n mu faxama i tan saabui ra.»

sentences.english: And so it was that when Abram came into Egypt, the men of Egypt, looking on the woman, saw that she was fair.
sentences.susu: Iburama to Misira li, Misirakae naxa a to, Sarayi ginɛ tofanyi nan a ra.

sentences.english: And Pharaoh's great men, having seen her, said words in praise of her to Pharaoh, and she was taken into Pharaoh's house.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ xa sansalae to Sarayi matɔxɔ a bɛ, a naxa a xanin a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And because of her, he was good to Abram, and he had sheep and oxen and asses, and men-servants and women-servants, and camels.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa mɛɛni Iburama ma Sarayi saabui ra. A naxa xuruse lanmae, xuruse xungbee, sofalee, konyie, nun ɲɔxɔmɛe fi a ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord sent great troubles on Pharaoh's house because of Sarai, Abram's wife.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala naxa fure ɲaaxi sa Misira mangɛ nun a xa denbaya ma, Iburama xa ginɛ Sarayi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Then Pharaoh sent for Abram, and said, What have you done to me? why did you not say that she was your wife?
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa Iburama xili. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «I munse rabaxi n na? Munfe ra i mu a fala n bɛ i xa ginɛ nan a ra.

sentences.english: Why did you say that she was your sister? so that I took her for my wife: now, take your wife and go on your way.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra i a falaxi i xunya na a ra, han n tan bara a findi n ma ginɛ ra? Awa, n ko, i xa ginɛ nan ya. Wo siga!»

sentences.english: And Pharaoh gave orders to his men, and they sent him on his way, with his wife and all he had.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Misira mangɛ naxa Iburama xa fe fala a xa korogbae bɛ. E naxa a ragbɛngbɛn, a tan, a xa ginɛ, nun a harige birin.

sentences.english: And Abram went up out of Egypt with his wife and all he had, and Lot with him, and they came in to the South.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Iburama naxa keli Misira, a siga Negewi gbengberen yire mabiri. A naxa a xa ginɛ nun a harige birin xanin a xun ma. A xunya xa di Loti fan naxa a mati naa.

sentences.english: Now Abram had great wealth of cattle and silver and gold.
sentences.susu: Iburama nu bara findi banna ra. Xurusee, gbeti, nun xɛɛma nu na a yi ra.

sentences.english: And travelling on from the South, he came to Beth-el, to the place where his tent had been before, between Beth-el and Ai;
sentences.susu: A naxa keli Negewi, a nu a xa ɲɛrɛ tagi isuxu, sigafe ra

sentences.english: To the place where he had made his first altar, and there Abram gave worship to the name of the Lord.
sentences.susu: yire nde Beteli nun Ayi tagi, a nu bara sɛrɛxɛbade ti dɛnnaxɛ. Mɛnni Iburama naxa Alatala maxandi a xili ra.

sentences.english: And Lot, who went with him, had flocks and herds and tents;
sentences.susu: Loti, naxan nu na Iburama fɔxɔ ra, a fan findixi xurusee nun kiri banxie kanyi nan na.

sentences.english: So that the land was not wide enough for the two of them: their property was so great that there was not room for them together.
sentences.susu: Iburama xa xuruse gɔɔrɛ nun Loti xa xuruse gɔɔrɛ nu gbo na bɔxi bɛ. E mu nu nɔma lude yire keren sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And there was an argument between the keepers of Abram's cattle and the keepers of Lot's cattle: at that time the Canaanites and Perizzites were still living in the land.
sentences.susu: Sɔnxɔɛ naxa mini Iburama xa xuruse dɛmadonyie a nun Loti xa xuruse dɛmadonyie tagi. Kanaankae nun Perisikae fan nu na mɛnni na waxati.

sentences.english: Then Abram said to Lot, Let there be no argument between me and you, and between my herdmen and your herdmen, for we are brothers.
sentences.susu: Iburama naxa a fala Loti bɛ, «Won naxa kɔnɲɛ, won ma xuruse dɛmadonyie fan mu lan e xa kɔnɲɛ, barima won tan ngaxakerenma nan won na.

sentences.english: Is not all the land before you? then let us go our separate ways: if you go to the left, I will go to the right; or if you take the right, I will go to the left.
sentences.susu: Yi bɔxi birin nan i ya i yi ki. Won naxan nabama, won xa fatan. Xa i siga kɔɔla ma, n tan sigama yirefanyi nan ma. Xa i siga yirefanyi ma, n tan siga kɔɔla ma.»
