sentences.english: And Lot, lifting up his eyes and looking an the valley of Jordan, saw that it was well watered everywhere, before the Lord had sent destruction on Sodom and Gomorrah; it was like the garden of the Lord, like the land of Egypt, on the way to Zoar.
sentences.susu: Loti naxa a ya rasiga, a naxa sa Yurudɛn mɛrɛ to. Ye nu na na a fanyi ra. Beenu Alatala xa Sodoma nun Gomora kana, na bɔxie nu fan han Sowari biri. Na nu luxi alɔ Misira bɔxi, alɔ Alatala xa yire yailanxi.

sentences.english: So Lot took for himself all the valley of Jordan, and went to the east, and they were parted from one another.
sentences.susu: Na kui Loti naxa Yurudɛn mɛrɛ sugandi a yɛtɛ bɛ. A naxa siga sogetede mabiri. Iburama nun Loti fatan na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Abram went on living in the land of Canaan, and Lot went to the lowland towns, moving his tent as far as Sodom.
sentences.susu: Iburama naxa lu Kanaan bɔxi ma, Loti naxa lu Yurudɛn mɛrɛ taae tagi. Loti naxa a xa kiri banxie ti Sodoma fɛ ma.

sentences.english: Now the men of Sodom were evil, and great sinners before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sodomakae nu bara kobi a gbe ra, e nu bara findi yunubitɔɛ belebele ra Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord had said to Abram, after Lot was parted from him, From this place where you are take a look to the north and to the south, to the east and to the west:
sentences.susu: Iburama nun Loti to fatan, Alatala naxa a masen Iburama bɛ, «I ya ti sogetede ra, sogegorode, yirefanyi, nun kɔɔla.

sentences.english: For all the land which you see I will give to you and to your seed for ever.
sentences.susu: I bɔxi naxan birin toxi, n a fima i tan nun i bɔnsɔɛ ma abadan.

sentences.english: And I will make your children like the dust of the earth, so that if the dust of the earth may be numbered, then will your children be numbered.
sentences.susu: N i bɔnsɔɛ rawuyama nɛ alɔ xube naxan na bɔxi ma. Xa mixi nde nɔma xube kɔntide, a nɔma nɛ i bɔnsɔɛ kɔnti fan kolonde.

sentences.english: Come, go through all the land from one end to the other for I will give it to you.
sentences.susu: Keli, i bɔxi iɲɛrɛ, a kuyɛya nun a gboya, i xa a birin mato barima n a fima i tan nan ma.»

sentences.english: And Abram, moving his tent, came and made his living-place by the holy tree of Mamre, which is in Hebron, and made an altar there to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Iburama naxa kiri banxi yire masara. A naxa sabati wuri belebele ndee mabiri naxan na Mamire nun Hebiron fɛ ma. A naxa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan naa Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: Now in the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar, Arioch, king of Ellasar, Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim,
sentences.susu: Na waxati Babilɔn bɔxi mangɛ Amarafeli, Elasari bɔxi mangɛ Ariyoki, Elama bɔxi mangɛ Kedorolameri, nun Goyin bɔxi mangɛ Tidali, yi mangɛ naani naxa saatɛ tongo e boore bɛ mangɛ suuli ndee gerefe ra.

sentences.english: They made war with Bera, king of Sodom, and with Birsha, king of Gomorrah, Shinab, king of Admah, and Shemeber, king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (which is Zoar).
sentences.susu: Na mangɛ suuli nan ya: Sodoma mangɛ Bera, Gomora mangɛ Birisa, Adamaha mangɛ Sinabu, Seboyimi mangɛ Semeberi, nun Bela mangɛ Sowari.

sentences.english: All these came together in the valley of Siddim (which is the Salt Sea).
sentences.susu: Yi mangɛ suuli naxa e malan gulunba nde kui naxan xili Sidimi, Fɔxɔɛ Baa na dɛnnaxɛ to.

sentences.english: For twelve years they were under the rule of Chedorlaomer, but in the thirteenth year they put off his control.
sentences.susu: Kabi ɲɛ fu nun firin yi mangɛ suuli nu na mangɛ Kedorolameri xa nɔɛ bun ma, kɔnɔ ɲɛ fu nun saxan nde e naxa muruta a xa mangɛya ma.

sentences.english: And in the fourteenth year, Chedorlaomer and the kings who were on his side, overcame the Rephaim in Ashteroth-karnaim, and the Zuzim in Ham, and the Emim in Shaveh-kiriathaim,
sentences.susu: A ɲɛ fu nun naani nde, mangɛ Kedorolameri nun mangɛ naxee nu na a sɛɛti ma, e naxa siga gere sode. E naxa nɔ a birin na: Refaka naxee nu na Asiteroti Karanayimi, Susika naxee nu na Hami, Emika naxee nu na Sawe Kiriyatayimi,

sentences.english: And the Horites in their mountain Seir, driving them as far as El-paran, which is near the waste land.
sentences.susu: a nun Xorika naxee nu na geya ma Seyiri biri han Paran gbengberen yire fɛ ma.

sentences.english: Then they came back to En-mishpat (which is Kadesh), making waste all the country of the Amalekites and of the Amorites living in Hazazon-tamar.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi e naxa gbilen, e naxa siga En Misapati, naxan xili Kadesi. E naxa nɔ Amalɛkikae ra, a nun Amorika naxee nu sabatixi Xasason Tamari.

sentences.english: And the king of Sodom with the king of Gomorrah and the king of Admah and the king of Zeboiim and the king of Bela (that is Zoar), went out, and put their forces in position in the valley of Siddim,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Sodoma mangɛ, Gomora mangɛ, Adamaha mangɛ, Seboyimi mangɛ, a nun Bela mangɛ (Bela xili Sowari), e naxa e malan gulunba kui naxan xili Sidimi yi mangɛ suuli gerefe ma:

sentences.english: Against Chedorlaomer, king of Elam, and Tidal, king of Goiim, and Amraphel, king of Shinar, and Arioch, king of Ellasar: four kings against the five.
sentences.susu: Elama mangɛ Kedorolameri, Goyin mangɛ Tidali, Babilɔn mangɛ Amarafeli, nun Lasa mangɛ Ariyoki. Na mangɛ naani naxa yi mangɛ suuli gere.

sentences.english: Now the valley of Siddim was full of holes of sticky earth; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah were put to flight and came to their end there, but the rest got away to the mountain.
sentences.susu: Yilie nu na Sidimi gulunba kui, dole nu na e kui. Sodoma mangɛ nun Gomora mangɛ to e gi, e naxa fa bira na yilie kui. Mixi dɔnxɔɛe naxa e gi sigafe ra geya fari.

sentences.english: And the four kings took all the goods and food from Sodom and Gomorrah and went on their way.
sentences.susu: Na mangɛ naani naxee geeni, e naxa Sodoma nun Gomora harige nun e xa baloe birin tongo, e siga.

sentences.english: And in addition they took Lot, Abram's brother's son, who was living in Sodom, and all his goods.
sentences.susu: E naxa Iburama xunya xa di Loti fan suxu a nun a harige birin, barima a nu sabatixi Sodoma nan kui.

sentences.english: And one who had got away from the fight came and gave word of it to Abram the Hebrew, who was living by the holy tree of Mamre, the Amorite, the brother of Eshcol and Aner, who were friends of Abram.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa nɔ a gide, a sa na fe birin tagi raba Iburama Eburuka bɛ. Na waxati, Iburama nu sabatixi Mamire Amorika xa wuri bili belebelee nan bun ma. Mamire nun a ngaxakerenyie Esekoli nun Aneri, e nun Iburama nu bara saatɛ tongo e boore bɛ.

sentences.english: And Abram, hearing that his brother's son had been made a prisoner, took a band of his trained men, three hundred and eighteen of them, sons of his house, and went after them as far as Dan.
sentences.susu: Iburama to a mɛ e bara a xunya xa di xɛmɛma Loti suxu, a naxa sɔɔri kɛmɛ saxan sɔɔri fu nun solomasaxan tongo, naxee nu barixi a xa mixie ya ma. E naxa siga na mangɛe fɔxɔ ra han taa naxan xili Dana.

sentences.english: And separating his forces by night, he overcame them, putting them to flight and going after them as far as Hobah, which is on the north side of Damascus.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ ra Iburama naxa a xa sɔɔrie itaxun, e naxa na mangɛe tɛrɛnna gere ra. E naxa nɔ na mangɛe matutunde han Hoba, Damasi kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: And he got back all the goods, and Lot, his brother's son, with his goods and the women and the people.
sentences.susu: Iburama naxa nɔ na harige birin masɔtɔde. A naxa gbilen a xunya xa di Loti ra, a harige, a xa ginɛ, nun a xa mixi birin.

sentences.english: And when he was coming back after putting to flight Chedorlaomer and the other kings, he had a meeting with the king of Sodom in the valley of Shaveh, that is, the King's Valley.
sentences.susu: Iburama to gbilen xun nakeli kui kelife mangɛ Kedorolameri gerede nun mangɛ naxee nu na a sɛɛti ma, Sodoma mangɛ naxa siga a ralande gulunba kui naxan xili Sawe. Mɛnni xili nɛ «Mangɛ xa gulunba.»

sentences.english: And Melchizedek, king of Salem, the priest of the Most High God, took bread and wine,
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Salamu mangɛ Melekisedeki naxa fa taami nun wɛni ra Iburama bɛ. Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nan nu na Melekisedeki ra.

sentences.english: And blessing him, said, May the blessing of the Most High God, maker of heaven and earth, be on Abram:
sentences.susu: A naxa duba Iburama bɛ a falafe ra, «Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi, naxan koore nun bɔxi daaxi, a xa barakɛ sa Iburama ma.

sentences.english: And let the Most High God be praised, who has given into your hands those who were against you. Then Abram gave him a tenth of all the goods he had taken.
sentences.susu: Tantui na Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi bɛ, naxan i yaxuie rayarabixi i bɛ.» Na tɛmui, Iburama naxa farilɛ fi Melekisedeki ma a naxan sɔtɔ na gere kui.

sentences.english: And the king of Sodom said to Abram, Give me the prisoners and take the goods for yourself.
sentences.susu: Sodoma mangɛ naxa a fala Iburama bɛ, «N ma mixie ragbilen n ma, kɔnɔ naafuli tan xa lu i bɛ.»

sentences.english: But Abram said to the king of Sodom, I have taken an oath to the Lord, the Most High God, maker of heaven and earth,
sentences.susu: Iburama naxa a yaabi, «N bara n kali Alatala ra, Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi naxan koore nun bɔxi daaxi,

sentences.english: That I will not take so much as a thread or the cord of a shoe of yours; so that you may not say, I have given wealth to Abram:
sentences.susu: n mu sese tongoma naxan findi i gbe ra, hali luuti di, xa na mu a ra sankiri luuti, alako i naxa fa a fala, ‹N bara Iburama findi banna ra.›

sentences.english: Give me nothing but the food which the fighting-men who went with me have had; but let Aner and Eshcol and Mamre have their part of the goods.
sentences.susu: N mu sese tongoma, fo n ma sɔɔrie naxan donxi. I man xa Aneri, Esekoli, nun Mamire gbe so e yi ra, barima e fan nu na n sɛɛti ma.»

sentences.english: After these things, the word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, saying, Have no fear, Abram: I will keep you safe, and great will be your reward.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi Alatala naxa mini Iburama ma, a naxa a masen a bɛ, «Iburama i naxa gaaxu, n tan nan na i kantama ra. I sare xungbe sɔtɔma nɛ.»

sentences.english: And Abram said, What will you give me? for I have no child and this Eliezer of Damascus will have all my wealth after me.
sentences.susu: Iburama naxa a yaabi, «Marigi Alatala, i munse ɲanigexi n bɛ a fife ra n ma? N to yi ki, di yo mu na n bɛ. Mixi mu na n bɛ naxan n kɛ tongoma fo n ma walikɛ Eliyeseri Damasi.

sentences.english: And Abram said, You have given me no child, and a servant in my house will get the heritage.
sentences.susu: I mu di yo fixi n tan ma. Naxan barixi n ma banxi kui, na nan findima n kɛ tongoma ra.»

sentences.english: Then said the Lord, This man will not get the heritage, but a son of your body will have your property after you.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a yaabi, «Ade, na mu findima i kɛ tongoma ra de. I bari di yati nan fama findide i kɛ tongoma ra.»

sentences.english: And he took him out into the open air, and said to him, Let your eyes be lifted to heaven, and see if the stars may be numbered; even so will your seed be.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Iburama ramini a xa kiri banxi bun ma, a naxa a masen a bɛ, «I ya rate koore ma. I xa tunbuie kɔnti xa i nɔma e kɔnti kolonde.» A man naxa a masen a bɛ, «Tunbuie gboxi ki naxɛ koore ma, i bɔnsɔɛ fan wuyama na ki nɛ.»

sentences.english: And he had faith in the Lord, and it was put to his account as righteousness.
sentences.susu: Iburama naxa la Alatala ra. Alatala fan naxa na findi tinxinyi ra a bɛ.

sentences.english: And he said to him, I am the Lord, who took you from Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land for your heritage.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen a bɛ, «N tan nan na Alatala ra, naxan i raminixi Uru taa kui Babilɔn bɔxi ma. N bara i xanin bɔxi ma, n dɛnnaxɛ fixi i ma.»

sentences.english: And he said, O Lord God, how may I be certain that it will be mine?
sentences.susu: Iburama naxa a Marigi Alatala maxɔrin, «N na kolonma di, n fama na sɔtɔde?»

sentences.english: And he said, Take a young cow of three years old, and a she-goat of three years old, and a sheep of three years old, and a dove and a young pigeon.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «Fa ninge ginɛ, si ginɛ, nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi ra, naxee bara ɲɛ saxan saxan sɔtɔ. I man xa fa ganbɛ nun kolokonde lanma ra.»

sentences.english: All these he took, cutting them in two and putting one half opposite the other, but not cutting the birds in two.
sentences.susu: Iburama naxa fa na subee ra. A naxa ninge, si ginɛ, nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi ixaba a tagi. A naxa na sube bolonyie sa e boore ya i, kɔnɔ a mu na xɔnie tan ixaba.

sentences.english: And evil birds came down on the bodies, but Abram sent them away.
sentences.susu: Yubɛe naxa fa, e goro na sube faxaxi yire, kɔnɔ Iburama naxa e birin keri naa.

sentences.english: Now when the sun was going down, a deep sleep came on Abram, and a dark cloud of fear.
sentences.susu: Soge to nu dulafe, xi xɔli naxa dangi Iburama ma dungbɛn. Dimi naxa sin a ma, gaaxui xungbe naxa a suxu.

sentences.english: And he said to Abram, Truly, your seed will be living in a land which is not theirs, as servants to a people who will be cruel to them for four hundred years;
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «A kolon, i bɔnsɔɛ fama sigade bɔxi gbɛtɛ ma e xɔnyi mu dɛnnaxɛ ra. E findima nɛ konyie ra na bɔxi ma. E fe xɔnɛ mɔɔli birin sɔtɔma nɛ mɛnni ɲɛ kɛmɛ naani bun ma.

sentences.english: But I will be the judge of that nation whose servants they are, and they will come out from among them with great wealth.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n fama nɛ na bɔxikae makiitide, i bɔnsɔɛ findima konyie ra dɛnnaxɛ. Na dangi xanbi, i bɔnsɔɛ kelima nɛ naa, e fa naafuli xungbe xanin e xun ma.

sentences.english: As for you, you will go to your fathers in peace; at the end of a long life you will be put in your last resting-place.
sentences.susu: I tan fama nɛ bɔɲɛsa sɔtɔde, i man simaya xɔnkuye sɔtɔma nɛ, han i sa ragatama tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And in the fourth generation they will come back here; for at present the sin of the Amorite is not full.
sentences.susu: Amorikae xa yunubi na gbo yɛ tɛmui naxɛ, i bɔnsɔɛ tolontolonyie fama gbilende kelife e xa konyiya kui.»

sentences.english: Then when the sun went down and it was dark, he saw a smoking fire and a flaming light which went between the parts of the bodies.
sentences.susu: Soge to bara dula, kuye bara ifɔɔrɔ, tuuri nun tɛ naxa dangi sube bolonyie tagi.

sentences.english: In that day the Lord made an agreement with Abram, and said, To your seed have I given this land from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, Alatala naxa yi saatɛ tongo Iburama bɛ, «N bara yi bɔxi fi i bɔnsɔɛ ma, keli Misira xure ma, sa dɔxɔ Efirati xure belebele ra.»

sentences.english: The Kenite, the Kenizzite, and the Kadmonite,
sentences.susu: Si dɔxɔ wuyaxi nan nu na na bɔxi ma. Na sie nan ya: Keni, Kenisi, Kadamon,

sentences.english: And the Hittite, and the Perizzite, and the Rephaim,
sentences.susu: Xiti, Perisi, Refa,

sentences.english: And the Amorite, and the Canaanite, and the Girgashite, and the Jebusite.
sentences.susu: Amori, Kanaan, Girigasa, nun Yebusu.

sentences.english: Now Sarai, Abram's wife, had given him no children; and she had a servant, a woman of Egypt whose name was Hagar.
sentences.susu: Sarayi mu nu di yo bari a xa mɔri Iburama bɛ. Konyi ginɛ Misiraka nu na Sarayi yi ra, naxan xili Hagara.

sentences.english: And Sarai said to Abram, See, the Lord has not let me have children; go in to my servant, for I may get a family through her. And Abram did as Sarai said.
sentences.susu: Sarayi naxa a fala Iburama bɛ, «I bara a to, Alatala mu di bari fe ragirixi n tan ma. Kɔnɔ tɛmunde n nɔma di sɔtɔde n ma konyi ginɛ saabui ra i bɛ. Wo xa lu yire keren to kɔɛ ra.» Iburama naxa tin Sarayi xa wɔyɛnyi ra.

sentences.english: So after Abram had been living for ten years in the land of Canaan, Sarai took Hagar, her Egyptian servant, and gave her to Abram for his wife.
sentences.susu: Sarayi naxa a xa konyi ginɛ Hagara Misiraka tongo, a naxa a so a xa mɔri Iburama yi ra, a xa findi a xa ginɛ ra. Iburama nu bara ɲɛ fu raba Kanaan bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And he went in to Hagar and she became with child, and when she saw that she was with child, she no longer had any respect for her master's wife.
sentences.susu: Iburama nun Hagara naxa xi yire keren, na nan findi Hagara bɛ tɛɛgɛ ra. Hagara to bara a kolon a a bara tɛɛgɛ, a naxa yo a kanyi ma, a naxa a mato mato ki kobi ra.

sentences.english: And Sarai said to Abram, May my wrong be on you: I gave you my servant for your wife and when she saw that she was with child, she no longer had any respect for me: may the Lord be judge between you and me.
sentences.susu: Sarayi naxa a fala Iburama bɛ, «I tan nan a niyaxi yi bɔtɛ raba xa ilan n na! N tan nan n ma konyi ginɛ fixi i ma a xa findi i xa ginɛ ra. Kabi a naxa a kolon a furuxi, a fa fe kobi nan tun ilanma n na. Alatala xa won tan firinyi makiiti.»

sentences.english: And Abram said, The woman is in your power; do with her whatever seems good to you. And Sarai was cruel to her, so that she went running away from her.
sentences.susu: Iburama naxa a xa ginɛ yaabi, «I xa konyi ginɛ na a ra. I wama fe naxan birin xɔn ma, i xa na raba a ra.» Sarayi naxa a waxɔnfe kobi birin naba Hagara ra, han a naxa a gi.

sentences.english: And an angel of the Lord came to her by a fountain of water in the waste land, by the fountain on the way to Shur.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa Hagara li dulonyi nde fɛ ma Suru kira xɔn ma gbengberen yire.

sentences.english: And he said, Hagar, Sarai's servant, where have you come from and where are you going? And she said, I am running away from Sarai, my master's wife.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa Hagara maxɔrin, «Sarayi xa konyi ginɛ Hagara, i kelixi minden? I sigafe minden?» Hagara naxa malekɛ yaabi, «N nan n gixi n kanyi nan ma.»

sentences.english: And the angel said to her, Go back, and put yourself under her authority.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa a masen Hagara bɛ, «I man xa gbilen i kelide, i sa i magoro i kanyi bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the angel of the Lord said, Your seed will be greatly increased so that it may not be numbered.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «N fama bɔnsɔɛ wuyaxi fide i ma, i mu nɔma naxan kɔnti kolonde.»

sentences.english: And the angel of the Lord said, See, you are with child and will give birth to a son, to whom you will give the name Ishmael, because the ears of the Lord were open to your sorrow.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ man naxa a fala a bɛ, «I tɛɛgɛxi nɛ yi ki. I fama di sɔtɔde. I na di xili sama nɛ Sumayila, barima Alatala bara i xui mɛ i xa marayaagi kui.

sentences.english: And he will be like a mountain ass among men; his hand will be against every man and every man's hand against him, and he will keep his place against all his brothers.
sentences.susu: I xa di findima geresoe ra alɔ wulai soe a rabama ki naxɛ. A mixi birin gerema nɛ, birin a tan fan gerema nɛ. A xunyae fan a gerema nɛ.»

sentences.english: And to the Lord who was talking with her she gave this name, You are a God who is seen; for she said, Have I not even here in the waste land had a vision of God and am still living?
sentences.susu: Hagara naxa xili sa Alatala xun, naxan wɔyɛn a bɛ, «Alatala naxan n toxi.» A naxa a fala, «N bara n toma to.»

sentences.english: So that fountain was named, Fountain of Life and Vision: it is between Kadesh and Bered.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi e na kɔlɔnyi xili falama, «Ala ɲiɲɛ naxan n toxi.» Na kɔlɔnyi na Kadesi nun Bereda nan tagi.

sentences.english: And Hagar gave birth to a child, the son of Abram, to whom Abram gave the name of Ishmael.
sentences.susu: Hagara naxa di sɔtɔ Iburama bɛ. Iburama naxa a xili sa Sumayila.

sentences.english: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar gave birth to Ishmael.
sentences.susu: Iburama nu bara ɲɛ tongo solomasaxan nun senni sɔtɔ simaya ra, Hagara fa na di sɔtɔ a bɛ.

sentences.english: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the Lord came to him, and said, I am God, Ruler of all; go in my ways and be upright in all things,
sentences.susu: Iburama to bara ɲɛ tongo solomanaani nun solomanaani sɔtɔ simaya ra, Alatala naxa mini a ma, a fa yi masen a bɛ, «N tan nan na Ala Sɛnbɛ Kanyi ra. I maɲɛrɛ n ya tode ra tinxinyi kui.

sentences.english: And I will make an agreement between you and me, and your offspring will be greatly increased.
sentences.susu: N fama nɛ saatɛ tongode won firin tagi. N fama bɔnsɔɛ gbegbe fide i ma.»

sentences.english: And Abram went down on his face on the earth, and the Lord God went on talking with him, and said,
sentences.susu: Iburama naxa a xinbi sin, a yatagi rafelen bɔxi. Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ,

sentences.english: As for me, my agreement is made with you, and you will be the father of nations without end.
sentences.susu: «N bara yi saatɛ tongo i bɛ. I fama nɛ findide si wuyaxi baba ra.

sentences.english: No longer will your name be Abram, but Abraham, for I have made you the father of a number of nations.
sentences.susu: I xili mu falama sɔnɔn Iburama, i xili fama nɛ falade Iburahima, barima n i findima si wuyaxi baba nan na.

sentences.english: I will make you very fertile, so that nations will come from you and kings will be your offspring.
sentences.susu: N fama nɛ i findide ɲama gbegbe baba ra. I fama nɛ die sɔtɔde naxee findima si wuyaxi ra, mangɛe fan fama nɛ minide i xa die ya ma.

sentences.english: And I will make between me and you and your seed after you through all generations, an eternal agreement to be a God to you and to your seed after you.
sentences.susu: N nan n ma saatɛ mabanbanma nɛ won firin tagi, hali i dangi xanbi, a nun i bɔnsɔɛ, gbilen nee fan bɔnsɔɛ bɔnsɔɛ. A findima saatɛ ra dan mu na naxan ma. Na kui, n tan nan na i Marigi Ala ra. N tan nan na i bɔnsɔɛ Marigi Ala ra, hali i dangi xanbi.

sentences.english: And to you and to your seed after you, I will give the land in which you are living, all the land of Canaan for an eternal heritage; and I will be their God.
sentences.susu: N fama nɛ yi bɔxi fide i tan nun i bɔnsɔɛ ma, wo faxi sabatide dɛnnaxɛ. Kanaan bɔxi birin findima nɛ wo gbe ra abadan. N tan nan na i bɔnsɔɛ Marigi Ala ra.»

sentences.english: And God said to Abraham, On your side, you are to keep the agreement, you and your seed after you through all generations.
sentences.susu: Ala man naxa a masen Iburahima bɛ, «I tan nun i bɔnsɔɛ, gbilen na fan bɔnsɔɛ bɔnsɔɛ, wo lan nɛ wo xa n ma saatɛ ratinmɛ.

sentences.english: And this is the agreement which you are to keep with me, you and your seed after you: every male among you is to undergo circumcision.
sentences.susu: Won ma saatɛ nan ya, n naxan saxi wo ma, wo lan wo xa naxan natinmɛ, i tan nun i bɔnsɔɛe: Naxan birin findixi xɛmɛ ra wo ya ma, e birin lan nɛ e xa sunna.

sentences.english: In the flesh of your private parts you are to undergo it, as a mark of the agreement between me and you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sunna findima saatɛ tɔnxuma nan na wo tan nun n tan tagi.

sentences.english: Every male among you, from one generation to another, is to undergo circumcision when he is eight days old, with every servant whose birth takes place in your house, or for whom you gave money to someone of another country, and not of your seed.
sentences.susu: Keli wo tan ma, a sa dɔxɔ wo bɔnsɔɛ bɔnsɔɛ ra, di xɛmɛ naxan birin barima, a lanma e xa sunna xi solomasaxan nde. Na sɛriyɛ lan nɛ a xa sa wo xa konyie ma naxee na wo yi ra, naxee barixi wo xɔnyi, a nun konyi naxee saraxi bɔxi gbɛtɛ ma, hali a mu fa na i bɔnsɔɛ xa ya ma.

sentences.english: He who comes to birth in your house and he who is made yours for a price, all are to undergo circumcision; so that my agreement may be marked in your flesh, an agreement for all time.
sentences.susu: Na kui, konyi naxan barixi i xɔnyi a nun i na naxan fan sara, e birin lan nɛ e xa sunna alako n ma saatɛ tɔnxuma xa lu wo fate ma abadan.

sentences.english: And any male who does not undergo circumcision will be cut off from his people: my agreement has been broken by him.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ naxan na lu a fate mu sunna, a fama nɛ raminide a bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, barima a mu n ma saatɛ rakamalixi.»

sentences.english: And God said, As for Sarai, your wife, from now her name will be not Sarai, but Sarah.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Ala naxa a masen Iburahima bɛ, «I naxa Sarayi xili fala i xa ginɛ xun ma sɔnɔn de, a fa xili nɛ kɔrɛ Sara.

sentences.english: And I will give her a blessing so that you will have a son by her: truly my blessing will be on her, and she will be the mother of nations: kings of peoples will be her offspring.
sentences.susu: N barakɛ sama a xa fe, a fa di xɛmɛ bari i bɛ. N barakɛ sama nɛ Sara xa fe, a fama findide si gbegbe nga ra. Si dɔxɔ wuyaxi mangɛe fama nɛ minide a xa die ya ma.»

sentences.english: Then Abraham went down on his face, and laughing, said in his heart, May a man a hundred years old have a child? will Sarah, at ninety years old, give birth?
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa a yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma, kɔnɔ a naxa yele, a fa a fala a bɔɲɛ ma, «N tan naxan bara ɲɛ kɛmɛ sɔtɔ simaya ra, n nɔma di nde sɔtɔde sɔnɔn? Sara naxan bara ɲɛ tongo solomanaani sɔtɔ simaya ra, a fan nɔma di nde baride fa?»

sentences.english: And Abraham said to God, If only Ishmael's life might be your care!
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Ala bɛ, «I ɲɛngi sa Sumayila xɔn ma. Na bara n wasa.»

sentences.english: And God said, Not so; but Sarah, your wife, will have a son, and you will give him the name Isaac, and I will make my agreement with him for ever and with his seed after him.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a yaabi, «Ade! I xa ginɛ Sara fama di xɛmɛ baride i bɛ i naxan xili sama Isiyaga. N nan n ma saatɛ mabanbanma nɛ n tan nun a tan tagi, a nun a bɔnsɔɛ ra hali a faxa xanbi. Saatɛ nan na ki naxan mu kanama abadan.

sentences.english: As for Ishmael, I have given ear to your prayer: truly I have given him my blessing and I will make him fertile and give him great increase; he will be the father of twelve chiefs, and I will make him a great nation.
sentences.susu: N bara i xa maxandi suxu Sumayila xa fe ra. N barakɛ sama nɛ a xa fe, n man fa di gbegbe barife ragiri a ma, n bɔnsɔɛ wuyaxi fima nɛ a ma. A findima nɛ mangɛ di fu nun firin baba ra, a nun si xungbe kanyi ra.

sentences.english: But my agreement will be with Isaac, to whom Sarah will give birth a year from this time.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ, naxan findi n ma saatɛ ra, n fama a mabanbande n tan nun Isiyaga nan tagi, Sara fama di xɛmɛ naxan baride i bɛ tamuna yi waxati.»

sentences.english: And having said these words, God went up from Abraham.
sentences.susu: Ala to gɛ na masenyi ra, a naxa keli Iburahima xun ma.

sentences.english: And Abraham took Ishmael, his son, and all whose birth had taken place in his house, and all his servants whom he had made his for a price, every male of his house, and on that very day he gave them circumcision in the flesh of their private parts as God had said to him.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa a xa di Sumayila tongo, a nun a xa konyi naxee barixi a xɔnyi, a nun a naxee saraxi. Xɛmɛ naxan birin na a xa banxi kui, a naxa e birin sunna na lɔxɔɛ alɔ Ala a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he underwent circumcision.
sentences.susu: Iburahima fan naxa sunna. Iburahima sunna tɛmui naxɛ, a ɲɛ tongo solomanaani a nun solomanaani nan nu na a ra.

sentences.english: And Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he underwent circumcision.
sentences.susu: Sumayila sunnama tɛmui naxɛ, a ɲɛ fu nun saxan.

sentences.english: Abraham and Ishmael, his son, underwent circumcision on that very day.
sentences.susu: E naxa e birin sunna lɔxɔɛ keren,

sentences.english: And all the men of his house, those whose birth had taken place in the house and those whom he had got for money from men of other lands, underwent circumcision with him.
sentences.susu: a nun xɛmɛ naxan birin nu na Iburahima xa banxi kui, konyi naxee barixi a xɔnyi, a nun a naxee fan saraxi kelife si gbɛtɛe ma.

sentences.english: Now the Lord came to him by the holy tree of Mamre, when he was seated in the doorway of his tent in the middle of the day;
sentences.susu: Alatala mini nɛ Iburahima ma Mamire, wuri bili belebele na dɛnnaxɛ. Na tɛmui, Iburahima nu dɔxɔxi a xa kiri banxi sode dɛ ra kuyefure tɛmui yanyi ra.

sentences.english: And lifting up his eyes, he saw three men before him; and seeing them, he went quickly to them from the door of the tent, and went down on his face to the earth;
sentences.susu: A to xɛmɛ saxan to fa ra, a naxa keli mafuren, a sa e ralan. A naxa a igoro e bɛ bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And said, My Lord, if now I have grace in your eyes, do not go away from your servant:
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen e bɛ, «N Marigi, n bara wo maxandi, wo xa wo malabu n tan wo xa konyi xɔnyi,

sentences.english: Let me get water for washing your feet, and take your rest under the tree:
sentences.susu: n xa fa ye ra wo bɛ alako wo xa wo sanyie maxa. Wo man xa foye tongo yi wuri bun ma.

sentences.english: And let me get a bit of bread to keep up your strength, and after that you may go on your way: for this is why you have come to your servant. And they said, Let it be so.
sentences.susu: N xa fa taami ra wo xɔn ma alako wo nɔma sɛnbɛ sɔtɔde ki naxɛ. Na xanbi, wo fa siga wo xa ɲɛrɛ ra. Na kui wo a kolonma wo xa konyi nan n na.» Na xɔɲɛe naxa a ratin, «Won bara lan na ma. I naxan falaxi, a raba.»

sentences.english: Then Abraham went quickly into the tent, and said to Sarah, Get three measures of meal straight away and make cakes.
sentences.susu: Na nan lan, Iburahima naxa gbilen mafuren a xa kiri banxi kui. A naxa a masen a xa ginɛ Sara bɛ, «I xulun. I farin fanyi sigaati ya tongo solofere yailan taami ra.»

sentences.english: And running to the herd, he took a young ox, soft and fat, and gave it to the servant and he quickly made it ready;
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, a naxa a gi, a siga ninge gɔɔrɛ, a sa ninge sube bɔrɔxɔxi fate fanyi keren tongo. A naxa na ninge so a xa walikɛ yi ra, a xa a faxa, a xa a yailan donse ra.

sentences.english: And he took butter and milk and the young ox which he had made ready and put it before them, waiting by them under the tree while they took food.
sentences.susu: Na sube to bara gɛ ɲinde, Iburahima naxa a tongo, a a so xɔɲɛe yi ra, a nun xiɲɛ xinbeli nun xiɲɛ bɔnbɔxi. E na na donse donfe, Iburahima naxa ti e sɛɛti ma wuri bun ma.

sentences.english: And they said to him, Where is Sarah your wife? And he said, She is in the tent.
sentences.susu: Na xɔɲɛe naxa Iburahima maxɔrin, «I xa ginɛ Sara na minden?» A naxa e yaabi, «A na kiri banxi bun ma.»

sentences.english: And he said, I will certainly come back to you in the spring, and Sarah your wife will have a son. And his words came to the ears of Sarah who was at the back of the tent-door.
sentences.susu: Na xɔɲɛ mixi keren naxa a masen Iburahima bɛ, «N man gbilenma tamuna yi ɲɔndɔn tɛmui. Na tɛmui i xa ginɛ fama di xɛmɛ baride i bɛ.» Sara nu tixi Iburahima xanbi ra kiri banxi sode dɛ ra, a tuli matixi e xa wɔyɛnyi ra.

sentences.english: Now Abraham and Sarah were very old, and Sarah was past the time for giving birth.
sentences.susu: Iburahima nun Sara nu bara gɛ foride. Sara mu nu nɔma di baride sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And Sarah, laughing to herself, said, Now that I am used up am I still to have pleasure, my husband himself being old?
sentences.susu: Sara to na mɛ, a naxa yele a yɛtɛ ma, «N tan na ki naxɛ yi ki n bara gɛ tagande. N ma xɛmɛ fan bara findi xɛmɛ fori ra. Muxu tan di bari tɛmui bara dangi.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said, Why was Sarah laughing and saying, Is it possible for me, being old, to give birth to a child?
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Iburahima bɛ, «Sara yelexi munfe ra? A a falaxi munfe ra, a tan mu nɔma di baride sɔnɔn, barima a bara gɛ tagande?

sentences.english: Is there any wonder which the Lord is not able to do? At the time I said, in the spring, I will come back to you, and Sarah will have a child.
sentences.susu: Na fe na na Alatala mu nɔma naxan nabade? N na fa tamuna i xɔnyi be yi tɛmui, Sara fama nɛ di baride.»

sentences.english: Then Sarah said, I was not laughing; for she was full of fear. And he said, No, but you were laughing.
sentences.susu: Sara naxa gaaxu, a naxa wule fala, «N mu yelexi de.» Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «Iyo, i yelexi nɛ!»

sentences.english: And the men went on from there in the direction of Sodom; and Abraham went with them on their way.
sentences.susu: Na xɔɲɛe naxa ti kira xɔn ma, e naxa e xunsa Sodoma taa ma. Iburahima naxa siga e matide.

sentences.english: And the Lord said, Am I to keep back from Abraham the knowledge of what I do;
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «N nɔma a nɔxunde Iburahima ma, n wama naxan nabafe?

sentences.english: Seeing that Abraham will certainly become a great and strong nation, and his name will be used by all the nations of the earth as a blessing?
sentences.susu: A fama nɛ findide si belebele sɛnbɛma ra. N fama nɛ barakɛ sade si birin ma a tan saabui ra.

sentences.english: For I have made him mine so that he may give orders to his children and those of his line after him, to keep the ways of the Lord, to do what is good and right: so that the Lord may do to Abraham as he has said.
sentences.susu: N na a sugandixi nɛ, alako a xa nɔ yaamari sade a xa die nun a bɔnsɔɛe ma, e xa nɔ e ɲɛngi sade n ma sɛriyɛ xɔn ma tinxinyi kui. Na tɛmui, n tan Alatala, n fama nɛ n ma laayidi rakamalide n naxan tongoxi Iburahima bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said, Because the outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah is very great, and their sin is very evil,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Iburahima bɛ, «Fe naxan falaxi Sodomakae nun Gomorakae xun, fe magaaxuxi na a ra. E xa yunubi bara gbo han,

sentences.english: I will go down now, and see if their acts are as bad as they seem from the outcry which has come to me; and if they are not, I will see.
sentences.susu: n fama gorode n xa sa a mato fe naxan birin falaxi e xun ma, xa a na na ki nɛ.»

sentences.english: And the men, turning from that place, went on to Sodom: but Abraham was still waiting before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Xɔɲɛ firin naxa keli e nu na dɛnnaxɛ, e naxa siga Sodoma. Kɔnɔ Alatala nun Iburahima naxa lu yire keren.

sentences.english: And Abraham came near, and said, Will you let destruction come on the upright with the sinners?
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa a maso Alatala ra, a naxa a masen a bɛ, «Alatala, i fama nɛ mixi kobi nun mixi tinxinxi birin sɔntɔde?

sentences.english: If by chance there are fifty upright men in the town, will you give the place to destruction and not have mercy on it because of the fifty upright men?
sentences.susu: Tɛmunde mixi tongo suuli na Sodomakae ya ma naxee findixi mixi matinxinxie ra. I fama nɛ na taa kanade? I mu nɔma diɲɛde Sodoma ɲama ma na mixi matinxinxi tongo suuli xa fe ra?

sentences.english: Let such a thing be far from you, to put the upright to death with the sinner: will not the judge of all the earth do right?
sentences.susu: Ade, a mu lan i xa mixi kobi nun mixi tinxinxi faxa ki keren. A mu lan kiiti keren xa sa mixi kobi nun mixi tinxinxi ma. A mu lan i xa na raba. Naxan duniɲa birin makiitima, a rabama nɛ tinxinyi kira ra.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said, If there are fifty upright men in the town, I will have mercy on it because of them.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yaabi ti, «Xa n mixi matinxinxi tongo suuli li Sodoma taa kui, n fama nɛ diɲɛde Sodoma mixi birin ma na mixi tongo suuli xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And Abraham answering said, Truly, I who am only dust, have undertaken to put my thoughts before the Lord:
sentences.susu: Iburahima man naxa wɔyɛnyi tongo, «N Marigi, n bara i maxandi i xa nɔ diɲɛde n bɛ, n xa nɔ yi masenyi tide i bɛ, ba n tan kelixi xube nun bɛndɛ nɛ.

sentences.english: If by chance there are five less than fifty upright men, will you give up all the town to destruction because of these five? And he said, I will not give it to destruction if there are forty-five.
sentences.susu: I sa a lima mixi tongo suuli xa mu mixi matinxinxi ra, tɛmunde fo mixi tongo naani a nun suuli. Na mixi suuli naxan luma na ki, i fama nɛ na taa kanade nee xa fe ra?» Alatala naxa a masen, «N mu na kanama xa n mixi matinxinxi tongo naani a nun suuli li naa.»

sentences.english: And again he said to him, By chance there may be forty there. And he said, I will not do it if there are forty.
sentences.susu: Iburahima man naxa a maxɔrɔxɔ, «Tɛmunde i mixi tongo naani nan lima naa.» Alatala naxa a masen, «N mu fama na kanade na mixi tongo naani xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And he said, Let not the Lord be angry with me if I say, What if there are thirty there? And he said, I will not do it if there are thirty.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa a fala, «N Marigi, n bara i maxandi, i naxa xɔnɔ xa n man fa wɔyɛnyi nde masen i bɛ. Tɛmunde i fama mixi tongo saxan nan lide naa.» Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «N mu fama na kanade xa n mixi matinxinxi tongo saxan li naa.»

sentences.english: And he said, See now, I have undertaken to put my thoughts before the Lord: what if there are twenty there? And he said, I will have mercy because of the twenty.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa a masen, «Marigi i xa i haakɛ to n bɛ n ma bɔɲɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ ma. Tɛmunde wo mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nan lima naa.» Alatala naxa a masen, «N mu fama na taa kanade na mixi mɔxɔɲɛn xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And he said, O let not the Lord be angry and I will say only one word more: by chance there may be ten there. And he said, I will have mercy because of the ten.
sentences.susu: Iburahima man naxa a fala, «N Marigi, n bara i maxandi, i naxa xɔnɔ. N ma maxɔrinyi dɔnxɔɛ nan yi ki i bɛ. Tɛmunde, i mixi fu nan lima naa.» Alatala naxa a masen Iburahima bɛ, «N mu fama na taa kanade na mixi fu xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And the Lord went on his way when his talk with Abraham was ended, and Abraham went back to his place.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ na masenyi ra, Alatala naxa siga, Iburahima fan naxa gbilen a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And at nightfall the two angels came to Sodom; and Lot was seated at the way into the town: and when he saw them he got up and came before them, falling down on his face to the earth.
sentences.susu: Nunmare tɛmui, na malekɛ firinyie naxa so Sodoma. Loti nu dɔxɔxi na taa sode dɛ ra. A to malekɛe to fa ra, a naxa keli a sa e ralan kira ra. A naxa a igoro bɔxi ma e bɛ.

sentences.english: And he said, My masters, come now into your servant's house and take your rest there for the night, and let your feet be washed; and early in the morning you may go on your way. And they said, Not so, but we will take our night's rest in the street.
sentences.susu: Loti naxa a masen e bɛ, «N bara wo maxandi wo xa tin n xa wo yigiya n xɔnyi. Wo nɔma wo sanyie maxade, wo wo malabu. Tina gɛɛsɛgɛ wo kurun wo xa biyaasi ra.» Malekɛe naxa a yaabi, «Ade! Fo muxu xa xi taa tagi nɛ to kɔɛ ra.»

sentences.english: But he made his request more strongly, so they went with him into his house; and he got food ready for them, and made unleavened bread, of which they took.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Loti naxa a maxɔrɔxɔ han e naxa siga a xɔnyi. A naxa donse fanyi rafala e bɛ, a naxa taami lɛbinitare gan. E naxa e dɛge.

sentences.english: But before they had gone to bed, the men of the town, all the men of Sodom, came round the house, young and old, from every part of the town;
sentences.susu: Sa tɛmui mu nu a lixi, Sodomakae naxa Loti xa banxi rabilin. Keli sɛgɛtalae ma, a sa dɔxɔ xɛmɔxie ra, e birin nu na naa.

sentences.english: And crying out to Lot, they said, Where are the men who came to your house this night? Send them out to us, so that we may take our pleasure with them.
sentences.susu: E naxa Loti xili, e a maxɔrin, «Na mixie na minden, naxee soxi i xɔnyi to nunmare ra? E ramini muxu ma, muxu xa kafu yire keren.»

sentences.english: And Lot went out to them in the doorway, shutting the door after him.
sentences.susu: Loti naxa mini a xa banxi kui, a ti naadɛ ra, a naadɛ ragali a xanbi ra.

sentences.english: And he said, My brothers, do not this evil.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen e bɛ, «Ade! N ngaxakerenyie, wo naxa fe ɲaaxi raba.

sentences.english: See now, I have two unmarried daughters; I will send them out to you so that you may do to them whatever seems good to you: only do nothing to these men, for this is why they have come under the shade of my roof.
sentences.susu: N ma di ginɛ firinyie na be naxee mu nu xɛmɛ fe kolon. N bara tin a ra n xa nee sa wo sagoe, wo xa wo waxɔnfe birin naba e ra, alako wo naxa sese raba n ma xɔɲɛe ra. N tan bara findi e yatigi ra.»

sentences.english: And they said, Give way there. This one man, they said, came here from a strange country, and will he now be our judge? now we will do worse to you than to them; and pushing violently against Lot, they came near to get the door broken in.
sentences.susu: Na mixie naxa a fala Loti bɛ, «Mini muxu tagi. Xɔɲɛ nan i ra be. I mu nɔma kiiti sade muxu ma. Xa i mu i kata, muxu fama fe xɔnɛ dɔxɔde i ma dangife e tan na.» E naxa sonson Loti ma, alako e xa naadɛ kana.

sentences.english: But the men put out their hands and took Lot into the house to them, shutting the door again.
sentences.susu: Na malekɛ firinyie naxa Loti suxu, e naxa a raso banxi kui, e naadɛ balan e xun ma.

sentences.english: But the men who were outside the door they made blind, all of them, small and great, so that they were tired out with looking for the door.
sentences.susu: Malekɛe naxa gali radɔnxu, naxee nu tixi naadɛ ra. Keli sɛgɛtalae ma, sa dɔxɔ xɛmɔxie ra, e mu nu sese toma fa. Kira naxa ifu e ma.

sentences.english: Then the men said to Lot, Are there any others of your family here? sons-in-law or sons or daughters, take them all out of this place;
sentences.susu: Na malekɛ firinyie naxa Loti maxɔrin, «I xa mixi nde na be? I xa i xa di birin namini yi taa kui. I xabilɛ xa keli be,

sentences.english: For we are about to send destruction on this place, because a great outcry against them has come to the ears of the Lord; and the Lord has sent us to put an end to the town.
sentences.susu: barima muxu fafe yi taa kanade. Yi taakae xa wali kobi bara findi seedeɲɔxɔya ra Alatala bɛ. Alatala man muxu rasanbaxi nɛ, muxu xa fa yi taa kana.»

sentences.english: And Lot went out and said to his sons-in-law, who were married to his daughters, Come, let us go out of this place, for the Lord is about to send destruction on the town. But his sons-in-law did not take him seriously.
sentences.susu: Loti naxa siga a fala a xa die xa mɔrie bɛ, «Wo keli be mafuren! Alatala na fafe be kanade yakɔsi.» E naxa a maɲɔxun a na gbɛntɛnfe nɛ.

sentences.english: And when morning came, the angels did all in their power to make Lot go, saying, Get up quickly and take your wife and your two daughters who are here, and go, for fear that you come to destruction in the punishment of the town.
sentences.susu: Na subaxɛ ma, malekɛe naxa gbata Loti ra, e naxa a masen a bɛ, «Keli, i xa ginɛ tongo, a nun i xa di ginɛ firinyi naxee na be. Wo xa keli be alako wo naxa sɔntɔ a nun yi taa mixi kobie ra.»

sentences.english: But while he was waiting, the men took him and his wife and his daughters by the hand, for the Lord had mercy on them, and put them outside the town.
sentences.susu: A to nu wama bufe, malekɛe naxa Loti suxu a bɛlɛxɛ ma, a nun a xa ginɛ, sa a xa di ginɛ firinyie xun ma. E naxa e ramini taa kui, barima Alatala nu bara kinikini e ma.

sentences.english: And when they had put them out, he said, Go for your life, without looking back or waiting in the lowland; go quickly to the mountain or you will come to destruction.
sentences.susu: Malekɛe to e ramini, keren naxa a masen Loti bɛ, «I gi, alako i xa i nii ratanga. I naxa i kobe rato de! I naxa i mati yi taa yire yoe. Xa i mu wama i xa sɔntɔ, siga na geya yire.»

sentences.english: And Lot said to them, Not so, O my Lord;
sentences.susu: Loti naxa a fala, «Ade, n Marigi, n bara i maxandi, n mu nɔma na rabade.

sentences.english: See now, your servant has had grace in your eyes and great is your mercy in keeping my life from destruction, but I am not able to get as far as the mountain before evil overtakes me and death;
sentences.susu: N a kolon, i bara hinnɛ i xa konyi di ra. I bara kinikini n ma a gbegbe ra. I bara n nii ratanga. Kɔnɔ, n tan mu nɔma n gide han geya ma, xa na mu a ra n faxama nɛ.

sentences.english: This town, now, is near, and it is a little one: O, let me go there (is it not a little one?) so that my life may be safe.
sentences.susu: I bara na taa lanmadi to naxan makɔrɛxi won na? N nɔma na tan lide. A lu n xa siga naa, n nii xa ratanga. A mato, taa xurudi xa mu a ra?»

sentences.english: And he said, See, I have given you your request in this one thing more: I will not send destruction on this town.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa a yaabi, «N bara tin na birin na. N mu na taa kanama.

sentences.english: Go there quickly, for I am not able to do anything till you have come there. For this reason, the town was named Zoar.
sentences.susu: Siga mafuren. Han i sa soma tɛmui naxɛ, n mu fefe rabama.» Na taa xili saxi nɛ Sowari, barima a xurun.

sentences.english: The sun was up when Lot came to Zoar.
sentences.susu: Soge nu tefe tɛmui naxɛ, Loti naxa so Sowari taa kui.

sentences.english: Then the Lord sent fire and flaming smoke raining down from heaven on Sodom and Gomorrah.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Alatala naxa sooda nun tɛ ragoro Gomora taa nun Sodoma taa ma.

sentences.english: And he sent destruction on those towns, with all the lowland and all the people of those towns and every green thing in the land.
sentences.susu: A naxa na taae tuxunsan, keli sansie ma, a sa dɔxɔ mixie ra naxee birin sabatixi na taae kui.

sentences.english: But Lot's wife, looking back, became a pillar of salt.
sentences.susu: Loti xa ginɛ naxa a kobe rato, na nan lan a naxa findi fɔxɛ xuti ra.

sentences.english: And Abraham got up early in the morning and went to the place where he had been talking with the Lord:
sentences.susu: Na subaxɛ ma, Iburahima naxa keli, a a xunsa yire ma a nun Alatala dɛ masara dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And looking in the direction of Sodom and Gomorrah and the lowland, he saw the smoke of the land going up like the smoke of an oven.
sentences.susu: A to a ya rasiga Gomora nun Sodoma ma, a nun na rabilinyi birin, a naxa tuuri gbegbe to te ra.

sentences.english: So it came about that when God sent destruction on the towns of the lowland, he kept his word to Abraham, and sent Lot safely away when he put an end to the towns where he was living.
sentences.susu: Ala to na taae kana Loti nu sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ, a a ratanga na gbaloe ma Iburahima xa fe nan na.

sentences.english: Then Lot went up out of Zoar to the mountain, and was living there with his two daughters, for fear kept him from living in Zoar: and he and his daughters made their living-place in a hole in the rock.
sentences.susu: Loti nu bara gaaxu lufe ra Sowari taa kui. A naxa keli naa, a siga geya fari. A naxa sabati a nun a xa di ginɛ firinyie ra fɔnmɛ nde kui gɛmɛ longori ra.

sentences.english: And the older daughter said to her sister, Our father is old, and there is no man to be a husband to us in the natural way:
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde, a xa di ginɛ singe naxa a fala a xunya bɛ, «Won baba bara fori. Won na dɛnnaxɛ yi ki, xɛmɛ yo mu na won dɔxɔma naxan xɔn alɔ adama darixi a ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Come, let us give our father much wine, and we will go into his bed, so that we may have offspring by our father,
sentences.susu: Fa be, won xa won baba rasiisi alako won xa xi a xɔn ma, alako won xa di fi a ma naxan findima a bɔnsɔɛ ra.»

sentences.english: And that night they made their father take much wine; and the older daughter went into his bed; and he had no knowledge of when she went in or when she went away.
sentences.susu: Na kɔɛ ra, e naxa e baba rasiisi. A xa di ginɛ singe naxa xi a baba xɔn ma. A mu a xun ma fe yo kolon, a xa di sa tɛmui, nun a keli tɛmui.

sentences.english: And on the day after, the older daughter said to the younger, Last night I was with my father; let us make him take much wine this night again, and do you go to him, so that we may have offspring by our father.
sentences.susu: Kuye to iba, a xa di ginɛ singe naxa a fala a xunya bɛ, «A bara ɲɔn, n tan nun n baba bara xi yire keren to. To kɔɛ ra, i nun won baba fama xide yire keren. Na tɛmui won nɔma bɔnsɔɛ fide a ma.»

sentences.english: And that night again they made their father take much wine; and the younger daughter went into his bed; and he had no knowledge of when she went in or when she went away.
sentences.susu: Na kɔɛ man na, e naxa e baba rasiisi. A xunya fan naxa xi a baba xɔn ma. A mu a xun ma fe yo kolon, a xa di sa tɛmui, nun a keli tɛmui.

sentences.english: And so the two daughters of Lot were with child by their father.
sentences.susu: Loti xa di ginɛ firinyie naxa furi tongo e baba xa di ma.

sentences.english: And the older daughter had a son, and she gave him the name Moab: he is the father of the Moabites to this day.
sentences.susu: Na di ginɛ singe to di bari, a xili naxa sa Mowaba. Na nan findi Mowabakae birin benba ra. Han yakɔsi e na na.

sentences.english: And the younger had a son and gave him the name Ben-ammi: from him come the children of Ammon to this day.
sentences.susu: A xa di ginɛ firin nde fan naxa di bari, a xili naxa sa Ben Ami. Na nan findi Amonikae birin benba ra. Han yakɔsi e na na.

sentences.english: And Abraham went on his way from there to the land of the South, and was living between Kadesh and Shur, in Gerar.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa siga Negewi bɔxi ma, a sabati Kadesi nun Suru tagi. Na dangi xanbi a naxa siga Gerara, a saxanyi raba mɛnni.

sentences.english: And Abraham said of Sarah, his wife, She is my sister: and Abimelech, king of Gerar, sent and took Sarah.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa a fala mɛnnikae bɛ a xa ginɛ Sara xa fe ra, «N xunya ginɛma nan a ra.» Na kui Gerara mangɛ Abimeleki naxa Sara tongo.

sentences.english: But God came to Abimelech in a dream in the night, and said to him, Truly you are a dead man because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man's wife.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ to so, Ala naxa a masen Abimeleki bɛ xiye kui, «I fama nɛ faxade yi ginɛ xa fe ra, i naxan tongoxi, barima xɛmɛ taa idɔxɔɛ na a ra.»

sentences.english: Now Abimelech had not come near her; and he said, Lord, will you put to death an upright nation?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Abimeleki mu nu a makɔrɛxi a ra. A naxa a yaabi, «N Marigi, i fama nɛ si tinxinxi xa fe kanade?

sentences.english: Did he not say to me himself, She is my sister? and she herself said, He is my brother: with an upright heart and clean hands have I done this.
sentences.susu: Iburahima a masen nɛ n bɛ, a yi ginɛ a xunya ginɛma nan lanxi a ma. Ginɛ fan naxa a fala n bɛ, a taara nan lanxi Iburahima ma. N naxan nabaxi, n na rabaxi n bɔɲɛ fiixɛ nan na.»

sentences.english: And God said to him in the dream, I see that you have done this with an upright heart, and I have kept you from sinning against me: for this reason I did not let you come near her.
sentences.susu: Ala man naxa a masen a bɛ na xiye kui, «N tan yati, n na kolon i fe naxan nabaxi, fe kobi xa mu a ra. N tan nan man a niyaxi, i mu nɔxi yunubi fe rabade n na. Na nan a toxi n mu a luxi i xa a findi i xa ginɛ ra.

sentences.english: So now, give the man back his wife, for he is a prophet, and let him say a prayer for you, so your life may be safe: but if you do not give her back, be certain that death will come to you and all your house.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, yi ginɛ ragbilen a xa mɔri ma. Namiɲɔnmɛ nan a ra. A fama nɛ Ala maxandide i bɛ, alako i nii ratangama ki naxɛ. Kɔnɔ xa i mu a ragbilen a xa mɔri ma, a kolon i fama nɛ faxade wo nun i xa denbaya birin.»

sentences.english: So Abimelech got up early in the morning and sent for all his servants and gave them word of these things, and they were full of fear.
sentences.susu: Abimeleki naxa keli sinnanyi ma, a naxa a xa konyie birin malan. Fe naxan birin dangixi, a na tagi raba e bɛ. Gaaxui gbegbe naxa e suxu.

sentences.english: Then Abimelech sent for Abraham, and said, What have you done to us? what wrong have I done you that you have put on me and on my kingdom so great a sin? You have done to me things which are not to be done.
sentences.susu: Abimeleki naxa Iburahima xili a xɔnyi. A naxa a maxɔrin, «N yunubi mundun nabaxi i ra, i xa nɔ n tan nun n ma ɲama findide yunubitɔɛ belebelee ra? I bara fe raba n na, fe naxan mu lan a xa raba.

sentences.english: And Abimelech said to Abraham, Why did you do this thing?
sentences.susu: Munfe a niyaxi i na rabaxi?»

sentences.english: And Abraham said, Because it seemed to me that there was no fear of God in this place, and that they might put me to death because of my wife.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa a yaabi, «N a fala nɛ mixi naxee birin na be, e mu gaaxuma Ala ya ra, e fama nɛ n faxade n ma ginɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And, in fact, she is my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife:
sentences.susu: Nɔndi nan a ra, n xunya nan man lanxi a ma. Muxu birin baba keren, kɔnɔ muxu nga keren mu a ra. Na nan a toxi a findixi n ma ginɛ ra.

sentences.english: And when God sent me wandering from my father's house, I said to her, Let this be the sign of your love for me; wherever we go, say of me, He is my brother.
sentences.susu: Ala to bara n tongo n baba xɔnyi, n naxa a masen n ma ginɛ bɛ, ‹Won na siga dɛdɛ, yandi n bara i maxandi i xa a fala, n xunya nan lanxi i ma.›»

sentences.english: Then Abimelech gave to Abraham sheep and oxen and men-servants and women-servants, and gave him back his wife Sarah.
sentences.susu: Abimeleki naxa yɛxɛɛe, sie, ningee, nun konyie tongo, a naxa e birin so Iburahima yi ra. A man naxa a xa ginɛ Sara ragbilen a ma.

sentences.english: And Abimelech said, See, all my land is before you; take whatever place seems good to you.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Iburahima bɛ, «N ma bɔxi bara rabi i bɛ. I na wa lufe dɛdɛ yi bɔxi ma, i xa lu naa.»

sentences.english: And he said to Sarah, See, I have given to your brother a thousand bits of silver so that your wrong may be put right; now your honour is clear in the eyes of all.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Sara bɛ, «I bara a to, n bara kɔbiri kole wulu firin so i taara yi ra, alako yaagi xa ba i ya ra, i tan nun i malan boore birin tagi. Na kui i xun nakeli sɔtɔma nɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Abraham made prayer to God, and God made Abimelech well again, and his wife and his women-servants, so that they had children.
sentences.susu: Iburahima to Ala maxandi, Ala naxa Abimeleki, a xa ginɛ, nun a xa konyie yalan, alako e man xa nɔ di baride.

sentences.english: For the Lord had kept all the women of the house of Abimelech from having children, because of Sarah, Abraham's wife.
sentences.susu: Alatala nu bara dibaritareɲa ragiri Abimeleki xa mixie ma Iburahima xa ginɛ Sara xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord came to Sarah as he had said and did to her as he had undertaken.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa hinnɛ Sara ra, a a xa laayidi rakamali a bɛ.

sentences.english: And Sarah became with child, and gave Abraham a son when he was old, at the time named by God.
sentences.susu: Sara naxa tɛɛgɛ. A xa mɔri xa xɛmɛforiɲa kui, a naxa di bari Iburahima bɛ Ala waxati naxan fala a bɛ.

sentences.english: And Abraham gave to his son, to whom Sarah had given birth, the name Isaac.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa a xa di xili sa Isiyaga, Sara naxan sɔtɔxi a bɛ.

sentences.english: And when his son Isaac was eight days old, Abraham made him undergo circumcision, as God had said to him.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa di sunna a xi solomasaxan lɔxɔɛ alɔ Ala a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Now Abraham was a hundred years old when the birth of Isaac took place.
sentences.susu: Iburahima nu bara ɲɛ kɛmɛ sɔtɔ simaya ra, Isiyaga barixi tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And Sarah said, God has given me cause for laughing, and everyone who has news of it will be laughing with me.
sentences.susu: Sara naxa a fala, «Ala bara n nasɛɛwa. Mixi yo na n ma di Isiyaga barife mɛ, muxu birin sɛɛwama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And she said, Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would have a child at her breast? for see, I have given him a son now when he is old.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a fala, «Nde nu nɔma a falade Iburahima bɛ na tɛmui, lɔxɔɛ nde fama a lide, Sara findima nɛ dingɛ ra? Kɔnɔ n tan bara di fi a ma a xa xɛmɛforiɲa kui.»

sentences.english: And when the child was old enough to be taken from the breast, Abraham made a great feast.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga to mɔ, e naxa a dɛ ba xiɲɛ ra. Iburahima naxa ɲɛlɛxin xulunyi belebele sa, a xa diyɔrɛ dɛ ba lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian playing with Isaac.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Sara naxa Sumayila to yele ra, Misiraka Hagara di naxan barixi Iburahima bɛ.

sentences.english: So she said to Abraham, Send away that woman and her son: for the son of that woman is not to have a part in the heritage with my son Isaac.
sentences.susu: Sara naxa a fala Iburahima bɛ, «Yi konyi ginɛ keri, a nun a xa di. Yi naxan yi ki, a mu lan a nun n ma di Isiyaga xa lu kɛ keren.»

sentences.english: And this was a great grief to Abraham because of his son.
sentences.susu: Na wɔyɛnyi mu rafan Iburahima ma a xa di xa fe ra,

sentences.english: But God said, Let it not be a grief to you because of the boy and Hagar his mother; give ear to whatever Sarah says to you, because it is from Isaac that your seed will take its name.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Ala naxa a masen Iburahima bɛ, «I bɔɲɛ naxa raɲaaxu i ma i xa konyi ginɛ nun a xa di xa fe ra. Sara na fe naxan birin fala i bɛ, a birin naba a bɛ, barima Isiyaga nan fama findide i bɔnsɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And I will make a nation of the son of your servant-woman, because he is your seed.
sentences.susu: N si fan naminima nɛ i xa konyi ginɛ xa di, barima i xa di nan lanxi a fan ma.»

sentences.english: And early in the morning Abraham got up, and gave Hagar some bread and a water-skin, and put the boy on her back, and sent her away: and she went, wandering in the waste land of Beer-sheba.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa keli subaxɛ ma. A naxa taami tongo a nun kiri gbɔnfɔɛ, ye na kui. A naxa na birin dɔxɔ Hagara xun ma, a naxa di so a yi ra, a fa e birin nasiga. Hagara naxa a xun ti gbengberen yire ra dɛnnaxɛ xili Beriseeba.

sentences.english: And when all the water in the skin was used up, she put the child down under a tree.
sentences.susu: Ye to bara ɲɔn a xa kiri gbɔnfɔɛ kui, a naxa a xa di lu wuri nde bun ma.

sentences.english: And she went some distance away, about an arrow flight, and seating herself on the earth, she gave way to bitter weeping, saying, Let me not see the death of my child.
sentences.susu: A naxa siga, a sa dɔxɔ a xati ma yaamilɛ keren ɲɔndɔnyi. A naxa a fala, «N mu nɔma n ya tide n ma di ra, a xa faxa n ya xɔri.» A naxa siga a sa dɔxɔ a xati ma a nu wa ra.

sentences.english: And the boy's cry came to the ears of God; and the angel of God said to Hagar from heaven, Hagar, why are you weeping? have no fear, for the child's cry has come to the ears of God.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa na di wa xui mɛ koore ma. Ala xa malekɛ naxa Hagara xili, a naxa a maxɔrin, «Hagara munse i sɔtɔxi? I naxa gaaxu barima Ala bara i xa di wa xui mɛ koore ma.

sentences.english: Come, take your child in your arms, for I will make of him a great nation.
sentences.susu: Keli, i xa mɛɛni i xa di ma, barima n fama a findide si belebele kanyi nan na.»

sentences.english: Then God made her eyes open, and she saw a water-spring, and she got water in the skin and gave the boy a drink.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa Hagara ya rabi, a naxa kɔlɔnyi nde to. A naxa kiri gbɔnfɔɛ tongo, a ye sa a kui, a nde fi a xa di ma.

sentences.english: And God was with the boy, and he became tall and strong, and he became a bowman, living in the waste land.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a ɲɛngi sa Sumayila xɔn ma. A naxa mɔ, a sa sabati gbengberen yire, dɛnnaxɛ xili Paran. A naxa findi xali woli yi matinxinxi ra.

sentences.english: And while he was in the waste land of Paran, his mother got him a wife from the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: A nga naxa Misira ginɛ keren fen a bɛ.

sentences.english: Now at that time, Abimelech and Phicol, the captain of his army, said to Abraham, I see that God is with you in all you do.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Abimeleki nun a xa sɔɔri mangɛ Pikoli naxa a fala Iburahima bɛ, «I fefe yo rabama wo nun Ala na a ra.

sentences.english: Now, then, give me your oath, in the name of God, that you will not be false to me or to my sons after me, but that as I have been good to you, so you will be to me and to this land where you have been living.
sentences.susu: I rakali n bɛ Ala xili ra, fa sa xili ma i mu fama n yanfade, i mu n ma die yanfama, i mu n ma mamadie fan yanfama. I xa fe fanyi raba n bɛ a nun yi bɔxi mixie bɛ i na dɛnnaxɛ, alɔ n na raba i bɛ ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And Abraham said, I will give you my oath.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa a yaabi, «N bara n kali Ala ra.»

sentences.english: But Abraham made a protest to Abimelech because of a water-hole which Abimelech's servants had taken by force.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa kɔrɔsi raba Abimeleki ra fe ma a xa mixie naxan niyaxi a ra, a xa kɔlɔnyi bafe a gbeɲa.

sentences.english: But Abimelech said, I have no idea who has done this thing; you never gave me word of it, and I had no knowledge of it till this day.
sentences.susu: Abimeleki naxa a yaabi, «N mu a kolon naxan na fe rabaxi i ra. I mu yi wɔyɛnyi falaxi n bɛ, fo to n tan fa na kolon.»

sentences.english: And Abraham took sheep and oxen and gave them to Abimelech, and the two of them made an agreement together.
sentences.susu: Na nan lan, Iburahima naxa yɛxɛɛe nun ningee fi Abimeleki ma, e xa saatɛ tongo e boore bɛ.

sentences.english: And Abraham put seven young lambs of the flock on one side by themselves.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa yɛxɛɛ solofere tongo, a naxa e sa a xati ma.

sentences.english: Then Abimelech said, What are these seven lambs which you have put on one side?
sentences.susu: Abimeleki naxa a maxɔrin, «I na yɛxɛɛ solofere saxi a xati ma munfe ra?»

sentences.english: And he said, Take these seven lambs from me as a witness that I have made this water-hole.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa a yaabi, «N nee sofe nɛ i yi ra, alako i xa a kolon, fa sa xili ma, yi kɔlɔnyi naxan yi ki, n tan nan a gexi.»

sentences.english: So he gave that place the name Beer-sheba, because there the two of them had given their oaths.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, na taa xili falama Beriseeba, barima na mixi firinyie e rakali e boore bɛ mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: So they made an agreement at Beer-sheba, and Abimelech and Phicol, the captain of his army, went back to the land of the Philistines.
sentences.susu: E to na saatɛ tongo e boore bɛ Beriseeba, Abimeleki nun a xa sɔɔri mangɛ Pikoli naxa ti kira xɔn ma gbilenfe Filisita bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Abraham, after planting a holy tree in Beer-sheba, gave worship to the name of the Lord, the Eternal God.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa tamare wuri bili keren si Beriseeba. A naxa Alatala maxandi a xili ra, Ala naxan na na.

sentences.english: And Abraham went on living in the land of the Philistines as in a strange country.
sentences.susu: Iburahima ɲɛ gbegbe raba nɛ Filisita bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Now after these things, God put Abraham to the test, and said to him, Abraham; and he said, Here am I.
sentences.susu: Na fe dangi xanbi, Ala naxa Iburahima mato. A naxa a xili, «Iburahima.» Iburahima naxa a ratin, «N tan nan ya.»

sentences.english: And he said to him, Take your son, your dearly loved only son Isaac, and go to the land of Moriah and give him as a burned offering on one of the mountains of which I will give you knowledge.
sentences.susu: Ala man naxa a masen a bɛ, «I xa di Isiyaga tongo, i xa di kerenyi, naxan nafanxi i ma, i xa a xanin bɔxi ma dɛnnaxɛ xili Moriya, geya fari n na dɛnnaxɛ masen i bɛ. I xa a fi n ma sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra.»

sentences.english: And Abraham got up early in the morning, and made ready his ass, and took with him two of his young men and Isaac, his son, and after the wood for the burned offering had been cut, he went on his way to the place of which God had given him word.
sentences.susu: Subaxɛ ma Iburahima naxa keli, a naxa dɔxɔse yailan a xa sofale fari. A naxa a xa walikɛ firin tongo a nun a xa di Isiyaga. Iburahima naxa yege ibɔɔ naxan findima tɛ xuruse ra sɛrɛxɛ bade. A naxa biyaasi fɔlɔ sigafe ra yire Ala dɛnnaxɛ masenxi a bɛ.

sentences.english: And on the third day, Abraham, lifting up his eyes, saw the place a long way off.
sentences.susu: Na xi saxan lɔxɔɛ, Iburahima ya naxa ti na yire makuye ra, a sigafe dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Then he said to his young men, Keep here with the ass; and I and the boy will go on and give worship and come back again to you.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a xa walikɛ firinyie bɛ, «Wo tan nun sofale xa lu be. N tan nun n ma di, muxu na sigafe geya fari salide. Na tɛmui muxu man gbilenma han be.»

sentences.english: And Abraham put the wood for the burned offering on his son's back, and he himself took the fire and the knife in his hand, and the two of them went on together.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa na yege dɔxɔ a xa di Isiyaga xun ma. A man naxa tɛ wole nun finɛ xanin. E ɲɛrɛfe e firin.

sentences.english: Then Isaac said to Abraham, My father; and he said, Here am I, my son. And he said, We have wood and fire here, but where is the lamb for the burned offering?
sentences.susu: Isiyaga naxa a baba Iburahima xili, «N baba.» A naxa a ratin, «N tan nan ya, n ma di.» Isiyaga naxa a baba maxɔrin, «N bara a to yege nun tɛ xuruse na won yi ra, kɔnɔ yɛxɛɛ na minden won naxan bafe sɛrɛxɛ ra?»

sentences.english: And Abraham said, God himself will give the lamb for the burned offering: so they went on together.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa a yaabi, «N ma di, Ala yati nan yɛxɛɛ soma won yi ra, won naxan bama sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra.» E ɲɛrɛfe e firin.

sentences.english: And they came to the place of which God had given him knowledge; and there Abraham made the altar and put the wood in place on it, and having made tight the bands round Isaac his son, he put him on the wood on the altar.
sentences.susu: E to yire li Ala dɛnnaxɛ masenxi Iburahima bɛ, Iburahima naxa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan, a yege sa a fari. A naxa a xa di Isiyaga xiri, a a sa sɛrɛxɛbade kɔn na, na yege fari.

sentences.english: And stretching out his hand, Abraham took the knife to put his son to death.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Iburahima naxa finɛ tongo, a naxa a bɛlɛxɛ itala a xa a xa di kɔn naxaba,

sentences.english: But the voice of the angel of the Lord came from heaven, saying, Abraham, Abraham: and he said, Here am I.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Alatala xa malekɛ naxa a xili koore ma, «Iburahima, Iburahima!» Iburahima naxa a ratin, «N tan nan ya.»

sentences.english: And he said, Let not your hand be stretched out against the boy to do anything to him; for now I am certain that the fear of God is in your heart, because you have not kept back your son, your only son, from me.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa a fala, «Yi sɛgɛtala lu naa. I naxa fefe ɲaaxi yo raba a ra. N bara a kolon i gaaxuma Ala ya ra. N man bara la a ra, i mu tondixi i xa di kerenyi fide n ma sɛrɛxɛ ra.»

sentences.english: And lifting up his eyes, Abraham saw a sheep fixed by its horns in the brushwood: and Abraham took the sheep and made a burned offering of it in place of his son.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa a ya ragbilen a xanbi ra, a naxa yɛxɛɛ kontonyi to sansi longori ra, a feri firinyi kankanxi sansi firi ra. A naxa siga, a sa na yɛxɛɛ kontonyi tongo, a fa a ra. A naxa na ba sɛrɛxɛ ra a xa di ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Abraham gave that place the name Yahweh-yireh: as it is said to this day, In the mountain the Lord is seen.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa na yire xili sa «Alatala mixi kima.» Na nan a toxi han yakɔsi a falama «Alatala mixi kima a xa geya fari.»

sentences.english: And the voice of the angel of the Lord came to Abraham a second time from heaven,
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ man naxa gbilen Iburahima xili ra koore ma.

sentences.english: Saying, I have taken an oath by my name, says the Lord, because you have done this and have not kept back from me your dearly loved only son,
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen a bɛ, «N bara n kali n yɛtɛ ra, Alatala xa masenyi nan ya. I to bara yi raba, i mu tondi i xa di kerenyi ma n bɛ,

sentences.english: That I will certainly give you my blessing, and your seed will be increased like the stars of heaven and the sand by the seaside; your seed will take the land of those who are against them;
sentences.susu: n barakɛ sama nɛ i ma. I bɔnsɔɛ wuyama nɛ alɔ tunbui naxee na koore ma, xa na mu a ra e gboma nɛ alɔ mɛyɛnyi naxan malanxi baa dɛ ra. I bɔnsɔɛ fama nɛ nɔde e yaxuie ra.

sentences.english: And your seed will be a blessing to all the nations of the earth, because you have done what I gave you orders to do.
sentences.susu: N fama nɛ barakɛ sade duniɲa si birin ma i bɔnsɔɛ saabui ra, barima i bara n xui ratinmɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Abraham went back to his young men and they went together to Beer-sheba, the place where Abraham was living.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa gbilen a xa konyie yire. E birin naxa siga Beriseeba, barima Iburahima nu sabatixi mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: After these things, Abraham had news that Milcah, the wife of his brother Nahor, had given birth to children;
sentences.susu: Na fe birin to dangi, Iburahima naxa a mɛ Milika die bari nɛ Iburahima xunya Naxori bɛ.

sentences.english: Uz the oldest, and Buz his brother, and Kemuel, the father of Aram,
sentences.susu: E xili nan ya: A xa di singe Usi, na xanbiratoe Busi, Arami baba Kemuweli,

sentences.english: And Chesed and Hazo and Pildash and Jidlaph and Bethuel.
sentences.susu: Kesede, Haso, Pilidasi, Yidilafi nun Betuweli.

sentences.english: Bethuel was the father of Rebekah: these eight were the children of Milcah and Nahor, Abraham's brother.
sentences.susu: Betuweli findi Rebeka baba nan na. Na di solomasaxanyi, Milika nan nee bari Iburahima xunya Naxori bɛ.

sentences.english: And his servant Reumah gave birth to Tebah and Gaham and Tahash and Maacah.
sentences.susu: Naxori xa konyi ginɛ nu xili nɛ Reyuma. A yi die nan bari: Teba, Gaxami, Taxasa, nun Maaka.

sentences.english: Now the years of Sarah's life were a hundred and twenty-seven.
sentences.susu: Sara to ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn a nun solofere nan sɔtɔ simaya ra,

sentences.english: And Sarah's death took place in Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron, in the land of Canaan: and Abraham went into his house, weeping and sorrowing for Sarah.
sentences.susu: a naxa laaxira Kiriyati Araba, Hebiron mabiri, Kanaan bɔxi ma. Iburahima naxa a xa ginɛ ɲɔn fe raba.

sentences.english: And Abraham came from his dead and said to the children of Heth,
sentences.susu: Iburahima to gɛ wade a xa ginɛ bɛ, a naxa siga Xitikae xɔn ma, a a fala e bɛ,

sentences.english: I am living among you as one from a strange country: give me some land here as my property, so that I may put my dead to rest.
sentences.susu: «Xɔɲɛ nan lanxi n ma wo ya ma be. N bara wo maxandi, wo gaburi yire fi n ma, n nɔma n ma ginɛ ragatade dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: And in answer the children of Heth said to Abraham,
sentences.susu: Xitikae naxa a yaabi,

sentences.english: My lord, truly you are a great chief among us; take the best of our resting-places for your dead; not one of us will keep back from you a place where you may put your dead to rest.
sentences.susu: «I tuli mati muxu ra a fanyi ra. Ala xa mixi nan i ra muxu ya ma. I na wa i xa ginɛ ragatafe muxu xa gaburi yire yoe, i sago na a ra. Muxu tan ya ma be, mixi yo mu na naxan nɔma tondide i bɛ i xa ginɛ ragatade a xa gaburi yire.»

sentences.english: And Abraham got up and gave honour to the children of Heth, the people of that land.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa keli, a igoro bɔxi ma Xiti bɔnsɔɛ ya i, naxee nu sabatixi na bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And he said to them, If you will let me put my dead to rest here, make a request for me to Ephron, the son of Zohar,
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Xa wo bara tin, n xa n ma ginɛ ragata wo xa bɔxi ma, wo xa n ma maxandi radangi Soxara xa di Eferon ma,

sentences.english: That he will give me the hollow in the rock named Machpelah, which is his property at the end of his field; let him give it to me for its full price as a resting-place for my dead among you.
sentences.susu: alako a xa Makipela fɔnmɛ so n yi ra gaburi ra naxan na a xa xɛ fɛ ma. N a kolon a tan nan gbe lanxi mɛnni ma. A xa na sara n ma wo ya xɔri, alako birin xa a kolon na bɔxi bara findi n ma mixi ragatade ra.»

sentences.english: Now Ephron was seated among the children of Heth: and Ephron the Hittite gave Abraham his answer in the hearing of the children of Heth, and of all those who came into his town, saying,
sentences.susu: Eferon Xitika nu tixi naa ɲama tagi. A naxa Iburahima yaabi a xui itexi ra, alako Xitika naxee birin nu malanxi taa sode dɛ ra, e xa nɔ a xa wɔyɛnyi ramɛde.

sentences.english: No, my lord, I will give you the field with the hollow in the rock; before all the children of my people will I give it to you for a resting-place for your dead.
sentences.susu: A naxɛ, «N baba, n bara i maxandi, i tuli mati n na. N bara na xɛ nun na fɔnmɛ fi i ma n bɔnsɔɛ ya xɔri. I xa i xa ginɛ ragata mɛnni.»

sentences.english: And Abraham went down on his face before the people of the land.
sentences.susu: Iburahima man naxa a igoro bɔxi ma ɲama birin ya xɔri,

sentences.english: And Abraham said to Ephron, in the hearing of the people of the land, If only you will give ear to me, I will give you the price of the field; take it, and let me put my dead to rest there.
sentences.susu: a a fala Eferon bɛ, «I xa i haakɛ to n bɛ. I xa xɛ masundi nan ya. Yandi, a rasuxu, alako n xa nɔ n ma ginɛ ragatade mɛnni.»

sentences.english: So Ephron said to Abraham,
sentences.susu: Eferon naxa a yaabi,

sentences.english: My lord, give ear to me: the value of the land is four hundred shekels; what is that between me and you? so put your dead to rest there.
sentences.susu: «N baba, i tuli mati n na a fanyi ra. Bɔxi naxan sare lanma gbeti kilo naani nun a tagi, sese mu na ki i tan nun n tan tagi. I xa ginɛ ragata naa tun!»

sentences.english: And Abraham took note of the price fixed by Ephron in the hearing of the children of Heth, and gave him four hundred shekels in current money.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa tin na sare ra Xitikae ya xɔri. A naxa gbeti kilo naani nun a tagi maniya a bɛ.

sentences.english: So Ephron's field at Machpelah near Mamre, with the hollow in the rock and all the trees in the field and round it,
sentences.susu: Na xɛ naxan na Makipela fɛ ma, Mamire sogetede biri, fɔnmɛ naxan na a nun wuri bili naxan birin sixi na naaninyi ra,

sentences.english: Became the property of Abraham before the eyes of the children of Heth and of all who came into the town.
sentences.susu: na birin naxa findi Iburahima gbe ra. Na Xitika naxee birin nu malanxi taa sode dɛ ra, e birin findixi na fe seede ra.

sentences.english: Then Abraham put Sarah his wife to rest in the hollow rock in the field of Machpelah near Mamre, that is, Hebron in the land of Canaan.
sentences.susu: Na birin dangi xanbi, Iburahima naxa a xa ginɛ Sara ragata na fɔnmɛ kui Makipela xɛ fɛ ma, naxan na Mamire yatagi Hebiron mabiri Kanaan bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the field and the hollow rock were handed over to Abraham as his property by the children of Heth.
sentences.susu: Na xɛ nun na fɔnmɛ naxa ba Xitikae gbeɲa, a findi Iburahima gbe ra, alako a xa nɔ a xa mixie ragatade mɛnni.

sentences.english: Now Abraham was old and far on in years: and the Lord had given him everything in full measure.
sentences.susu: Na waxati Iburahima nu bara gɛ foride. Alatala nu bara barakɛ sa Iburahima xa fe birin.

sentences.english: And Abraham said to his chief servant, the manager of all his property, Come now, put your hand under my leg:
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa a masen a xa walikɛe xunyi bɛ, naxan a ɲɛngi saxi a harige birin xɔn ma, «I bɛlɛxɛ sa n tabe bun ma kali ki ma.

sentences.english: And take an oath by the Lord, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you will not get a wife for my son Isaac from the daughters of the Canaanites among whom I am living;
sentences.susu: N fafe i rakalide koore nun bɔxi Marigi Alatala ra, alako i naxa Kanaan ginɛ fen n ma di bɛ n sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: But that you will go into my country and to my relations and get a wife there for my son Isaac.
sentences.susu: A xɔli n ma i xa siga n bari bɔxi nan ma, i fa mɛnni ginɛ nde fen n bɔnsɔɛ ya ma n ma di Isiyaga bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the servant said, If by chance the woman will not come with me into this land, am I to take your son back again to the land from which you came?
sentences.susu: A xa walikɛ naxa a yaabi, «Xa a sa li na ginɛ mu tin birade n fɔxɔ ra fafe yi bɔxi ma, n xa i xa di xanin i xa bɔxi ma, i kelixi dɛnnaxɛ?»

sentences.english: And Abraham said, Take care that you do not let my son go back to that land.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa a yaabi, «I naxa n ma di ragbilen mɛnni de!

sentences.english: The Lord God of heaven, who took me from my father's house and from the land of my birth, and made an oath to me, saying, To your seed I will give this land: he will send his angel before you and give you a wife for my son in that land.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxan na koore ma, naxan n tongoxi n bari mixie ya ma, naxan n nakelixi n ma bɔxi ma, a fa a kali a yi bɔxi fima nɛ n bɔnsɔɛ ma, a tan yati fama nɛ a xa malekɛ xɛɛde i malife ra, alako i xa nɔ ginɛ tongode mɛnni n ma di bɛ.

sentences.english: And if the woman will not come with you, then you are free from this oath; only do not take my son back there.
sentences.susu: Xa na ginɛ mu fa sa tin birade i fɔxɔ ra, i fama nɛ ratangade n ma marakali ma, i naxan tongoxi n bɛ. Kɔnɔ i naxa n ma di xanin mɛnni de!»

sentences.english: And the servant put his hand under Abraham's leg, and gave him his oath about this thing.
sentences.susu: Na walikɛ naxa a bɛlɛxɛ sa a marigi Iburahima tabe bun ma, a naxa a rakali.

sentences.english: And the servant took ten of his master's camels, and all sorts of good things of his master's, and went to Mesopotamia, to the town of Nahor.
sentences.susu: A naxa ɲɔxɔmɛ fu tongo Iburahima xa ɲɔxɔmɛ gɔɔrɛ ya ma, a kote gbegbe sa e fari. A naxa keli, a siga Naxori xa taa Padan Arami bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And he made the camels take their rest outside the town by the water-spring in the evening, at the time when the women came to get water.
sentences.susu: Iburahima xa walikɛ to mɛnni li, a naxa ɲɔxɔmɛe ragoro taa fari ma kɔlɔnyi nde sɛɛti ma. Nunmare tɛmui nan nu a ra, ginɛe minima ye bade tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And he said, O Lord, the God of my master Abraham, let me do well in what I have undertaken this day, and give your mercy to my master Abraham.
