sentences.susu: A naxa Ala maxandi, «N marigi Iburahima Marigi Alatala, n bara i maxandi alako n ma ɲɛrɛ xa findi n bɛ xun nakeli ra to lɔxɔɛ. I man xa hinnɛ n marigi Iburahima ra.

sentences.english: See, I am waiting here by the water-spring; and the daughters of the town are coming out to get water:
sentences.susu: I bara n to n na kɔlɔnyi sɛɛti ma, taa ginɛ dimɛe na fafe ye bade.

sentences.english: Now, may the girl to whom I say, Let down your vessel and give me a drink, and who says in answer, Here is a drink for you and let me give water to your camels: may she be the one marked out by you for your servant Isaac: so may I be certain that you have been good to my master Abraham.
sentences.susu: N fama nɛ ginɛ dimɛ nde maxɔrinde a xa a xa ye base so n yi ra, n xa ye min. Xa a sa n yaabi, ‹Ye min, n xa ye so i xa ɲɔxɔmɛe fan yi ra,› n fama nɛ a kolonde na tɛmui, i na ginɛ yati nan sugandixi i xa konyi Isiyaga bɛ. Na tɛmui n fama a kolonde i bara hinnɛ n marigi Iburahima ra.»

sentences.english: And even before his words were ended, Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Milcah, who was the wife of Nahor, Abraham's brother, came out with her water-vessel on her arm.
sentences.susu: Beenun a xa gɛ na wɔyɛnyi ra, na nan lan Betuweli xa di ginɛ Rebeka naxa fa. Iburahima xunya Naxori xa mamadi nan lanxi a ma. A xa fɛɲɛ dɔxɔxi a tunki fari.

sentences.english: She was a very beautiful girl, a virgin, who had never been touched by a man: and she went down to the spring to get water in her vessel.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ dimɛdi tofanyi nan nu a ra, naxan mu xɛmɛ fe kolon. A naxa goro kɔlɔnyi yire, a naxa a ye base rafe ye ra, a man naxa te.

sentences.english: And the servant came running to her and said, Give me a little water from your vessel.
sentences.susu: Iburahima xa walikɛ naxa a gi a sa a ralan. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «N bara i maxandi, a lu n xa ye nde min, naxan na i xa fɛɲɛ kui.»

sentences.english: And she said, Take a drink, my lord: and quickly letting down her vessel onto her hand, she gave him a drink.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «N ba, ye min.» A naxa a xa fɛɲɛ ragoro a tunki fari, a ye so a yi ra.

sentences.english: And having done so, she said, I will get water for your camels till they have had enough.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ na ra, a naxa a fala a bɛ, «N ye bama nɛ i xa ɲɔxɔmɛe fan bɛ, alako e birin xa ye min a fanyi ra.»

sentences.english: And after putting the water from her vessel into the animals' drinking-place, she went quickly back to the spring and got water for all the camels.
sentences.susu: Mafuren, a naxa a xa fɛɲɛ ibagan kuurɛ kui, a man a gi sigafe kɔlɔn dɛ ra a xa ye gbɛtɛ ba. A naxa ye ba han ɲɔxɔmɛ birin naxa wasa.

sentences.english: And the man, looking at her, said nothing, waiting to see if the Lord had given his journey a good outcome.
sentences.susu: Iburahima xa walikɛ nu fa a maɲɔxun, «Tɛmunde Alatala bara n ma biyaasi sɔɔnɛya n bɛ.»

sentences.english: And when the camels had had enough, the man took a gold nose-ring, half a shekel in weight, and two ornaments for her arms of ten shekels weight of gold;
sentences.susu: Ɲɔxɔmɛe to bara gɛ ye minde, Iburahima xa mixi naxa ɲɔɛrasoe xɛɛma daaxi so Rebeka ɲɔɛ ra, naxan xa binyɛ giramu senni lima. A man naxa bɛlɛxɛrasoe firin xɛɛma daaxie so a bɛlɛxɛ ra, naxan keren xa binyɛ dangi giramu kɛmɛ ra.

sentences.english: And said to her, Whose daughter are you? is there room in your father's house for us?
sentences.susu: A naxa ginɛdimɛdi maxɔrin, «Nde xa di lanxi i ma? Yandi, a fala n bɛ, i baba nɔma muxu yigiyade to kɔɛ ra?»

sentences.english: And she said to him, I am the daughter of Bethuel, the son of Milcah, Nahor's wife.
sentences.susu: Rebeka naxa a yaabi, «Betuweli xa di nan lanxi n ma, Milika nun Naxori xa mamadi.»

sentences.english: And she said, We have a great store of dry grass and cattle-food, and there is room for you.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a fala, «Muxu xɔnyi sɛxɛ nun ɲooge gbegbe na na, yigiya fan na na wo luma dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: And with bent head the man gave worship to the Lord;
sentences.susu: Iburahima xa walikɛ naxa a igoro bɔxi ma Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And said, Praise be to the Lord, the God of my master Abraham, who has given a sign that he is good and true to my master, by guiding me straight to the house of my master's family.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala, «N marigi Iburahima Marigi Alatala, n bara i tantu. I mu tagan hinnɛde n marigi Iburahima ra, i xa lanlanteya mu kana. Alatala n xun tixi n marigi Iburahima xabilɛ nan xɔnyi ra.»

sentences.english: So the girl went running and took the news of these things to her mother's house
sentences.susu: Rebeka naxa siga a gi ra a nga yire, alako fe naxan dangixi, a xa a tagi raba a bɛ.

sentences.english: Now Rebekah had a brother named Laban, and he came out quickly to the man at the water-spring.
sentences.susu: Rebeka taara Laban naxa a xulun sigafe ra kɔlɔn yire, Iburahima xa walikɛ nu tixi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And when he saw the nose-ring and the ornaments on his sister's hands, and when she gave him word of what the man had said to her, then he went out to the man who was waiting with the camels by the water-spring.
sentences.susu: Laban nu bara a maaginɛ to, ɲɔɛrasoe a ɲɔɛ ra, bɛlɛxɛrasoe a bɛlɛxɛ ra. A man nu bara a xa dɛntɛgɛ mɛ, xɛmɛ naxan falaxi a bɛ. Na kui, a naxa siga na xɛmɛ ralande kɔlɔnyi fɛ ma, ɲɔxɔmɛe nu na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And he said to him, Come in, you on whom is the blessing of the Lord; why are you waiting outside? for I have made the house ready for you, and a place for the camels.
sentences.susu: Laban naxa a fala a bɛ, «Alatala bara baraka sa i tan naxan ma fe, i tixi be munfe ra, dɛnnaxɛ makuya taa ra? I xa so n xɔnyi. N bara banxi yailan i yigiya ra, n bara yire rafala i xa ɲɔxɔmɛe luma dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: Then the man came into the house, and Laban took their cords off the camels and gave them dry grass and food, and he gave to him and the men who were with him water for washing their feet.
sentences.susu: Iburahima xa walikɛ naxa so Laban xɔnyi. Laban naxa ɲɔxɔmɛe xa kote ragoro, a fa donse so e yi ra, a yire yailan e bɛ. A naxa ye fan so Iburahima xa mixie yi ra, alako e xa e sanyie maxa.

sentences.english: And meat was put before him, but he said, I will not take food till I have made my business clear to you. And they said, Do so.
sentences.susu: Laban to fa donse ra e bɛ, Iburahima xa walikɛ naxa a fala, «N mu n dɛgema sinden, fo n xa n dɛntɛgɛ wo bɛ.» Laban naxa a fala a bɛ, «Awa yire, dɛntɛgɛ sa.»

sentences.english: And he said, I am Abraham's servant.
sentences.susu: Iburahima xa walikɛ naxa a masen, «N tan nan na Iburahima xa walikɛ ra.

sentences.english: The Lord has given my master every blessing, and he has become great: he has given him flocks and herds and silver and gold, and men-servants and women-servants and camels and asses.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara barakɛ sa n marigi Iburahima xa fe ki fanyi. A bara findi banna ra, barima Alatala bara xuruse mɔɔli birin fi a ma, a nun gbeti, xɛɛma, konyie, ɲɔxɔmɛe, nun sofalee. Alatala bara na birin fi a ma.

sentences.english: And when Sarah, my master's wife, was old, she gave birth to a son, to whom he has given all he has.
sentences.susu: N marigi Iburahima xa ginɛ Sara bara di fan bari a bɛ a xa foriɲa kui. Iburahima a harige birin fixi na di nan ma.»

sentences.english: And my master made me take an oath, saying, Do not get a wife for my son from the daughters of the Canaanites among whom I am living;
sentences.susu: «Iburahima n nakalixi nɛ, ‹I naxa ginɛ tongo n ma di bɛ naxan findi Kanaanka ra n sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: But go to my father's house and to my relations for a wife for my son.
sentences.susu: I xa siga n baba bariboore yire n xabilɛ tagi, alako i xa ginɛ tongo n ma di bɛ mɛnni.›

sentences.english: And I said to my master, What if the woman will not come with me?
sentences.susu: N marigi to na fala n bɛ, n naxa a maxɔrin, ‹Xa na ginɛ fa tondi birade n fɔxɔ ra go?›

sentences.english: And he said, The Lord, whom I have ever kept before me, will send his angel with you, who will make it possible for you to get a wife for my son from my relations and my father's house;
sentences.susu: A naxa n yaabi, ‹N ɲɛrɛma Alatala naxan ya i, a fama a xa malekɛ birade i fɔxɔ ra i xa ɲɛrɛ kui alako a xa sɔɔnɛya. I fama nɛ ginɛ tongode n ma di bɛ n xabilɛ tagi n baba xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And you will be free from your oath to me when you come to my people; and if they will not give her to you, you will be free from your oath.
sentences.susu: I na siga n xabilɛ ra, xa e mu fa sa ginɛ dimɛdi so i yi ra feo, i bara ratanga n ma marakali ma.›»

sentences.english: And I came today to the water-spring, and I said, O Lord, the God of my master Abraham, if it is your purpose to give a good outcome to my journey,
sentences.susu: «N to kɔlɔn yire li, n naxa Ala maxandi, ‹Alatala, n marigi Iburahima naxan batuma, n bara i mayandi i xa n ma biyaasi sɔɔnɛya.

sentences.english: Let it come about that, while I am waiting here by the water-spring, if a girl comes to get water and I say to her, Give me a little water from your vessel, and she says,
sentences.susu: I ya ti n na yi kɔlɔnyi sɛɛti ma. N fama nɛ ginɛ dimɛdi nde maxɔrinde naxan fafe ye bade, a xa ye so n yi ra naxan na a xa fɛɲɛ kui alako n xa a min.

sentences.english: Take a drink, and I will get water for your camels; let her be the woman marked out by the Lord for my master's son.
sentences.susu: Xa a n yaabi, «Ye min, n ye bama nɛ i xa ɲɔxɔmɛe fan bɛ, e min,» n a kolonma na tɛmui, Alatala na ginɛ dimɛdi yati nan sugandixi n marigi Iburahima xa di bɛ.›»

sentences.english: And even while I was saying this to myself, Rebekah came out with her vessel on her arm; and she went down to the spring to get water; and I said to her, Give me a drink.
sentences.susu: «Beenun n xa gɛ na wɔyɛnyi raɲɔnde n yɛtɛ ma, na nan lan Rebeka naxa fa, fɛɲɛ dɔxɔxi a tunki fari. A naxa goro kɔlɔnyi ra, a ye ba. N naxa a fala a bɛ, ‹N bara i maxandi, n ki ye, n xa a min.›

sentences.english: And straight away she took down her vessel from her arm, and said, Take a drink, and I will get water for your camels.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa fɛɲɛ ragoro mafuren a tunki fari, a naxa a fala n bɛ, ‹Ye min. I na gɛ ye minde n ye soma nɛ i xa ɲɔxɔmɛe fan yi ra.›

sentences.english: And questioning her, I said, Whose daughter are you? And she said, The daughter of Bethuel, the son of Nahor, and Milcah his wife. Then I put the ring on her nose and the ornaments on her hands.
sentences.susu: N naxa a maxɔrin, ‹Nde xa di na i ra?› A naxa n yaabi, ‹Betuweli xa di ginɛ nan n na, Naxori nun Milika xa mamadi.› Na kui n naxa xɛɛma so a ɲɔɛ ra, n naxa xɛɛma bɛlɛxɛrasoe so a bɛlɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: And with bent head I gave worship and praise to the Lord, the God of my master Abraham, by whom I had been guided in the right way, to get the daughter of my master's brother for his son.
sentences.susu: N naxa n igoro bɔxi ma Alatala bɛ. N naxa n marigi Iburahima Marigi Alatala tantu, barima a bara n xun ti n marigi xunya xa di ginɛma ra, n xa a futi a xa di bɛ.

sentences.english: And now, say if you will do what is good and right for my master or not, in order that it may be clear to me what I have to do.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, Laban, a fala n bɛ xa i bara tin fe fanyi nun fe tinxinxi rabafe n marigi bɛ. Xa na mu a ra n sigama nɛ yire gbɛtɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Laban and Bethuel said in answer, This is the Lord's doing: it is not for us to say Yes or No to you.
sentences.susu: Laban nun Betuweli naxa a yaabi, «Alatala nan yi fe ragirixi. Muxu mu fama na maxɔrɔxɔde.

sentences.english: See, here is Rebekah: take her and go, and let her be your master's son's wife, as the Lord has said.
sentences.susu: Rebeka nan tixi i ya i yi ki. A xanin i xun ma, alako a xa findi i marigi xa di xa ginɛ ra, alɔ Alatala a masenxi ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And at these words, Abraham's servant went down on his face and gave praise to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Iburahima xa walikɛ to na wɔyɛnyi mɛ, a naxa a igoro bɔxi ma Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: Then he took jewels of silver and jewels of gold and fair robes and gave them to Rebekah: and he gave things of value to her mother and her brother.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, a naxa bunse gbeti daaxi, bunse xɛɛma daaxi, a nun dugie fi Rebeka ma. A naxa sanbɛ fanyie fi Rebeka nga nun a taara fan ma.

sentences.english: Then he and the men who were with him had food and drink, and took their rest there that night; and in the morning he got up, and said, Let me now go back to my master.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Iburahima xa walikɛ nun a xa mixie naxa e dɛge, e min, e fa so e sade. E to keli gɛɛsɛgɛ, Iburahima xa walikɛ naxa a masen Rebeka nga nun a taara bɛ, «Wo a lu fa n xa gbilen n marigi xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: But her brother and her mother said, Let the girl be with us a week or ten days, and then she may go.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala, «Rebeka xa xi fu ɲɔndɔn naba be sinden, na tɛmui wo fa siga.»

sentences.english: And he said, Do not keep me; the Lord has given a good outcome to my journey; let me now go back to my master.
sentences.susu: Iburahima xa walikɛ naxa e yaabi, «Wo naxa n makankan be. Alatala bara n ma biyaasi sɔɔnɛya. Wo a lu fa n xa gbilen n marigi xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: And they said, We will send for the girl, and let her make the decision.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala, «Won xa Rebeka xili, won xa a kolon ɲanige naxan na a bɛ.»

sentences.english: And they sent for Rebekah and said to her, Are you ready to go with this man? And she said, I am ready.
sentences.susu: E naxa Rebeka xili, e naxa a maxɔrin, «I wama sigafe wo nun yi xɛmɛ ra?» Rebeka naxa e yaabi, «Iyo, n wama sigafe.»

sentences.english: So they sent their sister Rebekah and her servant with Abraham's servant and his men.
sentences.susu: Na kui e naxa e xunya Rebeka nun a mɛɛnima so Iburahima xa walikɛ nun a xa mixie yi ra.

sentences.english: And they gave Rebekah their blessing, saying, O sister, may you be the mother of thousands and ten thousands; and may your seed overcome all those who make war against them.
sentences.susu: E naxa duba Rebeka bɛ a falafe ra, «Muxu xunya nan lanxi i ma. Ala xa i findi ɲama gbegbe barima ra. I bɔnsɔɛ xa nɔ i yaxuie ra.»

sentences.english: So Rebekah and her servant-women went with the man, seated on the camels; and so the servant took Rebekah and went on his way.
sentences.susu: Rebeka nun a xa ginɛe naxa dɔxɔ ɲɔxɔmɛe fari, e naxa bira Iburahima xa walikɛ fɔxɔ ra. E birin naxa siga.

sentences.english: Now Isaac had come through the waste land to Beer-lahai-roi; for he was living in the South.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga nu bara keli kɔlɔn yire naxan xili «Ala ɲiɲɛ naxan n toxi.» A nu bara sabati Negewi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And when the evening was near, he went wandering out into the fields, and lifting up his eyes he saw camels coming.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde, Isiyaga to mini a maɲɛrɛde daaxa nunmare tɛmui, a naxa Iburahima xa walikɛ xa ɲɔxɔmɛe to fa ra.

sentences.english: And when Rebekah, looking up, saw Isaac, she got down from her camel,
sentences.susu: Rebeka to bara Isiyaga to, a naxa goro ɲɔxɔmɛe fari,

sentences.english: And said to the servant, Who is that man coming to us through the field? And the servant said, It is my master: then she took her veil, covering her face with it.
sentences.susu: a fa walikɛ maxɔrin, «Nde na na xɛmɛ ra naxan sa fafe na ki, keli daaxa longori ra won nalande?»

sentences.english: Then the servant gave Isaac the story of all he had done.
sentences.susu: Iburahima xa walikɛ naxa a yaabi, «N marigi nan a ra.» Na nan lan, Rebeka naxa a ya makoto a xa mafelenyi ra. Iburahima xa walikɛ naxa dɛntɛgɛ sa Isiyaga bɛ, a fe naxan birin nadangixi.

sentences.english: And Isaac took Rebekah into his tent and she became his wife; and in his love for her, Isaac was comforted after his father's death.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Isiyaga naxa Rebeka xanin a nga xa kiri banxi kui, a a findi a xa ginɛ ra. Isiyaga naxa a xanu a bɔɲɛ birin na, han a nga xa faxɛ sunnunyi naxa ba a ma.

sentences.english: And Abraham took another wife named Keturah.
sentences.susu: Iburahima man naxa ginɛ gbɛtɛ dɔxɔ naxan xili Ketura.

sentences.english: She became the mother of Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and Midian and Ishbak and Shuah.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ naxa die bari a bɛ. Na die nu xili: Simiran, Yokosan, Medan, Madiyan, Yisebaki, nun Suwa.

sentences.english: And Jokshan became the father of Sheba and Dedan. And from Dedan came the Asshurim and Letushim and Leummim.
sentences.susu: Yokosan naxa Seeba nun Dedan bari. Dedan bɔnsɔɛ findi Asurikae, Letusikae, nun Leyumikae nan na.

sentences.english: And from Midian came Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these were the offspring of Keturah.
sentences.susu: Madiyan xa die lanxi Efa, Efere, Hanoki, Abida, nun Elidaa nan ma. Ketura xa die nan lanxi e ma.

sentences.english: Now Abraham gave all his property to Isaac;
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa a harige birin fi Isiyaga ma.

sentences.english: But to the sons of his other women he gave offerings, and sent them away, while he was still living, into the east country.
sentences.susu: A naxa se gbegbe fan fi a xa ginɛ booree xa die ma, a fa e makuya a xa di Isiyaga ra, a e rasiga bɔxi nde ma naxan na sogetede mabiri.

sentences.english: Now the years of Abraham's life were a hundred and seventy-five.
sentences.susu: Iburahima xa simaya naxa siga han ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ tongo solofere nun suuli.

sentences.english: And Abraham came to his death, an old man, full of years; and he was put to rest with his people.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, a naxa faxa hɛɛri kui, a a benbae li aligiyama.

sentences.english: And Isaac and Ishmael, his sons, put him to rest in the hollow rock of Machpelah, in the field of Ephron, the son of Zohar the Hittite, near Mamre;
sentences.susu: A xa die Isiyaga nun Sumayila naxa a ragata Makipela fɔnmɛ kui, Soxara Xitika xa di Eferon xa bɔxi ma Mamire fɛ ma.

sentences.english: The same field which Abraham got from the children of Heth: there Abraham was put to rest with Sarah, his wife.
sentences.susu: Iburahima na bɔxi sara Xitikae bɔnsɔɛ nan ma. E nun a xa ginɛ Sara, e birin nagataxi mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: Now after the death of Abraham, the blessing of God was with Isaac, his son.
sentences.susu: Iburahima faxa xanbi, Ala naxa barakɛ sa a xa di Isiyaga ma. A nu sabatixi kɔlɔnyi fɛ ma, naxan xili «Ala ɲiɲɛ naxan n toxi.»

sentences.english: Now these are the generations of Ishmael, the son of Abraham, whose mother was Hagar the Egyptian, the servant of Sarah:
sentences.susu: Xilie nan ya naxee findi Sumayila bɔnsɔɛ ra. Sara nu bara a xa konyi ginɛ Misiraka Hagara fi Iburahima ma. Hagara naxa Sumayila sɔtɔ di ra.

sentences.english: These are the names of the sons of Ishmael by their generations: Ishmael's first son was Nebaioth; then Kedar and Adbeel and Mibsam
sentences.susu: Sumayila xa die nan ya, e barixi ki naxɛ e boore fɔxɔ ra: Nebayoti, Sumayila xa di singe, Kedari, Adabeeli, Mibisami,

sentences.english: And Mishma and Dumah and Massa,
sentences.susu: Misima, Duma, Masa,

sentences.english: Hadad and Tema, Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah:
sentences.susu: Hadada, Tema, Yeturi, Nafisi, nun Kedema. Na di fu nun firinyi findi Sumayila xa die nan na.

sentences.english: These are the sons of Ishmael, and these are their names in their towns and their tent-circles; twelve chiefs with their peoples.
sentences.susu: Na mixi keren keren ma findi bɔxi mangɛe nan na. E naxa e xilie sa e xa taae xun ma a nun e xa mixie.

sentences.english: And the years of Ishmael's life were a hundred and thirty-seven: and he came to his end, and was put to rest with his people.
sentences.susu: Sumayila xa simaya dan ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ tongo saxan nun solofere nɛ. A naxa laaxira, a sa a benbae li aligiyama.

sentences.english: And their country was from Havilah to Shur which is east of Egypt: they took their place to the east of all their brothers.
sentences.susu: Sumayila bɔnsɔɛ nu sabatixi bɔxi nan ma, dɛnnaxɛ nu na Hawila nun Suru tagi. Suru ya rafindixi Misira nan ma Asuri kira ra. E nu sabatixi e ngaxakerenyie nan sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Now these are the generations of Abraham's son Isaac:
sentences.susu: Isiyaga xa taruxui nan ya: Isiyaga findi Iburahima xa di nan na.

sentences.english: Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah, the daughter of Bethuel the Aramaean of Paddan-aram, and the sister of Laban the Aramaean, to be his wife.
sentences.susu: A to bara ɲɛ tongo naani sɔtɔ simaya ra, a naxa Rebeka dɔxɔ, Laban xunya ginɛma, Betuweli xa di ginɛ. Aramikae nan na e ra, kelife Padan Arami.

sentences.english: Isaac made prayer to the Lord for his wife because she had no children; and the Lord gave ear to his prayer, and Rebekah became with child.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Rebeka mu nu nɔma di baride Isiyaga bɛ. Isiyaga naxa Alatala maxandi a xa ginɛ xa fe ra a xa nɔ di baride. Alatala naxa a xa duba suxu, Rebeka naxa tɛɛgɛ.

sentences.english: And the children were fighting together inside her, and she said, If it is to be so, why am I like this? So she went to put her question to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na die nu fa gere e nga tɛɛgɛ. A naxa a yɛtɛ maxɔrin, «Munfe rabafe n bɛ yi ki?» Na kui a naxa siga Alatala maxɔrinde.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to her, Two nations are in your body, and two peoples will come to birth from you: the one will be stronger than the other, and the older will be the servant of the younger.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «Si dɔxɔ firin nan na i tɛɛgɛ. Keren sɛnbɛ gboma nɛ boore bɛ. Taara nan fama lude a xunya xa nɔɛ bun ma.»

sentences.english: And when the time came for her to give birth, there were two children in her body.
sentences.susu: A di bari tɛmui to a li, Rebeka naxa gulie bari.

sentences.english: And the first came out red from head to foot like a robe of hair, and they gave him the name of Esau.
sentences.susu: A xa di singe findixi mixi gbeeli nan na. Fate maxabe gbegbe kanyi nan nu a ra. E naxa a xili sa Esayu.

sentences.english: And after him, his brother came out, gripping Esau's foot; and he was named Jacob: Isaac was sixty years old when she gave birth to them.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi a xunya fan naxa bari. A bɛlɛxɛ raxutuxi a taara tingilinyi ma. E naxa a fan xili sa Yaxuba. Isiyaga na die barima tɛmui naxɛ, a nu na ɲɛ tongo senni nɛ.

sentences.english: And the boys came to full growth; and Esau became a man of the open country, an expert bowman; but Jacob was a quiet man, living in tents.
sentences.susu: Na di xɛmɛ firinyi naxa mɔ. Esayu naxa findi koyinma fanyi ra naxan nu wula i sama. Naxan findi Yaxuba tan na, mixi maxinbelixi nan nu a ra, a tan nu dɔxɔma kiri banxi nan bun ma.

sentences.english: Now Isaac's love was for Esau, because Esau's meat was greatly to his taste: but Rebekah had more love for Jacob.
sentences.susu: Esayu nan nu rafan Isiyaga ma, barima a nu fama sube ra a bɛ. Yaxuba tan nu rafan Rebeka nan ma.

sentences.english: And one day Jacob was cooking some soup when Esau came in from the fields in great need of food;
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Yaxuba nu bara supi yailan. Esayu naxa so, a taganxi kelife koyinde.

sentences.english: And Esau said to Jacob, Give me a full meal of that red soup, for I am overcome with need for food: for this reason he was named Edom.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a bɛ, «N mu nɔma fefe ra yi ki. A lu n xa yi supi gbeeli nde min.» Na nan toxi a Edon xili naxa sa a xun ma, na nan na ki «a gbeeli.»

sentences.english: And Jacob said, First of all give me your birthright.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a yaabi, «I xa foriɲa tide fi n ma sinden.»

sentences.english: And Esau said, Truly, I am at the point of death: what profit is the birthright to me?
sentences.susu: Esayu naxa a masen, «N na faxafe, kaamɛ nan na n ma yi ki. Na foriɲa tide munse fanma n ma?»

sentences.english: And Jacob said, First of all give me your oath; and he gave him his oath, handing over his birthright to Jacob.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba man naxa a fala, «Fo i xa i kali.» Esayu naxa a kali a a bara a xa foriɲa tide fi a ma.

sentences.english: Then Jacob gave him bread and soup; and he took food and drink and went away, caring little for his birthright.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa taami nun na toge supi nde so a yi ra. Esayu to gɛ a dɛgede, a a min, a naxa siga. Esayu mu tide yo toxi a xa foriɲa ma.

sentences.english: Then came a time of great need in the land, like that which had been before in the days of Abraham. And Isaac went to Abimelech, king of the Philistines, at Gerar.
sentences.susu: Kaamɛ naxa so bɔxi kui, bafe kaamɛ singe ra naxan naba Iburahima xa waxati. Isiyaga naxa siga Filisita mangɛ Abimeleki xɔnyi, naxan nu na Gerara.

sentences.english: And the Lord came to him in a vision and said, Do not go down to Egypt; keep in the land of which I will give you knowledge:
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa mini Isiyaga ma, a a masen a bɛ, «I naxa siga Misira bɔxi ma de. I xa lu bɔxi ma n na dɛnnaxɛ masen i bɛ.

sentences.english: Keep in this land, and I will be with you and give you my blessing; for to you and to your seed will I give all these lands, giving effect to the oath which I made to your father Abraham;
sentences.susu: Lu be. Won birin na a ra. N barakɛ sama nɛ i xa fe, barima n fama yi bɔxi fide i tan nun i bɔnsɔɛe nan ma. N laayidi naxan tongo i baba Iburahima bɛ, n na rakamalima nɛ.

sentences.english: I will make your seed like the stars of heaven in number, and will give them all these lands, and your seed will be a blessing to all the nations of the earth;
sentences.susu: N i bɔnsɔɛ rawuyama nɛ alɔ tunbui naxee na koore ma. N yi bɔxi fima nɛ i bɔnsɔɛ ma. N barakɛ sama nɛ duniɲa si birin ma i bɔnsɔɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: Because Abraham gave ear to my voice and kept my words, my rules, my orders, and my laws.
sentences.susu: Iburahima n xui ramɛ nɛ. A naxa a ɲɛngi sa n ma sɛriyɛ, n ma mangɛya, n ma yaamarie, nun n ma tɔnyie xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: So Isaac went on living in Gerar;
sentences.susu: Na kui Isiyaga naxa sabati Gerara.

sentences.english: And when he was questioned by the men of the place about his wife, he said, She is my sister; fearing to say, She is my wife; for, he said, the men of the place may put me to death on account of Rebekah; because she is very beautiful.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee dɔxɔxi mɛnni, nee naxa a maxɔrin a xa ginɛ xa fe ma. A naxa e yaabi, a a xunya ginɛma nan lanxi a ma. A mu suusa a falade e bɛ, a xa ginɛ nan lanxi Rebeka ma alako mɛnni mixie naxa fa a faxa. A bara gaaxu a falade a xa ginɛ na a ra barima Rebeka ginɛ tofanyi nan nu lanxi a ma.

sentences.english: And when he had been there for some time, Abimelech, king of the Philistines, looking through a window, saw Isaac playing with Rebekah his wife.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga to bara bu naa, lɔxɔɛ nde Filisitakae xa mangɛ Abimeleki naxa a ya ramini wundɛri ra, a naxa a to Isiyaga na Rebeka mafurukufe.

sentences.english: And he said to Isaac, It is clear that she is your wife: why then did you say, She is my sister? And Isaac said, For fear that I might be put to death because of her.
sentences.susu: Abimeleki naxa a xili a xɔnyi. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xa ginɛ yati nan lanxi yi ma! Munfe ra i fa a fala muxu bɛ i xunya ginɛma nan a ra?» Isiyaga naxa a yaabi, «N nu gaaxuxi nɛ wo naxa fa n faxa. Na nan a to n naxa na fala.»

sentences.english: Then Abimelech said, What have you done to us? one of the people might well have had connection with your wife, and the sin would have been ours.
sentences.susu: Abimeleki man naxa a maxɔrin, «I munse rabaxi muxu ra yi ki? Xa mixi nde fa mini n ma ɲama ya ma go, a naxa i xa ginɛ findi a yɛtɛ ra? Na tɛmui i bara muxu ratantan.»

sentences.english: And Abimelech gave orders to his people that anyone touching Isaac or his wife was to be put to death.
sentences.susu: Abimeleki naxa yaamari fi a xa ɲama birin ma, «Mixi yo na din yi xɛmɛ nun a xa ginɛ ra, n na kanyi faxama nɛ.»

sentences.english: Now Isaac, planting seed in that land, got in the same year fruit a hundred times as much, for the blessing of the Lord was on him.
sentences.susu: Na ɲɛ ra, Isiyaga naxa xɛ sa na bɔxi ma. A to na xɛ xaba, a naxa a xa sansi wolixi ɲɔndɔn kɛmɛ sɔtɔ, barima Alatala bara barakɛ sa a xa fe.

sentences.english: And his wealth became very great, increasing more and more;
sentences.susu: A harige xun naxa masa, a findi banna ra.

sentences.english: For he had great wealth of flocks and herds and great numbers of servants; so that the Philistines were full of envy.
sentences.susu: Yɛxɛɛ, si, ninge, nun konyi gbegbe nu na a yi ra. Na kui Filisitakae naxa Isiyaga tɔɔnɛ.

sentences.english: Now all the water-holes, which his father's servants had made in the days of Abraham, had been stopped up with earth by the Philistines.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa kɔlɔnyi birin nafe bɛndɛ ra, Isiyaga baba Iburahima xa konyi naxee ge Iburahima xa waxati.

sentences.english: And Abimelech said to Isaac, Go away from us, for you are stronger than we are.
sentences.susu: Abimeleki naxa a fala Isiyaga bɛ, «Fo i xa keli be. I bara sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ dangi muxu tan na.»

sentences.english: So Isaac went away from there, and put up his tents in the valley of Gerar, making his living-place there.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga naxa keli naa, a sa sabati Gerara gulunba kui.

sentences.english: And he made again the water-holes which had been made in the days of Abraham his father, and which had been stopped up by the Philistines; and he gave them the names which his father had given them.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga naxa kɔlɔnyie iba, naxee nu gexi a baba waxati, Filisitakae naxee dɛsɛ Iburahima faxa xanbi. A baba nu na kɔlɔnyie xili falama ki naxɛ, Isiyaga man naxa na xilie fala e xun ma.

sentences.english: Now Isaac's servants made holes in the valley, and came to a spring of flowing water.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga xa konyie man naxa kɔlɔnyi gbɛtɛ ge na gulunba yire, dulonyi fa mini a kui.

sentences.english: But the herdmen of Gerar had a fight with Isaac's herdmen, for they said, The spring is ours: so he gave the spring the name of Esek, because there was a fight about it.
sentences.susu: Gerara xa xuruse dɛmadonyie nun Isiyaga xa xuruse dɛmadonyie naxa kɔnɲɛ na kɔlɔnyi xa fe ra. E birin nu fa a fala e boore bɛ, «Muxu tan nan gbe na na kɔlɔnyi ra.» Isiyaga naxa na kɔlɔnyi xili fala «sɔnxɔɛ,» barima sɔnxɔɛ bara bira a xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Then they made another water-hole, and there was a fight about that, so he gave it the name of Sitnah.
sentences.susu: A xa konyie man naxa kɔlɔnyi gbɛtɛ ge, sɔnxɔɛ man naxa bira na fan xa fe ra. A naxa a xili fala Sitina, na nan na ki «galanbui kɔlɔnyi.»

sentences.english: Then he went away from there, and made another water-hole, about which there was no fighting: so he gave it the name of Rehoboth, for he said, Now the Lord has made room for us, and we will have fruit in this land.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga naxa keli naa, a sa kɔlɔnyi ge yire gbɛtɛ. Na kɔlɔnyi to ge, sɔnxɔɛ mu bira na tan xa fe ra. A naxa a xili fala Rehoboti kɔlɔnyi, na nan na ki «makuye kɔlɔnyi,» barima a naxɛ, «Alatala bara won makuya bekae ra alako won ma fe xa sɔɔnɛya yi bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And from there he went on to Beer-sheba.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga to keli mɛnni sigafe ra Beriseeba,

sentences.english: That night the Lord came to him in a vision, and said, I am the God of your father Abraham: have no fear for I am with you, blessing you, and your seed will be increased because of my servant Abraham.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa mini a ma kɔɛ ra. A naxa a masen a bɛ, «I baba Iburahima Marigi Ala lanxi n tan nan ma. I naxa gaaxu fefe ra, won tan nan a ra yire birin. N man barakɛ sama nɛ i xa fe. N i bɔnsɔɛ rawuyama nɛ n ma konyi Iburahima xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: Then he made an altar there, and gave worship to the name of the Lord, and he put up his tents there, and there his servants made a water-hole.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga naxa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan na yire, a nu fa Alatala maxandi a xili ra. A naxa sabati naa, a xa konyie man naxa kɔlɔnyi gbɛtɛ ge.

sentences.english: And Abimelech had come to him from Gerar, with Ahuzzath his friend and Phicol, the captain of his army.
sentences.susu: Abimeleki boore Ahusati, nun a xa sɔɔri mangɛ Pikoli naxa keli Gerara, e siga Isiyaga yire.

sentences.english: And Isaac said to them, Why have you come to me, seeing that in your hate for me you sent me away from you?
sentences.susu: Isiyaga naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo faxi n yire munfe ra yi ki? Wo bara n naɲaaxu han wo bara n keri wo xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: And they said, We saw clearly that the Lord was with you: so we said, Let there be an oath between us and you, and let us make an agreement with you;
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Muxu bara a kolon Alatala xa mixi nan lanxi i ma. Muxu man bara a maɲɔxun, fo won xa saatɛ tongo won boore bɛ marakali ra.

sentences.english: That you will do us no damage, even as we put no hand on you, and did you nothing but good, and sent you away in peace: and now the blessing of the Lord is on you.
sentences.susu: I rakali muxu bɛ, i mu fama fe xɔnɛ rabade muxu ra, barima muxu fan mu fe kobi yo rabaxi i ra, fo fe fanyi. Muxu man naxa i lu, i xa siga bɔɲɛsa kui. Yakɔsi Alatala bara barakɛ sa i ma.»

sentences.english: Then he made a feast for them, and they all had food and drink.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga naxa donse gbegbe yailan e bɛ. E birin naxa e dɛge, e naxa e min.

sentences.english: And early in the morning they took an oath one to the other: then Isaac sent them away and they went on their way in peace.
sentences.susu: Kuye to iba, e naxa e rakali e boore bɛ. Isiyaga naxa a ɲungu e ma, e naxa fatan lanyi kui.

sentences.english: And that day Isaac's servants came to him and gave him word of the water-hole which they had made, and said to him, We have come to water.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ kerenyi, Isiyaga xa konyie naxa kɔlɔnyi nde xa fe dɛntɛgɛ sa a bɛ e naxan gexi. E naxɛ, «Muxu bara ye li na kɔlɔnyi ra.»

sentences.english: And he gave it the name of Shibah: so the name of that town is Beer-sheba to this day.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga naxa na kɔlɔnyi xili fala Siba kɔlɔnyi, na nan falaxi «marakali.» Na nan a toxi muxu yi taa xili falama han yakɔsi Beriseeba, na nan falaxi «marakali kɔlɔnyi.»

sentences.english: And when Esau was forty years old, he took as his wives Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of Elon the Hittite:
sentences.susu: Esayu to ɲɛ tongo naani rakamali, a naxa Beeri xa di Yudita nun Elon xa di Basamati dɔxɔ. Na firinyi Xitikae nan na e ra.

sentences.english: And Isaac and Rebekah had grief of mind because of them.
sentences.susu: E naxa Isiyaga nun Rebeka bɔɲɛ raɲaaxu e ma.

sentences.english: Now when Isaac was old and his eyes had become clouded so that he was not able to see, he sent for Esau, his first son, and said to him, My son: and he said, Here am I.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga nu bara gɛ foride, a yae nu bara rafɔɔrɔ. A mu nɔma sese tode fa. A naxa a xa di singe Esayu xili, «N ma di!» Esayu naxa a ratin, «N tan nan ya!»

sentences.english: And he said, See now, I am old, and my death may take place at any time:
sentences.susu: Isiyaga naxa a fala a bɛ, «I bara a to, n bara gɛ foride. N mu a kolon n faxama tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: So take your arrows and your bow and go out to the field and get meat for me;
sentences.susu: Tanbɛ sase nun xali tongo, i xa siga wulai sube fende n bɛ.

sentences.english: And make me food, good to the taste, such as is pleasing to me, and put it before me, so that I may have a meal and give you my blessing before death comes to me.
sentences.susu: I xa na sube ɲin alɔ a rafanxi n ma ki naxɛ. I xa fa a ra n xɔn ma, alako n xa nɔ dubade i bɛ beenu n xa faxa.»

sentences.english: Now Isaac's words to his son were said in Rebekah's hearing. Then Esau went out to get the meat.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Rebeka tixi a tuli matixi Isiyaga ra, a naxan falaxi Esayu bɛ. Esayu naxa siga wulai sube bunde a baba bɛ.

sentences.english: And Rebekah said to Jacob, her son, Your father said to your brother Esau in my hearing,
sentences.susu: Rebeka naxa a fala a xa di Yaxuba bɛ, «N bara i baba xui mɛ a yi wɔyɛnyi falama Esayu bɛ,

sentences.english: Go and get some roe's meat and make me a good meal, so that I may be full, and give you my blessing before the Lord before my death.
sentences.susu: ‹Sa sube bun n bɛ, i xa a ɲin a fanyi ra, n xa a don. N na gɛ na sube donde, n dubama i bɛ Alatala ya i beenun n xa faxa.›

sentences.english: Now, my son, do what I say.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, n ma di, i tuli mati n na a fanyi ra. N naxan falama i bɛ, i xa a raba.

sentences.english: Go to the flock and get me two fat young goats; and I will make of them a meal to your father's taste:
sentences.susu: Siga gɔɔrɛ, i xa fa si fanyi firin na. N xa e ɲin a fanyi ra alɔ i baba wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And you will take it to him, so that he may have a good meal and give you his blessing before his death.
sentences.susu: N na gɛ na ra, i xa a xanin i baba xɔn ma, alako a xa duba i bɛ beenun a xa faxa.»

sentences.english: And Jacob said to Rebekah, his mother, But Esau my brother is covered with hair, while I am smooth:
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a nga Rebeka yaabi, «Esayu fate maxabe kanyi nan a ra. N tan fate maxabe mu na n bɛ.

sentences.english: If by chance my father puts his hand on me, it will seem to him that I am tricking him, and he will put a curse on me in place of a blessing.
sentences.susu: N baba na n masuxu, a kolonma nɛ Esayu xa mu a ra, n findima wule falɛ nan na a tan bɛ. Beenun n xa duba sɔtɔ, n fama dankɛ nan sɔtɔde.»

sentences.english: And his mother said, Let the curse be on me, my son: only do as I say, and go and get them for me.
sentences.susu: A nga naxa a fala, «Ade, na dankɛ xa gbilen n tan nan ma, n ma di. I naxan nabama, i tuli mati n na. Siga, i sa fa na si fanyi firinyie ra.»

sentences.english: So he went and got them and took them to his mother: and she made a meal to his father's taste.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa siga, a naxa fa si fanyi firinyie ra a nga xɔn ma. A nga naxa na donse yailan alɔ a rafanxi Isiyaga ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And Rebekah took the fair robes of her oldest son, which were with her in the house, and put them on Jacob, her younger son:
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Rebeka naxa a xa di singe Esayu xa donma tongo, donma naxan fan a xa dugie ya ma banxi kui. A naxa na ragoro Yaxuba ma, a xa di firin nde.

sentences.english: And she put the skins of the young goats on his hands and on the smooth part of his neck:
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa di bɛlɛxɛe nun a kɔnyi masalaxunxi maxiri si kiri ra.

sentences.english: And she gave into the hand of Jacob, her son, the meat and the bread which she had made ready.
sentences.susu: A naxa sube nun taami so a xa di Yaxuba yi ra, a naxan yailanxi.

sentences.english: And he came to his father, and said, My father: and he said, Here am I: who are you, my son?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yaxuba naxa siga a baba yire, a a fala a bɛ, «N baba, n tan nan ya.» A baba naxa a maxɔrin, «N ma di mundun lanxi i tan ma?»

sentences.english: And Jacob said, I am Esau, your oldest son; I have done as you said: come now, be seated and take of my meat, so that you may give me a blessing.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a baba yaabi, «Esayu nan lanxi n ma, i xa di singe. I naxan maxɔrinxi n ma, n bara fa a ra. Yandi, keli, i dɔxɔ, i xa n ma sube yailanxi don. Na tɛmui i xa duba n bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Isaac said, How is it that you have got it so quickly, my son? And he said, Because the Lord your God made it come my way.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga naxa a fala a xa di bɛ, «N ma di, i yi sube toxi yi ikɔrɛxi ra di?» Yaxuba naxa a yaabi, «I Marigi Alatala nan yi fixi n ma sɔɔnɛya ra.»

sentences.english: And Isaac said, Come near so that I may put my hand on you, my son, and see if you are truly my son Esau or not.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga naxa a fala Yaxuba bɛ, «N ma di, i maso n na, n xa i masuxu, alako n xa la a ra a n ma di Esayu yati nan i ra.»

sentences.english: And Jacob went near his father Isaac: and he put his hands on him; and he said, The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a maso a baba ra. Isiyaga naxa a fate masuxu. A naxa a fala, «I xui maniya Yaxuba xui ra, kɔnɔ i bɛlɛxɛ tan Esayu bɛlɛxɛ na a ra.»

sentences.english: And he did not make out who he was, because his hands were covered with hair like his brother Esau's hands: so he gave him a blessing.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga mu nɔ Yaxuba kolonde, barima a bɛlɛxɛe nu maxirixi xabe ra, alɔ a taara Esayu na ki naxɛ. Na kui Isiyaga naxa duba Yaxuba bɛ.

sentences.english: And he said, Are you truly my son Esau? And he said, I am.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga man naxa a maxɔrin, «N ma di Esayu yati nan i ra?» Yaxuba naxa a yaabi, «Iyo.»

sentences.english: And he said, Put it before me and I will take of my son's meat, so that I may give you a blessing. And he put it before him and he took it; and he gave him wine, and he had a drink.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga naxa a fala, «Fa donse ra, i naxan yailanxi, n xa a don, n fa duba i bɛ.» Yaxuba naxa donse so a baba yi ra, Isiyaga naxa a don. Yaxuba naxa wɛni fan so a yi ra, a naxa na fan min.

sentences.english: And his father Isaac said to him, Come near now, my son, and give me a kiss.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, a baba Isiyaga naxa a fala a bɛ, «N ma di, i makɔrɛ n na, i xa findigilin n ma.»

sentences.english: And he came near and gave him a kiss; and smelling the smell of his clothing, he gave him a blessing, and said, See, the smell of my son is like the smell of a field on which the blessing of the Lord has come:
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a maso a ra, a naxa findigilin a ma. Isiyaga naxa a xa sose xiri mɛ. Na dangi xanbi, a naxa duba a bɛ. A naxa a masen, «Iyo, n ma di xiri luxi nɛ alɔ Alatala barakɛ saxi xɛ naxan ma.

sentences.english: May God give you the dew of heaven, and the good things of the earth, and grain and wine in full measure:
sentences.susu: Ala xa xini fi i ma naxan kelima koore ma. Ala xa bɔxi daxamui fi i ma. Ala xa barakɛ sa i xa xɛ ma. Ala xa wɛni gbegbe fi i ma.

sentences.english: Let peoples be your servants, and nations go down before you: be lord over your brothers, and let your mother's sons go down before you: a curse be on everyone by whom you are cursed, and a blessing on those who give you a blessing.
sentences.susu: Ala xa ɲama birin lu i sagoe. Ala xa si birin magoro i bɛ. I xa findi i ngaxakerenyie xa yarerati ra. E birin xa e magoro i bɛ. Mixi yo na i danka, na dankɛ xa gbilen a kanyi ma. Mixi yo na duba i bɛ, Ala xa barakɛ sa na kanyi ma.»

sentences.english: And when Isaac had come to the end of blessing Jacob, and Jacob had not long gone away from Isaac his father, Esau came in from the field.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga to bara gɛ dubade a bɛ, Yaxuba naxa mini. A mu bu, Yaxuba taara Esayu fan naxa so kelife sube fende.

sentences.english: And he made ready a meal, good to the taste, and took it to his father, and said to him, Let my father get up and take of his son's meat, so that you may give me a blessing.
sentences.susu: A fan naxa na sube yailan a fanyi ra alɔ a baba wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ. A to fa a ra a baba xɔn, a naxa a fala a baba bɛ, «N baba, keli, i xa dɔxɔ, i sube don n naxan yailanxi i bɛ alako i xa duba n bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Isaac his father said to him, Who are you? And he said, I am your oldest son, Esau.
sentences.susu: A baba Isiyaga naxa a maxɔrin, «Nde na i tan na?» Esayu naxa a yaabi, «Esayu nan na n na, i xa di singe.»

sentences.english: And in great fear Isaac said, Who then is he who got meat and put it before me, and I took it all before you came, and gave him a blessing, and his it will be?
sentences.susu: Na fe naxa Isiyaga ifu a fanyi ra. A fate birin naxa sɛrɛn a ma. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «Kɔnɔ nde tan faxi sube yailanxi ra n bɛ, n naxan donxi yakɔsi beenun i tan xa so be yi ki? N bara duba na kanyi bɛ. A tan nan fama barakɛ sɔtɔde.»

sentences.english: And hearing the words of his father, Esau gave a great and bitter cry, and said to his father, Give a blessing to me, even to me, O my father!
sentences.susu: Esayu to a baba xa masenyi mɛ, a bɔɲɛ naxa mini, a naxa sɔnxɔɛ gbegbe rate. A naxa a baba mayandi, «N baba, duba n fan bɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said, Your brother came with deceit, and took away your blessing.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga naxa a yaabi, «I xunya bara n madaxu. N bara gɛ dubade a tan nan bɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said, Is it because he is named Jacob that he has twice taken my place? for he took away my birthright, and now he has taken away my blessing. And he said, Have you not kept a blessing for me?
sentences.susu: Esayu naxa a fala, «A xili yati na a xun ma, Yaxuba, ‹mixi mayanfɛ›. A sanmaya firin nan ya a n mayanfama. A bara n ma foriɲa tide tongo. Yakɔsi a bara n ma dubɛ fan sɔtɔ.» Esayu man naxa a maxɔrin, «Dubɛ yo mu na i yi ra sɔnɔn, i lan i xa naxan naba n tan bɛ?»

sentences.english: And Isaac answering said, But I have made him your master, and have given him all his brothers for servants; I have made him strong with grain and wine: what then am I to do for you, my son?
sentences.susu: Isiyaga naxa a masen Esayu bɛ, «N bara a tan findi i xunyi ra, n man bara a ngaxakerenyi birin so a yi ra e xa lu a bun ma. N bara barakɛ gbegbe fi a ma, a nun wɛni fanyi. N ma di, n nɔma munse rabade i tan bɛ?»

sentences.english: And Esau said to his father, Is that the only blessing you have, my father? give a blessing to me, even me! And Esau was overcome with weeping.
sentences.susu: Esayu naxa a fala a baba bɛ, «Dubɛ keren peti nan na i yi ra? N baba, duba n tan fan bɛ.» A naxa wa a xui itexi ra.

sentences.english: Then Isaac his father made answer and said to him, Far from the fertile places of the earth, and far from the dew of heaven on high will your living-place be:
sentences.susu: A baba Isiyaga naxa a yaabi, «A kolon, i mu fama bɔxi daxamui sɔtɔde, a nun xini naxan kelima koore ma.

sentences.english: By your sword will you get your living and you will be your brother's servant; but when your power is increased his yoke will be broken from off your neck.
sentences.susu: I baloma i xa santidɛgɛma nan xun na. I fama walide i xunya xa nɔɛ nan bun ma, kɔnɔ yare i fama i yɛtɛ sɔtɔde. A na nɔɛ naxan sa i ma, i tondima nɛ a ra.»

sentences.english: So Esau was full of hate for Jacob because of his father's blessing; and he said in his heart, The days of weeping for my father are near; then I will put my brother Jacob to death.
sentences.susu: Esayu nu a xunya Yaxuba rafenfe gere ra, a xa dubɛ sɔtɔfe xa fe ra e baba ra. Esayu naxa a fala a bɔɲɛ ma, «N baba xa ɲɔnfe na ba a ra tɛmui naxɛ, n Yaxuba faxama nɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Rebekah, hearing what Esau had said, sent for Jacob, her younger son, and said to him, It seems that your brother Esau is purposing to put you to death.
sentences.susu: Rebeka to bara a xa di singe Esayu xa natɛ tongoxi kolon, a naxa a xa di firin nde Yaxuba xili. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «I bara a to, i taara Esayu wama a gbeɲɔxɔfe i ma, a xa i faxa.

sentences.english: So now, my son, do what I say: go quickly to Haran, to my brother Laban;
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n ma di, i tuli mati n na a fanyi ra. Keli be, i xa siga Xarani, n taara Laban xɔnyi. I xa sa lu naa.

sentences.english: And be there with him for a little time, till your brother's wrath is turned away;
sentences.susu: I xa lu a xɔnyi yi saxanyi han beemanu i taara bɔɲɛ fama gorode tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: Till the memory of what you have done to him is past and he is no longer angry: then I will send word for you to come back; are the two of you to be taken from me in one day?
sentences.susu: I taara bɔɲɛ na goro i ma tɛmui naxan ma, a na nɛɛmu i raba fɔxi ra, na tɛmui n nan ɲunguma i xa fa. N mu wama ganfe wo firinyi birin na lɔxɔɛ keren.»

sentences.english: Then Rebekah said to Isaac, My life is a weariness to me because of the daughters of Heth: if Jacob takes a wife from among the daughters of Heth, such as these, the women of this land, of what use will my life be to me?
sentences.susu: Rebeka naxa a fala Isiyaga bɛ, «N bɔɲɛ bara raɲaaxu n ma Xiti xa di ginɛe xa fe ra. Xa a sa li Yaxuba fan ginɛ tongo e ya ma yi bɔxi ma, na tɛmui tide yo mu na n tan ma fe ma sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: Then Isaac sent for Jacob, and blessing him, said, Do not take a wife from among the women of Canaan;
sentences.susu: Isiyaga naxa Yaxuba xili, a duba a bɛ. A naxa a yamari, «I naxa ginɛ dɔxɔ de naxan findi Kanaanka ra.

sentences.english: But go to Paddan-aram, to the house of Bethuel, your mother's father, and there get yourself a wife from the daughters of Laban, your mother's brother.
sentences.susu: Keli, i xa siga Padan Arami, i nga baba Betuweli xɔnyi. Mɛnni i xa i nga taara Laban xa di ginɛ nde dɔxɔ.

sentences.english: And may God, the Ruler of all, give you his blessing, giving you fruit and increase, so that you may become an army of peoples.
sentences.susu: Ala Sɛnbɛ Kanyi xa barakɛ sa i xa fe, a xa di gbegbe fi i ma, a xa i findi si gbegbe benba ra.

sentences.english: And may God give you the blessing of Abraham, to you and to your seed, so that the land of your wanderings, which God gave to Abraham, may be your heritage.
sentences.susu: Ala xa barakɛ sa i xa fe, a nun i bɔnsɔɛ, alɔ a laayidixi Iburahima bɛ ki naxɛ, alako yi bɔxi xa findi i gbe ra, i saxanyi rabafe dɛnnaxɛ, Ala bɔxi naxan fi Iburahima ma.»

sentences.english: So Isaac sent Jacob away: and he went to Paddan-aram, to Laban, son of Bethuel the Aramaean, the brother of Rebekah, the mother of Jacob and Esau.
sentences.susu: Na kui Isiyaga naxa Yaxuba xɛɛ Padan Arami bɔxi ma Betuweli Aramika xa di Laban xɔnyi. Laban findixi Rebeka taara nan na, Yaxuba nun Esayu nga.

sentences.english: So when Esau saw that Isaac had given Jacob his blessing, and sent him away to Paddan-aram to get a wife for himself there, blessing him and saying to him, Do not take a wife from among the women of Canaan;
sentences.susu: Esayu naxa a kolon a baba bara duba Yaxuba bɛ, a xɛɛfe Padan Arami a xa mɛnni ginɛ dɔxɔ. A man naxa kolon sɔtɔ a ma, a baba bara Yaxuba yamari a naxa Kanaan ginɛ dɔxɔ,

sentences.english: And that Jacob had done as his father and mother said and had gone to Paddan-aram;
sentences.susu: Yaxuba fan bara a baba nun a nga xui ratinmɛ sigafe ra Padan Arami.

sentences.english: It was clear to Esau that his father had no love for the women of Canaan,
sentences.susu: Na kui Esayu naxa a fahaamu Kanaan ginɛ mu rafan a baba Isiyaga ma.

sentences.english: So Esau went to Ishmael and took Mahalath, the daughter of Abraham's son Ishmael, the sister of Nebaioth, to be his wife in addition to the wives he had.
sentences.susu: Na na a ra a naxa siga Iburahima xa di Sumayila yire, a sa na xa di ginɛ Mahalata dɔxɔ, naxan findixi Nebayoti xunya ra.

sentences.english: So Jacob went out from Beer-sheba to go to Haran.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa keli Beriseeba sigafe ra Xarani.

sentences.english: And coming to a certain place, he made it his resting-place for the night, for the sun had gone down; and he took one of the stones which were there, and putting it under his head he went to sleep in that place.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ to so a ra kira i, a naxa a sa yire nde, a gɛmɛ findi a xa xunsase ra.

sentences.english: And he had a dream, and in his dream he saw steps stretching from earth to heaven, and the angels of God were going up and down on them.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ ra a naxa xiye sa, samɛ tixi bɔxi fari a xunyi sa dɔxɔxi koore ra. Ala xa malekɛe nu tefe samɛ kɔn na, e man nu goro.

sentences.english: And he saw the Lord by his side, saying, I am the Lord, the God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac: I will give to you and to your seed this land on which you are sleeping.
sentences.susu: Alatala nu tixi samɛ fuge ra. A naxa a masen Yaxuba bɛ, «N tan nan na i tanun Iburahima nun i baba Isiyaga Marigi Alatala ra. I saxi bɔxi naxan fari yi ki, n a fima nɛ i tan nun i bɔnsɔɛ ma.

sentences.english: Your seed will be like the dust of the earth, covering all the land to the west and to the east, to the north and to the south: you and your seed will be a name of blessing to all the families of the earth.
sentences.susu: I bɔnsɔɛ fama nɛ wuyade alɔ xube. Wo xa bɔxi fama nɛ gbode kelife sogetede ma a sa dɔxɔ sogegorode ra, keli kɔɔla ma sa dɔxɔ yirefanyi ra. N fama hɛɛri fide si birin ma i tan nun i bɔnsɔɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: And truly, I will be with you, and will keep you wherever you go, guiding you back again to this land; and I will not give you up till I have done what I have said to you.
sentences.susu: I siga dɛdɛ, won birin na a ra. N i kantama yire birin. N man i ragbilenma nɛ yi bɔxi ma. N mu i raboloma fefe ma. N nan n ma laayidi birin nakamalima nɛ i bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Jacob, awaking from his sleep, said, Truly, the Lord is in this place and I was not conscious of it.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba to xunu, a naxa a fala, «Yakɔsi n bara a kolon Alatala na be, kɔnɔ singe n mu nu a kolonxi.»

sentences.english: And fear came on him, and he said, This is a holy place; this is nothing less than the house of God and the doorway of heaven.
sentences.susu: A naxa gaaxu, a fa a fala, «Yire magaaxuxi nan na be ra. Be findixi Ala xa banxi naadɛ nan na, sigafe ra koore ma.»

sentences.english: And early in the morning Jacob took the stone which had been under his head, and put it up as a pillar and put oil on it.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba to keli subaxɛ ma, a naxa na gɛmɛ tongo a xunyi nu saxi naxan ma. A naxa a rakeli, a a ti tɔnxuma ra, a naxa ture maso gɛmɛ xunyi ma.

sentences.english: And he gave that place the name of Beth-el, but before that time the town was named Luz.
sentences.susu: A naxa na yire xili sa Beteli, «Ala xa banxi.» Beenun na xa raba, na yire xili nu falama nɛ Lusi.

sentences.english: Then Jacob took an oath, and said, If God will be with me, and keep me safe on my journey, and give me food and clothing to put on,
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa laayidi tongo Ala bɛ a falafe ra, «Xa Ala n kantama kira xɔn ma, a fa donse nun sose fi n ma,

sentences.english: So that I come again to my father's house in peace, then I will take the Lord to be my God,
sentences.susu: n gbilen bɔɲɛsa kui n baba xɔnyi, na tɛmui n Alatala nan findima n Marigi Ala ra.

sentences.english: And this stone which I have put up for a pillar will be God's house: and of all you give me, I will give a tenth part to you.
sentences.susu: N bara yi gɛmɛ ti be tɔnxuma ra, yi yire xa findi Ala batude ra. Alatala, i harige naxan birin fima n ma, n farilɛ bama nɛ a ra, n na fi i ma.»

sentences.english: Then Jacob went on his journey till he came to the land of the children of the East.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi Yaxuba naxa a xa biyaasi dɛ idɔxɔ. A to bɔxi li naxan na sogetede,

sentences.english: And there he saw a water-hole in a field, and by the side of it three flocks of sheep, for there they got water for the sheep: and on the mouth of the water-hole there was a great stone.
sentences.susu: a naxa kɔlɔnyi nde to wula i. Yɛxɛɛ nun si gɔɔrɛ saxan nu malanxi na kɔlɔnyi fɛ ma, kɔnɔ gɛmɛ xungbe nan nu kɔlɔnyi dɛ makotoxi.

sentences.english: And all the flocks would come together there, and when the stone had been rolled away, they would give the sheep water, and put the stone back again in its place on the mouth of the water-hole.
sentences.susu: E nu darixi naxan na, xuruse birin na malan na yire, xuruse dɛmadonyie na kɔlɔnyi dɛrakote gɛmɛ maɲindigilinma, a ba naa. Xuruse na gɛ ye minde, xuruse dɛmadonyie man nu gɛmɛ ragbilenma kɔlɔnyi dɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then Jacob said to the herdmen, My brothers, where do you come from? And they said, From Haran.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa xuruse dɛmadonyie maxɔrin, «N ngaxakerenyie, wo kelixi minden yi ki?» E naxa a yaabi, «Muxu kelixi Xarani nɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Have you any knowledge of Laban, the son of Nahor? And they said, We have.
sentences.susu: A naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo Laban kolon, Naxori xa di xɛmɛ?» E naxa a yaabi, «Iyo, muxu a kolon.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Is he well? And they said, He is well, and here is Rachel his daughter coming with the sheep.
sentences.susu: A naxa e maxɔrin, «Tana mu na a ma?» E naxa a yaabi, «Sese mu a toxi. A xa di ginɛ Raxele nan fafe na ki e nun xurusee ra.»

sentences.english: Then Jacob said, The sun is still high and it is not time to get the cattle together: get water for the sheep and go and give them their food.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Won na yanyi nɛ yi ki. Xurusee malan tɛmui mu yi ki. Wo ye fi xurusee ma mafuren, wo man xa gbilen e ra e dɛmadonde.»

sentences.english: And they said, We are not able to do so till all the flocks have come together and the stone has been rolled away from the mouth of the water-hole; then we will get water for the sheep.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Muxu mu nɔma fefe yo rabade yi ki, fo xuruse birin na malan. Na tɛmui, muxu fa yi gɛmɛ ba kɔlɔnyi dɛ ra naxan a makotoxi, muxu ye fi xuruse birin ma.»

sentences.english: While he was still talking with them, Rachel came with her father's sheep, for she took care of them.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba to nu na wɔyɛnfe e bɛ, Raxele fan naxa fa a baba xa xurusee ra, barima xuruse dɛmadonyi nan nu lanxi a fan ma.

sentences.english: Then when Jacob saw Rachel, the daughter of Laban, his mother's brother, coming with Laban's sheep, he came near, and rolling the stone away from the mouth of the hole, he got water for Laban's flock.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba to Raxele to fa ra, Yaxuba nga taara Laban xa di ginɛ, a nun a xa xurusee, a naxa a maso kɔlɔnyi ra. A naxa gɛmɛ ba kɔlɔnyi dɛ ra, a naxa ye fi Laban xa xuruse birin ma.

sentences.english: And weeping for joy, Jacob gave Rachel a kiss.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa Raxele xɛɛbu sunbui ra, a nu wa a xui itexi ra.

sentences.english: And Rachel, hearing from Jacob that he was her father's relation and that he was the son of Rebekah, went running to give her father news of it.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Raxele bɛ, «I baba xunya xa di nan lanxi n ma, Rebeka xa di xɛmɛ.» Raxele to na mɛ, a naxa a gi rakɔɛ, a sa na tagi raba a baba bɛ.

sentences.english: And Laban, hearing news of Jacob, his sister's son, came running, and took Jacob in his arms, and kissing him, made him come into his house. And Jacob gave him news of everything.
sentences.susu: Laban to bara a xunya ginɛma xa di Yaxuba xa fe mɛ, a naxa siga a sa a ralan. A naxa findigilin a ma, a a xanin banxi. Yaxuba naxa dɛntɛgɛ sa Laban bɛ.

sentences.english: And Laban said to him, Truly, you are my bone and my flesh. And he kept Jacob with him for the space of a month.
sentences.susu: Laban naxa a fala a bɛ, «Won birin wuli keren fasɛ keren.» Yaxuba naxa kike keren naba Laban xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Then Laban said to Jacob, Because you are my brother are you to be my servant for nothing? say now, what is your payment to be?
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Laban naxa a fala Yaxuba bɛ, «N ma mamadi nan lanxi i ma, kɔnɔ sɛriyɛ yo mu a falaxi i xa wali n bɛ a fa lu n mu i sare fi. A fala n bɛ, a lanma n xa i sare fi naxan na.»

sentences.english: Now Laban had two daughters: the name of the older was Leah, and the name of the younger was Rachel.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui di ginɛ firin nan nu na Laban yi ra. A xa di ginɛ singe xili nɛ Leya, a firin nde Raxele.

sentences.english: And Leah's eyes were clouded, but Rachel was fair in face and form.
sentences.susu: Leya ya nu xurun, kɔnɔ Raxele tan ginɛ tofanyi nan nu lanxi a ma.

sentences.english: And Jacob was in love with Rachel; and he said, I will be your servant seven years for Rachel, your younger daughter.
sentences.susu: Raxele nan nu rafan Yaxuba ma ki fanyi ra. A naxa a fala Laban bɛ, «N ɲɛ solofere nan walima i bɛ, alako i xa i xa di ginɛ firin nde Raxele fi n ma.»

sentences.english: And Laban said, It is better for you to have her than another man: go on living here with me.
sentences.susu: Laban naxa a yaabi, «Beenun n xa n ma di fi mixi gbɛtɛ ma, n lan n xa a fi i tan nan ma. Lu n xɔnyi be.»

sentences.english: And Jacob did seven years' work for Rachel; and because of his love for her it seemed to him only a very little time.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa ɲɛ solofere wali raba Laban yi ra Raxele xa fe ra. Kɔnɔ na ɲɛ solofere lu nɛ a bɛ alɔ xi solofere gbansan, barima Raxele nu rafanxi a ma ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Then Jacob said to Laban, Give me my wife so that I may have her, for the days are ended.
sentences.susu: Na ɲɛ solofere dangi xanbi, Yaxuba naxa a fala Laban bɛ, «N ma kɛrɛ tongoxi bara kamali. N ma ginɛ so n yi ra fa, n xa a findi n yɛtɛ ra.»

sentences.english: And Laban got together all the men of the place and gave a feast.
sentences.susu: Laban naxa mɛnnika birin xili, e xa fa e dɛge, e xa ɲɛlɛxinyi xulunyi raba.

sentences.english: And in the evening he took Leah, his daughter, and gave her to him, and he went in to her.
sentences.susu: Nunmare ra, a naxa a xa di ginɛ singe Leya tongo, a naxa a xanin Yaxuba xɔn ma. Yaxuba naxa a findi a yɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Laban gave Zilpah, his servant-girl, to Leah, to be her waiting-woman.
sentences.susu: Laban naxa Silipa so a xa di Leya yi ra, a xa findi a xa konyi ra.

sentences.english: And in the morning Jacob saw that it was Leah: and he said to Laban, What have you done to me? was I not working for you so that I might have Rachel? why have you been false to me?
sentences.susu: Kuye to iba, Yaxuba naxa a to Leya na a ra. A naxa a fala Laban bɛ, «I munse rabaxi n na yi ki? N mu walixi i bɛ Raxele xa fe xa ra? I n yanfaxi munfe ra?»

sentences.english: And Laban said, In our country we do not let the younger daughter be married before the older.
sentences.susu: Laban naxa a yaabi, «Muxu tan ma naamunyi mu tinma a ra di ginɛ firin nde xa dɔxɔ xɛmɛ taa, a singe mu xɛmɛ sɔtɔxi.

sentences.english: Let the week of the bride-feast come to its end and then we will give you the other in addition, if you will be my servant for another seven years.
sentences.susu: Yi lɔxɔxunyi raba sinden wo nun Leya. Xa i man ɲɛ solofere wali raba n bɛ, n nan n ma di ginɛ firin nde fan fima nɛ i ma, a findi i xa ginɛ ra.»

sentences.english: And Jacob did so; and when the week was ended, Laban gave him his daughter Rachel for his wife.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa na raba. E nun Leya to lɔxɔxunyi raba yire keren, Laban naxa Raxele fan fi a ma,

sentences.english: And Laban gave Rachel his servant-girl Bilhah to be her waiting-woman.
sentences.susu: a Bila so Raxele yi ra a xa findi a xa konyi ra.

sentences.english: Then Jacob took Rachel as his wife, and his love for her was greater than his love for Leah; and he went on working for Laban for another seven years.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa Raxele findi a yɛtɛ ra, a a xanu dangife Leya ra. Na dangi xanbi a man naxa ɲɛ solofere wali raba Laban bɛ.

sentences.english: Now the Lord, seeing that Leah was not loved, gave her a child; while Rachel had no children.
sentences.susu: Alatala to bara a to Leya mu gɛxi rafande Yaxuba ma alɔ Raxele, a naxa Leya findi dibari ra, a Raxele findi dibaritare ra.

sentences.english: And Leah was with child, and gave birth to a son to whom she gave the name Reuben: for she said, The Lord has seen my sorrow; now my husband will have love for me.
sentences.susu: Leya naxa tɛɛgɛ, a di xɛmɛ bari. A naxa na di xili sa Ruben, a falafe ra, «Alatala bara n ma yaagi to. Yakɔsi n fa rafanma nɛ n ma xɛmɛ ma.»

sentences.english: Then she became with child again, and gave birth to a son; and said, Because it has come to the Lord's ears that I am not loved, he has given me this son in addition: and she gave him the name Simeon.
sentences.susu: A man naxa tɛɛgɛ di firin nde ma. A to na di bari, a naxa a fala, «Alatala fan yati a kolon, n mu rafan n ma xɛmɛ ma. Na nan a toxi a yi di firin nde fan fixi n ma.» A naxa na di xili sa Simeyɔn.

sentences.english: And she was with child again, and gave birth to a son; and said, Now at last my husband will be united to me, because I have given him three sons: so he was named Levi.
sentences.susu: A man naxa tɛɛgɛ di saxan nde ma. A to a bari, a man naxa a fala, «Yi biyaasi, fo n xa rafan nɛ n ma xɛmɛ ma sɔnɔn, barima n bara di saxan sɔtɔ a bɛ.» Na nan a to, a naxa na di xili sa Lewi.

sentences.english: And she was with child again, and gave birth to a son: and she said, This time I will give praise to the Lord: so he was named Judah; after this she had no more children for a time.
sentences.susu: A naxa tɛɛgɛ di naani nde ma. A to na fan bari, a naxa a fala, «Yi biyaasi n Alatala tantuma nɛ.» A naxa na di xili sa Yuda. A xa di barife dan na di naani nan ma.

sentences.english: Now Rachel, because she had no children, was full of envy of her sister; and she said to Jacob, If you do not give me children I will not go on living.
sentences.susu: Raxele to bara a to, a mu fa di barife, a naxa a taara tɔɔnɛ. A naxa a fala Yaxuba bɛ, «Di fi n fan ma, xa na mu a ra n faxama nɛ.»

sentences.english: But Jacob was angry with Rachel, and said, Am I in the place of God, who has kept your body from having fruit?
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa xɔnɔ a xa wɔyɛnyi ma. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «I tan a maɲɔxunxi nɛ a Ala na n tan nan na? Ala na a niyaxi i mu di barife!»

sentences.english: Then she said, Here is my servant Bilhah, go in to her, so that she may have a child on my knees, and I may have a family by her.
sentences.susu: Raxele naxa a yaabi, «N ma konyi ginɛ Bila tongo, alako a xa di bari n bɛ. A xa findi n ma saabui ra di barife ra.»

sentences.english: So she gave him her servant Bilhah as a wife, and Jacob went in to her.
sentences.susu: Raxele naxa a xa konyi ginɛ tongo, a a so a xa xɛmɛ Yaxuba yi ra. E to kafu,

sentences.english: And Bilhah became with child, and gave birth to a son.
sentences.susu: Bila naxa tɛɛgɛ, a naxa di xɛmɛ bari Yaxuba bɛ.

sentences.english: Then Rachel said, God has been my judge, and has given ear to my voice, and has given me a son; so he was named Dan.
sentences.susu: Raxele naxa a fala, «Ala bara n ma kiiti sa. A bara n ma wɔyɛnyi mɛ. Na nan a toxi a di fixi n ma.» A naxa na di xili sa Dana.

sentences.english: And again Bilhah, Rachel's servant, was with child, and gave birth to a second son.
sentences.susu: Raxele xa konyi ginɛ Bila man naxa tɛɛgɛ. A naxa di xɛmɛ firin nde bari Yaxuba bɛ.

sentences.english: And Rachel said, I have had a great fight with my sister, and I have overcome her: and she gave the child the name Naphtali.
sentences.susu: Raxele naxa a fala, «Ala bara n mali katɛ birin na alako n xa xun nakeli sɔtɔ n taara ginɛma xun ma.» A naxa a xa di xili sa Nafatali.

sentences.english: When it was clear to Leah that she would have no more children for a time, she gave Zilpah, her servant, to Jacob as a wife.
sentences.susu: Leya to bara a kolon a mu di barima fa, a naxa a xa konyi ginɛ Silipa tongo, a naxa a so Yaxuba yi ra a xa findi a xa ginɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Zilpah, Leah's servant, gave birth to a son.
sentences.susu: Silipa naxa di xɛmɛ bari Yaxuba bɛ.

sentences.english: And Leah said, It has gone well for me: and she gave him the name Gad.
sentences.susu: Leya naxa a fala, «Hɛɛri bara fa n ma.» A naxa na di xili sa Gadi.

sentences.english: And Zilpah, Leah's servant, gave birth to a second son.
sentences.susu: Silipa naxa di firin nde sɔtɔ Yaxuba bɛ.

sentences.english: And Leah said, Happy am I! and all women will give witness to my joy: and she gave him the name Asher.
sentences.susu: Leya naxa a fala, «N bara ɲɛlɛxin. Yakɔsi, ginɛ birin bara a kolon n bara hɛɛri gbegbe sɔtɔ.» A naxa a xili sa Aseri.

sentences.english: Now at the time of the grain-cutting, Reuben saw some love-fruits in the field, and took them to his mother Leah. And Rachel said to her, Let me have some of your son's love-fruits.
sentences.susu: Mɛngi xaba tɛmui to bara a li, Ruben naxa siga xɛ ma. A naxa bogise nde li naa, naxan xili marafanyi bogise. A naxa fa a ra a nga xɔn. Na nan lan Raxele naxa a fala Leya bɛ, «N bara i maxandi, i xa i xa di xa marafanyi bogise ndee fi n ma.»

sentences.english: But Leah said to her, Is it a small thing that you have taken my husband from me? and now would you take my son's love-fruits? Then Rachel said, You may have him tonight in exchange for your son's love-fruits.
sentences.susu: Leya naxa a yaabi, «I bara n ma xɛmɛ ba n yi ra. Na mu i wasaxi? I man waxi n ma di xa marafanyi bogise nan fan tongofe?» Raxele naxa a fala, «To kɔɛ ra, wo nun Yaxuba nan fama xide i xa di xa marafanyi bogise ɲɔxɔɛ ra.»

sentences.english: In the evening, when Jacob came in from the field, Leah went out to him and said, Tonight you are to come to me, for I have given my son's love-fruits as a price for you. And he went in to her that night.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba to so nunmare ra kelife xɛ ma, Leya naxa a ralan. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xima n tan nan xɔn ma to kɔɛ ra. N bara to kɔɛ sare fi n ma di xa marafanyi bogise ra.» A tan nun Yaxuba naxa kafu na kɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And God gave ear to her and she became with child, and gave Jacob a fifth son.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa Leya xa maxandi tongo, a naxa tɛɛgɛ. Na naxa findi a xa di suuli nde ra Yaxuba bɛ.

sentences.english: Then Leah said, God has made payment to me for giving my servant-girl to my husband: so she gave her son the name Issachar.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala, «Ala bara n sare fi n ma konyi ginɛ sofe ra n ma xɛmɛ yi.» A naxa a xa di xili sa Isakari.

sentences.english: And again Leah became with child, and she gave Jacob a sixth son.
sentences.susu: Leya man naxa tɛɛgɛ di senni nde ma. A naxa na di bari Yaxuba bɛ.

sentences.english: And she said, God has given me a good bride-price; now at last will I have my husband living with me, for I have given him six sons: and she gave him the name Zebulun.
sentences.susu: Leya naxa a fala, «Ala bara n ki. Yi biyaasi n ma xɛmɛ n binyama nɛ, barima n bara di senni bari a bɛ.» A naxa na di xili sa Sabulon.

sentences.english: After that she had a daughter, to whom she gave the name Dinah.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi a man naxa di ginɛ bari. A naxa a xili sa Dina.

sentences.english: Then God gave thought to Rachel, and hearing her prayer he made her fertile.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Ala naxa a ɲɛngi rasiga Raxele xa fe xɔn. A naxa a xa kɔntɔfili mɛ, a a findi di bari ra.

sentences.english: And she was with child, and gave birth to a son: and she said, God has taken away my shame.
sentences.susu: Raxele naxa tɛɛgɛ, a naxa di bari. A naxa a fala, «Ala bara n namini n ma yaagi kui.»

sentences.english: And she gave him the name Joseph, saying, May the Lord give me another son.
sentences.susu: A naxa na di xili sa Yusufu. Na xili yati nan findixi a xa maxandi ra, fa a falafe, «Alatala man xa di xɛmɛ gbɛtɛ fan fi n ma.»

sentences.english: Now after the birth of Joseph, Jacob said to Laban, Let me go away to my place and my country.
sentences.susu: Raxele to Yusufu bari, Yaxuba naxa a fala Laban bɛ, «A lu n xa gbilen n ma bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Give me my wives and my children, for whom I have been your servant, and let me go: for you have knowledge of all the work I have done for you.
sentences.susu: A lu n xa n ma ginɛe xanin a nun n ma die, n walixi i bɛ naxee xa fe ra. I a kolon n wali naxan xasabi rabaxi i bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Laban said, If you will let me say so, do not go away; for I have seen by the signs that the Lord has been good to me because of you.
sentences.susu: Laban naxa a fala a bɛ, «Yandi, xa n nafan i ma, i xa diɲɛ, i xa lu be. N bara a kolon sematoe saabui ra, Alatala barakɛ saxi n ma i tan nan xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Say then what your payment is to be and I will give it.
sentences.susu: A fala n bɛ i wama wali sare naxan xɔn. N na fima nɛ i ma.»

sentences.english: Then Jacob said, You have seen what I have done for you, and how your cattle have done well under my care.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a fala a bɛ, «I tan yɛtɛ yati a kolon n walixi i bɛ ki naxɛ han i xa gɔɔrɛ bara findi a ra. Na saabui kelixi n tan nan ma.

sentences.english: For before I came you had little, and it has been greatly increased; and the Lord has given you a blessing in everything I have done; but when am I to do something for my family?
sentences.susu: Dondoronti nan nu na i yi ra beenu n xa fa, a gbegbe bara sa a xun ma. Alatala bara barakɛ sa i xa fe kabi n naxa so i xɔnyi. Yakɔsi, i mu a luma n xa wali nde raba n ma denbaya fan bɛ?»

sentences.english: And Laban said, What am I to give you? And Jacob said, Do not give me anything; but I will again take up the care of your flock if you will only do this for me:
sentences.susu: Laban naxa a maxɔrin, «A lan n xa yeri fi i ma?» Yaxuba naxa a yaabi, «I naxa sese fi n ma. Xa i bara tin fe ra n naxan falaxi i bɛ i xa a raba, n fan bara tin n ɲɛngi safe ra i xa gɔɔrɛ xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Let me go through all your flock today, taking out from among them all the sheep which are marked or coloured or black, and all the marked or coloured goats: these will be my payment.
sentences.susu: N sigama to, n xa i xa xuruse birin mato. Yɛxɛɛ nun si makatunxi birin ti sɛɛti keren, a nun naxee birin nafɔɔrɔxi. N masundi findima nee nan na.

sentences.english: And so you will be able to put my honour to the test in time to come; if you see among my flocks any goats which are not marked or coloured, or any sheep which is not black, you may take me for a thief.
sentences.susu: N ma tinxinyi fama makɛnɛnde i fama xuruse matode tɛmui naxɛ. Si naxee birin mu makatunxi nun yɛxɛɛ yɔrɛ birin naxee mu fɔɔrɔ, nee bara findi muɲɛ ra n mabiri.»

sentences.english: And Laban said, Let it be as you say.
sentences.susu: Laban naxa a fala, «N bara tin na ra. I naxan falaxi na ki, won bara lan na ma.»

sentences.english: So that day he took all the he-goats which were banded or coloured, and all the she-goats which were marked or coloured or had white marks, and all the black sheep, and gave them into the care of his sons;
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Laban naxa si xɛmɛe nun ginɛe mayegeti, sarinyi saxi naxee ma a nun naxee makatunxi. A man naxa yɛxɛɛ rafɔɔrɔxi mayegeti. A naxa na xuruse birin so a xa die yi ra.

sentences.english: And sent them three days' journey away: and Jacob took care of the rest of Laban's flock.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi a naxa nee xanin yire xi saxan ɲɛrɛ rabama dɛnnaxɛ kira xɔn e nun Yaxuba tagi. Yaxuba nu fa Laban xa xuruse dɔnxɔɛe dɛmadon.

sentences.english: Then Jacob took young branches of trees, cutting off the skin so that the white wood was seen in bands.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yaxuba naxa wuri bili mɔɔli saxan salonyi xinde gira. A naxa e kobolee ba e ma yire nde alako sarinyi fiixɛ xa makɛnɛn.

sentences.english: And he put the banded sticks in the drinking-places where the flock came to get water; and they became with young when they came to the water.
sentences.susu: A naxa e sa xurusee ye minde alako xuruse xa e yae ti e ra e ye minma tɛmui naxɛ. Xurusee na siga ye minde, xuruse xɛmɛe xa te xuruse ginɛe ma salonyie ya i.

sentences.english: And because of this, the flock gave birth to young which were marked with bands of colour.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, na xurusee naxa die bari, sarinyie nun katunyie na e ma.

sentences.english: These lambs Jacob kept separate; and he put his flock in a place by themselves and not with Laban's flock.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa na xuruse yɔrɛe sa e xati ma, kɔnɔ booree ti Laban xa xurusee ya ra sarinyi na naxee ma, a nun naxee mafɔɔrɔxi. Na ki a gɔɔrɛ firin nan yailanxi. A mu tin a gbe xa lu Laban xa xurusee ya ma.

sentences.english: And whenever the stronger ones of the flock became with young, Jacob put the sticks in front of them in the drinking-places, so that they might become with young when they saw the sticks.
sentences.susu: Xuruse sɛnbɛmae nu tema ginɛmae ma tɛmui naxɛ, Yaxuba naxa na salonyi mɔɔli sa xuruse ye minde alako e xa te ginɛe ma salonyie ya i.

sentences.english: But when the flocks were feeble, he did not put the sticks before them; so that the feebler flocks were Laban's and the stronger were Jacob's.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba mu nu na wali rabama xuruse xurie ra. Na nan a niyaxi xuruse xurie naxa findi Laban gbe ra, a sɛnbɛmae naxa findi Yaxuba gbe ra.

sentences.english: So Jacob's wealth was greatly increased; he had great flocks and women-servants and men-servants and camels and asses.
sentences.susu: Na kui Yaxuba bara findi bannamixi belebele ra. Xurusee, konyie, ɲɔxɔmɛe, nun sofale gbegbe bara lu a yi ra.

sentences.english: Now it came to the ears of Jacob that Laban's sons were saying, Jacob has taken away all our father's property, and in this way he has got all this wealth.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yaxuba nu bara Laban xa di xɛmɛe xui mɛ e naxan falama, «Se naxan birin findixi won baba gbe ra, Yaxuba bara a birin tongo. Na nan a toxi a bara findi banna mixi ra.»

sentences.english: And Jacob saw that Laban's feeling for him was no longer what it had been before.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba yati naxa a kolon, a mu rafan Laban ma sɔnɔn alɔ singe.

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to Jacob, Go back to the land of your fathers, and to your relations, and I will be with you.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Yaxuba bɛ, «Gbilen i babae nun i baribooree xa bɔxi ma i kelixi dɛnnaxɛ. Won birin na a ra.»

sentences.english: And Jacob sent for Rachel and Leah to come to him in the field among his flock.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa Raxele nun Leya xili. E nu na a xa xurusee dɛmadonfe.

sentences.english: And he said to them, It is clear to me that your father's feeling is no longer what it was to me; but the God of my father has been with me
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «N bara a kolon n mu rafan wo baba ma alɔ singe, kɔnɔ n baba Marigi Alatala bara hinnɛ n na.

sentences.english: And you have seen how I have done all in my power for your father,
sentences.susu: Wo a kolon yati n bara wali wo baba bɛ n sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: But your father has not kept faith with me, and ten times he has made changes in my payment; but God has kept him from doing me damage.
sentences.susu: A bara n madaxu n wali sare masarafe dɔxɔ fu ra, kɔnɔ Ala mu tin a xa fe ɲaaxi raba n na.

sentences.english: If he said, All those in the flock which have marks are to be yours, then all the flock gave birth to marked young; and if he said, All the banded ones are to be yours, then all the flock had banded young.
sentences.susu: Xa wo baba fa a fala, ‹Katunyi na xuruse naxee ma, nee nan findima Yaxuba gbe ra,› xuruse birin di barima naxee makatunxi. Xa wo baba fa a fala, ‹Sarinyi na xuruse naxee ma, nee nan findima Yaxuba gbe ra,› xuruse birin di barima sarinyi na naxee ma.

sentences.english: So God has taken away your father's cattle and has given them to me.
sentences.susu: Ala bara wo baba xa xurusee ba a yi ra, a naxa e fi n tan ma.»

sentences.english: And at the time when the flock were with young, I saw in a dream that all the he-goats which were joined with the she-goats were banded and marked and coloured.
sentences.susu: «Yi xurusee nu tema e boore ma tɛmui naxɛ, n bara a to xiye kui, xuruse xɛmɛ naxee texi xuruse ginɛe ma, sarinyi nun katunyi na e birin ma.

sentences.english: And in my dream the angel of the Lord said to me, Jacob: and I said, Here am I.
sentences.susu: N ma xiye kui, Ala xa malekɛ naxa n xili, ‹Yaxuba›. N naxa a ratin, ‹N tan nan ya.›
