sentences.english: And he said, See how all the he-goats are banded and marked and coloured: for I have seen what Laban has done to you.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen, ‹I ya rakeli, i xa a mato. Xuruse xɛmɛ naxee birin texi xuruse ginɛe ma, sarinyi nun katunyi na e ma, barima Laban naxan birin nabaxi i ra, n na toxi.

sentences.english: I am the God of Beth-el, where you put oil on the pillar and took an oath to me: now then, come out of this land and go back to the country of your birth.
sentences.susu: N tan nan na Ala ra naxan mini i ma Beteli, i gɛmɛ tixi tɔnxuma ra dɛnnaxɛ. Mɛnni i bara laayidi tongo n bɛ. Yakɔsi, keli yi bɔxi ma. I xa siga bɔxi ma i barixi dɛnnaxɛ.›»

sentences.english: Then Rachel and Leah said to him in answer, What part or heritage is there for us in our father's house?
sentences.susu: Raxele nun Leya naxa Yaxuba yaabi, «Muxu baba mu kɛ yo luxi muxu tan bɛ.

sentences.english: Are we not as people from a strange country to him? for he took a price for us and now it is all used up.
sentences.susu: Xɔɲɛ xa mu na muxu ra muxu baba xɔnyi? A bara muxu mati, a man bara muxu xa kɔbiri fan don.

sentences.english: For the wealth which God has taken from him is ours and our children's; so now, whatever God has said to you, do.
sentences.susu: Ala harige naxan birin baxi muxu baba yi ra, a gbilenma nɛ muxu ma a nun muxu xa die. Yakɔsi Ala fe naxan birin masenxi i bɛ, na birin naba.»

sentences.english: Then Jacob put his wives and his sons on camels;
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a xa ginɛe nun a xa die baki ɲɔxɔmɛe fari.

sentences.english: And sending on before him all his cattle and his property which he had got together in Paddan-aram, he made ready to go to Isaac his father in the land of Canaan.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa xuruse nun a harige birin xanin, a naxan sɔtɔ Padan Arami sigafe ra a baba Isiyaga xɔnyi Kanaan bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Now Laban had gone to see to the cutting of the wool of his sheep; so Rachel secretly took the images of the gods of her father's house.
sentences.susu: Laban to siga a xa xurusee xabe maxabade e ma, Raxele nu bara a xa kuyee muɲa.

sentences.english: And Jacob went away secretly, without giving news of his flight to Laban the Aramaean.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba fan Laban Aramika mayanfa nɛ, barima a siga nɛ a mu ɲungui rabira a ma.

sentences.english: So he went away with all he had, and went across the River in the direction of the hill-country of Gilead.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a gi, a nun se naxan birin findi a gbe ra. A to dangi Efirati xure ra, a naxa siga Galadi geya mabiri.

sentences.english: And on the third day Laban had news of Jacob's flight.
sentences.susu: A xi saxan lɔxɔɛ, mixi nde naxa a fala Laban bɛ a Yaxuba bara a gi.

sentences.english: And taking the men of his family with him, he went after him for seven days and overtook him in the hill-country of Gilead.
sentences.susu: Laban naxa a ngaxakerenyie tongo, e naxa mini Yaxuba fende xi solofere bun ma. E naxa a li Galadi geya biri ra.

sentences.english: Then God came to Laban in a dream by night, and said to him, Take care that you say nothing good or bad to Jacob.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ kɔɛ ra, Ala naxa mini Laban Aramika ma xiye kui. A naxa a masen a bɛ, «I yɛtɛ ratanga fe mɔɔli birin falafe ra Yaxuba bɛ.»

sentences.english: Now when Laban overtook him, Jacob had put up his tent in the hill-country; and Laban and his brothers put up their tents in the hill-country of Gilead.
sentences.susu: Laban naxa Yaxuba li, a xa kiri banxi italaxi geya yire Galadi bɔxi ma. Laban nun a ngaxakerenyie fan naxa e gbe itala mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: And Laban said to Jacob, Why did you go away secretly, taking my daughters away like prisoners of war?
sentences.susu: Laban naxa a fala Yaxuba bɛ, «I munse rabaxi yi ki? Munfe ra i n mayanfaxi, i fa n ma die xanin alɔ geelimanie?

sentences.english: Why did you make a secret of your flight, not giving me word of it, so that I might have sent you away with joy and songs, with melody and music?
sentences.susu: I gixi nɔxunyi kui munfe ra? I bara yanfanteya niya n na. I mu i ɲungui rabira n ma. Xa i n nakolon nu, n xulunyi nan tima i bɛ, n i ti kira ra ɲɛlɛxinyi kui boote nun kɔra xui ra.

sentences.english: You did not even let me give a kiss to my sons and my daughters. This was a foolish thing to do.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan mu tinxi yati n xa n ma die nun n ma mamadie sunbu. Xaxili fanyi mu na ki.

sentences.english: It is in my power to do you damage: but the God of your father came to me this night, saying, Take care that you say nothing good or bad to Jacob.
sentences.susu: N nɔma fe kobi rabade wo ra, kɔnɔ i baba Marigi Alatala bara a masen n bɛ to kɔɛ ra, ‹I yɛtɛ ratanga fe mɔɔli birin falafe ra Yaxuba bɛ.›

sentences.english: And now, it seems, you are going because your heart's desire is for your father's house; but why have you taken my gods?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i to gbataxi sigafe ra i baba xɔnyi, i n ma alae tan xaninxi i xun ma munfe ra?»

sentences.english: And Jacob, in answer, said to Laban, My fear was that you might take your daughters from me by force.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa Laban yaabi, «N mu n ɲungu i ma, barima n gaaxu nɛ i fa i xa di ginɛe bafe n yi ra.

sentences.english: As for your gods, if anyone of us has them, let him be put to death: make search before us all for what is yours, and take it. For Jacob had no knowledge that Rachel had taken them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i na i xa alae to n ma mixi yo yi ra, n na kanyi faxama nɛ. I xa n ma kote birin mato won ngaxakerenyie ya xɔri. Naxan birin findixi i gbe ra, i xa a xanin.» Yaxuba mu nu a maɲɔxunma a Raxele nan a baba xa kuyee tongoxi.

sentences.english: So Laban went into Jacob's tent and into Leah's tent, and into the tents of the two servant-women, but they were not there; and he came out of Leah's tent and went into Rachel's.
sentences.susu: Laban naxa Yaxuba xa kiri banxi kui mato. A man naxa Leya xɔnyi, Leya xa konyi xɔnyi, nun Raxele xa konyi xɔnyi mato, kɔnɔ a mu a gbe se yo to naa. A to mini e xɔnyi, a naxa so Raxele xa kiri banxi kui.

sentences.english: Now Rachel had taken the images, and had put them in the camels' basket, and was seated on them. And Laban, searching through all the tent, did not come across them.
sentences.susu: Raxele yati nan yi kuyee tongo. A nu bara e nɔxun dɔxɔse bun ma naxan sama ɲɔxɔmɛ fari, a fa dɔxɔ a fari. Laban naxa kiri banxi kui mato, kɔnɔ a mu a gbe se yo toxi naa.

sentences.english: And she said to her father, Let not my lord be angry because I do not get up before you, for I am in the common condition of women. And with all his searching, he did not come across the images.
sentences.susu: Raxele naxa a fala a baba bɛ, «N baba i naxa xɔnɔ n ma de, i na to n mu kelixi n ti. N na kike wali nɛ.» Laban fenyi mɔɔli birin ti nɛ, kɔnɔ a mu kuyee to.

sentences.english: Then Jacob was angry with Laban, and said, What crime or sin have I done that you have come after me with such passion?
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa xɔnɔ, a naxa wɔyɛn xɔnɛ fala Laban bɛ. A naxɛ, «N gbaloe mundun nabaxi, n sɛriyɛ mundun kanaxi naxan a niyama i xa mini n fende yi mɔɔli ra?

sentences.english: Now that you have made search through all my goods, what have you seen which is yours? Make it clear now before my people and your people, so that they may be judges between us.
sentences.susu: I bara n ma kote birin kui mato. I gbe see mundun toxi e kui? A masen n bɛ n ngaxakerenyie ya xɔri a nun i fan ngaxakerenyie ya xɔri alako e xa won makiiti.

sentences.english: These twenty years I have been with you; your sheep and your goats have had young without loss, not one of your he-goats have I taken for food.
sentences.susu: N ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nan nabaxi i xɔnyi, kɔnɔ i xa yɛxɛɛ nun si keren mu di barixi n yi ra a fa faxa. N man mu i xa xuruse kontonyi yo donxi.

sentences.english: Anything which was wounded by beasts I did not take to you, but myself made up for the loss of it; you made me responsible for whatever was taken by thieves, by day or by night.
sentences.susu: N mu faxi xuruse ra i xɔn ma wulai subee naxan faxaxi. Xuruse naxee muɲaxi kɔɛ nun yanyi ra, n tan nan na kote birin tongoxi n yɛtɛ ra. I nu na birin maxɔrinma n tan nan ma.

sentences.english: This was my condition, wasted by heat in the day and by the bitter cold at night; and sleep went from my eyes.
sentences.susu: Yanyi ra kuyefure naxa n tɔɔrɔ, kɔɛ ra xinbeli naxa n tɔɔrɔ, han n mu nu nɔma xide a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: These twenty years I have been in your house; I was your servant for fourteen years because of your daughters, and for six years I kept your flock, and ten times was my payment changed.
sentences.susu: N bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn naba i yi ra. N ɲɛ fu nun naani walixi nɛ alako n xa i xa di ginɛ firinyie dɔxɔ. N man naxa ɲɛ senni fan sa a fari i xa gɔɔrɛ kantafe ra. Kɔnɔ i bara n sare masara dɔxɔ fu.

sentences.english: If the God of my father, the God of Abraham and the Fear of Isaac, had not been with me, you would have sent me away with nothing in my hands. But God has seen my troubles and the work of my hands, and this night he kept you back.
sentences.susu: Xa n tanun Iburahima Marigi Ala mu n mali nu, Ala naxan nu n baba Isiyaga rasɛrɛnma, n sigama n bɛlɛxɛ igeli nan na nu. Kɔnɔ Ala bara n ma marayaagi to, a bara n ma tɔɔrɛ kolon. Yi kɔɛ dangixi a bara n ma kiiti sa.»

sentences.english: Then Laban, answering, said, These women are my daughters and these children my children, the flocks and all you see are mine: what now may I do for my daughters and for their children?
sentences.susu: Laban naxa Yaxuba yaabi, «I xa ginɛe nan lanxi n ma die ma, e xa die, won ma die nan e ra. Yi xurusee n gbe na e ra, i se naxan birin toxi yi ki, n tan nan gbe e ra. Kɔnɔ to xanbi, n nɔma munse rabade n ma die nun n ma mamadie bɛ?

sentences.english: Come, let us make an agreement, you and I; and let it be for a witness between us.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, won xa saata. Seede xa lu won tagi.»

sentences.english: Then Jacob took a stone and put it up as a pillar.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa gɛmɛ tongo, a naxa a ti saatɛ tɔnxuma ra.

sentences.english: And Jacob said to his people, Get stones together; and they did so; and they had a meal there by the stones.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a ngaxakerenyie bɛ e fan xa gɛmɛe matongo. E naxa e matongo, e e malan yire keren. E naxa e dɛge na gɛmɛ kotoxi sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And the name Laban gave it was Jegar-sahadutha: but Jacob gave it the name of Galeed.
sentences.susu: Laban naxa na yire xili fala Yegara Sahaduta. Yi xili nan falaxi «koto seede» Arami xui ra. Yaxuba naxa na xili fala Galede. Yi xili nan falaxi «koto seede» Isirayila xui ra.

sentences.english: And Laban said, These stones are a witness between you and me today. For this reason its name was Galeed,
sentences.susu: Laban naxa a fala, «Yi gɛmɛ kotoxi naxan yi ki, a findixi seede nan na i tan nun n tan tagi.» Na nan a toxi be xili falaxi Galede, «seede gɛmɛ kotoxi.»

sentences.english: And Mizpah, for he said, May the Lord keep watch on us when we are unable to see one another's doings.
sentences.susu: Misipa xili fan saxi na yire nan xun. Na xili nan falaxi «ɲɛngi sa yire,» barima Laban a fala mɛnni nɛ, «Alatala xa a ɲɛngi sa won tan firinyi xa fe xɔn ma, hali won fatan xanbi.

sentences.english: If you are cruel to my daughters, or if you take other wives in addition to my daughters, then though no man is there to see, God will be the witness between us.
sentences.susu: Xa i n ma die tɔɔrɔ, xa na mu a ra i ginɛ gbɛtɛe dɔxɔ, i xa ratu a ma a Ala nan findixi seede ra won tagi, adamadi xa mu a ra.»

sentences.english: And Laban said, See these stones and this pillar which I have put between you and me;
sentences.susu: Na xanbi Laban naxa a fala Yaxuba bɛ, «I ya ti yi gɛmɛ kotoxi ra. Yi tɔnxuma gɛmɛ mato n naxan tixi won tagi.

sentences.english: They will be witness that I will not go over these stones to you, and you will not go over these stones or this pillar to me, for any evil purpose.
sentences.susu: Yi gɛmɛ kotoxi nun yi tɔnxuma gɛmɛ findixi seede nan na. N mu lan n xa dangi be ra i xa fe ɲaaxi ra n furi kui. I fan mu lan i xa dangi yi gɛmɛ kotoxi nun yi tɔnxuma gɛmɛ ra n ma fe ɲaaxi ra i furi kui.

sentences.english: May the God of Abraham and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, be our judge. Then Jacob took an oath by the Fear of his father Isaac.
sentences.susu: Iburahima Marigi Ala nun Naxori Marigi Ala xa findi won tan firinyi makiitima ra.» Na tɛmui Yaxuba naxa a yɛtɛ rakali Ala ra, a baba Isiyaga gaaxuxi naxan ya ra.

sentences.english: And Jacob made an offering on the mountain, and gave orders to his people to take food: so they had a meal and took their rest that night on the mountain.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa sɛrɛxɛ ba geya yire. A naxa a ngaxakerenyi birin xili e xa e dɛge. E to gɛ e dɛgede, e naxa xi mɛnni na kɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And on his way Jacob came face to face with the angels of God.
sentences.susu: Laban to keli subaxɛ ma, a naxa findigilin a xa die nun a xa mamadie ma. A naxa duba e bɛ. Na xanbi, Laban naxa gbilen a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And when he saw them he said, This is the army of God: so he gave that place the name of Mahanaim.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba to nu sigafe kira xɔn, Ala xa malekɛe naxa mini a ma. A to bara e to, a naxa a fala, «Ala xa yonkinde nan yi ki.»

sentences.english: Now Jacob sent servants before him to Esau, his brother, in the land of Seir, the country of Edom;
sentences.susu: A naxa yi yire xili sa Maxanayimi.

sentences.english: And he gave them orders to say these words to Esau: Your servant Jacob says, Till now I have been living with Laban:
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ a taara Esayu xɔn ma Edon daaxa, Seyiri bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And I have oxen and asses and flocks and men-servants and women-servants: and I have sent to give my lord news of these things so that I may have grace in his eyes.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo yi nan falama n marigi Esayu bɛ, ‹I xa konyi di Yaxuba naxɛ, N bara bu Laban xɔnyi han ya.

sentences.english: When the servants came back they said, We have seen your brother Esau and he is coming out to you, and four hundred men with him.
sentences.susu: Ningee, sofalee, yɛxɛɛe, nun sie nan n yi ra. Konyi xɛmɛe nun konyi ginɛe fan nan n yi ra. N marigi, n xɛɛrae xɛɛxi nɛ i xɔn ma alako i xa diɲɛ n bɛ.›»

sentences.english: Then Jacob was in great fear and trouble of mind: and he put all the people and the flocks and the herds and the camels into two groups;
sentences.susu: Na xɛɛrae to gbilen, e naxa a fala Yaxuba bɛ, «Muxu bara i taara Esayu to. A na fafe i yire, a nun gbangbalanyi mixi kɛmɛ naani.»

sentences.english: And said, If Esau, meeting one group, makes an attack on them, the others will get away safely.
sentences.susu: Na masenyi naxa Yaxuba bɔɲɛ ramini. Ɲama naxan nu a fɔxɔ ra, a naxa e itaxun dɔxɔ firin. A naxa yɛxɛɛe nun sie itaxun dɔxɔ firin, a nun ningee nun ɲɔxɔmɛe.

sentences.english: Then Jacob said, O God of my father Abraham, the God of my father Isaac, the Lord who said to me, Go back to your country and your family and I will be good to you:
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala, «Xa Esayu ɲama keren gere, ɲama boore xa nɔ a gide.»

sentences.english: I am less than nothing in comparison with all your mercies and your faith to me your servant; for with only my stick in my hand I went across Jordan, and now I have become two armies.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi Yaxuba naxa Ala maxandi, «N tanun Iburahima Marigi Ala, n baba Isiyaga Marigi Alatala, i a fala nɛ n bɛ, ‹Gbilen i xa bɔxi ma, i ngaxakerenyie yire. I na siga, n fe fanyi rabama nɛ i bɛ.›

sentences.english: Be my saviour from the hand of Esau, my brother: for my fear is that he will make an attack on me, putting to death mother and child.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi n Marigi, n tan xurun yi fe sɔtɔfe ma i naxan nagirixi n ma. I bara i xui rasabati n tan bɛ i xa konyi. N ma yisuxuwuri gbansan nan nu suxuxi n yi ra n Yurudɛn igirima tɛmui naxɛ, kɔnɔ yakɔsi muxu nun ɲama firin nan gbilenfe.

sentences.english: And you said, Truly, I will be good to you, and make your seed like the sand of the sea which may not be numbered.
sentences.susu: N natanga n taara Esayu ma, barima n bara gaaxu a ya ra. N gaaxuxi nɛ a naxa fa n faxa, n tan nun dingɛe nun e xa die.

sentences.english: Then he put up his tent there for the night; and from among his goods he took, as an offering for his brother Esau,
sentences.susu: I bara a masen n bɛ, ‹N fe fanyi rabama nɛ i bɛ. N i bɔnsɔɛ rawuyama nɛ alɔ mɛyɛnyi naxan kɔnti mu nɔma kolonde baa dɛ ra.›»

sentences.english: Two hundred she-goats and twenty he-goats, two hundred females and twenty males from the sheep,
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa kɔɛ radangi na yire. A naxa sanbase fanyi mayegeti a harige birin ya ma a naxan fima a taara Esayu ma:

sentences.english: Thirty camels with their young ones, forty cows, ten oxen, twenty asses, and ten young asses.
sentences.susu: Si kɛmɛ firin, si kontonyi mɔxɔɲɛn, yɛxɛɛ kɛmɛ firin, yɛxɛɛ kontonyi mɔxɔɲɛn,

sentences.english: These he gave to his servants, every herd by itself, and he said to his servants, Go on before me, and let there be a space between one herd and another.
sentences.susu: ɲɔxɔmɛ ginɛ tongo saxan, e xa die, ninge tongo naani, tuura fu, sofale ginɛ mɔxɔɲɛn, a nun sofale xɛmɛ fu.

sentences.english: And he gave orders to the first, saying, When my brother Esau comes to you and says, Whose servant are you, and where are you going, and whose are these herds?
sentences.susu: A naxa yi xurusee itaxun, a nde so a xa konyie yi ra. A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo dangi yare. Wo xa naaninyi lu gɔɔrɛe tagi.»

sentences.english: Then say to him, These are your servant Jacob's; they are an offering for my lord, for Esau; and he himself is coming after us.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a xa konyi singe bɛ, «Wo nun n taara Esayu na naralan, a fama i maxɔrinde, ‹Wo nun nde a ra? I na sigafe minden? Nde gbe na yi xurusee ra naxee tixi i ya ra yi ki?›

sentences.english: And he gave the same orders to the second and the third and to all those who were with the herds, saying, This is what you are to say to Esau when you see him;
sentences.susu: I fama nɛ a yaabide, ‹N marigi Esayu, i xa konyi Yaxuba nan gbe na e ra. A i sanbaxi yee nan na. A fan na n xanbi ra.›»

sentences.english: And you are to say further, Jacob, your servant, is coming after us. For he said to himself, I will take away his wrath by the offering which I have sent on, and then I will come before him: it may be that I will have grace in his eyes.
sentences.susu: A naxa na masenyi ti a firin nde fan bɛ, a nun a saxan nde, a nun mixi naxee birin biraxi xurusee fɔxɔ ra. «Wo nun Esayu na naralan tɛmui naxɛ, wo xa na masenyi ti a bɛ.

sentences.english: So the servants with the offerings went on in front, and he himself took his rest that night in the tents with his people.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a fala, ‹I xa konyi Yaxuba na fafe muxu xanbi ra.›» Na kui Yaxuba nu na a maɲɔxunfe, «Yakɔsi, n a bɔɲɛ magoroma yi sanbasee nan na. Na tɛmui, a na n to, tɛmunde a nɔma nɛ n nasɛnɛde.»

sentences.english: And in the night he got up, and taking with him his two wives and the two servant-women and his eleven children, he went over the river Jabbok.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba xa sanbasee naxa ti a ya ra, a tan naxa kɔɛ radangi yonkinde kui.

sentences.english: He took them and sent them over the stream with all he had.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ kui, Yaxuba naxa keli. A naxa a xa ginɛ firinyie tongo, e xa konyi firinyie, a nun a xa di fu nun kerenyi. E naxa Yaboko igiri.

sentences.english: Then Jacob was by himself; and a man was fighting with him till dawn.
sentences.susu: A naxa e ragiri Yaboko xure a nun se naxan birin na a yi ra.

sentences.english: But when the man saw that he was not able to overcome Jacob, he gave him a blow in the hollow part of his leg, so that his leg was damaged.
sentences.susu: A naxa lu mɛnni a keren. Na tɛmui, xɛmɛ nde naxa mini a ma, e naxa gere han kuye iba tɛmui.

sentences.english: And he said to him, Let me go now, for the dawn is near. But Jacob said, I will not let you go till you have given me your blessing.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ to bara a to a mu nɔma nɔla sɔtɔde Yaxuba ma e xa gere kui, a naxa a garin a tɔnxɔnyi ma. A tɔnxɔnyi naxa te a kui.

sentences.english: Then he said, What is your name? And he said, Jacob.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ naxa a fala, «A lu n xa siga, ba kuye bara iba.» Yaxuba naxa a fala, «N mu i bɛɲinma, fo i duba n bɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said, Your name will no longer be Jacob, but Israel: for in your fight with God and with men you have overcome.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «I xili di?» A naxa a yaabi, «Yaxuba.»

sentences.english: Then Jacob said, What is your name? And he said, What is my name to you? Then he gave him a blessing.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ naxa a fala, «I xili mu falama sɔnɔn Yaxuba. A fa falama nɛ kɔrɛ Isirayila, ba wo nun Ala nan gerexi, wo nun mixie fan bara gere. I tan bara nɔ e ra.»

sentences.english: And Jacob gave that place the name of Peniel, saying, I have seen God face to face, and still I am living.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa maxɔrinyi ti, «I xili di?» Xɛmɛ naxa a fala, «Munfe ra i n maxɔrinma n xili ma?» Na xanbi, a naxa duba Yaxuba bɛ.

sentences.english: And while he was going past Peniel, the sun came up. And he went with unequal steps because of his damaged leg.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa na yire xili Peniyeli, barima a naxɛ, «N Ala toxi nɛ n ya i, kɔnɔ n tan nan man ɲɛngife yi ki.»

sentences.english: For this reason the children of Israel, even today, never take that muscle in the hollow of the leg as food, because the hollow of Jacob's leg was touched.
sentences.susu: Soge tema tɛmui naxɛ, Yaxuba nu bara dangi Peniyeli ra, a goroma a sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Then Jacob, lifting up his eyes, saw Esau coming with his four hundred men. So he made a division of the children between Leah and Rachel and the two women-servants.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba to Esayu to fa ra e nun xɛmɛ mixi kɛmɛ naani, a naxa a xa die itaxun Leya nun Raxele ma, a nun e xa konyi ginɛ firinyie.

sentences.english: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after them, and Rachel and Joseph at the back.
sentences.susu: A naxa konyi ginɛ firinyie ti yare, e nun e xa die. Nee xanbi ra, Leya fan naxa ti nun a xa die. Raxele nun Yusufu naxa lu dɔnxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And he himself, going before them, went down on his face to the earth seven times till he came near his brother.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba tan naxa siga yare. A to makɔrɛ a taara ra, a naxa a igoro bɔxi ma sanya solofere.

sentences.english: Then Esau came running up to him, and folding him in his arms, gave him a kiss: and the two of them were overcome with weeping.
sentences.susu: Na nan lan Esayu naxa a gi a sa Yaxuba ralan. A naxa findigilin a ma, a fa a masunbu. E birin nu fa wa ra.

sentences.english: Then Esau, lifting up his eyes, saw the women and the children, and said, Who are these with you? And he said, The children whom God in his mercy has given to your servant.
sentences.susu: Esayu to bara ginɛe nun dimɛe to, a naxa maxɔrinyi ti, «Nde yee ra naxee biraxi i fɔxɔ ra yi ki?» Yaxuba naxa a yaabi, «Ala di naxee fixi i xa konyi di ma a xa marafanyi saabui ra.»

sentences.english: Then the servants and their children came near, and went down on their faces.
sentences.susu: Na kui Leya nun Raxele xa konyi ginɛe naxa e maso Esayu ra, e nun e xa die, e fa e igoro bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Leah came near with her children, and then Joseph and Rachel, and they did the same.
sentences.susu: Leya nun a xa die fan naxa e maso, e naxa e igoro bɔxi ma. Na xanbi Yusufu nun Raxele naxa e maso Esayu ra, e igoro bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And he said, What were all those herds which I saw on the way? And Jacob said, They were an offering so that I might have grace in my lord's eyes.
sentences.susu: Esayu naxa Yaxuba maxɔrin, «I munse rabama yi xuruse birin na, n naralanxi naxee ra yi ki?» Yaxuba naxa a yaabi, «N wama nɛ i tan naxan na n marigi ra, i xa n nafan.»

sentences.english: But Esau said, I have enough; keep what is yours, my brother, for yourself.
sentences.susu: Esayu naxa a fala, «N xunya, harige gbegbe na n fan yi ra. I gbe ragata.»

sentences.english: And Jacob said, Not so; but if I have grace in your eyes, take them as a sign of my love, for I have seen your face as one may see the face of God, and you have been pleased with me.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a yaabi, «Ade, n bara i maxandi. Xa i bara n nafan, n i sanbaxi se naxee birin na, i xa e rasuxu. Won tan firinyi xa maralanyi luxi nɛ n bɛ alɔ muxu nun Ala nan luxi yire keren. I bara n nasɛnɛ a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Take my offering then, with my blessing; for God has been very good to me and I have enough: so at his strong request, he took it.
sentences.susu: N bara i maxandi, i xa yi sanbasee rasuxu, barima Ala bara n waxɔnfe birin naba n bɛ. N hayi mu na sese ma sɔnɔn.» Yaxuba naxa a maxɔrɔxɔ han Esayu naxa tin nee ra.

sentences.english: And he said, Let us go on our journey together, and I will go in front.
sentences.susu: Esayu naxa a fala, «Won xɛɛ kira xɔn ma, n xa sa i mati.»

sentences.english: But Jacob said, My lord may see that the children are only small, and there are young ones in my flocks and herds: one day's over-driving will be the destruction of all the flock.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a yaabi, «N marigi, a kolon dimɛe xa fe xɔrɔxɔ. Yɛxɛɛ ginɛe nun ninge ginɛe na xiɲɛ fife e xa die ma. Xa won gbata e ra lɔxɔɛ keren, nee birin fama nɛ faxade.

sentences.english: Do you, my lord, go on before your servant; I will come on slowly, at the rate at which the cattle and the children are able to go, till I come to my lord at Seir.
sentences.susu: N marigi, i tan xa ti yare. N tan xa bira n ma xurusee fɔxɔ ra dɔyin. N xa siga n ma xurusee nun n ma die yaya ra, han muxu soma i xɔnyi tɛmui naxɛ Seyiri bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And Esau said, Then keep some of my men with you. And he said, What need is there for that, if my lord is pleased with me?
sentences.susu: Esayu naxa a fala, «N xa n ma mixi ndee lu i yi ra be.» Yaxuba naxa a yaabi, «Munfe ra? N marigi, n tan wama naxan xɔn, n xa rafan i ma gbansan.»

sentences.english: So Esau, turning back that day, went on his way to Seir.
sentences.susu: Na kui Esayu naxa gbilen na lɔxɔɛ Seyiri.

sentences.english: And Jacob went on to Succoth, where he made a house for himself and put up tents for his cattle: for this reason the place was named Succoth.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba tan naxa siga Sukɔti. Mɛnni a naxa banxi keren ti a yɛtɛ bɛ, a nun gɔɔrɛ a xa xurusee luma dɛnnaxɛ. Na nan a toxi na yire xili falama Sukɔti, na nan falaxi na ki «banxi xunxuri.»

sentences.english: So Jacob came safely from Paddan-aram to the town of Shechem in the land of Canaan, and put up his tents near the town.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba to so hɛɛri Sikemi taa kui Kanaan bɔxi ma kelife Padan Arami, a naxa a xa kiri banxi itala taa fari ma.

sentences.english: And for a hundred bits of money he got from the children of Hamor, the builder of Shechem, the field in which he had put up his tents.
sentences.susu: A xa kiri banxi nu tixi dɛnnaxɛ, a naxa na bɔxi sara Hamori xa die ma kɔbiri kole kɛmɛ ra. Hamori nan findi Sikemi Baba ra, naxan singe sabati na bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And there he put up an altar, naming it El, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan mɛnni, a na yire xili «Isirayila Marigi Ala sɛnbɛ gbo.»

sentences.english: Now Dinah, the daughter whom Leah had by Jacob, went out to see the women of that country.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba xa di ginɛ Dina, Leya naxan barixi a bɛ, na naxa siga Sikemi taa kui ginɛe xɛɛbude.

sentences.english: And when Shechem, the son of Hamor the Hivite who was the chief of that land, saw her, he took her by force and had connection with her.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Hamori Hiwika xa di Sikemi to Dina to, a naxa a madutun, a naxa a futi kana.

sentences.english: Then his heart went out in love to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he said comforting words to her.
sentences.susu: Na kui Yaxuba xa di ginɛ Dina xa xanunteya naxa lu Sikemi fate. Sikemi naxa wɔyɛn Dina bɛ marafanyi kui.

sentences.english: And Shechem said to Hamor, his father, Get me this girl for my wife.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Sikemi naxa a fala a baba Hamori bɛ, «Yi tɛmɛdi maxandi n bɛ alako n xa a dɔxɔ.»

sentences.english: Now Jacob had word of what Shechem had done to his daughter; but his sons were in the fields with the cattle, and Jacob said nothing till they came.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba a mɛ tɛmui naxɛ Sikemi bara a xa di ginɛ Dina futi kana, a xa di xɛmɛe nu na xɛ ma xurusee fɔxɔ ra. A mu sese fala han nee so tɛmui.

sentences.english: Then Hamor, the father of Shechem, came out to have a talk with Jacob.
sentences.susu: Sikemi baba Hamori naxa siga Yaxuba xɔnyi a xa sa wɔyɛn a bɛ.

sentences.english: Now the sons of Jacob came in from the fields when they had news of it, and they were wounded and very angry because of the shame he had done in Israel by having connection with Jacob's daughter; and they said, Such a thing is not to be done.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba xa die to a mɛ naxan dangixi, e naxa keli xɛ ma keren na, e gbilen banxi. E bɔɲɛ naxa te ki fanyi ra barima Sikemi fe mayaagixi nan nabaxi Isirayila bɔxi ma, a fe niya Yaxuba xa di ginɛ ra naxan mu lanma a xa raba.

sentences.english: But Hamor said to them, Shechem, my son, is full of desire for your daughter: will you then give her to him for a wife?
sentences.susu: Hamori naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo xa di ginɛ bara rafan n ma di Sikemi ma. N bara wo maxandi, wo xa a fi a ma, a xa findi a xa ginɛ ra.

sentences.english: And let our two peoples be joined together; give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.
sentences.susu: Won xa lu fe keren, wo wo xa di ginɛe fi muxu ma alako muxu xa e dɔxɔ. Na tɛmui wo fan nɔma muxu gbee dɔxɔde.

sentences.english: Go on living with us, and the country will be open to you; do trade and get property there.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sabati yi bɔxi ma muxu sɛɛti ma. Be xa findi wo xɔnyi ra, wo xa yulɛya raba, wo xa harige sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: And Shechem said to her father and her brothers, If you will give ear to my request, whatever you say I will give to you.
sentences.susu: Sikemi naxa a fala Dina baba nun a taarae bɛ, «Wo xa hinnɛ n na. Wo wama se naxan yo xɔn, n a fima wo ma.

sentences.english: However great you make the bride-price and payment, I will give it; only let me have the girl for my wife.
sentences.susu: Wo nɔma fe belebele maxɔrinde n ma naxan findima kote dɔxɔse ra, sa se gbegbe fan fari. Wo na se naxan birin maxɔrin n ma, n nɔma a birin fide wo ma alako n xa yi sungbutunyi dɔxɔ.»

sentences.english: But the sons of Jacob gave a false answer to Shechem and Hamor his father, because of what had been done to Dinah their sister.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba xa die naxa wɔyɛn furuxi fala Sikemi nun a baba Hamori bɛ, barima Sikemi nu bara e xunya Dina rayaagi.

sentences.english: And they said, It is not possible for us to give our sister to one who is without circumcision, for that would be a cause of shame to us:
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala e bɛ, «Muxu mu nɔma muxu xunya ginɛma fide mixi ma naxan mu sunnaxi. A findima yaagi nan na muxu bɛ.

sentences.english: But on this condition only will we come to an agreement with you: if every male among you becomes like us and undergoes circumcision;
sentences.susu: Muxu mu nɔma wo waxɔnfe rabade, fo wo xa lu alɔ muxu tan. Mixi naxan birin na wo xɔnyi, e lan nɛ e xa sunna alɔ muxu tan.

sentences.english: Then we will give our daughters to you and take your daughters to us and go on living with you as one people.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui muxu nɔma muxu xa di ginɛe fide wo ma, wo xa e dɔxɔ. Muxu fan wo gbee dɔxɔ. Muxu luma wo sɛɛti ma na tɛmui. Won birin findi ɲama keren na.

sentences.english: But if you will not undergo circumcision as we say, then we will take our daughter and go.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa wo mu fa sa tin wo sunnade, muxu muxu xunya ginɛma rasuxuma nɛ, muxu keli be.»

sentences.english: And their words were pleasing to Hamor and his son Shechem.
sentences.susu: Hamori nun a xa di Sikemi naxa tin e xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: And without loss of time the young man did as they said, because he had delight in Jacob's daughter, and he was the noblest of his father's house.
sentences.susu: Na sɛgɛtala mu bu na fe rabafe ra, barima Yaxuba xa di ginɛ bara rafan a ma. A tan nan nu wurugente ra a ngaxakerenyie tagi.

sentences.english: Then Hamor and Shechem, his son, went to the meeting-place of their town, and said to the men of the town,
sentences.susu: Hamori nun Sikemi naxa siga e xa malan yire taa sode dɛ ra. E naxa a masen e xa ɲama bɛ,

sentences.english: It is the desire of these men to be at peace with us; let them then go on living in this country and doing trade here, for the country is wide open before them; let us take their daughters as wives and let us give them our daughters.
sentences.susu: «Yi mixie won ma fe fanyi na e bɛ. E xa lu yi bɔxi ma, e xa yulɛya raba, barima won ma bɔxi gbo. Won nɔma e xa di ginɛe dɔxɔde, won fan won ma di ginɛe fima e ma.

sentences.english: But these men will make an agreement with us to go on living with us and to become one people, only on the condition that every male among us undergoes circumcision as they have done.
sentences.susu: Xa yi mixie sabatima be, won xa findi ɲama keren na, fo won xa yi nan naba. Xɛmɛ naxan birin na won xɔnyi be, e birin lan nɛ e xa sunna alɔ e tan.

sentences.english: Then will not their cattle and their goods and all their beasts be ours? so let us come to an agreement with them so that they may go on living with us.
sentences.susu: Xa won bara tin e xa masenyi ra, na tɛmui e sabatima won xɔnyi. E xa xurusee nun e sɔtɔse birin findi won birin gbe ra.»

sentences.english: Then all the men of the town gave ear to the words of Hamor and Shechem his son; and every male in the town underwent circumcision.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan birin nu na taa sode dɛ ra na lɔxɔɛ, e birin naxa tin Hamori nun a xa di Sikemi xa masenyi ra. Xɛmɛ naxan birin nu na taa kui, e birin naxa e sunna.

sentences.english: But on the third day after, before the wounds were well, two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, took their swords and came into the town by surprise and put all the males to death.
sentences.susu: E xa sunnɛ xi saxan lɔxɔɛ, yi xɛmɛe sunnade to nu na e xɔnɔfe, Yaxuba xa di xɛmɛ firinyie Simeyɔn nun Lewi, Dina taara xɛmɛmae naxa e xa santidɛgɛmae tongo, e so taa kui, e xɛmɛ birin faxa santidɛgɛma ra tɛrɛnna ra.

sentences.english: And Hamor and his son they put to death with the sword, and they took Dinah from Shechem's house and went away.
sentences.susu: E naxa Hamori nun a xa di Sikemi fan faxa. E naxa Dina tongo Sikemi xɔnyi, e naxa fa a ra.

sentences.english: And the sons of Jacob came on them when they were wounded and made waste the town because of what had been done to their sister;
sentences.susu: Yaxuba xa di booree naxa se birin tongo naxee findi na mixi faxaxie gbe ra, barima e nu bara e xunya ginɛma futi kana.

sentences.english: They took their flocks and their herds and their asses and everything in their town and in their fields,
sentences.susu: E naxa e xa yɛxɛɛe tongo a nun e xa sie, e xa ningee nun e xa sofalee, naxee nu na taa kui a nun daaxa.

sentences.english: And all their wealth and all their little ones and their wives; everything in their houses they took and made them waste.
sentences.susu: Se naxan birin nu na, e naxa a birin xanin. E naxa dimɛe nun ginɛe xanin. Banxi naxan birin nu na, e naxa a birin kana.

sentences.english: And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, You have made trouble for me and given me a bad name among the people of this country, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and because we are small in number they will come together against me and make war on me; and it will be the end of me and all my people.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a fala Simeyɔn nun Lewi bɛ, «Wo bara kɔntɔfili ti n ma n lufe ra xɔnnanteya dɔxɔɛ kui Kanaankae nun Peresikae tagi. Xɛmɛ gbegbe mu na n yi ra. E fama nɛ lande n xun ma, e n bɔnbɔ, e n xabilɛ birin halaki.»

sentences.english: But they said, Were we to let him make use of our sister as a loose woman?
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «A nu lanma yi mixi xa muxu xunya findi langoe ra?»

sentences.english: And God said to Jacob, Go up now to Beth-el and make your living-place there: and put up an altar there to the God who came to you when you were in flight from your brother Esau.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen Yaxuba bɛ, «Keli, i siga Beteli. I xa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan n bɛ mɛnni, n nan n yɛtɛ masen i bɛ dɛnnaxɛ, i nu i gima waxati naxɛ i taara Esayu ma.»

sentences.english: Then Jacob said to all his people, Put away the strange gods which are among you, and make yourselves clean, and put on a change of clothing:
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a fala a xa denbaya bɛ a nun a fɔxirabirɛe, «Wo gbilen kuye fe fɔxɔ ra, wo xa wo yɛtɛ sɛniyɛn, wo xa wo xa sosee fan masara.

sentences.english: And let us go up to Beth-el: and there I will make an altar to God, who gave me an answer in the day of my trouble, and was with me wherever I went.
sentences.susu: Wo wo yailan, won xa siga Beteli. N xa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan Ala bɛ, naxan a yɛtɛ masen n bɛ n nu na kɔntɔfili kui tɛmui naxɛ. A naxa a ɲɛngi sa n ma fe xɔn n siga dɛnnaxɛ birin.»

sentences.english: Then they gave to Jacob all the strange gods which they had, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob put them away under the holy tree at Shechem.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui e naxa e xa kuye birin so Yaxuba yi ra a nun e xa tulirasoe. Yaxuba naxa e birin biri wuri belebele bun ma naxan na Sikemi sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: So they went on their journey: and the fear of God was on the towns round about, so that they made no attack on the sons of Jacob.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba nun a xa die to bara e xa yonkinde ba, Ala naxa gaaxui lu taa mixi birin bɔɲɛ ma, mixi yo mu suusa birade e fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And Jacob came to Luz in the land of Canaan (which is the same as Beth-el), he and all his people.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba nun a fɔxirabirɛe naxa siga Lusi, Beteli nan na ki, Kanaan bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And there he made an altar, naming the place El-beth-el: because it was there he had the vision of God when he was in flight from his brother.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan mɛnni. A naxa na yire xili fala «Beteli Marigi Ala,» barima Ala a yɛtɛ masen a bɛ mɛnni nɛ a nu a gife a taara ma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And Deborah, the servant who had taken care of Rebekah from her birth, came to her end, and was put to rest near Beth-el, under the holy tree: and they gave it the name of Allon-bacuth.
sentences.susu: Rebeka xa di masuxui Debora naxa faxa. E naxa a ragata Beteli mabiri wuri belebele na dɛnnaxɛ. Na wuri belebele xili nɛ «wa tide.»

sentences.english: Now when Jacob was on his way from Paddan-aram, God came to him again and, blessing him, said,
sentences.susu: Ala man naxa mini Yaxuba ma, a to gbilen kelife Padan Arami. A naxa barakɛ sa a xa fe.

sentences.english: Jacob is your name, but it will be so no longer; from now your name will be Israel; so he was named Israel.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xili falafe nɛ Yaxuba, kɔnɔ a mu falama na ki sɔnɔn. To xanbi i xili fa falama nɛ Isirayila.» Ala naxa a xili sa Isirayila.

sentences.english: And God said to him, I am God, the Ruler of all: be fertile, and have increase; a nation, truly a group of nations, will come from you, and kings will be your offspring;
sentences.susu: A man naxa a masen a bɛ, «N tan nan na Ala ra Sɛnbɛ Kanyi. N di gbegbe fima nɛ i ma, alako i xa findi si nde benba ra. I man findima nɛ si gbegbe benba ra. Mangɛe fama nɛ minide i bɔnsɔɛ ya ma.

sentences.english: And the land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give to you; and to your seed after you I will give the land.
sentences.susu: N bɔxi naxan fi Iburahima nun Isiyaga ma, n bara a fi i fan ma, a nun i bɔnsɔɛ ma naxan fama i xanbi ra.»

sentences.english: Then God went up from him in the place where he had been talking with him.
sentences.susu: Na nan lan, Ala naxa keli yire, a wɔyɛn Yaxuba bɛ dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And Jacob put up a pillar in the place where he had been talking with God, and put a drink offering on it, and oil.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa gɛmɛ tɔnxuma ti naa, a naxa ture nun wɛni ifili a ma sɛrɛxɛ ra, alako a xa findi gɛmɛ magaaxuxi ra.

sentences.english: And he gave to the place where God had been talking with him, the name of Beth-el.
sentences.susu: A naxa yi yire xili fala Beteli, Ala wɔyɛn a bɛ dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: So they went on from Beth-el; and while they were still some distance from Ephrath, the pains of birth came on Rachel and she had a hard time.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba nun a xa denbaya to keli Beteli, beenu e xa makɔrɛ Efarata ra, Raxele naxa di sɔtɔ. Na di barife naxa findi a bɛ fe xɔrɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And when her pain was very great, the woman who was helping her said, Have no fear; for now you will have another son.
sentences.susu: Raxele nu na di barima tɛmui naxɛ xɔnɛ kui, di rasuxui naxa a fala a bɛ, «Hali i mu gaaxu, yi biyaasi i man xɛmɛ nan barixi.»

sentences.english: And in the hour when her life went from her (for death came to her), she gave the child the name Ben-oni: but his father gave him the name of Benjamin.
sentences.susu: Raxele nu bara lu alɔ mixi faxaxi. A nu a nii magagama tɛmui naxɛ, a naxa a xa di xili sa Ben Oni, «nimisa di.» Kɔnɔ a baba tan naxa a xili sa Bunyamin, «di barakaxi.»

sentences.english: So Rachel came to her end and was put to rest on the road to Ephrath (which is Beth-lehem).
sentences.susu: Raxele to faxa, e naxa a ragata Efarata kira dɛ. Na yire xili falama nɛ yakɔsi Bɛtɛlɛɛmu.

sentences.english: And Jacob put up a pillar on her resting-place; which is named, The Pillar of the resting-place of Rachel, to this day.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa gɛmɛ sa gaburi fari tɔnxuma ra, na na mɛnni han to.

sentences.english: And Israel went journeying on and put up his tents on the other side of the tower of the flock.
sentences.susu: Isirayila naxa siga a sa yonkin Migidali Ederi xanbi ra.

sentences.english: Now while they were living in that country, Reuben had connection with Bilhah, his father's servant-woman: and Israel had news of it.
sentences.susu: Isirayila nu na mɛnni tɛmui naxɛ, Ruben naxa a baba xa ginɛ Bila kolon ginɛ ra. Isirayila naxa kolon sɔtɔ na ma. Isirayila di xɛmɛ fu nun firin nan sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Now Jacob had twelve sons: the sons of Leah: Reuben, Jacob's first son, and Simeon and Levi and Judah and Issachar and Zebulun;
sentences.susu: Leya naxa Ruben bari di singe, na xanbi ra Simeyɔn, Lewi, Yuda, Isakari, nun Sabulon.

sentences.english: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin;
sentences.susu: Raxele naxa Yusufu nun Bunyamin bari.

sentences.english: The sons of Bilhah, Rachel's servant: Dan and Naphtali;
sentences.susu: Raxele xa konyi Bila naxa Nafatali nun Dana bari.

sentences.english: The sons of Zilpah, Leah's servant: Gad and Asher; these are the sons whom Jacob had in Paddan-aram.
sentences.susu: Leya xa konyi Silipa naxa Gadi nun Aseri bari. Nee birin findixi Yaxuba xa die nan na, a naxee sɔtɔ Padan Arami.

sentences.english: And Jacob came to his father Isaac at Mamre, at Kiriath-arba, that is, Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac had been living.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa siga a baba Isiyaga xɔnyi Mamire, Kiriyati Araba mabiri. Mɛnni fa xili nɛ kɔrɛ Hebiron. Iburahima nun Isiyaga sabati nɛ naa.

sentences.english: And Isaac was a hundred and eighty years old.
sentences.susu: Isiyaga xa simaya nu bara siga ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ tongo solomasaxan.

sentences.english: Then Isaac came to his end and was put to rest with his father's people, an old man after a long life: and Jacob and Esau, his sons, put him in his last resting-place.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ simaya xɔnkuye sɔtɔde, a naxa faxa, a a benbae masagata aligiyama. A xa di Esayu nun Yaxuba naxa a ragata.

sentences.english: Now these are the generations of Esau, that is to say, Edom.
sentences.susu: Esayu, naxan man xili falama Edon, a xa taruxui nan ya.

sentences.english: Esau's wives were women of Canaan: Adah, the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,
sentences.susu: Esayu Kanaan ginɛe dɔxɔ nɛ: Ada, naxan findixi Elon Xitika xa di ra, nun Oholibama, naxan findixi Ana xa di ra, Sibeyon Hiwika xa mamadi.

sentences.english: And Basemath, Ishmael's daughter, the sister of Nebaioth.
sentences.susu: A naxa Sumayila xa di ginɛ Basamati fan dɔxɔ, Nebayoti xunya ginɛma.

sentences.english: Adah had a son Eliphaz; and Basemath was the mother of Reuel;
sentences.susu: Elifasi findi Ada xa di nan na. Reyuweli findi Basamati xa di nan na.

sentences.english: Oholibamah was the mother of Jeush, Jalam, and Korah; these are the sons of Esau, whose birth took place in the land of Canaan.
sentences.susu: Oholibama naxa di xɛmɛ saxan bari a bɛ: Yeyusi, Yalami, nun Kora. Nee birin findi Esayu xa die nan na naxee barixi Kanaan bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters, and all the people of his house, and his beasts and his cattle and all his goods which he had got together in the land of Canaan, and went into the land of Seir, away from his brother Jacob.
sentences.susu: Esayu naxa a xa ginɛe xanin a xun ma, a xa di ginɛe, a xa di xɛmɛe, a xa konyie, a xa xurusee, nun a harige naxan birin sɔtɔ Kanaan bɔxi ma. A naxa a birin xanin bɔxi gbɛtɛ ma, dɛnnaxɛ makuya a xunya Yaxuba yire ra,

sentences.english: For their wealth was so great that the land was not wide enough for the two of them and all their cattle.
sentences.susu: barima e harige nu bara gbo, e mu nu nɔma lude e boore sɛɛti ma. E nu na dɛnnaxɛ, e xa xuruse birin mu nu nɔma ɲooge sɔtɔde.

sentences.english: So Esau made his living-place in the hill-country of Seir (Esau is Edom).
sentences.susu: Na nan a to Esayu, naxan findi Edon na, a naxa siga a sa sabati Seyiri geya bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And these are the generations of Esau, the father of the Edomites in the hill-country of Seir:
sentences.susu: Esayu naxan findi Edon bɔnsɔɛ baba ra, na nu sabatixi geyae nan ma Seyiri bɔxi ma, a xa taruxui nan ya.

sentences.english: These are the names of Esau's sons: Eliphaz, the son of Esau's wife Adah, and Reuel, the son of Esau's wife Basemath.
sentences.susu: Esayu xa die nan ya: Elifasi, Ada naxan barixi Esayu bɛ, Reyuweli, Basamati naxan barixi Esayu bɛ.

sentences.english: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
sentences.susu: Elifasi xa die nan ya: Teman, Omaru, Sefo, Gatami, nun Kenasi.

sentences.english: And Eliphaz, the son of Esau, had connection with a woman named Timna, who gave birth to Amalek: all these were the children of Esau's wife Adah.
sentences.susu: Timina, Elifasi xa konyi ginɛ, a Amalɛki bari nɛ Elifasi bɛ. Esayu nun a xa ginɛ Ada xa mamadie nan na ki.

sentences.english: And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah: they were the children of Esau's wife Basemath.
sentences.susu: Reyuweli xa die nan ya: Naxati, Sera, Sama, nun Misa. Esayu nun a xa ginɛ Basamati xa mamadie nan na ki.

sentences.english: And these are the sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon: she was the mother of Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
sentences.susu: Esayu xa die nan ya Oholibama naxan barixi a bɛ: Yeyusi, Yalami, nun Kora. Oholibama findixi Ana xa di ginɛ nan na. Ana findixi Sibeyon xa di ginɛ nan na.

sentences.english: These were the chiefs among the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz, Esau's first son: Teman, Omar, Zepho, Kenaz,
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxee keli Esayu bɔnsɔɛ nee nan ya: Esayu xa di singe Elifasi xa die nan ya: Mangɛe Teman, Omaru, Sefo, Kenasi,

sentences.english: Korah, Gatam, Amalek: all these were chiefs in the land of Edom, the offspring of Eliphaz, the seed of Adah.
sentences.susu: Kora, Gatami, nun Amalɛki. Mangɛe nan na ki naxee fatanxi Elifasi Edonka ra. Ada xa mamadie nan e ra.

sentences.english: And these are the sons of Esau's son Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, Mizzah: these were the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom, the children of Esau's wife Basemath.
sentences.susu: Esayu xa di Reyuweli xa die nan ya: Mangɛe Naxati, Sera, Sama, nun Misa. Mangɛe nan na ki naxee fatanxi Reyuweli Edonka ra. Basamati xa mamadie nan e ra.

sentences.english: And these are the sons of Esau's wife Oholibamah: Jeush, Jalam, and Korah: these were the chiefs who came from Esau's wife Oholibamah, daughter of Anah.
sentences.susu: Esayu xa ginɛ Oholibama xa die nan ya: Mangɛe Yeyusi, Yalami, nun Kora. Mangɛe nan na ki naxee fatanxi Esayu xa ginɛ Oholibama ra. Oholibama nan findixi Ana xa di ra.

sentences.english: These were the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these were their chiefs.
sentences.susu: Esayu, naxan man xili falama Edon, a xa die nan na ki, a nun mangɛ naxee fatanxi Esayu bɔnsɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: These are the sons of Seir the Horite who were living in that country; Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
sentences.susu: Seyiri Xorika xa die nan ya, naxee nu na yi bɔxi ma: Lotan, Sobali, Sibeyon, Ana,

sentences.english: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan: these are the chiefs of the Horites, offspring of Seir in the land of Edom.
sentences.susu: Dison, Eseri, nun Disan. Xori mangɛe nan na ki naxee fatanxi Seyiri bɔnsɔɛ ra Edon bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: The children of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; Lotan's sister was Timna.
sentences.susu: Lotan xa di xɛmɛe nan ya: Xori nun Hemami Timina findixi Lotan xunya ginɛma nan na.

sentences.english: And these are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
sentences.susu: Sobali xa di xɛmɛe nan ya: Aliban, Manaxati, Ebali, Sefo, nun Onan.

sentences.english: And these are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah; that same Anah who made the discovery of the water-springs in the waste land, when he was looking after the asses of his father Zibeon.
sentences.susu: Sibeyon xa di xɛmɛe nan ya: Aya nun Ana, naxan dulonyi furaxie toxi gbengberen yire, a to nu Sibeyon xa sofalee dɛmadonfe.

sentences.english: And these are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah his daughter.
sentences.susu: Ana xa die nan ya: Dison nun Oholibama, Ana xa di ginɛ.

sentences.english: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Keran.
sentences.susu: Dison xa di xɛmɛe nan ya: Hendan, Eseban, Yitiran, nun Keran.

sentences.english: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
sentences.susu: Eseri xa di xɛmɛe nan ya: Bilihan, Saban, nun Akan.

sentences.english: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
sentences.susu: Disan xa di xɛmɛe nan ya: Usi nun Aran.

sentences.english: These were the Horite chiefs: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,
sentences.susu: Xori mangɛe nan ya: Lotan, Sobali, Sibeyon, Ana,

sentences.english: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. Such were the Horite chiefs in their order in the land of Seir.
sentences.susu: Dison, Eseri, Disan. Xori mangɛe nan na ki Seyiri bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And these are the kings who were ruling in the land of Edom before there was any king over the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Edon mangɛe nan ya, naxee nu na beenu mangɛ ndee xa lu Isirayila:

sentences.english: Bela, son of Beor, was king in Edom, and the name of his chief town was Dinhabah.
sentences.susu: Beyori xa di Bela naxa findi Edon mangɛ ra. A xa taa xili nu fala nɛ Dinhaba.

sentences.english: At his death, Jobab, son of Zerah of Bozrah, became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Bela to faxa, Sera xa di Yobabo naxan keli Bosara, na naxa findi mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And at the death of Jobab, Husham, from the country of the Temanites, became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Yobabo to faxa, Xusama naxan keli Teman bɔxi ma, na naxa findi mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And at the death of Husham, Hadad, son of Bedad, who overcame the Midianites in the field of Moab, became king; his chief town was named Avith.
sentences.susu: Xusama to faxa, Bedada xa di Hadada, naxan bara nɔ Madiyan na Mowaba bɔxi ma, na naxa findi mangɛ ra. A xa taa xili nu fala nɛ Abiti.

sentences.english: And at the death of Hadad, Samlah of Masrekah became king.
sentences.susu: Hadada to faxa, Samala Masareka naxa findi mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And at the death of Samlah, Shaul of Rehoboth by the River became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Samala to faxa, Sawulu Rehobotika, naxan nu na xure dɛ ra, na naxa findi mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And at the death of Shaul, Baal-hanan, son of Achbor, became king.
sentences.susu: Sawulu to faxa, Akibori xa di Bali Hanan, na naxa findi mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And at the death of Baal-hanan, Hadar became king in his place; his chief town was named Pau, and his wife's name was Mehetabel; she was the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
sentences.susu: Akibori xa di Bali Hanan to faxa, Hadara naxa findi mangɛ ra. A xa taa xili nu fala nɛ Pawu. A xa ginɛ xili nu fala nɛ Mehetabeli, Matirɛdi xa di ginɛ, Mesahabi xa mamadi.

sentences.english: These are the names of the chiefs of Esau in the order of their families and their places: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,
sentences.susu: Mangɛe nan ya naxee kelixi Esayu bɔnsɔɛ ma: Timina, Aliba, Yeteti,

sentences.english: Oholibamah, Elah, Pinon,
sentences.susu: Oholibama, Ela, Pinon,

sentences.english: Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar,
sentences.susu: Kenasi, Teman, Mibisari,

sentences.english: Magdiel, Iram; these are the Edomite chiefs, in their places in their heritage; this is Esau, the father of the Edomites.
sentences.susu: Magadiyɛli, nun Irami. Edon mangɛe nu mangɛya raɲɛrɛma e xa bɔxie nan ma. Esayu xa taruxui nan na ki naxan findixi Edonkae benba ra.

sentences.english: Now Jacob was living in the land where his father had made a place for himself, in the land of Canaan.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba sabati nɛ Kanaan bɔxi ma, a baba nu na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: These are the generations of Jacob: Joseph, a boy seventeen years old, was looking after the flock, together with his brothers, the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father's wives; and Joseph gave their father a bad account of them.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ xa taruxui nan ya. Yusufu, naxan xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ fu nun solofere li, a nu xurusee nan kantama a nun a taarae, nun a baba xa ginɛe Bila nun Silipa xa die. Yusufu nu a taarae xa fe ɲaaxie dɛntɛgɛ sama a baba bɛ.

sentences.english: Now the love which Israel had for Joseph was greater than his love for all his other children, because he got him when he was an old man: and he had a long coat made for him.
sentences.susu: Yusufu nan nu rafan Isirayila ma dangi a xa di birin na, barima a tan bari a xa xɛmɛforiɲa nan kui. Na kui a naxa donma kuye tofanyi fi a ma.

sentences.english: And because his brothers saw that Joseph was dearer to his father than all the others, they were full of hate for him, and would not say a kind word to him.
sentences.susu: Yusufu taarae naxa a kolon e xunya nan nafan e baba ma dangi e birin na. E naxa a raɲaaxu fɔlɔ, e mu nu wɔyɛn fanyi falama a bɛ kɔrɛ.

sentences.english: Now Joseph had a dream, and he gave his brothers an account of it, which made their hate greater than ever.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yusufu naxa xiye nde sa. A to na iba a taarae bɛ, e naxa a raɲaaxu dangife a singe ra.

sentences.english: And he said to them, Let me give you the story of my dream.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo tuli mati n ma xiye ra, n naxan saxi.

sentences.english: We were in the field, getting the grain stems together, and my grain kept upright, and yours came round and went down on the earth before mine.
sentences.susu: Won birin nu na xɛ nan ma mɛngi raxiride. Na nan lan, n ma mɛngi xiri naxa keli, a ti. Mɛngi xiri naxee nu suxuxi wo tan yi ra, e naxa n gbe xiri rabilin, e birin fa e kuntin n ma xiri bun.»

sentences.english: And his brothers said to him, Are you to be our king? will you have authority over us? And because of his dream and his words, their hate for him became greater than ever.
sentences.susu: A taarae naxa a maxɔrin, «Pe, i wama findife muxu xa mangɛ nan na, alako i xa nu muxu yamari?» E naxa a raɲaaxu dangife a singe ra a xa xiye nun a xa masenyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Then he had another dream, and gave his brothers an account of it, saying, I have had another dream: the sun and the moon and eleven stars gave honour to me.
sentences.susu: Yusufu to xiye gbɛtɛ sa, a naxa na fan iba a taarae bɛ. A naxa a fala e bɛ, «N man bara xiye sa. Soge, kike, nun tunbui fu nun keren nu na n bun ma.»

sentences.english: And he gave word of it to his father and his brothers; but his father protesting said, What sort of a dream is this? am I and your mother and your brothers to go down on our faces to the earth before you?
sentences.susu: A naxa na xiye tagi raba a baba nun a taarae bɛ. A baba naxa xaaɲɛ a ma, a fa a fala a bɛ, «I xiye naxan saxi yi ki, a findixi xiye mɔɔli mundun na? I waxi nɛ i nga, i taarae, nun n tan, muxu xa fa muxu igorode bɔxi ma i bɛ?»

sentences.english: And his brothers were full of envy; but his father kept his words in mind.
sentences.susu: A taarae naxa bira a tɔɔnɛ fe fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ a baba naxa a ɲɛngi sa a xiye xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Now his brothers went to keep watch over their father's flock in Shechem.
sentences.susu: Yusufu taarae naxa siga Sikemi e baba xa xurusee dɛmadonde.

sentences.english: And Israel said to Joseph, Are not your brothers with the flock in Shechem? come, I will send you to them. And he said to him, Here am I.
sentences.susu: Isirayila naxa a fala Yusufu bɛ, «I taarae bara siga xurusee dɛmadonde Sikemi. N naxan nabama, n xa i xɛɛ e xɔn ma.» Yusufu naxa a yaabi, «Awa.»

sentences.english: And he said to him, Go now, and see if your brothers are well and how the flock is; then come back and give me word. So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
sentences.susu: Isirayila naxa a masen a bɛ, «Siga mafuren i xa sa a mato xa i taarae mu furaxi, xa se mu xurusee fan toxi alako i xa fa na dɛntɛgɛ sa n bɛ.» A naxa a xɛɛ keli Hebiron lanbanyi sigafe ra Sikemi.

sentences.english: And a man saw him wandering in the country, and said to him, What are you looking for?
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ nde naxa Yusufu to Sikemi bɔxi ma, a na ɲɛrɛfe wula i. Na xɛmɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «I munse fenfe?»

sentences.english: And he said, I am looking for my brothers; please give me word of where they are keeping their flock.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «N na n taarae nan fenfe. Yandi, a fala n bɛ e na xurusee dɛmadonfe dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: And the man said, They have gone away from here, for they said in my hearing, Let us go to Dothan. So Joseph went after them and came up with them at Dothan.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «E mu na be. N bara e xui mɛ a fala ra e xa siga Dotan.» Na kui Yusufu naxa bira a taarae fɔxɔ ra han a sa e li Dotan.

sentences.english: But they saw him when he was a long way off, and before he came near them they made a secret design against him to put him to death;
sentences.susu: E to sa a to yire makuye, e naxa lan a ma e xa a faxa.

sentences.english: Saying to one another, See, here comes this dreamer.
sentences.susu: E nu fa a fala ra e boore bɛ, «Yi xiye sa mangɛ nan na fafe yi ki.

sentences.english: Let us now put him to death and put his body into one of these holes, and we will say, An evil beast has put him to death: then we will see what becomes of his dreams.
sentences.susu: Wo fa be, won xa a faxa, won xa a ragoro kɔlɔnyi nde kui. Won nɔma a falade sube xaaɲɛ nde bara a ibɔɔ. Na tɛmui won fama a kolonde a xa xiye findima a bɛ fe naxan na.»

sentences.english: But Reuben, hearing these words, got him out of their hands, saying, Let us not take his life.
sentences.susu: Ruben to na mɛ, a naxa a ba e yi ra yi masenyi ra, «Won naxa a faxa de.

sentences.english: Do not put him to a violent death, but let him be placed in one of the holes; this he said to keep him safe from their hands, with the purpose of taking him back to his father again.
sentences.susu: A mu lanma wo xa a wuli ramini. Wo xa a ragoro yi kɔlɔnyi kui naxan na yi gbengberen yire. Mixi yo naxa a bɛlɛxɛ din a ra.» A nu wama a bafe nɛ e yi ra alako a xa nɔ a ragbilende a baba xɔn.

sentences.english: So when Joseph came to his brothers, they took off his long coat which he had on;
sentences.susu: Yusufu to a taarae yire li, e naxa a xa donma kuye tofanyi rate a ma.

sentences.english: And they took him and put him in the hole: now the hole had no water in it.
sentences.susu: E naxa Yusufu ragoro kɔlɔnyi nde kui, ye mu nu na naxan kui.

sentences.english: Then seating themselves, they took their meal: and looking up, they saw a travelling band of Ishmaelites, coming from Gilead on their way to Egypt, with spices and perfumes on their camels.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, e nu na e dɛgefe tɛmui naxɛ, e naxa Sumayila di ndee to fa ra kelife Galede. E nu na surayi, seri, nun labundɛ xaninfe Misira bɔxi ma ɲɔxɔmɛe fari.

sentences.english: And Judah said to his brothers, What profit is there in putting our brother to death and covering up his blood?
sentences.susu: Yuda naxa a masen a xunyae bɛ, «Won na won xunya faxa gundo kui, na munse fanma won tan ma?

sentences.english: Let us give him to these Ishmaelites for a price, and let us not put violent hands on him, for he is our brother, our flesh. And his brothers gave ear to him.
sentences.susu: Wo fa, won xa a mati Sumayila bɔnsɔɛ mixie ma. Won naxa a faxa, barima won xunya na a ra. Won wuli keren fasɛ keren.» A xunyae birin naxa tin a xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: And some traders from Midian went by; so pulling Joseph up out of the hole, they gave him to the Ishmaelites for twenty bits of silver, and they took him to Egypt.
sentences.susu: Na Madiyan yulɛe to e yire li, Yusufu taarae naxa a rate kɔlɔnyi kui, e fa a mati nee ma kɔbiri kole mɔxɔɲɛn na. Na yulɛ naxee fatanxi Sumayila bɔnsɔɛ ra, nee naxa Yusufu xanin Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Now when Reuben came back to the hole, Joseph was not there; and giving signs of grief,
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi Ruben naxa gbilen kɔlɔnyi yire Yusufu fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ a mu a li naa. A naxa a xa donma birin ibɔɔ a ma sunnunyi kui.

sentences.english: He went back to his brothers, and said, The child is gone; what am I to do?
sentences.susu: A naxa gbilen a xunyae yire, a a fala e bɛ, «Yusufu mu na yire won na lu dɛnnaxɛ, n fa munse rabama kɔrɛ?»

sentences.english: Then they took Joseph's coat, and put on it some of the blood from a young goat which they had put to death,
sentences.susu: E naxa si keren faxa, e fa Yusufu xa donma kuye tofanyi maturuxun na sube wuli.

sentences.english: And they took the coat to their father, and said, We came across this; is it your son's coat or not?
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, e naxa na donma kuye tofanyi xanin e baba xɔn ma. E naxa a fala a bɛ, «Muxu bara yi to. Yi donma mato ba xa i xa di nan gbe a ra.»

sentences.english: And he saw that it was, and said, It is my son's coat; an evil beast has put him to death; without doubt Joseph has come to a cruel end.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa na donma kolon, a fa a fala, «N ma di xa donma na a ra! Wula sube xaaɲɛ nde bara n ma di Yusufu faxa! A bara a ibɔɔ!»

sentences.english: Then Jacob, giving signs of grief, put on haircloth, and went on weeping for his son day after day.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a xa donma ibɔɔ a ma sunnunyi kui. A naxa sunnun dugi ragoro a ma, a a xa di ɲɔn fe raba xi wuyaxi.

sentences.english: And all his sons and all his daughters came to give him comfort, but he would not be comforted, saying with weeping, I will go down to the underworld to my son. So great was his father's sorrow for him.
sentences.susu: A xa di xɛmɛe nun a xa di ginɛe naxa fe birin naba a bɛ alako sunnunyi xa ba a ma, kɔnɔ Yaxuba mu dundu. A naxa a fala, «N nan n ma di xa sunnunyi xaninma han n sa a lima tɛmui naxɛ aligiyama.» Yaxuba naxa wa a xa di bɛ.

sentences.english: And in Egypt the men of Midian gave him for a price to Potiphar, a captain of high position in Pharaoh's house.
sentences.susu: Madiyankae to Misira li, e naxa Yusufu mati Potifari ma, naxan findixi Misira mangɛ kantamixie xunyi ra.

sentences.english: Now at that time, Judah went away from his brothers and became the friend of a man of Adullam named Hirah.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Yuda naxa keli a ngaxakerenyie xun ma, a siga Adulamaka nde xɔnyi naxan xili Hira.

sentences.english: And there he saw the daughter of a certain man of Canaan named Shua, and took her as his wife.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni Yuda naxa Suwa Kanaanka xa di ginɛ to. A naxa a findi a xa ginɛ ra. E naxa lu e boore ra.

sentences.english: And she gave birth to a son, and he gave him the name Er.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ naxa tɛɛgɛ, a naxa di xɛmɛ bari. Yuda naxa na di xili sa Eri.

sentences.english: And again she gave birth to a son, and he gave him the name Onan.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ man naxa tɛɛgɛ di firin nde ma, a naxa di xɛmɛ bari. A naxa na di xili sa Onan.

sentences.english: Then she had another son, to whom she gave the name Shelah; she was at Chezib when the birth took place.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, a man naxa di xɛmɛ gbɛtɛ bari. A naxa na di xili sa Selaha. Yuda xa ginɛ na di bari Kesibe nɛ.

sentences.english: And Judah took a wife for his first son Er, and her name was Tamar.
sentences.susu: Yuda naxa ginɛ nde fen, a a so a xa di singe Eri yi ra. Na ginɛ xili Tamari.

sentences.english: Now Er, Judah's first son, did evil in the eyes of the Lord, so that he put him to death.
sentences.susu: Mixi kobi nan nu lanxi Yuda xa di singe Eri ma Alatala ya i. Alatala naxa a ragiri a xa faxa.

sentences.english: Then Judah said to Onan, Go in to your brother's wife and do what it is right for a husband's brother to do; make her your wife and get offspring for your brother.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi Yuda naxa a fala Onan bɛ, «I taara xa ginɛ tongo, a xa findi i xa ginɛ ra. I xa nimɔxɔ wali raba, alako i xa di fi i taara ma.»

sentences.english: But Onan, seeing that the offspring would not be his, went in to his brother's wife, but let his seed go on to the earth, so that he might not get offspring for his brother.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Onan a kolon na di mu fama findide a gbe ra. Na nan a to, e nun a nimɔxɔ na kafu, a a xa maniye sama bɔxi nan ma alako a naxa fa di fi a taara ma.

sentences.english: And what he did was evil in the eyes of the Lord, so that he put him to death, like his brother.
sentences.susu: A nu naxan nabama, na mu nu rafan Alatala ma. Na nan a ra, Ala naxa a ragiri a fan xa faxa.

sentences.english: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, Go back to your father's house and keep yourself as a widow till my son Shelah becomes a man: for he had in his mind the thought that death might come to him as it had come to his brothers. So Tamar went back to her father's house.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yuda naxa a fala a xa mamadi Tamari bɛ, «Kaaɲɛ xanin i baba xɔnyi, beenun n ma di Selaha mɔma tɛmui naxɛ.» A a maɲɔxun nɛ, tɛmunde Selaha fan faxama alɔ a taarae faxaxi ki naxɛ. Na kui Tamari naxa siga, a sa lu a baba xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And after a time, Bath-shua, Judah's wife, came to her end; and after Judah was comforted for her loss, he went to Timnah, where they were cutting the wool of his sheep, and his friend Hirah of Adullam went with him.
sentences.susu: A mu bu Yuda xa ginɛ naxa fa, naxan nu lanxi Suwa xa di ginɛ ma. Ɲɔn fe to ba a ra, Yuda naxa siga Timina e nun a boore Hira Adulamaka. E naxa siga Yuda xa xuruse yire, Yuda xa walikɛe nu xurusee xabe maxabafe dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And when Tamar had news that her father-in-law was going up to Timnah to the wool-cutting,
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa a fala Tamari bɛ, «I tanun na sigafe Timina a xa xurusee xabe maxabade.»

sentences.english: She took off her widow's clothing, and covering herself with her veil, she took her seat near Enaim on the road to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was now a man, but she had not been made his wife.
sentences.susu: Tamari naxa a xa kaaɲɛ donma rate a ma, a naxa a yatagi makoto mafelenyi ra, a sa dɔxɔ Enayima sode dɛ ra Timina kira xɔn. A nu bara a to, Selaha bara a ginɛ dɔxɔde li, kɔnɔ Yuda mu Tamari fi a ma, a xa findi a xa ginɛ ra.

sentences.english: When Judah saw her he took her to be a loose woman of the town, because her face was covered.
sentences.susu: Yuda to bara Tamari to kira dɛ ra, a yatagi makotoxi mafelenyi ra, a naxa a maɲɔxun langoe ra.

sentences.english: And turning to her by the roadside, he said to her, Let me come in to you; for he had no idea that she was his daughter-in-law. And she said, What will you give me as my price?
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a bɛ kira ra, «Won xɛɛ, won xa sa kafu.» A mu nu a kolonxi a xa mamadi nan a ra. Kɔnɔ Tamari naxa Yuda maxɔrin, «I munse fima n ma won na kafu?»

sentences.english: And he said, I will give you a young goat from the flock. And she said, What will you give me as a sign till you send it?
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «N si keren tongoma n ma xurusee ya ma, n fa a ra i xɔn ma.» Tamari naxa a yaabi, «Awa, sɛɛkɛ se nde lu n yi ra be sinden, beenun i fama si ra tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said, What would you have? And she said, Your ring and its cord and the stick in your hand. So he gave them to her and went in to her, and she became with child by him.
sentences.susu: A naxa a maxɔrin, «I wama n xa munse dɔxɔ i xɔn ma sɛɛkɛ ra?» Tamari naxa a yaabi, «I xa i xa tɔnxuma, a luuti, nun i xa yisuxuwuri so n yi ra.» A naxa na see so a yi ra, e fa kafu e boore ra. Tamari naxa tɛɛgɛ a xa di ma.

sentences.english: Then she got up and went away and took off her veil and put on her widow's clothing.
sentences.susu: Tamari naxa gbilen a xɔnyi. A naxa a xa mafelenyi ba a xun ma, a man naxa a kaaɲɛ ginɛ donma ragoro a ma.

sentences.english: Then Judah sent his friend Hirah with the young goat, to get back the things which he had given as a sign to the woman: but she was not there.
sentences.susu: Yuda naxa a boore Adulamaka xɛɛ si tide na ginɛ ma, alako a xa fa see ra a naxan so ginɛ yi ra seedeɲɔxɔya ra. Kɔnɔ a boore mu na ginɛ to.

sentences.english: And he put questions to the men of the place, saying, Where is the loose woman who was in Enaim by the wayside? And they said, There was no such woman there.
sentences.susu: A naxa Enayima mixie maxɔrin, «Yi langoe ginɛ naxan nu na Enayima kira ra, a na minden?» E naxa a yaabi, «Langoe yo mu na be.»

sentences.english: So he went back to Judah, and said, I have not seen her, and the men of the place say that there is no such woman there.
sentences.susu: A naxa gbilen Yuda yire, a fa a fala, «N mu a lixi naa. Na longori mixie bara a fala n bɛ a langoe yo mu na na kira xɔn.»

sentences.english: And Judah said, Let her keep the things, so that we may not be shamed; I sent the young goat, but you did not see the woman.
sentences.susu: Yuda naxa a fala, «Na ginɛ xa na see ragata. Won fan naxa won yɛtɛ rayaagi. N bara si rasanba a ma, kɔnɔ i mu a lixi naa.»

sentences.english: Now about three months after this, word came to Judah that Tamar, his daughter-in-law, had been acting like a loose woman and was with child. And Judah said, Take her out and let her be burned.
sentences.susu: Kike saxan dangi xanbi, mixi nde naxa a fala Yuda bɛ, «I xa mamadi Tamari bara findi langoe ra, a bara furi tongo a xa langoeɲa saabui ra.» Yuda naxa a fala, «Wo a ramini, a xa gan.»

sentences.english: And while she was being taken out, she sent word to her father-in-law, saying, The man whose property these things are, is the father of my child: say then, whose are this ring and this cord and this stick?
sentences.susu: E nu fafe a ra tɛmui naxɛ, Tamari naxa xɛɛra rasanba a tanun ma, «Yi see mato naxan na n yi ra. Yi tɔnxuma, a luuti, nun yi yisuxuwuri findi mixi nan gbe ra naxan n nafuruxi. I lan nɛ i xa yi kanyi kolon.»

sentences.english: Then Judah said openly that they were his, and said, She is more upright than I am, for I did not give her to Shelah my son. And he had no more connection with her.
sentences.susu: Yuda naxa kolon sɔtɔ na see xa fe ma. A naxa a fala, «A bara sɛriyɛ rakamali dangife n tan na barima n mu a fixi n ma di Selaha ma.» Na xanbi, a mu a kolon ginɛ ra sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And when the time came for her to give birth, it was clear that there were two children in her body.
sentences.susu: Tamari nu di barima tɛmui naxɛ, e naxa a kolon a gulie nan na a furi.

sentences.english: And while she was in the act of giving birth, one of them put out his hand; and the woman who was with her put a red thread round his hand, saying, This one came out first.
sentences.susu: Di bari tɛmui, keren naxa a bɛlɛxɛ ramini. Di rasuxui naxa a bɛlɛxɛ suxu, a gɛsɛ gbeeli xiri a bɛlɛxɛ ra. A fa a fala, «Yi nan singe barixi.»

sentences.english: But then he took his hand back again, and his brother came first to birth: and the woman said, What an opening you have made for yourself! So he was named Perez.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na diyɔrɛ naxa a bɛlɛxɛ raso, a xunya naxa bari. Di rasuxui naxa a fala, «I faxi sɛnbɛ mundun na yi ki?» Yuda naxa a xili sa Peresi.

sentences.english: And then his brother came out, with the red thread round his hand, and he was named Zerah.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, boore fan naxa bari gɛsɛ gbeeli xirixi a bɛlɛxɛ ra. Yuda naxa a xili sa Sera.

sentences.english: Now Joseph was taken down to Egypt; and Potiphar the Egyptian, a captain of high position in Pharaoh's house, got him for a price from the Ishmaelites who had taken him there.
sentences.susu: Sumayila bɔnsɔɛe to Yusufu xanin Misira, Misira mangɛ kantamae xunyi Potifari naxa a sara konyi ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord was with Joseph, and he did well; and he was living in the house of his master the Egyptian.
sentences.susu: Alatala nun Yusufu nan nu a ra. Yusufu nu fe naxan birin nabama a xa mangɛ Misiraka xɔnyi, a birin nu fanma nɛ a yi ra.

sentences.english: And his master saw that the Lord was with him, making everything he did go well.
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛ naxa a kolon a Yusufu nun Alatala na a ra, barima Alatala nu fe birin sɔɔnɛyama a bɛ.

sentences.english: And having a high opinion of Joseph as his servant, he made him the overseer of his house and gave him control over all he had.
sentences.susu: Potifari naxa ɲɛlɛxin a ra, a naxa a findi a xa banxi mixie xunyi ra. A naxa a harige birin taxu a ra.

sentences.english: And from the time when he made him overseer and gave him control of all his property, the blessing of the Lord was with the Egyptian, because of Joseph; the blessing of the Lord was on all he had, in the house and in the field.
sentences.susu: Potifari to Yusufu findi a xa banxi nun a harige xunyi ra, Alatala naxa barakɛ sa na Misiraka xa banxi ma Yusufu saabui ra. Alatala naxa barakɛ sa Potifari xa banxi nun a xa xɛe birin ma.

sentences.english: And he gave Joseph control of all his property, keeping no account of anything, but only the food which was put before him. Now Joseph was very beautiful in form and face.
sentences.susu: Na nan a to, Potifari naxa a xa se birin taxu Yusufu ra. A tan mu nu fa a ɲɛngi saxi fefe xɔn ma, fo a nu donse naxan donma. Mixi tofanyi nan nu lanxi Yusufu ma.

sentences.english: And after a time, his master's wife, looking on Joseph with desire, said to him, Be my lover.
sentences.susu: Tɛmui nde to dangi, Yusufu xa mangɛ xa ginɛ ya naxa sin a i. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «Fa be, won xa fa kafu.»

sentences.english: But he would not, and said to her, You see that my master keeps no account of what I do in his house, and has put all his property in my control;
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa tondi, a fa a fala a xa mangɛ xa ginɛ bɛ, «Kafi n naxa fa n ma mangɛ xɔnyi a mu a ɲɛngi saxi fefe xɔn ma kɔrɛ a xa banxi kui. A bara a harige birin taxu n na.

sentences.english: So that no one has more authority in this house than I have; he has kept nothing back from me but you, because you are his wife; how then may I do this great wrong, sinning against God?
sentences.susu: A xa banxi kui be, n tan nan dangi mixi birin na. A mu sese rafisaxi n bɛ, fo i keren, ba i tan bara findi a xa ginɛ ra. Yakɔsi, n fe ɲaaxi rabama munfe ra naxan findi yunubi fe ra Ala bɛ?»

sentences.english: And day after day she went on requesting Joseph to come to her and be her lover, but he would not give ear to her.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na ginɛ naxa bira Yusufu xa fe dalili fɔxɔ ra. A nu a makatama lɔxɔɛ birin, kɔnɔ Yusufu naxa tondi e xa kafu.

sentences.english: Now one day he went into the house to do his work; and not one of the men of the house was inside.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Yusufu naxa so banxi kui a xa wali rabade. Konyi gbɛtɛ yo mu nu na banxi kui na tɛmui.

sentences.english: And pulling at his coat, she said, Come to my bed; but slipping out of his coat, he went running away.
sentences.susu: Potifari xa ginɛ naxa a suxu a xa donma ma. A nu fa a fala a bɛ, «Won kafu!» Ginɛ to Yusufu xa donma suxu, Yusufu naxa mini a xa donma kui a a lu ginɛ bɛlɛxɛ, a mini a gi ra tande.

sentences.english: And when she saw that he had got away, letting her keep his coat,
sentences.susu: Ginɛ to bara a kolon a bara a gi, a xa donma lu a yi ra, a naxa mini tande,

sentences.english: She sent for the men of her house and said to them, See, he has let a Hebrew come here and make sport of us; he came to my bed, and I gave a loud cry;
sentences.susu: a naxa a xa banxi konyie xili, a fa na donma masen e bɛ, «Wo yi to, n ma xɛmɛ faxi Eburu naxan na, na nan wama won mayanfafe kɔɔta ra. A faxi nɛ n yire a muxu xa muxu sa, kɔnɔ n naxa sɔnxɔɛ rate.

sentences.english: And hearing it he went running out without his coat.
sentences.susu: Kabi n bara sɔnxɔɛ rate, a naxa a gi, a xa donma lu n yi ra. A naxa mini a gi ra tande.»

sentences.english: And she kept his coat by her, till his master came back.
sentences.susu: Potifari xa ginɛ naxa Yusufu xa donma ragata han beenun a xa mangɛ so tɛmui.

sentences.english: Then she gave him the same story, saying, The Hebrew servant whom you have taken into our house came in to make sport of me;
sentences.susu: A naxa na fe tagi raba a bɛ, a naxɛ, «I faxi Eburu konyi xɛmɛ naxan na yi ki, a faxi nɛ a xa n mayanfa kɔɔta ra.

sentences.english: And when I gave a loud cry he went running out without his coat.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n to sɔnxɔɛ rate, a naxa a xa donma lu n yi ra, a naxa mini a gi ra tande.

sentences.english: And hearing his wife's account of what his servant had done, he became very angry.
sentences.susu: I xa konyi na nan nabaxi n na.» Yusufu xa mangɛ to a xa ginɛ xa wɔyɛnyi mɛ,

sentences.english: And Joseph's master took him and put him in prison, in the place where the king's prisoners were kept in chains, and he was there in the prison-house.
sentences.susu: a bɔɲɛ naxa te a ɲaaxi ra. A naxa Yusufu balan mangɛ xa geelimanie nu na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: But the Lord was with Joseph, and was good to him, and made the keeper of the prison his friend.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mɛnni fan, Alatala mɛɛni nɛ a ma. A naxa a ragiri Yusufu nun geeli mangɛ dɛ xa fan.

sentences.english: And the keeper of the prison put all the prisoners under Joseph's control, and he was responsible for whatever was done there.
