sentences.susu: Geeli mangɛ naxa geelimanie taxu Yusufu ra. Fe naxan birin nu rabama, a nu dangima a tan nan ma.

sentences.english: And the keeper of the prison gave no attention to anything which was under his care, because the Lord was with him; and the Lord made everything he did go well.
sentences.susu: Geeli mangɛ mu nu Yusufu xa wali xun matoma a ra, barima Alatala nun Yusufu birin na a ra. Alatala nu fe birin sɔɔnɛyama Yusufu bɛ.

sentences.english: Now after these things the chief servant who had the care of the wine, and the chief bread-maker in Pharaoh's house, did something against Pharaoh's orders;
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi Misira mangɛ xa walikɛ naxan a ɲɛngi saxi a xa minse xɔn ma, a nun a xa taamiganyi naxa fe nde raba naxan mu rafanxi e xa mangɛ ma.

sentences.english: And Pharaoh was angry with his two servants, with the chief wine-servant and the chief bread-maker;
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa xɔnɔ na walikɛ firinyie ma, naxan ɲɛngi sama a xa minse xɔn ma a nun naxan a xa taami ganma.

sentences.english: And he put them in prison under the care of the captain of the army, in the same prison where Joseph himself was shut up.
sentences.susu: A naxa e suxu, e balan sɔɔri mangɛ xa geeli kui, Yusufu nu na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And the captain put them in Joseph's care, and he did what was needed for them; and they were kept in prison for some time.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔrie xa mangɛ naxa e taxu Yusufu ra, a xa mɛɛni e ma. E to saxanyi raba geeli kui,

sentences.english: And these two had a dream on the same night; the chief wine-servant and the chief bread-maker of the king of Egypt, who were in prison, the two of them had dreams with a special sense.
sentences.susu: naxan ɲɛngi sama mangɛ xa minse xɔn ma, a nun naxan taami ganma mangɛ bɛ, nee naxa xiye sa geeli kui kɔɛ keren na. Kankan xa xiye nu wama fe nde nan masenfe a kanyi bɛ.

sentences.english: And in the morning when Joseph came to them he saw that they were looking sad.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba Yusufu naxa fa e yire, a naxa e li sunnunyi kui.

sentences.english: And he said to the servants of Pharaoh who were in prison with him, Why are you looking so sad?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a naxa na Misira mangɛ xa walikɛ firinyie maxɔrin, naxee taxuxi a ra, «Munfe ra wo sunnunxi to?»

sentences.english: Then they said to him, We have had a dream, and no one is able to give us the sense. And Joseph said, Does not the sense of dreams come from God? what was your dream?
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Muxu bara xiye ndee nan sa, kɔnɔ mixi yo mu na be naxan nɔma na fasaride.» Yusufu naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo mu a kolon Ala nɔma a fasaride wo bɛ? Wo xiye fala n bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then the chief wine-servant gave Joseph an account of his dream, and said, In my dream I saw a vine before me;
sentences.susu: Naxan ɲɛngi nu sama mangɛ xa minse xɔn ma, a naxa a xiye fala Yusufu bɛ. A naxɛ, «N tan ma xiye kui, n wɛni bili nan to a tixi n ya i.

sentences.english: And on the vine were three branches; and it seemed as if it put out buds and flowers, and from them came grapes ready for cutting.
sentences.susu: Salon saxan na a bili ma. A to fuga, a fuge naxa wɛni bogi mɔxie ramini.

sentences.english: And Pharaoh's cup was in my hand, and I took the grapes and crushing them into Pharaoh's cup, gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ xa wɛni sase suxuxi n yi ra. N naxa na wɛni bogi mɔxie ba, n naxa e bundu Misira mangɛ xa wɛni sase kui, n fa a so a yi ra.»

sentences.english: Then Joseph said, This is the sense of your dream: the three branches are three days;
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a fala a bɛ, «Yi xiye yi nan fasarixi: Na salonyi saxan naxan na ki, a xi saxan nan masenxi.

sentences.english: After three days Pharaoh will give you honour, and put you back into your place, and you will give him his cup as you did before, when you were his wine-servant.
sentences.susu: Xi saxan dangi xanbi, Misira mangɛ i xun nakelima nɛ, a man fa i ragbilen i walide fori. I man fama nɛ wɛni tɔnbili sode Misira mangɛ yi ra alɔ i darixi a ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But keep me in mind when things go well for you, and be good to me and say a good word for me to Pharaoh and get me out of this prison:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i naxa nɛɛmu n ma i na hɛɛri sɔtɔ tɛmui naxɛ. I xa findi saabui ra n bɛ, i xa n ma fe fala Misira mangɛ bɛ alako n xa mini geeli kui,

sentences.english: For truly I was taken by force from the land of the Hebrews; and I have done nothing for which I might be put in prison.
sentences.susu: barima e n tongoxi nɔɛ nan na Eburu bɔxi ma. Be fan, n mu fefe rabaxi naxan a niyama n xa geeli sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: Now when the chief bread-maker saw that the first dream had a good sense, he said to Joseph, I had a dream; and in my dream there were three baskets of white bread on my head;
sentences.susu: Naxan taami ganma mangɛ bɛ, a to bara a to Yusufu wɔyɛnyi naxan tagi rabaxi a boore bɛ, a fanxi a bɛ, a naxa a fala Yusufu bɛ, «N tan fan xiye nde saxi. Debe saxan dɔxɔxi n xun ma, taami fiixɛ na e kui.

sentences.english: And in the top basket were all sorts of cooked meats for Pharaoh; and the birds were taking them out of the baskets on my head.
sentences.susu: Debe naxan dɔxɔxi a fari, taamiganyi donse naxan birin nafalama Misira mangɛ bɛ, a birin nu na a kui. Kɔnɔ xɔnie nu fa na donse masakun naxan dɔxɔxi n xun ma.»

sentences.english: Then Joseph said, This is the sense of your dream: the three baskets are three days;
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a masen a bɛ, «I xa xiye yi nan fasarixi: Na debe saxanyi naxan na ki, a xi saxan nan masenxi.

sentences.english: After three days Pharaoh will take you out of prison, hanging you on a tree, so that your flesh will be food for birds.
sentences.susu: Xi saxan dangi xanbi, Misira mangɛ i xunyi bolonma nɛ a dɛ i. A i gbakuma nɛ wuri ma, xɔnie i sube masakun.»

sentences.english: Now the third day was Pharaoh's birthday, and he gave a feast for all his servants; and he gave honour to the chief wine-servant and the chief bread-maker among the others.
sentences.susu: Xi saxan lɔxɔɛ, Misira mangɛ bari lɔxɔɛ, mangɛ naxa xulunyi belebele ti a xa walikɛe bɛ. Naxan ɲɛngi sama mangɛ xa minse xɔn ma, a nun a xa taamiganyi, Misira mangɛ naxa e xun nakeli walikɛe tagi.

sentences.english: And he put the chief wine-servant back in his old place; and he gave the cup into Pharaoh's hand.
sentences.susu: Naxan ɲɛngi sama minse xɔn ma, a naxa a ragbilen a walide fori, alako a man xa minse so a yi ra.

sentences.english: But the chief bread-maker was put to death by hanging, as Joseph had said.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a naxa a xa taamiganyi gbaku wuri ma alɔ Yusufu nu bara a tagi raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But the wine-servant did not keep Joseph in mind or give a thought to him.
sentences.susu: Naxan ɲɛngi sama mangɛ xa minse xa fe xɔn ma, a mu ratu Yusufu xa fe ma, a nɛɛmu a ma.

sentences.english: Now after two years had gone by, Pharaoh had a dream; and in his dream he was by the side of the Nile;
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ firin dangi xanbi, Misira mangɛ naxa xiye nde sa. Na xiye kui a tixi xure dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And out of the Nile came seven cows, good-looking and fat, and their food was the river-grass.
sentences.susu: A naxa ninge fate fanyi solofere to mini ra xure kui, e na ɲooge donfe kalee tagi.

sentences.english: And after them seven other cows came out of the Nile, poor-looking and thin; and they were by the side of the other cows.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, ninge solofere gbɛtɛ, naxee xɔsixi, nee naxa mini xure dɛ ra boore ningee sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And the seven thin cows made a meal of the seven fat cows. Then Pharaoh came out of his sleep.
sentences.susu: Yi ninge xɔsixi solofere naxa yi ninge fate fanyi solofere don. Na nan lan Misira mangɛ naxa xunu.

sentences.english: But he went to sleep again and had a second dream, in which he saw seven heads of grain, full and good, all on one stem.
sentences.susu: A to gbilen a sa ra, a man naxa xiye gbɛtɛ sa.

sentences.english: And after them came up seven other heads, thin and wasted by the east wind.
sentences.susu: Na xiye kui tɔnsɔɛ solofere fanyi tixi bili keren ma.

sentences.english: And the seven thin heads made a meal of the good heads. And when Pharaoh was awake he saw it was a dream.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, tɔnsɔɛ solofere gbɛtɛ, naxee xun xurun, foye bara e ragan, e tixi boore tɔnsɔɛe sɛɛti ma. Yi tɔnsɔɛ xunxurie naxa yi tɔnsɔɛ rafexi fanyie don. Na nan lan, Misira mangɛ naxa xunu. Na xiye nan na ki.

sentences.english: And in the morning his spirit was troubled; and he sent for all the wise men of Egypt and all the holy men, and put his dream before them, but no one was able to give him the sense of it.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Misira mangɛ bɔɲɛ nu minixi. A naxa mandurulae nun karamɔxɔɛ birin xili. A naxa na xiyee masen e bɛ, kɔnɔ mixi yo mu sɔtɔ e ya ma, naxan nɔ a tagi rabade a bɛ.

sentences.english: Then the chief wine-servant said to Pharaoh, The memory of my sin comes back to me now;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui naxan a ɲɛngi sama mangɛ xa minse xɔn ma, na naxa wɔyɛnyi tongo a fa a fala Misira mangɛ bɛ, «N nan ma kanari ya xaranma nɛ to lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: Pharaoh had been angry with his servants, and had put me in prison in the house of the captain of the army, together with the chief bread-maker;
sentences.susu: Tɛmui dangixi, Misira mangɛ xɔnɔ nɛ a xa konyie ma. A naxa n suxu, a n balan sɔɔri mangɛ xa geeli kui, a nun naxan taami ganma mangɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: And we had a dream on the same night, the two of us, and the dreams had a special sense.
sentences.susu: A tan nun n tan, muxu birin xiye sa nɛ kɔɛ keren kui naxan tagi lan a xa raba. Kankan xa xiye nu wama fe nde masenfe a kanyi bɛ.

sentences.english: And there was with us a young Hebrew, the captain's servant, and when we put our dreams before him, he gave us the sense of them.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri mangɛ xa Eburu konyi nde nan nu na geeli kui muxu ya ma. Muxu to na xiyee fala a bɛ, a naxa e birin fasari muxu bɛ. Muxu xiye naxee saxi, a naxa kankan gbe fasari a bɛ.

sentences.english: And it came about as he said: I was put back in my place, and the bread-maker was put to death by hanging.
sentences.susu: A birin dangi nɛ alɔ a xiye tagi raba muxu bɛ ki naxɛ. Misira mangɛ bara n tan nagbilen n walide fori, kɔnɔ a bara boore gbaku wuri ma.»

sentences.english: Then Pharaoh sent for Joseph, and they took him quickly out of prison; and when his hair had been cut and his dress changed, he came before Pharaoh.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Yusufu yire. E naxa a ramini geeli kui a ikɔrɛxi ra. E naxa a xunyi bi, e sose gbɛtɛe ragoro a ma, e siga a ra Misira mangɛ yire.

sentences.english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, I have had a dream, and no one is able to give me the sense of it; now it has come to my ears that you are able to give the sense of a dream when it is put before you.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa a masen Yusufu bɛ, «N bara xiye nde sa. Mixi yo mu nɔxi a tagi rabade, kɔnɔ n bara a mɛ i tan xiye tagi rabama e na naxan fala i bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Joseph said, Without God there will be no answer of peace for Pharaoh.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa Misira mangɛ yaabi, «N tan mu a ra. Ala nan Misira mangɛ xa xiye tagi rabama a bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Pharaoh said, In my dream I was by the side of the Nile:
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa a masen Yusufu bɛ, «N ma xiye kui n tixi xure dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And out of the Nile came seven cows, fat and good-looking, and their food was the river-grass;
sentences.susu: N naxa ninge fate fanyi solofere to mini ra xure kui, e na ɲooge donfe kalee longori ra.

sentences.english: Then after them came seven other cows, very thin and poor-looking, worse than any I ever saw in the land of Egypt;
sentences.susu: Na nan lan, ninge solofere gbɛtɛ naxa te e xanbi ra, e xɔsixi han. E ganyanxɔri birin saxi kɛnɛ ma. Han to n mu na ninge xɔsixi mɔɔli to Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the thin cows made a meal of the seven fat cows who came up first;
sentences.susu: Na ninge xɔsixi xun nakanaxie naxa na ninge solofere fate fanyi don.

sentences.english: And even with the fat cows inside them they seemed as bad as before. And so I came out of my sleep.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na dangi xanbi, mixi yo mu nɔ a kolonde xa e bara e don. E xa xɔsi mu masara. Na nan lan, n naxa xunu.»

sentences.english: And again in a dream I saw seven heads of grain, full and good, coming up on one stem:
sentences.susu: «Na tɛmui n man naxa xiye gbɛtɛ sa. Tɔnsɔɛ rafexi fanyi solofere tixi bili keren ma.

sentences.english: And then I saw seven other heads, dry, thin, and wasted by the east wind, coming up after them:
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi tɔnsɔɛ xunxuri solofere gbɛtɛ, foye naxee raganxi, nee naxa mini booree sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And the seven thin heads made a meal of the seven good heads; and I put this dream before the wise men, but not one of them was able to give me the sense of it.
sentences.susu: Tɔnsɔɛ ponpoee naxa na tɔnsɔɛ solofere fanyi don. N bara na fala mandurulae bɛ, kɔnɔ mixi yo mu nɔ a fasaride n bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Joseph said, These two dreams have the same sense: God has made clear to Pharaoh what he is about to do.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a fala Misira mangɛ bɛ, «I xa xiye firinyi birin fe keren nan masenxi. Ala bara i rakolon fe ma a fama naxan nabade.

sentences.english: The seven fat cows are seven years, and the seven good heads of grain are seven years: the two have the same sense.
sentences.susu: Na ninge solofere fanyie nun na tɔnsɔɛ solofere fanyie, ɲɛ solofere nan masenxi na ki. Na tan xiye keren nan a ra.

sentences.english: The seven thin and poor-looking cows who came up after them are seven years; and the seven heads of grain, dry and wasted by the east wind, are seven years when there will be no food.
sentences.susu: Na ninge xɔsixi xun nakanaxi solofere nun na tɔnsɔɛ ponpoe solofere foye naxee raganxi, nee fan ɲɛ solofere kaamɛ nan masenxi.»

sentences.english: As I said to Pharaoh before, God has made clear to him what he is about to do.
sentences.susu: «N xa nɔndi fala i bɛ, Ala bara fe masen Misira mangɛ bɛ a fama naxan nabade.

sentences.english: Seven years are coming in which there will be great wealth of grain in Egypt;
sentences.susu: Yi ɲɛ solofere naxan fafe yi ki, e findima ɲɛ fanyi nan na Misira bɔxi bɛ.

sentences.english: And after that will come seven years when there will not be enough food; and the memory of the good years will go from men's minds; and the land will be made waste by the bad years;
sentences.susu: Na na dangi, kaamɛ ɲɛ solofere gbɛtɛ fama fade, won nɛɛmuma nɛ na fe fanyi birin na. Kaamɛ bɔxi halakima nɛ.

sentences.english: And men will have no memory of the good time because of the need which will come after, for it will be very bitter.
sentences.susu: Na findima fe magaaxuxi nan na, a lu alɔ sese fanyi mu nu raba yi bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And this dream came to Pharaoh twice, because this thing is certain, and God will quickly make it come about.
sentences.susu: «I yi xiye saxi nɛ dɔxɔ firin, barima Ala xa natɛ na a ra naxan mu kanama, a man mu buma a xa raba.

sentences.english: And now let Pharaoh make search for a man of wisdom and good sense, and put him in authority over the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ, yakɔsi a lanma i xa xaxilima fen naxan lɔnnixi. I xa Misira nɔɛ so na kanyi yi ra.

sentences.english: Let Pharaoh do this, and let him put overseers over the land of Egypt to put in store a fifth part of the produce of the land in the good years.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ, i xa mixie sugandi naxee ɲɛngi fama sade bɔxi rawali xɔn ma yi ɲɛ fanyi solofere bun ma. Bɔxi daxamui busali suuli yo suuli, e xa fa keren na mangɛ xɔn ma, a xa a ragata.

sentences.english: And let them get together all the food in those good years and make a store of grain under Pharaoh's control for the use of the towns, and let them keep it.
sentences.susu: E xa donse birin malan, e xa a ragata taae kui Misira mangɛ xa nɔɛ bun ma.

sentences.english: And let that food be kept in store for the land till the seven bad years which are to come in Egypt; so that the land may not come to destruction through need of food.
sentences.susu: Yi donse ragataxi fama Misira bɔxi ratangade kaamɛ ma, naxan fama fade ɲɛ solofere bun.»

sentences.english: And this seemed good to Pharaoh and to all his servants.
sentences.susu: Na wɔyɛnyi naxa rafan Misira mangɛ nun a xa mixi birin ma.

sentences.english: Then Pharaoh said to his servants, Where may we get such a man as this, a man in whom is the spirit of God?
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa a fala e bɛ, «Won nɔma mixi nde sɔtɔde naxan luma alɔ yi xɛmɛ? Ala Xaxili na a bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Seeing that God has made all this clear to you, there is no other man of such wisdom and good sense as you:
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa a fala Yusufu bɛ, «Ala bara na fe birin masen i bɛ. Mixi yo mu na naxan xaxili fan alɔ i tan, a xa lɔnni man xa dangi i gbe ra.

sentences.english: You, then, are to be over my house, and all my people will be ruled by your word: only as king will I be greater than you.
sentences.susu: I tan nan fama findide n ma banxi xunyi ra. N ma ɲama fama birade i xa yaamari nan fɔxɔ ra. N ma mangɛ kibanyi nan tun n nadangixi i ra.»

sentences.english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, See, I have put you over all the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ man naxa a fala Yusufu bɛ, «A mato, n bara nɔɛ so i yi ra Misira bɔxi birin ma.»

sentences.english: Then Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand and put it on Joseph's hand, and he had him clothed with the best linen, and put a chain of gold round his neck;
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa gbeti xurundɛ ba a bɛlɛxɛ ra, a naxa a so Yusufu bɛlɛxɛ ra. A naxa sose fanyi ragoro a ma. A naxa kɔnmagore xɛɛma daaxi ragoro a kɔn ma.

sentences.english: And he made him take his seat in the second of his carriages; and they went before him crying, Make way! So he made him ruler over all the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: A naxa a rate gise kui, naxan birama Misira mangɛ ragise fɔxɔ ra. Sɔɔrie nu fa a fala e xui itexi ra ɲama bɛ, «Wo xinbi sin!» Misira mangɛ a xa mangɛya taxu Yusufu ra na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Then Pharaoh said to Joseph, I am Pharaoh; and without your order no man may do anything in all the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ man naxa a fala Yusufu bɛ, «N tan nan mangɛ ra, kɔnɔ xa i mu yaamari fi naxan ma, fefe mu rabama Misira bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And Pharaoh gave Joseph the name of Zaphnath-paaneah; and he gave him Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera, the priest of On, to be his wife. So Joseph went through all the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa Yusufu xili sa Safanati Paneya. A naxa Potifera, On sɛrɛxɛdubɛ, xa di ginɛ Asana, fi a ma. Yusufu naxa Misira bɔxi xun mato fɔlɔ a ra.

sentences.english: Now Joseph was thirty years old when he came before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from before the face of Pharaoh and went through all the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Yusufu simaya nu bara ɲɛ tongo saxan li, a fa Misira mangɛ yire tɛmui naxɛ. Na tɛmui Yusufu naxa keli Misira mangɛ yire, a sa Misira bɔxi birin iɲɛrɛ.

sentences.english: Now in the seven good years the earth gave fruit in masses.
sentences.susu: Na ɲɛ solofere fanyi kui, bɔxi birin naxa rawali.

sentences.english: And Joseph got together all the food of those seven years, and made a store of food in the towns: the produce of the fields round every town was stored up in the town.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa donse birin malan naxan sɔtɔxi na ɲɛ solofere bun ma Misira bɔxi ma. A naxa donse ragata taae kui naxan sɔtɔxi daaxa.

sentences.english: So he got together a store of grain like the sand of the sea; so great a store that after a time he gave up measuring it, for it might not be measured.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa donse xɔri gbegbe malan, alɔ mɛyɛnyi naxan na baa dɛ ra. A naxa gbo yɛ han a mu na xasabi sɛbɛ sɔnɔn, barima mixi yo mu nɔma a kɔnti kolonde.

sentences.english: And before the time of need, Joseph had two sons, to whom Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera, priest of On, gave birth.
sentences.susu: Beenun kaamɛ ɲɛ sin tɛmui, Yusufu xa ginɛ Asana, On sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Potifari xa di ginɛ, naxa di firin bari a bɛ.

sentences.english: And to the first he gave the name Manasseh, for he said, God has taken away from me all memory of my hard life and of my father's house.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a xa di singe xili sa Manasi. Na nan na ki, Ala bara a niya n bara nɛɛmu n ma tɔɔrɛ birin ma, a nun n baba xa denbaya.

sentences.english: And to the second he gave the name Ephraim, for he said, God has given me fruit in the land of my sorrow.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa di firin nde xili sa Efirami. Na nan na ki, Ala bara n findi di bari ra bɔxi ma n xun nu goroxi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And so the seven good years in Egypt came to an end.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ fanyi solofere naxa dangi Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Then came the first of the seven years of need as Joseph had said: and in every other land they were short of food; but in the land of Egypt there was bread.
sentences.susu: Kaamɛ ɲɛ solofere naxa a li fɔlɔ, alɔ Yusufu a tagi raba ki naxɛ. Kaamɛ naxa din duniɲa birin na, kɔnɔ baloe nu na Misira bɔxi tan ma.

sentences.english: And when all the land of Egypt was in need of food, the people came crying to Pharaoh for bread; and Pharaoh said to the people, Go to Joseph, and whatever he says to you, do it.
sentences.susu: Kaamɛ to bara Misira bɔxi birin suxu, ɲama naxa sɔnxɔɛ rate Misira mangɛ ma baloe fe ra. Misira mangɛ naxa a fala Misirakae birin bɛ, «Wo siga a fala Yusufu bɛ, a na fe naxan fala wo bɛ, wo xa na raba.»

sentences.english: And everywhere on the earth they were short of food; then Joseph, opening all his store-houses, gave the people of Egypt grain for money; so great was the need of food in the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Kaamɛ naxa din bɔxi birin na. Yusufu naxa donse malandee rabi, a naxa mɛngi sara Misirakae ma, barima kaamɛ nu bara sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ Misira bɔxi birin ma.

sentences.english: And all lands sent to Egypt, to Joseph, to get grain, for the need was great over all the earth.
sentences.susu: Mixie nu fa keli yire birin, fafe mɛngi sarade Yusufu ma, barima kaamɛ nu bara sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ duniɲa birin ma.

sentences.english: Now Jacob, hearing that there was grain in Egypt, said to his sons, Why are you looking at one another?
sentences.susu: Yaxuba to bara a mɛ a mɛngi na Misira, a naxa a fala a xa die bɛ, «Wo dɔxɔxi munfe ra?

sentences.english: And he said, I have had news that there is grain in Egypt: go down there and get grain for us, so that life and not death may be ours.
sentences.susu: N bara a mɛ a mɛngi na Misira. Wo goro, wo sa mɛngi sara won bɛ alako won xa balo, won naxa fa faxa.»

sentences.english: So Joseph's ten brothers went down to get grain from Egypt.
sentences.susu: Yusufu taara mixi fu naxa goro donse xɔri sarade Misira.

sentences.english: But Jacob did not send Benjamin, Joseph's brother, with them, for fear, as he said, that some evil might come to him.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba mu tin Bunyamin, Yusufu xunya, xa bira e fɔxɔ ra. A nu fa a fala, «N bara gaaxu fe ɲaaxi naxa fa a sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: And the sons of Israel came with all the others to get grain: for they were very short of food in the land of Canaan.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa die naxa siga mɛngi sarade, e nun mixi gbɛtɛe ra naxee fan nu waxi mɛngi xɔn, barima kaamɛ nu bara din Kanaan bɔxi birin na.

sentences.english: Now Joseph was ruler over all the land, and it was he who gave out the grain to all the people of the land; and Joseph's brothers came before him and went down on their faces to the earth.
sentences.susu: Yusufu nan nu findixi mangɛ xungbe ra Misira. A tan nan nu mɛngi sarama mixi birin ma. Yusufu taarae naxa fa, e e yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma a ya i.

sentences.english: And when Joseph saw his brothers, it was clear to him who they were, but he made himself strange to them, and talking roughly to them, said, Where do you come from? And they said, From the land of Canaan, to get food.
sentences.susu: Yusufu to a taarae to, a naxa e kolon, kɔnɔ a naxa a yɛtɛ rasan e ma. A naxa wɔyɛn e bɛ a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra, «Wo kelixi minden?» E naxa a yaabi, «Muxu kelixi Kanaan bɔxi nan ma, fafe donse sarade.»

sentences.english: Now though Joseph saw that these were his brothers, they had no idea who he was.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a taarae kolon, kɔnɔ e tan mu kolon sɔtɔ a xa fe ma.

sentences.english: Then the memory of his dreams about them came back to Joseph, and he said to them, You have come secretly to see how poor the land is.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa ratu a xa xiye ma, a naxan sa a taarae xa fe ra. A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Bɔxi rabɛnyie nan na wo ra. Wo faxi yi bɔxi kobidee nan kolonde.»

sentences.english: And they said to him, Not so, my lord: your servants have come with money to get food.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Ade. Mangɛ, muxu faxi donse na tun sarade.

sentences.english: We are all one man's sons, we are true men; we have not come with any secret purpose.
sentences.susu: Muxu birin, xɛmɛ keren xa die nan lanxi muxu ma. Mixi matinxinxie nan na muxu ra. Muxu na i xa yaamari bun ma, muxu mu findixi bɔxi rabɛnyie xa ra.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, No, but you have come to see how poor the land is.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wule na a ra. Wo faxi bɔxi kobidee nan fende.»

sentences.english: Then they said, We your servants are twelve brothers, sons of one man in the land of Canaan; the youngest of us is now with our father, and one is dead.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Muxu tan luxi alɔ i xa konyie. Muxu di fu nun firin nan a ra. Mixi keren ma die nan na muxu birin na Kanaan bɔxi ma. Muxu birin xunya na muxu baba yire, di keren tan bara laaxira.»

sentences.english: And Joseph said, It is as I said; you have come with some secret purpose;
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a fala e bɛ, «N a kolon a bɔxi rabɛnyie nan na wo ra.

sentences.english: But in this way will you be put to the test: by the life of Pharaoh, you will not go away from this place till your youngest brother comes here.
sentences.susu: N wo matoma yi nan ma. Misira mangɛ xili ra, wo mu kelima be danmi wo xunya mu fa.

sentences.english: Send one of your number to get your brother, and the rest of you will be kept in prison, so that your words may be tested to see if you are true; if not, by the life of Pharaoh, your purpose is certainly secret.
sentences.susu: Wo mixi nde xɛɛ wo ya ma a xa sa fa wo xunya ra. Wo tan dɔnxɔɛe soma geeli nɛ. N fama wo xa wɔyɛnyi matode, n xa a kolon xa wo nɔndi falama, xa na mu Misira mangɛ xili ra, bɔxi rabɛnyie nan na wo ra.»

sentences.english: So he put them in prison for three days.
sentences.susu: A naxa e birin makankan han xi saxan.

sentences.english: And on the third day Joseph said to them, Do this, if you would keep your lives: for I am a god-fearing man:
sentences.susu: Xi saxan lɔxɔɛ, Yusufu naxa a fala e bɛ, «Xa wo bara n xui suxu, wo mu faxama, barima n gaaxuma Ala ya ra.

sentences.english: If you are true men, let one of you be kept in prison, while you go and take grain for the needs of your families;
sentences.susu: Xa mixi matinxinxie nan wo ra, wo mixi keren lu geeli kui, booree xa donse xanin wo xa denbayae xɔn ma, barima e na tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: And come back to me with your youngest brother, so that your words may be seen to be true, and you will not be put to death. This is what you are to do.
sentences.susu: Wo xa fa wo xunya ra n xɔn ma alako n xa a kolon xa nɔndi falɛe nan wo ra, na nan a toma wo mu faxama.»

sentences.english: And they said to one another, Truly, we did wrong to our brother, for we saw his grief of mind, and we did not give ear to his prayers; that is why this trouble has come on us.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, e nu fa a fala e boore bɛ, «Iyo won tan nan yati fɔxi na won yɛtɛ ma, barima won na won xunya xa yamaɲɔxunyi to nɛ. A naxa won mayandi, kɔnɔ won ɲan mu a danxun. Na fe nan a toxi won na yi tɔɔrɛ kui.»

sentences.english: And Reuben said to them, Did I not say to you, Do the child no wrong? but you gave no attention; so now, punishment has come on us for his blood.
sentences.susu: Ruben to wɔyɛnyi tongo, a naxa a fala e bɛ, «N na a fala nɛ wo bɛ, wo naxa gbaloe fe raba na dimɛdi ra. Kɔnɔ wo mu tin wo tuli matide n na. Yakɔsi a haakɛ nan won bɔnbɔfe yi ki.»

sentences.english: They were not conscious that the sense of their words was clear to Joseph, for he had been talking to them through one who had knowledge of their language.
sentences.susu: E mu nu a kolonxi a Yusufu e xa xui mɛma, barima xui madangi nu na e tagi.

sentences.english: And turning away from them, he was overcome with weeping; then he went on talking to them again and took Simeon and put chains on him before their eyes.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a makuya e ra, a nu fa wa. Na dangi xanbi, a naxa fa wɔyɛnde e bɛ. A naxa Simeyɔn tongo e ya ma, a a sa geeli e ya xɔri.

sentences.english: Then Joseph gave orders for their bags to be made full of grain, and for every man's money to be put back into his bag, and for food to be given them for the journey: which was done.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa yaamari fi a xa walikɛe ma, e xa e xa bɛkie rafe donse xɔri ra, e xa e xa kɔbiri fan sa kankan xa bɛkie kui a nun e fandɛ. Na naxa raba e bɛ.

sentences.english: Then they put the bags of grain on their asses and went away.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yusufu xa taarae naxa e xa mɛngi kote sa sofalee fari, e naxa siga.

sentences.english: Now at their night's resting-place one of them, opening his bag to give his ass some food, saw his money in the mouth of the bag.
sentences.susu: E to xide li, keren naxa a xa bɛki rabi alako a xa donse xɔri so a xa sofale yi ra. A naxa a xa kɔbiri to a xa bɛki kui.

sentences.english: And he said to his brothers, My money has been given back: it is in my bag; then their hearts became full of fear, and turning to one another they said, What is this which God has done to us?
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a taarae bɛ, «E bara n ma kɔbiri ragbilen n ma. A tan nan na n ma bɛki kui yi ki.» E bɔɲɛe naxa mini. E nu fa e boore maxɔrin kɔntɔfili kui, «Ala munse rabaxi won na yi ki?»

sentences.english: So when they came to Jacob their father, in the land of Canaan, they gave him an account of all their experiences, saying,
sentences.susu: E to so e baba Yaxuba yire Kanaan bɔxi ma, e naxa na birin dɛntɛgɛ a bɛ.

sentences.english: The man who is the ruler of the country was rough with us and put us in prison, saying that we had come with a secret evil purpose.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala, «Xɛmɛ naxan na na bɔxi mangɛ ra, a wɔyɛnxi nɛ muxu bɛ a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra. A man fa muxu findi mixie ra naxee faxi a xa bɔxi rabɛnde.

sentences.english: And we said to him, We are true men, we have no evil designs;
sentences.susu: Muxu naxa a fala a bɛ, ‹Mixi matinxinxie nan na muxu ra, bɔxi rabɛnyie xa mu lanxi muxu ma.

sentences.english: We are twelve brothers, sons of our father; one is dead, and the youngest is now with our father in the land of Canaan.
sentences.susu: Muxu di fu nun firin na a ra, muxu birin baba keren. Keren bara laaxira, muxu xunya na muxu baba fɛ ma Kanaan bɔxi ma.›

sentences.english: And the ruler of the land said, In this way I may be certain that you are true men; let one of you be kept here with me, while you go and take grain for the needs of your families;
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ naxan na na bɔxi mangɛ ra, a falaxi nɛ muxu bɛ, ‹N wama a kolonfe nɛ xa mixi matinxinxie nan na wo ra. Wo mixi keren lu n yire be. Wo mɛngi xanin wo xa mixie xɔn, barima kaamɛ na e ma. Wo siga,

sentences.english: And come back to me with your youngest brother: then I will be certain that you are true men, and I will give your brother back to you and let you do trade in the land.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ wo man xa fa wo xunya ra n xɔn ma. N fama a kolonde na nan ma mixi matinxinxie nan wo ra, bɔxi rabɛnyie mu wo ra. Na tɛmui, n wo xunya soma wo yi ra, wo man fa yulɛya raba n ma bɔxi kui.›»

sentences.english: And when they took the grain out of their bags, it was seen that every man's parcel of money was in his bag; and when they and their father saw the money, they were full of fear.
sentences.susu: E to e xa bɛkie ibagan, kankan naxa a xa kɔbiri to a xa bɛki kui. E tan nun e baba to na kɔbiri to, e birin naxa gaaxu.

sentences.english: And Jacob their father said to them, You have taken my children from me: Joseph is gone and Simeon is gone, and now you would take Benjamin away; all these things have come on me.
sentences.susu: E baba Yaxuba naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo bara n nagan n ma die ra. Yusufu mu na fa, Simeyɔn fan mu na. Wo man waxi Bunyamin nan fan tongofe yi ki. Yi kote birin findixi n tan nan gbe ra.»

sentences.english: And Reuben said, Put my two sons to death if I do not come back to you with him; let him be in my care and I will give him safely back to you.
sentences.susu: Ruben naxa a fala a baba bɛ, «Xa n mu Bunyamin nagbilen i ma, i xa n ma di firinyie faxa. Bunyamin so n yi ra, n man fama a ra.»

sentences.english: And he said, I will not let my son go down with you; for his brother is dead and he is all I have: if evil overtakes him on the journey, then through you will my grey head go down to the underworld in sorrow.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a yaabi, «Wo nun n ma di birin mu sigama, barima a taara bara faxa, a keren nan fa luxi. Xa fe nde sa a sɔtɔ wo xa biyaasi kui, n ma simaya raɲɔnyi findima n bɛ sunnunyi nan na wo fɔxi ra.»

sentences.english: Now the land was in bitter need of food.
sentences.susu: Kaamɛ sɛnbɛ nu gboma nan tun Kanaan bɔxi kui.

sentences.english: And when the grain which they had got in Egypt was all used up, their father said to them, Go again and get us a little food.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba nun a xa denbaya to bara gɛ mɛngi birin donde e fa naxan na kelife ra Misira, Yaxuba naxa a fala a xa die bɛ, «Wo man xa siga, wo xa sa donse nde sara won bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Judah said to him, The man said to us with an oath, You are not to come before me again without your brother.
sentences.susu: Yuda naxa a yaabi, «Misira mangɛ a fala nɛ muxu bɛ a fanyi ra, ‹Wo mu n yatagi toma xa wo nun wo xunya birin mu fa.›

sentences.english: If you will let our brother go with us, we will go down and get food:
sentences.susu: Xa i bara tin muxu nun Bunyamin birin xa siga, muxu sigama nɛ, muxu sa donse sara i bɛ.

sentences.english: But if you will not send him, we will not go down: for the man said to us, You are not to come before me if your brother is not with you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa i mu tin na ra, muxu mu sigama, barima na xɛmɛ a fala nɛ muxu bɛ, ‹Wo mu n yatagi toma xa wo nun wo xunya birin xa mu fa.›»

sentences.english: And Israel said, Why were you so cruel to me as to say to him that you had a brother?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isirayila naxa a fala, «Munfe ra wo fe kobi ilanxi n na a falafe na xɛmɛ bɛ a xunya gbɛtɛ na wo bɛ?»

sentences.english: And they said, The man put a number of questions to us about ourselves and our family, saying, Is your father still living? have you another brother? And we had to give him answers; how were we to have any idea that he would say, Come back with your brother?
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Na xɛmɛ muxu maxɔrinxi nɛ a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra muxu bari ki ma. A nu fa a fala, ‹Wo baba man na simaya kui? Wo xunya nde na?› Muxu fan naxa a xa maxɔrinyi birin yaabi. Muxu ɲɔxɔ mu nu a ma, a falama, ‹Wo fa wo xunya ra.›»

sentences.english: Then Judah said to Israel, his father, Send the boy with me, and let us be up and going, so that we and you and our little ones may not come to destruction.
sentences.susu: Yuda naxa a fala a baba Isirayila bɛ, «A lu muxu nun dimɛdi xa siga. Muxu xa siga, na tɛmui won baloe sɔtɔma nɛ won mu faxa, i tan, muxu tan, a nun muxu xa die.

sentences.english: Put him into my care and make me responsible for him: if I do not give him safely back to you, let mine be the sin for ever.
sentences.susu: I ya ti n tan na. I fama a maxɔrinde n tan nan ma. Xa n mu fa a ra, n fa a ti i ya i, na kote bara findi n gbe ra i mabiri.

sentences.english: Truly, if we had not let the time go by, we might have come back again by now.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, xa yi fe xa mu muxu rabuxi nu, muxu bara sigɛ nun fa firin naba nu.»

sentences.english: Then their father Israel said to them, If it has to be so, then do this: take of the best fruits of the land in your vessels to give the man, perfumes and honey and spices and nuts:
sentences.susu: E baba Isirayila naxa a fala e bɛ, «Yi nan to fa a ra, wo fan yi nan nabama. Wo bɔxi daxamui ndee sa kote alako wo xa na xɛmɛ sanba wuri dole, kumi, surayi, labundɛ, kusu, nun foote kansi ra.

sentences.english: And take twice as much money with you; that is to say, take back the money which was put in your bags, for it may have been an error;
sentences.susu: Wo xa mɛngi sare singe, wo naxan toxi bɛkie kui, a nun mɛngi gbɛtɛ sare, wo xa na kɔbiri birin xanin wo xun. Tɛmunde na findixi nɛɛmui nan na.

sentences.english: And take your brother and go back to the man:
sentences.susu: Wo wo xunya tongo, wo xa siga na xɛmɛ yire.

sentences.english: And may God, the Ruler of all, give you mercy before the man, so that he may give you back your other brother and Benjamin. If my children are to be taken from me; there is no help for it.
sentences.susu: Ala Sɛnbɛ Kanyi xa a niya na xɛmɛ xa kinikini wo ma, a xa wo xunya so wo yi ra a nun Bunyamin. Xa n tan fa ganma nɛ n ma die birin na, n bara yɛrɛlɛ.»

sentences.english: So they took what their father said for the man, and twice as much money in their hands, and Benjamin, and went on their journey to Egypt, and came before Joseph.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba xa die naxa na sanbasee yailan. E naxa mɛngi sare singe kɔbiri tongo, a nun e lanma e xa mɛngi gbɛtɛ sara kɔbiri naxan na. E naxa siga Misira a nun Bunyamin, e sa e yɛtɛ dɛntɛgɛ Yusufu bɛ.

sentences.english: And when Joseph saw Benjamin, he said to his chief servant, Take these men into my house, and make ready a meal, for they will take food with me in the middle of the day.
sentences.susu: Yusufu to Bunyamin to e ya ma, a naxa a fala a xa konyi bɛ, «Yi xɛmɛe xanin n xɔnyi. I xa xuruse ndee faxa, i donse yailan, alako muxu xa muxu dɛge yire keren to yanyi ra.»

sentences.english: And the servant did as Joseph said, and took the men into Joseph's house.
sentences.susu: Yusufu xa konyi naxa a xa yaamari raba keren na. A naxa Yaxuba xa die xanin Yusufu xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Now the men were full of fear because they had been taken into Joseph's house and they said, It is because of the money which was put back in our bags the first time; he is looking for something against us, so that he may come down on us and take us and our asses for his use.
sentences.susu: Gaaxui naxa lu e ma a nu e xaninma tɛmui naxɛ Yusufu xɔnyi. E nu fa a fala e boore bɛ, «E na won xaninfe na kɔbiri nan ma fe ra, won naxan to won ma bɛkie kui. E fama nɛ dutunde won ma, e won ma sofalee tongo, e won findi konyie ra.»

sentences.english: So they went up to Joseph's chief servant at the door of the house,
sentences.susu: Na kui e naxa e maso Yusufu xa banxi konyi ra, e naxa wɔyɛn a ra banxi sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And said, O my lord, we only came down the first time to get food;
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala, «Yandi mangɛ, muxu singe bara fa be nu donse sarade.

sentences.english: And when we came to our night's resting-place, on opening our bags we saw that every man's money was in the mouth of his bag, all our money in full weight: and we have it with us to give it back;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ muxu to muxu xide li gbilenfe ra muxu xɔnyi, muxu naxa muxu xa bɛkie rafulun, kankan naxa a xa kɔbiri to a xa bɛki kui na donse saraxi naxan na. Yakɔsi muxu man bara fa na kɔbiri ragbilende i ma.

sentences.english: As well as more money, with which to get food: we have no idea who put our money in our bags.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara fa kɔbiri gbɛtɛ fan na, alako muxu man xa donse gbɛtɛ sara. Muxu mu a kolon mixi yo naxan na kɔbiri saxi muxu xa bɛkie kui.»

sentences.english: Then the servant said, Peace be with you: have no fear: your God, even the God of your father, has put wealth in your bags for you: I had your money. Then he let Simeon come out to them.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa konyi naxa e yaabi, «Wo bɔɲɛ xa sa, wo naxa gaaxu. Ala na a ra, wo baba Marigi Ala nan na harige fixi wo ma wo xa bɛkie kui. N tan yati nan wo xa kɔbiri rasuxu.» Na tɛmui a naxa Simeyɔn ramini e ma,

sentences.english: And the servant took them into Joseph's house, and gave them water for washing their feet; and he gave their asses food.
sentences.susu: a fa e raso Yusufu xɔnyi. A naxa ye so e yi ra, alako e xa e sanyie maxa. A naxa ɲooge so e xa sofalee yi ra donse ra.

sentences.english: And they got ready the things for Joseph before he came in the middle of the day: for word was given to them that they were to have a meal there.
sentences.susu: Yusufu taarae naxa sanbasee yailan, beenu Yusufu soma tɛmui naxɛ yanyi ra, barima e nu bara a mɛ e e dɛgema naa nɛ.

sentences.english: And when Joseph came in, they gave him the things which they had for him, and went down to the earth before him.
sentences.susu: Yusufu to so banxi, e naxa a xa sanbasee so a yi ra, e e rafelen bɔxi ma a bɛ.

sentences.english: And he said, How are you? is your father well, the old man of whom you were talking to me? is he still living?
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa e maxɔrin xa e yalanxi. A man naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo baba forixi wo naxan xa fe fala n bɛ, se mu a toxi? A man na simaya kui?»

sentences.english: And they said, Your servant, our father, is well, he is still living. And they went down on their faces before him.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «I xa konyi muxu baba, sese mu a sɔtɔxi. A man na simaya kui.» E man naxa e rafelen bɔxi ma a bun ma.

sentences.english: Then, lifting up his eyes, he saw Benjamin, his brother, his mother's son, and he said, Is this your youngest brother of whom you gave me word? And he said, God be good to you, my son.
sentences.susu: Yusufu to a ya rakeli, a naxa a xunya Bunyamin to, a nga xa di. A naxa a fala, «Yi nan na wo xunya ra wo naxan xa fe fala n bɛ?» Yusufu naxa a fala Bunyamin bɛ, «N ma di, Ala xa hɛɛri fi i ma.»

sentences.english: Then Joseph's heart went out to his brother, and he went quickly into his room, for he was overcome with weeping.
sentences.susu: A xunya xa fe kinikini naxa goro a sondonyi kui, wa xɔli naxa a suxu. A naxa keli mafuren, a so a xide a nu fa wa.

sentences.english: Then, after washing his face, he came out, and controlling his feelings said, Put food before us.
sentences.susu: Yusufu to gɛ a ya rafurukude, a naxa mini, a na maɲɔxunyi ba a ya ra. A naxa yaamari fi, «Wo donse itaxun.»

sentences.english: And they put a meal ready for him by himself, and for them by themselves, and for the Egyptians who were with him by themselves; because the Egyptians may not take food with the Hebrews, for that would make them unclean.
sentences.susu: A xa walikɛe naxa a gbe sa a xati ma, e a taarae gbe dɔxɔ e xati ma, e Misirakae gbe fan dɔxɔ e xati ma, barima Misirakae nun Eburu mixie mu e dɛgema yire keren. Misirakae xa naamunyi mu tinma na ra feo.

sentences.english: And they were all given their seats before him in order of birth, from the oldest to the youngest: so that they were looking at one another in wonder.
sentences.susu: Yusufu xa walikɛe naxa a taarae magoro a ya xɔri. E birin nu magoroxi a fori ki ma, keli di singe ma han dimɛdi. Yi fe naxa e birin kaaba.

sentences.english: And Joseph sent food to them from his table, but he sent five times as much to Benjamin as to any of the others. And they took wine freely with him.
sentences.susu: Yusufu to yaamari fi donse xa so e yi ra, Bunyamin xa donse nu dangi a taarae gbe ra dɔxɔ suuli. E birin naxa e dɛge, e min, han e wasa.

sentences.english: Then he gave orders to the servant who was over his house, saying, Put as much food into the men's bags as will go into them, and put every man's money in the mouth of his bag;
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa yi yaamari so a xa banxi walikɛe xunyi yi ra, a naxɛ, «Yi mixie xa bɛkie rafe donse ra e nɔma naxan xaninde. I man xa e xa kɔbiri sa e xa bɛkie kui.

sentences.english: And put my cup, my silver cup, in the youngest one's bag, with his money. So he did as Joseph said.
sentences.susu: I xa n ma ye minse gbeti daaxi fan sa e birin xunya dɔnxɔɛ xa bɛki kui, a nun a xa mɛngi sara kɔbiri.» Yusufu fe naxan birin fala a xa walikɛ bɛ, a naxa a birin naba.

sentences.english: And at dawn the men, with their asses, were sent away.
sentences.susu: Kuye to iba gɛɛsɛgɛ, Yaxuba xa die naxa siga, e nun e xa sofalee ra.

sentences.english: And when they had gone only a little way out of the town, Joseph said to the servant who was over his house, Go after them; and when you overtake them, say to them, Why have you done evil in reward for good?
sentences.susu: E naxa keli taa kui, kɔnɔ beenun e xa makuya, Yusufu naxa a fala a xa walikɛ bɛ, «Keli, i siga na mixie fɔxɔ ra, i xa e suxu. I na e li, a fala e bɛ, ‹Wo fe fanyi masaraxi fe kobi ra munfe ra?

sentences.english: Is not this the cup from which my lord takes wine and by which he gets knowledge of the future? Truly, you have done evil.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra wo n ma mangɛ xa ye minse gbeti daaxi se matose muɲaxi? Na fe mɔɔli mu fan.›»

sentences.english: So he overtook them and said these words to them.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa walikɛ to e yire li, a naxa na birin fala e bɛ.

sentences.english: And they said to him, Why does my lord say such words as these? far be it from your servants to do such a thing:
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Mangɛ, i wɔyɛnma yi mɔɔli ra munfe ra? Muxu tan, i xa konyie mu nɔma na mɔɔli rabade.

sentences.english: See, the money which was in the mouth of our bags we gave back to you when we came again from Canaan: how then might we take silver or gold from your lord's house?
sentences.susu: Muxu kɔbiri naxan to bɛkie kui Kanaan, muxu bara fa a ra. Munfe ra muxu gbeti, xa na mu a ra xɛɛma, muɲama i xa mangɛ xa banxi kui?

sentences.english: If it comes to light that any of your servants has done this, let him be put to death, and we will be your lord's servants.
sentences.susu: I na sese to muxu yi ra naxan findixi Misira mangɛ gbe ra, i xa na kanyi faxa, i xa muxu tan dɔnxɔɛe fan findi i xa konyie ra.»

sentences.english: And he said, Let it be as you say: he in whose bag it is seen will become my servant; and you will not be responsible.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa konyi naxa a fala, «Na bara fan. Wo naxan falaxi yi ki, n fan bara tin na ra. N na se keren to mixi naxan yi ra, na tan bara findi n ma konyi ra, wo tan dɔnxɔɛe bara kisi.»

sentences.english: Then every man quickly got his bag down and undid it.
sentences.susu: E birin naxa e xa bɛkie ragoro mafuren, e naxa e rafulun.

sentences.english: And he made a search, starting with the oldest and ending with the youngest; and the cup was in Benjamin's bag.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa konyi naxa e fɛtɛnkɛn fɔlɔ fori ma a sa dɔxɔ dimɛdi ra. Na ye minse gbeti daaxi naxa to Bunyamin xa bɛki kui.

sentences.english: Then in bitter grief they put the bags on the asses again and went back to the town.
sentences.susu: Na kui Yaxuba xa die naxa e xa donmae ibɔɔ. E birin naxa e xa kote baki sofalee fari, e man naxa gbilen taa kui.

sentences.english: So Judah and his brothers came to Joseph's house; and he was still there: and they went down on their faces before him.
sentences.susu: Yuda nun a xunyae to Yusufu xɔnyi li, e naxa e felen a bun bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Joseph said, What is this thing which you have done? had you no thought that such a man as I would have power to see what is secret?
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo yi rabaxi munfe ra? Wo mu a kolon, mixi alɔ n tan a nɔma se matode fe birin ma?»

sentences.english: And Judah said, What are we to say to my lord? how may we put ourselves right in his eyes? God has made clear the sin of your servants: now we are in your hands, we and the man in whose bag your cup was seen.
sentences.susu: Yuda naxa a yaabi, «N munse falama n ma mangɛ bɛ? N lan n xa munse fala? Muxu nɔma fiixɛde di? Ala bara i xa konyie to fe kobi xun ma. Muxu bara findi n ma mangɛ xa konyie ra, muxu tan nun yi ye minse gbeti daaxi toxi mixi naxan yi.»

sentences.english: Then he said, Far be it from me to do so: but the man who had my cup will be my servant; and you may go back to your father in peace.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a fala, «N mu nɔma na mɔɔli rabade. Yi ye minse gbeti daaxi toxi mixi naxan yi ra, na nan na n ma konyi ra, kɔnɔ wo tan, wo siga xaxilisa kui wo baba yire.»

sentences.english: Then Judah came near him, and said, Let your servant say a word in my lord's ears, and let not your wrath be burning against your servant: for you are in the place of Pharaoh to us.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi Yuda naxa makɔrɛ mangɛ ra, a naxa a fala a bɛ, «N bara i mayandi n ma mangɛ, a lu n xa masenyi nde ti i bɛ. I bɔɲɛ naxa te n tan i xa konyi xili ma, barima i luxi nɛ alɔ Misira mangɛ.

sentences.english: My lord said to his servants, Have you a father or a brother?
sentences.susu: A singe ra i muxu maxɔrin nɛ, fa a fala, ‹Wo baba na na? Wo xunya nde na na?›

sentences.english: And we said to my lord, We have an old father and a young child, whom he had when he was old; his brother is dead and he is the only son of his mother, and is very dear to his father.
sentences.susu: Muxu naxa i yaabi, ‹Muxu baba forixi na na, a nun muxu xunya, a naxan sɔtɔxi a xa xɛmɛforiɲa kui. Bunyamin taara bara faxa, a keren nan fa luxi a nga xa die ya ma, a tan nan nafan muxu baba ma.›»

sentences.english: And you said to your servants, Let him come down to me with you, so that I may see him.
sentences.susu: «I bara a fala muxu tan i xa konyie bɛ, ‹Wo fa a ra n xɔn ma alako n xa a to n ya ra.›

sentences.english: And we said to my lord, His father will not let him go; for if he went away his father would come to his death.
sentences.susu: Muxu naxa n ma mangɛ yaabi, ‹Yi dimɛdi mu kelima a baba sɛɛti ma, xa na mu a ra a baba faxama nɛ.›

sentences.english: But you said to your servants, If your youngest brother does not come with you, you will not see my face again.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i bara a fala i xa konyie bɛ, ‹Xa wo nun wo xunya birin mu fa, n mu n ya tima wo bɛ.›

sentences.english: And when we went back to your servant, our father, we gave him an account of my lord's words.
sentences.susu: Muxu to siga n baba yire, i xa konyi, muxu naxa mangɛ xa dɛntɛgɛ sa a bɛ.»

sentences.english: And our father said, Go again and get us a little food.
sentences.susu: «Na dangi xanbi, muxu baba man naxa a fala muxu bɛ, ‹Wo siga, wo xa sa donse nde sara won bɛ.›

sentences.english: And we said, Only if our youngest brother goes with us will we go down; for we may not see the man's face again if our youngest brother is not with us.
sentences.susu: Muxu naxa a yaabi, ‹Muxu mu nɔma sigade xa muxu nun muxu xunya birin mu a ra. Xa biyaasi lanma, fo muxu nun muxu xunya xa siga. Xa na mu a ra, yi xɛmɛ mu muxu rasɛnɛma.›

sentences.english: And our father said to us, You have knowledge that my wife gave me two sons;
sentences.susu: I xa konyi, n baba, a a fala nɛ muxu bɛ, ‹Wo a kolon n ma ginɛ di xɛmɛ firin nan barixi n bɛ.

sentences.english: The one went away from me, and I said, Truly he has come to a violent death; and from that time I have not seen him,
sentences.susu: Keren kelixi nɛ n xun ma, n ɲɔxɔ luxi a ma tɛmunde sube nde bara a ibɔɔ, barima han yakɔsi n mu nu a to.

sentences.english: If now you take this one from me, and some evil comes to him, you will make my grey head go down in sorrow to the underworld.
sentences.susu: Xa wo yi di fan tongo n xun ma, fe ɲaaxi nde naxa a sɔtɔ, n faxama nɛ na sunnunyi ra n fate.›»

sentences.english: If then I go back to your servant, my father, without the boy, because his life and the boy's life are one,
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi xa n sa gbilen n baba yire, xa muxu nun yi dimɛdi birin xa mu a ra,

sentences.english: When he sees that the boy is not with us, he will come to his death, and our father's grey head will go down in sorrow to the underworld.
sentences.susu: n baba faxama nɛ, barima a nii luuti nan Bunyamin na. A na a to yi dimɛdi mu na muxu fɔxɔ ra, muxu tan i xa konyie bara e baba forixi faxa sunnunyi ra a fate.

sentences.english: For I made myself responsible for the boy to my father, saying, If I do not give him safely back to you, let mine be the sin for ever.
sentences.susu: N tan i xa konyi, n dɔxɔxi nɛ sɛɛkɛ ra yi dimɛdi xa fe ra. N nu bara a fala n baba bɛ, ‹Xa n mu gbilen a ra i yire, na bara findi n ma kote ra n ma duniɲɛigiri birin kui.›»

sentences.english: So now let me be my lord's servant here in place of the boy, and let him go back with his brothers.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi n bara i mayandi, i xa tin n tan xa lu yi dimɛdi ɲɔxɔɛ ra, n xa findi i xa konyi ra, alako yi dimɛdi nun a taarae birin xa siga.

sentences.english: For how may I go back to my father without the boy, and see the evil which will come on my father?
sentences.susu: N nɔma sigade n baba yire di, xa muxu nun yi dimɛdi birin xa mu a ra? N mu nɔma a lude sunnunyi xa n baba faxa n ya xɔri.»

sentences.english: Then Joseph, unable to keep back his feelings before those who were with him, gave orders for everyone to be sent away, and no one was present when he made clear to his brothers who he was.
sentences.susu: Yusufu to mu nu wama wafe a xa konyie ya xɔri, a naxa e yamari e birin xa mini. Na kui, a nu a yɛtɛ masenma a taarae bɛ tɛmui naxɛ, mixi gbɛtɛ yo mu nu na naa.

sentences.english: And so loud was his weeping, that it came to the ears of the Egyptians and all Pharaoh's house.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa wa a xui itexi ra, han Misirakae nun Misira mangɛ xa mixi birin naxa na fe kolon.

sentences.english: And Joseph said to his brothers, I am Joseph: is my father still living? But his brothers were not able to give him an answer for they were troubled before him.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a masen a taarae bɛ, «Yusufu nan n na! N baba man na duniɲɛ?» Kɔnɔ a taarae mu nɔ a yaabide fefe ma. E dɛ bara ixara, e gaaxu a ya ra.

sentences.english: Then Joseph said to his brothers, Come near to me. And they came near, And he said, I am Joseph your brother, whom you sent into Egypt.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a fala a taarae bɛ, «N bara wo maxandi, wo xa wo maso n na.» E naxa e maso a ra. A naxa a fala, «N tan nan na Yusufu ra, wo xunya, wo naxan mati a xa findi konyi ra Misirakae bɛ.

sentences.english: Now do not be troubled or angry with yourselves for sending me away, because God sent me before you to be the saviour of your lives.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi wo bɔɲɛ naxa mini, wo naxa gaaxu, wo to bara n mati konyi ra, n saramae naxa fa n na yi bɔxi ma. Ala nan na ragirixi. A tan nan n xɛɛxi wo ya ra alako n xa wo rakisi.

sentences.english: For these two years have been years of need, and there are still five more years to come in which there will be no ploughing or cutting of grain.
sentences.susu: Wo bara a to, ɲɛ firin nan yi ki kaamɛ na bɔxi ma, kɔnɔ ɲɛ suuli man luxi. Bɔxi mu rawalima, sansi mu xabama.

sentences.english: God sent me before you to keep you and yours living on earth so that you might become a great nation.
sentences.susu: Ala n nasanbaxi nɛ wo ya ra, alako n xa bɔxi donse nde ragata wo bɛ, wo xa nɔ balode maratangɛ kui.

sentences.english: So now it was not you who sent me here, but God: and he has made me as a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and ruler over all the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Wo tan xa mu faxi n na be. Ala na a ra. A tan nan n findi Misira mangɛ baba ra, a xa banxi nun a xa bɔxi birin xa lu n ma yaamari bun ma.»

sentences.english: Now go quickly to my father, and say to him, Your son Joseph says, God has made me ruler over all the land of Egypt: come down to me straight away:
sentences.susu: «Wo xulun, wo xa siga n baba yire. Wo xa a fala a bɛ, ‹I xa di Yusufu yi nan falaxi, «Ala bara n findi Misira mangɛ ra. I xa siga n yire, i naxa dugundi.

sentences.english: The land of Goshen will be your living-place, and you will be near me; you and your children and your children's children, and your flocks and herds and all you have:
sentences.susu: I fama lude Gosen bɔxi nan ma n fɛ ma, i tan, i xa die, i xa mamadie, i xa xurusee, nun i harige birin.

sentences.english: And there I will take care of you, so that you and your family may not be in need, for there are still five bad years to come.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ suuli kaamɛ man luxi. N i hayi birin fanma nɛ Gosen, alako i nun i xa denbaya naxa findi setaree ra.»›»

sentences.english: Now truly, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin see, that it is my mouth which says these things to you.
sentences.susu: «Wo bara a to wo yɛtɛ ya ra, n xunya Bunyamin fan bara a to, a n tan yati nan wɔyɛnfe wo bɛ.

sentences.english: Give my father word of all my glory in Egypt and of all you have seen; and come back quickly with my father.
sentences.susu: Wo xa n ma mangɛya sɛnbɛ tagi raba n baba bɛ, n na naxan kui Misira bɔxi ma, a nun wo fe naxan birin toxi. Wo wo xulun, wo xa fa n baba ra han be.»

sentences.english: Then, weeping, he took Benjamin in his arms, and Benjamin himself was weeping on Joseph's neck.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa findigilin a xunya Bunyamin ma, e firin naxa wa a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then he gave a kiss to all his brothers, weeping over them; and after that his brothers had no fear of talking to him.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a taarae fan masunbu, e birin naxa wa. Na xanbi, a taarae naxa suusa wɔyɛnde a bɛ.

sentences.english: And news of these things went through Pharaoh's house, and it was said that Joseph's brothers were come; and it seemed good to Pharaoh and his servants.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa kolon sɔtɔ a ma, a Yusufu taarae bara fa. Na naxa rafan Misira mangɛ nun a xa mixi birin ma.

sentences.english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Say to your brothers, Put your goods on your beasts and go back to the land of Canaan;
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen Yusufu bɛ, «A fala i taarae bɛ, ‹Wo kote baki wo xa sofalee fari, wo xa siga Kanaan bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And get your father and your families and come back to me: and I will give you all the good things of Egypt, and the fat of the land will be your food.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui wo xa gbilen wo nun wo baba nun wo xabilɛ ra n yire. Se fanyi naxan birin na Misira bɔxi ma, n na a soma nɛ wo yi ra, wo man fa bɔxi daxamui fanyi don.›

sentences.english: And say to them, This you are to do: take carts from the land of Egypt for your little ones and for your wives, and get your father and come back.
sentences.susu: I xa a fala i taarae bɛ, ‹Wo xa Misira gisee xanin, wo xa wo baba, wo xa die, nun wo xa ginɛe baki e kui, wo xa fa e ra.

sentences.english: And take no thought for your goods, for the best of all the land of Egypt is yours.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa mɔnɛ sese xa fe ra, barima se fanyi naxan birin na Misira bɔxi ma, a findima wo gbe nan na.›»

sentences.english: And the children of Israel did as he said; and Joseph gave them carts as had been ordered by Pharaoh, and food for their journey.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa die naxa na raba. Yusufu naxa gisee so a taarae yi ra alɔ Misira mangɛ a fala a bɛ ki naxɛ. A naxa fandɛ fan so e yi ra e naxan donma kira ra.

sentences.english: To every one of them he gave three changes of clothing; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred bits of silver and five changes of clothing.
sentences.susu: A naxa donma fanyie fi a taarae birin ma. Kɔnɔ a kɔbiri kole kɛmɛ saxan nan fi Bunyamin tan ma, a nun donma suuli.

sentences.english: And to his father he sent ten asses with good things from Egypt on their backs, and ten she-asses with grain and bread and food for his father on the journey.
sentences.susu: A naxa Misira daxamui fanyi baki sofale fu fari a baba xa sanbɛ. A man naxa donse xɔri, taami, nun fandɛ gbɛtɛe baki sofale ginɛ fu fari a baba xa biyaasi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And he sent his brothers on their way, and said to them, See that you have no argument on the road.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, a naxa a taarae lu e xa siga. A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo naxa galanbu kira xɔn ma de!»

sentences.english: So they went up from Egypt and came to the land of Canaan, to their father Jacob.
sentences.susu: E naxa keli Misira, e te Kanaan bɔxi ma e baba Yaxuba yire.

sentences.english: And they said to him, Joseph is living, and is ruler over all the land of Egypt. And at this word Jacob was quite overcome, for he had no faith in it.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala a bɛ, «Yusufu mu faxaxi! A tan nan Misira bɔxi birin yamarima!» Yaxuba to na mɛ, a mu nɔ lade na ra.

sentences.english: And they gave him an account of everything Joseph had said to them; and when he saw the carts which Joseph had sent for them, his spirit came back to him:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e to Yusufu xa masenyi birin dɛntɛgɛ a bɛ, a ya fan naxa gisee to Yusufu naxee rasanbaxi a xaninfe ra, Yaxuba naxa sɛɛwa.

sentences.english: And Israel said, It is enough: Joseph my son is still living; I will go and see him before my death.
sentences.susu: Isirayila naxa a fala, «N bara ɲɛlɛxin, n ma di Yusufu man na ɲɛngife. Beenun n xa faxa, n fama nɛ a tode.»

sentences.english: And Israel went on his journey with all he had, and came to Beer-sheba, where he made offerings to the God of his father Isaac.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a harige birin xanin a xun ma. A to Beriseeba li, a naxa sɛrɛxɛ ba a baba Isiyaga Marigi Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And God said to Israel in a night-vision, Jacob, Jacob. And he said, Here am I.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa Isirayila xili xiye kui, «Yaxuba, Yaxuba.» Isirayila naxa a ratin, «N tan nan ya.»

sentences.english: And he said, I am God, the God of your father: go down to Egypt without fear, for I will make a great nation of you there:
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen a bɛ, «N tan nan na Ala ra, i baba Marigi Ala. Hali i mu gaaxu sigafe ra Misira, barima n i findima si belebele nan na.

sentences.english: I will go down with you to Egypt, and I will see that you come back again, and at your death Joseph will put his hands on your eyes.
sentences.susu: Won birin nan sigama Misira, n tan nan man fama i ragbilende be. Yusufu yati nan fama i yae ragalide i ɲɔn tɛmui.»

sentences.english: Then Jacob went on from Beer-sheba; and the sons of Jacob took their father and their little ones and their wives in the carts which Pharaoh had sent for them.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Yaxuba naxa keli Beriseeba. Isirayila xa die naxa e baba Yaxuba, e xa die, a nun e xa ginɛe baki gisee kui, Misira mangɛ naxee rasanba.

sentences.english: And they took their cattle and all the goods which they had got in the land of Canaan, and came to Egypt, even Jacob and all his seed:
sentences.susu: E naxa e xa xurusee tongo, a nun e se naxan birin sɔtɔ Kanaan bɔxi ma. Yaxuba naxa siga Misira a nun a bɔnsɔɛ birin.

sentences.english: His sons and his sons' sons, his daughters and his daughters' sons and all his family he took with him into Egypt.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa die nun a xa mamadie birin xanin a xun ma. A naxa siga a tan nun a bɔnsɔɛ birin.

sentences.english: And these are the names of the children of Israel who came into Egypt, even Jacob and all his sons: Reuben, Jacob's oldest son;
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa die xili nan ya naxee siga Misira. Yaxuba nun a xa di xɛmɛe xa taruxui nan ya: Yaxuba xa di singe lanxi Ruben nan ma.

sentences.english: And the sons of Reuben: Hanoch and Pallu and Hezron and Carmi;
sentences.susu: Ruben xa die nan ya: Hanoki, Palu, Heseron, nun Karimi.

sentences.english: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel and Jamin and Ohad and Jachin and Zohar and Shaul, the son of a woman of Canaan;
sentences.susu: Simeyɔn xa die nan ya: Yemuweli, Yamin, Ohadi, Yakin, Soxara, nun Soli. Soli findi Kanaan ginɛ xa di nan na.

sentences.english: And the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari;
sentences.susu: Lewi xa die nan ya: Gerison, Kohata, nun Merari.

sentences.english: And the sons of Judah: Er and Onan and Shelah and Perez and Zerah: but Er and Onan had come to their death in the land of Canaan; and the sons of Perez were Hezron and Hamul.
sentences.susu: Yuda xa die nan ya: Eri, Onan, Selaha, Peresi, nun Sera. Kɔnɔ Eri nun Onan faxa Kanaan bɔxi nan ma. Peresi xa die findi Heseron nun Hamuli nan na.

sentences.english: And the sons of Issachar: Tola and Puah and Job and Shimron;
sentences.susu: Isakari xa die nan ya: Tola, Puwa, Yasubu, nun Simiron.

sentences.english: And the sons of Zebulun: Sered and Elon and Jahleel;
sentences.susu: Sabulon xa die nan ya: Seredi, Elon, nun Yaxaleeli.

sentences.english: All these, together with his daughter Dinah, were the children of Leah, whom Jacob had by her in Paddan-aram; they were thirty-three in number.
sentences.susu: Die nan na ki, Leya naxee bari Yaxuba bɛ Padan Arami. A man naxa a xa di ginɛ Dina bari naa. A xa di xɛmɛe nun di ginɛe kɔnti birin nalanxi mixi tongo saxan a nun saxan.

sentences.english: And the sons of Gad: Ziphion and Haggi, Shuni and Ezbon, Eri and Arodi and Areli;
sentences.susu: Gadi xa die nan ya: Sefon, Hagi, Suni, Esibon, Eri, Arodi, nun Areli.

sentences.english: And the sons of Asher: Jimnah and Ishvah and Ishvi and Beriah, and Sarah, their sister; and the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel.
sentences.susu: Aseri xa die nan ya: Yimina, Yisiwa, Yisiwi, Beriya, a nun e xunya ginɛma Sera. Beriya xa die findi Heberi nun Malakiyeli nan na.

sentences.english: These are the children of Zilpah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Leah, and Jacob had these sixteen children by her.
sentences.susu: Die nan na ki, Silipa naxee bari Yaxuba bɛ. E birin nalanxi mixi fu nun senni. Laban nu bara Silipa so a xa di ginɛ Leya yi ra.

sentences.english: The sons of Jacob's wife Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba xa ginɛ Raxele xa die nan ya: Yusufu nun Bunyamin.

sentences.english: And Joseph had Manasseh and Ephraim in the land of Egypt, by Asenath, the daughter of Poti-phera, priest of On.
sentences.susu: Asena naxa di firin sɔtɔ Yusufu bɛ Misira bɔxi ma: Manasi nun Efirami. Asana nan lanxi On sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Potifari xa di ginɛ ma.

sentences.english: And the sons of Benjamin were Belah and Becher and Ashbel, Gera and Naaman, Ehi and Rosh, Muppim and Huppim and Ard.
sentences.susu: Bunyamin xa die nan ya: Bela, Bekeri, Asibeli, Gera, Naaman, Eki, Rosi, Xupimi, Mupimi, nun Arade.

sentences.english: All these were the children of Rachel whom Jacob had by her, fourteen persons.
sentences.susu: Die nan na ki, Raxele naxee bari Yaxuba bɛ. E birin nalanxi mixi fu nun naani.

sentences.english: And the son of Dan was Hushim.
sentences.susu: Dana xa di nan ya: Xusimi.

sentences.english: And the sons of Naphtali: Jahzeel and Guni and Jezer and Shillem.
sentences.susu: Nafatali xa die nan ya: Yaxaseeli, Guni, Yeseri, nun Silemi.

sentences.english: These were the children of Bilhah, whom Laban gave to his daughter Rachel, seven persons.
sentences.susu: Die nan na ki, Bila naxee bari Yaxuba bɛ. E birin nalanxi mixi solofere. Laban nu bara Bila so a xa di ginɛ Raxele yi ra.

sentences.english: All the persons who came with Jacob into Egypt, the offspring of his body, were sixty-six, without taking into account the wives of Jacob's sons.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba nun mixi naxee birin siga Misira, a bɔnsɔɛ birin nalanxi mixi tongo senni nun senni, bafe a xa die xa ginɛe ra.

sentences.english: And the sons of Joseph whom he had in Egypt were two. Seventy persons of the family of Jacob came into Egypt.
sentences.susu: Yusufu di xɛmɛ firin nan bari Misira. Yaxuba xabilɛ naxan siga Misira bɔxi ma, e kɔnti birin nalanxi mixi tongo solofere.

sentences.english: Now he had sent Judah before him to Goshen, to get word from Joseph; and so they came to the land of Goshen.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa Yuda xɛɛ a ya ra Yusufu xɔn ma, alako a xa kira yailan e bɛ sigafe ra Gosen. E to so Gosen bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: And Joseph got his carriage ready and went to Goshen for the meeting with his father; and when he came before him, he put his arms round his neck, weeping.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a gise tongo, a naxa siga a baba Isirayila ralande naa. A to a li, a naxa findigilin a ma, a nu fa wa ra a xɔnkuye ra.

sentences.english: And Israel said to Joseph, Now that I have seen you living again, I am ready for death.
sentences.susu: Isirayila naxa a fala Yusufu bɛ, «Hali n faxa fa, n bɔɲɛ bara sa barima n bara i yatagi to, i man na ɲɛngife.»

sentences.english: And Joseph said to his brothers and to his father's people, I will go and give the news to Pharaoh, and say to him, My brothers and my father's people, from the land of Canaan, have come to me;
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a fala a taarae bɛ, a nun a baba xa denbaya, «N xa siga, n xa sa a fala Misira mangɛ bɛ, ‹N taarae nun n baba xa denbaya naxee nu sabatixi Kanaan bɔxi ma, e birin bara fa n yire.

sentences.english: And these men are keepers of sheep and owners of cattle, and have with them their flocks and their herds and all they have.
sentences.susu: Yi mixie gɔɔrɛ kanyie nan e ra. E xurusee nan dɛmadonma. E bara fa e xa gɔɔrɛe ra, sie, yɛxɛɛe, ningee, nun e harige birin.›

sentences.english: Now when Pharaoh sends for you and says, What is your business?
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ na wo xili tɛmui naxɛ, a wo maxɔrinma nɛ wo xa wali ma.

sentences.english: You are to say, Your servants have been keepers of cattle from our early days up to now, like our fathers; in this way you will be able to have the land of Goshen for yourselves; because keepers of sheep are unclean in the eyes of the Egyptians.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a yaabi, ‹Muxu tan i xa konyie findixi xuruse maxurie nan na, kabi muxu dimɛdi tɛmui han yakɔsi, alɔ muxu benbae nu a rabama ki naxɛ.› Na kui wo fama lude Gosen bɔxi nan ma, barima xuruse dɛmadonyie raɲaaxu Misirakae ma.»

sentences.english: Then Joseph went to Pharaoh, and said, My father and my brothers with their flocks and their herds and all they have, are come from Canaan, and are now in the land of Goshen.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa siga a sa a fala Misira mangɛ bɛ, «N baba nun n ngaxakerenyie bara fa Gosen kelife Kanaan bɔxi ma. E bara fa e xa xurusee nun e harige birin na.»

sentences.english: And he took five of his brothers to Pharaoh.
sentences.susu: A naxa a taara suuli ndee masen Misira mangɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: And Pharaoh said to them, What is your business? And they said, Your servants are keepers of sheep, as our fathers were before us.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa Yusufu taarae maxɔrin, «Wo wali mundun nabama?» E naxa Misira mangɛ yaabi, «Muxu tan i xa konyie findixi xuruse dɛmadonyie nan na, alɔ muxu benbae nu a rabama ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And they said to Pharaoh, We have come to make a living in this land, because we have no grass for our flocks in the land of Canaan; so now let your servants make a place for themselves in the land of Goshen.
sentences.susu: E man naxa a fala Misira mangɛ bɛ, «Muxu faxi nɛ, muxu xa lu yi bɔxi ma sinden, barima sɛxɛ mu na muxu xɔnyi kɔrɛ xurusee naxan donma. Kaamɛ bara din Kanaan bɔxi ra. Muxu bara i mayandi i xa muxu tan i xa konyie sago sa, muxu xa lu Gosen bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, Let them have the land of Goshen; and if there are any able men among them, put them over my cattle.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa a fala Yusufu bɛ, «I baba nun i taarae bara fa i fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And Jacob and his sons came to Joseph in Egypt, and when word of it came to the ears of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, he said to Joseph, Your father and brothers have come to you; all the land of Egypt is before you; let your father and your brothers have the best of the land for their resting-place.
sentences.susu: Misira bɔxi na i sagoe. Yire fanyi fen Gosen mabiri, i baba nun i ngaxakerenyie luma dɛnnaxɛ. Xa i mixi matinxinxie kolon e ya ma, e sugandi e xa findi n ma xuruse dɛmadonyie ra.»

sentences.english: Then Joseph made his father Jacob come before Pharaoh, and Jacob gave him his blessing.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Yusufu naxa a baba xanin Misira mangɛ yire, a a masen a bɛ. Yaxuba naxa duba Misira mangɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: And Pharaoh said to him, How old are you?
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa Yaxuba maxɔrin, «I xa simaya ɲɛ yeri a ra yi ki?»

sentences.english: And Jacob said, The years of my wanderings have been a hundred and thirty; small in number and full of sorrow have been the years of my life, and less than the years of the wanderings of my fathers.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa Misira mangɛ yaabi, «N ma simaya ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ tongo saxan na a ra yi ki. N simaya dunke naxasixi nan sɔtɔxi. A ɲan mu makɔrɛxi n benbae xa simaya xasabi ra.»

sentences.english: And Jacob gave Pharaoh his blessing, and went out from before him.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba to duba Misira mangɛ bɛ, a naxa siga.

sentences.english: And Joseph made a place for his father and his brothers, and gave them a heritage in the land of Egypt, in the best of the land, the land of Rameses, as Pharaoh had given orders.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa bɔxi fanyi fi a baba nun a taarae ma, alɔ Misira mangɛ a yamari ki naxɛ. E bɔxi naxan sɔtɔ a tan nan fan Misira bɔxi birin bɛ. A xili Ramesesi.

sentences.english: And Joseph took care of his father and his brothers and all his father's people, giving them food for the needs of their families.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa mɛɛni a baba, a taarae, nun a baba xa denbayae birin ma.

sentences.english: Now there was no food to be had in all the land, so that all Egypt and Canaan were wasted from need of food.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui kaamɛ nu bara sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ. Donse mu nu toma keli Misira bɔxi ma han Kanaan. Kaamɛ naxa ɲama halaki.

sentences.english: And all the money in Egypt and in the land of Canaan which had been given for grain, came into the hands of Joseph: and he put it in Pharaoh's house.
sentences.susu: Kɔbiri naxan birin nu na Misira nun Kanaan bɔxi ma, Yusufu naxa a masara mɛngi ra. A naxa na kɔbiri ragata Misira mangɛ xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: And when all the money in Egypt and Canaan was gone, the Egyptians came to Joseph, and said, Give us bread; would you have us come to destruction before your eyes? for we have no more money.
sentences.susu: Misirakae nun Kanaankae xa kɔbiri birin to ɲɔn, Misirakae naxa fa Yusufu yire e a fala, «Donse so muxu yi ra! A lanma muxu xa faxa i ya xɔri? Muxu xa kɔbiri birin bara ɲɔn.»

sentences.english: And Joseph said, Give me your cattle; I will give you grain in exchange for your cattle if your money is all gone.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa e yaabi, «Wo fa wo xa xurusee ra, won xa a masara donse ra, barima kɔbiri mu na wo yi ra.»

sentences.english: So they took their cattle to Joseph and he gave them bread in exchange for their horses and flocks and herds and asses, so all that year he gave them food in exchange for their cattle.
sentences.susu: E naxa fa e xa xurusee ra Yusufu xɔn ma. E xa soe, sie, yɛxɛɛe, ningee, nun sofalee, e nee birin masara Yusufu ma donse ra. A naxa donse taxun e ra e xa xurusee masarɛ ra.

sentences.english: And when that year was ended, they came to him in the second year, and said, We may not keep it from our lord's knowledge that all our money is gone, and all the herds of cattle are my lord's; there is nothing more to give my lord but our bodies and our land;
sentences.susu: Na ɲɛ to dangi, e naxa fa a yire, e a fala a bɛ, «Muxu mu nɔma muxu nɔxunde muxu xa mangɛ ma. Kɔbiri yo mu na muxu yi ra. Muxu xa xuruse fan birin na muxu xa mangɛ yi ra. Muxu gundie nun muxu xa bɔxie gbansan nan luxi muxu yi ra donse sare ra muxu xa mangɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: Are we to come to destruction before your eyes, we and our land? take us and our land and give us bread; and we and our land will be servants to Pharaoh; and give us seed so that we may have life and the land may not become waste.
sentences.susu: A lanma muxu xa faxa i ya xɔri, muxu xa bɔxie xun xa rakana? Muxu nun muxu xa bɔxie masara donse ra, muxu xa findi Misira mangɛ xa konyie ra, muxu xa bɔxie fan xa findi a gbe ra. Sansi xɔri so muxu yi ra muxu naxan nawalima, muxu xa balo alako muxu naxa faxa, bɔxi fan naxa rabɛɲin.»

sentences.english: So Joseph got all the land in Egypt for Pharaoh; for every Egyptian gave up his land in exchange for food, because of their great need; so all the land became Pharaoh's.
sentences.susu: Na kui Yusufu naxa Misirakae xa bɔxi birin sara Misira mangɛ bɛ. Kaamɛ xa xɔrɔxɔɛ nu bara a niya e xa e xa bɔxi birin mati Misira mangɛ ma.

sentences.english: And as for the people, he made servants of them, town by town, from one end of Egypt to the other.
sentences.susu: Yusufu Misira ɲama birin findi konyie ra na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Only he did not take the land of the priests, for the priests had their food given them by Pharaoh, and having what Pharaoh gave them, they had no need to give up their land.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ sɛrɛxɛdubɛe tan mu e gbe bɔxie sara, barima Misira mangɛ nu hinnɛma e ra donse fe ra.

sentences.english: Then Joseph said to the people, I have made you and your land this day the property of Pharaoh; here is seed for you to put in your fields.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a fala ɲama bɛ, «N bara wo sara to a nun wo xa bɔxie Misira mangɛ bɛ. Sansi nan yi ki, wo xa bɔxie rawali.

sentences.english: And when the grain is cut, you are to give a fifth part to Pharaoh, and four parts will be yours for seed and food, and for your families and your little ones.
sentences.susu: A xaba tɛmui, wo a dɔxɔ suuli nde soma Misira mangɛ nan yi ra. Dɔxɔ naani naxee luma, na findima sansi nun baloe nan na, wo tan, wo xa die, a nun wo xa mixi birin bɛ.»

sentences.english: And they said to him, Truly you have kept us from death; may we have grace in your eyes, and we will be Pharaoh's servants.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala, «I bara muxu rakisi! Muxu bara muxu xa mangɛ xa fe fanyi to a naxan nabaxi muxu bɛ. Muxu findima Misira mangɛ xa konyie nan na.»

sentences.english: Then Joseph made a law which is in force to this day, that Pharaoh was to have the fifth part; only the land of the priests did not become his.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa na findi sɛriyɛ ra. Han to Misira bɔxi daxamui dɔxɔ suuli nde birin findi Misira mangɛ nan gbe ra. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa bɔxie nan gbansan mu findixi Misira mangɛ gbe ra.

sentences.english: And so Israel was living among the Egyptians in the land of Goshen; and they got property there, and became very great in numbers and in wealth.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa sabati Gosen Misira bɔxi ma. Na bɔxi naxa findi e gbe ra. E bɔnsɔɛ naxa gbo yɛ.

sentences.english: And Jacob was living in the land of Goshen for seventeen years; so the years of his life were a hundred and forty-seven.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba ɲɛ fu nun solofere nan naba Misira bɔxi ma. A xa simaya naxa ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ tongo naani nun solofere li.

sentences.english: And the time of his death came near, and he sent for his son Joseph and said to him, If now I am dear to you, put your hand under my leg and take an oath that you will not put me to rest in Egypt;
