sentences.susu: Isirayila xa simaya to nu fa ɲɔnfe, a naxa a xa di Yusufu xili, a a fala a bɛ, «Na kui, i xa i bɛlɛxɛ dɔxɔ n tabe bunyi ra, i fa i kali n bɛ fa a falafe ra, i mu n nagatama yi Misira bɔxi ma, i xa mɛɛni n ma tinxinyi kui, i hinnɛ n na.

sentences.english: But when I go to my fathers, you are to take me out of Egypt and put me to rest in their last resting-place. And he said, I will do so.
sentences.susu: N na laaxira tɛmui naxɛ, i xa n namini Misira, i sa n nagata n benbae xa gaburi yire.» Yusufu naxa a yaabi, «I naxan falaxi n bɛ, n na rabama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said, Take an oath to me; and he took an oath to him: and Israel gave worship on the bed's head.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a fala, «I rakali n bɛ.» Yusufu naxa a kali a bɛ. Na tɛmui Yaxuba naxa a felen a xa sade xunyi ra.

sentences.english: Now after these things, word came to Joseph that his father was ill: and he took with him his sons Manasseh and Ephraim.
sentences.susu: Na fe birin to bara dangi, e naxa a fala Yusufu bɛ, «I baba mu yalanxi.» Yusufu naxa siga a baba yire, a nun a xa di xɛmɛ firinyie, Manasi nun Efirami.

sentences.english: And when they said to Jacob, Your son Joseph is coming to see you: then Israel, getting all his strength together, had himself lifted up in his bed.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa a fala Yaxuba bɛ, «I xa di Yusufu bara fa.» Isirayila naxa sɛnbɛ raba, a keli, a dɔxɔ sade ma.

sentences.english: And Jacob said to Joseph, God, the Ruler of all, came to me in a vision at Luz in the land of Canaan, and gave me his blessing,
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a fala Yusufu bɛ, «Ala Sɛnbɛ Kanyi mini nɛ n ma Lusi Kanaan bɔxi ma. A naxa barakɛ sa n ma fe.

sentences.english: And said to me, Truly, I will make you fertile and give you increase and will make of you a great family of nations: and I will give this land to your seed after you to be their heritage for ever.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a fala n bɛ, ‹N i findima dibari belebele nan na. N i xa die rawuyama nɛ, han e findi ɲama gbegbe ra. N yi bɔxi fima nɛ i bɔnsɔɛ ma, hali i dangi xanbi, a findi e gbe ra han duniɲa ɲɔn.›»

sentences.english: And now your two sons who came to birth in Egypt before I came to you here, are mine; Ephraim and Manasseh will be mine, in the same way as Reuben and Simeon are.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi yi di firinyie, i naxee barixi Misira beenun n tan xa fa, n bara e findi n ma die ra. Efirami nun Manasi findima n tan nan gbe ra, alɔ Ruben nun Simeyɔn.

sentences.english: And any other offspring which you have after them, will be yours, and will be named after their brothers in their heritage.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i di naxee barima yee xanbi ra, i gbe lanxi nee nan ma. E fama lude e taarae nan bun ma e kɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And as for me, when I came from Paddan, death overtook Rachel on the way, when we were still some distance from Ephrath; and I put her to rest there on the road to Ephrath, which is Beth-lehem.
sentences.susu: N to keli Padan, Raxele naxa faxa n yi ra kira xɔn Kanaan bɔxi ma. A ɲɔnde mu nu makuya Efarata ra. N naxa a ragata mɛnni, Efarata kira ra, dɛnnaxɛ xili Bɛtɛlɛɛmu.»

sentences.english: Then Israel, looking at Joseph's sons, said, Who are these?
sentences.susu: Isirayila naxa Yusufu xa die mato, a fa a fala, «Ndee yee ra?»

sentences.english: And Joseph said to his father, They are my sons, whom God has given me in this land. And he said, Let them come near me, and I will give them a blessing.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a baba yaabi, «N ma di xɛmɛe na e ra Ala naxee fixi n ma be.» Isirayila naxa a fala, «I xa e maso n na, alako n xa duba e bɛ.»

sentences.english: Now because Israel was old, his eyes were no longer clear, and he was not able to see. So he made them come near to him, and he gave them a kiss, folding them in his arms.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba nu bara gɛ foride, a yae mu nu see igbɛma sɔnɔn. Yusufu to a xa die maso a ra, Isirayila naxa e masunbu, a findigilin e ma.

sentences.english: And Israel said to Joseph, I had no hope of seeing your face again, but God in his mercy has let me see you and your children.
sentences.susu: Isirayila naxa a fala Yusufu bɛ, «N mu nu laxi a ra, xa n i yatagi toma sɔnɔn, kɔnɔ Ala bara a ragiri n bara i xa die fan to.»

sentences.english: Then Joseph took them from between his knees, and went down on his face to the earth.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a xa die tongo a baba san ma, a fa a rafelen bɔxi fari.

sentences.english: Then taking Ephraim with his right hand, Joseph put him at Israel's left side, and with his left hand he put Manasseh at Israel's right side, placing them near him.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Yusufu naxa a xa di firinyie tongo e bɛlɛxɛ ma. A naxa Efirami suxu a yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛ ra, Isirayila kɔɔla mabiri. A naxa Manasi suxu a kɔɔla bɛlɛxɛ ra, Isirayila yirefanyi mabiri. A naxa e maso a ra.

sentences.english: And Israel, stretching out his right hand, put it on the head of Ephraim, the younger, and his left hand on the head of Manasseh, crossing his hands on purpose, for Manasseh was the older.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Yaxuba naxa a yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛ sa Efirami xunyi fari naxan na dimɛdi ra. A naxa a kɔɔla bɛlɛxɛ sa Manasi xunyi fari naxan na di singe ra. A nu a kolon a nu fe naxan nabama a bɛlɛxɛe ra.

sentences.english: And he gave Joseph a blessing, saying, May the God to whom my fathers, Abraham and Isaac, gave worship, the God who has taken care of me all my life till this day,
sentences.susu: A naxa duba Yusufu bɛ, a fa a fala, «Ala, n benbae Iburahima nun Isiyaga ɲɛrɛ naxan ya xɔri, Ala naxan na n kantama ra, kafi n bari lɔxɔɛ han to,

sentences.english: The angel who has been my saviour from all evil, send his blessing on these children: and let my name and the name of my fathers, Abraham and Isaac, be given to them; and let them become a great nation in the earth.
sentences.susu: Ala naxan malekɛ xɛɛxi n natangade fe xɔrɔxɔɛ ma, a xa barakɛ sa yi dimɛe xa fe. Mixie xa e xili n xili ra, e xa e xili n benbae Iburahima nun Isiyaga xili ra. E bɔnsɔɛ xa wuya a gbegbe ra duniɲa.»

sentences.english: Now when Joseph saw that his father had put his right hand on the head of Ephraim, it did not seem right to him; and lifting his father's hand he would have put it on the head of Manasseh.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a to a baba bara a yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛ sa Efirami xunyi ma. Na fe mu rafanxi a ma. A naxa a baba bɛlɛxɛ suxu, a ba Efirami xunyi ma, a fa a sa Manasi xunyi ma.

sentences.english: And Joseph said to his father, Not so, my father, for this is the older; put your right hand on his head.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a fala a baba bɛ, «N baba, na ki xa mu a ra, barima yi nan na fori ra. I yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛ sama yi nan xunyi ma.»

sentences.english: But his father would not, saying, I am doing it on purpose, my son; he will certainly become a nation and a great one; but his younger brother will be greater than he, and his seed will become a great family of nations.
sentences.susu: A baba naxa tondi, a fa a fala, «N ma di, n a kolon, n a kolon. A fan fama findide bɔnsɔɛ wuyaxi kanyi nan na. A fan gboma nɛ, kɔnɔ a xunya nan fama gbode dangife a ra. A xunya bɔnsɔɛ findima nɛ si wuyaxi ra.»

sentences.english: So he gave them his blessing that day, saying, You will be the sign of blessing in Israel, for they will say, May God make you like Ephraim and Manasseh; and he put Ephraim before Manasseh.
sentences.susu: A naxa duba e bɛ na lɔxɔɛ, a fa a fala, «Isirayilakae duba rabama wo xilie nan na. E fama a falade, ‹Ala xa i lu alɔ Efirami nun Manasi.›» Na kui a naxa Efirami ti yare Manasi bɛ.

sentences.english: Then Israel said to Joseph, Now my death is near; but God will be with you, guiding you back to the land of your fathers.
sentences.susu: Isirayila naxa a fala Yusufu bɛ, «I bara a to, a gbe mu luxi n xa laaxira, kɔnɔ Ala tima nɛ i fanga ra, a fa i ragbilen i benbae xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And I have given you more than your brothers, even Shechem as your heritage, which I took from the Amorites with my sword and my bow.
sentences.susu: N fama kɛ fide i ma dangi i taarae ra. N bɔxi naxan nasuxu Amorikae yi ra n ma santidɛgɛma nun n ma xali saabui ra, n bara na fan sa i kɛ fari.»

sentences.english: And Jacob sent for his sons, and said, Come together, all of you, so that I may give you news of your fate in future times.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a xa die xili, a naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo xa wo malan, n xa fe fala naxan fama rabade wo bɛ.»

sentences.english: Come near, O sons of Jacob, and give ear to the words of Israel your father.
sentences.susu: «Yaxuba xa die, wo fa be, wo xa wo tuli mati wo baba Isirayila ra.

sentences.english: Reuben, you are my oldest son, the first-fruit of my strength, first in pride and first in power:
sentences.susu: Ruben, i tan, n ma di singe, i tan nan na n ma fonike di ra. I bara findi fisamante ra lasiriya kui. I sɛnbɛ dangi birin na.

sentences.english: But because you were uncontrolled, the first place will not be yours; for you went up to your father's bed, even his bride-bed, and made it unclean.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i to findi xurutare nan na, alɔ ye naxan susuma, i mu fisamanteya sɔtɔma sɔnɔn, barima i bara i sa i baba xa sade ma a nun i nanden. Na bara findi sɛniyɛntareɲa ra.

sentences.english: Simeon and Levi are brothers; deceit and force are their secret designs.
sentences.susu: Simeyɔn nun Lewi findixi ngaxakerenmae nan na. Santidɛgɛma nan na e xa geresose ra.

sentences.english: Take no part in their secrets, O my soul; keep far away, O my heart, from their meetings; for in their wrath they put men to death, and for their pleasure even oxen were wounded.
sentences.susu: N mu soma e xa fefe ya ma, n mu tinma dɔxɔde e xa malanyi, barima e xa bɔɲɛte kui e bara xɛmɛe faxa, e xa kalabanteɲa kui e bara tuurae maxɔnɔ fufafu.

sentences.english: A curse on their passion for it was bitter; and on their wrath for it was cruel. I will let their heritage in Jacob be broken up, driving them from their places in Israel.
sentences.susu: N bara e xa bɔɲɛte danka, barima geregirie nan e ra. E naxan nabama, n bara na danka, barima e ya ixara. E bɔnsɔɛ mu luma yire keren Yaxuba xɔnyi, n e rayensenma nɛ Isirayila bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: To you, Judah, will your brothers give praise: your hand will be on the neck of your haters; your father's sons will go down to the earth before you.
sentences.susu: Yuda, i xunyae i tan nan tantuma. I fama nɛ xutu sɔtɔde i yaxuie ma. I baba xa di xɛmɛe magoroma nɛ i bɛ.

sentences.english: Judah is a young lion; like a lion full of meat you have become great, my son; now he takes his rest like a lion stretched out and like an old lion; by whom will his sleep be broken?
sentences.susu: Yuda, yɛtɛ yɔrɛ nan lanxi i ma. N ma di, i baloma sube nan xun na. I xinbie kuntanma nɛ alɔ yɛtɛ. Nde nɔma suusade a xa i rakeli?

sentences.english: The rod of authority will not be taken from Judah, and he will not be without a law-giver, till he comes who has the right to it, and the peoples will put themselves under his rule.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ sawuri fama lude Yuda bɔnsɔɛ nan yi. Mixi yo mu mangɛ sawuri bama a yi, beemanu tɔnxuma kanyi fama tɛmui naxɛ, sie suyidima naxan bɛ.

sentences.english: Knotting his ass's cord to the vine, and his young ass to the best vine; washing his robe in wine, and his clothing in the blood of grapes:
sentences.susu: A xa sofale xirima wɛni bili nan na, a xa sofale yɔrɛ xirima wɛni bili fanyi nan na. A xa donma nun a xa xinbeli donma xama wɛni ye nan na.

sentences.english: His eyes will be dark with wine, and his teeth white with milk.
sentences.susu: A ya maɲingixi alɔ wɛni, A ɲinyi fiixɛ alɔ xiɲɛ.

sentences.english: The resting-place of Zebulun will be by the sea, and he will be a harbour for ships; the edge of his land will be by Zidon.
sentences.susu: Sabulon fama sabatide baa dɛ nɛ. A findima wafu dɛ nan na kunkuie bɛ. A xa naaninyi luma nɛ Sidɔn nan sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Issachar is a strong ass stretched out among the flocks:
sentences.susu: Isakari sɛnbɛ gbo alɔ sofale, naxan a sama gɔɔrɛ firinyie tagi.

sentences.english: And he saw that rest was good and the land was pleasing; so he let them put weights on his back and became a servant.
sentences.susu: A saxi bɔxi naxan ma, yire fanyi nan a ra. A tunki felenma nɛ kote bun ma, a luma yaamari nan bun ma.

sentences.english: Dan will be the judge of his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
sentences.susu: Dana a xa ɲama yamarima nɛ, alɔ Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ nde.

sentences.english: May Dan be a snake in the way, a horned snake by the road, biting the horse's foot so that the horseman has a fall.
sentences.susu: A luma nɛ alɔ bɔximase kira xɔn ma, alɔ tanbalunbe sankira ra. A na soe tingilinyi xin, soe ragi birama nɛ a fari ma.

sentences.english: I have been waiting for your salvation, O Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n xaxili tixi i xa kisi ra.

sentences.english: Gad, an army will come against him, but he will come down on them in their flight.
sentences.susu: Gadi, geresoe a gerema nɛ, kɔnɔ a tan nan e raboronma a tingilinyi ra.

sentences.english: Asher's bread is fat; he gives delicate food for kings.
sentences.susu: Aseri xa bɔxi findima daxamui fanyi yire nan na, naxan findima mangɛ daxamude ra.

sentences.english: Naphtali is a roe let loose, giving fair young ones.
sentences.susu: Nafatali luma nɛ alɔ xeli ginɛ naxan na a gife, a wɔyɛn fanyie falama nɛ.

sentences.english: Joseph is a young ox, whose steps are turned to the fountain;
sentences.susu: Yusufu luma nɛ alɔ sansi burɛxɛ nɛɛnɛ, naxan bogima a fanyi ra xure sɛɛti ma. A salonyie tima tɛtɛ nan xun.

sentences.english: He was troubled by the archers; they sent out their arrows against him, cruelly wounding him:
sentences.susu: Mixie naxa gere giri a ma, e naxa xali woli a ma gere ra.

sentences.english: But their bows were broken by a strong one, and the cords of their arms were cut by the Strength of Jacob, by the name of the Stone of Israel:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a xa xali sɛnbɛ gbo, a bɛlɛxɛ fan xɔrɔxɔ Yaxuba Marigi Ala Sɛnbɛ Kanyi saabui ra, naxan findixi Isirayila kantama ra, naxan luxi alɔ fanye.

sentences.english: Even by the God of your father, who will be your help, and by the Ruler of all, who will make you full with blessings from heaven on high, blessings of the deep stretched out under the earth, blessings of the breasts and of the fertile body:
sentences.susu: I baba Marigi Ala fama i malide. Ala Sɛnbɛ Kanyi barakɛ sama nɛ i xa fe. A koore barakɛ fima nɛ i ma, a bɔxi barakɛ fi i ma, a dibari barakɛ ragiri i ma.

sentences.english: Blessings of sons, old and young, to the father: blessings of the oldest mountains and the fruit of the eternal hills: let them come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of him who was separate from his brothers.
sentences.susu: I baba xa dubɛ dangi baloe nun se fanyi birin na, naxan kelima geya fari, geya naxan tixi kafi duniɲa fɔlɛ. Na barakɛ birin xa lu Yusufu ma, naxan findi a ngaxakerenyie xa mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: Benjamin is a wolf, searching for meat: in the morning he takes his food, and in the evening he makes division of what he has taken.
sentences.susu: Bunyamin luma nɛ alɔ wulai bare xaaɲɛ. A sube faxama gɛɛsɛgɛ, a a dɔnxɔɛ don nunmare.»

sentences.english: These are the twelve tribes of Israel: and these are the words their father said to them, blessing them; to every one he gave his blessing.
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ fu nun firinyie nan na ki, a nun dubɛ e baba naxan nabaxi kankan bɛ.

sentences.english: And he gave orders to them, saying, Put me to rest with my people and with my fathers, in the hollow of the rock in the field of Ephron the Hittite,
sentences.susu: Na dubɛ dangi xanbi, Yaxuba naxa a ɲungu a xa die ma, a falafe ra, «N fa sigafe n benba faxaxie nan yire. N na faxa, wo n nagata n benbae ragatade, gaburi naxan na Eferon Xitika xa xɛ yire,

sentences.english: In the rock in the field of Machpelah, near Mamre in the land of Canaan, which Abraham got from Ephron the Hittite, to be his resting-place.
sentences.susu: Makipela xɛ fɔnmɛ ra, Mamire fɛ ma, Kanaan bɔxi ma. Iburahima na xɛ saraxi Eferon Xitika nan ma, alako na xa findi a xa mixi ragatade ra.

sentences.english: There Abraham and Sarah his wife were put to rest, and there they put Isaac and Rebekah his wife, and there I put Leah to rest.
sentences.susu: Iburahima ragataxi mɛnni nɛ, a nun a xa ginɛ Sara. Isiyaga fan nagataxi mɛnni nɛ a nun a xa ginɛ Rebeka. N tan fan Leya ragataxi mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: In the rock in the field which was got for a price from the people of Heth.
sentences.susu: Na xɛ nun na fɔnmɛ naxan na naa, e saraxi Xitikae nan ma.»

sentences.english: And when Jacob had come to the end of these words to his sons, stretching himself on his bed, he gave up his spirit, and went the way of his people.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba to bara gɛ a xa wɔyɛnyi masende a xa die bɛ, a naxa a sa sade ma, a fa laaxira, a a benbae li aligiyama.

sentences.english: And Joseph put his head down on his father's face, weeping and kissing him.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa findigilin a baba ma, a masunbu, a wama.

sentences.english: And Joseph gave orders to his servants who had the necessary knowledge, to make his father's body ready, folding it in linen with spices, and they did so.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Yusufu naxa yaamari fi seribae ma e xa a baba fate sɔxɔ seri ra, alako a fure naxa bɔrɔ. E naxa na wali raba a baba Isirayila ra

sentences.english: And the forty days needed for making the body ready went by: and there was weeping for him among the Egyptians for seventy days.
sentences.susu: xi tongo naani bun ma e xa naamunyi ki ma. Misirakae naxa a ɲɔnfe raba xi tongo solofere bun.

sentences.english: And when the days of weeping for him were past, Joseph said to the servants of Pharaoh, If now you have love for me, say these words to Pharaoh:
sentences.susu: Ɲɔn fe to bara ba a ra, Yusufu naxa a fala Misira mangɛ xa mixie bɛ, «N bara wo mayandi, xa n ma fe rafan wo ma, wo xa n waxɔnfe masen Misira mangɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: My father made me take an oath, saying, When I am dead, put me to rest in the place I have made ready for myself in the land of Canaan. So now let me go and put my father in his last resting-place, and I will come back again.
sentences.susu: N baba n nakali nɛ, a naxɛ, ‹N fa na faxafe nɛ. I n nagatama gaburi nan kui n naxan gexi Kanaan bɔxi ma.› Na kui n wama sigafe nɛ n xa sa n baba ragata. N na gɛ, n fama.»

sentences.english: And Pharaoh said, Go up and put your father to rest, as you gave your oath to him.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa a yaabi, «Siga, i xa sa i baba ragata alɔ a i rakalixi ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: So Joseph went up to put his father in his last resting-place; and with him went all the servants of Pharaoh, and the chief men of his house and all the chiefs of the land of Egypt,
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa siga a baba ragatade. A naxa siga a nun Misira mangɛ xa konyie, Misira mangɛ xa mixi xungbee, Misira kuntigie,

sentences.english: And all the family of Joseph, and his brothers and his father's people: only their little ones and their flocks and herds they did not take with them from the land of Goshen.
sentences.susu: a yɛtɛ xa denbaya, a taarae, nun a baba xa denbaya. E xa dimɛdie nun e xa xurusee gbansan naxa lu Gosen bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And carriages went up with him and horsemen, a great army.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔrie nun soe ragie naxa Yusufu mati e xa gisee kui. Ɲama belebele nan nu e ra.

sentences.english: And they came to the grain-floor of Atad on the other side of Jordan, and there they gave the last honours to Jacob, with great and bitter sorrow, weeping for their father for seven days.
sentences.susu: E to Atadi lonyi li Yurudɛn naakiri ma, e naxa ɲɔn fe belebele raba. Yusufu naxa binyɛ fi a baba ma, a ɲɔn fe xanin han xi solofere.

sentences.english: And when the people of the land, the people of Canaan, at the grain-floor of Atad, saw their grief, they said, Great is the grief of the Egyptians: so the place was named Abel-mizraim, on the other side of Jordan.
sentences.susu: Kanaankae naxa e ɲɔxɔ dɔxɔ na maragatɛ xɔn ma, naxan nabaxi Atadi xa lonyi ma. E naxa a fala, «Yi ɲɔn fe findi fe belebele nan na Misirakae bɛ.» Na nan a toxi e naxa «Misira Ɲɔn fe» xili fala na yire xun Yurudɛn naakiri ma.

sentences.english: So his sons did as he had given them orders to do:
sentences.susu: Na kui, Yaxuba xa die naxa e baba waxɔnfe raba alɔ a a fala e bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For they took him into the land of Canaan and put him to rest in the hollow rock in the field of Machpelah, which Abraham got with the field, for a resting-place, from Ephron the Hittite at Mamre.
sentences.susu: E naxa a xanin Kanaan bɔxi ma, e naxa a ragata Makipela xa xɛ yire fɔnmɛ kui, Iburahima xɛ naxan sara Eferon Xitika ma alako na xa findi mixi ragatade ra Mamire sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And when his father had been put to rest, Joseph and his brothers and all who had gone with him, went back to Egypt.
sentences.susu: Yusufu to gɛ a baba ragatade, a naxa gbilen Misira bɔxi ma, a nun a taarae nun mixi naxan birin a mati.

sentences.english: Now after the death of their father, Joseph's brothers said to themselves, It may be that Joseph's heart will be turned against us, and he will give us punishment for all the evil which we did to him.
sentences.susu: Yusufu taarae to bara a to e baba bara faxa, e naxa a fala, «Xa Yusufu fa won findi a gerefa ra, won fe ɲaaxi naxan birin nabaxi a ra, a gbeɲɔxɔma nɛ won ma.»

sentences.english: So they sent word to Joseph, saying, Your father, before his death, gave us orders, saying,
sentences.susu: Na kui e naxa siga Yusufu yire, e a fala a bɛ, «I baba yi nan falaxi muxu bɛ beenun a xa faxa, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: You are to say to Joseph, Let the wrongdoing of your brothers be overlooked, and the evil they did to you: now, if it is your pleasure, let the sin of the servants of your father's God have forgiveness. And at these words, Joseph was overcome with weeping.
sentences.susu: ‹Wo yi fala Yusufu bɛ, «N bara i maxandi, diɲɛ i taarae xa gbaloe fe ma a nun e xa yunubi, barima e bara fe ɲaaxi raba i ra. N bara i maxandi, yakɔsi diɲɛ i baba Marigi Ala xa konyie ma.»›» E to na masenyi fala Yusufu bɛ, a naxa wa.

sentences.english: Then his brothers went, and falling at his feet, said, Truly, we are your servants.
sentences.susu: A taarae naxa e felen a bun ma, e fa a fala, «Muxu tan nan ya, i xa konyie.»

sentences.english: And Joseph said, Have no fear: am I in the place of God?
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a fala e bɛ, «Hali wo mu gaaxu. Ala mu na n tan xa ra.

sentences.english: As for you, it was in your mind to do me evil, but God has given a happy outcome, the salvation of numbers of people, as you see today.
sentences.susu: Wo lan nɛ n xun wo naxa fe ɲaaxi raba n na, kɔnɔ Ala naxa a masara fe fanyi ra alako n xa fe rakamali ɲama nii ratangafe ra.

sentences.english: So now, have no fear: for I will take care of you and your little ones. So he gave them comfort with kind words.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi hali wo mu gaaxu. N wo hayi birin fanma nɛ nun wo xa die.» A xa wɔyɛnyi naxa e bɔɲɛ sa.

sentences.english: Now Joseph and all his father's family went on living in Egypt: and the years of Joseph's life were a hundred and ten.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa lu Misira, a tan nun a xa denbaya birin. A naxa ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ fu sɔtɔ simaya ra.

sentences.english: And Joseph saw Ephraim's children of the third generation: and the children of Machir, the son of Manasseh, came to birth on Joseph's knees.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a xa mamadie nun a tolobitɛe to, a xa di Efirami naxee sɔtɔ. A naxa Manasi xa di Makiri xa die to, a nee tongo a gbe die ra.

sentences.english: Then Joseph said to his brothers, The time of my death has come; but God will keep you in mind and take you out of this land into the land which he gave by his oath to Abraham and Isaac and Jacob.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa a fala a taarae bɛ, «N fan na faxafe nɛ, kɔnɔ Ala wo malima nɛ a fanyi ra. A fama nɛ wo tongode Misira, a wo xanin bɔxi ma a dɛnnaxɛ laayidi tongo Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Yaxuba bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Joseph made the children of Israel take an oath, saying, God will certainly give effect to his word, and you are to take my bones away from here.
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa Isirayila xa die rakali, a fa a fala, «Ala na wo mali gbilenfe ra Kanaan bɔxi ma, wo xa n fure xanin naa.»

sentences.english: So Joseph came to his death, being a hundred and ten years old: and they made his body ready, and he was put in a chest in Egypt.
sentences.susu: Yusufu laaxira a ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ fu nan ma. E naxa a fure sɔxɔ seri ra alako a fate naxa bɔrɔ, e a ragata fure kankira kui Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Now these are the names of the sons of Israel who came into Egypt; every man and his family came with Jacob.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa die xilie nan ya, naxee e baba Yaxuba mati Misira bɔxi ma, a nun e xa denbayae:

sentences.english: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah;
sentences.susu: Ruben, Simeyɔn, Lewi, Yuda,

sentences.english: Issachar, Zebulun, and Benjamin;
sentences.susu: Isakari, Sabulon, Bunyamin,

sentences.english: Dan and Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
sentences.susu: Dana, Nafatali, Gadi, nun Aseri.

sentences.english: All the offspring of Jacob were seventy persons: and Joseph had come to Egypt before them.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba xa die nun a xa mamadie nu lanxi mixi tongo solofere nan ma. A xa di Yusufu ɲan nu bara siga Misira.

sentences.english: Then Joseph came to his end, and all his brothers, and all that generation.
sentences.susu: Yusufu nun a ngaxakerenyie dangi xanbi,

sentences.english: And the children of Israel were fertile, increasing very greatly in numbers and in power; and the land was full of them.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa yiriwa Misira bɔxi ma, e sɛnbɛ nu luma xun masa ra.

sentences.english: Now a new king came to power in Egypt, who had no knowledge of Joseph.
sentences.susu: Na waxati mangɛ gbɛtɛ nan nu na Misira xun ma, naxan mu Yusufu kolon.

sentences.english: And he said to his people, See, the people of Israel are greater in number and in power than we are:
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a xa ɲama bɛ, «Wo a to, Isirayilakae yiriwaxi ki naxɛ, a bara findi kɔntɔfili ra won bɛ. E bara dangi won na.

sentences.english: Let us take care for fear that their numbers may become even greater, and if there is a war, they may be joined with those who are against us, and make an attack on us, and go up out of the land.
sentences.susu: Won xa kɔɔta nde raba alako e naxa wuya sɔnɔn. Xa na mu, gere tɛmui, e fama nɛ kafude won yaxuie ma, e keli won xun ma.»

sentences.english: So they put overseers of forced work over them, in order to make their strength less by the weight of their work. And they made store-towns for Pharaoh, Pithom and Raamses.
sentences.susu: Na kui, mangɛ naxa e findi konyie ra, a wali xɔrɔxɔɛ dɔxɔ e ma Pitomi nun Ramesesi taae tife ra. Misira mangɛ Firawuna nu donse malanma na taae nan kui.

sentences.english: But the more cruel they were to them, the more their number increased, till all the land was full of them. And the children of Israel were hated by the Egyptians.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wali xɔrɔxɔɛ nu dɔxɔma e ma ki naxɛ, e man nu sigama gbo ra na ki nɛ, han Misirakae bɔɲɛ naxa raɲaaxu e ma Isirayilakae xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And they gave the children of Israel even harder work to do:
sentences.susu: Misirakae naxa e rawali a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: And made their lives bitter with hard work, making building-material and bricks, and doing all sorts of work in the fields under the hardest conditions.
sentences.susu: E naxa e tɔɔrɔ wali xɔrɔxɔɛ ra alɔ biriki bɔnbɔfe nun xɛe rawalife. E naxa konyiya ɲaaxi dɔxɔ e ma.

sentences.english: And the king of Egypt said to the Hebrew women who gave help at the time of childbirth (the name of the one was Shiphrah and the name of the other Puah),
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa Isirayilakae xa dirasuxuie Sifira nun Puwa yamari,

sentences.english: When you are looking after the Hebrew women in childbirth, if it is a son you are to put him to death; but if it is a daughter, she may go on living.
sentences.susu: «Wo na Isirayila ginɛ xa di rasuxu, xa xɛmɛ nan a ra, wo a faxa keren na. Xa ginɛ nan a ra, wo xa a lu a xa balo.»

sentences.english: But the women had the fear of God, and did not do as the king of Egypt said, but let the male children go on living.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ dirasuxuie to nu gaaxuma Ala ya ra, e mu nu Misira mangɛ xa yaamari rabatuma. E naxa di xɛmɛmae lu e xa balo.

sentences.english: And the king of Egypt sent for the women, and said to them, Why have you done this, and let the male children go on living?
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa dirasuxuie xili, a naxa e maxɔrin, «Munfe ra wo di xɛmɛe luma, e xa balo?»

sentences.english: And they said to Pharaoh, Because the Hebrew women are not like the Egyptian women, for they are strong, and the birth takes place before we come to them.
sentences.susu: Dirasuxuie naxa Firawuna yaabi, «Isirayila ginɛe sɛnbɛ gbo Misira ginɛe bɛ. Beenu dirasuxui xa e yire li, e ɲan bara di bari.»

sentences.english: And the blessing of God was on these women: and the people were increased in number and became very strong.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa hinnɛ na dirasuxuie ra. Isirayila ɲama naxa wuya dangife a singe ra.

sentences.english: And because the women who took care of the Hebrew mothers had the fear of God, he gave them families.
sentences.susu: Dirasuxuie to gaaxu Ala ya ra, Ala naxa die fi e fan ma.

sentences.english: And Pharaoh gave orders to all his people, saying, Every son who comes to birth is to be put into the river, but every daughter may go on living.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Firawuna naxa a xa ɲama birin yamari, «Wo Isirayilakae xa diyɔrɛ xɛmɛe woli Nili xure ma, kɔnɔ wo e xa di ginɛe tan lu, e xa balo.»

sentences.english: Now a man of the house of Levi took as his wife a daughter of Levi.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ nun ginɛ nde naxa e boore futi, e birin fatan Lewi bɔnsɔɛ nan na Isirayilakae ya ma.

sentences.english: And she became with child and gave birth to a Son; and when she saw that he was a beautiful child, she kept him secretly for three months.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ naxa tɛɛgɛ, a di xɛmɛ bari. A to a to di fanyi nan nu a ra, a naxa a nɔxun kike saxan.

sentences.english: And when she was no longer able to keep him secret, she made him a basket out of the stems of water-plants, pasting sticky earth over it to keep the water out; and placing the baby in it she put it among the plants by the edge of the Nile.
sentences.susu: A to mu nu nɔma a nɔxunde sɔnɔn, a naxa kɔlimɛ debe maso dole ra, a diyɔrɛ sa a kui, a fa debe dɔxɔ Nili xure ma yoforoe tagi.

sentences.english: And his sister took her place at a distance to see what would become of him.
sentences.susu: Na diyɔrɛ taara ginɛma nu tixi yire nde, a ya tixi a xunya ra, alako a xa a kolon fe naxan fama na lide.

sentences.english: Now Pharaoh's daughter came down to the Nile to take a bath, while her women were walking by the riverside; and she saw the basket among the river-plants, and sent her servant-girl to get it.
sentences.susu: Firawuna xa di ginɛ naxa goro Nili xure ma a maxade. A to debe to yoforoe tagi, a naxa a xa konyi ginɛ nde xɛɛ a tongode.

sentences.english: And opening it, she saw the child, and he was crying. And she had pity on him, and said, This is one of the Hebrews' children.
sentences.susu: A to a rabi, a naxa di xɛmɛ to a kui, a wafe. A naxa kinikini a ma, a fa a fala, «Isirayilaka nde xa di na a ra!»

sentences.english: Then his sister said to Pharaoh's daughter, May I go and get you one of the Hebrew women to give him the breast?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, diyɔrɛ taara naxa Firawuna xa di ginɛ maxɔrin, «N xa siga Isirayila dingɛ nde xili i bɛ, a xa fa xiɲɛ fi a ma?»

sentences.english: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Go. And the girl went and got the child's mother.
sentences.susu: Firawuna xa di ginɛ naxa a yaabi, «Iyo.» Diyɔrɛ taara naxa siga, a sa diyɔrɛ nga xili.

sentences.english: And Pharaoh's daughter said to her, Take the child away and give it milk for me, and I will give you payment. And the woman took the child and gave it milk at her breast.
sentences.susu: Firawuna xa di ginɛ naxa a fala diyɔrɛ nga bɛ, «Yi diyɔrɛ xanin, i xa xiɲɛ fi a ma n bɛ. N i sare fima nɛ.» Diyɔrɛ nga naxa diyɔrɛ tongo, a xiɲɛ fi a ma.

sentences.english: And when the child was older, she took him to Pharaoh's daughter and he became her son, and she gave him the name Moses, Because, she said, I took him out of the water.
sentences.susu: Diyɔrɛ to mɔ, a nga naxa a xanin Firawuna xa di ginɛ xɔn ma, a findi na xa di ra. A to a raminixi ye nan xɔɔra, a naxa a xili sa Munsa, naxan falaxi «minife» Eburu xui ra.

sentences.english: Now when Moses had become a man, one day he went out to his people and saw how hard their work was; and he saw an Egyptian giving blows to a Hebrew, one of his people.
sentences.susu: Munsa to fonikeya rakamali, a naxa siga a ngaxakerenyie yire, a xa e xun mato a ra e xa wali xɔrɔxɔɛ kui. A to a ngaxakerenyie yire li, a naxa Misiraka nde to Isirayilaka nde bɔnbɔ ra.

sentences.english: And turning this way and that, and seeing no one, he put the Egyptian to death, covering his body with sand.
sentences.susu: A to mu mixi yo to na longori, a naxa na Misiraka faxa, a fa a fure nɔxun mɛyɛnyi kui.

sentences.english: And he went out the day after and saw two of the Hebrews fighting: and he said to him who was in the wrong, Why are you fighting your brother?
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Munsa man naxa mini, a Isirayilaka firin to sɔnxɔ ra. A naxa mixi maxɔrin nɔndi mu na naxan bɛ, «I bariboore bɔnbɔfe munfe ra?»

sentences.english: And he said, Who made you a ruler and a judge over us? are you going to put me to death as you did the Egyptian? And Moses was in fear, and said, It is clear that the thing has come to light.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «Nde i findixi mangɛ nun kiitisa ra muxu xun ma? I wama n fan faxafe nɛ, alɔ i na Misiraka faxa ki naxɛ?» Munsa naxa gaaxu. A naxa a fala a bɔɲɛ ma, «N naxan nabaxi a bara kolon.»

sentences.english: Now when Pharaoh had news of this, he would have put Moses to death. But Moses went in flight from Pharaoh into the land of Midian: and he took his seat by a water-spring.
sentences.susu: Firawuna to a kolon Munsa naxan nabaxi, a naxa kata Munsa faxade. Kɔnɔ Munsa naxa a gi Firawuna ma, a sa sabati Madiyan bɔxi ma. Munsa to siga naa, a naxa kɔlɔnyi nde li, a fa dɔxɔ a xa a malabu.

sentences.english: Now the priest of Midian had seven daughters: and they came to get water for their father's flock.
sentences.susu: Madiyan sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa di ginɛ solofere naxa fa ye bade na kɔlɔnyi yire e baba xa xurusee bɛ.

sentences.english: And the keepers of the sheep came up and were driving them away; but Moses got up and came to their help, watering their flock for them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xuruse dɛmadonyi ndee fan naxa fa, e naxa wa na ginɛe kerife. Munsa to na to, a naxa keli, a na ginɛe xun magere so, a fa ye fi e xa xurusee ma.

sentences.english: And when they came to Reuel their father, he said, How is it that you have come back so quickly today?
sentences.susu: Na ginɛe to gbilen e baba Reyuweli yire, a naxa e maxɔrin, «Munse a niyaxi wo gbilenxi sinnanyi ma to?»

sentences.english: And they said, An Egyptian came to our help against the keepers of sheep and got water for us and gave it to the flock.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Misiraka nde bara muxu ratanga xuruse dɛmadonyi kobie ma, a man fa ye ba won ma xurusee bɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said to his daughters, Where is he? why have you let the man go? make him come in and give him a meal.
sentences.susu: Reyuweli naxa a xa di ginɛe maxɔrin, «A na minden? Wo a luxi naa munfe ra? Wo sa a xili, wo donse so a yi ra.»

sentences.english: And Moses was happy to go on living with the man; and he gave his daughter Zipporah to Moses.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa tin sabatide Reyuweli xɔnyi. Reyuweli naxa a xa di ginɛ Sipora fi Munsa ma, a xa a dɔxɔ.

sentences.english: And she gave birth to a son, to whom he gave the name Gershom: for he said, I have been living in a strange land.
sentences.susu: Sipora naxa di xɛmɛ bari a bɛ. Xɔɲɛ nan to lanxi Munsa ma na bɔxi ma, a naxa a xa di xili sa Gerisomi, naxan wama a falafe, «Xɔɲɛ nan n na yi bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: Now after a long time the king of Egypt came to his end: and the children of Israel were crying in their grief under the weight of their work, and their cry for help came to the ears of God.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ wuyaxi dangi xanbi, Misira mangɛ naxa faxa. Isirayilakae nu e mawafe Ala bɛ e xa konyiya xɔrɔxɔɛ xa fe ra. Na maxandi naxa Ala li.

sentences.english: And at the sound of their weeping the agreement which God had made with Abraham and Isaac and Jacob came to his mind.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa e wa xui mɛ. A naxa ratu a xa saatɛ ma naxan xirixi a tan nun Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Yaxuba tagi.

sentences.english: And God's eyes were turned to the children of Israel and he gave them the knowledge of himself.
sentences.susu: Na kui Ala naxa a ya rafindi Isirayilakae ma, a xa a ɲɛngi sa e xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Now Moses was looking after the flock of Jethro, his father-in-law, the priest of Midian: and he took the flock to the back of the waste land and came to Horeb, the mountain of God.
sentences.susu: Munsa bitanyi Yetiro nan nu na Madiyan sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra. Munsa naxa Yetiro xa xurusee xanin wula i yire makuye, han a sa Ala xa geya Xorebe li.

sentences.english: And the angel of the Lord was seen by him in a flame of fire coming out of a thorn-tree: and he saw that the tree was on fire, but it was not burned up.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni Alatala xa malekɛ naxa mini a ma wuri bili lanmadi ma, naxan radɛxɛxi. Munsa naxa a mato, tɛ nu na na wuri bili ma, kɔnɔ wuri bili mu ganxi.

sentences.english: And Moses said, I will go and see this strange thing, why the tree is not burned up,
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a fala a yɛtɛ ma, «N xa n makɔrɛ yi kaabanako ra, n xa a kolon munfe ra wuri bili lanma mu ganxi.»

sentences.english: And when the Lord saw him turning to one side to see, God said his name out of the tree, crying, Moses, Moses. And he said, Here am I.
sentences.susu: Alatala to Munsa to a makɔrɔxi wuri bili ra alako a xa a igbɛ, a naxa a xili kelife na wuri bili ma, «Munsa, Munsa!» Munsa naxa a ratin, «N tan nan ya.»

sentences.english: And he said, Do not come near: take off your shoes from your feet, for the place where you are is holy.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen a bɛ, «I naxa i makɔrɛ be ra. Sankirie ba, barima i tixi yire sɛniyɛnxi nan ma.»

sentences.english: And he said, I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. And Moses kept his face covered for fear of looking on God.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a masen, «I baba Marigi Ala na n tan na, Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Yaxuba Marigi Ala.» Munsa to na mɛ, a naxa a yatagi makoto, barima a nu gaaxuxi Ala matofe ra.

sentences.english: And God said, Truly, I have seen the grief of my people in Egypt, and their cry because of their cruel masters has come to my ears; for I have knowledge of their sorrows;
sentences.susu: Alatala man naxa yi masenyi ti Munsa bɛ, «N bara n ma ɲama xa tɔɔrɛ to Misira bɔxi ma. N bara e wa xui mɛ e xa konyiya kui. N ɲɛngi saxi e xa tɔɔrɛ xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And I have come down to take them out of the hands of the Egyptians, guiding them out of that land into a good land and wide, into a land flowing with milk and honey; into the place of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite.
sentences.susu: N goroxi na nan ma, n xa fa e bade Misirakae yi ra, n xa e raso bɔxi fanyi ma, lude gbegbe na dɛnnaxɛ. Xiɲɛ nun kumi gbo naa, Kanaankae, Xitikae, Amorikae, Perisikae, Hiwikae nun Yebusukae xɔnyi.

sentences.english: For now, truly, the cry of the children of Israel has come to me, and I have seen the cruel behaviour of the Egyptians to them.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi Isirayilakae wa xui bara n li. N man bara ɲaxankatɛ to Misirakae naxan dɔxɔfe e ma.

sentences.english: Come, then, and I will send you to Pharaoh, so that you may take my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Siga, n bara i xɛɛ Firawuna xɔn, i xa n ma ɲama Isirayila ramini Misira.»

sentences.english: And Moses said to God, Who am I to go to Pharaoh and take the children of Israel out of Egypt?
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a fala Ala bɛ, «Mixi mɔɔli mundun na n tan na, n xa siga Firawuna ma Isirayilakae raminife ra Misira?»

sentences.english: And he said, Truly I will be with you; and this will be the sign to you that I have sent you: when you have taken the children of Israel out of Egypt, you will give worship to God on this mountain.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a yaabi, «Won birin na a ra. I na gɛ ɲama raminide Misira bɔxi ma, wo fama n batude yi geya nan fari. Na findima tɔnxuma ra, fa a fala, n tan yati nan i xɛɛxi.»

sentences.english: And Moses said to God, When I come to the children of Israel and say to them, The God of your fathers has sent me to you: and they say to me, What is his name? what am I to say to them?
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a fala Ala bɛ, «N na sa a fala Isirayilakae bɛ, ‹Wo benbae Marigi Ala nan n xɛɛxi wo ma,› e fa sa n maxɔrin i xili ma, n yaabi mundun fima e ma?»

sentences.english: And God said to him, I AM WHAT I AM: and he said, Say to the children of Israel, I AM has sent me to you.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «N na ‹naxan na› na. I xa Isirayilakae yaabi, ‹Ala naxan na, a bara n xɛɛ wo ma.›»

sentences.english: And God went on to say to Moses, Say to the children of Israel, The Lord, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has sent me to you: this is my name for ever, and this is my sign to all generations.
sentences.susu: Ala man naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «I fama wɔyɛnde yi ki nɛ Isirayilakae bɛ, ‹Wo benba Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Yaxuba Marigi Alatala, Ala naxan na, na nan n xɛɛxi wo ma.› N xili nan na ki abadan, n wama mixi birin xa n xili na ki nɛ tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Go and get together the chiefs of the children of Israel, and say to them, The Lord, the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has been seen by me, and has said, Truly I have taken up your cause, because of what is done to you in Egypt;
sentences.susu: Sa Isirayila kuntigie malan, i a fala e bɛ, ‹Wo benba Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Yaxuba Marigi Alatala bara mini n ma. A bara a masen n bɛ, «N bara fe to e naxan dɔxɔfe wo ma Misira.

sentences.english: And I have said, I will take you up out of the sorrows of Egypt into the land of the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite, into a land flowing with milk and honey.
sentences.susu: N bara natɛ tongo wo raminife ra Misira wo xa tɔɔrɛ kui. N xa wo xanin Kanaankae, Xitikae, Amorikae, Perisikae, Hiwikae, nun Yebusukae xɔnyi, xiɲɛ nun kumi xɛlɛma dɛnnaxɛ.»›»

sentences.english: And they will give ear to your voice: and you, with the chiefs of Israel, will go to Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and say to him, The Lord, the God of the Hebrews, has come to us: let us then go three days' journey into the waste land to make an offering to the Lord our God.
sentences.susu: «Isirayila kuntigie na gɛ i xui ramɛde, wo sigama nɛ Misira mangɛ yire a falafe ra, ‹Isirayilakae Marigi Alatala bara fa muxu fɔxɔ ra. I xa muxu sago sa muxu xa fɛɛɲɛn saxan ɲɛrɛ raba gbengberenyi ma, alako muxu xa sɛrɛxɛe ba muxu Marigi Alatala bɛ.›

sentences.english: And I am certain that the king of Egypt will not let you go without being forced.
sentences.susu: N a kolon Misira mangɛ mu tinma wo lude wo xa siga, xa n mu n sɛnbɛ masen a bɛ.

sentences.english: But I will put out my hand and overcome Egypt with all the wonders which I will do among them: and after that he will let you go.
sentences.susu: Na kui n fe magaaxuxie rabama nɛ Misirakae ra, n e tɔɔrɔ kaabanakoe ra. Na dangi xanbi, e xa mangɛ tinma nɛ wo xa siga.

sentences.english: And I will give this people grace in the eyes of the Egyptians, so that when you go out you will go out with your hands full.
sentences.susu: N man a ragirima nɛ Misirakae xa wo ki, alako wo naxa siga wo bɛlɛxɛ igeli ra.

sentences.english: For every woman will get from her neighbour and from the woman living in her house, ornaments of silver and gold, and clothing; and you will put them on your sons and your daughters; you will take the best of their goods from the Egyptians.
sentences.susu: Isirayila ginɛ birin xa e dɔxɔboore Misirakae makula yirabase gbeti nun xɛɛma daaxie ra, a nun sosee, wo naxee soma wo xa die ma. Na kui wo harige bama nɛ Misirakae yi ra.»

sentences.english: And Moses, answering, said, It is certain that they will not have faith in me or give ear to my voice; for they will say, You have not seen the Lord.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Alatala maxɔrin, «Xa Isirayilakae mu sa la n ma masenyi ra, e fa a fala, ‹Alatala mu minixi i ma feo,› n munse rabama fa?»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to him, What is that in your hand? And he said, A rod.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a maxɔrin, «Munse na i bɛlɛxɛ na ki?» A naxa a yaabi, «N ma yisuxuwuri.»

sentences.english: And he said, Put it down on the earth. And he put it down on the earth and it became a snake; and Moses went running from it.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a yamari, «A woli bɔxi.» A to a woli bɔxi, na naxa mafindi bɔximase ra, Munsa fa a gi a ya ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Put out your hand and take it by the tail: (and he put out his hand and took a grip of it and it became a rod in his hand:)
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «I bɛlɛxɛ itala i xa a suxu a xuli ma.» Munsa naxa a bɛlɛxɛ itala. A to a suxu a bɛlɛxɛ ra, na naxa findi yisuxuwuri ra.

sentences.english: So that they may be certain that the Lord, the God of their fathers, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, has been seen by you.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «Na findima tɔnxuma ra e bɛ, fa a fala, e benba Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Yaxuba Marigi Alatala bara mini i ma.»

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to him again, Put your hand inside your clothing. And he put his hand inside his robe: and when he took it out it was like the hand of a leper, as white as snow.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Alatala man naxa a masen a bɛ, «I bɛlɛxɛ sa i kanke ma i xa donma bun ma.» A to na raba, a fa a ramini, kunɛ a bɛlɛxɛ rafiixɛxi.

sentences.english: And he said, Put your hand inside your robe again. (And he put his hand into his robe again, and when he took it out he saw that it had become like his other flesh.)
sentences.susu: A man naxa a yamari, «I man xa i bɛlɛxɛ sa i kanke ma i xa donma bun ma.» A to na raba, a bɛlɛxɛ naxa yalan keren na.

sentences.english: And if they do not have faith in you or give ear to the voice of the first sign, they will have faith in the second sign.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «Xa Isirayilakae mu la i xui ra, xa na mu a ra na tɔnxuma singe ra, tɛmunde e fama nɛ lade i ra na tɔnxuma firin nde xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And if they have no faith even in these two signs and will not give ear to your voice, then you are to take the water of the Nile and put it on the dry land: and the water you take out of the river will become blood on the dry land.
sentences.susu: Xa e mu la i xui ra na tɔnxuma firinyie xa fe ra, i xa ye tongo Nili xure, i a rafili bɔxi ma. A findima nɛ wuli ra keren na.»

sentences.english: And Moses said to the Lord, O Lord, I am not a man of words; I have never been so, and am not now, even after what you have said to your servant: for talking is hard for me, and I am slow of tongue.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Alatala yaabi, «N Marigi, i a kolon i xa konyi mu fata wɔyɛnde. N nɛnyi binya n dɛ i kabi n dimɛdi tɛmui. To masenyi mu na fe masaraxi.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to him, Who has made man's mouth? who takes away a man's voice or hearing, or makes him seeing or blind? Is it not I, the Lord?
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «Nde mixi nɛnyi rakelima? Nde mixi findima boboe ra, xa na mu tulixɔri? Nde mixi findima ya kanyi ra, xa na mu dɔnxui? N tan Alatala xa mu a ra?

sentences.english: So go now, and I will be with your mouth, teaching you what to say.
sentences.susu: Siga. N i malima masenyi tide. N masenyi yati rasoma nɛ i dɛ i, i naxan tima.»

sentences.english: And he said, O Lord, send, if you will, by the hand of anyone whom it seems good to you to send.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a yaabi, «N Marigi, yandi, mixi gbɛtɛ xɛɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord was angry with Moses, and said, Is there not Aaron, your brother, the Levite? To my knowledge he is good at talking. And now he is coming out to you: and when he sees you he will be glad in his heart.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala naxa xɔnɔ Munsa ma. A naxa a masen a bɛ, «I taara Haruna go? Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mu a ra? N a kolon, na tan fata wɔyɛnde. A ɲan na fafe i ralande. A sɛɛwama nɛ i tofe ra.

sentences.english: Let him give ear to your voice, and you will put my words in his mouth; and I will be with your mouth and with his, teaching you what you have to do.
sentences.susu: I masenyie tima nɛ a bɛ, a naxan falama ɲama bɛ. N wo firin malima na kui. N a masenma wo bɛ wo lan wo xa naxan fala.

sentences.english: And he will do the talking for you to the people: he will be to you as a mouth and you will be to him as God.
sentences.susu: Haruna i xui madangima ɲama bɛ, alɔ namiɲɔnmɛ Ala xui madangima ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And take in your hand this rod with which you will do the signs.
sentences.susu: I xa i xa yisuxuwuri tongo. I kaabanako birin nabama a tan na.»

sentences.english: And Moses went back to Jethro, his father-in-law, and said to him, Let me go back now to my relations in Egypt and see if they are still living. And Jethro said to Moses, Go in peace.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Munsa naxa gbilen a bitanyi xɔnyi, a a fala a bɛ, «N wama sigafe ngaxakerenyie yire Misira bɔxi ma, n xa a kolon e xa fe na ki naxɛ.» Yetiro naxa a yaabi, «Siga bɔɲɛsa kui.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses in Midian, Go back to Egypt, for all the men are dead who were attempting to take your life.
sentences.susu: Alatala nu bara a masen Munsa bɛ Madiyan bɔxi ma, «I xa gbilen Misira. Naxee nu wama i faxafe, nee birin bara faxa.»

sentences.english: And Moses took his wife and his sons and put them on an ass and went back to the land of Egypt: and he took the rod of God in his hand.
sentences.susu: Na kui Munsa naxa a xa ginɛ nun a xa die baki sofalee fari, e gbilen Misira. Munsa naxa a xa yisuxuwuri fan xanin, Ala naxan ma fe fala a bɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, When you go back to Egypt, see that you do before Pharaoh all the wonders which I have given you power to do: but I will make his heart hard and he will not let the people go.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti Munsa bɛ, «I na gbilen Misira, i xa kaabanako birin naba Firawuna ya i, n naxee saxi i sagoe. Na tɛmui n tan nan a xaxili raxɔrɔxɔma, alako a naxa tin n ma ɲama bɛɲinde.

sentences.english: And you are to say to Pharaoh, The Lord says, Israel is the first of my sons:
sentences.susu: I xa a fala Firawuna bɛ, ‹Alatala xui nan ya, Isirayila, n ma di singe nan a ra.

sentences.english: And I said to you, Let my son go, so that he may give me worship; and you did not let him go: so now I will put the first of your sons to death.
sentences.susu: N bara i yamari i xa a bɛɲin alako a xa siga n batude. I to bara tondi na ra, n i xa di singe faxama nɛ.›»

sentences.english: Now on the journey, at the night's resting-place, the Lord came in his way and would have put him to death.
sentences.susu: Munsa to nu na biyaasi kui sigafe ra Misira, Alatala naxa mini a ma kɔɛ ra, a xa a faxa,

sentences.english: Then Zipporah took a sharp stone, and cutting off the skin of her son's private parts, and touching his feet with it, she said, Truly you are a husband of blood to me.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Munsa xa ginɛ Sipora naxa a xa di xɛmɛ sunna gɛmɛ xɛɲɛnxi ra, a na soli sa a sanyi ma. A naxa a fala, «N ma mɔri nan i ra, muxu nun naxan wuli keren.»

sentences.english: So he let him go. Then she said, You are a husband of blood because of the circumcision.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala naxa Munsa lu na. Sipora xa masenyi, «N ma mɔri nan i ra, muxu nun naxan wuli keren,» a nu wama sunnɛ wuli nan xa fe falafe.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Aaron, Go into the waste land and you will see Moses. So he went and came across Moses at the mountain of God, and gave him a kiss.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Haruna bɛ, «I xa siga Munsa ralande gbengberenyi ma.» A to naralan Munsa ra Ala xa geya ma, a naxa a sunbu.

sentences.english: And Moses gave Aaron an account of all the words of the Lord which he had sent him to say, and of all the signs which he had given him orders to do.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Alatala xa xɛɛraya birin ya ba a bɛ. A naxa na kaabanako fee fan fala a bɛ, Ala naxan fixi a ma a rabafe ra.

sentences.english: Then Moses and Aaron went and got together all the chiefs of the children of Israel:
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Haruna to Isirayilakae li, e naxa Isirayila fori birin malan.

sentences.english: And Aaron said to them all the words the Lord had said to Moses, and did the signs before all the people.
sentences.susu: Haruna naxa dɛntɛgɛ sa e bɛ Alatala naxan masenxi Munsa bɛ. A naxa kaabanakoe fan naba ɲama ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And the people had faith in them; and hearing that the Lord had taken up the cause of the children of Israel and had seen their troubles, with bent heads they gave him worship.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa la na birin na. E to a kolon a Alatala ɲɛngi saxi Isirayilakae xɔn ma e xa tɔɔrɛ kui, e naxa e igoro bɔxi, e suyidi Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: And after that, Moses and Aaron came to Pharaoh, and said, The Lord, the God of Israel, says, Let my people go so that they may keep a feast to me in the waste land.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Munsa nun Haruna naxa siga Firawuna yire. E naxa a fala a bɛ, «Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, ‹N ma ɲama bɛɲin, alako e xa siga n ma sali rabade gbengberenyi ma.›»

sentences.english: And Pharaoh said, Who is the Lord, to whose voice I am to give ear and let Israel go? I have no knowledge of the Lord and I will not let Israel go.
sentences.susu: Firawuna naxa yi maxɔrinyi ti, «Nde tan na na Alatala ra, n lan n xa naxan xa yaamari rabatu Isirayila bɛɲinfe ra? N mu Alatala kolon! Na kui, n mu nɔma a lude Isirayila xa siga fefe ma!»

sentences.english: And they said, The God of the Hebrews has come to us: let us then go three days' journey into the waste land to make an offering to the Lord our God, so that he may not send death on us by disease or the sword.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala a bɛ, «Isirayila Marigi Ala bara fa muxu fɔxɔ ra. A lu muxu xa biyaasi xi saxan gbengberenyi yire, alako muxu xa sɛrɛxɛe ba muxu Marigi Alatala bɛ, xa muxu mu na raba muxu sɔntɔma nɛ wuganyi ra, xa na mu santidɛgɛma ra.»

sentences.english: And the king of Egypt said to them, Why do you, Moses and Aaron, take the people away from their work? get back to your work.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa e yaabi, «Munsa nun Haruna, munfe ra wo wama ɲama bafe wali dɛ i? Wo siga wo xa wali ra.

sentences.english: And Pharaoh said, Truly, the people of the land are increasing in number, and you are keeping them back from their work.
sentences.susu: Yi ɲama to bara gbo yɛ yi bɔxi ma, wo wama e xa wali nan xun nakanafe fa.»

sentences.english: The same day Pharaoh gave orders to the overseers and those who were responsible for the work, saying,
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Firawuna naxa konyie xa mangɛe nun wali xunyie yamari,

sentences.english: Give these men no more dry stems for their brick-making as you have been doing; let them go and get the material for themselves.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa sɛxɛ so Isirayila ɲama yi ra sɔnɔn, e naxan malanma boora ra e biriki bɔnbɔma tɛmui naxɛ. Yakɔsi e xa na sɛxɛ fen e yɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: But see that they make the same number of bricks as before, and no less: for they have no love for work; and so they are crying out and saying, Let us go and make an offering to our God.
sentences.susu: E dari biriki xasabi naxan bɔnbɔ ra, wo naxa sese ba na ra. Fuyante nan e ra. Na nan a ra, e a falama, ‹Muxu xa siga sɛrɛxɛ bade muxu Marigi Ala bɛ.›

sentences.english: Give the men harder work, and see that they do it; let them not give attention to false words.
sentences.susu: Wo xa nde sa e xa wali xun ma, alako e naxa yanfa wali ma madaxui wɔyɛnyi xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And the overseers of the people and their responsible men went out and said to the people, Pharaoh says, I will give you no more dry stems.
sentences.susu: Konyi xa mangɛe nun wali xunyie naxa a fala Isirayila ɲama bɛ, «Firawuna naxɛ a a mu sɛxɛ soma wo yi ra sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Go yourselves and get dry stems wherever you are able; for your work is not to be any less.
sentences.susu: Wo xa siga na fende wo yɛtɛ ra. Wo xa a kolon sese mu bama wo xa wali kote ra.»

sentences.english: So the people were sent in all directions through the land of Egypt to get dry grass for stems.
sentences.susu: Na kui ɲama naxa yensen Misira bɔxi sɛxɛ xabade.

sentences.english: And the overseers went on driving them and saying, Do your full day's work as before when there were dry stems for you.
sentences.susu: Mangɛe nu e ragbatama nɛ, e nu fa a fala, «Wo xa wo xa wali raɲɔn lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ alɔ a singe, sɛxɛ nu soma wo yi ra tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And the responsible men of the children of Israel, whom Pharaoh's overseers had put over them, were given blows, and they said to them, Why have you not done your regular work, in making bricks as before?
sentences.susu: Firawuna xa mixie nu fa Isirayilakae bɔnbɔ naxee nu tixi wali xunyie ra. E nu fa e maxɔrin, «Munfe ra xoro nun to, wo mu biriki xasabi bɔnbɔxi alɔ wo darixi a ra ki naxɛ?»

sentences.english: Then the responsible men of the children of Israel came to Pharaoh, protesting and saying, Why are you acting in this way to your servants?
sentences.susu: Isirayila wali xunyie naxa siga e mawade Firawuna xɔn a falafe ra, «I na yi mɔɔli rabafe muxu tan i xa konyie ra munfe ra?

sentences.english: They give us no dry stems and they say to us, Make bricks: and they give your servants blows; but it is your people who are in the wrong.
sentences.susu: E mu sɛxɛ yo soma muxu yi ra, kɔnɔ e a falama a muxu xa biriki bɔnbɔ! I xa mixie na muxu tan i xa konyi bɔnbɔfe, kɔnɔ e tan nan wali kanaxi.»

sentences.english: But he said, You have no love for work: that is why you say, Let us go and make an offering to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Firawuna naxa e yaabi, «Fuyantee nan wo ra. Na nan a toxi wo a falama, a wo xa siga sɛrɛxɛ bade Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: Go now, get back to your work; no dry stems will be given to you, but you are to make the full number of bricks.
sentences.susu: Wo siga walide! Sɛxɛ yo mu soma wo yi ra, sese man mu bama wo xa biriki kɔnti ra.»

sentences.english: Then the responsible men of the children of Israel saw that they were purposing evil when they said, The number of bricks which you have to make every day will be no less than before.
sentences.susu: Isirayila wali xunyie naxa kɔntɔfili na wɔyɛnyi ra, a falafe ra, «Sese mu bama birikie kɔnti ra wo naxan bɔnbɔma lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ.»

sentences.english: And they came face to face with Moses and Aaron, who were in their way when they came out from Pharaoh:
sentences.susu: E to mini Firawuna xɔnyi, e naxa Munsa nun Haruna li naa. E nu na e mɛmɛfe.

sentences.english: And they said to them, May the Lord take note of you and be your judge; for you have given Pharaoh and his servants a bad opinion of us, putting a sword in their hands for our destruction.
sentences.susu: Na wali xunyie naxa a fala e bɛ, «Alatala xa wo ɲaxankata, barima wo bara muxu maɲaaxu Firawuna nun a xa mixie xɔn ma. Wo bara santidɛgɛma sa e bɛlɛxɛ, e xa muxu faxa.»

sentences.english: And Moses went back to the Lord and said, Lord, why have you done evil to this people? why have you sent me?
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa gbilen Alatala ma a falafe ra, «Marigi, i bara yi tɔɔrɛ dɔxɔ yi ɲama ma munfe ra? I n xɛɛxi be munfe ma?

sentences.english: For from the time when I came to Pharaoh to put your words before him, he has done evil to this people, and you have given them no help.
sentences.susu: Kabi n naxa siga Firawuna yire wɔyɛnfe ra i xili ra, a fa fe ɲaaxi nan tun nabafe yi ɲama ra. I mu i xa ɲama xɔrɛyaxi feo.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Now you will see what I am about to do to Pharaoh; for by a strong hand he will be forced to let them go, driving them out of his land because of my outstretched arm.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «I fama a tode yakɔsi, n naxan nabama Firawuna ra. N sɛnbɛ nan fama a niyade a xa Isirayila ɲama bɛɲin, a yɛtɛ xa e keri a xa bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And God said to Moses, I am Yahweh:
sentences.susu: Ala man naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «N tan nan Alatala ra.

sentences.english: I let myself be seen by Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, as God, the Ruler of all; but they had no knowledge of my name Yahweh.
sentences.susu: N naxa n yɛtɛ masen Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Yaxuba bɛ. Kɔnɔ e mu n n xili kolonxi Alatala ra. E n kolonxi Ala Sɛnbɛma xili nan na.

sentences.english: And I made an agreement with them, to give them the land of Canaan, the land of their wanderings.
sentences.susu: Muxu man naxa saata, n xa Kanaan bɔxi fi e ma, e xɔɲɛya rabaxi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And truly my ears are open to the cry of the children of Israel whom the Egyptians keep under their yoke; and I have kept in mind my agreement.
sentences.susu: N bara Isirayilakae wa xui mɛ e xa konyiya kui Misirakae yi ra. N man bara ratu n ma saatɛ ma.

sentences.english: Say then to the children of Israel, I am Yahweh, and I will take you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians, and make you safe from their power, and will make you free by the strength of my arm after great punishments.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a fala Isirayilakae bɛ, ‹N tan nan Alatala ra. N fama nɛ wo raminide Misirakae xa nɔɛ bun ma. N xɔrɛya fima nɛ wo ma. N fama nɛ wo xun sarade n sɛnbɛ ra. N ɲaxankatɛ ragoroma nɛ Misirakae ma e xa wali kobie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And I will take you to be my people and I will be your God; and you will be certain that I am the Lord your God, who takes you out from under the yoke of the Egyptians.
sentences.susu: N wo findima nɛ n ma ɲama ra. N fan findima nɛ wo Marigi ra. Na tɛmui wo a kolonma nɛ, n tan nan na wo Marigi Alatala ra, naxan wo baxi konyiya kui Misirakae yi ra.

sentences.english: And I will be your guide into the land which I made an oath to give to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; and I will give it to you for your heritage: I am Yahweh.
sentences.susu: N fama nɛ wo rasode bɔxi ma, n nakalixi naxan ma fe ra, n xa a fi Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Yaxuba ma. N fama nɛ a fide wo ma, a lu wo sagoe.›»

sentences.english: And Moses said these words to the children of Israel, but they gave no attention to him, because of the grief of their spirit and the cruel weight of their work.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa na dɛntɛgɛ Isirayilakae bɛ, kɔnɔ e mu la a xui ra e xa konyiya xɔrɔxɔɛ xa fe ra. Limaniya birin nu bara ba e yi.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Go in and say to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, that he is to let the children of Israel go out of his land.
sentences.susu: «Siga Misira mangɛ yire. A fala Firawuna bɛ a xa Isirayila ɲama bɛɲin, e xa mini a xa bɔxi ra.»

sentences.english: And Moses, answering the Lord, said, See, the children of Israel will not give ear to me; how then will Pharaoh give ear to me, whose lips are unclean?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Munsa naxa Alatala yaabi, «Xa Isirayilakae yati mu laxi n xui ra, Firawuna fan mu n xui suxuma feo, n tan naxan ɲan mu fata wɔyɛnde.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to Moses and Aaron, with orders for the children of Israel and for Pharaoh, king of Egypt, to take the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Alatala masenyi ti Munsa nun Haruna bɛ na ki nɛ, Isirayilakae nun Misira mangɛ Firawuna xa fe ra. A e yamari nɛ e xa Isirayilakae ramini Misira bɔxi ra.

sentences.english: These are the heads of their fathers' families: the sons of Reuben the oldest son of Israel: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi: these are the families of Reuben.
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ yareratie nan yi ki: Ruben naxan singe bari Isirayila, a xa die nan ya: Xanɔki, Palu, Xesiron, nun Karimi. Ruben bɔnsɔɛ nan na ki.

sentences.english: And the sons of Simeon: Jemuel and Jamin and Ohad and Jachin and Zohar and Shaul, the son of a woman of Canaan: these are the families of Simeon.
sentences.susu: Simeyɔn xa die nan ya: Yemuweli, Yamin, Ohadi, Yakin, Soxara, nun ginɛ Kanaanka xa di Sawulu. Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ nan na ki.

sentences.english: And these are the names of the sons of Levi in the order of their generations: Gershon and Kohath and Merari: and the years of Levi's life were a hundred and thirty-seven.
sentences.susu: Lewi xa die xilie nan yi ki e xa taruxui ki ma: Gerison, Kehati, nun Merari. Lewi xa simaya naxa ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ tongo saxan a nun solofere li.

sentences.english: The sons of Gershon: Libni and Shimei, in the order of their families.
sentences.susu: Gerison xa die findixi Libini nun Simeyi nan na e xabilɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: And the sons of Kohath: Amram and Izhar and Hebron and Uzziel: and the years of Kohath's life were a hundred and thirty-three.
sentences.susu: Kehati xa die findixi Amarama, Yisehari, Xebiron, nun Yusiyɛli nan na e xabilɛ ki ma. Kehati xa simaya naxa ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ tongo saxan a nun saxan li.

sentences.english: And the sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi: these are the families of the Levites, in the order of their generations.
sentences.susu: Merari xa die findixi Maxali nun Musi nan na. Lewi xa die nan na ki e taruxui ki ma.

sentences.english: And Amram took Jochebed, his father's sister, as wife; and she gave birth to Aaron and Moses: and the years of Amram's life were a hundred and thirty-seven.
sentences.susu: Amarama naxa a baba barenyi Yebedi dɔxɔ, naxan Haruna nun Munsa bari a bɛ. Amarama xa simaya naxa ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ tongo saxan a nun solofere li.

sentences.english: And the sons of Izhar: Korah and Nepheg and Zichri.
sentences.susu: Yisehari xa die nan ya: Kora, Nefegi, nun Sikiri.

sentences.english: And the sons of Uzziel: Mishael and Elzaphan and Sithri.
sentences.susu: Yusiyɛli xa die nan ya: Misayeli, Elesafana, nun Sitiri.

sentences.english: And Aaron took as his wife Elisheba, the daughter of Amminadab, the sister of Nahshon; and she gave birth to Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
sentences.susu: Haruna naxa Aminadabo xa di Eliseeba dɔxɔ, naxan findixi Naxason maaginɛ ra. A naxa Nadabo, Abihu, Eleyasari, nun Itamari bari Haruna bɛ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Korah: Assir and Elkanah and Abiasaph: these are the families of the Korahites.
sentences.susu: Kora xa die nan ya: Asiri, Elekana, nun Abiyasafi a xabilɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: And Eleazar, Aaron's son, took as his wife one of the daughters of Putiel; and she gave birth to Phinehas. These are the heads of the families of the Levites, in the order of their families.
sentences.susu: Haruna xa di Eleyasari naxa Putiyeli xa di ginɛ dɔxɔ. A naxa Finexasi bari a bɛ. Lewi bɔnsɔɛ yareratie nan na ki e xabilɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: These are the same Aaron and Moses to whom the Lord said, Take the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt in their armies.
sentences.susu: Alatala Haruna nun Munsa yamari nɛ, «Wo Isirayilakae ramini Misira bɔxi ra e lanxundɛ ki ma.»

sentences.english: These are the men who gave orders to Pharaoh to let the children of Israel go out of Egypt: these are the same Moses and Aaron.
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Haruna nan wɔyɛn Misira mangɛ Firawuna bɛ Isirayilakae raminife ra Misira kui.

sentences.english: And on the day when the word of the Lord came to Moses in the land of Egypt,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti Munsa bɛ Misira bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: The Lord said to Moses, I am the Lord: say to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, everything I am saying to you.
sentences.susu: «N tan nan na Alatala ra. Siga, n xui birin nadangi Misira mangɛ Firawuna ma.»

sentences.english: And Moses said to the Lord, My lips are unclean; how is it possible that Pharaoh will give me a hearing?
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Alatala yaabi, «N tan nan yi ki, n mu fata wɔyɛnde a fanyi ra. Firawuna nɔma tinde n ma masenyi ra di?»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, See I have made you a god to Pharaoh, and Aaron your brother will be your prophet.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «Haruna xa i xui madangi Firawuna bɛ alɔ namiɲɔnmɛ Ala xui madangima mixie bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Say whatever I give you orders to say: and Aaron your brother will give word to Pharaoh to let the children of Israel go out of his land.
sentences.susu: N i yamarima naxan birin na, i xa na fala i taara Haruna bɛ naxan na madangima Firawuna ma, alako a xa a lu Isirayilakae xa mini Misira bɔxi ra.

sentences.english: And I will make Pharaoh's heart hard, and my signs and wonders will be increased in the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: N Firawuna xaxili raxɔrɔxɔma nɛ. N tɔnxuma nun kaabanako gbegbe rabama nɛ Misira bɔxi kui,

sentences.english: But Pharaoh will not give ear to you, and I will put my hand on Egypt, and take my armies, my people, the children of Israel, out of Egypt, after great punishments.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Firawuna mu fama a tuli matide wo ra. N fama nɛ ɲaxankatɛ xɔrɔxɔɛe dɔxɔde Misira ma, n fa n ma ɲama Isirayila ramini a lanxundɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: And the Egyptians will see that I am the Lord, when my hand is stretched out over Egypt, and I take the children of Israel out from among them.
sentences.susu: N na Misira halaki Isirayila raminife ra e tagi, e n kolonma nɛ Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: And Moses and Aaron did so: as the Lord gave them orders, so they did.
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Haruna naxa Alatala xa yaamari suxu alɔ a masenxi e bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And Moses was eighty years old, and Aaron eighty-three years old, when they gave the Lord's word to Pharaoh.
sentences.susu: E nu masenyi tima Firawuna bɛ tɛmui naxɛ, Munsa xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ tongo solomasaxan li. Haruna xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ tongo solomasaxan a nun saxan li.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa nun Haruna bɛ,

sentences.english: If Pharaoh says to you, Let me see a wonder: then say to Aaron, Take your rod and put it down on the earth before Pharaoh so that it may become a snake.
sentences.susu: «Firawuna na a fala wo bɛ, ‹Wo xa kaabanako nde raba,› i tan Munsa, i xa a fala Haruna bɛ, a xa i xa yisuxuwuri tongo, a a woli Firawuna sɛɛti ma. Na mafindima nɛ bɔximase ra.»

sentences.english: Then Moses and Aaron went in to Pharaoh and they did as the Lord had said: and Aaron put his rod down on the earth before Pharaoh and his servants, and it became a snake.
sentences.susu: Na kui Munsa nun Haruna naxa siga Firawuna yire, e fa a raba, alɔ Alatala e yamarixi ki naxɛ. Haruna naxa Munsa xa yisuxuwuri woli bɔxi ma Firawuna nun a xa kuntigie ya i, na naxa findi bɔximase ra.

sentences.english: Then Pharaoh sent for the wise men and the wonder-workers, and they, the wonder-workers of Egypt, did the same with their secret arts.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Firawuna naxa a xa karamɔxɔɛe nun a xa mandurulae xili, e xa na kaabanako mɔɔli raba e xa duureya ra.

sentences.english: For every one of them put down his rod on the earth, and they became snakes: but Aaron's rod made a meal of their rods.
sentences.susu: E nun Haruna birin naxa e xa yisuxuwurie woli bɔxi ma. Nee birin naxa mafindi bɔximasee ra, kɔnɔ Haruna gbe naxa boore gbe gerun.

sentences.english: But Pharaoh's heart was made hard, and he did not give ear to them, as the Lord had said.
sentences.susu: Na kui Firawuna xaxili naxa xɔrɔxɔ, a mu a tuli mati Munsa nun Haruna ra, alɔ Alatala nu bara a masen ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, Pharaoh's heart is unchanged; he will not let the people go.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «Firawuna xaxili bara xɔrɔxɔ. A bara tondi n ma ɲama bɛɲinde.

sentences.english: Go to Pharaoh in the morning; when he goes out to the water, you will be waiting for him by the edge of the Nile, with the rod which was turned into a snake in your hand;
sentences.susu: Tina gɛɛsɛgɛ i xa naralan Firawuna ra Nili xure dɛ. I xa i xa yisuxuwuri xanin, naxan nu bara mafindi bɔximase ra.

sentences.english: And say to him, The Lord, the God of the Hebrews, has sent me to you, saying, Let my people go so that they may give me worship in the waste land; but up to now you have not given ear to his words.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni i xa a fala Firawuna bɛ, ‹Isirayilakae Marigi Alatala bara n xɛɛ i yire, n xa a fala i bɛ, «N ma ɲama bɛɲin, alako e xa siga n batude gbengberenyi ma.» Han yakɔsi i tan mu tinxi na xui suxude.

sentences.english: So the Lord says, By this you may be certain that I am the Lord; see, by the touch of this rod in my hand the waters of the Nile will be turned to blood;
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Na nan a ra, i fama a kolonde, n tan nan Alatala ra. N ma yisuxuwuri na din Nili xure ra, ye mafindima nɛ wuli ra.

sentences.english: And the fish in the Nile will come to destruction, and the river will send up a bad smell, and the Egyptians will not be able, for disgust, to make use of the water of the Nile for drinking.
sentences.susu: Yɛxɛ naxee na Nili xure ma, e fama sɔntɔde, e xiri ɲaaxi fa mini, Misirakae mu nɔma na ye minde.»›»

sentences.english: And the Lord said, Say to Aaron, Let the rod in your hand be stretched out over the waters of Egypt, and over the rivers and the streams and the pools, and over every stretch of water, so that they may be turned to blood; and there will be blood through all the land of Egypt, in vessels of wood and in vessels of stone.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «Haruna yamari, ‹I xa i xa yisuxuwuri itala Misira baae, xuree, nun dabonyi birin ma.› Na a niyama nɛ ye birin xa mafindi wuli ra Misira bɔxi ma, hali naxee na fɛɲɛe kui, wuri nun gɛmɛ daaxi.»

sentences.english: And Moses and Aaron did as the Lord had said; and when his rod had been lifted up and stretched out over the waters of the Nile before the eyes of Pharaoh and his servants, all the water in the Nile was turned to blood;
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Haruna naxa a raba alɔ Alatala e yamarixi ki naxɛ. Haruna naxa a xa yisuxuwuri itala, a a din Nili xure ra. Xure naxa findi wuli ra Firawuna nun a xa kuntigie ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And the fish in the Nile came to destruction, and a bad smell went up from the river, and the Egyptians were not able to make use of the water of the Nile for drinking; and there was blood through all the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Yɛxɛ birin naxa faxa, e xiri ɲaaxi naxa mini Nili xure ma. Misirakae mu nu nɔma na ye minde, barima Misira ye birin findixi wuli nan na.

sentences.english: And the wonder-workers of Egypt did the same with their secret arts: but Pharaoh's heart was made hard, and he would not give ear to them, as the Lord had said.
sentences.susu: Mandurulae fan naxa na kaabanako mɔɔli raba. Firawuna xaxili naxa xɔrɔxɔ, a mu tin Munsa nun Haruna xui ra, alɔ Alatala nu bara a masen ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then Pharaoh went into his house, and did not take even this to heart.
sentences.susu: Firawuna naxa gbilen a xɔnyi, a naxa na fe bɔtɛ ba.

sentences.english: And all the Egyptians made holes round about the Nile to get drinking-water, for they were not able to make use of the Nile water.
sentences.susu: Misiraka birin naxa tigie ge Nili xure sɛɛtie ma, alako e xa ye min daaxi sɔtɔ, barima e mu nu nɔma Nili xure ye minde.

sentences.english: And seven days went past, after the Lord had put his hand on the Nile.
sentences.susu: Alatala to gɛ Nili xure garinde, xi solofere dangi xanbi,

sentences.english: And this is what the Lord said to Moses: Go to Pharaoh and say to him, The Lord says, Let my people go so that they may give me worship.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «A fala Haruna bɛ, a xa a xa yisuxuwuri itala baae, xuree, nun dabonyi birin xun ma alako lanxansarimae xa te Nili xure ma, e so Misira bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And if you will not let them go, see, I will send frogs into every part of your land:
sentences.susu: Haruna to a xa yisuxuwuri itala Misira yee xun ma, lanxansarimae naxa te Misira bɔxi birin ma.

sentences.english: The Nile will be full of frogs, and they will come up into your house and into your bedrooms and on your bed, and into the houses of your servants and your people, and into your ovens and into your bread-basins.
sentences.susu: Mandurulae fan naxa na kaabanako mɔɔli raba, e fan naxa lanxansarimae raso Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: The frogs will come up over you and your people and all your servants.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi Firawuna naxa Munsa nun Haruna xili, a a fala e bɛ, «Wo sa Alatala maxandi, alako lanxansarimae xa keli n tan nun n ma ɲama xun ma. N fama i xa ɲama rabɛɲinde, e xa siga sɛrɛxɛe bade Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Say to Aaron, Let the rod in your hand be stretched out over the streams and the waterways and the pools, causing frogs to come up on the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a fala Firawuna bɛ, «Mangɛ, i gbe binyɛ. I xa natɛ tongo lɔxɔɛ safe ra lanxansarimae xa keli i tan, i xa kuntigie, nun i xa ɲama xun ma, e xa lu Nili xure gbansan ma.»

sentences.english: And when Aaron put out his hand over the waters of Egypt, the frogs came up and all the land of Egypt was covered with them.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «Tina.» Munsa naxa a fala, «A fama rabade na ki nɛ, alako i xa a kolon, muxu Marigi Alatala maniyɛ mu na.

sentences.english: And the wonder-workers did the same with their secret arts, making frogs come up over the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Lanxansarimae fama kelide i tan, i xa kuntigie, nun i xa ɲama xun ma, e fa lu Nili xure ma.»

sentences.english: Then Pharaoh sent for Moses and Aaron and said, Make prayer to the Lord that he will take away these frogs from me and my people; and I will let the people go and make their offering to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Haruna to mini Firawuna xɔnyi, Munsa naxa Alatala maxandi lanxansarimae xa fe ra naxee nu Firawuna tɔɔrɔma.

sentences.english: And Moses said, I will let you have the honour of saying when I am to make prayer for you and your servants and your people, that the frogs may be sent away from you and your houses, and be only in the Nile.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Munsa xa maxandi suxu. Lanxansarimae naxa faxa banxie, xandɛe, nun daaxae kui.

sentences.english: And he said, By tomorrow. And he said, Let it be as you say: so that you may see that there is no other like the Lord our God.
sentences.susu: Mixie naxa e koto, e xiri ɲaaxi fa din bɔxi birin na.
