sentences.susu: Tɛtɛ sode dɛ xa yailan suwa dugi ra naxan masɔxɔxi gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi nun gɛsɛ bulu daaxi nun gɛsɛ gbeeli ra. Na dugi xa nɔngɔn xa mɔxɔɲɛn sɔtɔ. Na xa gbaku wuri naani ma, naxee tixi sanbunyi ma.

sentences.english: All the pillars round the open space are to have silver bands, with hooks of silver and bases of brass.
sentences.susu: Wuri naxee tixi tɛtɛ ma, e tixi e sanbunyi wure gbeeli daaxie ma. Dugi suxusee fan na e ma naxee yailanxi gbeti ra.

sentences.english: The open space is to be a hundred cubits long, fifty cubits wide, with sides five cubits high, curtained with the best linen, with bases of brass.
sentences.susu: Na hɔrɔmɔlingira tɛtɛ kuyɛya lanma nɔngɔn kɛmɛ nan ma, a igboya nɔngɔn tongo suuli. Suwa dugi naxee gbakuxi na, e ite nɔngɔn suuli. Tɛtɛ wuri sanbunyie,

sentences.english: All the instruments for the work of the House, and all its nails, and the nails of the open space are to be of brass.
sentences.susu: hɔrɔmɔlingira yirabase birin, nun tɛtɛ luuti xirima se naxee ma, na birin yailanma wure gbeeli nan na.»

sentences.english: Give orders to the children of Israel to give you clear olive oil for the lights, so that a light may be burning there at all times.
sentences.susu: «I xa Isirayilakae yaamari, e xa fa oliwi ture fanyi ra i xɔn ma, alako hɔrɔmɔlingira lanpuie xa dɛxɛ tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Let Aaron and his sons put this in order, evening and morning, before the Lord, inside the Tent of meeting, outside the veil which is before the ark; this is to be an order for ever, from generation to generation, to be kept by the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Haruna nun a xa die xa na lanpuie radɛxɛ, naxee na hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, n i lima dɛnnaxɛ, yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante ya ra, dugi gbakuxi dɛnnaxɛ saatɛ kankira ya ra. Na lanpuie xa yanba Alatala ya xɔri kelife kɔɛ han gɛɛsɛgɛ. Sɛriyɛ nan na ki Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin bɛ naxan mu kanama abadan.»

sentences.english: Now let Aaron your brother, and his sons with him, come near from among the children of Israel, so that they may be my priests, even Aaron, and Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar, his sons.
sentences.susu: «I xa i taara Haruna tongo Isirayilakae ya ma, a nun a xa die Nadabo, Abihu, Eleyasari, nun Itamari, e xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali raba n bɛ.

sentences.english: And make holy robes for Aaron your brother, so that he may be clothed with glory and honour.
sentences.susu: I xa sose sɛniyɛnxie dɛgɛ i taara Haruna bɛ, naxee a xa kuntigiya nun a binyɛ masenma.

sentences.english: Give orders to all the wise-hearted workmen, whom I have made full of the spirit of wisdom, to make robes for Aaron, so that he may be made holy as my priest.
sentences.susu: I xa na wali so mixie yi ra n naxee kixi xaxili fanyi ra, naxan a niyama e xa fata. E xa Haruna xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ sosee dɛgɛ, alako a xa ti n ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali ra.

sentences.english: This is what they are to make: a priest's bag, an ephod, and a robe, and a coat of coloured needlework, a head-dress, and a linen band; they are to make holy robes for Aaron your brother and for his sons, so that they may do the work of priests for me.
sentences.susu: Sosee nan yi ki e naxee dɛgɛma: donma kanke raxunmase, donma kuye, tunki raxunmase, donma kuye bun magoroe masɔxɔxi, xunmase naxan dɔxɔma e xunyi ma, nun bɛlɛti. E xa na sose sɛniyɛnxie yailan i taara Haruna nun a xa die bɛ, alako e xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali raba n bɛ.»

sentences.english: They are to take the gold and blue and purple and red and the best linen,
sentences.susu: «Donma dɛgɛmae xa gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi, gɛsɛ bulu daaxi, gɛsɛ gbeeli, gɛsɛ xɛɛma daaxi, nun suwa dugi malan.

sentences.english: And make the ephod of gold and blue and purple and red and the best linen, the work of a designer.
sentences.susu: E xa donma kuye dɛgɛ gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi, gɛsɛ bulu daaxi, gɛsɛ gbeeli, gɛsɛ xɛɛma daaxi, nun suwa dugi ra. A xa findi wali tofanyi ra.

sentences.english: It is to have two bands stitched to it at the top of the arms, joining it together.
sentences.susu: E xa tunki raxunmase firin yailan, e xa e dɛgɛ donma kuye ma.

sentences.english: And the beautifully worked band, which goes on it, is to be of the same work and the same material, of gold and blue and purple and red and twisted linen-work.
sentences.susu: Bɛlɛti fan xa yailan gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi, gɛsɛ bulu daaxi, gɛsɛ gbeeli, gɛsɛ xɛɛma daaxi, nun suwa dugi ra alɔ donma kuye.

sentences.english: You are to take two beryl stones, on which the names of the children of Israel are to be cut:
sentences.susu: I xa onixi gɛmɛ firin tongo, i fa Yaxuba xa die xilie masoli e ma

sentences.english: Six names on the one stone and six on the other, in the order of their birth.
sentences.susu: e bari ki ma. Xili senni masoli gɛmɛ keren ma, xili senni masoli gɛmɛ boore fan ma.

sentences.english: With the work of a jeweller, like the cutting of a stamp, the names of the children of Israel are to be cut on them, and they are to be fixed in twisted frames of gold.
sentences.susu: Na gɛmɛ masolixi firinyie findima wali tofanyi ra, alɔ sɛbɛli masolima xurundɛ ma ki naxɛ. I xa xɛɛma sa e rabilinyi ma,

sentences.english: And the two stones are to be placed on the ephod, over the arm-holes, to be stones of memory for the children of Israel: Aaron will have their names on his arms when he goes in before the Lord, to keep the Lord in mind of them.
sentences.susu: i fa nee dɛgɛ tunki raxunmasee ma, e xa findi ɲɔxɔ rasiga see ra Isirayila die xa fe ma. Na ki Haruna fama e xilie ra n ya i, a xa findi dubɛ ra.

sentences.english: And you are to make twisted frames of gold;
sentences.susu: I na xɛɛma sa e rabilinyi ma,

sentences.english: And two chains of the best gold, twisted like cords; and have the chains fixed on to the frames.
sentences.susu: i xa luuti die yailan xɛɛma ra naxee gbakuma e rabilinyi ma.»

sentences.english: And make a priest's bag for giving decisions, designed like the ephod, made of gold and blue and purple and red and the best linen.
sentences.susu: «I xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ donma kanke raxunmase yailan a tofanyi ki ma. A findima kiiti se nan na. I xa a yailan gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi, gɛsɛ bulu daaxi, gɛsɛ gbeeli, nun suwa dugi ra alɔ donma kuye yailanxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: It is to be square, folded in two, a hand-stretch long and a hand-stretch wide.
sentences.susu: A xa kuyɛ nun a xa igboya xa findi suxui keren na. A xa findi dugi firin na, alako a xa findi yuba ra.

sentences.english: And on it you are to put four lines of jewels; the first line is to be a cornelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;
sentences.susu: A xa raxunma gɛmɛ tofanyie safɛ naani ra. Safɛ singe findima gɛmɛe nan na, naxee xili sariduwani, topasi, nun emerode.

sentences.english: The second, a ruby, a sapphire, and an onyx;
sentences.susu: Safɛ firin nde, esikaribukulu, safiri, nun diyaman.

sentences.english: The third, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
sentences.susu: Safɛ saxan nde, opale, agati, nun ametisite.

sentences.english: The fourth, a topaz, a beryl, and a jasper; they are to be fixed in twisted frames of gold.
sentences.susu: Safɛ naani nde, kirosolite, onixi, nun yasipe. I xa xɛɛma sa nee birin rabilinyi ma.

sentences.english: The jewels are to be twelve in number, for the names of the children of Israel; every jewel having the name of one of the twelve tribes cut on it as on a stamp.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa die xilie xa masoli na gɛmɛ fu nun firin ma, alɔ sɛbɛli masolima xurundɛ ma ki naxɛ. Kankan xili xa masoli gɛmɛ nde ma. E findima Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ fu nun firinyi matɔnxuma se nan na.

sentences.english: And you are to make two chains of gold, twisted like cords, to be fixed to the priest's bag.
sentences.susu: I xa luuti die dɛgɛ na donma kanke raxunmase ma, naxee yailanxi xɛɛma ra.

sentences.english: And put two gold rings on the two ends of the bag.
sentences.susu: I xa xurundɛ firin yailan xɛɛma ra, i xa e dɛgɛ donma kanke raxunmase ma a dɛ kiri firinyie ma a fuge ra.

sentences.english: Put the two gold chains on the two rings at the ends of the bag;
sentences.susu: Na luuti xɛɛma daaxie xa xiri na xurundɛ firinyie ma, naxee dɛgɛxi donma kanke raxunmase dɛ kiri ma.

sentences.english: Joining the other ends of the chains to the gold frames and putting them on the front of the ephod, at the top of the arms.
sentences.susu: I man xa na luuti firinyie xiri donma kuye tunki raxunmasee ma.»

sentences.english: Then make two gold rings and put them on the lower ends of the bag, at the edge of it on the inner side nearest to the ephod.
sentences.susu: «I xa xurundɛ firin gbɛtɛ yailan xɛɛma ra, i naxee dɛgɛma donma kanke raxunmase dɛ kirie ma a labe ra. I xa nee dɛgɛ donma kuye sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And make two more gold rings and put them on the front of the ephod at the top of the arms, at the join, over the worked band:
sentences.susu: I xa xurundɛ firin gbɛtɛ yailan xɛɛma ra, i naxee dɛgɛma tunki raxunmasee lanbanyi ma, dɛnnaxɛ ilanma bɛlɛti ra.

sentences.english: So that the rings on the bag may be fixed to the rings of the ephod by a blue cord and on to the band of the ephod, so that the bag may not come loose from the ephod.
sentences.susu: Donma kanke raxunmase xa xiri donma kuye ma luuti gɛrɛ daaxi ra naxan nasoma xurundɛe kui naxee dɛgɛxi donma kanke raxunmase nun donma kuye ma.»

sentences.english: And so Aaron will have the names of the children of Israel on the priest's bag over his heart whenever he goes into the holy place, to keep the memory of them before the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Haruna na so hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ xili birin sɛbɛxi a xa donma kanke raxunmase ma, naxan saxi a kanke fari sondonyi yailanyi, a findima dubɛ ra Alatala bɛ Isirayila xa fe ra tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: And in the bag you are to put the Urim and Thummim, so that they may be on Aaron's heart whenever he goes in before the Lord; and Aaron may have the power of making decisions for the children of Israel before the Lord at all times.
sentences.susu: I xa gɛmɛ firin sa na donma kanke raxunmasee kui, naxan saxi Haruna kanke fari sondonyi mabiri. Nee findixi Ala waxɔnfe masen se nan na. Haruna na so Alatala yire, a nɔma Alatala waxɔnfe kolonde Isirayilakae xa fe ra nee saabui ra.»

sentences.english: The robe which goes with the ephod is to be made all of blue;
sentences.susu: «I xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa donma kuye bun magoroe sɔxɔ gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi ra.

sentences.english: With a hole at the top, in the middle of it; the hole is to be edged with a band to make it strong like the hole in the coat of a fighting-man, so that it may not be broken open.
sentences.susu: I xa a xunyi rasode xaba a tagi, i xa na sode dɛ masɔxɔ, alako bɔɔde yo naxa lu a ma.

sentences.english: And round the skirts of it put fruits in blue and purple and red, with bells of gold between;
sentences.susu: I xa a raxunma pirinti gɛrɛ daaxi, bulu daaxi, nun gbeeli ra naxee misaalixi wuri bogi ra a rabilinyi birin ma. I xa tɔlɔnyi xɛɛma daaxie dɛgɛ na pirintie tagi,

sentences.english: A gold bell and a fruit in turn all round the skirts of the robe.
sentences.susu: alako tɔlɔnyi nde xa lu wuri bogi birin tagi na donma kuye bun magoroe sanbunyi birin ma.

sentences.english: Aaron is to put it on for his holy work; and the sound of it will be clear, when he goes into the holy place before the Lord, and when he comes out, keeping him safe from death.
sentences.susu: Haruna na a ragoro a ma a so tɛmui nun a mini tɛmui Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, na nan a ratangama faxɛ ma.»

sentences.english: You are to make a plate of the best gold, cutting on it, as on a stamp, these words: HOLY TO THE LORD.
sentences.susu: «I xa xɛɛma yailan, a sɛbɛ a ma, ‹Alatala gbe›,

sentences.english: Put a blue cord on it and put it on the front of the twisted head-dress:
sentences.susu: i fa a xiri xunmase fari luuti gɛrɛ daaxi ra,

sentences.english: And it will be over Aaron's brow, so that Aaron will be responsible for any error in all the holy offerings made by the children of Israel; it will be on his brow at all times, so that their offerings may be pleasing to the Lord.
sentences.susu: alako a xa gbaku a tigi ra. Xa a sa li sɛrɛxɛ mu nu baxi sɛriyɛ ki ma, na kote luma Haruna nan ma, kɔnɔ na sɛbɛli naxan gbakuxi a tigi ra a niyama nɛ Alatala xa na sɛrɛxɛ suxu.»

sentences.english: The coat is to be made of the best linen, worked in squares; and you are to make a head-dress of linen, and a linen band worked in needlework.
sentences.susu: «I xa donma kuye bun magoroe gbɛtɛ dɛgɛ Haruna bɛ suwa dugi ra, a nun xunmase naxan sama a xun ma. I xa a xa bɛlɛti masɔxɔ a tofanyi ra.

sentences.english: And for Aaron's sons you are to make coats, and bands, and head-dresses, so that they may be clothed with glory and honour.
sentences.susu: I xa donma kuye bun magoroe, bɛlɛtie, nun xunmasee dɛgɛ Haruna xa die fan bɛ, naxee e xa binyɛ nun e xa kuntigiya masenma.

sentences.english: These you are to put on Aaron, your brother, and on his sons, putting oil on them, separating them and making them holy, to do the work of priests to me.
sentences.susu: I xa i taara Haruna nun a xa die maxiri na ki, beenun i xa e ti n ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali rabade. I xa ture maso e xunyi ma, i fa e masen ɲama bɛ e bara findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra.

sentences.english: And you are to make them linen trousers, covering their bodies from the middle to the knee;
sentences.susu: I xa wantanyi dɛgɛ suwa dugi ra naxan kelima e tagi han e tabe alako e xa sutura.

sentences.english: Aaron and his sons are to put these on whenever they go into the Tent of meeting or come near the altar, when they are doing the work of the holy place, so that they may be free from any sin causing death: this is to be an order for him and his seed after him for ever.
sentences.susu: Haruna nun a xa die xa na mɔɔli so e ma e makɔrɛma sɛrɛxɛbade ra tɛmui naxɛ, xa na mu a ra e na hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui li tɛmui naxɛ, n i lima dɛnnaxɛ. Na nan a niyama e mu yunubi sɔtɔma, e tangama nɛ faxɛ ma. Sɛriyɛ na a ra naxan mu kanama abadan Haruna nun a bɔnsɔɛ birin bɛ.»

sentences.english: This is what you are to do to make them holy, to do the work of priests to me: Take one young ox and two male sheep, without any mark on them,
sentences.susu: «I na wa mixi tife n ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali rabafe ra, i xa tuura nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi firin tongo, lanyuru yo mu na naxee ma,

sentences.english: And unleavened bread, and unleavened cakes mixed with oil, and thin unleavened cakes on which oil has been put, made of the best bread-meal;
sentences.susu: a nun taami lɛbinitare, taami lɛbinitare ture masunbuxi naxan na, nun taami lɛbinitare xunxuri ture masoxi naxan ma. I xa na birin naba sansi xɔri luxutaxi ra.

sentences.english: Put these in a basket and take them, with the ox and the two sheep.
sentences.susu: I xa na taami birin sa debe kui, i a xanin hɔrɔmɔlingira yire, a nun tuura, nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi firin.

sentences.english: And let Aaron and his sons come to the door of the Tent of meeting, and there let them be washed with water.
sentences.susu: I xa Haruna nun a xa die ti sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali ra hɔrɔmɔlingira sode, n e lima dɛnnaxɛ. I na gɛ e maxade ye ra e rasɛniyɛnfe ra,

sentences.english: Take the robes, and put the coat and the dress and the ephod and the priest's bag on Aaron; put the band of needlework round him,
sentences.susu: i xa Haruna xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ sosee ragoro a ma, a xa donma bun magoroe, a xa donma kuye bun magoroe, a xa donma kuye, a xa donma kanke raxunmase ra, nun a xa bɛlɛti donma kanke raxunmase xirima naxan na.

sentences.english: And let the head-dress be placed on his head and the holy crown on the head-dress.
sentences.susu: I xa xunmase dɔxɔ a xunyi ma, i fa na tɔnxuma xɛɛma daaxi xiri na ra.

sentences.english: Then take the oil and put it on his head.
sentences.susu: I xa ture sɛniyɛnxi surusuru a xunyi ma a tife sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra.

sentences.english: And take his sons and put their robes on them;
sentences.susu: I na gɛ na ra, i xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ donma kuye bun magoroe ragoro Haruna xa die fan ma.

sentences.english: And put the linen bands round Aaron and his sons, and the head-dresses on them, to make them priests by my order for ever: so you are to make Aaron and his sons holy to me.
sentences.susu: I xa Haruna nun a xa die tagi ixiri bɛlɛti ra, i xa xunmase dɔxɔ e xunyi ma. I Haruna nun a xa die tima sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra na ki nɛ. Na xa findi sɛriyɛ ra naxan mu kanama abadan.»

sentences.english: Then let the ox be taken in front of the Tent of meeting: and let Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head.
sentences.susu: «I xa tuura nde xanin hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra, n i lima dɛnnaxɛ. Haruna nun a xa die na e bɛlɛxɛ sa a xunyi,

sentences.english: And you are to put the ox to death before the Lord at the door of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: i xa na tuura kɔn naxaba Alatala ya xɔri hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra, n i lima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Then take some of the blood of the ox, and put it on the horns of the altar with your finger, draining out all the rest of the blood at the base of the altar.
sentences.susu: I xa na tuura wuli tongo, i nde sa sɛrɛxɛbade feri naani ma i bɛlɛxɛsole ra. Wuli naxan luxi, i xa na ifili sɛrɛxɛbade sanbunyi ma.

sentences.english: And take all the fat covering the inside of the ox, and the fat joining the liver and the two kidneys with the fat round them, and let them be burned on the altar;
sentences.susu: I na gɛ na ra, i xa na tuura ture tongo naxan na a furingɛ ma, a laare naxan a bɔɲɛ makotoxi, a gunguie nun ture naxan na e ma, i xa na birin gan sɛrɛxɛ ra sɛrɛxɛbade fari.

sentences.english: But the flesh of the ox and its skin and its waste parts are to be burned outside the circle of the tents, for it is a sin-offering.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a sube, a kiri, nun a xa ɲaɲɛ, i xa nee gan taa fari ma, barima yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ na a ra.»

sentences.english: Then take one of the sheep, and let Aaron and his sons put their hands on its head.
sentences.susu: «I na gɛ na ra, i xa yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren tongo. Haruna nun a xa die e xa e bɛlɛxɛ sa a xunyi,

sentences.english: Then let it be put to death, so that the sides of the altar are marked with its blood.
sentences.susu: i fa a kɔn naxaba. I xa a wuli tongo, i a ifili sɛrɛxɛbade rabilinyi ma.

sentences.english: Then the sheep is to be cut up into its parts, and after washing its legs and its inside parts, you are to put them with the parts and the head,
sentences.susu: I xa na yɛxɛɛ kontonyi bolon a xuntunyi ra. I xa a furingɛ nun a sanyie maxa, i fa e malan a sube nun a xunyi fari,

sentences.english: And let them all be burned on the altar as a burned offering to the Lord: a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
sentences.susu: i na birin gan sɛrɛxɛbade fari. Sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nan na ki Alatala bɛ, naxan nafan Alatala ma.»

sentences.english: Then take the other sheep; and after Aaron and his sons have put their hands on its head,
sentences.susu: «I na gɛ na singe ra, i xa na yɛxɛɛ kontonyi firin nde tongo. Haruna nun a xa die na e bɛlɛxɛ sa a xunyi ma,

sentences.english: You are to put the sheep to death, and take some of its blood and put it on the point of Aaron's right ear, and of the right ears of his sons, and on the thumbs of their right hands and the great toes of their right feet, dropping the rest of the blood on the sides of the altar.
sentences.susu: i xa a kɔn naxaba. I xa na wuli tongo, i nde sa Haruna nun a xa die yirefanyi tuli kirie ma, e yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛ, nun sankurae ma. Wuli naxan luxi, i xa na ifili sɛrɛxɛbade rabilinyi.

sentences.english: Then take some of the blood on the altar, and the oil, and put it on Aaron and his robes and on his sons and on their robes, so that he and his robes and his sons and their robes may be made holy.
sentences.susu: I xa wuli nde tongo sɛrɛxɛbade fari, a nun ture nde naxan nawalixi mixi tife sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra, i xa nee kasan Haruna, a xa die, nun e xa dugie ma. Na kui Haruna nun a xa die bara ti sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra, e xa dugie fan bara findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ dugie ra.»

sentences.english: Then take the fat of the sheep, the fat tail, the fat covering the insides, and the fat joining the liver and the two kidneys with the fat round them, and the right leg; for by the offering of this sheep they are to be marked out as priests:
sentences.susu: «I xa yɛxɛɛ kontonyi ture tongo, a nun a xuli, a ture naxan na a furingɛ ma, a laare naxan a bɔɲɛ makotoxi, a gunguie nun ture naxan e makotoxi, a nun a yirefanyi tabe, barima sɛrɛxɛ na a ra naxan a niyama mixi xa ti sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali ra.

sentences.english: And take one bit of bread and one cake of oiled bread and one thin cake out of the basket of unleavened bread which is before the Lord:
sentences.susu: I xa na debe tongo taami lɛbinitare na naxan kui naxan fixi Alatala ma. Na kui i xa taami digilinxi keren tongo, a nun taami lɛbinitare ture masunbuxi naxan na, nun taami lɛbinitare xunxuri nde,

sentences.english: And put them all on the hands of Aaron and of his sons, to be waved for a wave offering before the Lord.
sentences.susu: i xa nee sa Haruna nun a xa die bɛlɛxɛ, i nee lintan Alatala ya i sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then take them from their hands, and let them be burned on the burned offering on the altar, a sweet smell before the Lord, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, i xa e ba e bɛlɛxɛ, i e sa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi fari sɛrɛxɛbade. Sɛrɛxɛ ganxi na a ra naxan nafan Alatala ma.»

sentences.english: Then take the breast of Aaron's sheep, waving it before the Lord; and it is to be your part of the offering.
sentences.susu: «I xa yɛxɛɛ kontonyi kanke tongo, naxan baxi Haruna bɛ, i a lintan Alatala ya i sɛrɛxɛ ra, a xa findi i gbe ra.

sentences.english: So you are to make holy the breast of the sheep which is waved and the leg which is lifted up on high, that is, of the sheep which is offered for Aaron and his sons;
sentences.susu: Na kanke nun na tabe i naxan lintanxi Alatala ya i sɛrɛxɛ ra sɛrɛxɛdubɛe tife xa fe ra,

sentences.english: And it will be their part as a right for ever from the children of Israel, it is a special offering from the children of Israel, made from their peace-offerings, a special offering lifted up to the Lord.
sentences.susu: nee bara findi Haruna nun a xa die gbe ra. Sɛriyɛ nan na ki Isirayilakae bɛ naxan mu kanama abadan. E lan nɛ e xa na mɔɔli ba e xa xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ birin ma, e a fi Alatala ma.»

sentences.english: And Aaron's holy robes will be used by his sons after him; they will put them on when they are made priests.
sentences.susu: «Haruna na faxa, a xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ sose radangima a xa die nan ma. E ti tɛmui na wali ra, e xa e ragoro e ma.

sentences.english: For seven days the son who becomes priest in his place will put them on when he comes into the Tent of meeting to do the work of the holy place.
sentences.susu: Haruna xa di naxan findima a ɲɔxɔɛ ra na nan fama na dugie ragorode a ma xi solofere bun ma, beenun a xa so yire sɛniyɛnxi hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, n i lima dɛnnaxɛ, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali rabafe ra.»

sentences.english: Then take the sheep of the wave offering and let its flesh be cooked in water in a holy place.
sentences.susu: «Yɛxɛɛ kontonyi naxan baxi sɛrɛxɛ ra, Haruna findixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra tɛmui naxɛ, i xa na sube ɲin yire nde naxan sɛniyɛnxi.

sentences.english: And let Aaron and his sons make a meal of it, with the bread in the basket, at the door of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: Na sube nun na taami naxan na debe kui, Haruna nun a xa die xa na don hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra, n i lima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: All those things which were used as offerings to take away sin, and to make them holy to be priests, they may have for food: but no one who is not a priest may have them, for they are holy food.
sentences.susu: E keren xa na yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ don, sɛrɛxɛ naxan ba e bɛ e ti lɔxɔɛ sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra. A mu lanma mixi gbɛtɛ xa na don, barima se sɛniyɛnxi nan a ra.

sentences.english: And if any of the flesh of the offering or of the bread is over till the morning, let it be burned with fire; it is not to be used for food, for it is holy.
sentences.susu: Xa na sɛrɛxɛ sube nun taami nde sa lu han gɛɛsɛgɛ, i xa a gan tɛ xɔɔra. A mu donma, barima se sɛniyɛnxi nan a ra.»

sentences.english: All these things you are to do to Aaron and his sons as I have given you orders: for seven days the work of making them priests is to go on.
sentences.susu: «I xa n ma yaamarie rabatu Haruna nun a xa die xa fe ra na xi solofere bun ma e tima sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: Every day an ox is to be offered as a sin-offering, to take away sins: and by this offering on it, you will make the altar clean from sin; and you are to put oil on it and make it holy.
sentences.susu: I xa tuura keren ba lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra. Na nan a toma sɛrɛxɛbade fan sɛniyɛnma. Na xanbi i xa ture ifili sɛrɛxɛbade fari, alako a xa findi yire sugandixi ra.

sentences.english: For seven days you are to make offerings for the altar and make it holy, so that it may become completely holy, and anything touching it will become holy.
sentences.susu: I xa na wali raba xi solofere bun ma, alako sɛrɛxɛbade xa sɛniyɛn, a man xa mixi rasɛniyɛn naxan dinma a ra.»

sentences.english: Now this is the offering which you are to make on the altar: two lambs in their first year, every day regularly.
sentences.susu: «Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ a lanma i xa yɛxɛɛ firin ba sɛrɛxɛ ra sɛrɛxɛbade fari, naxee bara ɲɛ keren sɔtɔ. Na xa raba kudɛi.

sentences.english: One lamb is to be offered in the morning and the other in the evening:
sentences.susu: A singe xa ba gɛɛsɛgɛ, boore xa ba kɔɛ so tɛmui.

sentences.english: And with the one lamb, a tenth part of an ephah of the best meal, mixed with a fourth part of a hin of clear oil; and the fourth part of a hin of wine for a drink offering.
sentences.susu: I na na yɛxɛɛ singe ba, i xa farin konkoronyi suuli, oliwi ture litiri keren, nun wɛni litiri keren sa na fari.

sentences.english: And the other lamb is to be offered in the evening, and with it the same meal offering and drink offering, for a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
sentences.susu: I na na yɛxɛɛ firin nde ba kɔɛ so tɛmui, i xa sansi bogi nde nun wɛni sa a fari alɔ gɛɛsɛgɛ daaxi. I xa nee ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, naxan nafan Alatala ma.

sentences.english: This is to be a regular burned offering made from generation to generation, at the door of the Tent of meeting before the Lord, where I will come face to face with you and have talk with you.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi mɔɔli nan a ra, i bɔnsɔɛ lanma a xa naxan ba n tan Alatala bɛ abadan. A bama hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ nan na n tan Alatala ya xɔri, n wo lima dɛnnaxɛ, n wɔyɛnma wo bɛ dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: There I will come face to face with the children of Israel, and the Tent will be made holy by my glory
sentences.susu: «N nan n yɛtɛ masenma Isirayilakae bɛ mɛnni n ma nɔrɛ kui, naxan mɛnni rasɛniyɛnma.

sentences.english: I will make holy the Tent of meeting and the altar: and Aaron and his sons I will make holy, to be my priests
sentences.susu: N nan n ma hɔrɔmɔlingira nun n ma sɛrɛxɛbade rasɛniyɛnma nɛ, n i lima dɛnnaxɛ. N Haruna nun a xa die rasɛniyɛnma nɛ, alako e xa n ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali raba.

sentences.english: Among the children of Israel I will make my living-place, and I will be their God.
sentences.susu: N sabatima nɛ Isirayilakae tagi, n man findima nɛ e Marigi Ala ra.

sentences.english: And they will see that I am the Lord their God, who took them out of the land of Egypt, so that I might be ever with them: I am the Lord their God.
sentences.susu: Na kui e a kolonma nɛ n tan nan Alatala ra, e Marigi Ala, naxan e ramini Misira bɔxi ra, alako n xa sabati e tagi. Alatala nan n tan na, e Marigi Ala.»

sentences.english: And you are to make an altar for the burning of perfume; of hard wood let it be made.
sentences.susu: «I xa surayi sɛrɛxɛbade yailan kasiya wuri ra.

sentences.english: The altar is to be square, a cubit long and a cubit wide, and two cubits high, and its horns are to be made of the same.
sentences.susu: A xa kuya nɔngɔn keren, a igbo nɔngɔn keren, a ite nɔngɔn firin. Feri naani xa lu a tuxuie ra, e nun sɛrɛxɛbade findixi se keren nan na.

sentences.english: It is to be plated with the best gold, the top of it and the sides and the horns, with an edging of gold all round it.
sentences.susu: I xa na sɛrɛxɛbade birin maso xɛɛma xinde ra, a fari, a sɛɛtie, a ferie, nun a dɛ kiri.

sentences.english: Under the edge on the two opposite sides, you are to make two gold rings, to take the rods for lifting it.
sentences.susu: I xa suxuse digilinxi firin yailan xɛɛma ra sɛrɛxɛbade sɛɛti firinyie ma a dɛ kiri labe ra, wuri kuyee soma naxee kui a xaninfe ra.

sentences.english: And make these rods of the same wood, plating them with gold.
sentences.susu: I xa na wurie yailan kasiya wuri ra, i fa xɛɛma maso e ma.

sentences.english: And let it be placed in front of the veil before the ark of the law, before the cover which is over the law, where I will come face to face with you.
sentences.susu: Na surayi sɛrɛxɛbade xa dɔxɔ dugi ya ra naxan na saatɛ kankira ya ra, yunubi xunsare yire dɔxɔxi naxan fari, n mixi lima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And on this altar sweet spices are to be burned by Aaron every morning when he sees to the lights.
sentences.susu: Haruna xa surayi xiri ɲɔxunmɛ gan mɛnni gɛɛsɛgɛ birin, a fɛntɛnma lanpuie ma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And every evening, when he puts the lights up in their places, the spices are to be burned, a sweet-smelling smoke going up before the Lord from generation to generation for ever.
sentences.susu: A man xa na mɔɔli raba kɔɛ so tɛmui. Surayi nan a ra, naxan lanma a xa gan waxati birin Alatala ya xɔri. Sɛriyɛ na a ra wo bɔnsɔɛ bɛ naxan mu kanama abadan.

sentences.english: No strange perfume, no burned offering or meal offering, and no drink offering is to be offered on it.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa sese ba na sɛrɛxɛbade fari bafe surayi sɛniyɛnxi ra. Wo naxa surayi sɛniyɛntare ba, wo naxa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ba, wo naxa sansi sɛrɛxɛ ba, wo naxa wɛni xa na mu a ra ture ba mɛnni.

sentences.english: And once every year Aaron is to make its horns clean: with the blood of the sin-offering he is to make it clean once every year from generation to generation: it is most holy to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ yo ɲɛ Haruna xa yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ wuli nde tongo, a a maso surayi sɛrɛxɛbade ferie ma, alako e fan xa sɛniyɛn. Sɛriyɛ nan a ra i bɔnsɔɛ lanma a xa naxan naba abadan. Na sɛrɛxɛbade findixi se sɛniyɛnxi nan na Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti Munsa bɛ:

sentences.english: When you are taking the number of the children of Israel, let every man who is numbered give to the Lord a price for his life, so that no disease may come on them when they are numbered.
sentences.susu: «I na Isirayilakae kɔnti lɔxɔɛ naxɛ, birin xa a xunsare fi Alatala ma. Na nan a ra, mankanɛ yo mu e lima na kɔnti tife xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And this is what they are to give; let every man who is numbered give half a shekel, by the scale of the holy place: (the shekel being valued at twenty gerahs:) this money is an offering to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan birin kɔntima, e xa gbeti giramu senni fi Alatala ma. Na xa maniya hɔrɔmɔlingira sɛriyɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: Everyone who is numbered, from twenty years old and over, is to give an offering to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan birin simaya bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn li, a xa a xunsare fi Alatala ma.

sentences.english: The man of wealth is to give no more and the poor man no less than the half-shekel of silver, when the offering is made to the Lord as the price for your lives.
sentences.susu: Banna mu se sama na giramu senni xun ma, misikiinɛ fan mu nde bama na giramu senni ra. Birin xa na fi Alatala ma e xunsare ra.

sentences.english: And you are to take this money from the children of Israel to be used for the work of the Tent of meeting, to keep the memory of the children of Israel before the Lord and to be the price of your lives.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae na na gbeti so i yi ra, i xa a rawali hɔrɔmɔlingira yailanfe ra, n i lima dɛnnaxɛ, alako n xa ratu a ma Isirayilakae naxan fixi e xunsare ra.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti Munsa bɛ.

sentences.english: You are to make a brass washing-vessel, with a brass base; and put it between the Tent of meeting and the altar, with water in it;
sentences.susu: «I xa hɔrɔmɔlingira ye sase xungbe yailan wure gbeeli ra, a nun a dɔxɔse. I xa na dɔxɔ hɔrɔmɔlingira nun sɛrɛxɛbade tagi, i fa marasɛniyɛn ye sa a kui,

sentences.english: That it may be used by Aaron and his sons for washing their hands and feet;
sentences.susu: Haruna nun a xa die naxan nawalima e bɛlɛxɛe nun e sanyie maxafe ra.

sentences.english: Whenever they go into the Tent of meeting they are to be washed with water, to keep them from death; and whenever they come near to do the work of the altar, or to make an offering by fire to the Lord,
sentences.susu: Beenun e xa so hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, n wo lima dɛnnaxɛ, a lanma e xa e bɛlɛxɛe nun e sanyie maxa na ye ra, alako e naxa faxa. Beenun e xa e makɔrɛ sɛrɛxɛbade ra sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi bafe Alatala bɛ,

sentences.english: Their hands and feet are to be washed. so that they may be safe from death: this is an order to them for ever; to him and his seed from generation to generation.
sentences.susu: a lanma e xa e bɛlɛxɛe nun e sanyie maxa na ye ra, alako e naxa faxa. Sɛriyɛ nan na ra e bɔnsɔɛ birin bɛ naxan mu kanama abadan.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Take the best spices, five hundred shekels' weight of liquid myrrh, and of sweet cinnamon half as much, that is, two hundred and fifty shekels, and two hundred and fifty shekels of sweet calamus,
sentences.susu: «I xa se xiri ɲɔxunmɛ fanyie tongo, alɔ wuri wa ye naxan xili miri kilo suuli, wuri fuɲi naxan xili sinamon kilo firin nun a tagi, kale nde kilo firin nun a tagi naxan xiri ɲɔxun,

sentences.english: And of cassia, five hundred shekels' weight measured by the scale of the holy place, and of olive oil a hin:
sentences.susu: kasiya wuri fuɲi kilo suuli, nun oliwi ture litiri senni.

sentences.english: And make these into a holy oil, a perfume made by the art of the perfume-maker; it is to be a holy oil.
sentences.susu: I xa na birin yailan ture sɛniyɛnxi ra naxan nawalima sɛrɛxɛdubɛ tife ra. Na wali xa raba a fanyi ra a raba ki ma.»

sentences.english: This oil is to be put on the Tent of meeting, and on the ark of the law,
sentences.susu: «I man xa na ture rawali hɔrɔmɔlingira nun saatɛ kankira rasɛniyɛnfe ra, n wo lima dɛnnaxɛ,

sentences.english: And on the table and all its vessels, and on the support for the lights, with its vessels, and on the altar for burning spices,
sentences.susu: a nun hɔrɔmɔlingira teebili, a yirabasee, lanpui dɔxɔse, a yirabasee, surayi sɛrɛxɛbade,

sentences.english: And on the altar of burned offerings with its vessels, and on the washing-vessel and its base.
sentences.susu: sɛrɛxɛbade xungbe, a yirabasee, hɔrɔmɔlingira ye sase xungbe, nun a dɔxɔse.

sentences.english: And you are to make them most holy; anything touching them will become holy.
sentences.susu: I xa na ture sɛniyɛnxi rawali na birin nasɛniyɛnfe ra. Mixi naxee dinma nee ra, e sɛniyɛnma nɛ.

sentences.english: And put the oil on Aaron and his sons, making them holy to do the work of priests to me.
sentences.susu: I xa na ture sɛniyɛnxi rawali Haruna nun a xa die tife n ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra.»

sentences.english: And say to the children of Israel, This is to be the Lord's holy oil, from generation to generation.
sentences.susu: «I xa a fala Isirayilakae bɛ a na ture findixi ture sɛniyɛnxi nan na wo bɔnsɔɛ bɛ abadan.

sentences.english: It is not to be used for man's flesh, and no other is to be made like it: holy it is, and you are to keep it holy.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa a sa mixi fate ma, wo naxa na ture mɔɔli yailan wali gbɛtɛ xa fe ra. Ture sɛniyɛnxi nan a ra wo bɛ.

sentences.english: Whoever makes any like it, or puts it on one who is not a priest, will be cut off from his people.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo naxan na na ture mɔɔli rafala, a a sa mixi sɛniyɛntare ma, na kanyi bama nɛ ɲama ya ma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Take sweet spices, stacte and onycha and galbanum, with the best frankincense, in equal weights;
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «I xa se xiri ɲɔxunmɛe tongo, alɔ sitakite, onixi, nun galibanon. I xa e masunbu surayi fanyi ra, e xasabi birin xa lan.

sentences.english: And make from them a perfume, such as is made by the art of the perfume-maker, mixed with salt, and clean and holy.
sentences.susu: Na findima surayi ra naxan xiri ɲɔxun ki fanyi ra. Fɔxɛ di xa sa a ma. Surayi sɛniyɛnxi nan a ra.

sentences.english: And put some of it, crushed very small, in front of the ark in the Tent of meeting, where I will come face to face with you; it is to be most holy.
sentences.susu: I xa na surayi findi fuɲi ra i naxan sama saatɛ kankira ya ra hɔrɔmɔlingira kui n i lima dɛnnaxɛ. Se sɛniyɛnxi na a ra wo bɛ.

sentences.english: You are not to make any perfume like it for yourselves: it is to be kept holy to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa yi surayi mɔɔli rafala wo yɛtɛ bɛ. Se sɛniyɛnxi na a ra, wo naxan nawalima Alatala gbansan bɛ.

sentences.english: Whoever makes any like it, for its sweet smell, will be cut off from his people.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo naxan na na mɔɔli rafalama a yɛtɛ bɛ a xa na xiri ramɛ, na kanyi kerima nɛ a xa ɲama ya ma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: I have made selection of Bezalel, the son of Uri, by name, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah:
sentences.susu: «I xa a kolon n bara Uri xa di Besaleli sugandi, Xuru xa mamadi, naxan fatanxi Yuda bɔnsɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And I have given him the spirit of God and made him wise and full of knowledge and expert in every sort of handwork,
sentences.susu: N bara xaxili fanyi fi a ma naxan fatanxi n tan na, alako a xa wali birin naba ki kolon lɔnni fanyi ra,

sentences.english: To do all sorts of delicate work in gold and silver and brass;
sentences.susu: a xa nɔ wali tode a xaxili kui beenun a xa raba, a xa nɔ xɛɛma, gbeti, nun wure gbeeli rawalide,

sentences.english: In cutting stones for framing, and to do every form of woodwork.
sentences.susu: a xa nɔ gɛmɛ fanyi masolide a fa a rabilinyi yailan, a xa nɔ kamudɛriɲa nun wali gbɛtɛe rabade.»

sentences.english: And I have made selection of Oholiab with him, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the hearts of all who are wise I have put the knowledge to make whatever I have given you orders to have made;
sentences.susu: «N bara Oholiyabu Axisamaki xa di so a yi ra, naxan fatanxi Dana bɔnsɔɛ ra, a xa a mali. N bara xaxili fanyi fi mixie ma, naxee fata walide, alako e xa nɔ n ma yaamari birin nabade,

sentences.english: The Tent of meeting, and the ark of the law, and the cover which is on it, and all the things for the tent,
sentences.susu: alɔ hɔrɔmɔlingira n adamadi lima dɛnnaxɛ, saatɛ kankira, a dɛrakote naxan findixi xunsare yire ra, nun hɔrɔmɔlingira yirabase birin,

sentences.english: And the table with its vessels, and the holy light-support with all its vessels, and the altar for the burning of spices,
sentences.susu: teebili, teebili yirabasee, lanpui dɔxɔse xɛɛma daaxi, lanpui yirabasee, surayi sɛrɛxɛbade,

sentences.english: And the altar of burned offerings with all its vessels, and the washing-vessel with its base,
sentences.susu: sɛrɛxɛbade xungbe nun a xa yirabasee, ye sase xungbe nun a dɔxɔse,

sentences.english: And the robes of needlework, the holy robes for Aaron and for his sons, for their use when acting as priests,
sentences.susu: sɛrɛxɛdubɛ sose sɛniyɛnxie Haruna nun a xa die bɛ,

sentences.english: And the holy oil, and the perfume of sweet spices for the holy place; they will do whatever I have given you orders to have done.
sentences.susu: ture sɛniyɛnxi, nun surayi naxan ganma hɔrɔmɔlingira kui. E xa a birin yailan n ma yaamari ki ma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel that they are to keep my Sabbaths; for the Sabbath day is a sign between me and you through all your generations; so that you may see that I am the Lord who makes you holy.
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ a e xa e ɲɛngi sa n ma malabui lɔxɔɛe xɔn ma, barima nee findima tɔnxuma ra won tagi abadan, alako wo xa a kolon a n tan nan na Alatala ra naxan wo rasɛniyɛnma.

sentences.english: So you are to keep the Sabbath as a holy day; and anyone not honouring it will certainly be put to death: whoever does any work on that day will be cut off from his people.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo ɲɛngi sa malabui lɔxɔɛ xɔn ma, barima a sɛniyɛn wo tan bɛ. Xa naxan mu a binya, a lan nɛ na kanyi xa faxa. Mixi naxan walima malabui lɔxɔɛ, na kanyi xa keri n ma ɲama ya ma.

sentences.english: Six days may work be done, but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the Lord; whoever does any work on the Sabbath day is to be put to death.
sentences.susu: Xi senni na wo yi ra walife ra, kɔnɔ a xi solofere nde findima malabui lɔxɔɛ nan na, naxan fima Alatala ma. Mixi naxan walima na lɔxɔɛ, na kanyi xa faxa.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel are to keep the Sabbath holy, from generation to generation, by an eternal agreement.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae xa e ɲɛngi sa malabui lɔxɔɛ xɔn ma, e a rabatu waxati birin. Saatɛ na a ra naxan mu kanama abadan.

sentences.english: It is a sign between me and the children of Israel for ever; because in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he took his rest and had pleasure in it.
sentences.susu: A findima tɔnxuma nan na, n tan nun Isirayilakae tagi tɛmui birin, barima n tan Alatala, n koore nun bɔxi daaxi xi senni nan bun ma, kɔnɔ a xi solofere nde, n naxa wali dan, n nan n malabu.»

sentences.english: And when his talk with Moses on Mount Sinai was ended, he gave him the two stones of the law, two stones on which was the writing made by the finger of God.
sentences.susu: Alatala to gɛ masenyi tide Munsa bɛ Turusinina geya fari, a naxa gɛmɛ walaxɛ firin so a yi ra seede ra, a xa yaamarie nu sɛbɛxi naxee ma a bɛlɛxɛ sole ra.

sentences.english: And when the people saw that Moses was a long time coming down from the mountain, they all came to Aaron and said to him, Come, make us a god to go before us: as for this Moses, who took us up out of the land of Egypt, we have no idea what has become of him.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae to a to, Munsa bara bu geya fari, ɲama naxa e malan Haruna yire, e fa a fala a bɛ, «I xa kuye yailan naxan tima muxu ya ra. Munsa naxan muxu raminixi Misira bɔxi ra, muxu mu a kolon fe naxan a sɔtɔxi geya fari.»

sentences.english: Then Aaron said to them, Take off the gold rings which are in the ears of your wives and your sons and your daughters, and give them to me.
sentences.susu: Haruna naxa e yaabi, «Langa xɛɛma daaxi naxan birin na wo xa ginɛe nun wo xa die tulie ra, wo fa e birin na n xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: And all the people took the gold rings from their ears and gave them to Aaron.
sentences.susu: Isirayila ɲama birin naxa e xa langa xɛɛma daaxie ba e tulie ra, e fa e so Haruna yi ra.

sentences.english: And he took the gold from them and, hammering it with an instrument, he made it into the metal image of a young ox: and they said, This is your god, O Israel, who took you out of the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Haruna naxa na xɛɛma raxunu, a ninge kuye daaxi yailan a ra. A to gɛ na ra, e naxa a fala e xui itexi ra, «Isirayilakae, won ma ala nan ya naxan won naminixi Misira bɔxi kui.»

sentences.english: And when Aaron saw this, he made an altar before it, and made a public statement, saying, Tomorrow there will be a feast to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Haruna to na to, a naxa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan na ninge kuye daaxi ya ra, a fa a fala a xui itexi ra, «Tina, xulunyi tima nɛ Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: So early on the day after they got up and made burned offerings and peace-offerings; and took their seats at the feast, and then gave themselves to pleasure.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, e naxa keli subaxɛ ma, e sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ba. Mixie naxa e dɛge, e minsee min, e fa e waxɔnfe raba.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Go down quickly; for your people, whom you took out of the land of Egypt, are turned to evil ways;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «I xa goro ɲama yire, barima i naxee namini Misira bɔxi kui, e bara fe kana a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: Even now they are turned away from the rule I gave them, and have made themselves a metal ox and given worship to it and offerings, saying, This is your god, O Israel, who took you up out of the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: E bara n ma kira bɛɲin yi ikɔrɛxi ra, e bara ninge kuye daaxi yailan wure raxunuxi ra, e na batu, e sɛrɛxɛe ba a bɛ, e a fala, ‹Isirayilakae, won ma ala nan ya naxan won naminixi Misira bɔxi kui.›

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, I have been watching this people, and I see that they are a stiff-necked people.
sentences.susu: N tan Alatala n xa a masen i bɛ, yi ɲama, ɲama xurutare na a ra.

sentences.english: Now do not get in my way, for my wrath is burning against them; I will send destruction on them, but of you I will make a great nation.
sentences.susu: Won naxan nabama, a lu n xa e sɔntɔ n ma xɔnɛ kui, kɔnɔ i tan, i xa makuya e ra, n xa i findi si xungbe ra.»

sentences.english: But Moses made prayer to God, saying, Lord, why is your wrath burning against your people whom you took out of the land of Egypt, with great power and with the strength of your hand?
sentences.susu: Na kui Munsa naxa Alatala maxandi, «Alatala, munfe ra i wama xɔnɔfe i xa ɲama ma, i sɛnbɛ naxan naminixi Misira bɔxi ra?

sentences.english: Why let the Egyptians say, He took them out to an evil fate, to put them to death on the mountains, cutting them off from the earth? Let your wrath be turned away from them, and send not this evil on your people.
sentences.susu: Xa i na raba, Misirakae fama a falade a i yi ɲama raminixi Misira bɔxi kui nɛ alako i xa e faxa geyae fari, e xa fe xa ɲɔn duniɲa. N bara i maxandi, i bɔɲɛ magoro, n Marigi. I naxa yi ɲama sɔntɔ.

sentences.english: Have in mind Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you gave your oath, saying, I will make your seed like the stars of heaven in number, and all this land will I give to your seed, as I said, to be their heritage for ever.
sentences.susu: I ratu i xa konyie Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Isirayila ma, i kalixi naxee ra, a falafe ra, ‹N wo bɔnsɔɛ rawuyama nɛ alɔ tunbui naxee na koore ma. N bɔxi fima wo bɔnsɔɛ ma kɛ ra naxan mu bama wo yi ra abadan.›»

sentences.english: So the Lord let himself be turned from his purpose of sending punishment on his people.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala bɔɲɛ naxa goro, a mu a xa ɲama sɔntɔ sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Then Moses came down the mountain with the two stones of the law in his hand; the stones had writing on their two sides, on the front and on the back.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa goro geya fari na seede walaxɛ firinyie suxuxi a yi ra, sɛbɛli tixi nee sɛɛti firinyi ma.

sentences.english: The stones were the work of God, and the writing was the writing of God, cut on the stones.
sentences.susu: Ala nan na walaxɛe yailan, a sɛbɛli masoli e ma.

sentences.english: Now when the noise and the voices of the people came to the ears of Joshua, he said to Moses, There is a noise of war in the tents.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe to ɲama xui itexi mɛ, a naxa a fala Munsa bɛ, «N xui nde mɛma ɲama yire naxan luxi alɔ gere so xui.»

sentences.english: And Moses said, It is not the voice of men who are overcoming in the fight, or the cry of those who have been overcome; it is the sound of songs which comes to my ear.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a yaabi, «Gere geenife xui mu ya, gere lɔɔsife xui fan mu a ra. N xulunyi xui nan mɛma.»

sentences.english: And when he came near the tents he saw the image of the ox, and the people dancing; and in his wrath Moses let the stones go from his hands, and they were broken at the foot of the mountain.
sentences.susu: E to makɔrɛ ɲama ra, Munsa naxa mixie to fare boron na kuye yire. A bɔɲɛ naxa te han a fa walaxɛe woli bɔxi ma geya sanbunyi, e naxa kana.

sentences.english: And he took the ox which they had made, burning it in the fire and crushing it to powder, and he put it in the water and made the children of Israel take a drink of it.
sentences.susu: A naxa e xa ninge kuye daaxi woli tɛ xɔɔra, a gan han a findi xube ra. A naxa na tɛ xube sa ye xɔɔra, a na fi Isirayilakae ma, e xa a min.

sentences.english: And Moses said to Aaron, What did the people do to you that you let this great sin come on them?
sentences.susu: A naxa fa Haruna maxɔrin, «Yi ɲama munse rabaxi i ra, naxan a niyaxi i xa e ti yi yunubi xungbe ra?»

sentences.english: And Aaron said, Let not my lord be angry; you have seen how the purposes of this people are evil.
sentences.susu: Haruna naxa a yaabi, «N marigi, i naxa xɔnɔ n ma! I a kolon yi ɲama birama fe kobi fɔxɔ ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For they said to me, Make us a god to go before us: as for this Moses, who took us up out of the land of Egypt, we have no idea what has come to him.
sentences.susu: E tan nan a falaxi n bɛ, ‹I xa kuye yailan naxan tima muxu ya ra. Munsa naxan muxu raminixi Misira bɔxi ra, muxu mu a kolon fe naxan a sɔtɔxi geya fari.›

sentences.english: Then I said to them, Whoever has any gold, let him take it off; so they gave it to me, and I put it in the fire, and this image of an ox came out.
sentences.susu: N naxa a fala e bɛ, ‹Wo xa fa wo xa xɛɛma ra.› E to fa na xɛɛma ra, n naxa a woli tɛ xɔɔra, yi ninge kuye daaxi fa mini.»

sentences.english: And Moses saw that the people were out of control, for Aaron had let them loose to their shame before their haters:
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a kolon Haruna ɲama luxi nɛ e xa e waxɔnfe raba. Na nu wama findife yaagi ra Isirayilakae bɛ e yaxuie mabiri.

sentences.english: Then Moses took his place at the way into the tents, and said, Whoever is on the Lord's side, let him come to me. And all the sons of Levi came together to him.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa sa ti e xa yonkinde sode dɛ ra, a fa a fala a xui itexi ra, «Naxee na Alatala bɛ, wo xa fa n yire.» Lewi bɔnsɔɛ birin naxa e malan Munsa xanbi ra.

sentences.english: And he said to them, This is the word of the Lord, the God of Israel: Let every man take his sword at his side, and go from one end of the tents to the other, putting to death his brother and his friend and his neighbour.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Isirayila Marigi Alatala bara wo yamari wo birin xa wo xa santidɛgɛma tongo, wo fa wo ngaxakerenyi birin faxa, a nun wo booree nun wo dɔxɔbooree naxee bara lu yi fe kui.»

sentences.english: And the sons of Levi did as Moses said; and about three thousand of the people were put to death that day.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Lewi bɔnsɔɛ naxa Munsa xa yaamari suxu, e fa Isirayilaka mixi wulu saxan faxa.

sentences.english: And Moses said, You have made yourselves priests to the Lord this day; for every one of you has made the offering of his son and his brother; the blessing of the Lord is on you this day.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a fala e bɛ, «To wo bara Alatala waxɔnfe raba wo ngaxakerenyie faxafe. Ala xa baraka sa wo xa fe ma.»

sentences.english: And on the day after, Moses said to the people, Great has been your sin: but I will go up to the Lord, and see if I may get forgiveness for your sin.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Munsa naxa a fala ɲama bɛ, «Wo bara yunubi xungbe raba. N xa gbilen Alatala yire geya fari, alako n xa a mayandi wo xa yunubi xafarife ra.»

sentences.english: Then Moses went back to the Lord and said, This people has done a great sin, making themselves a god of gold;
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa siga Alatala yire, a a fala a bɛ, «Alatala, n bara i maxandi yi ɲama bɛ. E bara yunubi xungbe raba kuye yailanfe xɛɛma ra.

sentences.english: But now, if you will give them forgiveness — but if not, let my name be taken out of your book.
sentences.susu: N bara i maxandi, i xa diɲɛ e ma. Yandi, xa na mu a ra, i xa n xili ba e ɲɔxɔɛ ra kisi kitaabui kui, i naxan sɛbɛxi.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Whoever has done evil against me will be taken out of my book.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a yaabi, «Ade, n mixie nan xili bama n ma kisi kitaabui kui naxee yunubi rabaxi n na.

sentences.english: But now, go, take the people into that place of which I have given you word; see, my angel will go before you: but when the time of my judging has come, I will send punishment on them for their sin.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, siga, i xa ɲama xanin n dɛnnaxɛ masenxi i bɛ. N ma malekɛ tima i ya ra sinden, kɔnɔ kiiti lɔxɔɛ na fa, e e xa yunubie sare fima nɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord sent punishment on the people because they gave worship to the ox which Aaron made.
sentences.susu: Alatala Isirayilakae ratɔn nɛ, barima e a fala nɛ Haruna bɛ, a xa ninge kuye daaxi yailan e bɛ xɛɛma ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Go forward from this place, you and the people whom you have taken up out of the land of Egypt, to that land about which I made an oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, To your seed will I give it.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «Wo nun ɲama i naxan naminixi Misira bɔxi kui, wo xa siga n dɛnnaxɛ laayidixi Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Yaxuba bɛ kali ra, a falafe ra n na fima e bɔnsɔɛe ma.

sentences.english: And I will send an angel before you, driving out the Canaanite and the Amorite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite:
sentences.susu: N malekɛ tima nɛ wo ya ra. N Kanaankae, Amorikae, Xitikae, Perisikae, Hiwikae, nun Yebusukae kerima nɛ

sentences.english: Go up to that land flowing with milk and honey; but I will not go up among you, for you are a stiff-necked people, for fear that I send destruction on you while you are on the way.
sentences.susu: na bɔxi ma, xiɲɛ nun kumi xɛlɛma dɛnnaxɛ. Kɔnɔ n tan mu sigama naa wo fɔxɔ ra, xa na mu a ra n wo sɔntɔma nɛ kira xɔn ma, barima ɲama xurutare nan wo ra.»

sentences.english: Hearing this bad news the people were full of grief, and no one put on his ornaments.
sentences.susu: Ɲama to na masenyi xɔrɔxɔɛ mɛ, e naxa sunnun. Mixi yo mu a raxunmasee so a ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Say to the children of Israel, You are a stiff-necked people: if I come among you, even for a minute, I will send destruction on you; so take off all your ornaments, so that I may see what to do with you.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «I xa a fala Isirayilakae bɛ, ‹Xurutaree nan wo ra. Xa n bira wo fɔxɔ ra, n wo sɔntɔma nɛ. Wo xa wo fate raxunmase birin ba wo ma, n xa a mato n wo xa fe suxuma ki naxɛ.›»

sentences.english: So the children of Israel took off their ornaments at Mount Horeb, and did not put them on again.
sentences.susu: Na kui e to keli Xorebe geya yire, e naxa e xa xunmasee ba e ma.

sentences.english: Now it was Moses' way to put up the Tent of meeting outside the tent-circle, at some distance away; giving it the name of The Tent of meeting. And everyone desiring to make his prayer to the Lord went to the Tent of meeting outside the tent-circle.
sentences.susu: Munsa nu kiri banxi tongoma, a nu a ti Isirayilakae xa yonkinde fari ma. A naxa na xili sa Ala Maxandi yire. Mɛnni mixi nu nɔma maxɔrinyi tide Alatala ma.

sentences.english: And whenever Moses went out to the Tent of meeting, all the people got up and everyone went to the door of his tent, looking after Moses till he went inside the Tent.
sentences.susu: Munsa to nu minima sigafe ra na banxi kui, ɲama birin nu kelima nɛ, e ti e xa naadɛ ra, e ya ti Munsa ra han a so na kui.

sentences.english: And whenever Moses went into the Tent, the pillar of cloud came down, and took its place by the door of the Tent, as long as the Lord was talking with Moses.
sentences.susu: Munsa na gɛ sode na banxi kui, nuxui nu goroma na naadɛ ra, Alatala fa sumun a bɛ.

sentences.english: And all the people saw the cloud at the door of the Tent, and they went down on their faces, everyone at the door of his tent.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae to nu na nuxui toma na banxi sode dɛ ma, e nu luma e mafelen na bɔxi ma e xɔnyi naadɛe ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord had talk with Moses face to face, as a man may have talk with his friend. And when Moses came back to the tents, his servant, the young man Joshua, the son of Nun, did not come away from the Tent.
sentences.susu: Alatala nu wɔyɛnma Munsa bɛ e boore ya i, alɔ mixi wɔyɛnma a boore bɛ ki naxɛ. Sumunyi dangi xanbi, Munsa nu gbilenma ɲama yire, kɔnɔ a malima Yosuwe, Nun xa di, na tan mu nu kelima na banxi kui.

sentences.english: And Moses said to the Lord, See, you say to me, Be this people's guide on their journey, but you have not made clear to me whom you will send with me. But you have said, I have knowledge of you by name, and you have grace in my eyes.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a masen Alatala bɛ, «N Marigi i bara n yamari n xa ti yi ɲama ya ra, kɔnɔ i mu a masenxi n bɛ i naxan xɛɛma muxu matife ra. I bara a fala n bɛ, ‹N tan nan i sugandixi, i bara n kɛnɛn.›

sentences.english: If then I have grace in your eyes, let me see your ways, so that I may have knowledge of you and be certain of your grace; and my prayer is that you will keep in mind that this nation is your people.
sentences.susu: N bara i maxandi, xa n i kɛnɛnxi, i xa i waxɔnfe masen n bɛ, alako n xa i kolon yati, n man xa i xa hinnɛ sɔtɔ. I xa a kolon, yi si findixi i xa ɲama nan na.»

sentences.english: And he said, I myself will go with you and give you rest.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a yaabi, «N tan yati wo matima nɛ, n xa bɔɲɛsa fi wo ma.»

sentences.english: And Moses said, If you yourself are not going with us, do not send us on from here.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a masen a bɛ, «Xa i tan yati mu muxu matima naa, i naxa a lu muxu xa keli be.

sentences.english: For is not the fact of your going with us the sign that I and this people have grace in your eyes, so that we, that is, I and your people, are separate from all other people on the face of the earth?
sentences.susu: Munse nɔma a masende duniɲa bɛ a muxu bara i kɛnɛn, xa i mu na muxu fɔxɔ ra? Na kui xa i na muxu fɔxɔ ra, e nɔma a kolonde i bara n tan nun i xa ɲama sugandi duniɲa si birin ya ma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, I will do as you say: for you have grace in my eyes, and I have knowledge of you by your name.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Munsa yaabi, «I naxan falaxi, n a rabama nɛ, barima i bara n kɛnɛn. N tan nan i sugandixi yati.»

sentences.english: And Moses said, O Lord, let me see your glory.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi Munsa naxa Ala maxandi, «I xa i xa nɔrɛ masen n bɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said, I will make all the light of my being come before you, and will make clear to you what I am; I will be kind to those to whom I will be kind, and have mercy on those on whom I will have mercy.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a yaabi, «N fama n ma fanyi birin masende i bɛ. N tan Alatala, n man fama n xili yati falade i bɛ. N hinnɛma mixi ra, n wama hinnɛfe naxan na. N kinikinima mixi ma, n wama kinikinife naxan ma.

sentences.english: But it is not possible for you to see my face, for no man may see me and still go on living.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i mu nɔma n yatagi tan tode, barima adamadi yo mu nɔma n yatagi tode, a mu faxa.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said, See, there is a place near me, and you may take your place on the rock:
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «Fanye nde nan be n fɛ ma. I xa ti naa.

sentences.english: And when my glory goes by, I will put you in a hole in the rock, covering you with my hand till I have gone past:
sentences.susu: N nɛ dangima n ma nɔrɛ kui, n i nɔxunma fɔnmɛ kui, n fa i ya makoto n bɛlɛxɛ ra han n gɛma dangide tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then I will take away my hand, and you will see my back: but my face is not to be seen.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n fama n bɛlɛxɛ bade i ya ma, alako i xa nɔ n kobe tode fa, kɔnɔ i mu nɔma n yatagi tan tode.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Make two other stones like the first two; and I will put on them the words which were on the first stones, which were broken by you.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «Walaxɛ firin masoli gɛmɛ ra, naxee maniya na singee ra i naxee kana. N xa sɛbɛli ti e ma, alɔ sɛbɛli naxan nu tixi na booree ma.

sentences.english: And be ready by the morning, and come up on Mount Sinai, and come before me there in the morning, on the top of the mountain.
sentences.susu: I xa kurun tina gɛɛsɛgɛ tefe ra Turusinina geya fari i n lima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: No one is to come up with you, and let no man be seen anywhere on the mountain; let no flocks or herds come near to get their food at its foot.
sentences.susu: I naxa fa mixi yo ra, mixi yo naxa te geya ma. Hali xurusee naxa e dɛmadon mɛnni.»

sentences.english: So Moses got two stones cut like the first; and early in the morning he went up Mount Sinai, as the Lord had said, with the two stones in his hand.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa gɛmɛ walaxɛ firin masoli alɔ a singee. Subaxɛ a naxa te Turusinina geya ma na walaxɛe ra, alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord came down in the cloud and took his place by the side of Moses, and Moses gave worship to the name of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala to goro nuxui kui Munsa yire a xili masende a bɛ,

sentences.english: And the Lord went past before his eyes, saying, The Lord, the Lord, a God full of pity and grace, slow to wrath and great in mercy and faith;
sentences.susu: a naxa dangi Munsa ya ra, a fa a yita a bɛ, «N tan nan na Alatala ra. Alatala naxan kinikinima, naxan xa hinnɛ gbo, naxan diɲɛma ibunadama ma. Dugutɛgɛɲa kanyi nan n na, n mu yanfanteya kolon.

sentences.english: Having mercy on thousands, overlooking evil and wrongdoing and sin; he will not let wrongdoers go free, but will send punishment on children for the sins of their fathers, and on their children's children to the third and fourth generation.
sentences.susu: N ma dugutɛgɛɲa buma abadan. N diɲɛma mixi xa tantanyi ma, n mu ratuma e xa matandi ma, n e xa yunubi xafarima. Kɔnɔ n mu nɛɛmuma tinxintareya ma. N tinxintaree sare ragbilenma nɛ e bɔnsɔɛ ma han e tolontolonyie xa waxati.»

sentences.english: Then Moses quickly went down on his face in worship.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a felen bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: And he said, If now I have grace in your eyes, let the Lord go among us, for this is a stiff-necked people, and give us forgiveness for our wrongdoing and our sin, and take us for your heritage.
sentences.susu: a fa a fala, «N Marigi, n bara i maxandi, xa n i kɛnɛn, i xa ɲɛrɛ muxu ya ma, barima xurutare nan muxu ra. I xa diɲɛ muxu xa matandi ma, i xa muxu xa yunubie xafari, alako muxu xa findi i xa ɲama yati nan na.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said, See, this is what I will undertake: before the eyes of your people I will do wonders, such as have not been done in all the earth or in any nation: and all your people will see the work of the Lord, for what I am about to do for you is greatly to be feared.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a yaabi, «N xa saatɛ tongo wo bɛ. N fama nɛ kaabanakoe rabade wo ya ma, naxee singe mu nu raba duniɲa kui. Si birin kaabama nɛ Alatala xa wali magaaxuxie ma, n naxee rabama i tan saabui ra.

sentences.english: Take care to do the orders which I give you today; I will send out from before you the Amorite and the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Perizzite and the Hivite and the Jebusite.
sentences.susu: Wo ɲɛngi sa n ma yaamari xɔn ma n naxan falama wo bɛ to. N fama nɛ Amorikae, Kanaankae, Xitikae, Perisikae, Hiwikae, nun Yebusukae keride wo ya ra.

sentences.english: But take care, and do not make any agreement with the people of the land where you are going, for it will be a cause of sin to you.
sentences.susu: Wo na so na, wo nun e tan naxa saatɛ yo xiri, xa na mu a ra e findima gantanyi nan na wo bɛ.

sentences.english: But their altars are to be overturned and their pillars broken and their images cut down:
sentences.susu: A lanma wo xa e xa sɛrɛxɛbadee rabira, wo xa e xa gɛmɛ tɔnxumae kana, wo xa e xa kuyee masolixie masɛgɛ.

sentences.english: For you are to be worshippers of no other god: for the Lord is a God who will not give his honour to another.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo magoro ala gbɛtɛ bun ma, barima n tan naxan xili Alatala, n mu wama n firin nde xɔn.

sentences.english: So see that you make no agreement with the people of the land, and do not go after their gods, or take part in their offerings, or be guests at their feasts,
sentences.susu: Wo naxa saatɛ xiri wo nun na bɔxikae ra, alako wo naxa n yanfa, wo fa e xa alae xa sɛrɛxɛe don e wo xilima lande naxee ma.

sentences.english: Or take their daughters for your sons; for when their daughters give worship before their gods, they will make your sons take part with them.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa mɛnni ginɛe fen wo xa die bɛ, alako e naxa a niya wo xa die xa e xa alae batu.

sentences.english: Make for yourselves no gods of metal.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa ala gbɛtɛ yailan wure raxunuxi ra.»

sentences.english: Keep the feast of unleavened bread; for seven days your food is to be bread without leaven, as I gave you orders, at the regular time in the month Abib; for in that month you came out of Egypt.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa Taami Lɛbinitare Sali raba. Xi solofere bun ma Abiba kike ra, wo xa taami lɛbinitare gbansan don, alɔ n wo yamarixi ki naxɛ. Wo xa ratu a ma a n wo raminixi Misira bɔxi kui na kike nan na.»

sentences.english: Every first male child is mine; the first male birth of your cattle, the first male of every ox and sheep.
sentences.susu: «N gbe nan di xɛmɛ singe birin na, a findi mixi ra, a findi xuruse ra wo xa gɔɔrɛ kui alɔ ninge, yɛxɛɛ, xa na mu a ra si.

sentences.english: A lamb may be given in payment for the young of an ass, but if you will not make payment for it, its neck will have to be broken. For all the first of your sons you are to make payment. No one is to come before me without an offering.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sofale xa di singe xun sara yɛxɛɛ xa na mu a ra si ra. Xa wo mu tin na ra, wo xa na sofale kɔnyi gira. Wo xa di xɛmɛ singe birin xun sara. Wo naxa wo makɔrɛ n na wo bɛlɛxɛ igeli ra.»

sentences.english: Six days let work be done, but on the seventh day take your rest: at ploughing time and at the grain-cutting you are to have a day for rest.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa wali xi senni lɔxunyi kui, kɔnɔ a xi solofere nde, wo xa wo malabu. Hali a findi xɛ buxa nun xɛ xaba tɛmui nan na, wo xa na sɛriyɛ suxu.»

sentences.english: And you are to keep the feast of weeks when you get in the first-fruits of the grain, and the feast at the turn of the year when you take in the produce of your fields.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa Lɔxunyie Sali raba Ala tantufe ra wo mɛngi singe xabama tɛmui naxɛ, a nun wo xɛ xabama tɛmui naxɛ ɲɛ ɲɔnyi.

sentences.english: Three times in the year let all your males come before the Lord, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ keren kui, xɛmɛ birin xa fa sali raba ra Isirayila Marigi Alatala ya xɔri sanya saxan.

sentences.english: For I will send out the nations before you and make wide the limits of your land; and no man will make an attempt to take your land while you go up to give worship to the Lord, three times in the year.
sentences.susu: Na waxati saxanyi kui, n mu tinma si yo xa fa wo xa bɔxi ba wo yi ra. N a niyama nɛ wo xa nɔ e ra, wo fa nde sa wo xa bɔxi xa gboe xun ma.»

sentences.english: No leaven is to be offered with the blood of my offering, and the offering of the Passover feast may not be kept till the morning.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa fa xuruse sɛrɛxɛ ra n xɔn ma, taami lɛbini daaxi biraxi a fɔxɔ ra. Wo na gɛ Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali sɛrɛxɛ donde, wo naxa na sube dɔnxɔɛ raxi yɛ i.

sentences.english: Take the first-fruits of your land as an offering to the house of the Lord your God. Let not the young goat be cooked in its mother's milk
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo xa sansi bogi fisamante singee ba sɛrɛxɛ ra wo Marigi Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira kui. Wo naxa si yɔrɛ ɲin a nga xiɲɛ ye ra.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Put all these words in writing; for on them is based the agreement which I will make with you.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «I xa yi yaamarie sɛbɛ, barima nee findixi saatɛ nan na n nun Isirayila ɲama tagi.»

sentences.english: And for forty days and forty nights Moses was there with the Lord, and in that time he had no food or drink. And he put in writing on the stones the words of the agreement, the ten rules of the law.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa lu Alatala yire xi tongo naani. Kɔɛ nun yanyi a mu sese don, a mu sese min. Na waxati Alatala naxa na sɛriyɛ fu sɛbɛ gɛmɛ walaxɛe ma, naxee findixi saatɛ masenyi ra.

sentences.english: Now when Moses came down from Mount Sinai, with the two stones in his hand, he was not conscious that his face was shining because of his talk with God.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa goro Turusinina geya fari, walaxɛ firin suxuxi a yi ra, naxee findixi saatɛ masenyi ra. Munsa mu nu a kolon a yatagi nu bara nɔrɔ a tan nun Ala xa sumunyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: But when Aaron and all the children of Israel saw Moses, and the shining of his face, they would not come near him for fear.
sentences.susu: Haruna nun Isirayilakae to nɔrɛ to Munsa yatagi ma, e mu suusa e makɔrɛde a ra.

sentences.english: Then Moses sent for them; and Aaron, with the chiefs of the people, came to him; and Moses had talk with them.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Haruna nun ɲama kuntigie xili, e fa lu yire keren.

sentences.english: And later, all the children of Israel came near, and he gave them all the orders which the Lord had given him on Mount Sinai.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ wɔyɛnde, Isirayila ɲama birin naxa fa e tuli matide Alatala xa yaamari ra, a naxan masenxi Munsa bɛ Turusinina geya fari.

sentences.english: And at the end of his talk with them, Moses put a veil over his face.
sentences.susu: Munsa to gɛ na falade, a naxa mafelenyi dusu a yatagi xun na.

sentences.english: But whenever Moses went in before the Lord to have talk with him, he took off the veil till he came out. And whenever he came out he said to the children of Israel what he had been ordered to say;
sentences.susu: A nu so kiri banxi kui maxɔrinyi tide Alatala ma, a nu mafelenyi bama a yatagi ma. A na mini tɛmui naxɛ, a Ala xa yaamari radangi Isirayila ɲama ma.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel saw that the face of Moses was shining: so Moses put the veil over his face again till he went to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae nu a toma Munsa yatagi nu nɔrɔxi ki naxɛ. A na gɛ na masenyi ra, a man a xa mafelenyi dusu a xun na, han a gbilen tɛmui Alatala yire.

sentences.english: And Moses sent for all the children of Israel to come together, and said to them, This is what the Lord has said and these are his orders.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Isirayila ɲama birin malan, a a fala e bɛ, «Alatala xa yaamarie nan ya:

sentences.english: Six days let work be done, but the seventh day is to be a holy day to you, a Sabbath of rest to the Lord; whoever does any work on that day is to be put to death.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wali xi senni lɔxunyi kui, kɔnɔ a xi solofere nde wo xa wo malabu. Lɔxɔɛ sugandixi na a ra Alatala bɛ. Mixi yo naxan wali suxuma na lɔxɔɛ, a lanma na kanyi xa faxa.

sentences.english: No fire is to be lighted in any of your houses on the Sabbath day.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa tɛ yo radɛxɛ wo xa banxi kui malabui lɔxɔɛ.»

sentences.english: And Moses said to all the meeting of the children of Israel, This is the order which the Lord has given:
sentences.susu: Munsa man naxa a masen Isirayila ɲama birin bɛ, «Alatala xa yaamarie nan ya:

sentences.english: Take from among you an offering to the Lord; everyone who has the impulse in his heart, let him give his offering to the Lord; gold and silver and brass;
sentences.susu: Wo xa hadiya ba Alatala bɛ. Mixi naxan na a ɲanige a xa hadiya ba, alɔ xɛɛma, gbeti, nun wure gbeeli,

sentences.english: And blue and purple and red and the best linen and goats' hair,
sentences.susu: gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi, bulu daaxi, nun a gbeeli, suwa dugi, nun gɛsɛ naxan yailanxi si xabe ra,

sentences.english: And sheepskins coloured red, and leather, and hard wood,
sentences.susu: yɛxɛɛ kontonyi kiri naxee soxi a gbeeli ra, peremui kirie, nun kasiya wuri,

sentences.english: And oil for the lights, and spices for the holy oil and for the sweet perfumes for burning.
sentences.susu: lanpui ture, labundɛ naxan masunbuma ture ra, surayi xiri ɲɔxunmɛ naxan ganma,

sentences.english: And beryls and jewels to be cut for the ephod and for the priest's bag.
sentences.susu: onixi gɛmɛ, nun gɛmɛ tofanyi naxee sama sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa donma kuye nun a xa donma kanke raxunmase ma.»

sentences.english: And let every wise-hearted man among you come and make whatever has been ordered by the Lord;
sentences.susu: «Wali kolonyie naxee na wo ya ma, e xa fa yi see yailande alɔ Alatala a yamarixi ki naxɛ:

sentences.english: The House and its tent and its cover, its hooks and its boards, its rods and its pillars and its bases;
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔlingira dugie, a xun makoto see, a suxusee, a xebenyie, a wurie nun e sanbunyie,

sentences.english: The ark with its cover and its rods and the veil hanging before it;
sentences.susu: a nun saatɛ kankira, a wuri kuyee, a dɛrakote, a nun dugi naxan gbakuma a ya ra,

sentences.english: The table and its rods and all its vessels, and the holy bread;
sentences.susu: hɔrɔmɔlingira teebili, a wuri kuyee, a yirabase, nun taami naxee bama Alatala bɛ sɛrɛxɛ ra,

sentences.english: And the support for the lights, with its vessels and its lights and the oil for the light;
sentences.susu: hɔrɔmɔlingira lanpui dɔxɔse, a yirabasee, a lanpuie, nun ture naxan sama a kui,

sentences.english: And the altar for burning spices, with its rods, and the holy oil and the sweet perfume, and the curtain for the door, at the door of the House;
sentences.susu: surayi sɛrɛxɛbade, a wuri kuyee, nun ture sɛniyɛnxi, labundɛ gan daaxi, a nun dugi naxan gbakuma hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra,

sentences.english: The altar of burned offerings, with its network of brass, its rods, and all its vessels, the washing-vessel and its base;
sentences.susu: sɛrɛxɛbade xungbe, a sube ganse wure gbeeli daaxi, a wuri kuyee, a yirabase, nun hɔrɔmɔlingira ye sase xungbe nun a dɔxɔse,

sentences.english: The hangings for the open space, its pillars and their bases, and the curtain for the doorway;
sentences.susu: hɔrɔmɔlingira tɛtɛ xa dugie, a wurie, nun e sanbunyie, a nun dugi naxan gbakuma tɛtɛ sode dɛ ra,

sentences.english: The nails for the House, and the nails for the open space and their cords;
sentences.susu: hɔrɔmɔlingira maxirisee, tɛtɛ maxirisee, nun e xa luutie,

sentences.english: The robes of needlework for the work of the holy place, the holy robes for Aaron the priest, and the robes for his sons when acting as priests.
sentences.susu: a nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ sosee Haruna nun a xa die bɛ.»

sentences.english: And all the children of Israel went away from Moses.
sentences.susu: Isirayila ɲama naxa keli Munsa xun ma.

sentences.english: And everyone whose heart was moved, everyone who was guided by the impulse of his spirit, came with his offering for the Lord, for whatever was needed for the Tent of meeting and its work and for the holy robes.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee a ɲanige, nee naxa fa e xa hadiya ra Alatala bɛ a xa hɔrɔmɔlingira tife ra, Ala e lima dɛnnaxɛ, a nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ sosee sɛniyɛnxie yailanfe ra.

sentences.english: They came, men and women, all who were ready to give, and gave pins and nose-rings and finger-rings and neck-ornaments, all of gold; everyone gave an offering of gold to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛe nun ginɛ naxee a ɲanigexi, e naxa fa xunmase xɛɛma daaxie ra, alɔ tulirasoe, xurundɛe, kɔnyi magorosee, bɛlɛxɛrasoee, a nun xunmase gbɛtɛ naxee yailanxi xɛɛma ra. E naxa na birin fi Alatala ma sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: And everyone who had blue and purple and red and the best linen and goats' hair and sheepskins coloured red and leather, gave them.
sentences.susu: Gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi, bulu daaxi, nun a gbeeli, suwa dugie, gɛsɛ naxan yailanxi si xabe ra, yɛxɛɛ kontonyi kiri naxee soxi a gbeeli ra, nun peremui kirie nu na naxee yi ra, nee naxa fa e ra.

sentences.english: Everyone who had silver and brass gave an offering of them to the Lord; and everyone who had hard wood, such as was needed for the work, gave it.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee nu a ɲanigexi, nee naxa fa gbeti nun wure gbeeli hadiya ra Alatala bɛ. Kasiya wuri kanyie naxa fa na wuri ra hɔrɔmɔlingira wali xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And all the women who were expert with their hands, made cloth, and gave the work of their hands, blue and purple and red and the best linen.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxan birin fata dugi sɔxɔde, e naxa dugie sɔxɔ e bɛlɛxɛ ra, e fa nee ra: dugi gɛrɛ daaxi, bulu daaxi, nun a gbeeli. E naxa fa suwa dugi ra.

sentences.english: And those women who had the knowledge, made the goats' hair into cloth.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxan birin fata, e a ɲanige, e naxa gɛsɛ yailan si xabe ra.

sentences.english: And the rulers gave the beryls and the cut jewels for the ephod and the priest's bag;
sentences.susu: Ɲama kuntigie naxa fa onixi gɛmɛe nun gɛmɛ tofanyi gbɛtɛe ra, naxee sama sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa donma kuye nun a xa donma kanke raxunmase ra.

sentences.english: And the spice and the oil for the light, and the holy oil and the sweet perfumes.
sentences.susu: E naxa fa labundɛ nun ture ra hɔrɔmɔlingira lanpui bɛ, a nun ture sɛniyɛnxi nun labundɛ gan daaxi gbɛtɛ.

sentences.english: The children of Israel, every man and woman, from the impulse of their hearts, gave their offerings freely to the Lord for the work which the Lord had given Moses orders to have done.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka birin naxee a ɲanigexi e bɔɲɛ kui, xɛmɛe nun ginɛe, nee naxa fa hadiya ra Alatala xɔn ma, alako Munsa xa wali raba Alatala a yamarixi naxan na.

sentences.english: And Moses said to the children of Israel, See, the Lord has made selection of Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah;
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a masen Isirayilakae bɛ, «Wo a kolon, Alatala bara Besaleli Uri xa di sugandi, Xuru xa mamadi naxan fatanxi Yuda bɔnsɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And he has made him full of the spirit of God, in all wisdom and knowledge and art of every sort;
sentences.susu: Alatala bara xaxili fanyi fi a ma, alako a xa wali birin naba ki kolon lɔnni fanyi ra,

sentences.english: As an expert designer of beautiful things, working in gold and silver and brass;
sentences.susu: a xa nɔ wali tode a xaxili kui beenun a xa raba, a xa nɔ xɛɛma, gbeti, nun wure gbeeli rawalide,

sentences.english: Trained in the cutting of stones and the ornamenting of wood and in every sort of handwork.
sentences.susu: a xa nɔ gɛmɛ fanyi masolide a fa a rabilinyi yailan, a xa nɔ kamudɛriɲa nun wali gbɛtɛe rabade.

sentences.english: And he has given to him, and to Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, the power of training others.
