sentences.susu: Ala bara a niya Besaleli xa nɔ mixi gbɛtɛ matinkande a xa wali ra. Ala bara na niya Oholiyabu Axisamaki xa di fan bɛ, naxan fatanxi Dana bɔnsɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: To them he has given knowledge of all the arts of the handworker, of the designer, and the expert workman; of the maker of needlework in blue and purple and red and the best linen, and of the maker of cloth; in all the arts of the designer and the trained workman they are expert.
sentences.susu: Ala bara e mali alako e xa fata wali birin na, alɔ gɛmɛ nun wuri masolife, pirinti rabafe, suwa dugi sɔxɔfe gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi, bulu daaxi, nun a gbeeli ra, a nun wali birin e naxan toma e xaxili kui.»

sentences.english: So let Bezalel and Oholiab get to work, with every wise-hearted man to whom the Lord has given wisdom and knowledge, to do whatever is necessary for the ordering of the holy place, as the Lord has given orders.
sentences.susu: Besaleli, Oholiyabu, nun wali fanyi rabae, Alatala bara xaxili fanyi fi naxee ma, alako e xa hɔrɔmɔlingira wali birin naba ki kolon lɔnni fanyi ra, nee wali suxu nɛ alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then Moses sent for Bezalel and Oholiab, and for all the wise-hearted men to whom the Lord had given wisdom, even everyone who was moved by the impulse of his heart to come and take part in the work:
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Besaleli, Oholiyabu, nun wali fanyi rabae xili, Alatala bara xaxili fanyi fi naxee ma, naxee nu bara a ɲanige e xa na wali raba.

sentences.english: And they took from Moses all the offerings which the children of Israel had given for the building of the holy place. And still they went on giving him more free offerings every morning.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa hadiya birin so e yi ra, Isirayilakae naxee baxi sɛrɛxɛ ɲanigexi ra e xa hɔrɔmɔlingira tife xa fe ra. Gɛɛsɛgɛ yo gɛɛsɛgɛ, e nu hadiya gbɛtɛ sɔtɔma.

sentences.english: Then the wise men, who were doing all the work of the holy place, came from their work;
sentences.susu: Na wali fanyi rabae naxa keli e xa walie dɛ i, alako e xa hɔrɔmɔlingira wali gbansan naba.

sentences.english: And said to Moses, The people are giving much more than is needed for the work which the Lord has given us orders to do.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala Munsa bɛ, «Ɲama fama hadiya naxee ra, a gbo wali bɛ, Alatala naxan yamarixi.»

sentences.english: So Moses made an order and had it given out through all the tents, saying, Let no man or woman make any more offerings for the holy place. So the people were kept from giving more.
sentences.susu: Na kui Munsa naxa yaamari fi, yi xibaaru xa rayensen yonkinde kui, «Mixi naxa wali sɔnɔn hadiya xa fe ra, naxan bama hɔrɔmɔlingira tife ra.» Ɲama naxa na xui rabatu, e mu fa na hadiya mɔɔli ra sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: For the material they had was enough and more than enough for all the work which had to be done.
sentences.susu: Se naxee nu bara ba, nee nu nɔma wali raɲɔnde a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Then all the expert workmen among them made the House with its ten curtains; of the best linen, blue and purple and red, they made them, with winged ones worked by expert designers.
sentences.susu: Wali fanyi rabae naxa hɔrɔmɔlingira ti suwa dugi fu ra, a gɛrɛ daaxi, a bulu daaxi, nun a gbeeli. E malekɛe sawurɛ masɔxɔ a ma a tofan ki ma.

sentences.english: Every curtain was twenty-eight cubits long and four cubits wide, all of the same measure.
sentences.susu: Dugi birin kuya nɔngɔn mɔxɔɲɛn nun solomasaxan, e igbo nɔngɔn naani. E kuyɛ nun e igboya lan.

sentences.english: And five curtains were joined together, and the other five curtains were joined together.
sentences.susu: E dugi suuli dɛgɛ e boore ra, e dugi suuli gbɛtɛ fan dɛgɛ e boore ra. Na kui na dugi fu bara findi dugi firin na.

sentences.english: And they put twists of blue cord on the edge of the outside curtain of the first group, and in the same way on the outside curtain of the second group.
sentences.susu: E gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi dɛgɛ na dugi singe dɛ kiri ma, a nun na dugi firin nde dɛ kiri ma.

sentences.english: Fifty twists on the one curtain and fifty on the edge of the curtain of the other group; the twists being opposite to one another.
sentences.susu: E gɛsɛ tongo suuli dɛgɛ na firinyi dɛ kiri ma alako e birin xa lan e boore ma.

sentences.english: And they made fifty hooks of gold, joining the curtains one to another with the hooks; and so the House was made.
sentences.susu: E suxuse tongo suuli yailan xɛɛma ra, na dugi firinyie ralan e boore ra na suxusee ra. Na nan a niya hɔrɔmɔlingira findi dugi keren na.

sentences.english: And they made curtains of goats' hair for the tent; eleven curtains were made.
sentences.susu: E dugi fu nun keren sɔxɔ si xabe ra, naxee Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira makotoma.

sentences.english: Every curtain was thirty cubits long and four cubits wide, all of the same measure.
sentences.susu: Dugi keren kuya nɔngɔn tongo saxan, a igbo nɔngɔn naani. Na dugi fu nun kerenyi birin lan nɛ.

sentences.english: Five curtains were joined together to make one group, and six curtains were joined together to make the other group.
sentences.susu: E dugi suuli dɛgɛ e boore ra, e findi dugi keren na. Na dugi senni naxee luxi, e fan dɛgɛ e boore ra.

sentences.english: And they put fifty twists of cord on the edge of the outside curtain of the first group, and fifty twists on the edge of the outside curtain of the second group,
sentences.susu: E gɛsɛ tongo suuli dɛgɛ na dugi singe ra, a nun na dugi firin nde ra.

sentences.english: And fifty hooks of brass for joining them together to make the tent.
sentences.susu: E suxuse tongo suuli yailan wure gbeeli ra, na dugi firinyie ralan e boore ra na suxusee ra. Na nan a niya na birin findi dugi keren na naxan Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira makotoma.

sentences.english: And they made a cover of sheepskins coloured red, to go over the tent, and a cover of leather over that.
sentences.susu: E makotose gbɛtɛ yailan yɛxɛɛ kontonyi kiri ra, naxan soxi a gbeeli ra. E makotose gbɛtɛ yailan peremui kiri ra.

sentences.english: And for the uprights of the House they made boards of hard wood.
sentences.susu: E kasiya wuri xaba xebenyie ra hɔrɔmɔlingira tima naxee ra.

sentences.english: The boards were ten cubits long and one cubit and a half wide.
sentences.susu: Kankan kuya nɔngɔn fu, a igbo nɔngɔn keren nun a tagi.

sentences.english: Every board had two tongues fixed into it; all the boards were made in this way.
sentences.susu: Suxuse firin lu hɔrɔmɔlingira xebenyi birin ma e kafuma e boore ma naxee ra.

sentences.english: They made twenty boards for the south side of the House:
sentences.susu: Xebenyi mɔxɔɲɛn nan ti hɔrɔmɔlingira yirefanyi ma.

sentences.english: And for these twenty boards, forty silver bases, two bases under every board, to take its tongues.
sentences.susu: Sanbunyi gbeti daaxi tongo naani nan sa na xebenyi mɔxɔɲɛn bun ma, xebenyi keren, sanbunyi firin. E lu xebenyi suxusee fɛ ma.

sentences.english: And for the second side of the House, on the north, they made twenty boards,
sentences.susu: Xebenyi mɔxɔɲɛn nan ti hɔrɔmɔlingira kɔɔla fan ma,

sentences.english: With their forty silver bases, two bases for every board.
sentences.susu: a nun e sanbunyi gbeti daaxi tongo naani, xebenyi keren, sanbunyi firin.

sentences.english: And for the west side of the House, at the back, they made six boards,
sentences.susu: Xebenyi senni nan ti hɔrɔmɔlingira xanbi ra sogegorode mabiri.

sentences.english: And two boards for the angles at the back.
sentences.susu: E xebenyi firin yailan tuxuie bɛ hɔrɔmɔlingira xanbi ra,

sentences.english: These were joined together at the base and at the top to one ring, so forming the two angles.
sentences.susu: naxee fuge nun labe lanma e boore ma, e xiri fuge ra se digilinxi ra. Na tuxui firinyi yailan na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: So there were eight boards with sixteen bases of silver, two bases under every board.
sentences.susu: Na birin lanxi xebenyi solomasaxan nan ma, a nun e sanbunyi gbeti daaxi fu nun senni, xebenyi keren, sanbunyi firin.

sentences.english: And they made rods of hard wood; five for the boards on one side of the House,
sentences.susu: E wuri suuli yailan kasiya wuri ra, hɔrɔmɔlingira xebenyie tima naxee ma. Suuli rawali sɛɛti ma,

sentences.english: And five for the boards on the other side of the House, and five for the boards at the back, on the west.
sentences.susu: suuli rawali boore sɛɛti ma, suuli rawali hɔrɔmɔlingira xanbi ra sogegorode mabiri.

sentences.english: The middle rod was made to go right through the rings of all the boards from one end to the other.
sentences.susu: Wuri naxan lu a tagi, na dangi xebenyie nan xun ma, a keli sɛɛti singe a sa dɔxɔ boore ra.

sentences.english: All the boards were plated with gold, and the rings through which the rods went were of gold, and the rods were plated with gold.
sentences.susu: Na xebenyie, nun na wurie, nun se digilinxie wuri so naxee kui, na birin maso xɛɛma nan na.

sentences.english: And he made the veil of the best linen, blue and purple and red, worked with winged ones designed by expert workmen.
sentences.susu: E suwa dugi yailan gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi, bulu daaxi, nun a gbeeli ra. Malekɛ sawurɛe dɛgɛ na ma, a tofan ki ma.

sentences.english: And they made four pillars for it of hard wood plated with gold: they had hooks of gold and four silver bases.
sentences.susu: A gbaku kasiya wuri naani ma naxee masoxi xɛɛma ra, e tixi gbeti sanbunyie ma. Suxuse naxee dugi xirima wurie ma, nee fan maso xɛɛma ra.

sentences.english: And they made a curtain for the door of the tent, of the best linen with needlework of blue and purple and red;
sentences.susu: E suwa dugi gbɛtɛ yailan gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi, bulu daaxi, nun a gbeeli ra hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra. E a masɔxɔ a fanyi ra, a xa tofan.

sentences.english: And five pillars for the curtain, with their hooks; the heads of the pillars were of gold and they were circled with bands of gold; and their five bases were of brass.
sentences.susu: E a gbaku wuri suuli ma naxee yailanxi kasiya wuri ra, e masoxi xɛɛma ra, e tixi gbeti sanbunyie ma. Suxuse naxee dugi xirima wurie ma, nee yailanxi wure gbeeli ra.

sentences.english: And Bezalel made the ark of hard wood, two and a half cubits long, a cubit and a half wide and a cubit and a half high;
sentences.susu: Besaleli naxa kankira yailan kasiya wuri ra. A kuya nɔngɔn firin nun a tagi, a igbo nɔngɔn keren nun a tagi, a ite nɔngɔn keren nun a tagi.

sentences.english: Plating it inside and out with the best gold, and putting an edge of gold all round it.
sentences.susu: A naxa a kui nun a fari maso xɛɛma ra, a naxa a dɛ kiri fan yailan xɛɛma ra.

sentences.english: And he made four gold rings for its four angles, two on one side and two on the other,
sentences.susu: A naxa a suxude digilinxi naani rafala xɛɛma ra a tunxun naanie ma, firin na sɛɛti, firin na boore sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And rods of the same wood plated with gold.
sentences.susu: A naxa kasiya wuri firin masoli a bɛ, a fa e maso xɛɛma ra.

sentences.english: These rods he put in the rings at the sides of the ark, for lifting it.
sentences.susu: A naxa e raso na kankira suxude digilinxie kui, nee findi kankira tongose ra.

sentences.english: And he made the cover all of gold, two and a half cubits long and a cubit and a half wide.
sentences.susu: A naxa na kankira dɛrakote yailan xɛɛma fanyi ra, a findi xunsare yire ra. A kuya nɔngɔn firin nun a tagi, a igbo nɔngɔn keren nun a tagi.

sentences.english: And he made two winged ones, hammered out of one bit of gold, for the two ends of the cover;
sentences.susu: A naxa malekɛ sawurɛ firin yailan xɛɛma xabuxi ra kankira dɛrakote fari na sɛɛti firinyie ma.

sentences.english: Placing one at one end and one at the other; the winged ones were part of the cover.
sentences.susu: Na malekɛ sawurɛe nun na kankira dɛrakote findi keren na.

sentences.english: And their wings were stretched out over the cover; the faces of the winged ones were opposite one another and facing the cover.
sentences.susu: Na malekɛ sawurɛ firinyie naxa ti e boore ya i, e gabutenyie italaxi, e xun sinxi xunsare yire.

sentences.english: And he made the table of hard wood, two cubits long, a cubit wide and a cubit and a half high;
sentences.susu: A naxa teebili yailan kasiya wuri ra, naxan kuya nɔngɔn firin, a igbo nɔngɔn keren, a ite nɔngɔn keren nun a tagi.

sentences.english: Plating it with the best gold and putting a gold edge all round it.
sentences.susu: A naxa xɛɛma fanyi maso a ma, a nun a dɛ kirie ma.

sentences.english: And he made a frame all round it about as wide as a man's hand, edged with gold all round.
sentences.susu: A naxa xebenyi nde sa na dɛ kirie bun ma, naxan igbo suxui keren a nun a tagi. A naxa xɛɛma sa na fan dɛ kirie ma.

sentences.english: And he made four gold rings, and put the rings at the angles of its four feet.
sentences.susu: A naxa a suxude digilinxi naani rafala xɛɛma ra a tunxun naanie ma, naxee ilanma a sanyie ra.

sentences.english: The rings were fixed under the frame to take the rods with which the table was to be lifted.
sentences.susu: E nu na na xebenyi bun ma. Wuri kuyee nu soma nee kui teebili xaninfe ra.

sentences.english: The rods for lifting the table he made of hard wood plated with gold.
sentences.susu: A naxa wuri kuyee masoli kasiya wuri ra, a e maso xɛɛma ra. Nee findi teebili tongose ra.

sentences.english: And all the table-vessels, the plates and spoons and basins and the cups for liquids, he made of the best gold.
sentences.susu: Piletie, tɔnbilie, pɔɔtie, nun paani naxee sama na teebili ma, naxee rawalima sɛrɛxɛ yeerama daaxi xa fe ra, a naxa e birin yailan xɛɛma fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Then he made the support for the lights, all of the best gold; its base and its pillar were of hammered gold; its cups and buds and flowers were all made out of the same metal:
sentences.susu: A naxa lanpui dɔxɔse nde yailan xɛɛma fanyi xabuxi ra. A sanyi, a bili, a salonyie, nun lanpui dɔxɔde naxee maniya sansi fugee ra, na birin findi keren na.

sentences.english: It had six branches coming out from its sides, three from one side and three from the other;
sentences.susu: Salon senni nan mini lanpui dɔxɔse bili ma, saxan sɛɛti keren, saxan boore sɛɛti.

sentences.english: Every branch having three cups made like almond flowers, every cup with a bud and a flower on all the branches;
sentences.susu: Tɔnbili saxan nan lu na salon senni birin xun ma. E maniya sansi bogi ra naxan dɔxɔxi a burɛxɛee nun a fugee tagi.

sentences.english: And on its pillar, four cups like almond flowers, every one with its bud and its flower;
sentences.susu: Tɔnbili naani gbɛtɛ nan lu lanpui dɔxɔse bili ma. E fan maniya sansi bogi ra naxan dɔxɔxi a burɛxɛe nun a fugee tagi.

sentences.english: And under every two branches a bud, made with the branch, for all six branches of it.
sentences.susu: Na salon firin firin dɔxɔ saxanyie bun ma naxee kelixi a bili ma, a sa nɛ mɛnni fan ma.

sentences.english: The buds and the branches were made of the same metal, all together one complete work of the best hammered gold.
sentences.susu: Na tɔnbilie nun lanpui salonyie findi keren na, e yailan xɛɛma fanyi xabuxi ra.

sentences.english: And he made the seven vessels for the lights, and all the necessary instruments for it, of gold.
sentences.susu: A naxa lanpui solofere yailan, a e dɔxɔ e dɔxɔdee ma alako e dɛxɛ xa yare iyalan.

sentences.english: A talent of the best gold was used for the making of it and its vessels.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛma naxan nawalixi lanpui dɔxɔse nun lanpui yirabase yailanfe ra, na findi xɛɛma kilo tongo saxan nun naani nan na.

sentences.english: And he made the altar for the burning of spices, using the same hard wood; it was square, a cubit long and a cubit wide and two cubits high; the horns made of the same.
sentences.susu: A naxa surayi sɛrɛxɛbade yailan kasiya wuri ra. A kuya nɔngɔn keren, a igbo nɔngɔn keren, a sɛɛti naani birin lan, a ite nɔngɔn firin. Ferie naxa lu a tuxuie ra, e nun sɛrɛxɛbade findi se keren na.

sentences.english: The top and the sides and the horns were all plated with the best gold; and he put an edge of gold all round it.
sentences.susu: A naxa na sɛrɛxɛbade birin maso xɛɛma xinde ra, a fari, a sɛɛtie, a ferie, nun a dɛ kiri.

sentences.english: And he made two gold rings, placing them on the two opposite sides under the edge, to take the rods for lifting it.
sentences.susu: A naxa suxuse digilinxi firin yailan xɛɛma ra sɛrɛxɛbade sɛɛti firinyie ma, a dɛ kiri labe ra, wuri kuyee soma naxee kui a xaninfe ra.

sentences.english: The rods he made of the same hard wood, plating them with gold.
sentences.susu: A naxa na wurie yailan kasiya wuri ra, a naxa xɛɛma maso e ma.

sentences.english: And he made the holy oil and the perfume of sweet spices for burning, after the art of the perfume-maker.
sentences.susu: A naxa ture sɛniyɛnxi nun surayi xiri fanyi yailan naxan nawalima sɛrɛxɛdubɛ tife ra. Na wali xa raba a fanyi ra alɔ labundɛ rafalɛ a rafalama ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: The altar of burned offerings he made of hard wood; a square altar, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high,
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi sɛrɛxɛbade yailan kasiya wuri ra, naxan kuya nɔngɔn suuli, a igbo nɔngɔn suuli, a sɛɛti birin lan, a ite nɔngɔn saxan.

sentences.english: And he put horns at its four angles made of the same, plating it all with brass;
sentences.susu: A naxa feri naani yailan a tuxui birin ma, naxee findixi se keren na sɛrɛxɛbade ra. A naxa wure gbeeli maso na birin ma.

sentences.english: And brass was used for all the vessels of the altar, the baskets and the spades, the basins and the meat-hooks and the fire-trays; all the vessels he made of brass
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛbade yirabase birin yailan wure gbeeli ra, alɔ xube sasee, pelie, pɔɔtie, sube sɔxɔsee, nun tundee tɛ sama naxee kui.

sentences.english: And he made a network of brass for the altar, under the frame round it, stretching half-way up;
sentences.susu: A naxa se nde yailan wure gbeeli ra naxan sama tɛ xun ma, sube sama naxan fari. A naxa suxuse digilinxie wure gbeeli daaxi sa a tuxui ma,

sentences.english: And four rings for the four angles of this network, to take the rods.
sentences.susu: alako a xa gbaku sɛrɛxɛbade kui a tagi.

sentences.english: The rods he made of hard wood plated with brass.
sentences.susu: A naxa wuri kuyee yailan kasiya wuri ra wure gbeeli masoxi e ma.

sentences.english: He put the rods through the rings at the opposite sides of the altar for lifting it; he made the altar hollow, boarded in with wood.
sentences.susu: A naxa e raso suxuse digilinxi naanie kui sɛrɛxɛbade sɛɛti firinyie ma a xaninfe ra.

sentences.english: And he made the washing-vessel of brass on a brass base, using the polished brass looking-glasses given by the women who did work at the doors of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: A naxa hɔrɔmɔlingira ye sase xungbe nun a dɔxɔse yailan wure gbeeli ra, a naxan sɔtɔ ginɛe ra naxee nu malanma hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: To make the open space, he put hangings on the south side, of the best linen, a hundred cubits long:
sentences.susu: A naxa tɛtɛ yailan suwa dugi ra. Tɛtɛ kuya nɔngɔn kɛmɛ yirefanyi mabiri ra.

sentences.english: Their twenty pillars and their twenty bases were brass; and the hooks of the pillars and their bands were of silver.
sentences.susu: A naxa gɛrɛ dugi gbaku na wuri mɔxɔɲɛn ma, naxee tixi sanbunyi wure gbeeli daaxie ma. Na dugi suxusee naxa yailan gbeti ra.

sentences.english: And for the north side. hangings a hundred cubits long, on twenty brass pillars in brass bases, with silver hooks and bands.
sentences.susu: Tɛtɛ kuya nɔngɔn kɛmɛ kɔɔla fan mabiri ra. A naxa gɛrɛ dugi gbaku na wuri mɔxɔɲɛn ma, naxee tixi sanbunyi wure gbeeli daaxie ma. Na dugi suxusee xa yailan gbeti ra.

sentences.english: And on the west side, hangings fifty cubits long, on ten pillars in ten bases, with silver bands.
sentences.susu: Tɛtɛ igbo nɔngɔn tongo suuli sogegorode mabiri ra. A naxa gɛrɛ dugi gbaku na wuri fu ma, naxee tixi sanbunyi wure gbeeli daaxie ma.

sentences.english: And on the east side, the open space was fifty cubits long.
sentences.susu: Tɛtɛ igbo nɔngɔn tongo suuli sogetede fan mabiri ra.

sentences.english: The hangings on one side of the doorway were fifteen cubits long, on three pillars with their three bases;
sentences.susu: A naxa gɛrɛ dugi gbaku sɛɛti ma wuri saxan ma, naxee tixi sanbunyi ma. Na kuyɛ nɔngɔn fu nun suuli.

sentences.english: And the same on the other side of the doorway; on this side and on that the hangings were fifteen cubits long, on three pillars with their three bases.
sentences.susu: A naxa gɛrɛ dugi gbɛtɛ gbaku boore sɛɛti ma wuri saxan ma, naxee tixi sanbunyi ma. Na fan kuyɛ nɔngɔn fu nun suuli.

sentences.english: All the hangings were of the best linen.
sentences.susu: Tɛtɛ naxa yailan suwa dugi ra.

sentences.english: And the bases of the pillars were of brass; their hooks and the bands round the tops of them were of silver; all the pillars were ringed with silver.
sentences.susu: Wuri naxee tixi tɛtɛ ma, e tixi e sanbunyi wure gbeeli daaxie ma. Dugi suxusee fan na e ma naxee yailanxi gbeti ra.

sentences.english: And the curtain for the doorway of the open space was of the best linen, with designs of blue and purple and red in needlework; it was twenty cubits long and five cubits high, to go with the hangings round the sides.
sentences.susu: Tɛtɛ sode dɛ naxa yailan suwa dugi ra naxan masɔxɔxi gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi, bulu daaxi, nun a gbeeli ra. Na dugi kuya nɔngɔn mɔxɔɲɛn, a ite nɔngɔn suuli, alɔ tɛtɛ dugi birin xa maite.

sentences.english: There were four pillars with their bases, all of brass, the hooks being of silver, and their tops and their bands being covered with silver.
sentences.susu: A naxa na gbaku wuri naani ma, naxee tixi e sanbunyi wure gbeeli daaxie ma. Na dugi suxusee nun na wuri xunyie yailanxi gbeti ra.

sentences.english: All the nails used for the House and the open space round it were of brass.
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔlingira nun tɛtɛ luuti xirima se naxee ma, nee birin yailan wure gbeeli nan na.

sentences.english: This is the price of the making of the House, even the House of witness, as it was valued by the word of Moses, for the work of the Levites under the direction of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔlingira, seede walaxɛ na naxan kui, a wali dɛntɛgɛ nan yi ki. Lewi bɔnsɔɛ na wali raba Munsa xa yaamari nan bun ma. Haruna xa di, Itamari nan findi na wali yarerati ra.

sentences.english: Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made everything as the Lord had given orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: Besaleli, Uri xa di, Xuru xa mamadi, Yuda bɔnsɔɛ, naxa Alatala xa yaamari birin naba, a naxan masen Munsa bɛ.

sentences.english: And with him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; a designer and a trained workman, expert in needlework of blue and purple and red and the best linen.
sentences.susu: Oholiyabu, Axisamaki xa di, Dana bɔnsɔɛ, findi Besaleli malima nan na. A nu fata se masolide nun suwa dugi masɔxɔde gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi, bulu daaxi, nun a gbeeli daaxi ra.

sentences.english: The gold used for all the different work done for the holy place, the gold which was given, was twenty-nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels in weight, by the scale of the holy place.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛma xasabi naxan nawalixi hɔrɔmɔlingira tife ra, naxan sɔtɔ hadiya ra, a lan kilo kɛmɛ solomanaani kilo tongo solomanaani nan ma hɔrɔmɔlingira maniyase sɛriyɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: And the silver given by those who were numbered of the people was a hundred talents, and a thousand, seven hundred and seventy-five shekels in weight, by the scale of the holy place.
sentences.susu: Gbeti xasabi naxan sɔtɔ mixi kɔntixie ra, na lan nɛ kilo wulu saxan kilo kɛmɛ solomasaxan nun tongo solofere nun suuli nan ma hɔrɔmɔlingira maniyase sɛriyɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: A beka, that is, half a shekel by the holy scale, for everyone who was numbered; there were six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty men of twenty years old and over.
sentences.susu: Mixi wulu kɛmɛ senni mixi wulu saxan kɛmɛ suuli tongo suuli, naxee nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn sɔtɔ nun na xanbi, naxee kɔntixi Isirayilakae tagi, kankan naxa gbeti giramu senni fi hɔrɔmɔlingira maniyase sɛriyɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: Of this silver, a hundred talents was used for making the bases of the pillars of the holy place and of the veil; a talent for every base.
sentences.susu: E naxa gbeti kilo wulu saxan kilo kɛmɛ naani raxunu wuri sanbunyi kɛmɛ yailanfe ra hɔrɔmɔlingira nun tɛtɛ bɛ. Wuri sanbun keren findi gbeti kilo tongo saxan nun naani nan na.

sentences.english: And a thousand, seven hundred and seventy-five shekels of silver was used to make the hooks for the pillars, and for plating the tops of the pillars and for making their bands.
sentences.susu: Na kilo mɔxɔɲɛn naxan lu, na naxa yailan dugi nun wuri suxusee nun wuri xunyie ra.

sentences.english: The brass which was given was seventy talents, two thousand four hundred shekels;
sentences.susu: Wure gbeeli xasabi naxan sɔtɔ Isirayila xa hadiya ra, a lan kilo wulu firin kilo kɛmɛ naani nun solofere.

sentences.english: From it he made the bases of the doorway of the Tent of meeting and the brass altar and the network for it and all the vessels for the altar,
sentences.susu: E naxa a findi hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ wuri sanbunyie ra, nun sɛrɛxɛbade wure gbeeli daaxi, nun na xa yirabase birin,

sentences.english: And the bases for the open space all round and for its doorway, and all the nails for the House and for the open space.
sentences.susu: nun tɛtɛ wuri sanbunyie, nun a sode dɛ xa wuri sanbunyie, nun tɛtɛ maxirisee ra.

sentences.english: And from the needlework of blue and purple and red they made the robes used for the work of the holy place, and the holy robes for Aaron, as the Lord had given orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: E naxa sose sɛniyɛnxie dɛgɛ Haruna nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛe bɛ naxee walima hɔrɔmɔlingira kui. Na sose yailanxi gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi, bulu daaxi, a gbeeli, nun suwa dugi ra, alɔ Alatala a yamari Munsa bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: The ephod he made of gold and blue and purple and red and the best linen;
sentences.susu: E donma kuye yailan nɛ xɛɛma gɛsɛ ra, gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi, bulu daaxi, a gbeeli, nun suwa dugi ra.

sentences.english: Hammering the gold into thin plates and cutting it into wires to be worked into the blue and the purple and the red and the linen by the designer.
sentences.susu: E naxa xɛɛma kebela itala, e a ixaba e a yailan waya ra. E naxa gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi, bulu daaxi, a gbeeli, nun suwa dugi masɔxɔ na waya ra. A findi wali tofanyi nan na.

sentences.english: And they made two bands for joining its edges together at the top of the arms.
sentences.susu: E naxa tunki raxunmase firin yailan naxee xirima donma kuye ra.

sentences.english: And the beautifully worked band which went on it was of the same design and the same material, worked in gold and blue and purple and red and twisted linen-work, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: Bɛlɛti fan yailan na ki nɛ gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi, bulu daaxi, a gbeeli, nun suwa dugi ra. Na bɛlɛti nun donma findi keren na. Na birin yailanxi alɔ Alatala Munsa yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then they made the beryl stones, fixed in twisted frames of gold and cut like the cutting of a stamp, with the names of the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: E naxa onixi gɛmɛe rawali, e naxa e rabilinyi findi xɛɛma ra. E naxa Isirayila xa die xili masoli e ma, alɔ e sɛbɛli masolima xurundɛ ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: These he put on the ephod, over the arm-holes, to be stones of memory for the children of Israel, as the Lord had said to Moses.
sentences.susu: E naxa e sa tunki raxunmasee ma, e xa findi tɔnxuma see ra Isirayila xa die xa fe ma, alɔ Alatala Munsa yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: The priest's bag was designed like the ephod, of the best linen worked with gold and blue and purple and red.
sentences.susu: E donma kanke raxunmase yailan nɛ a fanyi ra alɔ donma kuye. E na suwa dugi sɔxɔ xɛɛma gɛsɛ, gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi, bulu daaxi, nun a gbeeli ra.

sentences.english: It was square and folded in two, as long and as wide as the stretch of a man's hand;
sentences.susu: A xa kuyɛ nun a xa igboya lan nɛ suxui keren ma, a findi dugi firin na.

sentences.english: And on it they put four lines of stones: in the first line was a carnelian, a chrysolite, and an emerald;
sentences.susu: Gɛmɛ tofanyie safɛ naani nu na a ma. Safɛ singe findi gɛmɛe nan na, naxee xili sariduwani, topasi, nun emerode.

sentences.english: In the second, a ruby, a sapphire, and an onyx;
sentences.susu: Safɛ firin nde, esikaribukulu, safiri, nun diyaman.

sentences.english: In the third, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;
sentences.susu: Safɛ saxan nde, opale, agati, nun ametisite.

sentences.english: In the fourth, a topaz, a beryl, and a jasper; they were fixed in twisted frames of gold.
sentences.susu: Safɛ naani nde, kirosolite, onixi, nun yasipe. Xɛɛma nu na na gɛmɛ birin rabilinyi ma.

sentences.english: There were twelve stones for the twelve tribes of Israel; on every one the name of one of the tribes of Israel was cut, like the cutting of a stamp.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa die xilie masoli na gɛmɛ fu nun firin ma, alɔ sɛbɛli masolima xurundɛ ma ki naxɛ. Kankan xili masoli gɛmɛ nde ma. E findi Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ fu nun firinyi matɔnxuma se nan na.

sentences.english: And on the bag they put gold chains, twisted like cords.
sentences.susu: E luuti die dɛgɛ nɛ na donma kanke raxunmase ma, naxee yailanxi xɛɛma ra.

sentences.english: And they made two gold frames and two gold rings, the rings being fixed to the ends of the priest's bag;
sentences.susu: E xurundɛ firin yailan xɛɛma ra, e e dɛgɛ donma kanke raxunmase ma a dɛ kiri firinyie ma a fuge ra.

sentences.english: And they put the two twisted chains on the two rings at the ends of the priest's bag;
sentences.susu: E na luuti xɛɛma daaxie xiri na xurundɛ firinyie ma, naxee dɛgɛxi donma kanke raxunmase dɛ kiri ma.

sentences.english: And the other two ends of the chains were joined to the two frames and fixed to the front of the ephod over the arm-holes.
sentences.susu: E man na luuti firinyie xiri donma kuye tunki raxunmasee ma.

sentences.english: And they made two rings of gold and put them on the two lower ends of the bag, on the inner side nearest to the ephod.
sentences.susu: E xurundɛ firin gbɛtɛ yailan xɛɛma ra, naxee dɛgɛma donma kanke raxunmase dɛ kirie ma a labe ra. E nee dɛgɛ donma kuye sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And two other gold rings were put on the front of the ephod, over the arm-holes, at the join, and over the worked band.
sentences.susu: E man naxa xurundɛ firin gbɛtɛ yailan xɛɛma ra, naxee dɛgɛma tunki raxunmasee labe ra, dɛnnaxɛ ilanma bɛlɛti ra.

sentences.english: And the rings on the bag were fixed to the rings of the ephod by a blue cord, keeping it in place over the band, so that the bag might not get loose, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: Donma kanke raxunmase naxa xiri donma kuye ma luuti gɛrɛ daaxi ra naxan nasoma xurundɛe kui naxee dɛgɛxi donma kanke raxunmase nun donma kuye ma, alɔ Alatala a yamari Munsa bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: The robe which went with the ephod was made all of blue;
sentences.susu: E naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa donma kuye bun magoroe sɔxɔ gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi ra.

sentences.english: With a hole at the top in the middle, like the hole in the coat of a fighting-man, edged with a band to make it strong.
sentences.susu: E naxa a xunyi rasode xaba a tagi, e na sode dɛ masɔxɔ, alako bɔɔde yo naxa lu a ma.

sentences.english: The skirts of the robe were worked all round with fruits in blue and purple and red made of twisted linen.
sentences.susu: E naxa a raxunma pirinti gɛrɛ daaxi, bulu daaxi, nun a gbeeli ra naxee misaalixi wuri bogi ra a rabilinyi birin ma.

sentences.english: And between the fruits all round the skirt they put gold bells, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: E naxa tɔlɔnyi xɛɛma daaxie dɛgɛ na pirintie tagi, alako tɔlɔnyi nde xa lu wuri bogi birin tagi na donma kuye bun magoroe sanbunyi birin ma.

sentences.english: All round the skirt of the robe were bells and fruits in turn.
sentences.susu: Tɔlɔnyi nde lu wuri bogi birin tagi na donma kuye bun magoroe sanbunyi birin ma, alako sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa wali raba alɔ Alatala a yamari Munsa bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: The coats for Aaron and his sons they made of the best linen;
sentences.susu: E naxa donma kuye bun magoroe gbɛtɛ dɛgɛ suwa dugi ra, naxan sɔxɔxi a fanyi ra, Haruna nun a xa di xɛmɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: And the twisted head-dress for Aaron, and beautiful head-dresses of linen, and linen trousers,
sentences.susu: Xunmasee naxa yailan suwa dugi ra. E naxa wantan bun soe fan dɛgɛ suwa dugi ra.

sentences.english: And a linen band worked with a design of blue and purple and red, as the Lord had said to Moses.
sentences.susu: E naxa bɛlɛti yailan suwa dugi ra, naxan masɔxɔxi a gɛrɛ daaxi, a bulu daaxi, nun a gbeeli ra, alɔ Alatala a yamari Munsa bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: The plate for the holy crown was made of the best gold, and on it were cut these words, HOLY TO THE LORD.
sentences.susu: E naxa walaxɛ lanmadi yailan xɛɛma ra, a findi tɔnxuma sɛniyɛnxi ra. E naxa sɛbɛli masoli a ma, alɔ e sɛbɛli masolima xurundɛ ma ki naxɛ, a masenfe ra, «Mixi sɛniyɛnxi Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: It was fixed to the head-dress by a blue cord, as the Lord had given orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: E naxa a xiri gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi nun gɛsɛ bulu daaxi ra xunmase ma a tigi ra, alɔ Alatala Munsa yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So all the work on the House of the Tent of meeting was done; as the Lord had given orders to Moses, so the children of Israel did it.
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔlingira xa wali raɲɔn na ki nɛ, Ala mixi lima dɛnnaxɛ. Isirayilakae a birin naba nɛ alɔ Alatala Munsa yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then they took the House to Moses, the tent with all the things for it; its hooks, its boards, its rods, its pillars, and its bases;
sentences.susu: E naxa hɔrɔmɔlingira xanin Munsa xɔn ma nun a se birin: tɛtɛ nun a see, suxusee, xebenyie, wuri kuyee mɔɔli firin, wuri sanbunyie,

sentences.english: The outer cover of sheepskins coloured red, and the cover of leather, and the veil for the doorway;
sentences.susu: hɔrɔmɔlingira makotosee, naxan yailanxi yɛxɛɛ kontonyi kiri gbeeli ra, a nun naxan yailanxi peremui kiri ra, dugi naxan gbakuxi yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante sode dɛ ra,

sentences.english: The ark of the law, with its rods and its cover;
sentences.susu: saatɛ kankira nun a xa wuri kuyee, seede kankira dɛrakote,

sentences.english: The table, with all its vessels and the holy bread;
sentences.susu: teebili, teebili xa yirabase birin, taami naxan sama teebili fari sɛrɛxɛ ra,

sentences.english: The support for the lights, with the vessels for the lights to be put in their places on it, and all its vessels, and the oil for the lights;
sentences.susu: lanpui dɔxɔse xɛɛma daaxi, lanpuie nun e yirabase birin, lanpui ture,

sentences.english: And the gold altar, and the holy oil, and the sweet perfume for burning, and the curtain for the doorway of the tent;
sentences.susu: Surayi sɛrɛxɛbade xɛɛma daaxi, ture sɛniyɛnxi, surayi, dugi naxan gbakuxi tɛtɛ sode dɛ ra,

sentences.english: And the brass altar, with its network of brass, and its rods and all its vessels, and the washing-vessel and its base;
sentences.susu: sɛrɛxɛbade wure gbeeli daaxi, a xa wuri kuyee, wuree sube sama naxee fari, a xa yirabase birin, ye sase xungbe nun a dɔxɔse,

sentences.english: The hangings for the open space, with the pillars and their bases, and the curtain for the doorway, and the cords and nails, and all the instruments necessary for the work of the House of the Tent of meeting;
sentences.susu: tɛtɛ dugie, wurie dugie gbakuma naxee ma nee sanbunyie, dugi naxan gbakuxi hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra, luutie, wurie luutie xirima naxee ra, a nun hɔrɔmɔlingira xa yirabase birin, Ala maxandi yire,

sentences.english: The robes for use in the holy place, and the holy robes for Aaron and his sons when acting as priests.
sentences.susu: sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa sose naxee rawalima yire sɛniyɛnxi kui, Haruna nun a xa die xa sose sɛniyɛnxie naxee rawalima e xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali kui.

sentences.english: The children of Israel did everything as the Lord had given orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa na wali birin naba, alɔ Alatala a yamari Munsa bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then Moses, when he saw all their work and saw that they had done everything as the Lord had said, gave them his blessing.
sentences.susu: Munsa to na wali birin to a rabaxi alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ, a naxa duba Isirayilakae bɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: On the first day of the first month you are to put up the House of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: «Kike singe xi singe, i xa hɔrɔmɔlingira ti, Ala wo lima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And inside it put the ark of the law, hanging the veil before it.
sentences.susu: I xa saatɛ kankira dɔxɔ na kui dugi xanbi ra.

sentences.english: And put the table inside, placing all the things on it in order; and put in the support for the lights, and let its lights be burning.
sentences.susu: I xa teebili yailan mɛnni, i fa see dɔxɔ a ma a raba ki ma. I xa lanpui dɔxɔse ti naa, i fa lanpuie dɔxɔ a fari.

sentences.english: And put the gold altar for burning perfumes in front of the ark of the law, hanging the curtain over the doorway of the House.
sentences.susu: I xa surayi sɛrɛxɛbade xɛɛma daaxi dɔxɔ saatɛ kankira ya ra, i fa dugi gbaku hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra Ala maxandi yire.

sentences.english: And put the altar of burned offerings before the doorway of the House of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: I xa sɛrɛxɛbade dɔxɔ hɔrɔmɔlingira sode ya ra, Ala wo lima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And let the washing-vessel, with water in it, be put between the Tent of meeting and the altar.
sentences.susu: I xa ye sase xungbe dɔxɔ hɔrɔmɔlingira nun sɛrɛxɛbade tagi, i fa ye sa a kui.

sentences.english: And put up the hangings forming the open space all round it, with the curtain over its doorway.
sentences.susu: I xa hɔrɔmɔlingira tɛtɛ ti, i fa dugi gbaku tɛtɛ sode dɛ ra.»

sentences.english: And take the holy oil and put it on the House and everything in it, and make it and everything in it holy:
sentences.susu: «I na gɛ na ra, i xa ture sɛniyɛnxi tongo, i fa a sa hɔrɔmɔlingira nun a kui se birin ma, e xa sɛniyɛn Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And put oil on the altar of burned offering, and make it and all its vessels holy; this altar is to be most holy.
sentences.susu: I man xa na raba sɛrɛxɛbade nun a yirabase birin ma. E xa sɛniyɛn Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And put oil on the washing-vessel and its base, and make them holy.
sentences.susu: I man xa na raba ye sase xungbe nun a dɔxɔse ma, e xa sɛniyɛn Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then let Aaron and his sons come to the door of the Tent of meeting; and after washing them with water,
sentences.susu: «I xa Haruna nun a xa die malan hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra, i fa e maxa ye ra.

sentences.english: You are to put on Aaron the holy robes; and you are to put oil on him, and make him holy, so that he may be my priest.
sentences.susu: I xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ sose sɛniyɛnxie ragoro Haruna ma, i fa ture sɛniyɛnxi sa a ma alako a xa findi n ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra.

sentences.english: And take his sons with him and put coats on them;
sentences.susu: I xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ sose sɛniyɛnxie ragoro a xa die fan ma,

sentences.english: And put oil on them as you did on their father, so that they may be my priests: the putting on of oil will make them priests for ever, from generation to generation.
sentences.susu: i fa ture sɛniyɛnxi sa e ma alɔ i naxan nabaxi e baba ra, alako e fan xa findi n ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra. Na wali luma e yi ra, a nun naxee fama e xanbi ra abadan.»

sentences.english: And Moses did this; as the Lord gave him orders, so he did.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Munsa naxa Alatala xa yaamari birin naba alɔ a fala a bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So on the first day of the first month in the second year the House was put up.
sentences.susu: Kelife e mini Misira bɔxi kui tɛmui naxɛ, ɲɛ firin nde, kike singe, tɛngɛ singe lɔxɔɛ, a naxa hɔrɔmɔlingira ti.

sentences.english: Moses put up the House; placing its bases in position and lifting up its uprights, putting in the rods and planting the pillars in their places;
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa hɔrɔmɔlingira sanbunyie sa, a a wuri birin ti,

sentences.english: Stretching the outer tent over it, and covering it, as the Lord had given him orders.
sentences.susu: a fa dugie itala hɔrɔmɔlingira xun ma, a nun a makotosee alɔ Alatala a yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And he took the law and put it inside the ark, and put the rods at its side and the cover over it;
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa saatɛ walaxɛ firinyie sa saatɛ kankira kui, a fa kankira wurie raso kankira suxuse digilinxie kui, a kankira dɛrakote sa a dɛ ra naxan findixi xunsare yire ra.

sentences.english: And he took the ark into the House, hanging up the veil before it as the Lord had given him orders.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ na rabade, a naxa saatɛ kankira xanin hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, a a dɔxɔ yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante kui. A naxa dugi gbaku na ya ra, alako mixi yo naxa a to alɔ Alatala a yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And he put the table in the Tent of meeting, on the north side outside the veil.
sentences.susu: A naxa hɔrɔmɔlingira teebili dɔxɔ dugi ya ra a kɔɔla mabiri,

sentences.english: And he put the bread on it in order before the Lord, as the Lord had said.
sentences.susu: a fa taamie sa a fari a safɛ ki ma Alatala ya xɔri alɔ Alatala a yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: The support for the lights he put in the Tent of meeting, opposite the table, on the south side:
sentences.susu: A naxa lanpui dɔxɔse ti hɔrɔmɔlingira kui teebili ya ra a yirefanyi mabiri,

sentences.english: Lighting the lights before the Lord, as the Lord had given him orders.
sentences.susu: a fa lanpuie ti na fari Alatala ya xɔri alɔ Alatala a yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And he put the gold altar in the Tent of meeting, in front of the veil:
sentences.susu: A naxa surayi sɛrɛxɛbade dɔxɔ hɔrɔmɔlingira kui dugi gbakuxi a ya ra,

sentences.english: Burning sweet perfumes on it, as the Lord had given him orders.
sentences.susu: a fa surayi gan mɛnni alɔ Alatala a yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And he put up the curtain at the doorway of the House.
sentences.susu: A naxa dugi gbaku hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And at the door of the House of the Tent of meeting, he put the altar of burned offerings, offering on it the burned offering and the meal offering, as the Lord had given him orders.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛbade dɔxɔ hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra. A naxa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ba mɛnni nun hadiya alɔ Alatala a yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And between the altar and the Tent of meeting he put the vessel with water in it for washing.
sentences.susu: A naxa ye sase xungbe dɔxɔ hɔrɔmɔlingira nun sɛrɛxɛbade tagi, a ye sa a kui marasɛniyɛnyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: In it the hands and feet of Moses and Aaron and his sons were washed,
sentences.susu: Munsa, Haruna, nun Haruna xa die nu luma e bɛlɛxɛe nun e sanyie maxa ra naa,

sentences.english: Whenever they went into the Tent of meeting, and when they came near the altar, as the Lord had given orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: e soma hɔrɔmɔlingira kui tɛmui naxɛ, a nun e sɛrɛxɛ bama tɛmui naxɛ alɔ Alatala Munsa yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And he put up the hangings forming the open space round the House and the altar, and put the curtain over the doorway. So Moses made the work complete.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa tɛtɛ rabilin hɔrɔmɔlingira nun sɛrɛxɛbade ra, a fa dugi gbaku tɛtɛ sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then the cloud came down covering the Tent of meeting, and the House was full of the glory of the Lord;
sentences.susu: Munsa to gɛ na birin na, nuxui naxa din hɔrɔmɔlingira xun ma, Ala e lima dɛnnaxɛ. Alatala xa nɔrɛ naxa hɔrɔmɔlingira rafe,

sentences.english: So that Moses was not able to go into the Tent of meeting, because the cloud was resting on it, and the House was full of the glory of the Lord.
sentences.susu: han na naxa a niya Munsa mu nu nɔma sode na kui. Alatala xa nɔrɛ nu bara na rafe, nuxui fan nu radinxi na birin xun ma.

sentences.english: And whenever the cloud was taken up from the House, the children of Israel went forward on their journey:
sentences.susu: Kelife na tɛmui e xa biyaasie kui, Isirayilakae mu ɲɛrɛ fɔlɔma fo nuxui na keli hɔrɔmɔlingira xun ma.

sentences.english: But while the cloud was there, they made no move till it was taken up.
sentences.susu: Xa nuxui mu te hɔrɔmɔlingira xun ma, Isirayilakae mu ɲɛrɛ raminima sigafe yire gbɛtɛ.

sentences.english: For the cloud of the Lord was resting on the House by day, and at night there was fire in the cloud, before the eyes of all the people of Israel, and so it was through all their journeys.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa nuxui nu luma hɔrɔmɔlingira xun ma yanyi nun kɔɛ ra. Isirayilakae nu tɛ dɛxɛxi toma nuxui kui kɔɛ ra. A lu na ki nɛ e xa biyaasi birin kui.

sentences.english: And the voice of the Lord came to Moses out of the Tent of meeting, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Annabi Munsa xili a xa hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, a a masen a bɛ,

sentences.english: Give these orders to the children of Israel: When anyone of you makes an offering to the Lord, you are to take it from the cattle, from the herd or from the flock.
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, naxan na wa sɛrɛxɛ bafe n tan Alatala bɛ, a xa xuruse lanma xa na mu a ra xuruse xungbe ba.

sentences.english: If the offering is a burned offering of the herd, let him give a male without a mark: he is to give it at the door of the Tent of meeting so that he may be pleasing to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Xa a wama xuruse xungbe nan bafe sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, fo a xa findi tuura ra lanyuru mu na naxan ma. A xa fa na ra n tan Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra, alako n xa a tongo.

sentences.english: And he is to put his hand on the head of the burned offering and it will be taken for him, to take away his sin.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛba xa a bɛlɛxɛ sa xuruse xun tagi, alako n tan Alatala xa na sɛrɛxɛ tongo, a xa findi a xunsare ra a xa yunubi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And the ox is to be put to death before the Lord: then Aaron's sons, the priests, are to take the blood and put some of it on and round the altar which is at the door of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: Na tuura xa faxa n tan Alatala ya i. Haruna xa di sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa fa na tuura wuli ra, e xa a kasan sɛrɛxɛbade sɛɛtie ma, sɛrɛxɛbade naxan na n ma hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the burned offering is to be skinned and cut up into its parts.
sentences.susu: E xa tuura bura, e fa a isɛgɛ.

sentences.english: And Aaron's sons, the priests, are to put fire on the altar and put the wood in order on the fire:
sentences.susu: Haruna xa di sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa yege radɔxɔ, e tɛ radɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And Aaron's sons, the priests, are to put the parts, the head and the fat, in order on the wood which is on the fire on the altar:
sentences.susu: E man xa sɛrɛxɛ sube, a xunyi, nun a ture sa tɛ i sɛrɛxɛbade.

sentences.english: But its inside parts and its legs are to be washed with water, and it will all be burned on the altar by the priest for a burned offering, an offering made by fire, for a sweet smell to the Lord.
sentences.susu: A furingɛ nun a sanyie xa raxa. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa na birin gan sɛrɛxɛbade. Sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi na a ra naxan xiri rafan n tan Alatala ma.»

sentences.english: And if his offering is of the flock, a burned offering of sheep or goats, let him give a male without a mark.
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi wama sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi bafe xuruse lanma ra, a xa findi yɛxɛɛ kontonyi ra, xa na mu a ra sikɔtɛ, lanyuru mu na naxan ma.

sentences.english: And he is to put it to death on the north side of the altar before the Lord: and Aaron's sons, the priests, are to put some of the blood on and round the altar.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛba xa na kɔn naxaba sɛrɛxɛbade kɔɔla mabiri n tan Alatala ya i. Haruna xa di sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa a wuli tongo, e xa a kasan sɛrɛxɛbade sɛɛtie ma.

sentences.english: And the offering is to be cut into its parts, with its head and its fat; and the priest is to put them in order on the wood which is on the fire on the altar:
sentences.susu: E na gɛ sube ixabade, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa a sube, a xunyi, nun a ture sa tɛ sɛrɛxɛbade fari.

sentences.english: But the inside parts and the legs are to be washed with water; and the priest will make an offering of all of it, burning it on the altar: it is a burned offering, an offering made by fire, for a sweet smell to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛba xa sɛrɛxɛ furingɛ nun a sanyie raxa. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa na birin gan sɛrɛxɛbade. Sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi na a ra naxan xiri rafan n tan Alatala ma.»

sentences.english: And if his offering to the Lord is a burned offering of birds, then he is to make his offering of doves or of young pigeons.
sentences.susu: «Xa a wama xɔni bafe sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra n tan Alatala bɛ, fo a xa findi kolokonde nan na, xa na mu a ra ganbɛ yɔrɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the priest is to take it to the altar, and after its head has been twisted off, it is to be burned on the altar, and its blood drained out on the side of the altar:
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa fa a ra sɛrɛxɛbade, a a xunyi bolon a dɛ i, a a sa tɛ, a a gan. A wuli xa ifili sɛrɛxɛbade sɛɛtie ma.

sentences.english: And he is to take away its stomach, with its feathers, and put it down by the east side of the altar, where the burned waste is put:
sentences.susu: A xa a gɛmɛ bɔɔtɔ ba, a a wɔlɛ tɛ i xube xun, sɛrɛxɛbade sogetede mabiri ra.

sentences.english: And let it be broken open at the wings, but not cut in two; and let it be burned on the altar by the priest on the wood which is on the fire; it is a burned offering; an offering made by fire for a sweet smell to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa a suxu a gabutenyie ma, a a ibɔɔ. A xa a gan, a findi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, naxan xiri rafan n tan Alatala ma.»

sentences.english: And when anyone makes a meal offering to the Lord, let his offering be of the best meal, with oil on it and perfume:
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi wama sɛrɛxɛ bafe n tan Alatala bɛ naxan findixi sansi xɔri ra, a xa a luxuta a fanyi ra. A xa ture sa a fari, a surayi fan sa ture fari.

sentences.english: And let him take it to Aaron's sons, the priests; and having taken in his hand some of the meal and of the oil, with all the perfume, let him give it to the priest to be burned on the altar, as a sign, an offering made by fire, for a sweet smell to the Lord.
sentences.susu: A xa na so Haruna xa di sɛrɛxɛdubɛe yi ra. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nde xa sansi xɔri luxutaxi bɛlɛxɛ ya keren kɔ, ture saxi naxan fari, a nun surayi, a xa a sa tɛ i. Na xa gan n tan Alatala bɛ, a xa findi tɔnxuma ra na sɛrɛxɛ birin xa fe ra. Sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi na a ra naxan xiri rafan n tan Alatala ma.

sentences.english: And the rest of the meal offering will be for Aaron and his sons; it is most holy among the Lord's fire offerings.
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri luxutaxi naxan luxi naa findima Haruna nun a xa die nan gbe ra. A sɛniyɛn barima a baxi sɛrɛxɛ ganxi nan na naxan baxi n tan Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: And when you give a meal offering cooked in the oven, let it be of unleavened cakes of the best meal mixed with oil, or thin unleavened cakes covered with oil.
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi wama sɛrɛxɛ bafe n tan Alatala bɛ naxan findixi taami ganxi ra, a xa na yailan sansi xɔri luxutaxi ra lɛbini mu na naxan xun. Ture xa masunbu na fan na. Taami lɛbinitare xunxurie fan nɔma yailande, ture masoxi naxee ma.»

sentences.english: And if you give a meal offering cooked on a flat plate, let it be of the best meal, unleavened and mixed with oil.
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi wama sɛrɛxɛ bafe naxan findixi taami gilinxi ra, a xa na yailan sansi xɔri luxutaxi ra lɛbini mu na naxan xun. Ture xa masunbu na fan na.

sentences.english: Let it be broken into bits, and put oil on it; it is a meal offering.
sentences.susu: A na gɛ gilinde, a xa igira, ture sa a ma, a xa findi sɛrɛxɛ ra.»

sentences.english: And if your offering is of meal cooked in fat over the fire, let it be made of the best meal mixed with oil.
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi wama sɛrɛxɛ bafe naxan findixi taami ra naxan ganxi tunde kui, a xa na yailan sansi xɔri luxutaxi nun ture ra.

sentences.english: And you are to give the meal offering made of these things to the Lord, and let the priest take it to the altar.
sentences.susu: A lanma mixi xa fa na sɛrɛxɛ mɔɔli ra n tan Alatala bɛ. Xa na bara so sɛrɛxɛdubɛ yi ra, a na xaninma sɛrɛxɛbade.

sentences.english: And he is to take from the meal offering a part, for a sign, burning it on the altar; an offering made by fire for a sweet smell to the Lord.
sentences.susu: A xa nde tongo naxan findima tɔnxuma ra, a xa na gan sɛrɛxɛbade fari, a xa findi sɛrɛxɛ ra, naxan xiri rafan n tan Alatala ma.

sentences.english: And the rest of the meal offering will be for Aaron and his sons; it is most holy among the Lord's fire offerings.
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri dinxi naxan luxi a findima Haruna nun a xa die nan gbe ra. A sɛniyɛn barima a baxi sɛrɛxɛ ganxi nan na naxan baxi n tan Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: No meal offering which you give to the Lord is to be made with leaven; no leaven or honey is to be burned as an offering made by fire to the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Sɛrɛxɛ naxan birin bama n tan Alatala bɛ, lɛbini yo naxa lu a xun. A mu lan wo xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi yo ba n tan Alatala bɛ lɛbini na naxan xun, xa na mu a ra kumi.

sentences.english: You may give them as an offering of first-fruits to the Lord, but they are not to go up as a sweet smell on the altar.
sentences.susu: Wo nɔma lɛbini nun kumi sade sansi bogi singee xun ma naxee bama sɛrɛxɛ ra n tan Alatala bɛ, kɔnɔ e naxa gan sɛrɛxɛbade fari.

sentences.english: And every meal offering is to be salted with salt; your meal offering is not to be without the salt of the agreement of your God: with all your offerings give salt.
sentences.susu: Fɔxɔɛ xa sa na sɛrɛxɛ mɔɔli birin ma, barima na bara findi saatɛ tɔnxuma ra wo tan nun wo Marigi Ala tagi. Fɔxɔɛ xa sa wo xa sɛrɛxɛ birin ma.»

sentences.english: And if you give a meal offering of first-fruits to the Lord, give, as your offering of first-fruits, new grain, made dry with fire, crushed new grain.
sentences.susu: «Xa wo wama sɛrɛxɛ bafe n tan Alatala bɛ wo xa sansi bogi singe ra, wo xa tɔnsɔɛ nɛɛnɛ gan,

sentences.english: And put oil on it and perfume: it is a meal offering.
sentences.susu: wo ture nun surayi sa a xun, a xa findi sansi bogi singe sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: And part of the meal of the offering and part of the oil and all the perfume is to be burned for a sign by the priest: it is an offering made by fire to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa nde tongo na sansi xɔri, ture, nun surayi ra, na xa findi tɔnxuma ra. A xa na gan sɛrɛxɛbade fari. A xa findi sɛrɛxɛ ra, naxan xiri rafan n tan Alatala ma.»

sentences.english: And if his offering is given for a peace-offering; if he gives of the herd, male or female, let him give it without any mark on it, before the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi wama xuruse xungbe bafe xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ra n tan Alatala bɛ, xuruse xɛmɛma, xa na mu a ra ginɛma, a xa findi xuruse ra lanyuru yo mu na naxan ma.

sentences.english: And he is to put his hand on the head of his offering and put it to death at the door of the Tent of meeting; and Aaron's sons, the priests, are to put some of the blood on and round the altar.
sentences.susu: A xa a bɛlɛxɛ sa na xuruse xun tagi n tan Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra, a a kɔn naxaba. Haruna xa di sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa na xuruse wuli kasan sɛrɛxɛbade sɛɛtie ma.

sentences.english: And he is to give of the peace-offering, as an offering made by fire to the Lord; the fat covering the inside parts and all the fat on the inside parts,
sentences.susu: Xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ kui, a lanma ture naxan na furingɛ sɛɛti ma, a xa gan tɛ i n tan Alatala ya i,

sentences.english: And the two kidneys, and the fat on them, which is by the top part of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, he is to take away;
sentences.susu: a nun a gungui firinyi, e ture, nun laare naxan na a bɔɲɛ ma.

sentences.english: That it may be burned by Aaron's sons on the altar, on the burned offering which is on the wood on the fire: it is an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Haruna xa die xa na birin gan sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi xun ma, naxan na ganfe sɛrɛxɛbade fari. A xa findi se xiri ɲɔxunmɛ ra n tan Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: And if what he gives for a peace-offering to the Lord is of the flock, let him give a male or female, without any mark on it.
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi wama xuruse lanma bafe xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ra n tan Alatala bɛ, xuruse xɛmɛma, xa na mu a ra ginɛma, a xa findi xuruse ra lanyuru yo mu na naxan ma.

sentences.english: If his offering is a lamb, then let it be placed before the Lord:
sentences.susu: Xa mixi wama yɛxɛɛ bafe sɛrɛxɛ ra, a xa na masen n tan Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And he is to put his hand on the head of his offering and put it to death before the Tent of meeting; and Aaron's sons are to put some of its blood on and round the altar.
sentences.susu: A xa a bɛlɛxɛ sa a xun tagi, a fa a kɔn naxaba n tan Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra. Haruna xa di sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa na xuruse wuli kasan sɛrɛxɛbade sɛɛtie ma.

sentences.english: And of the peace-offering, let him give an offering made by fire to the Lord; the fat of it, all the fat tail, he is to take away near the backbone; and the fat covering the inside parts and all the fat on the inside parts,
sentences.susu: Yi xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ kui, a lanma a ture, a xuli, ture naxan na furingɛ sɛɛti ma,

sentences.english: And the two kidneys, with the fat on them, which is by the top part of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, he is to take away;
sentences.susu: a gungui firinyi, e ture, nun laare naxan na a bɔɲɛ ma, na birin xa gan tɛ i n tan Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: That it may be burned by the priest on the altar; it is the food of the offering made by fire to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa na gan sɛrɛxɛbade fari. Tɛ xa na birin gan. Na bara findi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra n tan Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: And if his offering is a goat, then let it be placed before the Lord,
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi wama si bafe sɛrɛxɛ ra, a xa na masen n tan Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And let him put his hand on the head of it and put it to death before the Tent of meeting; and the sons of Aaron are to put some of its blood on and round the altar.
sentences.susu: A xa a bɛlɛxɛ sa a xun tagi, a fa a kɔn naxaba n tan Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra, Haruna xa di sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa na xuruse wuli kasan sɛrɛxɛbade sɛɛtie ma.

sentences.english: And of it let him make his offering, an offering made by fire to the Lord; the fat covering the inside parts and all the fat on the inside parts,
sentences.susu: Yi xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ kui, a lanma a ture naxan na furingɛ sɛɛti ma,

sentences.english: And the two kidneys, with the fat on them, which is by the top part of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, let him take away;
sentences.susu: a gungui firinyi, e ture, nun laare naxan na a bɔɲɛ ma, na birin xa gan tɛ i n tan Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: That it may be burned by the priest on the altar; it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet smell: all the fat is the Lord's.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa na gan sɛrɛxɛbade fari. Tɛ xa na birin gan. Na bara findi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra n tan Alatala bɛ naxan xiri rafan n ma.»

sentences.english: Let it be an order for ever, through all your generations, in all your houses, that you are not to take fat or blood for food.
sentences.susu: «Mixi yo naxa sube ture don, mixi yo naxa sube wuli min. Wo sabati dɛdɛ, na bara findi yaamari ra naxan mu kanama abadan.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel: These are the offerings of anyone who does wrong through error, doing any of the things which by the Lord's order are not to be done:
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, xa mixi nde sa yunubi raba, kɔnɔ a mu keli a ɲanige ma, a xa bira yi sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: If the chief priest by doing wrong becomes a cause of sin to the people, then let him give to the Lord for the sin which he has done, an ox, without any mark, for a sin-offering.
sentences.susu: Xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi sa Ala xa yaamari nde matandi, na fa findi yunubi ra ɲama bɛ, a lanma a xa tuura ba sɛrɛxɛ ra n tan Alatala bɛ, lanyuru mu na naxan ma, alako na xa findi yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra a bɛ.

sentences.english: And he is to take the ox to the door of the Tent of meeting before the Lord; and put his hand on its head and put it to death before the Lord.
sentences.susu: A xa tuura xanin n tan Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra n ya i, a a bɛlɛxɛ sa a xun tagi, a fa a kɔn naxaba n tan Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: And the chief priest is to take some of its blood and take it to the Tent of meeting;
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xa na tuura wuli xanin n ma hɔrɔmɔlingira kui,

sentences.english: And the priest is to put his finger in the blood, shaking drops of it before the Lord seven times, in front of the veil of the holy place.
sentences.susu: a a bɛlɛxɛsole ragoro na wuli xɔɔra, a a kasan sanya solofere dugi ya ra naxan gbakuxi yire sɛniyɛnxi ma n tan Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: And the priest is to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar on which perfume is burned before the Lord in the Tent of meeting, draining out all the rest of the blood of the ox at the base of the altar of burned offering which is at the door of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa wuli nde sa ferie ma naxee na surayi sɛrɛxɛbade tunxunyi naani ra, naxan na n tan Alatala ya i n ma hɔrɔmɔlingira kui. Wuli naxan luxi, a xa na ifili sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi sɛrɛxɛbade lanbanyi ma, naxan na n tan Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And he is to take away all the fat of the ox of the sin-offering; the fat covering the inside parts and all the fat of the inside parts,
sentences.susu: A xa ture birin ba tuura ma naxan findixi yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, ture naxan na a furingɛ sɛɛti ma,

sentences.english: And the two kidneys, with the fat on them, which is by the top part of the legs, and the fat joining the liver and the kidneys, he is to take away,
sentences.susu: a gungui firinyi, e ture, nun laare naxan na a bɔɲɛ ma.

sentences.english: As it is taken from the ox of the peace-offering; and it is to be burned by the priest on the altar of burned offerings.
sentences.susu: A xa na raba alɔ xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ rabama ki naxɛ. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa na gan sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi sɛrɛxɛbade fari.

sentences.english: And the skin of the ox and all its flesh, with its head and its legs and its inside parts and its waste,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ tuura kiri, a sube, a xunyi, a sanyie, a furingɛ, nun a ɲaɲɛ,

sentences.english: All the ox, he is to take away outside the circle of the tents into a clean place where the burned waste is put, and there it is to be burned on wood with fire.
sentences.susu: na tuura dɔnxɔɛ birin xa xanin ɲama yonkinde fari ma, yire sɛniyɛnxi, tɛ xube wɔlɛma dɛnnaxɛ. Mɛnni a xa gan tɛ ra na tɛ xube fari.»

sentences.english: And if all the people of Israel do wrong, without anyone's knowledge; if they have done any of the things which by the Lord's order are not to be done, causing sin to come on them;
sentences.susu: «Xa Isirayila ɲama birin nan sa n tan Ala xa yaamari nde matandixi, kɔnɔ na mu keli e ɲanige ma, na findima yunubi ra e bɛ.

sentences.english: When the sin which they have done comes to light, then let all the people give an ox for a sin-offering, and take it before the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: E na fahaamui sɔtɔ na ma tɛmui naxɛ, ɲama xa tuura yɔrɛ ba sɛrɛxɛ ra n tan Alatala bɛ hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra naxan findima yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra e bɛ.

sentences.english: And let the chiefs of the people put their hands on its head before the Lord, and put the ox to death before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ɲama forie xa e bɛlɛxɛ sa tuura xun tagi n tan Alatala ya i, e a kɔn naxaba.

sentences.english: And the priest is to take some of its blood to the Tent of meeting;
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xa na tuura wuli xanin n tan Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira kui,

sentences.english: And put his finger in the blood, shaking drops of the blood seven times before the Lord in front of the veil.
sentences.susu: a a bɛlɛxɛsole ragoro na wuli xɔɔra, a a kasan sanya solofere dugi ya ra naxan gbakuxi yire sɛniyɛnxi ma n tan Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: And he is to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before the Lord in the Tent of meeting; and all the rest of the blood is to be drained out at the base of the altar of burned offering at the door of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa wuli nde sa ferie ma naxee nu na sɛrɛxɛbade tunxunyi naani ra, naxan na n tan Alatala ya i n ma hɔrɔmɔlingira kui. Wuli naxan luxi, a xa na ifili sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi sɛrɛxɛbade lanbanyi ma, naxan na n ma hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And he is to take off all its fat, burning it on the altar.
sentences.susu: A xa ture birin ba tuura ma, a na gan sɛrɛxɛbade fari.

sentences.english: Let him do with the ox as he did with the ox of the sin-offering; and the priest will take away their sin and they will have forgiveness.
sentences.susu: A xa yi tuura ba sɛrɛxɛ ra alɔ naxan bama yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra. E ba ki birin keren. Na kui, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ sɛrɛxɛ bama naxan findima e xunsare ra, alako e xa yunubie xa xafari.

sentences.english: Then let the ox be taken away outside the tent-circle, that it may be burned as the other ox was burned; it is the sin-offering for all the people.
sentences.susu: A xa na tuura xanin ɲama yonkinde fari ma, a xa a gan alɔ boore tuura ganma ki naxɛ. Na findima yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ nan na ɲama bɛ.»

sentences.english: If a ruler does wrong, and in error does any of the things which, by the order of the Lord his God, are not to be done, causing sin to come on him;
sentences.susu: «Xa mangɛ nde a Marigi Alatala xa yaamari nde matandi, kɔnɔ na mu keli a ɲanige ma, na findima yunubi ra a bɛ.

sentences.english: When the sin which he has done is made clear to him, let him give for his offering a goat, a male without any mark.
sentences.susu: A na fahaamui sɔtɔ na ma tɛmui naxɛ, a xa sikɔtɛ ba sɛrɛxɛ ra, lanyuru mu na naxan ma.

sentences.english: And he is to put his hand on the head of the goat and put it to death in the place where they put to death the burned offering before the Lord: it is a sin-offering.
sentences.susu: A xa a bɛlɛxɛ sa sikɔtɛ xun tagi ma n tan Alatala ya i, a a kɔn naxaba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie kɔn naxabama dɛnnaxɛ. Yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ na a ra.

sentences.english: And the priest is to take some of the blood of the offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burned offering, draining out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar of burned offering.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa a bɛlɛxɛsole ragoro na wuli xɔɔra naxan baxi yunubi xa fe ra, a nde sa ferie ma naxee na sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi sɛrɛxɛbade tunxunyi naani ra. Wuli naxan luxi, a xa na ifili sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi sɛrɛxɛbade lanbanyi ma.

sentences.english: And all the fat of it is to be burned on the altar like the fat of the peace-offering; and the priest will take away his sin and he will have forgiveness.
sentences.susu: A xa na ture birin gan sɛrɛxɛbade fari, alɔ xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ rabama ki naxɛ. Na kui sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xunsare sɛrɛxɛ bama mangɛ bɛ, alako a xa yunubi xa xafari.»

sentences.english: And if any one of the common people does wrong in error, doing any of the things which the Lord has given orders are not to be done, causing sin to come on him;
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi nde sa a Marigi Alatala xa yaamari nde matandi, kɔnɔ na mu keli a ɲanige ma, na findima yunubi ra a bɛ.

sentences.english: When the sin which he has done is made clear to him, then he is to give for his offering a goat, a female without any mark, for the sin which he has done.
sentences.susu: A na fahaamui sɔtɔ na ma tɛmui naxɛ, a xa si ginɛ ba sɛrɛxɛ ra, lanyuru mu na naxan ma, a xa yunubi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And he is to put his hand on the head of the sin-offering and put it to death in the place where they put to death the burned offering.
sentences.susu: A xa a bɛlɛxɛ sa na yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ xun tagi, a a kɔn naxaba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie kɔn naxabama dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And the priest is to take some of the blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burned offering, and all the rest of its blood is to be drained out at the base of the altar.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa a bɛlɛxɛsole ragoro na wuli xɔɔra naxan baxi yunubi xa fe ra, a nde sa ferie ma naxee na sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi sɛrɛxɛbade tunxunyi naani ra. Wuli naxan luxi, a xa na ifili sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi sɛrɛxɛbade lanbanyi ma.

sentences.english: And let all its fat be taken away, as the fat is taken away from the peace-offerings, and let it be burned on the altar by the priest for a sweet smell to the Lord; and the priest will take away his sin and he will have forgiveness.
sentences.susu: A xa na ture birin ba si ma, alɔ xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ rabama ki naxɛ, a na gan sɛrɛxɛbade fari, a xa findi se xiri ɲɔxunmɛ ra n tan Alatala bɛ. Na kui sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xunsare sɛrɛxɛ bama na mixi bɛ, alako a xa yunubi xa xafari.»

sentences.english: And if he gives a lamb as his sin-offering, let it be a female without any mark;
sentences.susu: «Xa a yɛxɛɛ bama yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, fo a xa findi yɛxɛɛ ginɛma lanyuru mu na naxan ma.

sentences.english: And he is to put his hand on the head of the offering and put it to death for a sin-offering in the place where they put to death the burned offering.
sentences.susu: A xa a bɛlɛxɛ sa na yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ xun tagi, a a kɔn naxaba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie kɔn naxabama dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And the priest is to take some of the blood of the offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burned offering, and all the rest of the blood is to be drained out at the base of the altar;
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa a bɛlɛxɛsole ragoro na wuli xɔɔra naxan baxi yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, a nde sa ferie ma naxee na sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi sɛrɛxɛbade tunxunyi naani ra. Wuli naxan luxi, a xa na ifili sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi sɛrɛxɛbade lanbanyi ma.

sentences.english: And let him take away all its fat, as the fat is taken away from the lamb of the peace-offerings; and let it be burned by the priest on the altar among the offerings made by fire to the Lord: and the priest will take away his sin and he will have forgiveness.
sentences.susu: A xa na ture birin ba yɛxɛɛ ma, alɔ xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ rabama ki naxɛ, a xa na gan sɛrɛxɛe fari naxee ganma sɛrɛxɛbade fari. Na kui sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xunsare sɛrɛxɛ bama na mixi bɛ, alako a xa yunubi xa xafari.»

sentences.english: And if anyone does wrong by saying nothing when he is put under oath as a witness of something he has seen or had knowledge of, then he will be responsible:
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi nde sa a mɛ e seedee xilima kiiti nde ma, kɔnɔ a gundi seedeyaxi fe naxan ma a mu na fala ɲama bɛ, na yunubi luma a xun ma.

sentences.english: If anyone becomes unclean through touching unconsciously some unclean thing, such as the dead body of an unclean beast or of unclean cattle or of any unclean animal which goes flat on the earth, he will be responsible:
sentences.susu: Xa mixi din se sɛniyɛntare ra a mu a kolon, alɔ sube raharamuxi binbi, xa na mu a ra xuruse sɛniyɛntare binbi, xa na mu a ra bubuse sɛniyɛntare binbi, na mixi fan findima nɛ mixi sɛniyɛntare ra, a yunubi sɔtɔ na kui.

sentences.english: Or if he becomes unclean through touching unconsciously any unclean thing of man, whatever it may be, when it is made clear to him he will be responsible:
sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde sa din se sɛniyɛntare ra naxan kelixi adamadi fate ma, a fa li a mu a kolon na tɛmui, xa a sa a kolon tɛmui naxɛ, a findima sɛniyɛntare ra, a yunubi sɔtɔma na kui.

sentences.english: Or if anyone, without thought, takes an oath to do evil or to do good, whatever he says without thought, with an oath, having no knowledge of what he is doing; when it becomes clear to him, he will be responsible for any of these things.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde sa a kali fufafu, fe fanyi xa na mu a ra fe ɲaaxi ra, a fa nɛɛmu na ma, a na ratu na fe ma tɛmui naxɛ, a findima sɛniyɛntare ra, a yunubi sɔtɔ na kui.»

sentences.english: And whoever is responsible for any such sin, let him make a statement openly of his wrongdoing;
sentences.susu: «Naxan na yunubi mɔɔli rabama, a lanma a xa a ti na ra.

sentences.english: And take to the Lord the offering for the wrong which he has done, a female from the flock, a lamb or a goat, for a sin-offering, and the priest will take away his sin.
sentences.susu: A xa yɛxɛɛ ginɛ, xa na mu a ra si ginɛ ba yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ ra n tan Alatala bɛ. Na kui sɛrɛxɛdubɛ yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ bama a bɛ, alako a xa yunubi xa xafari.»

sentences.english: And if he has not money enough for a lamb, then let him give, for his offering to the Lord, two doves or two young pigeons; one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering.
sentences.susu: «Xa fɛɛrɛ mu na a yi ra na sɛrɛxɛ xa fe ra, a xa kolokonde firin xa na mu a ra ganbɛ firin ba sɛrɛxɛ ra n tan Alatala bɛ. Keren xa findi yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, boore xa findi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra.

sentences.english: And let him take them to the priest, who will first give the sin-offering, twisting off its head from its neck, but not cutting it in two;
sentences.susu: A xa e xanin sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xɔn, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ nan singe ba. A xa a kɔnyi gira, kɔnɔ a naxa a xunyi ba a dɛ i.

sentences.english: And he is to put drops of the blood of the offering on the side of the altar, and the rest of the blood is to be drained out at the base of the altar; it is a sin-offering.
sentences.susu: A a wuli nde kasanma sɛrɛxɛbade sɛɛti ma, wuli naxan luxi, a na ifilima sɛrɛxɛbade lanbanyi. Yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ na a ra.

sentences.english: And the second is for a burned offering, in agreement with the law; and the priest will take away his sin and he will have forgiveness.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa na xɔni firin nde ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra a raba ki ma. Na kui, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xunsare sɛrɛxɛ bama a bɛ a xa yunubi rabaxi xa fe ra, alako a xa xafari.»

sentences.english: But if he has not enough money for two doves or two young pigeons, then let him give, for the sin he has done, the tenth part of an ephah of the best meal, for a sin-offering; let him put no oil on it, and no perfume, for it is a sin-offering.
sentences.susu: «Xa fɛɛrɛ mu na a yi ra kolokonde firin, xa na mu a ra ganbɛ firin sɔtɔfe ra, a xa sansi xɔri dinxi konbo ya keren nun a tagi ba yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra. A naxa ture, xa na mu a ra surayi sa na fari de, barima yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ na a ra.

sentences.english: And let him come to the priest with it, and the priest will take some of it in his hand, to be burned on the altar as a sign, among the offerings of the Lord made by fire: it is a sin-offering.
sentences.susu: A xa na xanin sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xɔn ma, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ suxu keren ganma sɛrɛxɛbade fari tɔnxuma ra. A na rabama sɛrɛxɛe fari naxee ganma sɛrɛxɛbade fari, barima yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ na a ra.

sentences.english: And the priest will take away his sin and he will have forgiveness: and the rest of the offering will be the priest's, in the same way as the meal offering.
sentences.susu: Na kui sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xunsare sɛrɛxɛ bama a bɛ, alako a xa yunubi rabaxi xa xafari. Sansi xɔri dinxi naxan luxi a findima sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nan gbe ra.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: If anyone is untrue, sinning in error in connection with the holy things of the Lord, let him take his offering to the Lord, a male sheep from the flock, without any mark, of the value fixed by you in silver by shekels, by the scale of the holy place.
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi nde sa se nde tongo naxan findixi n tan Alatala gbe ra, kɔnɔ a mu a kolon a na yunubi mɔɔli rabaxi, a xa yɛxɛɛ kontonyi ba yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ ra n tan Alatala bɛ a xa yunubi xa fe ra. A mu lanma lanyuru yo xa lu na yɛxɛɛ ma, a sare fan xa lan sare ma naxan nawalima hɔrɔmɔlingira kui.

sentences.english: And he is to make payment to the priest for what he has done wrong in relation to the holy thing, together with a fifth part of its value in addition; and the priest will take away his sin by the sheep of his offering, and he will have forgiveness.
sentences.susu: A xa na se tongoxi ragbilen sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ma, a man xa kɔbiri sa na fari. Na findima kɔbiri naxan na, a na se sare nan itaxunma dɔxɔ suuli ra, a fa dɔxɔ keren ba a ra, a na so sɛrɛxɛdubɛ yi ra. Na kui sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xunsare sɛrɛxɛ bama a bɛ sikɔtɛ ra naxan findi yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ ra, alako a xa yunubi xa xafari.

sentences.english: And if anyone does wrong, and does any of the things which the Lord has given orders are not to be done, though he has no knowledge of it, still he is in the wrong and he is responsible.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan yunubi rabama, a n tan Alatala xa yaamari nde matandi, hali a mu a kolon, na bara yunubi sɔtɔ, fo a xa na sare fi.

sentences.english: Let him come to the priest with a sheep, a male without any mark out of the flock, of the value fixed by you, as an offering for his error; and the priest will take away the sin which he did in error, and he will have forgiveness.
sentences.susu: A lanma a xa sikɔtɛ ba yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ ra, lanyuru mu na naxan ma, naxan sare lanma sɛriyɛ ma. Na kui sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xunsare sɛrɛxɛ bama a bɛ a xa yunubi xa fe ra, a naxan nabaxi a mu a kolon, alako a xa yunubi xa xafari.

sentences.english: It is an offering for his error: he is certainly responsible before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na bara findi yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ ra, barima a yunubi sɔtɔ nɛ n tan Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: If anyone does wrong, and is untrue to the Lord, acting falsely to his neighbour in connection with something put in his care, or something given for a debt, or has taken away anything by force, or has been cruel to his neighbour,
sentences.susu: «Yi yaamari so Haruna nun a xa die yi ra: Sɛriyɛ nan ya sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi xa fe ra. Sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi xa lu sɛrɛxɛbade fari kɔɛ ra, a xa gan han gɛɛsɛgɛ.

sentences.english: Or has taken a false oath about the loss of something which he has come across by chance; if a man has done any of these evil things,
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa donma ragoro a ma, a xa wantanyi fiixɛ fanyi so a ra, a xa tɛ xube ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi bun ma, a a sa sɛrɛxɛbade sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Causing sin to come on him, then he will have to give back the thing he took by force or got by cruel acts, or the goods which were put in his care or the thing he came on by chance,
