sentences.english: And he is to put the male lamb to death in the place where they put to death the sin-offering and the burned offering, in the holy place; for as the sin-offering is the property of the priest, so is the offering for wrongdoing: it is most holy.
sentences.susu: A xa na yɛxɛɛ kɔn naxaba yire sɛniyɛnxi yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ nun sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi bama dɛnnaxɛ. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nan gbe yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ nun yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra. Sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxi nan e ra.

sentences.english: And let the priest take some of the blood of the offering for wrongdoing and put it on the point of the right ear of him who is to be made clean, and on the thumb of his right hand and on the great toe of his right foot;
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ wuli nde tongo, a xa a sa furema yirefanyi tuli ma, a bɛlɛxɛkura yirefanyi ma, nun a sankura yirefanyi ma.

sentences.english: And take some of the oil and put it in the hollow of his left hand;
sentences.susu: A man xa na ture sigaati ya keren ifili a yɛtɛ kɔɔla bɛlɛxɛ kui.

sentences.english: And let the priest put his right finger in the oil which is in his left hand, shaking it out with his finger seven times before the Lord;
sentences.susu: A xa a bɛlɛxɛsole yirefanyi sin ture kui, a nu bara naxan sa a kɔɔla bɛlɛxɛ kui, a xa na ture kasan dɔxɔ solofere n tan Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: And of the rest of the oil which is in his hand, the priest will put some on the point of the right ear of the man who is to be made clean, and on the thumb of his right hand and on the great toe of his right foot, over the blood of the offering for wrongdoing;
sentences.susu: Ture naxan luxi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ bɛlɛxɛ kui, a xa nde sa furema yirefanyi tuli ma, a nun a bɛlɛxɛkura yirefanyi ma, a nun a sankura yirefanyi ma yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ wuli fari.

sentences.english: And the rest of the oil in the priest's hand he will put on the head of him who is to be made clean; and so the priest will make him free from sin before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ture dɔnxɔɛ naxan luxi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ yi ra, a xa na sa furema xunyi ma. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa a xun sara n tan Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: And the priest will give the sin-offering, and take away the sin of him who is to be made clean from his unclean condition; and after that he will put the burned offering to death.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ba, a xa a xun sara a xa sɛniyɛntareɲa ma. Na dangi xanbi a xa na sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi kɔn naxaba.

sentences.english: And the priest is to have the burned offering and the meal offering burned on the altar; and the priest will take away his sin and he will be clean.
sentences.susu: A xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ ba sɛrɛxɛbade fari. A xa furema xun sara alako a xa sɛniyɛn.»

sentences.english: And if he is poor and not able to get so much, then he may take one male lamb as an offering for wrongdoing, to be waved to take away his sin, and one tenth part of an ephah of the best meal mixed with oil for a meal offering, and a log of oil;
sentences.susu: «Xa setare nan na furema ra, fɛɛrɛ mu na a yi na sɛrɛxɛ xa fe ra, a xa yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ keren gbansan ba yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ ra, naxan lintanma n tan Alatala ya i a xa findi furema xa xunsare ra. A xa sansi xɔri dinxi konbo ya tagi sɔtɔ, ture masunbuxi naxan na, a nun ture sigaati ya keren,

sentences.english: And two doves or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and one will be for a sin-offering and the other for a burned offering.
sentences.susu: nun ganbɛ firin, xa na mu a ra kolokonde yɔrɛ firin. Keren xa findi yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, boore sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi.

sentences.english: And on the eighth day he will take them to the priest, to the door of the Tent of meeting before the Lord, so that he may be made clean.
sentences.susu: Xi solomasaxan nde lɔxɔɛ, a xa fa na sɛrɛxɛe ra sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xɔn hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra n tan Alatala ya i, alako a xa sɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: And the priest will take the lamb of the offering for wrongdoing and the oil, waving them for a wave offering before the Lord;
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ yɛxɛɛ nun ture sigaati ya keren lintan n tan Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: And he will put to death the lamb of the offering for wrongdoing and the priest will take some of the blood of the offering for wrongdoing and put it on the point of the right ear of him who is to be made clean, and on the thumb of his right hand and on the great toe of his right foot;
sentences.susu: A xa na yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ kɔn naxaba yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ ra. A xa a wuli nde tongo, a xa na sa furema yirefanyi tuli ma, a yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛkura ma, a nun a yirefanyi sankura ma.

sentences.english: And the priest will put out some of the oil in the hollow of his left hand,
sentences.susu: A xa ture nde ifili a yɛtɛ kɔɔla bɛlɛxɛ kui.

sentences.english: Shaking out drops of oil with his right finger before the Lord seven times:
sentences.susu: A xa na ture kasan sanmaya solofere a bɛlɛxɛsole yirefanyi ra n tan Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: And the priest will put some of the oil which is in his hand on the point of the ear of the man who is to be made clean and on the thumb of his right hand and on the great toe of his right foot, on the place where the blood of the offering for wrongdoing was put;
sentences.susu: Ture naxan na a bɛlɛxɛ kui, a xa dondoronti tongo, a na sa furema yirefanyi tuli ma, a yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛkura ma, a nun a yirefanyi sankura ma wuli fari naxan keli yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ ma.

sentences.english: And the rest of the oil which is in the priest's hand he will put on the head of him who is to be made clean, to take away his sin before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ture naxan luxi a bɛlɛxɛ kui, a xa na sa na furema xunyi ma, alako a xun xa sara n tan Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: And he will make an offering of one of the doves or the young pigeons, such as he is able to get;
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa ganbɛ keren ba, xa na mu a ra kolokonde yɔrɛ, sɛrɛxɛe ya ma furema naxee sɔtɔxi.

sentences.english: And of these, he will give one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering, with the meal offering; and the priest will take away the sin of him who is to be made clean before the Lord.
sentences.susu: A xa keren ba yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, boore xa findi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, a nun sansi xɔri dinxi. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ furema xun sarama n tan Alatala ya i na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: This is the law for the man who has the disease of the leper on him, and who is not able to get that which is necessary for making himself clean.
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ nan na ki marasɛniyɛnyi xa fe ra furemae bɛ naxee findixi setaree ra.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa nun Haruna bɛ,

sentences.english: When you have come into the land of Canaan which I will give you for your heritage, if I put the leper's disease on a house in the land of your heritage,
sentences.susu: «Wo na so Kanaan bɔxi ma, n naxan fima wo ma kɛ ra, xa fure ɲaaxi sa mini wo xa banxi kankee ma mɛnni,

sentences.english: Then let the owner of the house come and say to the priest, It seems to me that there is a sort of leper's disease in the house.
sentences.susu: banxi kanyi xa sa a fala sɛrɛxɛdubɛ bɛ, ‹N bara fure ɲaaxi to n ma banxi ma.›

sentences.english: And the priest will give orders for everything to be taken out of the house, before he goes in to see the disease, so that the things in the house may not become unclean; and then the priest is to go in to see the house;
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa yaamari fi, e xa se birin namini banxi kui beenu a xa siga fure ɲaaxi matode, alako se naxan na banxi kui, na naxa findi se sɛniyɛntare ra. E na gɛ na rabade, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa siga na banxi matode.»

sentences.english: And if he sees that the walls of the house are marked with hollows of green and red, and if it seems to go deeper than the face of the wall;
sentences.susu: «Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa na fure mato. Xa fure fɔɔrɔ, xa na mu a ra a gbeeli, a man ya naxa itilin, a banxi kanke suxu,

sentences.english: Then the priest will go out of the door of the house, and keep the house shut up for seven days:
sentences.susu: sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa mini banxi kui, a xa banxi naadɛ balan lɔxun keren.

sentences.english: And the priest is to come again on the seventh day and have a look and see if the marks on the walls of the house are increased in size;
sentences.susu: Xi solofere nde lɔxɔɛ, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ man xa gbilen naa. Xa fure bara lantan yɛ i banxi kanke ma,

sentences.english: Then the priest will give orders to them to take out the stones in which the disease is seen, and put them out into an unclean place outside the town:
sentences.susu: sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa yaamari fi, banxi gɛmɛe xa ba na fure na dɛnnaxɛ, e xa e wɔlɛ taa fari ma yire sɛniyɛntare.

sentences.english: And he will have the house rubbed all over inside, and the paste which is rubbed off will be put out into an unclean place outside the town:
sentences.susu: Banxi kanke xa maxɔɔlin banxi kui. Naxan bama, na xa woli taa fari ma yire sɛniyɛntare.

sentences.english: And they will take other stones and put them in place of those stones, and he will take other paste and put it on the walls of the house.
sentences.susu: Gɛmɛ gbɛtɛe xa sa booree ɲɔxɔɛ ra, banxi kanke xa maso a nɛɛnɛ ra.»

sentences.english: And if the disease comes out again in the house after he has taken out the stones and after the walls have been rubbed and the new paste put on,
sentences.susu: «Na wali birin dangi xanbi, xa fure ɲaaxi man mini banxi ma,

sentences.english: Then the priest will come and see it; and if the disease in the house is increased in size, it is the leper's disease working out in the house: it is unclean.
sentences.susu: sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa gbilen na mato ra. Xa fure bara lantan yɛ banxi kui, fure ɲaaxi na a ra, a findixi se sɛniyɛntare nan na.

sentences.english: And the house will have to be pulled down, the stones of it and the wood and the paste; and everything is to be taken out to an unclean place outside the town.
sentences.susu: Na banxi xa rabira, a gɛmɛe, a wurie, nun a maso bɛndɛ birin xa wɔlɛ taa fari ma yire sɛniyɛntare.

sentences.english: And, in addition, anyone who goes into the house at any time, while it is shut up, will be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: Naxan yo soma na banxi kui a balan xanbi, na kanyi fan findima mixi sɛniyɛntare nan na han nunmare ra.

sentences.english: And anyone who has been sleeping in the house will have to have his clothing washed; and anyone who takes food in that house will have to have his clothing washed.
sentences.susu: Naxan na a sa na banxi kui, xa na mu a ra a a dɛge naa, na lanma a xa a xa dugie xa.»

sentences.english: And if the priest comes in, and sees that the disease is not increased after the new paste has been put on the house, then the priest will say that the house is clean, because the disease is gone.
sentences.susu: «Na banxi yailan xanbi, xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ sa gbilen na banxi kui, a fa a to fure mu lantanxi a i, a xa masenyi ti, na banxi bara sɛniyɛn, fure bara ɲɔn naa.

sentences.english: And in order to make the house clean, let him take two birds and cedar-wood and red thread and hyssop;
sentences.susu: Na banxi kanyi xa na marasɛniyɛnyi rakamali sɛrɛxɛ bafe ra. A xa xɔni firin, sɛdiri wuri, gɛrɛ mɔɔli nde, nun hisopi wuri sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And put one of the birds to death in a vessel of earth over flowing water;
sentences.susu: A xa xɔni keren kɔn naxaba fɛɲɛ nde xun ma dulon ye na naxan kui.

sentences.english: And take the cedar-wood and the hyssop and the red thread and the living bird and put them in the blood of the dead bird and in the flowing water, shaking it over the house seven times.
sentences.susu: A xa sɛdiri wuri, hisopi wuri, gɛrɛ mɔɔli nde, nun xɔni ɲiɲɛ sin xɔni kɔn naxaba wuli xɔɔra, naxan na dulon ye kui. A xa a kasan banxi ma sanmaya solofere.

sentences.english: And he will make the house clean with the blood of the bird and the flowing water and with the living bird and with the cedar-wood and the hyssop and the red thread.
sentences.susu: A xa banxi rasɛniyɛn xɔni wuli, dulon ye, xɔni ɲiɲɛ, sɛdiri wuri, hisopi wuri, nun gɛrɛ mɔɔli nde ra.

sentences.english: But he will let the living bird go out of the town into the open country; so he will take away sin from the house and it will be clean.
sentences.susu: A xa xɔni ɲiɲɛ bɛɲin taa fari ma wula i. Na kui, na banxi xa fe ɲaaxi ɲɔnma nɛ, a sɛniyɛn.»

sentences.english: This is the law for all signs of the leper's disease and for skin diseases;
sentences.susu: «Sɛriyɛ nan na ki fure ɲaaxie xa fe ra naxee minima mixi fate ma,

sentences.english: And for signs of disease in clothing, or in a house;
sentences.susu: dugie ma, banxie ma,

sentences.english: And for a growth or a bad place or a bright mark on the skin;
sentences.susu: naxee funtuma, naxee bulama, naxee fiixɛma,

sentences.english: To make clear when it is unclean and when it is clean: this is the law about the disease of the leper.
sentences.susu: alako a xa kolon xa se sɛniyɛnxi nan a ra, xa na mu a ra a mu sɛniyɛnxi. Sɛriyɛ nan na ki na fure ɲaaxi xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses and to Aaron,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa nun Haruna bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel: If a man has an unclean flow from his flesh, it will make him unclean.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa a fala Isirayilakae bɛ, kɔrɔsila kanyi bara findi mixi sɛniyɛntare ra.

sentences.english: If the flow goes on or if the part is stopped up, to keep back the flow, he is still unclean.
sentences.susu: Kɔrɔsila kanyi bara findi mixi sɛniyɛntare ra hali kɔrɔsila mu na minife sinden, kɔnɔ a na a fate kui.

sentences.english: Every bed on which he has been resting will be unclean, and everything on which he has been seated will be unclean.
sentences.susu: Kɔrɔsila kanyi sama sade naxan ma, se sɛniyɛntare na a ra. A dɔxɔ gonyi naxan yo ma, na fan se sɛniyɛntare na a ra.

sentences.english: And anyone touching his bed is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: Naxan na din a xa sade ra, na kanyi xa a xa dugie xa, a xa a yɛtɛ maxa ye ra. A findima mixi sɛniyɛntare nan na han nunmare ra.

sentences.english: And he who has been seated on anything on which the unclean man has been seated is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: Naxan dɔxɔma a xa gonyi ma, na kanyi xa a xa dugie xa, a xa a yɛtɛ maxa ye ra. A findima mixi sɛniyɛntare nan na han nunmare ra.

sentences.english: And anyone touching the flesh of the unclean man is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: Naxan yo din na furema fate ra, na kanyi xa a xa dugie xa, a xa a yɛtɛ maxa ye ra. A findima mixi sɛniyɛntare nan na han nunmare ra.

sentences.english: And if liquid from the mouth of the unclean man comes on to him who is clean, then he is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: Xa furema dɛ ye bɔxun mixi sɛniyɛnxi nde ma, na kanyi xa a xa dugie xa, a xa a yɛtɛ maxa. A findima mixi sɛniyɛntare nan na han nunmare ra.

sentences.english: And any leather seat on a horse on which the unclean man has been seated will be unclean.
sentences.susu: Dɔxɔse naxan sama soe ma, xa na mu a ra ɲɔxɔmɛ ma, xa furema dɔxɔ na fari, na dɔxɔse findima se sɛniyɛntare nan na.

sentences.english: And anyone touching anything which was under him will be unclean till the evening; anyone taking up any of these things is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: Naxan na din sese ra furema bara dɔxɔ naxan fari, na kanyi bara findi mixi sɛniyɛntare ra han nunmare ra. Na kanyi xa a xa dugie xa, a xa a yɛtɛ maxa.

sentences.english: And anyone on whom the unclean man puts his hands, without washing them in water, is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: Furema bɛlɛxɛ sɛniyɛntare kanyi dinma mixi naxan na, na xa a xa dugie xa, a xa a yɛtɛ maxa ye ra. A findima mixi sɛniyɛntare nan na han nunmare ra.

sentences.english: And any vessel of earth which has been touched by the unclean man will have to be broken and any vessel of wood washed.
sentences.susu: Furema dinma fɛɲɛ naxan na, na xa kana. Xa yirabase wuri daaxi na a ra, a lan a xa maxa ye ra.»

sentences.english: And when a man who has a flow from his body is made clean from it, he is to take seven days to make himself clean, washing his clothing and bathing his body in flowing water, and then he will be clean.
sentences.susu: «Kɔrɔsila kanyi na yalan, a mamɛ tima nɛ lɔxun keren beenu a xa findi mixi sɛniyɛnxi ra. A xa a xa dugie xa, a xa a maxa dulonyi ye ra. A sɛniyɛnma na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And on the eighth day he is to take two doves or two young pigeons and come before the Lord to the door of the Tent of meeting and give them to the priest:
sentences.susu: Xi solomasaxan nde lɔxɔɛ, a xa ganbɛ firin tongo, xa na mu a ra kolokonde yɔrɛ firin, a sa e so sɛrɛxɛdubɛ yi ra n tan Alatala ya i hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And they are to be offered by the priest, one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering, and the priest will take away his sin before the Lord on account of his flow.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa xɔni keren ba yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, boore sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi. Na kui, kɔrɔsila kanyi bara a xun sara n tan Alatala ya i.»

sentences.english: And if a man's seed goes out from him, then all his body will have to be bathed in water and he will be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: «Xa xɛmɛ nde a xa wantanyi nɔxɔ, a xa a fate birin maxa. A findima mixi sɛniyɛntare nan na han nunmare ra.

sentences.english: And any clothing or skin on which the seed comes is to be washed with water and be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: Dugi nun kiri naxan birin nɔxɔ, e xa maxa ye ra, e fan findima nɛ se sɛniyɛntare han nunmare ra.

sentences.english: And if a man has sex relations with a woman and his seed goes out from him, the two of them will have to be bathed in water and will be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: Xa xɛmɛ nun ginɛ kafu e boore ra, e xa e fate maxa. E findima mixi sɛniyɛntaree nan na han nunmare ra.»

sentences.english: And if a woman has a flow of blood from her body, she will have to be kept separate for seven days, and anyone touching her will be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: «Ginɛ naxan na a xa kike wali kui, a findima mixi sɛniyɛntare nan na lɔxun keren bun ma. Naxan na din a ra, a fan findima mixi sɛniyɛntare ra han nunmare ra.

sentences.english: And everything on which she has been resting, while she is kept separate, will be unclean, and everything on which she has been seated will be unclean.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxan na a xa kike wali kui, a sama sade naxan ma, se sɛniyɛntare na a ra. A dɔxɔ sese naxan ma, na fan se sɛniyɛntare na a ra.

sentences.english: And anyone touching her bed will have to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: Naxan yo na din a xa sade ra, na kanyi xa a xa dugie xa, a xa a yɛtɛ maxa ye ra. A findima mixi sɛniyɛntare nan na han nunmare ra.

sentences.english: And anyone touching anything on which she has been seated will have to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: Naxan yo na dɔxɔ a xa gonyi ma, na kanyi xa a xa dugie xa, a xa a yɛtɛ maxa ye ra. A findima mixi sɛniyɛntare nan na han nunmare ra.

sentences.english: Anyone touching anything on the bed or on the thing on which she has been seated, will be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: Xa se nde saxi na sade ma, xa na mu a ra na gonyi ma a nu dɔxɔxi naxan ma, naxan dinma na se ra a findima mixi sɛniyɛntare nan na han nunmare ra.

sentences.english: And if any man has sex relations with her so that her blood comes on him, he will be unclean for seven days and every bed on which he has been resting will be unclean.
sentences.susu: Xa xɛmɛ nde nun na ginɛ kafu, a xa kike wali wuli fa sa a fate ma, a fan findima mixi sɛniyɛntare nan na lɔxɔxun keren bun ma. A na sa sade yo ma, na fan findima se sɛniyɛntare nan na.»

sentences.english: And if a woman has a flow of blood for a long time, not at the time when she generally has it, or if the flow goes on longer than the normal time, she will be unclean while the flow of blood goes on, as she is at other normal times.
sentences.susu: «Xa wuli lu mini ra ginɛ ma, naxan mu findixi a xa kike wali wuli ra, xa na mu a ra a xa kike wali tɛmui xɔn naxa kuya, a findima mixi sɛniyɛntare nan na alɔ ginɛ naxan na a xa kike wali kui.

sentences.english: Every bed on which she has been resting will be unclean, as at the times when she normally has a flow of blood, and everything on which she has been seated will be unclean, in the same way.
sentences.susu: A na a sa sade naxan ma, xa na mu a ra a dɔxɔ gonyi naxan ma, na birin findima nɛ se sɛniyɛntare ra alɔ a xa kike wali tɛmui.

sentences.english: And anyone touching these things will be unclean, and his clothing will have to be washed and his body bathed in water and he will be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: Naxan dinma na see ra, na kanyi xa a xa dugie xa, a xa a fate maxa ye ra. A findima mixi sɛniyɛntare nan na han nunmare ra.»

sentences.english: But when her flow of blood is stopped, after seven days she will be clean.
sentences.susu: «Wuli na ba minife, na ginɛ xa mamɛ ti lɔxɔxun keren, a fa sɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: And on the eighth day let her get two doves or two young pigeons and take them to the priest to the door of the Tent of meeting,
sentences.susu: Xi solofere nde lɔxɔɛ, a xa ganbɛ firin, xa na mu a ra kolokonde yɔrɛ firin tongo, a xa e xanin sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xɔn hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: To be offered by the priest, one for a sin-offering and one for a burned offering; and the priest will take away her sin before the Lord on account of her unclean condition.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa xɔni keren ba yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, boore sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xunsare sɛrɛxɛ bama na ginɛ bɛ n tan Alatala ya i na ki nɛ.»

sentences.english: In this way may the children of Israel be made free from all sorts of unclean conditions, so that death may not overtake them when they are unclean and when they make unclean my holy place which is among them.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa Isirayilakae makuya sɛniyɛntareɲa ra, xa na mu a ra, e na e makɔrɛ n ma hɔrɔmɔlingira ra naxan na wo tagi, e faxama nɛ.»

sentences.english: This is the law for the man who has a flow from his body, or whose seed goes from him so that he is unclean;
sentences.susu: «Sɛriyɛ nan na ki kɔrɔsila xa fe ra, a nun xɛmɛ naxan a xa wantanyi nɔxɔma,

sentences.english: And for her who has a flow of blood, and for any man or woman who has an unclean flow, and for him who has sex relations with a woman when she is unclean.
sentences.susu: ginɛ naxan na kike wali kui, kɔrɔsila naxan minima xɛmɛ nun ginɛ fate i, nun xɛmɛ naxan nun ginɛ sɛniyɛntare kafuma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, after the death of the two sons of Aaron when they took in strange fire before the Lord and death overtook them;
sentences.susu: Haruna xa di firinyi to faxa e yɛtɛ masenfe ra Alatala bɛ, Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: The Lord said to Moses, Say to Aaron, your brother, that he may not come at all times into the holy place inside the veil, before the cover which is on the ark, for fear that death may overtake him; for I will be seen in the cloud on the cover of the ark.
sentences.susu: «A fala i taara Haruna bɛ, a na so hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, a naxa lu dangi ra dugi gbakuxi ra xa a dangi tɛmui mu a lixi, alako a naxa faxa. Yire sɛniyɛnxi na a ra saatɛ kankira na dɛnnaxɛ. Xunsarade na na saatɛ kankira nan fari, n minima nuxui kui dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: Let Aaron come into the holy place in this way: with an ox for a sin-offering and a male sheep for a burned offering.
sentences.susu: «Haruna xa so hɔrɔmɔlingira kui tuura ra, naxan bama yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, a nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra.

sentences.english: Let him put on the holy linen coat, and the linen trousers on his body, and the linen band round him, and the linen head-dress on his head; for this is holy clothing, and before he puts them on his body is to be washed with water.
sentences.susu: A xa guba sɛniyɛnxi gɛsɛ fute daaxi ragoro a ma, a xa wantanyi gɛsɛ fute daaxi so. A xa a tagi ixiri bɛlɛti gɛsɛ fute daaxi ra, a xa xunmase dɔxɔ a xunyi ma. A na gɛ a maxade, a xa na dugi sɛniyɛnxi birin nagoro a ma.

sentences.english: And let him take from the children of Israel two he-goats for a sin-offering and one male sheep for a burned offering.
sentences.susu: Isirayila ɲama xa sikɔtɛ firin so a yi ra yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, a nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra.

sentences.english: And Aaron is to give the ox of the sin-offering for himself, to make himself and his house free from sin.
sentences.susu: Haruna xa tuura ba a yɛtɛ xa yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra alako a tan nun a xa denbaya xun xa sara.

sentences.english: And he is to take the two goats and put them before the Lord at the door of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: A xa na sikɔtɛ firinyi ti n tan Alatala ya i, hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Aaron will make selection from the two goats by the decision of the Lord, one goat for the Lord and one for Azazel.
sentences.susu: A xa n tan Ala maxandi a xa tɔnxuma masen n bɛ na sikɔtɛ firinyi xa fe ra. Keren xa findi n tan Alatala gbe ra, boore xa lu Sentanɛ bɛ wula i.

sentences.english: And the goat which is marked out for the Lord, let Aaron give for a sin-offering.
sentences.susu: Sikɔtɛ naxan sugandixi n tan Alatala gbe ra, Haruna xa a ba yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: But the goat for Azazel is to be placed living before the Lord, for the taking away of sin, that it may be sent away for Azazel into the waste land.
sentences.susu: Sikɔtɛ naxan sugandixi a xa findi Sentanɛ gbe ra, na mu faxama. Haruna xa a ti n tan Alatala ya i, a xa findi xunsare ra, a xa a bɛɲin sigafe ra wula i Sentanɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: And Aaron is to give the ox of the sin-offering for himself and take away sin from himself and his house, and put to death the ox of the sin-offering which is for himself.
sentences.susu: Haruna xa tuura ba a yɛtɛ xa yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, a xa findi a tan nun a xa denbaya xunsare ra. A xa na tuura kɔn naxaba yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: And he is to take a vessel full of burning coal from the altar before the Lord and in his hand some sweet perfume crushed small, and take it inside the veil;
sentences.susu: A xa surayi ganse rafe tɛ wole ra naxan tongoxi sɛrɛxɛbade fari n tan Alatala ya i. A xa surayi fuɲi bɛlɛxɛ ya firin fan tongo. A xa na birin xanin dugi gbakuxi xanbi ra yire sɛniyɛnxi kui.

sentences.english: And let him put the perfume on the fire before the Lord so that the ark may be covered with a cloud of the smoke of the perfume, in order that death may not overtake him.
sentences.susu: A xa na surayi gan n tan Alatala ya i, alako tuuri naxan tema na xa saatɛ kankira nɔxun a ma alako a naxa faxa.

sentences.english: And let him take some of the blood of the ox, shaking drops of it from his finger on the cover of the ark on the east side, and before it, seven times.
sentences.susu: A xa tuura wuli nde tongo a bɛlɛxɛsole ra, a xa a kasan saatɛ kankira makoto se ma xunsarade sogetede biri sanmaya solofere, a man xa a kasan na makoto se ya ra.

sentences.english: Then let him put to death the goat of the sin-offering for the people, and take its blood inside the veil and do with it as he did with the blood of the ox, shaking drops of it on and before the cover of the ark.
sentences.susu: A xa sikɔtɛ kɔn naxaba ɲama xa yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, a fa a wuli xanin dugi gbakuxi xanbi ra. A xa na wuli kasan saatɛ kankira makoto se ma nun saatɛ kankira makoto se ya ra, alɔ a rabaxi tuura wuli ra ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And let him make the holy place free from whatever is unclean among the children of Israel and from their wrongdoing in all their sins; and let him do the same for the Tent of meeting, which has its place among an unclean people.
sentences.susu: «Na ki a xunsare sɔtɔma yire sɛniyɛnxi bɛ Isirayilakae xa sɛniyɛntareɲa, e xa fe kobie, nun e xa yunubie xa fe ra. A xa a raba na ki hɔrɔmɔlingira fan bɛ, naxan tixi Isirayilaka sɛniyɛntaree tagi.

sentences.english: And no man may be in the Tent of meeting from the time when Aaron goes in to take away sin in the holy place till he comes out, having made himself and his house and all the people of Israel free from sin.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo naxa lu hɔrɔmɔlingira kui han Haruna minima yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante kui tɛmui naxɛ. A xa a tan nun a xa denbaya xun sara, a nun Isirayila ɲama birin.

sentences.english: And he is to go out to the altar which is before the Lord and make it free from sin; and he is to take some of the blood of the ox and the blood of the goat and put it on the horns of the altar and round it;
sentences.susu: A xa siga sɛrɛxɛbade yire naxan na n tan Alatala ya i, a fa xunsare ba na sɛrɛxɛbade bɛ. A xa tuura nun sikɔtɛ wuli sa ferie ma naxee nu na sɛrɛxɛbade tunxunyi naanie ra.

sentences.english: Shaking drops of the blood from his finger on it seven times to make it holy and clean from whatever is unclean among the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: A xa wuli kasan a bɛlɛxɛsole ra sanya solofere sɛrɛxɛbade ma, alako a xa sɛniyɛn Isirayilakae xa sɛniyɛntareɲa xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And when he has done whatever is necessary to make the holy place and the Tent of meeting and the altar free from sin, let him put the living goat before the Lord;
sentences.susu: «Haruna na gɛ xunsare bade yire sɛniyɛnxi, hɔrɔmɔlingira, nun sɛrɛxɛbade bɛ, a xa sikɔtɛ boore maso naxan mu nu faxa.

sentences.english: And Aaron, placing his two hands on the head of the living goat, will make a public statement over him of all the evil doings of the children of Israel and all their wrongdoing, in all their sins; and he will put them on the head of the goat and send him away, in the care of a man who will be waiting there, into the waste land.
sentences.susu: A xa a bɛlɛxɛ firinyie sa na sikɔtɛ xun tagi, a fa Isirayilakae xa sɛniyɛntareɲa, e xa fe kobie, nun e xa yunubi birin masen n tan Ala bɛ. A na gɛ na kote birin sade sikɔtɛ xun, a xa na sikɔtɛ bɛɲin wula i mixi nde saabui ra naxan bara tin na wali ra.

sentences.english: And the goat will take all their sins into a land cut off from men, and he will send the goat away into the waste land.
sentences.susu: Na sikɔtɛ yunubi birin xaninma a xun ma wula i, a bɛɲin dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: Then let Aaron come into the Tent of meeting and take off the linen clothing which he put on when he went into the holy place, and put them down there;
sentences.susu: «Na dangi xanbi, Haruna xa so hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, a xa a xa dugi gɛsɛ fute daaxie ba, a naxee ragoroxi a ma beenu a xa so yire sɛniyɛnxi kui. A xa nee lu na.

sentences.english: And after bathing his body in water in a holy place, he is to put on his clothing and come out and give his burned offering and the burned offering of the people, to take away his sin and the sin of the people.
sentences.susu: A xa a maxa ye ra yire sɛniyɛnxi kui, a dugi gbɛtɛe ragoro a ma. A na gɛ, a xa mini, a sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi firin ba, keren a yɛtɛ bɛ, boore ɲama bɛ. A xunsare sɔtɔma a yɛtɛ bɛ nun ɲama bɛ na kui.

sentences.english: And the fat of the sin-offering is to be burned by him on the altar.
sentences.susu: A man xa yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ture gan sɛrɛxɛbade fari.»

sentences.english: And the man who takes away the goat for Azazel is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and then he may come back to the tent-circle.
sentences.susu: «Naxan sikɔtɛ bɛɲin wula i Sentanɛ bɛ, na lan a xa a xa dugie xa, a a fate maxa, a fa gbilen ɲama yonkinde.

sentences.english: And the ox of the sin-offering and the goat of the sin-offering, whose blood was taken in to make the holy place free from sin, are to be taken away outside the tent-circle and their skins and their flesh and their waste are to be burned with fire.
sentences.susu: Tuura nun sikɔtɛ naxee baxi yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, naxee wuli findi xunsare ra yire sɛniyɛnxi, nee lan e xa xanin ɲama yonkinde fari ma, e kiri, e sube, nun e ɲaɲɛ birin xa gan tɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the man by whom they are burned is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water, and then he may come back to the tent-circle.
sentences.susu: Naxan na wali rabama, a xa a xa dugie xa, a xa a fate maxa ye ra, a fa gbilen ɲama yonkinde.»

sentences.english: And let this be an order to you for ever: in the seventh month, on the tenth day, you are to keep yourselves from pleasure and do no sort of work, those who are Israelites by birth and those from other lands who are living among you:
sentences.susu: «Sɛriyɛ nan na ki wo bɛ naxan mu kanama abadan. Kike solofere nde, xi fu lɔxɔɛ, wo xa sunyi suxu, wo naxa wali yo raba, wo tan, nun mixi naxee sabatixi naa kɔnɔ e mu findi Isirayilakae ra.

sentences.english: For on this day your sin will be taken away and you will be clean: you will be made free from all your sins before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na findima xunsare lɔxɔɛ ra wo bɛ, alako wo xa sɛniyɛn, wo xa yunubi birin xa xafari n tan Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: It is a special Sabbath for you, and you are to keep yourselves from pleasure; it is an order for ever.
sentences.susu: Na findima malabui nun sali lɔxɔɛ ra wo bɛ. Wo xa sunyi suxu na lɔxɔɛ. Yi sɛriyɛ mu kanama abadan.»

sentences.english: And the man on whose head the holy oil has been put, and who has been marked out to be a priest in his father's place, will do what is necessary to take away sin, and will put on the linen clothing, even the holy robes:
sentences.susu: «Ala naxan sugandixi, a naxan tixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi ra, na nan wo xun sarama. A luma a baba xa wali raba ra. A luma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ dugi sɛniyɛnxie ragoro ra a ma.

sentences.english: And he will make the holy place and the Tent of meeting and the altar free from sin; he will take away sin from the priests and from all the people.
sentences.susu: A luma yire sɛniyɛnxi, hɔrɔmɔlingira, sɛrɛxɛbade, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Isirayila ɲama birin xun sara ra.

sentences.english: And let this be an order for ever for you, so that the sin of the children of Israel may be taken away once every year. And he did as the Lord gave orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: Yi sɛriyɛ mu kanama abadan, alako ɲɛ birin xunsare xa ba Isirayilakae bɛ e xa yunubi birin ma fe ra.» E Alatala xa yaamari birin suxu alɔ a masenxi Annabi Munsa bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of Israel: This is the order which the Lord has given.
sentences.susu: «A fala Haruna bɛ nun a xa die bɛ, a nun Isirayilaka birin bɛ, Alatala yi nan yamarixi.

sentences.english: If any man of Israel puts to death an ox or a lamb or a goat, in or outside the tent-circle;
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka naxan ninge, xa na mu a ra yɛxɛɛ, xa na mu a ra si bama sɛrɛxɛ ra ɲama yonkinde kui, xa na mu a ra ɲama yonkinde fari ma,

sentences.english: And has not taken it to the door of the Tent of meeting, to make an offering to the Lord, before the Lord's House, its blood will be on him, for he has taken life, and he will be cut off from among his people:
sentences.susu: a mu a xaninma hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ xa ra alako a xa a fi n tan Alatala ma hɔrɔmɔlingira yire, na kanyi luma nɛ alɔ faxɛti. A bara faxɛ ti, a lanma na kanyi xa keri ɲama ya ma.

sentences.english: So that the children of Israel may take to the Lord, to the door of the Tent of meeting and to the priest, the offerings which they have put to death in the open country, and that they may make their peace-offerings to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Yi yaamari wama a masenfe nɛ a Isirayilakae mu lanma e xa sɛrɛxɛ ba burunyi. E xa fa xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ra sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nan xɔn n tan Alatala ya i n ma hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the priest will put blood on the altar of the Lord at the door of the Tent of meeting, burning the fat for a sweet smell to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa na wuli kasan n tan Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade sɛɛtie ma hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra, a man xa na ture gan tɛ i, a xa findi xiri fanyi ra n tan Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And let them make no more offerings to evil spirits, after which they have gone, turning away from the Lord. Let this be a law to them for ever, through all their generations.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa sikɔtɛ sɛrɛxɛ ba kuye bɛ sɔnɔn de. Na findima yanfanteya nan na n tan Alatala mabiri. Yi yaamari mu kanama abadan.»

sentences.english: And say to them, If any man of Israel, or any other living among them, makes a burned offering or other offering,
sentences.susu: «A fala e bɛ, Isirayilaka, xa na mu a ra xɔɲɛ naxan sabatixi e tagi, xa a sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi, xa na mu a ra sɛrɛxɛ gbɛtɛ ba,

sentences.english: And does not take it to the door of the Tent of meeting to make an offering to the Lord, that man will be cut off from among his people.
sentences.susu: a mu a xanin hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra, alako a xa fi n tan Alatala ma, na kanyi kerima nɛ a xa ɲama tagi.»

sentences.english: And if any man of Israel, or any other living among them, takes any sort of blood for food, my wrath will be turned against that man and he will be cut off from among his people.
sentences.susu: «Xa Isirayilaka nde, xa na mu a ra xɔɲɛ nde naxan sabatixi Isirayila bɔxi ma a naxa wuli min, n gbilenma nɛ na kanyi fɔxɔ ra, n fa a keri a xa ɲama ya ma,

sentences.english: For the life of the flesh is in its blood; and I have given it to you on the altar to take away your sin: for it is the blood which makes free from sin because of the life in it.
sentences.susu: barima sube nii bara lu a wuli ya ma. N bara wuli findi wo xunsare ra, naxan bama sɛrɛxɛ ra sɛrɛxɛbade fari. Wuli nan na xunsare ra.

sentences.english: For this reason I have said to the children of Israel, No man among you, or any others living with you, may take blood as food.
sentences.susu: Na na a ra, n bara Isirayilakae yamari e naxa wuli min. Wo xa xɔɲɛ naxee sabatixi Isirayila bɔxi ma, e fan naxa wuli min de.

sentences.english: And any man of Israel, or any other living among them, who gets with his bow any beast or bird used for food, is to see that its blood is covered with earth.
sentences.susu: Xa Isirayilaka, xa na mu a ra xɔɲɛ nde naxan na wo tagi, sa sube nde, xa na mu a ra xɔni nde faxa naxan daxa a xa don, a xa na wuli ifili bɔxi ma, a bɛndɛ sa a fari,

sentences.english: For the blood is the life of all flesh: and so I have said to the children of Israel, You may not take any sort of blood as food, and any man who does so will be cut of.
sentences.susu: barima sube nii na a wuli nan ya ma. Na na a ra, n bara Isirayilakae yamari wo naxa sube wuli yo min, barima sube nii na a wuli nan ya ma. Naxan yo na raba, a fama keride Isirayila ɲama ya ma.»

sentences.english: And anyone who takes as food anything which has come to a natural end, or anything which has been put to death by beasts, if he is one of you by birth, or of another nation, will have to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening, and then he will be clean.
sentences.susu: «Xa Isirayilaka, xa na mu a ra xɔɲɛ nde naxan na wo tagi, na sube don naxan faxaxi a yɛtɛ ma, xa na mu a ra sube gbɛtɛ naxan faxaxi ki gbɛtɛ ra, na kanyi xa a xa dugie xa ye ra, a man xa a yɛtɛ maxa. A mu sɛniyɛnma han nunmare ra.

sentences.english: But if his clothing is not washed and his body bathed, his sin will be on him.
sentences.susu: Xa a mu a xa dugie xa, xa a mu a yɛtɛ maxa, na sɛniyɛntareɲa luma nɛ a ma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel, I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.

sentences.english: You may not do those things which were done in the land of Egypt where you were living; and you may not do those things which are done in the land of Canaan where I am taking you, or be guided in your behaviour by their rules.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa Misirakae xa naamunyie raba, wo nu na dɛnnaxɛ. Wo man naxa Kanaankae fan ma naamunyie raba, n wo xaninma dɛnnaxɛ. Wo naxa bira e xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: But you are to be guided by my decisions and keep my rules, and be guided by them: I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo xa n tan nan ma sɛriyɛ nun n ma yaamarie rabatu, barima Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.

sentences.english: So keep my rules and my decisions, which, if a man does them, will be life to him: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa bira n ma sɛriyɛ nun n ma yaamarie nan fɔxɔ ra. Mixi naxan nee rabatuma, a simaya sɔtɔma nee nan saabui ra. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: You may not have sex connection with anyone who is a near relation: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa kafu wo nun wo barima. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: You may not have sex relations with your father or your mother: she is your mother, you may not take her.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa kafu wo nun wo nga, naxan findixi wo baba xa ginɛ ra. Wo nga nan wo nga ra, wo naxa kafu a ra.»

sentences.english: And you may not have sex relations with your father's wife: she is your father's.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa kafu wo nun wo nanden, naxan findixi wo baba xa ginɛ ra.»

sentences.english: You may not take your sister, the daughter of your father or of your mother, wherever her birth took place, among you or in another country.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa kafu wo nun wo maaginɛ, naxan findixi wo baba xa na mu a ra wo nga xa di ra, naxan barixi wo xɔnyi xa na mu a ra yire gbɛtɛ.»

sentences.english: You may not have sex relations with your son's daughter or your daughter's daughter, for they are part of yourself;
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa kafu wo nun wo xa di xɛmɛ xa di ginɛ, wo naxa kafu wo nun wo xa di ginɛ xa di ginɛ. E fatanxi wo yɛtɛ fate nan na.»

sentences.english: Or your father's wife's daughter, the child of your father, for she is your sister.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa kafu wo nun wo baba xa ginɛ gbɛtɛ xa di ginɛ, wo baba naxan barixi. Wo maaginɛ na a ra.»

sentences.english: You may not have sex connection with your father's sister, for she is your father's near relation.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa kafu wo nun wo baba maaginɛ ra. Wo baba bariboore na a ra.»

sentences.english: You may not have sex connection with your mother's sister, for she is your mother's near relation.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa kafu wo nun wo nga xunya, xa na mu a ra a taara. Wo nga bariboore na a ra.»

sentences.english: You may not have sex relations with the wife of your father's brother, for she is of your family;
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa kafu wo nun wo baba xunya xa ginɛ, xa na mu a ra a taara xa ginɛ. Wo baba xunya xa na mu a ra a taara nan gbe findixi na ginɛe ra. Wo nga nun wo mama nan lanxi e ma.»

sentences.english: Or with your daughter-in-law, for she is your son's wife, and you may not take her.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa kafu wo nun wo xa di xa ginɛ, wo xa di nan xa ginɛ a ra.»

sentences.english: You may not have sex relations with your brother's wife, for she is your brother's.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa kafu wo nun wo xunya, xa na mu a ra wo taara xa ginɛ.»

sentences.english: You may not take as wife a woman and her daughter, or her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter, for they are of one family: it is an act of shame.
sentences.susu: «Xa wo nun ginɛ nde bara kafu, wo nun a xa di ginɛ tan naxa kafu de. Wo nun a xa di xɛmɛ xa di ginɛ naxa kafu de, wo nun a xa di ginɛ xa di ginɛ naxa kafu de. Baribooremae na e ra, na fe mɔɔli mu fan.»

sentences.english: And you may not take as wife a woman and at the same time her sister, to be in competition with her in her life-time.
sentences.susu: «Wo nun wo xa ginɛ xunya naxa kafu de, xa na mu a ra a taara, wo xa ginɛ xa simaya kui. Na fe fama nɛ tɔɔnɛ ra.»

sentences.english: And you may not go near a woman or have sex relations with her when she is unclean, at her regular time.
sentences.susu: «Wo nun ginɛ naxa kafu a xa kike wali kui de, barima a mu sɛniyɛnxi na tɛmui.»

sentences.english: And you may not have sex relations with your neighbour's wife, making yourself unclean with her.
sentences.susu: «Sade fe naxa lu wo nun wo malanboore xa ginɛ tagi de, na findima sɛniyɛntareɲa nan na.»

sentences.english: And you may not make any of your children go through the fire as an offering to Molech, and you may not put shame on the name of your God: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa wo xa di yo ba sɛrɛxɛ ra Mɔlɔkɔ kuye bɛ. Wo naxa wo Marigi Ala xili bɛxu. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: You may not have sex relations with men, as you do with women: it is a disgusting thing.
sentences.susu: «Xɛmɛ naxa kafu nun xɛmɛ ra. Fe ɲaaxi na a ra. Xɛmɛ lanma e nun ginɛ nan xa kafu.»

sentences.english: And you may not have sex relations with a beast, making yourself unclean with it; and a woman may not give herself to a beast: it is an unnatural act.
sentences.susu: «Xɛmɛ naxa kafu nun sube ra. Ginɛ fan naxa kafu nun sube ra. Na fe mɔɔli mu fan feo.»

sentences.english: Do not make yourself unclean in any of these ways; for so have those nations whom I am driving out from before you made themselves unclean:
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa wo manɔxɔ yi fe mɔɔlie ra, alɔ na sie a rabaxi ki naxɛ n naxee keri wo ya ra.

sentences.english: And the land itself has become unclean; so that I have sent on it the reward of its wrongdoing, and the land itself puts out those who are living in it.
sentences.susu: E xa fe ɲaaxie bara bɔxi yati manɔxɔ. N e ratɔnxi na nan ma, e mu luma yi bɔxi ma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: So then keep my rules and my decisions, and do not do any of these disgusting things, those of you who are Israelites by birth, or any others who are living with you:
sentences.susu: Wo tan Isirayilakae nun xɔɲɛ naxee na wo tagi, wo xa n ma sɛriyɛ nun n ma yaamarie rabatu. Wo naxa yi fe xɔnxie raba de.

sentences.english: (For all these disgusting things were done by the men of this country who were there before you, and the land has been made unclean by them;)
sentences.susu: Bekae nu bara na mɔɔli raba beenu wo xa fa. Yi bɔxi findi yire sɛniyɛntare ra na nan ma.

sentences.english: So that the land may not put you out from it, when you make it unclean, as it put out the nations which were there before you.
sentences.susu: Xa wo fan bira na mɔɔli fɔxɔ ra, wo fan kerima nɛ yi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: For all those who do any of these disgusting things will be cut off from among their people.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo naxan na mɔɔli rabama, a kelima nɛ a xa ɲama ya ma.

sentences.english: So then, keep my orders, so that you may not do any of these disgusting things which were done before you, or make yourselves unclean through them: I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo xa n ma yaamarie rabatu, wo naxa na fe xɔnxie raba alɔ mixi naxee nu na be beenu wo xa fa. Wo naxa findi mixi sɛniyɛntaree ra. Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to all the people of Israel, You are to be holy, for I, the Lord your God, am holy.
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, wo xa sɛniyɛn, barima n tan sɛniyɛn, wo Marigi Alatala.

sentences.english: Let every man give honour to his mother and to his father and keep my Sabbaths: I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Birin xa e nga nun e baba binya. Birin xa malabui lɔxɔɛ sɛriyɛ rabatu. Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.»

sentences.english: Do not go after false gods, and do not make metal images of gods for yourselves: I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa kuyee batu, wo naxa wure raxunu kuye yailanfe ra. Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.»

sentences.english: And when you give a peace offering to the Lord, do it in the way which is pleasing to the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ba n tan Alatala bɛ a raba ki ma.

sentences.english: Let it be used for food on the same day on which it is offered, or on the day after; and whatever is over on the third day is to be burned with fire.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛ sube xa don a faxa lɔxɔɛ, xa na mu a ra na kuye iba. Sube na xi saxan ti, na xa sa tɛ i.

sentences.english: If any of it is used for food on the third day, it is a disgusting thing and will not be pleasing to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Naxan luma han xi saxan, a raharamuxi, a mu lan na mɔɔli xa don.

sentences.english: And as for anyone who takes it for food, his sin will be on him, for he has put shame on the holy thing of the Lord: he will be cut off from his people.
sentences.susu: Naxan na rabama, a na sare sɔtɔma nɛ, barima a bara n tan Alatala xa se sɛniyɛnxi yelebu. Na kanyi raminima nɛ Isirayila ɲama ya ma.»

sentences.english: And when you get in the grain from your land, do not let all the grain be cut from the edges of the field, or take up what has been dropped on the earth after the getting in of the grain.
sentences.susu: «Wo na xɛ xaba wo xɔnyi, wo naxa a tuxuie xaba. Baloe naxan birama bɔxi ma, wo xa na lu naa.

sentences.english: And do not take all the grapes from your vine-garden, or the fruit dropped on the earth; let the poor man, and the man from another country, have these: I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo na wɛni bogi ba wo xa sansie kɔn na, wo naxa gbilen a ma a firin nde. Bogi naxee fan yolonma e yɛtɛ ma, wo xa nee fan lu na setaree bɛ, a nun mixie bɛ naxee kelixi ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛe ma. Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.»

sentences.english: Do not take anyone's property or be false in act or word to another.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa muɲɛ ti. Wo naxa wule fala. Wo naxa wo boore yanfa.

sentences.english: And do not take an oath in my name falsely, putting shame on the name of your God: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo kali n xili ra wule fari, barima na kui wo wo Marigi Ala xili nan kanama. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: Do not be cruel to your neighbour or take what is his; do not keep back a servant's payment from him all night till the morning.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa wo ngaxakerenyi tɔɔrɔ, wo naxa a muɲa. Wo naxa wo xa walikɛ xa wali sare lu han tina.»

sentences.english: Do not put a curse on those who have no hearing, or put a cause of falling in the way of the blind, but keep the fear of your God before you: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa tulixɔri konbi, wo naxa dɔnxui rabira. Wo xa gaaxu n tan Ala ya ra. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: Do no wrong in your judging: do not give thought to the position of the poor, or honour to the position of the great; but be a judge to your neighbour in righteousness.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa kiiti sa tinxintareya ra. Wo naxa setare rafisa a boore bɛ, wo naxa banna rafisa a boore bɛ. Wo xa kiiti birin sa tinxinyi ra.

sentences.english: Do not go about saying untrue things among your people, or take away the life of your neighbour by false witness: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo boore mafala. Wo naxa wo boore tɔɔɲɛgɛ alako a xa faxa. Alatala nan n na.

sentences.english: Let there be no hate in your heart for your brother; but you may make a protest to your neighbour, so that he may be stopped from doing evil.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo ngaxakerenyi xɔn. Wo xa wo boore rasi, alako wo naxa yunubi sɔtɔ a xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Do not make attempts to get equal with one who has done you wrong, or keep hard feelings against the children of your people, but have love for your neighbour as for yourself: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo gbeɲɔxɔ. Wo naxa gbɛsɛnxɔnnɛya ragata wo sondonyi kui wo ngaxakerenyi bɛ. Wo xa wo boore xanu alɔ wo wo yɛtɛ xanuma ki naxɛ. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: Keep my laws. Do not let your cattle have offspring by those of a different sort; do not put mixed seed into your field; do not put on a robe made of two sorts of cloth.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa n ma yaamarie rabatu. Wo naxa xuruse mɔɔli firin rate e boore ma. Wo naxa sansi mɔɔli firin si xɛ keren ma. Wo naxa dugi ragoro wo ma naxan dɛgɛxi gɛsɛ mɔɔli firin na.»

sentences.english: If any man has sex relations with a servant-woman who has given her word to be married to a man, and has not been made free for a price or in any other way, the thing will be looked into; but they will not be put to death because she was not a free woman.
sentences.susu: «Xa xɛmɛ nde nun konyi ginɛ nde kafu xɛmɛ gbɛtɛ naxan xa kote dɔxɔxi, naxan xun mu saraxi sinden, naxan mu xɔrɛyaxi, e xa ɲaxankata. Kɔnɔ wo naxa e faxa, barima konyi ginɛ nan a ra.

sentences.english: Let him take his offering for wrongdoing to the Lord, to the door of the Tent of meeting; let him give a male sheep as an offering for wrongdoing.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ xa yɛxɛɛ kontonyi ba yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ ra n tan Alatala bɛ hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the priest will take away his sin before the Lord with the sheep which is offered for his wrongdoing, and he will have forgiveness for the sin which he has done.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa na yɛxɛɛ kontonyi findi xunsare ra a bɛ n tan Alatala ya i, a xa findi yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ ra alako a xa yunubi xa xafari.»

sentences.english: And when you have come into the land, and have put in all sorts of fruit-trees, their fruit will be as if they had not had circumcision, and for three years their fruit may not be used for food.
sentences.susu: «Wo na so bɔxi kui n naxan fima wo ma, wo naxa wo xa sansi sixie bogie don sinden han ɲɛ saxan. E mu sɛniyɛn, e luxi alɔ sunnɛtare. Wo naxa e don.

sentences.english: And in the fourth year all the fruit will be holy as a praise-offering to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Naxee fan bogima ɲɛ naani nde ma, na birin fima n tan Alatala nan ma, a xa findi n ma matɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: But in the fifth year you may take the fruit and the increase of it for your food: I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Naxee bogima ɲɛ suuli nde ma, na tan birin findima wo baloe nan na. Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.»

sentences.english: Nothing may be used for food with its blood in it; you may not make use of strange arts, or go in search of signs and wonders.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa sube yo don wo mu naxan kɔn naxabaxi, a wuli xa mini. Wo naxa sematoe wali raba, wo naxa duureya raba.

sentences.english: The ends of the hair round your face and on your chin may not be cut off.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo xunsɛxɛ maxaba wo xunyi sɛɛtie ma a radigilinxi ra, wo naxa wo dɛ xabe sɛɛtie maxaba,

sentences.english: You may not make cuts in your flesh in respect for the dead, or have marks printed on your bodies: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: wo naxa wo fate maxaba ɲɔnyi to soxi wo ma. Wo naxa pirinti ti wo fate ma. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: Do not make your daughter common by letting her become a loose woman, for fear that the land may become full of shame.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa wo xa di ginɛ mati langoe ra, alako wo xa bɔxi naxa bira langoeɲa fɔxɔ ra, a xa rafe fe ɲaaxie ra.

sentences.english: Keep my Sabbaths and have respect for my holy place: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa n ma malabui lɔxɔɛe binya, a nun n ma yire sɛniyɛnxi. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: Do not go after those who make use of spirits, or wonder-workers; do not go in their ways or become unclean through them: I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa mixi fen naxan mixi faxaxie rawɔyɛnma. Wo naxa bira sematoee fɔxɔ ra, xa na mu a ra wo findima sɛniyɛntaree nan na. Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.»

sentences.english: Get up from your seats before the white-haired, and give honour to the old, and let the fear of your God be before you: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa mixi mɔxie binya, naxee xunsɛxɛ bara fiixɛ. Wo xa gaaxu wo Marigi Ala ya ra. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: And if a man from another country is living in your land with you, do not make life hard for him;
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa mixi rawali a ɲaaxi ra, naxee kelixi ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛ e xa sabati wo xa bɔxi kui.

sentences.english: Let him be to you as one of your countrymen and have love for him as for yourself; for you were living in a strange land, in the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na xɔɲɛ mɔɔli rasɛnɛ alɔ wo ngaxakerenyi. Wo xa a xanu alɔ wo wo yɛtɛ xanuma ki naxɛ. Wo fan nu na xɔɲɛya nan kui Misira bɔxi ma. Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.»

sentences.english: Do not make false decisions in questions of yard-sticks and weights and measures.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa tinxintareya yo raba, kiiti sade, se kuyɛya maniyade, se binyɛ maniyade, se rafe daaxi maniyade.

sentences.english: Have true scales, true weights and measures for all things: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt;
sentences.susu: Wo xa sikeeli xa kamali. Wo se maniyase kamalixie rawali. Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala, naxan wo raminixi Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: You are to keep all my rules and my decisions and do them: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa n ma sɛriyɛ nun n ma yaamari birin nabatu. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Again, say to the children of Israel, If any man of the children of Israel, or any other man living in Israel, gives his offspring to Molech, he is certainly to be put to death: he is to be stoned by the people of the land;
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, xa Isirayilaka nde, xa na mu a ra xɔɲɛ nde naxan sabatixi Isirayila bɔxi ma, a xa di nde ba sɛrɛxɛ ra Mɔlɔkɔ kuye bɛ, ɲama xa na kanyi magɔnɔ gɛmɛe ra han a xa faxa.

sentences.english: And my face will be turned against that man, and he will be cut off from his people; because he has given his offspring to Molech, making my holy place unclean, and making my holy name common.
sentences.susu: N tan fan gbilenma nɛ na mixi fɔxɔ ra, n a ramini ɲama ya ma, barima a bara n ma yire sɛniyɛnxi yelebu, a bara n xili sɛniyɛnxi kana na sɛrɛxɛ mɔɔli ra Mɔlɔkɔ kuye bɛ.

sentences.english: And if the people of the land do not take note of that man when he gives his offspring to Molech, and do not put him to death,
sentences.susu: Xa ɲama a ya raxi na fe ma, e tondi mixi faxade, naxan a xa di baxi sɛrɛxɛ ra Mɔlɔkɔ bɛ,

sentences.english: Then my face will be turned against him and his family, and he and all those who do evil with him will be cut off from among their people.
sentences.susu: n tan gbilenma nɛ na mixi nun a xabilɛ fɔxɔ ra, n nee keri e xa ɲama ya ma, a nun mixi birin naxee n yanfama Mɔlɔkɔ kuye xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And whoever goes after those who make use of spirits and wonder-workers, doing evil with them, against him will my face be turned, and he will be cut off from among his people.
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi nde n yanfa, a bira sematoe fɔxɔ ra, a nun mixi naxan mixi faxaxie rawɔyɛnma, n gbilenma na kanyi fɔxɔ ra, n a keri a xa ɲama ya ma.

sentences.english: So make and keep yourselves holy, for I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo ɲɛrɛ sɛniyɛnyi kui, alako wo xa sɛniyɛn, barima Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.

sentences.english: And keep my rules and do them: I am the Lord, who make you holy.
sentences.susu: Wo xa n ma yaamarie rabatu, wo xa e ratinmɛ. Alatala nan n na, naxan wo rasɛniyɛnma.»

sentences.english: Every man cursing his father or his mother is certainly to be put to death; because of his curse on his father or his mother, his blood will be on him.
sentences.susu: «Naxan yo a baba danka, xa na mu a ra a nga, wo xa na kanyi faxa. A tan nan a faxa fe ragirixi, barima a bara a baba danka, xa na mu a ra a nga.»

sentences.english: And if a man has sex relations with another man's wife, even the wife of his neighbour, he and she are certainly to be put to death.
sentences.susu: «Xa xɛmɛ nde yɛnɛ raba a malan boore xa ginɛ ra, na xɛmɛ nun na ginɛ xa faxa e xa langoeɲa xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And the man who has sex relations with his father's wife has put shame on his father: the two of them are to be put to death; their blood will be on them.
sentences.susu: «Xa xɛmɛ nde kafu nun a baba xa ginɛ ra, a bara fe ɲaaxi raba a baba ra. Wo xa na xɛmɛ nun na ginɛ faxa e xa yunubi xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And if a man has sex relations with his son's wife, the two of them are to be put to death: it is unnatural; their blood will be on them.
sentences.susu: «Xa xɛmɛ nde kafu nun a xa di xa ginɛ ra, wo xa e firinyi birin faxa na yunubi xa fe ra, barima na fe mɔɔli mu fan feo.»

sentences.english: And if a man has sex relations with a man, the two of them have done a disgusting thing: let them be put to death; their blood will be on them.
sentences.susu: «Xa xɛmɛ nde kafu nun xɛmɛ gbɛtɛ ra alɔ xɛmɛ darixi a raba ra ginɛ ra ki naxɛ, wo xa e firinyi birin faxa na fe xɔnxi xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And if a man takes as wife a woman and her mother, it is an act of shame; let them be burned with fire, all three of them, so that there may be no shame among you.
sentences.susu: «Xa xɛmɛ nde kafu nun ginɛ ra nun na xa di ginɛ ra, e bara fe ɲaaxi raba. Wo xa e gan tɛ ra, xɛmɛ nun ginɛ, alako na fe xɔnxi mɔɔli naxa lu wo tagi.»

sentences.english: And if a man has sex relations with a beast, let him be put to death, and let the beast be put to destruction.
sentences.susu: «Xa xɛmɛ nde kafu nun sube ra, wo xa na xɛmɛ nun na sube birin faxa.»

sentences.english: And if a woman goes near a beast and has sex relations with it, you will put an end to the woman and the beast: their blood will be on them.
sentences.susu: «Xa ginɛ nde a maso sube ra kafu booreɲa ra, wo xa na ginɛ nun na sube faxa na fe ɲaaxi xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And if a man takes his sister, daughter of his father or his mother, and has sex relations with her and she with him, it is an act of shame: they are to be cut off before the children of their people; he has had sex relations with his sister, and his sin will be on him.
sentences.susu: «Xa xɛmɛ nde kafu nun a maaginɛ ra, a baba xa di ginɛ, xa na mu a ra a nga xa di ginɛ, fe mayaagixi nan a ra. Wo xa e keri e xa ɲama ya ma, barima xɛmɛ bara kafu nun a maaginɛ ra. Na kote xa lu a xun ma.»

sentences.english: And if a man has sex relations with a woman at the time when she is unwell, he has seen her fountain and she has let the fountain of her blood be uncovered, and the two of them are to be cut off from among their people.
sentences.susu: «Xa xɛmɛ nde kafu nun ginɛ ra naxan na a xa kike wali kui, a wuli naxa mini kɛnɛ ma. E firinyi birin xa keri ɲama ya ma na fe ma.»

sentences.english: And you may not have sex connection with your mother's sister or your father's sister, for they are his near relations: their sin will be on them.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa kafu nun wo nga xunya, xa na mu a ra wo nga taara ra, xa na mu a ra wo baba maaginɛ ra, barima wo bariboore nan e ra. Naxan na mɔɔli rabama na kote xa lu a xun ma.»

sentences.english: And if a man has sex relations with the wife of his father's brother, he has put shame on his father's brother: their sin will be on them; till the day of their death they will have no children.
sentences.susu: «Xa xɛmɛ nde kafu nun a baba xunya xa ginɛ ra, xa na mu a ra a baba taara xa ginɛ ra, e na kote xaninma nɛ. E birin fama faxade dibaritareɲa nan kui.»

sentences.english: And if a man takes his brother's wife, it is an unclean act; he has put shame on his brother; they will have no children.
sentences.susu: «Xa xɛmɛ nde kafu nun a xunya xa ginɛ ra, xa na mu a ra a kafu nun a taara xa ginɛ ra, a bara fe sɛniyɛntare raba. E birin fama faxade dibaritareɲa nan kui.»

sentences.english: So then, keep my rules and my decisions and do them, so that the land which I am giving you as your resting-place may not violently send you out again.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa n ma sɛriyɛ nun n ma yaamari birin nabatu, wo xa na birin naba, alako wo mu fama keride ki naxɛ bɔxi ma n wo rasabatima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And do not keep the rules of the nations which I am driving out before you; for they did all these things, and for that reason my soul was turned against them.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa bira na bɔxi sie xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra, n fama naxee keride wo ya ra. E naxan nabama na mu rafanxi n ma feo.

sentences.english: But I have said to you, You will take their land and I will give it to you for your heritage, a land flowing with milk and honey: I am the Lord your God who have made you separate from all other peoples.
sentences.susu: N bara a fala wo bɛ na bɔxi findima wo gbe ra. N bara na bɔxi fi wo ma, xiɲɛ nun kumi gbegbe na dɛnnaxɛ. Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala, naxan wo sugandixi sie tagi.

sentences.english: So then, make division between the clean beast and the unclean, and between the clean bird and the unclean: do not make yourselves disgusting by any beast or bird or anything which goes flat on the earth, which has been marked by me as unclean for you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sube raharamuxie nun sube radaxaxie tagi rasa, e nun xɔni raharamuxie nun xɔni radaxaxie, alako wo naxa findi sɛniyɛntaree ra e saabui ra. N bara tɔnyi dɔxɔ na subee, na xɔnie, nun na bɔximasee ra. E mu sɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: And you are to be holy to me; for I the Lord am holy and have made you separate from the nations, so that you may be my people.
sentences.susu: Wo xa findi n ma ɲama sɛniyɛnxi ra, barima n tan Alatala nan sɛniyɛn. N bara wo sugandi sie tagi, alako wo xa findi n gbe ra.»

sentences.english: Any man or woman who makes use of spirits, or who is a wonder-worker, is to be put to death: they are to be stoned with stones: their blood will be on them.
sentences.susu: «Mixi yo naxan mixi faxaxie rawɔyɛnma, xa na mu a ra a findi sematoe ra, wo xa a magɔnɔ gɛmɛe ra han a xa faxa. A tan nan a faxa fe ragirixi.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Say to the priests, the sons of Aaron, Let no man make himself unclean for the dead among his people;
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ, «A fala Haruna xa di sɛrɛxɛdubɛe bɛ, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa a yɛtɛ findi sɛniyɛntare ra a xa mixi nde fure saabui ra,

sentences.english: But only for his near relations, for his mother or his father, his son or his daughter, and his brother;
sentences.susu: fo a xa mixi kɛndɛ nde alɔ a nga, a baba, a xa di xɛmɛ, a xa di ginɛ, a xunya xɛmɛma, a taara xɛmɛma,

sentences.english: And for his sister, a virgin, for she is his near relation and has had no husband, he may make himself unclean.
sentences.susu: nun a maaginɛ, ginɛdimɛdi na naxan na, a mu dɔxɔxi xɛmɛ taa sinden, a na a xɔnyi. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ na din e fure ra, a findima nɛ mixi sɛniyɛntare ra.

sentences.english: But let him, being a chief among his people, not make himself unclean in such a way as to put shame on himself.
sentences.susu: A mu lanma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa findi sɛniyɛntare ra a xa ginɛ fure xa fe ra, xa na mu a ra a xa ginɛ xa mixie fure xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: They are not to have their hair cut off for the dead, or the hair on their chins cut short, or make cuts in their flesh.
sentences.susu: «Xa ɲɔnfe bara a li, a mu lanma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa a xunyi bi, xa na mu a ra a dɛ xabee sɛɛti maxaba, xa na mu a ra a fate maxaba.

sentences.english: Let them be holy to their God and not make the name of their God common; for the fire offerings of the Lord and the bread of their God are offered by them, and they are to be holy.
sentences.susu: E xa sɛniyɛn e Marigi Ala bɛ. E naxa e Marigi Ala xili kana, barima e tan nan sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie bama n tan Alatala bɛ, naxee luxi alɔ n ma donse. E lan e xa sɛniyɛn na nan ma.

sentences.english: They may not take as wife a loose or common woman, or one who has been put away by her husband: for the priest is holy to his God.
sentences.susu: A mu lanma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa langoe ginɛ dɔxɔ, xa na mu a ra ginɛ futi kanɛ, xa na mu a ra ginɛ xɛmɛ mɛɛxi naxan na. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ tan sɛniyɛn a Marigi Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: And he is to be holy in your eyes, for by him the bread of your God is offered; he is to be holy in your eyes, for I the Lord, who make you holy, am holy.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon mixi sɛniyɛnxi ra, barima a tan nan sɛrɛxɛe fima Ala ma naxee luxi alɔ donse. Wo xa a kolon a sɛniyɛn, barima n tan Alatala sɛniyɛn, n tan naxan wo rasɛniyɛnma.

sentences.english: And if the daughter of a priest makes herself common and by her loose behaviour puts shame on her father, let her be burned with fire.
sentences.susu: Xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa di ginɛ nde a yɛtɛ rayaagima findife ra langoe ra, a bara a baba rayaagi. A lanma na ginɛ xa gan tɛ ra.»

sentences.english: And he who is the chief priest among his brothers, on whose head the holy oil has been put, who is marked out to put on the holy robes, may not let his hair go loose or have his clothing out of order as a sign of sorrow.
sentences.susu: «Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi naxan sugandixi a ngaxakerenyie tagi, e ture sɛniyɛnxi sa a ma, e dugi sɛniyɛnxi ragoro a ma, na naxa a xunsɛxɛ kana, a naxa a xa dugi ibɔɔ.

sentences.english: He may not go near any dead body or make himself unclean for his father or his mother;
sentences.susu: A naxa so fure xun ma, a naxa findi sɛniyɛntare ra fure xa fe ra, hali a baba xa na mu a ra a nga.

sentences.english: He may not go out of the holy place or make the holy place of his God common; for the crown of the holy oil of his God is on him: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: A naxa mini yire sɛniyɛnxi kui, a naxa a Marigi Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira manɔxɔ, barima n tan Ala nan a sugandixi, ture sɛniyɛnxi saxi a xunyi ma. Alatala nan n na.

sentences.english: And let him take as his wife one who has not had relations with a man.
sentences.susu: A xa ginɛdimɛdi dɔxɔ ginɛ ra.

sentences.english: A widow, or one whose husband has put her away, or a common woman of loose behaviour, may not be the wife of a priest; but let him take a virgin from among his people.
sentences.susu: A naxa kaaɲɛ ginɛ dɔxɔ, a naxa ginɛ rabɛɲinxi dɔxɔ, a naxa langoe dɔxɔ, a naxa ginɛ dɔxɔ ginɛdimɛdi mu naxan na. A xa ginɛdimɛdi tongo ginɛ ra a xa mixie ya ma,

sentences.english: And he may not make his seed unclean among his people, for I the Lord have made him holy.
sentences.susu: alako a naxa a bɔnsɔɛ rayaagi. Alatala nan n na naxan a rasɛniyɛnma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to Aaron, If a man of your family, in any generation, is damaged in body, let him not come near to make the offering of the bread of his God.
sentences.susu: «A fala Haruna bɛ, mixi mabɛnxi yo naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali raba, a sɛrɛxɛ sa sɛrɛxɛbade ma n tan Ala bɛ. Na mu lanma abadan.

sentences.english: For any man whose body is damaged may not come near: one who is blind, or has not the use of his legs, or one who has a broken nose or any unnatural growth,
sentences.susu: Mabɛnyie nan ya naxee mu daxa e xa e maso sɛrɛxɛbade ra: naxan ya mu fan, naxan mu nɔma ɲɛrɛde a fanyi ra, naxan salonse nde kanaxi,

sentences.english: Or a man with broken feet or hands,
sentences.susu: naxan bɛlɛxɛ, xa na mu a ra sanyi giraxi,

sentences.english: Or one whose back is bent, or one who is unnaturally small, or one who has a damaged eye, or whose skin is diseased, or whose sex parts are damaged;
sentences.susu: naxan kuntinxi, naxan xa kuyɛ mu kamalixi, naxan ya mu fanxi, fate kiri fure na naxan ma, nun xɛmɛ banaxi.

sentences.english: No man of the offspring of Aaron whose body is damaged in any way may come near to give the fire offerings of the Lord: he is damaged, he may not come near to make the offerings.
sentences.susu: Mabɛnyi yo fatan sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Haruna xabilɛ ra, a naxa a maso n tan Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade ra sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi bafe ra a Marigi Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: He may take of the bread of God, the holy and the most holy;
sentences.susu: A nɔma n tan Ala xa donse sɛniyɛnxi mɔɔli birin donde,

sentences.english: But he may not go inside the veil or come near the altar, because he is damaged; and he may not make my holy places common; for I the Lord have made them holy.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ a mu lan a xa a maso yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante xa dugi ra, xa na mu a ra sɛrɛxɛbade ra. A naxa n ma yire sɛniyɛnxi xili kana, barima Alatala nan n na, naxan a rasɛniyɛnma.»

sentences.english: These are the words which Moses said to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa naxa na masenyi ti Haruna, a xa die, nun Isirayilaka birin bɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Give orders to Aaron and to his sons to keep themselves separate from the holy things of the children of Israel which they give to me, and not to make my holy name common: I am the Lord,
sentences.susu: «A fala Haruna nun a xa die bɛ, e xa Isirayilakae xa sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxie ba a ba ki ma, barima e nee fima n tan nan ma. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxa n xili sɛniyɛnxi kana. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: Say to them, If any man of all your seed through all your generations, being unclean, comes near the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to the Lord, he will be cut off from before me: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: «A fala e bɛ, xa e bɔnsɔɛ mixi nde sa findi sɛniyɛntare ra, a naxa a maso Isirayilakae xa sɛrɛxɛ ra e naxee fima n tan Alatala ma, na kanyi kerima nɛ n ya i. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: No man of the seed of Aaron who is a leper, or who has a flow from his body, may take of the holy food till he is clean. And any man touching anything which is unclean because of the dead, or any man whose seed goes from him;
sentences.susu: «Kunɛ fure na mixi yo ma Haruna bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, xa na mu a ra kɔrɔsila fure, na mu lan a xa sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxi don fo a xa gɛ sɛniyɛnde. A man mu lan mixi xa na raba xa a bara din mixi nde ra naxan bara din mixi fure ra. Xa ye sɛniyɛntare na minife mixi xɛmɛya kui, a mu lan a xa sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxi don.

sentences.english: Or anyone touching any unclean thing which goes flat on the earth, or someone by whom he may be made unclean in any way whatever;
sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde bara din bubuse ra, xa na mu a ra mixi sɛniyɛntare ra, na mu lan a xa sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxi don.

sentences.english: Any person touching any such unclean thing will be unclean till evening, and may not take of the holy food till his flesh has been bathed in water;
sentences.susu: Naxan na rabama, na kanyi findima sɛniyɛntare nan na han nunmare. Beenu a xa na sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxi don, a xa a fate maxa.

sentences.english: And when the sun has gone down he will be clean; and after that he may take part in the holy food, because it is his bread.
sentences.susu: Soge na goro, a bara sɛniyɛn, a nɔma sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxi donde sɔnɔn, barima a baloe na a ra.»

sentences.english: That which comes to a natural death, or is attacked by beasts, he may not take as food, for it will make him unclean: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa sube don naxan faxaxi a yɛtɛ ma. A man naxa sube don sube gbɛtɛ naxan faxaxi, alako a naxa findi sɛniyɛntare ra. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: So then, let them keep what I have put into their care, for fear that sin may come on them because of it, so causing their death because they have made it common: I am the Lord, who make them holy.
sentences.susu: «Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa n ma yaamarie rabatu e baloe xa fe ra, alako e naxa yunubi sɔtɔ, e fa faxa. Alatala nan n na, naxan e rasɛniyɛnma.

sentences.english: No outside person may take of the holy food, or one living as a guest in the priest's house, or a servant working for payment.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo naxa sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxi don xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ mu a ra. Hali sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa xɔɲɛ, xa na mu a ra a xa walikɛ mu lanma a xa a don.

sentences.english: But any person for whom the priest has given money, to make him his, may take of it with him; and those who come to birth in his house may take of his bread.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa konyi, a naxan sara kɔbiri ra, a nun na konyi xa denbaya tan nɔma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ baloe donde.

sentences.english: And if the daughter of a priest is married to an outside person she may not take of the holy things which are lifted up as offerings.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa di ginɛ naxan dɔxɔxi xɛmɛ Ala kolontare xɔn ma, naxa sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxi don.

sentences.english: But if a priest's daughter is a widow, or parted from her husband, and has no child, and has come back to her father's house as when she was a girl, she may take of her father's bread; but no outside person may do so.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa di ginɛ naxan findixi kaaɲɛ ginɛ ra, xa na mu a ra xɛmɛ mɛɛxi naxan na e mu di bari, a gbilen a baba xɔnyi alɔ a nu na naa ki naxɛ a dimɛdi ra, na ginɛ nɔma a baba baloe donde. Mixi yo naxan mu findi Isirayilaka ra, na mu lanma a xa na mɔɔli don.

sentences.english: And if a man takes the holy food in error, he will have to give the holy thing back to the priest, with the addition of a fifth part.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde sa sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxi don kolontareya ma, a lan a xa a ɲɔxɔɛ fi kɔbiri ra, a man xa nde sa na fari. Na findima kɔbiri naxan na, a na donse sare nan itaxunma dɔxɔ suuli ra, a fa dɔxɔ keren ba a ra, a na so sɛrɛxɛdubɛ yi ra.

sentences.english: And they may not make common the holy things which the children of Israel give to the Lord,
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxa fe raba n tan Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxie ra, a mu lan naxan xa raba

sentences.english: So causing sin to come on them when they take their holy things for food: I am the Lord who make them holy.
sentences.susu: alako e naxa yunubi sɔtɔ na sɛrɛxɛe xa fe ra e naxee donxi. Alatala nan n na, naxan e rasɛniyɛnma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to Aaron and to his sons and to all the children of Israel, If any man of the children of Israel, or of another nation living in Israel, makes an offering, given because of an oath or freely given to the Lord for a burned offering;
sentences.susu: «A fala Haruna, a xa die, nun Isirayilakae birin bɛ, Isirayilakae birin, a nun xɔɲɛ naxee sabatixi Isirayila bɔxi ma, mixi naxan sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi bama n tan Alatala bɛ laayidi nde rakamalife ra, xa na mu a ra a yɛtɛ ɲanige rabafe ra,

sentences.english: So that it may be pleasing to the Lord, let him give a male, without any mark, from among the oxen or the sheep or the goats.
sentences.susu: a lan a xa tuura nan ba, xa na mu a ra yɛxɛɛ kontonyi, xa na mu a ra sikɔtɛ, lanyuru mu na naxan ma.

sentences.english: But anything which has a mark you may not give; it will not make you pleasing to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa xuruse yo ba lanyuru na naxan ma, barima n tan Ala mu na mɔɔli rasuxuma.

sentences.english: And whoever makes a peace-offering to the Lord, in payment of an oath or as a free offering, from the herd or the flock, if it is to be pleasing to the Lord, let it be free from any mark or damage.
