sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde wama xuruse xungbe, xa na mu a ra xuruse lanma bafe xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ra n tan Alatala bɛ, laayidi nde rakamalife ra, xa na mu a ra ɲanige rabafe ra, na xuruse fate xa fan, lanyuru yo naxa lu a ma, xa na mu a ra n tan Ala mu a rasuxuma.

sentences.english: Anything blind or broken or damaged or having any disease or any mark on it may not be offered to the Lord; you may not make an offering of it by fire on the altar to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa xuruse yo ba naxan ya mu fan, naxan maxɔnɔxi, naxan mabɛnxi, fure na naxan kiri ma. Wo naxa na mɔɔli sa n tan Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade fari, a xa findi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra.

sentences.english: An ox or a lamb which has more or less than its natural parts, may be given as a free offering; but it will not be taken in payment of an oath.
sentences.susu: I nɔma ninge, xa na mu a ra yɛxɛɛ kɛɲa ɲaaxi bade ɲanige sɛrɛxɛ ra, kɔnɔ i mu nɔma na bade laayidi rakamali sɛrɛxɛ ra de.

sentences.english: An animal which has its sex parts damaged or crushed or broken or cut, may not be offered to the Lord; such a thing may not be done anywhere in your land.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa xuruse banaxi, xɛmɛya kanaxi, xa na mu a ra xɛmɛya mu naxan bɛ, ba sɛrɛxɛ ra n tan Alatala bɛ. Wo naxa na mɔɔli ba sɛrɛxɛ ra wo xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And from one who is not an Israelite you may not take any of these for an offering to the Lord; for they are unclean, there is a mark on them, and the Lord will not be pleased with them.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa na xuruse mɔɔli rasuxu xɔɲɛe yi ra, wo xa e ba sɛrɛxɛ ra wo Marigi Ala bɛ, barima e fate mu fanxi, e mu kamalixi. N tan Ala mu nee rasuxuma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: When an ox or a sheep or a goat is given birth, let it be with its mother for seven days; and after the eighth day it may be taken as an offering made by fire to the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Ninge yɔrɛ, yɛxɛɛ yɔrɛ, nun si yɔrɛ na bari, e xa lu e nga bun ma xi solofere, beenu e xa findi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra n tan Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: A cow or a sheep may not be put to death with its young on the same day.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa ninge, xa na mu a ra yɛxɛɛ, nun a xa di kɔn naxaba lɔxɔɛ keren kui.»

sentences.english: And when you make an offering of praise to the Lord, make it in a way which is pleasing to him.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa tantui sɛrɛxɛ ba n tan Alatala bɛ a ba ki ma alako n xa a suxu.

sentences.english: Let it be used for food on the same day; do not keep any part of it till the morning: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na sɛrɛxɛ don na lɔxɔɛ yati, a naxa lu han gɛɛsɛgɛ. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: So then, keep my orders and do them: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa n ma yaamarie rabatu, wo xa e suxu. Alatala nan n na.

sentences.english: And do not make my holy name common; so that it may be kept holy by the children of Israel: I am the Lord who make you holy,
sentences.susu: Wo naxa n xili sɛniyɛnxi kana. Isirayilakae birin xa a kolon n sɛniyɛn. Alatala nan n na, naxan wo rasɛniyɛnma.

sentences.english: Who took you out of the land of Egypt that I might be your God: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: N tan nan wo ramini Misira bɔxi ra, n xa findi wo Marigi Ala ra. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel, These are the fixed feasts of the Lord, which you will keep for holy meetings: these are my feasts.
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, n tan Alatala xa sali lɔxɔɛe nan ya, naxee sɛniyɛnxi wo bɛ.

sentences.english: On six days work may be done; but the seventh day is a special day of rest, a time for worship; you may do no sort of work: it is a Sabbath to the Lord wherever you may be living.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wali xi senni, kɔnɔ xi solofere nde findixi malabui lɔxɔɛ nan na, malanyi sɛniyɛnxi rabama lɔxɔɛ naxɛ. Wo naxa wali yo raba na lɔxɔɛ. Na findixi n tan Alatala nan gbe ra. Wo xa na sɛriyɛ suxu wo sabatide birin.»

sentences.english: These are the fixed feasts of the Lord, the holy days of worship which you will keep at their regular times.
sentences.susu: «N tan Alatala xa sali lɔxɔɛ gbɛtɛe nan ya, wo ɲama maxilima lɔxɔɛ naxee ma:

sentences.english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at nightfall, is the Lord's Passover;
sentences.susu: Kike singe, xi fu nun naani nde, soge dula tɛmui, Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali sɛrɛxɛ xa ba n tan Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And on the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread; for seven days let your food be unleavened bread.
sentences.susu: N tan Alatala xa Taami Lɛbinitare Sali fɔlɔma na kike xi fu nun suuli nde lɔxɔɛ nɛ. Wo xa taami lɛbinitaree don na xi solofere bun ma.

sentences.english: On the first day you will have a holy meeting; you may do no sort of field-work.
sentences.susu: Na sali xi singe kui, wo xa malanyi sɛniyɛnxi raba. Wo naxa wali yo raba na lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: And every day for seven days you will give a burned offering to the Lord; and on the seventh day there will be a holy meeting; you may do no field-work.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɛrɛxɛe gan daaxie ba n tan Alatala bɛ na xi solofere bun ma. Xi solofere nde lɔxɔɛ, wo man xa malanyi sɛniyɛnxi raba. Wo naxa wali yo raba na lɔxɔɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel, When you have come to the land which I will give you, and have got in the grain from its fields, take some of the first-fruits of the grain to the priest;
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, wo na so bɔxi ma n naxan fima wo ma, wo na xɛ xaba, wo xa a xiri singe xanin sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xɔn.

sentences.english: And let the grain be waved before the Lord, so that you may be pleasing to him; on the day after the Sabbath let it be waved by the priest.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa na masen n tan Alatala bɛ malabui lɔxɔɛ dangi xanbi, alako n xa a suxu wo bɛ.

sentences.english: And on the day of the waving of the grain, you are to give a male lamb of the first year, without any mark, for a burned offering to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo na xiri singe masenma n tan Alatala bɛ lɔxɔɛ naxɛ, wo man xa yɛxɛɛ fanyi ɲɛ keren daaxi ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra n bɛ,

sentences.english: And let the meal offering with it be two tenth parts of an ephah of the best meal mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the Lord for a sweet smell; and the drink offering with it is to be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.
sentences.susu: a nun sansi xɔri dinxi konbo ya keren naxan masunbuxi ture ra. Na findima sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra n tan Alatala bɛ naxan xiri rafan n ma. Wo man xa wɛni litiri keren ba wɛni sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: And you may take no bread or dry grain or new grain for food till the very day on which you have given the offering for your God: this is a rule for ever through all your generations wherever you are living.
sentences.susu: Wo naxan sɔtɔ xɛ xaba tɛmui, wo naxa sese don, taami, tɔnsɔɛ ganxi, nun sansi xɔri ra, beenu wo xa na sɛrɛxɛ ba wo Marigi Ala bɛ. Sɛriyɛ nan na ki wo bɔnsɔɛ bɛ wo sabatide birin. Na mu kanama abadan.»

sentences.english: And let seven full weeks be numbered from the day after the Sabbath, the day when you give the grain for the wave offering;
sentences.susu: «Fɔlɔ malabui lɔxɔɛ kuye iba ma, wo na xiri singe lintanma Alatala ya i sɛrɛxɛ ra lɔxɔɛ naxɛ, lɔxun solofere xa dangi.

sentences.english: Let fifty days be numbered, to the day after the seventh Sabbath; then you are to give a new meal offering to the Lord.
sentences.susu: A xi tongo suuli nde, malabui lɔxɔɛ xi solofere nde kuye iba, wo man xa sɛrɛxɛ ba n tan Alatala bɛ daxamui nɛɛnɛ ra.

sentences.english: Take from your houses two cakes of bread, made of a fifth part of an ephah of the best meal, cooked with leaven, to be waved for first-fruits to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa fa taami firin na wo naxan lintanma n tan Alatala ya i sɛrɛxɛ ra, kelife ra wo xɔnyie. Wo xa e yailan sansi xɔri luxutaxi konbo ya keren na, wo lɛbini sunbu a ra. Bogise singe sɛrɛxɛ nan na ki n tan Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And with the bread, take seven lambs of the first year, without any marks, and one ox and two male sheep, to be a burned offering to the Lord, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, an offering of a sweet smell made by fire to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo man xa yɛxɛɛ fanyi ɲɛ keren daaxi solofere sa na taami fari, tuura lanma keren, nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi firin naxee bama sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie ra. Wo man xa sansi xɔri luxutaxi nun wɛni sɛrɛxɛ sa nee fari. Nee gan xiri nafan n tan Alatala ma.

sentences.english: And you are to give one male goat for a sin-offering and two male lambs of the first year for peace-offerings.
sentences.susu: Wo man xa sikɔtɛ keren ba yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, a nun yɛxɛɛ firin ɲɛ keren daaxi, naxee findima xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: And these will be waved by the priest, with the bread of the first-fruits, for a wave offering to the Lord, with the two lambs: they will be holy to the Lord for the priest.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ na birin lintanma n tan Alatala ya i sɛrɛxɛ ra, na taami singee, nun na yɛxɛɛ firinyie. E birin fima n tan Alatala nan ma, e fa lu sɛrɛxɛdubɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: And on the same day, let it be given out that there will be a holy meeting for you: you may do no field-work on that day: it is a rule for ever through all your generations wherever you are living.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ wo xa malanyi sɛniyɛnxi raba. Wo naxa wali yo raba na lɔxɔɛ. Sɛriyɛ na a ra wo bɔnsɔɛ bɛ yire birin abadan.

sentences.english: And when you get in the grain from your land, do not let all the grain at the edges of the field be cut, and do not take up the grain which has been dropped in the field; let that be for the poor, and for the man from another country: I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo na xɛ xaba wo xɔnyi, wo naxa a tuxuie xaba. Baloe naxan birama bɔxi ma, wo xa na lu naa setaree bɛ, a nun mixie bɛ naxee kelixi ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛe ma. Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel, In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, let there be a special day of rest for you, a day of memory, marked by the blowing of horns, a meeting for worship.
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, kike solofere nde, xi singe, wo xa wo malabu na lɔxɔɛ, wo xa ɲama maxili sara xui ra, wo malanyi sɛniyɛnxi raba.

sentences.english: Do no field-work and give to the Lord an offering made by fire.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wali yo raba na lɔxɔɛ, wo xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie ba n tan Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: The tenth day of this seventh month is the day for the taking away of sin; let it be a holy day of worship; you are to keep from pleasure, and give to the Lord an offering made by fire.
sentences.susu: «Kike solofere nde, xi fu nde xa findi Xunsare Lɔxɔɛ ra. Wo xa malanyi sɛniyɛnxi raba, wo xa sunyi suxu, wo xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie ba n tan Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And on that day you may do no sort of work, for it is a day of taking away sin, to make you clean before the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wali yo raba na lɔxɔɛ, barima Xunsare Lɔxɔɛ na a ra, wo xun sarama wo Marigi Alatala ya i lɔxɔɛ naxɛ.

sentences.english: For any person, whoever he may be, who takes his pleasure on that day will be cut off from his people.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan tondima sunyi suxude na lɔxɔɛ, na kanyi raminima nɛ a xa ɲama ya ma.

sentences.english: And if any person, whoever he may be, on that day does any sort of work, I will send destruction on him from among his people.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan wali yo rabama na lɔxɔɛ, n a sɔntɔma nɛ a xa ɲama tagi.

sentences.english: You may not do any sort of work: this is an order for ever through all your generations wherever you may be living.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wali yo raba. Sɛriyɛ na a ra wo bɔnsɔɛ birin bɛ yire birin, naxan mu kanama abadan.

sentences.english: Let this be a Sabbath of special rest to you, and keep yourselves from all pleasure; on the ninth day of the month at nightfall from evening to evening, let this Sabbath be kept.
sentences.susu: Na findima malabui lɔxɔɛ nan na wo bɛ. Wo xa sunyi suxu fɔlɔfe na kike xi solomanaani lɔxɔɛ nunmare ra, han a xi fu lɔxɔɛ nunmare ra.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel, On the fifteenth day of this seventh month let the feast of tents be kept to the Lord for seven days.
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, kike solofere nde xi fu nun suuli nde, Bage Ti Sali fɔlɔma, a bu xi solofere n tan Alatala xa binyɛ bun ma.

sentences.english: On the first day there will be a holy meeting: do no field-work.
sentences.susu: Sali xi singe malanyi sɛniyɛnxi rabama nɛ. Wo naxa wali yo raba na lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: Every day for seven days give an offering made by fire to the Lord; and on the eighth day there is to be a holy meeting, when you are to give an offering made by fire to the Lord; this is a special holy day: you may do no field-work on that day.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie ba n tan Alatala bɛ xi solofere bun ma. Xi solomasaxan nde wo xa malanyi sɛniyɛnxi raba. Wo xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie ba n tan Alatala bɛ. Sali xungbe na a ra, wo naxa wali yo raba.»

sentences.english: These are the fixed feasts of the Lord, to be kept by you as holy days of worship, for making an offering by fire to the Lord; a burned offering, a meal offering, an offering of beasts, and drink offerings; every one on its special day;
sentences.susu: «N tan Alatala xa sali lɔxɔɛ xungbee nan na ki wo bɛ. Wo xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie, sansi xɔri sɛrɛxɛe, nun wɛni sɛrɛxɛe ba a ba tɛmui.

sentences.english: In addition to the Sabbaths of the Lord, and in addition to the things you give and the oaths you make and the free offerings to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa n tan Alatala xa malabui lɔxɔɛe rabatu, wo xa xanunteya sɛrɛxɛe, wo xa laayidi sɛrɛxɛe, a nun wo xa ɲanige sɛrɛxɛe wo naxee fima n ma, wo xa e rakamali.»

sentences.english: But on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have got in all the fruits of the land, you will keep the feast of the Lord for seven days: the first day will be a Sabbath, and the eighth day the same.
sentences.susu: «Kike solofere nde xi fu nun suuli nde, wo gɛ xanbi wo xa xɛe bogisee malande, wo xa sali raba n tan Alatala bɛ xi solofere bun ma. Sali xi singe nun a xi solomasaxan nde findixi malabui lɔxɔɛe nan na.

sentences.english: On the first day, take the fruit of fair trees, branches of palm-trees, and branches of thick trees and trees from the riverside, and be glad before the Lord for seven days.
sentences.susu: Sali xi singe, wo xa bogise fanyie ba sansi bilie kɔn na, tugi fɛnsɛe, nun wuri tofanyi ɲingie. Wo xa sɛɛwa wo Marigi Alatala ya i xi solofere bun ma.

sentences.english: And let this feast be kept before the Lord for seven days in the year: it is a rule for ever from generation to generation; in the seventh month let it be kept.
sentences.susu: Wo xa yi sali raba Alatala bɛ ɲɛ yo ɲɛ xi solofere bun ma. Sɛriyɛ na a ra wo bɔnsɔɛ birin bɛ naxan mu kanama abadan. Wo xa na sali raba kike solofere nde kui.

sentences.english: For seven days you will be living in tents; all those who are Israelites by birth are to make tents their living-places:
sentences.susu: Wo xa xi bagee kui na xi solofere bun ma. Isirayilakae birin xa xi bagee kui,

sentences.english: So that future generations may keep in mind how I gave the children of Israel tents as their living-places when I took them out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: alako wo bɔnsɔɛe xa a kolon a n a niyaxi nɛ wo benbae xa xi bagee kui n e ramini Misira bɔxi ra tɛmui naxɛ. Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.»

sentences.english: And Moses made clear to the children of Israel the orders about the fixed feasts of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa xa masenyi nan na ki, a naxan masen Isirayilakae bɛ Alatala xa salie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Give orders to the children of Israel to give you clean olive oil for the light, so that a light may be burning at all times,
sentences.susu: «Isirayilakae yamari, e xa fa oliwi ture fanyi ra i xɔn, alako lanpuie xa dɛxɛ tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Outside the veil of the ark in the Tent of meeting; let Aaron see that it is burning from evening till morning at all times before the Lord: it is a rule for ever through all your generations.
sentences.susu: Haruna xa a ɲɛngi sa lanpuie xɔn, naxee na hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, yire sɛniyɛnxi sɛɛti ma. Saatɛ kankira na na yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante nan kui, dugi gbakuxi a sode dɛ ra. A xa a niya lanpuie xa nu dɛxɛ n tan Alatala ya i tɛmui birin, kelife nunmare ra han gɛɛsɛgɛ. Sɛriyɛ na a ra wo bɔnsɔɛ bɛ abadan.

sentences.english: Let Aaron put the lights in order on the support before the Lord at all times.
sentences.susu: Haruna xa a ɲɛngi sa lanpuie xɔn naxee dɔxɔxi lanpui dɔxɔ se xɛɛma daaxie fari n tan Alatala ya i.»

sentences.english: And take the best meal and make twelve cakes of it, a fifth part of an ephah in every cake.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa taami fu nun firin yailan sansi xɔri luxutaxi fanyi ra, taami keren, sansi xɔri dinxi konbo ya keren.

sentences.english: And put them in two lines, six in a line, on the holy table before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa e sa safɛ firin, senni na sɛɛti keren, senni na sɛɛti boore, teebili fari n tan Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: And on the lines of cakes put clean sweet-smelling spices, for a sign on the bread, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa surayi fanyi sa taami safɛe sɛɛti ma, naxan fama gande taami ɲɔxɔɛ ra n tan Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: Every Sabbath day regularly, the priest is to put it in order before the Lord: it is offered for the children of Israel, an agreement made for ever.
sentences.susu: Taami xa sa teebili fari malabui lɔxɔɛ birin. Sɛriyɛ na a ra Isirayilakae bɛ abadan.

sentences.english: And it will be for Aaron and his sons; they are to take it for food in a holy place: it is the most holy of all the offerings made by fire to the Lord, a rule for ever.
sentences.susu: Haruna nun a xa die xa na taamie don yire sɛniyɛnxi, barima sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxi na a ra, naxee fixi Alatala ma a gan daaxi ra. Sɛriyɛ na a ra naxan mu kanama abadan.»

sentences.english: And a son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel and had a fight with a man of Israel by the tents;
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde mixi nde naxa so Isirayilakae ya ma. A nga findi Isirayilaka nan na, kɔnɔ a baba naxa findi Misiraka ra. Gere naxa bira a i na mixi nun Isirayilaka nde tagi.

sentences.english: And the son of the Israelite woman said evil against the holy Name, with curses; and they took him to Moses. His mother's name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.
sentences.susu: Na kui, na Isirayila ginɛ xa di naxa Alatala xili bɛxu, a a konbi. E naxa a xanin Annabi Munsa xɔn na fe ma. Na mixi nga xili nɛ Selomiti, Dibiri xa di ginɛ, Dana bɔnsɔɛ.

sentences.english: And they kept him shut up, till a decision might be given by the mouth of the Lord.
sentences.susu: E naxa a suxu a fanyi ra han Alatala yati naxa a xa fe ya iba e bɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Take the curser outside the tent-circle; and let all in whose hearing the words were said put their hands on his head, and let him be stoned by all the people.
sentences.susu: «Ɲama xa yi konbiti xanin ɲama yonkinde fari ma. Naxee na konbi mɛxi, nee xa e bɛlɛxɛe sa a xunyi, ɲama birin fa a magɔnɔ gɛmɛ ra han a faxa.

sentences.english: And say to the children of Israel, As for any man cursing God, his sin will be on his head.
sentences.susu: I xa a fala Isirayilakae bɛ, mixi yo naxan n tan Ala konbima, na yunubi kote luma a xun ma.

sentences.english: And he who says evil against the name of the Lord will certainly be put to death; he will be stoned by all the people; the man who is not of your nation and one who is an Israelite by birth, whoever says evil against the holy Name is to be put to death.
sentences.susu: Naxan na n tan Alatala xili bɛxu, ɲama birin xa a magɔnɔ gɛmɛ ra han a xa faxa. Xa a findi xɔɲɛ ra, xa a findi beka ra, a xa faxa barima a bara n tan Alatala bɛxu.»

sentences.english: And anyone who takes another's life is certainly to be put to death.
sentences.susu: «Mixi naxan na adamadi faxa, a fan xa faxa.

sentences.english: And anyone wounding a beast and causing its death, will have to make payment for it: a life for a life.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan na mixi nde xa xuruse faxa, a xa a ɲɔxɔɛ so a yi. Nii ɲɔxɔɛ xa fi nii ra.

sentences.english: And if a man does damage to his neighbour, as he has done, so let it be done to him;
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan na a boore maxɔnɔ, a fan xa maxɔnɔ na ki.

sentences.english: Wound for wound, eye for eye, tooth for tooth; whatever damage he has done, so let it be done to him.
sentences.susu: Maxɔnɛ ɲɔxɔɛ maxɔnɛ nan na. Ya ɲɔxɔɛ ya nan na, ɲinyi ɲɔxɔɛ na ɲinyi nan na. A xa maxɔnɔ alɔ a a rabaxi a boore ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: He who puts a beast to death will have to make payment for it; he who puts a man to death will himself be put to death.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan na mixi xa xuruse faxa, a xa a ɲɔxɔɛ fi, kɔnɔ mixi naxan na adamadi faxa, na kanyi fan xa faxa.

sentences.english: You are to have the same law for a man of another nation living among you as for an Israelite; for I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ keren na a ra wo birin bɛ, xɔɲɛe nun Isirayilakae. Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.»

sentences.english: And Moses said these words to the children of Israel, and they took the man who had been cursing outside the tent-circle and had him stoned. The children of Israel did as the Lord gave orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa to gɛ na masenyi tide Isirayilakae bɛ, ɲama naxa na konbiti xanin ɲama yonkinde fari ma, e a magɔnɔ gɛmɛ ra han a faxa. Na kui e naxa Alatala xa yaamari suxu alɔ Annabi Munsa a masenxi e bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses on Mount Sinai,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ Turusinina geya fari,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel, When you come into the land which I will give you, let the land keep a Sabbath to the Lord.
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, wo na so bɔxi kui n naxan fima wo ma, wo xa a lu bɔxi xa malabu n tan Alatala xa binyɛ bun ma.

sentences.english: For six years put seed into your land, and for six years give care to your vines and get in the produce of them;
sentences.susu: Wo xa xɛ wali suxu, wo xa mɛɛni wɛni bilie ma, wo xa e bogie ba. Wo xa na birin naba ɲɛ senni bun ma,

sentences.english: But let the seventh year be a Sabbath of rest for the land, a Sabbath to the Lord; do not put seed into your land or have your vines cut.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ ɲɛ solofere nde wo xa a lu bɔxi xa a malabu n tan Alatala xa binyɛ bun ma. Wo naxa xɛ wali raba, wo naxa fefe raba wɛni bilie ra na ɲɛ kui.

sentences.english: That which comes to growth of itself may not be cut, and the grapes of your uncared-for vines may not be taken off; let it be a year of rest for the land.
sentences.susu: Sansi bogi naxee bulama e yɛtɛ ma, wo naxa e xaba. Wɛni bogie naxee bogima e yɛtɛ ma, wo xa e lu naa barima malabui ɲɛ na a ra bɔxi bɛ.

sentences.english: And the Sabbath of the land will give food for you and your man-servant and your woman-servant and those working for payment, and for those of another country who are living among you;
sentences.susu: Bɔxi naxan naminima na malabui ɲɛ kui, wo birin nɔma na donde, wo tan, wo xa konyie, wo xa walikɛe, wo xa xɔɲɛe,

sentences.english: And for your cattle and the beasts on the land; all the natural increase of the land will be for food.
sentences.susu: wo xa xurusee, a nun burunyi sube naxee na bɔxi kui. Bɔxi naxan namini a yɛtɛ ra na ɲɛ ra, na nan findima wo baloe ra.»

sentences.english: And let seven Sabbaths of years be numbered to you, seven times seven years; even the days of seven Sabbaths of years, that is forty-nine years;
sentences.susu: «Wo xa malabui ɲɛ solofere kɔnti, ɲɛ tongo naani nun solomanaani, ɲɛ solofere dɔxɔ solofere.

sentences.english: Then let the loud horn be sounded far and wide on the tenth day of the seventh month; on the day of taking away sin let the horn be sounded through all your land.
sentences.susu: A kike solofere xi fu nde, wo xa sarae fe ɲama bɛ bɔxi birin kui, a findima Xunsare Lɔxɔɛ nan na.

sentences.english: And let this fiftieth year be kept holy, and say publicly that everyone in the land is free from debt: it is the Jubilee, and every man may go back to his heritage and to his family.
sentences.susu: Na ɲɛ tongo suuli nde xa findi xɔrɛya ɲɛ ra bɔxi mixi birin bɛ. Konyi birin xa xɔrɛya sɔtɔ, kankan xa gbilen a xɔnyi a xabilɛ ya ma.

sentences.english: Let this fiftieth year be the Jubilee: no seed may be planted, and that which comes to growth of itself may not be cut, and the grapes may not be taken from the uncared-for vines.
sentences.susu: Na ɲɛ tongo suuli nde findima Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ nan na wo bɛ. Wo naxa sansi xɔrie si, wo naxa sansi bogie nun wɛni bogie ba naxee bulama e yɛtɛ ma,

sentences.english: For it is the Jubilee, and it is holy to you; your food will be the natural increase of the field.
sentences.susu: Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ nan na ra, waxati sɛniyɛnxi na a ra wo bɛ. Bɔxi daxamui xa findi wo xa baloe ra.»

sentences.english: In this year of Jubilee, let every man go back to his heritage.
sentences.susu: «Na Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ kui, birin xa gbilen e xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And in the business of trading goods for money, do no wrong to one another.
sentences.susu: Xa wo bɔxi matima wo ngaxakerenyi ma, xa na mu a ra wo bara nde sara wo ngaxakerenyi ma, wo naxa wo boore tɔɔrɔ na kui.

sentences.english: Let your exchange of goods with your neighbours have relation to the number of years after the year of Jubilee, and the number of times the earth has given her produce.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na sara sare tinxinxi ra, naxan ɲɛe kɔntima kelife Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ waxati. Wo ngaxakerenyi xa na mati wo ma sɛriyɛ ki ma. A xa xɛ xaba ɲɛ kɔnti naxee luxi beenu Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ xa a li.

sentences.english: If the number of years is great, the price will be increased, and if the number of years is small, the price will be less, for it is the produce of a certain number of years which the man is giving you.
sentences.susu: Xa ɲɛ wuyaxi luxi, a sare xa mate na ki. Xa ɲɛ wuyaxi mu luxi, a sare xa magoro. Wo xa a mato xɛ xabama sanmaya yeri beenu Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ xa a li.

sentences.english: And do no wrong, one to another, but let the fear of your God be before you; for I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo boore tɔɔrɔ na kui. Wo xa gaaxu wo Marigi Ala ya ra. Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.»

sentences.english: So keep my rules and my decisions and do them, and you will be safe in your land.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa n ma sɛriyɛ suxu, wo xa n ma yaamarie rabatu, alako wo xa lu yi bɔxi ma bɔɲɛsa kui.

sentences.english: And the land will give her fruit, and you will have food in full measure and be safe in the land.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi daxamui fama wo wasade, wo man sabatima bɔɲɛsa kui.

sentences.english: And if you say, Where will our food come from in the seventh year, when we may not put in seed, or get in the increase
sentences.susu: Xa wo sa maxɔrinyi ti yi ki, ‹Xa won mu sese sima ɲɛ solofere nde kui, xa won mu sansi xabama na tɛmui, won baloma munse ra fa?›

sentences.english: Then I will send my blessing on you in the sixth year, and the land will give fruit enough for three years.
sentences.susu: N tan nan baraka ragoroma wo ma ɲɛ senni nde kui, naxan findima baloe ra wo bɛ ɲɛ saxan bun ma.

sentences.english: And in the eighth year you will put in your seed, and get your food from the old stores, till the fruit of the ninth year is ready.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sansi xɔri si ɲɛ solomasaxan nde kui, kɔnɔ wo donse ragataxi nan donma han ɲɛ solomanaani nde. Donse naxan nagataxi, na wo ralima nɛ han baloe nɛɛnɛ sa minima tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: No exchange of land may be for ever, for the land is mine, and you are as my guests, living with me for a time.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa bɔxi mati a xa lu wo boore yi ra abadan, barima n tan nan gbe bɔxi ra. Wo luxi nɛ alɔ xɔɲɛe naxee yigiyaxi n xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Wherever there is property in land, the owner is to have the right of getting it back.
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ ki ma, wo xa tin yi bɔxi birin xun xa sara.

sentences.english: If your brother becomes poor, and has to give up some of his land for money, his nearest relation may come and get back that which his brother has given up.
sentences.susu: Xa wo ngaxakerenyi nde a xa bɔxi mati a xa setareɲa ma, a bariboore nde xa na bɔxi matixi xun sara.

sentences.english: And if he has no one to get it back for him, and later he himself gets wealth and has enough money to get it back;
sentences.susu: Xa a bariboore mu na naxan nɔma na bɔxi xun sarade, kɔnɔ a tan naxa sa na xunsare fɛɛrɛ sɔtɔ a yɛtɛ ra,

sentences.english: Then let him take into account the years from the time when he gave it up, and make up the loss for the rest of the years to him who took it, and so get back his property.
sentences.susu: a xa bɔxi sare kɔnti sɛriyɛ ki ma, kelife a sara tɛmui, a fa na ɲɔxɔɛ ragbilen a sara mixi ma, alako a xa gbilen a xa bɔxi masɔtɔ ra.

sentences.english: But if he is not able to get it back for himself, then it will be kept by him who gave a price for it, till the year of Jubilee; and in that year it will go back to its first owner and he will have his property again.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa a mu na xunsare fɛɛrɛ sɔtɔ, na bɔxi xa lu a sara mixi yi ra han Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ ra. Na tɛmui bɔxi kanyi man xa gbilen a xa bɔxi masɔtɔ ra.»

sentences.english: And if a man gives his house in a walled town for money, he has the right to get it back for the space of a full year after he has given it up.
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi nde sa a xa banxi mati naxan na taa kui tɛtɛ rabilinxi naxan na, a nɔma na banxi xun sarade ɲɛ keren bun ma.

sentences.english: And if he does not get it back by the end of the year, then the house in the town will become the property of him who gave the money for it, and of his children for ever; it will not go from him in the year of Jubilee.
sentences.susu: Xa na banxi xun mu sara na ɲɛ kui, a luma nɛ a sara mixi nun a bɔnsɔɛ yi ra abadan. Hali Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ kui a sara mixi mu kelima naa.

sentences.english: But houses in small unwalled towns will be the same as property in the country; they may be got back, and they will go back to their owners in the year of Jubilee.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ banxi naxee tixi taa xunxurie kui, naxee mu rabilinxi tɛtɛ ra, nee luma alɔ bɔxi. E nɔma xun sarade. Naxan na mɔɔli sarama, a lanma a xa mini na banxi Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ ra.»

sentences.english: But the houses in the towns of the Levites may be got back by the Levites at any time.
sentences.susu: «Lewikae tan nɔma e xa banxie xun sarade e xa taae kui tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: And if a Levite does not give money to get back his property, his house in the town which was exchanged for money will come back to him in the year of Jubilee. For the houses of the towns of the Levites are their property among the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Naxan bara Lewika nde xa banxi sara, a minima nɛ na kui Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ tɛmui, barima banxi naxee na Lewikae xa taae kui, nee findixi Lewikae nan gbe ra Isirayila ɲama tagi.

sentences.english: But the land on the outskirts of their towns may not be exchanged for money, for it is their property for ever.
sentences.susu: Xɛ naxee na Lewikae xa taae rabilinyi, nee mu nɔma matide, barima Lewikae nan gbe e ra abadan.»

sentences.english: And if your brother becomes poor and is not able to make a living, then you are to keep him with you, helping him as you would a man from another country who is living among you.
sentences.susu: «Xa wo ngaxakerenyi nde findi setare ra, fɛɛrɛ mu na a yi ra a baloma naxan na, a lanma wo xa a mali alɔ xɔɲɛ, a xa lu wo fɛ ma.

sentences.english: Take no interest from him, in money or in goods, but have the fear of your God before you, and let your brother make a living among you.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa riba sa a xa doni xun ma. Wo xa gaaxu Wo Marigi Ala ya ra. Wo xa wo ngaxakerenyi yigiya.

sentences.english: Do not take interest on the money which you let him have or on the food which you give him.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa riba sa a xa doni xun ma, wo naxa riba sa a xa donse sare xun ma.

sentences.english: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt to give you the land of Canaan, that I might be your God.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala, naxan wo raminixi Misira bɔxi kui, n xa Kanaan bɔxi fi wo ma, n xa findi wo Marigi Ala ra.»

sentences.english: And if your brother becomes poor and gives himself to you for money, do not make use of him like a servant who is your property;
sentences.susu: «Xa wo ngaxakerenyi nde a yɛtɛ mati wo ma a xa setareɲa ma, wo naxa konyi wali dɔxɔ a ma.

sentences.english: But let him be with you as a servant working for payment, till the year of Jubilee;
sentences.susu: A xa lu alɔ wo xa walikɛ, xa na mu a ra wo xa xɔɲɛ han Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ waxati.

sentences.english: Then he will go out from you, he and his children with him, and go back to his family and to the property of his fathers.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, a tan nun a xa die xa xɔrɛya, e xa gbilen e xabilɛ ma, e benbae xa bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: For they are my servants whom I took out from the land of Egypt; they may not become the property of another.
sentences.susu: barima n ma walikɛe nan Isirayilakae ra, n naxee raminixi Misira bɔxi ra. A mu lanma e xa mati konyiya ra.

sentences.english: Do not be a hard master to him, but have the fear of God before you.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa e yamari a ɲaaxi ra, wo xa gaaxu wo Marigi Ala ya ra.

sentences.english: But you may get servants as property from among the nations round about; from them you may take men-servants and women-servants.
sentences.susu: Xa wo wama konyie xɔn, wo xa e sara si gbɛtɛe tagi, naxee na wo rabilinyi. E tan nan xa findi wo xa konyie ra.

sentences.english: And in addition, you may get, for money, servants from among the children of other nations who are living with you, and from their families which have come to birth in your land; and these will be your property.
sentences.susu: Wo man nɔma konyie sarade si gbɛtɛe xa mixie ya ma naxee dɔxɔxi wo tagi, a nun e xabilɛe mixi naxee barixi wo xa bɔxi kui. Nee nɔma findide wo xa konyie ra.

sentences.english: And they will be your children's heritage after you, to keep as their property; they will be your servants for ever; but you may not be hard masters to your countrymen, the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Wo nɔma e lude wo xa die yi ra kɛ ra. E nɔma lude konyiya kui abadan, kɔnɔ wo ngaxakerenyi Isirayilakae mu nɔma lude e ngaxakerenyi xa yaamari xɔrɔxɔɛ bun ma.»

sentences.english: And if one from another nation living among you gets wealth, and your countryman, at his side, becomes poor and gives himself for money to the man from another nation or to one of his family;
sentences.susu: «Xa wo ngaxakerenyi setare nde a yɛtɛ mati xɔɲɛ bannaxi ma wo xa bɔxi kui, xa na mu a ra na xɔɲɛ xabilɛ mixi nde ma,

sentences.english: After he has given himself he has the right to be made free, for a price, by one of his brothers,
sentences.susu: wo ngaxakerenyi bariboore nde nɔma a xun sarade.

sentences.english: Or his father's brother, or the son of his father's brother, or any near relation; or if he gets money, he may make himself free.
sentences.susu: A sɔxɔ, xa na mu a ra a sɔxɔ xa di, xa na mu a ra a bariboore nde gbɛtɛ, nɔma a xun sarade. Xa a fan fɛɛrɛ sɔtɔ, a nɔma a yɛtɛ xun sarade.

sentences.english: And let the years be numbered from the time when he gave himself to his owner till the year of Jubilee, and the price given for him will be in relation to the number of years, on the scale of the payment of a servant.
sentences.susu: A xa na xunsare kɔnti sɛriyɛ ki ma, kelife a sara ɲɛ ma, han Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ ra. A xa na ɲɔxɔɛ ragbilen a kanyi ma, a xa lu alɔ wali sare.

sentences.english: If there is still a long time, he will give back, on account of it, a part of the price which was given for him.
sentences.susu: Xa ɲɛ wuyaxi luxi, a xunsare xa gbo na ki a kanyi mabiri.

sentences.english: And if there is only a short time, he will take account of it with his master, and in relation to the number of years he will give back the price of making him free.
sentences.susu: Xa ɲɛ wuyaxi mu luxi beenu Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ xa a li, a xunsare xa lan na ɲɛ xasabi ma.

sentences.english: And he will be with him as a servant working for payment year by year; his master is not to be cruel to him before your eyes.
sentences.susu: A nɔma lude alɔ walikɛ a kanyi xɔnyi, kɔnɔ a mu lanma a kanyi xa a yamari a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: And if he is not made free in this way, he will go out in the year of Jubilee, he and his children with him.
sentences.susu: Xa a mu nɔma a yɛtɛ xun sarade yi fɛɛrɛ mɔɔli yo ra, a tan nun a xa die xa lu e kanyi yi ra han Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ ra,

sentences.english: For the children of Israel are servants to me; they are my servants whom I took out of the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: barima n tan nan ma walikɛe na Isirayilakae ra, n naxee raminixi Misira bɔxi ra. Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.»

sentences.english: Do not make images of false gods, or put up an image cut in stone or a pillar or any pictured stone in your land, to give worship to it; for I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa kuye yo yailan, wo naxa ala nde rafala, wo naxa gɛmɛ batu daaxi dɔxɔ, wo naxa gɛmɛ masolixi batu, barima Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.

sentences.english: Keep my Sabbaths and give honour to my holy place: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa n ma malabui lɔxɔɛe rabatu, wo xa n ma yire sɛniyɛnxi binya. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: If you are guided by my rules, and keep my laws and do them,
sentences.susu: «Xa wo n ma sɛriyɛ suxu, xa wo n ma yaamarie rabatu,

sentences.english: Then I will give you rain at the right time, and the land will give her increase and the trees of the field will give their fruit;
sentences.susu: n tunɛ ragoroma nɛ wo bɛ a waxati, bɔxi daxamui raminima nɛ, sansie bogima nɛ xɛ ma.

sentences.english: And the crushing of the grain will overtake the cutting of the grapes, and the cutting of the grapes will overtake the planting of the seed, and there will be bread in full measure, and you will be living in your land safely.
sentences.susu: Sansi bɔnbɔ tɛmui buma nɛ han wɛni bogi ba tɛmui. Wɛni bogi ba tɛmui fan buma nɛ han sansi si tɛmui. Wo wasama nɛ baloe ra, wo sabati wo xa bɔxi ma bɔɲɛsa kui.

sentences.english: And I will give you peace in the land, and you will take your rest and no one will give you cause for fear; and I will put an end to all evil beasts in the land, and no sword of war will go through your land.
sentences.susu: N hinnɛma wo ra alako wo xa xi bɔɲɛsa kui, alako burunyi subee nun geresoe naxa wo tɔɔrɔ wo xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And you will put to flight those who are against you, and they will be put to death by your swords.
sentences.susu: Wo nɔma nɛ wo yaxuie ra santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: Then five of you will put to flight a hundred, and a hundred of you will put to flight ten thousand, and all who are against you will be put to death by your swords.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɔɔri suuli fama nɛ wo yaxui mixi kɛmɛ keride. Wo xa sɔɔri kɛmɛ fama wo yaxui mixi wulu fu keride. Wo fama nɔde wo yaxuie ra gere kui.

sentences.english: And I will have pleasure in you and make you fertile and greater in number; and I will keep my agreement with you.
sentences.susu: Won birin na a ra. N di wuyaxi fima nɛ wo ma, n wo rawuya. N nan n ma saatɛ rakamalima nɛ wo bɛ.

sentences.english: And old stores long kept will be your food, and you will take out the old because of the new;
sentences.susu: Wo yala maale donma nɛ han maale xaba tɛmui. Wo a fori bama nɛ a sasee kui a xa gboe ma, alako wo xa nɔ maale nɛɛnɛ ragatade.

sentences.english: And I will put my holy House among you, and my soul will not be turned away from you in disgust.
sentences.susu: N luma nɛ wo sɛɛti ma, n mu mɛɛma wo ra.

sentences.english: And I will be present among you and will be your God and you will be my people.
sentences.susu: N ɲɛrɛma nɛ wo ya ma. Wo Marigi Ala nan n na, wo fan bara findi n ma ɲama ra.

sentences.english: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt so that you might not be servants to them; by me the cords of your yoke were broken and I made you go upright.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala, naxan wo ramini Misira bɔxi ra alako wo naxa lu e yi ra. N bara konyiya kote ba wo xun ma, alako wo xa ɲɛrɛ xunnakeli kui.»

sentences.english: But if you do not give ear to me, and do not keep all these my laws;
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ, xa wo mu n xui ramɛ, xa wo mu n ma yaamarie birin nabatu,

sentences.english: And if you go against my rules and if you have hate in your souls for my decisions and you do not do all my orders, but go against my agreement;
sentences.susu: xa wo mu n ma sɛriyɛ suxu, xa wo mu bira n waxɔnfe fɔxɔ ra, xa wo n ma saatɛ kana,

sentences.english: This will I do to you: I will put fear in your hearts, even wasting disease and burning pain, drying up the eyes and making the soul feeble, and you will get no profit from your seed, for your haters will take it for food.
sentences.susu: n yi nan nabama wo ra: N yihadi ragoroma nɛ wo ma, n wo rafurama nɛ fure ɲaaxi ra naxan wo yae kanama, naxan wo bɔɲɛ tɔɔrɔma. Wo sansi xɔrie sima nɛ fufafu, barima wo yaxuie na birin donma nɛ.

sentences.english: And my face will be turned from you, and you will be broken before those who are against you, and your haters will become your rulers, and you will go in flight when no man comes after you.
sentences.susu: N gbilenma nɛ wo fɔxɔ ra. Wo yaxuie nɔma nɛ wo ra, wo xɔnnantee wo yamarima nɛ. Wo luma gaaxui nan kui, wo nu wo gi hali mixi mu na wo fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: And if, even after these things, you will not give ear to me, then I will send you punishment seven times more for your sins.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ na birin kui, wo mu fama n xui ramɛde. N wo ɲaxankatama han sanmaya solofere wo xa yunubie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And the pride of your strength will be broken, and I will make your heaven as iron and your earth as brass;
sentences.susu: N wo xa yɛtɛ igboɲa kanama nɛ. N koore balanma nɛ wo ya ra han wo xa bɔxi xɔrɔxɔ alɔ wure gbeeli.

sentences.english: And your strength will be used up without profit; for your land will not give her increase and the trees of the field will not give their fruit.
sentences.susu: Wo sɛnbɛ ɲɔnma nɛ fufafu. Wo xa bɔxi tondima nɛ daxamui raminide, wo xa sansie mu bogima sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: And if you still go against me and will not give ear to me, I will put seven times more punishments on you because of your sins.
sentences.susu: «Xa wo lu n matandi ra, xa wo mu n xui ramɛ, n wo ɲaxankatama han sanmaya solofere wo xa yunubie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: I will let loose the beasts of the field among you, and they will take away your children and send destruction on your cattle, so that your numbers will become small and your roads become waste.
sentences.susu: N burunyi subee rafama nɛ wo xili ma. E wo xa die faxama nɛ, e wo xa xurusee ibɔɔ, e wo sɔntɔ han mixi ɲɔn kirae xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: And if by these things you will not be turned to me, but still go against me;
sentences.susu: «Na birin naba xanbi wo ra, xa wo mu tin n ma sɛriyɛ ra, xa wo lu n matandi ra,

sentences.english: Then I will go against you, and I will give you punishment, I myself, seven times for all your sins.
sentences.susu: n fe xɔrɔxɔɛ rafama nɛ wo ma, n wo ɲaxankata han sanmaya solofere wo xa yunubie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And I will send a sword on you to give effect to the punishment of my agreement; and when you come together into your towns I will send disease among you and you will be given up into the hands of your haters.
sentences.susu: N gere rakelima nɛ wo ma n ma saatɛ kanaxi xa fe ra. Wo na wo nɔxun wo xa taa makantaxie kui, n wo rafurama nɛ fure ɲaaxi ra, wo fa lu wo yaxuie sagoe.

sentences.english: When I take away your bread of life, ten women will be cooking bread in one oven, and your bread will be measured out by weight; you will have food but never enough.
sentences.susu: N kaamɛ radinma wo ma tɛmui naxɛ, ginɛ fu taami ganma nɛ taami ganse keren kui. E na itaxun a xunxuri ra, e a xanin wo xɔn ma wo a don, kɔnɔ a mu wo wasama.»

sentences.english: And if, after all this, you do not give ear to me, but go against me still,
sentences.susu: «Na birin naba xanbi wo ra, xa wo mu wo tuli mati n na, xa wo tondi n waxɔnfe suxude,

sentences.english: Then my wrath will be burning against you, and I will give you punishment, I myself, seven times for your sins.
sentences.susu: n fe xɔrɔxɔɛ rafama nɛ wo ma, n wo ɲaxankata han sanmaya solofere wo xa yunubie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Then you will take the flesh of your sons and the flesh of your daughters for food;
sentences.susu: Wo fama wo xa die sube yati donde.

sentences.english: And I will send destruction on your high places, overturning your perfume altars, and will put your dead bodies on your broken images, and my soul will be turned from you in disgust.
sentences.susu: N wo xa kuye batudee kanama nɛ naxee na geyae fari. N wo xa gɛmɛe rabirama nɛ, wo naxee batuma. N furee malanma nɛ wo xa kuyee fari. N wo rabɛɲinma nɛ,

sentences.english: And I will make your towns waste and send destruction on your holy places; I will take no pleasure in the smell of your sweet perfumes;
sentences.susu: n wo xa taae findi gbengberenyi ra, n wo xa batudee kana, n tondi wo xa sɛrɛxɛe suxude sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And I will make your land a waste, a wonder to your haters living in it.
sentences.susu: N na gɛ wo xa bɔxi kanade, wo yaxuie yati fama kaabade na xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And I will send you out in all directions among the nations, and my sword will be uncovered against you, and your land will be without any living thing, and your towns will be made waste.
sentences.susu: N wo rayensenma nɛ ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛe ma, n wo ɲaxankatama nɛ santidɛgɛma ra. Wo xa bɔxi kanama nɛ, mixi yo mu luma wo xa taae kui.»

sentences.english: Then will the land take pleasure in its Sabbaths while it is waste and you are living in the land of your haters; then will the land have rest.
sentences.susu: «Na waxati bun ma wo xa bɔxi malabuma nɛ. Wo na wo yaxuie yire tɛmui naxɛ, wo xa bɔxi fanma nɛ malabui saabui ra.

sentences.english: All the days while it is waste will the land have rest, such rest as it never had in your Sabbaths, when you were living in it.
sentences.susu: Wo xa bɔxi malabui sɔtɔma na waxati nan kui a mu naxan sɔtɔ wo nu na mɛnni tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And as for the rest of you, I will make their hearts feeble in the land of their haters, and the sound of a leaf moved by the wind will send them in flight, and they will go in flight as from the sword, falling down when no one comes after them;
sentences.susu: Naxee mu faxama na geree kui, nee luma nɛ gaaxui kui e yaxuie yire, hali wuri burɛxɛ nan din e ra, fo e e gi. E e gima nɛ, e bira hali santidɛgɛma kanyi yo mu na e fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Falling on one another, as before the sword, when no one comes after them; you will give way before your haters.
sentences.susu: E birama nɛ e boore fari, alɔ santidɛgɛma kanyi nan e fɔxɔ ra, a fa li mixi yo mu na e fɔxɔ ra. Wo mu nɔma tide wo yaxuie ya ra.

sentences.english: And death will overtake you among strange nations, and the land of your haters will be your destruction.
sentences.susu: Wo sɔntɔma nɛ si gbɛtɛe tagi, wo yaxuie nɔma nɛ wo ra.

sentences.english: And those of you who are still living will be wasting away in their sins in the land of your haters; in the sins of their fathers they will be wasting away.
sentences.susu: Naxee mu faxama gere kui wo ya ma, nee fama nɛ faxade e yaxuie xa bɔxi ma e xa yunubie nun e benbae xa yunubie xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And they will have grief for their sins and for the sins of their fathers, when their hearts were untrue to me, and they went against me;
sentences.susu: «E fama e xa yunubie nun e benbae xa yunubie masende n bɛ, a nun e naxan nabaxi n na matandi kui.

sentences.english: So that I went against them and sent them away into the land of their haters: if then the pride of their hearts is broken and they take the punishment of their sins,
sentences.susu: N fan e tɔɔrɔma nɛ e yaxuie xa bɔxi kui, alako mixi naxee e yɛtɛ fixi n ma, e xa magoro. E xa e xa yunubie sare fi.

sentences.english: Then I will keep in mind the agreement which I made with Jacob and with Isaac and with Abraham, and I will keep in mind the land.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n nan n ɲɔxɔ sama nɛ n ma saatɛ xɔn ma naxan na n tan, nun Yaxuba, Isiyaga, nun Iburahima tagi. N mu nɛɛmuma na bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the land, while she is without them, will keep her Sabbaths; and they will undergo the punishment of their sins, because they were turned away from my decisions and in their souls was hate for my laws.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi fama nɛ malabude na tɛmui, barima Isirayilakae bara siga pon e xa yunubi sare fide. E bara n ma sɛriyɛ bɛɲin, e bara yo n ma yaamarie ma.»

sentences.english: But for all that, when they are in the land of their haters I will not let them go, or be turned away from them, or give them up completely; my agreement with them will not be broken, for I am the Lord their God.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ, n na e keri sigafe ra e yaxuie yire tɛmui naxɛ, n mu e rabɛɲinma han e xa sɔntɔ. N mu n ma saatɛ kanama e tan ma fe ra, barima Alatala nan n na, e Marigi Ala.

sentences.english: And because of them I will keep in mind the agreement which I made with their fathers, whom I took out of the land of Egypt before the eyes of the nations, to be their God: I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: N nan n ɲɔxɔ sama nɛ n ma saatɛ singe xɔn ma, n e ramini Misira bɔxi ra sie ya xɔri tɛmui naxɛ, alako n xa findi e Marigi Ala ra. Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: These are the rules, decisions, and laws, which the Lord made between himself and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai, by the hand of Moses.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa sɛriyɛ, a xa yaamarie, nun a xa masenyie nan na ki Alatala naxee masenxi Isirayilakae bɛ Annabi Munsa saabui ra Turusinina geya fari.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel, If a man makes a special oath, you will give your decision as to the value of the persons for the Lord.
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, xa mixi nde laayidi tongo, a xa mixi nde fi n tan Alatala ma, a nɔma a xun sarade yi kɔbiri xasabi nan na.

sentences.english: And you will put the value of a male from twenty years to sixty years old at fifty shekels of silver, by the scale of the holy place.
sentences.susu: Xa xɛmɛ na a ra naxan xa simaya kelima ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn han ɲɛ tongo senni, a xun sarama gbeti kole tongo suuli nan na naxan maniyama yire sɛniyɛnxi maniyase ra.

sentences.english: And if it is a female, the value will be thirty shekels.
sentences.susu: Xa ginɛ na a ra, a xun sarama gbeti kole tongo saxan nun a tagi nan na.

sentences.english: And if the person is from five to twenty years old, the value will be twenty shekels for a male, and ten for a female.
sentences.susu: Xa di xɛmɛ na a ra naxan xa simaya kelima ɲɛ suuli han ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn, a xun sarama gbeti kilo mɔxɔɲɛn nan na. Xa ginɛ dimɛdi na a ra, a xun sarama gbeti kole fu nan na.

sentences.english: And if the person is from one month to five years old, then the value for a male will be five shekels of silver, and for a female three shekels.
sentences.susu: Xa di xɛmɛ na a ra naxan mu ɲɛ suuli sɔtɔxi sinden, a xun sarama gbeti kole suuli nan na. Xa di ginɛ na a ra, a xun sarama gbeti kole saxan nan na.

sentences.english: And for sixty years old and over, for a male the value will be fifteen shekels, and for a female, ten.
sentences.susu: Xa xɛmɔxi na a ra naxan xa simaya dangima ɲɛ tongo senni ra, a xun sarama gbeti kole fu nun suuli nan na. Xa ɲɛlɛxɛfori na a ra, a xun sarama gbeti kole fu nan na.

sentences.english: But if he is poorer than the value which you have put on him, then let him be taken to the priest, and the priest will put a value on him, such as it is possible for him to give.
sentences.susu: Xa setare bara na laayidi tongo, naxan mu nɔma na xunsare xasabi fide, a lan a xa a yɛtɛ masen sɛrɛxɛdubɛ bɛ naxan fama xunsare xasabi falade a bɛ a nɔma naxan na.»

sentences.english: And if it is a beast of which men make offerings to the Lord, whatever any man gives of such to the Lord will be holy.
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi nde laayidi tongo xuruse nde fife ra, naxan nɔma bade sɛrɛxɛ ra n tan Alatala bɛ, na xuruse xa fi n tan Alatala ma. A bara sɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: It may not be changed in any way, a good given for a bad, or a bad for a good; if one beast is changed for another, the two will be holy.
sentences.susu: Xuruse gbɛtɛ mu fima a masare ra, a fan ba, a mu fan ba. Xa wo na rabama, e firinyi bara findi se sɛniyɛnxi ra.

sentences.english: And if it is any unclean beast, of which offerings are not made to the Lord, then let him take the beast before the priest;
sentences.susu: Xa sube raharamuxi na a ra, naxan mu bama sɛrɛxɛ ra n tan Alatala bɛ, a xa xanin sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xɔn.

sentences.english: And let the priest put a value on it, if it is good or bad; whatever value the priest puts on it, so will it be.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa xunsare nde fala sube kɛɲa ma. Na xa findi a sare ra.

sentences.english: But if he has a desire to get it back for himself, let him give a fifth more than your value.
sentences.susu: Xa a kanyi wama na sube xun sarafe, a xa na sare fi, a man xa kɔbiri nde sa na fari. Na findima kɔbiri naxan na, a na se sare nan itaxunma dɔxɔ suuli ra, a fa dɔxɔ keren ba a ra, a na fi xunsare ra.»

sentences.english: And if a man has given his house as holy to the Lord, then the priest will put a value on it, if it is good or bad; as the priest gives decision so will the value be fixed.
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi nde a xa banxi fi n tan Alatala ma, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa na sare fala banxi kɛɲa ma. Na xa findi a sare ra.

sentences.english: And if the owner has a desire to get back his house, let him give a fifth more than your value, and it will be his.
sentences.susu: Xa a kanyi wama a xun sarafe, a xa na sare fi, a man xa kɔbiri nde sa na fari. Na findima kɔbiri naxan na, a na banxi sare nan itaxunma dɔxɔ suuli ra, a fa dɔxɔ keren ba a ra, a na fi xunsare ra. Na tɛmui banxi xa gbilen a kanyi ma.»

sentences.english: And if a man gives to the Lord part of the field which is his property, then let your value be in relation to the seed which is planted in it; a measure of barley grain will be valued at fifty shekels of silver.
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi nde a xa xɛ fi n tan Alatala ma, a sare fatanma sansi xɔri xasabi nan na naxan nɔma garansande naa. Gbeti kole tongo suuli xa fi fundenyi maniyɛ busali naani xasabi ra.

sentences.english: If he gives his field from the year of Jubilee, the value will be fixed by your decision.
sentences.susu: Xa a a xa xɛ fi Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ nan kui, a sare mu masarama.

sentences.english: But if he gives his field after the year of Jubilee, the amount of the money will be worked out by the priest in relation to the number of years till the coming year of Jubilee, and the necessary amount will be taken off your value.
sentences.susu: Xa a a xa xɛ fi Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ dangi xanbi nɛ, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa ɲɛe kɔnti naxee luxi beenu Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ gbɛtɛ xa fa. A xa nde ba xɛ sare ra na sɛriyɛ kui.

sentences.english: And if the man who has given the field has a desire to get it back, let him give a fifth more than the price at which it was valued and it will be his.
sentences.susu: Xa xɛ kanyi wama a xa xɛ xun sarafe, a xa na sare fi, a man xa kɔbiri nde sa na fari. Na findima kɔbiri naxan na, a na xɛ sare nan itaxunma dɔxɔ suuli ra, a fa dɔxɔ keren ba a ra, a na fi xunsare ra. Na tɛmui xɛ xa lu a yi ra.

sentences.english: But if he has no desire to get it back, or if he has given it for a price to another man, it may not be got back again.
sentences.susu: Xa a mu xɛ xun sara, a fa a mati mixi gbɛtɛ ma, a mu nɔma a xun sarade sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: But the field, when it becomes free at the year of Jubilee, will be holy to the Lord, as a field given under oath: it will be the property of the priest.
sentences.susu: Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ na a li, na xɛ kanyi nɛɛnɛ xa keli na bɔxi ma. Bɔxi bara sɛniyɛn, a bara lu alɔ bɔxi naxan natɔnxi. A bara findi Alatala gbe ra, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa na rawali.

sentences.english: And if a man gives to the Lord a field which he has got for money from another, which is not part of his heritage;
sentences.susu: Xa mixi bara xɛ saraxi fi Alatala ma, naxan mu na a xabilɛ kɛ ya ma,

sentences.english: Then the value fixed by you up to the year of Jubilee will be worked out for him by the priest, and in that day he will give the amount of your value as holy to the Lord.
sentences.susu: sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa a sare fala a sɛriyɛ ki ma. A na kolonma ɲɛ xasabi nan ma naxee luxi beenu Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ xa a li. Na kanyi xa a sare fi na lɔxɔɛ yati, barima a sɛniyɛn n tan Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: In the year of Jubilee the field will go back to him from whom he got it, that is, to him whose heritage it was.
sentences.susu: Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ na a li, na xɛ gbilenma na xɛ kanyi singe nan ma, boore a sara naxan ma.

sentences.english: And let all your values be based on the shekel of the holy place, that is, twenty gerahs to the shekel.
sentences.susu: Na saree birin maniyama yire sɛniyɛnxi xa se maniya ki nan ma. A kole keren lanxi garamu fu nan ma.»

sentences.english: But a man may not give by oath to the Lord the first-fruits of cattle which are offered to the Lord: if it is an ox or a sheep it is the Lord's.
sentences.susu: «Mixi yo mu nɔma a xa xuruse di singe fide n tan Alatala ma, barima a ɲan findixi n tan Alatala gbe nan na. Xuruse xungbe nun a lanma di singe birin findixi n tan nan gbe ra.

sentences.english: And if it is an unclean beast, then the owner of it may give money to get it back, in agreement with the value fixed by you, by giving a fifth more; or if it is not taken back, let it be given for money in agreement with your valuing.
sentences.susu: Mixi nɔma sube raharamuxi xa di singe xun sarade. Na mixi xa a sare fi, a man xa kɔbiri nde sa na fari. Na findima kɔbiri naxan na, a na sube sare nan itaxunma dɔxɔ suuli ra, a fa dɔxɔ keren ba a ra, a na fi a xunsare ra. Xa a kanyi mu a xun sarama, a xa a mati a sare ra.»

sentences.english: But nothing which a man has given completely to the Lord, out of all his property, of man or beast, or of the land which is his heritage, may be given away or got back in exchange for money; anything completely given is most holy to the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ se ndee na mixi naxee fima n tan Alatala ma a bɔɲɛ birin na e findi n gbe ra, adama mu nɔma nee xun sarade sɔnɔn. Nee bara sɛniyɛn, nee bara findi n tan Alatala gbansan gbe ra. Nee nɔma findide mixi, xuruse, xɛ, xa na mu a ra se gbɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: Any man given completely to the Lord may not be got back: he is certainly to be put to death.
sentences.susu: Mixi se naxee fima n tan Alatala ma na mɔɔli ra, e xun mu nɔma sarade, fo e xa faxa nɛ.»

sentences.english: And every tenth part of the land, of the seed planted, or of the fruit of trees, is holy to the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Bɔxi farilɛ birin findima n tan Alatala nan gbe ra, sansi xɔri naxan naminima nun wuri bili naxan bogima. Na farilɛ birin fima n tan Alatala nan ma.

sentences.english: And if a man has a desire to get back any of the tenth part which he has given, let him give a fifth more.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde wama a xa farilɛ xun sarafe, a xa a sare fi, a man xa kɔbiri nde sa na fari. Na findima kɔbiri naxan na, a na se sare nan itaxunma dɔxɔ suuli ra, a fa dɔxɔ keren ba a ra, a na fi a xunsare ra.

sentences.english: And a tenth part of the herd and of the flock, whatever goes under the rod of the valuer, will be holy to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Xuruse farilɛ birin findima n tan Alatala nan gbe ra, xuruse xungbe nun a lanma, xuruse dɛmadonyi naxan birin kɔntima. Na farilɛ birin fima n tan Alatala nan ma.

sentences.english: He may not make search to see if it is good or bad, or make any changes in it; and if he makes exchange of it for another, the two will be holy; he will not get them back again.
sentences.susu: Xurusee mu matoma xa a fan, xa a mu fan. Xuruse mu nɔma masarade xuruse gbɛtɛ ra, xa na mu a ra na firinyi birin sɛniyɛnma nɛ, e findi n tan Alatala gbe ra, e sese mu nɔma xun sarade sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: These are the orders which the Lord gave to Moses for the children of Israel in Mount Sinai.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa yaamarie nan na ki, a naxee so Annabi Munsa yi ra Turusinina geya fari Isirayilakae bɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses in the waste land of Sinai, in the Tent of meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they came out of the land of Egypt,
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae xa mini Misira ɲɛ firin nde, kike firin nde, xi singe, Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ Turusinina gbengberenyi ma hɔrɔmɔlingira kui,

sentences.english: Take the full number of the children of Israel, by their families, and by their fathers' houses, every male by name;
sentences.susu: «Wo xa Isirayila xɛmɛ birin kɔnti a xabilɛ nun a denbaya ki ma,

sentences.english: All those of twenty years old and over, who are able to go to war in Israel, are to be numbered by you and Aaron.
sentences.susu: naxee xa simaya bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn li, naxee nɔma findide Isirayila sɔɔrie ra. I nun Haruna, wo xa e itaxun sɔɔri gaali ki ma.

sentences.english: And to give you help, take one man from every tribe, the head of his father's house.
sentences.susu: Bɔnsɔɛ xunyie xa wo mali na wali kui.

sentences.english: These are the names of those who are to be your helpers: from Reuben, Elizur, the son of Shedeur;
sentences.susu: E xilie nan ya: Ruben bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, Sedeyuri xa di xɛmɛ Elisuru.

sentences.english: From Simeon, Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai;
sentences.susu: Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, Surisadayi xa di xɛmɛ Selumiyeli.

sentences.english: From Judah, Nahshon, the son of Amminadab;
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, Aminadabo xa di xɛmɛ Naxason.

sentences.english: From Issachar, Nethanel, the son of Zuar;
sentences.susu: Isakari bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, Suwara xa di xɛmɛ Netaneeli.

sentences.english: From Zebulun, Eliab, the son of Helon;
sentences.susu: Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, Xelon xa di xɛmɛ Eliyabi.

sentences.english: Of the children of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama, the son of Ammihud; from Manasseh, Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur,
sentences.susu: Yusufu xa di xɛmɛ Efirami bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, Amixudi xa di xɛmɛ Elisama. Yusufu xa di xɛmɛ Manasi bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, Pedasuru xa di xɛmɛ Gamaliyɛli.

sentences.english: From Benjamin, Abidan, the son of Gideoni;
sentences.susu: Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, Gideyoni xa di xɛmɛ Abidan.

sentences.english: From Dan, Ahiezer, the son of Ammi-shaddai;
sentences.susu: Dana bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, Amisadayi xa di xɛmɛ Axiyeseri.

sentences.english: From Asher, Pagiel, the son of Ochran;
sentences.susu: Aseri bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, Okiran xa di xɛmɛ Pagiyɛli.

sentences.english: From Gad, Eliasaph, the son of Reuel;
sentences.susu: Gadi bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, Duweli xa di xɛmɛ Eliyasafa.

sentences.english: From Naphtali, Ahira, the son of Enan.
sentences.susu: Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, Enan xa di xɛmɛ Axira.»

sentences.english: These are the men named out of all the people, chiefs of their fathers' houses, heads of the tribes of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na bɔnsɔɛ xunyie nan xilixi, e xa findi Isirayila sɔɔri mangɛe ra.

sentences.english: And Moses and Aaron took these men, marked out by name;
sentences.susu: E naxa kafu Munsa nun Haruna ma,

sentences.english: And they got together all the people on the first day of the second month; and everyone made clear his family and his father's house, by the number of the names, from twenty years old and over.
sentences.susu: e xa Isirayila ɲama malan, na kike firin nde, xi singe. Xɛmɛ birin naxee xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn li, e naxa e tɛngɛ e xabilɛ nun e denbaya ki ma,

sentences.english: As the Lord had given orders to Moses, so they were numbered by him in the waste place of Sinai.
sentences.susu: alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ. Munsa naxa e tɛngɛ Turusinina gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: The generations of the sons of Reuben, the oldest son of Israel, were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over, who was able to go to war;
sentences.susu: E naxa Isirayila xa di singe Ruben bɔnsɔɛ birin tɛngɛ e xabilɛ nun e denbaya ki ma. E naxa xɛmɛe xili sɛbɛ, naxee xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn li, naxee nu nɔma sɔɔriɲa rabade.

sentences.english: Forty-six thousand, five hundred of the tribe of Reuben were numbered.
sentences.susu: Na xasabi lan nɛ xɛmɛ wulu tongo naani nun senni, xɛmɛ kɛmɛ suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: The generations of the sons of Simeon were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over, who was able to go to war;
sentences.susu: E naxa Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ birin tɛngɛ e xabilɛ nun e xa denbaya ki ma. E naxa xɛmɛe xili sɛbɛ, naxee xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn li, naxee nu nɔma sɔɔriɲa rabade.

sentences.english: Fifty-nine thousand, three hundred of the tribe of Simeon were numbered.
sentences.susu: Na xasabi lan nɛ xɛmɛ wulu tongo suuli nun solomanaani, xɛmɛ kɛmɛ saxan nan ma.

sentences.english: The generations of the sons of Gad were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
sentences.susu: E naxa Gadi bɔnsɔɛ birin tɛngɛ e xabilɛ nun e xa denbaya ki ma. E naxa xɛmɛe xili sɛbɛ, naxee xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn li, naxee nu nɔma sɔɔriɲa rabade.

sentences.english: Forty-five thousand, six hundred and fifty of the tribe of Gad were numbered.
sentences.susu: Na xasabi lan nɛ xɛmɛ wulu tongo naani nun suuli, xɛmɛ kɛmɛ senni tongo suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: The generations of the sons of Judah were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
sentences.susu: E naxa Yuda bɔnsɔɛ birin tɛngɛ e xabilɛ nun e xa denbaya ki ma. E naxa xɛmɛe xili sɛbɛ, naxee xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn li, naxee nu nɔma sɔɔriɲa rabade.

sentences.english: Seventy-four thousand, six hundred of the tribe of Judah were numbered.
sentences.susu: Na xasabi lan nɛ xɛmɛ wulu tongo solofere nun naani, xɛmɛ kɛmɛ senni nan ma.

sentences.english: The generations of the sons of Issachar were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
sentences.susu: E naxa Isakari bɔnsɔɛ birin tɛngɛ e xabilɛ nun e denbaya ki ma. E naxa xɛmɛe xili sɛbɛ, naxee xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn li, naxee nu nɔma sɔɔriɲa rabade.

sentences.english: Fifty-four thousand, four hundred of the tribe of Issachar were numbered.
sentences.susu: Na xasabi lan nɛ xɛmɛ wulu tongo suuli nun naani, xɛmɛ kɛmɛ naani nan ma.

sentences.english: The generations of the sons of Zebulun were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
sentences.susu: E naxa Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ birin tɛngɛ e xabilɛ nun e xa denbaya ki ma. E naxa xɛmɛe xili sɛbɛ, naxee xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn li, naxee nu nɔma sɔɔriɲa rabade.

sentences.english: Fifty-seven thousand, four hundred of the tribe of Zebulun were numbered.
sentences.susu: Na xasabi lan nɛ xɛmɛ wulu tongo suuli nun solofere, xɛmɛ kɛmɛ naani nan ma.

sentences.english: The generations of the sons of Joseph were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
sentences.susu: E naxa Yusufu xa di xɛmɛ Efirami bɔnsɔɛ birin tɛngɛ e xabilɛ nun e xa denbaya ki ma. E naxa xɛmɛe xili sɛbɛ, naxee xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn li, naxee nu nɔma sɔɔriɲa rabade.

sentences.english: Forty thousand, five hundred of the tribe of Ephraim were numbered.
sentences.susu: Na xasabi lan nɛ xɛmɛ wulu tongo naani, xɛmɛ kɛmɛ suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: The generations of the sons of Manasseh were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
sentences.susu: E naxa Yusufu xa di xɛmɛ Manasi bɔnsɔɛ birin tɛngɛ e xabilɛ nun e xa denbaya ki ma. E naxa xɛmɛe xili sɛbɛ, naxee xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn li, naxee nu nɔma sɔɔriɲa rabade.

sentences.english: Thirty-two thousand, two hundred of the tribe of Manasseh were numbered.
sentences.susu: Na xasabi lan nɛ xɛmɛ wulu tongo saxan nun firin, xɛmɛ kɛmɛ firin nan ma.

sentences.english: The generations of the sons of Benjamin were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
sentences.susu: E naxa Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ birin tɛngɛ e xabilɛ nun e xa denbaya ki ma. E naxa xɛmɛe xili sɛbɛ, naxee xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn li, naxee nu nɔma sɔɔriɲa rabade.

sentences.english: Thirty-five thousand, four hundred of the tribe of Benjamin were numbered.
sentences.susu: Na xasabi lan nɛ xɛmɛ wulu tongo saxan nun suuli, xɛmɛ kɛmɛ naani nan ma.

sentences.english: The generations of the sons of Dan were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years and over who was able to go to war;
sentences.susu: E naxa Dana bɔnsɔɛ birin tɛngɛ e xabilɛ nun e xa denbaya ki ma. E naxa xɛmɛe xili sɛbɛ, naxee xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn li, naxee nu nɔma sɔɔriɲa rabade.

sentences.english: Sixty-two thousand, seven hundred of the tribe of Dan were numbered.
sentences.susu: Na xasabi lan nɛ xɛmɛ wulu tongo senni nun firin, xɛmɛ kɛmɛ solofere nan ma.

sentences.english: The generations of the sons of Asher were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
sentences.susu: E naxa Aseri bɔnsɔɛ birin tɛngɛ e xabilɛ nun e xa denbaya ki ma. E naxa xɛmɛe xili sɛbɛ, naxee xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn li, naxee nu nɔma sɔɔriɲa rabade.

sentences.english: Forty-one thousand, five hundred of the tribe of Asher were numbered.
sentences.susu: Na xasabi lan nɛ xɛmɛ wulu naani nun keren, xɛmɛ kɛmɛ suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: The generations of the sons of Naphtali were numbered by their families and their fathers' houses, every male of twenty years old and over who was able to go to war;
sentences.susu: E naxa Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ birin tɛngɛ e xabilɛ nun e xa denbaya ki ma. E naxa xɛmɛe xili sɛbɛ, naxee xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn li, naxee nu nɔma sɔɔriɲa rabade.

sentences.english: Fifty-three thousand, four hundred of the tribe of Naphtali were numbered.
sentences.susu: Na xasabi lan nɛ xɛmɛ wulu tongo suuli nun saxan, xɛmɛ kɛmɛ naani nan ma.

sentences.english: These are they who were numbered by Moses and Aaron and by the twelve chiefs of Israel, one from every tribe.
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ xunyi fu nun firinyi nan kafu Munsa nun Haruna ma na tɛngɛ tife ra.

sentences.english: So all those who were numbered of the children of Israel, by their families, all those of twenty years old and over who were able to go to war,
sentences.susu: Isirayila xɛmɛ naxee nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn li, naxee nu nɔma sɔɔriɲa rabade,

sentences.english: Were six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty.
sentences.susu: nee nu lanxi xɛmɛ wulu kɛmɛ senni nun saxan, xɛmɛ kɛmɛ suuli nun tongo suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: But the Levites, of the tribe of their fathers, were not numbered among them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mu nu na na kɔnti ya ma,

sentences.english: For the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: barima Alatala nu bara a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Only the tribe of Levi is not to be numbered among the children of Israel,
sentences.susu: «I naxa Lewikae tɛngɛ Isirayilakae ya ma.

sentences.english: But to them you are to give the care of the Tent of meeting with its vessels and everything in it: they are to take up the Tent, and be responsible for everything to do with it, and put up their tents round it.
sentences.susu: I xa hɔrɔmɔlingira nun a xa se birin taxu e ra. N ma saatɛ tɔnxuma na a ra. E xa a maxanin, e xa mɛɛni a ma, e xa yonkin a rabilinyi ra.

sentences.english: And when the Tent of meeting goes forward, the Levites are to take it down; and when it is to be put up, they are to do it: any strange person who comes near it is to be put to death.
sentences.susu: Wo na keli sigade, e xa a ragoro. Wo na yire nɛɛnɛ li, e xa a ti. Xa mixi gbɛtɛ a maso a ra naxan mu findi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ra, na kanyi lan nɛ a xa faxa.

sentences.english: The children of Israel are to put up their tents, every man in his tent-circle round his flag.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka birin xa yonkin yire e na dɛnnaxɛ masen e bɛ, e bɔnsɔɛ xa tɔnxuma bun ma, a nun e xa sɔɔrie.

sentences.english: But the tents of the Levites are to be round the Tent of meeting, so that wrath may not come on the children of Israel: the Tent of meeting is to be in the care of the Levites.
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛe xa yonkin hɔrɔmɔlingira rabilinyi, xa na mu a ra n xɔnɔma nɛ Isirayila ɲama ma. Lewikae xa e ɲɛngi sa hɔrɔmɔlingira xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: So the children of Israel did as the Lord had given orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa Alatala xa yaamari birin suxu, a naxan soxi Munsa yi ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa nun Haruna bɛ,

sentences.english: The children of Israel are to put up their tents in the order of their families, by the flags of their fathers' houses, facing the Tent of meeting on every side.
sentences.susu: «Isirayilaka birin yonkinma e xabilɛ xa tɔnxuma nan bun ma. E birin ya rafindima e booree nan ma, hɔrɔmɔlingira fa lu e tagi.»

sentences.english: Those whose tents are on the east side, looking to the dawn, will be round the flag of the children of Judah, with Nahshon, the son of Amminadab, as their chief.
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛ nan yonkinma sogetede mabiri e xa tɔnxuma bun ma. Aminadabo xa di Naxason nan e xa yarerati ra.

sentences.english: The number of his army was seventy-four thousand, six hundred.
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔrie xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo solofere nun naani, mixi kɛmɛ senni nan ma.

sentences.english: And nearest to him will be the tribe of Issachar, with Nethanel, the son of Zuar, as their chief.
sentences.susu: Isakari bɔnsɔɛ nan yonkinma Yuda bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti ma e xa tɔnxuma bun ma. Suwara xa di Netaneeli nan e xa yarerati ra.

sentences.english: The number of his army was fifty-four thousand, four hundred.
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔrie xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo suuli nun naani, mixi kɛmɛ naani nan ma.

sentences.english: After him, the tribe of Zebulun, with Eliab, the son of Helon, as their chief.
sentences.susu: Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ nan yonkinma Yuda bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti ma e xa tɔnxuma bun ma. Xelon xa di Eliyabi nan e xa yarerati ra.

sentences.english: The number of his army was fifty-seven thousand, four hundred.
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔrie xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo suuli nun solofere, mixi kɛmɛ naani nan ma.

sentences.english: The number of all the armies of Judah was a hundred and eighty-six thousand, four hundred. They go forward first.
sentences.susu: Gali naxan yonkin Yuda bɔnsɔɛ mabiri, e xasabi lan mixi wulu kɛmɛ mixi wulu tongo solomasaxan nun senni, mixi kɛmɛ naani nan ma. E tan nan tima yare ra.

sentences.english: On the south side is the flag of the children of Reuben, in the order of their armies, with Elizur, the son of Shedeur, as their chief.
sentences.susu: Ruben bɔnsɔɛ nan yonkinma sogetede mabiri e xa tɔnxuma bun ma. Sedeyuri xa di Elisuru nan e xa yarerati ra.

sentences.english: The number of his army was forty-six thousand, five hundred.
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔrie xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo naani nun senni, mixi kɛmɛ suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: And nearest to him, the tribe of Simeon, with Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai, as their chief.
sentences.susu: Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ nan yonkinma Ruben bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti ma e xa tɔnxuma bun ma. Surisadayi xa di Selumiyeli nan e xa yarerati ra.

sentences.english: The number of his army was fifty-nine thousand, three hundred.
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔrie xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo suuli nun solomanaani, mixi kɛmɛ suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: Then the tribe of Gad, with Eliasaph, son of Reuel, as their chief.
sentences.susu: Gadi bɔnsɔɛ nan yonkinma Ruben bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti ma e xa tɔnxuma bun ma. Duweli xa di Eliyasafa nan e xa yarerati ra.

sentences.english: The number of his army was forty-five thousand, six hundred and fifty.
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔrie xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo naani nun suuli, mixi kɛmɛ senni nun tongo suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: The number of all the armies of Reuben together came to a hundred and fifty-one thousand, four hundred and fifty. They go forward second.
sentences.susu: Gali naxan yonkin Ruben bɔnsɔɛ mabiri, e xasabi lan mixi wulu kɛmɛ mixi wulu tongo suuli nun keren, mixi kɛmɛ naani nun tongo suuli nan ma. E tan nan sigama a firin nde.

sentences.english: Then the Tent of meeting is to go forward, with the tents of the Levites, in the middle of the armies; in the same order as their tents are placed, they are to go forward, every man under his flag.
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ naxan yonkinma e tagi, a birama e fɔxɔ ra hɔrɔmɔlingira xaninfe ra. Bɔnsɔɛ birin ɲɛrɛma e safɛ ki nan ma e xa tɔnxuma bun ma.

sentences.english: On the west side will be the flag of the children of Ephraim, with Elishama, the son of Ammihud, as their chief.
sentences.susu: Efirami bɔnsɔɛ nan yonkinma sogegorode mabiri e xa tɔnxuma bun ma. Amixudi xa di Elisama nan e xa yarerati ra.

sentences.english: The number of his army was forty thousand, five hundred.
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔrie xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo naani, mixi kɛmɛ suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: And by him the tribe of Manasseh with Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur, as their chief.
sentences.susu: Manasi bɔnsɔɛ nan yonkinma Efirami bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti ma e xa tɔnxuma bun ma. Pedasuru xa di Gamaliyɛli nan e xa yarerati ra.

sentences.english: The number of his army was thirty-two thousand, two hundred.
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔrie xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo saxan nun firin, mixi kɛmɛ firin nan ma.

sentences.english: Then the tribe of Benjamin, with Abidan, the son of Gideoni, as their chief.
