sentences.susu: Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ nan yonkinma Efirami bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti ma e xa tɔnxuma bun ma. Gideyoni xa di Abidan nan e xa yarerati ra.

sentences.english: The number of his army was thirty-five thousand, four hundred.
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔrie xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo saxan nun suuli, mixi kɛmɛ naani nan ma.

sentences.english: The number of all the armies of Ephraim was a hundred and eight thousand, one hundred. They go forward third.
sentences.susu: Gali naxan yonkin Efirami bɔnsɔɛ mabiri, e xasabi lan mixi wulu kɛmɛ mixi wulu solomasaxan, mixi kɛmɛ nan ma. E tan nan sigama a saxan nde.

sentences.english: On the north side will be the flag of the children of Dan, with Ahiezer, the son of Ammishaddai, as their chief.
sentences.susu: Dana bɔnsɔɛ nan yonkinma yirefanyi mabiri e xa tɔnxuma bun ma. Amisadayi xa di Axiyeseri nan e xa yarerati ra.

sentences.english: The number of his army was sixty-two thousand, seven hundred.
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔrie xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo senni nun firin, mixi kɛmɛ solofere nan ma.

sentences.english: Nearest to him will be the tribe of Asher, with Pagiel, the son of Ochran, as their chief.
sentences.susu: Aseri bɔnsɔɛ nan yonkinma Dana bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti ma e xa tɔnxuma bun ma. Okiran xa di Pagiyɛli nan e xa yarerati ra.

sentences.english: The number of his army was forty-one thousand, five hundred;
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔrie xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo naani nun keren, mixi kɛmɛ suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: Then the tribe of Naphtali, with Ahira, the son of Enan, as their chief.
sentences.susu: Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ nan yonkinma Dana bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti ma e xa tɔnxuma bun ma. Enan xa di Axira nan e xa yarerati ra.

sentences.english: The number of his army was fifty-three thousand, four hundred.
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔrie xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo suuli nun saxan, mixi kɛmɛ naani nan ma.

sentences.english: The number of all the armies in the tents of Dan was a hundred and fifty-seven thousand, six hundred. They will go forward last, by their flags.
sentences.susu: Gali naxan yonkin Dana bɔnsɔɛ mabiri, e xasabi lan mixi wulu kɛmɛ mixi wulu tongo suuli nun solofere, mixi kɛmɛ senni nan ma. E tan nan sigama a dɔnxɔɛ ra e xa tɔnxumae bun ma.

sentences.english: These are all who were numbered of the children of Israel, in the order of their fathers' families: all the armies in their tents together came to six hundred and three thousand, five hundred and fifty.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka naxee tɛngɛ e xabilɛ ki ma nun e xa sɔɔri gali ki ma, e xasabi lan mixi wulu kɛmɛ senni nun saxan, mixi kɛmɛ suuli nun tongo suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel, as the Lord said to Moses.
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ tan mu tɛngɛ Isirayilakae xun ma, alɔ Alatala a masen ki naxɛ Munsa bɛ.

sentences.english: So the children of Israel did as the Lord said to Moses, so they put up their tents by their flags, and they went forward in the same order, by their families, and by their fathers' houses.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa bira Alatala xa yaamari birin fɔxɔ ra, alɔ a Munsa yamari a ra ki naxɛ. E nu yonkinma e xa tɔnxuma nan bun ma, e man nu ɲɛrɛma e xabilɛ nun e xa denbaya ki nan ma.

sentences.english: Now these are the generations of Aaron and Moses, in the day when the word of the Lord came to Moses on Mount Sinai.
sentences.susu: Haruna nun Munsa xa taruxui nan ya, Alatala to wɔyɛn Munsa bɛ Turusinina geya ma.

sentences.english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the oldest, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
sentences.susu: Haruna xa di xɛmɛe xilie nan yi ki: a xa di xɛmɛ singe nu xili nɛ Nadabo, a xunyae, Abihu, Eleyasari, nun Itamari.

sentences.english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests, on whom the holy oil was put, who were marked out as priests.
sentences.susu: Nee nan sugandixi e xa findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra.

sentences.english: And Nadab and Abihu were put to death before the Lord when they made an offering of strange fire before the Lord, in the waste land of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar did the work of priests before Aaron their father.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Nadabo nun Abihu naxa faxa Alatala ya i e to sɛrɛxɛ gan tɛ ra naxan mu lanxi. E mu di yo sɔtɔ, kɔnɔ Eleyasari nun Itamari naxa lu sɛrɛxɛdubɛɲa kui e baba Haruna xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Make the tribe of Levi come near, and put them before Aaron the priest, to be his helpers,
sentences.susu: «I xa Lewi bɔnsɔɛ masen Haruna bɛ, e xa a mali a xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali kui.

sentences.english: In order that they may be responsible to him and to all Israel for the care of the Tent of meeting, and to do the work of the House;
sentences.susu: E xa Haruna nun Isirayila ɲama mali hɔrɔmɔlingira wali kui.

sentences.english: And they will have the care of all the vessels of the Tent of meeting, and will do for the children of Israel all the necessary work of the House.
sentences.susu: E xa e ɲɔxɔ sa hɔrɔmɔlingira raxunmasee xɔn na, e man xa hɔrɔmɔlingira wali raba Isirayilakae bɛ.

sentences.english: Give the Levites to Aaron and his sons; so that they may be his without question from among the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na kui i Lewi bɔnsɔɛ sama Haruna nun a xa di xɛmɛe nan sago. E sugandixi Isirayilakae ya ma Haruna malife nan na.

sentences.english: And give orders that Aaron and his sons are to keep their place as priests; any strange person who comes near is to be put to death.
sentences.susu: I xa Haruna nun a xa die nan tun ti sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali rabafe ra. Xa mixi gbɛtɛ sa a maso hɔrɔmɔlingira ra, na kanyi xa faxa.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: See, I have taken the Levites out of the children of Israel to be mine in place of the first sons of the children of Israel;
sentences.susu: «N bara Lewi bɔnsɔɛ sugandi Isirayilakae tagi Isirayila ginɛe xa di singe birin ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Na bɔnsɔɛ findixi n gbe nan na,

sentences.english: For all the first sons are mine; on the day when I put to death all the first sons in the land of Egypt, I took for myself every first male birth of man and beast. They are mine; I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: barima n gbe nan na di xɛmɛ singe birin na. N to di xɛmɛ singe birin faxa Misira bɔxi ma, n naxa Isirayila di xɛmɛ singe birin sugandi n yɛtɛ bɛ, a findi mixi ra, a findi xuruse ra. N tan nan na Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses in the waste land of Sinai,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ Turusinina gbengberenyi ma,

sentences.english: Let all the children of Levi be numbered by their families and their fathers' houses; let every male of a month old and over be numbered.
sentences.susu: «Lewi bɔnsɔɛ tɛngɛ a denbaya nun a xabilɛ ki ma. Xɛmɛ birin tɛngɛma nɛ naxan ma simaya bara kike keren li.»

sentences.english: So Moses did as the Lord said, numbering them as he had been ordered.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa e tɛngɛ alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: These were the sons of Levi by name: Gershon and Kohath and Merari.
sentences.susu: Lewi xa di xɛmɛe xilie nan yi ki: Gerison, Kehati, nun Merari.

sentences.english: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon, by their families: Libni and Shimei.
sentences.susu: Gerison xa di xɛmɛe xilie nan yi ki a xabilɛ ki ma: Libini nun Simeyi.

sentences.english: And the sons of Kohath, by their families: Amram and Izhar and Hebron and Uzziel.
sentences.susu: Kehati xa di xɛmɛe a xabilɛ ki ma: Amarama, Yisehari, Xebiron nun Yusiyɛli.

sentences.english: And the sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites in the order of their fathers' houses.
sentences.susu: Merari xa di xɛmɛe a xabilɛ ki ma: Maxali nun Musi. Lewi xabilɛ nan na ki e xa denbaya ki ma.

sentences.english: From Gershon come the Libnites and the Shimeites; these are the families of the Gershonites.
sentences.susu: Gerison bɔnsɔɛ nu na Libini Simeyi xabilɛ nan na.

sentences.english: Those who were numbered of them, the males from one month old and over, were seven thousand, five hundred.
sentences.susu: Naxee xa simaya nu bara kike keren li, e xasabi lan mixi wulu solofere mixi kɛmɛ suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: The tents of the Gershonites are to be placed at the back of the House, to the west.
sentences.susu: Gerison xabilɛ nu yonkinma hɔrɔmɔlingira nan xanbi ra sogegorode mabiri ra.

sentences.english: The chief of the Gershonites is Eliasaph, the son of Lael.
sentences.susu: E xunyi nu na Layɛli xa di xɛmɛ Eliyasafa nan na.

sentences.english: In the Tent of meeting, the Gershonites are to have the care of the House, and the Tent with its cover, and the veil for the door of the Tent of meeting,
sentences.susu: Gerison xa mixie nu e ɲɔxɔɛ saxi hɔrɔmɔlingira nan xɔn ma, nun mafelenyi naxan felenma a xun ma, a nun a sode dɛ ra,

sentences.english: And the hangings for the open space round the House and the altar, and the curtain for its doorway, and all the cords needed for its use.
sentences.susu: a nun kɔlimɛ naxee nu sama hɔrɔmɔlingira nun sɛrɛxɛbade rabilinyi ma, a nun na tɛtɛ sode dɛ ra, a nun luutie e na maxirima naxee ra.

sentences.english: From Kohath come the Amramites and the Izharites and the Hebronites and the Uzzielites; these are the families of the Kohathites.
sentences.susu: Kehati xa mixie nan yi ki: Amarama xabilɛ, Yisehari xabilɛ, Xebiron xabilɛ, nun Yusiyɛli xabilɛ. Na xabilɛe nan minixi e benba Kehati ma.

sentences.english: Those who were numbered of them, the males from one month old and over, were eight thousand, six hundred, who were responsible for the care of the holy place.
sentences.susu: E xa di xɛmɛ naxee xa simaya nu bara kike keren li, e xasabi lan mixi wulu solomasaxan kɛmɛ senni nan ma. Kehati xa mixie nan nu mɛɛnima hɔrɔmɔlingira ma.

sentences.english: The tents of the Kohathites are to be placed on the south side of the House.
sentences.susu: E tan nu yonkinma hɔrɔmɔlingira yirefanyi mabiri nɛ.

sentences.english: Their chief is Elizaphan, the son of Uzziel.
sentences.susu: Yusiyɛli xa di xɛmɛ Elisafan nan nu na e xunyi ra.

sentences.english: In their care are the ark, and the table, and the lights, and the altars, and all the vessels used in the holy place, and the veil, and all they are used for.
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔlingira saatɛ kankira, teebili, lanpuie, sɛrɛxɛbadee, yirabase naxee rawalima yire sɛniyɛnxi kui, nun dugi yarasa naxan na hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, e nu taxuxi e tan nan na.

sentences.english: Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, will be head over all the Levites and overseer of those responsible for the care of the holy place.
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ birin xunyi nu na Haruna xa di xɛmɛ Eleyasari nan na. A tan nan nu Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie xun ma, naxee mɛɛnima hɔrɔmɔlingira ma.

sentences.english: From Merari come the Mahlites and the Mushites; these are the families of Merari.
sentences.susu: Merari xa mixie nan yi ki: Maxali xabilɛ nun Musi xabilɛ.

sentences.english: Those who were numbered of them, the males of a month old and over, were six thousand, two hundred.
sentences.susu: E xa di xɛmɛ naxee xa simaya nu bara kike keren li, e xasabi lan mixi wulu senni kɛmɛ firin nan ma.

sentences.english: The chief of the families of Merari was Zuriel, the son of Abihail: their tents are to be placed on the north side of the House.
sentences.susu: Abixayili xa di xɛmɛ Suriyeli nan nu na Merari xabilɛe xunyi ra. E nu yonkinma hɔrɔmɔlingira kɔɔla mabiri nɛ.

sentences.english: And in their care are to be all the boards of the Tent, with their rods and pillars and bases, and all the instruments, and all they are used for,
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔlingira xebenyie, a wuri kuyee, a kɔntigibae, a sanbunyie, a xa yirabase, nun a rawalisee nu taxuxi e tan nan na.

sentences.english: And the pillars of the open space round it, with their bases and nails and cords.
sentences.susu: E man nu e ɲɔxɔ sama kɔntigibae xɔn ma naxee nu hɔrɔmɔlingira tɛtɛ rabilinxi, a nun e sanbunyie, e xa kɔridie, nun e xa luutie.

sentences.english: And those whose tents are to be placed on the east side of the House in front of the Tent of meeting, looking to the dawn, are Moses and Aaron and his sons, who will do the work of the holy place for the children of Israel; and any strange person who comes near will be put to death.
sentences.susu: Munsa, Haruna, nun a xa di xɛmɛe nu yonkinma hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ nan na sogetede mabiri. E tan nan nu e ɲɔxɔ sama hɔrɔmɔlingira xɔn ma Isirayilaka birin xili ra. Xa mixi gbɛtɛ sa a maso hɔrɔmɔlingira ra, na kanyi xa faxa.

sentences.english: All the Levites numbered by Moses and Aaron at the order of the Lord, all the males of one month old and over numbered in the order of their families, were twenty-two thousand.
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ di xɛmɛ naxee xa simaya nu bara kike keren li, e xasabi lan mixi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin nan ma. Munsa nun Haruna nu bara e tɛngɛ e xabilɛ ki ma alɔ Alatala e yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Let all the first male children be numbered, and take the number of their names.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «Di xɛmɛ singe birin tɛngɛ Isirayilakae ya ma, naxee simaya bara kike keren li, i xa e xilie sɛbɛ.

sentences.english: And give to me the Levites (I am the Lord) in place of the first sons of the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites in place of the first births among the cattle of the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ xa findi Isirayila di xɛmɛ singe birin ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Lewi bɔnsɔɛ xa gɔɔrɛ xa findi Isirayilakae xa xurusee di singee ɲɔxɔɛ ra. N tan nan na Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: So Moses had all the first sons among the children of Israel numbered, as the Lord said to him.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Isirayila di xɛmɛ singe birin tɛngɛ alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Every first son from a month old and over was numbered by name, and the number came to twenty-two thousand, two hundred and seventy-three.
sentences.susu: Isirayila di xɛmɛ singe birin naxee xa simaya bara kike keren li, e xasabi lan mixi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin mixi kɛmɛ firin tongo solofere nun saxan nan ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Take the Levites in place of all the first sons of the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites in place of their cattle; the Levites are to be mine; I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Lewi bɔnsɔɛ xa findi Isirayila di xɛmɛ singe birin ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Lewi bɔnsɔɛ xa gɔɔrɛ xa findi Isirayilakae xa xurusee di singee ɲɔxɔɛ ra. N tan nan na Alatala ra.

sentences.english: And the price you have to give for the two hundred and seventy-three first sons of the children of Israel which are in addition to the number of the Levites,
sentences.susu: Na Isirayila di xɛmɛ singe mixi kɛmɛ firin tongo solofere nun saxan naxee xasabi dangi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ kɔnti ra,

sentences.english: Will be five shekels for every one, by the scale of the holy place (the shekel is twenty gerahs);
sentences.susu: i xa kankan xun sara gbeti giramu tongo suuli nun solofere ra naxan mɔɔli rawalima hɔrɔmɔlingira kui.

sentences.english: And this money, the price of those over the number of the Levites, is to be given to Aaron and his sons.
sentences.susu: I xa na gbeti so Haruna nun a xa di xɛmɛ yi ra, di singee xunsare ra naxee xasabi nu dangi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ xasabi ra.»

sentences.english: So Moses took the money, the price of those whose place had not been taken by the Levites;
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa na gbeti suxu naxan fixi di singee xunsare xa fe ra, naxee xasabi nu dangi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ xasabi ra.

sentences.english: From the first sons of Israel he took it, a thousand, three hundred and sixty-five shekels, by the scale of the holy place;
sentences.susu: A naxa na gbeti kilo fu nun suuli nun a tagi rasuxu Isirayila di singee yi ra. Gbeti nan a ra naxan nu rawalima hɔrɔmɔlingira kui.

sentences.english: And he gave the money to Aaron and his sons, as the Lord had said.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa na xunsare gbeti so Haruna nun a xa di xɛmɛe yi ra alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Let the sons of Kohath, from among the sons of Levi, be numbered by their families, in the order of their fathers' houses;
sentences.susu: «Kehati xa die tɛngɛ Lewi bɔnsɔɛe ya ma a xabilɛ nun a denbaya ki ma,

sentences.english: All those from thirty to fifty years old who are able to do the work of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: naxee xa simaya bara ɲɛ tongo saxan li han ɲɛ tongo suuli, naxee fama hɔrɔmɔlingira wali rabade.

sentences.english: And this is to be the work of the sons of Kohath in connection with the most holy things.
sentences.susu: Kehati xa die lanma e xa mɛɛni se sɛniyɛnxie ma naxee na hɔrɔmɔlingira kui.

sentences.english: When all the people go forward, Aaron is to go in with his sons, and take down the veil of the curtain, covering the ark of witness with it;
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae na keli sigade, Haruna nun a xa di xɛmɛe xa dugi yarasa ragoro, e saatɛ kankira makoto a ra.

sentences.english: And putting over it the leather cover and over that a blue cloth; and putting its rods in place.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi e xa foye yɛxɛ kiri sa na fari, a nun gɛrɛ dugi. A dɔnxɔɛ ra e xa wuri kuyee raso kankira tongosee ra.»

sentences.english: And on the table of the holy bread they are to put a blue cloth, and on it all the vessels, the spoons and the basins and the cups; and the holy bread with them;
sentences.susu: «E na gɛrɛ dugi gbɛtɛ itala teebili ma, e xa piletie, tɔnbilie, nun kundie sa na fari, naxee rawalima wɛni sɛrɛxɛe ra. Taami naxan bama sɛrɛxɛ ra, na fan sama nɛ na teebili nan fari.

sentences.english: And over them they are to put a red cloth, covering it with a leather cover, and putting its rods in their places.
sentences.susu: E dugi gbeeli nan sama na birin xun ma, e fa foye yɛxɛ kiri itala na fari. Na dangi xanbi e xa wuri kuyee raso teebili tongosee ra.»

sentences.english: And they are to take a blue cloth, covering with it the light-support with its lights and its instruments and its trays and all the oil vessels which are used for it:
sentences.susu: «E xa gɛrɛ dugi dusu lanpui dɔxɔse, lanpuie, a yirabasee, xube sasee, nun ture kundie xun ma.

sentences.english: All these they are to put in a leather cover, and put it on the frame.
sentences.susu: E xa na birin mafilin foye yɛxɛ kiri nan kui, e fa a sa xaninse fari.

sentences.english: On the gold altar they are to put a blue cloth, covering it with a leather cover; and they are to put its rods in their places.
sentences.susu: E xa gɛrɛ dugi itala sɛrɛxɛbade xɛɛma daaxi fari, e fa a makoto foye yɛxɛ kiri ra, e wuri kuyee raso a tongosee ra.

sentences.english: All the vessels which are used in the holy place they are to put in a blue cloth, covering them with a leather cover, and put them on the frame.
sentences.susu: Na hɔrɔmɔlingira raxunmase birin makotoma garɛ dugi nan na, e e mafilin foye yɛxɛ kiri kui, e fa na sa xaninse fari.

sentences.english: And they are to take away the burned waste from the altar, and put a purple cloth on it;
sentences.susu: E xa xube ba sɛrɛxɛbade wure gbeeli daaxi kui, e fa dugi gbeeli dusu a xun na.

sentences.english: Placing on the cloth all its vessels, the fire-baskets, the meat-hooks, the spades, and the basins; all the vessels of the altar; they are to put a leather cover over all these, and put its rods in their places.
sentences.susu: E na a yirabasee sa a fari, alɔ surayi gansee, suxumɛe, pelie, nun pɔɔti xungbee, e xa na birin mafilin foye yɛxɛ kiri ra, e fa wuri kuyee raso a tongose ra.

sentences.english: And after the holy place and all its vessels have been covered up by Aaron and his sons, when the tents of the people go forward, the sons of Kohath are to come and take it up; but the holy things may not be touched by them for fear of death.
sentences.susu: Haruna nun a xa di xɛmɛe na gɛ na xunmase sɛniyɛnxie nun a yirabasee makotode, Kehati xa die lanma e xa na birin xanin biyaasi kui. Kɔnɔ e mu lanma e xa din na se sɛniyɛnxie ra xa na mu e faxama nɛ. Kehati bɔnsɔɛe xa wali nan na ki.

sentences.english: And Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, is to be responsible for the oil for the light, and the sweet perfumes for burning, and the regular meal offering, and the holy oil; the House and the holy place and everything in it will be in his care.
sentences.susu: Haruna sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa di xɛmɛ Eleyasari nan a ɲɔxɔ sama lanpui ture, surayi, sansi sɛrɛxɛ, nun ture sɛniyɛnxi xɔn ma. Hɔrɔmɔlingira raxunmase sɛniyɛnxie nun a yirabase birin taxuxi a tan nan na.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa nun Haruna bɛ,

sentences.english: Do not let the family of the Kohathites be cut off from among the Levites;
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa lu Kehati bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe xa ba Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ya ma.

sentences.english: But do this to them, so that life and not death may be theirs when they come near the most holy things; let Aaron and his sons go in and give to every one his work and that which he is to take up;
sentences.susu: Haruna nun a xa di xɛmɛe xa e mati hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, e fa e xa wali masen kankan bɛ alako e naxa e makɔrɛ se sɛniyɛnxie ra, e fa faxa.

sentences.english: But they themselves are not to go in to see the holy place, even for a minute, for fear of death.
sentences.susu: E mu lan e xa e ya masa se sɛniyɛnxie ma, hali dondoronti, xa na mu e faxama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Let the sons of Gershon be numbered by families, in the order of their fathers' houses;
sentences.susu: «Gerison bɔnsɔɛ tɛngɛ a xabilɛ nun a denbaya ki ma,

sentences.english: All those from thirty to fifty years old who are able to do the work of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: naxee xa simaya bara ɲɛ tongo saxan li han ɲɛ tongo suuli, naxee fama hɔrɔmɔlingira wali rabade.

sentences.english: This is to be the work of the Gershonites, the things they are to do and take up.
sentences.susu: Gerison xabilɛ xa wali nan yi ki.

sentences.english: They are to take up the curtains of the House, and the Tent of meeting with its cover and the leather cover over it, and the hangings for the door of the Tent of meeting;
sentences.susu: E hɔrɔmɔlingira mafelenyie nan xaninma, a nun mafelenyi naxan yailanxi foye yɛxɛ kiri ra, a nun mafelenyi naxan gbakuxi hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the hangings for the open space round the House and the altar, and the curtain for its doorway, with the cords and all the things used for them; whatever is necessary for these, they are to do.
sentences.susu: E xa tɛtɛ mafelenyie fan xanin naxee hɔrɔmɔlingira nun sɛrɛxɛbade rabilinma, a nun naxan gbakuxi tɛtɛ sode dɛ ra, a nun tɛtɛ luutie. E xa e ɲɔxɔ sa na se mɔɔli birin xɔn ma.

sentences.english: From the mouth of Aaron and his sons the Gershonites will have word about all the things they are to do and take up; you are to give them their orders.
sentences.susu: Gerison xabilɛ walima Haruna nun a xa di xɛmɛe xa yaamari nan bun ma, a findi kotee xaninfe ra, a findi wali gbɛtɛ rabafe ra. Nee nan a falama e bɛ e lan e xa naxan naba, a nun e lan e xa naxan xanin.

sentences.english: This is the work of the family of the Gershonites in the Tent of meeting, and they will be under the direction of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.
sentences.susu: Gerison bɔnsɔɛ xa wali nan na ki hɔrɔmɔlingira xa fe ra. E na wali rabama Haruna sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa di xɛmɛ Itamari xa yaamari nan bun ma.»

sentences.english: The sons of Merari are to be numbered by families, in the order of their fathers' houses;
sentences.susu: «I xa Merari bɔnsɔɛ fan tɛngɛ a xabilɛ nun a denbaya ki ma,

sentences.english: Every one from thirty to fifty years old who is able to do the work of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: naxee xa simaya bara ɲɛ tongo saxan li han ɲɛ tongo suuli, naxee fama hɔrɔmɔlingira wali rabade.

sentences.english: And this is their part in the work of the Tent of meeting: the transport of the boards and the rods of the Tent, with the pillars and their bases;
sentences.susu: See nan yi ki e tan lan e xa naxee maxanin hɔrɔmɔlingira see ra: a xebenyie, a wuri kuyee, a kɔntigibae, nun e sanbunyie.

sentences.english: And the pillars of the open space outside it, with their bases and their nails and cords and all the instruments used, and everything which has to be done there; all the instruments for which they are responsible are to be numbered by name.
sentences.susu: E xa tɛtɛ fan xanin, a nun a kɔntigibae, e sanbunyie, e sɔrɔnsee, e xa luutie, e xa yirabasee, nun e xa walise birin. Wo see masen kankan bɛ, a lanma a xa naxee xanin.

sentences.english: This is the work which the sons of Merari are to do in connection with the Tent of meeting, under the direction of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.
sentences.susu: Merari bɔnsɔɛe xa wali birin nan na ki hɔrɔmɔlingira xa fe ra. E walima Haruna sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa di xɛmɛ Itamari xa yaamari nan bun ma.»

sentences.english: So Moses and Aaron and the chiefs of the people took in hand the numbering of the sons of the Kohathites, by families, in the order of their fathers' houses;
sentences.susu: Munsa, Haruna, nun ɲama kuntigie naxa Kehati xa mixie tɛngɛ e xabilɛ nun e xa denbaya ki ma,

sentences.english: Numbering all those from thirty to fifty years old who were able to do the work in the Tent of meeting;
sentences.susu: xɛmɛ naxee xa simaya bara ɲɛ tongo saxan li han ɲɛ tongo suuli, naxee fama hɔrɔmɔlingira wali rabade.

sentences.english: And the number of all these was two thousand, seven hundred and fifty.
sentences.susu: E xasabi lan mixi wulu firin, mixi kɛmɛ solofere, tongo suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: This is the number of those of the Kohathites who did the work in the Tent of meeting, as they were numbered by Moses and Aaron at the order of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛe nan na ki Kehati xabilɛe ya ma naxee hɔrɔmɔlingira wali rabama. Munsa nun Haruna bara e tɛngɛ alɔ Alatala Munsa yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And those of the sons of Gershon who were numbered by families,
sentences.susu: E naxa Gerison xa mixie tɛngɛ e xabilɛ nun e xa denbaya ki ma,

sentences.english: All those from thirty to fifty years old who were able to do the work in the Tent of meeting,
sentences.susu: xɛmɛ naxee xa simaya bara ɲɛ tongo saxan li han ɲɛ tongo suuli, naxee fama hɔrɔmɔlingira wali rabade.

sentences.english: Who were numbered by families in the order of their fathers' houses, were two thousand, six hundred and thirty.
sentences.susu: E xasabi lan mixi wulu firin, kɛmɛ senni, tongo saxan nan ma.

sentences.english: This is the number of the sons of Gershon who did the work in the Tent of meeting, as they were numbered by Moses and Aaron at the order of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛe nan na ki Gerison xabilɛe ya ma naxee hɔrɔmɔlingira wali rabama. Munsa nun Haruna bara e tɛngɛ alɔ Alatala Munsa yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And those of the sons of Merari who were numbered by families, in the order of their fathers' houses,
sentences.susu: E naxa Merari xa mixie tɛngɛ e xabilɛ nun e xa denbaya ki ma,

sentences.english: All those from thirty to fifty years old who did the work in the Tent of meeting,
sentences.susu: xɛmɛ naxee xa simaya bara ɲɛ tongo saxan li han ɲɛ tongo suuli, naxee fama hɔrɔmɔlingira wali rabade.

sentences.english: Who were numbered by families, were three thousand, two hundred.
sentences.susu: E xasabi lan mixi wulu saxan mixi kɛmɛ firin nan ma.

sentences.english: This is the number of the sons of Merari, numbered by Moses and Aaron at the order of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛe nan na ki Merari xabilɛe ya ma naxee hɔrɔmɔlingira wali rabama. Munsa nun Haruna bara e tɛngɛ alɔ Alatala Munsa yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And all the Levites who were numbered by Moses and Aaron and the chiefs of the people, by families, in the order of their fathers' houses,
sentences.susu: Munsa, Haruna, nun Isirayila kuntigie, e Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixi naxee tɛngɛxi e xabilɛ nun e xa denbaya ki ma,

sentences.english: Those from thirty to fifty years old who were able to do the work of the Tent of meeting and of its transport,
sentences.susu: xɛmɛ naxee xa simaya bara ɲɛ tongo saxan li han ɲɛ tongo suuli, naxee fama hɔrɔmɔlingira wali rabade.

sentences.english: Came to eight thousand, five hundred and eighty.
sentences.susu: E xasabi lan mixi wulu solomasaxan, kɛmɛ suuli, tongo solomasaxan nan ma.

sentences.english: At the order of the Lord they were numbered by Moses, every one in relation to his work and to his part in the transport; so they were numbered by Moses at the order of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛe nun e xa walie nan na ki Lewi naxee tɛngɛxi Munsa nun Haruna saabui ra alɔ Alatala Munsa yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Give orders to the children of Israel to put outside the tent-circle every leper, and anyone who has any sort of flow from his body, and anyone who is unclean from the touch of the dead;
sentences.susu: «Isirayilakae yamari e xa kunɛ kanyi nun kɔrɔsila kanyi birin namini e yonkinde, a nun mixi naxee dinxi fure nde ra, e fa findi sɛniyɛntaree ra.

sentences.english: Male or female they are to be put outside the tent-circle, so that they may not make unclean my resting-place among them.
sentences.susu: A findi xɛmɛ ra, a findi ginɛ ra, wo e ramini wo ya ma, e xa sa lu e xati ma alako e naxa sɛniyɛntareɲa raso wo ya ma, n sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: So the children of Israel did as the Lord had said to Moses, and put them outside the tent-circle.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa a raba alɔ Alatala a yamarixi ki naxɛ, e naxa na mixie ramini e ya ma. Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ Munsa bɛ, e naxa a raba na ki.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel, If a man or a woman does any of the sins of men, going against the word of the Lord, and is in the wrong;
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, a findi xɛmɛ ra, a findi ginɛ ra, naxan yo na haakɛ nde raba a boore ra, haakɛ naxan findima Alatala xui matandife ra, na fe dɔxɔxi a xun ma.

sentences.english: Let them say openly what they have done; and make payment for the wrong done, with the addition of a fifth part, and give it to him to whom the wrong was done.
sentences.susu: A lan nɛ a xa a ti na haakɛ ra, a xa na fe yailan a nun na kanyi tagi, a man fa na fe kanaxi dɔxɔ suuli nde sa na fari.

sentences.english: But if the man has no relation to whom the payment may be made, then the payment for sin made to the Lord will be the priest's, in addition to the sheep offered to take away his sin.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li a haakɛ rabaxi naxan na, a bara faxa, a xa mixi yo mu na naxan nɔma na fe yailanxi rasuxude, na findima Alatala nan gbe ra, a so sɛrɛxɛdubɛ yi ra. Fe kanɛ man fa yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren ba a xa yunubi xafari ra, a a so sɛrɛxɛdubɛ yi ra.

sentences.english: And every offering lifted up of all the holy things which the children of Israel give to the priest, will be his.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae na sɛrɛxɛ ba, e a fi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ma, na sɛrɛxɛ findima na sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nan gbe ra.

sentences.english: And every man's holy things will be his: whatever a man gives to the priest will be his.
sentences.susu: Naxan birin sɛrɛxɛ bama, a naxan bama, a gbe nan na ki, kɔnɔ a naxan fima sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ma, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ gbe nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel, If any man's wife does wrong, sinning against him
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, e yi nan nabama xa ginɛ nde sa yɛnɛ raba.

sentences.english: By taking as her lover another man, and keeps it secret so that her husband has no knowledge of it, and there is no witness against her, and she is not taken in the act;
sentences.susu: Xa e nun xɛmɛ gbɛtɛ bara e sa gundo ra, ginɛ xa mɔri mu na kolon, seede mu na, mixi mu a suxu a kui,

sentences.english: If the spirit of doubt comes into her husband's heart, and he has doubts of his wife, with good cause; or if he has doubts of her without cause:
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ a xa mɔri bara a xa ginɛ tɔɔnɛ fɔlɔ, xa a xa ginɛ sɛniyɛnxi, xa na mu a mu sɛniyɛnxi,

sentences.english: Then let him take her to the priest, offering for her the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal, without oil or perfume; for it is a meal offering of a bitter spirit, a meal offering keeping wrongdoing in mind.
sentences.susu: a xa a xa ginɛ xanin sɛrɛxɛdubɛ yire, a mɛngi kilo saxan ba a bɛ sɛrɛxɛ ra ture nun surayi mu na naxan xun, barima tɔɔnɛ sɛrɛxɛ nan a ra naxan bama a kolonfe ra xa yunubi rabaxi.»

sentences.english: And the priest will make her come near and put her before the Lord;
sentences.susu: «Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa na ginɛ ti Alatala ya i,

sentences.english: And the priest will take holy water in a pot and put in it dust from the floor of the House;
sentences.susu: a fa xube makɔ bɔxi ma hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, a a masunbu ye sɛniyɛnxi ra fɛɲɛ kui.

sentences.english: And he will make the woman come before the Lord with her hair loose, and will put the meal offering, the offering of a bitter spirit, in her hands; and the priest will take in his hand the bitter water causing the curse;
sentences.susu: Ginɛ na ti Alatala ya i, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa a xunsɛxɛ fulun, a fa tɔɔnɛ sɛrɛxɛ sa ginɛ bɛlɛxɛ maratuse ra. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ tan xa na ye tongo naxan findima danka ra, a a lintan ginɛ ya i.»

sentences.english: And he will make her take an oath, and say to her, If no man has been your lover and you have not been with another in place of your husband, you are free from this bitter water causing the curse;
sentences.susu: «Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ginɛ rakalima nɛ, a a fala, ‹Xa a sa li i tan nun xɛmɛ gbɛtɛ mu kafuxi, i mu i xa mɔri yanfa, i mu sɛniyɛntareɲa sɔtɔ futi kui, i xa ratanga dankɛ ma yi ye fama naxan na.

sentences.english: But if you have been with another in place of your husband and have made yourself unclean with a lover:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa a sa li, i bara i xa mɔri yanfa wo xa futi kui, i nun xɛmɛ gbɛtɛ bara kafu sɛniyɛntareɲa kui,

sentences.english: Then the priest will put the oath of the curse on the woman, and say to her, May the Lord make you a curse and an oath among your people, sending on you wasting of the legs and disease of the stomach;
sentences.susu: Alatala xa a ragiri i furi xa kana. Na kui i ngaxakerenyie i dankama nɛ, e i konbi.

sentences.english: And this water of the curse will go into your body, causing disease of your stomach and wasting of your legs: and the woman will say, So be it.
sentences.susu: Yi ye naxan fama dankɛ ra, a xa i furi mafuntu, a i xɔrɛ maba.› Ginɛ xa a ratin a falafe ra, ‹Amina, amina.›»

sentences.english: And the priest will put these curses in a book, washing out the writing with the bitter water;
sentences.susu: «Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ na gɛ na dankɛ sɛbɛde kiri ma, a xa na kiri xa na ye sɛniyɛnxi ra,

sentences.english: And he will give to the woman the bitter water for drink; and the bitter water causing the curse will go into her.
sentences.susu: a fa a fi ginɛ ma, a xa a min. Na ye naxan nɔma findide dankɛ ra, a soma a fate i.

sentences.english: And the priest will take from her hand the meal offering of doubt, waving it before the Lord, and will take it to the altar;
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ tɔɔnɛ sɛrɛxɛ rasuxuma nɛ ginɛ yi ra, a a dɛntɛgɛ Alatala bɛ sɛrɛxɛbade yire.

sentences.english: And he will take some of it in his hand, burning it on the altar as a sign, and then he will give the woman the bitter water.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa mɛngi suxui keren gan sɛrɛxɛbade fari, a findi sɛrɛxɛ tɔnxuma ra. A na gɛ na ra, a xa na ye fi ginɛ ma, a xa a min.

sentences.english: And it will be that if the woman has become unclean, sinning against her husband, when she has taken the bitter water it will go into her body, causing disease of the stomach and wasting of the legs, and she will be a curse among her people.
sentences.susu: A na na ye min, xa a sa li na ginɛ bara findi sɛniyɛntare ra, a bara a xa mɔri yanfa, na ye naxan findima dankɛ ra, a soma nɛ a fate i, a a tɔɔrɔ ki fanyi ra. A furi funtuma nɛ, a xɔrɛ mabama nɛ, a ngaxakerenyie fama nɛ a dankade.»

sentences.english: But if she is clean she will be free and will have offspring.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ xa a sa li a mu sɛniyɛntareɲa yo rabaxi, tɔɔɲɛgɛ bama nɛ a xun ma, a man nɔma di baride.

sentences.english: This is the law for testing a wife who goes with another in place of her husband and becomes unclean;
sentences.susu: Tɔɔnɛ sɛriyɛ nan na ki naxan nawalima xa ginɛ findima sɛniyɛntare ra, a a xa mɔri yanfa futi kui,

sentences.english: Or for a husband who, in a bitter spirit, has doubts in his heart about his wife; let him take her to the priest, who will put in force this law.
sentences.susu: xa na mu a ra, tɔɔnɛ xaxili na so xɛmɛ furi, a fa siikɛ a xa ginɛ ma. A a xa ginɛ xaninma Alatala ya i, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ fa na sɛriyɛ rabatu a xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Then the man will be free from all wrong, and the woman's sin will be on her.
sentences.susu: Na kui yunubi mu na na xɛmɛ ma, kɔnɔ ginɛ tan a xa yunubi sare sɔtɔma nɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel, If a man or a woman takes an oath to keep himself separate and give himself to the Lord;
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, xa xɛmɛ nde, xa na mu ginɛ nde sa laayidi tongo Alatala bɛ, a xa lu a sago, na nan na ki a xa findi Nasari ra,

sentences.english: He is to keep himself from wine and strong drink, and take no mixed wine or strong drink or any drink made from grapes, or any grapes, green or dry.
sentences.susu: na kanyi mu lan a xa wɛni nun beere min. A naxa sese min naxan kelixi wɛni bogi ma, xa na mu beere ma. A naxa wɛni bogi bunda don, a naxa a xare don.

sentences.english: All the time he is separate he may take nothing made from the grape-vine, from its seeds to its skin.
sentences.susu: A tɛmui naxan birin nabama a xa Nasariya kui, a naxa sese don naxan keli wɛni bili ma, keli a bogi ma a sa dɔxɔ a xɔri ra.»

sentences.english: All the time he is under his oath let no blade come near his head; till the days while he is separate are ended he is holy and his hair may not be cut.
sentences.susu: «A xa Nasariya kui, a mu lanma a xunyi xa bi. A xa lu sɛniyɛnyi kui, a xunsɛxɛ xa nu kuya ra tun.

sentences.english: All the time he is separate he may not come near any dead body.
sentences.susu: Na waxati bun ma, a mu lan a xa a maso fure ra,

sentences.english: He may not make himself unclean for his father or his mother, his sister or his brother, if death comes to them; because he is under an oath to keep himself separate for God.
sentences.susu: hali a findi a baba ra, a nga, a taara, xa na mu a ra a xunya fure ra. A na Alatala nan sago tun, alɔ a xunsɛxɛ kɛɲa a masenxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: All the time he is separate he is holy to the Lord.
sentences.susu: A tɛmui naxan birin nabama a xa Nasariya kui, a luma sɛniyɛnyi nan kui Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: If death comes suddenly to a man at his side, so that he becomes unclean, let his hair be cut off on the day when he is made clean, on the seventh day.
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi nde sa faxa a fɛ ma a tɛrɛnna ki ma, a xunsɛxɛ bara findi se sɛniyɛntare ra. Na tɛmui a xa sɛniyɛn lɔxun keren bun ma, a man fa a xunyi bi na xi solofere lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: And on the eighth day let him take to the priest, at the door of the Tent of meeting, two doves or two young pigeons;
sentences.susu: A xi solomasaxan lɔxɔɛ, a fogotara firin nan xaninma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xɔn ma hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra, xa na mu ganbɛ firin.

sentences.english: And the priest will give one for a sin-offering and the other for a burned offering to take away the sin which came on him on account of the dead, and he will make his head holy that same day.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xɔni keren nan bama yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, boore findima a gan daaxi nan na, alako a xa yunubi xa xafari, barima a dinfe fure ra, na findima yunubi nan na. Na lɔxɔɛ a man xa a xunyi rasɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: And he will give to the Lord his days of being separate, offering a he-lamb of the first year as an offering for error: but the earlier days will be a loss, because he became unclean.
sentences.susu: A na gɛ na ra, a man xa gbilen a xa laayidi ma. Fo a xa yɛxɛɛ keren ba yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ ra, naxan ɲɛ keren a ra a xa yunubi xafarife ra. Lɔxɔɛ naxee bara dangi, nee mu kɔntima sɔnɔn, barima a nu bara sɛniyɛntareɲa sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: And this is the law for him who is separate, when the necessary days are ended: he is to come to the door of the Tent of meeting,
sentences.susu: «Mixi na gɛ Nasariya rabade, a xa bira yi sɛriyɛ nan fɔxɔ ra. A xa siga hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra,

sentences.english: And make his offering to the Lord; one he-lamb of the first year, without a mark, for a burned offering, and one female lamb of the first year, without a mark, for a sin-offering, and one male sheep, without a mark, for peace-offerings,
sentences.susu: a xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ba Alatala bɛ, yɛxɛɛ naxan bara ɲɛ keren sɔtɔ, lanyuru yo mu na naxan ma. A xa yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ fan ba, yɛxɛɛ ginɛ naxan bara ɲɛ keren sɔtɔ, lanyuru yo mu na naxan ma. A xa xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ba, yɛxɛɛ kontonyi, lanyuru yo mu na naxan ma.

sentences.english: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of the best meal mixed with oil, and thin unleavened cakes covered with oil, with their meal offering and drink offerings.
sentences.susu: A xa sɛrɛxɛ ndee sa na fari, alɔ sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ, wɛni sɛrɛxɛ, taami lɛbinitare, lɛki yailanxi ture ra, nun lɛki ture masoxi naxee ma.

sentences.english: And the priest will take them before the Lord, and make his sin-offering and his burned offering;
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ na sɛrɛxɛ see nan dɛntɛgɛma Alatala bɛ, a fa yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ba, a nun sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi.

sentences.english: Giving the sheep of the peace-offerings, with the basket of unleavened bread; and at the same time, the priest will make his meal offering and his drink offering.
sentences.susu: A xa na taami lɛbinitare masen Alatala bɛ, a xa na yɛxɛɛ kontonyi ba xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ra, a xa sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ nun wɛni sɛrɛxɛ sa na fari.»

sentences.english: Then let his long hair, the sign of his oath, be cut off at the door of the Tent of meeting, and let him put it on the fire on which the peace-offerings are burning.
sentences.susu: «Na tɛmui Nasari xa a xunsɛxɛ bi hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra, a naxan fixi Alatala ma. A xa na raso tɛ xɔɔra xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ na bafe dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And the priest will take the cooked leg of the sheep and one unleavened cake and one thin cake out of the basket, and put them on the hands of the separate one after his hair has been cut,
sentences.susu: Nasari na gɛ a xunsɛxɛ bide, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ yɛxɛɛ kontonyi bɛlɛxɛ ganxi keren nan tongoma a bɛlɛxɛ ra, a nun lɛki lɛbinitare firin naxee na debe kui.

sentences.english: Waving them for a wave offering before the Lord; this is holy for the priest, together with the waved breast and the leg which is lifted up; after that, the man may take wine.
sentences.susu: A xa e dɛntɛgɛ Alatala bɛ e lintanfe ra. Na findi donse sɛniyɛnxi nan na sɛrɛxɛdubɛ bɛ, a nun na yɛxɛɛ ganyanyi nun a tabe. Na dangi xanbi, Nasari nɔma wɛni minde sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: This is the law for him who takes an oath to keep himself separate, and for his offering to the Lord on that account, in addition to what he may be able to get; this is the law of his oath, which he will have to keep.
sentences.susu: Nasari sɛriyɛ nan na ki. A lanma a xa na sɛrɛxɛe ba Alatala bɛ alɔ a ɲanigexi ki naxɛ, a nun se gbɛtɛe a nɔma naxan na. Fo a xa a xa Nasari laayidi rakamali a sɛriyɛ ki ma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to Aaron and his sons, These are the words of blessing which are to be used by you in blessing the children of Israel; say to them,
sentences.susu: «A fala Haruna nun a xa die bɛ, e xa duba Isirayilakae bɛ yi ki nɛ:

sentences.english: May the Lord send his blessing on you and keep you:
sentences.susu: ‹Alatala xa baraka sa i xa fe, a xa i kanta.

sentences.english: May the light of the Lord's face be shining on you in grace:
sentences.susu: Alatala yatagi xa nɔrɔ i ma, a xa hinnɛ i ra.

sentences.english: May the Lord's approval be resting on you and may he give you peace.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa a ya rafindi i ma, a xa bɔɲɛsa fi i ma.›

sentences.english: So they will put my name on the children of Israel, and I will give them my blessing.
sentences.susu: E dubama Isirayilakae bɛ na ki nɛ, n fan baraka sama nɛ e ma.»

sentences.english: And when Moses had put up the House completely, and had put oil on it and made it holy, with all the things in it, and had made the altar and all its vessels holy with oil;
sentences.susu: Munsa to gɛ hɔrɔmɔlingira tide, a naxa ture sɛniyɛnxi sa a ma, a nun a xunmasee, a xa sɛrɛxɛbadee, nun a yirabasee, alako nee xa sɛniyɛn Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: Then the chiefs of Israel, the heads of their fathers' houses, made offerings; these were the chiefs of the tribes, who were over those who were numbered.
sentences.susu: Isirayila kuntigie, xabilɛ xunyi naxee bɔnsɔɛe tɛngɛ, e naxa hadiyae ba Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And they came with their offerings before the Lord, six covered carts and twelve oxen; a cart for every two of the chiefs, and for every one an ox.
sentences.susu: E naxa fa sarɛti makotoxi senni nun ninge fu nun firin na hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra, e xa findi e xa sɛrɛxɛ ra Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Take the things from them, to be used for the work of the Tent of meeting; and give them to the Levites, to every man what is needed for his work.
sentences.susu: «Yi hadiyae rasuxu e yi ra hɔrɔmɔlingira wali xa fe ra. E taxu Lewi bɔnsɔɛ xa mixie ra kankan xa wali bɛrɛ ra.»

sentences.english: So Moses took the carts and the oxen and gave them to the Levites.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa na sarɛtie nun ningee so Lewi xa mixie yi ra.

sentences.english: Two carts and four oxen he gave to the sons of Gershon for their work;
sentences.susu: A naxa sarɛti firin nun ninge naani so Gerison xabilɛ yi ra e xa wali bɛrɛ ra.

sentences.english: And four carts and eight oxen he gave to the sons of Merari for their work, under the direction of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.
sentences.susu: A naxa sarɛti naani nun ninge solomasaxan so Merari xabilɛ yi ra e xa wali bɛrɛ ra. E nu na Haruna sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa di Itamari xa yaamari nan bun ma.

sentences.english: But to the sons of Kohath he gave nothing; because they had the care of the holy place, taking it about on their backs.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a mu sese so Kehati xabilɛ tan yi, barima a nu lanma e xa se sɛniyɛnxie maxanin e tunki fari alɔ Alatala e yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the chiefs gave an offering for the altar on the day when the holy oil was put on it; they made their offering before the altar.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛbade nɛɛnɛ xa wali singe, ture sɛniyɛnxi to maso a ma tɛmui naxɛ, kuntigie naxa fa e xa sɛrɛxɛe ra sɛrɛxɛbade yire.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Let every chief on his day give his offering to make the altar holy.
sentences.susu: Alatala nu bara a masen Munsa bɛ, «Lɔxɔɛ yo lɔxɔɛ mixi keren xa fa a xa hadiya ra sɛrɛxɛbade nɛɛnɛ xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And he who made his offering on the first day was Nahshon, the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:

sentences.english: And his offering was one silver plate, a hundred and thirty shekels in weight, one silver basin of seventy shekels, by the scale of the holy place; the two of them full of the best meal mixed with oil for a meal offering;
sentences.susu: a naxa fa yi hadiyae ra: pileti keren naxan yailanxi gbeti kilo fu nun suuli ra, a nun pɔɔti keren naxan yailanxi gbeti kilo keren na alɔ se maniyama ki naxɛ hɔrɔmɔlingira kui. E firin nafexi sansi xɔri dinxi ra, ture masunbuxi naxan na, alako a xa findi sansi sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: On the ninth day Abidan, the son of Gideoni, chief of the children of Benjamin:
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ solomanaani nde, Gideyoni xa di Abidan fatanfe Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ ra,

sentences.english: On the eleventh day Pagiel, the son of Ochran, chief of the children of Asher:
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ fu nun keren nde, Okiran xa di Pagiyɛli fatanfe Aseri bɔnsɔɛ ra,

sentences.english: On the twelfth day Ahira, the son of Enan, chief of the children of Naphtali:
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ fu nun firin nde, Enan xa di Axira fatanfe Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ ra,

sentences.english: His offering was one silver plate, a hundred and thirty shekels in weight, one silver basin of seventy shekels, by the scale of the holy place; the two of them full of the best meal mixed with oil for a meal offering;
sentences.susu: a naxa fa yi hadiyae ra: pileti keren naxan yailanxi gbeti kilo fu nun suuli ra, a nun pɔɔti keren naxan yailanxi gbeti kilo keren na alɔ se maniyama ki naxɛ hɔrɔmɔlingira kui. E firin nafexi sansi xɔri dinxi ra, ture masunbuxi naxan na, alako a xa findi sansi sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: And for the peace-offerings, two oxen, five male sheep, five he-goats, five he-lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira, the son of Enan.
sentences.susu: a nun naxee bama xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ra alɔ ninge firin, yɛxɛɛ kontonyi suuli, nun yɛxɛɛ suuli naxee xa simaya bara ɲɛ keren li. Enan xa di Axira xa hadiya nan na ki.

sentences.english: These were the offerings given for the altar by the chiefs of Israel, when the holy oil was put on it: twelve silver plates, twelve silver basins, twelve gold spoons;
sentences.susu: Isirayila kuntigie xa hadiya malanxie findixi yi nan na sɛrɛxɛbade nɛɛnɛ xa fe ra: pileti gbeti daaxi fu nun firin, pɔɔti gbeti daaxi fu nun firin, nun pɔɔti xɛɛma daaxi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The weight of every silver plate was a hundred and thirty shekels, and of every basin seventy; the weight of all the silver of the vessels was two thousand and four hundred shekels, by the scale of the holy place;
sentences.susu: Pileti keren keren lanxi gbeti kilo keren nun a tagi nan ma. Pɔɔti keren keren lanxi gbeti kilo keren nan ma. Se naxee yailanxi gbeti ra, nee lanxi kilo mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nan ma, alɔ se maniyama ki naxɛ hɔrɔmɔlingira kui.

sentences.english: The weight of the twelve gold spoons of spice for burning was ten shekels for every one, by the scale of the holy place; all the gold of the spoons was a hundred and twenty shekels;
sentences.susu: Pɔɔti xɛɛma daaxi fu nun firin lanxi xɛɛma giramu kɛmɛ giramu fu nun naani nan ma, alɔ se maniyama ki naxɛ hɔrɔmɔlingira kui. Na pɔɔti fu nun firin lanxi xɛɛma kilo keren nun a tagi nan ma. E birin nafexi surayi nan na.

sentences.english: All the oxen, for the burned offering were twelve, the male sheep twelve, the he-lambs of the first year twelve, with their meal offering; and the males of the goats for sin-offering twelve;
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi xuruse xasabi naxa lan tuura fu nun firin ma, a nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi fu nun firin, nun yɛxɛɛ fu nun firin naxee xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ keren li, a nun e xa sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ. Yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ xuruse xasabi naxa lan sikɔtɛ fu nun firin ma.

sentences.english: And all the oxen for the peace-offerings, twenty-four oxen, the male sheep sixty, and the he-goats sixty, the he-lambs of the first year sixty. This was given for the altar after the holy oil was put on it.
sentences.susu: Xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ xa xuruse xasabi naxa lan tuura mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani ma, yɛxɛɛ kontonyi tongo senni, sikɔtɛ tongo senni, nun yɛxɛɛ tongo senni naxee bara ɲɛ keren sɔtɔ. Nee nan findi hadiyae ra sɛrɛxɛbade xa wali fɔlɔ tɛmui, ture sɛniyɛnxi to sa a ma.

sentences.english: And when Moses went into the Tent of meeting to have talk with him, then the Voice came to his ears from over the cover which was on the ark of witness, from between the two winged ones. And he had talk with him.
sentences.susu: Munsa to so hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, a nun Alatala xa sumun, a naxa Alatala xui mɛ saatɛ kankira dɛrakote fari, a masenyi tima a bɛ malekɛ firinyie sawurɛ tagi naxee na na kankira fari.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to Aaron, When you put the lights in their places, the seven lights will give light in front of the support.
sentences.susu: «A fala Haruna bɛ, a xa lanpui solofere dɔxɔ alako e xa yanba e dɔxɔse ya ra.»

sentences.english: And Aaron did so; he put the lights in their places so that they gave light in front of the support, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: Haruna a raba na ki nɛ. A naxa lanpui dɔxɔ alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ Munsa bɛ.

sentences.english: The support for the lights was of hammered gold work, from its base to its flowers it was of hammered work; from the design which the Lord had given to Moses, he made the support for the lights.
sentences.susu: Lanpuie dɔxɔse nu rafalaxi xɛɛma dinxi nan na, kelife a sanbunyi ma han a xunyi, alɔ Alatala a masenxi Munsa bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Take the Levites out from among the children of Israel and make them clean.
sentences.susu: «Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ba Isirayilakae ya ma, i xa e rasɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: And this is how you are to make them clean: let the holy water which takes away sin be put on them, and let the hair all over their bodies be cut off with a sharp blade, and let their clothing be washed and their bodies made clean.
sentences.susu: I e rasɛniyɛnma yi ki nɛ. Marasɛniyɛn ye makasan e ma. E xa e fate maxabe birin bi, e xa e xa dugie xa, alako e xa sɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: Then let them take a young ox and its meal offering, crushed grain mixed with oil, and take another ox for a sin-offering.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, e xa tuura keren ba sɛrɛxɛ ra, a nun mɛngi naxan masunbuxi ture ra. I xa tuura gbɛtɛ ba yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: And make the Levites come forward in front of the Tent of meeting, and let all the children of Israel come together:
sentences.susu: I xa Lewi bɔnsɔɛ nun Isirayilaka birin malan hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And you are to take the Levites before the Lord: and the children of Israel are to put their hands on them:
sentences.susu: Mɛnni, Alatala ya xɔri, Isirayilakae xa e bɛlɛxɛ sa Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie ma.

sentences.english: And Aaron is to give the Levites to the Lord as a wave offering from the children of Israel, so that they may do the Lord's work.
sentences.susu: Haruna nan fama e dɛntɛgɛde Alatala bɛ e xa lu alɔ sɛrɛxɛ Isirayilakae ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Na kui e nɔma Alatala xa wali rabade.»

sentences.english: And the Levites are to put their hands on the heads of the oxen, and one of the oxen is to be offered for a sin-offering and the other for a burned offering to the Lord to take away the sin of the Levites.
sentences.susu: «Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie xa e bɛlɛxɛ sa na tuura firinyie ma. Keren bama yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ nan na, boore ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, alako e xa yunubie xa xafari.

sentences.english: Then the Levites are to be put before Aaron and his sons, to be offered as a wave offering to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ na ti Haruna nun a xa die ya i, i xa e dɛntɛgɛ a sɛrɛxɛ ki ma Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: So you are to make the Levites separate from the children of Israel, and the Levites will be mine.
sentences.susu: A lima nɛ, na tɛmui, i bara Lewi bɔnsɔɛ tan ba Isirayilakae ya ma, e xa findi n gbe ra.»

sentences.english: After that, the Levites will go in to do whatever has to be done in the Tent of meeting; you are to make them clean and give them as a wave offering.
sentences.susu: «I na gɛ e rasɛniyɛnde a sɛrɛxɛ ki ma, Lewi bɔnsɔɛ fama nɛ sode e xa hɔrɔmɔlingira wali kui.

sentences.english: For they have been given to me from among the children of Israel; in place of every mother's first son, the first to come to birth in Israel, I have taken them for myself.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae nan e ra naxee findixi n gbe ra Isirayila di singe birin ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: For every mother's first son among the children of Israel is mine, the first male birth of man or beast: on the day when I sent death on all the first sons in the land of Egypt, I made them mine.
sentences.susu: Isirayila di singe birin nun e xa xuruse di singe birin findixi n gbe nan na, kafi n sa Misirakae xa di singe birin faxa tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And in place of the first sons among the children of Israel, I have taken the Levites.
sentences.susu: N naxa Lewi bɔnsɔɛ tongo Isirayila di singe birin ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And I have given them to Aaron and to his sons, from among the children of Israel, to undertake for them all the work of the Tent of meeting, and to take away sin from the children of Israel so that no evil may come on them when they come near the holy place.
sentences.susu: N bara e so Haruna nun a xa die yi ra Isirayilakae tagi, alako e xa hɔrɔmɔlingira wali raba Isirayilakae xili ra. E man xa yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ba Isirayilakae bɛ, alako gbaloe yo naxa goro Isirayilakae ma e na makɔrɛ yire sɛniyɛnxi ra tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: All these things Moses and Aaron and the children of Israel did to the Levites; as the Lord gave orders to Moses about the Levites, so the children of Israel did.
sentences.susu: Munsa, Haruna, nun ɲama birin naxa na raba Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ra alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the Levites were made clean from sin, and their clothing was washed, and Aaron gave them for a wave offering before the Lord; and Aaron took away their sin and made them clean.
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ naxa e yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn, e naxa e xa dugie xa. Haruna naxa e dɛntɛgɛ Alatala bɛ. A naxa e xa yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ba e bɛ e xa sɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: And then the Levites went in to do their work in the Tent of meeting before Aaron and his sons: all the orders which the Lord had given Moses about the Levites were put into effect.
sentences.susu: Na to ba a ra, Lewi bɔnsɔɛ naxa fa e xa wali suxu hɔrɔmɔlingira xa fe ra Haruna nun a xa die xa yaamari bun ma, alɔ Alatala a yamari Munsa bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: This is the rule for the Levites: those of twenty-five years old and over are to go in and do the work of the Tent of meeting;
sentences.susu: «Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie xa simaya na ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli li, e nɔma hɔrɔmɔlingira wali suxude.

sentences.english: But after they are fifty years old, they are to give up their work and do no more;
sentences.susu: E na ɲɛ tongo suuli sɔtɔ, e xa na wali lu naa.

sentences.english: But be with their brothers in the Tent of meeting, taking care of it but doing no work. This is what you are to do in connection with the Levites and their work.
sentences.susu: E nɔma e ngaxakerenyie malide na wali kui, kɔnɔ e tan mu nɔma na rabade sɔnɔn. I xa na sɛriyɛe suxu Lewi bɔnsɔɛ xa fe ra hɔrɔmɔlingira wali rabafe ma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, in the waste land of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt,
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae to mini Misira bɔxi ma, e fa lu gbengberen yire ɲɛ firin, na kike singe Alatala nu bara a masen Munsa bɛ Turusinina gbengberenyi ma,

sentences.english: Let the children of Israel keep the Passover at its regular time.
sentences.susu: «Isirayilakae xa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali raba

sentences.english: In the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you are to keep it at the regular time, and in the way ordered in the law.
sentences.susu: yi kike xi fu nun naani, soge dula tɛmui alɔ a yamarixi ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And Moses gave orders to the children of Israel to keep the Passover.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a fala Isirayilakae bɛ, a e xa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali raba.

sentences.english: So they kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, at evening, in the waste land of Sinai: as the Lord gave orders to Moses, so the children of Israel did.
sentences.susu: E naxa na sali raba kike singe xi fu nun naani soge dula tɛmui Turusinina gbengberenyi ma. E naxa a raba, alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ Munsa bɛ.

sentences.english: And there were certain men who were unclean because of a dead body, so that they were not able to keep the Passover on that day; and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na lɔxɔɛ, mixi ndee mu nɔ Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali raba barima e nu bara din mixi fure ra, e fa findi sɛniyɛntare ra na lɔxɔɛ. Na lɔxɔɛ kerenyi e naxa siga Munsa nun Haruna yire.

sentences.english: And these men said to him, We have been made unclean by the dead body of a man; why may we not make the offering of the Lord at the regular time among the children of Israel?
sentences.susu: E a fala e bɛ, «Muxu mu sɛniyɛn fure xa fe ra, kɔnɔ munfe ra muxu mu lan muxu xa fa muxu xa hadiya ra Alatala bɛ alɔ Isirayilaka birin?»

sentences.english: And Moses said to them, Do nothing till the Lord gives me directions about you.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa e yaabi, «Wo mamɛ ti sinden, n xa a mato Alatala naxan yamarima wo xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel, If any one of you or of your families is unclean because of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, still he is to keep the Passover to the Lord:
sentences.susu: «Xa wo mu sɛniyɛn fure nde xa fe ra, xa na mu a ra wo na biyaasi kui, wo man nɔma Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali rabade Alatala xa binyɛ bun ma, keli wo tan ma han a sa wo bɔnsɔɛ li.

sentences.english: In the second month, on the fourteenth day, in the evening, they are to keep it, taking it with unleavened bread and bitter-tasting plants;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e tan xa a raba kike firin nde xi fu nun naani soge dula tɛmui. E yɛxɛɛ don a nun taami lɛbinitare nun burɛxɛ xɔnɛ ra.

sentences.english: Nothing of it is to be kept till the morning, and no bone of it is to be broken: they are to keep it by the rules of the Passover.
sentences.susu: A dɔnxɔɛ yo naxa lu han gɛɛsɛgɛ. A xɔri fan mu ibɔɔma. E xa na sali raba a sɛriyɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: But the man who, not being unclean or on a journey, does not keep the Passover, will be cut off from his people: because he did not make the offering of the Lord at the regular time, his sin will be on him.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa mixi sɛniyɛnxi naxan mu na biyaasi kui, a tondi Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali rabade, na kanyi lanma a xa ba Alatala xa ɲama ya ma, barima a mu fa hadiya ra Alatala bɛ a waxati. Na kanyi fama nɛ a xa yunubi sare sɔtɔde.»

sentences.english: And if a man from another country is among you and has a desire to keep the Passover to the Lord, let him do as is ordered in the law of the Passover: there is to be the same rule for the man from another nation and for him who had his birth in the land.
sentences.susu: «Xa i xa xɔɲɛ nde wama Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali rabafe, a xa a raba a sɛriyɛ ki ma. Sɛriyɛ naxan saxi taa kanyie ma, na sɛriyɛ kerenyi nan luma na xɔɲɛ fan ma.»

sentences.english: And on the day when the House was put up, the cloud came down on it, on the Tent of witness; and in the evening there was a light like fire over the House till the morning.
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔlingira ti lɔxɔɛ, saatɛ walaxɛe na dɛnnaxɛ, nuxui nde naxa dusu na xun na. Keli nunmare han kuye iba, a nu na hɔrɔmɔlingira fari, a maniyaxi tɛ ra.

sentences.english: And so it was at all times: it was covered by the cloud, and by a light as of fire by night.
sentences.susu: Tɛmui birin a nu na na ki nɛ, nuxui nu na hɔrɔmɔlingira fari yanyi ra, a fa yanba alɔ tɛ kɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And whenever the cloud was taken up from over the House, then the children of Israel went journeying on; and in the place where the cloud came to rest, there the children of Israel put up their tents.
sentences.susu: Nuxui nɛfɛ keli hɔrɔmɔlingira xun ma, Isirayilakae fan bara keli, e ɲɛrɛ fɔlɔ han a goro, e fa yonkin mɛnni.

sentences.english: At the order of the Lord the children of Israel went forward, and at the order of the Lord they put up their tents: as long as the cloud was resting on the House, they did not go away from that place.
sentences.susu: Na kui Isirayilakae nu ɲɛrɛma Alatala xa yaamari nan bun ma, e man nu yonkinma Alatala xa yaamari nan ma. Fanni nuxui na hɔrɔmɔlingira xun ma, e fan yonkinma mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: When the cloud was resting on the House for a long time the children of Israel, waiting for the order of the Lord, did not go on.
sentences.susu: Xa nuxui sa bu hɔrɔmɔlingira fari a gbe ra, Isirayilakae nu birama Alatala xa yaamari nan fɔxɔ ra, e lu mɛnni.

sentences.english: Sometimes the cloud was resting on the House for two or three days; then, by the order of the Lord, they kept their tents in that place, and when the Lord gave the order they went on.
sentences.susu: Tɛmui ndee na nuxui mu buma, a keli. Isirayilakae nu luma Alatala xa yaamari nan bun ma, e fan keli, e yonkin nuxui yire.

sentences.english: And sometimes the cloud was there only from evening to morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning they went on their journey again: or if it was resting there by day and by night, whenever the cloud was taken up they went forward.
sentences.susu: Tɛmui ndee nuxui bara lu yire xi keren, keli kɔɛ ra han kuye iba, a fa siga. A nɛfɛ keli, Isirayilakae fan bara keli, e bira a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Or if the cloud came to rest on the House for two days or a month or a year without moving, the children of Israel went on waiting there and did not go on; but whenever it was taken up they went forward on their journey.
sentences.susu: Xa nuxui lu hɔrɔmɔlingira xun ma xi firin, xa na mu kike keren, xa na mu ɲɛ keren, Isirayilakae mu nu kelima e yonkinde, fo na nuxui na keli hɔrɔmɔlingira xun ma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: At the word of the Lord they put up their tents, and at the word of the Lord they went forward on their journey: they kept the orders of the Lord as he gave them by Moses.
sentences.susu: E nu yonkinma Alatala xa yaamari nan bun ma, e nu kelima Alatala xa yaamari nan bun ma. E nu birama Alatala xa yaamari nan fɔxɔ ra, a naxan fixi Munsa saabui ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Make two silver horns of hammered work, to be used for getting the people together and to give the sign for the moving of the tents.
sentences.susu: «I xa sara firin yailan gbeti bɔnbɔxi ra. E rawalima ɲama xilife nan na malanyi. E man nawalima ɲama kelife nan na biyaasi tɛmui.

sentences.english: When they are sounded, all the people are to come together to you at the door of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: E firin na fe tɛmui keren, ɲama birin xa malan i yire hɔrɔmɔlingira dɛ ra.

sentences.english: If only one of them is sounded, then the chiefs, the heads of the thousands of Israel, are to come to you.
sentences.susu: Xa sara keren nan fe, Isirayila yareratie nun kuntigie gbansan xa malan i yire.»

sentences.english: When a loud note is sounded, the tents placed on the east side are to go forward.
sentences.susu: «Wo kelima biyaaside tɛmui naxɛ, sarae xa fe keren. Na kui naxee dɔxɔxi sogetede, e xa siga.

sentences.english: At the sound of a second loud note, the tents on the south side are to go forward: the loud note will be the sign to go forward.
sentences.susu: Sarae na fe firin, naxee dɔxɔxi yirefanyi ma, nee fan xa siga. Sara xui nan a masenma ɲama siga tɛmui bara a li.

sentences.english: But when all the people are to come together, the horn is to be sounded but not loudly.
sentences.susu: Sara xui kɛɲa gbɛtɛ nan a masenma ɲama malan tɛmui bara a li.»

sentences.english: The horns are to be sounded by the sons of Aaron, the priests; this is to be a law for you for ever, from generation to generation.
sentences.susu: «Haruna bɔnsɔɛ sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nan na sarae fema. Sɛriyɛ nan na ra wo tan nun wo bɔnsɔɛe bɛ abadan.

sentences.english: And if you go to war in your land against any who do you wrong, then let the loud note of the horn be sounded; and the Lord your God will keep you in mind and give you salvation from those who are against you.
sentences.susu: Wo na wo yaxuie gere wo xa bɔxi ma tɛmui naxɛ, wo xa na sarae fe. Alatala ɲɔxɔ sama nɛ wo xɔn, a wo ratanga wo yaxuie ma.

sentences.english: And on days of joy and on your regular feasts and on the first day of every month, let the horns be sounded over your burned offerings and your peace-offerings; and they will put the Lord in mind of you: I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sali lɔxɔɛ xungbee nun wo xa kike nɛɛnɛ sali lɔxɔɛe, wo man xa na sarae fe wo sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛe bama tɛmui naxɛ. Na nan a niyama, n nan n ɲɔxɔ sama wo xɔn ma. N tan nan na wo Marigi Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: Now in the second year, on the twentieth day of the second month, the cloud was taken up from over the Tent of witness.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ firin nde kike firin nde xi mɔxɔɲɛn lɔxɔɛ, nuxui naxan nu dɔxɔxi hɔrɔmɔlingira xun ma, Ala xa seede nu na dɛnnaxɛ, a naxa ɲɛrɛ fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel went on their journey out of the waste land of Sinai; and the cloud came to rest in the waste land of Paran.
sentences.susu: Na kui Isirayilakae naxa keli Turusinina gbengberenyi ma, e bira na nuxui fɔxɔ ra han a sa ti Paran gbengberenyi xun ma.

sentences.english: They went forward for the first time on their journey as the Lord had given orders by the hand of Moses.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa e yamari Annabi Munsa saabui ra, e xa na biyaasi singe fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: First the flag of the children of Judah went forward with their armies: and at the head of his army was Nahshon, the son of Amminadab.
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛ naxa ti yare, e xa tɔnxuma tixi e ya ra. E xunyi nu na Aminadabo xa di xɛmɛ Naxason nan na.

sentences.english: And at the head of the army of the children of Issachar was Nethanel, the son of Zuar.
sentences.susu: Suwara xa di xɛmɛ Netaneeli nan nu na Isakari bɔnsɔɛ xunyi ra.

sentences.english: And at the head of the army of the children of Zebulun was Eliab, the son of Helon.
sentences.susu: Xelon xa di xɛmɛ Eliyabi nan nu na Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ xunyi ra.

sentences.english: Then the House was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who were responsible for moving the House, went forward.
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔlingira to mafagati, Gerison xa di xɛmɛe nun Merari xa di xɛmɛe naxa a xanin.

sentences.english: Then the flag of the children of Reuben went forward with their armies: and at the head of his army was Elizur, the son of Shedeur.
sentences.susu: Ruben bɔnsɔɛ naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra, e xa tɔnxuma tixi e ya ra. Sedeyuri xa di xɛmɛ Elisuru nan nu na e xunyi ra.

sentences.english: And at the head of the army of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel, the son of Zurishaddai.
sentences.susu: Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra. Surisadayi xa di xɛmɛ nan nu na e xunyi ra.

sentences.english: At the head of the army of the children of Gad was Eliasaph, the son of Reuel.
sentences.susu: Gadi bɔnsɔɛ naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra. Duweli xa di xɛmɛ Eliyasafa nan nu na e xunyi ra.

sentences.english: Then the Kohathites went forward with the holy place; the others put up the House ready for their coming.
sentences.susu: Kehati xabilɛ naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra hɔrɔmɔlingira se sɛniyɛnxie ra. Booree tan lan nɛ e xa hɔrɔmɔlingira ti beenu Kehati xabilɛ xa so.

sentences.english: Then the flag of the children of Ephraim went forward with their armies: and at the head of his army was Elishama, the son of Ammihud.
sentences.susu: Efirami bɔnsɔɛ naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra, e xa tɔnxuma tixi e ya ra. Amixudi xa di xɛmɛ Elisama nan nu na e xunyi ra.

sentences.english: At the head of the army of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel, the son of Pedahzur.
sentences.susu: Manasi bɔnsɔɛ naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra. Pedasuru xa di xɛmɛ Gamaliyɛli nan nu na e xunyi ra.

sentences.english: At the head of the army of the children of Benjamin was Abidan, the son of Gideoni.
sentences.susu: Gideyoni xa di xɛmɛ Abidan nan nu na Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ xunyi ra.

sentences.english: And the flag of the children of Dan, whose tents were moved last of all, went forward with their armies: and at the head of his army was Ahiezer, the son of Ammishaddai.
sentences.susu: Dana bɔnsɔɛe naxa ɲɛrɛ e birin xanbi ra, e xa tɔnxuma tixi e ya ra. Amisadayi xa di xɛmɛ Axiyeseri nan nu na e xunyi ra.

sentences.english: At the head of the army of the children of Asher was Pagiel, the son of Ochran.
sentences.susu: Okiran xa di xɛmɛ Pagiyɛli nan nu na Aseri bɔnsɔɛ xunyi ra.

sentences.english: And at the head of the army of the children of Naphtali was Ahira, the son of Enan.
sentences.susu: Enan xa di xɛmɛ Axira nan nu na Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ xunyi ra.

sentences.english: This was the order in which the children of Israel were journeying by armies; so they went forward.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae nu ɲɛrɛma na ki nɛ e gali ki ma.

sentences.english: Then Moses said to Hobab, the son of his father-in-law Reuel the Midianite, We are journeying to that place of which the Lord has said, I will give it to you: so come with us, and it will be for your profit: for the Lord has good things in store for Israel.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a fala a bitanyi Reyuweli Madiyanka xa di xɛmɛ Xobabo bɛ, «Muxu na sigafe Alatala dɛnnaxan laayidixi muxu bɛ. I fan xa fa. Na findima sɔɔnɛya nan na i bɛ, barima Alatala bara laayidi tongo a fe fanyie rabama nɛ Isirayila bɛ.»

sentences.english: But he said, I will not go with you, I will go back to the land of my birth and to my relations.
sentences.susu: Xobabo naxa a yaabi, «Ade, n xa gbilen n xɔnyi n ma mixie tagi.»

sentences.english: And he said, Do not go from us; for you will be eyes for us, guiding us to the right places in the waste land to put up our tents.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a maxandi, «Yandi, i naxa keli muxu xun ma. I tan nan yi gbengberenyi birin kolon muxu nɔma yonkinde dɛnnaxɛ. I findima muxu raɲɛrɛma nan na.

sentences.english: And if you come with us, we will give you a part in whatever good the Lord does for us.
sentences.susu: Xa i muxu matima, muxu i kima nɛ hɛɛri ra Alatala fama naxan fide muxu ma.»

sentences.english: So they went forward three days' journey from the mountain of the Lord; and the ark of the Lord's agreement went three days' journey before them, looking for a resting-place for them;
sentences.susu: E naxa keli Alatala xa geya bun ma, e xi saxan ɲɛrɛ raba. Alatala xa saatɛ kankira nu tixi e ya ra na xi saxan bun ma yonkinde fenfe ra.

sentences.english: And by day the cloud of the Lord went over them, when they went forward from the place where they had put up their tents.
sentences.susu: E to nu kelima e yonkinde, Alatala xa nuxui nu tixi e xun ma fɛɛɲɛnyi kui.

sentences.english: And when the ark went forward Moses said, Come up, O Lord, and let the armies of those who are against you be broken, and let your haters go in flight before you.
sentences.susu: E to nu saatɛ kankira rakelima tɛmui naxɛ, Munsa nu a falama, «Alatala, i xa keli, i xa i yaxuie rayensen. Naxee i xɔnxi, nee fan xa e gi i ya ra.»

sentences.english: And when it came to rest, he said, Take rest, O Lord, and give a blessing to the families of Israel.
sentences.susu: E to nu saatɛ kankira ragoroma tɛmui naxɛ, Munsa nu a falama, «Alatala, i xa i magoro Isirayila ɲama wuyaxi tagi.»

sentences.english: Now the people were saying evil against the Lord; and the Lord, hearing it, was angry and sent fire on them, burning the outer parts of the tent-circle.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde, ɲama naxa e mawa e xa tɔɔrɛ xa fe ra Alatala ya i. Alatala naxa xɔnɔ na fe ma, a fa tɛ rasin ɲama tagi, a yire nde gan yonkinde sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And the people made an outcry to Moses, and Moses made prayer to the Lord, and the fire was stopped.
sentences.susu: Ɲama to gbelegbele Munsa ra, a naxa Alatala maxandi. Na kui tɛ naxa xuben.

sentences.english: So that place was named Taberah, because of the fire of the Lord which had been burning among them.
sentences.susu: E naxa na yire xili sa Tabera, na nan na ki «Tɛ mankanɛ,» barima Alatala nu bara tɛ rasin e tagi.

sentences.english: And the mixed band of people who went with them were overcome by desire: and the children of Israel, weeping again, said, Who will give us flesh for our food?
sentences.susu: Mixi kobi ndee to wa donse mɔɔli gbɛtɛ xɔn ma, Isirayilakae man naxa e mawa, a falafe ra, «Muxu wama sube nan xɔn!

sentences.english: Sweet is the memory of the fish we had in Egypt for nothing, and the fruit and green plants of every sort, sharp and pleasing to the taste:
sentences.susu: Muxu muxu ratuma na donse fanyi ma muxu naxan sɔtɔ Misira bɔxi ma kɔbiri xanbi, alɔ yɛxɛ, kaakunboosi, basikɛti, yɛbɛ, nun yɛbɛ maniyɛ.

sentences.english: But now our soul is wasted away; there is nothing at all: we have nothing but this manna before our eyes.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi donse xɔli mu na muxu ma, barima ‹mana› donse nan tun na be.»

sentences.english: Now the manna was like a seed of grain, like small clear drops.
sentences.susu: Na «mana» nu luxi nɛ alɔ funden xɔri fiixɛ.

sentences.english: The people went about taking it up from the earth, crushing it between stones or hammering it to powder, and boiling it in pots, and they made cakes of it: its taste was like the taste of cakes cooked with oil.
sentences.susu: Ɲama nu minima a matongode, e fa a din gɛmɛ ra, xa na mu, mulunyi kui. E nu lɛki yailanma a ra. A nu luxi alɔ ture nu na a ma.

sentences.english: When the dew came down on the tents at night, the manna came down with it.
sentences.susu: Mana nu goroma xini goro tɛmui.

sentences.english: And at the sound of the people weeping, every man at his tent-door, the wrath of the Lord was great, and Moses was very angry.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa ɲama wa xui ramɛ. Mixi birin nu e mawama e xɔnyi. Alatala naxa xɔnɔ ki fanyi ra. Munsa naxa kɔntɔfili.

sentences.english: And Moses said to the Lord, Why have you done me this evil? and why have I not grace in your eyes, that you have put on me the care of all this people?
sentences.susu: A naxa Alatala maxɔrin, «N Marigi, munfe ra i bara yi kɔntɔfili lu i xa konyi ma? N munse rabaxi naxan a niyama i xa yi ɲama xa kote dɔxɔ n xun ma? N tan nan nu wama a xɔn?

sentences.english: Am I the father of all this people? have I given them birth, that you say to me, Take them in your arms, like a child at the breast, to the land which you gave by an oath to their fathers?
sentences.susu: N tan nan e barixi? Munfe ra i bara e sa n bɛlɛxɛ, n xa e xanin bɔxi ma i naxan laayidixi e benbae bɛ, alɔ dingɛ a xa di xaninma ki naxɛ?
