sentences.english: Where am I to get flesh to give to all this people? For they are weeping to me and saying, Give us flesh for our food.
sentences.susu: N sube sɔtɔma minden yi ɲama birin bɛ? E e mawama e wama sube xɔn.

sentences.english: I am not able by myself to take the weight of all this people, for it is more than my strength.
sentences.susu: N keren mu nɔma yi ɲama birin xa kote ra, a binya n bɛ.

sentences.english: If this is to be my fate, put me to death now in answer to my prayer, if I have grace in your eyes; and let me not see my shame.
sentences.susu: Faxɛ nan fisa na kote bɛ. Xa n ma fe rafan i ma, i naxa n xun nakana.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Send for seventy of the responsible men of Israel, who are in your opinion men of weight and authority over the people; make them come to the Tent of meeting and be there with you.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «Isirayila fori tongo solofere malan n bɛ, i naxee kolon taa yareratie nun kuntigie ra. E xa e malan hɔrɔmɔlingira dɛ ra i sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And I will come down and have talk with you there: and I will take some of the spirit which is on you and put it on them, and they will take part of the weight of the people off you, so that you do not have to take it by yourself.
sentences.susu: N fama gorode i yire, won xa wɔyɛn. N Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxan fixi i ma, n na nde bama i ma, n xa na sa e fan ma, alako i keren naxa yi ɲama xa kote xanin sɔnɔn. Wo nun na kuntigie nan a xaninma fa.»

sentences.english: And say to the people, Make yourselves clean before tomorrow and you will have flesh for your food: for in the ears of the Lord you have been weeping and saying, Who will give us flesh for food? for we were well off in Egypt: and so the Lord will give you flesh, and it will be your food;
sentences.susu: «A fala ɲama bɛ, ‹Wo xa wo yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn, barima tina wo sube donma nɛ. Alatala bara wo wa xui mɛ, a falafe ra, «Muxu wama sube nan xɔn ma. Lufe Misira nan fisa.» Alatala fama sube fide wo ma wo naxan donma.

sentences.english: Not for one day only, or even for five or ten or twenty days;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo mu a donma xɛ xi keren, xa na mu xi firin, xa na mu xi suuli, xa na mu xi fu, xa na mu xi mɔxɔɲɛn.

sentences.english: But every day for a month, till you are tired of it, turning from it in disgust: because you have gone against the Lord who is with you, and have been weeping before him saying, Why did we come out of Egypt?
sentences.susu: Wo a donma nɛ han kike keren, han a mini wo ɲɔɛ kui, han a raɲaaxu wo ma, barima wo bara Alatala rabɛɲin, naxan na wo ya ma. Wo bara wo mawa a falafe ra, «Munfe ra muxu minixi Misira?»›»

sentences.english: Then Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, I will give them flesh to be their food for a month.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a masen Alatala bɛ, «I a falama i sube fima yi ɲama ma kike keren bun ma? N na xɛmɛ wulu kɛmɛ senni nan ya ma.

sentences.english: Are flocks and herds to be put to death for them? or are all the fish in the sea to be got together so that they may be full?
sentences.susu: Xuruse gɔɔrɛ mu nɔma e ralide sube ra. Hali yɛxɛ naxee na baa ma, e mu nɔma e ralide.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Has the Lord's hand become short? Now you will see if my word comes true for you or not.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a yaabi, «N sɛnbɛ xurun na rabade? I fama a kolonde xa n ma wɔyɛnyi findixi nɔndi nan na.»

sentences.english: And Moses went out and gave the people the words of the Lord: and he took seventy of the responsible men of the people, placing them round the Tent.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa siga Alatala xa masenyi dɛntɛgɛde ɲama bɛ. A naxa ɲama forie mixi tongo solofere malan Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira rabilinyi.

sentences.english: Then the Lord came down in the cloud and had talk with him, and put on the seventy men some of the spirit which was on him: now when the spirit came to rest on them, they were like prophets, but only at that time.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa goro nuxui kui, a masenyi ti Munsa bɛ. A naxa a yɛtɛ Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nde tongo naxan nu na Munsa ma, a a sa na fori mixi tongo solofere ma. Na Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi to goro e ma, e naxa so masenyi tife Ala xili ra, kɔnɔ e mu a ikuya.

sentences.english: But two men were still in the tent-circle one of them named Eldad and the other Medad: and the spirit came to rest on them; they were among those who had been sent for, but they had not gone out to the Tent: and the prophet's power came on them in the tent-circle.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xɛmɛ firin nu na na fori tongo solofere ya ma naxee mu siga malanyi. E mu siga hɔrɔmɔlingira yire, e naxa lu yonkinde kui. Kɔnɔ Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa goro e fan ma, e fa masenyi ti Ala xili ra ɲama tagi.

sentences.english: And a young man went running to Moses and said, Eldad and Medad are acting as prophets in the tent-circle.
sentences.susu: Fonike nde naxa a gi, a sa a fala Munsa bɛ, «Eledade nun Medadi na masenyi tife Ala xili ra ɲama tagi.»

sentences.english: Then Joshua, the son of Nun, who had been Moses' servant from the time when he was a child, said, My lord Moses, let them be stopped.
sentences.susu: Nunu xa di xɛmɛ Yosuwe, naxan nu Munsa malima kafi a fonike tɛmui, a naxa a fala Munsa bɛ, «N marigi, i xa na fe dan.»

sentences.english: And Moses said to him, Are you moved by envy on my account? If only all the Lord's people were prophets, and the Lord might put his spirit on them!
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a yaabi, «I tɔɔnɛ tife n tan nan ma fe ra? A xɔli n ma Alatala xa ɲama birin findi namiɲɔnmɛe ra naxee bara Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi sɔtɔ!»

sentences.english: Then Moses, with the responsible men of Israel, went back to the tent-circle.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Munsa nun Isirayila kuntigie naxa gbilen ɲama ya ma.

sentences.english: Then the Lord sent a wind, driving little birds from the sea, so that they came down on the tents, and all round the tent-circle, about a day's journey on this side and on that, in masses about two cubits high over the face of the earth.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa foye xungbe ramini kelife baa ma, naxan xɔni gbegbe radin ɲama yonkinde rabilinyi, han kelife yonkinde tagi, a sa dɔxɔ fɛɛɲɛn keren ɲɛrɛ ra.

sentences.english: And all that day and all night and the day after, the people were taking up the birds; the smallest amount which anyone got was ten homers: and they put them out all round the tents.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa fɛɛɲɛn na xɔnie matongo ra, han na kuye iba. E man naxa fɛɛɲɛn xɔnie matongo ra, han kankan naxa paani ya fu sɔtɔ, litiri kɛmɛ saxan tongo suuli sama paani naxan kui. E naxa e rafen e xa yonkinde rabilinyi.

sentences.english: But while the meat was still between their teeth, before it was tasted, the wrath of the Lord was moved against the people and he sent a great outburst of disease on them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ beenu Isirayilakae xa gɛ na sube donde, Alatala naxa xɔnɔ e ma, a e ɲaxankata a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: So that place was named Kibroth-hattaavah; because there they put in the earth the bodies of the people who had given way to their desires.
sentences.susu: E naxa na yire xili sa Kibiroti Hataawa, na nan na ki «milante gaburi,» barima milante gali nan nagata mɛnni.

sentences.english: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people went on to Hazeroth; and there they put up their tents.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa keli Kibiroti Hataawa, e sa yonkin Xaseroti.

sentences.english: Now Miriam and Aaron said evil against Moses, because of the Cushite woman to whom he was married, for he had taken a Cushite woman as his wife.
sentences.susu: Munsa to nu bara Kusi ginɛ dɔxɔ, Mariyama nun Haruna naxa Munsa mafala,

sentences.english: And they said, Have the words of the Lord been given to Moses only? have they not come to us? And the Lord took note of it.
sentences.susu: a falafe ra, «Alatala wɔyɛnma Munsa nan gbansan saabui ra? A mu wɔyɛnma muxu fan saabui ra?» Alatala naxa na masenyi mɛ.

sentences.english: Now the man Moses was more gentle than any other man on earth.
sentences.susu: Munsa nu findixi yɛtɛ magoroe nan na dangife mixi birin na.

sentences.english: And suddenly the Lord said to Moses and Aaron and Miriam, Come out, you three, to the Tent of meeting. And the three of them went out.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Munsa, Haruna, nun Mariyama xili keren na, a e birin xa siga hɔrɔmɔlingira. E to siga naa,

sentences.english: And the Lord came down in a pillar of cloud, taking his place at the door of the Tent, and made Aaron and Miriam come before him.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa goro nuxui kui hɔrɔmɔlingira dɛ ra. A naxa Haruna nun Mariyama xili. E firin naxa e maso a ra.

sentences.english: And he said, Now give ear to my words: if there is a prophet among you I will give him knowledge of myself in a vision and will let my words come to him in a dream.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo tuli mati n ma masenyi ra. N namiɲɔnmɛ xɛɛma wo ya ma tɛmui naxɛ, n nan n yɛtɛ masenma na kanyi bɛ laamatunyi nan kui. N wɔyɛn a ra xiye ra.

sentences.english: My servant Moses is not so; he is true to me in all my house:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n ma konyi Munsa tan gbe mu na na ki xɛ. A tan findixi n dugutɛgɛ nan na n ma wali birin kui.

sentences.english: With him I will have talk mouth to mouth, openly and not in dark sayings; and with his eyes he will see the form of the Lord: why then had you no fear of saying evil against my servant Moses?
sentences.susu: N na n ma masenyi makɛnɛnma a bɛ, n mu taali wɔyɛnyi rawalima muxu tagi. N nan n yɛtɛ masenma a bɛ, a fa n niini igbɛfe. Munfe ra wo mu gaaxu n ma konyi Munsa mafalafe ra?»

sentences.english: And burning with wrath against them, the Lord went away.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa xɔnɔ e ma, a fa keli e xun ma.

sentences.english: And the cloud was moved from over the Tent; and straight away Miriam became a leper, as white as snow: and Aaron, looking at Miriam, saw that she was a leper.
sentences.susu: Nuxui to keli hɔrɔmɔlingira xun ma, Mariyama fate naxa rafiixɛ kunɛ ra keren na. Haruna to a to, kunɛ na Mariyama fate birin ma,

sentences.english: Then Aaron said to Moses, O my lord, let not our sin be on our heads, for we have done foolishly and are sinners.
sentences.susu: a naxa Munsa mayandi, «Yandi, n marigi, i naxa muxu ratɔn muxu xa yunubi xa fe ra, muxu naxan nabaxi muxu xa xaxilitareɲa kui.

sentences.english: Let her not be as one dead, whose flesh is half wasted when he comes out from the body of his mother.
sentences.susu: Mariyama naxa lu alɔ di naxan faxaxi a nga furi, naxan fate sɛɛti bɔrɔxi beenu a bari tɛmui.»

sentences.english: And Moses, crying to the Lord, said, Let my prayer come before you, O God, and make her well.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a xui rate Alatala ma, «N Marigi, n bara i maxandi, a rayalan!»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, If her father had put a mark of shame on her, would she not be shamed for seven days? Let her be shut up outside the tent-circle for seven days, and after that she may come in again.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a yaabi, «Xa a baba dɛye bɔxun a yatagi, a mu yaagima xɛ han lɔxun keren? I xa a ramini ɲama ya ma. A na ge lɔxun keren nabade ɲama yonkinde fari ma, wo nɔma a rasode wo ya ma.»

sentences.english: So Miriam was shut up outside the tent-circle for seven days: and the people did not go forward on their journey till Miriam had come in again.
sentences.susu: Na kui, e naxa a ramini ɲama ya ma, a xi solofere raba yonkinde fari ma. Ɲama mu keli e yonkinde han Mariyama naxa ragbilen e ya ma.

sentences.english: After that, the people went on from Hazeroth and put up their tents in the waste land of Paran.
sentences.susu: Na to ba a ra, ɲama naxa keli Xaseroti, e naxa sa yonkin Paran gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Send men to get knowledge about the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the children of Israel; from every tribe of their fathers you are to send a man, every one a chief among them.
sentences.susu: «I xa yarerati keren keren sugandi bɔnsɔɛ birin ya ma, i xa e xɛɛ Kanaan bɔxi ma, e xa sa na bɔxi rabɛn, n naxan fima Isirayilakae ma.»

sentences.english: And Moses sent them from the waste land of Paran as the Lord gave orders, all of them men who were heads of the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa na mixie xɛɛ kelife Paran gbengberenyi ma, alɔ Alatala a yamarixi ki naxɛ. Na mixi birin findi Isirayila kuntigie nan na.

sentences.english: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua, the son of Zaccur.
sentences.susu: E xilie nan yi ki: Kelife Ruben bɔnsɔɛ ma, Sakuru xa di xɛmɛ Samuwa.

sentences.english: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat, the son of Hori.
sentences.susu: Kelife Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ ma, Xori xa di xɛmɛ Safati.

sentences.english: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.
sentences.susu: Kelife Yuda bɔnsɔɛ ma, Yefune xa di xɛmɛ Kalebi.

sentences.english: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal, the son of Joseph.
sentences.susu: Kelife Isakari bɔnsɔɛ ma, Yusufu xa di xɛmɛ Yigali.

sentences.english: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea, the son of Nun.
sentences.susu: Kelife Efirami bɔnsɔɛ ma, Nunu xa di xɛmɛ Hoseya.

sentences.english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti, the son of Raphu.
sentences.susu: Kelife Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ ma, Rafu xa di xɛmɛ Paliti.

sentences.english: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel, the son of Sodi.
sentences.susu: Kelife Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ ma, Sodi xa di xɛmɛ Gadiyeli.

sentences.english: Of the tribe of Joseph, that is of the family of Manasseh, Gaddi, the son of Susi.
sentences.susu: Kelife Yusufu xa di, Manasi bɔnsɔɛ ma, Susi xa di xɛmɛ Gadi.

sentences.english: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel, the son of Gemalli.
sentences.susu: Kelife Dana bɔnsɔɛ ma, Gemali xa di xɛmɛ Amiyɛli.

sentences.english: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur, the son of Michael
sentences.susu: Kelife Aseri bɔnsɔɛ ma, Mikayeli xa di xɛmɛ Seturu.

sentences.english: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi, the son of Vophsi.
sentences.susu: Kelife Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ ma, Fofisi xa di xɛmɛ Naxabi.

sentences.english: Of the tribe of Gad, Gevel, the son of Machi.
sentences.susu: Kelife Gadi bɔnsɔɛ ma, Maki xa di xɛmɛ Geyuweli.

sentences.english: These are the names of the men whom Moses sent to get knowledge about the land. And Moses gave to Hoshea, the son of Nun, the name of Joshua.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛe xilie nan na ki Munsa naxee xɛɛ Kanaan bɔxi rabɛnde. Munsa naxa Nunu xa di xɛmɛ Hoseya xili sa Yosuwe.

sentences.english: So Moses sent them to have a look at the land of Canaan, and said to them, Go up into the South and into the hill-country;
sentences.susu: Munsa to e xɛɛ Kanaan bɔxi rabɛnde, a naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo xa mini Negewi gbengberenyi biri, han wo geyae yire li.

sentences.english: And see what the land is like; and if the people living in it are strong or feeble, small or great in number;
sentences.susu: Wo xa na bɔxi rabɛn, wo xa a kolon xa mɛnnikae sɛnbɛ gbo, xa e sɛnbɛ mu gbo, xa e wuya, xa e mu wuya.

sentences.english: And what sort of land they are living in, if it is good or bad; and what their living-places are, tent-circles or walled towns;
sentences.susu: Wo xa a mato xa na bɔxi fan. Wo xa a kolon xa tɛtɛ na na taae rabilinyi ma.

sentences.english: And if the land is fertile or poor, and if there is wood in it or not. And be of good heart, and come back with some of the produce of the land. Now it was the time when the first grapes were ready.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a mato xa na bɔxi fan sansi bɛ, xa wurie gbo naa. Wo kata wo xa fa na sansi bogi ndee ra.» Wɛni bilie bogi singe tɛmui nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: So they went up and got a view of the land, from the waste land of Zin to Rehob, on the way to Hamath.
sentences.susu: E naxa sa na bɔxi rabɛn, kelife Sini gbengberenyi ma, han Rexobo, Xamata mabiri.

sentences.english: They went up into the South and came to Hebron; and Ahiman and Sheshai and Talmai, the children of Anak, were living there. (Now the building of Hebron took place seven years before that of Zoan in Egypt.)
sentences.susu: E naxa dangi Negewi gbengberenyi ra, e sa Xebiron li, Anaki xa die Aximan, Sɛsayi, nun Talamayi nu sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ. Xebiron taa nu tixi ɲɛ solofere beenu Sowan taa xa ti Misira.

sentences.english: And they came to the valley of Eshcol, and cutting down a vine-branch with its grapes, two of them took it on a rod between them; and they took some pomegranates and figs.
sentences.susu: E to Esekoli gulunba li, e naxa wɛni bili salonyi nde rasɛgɛ, a tɔnsɔɛ nu na naxan ma. Mixi firin naxa na xanin wuri kuye ra. E naxa xɔrɛ bogi nde fan tongo, a nun bogise nde naxan xili girenadi, naxan maniyɛ kɔɔbɛ ra.

sentences.english: That place was named the valley of Eshcol because of the grapes which the children of Israel took from there.
sentences.susu: E naxa na yire xili sa Esekoli, na nan na ki «Tɔnsɔɛ yire,» na wɛni bogi tɔnsɔɛ xa fe ra, e naxan baxi.

sentences.english: At the end of forty days they came back from viewing the land.
sentences.susu: E to xi tongo naani raba naa na bɔxi rabɛnde, e naxa gbilen

sentences.english: And they came back to Moses and Aaron and all the children of Israel, to Kadesh in the waste land of Paran; and gave an account to them and to all the people and let them see the produce of the land.
sentences.susu: Munsa, Haruna, nun Isirayila ɲama yire. E nu na Kadesi, Paran gbengberenyi ma. Mɛnni e naxa dɛntɛgɛ sa, e na bɔxi sansi bogie masen e bɛ.

sentences.english: And they said, We came to the land where you sent us, and truly it is flowing with milk and honey: and here is some of the produce of it.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala Munsa bɛ, «Muxu so nɛ bɔxi ma, i muxu xɛɛ dɛnnaxɛ. Bɔxi nan a ra, kumi nun xiɲɛ xɛlɛma dɛnnaxɛ. Na bogise ndee nan ya.

sentences.english: But the people living in the land are strong, and the towns are walled and very great; further, we saw the children of Anak there.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ ɲama naxan sabatixi na bɔxi ma, e sɛnbɛ gbo. Tɛtɛ dɔxɔxi taa birin na. Taa xungbe nan e ra. Muxu Anaki bɔnsɔɛ yati toxi nɛ naa.

sentences.english: And the Amalekites are in the South; and the Hittites and the Jebusites and the Amorites are living in the hill-country; and the Canaanites by the sea and by the side of Jordan.
sentences.susu: Amalɛkikae sabatixi Negewi gbengberenyi nan ma. Xitikae, Yebusukae, nun Amorikae, nee nan sabatixi geya yire. Kanaankae tan sabatixi baa dɛ nan na, a nun Yurudɛn xure dɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Then Caleb made signs to the people to keep quiet, and said to Moses, Let us go up straight away and take this land; for we are well able to overcome it.
sentences.susu: Kalebi naxa ɲama masabari Munsa ya xɔri, a falafe ra, «Won xɛɛ! Won xa yi bɔxi findi won gbe ra. Won nɔma na rabade.»

sentences.english: But the men who had gone up with him said, We are not able to go up against the people, for they are stronger than we.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ boore naxee siga bɔxi rabɛnde, nee naxa a fala, «Won mu nɔma sigade na ɲama gerede. E sɛnbɛ gbo won bɛ!»

sentences.english: And they gave the children of Israel a bad account of the land they had been to see, saying, This land through which we went is a land causing destruction to those living in it; and all the people we saw there are men of more than common size.
sentences.susu: Na kui e naxa fe ɲaaxi fala na bɔxi xa fe ra Isirayila ɲama bɛ. E naxa a fala, «Muxu bɔxi naxan nabɛnxi, bɔxi nan a ra naxan mixi faxama. Mixi gbangbalanyie sabatixi naa.

sentences.english: There we saw those great men, the sons of Anak, offspring of the Nephilim: and we seemed to ourselves no more than insects, and so we seemed to them.
sentences.susu: Muxu anabiyoroe to nɛ naxan fatanxi Anaki bɔnsɔɛ ra. Muxu nu luxi nɛ alɔ katoe e mabiri. E tan yo, muxu tan yo, e birin a toxi na ki nɛ.»

sentences.english: Then all the people gave load cries of grief, and all that night they gave themselves up to weeping.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa wa xui ramini kɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And all the children of Israel, crying out against Moses and Aaron, said, If only we had come to our death in the land of Egypt, or even in this waste land!
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka birin nu fa wɔyɛn na Munsa nun Haruna ma, e nu a fala, «A nu fisa muxu xa faxa Misira, xa na mu a ra yi gbengberen yire.

sentences.english: Why is the Lord taking us into this land to come to our death by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will get into strange hands: would it not be better for us to go back to Egypt?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra Alatala muxu rasofe yi bɔxi ma, muxu xa faxa santidɛgɛma ra, muxu xa die nun muxu xa ginɛe xa suxu gere kui. A mu fisa muxu xa gbilen Misira?»

sentences.english: And they said to one another, Let us make a captain over us, and go back to Egypt.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala e booree bɛ, «Won mangɛ keren ti won xun na, won xa gbilen Misira.»

sentences.english: Then Moses and Aaron went down on their faces before the meeting of the people.
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Haruna naxa e yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma Isirayilaka birin ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And Joshua, the son of Nun, and Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, two of those who had been to see the land, giving signs of grief,
sentences.susu: Nunu xa di xɛmɛ Yosuwe nun Yefune xa di xɛmɛ Kalebi naxa e xa donma ibɔɔ sunnunyi kui. Na mixi firin nu na na xɛɛrae ya ma, naxee siga Kanaan bɔxi rabɛnde.

sentences.english: Said to all the children of Israel, This land which we went through to see is a very good land.
sentences.susu: E naxa fa yi masenyi ti ɲama bɛ, «Muxu bɔxi naxan matoxi, bɔxi fanyi fanyi nan a ra.

sentences.english: And if the Lord has delight in us, he will take us into this land and give it to us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
sentences.susu: Xiɲɛ nun kumi yire nan a ra. Xa Alatala na won bɛ, a won nasoma nɛ naa, a na bɔxi fi won ma.

sentences.english: Only, do not go against the Lord or go in fear of the people of the land, for they will be our food; their strength has been taken from them and the Lord is with us: have no fear of them.
sentences.susu: Yandi, wo naxa Alatala matandi. Wo naxa gaaxu na bɔxi mixie ya ra. Won nɔma nɛ e ra. E sanke yo mu na sɔnɔn, barima Alatala na won tan nan bɛ. Wo naxa gaaxu e ya ra.»

sentences.english: But all the people said they were to be stoned. Then the glory of the Lord was seen in the Tent of meeting, before the eyes of all the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Ɲama nu wama e magɔnɔfe, kɔnɔ Alatala xa nɔrɛ naxa mini hɔrɔmɔlingira Isirayilaka birin ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, How long will this people have no respect for me? how long will they be without faith, in the face of all the signs I have done among them?
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «Yi ɲama bama n maberefe mun tɛmui? Munfe ra e siikɛma hali n kaabanakoe rabama e tagi?

sentences.english: I will send disease on them for their destruction, and take away their heritage, and I will make of you a nation greater and stronger than they.
sentences.susu: N xa wuganyi radin e ma, n nee faxa. Na tɛmui n bɔnsɔɛ xungbe sɛnbɛma nde rakelima nɛ i saabui ra, naxan dangi e tan na.»

sentences.english: And Moses said to the Lord, Then it will come to the ears of the Egyptians; for by your power you took this people out from among them;
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Alatala yaabi, «Misirakae bara a kolon, a i yi ɲama ramini e xa bɔxi ra i sɛnbɛ nan na.

sentences.english: And they will give the news to the people of this land: they have had word that you, Lord, are present with this people, letting yourself be seen face to face, and that your cloud is resting over them, and that you go before them in a pillar of cloud by day and in a pillar of fire by night.
sentences.susu: E bara bekae rakolon. Nee bara a mɛ, a i tan Alatala na i xa ɲama fɔxɔ ra, a i i yɛtɛ masenma e ma, a i nuxui sama e xun ma, a i ɲɛrɛma e ya ra nuxui kui yanyi ra, nun tɛ kui kɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Now if you put to death all this people as one man, then the nations who have had word of your glory will say,
sentences.susu: Xa i fa yi ɲama birin faxa kerenyi ra, bɔnsɔɛ naxee i xa fe mɛxi, e a falama nɛ,

sentences.english: Because the Lord was not able to take this people into the land which he made an oath to give them, he sent destruction on them in the waste land.
sentences.susu: ‹Alatala sɛnbɛ yo mu nu nɔma yi ɲama rasode bɔxi ma, a naxan laayidixi e bɛ. Na nan a ra, a e birin sɔntɔ gbengberenyi ma.›»

sentences.english: So now, may my prayer come before you, and let the power of the Lord be great, as you said:
sentences.susu: «I xa i sɛnbɛ masen e bɛ, alɔ i tan yati a yitaxi ki naxɛ, a falafe ra,

sentences.english: The Lord is slow to wrath and great in mercy, overlooking wrongdoing and evil, and will not let wrongdoers go free; sending punishment on children for the sins of their fathers, to the third and fourth generation.
sentences.susu: ‹N mu xɔnɔma mafuren mafuren. N ma diɲɛ nun fanyi gbo. N mixie xa yunubie nun fe ɲaaxie xafarima. Kɔnɔ n mixi kobi nun mixi fanyi tagi rasama. N benbae xa yunubi sare dɔxɔma e xa die xun ma han bɔnsɔɛ saxan, xa na mu naani.›

sentences.english: May the sin of this people have forgiveness, in the measure of your great mercy, as you have had mercy on them from Egypt up till now.
sentences.susu: Yandi, n bara i maxandi, diɲɛ i xa ɲama xa yunubi ma i xa hinnɛ xa fe ra, alɔ i a rabaxi kabi e mini Misira tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said, I have had mercy, as you say:
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a yaabi, «N bara diɲɛ i xa maxandi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: But truly, as I am living, and as all the earth will be full of the glory of the Lord;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ, n bara n kali, nɔndi nan a ra alɔ n to na na, alɔ n ma nɔrɛ naxan bɔxi rafema,

sentences.english: Because all these men, having seen my glory and the signs which I have done in Egypt and in the waste land, still have put me to the test ten times, and have not given ear to my voice;
sentences.susu: xɛmɛ naxan birin n ma nɔrɛ nun n ma kaabanakoe toxi, n naxee raba Misira nun gbengberenyi ma, kɔnɔ e fa muruta n ma han sanya fu tuli xɔrɔxɔɛ ra,

sentences.english: They will not see the land about which I made an oath to their fathers; not one of these by whom I have not been honoured will see it.
sentences.susu: nee sese mu bɔxi toma, n naxan laayidixi e benbae bɛ. Naxan birin murutaxi n ma, e sese mu na toma.

sentences.english: But my servant Caleb, because he had a different spirit in him, and has been true to me with all his heart, him I will take into that land into which he went, and his seed will have it for their heritage.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n ma konyi di Kalebi to bira xaxili gbɛtɛ fɔxɔ ra, a fa n nabatu, n a tan nasoma nɛ na bɔxi ma, a naxan nabɛnxi. A bɔnsɔɛ kɛ sɔtɔma nɛ naa.

sentences.english: Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites are in the valley; tomorrow, turning round, go into the waste land by the way to the Red Sea.
sentences.susu: Amalɛkikae nun Kanaankae to sabati gulunba kui, tina wo xa wo mafindi, wo xa gbilen gbengberenyi ma Xulunyumi Baa mabiri.»

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa nun Haruna bɛ,

sentences.english: How long am I to put up with this evil people and their outcries against me? The words which they say against me have come to my ears.
sentences.susu: «Yi ɲama kobi n matandima han mun tɛmui? N bara Isirayilakae xui mɛ, e naxan falama n bɛ, e ti n kanke.

sentences.english: Say to them, By my life, says the Lord, as certainly as your words have come to my ears, so certainly will I do this to you:
sentences.susu: A fala e bɛ, ‹N bara n kali, nɔndi nan a ra, alɔ n to na na, n a rabama nɛ wo bɛ alɔ n a mɛxi wo dɛ i ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Your dead bodies will be stretched out in this waste land; and of all your number, all those of twenty years old and over who have been crying out against me,
sentences.susu: Wo tan matandilae, naxan birin kɔntixi Isirayila ɲama ya ma, naxee xa simaya bara dangi ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn na, wo faxama nɛ yi gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: Not one will come into the land which I gave my word you would have for your resting-place, but only Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua, the son of Nun.
sentences.susu: Wo mu soma bɔxi ma n naxan laayidi wo bɛ, fo Yefune xa di xɛmɛ Kalebi nun Nunu xa di xɛmɛ Yosuwe.

sentences.english: And your little ones, whom you said would come into strange hands, I will take in, and they will see the land which you would not have.
sentences.susu: Wo xa die, wo naxee ma a e birin faxama gere nan kui, n nee tan nasoma nɛ na bɔxi kui, wo mɛɛxi naxan na.

sentences.english: But as for you, your dead bodies will be stretched in this waste land.
sentences.susu: Wo faxama gbengberenyi nan ma, wo furee luma na nɛ.

sentences.english: And your children will be wanderers in the waste land for forty years, undergoing punishment for your false ways, till your bodies become dust in the waste land.
sentences.susu: Wo xa die findima ɲɛrɛtie nan na ɲɛ tongo naani bun ma yi gbengberenyi ma. E wo xa yunubi sare xaninma han wo birin faxa gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: And as you went through the land viewing it for forty days, so for forty years, a year for every day, you will undergo punishment for your wrongdoing, and you will see that I am against you.
sentences.susu: Wo xi xasabi naxan naba na bɔxi rabɛnde, wo na ɲɛ xasabi rabama gbengberenyi ma wo xa yunubi xa fe ra. Wo to xi tongo naani raba na bɔxi rabɛnde, wo fama nɛ ɲɛ tongo naani rabade gbengberenyi ma, alako wo xa a kolon n na yunubi xɔnxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: I the Lord have said it, and this I will certainly do to all this evil people who have come together against me: in this waste land destruction will come on them, and death will be their fate.
sentences.susu: N tan Alatala, n bara gɛ wɔyɛnde. N bara na natɛ tongo yi ɲama kobi xa fe ra, naxan ti n kanke. E birin faxama nɛ gbengberenyi ma.›»

sentences.english: And the men whom Moses sent to see the land, and who, by the bad account they gave of the land, were the cause of the outcry the people made against Moses,
sentences.susu: Munsa xa xɛɛrae to gbilen kelife na bɔxi rabɛnde, e naxa fe xɔrɔxɔɛ fala na bɔxi xa fe ra han Isirayila ɲama naxa ti Munsa kanke.

sentences.english: Those same men who said evil of the land, came to their death by disease before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Alatala naxa e faxa keren na.

sentences.english: But Joshua, the son of Nun, and Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, of those who went to see the land, were not touched by disease.
sentences.susu: Na xɛɛrae ya ma, Yefune xa di xɛmɛ Kalebi nun Nunu xa di xɛmɛ Yosuwe nan gbansan mu faxa.

sentences.english: And when Moses put these words before the children of Israel, the people were full of grief.
sentences.susu: Munsa to na masenyi ti Isirayila ɲama bɛ, e naxa sunnun ki fanyi.

sentences.english: And early in the morning they got up and went to the top of the mountain, saying, We are here and we will go up to the place which the Lord said he would give us: for we have done wrong.
sentences.susu: E naxa keli subaxɛ ma, e xa te geya longori. E naxɛ, «Muxu xa te yire, Alatala dɛnnaxɛ masenxi muxu bɛ. Muxu bara yunubi raba.»

sentences.english: And Moses said, Why are you now acting against the Lord's order, seeing that no good will come of it?
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo Alatala xa yaamari nan matandife? Wo mu geenima na kui.

sentences.english: Go not up, for the Lord is not with you, and you will be overcome by those who are fighting against you.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa te de, barima Alatala mu na wo ya ma sɔnɔn. Wo naxa a niya wo yaxuie xa nɔ wo ra.

sentences.english: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and you will be put to death by their swords: because you have gone back from the way of the Lord, the Lord will not be with you.
sentences.susu: Amalɛkikae nun Kanaankae na wo ya ra, e wo sɔntɔma nɛ e xa santidɛgɛmae ra. Wo to bara wo kobe so Alatala ra, a mu na wo fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: But they gave no attention to his words and went to the top of the mountain, though Moses and the ark of the Lord's agreement did not go out of the tent-circle.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isirayila ɲama mu e tuli mati Munsa ra. E naxa te geya yire, kɔnɔ Alatala xa saatɛ kankira nun Munsa mu keli ɲama xa yonkinde.

sentences.english: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who were living in the hill-country, and overcame them completely, driving them back as far as Hormah.
sentences.susu: Amalɛkikae nun Kanaankae naxee nu sabatixi na geya yire, e naxa goro Isirayilakae xili ma, e fa e bɔnbɔ, e e masɛgɛ han Horoma.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel, When you have come into the land which I am giving to you for your resting-place,
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, ‹Wo na so bɔxi ma, n dɛnnaxan fixi wo ma sabatide ra,

sentences.english: And are going to make an offering by fire to the Lord, a burned offering or an offering in connection with an oath, or an offering freely given, or at your regular feasts, an offering for a sweet smell to the Lord, from the herd or the flock:
sentences.susu: xa wo wama xuruse bafe sɛrɛxɛ ra naxan nafan Alatala ma, alɔ sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi, laayidi sɛrɛxɛ, sɛrɛxɛ ɲanigexi, xa na mu a ra sali sɛrɛxɛ,

sentences.english: Then let him who is making his offering, give to the Lord a meal offering of a tenth part of a measure of the best meal mixed with a fourth part of a hin of oil:
sentences.susu: wo xa sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ sa na fari, naxan findima sansi xɔri dinxi luxutaxi kilo saxan masunbuxi ture litiri keren nun a tagi ra,

sentences.english: And for the drink offering, you are to give with the burned offering or other offering, the fourth part of a hin of wine for every lamb.
sentences.susu: a nun wɛni litiri keren nun a tagi. Na sama sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun sɛrɛxɛ ɲanigexi nan xun ma naxan findima yɛxɛɛ ra.

sentences.english: Or for a male sheep, give as a meal offering two tenth parts of a measure of the best meal mixed with a third part of a hin of oil:
sentences.susu: Xa a sa findi yɛxɛɛ kontonyi nan na, wo xa sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ sa na fari, naxan findima sansi xɔri dinxi luxutaxi kilo senni masunbuxi ture litiri firin na,

sentences.english: And for the drink offering give a third part of a hin of wine, for a sweet smell to the Lord.
sentences.susu: a nun wɛni litiri firin. Na ganxi rafan Alatala ma.›»

sentences.english: And when you make ready a young ox for a burned or other offering, or for the effecting of an oath, or for peace-offerings to the Lord:
sentences.susu: «Xa wo wama ninge bafe sɛrɛxɛ ra naxan nafan Alatala ma, alɔ sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi, laayidi sɛrɛxɛ, xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ,

sentences.english: Then with the ox give a meal offering of three tenth parts of a measure of the best meal mixed with half a hin of oil.
sentences.susu: wo xa sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ sa na fari, naxan findima sansi xɔri dinxi luxutaxi kilo solomanaani naxan masunbuxi ture litiri saxan na,

sentences.english: And for the drink offering: give half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire for a sweet smell to the Lord.
sentences.susu: a nun wɛni litiri saxan. Na ganxi rafan Alatala ma.»

sentences.english: This is to be done for every young ox and for every male sheep or he-lamb or young goat.
sentences.susu: «Na nan nabama ningee, yɛxɛɛ kontonyie, yɛxɛɛe, nun sie birin bɛ wo naxan bama sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: Whatever number you make ready, so you are to do for every one.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na raba xuruse birin bɛ.

sentences.english: All those who are Israelites by birth are to do these things in this way, when giving an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka birin xa a raba na ki nɛ e xa sɛrɛxɛ birin bɛ, e naxan bama tɛ ra Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And if a man from another country or any other person living among you, through all your generations, has the desire to give an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord, let him do as you do.
sentences.susu: Xɔɲɛ naxee na wo ya ma, e fan xa a raba na ki e sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi bama tɛmui naxɛ. Na rafan Alatala ma.

sentences.english: There is to be one law for you and for the man of another country living with you, one law for ever from generation to generation; as you are, so is he to be before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ keren nan luma ɲama birin bɛ, Isirayilakae ba, xɔɲɛe ba. Keli wo tan ma, han wo xa die, nun nee fan xa die naxee fama, wo tan yo, xɔɲɛ yo, wo birin xa Alatala xa sɛriyɛ suxu na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: The law and the rule are to be the same for you and for those from other lands living with you.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae ba, xɔɲɛe ba, wo birin na sɛriyɛ keren nun yaamari keren nan bun ma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel, When you come into the land where I am guiding you,
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, ‹Wo na so bɔxi ma, n wo rasofe dɛnnaxɛ,

sentences.english: Then, when you take for your food the produce of the land, you are to give an offering lifted up before the Lord.
sentences.susu: wo fa na bɔxi daxamui sɔtɔ, wo xa nde ba sɛrɛxɛ ra n bɛ.

sentences.english: Of the first of your rough meal you are to give a cake for a lifted offering, lifting it up before the Lord as the offering of the grain-floor is lifted up.
sentences.susu: Wo na taami singe yailan sansi xɔri nɛɛnɛ ra, wo xa nde ba sɛrɛxɛ ra n bɛ, alɔ wo sansi xɔri nɛɛnɛ nde bama ki naxɛ xɛ xaba tɛmui lonyi yire.

sentences.english: From generation to generation you are to give to the Lord a lifted offering from the first of your rough meal.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na taami singe ba Alatala bɛ ɲɛ yo ɲɛ.›»

sentences.english: And if in error you go against any of these laws which the Lord has given to Moses,
sentences.susu: «Xa a sa li wo tantanxi nɛ Alatala xa yaamarie suxufe kui, a naxee masenxi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: All the laws which the Lord has given you by the hand of Moses, from the day when the Lord gave them, and ever after from generation to generation;
sentences.susu: kelife na masen tɛmui, han wo xa die xa mamadie xa tɛmui,

sentences.english: Then, if the wrong is done in error, without the knowledge of the meeting of the people, let all the meeting give a young ox as a burned offering, a sweet smell to the Lord, with its meal offering and its drink offering, as is ordered in the law, together with a he-goat for a sin-offering.
sentences.susu: xa wo mu na raba wo ɲanige ra, wo a raba kolontareya kui, ɲama xa tuura ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, naxan nafan Alatala ma. Wo xa sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ nun wɛni sɛrɛxɛ sa na fari a raba ki ma, a nun sikɔtɛ naxan findima yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: So the priest will make the people free from sin, and they will have forgiveness; for it was an error, and they have given their offering made by fire to the Lord, and their sin-offering before the Lord, on account of their error:
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ yunubi xafari maxandima nɛ Isirayilaka birin bɛ. Alatala diɲɛma nɛ e ma. Yunubi nan a ra, e mu naxan ɲanigexi. E man bara sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ba Alatala bɛ, a nun e xa yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And all the meeting of the children of Israel, as well as those from other lands living among them, will have forgiveness; for it was an error on the part of the people.
sentences.susu: Na yunubi xafarima nɛ Isirayilaka birin nun e xa xɔɲɛe bɛ, barima tantanyi na nu a ra.»

sentences.english: And if one person does wrong, without being conscious of it, then let him give a she-goat of the first year for a sin-offering.
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi keren nan yunubi raba ɲanigetareɲa kui, a xa si ginɛ keren ba yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, naxan bara ɲɛ keren sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the priest will take away the sin of the person who has done wrong, if the wrong was done unconsciously, and he will have forgiveness.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ yunubi xafari maxandima nɛ na mixi bɛ naxan yunubi raba ɲanigetareɲa kui Alatala ya xɔri. Na na ɲɔn, a xa yunubi bara xafari.

sentences.english: The law in connection with wrong done unconsciously is to be the same for him who is an Israelite by birth and for the man from another country who is living among them.
sentences.susu: Na sɛriyɛ kerenyi na Isirayilakae nun e xa xɔɲɛe bɛ, yunubi rabafe ɲanigetareɲa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: But the person who does wrong in the pride of his heart, if he is one of you or of another nation by birth, is acting without respect for the Lord, and will be cut off from his people.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa mixi nde sa Alatala matandi a ɲanige ra, a findi Isirayilaka ra, a findi xɔɲɛ ra, na kanyi kerima nɛ ɲama tagi.

sentences.english: Because he had no respect for the word of the Lord, and did not keep his law, that man will be cut off without mercy and his sin will be on him.
sentences.susu: A bara Alatala xa masenyi mabere, a bara Alatala xa sɛriyɛ matandi. Na kanyi kerima nɛ ɲama tagi, barima na yunubi kote dɔxɔxi a xun ma.»

sentences.english: Now while the children of Israel were in the waste land, they saw a man who was getting sticks on the Sabbath day.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae to nu na gbengberenyi ma, e naxa mixi nde li malabui lɔxɔɛ a yege fenfe.

sentences.english: And those who saw him getting sticks took him before Moses and Aaron and all the people.
sentences.susu: E naxa a xanin Munsa nun Haruna xɔn ɲama ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And they had him shut up, because they had no directions about what was to be done with him.
sentences.susu: E naxa a suxu, kɔnɔ e mu a ɲaxankata, barima natɛ mu nu tongoxi a xa fe ra sinden.

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to Moses, Certainly the man is to be put to death: let him be stoned by all the people outside the tent-circle.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «Yi xɛmɛ lan nɛ a xa faxa. Ɲama birin xa a magɔnɔ han a faxa yonkinde fari ma.»

sentences.english: So all the people took him outside the tent-circle and he was stoned to death there, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa a ramini e yonkinde fari ma, e a magɔnɔ han a faxa, alɔ Alatala a yamari Munsa bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel that through all their generations they are to put on the edges of their robes an ornament of twisted threads, and in every ornament a blue cord;
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, e tan nun e xa die xa mamadie e xa e xa sosee sanbunyi rafutufutu, e gɛsɛ gɛrɛ daaxi xiri a dɛ i.

sentences.english: So that, looking on these ornaments, you may keep in mind the orders of the Lord and do them; and not be guided by the desires of your hearts and eyes, through which you have been untrue to me:
sentences.susu: Na sanbunyi rafutufutuxi findima tɔnxuma nan na wo bɛ, alako wo xa ratu Alatala xa yaamarie ma, wo man xa e rabatu. Wo naxa bira wo yɛtɛ waxɔnfee fɔxɔ ra, naxee wo ratantanma.

sentences.english: And that you may keep in mind all my orders and do them and be holy to your God.
sentences.susu: Na nan a niyama, wo ratuma n ma yaamarie ma, wo man e rabatu. Na kui, wo bara findi n ma mixie ra.

sentences.english: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt, so that I might be your God: I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: N tan nan Alatala ra, wo Marigi Ala, naxan wo ramini Misira bɔxi ra, alako n xa findi wo Marigi Ala ra. N tan nan Alatala ra, wo Marigi Ala.»

sentences.english: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Pallu, the son of Reuben, made themselves ready,
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixi nde, naxan xili Kora, Yisehari xa di xɛmɛ, Kehati xa mamadi, a nun Datan nun Abirami, Eliyabi xa di xɛmɛe, a nun Peleta xa di xɛmɛ Oni, naxan fatanxi Ruben bɔnsɔɛ ra,

sentences.english: And came before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty chiefs of the people, men of good name who had a place in the meeting of the people.
sentences.susu: nee naxa ti Munsa kanke. Isirayilaka mixi kɛmɛ firin mixi tongo suuli nu na e xanbi ra. Kuntigi belebelee nu na e ya ma.

sentences.english: They came together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, You take overmuch on yourselves, seeing that all the people are holy, every one of them, and the Lord is among them; why then have you put yourselves in authority over the people of the Lord?
sentences.susu: E naxa e malan Munsa nun Haruna xili ma, e fa a fala e bɛ, «Wo xa mangɛya bara ɲɔn! Isirayila ɲama birin sɛniyɛn, Alatala man na muxu tagi. Munfe ra wo tan gbansan wo yɛtɛ itema Alatala xa ɲama xun ma?»

sentences.english: And Moses, hearing this, went down on his face;
sentences.susu: Munsa to na mɛ, a naxa a yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And he said to Korah and his band, In the morning the Lord will make clear who are his, and who is holy, and who may come near him: the man of his selection will be caused to come near him.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Kora nun a xa mixie bɛ, «Tina gɛɛsɛgɛ, Alatala fama a masende won bɛ, a xa mixi sɛniyɛnxi na naxan na. A tinma na kanyi xa makɔrɛ a ra, a naxan sugandima.

sentences.english: So do this: let Korah and all his band take vessels for burning perfumes;
sentences.susu: Kora, i nun i xa mixie, wo xa surayi gansee tongo.

sentences.english: And put spices on the fire in them before the Lord tomorrow; then the man marked out by the Lord will be holy: you take overmuch on yourselves, you sons of Levi.
sentences.susu: Tina wo tɛ sa e kui, wo surayi gan Alatala bɛ. Alatala na naxan sugandi, na nan sɛniyɛn. Lewi bɔnsɔɛ, yakɔsi wo bara a radangi a i.»

sentences.english: And Moses said to Korah, Give ear now, you sons of Levi:
sentences.susu: Munsa man naxa a fala Kora bɛ, «Lewi bɔnsɔɛ xa die, wo wo tuli mati.

sentences.english: Does it seem only a small thing to you that the God of Israel has made you separate from the rest of Israel, letting you come near himself to do the work of the House of the Lord, and to take your place before the people to do what has to be done for them;
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Ala wo sugandixi nɛ Isirayila ɲama ya ma a xa hɔrɔmɔlingira wali xa fe ra. Wo tan nan tima ɲama ya ra e sali tɛmui. Na mu wo wasa?

sentences.english: Letting you, and all your brothers the sons of Levi, come near to him? and would you now be priests?
sentences.susu: A tinma wo tan Lewi bɔnsɔɛ xa makɔrɛ a ra, kɔnɔ wo wama sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali fan nan nabafe.

sentences.english: So you and all your band have come together against the Lord; and Aaron, who is he, that you are crying out against him?
sentences.susu: Na kui i tan nun i xa mixie, wo bara lan wo boore ma wo xa Alatala matandi. Munfe ra wo na tife Haruna kanke?»

sentences.english: Then Moses sent for Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: and they said, We will not come up:
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa mixi xɛɛ Eliyabi xa di xɛmɛe Datan nun Abirami xilide, kɔnɔ e naxa tondi, e fa a fala, «Muxu tan mu sigama.

sentences.english: Is it not enough that you have taken us from a land flowing with milk and honey, to put us to death in the waste land, but now you are desiring to make yourself a chief over us?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra i bara muxu ramini bɔxi ma, kumi nun xiɲɛ xɛlɛma dɛnnaxɛ, alako muxu xa faxa yi gbengberenyi ma? I man wama i yɛtɛ findife muxu xa mangɛ ra?

sentences.english: And more than this, you have not taken us into a land flowing with milk and honey, or given us a heritage of fields and vine-gardens: will you put out the eyes of these men? We will not come up.
sentences.susu: I mu muxu rasoxi bɔxi kui kumi nun xiɲɛ xɛlɛma dɛnnaxɛ. I mu xɛe nun wɛni bilie xa fixi muxu ma kɛ ra. I ɲɔxɔ a ma, a i nun dɔnxuie nan a ra? Muxu mu sigama!»

sentences.english: Then Moses was very angry, and said to the Lord, Give no attention to their offering: not one of their asses have I taken, or done wrong to any of them.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa xɔnɔ ki fanyi ra, a a fala Alatala bɛ, «I naxa e xa sɛrɛxɛ suxu. N mu sese tongoxi e yi ra, hali sofale keren. N mu fe ɲaaxi yo rabaxi e ra.»

sentences.english: And Moses said to Korah, You and all your band are to come before the Lord tomorrow, you and they and Aaron:
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a fala Kora bɛ, «I tan nun i xa mixie, tina wo nun Haruna xa ti be Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: And let every man take a vessel for burning perfumes, and put sweet spices in them; let every man take his vessel before the Lord, two hundred and fifty vessels; you and Aaron and everyone with his vessel.
sentences.susu: Wo birin xa wo xa surayi gansee tongo, wo xa surayi sa a ma, wo wo yɛtɛ masen Alatala bɛ. Na lanma surayi ganse kɛmɛ firin tongo suuli nan ma. I tan nun Haruna, wo fan xa wo xa surayi ganse suxu wo yi ra.»

sentences.english: So every man took his vessel and they put fire in them, with spices, and came to the door of the Tent of meeting with Moses and Aaron.
sentences.susu: E birin naxa tɛ sa e xa surayi gansee kui, e naxa surayi sa a ma, e fa ti hɔrɔmɔlingira dɛ ra. Munsa nun Haruna fan nu na naa.

sentences.english: And Korah made all the people come together against them to the door of the Tent of meeting: and the glory of the Lord was seen by all the people.
sentences.susu: Kora to ɲama birin malan Munsa nun Haruna xili ma hɔrɔmɔlingira dɛ ra, Alatala xa nɔrɛ naxa mini ɲama birin ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa nun Haruna bɛ,

sentences.english: Come out from among this people, so that I may send sudden destruction on them.
sentences.susu: «Wo mini yi mixie ya ma. N xa e sɔntɔ keren na!»

sentences.english: Then falling down on their faces they said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, because of one man's sin will your wrath be moved against all the people?
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Haruna naxa e yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma, e fa a fala, «Alatala, Daali birin Mangɛ, a lanma i xa xɔnɔ ɲama birin ma, mixi keren xa yunubi xa fe ra?»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Munsa yaabi,

sentences.english: Say to the people, Come away from the tent of Korah Dathan, and Abiram.
sentences.susu: «A fala ɲama birin bɛ, e xa e makuya Kora, Datan, nun Abirami xɔnyi ra.»

sentences.english: So Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the responsible men of Israel went with him.
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Isirayila kuntigie naxa siga Abirami nun Datan yire.

sentences.english: And he said to the people, Come away now from the tents of these evil men, without touching anything of theirs, or you may be taken in the punishment of their sins.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala ɲama bɛ, «Wo wo makuya yi yunubitɔɛe xa lingirae ra. Wo naxa din e xa see ra, alako wo naxa fa faxa e xa yunubie xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: So on every side they went away from the tent of Korah Dathan, and Abiram: and Dathan and Abiram came out to the door of their tents, with their wives and their sons and their little ones.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa a masiga Kora, Datan, nun Abirami xa lingirae ra. Datan nun Abirami naxa mini e xɔnyi, e ti naadɛ ra, e nun e xa ginɛe, nun e xa die.

sentences.english: And Moses said, Now you will see that the Lord has sent me to do all these works, and I have not done them of myself.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a fala, «Wo a kolonma a Alatala nan n tixi yi wali birin na, n tan mu a ra.

sentences.english: If these men have the common death of men, or if the natural fate of all men overtakes them, then the Lord has not sent me.
sentences.susu: Xa yi mixie mu faxa kaabanakoe ra, Alatala mu n xɛɛxi.

sentences.english: But if the Lord does something new, opening the earth to take them in, with everything which is theirs, and they go down living into the underworld, then it will be clear to you that the Lord has not been honoured by these men.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa Alatala sa kaabanako raba, a bɔxi rabi, e goro e ɲiɲɛ ra a kui, e tan nun e kɛ birin, na nan a masenma wo bɛ, a e bara Alatala mabere.»

sentences.english: And while these words were on his lips, the earth under them was parted in two;
sentences.susu: Munsa to gɛ na falade, bɔxi naxa rabi e sanyi bun ma,

sentences.english: And the earth, opening her mouth, took them in, with their families, and all the men who were joined to Korah, and their goods.
sentences.susu: a e gerun, Kora nun a xa mixie, e xa lingirae, a nun e xa harige birin.

sentences.english: So they and all theirs went down living into the underworld, and the earth was shut over them, and they were cut off from among the meeting of the people.
sentences.susu: E naxa goro aligiyama e ɲiɲɛ ra, e tan nun e sɔtɔse birin. Bɔxi naxa e makoto, e naxa lɔɛ ɲama tagi.

sentences.english: And all Israel round about them went in flight at their cry, For fear, said they, that we go down into the heart of the earth.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka naxan birin nu na e sɛɛti ma, e naxa e gi e gbelegbele xui ma, e nu fa a fala, «Bɔxi naxa muxu fan gerun de!»

sentences.english: Then fire came out from the Lord, burning up the two hundred and fifty men who were offering the perfume.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa tɛ radin na mixi kɛmɛ firin mixi tongo suuli ma, naxee surayi gan hɔrɔmɔlingira dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel that they are to give you rods, one for every family, for every chief, the head of his father's house, making twelve rods; let every man's name be placed on his rod.
sentences.susu: «A fala Haruna sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa di xɛmɛ Eleyasari bɛ, a xa surayi gansee matongo tɛ xɔɔra, a xa e tɛ wolee rawoli yire makuye. Na surayi gansee bara findi se sɛniyɛnxie ra Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: And let Aaron's name be placed on the rod of Levi: for there is to be one rod for the head of every family.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na surayi gansee matongo, yunubitɔɛe naxee rawalixi e fa faxa, wo e bɔnbɔ han e xa findi a kebela ra, wo e sa sɛrɛxɛbade ma. Se sɛniyɛnxi na a ra barima a nu bara masen Alatala bɛ. Na kui a findi tɔnxuma nan na Isirayilakae bɛ.»

sentences.english: And let them be stored up in the Tent of meeting, in front of the ark of witness where I come to you.
sentences.susu: Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa na mixie xa surayi ganse wure gbeeli daaxie matongo, na mixi faxaxie naxee rawalixi, a e bɔnbɔ han e findi kebela ra, a e sa sɛrɛxɛbade ma.

sentences.english: And the rod of that man who is marked out by me for myself will have buds on it; so I will put a stop to the outcries which the children of Israel make to me against you.
sentences.susu: Na bara findi tɔnxuma ra Isirayilakae bɛ, alako e xa ratu a ma a mu lan mixi yo xa surayi gan sɛrɛxɛ ra bafe Haruna xa die, xa na mu a ra a fan luma nɛ alɔ Kora nun a xa mixie, alɔ Alatala a masenxi Munsa bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So Moses gave these orders to the children of Israel, and all their chiefs gave him rods, one for the head of every family, making twelve rods: and Aaron's rod was among them.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Isirayila ɲama naxa wɔyɛn fɔlɔ Munsa nun Haruna ma, a e tan nan Alatala xa ɲama faxaxi.

sentences.english: And Moses put the rods before the Lord in the Tent of witness.
sentences.susu: E nu e malanfe tɛmui naxɛ Munsa nun Haruna xili ma, e naxa a to nuxui naxa dusu hɔrɔmɔlingira xun ma, Alatala xa nɔrɛ fa mini e ma.

sentences.english: Now on the day after, Moses went into the Tent of witness; and he saw that Aaron's rod, the rod of the house of Levi, had put out buds, and was covered with buds and flowers and fruit.
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Haruna naxa siga hɔrɔmɔlingira dɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then Moses took out all the rods from before the Lord, and gave them back to the children of Israel: and they saw them, and every man took his rod.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Put Aaron's rod back in front of the ark of witness, to be kept for a sign against this false-hearted people, so that you may put a stop to their outcries against me, and death may not overtake them.
sentences.susu: «Wo mini yi mixie ya ma, n xa e sɔntɔ kerenyi ra.» Munsa nun Haruna naxa e yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: This Moses did: as the Lord gave orders, so he did.
sentences.susu: Munsa fa a fala Haruna bɛ, «I xa tɛ wole tongo sɛrɛxɛbade yire, i a sa i xa surayi ganse kui a nun surayi nde. Na xanin mafuren mafuren ɲama mabiri, i sa yunubi xafari maxandi e bɛ. Alatala bara a xa xɔnɛ fulun yi ɲama xili ma, sɔntɔɛ ɲan bara fɔlɔ.»

sentences.english: And the children of Israel said to Moses, Truly, destruction has come on us; an evil fate has overtaken us all.
sentences.susu: Haruna naxa surayi ganse tongo alɔ Munsa a fala a bɛ ki naxɛ, a a gi a siga ɲama yire, sɔntɔɛ nu bara fɔlɔ dɛnnaxɛ. A naxa surayi ba sɛrɛxɛ ra, a fa yunubi xafari maxandi ɲama bɛ.

sentences.english: Death will overtake everyone who comes near, who comes near the House of the Lord: are we all to come to destruction?
sentences.susu: A naxa ti mixi faxaxie nun mixi ɲiɲɛe tagi. Mixi faxafe naxa dan.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Aaron, You and your sons and your father's family are to be responsible for all wrongdoing in relation to the holy place: and you and your sons are to be responsible for the errors which come about in your work as priests.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Haruna bɛ, «I tan, i xa die, nun Lewi bɔnsɔɛ birin, wo tan nan yunubi sɔtɔma xa fe ɲaaxi sa raba hɔrɔmɔlingira xa fe ra. Haruna i tan nun i xa die, wo tan nan yunubi sɔtɔma xa fe ɲaaxi sa raba sɛrɛxɛdubɛɲa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Let your brothers, the family of Levi, come near with you, so that they may be joined with you and be your servants: but you and your sons with you are to go in before the ark of witness.
sentences.susu: I xa Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixi birin maso i ra, alako e xa i tan nun i xa die mali wo xa wali ra hɔrɔmɔlingira kui.

sentences.english: They are to do your orders and be responsible for the work of the Tent; but they may not come near the vessels of the holy place or the altar, so that death may not overtake them or you.
sentences.susu: E i malima hɔrɔmɔlingira wali kui, kɔnɔ e naxa makɔrɛ yirabase sɛniyɛnxie nun sɛrɛxɛbade ra, alako wo naxa faxa, e tan nun i tan.

sentences.english: They are to be joined with you in the care of the Tent of meeting, doing whatever is needed for the Tent: and no one of any other family may come near you.
sentences.susu: E birama nɛ i fɔxɔ ra i xa hɔrɔmɔlingira wali birin kui. Mixi gbɛtɛ yo naxa sunbu wo ra.

sentences.english: You are to be responsible for the holy place and the altar, so that wrath may never again come on the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Wo tan gbansan xa sɛniyɛn lingira nun sɛrɛxɛbade wali raba, alako Alatala naxa fa a xa xɔnɛ ramini Isirayilakae ma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Now, see, I have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel: they are given to you and to the Lord, to do the work of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: N tan nan wo ngaxakerenyi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ tongoxi Isirayilakae ya ma n yɛtɛ bɛ. N bara e sa wo sagoe, e xa wo mali hɔrɔmɔlingira wali raba ra.

sentences.english: And you and your sons with you are to be responsible as priests for the altar and everything on it, and everything inside the veil; you are to do the work of priests; I have given you your position as priests; and any other man who comes near will be put to death.
sentences.susu: I tan nun i xa die, wo ɲɔxɔ sama nɛ wo xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali xɔn ma sɛrɛxɛbade nun yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante, naxan na dugi gbakuxi xanbi ra. N tan nan na wali fixi wo ma. Mixi gbɛtɛ na a maso na ra, a faxama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Aaron, See, I have given into your care my lifted offerings; even all the holy things of the children of Israel I have given to you and to your sons as your right for ever, because you have been marked with the holy oil.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a fala Haruna bɛ, «N bara Isirayilakae xa hadiya sɛniyɛnxi birin fi i tan nun i xa die ma, barima wo tan nan sugandixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra abadan.

sentences.english: This is to be yours of the most holy things, out of the fire offerings; every offering of theirs, every meal offering and sin-offering, and every offering which they make on account of error, is to be most holy for you and your sons.
sentences.susu: See nan yi ki naxee findima i gbe ra se sɛniyɛnxie tagi, tɛ mu naxee ganxi: Isirayilakae xa sɛrɛxɛ, e xa sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛe, e xa yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛe, nun e xa yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛe. Na sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxie findima i tan nun i xa die nan gbe ra.

sentences.english: As most holy things they are to be your food: let every male have them for food; it is to be holy to you.
sentences.susu: Wo nee donma nɛ alɔ se sɛniyɛnxie. Xɛmɛ birin nɔma e donde wo xa denbaya kui. Se sɛniyɛnxie nan e ra wo bɛ.»

sentences.english: And this is yours: the lifted offering which they give and all the wave offerings of the children of Israel I have given to you and to your sons and to your daughters as your right for ever: everyone in your house who is clean may have them for food.
sentences.susu: «Se naxee baxi Isirayilakae xa hadiya sɛniyɛnxie ra, n nee fan fima nɛ i ma, naxee lintanma n ya i a masenfe ra n gbe na a ra. N na fima i tan, i xa di xɛmɛe, nun i xa di ginɛe ma. I xa mixi birin naxee sɛniyɛnxi e nɔma na donde.

sentences.english: All the best of the oil and the wine and the grain, the first-fruits of them which they give to the Lord, to you have I given them.
sentences.susu: N man bara daxamui singee fi i ma, Isirayilakae naxee bama n na hadiya ra alɔ ture, wɛni, nun sansi xɔrie dinxi.

sentences.english: The earliest produce from their land which they take to the Lord is to be yours; everyone in your house who is clean may have it for his food.
sentences.susu: Daxamui singee e fama naxan birin na n bɛ, na birin findima i gbe nan na. I xa mixi birin naxee sɛniyɛnxi e nɔma na donde.»

sentences.english: Everything given by oath to the Lord in Israel is to be yours.
sentences.susu: «Se naxan birin haramuxi mixie bɛ Isirayila bɔxi ma, a fa findi n gbe ra, n bara na fi i ma.

sentences.english: The first birth of every living thing which is offered to the Lord, of man or beast, is to be yours; but for the first sons of man payment is to be made, and for the first young of unclean beasts.
sentences.susu: Di singe birin naxee fima Alatala ma, a findi mixi ra, a findi xuruse ra, na birin i tan nan gbe a ra. Kɔnɔ ibunadama xa di xɛmɛ singe nun sube haramuxi xa di xɛmɛ singe, e tan xun sarama nɛ.

sentences.english: Payment is to be made for these when they are a month old, at the value fixed by you, a price of five shekels by the scale of the holy place, that is, twenty gerahs to the shekel.
sentences.susu: E na kike keren sɔtɔ, e xun xa sara gbeti kole suuli, naxan kole keren lanma giramu fu ma.»

sentences.english: But no such payment may be made for the first birth of an ox or a sheep or a goat; these are holy: their blood is to be dropped on the altar, and their fat burned for an offering made by fire, a sweet smell to the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ i naxa ningee, yɛxɛɛe, nun sie xa di singee xun sara, barima e tan sɛniyɛnxi. E wuli xa kasan sɛrɛxɛbade ma, e ture xa ba sɛrɛxɛ ra. E xa gan tɛ ra Alatala bɛ. Na rafan a ma.

sentences.english: Their flesh is to be yours; like the breast of the wave offering and the right leg, it is to be yours.
sentences.susu: E ganyanyi nun e yirefanyi tabe findima i gbe nan na, barima e nu lintanxi n tan Alatala ya i sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: All the lifted offerings of the holy things which the children of Israel give to the Lord, I have given to you and to your sons and to your daughters as a right for ever. This is an agreement made with salt before the Lord, to you and to your seed for ever.
sentences.susu: N bara nee fi i tan nun i xa die ma abadan, Isirayilaka naxan birin bama e xa sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxie ra Alatala bɛ. Saatɛ nan a ra naxan mu kanama abadan, i tan nun i bɔnsɔɛ birin bɛ Alatala ya i.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Aaron, You will have no heritage in their land, or any part among them; I am your part and your heritage among the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Haruna bɛ, «I mu kɛ sɔtɔma Isirayila bɔxi ma alɔ boore. N tan nan findima i kɛ ra Isirayilakae tagi. I hayi mu na sese gbɛtɛ ma.»

sentences.english: And to the children of Levi I have given as their heritage all the tenths offered in Israel, as payment for the work they do, the work of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: «N Isirayila xa farilɛ fima Lewi bɔnsɔɛ nan ma sare ra e xa hɔrɔmɔlingira wali xa fe ra.

sentences.english: In future the children of Israel are not to come near the Tent of meeting, so that death may not come to them because of sin.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa e maso hɔrɔmɔlingira ra sɔnɔn, alako e naxa fa yunubi sɔtɔ na kui e faxama naxan ma.

sentences.english: But the Levites are to do the work of the Tent of meeting, and be responsible for errors in connection with it: this is a law for ever through all your generations; and among the children of Israel they will have no heritage.
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ nan hɔrɔmɔlingira xa wali rabama. Xa yunubi yo sa mini na wali kui, e tan nan a kote tongoma. Na findima sɛriyɛ nan na wo bɛ abadan. Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mu fama kɛ sɔtɔde Isirayilakae tagi.

sentences.english: For the tenths which the children of Israel give as a lifted offering to the Lord I have given to the Levites as their heritage. and so I have said to them, Among the children of Israel they will have no heritage.
sentences.susu: N bara Isirayilakae xa farilɛ fi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ma kɛ ra. Na nan a toxi, n na a falaxi e xa fe ra, kɛ mu na e tan bɛ Isirayilakae tagi.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the Levites, When you take from the children of Israel the tenth which I have given to you from them as your heritage, a tenth part of that tenth is to be offered as an offering lifted up before the Lord.
sentences.susu: «A fala Lewi bɔnsɔɛ bɛ, ‹Isirayilakae na fa e xa farilɛ ra, n naxan fima wo ma, wo xa na farilɛ xa farilɛ ba n tan bɛ.

sentences.english: And this lifted offering is to be put to your credit as if it was grain from the grain-floor and wine from the vines.
sentences.susu: Na kui wo fan a rabama nɛ alɔ wo ngaxakerenyi naxee farilɛ bama e xa sansi xɔri ra lonyi yire, xa na mu a ra e xa wɛni ra e a bunduma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: So you are to make an offering lifted up to the Lord from all the tenths which you get from the children of Israel, giving out of it the Lord's lifted offering to Aaron the priest.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo xa hadiya ba n bɛ Isirayilakae xa farilɛ ra, wo fa a so Haruna sɛrɛxɛdubɛ yi ra.

sentences.english: From everything given to you, let the best of it, the holy part of it, be offered as a lifted offering to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa farilɛ ba n bɛ hadiya ra wo naxan birin sɔtɔma. Wo xa daxamui singee wo naxee sɔtɔma, wo xa n gbe ba na ra.›

sentences.english: Say to them, then, When the best of it is lifted up on high, it is to be put to the account of the Levites as the increase of the grain-floor and of the place where the grapes are crushed.
sentences.susu: I man xa a fala e bɛ, ‹Wo na gɛ daxamui fisamante bade n bɛ, wo xa na farilɛ ba sansi xɔri nun wɛni ra Lewi bɔnsɔɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: It is to be your food, for you and your families in every place: it is your reward for your work in the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: Wo tan nun wo xa denbayae nɔma na donde wo wama a xɔn dɛnnaxɛ. Wo xa hɔrɔmɔlingira wali sare nan na ki.

sentences.english: And no sin will be yours on account of it, when the best of it has been lifted up on high; you are not to make a wrong use of the holy things of the children of Israel, so that death may not overtake you.
sentences.susu: Daxamui singee bafe mu findima yunubi ra wo bɛ. Wo mu Isirayilakae xa hadiya sɛniyɛnxie maberema na kui, wo man mu faxama na xa fe ra.›»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa nun Haruna bɛ,

sentences.english: This is the rule of the law which the Lord has made, saying, Give orders to the children of Israel to give you a red cow without any mark on her, and on which the yoke has never been put:
sentences.susu: «Ala xa sɛriyɛ nan ya. Isirayilakae xa fa ninge ginɛ gbeeli ra, naxan mu mabɛnxi, lanyuru mu na naxan ma, a nun naxan mu sari bɛndunxi sinden.

sentences.english: Give her to Eleazar the priest and let him take her outside the tent-circle and have her put to death before him.
sentences.susu: I xa na so Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ yi ra, a kɔn fa raxaba a ya xɔri yonkinde fari ma.

sentences.english: Then let Eleazar the priest take some of her blood on his finger, shaking the blood seven times in the direction of the front of the Tent of meeting:
sentences.susu: Eleyasari xa a wuli nde kasan a bɛlɛxɛsole ra hɔrɔmɔlingira sode mabiri sanmaya solofere.

sentences.english: And the cow is to be burned before him, her skin and her flesh and her blood and her waste are to be burned:
sentences.susu: E xa na ninge gundi birin gan a ya xɔri, a kiri, a sube, a wuli, nun a ɲaɲɛ.

sentences.english: Then let the priest take cedar-wood and hyssop and red thread, and put them into the fire where the cow is burning.
sentences.susu: Na ninge na ganfe tɛmui naxɛ, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa sɛdiri wuri nde, hisopi, nun gɛsɛ gbeeli woli tɛ xɔɔra.»

sentences.english: And the priest, after washing his clothing and bathing his body in water, may come back to the tent-circle, and will be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: «Na dangi xanbi, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa a fate nun a xa sosee maxa, a fa so yonkin yire, kɔnɔ a mu sɛniyɛnxi han nunmare.

sentences.english: And he who does the burning is to have his clothing washed and his body bathed in water and be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: Naxan bara ninge gan, na fan xa a fate nun a xa sosee maxa, kɔnɔ a mu sɛniyɛnxi han nunmare.

sentences.english: Then let a man who is clean take the dust of the burned cow and put it outside the tent-circle in a clean place, where it is to be kept for the children of Israel and used in making the water which takes away what is unclean: it is a sin-offering.
sentences.susu: Mixi sɛniyɛnxi nde xa na ninge ganxi xube makɔ, a sa e sa yire sɛniyɛnxi yonkinde fari ma. A ragatama mɛnni nɛ Isirayila ɲama bɛ alako e xa marasɛniyɛn yɛ yailan a ra. Yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ nan a ra.

sentences.english: And he who takes up the dust of the burned cow is to have his clothing washed with water and be unclean till evening: this is to be a law for ever, for the children of Israel as well as for the man from another country who is living among them.
sentences.susu: Naxan bara na ninge ganxi xube makɔ, na fan xa a fate nun a xa dugie xa, kɔnɔ a mu sɛniyɛnxi han nunmare. Na sɛriyɛ mu kanama abadan Isirayilakae nun e xɔɲɛe bɛ.»

sentences.english: Anyone touching a dead body will be unclean for seven days:
sentences.susu: «Naxan na din mixi faxaxi ra, na kanyi findima sɛniyɛntare nan na xi solofere bun ma.

sentences.english: On the third day and on the seventh day he is to make himself clean with the water, and so he will be clean: but if he does not do this on the third day and on the seventh day, he will not be clean.
sentences.susu: A xa a yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn yi marasɛniyɛn ye ra a xi saxan nde nun a xi solofere nde ma. Xa a mu a raba na xi saxan nde nun na xi solofere nde ma, a mu sɛniyɛnma.

sentences.english: Anyone touching the body of a dead man without making himself clean in this way, makes the House of the Lord unclean; and that man will be cut off from Israel: because the water was not put on him, he will be unclean; his unclean condition is unchanged.
sentences.susu: Xa naxan yo din mixi faxaxi fure ra, a fa lu a mu a yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn, na kanyi xa sɛniyɛntareɲa dangima nɛ Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira ma. Na kanyi xa keri Isirayilakae ya ma. Marasɛniyɛn ye to mu kasanxi a ma, a mu sɛniyɛnxi.»

sentences.english: This is the law when death comes to a man in his tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, will be unclean for seven days.
sentences.susu: «Sɛriyɛ nan ya: Xa mixi faxa kiri banxi nde kui, mixi yo naxan na naa, xa na mu a ra a soma naa, na kanyi findima mixi sɛniyɛntare nan na xi solofere bun ma.

sentences.english: And every open vessel without a cover fixed on it will be unclean.
sentences.susu: Sesase rabixi birin findima se sɛniyɛntare ra.

sentences.english: And anyone touching one who has been put to death with the sword in the open country, or the body of one who has come to his end by a natural death, or a man's bone, or the resting-place of a dead body, will be unclean for seven days.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan din mixi faxaxi ra wula i, naxan bara faxa a ɲaaxi ra, xa na mu a faxa a yɛtɛ ma, na kanyi findima sɛniyɛntare nan na xi solofere bun ma. Naxan din mixi faxaxi xɔrie ra, xa na mu a gaburi ra, na fan mu sɛniyɛnxi xi solofere bun ma.»

sentences.english: And for the unclean, they are to take the dust of the burning of the sin-offering, and put flowing water on it in a vessel:
sentences.susu: «A lanma na mixi mɔɔli xa sɛniyɛn ye ra, naxan masunbuxi na ninge ganxi xube ra. Na ye xa tongo dulonyi yire, xa na mu a ra xure.

sentences.english: And a clean person is to take hyssop and put it in the water, shaking it over the tent, and all the vessels, and the people who were there, and over him by whom the bone, or the body of one who has been put to death with the sword, or the body of one who has come to his end by a natural death, or the resting-place was touched.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ sɛniyɛnxi nde xa hisopi wuri salonyi tongo, a a rasin na ye xɔɔra, a a kasan na kiri banxi ma, a kui se birin ma, nun mixie ma naxee nu na a kui. E man xa na raba mixi ra naxan dinxi mixi fure ra, naxan faxa a ɲaaxi ra, xa na mu a ra naxan faxa a yɛtɛ ma, a nun mixi naxan dinxi mixi xɔrie ra, xa na mu gaburi ra.

sentences.english: Let the clean person do this to the unclean on the third day and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he is to make him clean; and after washing his clothing and bathing himself in water, he will be clean in the evening.
sentences.susu: Mixi sɛniyɛnxi xa na ye kasan mixi sɛniyɛntare ma a xi saxan nde nun a xi solofere nde. A na gɛ na ra, a xa a yɛtɛ nun a xa sosee maxa ye ra, a fa findi mixi sɛniyɛnxi ra na xi solofere nunmare ra.»

sentences.english: But the man who, being unclean, does not make himself clean in this way, will be cut off from the meeting of the people, because he has made the holy place of the Lord unclean: the water has not been put on him, he is unclean.
sentences.susu: «Mixi naxan tondi a yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛnde, na kanyi xa keri ɲama ya ma, barima a xa sɛniyɛntareɲa dangima nɛ Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira ma. A to mu kasanxi marasɛniyɛn ye ra, a mu sɛniyɛnxi.

sentences.english: This is to be a law for them for ever: he who puts the water on the unclean person is to have his clothing washed; and anyone touching the water will be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: Yaamari nan na ki Isirayilakae bɛ naxan mu kanama abadan.» «Marasɛniyɛn ye kasanma naxan ma, na kanyi xa a xa dugie xa. A mu sɛniyɛnma fo nunmare.

sentences.english: Anything touched by the unclean person will be unclean; and any person touching it will be unclean till evening.
sentences.susu: Mixi sɛniyɛntare dinma se naxan na, na se bara findi se sɛniyɛntare ra. Mixi naxan dinma na se ra, na fan findima mixi sɛniyɛntare nan na han nunmare.»

sentences.english: In the first month all the children of Israel came into the waste land of Zin, and put up their tents in Kadesh; there death came to Miriam, and they put her body to rest in the earth.
sentences.susu: Kike singe, Isirayila ɲama birin naxa so Sini gbengberenyi ma, e yonkin Kadesi. Mariyama naxa faxa mɛnni, e fa a ragata gaburi kui.

sentences.english: And there was no water for the people: and they came together against Moses and against Aaron.
sentences.susu: Ye to mu nu na ɲama yi ra, e naxa e malan Munsa nun Haruna xili ma.

sentences.english: And the people were angry with Moses and said, If only death had overtaken us when our brothers came to their death before the Lord!
sentences.susu: E naxa sɔnxɔ Munsa ra, e nu a fala, «A nu fisa muxu fan xa faxa Alatala muxu ngaxakerenyie faxa tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: Why have you taken the Lord's people into this waste, for death to come to us and to our cattle there?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra wo Alatala xa ɲama rafaxi yi gbengberenyi ma, muxu nun muxu xa xurusee xa faxa?

sentences.english: Why have you made us come out of Egypt into this evil place? This is no place of seed or figs or vines or other fruits, and there is no water for drinking.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra wo muxu raminixi Misira bɔxi ra fafe ra yi yire ɲaaxi, xɔrɛ bili, wɛni bili, girenadi wuri bili mu na dɛnnaxɛ. Hali ye min daaxi mu sɔtɔma be.»

sentences.english: Then Moses and Aaron went away from the people to the door of the Tent of meeting; and, falling on their faces there, they saw the glory of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Haruna naxa keli ɲama ya ma, e e felen hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra. Alatala xa nɔrɛ naxa mini e ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Take the rod, you and Aaron, your brother, and make all the people come together, and before their eyes give orders to the rock to give out its water; and so make water come out of the rock for them, and give the people and their cattle drink.
sentences.susu: «I xa yisuxuwuri tongo. I tan nun i taara Haruna, wo xa Isirayilaka birin malan, wo wɔyɛn fanye ra e ya xɔri, alako a xa ye ramini. Wo ye raminima nɛ Isirayila ɲama bɛ alako e tan nun e xa xurusee xa ye min.»

sentences.english: And Moses took the rod from before the Lord as he gave him orders.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a xa yisuxuwuri tongo naxan nu na hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, alɔ Alatala a yamari a bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then Moses and Aaron made the people come together in front of the rock, and he said to them, Give ear now, you people whose hearts are turned from the Lord; are we to get water for you out of the rock?
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Haruna naxa ɲama malan na fanye ya ra, e fa a fala e bɛ, «Wo tuli mati, wo tan matandilae. Muxu xa ye ramini wo bɛ yi fanye kui?»

sentences.english: And lifting up his hand, Moses gave the rock two blows with his rod: and water came streaming out, and the people and their cattle had drink enough.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a bɛlɛxɛ ite, a fanye bɔnbɔ sanya firin a xa yisuxuwuri ra. Ye naxa gbusan fanye ra, ɲama nun xuruse birin naxa e min.

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to Moses and Aaron, Because you had not enough faith in me to keep my name holy before the children of Israel, you will not take this people into the land which I have given them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala naxa a masen Munsa nun Haruna bɛ, «Wo to mu laxi n na, Isirayila ɲama ya xɔri, wo xa binyɛ ti n tan Sɛniyɛntɔɛ ma, wo tan mu fama yi ɲama rasode na bɔxi ma n dɛnnaxɛ fixi e ma.»
