sentences.english: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel went against the Lord, and they saw that he was holy among them.
sentences.susu: E mɛnni nan xili Meriba ye, barima Isirayilakae sɔnxɔ Alatala ma mɛnni nɛ, a fa a xa sɛniyɛnyi masen e bɛ.

sentences.english: Then Moses sent men from Kadesh to the king of Edom to say to him, Your brother Israel says, You have knowledge of all the things we have been through;
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Edon mangɛ ma keli Kadesi, a falafe ra a bɛ, «I ngaxakerenyi Isirayilakae xui nan ya! I a kolon muxu tɔɔrɔxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we were living in Egypt for a long time; and the Egyptians were cruel to us and to our fathers:
sentences.susu: Muxu benbae goro nɛ Misira, muxu naxa ɲɛ wuyaxi raba mɛnni. Kɔnɔ Misirakae naxa muxu nun muxu benbae ɲaxankata.

sentences.english: And the Lord gave ear to the voice of our cry, and sent an angel and took us out of Egypt: and now we are in Kadesh, a town on the edge of your land;
sentences.susu: Muxu naxa Alatala maxandi, a fa muxu xui ramɛ. A naxa a xa malekɛ xɛɛ muxu raminide Misira. Yakɔsi muxu na be Kadesi naxan na wo xa naaninyi ra.

sentences.english: Let us now go through your land: we will not go into field or vine-garden, or take the water of the springs; we will go by the highway, not turning to the right or to the left, till we have gone past the limits of your land.
sentences.susu: A lu muxu xa dangi wo xa bɔxi tagi. Muxu mu wo xa xɛe nun wo xa wɛni bilie kanama. Muxu mu ye bama wo xa kɔlɔnyie kui. Muxu mu sigama kɔɔla ma, muxu mu fama yirefanyi ma. Muxu tima wo xa kira xungbe kerenyi nan xɔn, han muxu dangima wo xa bɔxi ra tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And Edom said, You are not to go through my land, for if you do I will come out against you with the sword.
sentences.susu: Edon mangɛ naxa a yaabi, «Wo mu dangima muxu xa bɔxi ra fefe ma, xa na mu muxu wo gerema santidɛgɛma nan na.»

sentences.english: And the children of Israel said to him, We will go up by the highway: and if we or our cattle take of your water, we will give you a price for it: only let us go through on our feet, nothing more.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae man naxa a fala a bɛ, «Muxu tan dangima nɛ kira xɔn. Xa muxu nun muxu xa xurusee wo xa ye nde min, muxu xa a sare fi. Muxu mu i maxɔrinxi sese ma, muxu wama dangife nɛ tun.»

sentences.english: But he said, You are not to go through. And Edom came out against them in his strength, with a great army.
sentences.susu: Edon mangɛ man naxa a yaabi, «Wo mu dangima feo!» Na kui, a naxa a xa sɔɔrie ramini a sɛnbɛ ki ma Isirayilakae ya ra.

sentences.english: So Edom would not let Israel go through his land; and Israel went in another direction.
sentences.susu: Edon mangɛ to tondi Isirayilakae xa dangi a xa bɔxi ra, Isirayila naxa gbilen.

sentences.english: And they went on from Kadesh, and came, with all their people, to Mount Hor.
sentences.susu: Isirayila ɲama naxa keli Kadesi, e naxa siga Horo geya yire.

sentences.english: And at Mount Hor, at the edge of the land of Edom, the Lord said to Moses and Aaron,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a fala Munsa nun Haruna bɛ Horo geya yire, Edon xa bɔxi naaninyi ra,

sentences.english: Aaron will be put to rest with his people; he will not go into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you went against my word at the waters of Meribah.
sentences.susu: «Haruna fama nɛ a benbae lide aligiyama. A mu soma na bɔxi ma n dɛnnaxɛ fixi Isirayilakae ma, barima wo bara n ma yaamari matandi Meriba ye xa fe ra.

sentences.english: So take Aaron and Eleazar, his son, up into Mount Hor;
sentences.susu: I xa Haruna nun a xa di xɛmɛ Eleyasari xanin Horo geya fari.

sentences.english: And take Aaron's robes off him and put them on Eleazar, his son: and death will come to Aaron there, and he will be put to rest with his people.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni i xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ dugie ba Haruna ma, i e ragoro a xa di xɛmɛ Eleyasari ma. Haruna laaxirama nɛ mɛnni, a fa a benbae yire li.»

sentences.english: So Moses did as the Lord had said, and before the eyes of all the people they went up Mount Hor.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a raba, alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ. E naxa te Horo geya fari Isirayilaka birin ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And Moses took off Aaron's robes, and put them on Eleazar, his son; and there on the top of the mountain death came to Aaron: then Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Haruna xa donmae ba a ma, a e ragoro a xa di xɛmɛ Eleyasari ma. Haruna naxa laaxira geya fari. Munsa nun Eleyasari naxa goro geya ra,

sentences.english: And when the people saw that Aaron was dead, all the children of Israel gave themselves up to weeping for him for thirty days.
sentences.susu: e fa Isirayila ɲama rakolon Haruna faxa fe ra. Isirayila naxa a ɲɔn fe raba xi tongo saxan bun ma.

sentences.english: And it came to the ears of the Canaanite, the king of Arad, living in the South, that Israel was coming by the way of Atharim, and he came out against them and took some of them prisoners.
sentences.susu: Aradi mangɛ Kanaanka, naxan nu sabatixi Negewi bɔxi ma, a to a mɛ, a Isirayila nu minife Atarima kira nan na, a naxa e gere, a ndee findi geelimanie ra.

sentences.english: Then Israel made an oath to the Lord, and said, If you will give up this people into my hands, then I will send complete destruction on all their towns.
sentences.susu: Na kui Isirayila naxa yi laayidi tongo Alatala bɛ, «Xa i yi mixie sa muxu sagoe, muxu e xa taa birin kanama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord, in answer to the voice of Israel, gave the Canaanites up to them; and they put them and their towns completely to destruction: and that place was named Hormah.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa tin Isirayilakae xa laayidi ra, a naxa Kanaankae sa e sagoe. Isirayilakae naxa e sɔntɔ, e e xa taae kana. Na nan a toxi e naxa mɛnni xili sa Horoma, naxan wama a falafe «gbaloe.»

sentences.english: Then they went on from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, going round the land of Edom: and the spirit of the people was overcome with weariness on the way.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa keli Horo geya ma Xulunyumi Baa kira xɔn ma, alako e xa Edon bɔxi mabilin. Kɔnɔ limaniya naxa ba e yi ra,

sentences.english: And crying out against God and against Moses, they said, Why have you taken us out of Egypt to come to our death in the waste land? For there is no bread and no water, and this poor bread is disgusting to us.
sentences.susu: e fa a fala Alatala nun Munsa bɛ, «Munfe ra wo muxu raminixi Misira bɔxi ra, alako muxu xa fa faxa gbengberenyi ma? Taami mu na be, ye mu na be, fo yi donse ɲaaxi naxan goroma koore ma!»

sentences.english: Then the Lord sent poison-snakes among the people; and their bites were a cause of death to numbers of the people of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala naxa a niya bɔximasee xa mini e tagi, e xa mixie xin, e mixi gbegbe faxa.

sentences.english: Then the people came to Moses and said, We have done wrong in crying out against the Lord and against you: make prayer to the Lord to take away the snakes from us. So Moses made prayer for the people.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa a fala Munsa bɛ, «Muxu bara yunubi raba wɔyɛnfe ra i tan nun Alatala ma. I xa Alatala maxandi muxu bɛ, a xa yi bɔximasee makuya muxu ra.» Munsa naxa tin na ra, a Alatala maxandi ɲama bɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Make an image of a snake and put it on a rod, and anyone who has been wounded by the snakes, looking on it will be made well.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a yaabi, «Bɔximase misaali rafala wure gbeeli ra, a gbaku wuri kuye ra. Mixi xinxi naxan a ya tima na ra, a mu faxama.»

sentences.english: So Moses made a snake of brass and put it on a rod; and anyone who had a snakebite, after looking on the snake of brass, was made well.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa bɔximase yailan wure gbeeli ra, a a gbaku wuri kuye ra. Na tɛmui bɔximasee mixi naxee xinxi, e nu nɔma e ya tide na ra, e kisi.

sentences.english: Then the children of Israel went on and put up their tents in Oboth.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa siga, e sa yonkin Oboti.

sentences.english: And journeying on again from Oboth, they put up their tents in Iye-abarim, in the waste land before Moab looking east.
sentences.susu: E naxa keli mɛnni, e siga Iye Abarimi gbengberenyi ma naxan ya rafindixi Mowaba bɔxi ma, sogetede mabiri.

sentences.english: And moving on from there, they put up their tents in the valley of Zered.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Serede gulunba yire.

sentences.english: From there they went on and put up their tents on the other side of the Arnon, which is on the waste land at the edge of the land of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the line of division between Moab and the Amorites:
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Arinon dɛ ra, xure naxan na Amori bɔxi ma. Arinon nan na naaninyi ra Mowabakae nun Amorikae tagi.

sentences.english: As it says in the book of the Wars of the Lord, Vaheb in Suphah, and the valley of the Amon;
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, a sɛbɛxi sɛbɛli nde kui, Alatala xa geree xa fe na naxan kui, «Wahebi nun a xa gulunbae na Sufa bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: The slope of the valleys going down to the tents of Ar and touching the edge of Moab.
sentences.susu: Arinon gulunbae gexi han Ari, a findi Mowaba naaninyi nan na.»

sentences.english: From there they went on to Beer, the water-spring of which the Lord said to Moses, Make the people come together and I will give them water.
sentences.susu: E to keli, e naxa siga Beeri, Alatala a masen Munsa bɛ dɛnnaxɛ, «Ɲama malan, n xa e ki ye ra.»

sentences.english: Then Israel gave voice to this song: Come up, O water-spring, let us make a song to it:
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae yi suuki ba na waxati nɛ: «Ye xa te kɔlɔnyi ra! Wo xa bɛɛti ba a xa fe ra!

sentences.english: The fountain made by the chiefs, made deep by the great ones of the people, with the law-givers' rod, and with their sticks. Then from the waste land they went on to Mattanah:
sentences.susu: Mangɛe nun kuntigie bara a ge, mangɛ tɔnxuma kanyie.»

sentences.english: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:
sentences.susu: E to keli gbengberenyi ma, e naxa siga Matana. E to keli Matana, e naxa siga Naxaliyɛli. E to keli Naxaliyɛli, e naxa siga Bamoti.

sentences.english: And from Bamoth to the valley in the open country of Moab, and to the top of Pisgah looking over Jeshimon.
sentences.susu: E to keli Bamoti, e naxa siga Mowaba gulunba yire, Pisiga geya na dɛnnaxɛ. Gbengberen yire birin toma nɛ na geya fari.

sentences.english: And Israel sent men to Sihon, king of the Amorites, saying,
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Amorikae xa mangɛ Sixɔn yire a falafe ra,

sentences.english: Let me go through your land: we will not go into field or vine-garden, or take the water of the springs; we will go by the highway till we have gone past the limits of your land.
sentences.susu: «Muxu wama girife i xa bɔxi nan ma. Muxu mu xɛ yire nun wɛni bogi yire lima. Muxu mu wo xa kɔlɔn ye minma. Muxu luma mangɛ xa kira gbansan nan xɔn ma, han muxu i xa bɔxi igiri.»

sentences.english: And Sihon would not let Israel go through his land; but got all his people together and went out against Israel into the waste land, as far as Jahaz, to make war on Israel.
sentences.susu: Sixɔn mu tin e xa dangi a xa bɔxi ma. A naxa a xa sɔɔrie malan, e naxa mini Isirayilakae xili ma gbengberenyi ma, e fa e gere Yahasi.

sentences.english: But Israel overcame him, and took all his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as the country of the children of Ammon, for the country of the children of Ammon was strongly armed.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa geeni. E naxa e xa bɔxi birin tongo keli Arinon xure ma han Yaboko xure, han Amonikae xa bɔxi naaninyi ra. E mu nɔ dangide na ra barima Amonikae sɛnbɛ nu gbo.

sentences.english: And Israel took all their towns, living in Heshbon and all the towns and small places of the Amorites.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isirayilakae naxa Amorikae xa taae birin suxu, e fa sabati nee kui. E naxa Xɛsibɔn fan suxu, a nun a xa rabilinyi.

sentences.english: For Heshbon was the town of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who had made war against an earlier king of Moab and taken from him all his land as far as the Arnon.
sentences.susu: Xɛsibɔn nan nu na Amorikae xa mangɛ Sixɔn xa mangataa ra. A nu bara na taa ba Mowaba mangɛ nde yi, a nun a xa bɔxi birin han Arinon xure.

sentences.english: So the makers of wise sayings say, Come to Heshbon, building up the town of Sihon and making it strong:
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, bɛɛtibae a falama, «Wo fa Xɛsibɔn! Sixɔn xa taa xa ti, a man xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ!

sentences.english: For a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the town of Sihon: for the destruction of Ar in Moab, and the lords of the high places of the Arnon.
sentences.susu: Tɛ bara Xɛsibɔn gan, Sixɔn xa taa bara kana tɛ ra. Mowaba bɔxi xa taa Ari fan bara gan, naxan xa mixie nu nɔma Arinon tode.

sentences.english: Sorrow is yours, O Moab! Destruction is your fate, O people of Chemosh: his sons have gone in flight, and his daughters are prisoners, in the hands of Sihon, king of the Amorites.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na wo bɛ Mowabakae, wo tan Kemosi xa batulae. A xa di xɛmɛe bara e gi. A xa di ginɛe bara findi geelimanie ra Amori mangɛ Sixɔn xɔnyi.

sentences.english: They are wounded with our arrows; destruction has come on Heshbon, even to Dibon; and we have made the land waste as far as Nophah, stretching out to Medeba.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ muxu bara nɔ e ra, Xɛsibɔn bara kana han Dibon. Muxu bara e halaki han Nofa, han a sa Medeba li.»

sentences.english: So Israel put up their tents in the land of the Amorites.
sentences.susu: Isirayila naxa sabati Amorikae xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Moses sent men secretly to Jazer, and they took its towns, driving out the Amorites who were living there.
sentences.susu: Munsa to gɛ Yaasɛri taa rabɛnde, Isirayila naxa Amorikae keri na longori birin ma.

sentences.english: Then turning they went up by the way of Bashan; and Og, king of Bashan, went out against them with all his people, to the fight at Edrei.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, e naxa kira tongo sigafe ra Basan. Basan mangɛ Ogo nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa e li Edereyi.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Have no fear of him: for I have given him up into your hands, with all his people and his land; do to him as you did to Sihon, king of the Amorites, at Heshbon.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «I naxa gaaxu a ya ra! N na sama nɛ i bɛlɛxɛ, a nun a xa sɔɔrie nun a xa bɔxi birin. I xa a bɔnbɔ alɔ i Amori mangɛ Sixɔn bɔnbɔxi ki naxɛ Xɛsibɔn.»

sentences.english: So they overcame him and his sons and his people, driving them all out: and they took his land for their heritage.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa Ogo, a xa die, nun a xa sɔɔri birin bɔnbɔ. Mixi keren mu nɔ a bade e yi. E naxa a xa bɔxi findi e gbe ra.

sentences.english: Then the children of Israel, journeying on, put up their tents in the lowlands of Moab, on the other side of Jordan at Jericho.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa siga e sa yonkin Mowaba fiili ma, Yurudɛn xure dɛ, Yeriko ya tagi.

sentences.english: Now Balak, the son of Zippor, saw what Israel had done to the Amorites.
sentences.susu: Siporo xa di xɛmɛ Balaki nu bara a mɛ Isirayilakae naxan nabaxi Amorikae ra.

sentences.english: And in Moab there was great fear of the people, because their numbers were so great: and the feeling of Moab was bitter against the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Mowabakae nu bara gaaxu Isirayila ɲama belebele xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Then Moab said to the responsible men of Midian, It is clear that this great people will be the destruction of everything round us, making a meal of us as the ox does of the grass of the field. At that time Balak, the son of Zippor, was king of Moab.
sentences.susu: Na kui, e naxa a fala Madiyan kuntigie bɛ, «Yi ɲama belebele fama won ma bɔxi birin xun nakanade, alɔ ningee mɛrɛ xun nakanama ki naxɛ.» Balaki nan nu na Mowaba mangɛ ra na tɛmui.

sentences.english: So he sent men to Balaam, son of Beor, at Pethor by the River in the land of the children of his people, saying to him, See, a people has come out of Egypt, covering all the face of the earth, and they have put up their tents opposite to me:
sentences.susu: A naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Beyori xa di xɛmɛ Balami yire, naxan nu sabatixi Petori, a bari taa xure dɛ ra, a falafe ra, «Ɲama belebele nde bara keli Misira bɔxi ma, e fa yonkin n ma bɔxi sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Come now, in answer to my prayer, and put a curse on this people, for they are greater than I: and then I may be strong enough to overcome them and send them out of the land: for it is clear that good comes to him who has your blessing, but he on whom you put your curse is cursed.
sentences.susu: Yandi, i xa fa yi ɲama dankade, barima e sɛnbɛ gbo n bɛ. Tɛmunde, na ki n nɔma nɛ e bɔnbɔde, n e keri yi bɔxi ma. N a kolon, i na duba naxan bɛ, na bara baraka. I man na naxan danka, na fan bara danka.»

sentences.english: So the responsible men of Moab and Midian went away, taking in their hands rewards for the prophet; and they came to Balaam and said to him what Balak had given them orders to say.
sentences.susu: Mowaba kuntigie nun Madiyan kuntigie naxa siga se matoe sare ra Balami xɔn, e fa Balaki xa xɛɛraya iba a bɛ.

sentences.english: And he said to them, Take your rest here tonight, and I will give you an answer after hearing what the Lord says; so the chiefs of Moab kept there with Balaam that night.
sentences.susu: Balami naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo xa kɔɛ radangi be. Alatala na yaabi so n yi, n na falama nɛ wo bɛ.» Na kui, Mowaba kuntigie naxa xi Balami xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And God came to Balaam and said, Who are these men with you?
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa mini Balami ma, a a maxɔrin, «Nde na yi mixie ra i naxee rasɛnɛxi i xɔnyi yi ki?»

sentences.english: And Balaam said to God, Balak, the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent them to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Balami naxa a yaabi, «Mowaba mangɛ Siporo xa di xɛmɛ Balaki nan yi mixie xɛɛ, a e xa fa a fala n bɛ,

sentences.english: See, the people who have come out of Egypt are covering all the earth: now, put a curse on this people for me, so that I may be able to make war on them, driving them out of the land.
sentences.susu: ‹Ɲama belebele nde bara keli Misira bɔxi ma, e fa sabati n ma bɔxi sɛɛti ma. I xa fa yi ɲama danka, alako n xa nɔ e keride.›»

sentences.english: And God said to Balaam, You are not to go with them, or put a curse on this people, for they have my blessing.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Balami bɛ, «I naxa bira yi mixie fɔxɔ ra, i naxa na ɲama danka. Barakatɔɛ ɲama na a ra.»

sentences.english: In the morning Balaam got up and said to the chiefs of Balak, Go back to your land, for the Lord will not let me go with you.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba Balami naxa keli, a a fala Balaki xa kuntigie bɛ, «Wo gbilen wo xa bɔxi ma, barima Alatala mu tinxi n xa bira wo fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: So the chiefs of Moab went back to Balak and said, Balaam will not come with us.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Mowaba kuntigie naxa gbilen Balaki yire, e a fala a bɛ, «Balami bara tondi birade muxu fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: So Balak sent more chiefs, greater in number and of higher position than the others.
sentences.susu: Balaki man naxa kuntigi gbegbe gbɛtɛ xɛɛ, naxee tide dangi a singee ra.

sentences.english: And they came to Balaam and said, Balak, son of Zippor, says, Let nothing keep you from coming to me:
sentences.susu: E naxa siga Balami yire, e a fala a bɛ, «Balaki xa masenyi nan ya: ‹N tan Siporo xa di xɛmɛ Balaki, n bara i mayandi, i naxa tondi talufe ra n yire!

sentences.english: For I will give you a place of very great honour, and whatever you say to me I will do; so come, in answer to my prayer, and put a curse on this people.
sentences.susu: N i sare fima nɛ a fanyi ra. I wama naxan yo xɔn, n na fima nɛ i ma. Yandi i xa yi ɲama danka n bɛ.›»

sentences.english: But Balaam, in answer; said to the servants of Balak, Even if Balak gave me his house full of silver and gold, it would not be possible for me to do anything more or less than the orders of the Lord my God.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Balami naxa Balaki xa xɛɛrae yaabi, «Hali Balaki a xa banxi rafe gbeti nun xɛɛma ra, a a so n yi ra, n mu nɔma fefe rabade n Marigi Alatala mu n yamari naxan na.

sentences.english: So take your rest here this night, till I have knowledge what more the Lord has to say to me.
sentences.susu: Wo naxan nabama, wo fan xa lu be han tina gɛɛsɛgɛ. N man xa Alatala xa masenyi ramɛ.»

sentences.english: And that night God came to Balaam and said to him, If these men have come for you, go with them: but do only what I say to you.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa mini Balami ma kɔɛ ra, a a masen a bɛ, «Yi mixie to bara fa i xilide, i xa bira e fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ n na naxan fala i bɛ, i na nan nabama.»

sentences.english: So in the morning Balaam got up and, making his ass ready, went with the chiefs of Moab.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba Balami naxa baki a xa sofale fari, a bira Mowaba kuntigie fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: But God was moved to wrath because he went: and the angel of the Lord took up a position in the road to keep him from his purpose. Now he was seated on his ass, and his two servants were with him.
sentences.susu: Balami sigafe naxa Alatala raxɔnɔ. Alatala xa malekɛ naxa siga kira ibolonde Balami ya ra. A nu dɔxɔxi a xa sofale fari, a xa walikɛ firinyie nu na a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And the ass saw the angel of the Lord waiting in the road with his sword in his hand; and turning from the road, the ass went into the field; and Balaam gave the ass blows, to get her back on to the road.
sentences.susu: Balami xa sofale to Alatala xa malekɛ to kira tagi, santidɛgɛma suxuxi a yi, a raminixi a tɛ i, a naxa keli kira xɔn ma, a so xɛ ra. Balami naxa sofale bɔnbɔ, alako a xa a xun ti kira ra.

sentences.english: Then the angel of the Lord took up his position in a narrow road through the vine-gardens, with a wall on this side and on that.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ man naxa sa ti e xa kira di xɔn ma wɛni bilie tɛtɛ firinyie tagi.

sentences.english: And the ass saw the angel of the Lord, and went near the wall, crushing Balaam's foot against the wall; and he gave her more blows.
sentences.susu: Sofale to Alatala xa malekɛ to, a naxa a raxɛtɛn tɛtɛ ra, a Balami sanyi xɛtɛn tɛtɛ ra a ɲaaxi ra. Balami naxa gbilen a bɔnbɔ ra.

sentences.english: Then the angel of the Lord went further, stopping in a narrow place where there was no room for turning to the right or to the left.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ man naxa sa ti yire raxɛtɛnxi a fanyi ra. Dangide yo mu nu na.

sentences.english: And the ass saw the angel of the Lord and went down on the earth under Balaam; and full of wrath, Balaam gave her hard blows with his stick.
sentences.susu: Sofale to Alatala xa malekɛ to, a naxa a sa Balami bun ma. Balami naxa xɔnɔ a ma, a a bɔnbɔ a xa yisuxuwuri ra.

sentences.english: Then the Lord gave the ass the power of talking, and opening her mouth she said to Balaam, What have I done to you that you have given me blows these three times?
sentences.susu: Na kui, Alatala naxa sofale dɛ ramini, a a niya a xa a fala Balami bɛ, «A saxan nde nan yi ki i n bɔnbɔma. N munse rabaxi i ra?»

sentences.english: And Balaam said to the ass, You have made me seem foolish: if only I had a sword in my hand I would put you to death.
sentences.susu: Balami naxa a yaabi, «I n matandixi nɛ. Xa santidɛgɛma na n yi ra nu, n i faxama nɛ keren na.»

sentences.english: And the ass said to Balaam, Am I not your ass upon which you have gone all your life till this day? and have I ever done this to you before? And he said, No.
sentences.susu: Sofale naxa a fala Balami bɛ, «N tan xa mu i xa sofale ra, i tema naxan fari tɛmui birin? N darixi yi mɔɔli raba ra?» Balami naxa a yaabi, «Ade.»

sentences.english: Then the Lord made Balaam's eyes open, and he saw the angel of the Lord in the way with his sword in his hand: and he went down on his face to the earth.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala naxa Balami ya rabi malekɛ tofe ra, a tixi kira tagi, a xa santidɛgɛma baxi a tɛ i, a suxuxi a bɛlɛxɛ. Balami naxa a felen, a suyidi keren na.

sentences.english: And the angel of the Lord said to him, Why have you given your ass blows these three times? See, I have come out against you to keep you back, because your purpose is not pleasing to me.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «Munfe ra i bara i xa sofale bɔnbɔ sanya saxan? N faxi nɛ n xa kira ibolon i ya ra, barima i na kira naxan xɔn yi ki, murutɛla xa kira na a ra.

sentences.english: And the ass saw me, turning to one side from me three times: if she had not gone to one side, I would certainly have put you to death and kept her safe.
sentences.susu: I xa sofale bara i ratanga n ma sanya saxan. Xa a tan mu a ra nu, n bara i faxa nu, kɔnɔ n mu a tan faxama.»

sentences.english: And Balaam said to the angel of the Lord, I have done wrong, for I did not see that you were in the way against me: but now, if it is evil in your eyes, I will go back again.
sentences.susu: Balami naxa a fala a bɛ, «N bara yunubi raba! N mu nu a kolonxi, i tixi n ya ra. Kɔnɔ yakɔsi, xa yi biyaasi mu i kɛnɛnxi, n xa gbilen n xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: And the angel of the Lord said to Balaam, Go with the men; but say only what I give you to say. Then Balaam went on with the chiefs of Balak.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa a masen, «Ade, i xa bira yi mixie fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ n na masenyi naxan masen i bɛ, i na nan falama.» Na kui, Balami nun Balaki xa xɛɛrae naxa siga.

sentences.english: Now Balak, hearing that Balaam had come, went to the chief town of Moab, on the edge of the Arnon, in the farthest part of the land, for the purpose of meeting him.
sentences.susu: Balaki to a mɛ a Balami na fafe, a naxa siga a ralande taa nde ma Arinon xure dɛ ra, Mowaba xa naaninyi yire.

sentences.english: And Balak said to Balaam, Did I not send to you, requesting you with all my heart to come to me? why did you not come? am I not able to give you a place of honour?
sentences.susu: A naxa Balami maxɔrin, «Munfe ra i mu fa n ma xɛɛraya singe xili ma? I ɲɔxɔ a ma n mu nɔma i sare fide?»

sentences.english: Then Balaam said to Balak, Now I have come to you; but have I power to say anything? Only what God puts into my mouth may I say.
sentences.susu: Balami naxa Balaki yaabi, «N bara fa i xɔn, kɔnɔ n mu nɔma wɔyɛnde na ki tun. Alatala masenyi naxan sama n dɛ i, n na nan tun falama.»

sentences.english: And Balaam went with Balak to Kiriath-huzoth.
sentences.susu: Balami nun Balaki naxa siga, e so Kiriyati Xusoti.

sentences.english: And Balak made offerings of oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam and the chiefs who were with him.
sentences.susu: Balaki naxa ningee nun yɛxɛɛe ba sɛrɛxɛ ra, a nde so Balami yi ra a nun kuntigi naxee nu na a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And in the morning Balak took Balaam up to the high places of Baal, and from there he was able to see the outer limits of the people.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Balaki naxa Balami xanin Bamoti Baali geya fari. Mɛnni a naxa Isirayila ɲama sɛɛti nde to.

sentences.english: And Balaam said to Balak, Make me here seven altars and get ready seven oxen and seven male sheep.
sentences.susu: Balami naxa a fala Balaki bɛ, «I xa sɛrɛxɛbade solofere yailan be. I man xa fa tuura solofere nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi solofere ra.»

sentences.english: And Balak did as Balaam had said; and Balak and Balaam made an offering on every altar of an ox and a male sheep.
sentences.susu: Balami naxan maxɔrin, Balaki naxa a birin naba. E naxa tuura keren nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren ba sɛrɛxɛ ra na sɛrɛxɛbade keren keren ma.

sentences.english: Then Balaam said to Balak, Take your place by your burned offering, and I will go and see if the Lord comes to me: and I will give you word of whatever he says to me. And he went to an open place on a hill.
sentences.susu: Balami naxa a fala Balaki bɛ, «I xa lu be sɛrɛxɛ fɛ ma, n tan xa n makuya dondoronti. Tɛmunde Alatala fama minide n ma. A naxan yo masen n bɛ, n a falama i bɛ.» Balami to te geya nde fari,

sentences.english: And God came to Balaam, and Balaam said to him, I have made ready seven altars, offering an ox and a male sheep on every altar.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa mini a ma. Balami naxa a fala a bɛ, «N bara sɛrɛxɛbade solofere yailan, n yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren nun tuura keren nan baxi a birin keren keren fari.»

sentences.english: And the Lord put words in Balaam's mouth, and said, Go back to Balak, and this is what you are to say.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa masenyi fi Balami ma a naxan masenma. A naxa a yita a bɛ, «Siga Balaki yire, i xa yi masenyi ti a bɛ.»

sentences.english: So he went back to him where he was waiting by his burned offering with all the chiefs of Moab.
sentences.susu: Balami naxa gbilen Balaki yire, a a li a tixi a xa sɛrɛxɛ fɛ ma, a tan nun Mowaba kuntigie.

sentences.english: And in the words which the Lord had given him he said, From Aram Balak has sent for me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East: come, put curses on Jacob for me and be angry with Israel.
sentences.susu: Balami naxa a xa masenyi ti yi ki, «Balaki nan faxi n na kelife Siriya. Mowaba mangɛ nan n xilixi, kelife sogetede geyae kɔn na. ‹Fa, Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ danka n bɛ! I xa xɔnɛ radin Isirayila ma!›

sentences.english: How may I put curses on him who is not cursed by God? how may I be angry with him with whom the Lord is not angry?
sentences.susu: N nɔma mixi dankade di, Alatala mu naxan dankaxi? N nɔma xɔnɔde mixi ma di, Ala mu xɔnɔxi naxan ma?

sentences.english: From the top of the rocks I see him, looking down on him from the hills: it is a people made separate, not to be numbered among the nations.
sentences.susu: N e toma kelife geya kɔn na, keli yire itexi. Ɲama nan a ra, naxan luma a xati ma, naxan tagi rasama e nun si gbɛtɛe ra.

sentences.english: Who is able to take the measure of the dust of Jacob or the number of the thousands of Israel? May my death be the death of the upright and my last end like his!
sentences.susu: Nde nɔma Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ kɔntide, kɔnti naxan dangima mɛyɛnyi kɔnti ra? E nu Isirayila ɲama itaxun dɔxɔde naani ra, nde nɔma a sɛɛti keren yati kɔntide? Ala xa n mali n xa aligiyama li tinxinyi kui. Ala xa n mali n xa maniya e ra n ma saya kui.»

sentences.english: Then Balak said to Balaam, What have you done to me? I sent for you so that my haters might be cursed, and see, you have given them a blessing.
sentences.susu: Balaki naxa a fala Balami bɛ, «I munse rabaxi n na yi ki? N i rafaxi nɛ n yaxuie dankade, kɔnɔ i tan na dubafe e bɛ.»

sentences.english: And in answer he said, Am I not ordered to say only what the Lord puts into my mouth?
sentences.susu: Balami naxa a yaabi, «Alatala na masenyi naxan sa n dɛ i, n mu lan n xa na fala?»

sentences.english: And Balak said to him, Come with me now into another place from which you will not be able to see them all, but only the outskirts of them; and you will send curses on them from there.
sentences.susu: Balaki man naxa a fala a bɛ, «Won xa siga yire gbɛtɛ, i nɔma e tode dɛnnaxɛ. I sɛɛti keren nan gbansan toma be, i mu e birin toma. Mɛnni i nɔma e birin tode, i fa e danka.»

sentences.english: So he took him into the country of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and there they made seven altars, offering an ox and a male sheep on every altar.
sentences.susu: A naxa Balami xanin Sofimi, Pisiga geya fari. A naxa sɛrɛxɛbade solofere yailan mɛnni, a tuura keren nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren ba sɛrɛxɛ ra na sɛrɛxɛbade keren keren ma fari.

sentences.english: Then he said to Balak, Take your place here by your burned offering, while I go over there to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Balami naxa a fala Balaki bɛ, «I xa lu be i xa sɛrɛxɛ fɛ ma, n tan xa n makuya dondoronti, n nun Alatala xa lu yire keren.»

sentences.english: And the Lord came to Balaam, and put words in his mouth, and said, Go back to Balak, and this is what you are to say.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa mini Balami ma, a masenyi nde fi a ma, a fa a fala a bɛ, «Siga Balaki yire, i xa yi masenyi ti a bɛ.»

sentences.english: So he came to him where he was waiting by his burned offering with the chiefs of Moab by his side. And Balak said to him, What has the Lord said?
sentences.susu: Balami naxa gbilen Balaki yire, a a li a tixi a xa sɛrɛxɛ fɛ ma, a tan nun Mowaba kuntigie. Balaki naxa a maxɔrin, «Alatala munse masenxi?»

sentences.english: And in the words which the Lord had given him he said, Up! Balak, and give ear; give attention to me, O son of Zippor:
sentences.susu: Balami naxa yi masenyi ti a bɛ, «Balaki, keli. Siporo xa di xɛmɛ, i tuli mati.

sentences.english: God is not a man, to say what is false; or the son of man, that his purpose may be changed: what he has said, will he not do? and will he not give effect to the words of his mouth?
sentences.susu: Ala mixi mu a ra, a mu wule falama. Adamadi mu a ra, a xa a xaxili masara. A mu a xui masarama. A mu nɛɛmuma a xa saatɛ ma. A mu laayidi kanama.

sentences.english: See, I have had orders to give blessing: and he has given a blessing which I have no power to take away.
sentences.susu: Ala bara n yamari n xa duba yi ɲama bɛ. Alatala bara baraka sa e ma. N mu nɔma na masarade.

sentences.english: He has seen no evil in Jacob or wrongdoing in Israel: the Lord his God is with him, and the glad cry of a king is among them.
sentences.susu: Tɔɔrɛ mu luma Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ ya ma. Setareɲa mu toma Isirayila. E Marigi Alatala na e fɔxɔ ra. Mangɛ xui mɛma nɛ e tagi.

sentences.english: It is God who has taken them out of Egypt; his horns are like those of the mountain ox.
sentences.susu: Alatala e raminixi Misira bɔxi ra, sɛnbɛ na e yi ra alɔ sɛxɛ ninge.

sentences.english: No evil power has effect against Jacob, no secret arts against Israel; at the right time it will be said of Jacob and of Israel, See what God has done!
sentences.susu: Karamɔxɔ wali mu nɔma Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ tɔɔrɔde. Sematoe mu nɔma sese rabade Isirayila xili ma. A fama falade Yaxuba nun Isirayila xa fe ra, Ala xa wali mato!

sentences.english: See, Israel comes up like a she-lion, lifting himself up like a lion: he will take no rest till he has made a meal of those he has overcome, drinking the blood of those he has put to death.
sentences.susu: Yi ɲama kelima alɔ yɛtɛ ginɛ, e tima alɔ yɛtɛ xɛmɛ, naxan mu a sama fo a xa sube don, a naxan faxa, fo a xa a wuli min.»

sentences.english: Then Balak said to Balaam, If you will not put a curse on them, at all events do not give them a blessing.
sentences.susu: Balaki naxa a fala Balami bɛ, «Xa i mu wama e dankafe, hali i mu duba e bɛ.»

sentences.english: But Balaam in answer said to Balak, Did I not say to you, I may only do what the Lord says?
sentences.susu: Balami naxa a yaabi, «N mu a fala i bɛ, Alatala na naxan yo masen n bɛ, n na nan falama?»

sentences.english: Then Balak said to Balaam, Come now, I will take you to another place; it may be that God will let you put a curse on them from there.
sentences.susu: Balaki naxa a fala Balami bɛ, «Awa, won xa siga yire gbɛtɛ. Tɛmunde Alatala tinma i xa yi ɲama danka n bɛ mɛnni.»

sentences.english: So Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, looking down over the waste land.
sentences.susu: Balaki naxa Balami xanin Peyori geya fari, gbengberenyi toma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And Balaam said to Balak, Make me seven altars here and get seven oxen and seven male sheep ready for me.
sentences.susu: Balami naxa a fala Balaki bɛ, «Sɛrɛxɛbade solofere ti be, i man xa fa tuura solofere nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi solofere ra.»

sentences.english: And Balak did as Balaam said, offering an ox and a male sheep on every altar.
sentences.susu: Balami naxan maxɔrin, Balaki naxa a birin naba. A naxa tuura keren nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren ba sɛrɛxɛ ra na sɛrɛxɛbade keren keren ma fari.

sentences.english: Now when Balaam saw that it was the Lord's pleasure to give his blessing to Israel, he did not, as at other times, make use of secret arts, but turning his face to the waste land,
sentences.susu: Balami to a to a Alatala nu wama baraka safe Isirayila xa fe ma, a mu karamɔxɔ wali raba alɔ a darixi a raba ra ki naxɛ. A naxa a ya rafindi gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: And lifting up his eyes, he saw Israel there, with their tents in the order of their tribes: and the spirit of God came on him.
sentences.susu: A to Isirayila ɲama to, e yonkinxi e bɔnsɔɛ ki ma, Ala Xaxili naxa goro a ma,

sentences.english: And moved by the spirit, he said, These are the words of Balaam, son of Beor, the words of the man whose eyes are open:
sentences.susu: a fa yi masenyi ti: «N yi nan masenma, n tan Beyori xa di xɛmɛ Balami, naxan xa se igbɛma a fanyi ra,

sentences.english: He says, whose ears are open to the words of God, who has seen the vision of the Ruler of all, falling down, but having his eyes open:
sentences.susu: naxan Ala xui ramɛma, naxan Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi xa laamatunyi toma, naxan fahaamui sɔtɔma suyidi kui.

sentences.english: How fair are your tents, O Jacob, your houses, O Israel!
sentences.susu: Yaxuba, i xa kiri banxie rayabu, Isirayila, i xa lingirae tofan.

sentences.english: They are stretched out like valleys, like gardens by the riverside, like flowering trees planted by the Lord, like cedar-trees by the waters.
sentences.susu: E gulunba rafema, e luma alɔ laakɔɛ naxan na xure dɛ ra, alɔ wuri bilie Alatala naxee sixi ye yire.

sentences.english: Peoples will be in fear before his strength, his arm will be on great nations: his king will be higher than Agag, and his kingdom made great in honour.
sentences.susu: Ye mu ɲɔnma Isirayila ɲama yi ra, tunɛ goroma e xa sansie ma a fanyi ra. E xa mangɛ sɛnbɛ gbo Agaga bɛ, Isirayila xa mangɛya xili fanyi sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: It is God who has taken him out of Egypt; his horns are like those of the mountain ox; the nations warring against him will be his food, their bones will be broken, they will be wounded with his arrows.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa e ramini Misira bɔxi ma, e sɛnbɛ gbo alɔ sɛxɛ ninge. E e yaxuie xun nakanama nɛ, naxee e xɔri girama, e e faxama xalie ra.

sentences.english: He took his sleep stretched out like a lion, and like a she-lion: by whom will his rest be broken? May a blessing be on everyone who gives you blessing, and a curse on everyone by whom you are cursed.
sentences.susu: E e malabuma nɛ alɔ yɛtɛ, nde suusama e rakelide? Baraka xa lu mixi bɛ naxan na duba wo bɛ, danka xa lu mixi bɛ naxan na wo danka!»

sentences.english: Then Balak was full of wrath against Balaam, and angrily waving his hands he said to Balaam, I sent for you so that those who are against me might be cursed, but now, see, three times you have given them a blessing.
sentences.susu: Na kui Balaki naxa xɔnɔ Balami ma a ɲaaxi ra. A naxa a fala, «N i xili nɛ i xa n yaxuie danka, kɔnɔ a sanya saxan nde nan yi ki, i na dubafe e bɛ!

sentences.english: Go back quickly to the place you came from: it was my purpose to give you a place of honour, but now the Lord has kept you back from honour.
sentences.susu: Keli be keren na! Siga i xɔnyi! N nu bara laayidi tongo i bɛ wali sare xa fe ra, kɔnɔ Alatala mu tinxi i xa a sɔtɔ!»

sentences.english: Then Balaam said to Balak, Did I not say to the men you sent to me,
sentences.susu: Balami naxa a yaabi, «N mu a fala i xa xɛɛrae bɛ,

sentences.english: Even if Balak gave me his house full of silver and gold, it would not be possible for me to go outside the orders of the Lord, doing good or evil at the impulse of my mind; whatever the Lord says I will say?
sentences.susu: ‹Hali Balaki a xa banxi nan nafe gbeti nun xɛɛma ra n bɛ, n mu nɔma sese rabade Alatala mu n yamari naxan na. Alatala naxan masenma n bɛ, n nɔma gbilende na fɔxɔ ra?›

sentences.english: So now I will go back to my people: but first let me make clear to you what this people will do to your people in days to come.
sentences.susu: Awa, yakɔsi, n na gbilenfe n xɔnyi, kɔnɔ i xa a kolon yi ɲama naxan nabama wo ra.»

sentences.english: Then he went on with his story and said, These are the words of Balaam, the son of Beor, the words of him whose eyes are open:
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Balami naxa yi masenyi ti a bɛ: «Beyori xa di xɛmɛ Balami xa masenyi nan ya, naxan see igbɛma a fanyi ra,

sentences.english: He says, whose ear is open to the words of God, who has knowledge of the Most High, who has seen the vision of the Ruler of all, falling down and having his eyes open:
sentences.susu: naxan Ala xui ramɛma, naxan Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi xa laamatunyi toma, naxan fahaamui sɔtɔma Ala Xili Xungbe saabui ra.

sentences.english: I see him, but not now: looking on him, but not near: a star will come out of Jacob, and a rod of authority out of Israel, sending destruction to the farthest limits of Moab and on the head of all the sons of Sheth.
sentences.susu: N fe toxi naxan fama rabade yare. N fe toxi naxan makuya yakɔsi ra. Tunbui nde fama tede kelife Yaxuba xa mixie ma. Mangɛ tɔnxuma nde fama kelide Isirayila ya ma. A Mowaba xun nakanama nɛ, a Seti xa die xa fe ɲɔnma nɛ.

sentences.english: Edom will be his heritage, and he will put an end to the last of the people of Seir.
sentences.susu: Edon xa fe goroma nɛ, Seyiri xa fe goroma nɛ, kɔnɔ Isirayila sɛnbɛ sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: And Israel will go on in strength, and Jacob will have rule over his haters.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nde kelima Yaxuba xa mixie ya ma, naxan bekae sɔntɔma.»

sentences.english: Then, turning his eyes to Amalek, he went on with his story and said, Amalek was the first of the nations, but his part will be destruction for ever.
sentences.susu: Balami to Amalɛkikae to, a naxa yi masenyi ti: «Amalɛki si fisamante na nu a ra, kɔnɔ a raɲɔnyi, a bɔnɔma nɛ!»

sentences.english: And looking on the Kenites he went on with his story and said, Strong is your living-place, and your secret place is safe in the rock.
sentences.susu: Balami to Kenikae to, a naxa yi masenyi ti: «Wo sabatide mabanbanxi, wo tɛɛ saxi fanye nan fari,

sentences.english: But still the Kenites will be wasted, till Asshur takes you away prisoner.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Asuri fama nɛ wo xun nakanade, a wo findi geelimanie ra.»

sentences.english: Then he went on with his story and said, But who may keep his life when God does this?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a naxa a xa masenyi xun dusu: «Nde nɔma kiside Ala xa ɲaxankatɛ ma?

sentences.english: But ships will come from the direction of Kittim, troubling Asshur and troubling Eber, and like the others their fate will be destruction.
sentences.susu: Kunkuie fama nɛ kelife Kitimi, e nɔma nɛ Asuri nun Xeberi ra, kɔnɔ a raɲɔnyi, e fan xun nakanama nɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Balaam got up and went back to his place: and Balak went away.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Balami naxa keli, a gbilen a xɔnyi. Balaki fan naxa keli naa.

sentences.english: Now when Israel was living in Shittim the people became false to the Lord, doing evil with the daughters of Moab:
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae to nu yonkinxi Sitimi, e naxa so yɛnɛ rabafe Mowaba ginɛe ra.

sentences.english: For they sent for the people to be present at the offerings made to their gods; and the people took part in their feasts and gave honour to their gods.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛe naxa Isirayila xɛmɛe xili e xa lan e xa sɛrɛxɛe ma, naxee nu bama e xa kuyee bɛ.

sentences.english: So Israel had relations with the women of Moab in honour of the Baal of Peor: and the Lord was moved to wrath against Israel.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae to Peyori xa Bali kuye batu fɔlɔ, Alatala naxa xɔnɔ e ma.

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to Moses, Take all the chiefs of the people, hanging them up in the sun before the Lord, so that the wrath of the Lord may be turned from Israel.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a fala Munsa bɛ, a a xa ɲama yarerati birin gbaku wuri kɔn na a ya i, a e ya rafindi soge ma, alako a xa xɔnɛ xa gbilen Isirayila fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: So Moses said to the judges of Israel, Let everyone put to death those of his men who have had relations with the women of Moab in honour of the Baal of Peor.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Isirayila kiitisae yamari, «Wo xa mixi birin faxa, naxan bara Peyori xa Bali kuye batu!»

sentences.english: Then one of the children of Israel came to his brothers, taking with him a woman of Midian, before the eyes of Moses and all the meeting of the people, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: A fɛfɛ na fala, Isirayilaka nde naxa fa Madiyanka ginɛ nde ra a ngaxakerenyie ya i. Munsa nun Isirayila ɲama naxee nu na wafe hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra, naxa na ginɛ nun na xɛmɛ to.

sentences.english: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, seeing it, got up from among the people and took a spear in his hand,
sentences.susu: Haruna xa mamadi, Eleyasari xa di xɛmɛ Finexasi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ to na ginɛ nun na xɛmɛ to, a naxa keli, a tanbɛ tongo,

sentences.english: And went after the man of Israel into the tent, driving the spear through the two of them, through the man of Israel and through the stomach of the woman. So the disease was stopped among the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: a bira na xɛmɛ fɔxɔ ra kiri banxi kui, a sa a tan nun na ginɛ sɔxɔ a xa tanbɛ ra e furi ma keren na. Na tɛmui Alatala xa xɔnɛ naxa dan.

sentences.english: But twenty-four thousand of them had come to their death by the disease.
sentences.susu: Mixi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nan faxa na gbaloe kui.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Through Phinehas, and because of his passion for my honour, my wrath has been turned away from the children of Israel, so that I have not sent destruction on them all in my wrath.
sentences.susu: «Haruna sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa mamadi, Eleyasari xa di xɛmɛ Finexasi, bara n ma xɔnɛ ba Isirayilakae ma. N ma xanunteya n ma ɲama bɛ nu na a bɔɲɛ kui, a fa a niya a xa na raba. N tan mu Isirayila birin sɔntɔ n ma xanunteya xa fe ra.

sentences.english: So say to them that I will make with him an agreement of peace:
sentences.susu: A fala Finexasi bɛ, n bara bɔɲɛsa saatɛ xiri a tan nun n tan tagi.

sentences.english: And by this agreement, he and his sons after him have the right to be priests for ever; because, by his care for the honour of his God, he took away the sin of the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na saatɛ luma n tan nun a bɔnsɔɛ tagi, e fa findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra abadan, barima n ma xanunteya nu na a bɔɲɛ kui, a man fa a niya Isirayilakae xa yunubi xa xafari.»

sentences.english: Now the man of Israel who was put to death with the woman of Midian was Zimri, the son of Salu, a chief of one of the families of the Simeonites.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka naxan faxa e nun na Madiyan ginɛ ra, a nu xili Simiri, Salu xa di xɛmɛ. Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ xunyi nde nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: And the woman of Midian who was put to death was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was the head of a family in Midian.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ Madiyanka tan nu xili Kɔsibi, Suuru xa di ginɛ. Madiyan xabilɛ ndee xunyi nan nu a baba ra.

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Take up arms against the Midianites and overcome them;
sentences.susu: «Wo xa Madiyankae gere alɔ yaxuie!

sentences.english: For they are a danger to you with their false ways, causing sin to come on you in the question of Peor, and because of Cozbi, their sister, the daughter of the chief of Midian, who was put to death at the time of the disease which came on you because of Peor.
sentences.susu: E findixi wo bɛ yaxuie nan na Peyori kuye xa fe ra, nun e maaginɛ Kɔsibi xa fe ra. Kɔsibi findixi e xa yarerati nde xa di ginɛ nan na,

sentences.english: Now after the disease was over, the Lord said to Moses and Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest,
sentences.susu: Na gbaloe to dangi, Alatala naxa a fala Munsa nun Haruna sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa di xɛmɛ Eleyasari bɛ,

sentences.english: Let all the children of Israel be numbered, by the names of their fathers' families, all those of twenty years old and over who are able to go to war in Israel.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa Isirayila ɲama birin xili sɛbɛ, keli a ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn ma han na xanbi, a denbaya ki ma, naxan birin nɔma sɔɔriɲa rabade.»

sentences.english: So Moses and Eleazar the priest gave them the order in the lowlands of Moab by Jordan at Jericho, saying,
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa a fala Isirayilakae bɛ Mowaba bɔxi ma Yurudɛn xure sɛɛti ma Yeriko ya i,

sentences.english: Let all the people of twenty years old and over be numbered, as the Lord has given orders to Moses and the children of Israel who have come out of Egypt.
sentences.susu: «Isirayilaka birin xa kɔnti, keli mixi ma naxan bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn sɔtɔ han na xanbi, alɔ Alatala a yamari Munsa nun Isirayilakae bɛ ki naxɛ.» Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ naxee mini Misira bɔxi ra, nee nan yi ki.

sentences.english: Reuben, the first son of Israel: the sons of Reuben by their families: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:
sentences.susu: A fɔlɔ Isirayila xa di singe Ruben nan ma, a xa die nan yi ki: Xanɔki, Palu,

sentences.english: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
sentences.susu: Xesiron, Karimi, nun e xabilɛe.

sentences.english: These are the families of the Reubenites: their number was forty-three thousand, seven hundred and thirty.
sentences.susu: Ruben bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe nan na ki. Nee xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo naani nun saxan kɛmɛ solofere tongo saxan nan ma.

sentences.english: And the sons of Pallu, Eliab
sentences.susu: Palu xa di xɛmɛ Eliyabi

sentences.english: And the sons of Eliab: Nemuel and Dathan and Abiram. These are the same Dathan and Abiram who had a place in the meeting of the people, who together with Korah made an outcry against Moses and Aaron and against the Lord:
sentences.susu: nan nu na Nemuweli, Datan, nun Abirami baba ra, naxee keli Munsa nun Haruna xili ma Isirayila kuntigie ya ma. E nun Kora nun a fɔxirabirɛe to keli Alatala xili ma,

sentences.english: And they went down into the open mouth of the earth, together with Korah, when death overtook him and all his band; at the time when two hundred and fifty men were burned in the fire, and they became a sign.
sentences.susu: bɔxi rabi nɛ, a fa e birin gerun. Na lɔxɔɛ Alatala mixi kɛmɛ firin mixi tongo suuli gan nɛ tɛ ra, e xa findi misaali ra ɲama bɛ.

sentences.english: But death did not overtake the sons of Korah.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Kora xa die tan mu faxa na fe kui.

sentences.english: The sons of Simeon by their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:
sentences.susu: Simeyɔn xa die nan yi ki e xabilɛ ki ma: Nemuweli, Yamin, Yakimi,

sentences.english: Of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
sentences.susu: Sera, Sawulu, a nun e xabilɛe.

sentences.english: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand, two hundred.
sentences.susu: Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe nan na ki. Nee xasabi lan mixi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin, mixi kɛmɛ firin nan ma.

sentences.english: The sons of Gad by their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:
sentences.susu: Gadi xa die nan yi ki e xabilɛ ki ma: Sefon, Xagi, Suni,

sentences.english: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:
sentences.susu: Oseni, Eri,

sentences.english: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
sentences.susu: Arodi, Areli, nun e xabilɛe.

sentences.english: These are the families of the sons of Gad as they were numbered, forty thousand, five hundred.
sentences.susu: Gadi bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe nan na ki. E xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo naani, mixi kɛmɛ suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: The sons of Judah, Er and Onan: and Er and Onan had come to their death in the land of Canaan.
sentences.susu: Yuda xa die nan yi ki: Eru nun Onan. Kɔnɔ e tan faxa Kanaan bɔxi nan ma.

sentences.english: And the sons of Judah by their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelahites: of Perez, the family of the Perezites: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.
sentences.susu: Yuda xa die nan yi ki e xabilɛ ki ma: Selaha, Peresi, Sera, nun e xabilɛe.

sentences.english: And the sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
sentences.susu: Peresi xa die nan yi ki: Xesiron, Xamuli, nun e xabilɛe.

sentences.english: These are the families of Judah as they were numbered, seventy-six thousand, five hundred.
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe nan na ki. E xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo solofere nun senni, mixi kɛmɛ suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: The sons of Issachar by their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Puvah, the family of the Punites:
sentences.susu: Isakari xa die nan yi ki e xabilɛ ki ma: Tola, Puwa,

sentences.english: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
sentences.susu: Yasubu, Simiron, nun e xabilɛe.

sentences.english: These are the families of Issachar, as they were numbered, sixty-four thousand, three hundred.
sentences.susu: Isakari bɔnsɔɛe nan na ki e xabilɛ ki ma. E xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo senni nun naani, mixi kɛmɛ saxan nan ma.

sentences.english: The sons of Zebulun by their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
sentences.susu: Sabulon xa die nan yi ki e xabilɛ ki ma: Seredi, Elon, Yaxaleeli, nun e xabilɛe.

sentences.english: These are the families of the Zebulunites as they were numbered, sixty thousand, five hundred.
sentences.susu: Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe nan na ki. E xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo senni, mixi kɛmɛ suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: The sons of Joseph by their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.
sentences.susu: Yusufu xa die nan yi ki e xabilɛ ki ma: Manasi nun Efirami.

sentences.english: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir was the father of Gilead: of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.
sentences.susu: Manasi xa die nan yi ki: Makiri nun a xabilɛe. Makiri nan Galadi nun a xabilɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:
sentences.susu: Galadi xa die nan yi ki e xabilɛ ki ma: Yeseri, Xeleki,

sentences.english: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:
sentences.susu: Asirɛli, Sikemi,

sentences.english: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
sentences.susu: Sɛmida, Xeferi, nun e xabilɛe.

sentences.english: And Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, had no sons, but only daughters, and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
sentences.susu: Xeferi xa di xɛmɛ Selofexadi tan di ginɛe nan tun sɔtɔ. Nee xilie nan yi ki: Maxala, Nowa, Xogala, Milika nun Tirisa.

sentences.english: These are the families of Manasseh; and those who were numbered of them were fifty-two thousand, seven hundred.
sentences.susu: Manasi bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe nan na ki. E xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo suuli nun firin, mixi kɛmɛ solofere nan ma.

sentences.english: These are the sons of Ephraim by their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites: of Becher, the family of the Becherites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
sentences.susu: Efirami xa die nan yi ki e xabilɛ ki ma: Sutela, Bekeri, Taxani, nun e xabilɛe.

sentences.english: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites:
sentences.susu: Sutela xa di nan yi ki: Eran nun a xabilɛe.

sentences.english: These are the families of Ephraim as they were numbered, thirty-two thousand, five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph by their families.
sentences.susu: Efirami xa die nan na ki. E xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo saxan nun firin, mixi kɛmɛ suuli nan ma. Yusufu xa mamadie nan na ki e xabilɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: The sons of Benjamin by their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:
sentences.susu: Bunyamin xa die nan yi ki e xabilɛ ki ma: Bela, Asibeli, Axirama,

sentences.english: Of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites: and of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
sentences.susu: Sufami, Xufami, nun e xabilɛe.

sentences.english: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
sentences.susu: Bela xa die naxa findi Arade, Naaman, nun e xabilɛe ra.

sentences.english: These are the sons of Benjamin by their families: and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand, six hundred.
sentences.susu: Bunyamin xa die nan na ki e xabilɛ ki ma. E xasabi naxa lan mixi wulu tongo naani nun mixi suuli kɛmɛ senni ma.

sentences.english: These are the sons of Dan by their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan by their families.
sentences.susu: Dana xa die nan yi ki e xabilɛ ki ma. Suxami nun a xabilɛe. Dana bɔnsɔɛ nan na ki e xabilɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: All the families of the Shuhamites, as they were numbered, were sixty-four thousand, four hundred.
sentences.susu: E xasabi naxa lan mixi wulu tongo senni nun naani, mixi kɛmɛ naani ma.

sentences.english: The sons of Asher by their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites: of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
sentences.susu: Aseri xa die nan yi ki e xabilɛ ki ma: Yimena, Yisiwi, Beriya, nun e xabilɛe.

sentences.english: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites:
sentences.susu: Beriya xa die nan yi ki: Xeberi, Malakiyeli, nun e xabilɛe.

sentences.english: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.
sentences.susu: Aseri xa di ginɛ nu xili nɛ Sera.

sentences.english: These are the families of the sons of Asher as they were numbered, fifty-three thousand, four hundred.
sentences.susu: Aserikae nan na ki e xabilɛ ki ma. E xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo suuli nun saxan, mixi kɛmɛ naani nan ma.

sentences.english: The sons of Naphtali by their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:
sentences.susu: Nafatali xa die nan yi ki e xabilɛ ki ma: Yaxaseeli, Guni,

sentences.english: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
sentences.susu: Yeseri, Silemi, nun e xabilɛe.

sentences.english: These are the families of Naphtali by their families: and those who were numbered of them were forty-five thousand, four hundred.
sentences.susu: Nafatali bɔnsɔɛe nan na ki e xabilɛ ki ma. E xasabi lan mixi wulu tongo naani nun suuli, mixi kɛmɛ naani nan ma.

sentences.english: Those who were numbered of the children of Israel were six hundred and one thousand, seven hundred and thirty.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka kɔnti lanxi mixi wulu kɛmɛ senni nun keren, mixi kɛmɛ solofere tongo saxan nan ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Let there be a division of the land among these, for their heritage, in relation to the number of names.
sentences.susu: «Kanaan bɔxi itaxunma na mixie nan ma e bɔnsɔɛ xasabi ma, a findi e kɛ ra.

sentences.english: To those families who are more in number, give a greater heritage; to those who are less in number, a smaller part: to every one let the heritage be given in relation to the number in his family.
sentences.susu: Bɔnsɔɛ birin kɛ sɔtɔma a xa mixie xasabi bɛrɛ nan na. Bɔnsɔɛ naxee xa mixie gbo, i nee gbe ragbo dangi booree ra, naxee xa mixi xurun.

sentences.english: But let the distribution of the land be made by the decision of the Lord: by the names of the tribes of their fathers let their heritage be given them.
sentences.susu: N tan nan a ragirima bɔnsɔɛ birin lan a xa kɛ naxan sɔtɔ e bɔnsɔɛ xasabi ma.

sentences.english: As it is ordered by the decision of the Lord, let distribution be made between those who are more in number and those who are less.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi itaxunyi findima Ala xa maragiri nan na, bɔnsɔɛ xungbee nun bɔnsɔɛ xurie tagi.»

sentences.english: These were those of the Levites who were numbered by their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ nan yi ki naxee kɔnti e xabilɛ ki ma: Gerison, Kehati, Merari, nun e xabilɛe.

sentences.english: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korahites. And Kohath was the father of Amram.
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe nan yi ki: Libini, Xebiron, Maxali, Musi, nun Kora. Kehati nu bara Amarama sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom he had in Egypt: by Amram she had Moses and Aaron and their sister Miriam.
sentences.susu: Amarama xa ginɛ nu xili nɛ Yebedi, Lewi xa di ginɛ, naxan bari Misira. A naxa Haruna, Munsa, nun e maaginɛ Mariyama bari Amarama bɛ.

sentences.english: Aaron's sons were Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
sentences.susu: Haruna nu bara Nadabo, Abihu, Eleyasari, nun Itamari sɔtɔ di ra.

sentences.english: Death overtook Nadab and Abihu when they made an offering of strange fire before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Nadabo nun Abihu faxa nɛ, e to sɛrɛxɛ gan tɛ ra naxan mu daxa.

sentences.english: Of these, twenty-three thousand males, from one month old and over, were numbered: they were not numbered with the rest of the children of Israel, for they had no heritage among the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Di xɛmɛ naxan kɔnti Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, keli a kike keren ma han na xanbi, a xasabi lan mixi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan nan ma. E xa kɔnti nu na a xati ma, barima e mu bɔxi sɔtɔ kɛ ra Isirayilakae ya ma.

sentences.english: All these were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest when the children of Israel were numbered in the lowlands of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ na mixie nan kɔnti Mowaba bɔxi ma Yurudɛn xure sɛɛti ma Yeriko taa ya i,

sentences.english: But among all these was not one of those numbered by Moses and Aaron the priest when the children of Israel were numbered in the waste land of Sinai.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Munsa nun Haruna sɛrɛxɛdubɛ mixi naxee kɔnti Turusinina gbengberenyi ma, na keren mu nu na Isirayilakae ya ma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: For the Lord had said of them, Death will certainly overtake them in the waste land. And of them all, only Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua, the son of Nun, were still living.
sentences.susu: Alatala a fala nɛ, a nee birin faxama nɛ gbengberenyi ma. Na kui, e sese mu lu duniɲa, fo Yefune xa di xɛmɛ Kalebi, nun Nunu xa di xɛmɛ Yosuwe.

sentences.english: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh, the son of Joseph, came forward: their names are Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
sentences.susu: Yusufu xa di xɛmɛ Manasi, na fan xa di xɛmɛ Makiri, na fan xa di xɛmɛ Galadi, na fan xa di xɛmɛ Xeferi, na fan xa di xɛmɛ Selofexadi, di ginɛ suuli nan sɔtɔ, naxee nu xili: Maxala, Nowa, Xogala, Milika nun Tirisa.

sentences.english: They came before Moses and Eleazar the priest and the chiefs and all the people at the door of the Tent of meeting, and said,
sentences.susu: Na di ginɛe nan fa e yɛtɛ kan dɛntɛgɛ Munsa, Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ, nun Isirayila yareratie bɛ, Isirayila ɲama birin ya xɔri, hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra. E naxa a masen,

sentences.english: Death overtook our father in the waste land; he was not among those who were banded together with Korah against the Lord; but death came to him in his sin; and he had no sons.
sentences.susu: «Muxu baba mu di xɛmɛ sɔtɔ. A bara faxa gbengberenyi ma, kɔnɔ a mu nu na Kora xa mixie ya ma naxee keli Alatala xili ma. A tan faxa a yɛtɛ kan xa yunubi rabaxi nan ma.

sentences.english: Why is the name of our father to be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give us a heritage among our father's brothers.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra muxu baba xili bama a xabilɛ xa mixie ya ma, di xɛmɛ to mu na a bɛ? Kɛ nde so muxu fan yi ra, muxu baba ngaxakerenyie tagi!»

sentences.english: So Moses put their cause before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa e xa fe dɛntɛgɛ Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ,

sentences.english: What the daughters of Zelophehad say is right: certainly you are to give them a heritage among their father's brothers: and let the property which would have been their father's go to them.
sentences.susu: «Selofexadi xa di ginɛe bara nɔndi fala. E baba kɛ so e yi ra alɔ e baba ngaxakerenyie a sɔtɔ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And say to the children of Israel, If a man has no son at the time of his death, let his heritage go to his daughter.
sentences.susu: A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, ‹Xa xɛmɛ nde sa faxa di xɛmɛ xanbi, wo a kɛ so a xa di ginɛe yi ra.

sentences.english: And if he has no daughter, then give his heritage to his brothers.
sentences.susu: Xa di ginɛ fan mu na a bɛ, wo a kɛ so a fafaxakerenyie yi ra.

sentences.english: And if he has no brothers, then give his heritage to his father's brothers.
sentences.susu: Xa fafaxakeren yo mu na a bɛ, wo a so a baba fafaxakerenyie yi ra.

sentences.english: And if his father has no brothers, then give it to his nearest relation in the family, as his heritage: this is to be a decision made by law for the children of Israel, as the Lord gave orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li, a baba fafaxakeren yo mu na, wo a kɛ so mixi yi ra, e nun naxan makɔrɛ e boore ra a xabilɛe ya ma.› Na xa findi yaamari nun sɛriyɛ ra Isirayilakae bɛ, alɔ n tan Alatala a yamarixi i bɛ ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Go up into this mountain of Abarim so that you may see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «Te yi Abarimi geya fari, alako i xa bɔxi mato n naxan fima Isirayilakae ma.

sentences.english: And when you have seen it, you will be put to rest with your people, as your brother Aaron was:
sentences.susu: I na gɛ a matode, i taa masarama nɛ, i gbilen i benbae ma alɔ i taara Haruna,

sentences.english: Because in the waste land of Zin, when the people were angry, you and he went against my word and did not keep my name holy before their eyes, at the waters. (These are the waters of Meribah in Kadesh in the waste land of Zin.)
sentences.susu: barima wo bara n ma yaamari matandi. Isirayilakae to keli n xili ma ye xɔli xa fe ra Kadesi, Sini gbengberenyi ma, wo mu seedeɲɔxɔya raba n ma sɛniyɛnyi xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: Then Moses said to the Lord,
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a fala Alatala bɛ,

sentences.english: Let the Lord, the God of the spirits of all flesh, put a man at the head of this people,
sentences.susu: «Alatala, daali birin Marigi Ala, mixi keren dɔxɔ ɲama xun ma,

sentences.english: To go out and come in before them and be their guide; so that the people of the Lord may not be like sheep without a keeper.
sentences.susu: naxan tima e ya ra, e mini tɛmui nun e so tɛmui, naxan e raminima, a e raso, alako i xa ɲama naxa lu alɔ xuruse naxee rabɛɲinxi e yɛtɛ ma, kantama yo mu e bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Take Joshua, the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and put your hand on him;
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, «I xa Nunu xa di Yosuwe sugandi, Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi na naxan ma. I xa i bɛlɛxɛ sa a ma.

sentences.english: And take him before Eleazar the priest and all the meeting of the people, and give him his orders before their eyes.
sentences.susu: I xa a ti Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nun ɲama birin ya xɔri, i fa yaamarie so a yi ra,

sentences.english: And put your honour on him, so that all the children of Israel may be under his authority.
sentences.susu: i xa mangɛya nde xa dangi a ma, alako Isirayila ɲama birin xa a xui suxu.

sentences.english: He will take his place before Eleazar the priest, so that he may get directions from the Lord for him, with the Urim: at his word they will go out, and at his word they will come in, he and all the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: A tima nɛ Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ya i n waxɔnfe maxɔrinde gɛmɛ sugandixie ra. N yaabi naxan fima, a tan nun ɲama birin ɲɛrɛma na nan ma. E minima Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xui nan ma, e soma Yosuwe xui nan ma.»

sentences.english: So Moses did as the Lord said: he took Joshua and put him before Eleazar the priest and the meeting of the people:
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Alatala xa yaamari raba. A naxa Yosuwe tongo, a sa a ti Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nun Isirayila ɲama ya i,

sentences.english: And he put his hands on him and gave him his orders, as the Lord had said by Moses.
sentences.susu: a a bɛlɛxɛ sa a ma, a yaamarie so a yi ra, alɔ Alatala nu bara a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Give orders to the children of Israel and say to them, Let it be your care to give me my offerings at their regular times, the food of the offerings made by fire to me for a sweet smell.
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, e xa n ma sɛrɛxɛ ba a ba tɛmui. Donsee nan e ra, naxee ganma, e xiri ɲɔxunmɛ te n na.

sentences.english: Say to them, This is the offering made by fire which you are to give to the Lord; he-lambs of the first year without any mark, two every day as a regular burned offering.
sentences.susu: «A fala e bɛ, ‹Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ wo xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ba Alatala bɛ, yɛxɛɛ firin, naxee bara ɲɛ keren sɔtɔ, lanyuru yo mu na naxee ma.

sentences.english: Let one be offered in the morning, and the other at evening;
sentences.susu: Keren xa ba gɛɛsɛgɛ, boore xa ba nunmare.

sentences.english: And the tenth part of an ephah of the best meal for a meal offering mixed with the fourth part of a hin of clear oil.
sentences.susu: Wo man xa sansi xɔri dinxi kilo saxan ba sɛrɛxɛ ra naxan namulanxi oliwi ture fanyi litiri keren nun a tagi ra.

sentences.english: It is a regular burned offering, as it was ordered in Mount Sinai, for a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi mɔɔli nu bama n bɛ Turusinina geya ma, a xiri ɲɔxunmɛ nu tema n na.

sentences.english: And for its drink offering take the fourth part of a hin for one lamb: in the holy place let the wine be drained out for a drink offering for the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wɛni sɛrɛxɛ litiri keren nun a tagi bama yɛxɛɛ sɛɛti ma Alatala bɛ. Na sɛrɛxɛ rafalama yire sɛniyɛnxi nan kui.

sentences.english: Let the other lamb be offered at evening; like the meal offering of the morning and its drink offering, let it be offered as an offering made by fire for a sweet smell to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ nun wɛni sɛrɛxɛ ba nunmare tɛmui yɛxɛɛ sɛɛti ma. Na birin findima sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nan na naxan xiri ɲɔxunmɛ tema n tan Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: And on the Sabbath day, two he-lambs of the first year, without any mark, and two tenth parts of the best meal for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:
sentences.susu: Malabui lɔxɔɛ wo xa yɛxɛɛ firin ba malabu lɔxɔɛ sɛrɛxɛ ra, naxee bara ɲɛ keren sɔtɔ, lanyuru yo mu na naxee ma. Sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ naxan namulanxi ture kilo senni ra, nun wɛni sɛrɛxɛ xa ba na yɛxɛɛe sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: This is the burned offering for every Sabbath day, in addition to the regular burned offering, and its drink offering.
sentences.susu: Malabui lɔxɔɛ sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nan bama gɛɛsɛgɛ nun nunmare sɛrɛxɛe ra, a nun e xa wɛni sɛrɛxɛe.

sentences.english: And on the first day of every month you are to give a burned offering to the Lord; two oxen, one male sheep, and seven he-lambs of the first year, without any mark;
sentences.susu: Kike xi singe birin, wo xa tuura firin ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, a nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren, a nun yɛxɛɛ solofere, naxee bara ɲɛ keren sɔtɔ, lanyuru yo mu na naxee ma.

sentences.english: And three tenth parts of the best meal for a meal offering mixed with oil, for every ox; and two tenth parts of the best meal for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one sheep;
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ kilo solomanaani naxan namulanxi ture ra, a xa sa tuura keren yo tuura keren sɛɛti ma. Sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ kilo senni naxan namulanxi ture ra, a xa sa yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren yo yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And a separate tenth part of the best meal mixed with oil for a meal offering for every lamb; for a burned offering of a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ kilo saxan naxan namulanxi ture ra, a xa sa yɛxɛɛ keren yo yɛxɛɛ keren sɛɛti ma. Sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nan a ra naxan ganma, a xiri ɲɔxunmɛ te n tan Alatala ra.

sentences.english: And their drink offerings are to be half a hin of wine for an ox, and the third part of a hin for a male sheep, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb: this is the burned offering for every month through all the months of the year.
sentences.susu: Wɛni litiri saxan sɛrɛxɛ xa ba tuura birin bɛ. Wɛni litiri firin sɛrɛxɛ xa ba yɛxɛɛ kontonyi birin bɛ. Wɛni litiri keren sɛrɛxɛ xa ba yɛxɛɛ birin bɛ. Na sɛrɛxɛ mɔɔli bama kike xi singe birin ɲɛ kui.

sentences.english: And one he-goat for a sin-offering to the Lord; it is to be offered in addition to the regular burned offering and its drink offering.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sikɔtɛ keren fan ba Alatala bɛ yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, wo gɛɛsɛgɛ nun nunmare sɛrɛxɛ bama tɛmui naxɛ, a nun a xa wɛni sɛrɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the Lord's Passover.
sentences.susu: Kike singe xi fu nun naani nde, wo xa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali raba Alatala xa binyɛ bun ma.

sentences.english: On the fifteenth day of this month there is to be a feast; for seven days let your food be unleavened cakes.
sentences.susu: Na kike xi fu nun suuli nde findima sali lɔxɔɛ nan na. Wo xa taami lɛbinitare don xi solofere bun ma.

sentences.english: On the first day there is to be a holy meeting: you may do no sort of field-work:
sentences.susu: Na xi singe wo xa wo malan Ala batude. Wo naxa wali yo raba na lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: And you are to give an offering made by fire, a burned offering to the Lord; two oxen, one male sheep, and seven he-lambs of the first year, without any mark:
sentences.susu: Wo xa yi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie ba Alatala bɛ na lɔxɔɛ: tuura firin, yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren, nun yɛxɛɛ solofere, naxee bara ɲɛ keren sɔtɔ, lanyuru yo mu na naxee ma.

sentences.english: And their meal offering, the best meal mixed with oil: let three tenth parts of an ephah be offered for an ox and two tenth parts for a male sheep;
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ kilo solomanaani naxan namulanxi ture ra, a xa sa tuura keren yo tuura keren sɛɛti ma. Sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ kilo senni naxan namulanxi ture ra, a xa sa yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren yo yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And a separate tenth part for every one of the seven lambs;
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ kilo saxan naxan namulanxi ture ra, a xa sa yɛxɛɛ yo yɛxɛɛ sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And one he-goat for a sin-offering to take away your sin.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sikɔtɛ keren fan ba Alatala bɛ yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: These are to be offered in addition to the morning burned offering, which is a regular burned offering at all times.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na sɛrɛxɛe sa gɛɛsɛgɛ daaxie xun ma, naxee bama lɔxɔɛ birin.

sentences.english: In this way, every day for seven days, give the food of the offering made by fire, a sweet smell to the Lord: it is to be offered in addition to the regular burned offering, and its drink offering.
sentences.susu: Wo xa nee ba xi solofere bun ma. Sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nan a ra naxan ganma, a xiri ɲɔxunmɛ te n tan Alatala ra. Nee bama nɛ lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ, e nun boore sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie, nun wɛni sɛrɛxɛ.

sentences.english: Then on the seventh day there will be a holy meeting; you may do no field-work.
sentences.susu: A xi solofere nde, wo xa wo malan Ala batude. Wo naxa wali gbɛtɛe raba na lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: And at the time of the first-fruits, when you give an offering of new meal to the Lord at your feast of weeks, there is to be a holy meeting: you may do no field-work:
sentences.susu: Xɛ Xaba Sali, wo na fa sansi bogi singee sɛrɛxɛ ra Alatala xɔn ma, wo xa wo malan n batude. Wo naxa wali yo suxu na lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: And give a burned offering for a sweet smell to the Lord; two oxen, one male sheep, and seven he-lambs of the first year;
sentences.susu: Wo xa yi sɛrɛxɛe ba: tuura firin, yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren, nun yɛxɛɛ solofere, naxee bara ɲɛ keren sɔtɔ. Nee nan bama sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, e xiri ɲɔxunmɛ te n tan Alatala ra.

sentences.english: And their meal offering, the best meal mixed with oil, three tenth parts for an ox, two tenth parts for a male sheep,
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ kilo solomanaani naxan namulanxi ture ra, a xa sa tuura keren yo tuura keren sɛɛti ma. Sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ kilo senni naxan namulanxi ture ra, a xa sa yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren yo yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And a separate tenth part for every one of the seven lambs;
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛ kilo saxan naxan namulanxi ture ra, a xa sa yɛxɛɛ keren yo yɛxɛɛ keren sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And one he-goat to take away your sin.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sikɔtɛ keren fan ba Alatala bɛ yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: These are in addition to the regular burned offering and its meal offering; take care that they are without any mark, and let them be offered with their drink offerings.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na sɛrɛxɛe sa boore sɛrɛxɛe xun, wo naxee bama lɔxɔɛ birin, e nun sansi xɔri nun wɛni naxan fan bama sɛrɛxɛ ra. Lanyuru yo naxa lu na sɛrɛxɛe ma.

sentences.english: In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, let there be a holy meeting; on it you may do no field-work; let the day be marked by the blowing of horns;
sentences.susu: «Kike solofere nde xi singe, wo xa wo malan n batude. Wo naxa wali yo raba na lɔxɔɛ. Wo sarae fema nɛ na lɔxɔɛ.
