sentences.english: And one he-goat for a sin-offering, to take away your sin:
sentences.susu: Wo xa sikɔtɛ keren fan ba Alatala bɛ yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: In addition to the burned offering of the new moon, and its meal offering, and the regular burned offering and its meal offering, and their drink offerings, as they are ordered, for a sweet smell, an offering made by fire to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na sɛrɛxɛ birin sama sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nan xun, wo naxee bama lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ, a nun wo naxee bama kike yo kike a xi singe, a nun sansi xɔri dinxi nun wɛni sɛrɛxɛ naxan sama e sɛɛti ma. Sɛrɛxɛe nan e ra naxee ganma, e xiri ɲɔxunmɛ te n tan Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: And on the tenth day of this seventh month there will be a holy meeting; keep yourselves from pleasure, and do no sort of work;

sentences.english: And give to the Lord a burned offering for a sweet smell; one ox, one male sheep, seven he-lambs of the first year: only those without any mark on them may be used:
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ wo xa tuura nde ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, a nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren, a nun yɛxɛɛ solofere, naxee bara ɲɛ keren sɔtɔ, lanyuru yo mu na naxee ma.

sentences.english: One he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the offering for taking away your sin, and the regular burned offering and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sikɔtɛ keren fan ba n tan Alatala bɛ yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, dangife na yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ, nun na sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie wo naxee bama lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ, a nun sansi xɔri dinxi nun wɛni sɛrɛxɛ.»

sentences.english: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month let there be a holy meeting; do no field-work, and keep a feast to the Lord for seven days;
sentences.susu: «Kike solofere nde, xi fu nun suuli, wo xa wo malan n batude. Wo naxa wali yo raba na lɔxɔɛ. Wo xa sali nde raba n tan Alatala bɛ xi solofere bun ma.

sentences.english: And give a burned offering, an offering made by fire of a sweet smell to the Lord, thirteen oxen, two male sheep, fourteen he-lambs of the first year, all without any mark on them;

sentences.english: And one he-goat for a sin-offering; in addition to the regular burned offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sikɔtɛ keren fan ba n tan Alatala bɛ yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra. Wo xa na sɛrɛxɛe sa boore sɛrɛxɛe xun, wo naxee bama lɔxɔɛ birin, e nun sansi xɔri nun wɛni naxan fan bama sɛrɛxɛ ra.»

sentences.english: These are the offerings which you are to give to the Lord at your regular feasts, in addition to the offerings for an oath, and the free offerings you give, for your burned offerings and your drink offerings and your peace-offerings.
sentences.susu: «Sɛrɛxɛe nan na ki wo lan wo xa naxee ba n tan Alatala bɛ wo xa sali lɔxɔɛe, bafe wo xa laayidi sɛrɛxɛe, wo xa sɛrɛxɛ ɲanigexie, wo xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie, wo xa sansi xɔri dinxi sɛrɛxɛe, wo xa wɛni sɛrɛxɛe, nun wo xa xanunteya sɛrɛxɛe.»

sentences.english: And Moses said to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, This is the order of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Alatala xa yaamari birin fala Isirayilakae bɛ, a naxee so a yi ra.

sentences.english: When a man takes an oath to the Lord, or gives an undertaking having the force of an oath, let him not go back from his word, but let him do whatever he has said he will do.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa yi masenyi ti Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ kuntigie bɛ, «Alatala xa yaamarie nan ya:

sentences.english: If a woman, being young and under the authority of her father, takes an oath to the Lord or gives an undertaking;
sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde sa laayidi tongo Alatala bɛ fe nde ma, xa na mu a a kali Alatala ra fe nde ma, na kanyi lan nɛ a xa a xui rakamali. A naxan birin falaxi a dɛ ra, a xa a birin naba.»

sentences.english: If her father, hearing of her oath or the undertaking she has given, says nothing to her, then all her oaths and every undertaking she has given will have force.
sentences.susu: «Ginɛ dimɛdi na sa laayidi tongo fe nde ma Alatala bɛ, a na a baba xɔnyi tɛmui naxɛ, a fa a kali,

sentences.english: But if her father, hearing of it, makes her take back her word, then the oaths or the undertakings she has given will have no force; and she will have forgiveness from the Lord, because her oath was broken by her father.
sentences.susu: a baba naxa a kolon a a xa di ginɛ bara laayidi nde tongo, a baba mu sese fala na fe kui, a xa na laayidi rakamali.

sentences.english: And if she is married to a husband at the time when she is under an oath or an undertaking given without thought;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa a baba mu tin na laayidi tongoxi ra a mɛ tɛmui, a mu lan na ginɛ dimɛdi xa a rakamali. Alatala mu a suxuma a ra a baba waxɔnfe xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: If her husband, hearing of it, says nothing to her at the time, then the oaths she made and the undertakings she gave will have force.
sentences.susu: «Ginɛ na sa laayidi tongo, xa na mu a a kali wɔyɛnyi mafuraxi ra,

sentences.english: But if her husband, hearing of it, makes her take it back, then the oath she made and the undertaking she gave without thought will have no force or effect, and she will have the Lord's forgiveness.
sentences.susu: xa a xa mɔri sa na mɛ, a fa lu a mu sese fala na fe ra, a xa na laayidi rakamali.

sentences.english: But an oath made by a widow or one who is no longer married to her husband, and every undertaking she has given, will have force.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa a xa mɔri mu tin na fe ra a mɛ tɛmui, a mu lan na ginɛ xa a rakamali. Alatala mu a suxuma a ra.»

sentences.english: If she made an oath while she was under the authority of her husband,
sentences.susu: «Kaaɲɛ ginɛ na laayidi tongo, xa na mu, ginɛ naxan nun a xa xɛmɛ bara fatan, a xa a xa laayidi rakamali.»

sentences.english: And her husband, hearing of it, said nothing to her and did not put a stop to it, then all her oaths and every undertaking she gave will have force.
sentences.susu: «Ginɛ xɛmɛ taa idɔxɔɛ na laayidi tongo, xa na mu a a kali fe nde ma,

sentences.english: But if her husband, on hearing of it, made them without force or effect, then whatever she has said about her oaths or her undertaking has no force: her husband has made them without effect, and she will have the Lord's forgiveness.
sentences.susu: xa a xa mɔri fa na fe kolon, kɔnɔ a mu fefe fala na fe kui, a lanma na ginɛ xa a xa laayidi rakamali.

sentences.english: Every oath, and every undertaking which she gives, to keep herself from pleasure, may be supported or broken by her husband.
sentences.susu: A xa mɔri na a xa laayidi mɛ tɛmui naxɛ, a nɔma tinde a ra, xa na mu a ra, a nɔma tɔnyi dɔxɔde a ma. Alatala mu a suxuma a ra.

sentences.english: But if the days go on, and her husband says nothing whatever to her, then he is giving the support of his authority to her oaths and undertakings, because at the time of hearing them he said nothing to her.
sentences.susu: A xa mɔri nɔma tinde, xa na mu a ra tondide a xa laayidi nun a xa kali birin na.

sentences.english: But if at some time after hearing of them, he makes them without force, then he is responsible for her wrongdoing.
sentences.susu: Xa a mu fefe falama na fe kui, a xa ginɛ lanma a xa a xa laayidi rakamali. A xa dundui a niyama nɛ ginɛ xa a xa laayidi rakamali.

sentences.english: These are the laws which the Lord gave Moses in relation to a man and his wife, or a father and a young daughter who is under his authority.
sentences.susu: Xa a xa mɔri tɔnyi dɔxɔma a xa ginɛ xa laayidi ma tɛmui gbɛtɛ, a tan nan yati a xa ginɛ xa kote xaninma.»

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Give the Midianites punishment for the wrong they did to the children of Israel: and after that you will go to rest with your people.
sentences.susu: «I xa Isirayilakae gbe ɲɔxɔ Madiyankae ma. I na gɛ na ra, i fa taa masara.»

sentences.english: So Moses said to the people, Let men from among you be armed for war to put into effect against Midian the Lord's punishment on them.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a fala ɲama bɛ, «Xɛmɛ ndee xa geresosee tongo Madiyan xili ma wo gbe ɲɔxɔde Alatala xili ra.

sentences.english: From every tribe of Israel send a thousand to the war.
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin xa mixi wulu keren keren ba geresoe ra.»

sentences.english: So from the thousands of Israel a thousand were taken from every tribe, twelve thousand men armed for war.
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ fu nun firin naxa mixi wulu keren keren ba geresoe ra.

sentences.english: And Moses sent them out to war, a thousand from every tribe, and with them Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, taking in his hands the vessels of the holy place and the horns for sounding the note of war.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa na sɔɔri wulu fu nun firin xɛɛ gere tide. Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa di xɛmɛ Finexasi naxa e mati, se sɛniyɛnxie nu na a yi ra, a nun sara naxee tɔnxuma fima e boore ma gere xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And they made war on Midian, as the Lord gave orders to Moses; and they put to death every male.
sentences.susu: E naxa siga gere tide Madiyan xili ma, alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ Munsa bɛ. E naxa na xɛmɛe birin faxa,

sentences.english: They put the kings of Midian to death with the rest, Evi and Reken and Zur and Hur and Reba, the five kings of Midian: and Balaam, the son of Beor, they put to death with the sword.
sentences.susu: a nun Madiyan mangɛ suuli: Efi, Rekemi, Suuru, Xuru, nun Reba. E naxa Beyori xa di xɛmɛ Balami fan faxa santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: The women of Midian with their little ones the children of Israel took prisoner; and all their cattle and flocks and all their goods they took for themselves;
sentences.susu: E naxa Madiyan ginɛe nun e xa di birin findi konyie ra. E naxa e xa xurusee, e xa gɔɔrɛe, nun e harige birin tongo.

sentences.english: And after burning all their towns and all their tent-circles,
sentences.susu: E naxa e xa taae nun e xa daaxae gan.

sentences.english: They went away with the goods they had taken, man and beast.
sentences.susu: E naxa e xa harige, e xa xurusee, nun e xa ginɛe suxu,

sentences.english: And the prisoners and the goods and everything they had taken, they took to Moses and Eleazar the priest and the people of Israel, to the tent-circle in the lowlands of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.
sentences.susu: e e xanin Munsa, Eleyasari, nun Isirayila ɲama xɔn ma e yonkinde Mowaba fiili ma, Yurudɛn xure dɛ i, Yeriko ya tagi.

sentences.english: Then Moses and Eleazar the priest and the chiefs of the people went out to them before they had come into the tent-circle.
sentences.susu: Munsa, Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ, nun Isirayila ɲama yareratie naxa e ralan yonkinde fari ma.

sentences.english: And Moses was angry with the chiefs of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds who had come back from the war.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa xɔnɔ sɔɔri wulu xunyie nun sɔɔri kɛmɛ xunyie ma, a a fala e bɛ,

sentences.english: And Moses said to them, Why have you kept all the women safe?
sentences.susu: «Munfe ra wo mu yi ginɛe faxa?

sentences.english: It was these who, moved by Balaam, were the cause of Israel's sin against the Lord in the question of Peor, because of which disease came on the people of the Lord.
sentences.susu: E tan nan bira Balami xa marasi fɔxɔ ra, e Isirayilakae ramini Alatala xa kira xɔn Peyori, Alatala fa gbaloe ragoro a xa ɲama ma.

sentences.english: So now put every male child to death, and every woman who has had sex relations with a man.
sentences.susu: Awa, yakɔsi, wo xɛmɛ dimɛ birin faxa, a nun ginɛ naxee bara xɛmɛ fe kolon.

sentences.english: But all the female children who have had no sex relations with men, you may keep for yourselves.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ dimɛdie tan, wo xa nee ragata wo yɛtɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: You yourselves will have to keep outside the tent-circle for seven days, anyone of you who has put any person to death or come near a dead body; and on the third day and on the seventh day make yourselves and your prisoners clean.
sentences.susu: Wo tan naxee bara mixi faxa, xa na mu wo bara din fure ra, wo xa lu yonkinde fari ma xi solofere, a nun mixie wo naxee suxu gere kui. Wo xa wo yɛtɛ nun wo xa mixi suxuxie rasɛniyɛn a xi saxan nde nun a xi solofere nde.

sentences.english: And every bit of clothing, and anything made of leather or goats' hair or wood, you are to make clean.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo xa dugie fan nasɛniyɛn a nun see naxan tan birin nafalaxi kiri, si xabe, nun wuri ra.»

sentences.english: Then Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who had been to the fight, This is the rule of the law which the Lord has given to Moses:
sentences.susu: Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa a fala sɔɔrie bɛ naxee gere tixi, «Alatala xa sɛriyɛ nan ya a naxan masenxi Munsa bɛ:

sentences.english: But gold and silver and brass and iron and tin and lead,
sentences.susu: Xɛɛma, gbeti, wure gbeeli, wure, yɔxui, nun sunbui,

sentences.english: And anything which may be heated, is to go through the fire and be made clean; but in addition it is to be put in the water of cleaning: and anything which may not go through the fire is to be put in the water.
sentences.susu: se naxan birin mu ganma tɛ ra, wo xa a raso tɛ, a xa sɛniyɛn. Na dangi xanbi wo man xa a rasɛniyɛn ye ra. Se naxan mu nɔma rasode tɛ, wo xa na rasɛniyɛn ye ra.

sentences.english: And on the seventh day, after washing your clothing, you will be clean, and then you may come into the tent-circle.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo xa dugie xa a xi solofere nde. Na tɛmui wo bara sɛniyɛn, wo fa nɔma sode yonkinde.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Get an account of everything which was taken in the war, of man and of beast, you and Eleazar the priest and the heads of families of the people:
sentences.susu: «I tan, Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ, nun Isirayila kuntigie, wo xa yi mixi suxuxie, nun e xa xurusee kɔnti, wo naxee sɔtɔxi gere kui.

sentences.english: And let division be made of it into two parts, one for the men of war who went out to the fight, and one for all the people:
sentences.susu: I xa e itaxun sɔɔrie nun ɲama ra.

sentences.english: And from the men of war who went out let there be offered to the Lord one out of every five hundred, from the persons, and from the oxen and asses and sheep:
sentences.susu: Sɔɔrie gbe ya ma, i xa mixi keren tongo mixi kɛmɛ suuli yo mixi kɛmɛ suuli tagi, a xa findi n gbe ra. Xurusee fan na ki, kɛmɛ suuli yo kɛmɛ suuli, i keren nan tongoma e ya ma n bɛ. A findi ningee ra, a findi sofalee ra, a findi xuruse lanmae ra.

sentences.english: Take this from their part and give it to Eleazar the priest as an offering to be lifted up to the Lord.
sentences.susu: I xa nee ba sɔɔrie gbe ya ma, i e fi Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ma Alatala xili ra.

sentences.english: And from the part given to the children of Israel, take one out of every fifty, from the persons, and from the oxen and asses and sheep, and give it to the Levites who have the care of the House of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Isirayila ɲama gbe ya ma, i xa mixi keren tongo mixi tongo suuli yo mixi tongo suuli ya ma, kɛmɛ suuli yo kɛmɛ suuli, i keren nan tongoma e ya ma n bɛ. A findi ningee ra, a findi sofalee ra, a findi xuruse lanmae ra. I xa nee so Lewi bɔnsɔɛ yi ra, naxee e ɲɔxɔ saxi n ma hɔrɔmɔlingira xɔn.»

sentences.english: So Eleazar and Moses did as the Lord had given orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa a raba, alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ Munsa bɛ.

sentences.english: Now the beasts taken, in addition to what the fighting-men took for themselves, were six hundred and seventy-five thousand sheep,
sentences.susu: Naxan sɔtɔ gere kui, a xasabi lan xuruse lanma wulu kɛmɛ senni wulu tongo solofere nun suuli nan ma,

sentences.english: And seventy-two thousand oxen,
sentences.susu: ninge wulu tongo solofere nun firin,

sentences.english: And sixty-one thousand asses;
sentences.susu: sofale wulu tongo senni nun keren,

sentences.english: And thirty-two thousand persons, that is, women who had never had sex relations with a man.
sentences.susu: ginɛ naxee mu xɛmɛ fe kolon, mixi wulu tongo saxan nun firin.

sentences.english: And the half given as their part to the men who went to the war, was three hundred and thirty-seven thousand, five hundred sheep,
sentences.susu: Sɛɛti naxan fixi sɔɔrie ma naxee gere ti, a xasabi naxa lan xuruse lanma wulu kɛmɛ saxan wulu tongo saxan nun solofere kɛmɛ suuli ma.

sentences.english: Of which the Lord's part was six hundred and seventy-five.
sentences.susu: Alatala gbe naxan ba na ra, na naxa lan xuruse lanma kɛmɛ senni tongo solofere nun suuli ma.

sentences.english: The number of oxen was thirty-six thousand, of which the Lord's part was seventy-two;
sentences.susu: Ninge naxee fixi sɔɔrie ma, e xasabi naxa lan wulu tongo saxan nun senni ma. Alatala gbe naxan ba na ra, na naxa lan ninge tongo solofere nun firin ma.

sentences.english: The number of asses was thirty thousand, five hundred, of which the Lord's part was sixty-one.
sentences.susu: Sofale naxee fixi sɔɔrie ma, e xasabi naxa lan wulu tongo saxan kɛmɛ suuli ma. Alatala gbe naxan ba na ra, na naxa lan sofale tongo senni nun keren ma.

sentences.english: And the number of persons was sixteen thousand, of which the Lord's part was thirty-two persons.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee fixi sɔɔrie ma, e xasabi naxa lan wulu fu nun senni ma. Alatala gbe naxan ba na ra, na naxa lan mixi tongo saxan nun firin ma.

sentences.english: And Moses gave the Lord's part, lifted up as an offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the Lord had given orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Alatala gbe fi Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ma, alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And from the half given to the children of Israel, which Moses had kept separate from that given to the fighting-men,
sentences.susu: Isirayila ɲama gbe, Munsa naxan so e yi ra, naxan mu nu na sɔɔrie gbe ya ma,

sentences.english: (Now the people's half was three hundred and thirty-seven thousand, five hundred sheep,
sentences.susu: na findixi xuruse lanmae wulu kɛmɛ saxan tongo saxan nun solofere kɛmɛ suuli nan ma,

sentences.english: And thirty-six thousand oxen,
sentences.susu: a nun ninge wulu tongo saxan nun senni,

sentences.english: And thirty thousand, five hundred asses,
sentences.susu: a nun sofale wulu tongo saxan kɛmɛ suuli,

sentences.english: And sixteen thousand persons;)
sentences.susu: a nun mixi wulu fu nun senni.

sentences.english: Even from the children of Israel's half, Moses took one out of every fifty, men and beasts, and gave them to the Levites who had the care of the House of the Lord; as the Lord gave orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: Na kui, xurusee ba, mixie ba, tongo suuli yo tongo suuli, Munsa naxa keren keren ba a birin na, a e so Lewi bɔnsɔɛ yi ra, naxee e ɲɔxɔ saxi Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira xɔn, alɔ Alatala a yamari a bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then the men in authority over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, came to Moses,
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri kɛmɛ xunyie nun sɔɔri wulu xunyie naxa fa Munsa yire,

sentences.english: And said to him, Your servants have taken note of the number of all the fighting-men under our orders, and every one is present;
sentences.susu: e a fala a bɛ, «Muxu tan i xa konyie, muxu bara sɔɔrie kɔnti naxee nu na muxu xa yaamari bun ma. E birin na na.

sentences.english: And we have here an offering for the Lord from what every man took in the war, ornaments of gold, leg-chains and arm-rings, finger-rings, ear-rings, and neck-ornaments, to make our souls free from sin before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi muxu bara fa hadiyae ra Alatala bɛ xunsare xa fe ra. Kankan bara fa a sɔtɔsee ra alɔ bɛlɛxɛrasoe, xurundɛe, tulirasoe, nun kɔnmagore xɛɛma daaxi.»

sentences.english: So Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from them, even all the worked ornaments.
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa na see xɛɛma daaxi rasuxu e yi ra.

sentences.english: And the gold which the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds gave, as an offering to be lifted up before the Lord, came to sixteen thousand, seven hundred and fifty shekels.
sentences.susu: Na xɛɛma birin, sɔɔri xunyie fa naxan na Alatala bɛ, a xasabi lan fayida xɛɛma kilo kɛmɛ tongo solofere nan ma.

sentences.english: (For every man of the army had taken goods for himself in the war.)
sentences.susu: Sɔɔrie tan nu e gbee ragataxi e yi ra.

sentences.english: Then Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold given by the captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, and took it into the Tent of meeting, to be a sign in memory of the children of Israel before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa na see birin nasuxu sɔɔri wulu xunyie nun sɔɔri kɛmɛ xunyie yi ra, e a xanin hɔrɔmɔlingira yire, alako na xa findi tɔnxuma ra Isirayila xa fe ra Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a great number of cattle: and when they saw that the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead was a good place for cattle;
sentences.susu: Gɔɔrɛ gbegbe nan nu na Ruben bɔnsɔɛ nun Gadi bɔnsɔɛ yi ra. E to a to Yaasɛri nun Galadi bɔxi fan xurusee bɛ,

sentences.english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and said to Moses and to Eleazar the priest and to the chiefs of the meeting,
sentences.susu: e naxa fa Munsa, Eleyasari, nun Isirayila kuntigie yire,

sentences.english: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Sebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
sentences.susu: e a fala e bɛ, «Taa naxee xili Ataroti, Dibon, Yaasɛri, Nimira, Xɛsibɔn, Eleyale, Sebami, Nebo, nun Beyon, nee na bɔxi ya ma,

sentences.english: The land which the Lord gave into the hands of the children of Israel, is a land for cattle, and your servants have cattle.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxan saxi Isirayila ɲama sagoe. Na longori fan xuruse kanyie bɛ alɔ muxu tan.

sentences.english: And they said, With your approval, let this land be given to your servants as their heritage: do not take us over Jordan.
sentences.susu: Xa wo bara tin a ra, be xa findi muxu tan gbe ra, hali muxu mu dangi Yurudɛn naakiri ma.»

sentences.english: And Moses said to the children of Gad and the children of Reuben, Are your brothers to go to the war, while you take your rest here?
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Gadi bɔnsɔɛ nun Ruben bɔnsɔɛ yaabi, «Wo ngaxakerenyie sigama nɛ gere sode, wo tan xa lu be?

sentences.english: Why would you take from the children of Israel the desire to go over into the land which the Lord has given them?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra wo wama limaniya bafe wo ngaxakerenyie yi ra, alako e naxa dangi Yurudɛn naakiri ma bɔxi ma Alatala naxan fixi e ma?

sentences.english: So did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.
sentences.susu: Wo babae fan bara na wali mɔɔli raba n to e xɛɛ Kanaan bɔxi rabɛnde kelife Kadesi Barineya.

sentences.english: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they took from the children of Israel the desire to go into the land which the Lord had given them.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ Esekoli gulunba rabɛnde, e naxa gbilen, e fa limaniya ba Isirayilakae yi ra sofe ra bɔxi ma, Alatala naxan fixi e ma.

sentences.english: And at that time the Lord was moved to wrath, and made an oath, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa xɔnɔ Isirayilakae ma na lɔxɔɛ, a fa a kali,

sentences.english: Truly, not one of the men of twenty years old and over who came out of Egypt will see the land which I gave by oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; because they have not been true to me with all their heart;
sentences.susu: ‹Yi mixi naxan birin kelixi Misira, naxan xa simaya bara dangi ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn na, e mu soma bɔxi ma n nan n kali Iburahima, Isiyaga nun Yaxuba bɛ dɛnnaxan fife ra e ma, barima e mu bira n fɔxɔ ra e ɲanige birin na.

sentences.english: But only Caleb, the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua, the son of Nun: because they have been true to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Fo Yefune xa di xɛmɛ Kalebi Kenisika, nun Nunu xa di xɛmɛ Yosuwe, nee nan peti bira n xui fɔxɔ ra e ɲanige birin na.›

sentences.english: Then the Lord was angry with Israel, and he made them wanderers in the waste land for forty years? till all that generation who had done evil in the eyes of the Lord was dead.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa xɔnɔ Isirayilakae ma ki fanyi, a fa e rabɛɲin gbengberenyi ma ɲɛ tongo naani bun ma, han na mixi birin faxa, naxee wali ki mu nu rafan a ma.

sentences.english: And now you have come to take the place of your fathers, another generation of sinners, increasing the wrath of the Lord against Israel.
sentences.susu: Wo tan yunubitɔɛ bɔnsɔɛe, wo na birafe wo benbae fɔxɔ ra Alatala raxɔnɔfe ra Isirayila xili ma.

sentences.english: For if you are turned away from him, he will send them wandering again in the waste land; and you will be the cause of the destruction of all this people.
sentences.susu: Xa wo keli Ala xa kira xɔn, a man Isirayila rabɛɲinma nɛ gbengberenyi ma, e halaki wo xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: Then they came to him, and said, We will make safe places for our cattle here, and towns for our little ones;
sentences.susu: E naxa siga Munsa yire, e a fala a bɛ, «Muxu wama gɔɔrɛ tife be muxu xa xurusee bɛ, a nun muxu wama yiree yailanfe be muxu xa ginɛe nun muxu xa die luma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: But we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel till we have taken them to their place: but our little ones will be safe in the walled towns against the people of the land.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ muxu bara tin sɔɔriɲa rabade muxu ngaxakerenyi Isirayilakae bɛ han e xa so e sode. Muxu xa die tan luma be muxu xanbi ra nɛ taa kantaxie kui, alako bekae naxa e tɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: We will not come back to our houses till every one of the children of Israel has come into his heritage.
sentences.susu: Muxu mu gbilenma muxu xɔnyi be, fo Isirayilaka birin a gbe bɔxi masɔtɔ.

sentences.english: For we will not have our heritage with them on the other side of Jordan and forward; because our heritage has come to us on this side of Jordan to the east.
sentences.susu: Kɛ gbɛtɛ mu luma muxu tan bɛ sɔnɔn Yurudɛn naakiri ma. Muxu gbe na bebiri Yurudɛn sogetede nɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Moses said to them, If you will do this, arming yourselves to go before the Lord to the war,
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa a fala e bɛ, «Xa wo sa a raba alɔ wo a falaxi ki naxɛ, xa wo wo maxiri sigafe ra gere tide Alatala xili ra,

sentences.english: Every armed man of you going across Jordan before the Lord till he has overcome and sent in flight all who are against him,
sentences.susu: xa wo mu gbilen be Yurudɛn naakiri ma, han Alatala gɛ a yaxuie birin keride a ya ra,

sentences.english: And the land is under the rule of the Lord: then after that you may come back, having done no wrong to the Lord and to Israel; and this land will be yours for your heritage before the Lord.
sentences.susu: na tɛmui be bara findi wo xa bɔxi ra Alatala xili ra. Mɛnni na lu Alatala xa yaamari bun ma, wo nɔma gbilende be. Na kui wo bara wo xa laayidi rakamali Isirayila nun Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: But if you do not do this, then you are sinners against the Lord; and you may be certain that your sin will have its reward.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ xa wo mu sa na sɛriyɛ rabatu, na bara findi yunubi ra wo bɛ, wo na sare fima nɛ.

sentences.english: So get to work building your towns for your little ones, and safe places for your sheep; and do as you have said.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, wo xa taae ti wo xa ginɛe nun wo xa die bɛ. Wo xa gɔɔrɛe yailan wo xa xurusee fan bɛ. Kɔnɔ wo naxa nɛɛmu wo xa laayidi tongoxi ma de, wo xa na rakamali.»

sentences.english: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben said to Moses, Your servants will do as my lord says.
sentences.susu: Gadi bɔnsɔɛ nun Ruben bɔnsɔɛ naxa Munsa yaabi, «Muxu fama nɛ i xa yaamari birin suxude.

sentences.english: Our little ones, our wives, and our flocks, and all our cattle, will be there in the towns of Gilead;
sentences.susu: Muxu xa die, muxu xa ginɛe, nun muxu xa xurusee birin luma be Galadi bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: But your servants will go over, every man armed for war, before the Lord to the fight, as my lord says.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ muxu geresosee tongoma nɛ, muxu fa gere so Alatala bɛ alɔ i a yitaxi ki naxɛ, muxu marigi.»

sentences.english: So Moses gave orders about them to Eleazar the priest and to Joshua, the son of Nun, and to the heads of families of the tribes of the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ, Nunu xa di xɛmɛ Yosuwe, a nun Isirayila kuntigie yamari,

sentences.english: And Moses said to them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben go with you over Jordan, every man armed for the fight before the Lord, and all the land is given into your hands, then let them have the land of Gilead for a heritage:
sentences.susu: «Xa Gadi bɔnsɔɛ nun Ruben bɔnsɔɛ sa dangi Yurudɛn naakiri ma, e siga gere sode Alatala bɛ, han wo naxa na bɔxi birin masɔtɔ tɛmui naxɛ, wo xa Galadi bɔxi so e yi ra kɛ ra.

sentences.english: But if they do not go over with you armed, they will have to take their heritage with you in the land of Canaan.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa e mu na raba, e fan xa sabati wo tagi Kanaan bɔxi ma!»

sentences.english: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben said, As the Lord has said to your servants, so will we do.
sentences.susu: Gadi bɔnsɔɛ nun Ruben bɔnsɔɛ naxa e yaabi, «Alatala naxan birin masenxi a xa konyi die xa fe ra, muxu a birin nabama nɛ.

sentences.english: We will go over armed before the Lord into the land of Canaan, and you will give us our heritage on this side of Jordan.
sentences.susu: Muxu dangima nɛ Yurudɛn naakiri ma muxu xa geresosee ra sigafe ra Kanaan bɔxi ma Alatala ya tode ra, kɔnɔ muxu kɛ tan findima bɔxi nan na Yurudɛn bebiri sɛɛti ma.»

sentences.english: So Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad and the children of Reuben and to the half-tribe of Manasseh, the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites and Og, king of Bashan, all the land with its towns and the country round them.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Amorikae xa mangɛ Sixɔn nun Basan mangɛ Ogo xa bɔxi nun na rabilinyi fi Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, nun Yusufu xa di xɛmɛ Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti keren ma.

sentences.english: And the children of Gad were the builders of Dibon and Ataroth and Aroer;
sentences.susu: Gadi xa die naxa gbilen Dibon ti ra, a nun Ataroti, Aroweri,

sentences.english: And Atroth-shophan and Jazer and Jogbehah;
sentences.susu: Atiroti Sofana, Yaasɛri, Yogbeha,

sentences.english: And Beth-nimrah and Beth-haran: walled towns and shut-in places for sheep.
sentences.susu: Beti Nimira, nun Beti Xarani. E bara findi taa makantaxie ra, gɔɔrɛe gbegbe fan nu na.

sentences.english: And the children of Reuben were the builders of Heshbon and Elealeh and Kiriathaim;
sentences.susu: Ruben bɔnsɔɛ naxa gbilen Xɛsibɔn ti ra, a nun Eleyale, Kiriyatayimi,

sentences.english: And Nebo and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Sibmah: and they gave other names to the towns they made.
sentences.susu: Nebo, Baali Meyoni, nun Sibima. E naxa na taa ndee xilie masara.

sentences.english: And the children of Machir, the son of Manasseh, went to Gilead and took it, driving out the Amorites who were living there.
sentences.susu: Manasi xa di Makiri xa die to Galadi taa suxu, e Amorikae keri naxee nu sabatixi naa,

sentences.english: And Moses gave Gilead to Machir, the son of Manasseh; and he made it his living-place.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa na taa so e yi ra sabatide ra.

sentences.english: And Jair, the son of Manasseh, went and took the towns of Gilead, naming them Havvoth-Jair.
sentences.susu: Manasi xa Yayiri fan naxa taa ndee suxu, a e xili Yayiri xa taae.

sentences.english: And Nobah went and took Kenath and its small towns, naming it Nobah, after himself.
sentences.susu: Noba fan naxa Kenata taa nun a rabilinyi suxu, a yɛtɛ xili sa e xun ma.

sentences.english: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt in their armies, under the direction of Moses and Aaron.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛrɛ nan ya Isirayilakae naxan naba e xundɛ ki ma Munsa nun Haruna xa yaamari bun ma e to keli Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the stages of their journey on their way out were put down in writing by Moses at the order of the Lord: these are the stages of their journey and the way they went.
sentences.susu: Munsa na birin sɛbɛxi nɛ alɔ Alatala a yamari a bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: On the fifteenth day of the first month they went out from Rameses; on the day after the Passover the children of Israel went out by the power of the Lord before the eyes of all the Egyptians,
sentences.susu: E naxa keli Ramesesi taa Misira bɔxi kike singe xi fu nun suuli. Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali lɔxɔɛ, na kuye iba Isirayilakae naxa mini Misira xɔrɛya kui Misiraka birin ya xɔri.

sentences.english: While the Egyptians were placing in the earth the bodies of their sons on whom the Lord had sent destruction: and their gods had been judged by him.
sentences.susu: A a lixi na tɛmui, Misirakae nu na e xa di singee ragatafe, Alatala naxee faxa e ya ma a xa xɔnɛ kui e xa kuyee xa fe ra.

sentences.english: So the children of Israel went from Rameses and put up their tents in Succoth.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa keli Ramesesi, e sa yonkin Sukɔti.

sentences.english: And they went on from Succoth and put up their tents in Etham on the edge of the waste land.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Etama gbengberenyi dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And from Etham, turning back to Pi-hahiroth which is before Baal-zephon, they put up their tents before Migdol.
sentences.susu: E to keli Etama, e naxa gbilen Pi Haxirɔti mabiri, Baali Sefon ya tagi, e sa yonkin Migidoli ya ra.

sentences.english: And journeying on from before Hahiroth, they went through the sea into the waste land: they went three days' journey through the waste land of Etham and put up their tents in Marah.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa baa igiri, e siga gbengberenyi ma. E naxa xi saxan ɲɛrɛ raba Etama gbengberenyi ma, e sa yonkin Mara.

sentences.english: And from Marah they went on to Elim: and in Elim there were twelve water-springs and seventy palm-trees; and they put up their tents there.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Elimi, e dulonyi fu nun firin nun tugi tongo solofere li dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And they went on from Elim and put up their tents by the Red Sea.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Xulunyumi Baa sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Then from the Red Sea they went on and put up their tents in the waste land of Sin.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Sini gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: And they went on from the waste land of Sin, and put up their tents in Dophkah.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa sa yonkin Dofika.

sentences.english: And they went on from Dophkah, and put up their tents in Alush.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Alusu.

sentences.english: And they went on from Alush, and put up their tents in Rephidim, where there was no drinking-water for the people.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Refidimi, kɔnɔ e mu ye to naa.

sentences.english: And they went on from Rephidim, and put up their tents in the waste land of Sinai.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Turusinina gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: And they went on from the waste land of Sinai and put up their tents in Kibroth-hattaavah.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Kibiroti Hataawa.

sentences.english: And they went on from Kibroth-hattaavah, and put up their tents in Hazeroth.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Xaseroti.

sentences.english: And they went on from Hazeroth, and put up their tents in Rithmah.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Ritima.

sentences.english: And they went on from Rithmah, and put up their tents in Rimmon-perez.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Rimɔn Peresi.

sentences.english: And they went on from Rimmon-perez, and put up their tents in Libnah.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Libina.

sentences.english: And they went on from Libnah, and put up their tents in Rissah.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Risa.

sentences.english: And they went on from Rissah, and put up their tents in Kehelathah.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Kehelata.

sentences.english: And they went on from Kehelathah, and put up their tents in Mount Shepher.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Seeferi geya ma.

sentences.english: And they went on from Mount Shepher, and put up their tents in Haradah.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Xarada.

sentences.english: And they went on from Haradah, and put up their tents in Makheloth.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Makeloti.

sentences.english: And they went on from Makheloth, and put up their tents in Tahath.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Taxati.

sentences.english: And they went on from Tahath, and put up their tents in Terah.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Tera.

sentences.english: And they went on from Terah, and put up their tents in Mithkah.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Mitika.

sentences.english: And they went on from Mithkah, and put up their tents in Hashmonah.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Xasamona.

sentences.english: And they went on from Hashmonah, and put up their tents in Moseroth.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Mosera.

sentences.english: And they went on from Moseroth, and put up their tents in Bene-jaakan.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Beneyaakan.

sentences.english: And they went on from Bene-jaakan, and put up their tents in Hor-haggidgad.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Horo Gidigada.

sentences.english: And they went on from Hor-haggidgad, and put up their tents in Jotbathah.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Yotobata.

sentences.english: And they went on from Jotbathah, and put up their tents in Abronah.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Abarona.

sentences.english: And they went on from Abronah, and put up their tents in Ezion-geber.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Esiyon Geberi.

sentences.english: And they went on from Ezion-geber, and put up their tents in the waste land of Zin (which is Kadesh).
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Kadesi Sini gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: And they went on from Kadesh, and put up their tents in Mount Hor, on the edge of the land of Edom.
sentences.susu: E keli mɛnni nɛ, e naxa siga Horo geya ma, Edon bɔxi naaninyi fɛ ma.

sentences.english: And Aaron the priest went up into the mountain at the order of the Lord, and came to his death there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae xa mini Misira ɲɛ tongo naani kike suuli nde xi singe, Alatala naxa Haruna yamari a xa te Horo geya fari, a xa laaxira mɛnni.

sentences.english: Aaron was a hundred and twenty-three years old at the time of his death in Mount Hor.
sentences.susu: Haruna nu bara ɲɛ kɛmɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan sɔtɔ, a faxa tɛmui Horo geya fari.

sentences.english: And news of the coming of the children of Israel came to the king of Arad, the Canaanite, who was living in the South in the land of Canaan.
sentences.susu: Aradi mangɛ, naxan sabatixi Negewi gbengberenyi Kanaan bɔxi ma, a naxa a kolon Isirayilakae bara fa.

sentences.english: And from Mount Hor they went on, and put up their tents in Zalmonah.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae to keli Horo geya yire, e naxa sa yonkin Salamona.

sentences.english: And they went on from Zalmonah, and put up their tents in Punon.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Punon.

sentences.english: And they went on from Punon, and put up their tents in Oboth.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Oboti.

sentences.english: And they went on from Oboth, and put up their tents in Iye-abarim at the edge of Moab.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Iye Abarimi, Mowaba bɔxi naaninyi ra.

sentences.english: And they went on from Iyim, and put up their tents in Dibon-gad.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Dibon Gadi.

sentences.english: And from Dibon-gad they went on, and put up their tents in Almon-diblathaim.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Alamɔn Dibilatayima.

sentences.english: And from Almon-diblathaim they went on, and put up their tents in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Abarimi geyae yire, Nebo geya yatagi.

sentences.english: And they went on from the mountains of Abarim, and put up their tents in the lowlands of Moab by Jordan at Jericho;
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa siga Mowaba fiili ma, Yurudɛn xure dɛ ra, Yeriko taa yatagi.

sentences.english: Planting their tents by the side of Jordan from Beth-jeshimoth as far as Abel-shittim in the lowlands of Moab.
sentences.susu: E naxa yonkin Yurudɛn xure dɛ ra, Beti Yesimoti nun Abeli Sitimi longori Mowaba fiili ma.

sentences.english: And in the lowlands of Moab by Jordan at Jericho, the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ Mowaba fiili ma, Yurudɛn xure dɛ ra, Yeriko taa yatagi,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel, When you go over Jordan into the land of Canaan,
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, ‹Wo na Yurudɛn xure giri tɛmui naxɛ sofe ra Kanaan bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: See that all the people of the land are forced out from before you, and put to destruction all their pictured stones, and all their metal images, and all their high places:
sentences.susu: wo mɛnnikae birin faxa. Wo xa e xa kuye birin kana, naxee masolixi gɛmɛ ra, naxee yailanxi wure raxunuxi ra. Wo xa e xa batudee fan kana.

sentences.english: And take the land for yourselves, for your resting-place: for to you I have given the land as your heritage.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na bɔxi suxu, wo fa sabati naa. N bara na bɔxi fi wo ma.

sentences.english: And you will take up your heritage in the land by the decision of the Lord, to every family its part; the greater the family the greater its heritage, and the smaller the family the smaller will be its heritage; wherever the decision of the Lord gives to any man his part, that will be his; distribution will be made to you by your fathers' tribes.
sentences.susu: Na bɔxi itaxunma wo ma Alatala xa maragiri kɛɲa nan ma a xabilɛ ki ma. Naxee bɔnsɔɛ xa mixie na wuya, e xa bɔxi belebele sɔtɔ. Naxee bɔnsɔɛ xa mixie mu wuya, e xa bɔxi xa xurun. Alatala a ragirima kankan naxan sɔtɔma a bɔnsɔɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: But if you are slow in driving out the people of the land, then those of them who are still there will be like pin-points in your eyes and like thorns in your sides, troubling you in the land where you are living.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa wo mu mɛnnikae faxa, e fama maniyade ɲooge nan na naxan mixi ya tɔɔrɔma, xa na mu a ra tunbee naxee mixi fari masɔxɔma. E findima nɛ wo yaxuie ra wo xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And it will come about that as it was my purpose to do to them, so I will do to you.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, n e xa yunubi sare dɔxɔma wo tan nan ma.›»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Give orders to the children of Israel and say to them, When you come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land which is to be your heritage, the land of Canaan inside these limits,)
sentences.susu: «A masen Isirayilakae bɛ, ‹Wo na siga Kanaan bɔxi ma, n naxan fixi wo ma kɛ ra, a naaninyie nan yi ki:

sentences.english: Then your south quarter will be from the waste land of Zin by the side of Edom, and your limit on the south will be from the east end of the Salt Sea,
sentences.susu: Yirefanyi mabiri, wo xa bɔxi naaninyi sa fɔlɔma Sini gbengberenyi nan ma, Edon bɔxi mabiri. Na naaninyi sa fɔlɔma Fɔxɔɛ Baa nan ma sogetede mabiri,

sentences.english: And round to the south of the slope of Akrabbim, and on to Zin: and its direction will be south of Kadesh-barnea, and it will go as far as Hazar-addar and on to Azmon:
sentences.susu: a sa a kɔnkɔrɔn Tali Tede yirefanyi mabiri, a a xun sa Sini, a dangi Kadesi Barineya yirefanyi mabiri, a siga Xasari Adari mabiri, a sa Asimon li.

sentences.english: And from Azmon it will go round to the stream of Egypt as far as the sea.
sentences.susu: A sa keli Asimon, a a kɔnkɔrɔn han Misira dabonyi kui, a fa sa mini Baa Xungbe ma.›»

sentences.english: And for your limit on the west you will have the Great Sea and its edge: this will be your limit on the west.
sentences.susu: «A sogegorode naaninyi findima Baa Xungbe nan na.»

sentences.english: And your limit on the north will be the line from the Great Sea to Mount Hor:
sentences.susu: «A kɔɔla naaninyi sa fɔlɔma Baa Xungbe nan ma, han a fa dɔxɔ Horo geya ra.

sentences.english: And from Mount Hor the line will go in the direction of Hamath; the farthest point of it will be at Zedad:
sentences.susu: Kelife ra Horo geya ma, wo xa naaninyi sigama na ki nɛ han Xamata sode dɛ ra, a sa dɔxɔ Sedade ra.

sentences.english: And the limit will go on to Ziphron, with its farthest point at Hazar-enan: this will be your limit on the north.
sentences.susu: A na keli mɛnni, a sigama Sifiron mabiri nɛ han a sa mini Xasari Enan ma. Wo xa bɔxi naaninyi nan na ki kɔɔla mabiri.»

sentences.english: And on the east, your limit will be marked out from Hazar-enan to Shepham,
sentences.susu: «A sogetede, wo xa naaninyi sa kelima Xasari Enan nan ma, a siga han Seefami.

sentences.english: Going down from Shepham to Riblah on the east side of Ain, and on as far as the east side of the sea of Chinnereth:
sentences.susu: A keli mɛnni, a siga Ribila, Ayin sogetede biri, a man siga, a sa din tentenyie ra Kinereti baa sogetede biri ra,

sentences.english: And so down to Jordan, stretching to the Salt Sea: all the land inside these limits will be yours.
sentences.susu: a sa mini Yurudɛn xure ma, a fa sa a raɲɔn Fɔxɔɛ Baa ma. Wo xa bɔxi naaninyie nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And Moses gave orders to the children of Israel saying, This is the land which is to be your heritage, by the decision of the Lord, which by the Lord's order is to be given to the nine tribes and the half-tribe:
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa na yaamari radangi Isirayilakae ma, a falafe ra, «Bɔxi nan yi ki, naxan itaxunma Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ solomanaani nun a tagi ma, alɔ Alatala a ragirixi kankan ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For the tribe of the children of Reuben, by their fathers' families, and the tribe of the children of Gad, by their fathers' families, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, have been given their heritage:
sentences.susu: Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti bara e gbe kɛ sɔtɔ e denbaya ki ma,

sentences.english: The two tribes and the half-tribe have been given their heritage on the other side of Jordan at Jericho, on the east looking to the dawn.
sentences.susu: Yurudɛn naakiri ma, Yeriko ya tagi sogetede biri ra.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: These are the names of the men who are to make the distribution of the land among you: Eleazar the priest and Joshua, the son of Nun.
sentences.susu: «Eleyasari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nun Nunu xa di xɛmɛ Yosuwe nan yi bɔxi itaxunma.

sentences.english: And you are to take one chief from every tribe to make the distribution of the land.
sentences.susu: Wo xa yarerati keren keren sugandi bɔnsɔɛ birin kui, naxee lanma yi bɔxi itaxunyi.

sentences.english: And these are the names of the men: of the tribe of Judah, Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.
sentences.susu: E xilie nan yi ki: Yuda bɔnsɔɛ, Yefune xa di xɛmɛ Kalebi.

sentences.english: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel, the son of Ammihud.
sentences.susu: Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ, Amixudi xa di xɛmɛ Semuweli.

sentences.english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad, the son of Chislon.
sentences.susu: Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ, Kisilon xa di xɛmɛ Elidada

sentences.english: And of the tribe of the children of Dan, a chief, Bukki, the son of Jogli.
sentences.susu: Dana bɔnsɔɛ, Yogoli xa di xɛmɛ Buuki.

sentences.english: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh, a chief, Hanniel, the son of Ephod:
sentences.susu: Yusufu xa di Manasi bɔnsɔɛ, Efodo xa di xɛmɛ Xaniyɛli.

sentences.english: And of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, a chief, Kemuel, the son of Shiphtan.
sentences.susu: Efirami bɔnsɔɛ, Sifitan xa di xɛmɛ Kemuweli.

sentences.english: And of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, a chief, Elizaphan, the son of Parnach.
sentences.susu: Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ, Paranaki xa di xɛmɛ Elisafan.

sentences.english: And of the tribe of the children of Issachar, a chief, Paltiel, the son of Azzan.
sentences.susu: Isakari bɔnsɔɛ, Asana xa di xɛmɛ Palatiyɛli.

sentences.english: And of the tribe of the children of Asher, a chief, Ahihud, the son of Shelomi.
sentences.susu: Aseri bɔnsɔɛ, Selomi xa di xɛmɛ Axihudi.

sentences.english: And of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, a chief, Pedahel, the son of Ammihud.
sentences.susu: Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ, Amixudi xa di xɛmɛ Pedaheli.»

sentences.english: These are they to whom the Lord gave orders to make the distribution of the heritage among the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
sentences.susu: Alatala nee nan sugandi Kanaan bɔxi itaxunfe ra Isirayilakae ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses in the lowlands of Moab by Jordan at Jericho,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ, Mowaba fiili ma, Yurudɛn xure fɛ ma, Yeriko ya tagi,

sentences.english: Give orders to the children of Israel to give to the Levites, from the heritage which is theirs, towns for themselves, with land on the outskirts of the towns.
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, e xa taa ndee nun e rabilinyie sugandi e xa bɔxi kui, e naxee fima Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ma, e sabatima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: These towns are to be their living-places, with land round them for their cattle and their food and all their beasts,
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ sabatima na taae nan kui, e xa xurusee luma na rabilinyie.

sentences.english: Stretching from the wall of the towns a distance of a thousand cubits all round.
sentences.susu: Na taa rabilinyie xa gboya sigama nɛ han nɔngɔn wulu keren na taa sɛɛti naani birin ma,

sentences.english: The measure of this space of land is to be two thousand cubits outside the town on the east, and two thousand cubits on the south and on the west and on the north, the town being in the middle. This space will be the outskirts of their towns.
sentences.susu: kelife taa tɛtɛ ma sigafe nɔngɔn wulu firin a sogetede biri, a sogegorode biri, a kɔɔla ma, nun a yirefanyi ma.»

sentences.english: And the towns which you give the Levites are to be the six safe places to which the taker of life may go in flight; and in addition you are to give them forty-two towns.
sentences.susu: «Na taa tongo naani nun solomasaxan ya ma, wo xa taa senni sugandi naxee findima makantadee ra mixie bɛ naxee bara faxɛ ti e mu a ɲanigexi.

sentences.english: Forty-eight towns are to be given to the Levites, all with land round them.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na taa tongo naani nun solomasaxan nun e rabilinyie fi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ma.

sentences.english: And these towns are to be given out of the heritage of the children of Israel, taking the greater number from those who have much, and a smaller number from those who have little: everyone, in the measure of his heritage, is to give of his property to the Levites.
sentences.susu: Bɔnsɔɛ naxee xa taae wuya, e xa taa gbegbe fi. Bɔnsɔɛ naxee xa taae mu wuya, e xa taa dondoronti fi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel, when you have gone over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ, e na Yurudɛn xure igiri sofe ra Kanaan bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: Then let certain towns be marked out as safe places to which anyone who takes the life of another in error may go in flight.
sentences.susu: e xa taae sugandi, naxee findima makantadee ra mixie bɛ naxee bara faxɛ ti e mu a ɲanigexi.

sentences.english: In these towns you may be safe from him who has the right of punishment; so that death may not overtake the taker of life till he has been judged by the meeting of the people.
sentences.susu: Na taae nan findima makantadee ra na mixie bɛ, han kiitisae e makiitima tɛmui naxɛ. Na kui e xa ratanga mixie ma naxee wama e gbeɲɔxɔfe, naxee wama e faxafe keren na.

sentences.english: Six of the towns which you give will be such safe places;
sentences.susu: Wo xa taa senni sugandi na wali xa fe ra,

sentences.english: Three on the other side of Jordan and three in the land of Canaan, to be safe places for flight.
sentences.susu: saxan Yurudɛn naakiri ma, saxan Kanaan bɔxi ma. Na taae nan findima wo makantadee ra.

sentences.english: For the children of Israel and for the man from another country who is living among them, these six towns are to be safe places, where anyone causing the death of another through error may go in flight.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mixi, a findi Isirayilaka ra, a findi xɔɲɛ ra, a findi dangi mixi ra, xa naxan yo sa mixi nde faxa a mu a ɲanigexi, na kanyi nɔma a nii ratangade na taa sennie nde kui.»

sentences.english: But if a man gives another man a blow with an iron instrument, causing his death, he is a taker of life and is certainly to be put to death.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ xa mixi sa mixi bɔnbɔ wure ra han a faxa, nii ba nan a ra. A lan nɛ, a fan xa faxa.

sentences.english: Or if he gives him a blow with a stone in his hand, causing his death, he is a taker of life and is certainly to be put to death.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi sa mixi bɔnbɔ gɛmɛ nan na han a faxa, nii ba nan a ra. A lan nɛ, a fan xa faxa.

sentences.english: Or if he gave him blows with a wood instrument in his hands, causing his death, he is a taker of life and is certainly to be put to death.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi sa mixi bɔnbɔ wuri nan na han a faxa, nii ba nan a ra. A lan nɛ, a fan xa faxa.

sentences.english: He whose right it is to give punishment for blood, may himself put to death the taker of life when he comes face to face with him.
sentences.susu: Gbeɲɔxɔɛ xa na faxɛti faxa a a suxuxi tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: If in his hate he put a sword through him, or waiting secretly for him sent a spear or stone at him, causing his death;
sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde sa a boore radin yɛ maraɲaaxui ma, xa na mu, a ɲanige a xa a gɔnɔ se nde ra, a faxa, faxɛti nan a ra.

sentences.english: Or in hate gave him blows with his hand, causing death; he who gave the death-blow is to be put to death; he is a taker of life: he whose right it is to give punishment for blood may put to death the taker of life when he comes face to face with him.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde sa a boore din a bɛlɛxɛ ra yaxuya ra, a faxa, faxɛti nan a ra. A lan nɛ, a fan xa faxa. Gbeɲɔxɔɛ xa na faxɛti faxa a a suxuxi tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: But if a man has given a wound to another suddenly and not in hate, or without design has sent something against him,
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ xa mixi nde sa a boore radin yɛ ɲanigetareɲa kui, xɔnɛ mu na, xa na mu a se nde woli a ma ɲanigetareɲa kui,

sentences.english: Or has given him a blow with a stone, without seeing him, so causing his death, though he had nothing against him and no desire to do him evil:
sentences.susu: xa na mu a a gɔnɔ gɛmɛ ra ɲanigetareɲa kui, a fa faxa, kɔnɔ xɔnɛ nun yaxuya mu na a kui,

sentences.english: Then let the meeting of the people be judge between the man responsible for the death and him who has the right of punishment for blood, acting by these rules:
sentences.susu: ɲama xa a makiiti yi sɛriyɛ ra gbeɲɔxɔɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And let the people keep the man responsible for the death safe from the hands of him who has the right of punishment for blood, and send him back to his safe town where he had gone in flight: there let him be till the death of the high priest who was marked with the holy oil.
sentences.susu: Ɲama xa a ba gbeɲɔxɔɛ yi ra, a a raso makantade kui. A xa lu mɛnni han sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi laaxirama tɛmui naxɛ, Alatala naxan sugandixi.

sentences.english: But if ever he goes outside the walls of the safe town where he had gone in flight,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa na kanyi sa mini makantade fari ma, a nu bara so dɛnnaxɛ,

sentences.english: And the giver of punishment, meeting him outside the walls of the town, puts him to death, he will not be responsible for his blood:
sentences.susu: gbeɲɔxɔɛ fa a to, a faxa, gbeɲɔxɔɛ mu findima faxɛti ra.

sentences.english: Because he had been ordered to keep inside the safe town till the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the taker of life may come back to the place of his heritage.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan nii bama ɲanigetareɲa kui, a xa lu makantade han sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi laaxirama tɛmui naxɛ. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi na laaxira tɛmui naxɛ, mixi naxan nii baxi ɲanigetareɲa kui, a nɔma gbilende a xɔnyi maratange kui.»

sentences.english: These rules are to be your guide in judging through all your generations wherever you may be living.
sentences.susu: «Sɛriyɛ nan ya wo bɔnsɔɛ bɛ yire birin, tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Anyone causing the death of another is himself to be put to death on the word of witnesses: but the word of one witness is not enough.
sentences.susu: Faxɛti mu lan a xa faxa seede keren xui ma, fo seede wuyaxi.

sentences.english: Further, no price may be given for the life of one who has taken life and whose right reward is death: he is certainly to be put to death.
sentences.susu: Faxɛti mu lan a xun xa sara, a xa faxa.

sentences.english: And no price may be offered for one who has gone in flight to a safe town, for the purpose of letting him come back to his place before the death of the high priest.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan faxɛ ti ɲanigetareɲa kui, a mu lan a xun xa sara alako a xa gbilen a xɔnyi beenun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi laaxirama tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: So do not make the land where you are living unholy: for blood makes the land unholy: and there is no way of making the land free from the blood which has come on it, but only by the death of him who was the cause of it.
sentences.susu: Wo mu lan wo xa bɔxi findi bɔxi sɛniyɛntare ra. Wuli raminife na nan nabama. Faxɛti wuli gbansan nan findima bɔxi xunsare ra.

sentences.english: Do not make unclean the land where you are living and in which is my House: for I the Lord am present among the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo xɔnyi findi yire sɛniyɛntare ra. N tan Alatala sabatixi wo tan Isirayilakae ya ma.»

sentences.english: Now the heads of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came to Moses, the chiefs and the heads of families of the children of Israel being present,
sentences.susu: Denbaya xunyi naxee nu na Galadi xabilɛ ya ma, Makiri xa die, Manasi xa mamadie, Yusufu xabilɛe, nee naxa siga Munsa nun Isirayila denbaya xunyie yire.

sentences.english: And said, The Lord gave orders to my lord to make distribution of the land as their heritage to the children of Israel: and my lord was ordered by the Lord to give the heritage of Zelophehad, our brother, to his daughters.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala Munsa bɛ, «Alatala bara a yamari i tan n marigi, i xa yi bɔxi itaxun Isirayila die ma Alatala xa maragiri kɛɲa ma, a xa findi e kɛ ra. Alatala man bara i yamari i xa muxu taara Selofexadi xa harige so a xa di ginɛe yi ra.

sentences.english: Now if they get married to any of the sons of other tribes of the children of Israel, then their property will be taken away from the heritage of our fathers, and become part of the heritage of the tribe into which they get married: and their heritage will be taken away from the heritage of our tribe.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa na di ginɛe sa dɔxɔ bɔnsɔɛ gbɛtɛ xɛmɛe xɔn, e kɛ bama nɛ muxu bɔnsɔɛ kɛ ra, a sa e xa xɛmɛe bɔnsɔɛe kɛ xun ma. Na kui nde bama nɛ muxu kɛ ra, naxan fixi muxu bɔnsɔɛ ma maragiri kui.

sentences.english: And at the time of the Jubilee of the children of Israel, their property will be joined to the heritage of the tribe of which they are part and will be taken away from the heritage of the tribe of our fathers.
sentences.susu: Xɔrɛya Ɲɛ na a li, e kɛ bama nɛ muxu benbae kɛ ra, a sa e xa xɛmɛe benbae kɛ xun ma.»

sentences.english: So by the direction of the Lord, Moses gave orders to the children of Israel, saying, What the tribe of the sons of Joseph have said is right.
sentences.susu: Munsa naxa Alatala xa yaamari radangi Isirayilakae ma, a falafe ra,

sentences.english: This is the order of the Lord about the daughters of Zelophehad: The Lord says, Let them take as their husbands whoever is most pleasing to them, but only among the family of their father's tribe.
sentences.susu: «Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ, wo nɔndi. Alatala xa yaamari nan ya Selofexadi xa di ginɛe bɛ. E xa dɔxɔ xɛmɛ xɔn naxan na xabilɛ nde kui e baba bɔnsɔɛ ya ma.

sentences.english: And so no property will be handed from tribe to tribe among the children of Israel; but every one of the children of Israel will keep the heritage of his father's tribe.
sentences.susu: Sese mu bama Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ nde kɛ ra, a findi bɔnsɔɛ gbɛtɛ kɛ ra. Birin a benba kɛ nan xun makantama.

sentences.english: And every daughter owning property in any tribe of the children of Israel is to be married to one of the family of her father's tribe, so that every man of the children of Israel may keep the heritage of his fathers.
sentences.susu: Di ginɛ kɛ kanyi xa dɔxɔ xɛmɛ xɔn naxan na xabilɛ nde kui a baba bɔnsɔɛ ya ma.

sentences.english: And no property will be handed from one tribe to another, but every tribe of the children of Israel will keep its heritage.
sentences.susu: Sese mu bama Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ nde kɛ ra, a findi bɔnsɔɛ gbɛtɛ kɛ ra. Birin a benba kɛ nan xun makantama.»

sentences.english: So the daughters of Zelophehad did as the Lord gave orders to Moses:
sentences.susu: Selofexadi xa di ginɛe naxa Alatala xa yaamari suxu alɔ Munsa a fala ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, took as their husbands the sons of their father's brothers:
sentences.susu: E xilie nan ya: Maxala, Tirisa, Xogala, Milika, nun Nowa. E birin naxa dɔxɔ e dɛɛxɔe xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh, the son of Joseph, and their property was kept in the tribe of their father's family
sentences.susu: E dɔxɔ Manasi xa di xabilɛe nan xɔn ma. Na kui e kɛ naxa lu e benba Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ.

sentences.english: These are the laws and the orders which the Lord gave to the children of Israel by Moses, in the lowlands of Moab by Jordan at Jericho.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa sɛriyɛ nun yaamarie nan na ki a naxee fixi Munsa ma, katarabi Isirayila ma, e nu na Mowaba fiili ma tɛmui naxɛ, Yurudɛn xure fɛ ma, Yeriko ya tagi.

sentences.english: These are the words which Moses said to all Israel on the far side of Jordan, in the waste land in the Arabah opposite Suph, between Paran on the one side, and Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab on the other.
sentences.susu: Wɔyɛnyie nan yi ki, Annabi Munsa naxan masen Isirayilakae birin bɛ. Na tɛmui a nu na Yurudɛn sogetede biri ra, gbengberenyi ma naxan na Araba, Sufi ya tagi, Paran, Tofeli, Laban, Xaseroti, nun Disahabi longori.

sentences.english: It is eleven days' journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh-barnea.
sentences.susu: Keli Xorebe geya han Kadesi Barineya kira ra minife ra Seyiri geyae biri, xi fu nun keren ɲɛrɛ na a ra.

sentences.english: Now in the fortieth year, on the first day of the eleventh month, Moses gave to the children of Israel all the orders which the Lord had given him for them;
sentences.susu: E xa keli ɲɛ tongo naani nde ma Misira, a kike fu nun keren nde, xi singe, Annabi Munsa naxa Alatala xa yaamari masen Isirayilakae bɛ.

sentences.english: After he had overcome Sihon, king of the Amorites, ruling in Heshbon, and Og, king of Bashan, ruling in Ashtaroth, at Edrei:
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Annabi Munsa nu bara xutu sɔtɔ Sixɔn ma, Amori mangɛ, naxan nu sabatixi Xɛsibɔn, a nun Ogo, Basan mangɛ, naxan nu sabatixi Asataroti nun Edereyi.

sentences.english: On the far side of Jordan in the land of Moab, Moses gave the people this law, saying,
sentences.susu: Yurudɛn sogetede biri Mowaba bɔxi ma, Annabi Munsa naxa Ala xa sɛriyɛ tagi raba e bɛ. Na wɔyɛnyi nan yi ki.

sentences.english: The Lord our God said to us in Horeb, You have been long enough in this mountain:
sentences.susu: «Won nu na Xorebe geya yire tɛmui naxɛ, won Marigi Alatala yi nan masen won bɛ, ‹Wo bara bu yi geya bun ma.

sentences.english: Make a move now, and go on your way into the hill-country of the Amorites and the places near it, in the Arabah and the hill-country and in the lowlands and in the South and by the seaside, all the land of the Canaanites, and Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.
sentences.susu: Wo ti kira xɔn ma fa. Wo xa siga geya ma Amorikae na dɛnnaxɛ, nun na longori birin, Araba bɔxi ma, geya biri, Sefela nun Negewi biri, baa dɛ ra, han Kanaan bɔxi ma, han Liban sa dɔxɔ Efirati xure belebele ra.

sentences.english: See, all the land is before you: go in and take for yourselves the land which the Lord gave by an oath to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and to their seed after them.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na bɔxi mato, n naxan fixi wo ma. Wo siga, wo xa na tongo, barima n tan Alatala yati nan na bɔxi laayidi tongoxi wo benbae bɛ, Iburahima, Isiyaga, a nun Yaxuba, a nun e bɔnsɔɛ birin hali e dangi xanbi.›»

sentences.english: At that time I said to you, I am not able to undertake the care of you by myself;
sentences.susu: «Na tɛmui n yi nan fala wo bɛ, ‹N tan keren mu nɔma wo xa fe nɔde.

sentences.english: The Lord your God has given you increase, and now you are like the stars of heaven in number.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala bara wo ragbo yɛ. Yakɔsi wo bara gbo yɛ alɔ tunbuie naxee na koore ma.

sentences.english: May the Lord, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times greater in number than you are, and give you his blessing as he has said!
sentences.susu: Wo benbae Marigi Alatala xa wo rawuya han. A xa baraka sa wo xa fe alɔ a masen ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: How is it possible for me by myself to be responsible for you, and undertake the weight of all your troubles and your arguments?
sentences.susu: N tan keren nɔma wo xa kalamuie makiitide di?

sentences.english: Take for yourselves men who are wise, far-seeing, and respected among you, from your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
sentences.susu: Wo kuntigi lɔnnilae sugandi, naxee kolonxi wo bɔnsɔɛe ya ma. N nee nan findima ɲama yareratie ra.›

sentences.english: And you made answer and said to me, It is good for us to do as you say.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa n yaabi, a n ma maɲɔxunyi, a maɲɔxun fanyi na a ra.

sentences.english: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise men and respected, and made them rulers over you, captains of thousands and captains of hundreds and captains of fifties and captains of tens, and overseers of your tribes.
sentences.susu: N naxa wo xa yareratie tongo, wo xa kuntigi lɔnnila naxee kolonxi wo bɔnsɔɛ ya ma. N naxa e findi mixi wulu, mixi kɛmɛ, mixi tongo suuli, mixi fu xunyie ra. N naxa e findi yareratie ra wo bɔnsɔɛe ya ma.

sentences.english: And at that time I gave orders to your judges, saying, Let all questions between your brothers come before you for hearing, and give decisions uprightly between a man and his brother or one from another nation who is with him.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n naxa yaamari so wo makiitimae yi ra. N naxɛ, ‹Wo xa wo tuli mati wo baribooree ra. Wo xa birin makiiti sɛriyɛ kɛɲa ma, wo ngaxakerenyie tagi nun e tan nun xɔɲɛe tagi.

sentences.english: In judging, do not let a man's position have any weight with you; give hearing equally to small and great; have no fear of any man, for it is God who is judge: and any cause in which you are not able to give a decision, you are to put before me and I will give it a hearing.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa ti mixi yo xɔn ma kiiti sade. Wo naxa xurunyi nun gboe mato. Wo naxa gaaxu mixi yo ya ra, barima kiitisa na Ala nan na. Xa kiiti sa xɔrɔxɔ wo bɛ han, wo fa a ra n xɔn, n tan kiiti sama.›

sentences.english: And at that time I gave you all the orders which you were to do.
sentences.susu: Na ki n bara fe birin masen wo bɛ, a lan wo xa naxan naba.»

sentences.english: Then we went on from Horeb, through all that great and cruel waste which you saw, on our way to the hill-country of the Amorites, as the Lord gave us orders; and we came to Kadesh-barnea.
sentences.susu: «Na to dangi, won naxa keli Xorebe geya, won mini gbengberenyi magaaxuxi ra wo bara dɛnnaxɛ to. Won naxa bira kira fɔxɔ ra naxan sigama Amori geyae biri ra, alɔ won Marigi Alatala a masen won bɛ ki naxɛ. Won naxa so Kadesi Barineya.

sentences.english: And I said to you, You have come to the hill-country of the Amorites, which the Lord our God is giving us.
sentences.susu: N naxa a fala wo bɛ, ‹Wo bara Amori geyae li, won Marigi Alatala dɛnnaxɛ fixi won ma.

sentences.english: See now, the Lord your God has put the land into your hands: go up and take it, as the Lord, the God of your fathers, has said to you; have no fear and do not be troubled.
sentences.susu: Wo a mato, wo Marigi Alatala bara yi bɔxi ti won ya i. Wo siga, wo xa na tongo alɔ wo benbae Marigi Alatala a falaxi wo bɛ ki naxɛ. Wo naxa gaaxu, wo xa limaniya.›»

sentences.english: And you came near to me, every one of you, and said, Let us send men before us to go through the land with care and give us an account of the way we are to go and the towns to which we will come.
sentences.susu: «Na tɛmui, wo birin naxa fa n yire, wo fa a fala n bɛ, ‹Won xa mixie xɛɛ, e xa siga yi bɔxi ma, e xa naa rabɛn. Na xa findi nee fan ma wali ra, alako won xa a kolon won lan won xa won ɲɛrɛ kira naxan xɔn a nun won sigama taa naxee.›

sentences.english: And what you said seemed good to me, and I took twelve men from among you, one from every tribe;
sentences.susu: Wo xa maɲɔxunyi naxa findi n bɛ fe fanyi ra. Na nan a to n naxa xɛmɛ mixi fu nun firin mayegeti wo ya ma, wo bɔnsɔɛ keren keren ma tagi.

sentences.english: And they went up into the hill-country and came to the valley of Eshcol, and saw what was there.
sentences.susu: E naxa siga geyae biri ra han e naxa gulunba li naxan xili Esekoli. E naxa naa rabɛn.

sentences.english: And taking in their hands some of the fruit of the land, they came down again to us, and gave us their account, saying, It is a good land which the Lord our God is giving us.
sentences.susu: E naxa yi bɔxi bogisee ba, e fa e masen won bɛ. E naxa dɛntɛgɛ sa won bɛ yi ki, ‹Won Marigi Alatala bɔxi fanyi nan fixi won ma.›

sentences.english: But going against the order of the Lord your God, you would not go up:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo mu tin tede, wo naxa tondi wo Marigi Alatala xa yaamari ra.

sentences.english: And you made an angry outcry in your tents, and said, In his hate for us the Lord has taken us out of the land of Egypt, to give us up into the hands of the Amorites for our destruction.
sentences.susu: Wo a maxɔrɔxɔ nɛ wo xa kiri banxie kui. Wo naxa a fala, ‹Xɔnnanteya na xɛɛxi, Alatala won tongoxi Misira bɔxi ma. A wama won sofe Amorikae nan yi ra alako e xa won halaki.

sentences.english: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our hearts feeble with fear by saying, The people are greater and taller than we are, and the towns are great and walled up to heaven; and more than this, we have seen the sons of the Anakim there.
sentences.susu: Won sigama minden? Limaniya mu na won bɛ, barima won ngaxakerenyie bara a fala won bɛ a mɛnnikae sɛnbɛ gbo. E man gbangbalan won bɛ, nun na taae xa fe maxɔrɔxɔ. Tɛtɛ naxan naa rabilinxi, a ite han. Muxu Anaki bɔnsɔɛe yati to nɛ.›»

sentences.english: Then I said to you, Have no fear of them.
sentences.susu: «N naxa a fala wo bɛ, ‹Wo naxa siikɛ. Wo naxa gaaxu e ya ra!

sentences.english: The Lord your God who goes before you will be fighting for you, and will do such wonders as he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala naxan ɲɛrɛma wo ya ra, a gere soma nɛ wo bɛ alɔ a a rabaxi wo ya xɔri ki naxɛ Misira bɔxi ma han gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: And in the waste land, where you have seen how the Lord was supporting you, as a man does his son, in all your journeying till you came to this place.
sentences.susu: Wo man bara a to, wo Marigi Alatala faxi nɛ wo ra alɔ xɛmɛ a xa di xaninma ki naxɛ, wo ɲɛrɛxi kira naxan birin na han wo naxa fa be li.

sentences.english: But for all this, you had no faith in the Lord your God,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na birin kui, wo mu nu laxi wo Marigi Alatala ra.

sentences.english: Who goes before you on your way, looking for a place where you may put up your tents, in fire by night, lighting up the way you are to go, and in a cloud by day.
sentences.susu: A tan nan ti wo ya ra, a yire fen wo bɛ wo luma dɛnnaxɛ. Kɔɛ ra a tan nan nu kira iyalanma wo bɛ tɛ ra. Yanyi fan na, a findi nuxui ra, a ti wo ya ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord, hearing your words, was angry, and said with an oath,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa wo xurutuxurutu xui mɛ. A xa xɔnɛ kui, a naxa a rakali,

sentences.english: Truly, not one of this evil generation will see that good land which I said I would give to your fathers,
sentences.susu: «Yi mixi kobi yo mu soma yi bɔxi fanyi ma, n naxan laayidixi wo babae bɛ

sentences.english: But only Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, he will see it; and to him and to his children I will give the land over which his feet have gone, because he has been true to the Lord with all his heart.
sentences.susu: fo Kalebi, Yefune xa di. A tan a toma nɛ. A bɔxi dɛnnaxɛ ɲɛrɛxi, na findima nɛ a gbe nun a bɔnsɔɛ gbe ra, barima a bara bira n tan Alatala xa kira fɔxɔ ra.»›»

sentences.english: And, in addition, the Lord was angry with me because of you, saying, You yourself will not go into it:
sentences.susu: «Wo tan xa fe ra Alatala bara xɔnɔ n fan ma. A naxa a masen, ‹I tan yɛtɛ yati mu soma yi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Joshua, the son of Nun, your servant, he will go into the land: say to him that he is to be strong, for he will be Israel's guide into their heritage.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe, Nunu xa di, i malima, nan fama sode. Limaniya fi a ma, barima a tan nan tima Isirayilakae ya ra yi bɔxi masɔtɔfe ra, a xa findi e kɛ ra.

sentences.english: And your little ones, who, you said, would come into strange hands, your children, who now have no knowledge of good or evil, they will go into that land, and to them I will give it and it will be theirs.
sentences.susu: Wo xa die, wo a falaxi naxee bɛ, e findima geelimanie ra. E tan naxan mu fe kobi nun fe fanyi tagi raba kolonxi, e tan nan fama sode na bɔxi ma. N fama na bɔxi fide e tan nan ma. A findima e tan nan gbe ra.

sentences.english: But as for you, go back, journeying into the waste land by the way of the Red Sea.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan man xa wo mafindi gbilenfe ra gbengberenyi biri ra, sigafe Kale baa mabiri.›»

sentences.english: Then you said to me, We have done evil against the Lord, we will go up to the attack, as the Lord our God has given us orders. And arming yourselves every one, you made ready to go up without care into the hill-country.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa a yaabi, ‹Muxu bara findi yunubitɔɛ ra Alatala ya i, kɔnɔ yakɔsi muxu fa wama sigafe gere sode nɛ, alɔ muxu Marigi Alatala muxu yamarixi a ra ki naxɛ.› Kankan naxa geresose tongo, barima wo a maɲɔxun nɛ a yi geya taa masɔtɔfe a findima sɔɔnɛya ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to me, Say to them, Do not go up to the attack; for I am not among you, and you will be overcome by those who are against you.
sentences.susu: Na nan a to Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, ‹A fala e bɛ, wo naxa siga gere sode de, barima n mu na wo ya ma. Wo naxa siga de, wo yaxuie naxa fa wo bɔnbɔ.›

sentences.english: This I said to you, but you gave no attention and went against the orders of the Lord, and in your pride went up into the hill-country.
sentences.susu: N yi marasi fixi nɛ wo ma, kɔnɔ wo mu tin wo tuli matide n na. Wo naxa Alatala xui matandi, wo naxa te yɛtɛ igboɲa kui geya fari.

sentences.english: And the Amorites who were in the hill-country came out against you and put you to flight, rushing after you like bees, and overcame you in Seir, driving you even as far as Hormah.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Amorika naxee nu sabatixi geya fari e naxa mini wo gerede alɔ kumi dinma mixi ra ki naxɛ. E naxa wo bɔnbɔ keli Seyiri han Horoma.

sentences.english: And you came back, weeping before the Lord; but the Lord gave no attention to your cries and did not give ear to you.
sentences.susu: Wo to gbilen, wo naxa wa Alatala ya i, kɔnɔ Alatala mu a tuli mati wo wa xui ra.

sentences.english: So you were kept waiting in Kadesh for a long time.
sentences.susu: Wo man naxa lu Kadesi, wo bu naa alɔ wo singe bui naxan naba.»

sentences.english: Then we went back, journeying into the waste land by the way to the Red Sea, as the Lord had said to me: and we were a long time going round Mount Seir.
sentences.susu: «Na xanbi won naxa gbilen gbengberenyi kira suxu ra sigafe Kale Baa mabiri, alɔ Alatala a masen n bɛ ki naxɛ. Won naxa xi wuyaxi raba Seyiri geyae rabilinyi.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to me,
sentences.susu: «Alatala naxa a fala n bɛ,

sentences.english: You have been journeying round this mountain long enough: now go to the north;
sentences.susu: ‹Wo bara yi geya mabilin a gbe ra. Wo wo mafindi sigafe ra kɔɔla ma.›

sentences.english: And give the people orders, saying, You are about to go through the land of your brothers, the children of Esau, who are living in Seir; and they will have fear of you; so take care what you do:
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala n bɛ n xa yi yaamari fi wo ma. Wo fama dangide Seyiri bɔxi sɛɛti ma, wo ngaxakerenyie na dɛnnaxɛ, Esayu bɔnsɔɛ. E fama nɛ gaaxude wo ya ra, kɔnɔ wo wo yɛtɛ masuxu e gerefe ra,

sentences.english: Make no attack on them, for I will not give you any of their land, not even space enough for a man's foot: because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for his heritage.
sentences.susu: barima n mu sese soma wo yi ra e xa bɔxi ma, hali sanyi tide. N bara Seyiri geyae fi Esayu ma.

sentences.english: You may get food for your needs from them for a price, and water for drinking.
sentences.susu: Wo na wa donse nun ye naxan xɔn fo wo a sara e ma gbeti ra.

sentences.english: For the blessing of the Lord your God has been on you in all the work of your hands: he has knowledge of your wanderings through this great waste: these forty years the Lord your God has been with you, and you have been short of nothing.
