sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala bara baraka sa wo wali fɔxi. A bara a ɲɔxɔ sa wo xa fe xɔn ma wo nu yi gbengberenyi igirima tɛmui naxɛ. Yi ɲɛ tongo naani bun ma, wo birin nan nu a ra. Sese xa fe mu xɔrɔxɔ wo ma.»

sentences.english: So we went on past our brothers, the children of Esau, living in Seir, by the road through the Arabah, from Elath and Ezion-geber. And turning, we went by the road through the waste land of Moab.
sentences.susu: «Won naxa dangi won ngaxakerenyie ra yire makuye, Esayu bɔnsɔɛ naxan sabatixi Seyiri bɔxi ma. Won man naxa dangi Araba, Elata, Esiyon Geberi kira ra yire makuye. Na xanbi won naxa won mafindi, won Mowaba gbengberenyi kira suxu.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to me, Make no attack on Moab and do not go to war with them, for I will not give you any of his land: because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for their heritage.
sentences.susu: «Alatala naxa a fala n bɛ, ‹Wo naxa gere giri Mowabakae ma de. Wo naxa gere ti e bɛ de, barima n mu fama sese sode wo yi ra e xɔnyi. N bara Ari bɔxi fi Loti ma.›»

sentences.english: (In the past the Emim were living there; a great people, equal in numbers to the Anakim and as tall;
sentences.susu: Singe ra, Emikae nan nu na Ari bɔxi ma. Ɲama gbangbalanyi nan nu e ra. E wuya, e fan kuya alɔ Anaki bɔnsɔɛe.

sentences.english: They are numbered among the Rephaim, like the Anakim; but are named Emim by the Moabites.
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee naxa e maɲɔxun Refakae ra, naxee maniya Anaki bɔnsɔɛe ra, kɔnɔ Mowabakae nu e xilima nɛ Emikae.

sentences.english: And the Horites in earlier times were living in Seir, but the children of Esau took their place; they sent destruction on them and took their land for themselves, as Israel did to the land of his heritage which the Lord gave them.)
sentences.susu: Naxan findi Seyiri bɔxi ra, Xorikae nan singe nu na naa. Esayu bɔnsɔɛ naxa e masuxu, e e faxa. E tan naxa sabati naa. Isirayilakae fan fama na mɔɔli nan nabade bɔxi ma Alatala na dɛnnaxɛ fi e ma.

sentences.english: Get up now, and go over the stream Zered. So we went over the stream Zered.
sentences.susu: «Alatala naxa a fala n bɛ, ‹Yakɔsi, wo keli, wo xa Serede xure igiri.›» Won naxa na raba.

sentences.english: Thirty-eight years had gone by from the time when we came away from Kadesh-barnea till we went over the stream Zered; by that time all the generation of the men of war among us were dead, as the Lord had said.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ tongo saxan nun solomasaxan dangi nɛ kabi won keli lɔxɔɛ Kadesi Barineya han won giri lɔxɔɛ Serede xure ra. Na waxati kui geresoe naxee nu na, nee birin nu bara faxa alɔ Alatala a rakali e bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For the hand of the Lord was against them, working their destruction, till all were dead.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa e tuxunsan han e birin naxa halaki.

sentences.english: So when death had overtaken all the men of war among the people,
sentences.susu: Na geresoe to bara halaki ɲama tagi,

sentences.english: The word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ,

sentences.english: You are about to go by Ar, the limit of the country of Moab;
sentences.susu: «Wo fa sigafe dangide Mowaba naaninyi nan na sigafe Ari bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And when you come near the land of the children of Ammon, give them no cause of trouble and do not make war on them, for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for your heritage: because I have given it to the children of Lot.
sentences.susu: Wo makɔrɛma nɛ Amonikae ra. Wo naxa gere giri e ma de. Wo naxa e fen gere ra, barima n mu fama sese sode wo yi ra e xa bɔxi ma. N naa fixi Loti bɔnsɔɛ nan ma.»

sentences.english: (That land is said to have been a land of the Rephaim, for Rephaim had been living there in earlier times, but they were named Zamzummim by the Ammonites;
sentences.susu: E nu yi bɔxi maɲɔxunxi Refakae nan gbe ra. Kabi tɛmui xɔnnakuye Refakae nan nu sabatixi naa. Amonikae nu e xilima nɛ Samisumikae.

sentences.english: They were a great people, tall as the Anakim, and equal to them in number; but the Lord sent destruction on them and the children of Ammon took their place, living in their land;
sentences.susu: Ɲama sɛnbɛma nan nu lanxi e ma, e wuya, e man gbangbalan alɔ Anaki bɔnsɔɛ. Kɔnɔ Alatala naxa e halaki Amonikae saabui ra. Naa naxa findi Amonikae gbe ra, e naxa sabati naa.

sentences.english: As he did for the children of Esau living in Seir, when he sent destruction on the Horites before them, and they took their land where they are living to this day:
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa na mɔɔli raba Esayu xa die bɛ naxee sabatixi Seyiri bɔxi ma. A to nu Xorikae halakima e saabui ra, naa naxa findi e gbe ra. E sabatixi mɛnni nɛ han yakɔsi.

sentences.english: And the Avvim, living in the small towns as far as Gaza, came to destruction by the hands of the Caphtorim who came out from Caphtor and took their land.)
sentences.susu: Naxan findi Awikae tan na, naxee nu sabatixi taae kui han Gasa, e naxa halaki Kafatorokae saabui ra. Naa naxa findi Kafatorokae gbe ra, e naxa sabati naa. Kafatorokae naxa keli Kafatoro.

sentences.english: Get up now, and go on your journey, crossing over the valley of the Arnon: see, I have given into your hands Sihon, the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and all his land: go forward to make it yours, and make war on him,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen won bɛ, «Wo ti kira xɔn ma, wo xa Arinon xure igiri. Wo a mato, n bara Sixɔn Amorika Xɛsibɔn mangɛ so wo yi ra nun a xa bɔxi. Yakɔsi, wo na tongo, wo e gere.

sentences.english: From now on I will put the fear of you in all peoples under heaven, who, hearing of you, will be shaking with fear and grief of heart because of you.
sentences.susu: To n fama nɛ wo xa fe magaaxui lude duniɲa mixi birin ma. E na wo xili mɛ, e fama nɛ sɛrɛnde gbirigbiri.»

sentences.english: Then from the waste land of Kedemoth I sent representatives to Sihon, king of Heshbon, with words of peace, saying,
sentences.susu: «N xɛɛra xɛɛ nɛ Sixɔn, Xɛsibɔn mangɛ ma, kelife ra Kedemoti gbengberenyi ma. N naxa yi bɔɲɛsa masenyi ti a bɛ,

sentences.english: Let me go through your land: I will keep to the highway, not turning to the right or to the left;
sentences.susu: ‹Muxu wama i xa bɔxi igirife. Muxu muxu ɲɛrɛma kira nan tun xɔn ma. Muxu mu sigama kɔɔla ma, muxu mu sigama yirefanyi ma.

sentences.english: Let me have food, at a price, for my needs, and water for drinking: only let me go through on foot;
sentences.susu: Muxu donse nun ye naxan minma, muxu fama nɛ a birin sare fide i ma gbeti ra. A lu kansan muxu xa dangi i xa bɔxi ma muxu sanyi ra.

sentences.english: As the children of Esau did for me in Seir and the Moabites in Ar; till I have gone over Jordan into the land which the Lord our God is giving us.
sentences.susu: Esayu bɔnsɔɛe naxee sabatixi Seyiri bɔxi ma, nun Mowabakae naxee sabatixi Ari bɔxi ma, nee naxa muxu sagoe sa dangife ra e xa bɔxi ma. I fan xa muxu sagoe sa muxu xa Yurudɛn xure igiri, muxu xa so bɔxi ma muxu Marigi Alatala dɛnnaxɛ fixi muxu ma.›

sentences.english: But Sihon, king of Heshbon, would not let us go through; for the Lord your God made his spirit hard and his heart strong, so that he might give him up into your hands as at this day.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Xɛsibɔn mangɛ Sixɔn naxa tondi muxu sagoe fide dangife ra a xa bɔxi ma, barima wo Marigi Alatala nu bara a xaxili raxɔrɔxɔ. A naxa a bɔɲɛ balan alako a xa a so wo yi ra alɔ wo a toxi ki naxɛ to.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to me, See, from now on I have given Sihon and his land into your hands: go forward now to take his land and make it yours.
sentences.susu: «Alatala naxa a fala n bɛ, ‹I bara a to, n bara gɛ Sixɔn nun a xa bɔxi sode i yi ra. Naa tongo i gbe.›

sentences.english: Then Sihon came out against us with all his people, to make an attack on us at Jahaz.
sentences.susu: Sixɔn nun a xa ɲama birin naxa keli fafe ra won gerede Yahasi.

sentences.english: And the Lord our God gave him into our hands; and we overcame him and his sons and all his people.
sentences.susu: Won Marigi Alatala naxa e so won yi ra xunnakeli kui. Won naxa nɔla sɔtɔ e ma, a tan, a xa die a nun a xa ɲama birin.

sentences.english: At that time we took all his towns, and gave them over to complete destruction, together with men, women, and children; we had no mercy on any:
sentences.susu: Won naxa na taae birin suxu, won naxa e birin kana. Won man naxa xɛmɛe, nun ginɛe, a nun dimɛe birin faxa. Won mu mixi yo lu a ɲiɲɛ ra,

sentences.english: Only the cattle we took for ourselves, with the goods from the towns we had taken.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ won mu sese tongo fo xurusee a nun se xɔri naxee nu na na taae kui.

sentences.english: From Aroer on the edge of the valley of the Arnon and from the town in the valley as far as Gilead, no town was strong enough to keep us out; the Lord our God gave them all into our hands:
sentences.susu: Keli Aroweri Arinon xure dɛ ra, a nun taa naxan na geya lanbanyi, sigafe ra han Galadi, taa yo sɛnbɛ mu dangi won na. Won Marigi Alatala naxa a birin so won yi ra.

sentences.english: But you did not go near the land of the children of Ammon, that is, all the side of the river Jabbok or the towns of the hill-country, wherever the Lord our God had said we were not to go.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo mu wo makɔrɛ Amonikae xa bɔxi ra, Yaboko xure dɛ birin, taa naxee na geya fari, a nun Alatala tɔnyi dɔxɔ won ma bɔxi naxee gerefe ra.»

sentences.english: Then turning we took the road to Bashan: and Og, king of Bashan, came out against us with all his people, and made an attack on us at Edrei.
sentences.susu: «Won naxa won mafindi tefe ra Basan kira xɔn ma. Ogo, Basan mangɛ, naxa mini won gerede Ederi, a tan nun a xa ɲama birin.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to me, Have no fear of him: for I have given him and all his people and his land into your hands; do to him as you did to Sihon, king of the Amorites, who was ruling in Heshbon.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a fala n bɛ, ‹I naxa gaaxu a ya ra, barima n a niyama nɛ i xutu sɔtɔ a tan nun a xa ɲama birin ma nun a xa bɔxi. I xa nɔ a ra alɔ i a rabaxi Amorikae xa mangɛ Sixɔn na ki naxɛ.›

sentences.english: So the Lord our God gave up Og, king of Bashan, and all his people into our hands; and we overcame him so completely that all his people came to their end in the fight.
sentences.susu: Won Marigi Alatala naxa a niya won xa xutu sɔtɔ Basan mangɛ Ogo nun a xa ɲama birin ma. Won naxa e birin faxa, mixi yo mu lu.

sentences.english: At that time we took all his towns; there was not one town of the sixty towns, all the country of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which we did not take.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui won nu bara e xa taae birin suxu. Na taa yo mu lu won mu dɛnnaxɛ suxu, taa tongo senni na a ra naxan na Aragobo rabilinyi. Na taa birin nu na Ogo xa mangɛya nan bun ma Basan bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: All these towns had high walls round them with doors and locks; and in addition we took a great number of unwalled towns.
sentences.susu: Na taae birin nu rabilinxi tɛtɛ itexie nan na, nun naadɛ mabalanxie ra. Taa gbegbe fan nu na tɛtɛ mu nu naxee rabilinxi.

sentences.english: And we put them to the curse, every town together with men, women, and children.
sentences.susu: Won naxa na longori taa birin kana alɔ won a raba Xɛsibɔn, Sixɔn mangɛ xa bɔxi ra ki naxɛ. Won naxa xɛmɛe, nun ginɛe, a nun dimɛe birin faxa,

sentences.english: But we took for ourselves all the cattle and the stored wealth of the towns.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ won naxa e xa xurusee nun e harige tan xanin.»

sentences.english: At that time we took their land from the two kings of the Amorites on the far side of Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon;
sentences.susu: «Won a raba na ki nɛ. Na waxati won naxa bɔxie rasuxu, naxee nu na Yurudɛn sogetede biri, Amorikae xa mangɛ firinyie yi ra. Na longori keli Arinon xure han Xerimon geya.

sentences.english: (By the Sidonians, Hermon is named Sirion, and by the Amorites Shenir;)
sentences.susu: Sidɔnkae na geya xili falama nɛ Siriyon. Amorikae tan na xili falama Seniri.

sentences.english: All the towns of the table-land and all Gilead and Bashan as far as Salecah and Edrei, towns of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
sentences.susu: Taa naxee birin na lanbanyi ma, won naxa e birin masɔtɔ, a nun Galadi bɔxi rabilinyi birin, sigafe ra Basan ma sa dɔxɔ Salika nun Ederi ra. Na taa birin nu na Ogo xa mangɛya nan bun ma Basan bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: (For Og, king of Bashan, was the last of all the Rephaim; his bed was made of iron; is it not in Rabbah, in the land of the children of Ammon? It was nine cubits long and four cubits wide, measured by the common cubit.)
sentences.susu: Basan mangɛ Ogo nan keren mu faxa Refakae ya ma. A xa wure sade nu na Raaba nɛ, Amonikae xa mangataa. A kuyɛ nu sigaxi nɔngɔn solomanaani, a igboe nɔngɔn naani.»

sentences.english: And this land which we took at that time, from Aroer by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill-country of Gilead with its towns, I gave to the Reubenites and the Gadites.
sentences.susu: «Na tɛmui won naxa xutu sɔtɔ na bɔxi ma. Kelife Aroweri sigafe ra Arinon xure ma, a nun Galade geya sɛɛti, nun a taae, n naxa na birin so Ruben nun Gadi bɔnsɔɛ yi ra.

sentences.english: The rest of Gilead and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, all the land of Argob, together with Bashan, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh. (This land is named the land of the Rephaim.
sentences.susu: N naxa Galade sɛɛti dɔnxɔɛ nun Ogo xa mangɛya naxan na Basan bɔxi ma so Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti yi ra. Aragobo rabilinyi nun Basan nu kolonxi Refakae xa bɔxi nan na.

sentences.english: Jair, the son of Manasseh, took all the land of Argob, as far as the country of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, naming it, Bashan, Havvoth-Jair after himself, as it is to this day.)
sentences.susu: Manasi xa di Yayiri naxa Aragobo bɔxi findi a gbe ra, han Gesurikae nun Maakakae naaninyi ra. A naxa a xili sa Basan xun ma, naxan xili falama han yakɔsi Yayiri taa.

sentences.english: And Gilead I gave to Machir.
sentences.susu: N naxa Galade so Makiri yi ra.

sentences.english: And the land from Gilead to the valley of the Arnon, with the middle of the valley as a limit, as far as the river Jabbok which is the limit of the country of the children of Ammon, I gave to the Reubenites and the Gadites;
sentences.susu: N naxa Galade sɛɛti so Ruben bɔnsɔɛ a nun Gadi bɔnsɔɛ yi ra, han a sa dɔxɔ Arinon xure ra. Xure nan na naaninyi ra, han a sa dɔxɔ Yaboko xure ra Amonikae naaninyi ra,

sentences.english: As well as the Arabah, with the river Jordan as their limit, from Chinnereth to the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah to the east.
sentences.susu: a nun Araba bɔxi naxan nun Yurudɛn naaninyi baxi, keli Kinereti Baa ma, a sa dɔxɔ Araba Fɔxɛ Baa ra, naxan na Pisiga lanbanyi ma sogetede.»

sentences.english: At that time I gave you orders, saying, The Lord has given you this land for your heritage: all the men of war are to go over armed before your brothers the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: «Na tɛmui n naxa yi yaamari fi wo ma, ‹Wo Marigi Alatala bara yi bɔxi fi wo ma alako a xa findi wo gbe ra. Wo tan xɛmɛ kɛndɛe, wo findima nɛ wo ngaxakerenyi Isirayilakae xa sɔɔrie ra.

sentences.english: But your wives and your little ones and your cattle (for it is clear that you have much cattle) may go on living in the towns I have given you;
sentences.susu: Wo xa ginɛe nun wo xa diyɔrɛe, nun wo xa xurusee nan gbansan fama lude taae kui n naxee soxi wo yi ra. N na a kolon xurusee gbegbe na wo yi ra.

sentences.english: Till the Lord has given rest to your brothers as to you, and till they have taken for themselves the land which the Lord your God is giving them on the other side of Jordan: then you may go back, every man of you, to the heritage which I have given you.
sentences.susu: Wo sɔɔriɲa rabama nɛ han wo Marigi Alatala malabui fima wo ngaxakerenyie ma tɛmui naxɛ. Wo Marigi Alatala bɔxi fima e ma Yurudɛn naakiri nan ma. Na tɛmui kankan fama gbilende a xa bɔxi ma n naxan soxi a yi ra.›»

sentences.english: And I gave orders to Joshua at that time, saying, Your eyes have seen what the Lord your God has done to these two kings: so will the Lord do to all the kingdoms into which you come.
sentences.susu: «Na tɛmui n naxa yaamari so Yosuwe yi ra. N fa a fala a bɛ, ‹I ya bara fee birin to i Marigi Alatala naxee rabaxi yi mangɛ firinyie ra. Alatala fama nɛ na rabade mangataa birin i na dangi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Have no fear of them, for the Lord your God will be fighting for you.
sentences.susu: I naxa gaaxu e ya ra, barima i Marigi Alatala nan fama e gerede wo bɛ.›»

sentences.english: And at that time I made request to the Lord, saying,
sentences.susu: «Na tɛmui n naxa Alatala maxandi,

sentences.english: O Lord God, you have now for the first time let your servant see your great power and the strength of your hand; for what god is there in heaven or on earth able to do such great works and such acts of power?
sentences.susu: ‹N Marigi Alatala, i bara i xa fisamanteya nun i sɛnbɛ masen i xa konyi bɛ. Ala gbɛtɛ yo mu na koore ma a nun bɔxi naxan nɔma i fɔxi a nun i xa kaabanakoe rabade.

sentences.english: Let me go over, O Lord, and see the good land on the other side of Jordan, and that fair mountain country, even Lebanon.
sentences.susu: N bara i mayandi, a lu n xa nɔ Yurudɛn xure igiride, alako n xa na bɔxi fanyi nun a xa geya fanyie to naxan na naakiri ma, a nun Liban.›

sentences.english: But the Lord was angry with me because of you and would not give ear to my prayer; and the Lord said to me, Let it be enough, say no more about this thing.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan xa fe ra, Alatala naxa xɔnɔ n ma. A mu n danxun. Alatala naxa a fala n bɛ, ‹A mu lan i xa yi wɔyɛnyi fala n bɛ sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and turning your eyes to the west and the north, to the south and the east, see the land with your eyes: for you are not to go over Jordan.
sentences.susu: Te Pisiga geya xuntagi, i xa sogegorode biri, kɔɔla biri, yirefanyi biri, a nun sogetede biri mato, kɔnɔ i xa a kolon a fanyi ra i mu Yurudɛn igirima.

sentences.english: But give my orders to Joshua, comforting him and making him strong; for he is to go over Jordan at the head of this people, and he will give them this land which you will see for their heritage.
sentences.susu: I xa yaamari so Yosuwe yi ra, i xa limaniya nun sɛnbɛ fi a ma, barima a tan nan fama tide ɲama ya ra Yurudɛn igirife ra. I bɔxi naxan toma, Yosuwe fama nɛ na bɔxi sode Isirayila yi ra, a findi e kɛ bɔxi ra.›

sentences.english: So we were waiting in the valley facing Beth-peor.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, won naxa lu gulunba Beti Peyori yatagi.

sentences.english: And now give ear, O Israel, to the laws and the decisions which I am teaching you, and do them; so that life may be yours, and you may go in and take for yourselves the land which the Lord, the God of your fathers, is giving you.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi, Isirayila, wo wo tuli mati. Wo xa bira sɛriyɛ nun yaamari fɔxɔ ra n wo xaranfe naxee ra yi ki, alako wo xa simaya sɔtɔ, wo man xa bɔxi sɔtɔ wo babae Marigi Alatala naxan fixi wo ma.

sentences.english: Make no addition to the orders which I give you, and take nothing from them, but keep the orders of the Lord your God which I give you.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa sese sa yaamari xun, n naxan falaxi wo bɛ. Wo man naxa sese ba a ra. Wo xa wo Marigi Alatala xa yaamari rawali alɔ n na falaxi wo bɛ ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Your eyes have seen what the Lord did because of Baal-peor: for destruction came from the Lord on all those among you who went after Baal-peor.
sentences.susu: «Wo yae bara fee to Alatala naxee rabaxi Peyori. Wo Marigi Alatala bara mixi birin faxa naxee Bali batuxi Peyori.

sentences.english: But you who kept faith with the Lord are living, every one of you, today.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan naxee biraxi wo Marigi Alatala xa fe fɔxɔ ra, wo birin man na simaya kui han to.»

sentences.english: I have been teaching you laws and decisions, as I was ordered to do by the Lord my God, so that you might keep them in the land to which you are going to take it for your heritage.
sentences.susu: «Wo a kolon, n bara wo xaran sɛriyɛ nun yaamari ra alɔ n Marigi Alatala a yamarixi n na ki naxɛ, alako wo xa a raba bɔxi ma dɛnnaxɛ findima wo gbe ra.

sentences.english: So keep these laws and do them; for so will your wisdom and good sense be clear in the eyes of the peoples, who hearing all these laws will say, Truly, this great nation is a wise and far-seeing people.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a ti xɔri ma, wo xa a raba, a xa findi lɔnni ra wo bɛ, a xa xaxili fi wo ma. Si gbɛtɛe na yi sɛriyɛe kolon, e fama nɛ a falade, ‹Yi si findixi lɔnnila fanyie nan na.›

sentences.english: For what great nation has a god so near to them as the Lord our God is, whenever we are turned to him in prayer?
sentences.susu: Si mundun xa ala makɔrɛxi a ra alɔ won Marigi Alatala a makɔrɛma won na ki naxɛ won na a maxandi tɛmui naxɛ?

sentences.english: And what great nation has laws and decisions so right as all this law which I put before you today?
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ nun yaamari tinxinxi na si mundun bɛ alɔ won ma sɛriyɛ n naxan soxi wo yi ra yi ki?

sentences.english: Only take care, and keep watch on your soul, for fear that the things which your eyes have seen go from your memory and from your heart all the days of your life; but let the knowledge of them be given to your children and to your children's children;
sentences.susu: Wo xa fee ragata wo xaxili ma lɔxɔɛ birin wo xa simaya kui, wo naxee toxi. Wo naxa nɛɛmu nee ma, e naxa ba wo bɔɲɛ ma. Wo xa e masen wo xa die nun wo xa mamadie bɛ.»

sentences.english: That day when you were waiting before the Lord your God in Horeb, and the Lord said to me, Make all the people come together, so that hearing my words they may go in fear of me all the days of their life on earth and give this teaching to their children.
sentences.susu: «Wo wo maɲɔxun lɔxɔɛ ma wo ti wo Marigi Alatala ya i lɔxɔɛ naxɛ, Xorebe geya fari. Na lɔxɔɛ Alatala naxa a fala n bɛ, ‹Ɲama birin xa malan n yire. N xa n ma sɛriyɛ fala e bɛ alako e xa gaaxu n ya ra e xa duniɲɛigiri kui. E man xa a xaran e xa die fan na.›

sentences.english: And you came near, waiting at the foot of the mountain; and flames of fire went up from the mountain to the heart of heaven, with dark clouds, and all was black as night.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo maso geya bunyi ra. Tɛ nu bara din geya ra han koore ma. Dimi, nuxui, nun kunda naxa goro.

sentences.english: And the voice of the Lord came to you out of the fire: the sound of his words came to your ears but you saw no form; there was nothing but a voice.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa wɔyɛn wo bɛ tɛ tagi. Wo naxa a wɔyɛn xui mɛ, kɔnɔ wo mu sese to. Wo nu a xui nan tun mɛma.

sentences.english: And he gave you his agreement with you, the ten rules which you were to keep, which he put in writing on the two stones of the law.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa saatɛ masen wo bɛ, wo naxan nawalima. A naxa na yaamari fu sɛbɛ gɛmɛ walaxɛ firinyi ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord gave me orders at that time to make clear to you these laws and decisions, so that you might do them in the land to which you are going, and which is to be your heritage.
sentences.susu: Na waxati, Alatala naxa n yaamari n xa wo xaran sɛriyɛ nun yaamari ra, alako wo xa a raba bɔxi ma naxan findima wo gbe ra.»

sentences.english: So keep watch on yourselves with care; for you saw no form of any sort on the day when the voice of the Lord came to you in Horeb out of the heart of the fire:
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa wo yɛtɛ ranɛɛmu lɔxɔɛ ma de Alatala wɔyɛn wo bɛ lɔxɔɛ naxɛ, Xorebe geya fari tɛ tagi, wo mu a gundi yati to.

sentences.english: So that you may not be turned to evil ways and make for yourselves an image in the form of any living thing, male or female,
sentences.susu: Wo naxa findi yunubitɔɛ ra de kuyee yailanfe ra, naxee misaalixi xɛmɛ, ginɛ,

sentences.english: Or any beast of the earth, or winged bird of the air,
sentences.susu: sube, xɔni,

sentences.english: Or of anything which goes flat on the earth, or any fish in the water under the earth.
sentences.susu: bubusee nun yɛxɛe ra naxee na ye ma.

sentences.english: And when your eyes are lifted up to heaven, and you see the sun and the moon and the stars, all the army of heaven, do not let yourselves be moved to give them worship, or become the servants of what the Lord has given equally to all peoples under heaven.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo yae rate koore ma de, soge batufe ra, xa na mu a ra kike, xa na mu a ra tunbuie. Se naxee birin na koore ma, wo naxa wo igoro e bɛ, wo naxa e batu. Wo Marigi Alatala nee daaxi si birin nan bɛ, naxee na duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: But the Lord has taken you out of the flaming fire, out of Egypt, to be to him the people of his heritage, as you are today.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan, Alatala wo ramini nɛ fe xɔrɔxɔɛ kui Misira bɔxi ma alako wo xa findi a xa ɲama ra, alɔ wo na ki naxɛ to lɔxɔɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord was angry with me because of you, and made an oath that I was not to go over Jordan into the good land which the Lord is giving you for your heritage:
sentences.susu: «Alatala naxa xɔnɔ n ma wo xa fe ra. A naxa a kali a n mu Yurudɛn igirima, n mu fama sode yi bɔxi fanyi ma wo Marigi Alatala naxan fixi wo ma kɛ ra.

sentences.english: But death is to come to me in this land, I may not go over Jordan: but you will go over and take that good land for your heritage.
sentences.susu: N tan, n fama faxade yi bɔxi nan ma. N mu fama Yurudɛn igiride feo. Kɔnɔ wo tan fama nɛ a igiride, na bɔxi fanyi findi wo gbe ra.

sentences.english: Take care that you do not let the agreement of the Lord your God, which he has made with you, go out of your mind, or make for yourselves images of any sort, against the orders which the Lord your God has given you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo ɲɛngi sa wo yɛtɛ xɔn ma alako wo naxa nɛɛmu wo Marigi Alatala xa saatɛ ma a naxan tongoxi wo bɛ. Wo naxa kuye yo yailan wo Marigi Alatala naxee ratɔnxi wo ma,

sentences.english: For the Lord your God is an all-burning fire, and he will not let the honour which is his be given to any other.
sentences.susu: barima wo Marigi Alatala luma alɔ tɛ naxan se kanama, a mu wama a firin boore xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: If, when you have had children and children's children, and have been living a long time in the land, you are turned to evil ways, and make an image of any sort, and do evil in the eyes of the Lord your God, moving him to wrath:
sentences.susu: «Wo na die nun mamadie sɔtɔ tɛmui naxɛ, wo na bu ki naxɛ bɔxi ma, xa wo kuye yailan se nde misaali ra, xa wo fe ɲaaxi raba wo Marigi Alatala ya i naxan mu rafan a ma,

sentences.english: May heaven and earth be my witnesses against you today, that destruction will quickly overtake you, cutting you off from that land which you are going over Jordan to take; your days will not be long in that land, but you will come to a complete end.
sentences.susu: koore nun bɔxi nan na won seede ra to lɔxɔɛ, wo fama nɛ faxade mafuren bɔxi ma naxan fama findide wo gbe ra Yurudɛn naakiri ma. Wo mu fama simaya sɔtɔde, wo halakima nɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord will send you wandering among the peoples; only a small band of you will be kept from death among the nations where the Lord will send you.
sentences.susu: Alatala wo rayensenma nɛ ɲamanɛe ma. Wo si fama nɛ xurunde ɲamae tagi Alatala na wo xanin dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: There you will be the servants of gods, made by men's hands, of wood and stone, having no power of seeing or hearing or taking food or smelling.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni wo fama kuyee nan batude, mixie naxee yailanxi wuri ra, xa na mu a ra gɛmɛ, kuye naxee mu nɔma se tode, e mu fe mɛma, e mu e dɛgema, e mu se xiri mɛma.

sentences.english: But if in those lands you are turned again to the Lord your God, searching for him with all your heart and soul, he will not keep himself from you.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni wo fama nɛ wo Marigi Alatala fende. Wo a toma nɛ xa wo a fen wo bɔɲɛ fanyi ra, wo ɲanige birin na.

sentences.english: When you are in trouble and all these things have come on you, if, in the future, you are turned again to the Lord your God, and give ear to his voice:
sentences.susu: Wo xa tɔɔrɛ kui na fe birin wo lima nɛ. Na tɛmui wo fama gbilende wo Marigi Alatala ma, wo a xui mɛma nɛ,

sentences.english: Because the Lord your God is a God of mercy, he will not take away his help from you or let destruction overtake you, or be false to the agreement which he made by an oath with your fathers.
sentences.susu: barima wo Marigi Alatala, Ala na a ra naxan kinikinima mixi ma, naxan mu wo rabɛɲinma, naxan mu wo halakima. A mu fama nɛɛmude saatɛ ma a rakali naxan na wo babae bɛ.»

sentences.english: Give thought now to the days which are past, before your time, from the day when God first gave life to man on the earth, and searching from one end of heaven to the other, see if such a great thing as this has ever been, or if anything like it has been talked of in story.
sentences.susu: «Wo wo maɲɔxun fe forie ma naxee bara dangi duniɲa ma kabi Ala adama daaxi tɛmui naxɛ. Fe kaabanakoe gbɛtɛ fan bara raba na xanbi ra? Nde bara na fe mɔɔli maniyɛ mɛ sinden?

sentences.english: Has any people ever gone on living after hearing the voice of God out of the heart of the fire as you did?
sentences.susu: Ɲama gbɛtɛ nde na na ba, naxee bara Ala xui mɛ tɛ tagi, a man fa simaya sɔtɔ alɔ naxan bara raba wo tan bɛ?

sentences.english: Has God ever before taken a nation for himself from out of another nation, by punishments and signs and wonders, by war and by a strong hand and a stretched-out arm and great acts of wonder and fear, as the Lord your God did for you in Egypt, before your very eyes?
sentences.susu: Ala mundun bara ɲama ba ɲama gbɛtɛ yi ra ɲaxankatɛ ra, tɔnxuma ra, kaabanakoe ra, gere belebele ra, fe magaaxuxie ra, alɔ wo Marigi Alatala naxan naba wo bɛ Misira bɔxi ma wo ya xɔri?»

sentences.english: All this he let you see, so that you might be certain that the Lord is God and there is no other.
sentences.susu: «Na bara fiixɛ wo bɛ alako wo xa la a ra a Alatala keren peti nan Ala ra, Ala gbɛtɛ yo mu na fo a keren.

sentences.english: Out of heaven itself his voice came to you, teaching you; and on earth he let you see his great fire; and his words came to your ears out of the heart of the fire.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xui ramini koore ma alako wo xa gaaxu a ya ra. A naxa tɛ belebele masen wo bɛ bɔxi fari, a wɔyɛn wo bɛ a tagi.

sentences.english: And because of his love for your fathers, he took their seed and made it his, and he himself, present among you, took you out of Egypt by his great power;
sentences.susu: A naxa wo babae xanu, a naxa e bɔnsɔɛ fan sugandi hali e dangi xanbi. Na nan a toxi a wo raminixi sɛnbɛ ra Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Driving out before you nations greater and stronger than you, to take you into their land and give it to you for your heritage, as at this day.
sentences.susu: A sie keri wo bɛ naxee sɛnbɛ gbo wo tan bɛ, a e xa bɔxi so wo yi ra kɛ ra alɔ wo a toxi ki naxɛ to.

sentences.english: So today be certain, and keep the knowledge deep in your hearts, that the Lord is God, in heaven on high and here on earth; there is no other God.
sentences.susu: Wo lan nɛ wo xa a kolon to lɔxɔɛ wo bɔɲɛ kui, a Alatala keren peti nan na Ala ra koore nun bɔxi ma. Ala gbɛtɛ mu na na fo a keren.

sentences.english: Then keep his laws and his orders which I give you today, so that it may be well for you and for your children after you, and that your lives may be long in the land which the Lord your God is giving you for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo a xa sɛriyɛ nun a xa yaamari rabatu, n naxan sofe wo yi ra to lɔxɔɛ, alako wo xa hɛɛri sɔtɔ wo tan nun wo bɔnsɔɛ, hali wo dangi xanbi, alako wo man xa simaya xɔnkuye sɔtɔ bɔxi ma wo Marigi Alatala dɛnnaxɛ fixi wo ma abadan.»

sentences.english: Then Moses had three towns marked out on the far side of Jordan looking to the east;
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa naxa taa saxan sugandi Yurudɛn sogetede biri.

sentences.english: To which anyone causing the death of his neighbour in error and not through hate, might go in flight; so that in one of these towns he might be kept from death:
sentences.susu: Nee naxa findi mixi ratanga taae ra faxatie bɛ naxee faxɛ tima, kɔnɔ e mu a ɲanigexi. Na faxɛti nɔma lude yi taa keren keren na ma kui alako a nii xa ratanga gbeɲɔxɔɛ ma.

sentences.english: The names of the towns were Bezer in the waste land, in the table-land, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for Manasseh.
sentences.susu: Na taae findi Beteseri nan na gbengberenyi ma geya fari, Rubenkae xɔnyi, Ramoti taa naxan na Galede, Gadikae xɔnyi, a nun Golan, taa naxan na Basan bɔxi ma Manasikae xɔnyi.

sentences.english: This is the law which Moses put before the children of Israel:
sentences.susu: Ala xa sɛriyɛ nan ya, Annabi Munsa naxan masenxi Isirayilakae bɛ.

sentences.english: These are the rules and the laws and the decisions which Moses gave to the children of Israel after they came out of Egypt;
sentences.susu: Masenyi, sɛriyɛ, nun yaamari nan ya, Annabi Munsa naxan fala Isirayilakae bɛ e nu minima Misira bɔxi ra tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: On the far side of Jordan, in the valley facing Beth-peor, in the land of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who was ruling in Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel overcame after they had come out of Egypt:
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, e nu na Yurudɛn naakiri nan ma, gulunba Beti Peyori ya tagi, Amorikae xa mangɛ Sixɔn xa bɔxi ma. Sixɔn nu sabatixi Xɛsibɔn nɛ. Annabi Munsa nun Isirayilakae to mini Misira bɔxi ma, e naxa nɔla sɔtɔ Sixɔn ma.

sentences.english: And they took his land for a heritage, and the land of Og, king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, whose lands were on the other side of Jordan to the east;
sentences.susu: E naxa a xa bɔxi rasuxu a yi ra, a nun Basan mangɛ Ogo xa bɔxi. Yi Amorikae xa mangɛ firinyie nu na Yurudɛn naakiri ma sogetede biri.

sentences.english: From Aroer on the edge of the valley of the Arnon as far as Mount Sion, which is Hermon,
sentences.susu: Yi taae nu sigaxi Aroweri han Arinon xure, sigafe ra Xerimon geya ma, naxan xili Siyon.

sentences.english: And all the Arabah on the far side of Jordan to the east, as far as the sea of the Arabah under the slopes of Pisgah.
sentences.susu: Yi taae nan nu Araba bɔxi ma Yurudɛn naakiri ma, sogetede biri, a sa dɔxɔ Araba baa ra Pisiga geya bun ma.

sentences.english: And Moses sent for all Israel, and said to them, Give ear, O Israel, to the laws and the decisions which I give you today, and give attention to them so that you may keep and do them.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa naxa Isirayila ɲama maxili, a naxa a fala e bɛ, «Isirayilakae, wo wo tuli mati yi sɛriyɛ nun yaamari ra, n naxan falafe wo bɛ to lɔxɔɛ. Wo lan wo xa a xaran, wo xa fɛntɛn a raba ki ma.

sentences.english: The Lord our God made an agreement with us in Horeb.
sentences.susu: Won Marigi Alatala bara saatɛ tongo won bɛ Xorebe geya fari.

sentences.english: The Lord did not make this agreement with our fathers but with us, who are all living and present here today.
sentences.susu: Alatala nun won babae xa mu yi saatɛ xirixi. A xirixi won tan nan birin tagi, won tan naxee na simaya kui yi waxati.

sentences.english: The word of the Lord came to you face to face on the mountain, out of the heart of the fire,
sentences.susu: Alatala wɔyɛn nɛ won bɛ ya nun ya tɛ tagi geya fari.

sentences.english: (I was between the Lord and you at that time, to make clear to you the word of the Lord: because, through fear of the fire, you did not go up the mountain;) saying,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n tan nan nu na wo nun Alatala tagi alako n xa Alatala xa masenyi ya xaran wo bɛ, barima wo nu gaaxuxi tɛ ya ra. Wo mu te geya fari. A naxa a masen wo bɛ,

sentences.english: I am the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt, out of the prison-house.
sentences.susu: ‹N tan nan na wo Marigi Alatala ra. N tan nan wo raminixi Misira, wo nu na konyiya kui dɛnnaxɛ.›»

sentences.english: You are to have no other gods but me.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa Ala gbɛtɛ batu fo n keren.»

sentences.english: You may not make for yourselves an image in the form of anything in heaven or on earth or in the waters under the earth:
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa kuye yailan misaali yo ra, se yo ra naxee na koore nun bɔxi ma, naxee na ye bun ma.

sentences.english: You may not go down on your faces before them or give them worship: for I, the Lord your God, am a God who will not give his honour to another; and I will send punishment on the children for the wrongdoing of their fathers, to the third and fourth generation of my haters;
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo igoro e bɛ de, wo naxa e batu de, barima n tan nan na wo Marigi Alatala ra, n mu wama n firin boore xɔn. Xa mixi nde n matandi, n na kanyi ɲaxankatama nɛ, a tan nun a bɔnsɔɛ han a sa dɔxɔ a tolobitɛe ra, xa na mu a ra a tolontolonyie ra naxee na n naɲaaxu.

sentences.english: And I will have mercy through a thousand generations on those who have love for me and keep my laws.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n fe fanyi rabama nɛ bɔnsɔɛ wulu bɛ n nafan naxee ma, naxee n ma sɛriyɛ rabatuma.»

sentences.english: You are not to make use of the name of the Lord your God for an evil purpose; whoever takes the Lord's name on his lips for an evil purpose will be judged as a sinner by the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa wo Marigi Alatala xili yelefu, barima Alatala mixi ɲaxankatama nɛ naxan na rabama.»

sentences.english: Keep the Sabbath day as a holy day, as you have been ordered by the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: «Wo lan nɛ wo xa fɛntɛn malabui lɔxɔɛ ma, wo xa a binya alɔ wo Marigi Alatala a yamarixi wo bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: On six days do all your work:
sentences.susu: Xi senni nan na wo bɛ lɔxɔxunyi kui wali lɔxɔɛe ra, wo xa wali birin nabafe ra.

sentences.english: But the seventh day is a Sabbath to the Lord your God; on that day do no work, you or your son or your daughter, or your man-servant or your woman-servant, or your ox or your ass or any of your cattle, or the man from a strange country who is living among you; so that your man-servant and your woman-servant may have rest as well as you.
sentences.susu: A xi solofere nde findixi wo Marigi Alatala xa malabui lɔxɔɛ nan na. Wo naxa wali yo raba na lɔxɔɛ keli wo tan ma, a sa wo xa die li, wo xa konyie, wo xa ningee, wo xa sofalee, wo xa xuruse mɔɔli birin, han a sa wo xa xɔɲɛe li naxee na wo xɔnyi, alako wo xa konyie fan xa e malabu alɔ wo tan.

sentences.english: And keep in mind that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the Lord your God took you out of that land by his strong hand and his stretched-out arm: for this reason the Lord has given you orders to keep the Sabbath day.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa nɛɛmu konyi nan nu wo ra Misira. N naxa wo ramini na konyiya kui, a keli n sɛnbɛ ma. N a falaxi wo bɛ na nan ma, wo xa malabui lɔxɔɛ binya.»

sentences.english: Give honour to your father and your mother, as you have been ordered by the Lord your God; so that your life may be long and all may be well for you in the land which the Lord your God is giving you.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa wo baba nun wo nga binya alɔ wo Marigi Alatala a yamarixi wo bɛ ki naxɛ, alako wo xa simaya xɔnkuye nun sɛɛwɛ sɔtɔ bɔxi ma wo Marigi Alatala naxan fima wo ma.»

sentences.english: Do not put anyone to death without cause.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa faxɛ ti.»

sentences.english: Do not be false to the married relation.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa yɛnɛ raba.»

sentences.english: Do not take the property of another.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa muɲɛ ti.»

sentences.english: Do not give false witness against your neighbour;
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa wule seedeɲɔxɔya raba wo boore xun.»

sentences.english: Or let your desire be turned to your neighbour's wife, or his house or his field or his man-servant or his woman-servant or his ox or his ass or anything which is your neighbour's.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa mila wo boore xa ginɛ ma, a xa banxi, a xa xɛ, a xa konyi, a xa ninge, a xa sofale, nun se naxan birin findixi a gbe ra.»

sentences.english: These words the Lord said to all of you together on the mountain, out of the heart of the fire, out of the cloud and the dark, with a great voice: and he said no more; he put them in writing on the two stones of the law and gave them to me.
sentences.susu: «Alatala yi fee nan masen wo xa malanyi kui, a xui itexi ra, geya fari, tɛ tagi, nuxui nun kunda tagi. A mu sese sa a xun ma. A naxa e sɛbɛ gɛmɛ walaxɛ firin ma, a e so n yi ra.»

sentences.english: And after hearing the voice which came out of the dark while the mountain was burning with fire, all the heads of your tribes and your chiefs came to me,
sentences.susu: «Wo yi xui mɛ kuye ifɔɔrɛ kui tɛmui naxɛ, tɛ tagi, geya fari, wo naxa wo maso n na, wo nun wo xa mangɛe nun kuntigie.

sentences.english: And said, The Lord has let us see his glory and his power, and his voice has come to us out of the fire: today we have seen that a man may go on living even after hearing the voice of God.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa a fala, ‹Muxu Marigi Alatala bara a xa nɔrɛ nun a xa gboe masen muxu bɛ. Muxu bara a xui mɛ wɔyɛn na tɛ tagi. Muxu bara a kolon to a Ala nɔma wɔyɛnde mixi bɛ, na kanyi man fa lu a mu faxa.

sentences.english: Why then is death to be our fate? For if the voice of the Lord our God comes to us any more, death will overtake us, and we will be burned up in this great fire.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, muxu fa muxu makɔrɛma faxɛ ra munfe ra? Yi tɛ muxu faxama nɛ. Xa muxu man muxu tuli mati won Marigi Alatala xui ra, muxu faxama nɛ.

sentences.english: For what man is there in all the earth, who, hearing the voice of the living God as we have, out of the heart of the fire, has been kept from death?
sentences.susu: Mixi mundun luxi alɔ won tan naxan bara Alatala xui mɛ a wɔyɛnma tɛ tagi, na kanyi man fa lu a mu faxa?

sentences.english: Do you go near: and after hearing everything which the Lord our God has to say, give us an account of all he has said to you, and we will give ear, and do it.
sentences.susu: I tan Munsa, i maso won Marigi Alatala ra, i xa i tuli mati a xa masenyi ra, alako i xa na madangi muxu bɛ, muxu muxu tuli matima nɛ i ra, muxu man fa a xui rabatu.›»

sentences.english: Then the Lord, hearing your words to me, said to me, The words which this people have said to you have come to my ears: what they have said is well said.
sentences.susu: «Alatala naxa wo xa wɔyɛnyi mɛ, wo naxan falaxi n bɛ. A naxa a masen n bɛ, ‹N bara ɲama fala xui mɛ. E naxan birin falaxi nɔndi na a ra.

sentences.english: If only they had such a heart in them at all times, so that they might go in fear of me and keep my orders and that it might be well for them and for their children for ever!
sentences.susu: Xa n ma fe gaaxui lu e bɔɲɛ ma tɛmui birin, e man naxa n ma yaamari rabatu, e tan nun e bɔnsɔɛ fama nɛ hɛɛri sɔtɔde abadan.

sentences.english: Now say to them, Go back to your tents.
sentences.susu: Siga i xa sa a fala e bɛ, e xa so e xa kiri banxie bun ma.

sentences.english: But as for you, keep your place here by me, and I will give you all the orders and the laws and the decisions which you are to make clear to them, so that they may do them in the land which I am giving them for their heritage.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan xa lu n fɛ ma be. N xa n ma sɛriyɛ nun yaamari birin masen i bɛ, i lan i xa e xaran naxan na, alako e xa nɔ na raɲɛrɛde bɔxi ma n fama dɛnnaxɛ fide e ma.›

sentences.english: Take care, then, to do whatever the Lord your God has given you orders to do; let there be no turning away to the right hand or to the left.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala naxan masenxi wo bɛ, wo xa wo tuli mati na ra, wo man xa a rabatu. Wo naxa siga kɔɔla ma, wo naxa siga yirefanyi ma.

sentences.english: Go on walking in the way ordered for you by the Lord your God, so that life may be yours and it may be well for you, and your days may be long in the land of your heritage.
sentences.susu: Wo xa bira yi kira fanyi nan fɔxɔ ra won Marigi Alatala naxan masenxi, alako wo naxa faxa, wo fa simaya xɔnkuye sɔtɔ sɛɛwɛ kui bɔxi ma wo fama dɛnnaxɛ sɔtɔde.»

sentences.english: Now these are the orders and the laws and the decisions which the Lord your God gave me for your teaching, so that you might do them in the land of your heritage to which you are going:
sentences.susu: «Sɛriyɛ, yaamari, nun masenyi nan yi ki, wo Marigi Alatala naxan soxi n yi ra alako n xa a xaran wo ra, wo xa nɔ a rabade bɔxi ma a fafe naxan fide wo ma.

sentences.english: So that living in the fear of the Lord your God, you may keep all his laws and his orders, which I give you: you and your son and your son's son, all the days of your life; and so that your life may be long.
sentences.susu: Wo xa gaaxu won Marigi Alatala ya ra. Wo xa simaya kui, wo tan, wo xa die, a nun wo xa mamadie, wo xa yi sɛriyɛ nun yi yaamari birin naba n naxan soxi wo yi ra, alako wo xa simaya xɔnkuye sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: So give ear, O Israel, and take care to do this; so that it may be well for you, and you may be greatly increased, as the Lord the God of your fathers has given you his word, in a land flowing with milk and honey.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae, wo wo ɲɛngi sa yi birin xɔn ma, wo man xa fɛntɛn a raba ki ma. Wo fama nɛ hɛɛri sɔtɔde, wo fama nɛ findide ɲama gbegbe ra yi bɔxi ma xiɲɛ nun kumi gbegbe na dɛnnaxɛ, alɔ wo benbae Marigi Alatala a falaxi wo bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Give ear, O Israel: the Lord our God is one Lord:
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae, wo wo tuli mati. Won Marigi Alatala keren peti na a ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord your God is to be loved with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your strength.
sentences.susu: Wo lan nɛ wo xa wo Marigi Alatala xanu wo bɔɲɛ fiixɛxi ra, wo nii ra, a nun wo sɛnbɛ birin na.

sentences.english: Keep these words, which I say to you this day, deep in your hearts;
sentences.susu: N yi masenyi naxan xaranxi wo bɛ yi ki, a xa lu wo bɔɲɛ ma.

sentences.english: Teaching them to your children with all care, talking of them when you are at rest in your house or walking by the way, when you go to sleep and when you get up.
sentences.susu: Wo fama nɛ a mabanbande wo xa die bɛ tɛmui birin, xa wo na banxi kui, xa wo na biyaasife, kɔɛ nun yanyi ra.

sentences.english: Let them be fixed as a sign on your hand, and marked on your brow;
sentences.susu: A xa xiri wo bɛlɛxɛ nun wo tigi ra tɔnxuma ra.

sentences.english: Have them lettered on the pillars of your houses and over the doors of your towns.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a sɛbɛ wo xa banxi nun wo xa naadɛ ma.»

sentences.english: And when the Lord your God has taken you into the land which he gave his oath to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, that he would give you; with great and fair towns which were not of your building;
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala na wo xanin tɛmui naxɛ bɔxi ma a na dɛnnaxɛ sofe wo yi ra, alɔ a rakali wo babae Iburahima, Isiyaga, a nun Yaxuba bɛ ki naxɛ, wo fama nɛ taa belebele tofanyie sɔtɔde wo mu naxee tixi,

sentences.english: And houses full of good things not stored up by you, and places for storing water which you did not make, and vine-gardens and olive-trees not of your planting; and you have taken food and are full;
sentences.susu: banxi rafexie harige mɔɔli birin na wo mu naxee fenxi, kɔlɔnyie wo mu naxee gexi, wɛni bilie nun oliwi bilie wo mu naxee sixi.

sentences.english: Then take care that you keep your hearts true to the Lord, who took you out of the land of Egypt, out of the prison-house.
sentences.susu: Wo na wo dɛge han wo naxa wasa tɛmui naxɛ, wo naxa nɛɛmu wo Marigi Alatala ma de, naxan wo raminixi konyiya kui Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Let the fear of the Lord your God be in your hearts, and be his servants, taking your oaths by his name.
sentences.susu: Wo xa gaaxu wo Marigi Alatala ya ra. Wo xa a keren nan batu. Wo xa wo kali a xili nan na.

sentences.english: Do not go after other gods, the gods of the peoples round about you;
sentences.susu: Wo naxa ala gbɛtɛe batu de, mixie naxee batuma wo rabilinyi,

sentences.english: For the Lord your God who is with you is a God who will not let his honour be given to another; or the wrath of the Lord will be burning against you, causing your destruction from the face of the earth.
sentences.susu: barima wo Marigi Alatala mu wama a firin nde xɔn. Xa na mu a ra a xɔnɔma nɛ wo ma, a man fa wo faxa.»

sentences.english: Do not put the Lord your God to the test as you did in Massah.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa wo Marigi Alatala mato de, alɔ wo naxan naba Masa.

sentences.english: Keep with care the orders of the Lord your God, and his rules and his laws which he has given you;
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo Marigi Alatala xa sɛriyɛ, a xa masenyi, nun a xa yaamari rabatu tinxinyi kui a naxan soxi wo yi ra.

sentences.english: And do what is upright and good in the eyes of the Lord your God, so that it may be well for you and you may go in and take for your heritage that good land from which the Lord undertook by an oath to your fathers,
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo ɲɛrɛ tinxinyi kira ra. Alatala wama fe naxan birin xɔn ma, wo lan wo xa na nan naba. Na tɛmui wo fama nɛ hɛɛri sɔtɔde, wo fa bɔxi fanyi sɔtɔ Alatala a kali naxan na wo babae bɛ.

sentences.english: To send out from before you all those who are against you.
sentences.susu: Wo wo yaxuie kerima nɛ alɔ Alatala a masenxi ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And when your son says to you in time to come, What is the reason for these rules and laws and decisions which the Lord our God has given you?
sentences.susu: «Wo xa die na wo maxɔrin tɛmui naxɛ, ‹Munse na yi masenyi, yi sɛriyɛ, nun yi yaamari ra, won Marigi Alatala naxan soxi won yi ra yi ki?›

sentences.english: Then you will say to your son, We were servants under Pharaoh's yoke in Egypt; and the Lord took us out of Egypt with a strong hand:
sentences.susu: Wo fama nɛ e yaabide, ‹Firawuna xa konyie nan nu muxu ra Misira bɔxi ma, Alatala fa muxu ramini naa a sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord did great signs and wonders against Egypt, and against Pharaoh and all his house, before our eyes:
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa tɔnxuma nun kaabanako belebele magaaxuxie raba muxu ya xɔri Misirakae ra, Firawuna nun a xa denbaya birin na.

sentences.english: And he took us out from that place, guiding us here to give us this land, as he said in his oath to our fathers.
sentences.susu: A muxu ramini nɛ Misira alako a xa muxu xanin bɔxi ma, a a kali dɛnnaxɛ xa fe ra won babae bɛ sofe ra won yi ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord gave us orders to keep all these laws, in the fear of the Lord our God, so that it might be well for us for ever, and that he might keep us from death, as he has done to this day.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala naxa muxu yaamari, a muxu xa yi sɛriyɛ birin nawali a rawali ki ma. Xa won gaaxu won Marigi Alatala ya ra, a hɛɛri nun simaya xɔnkuye fima nɛ won ma alɔ a na a rabafe ki naxɛ yakɔsi.

sentences.english: And it will be our righteousness if we take care to keep all this order before the Lord our God as he has given it to us.
sentences.susu: Xa won sa won Marigi Alatala xa yaamari birin nabatu alɔ a masenxi won bɛ ki naxɛ, na findima nɛ tinxinyi ra won bɛ.›»

sentences.english: When the Lord your God takes you into the land where you are going, which is to be your heritage, and has sent out the nations before you, the Hittites and the Girgashites and the Amorites and the Canaanites and the Perizzites and the Hivites and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and stronger than you;
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala na wo xanin bɔxi ma tɛmui naxɛ, a dɛnnaxɛ fima wo ma, a fama nɛ si solofere keride naxee findi Xitikae, Girigasakae, Amorikae, Kanaankae, Peresikae, Hiwikae nun Yebusukae ra, si solofere naxee sɛnbɛ gbo wo bɛ, e man wuya wo bɛ.

sentences.english: And when the Lord has given them up into your hands and you have overcome them, give them up to complete destruction: make no agreement with them, and have no mercy on them:
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala na e lu wo sagoe tɛmui naxɛ, wo xutu sɔtɔma nɛ e ma, wo e halaki. Wo naxa saatɛ xiri wo tagi, wo man naxa kinikini e ma.

sentences.english: Do not take wives or husbands from among them; do not give your daughters to their sons, or take their daughters for your sons.
sentences.susu: Wo nun e tan naxa futi malan de. Wo naxa wo xa di ginɛe fi e xa di xɛmɛe ma, wo naxa ginɛe fan fen e ra wo xa di xɛmɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: For through them your sons will be turned from me to the worship of other gods: and the Lord will be moved to wrath against you and send destruction on you quickly.
sentences.susu: Xa na mu a ra yi xɔɲɛe fama nɛ wo xa die ratantande, e xa ala gbɛtɛe batu. Alatala xɔnɔma nɛ wo ma na tɛmui, a man fa wo faxa mafurenyi ra.

sentences.english: But this is what you are to do to them: their altars are to be pulled down and their pillars broken, and their holy trees cut down and their images burned with fire.
sentences.susu: Kira nan yi ki wo lan wo xa mini naxan na yi mixie bɛ. Wo xa e xa sɛrɛxɛbadee a nun e xa gɛmɛ batuxie birin kana. Wo xa e xa Asera wuri masolixie bolon, wo xa e xa kuye birin gan.»

sentences.english: For you are a holy people to the Lord your God: marked out by the Lord your God to be his special people out of all the nations on the face of the earth.
sentences.susu: «Wo bara findi wo Marigi Alatala xa ɲama ra. Wo Marigi Alatala bara wo tan nan sugandi duniɲa ɲama tagi bɛndɛ fuɲi fari, alako wo xa findi a yɛtɛ yati gbe ra.

sentences.english: The Lord did not give you his love or take you for himself because you were more in number than any other people; for you were the smallest of the nations:
sentences.susu: Alatala mu wo sugandixi wo xa ɲama xasabi xa fe xa ra, barima wo xurun si birin bɛ.

sentences.english: But because of his love for you, and in order to keep his oath to your fathers, the Lord took you out with the strength of his hand, making you free from the prison-house and from the hand of Pharaoh, king of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Alatala wo tan nan sugandixi a xa xanunteya xa fe ra. A bara wa saatɛ rakamalife a naxan tongo wo benbae bɛ. Na nan a toxi a wo raminixi bɔxi ma a sɛnbɛ ra wo nu na konyiya kui dɛnnaxɛ. A naxa wo ba Firawuna yi ra, Misira mangɛ.

sentences.english: Be certain, then, that the Lord your God is God; whose faith and mercy are unchanging, who keeps his word through a thousand generations to those who have love for him and keep his laws;
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon wo Marigi Alatala, nan keren peti na Ala ra. Ala findixi Fonisire Mangɛ nan na naxan a xa saatɛ rakamalima, naxan hɛɛri gbegbe fima wo ma. A na rabama wo bɔnsɔɛe bɛ naxee fama wo xanbi ra, naxee a xanuma, e man a xa yaamarie rabatu.

sentences.english: Rewarding his haters to their face with destruction; he will have no mercy on his hater, but will give him open punishment.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a gbilenma nɛ mixie fɔxɔ ra naxee a xɔnma, a a xɔnnantee ralɔɛma nɛ keren na.

sentences.english: So keep the orders and the laws and the decisions which I give you today and do them.
sentences.susu: Wo xa fɛntɛn n ma yaamari nun n ma sɛriyɛ ma n naxan soxi wo yi ra to lɔxɔɛ.»

sentences.english: And it will be, that if you give attention to these decisions and keep and do them, then the Lord will keep his agreement with you and his mercy, as he said in his oath to your fathers.
sentences.susu: «Xa wo wo ɲɛngi sa yi yaamari xɔn ma, wo naxa fɛntɛn a ma, wo Marigi Alatala fama a xa saatɛ rakamalide, a hɛɛri fima nɛ wo ma alɔ a rakalixi wo benbae bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And he will give you his love, blessing you and increasing you: he will send his blessing on the offspring of your body and the fruit of your land, your grain and your wine and your oil, the increase of your cattle and the young of your flock, in the land which by his oath to your fathers he undertook to give you.
sentences.susu: A wo xanuma nɛ, a barakɛ sa wo xa fe, a man wo rawuya. A di gbegbe barife ragiri wo ma. Wo fa bɔxi daxamui fan sɔtɔde, mɛngi, wɛni nɛɛnɛ nun ture. A man fa wo xa ningee nun wo xa xurusee rawuya. A yi birin nabama nɛ bɔxi ma, a rakali naxan na wo babae bɛ sofe ra wo yi.

sentences.english: You will have greater blessings than any other people: no male or female among you or among your cattle will be without offspring.
sentences.susu: A wo barakama nɛ dangife si birin na. Dibaritare mu fama lude wo ya ma, xɛmɛ ba, ginɛ ba, xa na mu a ra xuruse.

sentences.english: And the Lord will take away from you all disease, and will not put on you any of the evil diseases of Egypt which you have seen, but will put them on your haters.
sentences.susu: Alatala wo ratangama nɛ fure dɔxɔɛ mɔɔli birin ma, a nun fe ɲaaxi birin ma wo naxee kolonxi Misira bɔxi ma. Kɔnɔ a yi fure rasanbama mixie nan ma naxee na wo raɲaaxu.

sentences.english: And you are to send destruction on all the peoples which the Lord your God gives into your hands; have no pity on them, and do not give worship to their gods; for that will be a cause of sin to you.
sentences.susu: Wo lan nɛ wo xa mixi birin faxa, wo Marigi Alatala naxee soma wo yi ra. Wo naxa kinikini e ma, wo man naxa e xa alae batu, alako e naxa wo ratantan.»

sentences.english: If you say in your hearts, These nations are greater in number than we are: how are we to take their land from them?
sentences.susu: «Wo fama a maɲɔxunde wo bɔɲɛ ma, ‹Yi sie gbo dangife won tan na. Won tan nɔla sɔtɔma nee ma di?›

sentences.english: Have no fear of them, but keep well in mind what the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ, wo naxa gaaxu e ya ra. Wo xa ratu wo Marigi Alatala naxan nabaxi Firawuna nun Misira bɔxi ra.

sentences.english: The great punishments which your eyes saw, and the signs and the wonders and the strong hand and the stretched-out arm, by which the Lord your God took you out: so will the Lord your God do to all the peoples who are the cause of your fears.
sentences.susu: Wo bara fe xɔrɔxɔɛe to naxee dɔxɔxi e ma, tɔnxumae nun kaabanakoe naxee rabaxi. Wo bara wo Marigi Alatala sɛnbɛ to a wo ramini ki naxɛ Misira bɔxi ma. Na nan a toma wo Marigi Alatala na mɔɔli rabama ɲamanɛ birin na wo gaaxuxi naxee ya ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord will send a hornet among them, till all the rest who have kept themselves safe from you in secret places have been cut off.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala fama nɛ wo yaxuie birin halakide, hali naxee nɔxunma wo ma.

sentences.english: Have no fear of them: for the Lord your God is with you, a great God greatly to be feared.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa gaaxu e ya ra, barima wo nun wo Marigi Alatala na a ra, Ala belebele naxan magaaxu.»

sentences.english: The Lord your God will send out the nations before you little by little; they are not to be rooted out quickly, for fear that the beasts of the field may be increased overmuch against you.
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala fama nɛ yi ɲama keride a xuri xuri ra wo ya i. Wo mu nɔma e birin faxade waxati keren bun, xa na mu a ra wula i subee fama nɛ wuyade, e wo tɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: But the Lord your God will give them up into your hands, overpowering them till their destruction is complete.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala fama nɛ yi mixie sode wo yi ra. E ifuma nɛ kira ma, han e sa halaki.

sentences.english: He will give their kings into your hands, and you will put their names out of existence under heaven; there is not one of them who will not give way before you, till their destruction is complete.
sentences.susu: A fama nɛ e xa mangɛe sode wo yi ra, wo e xili ralɔɛ. Mixi yo mu nɔma tide wo kanke. Wo e birin halakima nɛ.»

sentences.english: The images of their gods are to be burned with fire: have no desire for the gold and silver on them, and do not take it for yourselves, for it will be a danger to you: it is a thing disgusting to the Lord your God:
sentences.susu: «Wo e xa ala yailanxie ganma nɛ. Wo naxa mila e xa xɛɛma nun gbeti ma naxan na kuyee ma. Wo naxa na findi wo gbe ra alako a naxa findi wo fan bɛ gantanyi ra, barima fe nan na ki wo Marigi Alatala naxan naharamuxi.

sentences.english: And you may not take a disgusting thing into your house, and so become cursed with its curse: but keep yourselves from it, turning from it with fear and hate, for it is a cursed thing.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa na kuye mɔɔli ɲaaxi raso wo xa banxi kui de, alako wo naxa halaki alɔ kuyee. Wo nee findima se ɲaaxi nan na barima a raharamuxi.»

sentences.english: Take care to keep all the orders which I give you today, so that you may have life and be increased and go in and take as a heritage the land which the Lord, by his oath to your fathers, undertook to give you.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa yi yaamari birin naba n naxan xaranfe wo bɛ to lɔxɔɛ. Na nan fama a niyade wo xa simaya sɔtɔ, wo fa findi ɲama gbegbe ra. Na tɛmui, wo nɔma yi bɔxi sɔtɔde alɔ Alatala a rakalixi wo babae bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And keep in mind the way by which the Lord your God has taken you through the waste land these forty years, so that he might make low your pride and put you to the test, to see what was in your heart and if you would keep his orders or not.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo maɲɔxun ɲɛrɛ xɔnkuye ma wo Marigi Alatala naxan nagiri wo ma yi gbengberenyi igirife ra yi ɲɛ tongo naani bun ma. A yi fe xɔrɔxɔɛe rabaxi nɛ wo ra, alako wo xa wo yɛtɛ magoro, a xa wo mato, a xa nɔ a kolonde fe naxan na wo sondonmɛ ma. A man xa nɔ a kolonde xa wo wama a xa sɛriyɛ mabanbanfe.

sentences.english: And he made low your pride and let you be without food and gave you manna for your food, a thing new to you, which your fathers never saw; so that he might make it clear to you that bread is not man's only need, but his life is in every word which comes out of the mouth of the Lord.
sentences.susu: A bara wo xa fe magoro, a bara wo raxi kaamɛ ra. A bara mana so wo yi ra, wo nun wo benbae mu donse naxan kolon. A a masen wo bɛ na ki nɛ, a ibunadama mu nɔma balode donse xa kansan xun na, kɔnɔ masenyi fan birin na naxan fatanxi Alatala ra.

sentences.english: Through all these forty years your clothing did not get old or your feet become tired.
sentences.susu: Wo xa donmae mu ɲɔnxi, wo sanyie mu funtuxi yi ɲɛ tongo naani bun ma.

sentences.english: Keep in mind this thought, that as a son is trained by his father, so you have been trained by the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo lan nɛ wo xa a kolon a wo Marigi Alatala na wo xurufe nɛ alɔ baba a xa di xuruma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then keep the orders of the Lord your God, fearing him and walking in his ways.
sentences.susu: Wo wo Marigi Alatala xa yaamari mabanban, wo xa wo yɛtɛ suxu alɔ a wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ, wo man xa gaaxu a ya ra.»

sentences.english: For the Lord your God is guiding you into a good land, a land of water-springs, of fountains, and deep streams flowing out from the valleys and the hills;
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala wo rasoma nɛ bɔxi fanyi ma xuree nun dulonyie na dɛnnaxɛ. Ye gbegbe na na bɔxi bun ma, a man minima gulunba nun geya fari.

sentences.english: A land of grain and vines and fig-trees and fair fruits; a land of oil-giving olive-trees and honey;
sentences.susu: Bɔxi na a ra mɛngi, fundenyi maniyɛ, wɛni bili, xɔrɛ, kinkirinsi, oliwi, nun kumi na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Where there will be bread for you in full measure and you will be in need of nothing; a land where the very stones are iron and from whose hills you may get copper.
sentences.susu: Taami mu ɲɔnma sɔnɔn, se birin fama nɛ lude wo yi ra. Wure fama nɛ minide gɛmɛe kui, wure gbeeli fan sɔtɔma nɛ geya kui.»

sentences.english: And you will have food enough and be full, praising the Lord your God for the good land he has given you.
sentences.susu: «Wo na wo dɛge han wo naxa luga, wo xa wo Marigi Alatala tantu yi bɔxi fanyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Then take care that you are not turned away from the Lord your God and from keeping his orders and decisions and laws which I give you this day:
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo yɛtɛ ranɛɛmu wo Marigi Alatala xa fe ma de, tondife a xa yaamari nun a xa sɛriyɛ rabatufe ra, n naxan xaranxi wo bɛ to lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: And when you have taken food and are full, and have made fair houses for yourselves and are living in them;
sentences.susu: Wo na wo dɛge han wo naxa luga, wo na banxie ti, wo naxa sabati e kui,

sentences.english: And when your herds and your flocks are increased, and your stores of silver and gold, and you have wealth of every sort;
sentences.susu: wo xa xurusee xungbe nun a lanmae na wuya, wo xa gbeti nun wo xa xɛɛma na gbo, wo harige birin na gbo,

sentences.english: Take care that your hearts are not lifted up in pride, giving no thought to the Lord your God who took you out of the land of Egypt, out of the prison-house;
sentences.susu: wo xa fɛntɛn wo yɛtɛ ma a fanyi ra alako wo naxa wo yɛtɛ igbo han wo xa nɛɛmu wo Marigi Alatala ma, naxan wo raminixi Misira bɔxi ma konyiya kui.

sentences.english: Who was your guide through that great and cruel waste, where there were poison-snakes and scorpions and a dry land without water; who made water come out of the hard rock for you;
sentences.susu: A bara wo radangi gbengberen yire magaaxuxi ra, bɔximase xɔnɛ kanyi nun tali na dɛnnaxɛ, ye mu na bɔxi naxan ma. A naxa ye ramini fanye kui.

sentences.english: Who gave you manna for your food in the waste land, a food which your fathers had never seen; so that your pride might be broken and your hearts tested for your good in the end;
sentences.susu: A naxa mana donse so wo yi ra gbengberenyi ma, wo benbae mu nu naxan kolon, alako a xa wo xa fe magoro, a xa wo mato, a fa nɔ fe fanyi rabade wo bɛ.

sentences.english: Say not then, in your hearts, My power and the strength of my hands have got me this wealth.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa a maɲɔxun de a wo sɛnbɛ nun wo xa kɔɔta nan yi harige fixi wo ma.

sentences.english: But keep in mind the Lord your God: for it is he who gives you the power to get wealth, so that he may give effect to the agreement which he made by his oath with your fathers, as at this day.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo ratu wo Marigi Alatala ma, a tan nan yi sɛnbɛ fima wo ma, alako wo xa na harige birin sɔtɔ. A man bara saatɛ masen wo bɛ to lɔxɔɛ a naxan tongo a nun wo babae ra.»

sentences.english: And it is certain that if at any time you are turned away from the Lord your God, and go after other gods, to be their servants and to give them worship, destruction will overtake you.
sentences.susu: «Xa wo nɛɛmu wo Marigi Alatala ma, xa wo bira ala gbɛtɛe batufe fɔxɔ ra, xa wo tuubi e bɛ, xa wo wo magoro e bɛ, n xa a fala wo bɛ to lɔxɔɛ, wo halakima nɛ.

sentences.english: Like the nations which the Lord is cutting off before you, so you will be cut off; because you would not give ear to the voice of the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Iyo, wo halakima nɛ alɔ Alatala si gbɛtɛe halakixi ki naxɛ wo ya xɔri, barima wo mu wo tuli matixi wo Marigi Alatala xa masenyi ra.»

sentences.english: Give ear, O Israel: today you are to go over Jordan, to take the heritage of nations greater and stronger than yourselves, and towns of great size with walls as high as heaven;
sentences.susu: «Isirayilakae wo wo tuli mati. To lɔxɔɛ wo na sigafe Yurudɛn nan igiride. Wo fama nɛ sie ragide naxee gbo wo bɛ, e sɛnbɛ dangi wo ra. Wo fa e xa taae tongo naxee tɛtɛ itexi han.

sentences.english: A people great and tall, the sons of the Anakim, of whom you have knowledge and of whom it has been said, All are forced to give way before the sons of Anak.
sentences.susu: Wo fama Anaki xa die nan masɔtɔde, mixi sɛnbɛmae naxee gbangbalan, wo naxee kolon a fanyi ra. Wo bara a mɛ, e a falama, ‹Nde nɔma tide Anaki xa die ya i?›

sentences.english: Be certain then today that it is the Lord your God who goes over before you like an all-burning fire; he will send destruction on them, crushing them before you; and you will send them in flight, putting an end to them quickly, as the Lord has said.
sentences.susu: Wo nɔma a kolonde yakɔsi, a wo Marigi Alatala na a ɲɛrɛfe wo ya ra, alɔ tɛ naxan se birin kanama. A tan nan yati e halakima, a e xa fe magoro wo ya xɔri. Wo e kerima nɛ, wo e birin halakima nɛ alɔ wo Marigi Alatala a masenxi wo bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And after the Lord has sent them in flight from before you, say not in your heart, Because of my righteousness the Lord has given me this land; when it is because of their evil-doing that the Lord is driving these nations out before you.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala na e keri wo ya ra tɛmui naxɛ, wo naxa wo yɛtɛ matɔxɔ de han wo xa a fala, ‹Alatala na a xɛɛxi muxu yi bɔxi masɔtɔxi muxu xa tinxinyi saabui ra.› E xa fe kobi raba na a toxi Alatala e kerixi beenun wo xa be li.

sentences.english: Not for your righteousness or because your hearts are upright are you going in to take their land; but because of the evil-doing of these nations the Lord your God is driving them out from before you, and to give effect to his oath to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa a maɲɔxun de a wo be sɔtɔxi wo xa tinxinyi nun wo xa fanyi nan ma. Alatala yi sie kerima e xa yuge kobi nan ma, a man xa natɛ rakamali a naxan tongo wo babae Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Yaxuba bɛ.

sentences.english: Be certain then that the Lord your God is not giving you this good land as a reward for your righteousness; for you are a stiff-necked people.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon wo xa tinxinyi xa mu a niyaxi wo Marigi Alatala yi bɔxi fanyi soxi wo yi ra a xa findi wo gbe ra. Ɲama xurutare nan na wo ra.»

sentences.english: Keep well in mind how you made the Lord your God angry in the waste land; from the day when you went out of Egypt till you came to this place, you have gone against the orders of the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa wo ratu a ma wo wo Marigi Alatala raxɔnɔ ki naxɛ gbengberenyi ma. Wo naxa nɛɛmu wo keli lɔxɔɛ ma Misira, han wo so lɔxɔɛ be, wo nu xurutareɲa rabama nɛ wo Marigi Alatala ra.

sentences.english: Again in Horeb you made the Lord angry, and in his wrath he would have put an end to you.
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala raxɔnɔ nɛ Xorebe geya fari han a naxa wa wo faxafe.

sentences.english: When I had gone up into the mountain to be given the stones on which was recorded the agreement which the Lord made with you, I was on the mountain for forty days and forty nights without taking food or drinking water.
sentences.susu: N to te geya fari alako n xa walaxɛ gɛmɛ daaxi tongo naxan findi saatɛ ra Alatala nun won tan tagi, n naxa yanyi tongo naani nun kɔɛ tongo naani raba geya fari, n mu taami don, n mu ye fan min.

sentences.english: And the Lord gave me the two stones with writing on them done by the finger of God: on them were recorded all the words which the Lord said to you on the mountain out of the heart of the fire, on the day of the great meeting.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi walaxɛ gɛmɛ daaxi firinyie so n yi ra, a naxan sɛbɛ a xɔnyɛ ra. Alatala naxan fala wo bɛ tɛ tagi, wo nu malanxi lɔxɔɛ naxɛ geya fari, na birin sɛbɛxi walaxɛ ma.»

sentences.english: Then at the end of forty days and forty nights the Lord gave me those stones, the stones of the agreement.
sentences.susu: «Yi yanyi tongo naani nun yi kɔɛ tongo naani dangi xanbi, Alatala naxa yi walaxɛ gɛmɛ daaxi firinyi so n yi ra naxan findi saatɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to me, Get up now, and go down quickly from this place; for the people you have taken out of Egypt have given themselves over to evil; they have quickly been turned from the way in which I gave them orders to go; they have made themselves a metal image.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a fala n bɛ, ‹Keli, i xa goro mafuren barima i xa ɲama i naxan naminixi Misira bɔxi ra, e bara yangoe belebele raba, e bara e ba kira ma n naxan masen e bɛ, e bara kuye yailan wure raxunuxi ra.›

sentences.english: And then the Lord said to me, I have seen that this people is stiff-necked:
sentences.susu: Alatala man naxa yi masen n bɛ, ‹N bara a to yi ɲama, ɲama xurutare na a ra.

sentences.english: Let me send destruction on them till their very name is cut off; and I will make of you a nation greater and stronger than they.
sentences.susu: Keli be, n xa e halaki, n xa e xili ɲɔn duniɲa ma. N i mafindima ɲama gbegbe ra naxan sɛnbɛ gbo, e man wuya, dangi boore ɲama ra.›

sentences.english: So turning round I came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire; and the two stones of the agreement were in my hands.
sentences.susu: N naxa goro geya fari, naxan nu luxi alɔ a na tɛ nan tagi, na walaxɛ firinyie suxuxi n yi ra, Ala xa saatɛ sɛbɛxi naxee ma.

sentences.english: And I saw that you had done evil against the Lord, and had made for yourselves a metal image of a young ox: you had quickly been turned from the way in which the Lord had given you orders to go.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n naxa a to wo bara yunubi fe raba wo Marigi Alatala ra. Wo ninge yailan wure raxunuxi ra. Wo wo ba kira ma Alatala naxan masen wo bɛ.

sentences.english: And I let the stones go from my hands, and they were broken before your eyes.
sentences.susu: N naxa yi walaxɛ gɛmɛ daaxi firinyie suxu n bɛlɛxɛ firinyi ra, n fa e wɔlɛ, e naxa ibɔɔ wo ya xɔri.»

sentences.english: And I went down on my face before the Lord, as at the first, for forty days and forty nights, without taking food or drinking water, because of all your sin, in doing evil in the eyes of the Lord and moving him to wrath.
sentences.susu: «N naxa bira bɔxi Alatala ya i alɔ n naxan naba a singe. N naxa lu naa yanyi tongo naani nun kɔɛ tongo naani, n mu taami don, n mu ye fan min. N na birin naba wo xa yunubi nan ma fe ra, naxan naɲaaxuxi Alatala ma, a a raxɔnɔ.

sentences.english: For I was full of fear because of the wrath of the Lord which was burning against you, with your destruction in view. But again the Lord's ear was open to my prayer.
sentences.susu: N naxa gaaxu Alatala xa xɔnɛ ra a xɔnɔxi wo ma naxan ma han a wa wo halakife. Kɔnɔ Alatala man naxa n ma maxandi suxu.

sentences.english: And the Lord, in his wrath, would have put Aaron to death: and I made prayer for Aaron at the same time.
sentences.susu: A bɔɲɛ nu texi Haruna nan ma a gbe ra han a wa a halakife, kɔnɔ n naxa Ala maxandi Haruna fan bɛ.

sentences.english: And I took your sin, the image which you had made, and put it in the fire and had it hammered and crushed very small till it was only dust: and the dust I put in the stream flowing down from the mountain.
sentences.susu: N naxa ninge tongo wo naxan yailanxi, naxan findixi wo xa yunubi fe ra, n a woli tɛ xɔɔra, n a iwuru han a findi xube ra. N naxa na xube ibagan susui ye xɔɔra naxan kelima geya kɔn na.»

sentences.english: Again at Taberah and at Massah and at Kibroth-hattaavah you made the Lord angry.
sentences.susu: «Wo man bara Alatala raxɔnɔ Tabera, Masa, nun Kibiroti Hataawa.

sentences.english: And when the Lord sent you from Kadesh-barnea, saying, Go up and take the land which I have given you; you went against the orders of the Lord your God, and had no faith in him, and would not give ear to his voice.
sentences.susu: Alatala to wo xɛɛ kelife Kadesi Barineya yi xɛɛraya ra, ‹Wo siga, wo xa bɔxi tongo n naxan soxi wo yi ra,› wo naxa wo Marigi Alatala xui matandi. Wo mu la a fala xui ra, wo mu na fan suxu nɔndi ra.

sentences.english: From the day when I first had knowledge of you, you have gone against the word of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kabi n naxa sa wo kolon, wo xurutare fe nan tun nabafe Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: So I went down on my face in prayer before the Lord for forty days and forty nights as I did at first; because the Lord had said that he would put an end to you.
sentences.susu: «Alatala to wa wo faxafe, n naxa n felen bɔxi ma, n a maxandi yanyi tongo naani nun kɔɛ tongo naani bun ma.

sentences.english: And I made prayer to the Lord and said, O Lord God, do not send destruction on your people and your heritage, to whom, by your great power, you have given salvation, whom you have taken out of Egypt by the strength of your hand.
sentences.susu: N naxa Alatala maxandi, ‹Marigi Alatala, i naxa i yɛtɛ xa ɲama halaki, i ɲama naxan xa xɔrɛya soxi a yi i xa gboe saabui ra, i naxan naminixi Misira bɔxi ma i sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: Keep in mind your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, not looking at the hard heart of this people, or their evil-doing and their sin:
sentences.susu: I ratu i xa konyie ma, Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Yaxuba. I naxa i kobe rato yi ɲama xa xaxili xɔrɔxɔya ma, e xa ɲaaxui, nun e xa yunubi ma,

sentences.english: Or it may be said in the land from which you have taken them, Because the Lord was not able to take them into the land which he said he would give them, and because of his hate for them, he has taken them out to put them to death in the waste land.
sentences.susu: alako Misirakae naxa a fala, «Alatala mu nɔma yi mixie xaninde bɔxi ma a dɛnnaxɛ laayidi tongoxi e bɛ. A e xɔnxi nɛ. A e ramini alako a xa sa e faxa gbengberenyi ma.» ›

sentences.english: But still they are your people and your heritage, whom you took out by your great power and by your stretched-out arm.
sentences.susu: Alatala i xa ɲama nan lanxi e ma. I gbe nan na e ra, i naxee xɔrɛyaxi i sɛnbɛ nun i xa mangɛya ra.»

sentences.english: At that time the Lord said to me, Make two other stones, cut like the first two, and come up to me on the mountain, and make an ark of wood.
sentences.susu: «Na tɛmui Alatala naxa yaamari fi n ma. A naxɛ, ‹Walaxɛ gɛmɛ daaxi firin yailan alɔ a singee nu ki naxɛ. I man xa kankira wuri daaxi yailan. Na tɛmui i xa fa n yire geya fari.

sentences.english: And I will put on the stones the words which were on the first stones which were broken by you, and you are to put them into the ark.
sentences.susu: N man gbilenma nɛ yi sɛriyɛ sɛbɛ ra naxan nu na boore walaxɛe ma, i naxee kanaxi. I fama e sade na kankira nan kui.›

sentences.english: So I made an ark of hard wood, and had two stones cut like the others, and went up the mountain with the stones in my hands.
sentences.susu: N naxa kankira yailan wuri mɔɔli nde ra naxan xɔrɔxɔ. N naxa walaxɛ gɛmɛ daaxi firin fan yailan naxan maniya booree ra. N naxa te e ra geya fari.

sentences.english: And he put on the stones, as in the first writing, the ten rules which the Lord gave you on the mountain out of the fire on the day of the great meeting: and the Lord gave the stones to me.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa sɛbɛli ti yi walaxɛ nɛɛnɛe ma, alɔ naxan singe nu sɛbɛxi booree ma. Yi yaamari fu, a naxee yaxaran wo bɛ geya fari tɛ tagi wo nu malanxi tɛmui naxɛ, Alatala naxa e so n yi ra.

sentences.english: And turning round I came down from the mountain and put the stones in the ark which I had made; and there they are as the Lord gave me orders.
sentences.susu: N naxa goro geya fari, n fa e sa kankira kui, n naxan yailanxi. E naxa lu naa alɔ Alatala a fala n bɛ ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: (And the children of Israel went on from Beeroth Bene-jaakan to Moserah: there death came to Aaron and he was put to rest in the earth; and Eleazar, his son, took his place as priest.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa keli Bene Yakan kɔlɔnyie ra sigafe ra Mosera. Haruna laaxira mɛnni nɛ, a naxa bɛndɛ sɔtɔ naa. A xa di Eleyasari naxa findi a ɲɔxɔɛ ra sɛrɛxɛdubɛɲa kui.

sentences.english: From there they went on to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of streams of water.
