sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi Isirayilakae naxa siga Gudugoda. E to keli Gudugoda, e naxa siga Yotobata, xure gbegbe na bɔxi naxan ma.

sentences.english: At that time the Lord had the tribe of Levi marked out to take up the ark of the Lord's agreement, to be before the Lord and to do his work and to give blessings in his name, to this day.
sentences.susu: Na waxati bun ma, Alatala naxa wali taxu Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ra, e xa findi kankira xaninyie ra, e xa ti Alatala ya i a xa wali rabafe ma, e man xa duba ɲama bɛ Alatala xili ra. Na nan nabafe han to lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: For this reason Levi has no part or heritage for himself among his brothers: the Lord is his heritage, as the Lord your God said to him.)
sentences.susu: Na fe na a toxi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mu kɛ sɔtɔxi e ngaxakerenyie ya ma. Alatala nan na e tan malima ra alɔ a a fala ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And I was in the mountain, as at the first time, for forty days and forty nights; and again the ears of the Lord were open to my prayer, and he did not send destruction on you.
sentences.susu: «N naxa lu geya fari yanyi tongo naani nun kɔɛ tongo naani alɔ n naxan naba singe ra. Alatala man naxa n ma maxandi suxu, barima a mu waxi wo faxafe.

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to me, Get up and go on your journey before the people, so that they may go in and take the land which I said in my oath to their fathers that I would give them.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, ‹Ɲama raɲɛrɛ. E xa so bɔxi ma n nan nakalixi naxan na e babae bɛ sofe ra e yi.›»

sentences.english: And now, Israel, what would the Lord your God have you do, but to go in the fear of the Lord your God, walking in all his ways and loving him and doing his pleasure with all your heart and all your soul,
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi fa, Isirayilakae wo Marigi Alatala wama wo xa munse raba? A wama nɛ wo xa gaaxu a ya ra alako wo xa wo ɲɛrɛ a xa kira xɔn ma, wo xa a xanu, wo xa a rabatu wo bɔɲɛ fiixɛ nun wo nii birin na.

sentences.english: Doing the orders of the Lord and keeping his laws which I give you this day for your good?
sentences.susu: Alatala wama nɛ wo xa a xa yaamari raba, wo xa a xa sɛriyɛ rabatu, n naxan soxi wo yi ra to lɔxɔɛ, alako wo xa simaya xa fan.

sentences.english: The Lord your God is ruler of heaven, of the heaven of heavens, and of the earth with everything in it.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala nan gbe na koore nun bɔxi ra, a nun se naxan birin na a ma.

sentences.english: But the Lord had delight in your fathers and love for them, marking out for himself their seed after them, even you, from all peoples, as at this day.
sentences.susu: Alatala wo babae nan xanu. Yakɔsi fa wo tan nan na e bɔnsɔɛ ra, a wo tan nan sugandixi boore sie tagi, alɔ wo a toxi ki naxɛ to lɔxɔɛ.»

sentences.english: Let your circumcision be of the heart, and put away your pride.
sentences.susu: «Wo lan nɛ wo xa wo xaxili rasɛniyɛn, wo naxa xurutareɲa raba sɔnɔn,

sentences.english: For the Lord your God is God of gods and Lord of lords, the great God, strong in power and greatly to be feared, who has no respect for any man's position and takes no rewards:
sentences.susu: barima wo Marigi Alatala keren peti nan na Ala ra, mangɛe xa mangɛ, Ala belebele sɛnbɛma magaaxuxi, naxan mu mixi rafisa a boore bɛ, naxan mu kiiti ɲaaxi kɔbiri rasuxuma.

sentences.english: Judging uprightly in the cause of the widow and of the child who has no father, and giving food and clothing in his mercy to the man from a strange country.
sentences.susu: A tan nan kiridie nun kaaɲɛ ginɛe kantama ra. Xɔɲɛe rafan a ma, a donse nun sose soma e yi ra.

sentences.english: So be kind to the man from a strange country who is living among you, for you yourselves were living in a strange country in the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Wo tan fan, wo hinnɛ xɔɲɛe ra naxee na wo ya ma. Wo xa wo maɲɔxun xɔɲɛ nan nu na wo tan fan na Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Let the fear of the Lord your God be before you, give him worship and be true to him at all times, taking your oaths in his name.
sentences.susu: Wo xa gaaxu wo Marigi Alatala ya ra, wo xa tuubi a bɛ, wo xa bira a fɔxɔ ra, wo man xa wo rakali a tan nan xili ra.

sentences.english: He is your God, the God of your praise, your God who has done for you all these works of power which your eyes have seen.
sentences.susu: A tan nan na wo xa nɔrɛ ra. A tan nan na wo Marigi Ala ra, naxan kaabanakoe nun fe magaaxuxie rabaxi wo ya xɔri.

sentences.english: Your fathers went down into Egypt with seventy persons; and now the Lord your God has made you like the stars of heaven in number.
sentences.susu: Wo babae nu fama tɛmui naxɛ Misira, e mu nu dangixi mixi tongo solofere ra. Yakɔsi wo Marigi Alatala bara wo rawuya dangi tunbuie ra naxee na koore ma.»

sentences.english: So have love for the Lord your God, and give him worship, and keep his laws and his decisions and his orders at all times.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo Marigi Alatala xanu, wo tuubi a bɛ, wo xa a xa yaamari, a xa sɛriyɛ, a xa masenyi, nun a xa tɔnyi rabatu tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: And be certain in your minds this day; for these words are not said to your children, who have had no experience of the training of the Lord your God, and who have not seen his great power or his strong hand and his stretched-out arm,
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon to lɔxɔɛ wo xa die mu Alatala xa kaabanako magaaxuxie toxi e ya ra. E mu wo Marigi Alatala xa sɛriyɛ mɛxi e tuli ra.

sentences.english: Or his signs and wonders which he did in Egypt, to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and all his land;
sentences.susu: E mu a xa laamatunyie toxi Misira, a nun a naxan nabaxi Firawuna nun a xa bɔxi birin na.

sentences.english: And what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses and their war-carriages; how he made the waters of the Red Sea come up over them when they went after you, and how the Lord put an end to them even to this day;
sentences.susu: E man mu fe toxi a naxan nabaxi Misira sɔɔrie ra, e xa soe nun gisee ra. E mu a to Ala Misira sɔɔrie madulaxi Kale Baa ma ki naxɛ, e to bira wo fɔxɔ ra, Alatala fa e birin halaki kerenyi ra.

sentences.english: And what he did for you in the waste land, till you came to this place;
sentences.susu: E man mu fee toxi a naxee raba gbengberenyi ma beenun wo xa be li.

sentences.english: And what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben; when they went down into the open mouth of the earth, with their families and their tents and every living thing which was theirs, before the eyes of all Israel:
sentences.susu: A naxa wo ratanga Datan nun Abirami ma, naxee findi Eliyabi xa di xɛmɛe ra Ruben bɔnsɔɛ ya ma. Isirayilakae birin ya xɔri, bɔxi naxa a rabi, a fa a raxutu e nun e xa denbayae birin ma, e xa kiri banxie, nun mixi birin ma naxee nu biraxi e fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: But your eyes have seen all the great works of the Lord which he has done.
sentences.susu: Wo tan nan yati bara fe belebelee to Alatala naxee rabaxi.

sentences.english: So keep all the orders which I give you today, so that you may be strong, and go in and take the land which is to be your heritage;
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, wo lan wo xa yi sɛriyɛ rabatu n naxan xaranfe wo bɛ to lɔxɔɛ, alako wo xa limaniya sɔtɔ yi bɔxi masɔtɔfe ra wo na sigafe dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And that your days may be long in the land which the Lord gave by an oath to your fathers and to their seed after them, a land flowing with milk and honey.
sentences.susu: Wo xa yi raba alako wo xa bu bɔxi ma Alatala a kalixi naxan xa fe ra, a sofe ra wo babae nun e bɔnsɔɛe yi, xiɲɛ nun kumi gbegbe na bɔxi naxan ma.

sentences.english: For the land where you are going is not like the land of Egypt from which you have come, where you put in your seeds, watering them with your foot, like a planted garden:
sentences.susu: Wo fama bɔxi naxan sɔtɔde, a mu luxi alɔ Misira bɔxi, wo kelixi dɛnnaxɛ. Misira tan, wo na gɛ xɛ sade, fo wo nu ye maxanin a ma laakɔɛ daaxi wo sanyi ra.

sentences.english: But the land where you are going is a land of hills and valleys, drinking in the rain of heaven:
sentences.susu: Wo fama bɔxi naxan sɔtɔde, geya nun gulunba yire na a ra, tunɛ ye naxan nafanma a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: A land cared for by the Lord your God: the eyes of the Lord your God are on it at all times from one end of the year to the other.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi na a ra wo Marigi Alatala ɲɛngi saxi naxan xɔn. A man fa mɛɛni a ma, keli ɲɛ fɔlɛ han ɲɛ ɲɔnyi.

sentences.english: And it will be that if you truly give ear to the orders which I put before you this day, loving the Lord your God and worshipping him with all your heart and all your soul,
sentences.susu: Xa wo yi sɛriyɛ ratinmɛ a fanyi ra n naxan xaranxi wo bɛ yi ki to lɔxɔɛ, xa wo wo Marigi Alatala xanu, wo a xa sɛriyɛ raba bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra nun wo nii ra,

sentences.english: Then I will send rain on your land at the right time, the early rains and the late rains, so that you may get in your grain and your wine and your oil.
sentences.susu: a tunɛ rafama nɛ wo xa bɔxi ma, ɲɛmɛ a nun sogofure, alako wo xa harige fanyi sɔtɔ, alɔ mɛngi, wɛni nɛɛnɛ, a nun ture.

sentences.english: And I will give grass in your fields for your cattle, so that you may have food in full measure.
sentences.susu: A man ɲooge fan nafanma nɛ wo xa bɔxi ma wo xa xurusee naxan donma. Wo baloe gbegbe sɔtɔma nɛ, wo a don han wo luga.

sentences.english: But take care that your hearts are not turned to false ways so that you become servants and worshippers of other gods;
sentences.susu: Wo xa fe mɔɔli birin naba alako fefe yo naxa wo ba yi kira fanyi xɔn ma. Wo naxa wo igoro ala gbɛtɛe batufe ra.

sentences.english: For if you do so, the wrath of the Lord will be burning against you, and the heaven will be shut up so that there is no rain and the land will give no fruit; and in a very little time you will be cut off from the good land which the Lord is giving you.
sentences.susu: Xa wo na fe mɔɔli raba, Alatala xɔnɔma nɛ wo ma. Na tɛmui a a niyama nɛ tunɛ mu fa sɔnɔn, sansi yo mu fanma bɔxi ma sɔnɔn, wo fa halaki yi bɔxi ma Alatala naxan soxi wo yi ra.

sentences.english: So keep these words deep in your heart and in your soul, and have them fixed on your hand for a sign and marked on your brow;
sentences.susu: Wo xa yi sɛriyɛ rasabati wo bɔɲɛ ma nun wo nii ra. Wo nde xiri wo bɛlɛxɛ nun wo tigi ra tɔnxuma ra, alako wo naxa nɛɛmu a ra.

sentences.english: Teaching them to your children, and talking of them when you are at rest in your house or walking by the way, when you go to sleep and when you get up:
sentences.susu: Wo xa a xaran wo xa die ra wo xa banxie kui, wo xa biyaasie kui, wo sa tɛmui, wo keli tɛmui.

sentences.english: Writing them on the pillars of your houses and over the doors of your towns:
sentences.susu: Wo xa a sɛbɛ wo xa banxie nun wo xa naadɛe ma.

sentences.english: So that your days, and the days of your children, may be long in the land which the Lord by his oath to your fathers said he would give them, like the days of the eternal heavens.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toma wo xa simaya nun wo xa die xa simaya xɔn kuyama bɔxi ma Alatala naxan laayidixi wo benbae bɛ han duniɲa raɲɔnyi.

sentences.english: For if you take care to keep all the orders which I give you, and to do them; loving the Lord your God and walking in all his ways and being true to him:
sentences.susu: Xa wo yi sɛriyɛ rabatu a rabatu ki ma, n naxan xaranxi wo bɛ, xa wo wo Marigi Alatala xanu, xa wo wo ɲɛrɛ a xa kira xɔn ma, xa wo bira a fɔxɔ ra,

sentences.english: Then the Lord will send these nations in flight before you, and you will take the lands of nations greater and stronger than yourselves.
sentences.susu: Alatala fama nɛ yi sie birin keride wo ya xɔri, wo fa nɔ e ra, naxee gbangbalan wo bɛ, naxee sɛnbɛ gbo wo bɛ.

sentences.english: Every place where you put your foot will be yours: from the waste land and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates as far as the Great Sea, will be the limits of your land.
sentences.susu: Wo na wo sanyi ti dɛnnaxɛ birin ma, naa findima wo gbe nan na. Wo xa bɔxi italama keli gbengberenyi ma han Liban, keli Efirati xure ma han Mediteran Baa ra.

sentences.english: All people will give way before you: for the Lord your God will put the fear of you on all the land through which you go, as he has said.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu suusama tide wo ya ra. Wo na siga bɔxi naxan yo ma, wo Marigi Alatala a niyama nɛ mɛnnikae xa gaaxu wo ya ra, e bɔɲɛ mini alɔ a masenxi wo bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Today I put before you a blessing and a curse:
sentences.susu: Wo a mato, n bara barakɛ nun dankɛ sa wo ya i to.

sentences.english: The blessing if you give ear to the orders of the Lord your God, which I give you this day:
sentences.susu: Xa wo wo Marigi Alatala xa sɛriyɛ rabatu a rabatu ki ma, n naxan soxi wo yi ra to, wo barakɛ sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: And the curse if you do not give ear to the orders of the Lord your God, but let yourselves be turned from the way which I have put before you this day, and go after other gods which are not yours.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa wo mu wo Marigi Alatala xa sɛriyɛ ratinmɛ, xa wo wo ba kira xɔn ma n naxan soxi wo yi ra to, xa wo bira ala gbɛtɛe fɔxɔ ra wo mu naxee kolon, wo dankɛ nan sɔtɔma.

sentences.english: And when the Lord your God has taken you into the land of your heritage, you are to put the blessing on Mount Gerizim and the curse on Mount Ebal.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala na wo xanin bɔxi ma a fama naxan sode wo yi ra, wo dubɛ masenyi tima Garisimi geya nan fari, wo dankɛ masenyi tima Ebali geya nan fari.

sentences.english: Are they not on the other side of Jordan, looking west, in the land of the Canaanites living in the Arabah, opposite Gilgal, by the holy tree of Moreh?
sentences.susu: Na geyae na Yurudɛn naakiri nan ma, kira xanbi ra naxan na sogegorode, Kanaankae xa bɔxi ma naxee sabatixi Araba, Giligali ya tagi, More wuri belebele fɛ ma.

sentences.english: For you are about to go over Jordan to take the heritage which the Lord your God is giving you, and it will be your resting-place.
sentences.susu: Wo na Yurudɛn igiri sigafe ra bɔxi ma wo Marigi Alatala dɛnnaxɛ sofe wo yi ra, mɛnni findima wo gbe nan na, wo man fa sabati naa.

sentences.english: And you are to take care to keep all the laws and the decisions which I put before you today.
sentences.susu: Wo lan nɛ wo xa fɛntɛn yi sɛriyɛ nun yi yaamarie ma, n naxee soxi wo yi ra to lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: These are the laws and the decisions which you are to keep with care in the land which the Lord, the God of your fathers, has given you to be your heritage all the days of your life on earth.
sentences.susu: Wo xa yi sɛriyɛ nun yaamarie rabatu bɔxi ma, wo babae Marigi Alatala dɛnnaxɛ sofe wo yi ra.

sentences.english: You are to give up to the curse all those places where the nations, whom you are driving out, gave worship to their gods, on the high mountains and the hills and under every green tree:
sentences.susu: Wo xa yire birin kana geyae fari nun fɔtɔnyie kui, yi sie kuyee batuma dɛnnaxɛ. Wo fama yi sie keride.

sentences.english: Their altars and their pillars are to be broken down, and their holy trees burned with fire, and the images of their gods cut down; you are to take away their names out of that place.
sentences.susu: Wo xa e xa sɛrɛxɛbadee kana, wo xa e xa gɛmɛ tɔnxumae kana, wo xa e xa Aseri wuri masolixie gan, wo xa e xa kuyee rabira, wo xa e xilie ɲɔn naa.

sentences.english: Do not so to the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo Marigi Alatala batu na mɔɔli ra de.

sentences.english: But let your hearts be turned to the place which will be marked out by the Lord your God, among your tribes, to put his name there;
sentences.susu: Wo xa Alatala fen yire nde a dɛnnaxɛ sugandima wo bɔnsɔɛ ya ma. Na findima Ala xa yire nan na, a xili matɔxɔma dɛnnaxɛ. Wo xa siga mɛnni

sentences.english: And there you are to take your burned offerings and other offerings, and the tenth part of your goods, and the offerings to be lifted up to the Lord, and the offerings of your oaths, and those which you give freely from the impulse of your hearts, and the first births among your herds and your flocks;
sentences.susu: wo xa sɛrɛxɛe mɔɔli birin bade, alɔ sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie, sɛrɛxɛ naxee mu ganma, farilɛe, hadiyae, sɛrɛxɛ naxee bama alako wo waxɔnfe xa raba, ɲanige sɛrɛxɛe, nun xuruse di singee.

sentences.english: There you and all your families are to make a feast before the Lord your God, with joy in everything to which you put your hand, because the Lord has given you his blessing.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo xa sɛrɛxɛe don mɛnni, wo tan nun wo xa denbayae. Wo xa ɲɛlɛxin harige ra, wo Marigi Alatala naxan fixi wo ma.

sentences.english: You are not to do things then in the way in which we now do them here, every man as it seems right to him:
sentences.susu: A mu lanma kankan xa a yɛtɛ waxɔnfe raba, alɔ wo a rabafe ki naxɛ yakɔsi,

sentences.english: For you have not come to the rest and the heritage which the Lord your God is giving you.
sentences.susu: wo to mu so bɔxi ma, wo Marigi Alatala dɛnnaxɛ fima wo ma malabude ra.

sentences.english: But when you have gone over Jordan and are living in the land which the Lord your God is giving you as your heritage, and when he has given you rest from all those on every side who are fighting against you, and you are living there safely;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo na Yurudɛn igiri, wo na sabati bɔxi ma wo Marigi Alatala dɛnnaxɛ fima wo ma, a fama nɛ wo ratangade wo yaxuie birin ma naxee na wo rabilinyi, wo fa sabati naa bɔɲɛsa kui.

sentences.english: Then there will be a place marked out by the Lord your God as the resting-place for his name, and there you will take all the things which I give you orders to take: your burned offerings and other offerings, and the tenth part of your goods, and the offerings to be lifted up, and the offerings of your oaths which you make to the Lord;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, mɛnni findima wo Marigi Alatala xa yire sugandixi nan na, a xili matɔxɔma dɛnnaxɛ. Wo xa wo xa sɛrɛxɛe ba mɛnni nɛ, n naxee yamarixi wo ra, alɔ sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie, sɛrɛxɛ naxee mu ganma, farilɛe, hadiyae, a nun sɛrɛxɛ naxee bama alako wo waxɔnfe xa raba.

sentences.english: And you will be glad before the Lord your God, you and your sons and your daughters, and your men-servants and your women-servants, and the Levite who is with you in your house, because he has no part or heritage among you.
sentences.susu: Wo ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ wo Marigi Alatala ra, wo tan, wo xa die, wo xa konyie nun Lewi xa die naxee na wo ya ma barima bɔxi mu na e tan bɛ naxan findi e kɛ ra.

sentences.english: Take care that you do not make your burned offerings in any place you see:
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie ba wo waxɔnde.

sentences.english: But in the place marked out by the Lord in one of your tribes, there let your burned offerings be offered, and there do what I have given you orders to do.
sentences.susu: Wo e bama yire nɛ wo Marigi Alatala dɛnnaxɛ sugandima wo bɔnsɔɛ ya ma. N naxan birin yamarixi wo ra, wo xa a birin naba mɛnni.

sentences.english: Only you may put to death animals, such as the gazelle or the roe, for your food in any of your towns, at the desire of your soul, in keeping with the blessing of the Lord your God which he has given you: the unclean and the clean may take of it.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i nɔma sube don daaxi faxade, Ala naxan fixi i ma, yire birin i na sabati dɛnnaxɛ. Mixi sɛniyɛnxi nun mixi sɛniyɛntare nɔma a donde, alɔ xeli nun tɔɔkɛ.

sentences.english: But you may not take the blood for food, it is to be drained out on the earth like water.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo mu lan wo xa sube wuli min, wo xa a ifili bɔxi ma alɔ ye.

sentences.english: In your towns you are not to take as food the tenth part of your grain, or of your wine or your oil, or the first births of your herds or of your flocks, or anything offered under an oath, or freely offered to the Lord, or given as a lifted offering;
sentences.susu: Wo mu lan wo xa mɛngi, wɛni nɛɛnɛ, nun ture don wo xɔnyi, naxee findima wo xa farilɛ ra Alatala bɛ. Wo mu lan wo xa wo xa xuruse di singee fan don wo xɔnyi, wo naxee bama sɛrɛxɛ ra Alatala bɛ, sɛrɛxɛ naxee bama alako wo waxɔnfe xa raba wo bɛ, nun wo xa ɲanige sɛrɛxɛe. Wo mu lan wo xa wo xa bogi singee fan don wo xɔnyi, wo naxee bama sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: But they will be your food before the Lord your God in the place of his selection, where you may make a feast of them, with your son and your daughter, and your man-servant and your woman-servant, and the Levite who is living with you: and you will have joy before the Lord your God in everything to which you put your hand.
sentences.susu: Wo lan wo xa na see birin don wo Marigi Alatala nan ya i a xa yire sugandixi kui. Wo tan, wo xa die, wo xa konyie, a nun Lewi xa die naxee na wo ya ma, wo xa na sɛrɛxɛe don mɛnni ɲɛlɛxinyi kui wo Marigi Alatala ya i, a naxan fixi wo ma.

sentences.english: See that you do not give up caring for the Levite as long as you are living in your land.
sentences.susu: Wo wo ɲɛngi sa Lewi xa die xɔn ma a fanyi ra. Wo naxa nɛɛmu e ma.

sentences.english: When the Lord your God makes wide the limit of your land, as he has said, and you say, I will take flesh for my food, because you have a desire for it; then you may take whatever flesh you have a desire for.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala na wo xa bɔxi ragbo yɛ, alɔ a a laayidixi wo bɛ ki naxɛ, xa wo wa sube nan xɔn ma, wo nɔma na donde han wo wasa.

sentences.english: If the place marked out by the Lord your God as the resting-place for his name is far away from you, then take from your herds and from your flocks which the Lord has given you, as I have said, and have a meal of it in the towns where you may be living.
sentences.susu: Xa wo makuya Alatala xa yire sugandixi ra a xili matɔxɔma dɛnnaxɛ, wo nɔma xurusee faxade, wo Marigi naxee fixi wo ma, wo fa na sube don n ma sɛriyɛ ki ma wo xɔnyie han wo wasa.

sentences.english: It will be your food, like the gazelle and the roe; the unclean and the clean may take of it.
sentences.susu: Mixi sɛniyɛnxi nun mixi sɛniyɛntare nɔma e donde alɔ xeli nun tɔɔkɛ.

sentences.english: But see that you do not take the blood for food; for the blood is the life; and you may not make use of the life as food with the flesh.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo mu lan wo xa sube wuli min, barima wuli findixi nii nan na. A mu lan wo xa sube nun a wuli don.

sentences.english: Do not take it for food but let it be drained out on the earth like water.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wuli min, wo xa a ifili bɔxi ma alɔ ye.

sentences.english: Do not take it for food; so that it may be well for you and for your children after you, while you do what is right in the eyes of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa a min alako wo xa sɛɛwa, wo tan, nun wo xa die hali wo dangi xanbi. Wo xa fe tinxinxie raba, Alatala wama naxee xɔn.

sentences.english: But the holy things which you have, and the offerings of your oaths, you are to take to the place which will be marked out by the Lord:
sentences.susu: Xa wo wama sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxi nan bafe Alatala bɛ, alako wo waxɔnfe xa raba wo bɛ, wo xa na sɛrɛxɛ ba yire nɛ Alatala dɛnnaxɛ sugandima.

sentences.english: Offering the flesh and the blood of your burned offerings on the altar of the Lord your God; and the blood of your offerings is to be drained out on the altar of the Lord your God, and the flesh will be your food.
sentences.susu: Naxan findixi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, wo xa na sube nun na wuli sa wo Marigi Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade. Naxan findixi sɛrɛxɛ boore daaxi ra, wo xa a wuli ifili wo Marigi Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade, wo fa a sube tan don.

sentences.english: Take note of all these orders I am giving you and give attention to them, so that it may be well for you and for your children after you for ever, while you do what is good and right in the eyes of the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo wo tuli mati, wo lan nɛ wo xa yi sɛriyɛ ratinmɛ n naxan soxi wo yi ra, alako wo xa sɛɛwa, wo tan nun wo xa die hali wo faxa xanbi abadan, barima fe fanyi na a ra naxan nafan wo Marigi Alatala ma.

sentences.english: When the people of the land where you are going have been cut off before you by the Lord your God, and you have taken their land and are living in it;
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala na gɛ sie halakide wo saabui ra, wo na sabati e xa bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: After their destruction take care that you do not go in their ways, and that you do not give thought to their gods, saying, How did these nations give worship to their gods? I will do as they did.
sentences.susu: wo xa wo yɛtɛ ratanga e xa fe kobi rabafe ma, e halaki xanbi. Wo xa wo yɛtɛ ratanga e xa alae maxɔrinfe ma. Wo naxa a fala, «Yi sie nu tuubi rabirama e bɛ di? N fan waxi na nan nabafe.»

sentences.english: Do not so to the Lord your God: for everything which is disgusting to the Lord and hated by him they have done in honour of their gods: even burning their sons and daughters in the fire to their gods.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa na mɔɔli raba wo Marigi Alatala ra, barima e nu fe kobie rabama e xa alae bɛ Alatala mu wama naxee xɔn. Mixi nan nu e ra, naxee nu e xa die ganma e xa kuyee bɛ sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: If ever you have among you a prophet or a dreamer of dreams and he gives you a sign or a wonder,
sentences.susu: Wo lan nɛ wo xa yi sɛriyɛ raba a raba ki ma n naxan soxi wo yi ra. Wo naxa sese ba a ra, wo man naxa sese fan sa a xun ma.

sentences.english: And the sign or the wonder takes place, and he says to you, Let us go after other gods, which are strange to you, and give them worship;
sentences.susu: Xa namiɲɔnmɛ nde, xa na mu a ra waliyu nde,

sentences.english: Then give no attention to the words of that prophet or that dreamer of dreams: for the Lord your God is testing you, to see if all the love of your heart and soul is given to him.
sentences.susu: sa kaabanakoe fe nun tɔnxuma fe raba wo ya xɔri, a man fa a fala wo bɛ, «Won bira kuye batufe fɔxɔ ra, wo tan mu alae naxee kolon,»

sentences.english: But keep on in the ways of the Lord your God, fearing him and keeping his orders and hearing his voice, worshipping him and being true to him.
sentences.susu: wo naxa wo tuli mati na namiɲɔnmɛ ra a nun na waliyu ra de. Wo Marigi Alatala nan fama wo matode na ki, alako a xa nɔ a kolonde xa a xa xanunteya na wo sondonmɛ ma, xa wo a xanuxi wo nii ra.

sentences.english: And that prophet or that dreamer of dreams is to be put to death; for his words were said with the purpose of turning you away from the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt and made you free from the prison-house; and of forcing you out of the way in which the Lord your God has given you orders to go. So you are to put away the evil from among you.
sentences.susu: Wo lan wo xa tuubi rabira wo Marigi Alatala nan keren bɛ, wo xa gaaxu a ya ra, wo xa a xa yaamarie raba, wo xa a xui rabatu, wo xa a keren nan batu, wo xa bira a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: If your brother, the son of your mother, or your son or your daughter or the wife of your heart, or the friend who is as dear to you as your life, working on you secretly says to you, Let us go and give worship to other gods, strange to you and to your fathers;
sentences.susu: Yi namiɲɔnmɛ nun yi waliyu mɔɔli lan nɛ a xa faxa, barima a bara wa wo bɔɲɛ ratefe wo Marigi Alatala ma naxan wo raminixi konyiya kui Misira bɔxi ma. E bara wo ba kira xɔn Alatala wo tixi naxan na. Wo xa fe ɲaaxi ɲɔn wo tagi.

sentences.english: Gods of the peoples round about you, near or far, from one end of the earth to the other;
sentences.susu: Xa wo ngaxakerenyi, xa na mu a ra wo xa di, xa na mu a ra wo xa baatɛ ginɛ, xa na mu a ra wo boore naxan nafanxi wo ma alɔ wo yɛtɛ, sa wo manahanɛ alako wo xa ala gbɛtɛ batu, wo tan mu naxan kolon, wo babae fan mu naxan kolon,

sentences.english: Do not be guided by him or give attention to him; have no pity on him or mercy, and give him no cover;
sentences.susu: si gbɛtɛe naxee batuxi wo rabilinyi nun naxee makuya wo ra, keli bɔxi tuxui ma sa dɔxɔ boore tuxui ra,

sentences.english: But put him to death without question; let your hand be the first stretched out against him to put him to death, and then the hands of all the people.
sentences.susu: wo naxa tin e xa wɔyɛnyi ra, wo naxa wo tuli mati e ra. Wo naxa kinikini e ma, wo naxa e nɔxun, wo man naxa e kanta.

sentences.english: Let him be stoned with stones till he is dead; because it was his purpose to make you false to the Lord your God, who took you out of the land of Egypt, out of the prison-house.
sentences.susu: Wo lan nɛ wo xa na kanyi faxa, wo a gɔnɔ gɛmɛ ra, ɲama fan fa a magɔnɔ.

sentences.english: And all Israel, hearing of it, will be full of fear, and no one will again do such evil as this among you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a magɔnɔ han a xa faxa, barima a bara kata a xa wo ragbilen wo Marigi Alatala fɔxɔ ra naxan wo raminixi konyiya kui Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And if word comes to you, in one of the towns which the Lord your God is giving you for your resting-place,
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae birin na na fe mɛ, e luma nɛ gaaxui kui. Na tɛmui na fe kobi mɔɔli mu nɔma rabade wo tagi sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: That good-for-nothing persons have gone out from among you, turning the people of their town from the right way and saying, Let us go and give worship to other gods, of whom you have no knowledge;
sentences.susu: Xa wo a mɛ taa nde xa fe ra, wo Marigi Alatala wo rasabatima dɛnnaxɛ,

sentences.english: Then let a full search be made, and let questions be put with care; and if it is true and certain that such a disgusting thing has been done among you;
sentences.susu: a mɛnnika ndee a falama e booree bɛ, «Won xa kuye nɛɛnɛ ndee batu,»

sentences.english: Then take up arms against the people of that town and give it up to the curse, with all its cattle and everything in it.
sentences.susu: a lanma wo xa na mixi kobie xɔn nafen alako wo xa e kɛɲa kolon. Wo xa a kolon xa na fe kobi bara raba wo tagi.

sentences.english: And take all the goods into the middle of its open space, burning the town and all its property with fire as an offering to the Lord your God; it is to be a waste for ever; there is to be no more building there.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa na ki nɛ, wo xa na taakae birin faxa santidɛgɛma ra. Wo xa na taa halaki nun a xa xurusee birin na.

sentences.english: Keep not a thing of what is cursed for yourselves: so the Lord may be turned away from the heat of his wrath, and have mercy on you, and give you increase as he said in his oath to your fathers:
sentences.susu: Wo e harige birin malanma taa tagi nɛ, wo tɛ sa a ma, wo taa birin gan wo Marigi Alatala ya i. Naa fama findide bɔxi rabɛɲinxi nan na. Mɛnni tan mu findima taa ra sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: So long as you give ear to the voice of the Lord your God, and keep all his orders which I give you today, and do what is right in the eyes of the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa na se ratɔnxi sese tongo wo yɛtɛ bɛ, wo na naxan ganfe alako nde xa ba Alatala xa xɔnɛ ra, a xa kinikini wo ma, a xa wo rawuya alɔ a rakalixi ki naxɛ wo babae bɛ.

sentences.english: You are the children of the Lord your God: you are not to make cuts on your bodies or take off the hair on your brows in honour of the dead;
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala xa die lanxi wo tan nan ma. Xa faxɛ fa sa ti, Wo naxa wo yɛtɛ maxaba, wo naxa wo xunsɛxɛ bi wo tigi dɛ ra.

sentences.english: For you are a holy people to the Lord your God, and the Lord has taken you to be his special people out of all the nations on the face of the earth.
sentences.susu: Wo bara findi wo Marigi Alatala xa ɲama sɛniyɛnxi ra. A wo tan nan sugandixi bɔxi ɲama birin tagi, wo xa findi a gbe ra.

sentences.english: No disgusting thing may be your food.
sentences.susu: Wo mu lan wo xa se sɛniyɛntare don.

sentences.english: These are the beasts which you may have for food: the ox, the sheep, and the goat;
sentences.susu: Subee nan yi ki, wo lan wo xa naxee don: ninge, yɛxɛɛ, si,

sentences.english: The hart, the gazelle, and the roe, the mountain goat and the pygarg and the antelope and the mountain sheep.
sentences.susu: xeli, gaale, tɔɔkɛ, muntui, burunyi si, geya fari sube naxan maniyaxi yɛxɛɛ ra, bole,

sentences.english: Any beast which has a division in the horn of its foot and whose food comes back into its mouth to be crushed again, may be used for food.
sentences.susu: sube naxee tore itaxunxi, e man na ɲooge don, e gbilen a rate ra e kɔn na.

sentences.english: But even among these, there are some which may not be used for food: such as the camel, the hare, and the coney, which are unclean to you, because, though their food comes back, the horn of their feet is not parted in two.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na subee ya ma, naxee tore itaxunxi firinyi ra, naxee ɲooge donma, e man fa gbilen a rate ra e kɔn na, ndee na e ya ma wo naxa e don alɔ ɲɔxɔmɛ, yere, nun yere maniyɛ. E findixi sube sɛniyɛntaree nan na wo bɛ, barima e ɲooge donma, e man fa gbilen a rate ra e kɔn na, kɔnɔ e tore mu itaxunxi firinyi ra.

sentences.english: And the pig is unclean to you, because though it has a division in the horn of its foot, its food does not come back; their flesh may not be used for food or their dead bodies touched by you.
sentences.susu: Xɔsɛ naxan tore itaxunxi firinyi ra, kɔnɔ a mu ɲooge donma, a man xa gbilen a rate ra a kɔn na, na nan a findixi sube sɛniyɛntare ra wo bɛ. Wo naxa na sube don, wo man naxa wo bɛlɛxɛ din a binbi ra.

sentences.english: And of the things living in the waters, you may take all those who have wings for swimming with and skins formed of thin plates.
sentences.susu: Yɛxɛ naxee na ye xɔɔra, bɛlɛe na naxee birin bɛ a nun xalee, wo lan wo xa nee nan don.

sentences.english: But any which have no skin-plates or wings for swimming, you may not take; they are unclean for you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo mu lan wo xa yɛxɛ don bɛlɛ mu naxan bɛ a nun xale. Wo xa nee kolon yɛxɛ sɛniyɛntare ra.

sentences.english: All clean birds may be used for food.
sentences.susu: Wo nɔma xɔni sɛniyɛnxi birin donde.

sentences.english: But these birds you may not take: the eagle and the gier-eagle and the ospray;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xɔnie xilie nan yi ki wo mu lan wo xa naxee don: yubɛ, sɛgɛ, xaruma gbɔntɔɛ,

sentences.english: The falcon and the kite, and birds of that sort;
sentences.susu: a nun e maniyɛ birin.

sentences.english: Every raven, and all birds of that sort;
sentences.susu: Xaaxa fan wo naxa na don a nun a maniyɛ birin.

sentences.english: And the ostrich and the night-hawk and the sea-hawk and birds of that sort;
sentences.susu: Xundi, koofole, a nun tagarantongoe,

sentences.english: The little owl and the great owl and the water-hen;
sentences.susu: wo naxa e don a nun e maniyɛ birin.

sentences.english: And the pelican and the vulture and the cormorant;
sentences.susu: Gbongboe, yedɔnmɛ,

sentences.english: The stork and the heron and birds of that sort, and the hoopoe and the bat.
sentences.susu: laaba, tukɛ, a nun e maniyɛ birin, wo naxa e don.

sentences.english: Every winged thing which goes flat on the earth is unclean to you and may not be used as food.
sentences.susu: Nimase xunxuri gabutenyi kanyi birin raharamuɲaxi. Wo mu lan wo xa e don.

sentences.english: But all clean birds you may take.
sentences.susu: Wo lan wo xa nimasee nan don naxee sɛniyɛnxi.

sentences.english: You may not have as food anything which has come to a natural death; the man from another country who is living with you may take it for food, or you may get a price for it from one of another nation; for you are a holy people to the Lord your God. The young goat is not to be cooked in its mother's milk.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa sube don naxan faxaxi a yɛtɛ ma. Wo xa a so xɔɲɛ Ala kolontaree yi ra, naxee na wo xɔnyi, alako e xa a don, xa na mu wo xa a mati mixi gbɛtɛe ma. Wo tan bara findi wo Marigi Alatala xa ɲama sɛniyɛnxi ra. Wo naxa si yɔrɛ ɲin a nga xiɲɛ ye ra.

sentences.english: Put on one side a tenth of all the increase of your seed, produced year by year.
sentences.susu: Wo sansi naxan birin nawalima xɛ ma, wo lan nɛ wo xa farilɛ ba a ra ɲɛ yo ɲɛ.

sentences.english: And make a feast before the Lord your God, in the place which is to be marked out, where his name will be for ever, of the tenth part of your grain and your wine and your oil, and the first births of your herds and your flocks; so that you may have the fear of the Lord your God in your hearts at all times.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na farilɛ don yire wo Marigi Alatala xili matɔxɔma dɛnnaxɛ. Wo xa farilɛ findima wo xa mɛngi, wo xa wɛni nɛɛnɛ, wo xa ture, wo xa xurusee xa di singee nan na. Wo xa na ba alako wo nɔma gaaxude wo Marigi Alatala ya ra ki naxɛ lɔxɔɛ birin.

sentences.english: And if the way is so long that you are not able to take these things to the place marked out by the Lord your God for his name, when he has given you his blessing, because it is far away from you;
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li wo sabatide makuya wo Marigi Alatala xili matɔxɔde ra, na kote xaninfe xɔrɔxɔma nɛ wo bɛ, barima wo Marigi Alatala bara barakɛ gbegbe fi wo ma.

sentences.english: Then let these things be exchanged for money, and, taking the money in your hand, go to the place marked out by the Lord your God for himself;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui wo xa wo xa farilɛ masara kɔbiri ra, wo fa na xanin wo Marigi Alatala xili matɔxɔde.

sentences.english: And with the money get whatever you have a desire for, oxen or sheep or wine or strong drink, whatever your soul's desire may be: and make a feast there before the Lord your God, and be glad, you and all your house;
sentences.susu: Mɛnni wo nɔma xurusee, wɛni, nun wo waxɔnse gbɛtɛ sarade, alako wo nun wo xa denbayae xa wo dɛge wo Marigi Alatala ya i sɛɛwɛ kui.

sentences.english: And give a thought to the Levite who is living among you, for he has no part or heritage in the land.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa nɛɛmu Lewikae ma naxee sabatixi wo ya ma, barima se mu na e bɛ naxan findima e kɛ ra.

sentences.english: At the end of every three years take a tenth part of all your increase for that year, and put it in store inside your walls:
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ saxan yo ɲɛ saxan wo xa wo xa sansi farilɛ birin nagata wo xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And the Levite, because he has no part or heritage in the land, and the man from a strange country, and the child who has no father, and the widow, who are living among you, will come and take food and have enough; and so the blessing of the Lord your God will be on you in everything you do.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Lewikae, kɛ mu na naxee bɛ, wo xa xɔɲɛe, kiridie, a nun kaaɲɛ ginɛ naxee na wo ya ma, e birin xa fa e dɛgede wo xɔnyi han e luga. Na kui wo Marigi Alatala fama barakɛ sade wo xa fe birin ma.

sentences.english: At the end of every seven years there is to be a general forgiveness of debt.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ solofere yo ɲɛ solofere wo xa diɲɛ donie ma.

sentences.english: This is how it is to be done: every creditor is to give up his right to whatever he has let his neighbour have; he is not to make his neighbour, his countryman, give it back; because a general forgiveness has been ordered by the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na sɛriyɛ lan a xa raba yi ki nɛ: Fɛɛrɛ kanyie naxee birin doni bɛɲinxi e ngaxakerenyi bɛ, e lan nɛ e xa diɲɛ na doni ma. Wo mu lan wo xa wo boore nun wo ngaxakerenyi ɲaxankata doni fife ma ɲɛ kui Alatala naxan sugandixi.

sentences.english: A man of another nation may be forced to make payment of his debt, but if your brother has anything of yours, let it go;
sentences.susu: Wo lan wo xa dɔxɔ Ala kolontare nan na a xa wo xa doni fi, kɔnɔ wo naxan donixi wo ngaxakerenyi bɛ, wo lan nɛ wo xa diɲɛ na ma.

sentences.english: But there will be no poor among you; for the Lord will certainly give you his blessing in the land which the Lord your God is giving you for your heritage;
sentences.susu: Na nan a toma setare mu kolonma wo ya ma, barima Alatala barakɛ gbegbe sama nɛ wo xa fe bɔxi ma wo Marigi Alatala dɛnnaxɛ soxi wo yi ra kɛ ra, alako a xa findi wo gbe ra.

sentences.english: If only you give ear to the voice of the Lord your God, and take care to keep all these orders which I give you today.
sentences.susu: A na rabama nɛ xa wo bira wo Marigi Alatala xui fɔxɔ ra. Wo xa a xa yaamari rabatu, n naxan falaxi wo bɛ to lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: For the Lord your God will give you his blessing as he has said: you will let other nations have the use of your money, but you will not make use of theirs; you will be rulers over a number of nations, but they will not be your rulers.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala barakɛ sama nɛ wo xa fe alɔ a masen ki naxɛ. Wo kɔbiri donima nɛ ɲama gbegbe bɛ, kɔnɔ wo tan mu doni tongoma. Wo fama nɛ dangide ɲama gbegbe ra, mixi yo mu dangima wo ra.

sentences.english: If in any of your towns in the land which the Lord your God is giving you, there is a poor man, one of your countrymen, do not let your heart be hard or your hand shut to him;
sentences.susu: Xa setare na wo ngaxakerenyie ya ma wo nun naxee sabatixi bɔxi keren ma wo Marigi Alatala dɛnnaxɛ fima wo ma, wo naxa wo nii raxutu, wo xa tondi doni bɛɲinde e bɛ.

sentences.english: But let your hand be open to give him the use of whatever he is in need of.
sentences.susu: Wo lanma nɛ wo xa a doni sɛɛwɛ kui a hayi na naxan ma.

sentences.english: And see that there is no evil thought in your heart, moving you to say to yourself, The seventh year, the year of forgiveness is near; and so looking coldly on your poor countryman you give him nothing; and he will make an outcry to the Lord against you, and it will be judged as sin in you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo mɛɛni ki fanyi ra, xaxili ɲaaxi naxa nɔ wo ra a falafe ra, «A gbe mu luxi ɲɛ solofere nde xa a li, a lan mixi xa diɲɛ doni ma ɲɛ naxan na.» Wo xa wo mɛɛni, wo naxa kinikinitareɲa masen wo ngaxakerenyi setaree bɛ tondife se nde sode a yi ra. Na na raba, a a yaxaseri masama nɛ Alatala bɛ wo xa fe ra, wo fa findi yunubitɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: But it is right for you to give to him, without grief of heart: for because of this, the blessing of the Lord your God will be on all your work and on everything to which you put your hand.
sentences.susu: Wo lan nɛ wo xa a ki bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra. Wo na bɔɲɛ fanyi naxan nabaxi na ki, wo Marigi Alatala barakɛ sama nɛ wo xa walie wo na so naxee yo ya ma.

sentences.english: For there will never be a time when there are no poor in the land; and so I give orders to you, Let your hand be open to your countrymen, to those who are poor and in need in your land.
sentences.susu: Setaree luma nɛ wo xa bɔxi ma, na nan a toxi n na a falaxi wo bɛ wo xa hinnɛ wo ngaxakerenyie ra, misikiinɛ a nun setare naxee na wo xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: If one of your countrymen, a Hebrew man or woman, becomes your servant for a price and does work for you six years, in the seventh year let him go free.
sentences.susu: Xa wo ngaxakerenyi Eburu xɛmɛ, xa na mu a ra ginɛ, a yɛtɛ mati wo ma konyi ra, a walima nɛ wo bɛ ɲɛ senni. A ɲɛ solofere nde wo xa a xɔrɛya.

sentences.english: And when you make him free, do not let him go away with nothing in his hands:
sentences.susu: Wo man naxa a bɛɲin a yi igeli ra.

sentences.english: But give him freely from your flock and from your grain and your wine: in the measure of the wealth which the Lord your God has given you, you are to give to him.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala se naxan birin fixi wo ma barakɛ ra alɔ yɛxɛɛ, si, mɛngi, a nun wɛni, wo xa na ndee so a yi ra.

sentences.english: And keep in mind that you yourself were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God made you free: so I give you this order today.
sentences.susu: Wo wo ratu a ma konyi nan nu wo fan na Misira, wo Marigi Alatala fa wo xun sara. Na fe na a toxi, n yi sɛriyɛ soxi wo yi ra to lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: But if he says to you, I have no desire to go away from you; because you and your family are dear to him and he is happy with you;
sentences.susu: Xa konyi nde fa a fala wo bɛ a mu kelima wo xa denbaya ya ma barima wo bara rafan a ma,

sentences.english: Then take a sharp-pointed instrument, driving it through his ear into the door, and he will be your servant for ever. And you may do the same for your servant-girl.
sentences.susu: na tɛmui wo se tunbase nan tongoma. Wo a tuli tunba banxi naadɛ ma. Na tɛmui a bara findi wo xa konyi ra kudɛ. Wo na mɔɔli nan nabama wo xa konyi ginɛ fan na.

sentences.english: Let it not seem hard to you that you have to send him away free; for he has been working for you for six years, which is twice the regular time for a servant: and the blessing of the Lord your God will be on you in everything you do.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa nimisa xɔrɛya fife ra wo xa konyi ma, barima a xa wali ɲɛ senni bun ma na bara wo rageeni dɔxɔ firin dangi walikɛ sare ra. Na kui wo Marigi Alatala barakɛ sama nɛ wo xa wali birin ma na xa fe ra.

sentences.english: All the first males to come to birth in your herd and your flock are to be holy to the Lord your God: the first birth of your ox is not to be used for work, the wool of your first lamb is not to be cut.
sentences.susu: Wo xa ninge, yɛxɛɛ, nun si di xɛmɛ singe naxee barima, e birin findima wo Marigi Alatala nan gbe ra. Wo mu lan wo xa ninge xɛmɛ di singe rawali, wo man mu lan wo xa yɛxɛɛ di xɛmɛ singe xabe maxaba a ma.

sentences.english: But year by year you and all your house are to take a meal of it before the Lord, in the place of his selection.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ yo ɲɛ wo tan nun wo xa denbaya nan na donma yire, wo Marigi Alatala xa yire sugandixi.

sentences.english: But if it has any mark on it, if it is blind or has damaged legs, or if there is anything wrong with it, it may not be offered to the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Xa a mabɛnxi, xa a ya kanaxi, xa na mu fure gbɛtɛ na a ma, wo naxa na fi wo Marigi Alatala ma sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: It may be used for food in your houses: the unclean and the clean may take of it, as of the gazelle and the roe.
sentences.susu: Wo nɔma na donde wo xɔnyi nɛ, wo nun mixi sɛniyɛnxie, xa na mu a ra, mixi sɛniyɛntaree, alɔ wo xeli nun tɔɔkɛ donma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Only do not take its blood for food, but let it be drained out on the earth like water.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo naxa sube wuli don de. Wo a ifilima bɔxi nan ma alɔ ye.

sentences.english: Take note of the month of Abib and keep the Passover to the Lord your God: for in the month of Abib the Lord your God took you out of Egypt by night.
sentences.susu: Abiba kike ra, wo xa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali raba wo Marigi Alatala xa fe ra, barima na kike kui, wo Marigi Alatala wo ramini Misira ra kɔɛ nan na.

sentences.english: The Passover offering, from your flock or your herd, is to be given to the Lord your God in the place marked out by him as the resting-place of his name.
sentences.susu: Wo sɛrɛxɛ naxee bama wo Marigi Alatala bɛ Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali lɔxɔɛ, e tongoma xuruse nan ya ma: yɛxɛɛ, si, xa na mu a ra ninge. Na sɛrɛxɛ bama Alatala xili matɔxɔde nɛ.

sentences.english: Take no leavened bread with it; for seven days let your food be unleavened bread, that is, the bread of sorrow; for you came out of the land of Egypt quickly: so the memory of that day, when you came out of the land of Egypt, will be with you all your life.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa taami lɛbini daaxi don na sali xi solofere bun ma. Wo lan wo xa taami lɛbinitare nan don naxan findi kinikini taami ra. Na nan wo ratuma lɔxɔɛ ma wo gbataxi mini Misira bɔxi ra lɔxɔɛ naxɛ. Na a niyama nɛ wo mu nɛɛmu wo mini lɔxɔɛ ma Misira bɔxi ra.

sentences.english: For seven days let no leaven be used through all your land; and nothing of the flesh which is put to death in the evening of the first day is to be kept through the night till morning.
sentences.susu: Na xi solofere bun ma, a mu lan lɛbini siya xa to wo xɔnyi, wo xa bɔxi birin ma. Wo sɛrɛxɛ naxan bama a xi singe nunmare ra, na mu lan a xa lu han gɛɛsɛgɛ.

sentences.english: The Passover offering is not to be put to death in any of the towns which the Lord your God gives you:
sentences.susu: Na Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali sɛrɛxɛ mu lan a xa raba yire birin, wo Marigi Alatala wo rasabatixi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: But in the place marked out by the Lord your God as the resting-place of his name, there you are to put the Passover to death in the evening, at sundown, at that time of the year when you came out of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Wo a bama yire keren peti nɛ, wo Marigi Alatala xili matɔxɔde sɛniyɛnxi. Na sɛrɛxɛ bama nunmare nan na soge goro tɛmui, wo mini waxati naxan ma Misira bɔxi ra.

sentences.english: It is to be cooked and taken as food in the place marked out by the Lord: and in the morning you are to go back to your tents.
sentences.susu: Wo sube ɲinma nɛ, wo a don yire wo Marigi Alatala dɛnnaxɛ sugandixi. Kuye na iba, wo fa siga wo xɔnyi.

sentences.english: For six days let your food be unleavened bread; and on the seventh day there is to be a holy meeting to the Lord your God; no work is to be done.
sentences.susu: Xi senni bun ma, wo taami lɛbinitare nan donma. A xi solofere lɔxɔɛ wo malanyi belebele raba wo Marigi Alatala xa binyɛ bun ma. Wo naxa wali yo raba na lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: Let seven weeks be numbered from the first day when the grain is cut.
sentences.susu: Wo na mɛngi xaba fɔlɔ, wo lɔxɔxun solofere nan kɔntima,

sentences.english: Then keep the feast of weeks to the Lord your God, with an offering freely given to him from the wealth he has given you:
sentences.susu: wo fa Lɔxunyie Sali raba wo Marigi Alatala bɛ. Wo Marigi Alatala barakɛ naxan fixi wo ma wo sɔtɔse ra, wo xa nde ba wo ɲanige ra na barakɛ bɛrɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then you are to be glad before the Lord your God, you and your son and your daughter, your man-servant and your woman-servant, and the Levite who is with you, and the man from a strange country, and the child without a father, and the widow, who are living among you, in the place marked out by the Lord your God as a resting-place for his name.
sentences.susu: Wo sɛɛwama nɛ wo Marigi Alatala ra yire a dɛnnaxɛ sugandixi a xili falafe ra, wo tan nun wo xa die, wo xa konyie, Lewikae naxee na wo xɔnyi, xɔɲɛe, kiridie, a nun kaaɲɛ ginɛe.

sentences.english: And you will keep in mind that you were a servant in the land of Egypt: and you will take care to keep all these laws.
sentences.susu: Wo xa ratu konyi nan nu na wo ra Misira bɔxi ma. Wo lan nɛ wo xa yi sɛriyɛ raɲɛrɛ a raɲɛrɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: You are to keep the feast of tents for seven days after you have got in all your grain and made your wine:
sentences.susu: Wo na gɛ wo xa sansie bɔnbɔde lɔnyi ma, wo naxa wɛni bogi fan bundu, wo xa Bage Ti Sali raba xi solofere bun ma.

sentences.english: You are to keep the feast with joy, you and your son and your daughter, your man-servant and your woman-servant, and the Levite, and the man from a strange country, and the child without a father, and the widow, who are living among you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɛɛwa na sali kui, wo tan, wo xa die, wo xa konyie, Lewikae, xɔɲɛe, kiridie, a nun kaaɲɛ ginɛe naxee na wo xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Keep the feast to the Lord your God for seven days, in the place marked out by the Lord: because the blessing of the Lord your God will be on all the produce of your land and all the work of your hands, and you will have nothing but joy.
sentences.susu: Wo yi sali rabama xi solofere nan bun ma wo Marigi Alatala bɛ a na dɛnnaxɛ sugandi, barima wo Marigi Alatala barakɛ sama nɛ wo xa xɛ wali nun wo xa wali birin ma, wo fa sɛɛwa ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Three times in the year let all your males come before the Lord your God in the place named by him; at the feast of unleavened bread, the feast of weeks, and the feast of tents: and they are not to come before the Lord with nothing in their hands;
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ yo ɲɛ, xɛmɛ naxan birin na wo ya ma, e lan nɛ e xa ti e Marigi Alatala ya i sanya saxan, yire a dɛnnaxɛ sugandixi: Taami Lɛbinitare Sali, Lɔxunyie Sali, a nun Bage Ti Sali. Wo mu lan wo xa siga Alatala ma wo yi igeli ra.

sentences.english: Every man is to give as he is able, in the measure of the blessing which the Lord your God has given you.
sentences.susu: Wo keren keren ma fama sɛrɛxɛ nan na wo nɔxi naxan na, wo Marigi Alatala naxan fixi wo ma barakɛ ra.

sentences.english: You are to make judges and overseers in all your towns which the Lord your God gives you, for every tribe: and they are to be upright men, judging the people in righteousness.
sentences.susu: Taae birin kui, wo Marigi Alatala dɛnnaxɛ fixi wo ma, bɔnsɔɛ yo bɔnsɔɛ, wo kiitisae nan sugandima, e xa ɲama makiiti tinxinyi kui.

sentences.english: You are not to be moved in your judging by a man's position, you are not to take rewards; for rewards make the eyes of the wise man blind, and the decisions of the upright false.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa tɔɔɲɛgɛ kiiti sa de, wo man naxa ti mixi yo xɔn ma. Wo naxa tin fe nde xa wo madaxu, barima se nɔma nɔndi falɛe findide nɛ dɔnxui ra, e nɔndi mafindi wule ra.

sentences.english: Let righteousness be your guide, so that you may have life, and take for your heritage the land which the Lord your God is giving you.
sentences.susu: Wo lanma wo xa kiiti tinxinxi yati nan sa, alako wo xa simaya sɔtɔ, wo man xa nɔ bɔxi masɔtɔde wo Marigi Alatala dɛnnaxɛ fixi wo ma.

sentences.english: Let no holy tree of any sort be planted by the altar of the Lord your God which you will make.
sentences.susu: Wo mu lan wo xa Aseri wuri masolixi ti sɛrɛxɛbade fɛ ma, wo dɛnnaxɛ yailanxi wo Marigi Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: You are not to put up stone pillars, for they are hated by the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa gɛmɛ ti kuye ra, barima wo Marigi Alatala na fe mɔɔli xɔnxi.

sentences.english: No ox or sheep which has a mark on it or is damaged in any way may be offered to the Lord your God: for that is disgusting to the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo mu lan wo xa ninge xa na mu yɛxɛɛ ba sɛrɛxɛ ra wo Marigi Alatala bɛ, naxan kɛɲa mu fan, xa na mu a ra naxan mabɛnxi, barima wo Marigi Alatala na fe mɔɔli xɔnxi.

sentences.english: If there is any man or woman among you, in any of the towns which the Lord your God gives you, who does evil in the eyes of the Lord your God, sinning against his agreement,
sentences.susu: Xa wo mixi nde to wo xa taae kui, wo Marigi Alatala naxee fixi wo ma, naxan ala gbɛtɛ batuma, a bara fe ɲaaxi raba naxan mu rafan wo Marigi Alatala ma. A bara Ala xa saatɛ matandi

sentences.english: By becoming a servant of other gods and worshipping them or the sun or the moon or all the stars of heaven, against my orders;
sentences.susu: tuubi rabirafe ala gbɛtɛe bɛ, xa na mu soge, kike, nun tunbuie bɛ.

sentences.english: If word of this comes to your ears, then let this thing be looked into with care, and if there is no doubt that it is true, and such evil has been done in Israel;
sentences.susu: Wo na na fe mɔɔli ifalɛ mɛ, wo xa a xɔn nafen a fanyi ra. Wo na a kolon na fe xɔnxi bara raba Isirayila bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: Then you are to take the man or woman who has done the evil to the public place of your town, and they are to be stoned with stones till they are dead.
sentences.susu: a na findi xɛmɛ ra, xa na mu ginɛ, wo a kanyi xaninma taa sode dɛ nan na, wo a magɔnɔ gɛmɛ ra han a xa faxa.

sentences.english: On the word of two or three witnesses, a man may be given the punishment of death; but he is not to be put to death on the word of one witness.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan lan a xa faxa, a mu faxama sinden fo a tongo seede firin xui ma, xa na mu a ra saxan. A mu lan a xa faxa seede keren gbansan xui ma.

sentences.english: The hands of the witnesses will be the first to put him to death, and after them the hands of all the people. So you are to put away the evil from among you.
sentences.susu: Seedee nan singe gɛmɛ wolima a ma a faxafe ra, ɲama dɔnxɔɛ fan fa a magɔnɔ. Wo fe ɲaaxi ɲɔnma wo tagi na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: If you are not able to give a decision as to who is responsible for a death, or who is right in a cause, or who gave the first blow in a fight, and there is a division of opinion about it in your town: then go to the place marked out by the Lord your God;
sentences.susu: Xa faxa kiiti bara fa, xa na mu a ra galanbui, xa na mu maxɔnɛ, naxan findixi kiiti xɔrɔxɔɛ ra wo bɛ taa kui, wo xa siga yire wo Marigi Alatala dɛnnaxɛ sugandixi.

sentences.english: And come before the priests, the Levites, or before him who is judge at the time: and they will go into the question and give you a decision:
sentences.susu: Wo sigama Lewika sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nan xɔn, a nun kiitisae naxee na wo xun ma, wo a tagi raba e bɛ. E a falama wo bɛ na tɛmui a lan kiiti xa sa ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And you are to be guided by the decision they give in the place named by the Lord, and do whatever they say:
sentences.susu: E naxan falama wo bɛ yire, wo Marigi Alatala dɛnnaxɛ sugandixi, wo kiiti bolonma na ki nɛ. E naxan falama wo bɛ, wo xa na birin naba.

sentences.english: Acting in agreement with their teaching and the decision they give: not turning to one side or the other from the word they have given you.
sentences.susu: E sɛriyɛ naxan birin falama wo bɛ, wo xa na raba. Wo naxa binya yirefanyi ma, xa na mu kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: And any man who, in his pride, will not give ear to the priest whose place is there before the Lord your God, or to the judge, is to be put to death: you are to put away the evil from Israel.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde, a xa yɛtɛ igboɲa kui, mu a tuli mati kiitisae nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra, wo Marigi Alatala naxee sugandixi a xa wali rabafe ma, na kanyi lanma nɛ a xa faxa. Wo fe ɲaaxi ɲɔnma wo tagi na ki nɛ Isirayila.

sentences.english: And all the people, hearing of it, will be full of fear and put away their pride.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin fama lude gaaxui nan kui na tɛmui. E na yi fe mɛ naxan nabaxi, mixi gbɛtɛ yo mu suusama na yɛtɛ igboɲa mɔɔli rabade fa.

sentences.english: When you have come into the land which the Lord your God is giving you, and have taken it for a heritage and are living in it, if it is your desire to have a king over you, like the other nations round about you;
sentences.susu: Wo na so bɔxi ma tɛmui naxɛ, wo Marigi Alatala dɛnnaxɛ fima wo ma, wo na sabati naa, tɛmunde wo fama nɛ a maɲɔxunde wo fan xa wo gbe mangɛ sɔtɔ alɔ boore si naxee wo rabilinxi.

sentences.english: Then see that you take as your king the man named by the Lord your God: let your king be one of your countrymen, not a man of another nation who is not one of yourselves.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala na mixi naxan sugandi, na nan fama findide wo xa mangɛ ra. Wo naxa tin xɔɲɛ xa findi wo xa mangɛ ra, wo ngaxakerenyi mu naxan na.

sentences.english: And he is not to get together a great army of horses for himself, or make the people go back to Egypt to get horses for him: because the Lord has said, You will never again go back that way.
sentences.susu: A mu lan soe gbegbe xa lu wo xa mangɛ yi ra. A mu lan a xa mixie rasanba Misira e sarade, barima Alatala a falaxi nɛ wo bɛ, a wo naxa siga na bɔxi ma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And he is not to have a great number of wives, for fear that his heart may be turned away; or great wealth of silver and gold.
sentences.susu: A mu lan a xa ginɛ gbegbe dɔxɔ. Na fee nan fama a ragbilende Alatala fɔxɔ ra. A mu lan a xa gbeti gbegbe nun xɛɛma gbegbe malan.

sentences.english: And when he has taken his place on the seat of his kingdom, he is to make in a book a copy of this law, from that which the priests, the Levites, have in their care:
sentences.susu: Mangɛ na dɔxɔ a xa mangɛ kibanyi tɛmui naxɛ, sɛriyɛ kitaabui naxan nagataxi Lewika sɛrɛxɛdubɛe yi ra, a xa na misaali yailan a yɛtɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: And it is to be with him for his reading all the days of his life, so that he may be trained in the fear of the Lord his God to keep and do all the words of this teaching and these laws:
sentences.susu: A xa na kitaabui ragata a fɛ ma, a xa a xaran lɔxɔɛ birin a xa simaya kui, alako a xa gaaxu a Marigi Alatala ya ra, a man xa nɔ a xa sɛriyɛ nun a xa yaamari rabatude naxan sɛbɛxi a kui.

sentences.english: So that his heart may not be lifted up over his countrymen, and he may not be turned away from the orders, to one side or the other: but that his life and the lives of his children may be long in his kingdom in Israel.
sentences.susu: Na fe nan fama a niyade, a mu a yɛtɛ rafisa a ngaxakerenyie bɛ, a man mu tantan sɛriyɛ ma, a mu binya yirefanyi ma nun kɔɔla ma. Na tɛmui a mangɛya xɔnkuye sɔtɔma nɛ, a tan nun a xa die Isirayila ɲama tagi.

sentences.english: The priests, the Levites, that is, all the tribe of Levi, will have no part or heritage with Israel: their food and their heritage will be the offerings of the Lord made by fire.
sentences.susu: Lewika sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewi xabilɛ dɔnxɔɛe mu fama bɔxi sɔtɔde kɛ ra alɔ Isirayila di booree. E baloe findima sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nan na naxee bama Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And they will have no heritage among their countrymen: the Lord is their heritage, as he has said to them.
sentences.susu: E mu fama kɛ sɔtɔde e ngaxakerenyie tagi. Alatala nan findima e kɛ ra alɔ a a masen e bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And this is to be the priests' right: those who make an offering of a sheep or an ox are to give to the priest the top part of the leg and the two sides of the head and the stomach.
sentences.susu: Lewika sɛrɛxɛdubɛe mabiri findima sɛrɛxɛe nan na Isirayilakae fama naxee bade alɔ ningee, xa na mu a ra yɛxɛɛe. A lanma sube bɛlɛxɛ, a banganyi, nun a furi nan xa so sɛrɛxɛdubɛe yi ra.

sentences.english: And in addition you are to give him the first of your grain and wine and oil, and the first wool cut from your sheep.
sentences.susu: Wo man fa bɔxi daxamui singe so e yi ra: mɛngi, wɛni nɛɛnɛ, ture, a nun wo yɛxɛɛ xabe naxan singe maxabama.

sentences.english: For he, and his sons after him for ever, have been marked out by the Lord your God from all your tribes, to do the work of priests in the name of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala Lewi bɔnsɔɛ nan sugandixi bɔnsɔɛ birin tagi, alako e tan nun e xa die xa nɔ Alatala xili binyade tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: And if a Levite, moved by a strong desire, comes from any town in all Israel where he is living to the place marked out by the Lord;
sentences.susu: Xa Lewika nde wa kelife Isirayila taa kui a na dɛnnaxɛ, sigafe ra yire Alatala dɛnnaxɛ sugandixi,

sentences.english: Then he will do the work of a priest in the name of the Lord his God, with all his brothers the Levites who are there before the Lord.
sentences.susu: mɛnni, a lanma a xa a Marigi Alatala xa wali raba a nun a ngaxakerenyi Lewikae ra naxee na naa.

sentences.english: His food will be the same as theirs, in addition to what has come to him as the price of his property.
sentences.susu: A lan nɛ a xa baloe sɔtɔ alɔ sɛrɛxɛdubɛ booree, bafe a harige ra a faxi naxan na a xun ma, a bara naxan sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: When you have come into the land which the Lord your God is giving you, do not take as your example the disgusting ways of those nations.
sentences.susu: Wo na so tɛmui naxɛ bɔxi ma, wo Marigi Alatala naxan fima wo ma, wo mu lan wo xa so wali ɲaaxie ya ma mɛnnikae na naxee kui.

sentences.english: Let there not be seen among you anyone who makes his son or his daughter go through the fire, or anyone using secret arts, or a maker of strange sounds, or a reader of signs, or any wonder-worker,
sentences.susu: Mixi naxa mini wo ya ma de naxan a xa di ganma sɛrɛxɛ ra, naxan findima sematoe ra, ya kanyi ra, duure ra, kɔrɔmixi ra,

sentences.english: Or anyone using secret force on people, or putting questions to a spirit, or having secret knowledge, or going to the dead for directions.
sentences.susu: naxan karamɔxɔ wali rabama, naxan wɔyɛnma barie, ɲinnɛe, nun mixi faxaxie ra.

sentences.english: For all who do such things are disgusting to the Lord; and because of these disgusting things the Lord your God is driving them out before you.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala na mixi mɔɔli xɔnxi. Na fe kobie na a toxi, wo Marigi Alatala yi sie halakima wo ya ra.

sentences.english: You are to be upright in heart before the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo xa lu wo Marigi Alatala waxɔnki.

sentences.english: For these nations, whose land you are taking, give attention to readers of signs and to those using secret arts: but the Lord your God will not let you do so.
sentences.susu: Wo fama si naxee halakide na ki, e biraxi sematoe xui nan fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ wo Marigi Alatala mu tinma wo tan xa na raba.

sentences.english: The Lord your God will give you a prophet from among your people, like me; you will give ear to him;
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala fama namiɲɔnmɛ nde rakelide wo ya ma, naxan luma alɔ n tan. Wo xa wo tuli mati a ra.

sentences.english: In answer to the request you made to the Lord your God in Horeb on the day of the great meeting, when you said, Let not the voice of the Lord my God come to my ears again, and let me not see this great fire any more, or death will overtake me.
sentences.susu: Wo na nan yati maxɔrin wo Marigi Alatala ma, wo nu malanxi lɔxɔɛ naxɛ Xorebe geya fari. Wo naxa a fala, «Muxu mu wama muxu Marigi Alatala xui mɛfe fa. Muxu mu wama yi tɛ belebele fan tofe kɔrɛ, alako muxu naxa faxa.»

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to me, What they have said is well said.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, «E fe fanyi nan falaxi n bɛ.

sentences.english: I will give them a prophet from among themselves, like you, and I will put my words in his mouth, and he will say to them whatever I give him orders to say.
sentences.susu: N fama nɛ namiɲɔnmɛ nde rakelide e ya ma, naxan luxi alɔ i tan. N fama n ma masenyi fide a ma, a fa na tagi raba e bɛ.

sentences.english: And whoever does not give ear to my words which he will say in my name, will be responsible to me.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde na lu, a mu a tuli mati na namiɲɔnmɛ xa masenyi ra a naxan tima n xili ra, n tan yɛtɛ yati nan na kanyi makiitima.»

sentences.english: But the prophet who takes it on himself to say words in my name which I have not given him orders to say, or who says anything in the name of other gods, will come to his death.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ xa namiɲɔnmɛ yɛtɛ igboe nde fa masenyi ti n xili ra, n mu naxan fixi a ma, xa na mu a masenyi ti ala gbɛtɛ xili ra, a lanma nɛ na kanyi xa faxa.

sentences.english: And if you say in your hearts, How are we to be certain that the word does not come from the Lord?
sentences.susu: Tɛmunde wo fama nɛ wo yɛtɛ maxɔrinde, ‹Won nɔma a kolonde di xa yi wɔyɛnyi fatanxi Alatala nan na?›

sentences.english: When a prophet makes a statement in the name of the Lord, if what he says does not take place and his words do not come true, then his word is not the word of the Lord: the words of the prophet were said in the pride of his heart, and you are to have no fear of him.
sentences.susu: Xa namiɲɔnmɛ masenyi ti Alatala xili ra, a fa lu a mu kamali, na nan na ki a xa masenyi mu fatanxi Alatala ra. Namiɲɔnmɛ nan na falaxi a xa yɛtɛ igboɲa kui. Hali wo mu gaaxu a ya ra.»

sentences.english: When the nations, whose land the Lord your God is giving you, have been cut off by him, and you have taken their place and are living in their towns and in their houses;
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala na fa sie halakide wo ya ra, a fa e xa bɔxi so wo yi ra, wo fa sabati e xa taae nun e xa banxie kui,

sentences.english: You are to have three towns marked out in the land which the Lord your God is giving you for your heritage.
sentences.susu: wo xa taa saxan sugandi na bɔxi tagi, wo Marigi Alatala naxan fixi wo ma.

sentences.english: You are to make ready a way, and see that the land which the Lord your God is giving you for your heritage, is marked out into three parts, to which any taker of life may go in flight.
sentences.susu: Wo xa bɔxi maniya, wo Marigi Alatala naxan fixi wo ma kɛ ra, wo fa a itaxun dɔxɔ saxan. Na nan a toma faxati nde nɔma sigade na taa nde kui, alako a nii xa ratanga.

sentences.english: This is to be the rule for anyone who goes in flight there, after causing the death of his neighbour in error and not through hate;
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan faxɛ tixi, a mu a rakelixi a ma, na faxati mɔɔli nan gbansan nɔma sode yi taa nde kui a nii ratangafe ra.

sentences.english: For example, if a man goes into the woods with his neighbour for the purpose of cutting down trees, and when he takes his axe to give a blow to the tree, the head of the axe comes off, and falling on to his neighbour gives him a wound causing his death; then the man may go in flight to one of these towns and be safe:
sentences.susu: Misaali nan ya: Xa mixi siga fɔtɔnyi wuri sɛgɛde, a nun a boore, a xa beera fa koren, a din a boore ra, na fa faxa, na faxati mɔɔli tan nɔma sode yi taa nde kui a nii ratangafe ra.

sentences.english: For if not, he who has the right of punishment may go running after the taker of life in the heat of his wrath, and overtake him because the way is long, and give him a death-blow; though it is not right for him to be put to death because he was not moved by hate.
sentences.susu: A xa na raba alako mixi naxan wama na fure gbeɲɔxɔfe a xa bɔɲɛte kui, a naxa nɔ faxɛti lide kira ra, a fa a faxa. Na mu lanma, barima xɔnnanteya yo mu nu na a bɛ na mixi faxaxi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And so I am ordering you to see that three towns are marked out for this purpose.
sentences.susu: N yi yaamari fixi wo ma na nan ma. Wo xa taa saxan sugandi, nee xa findi mixi ratanga taae ra.

sentences.english: And if the Lord your God makes wide the limits of your land, as he said in his oath to your fathers, and gives you all the land which he undertook to give to your fathers;
sentences.susu: Xa wo Marigi Alatala wo xa bɔxi ragbo yɛ alɔ a rakali ki naxɛ wo babae bɛ, xa a yi bɔxi birin so wo yi ra a naxan laayidixi wo babae bɛ,

sentences.english: If you keep and do all these orders which I give you today, loving the Lord your God and walking ever in his ways; then let three more towns, in addition to these three, be marked out for you:
sentences.susu: xa wo yi yaamari raba a raba ki ma n naxan falaxi wo bɛ to lɔxɔɛ, wo Marigi Alatala naxa rafan wo ma, wo naxa bira a xa kira fɔxɔ ra, na tɛmui wo man xa taa saxan sugandi, wo xa e sa yi taa saxanyi boore xun ma.

sentences.english: So that in all your land, which the Lord your God is giving you for your heritage, no man may be wrongly put to death, for which you will be responsible.
sentences.susu: Na kui, mixi tɔɔɲɛgɛxi mu faxama wo xa bɔxi ma, wo Marigi Alatala naxan fixi wo ma kɛ ra.

sentences.english: But if any man has hate for his neighbour, and waiting for him secretly makes an attack on him and gives him a blow causing his death, and then goes in flight to one of these towns;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa mixi nde a yaxui xɔn, a a mɛlɛn, a a faxa, a fa so yi taa nde kui,

sentences.english: The responsible men of his town are to send and take him, and give him up to the one who has the right of punishment to be put to death.
sentences.susu: na taa forie lan nɛ e xa a suxu, e a xanin mixi xɔn ma naxan wama na fure gbeɲɔxɔfe, alako faxɛti xa faxa.

sentences.english: Have no pity on him, so that Israel may be clear from the crime of putting a man to death without cause, and it will be well for you.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa kinikini yo ti na kanyi ma. Wo na faxati mɔɔli ɲɔnma na ki nɛ Isirayila bɔxi ma, alako bɔɲɛsa xa lu wo yi ra.

sentences.english: Your neighbour's landmark, which was put in its place by the men of old times, is not to be moved or taken away in the land of your heritage which the Lord your God is giving you.
sentences.susu: Wo na sabati bɔxi ma wo Marigi Alatala naxan fixi wo ma kɛ ra, wo naxa naaninyi tɔnxumae masiga de wo benbae naxee dɔxɔ.

sentences.english: One witness may not make a statement against a man in relation to any sin or wrongdoing which he has done: on the word of two or three witnesses a question is to be judged.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan yunubi fe rabaxi, xa na mu a ra haakɛ, na kanyi mu lan a xa makiiti mixi keren xa seede baxi ma. Na mɔɔli makiitima seede firin, xa na mu, seede saxan xui nan ma.

sentences.english: If a false witness makes a statement against a man, saying that he has done wrong,
sentences.susu: Xa seede ɲaaxi ba nde sa mixi nde tɔɔɲɛgɛ fe nde ma,

sentences.english: Then the two men, between whom the argument has taken place, are to come before the Lord, before the priests and judges who are then in power;
sentences.susu: yi gere mixi firinyie lan nɛ e xa siga Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, e sa e xa galanbui yaxaran sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun kiitisae bɛ naxee na na waxati.

sentences.english: And the judges will have the question looked into with care: and if the witness is seen to be false and to have made a false statement against his brother,
sentences.susu: Kiitisae a fe xɔn nafenma nɛ a ki nun a kɛɲa ma. E na a kolon seede wule nan saxi a ngaxakerenyi xun ma,

sentences.english: Then do to him what it was his purpose to do to his brother: and so put away the evil from among you.
sentences.susu: a ngaxakerenyi nu wama a makiitife ki naxɛ, wo xa na kiiti ragbilen a ma. Wo fe ɲaaxi ɲɔnma wo tagi na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And the rest of the people, hearing of it, will be full of fear, and never again do such evil among you.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbɛtɛe na na fe mɛ, gaaxui nan luma e ma, e mu suusama na fe kobi mɔɔli rabade fa.

sentences.english: Have no pity; let life be given for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa kinikini na mixi mɔɔli ma. Xa a mixi nan faxaxi, wo a fan faxa. Xa a mixi ya nan kanaxi, wo a fan ya kana. Xa a mixi ɲinyi nan giraxi, wo a fan ɲinyi gira. Xa a mixi bɛlɛxɛ nan bolonxi, wo a fan bɛlɛxɛ bolon. Xa a mixi sanyi nan bolonxi, wo a fan sanyi bolon.

sentences.english: When you go out to war against other nations, and come face to face with horses and war-carriages and armies greater in number than yourselves, have no fear of them: for the Lord your God is with you, who took you up out of the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Wo na siga wo yaxuie gerede, wo fa a to e xa soee, geresosee, nun sɔɔrie dangi wo gbe ra, hali wo mu gaaxu. Wo Marigi Alatala naxan wo raminixi Misira bɔxi ra, a na wo fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And when you are on the point of attacking, let the priest come forward and say to the people,
sentences.susu: Wo nɛ wo yailanma tɛmui naxɛ gere sofe ma, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nan tima a wɔyɛn ɲama bɛ,

sentences.english: Give ear, O Israel: today you are going forward to the fight; let your heart be strong; do not let uncontrolled fear overcome you because of those who are against you;
sentences.susu: «Isirayila, wo wo tuli mati! To lɔxɔɛ wo faxi wo yaxuie nan gerede. Limaniya naxa ba wo yi ra de, wo naxa gaaxu, wo bɔɲɛ naxa mini a i, wo naxa sɛrɛn,

sentences.english: For the Lord your God goes with you, fighting for you to give you salvation from those who are against you.
sentences.susu: barima wo Marigi Alatala na wo fɔxɔ ra wo yaxuie gerede. A e rayarabima nɛ wo bɛ, wo fa xutu sɔtɔ e ma.»

sentences.english: And let the overseers say to the people, If there is any man who has made for himself a new house and has not gone into it, let him go back to his house, so that in the event of his death in the fight, another may not take his house for himself.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui mangɛ xa kuntigie xa sɔɔrie maxɔrin, «Mixi nde na wo ya ma, naxan bara gɛ banxi tide kɔnɔ a mu soxi a kui sinden? Na kanyi xa gbilen a xɔnyi, barima xa a faxa gere kui, mixi gbɛtɛ fama nɛ sode a xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: Or if any man has made a vine-garden without taking the first-fruits of it, let him go back to his house, so that in the event of his death in the fight, another may not be the first to make use of the fruit.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde na wo ya ma be, naxan wɛni bili sixi, a mu a bogi baxi sinden? Na kanyi xa gbilen a xɔnyi, barima xa a faxa gere kui, mixi gbɛtɛ fama nɛ a xa wɛni bogi bade.

sentences.english: Or if any man is newly married and has had no sex relations with his wife, let him go back to his house, so that in the event of his death in the fight, another man may not take her.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde na wo ya ma be, naxan bara wa ginɛ xɔn, kɔnɔ a mu a futixi sinden? Na kanyi xa gbilen a xɔnyi, barima xa a faxa gere kui, mixi gbɛtɛ fama nɛ a xa ginɛ futide.»

sentences.english: And let the overseers go on to say to the people, If there is any man whose heart is feeble with fear, let him go back to his house before he makes the hearts of his countrymen feeble.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa kuntigie man xa sɔɔrie maxɔrin, «Mixi nde na wo ya ma be limaniya baxi naxan yi, a gaaxu? Na kanyi fan xa gbilen a xɔnyi alako a naxa limaniya ba a booree fan yi.»

sentences.english: Then, after saying these words to the people, let the overseers put captains over the army.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa kuntigie na gɛ wɔyɛnde ɲama ra, e xa mangɛe ti yi sɔɔri xundɛe ya ra.

sentences.english: When you come to a town, before attacking it, make an offer of peace.
sentences.susu: Wo na wo makɔrɛ wo yaxuie xa taae ra gereso ki ma, wo xa lanyi maxɔrin e ma.

sentences.english: And if it gives you back an answer of peace, opening its doors to you, then all the people in it may be put to forced work as your servants.
sentences.susu: Xa e tin na ra, e taa naadɛ rabi wo bɛ, e birin xa lu wo xa yaamari nan bun ma, e nu duuti fi.

sentences.english: If however it will not make peace with you, but war, then let it be shut in on all sides:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa e mu tin lanyi ra, e fa wo yaabi gere ra, na tɛmui wo xa na taa bilin.

sentences.english: And when the Lord your God has given it into your hands, let every male in it be put to death without mercy.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala e rayarabima nɛ wo bɛ. Wo xa xɛmɛ birin faxa santidɛgɛma ra,

sentences.english: But the women and the children and the cattle and everything in the town and all its wealth, you may take for yourselves: the wealth of your haters, which the Lord your God has given you, will be your food.
sentences.susu: wo xa ginɛe, dimɛe, xurusee, nun se naxan birin na taa kui, wo xa a tongo wo yɛtɛ bɛ sɛɛwɛ kui. Wo Marigi Alatala bara na fi wo ma.

sentences.english: So you are to do to all the towns far away, which are not the towns of these nations.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na mɔɔli raba taae fan na, naxee makuya wo ra, naxee mu na taae ya ma wo fama sabatide dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: But in the towns of these peoples whose land the Lord your God is giving you for your heritage, let no living thing be kept from death:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo naxa sese lu a ɲiɲɛ ra taae kui, wo Marigi Alatala fama naxee fide wo ma kɛ ra.

sentences.english: Give them up to the curse; the Hittite, the Amorite, the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite, as the Lord your God has given you orders:
sentences.susu: Wo Xitikae, Amorikae, Kanaankae, Peresikae, Hiwikae, nun Yebusukae birin halakima nɛ alɔ wo Marigi Alatala a masenxi wo bɛ ki naxɛ,

sentences.english: So that you may not take them as your example and do all the disgusting things which they do in the worship of their gods, so sinning against the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: alako e naxa wo xaran na fe xɔnxie rabafe ra e naxee rabama e xa alae bɛ, na fa findi yunubi fe ra wo bɛ wo Marigi Alatala mabiri.
