sentences.susu: «Fe naxee nɔxunxi, won Marigi Alatala nan keren peti nee kolon. Fe naxee masenxi won bɛ, nun won ma die bɛ, nee findixi won gbe nan na han duniɲa ɲɔn. A lanma won xa yi sɛriyɛ masenxi birin nabatu.»

sentences.english: Now when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse which I have put before you, if the thought of them comes back to your minds, when you are living among the nations where the Lord your God has sent you,
sentences.susu: N baraka nun danka naxee birin falaxi wo bɛ, nee fama nɛ kamalide. Wo Marigi Alatala na wo rayensen yɛ tɛmui naxɛ bɔxi gbɛtɛ ma, wo wo maɲɔxun yi fee ma.

sentences.english: And your hearts are turned again to the Lord your God, and you give ear to his word which I give you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul:
sentences.susu: Xa wo gbilenma wo Marigi Alatala ma, wo man a xui suxu wo bɔɲɛ nun wo xaxili kui wo tan nun wo xa die, alɔ n a masenxi wo bɛ ki naxɛ to lɔxɔɛ,

sentences.english: Then the Lord will have pity on you, changing your fate, and taking you back again from among all the nations where you have been forced to go.
sentences.susu: na tɛmui wo Marigi Alatala wo raminima nɛ konyiya kui, a kinikini wo ma, a wo ba sie ya ma a wo rayensen yɛ dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Even if those who have been forced out are living in the farthest part of heaven, the Lord your God will go in search of you, and take you back;
sentences.susu: Hali wo na yire makuye konyiya kui, wo Marigi Alatala sigama nɛ wo fende, a fa wo malan

sentences.english: Placing you again in the land of your fathers as your heritage; and he will do you good, increasing you till you are more in number than your fathers were.
sentences.susu: wo benbae xa bɔxi ma, alako wo xa naa masɔtɔ, a fa mɛɛni wo ma dangife wo benbae ra, a wo rawuya dangi e ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord your God will give to you and to your seed a circumcision of the heart, so that, loving him with all your heart and all your soul, you may have life.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui wo Marigi Alatala yɛtɛ yati wo bɔnsɔɛ bɔɲɛ rasɛniyɛnma nɛ, alako wo xa a xanu wo bɔɲɛ nun wo xaxili birin na. Na kui wo nɔma simaya fanyi sɔtɔde.

sentences.english: And the Lord your God will put all these curses on those who are against you, and on your haters who put a cruel yoke on you.
sentences.susu: N yi dankɛ naxee birin sɛbɛxi wo bɛ yi ki, nee fama dɔxɔde wo yaxuie nun wo xɔnmae nan ma.

sentences.english: And you will again give ear to the voice of the Lord, and do all his orders which I have given you today.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui wo man tuubi rabirama nɛ a bɛ, wo a xa sɛriyɛ suxu n naxan fixi wo ma to lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord your God will make you fertile in all good things, blessing the work of your hands, and the fruit of your body, and the fruit of your cattle, and the fruit of your land: for the Lord will have joy in you, as he had in your fathers:
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala barakɛ sama nɛ wo xa fe birin ma. Wo di gbegbe sɔtɔma nɛ, wo xa xurusee rawuyama nɛ, wo xa sansie fanma nɛ, barima wo fama nɛ rafande Alatala ma alɔ wo benbae.

sentences.english: If you give ear to the voice of the Lord your God, keeping his orders and his laws which are recorded in this book of the law, and turning to the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
sentences.susu: Na nan nabama, wo na wo tuli mati a ra tɛmui naxɛ, a xa sɛriyɛ nun a xa yaamarie suxufe ra, naxee sɛbɛxi yi kitaabui kui. Na tɛmui wo wo yɛtɛ ragbilenma nɛ a ma wo bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra, wo xaxili birin na.

sentences.english: For these orders which I have given you today are not strange and secret, and are not far away.
sentences.susu: N yi sɛriyɛ naxan falaxi wo bɛ yi ki to lɔxɔɛ, a kolon yo mu xɔnɔ wo bɛ.

sentences.english: They are not in heaven, for you to say, Who will go up to heaven for us and give us knowledge of them so that we may do them?
sentences.susu: A mu na koore xa ma, alako a xa fala, «Nde nɔma tede koore ma a xa sa fa a ra won bɛ, a a xaran won bɛ alako won xa nɔ a rabade?»

sentences.english: And they are not across the sea, for you to say, Who will go over the sea for us and give us news of them so that we may do them?
sentences.susu: A mu na baa kiri fan xa ma, alako a xa fala, «Nde nɔma baa igiride a xa sa fa a ra won bɛ, a man xa a xaran won bɛ alako won xa nɔ a rabade?»

sentences.english: But the word is very near you, in your mouth and in your heart, so that you may do it.
sentences.susu: Ade, yi sɛriyɛ na wo sɛɛti ma nɛ, wo dɛ kui, a nun wo bɔɲɛ ma. Wo nɔma a rabade.

sentences.english: See, I have put before you today, life and good, and death and evil;
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae, wo a mato. To lɔxɔɛ n bara simaya nun fe fanyi ti sɛɛti, faxɛ nun fe ɲaaxi fan boore sɛɛti.

sentences.english: In giving you orders today to have love for the Lord your God, to go in his ways and keep his laws and his orders and his decisions, so that you may have life and be increased, and that the blessing of the Lord your God may be with you in the land where you are going, the land of your heritage.
sentences.susu: To lɔxɔɛ wo tin wo xa wo Marigi Alatala xanu, wo xa ɲɛrɛ a xa kira ma, wo xa bira a xa yaamari, a xa masenyi, nun a xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra, alako wo xa simaya fanyi sɔtɔ, wo xa wuya, alako Ala xa barakɛ sa wo ma yire a dɛnnaxɛ findima wo gbe ra.

sentences.english: But if your heart is turned away and your ear is shut, and you go after those who would make you servants and worshippers of other gods:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa wo gbilen a fɔxɔ ra, xa wo tondi a bɛ, xa wo bira kuye batufe fɔxɔ ra,

sentences.english: I give witness against you this day that destruction will certainly be your fate, and your days will be cut short in the land where you are going, the land of your heritage on the other side of Jordan.
sentences.susu: wo sɔntɔma nɛ feo, wo mu fa bude bɔxi ma wo fama dɛnnaxɛ sɔtɔde Yurudɛn kiri ma.

sentences.english: Let heaven and earth be my witnesses against you this day that I have put before you life and death, a blessing and a curse: so take life for yourselves and for your seed:
sentences.susu: To lɔxɔɛ koore nun bɔxi na n seede ra, n bara simaya nun fe fanyi ti wo bɛ sɛɛti keren na, faxɛ nun fe ɲaaxi fan na boore sɛɛti ra. Wo xa simaya fanyi sugandi, wo tan nun wo bɔnsɔɛe.

sentences.english: In loving the Lord your God, hearing his voice and being true to him: for he is your life and by him will your days be long: so that you may go on living in the land which the Lord gave by an oath to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo Marigi Alatala xanu, wo tuubi a bɛ, wo a xa fe suxu. Wo nɔma simaya sɔtɔde na ki nɛ, wo fa ɲɛ gbegbe raba bɔxi ma, Alatala dɛnnaxɛ saatɛ tongo fife ra wo benba Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Yaxuba ma.

sentences.english: So Moses said all these things to Israel.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa naxa a fala Isirayilakae birin bɛ,

sentences.english: Then he said to them, I am now a hundred and twenty years old; I am no longer able to go out and come in: and the Lord has said to me, You are not to go over Jordan.
sentences.susu: «N bara ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn sɔtɔ yi tɛmui, n mu nɔma mangɛya rabade fa. Alatala ɲan a fala nɛ n bɛ a n mu Yurudɛn igirima.

sentences.english: The Lord your God, he will go over before you; he will send destruction on all those nations, and you will take their land as your heritage: and Joshua will go over at your head as the Lord has said.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala yɛtɛ yati nan wo raɲɛrɛma. A sie birin faxama nɛ naxee na naakiri ma alako wo xa e xa bɔxie masɔtɔ. Yosuwe nan findima wo xa mangɛ ra, alɔ Alatala a fala ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, whom he put to destruction.
sentences.susu: Alatala yi sie halakima nɛ alɔ a Sixɔn nun Ogo, Amorikae xa mangɛe, halaki ki naxɛ, nun e xa bɔxie.

sentences.english: The Lord will give them up into your hands, and you are to do to them as I have given you orders.
sentences.susu: A e rayarabima nɛ wo bɛ. Wo xa a xa yaamari raba e xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Be strong and take heart, and have no fear of them: for it is the Lord your God who is going with you; he will not take away his help from you.
sentences.susu: Wo limaniya, wo xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ, wo naxa gaaxu e ya ra, barima wo Marigi Alatala na wo kantafe, a mu wo rabɛɲinma fefe ma.»

sentences.english: Then Moses sent for Joshua, and before the eyes of all Israel said to him, Be strong and take heart: for you are to go with this people into the land which the Lord, by his oath to their fathers, has given them; by your help they will take it for their heritage.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa naxa Yosuwe xili, a naxa wɔyɛn a bɛ Isirayilakae birin malanxi tagi, «I xa limaniya, i xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ, barima i tan nan Isirayilakae raɲɛrɛma bɔxi ma Alatala dɛnnaxɛ saatɛ tongoxi wo benbae bɛ. I tan xa e xa kɛ so e yi ra.

sentences.english: It is the Lord who goes before you; he will be with you, he will not take away his help from you or give you up: so have no fear.
sentences.susu: Alatala tima nɛ i ya ra, a mu i rabɛɲinma. A mu gbilenma i fɔxɔ ra fefe ma. Hali i mu gaaxu, i man naxa i yɛtɛ rabolo.»

sentences.english: Then Moses put all this law in writing, and gave it to the priests, the sons of Levi, who take up the ark of the Lord's agreement, and to all the responsible men of Israel.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa to yi sɛriyɛ sɛbɛ, a naxa a taxu sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra, Lewi xa di naxee saatɛ kankira xaninma, nun Isirayila forie.

sentences.english: And Moses said to them, At the end of every seven years, at the time fixed for the ending of debts, at the feast of tents,
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Ɲɛ solofere yo ɲɛ solofere, wo diɲɛma doni ma ɲɛ naxan na, wo yi sɛriyɛ xaranma Bage Ti Sali lɔxɔɛ nɛ.

sentences.english: When all Israel has come before the Lord your God in the place named by him, let a reading be given of this law in the hearing of all Israel.
sentences.susu: Wo a xaranma wo xui itexi nan na Isirayilakae birin bɛ, naxee faxi salide Marigi Alatala ya i a xa yire sugandixi.

sentences.english: Make all the people come together, men and women and children, and anyone from another country who is with you, so that hearing they may become wise in the fear of the Lord your God, and take care to do all the words of this law;
sentences.susu: Birin malanma mɛnni nɛ, xɛmɛ, ginɛ, dimɛdi, a nun xɔɲɛ naxee na wo xɔnyi, alako e xa yi xaranyi mɛ, e xa wo Marigi Alatala binya, e xa bira yi sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And so that your children, to whom it is new, may give ear and be trained in the fear of the Lord your God, while you are living in the land which you are going over Jordan to take for your heritage.
sentences.susu: Dimɛ naxee mu nu a kolonxi sinden, e fan a mɛma nɛ. Na kui e wo Marigi Alatala binya ki kolon, wo na fa bɔxi sɔtɔde Yurudɛn naakiri ma tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: At that time the Lord said to Moses, The day of your death is near: send for Joshua, and come to the Tent of meeting so that I may give him his orders. So Moses and Joshua went to the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ, «I faxa tɛmui bara makɔrɛ, Yosuwe xili, wo birin xa siga n ma hɔrɔmɔlingira yire. Mɛnni n fa n ma yaamari fi a ma.» Annabi Munsa nun Yosuwe naxa siga Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira yire.

sentences.english: And the Lord was seen in the Tent in a pillar of cloud resting by the door of the Tent.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa mini e ma nuxui kui naxan nu tema kiri banxi sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Moses, Now you are going to rest with your fathers; and this people will be false to me, uniting themselves to the strange gods of the land where they are going; they will be turned away from me and will not keep the agreement I have made with them.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ, «I fa na faxafe nɛ. I xa faxɛ xanbi, Isirayila ɲama fama kuyee nan batude bɔxi ma e fama sigade dɛnnaxɛ. E gbilenma nɛ saatɛ fɔxɔ ra won lanxi naxan ma.

sentences.english: In that day my wrath will be moved against them, and I will be turned away from them, veiling my face from them, and destruction will overtake them, and unnumbered evils and troubles will come on them; so that in that day they will say, Have not these evils come on us because our God is not with us?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n bɔɲɛ tema nɛ, n xɔnɔ e ma han n e rabɛɲin. N nan n yatagi nɔxunma nɛ e ma, si gbɛtɛe e halaki, tɔɔrɛ nun fe xɔrɔxɔɛe fa dusu e xun na. Isirayilakae a kolonma na tɛmui nɛ, yi tɔɔrɛ e lixi nɛ barima n tan, e Marigi Ala, mu na e ya ma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Truly, my face will be turned away from them in that day, because of all the evil they have done in going after other gods.
sentences.susu: N nan n yatagi nɔxunma nɛ e ma, barima e bara fe ɲaaxi raba kuyee batufe ra.»

sentences.english: Make then this song for yourselves, teaching it to the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, so that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi i xa bɛɛti sɛbɛ n naxan xaranma i bɛ. Munsa, i xa a xaran Isirayilakae bɛ alako e naxa nɛɛmu a ma, a man xa findi seede ra n tan nun Isirayilakae tagi.

sentences.english: For when I have taken them into the land named in my oath to their fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey, and they have made themselves full of food and are fat, then they will be turned to other gods and will give them worship, no longer honouring me or keeping my agreement.
sentences.susu: N fama yi ɲama xaninde bɔxi ma, xiɲɛ nun kumi xɛlɛma dɛnnaxɛ, alɔ n nan n kalixi e babae bɛ ki naxɛ. E na baloe don a fanyi ra han e belebele, e fama birade ala gbɛtɛe fɔxɔ ra, e man n ma saatɛ kana.

sentences.english: Then when evils and troubles without number have overtaken them, this song will be a witness to them, for the words of it will be clear in the memories of their children: for I see the thoughts which are moving in their hearts even now, before I have taken them into the land of my oath.
sentences.susu: Tɔɔrɛe nun fe xɔrɔxɔɛe fa bira e fɔxɔ ra, yi bɛɛti fan findima seede nan na won tagi. E bɔnsɔɛ mu nɛɛmu a ma. Naxan na e xaxili kui, n a kolon. A ɲan toma e ya ma beenu e xa so bɔxi kui n nan n kalixi e bɛ naxan xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: So that same day Moses made this song, teaching it to the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Annabi Munsa naxa na bɛɛti sɛbɛ, Ala naxan masenxi. A naxa a xaran Isirayilakae ra.

sentences.english: Then he gave orders to Joshua, the son of Nun, saying to him, Be strong and take heart: for you are to go at the head of the children of Israel into the land which I made an oath to give them; and I will be with you.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi Alatala naxa a xa yaamari so Annabi Yosuwe yi ra, Nunu xa di. A naxa a masen a bɛ, «I xa limaniya, i xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ. I tan nan Isirayilakae rasoma bɔxi ma n nan n kalixi e bɛ naxan xa fe ra. Won birin na a ra.»

sentences.english: Now after writing all the words of this law in a book till the record of them was complete,
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa naxa Ala xa sɛriyɛ birin sɛbɛ kitaabui kui.

sentences.english: Moses said to the Levites who were responsible for taking up the ark of the Lord's agreement,
sentences.susu: A to gɛ, a naxa wɔyɛn Lewikae ra, naxee Alatala xa saatɛ kankira xaninma. A naxa a masen e bɛ,

sentences.english: Take this book of the law and put it by the ark of the Lord's agreement, so that it may be a witness against you.
sentences.susu: «Wo yi kitaabui tongo, Ala xa sɛriyɛ sɛbɛxi naxan kui, wo xa a sa wo Marigi Alatala xa saatɛ kankira sɛɛti ma. A xa lu mɛnni seede ra Isirayilakae bɛ,

sentences.english: For I have knowledge of your hard and uncontrolled hearts: even now, while I am still living, you will not be ruled by the Lord; how much less after my death?
sentences.susu: barima n wo xaxili xɔrɔxɔya kolon. Kantagbele nan wo ra. Xa wo Alatala matandima n wo tagi tɛmui naxɛ, n faxa xanbi wo man a matandima nɛ.

sentences.english: Get together before me all those who are in authority in your tribes, and your overseers, so that I may say these things in their hearing, and make heaven and earth my witnesses against them.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi wo wo malan n sɛɛti ma, forie nun wo bɔnsɔɛ yareratie, alako n xa yi masenyi xaran wo bɛ. Koore nun bɔxi nan findima seede ra wo xili ma.

sentences.english: For I am certain that after my death you will give yourselves up to sin, wandering from the way which I have given you; and evil will overtake you in the end, because you will do evil in the eyes of the Lord, moving him to wrath by the work of your hands.
sentences.susu: N a kolon n faxa xanbi, Isirayilakae yunubi fe rabama nɛ, e gbilen kira fɔxɔ ra n naxan falaxi e bɛ. E na fe kobi raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma, na raɲɔnyi fa findi e bɛ nimisɛ ra barima a bɔɲɛ tema nɛ.»

sentences.english: Then in the hearing of all the meeting of Israel, Moses said the words of this song, to the end.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa naxa yi bɛɛti birin masen Isirayila ɲama bɛ.

sentences.english: Give ear, O heavens, to my voice; let the earth take note of the words of my mouth:
sentences.susu: «Koore, i tuli mati n ma wɔyɛnyi ra. Bɔxi, i tuli mati n fala xui ra.

sentences.english: My teaching is dropping like rain, coming down like dew on the fields; like rain on the young grass and showers on the garden plants:
sentences.susu: N ma xaranyi xa yensen yɛ alɔ tunɛ ye. N ma masenyi xa lu alɔ xini, naxan dɔxɔma burɛxɛe ma.

sentences.english: For I will give honour to the name of the Lord: let our God be named great.
sentences.susu: N fa na Alatala xili nan masenfe. Wo xa won Marigi Ala tantu.»

sentences.english: He is the Rock, complete is his work; for all his ways are righteousness: a God without evil who keeps faith, true and upright is he.
sentences.susu: «Alatala maniyaxi fanye nan na, naxan mixi kantama. A walima tinxinyi nan na. A xa natɛe birin fan. A xa wɔyɛnyi mu kanama, wule yo mu na a dɛ kui. A tinxin.»

sentences.english: They have become false, they are not his children, the mark of sin is on them; they are an evil and hard-hearted generation.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ wo tan, ɲama ɲaaxi, wo bara geregiri Alatala ma. Yaagi na wo bɛ. Wo bara findi ɲama kobi ra.

sentences.english: Is this your answer to the Lord, O foolish people and unwise? Is he not your father who has given you life? He has made you and given you your place.
sentences.susu: Ɲama daxui, ɲama xaxilitare, mixi lan a xa na fe mɔɔli raba a ra? Wo baba mu lanxi a tan xa ma, wo daa Marigi, naxan wo findixi a xa ɲama ra?

sentences.english: Keep in mind the days of the past, give thought to the years of generations gone by: go to your father and he will make it clear to you, to the old men and they will give you the story.
sentences.susu: Wo wo maɲɔxun lɔxɔɛ dangixie ma, wo ɲɛe mato, wo wo babae nun forie maxɔrin, e xa fe dangixie tagi raba wo bɛ.

sentences.english: When the Most High gave the nations their heritage, separating into groups the children of men, he had the limits of the peoples marked out, keeping in mind the number of the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi naxa bɔxi itaxun adamadie ma. A naxa bɔxie naaninyi sa Isirayila xa die xasabi ma.

sentences.english: For the Lord's wealth is his people; Jacob is the land of his heritage.
sentences.susu: Isirayila ɲama naxa findi a gbe ra. Alatala naxa Yaxuba xa die findi a yɛtɛ gbe ra.»

sentences.english: He came to him in the waste land, in the unpeopled waste of sand: putting his arms round him and caring for him, he kept him as the light of his eye.
sentences.susu: «A Isirayila toxi gbengberen yire nɛ. A naxa a ɲɛngi sa a xɔn ma, a naxa mɛɛni a ma alɔ a ya di firinyie.

sentences.english: As an eagle, teaching her young to make their flight, with her wings outstretched over them, takes them up on her strong feathers:
sentences.susu: A luxi nɛ alɔ sɛgɛ, naxan luma a xa die xun ma, a a gabutenyi itala, a die xanin.

sentences.english: So the Lord only was his guide, no other god was with him.
sentences.susu: Alatala keren peti nan a xa ɲama kantaxi. Ala gbɛtɛ yo mu kafu a ma.»

sentences.english: He put him on the high places of the earth, his food was the increase of the field; honey he gave him out of the rock and oil out of the hard rock;
sentences.susu: «A naxa wo rasabati geya fari. A naxa wo rabalo xɛ sansie xun na. A naxa kumi nun ture ramini wo bɛ gɛmɛ longori ra.

sentences.english: Butter from his cows and milk from his sheep, with fat of lambs and sheep of Bashan, and goats, and the heart of the grain; and for your drink, wine from the blood of the grape.
sentences.susu: A naxa ninge nun yɛxɛɛ xiɲɛ fi wo ma. A naxa yɛxɛe, sie, nun si kontonyie fi wo ma sube ra kelife Basan bɔxi ma. A naxa mɛngi fi wo ma wo naxan donma, a naxa wɛni fi wo ma wo naxan minma.»

sentences.english: But Jeshurun became fat and would not be controlled: you have become fat, you are thick and full of food: then he was untrue to the God who made him, giving no honour to the Rock of his salvation.
sentences.susu: «Isirayila tinxinxi naxa belebele, a naxa findi di fanyi ra, kɔnɔ a bara gbilen Ala fɔxɔ ra, a daa Marigi, a bara a kantama, a rakisima rayaagi.

sentences.english: The honour which was his they gave to strange gods; by their disgusting ways he was moved to wrath.
sentences.susu: Isirayila naxa Ala raxɔnɔ barima a bira nɛ ala gbɛtɛe fɔxɔ ra, e fe ɲaaxi raba.

sentences.english: They made offerings to evil spirits which were not God, to gods who were strange to them, which had newly come up, not feared by your fathers.
sentences.susu: E naxa sɛrɛxɛ ba ɲinnɛe bɛ, naxee mu na Ala ra, e mu naxee kolon sinden, e babae mu naxee kolon.

sentences.english: You have no thought for the Rock, your father, you have no memory of the God who gave you birth.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae, wo bara nɛɛmu wo kantama ma naxan wo raminixi duniɲa ma, naxan simaya fima wo ma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord saw with disgust the evil-doing of his sons and daughters.
sentences.susu: «Alatala to bara a xa die kɛɲa to, a naxa xɔnɔ e ma.

sentences.english: And he said, My face will be veiled from them, I will see what their end will be: for they are an uncontrolled generation, children in whom is no faith.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen, ‹N xa gbilen e kantafe fɔxɔ ra, n fa a mato fe naxan fama e lide.› E mu fan. Yanfante nan e ra.

sentences.english: They have given my honour to that which is not God, moving me to wrath with their false worship: I will give their honour to those who are not a people, moving them to wrath by a foolish nation,
sentences.susu: E bara n naxɔnɔ ala wulee ra. E bara n bɔɲɛ rate kuyee ra. N tan fan e raxɔnɔma nɛ mixie ra, ɲama fanyi mu na naxee ra. N e bɔɲɛ rate si xaxilitare ma.»

sentences.english: For my wrath is a flaming fire, burning to the deep parts of the underworld, burning up the earth with her increase, and firing the deep roots of the mountains.
sentences.susu: «Iyo, n ma xɔnɛ bara gbo yɛ, han a bara mixi faxaxie ramaxa. A luma alɔ tɛ naxan bɔxi nun a daxamui ganma, han a sa dɔxɔ geyae sanke ra.

sentences.english: I will send a rain of troubles on them, my arrows will be showered on them.
sentences.susu: N fe ɲaaxi ragboma nɛ e fari, n nan n ma xalie birin wolima nɛ.

sentences.english: They will be wasted from need of food, and overcome by burning heat and bitter destruction; and the teeth of beasts I will send on them, with the poison of the worms of the dust.
sentences.susu: N kaamɛ rasoma bɔxi ma, n fure ɲaaxi rasanbama nɛ e ma, n wulai sube magaaxuxie raminima nɛ e ma, a nun bɔximase xɔnɛ kanyie.

sentences.english: Outside they will be cut off by the sword, and in the inner rooms by fear; death will take the young man and the virgin, the baby at the breast and the grey-haired man.
sentences.susu: Naxee na tande, fanfore nan e faxama. Naxee na banxi kui, gaaxui nan e faxama. E birin faxama nɛ, xɛmɛ nun ginɛ, dimɛdi nun fori.»

sentences.english: I said I would send them wandering far away, I would make all memory of them go from the minds of men:
sentences.susu: «N nu wama nɛ e birin halakife, e xili xa lɔɛ duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: But for the fear that their haters, uplifted in their pride, might say, Our hand is strong, the Lord has not done all this.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n mu tin yaxuie xa n mayele. N mu wa e xa a maɲɔxun a e tan nan yi wali rabaxi, Ala xa fɔxi mu a ra.

sentences.english: For they are a nation without wisdom; there is no sense in them.
sentences.susu: Xaxili kanyi mu na e ra, lɔnni mu e yi.

sentences.english: If only they were wise, if only this was clear to them, and they would give thought to their future!
sentences.susu: Xa lɔnni kanyi nan e ra nu, e e sigade kolonma nɛ nu.

sentences.english: How would it be possible for one to overcome a thousand, and two to send ten thousand in flight, if their rock had not let them go, if the Lord had not given them up?
sentences.susu: Yaxui keren tan nɔma Isirayilaka wulu keren nagide di? Yaxui firin nɔma birade mixi wulu fu fɔxɔ ra di? Iyo, xa e Marigi, e Kantama sa e lu e yaxuie sagoe, na nɔma nɛ rabade.

sentences.english: For their rock is not like our Rock, even our haters themselves being judges.
sentences.susu: Yaxuie yati a kolon, e xa ala e kantama mu dangi Isirayila Marigi Alatala ra.

sentences.english: For their vine is the vine of Sodom, from the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are the grapes of evil, and the berries are bitter:
sentences.susu: E xa fe mu dangi Sodoma nun Gomora ra. E birin maniyaxi wɛni bili nan na naxan bogi xɔnɛe raminima,

sentences.english: Their wine is the poison of dragons, the cruel poison of snakes.
sentences.susu: naxan ye luxi alɔ bɔximase xɔnɛ.

sentences.english: Is not this among my secrets, kept safe in my store-house?
sentences.susu: Na birin nagataxi gundo nan na n xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Punishment is mine and reward, at the time of the slipping of their feet: for the day of their downfall is near, sudden will be their fate.
sentences.susu: E na bira, n nan n gbeɲɔxɔma nɛ. A gbegbe mu luxi. E yigi tɛgɛ lɔxɔɛ bara makɔrɛ.»

sentences.english: For the Lord will be judge of his people, he will have pity for his servants; when he sees that their power is gone, there is no one, shut up or free.
sentences.susu: «Alatala fama a xa ɲama makiitide, kɔnɔ a man kinikinima nɛ e ma, barima e sɛnbɛ yo mu na. Mixi yo mu na naxan nɔma e malide.

sentences.english: And he will say, Where are their gods, the rock in which they put their faith?
sentences.susu: Ala e maxɔrinma nɛ fa, ‹Wo xa alae na minden, naxee nu wo kantama,

sentences.english: Who took the fat of their offerings, and the wine of their drink offering? Let them now come to your help, let them be your salvation.
sentences.susu: wo naxee rabaloxi sube ture ra, wo nu wɛni soma naxee yi ra? E xa e yɛtɛ masen wo bɛ, e xa wo rakisi, e xa wo ratanga.

sentences.english: See now, I myself am he; there is no other god but me: giver of death and life, wounding and making well: and no one has power to make you free from my hand.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi wo xa a kolon, n tan nan keren peti nɔma mixi rakiside. Ala gbɛtɛ mu na fo n keren. N tan nan mixi faxama, n a rakeli. N tan nan mixi maxɔnɔma, n a rayalan. Nde gbɛtɛ nɔma mixi nde bade n bɛlɛxɛ?

sentences.english: For lifting up my hand to heaven I say, By my unending life,
sentences.susu: N kali naxan ti, n bɛlɛxɛ tixi koore ma na nan yi ki: N ɲiɲɛ. N mu faxama abadan!

sentences.english: If I make sharp my shining sword, and my hand is outstretched for judging, I will give punishment to those who are against me, and their right reward to my haters.
sentences.susu: Xa n fanfore ralugan, xa n a suxu n bɛlɛxɛ kui, n nan n gbeɲɔxɔma nɛ n gerefae ma, n sare fima nɛ n xɔnmae ma.

sentences.english: I will make my arrows red with blood, my sword will be feasting on flesh, with the blood of the dead and the prisoners, of the long-haired heads of my haters.
sentences.susu: N nan n ma xalie rasiisima nɛ wuli ra, n ma fanfore sube donma nɛ. Geresoe yo mu kisima.›»

sentences.english: Be glad, O you his people, over the nations; for he will take payment for the blood of his servants, and will give punishment to his haters, and take away the sin of his land, for his people.
sentences.susu: «Si birin xa sɛɛwa Alatala xa ɲama ra. Alatala a xa konyie xa faxɛ ɲɔxɔma nɛ. A tɔɔrɛ dɔxɔma nɛ a gerefae ma. A a xa ɲama nun a xa bɔxi xun sarama nɛ.»

sentences.english: So Moses said all the words of this song in the hearing of the people, he and Hoshea, the son of Nun.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa nun Annabi Yosuwe, Nunu xa di, naxa yi bɛɛti masenyi birin xaran ɲama bɛ e xui itexi ra.

sentences.english: And after saying all this to the people,
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa to gɛ Alatala xa masenyi tide Isirayilakae bɛ,

sentences.english: Moses said to them, Let the words which I have said to you today go deep into your hearts, and give orders to your children to do every word of this law.
sentences.susu: a naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo xa yi masenyi suxu sɛnbɛ ra n naxan xaranxi wo bɛ to lɔxɔɛ. Wo xa a xaran wo xa die bɛ, alako e xa nɔ Alatala xa sɛriyɛ rabatude a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And this is no small thing for you, but it is your life, and through this you may make your days long in the land which you are going over Jordan to take for your heritage.
sentences.susu: Masenyi tilinxi nan yi masenyi ra, a naxa lu wo bɛ alɔ masenyi fufafui. A simaya nan fima wo ma bɔxi ma wo fama dɛnnaxɛ sɔtɔde Yurudɛn naakiri ma.»

sentences.english: That same day the Lord said to Moses,
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ kerenyi kui, Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ,

sentences.english: Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo in the land of Moab opposite Jericho; there you may see the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the children of Israel for their heritage:
sentences.susu: «Siga Abarimi geya longori, Nebo geya fari Mowaba bɔxi ma, Yeriko ya tagi. Mɛnni i xa Kanaan bɔxi mato, n naxan fima Isirayilakae ma.

sentences.english: And let death come to you on the mountain where you are going, and be put to rest with your people; as death came to Aaron, your brother, on Mount Hor, where he was put to rest with his people:
sentences.susu: I na te geya fari, i fama saya sɔtɔde naa, i i benbae li aligiyama, alɔ i taara Haruna xa fe rabaxi ki naxɛ Horo geya fari.

sentences.english: Because of your sin against me before the children of Israel at the waters of Meribath Kadesh in the waste land of Zin; because you did not keep my name holy among the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Wo na sɔtɔxi nɛ, barima wo mu wo xaxili ti n na Isirayilakae ya xɔri Meriba ye yire, Kadesi biri ra, Sini gbengberenyi ma. Na kui wo mu tin n binyade ɲama ya xɔri.

sentences.english: So you will see the land before you, but you will not go into the land which I am giving to the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na fe na a niyaxi a i nɔma bɔxi tode yire makuye gbansan nɛ, n naxan fixi Isirayilakae ma, kɔnɔ i tan gundi mu soma naa.»

sentences.english: Now this is the blessing which Moses, the man of God, gave to the children of Israel before his death.
sentences.susu: Beenu Annabi Munsa xa laaxira, Ala xa mixi, a duba nɛ Isirayilakae bɛ. A xa dubɛ masenyi nan ya:

sentences.english: He said, The Lord came from Sinai, dawning on them from Seir; shining out from Mount Paran, coming from Meribath Kadesh: from his right hand went flames of fire: his wrath made waste the peoples.
sentences.susu: «Alatala keli nɛ Turusinina geya fari alɔ soge. A naxa te Seyiri bɔxi ma Isirayilakae nu na dɛnnaxɛ. A naxa keli Paran geya yirefanyi ma, malekɛ gbegbe biraxi a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: All his holy ones are at his hand; they go at his feet; they are lifted up on his wings.
sentences.susu: Alatala Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ xanuma. A a xa mixie kantama, naxee birama a xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Moses gave us a law, a heritage for the people of Jacob.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa bara a xa sɛriyɛ fi won ma. Na sɛriyɛ findixi Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ xa dariyɛ mate nan na.

sentences.english: And there was a king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel came together.
sentences.susu: Alatala findixi Isirayila xa Mangɛ nan na, ɲama mangɛe xa malanyi e nun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe birin na.»

sentences.english: Let life not death be Reuben's, let not the number of his men be small.
sentences.susu: «Alatala xa Ruben bɔnsɔɛ xa simaya xun masa. A xa mixie xa gbo.»

sentences.english: And this is the blessing of Judah: he said, Give ear, O Lord, to the voice of Judah and make him one with his people: let your hands take up his cause, and be his help against his attackers.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa yi masenyi nan ti Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xa fe ra, «Alatala xa Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xui ramɛ, alako a xa gbilen a xa ɲama ma. A na katafe. Alatala xa a mali a yaxuie ya ra.»

sentences.english: And of Levi he said, Give your Thummim to Levi and let the Urim be with your loved one, whom you put to the test at Massah, with whom you were angry at the waters of Meribah;
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa yi masenyi nan ti Lewi bɔnsɔɛ xa fe ra, «Alatala, i bara i xa tɔnxumae Tumimi nun Urimi so Lewi bɔnsɔɛ yi ra. Bɔnsɔɛ tinxinxi nan e ra i naxee mato Masa, i naxee makiiti Meriba ye xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Who said of his father, Who is he? and of his mother, I have not seen her; he kept himself separate from his brothers and had no knowledge of his children: for they have given ear to your word and kept your agreement.
sentences.susu: E mu birama e baba nun e nga sagoe xa fɔxɔ ra, xa na mu e ngaxakerenyie nun e xa die, e tan birama i xa masenyi gbansan nan fɔxɔ ra, e birama i xa saatɛ nan tun fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: They will be the teachers of your decisions to Jacob and of your law to Israel: the burning of perfumes before you will be their right, and the ordering of burned offerings on your altar.
sentences.susu: E tan nan i xa yaamari masenma Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛe bɛ, e tan nan i xa sɛriyɛ raxaranma Isirayilakae birin na. E tan nan man surayi bama sɛrɛxɛ ra, e sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ba i xa sɛrɛxɛbade.

sentences.english: Let your blessing, O Lord, be on his substance, may the work of his hands be pleasing to you: may those who take up arms against him and all who have hate for him, be wounded through the heart, never to be lifted up again.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa sɛnbɛ fi e ma, i xa barakɛ sa e xa fe birin, i xa e gerefae rakori, i xa e yaxuie rabira alako e naxa gbilen xanbi ra fefe ma.»

sentences.english: And of Benjamin he said, Benjamin is the loved one of the Lord, he will be kept safe at all times; he will be covered by the Most High, resting between his arms.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa yi masenyi nan ti Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ xa fe ra, «Alatala xanuntenyi nan lanxi e ma. E Marigi Ala e ratangama nɛ, a man luma nɛ e tagi, a e kantama tɛmui birin.»

sentences.english: And of Joseph he said, Let the blessing of the Lord be on his land; for the good things of heaven on high, and the deep waters flowing under the earth,
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa yi masenyi nan ti Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ xa fe ra, «Alatala bara barakɛ sa e xa bɔxi. E ye sɔtɔma nɛ keli koore ma, e ye sɔtɔ keli bɔxi bun ma.

sentences.english: And the good things of the fruits of the sun, and the good things of the growth of the moons,
sentences.susu: Soge sansie rafanma nɛ, kike yo kike bogie gbeeli luma nɛ naa.

sentences.english: And the chief things of the oldest mountains, and the good things of the eternal hills,
sentences.susu: E daxamui fanyi sɔtɔma nɛ e xa geyae fari, naxee tixi naa kabi a fɔlɛ.

sentences.english: The good things of the earth and all its wealth, the good pleasure of him who was seen in the burning tree: may they come on the head of Joseph, on the head of him who was prince among his brothers.
sentences.susu: Ala xa yi bɔxi daxamui se fan. Naxan wɔyɛn wuri bili radɛxɛxi kui, a xa hinnɛ Yusufu ra, a naxan sugandixi mangɛ ra a ngaxakerenyie tagi.

sentences.english: He is a young ox, glory is his; his horns are the horns of the mountain ox, with which all peoples will be wounded, even to the ends of the earth: they are the ten thousands of Ephraim and the thousands of Manasseh.
sentences.susu: Xunnakeli na Yusufu bɛ. A sɛnbɛ gbo alɔ ninge tuura, feri firin nan na a xa geresose ra alɔ sɛxɛ ninge. A sie birin bɔnbɔma nee nan na han yire makuye. Efirami xa di wuyaxie nan a feri singe ra. Manasi xa di wuyaxie nan a feri firin nde ra.»

sentences.english: And of Zebulun he said, Be glad, Zebulun, in your going out; and, Issachar, in your tents.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa yi masenyi nan ti Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ xa fe ra, «Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ, wo xa sɛɛwa yulɛya nan kui. Isakari bɔnsɔɛ, wo xa sɛɛwa wo xa kiri banxi nan kui.

sentences.english: They will send out the word for the people to come to the mountain, taking there the offerings of righteousness: for the store of the seas will be theirs, and the secret wealth of the sand.
sentences.susu: Wo wo dɔxɔbooree xilima nɛ, wo sɛrɛxɛ ba geya fari Ala wa xɔn ki ma, barima wo wo baloe sɔtɔma fɔxɔ ye nɛ, a nun hɛɛri naxan na mɛyɛnyi kui.»

sentences.english: Of Gad he said, A blessing be on him who makes wide the limits of Gad: he takes his rest like a she-lion, taking for himself the arm and the crown of the head.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa yi masenyi nan ti Gadi xa fe ra, «Ala xa barakɛ sa mixi xa fe, naxan Gadi xa fe gboma. Gadi malabuma nɛ, alɔ yɛtɛ naxan a xa sube ibɔɔxi donma.

sentences.english: He kept for himself the first part, for his was the ruler's right: he put in force the righteousness of the Lord, and his decisions for Israel.
sentences.susu: Gadi bara bɔxi fanyi findi a gbe ra, alɔ mangɛ naxan a ɲɛrɛma ɲama ya ra. A bara Alatala xa natɛ rakamali, a man bara Ala xa kiiti sa Isirayila ma.»

sentences.english: And of Dan he said, Dan is a young lion, springing out from Bashan.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa yi masenyi nan ti Dana bɔnsɔɛ xa fe ra, «Dana luxi nɛ alɔ yɛtɛ yɔrɛ, naxan tuganma Basan bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, made glad with grace and full of the blessing of the Lord: the sea and its fishes will be his.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa yi masenyi nan ti Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ xa fe ra, «Xunnafanyi gbegbe na Nafatali nan bɛ. Alatala a rakamalixi fe fanyi ra. A xa bɔxi xa gbo yɛ sogegorode nun yirefanyi.»

sentences.english: And of Asher he said, Let Asher have the blessing of children; may he be pleasing to his brothers, and let his foot be wet with oil.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa yi masenyi nan ti Aseri bɔnsɔɛ xa fe ra, «Alatala xa barakɛ sa Aseri, Yaxuba xa die tagi. A ngaxakerenyie xa hinnɛ a ra. A xa ture xa gbo han.

sentences.english: Your shoes will be iron and brass; and as your days, so may your work be.
sentences.susu: A xa naadɛe xa yailan wure nun wure gbeeli ra. A sɛnbɛ xa bu alɔ a xa simaya.»

sentences.english: No other is like the God of Jeshurun, coming on the heavens to your help, and letting his glory be seen in the skies.
sentences.susu: «Isirayila, Ala maniyɛ yo mu na. A a ɲɛrɛma koore ma fafe ra i malide. A nuxui igirima nɔrɛ ra.

sentences.english: The God of your fathers is your safe resting-place, and under you are his eternal arms: driving out the forces of your haters from before you, he said, Let destruction overtake them.
sentences.susu: Ala, fɔlɛ mu naxan bɛ, na nan i kantama ra, a bɛlɛxɛ na i bun kabi fe fɔlɔ fɔlɛ. A tan nan i yaxuie kerima i ya ra, a man fa a masen i bɛ i xa e halaki.

sentences.english: And Israel is living in peace, the fountain of Jacob by himself, in a land of grain and wine, with dew dropping from the heavens.
sentences.susu: Isirayila sabatima kantari nan kui. Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ luma Ala niini nan bun ma. Mɛngi nun wɛni gboma nɛ na bɔxi kui, ye fan kelima nɛ koore ma.

sentences.english: Happy are you, O Israel: who is like you, a people whose saviour is the Lord, whose help is your cover, whose sword is your strength! All those who are against you will put themselves under your rule, and your feet will be planted on their high places.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ na wo bɛ, Isirayilakae. Wo maniyɛ yo mu na sie tagi, Alatala naxan kisixi, a naxan kantaxi, a naxan xun nakelixi. Wo yaxuie fama nɛ e magorode wo ya ra, wo fan e xa batudee kanama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And Moses went up from the table-lands of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah which is facing Jericho. And the Lord let him see all the land, the land of Gilead as far as Dan;
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa naxa te Nebo geya fari, Mowaba bɔxi ma, han Pisiga geya, naxan na Yeriko sogetede. Alatala naxa bɔxi birin masen a bɛ, keli Galadi a sa dɔxɔ Dana ra,

sentences.english: And all Naphtali and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, as far as the Great Sea of the west;
sentences.susu: Nafatali bɔxi, Efirami nun Manasi xa bɔxi, Yuda xa bɔxi han baa ma naxan na sogegorode,

sentences.english: And the South, and the circle of the valley of Jericho, the town of palm-trees, as far as Zoar.
sentences.susu: Negewi bɔxi, a sa raɲɔn Yurudɛn longorie ra, Yeriko lanbanyi, tugi bili taa, han Sowari.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to him, This is the land about which I made an oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, saying, I will give it to your seed: now I have let you see it with your eyes, but you will not go in there.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «I ya ti bɔxi ra n naxan saatɛ tongoxi Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Yaxuba bɛ. N naxa a fala e bɛ, ‹N yi bɔxi fima wo bɔnsɔɛ nan ma.› N xa na bɔxi masen i bɛ, kɔnɔ i mu soma naa.»

sentences.english: So death came to Moses, the servant of the Lord, there in the land of Moab, as the Lord had said.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa, Alatala xa konyi, naxa laaxira mɛnni, Mowaba bɔxi ma, alɔ Alatala a masen ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord put him to rest in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth-peor: but no man has knowledge of his resting-place to this day.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a ragata Mowaba bɔxi ma gulunba kui Beti Peyori ya tagi. Mixi yo mu nɔxi a xa gaburi yire kolonde han to.

sentences.english: And Moses at his death was a hundred and twenty years old: his eye had not become clouded, or his natural force become feeble.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa laaxiraxi a ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nan ma. Na birin a ya nu se toma a fanyi ra, a sɛnbɛ fan nu gbo.

sentences.english: For thirty days the children of Israel were weeping for Moses in the table-lands of Moab, till the days of weeping and sorrow for Moses were ended.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa a wa Mowaba bɔxi ma xi tongo saxan bun ma. E Annabi Munsa xa ɲɔn fe raba na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And Joshua, the son of Nun, was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had put his hands on him: and the children of Israel gave ear to him, and did as the Lord had given orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa nu bara a bɛlɛxɛ sa Annabi Yosuwe ma, Nunu xa di, a fa rafe xaxilimaya ra. Isirayilakae naxa Yosuwe xui rabatu birafe Annabi Munsa xa yaamarie fɔxɔ ra, Alatala naxee fixi a ma.

sentences.english: There has never been another prophet in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord had knowledge of face to face;
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔxi ma, namiɲɔnmɛ yo mu nu na na naxan maniyama Annabi Munsa ra. A wɔyɛn Ala ra ya nun ya.

sentences.english: In all the signs and wonders which the Lord sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh and to all his servants and all his land;
sentences.susu: Ala a xɛɛ nɛ Misira fe kaabanakoe rabade Firawuna, a xa yareratie, nun a xa mixi birin xili ma.

sentences.english: And in all the acts of power and fear which Moses did before the eyes of all Israel.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa walixi sɛnbɛ magaaxuxi nan na Isirayilakae birin ya xɔri.

sentences.english: Now after the death of Moses, the servant of the Lord, the word of the Lord came to Joshua, the son of Nun, Moses' helper, saying,
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa, Alatala xa konyi to laaxira, Alatala naxa a masen Nunu xa di xɛmɛ Yosuwe bɛ, Annabi Munsa malima,

sentences.english: Moses my servant is dead; so now get up! Go over Jordan, you and all this people, into the land which I am giving to them, to the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: «N ma konyi Munsa bara laaxira. Yakɔsi, keli i xa Yurudɛn igiri nun yi ɲama birin na. Wo xa siga bɔxi ma n dɛnnaxɛ sofe Isirayilakae yi ra.

sentences.english: Every place on which you put your foot I have given to you, as I said to Moses.
sentences.susu: Wo na wo sanyi ti dɛnnaxɛ birin ma, n naa fima nɛ wo ma, alɔ n a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: From the waste land and this mountain Lebanon, as far as the great river, the river Euphrates, and all the land of the Hittites to the Great Sea, in the west, will be your country.
sentences.susu: Wo xa naaninyie kelima gbengberen yire nɛ, a sa dɔxɔ Liban geyae ra, han Efirati xure belebele ra, Xitikae xa bɔxi birin sa dɔxɔ Baa Xungbe ra sogegorode.

sentences.english: While you are living, all will give way before you: as I was with Moses, so I will be with you; I will not take away my help from you or give you up.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu nɔma i ra i xa simaya kui. Won birin na a ra, alɔ muxu nun Munsa nu a ra ki naxɛ. N mu i rabɛɲinma, n mu i raboloma.»

sentences.english: Take heart and be strong; for you will give to this people for their heritage the land which I gave by an oath to their fathers.
sentences.susu: «I i sɛnbɛ so, i xa limaniya, barima i tan nan findima saabui ra yi ɲama bɛ, e xa nɔ kɛ tongode, n nan n kali bɔxi naxan xa fe ra e babae bɛ fife ra e ma.

sentences.english: Only take heart and be very strong; take care to do all the law which Moses my servant gave you, not turning from it to the right hand or to the left, so that you may do well in all your undertakings.
sentences.susu: I lan nɛ i xa i sɛnbɛ so, limaniya xa lu i bɛ ki fanyi ra. I xa i ɲɛngi sa yi sɛriyɛ birin xɔn ma, i xa a rabatu alɔ n ma konyi Annabi Munsa i yamarixi a ra ki naxɛ. I naxa binya yirefanyi ma, i naxa binya kɔɔla ma, alako i xa xutu sɔtɔ yire ma i na siga dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Let this book of the law be ever on your lips and in your thoughts day and night, so that you may keep with care everything in it; then a blessing will be on all your way, and you will do well.
sentences.susu: Yi sɛriyɛ kitaabui falɛ mu lan a xa makuya i dɛ ra. I xa i ɲɛngi sa a xɔn ma kɔɛ nun yanyi, alako i xa a birin nabatu. Naxan birin sɛbɛxi i xa a rawali, barima na nan a niyama i na so fe naxan birin ya ma, i xutu sɔtɔma a ma, i findima a ra na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Have I not given you your orders? Take heart and be strong; have no fear and do not be troubled; for the Lord your God is with you wherever you go,
sentences.susu: N naxan falaxi i bɛ, i naxa nɛɛmu. I i sɛnbɛ so, i xa limaniya. I naxa gaaxu, i naxa hanmɛ, barima i na siga dɛdɛ, i nun n tan i Marigi Alatala birin na a ra.»

sentences.english: Then Joshua gave their orders to those who were in authority over the people, saying,
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa yi yaamari so ɲama xunyie yi ra:

sentences.english: Go through the tents and give orders to the people, saying, Get ready a store of food; for in three days you are to go over this river Jordan and take for your heritage the land which the Lord your God is giving you.
sentences.susu: «Wo wo ɲɛrɛ ɲama tagi, wo e yaamari yi ra, ‹Wo wo xa donsee xunlan, barima won fama Yurudɛn igiride beenun xi saxan, alako wo xa bɔxi masɔtɔ won Marigi Alatala naxan sofe wo yi.›»

sentences.english: And to the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said,
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa a fala Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti bɛ,

sentences.english: Keep in mind what Moses, the servant of the Lord, said to you, The Lord your God is sending you rest and will give you this land.
sentences.susu: «Wo ratu Alatala xa konyi Munsa xa yaamari ma. A to a fala, ‹Wo Marigi Alatala bara malabui fi wo ma. A bara yi bɔxi so wo yi.›

sentences.english: Your wives, your little ones, and your cattle will be kept here in the land which Moses gave you on this side of Jordan; but you, the fighting-men, are to go over before your brothers, armed, to give them help;
sentences.susu: Wo xa ginɛe, wo xa die, nun wo xa xurusee nɔma lude bɔxi ma Annabi Munsa naxan soxi wo yi ra Yurudɛn kiri ma. Kɔnɔ wo tan tima a gereso ki nan ma wo ngaxakerenyie ya ra. Wo xa e mali,

sentences.english: Till the Lord has given your brothers rest, as he has given it to you, and they have taken their heritage in the land which the Lord your God is giving them: then you will go back to the land of your heritage which Moses, the servant of the Lord, gave you on the east side of Jordan.
sentences.susu: han beenun Alatala malabui fima e ma tɛmui naxɛ alɔ wo tan, han e fan xa bɔxi masɔtɔ wo Marigi Alatala naxan fife e ma. Na xanbi, wo man fa gbilen wo xa bɔxi ma, Alatala xa konyi Munsa naxan fixi wo ma Yurudɛn kiri ma, sogetede biri.»

sentences.english: Then they said to Joshua in answer, Whatever you say to us we will do, and wherever you send us we will go.
sentences.susu: E naxa Yosuwe yaabi, «I muxu yamarixi fe naxan birin na, muxu a rabama nɛ. I na muxu xɛɛ dɛnnaxɛ fan, muxu sigama nɛ.

sentences.english: As we gave attention to Moses in all things, so we will give attention to you: and may the Lord your God be with you as he was with Moses.
sentences.susu: Muxu i xui rabatuma nɛ fe birin ma, alɔ muxu Annabi Munsa xui rabatu ki naxɛ. I Marigi Alatala xa bira i fɔxɔ ra alɔ e nun Munsa nu a ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Whoever goes against your orders, and does not give attention to all your words, will be put to death: only take heart and be strong.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo kalabante i xui ma, a mu bira i wɔyɛn xui fɔxɔ ra, i fe naxan birin falama a bɛ, a mu na mɛ, na kanyi faxama nɛ. I xa i sɛnbɛ so, i man xa limaniya.»

sentences.english: Then Joshua, the son of Nun, sent two men from Shittim secretly, with the purpose of searching out the land, and Jericho. So they went and came to the house of a loose woman of the town, named Rahab, where they took their rest for the night.
sentences.susu: Nunu xa di Yosuwe, naxa fe rabɛnyi firin xɛɛ a gundo ki ma keli Sitimi sigafe ra Yeriko. A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo siga Yeriko taa nun a rabilinyi rabɛnde.» E naxa siga, e sa so Raxabi langoe ginɛ nde xa banxi kui. Na naxa e yigiya naa.

sentences.english: And it was said to the king of Jericho, See, some men have come here tonight from the children of Israel with the purpose of searching out the land.
sentences.susu: Yerikoka ndee naxa sa a fala e xa mangɛ bɛ, «I bara a to, Isirayilaka mixi firin bara fa to kɔɛ ra, e xa fa yi bɔxi rabɛn.»

sentences.english: Then the king of Jericho sent to Rahab, saying, Send out the men who have come to you and are in your house; for they have come with the purpose of searching out all the land.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Yeriko mangɛ naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Raxabi ma, e xa a fala a bɛ, «Xɛmɛ naxee soxi i xɔnyi, e ramini, barima e faxi yi bɔxi ife nan birin nabɛnde.»

sentences.english: And the woman took the two men and put them in a secret place; then she said, Yes, the men came to me, but I had no idea where they came from;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Raxabi nu bara yi xɛmɛ firinyie xanin, a sa e nɔxun. A naxa a fala mangɛ xa xɛɛrae bɛ, «Iyo, yi xɛmɛe fa nɛ n xɔnyi, kɔnɔ n mu e kelide kolon.

sentences.english: And when it was the time for shutting the doors at dark, they went out; I have no idea where the men went: but if you go after them quickly, you will overtake them.
sentences.susu: E siga nɛ nunmare ra, taa naadɛ balan tɛmui. Yi xɛmɛe sigaxi dɛdɛ, n mu a kolon. Xa wo sa wo xulun, wo nɔma e suxude!»

sentences.english: But she had taken them up to the roof, covering them with the stems of flax which she had put out in order there.
sentences.susu: Raxabi nu bara yi xɛmɛe rate banxi gbanyi ra, a e nɔxun sansi xabaxi xaree ya ma.

sentences.english: So the men went after them on the road to Jordan as far as the river-crossing: and when they had gone out after them, the door into the town was shut.
sentences.susu: E fenmae naxa siga Yurudɛn kira xɔn, han e xure igiride li. E to mini, taakae naxa taa naadɛ balan.

sentences.english: And before the men went to rest, she came up to them on the roof,
sentences.susu: Beenun fe rabɛnyie xa xi, Raxabi naxa te banxi gbanyi ra e yire.

sentences.english: And said to them, It is clear to me that the Lord has given you the land, and that the fear of you has come on us;
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «N bara a kolon, Alatala bara muxu xa bɔxi so wo yi ra. Wo mirinyi bara a niya limaniya bara ba muxu tan birin yi ra. Yi bɔxi mixie bara sɛrɛn wo ya ra,

sentences.english: For we have had news of how the Lord made the Red Sea dry before you when you came out of Egypt; and what you did to the two kings of the Amorites, on the other side of Jordan, to Sihon and Og, whom you gave up to the curse.
sentences.susu: barima muxu bara a mɛ a Alatala bara Xulunyumi Baa xara wo ya ra, wo nu minima Misira tɛmui naxɛ. Muxu man bara a mɛ wo naxan nabaxi Amorikae xa mangɛ firinyie ra, Sixɔn nun Ogo, naxee nu na Yurudɛn kiri ma. Wo naxa e ratɔn, a nun e kɛ birin na.

sentences.english: And because of this news, our hearts became like water, and there was no more spirit in any of us because of you; for the Lord your God is God in heaven on high and here on earth.
sentences.susu: Muxu to na fe mɛ, muxu bɔɲɛ naxa kana. Limaniya naxa ba kankan yi ra wo xa fe ra, barima wo Marigi Alatala nan na Ala ra koore nun bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: So now, will you give me your oath by the Lord, that, because I have been kind to you, you will be kind to my father's house,
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi, wo xa wo kali n bɛ Alatala xili ra, a n kui ifanyiɲa naxan nabaxi wo bɛ, wo fan nɔma na kui ifanyiɲa mɔɔli rabade n tan fan nun n ma denbaya bɛ. Wo xa tɔnxuma nde so n yi ra, alako n xa a kolon

sentences.english: And that you will keep safe my father and mother and my brothers and sisters and all they have, so that death may not come on us?
sentences.susu: wo mu n baba, n nga, n xunyae, n taarae, nun e xa mixi keren faxama.»

sentences.english: And the men said to her, Our life for yours if you keep our business secret; and when the Lord has given us the land, we will keep faith and be kind to you.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛe naxa Raxabi yaabi, «Muxu rɛdixi faxafe ma wo ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Xa i mu muxu xa fe fala mixi yo bɛ, muxu fan kui ifanyiɲa rabama nɛ i bɛ dugutɛgɛɲa nun tinxinyi ra, Alatala na yi bɔxi so muxu yi ra tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Then she let them down from the window by a cord, for the house where she was living was on the town wall.
sentences.susu: Raxabi naxa na xɛmɛe ragoro luuti ma wundɛri ra, barima a xa banxi nu fatuxi tɛtɛ nan na. A nu sabatixi na tɛtɛ nan kui.

sentences.english: And she said to them, Get away into the hill-country, or the men who have gone after you will overtake you; keep yourselves safe there for three days, till the searchers have come back, and then go on your way.
sentences.susu: Raxabi naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo siga geya biri, xa na mu a ra wo fenmae wo toma nɛ. Wo xa wo nɔxun mɛnni han xi saxan, beemanu wo fenmae gbilenma tɛmui naxɛ. Na xanbi, wo fa siga wo xa ɲɛrɛ ra.»

sentences.english: And the men said to her, We will only be responsible for this oath which you have made us take,
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛe naxa a fala Raxabi bɛ, «Muxu mu muxu xa marakali kanama,

sentences.english: If, when we come into the land, you put this cord of bright red thread in the window from which you let us down; and get your father and mother and your brothers and all your family into the house;
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ fo i xa yi luuti gbeeli xiri wundɛri ra, i muxu ramini dɛnnaxɛ ra. Muxu na fa tɛmui naxɛ yi bɔxi ma, a lanma muxu xa na luuti li naa. I man xa i baba, i nga, i taarae, i xunyae, nun i xa mixie birin malan be i xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: Then if anyone goes out of your house into the street, his blood will be on his head, we will not be responsible; but if any damage comes to anyone in the house, his blood will be on our heads.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi yo mini i xa banxi kui, xa na kanyi faxa, a a tarixi nɛ, muxu tan fɔxi mu na ki. Kɔnɔ xa muxu xa mixi nde a bɛlɛxɛ din i xa mixi nde ra i xa banxi kui, muxu muxu tarixi nɛ na tɛmui.

sentences.english: But if you say anything about our business here, then we will be free from the oath you have made us take.
sentences.susu: Xa i muxu xa fe fala mixi nde bɛ, muxu bara fulun yi marakali ma.»

sentences.english: And she said, Let it be as you say. Then she sent them away, and they went; and she put the bright red cord in the window.
sentences.susu: Raxabi naxa e yaabi, «Won bara lan na ma.» A naxa na xɛmɛe bɛɲin, e naxa siga. Na tɛmui a naxa na luuti gbeeli xiri wundɛri ra.

sentences.english: And they went into the hill-country and were there three days, till the men who had gone after them had come back; and those who went after them were searching for them everywhere without coming across them.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛe naxa siga. E to geya yire li, e naxa e nɔxun naa xi saxan, han e fenmae naxa gbilen. E fenmae naxa e fen kira xɔn, kɔnɔ e mu e to.

sentences.english: Then the two men came down from the hill-country and went over and came back to Joshua, the son of Nun; and they gave him a complete account of what had taken place.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui na xɛmɛ firinyie naxa goro geya fari fa, e Yurudɛn igiri, e gbilen Nunu xa di Yosuwe yire. Fe naxan e sɔtɔ, e naxa na birin tagi raba a bɛ.

sentences.english: And they said to Joshua, Truly, the Lord has given all the land into our hands; and all the people of the land have become like water because of us.
sentences.susu: E naxɛ Yosuwe bɛ, «Muxu a kolon Alatala bara na bɔxi birin sa won bɛlɛxɛ i. Limaniya bara ba na bɔxi mixi birin yi ra tife ra won kanke.»

sentences.english: Then Joshua got up early in the morning, and, moving on from Shittim, he and all the children of Israel came to Jordan and were there for the night before going over.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa kurun keli ra Sitimi, e Yurudɛn li, a tan nun Isirayilakae birin. E naxa xi mɛnni han beenun Yurudɛn igiri lɔxɔɛ xa a li.

sentences.english: And at the end of three days, the men in authority over the people went through the tents,
sentences.susu: A xi saxan nde, ɲama xunyie naxa ɲama yonkinde iɲɛrɛ,

sentences.english: Giving the people their orders, and saying, When you see the ark of the agreement of the Lord your God lifted up by the priests, the Levites, then get up from your places and go after it;
sentences.susu: e fa ɲama yaamari yi ra, «Wo na wo Marigi Alatala xa saatɛ kankira to tɛmui naxɛ, a dɔxɔxi Lewi die sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xun ma, wo xa bira e fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: But let there be a space between you and it of about two thousand cubits: come no nearer to it, so that you may see the way you have to go, for you have not been over this way before.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a lanma yaamilɛ keren xasabi xa lu wo tan nun e tan tagi. Wo naxa wo makɔrɛ e ra de. Wo fama kira tode na ki nɛ wo wo ɲɛrɛma naxan xɔn, barima wo singe mu nu mini na kira ra sinden.»

sentences.english: And Joshua said to the people, Make yourselves holy, for tomorrow the Lord will do works of wonder among you.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa a fala ɲama bɛ, «Wo wo yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn, barima tina Alatala kaabanakoe masenma nɛ wo bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Joshua said to the priests, Take up the ark of the agreement and go over in front of the people. So they took up the ark of the agreement and went in front of the people.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Yosuwe naxa a fala sɛrɛxɛdubɛe bɛ, «Wo saatɛ kankira tongo, wo xa ti ɲama ya ra.» E naxa saatɛ kankira tongo, e naxa e ɲɛrɛ ɲama ya ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Joshua, From now on I will give you glory in the eyes of all Israel, so that they may see that, as I was with Moses, so I will be with you.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Yosuwe bɛ, «N i xa fe gbo fɔlɔma nɛ Isirayilakae birin ya xɔri to lɔxɔɛ, alako e xa a kolon won birin na a ra, alɔ muxu nun Munsa nu a ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And you are to give orders to the priests who take up the ark of the agreement, and say, When you come to the edge of the waters of Jordan, go no further.
sentences.susu: I tan fan xa yi yaamari so sɛrɛxɛdubɛe yi naxee yi saatɛ kankira xaninma, ‹Wo na Yurudɛn xure dɛ li, na tɛmui wo xa goro Yurudɛn ye xɔɔra.›»

sentences.english: And Joshua said to the children of Israel, Come to me here: and give ear to the words of the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa a masen Isirayilakae bɛ, «Wo fa be, wo xa wo tuli mati wo Marigi Alatala xa masenyi ra.»

sentences.english: And Joshua said, By this you will see that the living God is among you, and that he will certainly send out from before you the Canaanite and the Hittite and the Hivite and the Perizzite and the Girgashite and the Amorite and the Jebusite.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa a masen, «Yi nan fama a niyade wo xa a kolon Ala ɲiɲɛ na a ra. A na wo tagi, a tan fama nɛ Kanaankae, Xitikae, Hiwikae, Perisikae, Girigasakae, Amorikae, nun Yebusukae ragide wo ya ra.

sentences.english: See, the ark of the agreement of the Lord of all the earth is going over before you into Jordan.
sentences.susu: Wo bara a to Marigi, naxan na duniɲa birin Marigi ra, na xa saatɛ kankira tixi wo ya ra, a na Yurudɛn igirife.

sentences.english: So take twelve men out of the tribes of Israel, a man from every tribe.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi wo xa xɛmɛ fu nun firin sugandi Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ fu nun firinyie ya ma, bɔnsɔɛ keren, xɛmɛ keren.

sentences.english: And when the feet of the priests who take up the ark of the Lord, the Lord of all the earth, come to rest in the waters of Jordan, the waters of Jordan will be cut off, all the waters flowing down from higher up, and will come together in a mass.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxee duniɲa birin Marigi Alatala xa saatɛ kankira xaninma, nee nɛfɛ e sanyi rasin Yurudɛn xure ma, Yurudɛn ye bolonma nɛ. Ye naxan kelima fuge biri ra, na birin a malanma yire keren nɛ.»

sentences.english: So when the people went out from their tents to go over Jordan, the priests who took up the ark of the agreement were in front of the people;
sentences.susu: Ɲama to mini e xa kiri banxie kui Yurudɛn igirife ra, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxee saatɛ kankira xaninma, nee fan naxa e ɲɛrɛ fɔlɔ ɲama ya ra.

sentences.english: And when those who took up the ark came to Jordan, and the feet of the priests who took up the ark were touching the edge of the water (for the waters of Jordan are overflowing all through the time of the grain-cutting),
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe fɛfɛ Yurudɛn li, e e sanyie rasin ye xɔɔra, Yurudɛn xure naxan ye nu banbaranma yire birin na xɛ xaba tɛmui,

sentences.english: Then the waters flowing down from higher up were stopped and came together in a mass a long way back at Adam, a town near Zarethan; and the waters flowing down to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, were cut off: and the people went across opposite Jericho.
sentences.susu: na ye naxan kelima fuge biri ra, na naxa bolon, a fa malan yire makuye Adama taa longori, naxan nu na Saratan taa fɛ ma. Ye naxan goroma Fɔxɔɛ Baa ma Yurudɛn fole kui, na birin naxa bolon, ɲama naxa giri Yeriko ya tagi.

sentences.english: And the priests who took up the ark of the agreement of the Lord kept their places, with their feet on dry land in the middle of Jordan, while all Israel went over on dry land, till all the nation had gone over Jordan.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxee nu Alatala xa saatɛ kankira xaninma, nee naxa ti Yurudɛn tagi bɔxi xare ma, han Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin naxa gɛ Yurudɛn igiride e xaraxi ra.

sentences.english: Now when all the nation had come to the other side of Jordan, the Lord said to Joshua,
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin to gɛ Yurudɛn igiride, Alatala naxa a masen Yosuwe bɛ,

sentences.english: Take twelve men from the people, a man for every tribe,
sentences.susu: «Wo xɛmɛ fu nun firin mayegeti ɲama ya ma, bɔnsɔɛ keren, xɛmɛ keren.

sentences.english: And say to them, Take up from the middle of Jordan, from the place where the feet of the priests were resting, twelve stones, and take them over with you and put them down in the place where you take your rest tonight.
sentences.susu: Wo xa e yaamari e xa gɛmɛ fu nun firin tongo Yurudɛn xure tagi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe sanyi xaraxie nu tixi dɛnnaxɛ. Wo e xanin yire wo kɔɛ radangima dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: So Joshua sent for the twelve men, whom he had ready, one man out of every tribe of the children of Israel,
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa xɛmɛ fu nun firinyie xili e naxee mayegetixi Isirayilakae ya ma, bɔnsɔɛ keren, xɛmɛ keren.

sentences.english: And he said to them, Go over before the ark of the Lord your God into the middle of Jordan, and let every one of you take up a stone on his back, one for every tribe of the children of Israel:
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo dangi wo Marigi Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ya ra, wo xa siga Yurudɛn xure tagi. Wo tan mixi keren kerenma birin xa gɛmɛ keren keren tongo Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ kɔnti ma, wo a dɔxɔ wo tunkie fari,

sentences.english: So that this may be a sign among you; when your children say to you in time to come, What is the reason for these stones?
sentences.susu: alako na xa findi tɔnxuma ra wo tagi. Wo xa die fama wo maxɔrinde tina, ‹Yi gɛmɛe findixi wo bɛ munse ra?›

sentences.english: Then you will say to them, Because the waters of Jordan were cut off before the ark of the Lord's agreement; when it went over Jordan the waters of Jordan were cut off: and these stones will be a sign for the children of Israel, keeping it in their memory for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo a falama nɛ e bɛ, ‹Yi nan a masenxi a Yurudɛn ye bolon nɛ Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ya ra. A nu Yurudɛn igirima tɛmui naxɛ, xure ye birin naxa bolon. Yi gɛmɛe findixi ɲɔxɔ rasiga se nan na Isirayilakae bɛ tɛmui birin.›»

sentences.english: So the children of Israel did as Joshua gave them orders, and took twelve stones from the middle of Jordan, as the Lord had said to Joshua, one for every tribe of the children of Israel; these they took across with them to their night's resting-place and put them down there.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxan fala Isirayilakae bɛ, e naxa na raba. E naxa gɛmɛ fu nun firinyie tongo Yurudɛn xure tagi, alɔ Alatala a masen Yosuwe bɛ ki naxɛ, e sa e tongo Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ kɔnti ma. E naxa e xanin ɲama yonkinde, e e dɔxɔ naa.

sentences.english: And Joshua put up twelve stones in the middle of Jordan, where the feet of the priests who took up the ark of the agreement had been placed: and there they are to this day.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa gɛmɛ fu nun firin gbɛtɛe malan Yurudɛn xure tagi, Ala xa saatɛ kankira xaninmae nu tixi dɛnnaxɛ. Han to na gɛmɛ malanxie na naa.

sentences.english: For the priests who took up the ark kept there in the middle of Jordan till all the orders given to Joshua by Moses from the Lord had been done: then the people went over quickly.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxee nu saatɛ kankira xaninma, nee naxa ti Yurudɛn xure tagi, han ɲama gɛ Alatala xa yaamari birin nabatude, alɔ Annabi Munsa nu bara a masen Yosuwe bɛ ki naxɛ. Ɲama birin naxa dangi mafuren mafuren.

sentences.english: And when all the people had come to the other side, the ark of the Lord went over, and the priests, before the eyes of the people.
sentences.susu: E to bara gɛ dangide, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxa dangi ɲama ya ra, e nun Alatala xa saatɛ kankira.

sentences.english: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh went over armed before the children of Israel as Moses had said to them:
sentences.susu: Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti naxa dangi, e ti e gereso ki ma Isirayila ɲama ya ra, alɔ Annabi Munsa a fala e bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: About forty thousand armed for war went over before the Lord to the fight, to the lowlands of Jericho.
sentences.susu: Geresoe mixi wulu tongo naani ɲɔndɔn naxa dangi Alatala ya tode ra, geresose na e yi ra, e rɛdixi sigafe ra Yeriko fiili ma gere sode.

sentences.english: That day the Lord made Joshua great in the eyes of all Israel; and all the days of his life they went in fear of him, as they had gone in fear of Moses.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Alatala naxa Yosuwe xili gbo Isirayilakae birin ya xɔri. E naxa a binya a xa simaya kui alɔ e nu Annabi Munsa binyama ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to Joshua,
sentences.susu: Na xanbi Alatala naxa a masen Yosuwe bɛ,

sentences.english: Give orders to the priests who take up the ark of witness, to come up out of Jordan.
sentences.susu: «Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe yaamari, naxee sɛriyɛ kankira xaninma, e xa te Yurudɛn xure kui.»

sentences.english: So Joshua gave orders to the priests, saying, Come up now out of Jordan.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe yaamari, «Wo te Yurudɛn xure kui.»

sentences.english: And when the priests who took up the ark of the Lord's agreement came up out of Jordan and their feet came out on to dry land, the waters of Jordan went back to their place, overflowing its edges as before.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxee Alatala xa saatɛ kankira xaninma, nee nu e sanyi talama tɛmui naxɛ kelife ra Yurudɛn xure kui, Yurudɛn ye man naxa gbilen a yire, a man naxa a ɲɛrɛ fɔlɔ alɔ a singe. A naxa banbaran yɛ Yurudɛn yire birin ma.

sentences.english: So on the tenth day of the first month the people came up out of Jordan, and put up their tents in Gilgal, on the east side of Jericho.
sentences.susu: Ɲama keli Yurudɛn xure kike singe xi fu nde nɛ, e fa sa yonkin Giligali, Yeriko sogetede biri.

sentences.english: And the twelve stones which they took out of Jordan, Joshua put up in Gilgal.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa gɛmɛ fu nun firinyie malan Giligali, e naxee tongo Yurudɛn xure tagi,

sentences.english: And he said to the children of Israel, When your children say to their fathers in time to come, What is the reason for these stones?
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Isirayilakae bɛ, «Xa wo xa die sa wo maxɔrin yi gɛmɛe xa fe ra,

sentences.english: Then give your children the story, and say, Israel came over this river Jordan on dry land.
sentences.susu: wo xa e yaabi, ‹Isirayila yi Yurudɛn xure igiri a xaraxi nan na.›

sentences.english: For the Lord your God made the waters of Jordan dry before you till you had gone across, as he did to the Red Sea, drying it up before us till we had gone across:
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala yi xure xaraxi wo ya xɔri nɛ, han wo birin naxa gɛ dangide alɔ wo Marigi Alatala a raba Xulunyumi Baa ra ki naxɛ. Na naxa xara muxu ya xɔri han muxu birin naxa gɛ a igiride,

sentences.english: So that all the peoples of the earth may see that the hand of the Lord is strong; and that they may go in fear of the Lord your God for ever.
sentences.susu: alako duniɲa si birin xa nɔ a kolonde Alatala xɔnyɛ findixi xɔnyɛ barakaxi nan na, wo man xa gaaxu wo Marigi Alatala ya ra.»

sentences.english: Now when the news came to all the kings of the Amorites on the west side of Jordan, and all the kings of the Canaanites living by the sea, how the Lord had made the waters of Jordan dry before the children of Israel, till they had gone across, their hearts became like water, and there was no more spirit in them, because of the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Amorikae xa mangɛe naxee nu na Yurudɛn kiri ma sogegorode, a nun Kanaan mangɛe naxee birin nu na baa dɛ ra, e to a mɛ, Alatala bara Yurudɛn xara Isirayilakae ya ra, han e birin naxa gɛ giride, e bɔɲɛe naxa bolon, limaniya fan naxa ba e yi ra Isirayilakae xa fe ra.

sentences.english: At that time the Lord said to Joshua, Make yourself stone knives and give the children of Israel circumcision a second time.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Alatala naxa a masen Yosuwe bɛ, «Gɛmɛ xɛyɛnxie yailan finɛe ra, i man xa Isirayilakae sunna.»

sentences.english: So Joshua made stone knives and gave the children of Israel circumcision at Gibeath-ha-araloth.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa gɛmɛe yailan finɛe ra, a naxa Isirayilakae sunna geya fɛ ma. E naxa naa xili sa laaga.

sentences.english: And this is the reason why Joshua did so: all the males of the people who came out of Egypt, all the fighting-men, had been overtaken by death in the waste land on the way, after they came out of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe e sunna yi fe nan ma. Ɲama naxan birin keli Misira, xɛmɛ geresoe birin faxa nɛ gbengberenyi kira xɔn ma, e keli xanbi Misira.

sentences.english: All the people who came out had undergone circumcision; but all the people whose birth had taken place in the waste land on their journey from Egypt had not.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxan birin keli Misira, e birin nu sunnaxi, kɔnɔ mixi naxee birin bari gbengberenyi kira xɔn ma e keli xanbi Misira, nee keren mu nu sunnaxi.

sentences.english: For the children of Israel were wandering in the waste land for forty years, till all the nation, that is, all the fighting-men, who had come out of Egypt, were dead, because they did not give ear to the voice of the Lord: to whom the Lord said, with an oath, that he would not let them see the land which the Lord had given his word to their fathers to give us, a land flowing with milk and honey.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isirayilakae nu bara ɲɛ tongo naani ɲɛrɛ raba gbengberenyi ma, han xɛmɛ geresoe birin naxa gɛ faxade naxee tondi Alatala xa yaamari rabatude. Alatala nu bara a kali, a e mu fama bɔxi tode Alatala a kali e babae bɛ naxan xa fe ra a sofe ra e yi, xiɲɛ nun kumi xɛlɛma bɔxi naxan ma.

sentences.english: And their children, who came up in their place, now underwent circumcision by the hands of Joshua, not having had it before: for there had been no circumcision on the journey.
sentences.susu: Alatala e xa die nan findixi e ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Yosuwe naxa e sunna, barima e mu nu sunnaxi biyaasi kui.

sentences.english: So when all the nation had undergone circumcision, they kept in their tents till they were well again.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ bɔnsɔɛ birin sunnade, e naxa lu yire keren malabude han e birin gɛ yalande.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Joshua, Today the shame of Egypt has been rolled away from you. So that place was named Gilgal, to this day.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Yosuwe bɛ, «To lɔxɔɛ n bara Misira yaagi makuya wo ra.» Na nan a toxi mɛnni xili falama Giligali han to.

sentences.english: So the children of Israel put up their tents in Gilgal; and they kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the month, in the evening, in the lowlands of Jericho.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa yonkin Giligali Yurudɛn fili ma Yeriko biri ra, e Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali raba naa nunmare tɛmui, kike xi fu nun naani nde.

sentences.english: And on the day after the Passover, they had for their food the produce of the land, unleavened cakes and dry grain on the same day.
sentences.susu: Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali kuye iba, e naxa na bɔxi daxamui, taami lɛbinitare, nun sansi xɔri ganxie don.

sentences.english: And there was no more manna from the day after they had for their food the produce of the land; the children of Israel had manna no longer, but that year the produce of the land of Canaan was their food.
sentences.susu: E to bɔxi daxamui don, na kuye iba, mana mu goro sɔnɔn. Isirayilakae fa Kanaan bɔxi daxamui gbansan nan don na ɲɛ ra.

sentences.english: Now when Joshua was near Jericho, lifting up his eyes he saw a man in front of him, with his sword uncovered in his hand: and Joshua went up to him and said, Are you for us or against us?
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Yosuwe nu na Yeriko longori. A naxa xɛmɛ nde to, a tixi a ya i, a xa santidɛgɛma mageli suxuxi a yi. Yosuwe naxa a makɔrɛ a ra, a a maxɔrin, «I na muxu tan nan bɛ, ka muxu yaxui nan lanxi i ma?»

sentences.english: And he said, No; but I have come as captain of the armies of the Lord. Then Joshua, falling down with his face to the earth in worship, said, What has my lord to say to his servant?
sentences.susu: A naxa Yosuwe yaabi, «N tan nan na Alatala xa sɔɔrie xa mangɛ ra. N bara fa.» Yosuwe naxa a felen a bun ma, a fa a fala a bɛ, «N Marigi munse masenxi a xa konyi bɛ?»

sentences.english: And the captain of the Lord's army said to Joshua, Take off your shoes from your feet, for the place where you are is holy. And Joshua did so.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa sɔɔri mangɛ naxa a fala Yosuwe bɛ, «I xa sankirie ba i sanyi, barima i tixi yire naxɛ yi ki, yire sɛniyɛnxi na a ra.» Yosuwe naxa a xa sankirie ba a sanyi.

sentences.english: (Now Jericho was all shut up because of the children of Israel: there was no going out or coming in.)
sentences.susu: Yeriko sode dɛ birin nu mabalanxi nɛ Isirayilakae xa fe ra. Mixi mu minima, mixi mu soma.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Joshua, See, I have given into your hands Jericho with its king and all its men of war.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Yosuwe bɛ, «A mato, n bara Yeriko taa sa i bɛlɛxɛ, a mangɛ, nun a sɔɔri ɲalamae.

sentences.english: Now let all your fighting-men make a circle round the town, going all round it once. Do this for six days.
sentences.susu: I xa geresoe birin xa yi taa rabilin sanmaya keren xi keren kui, xi senni bun ma.

sentences.english: And let seven priests go before the ark with seven loud-sounding horns in their hands: on the seventh day you are to go round the town seven times, the priests blowing their horns.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ mixi solofere xa yɛxɛɛ kontonyi feri solofere suxu e yi ra, e xa ɲɛrɛ saatɛ kankira ya ra. A xi solofere nde, wo xa taa rabilin sanmaya solofere, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nu fa feri fe.

sentences.english: And at the sound of a long note on the horns, let all the people give a loud cry; and the wall of the town will come down flat, and all the people are to go straight forward.
sentences.susu: E na yɛxɛɛ kontonyi feri fe, wo naxa a xui mɛ, ɲama birin xa sɔnxɔɛ gbegbe rate. Na tɛmui tɛtɛ naxan taa rabilinxi, na birama nɛ a yɛtɛ ma. Kankan tixi dɛnnaxɛ biri, a xa so mɛnni ra.»

sentences.english: Then Joshua, the son of Nun, sent for the priests and said to them, Take up the ark of the agreement, and let seven priests take seven horns in their hands and go before the ark of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Nunu xa di Yosuwe naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xili, a a fala e bɛ, «Wo Alatala xa saatɛ kankira tongo. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ solofere xa yɛxɛɛ kontonyi feri solofere tongo, wo xa ti Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ya ra.»

sentences.english: And he said to the people, Go forward, circling the town, and let the armed men go before the ark of the Lord.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala ɲama bɛ, «Wo dangi, wo xa taa rabilin. Makantati singee xa ti Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ya ra.»

sentences.english: So after Joshua had said this to the people, the seven priests with their seven horns went forward before the Lord, blowing on their horns: and the ark of the Lord's agreement went after them.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe a fala ɲama bɛ ki naxɛ, e naxa a raba na ki. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ solofere, yɛxɛɛ kontonyi feri solofere nu suxuxi naxee yi Alatala ya i, nee naxa e ɲɛrɛ, e nu fa feri fe. Alatala xa saatɛ kankira xaninmae naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And the armed men went before the priests who were blowing the horns, and the mass of the people went after the ark, blowing their horns.
sentences.susu: Makantati singee naxa ti sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ya ra naxee nu feri fefe. Makantati dɔnxɔɛe naxa ti saatɛ kankira xanbi ra. E nu fa e ɲɛrɛ feri xui ma.
