sentences.english: And to the people Joshua gave an order, saying, You will give no cry, and make no sound, and let no word go out of your mouth till the day when I say, Give a loud cry; then give a loud cry.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe nu bara yi yaamari so ɲama yi ra, «Wo naxa sɔnxɔɛ rate, wo naxa wo xui ite, mixi yo naxa wɔyɛn han n na a falama wo bɛ lɔxɔɛ naxɛ. Na tɛmui kɔrɛ, wo fa sɔnxɔɛ rate.»

sentences.english: So he made the ark of the Lord go all round the town once: then they went back to the tents for the night.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa saatɛ kankira naxa taa rabilin sanmaya keren. Na xanbi e naxa gbilen ɲama yonkinde, e xi naa.

sentences.english: And early in the morning Joshua got up, and the priests took up the ark of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa keli subaxɛ ma, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxa Alatala xa saatɛ kankira tongo.

sentences.english: And the seven priests with their seven horns went on before the ark of the Lord, blowing their horns: the armed men went before them, and the mass of the people went after the ark of the Lord, blowing their horns.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ soloferee, feri soloferee suxuxi naxee yi, nee naxa e ɲɛrɛ fɔlɔ Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ya ra, e nu fa feri fe. Makantati singee tixi yare, Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ya ra. Makantati dɔnxɔɛe fan tixi a xanbi ra, e e ɲɛrɛma feri xui ma.

sentences.english: The second day they went all round the town once, and then went back to their tents: and so they did for six days.
sentences.susu: A xi firin nde, e naxa taa rabilin sanmaya keren, e fa gbilen ɲama yonkinde. E naxa na mɔɔli raba xi senni bun ma.

sentences.english: Then on the seventh day they got up early, at the dawn of the day, and went round the town in the same way, but that day they went round it seven times.
sentences.susu: A xi solofere nde, e naxa keli subaxɛ ma, e taa rabilin alɔ e darixi a ra ki naxɛ. Kɔnɔ yi biyaasi, e naxa na raba sanmaya solofere. E taa rabilin sanmaya solofere na xi solofere nde kansan nɛ.

sentences.english: And the seventh time, at the sound of the priests' horns, Joshua said to the people, Now give a loud cry; for the Lord has given you the town.
sentences.susu: A sanmaya solofere nde, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxa feri fe fa. Yosuwe fa a fala ɲama bɛ, «Wo sɔnxɔɛ rate, barima Alatala bara yi taa sa wo bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And the town will be put to the curse, and everything in it will be given to the Lord: only Rahab, the loose woman, and all who are in the house with her, will be kept safe, because she kept secret the men we sent.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara yi taa ratɔn nun a isee birin natɔn, fo Raxabi langoe ginɛ kerenyi peti naxan natangaxi, nun mixi naxee birin na a xa banxi kui, barima a tan nan yigiya fi won ma xɛɛrae ma.

sentences.english: And as for you, keep yourselves from the cursed thing, for fear that you may get a desire for it and take some of it for yourselves, and so be the cause of a curse and great trouble on the tents of Israel.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo a idɔyin se ratɔnxie ma, wo naxa keren xanin wo xun, xa na mu a ra Isirayila ɲama findima nɛ se ratɔnxi ra.

sentences.english: But all the silver and gold and the vessels of brass and iron are holy to the Lord: they are to come into the store-house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Gbeti, xɛɛma, wure, nun wure gbeeli, nee findima Alatala nan gbe ra. Wo xa e ragata a bɛ.»

sentences.english: So the people gave a loud cry, and the horns were sounded; and on hearing the horns the people gave a loud cry, and the wall came down flat, so that the people went up into the town, every man going straight before him, and they took the town.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa sɔnxɔɛ rate, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nu fa feri fe. Ɲama to feri xui mɛ, e naxa sɔnxɔɛ gbegbe rate. Tɛtɛ naxa bira a yɛtɛ ma, ɲama fa so keren na taa kui. Taa naxa findi e gbe ra.

sentences.english: And they put everything in the town to the curse; men and women, young and old, ox and sheep and ass, they put to death without mercy.
sentences.susu: E naxa taa ratɔn, e na taa mixi birin faxa santidɛgɛma ra, xɛmɛe nun ginɛe, dimɛe nun forie, ningee, yɛxɛɛe nun sofalee.

sentences.english: Then Joshua said to the two men who had been sent to make a search through the land, Go into the house of the loose woman, and get her out, and all who are with her, as you gave her your oath.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe nu bara a fala yi xɛmɛ firinyi bɛ, naxee siga yi bɔxi rabɛnde, «Wo siga na langoe ginɛ xa banxi kui, wo a ramini a nun a xa mixie birin, alɔ wo wo kali a bɛ ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: So the searchers went in and got out Rahab and her father and mother and her brothers and all she had, and they got out all her family; and they took them outside the tents of Israel.
sentences.susu: Yi sɛgɛtala fe rabɛnyi firinyie naxa siga, e sa Raxabi ramini banxi kui. E naxa a baba, a nga, a taarae, a xunyae, nun a baribooree birin namini, e fa e makanta e kerenyi ma Isirayila ɲama yonkinde sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Then, after burning up the town and everything in it, they put the silver and gold and the vessels of brass and iron into the store-house of the Lord's house.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa taa gan a nun a isee birin na, fo gbeti, xɛɛma, wure, nun wure gbeeli. E naxa nee raso naafuli ragatade Alatala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: But Joshua kept Rahab, the loose woman, and her father's family and all she had, from death, and so she got a living-place among the children of Israel to this day; because she kept safe the men whom Joshua had sent to make a search through the land.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa Raxabi langoe ginɛ lu a si ra, a nun a xa mixie birin. Raxabi naxa sabati Isirayilakae ya ma. Han to a bɔnsɔɛe na naa, barima a yigiya fi nɛ Yosuwe xa xɛɛra fe rabɛnyi firinyie ma Yeriko.

sentences.english: Then Joshua gave the people orders with an oath, saying, Let that man be cursed before the Lord who puts his hand to the building up of this town: with the loss of his first son will he put the first stone of it in place, and with the loss of his youngest son he will put up its doors.
sentences.susu: Na waxati Yosuwe naxa yi marakali ti, «Dankɛ na mixi bɛ naxan gbilenma Yeriko taa ti ra. Na kanyi xa di singe nan findima na biriki singe sare ra, nun a xa di dɔnxɔɛ nan findima taa naadɛ sare ra.»

sentences.english: So the Lord was with Joshua; and news of him went through all the land.
sentences.susu: Alatala nun Yosuwe nan nu a ra. Yosuwe xili naxa te, a din bɔxi birin na.

sentences.english: But the children of Israel did wrong about the cursed thing: for Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the family of Judah, took of the cursed thing, moving the Lord to wrath against the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isirayilakae naxa Alatala xui matandi, e se ndee tongo a tɔnyi dɔxɔxi naxee ra. Akan, Karimi xa mamadi, Sabidi tolobitɛ, Sera xa tolontolonyi, Yuda bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, nu bara se ratɔnxie tongo, Alatala bɔɲɛ fa te Isirayilakae xili ma na xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Now Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is by the side of Beth-aven, on the east side of Beth-el, and said to them, Go up and make a search through the land. And the men went up and saw how Ai was placed.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa mixie xɛɛ keli Yeriko, sigafe ra Ayi, dɛnnaxɛ na Beti Aweni fɛ ma, Beteli sogetede. A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo te, wo xa sa na bɔxi rabɛn.» Na xɛmɛe naxa te Ayi bɔxi rabɛnde.

sentences.english: Then they came back to Joshua and said to him, Do not send all the people up, but let about two or three thousand men go up and make an attack on Ai; there is no need for all the people to be tired with the journey there, for it is only a small town.
sentences.susu: E naxa gbilen Yosuwe yire, e a fala a bɛ, «Hali ɲama birin mu siga, mixi wulu firin, xa na mu mixi wulu saxan nan xa te, e Ayi mixie bɔnbɔma nɛ. I naxa ɲama birin natagan yi fe ma, barima won gerefae mu gbo.»

sentences.english: So about three thousand of the people went up, and were sent in flight by the men of Ai.
sentences.susu: Na kui mixi wulu saxan ɲɔndɔn naxa te gere xili ma. Kɔnɔ Ayi mixie naxa nɔ e ra, e fa e gi e ya ra.

sentences.english: The men of Ai put to death about thirty-six of them, driving them from before the town as far as the stoneworks, and overcoming them on the way down: and the hearts of the people became like water.
sentences.susu: Ayikae naxa mixi tongo saxan nun senni faxa Isirayilakae ra. E naxa e keri keli taa sode dɛ ra han Sabarimi. E goro goro ma na kira ra, e naxa nɔ e ra. Na kui Isirayila ɲama bɔɲɛ naxa kana, limaniya naxa ba e yi ra.

sentences.english: Then Joshua, in great grief, went down on the earth before the ark of the Lord till the evening, and all the chiefs of Israel with him, and they put dust on their heads.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa a xa sose ibɔɔ a ma, a naxa a yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ya i han nunmare, a tan nun Isirayila forie. E naxa bɛndɛ maso e xunyie ma nimisɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And Joshua said, O Lord God, why have you taken us over Jordan only to give us up into the hands of the Amorites for our destruction? If only it had been enough for us to keep on the other side of Jordan!
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa a fala, «N Marigi Alatala, munfe ra i a niyaxi yi ɲama xa Yurudɛn igiri? I wama muxu safe Amorikae bɛlɛxɛ nɛ, i xa gan muxu ra? Muxu na a kolon nu, hali muxu lu Yurudɛn naakiri ma nu.

sentences.english: O Lord, what am I to say now that Israel have given way before their attackers?
sentences.susu: N Marigi, n munse falama kɔrɛ, Isirayilakae to e gixi e yaxuie ya ra?

sentences.english: For when the news comes to the Canaanites and all the people of the land, they will come up, shutting us in and cutting off our name from the earth: and what will you do for the honour of your great name?
sentences.susu: Kanaankae nun yi bɔxi mixie na yi fe mɛ, e muxu digilinma nɛ, e muxu xili ɲɔn yi bɔxi ma. Na kui, i tan fa munse rabama i xili xungbe xa fe ra?»

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to Joshua, Get up; what are you doing with your face to the earth?
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Yosuwe bɛ, «Keli, i i yatagi rafelenxi bɔxi ma munfe ra yi ki?

sentences.english: Israel has done wrong, sinning against the agreement which I made with them: they have even taken of the cursed thing; acting falsely like thieves they have put it among their goods.
sentences.susu: Isirayila bara yunubi raba. Na kui e bara saatɛ kana n naxan tongo e bɛ. Iyo, e bara se ratɔnxie tongo a mu lan e xa naxan tongo. E bara a muɲa, e a nɔxun e xa kote kui.

sentences.english: For this reason the children of Israel have given way, turning their backs in flight before their attackers, because they are cursed: I will no longer be with you, if you do not put the cursed thing away from among you.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae mu nɔma tide e yaxuie ya ra. E e gima nɛ e yaxuie ma, barima e fan yɛtɛ yati bara findi mixi ratɔnxie ra. N mu luma wo fɔxɔ ra, xa wo mu yi se ratɔnxie kana wo naxee tongoxi.

sentences.english: Up! make the people holy; say to them, Make yourselves holy before tomorrow, for the Lord, the God of Israel, has said, There is a cursed thing among you, O Israel, and you will give way before your attackers in the fight till the cursed thing has been taken away from among you.
sentences.susu: Keli, i xa ɲama rasɛniyɛn. I xa a fala e bɛ, ‹Beemanu tina, wo xa wo yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn. Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Se ratɔnxie na wo tagi. Isirayila mu nɔma tide e yaxuie ya ra, danmi na se ratɔnxie na wo yi ra.»

sentences.english: So in the morning you are to come near, tribe by tribe; and the tribe marked out by the Lord is to come near, family by family; and the family marked out by the Lord is to come near, house by house; and the house marked out by the Lord is to come near, man by man.
sentences.susu: Tina gɛɛsɛgɛ wo wo maso wo bɔnsɔɛ ki ma. Alatala na bɔnsɔɛ naxan masen, na xa a maso a xabilɛ ki ma. Alatala na xabilɛ naxan masen, na xa a maso a denbaya ki ma. Alatala na mixi naxan masen denbaya ya ma, na xa a maso.

sentences.english: Then the man who is taken with the cursed thing is to be burned, with everything which is his; because he has gone against the agreement of the Lord and has done an act of shame in Israel.
sentences.susu: Na mixi nun na se ratɔnxie ganma nɛ tɛ ra, barima a bara Alatala xa saatɛ kana, a bara fe raba Isirayila, a mu lan a xa naxan naba.›»

sentences.english: So Joshua got up early in the morning, and made Israel come before him by their tribes; and the tribe of Judah was taken;
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa keli subaxɛ ma, a naxa Isirayila ti a bɔnsɔɛ ki ma. A fe naxa ti Yuda bɔnsɔɛ.

sentences.english: Then he made Judah come forward, and the family of the Zerahites was taken; and he made the family of the Zerahites come forward man by man; and Zabdi was taken;
sentences.susu: A naxa Yuda xabilɛe maso, a fe naxa ti Sera xabilɛ. A naxa Sera xabilɛ maso, a denbaya ki ma, a fe naxa ti Sabadi.

sentences.english: Then the house of Zabdi came forward man by man, and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.
sentences.susu: A naxa denbaya xunyie maso, a fe naxa ti Akan, Karimi xa di xɛmɛ, Sabadi xa di xɛmɛ, Sera xa di naxan fatan Yuda bɔnsɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Joshua said to Achan, My son, give glory and praise to the Lord, the God of Israel; give me word now of what you have done, and keep nothing back from me.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa a fala Akan bɛ, «N ma di, tantui rasiga Alatala ma, Isirayila Marigi Ala. A tantu. I naxan nabaxi, na tagi raba n bɛ a ki ma. I naxa a nɔxun n ma.»

sentences.english: And Achan, answering, said to Joshua, Truly I have done wrong against the Lord, the God of Israel, and this is what I have done:
sentences.susu: Akan naxa Yosuwe yaabi, «Nɔndi na a ra. N tan nan yunubi rabaxi Alatala ra, Isirayila Marigi Ala. N naxan nabaxi a tan nan yi ki.

sentences.english: When I saw among their goods a fair robe of Babylon and two hundred shekels of silver, and a mass of gold, fifty shekels in weight, I was overcome by desire and took them; and they are put away in the earth in my tent, and the silver is under it.
sentences.susu: N Sinari donma nde to nɛ na see ya ma, naxan xa tofanyi maniyɛ mu na, a nun gbeti kole kɛmɛ firin, nun xɛɛma, naxan kilo tagi lima. N naxa mila e ma, n fa e tongo. N bara e biri yili kui n ma kiri banxi bun ma. Gbeti saxi xɛɛma nun donma bun ma.»

sentences.english: So Joshua sent men quickly, and looking in his tent, they saw where the robe had been put away secretly with the silver under it.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa mixie xɛɛ e gi ra, e xa Akan xa kiri banxi mato. Na see nu nɔxunxi yili kui, gbeti saxi e bun ma.

sentences.english: And they took them from the tent and came back with them to Joshua and the children of Israel, and put them before the Lord.
sentences.susu: E naxa a birin nate yili kui kiri banxi bun ma, e a xanin Yosuwe xɔn ma, Isirayila ɲama tagi. E naxa a ibagan bɔxi Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: Then Joshua and all Israel took Achan, the son of Zerah, and the silver and the robe and the mass of gold, and his sons and his daughters and his oxen and his asses and his sheep and his tent and everything he had; and they took them up into the valley of Achor.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa Sera xa di Akan suxu. A naxa a xa see birin tongo, na gbeti, na donma tofanyi, na xɛɛma, nun a xa kiri banxi. A man naxa a xa di xɛmɛe, a xa di ginɛe, a xa ningee, a xa sofalee, nun a xa xurusee, a naxa na birin suxu, a a xanin Akori gulunba kui. Isirayila birin naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And Joshua said, Why have you been a cause of trouble to us? Today the Lord will send trouble on you. And all Israel took part in stoning him; they had him stoned to death and then burned with fire.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa a fala Akan bɛ, «I bara muxu xun maɲaaxu, Alatala i fan xun maɲaaxuma nɛ to lɔxɔɛ.» Na masenyi xanbi, Isirayilakae birin naxa e magɔnɔ gɛmɛ ra, e e gan.

sentences.english: And over him they put a great mass of stones, which is there to this day; then the heat of the Lord's wrath was turned away. So that place was named, The Valley of Achor, to this day.
sentences.susu: E naxa gɛmɛ gbegbe koto a fari. Han to na kotoxi naa. Na kui Alatala bɔɲɛ naxa goro. Na nan a toxi han to, Akori gulunba xili falama na yire xun ma.

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to Joshua, Have no fear and do not be troubled: take with you all the fighting-men and go up against Ai: for I have given into your hands the king of Ai and his people and his town and his land:
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Yosuwe bɛ, «Hali i mu gaaxu, i bɔɲɛ naxa mini a i. Geresoe birin tongo, wo keli, wo xa siga Ayi gerede. A kolon, n bara Ayi mangɛ sa i bɛlɛxɛ a nun a xa ɲama birin na, a xa taa nun a xa bɔxi.

sentences.english: And you are to do to Ai and its king as you did to Jericho and its king: but their goods and their cattle you may take for yourselves: let a secret force be stationed to make a surprise attack on the town from the back.
sentences.susu: I Ayi bɔxi nun a mangɛ xa fe rabama nɛ alɔ i Yeriko bɔxi nun a mangɛ xa fe raba ki naxɛ, kɔnɔ yi biyaasi e xa se fanyie nun e xa xurusee findima wo harige nan na. I fama taa mɛlɛnde a xanbi xanbi nan ma.»

sentences.english: So Joshua and the fighting-men got ready to go up against Ai; and Joshua took thirty thousand men of war, and sent them out by night.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe nun geresoe birin naxa keli, e naxa te Ayi. Yosuwe naxa sɔɔri geresoe fanyi mixi wulu tongo saxan mayegeti, e birin naxa te kɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And he gave them their orders, saying, Go and take up your position secretly at the back of the town: do not go very far away, and let all of you be ready:
sentences.susu: A naxa yi yaamari so e yi ra, «Wo a idɔyin, wo xa taa mɛlɛn a xanbi xanbi ma. Wo naxa wo makuya taa ra a gbe ra. Wo birin xa wo rɛdi.

sentences.english: And I and all the people with me will come near the town, and when they come out against us as they did before, we will go in flight from them;
sentences.susu: N tan nun n ma ɲama birin, muxu muxu makɔrɛma nɛ taa ra mɛnnikae ya ra. E na mini muxu ralande alɔ a singe ra, muxu fama nɛ muxu gide e ya ra.

sentences.english: And they will come out after us, till we have got them away from the town; for they will say, They have gone in flight from us as before; so we will go in flight before them;
sentences.susu: Na kui e birama nɛ muxu fɔxɔ ra a falafe ra, ‹E na e gife alɔ boore biyaasi.› Na ki muxu fama nɛ e raminide taa fari ma.

sentences.english: Then you will get up from your secret position and take the town, for the Lord your God will give it up into your hands.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, wo tan xa mini wo nɔxunde, wo fa taa masɔtɔ. Wo Marigi Alatala naa sama nɛ wo bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And when you have taken the town, put fire to it, as the Lord has said: see, I have given you your orders.
sentences.susu: Wo na taa suxu, wo tɛ so naa ra, wo naa gan. A tan nan na ki, wo xa Alatala waxɔnfe rakamali, wo xa n ma yaamari rabatu a rabatu ki ma.»

sentences.english: So Joshua sent them out: and they took up a secret position between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of Ai: but Joshua kept with the people that night.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa e rasiga fa, e sa taa mɛlɛn a xanbi xanbi ma. E naxa lu Ayi nun Beteli tagi, Ayi sogegorode. Yosuwe nun ɲama birin naxa xi yonkinde kui na kɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And early in the morning Joshua got up, and put the people in order, and he and the chiefs of Israel went up before the people to Ai.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Yosuwe naxa keli, a ɲama xunmato a ra. A tan nun Isirayila kuntigie naxa te ɲama ya ra, sigafe ra Ayi.

sentences.english: And all the fighting-men who were with him went up and came near the town, and took up a position on the north side of Ai facing the town, with a valley between him and the town.
sentences.susu: E tan nun geresoe birin naxa e makɔrɛ Ayi taa ra, e fa yonkinde yailan a kɔɔla biri ra. Gulunba naxa lu e tan nun Ayi tagi.

sentences.english: And taking about five thousand men, he put them in position for a surprise attack on the west side of Ai, between Beth-el and Ai.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe nu bara xɛmɛ wulu suuli ɲɔndɔn xɛɛ taa mɛlɛnde Ayi nun Beteli tagi, Ayi taa sogegorode.

sentences.english: So all the people were in their places, the army on the north side of the town and the secret force on the west; and that night Joshua went down into the valley.
sentences.susu: Na kui sɔɔrie xa yonkinde xungbe nu na taa kɔɔla ma, sɔɔri booree nu na taa mɛlɛnfe sogegorode biri. Yosuwe naxa siga na kɔɛ radangi gulunba kui.

sentences.english: Now when the king of Ai saw it, he got up quickly and went out to war against Israel, he and all his people, to the slope going down to the valley; but he had no idea that a secret force was waiting at the back of the town.
sentences.susu: Ayi mangɛ to Isirayila sɔɔrie to, a tan nun a xa ɲama naxa mini e gerede fiili yire Araba ya ra. Kɔnɔ a mu nu a kolon xa Isirayilakae bara a xa taa mɛlɛn a xanbi xanbi ma.

sentences.english: Then Joshua and all Israel, acting as if they were overcome before them, went in flight by way of the waste land.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yosuwe nun Isirayila ɲama birin naxa e yɛtɛ ragi Ayi mixie ya ra gbengberenyi kira xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And all the people in Ai came together to go after them; and they went after Joshua, moving away from the town.
sentences.susu: Ayikae naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra keren na. Yosuwe nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa e gi han e gɛ Ayi ɲama birin naminide taa fari ma.

sentences.english: There was not a man in Ai and Beth-el who did not go out after Israel; and the town was open and unwatched while they went after Israel.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ keren mu lu Ayi nun Beteli taae kui, e birin naxa bira Isirayilakae fɔxɔ ra, e xa e suxu. E naxa taa lu na ki, a rabixi.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Joshua, Let your spear be stretched out against Ai; for I will give it into your hands. So Joshua took up his spear, stretching it out in the direction of the town.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Alatala naxa a masen Yosuwe bɛ, «I xa tanbɛ itala Ayi biri ra, naxan suxuxi i yi ra, barima n bara a sa i bɛlɛxɛ.» Yosuwe naxa a xun ti taa ra, a xa tanbɛ suxuxi a yi ra Ayi mabiri.

sentences.english: Then the secret force came quickly from their place, and running forward when they saw his hand stretched out, went into the town and took it, and put fire to it straight away.
sentences.susu: A to na raba, sɔɔri mɛlɛntie naxa mini mafuren mafuren e nɔxunde kui, e fa so taa kui, e tɛ so na ra keren na.

sentences.english: Then the men of Ai, looking back, saw the smoke of the town going up to heaven, and were unable to go this way or that: and the people who had gone in flight to the waste land were turned back on those who were coming after them.
sentences.susu: Ayikae to e ya ragbilen e xanbi ra, e naxa a to tuuri na tefe koore ma kelife taa kui. E mu nɔ e gide e xa siga dɛdɛ. Isirayilaka naxee nu na e gife gbengberenyi kira xɔn Ayi mixie ya ra, nee naxa e mafindi e xili ma.

sentences.english: And when Joshua and all Israel saw that the town had been taken by the surprise attack, and that the smoke of the town had gone up, turning round they overcame the men of Ai.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe nun Isirayila ɲama to na tuuri to te ra, e naxa a kolon a sɔɔri mɛlɛntie bara gɛ taa suxude. Na kui e naxa e mafindi, e fa Ayikae bɔnbɔ.

sentences.english: Then the other force came out of the town against them, so that they were being attacked on this side and on that: and Israel overcame them and let not one of them get away with his life.
sentences.susu: Na mɛlɛntie fan naxa fa kelife taa kui, e xa Ayikae gere. Na kui Ayikae naxa raxɛtɛn, Isirayilakae fa e birin faxa. Mixi yo mu nɔ a gide, mixi yo mu lu a ɲiɲɛ ra,

sentences.english: But the king of Ai they made prisoner, and took him to Joshua.
sentences.susu: fo Ayi mangɛ, e naxan suxu, e a xanin Yosuwe xɔn.

sentences.english: Then, after the destruction of all the people of Ai in the field and in the waste land where they went after them, and when all the people had been put to death without mercy, all Israel went back to Ai, and put to death all who were in it without mercy.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae to gɛ Ayikae faxade naxee bira e fɔxɔ ra gbengberenyi kira xɔn ma, e naxa gbilen taa fan kui, e Ayika dɔnxɔɛe birin faxa e xa santidɛgɛmae ra.

sentences.english: On that day twelve thousand were put to death, men and women, all the people of Ai.
sentences.susu: Ayika naxee birin faxa na lɔxɔɛ, xɛmɛe nun ginɛe, e kɔnti naxa lan mixi wulu fu nun firin ma.

sentences.english: For Joshua did not take back his hand with the outstretched spear till the destruction of the people of Ai was complete.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe to a xa tanbɛ itala Ayi xun ma, a mu a iso fo naakae birin to gɛ faxade.

sentences.english: But the cattle and the goods from that town, Israel took for themselves, as the Lord had given orders to Joshua.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isirayila naxa a wasaso Ayi xuruse nun a harige ra, alɔ Alatala a masen ki naxɛ Yosuwe bɛ.

sentences.english: So Joshua gave Ai to the flames, and made it a waste mass of stones for ever, as it is to this day.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa Ayi taa birin kana, a a gan. Han to naa kiroxi.

sentences.english: And he put the king of Ai to death, hanging him on a tree till evening: and when the sun went down, Joshua gave them orders to take his body down from the tree, and put it in the public place of the town, covering it with a great mass of stones, which is there to this day.
sentences.susu: Naxan findi Ayi mangɛ tan na, e naxa na gbaku wuri ma han nunmare. Nunmare to so, Yosuwe naxa yaamari fi e xa a fure ragoro wuri kɔn na. E naxa a rabira taa sode dɛ ra, e fa gɛmɛ gbegbe malan a fari. Han to na gɛmɛ malanxi naa.

sentences.english: Then Joshua put up an altar to the Lord, the God of Israel, in Mount Ebal,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yosuwe naxa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ Ebali geya fari,

sentences.english: In the way ordered by Moses, the servant of the Lord, as it is recorded in the book of the law of Moses, an altar of uncut stones, untouched by any iron instrument: and on it they made burned offerings and peace-offerings to the Lord.
sentences.susu: alɔ Alatala xa konyi Munsa a fala Isirayilakae bɛ ki naxɛ. E naxa sɛrɛxɛbade gɛmɛ daaxi ti, wure mu nu din naxan na, alɔ a sɛbɛxi Tawureta Munsa kitaabui kui ki naxɛ. E naxa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛe ba Alatala bɛ na fari.

sentences.english: And he made there on the stones a copy of the law of Moses, writing it before the eyes of the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni Yosuwe naxa Ala xa sɛriyɛ sɛbɛ gɛmɛe ma Isirayilakae birin ya xɔri, Annabi Munsa naxan sɛbɛ e bɛ.

sentences.english: And all Israel, those who were Israelites by birth, as well as the men from other lands living with them, and their responsible men and their overseers and judges, took their places round the ark, in front of the priests, the Levites, whose work it was to take up the ark of the Lord's agreement; half of them were stationed in front of Mount Gerizim and half in front of Mount Ebal, in agreement with the orders for the blessing of the children of Israel which Moses, the servant of the Lord, had given.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae, e xa kuntigie, e xa sɔɔri mangɛe, e xa kiitisae, nun xɔɲɛ naxee nu na e ya ma, e birin naxa siga ti ra Lewi bɔnsɔɛ sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ya i, naxee nu Alatala xa saatɛ kankira xaninma. Ɲama sɛɛti keren naxa ti Garisimi geya biri, ɲama sɛɛti boore naxa ti Ebali geya biri, alɔ Alatala xa konyi Munsa a fala Isirayila ɲama singe bɛ ki naxɛ, a duba e bɛ tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And after, he gave them all the words of the law, the blessing and the curse, as it is all recorded in the book of the law;
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Yosuwe naxa yi sɛriyɛ masenyi birin ti, dubɛe nun dankɛe, alɔ a sɛbɛxi Tawureta Munsa kitaabui kui ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Reading to all the meeting of Israel, with the women and the children and the men from other lands who were living among them, every word of the orders which Moses had given.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa xa masenyi sɛbɛxi keren mu lu, Yosuwe mu naxan tagi raba Isirayila ɲama birin bɛ, hali ginɛe, dimɛe, nun xɔɲɛ naxee nu na e ya ma.

sentences.english: Now on hearing the news of these things, all the kings on the west side of Jordan, in the hill-country and the lowlands and by the Great Sea in front of Lebanon, the Hittites and the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites,
sentences.susu: Yurudɛn naakiri mangɛe, Xitikae, Amorikae, Kanaankae, Perisikae, Hiwikae, nun Yebusukae xa mangɛ, e to yi gere xa fe mɛ, naxan nabaxi Sefela bɔxi geyae fari, Baa Xungbe dɛ ra, Liban geyae sɛɛti ma,

sentences.english: Came together with one purpose, to make war against Joshua and Israel.
sentences.susu: e naxa e malan, e lanyi xiri e tagi alako e xa Yosuwe nun Isirayila ɲama gere.

sentences.english: And the men of Gibeon, hearing what Joshua had done to Jericho and Ai,
sentences.susu: Gabayonkae to a mɛ, Yosuwe naxan nabaxi Yeriko nun Ayi ra,

sentences.english: Acting with deceit, got food together as if for a long journey; and took old food-bags for their asses, and old and cracked wine-skins kept together with cord;
sentences.susu: e naxa yanfanteya maxiri. E naxa siga a xɔn, bɛki kobie nun wɛni sase ibɔɔxie dɔxɔxi e xa sofalee fari.

sentences.english: And put old stitched-up shoes on their feet, and old clothing on their backs; and all the food they had with them was dry and broken up.
sentences.susu: E naxa sankiri fori ɲɔnxi madɛgɛxie so e sanyi, e donma kobi ɲɔnxie ragoro e ma. E naxa taami xuntunyi xaraxie sa e xa kote kui.

sentences.english: And they came to Joshua to the tent-circle at Gilgal, and said to him and to the men of Israel, We have come from a far country: so now make an agreement with us.
sentences.susu: E to Yosuwe li yonkinde kui Giligali, e naxa a fala a tan nun Isirayilakae bɛ, «Muxu sa kelixi bɔxi makuye nɛ yi ki, alako won xa saatɛ xiri.»

sentences.english: And the men of Israel said to the Hivites, It may be that you are living among us; how then may we make an agreement with you?
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa a fala e bɛ, «Won nɔma saatɛ xiride di? Xa a sa li wo kelixi yi bɔxi nan ma, a mu lanma saatɛ xa lu won tagi.»

sentences.english: And they said to Joshua, We are your servants. Then Joshua said to them, Who are you and where do you come from?
sentences.susu: E naxa Yosuwe yaabi, «I xa konyie nan lanxi muxu ma.» Yosuwe naxa e maxɔrin, «Nde na wo tan na? Wo kelixi minden?»

sentences.english: And they said to him, Your servants have come from a very far country, because of the name of the Lord your God: for the story of his great name, and of all he did in Egypt has come to our ears,
sentences.susu: E naxa Yosuwe yaabi, «I xa konyie kelixi bɔxi makuye nan ma i Marigi Alatala xili xa fe ra, barima muxu bara a xa fe ifalɛ mɛ, a naxan nabaxi Misira,

sentences.english: And what he did to the two kings of the Amorites east of Jordan, to Sihon, king of Heshbon, and to Og, king of Bashan, at Ashtaroth.
sentences.susu: a nun a fe naxan birin nabaxi Amorikae xa mangɛ firinyie ra Yurudɛn naakiri ma, Xɛsibɔn mangɛ Sixɔn, nun Basan mangɛ Ogo, naxan nu sabatixi Asataroti.»

sentences.english: So the responsible men and all the people of our country said to us, Take food with you for the journey and go to them, and say to them, We are your servants: so now make an agreement with us.
sentences.susu: «Muxu xa forie nun bɔxi mixi birin a falaxi nɛ muxu bɛ, ‹Wo wo fandɛ tongo wo naxan donma kira xɔn ma. Wo xa siga Isirayilakae ralan, wo xa a fala e bɛ wo xa konyie nan muxu ra.› Yakɔsi, won xa saatɛ tongo won boore bɛ.

sentences.english: This bread which we have with us for our food, we took warm and new from our houses when starting on our journey to you; but now see, it has become dry and broken up.
sentences.susu: Wo bara muxu xa taamie to? Muxu to keli muxu xɔnyi, taami fanyi na nu a ra, kɔnɔ yakɔsi a birin bara xara.

sentences.english: And these wine-skins were new when we put the wine in them, and now they are cracked as you see; and our clothing and our shoes have become old because of our very long journey here.
sentences.susu: Muxu xa wɛni sase nɛɛnɛe nu rafexi wɛni fanyi ra, kɔnɔ yakɔsi na birin bara ɲɔn, wɛni sasee bara bɔɔ. Wo muxu xa donmae mato, a nun muxu xa sankirie. E birin bara kana yi kira xa makuye bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the men took some of their food, without requesting directions from the Lord.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa na birin mato, kɔnɔ e mu Alatala maxɔrin xa a findixi nɔndi nan na.

sentences.english: So Joshua made peace with them, and made an agreement with them that they were not to be put to death: and the chiefs of the people took an oath to them.
sentences.susu: Na kui Yosuwe naxa lanyi xiri e tagi e xa simaya makantafe ra. Marakali naxa lu e tagi.

sentences.english: Now three days after, when they had made this agreement with them, they had word that these men were their neighbours, living near them.
sentences.susu: Xi saxan to dangi na saatɛ xirife ra, Isirayilakae naxa a kolon a e dɔxɔbooree nan lanxi e ma.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel went forward on their journey, and on the third day came to their towns. Now their towns were Gibeon and Chephirah and Beeroth and Kiriath-jearim.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Isirayilakae naxa siga, e sa so e xa taae kui, naxan findixi Gabayon, Kefira, Beeroti, nun Kiriyati Yeyarimi.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel did not put them to death, because the chiefs of the people had taken an oath to them by the Lord, the God of Israel. And all the people made an outcry against the chiefs.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae mu e faxa saatɛ xa fe ma, bɔxi yareratie naxan tongo Gabayonkae bɛ Isirayila Marigi Alatala xili ra, kɔnɔ ɲama birin naxa xurutuxurutu e xa yareratie ma.

sentences.english: But all the chiefs said to the people, We have taken an oath to them by the Lord, the God of Israel, and so we may not put our hands on them.
sentences.susu: Mangɛe naxa a fala ɲama bɛ, «Muxu tan nan muxu kalixi e bɛ Isirayila Marigi Alatala xili ra. Won mu nɔma won bɛlɛxɛ dinde e ra.

sentences.english: This is what we will do to them: we will not put them to death, for fear that wrath may come on us because of our oath to them.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi won e xa fe suxuma yi ki nɛ. Won e luma e si nan na alako won naxa Alatala raxɔnɔ marakali kanafe ra.

sentences.english: Keep them living, and let them be servants, cutting wood and getting water for all the people. And all the people did as the chiefs had said to them.
sentences.susu: Won naxa e faxa, kɔnɔ won xa e rawali wuri sɛgɛfe nun ye bafe ra ɲama birin bɛ.» Na kui Isirayila yareratie xa saatɛ mu kanama.

sentences.english: Then Joshua sent for them, and said to them, Why have you been false to us, saying, We are very far from you, when you are living among us?
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa e xili, a wɔyɛn e bɛ, «Munfe ra wo muxu yanfaxi, wo a fala muxu bɛ, a wo sabatixi yire makuye nɛ, a fa sa a li, wo sabatixi muxu sɛɛti nan ma?

sentences.english: Now because of this you are cursed, and you will for ever be our servants, cutting wood and getting water for the house of my God.
sentences.susu: Na kui wo bara dankɛ sɔtɔ, wo bara findi muxu xa konyie ra. Wuri sɛgɛfe nun ye bafe wali luma wo tan nan xun ma muxu Marigi Ala xa ɲama bɛ abadan.»

sentences.english: And, answering Joshua, they said, Because it came to the ears of your servants that the Lord your God had given orders to his servant Moses to give you all this land, and to send destruction on all the people living in it, because of you; so, fearing greatly for our lives because of you, we have done this.
sentences.susu: E naxa Yosuwe yaabi, «Muxu bara a mɛ, i Marigi Alatala a fala nɛ a xa konyi Munsa bɛ, a xa yi bɔxi birin so wo yi ra, a xa bekae sɔntɔ wo ya xɔri. Wo xa fa bara gaaxui gbegbe lu muxu ma muxu nii xa fe ra. Na nan a toxi muxu bara wo yanfa.

sentences.english: And now we are in your hands: do to us whatever seems good and right to you.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, muxu na wo sago. Wo xa muxu xa fe raba alɔ wo wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ tinxinyi kui.»

sentences.english: So he kept them safe from the children of Israel, and did not let them be put to death.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa na tinxinyi raba, a mu a lu Isirayilakae xa e faxa.

sentences.english: And that day Joshua made them servants, cutting wood and getting water for the people and for the altar of the Lord, in the place marked out by him, to this day.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ a naxa wuri sɛgɛfe nun ye bafe wali dɔxɔ e xun ma Isirayila ɲama birin bɛ, a nun Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade bɛ, naxan na Alatala xa yire sugandixi. Han to Gabayonkae na na wali kui.

sentences.english: Now when it came to the ears of Adoni-zedek, king of Jerusalem, that Joshua had taken Ai, and had given it up to the curse (for as he had done to Jericho and its king, so he had done to Ai and its king); and that the people of Gibeon had made peace with Israel and were living among them;
sentences.susu: Darisalamu mangɛ Adoni Sedeki naxa a mɛ a Yosuwe bara Ayi taa suxu, a bara naa ratɔn, a bara Ayi bɔxi nun a mangɛ xa fe raba alɔ a Yeriko bɔxi nun a mangɛ xa fe raba ki naxɛ. A man bara a mɛ a Gabayon nun Isirayila bara lanyi xiri, a nee sabatixi e tagi.

sentences.english: He was in great fear, because Gibeon was a great town, like one of the king's towns, greater than Ai, and all the men in it were men of war.
sentences.susu: E naxa gaaxu na xa fe ra, barima mangataa belebele nan nu na Gabayon na, naxan xungbo Ayi bɛ. E xa sɔɔrie nu findixi xɛmɛ gbangbalanyie nan na.

sentences.english: So Adoni-zedek, king of Jerusalem, sent to Hoham, king of Hebron, and to Piram, king of Jarmuth, and to Japhia, king of Lachish, and to Debir, king of Eglon, saying,
sentences.susu: Darisalamu mangɛ Adoni Sedeki naxa xɛɛra xɛɛ, a xa sa a fala Xebiron mangɛ Hohami bɛ, Yaramuti mangɛ Pirami bɛ, Lakisi mangɛ Yafiya bɛ, a nun Egilon mangɛ Debiri bɛ,

sentences.english: Come up to me and give me help, and let us make an attack on Gibeon: for they have made peace with Joshua and the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: «Wo te n yire, wo xa fa kafu n ma alako won xa Gabayon gere, barima e tan nun Yosuwe nun Isirayilakae bara lanyi xiri.»

sentences.english: So the five kings of the Amorites, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon, were banded together, and went up with all their armies and took up their position before Gibeon and made war against it.
sentences.susu: Yi Amori mangɛ suulie: Darisalamu mangɛ, Xebiron mangɛ, Yaramuti mangɛ, Lakisi mangɛ, nun Egilon mangɛ naxa te nun e xa sɔɔrie ra. E naxa e xa yonkinde yailan Gabayon ya ra, e fa gere ti e bɛ.

sentences.english: And the men of Gibeon sent to Joshua to the tent-circle at Gilgal, saying, Be not slow to send help to your servants; come up quickly to our support and keep us safe: for all the kings of the Amorites from the hill-country have come together against us.
sentences.susu: Gabayonkae naxa xɛɛra xɛɛ Isirayilakae xa yonkinde Giligali, e xa sa a fala Yosuwe bɛ, «I naxa i xa konyie rabɛɲin. I xa te muxu yire mafuren. I xa muxu ratanga Amori mangɛe ma, naxee sabatixi geya yire, e wama muxu gerefe.»

sentences.english: So Joshua went up from Gilgal with all his army and all his men of war.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe nun a xa sɔɔri ɲalamae naxa keli Giligali, e siga Gabayon.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Joshua, Have no fear of them, for I have given them into your hands; they will all give way before you.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Yosuwe bɛ, «I naxa gaaxu e ya ra, barima n bara gɛ e sade i bɛlɛxɛ. Mixi keren mu nɔma tide i ya ra e ya ma.»

sentences.english: So Joshua, having come up from Gilgal all night, made a sudden attack on them.
sentences.susu: Na kui Yosuwe nun a xa mixie naxa keli Giligali, e ɲɛrɛ kɔɛ ra, alako e xa sin Amorikae xun ma tɛrɛnna ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord made them full of fear before Israel, and they put great numbers of them to death at Gibeon, and went after them by the way going up to Beth-horon, driving them back to Azekah and Makkedah
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Amorikae keri Isirayila ya ra, a fa nɔ e ra sɛnbɛ ra Gabayon. Isirayilakae naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra kira xɔn naxan tema Beti Xoron, e naxa e bɔnbɔ han Aseka nun Makeda.

sentences.english: And in their flight before Israel, on the way down from Beth-horon, the Lord sent down great stones from heaven on them all the way to Azekah, causing their death: those whose death was caused by the stones were more than those whom the children of Israel put to death with the sword.
sentences.susu: E to nu e gima Isirayilakae ya ra gorofe Beti Xoron kira xɔn, Alatala naxa balabalanyi xɔri belebele ragoro e ma keli koore ma, han e sa Aseka li. Na balabalanyi xa mixi faxaxie dangi mixie ra, Isirayilakae naxee faxa e xa santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: It was on the day when the Lord gave up the Amorites into the hands of the children of Israel that Joshua said to the Lord, before the eyes of Israel, Sun, be at rest over Gibeon; and you, O moon, in the valley of Aijalon.
sentences.susu: Alatala nu Amorikae safe Isirayila bɛlɛxɛ tɛmui naxɛ, Yosuwe nu bara Alatala maxandi Isirayilakae ya xɔri a xa soge raxara Gabayon xun, a xa kike raxara Ayalon gulunba xun.

sentences.english: And the sun was at rest and the moon kept its place till the nation had given punishment to their attackers. (Is it not recorded in the book of Jashar?) So the sun kept its place in the middle of the heavens, and was waiting, and did not go down, for the space of a day.
sentences.susu: Soge nun kike naxa e raxara, han Isirayila naxa gɛ e waxɔnyi rabade e yaxuie ra. Yi fe sɛbɛxi Yasari xa buki kui. Soge naxa a raxara koore tagi, soge mu gbata dulade fɛɛɲɛn keren kui.

sentences.english: And there was no day like that, before it or after it, when the Lord gave ear to the voice of a man; for the Lord was fighting for Israel.
sentences.susu: Han to na fe mɔɔli mu toxi duniɲa. Alatala nu bara Yosuwe xa maxandi suxu, a nu na gere sofe Isirayila bɛ.

sentences.english: And Joshua, with all Israel, went back to the tent-circle at Gilgal.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yosuwe nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa gbilen e xa yonkinde Giligali.

sentences.english: But these five kings went in flight secretly to a hole in the rock at Makkedah.
sentences.susu: Na mangɛ suulie e gi nɛ, e sa e nɔxun Makeda fɔnmɛ ra.

sentences.english: And word was given to Joshua that the five kings had been taken in a hole in the rock at Makkedah.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa a fala Yosuwe bɛ, «Na mangɛ suulie na e nɔxunfe Makeda fɔnmɛ kui.»

sentences.english: And Joshua said, Let great stones be rolled against the mouth of the hole, and let men keep watch by it:
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa yaamari fi, «Wo gɛmɛ belebelee mayindigilin na fɔnmɛ dɛ ma, wo sɔɔri ndee ti naa.

sentences.english: But do you, without waiting, go after their army, attacking them from the back; do not let them get into their towns, for the Lord your God has given them into your hands.
sentences.susu: Wo tan dɔnxɔɛe, wo naxa dugundi, wo xa bira wo yaxuie fɔxɔ ra, wo fa kira bolon e ya ra, alako e naxa nɔ e xɔnyi masɔtɔde, barima wo Marigi Alatala bara e sa wo bɛlɛxɛ.»

sentences.english: Now when Joshua and the children of Israel had come to the end of their war of complete destruction, and had put to death all but a small band who had got safely into the walled towns,
sentences.susu: Na kui Yosuwe nun a xa sɔɔriee naxa nɔ Amorikae ra, fo mixi keren kerenyi naxee e gi, e sa e xa taa makantaxie masɔtɔ.

sentences.english: All the people went back to Joshua to the tent-circle at Makkedah in peace: and no one said a word against the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa sɔɔrie birin naxa gbilen bɔɲɛsa kui Yosuwe yire Makeda yonkinde kui. Mixi yo mu nɔ e ra.

sentences.english: Then Joshua said, Take away the stones from the mouth of the hole in the rock, and make those five kings come out to me.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yosuwe naxa a fala, «Wo yi gɛmɛe ba fɔnmɛ dɛ ma, wo xa yi mangɛ suulie ramini.»

sentences.english: And they did so, and made those five kings come out of the hole to him, the king of Jerusalem, the king of Hebron, the king of Jarmuth, the king of Lachish, and the king of Eglon.
sentences.susu: E naxa na mixi suuli ramini: Darisalamu mangɛ, Xebiron mangɛ, Yaramuti mangɛ, Lakisi mangɛ, nun Egilon mangɛ.

sentences.english: And when they had made those kings come out to Joshua, Joshua sent for all the men of Israel, and said to the chiefs of the men of war who had gone with him, Come near and put your feet on the necks of these kings. So they came near and put their feet on their necks.
sentences.susu: E to yi mangɛe ramini Yosuwe ma, Yosuwe naxa Isirayila sɔɔrie birin xili, a a fala e xa yareratie bɛ, «Wo wo maso, wo xa wo sanyi ti yi mangɛe kɔnyie ma.» E naxa e maso, e e sanyi ti e kɔnyie ma.

sentences.english: And Joshua said to them, Have no fear and do not be troubled; be strong and take heart: for so will the Lord do to all against whom you make war.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo naxa gaaxu, wo bɔɲɛ naxa mini a i. Wo wo sɛnbɛ so, wo man xa limaniya, barima Alatala wo yaxuie birin ma fe rabama yi ki nɛ, wo nun naxee nɛ gerema.»

sentences.english: Then Joshua had them put to death, hanging them on five trees, where they were till evening.
sentences.susu: Na birin to dangi, Yosuwe naxa e faxa, a fa e gbaku wuri suuli kɔn na han nunmare.

sentences.english: And when the sun went down, they were taken down from the trees, by Joshua's orders, and put into the hole where they had gone to be safe; and great stones were placed at the mouth of the hole, where they are to this day.
sentences.susu: Soge dula tɛmui, Yosuwe naxa yaamari fi e xa e ragoro wuri kɔn na, e xa e raso fɔnmɛ kui, e nu nɔxunxi dɛnnaxɛ. E naxa gɛmɛ belebelee dɔxɔ na dɛ ma. Han to naa na na ki.

sentences.english: That day Joshua took Makkedah, and put it and its king to the sword; every soul in it he gave up to the curse without mercy: and he did to the king of Makkedah as he had done to the king of Jericho.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Yosuwe naxa Makeda fan suxu, a mɛnnikae nun e xa mangɛ sɔntɔ santidɛgɛma ra. A mu mixi keren lu. A naxa Makeda mangɛ xa fe raba alɔ a Yeriko mangɛ xa fe raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went on from Makkedah and came to Libnah, and made an attack on it;
sentences.susu: Yosuwe nun Isirayila xa sɔɔrie naxa keli Makeda, e siga Libina gerede.

sentences.english: And again the Lord gave it and its king into the hands of Israel; and he put it and every person in it to the sword, till their destruction was complete; and he did to its king as he had done to the king of Jericho.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa naakae nun e xa mangɛ sa e bɛlɛxɛ. E naxa na mixi birin sɔntɔ e xa santidɛgɛma ra, e mu mixi keren lu. E naxa Libina mangɛ xa fe raba alɔ e Yeriko mangɛ xa fe raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went on from Libnah to Lachish, and took up their position against it and made an attack on it,
sentences.susu: Yosuwe nun Isirayila xa sɔɔrie naxa keli Libina, e siga Lakisi gerede.

sentences.english: And the Lord gave Lachish into the hands of Israel, and on the second day he took it, putting it and every person in it to the sword without mercy, as he had done to Libnah.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Alatala naxa Lakisi sa e bɛlɛxɛ. E naxa na mixi birin faxa santidɛgɛma ra, alɔ e Libina xa fe raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then Horam, king of Gezer, came up to the help of Lachish; and Joshua overcame him and his people, putting all of them to death.
sentences.susu: Geseri mangɛ Horami naxa te kafude Lakisi ma, kɔnɔ Yosuwe naxa a tan nun a xa sɔɔrie birin faxa, a mu mixi keren lu.

sentences.english: And Joshua and all Israel with him went on from Lachish to Eglon: and they took up their position against it and made an attack on it;
sentences.susu: Yosuwe nun Isirayila xa sɔɔrie naxa keli Lakisi, e siga Egilon gerede.

sentences.english: And that day they took it, putting it and every person in it to the sword, as he had done to Lachish.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ e naxa mɛnnikae birin sɔntɔ, alɔ e Lakisi xa fe raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And Joshua and all Israel with him went up from Eglon to Hebron, and made an attack on it;
sentences.susu: Yosuwe nun Isirayila xa sɔɔrie naxa keli Egilon, e siga Xebiron gerede.

sentences.english: And took it, overcoming it and putting it and its king and its towns and every person in it to the sword: as he had done to Eglon, he put them all to death, and gave it up to the curse with every person in it.
sentences.susu: E naxa mɛnnikae birin, e xa mangɛ, nun e dɔxɔbooree sɔntɔ, e mu mixi keren lu. E naxa e xa fe raba alɔ e Egilon xa fe raba ki naxɛ, e mɛnnikae birin faxa.

sentences.english: And Joshua and all Israel with him went on to make an attack on Debir;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yosuwe nun Isirayila xa sɔɔrie naxa e mafindi Debiri taa xili ma, e xa e gere.

sentences.english: And he took it, with its king and all its towns: and he put them to the sword, giving every person in it to the curse; all were put to death: as he had done to Hebron, so he did to Debir and its king.
sentences.susu: E naxa mɛnnikae birin, e xa mangɛ, nun e dɔxɔbooree sɔntɔ, e mu mixi keren lu. E naxa e xa fe raba alɔ e Libina, a mangɛ, nun Xebiron xa fe raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So Joshua overcame all the land, the hill-country and the South and the lowland and the mountain slopes, and all their kings; all were put to death: and every living thing he gave up to the curse, as the Lord, the God of Israel, had given him orders.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa nɔ na bɔxi birin na, geya yire, Negewi gbengberenyi, Sefela bɔxi, nun a mangɛe. A naxa na mixi birin sɔntɔ alɔ Isirayila Marigi Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Joshua overcame them from Kadesh-barnea to Gaza, and all the land of Goshen as far as Gibeon.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa e gere keli Kadesi Barineya han Gasa, Gosen bɔxi birin, sa dɔxɔ Gabayon na.

sentences.english: And all these kings and their land Joshua took at the same time, because the Lord, the God of Israel, was fighting for Israel.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa nɔ na taae nun e mangɛe ra tɛmui kerenyi ra, barima Isirayila Marigi Alatala nan nu gere soma Isirayila bɛ.

sentences.english: Then Joshua and all Israel with him went back to their tents at Gilgal.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yosuwe nun Isirayila xa sɔɔrie birin naxa gbilen e xa yonkinde Giligali.

sentences.english: Now Jabin, king of Hazor, hearing of these things, sent to Jobab, king of Madon, and to the king of Shimron, and to the king of Achshaph,
sentences.susu: Xasori mangɛ Yabini to yi fee mɛ, a naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ yi mixie xɔn ma: Madon mangɛ Yobabo, Simiron mangɛ, Akisafa mangɛ,

sentences.english: And to the kings on the north in the hill-country, and in the Arabah south of Chinneroth, and in the lowland, and in the highlands of Dor on the west,
sentences.susu: mangɛ naxee nu sabatixi geyae fari kɔɔla ma, naxee nu sabatixi Yurudɛn gulunba kui, naxee nu sabatixi Kinereti Baa yirefanyi ma, naxee nu sabatixi Sefela bɔxi ma, naxee nu Dɔrɔ rabilinyi ma sogegorode,

sentences.english: And to the Canaanites on the east and on the west, and to the Amorites and the Hittites and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites in the hill-country, and the Hivites under Hermon in the land of Mizpah.
sentences.susu: Kanaankae naxee nu na sogetede nun sogegorode, Amorikae, Xitikae, Perisikae, Yebusukae naxee nu na geyae fari, a nun Hiwikae naxee nu na Xerimon geya bunyi Misipa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And they went out, they and all their armies with them, a great people, in number like the sand on the seaside, with horses and war-carriages in great number.
sentences.susu: Na mangɛe naxa e xa sɔɔrie birin malan, naxee wuya alɔ mɛyɛnyi baa dɛ ra. Soe gbegbe nun sɔɔri ragise gbegbe fan nu na e yi.

sentences.english: And all these kings came together, and put their forces in position at the waters of Merom, to make war on Israel.
sentences.susu: Yi mangɛe naxa lan fe keren ma, e naxa sa e xa yonkinde ti Meromi xure fɛ ma Isirayilakae gerefe ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Joshua, Have no fear of them: for tomorrow at this time I will give them all up dead before Israel; you are to have the leg-muscles of their horses cut and their war-carriages burned with fire.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Yosuwe bɛ, «Hali i mu gaaxu e ya ra, barima tina yi tɛmui ma, n tan e birin sama nɛ i bɛlɛxɛ, i e faxa Isirayilakae ya xɔri. I fama nɛ e xa soe san fasɛe bolonde, i fama nɛ e xa sɔɔri ragisee gande.»

sentences.english: So Joshua and all the men of war with him came against them suddenly at the waters of Merom, and made an attack on them.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe nun a xa geresoee naxa sin e ma Meromi xure fɛ ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord gave them up into the hands of Israel, and they overcame them driving them back to great Zidon and to Misrephoth-maim and into the valley of Mizpeh to the east; and they put them all to death, no man got away safely.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa e sa Isirayila bɛlɛxɛ. E naxa e bɔnbɔ, e e keri han Sidɔn taa xungbe kui, han Misirefoti Mayimi, han Misipa gulunba ra sogetede biri. E naxa e bɔnbɔ, e mu mixi keren lu.

sentences.english: And Joshua did to them as the Lord had said to him; he had the leg-muscles of their horses cut and their war-carriages burned with fire.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa e xa fe raba alɔ Alatala a masen a bɛ ki naxɛ. A naxa e xa soe san fasɛe bolon, a e xa sɔɔri ragisee fan gan.

sentences.english: At that time, Joshua went on to take Hazor and put its king to the sword: for in earlier times Hazor was the chief of all those kingdoms.
sentences.susu: A gbilen gbilen ma, Yosuwe naxa Xasori bɔxi fan suxu, a naxa a mangɛ faxa santidɛgɛma ra, barima a tan nan nu na mangataa ra na bɔxi birin xun.

sentences.english: And they put every person in it to death without mercy, giving every living thing up to the curse, and burning Hazor.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe xa sɔɔrie naxa e sɔntɔ santidɛgɛma ra, e mu mixi keren lu a si ra. Na dangi xanbi e naxa Xasori taa gan.

sentences.english: And all the towns of these kings, and all the kings, Joshua took, and put them to the sword: he gave them up to the curse, as Moses, the servant of the Lord, had said.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa na taae birin suxu, a mɛnnikae nun e mangɛe faxa santidɛgɛma ra, a mɛnni ratɔn alɔ Alatala xa konyi Munsa a fala a bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: As for the towns made on hills of earth, not one was burned by Israel but Hazor, which was burned by Joshua.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isirayila xa sɔɔrie mu taae gan naxee nu na geyae fari, fo Xasori keren Yosuwe dɛnnaxɛ gan.

sentences.english: And all the goods taken from these towns, and their cattle, the children of Israel kept for themselves; but every man they put to death without mercy, till their destruction was complete, and there was no one living.
sentences.susu: Isirayila naxa a wasaso yi taae harige nun e xa xurusee ra, kɔnɔ e naxa mixie tan birin faxa santidɛgɛma ra. E mu mixi keren lu a ɲiɲɛ ra.

sentences.english: As the Lord had given orders to Moses his servant, so Moses gave orders to Joshua, and so Joshua did; every order which the Lord had given to Moses was done.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxan yamari a xa konyi Munsa bɛ, Annabi Munsa fan naxa na yamari Yosuwe bɛ. Yosuwe naxa na birin naba alɔ Alatala a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So Joshua took all that land, the hill-country and all the South, and all the land of Goshen, and the lowland and the Arabah, the hill-country of Israel and its lowland;
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa na bɔxi birin masɔtɔ: geya yire, Negewi gbengberenyi, Gosen bɔxi, Sefela bɔxi, nun Yurudɛn gulunba, kelife Isirayila geyae ma han baa dɛ ra.

sentences.english: From Mount Halak, which goes up to Seir, as far as Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon under Mount Hermon: and all their kings he overcame and put to death.
sentences.susu: Keli geya Mageli itexi ra Seyiri biri ra, han Bali Gadi, Liban gulunba kui, Xerimon geya bunyi, a naxa naa mangɛe birin suxu, a e sɔntɔ.

sentences.english: For a long time Joshua made war on all those kings.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe nun yi mangɛe naxa gere xɔnkuye raba.

sentences.english: Not one town made peace with the children of Israel, but only the Hivites of Gibeon: they took them all in war.
sentences.susu: Taa yo mu nu na naxan tin Isirayila xa lanbooreɲa ra, fo Gabayon keren Hiwikae nu sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ. Isirayilakae naxa na dɔnxɔɛe birin gere.

sentences.english: For the Lord made them strong in heart to go to war against Israel, so that he might give them up to the curse without mercy, and that destruction might come on them, as the Lord had given orders to Moses.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan Kanaankae xaxilie raxɔrɔxɔ, alako Isirayila mixie xa e gere, e xa e ratɔn, e naxa kinikini e ma fefe ma, alɔ Alatala a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And Joshua came at that time and put an end to the Anakim in the hill-country, in Hebron, in Debir, in Anab, and in all the hill-country of Judah and Israel: Joshua gave them and their towns to the curse.
sentences.susu: Na waxati kerenyi kui, Yosuwe naxa Anaki bɔnsɔɛ fan gere, a e sɔntɔ Xebiron, Debiri, Anaba, nun geya yire naxee nu na Yudaya nun Isirayila bɔxi ma. Yosuwe naxa e birin halaki, a e xa taae kana.

sentences.english: Not one of the Anakim was to be seen in the land of the children of Israel: only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod, some were still living.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi Anaki bɔnsɔɛ keren mu lu Isirayila bɔxi ma. Naxee mu faxa, nee naxa sabati Gasa, Gati, nun Asidodi taae kui.

sentences.english: So Joshua took all the land, as the Lord had said to Moses; and Joshua gave it to the children of Israel as their heritage, making division of it among them by their tribes. And the land had rest from war.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Yosuwe naxa na bɔxi birin masɔtɔ alɔ Alatala a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ ki naxɛ. A naxa a itaxun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe ma e kɛ ra. Na tɛmui, bɔxi naxa xinbeli, gere yo mu so fa.

sentences.english: Now these are the kings of the land whom the children of Israel overcame, taking as their heritage their land on the east side of Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah to the east:
sentences.susu: Mangɛe nan ya Isirayilakae nɔ naxee ra, e e xa taae tongo Yurudɛn sogetede biri ra, fɔlɔfe Arinon xure ma, a sa dɔxɔ Xerimon geya ra, han a sa Yurudɛn gulunba birin li sogetede biri:

sentences.english: Sihon, king of the Amorites, who was living in Heshbon, ruling from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the town in the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, as far as the river Jabbok, the limits of the children of Ammon;
sentences.susu: Amori mangɛ Sixɔn, naxan nu sabatixi Xɛsibɔn, a xa mangɛya nu fɔlɔma Aroweri, naxan tixi Arinon xure dɛ ra, han a sa dɔxɔ Yaboko xure ra, Amoni naaninyi. Yi birin nu findixi Galadi bɔxi sɛɛti keren nan na.

sentences.english: And the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, to the east, and to the sea of the Arabah, that is the Salt Sea, to the east, the way to Beth-jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:
sentences.susu: A man naxa Yurudɛn gulunba sogetede fan yaamari, kelife Kinereti Baa han Fɔxɔɛ Baa Yurudɛn gulunba ra, Beti Yesimoti taa na dɛnnaxɛ. A xa bɔxi nu sigaxi itala ra yirefanyi biri ra han Pisiga geya ra.

sentences.english: And the land of Og, king of Bashan, of the rest of the Rephaim, who was living at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
sentences.susu: Basan mangɛ Ogo, Refa bɔnsɔɛ mixi dɔnxɔɛ nde, naxan nu dɔxɔxi Asataroti nun Edereyi taae.

sentences.english: Ruling in the mountain of Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, as far as the limits of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, to the land of Sihon, king of Heshbon.
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya nu fɔlɔma Xerimon geya nan ma, a siga Salaka, han a sa Basan bɔxi birin li. A xa mangɛya naaninyi nu na Gesurikae nun Maakakae xa bɔxi nan fɛ ma. Yi birin nu findixi Galadi sɛɛti boore nan fan na, han Xɛsibɔn mangɛ Sixɔn xa mangɛya fɔlɔde.

sentences.english: Moses, the servant of the Lord, and the children of Israel overcame them; and Moses, the servant of the Lord, gave their land for a heritage to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa, Alatala xa konyi nun Isirayilakae naxa nɔ na mangɛe birin na. Alatala xa konyi Annabi Munsa naxa e xa ɲamanɛ so Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti keren yi ra, mɛnni xa findi nee gbe ra.

sentences.english: And these are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel overcame on the west side of Jordan, from Baal-gad in the valley of Lebanon to Mount Halak, which goes up to Seir; and Joshua gave the land to the tribes of Israel for a heritage, in keeping with their divisions;
sentences.susu: Mangɛyae nan ya Yosuwe nun Isirayilakae naxee masɔtɔ Yurudɛn kiri ma sogegorode, fɔlɔfe Bali Gadi ma Liban gulunba, han Xalaka geya Seyiri biri ra. Yosuwe naxa yi bɔxi birin itaxun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe ma, kankan xa a gbe kɛ sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: In the hill-country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and on the mountain slopes, and in the waste land, and in the South; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
sentences.susu: E bɔxi naxee sɔtɔ na birin nalanxi na, Isirayila geyae, Sefela bɔxi, Yurudɛn gulunba, gbengberen yire, nun Negewi gbengberenyi nan na. Xitikae, Amorikae, Kanaankae, Perisikae, Hiwikae, nun Yebusukae nan nu sabatixi mɛnni.

sentences.english: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is near Beth-el, one;
sentences.susu: Mangɛe nan ya e nɔxi naxee ra: Yeriko mangɛ, Ayi mangɛ naxan nu na Beteli fɛ ma,

sentences.english: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
sentences.susu: Darisalamu mangɛ, Xebiron mangɛ,

sentences.english: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
sentences.susu: Yaramuti mangɛ, Lakisi mangɛ,

sentences.english: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
sentences.susu: Egilon mangɛ, Geseri mangɛ,

sentences.english: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
sentences.susu: Debiri mangɛ, Gederi mangɛ,

sentences.english: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
sentences.susu: Horoma mangɛ, Aradi mangɛ,

sentences.english: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
sentences.susu: Libina mangɛ, Adulama mangɛ,

sentences.english: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Beth-el, one;
sentences.susu: Makeda mangɛ, Beteli mangɛ,

sentences.english: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
sentences.susu: Tapuwa mangɛ, Xeferi mangɛ,

sentences.english: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lassharon, one;
sentences.susu: Afeki mangɛ, Lasarɔn mangɛ,

sentences.english: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
sentences.susu: Madon mangɛ, Xasori mangɛ,

sentences.english: The king of Shimron-meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
sentences.susu: Simiron Meron mangɛ, Akisafa mangɛ,

sentences.english: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
sentences.susu: Taanaki mangɛ, Megido mangɛ,

sentences.english: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;
sentences.susu: Kedesi mangɛ, Yokanayimi mangɛ naxan nu na Karemele biri,

sentences.english: The king of Dor on the hill of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;
sentences.susu: Dɔrɔ mangɛ, naxan nu na Dɔrɔ bɔxi ma, Goyimi mangɛ naxan nu na Giligali bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: The king of Tirzah, one; all the kings together were thirty-one.
sentences.susu: nun Tirisa mangɛ. Na birin nalanxi, mangɛ tongo saxan a nun keren.

sentences.english: Now Joshua was old and full of years; and the Lord said to him, You are old and full of years, and there is still very much land to be taken.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe to gɛ foride, Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «I bara fori kɔnɔ ɲamanɛ gbegbe man na wo lan wo xa naxee sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: This is the land which is still to be taken: all the country of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;
sentences.susu: Filisitakae nun Gesurikae xa bɔxi luxi sinden.

sentences.english: From the Shihor, which is before Egypt, to the edge of Ekron to the north, which is taken to be Canaanite property: the five chiefs of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites, as well as the Avvim;
sentences.susu: Bɔxi naxan fɔlɔma Sixori xure ma Misira ya tagi, han a sa Ekiron li, naxan na kɔɔla ma, na birin Kanaankae nan gbe nu a ra, kɔnɔ na waxati Awikae nu naa suxuxi e yi, e nun Filisita mangɛdi suulie, naxee nu na Gasa, Asidodi, Asikalɔn, Gati, nun Ekiron.

sentences.english: On the south: all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah which is the property of the Zidonians, to Aphek, as far as the limit of the Amorites:
sentences.susu: Kanaankae xa bɔxi fan luxi, fɔlɔfe Meyara taa ma Sidɔnkae na dɛnnaxɛ, han a sa Afeki li. Amorikae xa bɔxi fan luxi.»

sentences.english: And the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, looking east, from Baal-gad under Mount Hermon as far as Hamath:
sentences.susu: «Gebalakae nun Libankae xa bɔxi fan luxi, fɔlɔfe Bali Gadi ma Xerimon geya bunyi, han a sa Xamata li.

sentences.english: All the people of the hill-country from Lebanon to Misrephoth-maim, all the Zidonians; them will I send out from before the children of Israel: only make division of it to Israel for a heritage, as I have given you orders to do.
sentences.susu: Sidɔnka naxee birin na geyae fari, fɔlɔfe Liban geyae ma, han a sa Misirefoti Mayimi li, n fama e keride Isirayilakae ya xɔri. I xa na birin fi Isirayila ma kɛ ra, alɔ n a masenxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So now make division of this land for a heritage to the nine tribes, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
sentences.susu: I xa yi bɔxi itaxun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ solomanaani ma, a nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti boore ma.»

sentences.english: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites have been given their heritage, which Moses gave them, on the east side of Jordan, as Moses, the servant of the Lord, gave them;
sentences.susu: Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti singe, Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, nun Gadi bɔnsɔɛ nu bara e gbe kɛ sɔtɔ Yurudɛn kiri ma sogetede biri ra, Ala xa konyi Munsa saabui ra.

sentences.english: From Aroer, on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the town in the middle of the valley, and all the table-land from Medeba to Dibon;
sentences.susu: E xa bɔxi sa fɔlɔxi kafi Aroweri, taa naxan na Arinon xure fɛ ma, a geya bunyi taa li, a Medeba fiili li, han a sa Dibon li,

sentences.english: And all the towns of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who was ruling in Heshbon, to the limits of the children of Ammon;
sentences.susu: a sa Amori mangɛ Sixɔn Xɛsibɔnka xa taae birin li han Amonikae xa naaninyi ra.

sentences.english: And Gilead, and the land of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;
sentences.susu: E man naxa Galadi sɔtɔ, Gesurikae nun Maakakae xa bɔxi, Xerimon geya, nun Basan bɔxi han a sa Salaka li.

sentences.english: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who was ruling in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (he was one of the last of the Rephaim); these did Moses overcome, driving them out of their country.
sentences.susu: Basan mangɛ Ogo fan xa bɔxi, naxan nu dɔxɔxi Asataroti nun Edereyi taae, naxan findi Refa bɔnsɔɛ mixi dɔnxɔɛ ra, na fan gbe birin naxa findi Isirayilakae gbe ra. Annabi Munsa naxa nɔ yi ɲamanɛ birin na, a naxa e xa bɔxi birin tongo.

sentences.english: However, the people of Israel did not send out the Geshurites, or the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath are living among Israel to this day.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isirayilakae mu Gesurikae nun Maakakae keri. Han to e sabatixi Isirayilakae ya ma.

sentences.english: Only to the tribe of Levi he gave no heritage; the offerings of the Lord, the God of Israel, made by fire are his heritage, as he said to him.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa mu bɔxi yo fi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ tan ma, barima sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi naxee bama Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ, e nee nan findixi e tan gbe kɛ ra alɔ Ala a masen ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And Moses gave their heritage to the tribe of Reuben by their families.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa nu bara bɔxi fi Ruben bɔnsɔɛ ma, e xabilɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: Their limit was from Aroer, on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the town in the middle of the valley, and all the table-land by Medeba;
sentences.susu: E xa bɔxi naxa fɔlɔ Aroweri Arinon xure dɛ ra, a taa li naxan na geya bunyi, han a sa Medeba rabilinyi li,

sentences.english: Heshbon and all her towns in the table-land; Dibon, and Bamoth-baal, and Beth-baal-meon;
sentences.susu: a Xɛsibɔn li, nun taa naxee birin na naa rabilinyi. Na taae xili: Dibon, Bamoti Bali, Beti Bali Meyoni,

sentences.english: And Jahaz, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath;
sentences.susu: Yahasi, Kedemoti, Mefaati,

sentences.english: And Kiriathaim, and Sibmah, and Zereth-shahar in the mountain of the valley;
sentences.susu: Kiriyatayimi, Sibima, Sɛrɛti Saxari naxan na geya fari,

sentences.english: And Beth-peor, and the slopes of Pisgah, and Beth-jeshimoth;
sentences.susu: Beti Peyori, Pisiga geya fari, Beti Yesimoti,

sentences.english: And all the towns of the table-land, and all the kingdom of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who was ruling in Heshbon, whom Moses overcame, together with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, the chiefs of Sihon, who were living in the land.
sentences.susu: taa naxee birin na fiili ma nun Amori mangɛ Sixɔn, naxan nu dɔxɔxi Xɛsibɔn, na xa bɔxi birin. Annabi Munsa nu bara mangɛ Sixɔn faxa, a nun Madiyan mangɛdie Efi, Rekemi, Suru, Xuru, nun Reba. E nu sabatixi bɔxi kui Sixɔn xa mangɛya bun ma.

sentences.english: And Balaam, the son of Beor, the prophet, the children of Israel put to death with the sword.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa Beyori xa di xɛmɛ Balami fan faxa santidɛgɛma ra, naxan nu duureya rabama.

sentences.english: And the limit of the children of Reuben was the edge of Jordan. This was the heritage of the children of Reuben by their families, with its towns and its unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Yurudɛn xure findixi Ruben bɔnsɔɛ xa naaninyi nan na sogegorode biri ra. Na taae nun e xa bɔxie findixi Ruben bɔnsɔɛ gbe nan na.

sentences.english: And Moses gave their heritage to the tribe of Gad by their families.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa naxa yi bɔxi fi Gadi bɔnsɔɛ ma e xabilɛ ki ma:

sentences.english: And their limit was Jazer, and all the towns of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer before Rabbah;
sentences.susu: Yaasɛri bɔxi, Galadi bɔxi taae birin, nun Amoni bɔxi sɛɛti keren, han a sa Aroweri li, Raba ya tagi,

sentences.english: And from Heshbon to Ramath-mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the edge of Debir;
sentences.susu: kafi Xɛsibɔn han a sa Ramati Misipa nun Betonimi li, kafi Maxanayimi han a sa Debiri bɔxi li,

sentences.english: And in the valley, Beth-haram, and Beth-nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon, king of Heshbon, having Jordan for its limit, to the end of the sea of Chinnereth on the east side of Jordan.
sentences.susu: a sa Beti Harama, Beti Nimira, Sukɔti, nun Sefon li, taa naxee nu na Yurudɛn xure fɛ ma, a sa Xɛsibɔn mangɛ Sixɔn xa bɔxi birin li, nun Yurudɛn rabilinyi sogetede biri han a sa dɔxɔ Kinereti Baa ra.

sentences.english: This is the heritage of the children of Gad by their families, with its towns and its unwalled places
sentences.susu: Yi birin naxa findi Gadi bɔnsɔɛ kɛ ra e xabilɛ ki ma, kankan nun a xa taa, nun a daaxa.

sentences.english: And Moses gave their heritage to the half-tribe of Manasseh by their families.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa naxa yi bɔxi fi Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti singe ma, Manasi xa die sɛɛti keren ma:

sentences.english: And their limit was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og, king of Bashan, and all Havvoth-Jair, in Bashan, sixty towns;
sentences.susu: Basan bɔxi birin, naxan nu Basan mangɛ Ogo xa mangɛya bun ma, fɔlɔfe Maxanayimi, han a sa Yayiri li. Na findi taa tongo senni nan na.

sentences.english: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, towns of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir, the son of Manasseh, for half of the children of Machir by their families.
sentences.susu: E man naxa Galadi bɔxi sɛɛti keren sɔtɔ, e naxa Asataroti nun Edereyi taae sɔtɔ, naxee nu findixi Basan mangɛ Ogo gbe ra. Manasi xa di Makiri naxa yi birin sɔtɔ a xa die sɛɛti keren bɛ e xabilɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: These are the heritages of which Moses made distribution in the lowlands of Moab, on the other side of Jordan in Jericho, to the east.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa naxa yi kɛ fi Isirayilakae ma a nu na Mowaba fiili ma tɛmui naxɛ, Yurudɛn kiri ma Yeriko sogetede biri.

sentences.english: But to the tribe of Levi Moses gave no heritage: the Lord, the God of Israel, is their heritage, as he said to them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Annabi Munsa mu bɔxi yo fi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ tan ma. Isirayila Marigi Alatala nan nu na a kɛ ra alɔ Ala a masen ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And these are the heritages which the children of Israel took in the land of Canaan, which Eleazar, the priest, and Joshua, the son of Nun, and the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, gave out to them;
sentences.susu: Nunu xa di Yosuwe, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Eleyasari, nun xabilɛ kuntigie Kanaan bɔxi itaxun Isirayilakae ma kɛ ra yi ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Their heritage by the Lord's decision, as he gave orders by Moses, for the nine tribes and the half-tribe.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi naxa itaxun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ solomanaani nun a tagi ma Ala xa mali saabui ra, alɔ Alatala a masen Annabi Munsa bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For Moses had given their heritage to the two tribes and the half-tribe on the other side of Jordan, but to the Levites he gave no heritage among them.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi naxan na Yurudɛn xure kiri ma sogetede biri, Annabi Munsa naxa na fi bɔnsɔɛ firin nun a tagi ma, kɔnɔ a mu bɔxi yo fi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ tan ma.

sentences.english: Because the children of Joseph were two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim; and they gave the Levites no part in the land, only towns for their living-places, with the grass-lands for their cattle and for their property.
sentences.susu: Annabi Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ nu bara itaxun firin na, Manasi nun Efirami. Annabi Munsa mu bɔxi yo fi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ma naxan findixi e gbe yati ra, fo taae, e sabatima dɛnnaxɛ nun fiilie e xurusee dɛmadonma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: As the Lord had given orders to Moses, so the people of Israel did, and they made division of the land.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa na bɔxi itaxun e boore tagi alɔ Alatala a masenxi ki naxɛ Annabi Munsa bɛ.

sentences.english: Then the children of Judah went to Joshua in Gilgal; and Caleb, the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, said to him, You have knowledge of what the Lord said to Moses, the man of God, about me and about you in Kadesh-barnea.
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛ ndee nun Kenisi xa di Kalebi naxa siga Yosuwe xɔn. Kalebi naxa a fala a bɛ, «I a kolon Alatala naxan fala Annabi Munsa bɛ won firin xa fe ra Kadesi Barineya.

sentences.english: I was forty years old when Moses, the servant of the Lord, sent me from Kadesh-barnea to make a search through the land; and the account which I gave him was in keeping with his desire.
sentences.susu: N ɲɛ tongo naani nan nu a ra, Alatala xa konyi Annabi Munsa n xɛɛxi tɛmui naxɛ kelife Kadesi Barineya sigafe ra Kanaan bɔxi ma mɛnni rabɛnde. N to gɛ na ra, n naxa dɛntɛgɛ fanyi sa a bɛ.

sentences.english: My brothers, however, who went up with me, made the heart of the people like water: but I was true to the Lord with all my heart.
sentences.susu: N nan ngaxakerenyi naxee n mati naa, nee naxa limaniya ba ɲama yi ra, kɔnɔ n tan bira n Marigi Alatala nan tun fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And on that day Moses took an oath, saying, Truly the land where your feet have been placed will become a heritage for you and your children for ever, because you have been true to the Lord your God with all your heart.
sentences.susu: Na kui Annabi Munsa naxa laayidi tongo n bɛ yi ki, ‹I i ɲɛrɛxi bɔxi naxan ma, na findima nɛ i tan nun i xa die kɛ ra tɛmui birin, barima i bara bira n Marigi Alatala xui fɔxɔ ra a ki ma.›»

sentences.english: And now, as you see, the Lord has kept me safe these forty-five years, from the time when the Lord said this to Moses, while Israel was wandering in the waste land: and now I am eighty-five years old.
sentences.susu: «Ɲɛ tongo naani nun suuli bara dangi kabi Alatala naxa na masen Annabi Munsa bɛ, won nu na gbengberenyi ma tɛmui naxɛ. Alatala bara n ma simaya rasiga han ɲɛ tongo solomasaxan a nun suuli.

sentences.english: And still, I am as strong today as I was when Moses sent me out: as my strength was then, so is it now, for war and for all the business of life.
sentences.susu: To, n sɛnbɛ man luxi alɔ Annabi Munsa n xɛɛxi tɛmui naxɛ. N nɔma gere sode yi waxati alɔ n na raba ki naxɛ a singe ra.

sentences.english: So now, give me this hill-country named by the Lord at that time; for you had an account of it then, how the Anakim were there, and great walled towns: it may be that the Lord will be with me, and I will be able to take their land, as the Lord said.
sentences.susu: Awa, i xa yi geya bɔxi fi n ma alɔ Alatala laayidi tongo n bɛ ki naxɛ na lɔxɔɛ. Na lɔxɔɛ i nu a kolon Anaki bɔnsɔɛ na mɛnni, e xa taa xungbe makantaxi a fanyi ra. Alatala gbansan xa lu n sɛɛti ma. Na kui n nɔma e keride alɔ Alatala a masen ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And Joshua gave him his blessing; and he gave Hebron to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, for his heritage.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa duba Yefune xa di Kalebi bɛ, a Xebiron xa fi a ma kɛ ra.

sentences.english: So Hebron became the heritage of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, to this day, because with all his heart he was true to the Lord, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na taa na a xa die bɛlɛxɛ han to, barima Yefune Kenisika xa di Kalebi bira Isirayila Marigi Alatala nan fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: In earlier times the name of Hebron had been Kiriath-arba, named after Arba, the greatest of the Anakim. And the land had rest from war.
sentences.susu: Kabi na tɛmui bɔɲɛsa naxa lu na bɔxi ma, gere yo mu nu na sɔnɔn. Singe Xebiron xili nu falama nɛ Kiriyati Araba, barima Araba nan nu findixi Anaki mixie xa kuntigi ra.

sentences.english: Now the part of the land marked out for the children of Judah by families, went up to the edge of Edom, as far as the waste land of Zin to the south, to the farthest point of it on the south.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi naxan fixi Yuda bɔnsɔɛ ma e xabilɛ ki ma Alatala xa maragiri saabui ra, sa fɔlɔxi Edon naaninyi nan na, a sa dɔxɔ Sini gbengberenyi ra yirefanyi ma.

sentences.english: Their south limit was from the farthest part of the Salt Sea, from the inlet looking to the south:
sentences.susu: Na naaninyi fɔlɔxi Fɔxɔɛ Baa dɛ yirefanyi nan ma naxan na Negewi gbengberenyi ma,

sentences.english: From there it goes south of the slope up to Akrabbim, and on to Zin, then south past Kadesh-barnea, and on by Hezron and up to Addar, turning in the direction of Karka:
