sentences.susu: a siga Tali geya yirefanyi ma Sini biri ra, a te Kadesi Barineya yirefanyi ma han a sa dangi Xesiron na, a man te Adari, a siga han Karaka.

sentences.english: Then on to Azmon, ending at the stream of Egypt: and the end of the limit is at the sea; this will be your limit on the south.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi a Asimon li, a siga Misira xure han baa dɛ ra. Yudayakae xa naaninyi nan na ki yirefanyi biri ra.

sentences.english: And the east limit is the Salt Sea as far as the end of Jordan. And the limit of the north part of the land is from the inlet of the sea at the end of Jordan:
sentences.susu: Yudaya naaninyi sogetede biri findixi Fɔxɔɛ Baa dɛ nan na, han Yurudɛn xure sinma baa xun dɛnnaxɛ. A naaninyi kɔɔla biri fɔlɔma Yurudɛn xure sinma baa xun dɛnnaxɛ,

sentences.english: Then the line goes up to Beth-hoglah, past the north of Beth-arabah, and up to the stone of Bohan, the son of Reuben;
sentences.susu: a te Beti Xogala biri ra, a siga Beti Araba, han Ruben xa di Bohan xa gɛmɛ yire ra.

sentences.english: Then the line goes up to Debir from the valley of Achor, and so to the north, in the direction of Gilgal, which is opposite the slope up to Adummim, on the south side of the river: and the line goes on to the waters of En-shemesh, ending at En-rogel:
sentences.susu: Na naaninyi texi han Debiri, a dangi Akori gulunba kui ra, a siga kɔɔla ma han Giligali, naxan na Adumimi geya ya ra, xure yirefanyi ma. Na naaninyi sigaxi han En Semesi dulonyi ra, a mini En Rogeli ra.

sentences.english: Then the line goes up by the valley of the son of Hinnom to the south side of the Jebusite (which is Jerusalem): then up to the top of the mountain in front of the valley of Hinnom to the west, which is at the farthest point of the valley of Rephaim on the north:
sentences.susu: A keli mɛnni, a goro Hinoma xa gulunba kui, Yebusukae xa taa yirefanyi ma. Na taa findixi Darisalamu nan na. A siga han geya fari ma Hinoma xa gulunba ya ra sogetede biri nun Refa bɔnsɔɛ xa gulunba raɲɔnyi ra kɔɔla biri ra.

sentences.english: And the limit is marked out from the top of the mountain to the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah, and out to the towns of Mount Ephron, as far as Baalah (which is Kiriath-jearim):
sentences.susu: Kelife na geya fari ma, naaninyi sigama han Nefetowa dulonyi ra. Na xanbi a taa ndee li naxee na Eferon geya fari, a siga Baala, dɛnnaxɛ xili Kiriyati Yeyarimi.

sentences.english: Then turning west, the line goes from Baalah to Mount Seir, and on to the side of Mount Jearim (which is Chesalon) on the north, then down to Beth-shemesh, and on past Timnah:
sentences.susu: A Keli mɛnni a siga sogegorode biri han a Seyiri geya li, a siga Yeyarimi geya sɛɛti ma, dɛnnaxɛ xili Kɛsalɔn. A man siga Beti Semesi, han a Timina li.

sentences.english: And out to the side of Ekron to the north: then it is marked out to Shikkeron and on to Mount Baalah, ending at Jabneel; the end of the line is at the sea.
sentences.susu: Na naaninyi sigaxi Ekiron nun Sikirɔn taae sɛɛti ma, han a Baala geya li, a siga Yabaneeli. Na dangi xanbi a sa baa li.

sentences.english: And the limit on the west is the edge of the Great Sea. This is the line going round the land marked out for the children of Judah, by their families.
sentences.susu: Baa Xungbe dɛ ra findi na naaninyi nan na sogegorode biri ra. Yudayakae xa naaninyie nan na ki. E xabilɛe birin na mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: And to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, he gave a part among the children of Judah, as the Lord had given orders to Joshua, that is, Kiriath-arba, named after Arba, the father of Anak which is Hebron.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa Yudayakae xa bɔxi nde fi Yefune xa di Kalebi ma, alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ. A xa taa singe findi Kiriyati Araba nan na, naxan xili Xebiron. Mixi naxan nu xili Araba, na nan lanxi Anaki bɔnsɔɛ benba ma.

sentences.english: And the three sons of Anak, Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai, the children of Anak, were forced out from there by Caleb.
sentences.susu: Kalebi naxa Anaki xa di xɛmɛ saxanyie keri. Nee nu xili nɛ Sɛsayi, Aximan, nun Talama.

sentences.english: From there he went up against the people of Debir: (now the name of Debir before that was Kiriath-sepher.)
sentences.susu: Na xanbi e naxa te Debiri xili ma, dɛnnaxɛ nu xili Kiriyati Sifa.

sentences.english: And Caleb said, I will give Achsah, my daughter, as wife to the man who overcomes Kiriath-sepher and takes it.
sentences.susu: Kalebi naxa a fala, «Mixi yo naxan na nɔ Sifa taa ra, n nan n ma di ginɛ Akasa fima nɛ a ma.»

sentences.english: And Othniel, the son of Kenaz, Caleb's brother, took it: so he gave him his daughter Achsah for his wife.
sentences.susu: Kalebi xunya Kenasi xa di xɛmɛ Otiniyeli naxa nɔ Sifa taa ra. Kalebi naxa a xa di ginɛ Akasa fi a ma.

sentences.english: Now when she came to him, he put into her mind the idea of requesting a field from her father: and she got down from her ass; and Caleb said to her, What is it?
sentences.susu: Akasa to siga Otiniyeli xɔn, a naxa a fala a bɛ a xa bɔxi gbɛtɛ maxɔrin a baba ma. Akasa to goro a xa sofale fari, Kalebi naxa a maxɔrin, «I wama munse xɔn?»

sentences.english: And she said, Give me a blessing; because you have put me in dry south-land, now give me springs of water. So he gave her the higher spring and the lower spring.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «N wama naxan xɔn, i bara bɔxi fi n ma naxan na yirefanyi biri ra. Yakɔsi i man xa ye yire fan fi n ma.» Awa, a baba naxa geya yire fi a ma. Ye nu na na geya fari, a man nu na geya bunyi.

sentences.english: This is the heritage of the tribe of Judah, by their families.
sentences.susu: Yuda xa die kɛ nan yi ki, e xabilɛ ki ma:

sentences.english: The farthest towns of the tribe of Judah in the direction of the limits of Edom to the south, were Kabzeel, and Eder, and Jagur;
sentences.susu: Taa naxee nu na yirefanyi ma, Negewi gbengberenyi ma, Edon naaninyi fɛ ma, e xili Kabaseeli, Ederi, Yaguru,

sentences.english: And Kinah, and Dimonah, and Adadah;
sentences.susu: Kina, Dimona, Adada,

sentences.english: And Kedesh, and Hazor, and Ithnan;
sentences.susu: Kedesi, Xasori, Yitinan,

sentences.english: Ziph, and Telem, and Bealoth;
sentences.susu: Sifi, Telemi, Beyaloti,

sentences.english: And Hazor-hadattah, and Kerioth-hezron (which is Hazor);
sentences.susu: Xasori Xadata, Keriyoti Xesiron, naxan findixi Xasori ra,

sentences.english: Amam, and Shema, and Moladah;
sentences.susu: Amama, Sema, Molada,

sentences.english: And Hazar-gaddah, and Heshmon, and Beth-pelet;
sentences.susu: Xasari Gada, Xesimon, Beti Pɛlɛti,

sentences.english: And Hazar-shual, and Beer-sheba, and Biziothiah;
sentences.susu: Xasari Suwali, Beriseeba, Bisiyoteya

sentences.english: Baalah, and Iim, and Ezem;
sentences.susu: Baala, Iyimi, Esemi,

sentences.english: And Eltolad, and Chesil, and Hormah;
sentences.susu: Elitoladi, Kesili, Horoma,

sentences.english: And Ziklag, and Madmannah, and Sansannah;
sentences.susu: Sikilaga, Madamanna, Sansanna,

sentences.english: And Lebaoth, and Shilhim, and Ain, and Rimmon; all the towns are twenty-nine, with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Lebayoti, Siliximi, Ayin, e nun Rimɔn. E birin nalanxi taa mɔxɔɲɛn nun solomanaani, nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: In the lowland, Eshtaol, and Zorah, and Ashnah;
sentences.susu: Taa naxee nu na Sefela bɔxi, e xili Esetayoli, Soraha, Asena,

sentences.english: And Zanoah, and En-gannim, Tappuah, and Enam;
sentences.susu: Sanowa, En Ganimi, Tapuwa, Enama,

sentences.english: Jarmuth, and Adullam, Socoh, and Azekah;
sentences.susu: Yaramuti, Adulama, Soko, Aseka,

sentences.english: And Shaaraim, and Adithaim, and Gederah, and Gederothaim; fourteen towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Saarayimi, Aditayimi, Gedera, e nun Gederotayimi. E birin nalanxi taa fu nun naani, nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: Zenan, and Hadashah, and Migdal-gad;
sentences.susu: Senan, Xadasa, Migidali Gadi,

sentences.english: And Dilan, and Mizpeh, and Joktheel;
sentences.susu: Dilana, Misipa, Yokatili,

sentences.english: Lachish, and Bozkath, and Eglon;
sentences.susu: Lakisi, Bɔsikati, Egilon,

sentences.english: And Cabbon, and Lahmas, and Chithlish;
sentences.susu: Kabɔn, Laxamasi, Kitilisi,

sentences.english: And Gederoth, Beth-dagon, and Naamah, and Makkedah; sixteen towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Gederoti, Beti Dagɔn, Nama, e nun Makeda. E birin nalanxi taa fu nun senni, nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: Libnah, and Ether, and Ashan;
sentences.susu: Libina, Eteri, Asan,

sentences.english: And Iphtah, and Ashnah, and Nezib;
sentences.susu: Yifita, Asena, Nesibi,

sentences.english: And Keilah, and Achzib, and Mareshah; nine towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Keyila, Akisibu, nun Maresa. E birin nalanxi taa solomanaani, nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: Ekron, with her daughter-towns and her unwalled places;
sentences.susu: Ekiron nun a daaxae,

sentences.english: From Ekron to the sea, all the towns by the side of Ashdod, with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: taa naxee na Ekiron nun Asidodi tagi sogegorode,

sentences.english: Ashdod, with her daughter-towns and her unwalled places; Gaza, with her daughter-towns and her unwalled places, to the stream of Egypt, with the Great Sea as a limit.
sentences.susu: Asidodi nun a daaxae, Gasa nun a daaxae, han Misira xure nun Baa Xungbe naralande.

sentences.english: And in the hill-country, Shamir, and Jattir, and Socoh;
sentences.susu: Taa naxee nu na geya yire, e xili Samiri, Yatiri, Soko,

sentences.english: And Dannah, and Kiriath-sannah (which is Debir);
sentences.susu: Danna, Kiriyati Sanna naxan findi Debiri ra,

sentences.english: And Anab, and Eshtemoh, and Anim;
sentences.susu: Anaba, Esitemowa, Enama,

sentences.english: And Goshen, and Holon, and Giloh; eleven towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Gosen, Xolon, Giloka. E birin nalanxi taa fu nun keren, nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: Arab, and Dumah, and Eshan;
sentences.susu: Arabi, Duma, Eseyan,

sentences.english: And Janim, and Beth-tappuah, and Aphekah;
sentences.susu: Yanimi, Beti Tapuwa, Afeka,

sentences.english: And Humtah, and Kiriath-arba (which is Hebron), and Zior; nine towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Xumeta, Kiriyati Araba naxan findi Xebiron na, e nun Siyoro. E birin nalanxi taa solomanaani, nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: Maon, Carmel, and Ziph, and Jutah;
sentences.susu: Mayon, Karemele, Sifi, Yuta,

sentences.english: And Jezreel, and Jokdeam, and Zanoah;
sentences.susu: Yisireeli, Yokodeyan, Sanowa,

sentences.english: Kain, Gibeah, and Timnah; ten towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Kayin, Gibiya, nun Timina. E birin nalanxi taa fu, nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: Halhul, Beth-zur, and Gedor;
sentences.susu: Xalixuli, Beti Suru, Gedori,

sentences.english: And Maarath, and Beth-anoth, and Eltekon; six towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Maarati, Beti Anoti, nun Elitekon. E birin nalanxi taa senni, nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: Kiriath-baal (which is Kiriath-jearim), and Rabbah; two towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Kiriyati Bali naxan findi Kiriyati Yeyarimi, nun Raba. E birin nalanxi taa firin, nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: In the waste land, Beth-arabah, Middin, and Secacah;
sentences.susu: Taa naxee nu na gbengberen yire, e xili Beti Araba, Midin, Sekaka,

sentences.english: And Nibshan, and the Town of Salt, and En-gedi; six towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Nibisan, Fɔxɔɛ taa, e nun En Gedi. E birin nalanxi taa senni, nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: And as for the Jebusites living in Jerusalem, the children of Judah were unable to make them go out; but the Jebusites are living with the children of Judah at Jerusalem, to this day.
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛ mu nɔ Yebusukae keride, naxee dɔxɔxi Darisalamu taa kui. Han to e na Yudayakae ya ma.

sentences.english: And the limit of the land marked out for the children of Joseph went out from Jordan at Jericho, at the waters of Jericho on the east, in the waste land, going up from Jericho through the hill-country to Beth-el;
sentences.susu: Bɔxi naxan fi Yusufu xa die ma Alatala xa maragiri saabui ra, a fɔlɔ Yurudɛn xure nan ma Yeriko sogetede biri, Yeriko dulonyi na dɛnnaxɛ. Na naaninyi dangi Yeriko taa nan na, a siga wula i, han a Beteli geya li.

sentences.english: And it goes out from Beth-el to Luz, and on as far as the limit of the Archites to Ataroth;
sentences.susu: A keli naa, a siga Lusi han Ataroti taa, Arakakae na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And it goes down to the west to the limit of the Japhletites, to the limit of Beth-horon the lower, as far as Gezer; ending at the sea.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi a siga sogegorode biri Yefeletikae yire han Beti Xoron Labe, han Geseri, han Fɔxɛ Ye Baa dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the children of Joseph, Manasseh and Ephraim, took their heritage.
sentences.susu: Yusufu xa die Manasi nun Efirami na nan sɔtɔ kɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the limit of the land of the children of Ephraim by their families was marked out in this way: the limit of their heritage to the east was Ataroth-addar, to Beth-horon the higher;
sentences.susu: Efirami xa bɔxi nan ya e xabilɛ ki ma: Naaninyi naxan na fuge ra, a fɔlɔ Ataroti Adari nɛ han Beti Xoron Fuge,

sentences.english: The line goes out to the west at Michmethath on the north; then turning to the east to Taanath-shiloh, going past it on the east of Janoah;
sentences.susu: han a baa dɛ li. A keli Mikimetati kɔɔla ma, a dangi Taanati Silo fuge ra, a siga Yanowa.

sentences.english: And from Janoah down to Ataroth, and to Naarah, and touching Jericho, it goes on to Jordan.
sentences.susu: A goro han Ataroti nun Naarata. A man dangi Yeriko ra, a sa mini Yurudɛn xure ma.

sentences.english: From Tappuah the line goes on to the west to the river of Kanah; ending at the sea. This is the heritage of the children of Ephraim by their families;
sentences.susu: A keli Tapuwa, a siga sogegorode biri han Kanna xure, han baa dɛ ra. Efirami bɔnsɔɛ kɛ nan na ki e xabilɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: Together with the towns marked out for the children of Ephraim in the heritage of Manasseh, all the towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Efirami bɔnsɔɛ naxa taa nun daaxa ndee fan sɔtɔ Manasi bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi kui.

sentences.english: And the Canaanites who were living in Gezer were not forced out; but the Canaanites have been living among Ephraim, to this day, as servants, doing forced work.
sentences.susu: Efirami bɔnsɔɛ mu Kanaankae keri Geseri. Han to nee na Efiramikae ya ma, kɔnɔ e findixi konyie nan na.

sentences.english: And this was the part marked out for the tribe of Manasseh, because he was the oldest son of Joseph. As for Machir, the oldest son of Manasseh, the father of Gilead, because he was a man of war he had Gilead and Bashan.
sentences.susu: Yusufu xa di singe Manasi naxa a gbe kɛ sɔtɔ Alatala xa maragiri saabui ra. Manasi xa di singe Makiri, naxa findi Galadikae benba ra. A naxa Galadi nun Basan bɔxi sɔtɔ barima geresoe nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: And as for the rest of the children of Manasseh, their heritage was given to them by families; for the children of Abiezer, and for the children of Helek, and for the children of Asriel, and for the children of Shechem, and for the children of Hepher, and for the children of Shemida: these were the male children of Manasseh, the son of Joseph, by their families.
sentences.susu: Manasi xa mamadie birin naxa e gbe kɛ sɔtɔ e xabilɛ ki ma. E xilie nan ya: Abiyeseri, Xeleki, Asirɛli, Sikemi, Xeferi, nun Sɛmida. Yusufu xa di Manasi xa die nan na ki, nun e xabilɛe.

sentences.english: But Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, had no sons, but only daughters; and these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
sentences.susu: Selofexadi, Xeferi xa di, Galadi xa di, Makiri xa di, Manasi xa di mu di xɛmɛ yo bari, fo di ginɛ suuli. E xilie nan ya: Maxala, Nuha, Xogala, Milika, a nun Tirisa.

sentences.english: And they came before Eleazar the priest, and Joshua, the son of Nun, and before the chiefs, saying, The Lord gave orders to Moses to give us a heritage among our brothers: so in agreement with the orders of the Lord he gave them a heritage among their father's brothers.
sentences.susu: E naxa siga sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Eleyasari, Nunu xa di Yosuwe, nun Isirayila kuntigie xɔn ma, e a fala e bɛ, «Alatala a masen nɛ Annabi Munsa bɛ a xa muxu gbe kɛ fi muxu ma alɔ muxu benba barenyie na a sɔtɔfe ki naxɛ.» Awa Yosuwe naxa e gbe kɛ fi e ma alɔ a a raba e baba xunya xɛmɛmae bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And ten parts were given to Manasseh, in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan, which is on the other side of Jordan;
sentences.susu: Manasi bɔnsɔɛ naxa dɔxɔ fu sɔtɔ, bafe Galadi nun Basan na, naxan na Yurudɛn kiri ma.

sentences.english: Because the daughters of Manasseh had a heritage among his sons, and the land of Gilead was the property of the other sons of Manasseh.
sentences.susu: Manasi xa di ginɛe naxa kɛ sɔtɔ alɔ a xa di xɛmɛe. Galadi bɔxi naxa lu Manasi xa di gbɛtɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: And the limit of Manasseh's land was from Asher to Michmethath, which is before Shechem; the line goes on to the right hand, to the people of En-tappuah.
sentences.susu: Manasi xa bɔxi naxa fɔlɔ Aseri bɔxi naaninyi ra han Mikimetati taa, naxan na Sikemi sogetede biri ra. A man sigaxi han Yamin naxan na En Tapuwa fɛ ma.

sentences.english: The land of Tappuah was the property of Manasseh; but Tappuah on the edge of Manasseh was the property of the children of Ephraim.
sentences.susu: En Tapuwa xa bɔxi nu findixi Manasikae gbe nan na, kɔnɔ Tapuwa taa naxan nu na naaninyi ra, na tan nu findixi Efirami nan gbe ra.

sentences.english: And the limit goes down to the stream Kanah, to the south of the stream: these towns were Ephraim's among the towns of Manasseh; Manasseh's limit was on the north side of the stream, ending at the sea:
sentences.susu: Na naaninyi nu goroxi han Kanna xure dɛ ra. Manasi xa bɔxi naaninyi findi Kanna xure nan na yirefanyi ma han baa dɛ ra, kɔnɔ Efirami xa taa ndee nu na Manasi xa taae ya ma.

sentences.english: To the south it is Ephraim's, and to the north it is Manasseh's, and the sea is his limit; and they are touching Asher on the north, and Issachar on the east.
sentences.susu: Efirami xa bɔxi nu Kanna xure yirefanyi nan ma. Manasi gbe nu na kɔɔla ma. Baa fan nu findixi e naaninyi nan na. Manasi xa bɔxi kɔɔla ma, nu na Aseri xa bɔxi nan sɛɛti ma. A sogetede biri nu na Isakari xa bɔxi nan sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: In Issachar and Asher, Manasseh had Beth-shean and its daughter-towns, and Ibleam and its daughter-towns, and the people of Dor and its daughter-towns, and the people of En-dor and its daughter-towns, and the people of Taanach and its daughter-towns, and the people of Megiddo and its daughter-towns, that is, the three hills.
sentences.susu: Manasi naxa taa ndee sɔtɔ Isakari nun Aseri xa bɔxie kui. E xili nan ya: Beti Saan, Yibeleyami, Dɔrɔ, En Dɔrɔ, Taanaki, nun Megido, nun e daaxae. Na saxanyi dɔnxɔɛe nu na Dɔrɔ xa mangɛya nan bun ma.

sentences.english: But the children of Manasseh were not able to make the people of those towns go out; but the Canaanites would go on living in that land.
sentences.susu: Manasi bɔnsɔɛ mu nɔ na taae ra, Kanaan mixie naxa lu naa.

sentences.english: And when the children of Israel had become strong, they put the Canaanites to forced work, in place of driving them out.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isirayilakae to sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ, e naxa konyiya dɔxɔ Kanaankae ma, kɔnɔ e mu nɔ e keride.

sentences.english: Then the children of Joseph said to Joshua, Why have you given me only one part and one stretch of land for my heritage? For through the blessing given to me by the Lord up to now, I am a great people.
sentences.susu: Yusufu xa die naxa Yosuwe maxɔrin, «I yi bɔxi kerenyi gbansan fixi muxu ma munfe ra? Muxu xabilɛ wuya, barima Alatala bara barakɛ sa muxu xa fe a fanyi ra.»

sentences.english: Then Joshua said to them, If you are such a great people, go up into the woodlands, clearing a place there for yourselves in the land of the Perizzites and the Rephaim, if the hill-country of Ephraim is not wide enough for you.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa e yaabi, «Xa wo wuya Efirami geya yire bɛ, wo xa siga Perisikae nun Refakae xa wondi yire, wo mɛnni masɛgɛ alako wo xa bɔxi sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: And the children of Joseph said, The hill-country is not enough for us: and all the Canaanites living in the valley have iron war-carriages, those in Beth-shean and its towns as well as those in the valley of Jezreel.
sentences.susu: Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «Yi geyae xurun muxu bɛ. Kanaanka naxee fan sabatixi geyae bunyi, Beti Saan nun e daaxae, naxee na Yisireeli geya bunyi, geresoe ragise wure daaxi na e yi ra.»

sentences.english: Then Joshua said to the children of Joseph, to Ephraim and Manasseh, You are a great people, and have great power: you are not to have one property only,
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ yaabi, «Efiramikae nun Manasikae, wo bara nɔndi fala kɔnɔ wo wuya, wo sɛnbɛ fan gbo. A mu lanma wo xa kɛ dɔxɔde keren gbansan sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: For the hill-country of Gilead will be yours ... the woodland and cut down ... its outskirts will be yours ... get the Canaanites out, for they have iron war-carriages ... strong.
sentences.susu: Wo na geyae findi wo gbe ra, hali wondi to a ra. Wo naa masɛgɛ alako wo xa na tɔnɛ sɔtɔ. Wo fama Kanaankae keride hali geresoe ragisee wure daaxi nan to na e yi ra.»

sentences.english: And all the meeting of the children of Israel came together at Shiloh and put up the Tent of meeting there: and the land was crushed before them.
sentences.susu: Isirayila ɲama to gɛ nɔde bɔxi ra, e naxa e malan Silo, e Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira ti naa.

sentences.english: But there were still seven tribes among the children of Israel who had not taken up their heritage.
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ solofere nu na na tɛmui, naxee mu nu e gbe kɛ sɔtɔxi sinden.

sentences.english: Then Joshua said to the children of Israel, Why are you so slow to go in and take up your heritage in the land which the Lord, the God of your fathers, has given you?
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa a fala Isirayilakae bɛ, «Wo dɔxɔxi be munfe ra? Munfe ra wo mu sigama wo xa bɔxi tongode wo benbae Marigi Alatala naxan fi wo ma?

sentences.english: Take from among you three men from every tribe; and I will send them to go through the land and make a record of it for distribution as their heritage; then let them come back to me.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi wo xa mixi saxan sugandi bɔnsɔɛ birin ya ma. N xa e xɛɛ, e xa e bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi birin mato, e fa sa na dɛntɛgɛ n bɛ.

sentences.english: And let them make division of it into seven parts: let Judah keep inside his limit on the south, and let the children of Joseph keep inside their limit on the north.
sentences.susu: Na bɔxi xa itaxun dɔxɔ solofere ra. Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xa lu na bɔxi yirefanyi ma, Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ fan xa lu na bɔxi kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: And you are to have the land marked out in seven parts, and come back to me with the record; and I will make the distribution for you here by the decision of the Lord our God.
sentences.susu: Wo na gɛ na bɔxi itaxunxi dɔxɔ solofere masende n bɛ, n fama natɛ tongode won Marigi Alatala xa mali saabui ra, alako nee xa itaxun wo ma.

sentences.english: For the Levites have no part among you; to be the Lord's priests is their heritage; and Gad and Reuben and the half-tribe of Manasseh have had their heritage on the east side of Jordan, given to them by Moses, the servant of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mu bɔxi yo sɔtɔma, barima e gbe kɛ findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛɲa nan na Alatala bɛ. Gadi, Ruben, a nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti singe ɲan bara e gbe sɔtɔ Yurudɛn xure kiri ma sogetede biri ra alɔ Annabi Munsa a fi e ma ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: So the men got up and went; and Joshua gave orders to those who went, to make a record of the land, saying, Go up and down through the land, and make a record of it and come back here to me, and I will make the distribution for you here by the decision of the Lord in Shiloh.
sentences.susu: Na kui na xɛmɛe naxa siga. Yosuwe nu bara e yamari, «Wo siga, wo bɔxi iɲɛrɛ. Wo xa a mato a na ki naxɛ. Na xanbi wo xa fa be Silo, n xa natɛ tongo won Marigi Alatala xa mali saabui ra, won na bɔxi itaxunma wo ma ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: So the men went, travelling through the land, and made a record of it by towns in seven parts in a book, and came back to Joshua to the tent-circle at Shiloh.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛe naxa siga bɔxi matode. E taa naxee to na yire solofere kui, e naxa nee birin xilie sɛbɛ, e fa a ra Yosuwe xɔn Silo yonkinde kui.

sentences.english: And Joshua made the distribution for them in Shiloh by the decision of the Lord, marking out the land for the children of Israel by their divisions.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa natɛ tongo Silo Alatala xa mali saabui ra. A naxa na bɔxi birin itaxun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe ma.

sentences.english: And the first heritage came out for the tribe of Benjamin by their families: and the limit of their heritage went between the children of Judah and the children of Joseph.
sentences.susu: Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe birin naxa e gbe sɔtɔ Yuda bɔnsɔɛ gbe nun Yusufu xa die gbe tagi Alatala xa maragiri saabui ra.

sentences.english: And their limit on the north was from the Jordan, and the line goes up to the side of Jericho on the north and through the hill-country to the west, ending at the waste land of Beth-aven.
sentences.susu: E xa naaninyi kɔɔla ma fɔlɔ Yurudɛn xure nan ma, a dangi Yeriko ra kɔɔla biri ra, a te geya ma sogegorode biri ra han a Beti Aweni gbengberenyi li.

sentences.english: And from there the line goes south to Luz, to the side of Luz (which is Beth-el), then down to Ataroth-addar, by the mountain to the south of Beth-horon the lower.
sentences.susu: A keli mɛnni, a dangi Lusi ra, naxan man xili Beteli, yirefanyi biri ra. A goro han Ataroti Adari, a te geya fari, naxan na Beti Xoron Labe yirefanyi ma.

sentences.english: And the limit is marked as coming round to the south on the west side from the mountain which is south of Beth-horon, and ending at Kiriath-baal (which is Kiriath-jearim), a town of the children of Judah: this is the west part.
sentences.susu: Na naaninyi naxa goro na geya fari a siga baa sɛɛti xɔn ma sigafe ra Kiriyati Bali, naxan man xili Kiriyati Yeyarimi. Na taa findi Yuda xa die nan gbe ra. Naaninyi nan na ki naxan na sogegorode.

sentences.english: And the south part is from the farthest point of Kiriath-jearim, and the line goes out to the west to the fountain of the waters of Nephtoah:
sentences.susu: Naxan na yirefanyi ma, a fɔlɔ Kiriyati Yeyarimi nɛ, a siga sogegorode biri ra han a Nefetowa dulonyi li.

sentences.english: And the line goes down to the farthest part of the mountain facing the valley of the son of Hinnom, which is on the north of the valley of Rephaim: from there it goes down to the valley of Hinnom, to the side of the Jebusite on the south as far as En-rogel;
sentences.susu: Na naaninyi naxa goro mɛnni, a siga han Ben Hinoma geya bunyi ra, Refakae xa gulunba kui kɔɔla mabiri. A keli mɛnni, a goro Ben Hinoma geya bunyi ra, Yebusukae fɛ ma. A yirefanyi ma, a siga han En Rogeli.

sentences.english: And it goes to En-shemesh and on to Geliloth, opposite the way up to Adummim, and it goes down to the stone of Bohan, the son of Reuben;
sentences.susu: Na naaninyi sigaxi En Semesi kɔɔla biri ra, a siga Geliloti, naxan na Adumimi geya ya ra. A goro han Ruben xa di Bohan xa fanye ma.

sentences.english: And it goes on to the side facing the Arabah to the north, and down to the Arabah;
sentences.susu: A dangi geya ra kɔɔla biri ra, geya naxan na Yurudɛn gulunba ya tagi. A goro Yurudɛn gulunba kui,

sentences.english: And on to the north side of Beth-hoglah, ending at the north inlet of the Salt Sea at the south end of Jordan; this is their limit on the south.
sentences.susu: a dangi Beti Xogala ra, kɔɔla biri ra. Na yirefanyi naaninyi danxi Yurudɛn xure sode nan ma Fɔxɛ Baa xun.

sentences.english: And the limit of the east part is the Jordan. This is the heritage of the children of Benjamin, marked out for their families by these limits on all sides.
sentences.susu: Yurudɛn xure findixi Bunyamin xabilɛe xa bɔxi naaninyi nan na sogetede biri ra. Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ xa naaninyi birin nan na ki.

sentences.english: And the towns of the children of Benjamin, given to them in the order of their families, are Jericho and Beth-hoglah and Emek-kezziz
sentences.susu: Taa naxee fi Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe ma, nee nan ya: Yeriko, Beti Xogala, Emeki Kesisi,

sentences.english: And Beth-arabah and Zemaraim and Beth-el
sentences.susu: Beti Araba, Sɛmarayima, Beteli,

sentences.english: And Avvim and Parah and Ophrah
sentences.susu: Awimi, Para, Ofara,

sentences.english: And Chephar-Ammoni and Ophni and Geba; twelve towns with their unwalled places;
sentences.susu: Kefarahamoni, Ofini, nun Geba. Na birin lanxi taa fu nun firin nan ma, a nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: Gibeon and Ramah and Beeroth
sentences.susu: Gabayon, Ramati, Beeroti,

sentences.english: And Mizpeh and Chephirah and Mozah
sentences.susu: Misipa, Kefira, Mosa,

sentences.english: And Rekem and Irpeel and Taralah
sentences.susu: Rekemi, Yiripeeli, Tarala,

sentences.english: And Zela, Eleph and the Jebusite (which is Jerusalem), Gibeath and Kiriath; fourteen towns with their unwalled places. This is the heritage of the children of Benjamin by their families.
sentences.susu: Sela, Elefi, Yebusu naxan man xili Darisalamu, Gibiya, a nun Kiriyati Yeyarimi lanxi taa fu nun naani nan ma a nun e daaxae. Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe kɛ nan na ki.

sentences.english: And the second heritage came out for the tribe of Simeon by their families; and their heritage was in the middle of the heritage of the children of Judah.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi taxun firin nde kui, naxan nabaxi won Marigi Alatala xa mali saabui ra, Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ naxa e gbe kɛ sɔtɔ Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi kui.

sentences.english: And they had for their heritage Beer-sheba and Shema and Moladah
sentences.susu: Taa naxee fixi Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ ma, nee nan ya: Beriseeba, Seeba, Molada,

sentences.english: And Hazar-shual and Balah and Ezem
sentences.susu: Xasari Suwali, Bala, Esemi,

sentences.english: And Eltolad and Bethul and Hormah
sentences.susu: Elitoladi, Bɛtuli, Horoma,

sentences.english: And Ziklag and Beth-marcaboth and Hazar-susah
sentences.susu: Sikilaga, Beti Marakaboti, Xasari Susa,

sentences.english: And Beth-lebaoth and Sharuhen; thirteen towns with their unwalled places;
sentences.susu: Beti Lebayoti, a nun Saruxɛn. Na birin lanxi taa fu nun saxan nan ma, a nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: Ain, Rimmon, and Ether and Ashan; four towns with their unwalled places;
sentences.susu: Ayin, Rimɔn, Eteri, nun Asan lanxi taa naani nan ma, a nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: And all the unwalled places round about these towns as far as Baalath-beer-ramah to the south. This is the heritage of the tribe of Simeon by their families.
sentences.susu: Na daaxae sigama han Baalati Beeri, naxan nu xili Ramati Negewi gbengberenyi ma. Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe kɛ nan na ki.

sentences.english: The heritage of Simeon was taken out of Judah's stretch of land, for Judah's part was more than they had need of, so the heritage of the children of Simeon was inside their heritage.
sentences.susu: E kɛ nu na Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi nan kui, barima bɔxi naxan so Yuda bɔnsɔɛ yi ra, a nu gbo. Nde ba na bɔxi nan na, a naxa so Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ yi ra.

sentences.english: And the third heritage came out for Zebulun by their families; the limit of their heritage was as far as Sarid;
sentences.susu: Bɔxi taxun saxan nde naxa findi Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe gbe ra Alatala xa maragiri saabui ra. E xa bɔxi naaninyi sigaxi han Saridi,

sentences.english: And their limit goes up to the west to Maralah, stretching to Dabbesheth, and to the stream in front of Jokneam;
sentences.susu: a te Marala sogegorode, han Dabeseti, a man siga xure dɛ ra naxan na Yokanayimi ya ra.

sentences.english: Then turning east from Sarid to the limit of Chisloth-tabor, it goes out to Daberath, and up to Japhia;
sentences.susu: A keli Saridi a a ibilin sogetede biri ra, a Kisiloti Taboro li. A siga han Daberati, han Yafiya.

sentences.english: And from there it goes on east to Gath-hepher, to Eth-kazin; ending at Rimmon which goes as far as Neah;
sentences.susu: A tan na sogetede biri ra, a siga Gati Xeferi nun Eta Kasin. A na Rimɔn li, a siga Neya biri ra.

sentences.english: And the line goes round it on the north to Hannathon, ending at the valley of Iphtah-el;
sentences.susu: Kɔɔla ma, na naaninyi nan sigaxi Xanatɔn han a Yifita Eli gulunba li.

sentences.english: And Kattath and Nahalal and Shimron and Idalah and Beth-lehem; twelve towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: E man naxa Katati, Nahalali, Simiron, Yidala, nun Bɛtɛlɛɛmu sɔtɔ. Na birin nalanxi taa fu nun firin, a nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: This is the heritage of the children of Zebulun by their families, these towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe kɛ nan na ki, e xa taae nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: For Issachar the fourth heritage came out, for the children of Issachar by their families;
sentences.susu: Bɔxi taxun naani nde naxa findi Isakari bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe gbe ra Alatala xa maragiri saabui ra.

sentences.english: And their limit was to Jezreel and Chesulloth and Shunem
sentences.susu: E xa naaninyi naxa yi taae birin li: Yisireeli, Kesuloti, Sunemi,

sentences.english: And Hapharaim and Shion and Anaharath
sentences.susu: Xafarayimi, Siyon, Anaxarati,

sentences.english: And Rabbith and Kishion and Ebez
sentences.susu: Rabiti, Kisiyon, Abɛsi,

sentences.english: And Remeth and En-gannim and En-haddah and Beth-pazzez;
sentences.susu: Remeti, En Ganimi, En Xada, Beti Pasɛsi,

sentences.english: And their limit goes as far as Tabor and Shahazimah and Beth-shemesh, ending at Jordan; sixteen towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Taboro, Saxasima, nun Beti Semesi. Naaninyi danxi Yurudɛn xure dɛ nan na. E birin nalanxi taa fu nun senni, a nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: This is the heritage of the tribe of the children of Issachar by their families, these towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Isakari bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe kɛ nan na ki, e xa taae nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: And the fifth heritage came out for the tribe of Asher by their families.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi taxun suuli nde naxa findi Aseri bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe gbe ra Alatala xa maragiri saabui ra.

sentences.english: And their limit was Helkath and Hali and Beten and Achshaph
sentences.susu: E xa naaninyi na yi taae nan na: Xɛlɛkati, Xali, Beten, Akisafa,

sentences.english: And Alammelech and Amad and Mishal, stretching to Carmel on the west and Shihor-libnath;
sentences.susu: Alameleki, Amada, nun Misala. E xa naaninyi sogegorode biri na Karemele geya nun Sixori Libanati xure nan na.

sentences.english: Turning to the east to Beth-dagon and stretching to Zebulun and the valley of Iphtah-el as far as Beth-emek and Neiel to the north; on the left it goes as far as Cabul
sentences.susu: E xa naaninyi sogetede biri fɔlɔxi Beti Dagɔn nɛ, Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ na dɛnnaxɛ, nun Yifita Eli gulunba. A siga kɔɔla ma Beti Emeki nun Neyiyeli. A dangi Kabulu ra kɔɔla biri ra.

sentences.english: And Ebron and Rehob and Hammon and Kanah, to great Zidon;
sentences.susu: A naxa siga Abadon, Rexobo, Xamɔn, nun Kanna, han Sidɔn taa xungbe.

sentences.english: And the limit goes round to Ramah and the walled town of Tyre and Hosah, ending at the sea by Heleb and Achzib;
sentences.susu: Naaninyi keli Sidɔn, a siga Ramati nun Tire taa makantaxi mabiri. A siga Xosa, a mini Fɔxɛ Ye Baa ma Akisibu bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: And Ummah and Aphek and Rehob; twenty-two towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Uma, Afeki, nun Rexobo taae. E birin lanma taa mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin nan ma, a nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: This is the heritage of the tribe of the children of Asher by their families, these towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Yi taae nun daaxae birin findixi Aseri bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe kɛ nan na.

sentences.english: For the children of Naphtali the sixth heritage came out, for the children of Naphtali by their families;
sentences.susu: Bɔxi taxun senni nde naxa findi Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe gbe ra Alatala xa maragiri saabui ra.

sentences.english: And their limit was from Heleph, from the oak-tree in Zaanannim, and Adami-hannekeb and Jabneel, as far as Lakkum, ending at Jordan;
sentences.susu: Na bɔxi naaninyi naxa fɔlɔ Xelefa taa ma, a siga wuri bili belebele nde ma naxan na Saananimi. A dangi Adami Nekebi nun Yabaneeli ra, a Lakuma li, a siga han Yurudɛn xure dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And turning west to Aznoth-tabor, the limit goes out from there to Hukkok, stretching to Zebulun on the south, and Asher on the west, and Judah at Jordan on the east.
sentences.susu: Na naaninyi naxa siga sogegorode biri ra han a Asanoti Taboro li, a sa mini Hulɔku taa ma. A Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi li yirefanyi ma, a Aseri bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi li sogegorode biri ra. A Yurudɛn xure li sogetede biri ra.

sentences.english: And the walled towns are Ziddim, Zer, and Hammath, Rakkath, and Chinnereth
sentences.susu: Taae nan ya tɛtɛ hagigɛe nu soxi naxee ra: Sidima, Sere, Xamata, Rakati, Kinereti,

sentences.english: And Adamah and Ramah and Hazor
sentences.susu: Adama, Ramati, Xasori,

sentences.english: And Kedesh and Edrei and En-Hazor
sentences.susu: Kedesi, Edereyi, En Xasori,

sentences.english: And Iron and Migdal-el, Horem and Beth-anath and Beth-shemesh; nineteen towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Yirɔn, Migidali Eli, Xoremi, Beti Anati, Beti Semesi. Na birin lanxi taa fu nun solomanaani nan ma, a nun e daaxae.

sentences.english: This is the heritage of the tribe of the children of Naphtali by their families, these towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe kɛ nan na ki.

sentences.english: For the tribe of Dan by their families the seventh heritage came out;
sentences.susu: Bɔxi taxun solofere nde naxa findi Dana bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛe gbe ra Alatala xa maragiri saabui ra.

sentences.english: And the limit of their heritage was Zorah and Eshtaol and Ir-shemesh
sentences.susu: E xa bɔxi naaninyi na yi taae nan na: Soraha, Esetayoli, Iri Semesi,

sentences.english: And Shaalabbin and Aijalon and Ithlah
sentences.susu: Saalabin, Ayalon, Yitila,

sentences.english: And Elon and Timnah and Ekron
sentences.susu: Elon, Timina, Ekiron,

sentences.english: And Eltekeh and Gibbethon and Baalath
sentences.susu: Eliteke, Gibɛtɔn, Baalati,

sentences.english: And Jehud and Bene-berak and Gath-rimmon;
sentences.susu: Yehudu, Beneberaki, Gati Rimɔn,

sentences.english: And on the west was ... opposite Joppa.
sentences.susu: Yarakɔn dulonyi, Rakɔn, nun bɔxi naxan na Yafa ya ra.

sentences.english: (But the limit of the children of Dan was not wide enough for them; so the children of Dan went up and made war on Leshem and took it, putting it to the sword without mercy, and they took it for their heritage and made a place for themselves there, giving it the name of Leshem-dan, after the name of their father, Dan.)
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na bɔxi kanyie man naxa gbilen e xa bɔxi ma. Na kui Dana bɔnsɔɛ naxa siga Lesemi gerede. E naxa naa masɔtɔ, e mɛnnikae faxa santidɛgɛma ra. E sabati mɛnni, e fa e baba Dana xili sa naa xun.

sentences.english: This is the heritage of the tribe of the children of Dan by their families, these towns with their unwalled places.
sentences.susu: Yi taae nun daaxae birin findixi Dana xabilɛe kɛ nan na.

sentences.english: So the distribution of the land and its limits was complete; and the children of Israel gave Joshua, the son of Nun, a heritage among them;
sentences.susu: E to gɛ e xa bɔxi itaxunde, e naxa Nunu xa di Yosuwe kɛ fi a ma e tagi Alatala xa maragiri saabui ra.

sentences.english: By the orders of the Lord they gave him the town for which he made request, Timnath-serah in the hill-country of Ephraim: there, after building the town, he made his living-place.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe taa naxan maxɔrin e ma, Timina Sera, e naxa na fi a ma alɔ Alatala a masen e bɛ ki naxɛ. Na taa na Efirami bɔnsɔɛ xa geya bɔxi nan kui. Yosuwe naxa taa ragbilen a nɛɛnɛ ra, a sabati naa.

sentences.english: These are the heritages which Eleazar the priest and Joshua, the son of Nun, and the heads of families of the tribes of the children of Israel gave out at Shiloh, by the decision of the Lord, at the door of the Tent of meeting. So the distribution of the land was complete.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Eleyasari, Yosuwe, nun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛ kuntigie bɔxi itaxun Alatala xa mali saabui ra na ki nɛ, a xa hɔrɔmɔlingira naadɛ ra naxan nu na Silo.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Joshua,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Yosuwe bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the children of Israel, Let certain towns be marked out as safe places, as I said to you by the mouth of Moses,
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayilakae bɛ e xa taa ndee sugandi mixie ratangama dɛnnaxɛ, alɔ n a fala Annabi Munsa bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So that any man who in error and without design has taken the life of another, may go in flight to them: and they will be safe places for you from him who has the right of punishment for blood.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde sa a boore nde faxa, kɔnɔ a fa a li a mu a rakelixi a ma, a xa a gi, a siga na taa nde a ratangama gbeɲɔxɔɛ ti ma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And if anyone goes in flight to one of those towns, and comes into the public place of the town, and puts his cause before the responsible men of the town, they will take him into the town and give him a place among them where he may be safe.
sentences.susu: A na na taa li tɛmui naxɛ, a xa ti naa sode dɛ ra, a fa a dɛntɛgɛ forie bɛ. Nee xa a raso taa kui, e a yigiya e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And if the one who has the right of punishment comes after him, they are not to give the taker of life up to him; because he was the cause of his neighbour's death without designing it and not in hate.
sentences.susu: Xa gbeɲɔxɔɛ ti sa siga naa, e naxa na faxɛti so a yi ra de, barima na faxɛ mu kelixi ɲanige xa ma.

sentences.english: And he is to go on living in that town till he has to come before the meeting of the people to be judged; (till the death of him who is high priest at that time:) then the taker of life may come back to his town and to his house, to the town from which he had gone in flight.
sentences.susu: Faxɛti xa lu na taa kui han a xa makiiti mɛnnikae ya xɔri. E xa a lu na taa kui han sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi faxama tɛmui naxɛ. Na xanbi na mixi xa gbilen a xɔnyi, a kelixi dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: So they made selection of Kedesh in Galilee in the hill-country of Naphtali, and Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim, and Kiriath-arba (which is Hebron) in the hill-country of Judah.
sentences.susu: E naxa yi taae sugandi: Kedesi naxan na Galile bɔxi ma Nafatali geyae na dɛnnaxɛ, Sikemi naxan na Efirami geyae fari, Kiriyati Araba naxan xili Xebiron, naxan na Yudaya geyae ma.

sentences.english: And on the east side of Jordan at Jericho, they made selection of Bezer in the waste land, in the table-land, out of the tribe of Reuben, and Ramoth in Gilead out of the tribe of Gad, and Golan in Bashan out of the tribe of Manasseh.
sentences.susu: E naxa taa gbɛtɛe fan sugandi Yurudɛn xure kiri ma sogetede biri ra: Beteseri, naxan na Ruben xa gbengberenyi ma, Ramoti naxan na Galadi bɔxi ma, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ na dɛnnaxɛ, Golan naxan na Basan bɔxi ma, Manasi bɔnsɔɛ na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: These were the towns marked out for all the children of Israel and for the man from a strange country living among them, so that anyone causing the death of another in error, might go in flight there, and not be put to death by him who has the right of punishment for blood till he had come before the meeting of the people.
sentences.susu: Taae nan na ki naxee sugandixi Isirayilakae nun e xa xɔɲɛe bɛ, alako naxan na mixi faxa, kɔnɔ a mu a rakelixi a ma, a xa a yɛtɛ ratanga gbeɲɔxɔɛ ti ma mɛɛni. Na kui mixi mu faxama gbeɲɔxɔɛ ti saabui ra, beenun ɲama xa a makiiti.

sentences.english: Then the heads of the families of the Levites came to Eleazar the priest and Joshua, the son of Nun, and to the heads of families of the tribes of the children of Israel;
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ kuntigie naxa siga sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Eleyasari, Nunu xa di Yosuwe, nun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ xabilɛ kuntigie xɔn ma Silo taa kui Kanaan bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And said to them in Shiloh in the land of Canaan, The Lord gave orders by Moses that we were to have towns for living in, with their grass-lands for our cattle.
sentences.susu: E sa a fala e bɛ, «Alatala a masen nɛ nu Annabi Munsa bɛ a muxu xa taae sɔtɔ muxu sabatima dɛnnaxɛ, a nun muxu xa fiilie fan sɔtɔ muxu xa xurusee bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the children of Israel out of their heritage gave to the Levites these towns with their grass-lands, by the order of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na kui Isirayilakae naxa yi taae nun yi fiilie fi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ma, e xa findi e kɛ ra alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the heritage came out for the families of the Kohathites: the children of Aaron the priest, who were of the Levites, were given thirteen towns from the tribes of Judah, Simeon, and Benjamin.
sentences.susu: Kehati xabilɛ gbe nan ya: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Haruna xa die naxa taa fu nun saxan sɔtɔ Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xa taae ya ma, Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ gbee ya ma, nun Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ gbee ya ma.

sentences.english: The rest of the children of Kohath by their families were given ten towns from the tribes of Ephraim and Dan and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
sentences.susu: Kehati xabilɛ, naxee nu luxi, nee naxa taa fu sɔtɔ Efirami bɔnsɔɛ gbee ya ma, Dana bɔnsɔɛ gbee ya ma, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti boore gbee ya ma. Na natɛ birin tongoxi Ala xa maragiri saabui ra.

sentences.english: The children of Gershon by their families were given thirteen towns from the tribes of Issachar and Asher and Naphtali and the half-tribe of Manasseh which was in Bashan.
sentences.susu: Gerison xa die naxa taa fu nun saxan sɔtɔ Isakari bɔnsɔɛ gbee ya ma, Aseri bɔnsɔɛ gbee ya ma, Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ gbee ya ma, a nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti singe naxan na Basan bɔxi ma, na gbee ya ma. Na natɛ birin tongoxi Ala xa maragiri saabui ra.

sentences.english: The children of Merari by their families were given twelve towns from the tribes of Reuben and Gad and Zebulun.
sentences.susu: Merari xa die naxa taa fu nun firin sɔtɔ e xabilɛ ki ma Ruben bɔnsɔɛ gbee ya ma, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ gbee ya ma, nun Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ gbee ya ma. Na natɛ birin tongoxi Ala xa maragiri saabui ra.

sentences.english: All these towns with their grass-lands the children of Israel gave by the decision of the Lord to the Levites, as the Lord had given orders by Moses.
sentences.susu: Na kui Isirayilakae naxa yi taae nun e fiilie fi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ma alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ Annabi Munsa saabui ra.

sentences.english: From the tribes of the children of Judah and the children of Simeon they gave these towns, listed here by name:
sentences.susu: Taa naxee fixi e ma Yuda nun Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, nee nan ya.

sentences.english: These were for the children of Aaron among the families of the Kohathites, of the children of Levi: for they came first in the distribution.
sentences.susu: Haruna xa die gbe, naxee keli Kehati xabilɛ, nee naxa yi taae sɔtɔ Ala xa maragiri saabui ra sugandi singe kui:

sentences.english: They gave them Kiriath-arba, the town of Arba, the father of Anak, (which is Hebron) in the hill-country of Judah, with its grass-lands.
sentences.susu: Kiriyati Araba, naxan findi Xebiron na, a nun fiili naxee na Yudaya geya bɔxi rabilinyi ma. Araba findi Anakie benba nan na.

sentences.english: But the open country round the town, and its unwalled places, they gave to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, as his property.
sentences.susu: Daaxae nun taa xunxuri naxee na taa fari ma nee findi Yefune xa di Kalebi gbee nan na.

sentences.english: And to the children of Aaron the priest they gave Hebron with its grass-lands, the town where the taker of life might be safe, and Libnah with its grass-lands;
sentences.susu: E taa naxee fi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Haruna xa die ma, nee nan yi ki: Xebiron, mixi ratanga taa nde, Libina,

sentences.english: And Jattir with its grass-lands, and Eshtemoa with its grass-lands;
sentences.susu: Yatiri, Esitemowa,

sentences.english: And Holon with its grass-lands, and Debir with its grass-lands;
sentences.susu: Xolon, Debiri,

sentences.english: And Ain, and Juttah, and Beth-shemesh, with their grass-lands; nine towns from those two tribes.
sentences.susu: Ayin, Yuta, nun Beti Semesi, nun e fiilie. Na birin nalanxi taa solomanaani, kelife yi bɔnsɔɛ firinyi ma.

sentences.english: And from the tribe of Benjamin they gave Gibeon and Geba with their grass-lands;
sentences.susu: E naxa yi taae sɔtɔ Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi kui: Gabayon, Geba,

sentences.english: Anathoth and Almon with their grass-lands, four towns.
sentences.susu: Anatɔti, Alamɔn, nun e fiilie. Na birin nalanxi taa naani.

sentences.english: Thirteen towns with their grass-lands were given to the children of Aaron, the priests.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Haruna xa die naxa taa fu nun saxan sɔtɔ, nun e fiilie.

sentences.english: The rest of the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites, were given towns from the tribe of Ephraim.
sentences.susu: Lewika naxee kelixi Kehati xa di booree ya ma, Ala xa maragiri naxa a niya nee naxa taae sɔtɔ Efirami bɔnsɔɛ ya ma.

sentences.english: And they gave them Shechem with its grass-lands in the hill-country of Ephraim, the town where the taker of life might be safe, and Gezer with its grass-lands;
sentences.susu: Na taae nan ya: Sikemi naxan na Efirami geya bɔxi fari, mixi nɔma ratangade gbeɲɔxɔɛ ti ma dɛnnaxɛ, Geseri,

sentences.english: And Kibzaim and Beth-horon with their grass-lands, four towns.
sentences.susu: Kibisayimi, Beti Xoron, nun e fiilie. Na birin nalanxi taa naani.

sentences.english: And from the tribe of Dan, Elteke and Gibbethon with their grass-lands;
sentences.susu: E naxee sɔtɔ Dana xa bɔxi kui, nee nan ya: Eliteke, Gibɛtɔn,

sentences.english: Aijalon and Gath-rimmon with their grass-lands, four towns.
sentences.susu: Ayalon, Gati Rimɔn, nun e fiilie. Na birin nalanxi taa naani.

sentences.english: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh, Taanach and Gath-rimmon with their grass-lands, two towns.
sentences.susu: E naxee sɔtɔ Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti boore xa bɔxi kui, nee nan ya: Taanaki, Gati Rimɔn, nun e fiilie. Na birin nalanxi taa firin.

sentences.english: All the towns of the rest of the families of the children of Kohath were ten with their grass-lands.
sentences.susu: Yi taa fu nun e fiilie naxa findi Kehati xa die xabilɛe gbe ra naxee mu nu na Haruna xa die ya ma.

sentences.english: And to the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, they gave from the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its grass-lands, the town where the taker of life might be safe, and Ashtaroth with its grass-lands, two towns.
sentences.susu: Gerison xabilɛe naxa taae sɔtɔ Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti singe ya ma. E xili Golan, mixi ratanga taa nde naxan na Basan bɔxi ma, Bɛsɛtɛra, nun e fiilie. Na birin nalanxi taa firin.

sentences.english: And from the tribe of Issachar, Kishion and Daberath with their grass-lands;
sentences.susu: E naxee sɔtɔ Isakari bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi kui, nee nan ya: Kisiyon, Daberati,

sentences.english: Jarmuth and En-gannim with their grass-lands, four towns.
sentences.susu: Yaramuti, Ganimi, nun e fiilie. Na birin nalanxi taa naani.

sentences.english: And from the tribe of Asher, Mishal and Abdon, with their grass-lands:
sentences.susu: E naxee sɔtɔ Aseri bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi kui, nee nan ya: Misala, Abadon,

sentences.english: Helkath and Rehob with their grass-lands, four towns.
sentences.susu: Xɛlɛkati, Rexobo, nun e fiilie. Na birin nalanxi taa naani.

sentences.english: And from the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its grass-lands, the town where the taker of life might be safe, and Hammoth-dor and Kartan with their grass-lands, three towns.
sentences.susu: E naxee sɔtɔ Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi kui, nee nan ya: Kedesi, mixi ratanga taa nde naxan na Galile bɔxi kui nun a fiilie, Xamɔti Dɔrɔ nun a fiilie, Karatan nun a fiilie. Na birin nalanxi taa saxan.

sentences.english: All the towns of the Gershonites with their families were thirteen with their grass-lands.
sentences.susu: Gerison xabilɛe naxa taa fu nun saxan sɔtɔ nun e fiilie.

sentences.english: And to the rest of the Levites, that is, the families of the children of Merari, they gave from the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam and Kartah with their grass-lands;
sentences.susu: Lewikae naxee luxi, Merari xabilɛe ra, e naxee sɔtɔ Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, nee nan ya: Yokanayimi, Karata,

sentences.english: Dimnah and Nahalal with their grass-lands, four towns.
sentences.susu: Dimina, Nahalali, nun e fiilie. Na birin nalanxi taa naani.

sentences.english: And from the tribe of Reuben, Bezer and Jahaz with their grass-lands;
sentences.susu: E naxee sɔtɔ Ruben bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi kui, nee nan ya: Beteseri, Yahasi,

sentences.english: Kedemoth and Mephaath with their grass-lands, four towns.
sentences.susu: Kedemoti, Mefaati, nun e fiilie. Na birin nalanxi taa naani.

sentences.english: And from the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead, the town where the taker of life might be safe, and Mahanaim with their grass-lands;
sentences.susu: E naxee sɔtɔ Gadi bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi kui, nee nan ya: Ramoti, mixi ratanga taa nde naxan na Galadi bɔxi kui, Maxanayimi,

sentences.english: Heshbon and Jazer with their grass-lands, four towns.
sentences.susu: Xɛsibɔn, Yaasɛri, nun e fiilie. Na birin nalanxi taa naani.

sentences.english: All these towns were given to the children of Merari by their families, that is, the rest of the families of the Levites; and their heritage was twelve towns.
sentences.susu: Taa naxee birin fixi Merari xabilɛe ma, e ralanxi taa fu nun firin.

sentences.english: All the towns of the Levites, among the heritage of the children of Israel, were forty-eight towns with their grass-lands.
sentences.susu: Taa naxee birin fixi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ma Isirayilakae xa bɔxi kui, e ralanxi taa tongo naani nun solomasaxan, nun e rabilinyie.

sentences.english: Every one of these towns had grass-lands round it.
sentences.susu: Fiilie nu na taae birin nabilinxi.

sentences.english: So the Lord gave to Israel all the land which he gave by oath to their fathers; so it became their heritage and their living-place.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa na bɔxi birin fi Isirayilakae ma alɔ a a laayidi e benbae bɛ ki naxɛ. Na bɔxi birin naxa findi e gbe ra, e naxa sabati naa.

sentences.english: And the Lord gave them peace on every side, as he had said to their fathers: all those who were against them gave way before them, for the Lord gave them all up into their hands.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa bɔɲɛsa fi e ma e naaninyi birin na, alɔ a a laayidi e benbae bɛ ki naxɛ. E yaxui yo mu nɔ xunnakeli sɔtɔde e xun, barima Alatala e yaxui birin sa nɛ e sagoe.

sentences.english: The Lord kept faith with the house of Israel about all the good which he said he would do for them, and all his words came true.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa laayidi birin naxa kamali Isirayilakae bɛ. Keren mu lu naxan mu kamali.

sentences.english: Then Joshua sent for the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yosuwe naxa Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti singe xili.

sentences.english: And said to them, You have kept all the orders of Moses, the Lord's servant, and have done everything I gave you orders to do:
sentences.susu: A a fala e bɛ, «Alatala xa konyi Munsa fe naxan birin fala wo bɛ, wo bara na birin naba. Wo man bara bira n xui birin fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: You have now been with your brothers for a long time; till this day you have been doing the orders of the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo mu wo ngaxakerenyie rabɛɲin yi xi wuyaxie bun ma han to. Wo Marigi Alatala yaamari naxan so wo yi ra, wo bara wo ɲɛngi sa a xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And now the Lord your God has given your brothers rest, as he said: so now you may go back to your tents, to the land of your heritage, which Moses, the Lord's servant, gave to you on the other side of Jordan.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi wo Marigi Alatala bara malabui fi wo ngaxakerenyie ma, alɔ a a masen e bɛ ki naxɛ. Yakɔsi wo siga wo xɔnyi. Wo xa gbilen na bɔxi ma Alatala xa konyi Munsa dɛnnaxɛ soxi wo yi ra Yurudɛn kiri ma.

sentences.english: Only take great care to do the orders and the law which Moses, the Lord's servant, gave you; to have love for the Lord your God and to go in all his ways; and to keep his laws and to be true to him and to be his servants with all your heart and with all your soul.
sentences.susu: Wo xa mɛɛni yi sɛriyɛ nun yi yaamari rabafe ma, Alatala xa konyi Munsa naxan soxi wo yi ra. Wo xa wo Marigi Alatala xanu, wo xa bira a xa kira birin fɔxɔ ra, wo xa wo ɲɛngi sa a xa yaamari xɔn wo ɲanige fiixɛ ra nun wo nii birin na.»

sentences.english: Then Joshua gave them his blessing and sent them away: and they went back to their tents.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa duba e bɛ, e fa siga e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Now to the one half of the tribe of Manasseh, Moses had given a heritage in Bashan; but to the other half, Joshua gave a heritage among their brothers on the west side of Jordan. Now when Joshua sent them away to their tents, he gave them his blessing,
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa nu bara kɛ so Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti keren yi ra Basan. Yosuwe fan naxa kɛ so yi sɛɛti boore yi ra e ngaxakerenyie fɛ ma Yurudɛn sogegorode. Yosuwe to nu e rasigama e xɔnyi, a naxa duba e bɛ.

sentences.english: And said to them, Go back with much wealth to your tents, and with very much cattle, with silver and gold and brass and iron, and with a very great store of clothing; give your brothers a part of the goods taken in the war.
sentences.susu: A naxɛ e bɛ, «Wo nun harige gbegbe xa gbilen wo xɔnyi, nun xurusee, gbeti, xɛɛma, yɔxui, wure, nun dugie. Wo nun wo ngaxakerenyie xa wo yaxuie harige itaxun wo wo wasasoxi naxee.»

sentences.english: So Reuben and Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh went back, parting from the children of Israel at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, to go to the land of Gilead, to the land of their heritage which had been given to them by the Lord's order to Moses.
sentences.susu: Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti singe naxa gbilen. E naxa keli Isirayilakae xun ma Silo, Kanaan bɔxi ma, e siga Galadi bɔxi ma, bɔxi naxan findi e gbe ra Alatala xa yaamari bun ma Annabi Munsa saabui ra.

sentences.english: Now when they came to the country by Jordan in the land of Canaan, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh put up there, by Jordan, a great altar, seen from far.
sentences.susu: E to so Yurudɛn nabilinyi Kanaan bɔxi ma, Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti singe naxa sɛrɛxɛbade belebele yailan Yurudɛn xure dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And news came to the children of Israel, See, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh have put up an altar opposite the land of Canaan, in the country by Jordan on the side which is Israel's.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae to na mɛ, e naxa a fala, «Wo bara a to, Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti singe bara sɛrɛxɛbade yailan Kanaan bɔxi ma, Yurudɛn taae kui Isirayilakae fɛ ma.»

sentences.english: Then all the meeting of the children of Israel, hearing this, came together at Shiloh to go up against them to war.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae to na fe kolon, e birin naxa e malan Silo alako e xa te e gerede.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel sent Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, to the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead,
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa Finexasi, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Eleyasari xa di xɛɛ Galadi bɔxi ma, Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti singe xɔn.

sentences.english: And with him they sent ten chiefs, one for every tribe of the children of Israel, every one of them the head of his house among the families of Israel.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ fu, bɔnsɔɛ yo bɔnsɔɛ mangɛ keren, naxa a mati. Nee birin nu findixi e xabilɛ xunyie nan na Isirayilakae wulu wulu tagi.

sentences.english: And they came to the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh, to the land of Gilead, and said to them,
sentences.susu: E naxa siga Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti singe yire, Galadi bɔxi ma. Finexasi naxa a fala e bɛ,

sentences.english: This is what all the meeting of the people of the Lord has said, What is this wrong which you have done against the God of Israel, turning back this day from the Lord and building an altar for yourselves, and being false to the Lord?
sentences.susu: «Alatala xa ɲama birin yi nan masenxi, ‹Wo Isirayila Marigi Ala yanfaxi munfe ra? To, wo gbilenxi Alatala fɔxɔ ra munfe ra? Wo sɛrɛxɛbade yailanxi munfe ra, naxan findixi Alatala matandife ra?

sentences.english: Was not the sin of Baal-peor great enough, from which we are not clear even to this day, though punishment came on the people of the Lord,
sentences.susu: Won fe ɲaaxi naxan naba Peyori, han to won na na tɔɔrɛ nan kui yi ki. Hali Alatala to ɲaxankatɛ dɔxɔ a xa ɲama birin ma na fe ma, han to won mu nu sɛniyɛn sinden.

sentences.english: That now you are turned back from the Lord? and, because you are false to him today, tomorrow his wrath will be let loose on all the people of Israel.
sentences.susu: To, wo bara muruta wo Marigi Alatala ma. Xa wo Alatala matandima to, tina a xa xɔnɛ fama nɛ dusude Isirayila ɲama nan birin xun ma.

sentences.english: But if the land you now have is unclean, come over into the Lord's land where his House is, and take up your heritage among us: but do not be false to the Lord and to us by building yourselves an altar in addition to the altar of the Lord our God.
sentences.susu: Na kui, bɔxi naxan findi wo gbe ra, xa na mu sɛniyɛnxi, wo xa gbilen Alatala xa bɔxi ma, alako wo xa wo yɛtɛ bɔxi sɔtɔ muxu tagi. Kɔnɔ wo naxa Alatala nun Isirayilakae matandi sɛrɛxɛbade yailanfe ra de, naxan mu findixi won Marigi Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade ra.

sentences.english: Did not Achan, the son of Zerah, do wrong about the cursed thing, causing wrath to come on all the people of Israel? And not on him only came the punishment of death.
sentences.susu: Sera xa di Akan to tinxintareya raba se ratɔnxie ra, see ra a mu lan naxee xa tongo, Alatala naxa xɔnɔ Isirayilakae birin ma. A keren xa mu halaki a xa yunubi rabaxi ma.›»

sentences.english: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh said in answer to the heads of the families of Israel,
sentences.susu: Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti singe naxa Isirayila mangɛe yaabi,

sentences.english: God, even God the Lord, God, even God the Lord, he sees, and Israel will see — if it is in pride or in sin against the Lord,
sentences.susu: «Marigi Alatala, a tan nan na Mangɛ Ala ra! A tan nan a kolon muxu yi rabaxi fe naxan ma. Isirayilaka birin fan fama a kolonde. Xa muxu bara Alatala matandi, xa muxu bara tinxintareya raba, muxu naxa kisi to lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: That we have made ourselves an altar, being false to the Lord, keep us not safe from death this day; and if for the purpose of offering burned offerings on it and meal offerings, or peace-offerings, let the Lord himself send punishment for it;
sentences.susu: Xa muxu sɛrɛxɛbade yailanxi muxu yɛtɛ nan bɛ, alako muxu xa gbilen muxu Marigi Alatala fɔxɔ ra, muxu xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi, sɛrɛxɛ ɲanigexi, nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ba, Alatala yɛtɛ yati nan fama muxu makiitide.»

sentences.english: And if we have not, in fact, done this designedly and with purpose, having in our minds the fear that in time to come your children might say to our children, What have you to do with the Lord, the God of Israel?
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ na mɔɔli xa mu a ra. Muxu yi rabaxi nɛ barima muxu nu bara kɔntɔfili, tina wo xa die nɔma nɛ a falade muxu xa die bɛ, ‹Dari mundun na wo tan nun Isirayila Marigi Alatala tagi?

sentences.english: For the Lord has made Jordan a line of division between us and you, the children of Reuben and the children of Gad; you have no part in the Lord: so your children will make our children give up fearing the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala Yurudɛn nan findixi won naaninyi ra. Ruben bɔnsɔɛ nun Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, wo gbe yo mu na Alatala gbe ya ma.› Muxu xa die bama nɛ gaaxufe Alatala ya ra wo xa die saabui ra.»

sentences.english: So we said, Let us now make an altar for ourselves, not for burned offerings or for the offerings of beasts:
sentences.susu: «Na kui muxu naxa a fala, won fan xa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan. Sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun sɛrɛxɛ mɔɔli gbɛtɛ yo mu bama na,

sentences.english: But to be a witness between us and you, and between the future generations, that we have the right of worshipping the Lord with our burned offerings and our offerings of beasts and our peace-offerings; so that your children will not be able to say to our children in time to come, You have no part in the Lord.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ na xa findi seede ra wo tan nun muxu tan tagi, wo bɔnsɔɛ nun muxu bɔnsɔɛ tagi hali won tan dangi xanbi, muxu Alatala rabatuma sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi, sɛrɛxɛ ɲanigexi, nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ra a xa hɔrɔmɔlingira ya ra. Na tɛmui wo xa die naxa fa sa a fala muxu xa die bɛ, ‹Wo gbe yo mu na Alatala gbe ya ma.›

sentences.english: For we said to ourselves, If they say this to us or to future generations, then we will say, See this copy of the Lord's altar which our fathers made, not for burned offerings or offerings of beasts, but for a witness between us and you.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara a fala, tina, xa e sa na wɔyɛnyi fala muxu bɛ, xa na mu muxu xa die bɛ, muxu fan e yaabima nɛ, ‹Wo Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade kɛɲa mato, muxu babae naxan yailanxi. Sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun sɛrɛxɛ mɔɔli gbɛtɛ yo mu bama naa, kɔnɔ na xa findi seede ra wo tan nun muxu tan tagi.›

sentences.english: Never let it be said that we were false to the Lord, turning back this day from him and building an altar for burned offerings and meal offerings and offerings of beasts, in addition to the altar of the Lord our God which is before his House.
sentences.susu: Ala xa muxu tanga muxu bɔɲɛ ratefe ra Alatala xili ma. A xa muxu tanga muxu gbilenfe ra a fɔxɔ ra to lɔxɔɛ sɛrɛxɛbade yailanfe ra, sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie, sɛrɛxɛ ɲanigexie, nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛe bama dɛnnaxɛ. Nee bama won Marigi Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade gbansan nɛ, naxan na won Marigi Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira ya ra.»

sentences.english: Then Phinehas the priest and the chiefs of the meeting and the heads of the families of Israel who were with him, hearing what the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh said, were pleased.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Finexasi, mangɛdie nun Isirayila wulu wulu mangɛe to yi masenyi mɛ, Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti singe naxan masenxi, e bɔɲɛ naxa rafan e ma.

sentences.english: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, said to the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the children of Manasseh, Now we are certain that the Lord is among us, because you have not done this wrong against the Lord: and you have kept us from falling into the hands of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Eleyasari xa di Finexasi naxa a masen Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti singe bɛ, «Muxu bara a kolon Alatala na won ya ma to lɔxɔɛ, barima wo mu tinxintareya rabaxi Alatala ra. Wo bara Isirayilakae ratanga Alatala bɛlɛxɛ i.»

sentences.english: Then Phinehas, the son of Eleazar the priest, and the chiefs went back from the land of Gilead, from the children of Reuben and the children of Gad, and came to the children of Israel in Canaan and gave them the news.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Eleyasari xa di Finexasi nun mangɛe naxa keli Galadi bɔxi ma, Ruben, nun Gadi bɔnsɔɛ nu na dɛnnaxɛ, e gbilen Kanaan bɔxi ma Isirayilakae yire, e dɛntɛgɛ sa e bɛ.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel were pleased about this; and they gave praise to God, and had no more thought of going to war against the children of Reuben and the children of Gad for the destruction of their land.
sentences.susu: Yi dɛntɛgɛ naxa rafan Isirayilakae ma, e naxa Ala tantu. Gere sofe, e xa Ruben nun Gadi xa bɔxi sɔntɔ, na maɲɔxunyi mu lu e yi sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And the children of Reuben and the children of Gad gave to that altar the name of Ed. For, they said, It is a witness between us that the Lord is God.
sentences.susu: Ruben nun Gadi bɔnsɔɛ naxa yi xili sa na sɛrɛxɛbade xun ma: «A tan nan na won tagi seede ra a Alatala nan na Ala ra.»

sentences.english: Now after a long time, when the Lord had given Israel rest from wars on every side, and Joshua was old and full of years,
sentences.susu: Tɛmui gbegbe dangi nɛ kafi Alatala naxa malabui fi Isirayila ɲama ma, a ratangafe a yaxuie ma a rabilinyi. Yosuwe nu bara fori, a xa simaya nu bara bu.

sentences.english: Joshua sent for all Israel, for their responsible men and their chiefs and their judges and their overseers, and said to them, I am old, and full of years:
sentences.susu: Na kui Yosuwe naxa Isirayila birin malan, a forie, a mangɛe, a kiitisae, nun a sɔɔri mangɛe. A naxa a fala e bɛ, «N bara fori, n ma simaya bara a ikuya.

sentences.english: You have seen everything the Lord your God has done to all these nations because of you; for it is the Lord your God who has been fighting for you.
sentences.susu: Wo bara a to wo Marigi Alatala fe naxan birin nabaxi yi sie ra wo xa fe ra. Wo Marigi Alatala nan gere soxi wo bɛ.»

sentences.english: Now I have given to you, as the heritage of your tribes, all these nations which are still in the land, together with those cut off by me, from Jordan as far as the Great Sea on the west.
sentences.susu: «Wo a mato, n bara kɛ bɔxi so wo yi ra, Ala naxan ɲanigexi wo bɔnsɔɛe bɛ. Na bɔxi birin, sie gbɛtɛe nu dɛnnaxɛ, nun dɛnnaxɛ suxu daaxi luxi, Yurudɛn nun Baa Xungbe longori sogegorode, n bara na birin itaxun wo ma.

sentences.english: The Lord your God will send them away by force, driving them out before you; and you are to take their land for your heritage, as the Lord your God said to you.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala e makuyama nɛ wo ra pon, a e faxa wo ya ra, wo fa e xa bɔxi tongo alɔ wo Marigi Alatala a masen wo bɛ ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: So be very strong to keep and do whatever is recorded in the book of the law of Moses, not turning away from it to the right or to the left;
sentences.susu: «Wo wo sɛnbɛ so. Wo xa wo mɛɛni sɛriyɛ birin nabatufe ma naxan sɛbɛxi Tawureta Munsa kui. Wo naxa binya yirefanyi ma, wo naxa binya kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: Have nothing to do with these nations who still are living among you; let not their gods be named by you or used in your oaths; do not be their servants or give them worship:
sentences.susu: Wo naxa sunbu yi sie ra, naxee luxi wo ya ma. Wo naxa e xa alae maxandi, wo naxa wo kali e xili ra. Wo naxa e batu, wo naxa wo tuubi e bɛ.

sentences.english: But be true to the Lord your God as you have been till this day.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan xa wo tagi ixiri wo Marigi Alatala xa fe ra, alɔ wo bara fa a raba ra ki naxɛ han to.»

sentences.english: For the Lord has sent out from before you nations great and strong: and they have all given way before you till this day.
sentences.susu: «Alatala bara si gbangbalanyi sɛnbɛmae halaki wo ya ra, keli na ma, han to, mixi keren mu nɔxi tide wo ya ra.

sentences.english: One man of you is able to put to flight a thousand; for it is the Lord your God who is fighting for you, as he has said to you.
sentences.susu: Wo ya ma, mixi keren nu mixi wulu nan kerima, barima wo Marigi Alatala nan nu gere soma wo bɛ alɔ a a laayidi wo bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So keep watch on yourselves, and see that you have love for the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo ɲɛngi sa wo yɛtɛ kan xɔn ma a fanyi ra, wo xa wo Marigi Alatala xanu.»

sentences.english: For if you go back, joining yourselves to the rest of these nations who are still among you, getting married to them and living with them and they with you:
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ xa wo wo kobe ti wo Marigi Alatala ra, wo naxa bira si gbɛtɛe fɔxɔ ra naxee luxi wo ya ma, wo naxa sunbu e ra, wo naxa e xa di ginɛe dɔxɔ,

sentences.english: Then you may be certain that the Lord your God will not go on driving these nations out from before you; but they will become a danger and a cause of sin to you, a whip for your sides and thorns in your eyes, till you are cut off from this good land which the Lord your God has given you.
sentences.susu: wo xa a kolon wo Marigi Alatala mu fama yi sie ragide wo ya ra sɔnɔn. E findima wo bɛ yɛlɛ nun gantanyi nan na, e findi luxusinyi ra wo fari, e findi tunbe ra wo ya kui, han wo birin gɛ halakide yi bɔxi fanyi ma wo Marigi Alatala naxan fixi wo ma.»

sentences.english: Now I am about to go the way of all the earth: and you have seen and are certain, all of you, in your hearts and souls, that in all the good things which the Lord said about you, he has kept faith with you; everything has come true for you.
sentences.susu: «A gbe mu luxi n xa faxa alɔ nimase birin naxee na duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari. Wo xa a kolon wo bɔɲɛ kui, wo nii birin na, wo Marigi Alatala laayidi yo naxan tongoxi wo bɛ, na mu kanama. A xa laayidi birin bara kamali, keren mu kanaxi.

sentences.english: And you will see that, as all the good things which the Lord your God undertook to do for you, have come to you, so the Lord will send down on you all the evil things till he has made your destruction complete, and you are cut off from the good land which the Lord your God has given you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon wo Marigi Alatala a xa laayidi fanyi rakamalixi ki naxɛ, a man fama a xa laayidi ɲaxankatɛ daaxi rakamalide na ki nɛ, han a gɛ wo halakide yi bɔxi fanyi ma a dɛnnaxɛ fixi wo ma.

sentences.english: If the agreement of the Lord your God, which was given to you by his orders, is broken, and you become the servants of other gods and give them worship, then the wrath of the Lord will be burning against you, and you will quickly be cut off from the good land which he has given you.
sentences.susu: Xa wo tondi yi saatɛ rakamalide wo Marigi Alatala wo yamarixi naxan na, xa wo wo tuubi ala gbɛtɛe bɛ, wo naxa wo felen e bɛ, Alatala xɔnɔma nɛ wo ma, wo fa halaki, a wo ralɔɛ yi bɔxi fanyi ma, a dɛnnaxɛ fixi wo ma.»

sentences.english: Then Joshua got all the tribes of Israel together at Shechem; and he sent for the responsible men of Israel and their chiefs and their judges and their overseers; and they took their place before God.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin malan Sikemi, a fa Isirayila forie, a mangɛe, a kiitisae, nun a sɔɔri mangɛe maxili, e birin naxa sa e yɛtɛ dɛntɛgɛ Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: And Joshua said to all the people, These are the words of the Lord, the God of Israel: In the past your fathers, Terah, the father of Abraham, and the father of Nahor, were living on the other side of the River: and they were worshipping other gods.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa a masen ɲama birin bɛ, «Isirayila Marigi Alatala xui nan ya, ‹Wo benba Tera nun a xa die Iburahima nun Naxori nu sabatixi kafi tɛmui xɔnkuye xure kiri ma, e nu ala gbɛtɛe nan batuma.

sentences.english: And I took your father Abraham from the other side of the River, guiding him through all the land of Canaan; I made his offspring great in number, and gave him Isaac.
sentences.susu: N naxa wo baba Iburahima tongo xure kiri ma, muxu naxa Kanaan bɔxi birin isa, n fa a bɔnsɔɛ iwuya. N naxa a xa di Isiyaga fi a ma,

sentences.english: And to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau: to Esau I gave Mount Seir, as his heritage; but Jacob and his children went down to Egypt.
sentences.susu: n fa a niya Isiyaga xa a xa die Yaxuba nun Esayu bari. N naxa Seyiri geya bɔxi so Esayu yi ra, kɔnɔ Yaxuba nun a xa die tan naxa goro Misira bɔxi ma.›»

sentences.english: And I sent Moses and Aaron, troubling Egypt by all the signs I did among them: and after that I took you out.
sentences.susu: «N naxa Munsa nun Haruna xɛɛ Misira bɔxi ma, n fa ɲaxankatɛ wuyaxi dɔxɔ Misirakae ma e saabui ra. Na kui n naxa wo ramini Misira ra.

sentences.english: I took your fathers out of Egypt: and you came to the Red Sea; and the Egyptians came after your fathers to the Red Sea, with their war-carriages and their horsemen.
sentences.susu: N to wo babae ramini, Misirakae naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra han Xulunyumi Baa dɛ ra. E bakixi sɔɔri ragisee nun soe fari.

sentences.english: And at their cry, the Lord made it dark between you and the Egyptians, and made the sea go over them, covering them with its waters; your eyes have seen what I did in Egypt: then for a long time you were living in the waste land.
sentences.susu: Wo babae to gbelegbele Alatala ra, a naxa dimi rasin e nun Misirakae tagi. Misirakae to bira wo babae fɔxɔ ra baa tagi, Alatala naxa baa radin e xun ma. Wo yae bara na birin to, a naxan nabaxi Misirakae ra. Na dangi xanbi, wo naxa tɛmui xɔnkuye raba gbengberenyi ma.»

sentences.english: And I took you into the lands of the Amorites on the other side of Jordan; and they made war on you, and I gave them into your hands and you took their land; and I sent destruction on them before you.
sentences.susu: «N naxa wo xanin Amorikae xa bɔxi ma dɛnnaxɛ na Yurudɛn kiri ma. E naxa wo gere, kɔnɔ n naxa e sa wo bɛlɛxɛ i, n e keri wo ya ra, wo fa e xa bɔxi masɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Then Balak, the son of Zippor, king of Moab, went up to war against Israel; and he sent for Balaam, the son of Beor, to put a curse on you:
sentences.susu: Siporo xa di Balaki, naxan findixi Mowaba mangɛ ra, a fan naxa keli a xa Isirayila gere. A naxa Beyori xa di xɛmɛ Balami xili, alako a xa wo danka,

sentences.english: But I did not give ear to Balaam; and so he went on blessing you; and I kept you safe from him.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ n to mu wa n tuli matife na dankɛ ra, Balami xa wɔyɛnyi naxa mafindi, a fa duba wo bɛ. Na kui n naxa wo ba a bɛlɛxɛ i.»

sentences.english: Then you went over Jordan and came to Jericho: and the men of Jericho made war on you, the Amorites and the Perizzites and the Canaanites and the Hittites and the Girgashites and the Hivites and the Jebusites: and I gave them up into your hands.
sentences.susu: «Wo to Yurudɛn igiri, wo naxa Yeriko li. Yerikokae naxa wo gere, alɔ Amorikae, Perisikae, Kanaankae, Xitikae, Girigasakae, Hiwikae, nun Yebusukae fan nabaxi ki naxɛ, kɔnɔ n naxa e birin sa wo bɛlɛxɛ i.

sentences.english: And I sent the hornet before you, driving out the two kings of the Amorites before you, not with your sword and your bow.
sentences.susu: N fa ɲuri nde radin Amori mangɛ firinyie ma wo ya ra. A naxa e keri, kɔnɔ na mu findi wo yɛtɛ xa santidɛgɛma nun wo xa xali ra.

sentences.english: And I gave you a land on which you had done no work, and towns not of your building, and you are now living in them; and your food comes from vine-gardens and olive-gardens not of your planting.
