sentences.susu: N bɔxi nan fixi wo ma wo mu naxee rawalixi. N taae nan fixi wo ma, wo mu naxee tixi. N wɛni bilie nun oliwi bilie nan fixi wo ma, wo mu naxee sixi. Wo na balofe nee nan xun na yi ki.»

sentences.english: So now, go in fear of the Lord, and be his servants with true hearts: put away the gods worshipped by your fathers across the River and in Egypt, and be servants of the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi wo xa gaaxu Alatala ya ra, wo xa a rabatu ɲanige fanyi nun tinxinyi ra. Wo xa gbilen na alae fɔxɔ ra wo babae naxee batuxi xure kiri ma nun Misira bɔxi ma. Wo xa Alatala batu!

sentences.english: And if it seems evil to you to be the servants of the Lord, make the decision this day whose servants you will be: of the gods whose servants your fathers were across the River, or of the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living: but I and my house will be the servants of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Xa wo mu tinma na ra, wo xa natɛ tongo wo alae naxee batuma, alɔ Amorikae xa alae e naxee batuma yi bɔxi ma, xa na mu alae wo babae nu naxee batuma xure kiri ma. Kɔnɔ wo xa a kolon a n tan nun n ma denbaya, muxu Alatala nan batuma.»

sentences.english: Then the people in answer said, Never will we give up the Lord to be the servants of other gods;
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa a yaabi yi wɔyɛnyie ra, «Na xaxili makuya muxu ra gbilenfe ra Alatala fɔxɔ ra, muxu mu nɔma birade ala gbɛtɛe fɔxɔ ra,

sentences.english: For it is the Lord our God who has taken us and our fathers out of the land of Egypt, out of the prison-house, and who did all those great signs before our eyes, and kept us safe on all our journeys, and among all the peoples through whom we went:
sentences.susu: barima Alatala nan na won Marigi Ala ra. A tan nan muxu ramini Misira bɔxi ra, konyiya kui, muxu tan nun muxu babae. A gere so nɛ muxu bɛ muxu ya xɔri yi kaabanako belebelee ra. A naxa muxu kanta muxu xa ɲɛrɛ birin kui, nun ɲamae tagi muxu dangixi naxee birin na.

sentences.english: And the Lord sent out from before us all the peoples, the Amorites living in the land: so we will be the servants of the Lord, for he is our God.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara ɲama birin keri muxu ya ra, a nun Amorikae naxee sabatixi yi bɔxi ma. Muxu tan fan Alatala nan batuma, barima a tan nan na muxu Marigi Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: And Joshua said to the people, You are not able to be the servants of the Lord, for he is a holy God, a God who will not let his honour be given to another: he will have no mercy on your wrongdoing or your sins.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa a fala ɲama bɛ, «Wo mu nɔma Alatala batude, barima Alatala sɛniyɛn, Ala tɔɔnɛxi na a ra. A mu diɲɛma wo xa matandi nun wo xa yunubi ma.

sentences.english: If you are turned away from the Lord and become the servants of strange gods, then turning against you he will do you evil, cutting you off, after he has done you good.
sentences.susu: Xa wo Alatala finsiriwali birafe ala gbɛtɛe fɔxɔ ra, a gbilenma nɛ a xa fe fanyie fɔxɔ ra a nu naxee rabama wo bɛ, a fa gbaloe ramini wo ma, han a wo raɲɔn.»

sentences.english: And the people said to Joshua, No! But we will be the servants of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa a fala Yosuwe bɛ, «Ade, muxu Alatala nan batuma.»

sentences.english: And Joshua said to the people, You are witnesses against yourselves that you have made the decision to be the servants of the Lord. And they said, We are witnesses.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa a fala ɲama bɛ, «Wo bara findi wo yɛtɛ kan ma seedee ra. Wo tan nan yɛtɛ yati Alatala sugandixi alako wo xa a batu.» E naxa Yosuwe yaabi, «Muxu bara findi seedee ra.»

sentences.english: Then, he said, put away the strange gods among you, turning your hearts to the Lord, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe man naxa a fala e bɛ, «Yakɔsi wo xa gbilen ala gbɛtɛe fɔxɔ ra, naxee na wo tagi. Wo xa wo xaxili ti Alatala ra, Isirayila Marigi Ala.»

sentences.english: And the people said to Joshua, We will be the servants of the Lord our God, and we will give ear to his voice.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa a fala Yosuwe bɛ, «Muxu muxu Marigi Alatala nan batuma, muxu a xui rabatu.»

sentences.english: So Joshua made an agreement with the people that day, and gave them a rule and a law in Shechem.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, Yosuwe nun ɲama naxa saata. A naxa sɛriyɛ nun yaamarie so ɲama yi ra Sikemi.

sentences.english: And Joshua put these words on record, writing them in the book of the law of God; and he took a great stone, and put it up there under the oak-tree which was in the holy place of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe naxa yi fe birin sɛbɛ Ala xa Sɛriyɛ Kitaabui kui. A naxa gɛmɛ belebele tongo, a naxa a ti wuri tofanyi bun ma naxan nu na Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira yire.

sentences.english: And Joshua said to all the people, See now, this stone is to be a witness against us; for all the words of the Lord have been said to us in its hearing: so it will be a witness against you if you are false to the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe fa a fala ɲama bɛ, «Wo bara yi gɛmɛ to? A findima won bɛ seede nan na, barima a bara wɔyɛnyi birin mɛ, Alatala naxan masenxi won bɛ. A findima seede nan na won bɛ, alako wo naxa wo kobe so wo Marigi Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: Then Joshua let the people go away, every man to his heritage.
sentences.susu: Na kui Yosuwe naxa ɲama lu, e birin naxa siga e xa bɔxi ma dɛnnaxɛ findi e kɛ ra.

sentences.english: Now after these things, the death of Joshua, the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, took place, he being then a hundred and ten years old.
sentences.susu: Yi fe to dangi, Nunu xa di Yosuwe, Alatala xa konyi, naxa laaxira a xa simaya ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ fu ma.

sentences.english: And they put his body in the earth in the land of his heritage in Timnath-serah, in the hill-country of Ephraim, to the north of Mount Gaash.
sentences.susu: A naxa ragata bɔxi ma a kɛ naxan na, Timina Sera, Efirami geyae biri ra, Gaasi geya kɔɔla biri ra.

sentences.english: And Israel was true to the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the older men who were still living after Joshua's death, and had seen what the Lord had done for Israel.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Alatala batu nɛ Yosuwe xa simaya birin kui, a nun forie xa simaya birin kui, Yosuwe singe faxa naxee bɛ, naxee nu fe birin kolon Alatala naxan naba Isirayilakae bɛ.

sentences.english: And the bones of Joseph, which the children of Israel had taken up from Egypt, they put in the earth in Shechem, in the property which Jacob had got from the sons of Hamor, the father of Shechem, for a hundred shekels: and they became the heritage of the children of Joseph.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae Yusufu xɔri naxee xanin e xun ma keli Misira, e sa e ragata Sikemi bɔxi nan ma, Yaxuba bɔxi naxan sara Xamori xa die ma, Sikemi baba ma, mɛnnikae xa kɔbiri kole kɛmɛ ra. Na bara findi Yusufu xa die kɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then the death of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, took place; and his body was put in the earth in the hill of Phinehas his son, which had been given to him in the hill-country of Ephraim.
sentences.susu: Haruna xa di Eleyasari fan naxa faxa. E naxa a ragata a xa di Finexasi xa geya fari, dɛnnaxɛ nu bara findi a kɛ ra Efirami bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi ma geya longori.

sentences.english: Now after the death of Joshua, the children of Israel made request to the Lord, saying, Who is to go up first to make war for us against the Canaanites?
sentences.susu: Yosuwe faxa xanbi, Isirayilakae naxa Alatala maxɔrin, «Nde singe kelima muxu ya ma tefe ra Kanaankae gerede?»

sentences.english: And the Lord said, Judah is to go up: see, I have given the land into his hands.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa e yaabi, «Yuda bɔnsɔɛ nan tema. N bara bɔxi sa e sagoe.»

sentences.english: Then Judah said to Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my heritage, so that we may make war against the Canaanites; and I will then go with you into your heritage. So Simeon went with him.
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛ naxa a fala e ngaxakerenyi Simeyɔnkae bɛ, «Won birin xa siga e dɛnnaxɛ soxi muxu yi ra, won xa sa Kanaankae gere. Na dangi xanbi, won birin nan sigama e dɛnnaxɛ soxi wo tan fan yi ra.» Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ naxa tin na ra.

sentences.english: And Judah went up; and the Lord gave the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hands; and they overcame ten thousand of them in Bezek.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae to te, Alatala naxa Kanaankae nun Perisikae sa e sagoe. E naxa xɛmɛ wulu fu faxa Beseki.

sentences.english: And they came across Adoni-zedek, and made war on him; and they overcame the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
sentences.susu: Na kui e naxa Kanaankae nun Perisikae bɔnbɔ. E to Beseki mangɛ li naa, e naxa na fan gere.

sentences.english: But Adoni-zedek went in flight; and they went after him and overtook him, and had his thumbs and his great toes cut off.
sentences.susu: A naxa a gi, kɔnɔ e naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra han e naxa a suxu, e fa a bɛlɛxɛkurae nun a sankurae mabolon.

sentences.english: And Adoni-zedek said, Seventy kings, whose thumbs and great toes had been cut off, got broken meat under my table: as I have done, so has God done to me in full. And they took him to Jerusalem, and he came to his end there.
sentences.susu: Adoni Beseki naxa a fala, «Tɛmui dangixi, n tan bara mangɛ tongo solofere suxu, n e bɛlɛxɛkurae nun e sankurae bolon. E naxa e dɛge donse ra naxan nu birama n dɛgede. Yakɔsi Ala na na sare ragbilenfe n ma.» E naxa a xanin Darisalamu, a naxa faxa mɛnni.

sentences.english: Then the children of Judah made an attack on Jerusalem, and took it, burning down the town after they had put its people to the sword without mercy.
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛ naxa Darisalamu gere. E to a suxu, e naxa mɛnnikae sɔntɔ santidɛgɛma ra, e taa gan.

sentences.english: After that the children of Judah went down to make war on the Canaanites living in the hill-country and in the south and in the lowlands.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, e man naxa goro Kanaankae gerede, naxee nu sabatixi Isirayila geyae fari, Negewi gbengberenyi nun Sefela bɔxi mabiri.

sentences.english: And Caleb went against the Canaanites of Hebron: (now in earlier times Hebron was named Kiriath-arba:) and he put Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai to the sword.
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛ naxa siga Kanaankae gerede, naxee nu sabatixi Hebiron, dɛnnaxɛ xili nu falama singe ra nu Kiriyati Ariba. E naxa Sɛsayi, Aximan, nun Talama bɔnbɔ.

sentences.english: And from there he went up against the people of Debir. (Now the name of Debir in earlier times was Kiriath-sepher.)
sentences.susu: E naxa keli mɛnni sigafe ra Debirikae gerede, dɛnnaxɛ xili nu falama singe ra nu Kiriyati Sifa.

sentences.english: And Caleb said, I will give Achsah, my daughter, as wife to the man who overcomes Kiriath-sepher and takes it.
sentences.susu: Kalebi naxa a masen, «Mixi naxan Kiriyati Sifa masɔtɔma n bɛ, n nan ma di ginɛ Akasa fima nɛ na kanyi ma, a findi a xa ginɛ ra.»

sentences.english: And Othniel, the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it; so he gave him his daughter Achsah for his wife.
sentences.susu: Kenasi xa di xɛmɛ Otiniyeli, Kalebi xunya nan na masɔtɔ. Kalebi fa a xa di ginɛ Akasa fi a ma.

sentences.english: Now when she came to him, he put into her mind the idea of requesting a field from her father: and she got down from her ass; and Caleb said to her, What is it?
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Akasa naxa a fala Otiniyeli bɛ, a xa a bitanyi mayandi a xa xɛ nde fi a ma. Akasa to goro a xa sofale fari, Kalebi naxa a maxɔrin, «I wama munse xɔn?»

sentences.english: And she said to him, Give me a blessing; because you have put me in a dry south-land, now give me springs of water. So Caleb gave her the higher spring and the lower spring.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «N wama nɛ i xa fe fanyi nde raba n bɛ. I bara bɔxi nde so n yi ra yirefanyi ma. I xa ye dula nde fan fi n ma.» Kalebi naxa tin na ra, a fa ye dula ndee fi a ma. Keren nu na fuge, boore nu na labe.

sentences.english: Now Hobab the Kenite, Moses' father-in-law, had come up out of the town of palm-trees, with the children of Judah, into the waste land of Arad; and he went and was living among the Amalekites;
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa bitanyi Kenika xa die naxa keli Yeriko, taa naxan xili «Tugi taa,» e nun Yuda bɔnsɔɛ. E naxa siga sabatide gbengberenyi Yudaya bɔxi ma, Negewi Aradi yirefanyi ma. E naxa sabati ɲama tagi.

sentences.english: And Judah went with Simeon, his brother, and overcame the Canaanites living in Zephath, and put it under the curse; and he gave the town the name of Hormah.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae nun e ngaxakerenyi Simeyɔnkae naxa siga Kanaankae gerede, naxee nu sabatixi Sefati. E naxa na taa ratɔn. Na nan a toxi a xili falama Horoma.

sentences.english: Then Judah took Gaza and its limit, and Ashkelon and its limit, and Ekron and its limit.
sentences.susu: E man naxa Gasa, Asikalɔn, nun Ekiron masɔtɔ, a nun e xa bɔxie.

sentences.english: And the Lord was with Judah; and he took the hill-country for his heritage; but he was unable to make the people of the valley go out, for they had war-carriages of iron.
sentences.susu: Alatala nun Yuda bɔnsɔɛ nan nu a ra. E naxa Isirayila geyae masɔtɔ, kɔnɔ e mu nɔ mixie ra naxee nu sabatixi lanbanyi ma, barima sɔɔri ragisee wure daaxi nan nu na e yi ra.

sentences.english: And they gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said; and he took the land of the three sons of Anak, driving them out from there.
sentences.susu: E naxa Hebiron so Kalebi yi ra, alɔ Annabi Munsa a fala ki naxɛ. Kalebi naxa Anaki xa di saxanyie keri naa.

sentences.english: And the children of Judah did not make the Jebusites who were living in Jerusalem go out; the Jebusites are still living with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Bunyamin xa die mu nɔ Yebusukae keride, naxee nu sabatixi Darisalamu. Han to Yebusukae sabatixi Darisalamu Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ ya ma.

sentences.english: And the family of Joseph went up against Beth-el, and the Lord was with them.
sentences.susu: Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ naxa Beteli gere. E nun Alatala nan birin nu a ra.

sentences.english: So they sent men to make a search round Beth-el. (Now the name of the town in earlier times was Luz.)
sentences.susu: E naxa mixi xɛɛ Beteli, e xa mɛnni mato. Yi taa xili nu falama nɛ singe ra nu Lusi.

sentences.english: And the watchers saw a man coming out of the town, and said to him, If you will make clear to us the way into the town, we will be kind to you.
sentences.susu: Na xɛɛrae naxa xɛmɛ nde to, a na minife taa kui. E naxa a fala a bɛ, «Taa sode masen muxu bɛ. Muxu fan fe fanyi rabama nɛ i bɛ na tɛmui.»

sentences.english: So he made clear to them the way into the town, and they put it to the sword; but they let the man and all his family get away safe.
sentences.susu: A to taa sode masen e bɛ, e naxa mɛnnikae faxa santidɛgɛma ra, kɔnɔ e naxa yi xɛmɛ nun a xa denbaya lu na.

sentences.english: And he went into the land of the Hittites, building a town there and naming it Luz: which is its name to this day.
sentences.susu: Yi xɛmɛ naxa siga Xitikae xa bɔxi ma, a naxa taa ti, a Lusi xili sa a xun. Han to na xili nan falama na xun.

sentences.english: And Manasseh did not take away the land of the people of Beth-shean and its daughter-towns, or of Taanach and its daughter-towns, or of the people of Dor and its daughter-towns, or of the people of Ibleam and its daughter-towns, or of the people of Megiddo and its daughter-towns, driving them out; but the Canaanites would go on living in that land.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Manasi bɔnsɔɛ mu nɔ Beti Saan, Taanaki, Dɔrɔ, Yibeleyami, Megido, nun e xa bɔxie masɔtɔde. Kanaankae mu tin kelide na bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And whenever Israel became strong, they put the Canaanites to forced work, without driving them out completely.
sentences.susu: Isirayila to sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ a fanyi ra, e naxa Kanaankae findi e xa konyie ra, kɔnɔ e mu e keri.

sentences.english: And Ephraim did not make the Canaanites who were living in Gezer go out; but the Canaanites went on living in Gezer among them.
sentences.susu: Efirami bɔnsɔɛ fan mu nɔ Kanaankae keride naxee nu sabatixi Geseri. Kanaankae naxa lu naa Efiramikae ya ma.

sentences.english: Zebulun did not make the people of Kitron or the people of Nahalol go out; but the Canaanites went on living among them and were put to forced work.
sentences.susu: Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ fan mu nɔ Kanaankae keride naxee nu sabatixi Kitiron nun Nahaloli. Kanaankae naxa lu naa Sabulonkae ya ma, kɔnɔ Isirayilakae naxa e findi e xa konyie ra.

sentences.english: And Asher did not take the land of the people of Acco, or Zidon, or Ahlab, or Achzib, or Helbah, or Aphik, or Rehob, driving them out;
sentences.susu: Aseri bɔnsɔɛ fan mu nɔ Ako, Sidɔn, Axalabi, Akisibu, Xeleba, Afeki, nun Rexobo masɔtɔde.

sentences.english: But the Asherites went on living among the Canaanites, the people of the land, without driving them out.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi Aserikae naxa sabati Kanaankae tagi na bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Naphtali did not take the land of the people of Beth-shemesh or of Beth-anath, driving them out; but he was living among the Canaanites in the land; however, the people of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath were put to forced work.
sentences.susu: Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ fan mu nɔ Beti Semesi nun Beti Anati masɔtɔde. Nafatalikae naxa sabati Kanaankae tagi na bɔxi ma. Beti Semesikae nun Beti Anatikae naxa findi e xa konyie ra.

sentences.english: And the children of Dan were forced into the hill-country by the Amorites, who would not let them come down into the valley;
sentences.susu: Dana bɔnsɔɛ fan mu nɔ Amorikae keride Isirayila geya bunyie. Na nan a toxi Danakae naxa sabati geyae fari.

sentences.english: For the Amorites would go on living in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim; but the children of Joseph became stronger than they, and put them to forced work.
sentences.susu: Amorikae naxa wa lufe Xɛrɛsɛ geya, Ayalon, nun Saalabimi, kɔnɔ Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ naxa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ, e Amorikae findi e xa konyie ra.

sentences.english: And the limit of the Edomites went from the slope of Akrabbim from Sela and up.
sentences.susu: Amorikae xa naaninyi nu fɔlɔxi Akarabimi, a siga han Sɛla.

sentences.english: Now the angel of the Lord came up from Gilgal to Bochim. And he said, ***I took you out of Egypt, guiding you into the land which I gave by an oath to your fathers; and I said, My agreement with you will never be broken by me:
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa keli Giligali, a siga Bokin. A naxa a masen Isirayilakae bɛ, «N bara wo tongo Misira, n fa wo xun ti bɔxi ra, n dɛnnaxɛ saatɛ tongo marakali ra wo benbae bɛ. N nu bara a fala, ‹N mu n ma saatɛ kanama abadan.›

sentences.english: And you are to make no agreement with the people of this land; you are to see that their altars are broken down: but you have not given ear to my voice: what have you done?
sentences.susu: A mu lan wo tan xa saatɛ tongo yi bɔxi mixie bɛ. A nu lan nɛ wo xa e xa sɛrɛxɛbadee rabira, kɔnɔ wo mu n ma yaamari suxu! Wo yi wali mɔɔli rabaxi munfe ra?

sentences.english: And so I have said, I will not send them out from before you; but they will be a danger to you, and their gods will be a cause of falling to you.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, n xa a fala wo bɛ, n mu fama e keride wo ya ra. E fama lude wo sɛɛti ma nɛ. E xa alae findima gantanyi nan na wo bɛ.»

sentences.english: Now on hearing these words which the angel of the Lord said to all the children of Israel, the people gave themselves up to loud crying and weeping.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ to gɛ yi wɔyɛnyi masende Isirayilakae bɛ, e naxa wa e xui itexi ra.

sentences.english: And they gave that place the name of Bochim, and made offerings there to the Lord.
sentences.susu: E naxa Bokin xili fala yi yire xun, e fa sɛrɛxɛe ba Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And Joshua let the people go away, and the children of Israel went, every man to his heritage, to take the land for themselves.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe to ɲama bɛɲin, Isirayilakae naxa siga e xa bɔxi masɔtɔde naxan nu findixi e kɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the people were true to the Lord all the days of Joshua, and all the days of the responsible men who were still living after the death of Joshua, and had seen all the great work of the Lord which he had done for Israel.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa Alatala xa sɛriyɛ suxu Yosuwe xa waxati kui, nun forie xa waxati kui, naxee xa simaya dangi Yosuwe ra, naxee nu bara Alatala xa kaabanakoe to, a naxee rabaxi Isirayila bɛ.

sentences.english: And death came to Joshua, the son of Nun, the servant of the Lord, he being a hundred and ten years old.
sentences.susu: Nunu xa di Yosuwe, Alatala xa konyi, naxa laaxira a xa simaya ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ fu ma.

sentences.english: And they put his body in the earth in the land of his heritage in Timnath-heres, in the hill-country of Ephraim to the north of Mount Gaash.
sentences.susu: E naxa a ragata a xa bɔxi ma naxan findi a kɛ ra, Timinati Xɛrɛsɛ, Efirami geya yire, Gaasi geya kɔɔla biri.

sentences.english: And in time death overtook all that generation; and another generation came after them, having no knowledge of the Lord or of the things which he had done for Israel.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe xunlanmae birin to faxa, mixi gbɛtɛe naxa mini naxee mu Alatala kolon. E mu a kolon a nu bara naxan naba Isirayila bɛ.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel did evil in the eyes of the Lord and became servants to the Baals;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isirayilakae naxa fe raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma. E naxa tuubi Bali kuyee bɛ.

sentences.english: And they gave up the Lord, the God of their fathers, who had taken them out of the land of Egypt, and went after other gods, the gods of the peoples round about them, worshipping them and moving the Lord to wrath.
sentences.susu: E naxa Alatala finsiriwali, e benbae Marigi Alatala, naxan e ramini Misira bɔxi ma. E naxa bira ala gbɛtɛe fɔxɔ ra, e rabilinyi mixie nu ala naxee batufe, e nu fa e felen nee bɛ. E naxa Alatala raɲaaxu,

sentences.english: And they gave up the Lord, and became the servants of Baal and the Astartes.
sentences.susu: e a finsiriwali, e Bali kuyee nun Asitarate kuyee batu.

sentences.english: And the wrath of the Lord was burning against Israel, and he gave them up into the hands of those who violently took their property, and into the hands of their haters all round them, so that they were forced to give way before them.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa xɔnɔ Isirayila ma, a naxa e sa e wuru mixie bɛlɛxɛ. A naxa e sara e yaxuie ma e rabilinyi. E mu fa nɔ tide e yaxuie ya ra sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Wherever they went out, the hand of the Lord was against them for evil, as the Lord had taken his oath it would be; and things became very hard for them.
sentences.susu: E nu sigama gere sode dɛnnaxɛ birin, Alatala nan nu e bɔnbɔma, a nu fe ɲaaxi dɔxɔ e ma, alɔ a nu bara a masen e bɛ ki naxɛ marakali ra. E naxa tɔɔrɔ ki fanyi.

sentences.english: Then the Lord gave them judges, as their saviours from the hands of those who were cruel to them.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa kiitisae rakeli, e xa e ratanga e wuru mixie ma.

sentences.english: But still they would not give ear to their judges, but went after other gods and gave them worship; quickly turning from the way in which their fathers had gone, keeping the orders of the Lord; but they did not do so.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isirayilakae mu tin e tuli matide na kiitisae ra, barima e nu wama ala gbɛtɛe nan batufe, e xa e felen e bɛ. E naxa gbilen e benbae xa kira fɔxɔ ra mafuren. E benbae nu bara bira Alatala xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ e tan mu tin na ra feo.

sentences.english: And whenever the Lord gave them judges, then the Lord was with the judge, and was their saviour from the hands of their haters all the days of the judge; for the Lord was moved by their cries of grief because of those who were cruel to them.
sentences.susu: Alatala to nu kiitisamae rakelima, a naxa e mali e xa simaya birin kui alako Isirayilakae xa ratanga e yaxuie ma. Alatala nu kinikinima e ma e xa tɔɔrɛ birin kui.

sentences.english: But whenever the judge was dead, they went back and did more evil than their fathers, going after other gods, to be their servants and their worshippers; giving up nothing of their sins and their hard-hearted ways.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ kiitisa to bara faxa, e man naxa bira ala gbɛtɛe fɔxɔ ra dangife e babae ra. E naxa e batu, e felen bɔxi ma e bɛ. E mu sese ba e xa wali kobie ra, e bɔɲɛ xɔrɔxɔxi tun.

sentences.english: And the wrath of the Lord was burning against Israel, and he said, Because this nation has not been true to my agreement which I made with their fathers, and has not given ear to my voice;
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala bɔɲɛ naxa te Isirayilakae xili ma, a fa a masen, «Yi ɲama bara e kobe ti n ma saatɛ ra n naxan tongo e benbae bɛ. E bara n xui matandi.

sentences.english: From now on I will not go on driving out from before them any of the nations which at the death of Joshua were still living in this land;
sentences.susu: Na kui, n tan fan mu fama si keren keride e ya ra sɔnɔn, naxee nu na yi bɔxi ma Yosuwe faxa tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: In order to put Israel to the test, and see if they will keep the way of the Lord, walking in it as their fathers did, or not.
sentences.susu: N fama Isirayilakae matode xa e tinma, xa e mu tinma, birade Alatala xa kira fɔxɔ ra alɔ e benbae a raba ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: So the Lord let those nations go on living in the land, not driving them out quickly, and did not give them up into the hands of Joshua.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi sie lu naa, a mu naxee saxi Yosuwe sagoe. A mu gbata e keride sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Now these are the nations which the Lord kept in the land for the purpose of testing Israel by them, all those who had had no experience of all the wars of Canaan;
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi sie lu Kanaan bɔxi ma alako e xa Isirayilakae mato, naxee mu nu na gere singee kolon.

sentences.english: Only because of the generations of the children of Israel, for the purpose of teaching them war — only those who up till then had no experience of it;
sentences.susu: Na rabaxi nɛ alako Isirayila lanfanmae xa na gere xa fe kolon, naxee mu nu a kolonxi nu.

sentences.english: The five chiefs of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites and the Zidonians and the Hivites living in Mount Lebanon, from the mountain Baal-hermon as far as Hamath:
sentences.susu: Si naxee lu Kanaan bɔxi ma, nee nan yi ki: Filisitakae xa mangɛ suuli, Kanaankae birin, Sidɔnkae, nun Hiwikae naxee nu sabatixi Liban geyae fari, kelife Bali Xerimon geya ma, a sa dɔxɔ Xamata sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: For the purpose of testing Israel by them, to see if they would give ear to the orders of the Lord, which he had given to their fathers by the hand of Moses.
sentences.susu: Yi sie lu nɛ naa alako Alatala xa Isirayilakae mato, a xa a kolon xa e sa birama a xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra, a naxan sɛbɛ e babae bɛ Annabi Munsa saabui ra.

sentences.english: Now the children of Israel were living among the Canaanites, the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa sabati Kanaankae, Xitikae, Amorikae, Perisikae, Hiwikae, nun Yebusukae tagi.

sentences.english: And they took as wives the daughters of these nations and gave their daughters to their sons, and became servants to their gods.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa mɛnnikae xa di ginɛe dɔxɔ, e fan naxa e xa di ginɛe fi mɛnnikae xa di xɛmɛe ma. Isirayilakae man naxa e xa alae batu. Kiitisa mixi fu nun firin

sentences.english: And the children of Israel did evil in the eyes of the Lord, and put out of their minds the Lord their God, and became servants to the Baals and the Astartes.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa fe ɲaaxi raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma. E naxa nɛɛmu Alatala ma, e Marigi Ala, e fa Bali kuyee nun Aseri wuri masolixi batu.

sentences.english: So the wrath of the Lord was burning against Israel, and he gave them up into the hands of Cushan-rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel were his servants for eight years.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa xɔnɔ Isirayila ma, a fa e sa Kusan Risatayimi sago, Mesopotamiya mangɛ, Isirayilakae nu na naxan xa yaamari bun ma ɲɛ solomasaxan.

sentences.english: And when the children of Israel made prayer to the Lord, he gave them a saviour, Othniel, the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae to Alatala xili e xui itexi ra, a naxa marakisima ramini e bɛ, Kenasi xa di Otiniyeli, Kalebi xunya.

sentences.english: And the spirit of the Lord came on him and he became judge of Israel, and went out to war, and the Lord gave up Cushan-rishathaim, king of Mesopotamia, into his hands and he overcame him.
sentences.susu: Alatala Xaxili naxa goro a ma. A naxa findi Isirayila kiitisa ra. A to siga gere sode, Alatala naxa Mesopotamiya mangɛ, Kusan Risatayimi, sa a sago sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then for forty years the land had peace, till the death of Othniel, the son of Kenaz.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi naxa lu bɔɲɛsa kui ɲɛ tongo naani. Na tɛmui Kenasi xa di Otiniyeli naxa faxa.

sentences.english: Then the children of Israel again did evil in the eyes of the Lord; and the Lord made Eglon, king of Moab, strong against Israel, because they had done evil in the Lord's eyes.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae man naxa fe ɲaaxi raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma. Na nan a toxi, Alatala naxa sɛnbɛ so Mowaba mangɛ Egilon yi ra Isirayila xili ma, naxan nu bara fe ɲaaxi raba Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: And Eglon got together the people of Ammon and Amalek, and they went and overcame Israel and took the town of palm-trees.
sentences.susu: Egilon naxa Amonikae nun Amalɛkikae xili, e birin xa Isirayila gere. Na kui e naxa Tugi taa masɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel were servants to Eglon, king of Moab, for eighteen years.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa lu Mowaba mangɛ Egilon xa yaamari bun ma ɲɛ fu nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: Then when the children of Israel made prayer to the Lord, he gave them a saviour, Ehud, the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man; and the children of Israel sent an offering by him to Eglon, king of Moab.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae to Alatala xili e xui itexi ra, a naxa marakisima ramini e bɛ, Gera Bunyaminka xa di Exudu, naxan nu walima a kɔɔla bɛlɛxɛ ra. Isirayilakae naxa a xɛɛ, a xa duuti xanin Mowaba mangɛ Egilon xɔn.

sentences.english: So Ehud made himself a two-edged sword, a cubit long, which he put on at his right side under his robe.
sentences.susu: Exudu naxa santidɛgɛma dɛ firin yailan, naxan xa kuyɛ nɔngɔn ya keren lima, a fa a nɔxun a xa donma bun ma a yirefanyi tabe fari.

sentences.english: And he took the offering to Eglon, king of Moab, who was a very fat man.
sentences.susu: A naxa duuti fi Mowaba mangɛ Egilon ma, naxan fate xungbo a gbe ra.

sentences.english: And after giving the offering, he sent away the people who had come with the offering.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ duuti fide, a naxa xɛmɛe ragbilen naxee nu bara na kote xanin.

sentences.english: But he himself, turning back from the stone images at Gilgal, said, I have something to say to you in secret, O king. And he said, Let there be quiet. Then all those who were waiting before him went out.
sentences.susu: Exudu to kuyee li naxee nu na Giligali, a naxa gbilen Egilon yire, a fa a fala, «Mangɛ, n wama gundo nde falafe i bɛ.» Mangɛ naxa a fala booree bɛ, «Wo wo magbilen sinden.» Naxee birin nu na a sɛɛti ma, e naxa e magbilen.

sentences.english: Then Ehud came in to him while he was seated by himself in his summer-house. And Ehud said, I have a word from God for you. And he got up from his seat.
sentences.susu: Exudu naxa a maso Egilon na, naxan nu dɔxɔxi a xa konkoe itexi xinbelixi kui, dɛnnaxɛ nu yailanxi a keren peti bɛ. Exudu naxa a fala a bɛ, «Ala bara n xɛɛ, n xa yi masenyi fala i bɛ.» Egilon naxa keli a xa dɔxɔse kui.

sentences.english: And Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right side, and sent it into his stomach;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Exudu naxa a xa santidɛgɛma ba a tɛɛ i a kɔɔla bɛlɛxɛ ra a yirefanyi sɛɛti, a Egilon furi sɔxɔ a ra.

sentences.english: And the hand-part went in after the blade, and the fat was joined up over the blade; for he did not take the sword out of his stomach. And he went out into the ...
sentences.susu: A kole nun a fɛ birin naxa so a furi, a mini a fari. Ture naxa raxi a xun ma, barima a bara santidɛgɛma lu naa.

sentences.english: Then Ehud went out into the covered way, shutting the doors of the summer-house on him and locking them.
sentences.susu: Exudu to mini konkoe kui, a naxa naadɛ balan a xun ma saabi ra.

sentences.english: Now when he had gone, the king's servants came, and saw that the doors of the summer-house were locked; and they said, It may be that he is in his summer-house for a private purpose.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, mangɛ xa konyie naxa fa. E naxa a to konkoe itexi naadɛ balanxi. E nu fa a fala, «A na fe nde nan xun ma banxi xinbelixi kui.»

sentences.english: And they went on waiting till they were shamed, but the doors were still shut; so they took the key, and, opening them, saw their lord stretched out dead on the floor.
sentences.susu: E naxa mamɛ ti han, kɔnɔ mangɛ to mu nu konkoe itexi naadɛ rabima, e naxa saabi tongo, e na rabi. E naxa e xa mangɛ to bɔxi ma, a bara faxa.

sentences.english: But Ehud had got away while they were waiting and had gone past the stone images and got away to Seirah.
sentences.susu: E nu mamɛ tife tɛmui naxɛ, Exudu nu bara a gi. A naxa dangi kuyee yire ra, a sa a yɛtɛ ratanga Seyira biri.

sentences.english: And when he came there, he had a horn sounded in the hill-country of Ephraim, and all the children of Israel went down with him from the hill-country, and he at their head.
sentences.susu: A fɛfɛ so, a naxa feri fe. Isirayilakae naxee nu na Efirami geyae fari, e naxa goro, e naxa ti a xanbi ra.

sentences.english: And he said to them, Come after me; for the Lord has given the Moabites, your haters, into your hands. So they went down after him and took the crossing-places of Jordan against Moab, and let no one go across.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo bira n fɔxɔ ra, barima Alatala bara wo yaxui Mowabakae sa wo sagoe.» E naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra, e siga, e sa ti Yurudɛn xure dɛ Mowaba biri ra. E mu tin mixi gbɛtɛ xa xure igiri mɛnni.

sentences.english: At that time they put about ten thousand men of Moab to the sword, every strong man and every man of war; not a man got away.
sentences.susu: Na waxati bun ma, e naxa Mowabaka xɛmɛ gbangbalanyi mixi wulu fu faxa. Mixi yo mu nɔ a gide e ya ma.

sentences.english: So Moab was broken that day under the hand of Israel. And for eighty years the land had peace.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Isirayilakae naxa Mowabakae rayaagi. Bɔxi naxa lu bɔɲɛsa kui ɲɛ tongo solomasaxan.

sentences.english: And after him came Shamgar, the son of Anath, who put to death six hundred Philistines with an ox-stick; and he was another saviour of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na to dangi, Anati xa di Samagari naxa findi kiitisa ra. A naxa Filisitaka xɛmɛ mixi kɛmɛ senni faxa ninge raɲɛrɛ wuri ra. Na kui a fan naxa Isirayila ratanga.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel again did evil in the eyes of the Lord when Ehud was dead.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae man naxa fe ɲaaxi raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma. Exudu nu bara faxa na tɛmui.

sentences.english: And the Lord gave them up into the hands of Jabin, king of Canaan, who was ruling in Hazor; the captain of his army was Sisera, who was living in Harosheth of the Gentiles.
sentences.susu: Alatala fan naxa e sa Yabini sagoe, Kanaan mangɛ nde, naxan nu na Xasori. Sisera, a xa sɔɔrie xunyi, nu sabatixi Xaroseti Goyimi.

sentences.english: Then the children of Israel made prayer to the Lord; for he had nine hundred iron war-carriages, and for twenty years he was very cruel to the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa Alatala xili e xui itexi ra, barima sɔɔri ragise wure daaxi kɛmɛ solomanaani nan nu na Yabini yi ra. A naxa Isirayilakae tɔɔrɔ a ɲaaxi ra ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn bun ma.

sentences.english: Now Deborah, a woman prophet, the wife of Lapidoth, was judge of Israel at that time.
sentences.susu: Na waxati kui, Debora namiɲɔnmɛ ginɛ, Lapidoti xa ginɛ, nan nu kiitisa ra Isirayila bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: (And she had her seat under the palm-tree of Deborah between Ramah and Beth-el in the hill-country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel came up to her to be judged.)
sentences.susu: A nu kiiti sama tugi bunyi nɛ, naxan xili «Debora xa tugi,» Raama nun Beteli tagi, Efirami geyae ma. Isirayilakae nu sigama a yire, a xa e xa kiiti sa.

sentences.english: And she sent for Barak, the son of Abinoam, from Kedesh-naphtali, and said to him, Has not the Lord, the God of Israel, given orders saying, Go and get your force into line in Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
sentences.susu: Debora naxa Kedesika Abinowami xa di Baraki xili, naxan nu na Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi ma, a fa a fala a bɛ, «Isirayila Marigi Alatala yi yaamari nan soxi i yi ra. I xa Nafatalikae nun Sabulonkae xɛmɛ wulu fu xanin Taboro geya fari.

sentences.english: And I will make Sisera, the captain of Jabin's army, with his war-carriages and his forces, come against you at the river Kishon, where I will give him into your hands.
sentences.susu: N fama Sisera, Yabini xa sɔɔri mangɛ, bɛndunde i ma Kison xure mabiri. N a xa sɔɔri birin nun e ragisee sama nɛ i sago.»

sentences.english: And Barak said to her, If you will go with me then I will go; but if you will not go with me I will not go.
sentences.susu: Baraki naxa a fala a bɛ, «Xa won birin nan a ra, n sigama, kɔnɔ xa won birin mu a ra, n mu sigama feo.»

sentences.english: And she said, I will certainly go with you: though you will get no honour in your undertaking, for the Lord will give Sisera into the hands of a woman. So Deborah got up and went with Barak to Kedesh.
sentences.susu: Debora naxa a yaabi, «Na kui, won birin nan sigama, kɔnɔ i mu fama matɔxɔɛ yo sɔtɔde na kui, barima Alatala fama Sisera sade ginɛ nde nan sagoe.» Na tɛmui, Debora nun Baraki naxa siga Kedesi.

sentences.english: Then Barak sent for Zebulun and Naphtali to come to Kedesh; and ten thousand men went up after him, and Deborah went up with him.
sentences.susu: Baraki naxa Nafatalikae nun Sabulonkae maxili Kedesi. Xɛmɛ mixi wulu fu naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra. Debora fan nu na e ya ma.

sentences.english: Now Heber the Kenite, separating himself from the rest of the Kenites, from the children of Hobab, the brother-in-law of Moses, had put up his tent as far away as the oak-tree in Zaanannim, by Kedesh.
sentences.susu: Heberi Kenika nu bara gbilen a bɔnsɔɛ fɔxɔ ra, naxan findi Xobabo xa die ra, Annabi Munsa bitanyi xɛmɛma. Heberi nu bara a xa kiri banxi ti Saananimi, wuri belebele nde bun, Kedesi fɛ ma.

sentences.english: And word was given to Sisera that Barak, the son of Abinoam, had gone up to Mount Tabor.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde to a fala Sisera bɛ, a Abinowami xa di Baraki bara te Taboro geya fari,

sentences.english: So Sisera got together all his war-carriages, nine hundred war-carriages of iron, and all the people who were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles as far as the river Kishon.
sentences.susu: a naxa a xa sɔɔri birin nun a xa sɔɔri ragise kɛmɛ solomanaani xun lan Kison xure, kelife Xaroseti Goyimi.

sentences.english: Then Deborah said to Barak, Up! for today the Lord has given Sisera into your hands: has not the Lord gone out before you? So Barak went down from Mount Tabor and ten thousand men after him.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Debora naxa a fala Baraki bɛ, «Keli, to Alatala fama Sisera sade i sagoe. Alatala nan tima i ya ra.» Baraki naxa goro Taboro geya fari, xɛmɛ mixi wulu fu biraxi a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord sent fear on Sisera and all his war-carriages and all his army before Barak; and Sisera got down from his war-carriage and went in flight on foot.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Sisera nun a xa sɔɔri birin nagi Baraki xa santidɛgɛma xɛɲɛnxi ya ra. Sisera naxa goro a xa sɔɔri ragise kui, a a gi a sanyi ra.

sentences.english: But Barak went after the war-carriages and the army as far as Harosheth of the Gentiles; and all Sisera's army was put to the sword; not a man got away.
sentences.susu: Baraki naxa Sisera xa geresoe keri han Xaroseti Goyimi, e xa sɔɔri ragisee kui. Baraki xa sɔɔrie naxa e birin faxa santidɛgɛma ra, mixi keren mu lu.

sentences.english: But Sisera went in flight on foot to the tent of Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite; for there was peace between Jabin, king of Hazor, and the family of Heber the Kenite.
sentences.susu: Sisera naxa a gi a sanyi ra, a sa a nɔxun Yayeli xa kiri banxi kui, Heberi Kenika xa ginɛ. A na rabaxi nɛ barima lanyi nu na Xasori mangɛ Yabini nun Heberi Kenika xabilɛ tagi.

sentences.english: And Jael went out to Sisera, and said to him, Come in, my lord, come in to me without fear. So he went into her tent, and she put a cover over him.
sentences.susu: Yayeli naxa mini Sisera ya ra, a fa a fala a bɛ, «N marigi, fa be, i nɔxun n xɔnyi, hali i mu gaaxu.» A naxa sa a nɔxun Yayeli xa kiri banxi kui sade dugi bun ma.

sentences.english: Then he said to her, Give me now a little water, for I have need of a drink. And opening a skin of milk, she gave him drink, and put the cover over him again.
sentences.susu: Sisera naxa a fala Yayeli bɛ, «N bara i maxandi, n ki ye ra, n xa a min. Ye xɔli na n ma.» Yayeli naxa xiɲɛ sase dɛ rabi, a a so a yi. Sisera to a min, Yayeli naxa gbilen a makoto ra.

sentences.english: And he said to her, Take your place at the door of the tent, and if anyone comes and says to you, Is there any man here, say, No.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a fala Yayeli bɛ, «Ti kiri banxi sode dɛ ra. Xa mixi nde fa sa i maxɔrin a falafe ra, ‹Mixi nde mu soxi be?›, i xa na kanyi yaabi, ‹Ade.›»

sentences.english: Then Jael, Heber's wife, took a tent-pin and a hammer and went up to him quietly, driving the pin into his head, and it went through his head into the earth, for he was in a deep sleep from weariness; and so he came to his end.
sentences.susu: Heberi xa ginɛ Yayeli naxa kiri banxi mabanban wuri nde tongo, dɛrɛma suxuxi a yi. Xi xɔli nu bara gɛ Sisera nɔde taganyi saabui ra. A naxa a makɔrɛ Sisera ra dɔyin, a fa na wuri banban a gbɛgbɛ xɔnyi ma han a sɔti bɔxi. Sisera naxa faxa keren na.

sentences.english: Then Jael went out, and meeting Barak going after Sisera, said to him, Come, and I will let you see the man you are searching for. So he came into her tent and saw, and there was Sisera stretched out dead with the tent-pin in his head.
sentences.susu: Yayeli naxa mini Baraki ya ra, naxan nu na birafe Sisera fɔxɔ ra. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «Fa be, i xɛmɛ naxan fenfe, n xa a masen i bɛ.» Baraki naxa so Yayeli xɔnyi, a fa Sisera faxaxi to, wuri banbanxi a gbɛgbɛ xɔnyi.

sentences.english: So that day God overcame Jabin, king of Canaan, before the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Alatala naxa Kanaan bɔxi mangɛ Yabini rayaagi Isirayilakae ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And the power of the children of Israel went on increasing against Jabin, king of Canaan, till he was cut off.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae bɛlɛxɛ sa Kanaan mangɛ Yabini ma na ki nɛ a xuri xuri ra, han e naxa a faxa.

sentences.english: At that time Deborah and Barak, the son of Abinoam, made this song, saying:
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, Abinowami xa di Baraki nun Debora naxa yi bɛɛti ba:

sentences.english: Because of the flowing hair of the fighters in Israel, because the people gave themselves freely, give praise to the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Alatala tantu! Isirayila sɛnbɛmae bara keli. Ɲama fan bara tin na gere ra.

sentences.english: Give attention, O kings; give ear, O rulers; I, even I, will make a song to the Lord; I will make melody to the Lord, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: Mangɛe, mangɛdie, wo wo tuli mati a fanyi ra. N tan bɛɛti bama nɛ, n a bama Alatala nan bɛ. N xa Isirayila Marigi Alatala binya bɛɛti ra.

sentences.english: Lord, when you went out from Seir, moving like an army from the field of Edom, the earth was shaking and the heavens were troubled, and the clouds were dropping water.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i to keli Seyiri, Edonkae xa bɔxi ma, bɔxi naxa sɛrɛn, koore nuxui naxa tunɛ ragoro.

sentences.english: The mountains were shaking before the Lord, before the Lord, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: Geyae naxa xɔyɔ Alatala ya i, yi Turusinina geya fan naxa sɛrɛn Isirayila Marigi Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: In the days of Shamgar, the son of Anath, in the days of Jael, the highways were not used, and travellers went by side roads.
sentences.susu: Yayeli nun Anati xa di Samagari waxati, mixi mu nu nɔma biyaaside muɲɛtie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Country towns were no more in Israel, ***were no more, till you, Deborah, came up, till you came up as a mother in Israel.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae mu nu nɔma lude daaxae sɔnɔn, e birin naxa keli naa, han n tan Debora minixi tɛmui naxɛ. N bara findi Isirayila nga ra.

sentences.english: They had no one to make arms, there were no more armed men in the towns; was there a body-cover or a spear to be seen among forty thousand in Israel?
sentences.susu: E nu bara ala nɛɛnɛe batu fɔlɔ. Gere nu bara fa han taa naadɛe ra, sɔɔri makantase nun tanbɛ yo mu nu na Isirayilaka mixi wulu tongo naani yi ra.»

sentences.english: Come, you rulers of Israel, you who gave yourselves freely among the people: give praise to the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Alatala tantu! N bɔɲɛ na Isirayila mangɛe nun ɲama fɔxɔ ra, naxee e yɛtɛ ɲanigexi.

sentences.english: Let them give thought to it, who go on white asses, and those who are walking on the road.
sentences.susu: Wo tan naxee tema sofale ginɛ fiixɛe fari, wo tan naxee dɔxɔma dugi fanyi fari, wo tan naxee ɲɛrɛma kira ra, wo wo maɲɔxun.

sentences.english: Give ear to the women laughing by the water-springs; there they will give again the story of the upright acts of the Lord, all the upright acts of his arm in Israel.
sentences.susu: Naxee ye bama kɔlɔnyi ra, e Alatala tantuma a xa fe fanyie ma. Alatala fe fanyi raba nɛ Isirayila bɛ, a xa ɲama tixi taa sode dɛ ra tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Awake! awake! Deborah: awake! awake! give a song: Up! Barak, and take prisoner those who took you prisoner, O son of Abinoam.
sentences.susu: «Debora, xunu! Xunu, i xa bɛɛti ba. Abinowami xa di Baraki, keli! I xa yaxuie xanin.

sentences.english: Then the chiefs went down to the doors; the Lord's people went down among the strong ones.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa xunnakeli fi a xa ɲama fanyi ma, a naxa n xun nakeli sɛnbɛmae tagi.

sentences.english: Out of Ephraim they came down into the valley; after you, Benjamin, among your tribesmen; from Machir came down the captains, and from Zebulun those in whose hand is the ruler's rod.
sentences.susu: Efiramikae naxa fa, naxee kelixi Amalɛkikae xa bɔxi ma, Bunyaminkae naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra. Makiri mangɛe fan naxa goro, a nun Sabulon yareratie.

sentences.english: Your chiefs, Issachar, were with Deborah; and Naphtali was true to Barak; into the valley they went rushing out at his feet. In Reuben there were divisions, and great searchings of heart.
sentences.susu: Isakari mangɛe naxa lu Debora sɛɛti ma. E naxa Baraki mali, e goro geya bunyi, kɔnɔ Rubenkae tan naxa wɔyɛn han.

sentences.english: Why did you keep quiet among the sheep, hearing nothing but the watchers piping to the flocks?
sentences.susu: Wo luxi wo xa xurusee tagi munfe ra, wo nu fa wo tuli mati e wa xui ra? Rubenkae tan fo wɔyɛnyi ɲɔntare.

sentences.english: Gilead was living over Jordan; and Dan was waiting in his ships; Asher kept in his place by the sea's edge, living by his inlets.
sentences.susu: Galadikae fan naxa lu Yurudɛn naakiri ma. Danakae lu e xa kunkuie fɛ ma munfe ra? Aserikae fan naxa lu wafu ra, baa dɛ.

sentences.english: It was the people of Zebulun who put their lives in danger, even to death, with Naphtali on the high places of the field.
sentences.susu: Sabulonkae tan naxa ti faxɛ ya i. Nafatalikae fan naxa suusa gere ra.»

sentences.english: The kings came on to the fight, the kings of Canaan were warring; in Taanach by the waters of Megiddo: they took no profit in money.
sentences.susu: «Mangɛe naxa fa. Kanaan mangɛe naxa fa gere sode Taanaki, Megido xure dɛ ra, kɔnɔ e mu harige nun gbeti yo sɔtɔ na kui.

sentences.english: The stars from heaven were fighting; from their highways they were fighting against Sisera.
sentences.susu: Koore naxa gere so, tunbuie naxa Sisera gere.

sentences.english: The river Kishon took them violently away, stopping their flight, the river Kishon. Give praise, O my soul, to the strength of the Lord!
sentences.susu: Kison xure fori naxa e xanin. N bɔɲɛ xa sɛnbɛ so, n xa siga yare!

sentences.english: Then loudly the feet of the horses were sounding with the stamping, the stamping of their war-horses.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, sɔɔrie naxa e xa soe ragi. E naxa e xulun, e gbataxi.

sentences.english: A curse, a curse on Meroz! said the angel of the Lord. A bitter curse on her townspeople! Because they came not to the help of the Lord, to the help of the Lord among the strong ones.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa a fala, ‹Wo xa Merosi danka. Wo xa Merosikae birin danka. E mu nu biraxi Alatala fɔxɔ ra sɛnbɛmae tagi.›»

sentences.english: Blessings be on Jael, more than on all women! Blessings greater than on any in the tents!
sentences.susu: «Yayeli barakatɔɛ ginɛ nan a ra, Heberi Kenika xa ginɛ. Barakatɔɛ belebele nan a ra ginɛe tagi, naxee sabatixi kiri banxi kui.

sentences.english: His request was for water, she gave him milk; she put butter before him on a fair plate.
sentences.susu: Sisera to ye makula, a naxa xiɲɛ fi a ma. A naxa xiɲɛ fanyi so a yi ra pɔɔti tofanyi kui.

sentences.english: She put out her hand to the tent-pin, and her right hand to the workman's hammer; and she gave Sisera a blow, crushing his head, wounding and driving through his brow.
sentences.susu: Kiri banxi mabanban wuri suxuxi a yi, dɛrɛma fan na a yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛ. A naxa a banban Sisera xunyi, a xunyi naxa bɔɔ.

sentences.english: Bent at her feet he went down, he was stretched out; bent at her feet he went down; where he was bent down, there he went down in death.
sentences.susu: Sisera xa fe naxa dan Yayeli bun ma, a saxi bɔxi, a naxa faxa. Sisera xa fe naxa dan Yayeli bun ma, a saxi bɔxi, a naxa faxa.»

sentences.english: Looking out from the window she gave a cry, the mother of Sisera was crying out through the window, Why is his carriage so long in coming? When will the noise of his wheels be sounding?
sentences.susu: «Sisera nga tixi wundɛri ra, a a falama, ‹Munfe ra a ragise mu nu fa sinden? Munfe ra a sɔɔri ragisee buxi fade?›

sentences.english: Her wise women gave answer to her, yes, she made answer again to herself,
sentences.susu: A xa lɔnnilae naxa a yaabi yi wɔyɛnyi ra,

sentences.english: Are they not getting, are they not parting the goods among them: a young girl or two to every man; and to Sisera robes of coloured needlework, worked in fair colours on this side and on that, for the neck of the queen?
sentences.susu: ‹Tɛmunde e mu na e harige see xa tongofe? E mu na nee xa itaxunfe? Ginɛ keren sɔɔri keren, xa na mu a ra sɔɔri keren, ginɛ firin. E e wasaso se maɲingixie ra naxee nu rafan Sisera ma, e e wasaso donma maɲingi dinxie ra. Donma maɲingixi keren, donma dinxi firin, xunnakeli kanyi xa na sɔtɔ.›

sentences.english: So may destruction come on all your haters, O Lord; but let your lovers be like the sun going out in his strength. And for forty years the land had peace.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i yaxuie birin xa halaki na ki nɛ, kɔnɔ i xanuntenyie xa yanba alɔ soge itexi.» Na dangi xanbi, bɔxi naxa lu xaxilisa kui ɲɛ tongo naani.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel did evil in the eyes of the Lord; and the Lord gave them up into the hand of Midian for seven years.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae man naxa fe kobi raba Alatala ya i naxan mu rafan a ma. A naxa e sa Madiyankae xa nɔɛ bun ma han ɲɛ solofere.

sentences.english: And Midian was stronger than Israel; and because of the Midianites, the children of Israel made holes for themselves in the mountains, and hollows in the rocks, and strong places.
sentences.susu: Madiyankae naxa fe xɔrɔxɔɛe dɔxɔ Isirayila ma. Na nan a to, Isirayilakae naxa folee ge geya fari, e yɛtɛ makantadee yailan gɛmɛ longori ra.

sentences.english: And whenever Israel's grain was planted, the Midianites and the Amalekites and the people of the east came up against them;
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae na xɛ sa tɛmui naxɛ, Madiyankae, Amalɛkikae, nun bɔnsɔɛ gbɛtɛe naxee kelima sogegorode, nee nu tema nɛ, e ti e kanke.

sentences.english: And put their army in position against them; and they took all the produce of the earth as far as Gaza, till there was no food in Israel, or any sheep or oxen or asses.
sentences.susu: E nu lu e fɛ ma e xa Isirayilakae xa daxamui birin kana han Gasa. E mu nu sese luma Isirayila, hali bɔxi daxamuie, yɛxɛɛe, ningee, xa na mu a ra sofalee.

sentences.english: For they came up regularly with their oxen and their tents; they came like the locusts in number; they and their camels were without number; and they came into the land for its destruction.
sentences.susu: Na mixie nu tema tɛmui naxɛ, nun e xa xurusee ra, kiri banxie, nun ɲɔxɔmɛe, e nu luma nɛ alɔ katoe gali naxan kasarɛ rabama bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Israel was in great need because of Midian; and the cry of the children of Israel went up to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Madiyankae to Isirayila findi setare bɔxi ra, Isirayilakae naxa Alatala maxandi.

sentences.english: And when the cry of the children of Israel, because of Midian, came before the Lord,
sentences.susu: E to Alatala makula Madiyankae xa fe ra,

sentences.english: The Lord sent a prophet to the children of Israel, who said to them, The Lord the God of Israel, has said, I took you up from Egypt, out of the prison-house;
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa namiɲɔnmɛ keren xɛɛ e ma. A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan yi ki, ‹N bara wo ramini Misira bɔxi ma, wo nu na konyiya kui dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And I took you out of the hands of the Egyptians and out of the hands of all who were cruel to you, and I sent them out by force from before you and gave you their land;
sentences.susu: N bara wo ba Misirakae bɛlɛxɛ, a nun wo yaxui birin. N bara e keri wo ya ra, n fa e xa bɔxi fi wo ma.

sentences.english: And I said to you, I am the Lord your God; you are not to give worship to the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living, but you did not give ear to my voice.
sentences.susu: N bara a masen wo bɛ, «N tan nan na Alatala ra, wo Marigi Ala. Wo naxa gaaxu Amorikae xa alae ya ra, wo sabatixi bɔxi naxee ma.» Kɔnɔ wo mu biraxi n xui fɔxɔ ra.›»

sentences.english: Now the angel of the Lord came and took his seat under the oak-tree in Ophrah, in the field of Joash the Abiezrite; and his son Gideon was crushing grain in the place where the grapes were crushed, so that the Midianites might not see it.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa so Ofara daaxa kui, a naxa dɔxɔ wuri bili bun ma, naxan tixi Yowasi xɔnyi, naxan nu na Abiyesa bɔnsɔɛ ya ma. Yowasi xa di Gedeyon nu na mɛngi bɔnbɔfe yili kui wɛni bogi nu bunduma dɛnnaxɛ, alako a xa a nɔxun Madiyankae ma.

sentences.english: And the angel of the Lord came before his eyes, and said to him, The Lord is with you, O man of war.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa mini a ma, a fa a fala a bɛ, «I tan geresoe fanyi, wo nun Alatala birin nan a ra.»

sentences.english: Then Gideon said to him, O my lord, if the Lord is with us why has all this come on us? And where are all his works of power, of which our fathers have given us word, saying, Did not the Lord take us out of Egypt? But now he has given us up, handing us over to the power of Midian.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa a fala a bɛ, «N Marigi, xa muxu nun Alatala birin nan a ra, yi fe xɔrɔxɔɛ birin fa muxu lixi munfe ra? A xa kaabanakoe na minden? Muxu babae bara kaabanako nde madɔxɔ muxu bɛ. E naxɛ, ‹Alatala nan muxu ramini Misira ra.› Yakɔsi Alatala bara won nabɛɲin, a won sa Madiyankae sago.»

sentences.english: And the Lord, turning to him, said, Go in the strength you have and be Israel's saviour from Midian: have I not sent you?
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «I sɛnbɛ so. I fama nɛ Isirayila ratangade Madiyankae bɛlɛxɛ. N tan xa mu i xɛɛxi?»

sentences.english: And he said to him, O Lord, how may I be the saviour of Israel? See, my family is the poorest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «N Marigi, n tan nɔma Isirayila ratangade a yaxuie ma? N xabilɛ xa setareɲa dangi xabilɛ birin gbe ra Manasi bɔnsɔɛ ya ma. N baba xa di dɔnxɔɛ na n tan nan na.»

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to him, Truly, I will be with you, and you will overcome the Midianites as if they were one man.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «Kɔnɔ won birin nan a ra. Na kui i fama Madiyankae birin bɔnbɔde alɔ i na mixi keren nan bɔnbɔfe.»

sentences.english: So he said to him, If now I have grace in your eyes, then give me a sign that it is you who are talking to me.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa a yaabi, «Xa i bara hinnɛ n na, tɔnxuma nde masen n bɛ, naxan a masenma i tan yati nan wɔyɛnxi n bɛ.

sentences.english: Do not go away till I come with my offering and put it before you. And he said, I will not go away before you come back.
sentences.susu: Yandi, i naxa i makuya be ra, beemanu n xa fa n ma sɛrɛxɛ ra i bɛ.» Alatala naxa a fala, «N luma be han i fama tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Gideon went in and made ready a young goat, and with an ephah of meal he made unleavened cakes: he put the meat in a basket and the soup in which it had been cooked he put in a pot, and he took it out to him under the oak-tree and gave it to him there.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa siga, a sa si yɔrɛ keren faxa, a farin busali keren nafala taami lɛbinitare ra. A naxa sube sa debe kui, a naxa bɔrɛ sa bɔrɛ sase kui, a naxa e dɛntɛgɛ Alatala bɛ wuri bili bun ma.

sentences.english: And the angel of God said to him, Take the meat and the unleavened cakes and put them down on the rock over there, draining out the soup over them. And he did so.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa a masen a bɛ, «Sube nun taami lɛbinitare tongo, i xa e sa yi gɛmɛ fari, i bɔrɛ sa a ma.» Gedeyon to ge na rabade,

sentences.english: Then the angel of the Lord put out the stick which was in his hand, touching the meat and the cakes with the end of it; and a flame came up out of the rock, burning up the meat and the cakes: and the angel of the Lord was seen no longer.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa a yisuxuwuri itala, a naxa a din sube nun taami lɛbinitare ra. Na kui tɛ naxa dɛxɛ gɛmɛ ma, a sube nun taami lɛbinitare birin gan. Na xanbi Alatala xa malekɛ naxa lɔɛ a ma.

sentences.english: Then Gideon was certain that he was the angel of the Lord; and Gideon said, I am in fear, O Lord God! for I have seen the angel of the Lord face to face.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon to a to Alatala xa malekɛ yati nan a ra, a naxa a fala, «N Marigi Alatala! N bara Alatala xa malekɛ to, a tixi n ya i.»

sentences.english: But the Lord said to him, Peace be with you; have no fear: you are in no danger of death.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «Hali i mu gaaxu, i mu faxama. I bɔɲɛ xa sa.»

sentences.english: Then Gideon made an altar there to the Lord, and gave it the name Yahweh-shalom; to this day it is in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan Alatala bɛ mɛnni, a fa a xili fala na xun, «Alatala xa bɔɲɛsa.» Han to, mɛnni na Ofara, Abiyesa xabilɛ na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: The same night the Lord said to him, Take ten men of your servants and an ox seven years old, and after pulling down the altar of Baal which is your father's, and cutting down the holy tree by its side,
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ kɔɛ ra Alatala naxa a masen Gedeyon bɛ, «I baba xa tuura tongo, naxan bara ɲɛ solofere sɔtɔ. I xa i baba xa Bali kuye sɛrɛxɛbade kana, a nun na Aseri wuri masolixi, naxan tixi a xun.

sentences.english: Make an altar to the Lord your God on the top of this rock, in the ordered way and take the ox and make a burned offering with the wood of the holy tree which has been cut down.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, i xa sɛrɛxɛbade gbɛtɛ yailan i Marigi Alatala bɛ yi yire magaaxuxi fari. I xa na tuura ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra. Na Aseri wuri masolixi, i naxan kanama, na xa findi yege ra na sɛrɛxɛ ganse ra.»

sentences.english: Then Gideon took ten of his servants and did as the Lord had said to him; but fearing to do it by day, because of his father's people and the men of the town, he did it by night.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa mixi fu tongo a xa konyie ya ma, a na birin naba, Alatala naxan masenxi a bɛ. A na raba kɔɛ nan na, barima a nu gaaxuxi a baba xa mixie nun taakae ya ra.

sentences.english: And the men of the town got up early in the morning, and they saw the altar of Baal broken down, and the holy tree which was by it cut down, and the ox offered on the altar which had been put up there.
sentences.susu: Taakae to keli subaxɛ ma, e naxa a to Bali kuye sɛrɛxɛbade rabiraxi, Aseri wuri masolixi naxan nu tixi a xun ma, na fan nabiraxi. E man naxa tuura to naxan baxi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra sɛrɛxɛbade nɛɛnɛ fari.

sentences.english: And they said to one another, Who has done this thing? And after searching with care, they said, Gideon, the son of Joash, has done this thing.
sentences.susu: E naxa e boore maxɔrin, «Nde yi rabaxi?» E to na fe fen, e fa a fala e boore bɛ, «Yowasi xa di Gedeyon nan fɔxi a ra.»

sentences.english: Then the men of the town said to Joash, Make your son come out to be put to death, for pulling down the altar of Baal and cutting down the holy tree which was by it.
sentences.susu: Na kui taakae naxa a fala Yowasi bɛ, «I xa di ramini, a xa faxa, barima a bara Bali kuye sɛrɛxɛbade kana, a man bara Aseri wuri masolixi rabira, naxan nu tixi a xun.»

sentences.english: But Joash said to all those who were attacking him, Will you take up the cause of Baal? will you be his saviour? Let anyone who will take up his cause be put to death while it is still morning: if he is a god, let him take up his cause himself because of the pulling down of his altar.
sentences.susu: Yowasi naxa mixie yaabi, naxee nu tixi a kanke, «Wo tan nan Bali xun mafalama? Wo tan nan a ratangama? Mixi yo naxan Bali xun mafala, na kanyi nan singe faxama beemanu kuye xa iba. Xa Ala nan na Bali ra, a tan xa a yɛtɛ xun mafala, barima e a tan nan xa sɛrɛxɛbade rabiraxi.»

sentences.english: So that day he gave him the name of Jerubbaal, saying, Let Baal take up his cause against him because his altar has been broken down.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, e naxa Yerubaali xili fala Gedeyon xun ma, e nu fa a fala, «Bali xa a yɛtɛ xun mafala, barima a bara a xa sɛrɛxɛbade rabira.»

sentences.english: Then all the Midianites and the Amalekites and the people of the east, banding themselves together, went over and put up their tents in the valley of Jezreel.
sentences.susu: Madiyankae, Amalɛkikae, nun bɔnsɔɛ gbɛtɛe naxee keli sogetede, nee naxa e malan, e fa Yurudɛn igiri, e lu Yisireeli geya bunyi.

sentences.english: But the spirit of the Lord came on Gideon; and at the sound of his horn all Abiezer came together after him.
sentences.susu: Alatala Xaxili naxa lu Gedeyon bɛ. A naxa feri fe, a xa Abiyeseri bɔnsɔɛ maxili alako e birin xa bira a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And he sent through all Manasseh, and they came after him; and he sent to Asher and Zebulun and Naphtali, and they came up and were joined to the others.
sentences.susu: A naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Manasi bɔxi ma, nee fan xa bira a fɔxɔ ra. A man naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Aseri, Sabulon, nun Nafatali bɔxi ma, mɛnnikae fan naxa kafu a ma.

sentences.english: Then Gideon said to God, If you are going to give Israel salvation by my hand, as you have said,
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa a fala Alatala bɛ, «Xa i wama Isirayila ratangafe n saabui ra, alɔ i a masenxi ki naxɛ, i xa yi raba n bɛ.

sentences.english: See, I will put the wool of a sheep on the grain-floor; if there is dew on the wool only, while all the earth is dry, then I will be certain that it is your purpose to give Israel salvation by my hand as you have said.
sentences.susu: N xa yɛxɛɛ kiri itala lonyi xun, a xa lu mɛnni kɔɛ ra. Xa xini dɔxɔ yɛxɛɛ kiri nan kansan ma, bɔxi tan nabilinyi naxa xara, n fama a kolonde na tɛmui nɛ, i tan nan Isirayila ratangama n saabui ra, alɔ i a masenxi ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And it was so: for he got up early on the morning after, and twisting the wool in his hands, he got a basin full of water from the dew on the wool.
sentences.susu: A naxa na raba na ki. Na kuye iba, a naxa keli subaxɛ ma, a yɛxɛɛ kiri bundu alako a xa a kolon xa xini dɔxɔxi kiri ma. Ye, pɔɔti ya keren naxa mini na kui.

sentences.english: Then Gideon said to God, Do not be moved to wrath against me if I say only this: let me make one more test with the wool; let the wool now be dry, while the earth is covered with dew.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon man naxa a fala Ala bɛ, «Hali i bɔɲɛ mu te n xili ma, n ma wɔyɛn dɔnxɔɛ nan yi ki. N man waxi seedeɲɔxɔya nan matofe yi kiri ra. Kiri kansan xa xara, xini xa bɔxi birin bunda.»

sentences.english: And that night God did so; for the wool was dry, and there was dew on all the earth round it.
sentences.susu: Na kɔɛ ra, Ala naxa na raba na ki. Kiri kansan naxa xara, xini fa bɔxi birin bunda.

sentences.english: Then Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, and all the people with him, got up early and put up their tents by the side of the water-spring of Harod; the tents of Midian were on the north side of him, under the hill of Moreh in the valley.
sentences.susu: Yerubaali, naxan findi Gedeyon na, a nun ɲama naxan birin nu biraxi a fɔxɔ ra, e naxa keli subaxɛ ma, e sa kuru Xarodi dulonyi fɛ ma. Madiyankae nu malanxi kɔɔla biri More geya bunyi.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Gideon, So great is the number of your people, that if I give the Midianites into their hands they will be uplifted in pride over me and will say, I myself have been my saviour.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Gedeyon bɛ, «I xa sɔɔrie bara gbo yɛ. Xa n bara Madiyankae sa e sagoe, Isirayilakae fama nɛ e yɛtɛ wasude n na, e a fala, ‹Muxu tan nan muxu yɛtɛ kan natangaxi.›

sentences.english: So now, let it be given out to the people that anyone who is shaking with fear is to go back from Mount Galud. So twenty-two thousand of the people went back, but there were still ten thousand.
sentences.susu: I xa ɲama yaamari, ‹Gaaxui bara naxee birin sɛrɛn, e xa gbilen Galadi geya yire.›» Xɛmɛ mixi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn a nun firin naxa gbilen, kɔnɔ xɛmɛ mixi wulu fu tan naxa lu naa.

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to Gideon, There are still more people than is necessary; take them down to the water so that I may put them to the test for you there; then whoever I say is to go with you will go, and whoever I say is not to go will not go.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Gedeyon bɛ, «Han ya ɲama man gbo. Goro e ra xure biri, n fama e mayegetide mɛnni nɛ. N na a fala i bɛ naxan na, wo nun yi nan sigama, wo nun na kanyi xa siga. N na a fala xɛmɛ naxan birin na, e mu sigama, nee naxa bira i fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: So he took the people down to the water; and the Lord said to Gideon, Put on one side by themselves all those drinking up the water with their tongues like a dog; and in the same way, all those who go down on their knees to the water while drinking.
sentences.susu: A naxa ɲama ragoro xure dɛ ra. Alatala naxa a masen Gedeyon bɛ, «Naxee birin na ye kɔn e nɛnyi ra alɔ bare, i xa nee ti e xati ma. Naxee fan birin na e xinbi sin, e ye min, i xa nee fan ti e xati ma.»

sentences.english: Now the number of those who took up the water with their tongues was three hundred; all the rest of the people went down on their knees to the water.
sentences.susu: Naxee birin ye kɔ e bɛlɛxɛ kui, e naxa a min, e kɔnti naxa siga xɛmɛ mixi kɛmɛ saxan. Ɲama dɔnxɔɛ naxa e xinbi sin, e nu fa ye kɔn e nɛnyi ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Gideon, By those three hundred who were drinking with their tongues I will give you salvation and give the Midianites into your hands; let the rest of the people go away, every man to his place.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Gedeyon bɛ, «Yi xɛmɛ mixi kɛmɛ saxan naxee ye kɔxi e bɛlɛxɛ kui, n fama wo ratangade e tan nan saabui ra. N Madiyankae sama nɛ i sago. Yi ɲama dɔnxɔɛ, kankan xa siga a xɔnyi.» E naxa fandɛ tongo a nun feri naxee nu na ɲamae yi.

sentences.english: So they took the vessels of the people, and their horns from their hands, and he sent them away, every man to his tent, keeping only the three hundred; and the tents of Midian were lower down in the valley.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa e ragbilen e xɔnyi, na xɛmɛ mixi kɛmɛ saxan gbansan naxa lu a yire. Madiyan xa sɔɔrie nu na a labe ra geya bunyi.

sentences.english: The same night the Lord said to him, Up! go down now against their army, for I have given them into your hands.
sentences.susu: Na kɔɛ ra Alatala naxa a masen Gedeyon bɛ, «I xa goro Madiyan sɔɔrie yire, barima n bara e sa i sagoe.

sentences.english: But if you have fear of going down, take your servant Purah with you and go down to the tents;
sentences.susu: Xa gaaxui na i ma yi gere xa fe ra, wo nun i xa konyi Pura xa goro Madiyankae yire.

sentences.english: And after hearing what they are saying, you will get strength to go down against the army. So he went down with his servant Purah to the outer line of the tents of the armed men.
sentences.susu: I naxan mɛma naa, na fama i ralimaniyade. Goro e xa sɔɔrie yire sinden.» A tan nun a xa konyi Pura naxa goro, han sɔɔrie yonkinde fɛ ma.

sentences.english: Now the Midianites and the Amalekites and all the people of the east were covering the valley like locusts; and their camels were like the sand by the seaside, without number.
sentences.susu: Madiyankae, Amalɛkikae, nun bɔnsɔɛ gbɛtɛe naxee keli sogetede, nu na geya bunyi. E wuya alɔ katoe. E xa ɲɔxɔmɛ fan nu wuya alɔ mɛyɛnyi naxan na baa dɛ ra.

sentences.english: When Gideon came there, a man was giving his friend an account of his dream, saying, See, I had a dream about a cake of barley bread which, falling into the tents of Midian, came on to the tent, overturning it so that it was stretched out flat on the earth.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon to naa li, xɛmɛ nde naxa a xa xiye fala a boore bɛ. A naxa a masen, «N yi xiye nan saxi. N taami ganxi nan toxi a firifirima Madiyan sɔɔrie yonkinde. A naxa a bɔnbɔ kiri banxi nde ra, a a rabira.»

sentences.english: And his friend in answer said, This is certainly the sword of Gideon, the son of Joash, the men of Israel: into their hands God has given up all the army of Midian.
sentences.susu: A boore naxa a yaabi, «A mu findixi sese ra fo Gedeyon xa santidɛgɛma, Yowasi xa di Isirayilaka. Ala bara Madiyankae nun e xa sɔɔrie sa a sago.»

sentences.english: Then Gideon, hearing the story of the dream and the sense in which they took it, gave worship; then he went back to the tents of Israel, and said, Up! for the Lord has given the army of Midian into your hands.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon to gɛ xiye xa fe tagi raba ramɛde, a naxa a felen bɔxi ma, a Ala tantu. Na xanbi, a naxa gbilen Isirayila sɔɔrie yire, a a fala e bɛ, «Wo keli, barima Alatala bara Madiyan sɔɔrie sa won sagoe.»

sentences.english: Then separating the three hundred men into three bands, he gave every man a horn, and a vessel in which was a flaming branch.
sentences.susu: A naxa yi xɛmɛ mixi kɛmɛ saxan itaxun dɔxɔ saxan na. A fa feri nun fɛɲɛ lanmadie so e birin yi ra, tɛ na fɛɲɛe kui.

sentences.english: And he said to them, Keep your eyes on me, and do what I do; when I come to the outer line of tents, whatever I do, you are to do the same.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo xa n mato, n na naxan naba, wo fan xa na raba. N nɛfɛ sɔɔrie yire li, n na naxan naba, wo fan xa na raba.

sentences.english: At the sound of my horn, and the horns of those who are with me, let your horns be sounded all round the tents, and say, For the Lord and for Gideon.
sentences.susu: Muxu feri fema tɛmui naxɛ, wo fan xa wo gbe fe sɔɔrie yonkinde rabilinyi. Wo xa a fala wo xui itexi ra, ‹Alatala nun Gedeyon bɛ!›»

sentences.english: So Gideon and the three hundred men who were with him came to the outer line of tents, at the start of the middle watch, when the watchmen had only then taken their stations; and the horns were sounded and the vessels broken.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon nun a xa sɔɔri mixi kɛmɛ saxan, naxa Madiyan sɔɔrie yire li, e e xa yire makantade masara kɔɛ tagi tɛmui naxɛ. E naxa feri fe, e fɛɲɛe ibɔɔ.

sentences.english: So the three bands all gave a loud note on their horns, and when the vessels had been broken, they took the flaming branches in their left hands, and the horns in their right hands ready for blowing, crying out, For the Lord and for Gideon.
sentences.susu: Yi mixi kuru saxanyie naxa feri fe, e naxa fɛɲɛe ibɔɔ, tɛ suxuxi e kɔɔla bɛlɛxɛe ra, feri suxuxi e yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛe ra e naxan fema. E nu fa a fala e xui itexi ra, «Won xa gere so Alatala nun Gedeyon bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then they made a line round the tents, every man in his place; and all the army, awaking from sleep, came running out, and with loud cries went in flight.
sentences.susu: E birin naxa ti e tide, Madiyan sɔɔrie rabilinyi. Madiyankae naxa e gi, e siga sɔnxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And the three hundred gave a loud note on their horns, and every man's sword was turned by the Lord against his brother all through the army; and the army went in flight as far as Beth-shittah in the direction of Zeredah, to the edge of Abel-meholah by Tabbath.
sentences.susu: Isirayila sɔɔri mixi kɛmɛ saxanyie nu feri fe tɛmui naxɛ, Alatala naxa a niya Madiyankae xa e boore faxa santidɛgɛma ra. Sɔɔri dɔnxɔɛe naxa e gi han Beti Sita, Serera mabiri, han Abeli Mexola, Tabati mabiri.

sentences.english: And the men of Israel came together from Naphtali and from Asher and all Manasseh, and went after Midian.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xɛmɛe naxa e malan, Nafatalikae, Aserikae, nun Manasikae. E birin naxa Madiyankae keri.

sentences.english: Then Gideon sent through all the hill-country of Ephraim saying, Come down against Midian, and keep the ways across Jordan before they come. So all the men of Ephraim, massing themselves together, kept the ways across Jordan.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Efirami geyae yire, e xa a fala, «Wo goro Madiyankae ya ra, wo singe xa ti Yurudɛn xure igirima dɛnnaxɛ han Beti Baara.» Na kui Efirami xɛmɛe naxa e malan, e siga Yurudɛn xure igirima dɛnnaxɛ, han Beti Baara.

sentences.english: And they took the two chiefs of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb; and they put Oreb to death at the rock of Oreb, and Zeeb they put to death at the place of the grape-crushing in Zeeb, and they went after Midian; but the heads of Oreb and Zeeb they took across Jordan to Gideon.
sentences.susu: E naxa Madiyankae xa mangɛ firinyie suxu, Orebi nun Seebi. E naxa Orebi faxa Orebi fanye yire, e naxa Seebi faxa Seebi wɛni bogi bunduma dɛnnaxɛ. E naxa Madiyankae keri, e fa Orebi nun Seebi xunyie ra Gedeyon xɔn Yurudɛn fɛ ma.

sentences.english: And the men of Ephraim came and said to him, Why did you not send for us when you went to war against Midian? And they said sharp and angry words to him.
sentences.susu: Efirami xɛmɛe naxa a fala Gedeyon bɛ, «I yi mɔɔli rabaxi muxu ra munfe ra? I to siga Madiyankae gerede, munfe ra i mu muxu xili, won birin xa siga?» Sɔnxɔɛ belebele naxa bira a i e tagi.

sentences.english: And he said to them, What have I done in comparison with you? Is not that which Ephraim took up after the grape-cutting better than all the grapes which Abiezer got in from the grape-cutting?
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «Wo naxan nabaxi, na dangi n gbe rabaxi ra pon. Efiramikae xa wali lanmadi tide gbo Abiyeseri bɔnsɔɛe xa wali xungbe bɛ.

sentences.english: God has given into your hands the chiefs of Midian, Oreb and Zeeb; what have I been able to do in comparison with you? And when he said this, their feeling about him became kinder.
sentences.susu: Alatala Madiyankae xa mangɛe Orebi nun Seebi saxi wo tan nan sago. N munse rabaxi naxan tide gbo na bɛ?» A to gɛ wɔyɛnde, e bɔɲɛ naxa goro.

sentences.english: Then Gideon came to Jordan and went over it with his three hundred, overcome with weariness and in need of food.
sentences.susu: Hali Gedeyon nun a xa sɔɔrie mixi kɛmɛ saxanyie to nu taganxi, e Yurudɛn igiri nɛ Madiyankae kerife ra.

sentences.english: And he said to the men of Succoth, Give bread cakes to my people, for they are overcome with weariness, and I am going on after Zebah and Zalmunna, the kings of Midian.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Sukɔtikae bɛ, «N bara wo maxandi, wo taami nde so n ma mixie yi ra, barima e bara tagan. N na Madiyankae xa mangɛe Sɛba nun Salamuna nan kerife.»

sentences.english: But the chiefs of Succoth said, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna even now in your hand that we are to give bread to your army?
sentences.susu: Sukɔti mangɛe naxa Gedeyon yaabi, «Wo ɲan bara gɛ Sɛba nun Salamuna suxude? A lanma muxu xa taami so i xa sɔɔrie yi ra munfe ra?»

sentences.english: Then Gideon said, Because of this, when the Lord has given Zebah and Zalmunna into my hands, I will have you stretched on a bed of thorns of the waste land and on sharp stems, and have you crushed as grain is crushed on a grain-floor.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa a fala, «Alatala na Sɛba nun Salamuna sa n sago tɛmui naxɛ, n fama wo fatee mabɔɔde gbengberen yire tunbee nan na.»

sentences.english: So he went up from there to Penuel and made the same request to the men of Penuel; but they gave him the same answer as the men of Succoth had given.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa keli mɛnni, a siga Peniyeli. A naxa mɛnnikae fan makula taami ra. Peniyelikae fan naxa a yaabi alɔ Sukɔti mixie a yaabi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So he said to the men of Penuel, When I come back in peace, I will have this tower broken down.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala nee fan bɛ, «N na xunnakeli sɔtɔ, n fama be wo xa taa tɛtɛ birin nabirade.»

sentences.english: Now Zebah and Zalmunna were in Karkor and their armies with them, about fifteen thousand men, those of all the army of the children of the east who were still living; for a hundred and twenty thousand of their swordsmen had been put to death.
sentences.susu: Sɛba nun Salamuna nu na Karakore, e nun e xa sɔɔri mixi wulu fu nun suuli ɲɔndɔn. E tan gbansan nan nu luxi. Sɔɔri mixi wulu kɛmɛ mixi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nu bara faxa santidɛgɛma ra bɔnsɔɛe ya ma naxee kelixi sogetede.

sentences.english: And Gideon went up by the way used by the people living in tents on the east of Nobah and Jogbehah, and made an attack on the army when they had no thought of danger.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa te kira xɔn ma Noba nun Yogbeha sogetede biri. A naxa sɔɔrie bɔnbɔ naa, naxee nu laxi a ra a gere mu e lima sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And Zebah and Zalmunna went in flight; and he went after them, and took the two kings of Midian, Zebah and Zalmunna, and put all the army to the curse.
sentences.susu: Madiyan mangɛe Sɛba nun Salamuna fan naxa e gi. Gedeyon naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra, han a e suxu, a fa e xa sɔɔrie birin nagi.
