sentences.english: Then Gideon, the son of Joash, went back from the fight:
sentences.susu: Yowasi xa di Gedeyon to fa kelife gere sode Xɛrɛsɛ geya fari,

sentences.english: And taking prisoner a young man of the people of Succoth, he got from him, in answer to his questions, a list of the chiefs of Succoth and the responsible men, seventy-seven men.
sentences.susu: a naxa Sukɔti fonike nde suxu, a a karaxan a xa Sukɔti mangɛe nun kuntigie xilie sɛbɛ a bɛ. Nee naxa lan mixi tongo solofere a nun solofere ma.

sentences.english: So he came to the men of Succoth and said, Here are Zebah and Zalmunna, on account of whom you made sport of me, saying, Are the hands of Zebah and Zalmunna even now in your hand, that we are to give bread to your army who are overcome with weariness?
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa siga Sukɔti, a a fala e bɛ, «Sɛba nun Salamuna nan yi ki, wo n konbi naxee xa fe ra. Wo naxa a fala, ‹Wo ɲan bara gɛ Sɛba nun Salamuna suxude? A lanma muxu xa taami so i xa sɔɔrie yi ra munfe ra?›»

sentences.english: Then he took the responsible men of the town and had them crushed on a bed of thorns and sharp stems.
sentences.susu: Na kui a naxa taa kuntigie suxu, a e bɔnbɔ gbengberen yire tunbee ra.

sentences.english: And he had the tower of Penuel broken down and the men of the town put to death.
sentences.susu: A naxa Peniyeli tɛtɛ fan nabira, a fa mɛnnikae faxa.

sentences.english: Then he said to Zebah and Zalmunna, Where are the men whom you put to death at Tabor? And they gave answer, As you are, so were they; every one of them was like a king's son.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa Sɛba nun Salamuna maxɔrin, «Wo mixi naxee faxa Taboro, e nu na di?» E naxa a yaabi, «E nu nɛ alɔ i tan. E birin nu luxi alɔ mangɛdie.»

sentences.english: And he said, They were my brothers, my mother's sons: by the life of the Lord, if you had kept them safe, I would not put you to death.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa a fala e bɛ, «N taarae nan nu na e ra, n nga xa die. N bara n kali Alatala ɲiɲɛ ra, xa wo mu e faxa nu, n fan mu wo faxama nu.»

sentences.english: Then he said to Jether, his oldest son, Up! Put them to death. But the boy did not take out his sword, fearing because he was still a boy.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Yeteri bɛ, a xa di singe, «E faxa!» Kɔnɔ Yeteri mu a xa santidɛgɛma ba a tɛɛ i, barima fonike nan nu a ra, a gaaxuxi.

sentences.english: Then Zebah and Zalmunna said, Up! Put an end to us yourself: for you have a man's strength. Then Gideon got up and put Zebah and Zalmunna to death and took the ornaments which were on their camels' necks.
sentences.susu: Sɛba nun Salamuna naxa a fala Gedeyon bɛ, «Xa xɛmɛ nan i ra, i tan yɛtɛ yati xa muxu faxa.» Gedeyon naxa keli keren na, a e faxa. A naxa kɔnmagoree ba e xa ɲɔxɔmɛe kɔn ma.

sentences.english: Then the men of Israel said to Gideon, Be our ruler, you and your son and your son's son after him; for you have been our saviour from the hands of Midian.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xɛmɛe naxa a fala Gedeyon bɛ, «I xa findi muxu xa mangɛ ra, na dangi xanbi i xa di, nun na xa di. I bara muxu ratanga Madiyankae ma.»

sentences.english: But Gideon said to them, I will not be a ruler over you, and my son will not be a ruler over you: it is the Lord who will be ruler over you.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa a fala e bɛ, «N tan nun n ma di, muxu mu findima wo xa mangɛ ra. Alatala nan na wo xa mangɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Then Gideon said to them, I have a request to make to you; let every man give me the ear-rings he has taken. (For they had gold ear-rings, because they were Ishmaelites.)
sentences.susu: Gedeyon man naxa wɔyɛn e bɛ. A naxɛ, «Xa wo bara tin, a xɔli n ma kankan xa xurundɛ keren so n yi ra, wo naxan sɔtɔxi wo wasaso see ra gere kui.» Xurundɛ xɛɛma daaxi nu soxi Madiyankae bɛlɛxɛee ra, barima e kelixi Sumayila bɔnsɔɛ nɛ.

sentences.english: And they gave answer, We will gladly give them. So they put down a robe, every man dropping into it the ear-rings he had taken.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala, «Muxu bara tin na ra.» E fa dugi itala, e birin fa e xa xurundɛ keren keren sa dugi kui e naxan sɔtɔ wasaso see ra.

sentences.english: The weight of the gold ear-rings which he got from them was one thousand, seven hundred shekels of gold; in addition to the moon-ornaments and jewels and the purple robes which were on the kings of Midian, and the chains on their camels' necks.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon xɛɛma naxan maxɔrin, a binyɛ naxa siga han kilo mɔxɔɲɛn, bafe xunmasee ra, tuli rasoe, donma gbeeli Madiyan mangɛ daaxi, a nun ɲɔxɔmɛ kɔnmagore.

sentences.english: And Gideon made an ephod from them and put it up in his town Ophrah; and all Israel went after it there and were false to the Lord; and it became a cause of sin to Gideon and his house.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi donma yailan na xɛɛma ra, a a ti Ofara, a xa taa kui. A raɲɔnyi, na naxa findi gantanyi ra Gedeyon nun a xa denbaya bɛ, barima Isirayilakae birin naxa na findi e xa ala ra.

sentences.english: So Midian was broken before the children of Israel and the Midianites never got back their strength. And the land had peace for forty years, in the days of Gideon.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa Madiyan lu e xa nɔɛ bun ma, nee mu xunnakeli sɔtɔ sɔnɔn. Bɔxi naxa lu bɔɲɛsa kui ɲɛ tongo naani Gedeyon xa simaya kui.

sentences.english: And Jerubbaal, the son of Joash, went back to his house and was living there.
sentences.susu: Yowasi xa di Yerubaali naxa gbilen a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Gideon had seventy sons, the offspring of his body; for he had a number of wives.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon naxa di tongo solofere bari, barima ginɛ gbegbe nan nu dɔxɔxi a xɔn.

sentences.english: And the servant-wife he had in Shechem had a son by him, to whom he gave the name Abimelech.
sentences.susu: A xa konyi ginɛ naxan nu na Sikemi, na fan naxa di xɛmɛ bari a bɛ. A naxa Abimeleki xili fala a xun.

sentences.english: And Gideon, the son of Joash, came to his end when he was very old, and his body was put in the resting-place of Joash his father, in Ophrah of the Abiezrites.
sentences.susu: Yowasi xa di, Gedeyon naxa faxa simaya fanyi kui. E naxa a ragata Yowasi xa gaburi yire Ofara, Abiyesa bɔnsɔɛ nu na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And after the death of Gideon, the children of Israel again went after the gods of Canaan and were false to the Lord, and made Baal-berith their god.
sentences.susu: Gedeyon to faxa, Isirayilakae man naxa Alatala bɛɲin, e xa Bali kuyee batu. E naxa Bali Beriti findi e xa ala ra.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel did not keep in their minds the Lord their God, who had been their saviour from all their haters on every side;
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa nɛɛmu e Marigi Alatala ma, naxan e ratanga e yaxui birin bɛlɛxɛ i, naxee nu e rabilinxi.

sentences.english: And they were not kind to the house of Jerubbaal, that is, Gideon, in reward for all the good he had done to Israel.
sentences.susu: E mu dugutɛgɛɲa rasiga Yerubaali xa denbaya ma fefe ma, hali a to nu bara fe fanyi gbegbe raba Isirayila bɛ.

sentences.english: Now Abimelech, the son of Jerubbaal, went to Shechem to his mother's family, and said to them and to all the family of his mother's father,
sentences.susu: Yerubaali xa di Abimeleki naxa siga Sikemi a nga xunyie yire. A naxa yi masenyi ti a nga xabilɛ bɛ,

sentences.english: Say now in the ears of all the townsmen of Shechem, Is it better for you to be ruled by all the seventy sons of Jerubbaal or by one man only? And keep in mind that I am your bone and your flesh.
sentences.susu: «Katarabi Sikemi kuntigie birin ma, ‹Wo wama a xɔn ma Yerubaali xa di tongo solofere birin xa findi wo xa mangɛe ra, ka mixi keren gbansan xa findi wo xa mangɛ ra? Wo xa wo ratu a ma, won findixi wuli keren fasɛ keren nan na.›»

sentences.english: So his mother's family said all this about him in the ears of all the townsmen of Shechem: and their hearts were turned to Abimelech, for they said, He is our brother.
sentences.susu: A nga xunyie naxa na masenyi birin tagi raba Sikemi kuntigie bɛ. Kuntigie naxa tin birafe Abimeleki fɔxɔ ra, barima e ngaxakerenyi nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: And they gave him seventy shekels of silver from the house of Baal-berith, with which Abimelech got the support of a number of uncontrolled and good-for-nothing persons.
sentences.susu: E naxa gbeti kilo solomasaxan fi a ma, kelife Bali Beriti xa salide kui. Abimeleki naxa kɔbiri so xɛmɛ rabɛɲinxie nun kalabantee yi ra, alako e xa bira a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Then he went to his father's house at Ophrah, and put his brothers, the seventy sons of Jerubbaal, to death on the same stone; however, Jotham, the youngest, kept himself safe by going away to a secret place.
sentences.susu: A naxa siga a baba xɔnyi Ofara, a a xunyae birin faxa. Yerubaali xa di tongo solofere birin naxa faxa fanye keren fari, fo Yotami, Yerubaali xa di dɔnxɔɛ, naxan nu bara a nɔxun e ma.

sentences.english: And all the townsmen of Shechem and all Beth-millo came together and went and made Abimelech their king, by the oak of the pillar in Shechem.
sentences.susu: Sikemi kuntigie nun Beti Milo ɲama birin naxa e malan Sikemi, gɛmɛ belebele nun wuri tofanyi tixi dɛnnaxɛ. E naxa Abimeleki findi mangɛ ra mɛnni.

sentences.english: Now Jotham, on hearing of it, went to the top of Mount Gerizim, and crying out with a loud voice said to them, Give ear to me, you townsmen of Shechem, so that God may give ear to you.
sentences.susu: Yotami to na fe mɛ, a naxa siga a sa ti Garisimi geya fari, a fa a fala a xui itexi ra, «Sikemi kuntigie, xa wo wama nɛ Ala xa a tuli mati wo ra, wo xa wo tuli mati n tan na.

sentences.english: One day the trees went out to make a king for themselves; and they said to the olive-tree, Be king over us.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde, wuri bilie naxa a natɛ e xa mangɛ keren sugandi. E naxa a fala oliwi bili bɛ, ‹Findi muxu xa mangɛ ra.›

sentences.english: But the olive-tree said to them, Am I to give up my wealth of oil, by which men give honour to God, and go waving over the trees?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ oliwi bili naxa e yaabi, ‹N tan mu gbilenma n ture raminife fɔxɔ ra, ture naxan findima binya se ra Ala nun mixie bɛ, alako n xa nu sa n iyan wuri bilie xun.›»

sentences.english: Then the trees said to the fig-tree, You come and be king over us.
sentences.susu: «Wuri bilie naxa a fala xɔrɛ bili bɛ, ‹I tan xa fa be, i xa findi muxu xa mangɛ ra.›

sentences.english: But the fig-tree said to them, Am I to give up my sweet taste and my good fruit and go waving over the trees?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xɔrɛ bili naxa a fala e bɛ, ‹N tan mu gbilenma n bogi ɲɔxunmɛ fanyi raminife fɔxɔ ra, alako kansan n xa nu sa n iyan wuri bilie xun.›»

sentences.english: Then the trees said to the vine, You come and be king over us.
sentences.susu: «Wuri bilie naxa a fala wɛni bili bɛ, ‹I tan xa fa be, i xa findi muxu xa mangɛ ra.›

sentences.english: But the vine said to them, Am I to give up my wine, which makes glad God and men, to go waving over the trees?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wɛni bili naxa e yaabi, ‹N tan mu gbilenma n ma wɛni raminife fɔxɔ ra naxan Ala nun mixie rasɛɛwama, alako kansan n xa nu sa n iyan wuri bilie xun.›»

sentences.english: Then all the trees said to the thorn, You come and be king over us.
sentences.susu: «Na kui wuri bilie naxa a fala tunbe kunsi bɛ, ‹I tan xa fa be, i xa findi muxu xa mangɛ ra.›

sentences.english: And the thorn said to the trees, If it is truly your desire to make me your king, then come and put your faith in my shade; and if not, may fire come out of the thorn, burning up the cedars of Lebanon.
sentences.susu: Tunbe kunsi naxa wuri bilie yaabi, ‹Xa wo waxi ɲanige fanyi nan nabafe n bɛ alako n xa findi wo xa mangɛ ra, wo fa be, wo xa fa lu n niini bun ma. Xa na mu a ra, tɛ minima nɛ tunbe kunsi kui, a Liban wuri bili fanyi birin gan.›»

sentences.english: So now, if you have done truly and uprightly in making Abimelech king, and if you have done well to Jerubbaal and his house in reward for the work of his hands;
sentences.susu: Yotami man naxa a masen e bɛ, «Yakɔsi, wo tan Abimeleki findife mangɛ ra, wo a rabaxi tinxinyi nan ma? Wo fe fanyi nan nabaxi Yerubaali nun a xa denbaya ra na ki? Wo a xa fe fanyi sare ragbilenxi a ma na ki nɛ?

sentences.english: (For my father made war for you, and put his life in danger, and made you free from the hands of Midian;
sentences.susu: N baba gere soxi nɛ wo tan bɛ, a a nii fi gere ma, a wo ratanga Madiyankae bɛlɛxɛ i.

sentences.english: And you have gone against my father's family this day, and have put to death his sons, even seventy men on one stone, and have made Abimelech, the son of his servant-wife, king over the townsmen of Shechem because he is your brother;)
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan, wo bara keli n baba xa denbaya xili ma to lɔxɔɛ, wo bara a xa di xɛmɛ mixi tongo solofere faxa fanye keren fari, wo fa Abimeleki findi mangɛ ra kuntigie xun ma Sikemi. Wo bara Gedeyon xa konyi ginɛ xa di findi wo xa mangɛ ra, barima wo ngaxakerenyi lanxi a tan nan ma.

sentences.english: If then you have done what is true and upright to Jerubbaal and his family this day, may you have joy in Abimelech, and may he have joy in you;
sentences.susu: Xa na birin kelixi ɲanige fanyi nun tinxinyi nan ma Yerubaali nun a xa denbaya mabiri, awa wo tan nun Abimeleki xa rafan wo boore ma.

sentences.english: But if not, may fire come out from Abimelech, burning up the townsmen of Shechem and Beth-millo; and may fire come out from the townsmen of Shechem and Beth-millo, for the destruction of Abimelech.
sentences.susu: Xa na mu a ra, tɛ xa mini Abimeleki, a xa Sikemi kuntigie nun Beti Milo mixie gan. Tɛ xa mini e fan ma, a xa Abimeleki gan!»

sentences.english: Then Jotham straight away went in flight to Beer, and was living there for fear of his brother Abimelech.
sentences.susu: Yotami naxa keli naa, a sa a nɔxun Beeri, dɛnnaxɛ makuya a taara Abimeleki ra.

sentences.english: So Abimelech was chief over Israel for three years.
sentences.susu: Abimeleki naxa Isirayila yamari ɲɛ saxan bun ma.

sentences.english: And God sent an evil spirit between Abimelech and the townsmen of Shechem; and the townsmen of Shechem were false to Abimelech;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Ala naxa xaxili kobi raso Abimeleki nun Sikemi kuntigie tagi. Sikemi kuntigie fa Abimeleki yanfa.

sentences.english: So that punishment for the violent attack made on the seventy sons of Jerubbaal, and for their blood, might come on Abimelech, their brother, who put them to death, and on the townsmen of Shechem who gave him their help in putting his brothers to death.
sentences.susu: Na kui e birin xa e xa fe ɲaaxi sare sɔtɔ. Abimeleki nu bara a ngaxakerenyie faxa, Yerubaali xa di tongo solofere. Sikemikae nu bara Abimeleki mali na faxɛ tife ra.

sentences.english: And the townsmen of Shechem put secret watchers on the tops of the mountains, and they made attacks on all who went by on the road and took their goods; and word of this came to Abimelech.
sentences.susu: Sikemi kuntigie naxa mixie ti yanfanteya ra Abimeleki xili ma geyae xun tagi, e nu mixie fɛtɛnkɛn naxee nu dangima kira ra e yire. Abimeleki naxa na fe mɛ.

sentences.english: Then Gaal, the son of Ebed, came with his brothers, and went over to Shechem; and the men of Shechem put their faith in him.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Ebedi xa di Gaali nun a xunyae naxa fa Sikemi. Taa kuntigie naxa lanlanteya sa a ma.

sentences.english: And they went out into their fields and got in the fruit of their vines, and when the grapes had been crushed, they made a holy feast and went into the house of their god, and over their food and drink they were cursing Abimelech.
sentences.susu: E birin naxa siga wɛni bilie yire, e xa wɛni bogi ba. E naxa na bogie bundu, e fa xulunyi ti. E naxa so e xa ala batude kui, e naxa e dɛge, e e min, e fa Abimeleki danka.

sentences.english: And Gaal, the son of Ebed, said, Who is Abimelech and who is Shechem, that we are to be his servants? Is it not right for the son of Jerubbaal and Zebul his captain to be servants to the men of Hamor, the father of Shechem? But why are we to be his servants?
sentences.susu: Ebedi xa di Gaali naxa a fala e bɛ, «Won tan Sikemikae luxi Abimeleki xa nɔɛ bun ma munfe ra? Yerubaali xa di xa mu lanxi a ma? Abimeleki mu Sebulu xa findixi taa gomina ra? A lanma wo xa lu Hamori xa mixie tan xa yaamari bun ma, barima Hamori nan Sikemi benba ra. Won luxi Abimeleki xa mangɛya bun ma munfe ra?

sentences.english: If only I had authority over this people! I would put Abimelech out of the way, and I would say to Abimelech, Make your army strong, and come out.
sentences.susu: Xa Sikemikae fa bira n tan fɔxɔ ra nu, n Abimeleki kerima nɛ keren na.» Na masenyi dangi xanbi, Gaali naxa a fala Abimeleki bɛ, «I xa sɔɔrie ramini, won xa gere.»

sentences.english: Now Zebul, the ruler of the town, hearing what Gaal, the son of Ebed, had said, was moved to wrath.
sentences.susu: Sebulu, taa gomina to Ebedi xa di Gaali xa masenyi mɛ, a bɔɲɛ naxa te.

sentences.english: And he sent to Abimelech at Arumah, saying, See, Gaal, the son of Ebed, and his brothers have come to Shechem, and they are working up the town against you.
sentences.susu: A naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ gundoɲɔxɔɲa ra Abimeleki xɔn, e xa a fala a bɛ, «Ebedi xa di Gaali nun a xunyae bara fa Sikemi, e na taa mixie bɔɲɛ ratefe i xili ma.

sentences.english: So now, get up by night, you and your people, and keep watch in the field secretly;
sentences.susu: Keli, i xa fa to kɔɛ ra, i tan nun ɲama naxan birin biraxi i fɔxɔ ra, wo xa taa mɛlɛn.

sentences.english: And in the morning, when the sun is up, get up early and make a rush on the town; and when he and his people come out against you, do to them whatever you have a chance to do.
sentences.susu: Subaxɛ, i xa keli, i fa taa suxu. Gaali nun a xa mixie na ti wo ya ra, wo xa wo sɛnbɛ masen e bɛ.»

sentences.english: So Abimelech and the people with him got up by night, in four bands, to make a surprise attack on Shechem.
sentences.susu: Abimeleki nun a xa sɔɔri xundɛ naani naxa keli kɔɛ ra, e sa Sikemi mɛlɛn.

sentences.english: And Gaal, the son of Ebed, went out, and took his place at the doorway into the town; then Abimelech and his people got up from the place where they had been waiting.
sentences.susu: Ebedi xa di Gaali to keli gɛɛsɛgɛ, a sa ti taa sode dɛ ra, Abimeleki nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa mini kɛnɛ ma.

sentences.english: And when Gaal saw the people, he said to Zebul, See! people are coming down from the tops of the mountains. And Zebul said to him, You see the shade of the mountains like men.
sentences.susu: Gaali to sɔɔrie to, a naxa a fala Sebulu bɛ, «Ɲama nde nan na gorofe geya fari yi ki.» Sebulu naxa a yaabi, «I geya niini nan findixi mixie ra na ki.»

sentences.english: And Gaal said again, See! people are coming down from the middle of the land, and one band is coming by way of the oak-tree of the Seers.
sentences.susu: Gaali man naxa a fala, «Ɲama yati nan na gorofe taa kui yi ki. Ɲama gbɛtɛ fan na fafe sematoe xa wuri bili kira xɔn.»

sentences.english: Then Zebul said to him, Now where is your loud talk when you said, Who is Abimelech that we are to be his servants? Is this not the people whom you were rating so low? Go out now, and make war on them.
sentences.susu: Sebulu naxa a yaabi, «I xa wɔyɛn xungbe na minden, i tan naxan nu a falama, ‹Sikemi luxi Abimeleki xa yaamari bun ma munfe ra?› I mu nu yi mixie konbi xɛ? Siga, i sa e gere.»

sentences.english: So Gaal went out at the head of the townsmen of Shechem and made war on Abimelech.
sentences.susu: Gaali naxa ti Sikemi kuntigie ya ra, e naxa Abimeleki gere.

sentences.english: And Abimelech went after him and he went in flight before him; and a great number were falling by the sword all the way up to the town.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe naxa faxa taa sode dɛ ra. Abimeleki naxa Gaali keri

sentences.english: Then Abimelech went back to Arumah; and Zebul sent Gaal and his brothers away and would not let them go on living in Shechem.
sentences.susu: han Aruma. Sebulu naxa Gaali ngaxakerenyie keri Sikemi kui, hali keren, a mu lu naa.

sentences.english: Now the day after, the people went out into the fields; and news of it came to Abimelech.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, ɲama naxa siga daaxa. Abimeleki to na fe kolon,

sentences.english: And he took his people, separating them into three bands, and was waiting secretly in the field; and when he saw the people coming out of the town, he went up and made an attack on them.
sentences.susu: a naxa sɔɔrie tongo, a e itaxun xundɛ saxan na. E naxa e nɔxun daaxa han ɲama birin naxa mini, e fa keli e xili ma, e e bɔnbɔ.

sentences.english: And Abimelech with his band made a rush, and took up their position at the doorway into the town; and the other two bands made a rush on all those who were in the fields, and overcame them.
sentences.susu: Abimeleki xa xundɛ naxa sa ti taa sode dɛ ra. Boore xundɛ firinyi naxa sin na mixie ma, naxee nu na daaxa, e naxa e birin sɔntɔ.

sentences.english: And all that day Abimelech was fighting against the town; and he took it, and put to death the people who were in it, and had the town pulled down and covered with salt.
sentences.susu: Abimeleki naxa gere so na taa ma yanyi birin, han a naxa nɔ a ra, a mɛnnikae birin faxa. A man naxa na taa rabira, a fɔxɛ sa na ma.

sentences.english: Then all the townsmen of the tower of Shechem, hearing of it, went into the inner room of the house of El-berith.
sentences.susu: Sikemikae naxee luxi, e to na fe mɛ, e naxa so Eli Beriti kuye xa salide kui.

sentences.english: And word was given to Abimelech that all the men of the tower of Shechem were there together.
sentences.susu: E naxa sa a fala Abimeleki bɛ, a Sikemi taa kuntigie bara malan salide kui.

sentences.english: Then Abimelech went up to Mount Zalmon, with all his people; and Abimelech took an axe in his hand and, cutting down branches of trees, took them and put them on his back. And he said to the people who were with him, Be quick and do as you have seen me do.
sentences.susu: Na kui Abimeleki naxa te Salamon geya fari nun ɲama naxan nu biraxi a fɔxɔ ra. Abimeleki naxa beera suxu a bɛlɛxɛ. A naxa wuri salonyi nde sɛgɛ, a a sa a kɔn ma. Na xanbi, a naxa a fala ɲama bɛ naxan nu biraxi a fɔxɔ ra, «Wo bara a to n naxan nabaxi? Wo fan xa na mɔɔli raba mafuren mafuren.»

sentences.english: So all the people got branches, every man cutting down a branch, and they went with Abimelech at their head and, massing the branches against the inner room, put fire to the room over them; so all those who were in the tower of Shechem, about a thousand men and women, were burned to death with it.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa wuri salonyi keren keren sɛgɛ, e fa bira Abimeleki fɔxɔ ra. E naxa na wurie ti na salide sode dɛ ra, e fa tɛ so, e mixi birin gan. Sikemika wulu keren, ginɛe nun xɛmɛe, naxa sɔntɔ na ki.

sentences.english: Then Abimelech went to Thebez, and put his army in position against Thebez and took it.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Abimeleki naxa siga Tebeti, a xa mɛnnikae gere. A to yonkinde yailan mɛnni, a naxa nɔ Tebeti ra.

sentences.english: But in the middle of the town there was a strong tower, to which all the men and women of the town went in flight and, shutting themselves in, went up to the roof of the tower.
sentences.susu: Makantade itexi nde nu na taa tagi, xɛmɛe nun ginɛe naxa sa e nɔxun mɛnni, a nun taa kuntigie. E naxa na balan e xun ma, e tixi na fari.

sentences.english: And Abimelech came to the tower and made an attack on it, and got near to the door of the tower for the purpose of firing it.
sentences.susu: Abimeleki to mɛnni li, a naxa makɔrɛ a naadɛ ra alako a xa tɛ sa na ma.

sentences.english: But a certain woman sent a great stone, such as is used for crushing grain, on to the head of Abimelech, cracking the bone.
sentences.susu: Na nan lan ginɛ nde naxa mɛngi din se gɛmɛ daaxi sin Abimeleki xunyi, a xunyi naxa bɔɔ.

sentences.english: Then quickly crying out to his body-servant, he said to him, Take out your sword and put an end to me straight away, so that men may not say of me, His death was the work of a woman. So the young man put his sword through him, causing his death.
sentences.susu: Abimeleki naxa a fala a xa fonike bɛ, naxan nu a xa geresose xaninma, a naxɛ, «I xa santidɛgɛma ba a tɛɛ i, i xa n naɲɔn, alako mixi naxa a fala ginɛ nan n faxaxi.» Na kui na fonike naxa a sɔxɔ santidɛgɛma ra, a a faxa.

sentences.english: And when the men of Israel saw that Abimelech was dead, they went away, every man to his place.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xɛmɛe to a to Abimeleki bara faxa, e birin naxa gbilen e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: In this way Abimelech was rewarded by God for the evil he had done to his father in putting his seventy brothers to death;
sentences.susu: Na kui Ala Abimeleki xa wali kobi ragbilen nɛ a ma, a naxan naba a baba ra, a xunya tongo solofere faxafe ra.

sentences.english: And God sent back on to the heads of the men of Shechem all the evil they had done, and the curse of Jotham, the son of Jerubbaal, came on them.
sentences.susu: Ala na tɔɔrɛ birin nagbilen nɛ Sikemikae ma e xa kobiɲa sare ra. Yerubaali xa di xɛmɛ Yotami xa dankɛ naxa e birin nayarabi.

sentences.english: Now after Abimelech, Tola, the son of Puah, the son of Dodo, a man of Issachar, became the saviour of Israel; he was living in Shamir in the hill-country of Ephraim.
sentences.susu: Abimeleki to faxa, Puwa xa di Tola, Dodo xa mamadi, naxan fatanxi Isakari bɔnsɔɛ ra, a naxa keli a xa Isirayila ratanga. A nu sabatixi Samiri nɛ, Efirami geyae fari.

sentences.english: He was judge over Israel for twenty-three years; and at his death his body was put to rest in the earth in Shamir.
sentences.susu: A naxa findi kiitisa ra Isirayila ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan. Na xanbi a naxa faxa, e sa a ragata Samiri.

sentences.english: And after him came Jair the Gileadite, who was judge over Israel for twenty-two years.
sentences.susu: Tola to dangi, Yayiri Galadika naxa keli, a findi Isirayila kiitisa ra ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin.

sentences.english: And he had thirty sons, who went on thirty young asses; and they had thirty towns in the land of Gilead, which are named Havvoth-Jair to this day.
sentences.susu: Di tongo saxan nan nu na a bɛ. E nu ɲɛrɛma sofale tongo saxan nan fari, e nu taa tongo saxan yamarima Galadi bɔxi ma. Han to na taae xili falama Yayiri xa taae.

sentences.english: And at the death of Jair his body was put to rest in the earth in Kamon.
sentences.susu: Yayiri naxa faxa, e sa a ragata Kamon.

sentences.english: And again the children of Israel did evil in the eyes of the Lord, worshipping the Baals and Astartes, and the gods of Aram and the gods of Zidon and the gods of Moab and the gods of the children of Ammon and the gods of the Philistines; they gave up the Lord and were servants to him no longer.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae man naxa fee raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma. E naxa Bali nun Asitarate kuye batu, Aramikae xa alae, Sidɔnkae xa alae, Mowabakae xa alae, Amonikae xa alae, a nun Filisitakae xa alae. E naxa Alatala finsiriwali, e tondi tuubide a bɛ.

sentences.english: And the wrath of the Lord was burning against Israel, and he gave them up into the hands of the Philistines and into the hands of the children of Ammon.
sentences.susu: Alatala bɔɲɛ naxa te Isirayila xili ma, a fa e sa Filisitakae nun Amonikae sagoe.

sentences.english: And that year the children of Israel were crushed under their yoke; for eighteen years all the children of Israel on the other side of Jordan, in the land of the Amorites which is in Gilead, were cruelly crushed down.
sentences.susu: E naxa Isirayilakae tɔɔrɔ, e e ɲaxankata na ɲɛ bun ma. E man naxa Isirayilakae ɲaxankata naxee fan nu sabatixi Yurudɛn naakiri ma, Amonikae xa bɔxi ma, ɲɛ fu nun solomasaxan bun ma.

sentences.english: And the children of Ammon went over Jordan, to make war against Judah and Benjamin and the house of Ephraim; and Israel was in great trouble.
sentences.susu: Amonikae naxa dangi Yurudɛn na, alako e xa sa Yudaya, Bunyamin, nun Efirami fan gere. Isirayila bɔɲɛ tɔɔrɔ nɛ ki fanyi na waxati.

sentences.english: Then the children of Israel, crying out to the Lord, said, Great is our sin against you, for we have given up our God and have been servants to the Baals.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa Alatala xili e xui itexi ra, e nu fa a fala, «Muxu bara yunubi raba i ra, barima muxu bara gbilen muxu Marigi Ala fɔxɔ ra, muxu man bara Bali kuyee batu.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to the children of Israel, Were not the Egyptians and the Amorites and the children of Ammon and the Philistines
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Isirayilakae bɛ, «Misirakae, Amorikae, Amonikae, Filisitakae,

sentences.english: And the Zidonians and Amalek and Midian crushing you down, and in answer to your cry did I not give you salvation from their hands?
sentences.susu: Sidɔnkae, Amalɛkikae, nun Mayonkae to wo tɔɔrɔ, wo naxa n xili wo xui itexi ra. Na tɛmui, n mu wo ba xɛ e sagoe?

sentences.english: But, for all this, you have given me up and have been servants to other gods: so I will be your saviour no longer.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan bara n finisiriwali, wo fa ala gbɛtɛe batu. Na nan a toxi n mu wo ratangama sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Go, send up your cry for help to the gods of your selection; let them be your saviours in the time of your trouble.
sentences.susu: Wo sa sɔnxɔ wo xa alae ra, wo naxee sugandixi. E xa wo ratanga wo xa tɔɔrɛe ma.»

sentences.english: And the children of Israel said to the Lord, We are sinners; do to us whatever seems good to you: only give us salvation this day.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa a masen Alatala bɛ, «Muxu bara yunubi raba. I xa i waxɔnfe raba muxu ra, kɔnɔ yandi i xa muxu rakisi to.»

sentences.english: So they put away the strange gods from among them, and became the Lord's servants; and his soul was angry because of the sorrows of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui e naxa gbilen si gbɛtɛe xa alae fɔxɔ ra, e fa Alatala batu. Alatala nu bara kinikini e ma e xa tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: Then the children of Ammon came together and put their army in position in Gilead. And the children of Israel came together and put their army in position in Mizpah.
sentences.susu: Amonikae naxa e malan, e sa kuru Galadi. Isirayilakae fan naxa e malan, e sa kuru Misipa.

sentences.english: And the people of Israel said to one another, Who will be the first to make an attack on the children of Ammon? We will make him head over all Gilead.
sentences.susu: Galadi ɲama nun mangɛe nu fa a fala e boore bɛ, «Xɛmɛ mundun fama yi gere fɔlɔde Amonikae ma? Na kanyi nan findima Galadikae xa mangɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Now Jephthah the Gileadite was a great man of war; he was the son of a loose woman, and Gilead was his father.
sentences.susu: Yefite Galadika, gereso hagigɛ nan nu na a ra. Langoe ginɛ nde nun Galadi nan ma di nu a ra.

sentences.english: And Gilead's wife gave birth to sons, and when her sons became men, they sent Jephthah away, saying, You have no part in the heritage of our father's house, for you are the son of another woman.
sentences.susu: Galadi xa ginɛ naxa die bari a bɛ. Na ginɛ xa die naxa mɔ, e fa Yefite keri, e a fala a bɛ, «I mu fama muxu baba kɛ sɔtɔde, barima ginɛ gbɛtɛ nan ma di lanxi i ma.»

sentences.english: So Jephthah went in flight from his brothers and was living in the land of Tob, where a number of good-for-nothing men, joining Jephthah, went out with him on his undertakings.
sentences.susu: Yefite naxa keli, a makuya a taarae ra, a sa sabati Tobo bɔxi ma. Mɛnni xɛmɛ rabɛɲinxie naxa lu a fɛ ma, e xa bira a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Now after a time the children of Ammon made war against Israel.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Amonikae to Isirayilakae gere,

sentences.english: And when the children of Ammon made war against Israel, the responsible men of Gilead went to get Jephthah back from the land of Tob;
sentences.susu: Galadi forie naxa siga Yefite fende Tobo bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And they said to Jephthah, Come and be our chief so that we may make war against the children of Ammon.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala Yefite bɛ, «Won xɛɛ, i xa findi muxu xa yarerati ra alako won xa Amonikae gere.»

sentences.english: But Jephthah said to the responsible men of Gilead, Did you not, in your hate for me, send me away from my father's house? Why do you come to me now when you are in trouble?
sentences.susu: Yefite naxa Galadi forie yaabi, «Wo mu n xɔnxi xɛ? Wo mu n keri n baba xa banxi kui? Munfe ra wo n fenma yakɔsi wo xa tɔɔrɛ kui?»

sentences.english: And the responsible men of Gilead said to Jephthah, That is the reason we have come back to you; so go with us and make war against the children of Ammon, and we will make you our head over all the people of Gilead.
sentences.susu: Galadi forie naxa a fala Yefite bɛ, «Na fe yati nan a xɛɛxi muxu faxi i yire yakɔsi, alako won birin xa siga, i xa Amonikae gere, i man xa findi Galadikae birin xa mangɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Then Jephthah said to the responsible men of Gilead, If you take me back to make war against the children of Ammon, and if with the help of the Lord I overcome them, will you make me your head?
sentences.susu: Yefite naxa Galadi forie yaabi, «Xa wo n nagbilen alako n xa Amonikae gere, xa a sa a li Alatala naxa e sa n sagoe, n tan yati nan findima wo xa mangɛ ra.»

sentences.english: And the responsible men of Gilead said to Jephthah, May the Lord be our witness: we will certainly do as you say.
sentences.susu: Galadi forie naxa a fala Yefite bɛ, «Alatala bara findi won seede ra, muxu fama i xa wɔyɛnyi rakamalide.»

sentences.english: So Jephthah went with the responsible men of Gilead, and the people made him head and chief over them; and Jephthah said all these things before the Lord in Mizpah.
sentences.susu: Yefite nun Galadi forie naxa siga, ɲama naxa a findi e xa mangɛ nun e xa sɔɔrie yarerati ra. Yefite naxa gbilen a xa masenyi birin ma Alatala ya i Misipa.

sentences.english: Then Jephthah sent men to the king of the children of Ammon, saying, What have you against me that you have come to make war against my land?
sentences.susu: Yefite naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Amonikae xa mangɛ xɔn, e xa a fala a bɛ, «Munfe ra i faxi n gerede n ma bɔxi ma?»

sentences.english: And the king of the children of Ammon said to the men sent by Jephthah, Because Israel, when he came up out of Egypt, took away my land, from the Arnon as far as the Jabbok and as far as Jordan: so now, give me back those lands quietly.
sentences.susu: Amonikae xa mangɛ naxa Yefite xa xɛɛrae yaabi, «Isirayilakae to keli Misira, e naxa n ma bɔxi birin tongo fɔlɔfe Arinon xure ma, sa dɔxɔ Yaboko xure ra, han Yurudɛn xure. I xa na ragbilen n ma lanyi kui.»

sentences.english: And Jephthah sent again to the king of the children of Ammon,
sentences.susu: Yefite man naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Amonikae xa mangɛ xɔn.

sentences.english: And said to him, This is the word of Jephthah: Israel did not take away the land of Moab or the land of the children of Ammon;
sentences.susu: E xa a fala a bɛ, «Yefite wɔyɛn xui nan yi ki. Isirayilakae mu Mowaba bɔxi nun Amoni bɔxi yo tongoxi.

sentences.english: But when they came up from Egypt, Israel went through the waste land to the Red Sea and came to Kadesh;
sentences.susu: Isirayila ɲama to keli Misira bɔxi ma, e naxa e ɲɛrɛ gbengberenyi ma han Xulunyumi Baa, e fa so Kadesi.

sentences.english: Then Israel sent men to the king of Edom saying, Let me now go through your land; but the king of Edom did not give ear to them. And in the same way he sent to the king of Moab, but he would not; so Israel went on living in Kadesh.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isirayila naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Edon mangɛ xɔn, e xa a fala a bɛ, ‹A lu muxu xa dangi i xa bɔxi ma.› Kɔnɔ Edon mangɛ mu tin na ra fefe ma. E naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Mowaba mangɛ fan xɔn. A naxa tondi, Isirayilakae fa lu Kadesi.»

sentences.english: Then he went on through the waste land and round the land of Edom and the land of Moab, and came by the east side of the land of Moab, and put up their tents on the other side of the Arnon; they did not come inside the limit of Moab, for the Arnon was the limit of Moab.
sentences.susu: «Na dangi xanbi, e naxa Edon bɔxi nun Mowaba bɔxi mabilin gbengberenyi ma. E e ɲɛrɛ Mowaba bɔxi sogetede biri, han e Arinon xure igiri. Na kui e mu soxi Mowaba bɔxi ma, barima Arinon findixi Mowaba xa naaninyi nan na.

sentences.english: And Israel sent men to Sihon, king of the Amorites, the king of Heshbon; and Israel said to him, Let me now go through your land to my place.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isirayilakae naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Sixɔn xɔn, Amorikae xa mangɛ naxan nu na Xɛsibɔn. Isirayilakae naxa a fala a bɛ, ‹A lu muxu xa mini i xa bɔxi ra, muxu xa siga muxu xa bɔxi ma Ala naxan sugandixi muxu bɛ.›

sentences.english: But Sihon would not give way and let Israel go through his land; and Sihon got together all his people, and put his army in position in Jahaz, and made war on Israel.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Sixɔn mu tin Isirayilakae xa mini a xa bɔxi ra. A naxa a xa ɲama birin malan, e naxa kuru Yahasi, e Isirayila gere.

sentences.english: And the Lord, the God of Israel, gave Sihon and all his people into the hands of Israel, and they overcame them; so all the land of the Amorites, the people of that land, became Israel's.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Alatala naxa Sixɔn nun a xa ɲama sa Isirayila sagoe. Isirayilakae naxa nɔ e ra, e fa sabati Amorikae xa bɔxi birin ma,

sentences.english: All the limit of the Amorites was theirs, from the Arnon as far as the Jabbok and from the waste land even to Jordan.
sentences.susu: fɔlɔfe Arinon xure ma, sa dɔxɔ Yaboko xure ra, fɔlɔfe gbengberenyi ma, sa dɔxɔ Yurudɛn na.»

sentences.english: So now the Lord, the God of Israel, has taken away their land from the Amorites and given it to his people Israel; are you then to have it?
sentences.susu: «Isirayila Marigi Alatala bara Amorikae xa bɔxi fi muxu ma, i tan wama na bɔxi bafe muxu yi munfe ra?

sentences.english: Do you not keep the lands of those whom Chemosh your god sends out from before you? So we will keep all the lands of those whom the Lord our God sends out from before us.
sentences.susu: I xa ala Kemosi, a bɔxi naxan soxi i yi ra, i mu i wasasoma nɛ? Muxu fan, muxu Marigi Alatala bɔxi naxan birin soxi muxu yi ra, muxu na suxuma nɛ.

sentences.english: What! are you any better than Balak, the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever take up a cause against Israel or make war against them?
sentences.susu: I ɲɔxɔ a ma i sɛnbɛ dangixi nɛ Balaki ra, Siporo xa di, Mowaba mangɛ? Na tan mu tin Isirayila gerede fefe ma.

sentences.english: While Israel was living in Heshbon and its daughter-towns and in Aroer and its daughter-towns and in all the towns which are by the side of the Arnon, for three hundred years, why did you not get them back at that time?
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ kɛmɛ saxan nan yi ki, Isirayila sabatixi Xɛsibɔn nun a rabilinyie, Aroweri nun a rabilinyie, a nun taa birin naxee na Arinon xure dɛ ra. Munfe ra wo mu e rasuxu na waxati bun ma?

sentences.english: So I have done no wrong against you, but you are doing wrong to me in fighting against me: may the Lord, who is Judge this day, be judge between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.
sentences.susu: N tan mu haakɛ yo rabaxi i ra. I tan nan fe ɲaaxi rabafe n na, gere tife n bɛ. Alatala, kiitisa xungbe, a xa Isirayilakae nun Amonikae makiiti to lɔxɔɛ.»

sentences.english: The king of the children of Ammon, however, did not give ear to the words which Jephthah sent to him.
sentences.susu: Amonikae xa mangɛ mu tin a tuli matide Yefite xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: Then the spirit of the Lord came on Jephthah, and he went through Gilead and Manasseh, and came to Mizpeh of Gilead; and from Mizpeh of Gilead he went over to the children of Ammon.
sentences.susu: Alatala Xaxili naxa goro Yefite ma. Yefite naxa Galadi nun Manasi igiri. A naxa dangi Misipa ra Galadi bɔxi ma. A naxa siga han Amonikae xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Jephthah took an oath to the Lord, and said, If you will give the children of Ammon into my hands,
sentences.susu: Yefite naxa laayidi tongo Alatala bɛ, a a fala a bɛ, «Xa i sa Amonikae birin sa n sagoe,

sentences.english: Then whoever comes out from the door of my house, meeting me when I come back in peace from the children of Ammon, will be the Lord's and I will give him as a burned offering.
sentences.susu: naxan singe na mini n ma banxi naadɛ ra fafe n nalande, n nɛ gbilenma kelife ra Amonikae xa bɔxi ma sɛɛwɛ kui tɛmui naxɛ, na kanyi bama sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nan na Marigi Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: So Jephthah went over to the children of Ammon to make war on them; and the Lord gave them into his hands.
sentences.susu: Yefite naxa siga Amonikae xa bɔxi ma e gerede. Alatala naxa e sa a sago.

sentences.english: And he made an attack on them from Aroer all the way to Minnith, overrunning twenty towns, as far as Abel-cheramim, and put great numbers to the sword. So the children of Ammon were crushed before the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: A naxa e bɔnbɔ a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra fɔlɔ Aroweri ma, sa dɔxɔ Miniti biri ra, taa mɔxɔɲɛn, han Habila Keramimi. Amonikae naxa lu yaagi kui Isirayilakae ya i.

sentences.english: Then Jephthah came back to his house in Mizpah, and his daughter came out, meeting him on his way with music and with dances; she was his only child; he had no other sons or daughters.
sentences.susu: Yefite naxa gbilen Misipa. A to a xɔnyi li, a xa di ginɛ naxa mini a ralande. A nu fare boronma maxasee xui ra. A xa di kerenyi nan nu a ra, di xɛmɛ mu nu na, di ginɛ gbɛtɛ fan mu nu na a bɛ.

sentences.english: And when he saw her he was overcome with grief, and said, Ah! my daughter! I am crushed with sorrow, and it is you who are the chief cause of my trouble; for I have made an oath to the Lord and I may not take it back.
sentences.susu: A fɛfɛ a xa di ginɛ to, a naxa a xa donmae ibɔɔ, a a fala, «N ma di ginɛ, i bara n naso tɔɔrɛ xungbe kui, i bara a niya n xa sunnun a ɲaaxi ra. N bara laayidi tongo Alatala bɛ, n mu nɔma gbilende na ma sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: And she said to him, My father, you have made an oath to the Lord; do then to me whatever you have said; for the Lord has sent a full reward on your haters, on the children of Ammon.
sentences.susu: A xa di ginɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «N baba, i laayidi naxan tongo Alatala bɛ, i xa na rakamali. I naxan fala Alatala bɛ, i xa na raba n na, barima Alatala bara i gbeɲɔxɔ i yaxui Amonikae ma.»

sentences.english: Then she said to her father, Only do this for me: let me have two months to go away into the mountains with my friends, weeping for my sad fate.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a fala a baba bɛ, «I xa fe keren naba n bɛ. I xa mamɛ ti kike firin alako n xa siga geyae fari, a nun n booree, muxu xa wa ti barima n mu fama dɔxɔde xɛmɛ xɔn.»

sentences.english: And he said, Go then. So he sent her away for two months; and she went with her friends to the mountains, weeping for her sad fate.
sentences.susu: A baba naxa a yaabi, «Siga.» A naxa a xa di ginɛ mamɛ kike firin. A nun a booree naxa siga wa tide geyae fari, barima a mu fama dɔxɔde xɛmɛ xɔn.

sentences.english: And at the end of two months she went back to her father, who did with her as he had said in his oath: and she had never been touched by a man. So it became a rule in Israel,
sentences.susu: Na kike firinyie raɲɔnyi, a naxa gbilen a baba yire. A baba naxa a xa laayidi tongoxi rakamali. A xa di mu nu xɛmɛ fe kolonxi. Na nan a toxi Isirayilakae naxa yi naamunyi ramini:

sentences.english: For the women to go year by year sorrowing for the daughter of Jephthah the Gileadite, four days in every year.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ birin Isirayila ginɛdimɛdie Yefite Galadika xa di ginɛ xa kinikini rabama nɛ xi naani, alako e xa ratu a xa fe ma.

sentences.english: Now the men of Ephraim came together and took up arms and went over to Zaphon; and they said to Jephthah, Why did you go over to make war against the children of Ammon without sending for us to go with you? Now we will put your house on fire over you.
sentences.susu: Efirami xɛmɛe naxa e malan, e Yurudɛn igiri. E to Sefon li, e naxa a fala Yefite bɛ, «Munfe ra i sigaxi Amonikae gerede, i mu muxu xili alako won birin xa siga? Muxu fama tɛ nan sade i xa banxi ma, wo birin xa gan.»

sentences.english: And Jephthah said to them, I and my people were in danger, and the children of Ammon were very cruel to us, and when I sent for you, you gave me no help against them.
sentences.susu: Yefite naxa e yaabi, «N tan nun n ma ɲama, nu na lantareya belebele nan kui yi ki, muxu nun Amonikae ra. N wo maxili tɛmui naxɛ, wo mu tin fade n bade e sagoe.

sentences.english: So when I saw that there was no help to be had from you, I put my life in my hand and went over against the children of Ammon, and the Lord gave them into my hands: why then have you come up to me this day to make war on me?
sentences.susu: N to a to wo mu fafe n natangade, n naxa te Amonikae gerede, hali na to findi fe xɔrɔxɔɛ ra n bɛ. Alatala naxa e sa n sago. Wo faxi n gerede munfe ra?»

sentences.english: Then Jephthah got together all the men of Gilead and made war on Ephraim; and the men of Gilead overcame Ephraim.
sentences.susu: Yefite naxa Galadi xɛmɛe birin malan, e xa Efiramikae gere. Galadi xɛmɛe naxa Efiramikae bɔnbɔ, barima e nu bara a fala, «Wo tan Galadikae, wo wo gixi nɛ kelife Efirami, wo siga Manasi bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And the Gileadites took the crossing-places of Jordan against the Ephraimites; and when any of the men of Ephraim who had gone in flight said, let me go over; the men of Gilead said to him, Are you an Ephraimite? And if he said, No;
sentences.susu: Na gere dangi xanbi, Galadikae naxa ti Yurudɛn xure igiride ra gbilenfe ra Efirami bɔxi ma. Efiramika nde na wa gbilenfe a xɔnyi kelife gere yire, fo a xa a fala na Galadikae bɛ, «N wama Yurudɛn igirife.» Galadikae na kanyi maxɔrinma nɛ, «Efiramika nan na i ra?» A na e yaabi, «Ade,»

sentences.english: Then they said to him, Now say Shibboleth; and he said Sibboleth, and was not able to say it in the right way; then they took him and put him to death at the crossing-places of Jordan; and at that time forty-two thousand Ephraimites were put to death.
sentences.susu: Galadikae man a falama a bɛ, «Awa, a fala ba ‹Xiboleti›.» Efiramikae to mu fata na falade, e tan nu a falama nɛ, «Kiboleti.» Na kui Galadikae a kolonma na kanyi findixi Efiramika nan na naxan wama a gife. E a kɔn naxabama keren na mɛnni Yurudɛn xure igiride ra. Efiramika mixi wulu tongo naani nun firin sɔntɔ na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Now Jephthah was judge of Israel for six years. And Jephthah the Gileadite came to his death, and his body was put to rest in his town, Mizpeh of Gilead.
sentences.susu: Yefite Galadika naxa findi Isirayila kiitisa ra ɲɛ senni bun ma. A to faxa, a naxa ragata Galadi taae tagi.

sentences.english: And after him, Ibzan of Beth-lehem was judge of Israel.
sentences.susu: Yefite dangi xanbi, Ibisan Bɛtɛlɛɛmuka naxa findi kiitisa ra Isirayila.

sentences.english: He had thirty sons, and thirty daughters whom he sent to other places, and he got thirty wives from other places for his sons. And he was judge of Israel for seven years.
sentences.susu: A naxa di xɛmɛ tongo saxan nun di ginɛ tongo saxan bari. A naxa a xa di ginɛe fi bɔnsɔɛ gbɛtɛ xɛmɛe ma. A man naxa ginɛ tongo saxan fan fen bɔnsɔɛ gbɛtɛe ra a xa di xɛmɛe bɛ. A naxa findi Isirayila kiitisa ra ɲɛ solofere bun ma.

sentences.english: And Ibzan came to his death and his body was put to rest at Beth-lehem.
sentences.susu: Ibisan to faxa, a naxa ragata Bɛtɛlɛɛmu.

sentences.english: And after him, Elon the Zebulonite was judge of Israel; and he was judge of Israel for ten years.
sentences.susu: Ibisan dangi xanbi, Elon Sabulonka naxa findi kiitisa ra Isirayila bɔxi ma ɲɛ fu bun ma.

sentences.english: And Elon the Zebulonite came to his death, and his body was put to rest in Aijalon in the land of Zebulun.
sentences.susu: A to faxa, a naxa ragata Ayalon, Sabulon bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And after him, Abdon, the son of Hillel, the Pirathonite, was judge of Israel.
sentences.susu: Ibisan dangi xanbi, Hileli xa di Abadon Piratonka naxa findi kiitisa ra Isirayila.

sentences.english: He had forty sons and thirty sons' sons who went on seventy young asses; and he was judge of Israel for eight years.
sentences.susu: A naxa di tongo naani nun mamadi tongo saxan sɔtɔ, e te sofale tongo solofere fari. A naxa findi Isirayila kiitisa ra ɲɛ solomasaxan bun ma.

sentences.english: And Abdon, the son of Hillel, came to his death, and his body was put to rest in Pirathon in the land of Ephraim, in the hill-country of the Amalekites.
sentences.susu: Hileli xa di Abadon Piratonka to faxa, a naxa ragata Piraton Efirami bɔxi ma, Amalɛkikae xa geya fari.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel again did evil in the eyes of the Lord; and the Lord gave them into the hands of the Philistines for forty years.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae man naxa fe ɲaaxi raba Alatala ya i. Na nan a toxi Alatala naxa e lu Filisitakae sagoe ɲɛ tongo naani bun ma.

sentences.english: Now there was a certain man of Zorah of the family of the Danites, and his name was Manoah; and his wife had never given birth to a child.
sentences.susu: Dana bɔnsɔɛ mixi nde nu na Soraha naxan xili Manowa. Dibaritare nan nu a xa ginɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the angel of the Lord came to the woman, and said to her, See now! though you have never given birth to children, you will be with child and give birth to a son.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa mini na ginɛ ma, a fa a fala a bɛ, «Hali dibaritare to i ra, i fama tɛgɛde, i fa di xɛmɛ bari.

sentences.english: Now then take care to have no wine or strong drink and to take no unclean thing for food;
sentences.susu: I naxa sese min naxan nɔma i siiside. I naxa sese don naxan mu sɛniyɛnxi,

sentences.english: For you are with child and will give birth to a son; his hair is never to be cut, for the child is to be separate to God from his birth; and he will take up the work of freeing Israel from the hands of the Philistines.
sentences.susu: barima i fama tɛgɛde, i di xɛmɛ bari. I naxa a xunyi bi, barima yi di fixi Ala nan ma beenu a xa bari. Na kui a xili ‹Ala xa Nasari.› A tan nan Isirayilakae rakisi fɔlɔma Filisitakae ma.»

sentences.english: Then the woman came in, and said to her husband, A man came to me, and his form was like the form of a god, causing great fear; I put no question to him about where he came from, and he did not give me his name;
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ naxa siga, a sa a fala a xa mɔri bɛ, «Ala xa mixi nde bara fa n yire, a luxi n bɛ alɔ Ala xa malekɛ. A magaaxu. N mu a maxɔrin a kelixi dɛnnaxɛ, a fan mu a xili fala n bɛ.

sentences.english: But he said to me, You are with child and will give birth to a son; and now do not take any wine or strong drink or let anything unclean be your food; for the child will be separate to God from his birth to the day of his death.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen n bɛ, ‹I fama tɛgɛde, i fa di xɛmɛ bari. I naxa sese min naxan nɔma i siiside. I naxa sese don naxan mu sɛniyɛnxi, barima yi di fixi Ala nan ma beenu a xa bari, han a laaxirama tɛmui naxɛ. Ala xa Nasari na a ra.›»

sentences.english: Then Manoah made prayer to the Lord, and said, O Lord, let the man of God whom you sent come to us again and make clear to us what we are to do for the child who is to come.
sentences.susu: Manowa naxa Alatala maxandi yi ki, «N Marigi, i man xa i xa mixi xɛɛ muxu xɔn ma alako a xa muxu xaran na di xuru ki ra.»

sentences.english: And God gave ear to the voice of Manoah; and the angel of God came to the woman again when she was seated in the field; but her husband Manoah was not with her.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa Manowa xa dubɛ suxu, a man naxa a xa malekɛ xɛɛ a xa ginɛ xɔn ma. Manowa xa ginɛ nu dɔxɔxi xɛ ma a xa mɔri mu nu na naa.

sentences.english: So the woman, running quickly, gave her husband the news, saying, I have seen the man who came to me the other day.
sentences.susu: A to a to, a naxa a gi keren na, a sa a fala a xa mɔri bɛ, «Xɛmɛ naxan fa n yire, a man bara fa.»

sentences.english: And Manoah got up and went after his wife, and came up to the man and said to him, Are you the man who was talking to this woman? And he said, I am.
sentences.susu: Manowa naxa keli, a bira a xa ginɛ fɔxɔ ra. A to na xɛmɛ li, a naxa a maxɔrin, «I tan nan wɔyɛn n ma ginɛ ra?» A naxa a yaabi, «Iyo.»

sentences.english: And Manoah said, Now when your words come true, what is to be the rule for the child and what will be his work?
sentences.susu: Manowa man naxa a maxɔrin, «I xa masenyi na kamali tɛmui naxɛ, a lanma muxu xa na di xuru di?»

sentences.english: And the angel of the Lord said to Manoah, Let the woman take note of what I have said to her.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa a yaabi, «I xa ginɛ xa a raba alɔ n a fala a bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: She is to have nothing which comes from the vine for her food, and let her take no wine or strong drink or anything which is unclean; let her take care to do all I have given her orders to do.
sentences.susu: A naxa wɛni sansi bogi yo don, a naxa wɛni nun a maniyɛ min, a naxa donse sɛniyɛntare don. A xa na birin naba alɔ n a fala a bɛ ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And Manoah said to the angel of the Lord, Now let us keep you while we make ready a young goat for you.
sentences.susu: Manowa naxa a fala Alatala xa malekɛ bɛ, «I xa lu be sinden, muxu xa si ɲin i bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the angel of the Lord said to Manoah, Though you keep me I will not take of your food; but if you will make a burned offering, let it be offered to the Lord. For it had not come into Manoah's mind that he was the angel of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa a yaabi, «Hali n lu be, n mu i xa donse donma, kɔnɔ xa i wama sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi tan bafe Alatala bɛ, na fan.» Manowa mu nu a kolon Alatala xa malekɛ nan a ra.

sentences.english: Then Manoah said to the angel of the Lord, What is your name, so that when your words come true we may give you honour?
sentences.susu: Manowa naxa a maxɔrin, «I xili di? Muxu xa na kolon alako muxu xa i matɔxɔ i xa masenyi kamalima tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: But the angel of the Lord said to him, Why are you questioning me about my name, seeing that it is a wonder?
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «I wama n xili kolonfe munfe ra? Gundo nan a ra.»

sentences.english: So Manoah took the young goat with its meal offering, offering it on the rock to the Lord, who did strange things.
sentences.susu: Manowa naxa na si nun farin nde ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra fanye nde fari Alatala bɛ. Na tɛmui kaabanako nde naxa raba e ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And when the flame went up to heaven from the altar, the angel of the Lord went up in the flame of the altar, while Manoah and his wife were looking on; and they went down on their faces to the earth.
sentences.susu: Na tɛ nu na tefe koore ma tɛmui naxɛ, Alatala xa malekɛ fan naxa te koore ma na tɛ kui. Manowa nun a xa ginɛ to na to, e naxa e felen bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: But the angel of the Lord was seen no more by Manoah and his wife. Then it was clear to Manoah that he was the angel of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ to siga, Manowa nun a xa ginɛ mu nu a to sɔnɔn. E naxa a kolon Alatala xa malekɛ yati yati nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: And Manoah said to his wife, Death will certainly be our fate, for it is a god whom we have seen.
sentences.susu: Manowa naxa a fala a xa ginɛ bɛ, «Won fama faxade ya barima won bara Ala yati yati to.»

sentences.english: But his wife said to him, If the Lord was purposing our death, he would not have taken our burned offering and our meal offering, or have given us such orders about the child.
sentences.susu: A xa ginɛ naxa a yaabi, «Xa Alatala wama won faxafe nu, a mu won ma sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi suxuma nu, a mu na kaabanako masenma won bɛ nu.»

sentences.english: So the woman gave birth to a son, and gave him the name Samson; and he became a man and the blessing of the Lord was on him.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Manowa xa ginɛ naxa di bari. E naxa a xili fala Samison. A naxa mɔ Alatala xa barakɛ kui.

sentences.english: And the spirit of the Lord first came on him in Mahaneh-dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
sentences.susu: Alatala Xaxili naxa goro Samison ma a singe ra Maxane Dana, taa naxan na Soraha nun Esetayoli tagi.

sentences.english: Now Samson went down to Timnah, and saw a woman in Timnah, of the daughters of the Philistines;
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Samison naxa siga Timina. Mɛnni a naxa sungbutunyi Filisitaka nde to.

sentences.english: And when he came back he said to his father and mother, I have seen a woman in Timnah, of the daughters of the Philistines: get her now for me for my wife.
sentences.susu: A to gbilen a baba xɔnyi, a naxa a fala a baba nun a nga bɛ, «N bara Filisitaka sungbutunyi nde to Timina. Wo xa na fen n bɛ a xa findi n ma ginɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Then his father and mother said to him, Is there no woman among the daughters of your relations or among all my people, that you have to go for your wife to the Philistines, who are without circumcision? But Samson said to his father, Get her for me, for she is pleasing to me.
sentences.susu: A baba nun a nga naxa a fala a bɛ, «Munfe ra i mu ginɛ fen i ngaxakerenyie ya ma, xa na mu a ra won bɔnsɔɛ ya ma? Na mu fisa Filisitaka nde bɛ, na ɲama sunnatare?» Samison naxa a baba yaabi, «Na fen n bɛ. A tan nan nafan n ma.»

sentences.english: Now his father and mother had no knowledge that this was the purpose of the Lord, who had the destruction of the Philistines in mind. Now the Philistines at that time were ruling over Israel.
sentences.susu: A baba nun a nga mu nu a kolon na birin kelixi Alatala nan ma. A nu na gere fenfe Filisitakae ra, barima na waxati e nu na Isirayilakae yamarife.

sentences.english: Then Samson went down to Timnah (and his father and his mother,) and came to the vine-gardens of Timnah; and a young lion came rushing out at him.
sentences.susu: Samison nun a baba nun a nga naxa goro Timina. E to wɛni bilie yire li, yɛtɛ nde naxa mini Samison ma, a xa a faxa.

sentences.english: And the spirit of the Lord came on him with power, and, unarmed as he was, pulling the lion in two as one might do to a young goat, he put him to death; (but he said nothing to his father and mother of what he had done.)
sentences.susu: Alatala Xaxili naxa goro a ma alako a xa nɔ yɛtɛ ibɔɔde a bɛlɛxɛ ra alɔ si yɔrɛ, hali geresose yo to mu nu na a yi ra. A mu na fe fala a baba nun a nga bɛ.

sentences.english: So he went down and had talk with the woman; and she was pleasing to Samson.
sentences.susu: E naxa siga wɔyɛnde na sungbutunyi ra, naxan bara rafan Samison ma ki fanyi.

sentences.english: Then after a time he went back to take her; and turning from the road to see the dead body of the lion, he saw a mass of bees in the body of the lion, and honey there.
sentences.susu: Na biyaasi dangi xanbi, Samison naxa gbilen Timina na sungbutunyi yire, a xa a findi a xa ginɛ ra. Beenun a xa a li, a naxa mini kira ra, alako a xa na yɛtɛ binbinyi mato. A naxa kumi tɛɛ li naa, e ture na yɛtɛ xɔrie longori ra.

sentences.english: And he took the honey in his hand, and went on, tasting it on the way; and when he came to his father and mother he gave some to them; but did not say that he had taken the honey from the body of the lion.
sentences.susu: A naxa nde tongo a bɛlɛxɛ ra, a xa a kɔn kira xɔn ma. A to gbilen a bari mixie yire, a naxa nde fi nee fan ma. E naxa a kɔn, kɔnɔ Samison mu a fala e bɛ na kumi kelixi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Then Samson went down to the woman, and made a feast there, as was the way among young men.
sentences.susu: Samison baba fan naxa goro na sungbutunyi xɔnyi. Na tɛmui Samison naxa xulunyi ti naa, alɔ sɛgɛtalae darixi a ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And he took thirty friends, and they were with him.
sentences.susu: Na sungbutunyi xa mixie to Samison to, e naxa mixi tongo saxan xili naxan luma a sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And Samson said, Now I have a hard question for you: if you are able to give me the answer before the seven days of the feast are over, I will give you thirty linen robes and thirty changes of clothing;
sentences.susu: Samison naxa a fala e bɛ, «N xa taali nde sa wo bun ma. Xa wo nɔ na tagi rabade n bɛ beenu yi xulunyi xi solofere xa ba a ra, n donma nun dugi tongo saxan fima wo ma.

sentences.english: But if you are not able to give me the answer, then you will have to give me thirty linen robes and thirty changes of clothing. And they said to him, Put your hard question and let us see what it is.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa wo mu nɔ n ma taali tagi rabade n bɛ, wo keren keren ma birin donma nun dugi tofanyi fima n tan nan ma.» E naxa a fala a bɛ, «Awa yire, i xa taali fala. Muxu muxu tuli matixi i ra.»

sentences.english: And he said, Out of the taker of food came food, and out of the strong came the sweet. And at the end of three days they were still not able to give the answer.
sentences.susu: Na kui a naxa taali nde fala e bɛ, «Naxan se donma, a donse raminima. Se ɲɔxunmɛ kelixi sɛnbɛma nan ma.» E naxa na taali fen xi saxan bun ma, kɔnɔ e mu nɔ na kolonde.

sentences.english: So on the fourth day they said to Samson's wife, Get from your husband the answer to his question by some trick or other, or we will have you and your father's house burned with fire; did you get us here to take all we have?
sentences.susu: A xi naani nde, e naxa a fala Samison xa ginɛ bɛ, «Wɔyɛn i xa mɔri bɛ alako a xa na taali tagi raba muxu bɛ, xa na mu a ra muxu fama i tan nun i baba xa denbaya gande. A mu lanma wo xa muxu xili be, wo xa fa muxu muɲa.»

sentences.english: Then Samson's wife, weeping over him, said, Truly you have no love for me but only hate; you have put a hard question to the children of my people and have not given me the answer. And he said to her, See, I have not given the answer even to my father or my mother; am I to give it to you?
sentences.susu: Samison xa ginɛ naxa wa fɔlɔ a xa mɔri ya i, a a fala a bɛ, «N mu rafan i ma. I bara n xɔn, xa na mu a ra i na taali tagi rabama nɛ n bɛ nu.» A naxa a yaabi, «N mu naxan fala n nga nun n baba bɛ, n na falama i tan nan bɛ?»

sentences.english: And all the seven days of the feast she went on weeping over him; and on the seventh day he gave her the answer, because she gave him no peace; and she sent word of it to the children of her people.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ naxa wa Samison ya i xi solofere bun ma, na xulunyi tɛmui. Xulunyi lɔxɔɛ dɔnxɔɛ a naxa na taali tagi raba a xa ginɛ bɛ, barima a nu na a tɔɔrɔfe tun. Na tɛmui na ginɛ naxa na taali tagi raba a xa mixie bɛ.

sentences.english: Then on the seventh day, before he went into the bride's room, the men of the town said to him, What is sweeter than honey? and what is stronger than a lion? And he said to them, If you had not been ploughing with my cow you would not have got the answer to my question.
sentences.susu: Beenun soge dula tɛmui xi solofere nde, taakae naxa Samison xa taali fasari a bɛ yi maxɔrinyi ra, «Munse ɲɔxun kumi bɛ, munse sɛnbɛ gbo yɛtɛ bɛ?» Samison naxa e yaabi, «Xa wo mu n ma ginɛ mafuruku nu, wo mu nɔma n ma taali kui kolonde feo.»

sentences.english: And the spirit of the Lord came rushing on him, and he went down to Ashkelon and, attacking thirty men there, took their clothing from them, and gave it to the men who had given the answer to his hard question. Then, full of wrath, he went back to his father's house.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Alatala Xaxili naxa goro Samison ma. A naxa siga Asikalɔn, a xɛmɛ tongo saxan faxa, a e xa donmae nun dugie tongo, a nee fi mixie ma naxee nu bara na taali tagi raba a bɛ. Na tɛmui Samison naxa gbilen a baba xɔnyi, a xɔnɔxi a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: But Samson's wife was given to the friend who had been his best man.
sentences.susu: Na kui Filisitakae naxa Samison xa ginɛ fi xɛmɛ gbɛtɛ ma, xulunyi binyɛ fixi naxan ma.

sentences.english: Now a short time after, at the time of the grain-cutting, Samson, taking with him a young goat, went to see his wife; and he said, I will go in to my wife into the bride's room. But her father would not let him go in.
sentences.susu: Xɛ xaba tɛmui, Samison naxa si xanin a xa ginɛ xɔn. A naxa a fala a bitanyi bɛ, «A xɔli n ma n tan nun n ma ginɛ xa lu yire keren.» A bitanyi mu tin na ra,

sentences.english: And her father said, It seemed to me that you had only hate for her; so I gave her to your friend: but is not her younger sister fairer than she? so please take her in place of the other.
sentences.susu: a fa a fala Samison bɛ, «N ɲɔxɔ a ma i mɛɛxi a ra nɛ, na nan a ra, n bara a fi na xɛmɛ ma i xa xulunyi binyɛ fi naxan ma. I xa a xunya dɔxɔ, na fan a bɛ pon.»

sentences.english: Then Samson said to them, This time I will give payment in full to the Philistines, for I am going to do them great evil.
sentences.susu: Samison naxa a yaabi, «Yi biyaasi, xa n fe ɲaaxi raba wo tan Filisitakae ra, wo tan nan a niyaxi.»

sentences.english: So Samson went and got three hundred foxes and some sticks of fire-wood; and he put the foxes tail to tail with a stick between every two tails;
sentences.susu: A naxa siga, a xulumase kɛmɛ saxan suxu. A naxa nee xuli xiri e boore ra firin firin na, a sɛxɛ maxiri e xulie ra.

sentences.english: Then firing the sticks, he let the foxes loose among the uncut grain of the Philistines, and all the corded stems as well as the living grain and the vine-gardens and the olives went up in flames.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛxɛ radɛxɛ naxan nu maxirixi e xulie ra, a e rabɛɲin Filisitakae xa xɛe ma. Tɛ naxa xɛe birin gan, sansi naxan nu kotoxi xɛe ma, a nun sansi naxan mu nu xabaxi sinden. Hali oliwi bili naxee nu na mɛnni, e fan gan nɛ.

sentences.english: Then the Philistines said, Who has done this? And they said, Samson, the son-in-law of the Timnite, because he took his wife and gave her to his friend. So the Philistines came up and had her and her father's house burned.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa e booree maxɔrin, «Nde yi wali rabaxi?» Mixi ndee naxa e yaabi, «Samison fɔxi nan a ra, barima a bitanyi Timinaka bara a xa ginɛ fi xɛmɛ ma, a tan Samison xa xulunyi binyɛ fi naxan ma.» Na kui Filisitakae naxa siga na ginɛ nun a baba gande.

sentences.english: And Samson said to them, If you go on like this, truly I will take my full payment from you; and that will be the end of it.
sentences.susu: Samison naxa a fala e bɛ, «Xa wo a raba na ki, n fan n gbeɲɔxɔma nɛ wo ma.»

sentences.english: And he made an attack on them, driving them in uncontrolled flight, and causing great destruction; then he went away to his safe place in the crack of the rock at Etam.
sentences.susu: A naxa e gere a ɲaaxi ra, a mixi gbegbe faxa. Na xanbi, a naxa siga, a lu fɔnmɛ kui Etami geya mabiri.

sentences.english: Then the Philistines went and put up their tents in Judah, all round Lehi.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa sɔɔrie xɛɛ Yudaya Lexi mabiri.

sentences.english: And the men of Judah said, Why have you come up against us? And they said, We have come up to take Samson, and to do to him as he has done to us.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo faxi muxu gerede munfe ra?» E naxa e yaabi, «Muxu faxi Samison nan suxude, muxu xa fe ɲaaxi raba a ra alɔ a a rabaxi muxu ra ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Then three thousand of the men of Judah went down to the crack of the rock of Etam, and said to Samson, Is it not clear to you that the Philistines are our rulers? What is this you have done to us? And he said to them, I only did to them as they did to me.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae xɛmɛ wulu saxan naxa siga Samison fɔxɔ ra Etami geya yire. E naxa a fala a bɛ, «I munse rabaxi muxu ra yi ki? I mu a kolon won na Filisitakae xa yaamari nan bun ma?» Samison naxa e yaabi, «N e xa fe ɲaaxi nan tun sare ragbilenxi e ma.»

sentences.english: Then they said to him, We have come down to take you and give you up into the hands of the Philistines. And Samson said to them, Give me your oath that you will not make an attack on me yourselves.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae naxa a fala a bɛ, «Muxu faxi be i xiride nɛ, muxu xa i so e yi ra.» Samison naxa a fala e bɛ «Wo xa wo rakali xa wo tan mu fama n faxade.»

sentences.english: And they said, No; we will take you and give you up into their hands, but truly we will not put you to death. So knotting two new cords round him they took him up from the rock.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala a bɛ, «Won bara lan na ma. Muxu mu i faxama. Muxu xa i xiri, muxu xa i so Filisitakae yi ra tun.» E naxa a xiri luuti nɛɛnɛ firin na, e a xanin.

sentences.english: And when he came to Lehi, the Philistines came out, meeting him with loud cries; then the spirit of the Lord came rushing on him, and the cords on his arms became like grass which has been burned with fire, and the bands came falling off his hands.
sentences.susu: E to Lexi li, Filisitakae naxa sɔnxɔɛ rate. Alatala Xaxili naxa goro Samison ma, a na luutie bolon alɔ gɛsɛ ganxi bolonma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And taking up the mouth-bone of an ass newly dead, which he saw by chance on the earth, he put to death a thousand men with it.
sentences.susu: A naxa sofale banganyi xɔri nde tongo bɔxi ma, a Filisitakae mixi wulu keren faxa na ra.

sentences.english: And Samson said, With a red ass's mouth-bone I have made them red with blood, with a red ass's mouth-bone I have sent destruction on a thousand men.
sentences.susu: Samison naxa a fala, «N bara sofale banganyi xɔri sɔtɔ, sofale keren sofale gbegbe ya ma. N bara xɛmɛ wulu keren faxa sofale banganyi xɔri ra.»

sentences.english: And having said these words, he let the mouth-bone go out of his hand; so that place was named Ramath-lehi.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ na masenyi ra, a naxa na banganyi xɔri wɔlɛ. Mɛnni xili naxa sa Ramati Lexi, «Banganyi xɔri geya.»

sentences.english: After this, he was in great need of water, and crying out to the Lord, he said, You have given this great salvation by the hand of your servant, and now need of water will be my death; and I will be given into the hands of this people who are without circumcision.
sentences.susu: Ye xɔli xɔrɔxɔɛ naxa Samison suxu. A naxa Alatala maxandi, «I bara a niya n xa xutu sɔtɔ yi mixie ma. N mali alako n naxa faxa ye xɔli ma, yi mixi sunnataree naxa fa n xanin e xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: Then God made a crack in the hollow rock in Lehi and water came out of it; and after drinking, his spirit came back to him and he was strong again; so that place was named En-hakkore; it is in Lehi to this day.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa fanye ibɔɔ Lexi mabiri, ye naxa mini. Samison to ye min, a man naxa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ, a bɔɲɛ naxa sa. E naxa na yire xili fala «Hakore dulonyi.» Han ya na dulonyi na Lexi mabiri.

sentences.english: And he was judge of Israel in the days of the Philistines for twenty years.
sentences.susu: Samison naxa bu kiiti sa ra Isirayila ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn Filisitakae xa waxati.

sentences.english: Now Samson went to Gaza, and there he saw a loose woman and went in to her.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Samison naxa siga Gasa. A to langoe nde to naa, a naxa so a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And it was said to the Gazites, Samson is here. So they went round, watching for him all day at the doorway of the town, but at night they kept quiet, saying, When daylight comes we will put him to death.
sentences.susu: Gasakae naxa a kolon Samison nu na na. E naxa mɛnni mɛlɛn, alako kuye na iba e xa a faxa taa sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Samson was there till the middle of the night; then he got up, and took a grip on the doors of the town, pulling them up, together with their two supports and their locks, and put them on his back and took them up to the top of the hill in front of Hebron.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ tagi Samison naxa keli, a taa naadɛ suxu, nun a gbakuxi wure naxee ra wurie ma, a na birin tala, a a dɔxɔ a tunki fari. A naxa a xanin geya fari naxan na Hebiron ya tagi.

sentences.english: Now after this, he was in love with a woman in the valley of Sorek, named Delilah.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Samison naxa ginɛ nde kolon Soreki gulunba naxan xili Dalila. Samison naxa na ginɛ xanu.

sentences.english: And the chiefs of the Philistines came up to her, and said to her, Make use of your power over him and see what is the secret of his great strength, and how we may get the better of him, and put bands on him, so that we may make him feeble; and every one of us will give you eleven hundred shekels of silver.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae xa mangɛe naxa siga na ginɛ xɔn, e a fala a bɛ, «I xa a kolon Samison sɛnbɛ kelixi dɛnnaxɛ, alako muxu xa nɔ a ra. Xa i gɛ na kolonde, muxu a xirima nɛ, muxu keren keren ma fa kɔbiri kole wulu keren nun kɔbiri kole kɛmɛ fi i ma.»

sentences.english: So Delilah said to Samson, Make clear to me now what is the secret of your great strength, and how you may be put in bands and made feeble.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Dalila naxa a fala Samison bɛ, «Yandi, i xa i gundo fala n bɛ, i sɛnbɛ sɔtɔma ki naxɛ. Mixi nɔma munse rabade, e xa i xiri, e nɔ i ra?»

sentences.english: And Samson said to her, If seven new bow-cords which have never been made dry are knotted round me, I will become feeble and will be like any other man.
sentences.susu: Samison naxa a yaabi, «Xa e n xirima luuti nɛɛnɛ ra, naxee mu nu xara sinden, n sɛnbɛ bama n yi, n luma nɛ alɔ xɛmɛ booree.»

sentences.english: So the chiefs of the Philistines gave her seven new bow-cords which had never been made dry, and she had them tightly knotted round him.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa luuti nɛɛnɛ xaratare solofere xanin Dalila xɔn ma. A naxa Samison xiri e ra.

sentences.english: Now she had men waiting secretly in the inner room; and she said to him, The Philistines are on you, Samson. And the cords were broken by him as a twist of thread is broken when touched by a flame. So the secret of his strength did not come to light.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa a xa konkoe mɛlɛn. Dalila naxa a xui ramini Samison ma, «Filisitakae bara fa i suxude.» Samison naxa na luutie bolon keren na, alɔ gɛsɛ naxan ganxi. Na tɛmui e mu nɔ a sɛnbɛ gundo kolonde.

sentences.english: Then Delilah said to Samson, See, you have been making sport of me with false words; now, say truly how may you be put in bands?
sentences.susu: Dalila naxa a fala Samison bɛ, «I wama n madaxufe nɛ. I bara wule fala n bɛ. Yakɔsi, yandi, i xa i gundo fala n bɛ. E nɔma i xiride munse ra?»

sentences.english: And he said to her, If they only put round me new thick cords which have never been used, then I will become feeble and will be like any other man.
sentences.susu: Samison naxa a fala a bɛ, «Xa mixi n xirima luuti nɛɛnɛe ra, sese mu nu xiri naxee ra, n sɛnbɛ luma alɔ adamadi birin na ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: So Delilah took new thick cords, knotting them tightly round him, and said to him, The Philistines are on you, Samson. And men were waiting secretly in the inner room. And the cords were broken off his arms like threads.
sentences.susu: Dalila to gɛ a xiride luuti nɛɛnɛe ra, a naxa gbelegbele, «Samison, Filisitakae bara fa i suxude!» Filisitakae nu bara a xa konkoe mɛlɛn. Samison naxa luuti bolon a xirixi naxan na alɔ gɛsɛ bolonma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then Delilah said to Samson, Up to now you have made sport of me with false words; now say truly, how may you be put in bands? And he said to her, If you get the seven twists of my hair worked into the cloth you are making and fixed with the pin, I will become feeble and will be like any other man.
sentences.susu: Dalila naxa a fala Samison bɛ, «Han to i na n madaxufe, i wule nan tun falafe n bɛ. A fala n bɛ a lanma i xa xiri se naxan na.» Samison naxa a yaabi, «N xunsɛxɛ, naxan dɛnbɛxi solofere ra, xa i na birin dɛgɛ mabɔɛ dugi ra, wo naxa dugi sɔxɔ se fan sɔti n xunsɛxɛ kui, a sa sɔrɔn bɔxi, n sɛnbɛ luma alɔ adamadi birin na ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: So while he was sleeping she got the seven twists of his hair worked into her cloth and fixed with the pin, and said to him, The Philistines are on you, Samson. Then awaking from his sleep, he got up quickly, pulling up cloth and machine together.
sentences.susu: Dalila to gɛ dugi sɔxɔ se sode a fanyi ra, a man naxa gbelegbele, «Samison, Filisitakae bara fa i suxude!» Samison naxa xunu, a naxa dugi sɔxɔ se birin tala.

sentences.english: And she said to him, Why do you say you are my lover when your heart is not mine? Three times you have made sport of me, and have not made clear to me the secret of your great strength.
sentences.susu: Dalila naxa a fala Samison bɛ, «I naxɛ a marafanyi na won tagi, kɔnɔ n ma xanunteya mu na i bɛ. A sanya saxan nan ya i n madaxuma. Han to i tondixi i gundo falade n bɛ, i sɛnbɛ kelixi dɛnnaxɛ ma.»

sentences.english: So day after day she gave him no peace, for ever questioning him till his soul was troubled to death.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ birin Dalila nu a tɔɔrɔma yi wɔyɛnyi mɔɔli ra. A to dɔxɔ a ra,

sentences.english: And opening all his heart to her, he said to her, My head has never been touched by a blade, for I have been separate to God from the day of my birth: if my hair is cut off, then my strength will go from me and I will become feeble, and will be like any other man.
sentences.susu: Samison naxa a gundo fala a bɛ, a naxɛ, «Kafi n bari tɛmui n xunyi mu bixi, barima e n fixi Ala nan ma, Ala xa Nasari nan n na. Xa n xunyi bi, n sɛnbɛ luma alɔ adamadi birin gbe na ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And when Delilah saw that he had let her see into his heart, she sent word to the chiefs of the Philistines saying, Come up this time, for he has let out all his heart to me. Then the chiefs of the Philistines came to her, with the money in their hands.
sentences.susu: Dalila to a kolon Samison bara nɔndi yati yati fala a bɛ, a naxa Filisita mangɛe xili, a fa a fala e bɛ, «Wo man xa fa, barima yi biyaasi a bara a xa gundo fala n bɛ.» Filisita mangɛ naxa siga a xɔnyi, e man kɔbiri xanin e saataxi naxan ma.

sentences.english: And she made him go to sleep on her knees; and she sent for a man and had his seven twists of hair cut off; and while it was being done he became feeble and his strength went from him.
sentences.susu: Dalila naxa Samison raxi, a saxi a sanyi ma. A naxa xɛmɛ nde xili, a naxa Samison xunsɛxɛ dɛnbɛxi solofere maxaba. Na bara a niya Dalila xa nɔ a ra. A sɛnbɛ birin nu bara siga.

sentences.english: Then she said, The Philistines are on you, Samson. And awaking from his sleep, he said, I will go out as at other times, shaking myself free. But he was not conscious that the Lord had gone from him.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Dalila naxa gbelegbele, «Samison, Filisitakae bara fa i suxude!» Samison to xunu, a naxa a fala a yɛtɛ bɛ, «N man xa mini yi fe kui alɔ boore biyaasi.» A mu a kolon Alatala nu bara a rabɛɲin.

sentences.english: So the Philistines took him and put out his eyes; then they took him down to Gaza, and, chaining him with bands of brass, put him to work crushing grain in the prison-house.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa a suxu, e a yae sɔxɔ, e a xanin Gasa. Mɛnni e naxa a xiri yɔlɔnxɔnyi yɔxui daaxi ra geeli kui, a xa nu se binyee mayindigilin, naxan sansi xɔri luxutama.

sentences.english: But the growth of his hair was starting again after it had been cut off.
sentences.susu: Na waxati a xunsɛxɛ, naxan nu bixi, na naxa mini fɔlɔ.
