sentences.english: And the chiefs of the Philistines came together to make a great offering to Dagon their god, and to be glad; for they said, Our god has given into our hands Samson our hater.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Filisita mangɛe naxa e malan, e xa sɛrɛxɛ xungbe ba e xa kuye Dagɔn bɛ ɲɛlɛxinyi kui. E naxa a fala, «Won ma ala bara Samison sa won sagoe!»

sentences.english: And when the people saw him, they gave praise to their god; for they said, Our god has given into our hands the one who was fighting against us, who made our country waste, and who put great numbers of us to death.
sentences.susu: Ɲama to Dagɔn to, e naxa a matɔxɔ, e fa a fala, «Won ma ala bara won yaxui sa won sagoe, naxan bara won ma bɔxi kana, a man bara won ma mixie faxa.»

sentences.english: Now when their hearts were full of joy, they said, Send for Samson to make sport for us. And they sent for Samson out of the prison-house, and he made sport before them; and they put him between the pillars.
sentences.susu: Na sɛɛwɛ kui, e naxa a fala, «Won xa Samison xili, won xa a mayele.» E naxa fa a ra kelife geeli kui, e a xiri e xa salide sanyie ra. E naxa a findi mayele se ra.

sentences.english: And Samson said to the boy who took him by the hand, Let me put my hand on the pillars supporting the house, so that I may put my back against them.
sentences.susu: Samison naxa a fala a raɲɛrɛma bɛ, «A lu n bɛlɛxɛ xa sa salide sanyie ma, n xa n kilɔn e ra.»

sentences.english: Now the house was full of men and women; and all the lords of the Philistines were there; and about three thousand men and women were on the roof, looking on while Samson made sport.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ nun ginɛ gbegbe nu na salide kui. Filisita mangɛe fan nu na. Na birin findi mixi wulu saxan nan na, e birin nu fa Samison mayele.

sentences.english: And Samson, crying out to the Lord, said, O Lord God, do have me now in mind, and do make me strong only this once, O God, so that I may take one last payment from the Philistines for my two eyes.
sentences.susu: Samison naxa Alatala maxandi, «N Marigi Alatala, i xa ratu n ma. N bara i mayandi, Ala, sɛnbɛ fi n ma alako n xa n gbeɲɔxɔ Filisitakae ma n yae xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: Then Samson put his arms round the two middle pillars supporting the house, putting his weight on them, on one with his right hand and on the other with his left.
sentences.susu: Samison naxa a kilɔn na salide sanyie ra, keren na a yirefanyi ma, keren na a kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: And Samson said, Let death overtake me with the Philistines. And he put out all his strength, and the house came down on the chiefs and on all the people who were in it. So the dead whom he sent to destruction by his death were more than all those on whom he had sent destruction in his life.
sentences.susu: Samison naxa a fala, «N xa faxa n nun Filisitakae ra.» A naxa salide sanyie tutun a sɛnbɛ birin na. Salide naxa bira Filisitakae nun mangɛe ma, naxee nu na salide kui. Filisitaka naxee faxa na fe kui, na kɔnti dangi mixie ra Samison naxee faxa a xa duniɲɛigiri birin kui.

sentences.english: Then his brothers and his father's people came down and took him up and put his body to rest in the earth between Zorah and Eshtaol in the resting-place of Manoah his father. And he had been judge of Israel for twenty years.
sentences.susu: A xunyae nun a baba xa denbaya birin naxa goro naa a fure tongode. E naxa a ragata Soraha nun Esetayoli tagi, a baba Manowa xa gaburi kui. Samison nu bara Isirayila yamari ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn beenu a xa faxa.

sentences.english: Now there was a man of the hill-country of Ephraim named Micah.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ nde nu na Efirami geyae fari naxan xili Mike.

sentences.english: And he said to his mother, The eleven hundred shekels of silver which were taken from you, about which you took an oath and said in my hearing, I have given this silver to the Lord from my hand for myself, to make a pictured image and a metal image: see, I have the silver, for I took it: so now I will give it back to you. And his mother said, May the blessing of the Lord be on my son.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a nga bɛ, «I xa gbeti kilo fu nun keren a nun a tagi, naxan muɲaxi i ma, a na n xɔnyi. N bara i xui mɛ, i to nu na muɲɛti dankafe. N tan nan na tongoxi.» A nga naxa a fala, «Alatala xa n ma di baraka.»

sentences.english: And he gave back the eleven hundred shekels of silver to his mother, and his mother said, I have made the silver holy to the Lord from me for my son, to make a pictured image and a metal image.
sentences.susu: A naxa yi gbeti kilo fu nun keren a nun kilo tagi so a nga yi ra. A nga fa a fala a bɛ, «N tan yi gbeti fima Alatala nan ma. N a raxunuma nɛ, a xa findi kuye ra n ma di bɛ. N fama yi gbeti ragbilende i ma na ki nɛ.»

sentences.english: So he gave the silver back to his mother. Then his mother took two hundred shekels of silver and gave them to a metal-worker who made a pictured image and a metal image from them: and it was in the house of Micah.
sentences.susu: A to gbeti so a nga yi ra, a nga naxa gbeti kilo firin nun a tagi so xabui yi ra. A naxa a raxunu, a a yailan kuye ra. E fa na ti Mike xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: And the man Micah had a house of gods; and he made an ephod and family gods and put one of his sons in the position of priest.
sentences.susu: Mike kuye batude nde sɔtɔ na ki nɛ. A naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa dugi nun kuye gbɛtɛe yailan. A naxa a xa di nde findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra.

sentences.english: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did as seemed right to him.
sentences.susu: Na waxati kui, mangɛ yo mu nu na Isirayila. Kankan nu a waxɔnfe nan tun nabama.

sentences.english: Now there was a young man living in Beth-lehem-judah, of the family of Judah and a Levite, who was not a townsman of the place.
sentences.susu: Fonike nde nu na naxan kelixi Bɛtɛlɛɛmu Yudaya bɔxi ma. Lewi bɔnsɔɛ nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: And he went away from the town of Beth-lehem-judah, looking for somewhere to make his living-place; and on his journey he came to the hill-country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah.
sentences.susu: Yi xɛmɛ naxa keli Bɛtɛlɛɛmu Yudaya bɔxi ma, a xa yire gbɛtɛ fen a sabatima dɛnnaxɛ. A naxa ɲɛrɛ han a Efirami geyae li, Mike xa banxi nu na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And Micah said to him, Where do you come from? And he said to him, I am a Levite from Beth-lehem-judah, and I am looking for a living-place.
sentences.susu: Mike naxa a maxɔrin, «I kelixi minden?» A naxa a yaabi, «Lewika nan n na. N kelixi Bɛtɛlɛɛmu Yudaya bɔxi nan ma. N na yire fenfe n sabatima dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Micah said to him, Make your living-place with me, and be a father and a priest to me, and I will give you ten shekels of silver a year and your clothing and food.
sentences.susu: Mike naxa a fala a bɛ, «Won birin xa lu be. I xa findi n ma denbaya xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra, n xaxili tima naxan na. N gbeti kilo firin fima i ma ɲɛ keren kui, a nun sosee nun donsee.» Na Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixi naxa tin na ra,

sentences.english: And the Levite said he would make his living-place with the man, and he became to him as one of his sons.
sentences.susu: a xa lu Mike yire. Mike naxa mɛɛni a ma, a lu alɔ a xa di.

sentences.english: And Micah gave the position to the Levite, and the young man became his priest, and was in the house of Micah.
sentences.susu: Mike naxa a findi a xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra, a fa lu a xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: Then Micah said, Now I am certain that the Lord will do me good, seeing that the Levite has become my priest.
sentences.susu: Mike fa a fala, «Yakɔsi n bara a kolon Alatala fa fe fanyi rabama nɛ n bɛ, barima Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixi nan na n ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra.»

sentences.english: In those days there was no king in Israel, and in those days the Danites were looking for a heritage for themselves, to be their living-place; for up to that time no distribution of land had been made to them among the tribes of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na waxati mangɛ yo mu nu na Isirayila. Dana bɔnsɔɛ fan nu na bɔxi fenfe e luma dɛnnaxɛ, barima e mu nu kɛ sɔtɔxi Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe ya ma sinden.

sentences.english: So the children of Dan sent five men from among their number, strong men, from Zorah and from Eshtaol, to take a look at the land and make a search through it; and they said to them, Go and make a search through the land; and they came to the hill-country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, where they made a stop for the night.
sentences.susu: Danakae naxa xɛmɛ gbangbalanyi mixi suuli mayegeti e bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, naxee nu na Soraha nun Esetayoli. E naxa e xɛɛ, e xa Isirayila bɔxi rabɛn. E naxa a fala xɛɛrae bɛ, «Wo siga na bɔxi rabɛnde.» E naxa Mike xa banxi li Efirami geyae ma. E naxa xi naa.

sentences.english: When they were near the house of Micah, hearing a voice which was not strange to them, that of the young Levite, they went out of their road to his place, and said to him, How did you come here? and what are you doing in this place? and why are you here?
sentences.susu: E nu na mɛnni tɛmui naxɛ, e naxa na fonike Lewika xui rakɔrɔsi. E naxa a maxɔrin, «Nde faxi i ra be? I munse rabafe yi yire? I na be munfe ra?»

sentences.english: And he said to them, This is what Micah did for me, and he gave me payment and I became his priest.
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «Mike bara fe fanyi raba n bɛ, a wali sare fima n ma, n xa findi a xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Then they said, Do get directions from God for us, to see if the journey on which we are going will have a good outcome.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala a bɛ, «Ala maxɔrin muxu bɛ alako muxu xa nɔ a kolonde xa muxu xa biyaasi sɔɔnɛyama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And the priest said to them, Go in peace: your way is guided by the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa e yaabi, «Wo siga bɔɲɛsa kui, barima wo nun Alatala birin nan a ra.»

sentences.english: Then the five men went on their way and came to Laish and saw the people who were there, living without thought of danger, like the Zidonians, quiet and safe; for they had everything on earth for their needs, and they were far from the Zidonians and had no business with Aram.
sentences.susu: Yi xɛmɛ suulie naxa siga, e so Layisa. E naxa a to, mɛnnikae sabatixi bɔɲɛsa kui, alɔ Sidɔnkae darixi a ra ki naxɛ. Si gbɛtɛ yo mu nu na naxan e tɔɔrɔma, xa na mu a ra e yamarima. E nu bara makuya Sidɔnkae ra, e mu lanyi yo xiri e nun bɔnsɔɛ gbɛtɛ tagi.

sentences.english: So they came back to their brothers in Zorah and Eshtaol, and their brothers said to them, What news have you?
sentences.susu: Yi xɛmɛ mixi suuli to gbilen Soraha nun Esetayoli, e ngaxakerenyie naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo munse toxi naa?»

sentences.english: And they said, Up! and let us go against Laish; for we have seen the land, and it is very good: why are you doing nothing? Do not be slow to go in and take the land for your heritage.
sentences.susu: E naxa e yaabi, «Wo keli, won xɛɛ. Won xa sa mɛnnikae gere, barima bɔxi fanyi na e yi ra. Won xa won xulun. Won xa siga naa keren na, won xa na bɔxi sɔtɔ!

sentences.english: When you come there you will come to a people living without thought of danger; and the land is wide, and God has given it into your hands: a place where there is everything on earth for man's needs.
sentences.susu: Wo na so naa, wo a toma nɛ mɛnnikae bɔɲɛ saxi lɛpu. Bɔxi belebele na e yi ra, Ala bara na sa wo bɛlɛxɛ. Yire nan a ra, sese mu na yi duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari naxan mu na na.»

sentences.english: So six hundred men of the Danites from Zorah and Eshtaol went out armed with instruments of war.
sentences.susu: Dana bɔnsɔɛ sɔɔri mixi kɛmɛ senni naxa keli Soraha nun Esetayoli, geresose na e yi ra.

sentences.english: And they went up and put up their tents in Kiriath-jearim in Judah: so that place is named Mahaneh-dan to this day. It is to the west of Kiriath-jearim.
sentences.susu: E naxa te, e sa kuru Kiriyati Yeyarimi Yudaya bɔxi ma. Na nan a toxi, han to yire naxan na Kiriyati Yeyarimi xanbi ra, na xili falama Maxane Dana.

sentences.english: From there they went on to the hill-country of Ephraim and came to the house of Micah.
sentences.susu: E naxa keli mɛnni, e siga Efirami geyae yire, han Mike xa banxi nu na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Then the five men who had gone to make a search through the country of Laish, said to their brothers, Have you knowledge that in these houses there is an ephod and family gods and a pictured image and a metal image? So now you see what to do.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui yi xɛmɛ mixi suuli naxee siga Layisa bɔxi rabɛnde, nee naxa a fala e ngaxakerenyie bɛ, «Wo a kolon yi banxie kui sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi donma na na, a nun kuye masolixi, nun kuye naxan nafalaxi yɔxui ra. Wo xa na birin mato.»

sentences.english: And turning from their road they came to the house of the young Levite, the house of Micah, and said to him, Is it well with you?
sentences.susu: E naxa so na fonike Lewika xɔnyi, naxan nu na Mike xa banxi kui. E naxa a xɛɛbu.

sentences.english: And the six hundred armed men of the Danites took their places by the doorway.
sentences.susu: Dana bɔnsɔɛ sɔɔri mixi kɛmɛ senni nu tixi naadɛ ra, geresose na e yi ra.

sentences.english: Then the five men who had gone to make a search through the land, went in and took the pictured image and the ephod and the family gods and the metal image; and the priest was by the doorway with the six hundred armed men.
sentences.susu: Yi xɛmɛ suuli naxee siga bɔxi rabɛnde, nee naxa so banxi kui, e naxa kuye masolixi tongo, a nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xa donma, kuyee, nun na kuye naxan nu raxunuxi. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nu tixi banxi sode dɛ ra, a nun yi sɔɔri mixi kɛmɛ senni, e xa geresose suxuxi e yi.

sentences.english: And when they went into Micah's house and took out the pictured image and the ephod and the family gods and the metal image, the priest said to them, What are you doing?
sentences.susu: E to gɛ kuye masolixi tongode Mike xa banxi kui, a nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xa donma, kuyee, nun kuye naxan nu raxunuxi, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo na munse rabafe?»

sentences.english: And they said to him, Be quiet; say nothing, and come with us and be our father and priest; is it better for you to be priest to one man's house or to be priest to a tribe and a family in Israel?
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Dundu, i naxa sese fala. I xa bira muxu fɔxɔ ra tun. I xa findi muxu xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra, muxu xaxili tima naxan na. A lanma i xa findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra mixi keren ma denbaya bɛ, ka Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ nde bɛ?»

sentences.english: Then the priest's heart was glad, and he took the ephod and the family gods and the pictured image and went with the people.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa sɛɛwa na wɔyɛnyi ra. A naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xa donma, kuyee, nun na kuye masolixi tongo, a naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: So they went on their way again, putting the little ones and the oxen and the goods in front of them.
sentences.susu: E naxa ti kira xɔn ma, dimɛe, xurusee, nun kote na e ya ra.

sentences.english: When they had gone some way from the house of Micah, the men from the houses near Micah's house came together and overtook the children of Dan,
sentences.susu: E to makuya Mike xa banxi ra, Mike dɔxɔbooree naxa e malan, e fa bira Dana xa die fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Crying out to them. And the Danites, turning round, said to Micah, What is your trouble, that you have taken up arms?
sentences.susu: E naxa sɔnxɔɛ rate Dana xa die ma. Danakae naxa a fala Mike bɛ, «Munse niyaxi? I wama gere sofe munfe ra?»

sentences.english: And he said, You have taken my gods which I made, and my priest, and have gone away; what is there for me now? Why then do you say to me, What is your trouble?
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «Wo bara n ma kuyee nun n ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xanin. Munse fa luma n yi? N wo gerema na nan ma.»

sentences.english: And the children of Dan said to him, Say no more, or men of bitter spirit may make an attack on you, causing loss of your life and the lives of your people.
sentences.susu: Dana xa die naxa a fala a bɛ, «I naxa sɔnxɔ muxu ra, xa na mu xɛmɛ ndee fama wo bɔnbɔde xɔnɛ ra. Na kui i fama nɛ gande i tan nun i xa denbaya ra.»

sentences.english: Then the children of Dan went on their way; and when Micah saw that they were stronger than he, he went back to his house.
sentences.susu: E to na fala, e naxa siga. Mike naxa a kolon e sɛnbɛ gbo a bɛ, na na a niya, a naxa gbilen a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And they took that which Micah had made, and his priest, and came to Laish, to a people living quietly and without thought of danger, and they put them to the sword without mercy, burning down their town.
sentences.susu: E naxa Mike xa see nun a xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xanin Layisa. E naxa mɛnnikae faxa santidɛgɛma ra, e na taa birin gan. Layisakae mu nu sese kolon barima e bɔɲɛ nu saxi, yaxui yo mu nu na e yi ra.

sentences.english: And they had no saviour, because it was far from Zidon, and they had no business with Aram; and it was in the valley which is the property of Beth-rehob. And building up the town again they took it for their living-place.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu nɔ e ratangade, barima e nu makuya Sidɔn na, dari mu nu na e nun si gbɛtɛe tagi. E nu na geya bunyi Beti Rexobo biri. Dana xa die naxa gbilen Layisa taa ti ra a firin nde, e sabati naa.

sentences.english: And they gave the town the name of Dan, after Dan their father, who was the son of Israel: though the town had been named Laish at first.
sentences.susu: E naxa e baba Isirayilaka Dana xili sa na taa xun, naxan singe nu xili Layisa.

sentences.english: (And the children of Dan put up the pictured image for themselves; and Jonathan, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, and his sons were priests for the tribe of the Danites till the day when the ark was taken prisoner.)
sentences.susu: Dana xa die naxa Mike xa kuye ti naa. Gerisomi xa di Yonatan, Munsa xa mamadi, naxa findi Dana bɔnsɔɛ xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra, han e yaxuie e xanin ɲamanɛ ma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And they put up for themselves the image which Micah had made, and it was there all the time that the house of God was in Shiloh.
sentences.susu: E nu Mike xa kuye nan batuma, Ala xa banxi nu na Silo waxati naxan ma.

sentences.english: Now in those days, when there was no king in Israel, a certain Levite was living in the inmost parts of the hill-country of Ephraim, and he got for himself a servant-wife from Beth-lehem-judah.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ yo mu nu na Isirayila bɔxi ma na tɛmui. Lewika nde, naxan nu na Efirami geyae yire, naxa konyi ginɛ nde fen Bɛtɛlɛɛmu Yudaya bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And his servant-wife was angry with him, and went away from him to her father's house at Beth-lehem-judah, and was there for four months.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na ginɛ naxa yɛnɛ raba, a keli a xa mɔri xun ma, a siga Bɛtɛlɛɛmu Yudaya bɔxi ma a baba xɔnyi. A to kike naani raba naa,

sentences.english: Then her husband got up and went after her, with the purpose of talking kindly to her, and taking her back with him; he had with him his young man and two asses: and she took him into her father's house, and her father, when he saw him, came forward to him with joy.
sentences.susu: a xa mɔri naxa siga a yire alako e xa lan fe keren ma. A xa konyi fonike naxa a mati, e siga sofale firin fari. Na ginɛ naxa a raso a baba xɔnyi. Na ginɛ baba to na xɛmɛ to, a naxa a rasɛnɛ sɛɛwɛ ra.

sentences.english: And his father-in-law, the girl's father, kept him there for three days; and they had food and drink and took their rest there.
sentences.susu: A bitanyi naxa a makankan, e fa lu a xɔnyi xi saxan. A naxa e yigiya a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Now on the fourth day they got up early in the morning and he made ready to go away; but the girl's father said to his son-in-law, Take a little food to keep up your strength, and then go on your way.
sentences.susu: Xi naani nde, Lewika naxa kurun a xa kote yailan na, kɔnɔ a bitanyi naxa a fala a bɛ, «I dɛ iba taami ra sinden, wo fa siga.»

sentences.english: So seating themselves they had food and drink, the two of them together; and the girl's father said to the man, If it is your pleasure, take your rest here tonight, and let your heart be glad.
sentences.susu: E naxa dɔxɔ, e naxa e dɛge yire keren. Na xanbi a bitanyi naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xa xi be to kɔɛ ra. I xa tin na ra alako i bɔɲɛ xa rafan i ma.»

sentences.english: And the man got up to go away, but his father-in-law would not let him go, so he took his rest there again for the night.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ xa mɔri naxa keli, a xa siga, kɔnɔ a bitanyi naxa a karaxan a xa na kɔɛ radangi naa.

sentences.english: Then early on the morning of the fifth day he got up to go away; but the girl's father said, Keep up your strength; so the two of them had a meal, and the man and his woman and his servant did not go till after the middle of the day.
sentences.susu: Xi suuli nde, a man naxa kurun, a xa siga. A bitanyi man naxa a fala a bɛ, «N bara i mayandi, i xa i dɛ iba sinden, i fa siga nunmare ra.» E man naxa e dɛge yire keren.

sentences.english: And when they got up to go away, his father-in-law, the girl's father, said to him, Now evening is coming on, so do not go tonight; see, the day is almost gone; take your rest here and let your heart be glad, and tomorrow early, go on your way back to your house.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ to keli, a xa siga, a tan nun a xa ginɛ, nun a xa fonike konyi, a bitanyi man naxa a mayandi, «I bara a to, kɔɛ na sofe. Wo xa xi be to, i bɔɲɛ xa rafan i ma. Tina wo xa kurun, wo xa siga wo xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: But the man would not be kept there that night, and he got up and went away and came opposite to Jebus (which is Jerusalem); and he had with him the two asses, ready for travelling, and his woman.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ xa mɔri mu tin na ra. A naxa keli, a nun a xa ginɛ naxa dɔxɔ sofale firinyie fari, e siga Yebusu biri ra, naxan findixi Darisalamu ra.

sentences.english: When they got near Jebus the day was far gone; and the servant said to his master, Now let us go from our road into this town of the Jebusites and take our night's rest there.
sentences.susu: E makɔrɛxi Yebusu ra tɛmui naxɛ, nunmare nu bara so. Yi fonike konyi naxa a fala a marigi bɛ, «Won xa ti be Yebusu taa kui, won xa xi be.»

sentences.english: But his master said to him, We will not go out of our way into a strange town, whose people are not of the children of Israel; but we will go on to Gibeah.
sentences.susu: A marigi naxa a yaabi, «Won mu soma taa i si gbɛtɛ sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ. Won xa xi Isirayila taa nde nɛ Gibiya.»

sentences.english: And he said to his servant, Come, let us go on to one of these places, stopping for the night in Gibeah or Ramah.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a fala a xa fonike konyi bɛ, «Won xɛɛ, won xa so Gibiya, xa na mu Rama, won xa xi mɛnni.»

sentences.english: So they went on their way; and the sun went down when they were near Gibeah in the land of Benjamin.
sentences.susu: E naxa ɲɛrɛ han soge dula tɛmui. E nu bara makɔrɛ Gibiya ra, Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And they went off the road there with the purpose of stopping for the night in Gibeah: and he went in, seating himself in the street of the town, for no one took them into his house for the night.
sentences.susu: E naxa so Gibiya, e xa xi naa. E naxa ti taa tagi, kɔnɔ mixi yo mu tin e yigiyade.

sentences.english: Now when it was evening they saw an old man coming back from his work in the fields; he was from the hill-country of Ephraim and was living in Gibeah: but the men of the place were Benjamites.
sentences.susu: Fori nde, naxan keli Efirami geyae mabiri, kɔnɔ a nu sabatixi Gibiya nɛ, a naxa so taa kui nunmare, kelife walide xɛ ma. Mɛnni mixie tan Bunyamin xa die nan nu e ra.

sentences.english: And when he saw the traveller in the street of the town, the old man said, Where are you going? and where do you come from?
sentences.susu: Na fori to xɔɲɛe to taa tagi, a naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo kelixi minden? Wo sigafe minden?»

sentences.english: And he said to him, We are on our way from Beth-lehem-judah to the inmost parts of the hill-country of Ephraim: I came from there and went to Beth-lehem-judah: now I am on my way back to my house, but no man will take me into his house.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Muxu kelixi Bɛtɛlɛɛmu Yudaya bɔxi nan ma, muxu na sigafe Efirami geyae ma, n sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ. N kelixi Bɛtɛlɛɛmu Yudaya bɔxi nan ma, n na sigafe Alatala xa banxi, kɔnɔ n mu yigiya sɔtɔxi sinden.

sentences.english: But we have dry grass and food for our asses, as well as bread and wine for me, and for the woman, and for the young man with us: we have no need of anything.
sentences.susu: Ɲooge nun burɛxɛ na muxu yi muxu xa sofale naxan donma. Taami nun wɛni fan na muxu yi muxu naxan donma, n tan, n ma ginɛ, nun n ma fonike konyi. Sese mu luxi naxan mu na muxu yi ra.»

sentences.english: And the old man said, Peace be with you; let all your needs be my care; only do not take your rest in the street.
sentences.susu: Na fori naxa a fala a bɛ, «Ala xa wo bɔɲɛ sa. N bara wo yigiya, wo mu luma taa tagi to kɔɛ ra.»

sentences.english: So he took them into his house and gave the asses food; and after washing their feet they took food and drink.
sentences.susu: A naxa e xanin a xa banxi kui, a ɲooge so sofalee yi. Biyaasilae to e sanyie maxa, e naxa e dɛge, e naxa e min.

sentences.english: While they were taking their pleasure at the meal, the good-for-nothing men of the town came round the house, giving blows on the door; and they said to the old man, the master of the house, Send out that man who came to your house, so that we may take our pleasure with him.
sentences.susu: E to nu na e dɛgefe, taa mixi rabɛɲinxie naxa fa, e naxa banxi bilin, e naadɛ kɔnkɔn sɛnbɛ ra. E nu fa a fala fori bɛ, banxi kanyi, «Xɛmɛ naxan soxi i xa banxi kui, a ramini alako muxu xa yɛnɛ raba a ra.»

sentences.english: So the man, the master of the house, went out to them, and said, No, my brothers, do not this evil thing; this man has come into my house, and you are not to do him this wrong.
sentences.susu: Banxi kanyi naxa mini, a a fala e bɛ, «Ade, n ngaxakerenyie, wo naxa yi fe ɲaaxi raba n ma xɔɲɛ ra. N bara wo mayandi. Yi xɛmɛ bara so n xɔnyi, wo naxa yi yunubi xɔnxi raba a ra.

sentences.english: See, here is my daughter, a virgin, and his servant-wife: I will send them out for you to take them and do with them whatever you will. But do no such thing of shame to this man.
sentences.susu: N ma di ginɛdimɛdi nan yi ki, a nun yi xɛmɛ xa ginɛ, n xa nee ramini wo ma, wo xa wo waxɔnfe raba e ra. Kɔnɔ wo naxa na fe xɔnxi mɔɔli raba yi xɛmɛ ra.»

sentences.english: But the men would not give ear to him: so the man took his woman and sent her out to them; and they took her by force, using her for their pleasure all night till the morning; and when dawn came they let her go.
sentences.susu: Yi xɛmɛe mu tin e tuli matide a ra. Na kui, xɛmɛ naxa a xa ginɛ suxu, a a ramini e ma tande. E naxa a kolon ginɛ ra, e fa a maxi na kɔɛ birin na han gɛɛsɛgɛ. Kuye to iba, e naxa a bɛɲin.

sentences.english: Then at the dawn of day the woman came, and, falling down at the door of the man's house where her master was, was stretched there till it was light.
sentences.susu: Subaxɛ yi ginɛ naxa fa, a bira banxi dɛ ra, a xa mɔri yigiyaxi dɛnnaxɛ. A naxa lu naa han gɛɛsɛgɛ.

sentences.english: In the morning her master got up, and opening the door of the house went out to go on his way; and he saw his servant-wife stretched on the earth at the door of the house with her hands on the step.
sentences.susu: Gɛɛsɛgɛ a xa mɔri naxa keli, a xa siga. A to naadɛ rabi, a naxa a xa ginɛ to banxi sode dɛ ra, a bɛlɛxɛ saxi naadɛ gonyi ma.

sentences.english: And he said to her, Get up and let us be going; but there was no answer; so he took her up and put her on the ass, and went on his way and came to his house.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a xa ginɛ bɛ, «Won xɛɛ,» kɔnɔ a mu a yaabi. A nu bara faxa. Na kui a naxa a sa a xa sofale fari, a siga a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And when he had come to his house, he got his knife, and took the woman, cutting her up bone by bone into twelve parts, which he sent through all Israel.
sentences.susu: A to so a xɔnyi, a naxa finɛ tongo, a naxa a xa ginɛ ibolon a salonsee ma dɔxɔ fu nun firin. A naxa na xuntunyie rasanba Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ fu nun firinyie ma.

sentences.english: And he gave orders to the men whom he sent, saying, This is what you are to say to all the men of Israel, Has ever an act like this been done from the day when the children of Israel came out of Egypt to this day? Give thought to it, turning it over in your minds, and give your opinion of it.
sentences.susu: Naxee birin na to, e naxa a fala, «Kafi Isirayilakae naxa keli Misira bɔxi ma, han to, yi fe ɲaaxi mɔɔli mu nu raba sinden. Won xa lu yire keren, wo xa natɛ tongo yi xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: Then all the children of Israel took up arms, and the people came together like one man, from Dan to Beer-sheba, and the land of Gilead, before the Lord at Mizpah.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae birin, fɔlɔ Dana ma, sa dɔxɔ Beriseeba nun Galadi ra, e naxa e malan Ala ya i Misipa.

sentences.english: And the chiefs of the people, out of all the tribes of Israel, took their places in the meeting of the people of God, four hundred thousand footmen armed with swords.
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe kuntigi birin nu na Ala xa ɲama xa malanyi. Sɔɔri wulu kɛmɛ naani nu na, e birin fata santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: (Now the children of Benjamin had word that the children of Israel had gone up to Mizpah.) And the children of Israel said, Make clear how this evil thing took place.
sentences.susu: Bunyaminkae naxa a kolon Isirayilakae nu malanxi Misipa. Isirayilakae naxa a fala na Lewika bɛ a xa yi fe ɲaaxi dɛntɛgɛ sa e bɛ.

sentences.english: Then the Levite, the husband of the dead woman, said in answer, I came to Gibeah in the land of Benjamin, I and my servant-wife, for the purpose of stopping there for the night.
sentences.susu: Na kui Lewika naxan ma ginɛ faxaxi, a naxa a masen e bɛ, «Muxu nun n ma ginɛ naxa Gibiya li Bunyamin bɔxi ma, muxu xa xi naa.

sentences.english: And the townsmen of Gibeah came together against me, going round the house on all sides by night; it was their purpose to put me to death, and my servant-wife was violently used by them and is dead.
sentences.susu: Gibiya xɛmɛe naxa keli n xili ma kɔɛ ra. E naxa banxi bilin n nu na dɛnnaxɛ, e xa n faxa. E naxa e waxɔnfe raba n ma ginɛ ra han na faxa.

sentences.english: So I took her, cutting her into parts which I sent through all the country of the heritage of Israel: for they have done an act of shame in Israel.
sentences.susu: N naxa a fure ibolon bolon, n naxa a xuntunyie rasanba Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin ma, e xa a kolon yi fe ɲaaxi naxan nabaxi Isirayila bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Here you all are, you children of Israel; give now your suggestions about what is to be done.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, Isirayilakae birin, wo xa wɔyɛn, wo xa kiiti sa.»

sentences.english: Then all the people got up as one man and said, Not one of us will go to his tent or go back to his house:
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa lan a ma mixi yo naxa gbilen a xɔnyi,

sentences.english: But this is what we will do to Gibeah: we will go up against it by the decision of the Lord;
sentences.susu: fo e xa mixie sugandi sinden naxee tema Gibiya xili ma.

sentences.english: And we will take ten men out of every hundred, through all the tribes of Israel, a hundred out of every thousand, a thousand out of every ten thousand, to get food for the people, so that they may give to Gibeah of Benjamin the right punishment for the act of shame they have done in Israel.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala, «Xɛmɛ fu yo xɛmɛ fu, won xa keren xɛɛ a xa donse fen sɔɔrie bɛ. Naxee luxi, e xa te Gibiya e xa wali ɲaaxi sare ragbilen mɛnnikae ma, naxee bara fe xɔnxi raba Isirayila bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: So all the men of Israel were banded together against the town, united like one man.
sentences.susu: Na kui Isirayila xɛmɛ birin naxa e malan na taa xili ma.

sentences.english: And the tribes of Israel sent men through all the tribe of Benjamin saying, What is this evil which has been done among you?
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Bunyamin xabilɛ birin ma, e xa e maxɔrin, «Yi fe ɲaaxi mɔɔli dangixi wo tagi di?

sentences.english: Now give up those good-for-nothing persons in Gibeah so that we may put them to death, clearing away the evil from Israel. But the children of Benjamin would not give ear to the voice of their brothers, the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na Gibiyaka mixi ɲaaxie so muxu yi ra, muxu xa e faxa alako yi yunubi xa ba Isirayila ma.» Bunyaminkae naxa tondi e ngaxakerenyi Isirayilakae xui suxude.

sentences.english: And the children of Benjamin came together from all their towns to Gibeah, to go to war with the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: E naxa keli e xa taae kui, e fan xa malan Gibiya Isirayilakae gerede.

sentences.english: And the children of Benjamin who came that day from the towns were twenty-six thousand men armed with swords, in addition to the people of Gibeah, numbering seven hundred of the best fighting-men,
sentences.susu: Santidɛgɛma kanyi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun senni nu na Bunyaminkae ya ma, nun Gibiyaka mixi kɛmɛ solofere naxee sugandixi gere xili ma.

sentences.english: Who were left-handed, able to send a stone at a hair without error.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri yi matinxinxi kɛmɛ solofere nu na e ya ma, naxee fata gɛmɛ wolide laati ra e kɔɔla bɛlɛxɛ ra. E fata se birin gɔnɔde na ra.

sentences.english: And the men of Israel, other than Benjamin, were four hundred thousand in number, all armed with swords; they were all men of war.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka sɔɔrie santidɛgɛma kanyie nu lanxi xɛmɛ wulu kɛmɛ naani bafe Bunyaminkae ra.

sentences.english: And they got up and went up to Beth-el to get directions from God, and the children of Israel said, Who is to be the first to go up to the fight against the children of Benjamin? And the Lord said, Judah is to go up first.
sentences.susu: E naxa te Beteli, e Ala maxɔrin, «Nde singe tema muxu ya ma a xa Bunyaminkae gere?» Alatala naxa e yaabi, «Yudayakae singe xa na gere fɔlɔ.»

sentences.english: So the children of Israel got up in the morning and put themselves in position against Gibeah.
sentences.susu: Gɛɛsɛgɛ, Isirayilakae naxa kuru Gibiya xili ma.

sentences.english: And the men of Israel went out to war against Benjamin (and the men of Israel put their forces in fighting order against them at Gibeah).
sentences.susu: E naxa Bunyaminkae gere Gibiya ya tagi.

sentences.english: Then the children of Benjamin came out from Gibeah, cutting down twenty-two thousand of the Israelites that day.
sentences.susu: Bunyaminka naxee keli Gibiya, nee naxa Isirayilaka wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin faxa.

sentences.english: But the people, the men of Israel, taking heart again, put their forces in order and took up the same position as on the first day.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Isirayilakae naxa limaniya, e man naxa te Bunyaminkae xili ma, e nu na dɛnnaxɛ na lɔxɔɛ singe.

sentences.english: Now the children of Israel went up, weeping before the Lord till evening, requesting the Lord and saying, Am I to go forward again to the fight against the children of Benjamin my brother? And the Lord said, Go up against him.
sentences.susu: E man naxa te Beteli, e naxa wa han nunmare, e fa Alatala maxɔrin, «A lanma muxu man xa Bunyaminkae gere, muxu ngaxakerenyie?» Alatala naxa e yaabi, «Wo e gere.»

sentences.english: So the children of Israel went forward against the children of Benjamin the second day.
sentences.susu: Awa na xi firin nde, Isirayilakae man naxa te Bunyamin xa die xili ma.

sentences.english: And the second day Benjamin went out against them from Gibeah, cutting down eighteen thousand men of the children of Israel, all swordsmen.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Bunyaminka naxee keli Gibiya naxa Isirayila xɛmɛ wulu fu nun solomasaxan faxa santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: Then all the children of Israel, and all the people, went up to Beth-el, weeping and waiting there before the Lord, going without food all day till evening, and offering burned offerings and peace-offerings before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isirayilakae birin naxa te Beteli, e naxa wa Alatala ya i. E naxa sunyi suxu han nunmare, e sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ba Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel made request to the Lord, (for the ark of the agreement of the Lord was there in those days,
sentences.susu: E naxa Alatala xa marasi fen. Na waxati Ala xa saatɛ kankira nu na Beteli.

sentences.english: And Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron, was in his place before it,) and said, Am I still to go on with the fight against the children of Benjamin my brother, or am I to give it up? And the Lord said, Go on; for tomorrow I will give him into your hands.
sentences.susu: Finexasi, Eleyasari xa di, Haruna xa mamadi, nu a ɲɛngi saxi na birin xɔn ma. E naxa Ala maxɔrin, «A lanma muxu man xa te Bunyaminkae xili ma, muxu ngaxakerenyie, ka a lanma muxu xa gere lu naa?» Alatala naxa e yaabi, «Wo man xa gere so. Tina n e sama wo sagoe.»

sentences.english: So Israel put men secretly all round Gibeah to make a surprise attack on it.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isirayilakae naxa Gibiya mɛlɛn.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel went up against the children of Benjamin on the third day, and put themselves in fighting order against Gibeah as before.
sentences.susu: E to te Bunyaminkae xili ma Gibiya ya tagi e nu na dɛnnaxɛ boore biyaasi,

sentences.english: And the children of Benjamin went out against the people, moving away from the town; and as before, at their first attack, they put to death about thirty men of Israel on the highways, of which one goes up to Beth-el and the other to Gibeah, and in the open country.
sentences.susu: Bunyamin xa die naxa mini e gerede. E naxa mixi tongo saxan faxa Beteli nun Gibiya kirae xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And the children of Benjamin said, They are giving way before us as at first. But the children of Israel said, Let us go in flight and get them away from the town, into the highways.
sentences.susu: Bunyaminkae naxa a fala e booree bɛ, «Won man na e bɔnbɔfe nɛ yi ki alɔ a singe,» kɔnɔ Isirayilakae tan nu bara a fala e boore bɛ, «Won xa won makuya taa ra, e xa bira won fɔxɔ ra kirae xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: So all the men of Israel got up and put themselves in fighting order at Baal-tamar: and those who had been waiting secretly to make a surprise attack came rushing out of their place on the west of Geba.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xɛmɛe naxa e malan Bali Tamari. Naxee nu na Gibiya mɛlɛnfe, nee fan naxa mini kɛnɛ ma.

sentences.english: And they came in front of Gibeah, ten thousand of the best men in all Israel, and the fighting became more violent; but the children of Benjamin were not conscious that evil was coming on them.
sentences.susu: Isirayila sɔɔri fanyi wulu fu naxa Gibiya gere a ɲaaxi ra. Bunyaminkae mu gɛxi a kolonde gbaloe nu bara e li.

sentences.english: Then the Lord sent sudden fear on Benjamin before Israel; and that day the children of Israel put to death twenty-five thousand, one hundred men of Benjamin, all of them swordsmen.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ bɔnbɔ Isirayila ya xɔri. Xɛmɛ santidɛgɛma kanyi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli, xɛmɛ kɛmɛ naxa faxa na lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: So the children of Benjamin saw that they were overcome: and the men of Israel had given way before Benjamin, putting their faith in the watchers who were to make the surprise attack on Gibeah.
sentences.susu: Bunyamin xa die naxa a kolon e mu geenixi yi biyaasi. Isirayilakae naxa a lu e xa gbilen Gibiya mabiri, barima e a kolon sɔɔri gbɛtɛe nu na e mɛlɛnfe.

sentences.english: And the watchers, rushing on Gibeah and overrunning it, put all the town to the sword without mercy.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri naxee nu Gibiya mɛlɛnfe, nee naxa so taa kui keren na, e mixi birin faxa santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: Now the sign fixed between the men of Israel and those making the surprise attack was that when they made a pillar of smoke go up from the town,
sentences.susu: E nu bara lan a ma e xa tɛ so taa ra, tuuri gbegbe xa te koore ma.

sentences.english: The men of Israel were to make a turn about in the fight. And Benjamin had overcome and put to death about thirty of the men of Israel, and were saying, Certainly they are falling back before us as in the first fight.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka booree to na to, e naxa e mafindi Bunyaminkae xili ma. Bunyaminkae to bara mixi tongo saxan faxa, e naxa a fala e boore bɛ, «Won na e bɔnbɔfe nɛ yi ki alɔ a singe.»

sentences.english: Then the sign went up out of the town in the pillar of smoke, and the Benjamites, turning back, saw all the town going up in smoke to heaven.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e to tuuri to te ra koore ma kelife e xa taa kui,

sentences.english: And the men of Israel had made a turn about, and the men of Benjamin were overcome with fear, for they saw that evil had overtaken them.
sentences.susu: Bunyaminkae naxa gaaxu na gbaloe ya ra. Isirayilakae naxa e mafindi, e xa e gere.

sentences.english: So turning their backs on the men of Israel, they went in the direction of the waste land; but the fight overtook them; and those who came out of the town were heading them off and putting them to the sword.
sentences.susu: Bunyaminkae naxa gbilen e fɔxɔ ra, e e gi gbengberen kira xɔn ma. Sɔɔri naxee nu na taa kui, nee mu tin e xa e ba e yi. E naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra, e e faxa, barima e nu bara makɔrɛ e ra.

sentences.english: And crushing Benjamin down, they went after them, driving them from Nohah as far as the east side of Gibeah.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa e rabilin, e bira e fɔxɔ ra Gibiya fuge ra.

sentences.english: Eighteen thousand men of Benjamin came to their death, all strong men of war.
sentences.susu: Bunyamin sɔɔri fanyi wulu fu nun solomasaxan naxa faxa na gere kui.

sentences.english: And turning, they went in flight to the rock of Rimmon in the waste land: and on the highways five thousand of them were cut off by the men of Israel, who, pushing on hard after them to Geba, put to death two thousand more.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ wulu suuli naxa faxa, naxee nu bara e gi gbengberen kira xɔn ma, sigafe ra Rimɔn geya mabiri. Xɛmɛ wulu firin naxa faxa, naxee nu bara e gi han Gidomi.

sentences.english: So twenty-five thousand of the swordsmen of Benjamin came to their end that day, all strong men of war.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Bunyamin sɔɔri fanyi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli naxa faxa, e birin santidɛgɛma kanyi.

sentences.english: But six hundred men, turning back, went in flight to the rock of Rimmon in the waste land, and were living on the rock of Rimmon for four months.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ kɛmɛ senni, naxee nu bara e gi gbengberenyi Rimɔn geya mabiri, naxa lu mɛnni kike naani.

sentences.english: And the men of Israel, turning again against the children of Benjamin, put to the sword without mercy all the towns and the cattle and everything there was, burning every town which came into their hands.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa bira Bunyamin xa die fɔxɔ ra e xa taa birin kui. E naxa e faxa santidɛgɛma ra, xɛmɛe nun xurusee. E naxa tɛ fan so e xa taa birin na.

sentences.english: Now the men of Israel had taken an oath in Mizpah, saying, Not one of us will give his daughter as a wife to Benjamin.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xɛmɛe nu bara e yɛtɛ rakali Misipa, a falafe ra, «Mixi yo naxa a xa di ginɛ fi Bunyaminka nde ma.»

sentences.english: And the people came to Beth-el, waiting there till evening before God, and gave themselves up to bitter weeping.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa siga Beteli, e naxa lu Ala ya i han nunmare. E naxa wa e xui itexi ra.

sentences.english: And they said, O Lord, the God of Israel, why has this fate come on Israel, that today one tribe has been cut off from Israel?
sentences.susu: E nu fa a fala, «Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɔnsɔɛ nde baxi muxu ra munfe ra?»

sentences.english: Then on the day after, the people got up early and made an altar there, offering burned offerings and peace-offerings.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, e naxa keli subaxɛ ma, e sɛrɛxɛbade yailan, e fa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ba Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel said, Who is there among all the tribes of Israel, who did not come up to the Lord at the meeting of all Israel? For they had taken a great oath that whoever did not come up to Mizpah to the Lord was to be put to death.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa a maxɔrin, «Xabilɛ mundun mu na won ya ma to naxan mu faxi Alatala xa malanyi?» E nu bara e rakali mixi xili ma naxan mu fama Alatala xa malanyi Misipa. E nu bara a fala na kanyi xa faxa.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel were moved with pity for Benjamin their brother, saying, Today one tribe has been cut off from Israel.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa kinikini e ngaxakerenyi Bunyaminkae ma, e nu fa a fala, «To lɔxɔɛ bɔnsɔɛ keren bara ba Isirayila ra.

sentences.english: What are we to do about wives for those who are still living? For we have taken an oath by the Lord that we will not give them our daughters for wives.
sentences.susu: Won munse rabama e bɛ alako e xa ginɛe sɔtɔ, barima won tan bara won kali Alatala ra, won mu won ma di ginɛe fima e ma?»

sentences.english: And they said, Which one of the tribes of Israel did not come up to Mizpah to the Lord? And it was seen that no one had come from Jabesh-gilead to the meeting.
sentences.susu: Na kui, e naxa a fala, «Xabilɛ nde na Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe ya ma naxan mu te Alatala yire Misipa?» E naxa a mato fa Yabɛsi Galadi mixi yo mu nu na e ya ma.

sentences.english: For when the people were numbered, not one man of the people of Jabesh-gilead was present.
sentences.susu: E to ɲama mato, e naxa a kolon Yabɛsi Galadi xabilɛ mu nu na e ya ma.

sentences.english: So they (the meeting) sent twelve thousand of the best fighting-men, and gave them orders, saying, Go and put the people of Jabesh-gilead to the sword without mercy, with their women and their little ones.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa sɔɔri wulu fu nun firin xɛɛ Yabɛsi Galadi e xa mixi birin, ginɛe nun dimɛdie, faxa santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: And this is what you are to do: every male, and every woman who has had sex relations with a man, you are to put to the curse, but you are to keep safe the virgins. And they did so.
sentences.susu: «Wo lan nɛ wo xa mɛnni xɛmɛ birin faxa. Wo man xa ginɛe faxa naxee mu findixi ginɛdimɛdi ra.»

sentences.english: Now there were among the people of Jabesh-gilead four hundred young virgins who had never had sex relations with a man; these they took to their tents in Shiloh in the land of Canaan.
sentences.susu: E naxa ginɛdimɛdi kɛmɛ naani li Yabɛsi Galadi, naxee mu xɛmɛ fe kolon. E naxa e xanin Silo Kanaan bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And all the meeting sent to the men of Benjamin who were in the rock of Rimmon, offering them peace.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Bunyamin xa die xɔn ma naxee nu na Rimɔn geya mabiri. E naxa lanyi wɔyɛnyi masen e bɛ.

sentences.english: Then Benjamin came back; and they gave them the women whom they had kept from death among the women of Jabesh-gilead: but still there were not enough for them.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Bunyaminkae naxa gbilen Isirayila bɔxi ma. Isirayilakae naxa Yabɛsi Galadi ginɛe so e yi ra, kɔnɔ e birin mu ginɛ sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the people were moved with pity for Benjamin, because the Lord had let his wrath loose on the tribes of Israel.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa kinikini e ma, barima Alatala nu bara a ragiri nde xa ba Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe ra.

sentences.english: Then the responsible men of the meeting said, What are we to do about wives for the rest of them, seeing that the women of Benjamin are dead?
sentences.susu: Forie naxa a fala, «Won munse rabama e bɛ alako naxee mu ginɛ sɔtɔ, e fan xa ginɛ ndee dɔxɔ? Bunyaminka ginɛ birin bara faxa.

sentences.english: And they said, How is the rest of Benjamin to be given offspring so that one tribe of Israel may not be put out of existence,
sentences.susu: A lanma e xa kɛ tongoe sɔtɔ, alako bɔnsɔɛ nde naxa ba Isirayila ya ma.

sentences.english: Seeing that we may not give them our daughters as wives? For the children of Israel had taken an oath, saying, Cursed is he who gives a wife to Benjamin.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ won mu nɔma won ma die sode e yi ra, barima won bara won nakali, ‹Mixi naxan a xa di ginɛ fima Bunyaminka nde ma, na kanyi xa danka.›»

sentences.english: And they said, See, every year there is a feast of the Lord in Shiloh, which is to the north of Beth-el, on the east side of the highway which goes up from Beth-el to Shechem, and on the south of Lebonah.
sentences.susu: «Awa, won naxan nabama, na nan yi ki. Ɲɛ yo ɲɛ sali nde rabama Silo, Beteli kɔɔla ma, Beteli nun Sikemi kira fuge ra, Lebona yirefanyi ma.»

sentences.english: And they said to the men of Benjamin, Go into the vine-gardens, waiting there secretly,
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala Bunyaminkae bɛ, «Wo siga, wo sa wo nɔxun wɛni bilie xɔɔra.

sentences.english: And watching; and if the daughters of Shiloh come out to take part in the dances, then come from the vine-gardens and take a wife for every one of you from among the daughters of Shiloh, and go back to the land of Benjamin.
sentences.susu: Silo ginɛe na mini fare boronde, wo xa mini wɛni bilie xɔɔra, wo xa Silo ginɛ ndee tongo wo yɛtɛ bɛ, wo man xa gbilen Bunyamin bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And when their fathers or their brothers come and make trouble, you are to say to them, Give them to us as an act of grace; for we did not take them as wives for ourselves in war; and if you yourselves had given them to us you would have been responsible for the broken oath.
sentences.susu: Xa e baba, xa na mu a ra e taarae, fa wo kalamude muxu xɔn, muxu a falama nɛ e bɛ, ‹Wo xa diɲɛ e ma muxu xa fe ra, barima muxu mu ginɛ sɔtɔxi e xa sɔɔri birin bɛ. Wo tan xa mu wo xa die fixi e ma. Na kui wo mu na marakali kanaxi.›»

sentences.english: So the men of Benjamin did this, and got wives for themselves for every one of their number, taking them away by force from the dance; then they went back to their heritage, building up their towns and living in them.
sentences.susu: Bunyamin xa die naxa na birin naba. E naxa ginɛ tongo e xa kɔnti ma ginɛe ya ma, naxee nu na fare boronfe. E naxa e xanin e xa bɔxi ma, e man naxa e xa taae ti, e sabati naa.

sentences.english: Then the children of Israel went away from there, every man to his tribe and his family, every man went back to his heritage.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae fan naxa gbilen e xɔnyi, e bɔnsɔɛ nun xabilɛ nu na bɔxi naxan ma.

sentences.english: In those days there was no king in Israel: every man did what seemed right to him.
sentences.susu: Na waxati mangɛ yo mu nu na Isirayila. Kankan nu a waxɔnfe nan nabama.

sentences.english: Now there came a time, in the days of the judges, when there was no food in the land. And a certain man went from Beth-lehem-judah, he and his wife and his two sons, to make a living-place in the country of Moab.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa kiitisae xa waxati, kaamɛ din nɛ Isirayila bɔxi ra. Xɛmɛ nde naxa keli Bɛtɛlɛɛmu, naxan nu na Yudaya bɔxi ma. A naxa tunu Mowaba bɔxi ma, a tan, a xa ginɛ, nun a xa di firinyie.

sentences.english: And the name of the man was Elimelech, and the name of his wife Naomi, and the name of his two sons Mahlon and Chilion, Ephrathites of Beth-lehem-judah. And they came into the country of Moab, and were there for some time.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ xili Elimeleki, a xa ginɛ Nowemi, a xa die, Maxalɔn nun Kiliyon. E fatan Efarata xabilɛ nan ma. E naxa sa sabati Mowaba bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Elimelech, Naomi's husband, came to his end; and only her two sons were with her.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Nowemi xa mɔri Elimeleki naxa faxa. Nowemi naxa lu naa fa, a nun a xa di firinyie.

sentences.english: And they took two women of Moab as their wives: the name of the one was Orpah, and the name of the other Ruth; and they went on living there for about ten years.
sentences.susu: Na di firinyie naxa Mowaba ginɛe dɔxɔ. Ginɛ singe xili Oropa, a firin nde Ruti. E naxa lu mɛnni han ɲɛ fu.

sentences.english: And Mahlon and Chilion came to their end; and the woman was without her two sons and her husband.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi Maxalɔn nun Kiliyon fan naxa faxa. Nowemi naxa lu naa fa a keren. Xɛmɛ mu na, di mu na.

sentences.english: So she and her daughters-in-law got ready to go back from the country of Moab, for news had come to her in the country of Moab that the Lord, in mercy for his people, had given them food.
sentences.susu: Nowemi to a mɛ a Alatala bara a xa ɲama mali baloe fe ra,

sentences.english: And she went out of the place where she was, and her two daughters-in-law with her; and they went on their way to go back to the land of Judah.
sentences.susu: Nowemi nun a xa die xa ginɛ firinyie naxa keli Mowaba bɔxi ma, e nu sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ. E to kira li naxan sigama Yudaya bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: And Naomi said to her two daughters-in-law, Go back to your mothers' houses: may the Lord be good to you as you have been good to the dead and to me:
sentences.susu: Nowemi naxa a fala a xa die xa ginɛe bɛ, «Wo xa gbilen wo ngae xɔnyi. Alatala xa hinnɛ wo ra, alɔ wo a rabaxi n tan nun n ma die bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: May the Lord give you rest in the houses of your husbands. Then she gave them a kiss; and they were weeping bitterly.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa xɛmɛ fi wo ma, wo sabatima naxan xɔn bɔɲɛsa kui.» Nowemi naxa findigilin e ma, kinikini naxa e rawa.

sentences.english: And they said to her, No, but we will go back with you to your people.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala a bɛ, «Ade, na mu lanma. Won birin xa siga i bɔnsɔɛ yire.»

sentences.english: But Naomi said, Go back, my daughters; why will you come with me? Have I more sons in my body, to become your husbands?
sentences.susu: Nowemi naxa e yaabi, «N ma mamadie, wo xa gbilen. Munfe ra wo wama birafe n fɔxɔ ra? N tan nɔma di gbɛtɛe baride sɔnɔn wo dɔxɔma naxee xɔn?

sentences.english: Go back, my daughters, and go on your way; I am so old now that I may not have another husband. If I said, I have hopes, if I had a husband tonight, and might have sons,
sentences.susu: N ma mamadie, fo wo xa gbilen wo xɔnyi. N bara fori. N mu nɔma xɛmɛ gbɛtɛ sɔtɔde sɔnɔn. Hali n sa xɛmɛ gbɛtɛ sɔtɔ to, n fa di bari to kɔɛ ra,

sentences.english: Would you keep yourselves till they were old enough? would you keep from having husbands for them? No, my daughters; but I am very sad for you that the hand of the Lord is against me.
sentences.susu: wo nɔma na di mɛmɛde han a mɔ wo fa dɔxɔ a xɔn ma? Wo nɔma na ra? N ma mamadie, wo mu nɔma na ra. Na xɔrɔxɔ. Wo nɔma tondide xɛmɛ gbɛtɛ bɛ, han n ma die mɔ? Alatala naxan nagirixi n ma, a xɔrɔxɔ dangife wo xa tɔɔrɛ ra. Alatala bara n tɔɔrɔ ki fanyi.»

sentences.english: Then again they were weeping; and Orpah gave her mother-in-law a kiss, but Ruth would not be parted from her.
sentences.susu: Na kui Oropa nun Ruti man naxa wa fɔlɔ. Oropa naxa findigilin Nowemi ma, a fa gbilen a xɔnyi, kɔnɔ Ruti tan naxa kankan Nowemi ma.

sentences.english: And Naomi said, See, your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her gods: go back after your sister-in-law.
sentences.susu: Nowemi naxa a fala a bɛ, «Ruti, Oropa bara gbilen a xa mixie xɔnyi. A bara gbilen a xa diinɛ ma. I tan fan, i xa bira a fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: But Ruth said, Give up requesting me to go away from you, or to go back without you: for where you go I will go; and where you take your rest I will take my rest; your people will be my people, and your God my God.
sentences.susu: Ruti naxɛ, «I naxa n karaxan n xa gbilen i fɔxɔ ra. I naxa n keri. I nu siga dɛdɛ, n fan sigama mɛnni nɛ. Won sabatima nɛ yire keren. I xa mixie findima n ma mixie nan na. I Marigi Ala findima n fan Marigi nan na.

sentences.english: Wherever death comes to you, death will come to me, and there will be my last resting-place; the Lord do so to me and more if we are parted by anything but death.
sentences.susu: N luma i sɛɛti ma han i faxa, n fa ragata i xa gaburi sɛɛti ma. Xa n i bɛɲin, Alatala xa i haakɛ mini n i. Saya gbansan xa won nafatan.»

sentences.english: And when she saw that Ruth was strong in her purpose to go with her she said no more.
sentences.susu: Nowemi to a kolon, Ruti xa natɛ mu masarama, a naxa dundu.

sentences.english: So the two of them went on till they came to Beth-lehem. And when they came to Beth-lehem all the town was moved about them, and they said, Is this Naomi?
sentences.susu: E firin naxa ti kira xɔn ma han Bɛtɛlɛɛmu. E to so taa kui, ɲama naxa tɛrɛnna e tofe ra. Ginɛe nu fa maxɔrinyi ti, «Nowemi nan ya?»

sentences.english: And she said to them, Do not let my name be Naomi, but Mara, for the Ruler of all has given me a bitter fate.
sentences.susu: Nowemi nu fa e yaabi, «N mu xilima Nowemi sɔnɔn. Wo xa n xili Mara, barima Ala Sɛnbɛma bara n ma duniɲɛigiri raxɔrɔxɔ n ma.» («Nowemi» wama a falafe nɛ «a ɲɔxun.» «Mara» wama a falafe nɛ «a xɔnɔ.»)

sentences.english: I went out full, and the Lord has sent me back again with nothing; why do you give me the name Naomi, seeing that the Lord has given witness against me, and the Ruler of all has sent sorrow on me?
sentences.susu: «N siga sigama, n nun fe fanyi nan siga, kɔnɔ Alatala bara n nagbilen n bɛlɛxɛ igeli ra. Munfe ra wo n xilima Nowemi? Alatala Sɛnbɛma bara ti n kanke, a bara ɲaxankatɛ dɔxɔ n ma.»

sentences.english: So Naomi came back out of the country of Moab, and Ruth the Moabitess, her daughter-in-law, with her; and they came to Beth-lehem in the first days of the grain-cutting.
sentences.susu: Nowemi gbilen a xɔnyi na ki nɛ, a tan nun a xa di xa ginɛ Ruti Mowabaka. E soxi Bɛtɛlɛɛmu funden maniyɛ xaba tɛmui nɛ.

sentences.english: And Naomi had a relation of her husband, a man of wealth, of the family of Elimelech; and his name was Boaz.
sentences.susu: Sɛnbɛma nde nu na Isirayila bɔxi ma, naxan xili Boosu. A fatan Elimeleki xabilɛ nan na.

sentences.english: And Ruth the Moabitess said to Naomi, Now let me go into the field and take up the heads of grain after him in whose eyes I may have grace. And she said to her, Go, my daughter.
sentences.susu: Ruti Mowabaka naxa a fala Nowemi bɛ, «N wama sigafe xɛ ma funden maniyɛ dɔnxɔɛe matongode. Tɛmunde n xɛ kanyi nde toma naxan hinnɛma n na.» Nowemi naxɛ, «Awa n ma mamadi, i n lima be.»

sentences.english: And she went, and came and took up the heads of grain in the field after the cutters; and by chance she went into that part of the field which was the property of Boaz, who was of the family of Elimelech.
sentences.susu: Ruti naxa siga funden maniyɛ dɔnxɔɛe matongode xɛ walikɛe xanbi ra. Alatala naxa a ragiri, a xa a xun ti Boosu, Elimeleki xabilɛ mixi nde xa xɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Boaz came from Beth-lehem, and said to the grain-cutters, The Lord be with you. And they made answer, The Lord give you his blessing.
sentences.susu: Na waxati Boosu nu baxi sode keli Bɛtɛlɛɛmu. A naxa a xa walikɛe xɛɛbu, «Wo nu wali, Alatala xa wo ratanga.» E naxa a ratin, «Amina, Alatala xa barakɛ fi i fan ma.»

sentences.english: Then Boaz said to his servant who was in authority over the cutters, Whose girl is this?
sentences.susu: Boosu naxa maxɔrinyi ti walikɛe xunyi ma, «Nde na na sungbutunyi ra?»

sentences.english: And the servant who was in authority over the cutters said, It is a Moabite girl who came back with Naomi out of the country of Moab;
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «Na sungbutunyi Mowabaka na a ra, naxan fa Nowemi matide keli Mowaba bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And she said to me, Let me come into the grain-field and take up the grain after the cutters. So she came, and has been here from morning till now, without resting even for a minute.
sentences.susu: A mayandi nan ti a xa funden maniyɛ dɔnxɔɛe matongo walikɛe xanbi ra. Kafi a fa gɛɛsɛgɛ, han yakɔsi a na walife, fo a to a malabufe yi ki bage bun ma.»

sentences.english: Then said Boaz to Ruth, Give ear to me, my daughter: do not go to take up the grain in another field, or go away from here, but keep here by my young women:
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Boosu naxa a fala Ruti bɛ, «N ma di, i tuli mati. I xa lu be n ma walikɛ ginɛe xanbi ra. Hali i mu siga xɛ gbɛtɛ ma funden maniyɛ dɔnxɔɛe matongode.

sentences.english: Keep your eyes on the field they are cutting, and go after them; have I not given orders to the young men not to put a hand on you? And when you are in need of drink go to the vessels and take of what the young men have put there.
sentences.susu: E na siga xɛ naxan ma, i fan xa bira e fɔxɔ ra. N bara ɲungui lu n ma xɛmɛe ma, e naxa i tɔɔrɔ. Xa ye xɔli i suxu, i xa siga ye minde, walikɛe xa ye naxan saxi fɛɲɛ kui.»

sentences.english: Then she went down on her face to the earth, and said to him, Why have I grace in your eyes, that you give attention to me, seeing I am from a strange people?
sentences.susu: Ruti naxa a igoro bɔxi ma ɲɛlɛxinyi saabui ra, a fa a fala, «N tan, beka mu n na, kɔnɔ i bara hinnɛ n na. I hinnɛxi n na munfe ra?»

sentences.english: And Boaz answering said to her, I have had news of everything you have done for your mother-in-law after the death of your husband; how you went away from your father and mother and the land of your birth, and came to a people who are strange to you.
sentences.susu: Boosu naxa a yaabi, «Mixie bara a fala n bɛ, i naxan nabaxi i mama bɛ kafi i xa mɔri naxa faxa. E naxɛ, i bara i baba yo, i nga yo, nun i baride, i bara a birin bɛɲin, i fa siga mixie xɔnyi i mu dɛnnaxɛ kolon.

sentences.english: The Lord give you a reward for what you have done, and may a full reward be given to you by the Lord, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have come to take cover.
sentences.susu: Ala xa i baraayi. Isirayila Marigi Ala xa i sare rakamali, i xaxili tixi Marigi naxan na.»

sentences.english: Then she said, May I have grace in your eyes, my lord, for you have given me comfort, and you have said kind words to your servant, though I am not like one of your servants.
sentences.susu: Ruti naxa a fala Boosu bɛ, «N ma mangɛ, i bara hinnɛ n na, i bara nde ba n ma tɔɔrɛ ra. I xa wɔyɛnyi bara so n tan i xa konyi bɔɲɛ kui, na binyɛ gbo n tan bɛ.»

sentences.english: And at meal-time Boaz said to her, Come here, and take some of the bread, and put your bit into the wine. And she took her seat among the grain-cutters: and he gave her dry grain, and she took it, and there was more than enough for her meal.
sentences.susu: E dɛge waxati Boosu naxa a fala Ruti bɛ, «Fa be, i xa taami nun bɔrɛ nde don.» Ruti naxa dɔxɔ walikɛe fɛ ma. Boosu naxa funden maniyɛ gilinxi nde so a yi ra. A naxa na don han a luga, a fa a dɔnxɔɛ ragata.

sentences.english: And when she got ready to take up the grain, Boaz gave his young men orders, saying, Let her take it even from among the cut grain, and say nothing to her.
sentences.susu: A man to siga funden maniyɛ matongode, Boosu naxa yaamari fi a xa walikɛe ma. A naxɛ, «Hali a so a xabatare fan xɔɔra, wo naxa sɔnxɔ a ma.

sentences.english: And let some heads of grain be pulled out of what has been corded up, and dropped for her to take, and let no sharp word be said to her.
sentences.susu: Wo na funden maniyɛ raxiri, wo xa nde lu naa, a xa na fan matongo. Hali wo mu sese fala a bɛ.»

sentences.english: So she went on getting together the heads of grain till evening; and after crushing out the seed it came to about an ephah of grain.
sentences.susu: Ruti naxa wali han nunmare. A to gɛ walide, a naxa funden maniyɛ bɔnbɔ, a konbo ya firin nan sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And she took it up and went into the town; and she let her mother-in-law see what she had got, and after taking enough for herself she gave her the rest.
sentences.susu: Ruti to so na birin na taa kui, a naxa a masen Nowemi bɛ. A donse naxan don Boosu yire, a naxa na dɔnxɔɛ fan so Nowemi yi ra.

sentences.english: And her mother-in-law said to her, Where did you take up the grain today, and where were you working? May a blessing be on him who gave such attention to you. And she gave her mother-in-law an account of where she had been working, and said, The name of the man with whom I was working today is Boaz.
sentences.susu: Nowemi naxa Ruti maxɔrin, «I walixi xɛ mundun ma to? I yi funden maniyɛ matongoxi minden? Ala xa na mixi baraayi naxan hinnɛxi i ra.» Ruti naxa a birin ya maxaran a mama bɛ. A man naxa a fala, «Mixi naxan n malixi, a xili nɛ Boosu.»

sentences.english: And Naomi said to her daughter-in-law, May the blessing of the Lord, who has at all times been kind to the living and to the dead, be on him. And Naomi said to her, The man is of our family, one of our near relations.
sentences.susu: Nowemi naxa a fala a xa di xa ginɛ bɛ, «Ala xa a baraayi, Ala naxan mu a xa saatɛ fanyi kanama, a fa hinnɛ a xa mixie ra naxee na duniɲa a nun naxee na aligiyama. Yi xɛmɛ lanxi won xabilɛ mixi nde nan ma. Won xabilɛ ratangama nan a ra.»

sentences.english: And Ruth the Moabitess said, Truly, he said to me, Keep near my young men till all my grain is cut.
sentences.susu: Ruti Mowabaka naxa a yaabi, «Na xɛmɛ naxɛ, a n xa wakili a xa walikɛe fɔxɔ ra han funden maniyɛ xabɛ xa ba a ra.»

sentences.english: And Naomi said to Ruth, her daughter-in-law, It is better, my daughter, for you to go out with his servant-girls, so that no danger may come to you in another field.
sentences.susu: Nowemi naxa a fala a xa di xa ginɛ bɛ, «N ma di, a lanma i xa bira a xa walikɛ ginɛe fɔxɔ ra, alako mixi yo naxa i tɔɔrɔ xɛ gbɛtɛe ma.»

sentences.english: So she kept near the servant-girls of Boaz to take up the grain till the cutting of the early grain and the cutting of the late grain were ended; and she went on living with her mother-in-law.
sentences.susu: Na kui Ruti naxa lu Boosu xa walikɛ ginɛe fɔxɔ ra han funden maniyɛ nun mɛngi maniyɛ xabɛ naxa ɲɔn. Ruti sabati Nowemi xɔnyi, na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And Naomi, her mother-in-law, said to her, My daughter, am I not to get you a resting-place where you may be in comfort?
sentences.susu: Nowemi naxa a fala a xa di xa ginɛ bɛ, a naxɛ, «Ruti, n wama i xa xɛmɛ taa fanyi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And now, is there not Boaz, our relation, with whose young women you were? See, tonight he is separating the grain from the waste in his grain-floor.
sentences.susu: I a kolon, Boosu, i sa walixi naxan xɔnyi nun a xa walikɛ ginɛe ra, won xabilɛ nan a ra. To nunmare ra, Boosu sigama lonyi ma funden maniyɛ bɔnbɔde.

sentences.english: So take a bath, and, after rubbing your body with sweet oil, put on your best robe, and go down to the grain-floor; but do not let him see you till he has come to the end of his meal.
sentences.susu: I naxan nabama, i xa i yailan a fanyi ra. I xa i maxa, i labundɛ sa i ma, i i maxiri dugi fanyi ra. Na tɛmui i xa siga lonyi yire. I i ya manɔxun Boosu ma han a xa gɛ a dɛgede.

sentences.english: But see to it, when he goes to rest, that you take note of the place where he is sleeping, and go in there, and, uncovering his feet, take your place by him; and he will say what you are to do.
sentences.susu: A na so a sade, i xa a mato a saxi dɛnnaxɛ. A na xi, i xa a xa dugi ba a sanyie ma, i i sa a san labe ra. A fama i rabafe falade i bɛ.»

sentences.english: And she said, I will do all you say.
sentences.susu: Ruti naxa a yaabi, «Awa, n a birin nabama nɛ alɔ i a falaxi ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: So she went down to the grain-floor and did all her mother-in-law had said to her.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Ruti naxa siga na lonyi ma. A mama naxan falaxi a bɛ, a naxa na raba.

sentences.english: Now when Boaz had taken meat and drink, and his heart was glad, he went to take his rest at the end of the mass of grain; then she came softly and, uncovering his feet, went to rest.
sentences.susu: Boosu to gɛ a dɛgede, a naxa a sa funden maniyɛ kuruxi fɛ ma ɲɛlɛxinyi kui. Ruti naxa a maso a ra dɔyin dɔyin, a dugi ba a sanyie ma, a fa a sa a san labe ra.

sentences.english: Now in the middle of the night, the man awaking from his sleep in fear, and lifting himself up, saw a woman stretched at his feet.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ tagi, Boosu naxa xunu, a naxa ginɛ to a san labe ra.

sentences.english: And he said, Who are you? And she answering said, I am your servant Ruth: take your servant as wife, for you are a near relation.
sentences.susu: A naxa a maxɔrin, «Nde a ra?» Ruti naxa a yaabi, «I xa konyi nan n na. N xili Ruti. N faxi nɛ, xa i nɔma n futide, barima muxu xabilɛ ratangama na i ra.»

sentences.english: And he said, May the Lord give you his blessing, my daughter: even better than what you did at the first is this last kind act you have done, in not going after young men, with or without wealth.
sentences.susu: Boosu naxa a masen a bɛ, «N ma di, Ala xa i baraayi. Yi hinnɛ fan i xa hinnɛ singe bɛ, barima i mu sigaxi sɛgɛtala se kanyi fɔxɔ ra, i mu sigaxi sɛgɛtala setare fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And now, my daughter, have no fear; I will do for you whatever you say: for it is clear to all my townspeople that you are a woman of virtue.
sentences.susu: N ma di, xanmɛri yo naxa lu i yi ra. N a birin nabama nɛ i bɛ i naxan maxɔrinxi, barima ɲama birin a kolon ginɛ fanyi nan i ra.

sentences.english: Now it is true that I am a near relation: but there is a relation nearer than I.
sentences.susu: I bara nɔndi fala. N tan, wo xabilɛ ratangama nan n na, kɔnɔ xabilɛ ratangama gbɛtɛ na naxan makɔrɛ i ra n tan bɛ.

sentences.english: Take your rest here tonight; and in the morning, if he will do for you what it is right for a relation to do, very well, let him do so: but if he will not, then by the living Lord I myself will do so.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ radangi be to. Gɛɛsɛgɛ, xa na mixi tin i ratangade, awa. Xa a mu tin, n tan i ratangama nɛ. N bara n kali Alatala ra! I xa xi be han kuye xa iba.»

sentences.english: And she took her rest at his feet till the morning: and she got up before it was light enough for one to see another. And he said, Let it not come to anyone's knowledge that the woman came to the grain-floor.
sentences.susu: Ruti naxa a sa Boosu san labe ra han subaxɛ ma. A naxa keli beenun soge xa te, barima Boosu mu nu wama mixi xa a kolon yi ginɛ nu na lonyi ma.

sentences.english: And he said, Take your robe, stretching it out in your hands: and she did so, and he took six measures of grain and put them into it, and gave it her to take: and she went back to the town.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xa mafelenyi tongo, a dɛ suxu.» Ruti to a xa mafelenyi dɛ suxu, Boosu naxa funden maniyɛ konbo ya keren sa a kui. Boosu naxa Ruti rate na kote ma, Ruti fa siga taa kui.

sentences.english: And when she came back her mother-in-law said to her, How did it go with you, my daughter? And she gave her an account of all the man had done to her.
sentences.susu: A naxa gbilen a mama Nowemi xɔnyi. Nowemi naxa a maxɔrin, «N ma mamadi, fe bara dangi a fanyi ra?» Ruti naxa a ya maxaran Boosu naxan birin nabaxi a bɛ.

sentences.english: And she said, He gave me these six measures of grain, saying, Do not go back to your mother-in-law with nothing in your hands.
sentences.susu: A naxɛ, «A bara yi funden maniyɛ konbo ya keren fi n ma. A naxɛ n bɛ, ‹I mu gbilenma i mama xɔnyi i bɛlɛxɛ igeli.›»

sentences.english: Then she said, Do nothing now, my daughter, till you see what will come of this; for the man will take no rest till he has put this thing through.
sentences.susu: Nowemi naxa a fala a bɛ, «N ma mamadi, i xa lu be han won xa a kolon yi fe raɲɔnma ki naxɛ. Na xɛmɛ mu a raxarama, fo yi fe xa yailan to yati nɛ.»

sentences.english: And Boaz went up to the public place of the town, and took his seat there: and the near relation of whom he had been talking came by; and Boaz, crying out to him by name, said, Come and be seated here. And he came and was seated.
sentences.susu: Boosu naxa siga taa naadɛ ra, taakae malanma dɛnnaxɛ, a dɔxɔ. Na xabilɛ ratangama, Boosu nu naxan xa fe falama, na naxa fa. Boosu naxa a fala a bɛ, «N ba, fa i magoro be.» A naxa fa, a dɔxɔ.

sentences.english: Then he got ten of the responsible men of the town, and said, Be seated here. And they took their seats.
sentences.susu: Boosu man naxa a fala taa kuntigi fu bɛ, «Wo fa, wo wo magoro be.» E to dɔxɔ,

sentences.english: Then he said to the near relation, Naomi, who has come back from the country of Moab, is offering for a price that bit of land which was our brother Elimelech's:
sentences.susu: Boosu naxa a masen na xabilɛ ratangama bɛ, «Nowemi, naxan kelixi Mowaba, a wama Elimeleki xa bɔxi matife. I a kolon, Elimeleki won taara na a ra.

sentences.english: And it was in my mind to give you the chance of taking it, with the approval of those seated here and of the responsible men of my people. If you are ready to do what it is right for a relation to do, then do it: but if you will not do it, say so to me now; for there is no one who has the right to do it but you, and after you myself. And he said, I will do it.
sentences.susu: N nu wama i xa kolon sɔtɔ na fe ma, i xa na bɔxi xun sara taakae nun taa kuntigie ya xɔri. Xa i nɔma a xun sarade, i xa a raba. Xa i mu nɔma na ra, a fala n bɛ, alako n xa a kolon, barima mixi gbɛtɛ mu nɔma a xun sarade fo i xa i xui fi. N tan nan i xanbi ra.» Na xɛmɛ naxa a yaabi, «N a xun sarama nɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Boaz said, On the day when you take this field, you will have to take with it Ruth, the Moabitess, the wife of the dead, so that you may keep the name of the dead living in his heritage.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Boosu naxa yi wɔyɛnyi sa na fari, a naxɛ, «I nɛ yi bɔxi sarama lɔxɔɛ naxɛ Nowemi nun Ruti Mowabaka ma, i man xa na kaaɲɛ ginɛ fan dɔxɔ, alako faxamixi xili naxa lɔɛ na bɔxi xun ma.»

sentences.english: And the near relation said, I am not able to do the relation's part, for fear of damaging the heritage I have: you may do it in my place, for I am not able to do it myself.
sentences.susu: Na xabilɛ ratangama naxa a yaabi, «Na kui n mu nɔma a xun sarade, xa na mu a ra n yɛtɛ kɛ kanama nɛ. I xa a xun sara, n tan mu nɔma.»

sentences.english: Now, in earlier times this was the way in Israel when property was taken over by a near relation, or when there was a change of owner. To make the exchange certain one man took off his shoe and gave it to the other; and this was a witness in Israel.
sentences.susu: Singe ra Isirayila bɔxi ma, xa mixi nde nu wama lanyi xirife, fo a xa sankiri ba, a xa a so a boore yi ra. Na nan a masenma lanyi bara gɛ xiride.

sentences.english: So the near relation said to Boaz, Take it for yourself. And he took off his shoe.
sentences.susu: Na kui, na xabilɛ ratangama to a fala Boosu bɛ, «I xa na bɔxi xun sara i yɛtɛ bɛ,» a naxa a xa sankiri ba, a a so Boosu yi ra.

sentences.english: Then Boaz said to the responsible men and to all the people, You are witnesses today that I have taken at a price from Naomi all the property which was Elimelech's, and everything which was Chilion's and Mahlon's.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi Boosu naxa a masen taa kuntigie nun ɲama bɛ, «Wo bara findi seedee ra to. Elimeleki, Kilɔn, nun Maxalɔn xa see, n bara e birin sara Nowemi ma.

sentences.english: And, further, I have taken Ruth, the Moabitess, who was the wife of Mahlon, to be my wife, to keep the name of the dead man living in his heritage, so that his name may not be cut off from among his countrymen, and from the memory of his town: you are witnesses this day.
sentences.susu: Maxalɔn xa ginɛ, Ruti Mowabaka, n bara na fan dɔxɔ alako faxamixi xili naxa lɔɛ a xa bɔxi xun ma, a xabilɛ nun a xa taa mixie naxa nɛɛmu a xa fe ma. To wo bara findi yi fe seedee ra.»

sentences.english: And all the people who were in the public place, and the responsible men, said, We are witnesses. May the Lord make this woman, who is about to come into your house, like Rachel and Leah, which two were the builders of the house of Israel: and may you have wealth in Ephrathah, and be great in Beth-lehem;
sentences.susu: Ɲama nun kuntigie naxa a yaabi, «Muxu bara tin findide seedee ra! Muxu bara Alatala maxandi yi ginɛ bɛ naxan sofe i xɔnyi. Alatala xa a lu alɔ Raxele nun Leya naxee bara die sɔtɔ, e findi Isirayila ɲama ra. Alatala xa sɛnbɛ fi i ma Efarata xabilɛ ya ma. Alatala xa xili xungbe fi i ma Bɛtɛlɛɛmu taa kui.

sentences.english: May your family be like the family of Perez, the son whom Tamar gave to Judah, from the offspring which the Lord may give you by this young woman.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa di gbegbe fi i ma yi sungbutunyi saabui ra. Alatala xa wo xa die findi denbaya ra alɔ Peresi xa denbaya, Peresi naxan Tamari barixi Yuda bɛ.»

sentences.english: So Boaz took Ruth and she became his wife; and he went in to her, and the Lord made her with child and she gave birth to a son.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Boosu naxa Ruti xa futi xiri. E to lu yire keren, Alatala naxa a ragiri Ruti xa tɛgɛ, a di sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the women said to Naomi, A blessing on the Lord, who has not let you be this day without a near relation, and may his name be great in Israel.
sentences.susu: Na kui ginɛe naxa a fala Nowemi bɛ, «Ala tantu, barima Alatala bara xabilɛ ratangama fi i ma. Isirayilakae xa tantui rasiga Ala ma!

sentences.english: He will be a giver of new life to you, and your comforter when you are old, for your daughter-in-law, who, in her love for you, is better than seven sons, has given birth to him.
sentences.susu: Yi di fama mɛɛnide i ma, a i kantama i xa ɲɛlɛxɛforiɲa kui. I xa mamadi Ruti, naxan yi di sɔtɔxi i bɛ, a fan i xanuma, a tide gbo i bɛ dangi di solofere ra.»

sentences.english: And Naomi took the child and put her arms round it, and she took care of it.
sentences.susu: Nowemi naxa na diyɔrɛ tongo, a a sa a kanke ma, a findi a mɛɛnima ra.

sentences.english: And the women who were her neighbours gave it a name, saying, Naomi has a child; and they gave him the name of Obed: he is the father of Jesse, the father of David.
sentences.susu: Nowemi dɔxɔboore ginɛe naxa xili sa yi diyɔrɛ xun ma, a falafe ra, «Nowemi bara di sɔtɔ, a xili Obedo.» Obedo xa di nan Yisayi ra. Yisayi xa di nan Dawuda ra.

sentences.english: Now these are the generations of Perez: Perez became the father of Hezron;
sentences.susu: Peresi xa taruxui nan ya: Peresi naxa Heseron sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Hezron became the father of Ram, and Ram became the father of Amminadab;
sentences.susu: Heseron naxa Rami sɔtɔ. Rami naxa Aminadabo sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, and Nahshon became the father of Salmon;
sentences.susu: Aminadabo naxa Naxason sɔtɔ. Naxason naxa Salimon sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Salmon became the father of Boaz, and Boaz became the father of Obed;
sentences.susu: Salimon naxa Boosu sɔtɔ. Boosu naxa Obedo sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Obed became the father of Jesse, and Jesse became the father of David.
sentences.susu: Obedo naxa Yisayi sɔtɔ. Yisayi naxa Dawuda sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim, a Zuphite of the hill-country of Ephraim, named Elkanah; he was the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite:
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ nde nu na Ramatayimi taa kui, Sofimu yire, Efirami geya longori, naxan xili Elekana. Efirami bɔnsɔɛ nan nu a ra, fatanfe a benba Sufu, Tohu, nun Elihu ra. Yeroxama xa di nan nu a ra.
