sentences.english: And he had two wives, one named Hannah and the other Peninnah: and Peninnah was the mother of children, but Hannah had no children.
sentences.susu: A ginɛ firin nan dɔxɔ: Ani nun Peninna. Peninna nu bara die bari, kɔnɔ di yo mu nu na Ani tan yi ra.

sentences.english: Now this man went up from his town every year to give worship and to make offerings to the Lord of armies in Shiloh. And the two sons of Eli, Hophni and Phinehas, the priests of the Lord, were there.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ yo ɲɛ Elekana nu kelima a xɔnyi, a siga Silo, a xa Alatala Mangɛ Xungbe batu, a sɛrɛxɛ ba a bɛ. Eli xa di firinyie, Xofini nun Finexasi, nan nu na Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra mɛnni na tɛmui.

sentences.english: And when the day came for Elkanah to make his offering, he gave to Peninnah his wife, and to all her sons and daughters, their part of the feast:
sentences.susu: Elekana nɛ a xa sɛrɛxɛ bama, a nu darixi sɛrɛxɛ sube nde fi ra a xa ginɛ Peninna nun na xa die ma.

sentences.english: But to Hannah he gave one part, though Hannah was very dear to him, but the Lord had not let her have children.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a nu naxan fima a xa ginɛ Ani tan ma, na gbo boore gbe bɛ. A nu na rabama nɛ barima Ani nu rafan a ma ki fanyi ra, hali Alatala to mu nu di fe ragiri na ma.

sentences.english: And the other wife did everything possible to make her unhappy, because the Lord had not let her have children;
sentences.susu: A siina nu a mayelema tɛmui birin a xa dibaritareɲa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And year by year, whenever she went up to the house of the Lord, she kept on attacking her, so that Hannah gave herself up to weeping and would take no food.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ yo ɲɛ, Ani nɛ tema Alatala batu banxi, a siina Peninna nu a mayelema han a nu tondi a dɛgede, a bɔnbɔ wa tun na.

sentences.english: Then her husband Elkanah said to her, Hannah, why are you weeping? and why are you taking no food? why is your heart troubled? am I not more to you than ten sons?
sentences.susu: A xa mɔri Elekana nu a maxɔrin, «Munfe ra, i tondima i dɛgede, i nu fa wa? Munfe ra i nimisaxi? N tan mu i wasa dangi di fu ra?»

sentences.english: So after they had taken food and wine in the guest room, Hannah got up. Now Eli the priest was seated by the pillars of the doorway of the Temple of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Yi biyaasi tan, Elekana xa mixie to gɛ e dɛgede nun e minde Silo, Ani tan naxa keli e ya ma, a siga Alatala batu banxi. Eli sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nu magoroxi naa a xa dɔxɔse ma naadɛ fɛ ma.

sentences.english: And with grief in her soul, weeping bitterly, she made her prayer to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ani bɔɲɛ to maɲaaxuxi a ra, a naxa Alatala maxandi yaye gbegbe ra.

sentences.english: And she made an oath, and said, O Lord of armies, if you will truly take note of the sorrow of your servant, not turning away from me but keeping me in mind, and will give me a man-child, then I will give him to the Lord all the days of his life, and his hair will never be cut.
sentences.susu: Na kui a naxa laayidi tongo Alatala bɛ a falafe ra, «Alatala Mangɛ Xungbe, xa i sa i ya ragoro i xa konyi ginɛ xa yaagi ma, xa i sa ratu n ma, xa i mu nɛɛmu i xa konyi ginɛ ma, xa i di xɛmɛ keren fi i xa konyi ginɛ ma, n na fima nɛ i ma a xa simaya birin kui, a xunyi mu bima feo.»

sentences.english: Now while she was a long time in prayer before the Lord, Eli was watching her mouth.
sentences.susu: A xa Ala maxandi xɔn to kuya, Eli naxa Ani rakɔrɔsi a dɛ ramaxama,

sentences.english: For Hannah's prayer came from her heart, and though her lips were moving she made no sound: so it seemed to Eli that she was overcome with wine.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ xui yo mu minima. Ani nu wɔyɛnfe a bɔɲɛ nan ma, kɔnɔ Eli tan ɲɔxɔ a ma a a siisixi nɛ.

sentences.english: And Eli said to her, How long are you going to be the worse for drink? Put away the effects of your wine from you.
sentences.susu: Na kui a naxa a fala a bɛ, «I luma yi siisi kui han mun tɛmui? Sa na raba yire gbɛtɛ!»

sentences.english: And Hannah, answering him, said, No, my lord, I am a woman whose spirit is broken with sorrow: I have not taken wine or strong drink, but I have been opening my heart before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ani naxa a yaabi, «N marigi, n mu wɛni minxi, n mu bere minxi. N na n ma kɔntɔfili nan masenfe Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: Do not take your servant to be a good-for-nothing woman: for my words have come from my stored-up sorrow and pain.
sentences.susu: I naxa n maɲɔxun siisila ra. N ma tɔɔrɛ xa gboe nan a niyaxi, n na n bɔɲɛ ma fe masenfe Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Eli said to her, Go in peace: and may the God of Israel give you an answer to the prayer you have made to him.
sentences.susu: Eli naxa a yaabi, «Awa, siga bɔɲɛsa kui. Isirayila Marigi Ala xa i xa maxandi suxu.»

sentences.english: And she said, May your servant have grace in your eyes. So the woman went away, and took part in the feast, and her face was no longer sad.
sentences.susu: Ani naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xa hinnɛ n tan i xa konyi ginɛ ra.» Na dangi xanbi, a naxa a dɛge, a bɔɲɛ naxa rafan a ma, a yatagi naxa masara.

sentences.english: And early in the morning they got up, and after worshipping before the Lord they went back to Ramah, to their house: and Elkanah had connection with his wife; and the Lord kept her in mind.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Elekana nun a xa denbaya naxa kurun. E to gɛ salide, e naxa gbilen e xɔnyi Rama. Na dangi xanbi, Elekana nun a xa ginɛ Ani naxa kafu, Alatala fa ratu a xa fe ma.

sentences.english: Now the time came when Hannah, being with child, gave birth to a son; and she gave him the name Samuel, Because, she said, I made a prayer to the Lord for him.
sentences.susu: Ani naxa tɛɛgɛ, a fa di xɛmɛ bari, a a xili sa Samuweli, naxan nu wama a falafe, «Alatala bara a mɛ.» A na xili saxi nɛ a xun ma barima a nu a falama a yɛtɛ ma, «N yi di maxandixi Alatala nan ma.»

sentences.english: And the man Elkanah with all his family went up to make the year's offering to the Lord, and to give effect to his oath.
sentences.susu: Na ɲɛ igbilenyi Elekana nun a xa denbaya man naxa te Silo sɛrɛxɛ bade Alatala bɛ, a man xa a xa laayidi rakamali.

sentences.english: But Hannah did not go, for she said to her husband, I will not go till the child has been taken from the breast, and then I will take him with me and put him before the Lord, where he may be for ever.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ani tan mu te. A naxa a fala a xa mɔri bɛ, «N xa mamɛ ti han diyɔrɛ dɛ ba tɛmui, n fa a xanin Silo a dɛntɛgɛde Alatala bɛ, a xa lu naa kerenyi ra.»

sentences.english: And her husband Elkanah said to her, Do whatever seems right to you, but not till you have taken him from the breast; only may the Lord do as he has said. So the woman, waiting there, gave her son milk till he was old enough to be taken from the breast.
sentences.susu: A xa mɔri naxa a yaabi, «Naxan nafan i ma, na raba. Lu be han a dɛ ba tɛmui. Alatala xa a xa masenyi rakamali.» Na kui Ani naxa lu banxi han a xa di dɛ ba tɛmui.

sentences.english: Then when she had done so, she took him with her, with a three-year old ox and an ephah of meal and a skin full of wine, and took him to the house of the Lord at Shiloh: now the child was still very young.
sentences.susu: A to Samuweli dɛ ba, a naxa a xanin Silo Alatala batu banxi, a nun tura ɲɛ saxan daaxi, farin kilo fu, nun wɛni. Na tɛmui a xa diyɔrɛ nu xurun.

sentences.english: And when they had made an offering of the ox, they took the child to Eli.
sentences.susu: E naxa tura kɔn naxaba sɛrɛxɛ ra, e fa diyɔrɛ dɛntɛgɛ Eli bɛ.

sentences.english: And she said, O my lord, as your soul is living, my lord, I am that woman who was making a prayer to the Lord here by your side:
sentences.susu: Ani naxa a fala a bɛ, «N marigi, i haakɛ to n bɛ. Ginɛ naxan fa be Alatala maxandide i ya xɔri, n tan nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: My prayer was for this child; and the Lord has given him to me in answer to my request:
sentences.susu: N nu a maxandife yi di xɛmɛ nan ma fe ra. Alatala bara n ma maxandi suxu.

sentences.english: So I have given him to the Lord; for all his life he is the Lord's. Then he gave the Lord worship there.
sentences.susu: N tan fan wama a fife Alatala ma, a xa lu Alatala sagoe a xa simaya birin kui.» Na dangi xanbi, e naxa suyidi Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And Hannah, in prayer before the Lord, said, My heart is glad in the Lord, my horn is lifted up in the Lord: my mouth is open wide over my haters; because my joy is in your salvation.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Ani yi suuki nan ba Alatala bɛ, «Alatala bara n bɔɲɛ rasɛɛwa, a bara n xun nakeli. N dɛ bara mafulun n yaxuie xili ma, n sɛɛwaxi Alatala xa mali xa fe ra.

sentences.english: No other is holy as the Lord, for there is no other God but you: there is no Rock like our God.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa sɛniyɛnyi maniyɛ mu na. Ala gbɛtɛ yo mu na, bafe a tan na. Sɛnbɛma yo mu na alɔ won Marigi Ala.

sentences.english: Say no more words of pride; let not uncontrolled sayings come out of your mouths: for the Lord is a God of knowledge, by him acts are judged.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo yɛtɛ igbo, na wɔyɛnyi mɔɔli naxa mini wo dɛ i, barima Alatala, Ala nan a ra naxan fe birin kolon, naxan mixi xa wali birin maniyama sikeeli ra.

sentences.english: The bows of the men of war are broken, and the feeble are clothed with strength.
sentences.susu: Gereso sɛnbɛmae xa xali igirama nɛ, kɔnɔ yɛtɛ magoroe sɛnbɛ sɔtɔma.

sentences.english: Those who were full are offering themselves as servants for bread; those who were in need are at rest; truly, she who had no children has become the mother of seven; and she who had a family is wasted with sorrow.
sentences.susu: Naxee singe nu lugaxi, nee nu walima nɛ alako e xa taami sare sɔtɔ, kɔnɔ naxee nu kaamɛxi, nee tan bara wasa. Ginɛ dibaritare di solofere barima nɛ, kɔnɔ dibari bara findi dibaritare ra.

sentences.english: The Lord is the giver of death and life: sending men down to the underworld and lifting them up.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan mixi faxama, a tan nan mixi baloma. A mixi rasigama aligiyama, a tan nan mixi rakelima faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: The Lord gives wealth and takes a man's goods from him: crushing men down and again lifting them up;
sentences.susu: Alatala nan keren mixi rabannama, a tan nan mixi rafuxarima. A mixi itema, a tan nan mixi igoroma.

sentences.english: Lifting the poor out of the dust, and him who is in need out of the lowest place, to give them their place among rulers, and for their heritage the seat of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the Lord's and he has made them the base of the world.
sentences.susu: A misikiinɛ bama a xa setareɲa kui, a niya a xa dɔxɔ kuntigie tagi binyɛ ra. Alatala nan gbe na duniɲa tunxunyie ra, a bɔxi italaxi e tan nan fari.

sentences.english: He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the evil-doers will come to their end in the dark night, for by strength no man will overcome.
sentences.susu: A ɲɔxɔ sama nɛ a batulae ɲɛrɛ ki xɔn ma, kɔnɔ mixi kobie tan lɔɛma nɛ dimi kui. Mixi yo mu geenima a yɛtɛ sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: Those who make war against the Lord will be broken; against them he will send his thunder from heaven: the Lord will be judge of the ends of the earth, he will give strength to his king, lifting up the horn of him on whom the holy oil has been put.
sentences.susu: Alatala matandilae xa fe kanama nɛ. Galanyi bulama e tan nan xili ma. Alatala bɔxi birin makiitima nɛ. A sɛnbɛ fima nɛ a xa mangɛ sugandixi ma, a fa a xa Masiihu sɛnbɛ gbo.»

sentences.english: Then Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child became the servant of the Lord under the direction of Eli the priest.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Elekana naxa gbilen a xɔnyi Rama. A naxa a xa di Samuweli lu Alatala xa wali ra Eli sɛrɛxɛdubɛ fɛ ma.

sentences.english: Now the sons of Eli were evil and good-for-nothing men, having no knowledge of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Fuyante nan nu na Eli xa die ra, naxee mu nu birama Alatala fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And the priests' way with the people was this: when any man made an offering, the priest's servant came while the flesh was being cooked, having in his hand a meat-hook with three teeth;
sentences.susu: Yi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nu walima yi ki nɛ ɲama ra: Mixie to nu fama sɛrɛxɛ bade, e nɛ sɛrɛxɛ sube ɲinma, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa walikɛ nu sube sɔxɔse belebele

sentences.english: This he put into the pot, and everything which came up on the hook the priest took for himself. This they did in Shiloh to all the Israelites who came there.
sentences.susu: ragoroma nɛ tunde kui, xa na mu se ɲin se gbɛtɛ kui, a nu naxan yo sɔxɔ, a a rate, a na soma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nan yi ra. E nu na mɔɔli rabama Isirayilakae birin na naxee nu fama Silo.

sentences.english: And more than this, before the fat was burned, the priest's servant would come and say to the man who was making the offering, Give me some of the flesh to be cooked for the priest; he has no taste for meat cooked in water, but would have you give it uncooked.
sentences.susu: Waxati ndee beenun xuruse ture gan tɛmui xa fɔlɔ, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa walikɛ nu a falama nɛ sɛrɛxɛ kanyi bɛ, «Beenun i xa na sube gan, i xa nde so n yi ra sɛrɛxɛdubɛ bɛ. A mu wama sube ganxi xɔn.»

sentences.english: And if the man said to him, First let the fat be burned, then take as much as you will; then the servant would say, No, you are to give it to me now, or I will take it by force.
sentences.susu: Xa sɛrɛxɛ kanyi a yaabi, «A lanma ture xa gan sinden. Na dangi xanbi, i na wa naxan xɔn, i xa na tongo.» Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa walikɛ nu a yaabima nɛ, «N tondi. Xa i mu tin, n a tongoma sɛnbɛ nan na.»

sentences.english: And the sin of these young men was very great before the Lord; for they gave no honour to the Lord's offerings.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Eli xa die nu yunubi ɲaaxi nan sɔtɔma Alatala ra, barima e mu nu binyɛ yo saxi sɛrɛxɛe ma naxee nu bama a bɛ.

sentences.english: But Samuel did the work of the Lord's house, while he was a child, dressed in a linen ephod.
sentences.susu: Samuweli nu Alatala xa wali rabama nɛ, donma kuye sɛrɛxɛdubɛ daaxi ragoroxi a ma.

sentences.english: And his mother made him a little robe and took it to him every year when she came with her husband for the year's offering.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ yo ɲɛ a nga nun a baba nu fama Silo sɛrɛxɛ bade. A nga nu a sanbama guba di ra.

sentences.english: And every year Eli gave Elkanah and his wife a blessing, saying, May the Lord give you offspring by this woman in exchange for the child you have given to the Lord. And they went back to their house.
sentences.susu: Eli nu Ala maxandima nɛ Elekana nun a xa ginɛ bɛ a falafe ra, «Alatala xa a ragiri i xa ginɛ xa di gbɛtɛe bari i bɛ di ɲɔxɔɛ ra a naxan fixi Alatala ma.» Na dangi xanbi, Elekana nun Ani naxa gbilen e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And the Lord had mercy on Hannah and she gave birth to three sons and two daughters. And the young Samuel became older before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa hinnɛ Ani ra, a fa di xɛmɛ saxan nun di ginɛ firin bari. Na tɛmui Samuweli nu na mɔfe Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: Now Eli was very old; and he had news from time to time of what his sons were doing to all Israel.
sentences.susu: Eli sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxan nu bara fori ki fanyi ra, a naxa a kolon a xa die nu na fe ɲaaxi rabafe Isirayilakae ra. E nun ginɛ naxee nu wali rabama hɔrɔmɔlingira sode dɛ ra, e nu yɛnɛ rabama nee yɛtɛ yati ra.

sentences.english: And he said to them, Why are you doing such things? for from all this people I get accounts of your evil ways.
sentences.susu: Eli naxa a xa die maxɔrin, «Munfe ra wo yi mɔɔli rabama? Ɲama birin wo xa wali kobi nan falafe n bɛ.

sentences.english: No, my sons, the account which is given me, which the Lord's people are sending about, is not good.
sentences.susu: N ma die, wo xa ba na mɔɔli rabafe. N naxan mɛfe wo xun, a mu fan feo. Wo Alatala xa ɲama ramurutama nɛ a xa sɛriyɛ ma.

sentences.english: If one man does wrong to another, God will be his judge: but if a man's sin is against the Lord, who will take up his cause? But they gave no attention to the voice of their father, for it was the Lord's purpose to send destruction on them.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi yunubi raba a boore ra, Ala nan a makiitima, kɔnɔ xa mixi sa yunubi raba Alatala ra, nde xari sama na kanyi bɛ?» Kɔnɔ Eli xa die mu tin e tuli matide e baba ra, barima Ala sago na nu a ra e xa faxa.

sentences.english: And the young Samuel, becoming older, had the approval of the Lord and of men.
sentences.susu: Na fonike Samuweli nu na mɔfe a fanyi ra. A nu rafan Ala ma, a nu rafan mixie ma.

sentences.english: And a man of God came to Eli and said to him, The Lord says, Did I let myself be seen by your father's people when they were in Egypt, servants in Pharaoh's house?
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde namiɲɔnmɛ nde naxa fa Eli yire, a a fala a bɛ, «Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: N mu n yɛtɛ masen xɛ i benbae bɛ Misira, e nu na Firawuna xa yaamari bun ma tɛmui naxɛ?

sentences.english: Did I take him out of all the tribes of Israel to be my priest and to go up to my altar to make the smoke of the offerings go up and to take up the ephod? Did I give to your father's family all the offerings made by fire by the children of Israel?
sentences.susu: N tan nan i benba sugandi Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin tagi, a xa findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra n ma hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, a xa te n ma sɛrɛxɛ gande, a xa surayi gan sɛrɛxɛ ra, a nun a xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ donma kuye ragoro a ma n ya i. Isirayila e xa sɛrɛxɛ ganxi naxan birin fima n ma, n a birin fi i benba bɔnsɔɛ nan ma.»

sentences.english: Why then are you looking with envy on my offerings of meat and of meal which were ordered by my word, honouring your sons before me, and making yourselves fat with all the best of the offerings of Israel, my people?
sentences.susu: «Munfe ra wo n ma hadiyae nun n ma sɛrɛxɛe yelebuma, n naxee yamarixi e xa ba n bɛ n ma banxi kui? Munfe ra i i xa die binyaxi dangi n tan na, alako wo xa wo yɛtɛ rabɔrɔgɛ hadiya singee ra, n ma ɲama Isirayila naxee baxi?

sentences.english: For this reason the Lord God of Israel has said, Truly I did say that your family and your father's people would have their place before me for ever: but now the Lord says, Let it not be so; I will give honour to those by whom I am honoured, and those who have no respect for me will be of small value in my eyes.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n tan Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Singe n nu bara laayidi tongo wo bɛ, wo xa denbaya nun wo benbae xa denbaya xa n ma wali raba, kɔnɔ yakɔsi n bara na natɛ masara, barima n mixi nan binyama naxan n binya, kɔnɔ naxee tan n maberema, n yaagi nan dusuma e xun.

sentences.english: See, the days are coming when your arm and the arm of your father's people will be cut off;
sentences.susu: N fama nɛ i tan nun i xa denbaya sɛnbɛ xun nakanade, xɛmɔxi yo mu toma wo ya ma.

sentences.english: And never again will there be an old man in your family.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa fe na te, i fama tɔɔrɛ sɔtɔde n ma banxi xa fe ra. I xa mixie mu simaya xɔnkuye sɔtɔma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: But one man of your family will not be cut off by my hand, and his eyes will be made dark, and grief will be in his heart: and all the offspring of your family will come to their end by the sword of men.
sentences.susu: I xa mixi nde luma n ma sɛrɛxɛbade xa wali kui, kɔnɔ na findima yaye nun tɔɔrɛ nan na i bɛ. I xa mixie mu simaya xɔnkuye sɔtɔma.»

sentences.english: And this will be the sign to you, which will come on Hophni and Phinehas, your sons; death will overtake them on the same day.
sentences.susu: «Fe naxan i xa di firinyie sɔtɔma, na nan findima i bɛ tɔnxuma ra: Xofini nun Finexasi birin faxama lɔxɔɛ keren nɛ.

sentences.english: And I will make a true priest for myself, one who will do what is in my heart and in my mind: and I will make for him a family which will not come to an end; and his place will be before my holy one for ever.
sentences.susu: N sɛrɛxɛdubɛ tinxinxi nde fenma, naxan n bɔɲɛ nun n xaxili waxɔnfe rabama. N bɔnsɔɛ fima nɛ a ma naxan ɲɛrɛma Masiihu ya i, n naxan sugandima.

sentences.english: Then it will be that the rest of your family, anyone who has not been cut off, will go down on his knees to him for a bit of silver or a bit of bread, and say, Be pleased to put me into one of the priest's places so that I may have a little food.
sentences.susu: I bɔnsɔɛ mixie fama nɛ e magorode a bun ma, alako e xa kɔbiri di sɔtɔ, xa na mu, donse di. E fama a falade a bɛ, ‹Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali nde fi n ma, alako n xa n baloe nde sɔtɔ.›»

sentences.english: Now the young Samuel was the servant of the Lord before Eli. In those days the Lord kept his word secret from men; there was no open vision.
sentences.susu: Na fonike Samuweli nu na Alatala xa wali rabafe Eli fɛ ma. Na tɛmui Alatala mu nu wɔyɛnma mixie bɛ a gbe ra, a xa laamatunyie fan mu nu wuya.

sentences.english: And at that time, when Eli was resting in his place, (now his eyes were becoming clouded so that he was not able to see,)
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ nde ra Eli sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nu saxi a xa konkoe kui. A yae mu nu se toma a fanyi ra, a gbe mu nu luxi a xa findi dɔnxui ra.

sentences.english: And the light of God was still burning, while Samuel was sleeping in the Temple of the Lord where the ark of God was,
sentences.susu: Ala xa lanpui mu nu xubenxi sinden. Samuweli tan nu a saxi Alatala xa banxi kui, saatɛ kankira nu na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: The voice of the Lord said Samuel's name; and he said, Here am I.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Samuweli xili. Samuweli naxa a ratin, «N tan nan ya.»

sentences.english: And running to Eli he said, Here am I, for you said my name. And Eli said, I did not say your name; go to your rest again. So he went back to his bed.
sentences.susu: Na kui a naxa siga a gi ra Eli yire, a a fala a bɛ, «N bara fa i xa xili ma.» Eli naxa a yaabi, «Ade, n mu i xili de. Siga, i i sa.» Samuweli naxa gbilen, a sa a sa.

sentences.english: And again the Lord said, Samuel. And Samuel got up and went to Eli and said, Here am I; for you certainly said my name. But he said in answer, I said nothing, my son; go to your rest again.
sentences.susu: Alatala man naxa Samuweli xili. Samuweli naxa keli, a siga Eli yire, a a fala a bɛ, «I to n xili, n bara fa» Eli naxa a yaabi, «Ade, n mu i xili. Siga, i sa i sa.»

sentences.english: Now at that time Samuel had no knowledge of the Lord, and the revelation of the word of the Lord had not come to him.
sentences.susu: Samuweli mu nu Alatala kolonxi sinden, barima han na tɛmui Alatala mu nu wɔyɛn a bɛ.

sentences.english: And for the third time the Lord said Samuel's name. And he got up and went to Eli and said, Here am I; for you certainly said my name. Then it was clear to Eli that the voice which had said the child's name was the Lord's.
sentences.susu: Alatala man naxa Samuweli xili a saxan nde. Samuweli naxa keli, a siga Eli yire, a a fala a bɛ, «I to n xili, n bara fa.» Na kui Eli naxa a fahaamu a Alatala nan na fonike xilife.

sentences.english: So Eli said to Samuel, Go back: and if the voice comes again, let your answer be, Say on, Lord; for the ears of your servant are open. So Samuel went back to his bed.
sentences.susu: Eli naxa a fala Samuweli bɛ, «Gbilen i sa i sa. I na na xui mɛ sɔnɔn, i xa a ratin, ‹Alatala, wɔyɛn. I xa konyi di a tuli matima i ra.›» Samuweli naxa gbilen, a sa a sa a sade.

sentences.english: Then the Lord came and said as before, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel made answer, Say on, Lord; for the ears of your servant are open.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa fa a yire, a man naxa a xili, «Samuweli, Samuweli.» Samuweli naxa a ratin, «Alatala, wɔyɛn. I xa konyi di a tuli matixi i ra.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Samuel, See, I will do a thing in Israel at which the ears of everyone hearing of it will be burning.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Samuweli bɛ, «N fama nɛ fe nde rabade Isirayila, naxan mixie dɛ ixarama.

sentences.english: In that day I will do to Eli everything which I have said about his family, from first to last.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, n naxan birin falaxi Eli xa denbaya xa fe ra, n a birin nakamalima nɛ, kelife a fɔlɛ han a raɲɔnyi.

sentences.english: And you are to say to him that I will send punishment on his family for ever, for the sin which he had knowledge of; because his sons have been cursing God and he had no control over them.
sentences.susu: N bara a fala a bɛ, a n fama nɛ a xa denbaya ɲaxankatade abadan a xa yunubi xa fe ra. A nu a kolon a a xa die na n maberefe, kɔnɔ a tan mu tɔnyi dɔxɔ e ma.

sentences.english: So I have made an oath to the family of Eli that no offering of meat or of meal which they may make will ever take away the sin of his family.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, n bara n kali Eli xa denbaya xa fe ra, xunsare yo mu na e bɛ. Sɛrɛxɛ nun hadiya mu nɔma e xa yunubie xafaride.»

sentences.english: And Samuel kept where he was, not moving till the time came for opening the doors of the house of God in the morning. And fear kept him from giving Eli an account of his vision.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a sa han gɛɛsɛgɛ, a fa Alatala xa banxi naadɛe rabi. Samuweli nu gaaxuxi a xa laamatunyi yabade Eli bɛ,

sentences.english: Then Eli said, Samuel, my son. And Samuel answering said, Here am I.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Eli naxa a xili, a a fala a bɛ, «N ma di Samuweli.» Samuweli naxa a ratin, «N na be.»

sentences.english: And he said, What did the Lord say to you? Do not keep it from me: may God's punishment be on you if you keep from me anything he said to you.
sentences.susu: Eli naxa a maxɔrin, «Alatala munse masenxi i bɛ? I naxa sese nɔxun n ma. Xa i wɔyɛn keren nɔxun n ma, Ala xa na sare ragbilen i ma, a fa nde sa na fari.»

sentences.english: Then Samuel gave him an account of everything, keeping nothing back. And he said, It is the Lord; let him do what seems good to him.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Samuweli naxa Ala xa masenyi birin nadangi Eli ma, a mu sese nɔxun a ma. Eli naxa a fala, «Alatala nan a ra. A xa a sago raba.»

sentences.english: And Samuel became older, and the Lord was with him and let not one of his words be without effect.
sentences.susu: Samuweli nu na mɔfe, Alatala fan nu na a fɔxɔ ra. A mu Alatala xa masenyi yo rabɛɲinxi.

sentences.english: And it was clear to all Israel from Dan to Beer-sheba that Samuel had been made a prophet of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kelife Dana han Beriseeba, Isirayila birin naxa a kolon a Samuweli findixi Alatala xa namiɲɔnmɛ nan na.

sentences.english: And the Lord was seen again in Shiloh; for the Lord gave to Samuel in Shiloh the revelation of his word.
sentences.susu: Alatala nu luma mini ra Samuweli ma Silo, a a xa masenyi ti a bɛ.

sentences.english: Now at that time the Philistines came together to make war against Israel, and the men of Israel went out to war against the Philistines and took up their position at the side of Eben-ezer: and the Philistines put their forces in position in Aphek.
sentences.susu: Na waxati Samuweli nu Alatala xa masenyi kawandima Isirayilakae birin bɛ. Isirayilakae naxa mini Filisitakae gerede. E naxa yonkin Ebeneseri, Filisitakae naxa sa yonkin Afeki.

sentences.english: And the Philistines put their forces in order against Israel, and the fighting was hard, and Israel was overcome by the Philistines, who put to the sword about four thousand of their army in the field.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa mini a gere ki ma Isirayilakae ya i. Na gere kui e naxa Isirayilakae bɔnbɔ, e mixi wulu naani faxa.

sentences.english: And when the people came back to their tents, the responsible men of Israel said, Why has the Lord let the Philistines overcome us today? Let us get the ark of the Lord's agreement here from Shiloh, so that it may be with us and give us salvation from the hands of those who are against us.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔrie to gbilen yonkin yire, Isirayila forie naxa maxɔrinyi ti, «Munfe ra Alatala a luxi Filisitakae xa won bɔnbɔ to? Won xɛɛ Silo Alatala xa saatɛ kankira tongode. A xa lu won tagi, a xa fa won nakisi won yaxuie ma.»

sentences.english: So the people sent to Shiloh and got the ark of the agreement of the Lord of armies whose resting-place is between the winged ones; and Hophni and Phinehas, the two sons of Eli, were there with the ark of God's agreement.
sentences.susu: E naxa mixie xɛɛ Silo Alatala xa saatɛ kankira tongode, naxan dɔxɔxi malekɛ sawurɛ firinyie tagi. Eli xa di firinyie Xofini nun Finexasi naxa na saatɛ kankira mati han Isirayilakae nu yonkinxi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And when the ark of the Lord's agreement came into the tent-circle, all Israel gave a great cry, so that the earth was sounding with it.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa saatɛ kankira to so yonkinde, Isirayilakae naxa e xui ite han bɔxi fa sɛrɛn.

sentences.english: And the Philistines, hearing the noise of their cry, said, What is this great cry among the tents of the Hebrews? Then it became clear to them that the ark of the Lord had come to the tent-circle.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae to na mɛ, e naxa a fala, «Munse na yi xui gbe ra naxan tefe Isirayilakae xɔnyi yi ki?» E to a kolon a Alatala xa saatɛ kankira bara fa Isirayilakae yonkinde,

sentences.english: And the Philistines, full of fear, said, God has come into their tents. And they said, Trouble is ours! for never before has such a thing been seen.
sentences.susu: e naxa gaaxu, barima e nu a falama, «Ala bara fa e yire. Ɲaxankatɛ na won bɛ, naxan maniyɛ mu toxi sinden.

sentences.english: Trouble is ours! Who will give us salvation from the hands of these great gods? These are the gods who sent all sorts of blows on the Egyptians in the waste land.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na won bɛ. Nde won kantama yi ala sɛnbɛmae ma? Alae nan yi ki naxee gbaloe mɔɔli birin dɔxɔ Misirakae ma gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: Be strong, O Philistines, be men! Do not be servants to the Hebrews as they have been to you: go forward to the fight without fear.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae, won xa limaniya, won xa lu alɔ xɛmɛ sɛnbɛmae, alako Isirayilakae naxa nɔ won na alɔ won tan nɔxi e ra ki naxɛ. Won xa findi xɛmɛ sɛnbɛmae ra, won xa gere so!»

sentences.english: So the Philistines went to the fight, and Israel was overcome, and every man went in flight to his tent: and great was the destruction, for thirty thousand footmen of Israel were put to the sword.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa gere ti, e naxa Isirayilakae bɔnbɔ han e gi e siga e xɔnyi. Na lɔxɔɛ kasarɛ naxa gbo. Isirayilaka mixi wulu tongo saxan naxa faxa na gere kui.

sentences.english: And the ark of God was taken; and Hophni and Phinehas, the sons of Eli, were put to the sword.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa Ala xa saatɛ kankira suxu, e fa Eli xa di firinyie Xofini nun Finexasi faxa.

sentences.english: And a man of Benjamin went running from the fight and came to Shiloh the same day with his clothing out of order and earth on his head.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ mixi nde naxa a gi kelife gere yire han Silo taa kui. A xa dugie ibɔɔxi a ma, xubutanyi soxi a xunyi birin ma.

sentences.english: And when he came, Eli was seated by the wayside watching: and in his heart was fear for the ark of God. And when the man came into the town and gave the news, there was a great outcry.
sentences.susu: A to so, a naxa Eli li, a dɔxɔxi kira dɛ ra, barima a nu kɔntɔfili kui saatɛ kankira xa fe ra. Xɛɛra fe naxan to gere yire a naxa na tagi raba a bɛ, taakae naxa gbelegbele.

sentences.english: And Eli, hearing the noise and the cries, said, What is the reason of this outcry? And the man came quickly and gave the news to Eli.
sentences.susu: Eli to e gbelegbele xui mɛ, a naxa maxɔrinyi ti, «Munfe ra e na gbelegbelefe yi ki?» Xɛɛra naxa fa a yire keren na, a na xibaaru fala a bɛ.

sentences.english: Now Eli was ninety-eight years old, and his eyes were fixed so that he was not able to see.
sentences.susu: Eli nu bara ɲɛ tongo solomanaani nun solomasaxan sɔtɔ, a yae mu nu sese toma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And the man said to Eli, I have come from the army and have come in flight today from the fight. And he said, How did it go, my son?
sentences.susu: Xɛɛra naxa a fala Eli bɛ, «N faxi n gi ra nɛ yi ki kelife gere yire.» Eli naxa a maxɔrin, «N ma di, munse dangixi naa?»

sentences.english: And the man said, Israel went in flight from the Philistines, and there has been great destruction among the people, and your two sons, Hophni and Phinehas, are dead, and the ark of God has been taken.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛra naxa a yaabi, «Isirayila a gixi nɛ Filisitakae ya ra, nee bara nɔ e ra a fanyi ra. I xa di firinyie fan bara faxa, Xofini nun Finexasi. Filisitakae bara Ala xa saatɛ kankira suxu.»

sentences.english: And at these words about the ark of God, Eli, falling back off his seat by the side of the doorway into the town, came down on the earth so that his neck was broken and death overtook him, for he was an old man and of great weight. He had been judging Israel for forty years.
sentences.susu: A fɛfɛ Ala xa saatɛ kankira xa fe mɛ, Eli naxa bira a legere ma taa naadɛ sɛɛti ma. A kobe naxa gira, a naxa faxa, barima xɛmɔxi tirɔnxi nan nu a ra. A nu bara findi Isirayila yarerati ra ɲɛ tongo naani bun ma.

sentences.english: And his daughter-in-law, the wife of Phinehas, was with child and near the time when she would give birth; and when she had the news that the ark of God had been taken and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, her pains came on her suddenly and she gave birth.
sentences.susu: A xa di Finexasi xa ginɛ nu furuxi, a gbe mu nu luxi a xa di bari. A to a mɛ a Ala xa saatɛ kankira bara suxu, a tanun nun a xa mɔri fan bara faxa, a naxa a felen a furi ma xɔnɛ kui, a di bari keren na.

sentences.english: And when she was very near death the women who were with her said, Have no fear, for you have given birth to a son. But she made no answer and gave no attention to it.
sentences.susu: A to nu na faxɛ dɛ nan ma, ginɛe naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xa limaniya, i di xɛmɛ nan barixi.» Kɔnɔ a mu a ɲɔxɔ yo saxi na wɔyɛnyi xɔn ma, a mu a yaabi.

sentences.english: And she gave the child the name of Ichabod, saying, The glory has gone from Israel: because the ark of God was taken and because of her father-in-law and her husband.
sentences.susu: A naxa diyɔrɛ xili sa Ikabodi, naxan nu wama a falafe, «Nɔrɛ bara ɲɔn Isirayila.» A na fala nɛ barima Alatala xa saatɛ kankira nu bara suxu, a xa mɔri nun a tanun fan nu bara faxa.

sentences.english: And she said, The glory is gone from Israel, for the ark of God has been taken.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala, «Nɔrɛ bara ɲɔn Isirayila, barima e bara Alatala xa saatɛ kankira suxu.»

sentences.english: Now the Philistines, having taken the ark of God, took it with them from Eben-ezer to Ashdod.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa Ala xa saatɛ kankira suxu Ebeneseri, e a xanin Asidodi.

sentences.english: They took the ark of God into the house of Dagon and put it by the side of Dagon.
sentences.susu: E naxa a xanin e xa kuye xungbe Dagɔn batu banxi, e sa a dɔxɔ na kuye fɛ ma.

sentences.english: And when the people of Ashdod got up early on the morning after, they saw that Dagon had come down to the earth on his face before the ark of the Lord. And they took Dagon up and put him in his place again.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Asidodikae naxa Dagɔn li, a rabiraxi a ya tagi ma Ala xa saatɛ kankira bun ma. E naxa a rakeli, e a dɔxɔ a dɔxɔde.

sentences.english: And when they got up early on the morning after, Dagon had come down to the earth on his face before the ark of the Lord; and his head and his hands were broken off on the doorstep; only the base was in its place.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, e man naxa Dagɔn li, a man nabiraxi Ala xa saatɛ kankira bun ma, a xunyi nun a bɛlɛxɛe bolonxi, e saxi sode dɛ ra. Kuye gundi nu na a xati ma.

sentences.english: So to this day no priest of Dagon, or any who come into Dagon's house, will put his foot on the doorstep of the house of Dagon in Ashdod.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, han yakɔsi, Dagɔn kuye xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun naxee birin soma Dagɔn batu banxi kui Asidodi, e mu lan e xa e sanyi ti na sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: But the hand of the Lord was hard on the people of Ashdod and he sent disease on them through all the country of Ashdod.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a sɛnbɛ ragoro Asidodikae ma, a kasarɛ gbegbe raba e tagi, a a niya fie xa mini e ma na longori birin.

sentences.english: And when the men of Ashdod saw how it was, they said, Let not the ark of the God of Israel be with us, for his hand is hard on us and on Dagon our god.
sentences.susu: E to na fe to, e naxa a fala, «Isirayila xa Ala xa saatɛ kankira mu luma won xɔnyi, barima a na won tan nun won ma ala Dagɔn ɲaxankatafe ki fanyi.»

sentences.english: So they sent for all the lords of the Philistines to come together there, and said, What are we to do with the ark of the God of Israel? And their answer was, Let the ark of the God of Israel be taken away to Gath. So they took the ark of the God of Israel away.
sentences.susu: E naxa Filisitakae kuntigi birin malan, e e maxɔrin, «Won munse rabama Isirayila xa Ala xa saatɛ kankira ra? A xa xanin Gati.» E naxa Isirayila Marigi Ala xa kankira xanin Gati.

sentences.english: But after they had taken it away, the hand of the Lord was stretched out against the town for its destruction: and the signs of disease came out on all the men of the town, small and great.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na dangi xanbi, Alatala naxa a sɛnbɛ ramini Gatikae ma, kelife e xa dimɛe ma han a sa dɔxɔ e xa forie ra. Na fi ɲaaxi naxa din e birin na.

sentences.english: So they sent the ark of God to Ekron. And when the ark of God came to Ekron, the people of the town made an outcry, saying, They have sent the ark of the God of Israel to us for the destruction of us and of our people.
sentences.susu: Na kui e naxa Ala xa kankira xanin Ekiron. A to so naa, Ekironkae naxa gbelegbele a falafe ra, «E bara Isirayilakae xa Ala xa kankira rafa muxu xɔnyi, alako a xa muxu xa mixie faxa.»

sentences.english: So they sent and got together all the lords of the Philistines, and they said, Send away the ark of the God of Israel, and let it go back to its place, so that it may not be the cause of death to us and to our people: for there was a great fear of death through all the town; the hand of God was very hard on them there.
sentences.susu: E fan naxa Filisitakae kuntigie malan, e a fala e bɛ, «Wo xa Isirayilakae xa Ala xa kankira ragbilen a yire, alako a naxa muxu xa mixie faxa.» Na taa birin nu bara kɔntɔfili na faxɛ xa fe ra. Ala nu bara a sɛnbɛ masen e bɛ.

sentences.english: And those men who were not overtaken by death were cruelly diseased: and the cry of the town went up to heaven.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee mu nu faxa, fi ɲaaxi naxa dɔxɔ nee ma. Ɲama xa maxandi naxa te han koore ma.

sentences.english: Now the ark of the Lord was in the country of the Philistines for seven months.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa saatɛ kankira kike solofere nan naba Filisitakae xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the Philistines sent for the priests and those who were wise in secret arts, and said to them, What are we to do with the ark of the Lord? How are we to send it away to its place?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui e naxa e xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun e sematoe malan, e e maxɔrin, «A lanma muxu xa munse raba Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ra? Wo na ragbilen ki fala muxu bɛ.»

sentences.english: And they said, If you send away the ark of the God of Israel, do not send it without an offering, but send him a sin-offering with it: then you will have peace again, and it will be clear to you why the weight of his hand has not been lifted from you.
sentences.susu: E naxa e yaabi, «Xa wo sa Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ragbilen a yire, wo naxa a ragbilen yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ xanbi. Fo wo xa wo xunsare ba, alako wo xa yalan, wo man xa a kolon fe naxan a niyaxi a a sɛnbɛ mu gbilenxi wo fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: Then they said, What sin-offering are we to send to him? And they said, Five gold images of the growths caused by your disease and five gold mice, one for every lord of the Philistines: for the same disease came on you and on your lords.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa maxɔrinyi ti, «A lanma muxu xa munse ba yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ ra a bɛ?» E naxa e yaabi, «Wo xa se suuli yailan xɛɛma ra na fi ɲaaxi misaali ra. Wo man xa se suuli gbɛtɛ yailan xɛɛma ra ɲɛnɛ misaali ra. Na xasabi nan lanxi Filisita mangɛ suulie xasabi ma, gbaloe ragoroxi naxee xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: So make images of the growths caused by your disease and of the mice which are damaging your land; and give glory to the God of Israel: it may be that the weight of his hand will be lifted from you and from your gods and from your land.
sentences.susu: Wo na gɛ na fi ɲaaxi misaali yailande xɛɛma ra, a nun na ɲɛnɛ xɛɛma daaxi naxee ɲɛnɛ misaalixi wo xa bɔxi kasara naxee xa fe ra, wo xa Isirayila Marigi Ala matɔxɔ. Tɛmunde a xa xɔnɛ nde bama wo tan, wo xa kuyee, nun wo xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Why do you make your hearts hard, like the hearts of Pharaoh and the Egyptians? When he had made sport of them, did they not let the people go, and they went away?
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo xaxili xɔrɔxɔ alɔ Misirakae nun e xa Firawuna. Wo maɲɔxun ɲaxankatɛ ma Ala naxan dɔxɔ e ma han e Isirayilakae keri e xɔnyi e siga.

sentences.english: So now, take and make ready a new cart, and two cows which have never come under the yoke, and have the cows yoked to the cart, and take their young ones away from them:
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, wo xa sarɛti nɛɛnɛ yailan. Wo ninge dingɛ firin tongo, wuri singe mu nu sa naxee kɔn, wo e xiri sarɛti ra. Wo xa e xa die ragbilen banxi.

sentences.english: And put the ark of the Lord on the cart, and the gold images which you are sending as a sin-offering in a chest by its side; and send it away so that it may go.
sentences.susu: Wo na gɛ na wali ra, wo xa Alatala xa saatɛ kankira baki sarɛti fari. Na se yailanxie xɛɛma ra, naxee findixi wo yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ ra, wo xa nee sa kankira lanma nde kui, wo na kankira baki boore fɛ ma. Na dangi xanbi, wo xa na ningee nun na sarɛti bɛɲin, e xa siga e yɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: If it goes by the land of Israel to Beth-shemesh, then this great evil is his work; but if not, then we may be certain that the evil was not his doing, but was the working of chance.
sentences.susu: Xa e e xun ti Isirayila bɔxi nan na Beti Semesi biri ra, na findima tɔnxuma nan na a a Alatala nan yi gbaloe ragoroxi won ma, kɔnɔ xa e mu siga na biri, na fan findima tɔnxuma nan na a yi gbaloe mu kelixi Alatala xa ma, a ilanxi nɛ a ra tun.»

sentences.english: And the men did so; they took two cows, yoking them to the cart and shutting up their young ones in their living-place:
sentences.susu: Filisitakae na nan naba. E naxa ninge dingɛ firin tongo, e e xiri sarɛti ra, e na ningee xa die mabalan kulɛ kui.

sentences.english: And they put the ark of the Lord on the cart and the chest with the gold images.
sentences.susu: E naxa Alatala xa saatɛ kankira baki sarɛti kui, a nun kankira boore, ɲɛnɛ xɛɛma daaxi nun e xa fi misaali yailanxi xɛɛma ra nu na naxan kui.

sentences.english: And the cows took the straight way, by the road to Beth-shemesh; they went by the highway, not turning to the right or to the left, and the sound of their voices was clear on the road; and the lords of the Philistines went after them as far as the edge of Beth-shemesh.
sentences.susu: Na ninge dingɛe naxa ti kira xɔn ma naxan sigama Beti Semesi biri. E naxa bira na kira kerenyi fɔxɔ ra e xui ramini ra. E mu siga kɔɔla ma, e mu siga yirefanyi ma. Filisita mangɛe naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra han Beti Semesi naaninyi ra.

sentences.english: And the people of Beth-shemesh were cutting their grain in the valley, and lifting up their eyes they saw the ark and were full of joy when they saw it.
sentences.susu: Beti Semesikae nu na fundenyi maniyɛ xabafe gulunba kui. E to Alatala xa saatɛ kankira to fa ra, e naxa sɛɛwa.

sentences.english: And the cart came into the field of Joshua the Beth-shemite, and came to a stop there by a great stone: and cutting up the wood of the cart they made a burned offering of the cows to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sarɛti naxa ti Yosuwe Beti Semesika xa xɛ ma. Gɛmɛ xungbe nu na mɛnni. E naxa sarɛti wuri ibɔɔ, e na ningee ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: Then the Levites took down the ark of the Lord and the chest in which were the gold images, and put them on the great stone: and the men of Beth-shemesh made burned offerings and gave worship that day before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie naxa Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ragoro, nun na kankira, naxan nu dɔxɔxi a fɛ ma, xɛɛma see nu na naxan kui. E naxa nee dɔxɔ na gɛmɛ xungbe fari. Na lɔxɔɛ Beti Semesikae naxa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nun sɛrɛxɛ mɔɔli gbɛtɛe ba Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And the five lords of the Philistines, having seen it, went back to Ekron the same day.
sentences.susu: Filisita mangɛ suulie to na birin to, e naxa gbilen Ekiron na lɔxɔɛ kerenyi.

sentences.english: Now these are the gold images which the Philistines sent as a sin-offering to the Lord; one for Ashdod, one for Gaza, one for Ashkelon, one for Gath, one for Ekron;
sentences.susu: Filisitakae nu bara se suuli yailan xɛɛma ra naxee misaalixi na fi ɲaaxi ra. E nee fi e yɛtɛ ragbilen sɛrɛxɛ nan na Alatala bɛ, keren Asidodi bɛ, keren Gasa bɛ, keren Asikalɔn bɛ, keren Gati bɛ, keren Ekiron bɛ.

sentences.english: And the gold mice, one for every town of the Philistines, the property of the five lords, walled towns as well as country places: and the great stone where they put the ark of the Lord is still in the field of Joshua the Beth-shemite to this day.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛnɛ xɛɛma daaxi keren keren, e na nan ba Filisita mangɛe xa taa suuli bɛ, a nun e xa daaxae bɛ naxee na gɛmɛ xungbe lima, Alatala xa saatɛ kankira dɔxɔ naxan fari, Yosuwe Beti Semesika xa xɛ yire.

sentences.english: But the Lord sent destruction on seventy men of the people of Beth-shemesh for looking into the ark of the Lord; and great was the sorrow of the people for the destruction which the Lord had sent on them.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa mixi tongo solofere faxa Beti Semesi ɲama mixi wulu tongo suuli ya ma, barima e nu bara saatɛ kankira rabi, e a kui mato. Taa birin naxa sunnun na gbaloe xa fe ra, Alatala naxan nagoroxi e ma.

sentences.english: And the men of Beth-shemesh said, Who is able to keep his place before the Lord, this holy God? and to whom may he go from us?
sentences.susu: Beti Semesikae naxa a fala, «Nde nɔma tide Alatala ya i, naxan findixi Ala Sɛniyɛnxi ra? Won yi kankira makuyama won na minden?»

sentences.english: And they sent men to the people living in Kiriath-jearim, saying, The Philistines have sent back the ark of the Lord; come and take it up to your country.
sentences.susu: E naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Kiriyati Yeyarimi a falafe ra, «Filisitakae bara fa Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ra. Wo fa a xanin wo xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: So the men of Kiriath-jearim came and took the ark of the Lord to the house of Abinadab in Gibeah, and they made his son Eleazar holy and put the ark in his care.
sentences.susu: Kiriyati Yeyarimi xɛmɛe naxa fa Alatala xa saatɛ kankira tongode, e a xanin Abinadabo xɔnyi geya nde fari. E naxa a xa di xɛmɛ Eleyasari findi a kantama ra.

sentences.english: And the ark was in Kiriath-jearim for a long time, as much as twenty years: and all Israel was searching after the Lord with weeping.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nan naba Kiriyati Yeyarimi. Na tɛmui Isirayila ɲama nu wama gbilenfe Alatala ma.

sentences.english: Then Samuel said to all Israel, If with all your hearts you would come back to the Lord, then put away all the strange gods and the Astartes from among you, and let your hearts be turned to the Lord, and be servants to him only: and he will make you safe from the hands of the Philistines.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a fala Isirayilakae bɛ, «Xa wo wama wo yɛtɛ ragbilenfe Alatala ma wo bɔɲɛ birin na, wo xa Asataroti kuye nun kuye gbɛtɛe ba wo tagi, wo Alatala keren batu. Na tɛmui, a wo rakisima nɛ Filisitakae ma.»

sentences.english: So the children of Israel gave up the worship of Baal and Astarte, and became worshippers of the Lord only.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isirayilakae naxa Bali kuyee nun Asataroti kuyee ba e tagi, e fa Alatala keren batu.

sentences.english: Then Samuel said, Let all Israel come to Mizpah and I will make prayer to the Lord for you.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa e yamari, «Isirayilaka birin xa malan Misipa, n xa Alatala maxandi wo bɛ.»

sentences.english: So they came together to Mizpah, and got water, draining it out before the Lord, and they took no food that day, and they said, We have done evil against the Lord. And Samuel was judge of the children of Israel in Mizpah.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa e malan Misipa Samuweli xa yaamari bun ma. E naxa ye ba, e a ifili Alatala ya i sunyi kui. Mɛnni e naxa a fala, «Muxu bara yunubi raba Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: Now when the Philistines had news that the children of Israel had come together at Mizpah, the lords of the Philistines went up against Israel. And the children of Israel, hearing of it, were full of fear.
sentences.susu: Filisita mangɛe to a mɛ a Isirayilakae malanxi Misipa, e naxa siga e gerede. Isirayilakae naxa gaaxu e ya ra,

sentences.english: And the children of Israel said to Samuel, Go on crying to the Lord our God for us to make us safe from the hands of the Philistines.
sentences.susu: e a fala Samuweli bɛ, «I naxa muxu rabɛɲin. I xa muxu Marigi Alatala makula muxu bɛ, a xa muxu ratanga Filisitakae ma.»

sentences.english: And Samuel took a young lamb, offering all of it as a burned offering to the Lord; and Samuel made prayers to the Lord for Israel and the Lord gave him an answer.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa yɛxɛɛ yɔrɛ keren ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra Alatala bɛ, a a makula Isirayila xa fe ra. Alatala naxa a xa maxandi suxu.

sentences.english: And while Samuel was offering the burned offering, the Philistines came near for the attack on Israel; but at the thunder of the Lord's voice that day the Philistines were overcome with fear, and they gave way before Israel.
sentences.susu: Samuweli nu na sɛrɛxɛ bafe Alatala bɛ tɛmui naxɛ, Filisitakae naxa Isirayilakae gere, kɔnɔ Alatala naxa galanyi xui ramini a belebele ra e xili ma. Na kui Filisitakae naxa gaaxu, Isirayilakae fa nɔ e ra.

sentences.english: And the men of Israel went out from Mizpah and went after the Philistines, attacking them till they came under Beth-car.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa Filisitakae keri Misipa, e e bɔnbɔ han Beti Kara.

sentences.english: Then Samuel took a stone and put it up between Mizpah and Jeshanah, naming it Eben-ezer, and saying, Up to now the Lord has been our help.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa gɛmɛ nde tongo, a naxa a sa Misipa nun Seeni tagi a falafe ra, «Alatala muxu mali nɛ han be.»

sentences.english: So the Philistines were overcome, and did not come into the country of Israel again: and all the days of Samuel the hand of the Lord was against the Philistines.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae rayaagi na ki nɛ, e mu fa Isirayila bɔxi ma sɔnɔn. Alatala naxa a sɛnbɛ masen Filisitakae bɛ Samuweli xa simaya bun ma.

sentences.english: And the towns which the Philistines had taken were given back to Israel, from Ekron to Gath, and all the country round them Israel made free from the power of the Philistines. And there was peace between Israel and the Amorites.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae taa naxee ba Isirayilakae yi ra, e naxa gbilen Isirayila ma, kelife Ekiron han Gati. Na tɛmui lanyi naxa lu Isirayila nun Amorikae tagi.

sentences.english: And Samuel was judge of Israel all the days of his life.
sentences.susu: Samuweli findi nɛ Isirayila yarerati ra a xa simaya birin kui.

sentences.english: From year to year he went in turn to Beth-el and Gilgal and Mizpah, judging Israel in all those places.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ yo ɲɛ, a nu biyaasi nde rabama sigafe ra Beteli, Giligali, nun Misipa alako a xa Isirayilakae raɲɛrɛ.

sentences.english: And his base was at Ramah, where his house was; there he was judge of Israel and there he made an altar to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na biyaasi dangi xanbi a nu gbilenma nɛ a xɔnyi Rama, a findi mɛnnikae fan xa mangɛ ra. A sɛrɛxɛbade yailan Alatala bɛ na taa kui.

sentences.english: Now when Samuel was old, he made his sons judges over Israel.
sentences.susu: Samuweli to fori, a naxa a xa die findi kiitisae ra Isirayila xun ma.

sentences.english: The name of his first son was Joel and the name of his second Abijah: they were judges in Beer-sheba.
sentences.susu: A xa di xɛmɛ singe xili nɛ Yoweli, a firin nde xili Abiya. E tan nan nu na kiitisae ra Beriseeba.

sentences.english: And his sons did not go in his ways, but moved by the love of money took rewards, and were not upright in judging.
sentences.susu: Samuweli xa di xɛmɛe mu bira e baba xa misaali fɔxɔ ra. Kɔbiri nu rafan e ma, e mu nu kiiti sama tinxinyi ra.

sentences.english: Then all the responsible men of Israel got together and went to Samuel at Ramah,
sentences.susu: Na kui Isirayila kuntigie naxa e malan, e siga Samuweli xɔnyi Rama.

sentences.english: And said to him, See now, you are old, and your sons do not go in your ways: give us a king now to be our judge, so that we may be like the other nations.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala a bɛ, «I bara fori, i xa di xɛmɛe mu birafe i xa misaali fɔxɔ ra. Kiitisa nde dɔxɔ muxu xun ma naxan findima muxu xa mangɛ xungbe ra, alɔ ɲamanɛ booree a rabama ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: But Samuel was not pleased when they said to him, Give us a king to be our judge. And Samuel made prayer to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Samuweli to e xa masenyi mɛ, a falafe ra, «Mangɛ nde so muxu yi ra naxan muxu makiitima,» na fe mu rafan a ma. Na kui a naxa Alatala maxandi.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Samuel, Give ear to the voice of the people and what they say to you: they have not been turned away from you, but they have been turned away from me, not desiring me to be king over them.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Samuweli yaabi, «I tuli mati ɲama xui ra. E mu mɛɛxi i tan xa ra, e mɛɛxi n tan nan na. E mu tinma sɔnɔn n xa findi e xa mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: As they have done from the first, from the day when I took them out of Egypt till this day, turning away from me and worshipping other gods, so now they are acting in the same way to you.
sentences.susu: E naxan nabafe i ra, e na nan tun nabafe kabi n sa e ramini Misira han to. E bara mɛɛ n na, e xa ala gbɛtɛe batu.

sentences.english: Give ear now to their voice: but make a serious protest to them, and give them a picture of the sort of king who will be their ruler.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, i tuli mati e xui ra, kɔnɔ i xa e rakolon a fanyi ra mangɛ fama e yamaride ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And Samuel said all these words of the Lord to the people who were desiring a king.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa Alatala xa masenyi birin nadangi ɲama ma, naxee nu wama mangɛ xɔn.

sentences.english: And he said, This is the sort of king who will be your ruler: he will take your sons and make them his servants, his horsemen, and drivers of his war-carriages, and they will go running before his war-carriages;
sentences.susu: A naxɛ, «Mangɛ naxan fama dɔxɔde wo xun ma, a wo xa di xɛmɛe nan findima a xa sɔɔrie nun a xa soe ragie ra. Ndee nu e yi a ragise ya ra.

sentences.english: And he will make them captains of thousands and of fifties; some he will put to work ploughing and cutting his grain and making his instruments of war and building his war-carriages.
sentences.susu: Ndee findima yareratie nan na mixi wulu xun ma, xa na mu a ra mixi tongo suuli. Ndee a xa xɛe buxama, ndee a xa xɛe xabama. Ndee geresose nun sɔɔri ragisee yailanma.

sentences.english: Your daughters he will take to be makers of perfumes and cooks and bread-makers.
sentences.susu: A wo xa di ginɛe nan findima a xa labundɛ yailanyie ra, a xa kurisomae, a nun a xa taamiganyie.

sentences.english: He will take your fields and your vine-gardens and your olive-gardens, all the best of them, and give them to his servants.
sentences.susu: A wo xa wɛni sansi fanyie nun wo xa oliwi wuri fanyie tongo, a e so a xa mixie yi ra.

sentences.english: He will take a tenth of your seed and of the fruit of your vines and give it to his servants.
sentences.susu: A wo xa sansie farilɛ nun wo xa wɛni farilɛ tongoma nɛ, a a fi a xa walikɛe nun a xa mixie ma.

sentences.english: He will take your men-servants and your servant-girls, and the best of your oxen and your asses and put them to his work.
sentences.susu: A wo xa walikɛ fanyie, wo xa fonikee, nun wo xa sofalee tongoma nɛ a yɛtɛ xa wali xa fe ra.

sentences.english: He will take a tenth of your sheep: and you will be his servants.
sentences.susu: A wo xa xuruse farilɛ bama nɛ, a wo fan findi a xa konyie ra.

sentences.english: Then you will be crying out because of your king whom you have taken for yourselves; but the Lord will not give you an answer in that day.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ wo dɛ rawama nɛ Alatala bɛ mangɛ xa fe ra wo naxan sugandixi, kɔnɔ a mu wo yaabima.»

sentences.english: But the people gave no attention to the voice of Samuel; and they said, No, but we will have a king over us,
sentences.susu: Ɲama mu tin e tuli matide Samuweli xa masenyi ra. E naxa a yaabi, «Ade! Mangɛ xa dɔxɔ muxu xun ma,

sentences.english: So that we may be like the other nations, and so that our king may be our judge and go out before us to war.
sentences.susu: muxu fan xa lu alɔ ɲamanɛ boore na ki naxɛ. Muxu xa mangɛ xa muxu yamari, a xa ti muxu ya ra geree kui.»

sentences.english: Then Samuel, after hearing all the people had to say, went and gave an account of it to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Samuweli to ɲama xui mɛ, a naxa a madangi Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Samuel, Give ear to their voice and make a king for them. Then Samuel said to the men of Israel, Let every man go back to his town.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Samuweli yaabi, «I tuli mati e ra. I mangɛ dɔxɔma nɛ e xun ma.» Samuweli naxa a fala Isirayila ɲama bɛ, «Birin xa gbilen e xa taa kui.»

sentences.english: Now there was a man of Benjamin named Kish, the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah, a Benjamite, a man of wealth.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ sɛnbɛma nde nu na Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, a xili Kisu. A benbae nan yi ki: Abiyɛli, Serori, Bekorati, nun Afiya.

sentences.english: He had a son named Saul, a specially good-looking young man; there was no one better-looking among the children of Israel: he was taller by a head than any other of the people.
sentences.susu: A xa di xɛmɛ gbangbalanyi nde nu na naxan xili Sɔlu. A nu rayabu Isirayilaka birin bɛ, a man nu kuya dangi e birin na.

sentences.english: Now the asses of Saul's father Kish had gone wandering away. And Kish said to his son Saul, Take one of the servants with you, and get up and go in search of the asses.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Kisu xa sofale lanmae naxa lɔɛ, a naxa a fala a xa di xɛmɛ Sɔlu bɛ, «Konyi keren tongo, i sa n ma sofale lanmae fen.»

sentences.english: So they went through the hill-country of Ephraim and through the land of Shalishah, but they saw no sign of them: then they went through the land of Shaalim, but they were not there: and they went through the land of the Benjamites, but they did not come across them.
sentences.susu: E naxa mini Efirami geyae ra, e Salisa bɔxi iɲɛrɛ, kɔnɔ e mu sofalee to. E naxa Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi fan iɲɛrɛ, kɔnɔ e mu e to.

sentences.english: And when they had come to the land of Zuph, Saul said to the servant who was with him, Come, let us go back, or my father may give up caring about the asses and be troubled about us.
sentences.susu: E to so Sufu bɔxi ma, Sɔlu naxa a fala a xa konyi bɛ naxan nu biraxi a fɔxɔ ra, «Won gbilen, alako n baba naxa kɔntɔfili won ma fe ra, dangi sofalee xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: But the servant said to him, See now, in this town there is a man of God, who is highly honoured, and everything he says comes true: let us go there now; it may be that he will give us directions about our journey.
sentences.susu: Na konyi naxa a yaabi, «Ala xa mixi binyɛ nde na yi taa kui, naxan xa masenyi kamalima tɛmui birin. Won xa a maxɔrin a xa sɔɔnɛya kira masen won bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Saul said to his servant, But if we go, what are we to take the man? all our bread is gone, and we have no offering to take to the man of God: what are we to do?
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a fala a xa konyi bɛ, «Mixi nɔma sigade Ala xa mixi ma a bɛlɛxɛ igeli ra? Hali taami keren mu na won ma gbɔnfɔɛ kui. Sese mu na won yi ra, won naxan fima Ala xa mixi ma. Won na rabama di?»

sentences.english: But the servant said in answer, I have here a fourth part of a shekel of silver: I will give that to the man of God, and he will give us directions about our way.
sentences.susu: A xa konyi naxa a yaabi, «Kɔbiri di na n yi ra won naxan fima Ala xa mixi ma, alako a xa sɔɔnɛya kira masen won bɛ.»

sentences.english: (In the past in Israel, when a man went to get directions from God, he said, Come let us go to the Seer, for he who now is named Prophet was in those days given the name of Seer.)
sentences.susu: Na waxati, Isirayilaka naxee nu wama maxɔrinyi tife Alatala ma e nu a falama, «Won xa siga sematoe yire.» To na sematoe xili falama namiɲɔnmɛ.

sentences.english: Then Saul said to his servant, You have said well; come, let us go. So they went to the town where the man of God was.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a fala a xa konyi bɛ, «Awa, won xɛɛ.» E naxa siga na taa kui, na Ala xa mixi nu na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And when they were on the way up to the town, they saw some young girls going out to get water and said to them, Is the seer here?
sentences.susu: E to so naa, e naxa ginɛdimɛdie li kira xɔn, e sigafe ye bade. E naxa e maxɔrin, «Sematoe na be?»

sentences.english: And they said, He is; in fact he is before you: go quickly now, for he has come into the town today, for the people are making an offering in the high place today:
sentences.susu: Ginɛdimɛdie naxa e yaabi, «Iyo, a baxi sode yakɔsi, kɔnɔ wo xulun de, barima a faxi sɛrɛxɛ bade ɲama nan bɛ geya fari.

sentences.english: When you come into the town you will see him straight away, before he goes up to the high place for the feast: the people are waiting for his blessing before starting the feast, and after that the guests will take part in it. So go up now and you will see him.
sentences.susu: Xa wo soma taa kui yakɔsi, wo a lima nɛ naa beenun a xa te geya fari sɛrɛxɛ xɔlide. Ɲama mu a dɛgema a xanbi, fo a xa sɛrɛxɛ duba beenun mixie xa a xɔli. Wo te yakɔsi. Wo a lima naa.»

sentences.english: So they went up to the town, and when they came inside the town, Samuel came face to face with them on his way to the high place.
sentences.susu: E to so taa kui, Samuweli naxa mini e ralande sigafe ra geya fari.

sentences.english: Now the day before Saul came, the word of God had come to Samuel, saying,
sentences.susu: Beenun Sɔlu xa fa, Alatala nu bara a fala Samuweli bɛ,

sentences.english: Tomorrow about this time I will send you a man from the land of Benjamin, and on him you are to put the holy oil, making him ruler over my people Israel, and he will make my people safe from the hands of the Philistines: for I have seen the sorrow of my people, whose cry has come up to me.
sentences.susu: «Tina, yi waxati, n Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ mixi nde xɛɛma i yire. I xa ture sa a xunyi ma a masenfe ra a a xa findi n ma Isirayila ɲama mangɛ ra. A fama n ma ɲama rakiside Filisitakae ma. N bara n ma ɲama xui mɛ.»

sentences.english: And when Samuel saw Saul, the Lord said to him, This is the man of whom I gave you word! he it is who is to have authority over my people.
sentences.susu: Samuweli to Sɔlu to, Alatala naxa a fala a bɛ, «N xɛmɛ naxan xa fe fala i bɛ, a tan nan yi ki. Yaamari luma a yi ra n ma ɲama xun na.»

sentences.english: Then Saul came up to Samuel in the doorway of the town and said, Give me directions, if you will be so good, to the house of the seer.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a maso Samuweli ra taa sode dɛ ra, a naxa a fala a bɛ, «Yandi, sematoe xa banxi masen muxu bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Samuel said to Saul, I am the seer; go up before me to the high place and take food with me today: and in the morning I will let you go, after opening to you all the secrets of your heart.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a yaabi, «Sematoe na n tan nan na. Won xɛɛ geya fari. Won birin xa won dɛge yire keren. Tina n i xa kɔntɔfili bama i ma, n fa i bɛɲin.

sentences.english: As for your asses which have been wandering for three days, give no thought to them, for they have come back. And for whom are all the desired things in Israel? are they not for you and your father's family?
sentences.susu: I naxa kɔntɔfili i xa sofale lanmae xa fe ra naxee lɔɛxi kabi xi saxan. Sese mu e toxi, e bara to. Naxan tide gbo Isirayila, a findima nde gbe ra? I tan xa mu a ra, a nun i baba xa denbaya birin?»

sentences.english: And Saul said, Am I not a man of Benjamin, the smallest of all the tribes of Israel? and my family the least of the families of Benjamin? why then do you say these words to me?
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a fala a bɛ, «Bunyaminka nan n na. Muxu tan xa mu xurun bɔnsɔɛ birin bɛ Isirayila? Muxu xabilɛ fan mu xurun xabilɛ birin bɛ Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ tagi? Munfe ra i wɔyɛnma n bɛ yi ki?»

sentences.english: Then Samuel took Saul and his servant into the guest room, and made them take the chief place among all the guests who were there, about thirty persons.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa Sɔlu nun a xa konyi raso banxi kui, a naxa binyɛ magorode so e yi ra mixi xilixi tongo saxan tagi.

sentences.english: And Samuel said to the cook, Give me that part which I gave you orders to keep by you.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a fala kurisoma bɛ, «Fa donse ra n nu naxan ma i xa a sa a xati ma.»

sentences.english: And the cook took up the leg with the fat tail on it, and put it before Saul. And Samuel said, This is the part which has been kept for you: take it as your part of the feast; because it has been kept for you till the right time came and till the guests were present. So that day Saul took food with Samuel.
sentences.susu: Kurisoma naxa fa sube tabe ra, a a dɔxɔ Sɔlu ya i. Samuweli naxa a fala Sɔlu bɛ, «Yi sube don, naxan saxi a xati ma i bɛ, n to yi malanyi maxili.» Na lɔxɔɛ, Sɔlu nun Samuweli naxa e dɛgɛ yire keren.

sentences.english: And when they had come down from the high place into the town, where a bed was made ready for Saul, he went to rest.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, e naxa goro kelife geya fari, e so taa kui. E naxa lu yire keren banxi fari, berede nu na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And about dawn Samuel said to Saul on the roof, Get up so that I may send you away. So Saul got up, and he and Samuel went out together.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba subaxɛ, e naxa keli. Samuweli naxa Sɔlu xili banxi fari ma, e xa e boore to. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «Keli, n xa i mati kira xɔn.» Sɔlu naxa keli, e naxa mini kira ma, a tan nun Samuweli.

sentences.english: And on their way down to the end of the town, Samuel said to Saul, Give your servant orders to go on in front of us, (so he went on,) but you keep here, so that I may give you the word of God.
sentences.susu: E to mini taa fari ma, Samuweli naxa a fala Sɔlu bɛ, «A fala i xa konyi bɛ, a xa dangi yare.» Konyi to dangi yare, Samuweli naxa a fala Sɔlu bɛ, «Ti be, alako n xa Alatala xa masenyi nde fala i bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Samuel took the bottle of oil, and put the oil on his head and gave him a kiss and said, Is not the Lord with the holy oil making you ruler over Israel, his people? and you will have authority over the people of the Lord, and you will make them safe from the hands of their attackers round about them, and this will be the sign for you:
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa ture bitirɛ keren tongo, a a surusuru Sɔlu xunyi. A naxa a sunbu, a a fala a bɛ, «Alatala bara i sugandi, a i xa findi mangɛ ra a xa ɲama kɛ tongoma xun ma.

sentences.english: When you have gone away from me today, you will see two men by the resting-place of Rachel's body, in the land of Benjamin at Zelzah; and they will say to you, The asses which you went in search of have come back, and now your father, caring no longer for the asses, is troubled about you, saying, What am I to do about my son?
sentences.susu: I na keli be to, i mixi firin lima Raxele gaburi fɛ ma Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ naaninyi ra, yire nde naxan xili Selesa. E fama a falade i bɛ, ‹Wo siga sofale lanma naxee fende, e bara to. Yakɔsi i baba fa kɔntɔfilixi wo tan nan ma fe ra. A naxɛ, «N ma di toma di kɔrɛ?»›

sentences.english: Then you are to go on from there, and when you come to the oak-tree of Tabor, you will see three men going up to God to Beth-el, one having with him three young goats and another three cakes of bread and another a skin full of wine:
sentences.susu: I na keli mɛnni, i siga han i sa so Taboro, wuri belebele na dɛnnaxɛ. I xɛmɛ saxan lima na naxee na tefe Ala maxandide Beteli. Si saxan na xɛmɛ keren yi ra, taami saxan na xɛmɛ firin nde yi ra, wɛni na xɛmɛ saxan nde yi ra.

sentences.english: They will say, Peace be with you, and will give you two cakes of bread, which you are to take from them.
sentences.susu: E na i xɛɛbu, e taami firin fima i ma.

sentences.english: After that you will come to Gibeah, the hill of God, where an armed force of the Philistines is stationed: and when you come to the town, you will see a band of prophets coming down from the high place with instruments of music before them; and they will be acting like prophets:
sentences.susu: I na keli mɛnni, i siga Gibeya Elohimu, Filisitakae xa sɔɔri gali nde na dɛnnaxɛ. I na so taa kui, i namiɲɔnmɛ gali nde lima, naxee gorofe geya fari e bɛɛti bafe Ala bɛ kɔrae, maxasee, nun xule ra.

sentences.english: And the spirit of the Lord will come on you with power, and you will be acting like a prophet with them, and will be changed into another man.
sentences.susu: Alatala Xaxili ragoroma nɛ i ma, wo birin nan Alatala xa xɛɛra ibama, i findima mixi nɛɛnɛ nan na.

sentences.english: And when these signs come to you, see that you take the chance which is offered you; for God is with you.
sentences.susu: Na tɔnxuma na raba i bɛ, i xa fe raba naxan na i bɔɲɛ ma, barima Alatala na i fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Then you are to go down before me to Gilgal, where I will come to you, for the offering of burned offerings and peace-offerings: go on waiting there for seven days till I come to you and make clear to you what you have to do.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, i xa goro Giligali n ya ra. N na i li naa, n fama nɛ sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛe bade. I xa n mamɛ xi solofere, beenun n xa i yire li, n fa i rakolon a lanma i xa naxan naba.»

sentences.english: And it came about, that when he went away from Samuel, God gave him a changed heart: and all those signs took place that day.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu fɛfɛ keli Samuweli xun ma, Alatala naxa a xaxili masara, na tɔnxuma birin naxa raba a bɛ na lɔxɔɛ yati.

sentences.english: And when they came to Gibeah, a band of prophets came face to face with him; and the spirit of God came on him with power and he took his place among them as a prophet.
sentences.susu: E to so Gibeya, e naxa namiɲɔnmɛ gali li naa. Alatala Xaxili naxa goro Sɔlu ma, a fa masenyi ti Ala xili ra e tagi.

sentences.english: Now when Saul's old friends saw him among the band of prophets, the people said to one another, What has come to Saul, the son of Kish? Is even Saul among the prophets?
sentences.susu: A kolonmae to a to a Sɔlu bara namiɲɔnmɛ masenyi ti, e naxa a fala e boore bɛ, «Munse Kisu xa di sɔtɔxi? Sɔlu fan bara findi namiɲɔnmɛ ra?»

sentences.english: And one of the people of that place said in answer, And who is their father? So it became a common saying, Is even Saul among the prophets?
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa maxɔrinyi ti e ya ma, «Nde na e karamɔxɔ ra?» Na kui yi taali fala fɔlɔ na lɔxɔɛ nɛ, «Sɔlu fan bara findi namiɲɔnmɛ ra?»

sentences.english: Then going away from the prophets, he came to the house.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ Alatala xa masenyi tide, a naxa te geya fari.

sentences.english: And Saul's father's brother said to him and his servant, Where have you been? And he said, Searching for the asses: and when we saw no sign of them, we came to Samuel.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu sɔxɔ naxa Sɔlu nun a xa konyi maxɔrin, «Wo tan siga minden?» Sɔlu naxa a yaabi, «Muxu sigaxi sofale lanmae nan fende, kɔnɔ muxu mu e to. Na nan a ra, muxu naxa siga Samuweli yire.»

sentences.english: Then he said, And what did Samuel say to you?
sentences.susu: A sɔxɔ naxɛ, «Samuweli naxan fala wo bɛ, a fala n bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Saul, answering him, said, He gave us word that the asses had come back. But he said nothing to him of Samuel's words about the kingdom.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a sɔxɔ yaabi, «A a fala nɛ muxu bɛ, a sofale lanmae bara to.» Kɔnɔ Sɔlu mu sese masen mangɛya xa fe ra, Samuweli naxan fala a bɛ.

sentences.english: Then Samuel sent for the people to come together before the Lord at Mizpah;
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa ɲama birin maxili Misipa Alatala ya i,

sentences.english: And he said to the children of Israel, The Lord, the God of Israel, has said, I took Israel out of Egypt, and made you free from the hands of the Egyptians and from all the kingdoms which kept you down:
sentences.susu: a a fala e bɛ, «Isirayila Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, ‹N tan nan Isirayila ramini Misira bɔxi ra, n wo ba e bɛlɛxɛ. N bara wo ratanga wo yaxuie ma.›

sentences.english: But today you are turned away from your God, who himself has been your saviour from all your troubles and sorrows; and you have said to him, Put a king over us. So now, take your places before the Lord by your tribes and by your thousands.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ to wo tan bara wo Marigi Ala bɛɲin, naxan wo ratanga gbaloe nun kɔntɔfilie ma. Wo naxɛ, ‹Mangɛ nde dɔxɔ muxu xun ma!› Awa, wo xa ti Alatala ya i wo bɔnsɔɛ ki ma, wo xabilɛ ki ma.»

sentences.english: So Samuel made all the tribes of Israel come near, and the tribe of Benjamin was taken.
sentences.susu: Samuweli to gɛ Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin masende Ala bɛ, Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ naxa sugandi.

sentences.english: Then he made the tribe of Benjamin come near by families, and the family of the Matrites was taken: and from them, Saul, the son of Kish, was taken: but when they went in search of him he was nowhere to be seen.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ masende a xabilɛ ki ma, Matiri xabilɛ naxa sugandi. Na Matiri xabilɛ ya ma, Kisu xa di Sɔlu naxa sugandi, kɔnɔ a mu nu na e ya ma. E naxa a fen, e mu a to.

sentences.english: So they put another question to the Lord, Is the man present here? And the answer of the Lord was, He is keeping himself from view among the goods.
sentences.susu: E naxa Alatala maxɔrin, «Sɔlu na be?» Alatala naxa e yaabi, «A nɔxunxi kotee longori ra.»

sentences.english: So they went quickly and made him come out; and when he took his place among the people, he was taller by a head than any of the people.
sentences.susu: E naxa siga e gi ra, e sa a suxu naa, e a ti ɲama birin ya i. A nu kuya e birin bɛ.

sentences.english: And Samuel said to all the people, Do you see the man of the Lord's selection, how there is no other like him among all the people? And all the people with loud cries said, Long life to the king!
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a fala ɲama birin bɛ, «Wo bara a to, Alatala naxan sugandixi? A maniyɛ mu na ɲama tagi.» E birin naxa ɲɛlɛxinyi xui ramini, e a fala, «Kisi na mangɛ bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Samuel gave the people the laws of the kingdom, writing them in a book which he put in a safe place before the Lord. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa sɛriyɛ sɛbɛ mangɛya xa fe ra, a na sɛbɛli sa Alatala ya i. Na dangi xanbi, a naxa ɲama ragbilen a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And Saul went to Gibeah, to his house; and with him went the men of war whose hearts had been touched by God.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu fan naxa gbilen a xɔnyi Gibeya. Kuntigi ndee naxa a mati, Alatala naxee bɔɲɛ ya rafindi a ma.

sentences.english: But certain good-for-nothing persons said, How is this man to be our saviour? And having no respect for him, they gave him no offering.
sentences.susu: Fuyante ndee fan nu na, naxee nu a falama, «Yi xɛmɛ nan won nakisima?» E naxa yo a ma, e mu fa buɲa yo ra a xɔn ma, kɔnɔ Sɔlu mu sese fala na fe ma.

sentences.english: Then about a month after this, Nahash the Ammonite came up and put his forces in position for attacking Jabesh-gilead: and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, Make an agreement with us and we will be your servants.
sentences.susu: Amoni mangɛ Naxasa naxa yonkin Yabɛsi taa ya ra Galadi bɔxi ma. Yabɛsikae naxa a fala a bɛ, «Won xa saatɛ xiri, muxu xa lu i sagoe.»

sentences.english: And Nahash the Ammonite said to them, I will make an agreement with you on this condition, that all your right eyes are put out; so that I may make it a cause of shame to all Israel.
sentences.susu: Naxasa Amonika naxa e yaabi, «Won nɔma saatɛ xiride, kɔnɔ fo wo xa tin n xa wo yirefanyi ya kana, alako yaagi xa dusu Isirayila birin xun na.»

sentences.english: Then the responsible men of Jabesh said to him, Give us seven days, so that we may send men to every part of Israel: and then, if no one comes to our help, we will come out to you.
sentences.susu: Yabɛsi kuntigie naxa a fala a bɛ, «Xi solofere fi muxu ma, alako xɛɛrae xa siga Isirayila taa birin. Xa mixi yo mu nɔma muxu ratangade, muxu luma i sagoe.»

sentences.english: So they sent representatives to Saul's town Gibeah, and these gave the news to the people: and all the people gave themselves to weeping.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛrae naxa siga Gibeya Sɔlu xɔnyi. E to gɛ dɛntɛgɛ sade, ɲama birin naxa wa a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Now Saul came from the field, driving the oxen before him; and he said, Why are the people weeping? And they gave him word of what the men of Jabesh had said.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Sɔlu naxa fa kelife xɛ ma a xa ningee fɔxɔ ra. A naxa maxɔrinyi ti, «Munfe ra ɲama na wafe yi mɔɔli ra?» E naxa Yabɛsikae xa masenyi dɛntɛgɛ a bɛ.

sentences.english: And at their words, the spirit of God came on Saul with power, and he became very angry.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu to na mɛ, Alatala Xaxili naxa goro a ma, a bɔɲɛ naxa te sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: And he took two oxen and, cutting them up, sent them through all the land of Israel by the hand of runners, saying, If any man does not come out after Saul and Samuel, this will be done to his oxen. And the fear of the Lord came on the people and they came out like one man.
sentences.susu: A naxa ninge firin tongo, a e ibolon a xuntun xuntunyi ra. A naxa na xuntunyie rasanba Isirayila taa birin ma na xɛɛrae saabui ra, a falafe ra, «Xa naxan yo mu bira Sɔlu nun Samuweli fɔxɔ ra, na kanyi xa ningee fan nabama yi ki nɛ.» Alatala xa yaragaaxui naxa goro Isirayilakae ma, e birin naxa te gere xili ma lanyi kui.

sentences.english: And he had them numbered in Bezek: the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the men of Judah thirty thousand.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa e kɔnti Beseki. Isirayila xɛmɛ xasabi lan mixi wulu kɛmɛ saxan nan ma. Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xɛmɛ lan mixi wulu tongo saxan.
