sentences.english: Then he said to the representatives who had come, Say to the men of Jabesh-gilead, Tomorrow, by the time the sun is high, you will be made safe. And the representatives came and gave the news to the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala xɛɛrae bɛ, «Wo sa a fala Yabɛsikae bɛ Galadi bɔxi ma, ‹Tina, soge na xɔnɔ, wo xun fama rakelide.›» Xɛɛrae to na xibaaru masen Yabɛsi ɲama bɛ, e naxa ɲɛlɛxin ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: So the men of Jabesh said, Tomorrow we will come out to you, and you may do to us whatever seems good to you.
sentences.susu: Na kui Yabɛsi ɲama naxa a fala Amonikae bɛ, «Tina, muxu luma wo sagoe, wo wo waxɔnyi rabama nɛ muxu ra.»

sentences.english: Now on the day after, Saul put the people into three bands, and in the morning watch they came to the tents of the Ammonites, and they went on attacking them till the heat of the day: and those who were not put to death were put to flight in every direction, so that no two of them were together.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Sɔlu naxa ɲama findi gali saxan na. Subaxɛ e naxa so Amonikae yonkinde, e e bɔnbɔ han yanyi tagi. Mixi naxee mu faxa, nee naxa yensen han mixi firin mu nɔ lude yire keren.

sentences.english: And the people said to Samuel, Who was it who said, Is Saul to be our king? give the men up, so that we may put them to death.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa a fala Samuweli bɛ, «Ndee a fala a Sɔlu mu nɔma mangɛya rabade won xun ma? Wo na mixie ramini, muxu xa e faxa.»

sentences.english: And Saul said, Not a man is to be put to death today: for today the Lord has made Israel safe.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Sɔlu naxa e yaabi, «Mixi yo mu faxama to, barima to Alatala bara Isirayila rakisi.»

sentences.english: Then Samuel said to the people, Come, let us go to Gilgal and there make the kingdom strong in the hands of Saul.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a fala ɲama bɛ, «Won xɛɛ Giligali, alako mangɛ xa magoro a xa kibanyi kerenyi ra.»

sentences.english: So all the people went to Gilgal; and there in Gilgal they made Saul king before the Lord; and peace-offerings were offered before the Lord; and there Saul and all the men of Israel were glad with great joy.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa siga Giligali, e naxa Sɔlu ti mangɛ ra Alatala ya i. E naxa xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ba mɛnni Alatala bɛ, Sɔlu nun Isirayilakae naxa sɛɛwa ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And Samuel said to all Israel, You see that I have given ear to everything you said to me, and have made a king over you.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a masen Isirayilakae birin bɛ, «Wo a kolon n bara n tuli mati wo ra, n naxa mangɛ dɔxɔ wo xun ma.

sentences.english: And now, see, the king is before you: and I am old and grey-headed, and my sons are with you: I have been living before your eyes from my early days till now.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nan yi ki naxan tima wo ya ra. N tan bara fori, n xunsɛxɛ bara fiixɛ, n ma die na wo ya ma. N bara ti wo ya ra kelife n fonike tɛmui ma han to.

sentences.english: Here I am: give witness against me before the Lord and before the man on whom he has put the holy oil: whose ox or ass have I taken? to whom have I been untrue? who has been crushed down by me? from whose hand have I taken a price for the blinding of my eyes? I will give it all back to you.
sentences.susu: Awa, n tixi wo ya i na nan ma, alako wo xa a fala n bɛ Alatala nun mangɛ sugandixi ya xɔri, xa a sa li n bara ninge xa na mu sofale nde ba wo yi ra. Wo xa a fala xa n bara mixi nde tɔɔrɔ, xa n bara mixi nde xun nakana, xa n bara kɔbiri rasuxu funmaya ra. Wo xa na fala, n xa na sare ragbilen wo ma.»

sentences.english: And they said, You have never been untrue to us or cruel to us; you have taken nothing from any man.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «I mu muxu tɔɔrɔ, i mu muxu xun nakana, i mu kɔbiri rasuxu muxu yi.»

sentences.english: Then he said, The Lord is witness against you, and the man on whom he has put the holy oil is witness this day that you have seen no wrong in me. And they said, He is witness.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a fala e bɛ, «Alatala nun a xa mangɛ sugandixi na seede ra to lɔxɔɛ, wo mu n nakɔrɔsixi sese xa fe ra.» E naxa a yaabi, «A na na fe seede ra!»

sentences.english: And Samuel said to the people, The Lord is witness, who gave authority to Moses and Aaron, and who took your fathers up out of the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a masen ɲama bɛ, «Alatala nan Munsa nun Haruna ti wo xun ma, a tan nan wo benbae ramini Misira bɔxi ra.

sentences.english: Keep your places now, while I take up the argument with you before the Lord, and give you the story of the righteousness of the Lord, which he has made clear by his acts to you and to your fathers.
sentences.susu: Awa yakɔsi, wo ti Alatala ya i, n xa wo ratu fe fanyie ra, Ala naxan nabaxi wo tan nun wo babae bɛ.

sentences.english: When Jacob and his sons had come into Egypt, and were crushed by the Egyptians, the prayers of your fathers came up to the Lord, and the Lord sent Moses and Aaron, who took your fathers out of Egypt, and he put them into this place.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba fa xanbi Misira, wo babae naxa Alatala xili a xa fa e mali. Alatala naxa Munsa nun Haruna xɛɛ wo benbae raminide Misira kui, e fa e rasabati yi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: But they were false to the Lord their God, and he gave them up into the hands of Sisera, captain of the army of Jabin, king of Hazor, and into the hands of the Philistines, and into the hands of the king of Moab, who made war against them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e to nɛɛmu e Marigi Alatala ma, a naxa e lu Xasori xa sɔɔrie xa mangɛ Sisera bɛlɛxɛ. Filisitakae nun Mowabakae fan naxa e gere.

sentences.english: Then crying out to the Lord, they said, We have done evil, because we have been turned away from the Lord, worshipping the Baals and the Astartes: but now, make us safe from those who are against us and we will be your servants.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa a fala Alatala bɛ, ‹Muxu bara yunubi raba Alatala rabolofe ra, muxu fa Bali kuye nun Asiteroti batu. Yandi, i xa muxu ba muxu yaxuie bɛlɛxɛ. Muxu i batuma nɛ.›

sentences.english: So the Lord sent Jerubbaal and Barak and Jephthah and Samuel and took you out of the power of those who were fighting against you on every side, and made you safe.
sentences.susu: Na nan a niya, Alatala naxa Yerubaali, Bedan, Yefite, nun Samuweli xɛɛ wo bade wo yaxuie yi ra naxee nu wo rabilinxi. Na kui wo naxa lu bɔɲɛsa kui.»

sentences.english: And when you saw that Nahash, the king of the Ammonites, was coming against you, you said to me, No more of this; we will have a king for our ruler: when the Lord your God was your king.
sentences.susu: «Wo to a to Amonikae xa mangɛ Naxasa na fafe wo gerede, wo naxa a fala n bɛ, ‹Muxu wama mangɛ xa ti muxu xun ma.› Kɔnɔ wo Marigi Alatala nan findixi wo xa mangɛ ra!

sentences.english: Here, then, is the king marked out by you: the Lord has put a king over you.
sentences.susu: Awa yakɔsi, Alatala bara mangɛ nde ti wo xun na, alɔ wo nu wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: If in the fear of the Lord you are his servants, hearing his voice and not going against the orders of the Lord, but being true to the Lord your God, you and the king ruling over you, then all will be well:
sentences.susu: Xa wo sa gaaxu Alatala ya ra, xa wo sa a batu, xa wo sa wo tuli mati a ra, xa wo mu sa a matandi, xa wo nun wo xa mangɛ sa bira Alatala fɔxɔ ra, fe birin sɔɔnɛyama nɛ wo bɛ.

sentences.english: But if you do not give ear to the voice of the Lord, but go against his orders, then the hand of the Lord will be against you and against your king for your destruction, as it was against your fathers.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa wo mu wo tuli mati Alatala ra, xa wo sa a matandi, Alatala xa xɔnɛ goroma nɛ wo ma, alɔ a goro wo benbae ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Now keep where you are and see this great thing which the Lord will do before your eyes.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi wo ti, wo xa a mato Alatala fe xungbe naxan nabama wo ya xɔri.

sentences.english: Is it not now the time of the grain cutting? My cry will go up to the Lord and he will send thunder and rain: so that you may see and be conscious of your great sin which you have done in the eyes of the Lord in desiring a king for yourselves.
sentences.susu: Mɛngi xaba tɛmui nan to, kɔnɔ n Alatala maxandima nɛ, a xa tunɛ nun galanyi rabira bɔxi ma, alako wo nɔma a kolonde wo bara fe ɲaaxi raba Alatala ya i mangɛ maxandife a ma.»

sentences.english: So Samuel made prayer to the Lord; and the Lord sent thunder and rain that day: and all the people were in fear of the Lord and of Samuel.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa Alatala maxandi. Na lɔxɔɛ yati, Alatala naxa galanyi nun tunɛ rabira bɔxi ma. Ɲama naxa gaaxu Alatala nun Samuweli ya ra,

sentences.english: And all the people said to Samuel, Make prayer for us to the Lord your God so that death may not overtake us: for in addition to all our sins we have done this evil, in desiring a king.
sentences.susu: e fa a fala Samuweli bɛ, «I xa i Marigi Alatala maxandi muxu bɛ, i xa konyi die, alako muxu naxa faxa, barima muxu bara nde sa muxu xa yunubie fari, a falafe ra, ‹Mangɛ nde ti muxu xun ma.›»

sentences.english: Then Samuel said to the people, Have no fear: truly you have done evil, but do not be turned away from the Lord; be his servants with all your heart;
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a fala ɲama bɛ, «Hali wo mu hanmɛ. Wo bara na fe kobi birin naba, kɔnɔ wo naxa makuya Alatala ra, wo xa a xa yaamarie raba wo bɔɲɛ birin na.

sentences.english: And do not go from the right way turning to those false gods in which there is no profit and no salvation, for they are false.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo makuya a ra, wo naxa bira fe fufafu fɔxɔ ra, naxee munafanyi yo mu na, naxee mu wo malima fefe ma, barima ala wule daaxie nan e ra.

sentences.english: For the Lord will not give his people up, because of the honour of his name; for it was the Lord's pleasure to make of you a people for himself.
sentences.susu: Alatala mu a xa ɲama raboloma a yɛtɛ xili xungbe xa fe ra, barima a bara natɛ tongo wo xa findi a xa ɲama ra.

sentences.english: And as for me, never will I go against the orders of the Lord by giving up my prayers for you: but I will go on teaching you the good and right way.
sentences.susu: N mu bama Alatala maxandife wo bɛ, xa na mu a findima yunubi nan na n bɛ Alatala ya i. N luma wo xaran na fe fanyi nun tinxinyi nan na.

sentences.english: Only go in the fear of the Lord, and be his true servants with all your heart, keeping in mind what great things he has done for you.
sentences.susu: N naxan tun falama wo bɛ, wo xa gaaxu Alatala ya ra, wo a xa yaamarie raba wo bɔɲɛ birin na. Wo xa ratu a xa fe xungbee ma a naxee rabaxi wo ya i.

sentences.english: But if you still do evil, destruction will overtake you and your king.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa wo fe kobi raba, wo bɔnɔma nɛ, wo tan nun wo xa mangɛ.»
Sɔlu nu bara ɲɛ tongo saxan sɔtɔ a to findi mangɛ ra. A xa mangɛya bu nɛ ɲɛ tongo naani nun firin.

sentences.english: And Saul took for himself three thousand men of Israel, of whom he kept two thousand with him in Michmash and in the mountain of Beth-el, and a thousand were with Jonathan in Gibeah in the land of Benjamin: the rest of the people he sent back to their tents.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa xɛmɛ wulu saxan sugandi sɔɔrie ra Isirayila. Xɛmɛ wulu firin nu na a sɛɛti ma Mikimasi nun Beteli geya fari, xɛmɛ wulu keren nu na a xa di Yonatan sɛɛti ma Gibeya, Bunyamin xɔnyi. A naxa ɲama dɔnxɔɛe ragbilen e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And Jonathan made an attack on the armed force of the Philistines stationed at Gibeah; and news was given to the Philistines that the Hebrews were turned against them. And Saul had a horn sounded through all the land,
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Yonatan naxa Filisitakae xa sɔɔrie bɔnbɔ, naxee nu na Geba. Filisitaka booree naxa na fe mɛ. Sɔlu naxa yaamari fi feri xa fe bɔxi birin kui, Isirayilakae xa a ramɛ.

sentences.english: And all Israel had the news that Saul had made an attack on the Philistines, and that Israel was bitterly hated by the Philistines. And the people came together after Saul to Gilgal.
sentences.susu: Isirayila birin naxa a mɛ a Sɔlu bara Filisitakae xa sɔɔrie bɔnbɔ, Isirayila naxa raɲaaxu Filisitakae ma. Isirayila ɲama naxa malan Sɔlu fɛ ma Giligali.

sentences.english: And the Philistines came together to make war on Israel, three thousand war-carriages and six thousand horsemen and an army of people like the sands of the sea in number: they came up and took up their position in Michmash, to the east of Beth-aven.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae fan naxa e malan Isirayila gere xili ma. Sɔɔri ragise wulu tongo saxan nan nu na e yi ra, a nun soe ragie wulu senni. Na ɲama nu wuya alɔ mɛyɛnyi naxan na baa dɛ ra. E naxa yonkin Mikimasi, Beti Aweni sogetede.

sentences.english: When the men of Israel saw the danger they were in, (for the people were troubled,) they took cover in cracks in the hillsides and in the woods and in rocks and holes and hollows.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mixie bɔɲɛ naxa raɲaaxu e ma, barima Filisitakae nu bara e raxɛtɛn. E naxa siga e nɔxun fɔnmɛe nun yilie kui gɛmɛ yire.

sentences.english: And a great number of the people had gone over Jordan to the land of Gad and Gilead; but Saul was still in Gilgal, and all the people went after him shaking in fear.
sentences.susu: Ndee naxa Yurudɛn xure igiri, e siga Gadi nun Galadi bɔxi ma. Sɔlu nu na Giligali. Ɲama naxan nu na a fɛ ma, nee birin nu bara gaaxu ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And he went on waiting there for seven days, the time fixed by Samuel: but Samuel did not come to Gilgal; and the people were starting to go away from him.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa Samuweli mamɛ xi solofere alɔ e nu lanxi a ma ki naxɛ, kɔnɔ Samuweli mu fa, ɲama naxa yensen fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: Then Saul said, Come here and give me the burned offering and the peace-offerings. And he made a burned offering to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na kui Sɔlu naxa yaamari fi, «Wo fa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, a nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ.» A naxa na sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ba.

sentences.english: And when the burned offering was ended, Samuel came; and Saul went out to see him and to give him a blessing.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ na ra, Samuweli naxa so. Sɔlu naxa siga a xɛɛbude.

sentences.english: And Samuel said, What have you done? And Saul said, Because I saw that the people were going away from me, and you had not come at the time which had been fixed, and the Philistines had come together at Michmash;
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a maxɔrin, «I munse rabaxi?» Sɔlu naxa a yaabi, «N to a to ɲama na yensenfe, i tan mu faxi a waxati, a nun man Filisitakae bara malan Mikimasi,

sentences.english: I said, Now the Philistines will come down on me at Gilgal, and I have made no prayer for help to the Lord: and so, forcing myself to do it, I made a burned offering.
sentences.susu: n naxa a maɲɔxun, ‹Filisitakae goroma nɛ n fɔxɔ ra Giligali, beenun n xa Alatala maxandi.› Na nan a ra, fɛɛrɛ to mu na n yi, n bara sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ba.»

sentences.english: And Samuel said to Saul, You have done a foolish thing: you have not kept the rules which the Lord your God gave you; it was the purpose of the Lord to make your authority over Israel safe for ever.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a fala Sɔlu bɛ, «I bara xaxilitareɲa raba i Marigi Alatala xa sɛriyɛ matandife ra. Alatala nu wama i xa mangɛya rasabatife Isirayila xun ma abadan,

sentences.english: But now, your authority will not go on: the Lord, searching for a man who is pleasing to him in every way, has given him the place of ruler over his people, because you have not done what the Lord gave you orders to do.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ yakɔsi i xa mangɛya bara kana. Alatala bara mixi gbɛtɛ fen naxan bɔɲɛ lanxi Ala bɔɲɛ ma. A bara na kanyi ti mangɛ ra a xa ɲama xun ma, barima i tan mu Alatala xa yaamari rabatuxi.»

sentences.english: Then Samuel went up from Gilgal and the rest of the people went up after Saul against the men of war, and they came from Gilgal to Gibeah in the land of Benjamin: and Saul took the number of the people who were with him, about six hundred men.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Samuweli naxa keli Giligali, a siga Gibeya, Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi. Sɔlu naxa a xa sɔɔrie kɔnti, a fa li xɛmɛ mixi kɛmɛ senni nu na a yi ra.

sentences.english: And Saul, with Jonathan his son and the people who were with them, was waiting in Geba in the land of Benjamin: but the tents of the Philistines were in Michmash.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu nun a xa di xɛmɛ Yonatan naxa e xa sɔɔrie ti a gere ki ma Geba Bunyamin xɔnyi. Filisitakae nu tixi Mikimasi.

sentences.english: And three bands of men came out from the Philistines to make an attack; one band went by the road which goes to Ophrah, into the land of Shual:
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri gali saxan naxa mini Filisitakae xa yonkinde. Keren naxa e xun ti Ofara kira ra, Suwali bɔxi mabiri.

sentences.english: And another went in the direction of Beth-horon: and another went by the hill looking down on the valley of Zeboiim, in the direction of the waste land.
sentences.susu: Keren naxa e xun ti Beti Xoron kira ra. Keren naxa e xun ti naaninyi kira ra, naxan goroma Seboyima gulunba gbengberenyi fɛ ma.

sentences.english: Now there was no iron-worker in all the land of Israel: for the Philistines said, For fear the Hebrews make themselves swords or spears:
sentences.susu: Xabui yo mu nu toma Isirayila bɔxi birin ma, barima Filisitakae nu bara yi tɔnyi dɔxɔ, «Eburu mixie naxa santidɛgɛma nun tanbɛ yo yailan.»

sentences.english: But all the Israelites had to go to the Philistines to get their ploughs and blades and axes and hooks made sharp;
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae birin nu sigama Filisitakae nan xɔn ma, e xa walisee ralugande alɔ kerie, bɔxi buxa see, nun beerae.

sentences.english: For they had instruments for putting an edge on their ploughs and blades and forks and axes, and for putting iron points on their ox-driving rods.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi buxa se nun keri ralugan sare findixi gbeti giramu solomasaxan nan na. Beera nun sɔxɔse ralugan sare findixi gbeti giramu naani nan na.

sentences.english: So on the day of the fight at Michmash, not a sword or a spear was to be seen in the hands of any of the people with Saul and Jonathan: only Saul and his son Jonathan had them.
sentences.susu: Na nan a niya gere lɔxɔɛ santidɛgɛma nun tanbɛ mu nu na Isirayilaka yo yi ra, hali Sɔlu nun a xa di Yonatan.

sentences.english: And the armed force of the Philistines went out to the narrow way of Michmash.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae xa sɔɔri gali nde naxa fa yonkin Mikimasi yatagi.

sentences.english: Now one day Jonathan, the son of Saul, said to the young man who was with him, looking after his arms, Come, let us go over to the Philistine force over there. But he said nothing to his father.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde, Sɔlu xa di Yonatan naxa a fala a xa konyi bɛ, naxan nu a xa geresosee maxaninma, «Won xa be igiri, won xɛɛ Filisitakae yonkinde.» A mu sese fala a baba bɛ na xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And Saul was still waiting in the farthest part of Geba, under the fruit-tree in Migron: there were about six hundred men with him;
sentences.susu: Sɔlu nu na Gibeya naaninyi Migiron wuri nde bun ma naxan xili «girenadi.» Xɛmɛ kɛmɛ senni nu na a yi ra.

sentences.english: And Ahijah, the son of Ahitub, brother of Ichabod, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eli, the priest of the Lord in Shiloh, who had the ephod. And the people had no idea that Jonathan had gone.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nde nu na a fɛ ma, naxan xili Ahiya, Axituba xa di xɛmɛ, Ikabodi xa nɛɛgaari. Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ, Eli xa di xɛmɛ Finexasi nan xa di xɛmɛ nu na Ikabodi ra. Mixi yo mu nu a kolon a Yonatan bara siga Filisitakae yire.

sentences.english: Now between the narrow roads over the mountains by which Jonathan was making his way to the Philistines' forces, there was a sharp overhanging rock on one side, and a sharp rock on the other side: one was named Bozez and the other Seneh.
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa dangi fanye firin tagi. Keren nu xili nɛ Bɔsɛsi, boore fan nu xili nɛ Sene.

sentences.english: The one rock went up on the north in front of Michmash and the other on the south in front of Geba.
sentences.susu: Keren nu na kɔɔla ma Mikimasi ya tagi, boore nu na yirefanyi ma Geba ya tagi.

sentences.english: And Jonathan said to his young servant who had his arms, Come, let us go over to the armies of these men who have no circumcision: it may be that the Lord will give us help, for there is no limit to his power; the Lord is able to give salvation by a great army or by a small band.
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa a fala a xa konyi bɛ, naxan nu a xa geresose maxaninma, «Won xɛɛ yi sunnataree yire. Tɛmunde Alatala fe nde rabama won saabui ra, barima Alatala nɔma marakisi rabade mixi xurudi saabui ra, xa na mu mixi wuyaxi saabui ra.»

sentences.english: And his servant said to him, Do whatever is in your mind: see, I am with you in every impulse of your heart.
sentences.susu: A xa konyi naxa a yaabi, «I waxɔnfe birin naba, hali i mu siikɛ, won birin na xaxili keren.»

sentences.english: Then Jonathan said, Now we will go over to these men and let them see us.
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa a fala a bɛ, «Won xɛɛ han na mixie xa won to.

sentences.english: If they say to us, Keep quiet where you are till we come to you; then we will keep our places and not go up to them.
sentences.susu: Xa e a fala ‹Wo ti mɛnni, muxu fama ya›, won tima mɛnni nɛ, won mu tema e yire.

sentences.english: But if they say, Come up to us; then we will go up, for the Lord has given them into our hands: and this will be the sign to us.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa e a fala, ‹Wo fa be›, won tema nɛ, barima Alatala bara e sa won bɛlɛxɛ. Na nan findima won bɛ tɔnxuma ra.»

sentences.english: And they let the Philistine force see the two of them: and the Philistines said, Look! the Hebrews are coming out of the holes where they have taken cover.
sentences.susu: E to mini Filisitakae ma, nee naxa a fala, «Isirayilakae nan yi ki. E na minife fɔnmɛ kui, e nu e nɔxunxi dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: And the armed men of the force gave Jonathan and his servant their answer, saying, Come up here to us, and we will let you see something. Then Jonathan said to his servant, Come up after me: for the Lord has given them up into the hands of Israel.
sentences.susu: Filisitaka naxee yonkinxi mɛnni, e naxa a fala Yonatan nun a xa konyi bɛ, «Wo fa be, muxu xa fe nde fala wo bɛ.» Yonatan naxa a fala a xa konyi bɛ, naxan nu a xa geresosee xaninma, «I xa te n fɔxɔ ra, barima Alatala bara yi mixie sa Isirayilakae bɛlɛxɛ.»

sentences.english: And Jonathan went up, gripping with his hands and his feet, his servant going up after him; and the Philistines gave way before Jonathan when he made an attack on them, and his servant put them to death after him.
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa te a wulumen na, a xa konyi na a xanbi ra. Yonatan nun a xa konyi naxa na Filisitakae faxa.

sentences.english: And at their first attack, Jonathan and his servant put to the sword about twenty men, all inside the space of half an acre of land.
sentences.susu: Na gere kui Yonatan nun a xa konyi naxa mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun nde faxa na yire raxɛtɛnxi.

sentences.english: And there was great fear in the tents and in the field and among all the men of the armed force, and the attackers were shaking with fear; even the earth was moved with a great shaking and there was a fear as from God.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae bɔɲɛ naxa mini yonkinde kui, gaaxui fa ɲama suxu na longori birin. Bɔxi yati naxa sɛrɛn. Alatala nu bara a ragaaxu a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: And the watchmen of Saul, looking out from Geba in the land of Benjamin, saw all the army flowing away and running here and there.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa yire makantɛe, naxee nu na Gibeya, Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi ma, nee naxa Filisitakae to e yensenfe gi kui.

sentences.english: Then Saul said to the people who were with him, Let everyone be numbered and let us see who has gone from us. And when they had been numbered, it was seen that Jonathan and his servant were not there.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a fala sɔɔrie bɛ, «Wo kɔnti ti, won xa a kolon naxan minixi won ya ma.» E to kɔnti ti e naxa a to a Yonatan nun a xa konyi mu na ɲama ya ma.

sentences.english: And Saul said to Ahijah, Let the ephod come here. For he went before Israel with the ephod at that time.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa saatɛ kankira to nu na Isirayilakae yonkinde kui, Sɔlu naxa a fala Ahiya bɛ, «Fa Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ra.»

sentences.english: Now while Saul was talking to the priest, the noise in the tents of the Philistines became louder and louder; and Saul said to the priest, Take back your hand.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu nu wɔyɛnma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra tɛmui naxɛ, gere sɔnxɔ xui fan nu gboma nan tui Filisitakae yonkinde. Na kui Sɔlu naxa a fala sɛrɛxɛdubɛ bɛ, «Hali i mu Ala maxandi kɔrɛ.»

sentences.english: And Saul and all the people with him came together and went forward to the fight: and every man's sword was turned against the man at his side, and there was a very great noise.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a xa sɔɔrie xili, e fa siga gere yire. Mɛnni e naxa a to Filisitakae nu na e boore sɔxɔfe santidɛgɛma ra ɲaxasi daaxi.

sentences.english: Then the Hebrews who had been with the Philistines for some time, and had gone up with them to their tents, turning round were joined to those who were with Saul and Jonathan.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka ndee, naxee nu na Filisitakae xa nɔɛ bun ma, nee naxa fa Sɔlu nun Yonatan mabiri.

sentences.english: And all the men of Israel who had taken cover in the hill-country of Ephraim, hearing that the Philistines had been put to flight, went after them, attacking them.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka naxee nu bara e nɔxun Efirami geya longori ra, e birin naxa mini Filisitakae gerede e gi tɛmui.

sentences.english: So the Lord made Israel safe that day: and the fight went over to Beth-aven.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, Alatala Isirayila rakisi nɛ. Gere naxa lantan yɛ han Beti Aweni.

sentences.english: And all the people were with Saul, about twenty thousand men, and the fight was general through all the hill-country of Ephraim; but Saul made a great error that day, by putting the people under an oath, saying, Let that man be cursed who takes food before evening comes and I have given punishment to those who are against me. So the people had not a taste of food.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae nu na tɔɔrɛ nde kui na lɔxɔɛ, barima Sɔlu nu bara a kali ɲama bɛ, «Dankɛ na mixi bɛ, naxan a dɛgema beenun n xa n gbe ɲɔxɔ n yaxuie ma.» Na kui, mixi yo mu donse don na lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: And there was honey on the face of the field, and all the people came to the honey, the bees having gone from it;
sentences.susu: Ɲama xa ɲɛrɛ kui, e naxa kumi li fɔtɔnyi nde kui,

sentences.english: But not a man put his hand to his mouth for fear of the curse.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ mixi yo mu a nɛmunnɛmun Sɔlu xa marakali xa fe ra.

sentences.english: But Jonathan, having no knowledge of the oath his father had put on the people, stretching out the rod which was in his hand, put the end of it in the honey, and put it to his mouth; then his eyes were made bright.
sentences.susu: Yonatan to na yire li, a fa kumi to, a naxa a xa yisuxuwuri rasin kumi kui, a a makɔn. A ya naxa iyalan keren na. A mu nu a baba xa marakali mɛxi.

sentences.english: Then one of the people said to him, Your father put the people under an oath, saying, Let that man be cursed who takes any food this day. And the people were feeble, needing food.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa a fala a bɛ, «I baba bara ɲama rakali a falafe ra, ‹Dankɛ na mixi bɛ naxan a dɛgema to.› Na nan a toxi ɲama na tɔɔrɛ kui yi ki.»

sentences.english: Then Jonathan said, My father has made trouble come on the land: now see how bright my eyes have become because I have taken a little of this honey.
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa a yaabi, «N baba na ɲama tɔɔrɔfe nɛ na ki. Wo a mato n ya iyalanxi ki naxɛ, n to yi kumi kɔnxi.

sentences.english: How much more if the people had freely taken their food from the goods of those who were fighting against them! would there not have been much greater destruction among the Philistines?
sentences.susu: Xa won ma sɔɔri gali won yaxuie xa donse nde don to nu, nde ɲan bara sa Filisitakae xa xunnakanɛ fari nu.»

sentences.english: That day they overcame the Philistines from Michmash to Aijalon: and the people were feeble from need of food.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ e naxa Filisitakae bɔnbɔ, kelife Mikimasi ma, han Ayalon. Ɲama nu bara tagan ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And rushing at the goods taken in the fight, the people took oxen and sheep and young oxen, and put them to death there on the earth, and had a meal, taking the flesh with the blood in it.
sentences.susu: E naxa din e yaxuie xa see ra. E naxa yɛxɛɛe, sie, nun ningee kɔn naxaba keren na, e fa e don a nun e wuli ra.

sentences.english: Then it was said to Saul, See, the people are sinning against the Lord, taking the blood with the flesh. And he said to those who gave him the news, Now let a great stone be rolled to me here.
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee to a fala Sɔlu bɛ, a a xa sɔɔrie na yunubi sɔtɔfe Alatala ra sube donfe a wuli ra, Sɔlu naxa a fala ɲama xa fe ra, «Yanfante nan e ra. Wo fa gɛmɛ xungbe ra be.

sentences.english: And Saul said, Go about among the people and say to them, Let every man come here to me with his ox and his sheep, and put them to death here, and take his meal: do no sin against the Lord by taking the blood with the flesh. So all the people took their oxen with them that night and put them to death there.
sentences.susu: Wo yensen ɲama tagi, wo a fala e bɛ, mixi birin xa fa a xa ninge ra, a xa yɛxɛɛ, xa na mu a ra a xa si. E xa a faxa be. Na kui, e nɔma a donde, e mu yunubi sɔtɔ Alatala ra sube donfe a wuli ra.» Kɔɛ ra, mixie birin naxa siga mɛnni e xa xuruse ra, e xa a kɔn naxaba naa.

sentences.english: And Saul put up an altar to the Lord: this was the first altar which he put up to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu sɛrɛxɛbade singe ti nɛ Alatala bɛ mɛnni.

sentences.english: And Saul said, Let us go down after the Philistines by night, attacking them till the morning, till there is not a man of them living. And they said, Do whatever seems right to you. Then the priest said, Let us come near to God.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Sɔlu naxa a fala, «Won xa bira na Filisitakae fɔxɔ ra to kɔɛ ra yati. Won xa e tuxunsan han subaxɛ, won naxa mixi keren lu na.» Sɔɔrie naxa a yaabi, «Won xa a raba alɔ i wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ.» Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa a fala, «Won xa Ala maxɔrin sinden.»

sentences.english: And Saul, desiring directions from God, said, Am I to go down after the Philistines? will you give them up into the hands of Israel? But he gave him no answer that day.
sentences.susu: Na kui Sɔlu naxa Ala maxɔrin, «A lanma n xa bira Filisitakae fɔxɔ ra? I tan e sama nɛ Isirayila bɛlɛxɛ?» Kɔnɔ na lɔxɔɛ, Ala mu a yaabi.

sentences.english: And Saul said, Come near, all you chiefs of the people, and let us get word from God and see in whom is this sin today.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a xa sɔɔri gali xunyie xili, a a fala e bɛ, «Wo xa a mato yunubi naxan nabaxi to.

sentences.english: For, by the living Lord, the saviour of Israel, even if the sinner is Jonathan, my son, death will certainly be his fate. But not a man among all the people gave him any answer.
sentences.susu: N bara n kali Isirayila Rakisima Alatala ra, hali n ma di Yonatan nan a rabaxi, n na a faxama nɛ.» Ɲama birin ya ma, mixi yo mu a yaabi.

sentences.english: Then he said to all Israel, You be on one side, and I with Jonathan my son will be on the other side. And the people said to Saul, Do whatever seems good to you.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Isirayila ɲama bɛ, «Wo ti mɛnni, n tan nun n ma di Yonatan, muxu tima bebiri.» Ɲama naxa a yaabi, «I waxɔnyi raba.»

sentences.english: Then Saul said to the Lord, the God of Israel, Why have you not given me an answer today? If the sin is in me or in Jonathan my son, O Lord God of Israel, give Urim, and if it is in your people Israel, give Thummim. And by the decision of the Lord, Saul and Jonathan were marked out, and the people went free.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Sɔlu naxa Alatala maxandi, «Isirayila Marigi Ala, kiiti sa muxu tagi.» Alatala naxa a masen a kiiti fanxi ɲama nan bɛ, a mu fanxi Sɔlu nun Yonatan bɛ.

sentences.english: And Saul said, Give your decision between my son Jonathan and me. And Jonathan was taken.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu man naxa Alatala maxandi kiiti xa sa a tan nun Yonatan tagi. Na kui kiiti mu fanxi Yonatan bɛ.

sentences.english: Then Saul said to Jonathan, Give me an account of what you have done. And Jonathan gave him the story and said, Certainly I took a little honey on the end of my rod; and now death is to be my fate.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a xa di Yonatan maxɔrin, «I munse rabaxi?» Yonatan naxa a yaabi, «N kumi nde nan kɔn, n naxan tongo n ma yisuxuwuri ra. N tan nan yi ki, i xa n faxa.»

sentences.english: And Saul said, May God's punishment be on me if death is not your fate, Jonathan.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a fala, «I nɔndi. Yonatan, i xa faxa. Xa n mu i faxa, Ala xa n ɲaxankata a ɲaaxi ra.»

sentences.english: And the people said to Saul, Is death to come to Jonathan, the worker of this great salvation for Israel? Let it not be so: by the living Lord, not one hair of his head is to be touched, for he has been working with God today. So the people kept Jonathan from death.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ sɔɔri gali naxa a fala Sɔlu bɛ, «A lanma Yonatan xa faxa, naxan geeni sɔtɔ Isirayila bɛ sɛnbɛ ra? Astɔfulahi. Muxu bara muxu kali Alatala ra, hali xunsɛxɛ keren a mu bama a xunyi ra, barima Yonatan walixi to Ala xa mali saabui nan na.» E Yonatan ratanga Sɔlu ma na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Then Saul, turning back, went after the Philistines no longer: and the Philistines went back to their place.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu to gɛ Filisitakae keride waxati nde bun ma, a naxa gbilen a xɔnyi. Filisitaka naxee luxi, e fan naxa siga e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Now when Saul had taken his place as ruler of Israel, he made war on those who were against him on every side, Moab and the Ammonites and Edom and the kings of Zobah and the Philistines: and whichever way he went, he overcame them.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu to findi Isirayila mangɛ ra, a naxa gere ti a yaxuie birin bɛ: Mowabakae, Amonikae, Edonkae, Soba mangɛe, nun Filisitakae.

sentences.english: And he did great things, and overcame the Amalekites, and made Israel safe from the hands of their attackers.
sentences.susu: A naxa Amalɛkikae bɔnbɔ sɛnbɛ ra, a Isirayila ba mixie bɛlɛxɛ naxee nu e xa bɔxi tuxunsanma.

sentences.english: Now the sons of Saul were Jonathan and Ishvi and Malchi-shua; and these are the names of his daughters: the older was named Merab and the younger Michal;
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa di xɛmɛe nu xili nɛ: Yonatan, Yisiwi, nun Malakisuwa. A xa di ginɛe nu xili nɛ: Merabi, nun a xanbiratoe Mikali.

sentences.english: The name of Saul's wife was Ahinoam, the daughter of Ahimaaz; the captain of his army was Abner, the son of Ner, brother of Saul's father.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa ginɛ nu xili nɛ Axinowama, Aximaasi xa di. A xa sɔɔri gali mangɛ nu findi Abeneri nan na, Sɔlu sɔxɔ Neri xa di.

sentences.english: Kish, the father of Saul, and Ner, the father of Abner, were sons of Abiel.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu baba Kinsi nun Abeneri baba Neri nan lanxi Abiyɛli xa die ma.

sentences.english: All through the life of Saul there was bitter war against the Philistines; and whenever Saul saw any strong man or any good fighting man, he kept him near himself.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu nu Filisitaka gerema a xa simaya birin kui. Sɔlu nu gbangbalanyi sɛnbɛmae birin naso nɛ a xa sɔɔrie ya ma.

sentences.english: And Samuel said to Saul, The Lord sent me to put the holy oil on you and to make you king over his people, over Israel: so give ear now to the words of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a fala Sɔlu bɛ, «Alatala n tan nan xɛɛ n xa i sugandi mangɛ ra a xa ɲama Isirayila xun ma. I tuli mati Alatala xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: The Lord of armies says, I will give punishment to Amalek for what he did to Israel, fighting against him on the way when Israel came out of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xui nan ya: ‹N bara natɛ tongo Amalɛkikae xa fe ra, naxee tondi Isirayila xa dangi e xa kira xɔn kelife ra Misira.

sentences.english: Go now and put Amalek to the sword, putting to the curse all they have, without mercy: put to death every man and woman, every child and baby at the breast, every ox and sheep, camel and ass.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, siga, e ratɔn. I naxa e sese lu naa. I xa e xa xɛmɛe, e xa ginɛe, e xa die, e xa diyɔrɛe, e xa ningee, e xa yɛxɛɛe, e xa sie, e xa ɲɔxɔmɛe, e xa sofalee birin faxa.›»

sentences.english: And Saul sent for the people and had them numbered in Telaim, two hundred thousand footmen and ten thousand men of Judah.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a xa sɔɔri gali malan Telayimi. Xɛmɛ mixi wulu kɛmɛ firin nan faxi kelife kɔɔla ma, xɛmɛ mixi wulu fu nan faxi kelife Yuda bɔnsɔɛ ma.

sentences.english: And Saul came to the town of Amalek, and took up his position in the valley secretly.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa gantanyi te fole kui Amalɛkikae xa taa fari ma.

sentences.english: And Saul said to the Kenites, Go away, take yourselves out from among the Amalekites, or destruction will overtake you with them: for you were kind to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt. So the Kenites went away from among the Amalekites.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Keni bɔnsɔɛ bɛ, «Wo mini Amalɛkikae tagi, alako wo naxa sɔntɔ e ya ma, barima wo hinnɛ nɛ Isirayilakae ra e minixi Misira bɔxi ra tɛmui naxɛ.» Keni bɔnsɔɛ naxa mini Amalɛkikae ya ma.

sentences.english: And Saul made an attack on the Amalekites from Havilah on the road to Shur, which is before Egypt.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa Amalɛkikae bɔnbɔ kelife Hawila ma han Suri sode dɛ ra Misira ya ra.

sentences.english: He took Agag, king of the Amalekites, prisoner, and put all the people to the sword without mercy.
sentences.susu: A naxa Amalɛki mangɛ Agaga suxu, a mu a faxa, kɔnɔ a naxa a xa ɲama tan birin sɔntɔ santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: But Saul and the people did not put Agag to death, and they kept the best of the sheep and the oxen and the fat beasts and the lambs, and whatever was good, not desiring to put them to the curse: but everything which was bad and of no use they put to the curse.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu nun a xa ɲama mu tin Agaga faxade. E naxa a lu a nii ra, a nun a xa xuruse fanyi bɔrɔgɛxie, a xa yɛxɛɛe, a xa sie, nun a xa ningee. E mu tin nee sɔntɔde, kɔnɔ naxee mu fanxi, e nee nan faxa.

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to Samuel,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti Samuweli bɛ,

sentences.english: It is no longer my pleasure for Saul to be king; for he is turned back from going in my ways, and has not done my orders. And Samuel was very sad, crying to the Lord in prayer all night.
sentences.susu: «N nimisaxi Sɔlu xa fe ra n naxan tixi mangɛ ra, barima a bara a kobe so n na, a mu biraxi n wɔyɛn xui fɔxɔ ra.» Samuweli naxa sunnun ki fanyi, a Alatala makula na kɔɛ birin na.

sentences.english: And early in the morning he got up and went to Saul; and word was given to Samuel that Saul had come to Carmel and put up a pillar, and had gone from there down to Gilgal.
sentences.susu: A naxa keli subaxɛ ma, a siga Sɔlu yire. Mixi nde naxa a fala a bɛ a Sɔlu bara siga Karemele geya fari tɔnxuma nde tide. Na dangi xanbi, a keli mɛnni, a goro Giligali.

sentences.english: And Samuel came to Saul; and Saul said to him, May the blessing of the Lord be with you: I have done what was ordered by the Lord.
sentences.susu: Samuweli to Sɔlu yire li, Sɔlu naxa a fala a bɛ, «Ala xa baraka sa i ma. N bara Alatala xa yaamari ratinmɛ.»

sentences.english: And Samuel said, What then is this sound of the crying of sheep and the noise of oxen which comes to my ears?
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a maxɔrin, «N xuruse wa xui mundun mɛfe yi ki?»

sentences.english: And Saul said, They have taken them from the Amalekites: for the people have kept the best of the sheep and of the oxen as an offering to the Lord your God; all the rest we have given up to destruction.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a yaabi, «Ɲama nan faxi yi xurusee ra e naxan tongoxi Amalɛkikae yi ra, alako e xa e ba sɛrɛxɛ ra i Marigi Alatala bɛ. Muxu bara na dɔnxɔɛ tan sɔntɔ.»

sentences.english: Then Samuel said to Saul, Say no more! Let me give you word of what the Lord has said to me this night. And he said to him, Say on.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a fala Sɔlu bɛ, «Awa yire. N xa Alatala xa masenyi fala i bɛ a naxan fixi n ma yi kɔɛ ra.» Sɔlu naxa a fala, «Awa, na fala n bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Samuel said, Though you may seem little to yourself, are you not head of the tribes of Israel? for the Lord with the holy oil made you king over Israel,
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a fala, «Alatala mu i tixi xɛ mangɛ ra Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ xun ma, hali i to nu a kolon mixi xurudi nan i ra?

sentences.english: And the Lord sent you on a journey and said, Go and put to the curse those sinners, the Amalekites, fighting against them till every one is dead.
sentences.susu: Alatala i xɛɛ nɛ, a a fala i bɛ, ‹Siga Amalɛki yunubitɔɛe sɔntɔde. I xa e birin ɲɔn feo›.

sentences.english: Why then did you not do the orders of the Lord, but by violently taking their goods did evil in the eyes of the Lord?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra i mu i tuli matixi Alatala xui ra? Munfe ra i baganxi na see ma, i fe ɲaaxi raba Alatala ya i?»

sentences.english: And Saul said, Truly, I have done the orders of the Lord and have gone the way the Lord sent me; I have taken Agag, the king of Amalek, and have given the Amalekites up to destruction.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa Samuweli yaabi, «N bara Alatala xui rabatu a fanyi ra. N bara bira a xa kira fɔxɔ ra, a n tixi naxan xɔn ma. N faxi Amalɛki mangɛ Agaga nan tun na, n bara Amalɛki ɲama dɔnxɔɛ birin sɔntɔ.

sentences.english: But the people took some of their goods, sheep and oxen, the chief of the things which were put to the curse, to make an offering of them to the Lord your God in Gilgal.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ ɲama bara a xa xuruse fanyie mayegeti, nee xa findi sɛrɛxɛ fisamantee ra i Marigi Alatala bɛ Giligali.»

sentences.english: And Samuel said, Has the Lord as much delight in offerings and burned offerings as in the doing of his orders? Truly, to do his pleasure is better than to make offerings, and to give ear to him than the fat of sheep.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a yaabi, «Alatala ɲɛlɛxinma sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nun hadiyae nan na ba, ka a ɲɛlɛxinma mixie nan na naxee a xui rabatuma? N xa a fala i bɛ, yaamari rabatufe fisa sɛrɛxɛ bafe bɛ, yɛtɛ magoroe fisa, yɛxɛɛ kontonyi ture bɛ.

sentences.english: For to go against his orders is like the sin of those who make use of secret arts, and pride is like giving worship to images. Because you have put away from you the word of the Lord, he has put you from your place as king.
sentences.susu: Ala xui matandife ɲaaxu, alɔ sematoe xa wali ɲaaxuxi ki naxɛ. Ala xa yaamari matandife ɲaaxu, alɔ kuye batufe ɲaaxuxi ki naxɛ. I to bara Alatala xa yaamari rabɛɲin, a fan fama nɛ i rabɛɲinde, a mangɛya ba i yi ra.»

sentences.english: And Saul said to Samuel, Great is my sin: for I have gone against the orders of the Lord and against your words: because, fearing the people, I did what they said.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a fala Samuweli bɛ, «N bara yunubi raba. N bara Alatala xa sɛriyɛ kana, n bara i fan xui matandi. N nu gaaxuxi ɲama nan ya ra, n naxa n tuli mati e ra.

sentences.english: So now, let my sin have forgiveness, and go back with me to give worship to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n bara i mayandi, diɲɛ n ma yunubi ma. I naxa gbilen n fɔxɔ ra. Na kui n fan xa suyidi Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Samuel said to Saul, I will not go back with you: for you have put away from you the word of the Lord, and the Lord has put you from your place as king over Israel.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a fala Sɔlu bɛ, «N mu birama i fɔxɔ ra, barima i bara i kobe raso Alatala xa masenyi ra, Alatala fan bara i rabɛɲin, a bara Isirayila mangɛya ba i yi ra.»

sentences.english: And when Samuel was turning round to go away, Saul took the skirt of his robe in his hand, and the cloth came away.
sentences.susu: Samuweli to a mafindi sigafe ra, Sɔlu naxa a xa donma suxu, a fa bɔɔ a yi ra.

sentences.english: And Samuel said to him, The Lord has taken away the kingdom of Israel from you this day by force, and has given it to a neighbour of yours who is better than you.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a fala a bɛ, «To Alatala fan bara Isirayila mangɛya ba i yi ra na ki, a a fi i boore ma, naxan fan dangi i tan na.

sentences.english: And further, the Glory of Israel will not say what is false, and his purpose may not be changed: for he is not a man, whose purpose may be changed.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxan findixi Isirayila sɛnbɛ ra, a mu wule falama, a xaxili mu masarama. Ibunadama mu a ra.»

sentences.english: Then he said, Great is my sin: but still, give me honour now before the heads of my people and before Israel, and come back with me so that I may give worship to the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu man naxa a fala, «N bara yunubi raba. Yandi, n bara i maxandi, i xa n binya Isirayila nun a kuntigie ya i. Bira n fɔxɔ ra, n xa suyidi i Marigi Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: So Samuel went back after Saul, and Saul gave worship to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Samuweli naxa bira Sɔlu fɔxɔ ra. Sɔlu naxa suyidi Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: Then Samuel said, Make Agag, the king of the Amalekites, come here to me. And Agag came to him shaking with fear. And Agag said, Truly the pain of death is past.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi Samuweli naxa a fala, «Wo fa Amalɛki mangɛ Agaga ra.» Agaga naxa fa bɔɲɛsa kui, barima a maɲɔxunxi nɛ e mu xɔnɔxi a ma sɔnɔn e xa a faxa.

sentences.english: And Samuel said, As your sword has made women without children, so now your mother will be without children among women. And Agag was cut up by Samuel, bone from bone, before the Lord in Gilgal.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a fala a bɛ, «I to dingɛe xa die faxa i xa santidɛgɛma ra, i nga fan xa di bama a yi ra.» Samuweli to na fala, a naxa a faxa Alatala ya i Giligali.

sentences.english: Then Samuel went to Ramah; and Saul went up to his house in Gibeah, in the land of Saul.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa siga Rama. Sɔlu fan naxa siga a xɔnyi Gibiya.

sentences.english: And Samuel never saw Saul again till the day of his death; but Samuel was sorrowing for Saul: and it was no longer the Lord's pleasure for Saul to be king over Israel.
sentences.susu: Samuweli mu Sɔlu to sɔnɔn. A naxa sunnun Sɔlu xa fe ra. Alatala fan naxa nimisa a Sɔlu findife mangɛ ra Isirayila.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Samuel, How long will you go on sorrowing for Saul, seeing that I have put him from his place as king over Israel? Take oil in your vessel and go; I will send you to Jesse, the Beth-lehemite: for I have got a king for myself among his sons.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Samuweli bɛ, «I sunnunma Sɔlu xa fe ra han mun tɛmui? N bara a rabɛɲin, n bara Isirayila mangɛya ba a yi. I xa feri ture sase rafe ture ra, i xa siga Bɛtɛlɛɛmu. N i xɛɛfe Yisayi Bɛtɛlɛɛmuka nan xɔnyi, barima n bara mangɛ sugandi a xa di xɛmɛe ya ma.»

sentences.english: And Samuel said, How is it possible for me to go? If Saul gets news of it he will put me to death. And the Lord said, Take a young cow with you and say, I have come to make an offering to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a fala, «N sigama di? Sɔlu na a kolon, a n faxama nɛ.» Alatala naxa a fala, «I xa ninge xanin i xun ma, i a fala, ‹N fafe yi sɛrɛxɛ bade Alatala bɛ.›

sentences.english: And send for Jesse to be present at the offering, and I will make clear to you what you are to do: and you are to put the holy oil on him whose name I give you.
sentences.susu: I xa Yisayi xili na sɛrɛxɛ ma. Na tɛmui n i rakolonma i lan i xa naxan naba. I fama nɛ mixi sugandide, n naxan masenma i bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Samuel did as the Lord said and came to Beth-lehem. And the responsible men of the town came out to him in fear and said, Do you come in peace?
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a raba alɔ Alatala a fala a bɛ ki naxɛ, a siga Bɛtɛlɛɛmu. Taa forie to a to, e naxa gaaxu. E naxa a maxɔrin, «I faxi fe fanyi nan na muxu bɛ?»

sentences.english: And he said, In peace: I have come to make an offering to the Lord: make yourselves clean and come with me to make the offering. And he made Jesse and his sons clean, and sent for them to be present at the offering.
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «Iyo, n faxi sɛrɛxɛ bade Alatala nan bɛ. Wo xa wo rasɛniyɛn, wo xa fa lan na sɛrɛxɛ ba ma.» A naxa a fala Yisayi nun a xa die fan bɛ, e fan xa e rasɛniyɛn, e xa lan sɛrɛxɛ ba ma.

sentences.english: Now when they came, looking at Eliab, he said, Clearly the man of the Lord's selection is before him.
sentences.susu: Mixie to fa, Samuweli naxa Yisayi xa di Eliyabi to. A naxa a maɲɔxun, «Mixi nan na ki Alatala naxan sugandixi mangɛ ra.»

sentences.english: But the Lord said to Samuel, Do not take note of his face or how tall he is, because I will not have him: for the Lord's view is not man's; man takes note of the outer form, but the Lord sees the heart.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala naxa a fala Samuweli bɛ, «I naxa mixi fate bɛndɛ xa mato. N mu na xɛmɛ sugandixi. N ya mu tima fe ra, adamadi ya tima naxan na. N tan mixi bɔɲɛ ma fe nan matoma.»

sentences.english: Then Jesse sent for Abinadab and made him come before Samuel. And he said, The Lord has not taken this one.
sentences.susu: Yisayi naxa Abinadabo xili, a a masen Samuweli bɛ. Kɔnɔ Samuweli naxa a fala, «Alatala mu yi fan sugandixi.»

sentences.english: Then Jesse made Shammah come before him. And he said, The Lord has not taken this one.
sentences.susu: Yisayi naxa Sanma masen Samuweli bɛ. Kɔnɔ Samuweli naxa a fala, «Alatala mu yi fan sugandixi.»

sentences.english: And Jesse made his seven sons come before Samuel. And Samuel said to Jesse, The Lord has not taken any of these.
sentences.susu: Yisayi naxa a xa di soloferee birin masen Samuweli bɛ keren keren, kɔnɔ Samuweli naxa a fala Yisayi bɛ, «Alatala mu e sese sugandixi.»

sentences.english: Then Samuel said to Jesse, Are all your children here? And he said, There is still the youngest, and he is looking after the sheep. And Samuel said to Jesse, Send and make him come here: for we will not take our seats till he is here.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Samuweli naxa a maxɔrin, «Di gbɛtɛ yo mu na i yi ra?» Yisayi naxa a yaabi, «Dimɛdi keren nan fa luxi, kɔnɔ na tan na xurusee dɛmadonfe.» Samuweli naxa a yaabi, «I xa mixi nde xɛɛ a fɔxɔ ra, a xa fa. Won mu sɛrɛxɛ donma fo a xa fa.»

sentences.english: So he sent and made him come in. Now he had red hair and beautiful eyes and pleasing looks. And the Lord said, Come, put the oil on him, for this is he.
sentences.susu: Yisayi naxa mixi nde xɛɛ a xilide. A to fa, Samuweli naxa a to a xɛmɛ tofanyi na nu a ra. A ya iyalan, a fate bɛndɛ fan. Alatala naxa a fala Samuweli bɛ. «A tan nan ya. I xa ture sa a xunyi a sugandife ra.»

sentences.english: Then Samuel took the bottle of oil, and put the oil on him there among his brothers: and from that day the spirit of the Lord came on David with power. So Samuel went back to Ramah.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa feri ture sase tongo naxan nu rafexi ture ra, a ture sa Dawuda xunyi a taarae ya xɔri. Kelife na lɔxɔɛ, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa lu Dawuda fɔxɔ ra. Na dangi xanbi, Samuweli naxa gbilen Rama.

sentences.english: Now the spirit of the Lord had gone from Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord was troubling him.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala Xaxili naxa gbilen Sɔlu fɔxɔ ra. Alatala naxa a niya ɲinnɛ nde xa a tɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: And Saul's servants said to him, See now, an evil spirit from God is troubling you.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa walikɛe naxa a fala a bɛ, «Ala bara a niya ɲinnɛ nde xa i tɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: Now give orders to your servants who are here before you to go in search of a man who is an expert player on a corded instrument: and it will be that when the evil spirit from God is on you, he will make music for you on his instrument, and you will get well.
sentences.susu: Muxu marigi, i xa yaamari fi muxu ma, i xa konyi die, muxu xa sa mixi fen naxan fata kɔra raberede. Ɲinnɛ na i tɔɔrɔ, na kanyi xa kɔra rabere i bɔɲɛ safe ra.»

sentences.english: And Saul said to his servants, Then get me a man who is an expert player, and make him come to me.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a sago fi a falafe ra, «Wo sa na mixi fen n bɛ, naxan fata a fanyi ra.»

sentences.english: Then one of the servants in answer said, I have seen a son of Jesse, the Beth-lehemite, who is expert at playing, and a strong man and a man of war; and he is wise in his words, and pleasing in looks, and the Lord is with him.
sentences.susu: A xa walikɛ nde naxa a fala, «N bara Yisayi xa di xɛmɛ to Bɛtɛlɛɛmu. A kɔra raberema a fanyi ra. Gbangbalanyi tofanyi na a ra, naxan fata gere sode. A wɔyɛn ki fan. Alatala xa barakatɔɛ na a ra.»

sentences.english: So Saul sent his servants to Jesse and said, Send me your son David who is with the sheep.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa mixie xɛɛ Yisayi xɔn ma, a falafe ra a xa a xa di Dawuda so a yi ra, naxan na xurusee dɛmadonfe.

sentences.english: And Jesse took five cakes of bread and a skin of wine and a young goat and sent them to Saul by David.
sentences.susu: Yisayi naxa taami, wɛni, nun si baki sofale fari, a a so a xa di Dawuda yi ra katarabi Sɔlu ma.

sentences.english: And David came to Saul, waiting before him: and he became very dear to Saul, who made him his servant, giving him the care of his arms.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa siga a yɛtɛ dɛntɛgɛde Sɔlu bɛ. Dawuda naxa rafan a ma ki fanyi. Sɔlu naxa a findi a xa geresose xaninma ra.

sentences.english: And Saul sent to Jesse saying, Let David be with me, for he is pleasing to me.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa xɛɛra ti Yisayi ma a falafe ra a bɛ, «Yandi, Dawuda xa lu n yi ra. A rafan n ma ki fanyi.»

sentences.english: And whenever the evil spirit from God came on Saul, David took his instrument and made music: so new life came to Saul, and he got well, and the evil spirit went away from him.
sentences.susu: Ala to a niya ɲinnɛ xa bira Sɔlu fɔxɔ ra, Dawuda nu fa kɔra rabere han Sɔlu fisa, ɲinnɛ fa gbilen a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Now the Philistines got their armies together for war, and came together at Socoh in the land of Judah, and took up their position between Socoh and Azekah in Ephes-dammim.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa e xa sɔɔrie malan gere xili ma Efesi Damimi, Soko nun Aseka tagi Yudaya bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Saul and the men of Israel came together and took up their position in the valley of Elah, and put their forces in order against the Philistines.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu nun Isirayila xa sɔɔrie fan naxa e malan, e sa yonkin Terebinti gulunba kui Filisitakae ya ra.

sentences.english: The Philistines were stationed on the mountain on one side and Israel on the mountain on the other side: and there was a valley between them.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae nu na geya yire sɛɛti keren, Isirayilakae fan nu na boore sɛɛti, gulunba na e tagi.

sentences.english: And a fighter came out from the tents of the Philistines, named Goliath of Gath; he was more than six cubits tall.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae xa sɛnbɛma nde naxa mini, naxan nu xili Goliyati, a kuya mɛtiri saxan.

sentences.english: And he had a head-dress of brass on his head, and he was dressed in a coat of metal, the weight of which was five thousand shekels of brass.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri xunyi makantase nu na a xun na, naxan yailanxi wure gbeeli ra. Kanke makantase wure gbeeli daaxi nu na a ma, naxan binyɛ lanxi kilo tongo senni ma.

sentences.english: His legs were covered with plates of brass and hanging on his back was a javelin of brass.
sentences.susu: Sanyi makantase wure gbeeli daaxi nu na a sanyie ma, tanbɛ wure gbeeli daaxi fan nu gbakuxi a fari.

sentences.english: The stem of his spear was as long as a cloth-worker's rod, and its head was made of six hundred shekels' weight of iron: and one went before him with his body-cover.
sentences.susu: A xa tanbɛ nu yailanxi wuri kuye ra naxan xungbo alɔ mabɔɛ xa wuri, dugi masɔxɔ se. A xa tanbɛ ɲɔɛ nu yailanxi wure ra, a xa binyɛ kilo solofere. A xa makantase xungbe nu na mixi nde yi ra naxan nu tixi a ya ra.

sentences.english: He took up his position and in a loud voice said to the armies of Israel, Why have you come out to make war? Am I not a Philistine and you servants of Saul? Send out a man for yourselves and let him come down to me.
sentences.susu: Goliyati naxa ti Isirayila xa sɔɔrie ya ra, a a fala e bɛ a xui itexi ra, «Munfe ra wo tixi gere ki ma? Filisitaka nan n na, Sɔlu xa konyie nan wo tan na. Wo mixi keren sugandi wo ya ma, a xa fa, muxu firin xa gere.

sentences.english: If he is able to have a fight with me and overcome me, then we will be your servants: but if I am able to overcome him, then you will be our servants and do work for us.
sentences.susu: Xa a nɔ n na, muxu findi wo xa konyie ra, muxu xa wali wo bɛ. Kɔnɔ xa n tan nɔ a ra, wo fan findi muxu xa konyie ra, wo xa wali muxu bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Philistine said, I have put to shame the armies of Israel this day; give me a man so that we may have a fight together.
sentences.susu: Na Filisitaka naxa a fala, «To n bara yi gere mɔɔli ti wo bɛ. Wo mixi keren sugandi, muxu xa fa gere.»

sentences.english: And Saul and all Israel, hearing those words of the Philistine, were troubled and full of fear.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu nun Isirayila xa sɔɔrie to na masenyi mɛ, e naxa gaaxu ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Now David was the son of that Ephrathite of Beth-lehem-judah named Jesse, who had eight sons; and he was an old man in Saul's day, and far on in years.
sentences.susu: Dawuda baba findixi Yisayi Efiramika nan na, naxan nu na Bɛtɛlɛɛmu Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi ma. Di xɛmɛ solomasaxan nan nu na a yi ra. Sɔlu xa waxati, a nu bara fori.

sentences.english: And the three oldest sons of Jesse had gone with Saul to the fight: the names of the three who went to the fight were Eliab, the oldest, and Abinadab the second, and Shammah the third.
sentences.susu: Yisayi xa di saxan singee nu biraxi Sɔlu fɔxɔ ra gere kui. E xilie nan ya: di singe Eliyabi, di firin nde Abinadabo, di saxan nde Sanma.

sentences.english: And David was the youngest: and the three oldest were with Saul's army.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nan nu na e birin xanbiratoe ra. Na nan a ra, Dawuda taara saxanyie to siga Sɔlu yire gere xa fe ra,

sentences.english: Now David went to and from Saul, looking after his father's sheep at Beth-lehem.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nu luma siga ra Sɔlu yire, a man nu fa gbilen a baba Yisayi xɔnyi xurusee dɛmadonfe ra Bɛtɛlɛɛmu.

sentences.english: And the Philistine came near every morning and evening for forty days.
sentences.susu: Xi tongo naani bun ma, na Filisitaka nu minima nɛ Isirayilakae ya i gɛɛsɛgɛ nun nunmare.

sentences.english: And Jesse said to his son David, Take now for your brothers an ephah of this dry grain and these ten cakes of bread, and go quickly with them to the tents to your brothers;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yisayi naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, «Yi donse magilinxi nun yi taami fu xanin mafuren i taarae xɔn ma, e yonkinma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And take these ten cheeses to the captain of their thousand, and see how your brothers are and come back with a sign to say how they are.
sentences.susu: I xa yi xiɲɛ xuti fu fan xanin e xa yarerati xɔn ma. I taarae xun mato a ra, i xa fa n kunfa ba.

sentences.english: Now Saul, and they, and all the men of Israel were in the valley of Elah, fighting with the Philistines.
sentences.susu: E na Sɔlu nun Isirayila xa sɔɔri birin fɔxɔ ra Terebinti gulunba kui, Filisitakae gerefe ra.»

sentences.english: And David got up early in the morning, and, giving the sheep into the care of a keeper, took the things and went as Jesse had said; and he came to the lines where the carts were, when the army was going out to the fight giving their war-cry.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa kurun subaxɛ ma. A to xurusee taxu mixi nde ra, a naxa a xa kote tongo, a siga a baba xa yaamari ra. A to so Isirayila yonkinde, a a li nɛ sɔɔrie nu na minife gere xili ma e xui itexi ra.

sentences.english: And Israel and the Philistines had put their forces in position, army against army.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae nun Filisitakae nu tixi gere ki ma e boore ya i.

sentences.english: And David gave his parcels into the hands of the keeper of the army stores, and went running to the army and came to his brothers to get knowledge about them.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a xa kote lu kote kantɛ yi ra, a fa a gi a siga sɔɔrie yire. A fɛfɛ so, a naxa a taarae xɛɛbu.

sentences.english: And while he was talking to them, the fighter, the Philistine of Gath, Goliath by name, came out from the Philistines' lines and said the same words, in David's hearing.
sentences.susu: E nu wɔyɛnfe tɛmui naxɛ, Filisitakae xa sɛnbɛma naxa mini. Gadika nan nu a ra, naxan nu xili Goliyati. A naxa a xa masenyi kerenyi ti Dawuda ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And all the men of Israel, when they saw him, went in flight, overcome with fear.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae to na sɛnbɛma to, e naxa e magbilen e xanbi xanbi ma gaaxui bɛ.

sentences.english: And the men of Israel said, Have you seen this man? Clearly he has come out to put shame on Israel: and it is certain that if any man overcomes him, the king will give that man great wealth, and will give him his daughter, and make his father's family free in Israel.
sentences.susu: E nu a fala e boore bɛ, «Wo bara a to mini ra? A faxi Isirayila nan tun maberede. Xa Isirayilaka nde sa nɔ yi faxade, Sɔlu naafuli gbegbe nan fima na kanyi ma, a a xa di ginɛ fan fi a ma, a man duuti fe bama nɛ a xa denbaya xun ma Isirayila bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And David said to the men near him, What will be done to the man who overcomes this Philistine and takes away the shame from Israel? for who is this Philistine, a man without circumcision, that he has put shame on the armies of the living God?
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa mixi ndee maxɔrin a fɛ ma, «Naxan na yi Filisitaka faxa a fa yaagi ba Isirayila ma, munse rabama na kanyi bɛ? Pe, nde na yi Filisitaka gaantare ra, naxan na Ala Kisi Kanyi xa sɔɔrie maberefe?»

sentences.english: And the people gave him this answer, So it will be done to the man who overcomes him.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa a yaabi, e fe fala a bɛ naxan nabama mixi bɛ naxan na Filisitaka faxama.

sentences.english: And Eliab, his oldest brother, hearing what David said to the men, was moved to wrath against David, and said, Why have you come here? Into whose care have you given that little flock of sheep in the waste land? I have knowledge of your pride and the evil of your heart, you have come down to see the fight.
sentences.susu: Dawuda taara Eliyabi to na wɔyɛnyi mɛ, a naxa xɔnɔ a xunya ma. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «Munse i rafaxi be? I xurusee luxi nde yi ra gbengberenyi ma? N i kolon a fanyi ra. Yɛtɛ igboe nan i ra, i tan fuyante. I faxi sunbude gere nan na?»

sentences.english: And David said, What have I done now? was it not only a word?
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala, «N munse rabaxi? N mu maxɔrinyi xa tun tixi?»

sentences.english: And turning away from him to one of the other men, he said the same words: and the people gave him the same answer.
sentences.susu: Na kui a naxa a kobe so a taara ra, a man naxa mixi gbɛtɛ maxɔrin na fe ma. E fan naxa na yaabi kerenyi fala a bɛ.

sentences.english: And, hearing what David said, they gave Saul word of it: and he sent for him.
sentences.susu: Na mixie to Dawuda xa masenyi fala Sɔlu bɛ, Sɔlu naxa a xili.

sentences.english: And David said to Saul, Let no man's heart become feeble because of him; I, your servant, will go out and have a fight with this Philistine.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Sɔlu bɛ, «Mixi yo naxa gaaxu yi Filisitaka ya ra. N tan yati, i xa konyi, n a gerema nɛ.»

sentences.english: And Saul said to David, You are not able to go out against this Philistine and have a fight with him: for you are only a boy, and he has been a man of war from his earliest days.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a yaabi, «I mu nɔma yi Filisitaka gerede. Dimɛdi nan i ra. A tan bara mɔ gere fe kui kabi a fonike tɛmui.»

sentences.english: And David said to Saul, Your servant has been keeper of his father's sheep; and if a lion or a bear came and took a lamb from the flock,
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Sɔlu bɛ, «N tan i xa konyi, n tan nan n baba xa xurusee dɛmadonma ra. Wula sube alɔ yɛtɛ na fa n ma xuruse nde suxude,

sentences.english: I went out after him, and overcame him, and took it out of his mouth: and if, turning on me, he came at me, I took him by the hair and overcame him and put him to death.
sentences.susu: n a kerima nɛ, n a bɔnbɔ han n na xuruse ba a dɛ i. Xa a a ya rafindi n ma, n a suxuma a kɔn xabe nan ma, n a faxa.

sentences.english: Your servant has overcome lion and bear: and the fate of this Philistine, who is without circumcision, will be like theirs, seeing that he has put shame on the armies of the living God.
sentences.susu: I xa konyi to fata yɛtɛ nun wulai sube bɔnbɔde na ki, n na mɔɔli fan nabama nɛ yi Filisitaka sunnatare ra, barima a Ala Kisi Kanyi xa sɔɔrie maberema.»

sentences.english: And David said, The Lord, who kept me safe from the grip of the lion and the bear, will be my saviour from the hands of this Philistine. And Saul said to David, Go! and may the Lord be with you.
sentences.susu: Dawuda man naxa a fala, «Alatala naxan n natanga yɛtɛ nun wulai sube ma, a fama n natangade yi Filisitaka fan ma.» Na kui, Sɔlu naxa a yaabi, «Siga, Alatala xa lu i sɛɛti ma.»

sentences.english: Then Saul gave David his clothing of war, and put a head-dress of brass on his head and had him clothed with a coat of metal.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a xa makanta see ragoro Dawuda ma, a xa sɔɔri xunyi makantase wure gbeeli daaxi, a nun a kanke makantase.

sentences.english: And David took Saul's sword and put the band round him over the metal coat, and was unable to go forward; for he was not used to them. Then David said to Saul, It is not possible for me to go out with these, for I am not used to them. So David took them off.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Sɔlu xa santidɛgɛma ragoro a tɛɛ kui, naxan nu xirixi a tagi, kɔnɔ a fɛfɛ ɲɛrɛ fɔlɔ a mu nɔ, barima a mu darixi na mɔɔli ra. Na kui a naxa a fala Sɔlu bɛ, «N mu nɔma sigade yi kanta see ra n ma, barima n mu darixi a ra.» Dawuda naxa na kanta see birin ba a ma.

sentences.english: Then he took his stick in his hand, and got five smooth stones from the bed of the stream and put them in a bag such as is used by sheep-keepers; and in his hand was a leather band used for sending stones: and so he went in the direction of the Philistine.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa yisuxuwuri tongo, a gɛmɛ manɔxunxi suuli fen fole kui, a e sa a xa gbɔnfɔɛ kui. A naxa siga na Filisitaka xili ma, a xa laati suxuxi a yi ra.

sentences.english: And the Philistine came nearer to David; and the man who had his body-cover went before him.
sentences.susu: Filisitaka naxa a makɔrɛ Dawuda ra, a xa kanke makantase xungbe xaninma tixi a ya ra.

sentences.english: And when the Philistine, taking note, saw David, he had a poor opinion of him: for he was only a boy, red-haired and good-looking.
sentences.susu: A to Dawuda to, a fonike tofanyi na a ra, a naxa yo a ma.

sentences.english: And the Philistine said to David, Am I a dog, that you come out to me with sticks? And the Philistine put curses on David by all his gods.
sentences.susu: Filisitaka naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, «Pe, bare nan n na, i to fama n gerede wuri ra?» A naxa Dawuda danka a xa alae xili ra,

sentences.english: And the Philistine said to David, Come here to me, and I will give your flesh to the birds of the air and the beasts of the field.
sentences.susu: a fa a fala a bɛ, «Fa be, n i sube soma xɔnie yi ra naxee ɲɛrɛma koore ma, a nun subee naxee na wula i.»

sentences.english: Then David said to the Philistine, You come to me with a sword and a spear and a javelin: but I come to you in the name of the Lord of armies, the God of the armies of Israel on which you have put shame.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a yaabi, «I tan fafe n gerede santidɛgɛma nun tanbɛ mɔɔli firin nan na. N tan i gerema Isirayila xa sɔɔrie Marigi Alatala nan xili ra, i naxan maberema.

sentences.english: This day the Lord will give you up into my hands, and I will overcome you, and take your head off you; and I will give the bodies of the Philistine army to the birds of the air and the beasts of the earth today, so that all the earth may see that Israel has a God;
sentences.susu: To Alatala i sama nɛ n bɛlɛxɛ. N i bɔnbɔma nɛ, n i xunyi bolon, n Filisitakae binbi fima nɛ xɔnie nun sube xaaɲɛe ma. Na tɛmui, duniɲa birin a kolonma nɛ a Ala na Isirayila fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And all these people who are here today may see that the Lord does not give salvation by sword and spear: for the fight is the Lord's, and he will give you up into our hands.
sentences.susu: Yi ɲama birin fama a kolonde a Alatala mu mixi rakisima santidɛgɛma nun tanbɛ saabui ra. Mixi kisima Alatala nan saabui ra, naxan wo sama muxu bɛlɛxɛ.»

sentences.english: Now when the Philistine made a move and came near to David, David quickly went at a run in the direction of the army, meeting the Philistine face to face.
sentences.susu: Filisitaka to siga fɔlɔ Dawuda ma, Dawuda naxa a gi keren na e nun Filisitaka xa naralan.

sentences.english: And David put his hand in his bag and took out a stone and sent it from his leather band straight at the Philistine, and the stone went deep into his brow, and he went down to the earth, falling on his face.
sentences.susu: A naxa a bɛlɛxɛ ragoro a xa gbɔnfɔɛ kui, a gɛmɛ keren tongo, a woli a xa laati ra. Gɛmɛ naxa na Filisitaka gɔnɔ a tigi ma, a a xun konkota bɔɔ. A naxa bira a yatagi ma bɔxi.

sentences.english: So David overcame the Philistine with his leather band and a stone, wounding the Philistine and causing his death: but David had no sword in his hand.
sentences.susu: Dawuda sɛnbɛ gbo Filisitaka bɛ na ki nɛ, a a faxa laati nun gɛmɛ keren peti ra santidɛgɛma xanbi.

sentences.english: So running up to the Philistine and putting his foot on him, David took his sword out of its cover, and put him to death, cutting off his head with it. And when the Philistines saw that their fighter was dead, they went in flight.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a gi a siga na Filisitaka saxi dɛnnaxɛ, a Filisitaka xa santidɛgɛma ba a tɛɛ i, a a faxa a ra, a a xunyi bolon a dɛ i. Filisitakae to a to e xa sɛnbɛma bara faxa, e naxa e gi.

sentences.english: And the men of Israel and of Judah got up, and gave a cry, and went after the Philistines as far as Gath and the town doors of Ekron. And the wounded of the Philistines were falling down by the road from Shaaraim all the way to Gath and Ekron.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae nun Yudakae naxa e xui ramini, e fa Filisitakae keri gulunba fɔlɛ, han Ekiron taa naadɛ ra. Filisitaka binbie nu saxi kira xɔn kelife Saarayimi han Gati nun Ekiron.

sentences.english: Then the children of Israel came back from going after the Philistines, and took their goods from the tents.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae to gɛ Filisitakae keride kira xɔn ma, e naxa gbilen nee yonkinde, e e xa see xanin.

sentences.english: And David took the head of the Philistine to Jerusalem, but the metal war-dress and the arms he put in his tent.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa na Filisitaka xunyi xanin Darisalamu, a a xa geresose ragata a yɛtɛ xa kiri banxi kui.

sentences.english: And when Saul saw David going out against the Philistine, he said to Abner, the captain of the army, Abner, whose son is this young man? And Abner said, On your life, O king, I have no idea.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu to Dawuda to sigafe ra na Filisitaka gerede, a naxa a xa sɔɔri mangɛ Abeneri maxɔrin, «Nde xa di na yi sɛgɛtala ra?» Abeneri naxa a yaabi, «Mangɛ, n mu na kolon feo.»

sentences.english: And the king said, Make search and see whose son this young man is.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a yamari, «I xa a kolon naxan xa di na yi sɛgɛtala ra.»

sentences.english: And when David was coming back after the destruction of the Philistine, Abner took him to Saul, with the head of the Philistine in his hand.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to gbilen kelife na Filisitaka faxade, Abeneri naxa a xanin Sɔlu yire. Filisitaka xunyi nu suxuxi Dawuda bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And Saul said to him, Young man, whose son are you? And David in answer said, I am the son of your servant Jesse of Beth-lehem.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a fala a bɛ, «N ma di, nde na i baba ra?» Dawuda naxa a yaabi, «I xa konyi Yisayi Bɛtɛlɛɛmuka xa di nan n na.»

sentences.english: Now after David's talk with Saul was ended, the soul of Jonathan was joined with the soul of David, and David became as dear to him as his very life.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun Sɔlu to gɛ dɛ masarade, Yonatan naxa findi Dawuda xanuntenyi ra. Yonatan nu a xanuxi alɔ a yɛtɛ yati.

sentences.english: And that day Saul took David and would not let him go back to his father's house.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Sɔlu naxa kankan Dawuda ma, a mu tin a xa gbilen a baba xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Then Jonathan and David made an agreement together, because of Jonathan's love for David.
sentences.susu: Yonatan nun Dawuda naxa saata, barima Dawuda nu rafan a ma alɔ a yɛtɛ yati.

sentences.english: And Jonathan took off the robe he had on and gave it to David, with all his military dress, even to his sword and his bow and the band round his body.
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa a xa donma xungbe ba a ma, a a ragoro Dawuda ma, a nun a xa santidɛgɛma, a xa xali, nun a xa bɛlɛti.

sentences.english: And David went wherever Saul sent him, and did wisely: and Saul put him at the head of his men of war, and this was pleasing to all the people as well as to Saul's servants.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu Dawuda rasanba dɛdɛ gere sode, Dawuda nu geenima nɛ. Na nan a to Sɔlu naxa a findi a xa sɔɔrie xunyi ra. Na fe naxa rafan ɲama ma, a nun Sɔlu xa mixie yati.

sentences.english: Now on their way, when David came back after the destruction of the Philistine, the women came out of all the towns of Israel, with songs and dances, meeting David with melody and joy and instruments of music.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔrie nu gbilenma tɛmui naxɛ kelife gere sode, Dawuda Goliyati faxa gere naxan kui, Isirayila ginɛe naxa mini Sɔlu ralande. E nu sigi sama maxase mɔɔli ndee ra, e nu fare boronma, e nu e xui itema sɛɛwɛ kui.

sentences.english: And the women, answering one another in their song, said, Saul has put to death his thousands and David his tens of thousands.
sentences.susu: Na sigie kui ginɛe nu a falama, «Sɔlu bara mixi wulu wulu bɔnbɔ, kɔnɔ Dawuda tan mixi wulu wulu dɔxɔ fu nan bɔnbɔxi.»

sentences.english: And Saul was very angry and this saying was unpleasing to him; and he said, They have given David credit for tens of thousands, and to me for only thousands: what more is there for him but the kingdom?
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa xɔnɔ ki fanyi ra na sigi xa fe ra. A naxa a fala, «E naxɛ Dawuda bara wulu fu bɔnbɔ, n tan bara wulu keren bɔnbɔ. A gbe mu luxi a xa n ma mangɛya sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: And from that day Saul was looking with envy on David.
sentences.susu: Kelife na lɔxɔɛ ma, Sɔlu bɔɲɛ naxa raɲaaxu a ma Dawuda xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Now on the day after, an evil spirit from God came on Saul with great force and he was acting like a prophet among the men of his house, while David was making music for him, as he did day by day: and Saul had his spear in his hand.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Ala naxa a niya ɲinnɛ xa bira Sɔlu fɔxɔ ra, a masenyi ti alɔ namiɲɔnmɛ. A xa tanbɛ nu suxuxi a yi ra. Dawuda nu na kɔra raberefe a bɛ, alɔ a darixi a ra ki naxɛ tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: And Saul, balancing the spear in his hand, said, I will give David a blow, pinning him to the wall. And David got away from him twice.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a xa tanbɛ ite, a fa a fala, «N Dawuda mabanbanma nɛ banxi kanke.» A naxa kata sanya firin, kɔnɔ Dawuda naxa keli tanbɛ ya i.

sentences.english: And Saul went in fear of David, because the Lord was with David and had gone away from Saul.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu mu nu suusaxi Dawuda ra sɔnɔn, barima Alatala nu na Dawuda fɔxɔ ra, a gbilen Sɔlu tan fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: So Saul sent him away, and made him a captain over a thousand; and he went about his business before the people.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa Dawuda findi sɔɔri wulu keren mangɛ ra, alako a xa a makuya a ra. Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie nu luma siga ra gere sode, Dawuda nu fa gbilen

sentences.english: And in all his undertakings David did wisely; and the Lord was with him.
sentences.susu: xunnakeli kui, barima Alatala nu na a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And when Saul saw how wisely he did, he was in fear of him.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu to a to fe birin sɔɔnɛyaxi Dawuda bɛ, a naxa lu gaaxui kui a ya ra.

sentences.english: But David was loved by all Israel and Judah, for he went out and came in before them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Dawuda nu rafan Isirayila nun Yuda bɔnsɔɛ ma, barima a nu tima e ya ra na gere birin kui.

sentences.english: And Saul said to David, Here is my oldest daughter Merab, whom I will give you for your wife: only be strong for me, fighting in the Lord's wars. For Saul said, Let it not be through me that his fate comes to him, but through the Philistines.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Sɔlu naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, «N ma di ginɛ singe nan ya, a xili Merabi. N bara a fi i ma. I xa sɔɔri wali tun naba n bɛ Alatala xa geree kui.» Sɔlu nu a falama a bɔɲɛ kui, «Hali n mu a faxa n yɛtɛ ra, n xa a lu Filisitakae xa na raba n bɛ.»

sentences.english: And David said to Saul, Who am I, and what is my father's family in Israel, that I am to be son-in-law to the king?
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Sɔlu yaabi, «Nde na n tan na? N baba xabilɛ xurun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, n tan xa findi mangɛ bitanyi ra?»

sentences.english: But when the time came to give Merab, Saul's daughter, to David, she was given to Adriel of Meholath.
sentences.susu: Waxati to a li a nu lanma Sɔlu xa di ginɛ Merabi xa fi Dawuda ma, Sɔlu naxa a fi Mexolaka Adiriyeli ma.

sentences.english: And Saul's daughter Michal was in love with David: and Saul had word of it and was pleased.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa di ginɛ Mikali nu Dawuda xanuxi. E to na fala Sɔlu bɛ, na naxa rafan a ma.

sentences.english: And Saul said, I will give her to him, so that she may be a cause of danger to him, and so that the hands of the Philistines may be against him. So Saul said to David, Today you are to become my son-in-law for the second time.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu nu a falama a yɛtɛ ma, «N xa a fi a ma, alako a xa findi gantanyi ra a bɛ, Filisitakae xa a faxa.» Na kui Sɔlu man naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, «To i xa findi n bitanyi ra.»

sentences.english: And Saul gave his servants orders saying, Have talk with David secretly and say to him, See how the king has delight in you, and how you are loved by all his servants: then be the king's son-in-law.
