sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa yaamari fi a xa mixie ma, «Wo a fala Dawuda bɛ gundo ra, ‹I bara rafan mangɛ nun a xa mixi birin ma. I xa tin findide mangɛ bitanyi ra.›»

sentences.english: And Saul's servants said these things to David. And David said, Does it seem to you a small thing to be the king's son-in-law, seeing that I am a poor man, of no great name?
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa mixie to na fala Dawuda bɛ, a naxa e yaabi, «Wo tan bɛ, fe xuri nan a ra findife mangɛ bitanyi ra? Setare na n tan na, naxan tide mu gbo feo.»

sentences.english: And the servants of Saul gave him an account of what David had said.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa walikɛe naxa na dɛntɛgɛ sa Sɔlu bɛ.

sentences.english: And Saul said, Then say to David, The king has no desire for any bride-price, but only for the private parts of a hundred Philistines so that the king may get the better of his haters. But it was in Saul's mind that David might come to his end by the hands of the Philistines.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa e yamari, «Wo a fala Dawuda bɛ, ‹Mangɛ mu wama sese xɔn kote ra fo i xa Filisitaka xɛmɛ kɛmɛ soli xaba, i fa e ra be, alako a xa a gbe ɲɔxɔ a yaxuie ma.›» Na kui Sɔlu nu wama Filisitaka xa Dawuda faxa.

sentences.english: And when his servants said these words to David, he was well pleased to be the son-in-law of the king. And the days were still not past.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa walikɛe to a xa masenyi ti Dawuda bɛ, na fe naxa a kɛnɛn, a naxa a maɲɔxun na nɔma a niyade a xa findi mangɛ bitanyi ra. Beenun lɔxɔɛ dɔnxɔɛ xa a li,

sentences.english: So David and his men got up and went, and put to death two hundred of the Philistines; and David took their private parts and gave the full number of them to the king, so that he might be the king's son-in-law. And Saul gave him his daughter Michal for his wife.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa sa Filisitaka xɛmɛ kɛmɛ firin faxa. Dawuda naxa e soli xaba, a fa na xasabi kamalixi ra mangɛ xɔn ma, alako a xa findi mangɛ bitanyi ra. Na tɛmui Sɔlu naxa a xa di ginɛ Mikali fi Dawuda ma, a xa findi a xa ginɛ ra.

sentences.english: And it was clear to Saul that the Lord was with David; and he was loved by all Israel.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu nu bara a kolon Alatala na Dawuda fɔxɔ ra. Sɔlu xa di ginɛ Mikali nu Dawuda xanuxi.

sentences.english: And Saul's fear of David became all the greater, and he went on hating him, day by day.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu nu gaaxuxi Dawuda ya ra, a a findi a yaxui ra abadan.

sentences.english: Then the rulers of the Philistines went out to war: and whenever they went out, David did more wisely than all the other servants of Saul, so that his name became greatly honoured.
sentences.susu: Filisita kuntigie nu gere tima Isirayila bɛ, kɔnɔ Dawuda nu e bɔnbɔma dangife Sɔlu xa sɔɔrie birin na. Na kui a naxa xili xungbe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Saul gave orders to his son Jonathan and to all his servants to put David to death. But Saul's son Jonathan had great delight in David.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a fala a xa di Yonatan nun a xa mixie bɛ, a e xa Dawuda faxa. Kɔnɔ Dawuda nu rafan Yonatan ma ki fanyi.

sentences.english: And Jonathan said to David, Saul, my father, is purposing your death: so now, take care in the morning, and keep yourself safe in a secret place:
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, Yonatan naxa sa na fe yaba Dawuda bɛ, «N baba wama i faxafe. I xa mɛɛni i yɛtɛ ma tina gɛɛsɛgɛ. I xa i nɔxun.

sentences.english: And I will go out and take my place by my father's side in the field near where you are; and I will get into talk with my father about you, and when I see how things are, I will give you word.
sentences.susu: Tina n nan n baba matima daaxa i i nɔxunma dɛnnaxɛ. N i xa fe falama a bɛ, n xa a natɛ kolon, alako n xa na fala i bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Jonathan gave his father Saul a good account of David, and said to him, Let not the king do wrong against his servant, against David; because he has done you no wrong, and all his acts have had a good outcome for you:
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa Dawuda xun mafala a baba Sɔlu bɛ, a falafe ra, «Mangɛ, i naxa yunubi sɔtɔ i xa konyi Dawuda xa fe ra, barima a mu fe ɲaaxi yo rabaxi i ra. A hinnɛxi nɛ i ra tun.

sentences.english: For he put his life in danger and overcame the Philistine, and the Lord gave all Israel salvation: you saw it and were glad: why then are you sinning against him who has done no wrong, desiring the death of David without cause?
sentences.susu: A mu gaaxu faxɛ ya ra, alako a xa na Filisitaka faxa. Na kui Alatala naxa Isirayila xun nakeli. I fan bara na to, i fan bara ɲɛlɛxin na xa fe ra. Munfe ra yakɔsi i wama yunubi rabafe, mixi nii bafe ra tɔɔɲɛgɛ kui? Munfe ra i wama Dawuda faxafe na ki tun?»

sentences.english: And Saul gave ear to the voice of Jonathan, and said with an oath, By the living Lord, he is not to be put to death.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a xa di Yonatan xui ramɛ a fanyi ra. A naxa a kali Alatala ra, a Dawuda mu faxama.

sentences.english: Then Jonathan sent for David and gave him word of all these things. And Jonathan took David to Saul, who kept him by his side as in the past.
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa Dawuda xili, a na birin tagi raba a bɛ. A naxa Dawuda xanin Sɔlu yire, Dawuda man naxa wali Sɔlu bɛ alɔ a darixi a ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And there was war again: and David went out fighting the Philistines, causing great destruction among them; and they went in flight before him.
sentences.susu: Gere man naxa bira Isirayila nun Filisita tagi. Dawuda naxa mini Filisitakae gerede, a naxa e bɔnbɔ a fanyi ra, e fa e gi.

sentences.english: And an evil spirit from the Lord came on Saul, when he was seated in his house with his spear in his hand; and David made music for him.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Ala naxa a niya ɲinnɛ xa bira Sɔlu fɔxɔ ra. A nu dɔxɔxi a xɔnyi, tanbɛ suxuxi a yi ra. Dawuda nu na kɔra raberefe.

sentences.english: And Saul would have sent his spear through him, pinning him to the wall, but he got away and the spear went into the wall: and that night David went in flight and got away.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a xa xali woli Dawuda ma, a xa a sɔxɔ banxi kanke. Dawuda naxa tanbɛ dɛ maba, tanbɛ naxa sɔrɔn banxi kanke. Dawuda naxa a gi, a a nɔxun na kɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then in that night Saul sent men to David's house to keep watch on him so as to put him to death in the morning: and David's wife Michal said to him, If you do not go away to a safe place tonight you will be put to death in the morning.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa mixie xɛɛ Dawuda xɔnyi, e xa a xa fe kolon, alako e xa a faxa gɛɛsɛgɛ. Kɔnɔ a xa ginɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «Xa i mu i gi, e i faxama nɛ.»

sentences.english: So Michal let David down through the window, and he went in flight and got away.
sentences.susu: A xa ginɛ naxa a ragoro wundɛri ra, a naxa a gi. A ratangaxi na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Then Michal took the image and put it in the bed, with a cushion of goat's hair at its head, and she put clothing over it.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Mikali naxa wuri masolixi sa Dawuda xa sade ma, a dugi felen a xun ma, a si kiri sa a xunsase fari.

sentences.english: And when Saul sent men to take David, she said, He is ill.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu to mixie xɛɛ Dawuda suxude, a xa ginɛ naxa a fala e bɛ, «A mu yalanxi.»

sentences.english: And Saul sent his men to see David, saying, Do not come back without him, take him in his bed, so that I may put him to death.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu man naxa e xɛɛ alako e xa Dawuda gundi to. A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo xa fa a ra a xa sade ma.»

sentences.english: And when the men came in, there was the image in the bed, with the cushion of goat's hair at its head
sentences.susu: Xɛɛrae to fa, e naxa a li wuri masolixi nan na sade ma, si kiri saxi xunsase fari.

sentences.english: And Saul said to Michal, why have you been false to me, letting my hater go and get safely away? And in answer Michal said to Saul, He said to me, Let me go, or I will put you to death.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a xa di Mikali maxɔrin, «I n yanfaxi yi ki munfe ra? I a niyaxi munfe ra n yaxui xa a gi?» Mikali naxa a yaabi, «A a fala nɛ n bɛ, xa i mu a lu n xa siga, n i faxama nɛ.»

sentences.english: So David went in flight and got away and came to Ramah, to Samuel, and gave him an account of all Saul had done to him. And he and Samuel went and were living in Naioth.
sentences.susu: Dawuda a gi na ki nɛ, a siga Samuweli yire Rama. A naxa dɛntɛgɛ sa a bɛ Sɔlu naxan nabaxi a ra. Na dangi xanbi, Dawuda nun Samuweli naxa siga, e sa lu Nayoti.

sentences.english: And word was given to Saul that David was at Naioth in Ramah.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa Sɔlu rakolon a Dawuda sa na Nayoti, Rama mabiri.

sentences.english: And Saul sent men to take David; and when they saw the band of prophets at work, with Samuel in his place at their head, the spirit of God came on Saul's men, and they became like prophets.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa mixie xɛɛ Dawuda suxude, kɔnɔ e naxa namiɲɔnmɛe to kira ra Samuweli fɔxɔ ra. Xɛɛrae to mixie to masenyi tife Ala xili ra, Ala Xaxili naxa goro e fan ma, e fan naxa so na masenyi mɔɔli tide.

sentences.english: And Saul, having news of this, sent other men, who in the same way became like prophets. And a third time Saul sent men, and they like the others became like prophets.
sentences.susu: E to na dɛntɛgɛ Sɔlu bɛ, a naxa mixi gbɛtɛe xɛɛ, kɔnɔ nee fan naxa so masenyi tife Ala xili ra. A naxa mixie xɛɛ a saxan nde, kɔnɔ nee fan naxa so masenyi tife Ala xili ra.

sentences.english: Then he himself went to Ramah, and came to the great water-spring in Secu; and questioning the people he said, Where are Samuel and David? And one said, They are at Naioth in Ramah.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi Sɔlu yɛtɛ yati naxa siga Rama. A to kɔlɔnyi li Seku taa kui, a naxa mixie maxɔrin, «Dawuda nun Samuweli na minden?» E naxa a yaabi, a e sa na Nayoti, Rama mabiri.

sentences.english: And he went on from there to Naioth in Ramah: and the spirit of God came on him, and he went on, acting like a prophet, till he came to Naioth in Ramah.
sentences.susu: A naxa Nayoti kira suxu Rama mabiri, kɔnɔ Ala Xaxili naxa goro a ma kira xɔn. A naxa masenyi ti Ala xili ra han Nayoti, Rama mabiri.

sentences.english: And he took off his clothing, acting like a prophet before Samuel, and falling down he was stretched out, without his clothing, all that day and all that night. This is the reason for the saying, Is even Saul among the prophets?
sentences.susu: A fan naxa donma rate a ma, a fa masenyi ti Ala xili ra Samuweli ya xɔri. A naxa a felen bɔxi ma donma mu a ma. A naxa lu na ki na yanyi nun na kɔɛ birin. Yi taali minixi na fe nan kui, «Sɔlu fan bara findi namiɲɔnmɛe ra ba?»

sentences.english: And David went in flight from Naioth in Ramah and came to Jonathan and said, What have I done? What is my crime and my sin against your father that he is attempting to take my life?
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa keli namiɲɔnmɛe yire Rama taa kui, a siga Yonatan tode, a sa a maxɔrin, «N munse rabaxi n xa haakɛ sɔtɔ i baba ra? N munse niyaxi a ra, a wama n faxafe naxan ma?»

sentences.english: And he said to him, Far be the thought: you will not be put to death: see, my father does nothing, great or small, without giving me word of it: would he keep this secret from me? It is not so.
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa a yaabi, «Ade, n baba mu i faxama. A mu sese rabama a mu a fala n bɛ, a findi fe xuri ra, a findi fe xungbe ra. N baba mu fefe nɔxunma n ma. A mu fefe rabama a mu a fala n bɛ.»

sentences.english: But David took his oath again and said, Your father sees that I am dear to you; so he says to himself, Let Jonathan have no idea of this, for it will be a grief to him; but as the Lord is living, and as your soul is living, there is only a step between me and death.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala a bɛ, «I baba a kolon, a n nafan i ma. A naxɛ, ‹N mu yi falama Yonatan bɛ, xa na mu a tɔɔrɔma nɛ.› Kɔnɔ n bara n kali Ala ra, san tongo keren mu na n tan nun faxɛ tagi.»

sentences.english: Then Jonathan said to David, Whatever your desire is, I will do it for you.
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, «I nu wa naxan yo xɔn, n na nan nabama.»

sentences.english: And David said to Jonathan, Tomorrow is the new moon, and I will not be seated with the king at his table: but let me go to a safe place in the country till the evening.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a yaabi, «Kike Nɛɛnɛ Sali sɛrɛxɛ nan tina. A lanma nɛ n nun mangɛ xa muxu dɛge yire keren. A lu n xa siga, n xa n nɔxun daaxa, han a xi saxan nde lɔxɔɛ nunmare.

sentences.english: And if your father takes note of the fact that I am away, say, David made a request to me for himself that he might go to Beth-lehem, to his town: for it is the time when his family make their offering year by year.
sentences.susu: Xa a n ma fe maxɔrin, a fala a bɛ, ‹Dawuda n maxandi nɛ, a n xa diɲɛ a ma, a xa siga a xɔnyi Bɛtɛlɛɛmu, a xa lan a xabilɛ ma naxan sɛrɛxɛ bama naa ɲɛ yo ɲɛ.›

sentences.english: If he says, It is well, your servant will be at peace: but if he is angry, then it will be clear to you that he has an evil purpose in mind against me.
sentences.susu: Xa a i yaabi, ‹Na fan,› awa, bɔɲɛsa na n bɛ, i xa konyi. Kɔnɔ xa a xɔnɔ na fe ma, i bara a kolon natɛ na a yi, a wama n tɔɔrɔfe ma.

sentences.english: So, then, be kind to your servant; for you have been united with your servant in an agreement made before the Lord: but if there is any wrongdoing in me, put me to death yourself; why take me to your father?
sentences.susu: I xa n xun mafala na ki nɛ, barima won bara saatɛ xiri Alatala ya i. Xa i haakɛ nan n ma, i yɛtɛ xa n faxa, hali i mu n xanin i baba yire.»

sentences.english: And Jonathan said, Do not have such a thought: for if I saw that my father was designing evil against you, would I not give you word of it?
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa a kali Dawuda bɛ, «Xa n a kolon n baba wama i faxafe, n na falama nɛ i bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then David said to Jonathan, Who will give me word if your father gives you a rough answer?
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Yonatan bɛ, «Xa i baba fa i yaabi a xɔnɛ ra, nde n nakolonma?»

sentences.english: And Jonathan said to David, Come, let us go out into the country. And the two of them went out together into the open country.
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa a yaabi, «Won xa siga burunyi.» E to mɛnni li,

sentences.english: And Jonathan said to David, May the Lord, the God of Israel, be witness; when I have had a chance of talking to my father, about this time tomorrow, if his feelings to David are good, will I not send and give you the news?
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, «N bara n kali Isirayila Marigi Alatala ra, tina xa na mu tina bora yi waxati, n nan n baba maxɔrinma n xa a kolon naxan na a bɔɲɛ ma i xa fe ra. Xa fe fanyi na a ra, n i rakolonma.

sentences.english: May the Lord's punishment be on Jonathan, if it is my father's pleasure to do you evil and I do not give you word of it and send you away so that you may go in peace: and may the Lord be with you, as he has been with my father.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa a sa li a wama i tɔɔrɔfe nɛ, n mu fa na fala i bɛ, Alatala xa n yɛtɛ tɔɔrɔ, a xa nde sa a xun ma. Na tɛmui, n a luma nɛ i xa siga bɔɲɛsa kui, Alatala xa lu i fɔxɔ ra, alɔ a nu na n baba fɔxɔ ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And may you, while I am still living, O may you be kind to me, as the Lord is kind, and keep me from death!
sentences.susu: I xa hinnɛ n na Alatala xa hinnɛ ra n ma duniɲɛigiri birin kui. N faxa xanbi,

sentences.english: And let not your mercy ever be cut off from my family, even when the Lord has sent destruction on all David's haters, cutting them off from the face of the earth.
sentences.susu: i naxa ba hinnɛfe n ma denbaya ra, hali Alatala i yaxui birin ba nɛ yi duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari.»

sentences.english: And if it comes about that the name of Jonathan is cut off from the family of David, the Lord will make David responsible.
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa saatɛ tongo Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ bɛ, a fa a fala, «Alatala xa Dawuda gbe ɲɔxɔ a yaxuie ma.»

sentences.english: And Jonathan again took an oath to David, because of his love for him: for David was as dear to him as his very soul.
sentences.susu: Yonatan man naxa Dawuda rakali a xa xanunteya xa fe ra, barima Yonatan Dawuda xanu nɛ alɔ a a yɛtɛ xanu ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then Jonathan said to him, Tomorrow is the new moon: and it will be seen that you are not present, for there will be no one in your seat.
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa a fala a bɛ, «Tina nan na Kike Nɛɛnɛ Sali ra. E na a to i mu na, e fama nɛ i xa fe maxɔrinde.

sentences.english: And on the third day it will be specially noted, and you will go to the place where you took cover when the other business was in hand, waiting by the hill over there.
sentences.susu: A xi saxan nde, i xa siga i sa i nɔxun dɛnnaxɛ Eseli gɛmɛ xanbi ra, yi fe to fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: And on the third day I will send arrows from my bow against its side as if at a mark.
sentences.susu: N xali saxan nan wolima i mabiri ra, alɔ n wama se nde nan bunfe.

sentences.english: And I will send my boy to have a look for the arrow. And if I say to him, See, the arrow is on this side of you; take it up! then you may come; for there is peace for you and no evil, by the living Lord.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, n didi xɛɛma nɛ xalie fende. Xa n a fala a bɛ, ‹Xalie na i sɛɛti ma,› na findima tɔnxuma nan na i bɛ a i naxa gaaxu, barima hɛri nan tun na i bɛ. Ala tantu.

sentences.english: But if I say to the boy, See, the arrow has gone past you: then go on your way, for the Lord has sent you away.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ, xa n sa a fala didi bɛ, ‹Xalie na i ya ra pon,› na findima tɔnxuma nan na i bɛ i xa i gi, barima Ala nan a niyaxi i xa siga.

sentences.english: As for what you and I were talking of, the Lord is between you and me for ever.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan na won ma saatɛ seede ra.»

sentences.english: So David went to a secret place in the country: and when the new moon came, the king took his place at the feast.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a nɔxun fɔtɔnyi kui. Kike Nɛɛnɛ Sali to a li, mangɛ Sɔlu naxa a magoro teebili ra, a xa a dɛge.

sentences.english: And the king took his seat, as at other times, by the wall: and Jonathan was in front, and Abner was seated by Saul's side, but there was no one in David's seat.
sentences.susu: A naxa dɔxɔ banxi bili kanke, alɔ a darixi a ra ki naxɛ. Yonatan naxa dɔxɔ a ya ra, Abeneri naxa dɔxɔ a fɛ ma. Kɔnɔ Dawuda tan mu nu na a dɔxɔde.

sentences.english: But Saul said nothing that day, for his thought was, Something has taken place making him unclean; it is clear that he is not clean.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Sɔlu mu sese fala Dawuda xa fe ra, barima a ɲɔxɔ a ma a mu faxi a xa sɛniyɛntareɲa xa fe nan ma.

sentences.english: And on the day after the new moon, that is, the second day, there was still no one in David's seat: and Saul said to his son Jonathan, Why has the son of Jesse not come to the feast yesterday or today?
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Kike Nɛɛnɛ Sali xi firin nde, Sɔlu to a to Dawuda mu fa, a naxa Yonatan maxɔrin, «N ma di, munfe ra Yisayi xa di mu faxi a dɛgede xoro, a mu fa to?»

sentences.english: And answering Saul, Jonathan said, He made a request to me that he might go to Beth-lehem,
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa Sɔlu yaabi, «Dawuda n mayandi nɛ, n xa diɲɛ a ma, a xa siga Bɛtɛlɛɛmu.

sentences.english: Saying, Our family is making an offering in the town, and my brothers have given me orders to be there: so now, if I have grace in your eyes, let me go away and see my brothers. This is why he has not come to the king's table.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala n bɛ, ‹Yandi, a lu, n xa siga lande n xabilɛ xa sɛrɛxɛ ma. N taara bara n xili. I xa tin n xa siga n ngaxakerenyie yire.› Na nan a ra, Dawuda mu na be to mangɛ xa teebili ra.»

sentences.english: Then Saul was moved to wrath against Jonathan, and he said to him, You son of an evil and uncontrolled woman, have I not seen how you have given your love to the son of Jesse, to your shame and the shame of your mother?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Sɔlu naxa xɔnɔ a xa di Yonatan ma, a a fala a bɛ, «Ginɛ matandila xa di nan i ra. I ɲɔxɔ a ma a n mu a kolon a i na Yisayi xa di nan bɛ? I xa yaagi nan na ki, a nun i nga!

sentences.english: For while the son of Jesse is living on the earth, your position is unsafe and your kingdom is in danger. So make him come here to me, for it is certainly right for him to be put to death.
sentences.susu: I mu a kolon a fanni Yisayi xa di na duniɲa, xaxili sa yo mu na i bɛ i xa mangɛya xa fe ra? I xa mixi nde xɛɛ a suxude. A lanma a xa faxa.»

sentences.english: And Jonathan, answering his father Saul, said to him, Why is he to be put to death? What has he done?
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa a baba Sɔlu yaabi, «Munfe ra a lanma a xa faxa? A munse rabaxi?»

sentences.english: And Saul, pointing his spear at him, made an attempt to give him a wound: from which it was clear to Jonathan that his father's purpose was to put David to death.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu to a xa tanbɛ ite a xa di xili ma, Yonatan naxa a kolon a a baba nu wama Dawuda faxafe nɛ.

sentences.english: So Jonathan got up from the table, burning with wrath, and took no part in the feast the second day of the month, being full of grief for David because his father had put shame on him.
sentences.susu: A naxa keli a xɔnɔxi ra, a mu sese don na Kike Nɛɛnɛ Sali xi firin nde. A bɔɲɛ nu raɲaaxuxi a ma Dawuda nun a yɛtɛ kan ma yaagi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Now in the morning, Jonathan went out into the fields at the time he had said to David, and he had a little boy with him.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Yonatan naxa siga daaxa yire nde, a nun Dawuda nu lanxi naxan ma. A naxa dimɛdi nde fan xanin naa.

sentences.english: And he said to the boy, Go and get the arrow I let loose from my bow. And while the boy was running, he sent an arrow past him.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a bɛ, a naxɛ, «N na xali woli, i gi, i sa fa a ra.» Dimɛdi naxa a gi fɔlɔ, Yonatan fa xali woli a ya ra pon.

sentences.english: And when the boy came to the place where the arrow was, Jonathan, crying out after the boy, said, Has it not gone past you?
sentences.susu: Dimɛdi to xali yire li, Yonatan naxa a xui ite a falafe ra, «Xali makuya mɛnni ra pon!»

sentences.english: And Jonathan went on crying out after the boy, Be quick, do not keep waiting about, go quickly. And Jonathan's boy got the arrow and came back to his master.
sentences.susu: A man naxa sɔnxɔ a ra, a naxɛ, «I xulun, i naxa ti de!» Yonatan xa dimɛdi naxa xalie matongo, a fa a ra a marigi xɔn ma.

sentences.english: But the boy had no idea what was going on; only Jonathan and David had knowledge of it.
sentences.susu: A mu nu sese kolon na fe kui, kɔnɔ Dawuda nun Yonatan tan naxa e boore fahaamu.

sentences.english: And Jonathan gave his bow and arrows to the boy, and said to him, Take these and go back to the town.
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa a xa xali nun a xa tanbɛe so dimɛdi yi ra, a a fala a bɛ, «Yi see xanin taa kui.»

sentences.english: And when the boy had gone, David came from his secret place by the hill, and falling to the earth went down on his face three times: and they gave one another a kiss, weeping together, till David's grief was the greater.
sentences.susu: Dimɛdi to siga, Dawuda naxa mini kɔɔla mabiri, a fa a yatagi rafelen bɔxi sanya saxan. E naxa filinfilin e boore ma, e fa wa, a gbengbenyi Dawuda.

sentences.english: And Jonathan said to David, Go in peace, for we two have taken an oath, in the name of the Lord, saying, The Lord will be between me and you, and between my seed and your seed for ever. Then David went away, and Jonathan went into the town.
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, «Won bara saatɛ xiri. Alatala na seede ra won tan nun won bɔnsɔɛe tagi abadan. Yakɔsi, i xa siga bɔɲɛsa kui.»

sentences.english: Then David came to Nob, to Ahimelech the priest: and Ahimelech was full of fear at meeting David, and said to him, Why are you by yourself, having no man with you?
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Dawuda naxa siga Nobo, Yonatan naxa gbilen taa kui.

sentences.english: And David said to Ahimelech the priest, The king has given me orders and has said to me, Say nothing to anyone about the business on which I am sending you and the orders I have given you: and a certain place has been fixed to which the young men are to go.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to Nobo li, a naxa siga sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Aximeleki xɔnyi. A to Dawuda to, a naxa gaaxu, a fa a maxɔrin, «I keren nan a ra? Mixi yo mu na i fɔxɔ ra?»

sentences.english: So now, if you have here five cakes of bread, give them into my hand, or whatever you have.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Aximeleki yaabi, a naxɛ, «Mangɛ nan n xɛɛxi, kɔnɔ a a fala n bɛ, a mixi yo naxa a kolon a n xɛɛxi fe naxan ma. N bara a fala n ma sɔɔrie bɛ, e xa n naralan yire nde.

sentences.english: And the priest, answering David, said, I have no common bread here but there is holy bread; if only the young men have kept themselves from women.
sentences.susu: Donse nde na na? Taami suuli so n yi ra, xa na mu donse gbɛtɛ.»

sentences.english: And David in answer said to the priest, Certainly women have been kept from us; and as has been done before when I have gone out the arms of the young men were made holy, even though it was a common journey; how much more today will their arms be made holy.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa a yaabi, «Taami yo mu na n yi ra, fo taami sɛniyɛnxi naxan baxi sɛrɛxɛ ra. I xa sɔɔrie nɔma na donde xa a sa li e nun ginɛe mu saxi yire keren yi saxanyi.»

sentences.english: So the priest gave him the holy bread: there was no other, only the holy bread which had been taken from before the Lord, so that new bread might be put in its place on the day when it was taken away.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala a bɛ, «Tɔnyi ɲan dɔxɔxi muxu ma ginɛ fe rabafe ma muxu sigama gere sode tɛmui naxɛ. N ma sɔɔrie marasɛniyɛnyi rabama e nɛ sigama dɛdɛ. Yi biyaasi tide to gbo biyaasi gbɛtɛe bɛ, e birin sɛniyɛnxi ki fanyi ra.»

sentences.english: Now a certain man of the servants of Saul was there that day, kept back before the Lord; his name was Doeg, an Edomite, the strongest of Saul's runners.
sentences.susu: Na kui sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa sɛrɛxɛ taami so a yi ra, barima taami gbɛtɛ yo mu nu na. Na sɛrɛxɛ taami nu masarama taami nɛɛnɛ ra lɔxɔɛ birin Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: And David said to Ahimelech, Have you no sword or spear with you here? for I have come without my sword and other arms, because the king's business had to be done quickly.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Sɔlu xa mixi nde nu na mɛnni sali xa fe ra. Edonka nan nu a ra, naxan xili Dowege, naxan findixi Sɔlu xa xuruse kantɛe xunyi ra.

sentences.english: And the priest said, The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you put to death in the valley of Elah, is here folded in a cloth at the back of the ephod: take that, if you will, for there is no other sword here. And David said, there is no other sword like that; give it to me.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Aximeleki bɛ, a naxɛ, «Tanbɛ yo mu na i yi ra, xa na mu santidɛgɛma? N to gbataxi mangɛ xa xɛɛraya xa fe ra, n mu faxi n ma santidɛgɛma nun n ma geresose ra.»

sentences.english: Then David got up and went in flight that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish, the king of Gath.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa a yaabi, «Goliyati Filisitaka xa santidɛgɛma na be, i naxan faxa Ela gulunba kui. A mafilinxi dugi nde kui, a saxi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa donma xanbi ra. Xa i wama a xɔn, a tongo. Gbɛtɛ mu na be.» Dawuda naxa a fala, «A so n yi ra, a maniyɛ yo mu na.»

sentences.english: And the servants of Achish said to him, Is not this David, the king of the land? did they not make songs about him in their dances, saying, Saul has put to death thousands, and David tens of thousands?
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Dawuda naxa keli, a a gi Sɔlu ya ra. A naxa siga Gati mangɛ Akisi xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And David took these words to heart, fearing Achish, the king of Gath.
sentences.susu: Akisi xa mixie naxa a fala a bɛ, «Isirayila mangɛ Dawuda xa mu yi ki, naxan xa fe falama, ‹Sɔlu bara mixi wulu wulu faxa. Dawuda tan bara mixi wulu wulu dɔxɔ fu faxa›?»

sentences.english: So changing his behaviour before them, he made it seem as if he was off his head, hammering on the doors of the town, and letting the water from his mouth go down his chin.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to na fe mɛ, a naxa gaaxu ki fanyi Gati mangɛ Akisi ya ra.

sentences.english: Then Achish said to his servants, Look! the man is clearly off his head; why have you let him come before me?
sentences.susu: Na kui a naxa a niya ɲama xa a maɲɔxun daxui ra. A naxa daxuɲa raba e tagi, a se korin naadɛ ma, a dɛye nu goro a dɛ xabe ma.

sentences.english: Are there not enough unbalanced men about me, that you have let this person come and do such tricks before me? is such a man to come into my house?
sentences.susu: Akisi naxa a fala a xa mixie bɛ, a naxɛ, «Wo mu a toxi a findixi daxui nan na yi ki. Wo faxi yi xɛmɛ ra n xɔn ma munfe ra?

sentences.english: So David went away from there and took cover in a strong place at Adullam; and his brothers and all his father's people, hearing of it, went down to him there.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa sa a nɔxun Adulama fɔnmɛ kui. A taarae nun a barenyie to na kolon, e naxa siga a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And everyone who was in trouble, and everyone who was in debt, and everyone who was bitter in soul, came together to him, and he became captain over them: about four hundred men were joined to him.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee nu na tɔɔrɛ nde kui alɔ doni kanyie, e naxa lu a fɛ ma, e a findi e xa mangɛ ra. Mixi kɛmɛ naani ɲɔndɔn nu na a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And from there David went to Mizpeh in the land of Moab: and he said to the king of Moab, Let my father and mother come and make their living-place with you till it is clear to me what God will do for me.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa keli mɛnni, a naxa siga Misipa Mowaba bɔxi ma. A naxa a fala Mowaba mangɛ bɛ, a naxɛ, «Yandi, a lu n baba nun n nga xa sabati be sinden, han n xa a kolon Alatala wama naxan xɔn n bɛ.»

sentences.english: And he took them to the king of Moab and they went on living with him while David was in his safe place.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a xa mixie xanin na mangɛ xɔnyi, e naxa lu mɛnni Dawuda fɛ ma.

sentences.english: And the prophet Gad said to David, Do not go on living in this place but go into the land of Judah. Then David went away and came to the woodland of Hereth.
sentences.susu: Annabi Gadi naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, a naxɛ, «I naxa lu yi mangɛ xɔnyi. I xa gbilen Yudaya.» Dawuda naxa keli, a so Xɛrɛti fɔtɔnyi yire.

sentences.english: And news was given to Saul that David had been seen, and the men who were with him: now Saul was in Gibeah, seated under the tree in the high place, with his spear in his hand, and all his servants were in their places before him.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu to Dawuda nun a fɔxirabirɛe xa xibaaru mɛ, a nu na Gibeya, tamare bili bun ma, geya fari. A xa tanbɛ nu suxuxi a yi ra, a xa mixie nu na a fɛ ma.

sentences.english: Then Saul said to his servants who were there about him, Give ear now, you Benjamites; will the son of Jesse give to every one of you fields and vine-gardens, will he make you all captains of hundreds and captains of thousands;
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, a naxɛ, «Wo wo tuli mati, wo tan Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛe. Yisayi xa di fama nɛ wɛni yiree nun xɛe fide wo ma? A wo findi sɔɔri wulu xunyie ra, xa na mu sɔɔri kɛmɛ xunyie ra?

sentences.english: That all of you have made designs against me, and not one of you gave me word when my son made an agreement with the son of Jesse, and not one of you has pity for me or has made my eyes open to the fact that my servant has been moved by my son against me, as at this day?
sentences.susu: Wo birin bara n yanfa. Mixi yo mu n nakolonxi n ma di nun Yisayi xa di bara saatɛ xiri. Wo mu kinikini n ma, wo mu a fala n bɛ n ma di wama n ma konyi xunyi ikelife n xili ma, alako na xa gantanyi sa n ya ra alɔ a fa na ki naxɛ yi ki to.»

sentences.english: Then Doeg, the Edomite, who was by the side of the servants of Saul, in answer said, I saw the son of Jesse coming to Nob, to Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa xuruse kantɛe xunyi, Edonka Dowege, na naxa a fala Sɔlu bɛ, «N tan Yisayi xa di to nɛ Nobo, Axituba xa di Aximeleki xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And he got directions from the Lord for him, and gave him food, and put in his hand the sword of Goliath the Philistine.
sentences.susu: Aximeleki naxa Alatala maxandi a bɛ, a donsee so a yi ra, a nun Goliyati Filisitaka xa santidɛgɛma.»

sentences.english: Then the king sent for Ahimelech the priest, the son of Ahitub, and for all the men of his father's family who were priests in Nob: and they all came to the king.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Aximeleki xilide, a nun a xa denbaya nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxee birin nu na Nobo. E to fa mangɛ yire,

sentences.english: And Saul said, Give ear now, O son of Ahitub. And answering he said, Here I am, my lord.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a fala e bɛ, a naxɛ, «Axituba xa di, i tuli mati n na.» A naxa a yaabi, «N marigi, n tuli matixi i ra.»

sentences.english: And Saul said to him, Why have you made designs against me with the son of Jesse, giving him food and a sword and getting directions from the Lord for him, and helping him to take up arms against me, and to be on the watch to make a secret attack on me as he is doing now?
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxɛ, «Munfe ra i yanfɛ maxirixi n xun ma, wo tan nun Yisayi xa di? Munfe ra i taami nun santidɛgɛma soxi a yi ra, i man fa Alatala maxandi a bɛ, alako a xa a ya rafindi n ma, a xa gantanyi te n bɛ alɔ a fa na ki naxɛ yi ki to.»

sentences.english: Then Ahimelech answering said to the king, Who among all your servants is so true to you as David, who is the king's son-in-law, and is a captain of your armed men, and has a place of honour in your house?
sentences.susu: Aximeleki naxa wɔyɛnyi tongo, a naxɛ, «Nde tinxin i bitanyi Dawuda bɛ i xa mixie ya ma? Nde xa binyɛ dangima a ra i xa banxi kui?

sentences.english: Is this the first time I have got directions from God for him? Far be the thought! let the king make no such statement against his servant or my father's family, for your servant has no knowledge, great or small, of this thing.
sentences.susu: N bara Alatala maxandi a bɛ sanya wuyaxi. Mangɛ, i naxa yi kalamui sa i xa konyi nun a xa denbaya xun ma, barima n mu sese kolon yi fe kui.»

sentences.english: And the king said, You will certainly be put to death, Ahimelech, you and all your father's family.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala, «Aximeleki, n i tan nun i xa denbaya faxama to.»

sentences.english: Then the king said to the runners who were waiting near him, Put the priests of the Lord to death; because they are on David's side, and having knowledge of his flight, did not give me word of it. But the king's servants would not put out their hands to make an attack on the Lord's priests.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala a xa sɔɔrie bɛ, naxee nu tixi a fɛ ma, a e xa Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe faxa, barima e mu a rakolon a Dawuda na gife a ma. Kɔnɔ sɔɔrie tan mu tin na rabade.

sentences.english: Then the king said to Doeg, You are to put the priests to death. And Doeg the Edomite, turning on the priests and attacking them, put to death that day eighty-five men who took up the ephod.
sentences.susu: Na kui mangɛ naxa a fala Dowege bɛ, «I tan xa yi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe faxa.» Awa Dowege Edonka naxa e faxa. Na lɔxɔɛ a mixi tongo solomasaxan nun suuli nan faxa, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ donma ragoroxi naxee ma.

sentences.english: And Nob, the town of the priests, he put to the sword, all the men and women, children and babies at the breast, and oxen and asses and sheep.
sentences.susu: A naxa e xa taa mixie fan faxa santidɛgɛma ra, xɛmɛe yo, ginɛe yo, dimɛe yo, diyɔrɛe yo. Hali ningee ba, sofalee ba, yɛxɛɛe ba, e naxa e birin faxa santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: And Abiathar, one of the sons of Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub, got away and went in flight after David;
sentences.susu: Aximeleki xa di xɛmɛ Abiyatari, Axituba xa mamadi, na nan keren nɔ a gide. A naxa siga alako a xa bira Dawuda fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And gave him the news of how Saul had put to death the Lord's priests.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ a Sɔlu bara Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe faxa.

sentences.english: And David said to Abiathar, I was certain that day, when Doeg the Edomite was there, that he would take the news to Saul: I am responsible for the lives of all your father's family.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a yaabi, «Na lɔxɔɛ n nu bara a maɲɔxun a Dowege Edonka fama nɛ n ma fe falade Sɔlu bɛ. N tan nan a niyaxi i xa mixie xa faxa.

sentences.english: Keep here with me and have no fear; for he who has designs on my life has designs on yours: but with me you will be safe.
sentences.susu: Hali i mu gaaxu. Lu n sɛɛti ma, barima naxan wama n faxafe, a wama i fan faxafe. I na kantari nan kui n fɛ ma.»

sentences.english: And they sent word to David, saying, The Philistines are fighting against Keilah and taking the grain from the grain-floors.
sentences.susu: E naxa fa a fala Dawuda bɛ, a Filisitakae bara din Keyila taa ra, a e na e xa baloe muɲafe lonyie yire.

sentences.english: So David, questioning the Lord, said, Am I to go and make an attack on these Philistines? And the Lord said to David, Go and make an attack on the Philistines so that Keilah may be kept from falling into their hands.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Alatala maxɔrin, a naxɛ, «N nɔma nɛ Filisitakae ra?» Alatala naxa a yaabi, «Siga, i xa Keyila ratanga Filisitakae ma.»

sentences.english: And David's men said to him, Even here in Judah we are full of fear: how much more then if we go to Keilah against the armies of the Philistines?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Dawuda xa mixie naxa a fala a bɛ, «Hali be Yudaya bɔxi, won bara gaaxu. Won mu suusama sigade Keyila Filisitakae gerede.»

sentences.english: Then David put the question to the Lord again, and the Lord answering said, Up! go down to Keilah; for I will give the Philistines into your hands.
sentences.susu: Dawuda man naxa Alatala maxɔrin na xa fe ra. Alatala naxa a yaabi, «Keli, i xa siga Keyila, barima n bara Filisitakae sa i sagoe.»

sentences.english: So David and his men went to Keilah, and had a fight with the Philistines, and took away their cattle, and put them to the sword with great destruction. So David was the saviour of the people of Keilah.
sentences.susu: Na kui Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa siga naa Filisitakae gerede. E naxa e bɔnbɔ, e fa e xa gɔɔrɛe tongo. Dawuda Keyilakae ratanga na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Now when Abiathar, the son of Ahimelech, went in flight to David, he came down to Keilah with the ephod in his hand.
sentences.susu: Aximeleki xa di Abiyatari to siga Dawuda yire Keyila, a nu bara sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kanke raxunmase xanin naa.

sentences.english: And news was given to Saul that David had come to Keilah. And Saul said, Now God has given him into my hands; for by going into a walled town with locked doors, he has let himself be shut in.
sentences.susu: E to a fala Sɔlu bɛ, a Dawuda bara so Keyila taa kui, Sɔlu naxa a fala, «Ala bara a sa n bɛlɛxɛ, barima Dawuda bara a yɛtɛ balan Keyila taa kui naadɛ xɔrɔxɔɛe xanbi ra.»

sentences.english: And Saul sent for all the people to come to the fight, and go down to Keilah to make an attack on David and his men.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a xa sɔɔrie xili, e xa goro naa Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie rabilinde.

sentences.english: And it was clear to David that Saul had evil designs against him, and he said to Abiathar the priest, Come here with the ephod.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to Sɔlu waxɔnfe ɲaaxi kolon, a naxa a fala Abiyatari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ bɛ, a xa fa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kanke raxunmase ra.

sentences.english: Then David said, O Lord, the God of Israel, news has been given to your servant that it is Saul's purpose to come to Keilah and send destruction on the town because of me.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Alatala maxɔrin, «Isirayila Marigi Alatala, n tan i xa konyi di bara a kolon a Sɔlu wama fafe Keyila, a xa fa yi taa kana n tan nan ma fe ra.

sentences.english: And now, is it true, as they have said to me, that Saul is coming? O Lord, the God of Israel, give ear to your servant, and say if these things are so. And the Lord said, He is coming down.
sentences.susu: Keyila mangɛe n soma nɛ a yi ra? Sɔlu fama nɛ be alɔ n a mɛxi ki naxɛ? Isirayila Marigi Alatala, i xa na masen n bɛ.» Alatala naxa a yaabi, «Sɔlu fama nɛ.»

sentences.english: Then David said, Will the men of Keilah give me and my men up to Saul? and the Lord said, They will give you up.
sentences.susu: Dawuda man naxa a maxɔrin, «Keyila mangɛe n soma nɛ Sɔlu yi ra, n tan nun n ma sɔɔrie?» Alatala naxa a yaabi, «E wo sama nɛ a sagoe.»

sentences.english: Then David and his men, about six hundred of them, went out of Keilah, and got away wherever they were able to go. And Saul, hearing that David had got away from Keilah, did not go there.
sentences.susu: Na kui Dawuda nun a xa mixie naxa keli Keyila, mixi kɛmɛ senni ɲɔndɔn, e siga yire gbɛtɛ. Mixie to a fala Sɔlu bɛ, a Dawuda bara a gi Keyila, Sɔlu naxa na gere lu na.

sentences.english: And David kept in the waste land, in safe places, waiting in the hill-country in the waste land of Ziph. And Saul was searching for him every day, but God did not give him up into his hands.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa lu Sifi gbengberenyi ma geyae yire. Sɔlu nu a fenma, kɔnɔ Ala mu a sa a bɛlɛxɛ i.

sentences.english: And David was full of fear, in the knowledge that Saul had come out to take his life; and David was in the waste land of Ziph, in Horesh.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a to, Sɔlu nu na a fenfe, a xa a faxa. Dawuda nu na Xoresa, Sifi gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: And Saul's son Jonathan went to David in Horesh, and made his hands strong in God;
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Yonatan naxa siga Xoresa Dawuda ralimaniyade.

sentences.english: And said to him, Have no fear, for Saul my father will not get you into his power; and you will be king of Israel, and I will be by your side, and my father Saul is certain of this.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a bɛ, «Hali i mu gaaxu, n baba Sɔlu mu i masɔtɔma feo. I findima nɛ Isirayila mangɛ ra, n tan luma i sɛɛti ma. N baba Sɔlu na kolon.»

sentences.english: And the two of them made an agreement before the Lord: and David went on living in Horesh, and Jonathan went back to his house.
sentences.susu: Na kui e naxa saatɛ xiri Alatala ya i. Dawuda naxa lu Xoresa, Yonatan naxa gbilen a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Then the Ziphites came up to Gibeah to see Saul, and said, Is not David living secretly among us in the strong places in Horesh, in the hill of Hachilah to the south of the waste land?
sentences.susu: Sifikae naxa siga Sɔlu yire Gibeya, e sa a fala a bɛ, «Dawuda nɔxunxi gbengberenyi yirefanyi ma Xakila geyae mabiri.

sentences.english: So now, O king, have your soul's desire and come down, and we, for our part, will give him up into the king's hands.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ, xa i wama a xɔn, i xa goro naa. Muxu a sama nɛ i sagoe.»

sentences.english: And Saul said, The Lord's blessing will be yours, for you have had pity on me.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa e yaabi, «Alatala xa barakɛ sa wo xa fe, barima wo bara kinikini n ma.

sentences.english: Go now, and take more steps, and see where he is living: for they say that he is expert in deceit.
sentences.susu: Wo siga sinden, wo man xa a mato ki fanyi ra. Wo xa a kolon a na dɛnnaxɛ, wo man xa a kolon nde na a fɔxɔ ra. Mixi na a ra naxan kɔɔta ki fanyi.

sentences.english: So take care to get knowledge of all the secret places where he is taking cover, and be certain to come back to me, and I will go with you: and without doubt, if he is anywhere in the land, I will get him, among all the families of Judah.
sentences.susu: Wo na gɛ a nɔxunde kolonde, wo xa na fala n bɛ alako won birin xa siga. Xa a na Yudaya bɔxi ma, n a fenma nɛ yire birin han n a toma tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And they went back and came to Ziph before Saul: but David and his men were in the waste land of Maon, in the dry land south of the waste land.
sentences.susu: Sifikae naxa gbilen e xɔnyi Sɔlu ya ra. Dawuda nun a xa mixie nu na Mayon gbengberenyi ma kɔɔla mabiri.

sentences.english: And Saul and his men went in search of him. And David had word of it, so he came down to the rock in the waste land of Maon. And Saul, hearing of this, went after David into the waste land of Maon.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu nun a xa mixie naxa mini Dawuda fende. Dawuda to na kolon, a naxa siga fanye yire Mayon gbengberenyi ma. Sɔlu to na mɛ, a naxa bira Dawuda fɔxɔ ra mɛnni.

sentences.english: And Saul and his men went on one side of the mountain, and David and his men went on the other: and David's purpose was to get away as quickly as possible, for fear of Saul; for Saul and his men were making a circle round David and his men in order to take them.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu nu ɲɛrɛma geya sɛɛti ma, Dawuda fan nu ɲɛrɛma geya boore sɛɛti ma, gulunba nu na e tagi. Dawuda nu a gife a sɛnbɛ ra, kɔnɔ Sɔlu xa mixie nu na a raxɛtɛnfe.

sentences.english: But a man came to Saul saying, Be quick and come; for the Philistines have made an attack on the land.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui xɛɛra nde naxa fa Sɔlu yire, a a fala a bɛ, «I xa fa keren na. Filisitakae man bara din Isirayila bɔxi ra!»

sentences.english: So turning back from going after David, Saul went against the Philistines: so that place was named Sela-hammah-lekoth.
sentences.susu: Na kui Sɔlu naxa gbilen Dawuda fɔxɔ ra na Filisitakae xa fe ra. Na nan a niya, e naxa mɛnni xili sa Sela Hamalekoto. Na nan na ki «Fatan fanye.»

sentences.english: Now when Saul came back from fighting the Philistines, news was given him that David was in the waste land of En-gedi.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa siga En Gedi geya yire.

sentences.english: Then Saul took three thousand of the best men out of all Israel, and went in search of David and his men on the rocks of the mountain goats.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu to gbilen kelife Filisitakae gerede, mixie naxa a fala a bɛ, a Dawuda na En Gedi gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: And on the way he came to a place where sheep were kept, where there was a hollow in the rock; and Saul went in for a private purpose. Now David and his men were in the deepest part of the hollow.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa sɔɔri wulu saxan tongo, naxee fata gere sode dangi Isirayilakae birin na, e naxa mini Dawuda nun a xa mixie fende, han e sa so fanyee longori ra.

sentences.english: And David's men said to him, Now is the time when the Lord says to you, I will give up your hater into your hands to do with him whatever seems good to you. Then David, getting up, took the skirt of Saul's robe in his hand, cutting off the end of it without his knowledge.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa dangi gɔɔrɛe yire, naxee nu na kira dɛ ra. A naxa so fɔnmɛ kui a xa ye rafili. A mu a kolon Dawuda nun a xa mixie fan nu na na fɔnmɛ kui.

sentences.english: And later, David was full of regret for cutting off Saul's skirt.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa mixie naxa a fala a bɛ, «Alatala bara yi lɔxɔɛ fi i ma. A xa masenyi bara kamali a falafe ra, ‹N tan nan i yaxui sama i bɛlɛxɛ, alako i xa i sago raba a ra.›» Na tɛmui Dawuda naxa a maso dɔyindɔyin Sɔlu xanbi ra, a fa a xa burumusi sɛɛti xaba.

sentences.english: And David said to his men, Before the Lord, never let it be said that my hand was lifted up against my lord, the man of the Lord's selection, for the Lord's holy oil has been put on him.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to gɛ na rabade, a naxa nimisa Sɔlu xa burumusi sɛɛti xabafe ma.

sentences.english: So with these words David kept his servants back, and did not let them make an attack on Saul. And Saul got up and went on his way.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a xa mixie bɛ, «Alatala xa n natanga na fe mɔɔli ma. N bara na raba n marigi ra, Alatala naxan sugandixi mangɛ ra.»

sentences.english: And after that David came out of the hollow rock, and crying after Saul said, My lord the king. And when Saul gave a look back, David went down on his face and gave him honour.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa tɔnyi dɔxɔ a xa sɔɔrie ma Sɔlu gerefe ra. Sɔlu naxa mini fɔnmɛ kui, a siga.

sentences.english: And David said to Saul, Why do you give any attention to those who say that it is my desire to do you wrong?
sentences.susu: Dawuda fan naxa mini fɔnmɛ kui, a fa Sɔlu xili a xui itexi ra, «N ma mangɛ, n marigi!» Sɔlu to a kobe rato, Dawuda naxa a xunyi felen bɔxi ma, a suyidi a bɛ.

sentences.english: Look! you have seen today how the Lord gave you up into my hands even now in the hollow of the rocks: and some would have had me put you to death, but I had pity on you: for I said, Never will my hand be lifted up against my lord, who has been marked with the holy oil.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Sɔlu bɛ, a naxɛ, «Munfe ra i tuli matima mixie xa wɔyɛnyie ra, naxee a falama, a n tan mu wama i xa fe fanyi xɔn ma?

sentences.english: And see, my father, see the skirt of your robe in my hand: for the fact that I took off the skirt of your robe and did not put you to death is witness that I have no evil purpose, and I have done you no wrong, though you are waiting for my life to take it.
sentences.susu: To lɔxɔɛ Alatala bara i sa n sagoe fɔnmɛ kui. N ma mixie bara a fala n bɛ, a n xa i faxa, kɔnɔ n bara tondi. N bara a fala, ‹N mu n marigi gerema, Alatala naxan sugandixi mangɛ ra.›

sentences.english: May the Lord be judge between me and you, and may the Lord give me my rights against you, but my hand will never be lifted up against you.
sentences.susu: I bara a to se naxan na n bɛlɛxɛ? N bara i xa burumusi sɛɛti xaba. N nu nɔma i faxade, kɔnɔ n mu a raba. Na kui i nɔma a kolonde fe ɲaaxi yo mu na n furi kui i xa fe ra. N mu wama i matandife, n mu wama haakɛ xɔn, kɔnɔ i tan na birafe n fɔxɔ ra, i xa n faxa.»

sentences.english: There is an old saying, From the evil-doer comes evil: but my hand will never be lifted up against you.
sentences.susu: «Alatala xa won makiiti. Alatala xa n gbe ɲɔxɔ. N tan mu i faxama feo.

sentences.english: After whom has the king of Israel come out? for whom are you searching? for a dead dog, an insect.
sentences.susu: Forie a falama, ‹Ɲaaxuɲa kelima mixi ɲaaxie nan ma.› Na kui n xa a fala i bɛ, n tan mu i faxama feo.

sentences.english: So let the Lord be judge, and give a decision between me and you, and see and give support to my cause, and keep me from falling into your hands.
sentences.susu: I tan Isirayila mangɛ, i wama nde gerefe? I na birafe nde fɔxɔ ra? Mixi xurudi naxan tide mu dangi bare faxaxi ra, xa na mu a ra nimase xunxuri?

sentences.english: Now when David had said these words to Saul, Saul said, Is this your voice, David, my son? And Saul was overcome with weeping.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa won firin makiiti. A xa nɔndi fi n ma, a xa n natanga i bɛlɛxɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said to David, You are right and I am wrong: for you have given me back good, but I have given you evil.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to gɛ na masenyi tide, Sɔlu naxa a fala a bɛ, a naxɛ, «I tan nan yati xui a ra, n ma di Dawuda?» Sɔlu naxa wa fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: And you have made clear to me how good you have been to me today: because, when the Lord gave me up into your hands, you did not put me to death.
sentences.susu: A fa a fala Dawuda bɛ, a naxɛ, «I tinxin n tan bɛ, barima i bara n ma fe kobi masara fe fanyi ra.

sentences.english: If a man comes across his hater, will he let him get away safe? so may you be rewarded by the Lord for what you have done for me today.
sentences.susu: To tan i bara i xa marafanyi masen n bɛ. Alatala nu bara n sa i sagoe, i fa tondi n faxade.

sentences.english: And now I am certain that you will be king, and that the kingdom of Israel will be made strong under your authority.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi a yaxui masɔtɔ, a bɛɲinma bɔɲɛsa kui? Alatala xa i sare fi i naxan nabaxi n bɛ to lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: So give me your oath by the Lord, that you will not put an end to my seed after me or let my name be cut off from my father's family.
sentences.susu: N a kolon i fama nɛ findide mangɛ ra, Isirayila fama xande i xa mangɛya bun ma.

sentences.english: And David gave Saul his oath. And Saul went back to his house; but David and his men went up to their safe place.
sentences.susu: I xa i kali Ala xili ra, a i mu n bɔnsɔɛ sɔntɔma n faxa xanbi, i man mu n xili kanama n ma mixie tagi.»

sentences.english: And death came to Samuel; and all Israel came together, weeping for him, and put his body in its resting-place in his house at Ramah. Then David went down to the waste land of Maon.
sentences.susu: Samuweli to laaxira, Isirayila birin naxa malan a xa ɲɔnfe ma, e xa a ragata a xɔnyi Rama. Na tɛmui Dawuda naxa goro Paran gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: Now there was a man in Maon whose business was in Carmel; he was a great man and had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats: and he was cutting the wool of his sheep in Carmel.
sentences.susu: Kuntigi nde nu na Mayon, naxan ma yɛxɛ wulu saxan nun si wulu keren nu na Karemele. A nu sigaxi a xa na yɛxɛɛe xabe mabide.

sentences.english: Now this man was named Nabal, and his wife's name was Abigail: she was a woman of good sense and pleasing looks: but the man was cruel and evil in his ways; he was of the family of Caleb.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ nu xili nɛ Nabali, a xa ginɛ xili Abigayili. Ginɛ xaxilima nan nu a ra, naxan tofan ki fanyi. Kɔnɔ a xa mɔri xaxili nu xɔrɔxɔ, a nu luma fe ɲaaxi raba ra. Kalebi bɔnsɔɛ nan a ra.

sentences.english: And David had word in the waste land that Nabal was cutting the wool of his sheep.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a mɛ gbengberenyi ma a Nabali na a xa yɛxɛɛe xabe mabife.

sentences.english: And David sent ten young men, and said to them, Go up to Carmel and go to Nabal, and say kind words to him in my name;
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa mixi fu xɛɛ, a falafe ra, «Wo siga Nabali yire, wo xa a xɛɛbu n bɛ. Wo xa yi masenyi ti n xili ra, wo naxɛ,

sentences.english: And say this to my brother, May all be well for you: peace be to you and your house and all you have.
sentences.susu: ‹Ala xa fe birin sɔɔnɛya i bɛ, i tan nun i xa denbaya.

sentences.english: I have had word that you have wool-cutters: now the keepers of your sheep have been with us, and we have done them no evil, and taken nothing of theirs while they were in Carmel.
sentences.susu: Muxu a mɛxi nɛ, a i xa walikɛe na i xa yɛxɛɛe xabe xabafe. Kabi i xa xuruse kantɛe faxi Karemele, muxu nu na e fɔxɔ ra bɔɲɛsa kui. Sese mu baxi e yi ra na waxati bun ma.

sentences.english: If your young men are questioned they will say the same thing. So now, let my young men have grace in your eyes, for we are come at a good time; please give anything you may have by you to your servants and to your son David.
sentences.susu: I xa i xa mixie maxɔrin xa nɔndi na a ra. Na kui i xa hinnɛ n ma mixie ra yi xulun lɔxɔɛ. I xa muxu ki i nɔma naxan na, barima muxu findixi i xa konyie nan na, naxee birama i xa di Dawuda fɔxɔ ra.›»

sentences.english: And when David's young men came, they said all this to Nabal, in David's name, and said nothing more.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa xɛɛrae to so naa, e naxa a xa xɛɛraya iba Nabali bɛ a xili ra, e mu sese sa na fari.

sentences.english: And Nabal gave them his answer and said, Who is David? who is the son of Jesse? there are a number of servants in these days running away from their masters.
sentences.susu: Nabali naxa xɛɛrae yaabi, a naxɛ, «Nde na Dawuda ra, nde na Yisayi xa di ra? Konyi gbegbe na na to, naxee e gima e marigi ma.

sentences.english: Am I to take my bread and my wine and the meat I have got ready for my wool-cutters and give it to men coming from I have no idea where?
sentences.susu: Wo waxi nɛ n xa n ma taami nun n ma sube tongo, n naxee fenxi n ma walikɛe bɛ, n xa na so mixie yi ra n mu naxee kelide yati kolon?»

sentences.english: So David's young men, turning away, went back and gave him an account of everything he had said.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa xɛɛrae naxa gbilen. E to so, e naxa na birin dɛntɛgɛ.

sentences.english: And David said to his men, Put on your swords, every one of you. And every man put on his sword; and David did the same; and about four hundred men went up with David, and two hundred kept watch over their goods.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala a xa sɔɔrie bɛ, a naxɛ, «Wo xa wo xa santidɛgɛma xiri wo tagi.» E naxa na raba. Dawuda fan naxa a xa santidɛgɛma tongo, a a xiri a tagi. Mixi kɛmɛ naani ɲɔndɔn naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra, mixi kɛmɛ firin naxa lu kotee san na.

sentences.english: But one of the young men said to Nabal's wife Abigail, David sent men from the waste land to say kind words to our master, and he gave them a rough answer.
sentences.susu: Nabali xa walikɛ nde naxa sa na fe yaba a xa ginɛ Abigayili bɛ, a naxɛ, «Dawuda bara xɛɛrae xɛɛ won marigi ma keli gbengberenyi ma, e xa a xɛɛbu, kɔnɔ a mu e rasɛnɛxi a fanyi ra feo.

sentences.english: But these men have been very good to us; they did us no wrong and nothing of ours was touched while we were with them in the fields:
sentences.susu: Kabi muxu na burunyi, na mixie fe fanyi nan naba muxu bɛ. E mu muxu tɔɔrɔ, e mu sese ba muxu yi.

sentences.english: But day and night they were like a wall round us while we were with them, looking after the sheep.
sentences.susu: E bara muxu kanta kɔɛ nun yanyi muxu xa xuruse dɛmadonyi wali kui.

sentences.english: So now, give thought to what you are going to do; for evil is in store for our master and all his house: for he is such a good-for-nothing person that it is not possible to say anything to him.
sentences.susu: I xa a mato i nɔma naxan nabade, xa na mu a ra won marigi nun a xa denbaya fama fe ɲaaxi sɔtɔde. I xa mɔri xaxili xɔrɔxɔ, a mu mixi yo xa marasi mɛma.»

sentences.english: Then Abigail quickly took two hundred cakes of bread and two skins full of wine and five sheep ready for cooking and five measures of dry grain and a hundred parcels of dry grapes and two hundred cakes of figs, and put them on asses.
sentences.susu: A xa ginɛ Abigayili naxa taami kɛmɛ firin tongo, a nun wɛni kundi firin, yɛxɛɛ ganxi suuli, kaabɛ ganxi busali firin, tamare mɔɔli nde suxui kɛmɛ, nun xɔrɛ xaraxi xuti kɛmɛ firin. A naxa na kote baki sofale fari.

sentences.english: And she said to her young men, Go on in front of me and I will come after you. But she said nothing to her husband Nabal.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a xa konyie bɛ, «Wo siga yare, n fafe.» A mu sese fala a xa mɔri Nabali bɛ.

sentences.english: Now while she was going down under cover of the mountain on her ass, David and his men came down against her, and suddenly she came face to face with them.
sentences.susu: A naxa baki sofale fari, a goro geya ma. Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie fan nu na gorofe, e fa naralan na ginɛ ra.

sentences.english: Now David had said, What was the use of my taking care of this man's goods in the waste land, so that there was no loss of anything which was his? he has only given me back evil for good.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nu bara a fala a xa mixie bɛ, a naxɛ, «N bara Nabali xa xurusee makanta fufafu gbengberenyi ma. Sese mu baxi a xa naafuli ra, kɔnɔ a naxa n ma wali fanyi sare masara fe ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: May God's punishment be on David, if when morning comes there is so much as one male of his people still living.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li n mu Nabali xa xɛmɛ birin faxa beenun tina gɛɛsɛgɛ, Ala xa n ɲaxankata a ɲaaxi ra.»

sentences.english: And when Abigail saw David, she quickly got off her ass, falling down on her face before him.
sentences.susu: Abigayili to sa Dawuda to, a naxa goro mafuren sofale fari, a suyidi Dawuda bɛ.

sentences.english: And falling at his feet she said, May the wrong be on me, my lord, on me: let your servant say a word to you, and give ear to the words of your servant.
sentences.susu: A to bira a sanyi bun ma, a naxa a fala a bɛ, «N marigi, i xa i haakɛ to n bɛ. I xa i tuli mati n tan, i xa konyi ginɛ xui ra.

sentences.english: Let my lord give no attention to Nabal, that good-for-nothing: for as his name is, so is he, a man without sense: but I, your servant, did not see the young men whom my lord sent.
sentences.susu: I naxa i tuli mati Nabali xui ra. Xaxilitare nan a ra, alɔ a xili ‹Nabali› a masenma ki naxɛ. A daxuɲa nan tun falama. N tan mu i xa xɛɛrae toxi.

sentences.english: So now, my lord, by the living God and by your living soul, seeing that the Lord has kept you from the crime of blood and from taking into your hands the punishment for your wrongs, may all your haters, and those who would do evil to my lord, be like Nabal.
sentences.susu: Ala to i ratanga nii bafe ma, a to i ratanga i gbeɲɔxɔfe ma, Ala xa a niya i yaxuie xa lu alɔ Nabali. Ala bɛ, i tan bɛ, naxee wama fe ɲaaxi rabafe i tan na, nee birin xa lu alɔ Nabali.»

sentences.english: And let this offering, which your servant gives to my lord, be given to the young men who are with my lord.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi, n tan i xa konyi ginɛ faxi buɲa naxan na, na xa itaxun i fɔxirabirɛe ma.

sentences.english: And may the sin of your servant have forgiveness: for the Lord will certainly make your family strong, because my lord is fighting in the Lord's war; and no evil will be seen in you all your days.
sentences.susu: Yandi, i xa diɲɛ muxu ma. Alatala xa i bɔnsɔɛ sabati, barima Ala xa geresoe nan i ra. Ala xa i ratanga fe ɲaaxi birin ma.

sentences.english: And though a man has taken up arms against you, putting your life in danger, still the soul of my lord will be kept safe among the band of the living with the Lord your God; and the souls of those who are against you he will send violently away from him, like stones from a bag.
sentences.susu: I Marigi Alatala xa i nii ratanga i yaxuie ma. Alatala xa i yaxuie makuya i ra pon.

sentences.english: And when the Lord has done for my lord all those good things which he has said he will do for you, and has made you a ruler over Israel;
sentences.susu: Alatala na gɛ hinnɛde i ra, a i findi Isirayila mangɛ ra, alɔ a laayidixi i bɛ ki naxɛ,

sentences.english: Then you will have no cause for grief, and my lord's heart will not be troubled because you have taken life without cause and have yourself given punishment for your wrongs: and when the Lord has been good to you, then give a thought to your servant.
sentences.susu: a mu lanma i bɔɲɛ xa tɔɔrɔ fe nde ma i naxan nabaxi, alɔ mixi nii bafe fufafu i gbeɲɔxɔ fe ra. Alatala na gɛ hinnɛde i ra, i ratu n ma.»

sentences.english: And David said to Abigail, May the Lord, the God of Israel, be praised, who sent you to me today:
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Abigayili bɛ, a naxɛ, «Tantui na Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ, naxan i xɛɛxi n yire to.

sentences.english: A blessing on your good sense and on you, who have kept me today from the crime of blood and from taking into my hands the punishment for my wrongs.
sentences.susu: Ala tantu i xaxili fanyi xa fe ra, Ala xa baraka sa i xa fe, i tan naxan n natangaxi gbaloe rabafe ma alako n xa kisi.

sentences.english: For truly, by the living Lord, the God of Israel, who has kept me from doing you evil, if you had not been so quick in coming to me and meeting me, by dawn there would not have been in Nabal's house so much as one male living.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala i bɛ Isirayila Marigi Alatala xili ra, naxan n natangaxi fe kobi rabafe ma, xa i mu i xulun fafe ra n yire nu, beemanun kuye xa iyalan, Nabali xa xɛmɛ birin bara faxa nu.»

sentences.english: Then David took from her hands her offering: and he said to her, Go back to your house in peace; see, I have given ear to your voice, and taken your offering with respect.
sentences.susu: Abigayili Dawuda sanba see naxee ra, Dawuda naxa e rasuxu, a fa a fala a bɛ, «Gbilen i xɔnyi bɔɲɛsa kui. N bara gɛ i xui suxude.»

sentences.english: And Abigail went back to Nabal; and he was feasting in his house like a king; and Nabal's heart was full of joy, for he had taken much wine; so she said nothing to him till dawn came.
sentences.susu: Abigayili to Nabali yire li, a naxa a to a na xulunyi xungbe tife ɲɛlɛxinyi kui, a siisixi feo. A mu sese fala a xa mɔri bɛ han gɛɛsɛgɛ.

sentences.english: And in the morning, when the effect of the wine was gone, Nabal's wife gave him an account of all these things, and all the heart went out of him, and he became like stone.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, siisi to ba Nabali fate i, a xa ginɛ naxa dɛntɛgɛ sa a bɛ, a fa gaaxu ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And about ten days after, the Lord sent disease on Nabal and death came to him.
sentences.susu: Xi fu ɲɔndɔn dangi xanbi, Alatala naxa Nabali faxa.

sentences.english: And David, hearing that Nabal was dead, said, May the Lord be praised, who has taken up my cause against Nabal for the shame which he put on me, and has kept back his servant from evil, and has sent on Nabal's head the reward of his evil-doing. And David sent word to Abigail, desiring to take her as his wife.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to Nabali faxa fe mɛ, a naxa a fala, «Tantui na Alatala bɛ, naxan n natanga Nabali xa xaxilitareɲa ma alako n naxa ɲaaxuɲa raba. Alatala bara Nabali xa ɲaaxuɲa sare ragbilen a ma.» Dawuda naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ, e xa sa a fala Abigayili bɛ, a xa findi a xa ginɛ ra.

sentences.english: And when David's servants came to Carmel, to Abigail, they said to her, David has sent us to you to take you to him as his wife.
sentences.susu: E to siga Karemele na falade a bɛ,

sentences.english: And she got up, and going down on her face to the earth, said, See, I am ready to be a servant-girl, washing the feet of the servants of my lord.
sentences.susu: a naxa a yatagi felen bɔxi ma, a fa a fala, «N marigi Dawuda, i xa konyi ginɛ nan n na, naxan mu tondima i xa walikɛe sanyie maxade.»

sentences.english: Then Abigail got up quickly and went on her ass, with five of her young women, after the men whom David had sent; and she became David's wife.
sentences.susu: Abigayili naxa keli keren na, a te sofale fari, a bira Dawuda xa xɛɛrae fɔxɔ ra, a nun ginɛ dimɛdi suuli. Na ki a naxa findi Dawuda xa ginɛ ra.

sentences.english: And David had taken Ahinoam of Jezreel, to be his wife; these two were his wives.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nu bara Axinowama Yisireelika fan dɔxɔ.

sentences.english: Now Saul had given his daughter Michal, David's wife, to Palti the son of Laish of Gallim.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu nu bara a xa di ginɛ Mikali, Dawuda xa ginɛ singe, fi Layisa xa di Paliti Galimuka ma.

sentences.english: And the Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah, and said, Is not David waiting secretly near us in the hill of Hachilah, before the waste land?
sentences.susu: Sifikae naxa siga Sɔlu yire, e sa a fala a bɛ, a Dawuda nɔxunxi Xakila geyae fari gbengberenyi ya ra.

sentences.english: Then Saul went down to the waste land of Ziph, taking with him three thousand of the best men of Israel, to make search for David in the waste land of Ziph.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa Isirayila sɔɔri fanyi wulu saxan xanin Sifi gbengberenyi ma Dawuda fende.

sentences.english: And Saul put up his tents on the hill of Hachilah, which is in front of the waste land on the road. But David was in the waste land, and he saw that Saul was coming after him.
sentences.susu: E naxa yonkin Xakila geyae yire, gbengberenyi ya ra kira dɛ ra. Dawuda tan nu na gbengberenyi ma. A to a mɛ a Sɔlu na a fenfe gbengberenyi ma,

sentences.english: And so David sent out watchers, and got word from them that Saul was certainly coming.
sentences.susu: a naxa fe rabɛnyie xɛɛ. Na kui a naxa a kolon a Sɔlu bara fa.

sentences.english: And David got up and came to the place where Saul's tents were: and David had a view of the place where Saul was sleeping with Abner, the son of Ner, the captain of his army: and Saul was sleeping inside the ring of carts, and the tents of the people were all round him.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Dawuda naxa siga Sɔlu yonkinde. A naxa yire to Sɔlu nun a xa sɔɔrie xunyi Abeneri, Neri xa di, nu xife dɛnnaxɛ e xa sɔɔrie tagi.

sentences.english: Then David said to Ahimelech the Hittite, and to Abishai, the son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, Who will go down with me to the tents of Saul? And Abishai said, I will go down with you.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Aximeleki Xitika nun Seruya xa di Abisayi, Yowaba xunya, maxɔrin, «Nde n matima Sɔlu yire?» Abisayi naxa a yaabi, «N tan.»

sentences.english: So David and Abishai came down to the army by night: and Saul was sleeping inside the ring of carts with his spear planted in the earth by his head: and Abner and the people were sleeping round him.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun Abisayi naxa goro ɲama yire kɔɛ ra. Sɔlu nu saxi ɲama tagi, a na xife, a xa tanbɛ sɔrɔnxi a xun sade ra. Abeneri nun ɲama birin saxi a rabilinyi.

sentences.english: Then Abishai said to David, God has given up your hater into your hands today; now let me give him one blow through to the earth with his spear, and there will be no need to give him a second.
sentences.susu: Abisayi naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, «Ala bara i yaxui sa i bɛlɛxɛ to. A lu n tan xa a banban bɔxi ma n ma tanbɛ ra sanmaya keren. A mu findima firin na!»

sentences.english: And David said to Abishai Do not put him to death; for who, without sin, may put out his hand against the man on whom the Lord has put the holy oil?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Dawuda naxa a fala Abisayi bɛ, «I naxa a faxa! Nde nɔma Alatala xa mixi sugandixi faxade, na yunubi mu fa lu a xun ma?

sentences.english: And David said, By the living Lord, the Lord will send destruction on him; the natural day of his death will come, or he will go into the fight and come to his end.
sentences.susu: N bara a fala i bɛ Alatala xili ra, Alatala nan keren nɔma a faxade, a xa simaya kamalima tɛmui naxɛ, xa na mu gere nde kui.

sentences.english: Never will my hand be stretched out against the man marked with the holy oil; but take the spear which is by his head and the vessel of water, and let us go.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa n natanga n bɛlɛxɛ safe ra Alatala xa mixi sugandixi ma! A xa tanbɛ nun a xa ye kundi tongo tun, won xɛɛ.»

sentences.english: So David took the spear and the vessel of water from Saul's head; and they got away without any man seeing them, or being conscious of their coming, or awaking; for they were all sleeping because a deep sleep from the Lord had come on them.
sentences.susu: Na ki Dawuda naxa Sɔlu xa tanbɛ nun a xa ye kundi xanin, mixi yo mu e to, mixi yo mu na fe kolon, mixi yo mu xunu. Alatala nu bara xi xɔli tilinxi radangi e birin ma.

sentences.english: Then David went over to the other side, and took his place on the top of a mountain some distance away, with a great space between them;
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa dangi boore sɛɛti ma yire makuyaxi, a sa ti geya xun tagi.

sentences.english: And crying out to the people and to Abner, the son of Ner, David said, Have you no answer to give, Abner? Then Abner said, Who is that crying out to the king?
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a xui ramini ɲama nun Neri xa di Abeneri ma, a naxɛ, «Abeneri, i mu n xui ratinma?» Abeneri naxa a maxɔrin, «Nde na i ra, naxan gbelegbelefe mangɛ ra yi ki?»

sentences.english: And David said to Abner, Are you not a man of war? is there any other like you in Israel? why then have you not kept watch over your lord the king? for one of the people came in to put the king your lord to death.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Abeneri bɛ, «Xɛmɛ gbangbalanyi mu i ra, naxan maniyɛ mu na Isirayila? Pe, munfe ra i mu fa i xa mangɛ kanta, i marigi? Mixi nde so nɛ wo tagi a xa mangɛ faxa.

sentences.english: What you have done is not good. By the living Lord, death is the right fate for you, because you have not kept watch over your lord, the man on whom the Lord has put the holy oil. Now see, where is the king's spear, and the vessel of water which was by his head?
sentences.susu: I naxan nabaxi na ki, na mu fan. N xa a fala i bɛ Alatala xili ra, a lan nɛ i xa faxa, i to mu wo xa mangɛ kantaxi, Alatala xa mixi sugandixi. A mato ba, mangɛ xa tanbɛ nun a xa ye kundi na minden, naxee nu na a xun sade ra?»

sentences.english: And Saul, conscious that the voice was David's, said, Is that your voice, David, my son? And David said, It is my voice, O my lord king.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa Dawuda xui kolon, a naxa a maxɔrin, «N ma di Dawuda, i xui nan na ki?» Dawuda naxa a yaabi, «N marigi, n tan nan a ra.

sentences.english: And he said, Why does my lord go armed against his servant? what have I done? or what evil is there in me?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra i na birafe n tan i xa konyi fɔxɔ ra? N munse rabaxi, naxan mu rafan i ma?

sentences.english: Let my lord the king give ear now to the words of his servant. If it is the Lord who is moving you against me, let him take an offering: but if it is the children of men, may they be cursed before the Lord, for driving me out today and keeping me from my place in the heritage of the Lord, saying, Go, be the servant of other gods.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, n marigi, i tuli mati n na. Xa Alatala nan i bɔɲɛ ratexi n ma, i xa sɛrɛxɛ nde ba alako a xa diɲɛ n ma. Kɔnɔ xa mixie nan i bɔɲɛ ratexi n ma, Alatala xa e danka, barima e wama n kerife Alatala xa ɲama ya ma, n xa siga ala gbɛtɛe batude.

sentences.english: Then do not let my blood be drained out on the earth away from the face of the Lord: for the king of Israel has come out to take my life, like one going after birds in the mountains.
sentences.susu: N mu wama faxafe yire naxan makuya Alatala ya tode ra. A luxi alɔ i tan Isirayila mangɛ na dondoli di nde nan gerefe, alɔ i na xɔni xunxuri di nde nan fenfe geya ma.»

sentences.english: Then Saul said, I have done wrong: come back to me, David my son: I will do you no more wrong, because my life was dear to you today truly, I have been foolish and my error is very great.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a yaabi, «N bara haakɛ sɔtɔ i ra. Diɲɛ, n ma di Dawuda, n mu fe ɲaaxi yo rabama i ra sɔnɔn, barima to tan i bara hinnɛ n na. N xaxilitareɲa naxan nabaxi i ra, a mu fan.»

sentences.english: Then David said, Here is the king's spear! let one of the young men come over and get it.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a yaabi, «Mangɛ xa tanbɛ nan yi ki, i xa konyi nde xa fa a tongo.

sentences.english: And the Lord will give to every man the reward of his righteousness and his faith: because the Lord gave you into my hands today, and I would not put out my hand against the man who has been marked with the holy oil.
sentences.susu: Alatala mixi birin sare fima a xa tinxinyi nun a xa kinikini nan ma. To Alatala nu bara i sa n bɛlɛxɛ, kɔnɔ n mu tin Alatala xa mixi sugandixi tɔɔrɔde.

sentences.english: And so, as your life was dear to me today, may my life be dear to the Lord, and may he make me free from all my troubles.
sentences.susu: I nii tide to gboxi n bɛ to, tina n fan nii tide gboma nɛ Alatala bɛ na ki, a n natangama nɛ tɔɔrɛ birin ma.»

sentences.english: Then Saul said to David, May a blessing be on you, David, my son; you will do great things and without doubt you will overcome. Then David went on his way, and Saul went back to his place.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, «N ma di Dawuda, Alatala xa i baraayi. Ala xa i xa fe birin sɔɔnɛya.» Dawuda naxa siga a xa kira xɔn, Sɔlu fan naxa gbilen a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And David said to himself, Some day death will come to me by the hand of Saul: the only thing for me to do is to get away into the land of the Philistines; then Saul will give up hope of taking me in any part of the land of Israel: and so I may be able to get away from him.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala a yɛtɛ ma, a naxɛ, «Lɔxɔɛ nde Sɔlu man katama nɛ n faxade. N xa n gi a ya ra Filisita bɔxi ma, alako a xa gbilen n fɔxɔ ra Isirayila bɔxi ma. Na nan nɔma n bade a bɛlɛxɛ.»

sentences.english: So David and the six hundred men who were with him went over to Achish, the son of Maoch, king of Gath.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun a xa mixi kɛmɛ sennie naxa keli, e naxa siga Mayi xa di Akisi yire, naxan findixi Gati mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And David and his men were living with Achish at Gath; every man had his family with him, and David had his two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel, and Abigail of Carmel, who had been the wife of Nabal.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa sabati Akisi xɔnyi Gati bɔxi ma, a tan nun a xa mixi kɛmɛ senni, birin nun a xa denbaya. Dawuda xa denbaya fan nu na, a xa ginɛ firinyie, Axinowama Yisireelika nun Abigayili Karemeleka, Nabali xa ginɛ fori.

sentences.english: And Saul, hearing that David had gone to Gath, went after him no longer.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu to a kolon a Dawuda bara a gi Gati, a naxa gbilen a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Then David said to Achish, If now I have grace in your eyes, let me have a place in one of the smaller towns of your land, to be my living-place; for it is not right for your servant to be living with you in the king's town.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Akisi bɛ, «Xa a sa i kɛnɛn mangɛ, i xa yire nde so n tan yi ra, i xa konyi di, n luma dɛnnaxɛ. A mu lanma n tan i xa konyi xa lu i sɛɛti ma mangataa kui.»

sentences.english: So Achish straight away gave him Ziklag: and for that reason Ziklag has been the property of the kings of Judah to this day.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Akisi naxa Sikilaga taa so a yi ra. Na nan a toxi Sikilaga naxa findi Yuda mangɛe gbe ra han to.

sentences.english: And David was living in the land of the Philistines for the space of a year and four months.
sentences.susu: Dawuda ɲɛ keren kike naani nan naba Filisita bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And David and his men went up and made attacks on the Geshurites and the Girzites and the Amalekites; for these were the people who were living in the land from Telam on the way to Shur, as far as Egypt.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie nu sigama Gesurikae, Girisikae, Amalɛkikae gerede, barima nee nu sabatixi kelife Suru bɔxi ma han Misira bɔxi ma kabi tɛmui xɔnkuye.

sentences.english: And David again and again made attacks on the land till not a man or a woman was still living; and he took away the sheep and the oxen and the asses and the camels and the clothing; and he came back to Achish.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nu darixi naakae sɔntɔ ra ginɛe nun xɛmɛe, a fa e xa xuruse xungbee, e xa xuruse lanmae, e xa sofalee, e xa ɲɔxɔmɛe, nun e xa dugie, a na birin xanin Akisi yire.

sentences.english: And every time Achish said, Where have you been fighting today? David said, Against the South of Judah and the South of the Jerahmeelites and the South of the Kenites.
sentences.susu: Akisi nu a maxɔrinma, «Wo gere so minden to?» Dawuda nu a yaabima, «Yudaya, Yerameeli, nun Keni xa gbengberenyie.»

sentences.english: Not one living man or woman did David ever take back with him to Gath, fearing that they might give an account of what had taken place, and say, This is what David did, and so has he been doing all the time while he has been living in the land of the Philistines.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nu na mixie faxama na nan ma, alako e naxa nɔ sigade Gati, e sa dɛntɛgɛ sa Dawuda xa fe rabaxi xa fe ra. A nu walima na ki nɛ Filisita bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Achish had belief in what David said, saying, He has made himself hated by all his people Israel, and so he will be my servant for ever.
sentences.susu: Na kui Akisi nu laxi Dawuda ra, a nu a falama, «Dawuda bara a yɛtɛ raɲaaxu a xa ɲama Isirayila ma. A mu kelima n xun ma abadan.»
