sentences.english: Now in those days the Philistines got their forces together to make war on Israel. And Achish said to David, Certainly you and your men are to go out with me to the fight.
sentences.susu: Na waxati, Filisitakae nu bara e xa sɔɔrie malan sigafe ra Isirayilakae gerede. Akisi naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, «I tan nun i xa sɔɔrie, wo xa n mali yi gere kui.»

sentences.english: And David said to Achish, You will see now what your servant will do. And Achish said to David, Then I will make you keeper of my head for ever.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Akisi yaabi, «I fama a kolonde n nɔma naxan nabade.» Akisi naxa a fala a bɛ, «N i findima nɛ n ma kantama ra abadan.»

sentences.english: Now Samuel was dead, and all Israel, after weeping for him, had put his body in its last resting-place in Ramah, his town. And Saul had put away from the land all those who had control of spirits and who made use of secret arts.
sentences.susu: Samuweli nu bara faxa. Isirayilakae birin a xa ɲɔnfe raba nɛ, a ragata Rama, a bari taa kui. Na waxati Sɔlu nu bara tɔnyi dɔxɔ karamɔxɔɛe xa wali ra, naxee nu wɔyɛnma faxamixie nun ɲinnɛe ra.

sentences.english: And the Philistines came together and put their forces in position in Shunem; and Saul got all Israel together and they took up their positions in Gilboa.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa e malan Sunemi, Sɔlu naxa Isirayilakae malan Gilibowa.

sentences.english: And when Saul saw the Philistine army he was troubled, and his heart was moved with fear.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu to Filisita ɲama to, a bɔɲɛ naxa mini a i, a gaaxu a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: And when Saul went for directions to the Lord, the Lord gave him no answer, by a dream or by the Urim or by the prophets.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa Alatala maxandi, kɔnɔ Alatala mu a yaabi xiye ra, a mu a yaabi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nun namiɲɔnmɛ xui ra.

sentences.english: Then Saul said to his servants, Get me a woman who has control of a spirit so that I may go to her and get directions. And his servants said to him, There is such a woman at En-dor.
sentences.susu: Na kui Sɔlu naxa a xa mixi ndee xili, a naxɛ, «Wo sa ginɛ sematoe nde fen, naxan fata wɔyɛnde mixi faxaxie ra, alako a xa n mali.» Sɔlu xa mixie naxa a yaabi, «Ginɛ nde na Endori, naxan wɔyɛnma faxamixie ra.»

sentences.english: So Saul, putting on other clothing, so that he might not be seen to be the king, took two men with him and went to the woman by night; and he said, Now, with the help of the spirit which you have, make the person whose name I will give you come up.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu to na mɛ, a naxa a dugi masara alako mixi naxa a kolon a tan na a ra. A tan nun mixi firin, e naxa siga na ginɛ yire kɔɛ ra. Sɔlu naxa a fala a bɛ, «Se mato n bɛ faxamixi nde saabui ra, n naxan xili falama i bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the woman said to him, But you have knowledge of what Saul has done, how he has put away out of the land those who have control of spirits and the users of secret arts: why would you, by a trick, put me in danger of death?
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a yaabi, «I a kolon Sɔlu tɔnyi naxan dɔxɔxi karamɔxɔɛ wali ra, naxee wɔyɛnma faxamixie nun ɲinnɛe ra. Munfe ra i na gantanyi tefe n bɛ, i xa n faxa?»

sentences.english: And Saul made an oath to her by the Lord, saying, By the living Lord, no punishment will come to you for this.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a rakali a bɛ, «Alatala xili ra, i naxa kɔntɔfili. A findi kote yo ra, n tan nan a tongoma.»

sentences.english: Then the woman said, Who am I to let you see? And he said, Make Samuel come up for me.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «I wama wɔyɛnfe faxamixi mundun na?» A naxa a yaabi, «Samuweli.»

sentences.english: And the woman saw that it was Saul, and she gave a loud cry, and said to Saul, Why have you made use of deceit? for you are Saul.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ to Samuweli to, a naxa gbelegbele, a fa a fala Sɔlu bɛ, «Munfe ra i bara n madaxu? I tan nan yati na Sɔlu ra!»

sentences.english: And the king said to her, Have no fear: what do you see? And the woman said to Saul, I see a god coming up out of the earth.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «Hali i mu gaaxu! I munse toxi?» Ginɛ naxa a fala Sɔlu bɛ, «A luxi alɔ malekɛ nde na kelife bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And he said to her, What is his form? And she said, It is an old man coming up covered with a robe. And Saul saw that it was Samuel, and with his face bent down to the earth he gave him honour.
sentences.susu: A naxa a maxɔrin, «A lahalɛ na di?» Ginɛ naxa a yaabi, «Xanfɔri nan a ra, burumusi ragoroxi a ma.» Sɔlu naxa a kolon keren na a Samuweli nan a ra. A naxa a tigi sin bɔxi ma, a suyidi.

sentences.english: And Samuel said to Saul, Why have you made me come up, troubling my rest? And Saul in answer said, I am in great danger; for the Philistines are making war on me, and God has gone away from me and will no longer give me any answer, by the prophets or by dreams: so I have sent for you to make clear to me what I am to do.
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a fala Sɔlu bɛ, «Munfe ra i n tɔɔrɔxi, n xa mini i ma?» Sɔlu naxa a yaabi, «N na kɔntɔfili belebele nan kui. Filisitakae bara fa n gerede. N tan bara Alatala xili, kɔnɔ a bara mɛɛ n na, a mu n yaabixi namiɲɔnmɛe saabui ra, a mu n yaabixi xiye saabui ra. N fa i xilixi na nan ma, alako i xa a masen n bɛ a lanma n xa naxan naba.»

sentences.english: And Samuel said, Why do you put your questions to me, seeing that God has gone away from you and is on the side of him who is against you?
sentences.susu: Samuweli naxa a maxɔrin, «Xa Alatala bara mɛɛ i ra, a bara findi i gerefa ra, i fa n tan maxɔrinma munfe ra?

sentences.english: And the Lord himself has done what I said: the Lord has taken the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbour David;
sentences.susu: Alatala bara fe raba, alɔ a a fala i bɛ ki naxɛ n tan saabui ra. A bara mangɛya ba i yi ra, a a so Dawuda yi ra.

sentences.english: Because you did not do what the Lord said, and did not give effect to his burning wrath against Amalek. So the Lord has done this thing to you today.
sentences.susu: I to tondi Alatala xui suxude Amalɛki xa fe ra, a nu xɔnɔxi naxan ma, Alatala tan na fe mɔɔli nan niyama i ra to.

sentences.english: And more than this, the Lord will give Israel up with you into the hands of the Philistines: and tomorrow you and your sons will be with me: and the Lord will give up the army of Israel into the hands of the Philistines.
sentences.susu: Alatala fama nɛ i tan nun Isirayila sade Filisitakae sagoe. Tina, i tan nun i xa die birin luma nɛ n fɛ ma be, Alatala Isirayila xa sɔɔrie sama nɛ Filisitakae sagoe.»

sentences.english: Then Saul went down flat on the earth, and was full of fear because of Samuel's words: and there was no strength in him, for he had taken no food all that day or all that night.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Sɔlu naxa bira bɔxi gaaxui ra Samuweli xa masenyi xa fe ra. A sɛnbɛ yo mu na, barima a mu nu sese donxi na lɔxɔɛ nun na kɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the woman came to Saul and saw that he was in great trouble, and said to him, See now, your servant has given ear to your words, and I have put my life in danger by doing what you said.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ to Sɔlu xa gaaxui to, a naxa a fala a bɛ, «To tan n bara i xui ratinmɛ, hali na nu nɔma findide faxɛ ra n bɛ.

sentences.english: So now, give ear to the voice of your servant, and let me give you a little bread; and take some food to give you strength when you go on your way.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi i xa i tuli mati n na. I xa tin n xa donse nde fi i ma, alako i xa nɔ sɛnbɛ sɔtɔde biyaasi xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: But he would not, saying, I have no desire for food. But his servants, together with the woman, made him take food, and he gave way to them. So he got up from the earth, and took his seat on the bed.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Sɔlu mu tin, a naxɛ, «N mu n dɛgema.» A xa mixie nun na ginɛ naxa karaxan, alako a xa a dɛge. A raɲɔnyi a naxa tin na ra, a keli bɔxi ma, a dɔxɔ sade ma.

sentences.english: And the woman had in the house a young cow, made fat for food; and she put it to death straight away; and she took meal and got it mixed and made unleavened bread;
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa keli keren na, a naxa a xa ninge lanma bɔrɔgɛxi faxa. A naxa taami lɛbinitare rafala farin nun ture ra.

sentences.english: And she put it before Saul and his servants, and they had a meal. Then they got up and went away the same night.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fi Sɔlu nun a xa mixie ma, e naxa e dɛge, e fa siga na kɔɛ yati ra.

sentences.english: Now the Philistines got all their army together at Aphek: and the Israelites put their forces in position by the fountain in Jezreel.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa e xa sɔɔrie malan Afeki, Isirayilakae tan naxa e xa sɔɔrie malan dulonyi yire Yisireeli mabiri.

sentences.english: And the lords of the Philistines went on with their hundreds and their thousands, and David and his men came after with Achish.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae xa sɔɔri mangɛe nu ɲɛrɛma e xa galie ya ra, ndee lanxi mixi kɛmɛ ma, ndee nu lanxi mixi wulu ma. Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie nu na e xanbi ra mangɛ Akisi sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Then the rulers of the Philistines said, What are these Hebrews doing here? And Achish said to the rulers of the Philistines, Is this not David, the servant of Saul the king of Israel, who has been with me for a year or two, and I have never seen any wrong in him from the time when he came to me till now?
sentences.susu: Filisita sɔɔri mangɛe naxa Akisi maxɔrin, «Pe, yi Isirayilakae na munse rabafe be?» Akisi naxa e yaabi, a naxɛ, «Dawuda nan a ra, naxan nu findixi Isirayila mangɛ Sɔlu xa mixi ra, kɔnɔ a na n fɔxɔ ra kabi ɲɛ wuyaxi. Han yakɔsi n mu fe ɲaaxi yo toxi a ra, kabi a naxa so n xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: But the rulers of the Philistines were angry with him, and said to him, Make the man go back to the place you have given him; do not let him go down with us to the fight, or he may be turned against us and be false to us: for how will this man make peace with his lord? will it not be with the heads of these men?
sentences.susu: Filisita sɔɔri mangɛe naxa xɔnɔ Akisi ma na xa fe ra, e fa a fala a bɛ, «A lanma i xa Dawuda ragbilen yire, i dɛnnaxɛ soxi a yi ra. A mu lanma a xa bira won fɔxɔ ra, alako a naxa won yanfa gere kui. Na yanfanteya mɔɔli mu nɔma xɛ a niyade Sɔlu xa diɲɛ a ma?

sentences.english: Is this not David, who was named in their songs, when in the dance they said to one another, Saul has put to death thousands, and David tens of thousands?
sentences.susu: Mixie nu sigi sama, e fare boron Dawuda matɔxɔfe ra. E nu a fala, ‹Sɔlu bara mixi wulu keren faxa, kɔnɔ Dawuda tan bara mixi wulu fu faxa.›»

sentences.english: Then Achish sent for David and said to him, By the living Lord, you are upright, and everything you have done with me in the army has been pleasing to me: I have seen no evil in you from the day when you came to me till now: but still, the lords are not pleased with you.
sentences.susu: Akisi naxa Dawuda xili, a a fala a bɛ, «N bara n kali Alatala ra, i tinxin. N nu wama nɛ, won birin xa siga gere kui, won man fa, barima n mu fe ɲaaxi yo toxi i ra. Kɔnɔ i mu rafan n ma sɔɔri mangɛe ma.

sentences.english: So now go back, and go in peace, so that you do not make the lords of the Philistines angry.
sentences.susu: I naxan nabama, i xa gbilen muxu fɔxɔ ra bɔɲɛsa kui, alako Filisita sɔɔri mangɛe bɔɲɛ naxa raɲaaxu e ma.»

sentences.english: And David said to Achish, But what have I done? what have you seen in your servant while I have been with you till this day, that I may not go and take up arms against those who are now making war on my lord the king?
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a maxɔrin, «N tan i xa konyi, n munse rabaxi, naxan mu rafanxi i ma, naxan a niyama n xa gbilen n marigi yaxuie gerefe fɔxɔ ra?»

sentences.english: And Achish in answer said, It is true that in my eyes you are good, like an angel of God: but still, the rulers of the Philistines have said, He is not to go up with us to the fight.
sentences.susu: Akisi naxa Dawuda yaabi, a naxɛ, «N a kolon. I rafan n ma alɔ Alatala xa xɛɛra, kɔnɔ Filisita sɔɔri mangɛe naxɛ, ‹Muxu mu tinma a xa bira muxu fɔxɔ ra gere kui!›

sentences.english: So get up early in the morning, with the servants of your lord who are with you, and go to the place I have given you, and have no evil design in your heart, for you are good in my eyes; but when there is light enough in the morning, go away.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, tina subaxɛ i tan nun i xa mangɛ xa sɔɔrie, naxee faxi i fɔxɔ ra, wo xa gbilen.»

sentences.english: So David and his men got up early in the morning to go back to the land of the Philistines. And the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa keli subaxɛ ma, e gbilen Filisita bɔxi ma. Filisitakae tan naxa te Yisireeli.

sentences.english: Now when David and his men came to Ziklag on the third day, the Amalekites had made an attack on the South and on Ziklag, and had overcome Ziklag and put it on fire;
sentences.susu: A xi saxan nde, Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie to so e xɔnyi Sikilaga, e naxa a to a Amalɛkikae nu bara so Negewi bɔxi ma, e Sikilaga gan.

sentences.english: And had made the women and all who were there, small and great, prisoners: they had not put any of them to death, but had taken them all away.
sentences.susu: E naxa mixi birin suxu, ginɛe yo, xɛmɛe yo, dimɛe yo, e e xanin e ɲiɲɛ ra e xun ma.

sentences.english: And when David and his men came to the town, they saw that it had been burned down, and their wives and their sons and daughters had been made prisoners.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie to e xɔnyi li, e naxa a to e xa taa nu ganxi, e xa ginɛe nun e xa die nu xaninxi.

sentences.english: Then David and the people who were with him gave themselves up to weeping till they were able to go on weeping no longer.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Dawuda nun a xa mixie naxa wa han e tagan.

sentences.english: And David's two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel and Abigail, the wife of Nabal of Carmel, had been made prisoners.
sentences.susu: Amalɛkikae nu bara Dawuda xa ginɛ firinyie fan xanin: Axinowama Yisireelika, nun Abigayili Karemeleka, Nabali xa kaaɲɛ ginɛ.

sentences.english: And David was greatly troubled; for the people were talking of stoning him, because their hearts were bitter, every man sorrowing for his sons and his daughters: but David made himself strong in the Lord his God.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa tɔɔrɔ ki fanyi, barima ɲama nu wama a magɔnɔfe. Birin bɔɲɛ nu raɲaaxuxi e ma e xa die xa fe ra, kɔnɔ Dawuda naxa limaniya a xaxili tife ra a Marigi Alatala ra.

sentences.english: And David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, Come here to me with the ephod. And Abiathar took the ephod to David.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Aximeleki xa di Abiyatari bɛ, a naxɛ, «Fa Alatala maxɔrin see ra.» Abiyatari naxa fa a ra Dawuda xɔn.

sentences.english: Then David, questioning the Lord, said, Am I to go after this band? will I be able to overtake them? And in answer he said, Go after them, for you will certainly overtake them, and get back everything.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Alatala maxɔrin, a naxɛ, «Xa n siga yi mixie fɔxɔ ra, n nɔma e masɔtɔde?» Alatala naxa a yaabi, «I xa siga e fɔxɔ ra. I fama nɛ e masɔtɔde, i man gbilenma nɛ e birin na.»

sentences.english: So David went, and his six hundred men went with him, and they came to the stream Besor.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie mixi kɛmɛ senni naxa siga, e fa Besori xure li.

sentences.english: And David, with four hundred men, went on: but two hundred of them were overcome with weariness, and not able to go across the stream.
sentences.susu: Mixi kɛmɛ firin naxa lu mɛnni taganyi xa fe ra. Dawuda nun mixi kɛmɛ naanie naxa siga yare.

sentences.english: And in the fields they saw an Egyptian whom they took to David, and they gave him bread, and he had a meal, and they gave him water for drink;
sentences.susu: E to Misiraka nde li wula i, e naxa fa a ra Dawuda yire. E naxa ye nun donse nde so a yi ra,

sentences.english: And they gave him part of a cake of figs and some dry grapes; and after the food, his spirit came back to him, for he had had no food or drink for three days and nights.
sentences.susu: alɔ xɔrɛ nun tamare mɔɔli nde xaraxi. A to gɛ a dɛgede, a naxa a yɛtɛ kolon. A nu bara fɛɛɲɛn saxan nun kɔɛ saxan ti, a mu a dɛge, a mu ye min.

sentences.english: And David said to him, Whose man are you and where do you come from? And he said, I am a young man of Egypt, servant to an Amalekite; and my master went on without me because three days back I became ill.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a maxɔrin, «Nde xa mixi na i ra? I keli minden?» A naxa a yaabi, «Misiraka nan n na, Amalɛkika nde xa konyi. A xi saxan nan yi ki, n marigi n naboloxi, barima n to mu yalanxi.

sentences.english: We made an attack on the south part of the country of the Cherethites, and on the land which is Judah's, and on the south of Caleb; and we put Ziklag on fire.
sentences.susu: Muxu Kereti nun Kalebi xa mixie bɔnbɔ nɛ gbengberenyi ma, Yudaya. Muxu tɛ so nɛ Sikilaga fan na.»

sentences.english: And David said to him, Will you take me down to this band? And he said, If you give me your oath that you will not put me to death or give me up to my master, I will take you to them.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a maxɔrin, «I nɔma n xaninde yi mixie yire?» A naxa a yaabi, «Xa i kali Ala ra a i mu n faxama, a i mu n sama n marigi bɛlɛxɛ, n i xaninma nɛ e yire.»

sentences.english: And when he had taken him down, they saw them all, seated about on all sides, feasting and drinking among all the mass of goods which they had taken from the land of the Philistines and the land of Judah.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a naxa e xanin Amalɛkikae yire. E naxa e li e nu na e dɛgefe, e siisife see ra e naxee sɔtɔ gere kui Filisita nun Yudaya bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And David went on fighting them from evening till the evening of the day after; and not one of them got away but only four hundred young men who went in flight on camels.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa e gere, keli gɛɛsɛgɛ han nunmare. Mixi yo mu nɔ a gide, fo sɛgɛtala mixi kɛmɛ naani naxee siga ɲɔxɔmɛe fari.

sentences.english: And David got back everything the Amalekites had taken; and he got back his two wives.
sentences.susu: Amalɛkikae se naxee suxu, Dawuda naxa a birin masɔtɔ, a nun a xa ginɛ firinyie.

sentences.english: There was no loss of anything, small or great, sons or daughters or goods or anything which they had taken away: David got it all back.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a xa mixi birin masɔtɔ, dimɛe ba, forie ba, a nun e xa see birin.

sentences.english: And they took all the flocks and herds, and driving them in front of him, said, These are David's.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa e xa xuruse xungbee nun a lanmae tongo, mixie fa a fala, «See nan ya Dawuda naxee sɔtɔ gere kui!»

sentences.english: And David came to the two hundred men, who because of weariness had not gone with him, but were waiting at the stream Besor: and they went out, meeting David and the people who were with him; and when they came near them, they said, How are you?
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa gbilen na mixi kɛmɛ firinyie yire, naxee nu bara lu Besori xure taganyi xa fe ra. E naxa mini Dawuda nun a fɔxirabirɛe ma. Dawuda naxa a maso e ra, a e xɛɛbu.

sentences.english: Then the bad and good-for-nothing men among those who went with David said, Because they did not go with us, we will give them nothing of the goods which we have got back, but only to every man his wife and children, so that he may take them and go.
sentences.susu: Mixi kobi ndee naxee nu na Dawuda xa sɔɔri kɛmɛ naani ya ma, nee naxa a fala, «Yi xɛmɛ naxee mu bira won fɔxɔ ra gere kui, a mu lanma e xa sese sɔtɔ, fo e xa die nun e xa ginɛe. E xa nee tongo, e xa siga.»

sentences.english: Then David said, You are not to do this, my brothers, after what the Lord has given us, who has kept us safe and given up the band which came against us into our hands.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala e bɛ, «N ngaxakerenyie, wo naxa yi mɔɔli raba see ra Alatala naxee fixi won ma, barima a bara won natanga, a won yaxuie sa won bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: Who is going to give any attention to you in this question? for an equal part will be given to him who went to the fight and to him who was waiting by the goods: they are all to have the same.
sentences.susu: Nde wo xui ramɛma yi fe kui? A lanma won xa se birin itaxun won ma mixie birin na, naxee siga gere sode nun naxee lu kote san na.»

sentences.english: And so he made it a rule and an order for Israel from that day till now.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Dawuda naxa na findi sɛriyɛ ra Isirayila bɔxi birin ma. Han to a na na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And when David came to Ziklag, he sent some of the goods to the responsible men of Judah, and to his friends, saying, Here is an offering for you from the goods of those who were fighting against the Lord;
sentences.susu: E to so Sikilaga, Dawuda naxa e sɔtɔse sɛɛti rasanba a xanuntenyi Yuda forie ma a falafe ra, «Wo mabiri nan yi ki, muxu naxee sɔtɔxi Alatala yaxuie yi ra!»

sentences.english: He sent to those who were in Beth-el, and in Ramah of the South, and in Jattir;
sentences.susu: A naxa na see rasanba yi mixie ma naxee na gere kui: Betelikae, Ramotika naxee nu na gbengberenyi ma, Yatirikae,

sentences.english: And to those in Arara and Eshtemoa
sentences.susu: Arowerikae, Sifimotikae, Esitemowakae,

sentences.english: and Carmel and in the towns of the Jerahmeelites, and in the towns of the Kenites;
sentences.susu: Rakalikae, Yerameeli mixie, Keni mixie,

sentences.english: And to those who were in Hormah and in Bor-ashan and in Athach;
sentences.susu: Horomakae, Bori Asankae, Atakika,

sentences.english: And in Hebron, and to all the places where David and his men had been living.
sentences.susu: Hebironkae, nun mixi naxee nu na yire birin Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie siga dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Now the Philistines were fighting against Israel: and the men of Israel went in flight before the Philistines, falling down wounded in Mount Gilboa.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Filisitakae naxa Isirayila gere. Isirayilakae naxa e gi e ya ra, mixi gbegbe naxa faxa Gilibowa geya fari.

sentences.english: And the Philistines overtook Saul and his sons; and they put to death Jonathan and Abinadab and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa Sɔlu nun a xa die raxɛtɛn, e fa Sɔlu xa die Yonatan, Abinadabo, nun Malakisuwa faxa.

sentences.english: And the fight was going badly for Saul, and the archers came across him, and he was wounded by the archers.
sentences.susu: Gere naxa nɔ Sɔlu ra. Xali wolie to Sɔlu sɔxɔ, a nu sɛrɛnma a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: Then Saul said to the servant who had the care of his arms, Take out your sword and put it through me, before these men without circumcision come and make sport of me. But his servant, full of fear, would not do so. Then Saul took out his sword, and falling on it, put an end to himself.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a fala a xa sɔɔri bɛ, naxan nu a geresose maxaninma, a naxɛ, «I xa n faxa i xa santidɛgɛma ra, alako yi sunnataree naxa n faxa xɔnɛ ɲaaxi ra.» Sɔlu xa sɔɔri to mu tin na rabade gaaxui xa fe ra, Sɔlu naxa a yɛtɛ faxa a xa santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: And when his servant saw that Saul was dead, he did the same, and was united with him in death.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa geresose maxaninma to a to Sɔlu bara faxa, na fan naxa a yɛtɛ faxa a xa santidɛgɛma ra a fɛ ma.

sentences.english: So death overtook Saul and his three sons and his servant on the same day.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu faxa na ki nɛ na lɔxɔɛ, a tan nun a xa di saxanyie, a xa sɔɔri naxan nu a xa geresose maxaninma, nun a xa sɔɔri birin.

sentences.english: And when the men of Israel across the valley and on the other side of Jordan saw that the army of Israel was in flight and that Saul and his sons were dead, they came out of their towns and went in flight; and the Philistines came and took them for themselves.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka naxee nu na gulunba naakiri ma, nun Yurudɛn xure naakiri ma, nee naxa a to a Isirayila sɔɔrie na e gife. E man naxa a to a Sɔlu nun a xa die bara faxa. Na kui e naxa keli e xa taae xun ma, e e gi. Filisitakae naxa sabati e xa taae kui.

sentences.english: Now on the day after, when the Philistines came to take their goods from the dead, they saw Saul and his three sons dead on the earth in Mount Gilboa.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Filisitakae to siga faxa mixie xa see tongode, e naxa Sɔlu nun a xa di saxanyie fure to Gilibowa geya fari.

sentences.english: And cutting off his head and taking away his war-dress, they sent word into the land of the Philistines round about, to take the news to their gods and to the people.
sentences.susu: E naxa Sɔlu xunyi bolon, e naxa a xa geresosee tongo. E naxa na xibaaru masen Filisita bɔxi birin ma, e xa kuye banxie nun e xa ɲama ya ma.

sentences.english: His war-dress they put in the house of Astarte; and his body was fixed on the wall of Beth-shan.
sentences.susu: E naxa Sɔlu xa geresose raso Asitarate kuye xa banxi kui, e naxa a fure gbaku Beti San tɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: And when the people of Jabesh-gilead had news of what the Philistines had done to Saul,
sentences.susu: Yabɛsikae Galadi bɔxi ma, e to a kolon Filisitakae fe naxan nabaxi Sɔlu ra,

sentences.english: All the fighting men got up and, travelling all night, took Saul's body and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beth-shan; and they came to Jabesh and had them burned there.
sentences.susu: e xa sɔɔri gbangbalanyie naxa ɲɛrɛ na kɔɛ birin na, e fa Sɔlu nun a xa di furee tongo Beti San tɛtɛ ra, e gbilen Yabɛsi. Mɛnni e naxa na furee gan,

sentences.english: And their bones they put in the earth under a tree in Jabesh; and for seven days they took no food.
sentences.susu: e naxa e xɔrie ragata tamare bili nde bun ma Yabɛsi. E naxa sunyi suxu xi solofere bun ma.

sentences.english: Now after the death of Saul, when David, having come back from the destruction of the Amalekites, had been in Ziklag for two days;
sentences.susu: Sɔlu faxa xanbi, Dawuda naxa gbilen Sikilaga kelife Amalɛkikae bɔnbɔde. A naxa lu naa xi firin.

sentences.english: On the third day a man came from Saul's tents, with his clothing out of order and earth on his head: and when he came to David, he went down on the earth and gave him honour.
sentences.susu: A xi saxan nde, xɛmɛ nde naxa fa keli Sɔlu yire. A nu bara a xa donma ibɔɔ a ma, a bɛndɛ so a xunyi ma sunnun fe ma. A to so Dawuda yire, a naxa a xinbi sin a bun ma binyɛ kui.

sentences.english: And David said to him, Where have you come from? And he said, I have come in flight from the tents of Israel.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a maxɔrin, «I kelixi minden?» A naxa a yaabi, «N nan n gixi Isirayila xa gali nan ya ma.»

sentences.english: And David said to him, How did things go? Give me the news. And in answer he said, The people have gone in flight from the fight, and a great number of them are dead; and Saul and his son Jonathan are dead.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala a bɛ, «Munse dangixi naa? Na tagi raba n bɛ.» A naxa a yaabi, «Isirayilakae bara e gi gere ma. Mixi gbegbe bara faxa e ya ma. Hali Sɔlu nun a xa di xɛmɛ Yonatan bara laaxira.»

sentences.english: And David said to the young man who gave him the news, Why are you certain that Saul and his son Jonathan are dead?
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala xɛmɛ bɛ, naxan nu dɛntɛgɛ safe a bɛ, a naxɛ, «I tan a kolonxi di, a Sɔlu nun a xa di xɛmɛ Yonatan bara laaxira?»

sentences.english: And the young man said, I came by chance to Mount Gilboa, and I saw Saul supporting himself on his spear; and the war-carriages and horsemen overtook him.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «N Sɔlu li Gilibowa geya nan fari a maxɔnɔxi a ɲaaxi ra. A nu wama a yɛtɛ faxafe tanbɛ ra, barima Filisita sɔɔri soe ragie nu bara a raxɛtɛn.

sentences.english: And looking back, he saw me and gave a cry to me. And answering him I said, Here am I.
sentences.susu: A to n to, a naxa n xili. N naxa a ratin.

sentences.english: And he said to me, Who are you? And I said, I am an Amalekite.
sentences.susu: A naxɛ, ‹Nde na i tan na?› N naxa a yaabi, ‹Amalɛkika nde nan n na.›

sentences.english: Then he said to me, Come here to my side, and put me to death, for the pain of death has me in its grip but my life is still strong in me.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala n bɛ, ‹N mu gɛxi faxade, i xa n mali n xa faxa.›

sentences.english: So I put my foot on him and gave him his death-blow, because I was certain that he would not go on living after his fall: and I took the crown from his head and the band from his arm, and I have them here for my lord.
sentences.susu: Na kui n naxa a faxa, barima n na kolon, a mu kisima feo. N naxa fa a xa mangɛ tɔnxuma nun a xa bɛlɛxɛ rasoe ra i tan n marigi xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: Then David gave way to bitter grief, and so did all the men who were with him:
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun a xa mixie naxa e xa donmae ibɔɔ sunnunyi kui na dɛntɛgɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And till evening they gave themselves to sorrow and weeping, and took no food, weeping for Saul and for Jonathan, his son, and for the people of the Lord and for the men of Israel; because they had come to their end by the sword.
sentences.susu: E naxa Sɔlu, a xa di xɛmɛ Yonatan, nun Alatala xa ɲama Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ xa ɲɔnfe raba, naxee faxaxi gere kui. E naxa wa, e naxa sun han nunmare nee xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And David said to the young man who had given him the news, Where do you come from? And he said, I am the son of a man from a strange land; I am an Amalekite.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa na xɛmɛ maxɔrin, naxan fa dɛntɛgɛ sa a bɛ, «I keli minden?» A naxa a yaabi, «Xɔɲɛ Amalɛkika xa di nan n na.»

sentences.english: And David said to him, Had you no fear of stretching out your hand to put to death the one marked with the holy oil?
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a maxɔrin, «I tan mu gaaxu Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi faxade?»

sentences.english: And David sent for one of his young men and said, Go near and put an end to him. And he put him to death.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a xa sɔɔri nde xili, a a yamari, «Yi xɛmɛ faxa!» A naxa na raba.

sentences.english: And David said to him, May your blood be on your head; for your mouth has given witness against you, saying, I have put to death the man marked with the holy oil.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala na Amalɛkika bɛ, «I to a fala a i bara Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi faxa, i bara i yɛtɛ xun nakana. A lanma i xa faxa.»

sentences.english: Then David made this song of grief for Saul and Jonathan, his son:
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa yi suuki sɛbɛ Sɔlu nun a xa di xɛmɛ Yonatan xa fe ra,

sentences.english: (It is recorded in the book of Jashar for teaching to the sons of Judah) and he said:
sentences.susu: a fa yamari fi Yudayakae xa a xaran. A xili nɛ «Xali xa suuki.» A sɛbɛxi Yasari xa buki kui.

sentences.english: The glory, O Israel, is dead on your high places! How have the great ones been made low!
sentences.susu: «Isirayila, wo xa mangɛ xungbe bara laaxira geya fari, sɔɔri fanyie bara faxa.

sentences.english: Give no news of it in Gath, let it not be said in the streets of Ashkelon; or the daughters of the Philistines will be glad, the daughters of men without circumcision will be uplifted in joy.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa na fala Gati taa kui, wo naxa na xibaaru masen Asikalɔn taa kui, alako Filisita di ginɛe naxa fa sɛɛwa, alako e tan sunnataree xa di ginɛe naxa fa ɲɛlɛxin.

sentences.english: O mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew or rain on you, you fields of death: for there the arms of the strong have been shamed, the arms of Saul, as if he had not been marked with the holy oil.
sentences.susu: Gilibowa geyae, tunɛ nun xini naxa bira wo ma, wo xa xɛe naxa fan, barima mangɛ Sɔlu xa kanke makantase bara yaagi sɔtɔ naa, ture yo mu soma a ma sɔnɔn!»

sentences.english: From the blood of the dead, from the fat of the strong, the bow of Jonathan was not turned back, the sword of Saul did not come back unused.
sentences.susu: «Yonatan xa xali bara sɔɔri xungbee faxa, Sɔlu xa tanbɛ xa wali bara sɔɔnɛya.

sentences.english: Saul and Jonathan were loved and pleasing; in their lives and in their death they were not parted; they went more quickly than eagles, they were stronger than lions.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu nun Yonatan naxee nu rafanxi mixie ma e xa simaya kui, e birin fa faxa lɔxɔɛ keren. E nu xulun dangi sɛgɛe ra. E sɛnbɛ nu gbo dangi yɛtɛe ra.

sentences.english: O daughters of Israel, have sorrow for Saul, by whom you were delicately clothed in robes of red, with ornaments of gold on your dresses.
sentences.susu: Isirayila di ginɛe, wo xa wa Sɔlu xa fe ra, naxan nu dugi fanyie ragoroma wo ma, naxan nu xɛɛma fima wo ma xunmasee ra.»

sentences.english: How have the great ones been made low in the fight! Jonathan is dead on your high places.
sentences.susu: «Korogbae bara faxa gere kui. Yonatan bara laaxira wo xa geyae fari.

sentences.english: I am full of grief for you, my brother Jonathan: very dear have you been to me: your love for me was a wonder, greater than the love of women.
sentences.susu: Yonatan ngaxakerenyi, n sunnunxi i xa fe ra. I xa fe nu xɔrɔxɔ n ma! I xa xanunteya nu na n bɛ dangi ginɛe xa xanunteya ra.

sentences.english: How have the great ones been made low, and the arms of war broken!
sentences.susu: Korogbae bara faxa gere kui. Geresosee bara kana.»

sentences.english: Now after this, David, questioning the Lord, said, Am I to go up into any of the towns of Judah? And the Lord said to him, Go up. And David said, Where am I to go? And he said, To Hebron.
sentences.susu: Na to dangi, Dawuda naxa Alatala maxɔrin, a naxɛ, «N xa te Yuda taa nde kui?» Alatala naxa a yaabi, a naxɛ, «Iyo.» Dawuda man naxa a maxɔrin, «Yuda taa mundun?» Alatala naxa a yaabi, «Hebiron bɔxi.»

sentences.english: So David went there, taking with him his two wives, Ahinoam of Jezreel, and Abigail, the wife of Nabal of Carmel.
sentences.susu: Na kui Dawuda naxa te naa a nun a xa ginɛ firinyie: Axinowama Yisireelika nun Nabali Karemeleka xa ginɛ fori Abigayili.

sentences.english: And David took all his men with him, every man with his family: and they were living in the towns round Hebron.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fɔxirabirɛe nun e xa denbayae xanin a xun ma. E naxa sa sabati Hebiron bɔxi.

sentences.english: And the men of Judah came there, and with the holy oil made David king over the people of Judah. And word came to David that it was the men of Jabesh-gilead who put Saul's body in its last resting-place.
sentences.susu: Yuda xɛmɛe naxa e malan Hebiron, e fa Dawuda findi Yuda bɔnsɔɛ mangɛ ra. Dawuda to a kolon a Yabɛsi Galadi xɛmɛe nu bara Sɔlu ragata,

sentences.english: And David sent to the men of Jabesh-gilead and said to them, May the Lord give you his blessing, because you have done this kind act to Saul your lord, and have put his body to rest!
sentences.susu: a naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ e xɔn ma, e xa sa a fala e bɛ, «Ala xa wo baraayi wo xa hinnɛ xa fe ra wo naxan masenxi Sɔlu bɛ a xa maragatɛ kui.

sentences.english: May the Lord be good and true to you: and I myself will see that your kind act is rewarded, because you have done this thing.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa hinnɛ wo ra, a xa lu wo sɛɛti ma. N fan hinnɛma nɛ wo ra na xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Then let your hands be strong, and have no fear: though Saul your lord is dead, the people of Judah have made me their king.
sentences.susu: Wo limaniya tongo, wo sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ, barima wo marigi Sɔlu bara faxa, Yuda bɔnsɔɛ bara n tan sugandi e xa mangɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Now Abner, the son of Ner, captain of Saul's army, had taken Saul's son Ish-bosheth over to Mahanaim,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Sɔlu xa sɔɔrie xa mangɛ Abeneri nu bara Sɔlu xa di Isiboseti xanin Maxanayimi.

sentences.english: And made him king over Gilead and the Asherites and over Jezreel and Ephraim and Benjamin, that is, over all Israel.
sentences.susu: A naxa a findi Asuri, Yisireeli, Efirami, nun Isirayila birin mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: (Saul's son Ish-bosheth was forty years old when he became king over Israel, and he was ruler for two years.) But Judah was on the side of David.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa di Isiboseti nu bara ɲɛ tongo naani sɔtɔ, a findixi mangɛ ra tɛmui naxɛ Isirayila xun ma. A naxa e yamari ɲɛ firin bun ma. Kɔnɔ Yuda bɔnsɔɛ tan naxa lu Dawuda xa mangɛya bun ma.

sentences.english: And the time when David was king in Hebron over the people of Judah was seven years and six months.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Yuda bɔnsɔɛ yaamari ɲɛ solofere kike senni Hebiron kui.

sentences.english: And Abner, the son of Ner, with the servants of Saul's son Ish-bosheth, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
sentences.susu: Neri xa di Abeneri nun Sɔlu xa di Isiboseti xa mixie naxa keli Maxanayimi sigafe ra Gabayon.

sentences.english: And Joab, the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of David, went out and came face to face with them by the pool of Gibeon; and they took up their position, facing one another on opposite sides of the pool.
sentences.susu: Seruya xa di xɛmɛ Yowaba nun Dawuda xa sɔɔrie naxa e li Gabayon ye yire. E naxa ti sɛɛti, booree naxa ti naakiri ma.

sentences.english: And Abner said to Joab, Let the young men give a test of their strength before us. And Joab said, Let them do so.
sentences.susu: Abeneri naxa a fala Yowaba bɛ, «Won ma sɔɔri ndee xa e boore gere won ya tode ra.» Yowaba naxa tin na ra.

sentences.english: So they got up and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin and Ish-bosheth and twelve of the servants of David.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ fu nun firin naxa keli Bunyamin nun Sɔlu xa di Isiboseti xa mixie ya ma. Xɛmɛ fu nun firin naxa keli Dawuda xa mixie ya ma. E naxa ti e boore kanke.

sentences.english: And every one got the other by the head, driving his sword into the other's side, so they all went down together: and that place was named the Field of Sides, and it is in Gibeon.
sentences.susu: Birin naxa a gerefa suxu a xunyi ma, a santidɛgɛma raso a furi kui. E birin naxa faxa tɛmui keren. Na kui e naxa mɛnni xili sa Xɛlɛkati Asurin, naxan nu wama a falafe e xa xui ra «Santidɛgɛma yire.»

sentences.english: And there was hard fighting that day; and Abner and the men of Israel gave way before the servants of David.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Dawuda xa mixie naxa Abeneri nun Isirayila mixie bɔnbɔ a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: There were three sons of Zeruiah there, Joab and Abishai and Asahel: and Asahel was as quick-footed as a roe of the fields.
sentences.susu: Seruya xa di saxanyie nu na na gere kui: Yowaba, Abisayi, nun Asahɛli. Asahɛli to xulun alɔ xeli,

sentences.english: Asahel went running after Abner, not turning to the right or to the left.
sentences.susu: a naxa bira Abeneri fɔxɔ ra a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then Abner, looking back, said, Is it you, Asahel? And he said, It is I.
sentences.susu: Abeneri naxa a ya rafindi a ma, a a maxɔrin, «I tan nan a ra Asahɛli?» Asahɛli naxɛ, «Iyo, n tan nan a ra!»

sentences.english: And Abner said, Then go to the right or to the left and put your hands on one of the fighting-men and take his arms. But Asahel would not be turned away from going after Abner.
sentences.susu: Abeneri naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xa bira sɔɔri gbɛtɛ fɔxɔ ra. I xa na faxa, i nɔma na xa geresose tongode i yɛtɛ bɛ.» Kɔnɔ Asahɛli mu tin gbilende a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Then again Abner said to Asahel, Go to one side, do not keep on coming after me: why will you make me put an end to you? for then I will be shamed before your brother Joab.
sentences.susu: Abeneri man naxa a fala Asahɛli bɛ, «N lu na. Xa n i faxa, n munse falama i taara Yowaba bɛ?»

sentences.english: But still he did not go to one side: so Abner gave him a back blow in the stomach with his spear, so that the spear came out at his back; and he went down on the earth, wounded to death: and all those who came to the place where Asahel went down dead, came to a stop.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Asahɛli mu tin. Na nan a niya, Abeneri naxa a sɔxɔ a furi ma, a xa tanbɛ fa mini a xanbi ra, a faxa keren na. Na dangi xanbi, naxan yo nɛ dangima Asahɛli faxade ra, fo a ti naa.

sentences.english: But Joab and Abishai went after Abner: and the sun went down when they came to the hill of Ammah, which is to the east of the road through the waste land of Geba.
sentences.susu: Yowaba nun Abisayi naxa bira Abeneri fɔxɔ ra, han soge dula tɛmui, e fa so Ama geya yire, Giyaxa ya tagi, Gabayon gbengberenyi kira ra.

sentences.english: And the men of Benjamin came together after Abner in one band, and took their places on the top of a hill.
sentences.susu: Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ sɔɔrie naxa ti gere ki ma Abeneri xanbi ra geya fari.

sentences.english: Then crying out to Joab, Abner said, Are fighting and destruction to go on for ever? do you not see that the end will only be bitter? how long will it be before you send the people back and make them give up attacking their countrymen?
sentences.susu: Abeneri naxa a fala Yowaba bɛ, «Santidɛgɛma faxɛ nan tun tima? I mu a kolon a na raɲɔnma fe ɲaaxi nan ma? I xa yaamari fi i xa mixie xa gbilen e ngaxakerenyie fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: And Joab said, By the living God, if you had not given the word, the people would have gone on attacking their countrymen till the morning.
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa a yaabi, «N xa a fala i bɛ Ala ya xɔri. Xa i tan xa mu wɔyɛn nu, muxu birama nɛ wo fɔxɔ ra han gɛɛsɛgɛ.»

sentences.english: So Joab had a horn sounded, and all the people came to a stop, and gave up going after Israel and fighting them.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Yowaba naxa feri fe, alako a xa sɔɔrie xa gbilen Isirayilakae fɔxɔ ra. Gere dan na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And all that night Abner and his men went through the Arabah; they went over Jordan and through all Bithron and came to Mahanaim.
sentences.susu: Abeneri nun a xa mixie naxa e ɲɛrɛ kɔɛ birin na, e dangi Araba bɔxi ra, e Yurudɛn xure giri, e dangi Bitiron na, e sa so Maxanayimi.

sentences.english: And Joab came back from fighting Abner: and when he had got all his men together, it was seen that nineteen of David's men, in addition to Asahel, were not with them.
sentences.susu: Yowaba to gbilen Abeneri fɔxɔ ra, a naxa a xa mixi birin malan. Asahɛli nun mixi fu nun solomanaani nu baxi Dawuda xa mixie ra na gere xa fe ra.

sentences.english: But David's men had put to death three hundred and sixty of the men of Benjamin and of Abner's men
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Dawuda xa mixie nu bara Bunyaminka mixi kɛmɛ saxan tongo senni faxa, naxee nu na Abeneri fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And they took Asahel's body and put it in the last resting-place of his father in Beth-lehem. And Joab and his men, travelling all night, came to Hebron at dawn.
sentences.susu: E naxa Asahɛli fure xanin e xun ma, e sa a ragata a benbae xa gaburi Bɛtɛlɛɛmu. Yowaba nun a xa mixie naxa e ɲɛrɛ kɔɛ birin na, e sa so Hebiron subaxɛ ma.

sentences.english: Now there was a long war between Saul's people and David's people; and David became stronger and stronger, but those on Saul's side became more and more feeble.
sentences.susu: Gere bu nɛ ki fanyi ra Dawuda xa mixie nun Sɔlu xa mixie tagi, Dawuda sɛnbɛ nu gboma, Sɔlu xa mixie tan sɛnbɛ nu xurunma.

sentences.english: While David was in Hebron he became the father of sons: the oldest was Amnon, son of Ahinoam of Jezreel;
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa die nan ya naxee barixi Hebiron. A xa di singe findixi Aminon nan na, Axinowama Yisireelika naxan bari a bɛ.

sentences.english: And the second, Chileab, whose mother was Abigail, the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Absalom, son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur;
sentences.susu: A xa di firin nde findixi Kileyaba nan na, Nabali Karemeleka xa ginɛ Abigayili naxan bari a bɛ. A xa di saxan nde findixi Abisalomi nan na, Gesuri mangɛ xa di ginɛ Talamayi, Maaka naxan bari a bɛ.

sentences.english: And the fourth, Adonijah, the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah, the son of Abital;
sentences.susu: A xa di naani nde findixi Adoniya nan na, Hagi naxan bari a bɛ. A xa di suuli nde findixi Sɛfataya nan na, Abitali naxan bari a bɛ.

sentences.english: And the sixth, Ithream, whose mother was David's wife Eglah. These were the sons of David, whose birth took place in Hebron.
sentences.susu: A xa di senni nde findixi Yitireyami nan na, a xa ginɛ Egela naxan bari a bɛ. Dawuda xa die nan na ki naxee bari Hebiron.

sentences.english: Now while there was war between Saul's people and David's people, Abner was making himself strong among the supporters of Saul.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa mixie nun Dawuda xa mixie nu na gerefe tɛmui naxɛ, Abeneri nu katama sɛnbɛ sɔtɔde Sɔlu xa mixie ya ma.

sentences.english: Now Saul had among his wives a woman named Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and Ish-bosheth said to Abner, Why have you taken my father's wife?
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa konyi ginɛ nde nu na naxan xili Risipa, Aya xa di ginɛ. Isiboseti naxa Abeneri maxɔrin, «Munfe ra i biraxi n baba xa konyi ginɛ fɔxɔ ra?»

sentences.english: And Abner was very angry at the words of Ish-bosheth, and he said, Am I a dog's head of Judah? I am this day doing all in my power for the cause of your father Saul and for his brothers and his friends, and have not given you up into the hands of David, and now you say I have done wrong with a woman.
sentences.susu: Abeneri naxa xɔnɔ Isiboseti ma na wɔyɛnyi xa fe ra, a fa a yaabi, «Pe, bare nan n na Yudaya bɔxi ma? N fe gbegbe rabaxi nɛ i bɔnsɔɛ bɛ, i baba xa denbaya bɛ, nun i baba booree bɛ. I baba xa xanunteya xa fe ra, n mu tin i sode Dawuda yi ra. Kɔnɔ yakɔsi i fa n kalamuxi yi ginɛ nan ma fe ra?

sentences.english: May God's punishment be on Abner, if I do not for David as the Lord in his oath has said,
sentences.susu: Ala xa n makiiti a ɲaaxi ra, xa n mu fe birin naba alako Dawuda xa fe xa kamali, alɔ Alatala a laayidixi a bɛ ki naxɛ,

sentences.english: And if I do not take away the kingdom from the family of Saul and make David ruler over Israel and Judah from Dan as far as Beer-sheba!
sentences.susu: a xa mangɛya ba Sɔlu yi ra, a fa Dawuda xa mangɛya mabanban Yudaya bɔxi ma, kelife Dana han Beriseeba.»

sentences.english: And so great was Ish-bosheth's fear of Abner that he was not able to say a word in answer.
sentences.susu: Isiboseti mu suusa a yaabide wɔyɛn keren na, barima a gaaxuxi a ya ra.

sentences.english: And Abner sent men to David at Hebron, saying, Make an agreement with me, and I will give you my support in getting all Israel on your side.
sentences.susu: Abeneri naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Dawuda ma, e xa sa a fala a bɛ a tan xili ra, «Nde gbe na yi bɔxi ra?» E man xa sa a fala a bɛ, «Won xa saata, n xa i mali Isirayila birin ya xa rafindi i ma.»

sentences.english: And he said, It is well; I will make an agreement with you, but on one condition, which is, that when you come before me, Saul's daughter Michal is to come with you; till she comes you will not see my face.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a yaabi, «Awa, won xa saatɛ xiri, kɔnɔ n mu wama i xa fa n yire n ma ginɛ Mikali xanbi, Sɔlu xa di ginɛ.»

sentences.english: And David sent men to Saul's son Ish-bosheth, saying, Give me back Michal, my wife, whom I made mine for the price of the private parts of a hundred Philistines.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Sɔlu xa di Isiboseti ma, a falafe ra, «N ma ginɛ rasanba n ma be, n naxan xa kote dɔxɔ Filisitaka soli kɛmɛ ra.»

sentences.english: So Ish-bosheth sent and took her from her husband Paltiel, the son of Laish.
sentences.susu: Na kui Isiboseti naxa sa a ba a xa mɔri Palatiyɛli yi ra, Layisa xa di.

sentences.english: And her husband went with her as far as Bahurim, weeping while he went. Then Abner said to him, Go back. And he went back.
sentences.susu: A xa mɔri naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra han Baxurimi a wama, kɔnɔ Abeneri naxa a fala a bɛ, «Gbilen i xɔnyi.» Palatiyɛli naxa gbilen.

sentences.english: Then Abner had a talk with the chief men of Israel, saying, In the past it was your desire to make David your king: so now, do it:
sentences.susu: Abeneri nun Isirayila forie naxa e boore to. A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Singe wo nu wama nɛ Dawuda xa findi wo xa mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: For the Lord has said of David, By the hand of my servant David I will make my people Israel safe from the Philistines, and from all who are against them.
sentences.susu: A lanma wo xa a raba yakɔsi, barima Alatala a fala nɛ a xa fe ra, ‹N nan ma ɲama bama nɛ Filisitakae nun a yaxuie birin yi ra n ma konyi Dawuda nan saabui ra.›»

sentences.english: And Abner said the same things to Benjamin: and he went to David in Hebron to make clear to him what seemed good to Israel and to all the people of Benjamin.
sentences.susu: Abeneri naxa wɔyɛn Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛe fan bɛ. Na dangi xanbi, a naxa siga Hebiron a falafe ra Dawuda bɛ Isirayilakae nun Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ naxan natɛxi.

sentences.english: So Abner, with twenty men, came to Hebron, to David. And David made a feast for Abner and the men who were with him.
sentences.susu: Abeneri to siga Dawuda yire Hebiron, a tan nun mixi mɔxɔɲɛn, Dawuda naxa xulunyi ti a tan nun a xa mixie bɛ.

sentences.english: And Abner said to David, Now I will go, and make all Israel come to my lord the king, so that they may make an agreement with you, and your kingdom may be as wide as your heart's desire. Then David sent Abner away and he went in peace.
sentences.susu: Abeneri naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, «N marigi, tin n xa siga Isirayila birin xun lan, alako wo xa saatɛ xiri, birin xa lu i xa mangɛya bun ma, alɔ i wama a xɔnma ki naxɛ.» Dawuda naxa tin Abeneri xa masenyi ra, a naxa a lu a xa siga bɔɲɛsa kui.

sentences.english: Now the servants of David and Joab had been out attacking a band of armed men, and they came back with a great store of goods taken in the fight: but Abner was no longer in Hebron with David, for he had sent him away and he had gone in peace.
sentences.susu: A mu bu, Yowaba nun Dawuda xa sɔɔrie naxa fa see ra e naxee sɔtɔ gere nde kui. Abeneri mu nu na Dawuda yire Hebiron, barima Dawuda nu bara a bɛɲin bɔɲɛsa kui.

sentences.english: When Joab and his men came, news was given them that Abner, the son of Ner, had come to the king, who had let him go away again in peace.
sentences.susu: Yowaba nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa a kolon Neri xa di Abeneri nu bara fa mangɛ yire, a man fa siga bɔɲɛsa kui.

sentences.english: Then Joab came to the king, and said, What have you done? when Abner came to you why did you send him away and let him go?
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa siga mangɛ yire, a a fala a bɛ, «I munse rabaxi Abeneri to fa i yire? I a luxi munfe ra a xa siga bɔɲɛsa kui?

sentences.english: Is it not clear to you that Abner, the son of Ner, came with deceit to get knowledge of your going out and your coming in and of all you are doing?
sentences.susu: I mu a kolon Neri xa di Abeneri faxi i madaxude nun i rabɛnde nɛ?»

sentences.english: And when Joab had come out from David, he sent men after Abner, and they overtook him at the water-spring of Sirah, and made him come back with them: but David had no knowledge of it.
sentences.susu: Yowaba to keli Dawuda yire, a naxa mixie xɛɛ Abeneri fɔxɔ ra Sira ye kundi yire. E naxa fa a ra, kɔnɔ Dawuda mu nu fefe kolon.

sentences.english: And when Abner was back in Hebron, Joab took him on one side by the doorway of the town to have a word with him quietly, and there he gave him a wound in the stomach, causing his death in payment for the death of his brother Asahel.
sentences.susu: Abeneri to gbilen Hebiron, Yowaba naxa a mabɛndun a gundo ki ma taa naadɛ ra, alɔ a nɛ wama e xa e boore to. A naxa a sɔxɔ finɛ ra a furi ma mɛnni a xunya Asahɛli gbeɲɔxɔfe ra. Abeneri faxa na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And when David had word of it he said, May I and my kingdom be clear for ever in the eyes of the Lord from the blood of Abner, the son of Ner:
sentences.susu: Dawuda to na fe kolon, a naxa a fala, «Ala ya xɔri, Abeneri xa faxɛ mu findixi n ma kote ra, a mu findixi n ma mangɛya xa kote ra.

sentences.english: May it come on the head of Joab and all his father's family: among the men of Joab's family may there ever be some who are diseased or lepers, or who do the work of women, or are put to the sword, or are wasted from need of food!
sentences.susu: Yi faxɛ kote na Yowaba nun a bɔnsɔɛe nan xun ma! Kundi fure xa lu a bɔnsɔɛ mixi ndee ma abadan, xa na mu a ra, mabɛn fure, faxɛ ɲaaxi, ka kaamɛ.»

sentences.english: So Joab and Abishai his brother put Abner to death, because he had put to death their brother Asahel in the fight at Gibeon.
sentences.susu: Yowaba nun a taara Abisayi Abeneri faxa na ki nɛ, e xunya Asahɛli xa fe ra, naxan faxa gere kui Gabayon.

sentences.english: And David said to Joab and all the people who were with him, Go in grief and put haircloth about you, in sorrow for Abner. And King David went after the dead body.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Yowaba nun a xa sɔɔrie bɛ, a naxɛ, «Wo xa wo xa donmae ibɔɔ sunnunyi kui, wo xa ɲɔnfe dugi ragoro wo ma Abeneri xa faxɛ xa fe ra.» Mangɛ Dawuda naxa Abeneri fure mati gaburi dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And they put Abner's body to rest in Hebron; and the king and all the people were weeping loudly by the resting-place of Abner's body.
sentences.susu: E naxa Abeneri ragata Hebiron. Mangɛ Dawuda naxa wa a xui itexi ra, a nun ɲama birin.

sentences.english: And the king made a song of grief for Abner and said, Was the death of Abner to be like the death of a foolish man?
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa yi suuki ba a bɛ, a naxɛ, «Abeneri lan nɛ nu a xa faxa alɔ matandila nde?

sentences.english: Your hands were free, your feet were not chained: like the downfall of a man before evil men, so was your fall. And the weeping of the people over him went on again.
sentences.susu: I bɛlɛxɛe mu nu xirixi, i sanyie fan mu nu xirixi! I faxaxi nɛ, alɔ mixi tinxintare nde naxan ɲaxankatama.»

sentences.english: And the people came to make David take food, while it was still day, but David with an oath said, May God's punishment be on me if I take a taste of bread or any other thing till the sun has gone down!
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa wa Abeneri xa fe ra. Dawuda xa mixie to wa a xa a dɛge, Dawuda naxa a kali, a naxɛ, «Ala xa n xun nakana a ɲaaxi ra xa n nan n dɛgema beemanu soge dulama tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And all the people took note of it and were pleased: like everything the king did, it was pleasing to the people.
sentences.susu: Ɲama to Dawuda xa wɔyɛnyi mɛ, na naxa rafan e ma. Mangɛ Dawuda xa fe nu ɲama kɛnɛnma.

sentences.english: So it was clear to Israel and to all the people on that day that the king was not responsible for the death of Abner, the son of Ner.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa a kolon a Neri xa di Abeneri mu faxa mangɛ xa yaamari xa ma.

sentences.english: And the king said to his servants, Do you not see that a chief and a great man has come to his end today in Israel?
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala a xa mixie bɛ, a naxɛ, «N xa a fala wo bɛ, to kuntigi xungbe bara faxa Isirayila.

sentences.english: While I, though I am crowned king, have little strength, and these men, the sons of Zeruiah, are out of my control: may the Lord give to the evil-doer the reward of his evil-doing!
sentences.susu: Hali n to findixi wo xa mangɛ sugandixi ra, n sɛnbɛ bara xurun Seruya xa die ya i. Ala xa e xa wali ɲaaxi sare ragbilen e tan tinxintaree ma.»

sentences.english: And when Saul's son Ish-bosheth had news that Abner was dead in Hebron, his hands became feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa di Isiboseti to a mɛ, a Abeneri bara faxa Hebiron, limaniya naxa ba a yi, Isirayilakae fan naxa kɔntɔfili fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: And Saul's son had two men, captains of bands, one named Baanah and the other Rechab, sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, of the tribe of Benjamin; (for Beeroth was at one time taken to be part of Benjamin:
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri mangɛ firin nu na Sɔlu xa di yi ra. Keren nu xili Baana, boore nu xili Rekabu. Rimɔn Beerotika xa di xɛmɛe nan nu e ra. Beerotikae nu na Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ ya ma,

sentences.english: But the people of Beeroth had gone in flight to Gittaim, where they have been living to this day.)
sentences.susu: barima e e gixi nɛ, e sa dɔxɔ Gitayimi. Han to, e sabatixi mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: Now Jonathan, Saul's son, had a son whose feet were damaged. He was five years old when news of the death of Saul and Jonathan came from Jezreel, and the woman who took care of him took him up and went in flight: and while she was getting him away as quickly as she was able, he had a fall and his feet were damaged. His name was Mephibosheth.
sentences.susu: Di mabɛnxi keren nu na Sɔlu xa di Yonatan yi ra. A ɲɛ suuli nan nu a ra, Sɔlu nun Yonatan faxa tɛmui naxɛ Yisireeli. Ginɛ naxan nu xiɲɛ fima a ma, na naxa a tongo, a xa a gi. Na gbata kui, ginɛ naxa bira, na di sanyi naxa maxɔnɔ, a mabɛn. Na di nu xili nɛ Mefiboseti.

sentences.english: And Rechab and Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, went out and came to the house of Ish-bosheth in the heat of the day, when he was resting in the middle of the day. Now the woman who kept the door was cleaning grain, and sleep overcame her.
sentences.susu: Rimɔn xa di xɛmɛe Rekabu nun Baana naxa siga Isiboseti xɔnyi yanyi tagi. Isiboseti nu saxi, a nu a xife.

sentences.english: And Rechab and his brother Baanah got in without being seen.
sentences.susu: E naxa so banxi kui, alɔ e nu na donse nan fenfe, kɔnɔ e naxa so Isiboseti yire, e fa a furi sɔxɔ a xa faxa a xa sade ma. E to gɛ na rabade, Rekabu nun a taara Baana naxa e gi.

sentences.english: And when they came into the house, Ish-bosheth was stretched on his bed in his bedroom; and they made an attack on him and put him to death, and, cutting off his head, they took it with them and went by the road through the Arabah all night.
sentences.susu: E nu bara so Isiboseti xa banxi kui, e fa a li a saxi a xa sade ma a xa konkoe kui. E to gɛ a sɔxɔde, e a faxa, e naxa a xunyi bolon, e a xanin e xun ma. E naxa e ɲɛrɛ kɔɛ birin na Araba kira xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And they took the head of Ish-bosheth to David in Hebron, and said to the king, Here is the head of Ish-bosheth, the son of Saul your hater, who would have taken your life; the Lord has taken payment for the wrongs of my lord the king from Saul and his seed today.
sentences.susu: E naxa Isiboseti xunyi xanin Dawuda xɔn ma Hebiron, e fa a fala, «Mangɛ, Isiboseti xunyi nan yi ki, Sɔlu xa di xɛmɛ, i yaxui naxan nu wama i faxafe. N marigi, Alatala bara i gbeɲɔxɔ Sɔlu bɔnsɔɛ ma to.»

sentences.english: And David made answer to Rechab and his brother Baanah, the sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, and said to them, By the living Lord, who has kept me safe from all my trouble,
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Rimɔn Beerotika xa die Rekabu nun Baana yaabi, «N bara n kali Alatala ra, naxan n natanga tɔɔrɛ birin ma, n xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ.

sentences.english: When one came to me with the news of Saul's death, in the belief that it would be good news, I took him and put him to death in Ziklag, which was the reward I gave him for his news:
sentences.susu: Mixi nde to a fala n bɛ, a mangɛ Sɔlu bara faxa, na kanyi ɲɔxɔ nu a ma, a a xibaaru fanyi nan ibaxi n bɛ. Kɔnɔ n tan bara yaamari fi, e xa a suxu, e a faxa Sikilaga taa kui. A xa xibaaru sare nan na ki!

sentences.english: How much more, when evil men have put an upright person to death, in his house, sleeping on his bed, will I take payment from you for his blood, and have you cut off from the earth?
sentences.susu: Mixi kobie na tinxintɔɛ nde faxa a xa banxi kui, han a xa sade ma, a mu lan xɛ e fan xa na nii sare fi? N mu lan xɛ n xa na mixie xa fe ɲɔn yi duniɲa ma?»

sentences.english: And David gave orders to his young men and they put them to death, cutting off their hands and their feet and hanging them up by the side of the pool in Hebron. But they took the head of Ish-bosheth and put it in its last resting-place with Abner's body in Hebron.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a xa sɔɔrie yamari, e xa e faxa. E naxa e bɛlɛxɛe nun e sanyie bolon, e sa e furee singan Hebiron ye yire. Kɔnɔ e naxa Isiboseti tan xunyi tongo, e a ragata Abeneri xa gaburi kui Hebiron.

sentences.english: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David in Hebron and said, Truly, we are your bone and your flesh.
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin naxa fa Dawuda yire Hebiron, e fa a fala a bɛ, «Won birin bɔnsɔɛ keren.

sentences.english: In the past when Saul was king over us, it was you who went at the head of Israel when they went out or came in: and the Lord said to you, You are to be the keeper of my people Israel and their ruler.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa mangɛya bun ma, i tan nan nu Isirayila raɲɛrɛma e xa geree kui. Alatala a masenxi nɛ i bɛ, ‹I tan nan mɛɛnima n ma ɲama Isirayila ma, i tan nan findima e xa yarerati ra.›»

sentences.english: So all the responsible men of Israel came to the king at Hebron; and King David made an agreement with them in Hebron before the Lord: and they put the holy oil on David and made him king over Israel.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isirayila fori birin to fa mangɛ Dawuda yire Hebiron, e nun Dawuda naxa saatɛ xiri Ala ya xɔri. Forie naxa ture nde sa Dawuda xunyi ma tɔnxuma ra a e bara a sugandi a xa findi Isirayila mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: David was thirty years old when he became king, and he was king for forty years,
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ tongo saxan li na tɛmui. A xa mangɛya bu nɛ ɲɛ tongo naani.

sentences.english: Ruling over Judah in Hebron for seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem, over all Israel and Judah, for thirty-three years.
sentences.susu: A ɲɛ solofere kike senni nan naba mangɛya ra Hebiron Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xun ma. A ɲɛ tongo saxan nun saxan nan naba mangɛya ra Darisalamu Isirayila nun Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xun ma.

sentences.english: And the king and his men went to Jerusalem against the Jebusites, the people of the land: and they said to David, You will not come in here, but the blind and the feeble-footed will keep you out; for they said, David will not be able to come in here.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa siga Darisalamu alako e xa Yebusukae gere, naxee nu sabatixi mɛnni. Mɛnnikae naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, «I mu soma be feo. Hali dɔnxuie nun mabɛnyie nɔma i keride!» E ɲɔxɔ a ma a Dawuda mu nɔma sode naa.

sentences.english: But David took the strong place of Zion, which is the town of David.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Dawuda naxa nɔ e ra, a Siyoni taa sɛnbɛ yire masɔtɔ. Na nan a toxi, na taa xili falama «Dawuda xa taa.»

sentences.english: And that day David said, Whoever makes an attack on the Jebusites, let him go up by the water-pipe, and put to death all the blind and feeble-footed who are hated by David. And this is why they say, The blind and feeble-footed may not come into the house.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Dawuda naxa a fala, «Naxan wama yi Yebusukae masɔtɔfe, fo a xa so ye yire bɔxi nan bun ma. Na kui a nɔma Dawuda yaxuie ra naxee luma alɔ mabɛnyie nun dɔnxuie!» Na nan a ra, mixie nu a falama a dɔnxui nun mabɛnyi mu soma mangɛ xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: So David took the strong tower for his living-place, naming it the town of David. And David took in hand the building of the town all round, starting from the Millo.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to nɔ e ra, a naxa sabati na yire makantaxi kui, a fa na xili sa «Dawuda xa taa.» A naxa a rabilinyie birin ti, kelife Milo han taa mabiri.

sentences.english: And David became greater and greater; for the Lord, the God of armies, was with him.
sentences.susu: Dawuda sɛnbɛ nu gboma nan tui, barima Alatala Sɛnbɛma nu na a sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And Hiram, king of Tyre, sent men to David, with cedar-trees and woodworkers and stoneworkers: and they made David a house.
sentences.susu: Tire mangɛ Xirami naxa mixie xɛɛ Dawuda yire. E naxa sɛdiri wuri, banxi banbanyie, nun gɛmɛ masolie rasanba a ma, alako e xa mangɛ banxi ti a bɛ.

sentences.english: And David saw that the Lord had made his position safe as king over Israel, and that he had made his kingdom great because of his people Israel.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nu a kolon, a Alatala nan a tixi mangɛ ra Isirayila xun ma, a xa mangɛya xa sabati Alatala xa ɲama Isirayila xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And David took more women and wives in Jerusalem, after he had come from Hebron: and he had more sons and daughters.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to keli Hebiron, a naxa konyi ginɛe nun ginɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ Darisalamu, naxee bara die bari a bɛ.

sentences.english: These are the names of those whose birth took place in Jerusalem: Shammua and Shobab and Nathan and Solomon
sentences.susu: Na die xili nan yi ki, naxee barixi a bɛ Darisalamu: Samuwa, Sowa, Natan, Sulemani,

sentences.english: And Ibhar and Elishua and Nepheg and Japhia
sentences.susu: Yibixari, Elisuwa, Nefegi, Yafiya,

sentences.english: And Elishama and Eliada and Eliphelet.
sentences.susu: Elisama, Eliyada, Elifeleti.

sentences.english: And when the Philistines had news that David had been made king over Israel, they all went up in search of David; and David, hearing of it, went down to the strong place.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae to a mɛ, a e bara Dawuda sugandi Isirayila mangɛ ra, e birin naxa siga sɛnbɛ ra a fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ Dawuda to a mɛ, a fa goro a xa yire makantaxi.

sentences.english: And when the Philistines came, they went in every direction in the valley of Rephaim.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa fa, e naxa so Refa gulunba kui.

sentences.english: And David, desiring directions from the Lord, said, Am I to go up against the Philistines? will you give them up into my hands? And the Lord said, Go up, for I will certainly give up the Philistines into your hands.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Alatala maxɔrin, a naxɛ, «A lanma n xa siga Filisitakae gerede? I e sama nɛ n sagoe?» Alatala naxa a yaabi, «Siga, n e sama nɛ i bɛlɛxɛ.»

sentences.english: And David went to Baal-perazim, and overcame them there; and he said, The Lord has let the forces fighting against me be broken before me as a wall is broken by rushing waters. So that place was named Baal-perazim.
sentences.susu: Na kui Dawuda naxa siga, a e bɔnbɔ Baali Perasimi. A naxa a fala, «Alatala bara n yaxuie bɔnbɔ n ya ra, alɔ ye naxan bɔnbɔma xare ra diki ibɔɔma tɛmui naxɛ.» Na yire xili sa Baali Perasimi na nan ma.

sentences.english: And the Philistines, when they went in flight, did not take their images with them, and David and his men took them away.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa e xa kuyee lu mɛnni. Dawuda nun a xa mixie naxa nee birin xanin.

sentences.english: And the Philistines came up again, and went in every direction in the valley of Rephaim.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi Filisitakae man naxa te, e sa so Refa gulunba kui.

sentences.english: And when David went for directions to the Lord, he said, You are not to go up against them in front; but make a circle round them from the back and come on them opposite the spice-trees.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to Alatala maxɔrin, a naxa a yaabi, «I naxa te e ya ra de. I xa i mabilin e xanbi ra nɛ, i din e ra fɔtɔnyi ya ra.

sentences.english: Then at the sound of footsteps in the tops of the trees, go forward quickly, for the Lord has gone out before you to overcome the army of the Philistines.
sentences.susu: I na sanyi xui mɛ wurie kɔn na tɛmui naxɛ, i siga keren na Filisitakae fɔxɔ ra, barima a lima Alatala bara mini i ya ra e bɔnbɔde.»

sentences.english: And David did as the Lord had said; and he overcame the Philistines, attacking them from Gibeon to near Gezer.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a raba, alɔ Alatala a falaxi a bɛ ki naxɛ. A naxa Filisitakae bɔnbɔ, kelife Geba ma han Geseri.

sentences.english: And David got together all the fighting-men of Israel to the number of thirty thousand;
sentences.susu: Dawuda man naxa Isirayila sɔɔrie malan, e kɔnti naxa siga mixi wulu tongo saxan.

sentences.english: And David, and all the people who were with him, went to Baal of Judah to get the ark of God, over which the holy name is named, the name of the Lord of armies, whose place is between the winged ones.
sentences.susu: E naxa siga Bale Yuda, Ala xa kankira tongode, Alatala xili falama naxan xun, Alatala Sɛnbɛma magoroxi naxan ma malekɛe masolixie tagi.

sentences.english: And they put the ark of God on a new cart and took it out of the house of Abinadab which was on the hill: and Uzzah and Ahio, the sons of Abinadab, were the drivers of the cart.
sentences.susu: E naxa Ala xa kankira dɔxɔ sarɛti nɛɛnɛ nde fari, e fa e ɲɛrɛ a sɛɛti ma kelife Abinadabo xɔnyi geya fari. Abinadabo xa di xɛmɛe Usa nun Axiyo nan nu sarɛti nɛɛnɛ raɲɛrɛfe.

sentences.english: And Uzzah went by the side of the ark, while Ahio went before it.
sentences.susu: E naxa a raɲɛrɛ kelife Abinadabo xɔnyi geya fari. Axiyo nu ɲɛrɛfe sarɛti ya ra, Ala xa kankira nu na naxan fari.

sentences.english: And David and all the men of Israel made melody before the Lord with all their power, with songs and with corded instruments and instruments of brass.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun Isirayila ɲama nu na Alatala matɔxɔfe maxase mɔɔli birin na. Maxase wuri daaxie nun kɔra mɔɔli ndee nu na e yi ra.

sentences.english: And when they came to Nacon's grain-floor, Uzzah put his hand on the ark of God to keep it safe in its place, for the oxen were out of control.
sentences.susu: E to Nakon xa lɔnyi li, ningee naxa wa birafe. Na kui Usa naxa a bɛlɛxɛ itala, a Ala xa kankira suxu.

sentences.english: And the wrath of the Lord, burning against Uzzah, sent destruction on him because he had put his hand on the ark, and death came to him there by the ark of God.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa xɔnɔ a ma a xa na karinyi ma, a fa a sɔntɔ Alatala xa kankira fɛ ma.

sentences.english: And David was angry because of the Lord's outburst of wrath against Uzzah: and he gave that place the name Perez-uzzah, which is its name to this day.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa xɔnɔ Alatala Usa faxafe ra. E naxa na yire xili sa Peresi Usa. Naa xili falama na ki nɛ han to lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: And such was David's fear of the Lord that day, that he said, How may I let the ark of God come to me?
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa gaaxu Alatala ya ra na lɔxɔɛ, a a fala, «Alatala xa kankira fa soma n tan xɔnyi di?»

sentences.english: So David did not let the ark of the Lord come back to him to the town of David: but had it turned away and put into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
sentences.susu: A naxa natɛ tongo a a mu lanma a xa a raso a xa taa kui sinden, a xa a xanin Obedo Edon Gatika xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And the ark of the Lord was in the house of Obed-edom the Gittite for three months: and the Lord sent a blessing on Obed-edom and all his family.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa kankira naxa lu mɛnni han kike saxan. Na waxati bun ma, Alatala naxa baraka sa Obedo Edon nun a xa mixi birin ma.

sentences.english: And they said to King David, The blessing of the Lord is on the family of Obed-edom and on all he has, because of the ark of God. And David went and took the ark of God from the house of Obed-edom into the town of David with joy.
sentences.susu: E naxa sa na dɛntɛgɛ mangɛ Dawuda bɛ. E naxɛ, «Alatala bara duba Obedo Edon xa fɔxɛ bɛ Alatala xa kankira xa fe ra.» Na kui Dawuda naxa siga Obedo Edon xɔnyi, a sa Alatala xa kankira tongo, a a xanin sɛɛwɛ ra a xa taa kui.

sentences.english: And when those who were lifting the ark of the Lord had gone six steps, he made an offering of an ox and a fat young beast.
sentences.susu: Kankira xaninyie to santongo senni raba, Dawuda naxa tuura nun ninge bɔrɔgɛxi ba sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: And David, clothed in a linen ephod, was dancing before the Lord with all his strength.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nu na fare boronfe a sɛnbɛ birin na Alatala ya i, dugi fiixɛ ragoroxi a ma.

sentences.english: So David and all the men of Israel took up the ark of the Lord with cries of joy and sounding of horns.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun Isirayila ɲama naxa na kankira rasiga Darisalamu, e nu Alatala matɔxɔ sarae fe xui ra.

sentences.english: And when the ark of the Lord came into the town of David, Michal, Saul's daughter, looking out of the window, saw King David dancing and jumping before the Lord; and to her mind he seemed foolish.
sentences.susu: E nu kankira rasoma Dawuda xa taa kui tɛmui naxɛ, Sɔlu xa di ginɛ Mikali nu tixi wundɛri ra. A to Dawuda to fare boron na, Ala xa kankira ya ra, a bɔɲɛ naxa raɲaaxu a ma.

sentences.english: And they took in the ark of the Lord, and put it in its place inside the tent which David had put up for it: and David made burned offerings and peace-offerings to the Lord.
sentences.susu: E naxa Alatala xa kankira dɔxɔ kiri banxi bun ma Dawuda nu naxan tixi a bɛ. Na tɛmui Dawuda naxa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛe ba.

sentences.english: And after David had made the burned offerings and the peace-offerings, he gave the people a blessing in the name of the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ na sɛrɛxɛe bade, a naxa duba ɲama bɛ Alatala Sɛnbɛma xili ra.

sentences.english: And he gave to every man and woman among all the people, among all the masses of Israel, a cake of bread and a measure of wine and a cake of dry grapes. Then all the people went away, every man to his house.
sentences.susu: A naxa taami keren, tamaree, nun xɔrɛ maniyɛe fi ginɛ nun xɛmɛ birin ma, e fa gbilen e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Then David came back to give a blessing to his family. And Michal, Saul's daughter, came out to him and said, How full of glory was the king of Israel today, who let himself be seen uncovered by his servant-girls like a foolish person uncovering himself without shame!
sentences.susu: Dawuda to gbilen a xɔnyi, a xa sa duba a xa denbaya bɛ, Mikali naxa a ralan, a a fala a bɛ, «I tan, Isirayila mangɛ, i tan nan fare boronfe i mageli ra i xa konyie nun e xa ginɛe ya i yi ki, alɔ sɛgɛtala xurutare nde, i mu yaagi?»

sentences.english: And David said to Michal, I was dancing before the Lord, who put me over your father and all his sons, to make me a ruler over the people of the Lord, over his people Israel: and I will go on playing before the Lord;
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a yaabi, a naxɛ, «N a rabaxi Alatala nan bɛ, naxan n sugandi, a n nafisa i baba nun a bɔnsɔɛ birin bɛ, a n findi a xa ɲama Isirayila mangɛ ra. N matɔxɔɛ nan tife Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And I will do even worse than this, and make myself even lower in your eyes: but the servant-girls of whom you were talking will give me honour.
sentences.susu: N bara tin nde xa sa na fari, n man xa n yɛtɛ magoro a bɛ. Na konyi ginɛe i naxee xa fe fala, nee fan n binyama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And Michal, Saul's daughter, had no child till the day of her death.
sentences.susu: Na na a ra, Sɔlu xa di ginɛ Mikali mu di yo bari a xa simaya kui.

sentences.english: Now when the king was living in his house, and the Lord had given him rest from war on every side;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda to gɛ sabatide a xa mangɛ banxi kui, a yaxui naxee birin a rabilinyie naxa lu a bun ma Alatala saabui ra,

sentences.english: The king said to Nathan the prophet, See now, I am living in a house of cedar, but the ark of God is housed inside the curtains of a tent.
sentences.susu: a naxa a fala Annabi Natan bɛ, a naxɛ, «A mato ba, n tan sabatixi sɛdiri wuri banxi fanyi nan kui yi ki, kɔnɔ Ala xa seede kankira tan na kiri banxi nan bun ma.»

sentences.english: And Nathan said to the king, Go and do whatever is in your heart; for the Lord is with you.
sentences.susu: Natan naxa mangɛ yaabi, a naxɛ, «Naxan birin na i bɔɲɛ ma, a birin naba, Alatala na i fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: Now that night the word of the Lord came to Nathan, saying,
sentences.susu: Na kɔɛ ra, Alatala naxa a masen Natan bɛ,

sentences.english: Go and say to my servant David, The Lord says, Are you to be the builder of a house, a living-place for me?
sentences.susu: «Siga, a fala n ma konyi Dawuda bɛ, ‹Alatala yi nan masenxi, a n xa a fala i bɛ, «I tan nan banxi tima n bɛ n sabatima dɛnnaxɛ?

sentences.english: For from the day when I took the children of Israel up out of Egypt till this day, I have had no house, but have gone from place to place in a tent.
sentences.susu: Kabi n naxa Isirayila ramini Misira, han to, n mu lu banxi kui. N bara n ɲɛrɛ n ma hɔrɔmɔlingira kui naxan findixi kiri banxi ra.

sentences.english: In all the places where I went with all the children of Israel, did I ever say to any of the judges of Israel, to whom I gave the care of my people Israel, Why have you not made me a house of cedar?
sentences.susu: N ɲɛrɛ naxan birin naba n nun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe ra, n mu a fala n ma mixi sugandixi yo bɛ, munfe ra i mu banxi ti n bɛ sɛdiri wuri ra?»›»

sentences.english: Then say these words to my servant David, The Lord of armies says, I took you from the fields, from keeping the sheep, so that you might be a ruler over my people, over my people Israel:
sentences.susu: «I xa a fala n ma konyi Dawuda bɛ, ‹Alatala Sɛnbɛma xa masenyi nan yi ki: N tan nan i tongo xuruse dɛmadon wali kui, n i findi n ma ɲama Isirayila mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And I have been with you wherever you went, cutting off before you all those who were against you; and I will make your name great, like the name of the greatest ones of the earth.
sentences.susu: N bara i kanta i xa ɲɛrɛ birin kui, n bara i yaxui birin sɔntɔ. Yakɔsi n i findima nɛ xili xungbe kanyi ra duniɲa kuntigie ya ma.

sentences.english: And I will make a resting-place for my people Israel, planting them there, so that they may be living in the place which is theirs, and never again be moved; and never again will they be troubled by evil men as they were at the first,
sentences.susu: N bɔxi fima n ma ɲama Isirayila ɲama ma e sabatima dɛnnaxɛ, e fa lu bɔɲɛsa kui abadan. Mixi kobi mu e tɔɔrɔma sɔnɔn alɔ tɛmui dangixi.

sentences.english: From the time when I put judges over my people Israel; and I will give you peace from all who are against you. And the Lord says to you that he will make you the head of a line of kings.
sentences.susu: Keli n kiitisae dɔxɔ tɛmui naxɛ n ma ɲama Isirayila xun na, han ya n i yaxui birin safe nɛ i sagoe.›» «‹Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Alatala yati bɔnsɔɛ fima nɛ i ma.

sentences.english: And when the time comes for you to go to rest with your fathers, I will put in your place your seed after you, the offspring of your body, and I will make his kingdom strong.
sentences.susu: I xa simaya na kamali, i fa i benbae li aligiyama, n a niyama nɛ i xa di xa findi mangɛ ra i ɲɔxɔɛ ra, n fa a xa mangɛya mabanban.

sentences.english: He will be the builder of a house for my name, and I will make the seat of his authority certain for ever.
sentences.susu: A fama n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi tide, n a xa mangɛya mabanbanma nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: I will be to him a father and he will be to me a son: if he does wrong, I will give him punishment with the rod of men and with the blows of the children of men;
sentences.susu: N findima a baba nan na, a fan findi n ma di ra. A na ba n ma kira xɔn ma, n a ɲaxankatama nɛ mixie saabui ra.

sentences.english: But my mercy will not be taken away from him, as I took it from him who was before you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n ma hinnɛ mu bama a ma, alɔ n a ba Sɔlu ma ki naxɛ, n naxan igoroxi i ya i.

sentences.english: And your family and your kingdom will keep their place before me for ever: the seat of your authority will never be overturned.
sentences.susu: I bɔnsɔɛ nun i xa mangɛya mabanbanma nɛ abadan, i xa kibanyi dɔxɔma nɛ tɛmui birin.›»
