sentences.english: So Nathan gave David an account of all these words and this vision.
sentences.susu: Natan naxa Ala xa masenyi birin dɛntɛgɛ Dawuda bɛ.

sentences.english: Then David the king went in and took his seat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my family, that you have been my guide till now?
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, mangɛ Dawuda naxa a magoro Alatala ya i, a a masen a bɛ, «N Marigi Alatala, munfe ra i n tan nun n xabilɛ xa fe itexi yi ki?

sentences.english: And this was only a small thing to you, O Lord God; but your words have even been about the far-off future of your servant's family, O Lord God!
sentences.susu: I man bara a fala e xa fe fama itede yare. N Marigi Alatala, i darixi na mɔɔli raba ra Adama di nan bɛ?

sentences.english: What more may David say to you? for you have knowledge of your servant, O Lord God.
sentences.susu: N tan Dawuda, i xa konyi, n nɔma munse falade i bɛ? I n bɔɲɛ birin kolon.

sentences.english: Because of your word and from your heart, you have done all this great work, and let your servant see it.
sentences.susu: I bara yi fe xungbe raba i xa laayidi nun i ɲanige xa fe ra, i fa a masen n tan i xa konyi bɛ.

sentences.english: Truly you are great, O Lord God: there is no one like you and no other God but you, as is clear from everything which has come to our ears.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala, i sɛnbɛ gbo, i maniyɛ mu na. Ala gbɛtɛ yo mu na bafe i tan na. Muxu na nan mɛxi muxu tuli ra.

sentences.english: And what other nation in the earth, like your people Israel, did a god go out to take for himself, to be his people, and to make a name for himself, and to do great and strange things for them, driving out a nation and its gods from before his people?
sentences.susu: Bɔnsɔɛ mundun na yi duniɲa ma naxan luxi alɔ Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ, i xa ɲama sugandixi? I tan Ala bara na si kerenyi xun sara i yɛtɛ bɛ, e fa findi matɔxɔɛ ra i bɛ. I tan bara kaabanakoe raba e bɛ, i fa sie nun e xa alae keri i xa ɲama ya ra, i naxan xun saraxi Misira.

sentences.english: But you took and made strong for yourself your people Israel, to be your people for ever; and you, Lord, became their God.
sentences.susu: I bara sɛnbɛ so i xa ɲama Isirayila yi ra, alako a xa findi i xa ɲama ra abadan, i fan xa findi e Marigi Ala ra.»

sentences.english: And now, O Lord God, may the word which you have said about your servant and about his family, be made certain for ever, and may you do as you have said!
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi, n Marigi Alatala, i xa i xa laayidi rakamali n bɛ. I naxan fala n xabilɛ xa fe ra, i xa na ragiri abadan.

sentences.english: And let your name be made great for ever, and let men say, The Lord of armies is God over Israel: and let the family of David your servant be made strong before you!
sentences.susu: I xili xa ite abadan! Mixie xa a fala, ‹Alatala Sɛnbɛma findixi Isirayila Marigi nan na! I xa sɛnbɛ fi i xa konyi Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ ma!›

sentences.english: For you, O Lord of armies, the God of Israel, have clearly said to your servant, I will make you the head of a family of kings: and so it has come into your servant's heart to make this prayer to you.
sentences.susu: I tan yati, Isirayila Marigi Alatala Sɛnbɛma, i bara a masen n bɛ, ‹N bɔnsɔɛ fima nɛ i ma.› Na nan a ra, n tan i xa konyi bara limaniya sɔtɔ n xa yi maxandi ti i ma.

sentences.english: And now, O Lord God, you are God and your words are true and you have said you will give your servant this good thing;
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, n Marigi Alatala, i tan nan na Ala ra. Nɔndi nan i xa masenyi ra. I bara i xa hinnɛ masen n bɛ.

sentences.english: So may it be your pleasure to give your blessing to the family of your servant, so that it may go on for ever before you: (for you, O Lord God, have said it,) and may your blessing be on your servant's family line for ever!
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, baraka sa n xabilɛ ma, alako e xa ti i ya tode ra abadan. I tan, n Marigi Alatala, i tan nan wɔyɛnxi. I xa masenyi nan a niyama n bɔnsɔɛ baraka sɔtɔma abadan.»

sentences.english: And it came about after this that David made an attack on the Philistines and overcame them; and David took the authority of the mother-town from the hands of the Philistines.
sentences.susu: Na birin dangi xanbi, Dawuda naxa Filisitakae bɔnbɔ, a e lu a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: And he overcame the Moabites, and he had them measured with a line when they were stretched out on the earth; marking out two lines for death and one full line for life. So the Moabites became servants to David and gave him offerings.
sentences.susu: A naxa Mowabakae fan bɔnbɔ. Mixi naxee suxu, a naxa nee itaxun dɔxɔ saxan, a fa dɔxɔ firin faxa. Mowabakae naxa lu Dawuda xa nɔɛ bun ma, e nu fa duuti fi a ma.

sentences.english: And David overcame Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, when he went to make his power seen by the River.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to gere ti Efirati xure longori, a naxa Rexobo xa di Hadadeseri bɔnbɔ, naxan findixi Soba mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And David took from him one thousand, seven hundred horsemen and twenty thousand footmen: and David had the leg-muscles of the horses cut, only keeping enough of them for a hundred war-carriages.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Hadadeseri xa soe ragi mixi wulu keren kɛmɛ solofere suxu, a nun sɔɔri mixi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn. A naxa soe birin san fasɛ raxaba, bafe soe kɛmɛ ɲɔndɔn a naxee ragata a yɛtɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: And when the Aramaeans of Damascus came to the help of Hadadezer, king of Zobah, David put to the sword twenty-two thousand of the Aramaeans.
sentences.susu: Aramikae naxa keli e xɔnyi Damasi, e xa Hadadeseri Soba mangɛ mali, kɔnɔ Dawuda naxa e xa mixi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin sɔntɔ.

sentences.english: And David put armed forces in Aram of Damascus: and the Aramaeans became servants to David and gave him offerings. And the Lord made David overcome wherever he went.
sentences.susu: Na kui Dawuda naxa a xa sɔɔrie rasabati Damasi, Aramikae fa lu a xa yaamari bun ma, e duuti fi. Alatala nu Dawuda xun nakelima yire birin.

sentences.english: And David took their gold body-covers from the servants of Hadadezer and took them to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa kanke makantase xɛɛma daaxi gbegbe ba Hadadeseri xa mixie yi ra, a e xanin Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And from Tebah and Berothai, towns of Hadadezer, King David took a great store of brass.
sentences.susu: A naxa wure gbeeli gbegbe fan tongo Betaxa nun Berotayi, Hadadeseri xa taae.

sentences.english: And when Tou, king of Hamath, had news that David had overcome all the army of Hadadezer,
sentences.susu: Xamata mangɛ Tohu to a mɛ, a Dawuda bara Hadadeseri xa sɔɔrie birin bɔnbɔ,

sentences.english: He sent his son Hadoram to David, with words of peace and blessing, because he had overcome Hadadezer in the fight, for Hadadezer had wars with Tou; and Hadoram took with him vessels of silver and gold and brass:
sentences.susu: a naxa a xa di Yorami xɛɛ mangɛ Dawuda yire, a xa sa a xɛɛbu, a man xa a tantu Hadadeseri gerefe nun a bɔnbɔfe ra. Yorami naxa a sanba gbeti, xɛɛma, nun wure gbeeli ra.

sentences.english: These King David made holy to the Lord, together with the silver and gold which he had taken from the nations he had overcome —
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda naxa na birin fi Alatala ma. A nu luma na raba ra xɛɛma nun gbeti birin na a naxan sɔtɔma gere kui a yaxuie yi ra,

sentences.english: The nations of Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon and the Philistines and the Amalekites and the goods he had taken from Hadadezer, the son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
sentences.susu: alɔ Aramikae, Mowabakae, Amonikae, Filisitakae, Amalɛkikae, nun Rexobo xa di Hadadeseri Soba mangɛ.

sentences.english: And David got great honour for himself, when he came back, by the destruction of Edom in the valley of Salt, to the number of eighteen thousand men.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra Dawuda naxa xili xungbe sɔtɔ a to Aramikae bɔnbɔ Fɔxɛ Gulunba, a mixi wulu fu nun solomasaxan sɔntɔ dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And he put armed forces in Edom; all through Edom he had armed forces stationed, and all the Edomites became servants to David. And the Lord made David overcome wherever he went.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa sɔɔrie rasabati Edon bɔxi birin ma. Mɛnni nu na Dawuda xa yaamari nan bun ma, barima Alatala nu xun nakeli fima a ma yire birin.

sentences.english: And David was king over all Israel, judging and giving right decisions for all his people.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a xa ɲama Isirayila yamari tinxinyi nun nɔndi ra.

sentences.english: And Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the army; and Jehoshaphat, the son of Ahilud, was keeper of the records;
sentences.susu: Seruya xa di Yowaba nan nu na Dawuda xa sɔɔrie xa mangɛ ra. Axiludu xa di Yehosafati nan nu na mangɛ xa kɛɛdi ragatama ra.

sentences.english: And Zadok and Abiathar, the son of Ahimelech, the son of Ahitub, were priests; and Seraiah was the scribe;
sentences.susu: Axituba xa di Sadɔki nun Abiyatari xa di Aximeleki nan nu na sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie ra.

sentences.english: And Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were priests.
sentences.susu: Seraya nan nu na Dawuda xa sɛbɛliti ra. Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya nan nu na Keretikae nun Peletakae xa mangɛ ra. Dawuda xa di xɛmɛe fan nu walima e baba xa mangɛya kui.

sentences.english: And David said, Is there still anyone of Saul's family living, so that I may be a friend to him, because of Jonathan?
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa maxɔrinyi ti, a naxɛ, «Sɔlu xabilɛ mixi nde na na, n nɔma hinnɛde naxan na Yonatan xa fe ra?»

sentences.english: Now there was of Saul's people a servant named Ziba, and they sent him to David; and the king said to him, Are you Ziba? And he said, I am.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa konyi nde nu na naxan xili Siba. E to fa a ra Dawuda yire, mangɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «I tan nan xili Siba?» A naxɛ, «Iyo mangɛ, n tan nan a ra, i xa konyi di.»

sentences.english: And the king said, Is there anyone of Saul's family still living, to whom I may be a friend in God's name? And Ziba said, There is a son of Jonathan, whose feet are damaged.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «Mixi gbɛtɛ mu na Sɔlu xabilɛ ya ma n nɔma hinnɛde naxan na?» A naxa mangɛ yaabi, a naxɛ, «Yonatan xa di xɛmɛ keren na na, naxan sanyi mabɛnxi.»

sentences.english: And the king said to him, Where is he? And Ziba said to the king, He is in the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel, in Lo-debar.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «A na minden?» Siba naxa a fala, «A na Amiyɛli xa di Makiri xɔnyi Lodebara taa kui.»

sentences.english: Then King David sent, and had him taken from Lo-debar, from the house of Machir, the son of Ammiel.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda naxa a xɛɛ Amiyɛli xa di Makiri fende Lodebara taa kui.

sentences.english: And Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, came to David, and falling down on his face, gave him honour. And David said, Mephibosheth. And answering he said, Your servant is here.
sentences.susu: Yonatan xa di Mefiboseti, Sɔlu xa mamadi to Dawuda yire li, a naxa a yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma. Dawuda naxa a xɛɛbu, «Mefiboseti.» Mefiboseti naxa a ratin, «N tan nan ya, i xa konyi di.»

sentences.english: And David said to him, Have no fear: for truly I will be good to you, because of your father Jonathan, and I will give back to you all the land which was Saul's; and you will have a place at my table at all times.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala a bɛ, a naxɛ, «Hali i mu gaaxu, a kolon n wama hinnɛfe i ra i baba Yonatan xa fe ra. N Sɔlu xa bɔxie birin nagbilenma nɛ i ma. A xɔli n ma i xa i dɛge n xɔnyi lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ.»

sentences.english: And he went down on his face before the king, and said, What is your servant, for you to take note of a dead dog such as I am?
sentences.susu: Mefiboseti man naxa a yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma, a a fala, «I wama n ma fe fanyi xɔnma munfe ra? N tide mu dangi hali bare faxaxi nde yati ra.»

sentences.english: Then the king sent for Ziba, Saul's servant, and said to him, All the property of Saul and of his family I have given to your master's son.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui mangɛ naxa Siba xili, a a fala a bɛ, «N bara Sɔlu nun a xa die xa se birin fi i marigi Yonatan xa di ma.

sentences.english: And you and your sons and your servants are to take care of the land for him, and get in the fruit of it, so that your master's son may have food: but Mephibosheth, your master's son, will have a place at my table at all times. Now Ziba had fifteen sons and twenty servants.
sentences.susu: I tan, i xa die, nun wo xa konyie, wo xa xɛ sa a bɛ, alako a xa baloe sɔtɔ. I marigi xa di Mefiboseti fama a dɛgɛde n xɔnyi lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ.» Di xɛmɛ fu nun suuli nun konyi mɔxɔɲɛn nan nu na Siba yi ra.

sentences.english: Then Ziba said to the king, Every order which you have given to your servant will be done. As for Mephibosheth, he had a place at David's table, like one of the king's sons.
sentences.susu: Siba naxa a fala mangɛ bɛ, a naxɛ, «Mangɛ, n i xa yaamari rabama nɛ alɔ i a falaxi n bɛ ki naxɛ.» Dawuda nu bara a fala, a Mefiboseti a dɛgema mangɛ xɔnyi alɔ mangɛ xa die a rabama ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And Mephibosheth had a young son named Mica. And all the people living in the house of Ziba were servants to Mephibosheth.
sentences.susu: Di lanma di nde nu na Mefiboseti yi ra, a xili Mike. Siba xa mixie birin nu walima Mefiboseti bɛ.

sentences.english: So Mephibosheth went on living in Jerusalem; for he took all his meals at the king's table; and he had not the use of his feet.
sentences.susu: Mefiboseti nu sabatixi Darisalamu nɛ, tɛmui birin a nu a dɛgema mangɛ xɔnyi nɛ. A sanyi firinyie nu mabɛnxi.

sentences.english: Now after this, death came to the king of the children of Ammon, and Hanun, his son, became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Na to dangi, Amonikae xa mangɛ naxa faxa, a xa di Xanun naxa findi mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And David said, I will be a friend to Hanun, the son of Nahash, as his father was a friend to me. So David sent his servants, to give him words of comfort on account of his father. And David's servants came into the land of the children of Ammon.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala, «N hinnɛma nɛ Naxasa xa di Xanun na, alɔ a baba a rabaxi n tan bɛ ki naxɛ.» Na kui Dawuda naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ, e xa sa ɲɔn xɛɛbui ti a baba xa faxɛ ma. Dawuda xa xɛɛrae to Amoni bɔxi li,

sentences.english: But the chiefs of the children of Ammon said to Hanun their lord, Does it seem to you that David is honouring your father by sending comforters to you? has he not sent his servants to go through the town and make secret observation of it, and overcome it?
sentences.susu: kuntigie naxa a fala Xanun bɛ, e naxɛ, «I ɲɔxɔ a ma a Dawuda yi mixie xɛɛxi i baba xa ɲɔnfe nan kunfa bade? E faxi i xa bɔxi rabɛnde nɛ, alako Dawuda xa be kana.»

sentences.english: So Hanun took David's servants, and after cutting off half the hair on their chins, and cutting off the skirts of their robes up to the middle, he sent them away.
sentences.susu: Na kui Xanun naxa Dawuda xa xɛɛrae suxu, a e dɛxabe sɛɛti bi, a e xa donmae ibɔɔ e xɔrɛ yailanyi ma, a e keri e mageli ra yaagi kui.

sentences.english: When David had news of it, he sent men out with the purpose of meeting them on their way, for the men were greatly shamed: and the king said, Go to Jericho till your hair is long again, and then come back.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to a mɛ e naxan nabaxi, a naxa mixie rasiga a xa xɛɛrae ralande, e a fala e bɛ, «Wo xa lu Yeriko, han wo dɛ xabee xa mini. Na tɛmui, wo xa fa.» A na raba e xa yaagi xa fe nan ma.

sentences.english: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves hated by David, they sent to the Aramaeans of Beth-rehob and Zobah, and got for payment twenty thousand footmen, and they got from the king of Maacah a thousand men, and from Tob twelve thousand.
sentences.susu: Amonikae naxa a kolon, a e xa fe bara raɲaaxu Dawuda ma. Na kui e naxa sɔɔrie malan kelife yire wuyaxi: mixi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn kelife Beti Rexobo nun Soba Arami bɔxi ma, mixi wulu keren Maaka mangɛ xa bɔxi ma, nun mixi wulu fu nun firin Tobo xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And hearing of this, David sent Joab and all the army and the best fighting-men.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to na fe mɛ, a naxa Yowaba nun a xa sɔɔrie rasiga na gere sode.

sentences.english: And the children of Ammon came out and put their forces in position at the way into the town: and the Aramaeans of Zobah and of Rehob, with the men of Tob and Maacah, were by themselves in the field.
sentences.susu: Amonikae naxa ti a gere ki ma e xa taa sode dɛ ra. Aramika naxee tan kelixi Soba nun Beti Rexobo, sa sɔɔrie xun ma naxee keli Tobo nun Maaka, nee naxa lu e xati ma taa fari ma.

sentences.english: Now when Joab saw that their forces were in position against him in front and at his back, he took the best of the men of Israel and put them in line against the Aramaeans;
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa a to gere tixi a bɛ yare nun xanbi. A naxa a xa sɔɔri sɛnbɛmae ti Aramikae ya ra,

sentences.english: And the rest of the people he put in position against the children of Ammon, with Abishai, his brother, at their head.
sentences.susu: a booree ti Amonikae ya ra, a xunya Abisayi xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: And he said, If the Aramaeans are stronger and get the better of me, then you are to come to my help; but if the children of Ammon get the better of you, I will come to your help.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a xunya bɛ, «Won xa won boore sɛnbɛ so. Aramikae sɛnbɛ na gbo n bɛ, i fa n mali, kɔnɔ n fan xa Amonikae sɛnbɛ sa gbo i bɛ, n sigama nɛ i malide.

sentences.english: Take heart, and let us be strong for our people and for the towns of our God, and may the Lord do what seems good to him.
sentences.susu: I xa limaniya, i xa sɛnbɛ so. Won xa gere so won ma mixie nun won Marigi Ala xa taae bɛ. Alatala fama a sago rabade.»

sentences.english: Then Joab and the people with him went forward to the fight against the Aramaeans, and they went in flight before him.
sentences.susu: Yowaba nun a xa sɔɔrie to makɔrɛ Aramikae ra, e naxa e gi a ya ra.

sentences.english: And when the children of Ammon saw the flight of the Aramaeans, they themselves went in flight from Abishai, and came into the town. So Joab went back from fighting the children of Ammon and came to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Amonikae to na to, e fan naxa e gi Abisayi ya ra, e so taa kui. Na gere dangi xanbi, Yowaba naxa gbilen Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And when the Aramaeans saw that Israel had overcome them, they got themselves together.
sentences.susu: Aramikae to a to, a Isirayilakae bara e bɔnbɔ, e man naxa e sɛnbɛ birin xunlan.

sentences.english: And Hadadezer sent for the Aramaeans who were on the other side of the River: and they came to Helam, with Shobach, the captain of Hadadezer's army, at their head.
sentences.susu: Hadadeseri naxa Aramika gbɛtɛe xili kelife Efirati naakiri ma, e fa Hadadeseri xa sɔɔri mangɛ Sobaki li Xelama taa kui.

sentences.english: And word of this was given to David: and he got all Israel together and went over Jordan and came to Helam. And the Aramaeans put their forces in position against David, and made an attack on him.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to na kolon, a naxa Isirayilakae birin xunlan, e naxa giri Yurudɛn xure naakiri ma, e siga Xelama. Aramikae naxa ti Dawuda ya ra, e fa a gere.

sentences.english: And the Aramaeans went in flight before Israel; and David put to the sword the men of seven hundred Aramaean war-carriages and forty thousand footmen, and Shobach, the captain of the army, was wounded, and came to his death there.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Aramikae mu nɔ a ra, e naxa e gi Isirayila ya ra. Dawuda naxa e xa soe ragi wulu tongo naani faxa, a nun sɔɔri wulu tongo naani. A naxa e xa sɔɔri mangɛ Sobaki fan bɔnbɔ, a naxa faxa mɛnni.

sentences.english: And when all the kings who were servants of Hadadezer saw that they were overcome by Israel, they made peace with Israel and became their servants. So the Aramaeans, in fear, gave no more help to the children of Ammon.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxee birin nu na Hadadeseri malife, nee to a to Isirayila bara e bɔnbɔ, e naxa saatɛ xiri e nun Dawuda ra, e fa lu a xa yaamari bun ma. Kabi na waxati, Aramikae mu suusa Amonikae malide sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Now in the spring, at the time when kings go out to war, David sent Joab and his servants and all Israel with him; and they made waste the land of the children of Ammon, and took up their position before Rabbah, shutting it in. But David was still at Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Na ɲɛ igbilenyi, mangɛe nu geree tima waxati naxɛ, Dawuda naxa Yowaba nun Isirayila sɔɔrie xɛɛ Amonikae gerede, a nun Raba taa suxude. Kɔnɔ Dawuda tan naxa lu Darisalamu.

sentences.english: Now one evening, David got up from his bed, and while he was walking on the roof of the king's house, he saw from there a woman bathing; and the woman was very beautiful.
sentences.susu: Nunmare nde, Dawuda naxa keli a xa sade ma, a siga a maɲɛrɛde a xa koore banxi fari. Kelife na yire itexi, a naxa ginɛ tofanyi nde to, a na a maxafe.

sentences.english: And David sent to get knowledge who the woman was. And one said, Is this not Bath-sheba, the daughter of Eliam and wife of Uriah the Hittite?
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa mixi nde xɛɛ a xa fe maxɔrinde. A naxa fa a fala a bɛ, a Eliyami xa di Batiseba nan a ra, naxan dɔxɔxi Uri Xitika xɔn.

sentences.english: And David sent and took her; and she came to him, and he took her to his bed: (for she had been made clean;) then she went back to her house.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa mixie xɛɛ, e xa a xili. A to fa, Dawuda naxa a kolon ginɛ ra. Na dangi xanbi, Batiseba naxa gbilen a xɔnyi. Na tɛmui a nu baxi gɛde a xa kike wali ra.

sentences.english: And the woman became with child; and she sent word to David that she was with child.
sentences.susu: Batiseba to a kolon a bara tɛɛgɛ, a naxa na fala Dawuda bɛ, a naxɛ, «N bara furi tongo.»

sentences.english: And David sent to Joab saying, Send Uriah the Hittite to me. And Joab sent Uriah to David.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Dawuda naxa Yowaba yamari, a xa Uri Xitika rafa a tan Dawuda ma keli gere yire. Yowaba naxa na raba,

sentences.english: And when Uriah came to him, David put questions to him about how Joab and the people were, and how the war was going.
sentences.susu: Uri naxa siga Dawuda yire. Dawuda naxa maxɔrinyi ndee ti a ma Yowaba nun a xa sɔɔrie xa fe ra, naxee nu na gere sofe.

sentences.english: And David said to Uriah, Go down to your house and let your feet be washed. And Uriah went away from the king's house, and an offering from the king was sent after him.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Dawuda naxa a fala Uri bɛ, «Siga i xɔnyi, i xa sa i maxa.» Uri to keli mangɛ banxi sigafe a xɔnyi, Dawuda naxa se fanyi nde rasanba a ma.

sentences.english: But Uriah took his rest at the door of the king's house, with all the servants of his lord, and did not go down to his house.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Uri mu gbilen a xɔnyi. A naxa xi mangɛ xa buntunyi kui mangɛ makantɛe ya ma.

sentences.english: And when word was given to David that Uriah had not gone down to his house, David said to Uriah, Have you not come from a journey? why did you not go down to your house?
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba mixi nde naxa sa a fala Dawuda bɛ, «Uri mu siga a xɔnyi.» Na kui, Dawuda naxa Uri xili, a a maxɔrin, «Munfe ra i mu gbilen i xɔnyi? I mu kelixi biyaasi xɛ?»

sentences.english: And Uriah said to David, Israel and Judah with the ark are living in tents, and my lord Joab and the other servants of my lord are sleeping in the open field; and am I to go to my house and take food and drink, and go to bed with my wife? By the living Lord, and by the life of your soul, I will not do such a thing.
sentences.susu: Uri naxa a yaabi, «Alatala xa saatɛ kankira, Isirayila, nun Yudaya sɔɔrie, nun n marigi Yowaba, e birin na leele bun ma gere yire. A lanma n tan xa so n xɔnyi, n xa n dɛge, n xa n min, n nun n ma ginɛ xa kafu na kui? N bara n kali i xa simaya yati ra, n mu na fe mɔɔli rabama.»

sentences.english: And David said to Uriah, Be here today, and after that I will let you go. So Uriah was in Jerusalem that day and the day after.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a yaabi, «I xa lu be to. Tina n i bɛɲinma nɛ.» Na kui Uri naxa lu Darisalamu na xi firinyi.

sentences.english: And when David sent for him, he took meat and drink with him, and David made him the worse for drink: and when evening came, he went to rest on his bed with the servants of his lord, but he did not go down to his house.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a xili a xa a dɛge a xɔnyi. Na tɛmui Dawuda naxa a rasiisi, kɔnɔ na kɔɛ ra Uri mu siga a xɔnyi. A man naxa xi mangɛ makantɛe ya ma.

sentences.english: Now in the morning, David gave Uriah a letter to take to Joab.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Dawuda naxa bataaxɛ sɛbɛ Yowaba ma, a a so Uri yi ra.

sentences.english: And in the letter he said, Take care to put Uriah in the very front of the line, where the fighting is most violent, and go back from him, so that he may be overcome and put to death.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi na bataaxɛ kui, «Wo xa Uri ti yire nde gere xɔrɔxɔxi dɛnnaxɛ. Gere kui wo xa wo magbilen wo keli a xun, alako a xa faxa na gere kui.»

sentences.english: So while Joab was watching the town, he put Uriah in the place where it was clear to him the best fighters were.
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa Uri ti yire nde a a kolon gere xɔrɔxɔxi dɛnnaxɛ ki fanyi.

sentences.english: And the men of the town went out and had a fight with Joab: and a number of David's men came to their death in the fight, and with them Uriah the Hittite.
sentences.susu: Taakae to mini Yowaba xili ma, Dawuda xa mixi ndee naxa sɔntɔ. Uri Xitika nu na nee ya ma.

sentences.english: Then Joab sent David news of everything which had taken place in the war:
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa xɛɛra xɛɛ Dawuda yire, a fe birin dɛntɛgɛ a bɛ naxan dangixi na gere kui.

sentences.english: And he gave orders to the man who took the news, saying, After you have given the king all the news about the war,
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa a fala na xɛɛra bɛ, «I na gɛ na dɛntɛgɛ sade,

sentences.english: If the king is angry and says, Why did you go so near the town for the fight? was it not certain that their archers would be on the wall?
sentences.susu: xa mangɛ fa xɔnɔ, a fa yi wɔyɛnyi mɔɔli fala, ‹Munfe ra wo wo masoxi na taa ra a gbe ra gere sode? Wo mu nu a kolon a e nɔma bunyi tide kelife taa tɛtɛ fari ma?

sentences.english: Who put Abimelech, the son of Jerubbaal, to death? did not a woman send a great stone down on him from the wall, putting him to death at Thebez? why did you go so near the wall? Then say to him, Your servant Uriah the Hittite is among the dead.
sentences.susu: Yerubeseti xa di Abimeleki mu faxa na ki xɛ? Ginɛ nde nan a gɔnɔ gɛmɛ xungbe ra kelife Tɛbɛsi taa tɛtɛ ra. Wo wo masoxi na tɛtɛ ra munfe ra?› Na tɛmui i xa yi wɔyɛnyi sa i xa dɛntɛgɛ fari, a falafe ra, ‹I xa konyi Uri Xitika fan bara faxa na gere kui.›»

sentences.english: So the man went, and came to David, and gave him all the news which Joab had sent him to give; then David was angry with Joab and said, Why did you go so near the town for the fight? was it not certain that their archers would be on the wall? who put Abimelech, the son of Jerubbaal, to death? did not a woman send a great stone down on him from the wall, putting him to death at Thebez? why did you go so near the wall?
sentences.susu: Xɛɛra naxa siga, a fe birin dɛntɛgɛ sa Dawuda bɛ naxan dangi gere kui alɔ Yowaba a fala a bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the man said to David, Truly the men got the better of us, and came out against us into the open country, but we sent them back to the very doors of the town.
sentences.susu: A naxɛ, «Yi mixie bara nɔ muxu ra. E to mini taa fari ma, muxu naxa e matutun han e man naxa so taa sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the archers sent their arrows at your servants from the wall, and some of the king's servants are dead, and among them is your servant Uriah the Hittite.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na tɛmui mixi gbɛtɛe naxa xalie woli muxu ma kelife taa tɛtɛ fari. Muxu xa mixi ndee naxa faxa, hali i xa konyi di Uri, na Xitika.»

sentences.english: Then David said to the man, Go and say to Joab, Do not let this be a grief to you; for one man may come to his death by the sword like another: put up an even stronger fight against the town, and take it: and do you put heart into him.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa na xɛɛra yaabi yi ra, «Yowaba, i bɔɲɛ naxa raɲaaxu i ma yi fe ma, barima gere tan kui, fo mixi nde xa faxa nɛ. I xa na taa suxu sɛnbɛ ra, i a birin kana.» I tan fan xa a ralimaniya.

sentences.english: And when the wife of Uriah had news that her husband was dead, she gave herself up to weeping for him.
sentences.susu: Uri xa ginɛ to a mɛ a xa mɔri bara faxa, a naxa kaaɲɛ fe raba.

sentences.english: And when the days of weeping were past, David sent for her, and took her into his house, and she became his wife and gave him a son. But the Lord was not pleased with the thing David had done.
sentences.susu: A xa kaaɲɛ fe to ba a ra, Dawuda naxa a xili, a a findi a xa ginɛ ra. Na tɛmui a naxa di xɛmɛ keren bari a bɛ. Kɔnɔ Dawuda naxan nabaxi, na mu rafan Alatala ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord sent Nathan to David. And Nathan came to him and said, There were two men in the same town: one a man of great wealth, and the other a poor man.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Natan xɛɛ Dawuda xɔn ma. Natan naxa a fala a bɛ, «Mixi firin nu na taa nde kui, keren nu findixi banna nan na, boore setare.

sentences.english: The man of wealth had great numbers of flocks and herds;
sentences.susu: Xuruse gbegbe nu na na banna yi ra,

sentences.english: But the poor man had only one little she-lamb, which he had got and taken care of: from its birth it had been with him like one of his children; his meat was its food, and from his cup it took its drink, resting in his arms, and it was like a daughter to him.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ yɛxɛɛ ginɛ keren peti nan nu na setare tan yi ra. A na sara nɛ, a nu a balo a xɔnyi a xa die ya ma. A nu donse xuntunyie fima a ma, a nu ye fi a ma a yɛtɛ xa tɔnbili ra. Kɔɛ ra yɛxɛɛ nu xima a kanke nan ma. A nu luxi nɛ a bɛ alɔ a xa di.

sentences.english: Now a traveller came to the house of the man of wealth, but he would not take anything from his flock or his herd to make a meal for the traveller who had come to him, but he took the poor man's lamb and made it ready for the man who had come.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde xɔɲɛ naxa fa na banna xɔnyi. Na banna to mu tin xuruse bade a yɛtɛ xa gɔɔrɛ kui, a naxa siga a sa na setare xa yɛxɛɛ kerenyi tongo, a a faxa, a a rafala a xa xɔɲɛ bɛ.»

sentences.english: And David was full of wrath against that man; and he said to Nathan, By the living Lord, death is the right punishment for the man who has done this:
sentences.susu: Dawuda to na mɛ, a naxa xɔnɔ ki fanyi ra na banna ma, a naxa a fala Natan bɛ, «N bara n kali Alatala xili ra, na banna lan nɛ a xa faxa.

sentences.english: And he will have to give back four times the value of the lamb, because he has done this and because he had no pity.
sentences.susu: A man xa na yɛxɛɛ ɲɔxɔɛ naani ragbilen na setare ma, barima a bara fe kobi raba, a mu kinikini.»

sentences.english: And Nathan said to David, You are that man. The Lord God of Israel says, I made you king over Israel, putting holy oil on you, and I kept you safe from the hands of Saul;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Natan naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, a naxɛ, «I tan nan na na banna ra! Isirayila Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, a naxɛ, ‹N bara i sugandi Isirayila mangɛ ra, n bara i ratanga Sɔlu ma,

sentences.english: I gave you your master's daughter and your master's wives for yourself, and I gave you the daughters of Israel and Judah; and if that had not been enough, I would have given you such and such things.
sentences.susu: n fa a xa banxi so i yi ra, a nun a xa ginɛe, a nun Isirayila nun Yudaya birin. Xa na mu i wasa nu, n nu nɔma nde sade na xun ma.

sentences.english: Why then have you had no respect for the word of the Lord, doing what is evil in his eyes? You have put Uriah the Hittite to death with the sword, and have taken his wife to be your wife; you have put him to death with the sword of the children of Ammon.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra i Alatala xui maberexi, i wali ɲaaxi raba? I bara Uri Xitika faxa Amonikae saabui ra, i bara Uri xa ginɛ tongo, i a findi i gbe ra.

sentences.english: So now the sword will never be turned away from your family; because you have had no respect for me, and have taken the wife of Uriah the Hittite to be your wife.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, gere mu makuyama i bɔnsɔɛ ra sɔnɔn, barima i bara n xui mabere, i Uri Xitika xa ginɛ findi i gbe ra.

sentences.english: The Lord says, From those of your family I will send evil against you, and before your very eyes I will take your wives and give them to your neighbour, and he will take your wives to his bed by the light of this sun.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala i bɛ, n tan Alatala fama i tɔɔrɔde i bɔnsɔɛ tagi. N fama i xa ginɛe bade i yi ra, n e so i xa mixi nde yi ra, e nun nee fa kafu kɛnɛ ma.

sentences.english: You did it secretly; but I will do this thing before all Israel and in the light of the sun.
sentences.susu: I tan fe ɲaaxi rabaxi a gundo daaxi nɛ, kɔnɔ n i sare ragbilenma a kɛnɛ ma daaxi nɛ Isirayila ɲama ya xɔri.›»

sentences.english: And David said to Nathan, Great is my sin against the Lord. And Nathan said to David, The Lord has put away your sin; death will not come on you.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Natan bɛ, «N bara yunubi raba Alatala ra!» Natan naxa a yaabi, «Alatala bara diɲɛ i xa yunubi ma, i mu faxama.

sentences.english: But still, because you have had no respect for the Lord, death will certainly overtake the child who has newly come to birth.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i to a niyaxi Alatala yaxuie xa nɔ a maberede yi fe kui, i xa di naxan fama baride, na tan faxama nɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Nathan went back to his house. And the hand of the Lord was on David's son, the child of Uriah's wife, and it became very ill.
sentences.susu: Natan naxa gbilen a xɔnyi. Alatala naxa fure radin diyɔrɛ ma, Uri xa ginɛ naxan bari Dawuda bɛ.

sentences.english: So David made prayer to God for the child; and he took no food day after day, and went in and, stretching himself out on the earth, was there all night.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Ala maxandi diyɔrɛ bɛ, a man sunyi suxu a xa fe ra. A to so a xɔnyi, a naxa a sa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the chief men of his house got up and went to his side to make him get up from the earth, but he would not; and he would not take food with them.
sentences.susu: A xa forie naxa fe birin naba alako a xa keli bɔxi ma, a xa a dɛge, kɔnɔ a mu tin feo.

sentences.english: And then on the seventh day the child's death took place. And David's servants were in fear of giving him the news of the child's death: for they said, Truly, while the child was still living he gave no attention when we said anything to him: what will he do to himself if we give him word that the child is dead?
sentences.susu: A xi solofere nde diyɔrɛ naxa faxa. Dawuda xa walikɛe mu nu wama na falafe a bɛ, barima e nu a falama e boore tagi, «Diyɔrɛ to mu nu faxaxi, muxu nu wɔyɛn nɛ a bɛ, a mu muxu danxun. Yakɔsi muxu fama a xa diyɔrɛ xa faxɛ falade a bɛ di? A fama fe xɔnɛ nan nabade!»

sentences.english: But when David saw that his servants were talking together quietly, he was certain that the child was dead: and he said to his servants, Is the child dead? and they said, He is.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa sogi a xa walikɛe ma, e na fe nde madukufe e xui igoroxi ra e boore tagi. Na kui a naxa a kolon a xa diyɔrɛ bara faxa. A naxa a xa walikɛe maxɔrin, «Diyɔrɛ bara faxa?» E naxa, «Iyo, a bara faxa.»

sentences.english: Then David got up from the earth, and after washing and rubbing himself with oil and changing his clothing, he went into the house of the Lord and gave worship: then he went back to his house, and at his order they put food before him and he had a meal.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa keli bɔxi, a a maxa, a labundɛ sa a ma, a dugie masara, a fa siga Alatala xa banxi kui suyidide Ala bɛ. A to keli mɛnni, a naxa siga a xɔnyi, a donse maxɔrin, a a dɛge.

sentences.english: Then his servants said to him, Why have you been acting in this way? you were weeping and going without food while the child was still living; but when the child was dead, you got up and had a meal.
sentences.susu: A xa walikɛe naxa a maxɔrin, e naxɛ, «Munfe ra diyɔrɛ nu baloxi tɛmui naxɛ, i nu sunma, i nu wama, kɔnɔ diyɔrɛ to faxaxi fa, i bara keli, i i dɛge?»

sentences.english: And he said, While the child was still living I went without food and gave myself up to weeping: for I said, Who is able to say that the Lord will not have mercy on me and give the child life?
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «Diyɔrɛ to nu baloxi, n nu sunma, n nu wama, barima n ɲɔxɔ a ma a tɛmunde Alatala diɲɛma n ma, a n ma diyɔrɛ rakisi.

sentences.english: But now that the child is dead there is no reason for me to go without food; am I able to make him come back to life? I will go to him, but he will never come back to me.
sentences.susu: A to bara faxa, n fa sunma munfe ra? N nɔma a ragbilende duniɲa ma fa? N tan a lima nɛ naa, kɔnɔ a tan mu gbilenma n tan ma sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: And David gave comfort to his wife Bath-sheba, and he went in to her and had connection with her: and she had a son to whom she gave the name Solomon. And he was dear to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Dawuda naxa a xa ginɛ Batiseba madundu. E naxa lu yire keren, a naxa tɛɛgɛ, a di xɛmɛ bari. E naxa a xili sa Sulemani. Alatala to a xanu,

sentences.english: And he sent word by Nathan the prophet, who gave him the name Jedidiah, by the word of the Lord.
sentences.susu: a naxa Annabi Natan xɛɛ Dawuda yire, a falafe ra, Yedideya xili fan xa sa a xun, naxan wama a falafe Alatala xanuntenyi.

sentences.english: Now Joab was fighting against Rabbah, in the land of the children of Ammon, and he took the water-town.
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa Amonikae xa mangataa Raaba gere, a na mangɛ banxi suxu.

sentences.english: And Joab sent men to David, saying, I have made war against Rabbah and have taken the water-town.
sentences.susu: A naxa mixie xɛɛ a falafe ra Dawuda bɛ, «N bara Raaba gere, n man bara e xa ye yire suxu.

sentences.english: So now, get the rest of the people together, and put them in position against the town and take it, for if I take it, it will be named after my name.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi i xa sɔɔrie malan, wo xa te taa suxude. A mu lanma n tan xa na binyɛ sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: Then David got all the people together and went to Rabbah and made war on it and took it.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to sɔɔrie malan, e naxa siga Raaba. A naxa din taa ra, a a suxu.

sentences.english: And he took the crown of Milcom from his head; the weight of it was a talent of gold, and in it were stones of great price; and it was put on David's head. And he took a great store of goods from the town.
sentences.susu: A naxa Amoni mangɛ xa mangɛ tɔnxuma ba a xun ma, a fa a sa a yɛtɛ xun ma. A binya kilo tongo saxan, a yailanxi xɛɛma nan na. Gɛmɛ tofanyi fan nu na a ma. Dawuda naxa se gbegbe sɔtɔ na taa kui.

sentences.english: And he took the people out of the town and put them to work with wood-cutting instruments, and iron grain-crushers, and iron axes, and at brick-making: this he did to all the towns of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people went back to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: A naxa na taakae findi konyie ra, naxee nu wuri xabama a nun biriki bɔnbɔma. A a raba na ki nɛ Amonikae xa taa birin kui. Na dangi xanbi Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa gbilen Darisalamu.

sentences.english: Now after this, it came about that Absalom, David's son, had a beautiful sister, whose name was Tamar; and David's son Amnon was in love with her.
sentences.susu: Na to dangi, fe nde naxa Dawuda xa di Abisalomi xunya ginɛma tofanyi Tamari li. Dawuda xa di Aminon naxa a xanu fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: And he was so deeply in love that he became ill because of his sister Tamar; for she was a virgin, and so it seemed hard to Amnon to do anything to her.
sentences.susu: A naxa wa a maaginɛ Tamari xɔn ma han na naxa findi a bɛ fure ra. Ginɛ dimɛdi nan nu a ra, kɔnɔ Aminon mu nɔma a makɔrɛde a ra.

sentences.english: But Amnon had a friend whose name was Jonadab, the son of Shimeah, David's brother: and Jonadab was a very wise man.
sentences.susu: Aminon boore nde nu na na, naxan nu xili Yonadabo, Dawuda taara Simeya xa di. A nu kɔɔta ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And he said to him, O son of the king, why are you getting thinner day by day? will you not say what your trouble is? And Amnon said to him, I am in love with Tamar, my brother Absalom's sister.
sentences.susu: A naxa a boore maxɔrin, «Mangɛ xa di, munfe ra i yatagi ixɔnɔxi lɔxɔɛ yo lɔxɔɛ? A fala n bɛ.» Aminon naxa a yaabi, «N wama n bariboore Abisalomi maaginɛ Tamari nan xɔn.»

sentences.english: Then Jonadab said to him, Go to your bed, and let it seem that you are ill: and when your father comes to see you, say to him, Let my sister Tamar come and give me bread, and get the food ready before my eyes, so that I may see it and take it from her hand.
sentences.susu: Yonadabo naxa a fala a bɛ, «I naxan nabama, i xa i sa, alɔ i na fura a gbe ra. I baba na fa i xɛɛbude, i xa a mayandi a falafe ra, ‹A lu n maaginɛ Tamari xa fa n yire, a xa donse yailan n ya xɔri, a a so n yi ra a yɛtɛ ra.›»

sentences.english: So Amnon went to bed and made himself seem ill: and when the king came to see him, Amnon said to the king, Please let my sister Tamar come and make me one or two cakes before my eyes, so that I may take food from her hand.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Aminon naxa a sa, alɔ a furaxi nɛ. Mangɛ to fa a xɛɛbude, a naxa a fala a bɛ, «Yandi, a lu Tamari xa fa n yire, a xa donse nde yailan n ya xɔri, a a so n yi ra a yɛtɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Then David sent to the house for Tamar and said, Go now to your brother Amnon's house and get a meal for him.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa mixie xɛɛ Tamari xɔnyi, a falafe ra, «I xa siga i taara Aminon xɔnyi, alako i xa donse yailan a bɛ.»

sentences.english: So Tamar went to her brother Amnon's house; and he was in bed. And she took paste and made cakes before his eyes, cooking them over the fire.
sentences.susu: Tamari naxa so a taara Aminon xa banxi kui, a naxa a li a saxi. A naxa donse nde yailan, a ture sa a ma, a a ɲin a ya tode ra.

sentences.english: And she took the cooking-pot, and put the cakes before him, but he would not take them. And Amnon said, Let everyone go away from me. So they all went out.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ, a naxa a makɔrɛ a ra donse ra a yi tunde kui alako a xa a so a yi ra, kɔnɔ Aminon mu tin a donde. A naxa yaamari fi mixi birin xa mini. E to mini,

sentences.english: Then Amnon said to Tamar, Take the food and come into my bedroom, so that I may take it from your hand. So Tamar took the cakes she had made and went with them into her brother Amnon's bedroom.
sentences.susu: a naxa a fala Tamari bɛ, «Fa donse ra n ma konkoe kui. I xa a fi n ma i bɛlɛxɛ ra.» Tamari naxa donse tongo a naxan yailanxi, a siga a ra a taara xa konkoe kui.

sentences.english: And when she took them to give them to him, he put his arms round her and said, Come to bed, my sister.
sentences.susu: A to donse ti a bɛ, a naxa dutun a ma, a a fala a bɛ, «N xunya, won xa kafu!»

sentences.english: And answering him, she said, O my brother, do not put shame on me; it is not right for such a thing to be done in Israel: do not this evil thing.
sentences.susu: A maaginɛ naxa a yaabi, «N taara yandi, i naxa dutun n ma, barima na fe mɔɔli mu lanma a xa raba Isirayila bɔxi ma. I naxa yi daxuɲa raba.

sentences.english: What will become of me in my shame? and as for you, you will be looked down on with disgust by all Israel. Now then, go and make your request to the king, for he will not keep me from you.
sentences.susu: N na yaagi mɔɔli xaninma di? I xili fan kanama nɛ Isirayila. I xa mangɛ mayandi, a mu tondima n fide i ma.»

sentences.english: But he would not give attention to what she said: but being stronger than she, he took her by force, and had connection with her.
sentences.susu: A mu tin a tuli matide a ra, a naxa dutun a ma, a a futi kana.

sentences.english: Then Amnon was full of hate for her, hating her with a hate greater than his earlier love for her. And he said to her, Get up and be gone.
sentences.susu: Na to ba a ra, Tamari xa fe naxa raɲaaxu Aminon ma, a fa a fala a bɛ, «Keli, i siga!»

sentences.english: And she said to him, Not so, my brother, for this great wrong in sending me away is worse than what you did to me before. But he gave no attention to her.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, a naxɛ, «Ade! Xa i n keri, na ɲaaxu dangi i naxan nabaxi n na!» Kɔnɔ Aminon mu a tuli mati a ra.

sentences.english: Then he gave a cry to the servant who was waiting on him and said, Put this woman out, and let the door be locked after her.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa konyi xili, a a fala a bɛ, «Yi ginɛ keri n bɛ, i fa naadɛ balan.»

sentences.english: Now she had on a long robe, such as in past times the king's virgin daughters were dressed in. Then the servant put her out, locking the door after her.
sentences.susu: Aminon xa konyi naxa a keri, a naadɛ balan alɔ a falaxi a bɛ ki naxɛ. Donma nu ragoroxi Tamari ma, naxan ɲingi masunbuxi. Mangɛ xa di ginɛ naxee mu nu xɛmɛ fe kolon sinden nu darixi na donma mɔɔli ra.

sentences.english: And Tamar, in her grief, put dust on her head; and she put her hand on her head and went away crying loudly.
sentences.susu: Tamari naxa xube radin a yɛtɛ xun na, a a xa donma ibɔɔ a ma. A naxa a bɛlɛxɛe sa a xun ma, a siga gbelegbele ra.

sentences.english: And her brother Absalom said to her, Has your brother Amnon been with you? but now, let there be an end to your crying, my sister: he is your brother, do not take this thing to heart. So Tamar went on living uncomforted in her brother's house.
sentences.susu: A taara Abisalomi naxa a maxɔrin, «I taara Aminon bara dutun i ma? N xunya, i sabari. I naxa kɔntɔfili yi xa fe ra. I taara nan a ra.» Kabi na tɛmui Tamari naxa sabati a taara Abisalomi xɔnyi sunnunyi kui.

sentences.english: But when King David had news of all these things he was very angry; but he did not make trouble for Amnon his son, for he was dear to David, being his oldest son.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda to na fe kolon, a naxa xɔnɔ ki fanyi.

sentences.english: But Absalom said nothing to his brother Amnon, good or bad: for he was full of hate for him, because he had taken his sister Tamar by force.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi mu sese fala Aminon bɛ na xa fe ra, kɔnɔ xɔnnanteya naxa lu a bɔɲɛ kui Aminon mabiri, barima a nu bara fe kobi raba a maaginɛ Tamari ra.

sentences.english: Now after two full years, Absalom had men cutting the wool of his sheep in Baal-hazor, which is near Ephraim: and he sent for all the king's sons to come to his feast.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ firin dangi xanbi, Abisalomi xa walikɛe nu na a xa yɛxɛɛ xabe maxabafe Bali Xasori, Efirami bɔxi fɛ ma. Abisalomi naxa mangɛ xa di birin xili naa, e xa xulunyi raba.

sentences.english: And Absalom came to the king and said, See now, your servant is cutting the wool of his sheep; will the king and his servants be pleased to come?
sentences.susu: Abisalomi naxa siga mangɛ yire, a naxɛ, «Mangɛ, n ma yɛxɛe xabe xaba tɛmui bara a li. Xa i sa tinma, i xa fa a nun i xa mixie na xulunyi.»

sentences.english: And the king said to Absalom, No, my son, let us not all go, or the number will be over-great for you. And he made his request again, but he would not go, but he gave him his blessing.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa Abisalomi yaabi, a naxɛ, «Ade, n ma di, a mu lanma muxu birin xa siga, xa na mu a ra a findima kote xungbe nan na i bɛ.» Abisalomi naxa a karaxan, kɔnɔ mangɛ naxa tondi, a fa duba a bɛ.

sentences.english: Then Absalom said, If you will not go, then let my brother Amnon go with us. And the king said to him, Is there any reason for him to go with you?
sentences.susu: Abisalomi naxɛ, «N ba, xa fe na na ki nɛ, a lu n xunya Aminon tan xa fa.» Mangɛ naxɛ, «Munfe ra?»

sentences.english: But Absalom went on requesting him till he let Amnon and all the king's sons go with him. And Absalom made a great feast like a feast for a king.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi naxa a karaxan, han mangɛ naxa tin Aminon nun mangɛ xa di birin xa siga na xulunyi.

sentences.english: Now Absalom had given orders to his servants, saying, Now take note when Amnon's heart is glad with wine; and when I say to you, Make an attack on Amnon, then put him to death without fear: have I not given you orders? be strong and without fear.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi naxa a fala a xa konyie bɛ, «Aminon na siisi, n fama yaamari fide wo ma wo xa a faxa. Na waxati hali wo mu gaaxu, n tan nan wo yamarixi. Wo xa limaniya, wo a faxa.»

sentences.english: So Absalom's servants did to Amnon as Absalom had given them orders. Then all the king's sons got up, and every man got on his beast and went in flight.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi xa konyie naxa na raba Aminon na, alɔ Abisalomi e yamarixi ki naxɛ. Mangɛ xa di birin to na to, e naxa e gi e xa soe fari.

sentences.english: Now while they were on their way, news was given to David that Absalom had put to death all the sons of the king and that not one of them was still living.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda naxa na xibaaru mɛ beenu e xa a yire li, a falafe ra, «Abisalomi bara mangɛ xa di xɛmɛ birin faxa, keren mu luxi.»

sentences.english: Then the king got up in great grief, stretching himself out on the earth: and all his servants were by his side, with their clothing parted.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a xa donma ibɔɔ sunnunyi kui, a fa goro bɔxi ma, a tan nun a xa mixie.

sentences.english: And Jonadab, the son of Shimeah, David's brother, said, Let not my lord have the idea that all the sons of the king have been put to death; for only Amnon is dead: this has been purposed by Absalom from the day when he took his sister Tamar by force.
sentences.susu: Dawuda taara Simeya xa di xɛmɛ Yonadabo, naxa a fala a bɛ, «N marigi, i xa di xɛmɛ birin xa mu faxaxi. Aminon gbansan nan faxaxi. Na natɛ nu na Abisalomi furi kabi Aminon dutunxi a maaginɛ Tamari ma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: So now, let not my lord the king take this thing to heart, with the idea that all the king's sons are dead: for only Amnon is dead.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ, i naxa la na xibaaru ra, a falafe ra i xa di xɛmɛ birin bara faxa. Aminon gbansan nan faxaxi.»

sentences.english: But Absalom went in flight. And the young man who kept the watch, lifting up his eyes, saw that a great band of people was coming down the slope by the way of the Horons; and the watchman came and gave word to the king, saying, I saw men coming down by the way of the Horons, from the hillside.
sentences.susu: Na kui Abisalomi naxa a gi. Na tɛmui taa makantɛ naxa mixi gbegbe to fa ra kira xɔn ma kelife geya yire.

sentences.english: And Jonadab said to the king, See, the king's sons are coming; as your servant said, so it is.
sentences.susu: Yonadabo naxa a fala mangɛ bɛ, «I xa die nan fafe yi ki, alɔ n a fala i bɛ ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And while he was talking, the king's sons came, with weeping and loud cries: and the king and all his servants were weeping bitterly.
sentences.susu: A ɲan mu gɛ wɔyɛnde, mangɛ xa die naxa so wa ra. Mangɛ nun a xa mixie fan naxa wa fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: So Absalom went in flight and came to Talmai, the son of Ammihud, the king of Geshur, where he was for three years.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi nu bara a gi, a siga Gesuri mangɛ Amixudi xa di xɛmɛ Talamayi xɔnyi. Dawuda a xa di xa ɲɔnfe raba nɛ tɛmui xɔnkuye.

sentences.english: And the king was sorrowing for his son all the time.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi lu nɛ Gesuri xɔnyi ɲɛ saxan.

sentences.english: And the heart of David was wasted with desire for Absalom: for he was comforted for the death of Amnon.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda bɔɲɛ goro nɛ Aminon xa faxɛ xa fe ra, a Abisalomi lu na sinden.

sentences.english: Now it was clear to Joab, the son of Zeruiah, that the king's heart was turning to Absalom.
sentences.susu: Seruya xa di xɛmɛ Yowaba nu a kolon a Abisalomi rafan Dawuda ma.

sentences.english: And Joab sent to Tekoa and got from there a wise woman, and said to her, Now make yourself seem like one given up to grief, and put on the clothing of sorrow, not using any sweet oil for your body, but looking like one who for a long time has been weeping for the dead:
sentences.susu: Na kui Seruya naxa Tekowa ginɛ nde fen naxan kɔɔta. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xa i maxiri alɔ kaaɲɛ ginɛ. I naxa labundɛ nun ture sa i ma de. I xa lu alɔ ginɛ naxan buxi ɲɔnfe sunnunyi kui tɛmui xɔnkuye.

sentences.english: And come to the king and say these words to him. So Joab gave her words to say.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui i xa siga mangɛ yire, i fa wɔyɛn a bɛ alɔ n a falama i bɛ ki naxɛ.» Yowaba naxa na wɔyɛnyi birin masen a bɛ.

sentences.english: And the woman of Tekoa came to the king, and falling on her face, gave him honour and said, Give me help, O king.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ Tekowaka naxa sa wɔyɛn mangɛ bɛ na ki. A naxa a yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma mangɛ ya i, a fa a fala, «Mangɛ, i xa n nakisi.»

sentences.english: And the king said to her, What is your trouble? And her answer was, Truly I am a widow, and my husband is dead.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «Munse niyaxi?» A naxa a yaabi, «Kaaɲɛ ginɛ nan n na, n ma mɔri bara faxa.

sentences.english: And I had two sons, and the two of them had a fight in the field, and there was no one to come between them, and one with a blow put the other to death.
sentences.susu: Di xɛmɛ firin nu na n yi ra. Lɔxɔɛ nde e naxa gere daaxa. Mixi yo mu nu na naxan e tagi ibama. Na kui keren naxa boore faxa.

sentences.english: And now all the family is turned against me, your servant, saying, Give up him who was the cause of his brother's death, so that we may put him to death in payment for the life of his brother, whose life he took; and we will put an end to the one who will get the heritage: so they will put out my last burning coal, and my husband will have no name or offspring on the face of the earth.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n ma mixie bara a fala n bɛ, a n xa n ma di so e yi ra naxan luxi, e xa a fan faxa n ma di faxaxi gbeɲɔxɔfe ra. E wama na kɛ tongoma kerenyi faxafe naxan luma n bɛ, alako n ma mɔri xili nun a xa fe xa ɲɔn feo.»

sentences.english: And the king said to the woman, Go to your house and I will give orders about this.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala na ginɛ bɛ, «I naxa kɔntɔfili. Siga i xɔnyi. N yaamari fima i xa fe ra yakɔsi.»

sentences.english: And the woman of Tekoa said to the king, My lord, O king, may the sin be on me and on my family, and may the king and the seat of his kingdom be clear of sin!
sentences.susu: Na Tekowa ginɛ naxa a yaabi, «N ma fe rabaxi sare xa gbilen n tan nun n xabilɛ ma. Na kote naxa lu mangɛ nun a xa kibanyi xun ma.»

sentences.english: And the king said, If anyone says anything to you, make him come to me, and he will do you no more damage.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «Xa mixi nde sa i rakiiti, i xa fa a ra n xɔn ma. A mu i rakiitima sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: Then she said, Let the king keep in mind the Lord your God, so that he who gives punishment for blood may be kept back from further destruction and that no one may send death on my son. And he said, By the living Lord, not a hair of your son's head will come to the earth.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ naxa a yaabi, «Mangɛ, i xa laayidi tongo n bɛ i Marigi Alatala xili ra, alako n ma di faxaxi gbeɲɔxɔfe soxi mixi naxan yi, na naxa nde sa n ma tɔɔrɛ xun ma n ma di baloxi faxafe ra.» Mangɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «N xa a fala i bɛ Alatala xili ra, sese mu fama i xa di tode.»

sentences.english: Then the woman said, Will the king let his servant say one word more? And he said, Say on.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui na ginɛ naxa a fala mangɛ bɛ, «I xa i haakɛ to, n xa masenyi nde ti i bɛ.» A naxɛ, «Awa yire.»

sentences.english: And the woman said, Why have you had such a thought about the people of God? (for in saying these very words the king has put himself in the wrong because he has not taken back the one whom he sent far away.)
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «Munfe ra i na rabaxi Alatala xa ɲama ra? I xa wɔyɛnyi a masenxi i tan bara tantan, barima i mu tinxi mixi rafade i naxan kerixi.

sentences.english: For death comes to us all, and we are like water drained out on the earth, which it is not possible to take up again; and God will not take away the life of the man whose purpose is that he who has been sent away may not be completely cut off from him.
sentences.susu: Ibunadama birin faxama nɛ. E luxi nɛ alɔ ye ifilixi naxan mu makɔma sɔnɔn! Kɔnɔ Ala mu tinma mixi xa simaya xun nakanade. A fe birin nabama alako naxan bara a makuya a ra, na man xa makɔrɛ a ra.»

sentences.english: And now it is my fear of the people which has made me come to say these words to my lord the king: and your servant said, I will put my cause before the king, and it may be that he will give effect to my request.
sentences.susu: «Mangɛ, n bara yi birin masen mangɛ bɛ to, barima n bara gaaxu ɲama ya ra. N bara a maɲɔxun a tɛmunde i nɔma tinde n tan i xa konyi xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: For the king will give ear, and take his servant out of the power of the man whose purpose is the destruction of me and my son together from the heritage of God.
sentences.susu: N bara a maɲɔxun a i nɔma n bade n yaxui bɛlɛxɛ i naxan wama n tan nun n ma di faxafe, muxu naxa lu sɔnɔn Ala xa ɲama ya ma.

sentences.english: Then your servant said, May the word of my lord the king give me peace! for my lord the king is as the angel of God in his hearing of good and bad: and may the Lord your God be with you!
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa masenyi xa bɔɲɛsa fi n ma. I tan luxi nɛ n bɛ alɔ Alatala xa malekɛ naxan nɔma fe fanyi nun fe ɲaaxi tagi rasade. I Marigi Alatala xa i mali.»

sentences.english: Then the king said to the woman, Now give me an answer to the question I am going to put to you; keep nothing back. And the woman said, Let my lord the king say on.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa na ginɛ yaabi, «Nɔndi fala n bɛ, i naxa fefe nɔxun n ma.» Ginɛ naxɛ, «Awa yire n mangɛ n marigi.»

sentences.english: And the king said, Is not the hand of Joab with you in all this? And the woman in answer said, By the life of your soul, my lord the king, it is not possible for anyone to go to the right hand or to the left from anything said by the king: your servant Joab gave me orders, and put all these words in my mouth:
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «I xa masenyi birin fatanxi Yowaba nan na?» Ginɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «Mangɛ, i bara nɔndi yati fala. Mixi mu nɔma fefe nɔxunde i ma. Yowaba nan n xɛɛxi n xa na birin masen i bɛ.

sentences.english: This he did, hoping that the face of this business might be changed: and my lord is wise, with the wisdom of the angel of God, having knowledge of everything on earth.
sentences.susu: I xa konyi Yowaba yi rabaxi nɛ, alako fe nde xa masara. Kɔnɔ i tan, n marigi, i xaxili fan alɔ Alatala xa malekɛ nde. I fe birin kolon naxan dangima yi bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And the king said to Joab, See now, I will do this thing: go then and Come back with the young man Absalom.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala Yowaba bɛ, a naxɛ, «I naxan fala, n wama na nan nabafe. Siga, i sa fa n ma di Abisalomi ra.»

sentences.english: Then Joab, falling down on his face on the earth, gave the king honour and blessing; and Joab said, Today it is clear to your servant that I have grace in your eyes, my lord king, because the king has given effect to the request of his servant.
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa a magoro bɔxi ma binyɛ kui, a fa duba mangɛ bɛ. A naxa a fala mangɛ bɛ, «Mangɛ n marigi, to n bara i xa hinnɛ to n mabiri, barima i bara tin n ma wɔyɛnyi ra.»

sentences.english: So Joab got up and went to Geshur and came back again to Jerusalem with Absalom.
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa siga Gesuri Abisalomi fɔxɔ ra, a fa fa a ra Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And the king said, Let him go to his house, but let him not see my face. So Absalom went back to his house and did not see the face of the king.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Abisalomi to Darisalamu li, mangɛ naxa yaamari fi a a naxa fa mangɛ yire, a xa lu a xɔnyi. Na kui Abisalomi naxa siga a xɔnyi, a mu mangɛ yire li.

sentences.english: Now in all Israel there was no one so greatly to be praised for his beautiful form as Absalom: from his feet to the crown of his head he was completely beautiful.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu nu na Isirayila bɔxi ma, naxan nu tofan alɔ Abisalomi, kelife a xunyi han a sanyi. Ɲama birin na to nɛ.

sentences.english: And when he had his hair cut, (which he did at the end of every year, because of the weight of his hair;) the weight of the hair was two hundred shekels by the king's weight.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ yo ɲɛ a nu luma a xunyi bii ra, barima a xunsɛxɛ nu binya han kilo firin mangɛ maniyase ki ma.

sentences.english: And Absalom was the father of three sons and of one daughter named Tamar, who was very beautiful.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi di xɛmɛ saxan nan bari, a nun di ginɛ nde naxan xili Tamari. Ginɛ tofanyi na nu a ra.

sentences.english: For two full years Absalom was living in Jerusalem without ever seeing the face of the king.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi naxa lu Darisalamu ɲɛ firin, mangɛ mu tin e xa boore to ra.

sentences.english: Then Absalom sent for Joab to send him to the king, but he would not come to him: and he sent again a second time, but he would not come.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi naxa Yowaba xili alako a xa a masen mangɛ bɛ, kɔnɔ Yowaba fan mu tin e xa boore to ra. Abisalomi naxa a xili a sanya firin nde, kɔnɔ Yowaba mu a xa xili ratin.

sentences.english: So he said to his servants, See, Joab's field is near mine, and he has barley in it; go and put it on fire. And Absalom's servants put the field on fire.
sentences.susu: Na kui Abisalomi naxa a fala a xa mixie bɛ, «Wo a kolon, Yowaba xa mɛngi xɛ na n gbe fɛ ma. Wo sa tɛ so naa ra.»

sentences.english: Then Joab came to Absalom in his house and said to him, Why have your servants put my field on fire?
sentences.susu: E to gɛ na rabade, Yowaba naxa siga Abisalomi yire, a sa a maxɔrin a a xa xɛ ganxi fe naxan ma.

sentences.english: And Absalom's answer was, See, I sent to you saying, Come here, so that I may send you to the king to say, Why have I come back from Geshur? it would be better for me to be there still: let me now see the king's face, and if there is any sin in me, let him put me to death.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi naxa a yaabi, «N bara i xili alako n xa i xɛɛ mangɛ xɔn, i xa a maxɔrin n bɛ, ‹Munfe ra i n tongoxi Gesuri, i fa n na be? Xa i mu wama n tofe, a nu fisa n xa lu mɛnni!› Yakɔsi n wama n yɛtɛ dɛntɛgɛfe mangɛ bɛ. Xa n bara sɛriyɛ nde kana, a xa n faxa.»

sentences.english: So Joab went to the king and said these words to him: and when the king had sent for him, Absalom came, and went down on his face on the earth before the king: and the king gave him a kiss.
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa siga mangɛ yire, a sa Abisalomi xa xɛɛra iba mangɛ bɛ. Na tɛmui mangɛ naxa Abisalomi xili. Abisalomi to siga mangɛ yire, a naxa a magoro bɔxi ma binyɛ kui, mangɛ fa a sunbu.

sentences.english: Now after this, Absalom got for himself a carriage and horses, and fifty runners to go before him.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Abisalomi naxa sɔɔri ragise nun soee sɔtɔ, a nun sɔɔri mixi tongo suuli, naxee nu ɲɛrɛma a ya ra.

sentences.english: And Absalom got up early, morning after morning, and took his place at the side of the public meeting-place: and when any man had a cause which had to come to the king to be judged, then Absalom, crying out to him, said, What is your town? and he would say, Your servant is of one of the tribes of Israel.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi nu kelima gɛɛsɛgɛ, a ti kira dɛ ra naxan nu soma mangataa. Mixi naxee nu minima naa ra sigafe ra mangɛ yire alako e xa e xa kɔntɔfili masen a bɛ, Abisalomi nu nee maxɔrinma, «Wo kelixi minden?» E na e kelide fala a bɛ,

sentences.english: And Absalom would say to him, See, your cause is true and right; but no man has been named by the king to give you a hearing.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi nu a falama nɛ e bɛ, «Nɔndi na wo bɛ, kɔnɔ mixi yo mu a tuli matima wo ra mangɛ xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And more than this, Absalom said, If only I was made judge in the land, so that every man who has any cause or question might come to me, and I would give a right decision for him!
sentences.susu: Xa n tan nan findixi kiitisa ra Isirayila bɔxi ma nu, n mixi birin makiitima tinxinyi nun nɔndi nan na nu.»

sentences.english: And if any man came near to give him honour, he took him by the hand and gave him a kiss.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee nu e xinbi sinma a bɛ, Abisalomi nu e bɛlɛxɛ suxuma, a e sunbu.

sentences.english: And this Absalom did to everyone in Israel who came to the king to have his cause judged: so Absalom, like a thief, took away the hearts of the men of Israel.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi nu na nan nabama Isirayilakae birin bɛ, naxee nu sigama mangɛ yire kiiti nde xa fe ra. Na kui a naxa e bɔɲɛ ya rafindi a yɛtɛ ma.

sentences.english: Now at the end of four years, Absalom said to the king, Let me go to Hebron and give effect to the oath which I made to the Lord:
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ naani dangi xanbi, Abisalomi naxa a fala mangɛ bɛ, «Diɲɛ n ma, n xa siga Hebiron laayidi nde rakamalide,

sentences.english: For while I was living in Geshur in Aram, your servant made an oath, saying, If ever the Lord lets me come back to Jerusalem, I will give him worship in Hebron.
sentences.susu: n naxan tongo Alatala bɛ, n nu na Gesuri taa kui tɛmui naxɛ Arami bɔxi ma. N a fala nɛ, xa Alatala n nagbilen Darisalamu, n sɛrɛxɛ bama nɛ a bɛ Hebiron.»

sentences.english: And the king said to him, Go in peace. So he got up and went to Hebron.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «Siga bɔɲɛsa kui.» Na tɛmui Abisalomi naxa a xun ti Hebiron na.

sentences.english: But Absalom at the same time sent watchers through all the tribes of Israel to say, At the sound of the horn you are to say, Absalom is king in Hebron.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi naxa mixie xɛɛ Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe birin ma, e xa a fala, «Wo na sara xui mɛ tɛmui naxɛ, wo xa a fala, Abisalomi bara mangɛya tongo Hebiron.»

sentences.english: And with Absalom, at his request, went two hundred men from Jerusalem, who were completely unconscious of his designs.
sentences.susu: A naxa mixi kɛmɛ firin tongo Darisalamu, naxee a mati Hebiron, kɔnɔ e mu a kolon Abisalomi nu wama naxan nabafe naa.

sentences.english: And Absalom sent for Ahithophel the Gilonite, one of David's helpers, from Giloh his town, while he was making the offerings. And the design against David became strong, for more and more people were joined to Absalom.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi to nu sɛrɛxɛ bama Alatala bɛ Hebiron, a naxa Axitofeli xili Gilo taa kui. Axitofeli nu findixi Dawuda rasima nde nan na. Na waxati Abisalomi nu sɛnbɛ sɔtɔma, mixi gbegbe nu luma a sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And one came to David and said, The hearts of the men of Israel have gone after Absalom.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui mixi nde naxa a masen Dawuda bɛ, «Abisalomi rafan Isirayilakae ma.»

sentences.english: And David said to all his servants who were with him at Jerusalem, Come, let us go in flight, or not one of us will be safe from Absalom: let us go without loss of time, or he will overtake us quickly and send evil on us, and put the town to the sword.
sentences.susu: Na kui Dawuda naxa a fala a xa mixie bɛ Darisalamu, «Won xa won gi, xa na mu a ra Abisalomi fama nɛ won sɔntɔde. Wo xulun alako a naxa won li taa kui, a fa won faxa santidɛgɛma ra.»

sentences.english: And the king's servants said to the king, See, your servants are ready to do whatever the king says is to be done.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa mixie naxa a yaabi, «Mangɛ, i na wa fefe xɔn ma, muxu na i xanbi ra.»

sentences.english: So the king went out, taking with him all the people of his house, but for ten of his women, who were to take care of the house.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nun a xa mixie naxa keli a xɔnyi, e xa e gi. A naxa konyi ginɛ fu lu naa alako e xa mɛɛni mangɛ xa banxi ma.

sentences.english: And the king went out, and all his servants went after him, and made a stop at the Far House.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa bira mangɛ fɔxɔ ra kelife Darisalamu. E to banxi dɔnxɔɛ li, e naxa ti naa.

sentences.english: And all the people went on by his side; and all the Cherethites and all the Pelethites and all the men of Ittai of Gath, six hundred men who came after him from Gath, went on before the king.
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔrie, a xa sɔɔri Keretikae nun Peletakae, nun a xa sɔɔri kɛmɛ senni naxee keli Gati, e birin naxa dangi mangɛ ya tode ra.

sentences.english: Then the king said to Ittai the Gittite, Why are you coming with us? go back and keep with the king: for you are a man of another country, you are far from the land of your birth.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala Gatika Itayi bɛ, «Munfe ra i fan faxi muxu fɔxɔ ra? I xa lu be mangɛ nɛɛnɛ sɛɛti ma. Xɔɲɛ nan i ra, naxan ɲan bara keli a xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: It was only yesterday you came to us; why then am I to make you go up and down with us? for I have to go where I may; go back then, and take your countrymen with you, and may the Lord's mercy and good faith be with you.
sentences.susu: I faxi xoro nɛ. A mu lanma i xa lintan muxu fɔxɔ ra, barima n tan yati mu n sigade kolon. Wo xa gbilen, i tan nun i ngaxakerenyie. Alatala xa hinnɛ i ra a xa tinxinyi kui.»

sentences.english: And Ittai the Gittite in answer said, By the living Lord, and by the life of my lord the king, in whatever place my lord the king may be, for life or death, there will your servant be.
sentences.susu: Itayi naxa mangɛ yaabi, «Mangɛ, n xa a fala i bɛ Alatala ya xɔri, i siga dɛdɛ, n fan sigama naa. Xa na findi faxɛ ra, xa na findi kisi ra, n mu kelima i sɛɛti ma.»

sentences.english: And David said to Ittai, Go forward, then. And Ittai the Gittite went on, with all his men and all the little ones he had with him.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda naxa a fala Itayi bɛ, «Awa yire.» Na kui Itayi, a xa mixie, nun e xa denbayae naxa lu Dawuda fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And there was great weeping in all the country when all the people went through; and the king himself was waiting in the Kidron valley and all the people went by him in the direction of the olive-tree on the edge of the waste land.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin nu na wafe e xui itexi ra, e dangi tɛmui. Mangɛ nun a xa ɲama naxa Sediron xure di igiri, e kira suxu naxan sigama gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: Then Zadok came, and Abiathar, and with them the ark of God's agreement: and they put down the ark of God, till all the people from the town had gone by.
sentences.susu: Sadɔki nun Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie nu na na, Alatala xa kankira xaninfe ra. E naxa Alatala xa kankira ragoro, alako Abiyatari xa nu sɛrɛxɛe ba han ɲama xa gɛ minide taa kui.

sentences.english: And the king said to Zadok, Take the ark of God back into the town: if I have grace in the eyes of the Lord, he will let me come back and see it and his House again:
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala Sadɔki bɛ, «I xa Alatala xa kankira ragbilen taa kui. Xa Alatala wama hinnɛfe n na, a n nagbilenma nɛ, n xa a xa hɔrɔmɔlingira nun a xa kankira to.

sentences.english: But if he says, I have no delight in you: then, here I am; let him do to me what seems good to him.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa a sa li n ma fe mu rafan Alatala ma sɔnɔn, a sago xa raba.»

sentences.english: The king said further to Zadok the priest, See, you and Abiathar are to go back to the town in peace, with your two sons, Ahimaaz, your son, and Jonathan, the son of Abiathar.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ man naxa a fala sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Sadɔki bɛ, «Wo xa gbilen bɔɲɛsa kui, i tan nun i xa di Aximaasi, a nun Abiyatari nun a xa di Yonatan.

sentences.english: See, I will be waiting at the way across the river, in the waste land, till I get news from you.
sentences.susu: N luma gbengberenyi fiili ma, han n xibaaru sɔtɔma wo ra tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: So Zadok and Abiathar took the ark of God back to Jerusalem, and did not go away from there.
sentences.susu: Na kui Sadɔki nun Abiyatari naxa gbilen Darisalamu Alatala xa kankira ra, e fa lu mɛnni.

sentences.english: And David went up the slopes of the Mount of Olives weeping all the way, with his head covered and no shoes on his feet: and all the people who were with him, covering their heads, went up weeping.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun a xa ɲama naxa te Oliwi kira xɔn ma sunnunyi kui, e nu wama, e xunyi makotoxi, e sanyi igeli.

sentences.english: And word came to David, saying, Ahithophel is among those who are joined to Absalom. And David said, O Lord, let the wisdom of Ahithophel be made foolish.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, a Axitofeli nun Abisalomi birin na a ra yi fe kui. Dawuda naxa Ala maxandi, «Alatala, i xa Axitofeli xa marasie kana.»

sentences.english: Now when David had come to the top of the slope, where they gave worship to God, Hushai the Archite came to him in great grief with dust on his head:
sentences.susu: Dawuda to so geya fari, mixie nu salima dɛnnaxɛ, Xusayi Arika naxa fa a ralande, a xa donma ibɔɔxi a ma, xube soxi a xunyi ra sunnunyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: David said to him, If you go on with me, you will be a trouble to me:
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala a bɛ, «Xa i bira n fɔxɔ ra, i findima kote nan na n bɛ.

sentences.english: But if you go back to the town and say to Absalom, I will be your servant, O king; as in the past I have been your father's servant, so now I will be yours: then you will be able to keep Ahithophel's designs against me from being put into effect.
sentences.susu: I naxan nabama, i xa gbilen taa kui Abisalomi yire, i fa a fala a bɛ, ‹Mangɛ, n bara natɛ tongo n xa findi i xa konyi ra alɔ n a rabaxi i baba bɛ ki naxɛ.› Na ki i nɔma Axitofeli xa marasie xun nakanade n bɛ.

sentences.english: And have you not there Zadok and Abiathar the priests? so whatever comes to your ears from the king's house, give word of it to Zadok and Abiathar the priests.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Sadɔki nun Abiyatari fan na n malife. I na naxan yo mɛ mangɛ xa banxi kui, i xa a fala e bɛ.

sentences.english: See, they have with them their two sons, Ahimaaz, Zadok's son, and Jonathan, the son of Abiathar; by them you may send word to me of everything which comes to your ears.
sentences.susu: E fama e xa die Aximaasi nun Yonatan xɛɛde n yire i xa xibaaru ra.»

sentences.english: So Hushai, David's friend, went into the town, and Absalom came to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xanuntenyi Xusayi gbilen taa kui na nan ma. A tan nun Abisalomi naxa so Darisalamu tɛmui keren.

sentences.english: And when David had gone a little way past the top of the slope, Ziba, the servant of Mephibosheth, came to him, with two asses on which were two hundred cakes of bread and a hundred stems of dry grapes and a hundred summer fruits and a skin of wine.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to dangi geya xun tagi ra, a naxa naralan Mefiboseti xa konyi Siba ra. Sofale firin nu na a yi ra, taami kɛmɛ firin bakixi e fari, tamare mɔɔli nde suxui kɛmɛ, xɔrɛ xaraxi debe kɛmɛ, nun wɛni lului keren.

sentences.english: And David said to Ziba, What is your reason for this? And Ziba said, The asses are for the use of the king's people, and the bread and the fruit are food for the young men; and the wine is for drink for those who are overcome by weariness in the waste land.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «I munse rabama yi birin na?» Siba naxa a yaabi, «Sofalee findima mangɛ xa mixi maxanin see ra, taami nun xɔrɛ findima donse nan na fonikee bɛ, wɛni tan sɛnbɛ nan fima mixie ma naxee taganma gbengberenyi ma.»

sentences.english: And the king said, And where is your master's son? And Ziba said, He is still at Jerusalem: for he said, Today Israel will give back to me the kingdom of my father.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «I marigi xa di na minden?» Siba naxa a yaabi, «A na Darisalamu taa kui, barima a naxɛ, ‹Isirayilakae n baba xa mangɛya ragbilenma nɛ n ma to.›»

sentences.english: Then the king said to Ziba, Truly everything which was Mephibosheth's is yours. And Ziba said, I give honour to my lord, may I have grace in your eyes, my lord, O king!
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala Siba bɛ, «N bara Mefiboseti kɛ birin fi i ma.» Siba naxɛ, «Mangɛ n marigi, n bara i tantu. I xa hinnɛ n na kudɛi.»

sentences.english: And when King David came to Bahurim, a man of Saul's family named Shimei, the son of Gera, came out from there, calling curses after him.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda to Baxurimi li, Sɔlu xabilɛ xa mixi nde naxa mini naxan xili Simeyi. Gera xa di nan nu a ra. A naxa dankɛe rasiga Dawuda ma.

sentences.english: And he sent stones at David and at all the king's servants and at all the people and at all the men of war by his side, on the right hand and on the left.
sentences.susu: A naxa gɛmɛe mawoli Dawuda nun a xa mixie ma, naxee nu na e ɲɛrɛfe Dawuda xa ɲama nun a xa sɔɔrie tagi.

sentences.english: And Shimei said, with curses, Be gone, be gone, you man of blood, you good-for-nothing:
sentences.susu: Simeyi nu a dankama yi ki nɛ, «Keli be, keli be, i tan faxɛti sɛriyɛlatare.

sentences.english: The Lord has sent punishment on you for all the blood of the family of Saul, whose kingdom you have taken; and the Lord has given the kingdom to Absalom, your son: now you yourself are taken in your evil, because you are a man of blood.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa Sɔlu bɔnsɔɛ nii sare dɔxɔ i xun ma, i tan naxan findixi mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Alatala bara mangɛya ragbilen i xa di Abisalomi ma. Yi tɔɔrɛ bara findi i xa faxɛti sare ra.»

sentences.english: Then Abishai, the son of Zeruiah, said to the king, Is this dead dog to go on cursing my lord the king? let me go over and take off his head.
sentences.susu: Seruya xa di Abisayi naxa a fala mangɛ bɛ, «N marigi, munfe ra won a luma yi xɛmɛ xurutare xa mangɛ konbi? Sago fi n ma n xa a xunyi bolon a dɛ i.»

sentences.english: And the king said, What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah? Let him go on cursing, for the Lord has said, Put a curse on David, and who then may say, Why have you done so?
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a yaabi, «Seruya xa di, i mu na yi fe kui feo. Yi mixi n dankaxi nɛ, barima Alatala bara a yamari a xa n danka. Nde nɔma a falade a bɛ, ‹Munfe ra i yi rabama?›»

sentences.english: And David said to Abishai and to all his servants, You see how my son, the offspring of my body, has made designs against my life: how much more then may this Benjamite do so? Let him be, and let him go on cursing; for the Lord has given him orders.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Abisayi nun a xa mixie bɛ, «Xa n ma di barixi yati wama n faxafe, a mu findima n bɛ tɛrɛnna ra yi mixi fan xa n faxa naxan kelixi Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ! Wo a lu na. A xa n danka alɔ Alatala a yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: It may be that the Lord will take note of my wrongs, and give me back good in answer to his cursing of me today.
sentences.susu: Tɛmunde Alatala na n ma tɔɔrɛ to, a fama to dankɛ mafindide fe fanyi ra.»
