sentences.english: So David and his men went on their way: and Shimei went by the hillside parallel with them, cursing and sending stones and dust at him.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun a xa mixie naxa bira e xa kira fɔxɔ ra. Kɔnɔ Simeyi nu ɲɛrɛfe geya kanke Dawuda mabiri, a nu a danka, a nu gɛmɛ mawoli a ma, a nu xube rate a ma.

sentences.english: And the king and his people came tired to Jordan, and took their rest there.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nun a xa ɲama birin naxa e yonkinde li, e taganxi. Mɛnni e naxa e malabu.

sentences.english: And Absalom and the men of Israel came to Jerusalem, and Ahithophel was with him.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi nun a xa ɲama tan naxa so Darisalamu. Axitofeli fan nu na a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Then Hushai the Archite, David's friend, came to Absalom and said, Long life to the king, long life to the king!
sentences.susu: Dawuda xanuntenyi Xusa Arika to so Abisalomi yire, a naxa a fala a bɛ, «Kisi na mangɛ bɛ! Kisi na mangɛ bɛ!»

sentences.english: And Absalom said, Is this your love for your friend? why did you not go with your friend?
sentences.susu: Abisalomi naxa Xusa yaabi, «Xanunteya mu na i bɔɲɛ kui i boore bɛ? Munfe ra i mu bira i xanuntenyi fɔxɔ ra?»

sentences.english: And Hushai said to Absalom, Not so; I am for that man whom the Lord and this people and all the men of Israel have taken as king, and I will take my place with him.
sentences.susu: Xusa naxa Abisalomi yaabi, «Ade! N tan birama mixi nan fɔxɔ ra Alatala nun Isirayila ɲama naxan sugandixi. N wama lufe na nan sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And more than this! where is my place as a servant? is it not before his son? as I have been your father's servant, so will I be yours.
sentences.susu: A nun, a lanma n xa Dawuda xa di rabatu. A xa di mu i ra? N walima nɛ i bɛ alɔ n wali i baba bɛ ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Absalom said to Ahithophel, Give your opinion now, what are we to do?
sentences.susu: Abisalomi naxa a fala Axitofeli bɛ, «Yakɔsi, a lanma won xa munse raba?»

sentences.english: And Ahithophel said to Absalom, Go in to your father's women who are here looking after his house; then all Israel will have the news that you are hated by your father, and the hands of your supporters will be strong.
sentences.susu: Axitofeli naxa a fala Abisalomi bɛ, «I xa i sa i baba xa konyi ginɛe fɛ ma a naxee luxi mangɛ banxi kui. Na kui Isirayilaka birin a kolonma nɛ xɔnnanteya bara lu i tan nun i baba tagi. I xa mixie limaniyama nɛ i xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: So they put up the tent for Absalom on the top of the house, and Absalom went in to his father's women before the eyes of all Israel.
sentences.susu: E to kiri banxi ti mangɛ banxi fari, Abisalomi naxa a sa a baba xa konyi ginɛe fɛ ma Isirayila ɲama ya xɔri.

sentences.english: In those days the opinions of Ahithophel were valued as highly as if through him a man might get direction from God; so were they valued by David as much as by Absalom.
sentences.susu: Na waxati Abisalomi nun Dawuda birin nu birama Axitofeli xa marasie fɔxɔ ra, alɔ marasie naxee kelixi Ala ma.

sentences.english: Then Ahithophel said to Absalom, Let me take out twelve thousand men and this very night I will go after David:
sentences.susu: Axitofeli naxa a fala Abisalomi bɛ, «A lu n xa mixi wulu fu nun firin mayegeti, n xa siga Dawuda fɔxɔ ra to kɔɛ ra yati.

sentences.english: And I will come up with him when he is tired and feeble, and make him full of fear: and all the people with him will go in flight; and I will make an attack on the king only:
sentences.susu: N a lima naa, a taganxi, limaniya yo mu na a bɛ, fo gaaxui. Na kui ɲama e gima nɛ, n fa mangɛ faxa a keren.

sentences.english: And I will make all the people come back to you as a bride comes back to her husband: it is the life of only one man you are going after; so all the people will be at peace.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n ɲama birin malanma, e xa gbilen i ma. Na fatanma Dawuda xa faxɛ nan na. Ɲama fama lude bɔɲɛsa kui na ki nɛ.»

sentences.english: And the saying was pleasing to Absalom and to the responsible men of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na masenyi naxa rafan Abisalomi nun Isirayila kuntigie birin ma.

sentences.english: Then Absalom said, Now send for Hushai the Archite, and let us give ear to what he has to say.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi naxa a fala, «Wo Xusa Arika xili. Won xa na fan xui ramɛ.»

sentences.english: And when Hushai came, Absalom said to him, This is what Ahithophel has said: are we to do as he says? if not, what is your suggestion?
sentences.susu: Xusa to fa, Abisalomi naxa a fala a bɛ, «Axitofeli xa marasi nan ya. I tan a toma di? A lanma ka a mu lanma?»

sentences.english: And Hushai said to Absalom, Ahithophel's idea is not a good one at this time.
sentences.susu: Xusa naxa a yaabi, «Yi biyaasi, Axitofeli xa marasi mu fan.

sentences.english: Hushai said further, You have knowledge of your father and his men, that they are men of war, and that their feelings are bitter, like those of a bear in the field whose young ones have been taken from her: and your father is a man of war, and will not take his night's rest with the people;
sentences.susu: I i baba kolon, i a xa sɔɔrie kolon. Gbangbalanyie nan e ra, e xaaɲɛ alɔ yɛtɛ naxan xa die baxi a yi. I baba gere kolon. A mu xima ɲama ya ma.

sentences.english: But he will certainly have taken cover now in some hole or secret place; and if some of our people, at the first attack, are overcome, then any hearing of it will say, There is destruction among the people who are on Absalom's side.
sentences.susu: A lima yakɔsi a ɲan bara a nɔxun geya yire nde. I xa mixi nde na faxa na gere kui, ɲama fama nɛ a falade, ‹Abisalomi xa mixie bara sɔntɔ a ɲaaxi ra!›

sentences.english: Then even the strongest, whose heart is like the heart of a lion, will become like water; for all Israel is conscious that your father is a man of war, and those who are with him are strong and without fear.
sentences.susu: Limaniya fama nɛ bade mixie yi ra, hali sɔɔri xɔrɔxɔɛe. Isirayila i baba kolon sɔɔri ra, e a xa mixie kolon gbangbalanyie ra.»

sentences.english: But my suggestion is that all Israel, from Dan as far as Beer-sheba, comes together to you, a great army like the sands of the sea in number; and that you yourself go out among them.
sentences.susu: «N ma marasi nan ya. I xa Isirayila birin malan kelife Dana ma han Beriseeba. I xa mixie na wuya alɔ mɛyɛnyi naxan na baa dɛ ra, i tan yati fama e rasode gere kui.

sentences.english: Then we will come on him in some place, wherever he may be, falling on him as the dew comes on the earth: and of him and all the men who are with him not one will get away with his life.
sentences.susu: A na dɛdɛ, won fama a tode, won fama nɛ gorode a ma, alɔ xini goroma bɔxi ma ki naxɛ. Mixi keren mu luma e ya ma, muxu fama Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔri birin faxade.

sentences.english: And if he has gone into some town, then let all Israel take strong cords to that town, and we will have it pulled into the valley, till not one small stone is to be seen there.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa a nɔxun taa nde kui, Isirayilakae fama na taa tɛtɛ gɛmɛe bɛndunde luutie ra han tɛtɛ birin ba naa.»

sentences.english: Then Absalom and all the men of Israel said, Hushai's suggestion is better than that of Ahithophel. For it was the purpose of the Lord to make the wise designs of Ahithophel without effect, so that the Lord might send evil on Absalom.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi nun Isirayila kuntigie naxa a fala, «Xusa Arika xa marasi nan fan dangi Axitofeli xa marasi ra.» Alatala nu bara Axitofeli xa marasi kɔɔtaxi xun nakana, alako Abisalomi xa tɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: Then Hushai said to Zadok and Abiathar, the priests, This is the suggestion made by Ahithophel to Absalom and the responsible men of Israel, and this is what I said to them.
sentences.susu: Xusa naxa a fala Sadɔki nun Abiyatari sɛrɛxɛdubɛe bɛ, «Axitofeli bara Abisalomi nun Isirayila forie rasi marasi nde ra, kɔnɔ n tan bara e rasi fe gbɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: So now send the news quickly to David, and say, Do not take your night's rest by the way across the river to the waste land, but be certain to go over; or the king and all the people with him will come to destruction.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi wo xa xɛɛraya iba Dawuda bɛ keren na, a falafe ra, ‹I naxa lu fiili ma gbengberenyi sɛɛti ma to kɔɛ ra de. I xa dangi naa ra pon, alako mangɛ nun a xa mixie naxa sɔntɔ.›»

sentences.english: Now Jonathan and Ahimaaz were waiting by En-rogel; and a servant-girl went from time to time and gave them news and they went with the news to King David, for it was not wise for them to let themselves be seen coming into the town.
sentences.susu: Yonatan nun Aximaasi nu na En Rogeli. Konyi ginɛ nde naxa siga Xusa xa masenyi falade e bɛ, alako e fan xa siga na xɛɛraya ibade Dawuda bɛ. E nu na En Rogeli nɛ barima e mu nu suusama lude Darisalamu taa kui.

sentences.english: But a boy saw them, and gave word of it to Absalom: so the two of them went away quickly, and came to the house of a man in Bahurim who had a water-hole in his garden, and they went down into it.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ fonike nde naxa e to, a sa na fe dɛntɛgɛ Abisalomi bɛ. Yonatan nun Aximaasi naxa e xulun, e sa so Baxurimi taa kui mixi nde xɔnyi. E naxa goro na mixi xa kɔlɔnyi kui, naxan nu na a xa fɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And a woman put a cover over the hole, and put crushed grain on top of it, and no one had any knowledge of it.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ nde naxa dugi sa na kɔlɔnyi dɛ ra, a fa sansi xɔri dinxi sa na dugi fari, alako mixi naxa sogi fe nde ma.

sentences.english: And Absalom's servants came to the woman at the house and said, Where are Ahimaaz and Jonathan? And the woman said to them, They have gone from here to the stream. And after searching for them, and seeing nothing of them, they went back to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi xa sɔɔrie naxa so na ginɛ xa banxi kui, e naxa a maxɔrin, «Aximaasi nun Yonatan na minden?» Ginɛ naxa e yaabi, «E bara xure igiri.» Abisalomi xa sɔɔrie naxa e fen, kɔnɔ e mu e to. Na tɛmui e naxa gbilen Darisalamu.

sentences.english: Then after the servants had gone away, they came up out of the water-hole and went to give King David the news; and they said, Get up and go quickly over the water, for such and such are Ahithophel's designs against you.
sentences.susu: E to gbilen, Aximaasi nun Yonatan naxa te kɔlɔnyi ra, e siga a fala Dawuda bɛ, «Wo xa xure igiri mafurenyi ra. Axitofeli bara yi marasi fi Abisalomi ma wo xili ma.»

sentences.english: So David and all the people who were with him went up over Jordan: when dawn came, every one of them had gone over Jordan.
sentences.susu: Na kui Dawuda nun a xa ɲama naxa Yurudɛn igiri subaxɛ ma, e mu mixi keren lu e xanbi ra.

sentences.english: Now when Ahithophel saw that his suggestion was not acted on, he got his ass ready, and went back to his house, to the town where he came from, and having put his house in order, he put himself to death by hanging; so he came to his end and was put in the resting-place of his father.
sentences.susu: Axitofeli to a to a Abisalomi mu a xa marasi suxuxi, a naxa baki a xa sofale fari, a gbilen a bari taa kui. A naxa a xa fee yailan, a fa a yɛtɛ gbaku. A faxa na ki nɛ. E naxa sa a ragata a baba xa gaburi sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And David came to Mahanaim. And Absalom, with all the men of Israel, went over Jordan.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa so Maxanayimi. Abisalomi nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa Yurudɛn xure igiri.

sentences.english: And Absalom put Amasa at the head of the army in place of Joab. Now Amasa was the son of a man named Ithra the Ishmaelite, who had been the lover of Abigail, the daughter of Jesse, sister of Zeruiah, Joab's mother.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi naxa Amasa ti a xa sɔɔrie yarerati ra, Yowaba ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Amasa findi Yeteri xa di nan na, naxan Naxasa xa di ginɛ Abigayili dɔxɔ. Abigayili findi Yowaba nga Seruya xunya nan na.

sentences.english: And Israel and Absalom put up their tents in the land of Gilead.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi nun a xa ɲama naxa yonkin Galadi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Now when David had come to Mahanaim, Shobi, the son of Nahash of Rabbah, the Ammonite, and Machir, the son of Ammiel of Lo-debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,
sentences.susu: Dawuda to so Maxanayimi taa kui, Naxasa xa di Soobi, naxan kelixi Raba taa kui Amonikae xa bɔxi ma, a nun Amiyɛli xa di Makiri, naxan kelixi Lodebara, a nun Barasilayi, naxan kelixi Rogelimi taa kui Galadi bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: Came with beds and basins and pots, and grain and meal, and all sorts of dry foods,
sentences.susu: nee naxa fa yi se birin na Dawuda xa mixie bɛ: sadee, piletie, fɛɲɛe, fundenyi maniyɛ, mɛngi maniyɛ, farin, sansi xɔri ganxie, toge mɔɔli firin,

sentences.english: And honey and butter and sheep and milk-cheeses, for David and his people: for they said, This people is in the waste land, needing food and drink and rest.
sentences.susu: kumi, yɛxɛɛ nun ninge xiɲɛ. E naxa fa na birin na Dawuda nun a xa ɲama xɔn ma, alako e xa e dɛge, barima e nu yi nan falama, «Yi ɲama bara tagan. Kaamɛ nun ye xɔli nan e suxuxi gbengberenyi ma yi ki.»

sentences.english: And David had the people who were with him numbered, and he put over them captains of thousands and captains of hundreds.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a xa sɔɔrie kɔnti, a mangɛe sugandi gali die bɛ, mixi wulu keren nun mixi kɛmɛ daaxi.

sentences.english: And David sent the people out, a third of them under the orders of Joab, and a third under the orders of Abishai, son of Zeruiah, Joab's brother, and a third under Ittai the Gittite. And the king said to the people, And I myself will certainly go out with you.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a xa sɔɔrie itaxun dɔxɔ saxan na. A singe xunyi naxa findi Yowaba ra, a firin nde xunyi naxa findi Seruya xa di Abisayi ra, Yowaba xunya, a saxan nde xunyi naxa findi Itayi ra, Gatika. Mangɛ Dawuda naxa a fala e bɛ, «N fan luma wo sɛɛti ma yi gere kui.»

sentences.english: But the people said, It is better for you not to go out: for if we are put to flight, they will not give a thought to us, and if death overtakes half of us, it will be nothing to them: but you are of more value than ten thousand of us: so it is better for you to be ready to come to our help from this town.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a xa sɔɔrie naxa tondi, a falafe ra, «A mu lanma i fan xa so gere kui. Xa muxu sa muxu gima nɛ, na mu findima fefe ra e bɛ. Hali won ma gali die sɛɛti sa faxa nɛ, na tide mu luma e bɛ. Kɔnɔ i tan tide dangi sɔɔri wulu fu ra. A fan ki ma, a lanma i xa lu taa kui, alako i xa nɔ minide muxu malide xa fee mu sa sɔɔnɛya.»

sentences.english: And the king said to them, I will do whatever seems best to you. So the king took his place by the door of the town, and all the people went out by hundreds and by thousands.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa e yaabi, a naxɛ, «Awa, wo sago.» Gali die naxa mini e dɔxɔ ki ma mixi wulu nun mixi kɛmɛ daaxi, mangɛ fan nu tixi taa naadɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the king gave orders to Joab and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Because of me, be gentle to the young man Absalom. And this order about Absalom was given in the hearing of all the people.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa Yowaba, Abisayi, nun Itayi yamari, «Wo naxa fe xɔrɔxɔɛ raba Abisalomi ra n ma fe xanunteya ma.» Ɲama birin naxa mangɛ xa yaamari mɛ, a naxan falaxi sɔɔri yareratie bɛ Abisalomi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: So the people went out into the field against Israel, and the fight took place in the woods of Ephraim.
sentences.susu: Gali die naxa mini taa fari ma Isirayila gerede. Gere naxa sin yɛ Efirami fɔtɔnyi kui.

sentences.english: And the people of Israel were overcome there by the servants of David, and there was a great destruction that day, and twenty thousand men were put to the sword.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa sɔɔrie naxa xunnakeli fanyi sɔtɔ, e Isirayilaka wulu mɔxɔɲɛn faxa na lɔxɔɛ kerenyi.

sentences.english: And the fighting went on over all the face of the country: and the woods were responsible for more deaths than the sword.
sentences.susu: Gere naxa din bɔxi birin na. Sɔɔri gbegbe naxa lɔɛ fɔtɔnyi kui dangi a faxaxie ra santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: And Absalom came across some of David's men. And Absalom was seated on his mule, and the mule went under the thick branches of a great tree, and his head became fixed in the tree and he was lifted up between earth and heaven, and the beast under him went on.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa sɔɔrie naxa Abisalomi li fɔtɔnyi kui. A xa sofale tixi wuri xungbe nde bun ma, Abisalomi xunsɛxɛ kuye kankanxi wuri salonyie ma, a fa singan kuye ma. A xa sofale naxa a gi.

sentences.english: And a certain man saw it and said to Joab, I saw Absalom hanging in a tree.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri nde to na to, a naxa sa a fala Yowaba bɛ, a naxɛ, «N bara Abisalomi to, a gbakuxi wuri xungbe nde ra.»

sentences.english: And Joab said to the man who had given him the news, If you saw this, why did you not put your sword through him, and I would have given you ten bits of silver and a band for your robe?
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa a yaabi, «I to a to, munfe ra i mu a faxa keren na? Xa i na raba nu, n gbeti kole fu nun bɛlɛti keren nan fima i ma na fe rabaxi sare ra.»

sentences.english: And the man said to Joab, Even if you gave me a thousand bits of silver, I would not put out my hand against the king's son: for in our hearing the king gave orders to you and Abishai and Ittai, saying, Take care that the young man Absalom is not touched.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ naxa a fala Yowaba bɛ, «Hali i gbeti kole wulu keren fi n ma, n mu dinma mangɛ xa di xɛmɛ ra, barima mangɛ i tan nun Abisayi yamari muxu birin ya xɔri nɛ, ‹Wo naxa fe xɔrɔxɔɛ raba Abisalomi ra n ma fe xanunteya ma.›

sentences.english: And if I had falsely put him to death (and nothing may be kept secret from the king), you would have had nothing to do with me.
sentences.susu: Xa n sa na fe raba nu, sese mu nɔma n tangade mangɛ ma, naxan fama fe birin kolonde. Hali i tan mu nɔma n natangade a ma.»

sentences.english: Then Joab said, I would have made it safe for you. And he took three spears in his hand, and put them through Absalom's heart, while he was still living, in the branches of the tree.
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa a fala a bɛ, «N mu luma be n dɛ makanafe ra i bɛ.» A naxa tanbɛ saxan tongo, a sa e banban Abisalomi sondonyi ma. Han na waxati Abisalomi nu gbakuxi wuri ma, a mu nu faxaxi.

sentences.english: And ten young men, servants of Joab, came round Absalom and put an end to him.
sentences.susu: Sɛgɛtala fu naxee nu Yowaba xa geresosee maxaninma, nee naxa Abisalomi rabilin, e a bɔnbɔ han a faxa.

sentences.english: And Joab had the horn sounded, and the people came back from going after Israel, for Joab kept them back.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yowaba naxa sara fe, alako ɲama xa gbilen Isirayilakae fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And they took Absalom's body and put it into a great hole in the wood, and put a great mass of stones over it: and every man of Israel went in flight to his tent.
sentences.susu: E naxa Abisalomi tongo, e a sa yili xungbe nde kui fɔtɔnyi tagi, e gɛmɛ gbegbe koto a fari. Isirayilaka birin naxa e gi, e naxa siga e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Now Absalom, before his death, had put up for himself a pillar in the king's valley, naming it after himself; for he said, I have no son to keep my name in memory: and to this day it is named Absalom's pillar.
sentences.susu: Abisalomi nu bara gɛmɛ tɔnxuma masoli, a a ti Mangɛ xa Gulunba kui. A nu bara a fala, «Di yo mu na n bɛ naxan n xili binyama.» Na kui a naxa a yɛtɛ xili sa na gɛmɛ tɔnxuma xun ma. Han to mixie na xilima «Abisalomi xa gɛmɛ tɔnxuma.»

sentences.english: Then Ahimaaz, the son of Zadok, said, Let me go and give the king news of how the Lord has done right in his cause against those who took up arms against him.
sentences.susu: Sadɔki xa di Aximaasi naxa a fala Yowaba bɛ, «A lu n xa sa a masen mangɛ bɛ a Alatala bara a rakisi a yaxui bɛlɛxɛ.»

sentences.english: And Joab said, You will take no news today; another day you may give him the news, but you will take no news today, because the king's son is dead.
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa a yaabi, «Na mu findima xibaaru fanyi xa ra to. Tɛmui gbɛtɛ i nɔma xibaaru fanyi masende mangɛ bɛ, kɔnɔ to mu lanma barima mangɛ xa di bara faxa.»

sentences.english: Then Joab said to the Cushite, Go and give the king word of what you have seen. And the Cushite, making a sign of respect to Joab, went off running.
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa a fala Kusika nde bɛ, «Siga, i sa a dɛntɛgɛ mangɛ bɛ i naxan toxi be.» Kusika to gɛ a xinbi sinde Yowaba bun ma, a naxa siga mafurenyi ra.

sentences.english: Then Ahimaaz, the son of Zadok, said to Joab again, Whatever may come of it, let me go after the Cushite. And Joab said, Why have you a desire to go, my son, seeing that you will get no reward for your news?
sentences.susu: Sadɔki xa di Aximaasi fan naxa a fala Yowaba bɛ, «Yandi, a lu n fan xa siga mangɛ yire Kusika fɔxɔ ra.» Yowaba naxa a yaabi, «N ma di, i wama sigafe munfe ra? Yi biyaasi mu findixi xibaaru fanyi ra.»

sentences.english: Whatever may come of it, he said, I will go. Then he said to him, Go. So Ahimaaz went running by the lowland road and overtook the Cushite.
sentences.susu: Aximaasi naxa a fala a bɛ, «A fa findi fefe ra, n tan wama sigafe na masenyi ra.» Yowaba naxa a yaabi, «Awa yire, siga.» Aximaasi naxa mini Yurudɛn gulunba biri ra, a dangi na Kusika ra.

sentences.english: Now David was seated between the two town doors; and the watchman went up to the roof of the doorways, on the wall, and, lifting up his eyes, saw a man running by himself.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nu dɔxɔxi taa naadɛ dɛ ra. Taa kantama naxa te tɛtɛ fari naadɛ biri ra. A to a ya rasiga, a naxa sa mixi nde to fa ra a keren.

sentences.english: And the watchman gave news of it to the king. And the king said, If he is coming by himself, then he has news. And the man was travelling quickly, and came near.
sentences.susu: Taa kantama to na fala a xui itexi ra, mangɛ naxa a fala, «Xa mixi keren na a ra, a na fafe xibaaru nan na.» Na xɛmɛ to nu na fafe,

sentences.english: Then the watchman saw another man running: and crying out in the direction of the door he said, Here is another man running by himself. And the king said, He, like the other, comes with news.
sentences.susu: taa kantama naxa mixi gbɛtɛ to, naxan na fafe a gi ra. A naxa a fala a xui itexi ra, «Mixi gbɛtɛ na fafe a gi ra.» Mangɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «Na fan fafe xibaaru nde nan na.»

sentences.english: And the watchman said, It seems to me that the running of the first is like the running of Ahimaaz, the son of Zadok. And the king said, He is a good man, and his news will be good.
sentences.susu: Taa kantama naxa a fala, «A luxi n bɛ alɔ Sadɔki xa di Aximaasi nan yare. N a gi ki kolon.» Mangɛ naxɛ, «Mixi fanyi nan a ra. A na fafe xibaaru fanyi nan na.»

sentences.english: And Ahimaaz, crying out to the king, said, It is well. And falling down before the king, with his face to the earth, he said, May the Lord your God be praised, who has given up the men who took up arms against my lord the king!
sentences.susu: Aximaasi to makɔrɛ mangɛ ra, a naxa a fala a xui itexi ra, «Gere bara sɔɔnɛya!» A naxa a yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma, a fa a fala, «Tantui na i Marigi Alatala bɛ, naxan n ma mangɛ yaxuie ragoroma a bun ma!»

sentences.english: And the king said, Is it well with the young man Absalom? And Ahimaaz said in answer, When Joab sent me, your servant, I saw a great outcry going on, but I had no knowledge of what it was.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «Abisalomi go, tana mu na n ma fonike ma?» Aximaasi naxa a yaabi, «Yowaba to n tan nun mangɛ xa konyi nde xɛɛ, fe nde nu na, kɔnɔ n mu a kolon fe naxan a ra.»

sentences.english: And the king said, Get back and take your place here. So turning to one side, he took his place there.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «Lu be sinden.» Aximaasi naxa ti a xati ma.

sentences.english: And then the Cushite came and said, I have news for my lord the king: today the Lord has done right in your cause against all those who took up arms against you.
sentences.susu: Kusika to so, a naxa a fala, «N ma mangɛ, n bara fa xibaaru nde ra i bɛ. To, Alatala bara i rakisi i yaxuie bɛlɛxɛ tinxinyi ra.»

sentences.english: And the king said to the Cushite, Is the young man Absalom safe? And the Cushite said in answer, May all the king's haters and those who do evil against the king, be as that young man is!
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «Abisalomi go, tana mu na n ma fonike ma?» A naxa a yaabi, «Mangɛ, mixi naxee fe ɲaaxi rabama i ra, nun i yaxuie birin na, e xa fe xa ɲɔn alɔ na fonike Abisalomi.»

sentences.english: And word was given to Joab that the king was weeping and sorrowing for Absalom.
sentences.susu: Na kui mangɛ naxa sunnun ki fanyi. A naxa te a xa konkoe kui taa naadɛ xun ma, a wama. A nu a fala a yɛtɛ ma, «N ma di Abisalomi, n ma di Abisalomi, a nu fisa n tan xa faxa i ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Abisalomi, n ma di. Ee, n ma di!»

sentences.english: And the salvation of that day was changed to sorrow for all the people: for it was said to the people, The king is in bitter grief for his son.
sentences.susu: E naxa na dɛntɛgɛ Yowaba bɛ, e naxɛ, «Mangɛ na wafe sunnunyi kui Abisalomi xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And the people made their way back to the town quietly and secretly, as those who are shamed go secretly when they go in flight from the war.
sentences.susu: E gere naxan geenixi na lɔxɔɛ, na naxa findi sunnunyi ra bɔxi birin bɛ, barima ɲama nu bara a mɛ a mangɛ tɔɔrɔxi a xa di Abisalomi xa faxɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: But the king, covering his face, gave a great cry, O my son Absalom, O Absalom, my son, my son!
sentences.susu: Sɔɔrie naxa so taa kui, e xun sinxi alɔ e na e gi gere ma yaagi kui.

sentences.english: And Joab came into the house to the king and said, Today you have put to shame the faces of all your servants who even now have kept you and your sons and your daughters and your wives and all your women safe from death;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a yatagi makoto, a nu fa gbelegbele a xui itexi ra, «N ma di Abisalomi! N ma di Abisalomi! N ma di!»

sentences.english: For your haters, it seems, are dear to you, and your friends are hated. For you have made it clear that captains and servants are nothing to you: and now I see that if Absalom was living and we had all been dead today, it would have been right in your eyes.
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa so mangɛ yire, a a fala a bɛ, «To i bara i xa sɔɔrie rayaagi, naxee i nii ratangaxi, a nun i xa die, i xa ginɛe, nun i xa konyi ginɛe.

sentences.english: So get up now, and go out and say some kind words to your servants; for, by the Lord, I give you my oath, that if you do not go out, not one of them will keep with you tonight; and that will be worse for you than all the evil which has overtaken you from your earliest years.
sentences.susu: I mixie xanuma, naxee i xɔnxi, i mixie xɔnma, naxee i xanuxi. To i bara a masen a i xa sɔɔrie nun e xa yareratie tide yo mu na i bɛ. Xa muxu birin sa faxa nu fo Abisalomi, na nan nafanma i ma nu.

sentences.english: Then the king got up and took his seat near the town-door. And word was given to all the people that the king was in the public place: and all the people came before the king. Now all the men of Israel had gone back in flight to their tents.
sentences.susu: I naxan nabama, keli, i xa wɔyɛn fanyi fala i xa sɔɔrie bɛ. Xa na mu a ra, n bara n kali Alatala ra, beenu kɔɛ xa so i xa xɛmɛ birin kelima nɛ i xun ma to. Na fe xɔrɔxɔma i xa tɔɔrɛ birin bɛ i naxan kolon kabi i bari tɛmui.»

sentences.english: And through all the tribes of Israel the people were having arguments, saying, The king made us safe from the hands of those who were against us and made us free from the hands of the Philistines; and now he has gone in flight from the land, because of Absalom.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui mangɛ naxa mini, a a magoro taa naadɛ ra. Ɲama to na kolon, e naxa siga a yire. Isirayilaka naxee nu biraxi Abisalomi fɔxɔ ra, nee nu bara e gi na tɛmui e siga e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And Absalom, whom we made a ruler over us, is dead in the fight. So now why do you say nothing about getting the king back? And word of what all Israel was saying came to the king.
sentences.susu: Na bɔnsɔɛ birin nu a falama, «Mangɛ Dawuda bara won ba won yaxuie bɛlɛxɛ i, a tan nan won baxi Filisitakae yi ra, kɔnɔ a a gixi nɛ Abisalomi tan ya ra.

sentences.english: And King David sent word to Zadok and Abiathar, the priests, Say to the responsible men of Judah, Why are you the last to take steps to get the king back to his house?
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, Abisalomi, won naxan findi mangɛ ra, na bara faxa gere kui. Won munse mamɛfe, won mu sa mangɛ ragbilenma?»

sentences.english: You are my brothers, my bone and my flesh; why are you the last to get the king back again?
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda tan naxa a fala sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Sadɔki nun Abiyatari bɛ, «Wo a fala Yuda forie bɛ, ‹Munfe ra wo mu yarerati wali rabama mangɛ ragbilenfe ra a xɔnyi? Mangɛ ɲan bara Isirayila waxɔnfe mɛ.

sentences.english: And say to Amasa, Are you not my bone and my flesh? May God's punishment be on me, if I do not make you chief of the army before me at all times in place of Joab!
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyi nan wo ra, won wuli keren, fasɛ keren. Munfe ra wo na bufe mangɛ ragbilenfe ra?›

sentences.english: And the hearts of the men of Judah were moved like one man; so that they sent to the king, saying, Come back, with all your servants.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a fala Amasa fan bɛ, ‹Won wuli keren, fasɛ keren xa mu a ra? N bara n kali Ala ra, n i tima nɛ n ma sɔɔrie xa mangɛ ra Yowaba ɲɔxɔɛ ra kudɛi.›»

sentences.english: So the king came back, and came as far as Jordan. And Judah came to Gilgal, meeting the king there, to take him back with them over Jordan.
sentences.susu: Na kui Dawuda naxa a niya Yudakae birin xa lan a gbilenfe ma. E naxa xɛɛra xɛɛ mangɛ ma, a xa gbilen, a tan nun a xa mixi birin.

sentences.english: And Shimei, the son of Gera, the Benjamite from Bahurim, got up quickly and went down with the men of Judah for the purpose of meeting King David;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa gbilen fɔlɔ, a fa Yurudɛn xure li. Yudayakae naxa siga Giligali, e xa a rasɛnɛ.

sentences.english: And with him a thousand men of Benjamin, and Ziba, the servant of Saul, with his fifteen sons and twenty servants, came rushing to Jordan before the king,
sentences.susu: Gera xa di Simeyi, naxan kelixi Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ, naxan nu Dawuda dankaxi Baxurimi, a fan naxa siga mangɛ Dawuda ralande. Yudayakae nun

sentences.english: And kept going across the river to take the people of the king's house over, and to do whatever was desired by the king. And Shimei, the son of Gera, went down on his face in the dust before the king, when he was about to go over Jordan,
sentences.susu: Bunyaminka sɔɔri mixi wulu keren nan nu na a fɔxɔ ra. Siba, naxan nu bara wali Sɔlu xa denbaya bɛ, a tan nun a xa di fu nun suuli, a nun a xa konyi mɔxɔɲɛn, e fan naxa siga Yurudɛn xure mangɛ ralande.

sentences.english: And said to him, Let me not be judged as a sinner in your eyes, O my lord, and do not keep in mind the wrong I did on the day when my lord the king went out of Jerusalem, or take it to heart.
sentences.susu: Mixie nu na mangɛ xa ɲama malife xure igiride tɛmui naxɛ, Gera xa di Simeyi naxa bira mangɛ bun ma,

sentences.english: For your servant is conscious of his sin: and so, as you see, I have come today, the first of all the sons of Joseph, for the purpose of meeting my lord the king.
sentences.susu: a a mayandi, «N marigi, i naxa xɔnɛ ragata i bɔɲɛ kui n bɛ. I naxa i gbe ɲɔxɔ n ma fe ɲaaxi ra, n naxan nabaxi i ra i mini lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: But Abishai, the son of Zeruiah, said, Is not death the right fate for Shimei, because he has been cursing the one marked by the holy oil?
sentences.susu: N marigi, n bara n ma yunubi kolon. Na kui, to, n singe nan faxi i rasɛnɛde Yusufu xa mixie ya ma.»

sentences.english: And David said, What have I to do with you, you sons of Zeruiah, that you put yourselves against me today? is it right for any man in Israel to be put to death today? for I am certain today that I am king in Israel.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Seruya xa di Abisayi naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, «A mu lanma xɛ Simeyi xa faxa, barima a bara mangɛ danka, Alatala naxan sugandixi?»

sentences.english: So the king said to Shimei, You will not be put to death. And the king gave him his oath.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a yaabi, «Seruya xa die, munse na won tagi? Wo wama findife n yaxuie nan na to? A lanma mixi nde xa faxa to Isirayila bɔxi ma? N ɲan a kolon n bara gɛ mangɛya sɔtɔde to.»

sentences.english: And Mephibosheth, the son of Saul's son, came down for the purpose of meeting the king; his feet had not been cared for or his hair cut or his clothing washed from the day when the king went away till the day when he came back in peace.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala Simeyi bɛ, «N tan Isirayila mangɛ, n bara n kali, n mu i faxama.»

sentences.english: Now when he had come from Jerusalem to see the king, the king said to him, Why did you not come with me, Mephibosheth?
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa di Mefiboseti fan naxa siga mangɛ ralande. Kabi mangɛ Dawuda keli lɔxɔɛ Darisalamu, a mu a sanyie maxa, a mu a xa dugie xa, a mu a dɛ xabe yailan. A nu mamɛ tife nɛ mangɛ xa gbilen bɔɲɛsa kui.

sentences.english: And he said in answer, Because of the deceit of my servant, my lord king: for I, your servant, said to him, You are to make ready an ass and on it I will go with the king, for your servant has not the use of his feet.
sentences.susu: A to fa mangɛ ralande Darisalamu, mangɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «Mefiboseti, n to keli Darisalamu, munfe ra i mu bira n fɔxɔ ra nu?»

sentences.english: He has given you a false account of me: but my lord the king is like the angel of God: do then whatever seems good to you.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «N ma mangɛ, n tan mu a ra. Na lɔxɔɛ n ma konyi nan n madaxu. N a fala nɛ a bɛ a xa n baki n ma sofale fari sigafe ra mangɛ fɔxɔ ra. N nu a rabama na ki nɛ, barima n sanyie mu fan.

sentences.english: For all my father's family were only dead men before my lord the king: and still you put your servant among those whose place is at the king's table. What right then have I to say anything more to the king?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n ma konyi naxa siga n xun mafalade i xɔn. Yakɔsi, i tan naxan luxi alɔ Alatala xa malekɛ, i sagoe xa raba.

sentences.english: And the king said, Say nothing more about these things. I say, Let there be a division of the land between Ziba and you.
sentences.susu: A sɛriyɛ ki ma a nu lanma i xa n baba bɔnsɔɛ birin faxa e xa fe kobi xa fe ra i tan mabiri, kɔnɔ i bara tin n xa lu i xa denbaya ya ma, won birin xa won dɛgɛ yire keren. Na kui n mu nɔma i maxandide fefe ra fa.»

sentences.english: And Mephibosheth said, Let him take it all, now that my lord the king has come back to his house in peace!
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «I naxa wɔyɛnyi yo sa na fari. N bara natɛ tongo Siba xa bɔxie xa itaxun.»

sentences.english: And Barzillai the Gileadite came down from Rogelim; and he went on as far as Jordan with the king to take him across Jordan.
sentences.susu: Mefiboseti naxa a yaabi, «N tan bɛ a nɔma a birin tongode. N ɲɛlɛxinxi barima i tan mangɛ bara so to i kɛndɛxi ra.»

sentences.english: Now Barzillai was a very old man, as much as eighty years old: and he had given the king everything he had need of, while he was at Mahanaim, for he was a very great man.
sentences.susu: Barasilayi Galadika nu bara mangɛ mati han Yurudɛn xure keli Rogelimi. E to xure igiri, a naxa a ɲungu mangɛ ma.

sentences.english: And the king said to Barzillai, Come over with me, and I will take care of you in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Barasilayi xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ tongo solomasaxan li. A nu bara mɛɛni mangɛ ma a to siga Maxanayimi kelife Darisalamu. Kuntigi belebele nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: And Barzillai said to the king, How much of my life is still before me, for me to go up to Jerusalem with the king?
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala Barasilayi bɛ, «I xa lu n fɛ ma Darisalamu. N nan ɲɔxɔ sama nɛ i xɔn ma a fanyi ra.»

sentences.english: I am now eighty years old: good and bad are the same to me; have meat and drink any taste for me now? am I able to take pleasure in the voices of men or women in song? why then am I to be a trouble to my lord the king?
sentences.susu: Barasilayi naxa mangɛ yaabi, «A lanma n xa te Darisalamu? Ɲɛ yeri luxi n ma simaya ra fa?

sentences.english: Your servant's desire was only to take the king over Jordan; why is the king to give me such a reward?
sentences.susu: N bara ɲɛ tongo solomasaxan sɔtɔ, n bara tagan sɔnɔn. Hali donse nun minse fanyi, n dɛ mu nɔma na kolonde. N tuli mu nɔma sigi xui mɛde. A mu lanma n xa findi kote tun na n ma mangɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: Let your servant now go back again, so that when death comes to me, it may be in my town and by the resting-place of my father and mother. But here is your servant Chimham: let him go with my lord the king, and do for him what seems good to you.
sentences.susu: N man i matima nɛ dondoronti, kɔnɔ i wama yi hɛɛri mɔɔli fife n ma munfe ra?

sentences.english: And the king said in answer, Let Chimham go over with me, and I will do for him whatever seems good to you: and whatever your desire is, I will do it for you.
sentences.susu: Yandi, i xa diɲɛ n tan i xa konyi xa gbilen n baride, n xa sa faxa mɛnni, n nga nun n baba xa gaburi na dɛnnaxɛ. Kɔnɔ i naxan nabama n bɛ, i xa Kimehami xanin i xun ma, i xa a mali alɔ i wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Then all the people went over Jordan, and the king went over: and the king gave Barzillai a kiss, with his blessing; and he went back to his place.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala, «Awa, n xa Kimehami xanin n xun ma, n xa i waxɔnfe birin naba a bɛ.»

sentences.english: So the king went over to Gilgal, and Chimham went with him: and all the people of Judah, as well as half the people of Israel, took the king on his way.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin to Yurudɛn xure giri, mangɛ naxa Barasilayi sunbu, a duba a bɛ. Na tɛmui Barasilayi naxa gbilen a xɔnyi,

sentences.english: Then the men of Israel came to the king and said, Why have our countrymen of Judah taken you away in secret and come over Jordan with the king and all his family, because all his people are David's men?
sentences.susu: mangɛ naxa siga Giligali, a nun Kimehami. Yuda ɲama nun Isirayila ɲama sɛɛti keren nan mangɛ mali Yurudɛn igiride.

sentences.english: And all the men of Judah gave this answer to the men of Israel, Because the king is our near relation: why then are you angry about this? have we taken any of the king's food, or has he given us any offering?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isirayila xɛmɛe naxa e mawa mangɛ xɔn, a falafe ra, «Muxu ngaxakerenyi Yudayakae i baxi muxu yi ra munfe ra? E tan i xa ɲama matixi munfe ra kelife ra Yurudɛn xure han i xɔnyi?»

sentences.english: And in answer to the men of Judah, the men of Israel said, We have ten parts in the king, and we are the first in order of birth: why did you make nothing of us? and were we not the first to make suggestions for getting the king back? And the words of the men of Judah were more violent than the words of the men of Israel.
sentences.susu: Yudaya xɛmɛe naxa Isirayilakae yaabi, e naxɛ, «Mangɛ kelixi muxu bɔnsɔɛ nɛ. A mu lanma wo xa xɔnɔ na fe ma. Muxu bara mangɛ makula donse ra? A bara muxu buɲa?»

sentences.english: Now by chance there was present a good-for-nothing person named Sheba, the son of Bichri, a Benjamite: and he, sounding the horn, said, We have no part in David, or any interest in the son of Jesse: let every man go to his tent, O Israel.
sentences.susu: Mixi sɛriyɛtare nde nu na, naxan nu xili Seeba, Bikiri xa di, fatanfe Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ ra. Seeba naxa feri fe Isirayila ɲama ma, a a fala e bɛ, «Won mu birama Dawuda fɔxɔ ra. Won nun Yisayi xa di mu na kɛ keren. Isirayila ɲama xa gbilen e xɔnyi!»

sentences.english: So all the men of Israel, turning away from David, went after Sheba, the son of Bichri: but the men of Judah were true to their king, going with him from Jordan as far as Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xɛmɛ birin naxa keli Dawuda xun ma, e bira Bikiri xa di Seeba fɔxɔ ra. Yudaya xɛmɛe tan naxa lu e xa mangɛ sɛɛti ma, e sa a mati kelife Yurudɛn xure ma, han Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And David came to his house at Jerusalem: and the king took the ten women to whom he had given the care of the house, and had them shut up, and gave them the necessaries of life, but did not go near them. So they were shut up till the day of their death, living as widows.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda to so a xɔnyi Darisalamu, a naxa a xa konyi ginɛ fu tongo, a nu bara naxee lu a xa banxi kantade, a e yigiya banxi makantaxi nde kui. A naxa a ɲɛngi sa e xɔn ma, kɔnɔ a nun e tan mu kafu sɔnɔn. E naxa lu na banxi kui e kaaɲɛ ki ma han e faxa.

sentences.english: Then the king said to Amasa, Get all the men of Judah together, and in three days be here yourself.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala Amasa bɛ, «Siga, sa Yudaya sɔɔrie malan beenun xi saxan wo xa be li.»

sentences.english: So Amasa went to get all the men of Judah together, but he took longer than the time David had given him.
sentences.susu: Amasa naxa siga na rabade, kɔnɔ a naxa dugundi.

sentences.english: And David said to Abishai, Sheba, the son of Bichri, will do us more damage than Absalom did; so take some of your lord's servants and go after him, before he makes himself safe in the walled towns, and gets away before our eyes.
sentences.susu: Na xi saxan to dangi, Dawuda naxa a fala Abisayi bɛ, «Yakɔsi Bikiri xa di Seeba fama won tɔɔrɔde dangife Abisalomi ra. I xa n ma sɔɔrie tongo, wo xa siga a fende, alako a naxa a nɔxun taa makantaxi nde kui, a fa lɔɛ won ma.»

sentences.english: So there went after Abishai, Joab and the Cherethites and the Pelethites and all the fighting-men; they went out of Jerusalem to overtake Sheba, the son of Bichri.
sentences.susu: Yowaba xa mixie fan naxa bira Abisayi fɔxɔ ra, a nun Keretikae nun Peletakae. E birin naxa mini Darisalamu ra, sigafe Bikiri xa di Seeba fende.

sentences.english: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came face to face with them. Now Joab had on his war-dress, and round him a band from which his sword was hanging in its cover; and while he was walking, it came out, falling to the earth.
sentences.susu: E to fanye xungbe yire li Gabayon, Amasa naxa mini e ya ra. Yowaba nu bara a xa finɛ tɛɛ xiri a xa geresose donma tagi. A to nu makɔrɛfe Amasa ra, a xa finɛ naxa mini a tɛɛ kui a bira.

sentences.english: And Joab said to Amasa, Is it well, my brother? And with his right hand he took him by the hair of his chin to give him a kiss.
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa Amasa xɛɛbu, «A rabaxi di ngaxakerenyi?» A naxa a dɛxabe suxu a yire fanyi bɛlɛxɛ ra xɛɛbui kui.

sentences.english: But Amasa did not see danger from the sword which was now in Joab's left hand, and Joab put it through his stomach so that his inside came out on to the earth, and he did not give him another blow. So Joab and his brother Abishai went on after Sheba, the son of Bichri.
sentences.susu: Amasa mu a ɲɔxɔ sa finɛ xɔn ma naxan nu na Yowaba kɔɔla bɛlɛxɛ i. Yowaba naxa Amasa furi sɔxɔ, a a furingɛe ramini kɛnɛ ma, a naxa faxa keren na. Na tɛmui Yowaba nun a xunya Abisayi naxa siga Bikiri xa di Seeba fende.

sentences.english: And one of Joab's young men, taking his place at Amasa's side, said, Whoever is for Joab and for David, let him go after Joab!
sentences.susu: Yowaba xa mixi nde naxa ti Amasa fure fɛ ma, a a fala a xui itexi ra ɲama bɛ, «Naxan na Yowaba nun Dawuda bɛ, wo xa bira Yowaba fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: And Amasa was stretched out in a pool of blood in the middle of the highway. And when the man saw that all the people were stopping, he took Amasa out of the highway and put him in a field, with a cloth over him, when he saw that everyone who went by came to a stop.
sentences.susu: Amasa to nu saxi a wuli xɔɔra kira tagi, ɲama fan nu tixi naa a matode. Na kui Yowaba xa na mixi naxa Amasa fure bɛndun sɛxɛ xɔɔra, a dugi nde felen a ma, alako ɲama naxa ti naa a matode.

sentences.english: When he had been taken off the road, all the people went on after Joab in search of Sheba, the son of Bichri.
sentences.susu: A to a ba kira ra, ɲama naxa bira Yowaba fɔxɔ ra, sigafe Bikiri xa di Seeba fende.

sentences.english: And Sheba went through all the tribes of Israel, to Abel of Beth-maacah; and all the Bichrites came together and went in after him.
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa dangi Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe birin na sigafe ra taa nde naxan xili Abeli Beti Maaka longori ra. Berimukae fan naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And Joab and his men got him shut up in Abel of Beth-maacah, and put up an earthwork against the town: and all Joab's men did their best to get the wall broken down.
sentences.susu: E birin naxa Abeli Beti Maaka rabilin, Seeba nu na na taa kui. E naxa bɛndɛ malan tɛtɛ kanke, alako e xa a rabira, e xa so taa kui.

sentences.english: Then a wise woman got up on the wall, and crying out from the town, said, Give ear, give ear; say now to Joab, Come near, so that I may have talk with you.
sentences.susu: Na kui ginɛ xaxilima nde naxa a fala a xui itexi ra kelife tɛtɛ kui, a naxɛ, «Wo wo tuli mati! Wo Yowaba xili n bɛ a xa fa be, muxu xa wɔyɛn.»

sentences.english: And he came near, and the woman said, Are you Joab? And he said in answer, I am. Then she said, Give ear to your servant's words. And he said, I am giving ear.
sentences.susu: Yowaba to a makɔrɛ, na ginɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «Yowaba nan i ra?» A naxa a yaabi, «Iyo.» A naxa a fala a bɛ, «I tuli mati n tan i xa konyi ginɛ xui ra.» A naxɛ, «Awa.»

sentences.english: Then she said, In the old days, there was a saying, Let them put the question in Abel and in Dan, saying, Has what was ordered by men of good faith in Israel ever come to an end?
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala, «Birin a kolon kabi tɛmui xɔnkuye, yi Abeli taa findixi xaxilima yire nan na. Mixie fama be nɛ tɛmui birin marasi fende.

sentences.english: Your purpose is the destruction of a mother-town in Israel: why would you put an end to the heritage of the Lord?
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa taa nde nan Abeli ra naxan bɔɲɛsa kolon dangi a birin na. Munfe ra i wama taa kanafe naxan findixi Alatala gbe ra?»

sentences.english: And Joab, answering her, said, Far, far be it from me to be a cause of death or destruction;
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa a yaabi, «Ala xa n natanga na ma. N mu wama Abeli Beti Maaka kanafe.

sentences.english: Not so: but a man of the hill-country of Ephraim, Sheba, son of Bichri, by name, has taken up arms against the king, against David: give up this man only, and I will go away from the town. And the woman said to Joab, His head will be dropped over the wall to you.
sentences.susu: Muxu faxi Efiramika nde nan fɔxɔ ra, Bikiri xa di Seeba. A bara mangɛ Dawuda matandi. Xa wo a so muxu yi, muxu kelima nɛ be keren na.» Ginɛ naxa a yaabi, «Muxu a xunyi nan wolima wo ma tɛtɛ fari ma.»

sentences.english: Then the woman in her wisdom had talk with all the town. And they had Sheba's head cut off and sent out to Joab. And he had the horn sounded, and sent them all away from the town, every man to his tent. And Joab went back to Jerusalem to the king.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ naxa wɔyɛn a xa mixie ra xaxilimaya ra. E naxa Bikiri xa di Seeba xunyi bolon a dɛ i, e a woli tɛtɛ fari ma, Yowaba nun a xa mixie ma. Yowaba to na to, a naxa feri fe, a xa mixie birin naxa gbilen e xɔnyi. Yowaba naxa siga mangɛ yire Darisalamu.

sentences.english: Now Joab was over all the army; and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, was at the head of the Cherethites and the Pelethites;
sentences.susu: Yowaba nan nu na Isirayila sɔɔrie xa mangɛ ra. Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya nan nu na Keretikae nun Peletakae xunyi ra.

sentences.english: And Adoram was overseer of the forced work; and Jehoshaphat, the son of Ahilud, was the recorder;
sentences.susu: Adorami nan nu na mangɛ xa walikɛe xa yarerati ra. Axiludu xa di Yehosafati nan nu na mangɛ xa kɛɛdi makantade xunyi ra.

sentences.english: And Sheva was the scribe, and Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
sentences.susu: Sewa nan nu a xa sɛbɛliti ra. Sadɔki nun Abiyatari nan nu na sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xunyie ra.

sentences.english: And in addition, Ira the Jairite was a priest to David.
sentences.susu: Ira Yayirika nan nun na Dawuda xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra.

sentences.english: In the days of David they were short of food for three years, year after year; and David went before the Lord for directions. And the Lord said, On Saul and on his family there is blood, because he put the Gibeonites to death.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa waxati, kaamɛ sin nɛ bɔxi ma ɲɛ saxan. Dawuda to Alatala maxɔrin na fe keli fe naxan ma, a naxa a yaabi, «A kelixi Sɔlu nun a bɔnsɔɛ Gabayonkae faxafe nan ma.»

sentences.english: Then the king sent for the Gibeonites; (now the Gibeonites were not of the children of Israel, but were the last of the Amorites, to whom the children of Israel had given an oath; but Saul, in his passion for the children of Israel and Judah, had made an attempt on their lives:)
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa Gabayonkae xili, e xa dɛ masara. Isirayilakae mu nu e tan na. Amorikae nan nu e ra, naxee nu bara saata e nun Isirayilakae ra. Kɔnɔ Sɔlu na saatɛ kana nɛ, a e gere Isirayila nun Yudaya bɛ.

sentences.english: So David said to the Gibeonites, What may I do for you? how am I to make up to you for your wrongs, so that you may give a blessing to the heritage of the Lord?
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Gabayonkae bɛ, «N nɔma munse rabade wo bɛ, naxan nɔma a niyade wo xa diɲɛ Alatala xa ɲama Isirayila ma?»

sentences.english: And the Gibeonites said to him, It is not a question of silver and gold between us and Saul or his family; and it is not in our power to put to death any man in Israel. And he said, Say, then, what am I to do for you?
sentences.susu: Gabayonkae naxa a yaabi, «Gbeti nun xɛɛma fe mu na muxu nun Sɔlu bɔnsɔɛ tagi. Muxu tan mu nɔma mixi yo faxade Isirayila bɔxi ma.» Mangɛ naxa a fala, «Wo naxan yo fala, n na nan nabama wo bɛ.»

sentences.english: And they said to the king, As for the man by whom we were wasted, and who made designs against us to have us completely cut off from the land of Israel,
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala mangɛ bɛ, «Sɔlu nu wama muxu sɔntɔfe nɛ, muxu xa ɲɔn Isirayila bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Let seven men of his family be given up to us and we will put an end to them by hanging them before the Lord in Gibeon, on the hill of the Lord. And the king said, I will give them.
sentences.susu: Na kui a bɔnsɔɛ mixi solofere xa sa muxu sagoe, e binbie xa sa Alatala ya i Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Sɔlu xa taa kui, dɛnnaxɛ xili falama Gibeya.» Mangɛ Dawuda naxa e yaabi, «N e sama nɛ wo sagoe.»

sentences.english: But the king did not give up Mephibosheth, the son of Saul's son Jonathan, because of the Lord's oath made between David and Jonathan, the son of Saul.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ mu tin Sɔlu xa mamadi Mefiboseti sode e yi ra. Yonatan xa di nan nu na ra. Dawuda nu bara a kali Sɔlu xa di Yonatan bɛ a mu fe ɲaaxi yo rabama a xa denbaya ra.

sentences.english: But the king took Armoni and Mephibosheth, the two sons of Saul to whom Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah, had given birth; and the five sons of Saul's daughter Merab, whose father was Adriel, the son of Barzillai the Meholathite:
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa Aya xa di ginɛ Risipa, xa di xɛmɛ firin tongo, a naxee bari Sɔlu bɛ. Nee xili nɛ Aramoni nun Mefiboseti. A naxa Sɔlu xa di ginɛ Mikali, xa di xɛmɛ suuli fan tongo, a naxee bari Barasilayi xa di Adiriyeli bɛ, Mexolaka.

sentences.english: And he gave them up to the Gibeonites, and they put them to death, hanging them on the mountain before the Lord; all seven came to their end together in the first days of the grain-cutting, at the start of the cutting of the barley.
sentences.susu: A naxa na mixie so Gabayonkae yi ra, e fa e sangbon geya fari Alatala ya i lɔxɔɛ keren kui, naxan findixi xɛ xabɛ lɔxɔɛ singe ra.

sentences.english: And Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah, took haircloth, placing it on the rock as a bed for herself, from the start of the grain-cutting till rain came down on them from heaven; and she did not let the birds of the air come near them by day, or the beasts of the field by night.
sentences.susu: Aya xa di ginɛ Risipa naxa a xa kaaɲɛ dugi itala fanye fari furee nu na dɛnnaxɛ, a dɔxɔ a ma kelife xɛ xabɛ han tunɛ birɛ. A mu tin xɔnie xa goro furee ma yanyi ra, a mu tin burun subee xa e don kɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And news was given to David of what Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah, one of Saul's wives, had done.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa sa na fe fala Dawuda bɛ. Risipa na raba Sɔlu nan xa fe ra, barima a xa konyi ginɛ nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: And David went and took the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from the men of Jabesh-gilead, who had taken them away secretly from the public place of Beth-shan, where the Philistines had put them, hanging up the bodies there on the day when they put Saul to death in Gilboa:
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Dawuda naxa siga Sɔlu nun a xa di xɛmɛ Yonatan xɔrie tongode Yabɛsi, Galadi bɔxi ma. Filisitakae to e faxa Gilibowa, e e furee gbaku Beti San taa nan kui, Yabɛsikae fan nu bara sa e furee tongo, e e xanin Yabɛsi.

sentences.english: And he took the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan from that place; and they got together the bones of those who had been put to death by hanging.
sentences.susu: Na ki, Dawuda naxa Sɔlu, a xa di, nun na mixi solofere xɔrie tongo, a e xanin.

sentences.english: And they put them with the bones of Saul and his son Jonathan in the resting-place of Kish, his father, in Zela in the country of Benjamin; they did all the king had given them orders to do. And after that, God gave ear to their prayers for the land.
sentences.susu: A naxa yaamari fi, a Sɔlu nun a xa di Yonatan xɔrie xa ragata Sela, Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi ma, Sɔlu baba Kisu xa gaburi yire. E to gɛ mangɛ waxɔnfe rabade, Ala naxa hinnɛ e xa bɔxi ra.

sentences.english: And the Philistines went to war again with Israel; and David went down with his people, and while they were at Gob they had a fight with the Philistines:
sentences.susu: Gere man naxa bira a i Isirayila nun Filisita tagi. Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa siga Filisitakae gerede. Dawuda nu bara tagan fɔlɔ na tɛmui.

sentences.english: And there came against David one of the offspring of the Rephaim, whose spear was three hundred shekels of brass in weight, and having a new sword, he made an attempt to put David to death.
sentences.susu: Yisibi Benobi, naxan fatan Rafa bɔnsɔɛ ra, nu a falama a a wama Dawuda faxafe. Tanbɛ kuye nu na a yi ra naxan binyɛ nu dangi kilo saxan na. Santidɛgɛma fan nu xirixi a tagi.

sentences.english: But Abishai, the son of Zeruiah, came to his help, and, turning on the Philistine, gave him his death-blow. Then David's men took an oath, and said, Never again are you to go out with us to the fight, so that you may not put out the light of Israel.
sentences.susu: A nu na Dawuda gerefe tɛmui naxɛ, Seruya xa di Abisayi naxa fa Dawuda malide, a na Filisitaka faxa. Na kui, Dawuda xa mixie naxa a rakali a a yɛtɛ mu minima gere sode sɔnɔn, alako mangɛ fanyi naxa ba Isirayila xun.

sentences.english: Now after this there was war with the Philistines again at Gob, and Sibbecai the Hushathite put to death Saph, one of the offspring of the Rephaim.
sentences.susu: Na gere to ba a ra, gere gbɛtɛ man naxa bira a i Gobo, Filisitakae nun Isirayilakae tagi. Sibekayi, Husatika naxa Safa faxa, Rafa bɔnsɔɛ nde.

sentences.english: And again there was war with the Philistines at Gob, and Elhanan, the son of Jair the Beth-lehemite, put to death Goliath the Gittite, the stem of whose spear was like a cloth-worker's rod.
sentences.susu: Tɛmui gbɛtɛ, gere naxa bira a i Gobo man, Filisitakae nun Isirayilakae tagi. Na gere kui, Yare, Oregimu xa di Elexanan Bɛtɛlɛɛmuka naxa Goliyati Gatika faxa, naxan xa tanbɛ nu xungbo alɔ dugi sɔxɔ wuri.

sentences.english: And again there was war at Gath, where there was a very tall man, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six fingers on his hands and six toes on his feet; he was one of the offspring of the Rephaim.
sentences.susu: Gere gbɛtɛ man naxa bira a i Gati. Rafa bɔnsɔɛ sɛnbɛma nde nu na, bɛlɛxɛ sole senni senni nan nu na a bɛlɛxɛ firinyi ma, san sole senni senni a sanyi firinyi fan ma, a birin nalanxi sole mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani.

sentences.english: And when he was purposing to put shame on Israel, Jonathan, the son of Shimei, David's brother, put him to death.
sentences.susu: A to Isirayila konbi, Dawuda taara Simeya xa di Yonatan naxa a faxa.

sentences.english: These four were of the offspring of the Rephaim in Gath; and they came to their end by the hands of David and his servants.
sentences.susu: Na Gatika naani birin kelixi Rafa bɔnsɔɛ nɛ. Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie nan nee birin faxa.

sentences.english: And David made a song to the Lord in these words, on the day when the Lord made him free from the hands of all his haters, and from the hand of Saul:
sentences.susu: Alatala to Dawuda ratanga Sɔlu nun a yaxuie ma, Dawuda naxa yi bɛɛti ba Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And he said, The Lord is my Rock, my walled town, and my saviour, even mine;
sentences.susu: A naxɛ, «Alatala nan n ma fanye ra, Alatala nan n ma yire makantaxi ra, Alatala nan n nakisima ra.

sentences.english: My God, my Rock, in him will I put my faith; my breastplate, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower, and my safe place; my saviour, who keeps me safe from the violent man.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala luxi alɔ gɛmɛ yire n lingira sɔtɔma dɛnnaxɛ. A luxi alɔ wure lefa n bɛ, alɔ sɛnbɛma naxan n nakisima, alɔ taa makantaxi n sabatima dɛnnaxɛ. I tan, n nakisima, i n natangama n yaxuie ma.

sentences.english: I will send up my cry to the Lord, who is to be praised; so will I be made safe from those who are against me.
sentences.susu: Ala tantu! N to i xili, i bara n natanga n yaxuie ma.

sentences.english: For the waves of death came round me, and the seas of evil put me in fear;
sentences.susu: Faxɛ nu bara wa nɔfe n na, alɔ mɔrɔnyie naxee dusuma mixi xun na. N nu bara kɔntɔfili gbaloe ra,

sentences.english: The cords of hell were round me: the nets of death came on me.
sentences.susu: faxɛ luuti nu bara n xiri, faxɛ yɛlɛ nu bara itala n ya ra.

sentences.english: In my trouble my voice went up to the Lord, and my cry to my God: my voice came to his hearing in his holy Temple, and my prayer came to his ears.
sentences.susu: N ma tɔɔrɛ kui, n bara Alatala xili, n bara n Marigi Ala maxandi. A bara n xui mɛ a xa hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, n wa xui bara a tuli li.

sentences.english: Then the earth was moved with a violent shock; the bases of heaven were moved and shaking, because he was angry.
sentences.susu: Awa, koore nun bɔxi naxa imaxa, e sɛrɛn Ala xa xɔnɛ ya i.

sentences.english: There went up a smoke from his nose, and a fire of destruction from his mouth: coals were lighted by it.
sentences.susu: Tuuri nu minima a ɲɔɛ i, tɛ nu minima a dɛ i, tɛ wole nu kasanma.

sentences.english: The heavens were bent, so that he might come down; and it was dark under his feet.
sentences.susu: A naxa koore walaxɛ ɲɛnkɛn, a goro nuxui binye fari.

sentences.english: And he went through the air, seated on a storm-cloud: going quickly on the wings of the wind.
sentences.susu: A naxa ti malekɛ fari, a a ɲɛrɛ koore ma foye fari.

sentences.english: And he made the dark his tent round him, a mass of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
sentences.susu: Nuxui ifɔɔrɔxie nu na a rabilinyi, e rafexi ye ra.

sentences.english: Before his shining light his dark clouds went past, raining ice and coals of fire.
sentences.susu: Tɛ wolee nu minima a xa yanbɛ ya ra.

sentences.english: The Lord made thunder in the heavens, and the voice of the Highest was sounding out.
sentences.susu: Alatala xui nu luxi alɔ se sarinyi. Koore Mangɛ naxa a xui ramini.

sentences.english: And he sent out his arrows, driving them in all directions; by his flames of fire they were troubled.
sentences.susu: A naxa seyamakɔnyie woli alɔ xalie, e xa n yaxuie keri.

sentences.english: Then the deep beds of the sea were seen, and the bases of the world were uncovered, because of the Lord's wrath, because of the breath of his mouth.
sentences.susu: Baa bunyi naxa maba, bɔxi xɔri naxa makɛnɛn, Alatala ɲɔɛ foye to mini.

sentences.english: He sent from on high, he took me, pulling me out of great waters.
sentences.susu: A naxa a bɛlɛxɛ itala keli koore ma, a n suxu, a n namini baa ye xɔɔra.

sentences.english: He made me free from my strong hater, from those who were against me, because they were stronger than I.
sentences.susu: A naxa n natanga n yaxui sɛnbɛmae ma, n xɔnnante naxee sɛnbɛ gbo n bɛ.

sentences.english: They came on me in the day of my trouble: but the Lord was my support.
sentences.susu: E nu n gerema n xunsin lɔxɔɛe kui, kɔnɔ Alatala nu findixi n malima nan na.

sentences.english: He took me out into a wide place; he was my saviour because he had delight in me.
sentences.susu: A naxa n namini, a naxa n nakisi a xa xanunteya xa fe ra.

sentences.english: The Lord gives me the reward of my righteousness, because my hands are clean before him.
sentences.susu: Alatala n suxu n ma tinxinyi nan ma, a n ma sɛniyɛnyi sare ragbilen n ma,

sentences.english: For I have kept the ways of the Lord; I have not been turned away in sin from my God.
sentences.susu: barima n nu ɲɛrɛma Alatala xa kira nan xɔn, n mu n baxi n Marigi Ala xa kira ma alɔ mixi ɲaaxie.

sentences.english: For all his decisions were before me, and I did not put away his laws from me.
sentences.susu: N birama a xa yaamarie fɔxɔ ra, n mu gbilenma a xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And I was upright before him, and I kept myself from sin.
sentences.susu: N tinxin nɛ a bɛ, n fe kobi birin lu na.

sentences.english: Because of this the Lord has given me the reward of my righteousness, because my hands are clean in his eyes.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala naxa n ma tinxinyi nun n ma sɛniyɛnyi sare ragbilen n ma.

sentences.english: On him who has mercy you will have mercy; to the upright you will be upright;
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan tima i sɛɛti ma, i fan tima na kanyi nan sɛɛti ma. Mixi naxan mu findi filankafui ra i mabiri, i fan mu i xa laayidi kanama na kanyi bɛ.

sentences.english: He who is holy will see that you are holy; but to the man whose way is not straight you will be a hard judge.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan sɛniyɛn i ya xɔri, i fan i xa sɛniyɛnyi masenma na kanyi bɛ. Mixi naxan fe kanama, i fan fata na sare ragbilende a ma.

sentences.english: For you are the saviour of those who are in trouble; but your eyes are on men of pride, to make them low.
sentences.susu: I mixi magoroxie itema nɛ, i yɛtɛ igboee magoroma nɛ.

sentences.english: For you are my light, O Lord; and the Lord will make the dark bright for me.
sentences.susu: I tan Alatala nan na n ma naiyalanyi ra. Alatala nan dimi iyalanma n bɛ.

sentences.english: By your help I have made a way through the wall which was shutting me in: by the help of my God I have gone over a wall.
sentences.susu: Xa i na n fɔxɔ ra, n mu gaaxuma sɔɔri gali ya ra. Xa n Marigi Ala na n fɔxɔ ra, n suusama nɛ gere ra.

sentences.english: As for God, his way is all good: the word of the Lord is tested; he is a safe cover for all those who put their faith in him.
sentences.susu: Ala xa kira kamalixi. Ala xa masenyi sɛniyɛnxi. A findixi makantɛ nan na mixi bɛ, naxan a yɛtɛ taxu a ra.

sentences.english: For who is God but the Lord? and who is a Rock but our God?
sentences.susu: Nde na Ala ra xa Alatala mu a ra? Nde na ibunadama xa fanye ra xa muxu Marigi Ala mu a ra?

sentences.english: God puts a strong band about me, guiding me in a straight way.
sentences.susu: Ala nan na n ma yire makantaxi ra, naxan kira fanyi yailanma n bɛ.

sentences.english: He makes my feet like roes' feet, and puts me on high places.
sentences.susu: A n malima n ma ɲɛrɛ kui, alɔ a xeli malima ki naxɛ a xa ɲɛrɛ kui geyae fari.

sentences.english: He makes my hands expert in war, so that a bow of brass is bent by my arms.
sentences.susu: A n malima n ma gere kui, alɔ sɛnbɛma naxan xali wure gbeeli daaxi italama.

sentences.english: You have given me the breastplate of your salvation, and your mercy has made me great.
sentences.susu: I findixi n ma kantama nan na, i n xun nakelima.

sentences.english: You have made my steps wide under me, so that my feet make no slip.
sentences.susu: I n naɲɛrɛma a fanyi ra, n ma kira mu findima tɔɔrɛ ra n bɛ.

sentences.english: I go after my haters and overtake them; not turning back till they are all overcome.
sentences.susu: N na n yaxuie kerima, n e sɔntɔma. N mu gbilenma e fɔxɔ ra fo n e birin faxa.

sentences.english: I have sent destruction on them and given them wounds, so that they are not able to get up: they are stretched under my feet.
sentences.susu: N e faxama nɛ, n e bɔnbɔma nɛ. E mu kelima sɔnɔn, e luma n bun ma abadan.

sentences.english: For I have been armed by you with strength for the fight: you have made low under me those who came out against me.
sentences.susu: I sɛnbɛ fima n ma gere kui, i n yaxuie ragoroma n bun ma.

sentences.english: By you their backs are turned in flight, so that my haters are cut off.
sentences.susu: I n yaxuie kerima n ya ra, i n xɔnnantee ralɔɛma nɛ.

sentences.english: They were crying out, but there was no one to come to their help: even to the Lord, but he gave them no answer.
sentences.susu: E e ya ragema nɛ, kɔnɔ e rakisima mu na! E Alatala xilima nɛ, kɔnɔ a mu e yaabima!

sentences.english: Then they were crushed as small as the dust of the earth, stamped down under my feet like the waste of the streets.
sentences.susu: N e luntunma nɛ e findi xube ra, n e iboronma nɛ alɔ boora.

sentences.english: You have made me free from the fightings of my people; you have made me the head of the nations: a people of whom I had no knowledge will be my servants.
sentences.susu: I bara n natanga n ma ɲama xa ɲɔxɔnsɔsɔɛ ma, i bara n findi ɲamanɛe xa mangɛ ra, i bara sie lu n sagoe n mu naxee kolon.

sentences.english: Men of other countries will, with false hearts, put themselves under my authority: from the time when my name comes to their ears, they will be ruled by me.
sentences.susu: Si gbɛtɛe n matɔxɔma, e n ma yaamari birin suxuma.

sentences.english: They will be wasted away, they will come out of their secret places shaking with fear.
sentences.susu: Si gbɛtɛe mu suusama sɔnɔn, e minima e xa yire makantaxie kui gaaxui ra.

sentences.english: The Lord is living; praise be to my Rock, and let the God of my salvation be honoured:
sentences.susu: Kisi na Alatala bɛ, tantui na a bɛ naxan luxi alɔ fanye n bɛ, a xili xa matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: It is God who sends punishment on my haters, and puts peoples under my rule.
sentences.susu: Tantui na Ala bɛ, naxan n gbe ɲɔxɔma, naxan sie luma n sagoe,

sentences.english: He makes me free from my haters: I am lifted up over those who come up against me: you have made me free from the violent man.
sentences.susu: naxan n bama n yaxuie yi ra, naxan n natema yaxuie xun ma, naxan n bama mixi ɲaaxi bɛlɛxɛ i.

sentences.english: Because of this I will give you praise, O Lord, among the nations, and will make a song of praise to your name.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, n i matɔxɔma sie tagi, Alatala! N bɛɛti bama i xili ra.

sentences.english: Great salvation does he give to his king; he has mercy on the king of his selection, David, and on his seed for ever.
sentences.susu: A bara a xa mangɛ sugandixi rakisi, a mu gbilen na mangɛ fɔxɔ ra, naxan findixi Dawuda nun a bɔnsɔɛ ra abadan.»

sentences.english: Now these are the last words of David. David, the son of Jesse, says, the man who was lifted up on high, the man on whom the God of Jacob put the holy oil, the loved one of Israel's songs, says:
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa masenyi dɔnxɔɛ nan ya: Yisayi xa di Dawuda xa masenyi nan ya, kuntigi xungbe, Yaxuba Marigi Ala naxan sugandixi mangɛ ra, bɛɛtiba naxan maniyɛ mu na Isirayila bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: The spirit of the Lord had voice through me, his word was on my tongue.
sentences.susu: «Alatala Xaxili bara so n dɛ i, a xa masenyi nan ya.

sentences.english: The God of Israel said, the word of the Rock of Israel came to me: When an upright king is ruling over men, when he is ruling in the fear of God,
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Ala bara wɔyɛn, Isirayila xa fanye bara a fala n bɛ, ‹Naxan na mangɛya xaninfe tinxinyi ra, naxan na mangɛya xaninfe Ala xa yaragaaxui kui,

sentences.english: It is as the light of the morning, when the sun comes up, a morning without clouds; making young grass come to life from the earth.
sentences.susu: na kanyi luxi nɛ alɔ gɛɛsɛgɛ, soge te tɛmui nuxui yo mu a ya ma. A luxi alɔ yanbɛ nun tunɛ naxan sansi raminima bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: For is not my house so with God? For he has made with me an eternal agreement, ordered in all things and certain: as for all my salvation and all my desire, will he not give it increase?
sentences.susu: N ma denbaya na na ki nɛ Ala bɛ, barima muxu xa saatɛ mu kanama abadan, a mabanbanxi a fanyi ra. A fama n ma kisi rakamalide, a hinnɛma n na fe fanyi birin na.›»

sentences.english: But the evil-doers, all of them, will be like thorns to be pushed away, because they may not be gripped in the hand:
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ mixi sɛriyɛtare luxi nɛ alɔ sansi tunbe daaxi naxan xun nakanama, naxan mu matongoma bɛlɛxɛ ra,

sentences.english: But anyone touching them has to be armed with iron and the rod of a spear; and they will be burned with fire, every one of them.
sentences.susu: naxan xabama dɛgɛma nun keri ra, naxan ganma tɛ ra a bulaxi dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: These are the names of David's men of war: Ishbaal the Hachmonite, chief of the three; his axe was lifted up against eight hundred put to death at one time.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa sɔɔrie xunyie nan ya: Xakimoni xa di Yasobeyami, naxan findi e xunyi ra. A tan naxan man nu xili Adino Esinika, nan mixi kɛmɛ solomasaxan faxa tanbɛ ra gere keren kui.

sentences.english: After him was Eleazar, the son of Dodai the Ahohite, one of the three great fighters, who was with David in Pas-dammim when the Philistines came together there for the fight; and when the men of Israel had gone in flight,
sentences.susu: A firin nde findi Dodayi xa di Eleyasari nan na, Axowaka. A nu na Dawuda xa sɛnbɛma saxanyie ya ma, naxee Dawuda mali Filisitakae gerede, Isirayilakae to e gi e ma e siga geya fari.

sentences.english: He was with David and went on fighting the Philistines till his hand became tired and stiff from gripping his sword: and that day the Lord gave a great salvation, and the people came back after him only to take the goods of the Philistines.
sentences.susu: A tan nan Filisitakae gere, han a bɛlɛxɛ kankan a xa santidɛgɛma ma. Alatala naxa xun nakeli fanyi fi e ma na lɔxɔɛ. Ɲama mu gbilen Eleyasari yire fo gere to ɲɔn. E naxa mixi faxaxie harige tongo.

sentences.english: After him was Shammah, the son of Ela the Hararite. And the Philistines came together in Lehi, where there was a bit of land full of seed; and the people went in flight from the Philistines.
sentences.susu: A saxan nde findi Age xa di Sanma nan na, Hararaka. Filisitakae nu e malanxi Lexi tɛmui naxɛ. Bɔxi nde nu na mɛnni, toge nu sixi naxan ma. Isirayilakae nu bara e gi Filisitakae ma,

sentences.english: But he kept his place in the middle of the bit of land, and kept back their attack and overcame the Philistines: and the Lord gave a great salvation.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Sanma naxa ti na toge xɛ tagi Filisitakae gerede. Alatala naxa xunnakeli fanyi fi e ma na lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: And three of the thirty went down at the start of the grain-cutting, and they came to David at the strong place of Adullam; and the band of Philistines had taken up their position in the valley of Rephaim.
sentences.susu: Yarerati saxan, Dawuda xa yarerati tongo saxanyie ya ma, naxa siga Dawuda yire Adulama fɔnmɛ ra. Filisitakae nu tixi Refa gulunba kui.

sentences.english: And at that time David had taken cover in the strong place, and an armed force of the Philistines was in Beth-lehem.
sentences.susu: Na waxati Dawuda nu na a xa yire makantaxi kui, Filisitakae fan nu na Bɛtɛlɛɛmu.

sentences.english: And David, moved by a strong desire, said, If only someone would give me a drink of water from the water-hole of Beth-lehem, by the doorway into the town!
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a sago nde fala, «A xɔli n ma n xa Bɛtɛlɛɛmu kɔlɔnyi ye min.»

sentences.english: And the three men, forcing their way through the Philistine army, got water from the water-hole of Beth-lehem, by the doorway into the town, and took it back to David: but he would not take it, but, draining it out, made an offering of it to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na sɔɔri yarerati saxanyie naxa Filisita naaninyi igiri, e sa ye ba kɔlɔnyi ra naxan na Bɛtɛlɛɛmu naadɛ ra. E to fa na ra Dawuda bɛ, a naxa tondi na minde. A naxa a ifili bɔxi ma sɛrɛxɛ ra Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And he said, Far be it from me, O Lord, to do this; how may I take as my drink the life-blood of men who have put their lives in danger? So he would not take it. These things did the three great men of war.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala, «Ala xa n natanga na ma. N mu nɔma yi ye minde, n ma xɛmɛe naxan sɔtɔxi n bɛ e nii sare ra. Na luma alɔ e nii tide mu gbo n bɛ.» Na kui a naxa tondi ye minde a xa sɛnbɛma saxanyie naxan sɔtɔ a bɛ.

sentences.english: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the thirty. He put to death three hundred with his spear, and he got for himself a name among the thirty.
sentences.susu: Yowaba ngaxakerenyi Abisayi nan nu findixi na sɛnbɛma saxanyie xunyi ra. A nu bara xɛmɛ kɛmɛ saxan faxa a xa tanbɛ ra. A xili nu gbo alɔ na xɛmɛ saxanyie.

sentences.english: Was he not the noblest of the thirty? so he was made their captain: but he was not equal to the first three.
sentences.susu: A naxa binyɛ sɔtɔ dangi e tan na, kɔnɔ a mu nu na e ya ma hali a to nu findixi e xa mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a fighting man of Kabzeel, had done great acts; he put to death the two sons of Ariel of Moab: he went down into a hole and put a lion to death in time of snow:
sentences.susu: Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya Kabaseeli findi sɛnbɛma nde xa di nan na. A nu bara fe xungbe gbegbe raba, alɔ Ariyɛli Mowabaka firinyie faxafe. A man naxa yɛtɛ nde faxa kɔlɔnyi kui balabalanyi tɛmui.

sentences.english: And he made an attack on an Egyptian, a tall man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a stick, and pulling the spear out of the hands of the Egyptian, put him to death with that same spear.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde a naxa Misiraka gbangbalanyi nde faxa. Tanbɛ belebele nu na Misiraka yi ra. Bɛnaya naxa na ba a yi ra wuri di ra, a a faxa a yɛtɛ xa tanbɛ ra.

sentences.english: These were the acts of Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, who had a great name among the thirty men of war.
sentences.susu: Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya xa fe xungbe nan na ki. A xili gbo na sɛnbɛma saxanyi ya ma.

sentences.english: He was honoured over the rest of the thirty, but he was not equal to the first three. And David put him over the fighting men who kept him safe.
sentences.susu: A naxa binyɛ sɔtɔ dangi na xɛmɛ tongo saxan na, kɔnɔ a sɛnbɛ mu gbo na sɛnbɛma saxanyi bɛ. Dawuda xa gundo sɔɔri nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: Asahel, the brother of Joab, was one of the thirty; and Elhanan, the son of Dodai, of Beth-lehem,
sentences.susu: Sɛnbɛma gbɛtɛe nan ya: Yowaba xunya Asahɛli, naxan nu na na mixi tongo saxanyie ya ma, Dodo xa di Elexanan Bɛtɛlɛɛmuka,

sentences.english: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
sentences.susu: Samoti Harorika, Elika Xarodika,

sentences.english: Helez the Paltite, Ira, the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
sentences.susu: Xɛlɛsi Pelonka, Ikesi xa di Ira Tekowaka,

sentences.english: Abiezer the Anathothite, Sibbecai the Hushathite,
sentences.susu: Abiyeseri Anatɔtika, Mebunnayi Husatika,

sentences.english: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
sentences.susu: Salamon Ahoxika, Maharayi Netofaka,

sentences.english: Heldai, the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai, the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
sentences.susu: Baanna xa di Xeleda Netofaka, Ribayi xa di Itayi, naxan keli Gibiya Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: Benaiah the Pirathonite, Hiddai of the valleys of Gaash,
sentences.susu: Bɛnaya Piratonka, Xurayi Gaasika,

sentences.english: Abiel the Arbathite, Azmaveth of Bahurim,
sentences.susu: Abiyɛli Arabaka, Asamafeti Baxurimika,

sentences.english: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, Jashen the Gunite,
sentences.susu: Eliyaba Saalabonka, Hasemi xa di, Yonatan,

sentences.english: Jonathan, the son of Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam, the son of Sharar the Hararite,
sentences.susu: Saama Hararaka, Sakara xa di Axiyama Hararaka,

sentences.english: Eliphelet, the son of Ahasbai the Maacathite, Eliam, the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
sentences.susu: Maakaka xa di Axasabayi xa di Elifeleti, Axitofeli Gilonka xa di Eliyami,

sentences.english: Hezrai the Carmelite, Paarai the Archite,
sentences.susu: Xesero Karemeleka, Paarayi Aribika,

sentences.english: Igal, the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
sentences.susu: Natan ngaxakerenyi Yigali Sobaka, Bani Gadika,

sentences.english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, who had the care of the arms of Joab, son of Zeruiah,
sentences.susu: Sɛlɛki Amonika, Seruya xa di Naxarayi Berotika, naxan nu Yowaba xa geresosee xaninma,

sentences.english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
sentences.susu: Ira nun Garebe Yatirikae, a nun

sentences.english: Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in number.
sentences.susu: Uriya Xitika. E birin nalanxi, mixi tongo saxan nun solofere.

sentences.english: Again the wrath of the Lord was burning against Israel, and moving David against them, he said, Go, take the number of Israel and Judah.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala naxa xɔnɔ Isirayila ma a sanya firin nde. A naxa maɲɔxunyi nde raso Dawuda bɔɲɛ e xili ma, a a fala a bɛ, «Siga Isirayila nun Yudaya mixie kɔnti.»

sentences.english: And the king said to Joab and the captains of the army, who were with him, Go now through all the tribes of Israel, from Dan as far as Beer-sheba, and have all the people numbered, so that I may be certain of the number of the people.
sentences.susu: Na kui mangɛ Dawuda naxa a fala a xa sɔɔrie xa mangɛ Yowaba bɛ, a naxɛ, «Siga Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin xɔnyi, kelife Dana ma han Beriseeba. I xa na ɲama kɔnti alako n xa mixi xasabi kolon.»

sentences.english: And Joab said to the king, Whatever the number of the people, may the Lord make it a hundred times as much, and may the eyes of my lord the king see it: but why does my lord the king take pleasure in doing this thing?
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa mangɛ yaabi, «I Marigi Ala xa ɲama rawuya dɔxɔ kɛmɛ i ya xɔri, kɔnɔ mangɛ, munfe ra i wama yi rabafe?»

sentences.english: But the king's order was stronger than Joab and the captains of the army. And Joab and the captains of the army went out from the king, to take the number of the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a yaabi a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra. Yowaba nun sɔɔri mangɛe naxa keli mangɛ xun, e siga Isirayila ɲama kɔntide.
