sentences.english: And they went over Jordan, and starting from Aroer, from the town which is in the middle of the valley, they went in the direction of the Gadites, and on to Jazer;
sentences.susu: E naxa Yurudɛn xure igiri, e yonkin Aroweri yirefanyi ma. Na taa na gulunba nan kui Gadi, Yaasɛri biri.

sentences.english: Then they came to Gilead, and to the land of the Hittites under Hermon; and they came to Dan, and from Dan they came round to Zidon,
sentences.susu: E naxa siga Galadi bɔxi ma, Tatimi Xodosi, Dana Yaan, nun Sidɔn biri.

sentences.english: And to the walled town of Tyre, and to all the towns of the Hivites and the Canaanites: and they went out to the South of Judah at Beer-sheba.
sentences.susu: E naxa siga Tire yire makantaxi, a nun taa birin naxee nu na Hiwikae nun Kanaankae xa bɔxi ma. A raɲɔnyi, e naxa siga han Beriseeba, naxan na Yudaya bɔxi yirefanyi biri.

sentences.english: So after going through all the land in every direction, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ bɔxi birin isade kike solomanaani xi mɔxɔɲɛn bun ma, e naxa so Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And Joab gave the king the number of all the people: there were in Israel eight hundred thousand fighting men able to take up arms; and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand.
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa ɲama xasabi dɛntɛgɛ mangɛ bɛ. Xɛmɛ mixi wulu kɛmɛ solomasaxan nan nu na Isirayila, naxee nu nɔma findide sɔɔrie ra. Xɛmɛ mixi wulu kɛmɛ suuli nan nu na Yudaya fan, naxee nu nɔma findide sɔɔrie ra.

sentences.english: And after the people had been numbered, David's heart was troubled. And David said to the Lord, Great has been my sin in doing this; but now, O Lord, be pleased to take away the sin of your servant, for I have done very foolishly
sentences.susu: Dawuda to gɛ ɲama kɔntide, a bɔɲɛ naxa maɲaaxu, a fa a fala Alatala bɛ, «N to yi rabaxi, n bara yunubi belebele raba. Yakɔsi n bara i mayandi i xa diɲɛ i xa konyi xa yunubi ma. Na bara findi n ma daxuɲa ra.»

sentences.english: And David got up in the morning; now the word of the Lord had come to the prophet Gad, David's seer, saying,
sentences.susu: Dawuda to keli gɛɛsɛgɛ, a lixi Alatala nu bara masenyi ti a xa namiɲɔnmɛ Gadi bɛ, Dawuda xa waliyu, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Go and say to David, The Lord says, Three things are offered to you: say which of them you will have, and I will do it to you.
sentences.susu: «I xa a fala Dawuda bɛ, Alatala yi nan masenxi i bɛ, ‹N bara fe saxan masen i bɛ, i xa keren sugandi i wama n xa naxan naba i ra.›»

sentences.english: So Gad came to David, and gave him word of this and said to him, Are there to be three years when there is not enough food in your land? or will you go in flight from your haters for three months, while they go after you? or will you have three days of violent disease in your land? take thought and say what answer I am to give to him who sent me.
sentences.susu: Gadi naxa siga Dawuda yire, a a fala a bɛ, «Alatala yi nan masenxi i bɛ, ‹I bara tin ɲaxankatɛ mundun na: kaamɛ xa sin bɔxi ɲɛ solofere, xa na mu i yaxuie xa nɔ wo ra e xa santidɛgɛma ra kike saxan, xa na mu fure ɲaaxi xa din Isirayila ɲama ma xi saxan bun ma. Yakɔsi i xa a mato n lan n xa naxan fala n xɛɛma bɛ.›»

sentences.english: And David said to Gad, This is a hard decision for me to make: let us come into the hands of the Lord, for great are his mercies: let me not come into the hands of men.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Gadi yaabi, «N bɔɲɛ bara maɲaaxu a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra. A lan n xa n sa Alatala nan bɛlɛxɛ i, naxan xa kinikini gbo. Na fisa adamadie bɛlɛxɛe bɛ.»

sentences.english: So David made selection of the disease; and the time was the days of the grain-cutting, when the disease came among the people, causing the death of seventy thousand men from Dan as far as Beer-sheba.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa fure ɲaaxi radin Isirayila ma, kelife gɛɛsɛgɛ han a waxati naxan fala. Na kui, kelife Dana han a sa dɔxɔ Beriseeba ra, xɛmɛ wulu tongo solofere nan faxa Isirayila bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And when the hand of the angel was stretched out in the direction of Jerusalem, for its destruction, the Lord had regret for the evil, and said to the angel who was sending destruction on the people, It is enough; do no more. And the angel of the Lord was by the grain-floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
sentences.susu: Ala xa malekɛ to Darisalamu kana fɔlɔ, Alatala naxa nimisa na tɔɔrɛ xa fe ra. A naxa a masen malekɛ bɛ naxan nu na ɲama ya ma, «Na lan. E lu na sinden.» Alatala xa malekɛ nu tixi Arawuna Yebusuka xa lonyi ma.

sentences.english: And when David saw the angel who was causing the destruction of the people, he said to the Lord, Truly, the sin is mine; I have done wrong: but these are only sheep; what have they done? let your hand be against me and against my family.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to malekɛ to faxɛ ti ra ɲama tagi, a naxa a fala Alatala bɛ, «N tan nan yunubi rabaxi, n tan nan yi fe kobi niyaxi. Yi ɲama munse rabaxi? N Marigi Alatala, i xa n tan nun n ma denbaya halaki, i xa i xa ɲama lu na.»

sentences.english: And that day Gad came to David and said to him, Go up, and put up an altar to the Lord on the grain-floor of Araunah the Jebusite.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Annabi Gadi naxa siga Dawuda yire, a a fala a bɛ «Keli, i xa sa sɛrɛxɛbade ti Alatala bɛ Arawuna Yebusuka xa lonyi ma.»

sentences.english: So David went up, as Gad had said and as the Lord had given orders.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa te naa alɔ Gadi a fala a bɛ Alatala xili ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And Araunah, looking out, saw the king and his servants coming to him: and Araunah went out, and went down on his face to the earth before the king.
sentences.susu: Keli yire itexi nde ma, Arawuna naxa mangɛ nun a xa mixie to fa ra a yire. A naxa keli keren na, a sa e ralan, a a felen bɔxi ma mangɛ bun ma.

sentences.english: And Araunah said, Why has my lord the king come to his servant? And David said, To give you a price for your grain-floor, so that I may put up an altar to the Lord, and the disease may be stopped among the people.
sentences.susu: Arawuna naxa a maxɔrin, «Mangɛ faxi munse fende a xa konyi yire?» Dawuda naxa a yaabi, «N wama yi lonyi nan sarafe i ma alako n xa sɛrɛxɛbade ti Alatala bɛ. Na ki fure ɲaaxi xa ɲɔn ɲama ma.»

sentences.english: And Araunah said to David, Let my lord the king take whatever seems right to him, and make an offering of it: see, here are the oxen for the burned offering, and the grain-cleaning instruments and the ox-yokes for wood:
sentences.susu: Arawuna naxa Dawuda yaabi, «Mangɛ, a tongo. N marigi xa a waxɔnfe raba a ra. N bara yi ningee fan so i yi ra, e xa findi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra. Yi sarɛtie nɔma gande yege ra, yi mɛngi fan xa findi sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: All this does the servant of my lord the king give to the king. And Araunah said, May the Lord your God be pleased with your offering!
sentences.susu: N bara yi birin fi i ma.» Arawuna man naxa a fala mangɛ bɛ, «I Marigi Alatala xa i xa sɛrɛxɛ rasuxu.»

sentences.english: And the king said to Araunah, No, but I will give you a price for it; I will not give to the Lord my God burned offerings for which I have given nothing. So David got the grain-floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mangɛ Dawuda naxa a fala Arawuna bɛ, «Ade, n wama a sarafe nɛ kɔbiri ra naxan lanma sɛriyɛ ki ma. N mu se bama sɛrɛxɛ ra Alatala bɛ, naxan mu kelima n yɛtɛ harige ma. N mu nɔma sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi bade n mu naxan sare baxi.» Na kui Dawuda naxa Arawuna xa lonyi nun a xa ningee sara gbeti kilo tongo suuli ra.

sentences.english: And there David put up an altar to the Lord, making burned offerings and peace-offerings. So the Lord gave ear to his prayer for the land, and the disease came to an end in Israel.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa sɛrɛxɛbade ti mɛnni Alatala bɛ, a fa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ba. Alatala naxa na sɛrɛxɛe suxu Isirayila bɛ, fure ɲaaxi dan na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Now King David was old and far on in years; and though they put covers over him, his body was cold.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda xa simaya nu bara a ikuya. Xinbeli nu na a fate i tɛmui birin, hali dugie to nu felenma a ma a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: So his servants said to him, Let search be made for a young virgin for my lord the king, to take care of him and be waiting on him; and you may take her in your arms, and so my lord the king will be warm.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a xa mixie naxa a fala a bɛ, «Ginɛdimɛdi nde xa fen i bɛ, naxan mɛɛnima i ma, a nu fa a sa i fɛ ma alako xinbeli xa ba i ma.»

sentences.english: So after searching through all the land of Israel for a fair young girl, they saw Abishag the Shunammite, and took her to the king.
sentences.susu: E naxa ginɛdimɛdi tofanyi nde fen Isirayila bɔxi ma, han e sa Abisaga Sunamika to. E naxa na xanin mangɛ xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Now she was very beautiful; and she took care of the king, waiting on him at all times; but the king had no connection with her.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmɛdi nu tofan ki fanyi. A nu mɛɛni mangɛ ma, a nu wali birin naba a bɛ. Kɔnɔ na kui mangɛ mu a kolon ginɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then Adonijah, the son of Haggith, lifting himself up in pride, said, I will become king; and he made ready his carriages of war and his horsemen, with fifty runners to go before him.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Xagiti xa di Adoniya naxa a yɛtɛ ite fɔlɔ, a nu fa a fala, «N tan nan findima Isirayila mangɛ ra.» A naxa soe nun kuntigi maɲɛrɛse tongo, a nun korogba tongo suuli.

sentences.english: Now all his life his father had never gone against him or said to him, Why have you done so? and he was a very good-looking man, and younger than Absalom.
sentences.susu: A xa simaya kui, a baba Dawuda nu a luxi a yɛtɛ nan yi, a mu nu a falama a bɛ, «Yi lu, yi mu fan?» Adoniya fate nu tofan ki fanyi. Abisalomi xanbiratoe nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: And he had talk with Joab, the son of Zeruiah, and with Abiathar the priest; and they were on his side and gave him their support.
sentences.susu: A tan nun Seruya xa di Yowaba nun Abiyatari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa lan fe keren ma, e xa kafu a ma Adoniya xa mangɛya masɔtɔ.

sentences.english: But Zadok the priest, and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, and Nathan the prophet and Shimei and Rei, and David's men of war did not take the side of Adonijah.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Sadɔki sɛrɛxɛdubɛ, Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya, Annabi Natan, Simeyi, Reyi, nun Dawuda xa sɔɔri sɛnbɛmae naxa tondi birade Adoniya fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Then Adonijah put to death sheep and oxen and fat beasts by the stone of Zoheleth, by En-rogel; and he sent for all his brothers, the king's sons, and all the men of Judah, the king's servants, to come to him:
sentences.susu: Adoniya naxa ningee nun yɛxɛɛ bɔrɔgɛxie ba sɛrɛxɛ ra Soxeleti fanye fɛ ma, dɛnnaxɛ na En Rogeli sɛɛti ma. A naxa a ngaxakerenyie, mangɛ xa die, nun mangɛ xa mixie birin xili.

sentences.english: But he did not send for Nathan the prophet and Benaiah and the other men of war and Solomon his brother.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a mu Annabi Natan, Bɛnaya, mangɛ xa sɔɔri sɛnbɛmae, nun a xunya Sulemani tan xili.

sentences.english: Then Nathan said to Bath-sheba, the mother of Solomon, Has it not come to your ears that Adonijah, the son of Haggith, has made himself king without the knowledge of David our lord?
sentences.susu: Natan naxa a fala Sulemani nga Batiseba bɛ, «I mu a mɛxi a Xagiti xa di Adoniya bara findi mangɛ ra, a fa li won marigi Dawuda mu fefe kolonxi na fe kui?

sentences.english: So now, let me make a suggestion, so that you may keep your life safe and the life of your son Solomon.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi i naxan nabama, i i tuli mati n ma marasi ra, alako i xa i tan nun i xa di Sulemani nii ratanga.

sentences.english: Come now, go to King David and say to him, Did you not, O my lord, take an oath to me, your servant, saying, Truly Solomon your son will be king after me, seated on the seat of my kingdom? why then is Adonijah acting as king?
sentences.susu: I xa siga mangɛ Dawuda yire, i a fala a bɛ, ‹Mangɛ n marigi, i mu laayidi tongo xɛ n tan i xa konyi ginɛ bɛ, fa a fala n ma di Sulemani fama mangɛya sɔtɔde i ɲɔxɔɛ ra, a dɔxɔ i xa kibanyi kui? Munfe ra Adoniya na findife mangɛ ra yakɔsi?›

sentences.english: And while you are still talking there with the king, see, I will come in after you and say that your story is true.
sentences.susu: I nun mangɛ wɔyɛnma tɛmui naxɛ, n fan so tɛmui nan na ki wo yire, n fa i xa wɔyɛnyi rakamali.»

sentences.english: Then Bath-sheba went into the king's room; now the king was very old, and Abishag the Shunammite was waiting on him.
sentences.susu: Batiseba naxa so mangɛ xa konkoe kui. Mangɛ nu bara fori ki fanyi. Abisaga Sunamika nu na mɛɛnife a ma.

sentences.english: And Bath-sheba went down on her face on the earth before the king giving him honour. And he said, What is your desire?
sentences.susu: Batiseba naxa suyidi, a a magoro mangɛ ya i. Mangɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «Munse niyaxi?»

sentences.english: And she said to him, My lord, you took an oath by the Lord your God and gave your word to your servant, saying, Truly, Solomon your son will be king after me, seated on the seat of my kingdom.
sentences.susu: Batiseba naxa a yaabi, «N marigi, i bara i kali i Marigi Alatala xili ra, a falafe ra a n ma di nan findima mangɛ ra i ɲɔxɔɛ ra, a dɔxɔ i xa kibanyi kui.

sentences.english: And now, see, Adonijah has made himself king without my lord's knowledge;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mangɛ n marigi, yakɔsi Adoniya nan fa findife mangɛ ra, a fa li i mu fefe kolon na kui.

sentences.english: And has put to death oxen and fat beasts and sheep in great numbers, and has sent for all the sons of the king, and Abiathar the priest, and Joab, the captain of the army; but he has not sent for Solomon your servant.
sentences.susu: A bara ninge nun yɛxɛɛ turaxi gbegbe ba sɛrɛxɛ ra. A bara mangɛ xa die birin xili, fo n ma di Sulemani, naxan findixi i xa konyi fanyi ra. A bara Abiyatari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nun Yowaba sɔɔri mangɛ fan xili.

sentences.english: And now, my lord the king, the eyes of all Israel are on you, waiting for you to say who is to take the place of my lord the king after him.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ n marigi, Isirayila ɲama tuli matixi i tan nan na, alako i xa a masen naxan dɔxɔma i xa kibanyi kui i ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: For as things are, it will come about, when my lord the king is sleeping with his fathers, that I and Solomon my son will be made outlaws.
sentences.susu: Xa na mu a ra, i na bɛlɛ tɛmui naxɛ i benbae fɛ ma, yi ɲama fama n tan nun n ma di Sulemani xa fe xun nakanade nɛ alɔ kaafirie.»

sentences.english: And while she was still talking with the king, Nathan the prophet came in.
sentences.susu: A wɔyɛn tɛmui, Annabi Natan naxa mangɛ xɔnyi li.

sentences.english: And they said to the king, Here is Nathan the prophet. And when he came in before the king, he went down on his face on the earth.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa a raso mangɛ xa konkoe kui, a a fala, «Annabi Natan bara fa.» Natan naxa a magoro bɔxi ma mangɛ ya i.

sentences.english: And Nathan said, O my lord king, have you said, Adonijah is to be king after me, seated on the seat of my kingdom?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a naxa a masen mangɛ bɛ, «Mangɛ n marigi, i tan nan a falaxi, ‹Adoniya nan findima mangɛ ra n ɲɔxɔɛ ra, a dɔxɔ n ma kibanyi kui?›

sentences.english: Because today he has gone down and has put to death oxen and fat beasts and sheep in great numbers, and has sent for all the king's sons to come to him, with the captains of the army and Abiathar the priest; and they are feasting before him and crying, Long life to King Adonijah!
sentences.susu: N i maxɔrinxi nɛ na ma barima Adoniya ɲan bara ningee nun yɛxɛɛ bɔrɔgɛxi gbegbe ba sɛrɛxɛ ra. A bara mangɛ xa die birin, sɔri mangɛe, nun Abiyatari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xili. E birin na e dɛgefe yire keren, e a falama, ‹Kisi na mangɛ Adoniya bɛ!›

sentences.english: But me, your servant, and Zadok the priest, and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, and your servant Solomon, he has not sent for.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ, a mu n tan xilixi, n tan naxan findixi i xa konyi fanyi ra. A mu Sadɔki sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xilixi, a mu Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya xilixi, a mu i xa di Sulemani xilixi, naxan fan findixi i xa konyi ra.

sentences.english: Has this thing been done by my lord the king, without giving word to your servants who was to be placed on my lord the king's seat after him?
sentences.susu: Na fe kelixi i tan na ma, mangɛ n marigi? Munfe ra i mu a fala n tan i xa konyi fanyi bɛ, mixi naxan fama dɔxɔde i xa kibanyi kui?»

sentences.english: Then King David in answer said, Send for Bath-sheba to come to me. And she came in and took her place before the king.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda naxa a fala, «Wo Batiseba xili n bɛ.» A to so mangɛ yire,

sentences.english: And the king took an oath, and said, By the living Lord, who has been my saviour from all my troubles,
sentences.susu: mangɛ naxa a kali a bɛ, «N bara n kali Alatala ra, naxan n natangaxi n ma tɔɔrɛ birin kui,

sentences.english: As I took an oath to you by the Lord, the God of Israel, saying, Certainly Solomon your son will become king after me, seated on my seat in my place; so will I do this day.
sentences.susu: alɔ n nan n kali Alatala ra ki naxɛ a falafe ra, ‹I xa di Sulemani nan findima mangɛ ra n ɲɔxɔɛ ra, a tan nan dɔxɔma n ma kibanyi kui,› to yati n fama nɛ na laayidi rakamalide.»

sentences.english: Then Bath-sheba went down on her face on the earth before the king giving him honour, and said, May my lord King David go on living for ever.
sentences.susu: Batiseba naxa a magoro, a suyidi mangɛ ya i, a fa a fala «Mangɛ n marigi Dawuda xa kisi abadan!»

sentences.english: And King David said, Send for Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada. And they came before the king.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda naxa a fala a xa mixie bɛ e xa Sadɔki sɛrɛxɛdubɛ, Annabi Natan, nun Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya xili. Nee to fa mangɛ yire,

sentences.english: And the king said to them, Take with you the servants of your lord, and put Solomon my son on my beast, yes, mine, and take him down to Gihon;
sentences.susu: a naxa a masen e bɛ, a naxɛ, «Wo xa n ma mixie tongo, wo xa n ma di Sulemani dɔxɔ n ma sofale fari, wo goro a ra Gixon.

sentences.english: And there let Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet put the holy oil on him to make him king over Israel; and sounding the horn say, Long life to King Solomon!
sentences.susu: Mɛnni, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Sadɔki nun Annabi Natan xa ture surusuru a xunyi ma, a tife ra Isirayila mangɛ ra. Wo na gɛ na rabade, wo xa feri fe, wo fa a fala wo xui itexi ra, ‹Kisi na mangɛ Sulemani bɛ!›

sentences.english: Then come up after him and he will come in and take his place on the seat of my kingdom; for he is to be king in my place, and I have given orders that he is to be ruler over Israel and over Judah.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui wo birin xa gbilen, wo xa a dɔxɔ n ma kibanyi kui. A tan nan findima mangɛ ra n ɲɔxɔɛ ra. N bara a ti Isirayila nun Yudaya mangɛ ra.»

sentences.english: And Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, answering the king, said, So be it: and may the Lord, the God of my lord the king, say so.
sentences.susu: Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya naxa mangɛ yaabi, «N ma mangɛ, a xa raba na ki! A xa findi i Marigi Alatala sagoe ra!

sentences.english: As the Lord has been with my lord the king, even so may he be with Solomon and make the seat of his authority greater than that of my lord King David.
sentences.susu: Alatala nu na n ma mangɛ bɛ ki naxɛ, a xa lu Sulemani fan bɛ na ki. Sulemani xa mangɛya xa gbo dangi n marigi mangɛ Dawuda gbe ra.»

sentences.english: So Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites, went down and put Solomon on King David's beast and took him to Gihon.
sentences.susu: Sadɔki sɛrɛxɛdubɛ, Annabi Natan, Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya, Keretikae, nun Peletakae naxa Sulemani rate mangɛ Dawuda xa sofale fari, e siga a ra Gixon.

sentences.english: And Zadok the priest took the vessel of oil out of the Tent, and put the holy oil on Solomon. And when the horn was sounded, all the people said, Long life to King Solomon!
sentences.susu: Sadɔki sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa so hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, a feri tongo ture sɛniyɛnxi nu na naxan kui. A naxa na ture surusuru Sulemani xunyi ma. Na tɛmui e naxa sara fe, ɲama birin naxa a fala e xui itexi ra, «Kisi na mangɛ Sulemani bɛ!»

sentences.english: And all the people came up after him, piping with pipes, and they were glad with great joy, so that the earth was shaking with the sound.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra ɲɛlɛxinyi kui. E nu xule fe, e nu e xui ite han bɔxi naxa sɛrɛn na xui ma.

sentences.english: And it came to the ears of Adonijah and all the guests who were with him, when their meal was ended. And Joab, hearing the sound of the horn, said, What is the reason of this noise as if the town was worked up?
sentences.susu: Adoniya nun a xa ɲama to gɛ e dɛgɛde, e naxa na xui mɛ. Yowaba to na sara xui mɛ, a naxa a fala, «Sɔnxɔɛ mundun na taa kui na ki?»

sentences.english: And while the words were on his lips, Jonathan, the son of Abiathar the priest, came; and Adonijah said, Come in; for you are a man of good faith and the news which you have for us will be good.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui yati, Abiyatari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xa di Yonatan naxa so. Adoniya naxa a xili, a naxɛ, «Mixi hagigɛ nan i ra, naxan faxi xibaaru fanyi ra.»

sentences.english: And Jonathan, answering, said to Adonijah, Not so, but our lord King David has made Solomon king:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Yonatan naxa Adoniya yaabi, «Won marigi mangɛ Dawuda bara Sulemani ti mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And he sent with him Zadok the priest, and Nathan the prophet, and Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they put him on the king's beast:
sentences.susu: Mangɛ bara Sadɔki sɛrɛxɛdubɛ, Annabi Natan, Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya, Peletakae, nun Keretikae xɛɛ Sulemani matide mangɛ xa sofale fari.

sentences.english: And Zadok the priest and Nathan the prophet put the holy oil on him and made him king in Gihon; and they came back from there with joy, and the town was all worked up. This is the noise which has come to your ears.
sentences.susu: Sadɔki sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nun Annabi Natan bara ture sɛniyɛnxi surusuru a xunyi ma Gixon, a xa findi mangɛ ra. E birin bara keli mɛnni sɛɛwɛ kui. Na ɲɛlɛxinyi bara din taa birin na. Wo na xui nan mɛfe yi ki.

sentences.english: And now Solomon is seated on the seat of the kingdom.
sentences.susu: Sulemani ɲan bara a magoro mangɛ kibanyi kui.

sentences.english: And the king's servants came to our lord King David, blessing him and saying, May God make the name of Solomon better than your name, and the seat of his authority greater than your seat; and the king was bent low in worship on his bed.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa mixie birin bara fa won marigi mangɛ Dawuda yire, e xa duba a bɛ a falafe ra, ‹I Marigi Ala xa Sulemani xili ite dangi i tan na, a xa mangɛya xa gbo dangi i gbe ra!› Mangɛ naxa suyidi a xa sade ma.

sentences.english: Then the king said, May the God of Israel be praised, who has given one of my seed to be king in my place this day and has let my eyes see it.
sentences.susu: A naxa yi masenyi ti, a naxɛ, ‹Tantui na Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ, naxan mixi nde dɔxɔxi n ma kibanyi kui n ya xɔri.›»

sentences.english: And all the guests of Adonijah got up in fear and went away, every man to his place.
sentences.susu: Adoniya xa mixie a naxee xili, nee birin naxa so sɛrɛnfe gaaxui ra. E naxa keli, kankan naxa siga a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And Adonijah himself was full of fear because of Solomon; and he got up and went to the altar, and put his hands on its horns.
sentences.susu: Adoniya fan naxa gaaxu, a siga hɔrɔmɔlingira, a sɛrɛxɛbade ferie suxu.

sentences.english: And they gave Solomon word of it, saying, See, Adonijah goes in such fear of King Solomon, that he has put his hands on the horns of the altar, saying, Let King Solomon first give me his oath that he will not put his servant to death with the sword.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa a fala Sulemani bɛ a Adoniya to gaaxuxi Sulemani ya ra, a soxi hɔrɔmɔlingira nan kui, a sɛrɛxɛbade ferie suxu, a a fala, «Fo mangɛ Sulemani xa a kali n bɛ to, a mu n tan a xa konyi faxama santidɛgɛma ra.»

sentences.english: And Solomon said, If he is seen to be a man of good faith, not a hair of him will be touched; but if any wrongdoing is seen in him, he is to be put to death.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa yi yaabi fi, a naxɛ, «Xa a sa findi mixi fanyi nan na, sese mu a toma. Kɔnɔ xa a sa findi mixi kobi nan na, a faxama nɛ!»

sentences.english: So King Solomon sent, and they took him down from the altar. And he came and gave honour to King Solomon; and Solomon said to him, Go to your house.
sentences.susu: Na kui mangɛ Sulemani naxa mixie xɛɛ, e xa a ragoro sɛrɛxɛbade fari. Adoniya naxa siga mangɛ yire, a suyidi a bɛ. Sulemani naxa a fala a bɛ, «Siga i xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: Now the time of David's death came near; and he gave orders to Solomon his son, saying,
sentences.susu: Dawuda to a kolon a nu fa na saya kira nan xɔn, a naxa yi masenyi ti a xa di Sulemani bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: I am going the way of all the earth: so be strong and be a man;
sentences.susu: «N na saya kira nan xɔn ma yi ki alɔ ibunadama birin. I xa i sɛnbɛ so, i xa ti gben.

sentences.english: And keep the orders of the Lord your God, walking in his ways, keeping his laws and his orders and his rules and his words, as they are recorded in the law of Moses; so that you may do well in all you do and wherever you go,
sentences.susu: I xa i ɲɔxɔ sa i Marigi Alatala xa yaamarie xɔn ma, i xa bira a xa kira fɔxɔ ra. I xa a xa sɛriyɛ rabatu, i xa a xa yaamarie ratinmɛ. I xa bira a xa lɔnni fɔxɔ ra, i xa a xui suxu alɔ a sɛbɛxi ki naxɛ Tawureta Munsa kui, alako fe birin xa sɔɔnɛya i bɛ i siga dɛdɛ.

sentences.english: So that the Lord may give effect to what he said of me, If your children give attention to their ways, living uprightly before me with all their heart and their soul, you will never be without a man to be king in Israel.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toma, Alatala a xa masenyi rakamalima, a naxan masen n bɛ a to a fala, ‹Xa i xa die fe birin nabama alako e xa e ɲɛrɛ n ma kira xɔn e bɔɲɛ birin na, e nii birin na, Isirayila mangɛya luma e yi ra abadan.›»

sentences.english: Now you have knowledge of what Joab, the son of Zeruiah, did to me, and to the two captains of the army of Israel, Abner, the son of Ner, and Amasa, the son of Jether, whom he put to death, taking payment for the blood of war in time of peace, and making the band of my clothing and the shoes on my feet red with the blood of one put to death without cause.
sentences.susu: «I a kolon Seruya xa di Yowaba naxan naba n na, i a kolon a naxan naba Isirayila sɔɔrie xa mangɛe, Abeneri, nun Amasa ra. A naxa e faxa bɔɲɛsa waxati, a e wuli maso a xa bɛlɛti nun a xa sankirie ma.

sentences.english: So be guided by your wisdom, and let not his white head go down to the underworld in peace.
sentences.susu: Na kui i xa fɛɛrɛ fen alako a naxa siga aligiyama bɔɲɛsa kui.

sentences.english: But be good to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be guests at your table; for so they came to me when I went in flight from Absalom your brother.
sentences.susu: I xa i ɲɔxɔ sa Barasilayi Galadika xa die xɔn ma, alako e xa e dɛge i xa teebili ra, barima e na mɔɔli nan naba n bɛ n nu na n gife i taara Abisalomi ma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: Now you have with you Shimei, the son of Gera the Benjamite of Bahurim, who put a bitter curse on me on the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to see me at Jordan, and I gave him my oath by the Lord, saying, I will not put you to death by the sword.
sentences.susu: Fo i xa Gera xa di Simeyi Baxurimi xa fe fan mato, naxan fatanxi Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ ra. A n danka nɛ a ɲaaxi ra, n nu sigafe Maxanayimi lɔxɔɛ naxɛ. N to gbilen, a naxa n nalan Yurudɛn xure biri. Mɛnni n naxa n kali Alatala ra a n mu a faxama santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: But do not let him be free from punishment, for you are a wise man; and it will be clear to you what you have to do with him; see that his white head goes down to the underworld in blood.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi i naxa diɲɛ a ma de. Xaxilima nan i ra, i a kolon a lanma i xa a rasiga aligiyama ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Then David went to rest with his fathers, and his body was put into the earth in the town of David.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Dawuda naxa laaxira, a naxa bɛlɛ a benbae fɛ ma a xa taa kui.

sentences.english: David was king over Israel for forty years: for seven years he was king in Hebron and for thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: A ɲɛ tongo naani mangɛya nan naba Isirayila xun ma. A naxa ɲɛ solofere raba Xebiron, a ɲɛ tongo saxan nun saxan naba Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And Solomon took his place on the seat of David his father, and his kingdom was made safe and strong.
sentences.susu: A xa di Sulemani naxa magoro a xa kibanyi kui, a xa mangɛya naxa mabanban.

sentences.english: Then Adonijah, the son of Haggith, came to Bath-sheba, the mother of Solomon. And she said, Come you in peace? And he said, Yes, in peace.
sentences.susu: Xagiti xa di Adoniya naxa siga Sulemani nga Batiseba yire. Batiseba naxa a maxɔrin, «I faxi bɔɲɛsa kui?» A naxa a yaabi, «Iyo, n faxi bɔɲɛsa kui.»

sentences.english: Then he said, I have something to say to you. And she said, Say on.
sentences.susu: Adoniya naxa a fala a bɛ, «N wama wɔyɛn keren nan falafe i bɛ.» Batiseba naxa a yaabi, «Na fala n bɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said, You saw how the kingdom was mine, and all Israel had the idea that I would be their king; but now the kingdom is turned about, and has become my brother's, for it was given to him by the Lord.
sentences.susu: Adoniya naxa yi masenyi ti a bɛ, «I a kolon a nu lanma n tan nan xa findi mangɛ ra. Isirayila birin ya nu rafindixi n tan nan ma n xa findi mangɛ ra. Kɔnɔ Alatala naxa a niya mangɛya xa so n xunya yi ra.

sentences.english: Now I have one request to make to you, and do not say, No, to me. And she said to him, Say on.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, n wama fe keren gbansan nan xɔn ma i yi, i naxa tondi n bɛ.» Batiseba naxɛ, «Na fala n bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then he said, Will you go to Solomon the king (for he will not say, No, to you) and put before him my request that he will give me Abishag the Shunammite for a wife?
sentences.susu: Adoniya naxa a fala, «Yandi, i xa a fala mangɛ Sulemani bɛ a xa Abisaga Sunamika fi n ma ginɛ ra. A mu tondima i bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Bath-sheba said, Good! I will make your request to the king.
sentences.susu: Batiseba naxa a yaabi, «Awa, n wɔyɛnma mangɛ bɛ i xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: So Bath-sheba went to King Solomon to have talk with him on Adonijah's account. And the king got up to come to her, and went down low to the earth before her; then he took his place on the king's seat and had a seat made ready for the king's mother and she took her place at his right hand.
sentences.susu: Batiseba naxa siga mangɛ Sulemani yire, a xa sa Adoniya xa fe fala a bɛ. Mangɛ to a nga to, a naxa keli a xa kibanyi, a siga a ralande. A naxa a igoro a nga bɛ, a kibanyi gbɛtɛ maxili. Sulemani nga naxa a magoro a yirefanyi ma.

sentences.english: Then she said, I have one small request to make to you; do not say, No, to me. And the king said, Say on, my mother, for I will not say, No, to you.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a nga naxa a fala a bɛ, «N wama fe nde nan xɔn. I naxa tondi n bɛ.» Mangɛ naxa a yaabi, «Nga, i xa na fala n bɛ, n mu tondima i bɛ.»

sentences.english: And she said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adonijah your brother for a wife.
sentences.susu: A nga naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xa Abisaga Sunamika fi ginɛ ra i taara Adoniya ma.»

sentences.english: Then King Solomon made answer and said to his mother, Why are you requesting me to give Abishag the Shunammite to Adonijah? Take the kingdom for him in addition, for he is my older brother, and Abiathar the priest and Joab, the son of Zeruiah, are on his side.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani naxa a nga yaabi, «Munfe ra i Abisaga maxɔrinma Adoniya bɛ? Na luxi alɔ i wama n ma mangɛya nan sofe a yi ra, a to findixi n taara ra. I xa a so Abiyatari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nun Seruya xa di Yowaba fan yi ra.»

sentences.english: Then King Solomon took an oath by the Lord, saying, May God's punishment be on me if Adonijah does not give payment for these words with his life.
sentences.susu: Na kui mangɛ Sulemani naxa a kali Alatala ra, a naxɛ, «Ala xa n xun nakana xa Adoniya mu faxama a xa wɔyɛnyi xa fe ra!

sentences.english: Now by the living Lord, who has given me my place on the seat of David my father, and made me one of a line of kings, as he gave me his word, truly Adonijah will be put to death this day.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, n bara n kali Alatala xili ra, naxan n dɔxɔxi n baba Dawuda xa mangɛ kibanyi kui, to yati Adoniya faxama nɛ. N bara n kali Alatala ra naxan n ma fe birin sɔɔnɛyama, naxan bɔnsɔɛ fima n ma.»

sentences.english: And King Solomon sent Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, and he made an attack on him and put him to death.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani naxa Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya yamari, a xa sa Adoniya faxa. A raba na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And to Abiathar the priest the king said, Go to Anathoth, to your fields; for death would be your right reward; but I will not put you to death now, because you took up the ark of the Lord God before David my father, and you were with him in all his troubles.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, mangɛ naxa a fala Abiyatari sɛrɛxɛdubɛ bɛ, «Siga i xɔnyi Anatɔti bɔxi ma. A lan i xa faxa, kɔnɔ n bara diɲɛ barima i Ala xa saatɛ kankira xanin nɛ n Baba Dawuda ya i, i man tɔɔrɔ nɛ n baba xa tɔɔrɛ.»

sentences.english: So Solomon let Abiathar be priest no longer, so that he might make the word of the Lord come true which he said about the sons of Eli in Shiloh.
sentences.susu: Sulemani Abiyatari keri na ki nɛ. Na kui Alatala xa masenyi naxa kamali, Ala naxan masen Eli bɔnsɔɛ xa fe ra Silo.

sentences.english: And news of this came to Joab; for Joab had been one of Adonijah's supporters, though he had not been on Absalom's side. Then Joab went in flight to the Tent of the Lord, and put his hands on the horns of the altar.
sentences.susu: Yowaba nu bara Adoniya mali mangɛ matandide, kɔnɔ a mu nu na Abisalomi tan xa mangɛ matandife kui. Na kui, a to fe mɛ Sulemani naxan naba, a naxa a gi, a siga hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, a sa sɛrɛxɛbade ferie suxu.

sentences.english: And they said to King Solomon, Joab has gone in flight to the Tent of the Lord and is by the altar. Then Solomon sent Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, saying, Go, make an attack on him.
sentences.susu: Mixie to a fala mangɛ Sulemani bɛ, a Yowaba bara a gi a siga hɔrɔmɔlingira kui sɛrɛxɛbade yire, mangɛ Sulemani naxa Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya yamari, «Sa a faxa!»

sentences.english: And Benaiah came to the Tent of the Lord and said to him, The king says, Come out. And he said, No; but let death come to me here. And Benaiah went back to the king and gave him word of the answer which Joab had given.
sentences.susu: Bɛnaya naxa siga Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira, a a fala a bɛ, «Mangɛ naxɛ i xa mini.» A naxa a yaabi, «N tondi! N xa faxa be!» Bɛnaya naxa sa Yowaba xa wɔyɛnyi dɛntɛgɛ mangɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: And the king said, Do as he has said and make an attack on him there, and put his body into the earth; so that you may take away from me and from my family the blood of one put to death by Joab without cause.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala Bɛnaya bɛ, «I xa a raba alɔ a a falaxi ki naxɛ. I na a faxa, a ragata. Na kui i fama n tan nun n ma denbaya ratangade Yowaba xa wuli raminixi fufafui ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord will send back his blood on his head, because of the attack he made on two men more upright and better than himself, putting them to the sword without my father's knowledge; even Abner, the son of Ner, captain of the army of Israel, and Amasa, the son of Jether, captain of the army of Judah.
sentences.susu: Alatala fama na yunubi sare ragbilende a tan nan ma, barima a mixi firin faxa nɛ naxee nu tinxin a tan bɛ, naxee xa fe binyɛ nu dangi a tan gbe ra. N baba Dawuda mu nu a kolon a Neri xa di Abeneri nun Yeteri xa di Amasa, Isirayila sɔɔrie xa mangɛe faxa Yowaba xa santidɛgɛma nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: So their blood will be on the head of Joab, and on the head of his seed for ever; but for David and his seed and his family and the seat of his kingdom, there will be peace for ever from the Lord.
sentences.susu: E wuli sare dɔxɔma Yowaba nun a bɔnsɔɛ nan xun ma abadan, kɔnɔ Alatala xa hinnɛ nan luma Dawuda, a bɔnsɔɛe, a xa denbaya nun a xa mangɛya ma.»

sentences.english: So Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, went up, and falling on him, put him to death; and his body was put to rest in his house in the waste land.
sentences.susu: Yehoyada xa Bɛnaya naxa siga, a sa Yowaba faxa, a a ragata a xɔnyi gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: And the king put Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, in his place over the army; and Zadok the priest he put in the place of Abiathar.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya findi sɔɔrie xa mangɛ ra. A naxa Sadɔki sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ti Abiyatari ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then the king sent for Shimei, and said to him, Make a house for yourself in Jerusalem and keep there and go to no other place.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa xɛɛra ti Simeyi ma, a a fala a bɛ, «Banxi nde ti Darisalamu, i luma dɛnnaxɛ. I naxa mini taa kui de.

sentences.english: For be certain that on the day when you go out and go over the stream Kidron, death will overtake you: and your blood will be on your head.
sentences.susu: I na Sediron xure igiri lɔxɔɛ naxɛ minife ra taa kui, i faxama na lɔxɔɛ yati nɛ.»

sentences.english: And Shimei said to the king, Very well! as my lord the king has said, so will your servant do. And for a long time Shimei went on living in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Simeyi naxa mangɛ yaabi, a naxɛ, «Awa yire, i tan n marigi naxan falaxi, n na nan nabama.» Simeyi naxa bu Darisalamu ki fanyi,

sentences.english: But after three years, two of the servants of Shimei went in flight to Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. And word was given to Shimei that his servants had gone to Gath.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ ɲɛ saxan to dangi, a xa konyi firin naxa e gi e siga Maaka xa di Akisi xɔnyi, Gati mangɛ. Mixi ndee to a fala a bɛ, «I xa konyi firin na Gati,»

sentences.english: Then Shimei got up, and making ready his ass, he went to Gath, to Achish, in search of his servants; and he sent and got them from Gath.
sentences.susu: a naxa te a xa sofale fari, a siga a xa konyie fɔxɔ ra Gati, Akisi xɔnyi. A to e masɔtɔ, a naxa e ragbilen.

sentences.english: And news was given to Solomon that Shimei had gone from Jerusalem to Gath and had come back again.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa sa na fala mangɛ bɛ, a Simeyi mini nɛ Darisalamu, a siga Gati, a man gbilen.

sentences.english: Then the king sent for Shimei, and said to him, Did I not make you take an oath by the Lord, protesting to you and saying, Be certain that on the day when you go out from here, wherever you go, death will overtake you? and you said to me, Very well!
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa Simeyi xili, a a fala a bɛ, «N mu n kali Alatala ra xɛ i ya xɔri, fa a fala, ‹Xa i mini Darisalamu taa kui, n i faxama nɛ na lɔxɔɛ yati?› I mu a fala xɛ n bɛ a i n xui suxuma nɛ a fanyi ra?

sentences.english: Why then have you not kept the oath of the Lord and the order which I gave you?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra i mu tin na laayidi rakamalide i naxan tongo Alatala bɛ? Munfe ra i mu n ma yaamari suxu?»

sentences.english: And the king said to Shimei, You have knowledge of all the evil which you did to David my father; and now the Lord has sent back your evil on yourself.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala Simeyi bɛ, «I a kolon i fe ɲaaxi naxan birin naba n baba ra, mangɛ Dawuda, Alatala fama na sare ragbilende i ma,

sentences.english: But a blessing will be on King Solomon, and the kingdom of David will keep its place before the Lord for ever.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ a bara barakɛ sa mangɛ Sulemani ma. Dawuda xa mangɛya mabanbanxi a fanyi ra Alatala ya i.»

sentences.english: So the king gave orders to Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada; and he went out and, falling on him, put him to death. And Solomon's authority over the kingdom was complete.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui mangɛ naxa Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya yamari a xa Simeyi faxa. A naxa na raba. Sulemani xa mangɛya mabanban na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Solomon became the son-in-law of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh's daughter as his wife, keeping her in the town of David, till the house he was building for himself, and the house of the Lord and the wall round Jerusalem, were complete.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa lanyi xiri a tan nun Misira mangɛ firawuna tagi futi ra, a na xa di ginɛ dɔxɔ. A naxa na ginɛ yigiya «Dawuda xa Taa» kui, barima a mu nu gɛxi a xa mangɛ banxi, Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi, nun Darisalamu tɛtɛ tide.

sentences.english: But all this time the people were making their offerings in the high places, because no house had been put up to the name of the Lord till those days.
sentences.susu: Ɲama nu sɛrɛxɛ bama geyae nan fari, barima Alatala xa banxi mu nu tixi sinden.

sentences.english: And Solomon, in his love for the Lord, kept the laws of David his father; but he made offerings and let them go up in smoke on the high places.
sentences.susu: Sulemani nu Alatala xanuma, a man nu birama a baba Dawuda xa yaamarie fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ a fan nu sɛrɛxɛ nun surayi bama geyae nan fari alɔ booree.

sentences.english: And the king went to Gibeon to make an offering there, because that was the chief high place: it was Solomon's way to make a thousand burned offerings on that altar.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa siga Gabayon sɛrɛxɛ bade, barima na geya tide nu gbo. Sulemani naxa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi wulu keren ba mɛnni na sɛrɛxɛbade fari.

sentences.english: In Gibeon, Solomon had a vision of the Lord in a dream by night; and God said to him, Say what I am to give you.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa mini Sulemani ma xiye kui Gabayon kɔɛ ra. Ala naxa a fala a bɛ, «I wama fe naxan yo xɔn, a fala n bɛ n xa a fi i ma.»

sentences.english: And Solomon said, Great was your mercy to David my father, as his life before you was true and upright and his heart was true to you; and you have kept for him this greatest mercy, a son to take his place this day.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa a yaabi, a naxɛ, «I bara hinnɛnteya belebele raba i xa konyi n baba Dawuda bɛ, barima a a ɲɛrɛ nɛ i ya i nɔndi ra, tinxinyi ra, nun ɲanige fiixɛ ra. I bara hinnɛ a ra, i di fi a ma, naxan magoroxi a xa kibanyi kui. Na nan a niyaxi n bɛ to.

sentences.english: And now, O Lord my God, you have made your servant king in the place of David my father; and I am only a young boy, with no knowledge of how to go out or come in.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, n Marigi Alatala, i tan nan n magoroxi mangɛ kibanyi kui n baba Dawuda ɲɔxɔɛ ra. N luxi alɔ dimɛdi yi mangɛya kui.

sentences.english: And your servant has round him the people of your selection, a people so great that they may not be numbered, and no account of them may be given.
sentences.susu: N na i xa ɲama sugandixi tagi, naxan wuya han e kɔnti mu nɔma kɔntide.

sentences.english: Give your servant, then, a wise heart for judging your people, able to see what is good and what evil; for who is able to be the judge of this great people?
sentences.susu: Xaxilimaya fi n ma, alako n xa nɔ ɲama raɲɛrɛde a fanyi ra, n xa nɔ fe fanyi nun fe ɲaaxi tagi rasade. Xa na mu, nde fata yi ɲama raɲɛrɛde?»

sentences.english: Now these words and Solomon's request were pleasing to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sulemani xa maxandi naxa rafan Marigi ma.

sentences.english: And God said to him, Because your request is for this thing, and not for long life for yourself or for wealth or for the destruction of your haters, but for wisdom to be a judge of causes;
sentences.susu: Na kui, Ala naxa a masen Sulemani bɛ, «I to waxi xaxilimaya nan xɔn yi ɲama raɲɛrɛfe ra, i mu simaya xɔnkuye xa maxɔrinxi, i mu bannaya xa maxɔrinxi, i mu i yaxuie faxafe xa maxɔrinxi,

sentences.english: I have done as you said: I have given you a wise and far-seeing heart, so that there has never been your equal in the past, and never will there be any like you in the future.
sentences.susu: n bara i xa maxandi suxu. N xaxilimaya fanyi fima nɛ i ma, naxan maniyɛ mu toxi sinden, a man mu toma tɛmuie ma naxee sa fama.

sentences.english: And with this I have given you what you made no request for: wealth and honour, so that no king was ever your equal.
sentences.susu: N bannaya nun binyɛ fima nɛ i ma, naxee maniyɛ mu toma mangɛ gbɛtɛe yi i xa waxati, hali i to mu e maxɔrinxi.

sentences.english: And if you go on in my ways, keeping my laws and my orders as your father David did, I will give you a long life.
sentences.susu: Xa i bira n ma kira fɔxɔ ra, i n ma sɛriyɛ nun n ma yaamari ratinmɛ, alɔ i baba Dawuda a raba ki naxɛ, n i xa simaya ikuyama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And Solomon, awakening, saw that it was a dream; then he came to Jerusalem, where he went before the ark of the agreement of the Lord, offering burned offerings and peace-offerings; and he made a feast for all his servants.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Sulemani naxa xunu na xiye ma. A naxa gbilen Darisalamu Alatala xa saatɛ kankira yire. A naxa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛe ba, a fa na don a tan nun a xa mixie birin na.

sentences.english: Then two loose women of the town came and took their places before the king;
sentences.susu: Langoe ginɛ firin naxa siga mangɛ yire kiiti fenfe ra a yi.

sentences.english: And one of them said, O my lord, I and this woman are living in the same house; and I gave birth to a child by her side in the house.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ nde naxa a fala a bɛ, a naxɛ, «N marigi i xa i haakɛ to n bɛ. N nun yi ginɛ, muxu birin nan na banxi keren kui. N naxa di bari a ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And three days after the birth of my child, this woman had a child: we were together, no other-person was with us in the house but we two only.
sentences.susu: Xi saxan to dangi, a fan naxa di bari. Muxu doro nan tun nu a ra, mixi gbɛtɛ yo mu nu na banxi kui fo muxu firin peti.

sentences.english: In the night, this woman, sleeping on her child, was the cause of its death.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ nde kui, yi ginɛ naxa a sa a xa di fari, a xa di naxa faxa.

sentences.english: And she got up in the middle of the night and took my son from my side while your servant was sleeping; and she took it in her arms and put her dead child in my arms.
sentences.susu: A to na to, a naxa n ma di tongo n sɛɛti ma, a fa a xa di faxaxi sa n tan fɛ ma. N nu xife, n mu nu na sese kolon.

sentences.english: And when I got up to give my child the breast, I saw that it was dead; but in the morning, looking at it with care, I saw that it was not my son.
sentences.susu: Gɛɛsɛgɛ n to keli n xa xiɲɛ fi n ma di ma, n naxa a to na di bara faxa. Kɔnɔ n to a igbɛ fa a fanyi ra, n naxa a to n ma di mu a ra, n naxan barixi.»

sentences.english: And the other woman said, No; but the living child is my son and the dead one yours. But the first said, No; the dead child is your son and the living one mine. So they kept on talking before the king.
sentences.susu: Boore ginɛ naxa wɔyɛnyi tongo, a a fala, «A mu na na ki xɛ. N ma di nan baloxi, i tan nan xa di faxaxi.» Ginɛ singe naxa boore matandi a falafe ra, «I wule! N ma di xa mu faxaxi, n gbe nan baloxi.» E nu wɔyɛnma na ki nɛ mangɛ ya xɔri.

sentences.english: Then the king said, One says, The living child is my son, and yours is the dead: and the other says, Not so; but your son is the dead one and mine is the living.
sentences.susu: Na kui mangɛ naxa yi masenyi ti e bɛ, «Nde naxɛ, ‹N ma di nan baloxi, i gbe nan faxaxi.› Boore naxɛ, ‹I wule. N gbe nan baloxi, i gbe nan faxaxi.›»

sentences.english: Then he said, Get me a sword. So they went and put a sword before the king.
sentences.susu: Na wɔyɛnyi dangi xanbi, mangɛ naxa mixie yamari, «Wo fa santidɛgɛma ra n bɛ ba.» E to fa na santidɛgɛma ra a xɔn ma,

sentences.english: And the king said, Let the living child be cut in two and one half given to one woman and one to the other.
sentences.susu: a naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo yi diyɔrɛ baloxi ibolon a tagi, wo sɛɛti nde so yi ginɛ yi ra, wo boore sɛɛti so na boore ginɛ yi ra.»

sentences.english: Then the mother of the living child came forward, for her heart went out to her son, and she said, O my lord, give her the child; do not on any account put it to death. But the other woman said, It will not be mine or yours; let it be cut in two.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui ginɛ naxan xa di baloxi, na bɔɲɛ naxa a xaba a xa di xa fe xanunteya xafe ra, han a a fala mangɛ bɛ, «Yandi, n bara i maxandi n marigi, wo di baloxi so a yi ra, wo naxa yi di faxa.» Kɔnɔ boore ginɛ tan naxa a fala, «Yi di naxa lu n yi ra, a naxa lu i fan yi ra. Wo a ibolon!»

sentences.english: Then the king made answer and said, Give her the child, and do not put it to death; she is the mother of it.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ to na mɛ, a naxa a masen, «Wo naxa diyɔrɛ faxa. Wo xa yi di baloxi so na ginɛ singe yi ra, a nga nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And news of this decision which the king had made went through all Israel; and they had fear of the king, for they saw that the wisdom of God was in him to give decisions.
sentences.susu: Isirayila ɲama to mangɛ xa kiiti mɛ, e naxa gaaxu a ya ra, barima e nu bara a kolon Ala xaxili nan na a bɔɲɛ ma mangɛya raɲɛrɛfe ra tinxinyi kui.

sentences.english: Now Solomon was king over all Israel.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani nu Isirayila bɔxi birin yamarima.

sentences.english: And these were his chief men: Azariah, the son of Zadok, was the priest;
sentences.susu: A xa kuntigi xungbee nan yi ki: Sadɔki xa di Asaraya, naxan findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra.

sentences.english: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, were scribes; Jehoshaphat, the son of Ahilud, was the recorder;
sentences.susu: Sifa xa di Elixorefa nun Ahiya, naxee findi sɛbɛlitie ra. Axiludu xa di Yehosafati, naxan findi kɛɛdi ragatɛ ra.

sentences.english: Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, was head of the army; Zadok and Abiathar were priests;
sentences.susu: Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya, naxan findi sɔɔrie xa mangɛ ra. Sadɔki nun Abiyatari, naxee findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra.

sentences.english: Azariah, the son of Nathan, was over those in authority in the different divisions of the country; Zabud, the son of Nathan, was priest and the king's friend;
sentences.susu: Natan xa di Asariyahu, naxan findi gominae xa mangɛ ra. Natan xa di Sabadi, naxan findi mangɛ xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra.

sentences.english: Ahishar was controller of the king's house; Adoniram, the son of Abda, was overseer of the forced work.
sentences.susu: Ahisari, naxan findi mangɛ xa banxi walikɛe xunyi ra. Abeda xa di Adonirami, naxan findi konyie xunyi ra.

sentences.english: And Solomon put twelve overseers over all Israel, to be responsible for the stores needed for the king and those of his house; every man was responsible for one month in the year.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani nu bara gomina fu nun firin ti Isirayila bɔxi xun ma. Kike yo kike ɲɛ kui, gomina keren nu fama baloe ra mangɛ nun a xa denbaya bɛ.

sentences.english: And these are their names: ... the son of Hur in the hill country of Ephraim;
sentences.susu: E xilie nan ya: Xuru xa di, naxan nu gomina ra Efirami bɔnsɔɛ xa geya bɔxi xun ma.

sentences.english: ... the son of Deker in Makaz and Shaalbim and Beth-shemesh and Elonbeth-hanan;
sentences.susu: Dekeri xa di, naxan nu gomina ra Makasa, Saalabimi, Beti Semesi, Elon, nun Beti Hanan taae xun ma.

sentences.english: ... the son of Hesed in Arubboth; Socoh and all the land of Hepher were under his control;
sentences.susu: Xeseda xa di, naxan nu gomina ra Arubotu, Soko, nun Xeferi bɔxi xun ma.

sentences.english: ... the son of Abinadab in all Naphath-dor; his wife was Taphath, the daughter of Solomon.
sentences.susu: Abinadabo xa di, naxan nu gomina ra Dɔrɔ bɔxi xun ma, naxan mangɛ Sulemani xa di ginɛ Tafati dɔxɔ.

sentences.english: Baana, the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beth-shean which is by the side of Zarethan, under Jezreel, from Beth-shean to Abel-meholah, as far as the far side of Jokmeam;
sentences.susu: Axiludu xa di Bana, naxan nu gomina ra Taanaki, Megido, nun Beti Saan xun ma, dɛnnaxɛ na Saratan sɛɛti ma. A tan nan nu gomina ra Yisireeli fan xun ma, kelife Beti Saan han Abeli Mexola, han Yokineyami xanbi ra.

sentences.english: ... the son of Geber in Ramoth-gilead; he had the towns of Jair, the son of Manasseh, which are in Gilead, and the country of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great towns with walls and locks of brass.
sentences.susu: Geberi xa di, naxan nu gomina ra Ramoti, Galadi bɔxi ma. A tan nan nu gomina ra Manasi xa di Yayiri xa taae xun ma, Galadi bɔxi ma. A tan nan nu gomina ra na bɔxi xun ma, kelife Aragobo han Basan, taa xungbe makantaxi tongo senni nu na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Ahinadab, the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;
sentences.susu: Ido xa di Axinadabo nan nu gomina ra Maxanayimi xun ma.

sentences.english: Ahimaaz in Naphtali; he took Basemath, the daughter of Solomon, as his wife;
sentences.susu: Aximaasi nan nu gomina ra Nafatali bɔxi xun ma, naxan mangɛ Sulemani xa di ginɛ Basamati dɔxɔ.

sentences.english: Baana, the son of Hushai, in Asher and Aloth;
sentences.susu: Xusayi xa di Bana nan nu gomina ra Aseri nun Beyaloti xun ma.

sentences.english: Jehoshaphat, the son of Paruah, in Issachar;
sentences.susu: Paruwa xa di Yehosafati nan nu gomina ra Isakari bɔxi xun ma.

sentences.english: Shimei, the son of Ela, in Benjamin;
sentences.susu: Ela xa di Simeyi nan nu gomina ra Bunyamin bɔxi xun ma.

sentences.english: Geber, the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan; and one overseer had authority over all the overseers who were in the land.
sentences.susu: Uri xa di Geberi nan nu gomina ra Galadi bɔxi xun ma, a Amorikae xa mangɛ Sixɔn xa bɔxi, nun Basankae xa mangɛ Ogo xa bɔxi. Geberi keren nan nu na bɔxi birin gomina ra.

sentences.english: Judah and Israel were as great in number as the sand by the seaside, and they took their food and drink with joy in their hearts.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae nun Isirayilakae nu wuya alɔ baa dɛ ra mɛyɛnyi. E nu e dɛgema, e nu e minma sɛɛwɛ kui.

sentences.english: Now Hiram, king of Tyre, hearing that Solomon had been made king in place of his father, sent his servants to him; for Hiram had ever been a friend to David.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani nu bɔxi birin yamarima, kelife Efirati xure ma, han Filisita bɔxi, han Misira naaninyi ra. Na mixi birin nu duuti fima mangɛ Sulemani ma a xa simaya birin kui.

sentences.english: And Solomon sent back word to Hiram, saying,
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani nun a xa mixie baloe findi yi nan na lɔxɔɛ keren kui: farin fuɲi daaxi busali kɛmɛ tongo saxan, ɲɔɛraba busali kɛmɛ firin tongo naani,

sentences.english: You have knowledge that David my father was not able to make a house for the name of the Lord his God, because of the wars which were round him on every side, till the Lord put all those who were against him under his feet.
sentences.susu: ninge bɔrɔgɛxi fu, ninge dɛmadon daaxi mɔxɔɲɛn, xuruse lanma kɛmɛ, bolee, xelie, burunyi sie, nun xɔni bɔrɔgɛxie.

sentences.english: But now the Lord my God has given me rest on every side; no one is making trouble, and no evil is taking place.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani nan nu bɔxi birin yamarima naxee nu na Efirati xure yirefanyi ma, kelife Tifisa han Gasa. Na bɔxi mangɛe nun e xa mixie nu sabatixi bɔɲɛsa nan kui.

sentences.english: And so it is my purpose to make a house for the name of the Lord my God, as he said to David my father, Your son, whom I will make king in your place, will be the builder of a house for my name.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae nun Isirayilakae birin, kelife Dana han Beriseeba, nu sabatixi bɔɲɛsa nan kui e xa wɛni bilie nun e xa xɔrɛ bilie tagi Sulemani xa mangɛya bun ma.

sentences.english: So now, will you have cedar-trees from Lebanon cut down for me, and my servants will be with your servants; and I will give you payment for your servants at whatever rate you say; for it is common knowledge that we have no such wood-cutters among us as the men of Zidon.
sentences.susu: Soe gɔɔrɛ wulu tongo naani nu na Sulemani yi ra, naxee nu a xa sɔɔri ragisee bɛndunma. Soe ragi mixi wulu fu nun firin nan nu na Sulemani yi ra.

sentences.english: And these words of Solomon made Hiram glad, and he said, Now may the Lord be praised who has given to David a wise son to be king over this great people.
sentences.susu: Sulemani xa gomina fu nun firinyie nu fama baloe ra a bɛ nun a xa mixie bɛ. Kike yo kike gomina nde nu fama mangɛ hayi birin na.

sentences.english: Then Hiram sent to Solomon, saying; The words you sent have been given to me: I will do all your desire in the question of cedar-wood and cypress-wood.
sentences.susu: E nu fama mɛngi nun sɛxɛ ra soe birin bɛ gɔɔrɛe kui.

sentences.english: My men will take them down from Lebanon to the sea, where I will have them corded together to go by sea to whatever place you say, and I will have them cut up there so that you may take them away; as for payment, it will be enough if you give me food for my people.
sentences.susu: Ala xaxilimaya, lɔnni, nun fahaamui gbegbe nan so Sulemani yi ra. E nu gbo alɔ baa dɛ ra mɛyɛnyi.

sentences.english: So Hiram gave Solomon all the cedar-wood and cypress-wood he had need of;
sentences.susu: Sulemani xa xaxilimaya nu dangi fugerakae nun Misirakae xa xaxilimaya birin na.

sentences.english: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of grain, as food for his people, and twenty measures of clear oil; this he did every year.
sentences.susu: A xa xaxilimaya nu dangi mixi birin na, hali Etani Esiraka, Maxolo xa die Heman, Kalikɔli, nun Darada. A xili naxa din bɔxi birin na naxee nu Isirayila rabilinyi.

sentences.english: Now the Lord had given Solomon wisdom, as he had said to him; and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and they made an agreement together.
sentences.susu: A taali wulu saxan nan fala, a nun bɛɛti wulu keren nun suuli.

sentences.english: Then King Solomon got together men for the forced work through all Israel, thirty thousand men in number;
sentences.susu: A wuri gbegbee xa fe fala, a fɔlɔfe Liban wuri xungbe ma naxan xili sɛdiri, a sa hisopi sansi xunxuri li naxan bulama banxi xalɛ ma. A subee, xɔnie, bubusee, nun yɛxɛe fan xa fe fala.

sentences.english: And sent them to Lebanon in bands of ten thousand every month: for a month they were working in Lebanon and for two months in their country, and Adoniram was in control of them.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa mangɛe nu luma mixie xɛɛ ra e xa fa mangɛ Sulemani xa lɔnni nun xaxilimaya ramɛ.

sentences.english: Then he had seventy thousand for the work of transport, and eighty thousand stone-cutters in the mountains;
sentences.susu: Tire mangɛ Xirami naxa kuntigie xɛɛ mangɛ Sulemani xɔn, barima a nu bara a mɛ a a tan nan tixi mangɛ ra a baba ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Xirami nu bara Sulemani baba Dawuda xanu kabi a rakuya.

sentences.english: In addition to the chiefs of the responsible men put by Solomon to oversee the work, three thousand and three hundred in authority over the workmen.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa Xirami yaabi,

sentences.english: By the king's orders great stones, stones of high price, were cut out, so that the base of the house might be made of squared stone.
sentences.susu: «I nu n baba Dawuda kolon, a mu nɔ banxi tide a Marigi Alatala bɛ gere xa fe ra, naxan nu na a yire birin han Alatala naxa a yaxuie sa a sanyi bun ma.

sentences.english: Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did the work of cutting them, and put edges on them, and got the wood and the stone ready for the building of the house.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi Alatala bara a ragiri n xa lu bɔɲɛsa kui. Gere nun fe xɔnɛ bara ɲɔn.

sentences.english: In the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel came out of the land of Egypt, in the fourth year that Solomon was king of Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, the building of the Lord's house was started.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ kɛmɛ naani ɲɛ tongo solomasaxan to dangi kelife Isirayila mini Misira bɔxi ra tɛmui naxɛ, mangɛ Sulemani naxa Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ti fɔlɔ Siwi kike kui. Na ɲɛ findixi a xa mangɛya ɲɛ naani nde nan na Isirayila bɔxi xun ma.

sentences.english: The house which Solomon made for the Lord was sixty cubits long, twenty cubits wide and thirty cubits high.
sentences.susu: Sulemani Ala xa banxi ti yi maniyɛ xasabi nan na: A kuyɛ ɲɔngɔn ya tongo senni, a gboe ɲɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn, a ite ɲɔngɔn ya tongo saxan.

sentences.english: The covered way before the Temple of the house was twenty cubits long, as wide as the house, and ten cubits wide in front of the house.
sentences.susu: A yatagi buntunyi xa kuyɛ nu lanxi ɲɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn nan ma, alɔ banxi xa kuyɛ na ki naxɛ. A gboe fan findi ɲɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn nan na.

sentences.english: And for the house he made windows, with network across.
sentences.susu: A wundɛrie nu yailanxi banxi xalɛ nan kui, wurie fan nu yailanxi e fari.

sentences.english: And against the walls all round, and against the walls of the Temple and of the inmost room, he put up wings, with side rooms all round:
sentences.susu: A naxa konkoe fatu hɔrɔmɔbanxi xalɛ rabilinyi.

sentences.english: The lowest line of them being five cubits wide, the middle six cubits wide and the third seven cubits; for there was a space all round the outside walls of the house so that the boards supporting the rooms did not have to be fixed in the walls of the house.
sentences.susu: Konkoe singee xa gboe nu lanxi ɲɔngɔn ya suuli nan ma. Nee fari konkoe gbɛtɛe naxa dɔxɔ naxee xa gboe nu lanxi ɲɔngɔn ya senni ma. Nee fan fari konkoe gbɛtɛe naxa dɔxɔ naxee xa gboe nu lanxi ɲɔngɔn ya solofere ma. Hɔrɔmɔbanxi xalɛ xa marabinye nu raxurunxi a fuge biri ra, alako konkoee masa wurie mu soma banxi xalɛ kui ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: (And the stones used in the building of the house were squared at the place where they were cut out; there was no sound of hammer or axe or any iron instrument while they were building the house.)
sentences.susu: E to nu hɔrɔmɔbanxi tima, e nu gɛmɛe rawalima naxee ɲan nu bara masoli geya yire e tongoxi dɛnnaxɛ. Na ki walise yo xui mu nu mɛma hɔrɔmɔbanxi yire, alɔ dɛrɛma, bera, xa na mu a ra walise gbɛtɛ naxan yailanxi wure ra.

sentences.english: The door to the lowest side rooms was in the right side of the house; and they went up by twisting steps into the middle rooms, and from the middle into the third.
sentences.susu: Naadɛ nde nu na banxi yirefanyi ma naxan minima konkoee yire ma. Tede samɛ daaxi nde nu yailanxi banxi kui ma, naxan nu konkoee kui masɔtɔma koore ra.

sentences.english: So he put up the house and made it complete, roofing it with boards of cedar-wood.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ banxi tide, Sulemani naxa a raxunma sɛdiri wurie ra.

sentences.english: And he put up the line of side rooms against the walls of the house, fifteen cubits high, resting against the house on boards of cedar-wood.
sentences.susu: Konkoe naxee nu tixi hɔrɔmɔbanxi sɛɛtie ma, e ite ɲɔngɔn ya suuli. Na birin nu xirixi banxi ma sɛdiri wurie ra.

sentences.english: (And the word of the Lord came to Solomon, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen mangɛ Sulemani bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: About this house which you are building: if you will keep my laws and give effect to my decisions and be guided by my rules, I will give effect to my word which I gave to David your father.
sentences.susu: «N xa a fala i bɛ yi banxi tife xa fe ra, xa i sa i ɲɛrɛ n ma kira xɔn ma, xa i sa n ma sɛriyɛ rabatu, xa i sa n ma yaamarie suxu, n nan n ma laayidi rakamalima nɛ i bɛ, n naxan fala i baba Dawuda bɛ.

sentences.english: And I will be ever among the children of Israel, and will not go away from my people.
sentences.susu: Na kui n luma nɛ n ma ɲama tagi, n mu i bɛɲinma abadan.»

sentences.english: So Solomon made the building of the house complete.)
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ti, a wali raɲɔn.

sentences.english: The walls of the house were covered inside with cedar-wood boards; from the floor to the roof of the house they were covered inside with wood; and the floor was covered with boards of cypress-wood.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛdiri wuri xebenyie mafatu banxi xalɛe ma a kui, kelife a xalɛ fɔlɛ ma han banxi xunyi ra. A naxa sipirɛ wuri xebenyie mafatu banxi gbaata ma.

sentences.english: And at the back of the house a further space of twenty cubits was shut in with boards of cedar-wood, for the inmost room.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛdiri wuri xebenyie mafatu konkoe ɲɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn daaxi ma banxi kui dunxui ra, kelife a gbaata ma han fuge. Na nu findixi Yire Sɛniyɛnxi Fisamante nan na.

sentences.english: And the house, that is, the Temple, in front of the holy place was forty cubits long.
sentences.susu: Banxi palaa dɔnxɔɛ naxan nu na na yatagi, nu kuya ɲɔngɔn ya tongo naani. Na nu findixi Yire Sɛniyɛnxi nan na.

sentences.english: (All the inside of the house was cedar-wood, ornamented with designs of buds and flowers; no stonework was to be seen inside.)
sentences.susu: Sɛdiri wuri xebenyie naxee nu fatuxi banxi xalɛe ma palaa ma, sansi bogie nun sansi fugee fan nu masolixi e ma. Na ki, gɛmɛ mu nu toma banxi kui ma fefe ma.

sentences.english: And he made ready an inmost room in the middle of the house, in which to put the ark of the agreement of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa Yire Sɛniyɛnxi Fisamante yailan hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, Alatala xa saatɛ kankira dɔxɔma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And the inmost room was twenty cubits square and twenty cubits high, plated over with clear gold, and he made an altar of cedar-wood, plating it with gold.
sentences.susu: Na yire kuya ɲɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn, a igbo ɲɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn, a ite ɲɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn. Xɛɛma nu masoxi na konkoe xalɛe birin ma, a nun sɛrɛxɛbade ma naxan yailanxi sɛdiri wuri ra.

sentences.english: Solomon had all the inside of the house covered with gold, and he put chains of gold across in front of the inmost room, which itself was covered with gold.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani naxa xɛɛma maso na Yire Sɛniyɛnxi Fisamante xalɛe ma. A naxa yɔlɔnxɔnyi xunxuri xɛɛma daaxie gbaku naa sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: Plates of gold were put all through the house till it was covered completely (and the altar in the inmost room was all covered with gold).
sentences.susu: Ba na ra, a nu bara xɛɛma maso na hɔrɔmɔbanxi xalɛe birin ma, a nun sɛrɛxɛbade ma naxan nu na naa.

sentences.english: In the inmost room he made two winged beings of olive-wood, ten cubits high;
sentences.susu: A naxa malekɛ firin misaali masoli wulai oliwi wuri ra. E ite ɲɔngɔn ya fu.

sentences.english: With outstretched wings five cubits wide; the distance from the edge of one wing to the edge of the other was ten cubits.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ singe gabutenyi keren xa kuyɛ ɲɔngɔn ya suuli, a gabutenyi firin nde fan xa kuyɛ ɲɔngɔn ya suuli, naxan lanma nɔngɔn fu ma kelife a kɔɔla ma han a yirefanyi ma.

sentences.english: The two winged ones were ten cubits high, of the same size and form.
sentences.susu: Boore malekɛ fan gbee lanxi ɲɔngɔn ya fu nan ma. E firinyi nu yailanxi kɛɲa keren nan na.

sentences.english: The two of them were ten cubits high.
sentences.susu: E firinyi ite ɲɔngɔn ya fu.

sentences.english: These were placed inside the inner house, their outstretched wings touching the walls of the house, one touching one wall and one the other, while their other wings were touching in the middle.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa na malekɛe ti Yire Sɛniyɛnxi Fisamante tagi, alako malekɛe gabutenyie xa banxi xalɛe li, e fan xa e boore li banxi tagi.

sentences.english: These winged ones were plated over with gold.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa xɛɛma maso na malekɛ firinyie birin ma.

sentences.english: And all the walls of the house inside and out were ornamented with forms of winged ones and palm-trees and open flowers.
sentences.susu: A naxa yaamari fi, a e xa malekɛe, tugi bilie, nun wuri fuge tofanyi misaalie masoli banxi xalɛe ma, naxee nu na Yire Sɛniyɛnxi Fisamante nun Yire Sɛniyɛnxi kui.

sentences.english: And the floor of the house was covered with gold, inside and out.
sentences.susu: A naxa xɛɛma maso banxi gbaata ma na yire firinyie kui.

sentences.english: For the way into the inmost room he made doors of olive-wood, the arch and the door supports forming a five-sided opening.
sentences.susu: A naxa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa naadɛe yailan wulai oliwi wuri ra. A e gbaku oliwi wuri xebenyie ra naxee xa marabinye mu nu banxi xalɛ gbe lima, fo dɔxɔ naani.

sentences.english: On the olive-wood doors were cut designs of winged ones and palm-trees and open flowers, all of them, with the doors, plated with gold.
sentences.susu: Na naadɛ firinyie nu yailanxi wulai oliwi wuri nan na. Malekɛ, tugi bili, nun wuri fuge tofanyie misaalie nu masolixi na naadɛe ma. Xɛɛma nu masoxi na naadɛe nun na misaalie ma

sentences.english: Then he made pillars of olive-wood for the way into the Temple; the pillars were square:
sentences.susu: A naxa na mɔɔli raba naadɛe ma naxee nu na Yire Sɛniyɛnxi ma. E yailanxi oliwi wuri ra, e gbakuxi wuri xebenyie ra naxee mu nu banxi xalɛ xa marabinye lima fo dɔxɔ saxan.

sentences.english: And two folding doors of cypress-wood, with two leaves.
sentences.susu: Naadɛ firinyi gbɛtɛ nu yailanxi sipirɛ wuri ra.

sentences.english: These were ornamented with designs of winged ones and palm-trees and open flowers, plated over with gold.
sentences.susu: A naxa yaamari fi e xa malekɛe, tugie, nun sansi fuge tofanyi misaalie masoli e ma. Na dangi xanbi a naxa xɛɛma maso naadɛe nun na misaalie ma.

sentences.english: And the inner space was walled with three lines of squared stones and a line of cedar-wood boards.
sentences.susu: A naxa buntunyi yailan gɛmɛ masolixie ra, naxee nu dɔxɔxi safɛ saxan na, a nun sɛdiri wuri safɛ keren na.

sentences.english: In the fourth year the base of the house was put in its place, in the month Ziv.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa banxi dɔxɔ fɔlɔ Siwi kike nan na, Sulemani xa mangɛya ɲɛ naani nde.

sentences.english: And in the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, the building of the house was complete in every detail, as it had been designed. So he was seven years building it.
sentences.susu: A naxa ɲɔn Bulu kike ra, kike solomasaxan nde, Sulemani xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun keren nde. Na banxi birin ti ɲɛ solofere nan bun ma, a fa lu alɔ Ala nu wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Solomon was thirteen years building a house for himself till it was complete.
sentences.susu: Sulemani bu nɛ ɲɛ fu nun saxan a yɛtɛ xa banxie tife ra.

sentences.english: And he made the house of the Woods of Lebanon, which was a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide and thirty cubits high, resting on four lines of cedar-wood pillars with cedar-wood supports on the pillars.
sentences.susu: A banxi naxan singe ti a a xili sa nɛ «Liban fɔtɔnyi banxi.» A nu kuya ɲɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ, a igbo ɲɔngɔn ya tongo suuli, a ite ɲɔngɔn ya tongo saxan. A xunyi wurie nu dɔxɔxi kinki safɛ naani naxee xun, nee nu yailanxi sɛdiri wuri nan na.

sentences.english: And it was covered with cedar over the forty-five supports which were on the pillars, fifteen in a line.
sentences.susu: Na kinkie fari nu makotoxi sɛdiri xebenyi tongo naani nun suuli nan na a safɛ ki ma, fu nun suuli safɛ keren.

sentences.english: There were three lines of window-frames, window facing window in every line.
sentences.susu: Banxi sɛɛtie ma, wundɛri safɛ saxan nu na e ma, e ya rafindixi e boore ma.

sentences.english: And all the doors and windows had square frames, with the windows facing one another in three lines.
sentences.susu: Naadɛ saxan fan nu na wundɛrie ya tagi.

sentences.english: And he made a covered room of pillars, fifty cubits long and thirty cubits wide, and ... with steps before it.
sentences.susu: Buntunyi nu na naxan xa kuyɛ ɲɔngɔn ya tongo suuli lima, a igboe ɲɔngɔn ya tongo saxan.

sentences.english: Then he made a covered room for his high seat when he gave decisions; this was the covered room of judging; it was covered with cedar-wood from floor to roof.
sentences.susu: Banxi pala naxan fan nu yailanxi sɛdiri wuri ra keli a gbata ma han fuge, nan nu findixi a xa kiiti sade ra.

sentences.english: And the house for his living-place, the other open square in the covered room, was made in the same way. And then he made a house like it for Pharaoh's daughter, whom Solomon had taken as his wife.
sentences.susu: A banxi gbɛtɛ ti nɛ na xanbi ra a nu luma dɛnnaxɛ. A a yailan alɔ boore. Na xanbi ra, a naxa banxi gbɛtɛ ti Firawuna xa di ginɛ bɛ a naxan dɔxɔ.

sentences.english: All these buildings were made, inside and out, from base to crowning stone, and outside to the great walled square, of highly priced stone, cut to different sizes with cutting-instruments.
sentences.susu: Nee birin ti gɛmɛ masolixie nan na naxee xabaxi sɛra ra a kui nun a fari, kelife a bunyi ma han fuge.

sentences.english: And the base was of great masses of highly priced stone, some ten cubits and some eight cubits square.
sentences.susu: Banxi sanbunyi dɔxɔ gɛmɛ tofanyi xungbee nan na, naxee xabaxi ɲɔngɔn ya fu xa na mu a ra ɲɔngɔn ya solomasaxan ma.

sentences.english: Overhead were highly priced stones cut to measure, and cedar-wood.
sentences.susu: A fuge ra, sɛdiri wuri nun gɛmɛ tofanyie nu na naxee xabaxi a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: The great outer square all round was walled with three lines of squared stones and a line of cedar-wood boards, round about the open square inside the house of the Lord and the covered room of the king's house.
sentences.susu: Na tɛtɛ xungbe nu yailanxi gɛmɛ xabaxi safɛ saxan na, sɛdiri wuri fan nu saxi na fari, alɔ Alatala xa banxi nun a gbutunyi.

sentences.english: Then King Solomon sent and got Hiram from Tyre.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani naxa mixi nde fen Tire, naxan xili Xirami.

sentences.english: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a man of Tyre, a worker in brass; he was full of wisdom and knowledge and an expert worker in brass. He came to King Solomon and did all his work for him.
sentences.susu: Kaaɲɛ ginɛ nde xa di nan nu a ra fatanfe Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ ra. Tireka nan nu a Baba ra, naxan nu wure gbeeli rawalima. A lɔnnixi, a xaxili fan, a fata wure gbeeli rawalide a mɔɔli birin na. A siga nɛ mangɛ Sulemani yire, a na wali mɔɔli raba.

sentences.english: He it was who made the two brass pillars; the first pillar was eighteen cubits high, and a line of twelve cubits went round it; and the second was the same.
sentences.susu: A kinki firin xabu wure gbeeli ra, naxee ite ɲɔngɔn ya fu nun solomasaxan, naxee xa radigilinyi lanxi ɲɔngɔn ya fu nun firin ma.

sentences.english: And he made the two crowns to be put on the tops of the pillars, of brass made soft in the fire; the crowns were five cubits high.
sentences.susu: A xunyi firin xabu na kinki firinyie bɛ, naxee ite ɲɔngɔn ya suuli.

sentences.english: There were nets of open-work for the crowns on the tops of the pillars, a net of open-work for one and a net of open-work for the other.
sentences.susu: A se raxunmase fu nun naani xabu na xunyi firinyie bɛ, xunyi keren solofere.

sentences.english: And he made ornaments of apples; and two lines of apples all round over the network, covering the crowns of the pillars, the two crowns in the same way.
sentences.susu: A mangoe bogi maniyɛe yailan safɛ firin na na se raxunmase radɔxɔxi firinyie ma.

sentences.english: The crowns on the tops of the pillars were ornamented with a design of flowers, and were four cubits across.
sentences.susu: A fuge maniyɛe masoli na kinki xunyi firinyie ma naxee nu na buntunyi ra. E ite ɲɔngɔn ya naani.

sentences.english: And there were crowns on the two pillars near the round part by the network, and there were two hundred apples in lines round every crown.
sentences.susu: A mangoe bogi maniyɛe kɛmɛ firin masoli na kinki xunyi firinyie ma.

sentences.english: He put up the pillars at the doorway of the Temple, naming the one on the right Jachin, and that on the left Boaz.
sentences.susu: A na kinkie ti buntunyi ya tagi. Naxan nu na a yirefanyi ma, a xili naxa sa Yakin, naxan nu na a kɔɔla ma, na xili naxa sa Boosu.

sentences.english: The tops of the pillars had a design of flowers; and the work of making the pillars was complete.
sentences.susu: Na kinkie konde ra, fugee nu masolixi mɛnnie ma.

sentences.english: And he made a great metal water-vessel ten cubits across from edge to edge, five cubits high and thirty cubits round.
sentences.susu: A naxa ye sase xungbe digilinxi yailan yɔxui ra. A dɛ igboe ɲɔngɔn ya fu, a ite ɲɔngɔn ya suuli, a xa radigilinyi ɲɔngɔn ya tongo saxan.

sentences.english: And under the edge of it, circling it all round for ten cubits, were two lines of flower buds, made together with it from liquid metal.
sentences.susu: Na ye sase dɛ rabilinyi bunyi, ninge maniyɛ nu masolixi a ma e radɔxɔxi e boore ra a rabilinyi birin ma. Ninge fu na ɲɔngɔn ya keren ma, suuli a fari, suuli a bun. Ningee yo, ye sase yo, na birin yailanxi kerenyi nan na.

sentences.english: It was supported on twelve oxen, with their back parts turned to the middle of it, three of them facing to the north, three to the west, three to the south, and three to the east; the vessel was resting on top of them.
sentences.susu: Na ye sase nu dɔxɔxi ninge maniyɛ gbɛtɛ fu nun firin fari. Saxan ya rafindixi kɔɔla biri, saxan ya rafindixi sogegorode biri, saxan ya rafindixi yirefanyi biri, saxan ya rafindixi sogetede biri. Na ye sase naxan nu xili «Baa» nu dɔxɔxi na ningee fari, e ya rafindixi tande ma.

sentences.english: It was as thick as a man's open hand, and was curved like the edge of a cup, like the flower of a lily: it would take two thousand baths.
sentences.susu: Na ye sase xa marabinye nu findixi suxu keren nan na. A dɛ kiri masolixi maniyɛ sansi fuge tofanyi ra. Ye fifa kɛmɛ solofere fifa tongo suuli nu nɔma sade a kui.

sentences.english: And he made ten wheeled bases of brass; every one four cubits long, four cubits wide, and three cubits high.
sentences.susu: A naxa e sanbunyi fu yailan. E birin nu kuya ɲɔngɔn ya naani, e igbo ɲɔngɔn ya naani, a ite ɲɔngɔn ya saxan.

sentences.english: And the bases were made in this way; their sides were square, fixed in a framework;
sentences.susu: E na sanbunyie rafala ki naxɛ, wure ralɛnfɛtɛnxie nu na wure gbɛtɛ naani tagi.

sentences.english: And on the square sides between the frames were lions, oxen, and winged ones; and the same on the frame; and over and under the lions and the oxen and the winged ones were steps.
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛ misaalie, ninge misaalie, nun malekɛ misaalie nu yailanxi na wure ralɛnfɛtɛnxie ma, a nun pirinti gbɛtɛe.

sentences.english: Every base had four wheels of brass, turning on brass rods, and their four angles had angle-plates under them; the angle-plates under the base were of metal, and there were ornaments at the side of every one.
sentences.susu: Wure digilinxi naani nu na sanbunyi keren keren ma bɛ a ti se ra, naxee nu xirixi e boore ra wure gbeeli firin na. Wure nde nu na na tuxui naanie ma ye sase bun ma. Na birin nu yailanxi tɛmui kerenyi nan na.
