sentences.english: The mouth of it inside the angle-plate was one cubit across; it was round like a pillar, a cubit and a half across; it had designs cut on it; the sides were square, not round.
sentences.susu: Se digilinxi nde nu na ye sase nu dɔxɔxi naxan kui. Na ite ɲɔngɔn ya keren sanbunyi bɛ, a igbo ɲɔngɔn ya keren nun a tagi. Se ndee nu masolixi na ma. Na wure ralɛnfɛtɛnxie mu nu digilinxi, e sɛɛti naanie birin xa maniyɛ nu lan.

sentences.english: The four wheels were under the frames, and the rods on which the wheels were fixed were in the base; the wheels were a cubit and a half high.
sentences.susu: Na wure digilinxi naani naxee nu na a ye maxanin se tuxui naanie ra, e ite ɲɔngɔn ya keren nun a tagi, firin nu xirixi e boore ra wure gbeeli ra.

sentences.english: The wheels were made like carriage-wheels, the rods on which they were fixed, the parts forming their edges, their rods and the middle points of them, were all formed out of liquid metal.
sentences.susu: Na wure digilinxie maniyɛ sɔɔri ragise sanyie ra. E birin nu yailanxi wure gbeeli ra tɛmui kerenyi ra.

sentences.english: And there were four angle-plates at the four angles of every base, forming part of the structure of the base.
sentences.susu: Se nde nu na tuxui naanie birin na naxee nu sɛnbɛ fima e ma.

sentences.english: And at the top of the base there was a round vessel, half a cubit high;
sentences.susu: Se digilinxi nde nu na ye sase dɔxɔde kui. Na ite sanbunyi bɛ ɲɔngɔn ya keren. Sanbunyie fuge, a kilɔndee nun a wure ralɛnfɛtɛnxie birin nu yailanxi wure gbeeli nan na tɛmui kerenyi ra.

sentences.english: In the spaces of the flat sides and on the frames of them, he made designs of winged ones, lions, and palm-trees, with ornamented edges all round.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ misaalie, yɛtɛ misaalie, nun tugi misaalie nu yailanxi na kebelae ma, nun se gbɛtɛe.

sentences.english: All the ten bases were made in this way, after the same design, of the same size and form.
sentences.susu: Ye maxanin se fu nu yailanxi ki kerenyi ra na ki nɛ wure gbeeli ra. E birin nu lan.

sentences.english: And he made ten brass washing-vessels, everyone taking forty baths, and measuring four cubits; one vessel was placed on every one of the ten bases.
sentences.susu: Xirami ye sase fu yailan nɛ wure gbeeli ra, naxee nu dɔxɔxi na ye maxanin se fu fari. Ye litiri wulu keren kɛmɛ senni ɲɔndɔn nu sama kankan kui. Ye sase nu igbo ɲɔngɔn ya naani.

sentences.english: And he put the bases by the house, five on the right side and five on the left; and he put the great water-vessel on the right side of the house, to the east, facing south.
sentences.susu: A naxa ye maxanin see dɔxɔ Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi sɛɛtie ma, suuli kɔɔla biri, suuli yirefanyi biri. Na ye sase belebele naxan nu xili «Baa,» a naxa na dɔxɔ banxi yirefanyi ma, a makɔrɛ a sogetede biri ra.

sentences.english: And Hiram made the pots and spades and the basins. So Hiram came to the end of all the work he did for King Solomon in the house of the Lord:
sentences.susu: Xurami naxa ye sasee, tɛ xube kɔ see nun tundee yailan. Na kui, Xurami naxa gɛ mangɛ Sulemani xa walie ra Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa fe ra. Na walie nan ya:

sentences.english: The two pillars and the two cups of the crowns which were on the tops of the two pillars; and the network covering the two cups of the crowns on the tops of the pillars,
sentences.susu: kinki firinyie, e xunyi tofanxie, se raxunmase naxee e fari,

sentences.english: And the four hundred apples for the network, two lines of apples for every network, covering the two cups of the crowns on the pillars;
sentences.susu: kɔɔbɛ bogi maniyɛ kɛmɛ naani gbakuxi e ra, kɔɔbɛ bogi maniyɛ safɛ firin se raxunmase keren ma kinkie xunyi ra,

sentences.english: And the ten bases, with the ten washing-vessels on them;
sentences.susu: sunbui maxanin se fu,

sentences.english: And the great water-vessel, with the twelve oxen under it;
sentences.susu: ye sase xungbe naxan xili «Baa,» ninge fu nun firin misaali naxee na ye sase xungbe bun ma,

sentences.english: And the pots and the spades and the basins; all the vessels which Hiram made for King Solomon, for the house of the Lord, were of polished brass.
sentences.susu: tundee, pelie, paanie. Xurami se naxee birin yailan mangɛ Sulemani bɛ Alatala xa banxi xa fe ra, a e yailan wure gbeeli raxunuxi nan na.

sentences.english: He made them of liquid metal in the lowland of Jordan, at the way across the river, at Adama, between Succoth and Zarethan.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nu na yɔxui raxunu Yurudɛn mɛrɛ yire nɛ, Sukɔti nun Saratan tagi.

sentences.english: The weight of all these vessels was not measured, because there was such a number of them; it was not possible to get the weight of the brass.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani na birin yailan wure gbeeli nan na, naxan xa gboe xasabi mu nu nɔma kolonde.

sentences.english: And Solomon had all the vessels made for use in the house of the Lord: the altar of gold and the gold table on which the holy bread was placed;
sentences.susu: Sulemani se gbegbe yailan nɛ Ala xa banxi bɛ, alɔ sɛrɛxɛbade xɛɛma daaxi, teebili xɛɛma daaxi nde taami sɛrɛxɛ sama dɛnnaxɛ,

sentences.english: And the supports for the lights, five on the right side and five on the left before the inmost room, of clear gold; and the flowers and the lights and all the instruments of gold;
sentences.susu: lanpui dɔxɔ se xɛɛma daaxie naxee dɛxɛma Yire Sɛniyɛnxi kui sɛriyɛ ki ma, a fuge misaalixie, lanpuie, tɛ xube kɔ se xɛɛma daaxie,

sentences.english: And the cups and the scissors and the basins and the spoons and the fire-trays, all of gold; and the pins on which the doors were turned, the doors of the inner house, the most holy place, and the doors of the Temple, all of gold.
sentences.susu: paanie, finɛe, pɔɔti tofanyie, piletie, kolopɔɔti xɛɛma fanyi daaxie, Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa naadɛe gbaku se xɛɛma daaxie, naxee nu na Yire Sɛniyɛnxi Fisamante sode dɛ ra nun hɔrɔmɔbanxi sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: So all the work King Solomon had done in the house of the Lord was complete. Then Solomon took the holy things which David his father had given, the silver and the gold and all the vessels, and put them in the store-houses of the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sulemani Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa see yailan xɛɛma ra na ki nɛ. A to gɛ na ra, a naxa se birin naso Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa naafuli ragatade kui, a baba Dawuda naxee fixi Ala ma.

sentences.english: Then Solomon sent for all the responsible men of Israel, and all the chiefs of the tribes, and the heads of families of the children of Israel, to come to him in Jerusalem to take the ark of the Lord's agreement up out of the town of David, which is Zion.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Sulemani naxa Isirayila forie, bɔnsɔɛ xunyie, nun Isirayila denbaya xunyie maxili alako e xa te Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ra kelife Siyon, Dawuda xa taa.

sentences.english: And all the men of Israel came together to King Solomon at the feast, in the month Ethanim, the seventh month.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka birin naxa e malan mangɛ yire alako e xa kike solofere sali raba.

sentences.english: And all the responsible men of Israel came, and the priests took up the ark.
sentences.susu: Isirayila forie birin to mɛnni li, Lewikae naxa saatɛ kankira tongo,

sentences.english: They took up the ark of the Lord, and the Tent of meeting, and all the holy vessels which were in the Tent; all these the priests and the Levites took up.
sentences.susu: e a xanin a nun Ala xa Naralande Kiri banxi, a nun se sɛniyɛnxi naxee nu na a kui. Lewika sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nan na wali raba.

sentences.english: And King Solomon and all the men of Israel who had come together there, were with him before the ark, making offerings of sheep and oxen more than might be numbered.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani nun Isirayila ɲama naxee birin nu maxilixi, naxa ti saatɛ kankira ya ra. E naxa xuruse lanmae nun a xungbe gbegbe ba sɛrɛxɛ ra, naxan kɔnti mu nu nɔma kolonde.

sentences.english: And the priests took the ark of the agreement of the Lord and put it in its place in the inner room of the house, in the most holy place, under the wings of the winged ones.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxa Alatala xa saatɛ kankira dɔxɔ a dɔxɔde Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi, Yire Sɛniyɛnxi Fisamante kui. E a dɔxɔ malekɛe gabutenyie bun ma.

sentences.english: For their wings were outstretched over the place where the ark was, covering the ark and its rods.
sentences.susu: Malekɛe gabutenyie nu italaxi saatɛ kankira nun a maxanin see xun ma.

sentences.english: The rods were so long that their ends were seen from the holy place, in front of the inmost room; but they were not seen from outside: and there they are to this day.
sentences.susu: Saatɛ kankira maxanin see findixi wuri kuyee nan na, naxee ɲɔɛe nu toma kafi pala ma yire sɛniyɛnxi kui, kɔnɔ e mu nu nɔma tode hɔrɔmɔbanxi tande tan ma. Han to saatɛ kankira na mɛnni.

sentences.english: There was nothing in the ark but the two flat stones which Moses put there at Horeb, where the Lord made an agreement with the children of Israel when they came out of the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Sese mu nu na na saatɛ kankira kui, fo na walaxɛ firinyi Annabi Munsa naxee sa a kui. A na raba Xorebe geya yire nɛ, Alatala saatɛ xiri lɔxɔɛ e nun Isirayilakae tagi, e mini tɛmui Misira.

sentences.english: Now when the priests had come out of the holy place, the house of the Lord was full of the cloud,
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe to mini Yire Sɛniyɛnxi kui, nuxui nde naxa goro Alatala xa banxi ma, a a rafe.

sentences.english: So that the priests were not able to keep their places to do their work because of the cloud, for the house of the Lord was full of the glory of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe mu nɔ lude mɛnni e xa e xa wali raba, barima na nuxui nu na naa, Alatala xa nɔrɛ nu bara lu banxi birin ma.

sentences.english: Then Solomon said, O Lord, to the sun you have given the heaven for a living-place, but your living-place was not seen by men;
sentences.susu: Na kui, Sulemani naxa a fala, «Alatala a masen nɛ, a a sabatima nuxui fɔɔrɛ nan kui.

sentences.english: So I have made for you a living-place, a house in which you may be for ever present.
sentences.susu: Na kui n bara lingira ti i bɛ, i sabatima dɛnnaxɛ abadan.»

sentences.english: Then, turning his face about, the king gave a blessing to all the men of Israel; and they were all on their feet together.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a ya rafindi, a duba Isirayila ɲama birin bɛ. E birin nu tixi.

sentences.english: And he said, Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, who himself gave his word to David my father, and with his strong hand has made his word come true, saying,
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen, «Tantui na Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ, naxan wɔyɛn n baba Dawuda bɛ a kɛrɛ ra. A fe naxan birin masen a bɛ, a na birin nakamalixi nɛ.

sentences.english: From the day when I took my people Israel out of Egypt, no town in all the tribes of Israel has been marked out by me for the building of a house for the resting-place of my name; but I made selection of David to be king over my people Israel.
sentences.susu: A naxɛ, ‹Kafi n nan n ma ɲama ramini Misira bɔxi ra, n mu nu taa sugandixi Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe tagi n banxi tima dɛnnaxɛ. N man mu xɛmɛ sugandixi naxan findima n ma Isirayila ɲama yarerati ra. Kɔnɔ n bara Darisalamu nan sugandi alako n xili xa lu naa. N man bara Dawuda sugandi alako a xa findi n ma Isirayila ɲama xunyi ra.›»

sentences.english: Now it was in the heart of David my father to put up a house for the name of the Lord, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: «N baba Dawuda naxa natɛ tongo a bɔɲɛ kui, a fo a xa banxi ti Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: But the Lord said to David my father, You did well to have in your heart the desire to make a house for my name;
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a fala n baba Dawuda bɛ, ‹I to natɛ tongo i bɔɲɛ kui n ma banxi xa fe ra, na bara findi ɲanige fanyi ra.

sentences.english: But you yourself will not be the builder of my house; but your son, the offspring of your body, he it is who will put up a house for my name.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan xa mu na banxi tima. I xa di nan na tima. I naxan barixi, na nan n ma banxi tima.›

sentences.english: And the Lord has made his word come true; for I have taken my father David's place on the seat of the kingdom of Israel, as the Lord gave his word; and I have made a house for the name of the Lord, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a xa masenyi rakamali. N tan bara ti n baba Dawuda ɲɔxɔɛ ra Isirayila mangɛ kibanyi kui, alɔ Alatala a masen ki naxɛ. N man bara banxi ti Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: In it I have made a place for the ark, in which is the agreement which the Lord made with our fathers, when he took them out of the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: N bara Alatala xa saatɛ kankira dɔxɔ naa, a xa saatɛ walaxɛ na na kui. A na saatɛ xiri a nun Isirayilakae nan tagi.»

sentences.english: Then Solomon took his place before the altar of the Lord, all the men of Israel being present, and stretching out his hands to heaven,
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani naxa ti sɛrɛxɛbade ya i ɲama birin ya xɔri, a naxa a bɛlɛxɛ itala koore ma, a fa a fala,

sentences.english: Said, O Lord, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on the earth; keeping faith and mercy unchanging for your servants, while they go in your ways with all their hearts.
sentences.susu: «Isirayila Marigi Alatala, i maniyɛ mu na koore nun bɔxi ma. I dugutɛgɛxi i xa saatɛ nun i xa hinnɛ xa fe nan na i xa konyie mabiri, naxee ɲɛrɛma i ya tode ra e bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra.

sentences.english: And you have kept the word which you gave to your servant David, my father; with your mouth you said it and with your hand you have made it come true this day.
sentences.susu: Na na a ra, to lɔxɔɛ i bara i xa laayidi rakamali i xa konyi n baba Dawuda bɛ.

sentences.english: So now, O Lord, the God of Israel, let your word to your servant David, my father, come true, when you said, You will never be without a man to take his place on the seat of the kingdom of Israel before me, if only your children give attention to their ways, walking before me as you have done.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, Isirayila Marigi Alatala, i laayidi naxan tongoxi i xa konyi n baba Dawuda bɛ, i xa na rakamali. I bara a masen a bɛ, ‹Xa i bɔnsɔɛ fɛntɛn e ɲɛrɛ ki ma alɔ i a rabaxi ki naxɛ, e naxa n ma sɛriyɛ binya, mixi nde na e bɔnsɔɛ ya ma naxan fama lude Isirayila kibanyi kui abadan.›

sentences.english: So now, O God of Israel, it is my prayer that you will make your word come true which you said to your servant David, my father.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, Isirayila Marigi Alatala, i xa i xa masenyi rakamali, i naxan masen i xa konyi Dawuda bɛ.»

sentences.english: But is it truly possible that God may be housed on earth? see, heaven and the heaven of heavens are not wide enough to be your resting-place; how much less this house which I have made!
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ Ala tan nɔma sabatide duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari adamadie tagi? Koore nun a xa gboe xurun i bɛ. N banxi naxan tixi i bɛ a xurun koore bɛ. I luma mɛnni di?

sentences.english: Still, let your heart be turned to the prayer of your servant, O Lord God, and to his prayer for grace; give ear to the cry and the prayer which your servant sends up to you this day;
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala, i xa i xa konyi xa dubɛ suxu, i xa a xa maxandi tongo, i xa i tuli mati i xa konyi wa xui ra.

sentences.english: That your eyes may be open to this house night and day, to this place of which you have said, My name will be there; hearing the prayer which your servant may make, turning to this place.
sentences.susu: I xa i ɲɛngi sa yi banxi xɔn ma kɔɛ nun yanyi ra, barima i xili matɔxɔma be. I xa i xa konyi xa maxandi suxu yi banxi kui.

sentences.english: Give ear to the prayers of your servant, and the prayers of your people Israel, when they make their prayers, turning to this place; give ear in heaven your living-place, and hearing, have mercy.
sentences.susu: I xa i tuli mati i xa konyi nun i xa ɲama wa xui ra, e i maxandima be tɛmui naxɛ. Kelife koore ma i dɔxɔxi dɛnnaxɛ, i xa i tuli mati muxu ra, i man xa diɲɛ.»

sentences.english: If a man does wrong to his neighbour, and has to take an oath, and comes before your altar to take his oath in this house:
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi nde sa yunubi raba a boore ra, e fa a fala a bɛ a xa kali nde ti sɛrɛxɛbade yire yi banxi kui,

sentences.english: Then let your ear be open in heaven, and be the judge of your servants, giving your decision against the wrongdoer, so that punishment for his sins may come on his head; and, by your decision, keeping from evil him who has done no wrong.
sentences.susu: i xa na fe mato kelife koore ma, i xa kiiti sa nɔndi ra alako fe kanɛ nun tinxintɔɛ birin xa e sare sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: When your people Israel are overcome in war, because of their sin against you; if they are turned to you again, honouring your name, making prayers to you and requesting your grace in this house:
sentences.susu: «Xa i xa ɲama Isirayila sa yunubi raba i ra, e yaxuie fa nɔ e ra na xa fe ra, xa e bara tin gbilenfe ra i yire, e i xili matɔxɔ, e i maxandi yi hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui,

sentences.english: Then give ear in heaven, and let the sin of your people Israel have forgiveness, and take them back again into the land which you gave to their fathers.
sentences.susu: i xa na fe mato kelife koore ma, i xa i xa ɲama Isirayila xa yunubie xafari, i fa e ragbilen bɔxi ma, i dɛnnaxɛ fixi e tan nun e babae ma.»

sentences.english: When heaven is shut up and there is no rain, because of their sin against you; if they make prayers with their faces turned to this place, honouring your name and turning away from their sin when you send trouble on them:
sentences.susu: «Xa koore sa balan, tunɛ yo mu fa, barima e bara yunubi raba i ra, xa e fa i maxandi be, e i xili matɔxɔ, e gbilen e xa yunubi fɔxɔ ra i e rayaagixi naxan ma,

sentences.english: Then give ear in heaven, so that the sin of your servants, and of your people Israel, may have forgiveness, when you make clear to them the good way in which they are to go; and send rain on your land which you have given to your people for their heritage.
sentences.susu: i xa na fe mato kelife koore ma, i xa i xa konyie, i xa ɲama Isirayila xa yunubie xafari, i xa i xa sɛriyɛ fanyi masen e bɛ alako e xa na ɲɛrɛ ki kolon, i fa tunɛ ragoro i xa bɔxi ma, i naxan findi e gbe ra.»

sentences.english: If there is no food in the land, or if there is disease, or if the fruits of the earth are damaged through heat or water, locust or worm; if their towns are shut in by their attackers; whatever trouble, whatever disease there may be:
sentences.susu: «Xa kaamɛ sa sin yi bɔxi ma, xa na mu fure, xa na mu baloe kanɛ, xa na mu gere, xa na mu gbaloe gbɛtɛ,

sentences.english: Whatever prayer or request for your grace is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, whatever his trouble may be, whose hands are stretched out to this house:
sentences.susu: xa mixi nde sa i maxandi, xa i xa ɲama Isirayila a mawa i xɔn, barima e bara a kolon e xa tɔɔrɛ kelixi fe naxan ma, e fa e bɛlɛxɛ itala yi banxi mabiri,

sentences.english: Give ear in heaven your living-place, acting in mercy; and give to every man whose secret heart is open to you, the reward of all his ways; for you, and you only, have knowledge of the hearts of all the children of men:
sentences.susu: i xa na fe mato kelife koore ma i magoroxi dɛnnaxɛ, i xa diɲɛ, i xa mixi birin sare fi a xa wali ra, i tan naxan adama birin bɔɲɛ ma fe kolon. I keren peti nan ibunadama birin sondon ma fe kolon.

sentences.english: So that they may give you worship all the days of their life in the land which you gave to our fathers.
sentences.susu: Na kui e fama gaaxude i ya ra, e ɲɛrɛ i xa kira xɔn e xa simaya birin kui yi bɔxi ma, i naxan fixi muxu babae ma.»

sentences.english: And as for the man from a strange land, who is not of your people Israel; when he comes from a far country because of the glory of your name:
sentences.susu: «Xa xɔɲɛ nde sa fa kelife ɲamanɛ ma, naxan mu findi i xa ɲama Isirayila mixi nde ra,

sentences.english: (For they will have news of your great name and your strong hand and your out-stretched arm;) when he comes to make his prayer, turning to this house:
sentences.susu: a fa i xili xungbe nun i sɛnbɛ xa fe ra, a i maxandi yi banxi kui,

sentences.english: Give ear in heaven your living-place, and give him his desire, whatever it may be; so that all the peoples of the earth may have knowledge of your name, worshipping you as do your people Israel, and that they may see that this house which I have put up is truly named by your name.
sentences.susu: i xa na fe mato kelife koore ma i i magoroxi dɛnnaxɛ, i xa a xa maxandi suxu alako si birin xa gaaxu i xili ya ra duniɲa, alɔ i xa ɲama Isirayila. E xa a kolon i tan nan xili maxandima yi banxi kui n naxan tixi.»

sentences.english: If your people go out to war against their attackers, by whatever way you may send them, if they make their prayer to the Lord, turning their faces to this town of yours and to this house which I have made for your name:
sentences.susu: «Xa i xa ɲama sa mini a yaxuie gerede alɔ i a masen e bɛ ki naxɛ, xa e i maxandi yi taa mabiri ra i dɛnnaxɛ sugandixi, xa e i maxandi yi banxi mabiri ra n naxan tixi i xili ra,

sentences.english: Give ear in heaven to their prayer and their cry for grace, and see right done to them.
sentences.susu: i xa na fe mato, i xa e xa dubɛ suxu, i xa kiiti tinxinxi sa e bɛ.»

sentences.english: If they do wrong against you, (for no man is without sin,) and you are angry with them and give them up into the power of those who are fighting against them, so that they take them away as prisoners into a strange land, far off or near;
sentences.susu: «Xa e sa yunubi raba i ra, alɔ adamadi birin darixi naxan na, xa i bɔɲɛ te e xili ma, i fa e sa e yaxuie sagoe, e findi geelimanie ra yire makuye, xa na mu a ra yire makɔrɛxi,

sentences.english: And if they take thought, in the land where they are prisoners, and are turned again to you, crying out in prayer to you in that land, and saying, We are sinners, we have done wrong, we have done evil;
sentences.susu: xa e bara xaxili sɔtɔ na konyiya kui, e fa i maxandi e xa geeli kui, ‹Muxu bara yunubi raba, muxu bara fe ɲaaxi raba, muxu bara kobi,›

sentences.english: And with all their heart and soul are turned again to you, in the land of those who took them prisoners, and make their prayer to you, turning their eyes to this land which you gave to their fathers, and to the town which you took for yourself, and the house which I made for your name:
sentences.susu: xa e man e yɛtɛ ragbilen i ma e bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra, e nii birin na, e fa i maxandi ɲamanɛ ma konyiya kui yi bɔxi mabiri, i naxan fixi e babae ma, a nun yi taa mabiri, i naxan sugandixi, a nun yi banxi mabiri, n naxan tixi i bɛ,

sentences.english: Then give ear to their prayer and to their cry in heaven your living-place, and see right done to them;
sentences.susu: i xa na fe mato kelife koore ma i magoroxi dɛnnaxɛ, i xa i tuli mati e xa maxandi nun e wa xui ra, i xa kiiti tinxinxi sa e bɛ,

sentences.english: Answering with forgiveness the people who have done wrong against you, and overlooking the evil which they have done against you; let those who made them prisoners be moved with pity for them, and have pity on them;
sentences.susu: i xa diɲɛ i xa ɲama ma naxan yunubi rabaxi i ra. I xa e xa yunubie xafari e naxan nabaxi i ra. I xa hinnɛ e ra e yaxuie ya xɔri, alako e yaxuie fan xa hinnɛ e ra.

sentences.english: For they are your people and your heritage, which you took out of Egypt, out of the iron fireplace;
sentences.susu: E findixi i xa ɲama nan na, i kɛ tongoe, i naxee ramini Misira bɔxi ra konyiya kui.»

sentences.english: Let your eyes be open to your servant's prayer for grace and to the prayer of your people Israel, hearing them when their cry comes to you.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi, n Marigi Ala, i xa muxu xa maxandi mato, i xa a ramɛ, muxu naxan nabaxi yi banxi kui,

sentences.english: For you made them separate from all the peoples of the earth, to be your heritage, as you said by Moses your servant, when you took our fathers out of Egypt, O Lord God.
sentences.susu: barima i tan nan muxu ba duniɲa bɔnsɔɛ tagi muxu xa findi i kɛ tongoe ra, alɔ i a masen Isirayila bɛ ki naxɛ i xa konyi Munsa saabui ra, a to muxu benbae ramini Misira bɔxi ra.»

sentences.english: Then Solomon, after making all these prayers and requests for grace to the Lord, got up from his knees before the altar of the Lord, where his hands had been stretched out in prayer to heaven;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani to gɛ na maxandi tide Alatala bɛ, a naxa keli Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade yire, a xinbi nu sinxi dɛnnaxɛ a bɛlɛxɛe itexi koore ma.

sentences.english: And, getting on his feet, he gave a blessing to all the men of Israel, saying with a loud voice,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a naxa ti Isirayila ɲama ya xɔri, a duba e bɛ a xui itexi ra. A naxɛ,

sentences.english: Praise be to the Lord who has given rest to his people Israel, as he gave them his word to do; every word of all his oath, which he gave by the hand of Moses his servant, has come true.
sentences.susu: «Tantui na Alatala bɛ, naxan bara malabui fi a xa ɲama Isirayila ma, alɔ a a masen ki naxɛ. A masenyi naxee ti a xa konyi Annabi Munsa saabui ra, keren mu na a mu naxan nakamali.

sentences.english: Now may the Lord our God be with us as he was with our fathers; let him never go away from us or give us up;
sentences.susu: Won Marigi Alatala xa lu won sɛɛti ma alɔ a raba won benbae bɛ ki naxɛ. Ala naxa won nabolo, a naxa won nabɛɲin.

sentences.english: Turning our hearts to himself, guiding us to go in all his ways, to keep his orders and his laws and his decisions, which he gave to our fathers.
sentences.susu: Ala xa won bɔɲɛ ya mafindi a ma, alako won xa won ɲɛrɛ a xa kira xɔn ma, won xa a xa yaamari birin nabatu, won xa gbilen fee fɔxɔ ra a tɔnyi dɔxɔxi naxee ra, won xa bira a xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra a naxan so won benbae yi ra.

sentences.english: And may these my words, the words of my prayer to the Lord, be before the Lord our God day and night, so that he may see right done to his servant and to his people Israel, day by day as we have need.
sentences.susu: Ala xa ratu n ma maxandi ma kɔɛ nun yanyi. Won Marigi Alatala xa n tan a xa konyi nun a xa ɲama Isirayila makanta fe ɲaaxi ma lɔxɔɛ birin,

sentences.english: So that all the peoples of the earth may see that the Lord is God, and there is no other.
sentences.susu: alako duniɲa birin xa a kolon a Alatala nan na Ala ra. Ala gbɛtɛ mu na.

sentences.english: Then let your hearts be without sin before the Lord our God, walking in his laws and keeping his orders as at this day.
sentences.susu: Wo bɔɲɛ birin xa lu won Marigi Alatala nan bɛ, alako won xa a xa yaamarie ratinmɛ, won xa won ɲɛrɛ a xa sɛriyɛ ma alɔ wo darixi a ra ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Now the king, and all Israel with him, were making offerings before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nun Isirayila ɲama birin naxa sɛrɛxɛ ba Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And Solomon gave to the Lord for peace-offerings, twenty-two thousand oxen and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the children of Israel kept the feast of the opening of the Lord's house.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani naxa ninge wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin ba xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ra, a nun yɛxɛɛ wulu kɛmɛ mɔxɔɲɛn. Na dangi xanbi, Mangɛ nun ɲama naxa Ala xa banxi rabi.

sentences.english: The same day the king made holy the middle of the open square in front of the house of the Lord, offering there the burned offering and the meal offering and the fat of the peace-offerings; for there was not room on the brass altar of the Lord for the burned offerings and the meal offerings and the fat of the peace-offerings.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa tɛtɛ yire rasɛniyɛn sɛrɛxɛ ra Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ya ra. A naxa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie ba naa, a nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛe ture nun sansi xɔri ra, barima sɛrɛxɛbade yɔxui daaxi, Sulemani naxan yailan, na nu xurun na sɛrɛxɛ birin bɛ.

sentences.english: So Solomon and all Israel with him, a very great meeting, (for the people had come together from the way into Hamath to the river of Egypt,) kept the feast at that time before the Lord our God, for two weeks, even fourteen days.
sentences.susu: Sulemani nun Isirayilakae birin sali raba nɛ won Marigi Alatala ya xɔri xi solofere bun ma. Ɲama gbegbe fa nɛ kelife Xamata han Misira xure. E to gɛ na sali ra, e man naxa sali xi solofere gbɛtɛ bun ma, a findi xi fu nun naani ra.

sentences.english: And on the eighth day he sent the people away, and, blessing the king, they went to their tents full of joy and glad in their hearts, because of all the good which the Lord had done to David his servant and to Israel his people.
sentences.susu: A xi fu nun suuli nde, mangɛ naxa ɲama bɛɲin e xa gbilen e xɔnyi. E naxa duba mangɛ bɛ, e fa gbilen e xɔnyi sɛɛwɛ kui, Alatala xa hinnɛ xa fe ra a xa konyi Dawuda nun a xa ɲama Isirayila mabiri.

sentences.english: Now when Solomon came to the end of building the house of the Lord and the king's house, and all Solomon's desires, which he had in mind were effected;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani to gɛ Alatala xa banxi nun a yɛtɛ xa banxi tide, a a waxɔnfe birin naba na xa fe ra,

sentences.english: The Lord came to him again in a vision, as he had done at Gibeon;
sentences.susu: Alatala man naxa mini a ma alɔ a raba Gabayon ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to him, Your prayers and your requests for grace have come to my ears: I have made holy this house which you have made, and I have put my name there for ever; my eyes and my heart will be there at all times.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a fala a bɛ, «N bara i xui mɛ, n bara i xa maxandi suxu. N bara tin yi banxi xa findi n gbe ra, i naxan tixi. N xili xa lu a ma abadan, n nan n ɲɛngi sama nɛ a xɔn ma.

sentences.english: As for you, if you will go on your way before me, as David your father did, uprightly and with a true heart, doing what I have given you orders to do, keeping my laws and my decisions;
sentences.susu: Xa i sa i ɲɛrɛ n ma kira xɔn ma bɔɲɛ tinxinxi ra, alɔ i baba Dawuda, i fa n ma yaamarie, n ma sɛriyɛ, nun n ma xaranyi suxu a fanyi ra,

sentences.english: Then I will make the seat of your rule over Israel certain for ever, as I gave my word to David your father, saying, You will never be without a man to be king in Israel.
sentences.susu: n i xa mangɛ kibanyi mabanbanma nɛ, alɔ n a saataxi i baba Dawuda bɛ ki naxɛ. N a masen nɛ a bɛ, ‹Isirayila mangɛya mu bama i bɔnsɔɛ yi ra.›

sentences.english: But if you are turned from my ways, you or your children, and do not keep my orders and my laws which I have put before you, but go and make yourselves servants to other gods and give them worship:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa wo wo kobe ratoma, wo fa gbilen n ma sɛriyɛ nun n ma yaamarie fɔxɔ ra, xa wo sa tuubi Ala gbɛtɛ bɛ,

sentences.english: Then I will have Israel cut off from the land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy for myself, I will put away from before my eyes; and Israel will be a public example, and a word of shame among all peoples.
sentences.susu: n wo talama nɛ n ma bɔxi ma, n naxan fixi wo ma, n yi banxi rakasanɲɛ, n naxan findixi n xili falade ra. Na tɛmui si birin fama nɛ yelede Isirayila xa fe ma, e yo wo ma.

sentences.english: And this house will become a mass of broken walls, and everyone who goes by will be overcome with wonder at it and make whistling sounds; and they will say, Why has the Lord done so to this land and to this house?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui mixi nɛ dangima yi banxi ra, naxan bara xili fanyi sɔtɔ, e dɛ ixarama nɛ, e a fala, ‹Munfe ra Alatala yi bɔxi nun yi banxi xa fe xun nakanaxi yi ki?›

sentences.english: And their answer will be, Because they were turned away from the Lord their God, who took their fathers out of the land of Egypt; they took for themselves other gods and gave them worship and became their servants: that is why the Lord has sent all this evil on them.
sentences.susu: E a yaabima nɛ, ‹Ala yi birin niyaxi e ra nɛ barima e bara gbilen e babae Marigi Alatala fɔxɔ ra, naxan e ramini Misira bɔxi ra. E bara e tagi ixiri ala gbɛtɛe ra, e e batu, e tuubi e bɛ. E yi tɔɔrɛ sɔtɔxi na nan ma.›»

sentences.english: Now at the end of twenty years, in which time Solomon had put up the two houses, the house of the Lord and the king's house,
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani nu bara Alatala xa banxi nun a yɛtɛ xa banxi ti ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn bun ma.

sentences.english: (Hiram, king of Tyre, had given Solomon cedar-trees and cypress-trees and gold, as much as he had need of,) King Solomon gave Hiram twenty towns in the land of Galilee.
sentences.susu: Tire mangɛ Xirami to bara nu sɛdiri nun sipirɛ wurie, nun xɛɛma so Sulemani yi ra, a nu wama naxan xasabi xɔn, a naxa taa mɔxɔɲɛn fi Xirami ma Galile bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: But when Hiram came from Tyre to see the towns which Solomon had given him, he was not pleased with them.
sentences.susu: Xirami to mini na taae matode, nee mu rafan a ma.

sentences.english: And he said, What sort of towns are these which you have given me, my brother? So they were named the land of Cabul, to this day.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Sulemani bɛ, «N ngaxakerenyi, i taa mɔɔli mundun fixi n ma yi ki?» Xirami naxa na taae xili sa «Taa fufafu.» Na xili nan na e xun ma han to.

sentences.english: And Hiram sent the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Xirami naxa xɛɛma kilo wulu naani rasanba mangɛ Sulemani ma.

sentences.english: Now, this was the way of Solomon's system of forced work for the building of the Lord's house and of the king's house, and the Millo and the wall of Jerusalem and Megiddo and Gezer. ...
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani nu bara teku wali rakeli banxie nun taae tife ra, alɔ Alatala xa banxi, mangɛ Sulemani xa banxi, Milo taa, Darisalamu tɛtɛ, Xasori taa, Megido taa, nun Geseri taa.

sentences.english: Pharaoh, king of Egypt, came and took Gezer, burning it down and putting to death the Canaanites living in the town, and he gave it for a bride-offering to his daughter, Solomon's wife. ...
sentences.susu: Firawuna, Misira mangɛ, dusu nɛ Geseri taa xun na, a tɛ so na ra, na Kanaankae birin faxa. Na dangi xanbi a na fi a xa di ginɛ ma, naxan dɔxɔ mangɛ Sulemani xɔn ma.

sentences.english: ... and Solomon was the builder of Gezer and Beth-horon the lower,
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani yi taa birin ti nɛ: Geseri taa, Beti Xoron Labe,

sentences.english: And Baalath and Tamar in the waste land, in that land;
sentences.susu: Baalati nun Tamari naxee nu na gbengberenyi ma,

sentences.english: And all the store-towns and the towns which Solomon had for his war-carriages and for his horsemen, and everything which it was his pleasure to put up in Jerusalem and in Lebanon and in all the land under his rule.
sentences.susu: nun taa gbɛtɛ sɔɔri ragisee nun soee nu ragatama dɛnnaxɛ. Sulemani nu bara banxi nun taa gbegbe ti Darisalamu, Liban bɔxi, nun a xa bɔxi birin ma, alɔ a nu wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: As for the rest of the Amorites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not children of Israel;
sentences.susu: Xitikae, Amorikae, Peresikae, Hiwikae, nun Yebusukae naxee lu Isirayila bɔxi ma, kɔnɔ e mu findi Isirayilakae ra.

sentences.english: Their children who were still in the land, and whom the children of Israel had not been able to put to complete destruction, them did Solomon put to forced work, to this day.
sentences.susu: E babae mu faxa Isirayila xa santidɛgɛma saabui ra Isirayilakae so tɛmui. Na kui Sulemani na mixie findi nɛ konyie ra. Han to e na konyiya kui.

sentences.english: But Solomon did not put the children of Israel to forced work; they were the men of war, his servants, his captains, and his chiefs, captains of his war-carriages and of his horsemen.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Sulemani mu tin Isirayila di yo xa findi konyi ra. Isirayilakae nu findixi a xa sɔɔrie, sɛbɛlitie, sɔɔri xunyie, nun soe ragi xunyie nan na.

sentences.english: These were the chiefs of the overseers of Solomon's work, five hundred and fifty, in authority over the people who did the work.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani mixi kɛmɛ suuli mixi tongo suuli nan ti xunyie ra konyie xun ma naxee nu a xa wali rabama.

sentences.english: At that time Solomon made Pharaoh's daughter come up from the town of David to the house which he had made for her: then he made the Millo.
sentences.susu: Sulemani Firawuna xa di ginɛ tongo nɛ Dawuda xa taa kui, a a ratunu banxi gbɛtɛ kui, a naxan ti a bɛ. Na tɛmui fa a naxa Milo taa ti.

sentences.english: Three times in the year it was Solomon's way to give burned offerings and peace-offerings on the altar he had made to the Lord, causing his fire-offering to go up on the altar before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani nu sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛe bama sanya saxan ɲɛ yo ɲɛ sɛrɛxɛbade fari, a naxan yailan Alatala bɛ. A nu surayi bama sɛrɛxɛ ra sɛrɛxɛbade nde fari naxan nu na Alatala ya i. A Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi raɲɔn.

sentences.english: And King Solomon made a sea-force of ships in Ezion-geber, by Eloth, on the Red Sea, in the land of Edom.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani kunkuie yailan nɛ Esiyon Geberi, Elata fɛ ma, baa dɛ ra naxan nu na Edon bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Hiram sent his servants, who were experienced seamen, in the sea-force with Solomon's men.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Xirami walikɛ ndee so nɛ Sulemani yi ra, naxee nu bakima na kunkuie kui Sulemani xa walikɛe sɛɛti ma. E nu kunkui wali kolon a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And they came to Ophir, where they got four hundred and twenty talents of gold, and took it back to King Solomon.
sentences.susu: Na kunkuie siga nɛ Ofiri bɔxi ma xɛɛma kilo wulu fu nun naani tongode mangɛ Sulemani bɛ.

sentences.english: Now the queen of Sheba, hearing great things of Solomon, came to put his wisdom to the test with hard questions.
sentences.susu: Seeba mangɛ ginɛ to Sulemani xili gbe mɛ Alatala xili xa fe ra, a naxa siga maxɔrinyi xɔrɔxɔɛe tide a ma.

sentences.english: And she came to Jerusalem with a very great train, with camels weighted down with spices, and stores of gold and jewels: and when she came to Solomon she had talk with him of everything in her mind.
sentences.susu: A naxa siga Darisalamu, a sanbase gbegbe xanin a xun ma ɲɔxɔmɛe fari alɔ labundɛ, xɛɛma, nun gɛmɛ tofanyie. A naxa a xa maxɔrinyi birin ti Sulemani ma.

sentences.english: And Solomon gave her answers to all her questions; there was no secret which the king did not make clear to her.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani naxa a xa maxɔrinyie birin yaabi, na birin naxa sɔɔnɛya a bɛ.

sentences.english: And when the queen of Sheba had seen all the wisdom of Solomon, and the house which he had made,
sentences.susu: Seeba mangɛ ginɛ to gɛ Sulemani xa lɔnni tode, a nun a xa banxie a naxee ti,

sentences.english: And the food at his table, and all his servants seated there, and those who were waiting on him in their places, and their robes, and his wine-servants, and the burned offerings which he made in the house of the Lord, there was no more spirit in her.
sentences.susu: a xa donsee, a xa walikɛe nun e wali ki, e xa dugie, e ludee, na fe birin naxa a dɛ ixara.

sentences.english: And she said to the king, The account which was given to me in my country of your acts and your wisdom was true.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala mangɛ bɛ, «N fe naxee birin mɛxi n ma bɔxi ma i xa masenyie nun i xa lɔnni xa fe ra, na birin findixi nɔndi nan na.

sentences.english: But I had no faith in what was said about you, till I came and saw for myself; and now I see that it was not half the story; your wisdom and your wealth are much greater than they said.
sentences.susu: Beenun n xa be to n yɛtɛ ra, n mu la e xa masenyi ra. Kɔnɔ yakɔsi n bara a kolon i xa lɔnni gbo dangife e naxan masenxi n bɛ. I fe naxan birin tagi rabaxi n bɛ nun i xa naafuli, na dangi i xili ra.

sentences.english: Happy are your wives, happy are these your servants whose place is ever before you, hearing your words of wisdom.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛlɛxinyi na i xa mixie bɛ, ɲɛlɛxinyi na i xa konyie bɛ, barima e na i sɛɛti ma tɛmui birin i xa lɔnni ramɛfe ra.

sentences.english: May the Lord your God be praised, whose pleasure it was to put you on the seat of the kingdom of Israel; because the Lord's love for Israel is eternal, he has made you king, to be their judge in righteousness.
sentences.susu: Tantui na i Marigi Alatala bɛ, naxan hinnɛxi i ra, a fa i dɔxɔ Isirayila mangɛ kibanyi kui. I Marigi Ala na raba nɛ barima Isirayila rafan a ma abadan. A i findixi nɛ e xa mangɛ ra alako i xa e yamari tinxinyi nun nɔndi ra.»

sentences.english: And she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and a great store of spices and jewels: never again was such a wealth of spices seen as that which the queen of Sheba gave King Solomon.
sentences.susu: A naxa xɛɛma kilo wulu naani fi mangɛ ma, a nun labundɛ gbegbe, nun gɛmɛ tofanyie. Kabi na tɛmui, Seeba mangɛ ginɛ labundɛ xasabi naxan fi mangɛ Sulemani ma na ɲɔndɔn mu to Isirayila bɔxi ma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And the sea-force of Hiram, in addition to gold from Ophir, came back with much sandal-wood and jewels.
sentences.susu: Xirami nun Sulemani xa walikɛe naxee fa xɛɛma ra kelife Ofiri bɔxi ma, nee man naxa fa wuri nun gɛmɛ tofanyie ra.

sentences.english: And from the sandal-wood the king made pillars for the house of the Lord, and for the king's house, and instruments of music for the makers of melody: never has such sandal-wood been seen to this day.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa na wuri rawali Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi sode dɛ ra, a nun mangɛ xa banxi sode dɛ ra. A man naxa na wuri rawali kɔrae yailanfe ra bɛɛtibae bɛ. Na wuri mɔɔli mu nu toxi Yudaya sinden.

sentences.english: And King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she made request for, in addition to what he gave her freely from the impulse of his heart. So she went back to her country, she and her servants.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani naxa Seeba mangɛ ginɛ waxɔnse birin so a yi ra dangife a naxan nasanbaxi a ma. Na xanbi, a naxa gbilen a xa bɔxi ma, a tan nun a xa mixie.

sentences.english: Now the weight of gold which came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and sixty-six talents;
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ yo ɲɛ Sulemani nu xɛɛma kilo wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin, kilo kɛmɛ senni tongo naani nun naani sɔtɔma,

sentences.english: In addition to what came to him from the business of the traders, and from all the kings of the Arabians, and from the rulers of the country.
sentences.susu: bafe a naxan sɔtɔ yulɛya duuti ra. A man nu xɛɛma nun gbeti sɔtɔma mangɛe nun gominae ra Arabu bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Solomon made two hundred body-covers of hammered gold, every one having six hundred shekels of gold in it.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani naxa sɔɔri makantase kɛmɛ firin yailan xɛɛma ra, kankan yailanxi xɛɛma kilo solofere nan na.

sentences.english: And he made three hundred smaller body-covers of hammered gold, with three pounds of gold in every cover: and the king put them in the house of the Woods of Lebanon.
sentences.susu: A man naxa sɔɔri makantase xunxuri kɛmɛ saxan yailan xɛɛma ra, kankan yailanxi xɛɛma kilo saxan nan na. A naxa e gbaku banxi kui naxan xili falama Liban Fɔtɔn Banxi.

sentences.english: Then the king made a great ivory seat, plated with the best gold.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa kibanyi xungbe yailan sili ɲinyi ra, a fa xɛɛma fanyi maso a ma.

sentences.english: There were six steps going up to it, and the top of it was round at the back, there were arms on the two sides of the seat, and two lions by the side of the arms;
sentences.susu: Santide senni nu na na kibanyi ma. A xanbi radigilinxi, bɛlɛxɛ sade firin nu na a sɛɛtie ma, yɛtɛ masolixi firin fan nu na a sɛɛtie ma.

sentences.english: And twelve lions were placed on the one side and on the other side on the six steps: there was nothing like it in any kingdom.
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛ fu nun firin fan masolixi nu na santidee sɛɛtie ma, senni nu na yirefanyi ma, sennie nu na kɔɔla ma. Na kibanyi maniyɛ mu nu na mangataa yo kui sinden.

sentences.english: And all King Solomon's drinking-vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the Woods of Lebanon were of the best gold; not one was of silver, for no one gave a thought to silver in the days of King Solomon.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani xa pɔɔti birin nun Liban Fɔtɔn Banxi xa pileti birin nu yailanxi xɛɛma nan na. A mu nu gbeti rawalima fefe ma, a tide mu gbo a bɛ.

sentences.english: For the king had Tarshish-ships at sea with the ships of Hiram; once every three years the Tarshish-ships came with gold and silver and ivory and monkeys and peacocks.
sentences.susu: Kunkuie nu na mangɛ yi ra naxee nu sigama Tarasisi ɲɛ saxan yo ɲɛ saxan xɛɛma, gbeti, sili ɲinyi, kule, nun xɔni tofanyie tongode. Xirami xa walikɛe nu a malima na wali kui.

sentences.english: And King Solomon was greater than all the kings of the earth in wealth and in wisdom.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani xa bannaya nun a xa lɔnni naxa gbo yɛ dangi bɔxi mangɛ birin na.

sentences.english: And from all over the earth they came to see Solomon and to give ear to his wisdom, which God had put in his heart.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi mangɛ birin nu wama Sulemani xa lɔnni ramɛfe Ala naxan saxi a xaxili ma.

sentences.english: And everyone took with him an offering, vessels of silver and vessels of gold, and robes, and coats of metal, and spices, and horses, and beasts of transport, regularly year by year.
sentences.susu: Nee birin nu mangɛ sanbama gbeti, xɛɛma, dugie, geresosee, labundɛe, soe, nun sofalee ra ɲɛ yo ɲɛ.

sentences.english: And Solomon got together war-carriages and horsemen; he had one thousand, four hundred carriages and twelve thousand horsemen, whom he kept, some in the carriage-towns and some with the king at Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa sɔɔri ragisee nun soe ragie malan. Sɔɔri ragise wulu keren kɛmɛ naani, nun soe ragie wulu fu nun firin nan nu na mangataa Darisalamu nun taa makantaxi gbɛtɛe.

sentences.english: And the king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem and cedars like the sycamore-trees of the lowlands in number.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a niya gbeti xa wuya Darisalamu dangife gɛmɛ xɔri ra. Wuri fanyi fan naxan xili sɛdiri naxa wuya dangife sikomoro wuri ra naxee na Sefela bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Solomon's horses came from Egypt and from Kue; the king's traders got them at a price from Kue.
sentences.susu: Sulemani nu soe sarama Misira nun Kowa bɔxi nan ma. Mangɛ xa yulɛe nu sigama e tongode.

sentences.english: A war-carriage might be got from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty; they got them at the same rate for all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Aram.
sentences.susu: E sɔɔri ragise sara gbeti kilo solofere ra, e soe sara gbeti kilo keren nun a tagi. E na mɔɔli sara Xiti nun Arami mangɛe fan bɛ.

sentences.english: Now a number of strange women were loved by Solomon, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites:
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani naxa ginɛ gbegbe dɔxɔ naxee mu findixi Isirayilakae ra, alɔ Firawuna xa di ginɛ, Mowaba ginɛe, Amoni ginɛe, Edon ginɛe, Sidɔn ginɛe, nun Xiti ginɛe.

sentences.english: The nations of which the Lord had said to the children of Israel, You are not to take wives from them and they are not to take wives from you; or they will certainly make you go after their gods: to these Solomon was united in love.
sentences.susu: Alatala nu bara a fala Isirayilakae bɛ na sie xa fe ra, «Wo naxa siga e xɔnyi, e fan naxa fa wo xɔnyi. Xa na mu, e wo bɔɲɛe ya rafindima nɛ e xa alae mabiri.» Kɔnɔ Sulemani tan bira na mixie nan fɔxɔ ra, ginɛe maxanufe ra.

sentences.english: He had seven hundred wives, daughters of kings, and three hundred other wives; and through his wives his heart was turned away.
sentences.susu: A mangɛ di ginɛ kɛmɛ solofere nan dɔxɔ, a konyi ginɛ kɛmɛ saxan fan tongo. Na ginɛe naxa a bɔɲɛ mafindi.

sentences.english: For it came about that when Solomon was old, his heart was turned away to other gods by his wives; and his heart was no longer true to the Lord his God as the heart of his father David had been.
sentences.susu: A to fori, na ginɛe nu bara a bɔɲɛ birin mafindi ala gbɛtɛe ma, a mu bira a Marigi Alatala fɔxɔ ra alɔ a baba Dawuda.

sentences.english: For Solomon went after Ashtoreth, the goddess of the Zidonians, and Milcom, the disgusting god of the Ammonites.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani nu Sidɔnkae xa ala Asiteroti nun Amonikae xa ala Mɔlɔkɔ fan batuma.

sentences.english: And Solomon did evil in the eyes of the Lord, not walking in the Lord's ways with all his heart as David his father did.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani naxa fe raba, naxan mu rafan Alatala ma, a mu a xui rakamali Alatala bɛ alɔ a baba Dawuda.

sentences.english: Then Solomon put up a high place for Chemosh, the disgusting god of Moab, in the mountain before Jerusalem, and for Molech, the disgusting god worshipped by the children of Ammon.
sentences.susu: Na kui Sulemani naxa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan Mowaba xa ala Kemosi bɛ, a nun Amonikae xa ala Mɔlɔkɔ bɛ geya fari, naxan nu na Darisalamu ya ra.

sentences.english: And so he did for all his strange wives, who made offerings with burning of perfumes to their gods.
sentences.susu: A nu na mɔɔli rabama a xa ginɛe birin bɛ, naxee nu fatanxi si gbɛtɛe ra, naxee nu surayi nun sɛrɛxɛe bama e xa alae bɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from the Lord, the God of Israel, who had twice come to him in a vision;
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa xɔnɔ mangɛ Sulemani ma, barima a nu bara a kobe so Isirayila Marigi Alatala ra, naxan mini a ma sanya firin.

sentences.english: And had given him orders about this very thing, that he was not to go after other gods; but he did not keep the orders of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala nu bara tɔnyi dɔxɔ ala gbɛtɛ batufe ra, kɔnɔ Sulemani mu Alatala xa yaamari suxu.

sentences.english: So the Lord said to Solomon, Because you have done this, and have not kept my agreement and my laws, which I gave you, I will take the kingdom away from you by force and will give it to your servant.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala naxa a fala Sulemani bɛ, «I to bara na mɔɔli raba, i mu bira n ma yaamarie fɔxɔ ra n naxee birin masen i bɛ, i n ma saatɛ kana, n i xa mangɛya bama nɛ i yi ra, n fa a so i xa konyi nde yi ra.

sentences.english: I will not do it in your life-time, because of your father David, but I will take it from your son.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i baba Dawuda xa fe ra, n mu na rabama i xa simaya kui, n mangɛya bama nɛ i xa di xɛmɛ yi ra.

sentences.english: Still I will not take all the kingdom from him; but I will give one tribe to your son, because of my servant David, and because of Jerusalem, the town of my selection.
sentences.susu: N mu mangɛya birin bama a yi ra, n bɔnsɔɛ keren nan luma i xa di bɛ n ma konyi Dawuda xa fe ra, nun Darisalamu xa fe ra n naxan sugandixi.»

sentences.english: So the Lord sent Hadad the Edomite to make trouble for Solomon: he was of the king's seed in Edom.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Sulemani gerefa nde ramini, naxan nu xili Hadada. Edon mangɛ xa di nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: And when David had sent destruction on Edom, and Joab, the captain of the army, had gone to put the dead into the earth, and had put to death every male in Edom;
sentences.susu: Dawuda Edon bɔxi gere tɛmui naxɛ, a xa sɔɔri mangɛ Yowaba nu bara te naa Isirayila sɔɔrie furee ragatade. Na tɛmui a man naxa Edon xɛmɛ birin faxa.

sentences.english: (For Joab and all Israel were there six months till every male in Edom had been cut off;)
sentences.susu: Yowaba nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa lu naa kike senni, han e gɛ xɛmɛ birin faxade

sentences.english: Hadad, being still a young boy, went in flight to Egypt, with certain Edomites, servants of his father;
sentences.susu: Hadada nun a baba xa konyi Edonka ndee nu bara e gi, e siga Misira. Na raba Hadada dimɛdi tɛmui nɛ.

sentences.english: And they went on from Midian and came to Paran; and, taking men from Paran with them, they came to Egypt, to Pharaoh, king of Egypt, who gave him a house and gave orders for his food and gave him land.
sentences.susu: E to keli Madiyan, e naxa siga Paran. E naxa mixie tongo mɛnni, e fa siga Misira Firawuna yire. Misira mangɛ naxa banxi so a yi ra, a a ɲɔxɔ sa a xa donse fe xɔn ma, a bɔxi fan fi a ma.

sentences.english: Now Hadad was very pleasing to Pharaoh, so that he gave him the sister of his wife, Tahpenes the queen, for his wife.
sentences.susu: Hadada naxa rafan Firawuna ma, han a a xa mangɛ ginɛ xunya fi a ma ginɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the sister of Tahpenes had a son by him, Genubath, whom Tahpenes took care of in Pharaoh's house; and Genubath was living in Pharaoh's house among Pharaoh's sons.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ ginɛ Tapenesi xunya naxa di xɛmɛ bari a bɛ, naxan nu xili Genubati. Tapenesi na dɛ ba Firawuna xɔnyi nɛ, a fa lu mɛnni Firawuna xa die ya ma.

sentences.english: Now when Hadad had news in Egypt that David had been put to rest with his fathers, and that Joab, the captain of the army, was dead, he said to Pharaoh, Send me back to my country.
sentences.susu: Hadada to a mɛ a Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔri mangɛ Yowaba bara faxa, a naxa a fala Firawuna bɛ, a xa diɲɛ a ma a xa gbilen a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: But Pharaoh said to him, What have you been short of while you have been with me, that you are desiring to go back to your country? And he said, Nothing; but even so, send me back.
sentences.susu: Firawuna naxa a yaabi, «Munfe ra i wama gbilenfe i xɔnyi? I waxɔnfe birin na be.» A naxa a yaabi, «I nɔndi, kɔnɔ diɲɛ n xa gbilen.»

sentences.english: And God sent another trouble-maker, Rezon, the son of Eliada, who had gone in flight from his lord, Hadadezer, king of Zobah:
sentences.susu: Ala naxa gerefa gbɛtɛ ramini mangɛ Sulemani bɛ, naxan findixi Eliyada xa di Reson na, naxan nu bara a gi kelife Soba mangɛ Hadadeseri xɔnyi,

sentences.english: He got some men together and made himself captain of a band of outlaws; and went to Damascus and became king there.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nu na e gerefe tɛmui naxɛ. Reson xa sɔɔrie nan malan a fɛ ma, e fa lu Damasi, e mangɛya sɔtɔ mɛnni.

sentences.english: He was a trouble to Israel all through the days of Solomon. And this is the damage Hadad did: he was cruel to Israel while he was ruler over Edom.
sentences.susu: Reson nun Hadada findi Sulemani yaxuie nan na a xa simaya birin kui. Arami mangɛ Reson nu Isirayila ɲama xɔnxi.

sentences.english: And there was Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, an Ephraimite from Zeredah, a servant of Solomon, whose mother was Zeruah, a widow; and his hand was lifted up against the king.
sentences.susu: Nebati xa di Yerobowami nu kelixi Sereda nɛ Efirami bɔxi ma. A nga naxa findi kaaɲɛ ginɛ nde ra, naxan xili Seruya. A nu walima mangɛ Sulemani xa mixie ya ma, kɔnɔ mangɛ xa fe mu nu rafan a ma.

sentences.english: The way in which his hand came to be lifted up against the king was this: Solomon was building the Millo and making good the damaged parts of the town of his father David;
sentences.susu: Na rakeli yi fe nan ma: Mangɛ Sulemani nu na Milo tife, a nun a baba xa taa tɛtɛ yire nde.

sentences.english: And Jeroboam was an able and responsible man; and Solomon saw that he was a good worker and made him overseer of all the work given to the sons of Joseph.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami to findi gbangbalanyi fanyi nan na, Sulemani naxa a findi teku wali xunyi ra Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ xun ma.

sentences.english: Now at that time, when Jeroboam was going out of Jerusalem, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite came across him on the road; now Ahijah had put on a new robe; and the two of them were by themselves in the open country.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Yerobowami naxa mini Darisalamu, a Annabi Ahiya Siloka li kira xɔn ma e doro. Donma xungbe nɛɛnɛ nu ragoroxi namiɲɔnmɛ ma.

sentences.english: And Ahijah took his new robe in his hands, parting it violently into twelve.
sentences.susu: Annabi Ahiya naxa a xa donma nɛɛnɛ ibɔɔ xuntun fu nun firin na,

sentences.english: And he said to Jeroboam, Take ten of the parts, for this is what the Lord has said: See, I will take the kingdom away from Solomon by force, and will give ten tribes to you;
sentences.susu: a fa a fala Yerobowami bɛ, «Xuntun fu tongo, barima Isirayila Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi n bɛ, ‹N fama nɛ mangɛya bade Sulemani yi ra, n fa bɔnsɔɛ fu sa i tan xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: (But one tribe will be his, because of my servant David, and because of Jerusalem, the town which, out of all the tribes of Israel, I have made mine,)
sentences.susu: N bɔnsɔɛ keren luma nɛ Sulemani bun ma n ma konyi Dawuda xa fe ra nun Darisalamu xa fe ra, n taa naxan sugandixi Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ ya ma.

sentences.english: Because they are turned away from me to the worship of Ashtoreth, the goddess of the Zidonians, and Chemosh, the god of Moab, and Milcom, the god of the Ammonites; they have not been walking in my ways or doing what is right in my eyes or keeping my laws and my decisions as his father David did.
sentences.susu: N na rabama nɛ barima e bara e kobe so n na, e Sidɔn xa ala Asiteroti, nun Mowaba xa ala Kemosi, nun Amoni xa ala Mɔlɔkɔ batu. E mu e ɲɛrɛma n ma kira xɔn ma, e mu n ma yaamarie ratinmɛma alɔ Sulemani baba Dawuda a raba nɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But I will not take the kingdom from him; I will let him be king all the days of his life, because of David my servant, in whom I took delight because he kept my orders and my laws.
sentences.susu: N mu mangɛya birin bama Sulemani yi ra, a xa lu mangɛya kui a xa simaya birin na n ma konyi sugandixi Dawuda xa fe ra, naxan bara n ma yaamarie nun n waxɔnfe rabatu.

sentences.english: But I will take the kingdom from his son, and give it to you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n mangɛya bama nɛ Dawuda xa di Sulemani yi ra, n bɔnsɔɛ fu fi i ma.

sentences.english: And one tribe I will give to his son, so that David my servant may have a light for ever burning before me in Jerusalem, the town which I have made mine to put my name there.
sentences.susu: N bɔnsɔɛ keren nan luma a xa di yi ra, alako n ma konyi Dawuda fɔxi xa lu Darisalamu abadan, n dɛnnaxɛ sugandixi n xili xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And you I will take, and you will be king over Israel, ruling over whatever is the desire of your soul.
sentences.susu: N i tongoma nɛ, n i findi mangɛ ra Isirayila xun na. I luma i waxɔnde nɛ.

sentences.english: And if you give attention to the orders I give you, walking in my ways and doing what is right in my eyes and keeping my laws and my orders as David my servant did; then I will be with you, building up for you a safe house, as I did for David, and I will give Israel to you.
sentences.susu: Xa i sa i tuli mati n na, xa i sa i ɲɛrɛ n ma kira xɔn, xa i sa wali n bɛ, i n ma yaamarie ratinmɛ, i n ma sɛriyɛ rabatu, alɔ n ma konyi Dawuda a raba ki naxɛ, n luma nɛ i sɛɛti ma tɛmui birin, n i bɔnsɔɛ rasabatima nɛ, alɔ n naxan nabaxi n ma konyi mangɛ Dawuda bɛ, n Isirayila fima nɛ i ma.

sentences.english: (So that I may send trouble for this on the seed of David, but not for ever.)
sentences.susu: N mangɛ Dawuda bɔnsɔɛe rayaagima nɛ, kɔnɔ kudɛ xa mu a ra.›»

sentences.english: And Solomon was looking for a chance to put Jeroboam to death; but he went in flight to Egypt, to Shishak, king of Egypt, and was in Egypt till the death of Solomon.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani naxa wa Yerobowami faxafe. Na nan a niya, Yerobowami naxa a gi, a sa a xunyi taxu Sisaki ra Misira mangɛ. A naxa lu mɛnni han mangɛ Sulemani naxa faxa.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, and all he did, and his wisdom, are they not recorded in the book of the acts of Solomon?
sentences.susu: Sulemani xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, a fɔlɛ nun a raɲɔnyi, a sɛbɛxi Sulemani xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: And the time Solomon was king in Jerusalem over all Israel was forty years.
sentences.susu: Sulemani xa mangɛya naxa bu ɲɛ tongo naani Darisalamu nun Isirayila xun ma.

sentences.english: And Solomon went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth in the town of David his father: and Solomon went to rest with his fathers and Rehoboam his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Sulemani naxa laaxira. E naxa a ragata a babae sɛɛti ma a baba Dawuda xa taa kui. A xa di Robowami naxa lu a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Rehoboam went to Shechem, where all Israel had come together to make him king,
sentences.susu: Robowami naxa siga Sikemi, barima Isirayilakae birin nu malanxi naa, e xa a ti mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And, hearing of it, Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, who was still in Egypt, where he had gone in flight from Solomon, and was living there, came back to his town Zeredah, in the hill-country of Ephraim;
sentences.susu: Nebati xa di Yerobowami naxa na fe mɛ Misira, a to a gi Sulemani ma a siga dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And all the men of Israel came to Rehoboam and said,
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee naxa a xili a xa fa Isirayila bɔxi ma. Yerobowami nun Isirayilakae birin naxa siga Robowami yire, e a fala a bɛ,

sentences.english: Your father put a hard yoke on us: if you will make the conditions under which your father kept us down less cruel, and the weight of the yoke he put on us less hard, then we will be your servants.
sentences.susu: «I baba muxu suxu nɛ alɔ konyie. Yakɔsi tan, i xa nde ba muxu xa kote ra i baba naxan saxi muxu fari. Na kui muxu fama i xa yaamari rabatude.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Go away for three days and then come back to me again. So the people went away.
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «Xi saxan na dangi, wo xa fa.» Ɲama naxa siga.

sentences.english: Then King Rehoboam took the opinion of the old men who had been with Solomon his father when he was living, and said, In your opinion, what answer am I to give to this people?
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Robowami naxa marasi fen forie ra, naxee nu na a baba Sulemani fɛ ma a xa simaya kui, a fa e maxɔrin, «Wo marasi mundun fima n ma n nan n ma ɲama yaabima naxan na?»

sentences.english: And they said to him, If you will be a servant to this people today, caring for them and giving them a gentle answer, then they will be your servants for ever.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Xa i fe fanyi rabama ɲama bɛ, xa i tin e waxɔnfe ra, xa i wɔyɛn fanyi fala e bɛ, e luma nɛ i xa yaamari bun ma tɛmui birin.»

sentences.english: But he gave no attention to the opinion of the old men, and went to the young men of his generation who were waiting before him:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Robowami mu tin forie xa marasi ra. A naxa a lanfanma booree maxɔrin a lanma a xa naxan naba.

sentences.english: And said to them, What is your opinion? What answer are we to give to this people who have said to me, Make less the weight of the yoke which your father put on us?
sentences.susu: A naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo marasi mundun fima n ma n na n ma ɲama yaabima naxan na, ɲama naxan n mayandima n xa nde ba e xa kote ra n baba naxan saxi e fari.»

sentences.english: And the young men of his generation said to him, This is the answer to give to the people who came to you saying, Your father put a hard yoke on us; will you make it less? say to them, My little finger is thicker than my father's body;
sentences.susu: A lanfanmae naxa a yaabi, «I xa yi ɲama yaabi yi ki, naxee i mayandixi i xa nde ba e xa kote ra i baba naxan saxi e fari. I xa a fala e bɛ, ‹N bɛlɛxɛ sole lanmadi xungbo n baba tagi bɛ.

sentences.english: If my father put a hard yoke on you, I will make it harder: my father gave you punishment with whips, but I will give you blows with snakes.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, n baba xa kote xɔrɔxɔ a naxan dɔxɔ wo ma, n tan na xun masama nɛ. N baba wo bɔnbɔ luxusinyie nan na, kɔnɔ n tan fama wo bɔnbɔde talie nan na.›»

sentences.english: So all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king had given orders, saying, Come back to me the third day.
sentences.susu: Xi saxan to dangi, Yerobowami nun ɲama naxa siga Robowami yire, naxan nu bara a fala, «Xi saxan na dangi, wo xa fa.»

sentences.english: And the king gave them a rough answer, giving no attention to the suggestion of the old men;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Robowami naxa e yaabi a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra, a mu forie xa marasi tongo.

sentences.english: But giving them the answer put forward by the young men, saying, My father made your yoke hard, but I will make it harder; my father gave you punishment with whips, but I will give it with snakes.
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi a lanfanmae xa marasi ra, «N na n baba xa kote xɔrɔxɔɛ xun ma sama nɛ a naxan dɔxɔ wo ma. N baba wo bɔnbɔ luxusinyie nan na, kɔnɔ n tan fama wo bɔnbɔde talie nan na.»

sentences.english: So the king did not give ear to the people; and this came about by the purpose of the Lord, so that what he had said by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam, son of Nebat, might be effected.
sentences.susu: Na kui, mangɛ mu tin a tuli matide ɲama ra. Marigi Alatala nu bara na ragiri alako a xa a xa masenyi rakamali a naxan fala Nebati xa di Yerobowami bɛ Annabi Ahiya Siloka saabui ra.

sentences.english: And when all Israel saw that the king would give no attention to them, the people in answer said to the king, What part have we in David? what is our heritage in the son of Jesse? to your tents, O Israel; now see to your people, David. So Israel went away to their tents.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae to a kolon mangɛ mu tin a tuli matide e ra, e naxa a yaabi, «Munse na won nun Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ tagi? Kɛ mu na muxu bɛ Yisayi xa die tagi. Isirayila xa gbilen e xɔnyi. Yakɔsi Dawuda, i xa mɛɛni i xa banxi ma i yɛtɛ ra.» Na kui, Isirayila birin naxa gbilen e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: (But Rehoboam was still king over those of the children of Israel who were living in the towns of Judah.)
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka naxee nu sabatixi Yudaya taae kui, nee naxa lu Robowami xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: Then King Rehoboam sent Adoniram, the overseer of the forced work; and he was stoned to death by all Israel. And King Rehoboam went quickly and got into his carriage to go in flight to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, mangɛ Robowami naxa Adorami xɛɛ, naxan ɲɛngi nu saxi teku wali xɔn ma, kɔnɔ Isirayilakae naxa a magɔnɔ han a faxa. Mangɛ Robowami naxa a gi keren na sigafe ra Darisalamu a xa sɔɔri ragise kui.

sentences.english: So Israel was turned away from the family of David to this day.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Dawuda xabilɛ matandi na ki nɛ. Han to e mu lanxi.

sentences.english: Now when all Israel had news that Jeroboam had come back, they sent for him to come before the meeting of the people, and made him king over Israel: not one of them was joined to the family of David but only the tribe of Judah.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka birin to a mɛ a Yerobowami bara fa, e naxa e malan, e a xili, e a findi mangɛ ra Isirayila birin xun ma. Yudaya nan keren sa Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ dɛ ra.

sentences.english: When Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, he got together all the men of Judah and the tribe of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand of his best fighting-men, to make war against Israel and get the kingdom back for Rehoboam, the son of Solomon.
sentences.susu: Robowami to so Darisalamu, a naxa Yuda nun Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ sɔɔrie malan, geresoe fanyi wulu kɛmɛ tongo solomasaxan, alako e xa Isirayila gere, Isirayila xa gbilen Robowami xa mangɛya bun ma.

sentences.english: But the word of God came to Shemaiah, the man of God, saying,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala naxa a masen a xa mixi Semaya bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all the men of Judah and Benjamin and the rest of the people:
sentences.susu: «A fala Sulemani xa di Robowami bɛ, Yudaya mangɛ, a nun Isirayilakae birin naxee na Yudaya nun Bunyamin bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: The Lord has said, You are not to go to war against your brothers, the children of Israel; go back, every man to his house, because this thing is my purpose. So they gave ear to the word of the Lord, and went back, as the Lord had said.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan yi ki: ‹Wo naxa te de sigafe ra won ngaxakerenyie gerede. Wo birin xa gbilen wo xɔnyi, barima n tan nan yi fe ragirixi.›» E naxa Alatala xa masenyi rabatu, e naxa gbilen, e mu siga Yerobowami gerede sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Then Jeroboam made the town of Shechem in the hill-country of Ephraim a strong place, and was living there; and from there he went out and did the same to Penuel.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami naxa Sikemi taa ti Efirami geyae yire, a sabati naa. Na dangi xanbi, a man naxa siga, a Peniyeli ti.

sentences.english: And Jeroboam said in his heart, Now the kingdom will go back to the family of David:
sentences.susu: Yerobowami naxa a fala a bɔɲɛ ma, «Tɛmunde yi ɲama fama gbilende, e lu Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ xa yaamari bun ma,

sentences.english: If the people go up to make offerings in the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, their heart will be turned again to their lord, to Rehoboam, king of Judah; and they will put me to death and go back to Rehoboam, king of Judah.
sentences.susu: xa e luma te ra sɛrɛxɛe bade Alatala xa banxi kui Darisalamu. Yi ɲama bɔɲɛ ya fama nɛ rafindide e marigi Robowami Yudaya mangɛ ma, e n tan faxa, e fa gbilen Yudaya mangɛ Robowami ma.»

sentences.english: So after taking thought the king made two oxen of gold; and he said to the people, You have been going up to Jerusalem long enough; see! these are your gods, O Israel, who took you out of the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ marasi fende, mangɛ naxa ninge misaali firin yailan xɛɛma ra, a fa a fala ɲama bɛ, «Wo xa sigɛ Darisalamu mu lanma sɔnɔn. Isirayila, wo xa alae nan yi ki naxee wo ramini Misira bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And he put one in Beth-el and the other in Dan.
sentences.susu: A naxa keren ti Beteli, a keren ti Dana.

sentences.english: And this became a sin in Israel; for the people went to give worship to the one at Beth-el, and to the other at Dan.
sentences.susu: Na nan findixi yunubi ra e bɛ. Ɲama nu luma siga ra na kuyee batude Beteli, xa na mu a ra Dana.

sentences.english: And he made places for worship at the high places, and made priests, who were not Levites, from among all the people.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami naxa salidee ti yire itexi, a fa mixie ti sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra naxee mu findi Lewi die ra.

sentences.english: And Jeroboam gave orders for a feast in the eighth month, on the fifteenth day of the month, like the feast which is kept in Judah, and he went up to the altar. And in the same way, in Beth-el, he gave offerings to the oxen which he had made, placing in Beth-el the priests of the high places he had made.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami naxa sali nde raba kike solomasaxan nde xi fu nun suuli nde ra, alɔ sali naxan mɔɔli nu rabama Yudaya. A yɛtɛ yati naxa sɛrɛxɛe ba na kuye ninge daaxie bɛ, a naxee yailan Beteli. A naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe dɔxɔ Beteli na salide yiree, a naxee ti geyae kɔn.

sentences.english: He went up to the altar he had made in Beth-el on the fifteenth day of the eighth month, the month fixed by him at his pleasure; and he gave orders for a feast for the people of Israel, and went up to the altar, and there he made the smoke of his offerings go up.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛ ba na salide kui, a naxan yailan Beteli. A na raba kike solomasaxan nde xi fu nun suuli nde nɛ. A nu bara na kike sugandi a yɛtɛ kan waxɔnki ra. A naxa sali xungbe raba Isirayilakae bɛ, a surayi gan sɛrɛxɛ ra Beteli sɛrɛxɛbade fari.

sentences.english: Then a man of God came from Judah by the order of the Lord to Beth-el, where Jeroboam was by the altar, burning offerings.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa xɛɛra nde naxa fa Beteli kelife Yudaya bɔxi ma. Yerobowami nu tixi sɛrɛxɛbade fari, a na surayi ganfe sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: And by the order of the Lord he made an outcry against the altar, saying, O altar, altar, the Lord has said, From the seed of David will come a child, named Josiah, and on you he will put to death the priests of the high places, who are burning offerings on you, and men's bones will be burned on you.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa xɛɛra naxa a xui ite sɛrɛxɛbade a xɔrɔxɔ ra a Alatala xa masenyi fala a xui itexi ra. A naxɛ, «Sɛrɛxɛbade, sɛrɛxɛbade! Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: ‹Di xɛmɛ nde barima nɛ mangɛ Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, a xili Yosiya. A i xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe findi sɛrɛxɛ ra i fari, naxee surayi bama sɛrɛxɛ ra salide geyae fari. Mixi xɔrie nan yati ganma i fari!›»

sentences.english: The same day he gave them a sign, saying, This is the sign which the Lord has given: See, the altar will be broken and the burned waste on it overturned.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ a naxa tɔnxuma fi e ma, a naxa a fala e bɛ, «Tɔnxuma nan ya alako wo xa a kolon a n tan Alatala xui yati nan falaxi wo bɛ. Yi sɛrɛxɛbade fama nɛ ibɔɔde, a xube ibɔgonma bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: Then the king, hearing the man of God crying out against the altar at Beth-el, put out his hand from the altar, saying, Take him prisoner. And his hand, stretched out against him, became dead, and he had no power of pulling it back.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Yerobowami to Ala xa xɛɛra xa masenyi mɛ, a naxan fala a xui itexi ra Beteli sɛrɛxɛbade xa fe ra, a naxa a bɛlɛxɛ itala na sɛrɛxɛbade fari, a fa a fala, «Na xɛmɛ suxu.» A to na raba, a bɛlɛxɛ naxa xɔrɔxɔ a ra, a mu nɔ a ramaxade sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And the altar was broken and the burned waste on it overturned; this was the sign which the man of God had given by the word of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na sɛrɛxɛbade naxa ibɔɔ keren na, a xube naxa ibɔgon bɔxi ma, alɔ Alatala xa xɛɛra a fala ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then the king made answer and said to the man of God, Make a prayer now for the grace of the Lord your God, and for me, that my hand may be made well. And in answer to the prayer of the man of God, the king's hand was made well again, as it was before.
sentences.susu: Na kui mangɛ naxa a fala Ala xa xɛɛra bɛ, «I Marigi Alatala maxandi n bɛ, alako n bɛlɛxɛ xa yalan.» Ala xa xɛɛra naxa Ala maxandi a bɛ, Yerobowami bɛlɛxɛ naxa yalan alɔ a singe.

sentences.english: And the king said to the man of God, Come with me to my house for food and rest, and I will give you a reward.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala Ala xa xɛɛra bɛ, «Fa n xɔnyi i xa i malabu, n buɲa nde fima i ma.»

sentences.english: But the man of God said to the king, Even if you gave me half of all you have, I would not go in with you, and I would not take food or a drink of water in this place;
sentences.susu: Ala xa xɛɛra naxa mangɛ yaabi, «Hali i naafuli gbegbe fima n ma, n mu soma i xɔnyi. N mu sese donma, n mu sese minma be,

sentences.english: For so I was ordered by the word of the Lord, who said, You are not to take food or a drink of water, and you are not to go back the way you came.
sentences.susu: barima Alatala n yamarixi yi nan na, ‹I naxa sese don, i naxa sese min na yire. I xa gbilen i xɔnyi kira gbɛtɛ ra.›»

sentences.english: So he went another way, and not by the way he came to Beth-el.
sentences.susu: A naxa gbilen kira gbɛtɛ ra, a mu gbilen kira ra a fa naxan xɔn ma a singe.

sentences.english: Now there was an old prophet living in Beth-el; and one of his sons came and gave him word of all the man of God had done that day in Beth-el, and they gave their father an account of the words he had said to the king.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ xɛmɔxi nde nu na Beteli taa kui. A xa di nde naxa na fe ya maxaran a bɛ, Ala xa xɛɛra naxan birin naba Beteli na lɔxɔɛ, nun a wɔyɛnyi naxee fala mangɛ bɛ. A xa di to gɛ na fe birin masende a bɛ,

sentences.english: Then their father said to them, Which way did he go? Now his sons had seen which way the man of God who came from Judah had gone.
sentences.susu: a naxa a tan nun a xunyae maxɔrin, «A gbilen kira mundun na?» A xa die nu bara a kolon na xɛɛra gbilen kira naxan na. E to na fala e baba bɛ,

sentences.english: So the prophet said to his sons, Make ready an ass for me. So they made an ass ready, and he got on it,
sentences.susu: a naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo fa n ma sofale ra.» E to a yailan, a naxa te a fari,

sentences.english: And went after the man of God, and came up with him while he was seated under an oak-tree. And he said to him, Are you the man of God who came from Judah? And he said, I am.
sentences.susu: a bira Ala xa xɛɛra fɔxɔ ra, han a sa a li wuri nde bun ma. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «Ala xa xɛɛra na i tan nan na naxan keli Yudaya?» A naxa a yaabi, «Iyo, n tan nan a ra.»

sentences.english: Then he said to him, Come back to the house with me and have a meal.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ xɛmɔxi naxa a fala a bɛ, «Won xa gbilen n xɔnyi, won xa won dɛge.»

sentences.english: But he said, I may not go back with you or go into your house; and I will not take food or a drink of water with you in this place;
sentences.susu: Ala xa xɛɛra naxa a yaabi, «N mu nɔma gbilende, n mu nɔma sode i xɔnyi. N mu sese donma, n mu sese minma yi yire,

sentences.english: For the Lord said to me, You are not to take food or water there, or go back again by the way you came.
sentences.susu: barima Alatala a masenxi nɛ n bɛ, ‹I naxa sese don, i naxa sese min, i naxa gbilen kira ra i fa fama faxi naxan xɔn ma.›»

sentences.english: Then he said to him, I am a prophet like you; and an angel said to me by the word of the Lord, Take him back with you and give him food and water. But he said false words to him.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɔxi naxa a fala a bɛ, «N tan fan findixi namiɲɔnmɛ nan na alɔ i tan. Malekɛ nde nan goroxi n ma, a Ala xa masenyi ti n bɛ, a falafe ra, ‹Na mixi ragbilen i xɔnyi, a xa a dɛge, a xa a min.›» A nu wule nan falafe a bɛ.

sentences.english: So he went back with him, and had a meal in his house and a drink of water.
sentences.susu: Na kui Ala xa xɛɛra naxa gbilen, e naxa e dɛge, e naxa e min.

sentences.english: But while they were seated at the table, the word of the Lord came to the prophet who had taken him back;
sentences.susu: E nu dɔxɔxi teebili ra tɛmui naxɛ, Ala xa masenyi naxa goro na namiɲɔnmɛ xɛmɔxi ma,

sentences.english: And crying out to the man of God who came from Judah, he said, The Lord says, Because you have gone against the voice of the Lord, and have not done as you were ordered by the Lord,
sentences.susu: a naxa a xui ite Ala xa xɛɛra bɛ naxan keli Yudaya bɔxi ma. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «Ala xa masenyi nan ya: ‹I to i Marigi Alatala xa yaamari matandi, i mu a xui suxu,

sentences.english: But have come back, and have taken food and water in this place where he said you were to take no food or water; your dead body will not be put to rest with your fathers.
sentences.susu: a falafe ra i naxa sese don, i naxa sese min be, i fure mu ragatama i benbae xa gaburi yire.›»

sentences.english: Now after the meal he made ready the ass for him, for the prophet whom he had taken back.
sentences.susu: Ala xa namiɲɔnmɛ to gɛ a dɛgede, na xɛmɔxi naxa fa a xa sofale ra alako boore xa siga.

sentences.english: And he went on his way; but on the road a lion came rushing at him and put him to death; and his dead body was stretched in the road with the ass by its side, and the lion was there by the body.
sentences.susu: A to siga, a xa biyaasi kui yɛtɛ nde naxa dutun a ma kira xɔn ma, a a faxa. A fure naxa sa kira xɔn ma, a xa sofale nun na yɛtɛ naxa ti a fɛ ma.
