sentences.english: And some men, going by, saw the body stretched out in the road with the lion by its side; and they came and gave news of it in the town where the old prophet was living.
sentences.susu: Dangi mixie naxa a fure to kira dɛ ra, yɛtɛ tixi a fɛ ma. E to Beteli li, namiɲɔnmɛ xɛmɔxi nu na dɛnnaxɛ, e naxa na fe fala mixie bɛ.

sentences.english: Then the prophet who had made him come back, hearing it, said, It is the man of God, who went against the word of the Lord; that is why the Lord has given him to the lion to be wounded to death, as the Lord said.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ xɛmɔxi naxan Ala xa xɛɛra ragbilen a xɔnyi a to na fe mɛ, a naxa a fala, «Na Ala xa xɛɛra nan a ra, naxan Alatala xa yaamari matandixi. Alatala bara a niya yɛtɛ xa a ibɔɔ, a xa a faxa, alɔ a masenxi a bɛ ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said to his sons, Make ready the ass for me. And they did so.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a naxa a fala a xa die bɛ, «Wo fa n ma sofale ra.» E naxa na raba.

sentences.english: And he went and saw the dead body stretched out in the road with the ass and the lion by its side: the lion had not taken the body for its food or done any damage to the ass.
sentences.susu: A to siga, a naxa Ala xa xɛɛra fure to kira xɔn ma, yɛtɛ nun sofale tixi a fɛ ma. Yɛtɛ mu fure donxi, a mu sofale ibɔɔxi.

sentences.english: Then the prophet took up the body of the man of God and put it on the ass and took it back; and he came to the town to put the body to rest with weeping.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ xɛmɔxi naxa Ala xa xɛɛra fure tongo, a a sa a xa sofale fari, a gbilen a ra. Namiɲɔnmɛ xɛmɔxi naxa a raso taa kui, a a kasange, a a xa ɲɔn fe raba.

sentences.english: And he put the body in the resting-place made ready for himself, weeping and sorrowing over it, saying, O my brother!
sentences.susu: A to a fure sa gaburi kui, a naxa a fala, «N ngaxakerenyi, i nu tɔɔrɔ.»

sentences.english: And when he had put it to rest, he said to his sons, When I am dead, then you are to put my body into the earth with the body of this man of God, and put me by his bones so that my bones may be kept safe with his bones.
sentences.susu: Na to ba a ra, xɛmɔxi naxa a fala a xa die bɛ, «N na faxa, wo xa n sa yi gaburi kui Ala xa xɛɛra fure saxi dɛnnaxɛ. Wo xa n xɔrie sa a xɔrie fɛ ma.

sentences.english: For the outcry he made by the word of the Lord against the altar in Beth-el and against all the houses of the high places in the towns of Samaria, will certainly come about.
sentences.susu: A naxan fala Alatala xili ra Beteli nun yi sɛrɛxɛbade naxee na geyae ma Samari bɔxi ma, a fama nɛ kamalide.»

sentences.english: After this Jeroboam, not turning back from his evil ways, still made priests for his altars from among all the people; he made a priest of anyone desiring it, so that there might be priests of the high places.
sentences.susu: Na fee to dangi, Yerobowami mu gbilen a xa fe ɲaaxie fɔxɔ ra. A mixi mɔɔli birin ti sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra na salidee kui geyae fari, naxee na tin na ra.

sentences.english: And this became a sin in the family of Jeroboam, causing it to be cut off and sent to destruction from the face of the earth.
sentences.susu: Na nan findi Yerobowami bɔnsɔɛ xa yunubi ra. Ala e sɔntɔ nɛ, a e fa e ralɔɛ duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: At that time Abijah, the son of Jeroboam, became ill.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yerobowami xa di Abiya naxa fura.

sentences.english: And Jeroboam said to his wife, Now come, put on different clothing so that you may not seem to be the wife of Jeroboam, and go to Shiloh; see, Ahijah is there, the prophet who said I would be king over this people.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami naxa a fala a xa ginɛ bɛ, «I xa i maxiri kɛɲa nde ra, alako mixi naxa a kolon a Yerobowami xa ginɛ nan i ra. I siga Silo Annabi Abiya xɔn ma, naxan a fala n bɛ, a n findima nɛ yi bɔxi mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And take with you ten cakes of bread and dry cakes and a pot of honey, and go to him: he will give you word of what is to become of the child.
sentences.susu: I xa taami fu, se ɲɔxunmɛ ndee, nun kumi nde xanin a xɔn. A a falama nɛ i bɛ, fe naxan fama won ma di lide.»

sentences.english: So Jeroboam's wife did so, and got up and went to Shiloh and came to the house of Ahijah. Now Ahijah was unable to see, because he was very old.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami xa ginɛ naxa a raba na ki, a naxa siga Silo, a sa so Ahiya xɔnyi. Ahiya nu bara fori, a ya mu nu se igbɛma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And the Lord had said to Ahijah, The wife of Jeroboam is coming to get news from you about her son, who is ill; give her such and such an answer; for she will make herself seem to be another woman.
sentences.susu: Alatala nu bara a fala Ahiya bɛ, «Yerobowami xa ginɛ nan fafe yi ki, a faxi i maxɔrinde a xa di xa fe ma, barima na mu yalanxi. I xa n ma masenyi ti a bɛ. A fama gundo ki nan ma, alako mixi mu a kolonma ki naxɛ Yerobowami xa ginɛ na a ra.»

sentences.english: Then Ahijah, hearing the sound of her footsteps coming in at the door, said, Come in, O wife of Jeroboam; why do you make yourself seem like another? for I am sent to you with bitter news.
sentences.susu: Ahiya to a sanyi xui mɛ a bara makɔrɛ naadɛ ra, a naxa a fala a bɛ, «So, Yerobowami xa ginɛ. I faxi a gundo ki ma munfe ra? Masenyi xɔrɔxɔɛ nan yi ra i bɛ.

sentences.english: Go, say to Jeroboam, These are the words of the Lord, the God of Israel: Though I took you from among the people, lifting you up to be a ruler over my people Israel,
sentences.susu: Siga, i sa a fala Yerobowami bɛ, Isirayila Marigi Alatala naxɛ, ‹N bara i xa fe ite ɲama tagi, n bara i ti mangɛ ra n ma ɲama Isirayila xun ma,

sentences.english: And took the kingdom away by force from the seed of David and gave it to you, you have not been like my servant David, who kept my orders, and was true to me with all his heart, doing only what was right in my eyes.
sentences.susu: n bara mangɛya ba Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ yi ra, n a fi i tan ma. Kɔnɔ i mu luxi alɔ n ma konyi Dawuda, naxan n ma sɛriyɛ rabatu, a bira n fɔxɔ ra a bɔɲɛ birin na n waxɔnfe rabade.

sentences.english: But you have done evil more than any before you, and have made for yourself other gods, and images of metal, moving me to wrath, and turning your back on me.
sentences.susu: I wali ki ɲaaxu dangi mixi birin na. I bara n naxɔnɔ i xa kuyee batufe ra, naxee yailanxi wure raxunuxi ra. I bara i kobe raso n na.

sentences.english: So I will send evil on the line of Jeroboam, cutting off from his family every male child, those who are shut up and those who go free in Israel; the family of Jeroboam will be brushed away like a man brushing away waste till it is all gone.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, n gbaloe ragoroma i tan Yerobowami bɔnsɔɛ, i xa konyie, nun i xa mixi xɔrɛyaxie ma. E birin sɔntɔma nɛ. N fe ɲaaxi bama nɛ wo tagi, alɔ ginɛ banxi makɔma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Those of the family of Jeroboam who come to death in the town, will become food for the dogs; and those on whom death comes in the open country, will be food for the birds of the air; for the Lord has said it.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami bɔnsɔɛ naxan na faxa taa kui, baree nan na fure donma. Naxan na faxa wula i, xɔnie nan na donma.› Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: Up, then! go back to your house; and in the hour when your feet go into the town, the death of the child will take place.
sentences.susu: Ahiya man naxa a fala na ginɛ bɛ, «Yakɔsi i xa gbilen i xɔnyi. I nɛfɛ i sanyi ti taa kui, wo xa di faxama nɛ.

sentences.english: And all Israel will put his body to rest, weeping over him, because he only of the family of Jeroboam will be put into his resting-place in the earth; for of all the family of Jeroboam, in him only has the Lord, the God of Israel, seen some good.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae birin a ɲɔn fe raba, e a ragata gaburi kui. A keren nan sama gaburi kui Yerobowami xa denbaya ya ma, barima a keren nan fe fanyi rabaxi Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ Yerobowami xa mixie tagi.

sentences.english: And the Lord will put up a king over Israel who will send destruction on the family of Jeroboam in that day;
sentences.susu: A gbe mu luxi sɔnɔn Alatala xa fa mangɛ dɔxɔ Isirayila xun ma Yerobowami ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And even now the hand of the Lord has come down on Israel, shaking it like a river-grass in the water; and, uprooting Israel from this good land, which he gave to their fathers, he will send them this way and that on the other side of the River; because they have made for themselves images, moving the Lord to wrath.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa xɔnɛ sinma nɛ Isirayila ma, alɔ foye xungbe sinma kalee ma xure dɛ ra ki naxɛ. A Isirayila talama nɛ yi bɔxi fanyi ma, a naxan fi a benbae ma, a fa e rayensen yɛ xure kiri ma, barima e bara kuyee yailan.

sentences.english: And he will give Israel up because of the sins which Jeroboam has done and made Israel do.
sentences.susu: A Isirayila sama nɛ a yaxuie bɛlɛxɛ i yunubi xa fe ra, Isirayila naxan naba Yerobowami fɔxi ra.»

sentences.english: Then Jeroboam's wife got up and went away and came to Tirzah; and when she came to the doorway of the house, death came to the child.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami xa ginɛ naxa siga. A to so Tirisa, a bara makɔrɛ naadɛ ra a xɔnyi, a xa di naxa faxa.

sentences.english: And all Israel put his body to rest, weeping over him, as the Lord had said by his servant Ahijah the prophet.
sentences.susu: E naxa a ragata, Isirayila birin fa a ɲɔn fe raba, alɔ Alatala a masen ki naxɛ a xa konyi Annabi Ahiya bɛ.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, how he made war and how he became king, are recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ na Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui. A xa geree nun a xa mangɛya xa fe birin sɛbɛxi a kui.

sentences.english: And Jeroboam was king for twenty-two years, and was put to rest with his fathers, and Nadab his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami mangɛya raba nɛ ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin. Na tɛmui a naxa faxa, a xa di xɛmɛ Nadabo naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, was king in Judah. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he became king, and he was king for seventeen years in Jerusalem, the town which the Lord had made his out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there; his mother's name was Naamah, an Ammonite woman.
sentences.susu: Sulemani xa di Robowami findi Yudaya mangɛ ra tɛmui naxɛ, a xa simaya nu na ɲɛ tongo naani nun keren. A ɲɛ fu nun solofere mangɛya nan naba Darisalamu, Alatala taa naxan sugandi a xili xa fe ra Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin tagi. A nga Amonika nu xili nɛ Naama.

sentences.english: And Judah did evil in the eyes of the Lord, and made him more angry than their fathers had done by their sins.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae fan naxa Alatala raxɔnɔ e xa yunubie ra, e benbae mu nu darixi naxee mɔɔli ra.

sentences.english: For they made high places and upright stones and wood pillars on every high hill and under every green tree;
sentences.susu: E fan naxa sɛrɛxɛbadee yailan yire itexi birin fari wurie fɛ ma, e fa gɛmɛ masolixie nun Aseri wuri masolixie ti naa.

sentences.english: And more than this, there were those in the land who were used for sex purposes in the worship of the gods, doing the same disgusting crimes as the nations which the Lord had sent out before the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Langoee fan nu na naa. E nu fe ɲaaxie rabama na sali mɔɔli kui, alɔ sie, Ala naxee keri na bɔxi ma, nee nu a rabama ki naxɛ beenun Isirayilakae xa sabati naa.

sentences.english: Now in the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak, king of Egypt, came up against Jerusalem;
sentences.susu: Na bara a niya Robowami xa mangɛya ɲɛ suuli nde ra, Misira mangɛ Sisaki xa Darisalamu gere.

sentences.english: And took away all the stored wealth from the house of the Lord, and from the king's house, and all the gold body-covers which Solomon had made.
sentences.susu: A naxa naafuli birin tongo naxan nu na Alatala xa banxi nun mangɛ xa banxi kui. A naxa wure lefae fan tongo, Sulemani nu bara naxee maso xɛɛma ra.

sentences.english: So in their place King Rehoboam had other body-covers made of brass, and gave them into the care of the captains of the armed men who were stationed at the door of the king's house.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Robowami naxa e ɲɔxɔɛ yailan yɔxui ra, a e taxu sɔɔri mangɛe ra naxee mangɛ xa banxi naadɛe makantama.

sentences.english: And whenever the king went into the house of the Lord, the armed men went with him taking the body-covers, and then took them back to their room.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nu sigama Ala xa banxi kui tɛmui naxɛ, sɔɔrie nu na wure lefae rawalima. Mangɛ na gbilen, e man fa na wure lefae ragbilen sɔɔri banxi kui.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Rehoboam, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?
sentences.susu: Robowami xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ sɛbɛxi Yudaya mangɛe xa taruxui nan kui.

sentences.english: And there was war between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.
sentences.susu: Tɛmui birin, Robowami nun Yerobowami nu luma e boore gere ra.

sentences.english: And Rehoboam went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth with his fathers in the town of David; his mother's name was Naamah, an Ammonite woman. And Abijam his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Robowami to laaxira, e naxa a ragata a benbae sɛɛti ma Dawuda xa taa kui. A xa di Abiya naxa ti a ɲɔxɔɛ ra. A nga Amonika nu xili nɛ Naama.

sentences.english: Now in the eighteenth year of king Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, Abijam became king over Judah.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun solomasaxan nde ra, Nebati xa di Abiyami naxa ti mangɛ ra Yudaya.

sentences.english: For three years he was king in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Maacah, the daughter of Abishalom.
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya bu nɛ ɲɛ saxan Darisalamu. A nga nu xili nɛ Maaka, Abisaalon xa di.

sentences.english: And he did the same sins which his father had done before him: his heart was not completely true to the Lord his God, like the heart of David his father.
sentences.susu: A fan naxa bira yunubi fee fɔxɔ ra, a baba nu naxee rabama. A bɔɲɛ birin mu nu na a Marigi Alatala bɛ, alɔ a benba Dawuda gbe nu na ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But because of David, the Lord gave him a light in Jerusalem, making his sons king after him, so that Jerusalem might be safe;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala naxa a ti mangɛ ra Darisalamu a baba Dawuda xa fe ra,

sentences.english: Because David did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, and never in all his life went against his orders, but only in the question of Uriah the Hittite.
sentences.susu: barima Dawuda nu bara Alatala waxɔnfe raba, a bira a xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra a xa duniɲɛigiri birin kui, fo Uri Xitika xa fe.
Robowami nun Yerobowami nu e boore gerema e xa simaya birin kui.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Abijam, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah? And there was war between Abijam and Jeroboam.
sentences.susu: Abiyami xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ sɛbɛxi Yudaya mangɛe xa taruxui kui. Abiyami nun Yerobowami nu e boore gerema tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Then Abijam went to rest with his fathers, and they put him into the earth in the town of David: and Asa his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: A naxa laaxira, e a ragata a benbae sɛɛti ma Dawuda xa taa kui. A xa di Asa naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: In the twentieth year that Jeroboam was king of Israel, Asa became king over Judah.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ Yerobowami xa mangɛya ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nde ra, Asa naxa ti mangɛ ra Yudaya.

sentences.english: And he was king for forty-one years in Jerusalem; his mother's name was Maacah, the daughter of Abishalom.
sentences.susu: A ɲɛ tongo naani nun keren nan naba mangɛya kui Darisalamu. A nga nu xili nɛ Maaka, Abisaalon xa di.

sentences.english: Asa did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, as David his father did.
sentences.susu: Asa naxa Ala waxɔnfe raba alɔ a benba Dawuda a raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Those used for sex purposes in the worship of the gods he sent out of the country, and he took away all the images which his fathers had made.
sentences.susu: A naxa kuye fe kana, a babae naxee fɔlɔ, a langoee keri na sɛrɛxɛbadee xun ma.

sentences.english: And he would not let Maacah his mother be queen, because she had made a disgusting image for Asherah; and Asa had the image cut down and burned by the stream Kidron.
sentences.susu: A naxa mangɛ ginɛ binyɛ ba a nga Maaka ma, barima a nu Asera kuye batuma. A naxa na kuye rabira, a a gan, a a xube woli Sediron xure kui.

sentences.english: The high places, however, were not taken away: but still the heart of Asa was true to the Lord all his life.
sentences.susu: Hali Asa bɔɲɛ birin to nu na Alatala nan bɛ a xa simaya birin kui, a mu gɛ kuye sɛrɛxɛbadee birin kanade yire itexie Yudaya bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: He took into the house of the Lord all the things which his father had made holy, and those which he himself had made holy, silver and gold and vessels.
sentences.susu: Asa naxa xɛɛma, gbeti, nun se fanyie raso Alatala xa banxi kui, a tan nun a baba naxee ba Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: Now there was war between Asa and Baasha, king of Israel, all their days.
sentences.susu: Asa nun Isirayila mangɛ Baasa nu e boore gerema e xa simaya birin kui.

sentences.english: And Baasha, king of Israel, went up against Judah, building Ramah, so that no one was able to go out or in to Asa, king of Judah.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ Baasa naxa te Yudaya gere xili ma. A naxa Rama taa ti, alako a xa kira ibolon Yudaya mangɛ Asa ya ra.

sentences.english: Then Asa took all the silver and gold which was still stored in the Lord's house, and in the king's house, and sent them, in the care of his servants, to Ben-hadad, son of Tabrimmon, son of Rezon, king of Aram, at Damascus, saying,
sentences.susu: Asa naxa gbeti nun xɛɛma tongo Alatala xa banxi nun mangɛ xa banxi kui, a a so xɛɛrae yi ra, a e xɛɛ Damasi taa, Arami mangɛ Ben Hadada yire yi masenyi ra:

sentences.english: Let there be an agreement between me and you as there was between my father and your father: see, I have sent you an offering of silver and gold; go and put an end to your agreement with Baasha, king of Israel, so that he may give up attacking me.
sentences.susu: «Won xa saatɛ xiri won tagi alɔ n baba nun i baba a raba ki naxɛ. Sanbase nan ya, xɛɛma nun gbeti. Saatɛ kana naxan na i nun Isirayila mangɛ Baasa tagi, alako a xa makuya n na.»

sentences.english: So Ben-hadad did as King Asa said, and sent the captains of his armies against the towns of Israel, attacking Ijon and Dan and Abel-beth-maacah, and all Chinneroth as far as all the land of Naphtali.
sentences.susu: Ben Hadada naxa tin mangɛ Asa xa masenyi ra. A naxa a xa sɔɔri xunyie xɛɛ Isirayila taae suxude. E naxa Iyono, Dana, Abeli Beti Maaka, Kinereti, nun Nafatali bɔxi suxu.

sentences.english: And Baasha, hearing of it, put a stop to the building of Ramah, and was living in Tirzah.
sentences.susu: Baasa to na fe mɛ, a naxa Rama tife wali rati, a lu Tirisa taa kui.

sentences.english: Then King Asa got all Judah together, making every man come; and they took away the stones and the wood with which Baasha was building Ramah, and King Asa made use of them for building Geba in the land of Benjamin, and Mizpah.
sentences.susu: Na wali to ti, mangɛ Asa naxa Yudayakae birin xili, e xa fa teku gɛmɛe nun wurie tongode Baasa nu naxee rawalima Rama. E naxa na birin xanin, e a rawali Geba nun Misipa tife ra.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Asa, and his power, and all he did, and the towns of which he was the builder, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah? But when he was old he had a disease of the feet.
sentences.susu: Asa xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, a xa geree xa fe, a xa taa tife xa fe, nun a xa fe birin sɛbɛxi Yudaya nun Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui. Asa to fori, fure nde naxa a sanyie suxu.

sentences.english: So Asa went to rest with his fathers and was put into the earth in the town of David his father: and Jehoshaphat his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Asa naxa laaxira. E naxa a ragata gaburi kui a benba Dawuda xa taa a benbae fɛ ma. A xa di Yehosafati naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Nadab, the son of Jeroboam, became king over Israel in the second year that Asa was king of Judah; and he was king of Israel for two years.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami xa di Nadabo naxa ti Isirayila mangɛ ra Yudaya mangɛ Asa xa mangɛya ɲɛ firin nde ra. Nadabo naxa mangɛya xanin ɲɛ firin Isirayila bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, copying the evil ways of his father, and the sin which he did and made Israel do.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma, a a ɲɛrɛ a baba xa kira xɔn ma, naxan a niya Isirayila xa yunubi raba.

sentences.english: And Baasha, the son of Ahijah, of the family of Issachar, made a secret design against him, attacking him at Gibbethon, a town of the Philistines; for Nadab and the armies of Israel were making war on Gibbethon.
sentences.susu: Ahiya xa di Baasa, fatanfe Isakari bɔnsɔɛ ra, naxa yanfanteya maxiri a xun ma. Baasa naxa a faxa Gibɛtɔn, a tan Nadabo nun Isirayilakae nu na Filisitakae gerefe tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: In the third year of the rule of Asa, king of Judah, Baasha put him to death, and became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Baasa a faxa Yudaya mangɛ Asa xa mangɛya ɲɛ saxan nde nɛ, a ti Isirayila mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And straight away when he became king, he sent destruction on all the offspring of Jeroboam; there was not one living person of all the family of Jeroboam whom he did not put to death, so the word of the Lord, which he said by his servant Ahijah the Shilonite, came about;
sentences.susu: A to findi mangɛ ra, a naxa Yerobowami bɔnsɔɛ birin faxa. A mu keren lu, a e birin sɔntɔ nɛ, alɔ Alatala nu bara a masen ki naxɛ Annabi Ahiya saabui ra, naxan nu na Silo.

sentences.english: Because of the sins which Jeroboam did and made Israel do, moving the Lord, the God of Israel, to wrath.
sentences.susu: A faxa Yerobowami xa yunubi nan ma fe ra, naxan a niya Isirayila fan xa e kobe raso e Marigi Alatala ra.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Nadab, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?
sentences.susu: Nadabo xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ nun a fe naxan birin naba, na sɛbɛxi Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: And there was war between Asa and Baasha, king of Israel, all their days.
sentences.susu: Asa nun Isirayila mangɛ Baasa nu e boore gerema e xa simaya birin kui.

sentences.english: In the third year of the rule of Asa, king of Judah, Baasha, the son of Ahijah, became king over all Israel in Tirzah, and was king for twenty-four years.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Asa xa mangɛya ɲɛ saxan nde ra, Ahiya xa di Baasa naxa ti Isirayila mangɛ ra Tirisa. A bu nɛ mangɛya kui ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, copying the evil ways of Jeroboam and the sin which he made Israel do.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma, a bira Yerobowami xa kira fɔxɔ ra, naxan a niya Isirayila fan xa yunubi raba.

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to Jehu, son of Hanani, protesting against Baasha and saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi masenyi ragoro Xanani xa di Yehu ma Baasa bɛ:

sentences.english: Because I took you up out of the dust, and made you ruler over my people Israel; and you have gone in the ways of Jeroboam, and made my people Israel do evil, moving me to wrath by their sins;
sentences.susu: «N bara i tongo duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari, n i findi n ma ɲama xa mangɛ ra. Kɔnɔ i tan bara bira Yerobowami xa kira fɔxɔ ra, i n ma Isirayila ɲama ti yunubi rabafe ra, naxan bara n naxɔnɔ a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: Truly, I will see that Baasha and all his family are completely brushed away; I will make your family like the family of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat.
sentences.susu: Na kui n i tan Baasa bama nɛ mangɛ ra, alɔ ginɛ a xa banxi kui makɔma ki naxɛ. N i bɔnsɔɛ luma nɛ, alɔ n Nebati xa di Yerobowami bɔnsɔɛ luxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Anyone of the family of Baasha who comes to death in the town, will become food for the dogs; and he to whom death comes in the open country, will be food for the birds of the air.
sentences.susu: Baasa bɔnsɔɛ naxan na faxa taa kui, baree nan na donma. Naxan na faxa wula i, xɔnie nan na donma.»

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Baasha, and what he did, and his power, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?
sentences.susu: Baasa xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ nun a xa gere ki fanyi, birin sɛbɛxi Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: And Baasha went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth at Tirzah; and Elah his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Baasa naxa laaxira, a naxa ragata Tirisa. A xa di Ela naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord sent his word against Baasha and his family by the mouth of the prophet Jehu, the son of Hanani, because of all the evil he did in the eyes of the Lord, moving him to wrath by the work of his hands, because he was like the family of Jeroboam, and because he put it to death.
sentences.susu: Alatala a xa masenyi ti nɛ Baasa nun a bɔnsɔɛ bɛ, Xanani xa di Annabi Yehu saabui ra. Na masenyi ti a xa fe ɲaaxie nan ma fe ra, naxee mu rafanxi Alatala ma. A nu bara maniya Yerobowami bɔnsɔɛ ra, a naxan sɔntɔ.

sentences.english: In the twenty-sixth year that Asa was king of Judah, Elah, the son of Baasha, became king of Israel in Tirzah, and he was king for two years.
sentences.susu: Asa xa mangɛya ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun senni nde ra, Baasa xa di Ela naxa ti Isirayila mangɛ ra. A xa mangɛya bu nɛ ɲɛ firin.

sentences.english: And his servant Zimri, captain of half his war-carriages, made secret designs against him: now he was in Tirzah, drinking hard in the house of Arza, controller of the king's house in Tirzah.
sentences.susu: Simiri, a xa sɔɔri mangɛ nde, naxan nu findixi a xa sɔɔri ragisee sɛɛti keren xunyi ra, naxa yanfanteya xiri a xun. Lɔxɔɛ nde Ela nu na Tirisa a siisife Arisa xɔnyi, naxan findi na mangɛ xa banxi kantɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Zimri went in and made an attack on him and put him to death, in the twenty-seventh year that Asa was king of Judah, and made himself king in his place.
sentences.susu: Simiri naxa so naa, a a faxa. Yudaya mangɛ Asa xa mangɛya ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun solofere nde ra, Simiri naxa ti Isirayila mangɛ ra Ela ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And straight away when he became king and took his place on the seat of the kingdom, he put to death all the family of Baasha: not one male child of his relations or his friends kept his life.
sentences.susu: A to findi mangɛ ra, a naxa dɔxɔ kibanyi, a Baasa bɔnsɔɛ birin faxa nɛ. A mu na xa mixi yo lu, na boore nde ba, na ɲɔxɔɛ ba.

sentences.english: So Zimri put to death all the family of Baasha, so that the word which the Lord said against him by the mouth of Jehu the prophet came about;
sentences.susu: Simiri Baasa bɔnsɔɛ birin sɔntɔ nɛ, alɔ Alatala a masen ki naxɛ Baasa xili ma Annabi Yehu saabui ra.

sentences.english: Because of all the sins of Baasha, and the sins of Elah his son, which they did and made Israel do, moving the Lord, the God of Israel, to wrath by their foolish acts.
sentences.susu: Baasa nun a xa di Ela faxa e xa yunubi fufafue nan ma fe ra, e Isirayila Marigi Alatala raxɔnɔxi naxee ra.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Elah, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?
sentences.susu: Ela xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ birin sɛbɛxi Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: In the twenty-seventh year of Asa, king of Judah, Zimri was king for seven days in Tirzah. Now the people were attacking Gibbethon in the land of the Philistines.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Asa xa mangɛya ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun solofere nde ra, Simiri naxa mangɛya raba xi solofere bun ma Tirisa. Isirayila ɲama nu na Gibɛtɔn Filisitakae gerede.

sentences.english: And news came to the people in the tents that Zimri had made a secret design and had put the king to death: so all Israel made Omri, the captain of the army, king that day in the tents.
sentences.susu: Ɲama to a mɛ, a Simiri bara mangɛ yanfa, a a faxa, e naxa sɔɔri xunyi Omiri ti Isirayila mangɛ ra keren na.

sentences.english: Then Omri went up from Gibbethon, with all the army of Israel, and they made an attack on Tirzah, shutting in the town on every side.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Omiri nun Isirayila sɔɔrie naxa keli Gibɛtɔn, e sa Tirisa rabilin.

sentences.english: And when Zimri saw that the town was taken, he went into the inner room of the king's house, and burning the house over his head, came to his end,
sentences.susu: Simiri to a to, taa birin nabilinxi, a naxa so mangɛ banxi kui, a na gan a yɛtɛ xun ma.

sentences.english: Because of his sin in doing evil in the eyes of the Lord, in going in the way of Jeroboam and in his sin which he made Israel do.
sentences.susu: A faxa a xa yunubie nan ma fe ra, naxee nu bara Alatala raxɔnɔ. A nu bara bira Yerobowami xa kira fɔxɔ ra, a a niya Isirayila ɲama fan xa yunubi raba.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Zimri, and the secret design he made, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?
sentences.susu: Simiri xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ nun a xa yanfanteya sɛbɛxi Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: Then there was a division among the people of Israel; half the people were for making Tibni, son of Ginath, king, and half were supporting Omri.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isirayila ɲama sɛɛti nu wama Ginati xa di Tibini tife mangɛ ra, boore sɛɛti nu wama Omiri nan xɔn.

sentences.english: But the supporters of Omri overcame those who were on the side of Tibni, the son of Ginath; and death came to Tibni and to his brother Joram at that time: and Omri became king in the place of Tibni.
sentences.susu: Ɲama sɛɛti naxan nu na Omiri fɔxɔ ra, nee naxa nɔ Ginati xa di Tibini xa ɲama ra. E naxa Tibini faxa, e Omiri ti mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: In the thirty-first year of Asa, king of Judah, Omri became king over Israel, and he was king for twelve years; for six years he was ruling in Tirzah.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Asa xa mangɛya ɲɛ tongo saxan nun keren nde ra, Omiri naxa findi Isirayila mangɛ ra, a bu na kui ɲɛ fu nun firin. A to gɛ ɲɛ senni rabade Tirisa,

sentences.english: He got the hill Samaria from Shemer for the price of two talents of silver, and he made a town there, building it on the hill and naming it Samaria, after Shemer the owner of the hill.
sentences.susu: a naxa Samari geya sara Semeri ma gbeti kilo tongo solofere ra. A naxa taa ti naa fari, a na taa xili sa Samari, barima na geya kanyi nu xili nɛ Semeri.

sentences.english: And Omri did evil in the eyes of the Lord, even worse than all those before him,
sentences.susu: Omiri nu fe ɲaaxie rabama, naxee mu rafan Alatala ma. A xa fe ɲaaxie nu dangi Isirayila mangɛ singee gbee ra.

sentences.english: Copying all the evil ways of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, and all the sins he did and made Israel do, moving the Lord, the God of Israel, to wrath by their foolish ways.
sentences.susu: A Nebati xa di Yerobowami fɔxi birin naba nɛ, a a niya Isirayila ɲama fan xa e Marigi Alatala raxɔnɔ e xa fe fufafue ra.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts which Omri did, and his great power, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?
sentences.susu: Omiri xa taruxui, nun a xa gere ki fanyi, na birin sɛbɛxi Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: So Omri went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth in Samaria; and Ahab his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Omiri naxa laaxira, a ragata a benbae sɛɛti ma Samari. A xa di Akabu naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: In the thirty-eighth year that Asa was king of Judah, Ahab, the son of Omri, became king over Israel; and Ahab was king in Samaria for twenty-two years.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Asa xa mangɛya ɲɛ tongo saxan nun solomasaxan nde ra, Omiri xa di naxa findi Isirayila mangɛ ra. A bu nɛ mangɛya kui Isirayila xun ma Samari ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin.

sentences.english: And Ahab, the son of Omri, did evil in the eyes of the Lord, even worse than all who went before him.
sentences.susu: Akabu naxa fe ɲaaxie raba, naxee mu rafan Alatala ma, dangi mangɛ singee ra.

sentences.english: And as if copying the evil ways of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, was a small thing for him, he took as his wife Jezebel, daughter of Ethbaal, king of Zidon, and became a servant and worshipper of Baal.
sentences.susu: Bafe Nebati xa di Yerobowami xa yunubi ra, a naxa Sidɔn mangɛ Etibaali xa di Yesabela fan tongo ginɛ ra, a fa na xa kuye Bali batu, a a xinbi sin na bun ma.

sentences.english: And he put up an altar for Baal in the house of Baal which he had made in Samaria.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan Bali kuye bɛ Bali xa banxi kui, naxan nu tixi Samari.

sentences.english: And Ahab made an image of Asherah and did more than all the kings of Israel before him to make the Lord, the God of Israel, angry.
sentences.susu: Akabu naxa Aseri wuri masolixie fan yailan, naxee nu xili Asera. Akabu naxa Alatala raxɔnɔ na fe mɔɔlie ra, dangife Isirayila mangɛ singee ra.

sentences.english: In his days Hiel made Jericho; he put its base in position at the price of Abiram, his oldest son, and he put its doors in place at the price of his youngest son Segub; even as the Lord had said by Joshua, the son of Nun.
sentences.susu: A xa waxati, Xiyeli Betelika naxa gbilen Yeriko taa ti ra. A naa ti fɔlɔ a xa di singe Abirami sare nan na, a wali raɲɔn naadɛe tife nan ma a xa di Segubu sare ra, alɔ Alatala nu bara a masen ki naxɛ Nunu xa di Annabi Yosuwe saabui ra.

sentences.english: And Elijah the Tishbite, of Tishbe in Gilead, said to Ahab, By the living Lord, the God of Israel, whose servant I am, there will be no dew or rain in these years, but only at my word.
sentences.susu: Eliya Tisibeka, naxan findi Galadi bɔxi mixi nde ra naxa a fala mangɛ Akabu bɛ, «N xa a fala i bɛ Isirayila Marigi Alatala xili ra, n naxan nabatuma, toofare tunɛ nun xini yo mu fama, fo n Ala maxandi.»

sentences.english: Then the word of the Lord came to him, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala yi nan masen Annabi Eliya bɛ,

sentences.english: Go from here in the direction of the east, and keep yourself in a secret place by the stream Cherith, east of Jordan.
sentences.susu: a naxɛ, «Keli be, i xa siga sogetede biri ra, i sa i nɔxun Keriti xure yire.

sentences.english: The water of the stream will be your drink, and by my orders the ravens will give you food there.
sentences.susu: I xure ye nan minma, n donse rasanbama nɛ i ma xaxae saabui ra.»

sentences.english: So he went and did as the Lord said, living by the stream Cherith, east of Jordan.
sentences.susu: A naxa siga, a a raba alɔ Alatala a fala a bɛ ki naxɛ, a sa sabati Keriti xure yire Yurudɛn sogetede biri.

sentences.english: And the ravens took him bread in the morning and meat in the evening; and the water of the stream was his drink.
sentences.susu: Xaxae nu fama taami nun sube ra a xɔn ma gɛɛsɛgɛ nun nunmare. A nu xure ye nan minma.

sentences.english: Now after a time the stream became dry, because there was no rain in the land.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ tɛmui nde to dangi, na xure naxa xɔri, barima tunɛ mu nu fama na bɔxi ma na waxati.

sentences.english: Then the word of the Lord came to him, saying,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Up! go now to Zarephath, in Zidon, and make your living-place there; I have given orders to a widow woman there to see that you have food.
sentences.susu: «Keli, i xa siga Sarepeta naxan na Sidɔn bɔxi ma. I xa lu naa. N bara yaamari fi kaaɲɛ ginɛ nde ma, a xa i balo.»

sentences.english: So he got up and went to Zarephath; and when he came to the door of the town, he saw a widow woman getting sticks together; and crying out to her he said, Will you give me a little water in a vessel for my drink?
sentences.susu: A naxa keli, a siga Sarepeta. A to so na taa kui, a naxa kaaɲɛ ginɛ nde to, a yege matongofe. A naxa na ginɛ xili, a a fala a bɛ, «Yandi, n ki ye ra n xa a min.»

sentences.english: And when she was going to get it, he said to her, And get me with it a small bit of bread.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ to nu sigafe ye fɔxɔ ra a bɛ, a man naxa a xili, a a fala a bɛ, «Yandi, i xa fa taami xuntunyi fan na n bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then she said, By the life of the Lord your God, I have nothing but a little meal in my store, and a drop of oil in the bottle; and now I am getting two sticks together so that I may go in and make it ready for me and my son, so that we may have a meal before our death.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a yaabi, «N xa a fala i bɛ i Marigi Alatala xili ra, taami yo mu na n yi ra, fo farin pɔɔti ya keren, a nun ture dondoronti kundi kui. N na yege di matongofe na nan ma, n xa sa na yailan n tan nun n ma di bɛ. Muxu na gɛ na donde, muxu fama faxade nɛ.»

sentences.english: And Elijah said to her, Have no fear; go and do as you have said, but first make me a little cake of it and come and give it to me, and then make something for yourself and your son.
sentences.susu: Eliya naxa a fala a bɛ, «Hali i mu gaaxu, sa a raba alɔ n a falaxi i bɛ ki naxɛ. Kɔnɔ i naxan nabama, i xa n ma taami nan singe yailan, i fa a ra. Na dangi xanbi, i xa i gbe nun i xa di gbe yailan.

sentences.english: For this is the word of the Lord, the God of Israel: The store of meal will not come to an end, and the bottle will never be without oil, till the day when the Lord sends rain on the earth.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Alatala a masen nɛ, ‹Farin mu ɲɔnma pɔɔti kui, ture mu ɲɔnma kundi kui, beenun Alatala tunɛ rafama bɔxi ma tɛmui naxɛ.›»

sentences.english: So she went and did as Elijah said; and she and he and her family had food for a long time.
sentences.susu: Na kui ginɛ naxa siga, a a raba alɔ Alatala a yamarixi ki naxɛ Annabi Eliya saabui ra. Na waxati bun ma baloe nu na a tan, a xa di, nun Annabi Eliya yi.

sentences.english: The store of meal did not come to an end, and the bottle was never without oil, as the Lord had said by the mouth of Elijah.
sentences.susu: Farin mu nu ɲɔnma pɔɔti kui, ture mu nu ɲɔnma kundi kui alɔ Alatala a masen ki naxɛ Annabi Eliya saabui ra.

sentences.english: Now after this, the son of the woman of the house became ill, so ill that there was no breath in him.
sentences.susu: Na fee to dangi, na kaaɲɛ ginɛ xa di naxa fura. Na fure sɛnbɛ naxa gbo, han a ɲɛngi naxa ɲɔn a fate i.

sentences.english: And she said to Elijah, What have I to do with you, O man of God? have you come to put God in mind of my sin, and to put my son to death?
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a fala Annabi Eliya bɛ, «Munse na won tagi, i tan Ala xa mixi? I faxi nɛ n xɔnyi i xa fa n natu n ma yunubie ra, i man xa n ma di faxa?»

sentences.english: And he said to her, Give your son to me. And lifting him out of her arms, he took him up to his room and put him down on his bed.
sentences.susu: Eliya naxa a yaabi, «I xa di so n yi ra.» A naxa dimɛdi tongo a nga yi ra, a a xanin a xa konkoe kui naxan nu na banxi kui koore kɔn na. A to a sa sade ma,

sentences.english: And crying to the Lord he said, O Lord my God, have you sent evil even on the widow whose guest I am, by causing her son's death?
sentences.susu: a naxa Alatala maxandi a bɛ, a naxɛ, «N Marigi Alatala, i wama n yatigi kaaɲɛ ginɛ tɔɔrɔfe yi ki nɛ, a xa di xa faxa?»

sentences.english: And stretching herself out on the child three times, he made his prayer to the Lord, saying, O Lord my God, be pleased to let this child's life come back to him again.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yɛtɛ itala dimɛdi fate fari sanya saxan, a Alatala maxandima a falafe ra, «N Marigi Alatala, n bara i maxandi, i xa yi di ɲɛngi ragbilen a fate i.»

sentences.english: And the Lord gave ear to the voice of Elijah, and the child's spirit came into him again, and he came back to life.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Annabi Eliya xa maxandi suxu, dimɛdi ɲɛngi naxa gbilen a fate i.

sentences.english: And Elijah took the child down from his room into the house and gave him to his mother and said to her, See, your son is living.
sentences.susu: Eliya naxa a tongo, a goro a ra a nga xɔn, a a fala a bɛ, «I xa di mato, a kisixi.»

sentences.english: Then the woman said to Elijah, Now I am certain that you are a man of God, and that the word of the Lord in your mouth is true.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a fala Eliya bɛ, «Yakɔsi n bara a kolon a Ala xa mixi nan i ra, naxan Alatala xa masenyi tinxinxi masenma.»

sentences.english: Now after a long time, the word of the Lord came to Elijah, in the third year, saying, Go and let Ahab see you, so that I may send rain on the earth.
sentences.susu: Tɛmui xɔn to kuya, Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Eliya bɛ a ɲɛ saxan nde ra, a naxɛ, «Siga Akabu yire, n tunɛ rafama nɛ bɔxi ma fa.»

sentences.english: So Elijah went to let Ahab see him. Now there was no food to be had in Samaria.
sentences.susu: Eliya naxa siga Akabu yire.

sentences.english: And Ahab sent for Obadiah, the controller of the king's house. (Now Obadiah had the fear of the Lord before him greatly;
sentences.susu: Kaamɛ nu bara sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ Samari bɔxi ma. Akabu naxa Abadiyasi xili, naxan nu walima mangɛ banxi kui. A nu gaaxuma Alatala ya ra ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: For when Jezebel was cutting off the prophets of the Lord, Obadiah took a hundred of them, and kept them secretly in a hole in the rock, fifty at a time, and gave them bread and water.)
sentences.susu: Yesabela nu Alatala xa namiɲɔnmɛe faxama tɛmui naxɛ, Abadiyasi namiɲɔnmɛ kɛmɛ tongo nɛ, a sa e nɔxun mixi tongo suuli suuli ma fɔnmɛ firin kui, a e balo ye nun taami ra.

sentences.english: And Ahab said to Obadiah, Come, let us go through all the country, to all the fountains of water and all the rivers, and see if there is any grass to be had for the horses and the transport beasts, so that we may be able to keep some of the beasts from destruction.
sentences.susu: Akabu naxa a fala Abadiyasi bɛ, a naxɛ, «I xa bɔxi birin isa mɛrɛ fende won ma soee nun won ma sofalee nɔma ɲooge sɔtɔde dɛnnaxɛ, alako e naxa faxa.»

sentences.english: So they went through all the country, covering it between them; Ahab went in one direction by himself, and Obadiah went in another by himself.
sentences.susu: Akabu nun Abadiyasi naxa bɔxi itaxun e bore ma, e xa a isa. Akabu naxa siga kira nde xɔn, Abadiyasi naxa siga kira gbɛtɛ xɔn.

sentences.english: And while Obadiah was on his way, he came face to face with Elijah; and seeing who it was, he went down on his face and said, Is it you, my lord Elijah?
sentences.susu: Abadiyasi naxa naralan Annabi Eliya ra kira xɔn. Abadiyasi to a to, a naxa a felen a bun ma, a a fala a bɛ, «N marigi Eliya, i tan yati nan a ra?»

sentences.english: And Elijah in answer said, It is I; now go and say to your lord, Elijah is here.
sentences.susu: Eliya naxa a yaabi, «Iyo, n tan nan a ra. Sa a fala i xa mangɛ bɛ, i bara Annabi Eliya to.»

sentences.english: And he said, What sin have I done, that you would give up your servant into the hand of Ahab, and be the cause of my death?
sentences.susu: Abadiyasi naxa a fala, «N haakɛ mundun nabaxi i ra naxan a niyama i xa yi mɔɔli raba n na? Yi findima faxɛ nan na n bɛ Akabu mabiri.

sentences.english: By the life of the Lord your God, there is not a nation or kingdom where my lord has not sent in search of you; and when they said, He is not here; he made them take an oath that they had not seen you.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala i bɛ i Marigi Alatala xili ra, ɲamanɛ nun bɔxi yo mu na, n ma mangɛ mu i fenxi dɛnnaxɛ. Mɛnnikae na a fala i mu na, Akabu e rakalima xa e mu i toxi.

sentences.english: And now you say, Go, say to your lord, Elijah is here.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi i naxɛ, ‹Sa a fala mangɛ bɛ i bara Annabi Eliya to.›

sentences.english: And straight away, when I have gone from you, the spirit of the Lord will take you away, I have no idea where, so that when I come and give word to Ahab, and he sees you not, he will put me to death: though I, your servant, have been a worshipper of the Lord from my earliest years.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n na keli i xun ma ya, Alatala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi fama i xaninde yire nde. Na kui, n na gɛ xɛɛra ibade Akabu bɛ, a lima muxu mu i toma be sɔnɔn, a fa n faxa na ma. N tan bara gaaxu Alatala ya ra kabi n dimɛdi tɛmui.

sentences.english: Has my lord not had word of what I did when Jezebel was putting the Lord's prophets to death? how I kept a hundred of them in a secret hole in the rock, fifty at a time, and gave them bread and water?
sentences.susu: N marigi, e mu a falaxi i bɛ, n naxan naba Yesabela nu Alatala xa namiɲɔnmɛe faxama tɛmui naxɛ? N Alatala xa namiɲɔnmɛ kɛmɛ nan nɔxun fɔnmɛ kui tongo suuli suuli ma. N nu fa e balo taami nun ye ra.

sentences.english: And now you say, Go and say to your Lord, Elijah is here; and he will put me to death.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi, xa i n xɛɛ n ma mangɛ xɔn ma, n xa a fala a bɛ n bara Annabi Eliya to, a n faxama nɛ!»

sentences.english: And Elijah said, By the life of the Lord of armies, whose servant I am, I will certainly let him see me today.
sentences.susu: Annabi Eliya naxa a yaabi, «N bara n kali n Marigi Alatala ra, to n nan n yɛtɛ masenma nɛ Akabu bɛ.»

sentences.english: So Obadiah went to Ahab and gave him the news; and Ahab went to see Elijah.
sentences.susu: Abadiyasi naxa siga Akabu yire, a fa dɛntɛgɛ sa a bɛ. Akabu naxa siga Eliya fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And when he saw Elijah, Ahab said to him, Is it you, you troubler of Israel?
sentences.susu: A to sa Eliya to, Akabu naxa a fala a bɛ, «I tan nan Isirayila ya isoxi yi ki?»

sentences.english: Then he said in answer, I have not been troubling Israel, but you and your family; because, turning away from the orders of the Lord, you have gone after the Baals.
sentences.susu: Annabi Eliya naxa a yaabi, «N tan xa mu Isirayila ya isoxi. I tan nun i baba bɔnsɔɛ nan Isirayila ya isoxi, barima wo bara Alatala xa yaamarie rabolo, i bira Bali kuye fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Now send, and get Israel together before me at Mount Carmel, with the four hundred and fifty prophets of Baal who get their food at Jezebel's table.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, i xa Isirayila ɲama birin malan Karemele geya ma, a nun wo xa Bali kuye xa namiɲɔnmɛ kɛmɛ naani tongo suulie, a nun Asera kuye xa namiɲɔnmɛ kɛmɛ naanie, i xa ginɛ Yesabela naxee rabaloma.»

sentences.english: So Ahab sent for all the children of Israel, and got the prophets together at Mount Carmel.
sentences.susu: Akabu naxa mixie xɛɛ Isirayilakae xilide. A naxa na namiɲɔnmɛe malan Karemele geya fari.

sentences.english: And Elijah came near to all the people and said, How long will you go on balancing between two opinions? if the Lord is God, then give worship to him; but if Baal, give worship to him. And the people said not a word in answer.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Eliya naxa a maso ɲama birin na, a fa yi masenyi ti e bɛ, «Wo tan luma filankafuiɲa kui han mun tɛmui? Xa Alatala nan Ala ra, wo bira a fɔxɔ ra. Xa Bali nan Ala ra, wo bira a tan Bali fɔxɔ ra.» Ɲama mu a yaabi.

sentences.english: Then Elijah said to the people, I, even I, am the only living prophet of the Lord; but Baal's prophets are four hundred and fifty men.
sentences.susu: Annabi Eliya man naxa a fala e bɛ, «N keren nan be Alatala xa namiɲɔnmɛ ra. Bali xa namiɲɔnmɛe mixi kɛmɛ naani tongo suuli na be.

sentences.english: Now, let them give us two oxen; and let them take one for themselves, and have it cut up, and put it on the wood, but put no fire under it; I will get the other ox ready, and put it on the wood, and put no fire under it.
sentences.susu: Wo xa tuura firin so muxu yi ra. Bali namiɲɔnmɛe xa e gbe sugandi, e xa a ibolon, e a sa yege fari, kɔnɔ tɛ mu dɔxɔma a ra. N tan fan xa tuura boore ibolon, n a sa yege gbɛtɛ fari, n fan mu tɛ dɔxɔma a ra.

sentences.english: And do you make prayers to your god, and I will make a prayer to the Lord: and it will be clear that the one who gives an answer by fire is God. And all the people in answer said, It is well said.
sentences.susu: Muxu na gɛ na rabade, Bali namiɲɔnmɛe xa wo marigi ala maxandi. N tan fan xa Alatala maxandi. Ala naxan na tɛ ragoro sɛrɛxɛ ma, na nan findima ɲama birin Marigi Ala ra.» Ɲama birin naxa tin na fe ra.

sentences.english: Then Elijah said to the prophets of Baal, Take one ox for yourselves and get it ready first, for there are more of you; and make your prayers to your god, but put no fire under.
sentences.susu: Eliya naxa a fala Bali xa namiɲɔnmɛe bɛ, «Wo tuura keren sugandi, wo singe xa a ibolon, barima wo tan nan gbo. Wo wo marigi ala maxandi, kɔnɔ wo naxa tɛ sa.»

sentences.english: So they took the ox which was given them, and made it ready, crying out to Baal from morning till the middle of the day, and saying, O Baal, give ear to us. But there was no voice and no answer. And they were jumping up and down before the altar they had made.
sentences.susu: E naxa tuura keren tongo, e a ibolon, e a sa yege fari, e fa Bali maxandi fɔlɔ. Keli gɛɛsɛgɛ ma, han yanyi tagi, e a falama, «Bali, muxu yaabi.» Kɔnɔ yaabi yo mu fa, xui nde yo mu mɛ. E naxa tugan tugan fɔlɔ e xa sɛrɛxɛbade ya i.

sentences.english: And in the middle of the day, Elijah made sport of them, saying, Give louder cries, for he is a god; he may be deep in thought, or he may have gone away for some purpose, or he may be on a journey, or by chance he is sleeping and has to be made awake.
sentences.susu: Yanyi tagi to a li, Annabi Eliya naxa yo e ma, a falafe ra, «Wo wo xui ite de, barima a to findixi ala ra, fee wuya a yi. Tɛmunde a na biyaasi kui, xa na mu a ra a na xife. Wo xa a raxunu.»

sentences.english: So they gave loud cries, cutting themselves with knives and swords, as was their way, till the blood came streaming out all over them.
sentences.susu: E man naxa e xui ite sɛnbɛ ra. E naxa e fate maxaba santidɛgɛmae nun tanbɛe ra, han e wuli mini.

sentences.english: And from the middle of the day they went on with their prayers till the time of the offering; but there was no voice, or any answer, or any who gave attention to them.
sentences.susu: Yanyi to dangi, e naxa Bali kuye maxandi a namiɲɔnmɛ daaxi han nunmare sɛrɛxɛ ba tɛmui. Kɔnɔ yaabi yo mu fa, xui nde yo mu mɛ, tɔnxuma nde yo mu to.

sentences.english: Then Elijah said to all the people, Come near to me; and all the people came near. And he put up again the altar of the Lord which had been broken down.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Annabi Eliya naxa a fala ɲama bɛ, a naxɛ, «Wo wo maso n na.» Ɲama to na raba, Eliya naxa Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan, naxan nu bara kana mɛnni tɛmui dangixi.

sentences.english: And Elijah took twelve stones, the number of the tribes of the sons of Jacob, to whom the Lord had said, Israel will be your name:
sentences.susu: Eliya naxa gɛmɛ fu nun firin tongo, naxan lanxi Yaxuba xa die kɔnti ma, Alatala a masen naxan bɛ, «I xili falama nɛ Isirayila.»

sentences.english: And with the stones he made an altar to the name of the Lord; and he made a deep drain all round the altar, great enough to take two measures of seed.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan na gɛmɛ fu nun firinyi ra Alatala xili ra. A naxa fole ge na sɛrɛxɛbade rabilinyi, ye konbo ya naani nɔma naxan nafede.

sentences.english: And he put the wood in order, and, cutting up the ox, put it on the wood. Then he said, Get four vessels full of water and put it on the burned offering and on the wood. And he said, Do it a second time, and they did it a second time;
sentences.susu: A naxa yege sa na fari, a tuura ibolon, a na sa na yege fari.

sentences.english: And he said, Do it a third time, and they did it a third time.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ na ra, a naxa mixie yamari, «Wo yi fɛɲɛ naani rafe ye ra, wo a ifili yi yege nun yi sɛrɛxɛ ma.» E to gɛ na rabade, a man naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo man xa a raba.» E to a raba a firin nde, Eliya man naxa a fala, «Wo man xa ye sa.» E naxa a raba a saxan nde.

sentences.english: And the water went all round the altar, till the drain was full.
sentences.susu: Ye nu sɔli sɛrɛxɛbade ra, fole fa rafe ye ra.

sentences.english: Then at the time of the offering, Elijah the prophet came near and said, O Lord, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, let it be seen this day that you are God in Israel, and that I am your servant, and that I have done all these things by your order.
sentences.susu: Nunmare sɛrɛxɛ ba tɛmui, Annabi Eliya naxa a maso sɛrɛxɛbade ra, a a fala, «Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Isirayila Marigi Alatala, birin xa a kolon to a i tan nan na Ala ra Isirayila. Birin xa a kolon a n tan nan na i xa konyi ra, naxan yi fe birin nabaxi i xui ma!

sentences.english: Give me an answer, O Lord, give me an answer, so that this people may see that you are God, and that you have made their hearts come back again.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa n ma maxandi suxu. Yandi, i xa a suxu, alako yi ɲama xa a kolon a i tan Alatala nan na Ala ra, naxan nɔma e bɔɲɛ ragbilende i ma.»

sentences.english: Then the fire of the Lord came down, burning up the offering and the wood and the stones and the dust, and drinking up the water in the drain.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala naxa tɛ ragoro, a sɛrɛxɛ gan, a yege gan, hali gɛmɛe nun bɔxi gan nɛ. Ye naxan nu fole kui, a birin naxa xara feo.

sentences.english: And when the people saw it, they all went down on their faces, and said, The Lord, he is God, the Lord, he is God.
sentences.susu: Ɲama to na to, e naxa e yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma, e fa a fala, «Alatala nan Ala ra! Alatala nan Ala ra!»

sentences.english: And Elijah said to them, Take the prophets of Baal, let not one of them get away. So they took them, and Elijah made them go down to the stream Kishon, and put them to death there.
sentences.susu: Annabi Eliya naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo Bali xa namiɲɔnmɛe suxu. A keren naxa a gi.» Ɲama naxa e suxu, Eliya naxa e xanin Kison xure yire, a e birin kɔn naxaba.

sentences.english: Then Elijah said to Ahab, Up! take food and drink, for there is a sound of much rain.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Eliya naxa a fala Akabu bɛ, «Siga i xɔnyi. I xa i dɛge, i xa i min, barima na xui i naxan mɛxi yi ki na fama tunɛ nan na.»

sentences.english: So Ahab went up to have food and drink, while Elijah went up to the top of Carmel; and he went down on the earth, putting his face between his knees.
sentences.susu: Akabu naxa te a xɔnyi a dɛgede nun a minde, kɔnɔ Annabi Eliya tan naxa te Karemele geya fari, a fa a felen bɔxi ma, a yatagi fa lu a sanyie tagi.

sentences.english: And he said to his servant, Go now, and take a look in the direction of the sea. And he went up, and after looking said, There is nothing. And he said, Go again seven times; and he went seven times.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a xa konyi bɛ, «Te yire itexi, i xa baa mabiri mato.» Konyi to te naa, a naxa baa mato, a mu sese gbɛtɛ to. Eliya naxa a ragbilen na yire itexi sanya solofere baa matode.

sentences.english: And the seventh time he said, I see a cloud coming up out of the sea, as small as a man's hand. Then he said, Go up and say to Ahab, Get your carriage ready and go down or the rain will keep you back.
sentences.susu: A sanya solofere nde, konyi naxa a fala, «Nuxui di nan tefe baa xun ma. A nun bɛlɛxɛ mɔndɛ lan.» Eliya naxa a fala a bɛ, «Siga, i xa sa a fala Akabu bɛ, a xa baki a xa sɔɔri ragise kui, a xa goro geya fari mafuren mafuren alako a naxa biri boora. Tunɛ na fafe!»

sentences.english: And after a very little time, the heaven became black with clouds and wind, and there was a great rain. And Ahab went in his carriage to Jezreel.
sentences.susu: Nuxuie naxa koore birin ifɔɔrɔ, foye naxa keli, tunɛ belebele naxa sin bɔxi ma. Akabu naxa te a xa sɔɔri ragise kui, a siga Yisireeli.

sentences.english: And the hand of the Lord was on Elijah; and he made himself strong, and went running before Ahab till they came to Jezreel.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa sɛnbɛ fi Eliya ma, a fa a gi a sanyi ra, a dangi Akabu ya ra han Yisireeli sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: Ahab gave Jezebel news of all Elijah had done, and how he had put all the prophets to death with the sword.
sentences.susu: Akabu naxa sa dɛntɛgɛ sa Yesabela bɛ, Eliya naxan birin nabaxi, a a xa namiɲɔnmɛe faxaxi santidɛgɛma ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then Jezebel sent a servant to Elijah, saying, May the gods' punishment be on me if I do not make your life like the life of one of them by tomorrow about this time.
sentences.susu: Yesabela naxa xɛɛra xɛɛ Eliya ma, a a fala a bɛ, «Xa n lu mu i faxa beenun tina yi waxati alɔ i n ma namiɲɔnmɛe faxa ki naxɛ, alae xa n danka.»

sentences.english: And he got up, fearing for his life, and went in flight, and came to Beer-sheba in Judah, parting there from his servant;
sentences.susu: Annabi Eliya to na mɛ, a naxa a gi a xa a nii ratanga. A naxa so Beriseeba Yudaya bɔxi ma, a naxa a xa konyi lu mɛnni.

sentences.english: While he himself went a day's journey into the waste land, and took a seat under a broom-plant, desiring for himself only death; for he said, It is enough: now, O Lord, take away my life, for I am no better than my fathers.
sentences.susu: A tan naxa siga gbengberenyi ma a fɛɛɲɛn keren ɲɛrɛ raba, a dɔxɔ wuri nde bun ma, a Ala maxandi faxɛ ra. A naxɛ, «Alatala, n ma tɔɔrɛ bara dangi a i. N nii tongo, barima n mu fisa n benbae bɛ.»

sentences.english: And stretching himself on the earth, he went to sleep under the broom-plant; but an angel, touching him, said to him, Get up and have some food.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a naxa a sa, a xi na wuri bun ma. Malekɛ nde naxa goro a ma, a din a ra, a a fala a bɛ, «Keli i xa i dɛge.»

sentences.english: And looking up, he saw by his head a cake cooked on the stones and a bottle of water. So he took food and drink and went to sleep again.
sentences.susu: Taami ɲinxi nu na mɛnni gɛmɛ furee fari, a nun ye fɛɲɛ. A naxa a dɛge, a ye min, a man naxa a sa.

sentences.english: And the angel of the Lord came again a second time, and touching him said, Get up and have some food, or the journey will be overmuch for your strength.
sentences.susu: Ala xa malekɛ naxa fa a ma a firin nde, a din a ra, a a fala a bɛ, «Keli i xa i dɛge, barima biyaasi xɔnkuye na i ya ra.»

sentences.english: So he got up and took food and drink, and in the strength of that food he went on for forty days and nights, to Horeb, the mountain of God.
sentences.susu: A naxa keli, a a dɛge, a ye min. A sɛnbɛ naxan sɔtɔ na donsee ra, na naxa a niya a xa nɔ a ɲɛrɛde xi tongo naani, kɔɛ tongo naani bun ma, han a Ala xa Xorebe geya li.

sentences.english: And there he went into a hole in the rock for the night; then the word of the Lord came to him, saying, What are you doing here, Elijah?
sentences.susu: Mɛnni a naxa kɔɛ radangi fɔnmɛ nde kui. Na tɛmui a naxa yi masenyi mɛ: «I na munse rabafe be Eliya?»

sentences.english: And he said, I have been burning for the honour of the Lord, the God of armies; for the children of Israel have not kept your agreement; they have made destruction of your altars, and have put your prophets to death with the sword: till I, even I, am the only one living; and now they are attempting to take away my life.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi. «N bara n yɛtɛ fi i tan Alatala Sɛnbɛma ma. Isirayilakae bara i xa saatɛ rabolo, e bara i xa sɛrɛxɛbadee kana, e bara i xa namiɲɔnmɛe faxa santidɛgɛma ra. N keren nan fa luxi, e na katafe n fan faxade.»

sentences.english: Then he said, Go out and take your place on the mountain before the Lord. Then the Lord went by, and mountains were parted by the force of a great wind, and rocks were broken before the Lord; but the Lord was not in the wind. And after the wind there was an earth-shock, but the Lord was not in the earth-shock.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «Mini tande Alatala ya i, i keli fɔnmɛ kui.» A to mini, Alatala naxa dangi a ya i. Foye xungbe sɛnbɛma nde naxa a xun sa geya ma, a gɛmɛe ibɔɔma, a fanyee ibutuxunma, kɔnɔ Alatala mu nu na na foye kui. Na tɛmui bɔxi fan naxa sɛrɛn, kɔnɔ Alatala mu nu na na bɔxi sɛrɛnyi kui.

sentences.english: And after the earth-shock a fire, but the Lord was not in the fire. And after the fire, the sound of a soft breath.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, tɛ fan naxa mini, kɔnɔ Alatala mu nu na na tɛ xɔɔra. Na to ba a ra, xui ɲɔxunmɛ nde naxa mini dɔyi dɔyi ra.

sentences.english: And Elijah, hearing it, went out, covering his face with his robe, and took his place in the opening of the hole. And there a voice came to him saying, What are you doing here, Elijah?
sentences.susu: Annabi Eliya to na mɛ, a naxa a yatagi makoto a xa donma ra, a naxa mini fɔnmɛ kui, a ti fɔnmɛ dɛ ra. A mu bu, xui nde naxa mini a ma, a naxɛ, «I na munse rabafe be Eliya?»

sentences.english: And he said, I have been burning for the honour of the Lord, the God of armies; for the children of Israel have not kept your agreement; they have had your altars broken down, and have put your prophets to death with the sword: till I, even I, am the only one living; and now they are attempting to take away my life.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «N bara n yɛtɛ fi i tan Alatala Sɛnbɛma ma. Isirayilakae bara i xa saatɛ rabolo, e bara i xa sɛrɛxɛbadee kana, e bara i xa namiɲɔnmɛe faxa santidɛgɛma ra. N keren nan fa luxi, e na katafe n fan faxade.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to him, Go back on your way through the waste land to Damascus; and when you come there, put the holy oil on Hazael to make him king over Aram;
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «I xa gbilen gbengberenyi kira xɔn ma sigafe ra Damasi. I na so naa, i xa ture sɛniyɛnxi sa Xasayeli xunyi a masenfe ra, a xa findi Arami mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And on Jehu, son of Nimshi, making him king over Israel; and on Elisha, the son of Shaphat of Abel-meholah, to be prophet in your place.
sentences.susu: I xa ture sɛniyɛnxi sa Nimisi xa di Yehu fan ma, a xa findi Isirayila mangɛ ra. Na dangi xanbi i xa ture sa Elise xunyi, Safati xa di, Abeli Mexolaka xa mamadi, a tan xa findi namiɲɔnmɛ ra i ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And it will come about that the man who gets away safe from the sword of Hazael, Jehu will put to death; and whoever gets away safe from the sword of Jehu, Elisha will put to death.
sentences.susu: Naxan na tanga Xasayeli xa santidɛgɛma ma, Yehu a faxama nɛ. Xa naxan tanga Yehu xa santidɛgɛma ma, Elise a faxama nɛ.

sentences.english: But I will keep safe seven thousand in Israel, all those whose knees have not been bent to Baal, and whose mouths have given him no kisses.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n mixi wulu solofere luma nɛ Isirayila, naxee mu suyidixi Bali kuye bɛ, e dɛ mu a sunbuxi.»

sentences.english: So he went away from there and came across Elisha, the son of Shaphat, ploughing with twelve yoke of oxen, he himself walking with the twelfth; and Elijah went up to him and put his robe on him.
sentences.susu: Eliya naxa keli mɛnni, a sa Safati xa di Elise li, a na bɔxi buxafe. Ninge mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nan nu ɲɛrɛfe a ya ra, a nu firinyi nan nawalife e xanbi ra. Eliya naxa dangi a fɛ ma, a naxa a xa donma woli a ma.

sentences.english: And letting the oxen be where they were, he came running after Elijah, and said, Only let me give a kiss to my father and mother, and then I will come after you. But he said to him, Go back again; for what have I done to you?
sentences.susu: Elise naxa a xa ningee rabolo, a a gi Eliya fɔxɔ ra, a a fala a bɛ, «Yandi, i xa diɲɛ n xa sa n ɲungu nga nun n baba ma. Na tɛmui n birama nɛ i fɔxɔ ra.» Eliya naxa a fala a bɛ, «Gbilen i xa wali ra. I munse mɛxi n na?»

sentences.english: And he went back, and took the oxen and put them to death, and cooking their flesh with the yokes of the oxen, he gave the people a feast. Then he got up and went after Elijah and became his servant.
sentences.susu: A to a makuya Eliya ra, a naxa ninge firin tongo, a e ba sɛrɛxɛ ra. A naxa wurie findi yege ra e nu maxirixi naxee ra, a sube ɲin ɲama bɛ. Na dangi xanbi, a naxa bira Annabi Eliya fɔxɔ ra, a findi a xa batula ra.

sentences.english: Now Ben-hadad, king of Aram, got all his army together, and thirty-two kings with him, and horses and carriages of war; he went up and made war on Samaria, shutting it in.
sentences.susu: Arami mangɛ Ben Hadada naxa a xa sɔɔrie birin malan. Mangɛ tongo saxan nun firin nan nu e ya ma, soe nun sɔɔri ragisee nu na e yi ra. E naxa Samari rabilin, e fa gere ti e bɛ.

sentences.english: And he sent representatives into the town to Ahab, king of Israel;
sentences.susu: Na kui Ben Hadada naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Isirayila mangɛ Akabu xɔn.

sentences.english: And they said to him, Ben-hadad says, Your silver and your gold are mine; and your wives and children are mine.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a bɛ, «A lanma i xa i xa gbeti, i xa xɛɛma, i xa ginɛ tofanyie, nun i xa die birin findi n gbe ra.»

sentences.english: And the king of Israel sent him an answer saying, As you say, my lord king, I am yours with all I have.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ naxa a yaabi, «Mangɛ, n bara findi i xa konyi ra, n bara n harige birin fi i ma.»

sentences.english: Then the representatives came back again, and said, These are the words of Ben-hadad: I sent to you saying, Give up to me your silver and your gold, your wives and your children;
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi mangɛ naxa xɛɛra gbɛtɛe xɛɛ a falafe ra, «Mangɛ Ben Hadada naxɛ, ‹A lanma i xa i xa gbeti, i xa xɛɛma, i xa ginɛ tofanyie, nun i xa die birin findi n gbe ra.

sentences.english: But I will send my servants to you tomorrow about this time, to make a search through your house and the houses of your people, and everything which is pleasing in your eyes they will take away in their hands.
sentences.susu: Tina yi waxati, n mixie xɛɛma nɛ i xɔnyi, e xa sa i xa banxi kui mato, a nun i xa mixie xa banxie, e xa se birin tongo naxan tide gbo i bɛ.›»

sentences.english: Then the king of Israel sent for all the responsible men of the land, and said, Now will you take note and see the evil purpose of this man: he sent for my wives and my children, my silver and my gold, and I did not keep them back.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ naxa taa kuntigie xili, a a fala e bɛ, «Wo xa a kolon, a yi mixi wama won tɔɔrɔfe nɛ. N nu bara a fala a bɛ a n nan n ma ginɛe, n ma die, n ma xɛɛma, nun n ma gbeti birin fima nɛ a ma. N mu nu tondixi na sese ra.»

sentences.english: And all the responsible men and the people said to him, Do not give attention to him or do what he says.
sentences.susu: Kuntigie nun ɲama birin naxa a yaabi, «I naxa i tuli mati a ra, i naxa a danxun.»

sentences.english: So he said to the representatives of Ben-hadad, Say to my lord the king, All the orders you sent the first time I will do; but this thing I may not do. And the representatives went back with this answer.
sentences.susu: Na kui Akabu naxa a fala Ben Hadada xa xɛɛrae bɛ, «Wo sa a fala won ma mangɛ bɛ a a naxan singe fala, n bara tin na ra, kɔnɔ a naxan saxi na fari, n mu na rabama.» Xɛɛrae naxa gbilen na falade mangɛ Ben Hadada bɛ.

sentences.english: Then Ben-hadad sent to him, saying, May the gods' punishment be on me if there is enough of the dust of Samaria for all the people at my feet to take some in their hands.
sentences.susu: Ben Hadada naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ mangɛ Akabu ma a falafe ra, «Xa n mu Samari xun nakana, sese mu lu yi taa kui fa, mixi nɔma naxan matongode a bɛlɛxɛsole ra, alae xa n danka.»

sentences.english: And the king of Israel said in answer, Say to him, The time for loud talk is not when a man is putting on his arms, but when he is taking them off.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isirayila mangɛ naxa a yaabi, «Sɔɔri naxan na sigafe gere sode, a mu lan a xa a yɛtɛ matɔxɔ, alɔ sɔɔri naxan bara gɛ gere sode.»

sentences.english: Now when this answer was given to Ben-hadad, he was drinking with the kings in the tents, and he said to his men, Take up your positions. So they put themselves in position for attacking the town.
sentences.susu: Ben Hadada to na wɔyɛnyi mɛ, a nu na bere minfe nɛ a nun mangɛ gbɛtɛe e xa leelee bun ma. A naxa a fala a xa sɔɔrie bɛ, «Won xɛɛ gere sode.» Na kui e naxa e ya rafindi Samari taa ma.

sentences.english: Then a prophet came up to Ahab, king of Israel, and said, The Lord says, Have you seen all this great army? See, I will give it into your hands today, and you will see that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui namiɲɔnmɛ nde naxa a maso Isirayila mangɛ Akabu ra, a naxa a masen a bɛ, «Alatala naxɛ, ‹I yi sɔɔri gali to? To yati n e birin sama nɛ i sagoe, alako i xa a kolon a n tan nan na Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: And Ahab said, By whom? And he said, The Lord says, By the servants of the chiefs who are over the divisions of the land. Then he said, By whom is the fighting to be started? And he made answer, By you.
sentences.susu: Akabu naxa a maxɔrin, «A fama na rabade nde saabui ra?» Namiɲɔnmɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «Alatala naxɛ i fama na rabade gominae xa sɛgɛtalae nan saabui ra.» Akabu naxa a maxɔrin, «Nde findima e xa yarerati ra na gere kui?» A naxa a yaabi, «I tan.»

sentences.english: Then he got together the servants of all the chiefs who were over the divisions of the land, two hundred and thirty-two of them; and after them, he got together all the people, all the children of Israel, seven thousand.
sentences.susu: Na kui Akabu naxa gominae xa sɛgɛtalae malan, e findi mixi kɛmɛ firin mixi tongo saxan nun firin na. Isirayila ɲama naxan nu na e xanbi ra, e findi mixi wulu solofere nan na.

sentences.english: And in the middle of the day they went out. But Ben-hadad was drinking in the tents with the thirty-two kings who were helping him.
sentences.susu: E naxa mini gere sode yanyi tagi. A lixi Ben Hadada nun a malima mangɛ tongo saxan nun firin nu na bere minfe e xa leelee bun ma.

sentences.english: And the servants of the chiefs who were over the divisions of the land went forward first; and when Ben-hadad sent out, they gave him the news, saying, Men have come out from Samaria.
sentences.susu: Gominae xa sɛgɛtalae singe naxa mini gere sode. Mixie naxa a fala Ben Hadada bɛ, «Sɔɔrie bara mini Samari taa kui.»

sentences.english: And he said, If they have come out for peace, take them living, and if they have come out for war, take them living.
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «Xa na sɔɔrie fafe lanyi nan fende, xa na mu a ra e wama gere sode, wo xa e suxu kɔnɔ wo naxa e faxa de.»

sentences.english: So the servants of the chiefs of the divisions of the land went out of the town, with the army coming after them.
sentences.susu: Isirayila gominae xa sɛgɛtalae naxa mini, e nun Isirayila sɔɔri ɲama.

sentences.english: And every one of them put his man to death, and the Aramaeans went in flight with Israel after them; and Ben-hadad, king of Aram, got away safely on a horse with his horsemen.
sentences.susu: E to gere so, kankan naxa mixi nde faxa. Aramikae naxa e gi keren na, Isirayilakae fa bira e fɔxɔ ra. Arami mangɛ Ben Hadada fan naxa a gi a xa soe fari, a nun sɔɔri nde naxee nu na sɔɔri ragisee kui.

sentences.english: And the king of Israel went out and took the horses and the war-carriages, and made great destruction among the Aramaeans.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ naxa mini, a Aramikae xa soee faxa, a e xa sɔɔri ragisee kana. Na findi nɛ gbaloe ra Aramikae bɛ.

sentences.english: Then the prophet came up to the king of Israel, and said to him, Now make yourself strong, and take care what you do, or a year from now the king of Aram will come up against you again.
sentences.susu: Na namiɲɔnmɛ man naxa a maso Isirayila mangɛ ra, a a fala a bɛ, «I xa wakili, i xa fee rafala, barima tamuna Arami mangɛ man fama nɛ i gerede.»

sentences.english: Then the king of Aram's servants said to him, Their god is a god of the hills; that is why they were stronger than we: but if we make an attack on them in the lowlands, we will certainly be stronger than they.
sentences.susu: Arami sɔɔrie naxa a fala e xa mangɛ bɛ, «Isirayilakae xa ala sɛnbɛ gbo geya nan fari. Na nan a toxi e won bɔnbɔxi. Xa won sa e gere fili nan ma nu, won nɔma nɛ e ra.

sentences.english: This is what you have to do: take away the kings from their positions, and put captains in their places;
sentences.susu: I naxan nabama, i xa na mangɛe ba naxee na i xa mixie ya ma, i fa gominae ti e ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And get together another army like the one which came to destruction, horse for horse, and carriage for carriage; and let us make war on them in the lowlands, and certainly we will be stronger than they. And he gave ear to what they said, and did so.
sentences.susu: I xa sɔɔri gbɛtɛe fen sɔɔri faxaxie ɲɔxɔɛ ra, i xa soe nun sɔɔri ragisee fen a kanaxie ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Na tɛmui, won man sigama e gerede fili nan ma, won fama nɛ nɔde e ra a fanyi ra.» Mangɛ naxa na birin naba, alɔ e a fala a bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So, a year later, Ben-hadad got the Aramaeans together and went up to Aphek to make war on Israel.
sentences.susu: Na ɲɛ igbilenyi, Ben Hadada naxa a xa sɔɔrie malan, a e xanin Afeki biri ra, e xa Isirayila gere.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel got themselves together, and food was made ready and they went against them; the tents of the children of Israel were like two little flocks of goats before them, but all the country was full of the Aramaeans.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae fan naxa e xa sɔɔrie malan, e fandɛ sɔtɔ, e siga e ralande. Isirayilakae to yonkin Arami ɲama ya i, e lu nɛ alɔ si gɔɔrɛ lanmadi firin Aramikae xa gboe xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And a man of God came up and said to the king of Israel, The Lord says, Because the Aramaeans have said, The Lord is a god of the hills and not of the valleys; I will give all this great army into your hands, and you will see that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ala xa mixi naxa a maso Isirayila mangɛ ra, a a masen a bɛ, «Alatala xui nan yi ki: Aramikae to a fala a Alatala sɛnbɛ gbo geya nan fari a mu findixi ala ra fili tan ma, n e sama nɛ i sagoe, alako i xa a kolon n tan nan Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: Now the two armies kept their positions facing one another for seven days. And on the seventh day the fight was started; and the children of Israel put to the sword a hundred thousand Aramaean footmen in one day.
sentences.susu: E naxa yonkin e boore ya i xi solofere bun ma. Na tɛmui gere naxa fɔlɔ, Isirayilakae fa Arami sɔɔrie mixi wulu kɛmɛ faxa.

sentences.english: But the rest went in flight to Aphek, into the town, where a wall came down on the twenty-seven thousand who were still living. And Ben-hadad went in flight into the town, into an inner room.
sentences.susu: A dɔnxɔɛe naxa mini e gi ra Afeki tɛtɛ kui, kɔnɔ tɛtɛ fan yati naxa bira e ma, a mixi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun solofere faxa. Ben Hadada tan nu bara a gi, a sa a nɔxun konkoe nde kui.

sentences.english: Then his servants said to him, It is said that the kings of Israel are full of mercy: let us then put on haircloth, and cords on our heads, and go to the king of Israel; it may be that he will give you your life.
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔrie naxa a fala a bɛ, «Muxu a mɛ nɛ, a Isirayilakae xa mangɛe bɔɲɛ fan. Muxu xa bɛki dugi xiri muxu tagi, muxu xa luuti xiri muxu xunyie sunnunyi tɔnxuma ra, muxu xa muxu yɛtɛ dɛntɛgɛ Isirayila mangɛ bɛ. Tɛmunde a diɲɛma i faxafe ma.»

sentences.english: So they put on haircloth, and cords on their heads, and came to the king of Israel and said, Your servant Ben-hadad says, Let me now keep my life. And he said, Is he still living? he is my brother.
sentences.susu: E naxa bɛki dugi xiri e tagi, e luutie xiri e xunyie sunnunyi tɔnxuma ra, e fa e yɛtɛ dɛntɛgɛ Isirayila mangɛ bɛ, e fa a fala, «I xa konyi Ben Hadada bara i mayandi i naxa a faxa.» Akabu naxa e yaabi, «A man baloxi? N ngaxakerenyi nan a ra.»

sentences.english: Now the men took it as a sign, and quickly took up his words; and they said, Ben-hadad is your brother. Then he said, Go and get him. So Ben-hadad came out to him and he made him get up into his carriage.
sentences.susu: Na mixie to na mɛ, e naxa a maɲɔxun fe fanyi na a ra. E naxa mangɛ yaabi, «Iyo, Ben Hadada i ngaxakerenyi nan a ra!» Akabu naxa e yamari, «Wo sa fa a ra.» Ben Hadada naxa mini a nu na dɛnnaxɛ, a siga Akabu yire. Akabu naxa a baki a xa sɔɔri ragise kui.

sentences.english: And Ben-hadad said to him, The towns my father took from your father I will give back; and you may make streets for yourself in Damascus as my father did in Samaria. And as for me, at the price of this agreement you will let me go. So he made an agreement with him and let him go.
sentences.susu: Ben Hadada naxa a fala a bɛ, «N taae ragbilenma nɛ i ma, n baba naxee ba i baba yi ra. I nɔma i xa makiti tide Damasi, alɔ n baba gbe to nu na Samari.» Akabu naxa a fala a bɛ, «Won xa saatɛ xiri, n fa i bɛɲin.» E to saatɛ xiri, a naxa a bɛɲin.

sentences.english: And a certain man of the sons of the prophets said to his neighbour by the word of the Lord, Give me a wound. But the man would not.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ nde naxa a fala a ɲɛrɛ boore bɛ Alatala xui ra, «N bɔnbɔ.» Kɔnɔ a ɲɛrɛ boore mu tin a bɔnbɔde.

sentences.english: Then he said to him, Because you have not given ear to the voice of the Lord, straight away when you have gone from me a lion will put you to death. And when he had gone, straight away a lion came rushing at him and put him to death.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a naxa a fala a ɲɛrɛ boore bɛ, «I to mu tinxi i tuli matide Alatala xa masenyi ra, yɛtɛ nde fama nɛ i faxade.» A to keli mɛnni, yɛtɛ naxa dutun a ma, a a faxa.

sentences.english: Then he came across another man, and said, Give me a wound. And the man gave him a blow wounding him.
sentences.susu: Na namiɲɔnmɛ naxa siga mixi gbɛtɛ fan yire, a a fala a bɛ, «N bɔnbɔ.» Na kanyi naxa a bɔnbɔ han a a maxɔnɔ.

sentences.english: So the prophet went away, and pulling his head-band over his eyes to keep his face covered, took his place by the road waiting for the king.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ naxa sa ti kira ra mangɛ nu dangima dɛnnaxɛ. A naxa a yatagi maxiri dugi nde ra a fi daaxi.

sentences.english: And when the king went by, crying out to him he said, Your servant went out into the fight; and a man came out to me with another man and said, Keep this man: if by any chance he gets away, your life will be the price of his life, or you will have to give a talent of silver in payment.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ to dangi naa, namiɲɔnmɛ naxa a fala mangɛ bɛ a xui itexi ra, «N tan i xa sɔɔri, n nu na gere yire nɛ. Sɔɔri nde naxa mini gere ya ma, a fa won yaxui suxuxi nde taxu n na, a a fala n bɛ, ‹Yi xɛmɛ suxu gben. Xa a a ba i yi, i nii nan findima a sare ra, xa na mu i kɔbiri ba.›

sentences.english: But while your servant was turning this way and that, he was gone. Then the king of Israel said to him, You are responsible; you have given the decision against yourself.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n nu yanfaxi wali nde kui, na xɛmɛ suxuxi naxa nɔ a gide.» Mangɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «I bara i yɛtɛ makiiti. A lanma i xa faxa.»

sentences.english: Then he quickly took the head-band from his eyes; and the king of Israel saw that he was one of the prophets.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui namiɲɔnmɛ naxa dugi ba a yatagi ma, Isirayila mangɛ naxa a kolon fa namiɲɔnmɛ nde nan a ra.
