sentences.english: And he said to him, These are the words of the Lord: Because you have let go from your hands the man whom I had put to the curse, your life will be taken for his life, and your people for his people.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala mangɛ bɛ, «I to bara i yaxui bɛɲin n naxan saxi i bɛlɛxɛ i, n mixi naxan natɔnxi, i nii nan findima a sare ra, i xa ɲama findima a xa ɲama sare nan na.»

sentences.english: Then the king of Israel went back to his house, bitter and angry, and came to Samaria.
sentences.susu: Na kui Isirayila mangɛ naxa gbilen a xɔnyi Samari sunnunyi nun bɔɲɛ maɲaaxui kui.

sentences.english: Now Naboth the Jezreelite had a vine-garden in Jezreel, near the house of Ahab, king of Samaria.
sentences.susu: Yisireelika nde nu na naxan xili Naboti. Sansi yire nu na a yi ra Samari mangɛ Akabu xa bɔxi fɛ ma.

sentences.english: And Ahab said to Naboth, Give me your vine-garden so that I may have it for a garden of sweet plants, for it is near my house; and let me give you a better vine-garden in exchange, or, if it seems good to you, let me give you its value in money.
sentences.susu: Akabu naxa a fala Naboti bɛ, «I xa i xa sansi yire so n yi ra, n xa a findi n ma laakɔɛ yire ra, barima a makɔrɛ n ma banxi ra. N sansi yire gbɛtɛ soma i yi ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra naxan fan na bɛ, xa na mu a ra, n xa a sara kɔbiri ra.»

sentences.english: But Naboth said to Ahab, By the Lord, far be it from me to give you the heritage of my fathers.
sentences.susu: Naboti naxa Akabu yaabi, a naxɛ, «Alatala xa n natanga n benbae kɛ sofe ra i yi.»

sentences.english: So Ahab came into his house bitter and angry because Naboth the Jezreelite had said to him, I will not give you the heritage of my fathers. And stretching himself on the bed with his face turned away, he would take no food.
sentences.susu: Akabu naxa so a xɔnyi, a sunnunxi ra, a bɔɲɛ maɲaaxuxi Yisireelika Naboti xa masenyi xa fe ra, a falafe ra, «N mu n benbae kɛ soma i yi ra.» A naxa a sa, a a kobe raso mixie ra, a mu tin donse donde.

sentences.english: But Jezebel, his wife, came to him and said, Why is your spirit so bitter that you have no desire for food?
sentences.susu: A xa ginɛ Yesabela naxa siga a yire, a a maxɔrin, «Munfe ra i bɔɲɛ maɲaaxuxi, i mu tin i dɛgede?»

sentences.english: And he said to her, Because I was talking to Naboth the Jezreelite, and I said to him, Let me have your vine-garden for a price, or, if it is pleasing to you, I will give you another vine-garden for it: and he said, I will not give you my vine-garden.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «N bara a fala Yisireelika Naboti bɛ a xa a xa sansi yire so n yi ra, n xa a sara, xa na mu a ra, n xa sansi yire gbɛtɛ so a yi ra, kɔnɔ a mu tin na ra fefe ma.»

sentences.english: Then Jezebel, his wife, said, Are you now the ruler of Israel? Get up, take food, and let your heart be glad; I will give you the vine-garden of Naboth the Jezreelite.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a xa ginɛ Yesabela naxa a fala a bɛ. «Pe, i tan xa mu findixi Isirayila mangɛ ra? Awa, mangɛ, keli, i xa i dɛge ɲɛlɛxinyi kui. N tan Yisireelika Naboti xa sansi yire soma nɛ i yi ra!»

sentences.english: So she sent a letter in Ahab's name, stamped with his stamp, to the responsible men and the chiefs who were in authority with Naboth.
sentences.susu: A xa ginɛ naxa bataaxɛ sɛbɛ Akabu xili ra, a mangɛ Akabu xa tɔnxuma sa a ma, a fa a rasanba forie nun kuntigie ma, naxee nu sabatixi Naboti xa taa kui.

sentences.english: And in the letter she said, Let a time of public sorrow be fixed, and put Naboth at the head of the people;
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi bataaxɛ kui, «Wo sunyi nun sali rabafe ti ɲama bɛ, Naboti xa dɔxɔ ɲama birin ya i.

sentences.english: And get two good-for-nothing persons to come before him and give witness that he has been cursing God and the king. Then take him out and have him stoned to death.
sentences.susu: Wo xa fuyante firin dɔxɔ a ya i, naxee a tɔɔɲɛgɛma, a falafe ra a bara Ala nun mangɛ konbi. Na kui wo xa a ramini taa kui, wo a magɔnɔ gɛmɛ ra han a xa faxa.»

sentences.english: So the responsible men and the chiefs who were in authority in his town, did as Jezebel had said in the letter she sent them.
sentences.susu: Naboti xa taa mixie, forie nun kuntigie naxa a raba, alɔ Yesabela a yamarixi ki naxɛ na bataaxɛ kui.

sentences.english: They gave orders for a day of public sorrow, and put Naboth at the head of the people.
sentences.susu: E naxa sun e sali, e Naboti dɔxɔ ɲama birin ya tode ra,

sentences.english: And the two good-for-nothing persons came in and took their seats before him and gave witness against Naboth, in front of the people, saying, Naboth has been cursing God and the king. Then they took him outside the town and had him stoned to death.
sentences.susu: e fa fuyante firinyi radɔxɔ a yire. Na fuyante firinyie naxa Naboti tɔɔɲɛgɛ ɲama ya i, a falafe ra, «Naboti bara Ala nun mangɛ konbi.» Ɲama naxa Naboti xanin taa fari ma, e a magɔnɔ han a faxa.

sentences.english: And they sent word to Jezebel, saying, Naboth has been stoned and is dead.
sentences.susu: E naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Yesabela ma, a falafe ra, «Naboti bara magɔnɔ gɛmɛ ra, a bara faxa.»

sentences.english: Then Jezebel, hearing that Naboth had been stoned and was dead, said to Ahab, Get up and take as your heritage the vine-garden of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he would not give you for money, for Naboth is no longer living but is dead.
sentences.susu: Yesabela to a mɛ a Naboti bara magɔnɔ gɛmɛ ra han a bara faxa, a naxa siga Akabu yire, a a fala a bɛ, «Yakɔsi keli, i xa Naboti xa sansi yire tongo, Naboti Yisireelika tondi naxan sarade i ma kɔbiri ra. Naboti a mu na sɔnɔn, a bara faxa.»

sentences.english: So Ahab, hearing that Naboth was dead, went down to the vine-garden of Naboth the Jezreelite to take it as his heritage.
sentences.susu: Akabu to a mɛ, a Naboti bara faxa, a naxa keli keren na, a sa Naboti xa sansi yire findi a gbe ra.

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Eliya Tisibeka bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Go down to Ahab, king of Israel, in Samaria; see, he is in the vine-garden of Naboth the Jezreelite, where he has gone to take it as his heritage.
sentences.susu: «Siga Isirayila mangɛ Akabu yire Samari. A na Naboti xa sansi yire, a naxan findixi a gbe ra.

sentences.english: Say to him, The Lord says, Have you put a man to death and taken his heritage? Then say to him, The Lord says, In the place where dogs have been drinking the blood of Naboth, there will your blood become the drink of dogs.
sentences.susu: I xa a fala a bɛ, ‹Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «I bara faxɛ ti, i bara mixi kɛ muɲa! Baree fama i wuli makɔnde, e Naboti wuli makɔnxi dɛnnaxɛ.»›»

sentences.english: And Ahab said to Elijah, Have you come face to face with me, O my hater? And he said, I have come to you because you have given yourself up to do evil in the eyes of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Akabu naxa Eliya yaabi, «I tan n yaxui, i bara n to?» A naxa a fala a bɛ, «Iyo, n bara i to. I to i yɛtɛ fi fe ɲaaxi rabafe ma, naxan mu rafanxi Alatala ma,

sentences.english: See, I will send evil on you and put an end to you completely, cutting off from Ahab every male child, him who is shut up and him who goes free in Israel;
sentences.susu: n gbaloe ragoroma nɛ i ma, n i bama nɛ Isirayila, n xɛmɛ birin faxa xɔrɛ nun konyi i bɔnsɔɛ ya ma Isirayila.

sentences.english: And I will make your family like the family of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, and like the family of Baasha, the son of Ahijah, because you have made me angry, and have made Israel do evil.
sentences.susu: N i xa fɔxɛ luma nɛ, alɔ Nebati xa di Yerobowami nun Ahiya xa di Baasa xa fɔxɛe, barima i bara n naxɔnɔ, i man bara Isirayila ɲama birin naɲɛrɛ yunubi kui.»

sentences.english: And of Jezebel the Lord said, Jezebel will become food for dogs in the heritage of Jezreel.
sentences.susu: «Alatala xa masenyi nan ya Yesabela xa fe ra, a naxɛ, ‹Baree fama nɛ Yesabela donde Yisireeli tɛtɛ fɛ ma.

sentences.english: Any man of the family of Ahab who comes to his death in the town will become food for the dogs; and he who comes to his death in the open country will be food for the birds of the air.
sentences.susu: Akabu xa mixi naxan na faxa taa kui, baree nan na donma. Naxan na faxa wula i, yubɛe nan na donma.›»

sentences.english: (There was no one like Ahab, who gave himself up to do evil in the eyes of the Lord, moved to it by Jezebel his wife.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu na naxan a yɛtɛ fi fe ɲaaxi rabafe ma alɔ Akabu. A xa ginɛ Yesabela nu a bɔɲɛ ratema na fe kui.

sentences.english: He did a very disgusting thing in going after false gods, doing all the things the Amorites did, whom the Lord sent out before the children of Israel.)
sentences.susu: A nu fe ɲaaxi rabama dangi mixi birin na. A nu kuyee batuma alɔ Amorikae, Alatala naxee keri Isirayilakae ya ra.

sentences.english: Hearing these words, Ahab, in great grief, put haircloth on his flesh and went without food, sleeping in haircloth, and going about quietly.
sentences.susu: Akabu to Annabi Eliya xa masenyi mɛ, a naxa a xa donma ibɔɔ sunnunyi kui, a naxa sunnun dugi ragoro a ma, a sunyi suxu. A nu a sama sade ma, na sunnun dugi ragoroxi a ma, xa na mu a nu ɲɛrɛ dɔyi dɔyi a sunnunxi ra.

sentences.english: Then the word of the Lord came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Eliya Tisibeka bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Do you see how Ahab has made himself low before me? because he has made himself low before me, I will not send the evil in his life-time, but in his son's time I will send the evil on his family.
sentences.susu: «I bara a to Akabu a yɛtɛ magoroxi n bɛ ki naxɛ? A to bara a yɛtɛ magoro n bɛ, n mu gbaloe ragoroma a ma fanni a baloxi. N gbaloe ragoroma a bɔnsɔɛ ma a xa di xa waxati nɛ.»

sentences.english: Now for three years there was no war between Aram and Israel.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ saxan naxa dangi, gere yo mu lu Arami nun Isirayila tagi.

sentences.english: And it came about in the third year, that Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, came down to the king of Israel.
sentences.susu: A ɲɛ saxan nde ra, Yudaya mangɛ Yehosafati naxa goro Isirayila mangɛ yire.

sentences.english: And the king of Israel said to his servants, Do you not see that Ramoth-gilead is ours? and we are doing nothing to get it back from the hands of the king of Aram.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ naxa a fala a xa mixie bɛ, «Wo a kolon a Ramoti, naxan na Galadi bɔxi ma, won tan nan gbe a ra. Won naxa siikɛ a rasuxude Arami mangɛ yi ra.»

sentences.english: And he said to Jehoshaphat, Will you go with me to Ramoth-gilead to make war? And Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, I am as you are: my people as your people, my horses as your horses.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ Akabu naxa a fala Yudaya mangɛ Yehosafati bɛ, «Won birin na a ra sigafe Ramoti Galadi bɔxi ma?» Yehosafati naxa a yaabi, «Iyo, i tan yo n tan yo, won birin keren. Won ma ɲamae nun won ma soe fan a birin keren.»

sentences.english: Then Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, Let us now get directions from the Lord.
sentences.susu: Yehosafati naxa a fala Isirayila mangɛ bɛ, «N bara i maxandi, won xa Alatala sago fen yi fe kui yakɔsi.»

sentences.english: So the king of Israel got all the prophets together, about four hundred men, and said to them, Am I to go to Ramoth-gilead to make war or not? And they said, Go up: for the Lord will give it into the hands of the king.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ naxa namiɲɔnmɛ kɛmɛ naani malan, a e maxɔrin, «A lanma ka a mu lanma won xa siga Ramoti gerede Galadi bɔxi ma?» E naxa a yaabi, «Wo te, Ala fama e sade i sagoe mangɛ.»

sentences.english: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there no other prophet of the Lord here from whom we may get directions?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Yehosafati naxa mangɛ maxɔrin, «Alatala xa namiɲɔnmɛ nde mu na be, won nɔma naxan maxɔrinde?»

sentences.english: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, There is still one man by whom we may get directions from the Lord, Micaiah, son of Imlah; but I have no love for him, for he is a prophet of evil to me and not of good. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ naxa Yehosafati yaabi, «Xɛmɛ keren peti nan be, won nɔma Alatala maxɔrinde naxan saabui ra, kɔnɔ a mu rafan n ma, barima a xunnakanɛ fe nan gbansan falama n ma fe ra. A mu xunnakeli fe yo falama n bɛ. A xili Mike. Yimila xa di na a ra.» Yehosafati naxa a fala, «A mu lanma mangɛ xa na wɔyɛn mɔɔli fala.»

sentences.english: Then the king of Israel sent for one of his unsexed servants and said, Go quickly and come back with Micaiah, the son of Imlah.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isirayila mangɛ naxa a xa batula keren xili, a a fala a bɛ, «Fa Yimila xa di Mike ra n bɛ keren na.»

sentences.english: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah, were seated on their seats of authority, dressed in their robes, by the doorway into Samaria; and all the prophets were acting as prophets before them.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ nun Yudaya mangɛ Yehosafati nu dɔxɔxi e xa kibanyie kui, mangɛ donmae ragoroxi e ma. E nu na lonyi ma, Samari taa sode dɛ ra. Namiɲɔnmɛe nu na e xa masenyie tife e bɛ.

sentences.english: And Zedekiah, the son of Chenaanah, made himself horns of iron and said, The Lord says, Pushing back the Aramaeans with these, you will put an end to them completely.
sentences.susu: Kenaana xa di Sedekiya nu bara feri wure daaxie yailan, a fa a fala mangɛe bɛ, «Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: ‹Wo Aramikae bɔnbɔma yi ferie nan na han e sɔntɔ.›»

sentences.english: And all the prophets said the same thing, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and it will go well for you, for the Lord will give it into the hands of the king.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ birin nu na masenyi mɔɔli falama e bɛ. E naxa a fala, «Wo te Ramoti Galadi bɔxi ma. Wo xunnakeli nan sɔtɔma, Alatala fama nɛ e sade mangɛ sagoe.»

sentences.english: Now the servant who had gone to get Micaiah said to him, See now, all the prophets with one voice are saying good things to the king; so let your words be like theirs and say good things.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛra naxan siga Mike xilide, na naxa a fala a bɛ, «I bara a to, namiɲɔnmɛ birin bara lan e xa fe fanyi fala mangɛ bɛ. I fan xa kata, wo xui xa lu keren, i xa fe fanyi fala mangɛ bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Micaiah said, By the living Lord, whatever the Lord says to me I will say.
sentences.susu: Mike naxa a fala, «Alatala ɲiɲɛ na a ra. N Marigi Alatala na naxan yo masen, n na nan falama.»

sentences.english: When he came to the king, the king said to him, Micaiah, are we to go to Ramoth-gilead to make war or not? And in answer he said, Go up, and it will go well for you; and the Lord will give it into the hands of the king.
sentences.susu: A to mangɛ yire li, mangɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «Mike, a lanma ka a mu lanma muxu xa siga gere sode Ramoti Galadi bɔxi ma?» Mike naxa a yaabi, «Wo te, wo xunnakeli nan sɔtɔma. Alatala fama nɛ e sade wo sagoe.»

sentences.english: Then the king said to him, Have I not, again and again, put you on your oath to say nothing to me but what is true in the name of the Lord?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mangɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «N ɲan bara a fala i bɛ sanya wuyaxi, i xa i kali nɔndi yati nan falade n bɛ Alatala xili ra.»

sentences.english: Then he said, I saw all Israel wandering on the mountains like sheep without a keeper; and the Lord said, These have no master: let them go back, every man to his house in peace.
sentences.susu: Mike naxa a yaabi, «N bara Isirayila birin to, e yensenxi geyae fari, alɔ xuruse rabɛɲinxie. Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Marigi mu na yi ɲama bɛ. Kankan xa gbilen a xɔnyi bɔɲɛsa kui.»

sentences.english: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not say that he would not be a prophet of good but of evil?
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ naxa a fala Yehosafati bɛ, «N mu a fala xɛ i bɛ, a mu nɔma fe fanyi masende n ma fe ra, fo fe ɲaaxi tun?»

sentences.english: And he said, Give ear now to the word of the Lord: I saw the Lord seated on his seat of power, with all the army of heaven in their places round him at his right hand and at his left.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Mike naxa a fala e bɛ, «Yakɔsi, wo wo tuli mati Alatala xa masenyi ra. N bara Alatala to a xa kibanyi kui, a xa malekɛ gali nu tixi a yirefanyi ma nun a kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord said, How may Ahab be tricked into going up to Ramoth-gilead to his death? And one said one thing and one another.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a fala, ‹Nde wama sigafe xaxili kobi rasode Isirayila mangɛ Akabu xunyi, a xa sa Ramoti gere Galadi bɔxi ma alako a xa faxa?› Nde naxa a yaabi xaxili nde ra, nde fan naxa a yaabi xaxili gbɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then a spirit came forward and took his place before the Lord and said, I will get him to do it by a trick.
sentences.susu: Na kui ɲinnɛ nde naxa mini, a ti Alatala ya i, a a fala, ‹N tan nɔma nɛ a ra.› Alatala naxa a maxɔrin, ‹I nɔma di?›

sentences.english: And the Lord said, How? And he said, I will go out and be a spirit of deceit in the mouth of all his prophets. And he said, Your trick will have its effect on him: go out and do so.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, ‹N sigama nɛ, n fa wule fala mangɛ bɛ a xa namiɲɔnmɛe saabui ra.› Alatala naxa a fala a bɛ, ‹I fama nɛ a nɔde, na sɔɔnɛyama nɛ. Siga, i xa sa na raba.›

sentences.english: And now, see, the Lord has put a spirit of deceit in the mouth of all these your prophets; and the Lord has said evil against you.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, Alatala bara wule sa i xa namiɲɔnmɛe dɛ i. Ala bara natɛ ɲaaxi tongo i xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: Then Zedekiah, the son of Chenaanah, came near and gave Micaiah a blow on the side of the face, saying, Where is the spirit of the Lord whose word is in you?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Kenaana xa di Sedekiya naxa a maso, a Mike dɛ ragarin, a fa a fala, «Alatala Xaxili minixi kira mundun na n ma n xa wɔyɛn i bɛ?»

sentences.english: And Micaiah said, Truly, you will see on that day when you go into an inner room to keep yourself safe.
sentences.susu: Mike naxa a yaabi, «I fama na tode, i i gima i nɔxunde fende tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And the king of Israel said, Take Micaiah and send him back to Amon, the ruler of the town, and to Joash, the king's son;
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ naxa a fala, «Wo Mike xanin taa mangɛ Amon nun mangɛ xa di Yowasi xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And say, It is the king's order that this man is to be put in prison and given prison food till I come again in peace.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a fala e bɛ, ‹Mangɛ naxɛ, a wo xa yi xɛmɛ sa geeli kui, a wo naxa donse so a yi ra, fo taami xare nun ye, han n sa fama tɛmui naxɛ xunnakeli kui.›»

sentences.english: And Micaiah said, If you come back at all in peace, the Lord has not sent his word by me.
sentences.susu: Mike naxa a yaabi, «Xa i sa gbilen xunnakeli kui, n ma masenyi mu kelixi Alatala ma.» A man naxa a fala ɲama ya xɔri, «Ɲama birin, wo xa wo tuli mati n ma masenyi ra a fanyi ra!»

sentences.english: So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah, went up to Ramoth-gilead.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ nun Yudaya mangɛ Yehosafati naxa te Ramoti Galadi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, I will make a change in my clothing, so that I do not seem to be the king, and will go into the fight; but do you put on your robes. So the king of Israel made a change in his dress and went into the fight.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ naxa a fala Yehosafati bɛ, «I xa so gere kui mangɛ donma ragoroxi i ma.» Isirayila mangɛ tan naxa mangɛ dugi ba a ma, a sɔɔri donma gbansan nagoro a ma, a siga gere sode.

sentences.english: Now the king of Aram had given orders to the thirty-two captains of his war-carriages, saying, Make no attack on small or great, but only on the king of Israel.
sentences.susu: Arami mangɛ nu bara a fala a xa sɔɔri tongo saxan nun firinyi bɛ, naxee findixi sɔɔri ragise xa sɔɔrie yareratie ra, «Wo xa katɛ birin naba wo xa Isirayila mangɛ gbansan nan fen, wo a faxa.»

sentences.english: So when the captains of the war-carriages saw Jehoshaphat, they said, Truly, this is the king of Israel; and turning against him, they came round him, but Jehoshaphat gave a cry.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri ragise xa sɔɔrie yareratie to Yehosafati to, e naxa a maɲɔxun tɛmunde Isirayila mangɛ nan a ra. E naxa e xun ti a ra, e xa sa a gere. Yehosafati naxa a malimae xili.

sentences.english: And when the captains of the war-carriages saw that he was not the king of Israel, they went back from going after him.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri ragise xa sɔɔrie yareratie naxa a kolon Isirayila mangɛ xa mu a ra, e fa gbilen a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And a certain man sent an arrow from his bow without thought of its direction, and gave the king of Israel a wound where his breastplate was joined to his clothing; so he said to the driver of his war-carriage, Go to one side and take me away out of the army, for I am badly wounded.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui sɔɔri nde naxa xali woli na ki tun. Tanbɛ naxa sa Isirayila mangɛ sɔxɔ a kanke makantase lenbee tagi. Mangɛ naxa a fala a xa sɔɔri ragise ragima bɛ, «Gise mafindi, i xa n namini gere fari ma, barima n bara maxɔnɔ.»

sentences.english: But the fight became more violent while the day went on; and the king was supported in his war-carriage facing the Aramaeans, and the floor of the carriage was covered with the blood from his wound, and by evening he was dead.
sentences.susu: Gere naxa xɔrɔxɔ na lɔxɔɛ ki fanyi ra. Mangɛ nu tixi a xa sɔɔri ragise kui, a ya rafindixi Aramikae ma. A naxa faxa na nunmare ra, a wuli gbegbe nu na a xa sɔɔri ragise kui.

sentences.english: And about sundown a cry went up from all parts of the army, saying, Let every man go back to his town and his country, for the king is dead.
sentences.susu: Soge goro tɛmui, yaamari naxa fi, «Birin xa gbilen e xɔnyi, birin xa siga e xa bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And they came to Samaria, and put the king's body to rest in Samaria.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ faxa na ki nɛ, a naxa ragata Samari taa kui.

sentences.english: And the war-carriage was washed by the pool of Samaria, which was the bathing-place of the loose women, and the dogs were drinking his blood there, as the Lord had said.
sentences.susu: E to mangɛ xa sɔɔri ragise kui ixa Samari ye yire, baree naxa Akabu wuli makɔn, langoe ginɛe fan naxa e maxa naa, alɔ Alatala a masen ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahab, and all he did, and his ivory house, and all the towns of which he was the builder, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?
sentences.susu: Akabu xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, nun a fe naxan birin naba, nun a banxi tixi ki naxɛ sili ɲinyie ra, nun a taa naxee ti, na birin sɛbɛxi Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: So Ahab was put to rest with his fathers; and Ahaziah his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Akabu naxa ragata a benbae fɛ ma. A xa di Axasiya naxa findi mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Jehoshaphat, the son of Asa, became king over Judah in the fourth year of Ahab's rule over Israel.
sentences.susu: Asa xa di Yehosafati findi Yudaya mangɛ ra, Isirayila mangɛ Akabu xa mangɛya ɲɛ naani nde nɛ.

sentences.english: Jehoshaphat was thirty-five years old when he became king, and he was king for twenty-five years in Jerusalem. His mother's name was Azubah, the daughter of Shilhi.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ tongo saxan nun suuli nu na Yehosafati bɛ, a to nu findima mangɛ ra Darisalamu. A nga nu na Sili xa di Asuba nan na.

sentences.english: He did as Asa his father had done, not turning away from it, but doing what was right in the eyes of the Lord; but the high places were not taken away: the people went on making offerings and burning them in the high places.
sentences.susu: Yehosafati naxa ɲɛrɛ a baba Asa xa kira xɔn ma, a mu a makuya Alatala xa kira ra.

sentences.english: And Jehoshaphat made peace with the king of Israel.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ kuye batufe yire itexie ma, na mu dan Yudaya bɔxi ma. Mixie mu tagan sɛrɛxɛ bafe ra naa, a nun surayi ganfe sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, and his great power, and how he went to war, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?
sentences.susu: Lanyi nu na Yehosafati nun Isirayila mangɛ tagi.

sentences.english: He put an end to the rest of those who were used for sex purposes in the worship of the gods, all those who were still in the land in the time of his father Asa.
sentences.susu: Yehosafati xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, nun a xa gere ki fanyi, na sɛbɛxi Yudaya mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: At that time there was no king in Edom;
sentences.susu: A naxa tɔnyi dɔxɔ langoe xa wali ma kuye batudee, naxee nu na kabi a baba Asa waxati.

sentences.english: And the representative of King Jehoshaphat made a Tarshish-ship to go to Ophir for gold, but it did not go, because it was broken at Ezion-geber.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nu na Edon, Yudaya mangɛ gomina nde nan ti naa.

sentences.english: Then Ahaziah, the son of Ahab, said to Jehoshaphat, Let my men go with yours in the ships. But Jehoshaphat would not let them.
sentences.susu: Yehosafati naxa kunkuie yailan Tarasisi, alako e xa siga xɛɛma fende Ofiri, kɔnɔ kunkuie naxa kana Esiyon Geberi.

sentences.english: Then Jehoshaphat went to rest with his fathers, and his body was put into the earth in the town of David his father; and Jehoram his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Na kui Akabu xa di Axasiya naxa a fala Yehosafati bɛ, «N ma mixie nun i i xa mixie birin xa siga na wali rabade kunkuie kui.» Kɔnɔ Yehosafati mu tin na fe ra.

sentences.english: Ahaziah, the son of Ahab, became king over Israel in Samaria in the seventeenth year of the rule of Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah, and he was king over Israel for two years.
sentences.susu: Yehosafati naxa bɛlɛ a benbae fɛ ma, a ragata a benba Dawuda xa taa kui. A xa di Yehorami naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, going in the ways of his father and his mother, and in the ways of Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, who made Israel do evil.
sentences.susu: Akabu xa di Axasiya naxa findi mangɛ ra Samari, Isirayila bɔxi xun ma, Yudaya mangɛ Yehosafati xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun solofere nde ra. A bu nɛ mangɛya kui ɲɛ firin Isirayila xun ma.

sentences.english: He was a servant and worshipper of Baal, moving the Lord, the God of Israel, to wrath, as his father had done.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba, naxan mu rafan Alatala ma, a naxa a ɲɛrɛ a baba nun a nga xa kira xɔn ma. A naxa fe raba alɔ Nebati xa di Yerobowami, naxan a niya Isirayila birin xa yunubi raba.

sentences.english: After the death of Ahab, Moab made itself free from the authority of Israel.
sentences.susu: Akabu faxa xanbi, Mowabakae naxa muruta Isirayilakae xili ma.

sentences.english: Now Ahaziah had a fall from the window of his room in Samaria, and was ill. And he sent men, and said to them, Put a question to Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, about the outcome of my disease, to see if I will get well or not.
sentences.susu: Axasiya naxa bira kelife a xa koore banxi kɔn na Samari, a maxɔnɔ a belebele ra. A naxa xɛɛrae rasiga Ekironkae xa ala Bali Sebubu maxɔrinde xa a nɔma yalande.

sentences.english: But the angel of the Lord said to Elijah the Tishbite, Go now, and, meeting the men sent by the king of Samaria, say to them, Is it because there is no God in Israel, that you are going to get directions from Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala xa malekɛ naxa a fala Annabi Eliya Tisibeka bɛ, «I xa siga Samari mangɛ xa xɛɛrae ya ra, i a fala e bɛ, ‹Ala mu na Isirayila bɔxi ma, wo to fa sigama Ekironkae xa ala Bali Sebubu maxɔrinde?

sentences.english: Give ear then to the words of the Lord: You will never again get down from the bed on to which you have gone up, but death will certainly come to you. Then Elijah went away.
sentences.susu: Na xa fe ra, Alatala xa masenyi nan ya Axasiya bɛ, i mu goroma sade ma i saxi naxan kɔn na. I faxama nɛ.›» Annabi Eliya to gɛ na falade mangɛ xa xɛɛrae bɛ, a naxa siga.

sentences.english: And the men he had sent came back to the king; and he said to them, Why have you come back?
sentences.susu: Xɛɛrae naxa gbilen mangɛ Axasiya yire. A naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo gbilenxi munfe ra?»

sentences.english: And they said to him, On our way we had a meeting with a man who said, Go back to the king who sent you and say to him, The Lord says, Is it because there is no God in Israel that you send to put a question to Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron? For this reason, you will not come down from the bed on to which you have gone up, but death will certainly come to you.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Mixi nde nan muxu ralanxi, a a fala muxu bɛ ‹Wo gbilen mangɛ yire, naxan wo xɛɛxi, wo a fala a bɛ, Ala mu na Isirayila bɔxi tan ma, i to fa xɛɛrae xɛɛma Ekironkae xa ala Bali Sebubu maxɔrinde? Na xa fe ra, i mu goroma sade ma i saxi naxan ma. I faxama nɛ.›»

sentences.english: And he said to them, What sort of a man was it who came and said these words to you?
sentences.susu: Axasiya naxa e maxɔrin, «Yi xɛmɛ nu na di, naxan wo ralanxi a yi wɔyɛnyi fala wo bɛ?»

sentences.english: And they said in answer, He was a man clothed in a coat of hair, with a leather band about his body. Then he said, It is Elijah the Tishbite.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Fate maxabe kanyi nan nu a ra, bɛlɛti kiri daaxi xirixi a tagi.» Axasiya naxa a fala keren na, «Eliya nan a ra, na Tisibeka.»

sentences.english: Then the king sent to him a captain of fifty with his fifty men; and he went up to him where he was seated on the top of a hill, and said to him, O man of God, the king has said, Come down.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɔɔri mangɛ nde xɛɛ, naxan nu sɔɔri mixi tongo suuli yamarima, a xa Annabi Eliya suxu. Na to siga Eliya yire, a naxa a li a dɔxɔxi geya xun tagi. A naxa a fala Eliya bɛ, «Ala xa mixi, mangɛ naxɛ, a i xa goro!»

sentences.english: And Elijah in answer said to the captain of fifty, If I am a man of God, may fire come down from heaven on you and on your fifty men, and put an end to you. Then fire came down from heaven and put an end to him and his fifty men.
sentences.susu: Eliya naxa a fala na sɔɔri mangɛ bɛ, naxan nu sɔɔri mixi tongo suuli yamarima, «Xa Ala xa mixi nan n na, tɛ xa goro keli koore ma, a xa i tan nun i xa mixi tongo suuli birin gan.» Na kui, tɛ naxa goro keren na, a a tan nun a xa mixi tongo suuli gan.

sentences.english: Then the king sent another captain of fifty with his fifty men; and he said to Elijah, O man of God, the king says, Come down quickly.
sentences.susu: Axasiya naxa sɔɔri mangɛ gbɛtɛ xɛɛ, na fan nun a xa sɔɔri mixi tongo suuli, e xa Eliya suxu. Na sɔɔri mangɛ naxa a fala Eliya bɛ, «Ala xa mixi, mangɛ naxɛ a i xa goro keren na!»

sentences.english: And Elijah in answer said, If I am a man of God, may fire come down from heaven on you and on your fifty men, and put an end to you. And the fire of God came down from heaven, and put an end to him and his fifty men.
sentences.susu: Eliya naxa a yaabi, «Xa Ala xa mixi nan n na, tɛ xa goro keli koore ma, a xa i tan nun i xa mixi tongo suuli gan.» Na kui Ala naxa tɛ ragoro, a a tan nun a xa mixi tongo suuli gan.

sentences.english: Then he sent a third captain of fifty with his fifty men; and the third captain of fifty went up, and falling on his knees before Elijah, requesting mercy of him, said, O man of God, let my life and the life of these your fifty servants be of value to you.
sentences.susu: Axasiya man naxa sɔɔri mangɛ saxan nde xɛɛ, na fan nun a xa sɔɔri mixi tongo suuli ra. Na sɔɔri mangɛ saxan nde naxa te geya kɔn na. A to Eliya yire li, a naxa a xinbi sin a bun ma, a a mayandi, «Ala xa mixi, n bara i maxandi, i xa kinikini n tan nun n ma mixi tongo suuli ma.

sentences.english: For fire came down from heaven and put an end to the first two captains of fifty and their fifties; but now let my life be of value in your eyes.
sentences.susu: Ala bara tɛ ragoro keli koore, a na sɔɔri mangɛ firinyi singe nun e xa mixie gan. Kɔnɔ yakɔsi, i xa kinikini muxu tan ma, i xa muxu ratanga na ma.»

sentences.english: Then the angel of the Lord said to Elijah, Go down with him; have no fear of him. So he got up and went down with him to the king.
sentences.susu: Ala xa malekɛ naxa goro, a a fala Annabi Eliya bɛ, «Wo birin xa goro. I naxa gaaxu a ya ra.» Eliya nun a tan sɔɔri mangɛ naxa goro mangɛ yire,

sentences.english: And he said to him, This is the word of the Lord: Because you sent men to put a question to Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, for this reason you will never again get down from the bed on to which you have gone up, but death will certainly come to you.
sentences.susu: Eliya naxa a fala mangɛ bɛ, «Alatala xui nan ya, ‹Ala mu na Isirayila bɔxi tan ma, i to fa xɛɛrae xɛɛma Ekironkae xa ala Bali Sebubu maxɔrinde? Na xa fe ra, i mu goroma sade ma i saxi naxan kɔn na. I faxama nɛ.›»

sentences.english: So death came to him, as the Lord had said by the mouth of Elijah. And Jehoram became king in his place in the second year of the rule of Jehoram, son of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah; because he had no son.
sentences.susu: Axasiya naxa faxa alɔ Alatala a masen ki naxɛ Annabi Eliya saabui ra. A xunya Yorami naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra Isirayila. Na raba Yudaya mangɛ Yosafati xa di Yehorami xa mangɛya ɲɛ firin nde nan na, barima di mu nu na Axasiya tan bɛ.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Ahaziah, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?
sentences.susu: Axasiya xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛe, nun a fe naxee raba, na sɛbɛxi Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: Now when the Lord was about to take Elijah up to heaven in a great wind, Elijah went with Elisha from Gilgal.
sentences.susu: Beenun Alatala xa Annabi Eliya rate koore ma foye xungbe kui, Eliya nun a xa taalibi Elise nu kelife Giligali nɛ.

sentences.english: And Elijah said to Elisha, Come no farther for the Lord has sent me to Beth-el. But Elisha said, As the Lord is living and as your soul is living, I will not be parted from you. So they went down to Beth-el.
sentences.susu: Eliya naxa a fala Elise bɛ, «I xa lu be yandi, barima Alatala wama n xɛɛfe Beteli.» Kɔnɔ Elise naxa a yaabi, «N bara n kali Alatala ra, n bara n kali n yɛtɛ nii ra, n mu gbilenma i fɔxɔ ra feo!» Na kui e firin birin naxa goro Beteli.

sentences.english: And at Beth-el the sons of the prophets came out to Elisha and said, Has it been made clear to you that the Lord is going to take away your master from over you today? And he said, Yes, I have knowledge of it: say no more.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ naxee nu na Beteli, nee to Elise to, e naxa a fala a bɛ, «I a kolon a Alatala i karamɔxɔ ratema nɛ koore ma to?» A naxa e yaabi, «Iyo n a kolon. Wo wo sabari.»

sentences.english: Then Elijah said to him, Come no farther, for the Lord has sent me to Jericho. But he said, As the Lord is living and as your soul is living, I will not be parted from you. So they went on to Jericho.
sentences.susu: Eliya naxa a fala a bɛ, «Elise, i xa lu be, barima Alatala wama n xɛɛfe Yeriko.» A naxa a yaabi, «N bara n kali Alatala ra, n bara n kali n yɛtɛ nii ra, n mu gbilenma i fɔxɔ ra feo!» Na kui e firin birin naxa goro Yeriko.

sentences.english: And at Jericho the sons of the prophets came up to Elisha and said to him, Has it been made clear to you that the Lord is going to take away your master from over you today? And he said in answer, Yes, I have knowledge of it: say no more.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ naxee nu na Yeriko, nee to Elise to, e naxa a fala a bɛ, «I a kolon a Alatala i karamɔxɔ ratema nɛ koore ma to?» A naxa e yaabi, «Iyo, n a kolon. Wo wo sabari.»

sentences.english: Then Elijah said to him, Come no farther, for the Lord has sent me to Jordan. But he said, As the Lord is living and as your soul is living, I will not be parted from you. So they went on together.
sentences.susu: Eliya naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xa lu be, barima Alatala wama n xɛɛfe Yurudɛn mabiri.» A naxa a yaabi, «N bara n kali Alatala ra, n bara n kali n yɛtɛ nii ra, n mu gbilenma i fɔxɔ ra feo!» Na kui e firin birin naxa siga.

sentences.english: And fifty men of the sons of the prophets went out and took their places facing them a long way off, while the two of them were by the edge of Jordan.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ mixi tongo suuli naxa fa, e ti yire nde. E naxa Eliya nun Elise to Yurudɛn xure dɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then Elijah took off his robe, and, rolling it up, gave the water a blow with it, and the waters were parted, flowing back this way and that, so that they went over on dry land.
sentences.susu: Eliya naxa a xa donma rate a ma, a a mafilinfilin, a xure garin a ra. Xure naxa itaxun firin na, e fa giri e sanyi xaraxi ra.

sentences.english: And when they had come to the other side, Elijah said to Elisha, Say what you would have me do for you before I am taken from you. And Elisha said, Be pleased to let a special measure of your spirit be on me.
sentences.susu: E to nu dangife, Eliya naxa Elise maxɔrin, «I wama n xa munse raba i bɛ beenun n xa tongo i xun ma?» Elise naxa a yaabi, «Yandi, n wama naxan xɔn, i xa xaxilimaya namiɲɔnmɛ daaxi dɔxɔ firin xa lu n ma.»

sentences.english: And he said, You have made a hard request: still, if you see me when I am taken from you, you will get your desire; but if not, it will not be so.
sentences.susu: Eliya naxa a yaabi, «I fe xɔrɔxɔɛ nan maxɔrinxi na ki, kɔnɔ xa i n to, n tongoma i xun ma tɛmui naxɛ, na rabama nɛ i bɛ. Xa n mu tongoma i ya xɔri, na mu rabama i bɛ.»

sentences.english: And while they went on their way, going on talking together, suddenly there were carriages and horses of fire separating them from one another and Elijah went up to heaven in a great wind.
sentences.susu: E sigama wɔyɛn na tɛmui naxɛ, soe nun gise tɛ daaxi naxa e rafatan, Eliya naxa te koore ma foye xungbe kui.

sentences.english: And when Elisha saw it he gave a cry, My father, my father, the carriages of Israel and its horsemen! And he saw him no longer; and he was full of grief.
sentences.susu: Elise naxa a ya ti a ra, a gbelegbele, «N baba! N baba! Isirayila xa sɛnbɛma!» Na tɛmui a mu Eliya to sɔnɔn. A naxa a xa donma ibɔɔ firin na sunnunyi kui,

sentences.english: Then he took up Elijah's robe, which had been dropped from him, and went back till he came to the edge of Jordan.
sentences.susu: a fa Eliya xa donma tongo naxan bira bɔxi ma. A naxa gbilen Yurudɛn xure dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And he took Elijah's robe, which had been dropped from him, and giving the water a blow with it, said, Where is the Lord, the God of Elijah? and at his blow the waters were parted this way and that; and Elisha went over.
sentences.susu: A naxa xure ye garin donma ra Eliya naxan lu a yi ra, a a fala, «Eliya Marigi Alatala na minden?» Xure ye man naxa itaxun firin na alɔ a singe, Elise fa giri a sanyi xaraxi ra.

sentences.english: And when the sons of the prophets who were facing him at Jericho saw him, they said, The spirit of Elijah is resting on Elisha. And they came out to him, and went down on the earth before him.
sentences.susu: Yeriko namiɲɔnmɛe nu tixi e na a matofe. E naxa a fala, «Eliya xa xaxilimaya namiɲɔnmɛ daaxi bara dangi Elise ma.» E naxa siga a ralande, e sa e igoro a bɛ bɔxi.

sentences.english: And they said, Your servants have with us here fifty strong men; be pleased to let them go in search of Elijah; for it may be that the spirit of the Lord has taken him up and put him down on some mountain or in some valley. But he said, Do not send them.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala a bɛ, «I malima gbangbalanyi mixi tongo suuli na be muxu ya ma. E xa siga i marigi fende. Tɛmunde Alatala Xaxili bara a xanin, a sa a lu geya nde kɔn na, xa na mu a ra gulunba nde kui.» A naxa e yaabi, «Wo naxa e rasiga de.»

sentences.english: But when they kept on requesting him, he was shamed and said, Send, then. So they sent fifty men; but after searching for three days, they came back without having seen him.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e to na fe maxɔrɔxɔ, a naxa tin na ra. E naxa na mixi tongo suuli xɛɛ Eliya fende. E naxa a fen xi saxan bun ma, e mu a to.

sentences.english: And they came back to him, while he was still at Jericho; and he said to them, Did I not say to you, Go not?
sentences.susu: E to gbilen Yeriko Elise yire, a naxa a fala e bɛ, «N mu a fala xɛ wo bɛ, wo naxa siga?»

sentences.english: Now the men of the town said to Elisha, You see that the position of this town is good; but the water is bad, causing the young of the cattle to come to birth dead.
sentences.susu: Yerikokae naxa a fala Annabi Elise bɛ, «Muxu marigi, i a kolon yi taa fan sabatide ra alɔ i a toxi ki naxɛ, kɔnɔ a ye mu fanxi, xɛ fe mu sɔɔnɛyaxi.»

sentences.english: So he said, Get me a new vessel, and put salt in it; and they took it to him.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo fa se sase nɛɛnɛ nde ra n bɛ, a nun fɔxɛ.» E naxa fa na ra.

sentences.english: Then he went out to the spring from which the water came, and put salt in it, and said, The Lord says, Now I have made this water sweet; no longer will it be death-giving or unfertile.
sentences.susu: A naxa siga ye dulonyi yire, a fɔxɛ woli ye ma, a fa a fala, «Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: ‹N bara yi ye yailan. A mu nimasee faxama sɔnɔn, a mu xɛ kanama sɔnɔn.›»

sentences.english: And the water was made sweet again to this day, as Elisha said.
sentences.susu: Sa kelife na lɔxɔɛ ma han to, na ye fanxi alɔ Annabi Elise a masenxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then from there he went up to Beth-el; and on his way, some little boys came out from the town and made sport of him, crying, Go up, old no-hair! go up, old no-hair!
sentences.susu: Annabi Elise naxa keli mɛnni, a te Beteli. A to nu na kira xɔn ma, dimɛdi gali naxa mini taa kui, e fa a mayelede, a falafe ra, «Dangi, i tan lɛla kanyi!»

sentences.english: And turning back, he saw them, and put a curse on them in the name of the Lord. And two she-bears came out of the wood and put forty-two of the children to death.
sentences.susu: A naxa a ya ragbilen e ma, a e danka Alatala xili ra. A to na raba, wulai sube firin naxa mini fɔtɔnyi kui, a mixi tongo naani nun firin ibɔɔ na dimɛe ra.

sentences.english: From there he went to Mount Carmel, and came back from there to Samaria.
sentences.susu: Annabi Elise to keli mɛnni, a naxa siga Karemele geya fari. A keli mɛnni nɛ, a gbilen Samari.

sentences.english: And Jehoram, the son of Ahab, became king over Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of the rule of Jehoshaphat, king of Judah; and he was king for twelve years.
sentences.susu: Akabu xa di xɛmɛ Yorami naxa ti mangɛ ra Isirayila bɔxi ma Samari, Yudaya mangɛ Yehosafati xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun solomasaxan nde ra. A mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun firin nan naba.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord; but not like his father and his mother, for he put away the stone pillar of Baal which his father had made.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma, kɔnɔ a xa yunubi rabaxi mu lu alɔ a baba nun a nga naxan naba. Yorami tan naxa Bali kuye rabira, a baba naxan ti.

sentences.english: But still he did the same sins which Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, did and made Israel do; he went on in them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a naxa bira Nebati xa di Yerobowami xa yunubi mɔɔli fɔxɔ ra, naxan a niya Isirayila ɲama xa yunubi raba. A mu tin a makuyade na fe mɔɔli ra.

sentences.english: Now Mesha, king of Moab, was a sheep-farmer; and he gave regularly to the king of Israel the wool from a hundred thousand lambs and a hundred thousand sheep.
sentences.susu: Mowaba mangɛ Mesa nu xuruse nan dɛmadonma. A nu duuti fima nɛ Isirayila mangɛ ma yɛxɛɛ yɔrɛ wulu kɛmɛ nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi wulu kɛmɛ ra, e xabee saxi na nan fari.

sentences.english: But when Ahab was dead, the king of Moab got free from the authority of the king of Israel.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ Akabu faxa xanbi, Mowaba mangɛ naxa muruta Isirayila mangɛ xili ma.

sentences.english: At that time, King Jehoram went out from Samaria and got all Israel together in fighting order.
sentences.susu: Na kui mangɛ Yorami naxa mini Samari taa kui, a sa a xa sɔɔrie xun mato a ra Isirayila bɔxi birin ma.

sentences.english: And he sent to Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, saying, The king of Moab has got free from my authority: will you go with me to make war on Moab? And he said, I will go with you: I am as you are, my people as your people, and my horses as your horses.
sentences.susu: A to a rɛdi Mowaba gerefe ma, a naxa xɛɛra xɛɛ Yudaya mangɛ Yehosafati ma, a falafe ra, «Mowaba mangɛ bara muruta n xili ma, i tinma n malide a gerede?» Yehosafati naxa a yaabi, «Won birin nan tema Mowabakae gerede. N ma ɲama, i xa ɲama nan a ra, n ma soee, i xa soee nan e ra.»

sentences.english: And he said, Which way are we to go? And he said in answer, By the waste land of Edom.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a maxɔrin, «Won tema kira mundun na?» Yehosafati naxa a yaabi, «Won tema Edon gbengberen yire nan na.»

sentences.english: So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom by a roundabout way for seven days: and there was no water for the army or for the beasts they had with them.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ, Yudaya mangɛ, nun Edon mangɛ to e ɲɛrɛ xi solofere, ye min daaxi naxa ɲɔn e xa sɔɔrie nun e xa xurusee yi ra.

sentences.english: And the king of Israel said, Here is trouble: for the Lord has got these three kings together to give them into the hands of Moab.
sentences.susu: Na kui Isirayila mangɛ naxa a fala, «Alatala bara wa won tan mangɛ saxanyie safe Mowabakae bɛlɛxɛ i.»

sentences.english: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there no prophet of the Lord here, through whom we may get directions from the Lord? And one of the king of Israel's men said in answer, Elisha, the son of Shaphat, is here, who was servant to Elijah.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Yehosafati naxa e maxɔrin, «Alatala xa namiɲɔnmɛ yo mu na won ya ma, naxan nɔma Alatala xilide won bɛ?» Isirayila mangɛ xa mixi nde naxa a yaabi, «Annabi Elise na be, Safati xa di xɛmɛ, Annabi Eliya fɔxirabirɛ.»

sentences.english: And Jehoshaphat said, The word of the Lord is with him. So the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat and the king of Edom went down to him.
sentences.susu: Yehosafati naxa a fala, «Alatala xa masenyi na a yi ra.» Isirayila mangɛ Yehosafati nun Edon mangɛ naxa goro a yire.

sentences.english: But Elisha said to the king of Israel, What have I to do with you? go to the prophets of your father and your mother. And the king of Israel said, No; for the Lord has got these three kings together to give them up into the hands of Moab.
sentences.susu: Annabi Elise naxa a fala Isirayila mangɛ bɛ, «Munse na won tan tagi? Siga i baba nun i nga xa namiɲɔnmɛe yire.» Isirayila mangɛ naxa a yaabi, «Ade, barima Alatala yi mangɛ saxanyi xilixi nɛ be, a xa fa e sa Mowabakae sagoe.»

sentences.english: Then Elisha said, By the life of the Lord of armies whose servant I am, if it was not for the respect I have for Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, I would not give a look at you, or see you.
sentences.susu: Annabi Elise naxa a fala a bɛ, «N bara n kali mangɛ Alatala ra, n naxan batuma, xa n mu binyɛ saxi Yehosafati xa ma nu, n mu tinma yati i xa ti n ya i nu.

sentences.english: But now, get me a player of music, and it will come about that while the man is playing, the hand of the Lord will come on me and I will give you the word of the Lord: and they got a player of music, and while the man was playing, the hand of the Lord was on him.
sentences.susu: Wo fa kɔra bɔnbɔɛ nde ra n bɛ.» A to kɔra bɔnbɔ fɔlɔ, Alatala naxa fa Elise ma,

sentences.english: And he said, The Lord says, I will make this valley full of water-holes.
sentences.susu: a a fala a bɛ, «Wo yili wuyaxi ge yi gulunba kui.

sentences.english: For the Lord says, Though you see no wind or rain, the valley will be full of water, and you and your armies and your beasts will have drink.
sentences.susu: Alatala yi nan masenxi, wo mu foye toma, wo mu tunɛ toma, kɔnɔ yi gulunba birin nafema nɛ ye ra, wo nun wo xa xurusee naxan minma.

sentences.english: And this will be only a small thing to the Lord: in addition he will give the Moabites into your hands.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na tan findixi fe xuri nan na Alatala bɛ. Naxan dangima a ra, a Mowabakae sama nɛ wo sagoe.

sentences.english: And you are to put every walled town to destruction, cutting down every good tree, and stopping up every water-spring, and making all the good land rough with stones.
sentences.susu: Wo e xa taa kantaxie nun e xa taa xungbee birin kanama nɛ. Wo e xa wuri bogilae birin nabirama nɛ. Wo e xa ye dulonyie birin dɛsɛma nɛ. Wo gɛmɛe rayensenma nɛ e xa xɛ fanyie ma.»

sentences.english: Now in the morning, about the time when the offering was made, they saw water flowing from the direction of Edom till the country was full of water.
sentences.susu: Na kui gɛɛsɛgɛ sɛrɛxɛ ba tɛmui, ye naxa fa keli Edon biri ra, a bɔxi makoto ye ra.

sentences.english: Now all Moab, hearing that the kings had come to make war against them, got together all who were able to take up arms and went forward to the edge of the country.
sentences.susu: Mowabakae to a mɛ a mangɛe na tefe e gerede, e naxa mixie malan naxee fata geresose ra, e fa ti Mowaba naaninyi ra.

sentences.english: And early in the morning they got up, when the sun was shining on the water, and they saw the water facing them as red as blood.
sentences.susu: E to keli gɛɛsɛgɛ gbe, soge yanbɛ nu tixi na ye ma, a fa lu Mowabakae bɛ alɔ gulunba rafexi wuli nan na.

sentences.english: Then they said, This is blood: it is clear that destruction has come on the kings; they have been fighting one another: now come, Moab, let us take their goods.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala, «Wuli nan a ra. Mangɛe bara santidɛgɛma tongo e boore xili ma, e e boore faxa. Yakɔsi, Mowabakae won xɛɛ, won sa e xa see tongo.»

sentences.english: But when they came to the tents of Israel, the Israelites came out and made a violent attack on the Moabites, so that they went in flight before them; and they went forward still attacking them;
sentences.susu: E to Isirayilakae yonkinde li, Isirayilakae naxa keli, e e bɔnbɔ han e naxa e gi e ya ra.

sentences.english: Pulling down the towns, covering every good field with stones, stopping up all the water-springs, and cutting down all the good trees; they went on driving Moab before them till only in Kir-hareseth were there any Moabites; and the fighting-men went round the town raining stones on it.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa Mowaba taae kana, e gɛmɛe ba na tɛtɛe ma, e e mawoli Mowabakae xa xɛe ma. E naxa ye dulonyie dɛsɛ gɛmɛe ra, e wuri bogilae birin nabira. Kire Xareseti taa tɛtɛ gɛmɛe nan tun nu fa luxi. Laati kanyie naxa a rabilin, e a magɔnɔ.

sentences.english: And when the king of Moab saw that the fight was going against him, he took with him seven hundred men armed with swords, with the idea of forcing a way through to the king of Aram, but they were not able to do so.
sentences.susu: Mowaba mangɛ to a to gere sɛnbɛ bara gbo a bɛ, a naxa santidɛgɛma kanyi kɛmɛ solofere tongo, e xa kira rabɔɔ sigafe ra Edon mangɛ yire, kɔnɔ e mu nɔ.

sentences.english: Then he took his oldest son, who would have been king after him, offering him as a burned offering on the wall. So there was great wrath against Israel; and they went away from him, back to their country.
sentences.susu: Na kui a naxa a xa di xɛmɛ singe tongo, naxan nu lan a xa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra, a a ba sɛrɛxɛ ra taa tɛtɛ fari. Na tɛmui, xɔnɛ belebele naxa goro Isirayilakae ma, e fa e makuya Mowaba mangɛ ra, e gbilen e xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Now a certain woman, the wife of one of the sons of the prophets, came crying to Elisha and said, Your servant my husband is dead; and to your knowledge he was a worshipper of the Lord; but now, the creditor has come to take my two children as servants in payment of his debt.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ nde xa ginɛ naxa a mawa Elise xɔn, a naxɛ, «I xa batula nde, naxan nu gaaxuma Alatala ya ra, n ma xɛmɛ nan nu a ra, kɔnɔ a bara faxa. Mixi nde, naxan xa doni nu na a ma, na bara fa n ma di firinyie tongode, e xa findi konyie ra na doni ɲɔxɔɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Then Elisha said to her, What am I to do for you? say now, what have you in the house? And she said, Your servant has nothing in the house but a pot of oil.
sentences.susu: Elise naxa a fala a bɛ, «N nɔma munse rabade i bɛ? Munse na i yi ra banxi?» Ginɛ naxa a yaabi, «Sese mu na n tan i xa konyi yi ra, fo ture pɔɔti keren.»

sentences.english: Then he said, Go out to all your neighbours and get vessels, a very great number of them.
sentences.susu: Elise naxa a fala a bɛ, «Siga, i xa se sase wuyaxi yefu. I naxa dondoronti gbansan fen, i xa a gbegbe nan fen.

sentences.english: Then go in, and, shutting the door on yourself and your sons, put oil into all these vessels, putting on one side the full ones.
sentences.susu: I na gbilen banxi, i xa naadɛ balan wo nun i xa die xun ma. I xa na ture pɔɔti keren ifili na se sase birin kui. Naxan na a rafe, i xa na dɔxɔ a xati ma.»

sentences.english: So she went away, and when the door was shut on her and her sons, they took the vessels to her and she put oil into them.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ naxa siga, a sa se sasee yefu. A naxa so a xɔnyi a naadɛ balan a tan nun a xa die xun ma. A xa die nu fa se sasee radangi a ma, a nu ture sa e kui.

sentences.english: And when all the vessels were full, she said to her son, Get me another vessel. And he said, There are no more. And the flow of oil was stopped.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ se sase ndee rafede, a naxa a fala a xa di bɛ, «Se sase gbɛtɛ man so n yi ra.» A xa di naxa a yaabi, «Se sase gbɛtɛ yo mu na fa.» Na tɛmui, ture fan naxa a iti.

sentences.english: So she came to the man of God and gave him word of what she had done. And he said, Go and get money for the oil and make payment of your debt, and let the rest be for the needs of yourself and your sons.
sentences.susu: A naxa sa na birin yaba Ala xa mixi Annabi Elise bɛ. Elise naxa a fala a bɛ, «Sa na ture mati, i fa i xa doni fi. Na tɛmui wo nun i xa die xa balo na dɔnxɔɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Now there came a day when Elisha went to Shunem, and there was a woman of high position living there, who made him come in and have a meal with her. And after that, every time he went by, he went into her house for a meal.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Annabi Elise naxa siga Sunami taa kui. Ginɛ kuntigi nde nu na mɛnni, naxan Elise karaxan a fo a xa a dɛge a xɔnyi. Sa kelife na lɔxɔɛ ma, xa Elise minima mɛnni ra, a nu a dɛgema naa nɛ.

sentences.english: And she said to her husband, Now I see that this is a holy man of God, who comes by day after day.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a fala a xa mɔri bɛ, «N a kolon, yi xɛmɛ naxan luma dangi ra won xɔnyi, Ala xa mixi sɛniyɛnxi nan a ra.

sentences.english: So let us make a little room on the wall; and put a bed there for him, and a table and a seat and a light; so that when he comes to us, he will be able to go in there.
sentences.susu: Yandi, won xa konkoe lanmadi keren yailan a bɛ banxi koore ra, won sade, teebili, gonyi, nun lanpui dɔxɔ a bɛ naa kui, alako mɛnni xa findi a malabude ra, a na fa won xɔnyi tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Now one day, when he had gone there, he went into the little room and took his rest there.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Elise naxa siga naa, a sa a malabu na konkoe kui.

sentences.english: And he said to Gehazi, his servant, Send for this Shunammite. So in answer to his voice she came before him.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a fɔxirabirɛ Gexasi bɛ, «Yi ginɛ Sunamika xili ba.» Gexasi naxa a xili, ginɛ naxa fa Elise yire.

sentences.english: And he said to him, Now say to her, See, you have taken all this trouble for us; what is to be done for you? will you have any request made for you to the king or the captain of the army? But she said, I am living among my people.
sentences.susu: Elise naxa a fala Gexasi bɛ, «A fala yi ginɛ bɛ, ‹I bara fe gbegbe raba muxu bɛ. Muxu tan nɔma munse rabade i bɛ? Muxu xa fe fanyi fala mangɛ bɛ i xa fe ra, xa na mu sɔɔrie xa mangɛ bɛ?›» Ginɛ naxa a yaabi, «N sabatixi n ma ɲama nan tagi.»

sentences.english: So he said, What then is to be done for her? And Gehazi made answer, Still there is this, she has no son and her husband is old.
sentences.susu: Na wɔyɛnyi masarɛ dangi xanbi, Elise naxa Gexasi maxɔrin, «Awa, won xa munse raba yi ginɛ bɛ?» Gexasi naxa a yaabi, «Di yo mu a bɛ, a xa mɔri fan bara fori.»

sentences.english: Then he said, Send for her. And in answer to his voice she took her place at the door.
sentences.susu: Elise naxa a fala Gexasi bɛ, «I man xa a xili.» Gexasi naxa na ginɛ xili, ginɛ naxa fa, a ti naadɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Elisha said, At this time in the coming year you will have a son in your arms. And she said, No, my lord, O man of God, do not say what is false to your servant.
sentences.susu: Elise naxa a fala a bɛ, «Yi tɛmui tamuna, i fama di baride, i a sa i kanke ma.» Ginɛ naxa a fala, «Ade n marigi, Ala xa mixi, i naxa n tan i xa konyi ginɛ mayenden.»

sentences.english: Then the woman became with child and gave birth to a son at the time named, in the year after, as Elisha had said to her.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ naxa tɛɛgɛ, a di xɛmɛ bari na tɛmui yati ma, alɔ Elise a fala a bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Now one day, when the child was older, he went out to his father to where the grain was being cut.
sentences.susu: Na di to mɔ, lɔxɔɛ nde a naxa siga a baba yire xɛ ma xɛ xaba tɛmui.

sentences.english: And he said to his father, My head, my head! And the father said to a servant, Take him in to his mother.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a baba bɛ, «N baba, n xunyi n xɔnɔma a ɲaaxi ra.» A baba naxa a fala a xa konyi bɛ, «A xanin a nga xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: And he took him in to his mother, and she took him on her knees and kept him there till the middle of the day, when his life went from him.
sentences.susu: Na konyi naxa a tongo, a a xanin a nga xɔn ma. Didi naxa lu a nga san ma han yanyi tagi, a fa faxa.

sentences.english: Then she went up and put him on the bed of the man of God, shutting the door on him, and went out.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa te a xa di ra, a a sa Ala xa mixi xa sade ma, a naadɛ balan a xun ma, a mini.

sentences.english: And she said to her husband, Send me one of the servants and one of the asses so that I may go quickly to the man of God and come back again.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa mɔri xili, a a fala a bɛ, «Yandi i xa konyi keren nun sofale keren so n yi ra, n xa siga na Ala xa mixi fɔxɔ ra, n man fama.»

sentences.english: And he said, Why are you going to him today? it is not a new moon or a Sabbath. But she said, It is well.
sentences.susu: A xa mɔri naxa a maxɔrin, «To, i sigafe a tode munfe ra? Kike Nɛɛnɛ Sali mu a ra, malabui lɔxɔɛ fan mu a ra.» A naxa a yaabi, «I naxa kɔntɔfili.»

sentences.english: Then she made the ass ready and said to her servant, Keep driving on; do not make a stop without orders from me.
sentences.susu: Na kui, ginɛ naxa a fala a sofale xa yailan a biyaasi ki ma. A naxa a fala a xa konyi bɛ, «I xa sofale raɲɛrɛ mafurenyi ra. Won naxa ti kira xɔn ma de, fo n na a fala i bɛ tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: So she went, and came to Mount Carmel, to the man of God. And when the man of God saw her coming in his direction, he said to Gehazi, his servant, See, there is the Shunammite;
sentences.susu: E naxa e xun ti Ala xa mixi yire ra Karemele geya kɔn. Ala xa mixi to sa a to yire makuye, a naxa a fala a fɔxirabirɛ bɛ, «Na ginɛ Sunamika nan fafe na ki.

sentences.english: Go quickly to her, and on meeting her say to her, Are you well? and your husband and the child, are they well? And she said in answer, All is well.
sentences.susu: I gi i sa a maxɔrin, ‹Munse niyaxi? Tana mu na i xa mɔri ma? Tana mu na i xa di ma?›» Ginɛ naxa a yaabi, «Tana yo mu na,»

sentences.english: And when she came to where the man of God was on the hill, she put her hands round his feet; and Gehazi came near with the purpose of pushing her away; but the man of God said, Let her be, for her soul is bitter in her; and the Lord has kept it secret from me, and has not given me word of it.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ a fɛfɛ Ala xa mixi yire li geya kɔn, a naxa bira a bun ma, a a sanyie suxu. Gexasi naxa wa a masigafe a marigi ra, kɔnɔ Elise naxa a fala a bɛ, «A lu na, a sunnunxi nɛ. Fe xɔrɔxɔɛ nde bara a sɔtɔ, kɔnɔ Ala na fe nɔxunxi n ma nɛ sinden, a mu n nakolonxi na ra.»

sentences.english: Then she said, Did I make a request to my lord for a son? did I not say, Do not give me false words?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui ginɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «N marigi, n di maxɔrin nɛ i ma? N mu a fala xɛ i bɛ, i naxa n mayenden?»

sentences.english: Then he said to Gehazi, Make yourself ready, and take my stick in your hand, and go: if you come across anyone on the way, give him no blessing, and if anyone gives you a blessing, give him no answer. And put my stick on the child's face.
sentences.susu: Annabi Elise naxa a fala a fɔxirabirɛ bɛ, «Keli, i i tagi ixiri, i xa n ma yisuxuwuri tongo, i siga mafuren na di yire, i n ma yisuxuwuri sa a yatagi ma. I naxa dugundi kira xɔn ma mixi xɛɛbufe ra.»

sentences.english: But the mother of the child said, As the Lord is living and as your soul is living, I will not go back without you. So he got up and went with her.
sentences.susu: Didi nga naxa a fala, «N bara n kali Alatala nun i tan xili ra, n mu sigama i xanbi.» Na kui e naxa keli, e birin naxa siga.

sentences.english: And Gehazi went on before them and put the stick on the child's face; but there was no voice, and no one gave attention. So he went back, and meeting him gave him the news, saying, The child is not awake.
sentences.susu: Gexasi tan nu bara ti yare, a Elise xa yisuxuwuri sa didi yatagi ma. Kɔnɔ na di faxaxi mu a xui yo ramini, a mu a ramaxa. Gexasi naxa gbilen Elise ralande, a dɛntɛgɛ sa a bɛ, a naxɛ, «Didi mu kelixi de.»

sentences.english: And when Elisha came into the house he saw the child dead, stretched on his bed.
sentences.susu: Annabi Elise to so banxi kui, a naxa a li didi faxaxi saxi a xa sade ma.

sentences.english: So he went in, and shutting the door on the two of them, made prayer to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Elise naxa naadɛ balan a tan nun na fure xun ma, a xa Alatala maxandi.

sentences.english: Then he got up on the bed, stretching himself out on the child, and put his mouth on the child's mouth, his eyes on his eyes and his hands on his hands; and the child's body became warm.
sentences.susu: A naxa te sade ma, a a itala didi fure fari. A naxa a dɛ sa a dɛ ma, a a ya sa a ya ma, a a bɛlɛxɛe sa a bɛlɛxɛe ma. A naxa lu na ki, han didi fate naxa wolen.

sentences.english: Then he came back, and after walking once through the house and back, he went up, stretching himself out on the child seven times; and the child's eyes became open.
sentences.susu: Elise naxa so a maɲɛrɛfe konkoe kui, a man naxa gbilen te ra didi fari. Na tɛmui didi naxa tison sanya solofere, a fa a ya rabi.

sentences.english: And he gave orders to Gehazi, and said, Send for the Shunammite. And she came in answer to his voice. And he said, Take up your son.
sentences.susu: Elise naxa Gexasi xili, a a fala a bɛ, «Yi ginɛ Sunamika xili ba.» Ginɛ to fa Elise yire, Elise naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xa di tongo.»

sentences.english: And she came in, and went down on her face to the earth at his feet; then she took her son in her arms and went out.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa fa a a xinbi sin Annabi Elise bun ma, a a sanyie suxu. Na tɛmui a naxa a xa di tongo, a mini.

sentences.english: And Elisha went back to Gilgal, now there was very little food in the land; and the sons of the prophets were seated before him. And he said to his servant, Put the great pot on the fire, and make soup for the sons of the prophets.
sentences.susu: Elise naxa gbilen Giligali. Na tɛmui kaamɛ nu dinxi bɔxi ra. Namiɲɔnmɛe to nu dɔxɔxi Annabi Elise san na, a naxa a fala a fɔxirabirɛ bɛ, «Tunde dɔxɔ tɛ ma, i xa donse nde yailan yi namiɲɔnmɛe bɛ.»

sentences.english: And one went out into the field to get green plants and saw a vine of the field, and pulling off the fruit of it till the fold of his robe was full, he came back and put the fruit, cut up small, into the pot of soup, having no idea what it was.
sentences.susu: Keren naxa mini e ya ma, a siga burunyi bogi se ndee fende. A naxa sansi nde to, a na bogi gbegbe matongo, a e sa a xa donma kui. A to so namiɲɔnmɛe yire, a naxa e maxaba, a e sa tunde kui, kɔnɔ e mu a kolon se naxan a ra.

sentences.english: Then they gave the men soup from the pot. And while they were drinking the soup, they gave a cry, and said, O man of God, there is death in the pot; and they were not able to take any more food.
sentences.susu: Donse to gɛ rafalade, e birin naxa a don fɔlɔ, kɔnɔ e fɛfɛ a raso e dɛ i, e naxa gbelegbele, e naxɛ, «Ala xa mixi, xɔnɛ nde na yi donse ma tunde kui.» E mu nɔ a donde.

sentences.english: But he said, Get some meal. And he put it into the pot, and said, Now give it to the people so that they may have food. And there was nothing bad in the pot.
sentences.susu: Elise naxa a fala, «Wo farin nde tongo.» A naxa na nde sa tunde kui, a fa a fala, «Wo yi donse sa yi mixie bɛ, e xa e dɛge.» Donse nu bara gɛ fande, xɔnɛ yo mu nu na a i fa.

sentences.english: Now a man came from Baal-shalishah with an offering of first-fruits for the man of God, twenty barley cakes and garden fruit in his bag. And he said, Give these to the people for food.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde nan fa kelife Baali Salisa. A nu fafe taami nun sansi bogi singee nan na Ala xa mixi xɔn ma, taami mɔxɔɲɛn nun mɛngi nɛɛnɛ bɛki keren. Annabi Elise naxa a fala a batula bɛ, «I xa yi donse fi yi ɲama ma, alako e xa e dɛge.»

sentences.english: But his servant said, How am I to put this before a hundred men? But he said, Give it to the people for food; for the Lord says, There will be food for them and some over.
sentences.susu: A batula naxa a fala a bɛ, «N yi donse itaxunma yi xɛmɛ kɛmɛ birin na di?» Elise naxa a fala, «Donse itaxun yi mixie ra tun, alako e xa e dɛge, barima Alatala nan a masenxi, ‹Yi mixie birin e dɛgema nɛ, taami dɔnxɔɛ man lu.›»

sentences.english: So he put it before them, and they had a meal and there was more than enough, as the Lord had said.
sentences.susu: Na kui a naxa taami itaxun e ra, e naxa a don han e luga, a dɔnxɔɛ naxa lu alɔ Ala a masen ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Now Naaman, chief of the army of the king of Aram, was a man of high position with his master, and greatly respected, because by him the Lord had given salvation to Aram; but he was a leper.
sentences.susu: Arami mangɛ xa sɔɔrie xunyi Naaman nu rafan a xa mangɛ ma. A tide nu gbo a xa mangɛ bɛ, barima Alatala xunnakeli fi Arami bɔxi ma a tan nan saabui ra. Kɔnɔ kunɛ fure nu na yi sɔɔri xunyi gbangbalanyi ma.

sentences.english: Now the Aramaeans had gone out in bands, and taken prisoner from Israel a little girl, who became servant to Naaman's wife.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Aramikae to siga Isirayila gerede, e tɛmɛdi nde suxu nɛ, e a xanin e xun ma, a xa findi Naaman xa ginɛ xa konyi ra.

sentences.english: And she said to her master's wife, If only my lord would go to the prophet in Samaria, he would make him well.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmɛdi naxa a fala a marigi bɛ, «Xa n marigi xa mɔri siga nu namiɲɔnmɛ yire, naxan na Samari, na nɔma nɛ yi kunɛ fure bade a ma nu.»

sentences.english: And someone went and said to his lord, This is what the girl from the land of Israel says.
sentences.susu: Naaman naxa na dɛntɛgɛ sa a xa mangɛ bɛ, tɛmɛdi Isirayilaka naxan falaxi a bɛ.

sentences.english: So the king of Aram said, Go then; and I will send a letter to the king of Israel. And he went, taking with him ten talents of silver and six thousand shekels of gold, and ten changes of clothing.
sentences.susu: Arami mangɛ naxa a fala Naaman bɛ, «I xa siga Samari. N bataaxɛ sɛbɛma Isirayila mangɛ ma i xa fe ra.» Naaman naxa gbeti kilo kɛmɛ saxan, xɛɛma kilo tongo senni, nun donma tofanyi fu xanin a xun ma.

sentences.english: And he took the letter to the king of Israel, in which the king of Aram had said, See, I have sent my servant Naaman to you to be made well, for he is a leper.
sentences.susu: A naxa na bataaxɛ xanin Isirayila mangɛ xɔn ma, a nu sɛbɛxi naxan kui, «N bara n ma sɔɔrie xunyi Naaman xɛɛ i yire, alako i xa kunɛ fure ba a ma.»

sentences.english: But the king of Israel, after reading the letter, was greatly troubled and said, Am I God, to give death and life? why does this man send a leper to me to be made well? is it not clear that he is looking for a cause of war?
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ to gɛ bataaxɛ xarande, a naxa a xa donma ibɔɔ, a fa a fala, «Pe, Ala nan n na, naxan faxɛ tima, naxan mixi rakisima, yi mangɛ to fa a falama n bɛ, a n xa kunɛ fure ba mixi nde ma? Wo a mato, n tan bɛ, a wama gere nan xɔn.»

sentences.english: Now Elisha, the man of God, hearing that the king of Israel had done this, sent to the king, saying, Why are you troubled? send the man to me, so that he may see that there is a prophet in Israel.
sentences.susu: Ala xa mixi Elise to a mɛ, a mangɛ bara a xa donma ibɔɔ sunnunyi kui, a naxa xɛɛra xɛɛ mangɛ ma, a falafe ra, «I i xa donma ibɔɔxi munfe ra? I naxan nabama, a xɛɛ n yire, alako a xa a kolon namiɲɔnmɛ nde na Isirayila bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: So Naaman, with all his horses and his carriages, came to the door of Elisha's house.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Naaman naxa siga a xa soee nun a xa sɔɔri ragise ra, a fa ti Annabi Elise xa banxi sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Elisha sent a servant to him, saying, Go to Jordan, and after washing seven times in its waters your flesh will be well again and you will be clean.
sentences.susu: Elise naxa mixi xɛɛ tande a falafe ra Naaman bɛ, «Sa i maxa Yurudɛn xure ma sanya solofere. Na kui i fate yalanma nɛ, i fa sɛniyɛn.»

sentences.english: But Naaman was angry and went away and said, I had the idea that he would come out to see such an important person as I am, and make prayer to the Lord his God, and with a wave of his hand over the place make the leper well.
sentences.susu: Naaman naxa xɔnɔ na wɔyɛnyi ma, a nu fa siga a fala ra, «N ɲɔxɔ a ma, a minima nɛ nu n ya i, a a Marigi Alatala maxandi, a a bɛlɛxɛ sa kunɛ yire ma n fate i, kunɛ fure xa ba n ma.

sentences.english: Are not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not be washed in them and become clean? So turning, he went away in wrath.
sentences.susu: Xure fanyi mu na n xɔnyi Damasi, alɔ Abana nun Farpara xuree, naxee dangi Isirayila xuree birin na? N mu nɔma n maxade xɛ mɛnni, n sɛniyɛn?» Na kui a naxa gbilen a xɔnɔxi ra.

sentences.english: Then his servants came to him and said, If the prophet had given you orders to do some great thing, would you not have done it? how much more then, when he says to you, Be washed and become clean?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a xa konyie naxa a fala a bɛ, «Xa yi namiɲɔnmɛ sa fe xɔrɔxɔɛ nde nan fala i bɛ nu, i mu a rabama xɛ nu? A to a falaxi i bɛ a i xa sa i maxa, a mu lanma xɛ i xa na raba?»

sentences.english: Then he went down seven times into the waters of Jordan, as the man of God had said; and his flesh became like the flesh of a little child again, and he was clean.
sentences.susu: Na kui Naaman naxa goro Yurudɛn xure, a sin a xɔɔra sanya solofere, alɔ Ala xa mixi a masen ki naxɛ. Na dangi xanbi a fate naxa fan alɔ dimɛdi, a sɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: Then he went back to the man of God, with all his train, and, taking his place before him, said, Now I am certain that there is no God in all the earth, but only in Israel: now then, take an offering from me.
sentences.susu: Naaman naxa gbilen Ala xa mixi yire, a tan nun a ɲɛrɛ booree birin na. A to so, a naxa ti a ya i, a a fala, «N bara a kolon, Ala mu na dɛdɛ xa Isirayila bɔxi xa mu a ra. Yakɔsi, n bara i mayandi, i xa n ma buɲa rasuxu.»

sentences.english: But he said, By the life of the Lord whose servant I am, I will take nothing from you. And he did his best to make him take it but he would not.
sentences.susu: Elise naxa a yaabi, «N bara n kali Alatala ra, n naxan batuma, n mu nɔma i xa buɲa rasuxude.» Naaman naxa a karaxan a xa na rasuxu, kɔnɔ a naxa tondi.

sentences.english: Then Naaman said, If you will not, then let there be given to your servant as much earth as two beasts are able to take on their backs; because from now on, your servant will make no offering or burned offering to other gods, but only to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Naaman naxa a fala Elise bɛ, «Awa yire, i naxan nabama n bɛ, i xa be bɔxi bɛndɛ nde so n tan i xa konyi yi ra, sofale firin nɔma naxan xaninde. N wama sɛrɛxɛbade tife na bɛndɛ fari, n fa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun sɛrɛxɛ gbɛtɛe ba Alatala gbansan bɛ. N mu sɛrɛxɛ yo bama ala gbɛtɛ bɛ sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: But may your servant have the Lord's forgiveness for this one thing: when my master goes into the house of Rimmon for worship there, supported on my arm, and my head is bent in the house of Rimmon; when his head is bent in the house of Rimmon, may your servant have the Lord's forgiveness for this thing.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala xa diɲɛ n ma yi fe kerenyi ma. N ma mangɛ nɛ soma a xa ala Rimɔn xa salide kui, alako a xa suyidi a bɛ, a luma n bɛlɛxɛ suxu ra a yi, na a niyama nɛ n tan fan xa n igoro bɔxi ma Rimɔn kuye xa banxi kui. Alatala xa diɲɛ n ma na xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And he said to him, Go in peace. And he went from him some distance.
sentences.susu: Elise naxa a yaabi, «Siga bɔɲɛsa kui.» Na tɛmui Naaman naxa keli a xun a siga. A to a makuya dondoronti,

sentences.english: But Gehazi, the servant of Elisha, the man of God, said, Now my master has taken nothing from Naaman, this Aramaean, of what he would have given him: by the living Lord, I will go after him and get something from him.
sentences.susu: Elise fɔxirabirɛ Gexasi naxa a fala a bɔɲɛ ma, «N marigi bara a lu yi Aramika xa siga, a mu a xa buɲa rasuxu. N bara n kali Alatala ra, n tan xa n gi a fɔxɔ ra ba, alako n xa se nde sɔtɔ a ra.»

sentences.english: So Gehazi went after Naaman. And when Naaman saw him running after him, he got down from his carriage and went back to him and said, Is all well?
sentences.susu: Awa, Gexasi naxa a gi Naaman fɔxɔ ra. Naaman to sa a to a gi ra fafe ra a fɔxɔ ra, a naxa goro mafuren a xa gise kɔn na, a sa a ralan, a a maxɔrin, «Munse niyaxi? Tana mu na?»

sentences.english: And he said, All is well: but my master has sent me, saying, Even now, two young men of the sons of the prophets have come to me from the hill-country of Ephraim; will you give me a talent of silver and two changes of clothing for them?
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «Hɛri tun. N marigi nan n xɛɛxi n xa fa a fala i bɛ, ‹Namiɲɔnmɛ xɔɲɛ firin nan faxi n xɔnyi keli Efirami geyae ma. Yandi, gbeti kilo tongo saxan nun donma firin fi n ma e bɛ.›»

sentences.english: And Naaman said, Be good enough to take two talents. And forcing him to take them, he put two talents of silver in two bags, with two changes of clothing, and gave them to his two servants to take before him.
sentences.susu: Naaman naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xa gbeti kilo tongo senni rasuxu.» A naxa a karaxan, a na gbeti sa bɛki firin kui, a nun donma firin, a e so a xa konyi firin yi ra. Nee naxa ti Gexasi ya ra, e a xanin a bɛ.

sentences.english: When he came to the hill, he took them from their hands, and put them away in the house; and he sent the men away, and they went.
sentences.susu: E to tentenyi fari li, Gexasi naxa kote rasuxu e yi ra, a a raso banxi, a fa na mixie ragbilen, nee naxa siga.

sentences.english: Then he came in and took his place before his master. And Elisha said to him, Where have you come from, Gehazi? And he said, Your servant went nowhere.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, a naxa fa a marigi yire. Annabi Elise naxa a maxɔrin, «I kelixi minden yi ki Gexasi?» Gexasi naxa a yaabi, «N mu siga dɛdɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said to him, Did not my heart go with you, when the man got down from his carriage and went back to you? Is this a time for getting money, and clothing, and olive-gardens and vine-gardens, and sheep and oxen, and men-servants and women-servants?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Elise naxa a fala a bɛ, «Naaman to goro a xa gise kui i ralande, n mu na to xɛ n bɔɲɛ ma? Yi waxati a lanma i xa gbeti, donmae, oliwi bilie, sansie, xuruse lanmae nun a xungbee, konyi ginɛe nun konyi xɛmɛe fen yi ki?

sentences.english: Because of what you have done, the disease of Naaman the leper will take you in its grip, and your seed after you, for ever. And he went out from before him a leper as white as snow.
sentences.susu: Naaman xa kunɛ fure luma nɛ i nun i bɔnsɔɛ ma abadan!» Gexasi naxa keli a ya i. Kunɛ naxa din a fate birin na, a fa rafiixɛ alɔ kunda.

sentences.english: Now the sons of the prophets said to Elisha, There is not room enough for us in the place where we are living under your care;
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ ndee naxa a fala Annabi Elise bɛ, «Yi lude xurun won bɛ.

sentences.english: So let us go to Jordan, and let everyone get to work cutting boards, and we will make a living-place for ourselves there. And he said to them, Go, then.
sentences.susu: Xa i tinma a ra, won xɛɛ Yurudɛn xure, kankan xa wuri keren keren sɛgɛ, won xa yire yailan malande ra be.» Annabi Elise naxa tin na a ra, a fa a fala e bɛ, «Wo siga,»

sentences.english: And one of them said, Be pleased to go with your servants. And he said, I will go.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ mixi nde naxa a fala e ya ma, «Yandi, i fan xa fa muxu fɔxɔ ra.» Elise naxa tin na ra, a naxɛ, «Awa, won birin na a ra.»

sentences.english: So he went with them. And when they came to Jordan, they got to work cutting down trees.
sentences.susu: Na kui e birin naxa siga Yurudɛn xure dɛ ra, e naxa so wurie sɛgɛfe.

sentences.english: But one of them, while cutting a board, let the head of his axe go into the water; and he gave a cry, and said, This is a bad business, my master, for it is another's.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde to nu wuri sɛgɛfe, a xa beera kole naxa koren, a sin ye xɔɔra. A naxa gbelegbele, a naxɛ, «Ee! N marigi, beera yefuxi nan a ra.»

sentences.english: And the man of God said, Where did it go in? and when he saw the place where it had gone into the water, cutting a stick, he put it into the water, and the iron came up to the top of the water.
sentences.susu: Ala xa mixi naxa a fala, «A biraxi minden?» A to a birade masen a bɛ, Annabi Elise naxa wuri xuntunyi nde bolon, a naxa a woli na yire yati, beera kole fa te ye fari.

sentences.english: Then he said, Take it up. So he put out his hand and took it.
sentences.susu: Elise naxa a fala a boore bɛ, «A tongo.» Boore naxa a bɛlɛxɛ itala, a beera kole tongo.

sentences.english: At that time the king of Aram was making war against Israel; and he had a meeting with the chiefs of his army and said, I will be waiting in secret in some named place.
sentences.susu: Arami mangɛ nu na Isirayila gerefe. Na kui a nu luma yire xa fe fala ra a xa kuntigie bɛ, e xa sɔɔrie fama yonkinde dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And the man of God sent to the king of Israel, saying, Take care to keep away from that place, for the Aramaeans are waiting there in secret.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala xa mixi naxa xɛɛra xɛɛ Isirayila mangɛ ma, a falafe ra, «I naxa siga na yire de, xa na mu a ra i Aramikae lima nɛ naa.»
