sentences.english: It is true that you have overcome Edom and your heart is uplifted; let that glory be enough for you, and keep in your country; why do you make causes of trouble, putting yourself, and Judah with you, in danger of downfall?
sentences.susu: I bara Edon bɔnbɔ a fanyi ra, na bara a niya i xa i yɛtɛ igbo. Sɛɛwa i xa xunnakeli ra, i xa lu i xɔnyi. I gbaloe fenfe i yɛtɛ bɛ munfe ra? I sɔntɔma nɛ, i nun Yudaya ra»

sentences.english: But Amaziah gave no attention. So Jehoash, king of Israel, went up, and he and Amaziah, king of Judah, came face to face at Beth-shemesh, which is in Judah.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Amasiya mu a tuli mati a ra. Na kui Isirayila mangɛ Yehowasa naxa siga a xili ma, a tan nun Yudaya mangɛ Amasiya naxa e bore gere Beti Semesi, Yudaya bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Judah was overcome before Israel, so that they went in flight, every man to his tent.
sentences.susu: Isirayila naxa Yudaya bɔnbɔ, e fa e gi e so e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And Jehoash, king of Israel, made Amaziah, king of Judah, the son of Jehoash, son of Ahaziah, prisoner at Beth-shemesh, and came to Jerusalem, and had the wall of Jerusalem pulled down from the doorway of Ephraim to the door in the angle, four hundred cubits.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ Yehowasa naxa Axasiya xa mamadi Amasiya findi a xa geelimani ra Beti Semesi. A naxa fa Darisalamu tɛtɛ rabira kelife Efirami xa naadɛ ra han naadɛ naxan na tunxui ma, nɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ naani ɲɔndɔn.

sentences.english: And he took all the gold and silver and all the vessels which were in the house of the Lord and in the store-house of the king, together with those whose lives would be the price of broken faith, and went back to Samaria.
sentences.susu: A naxa xɛɛma nun gbeti birin tongo naxan nu na Alatala xa banxi nun mangɛ xa banxi kui. A naxa mixi ndee fan suxu, a gbilen Samari.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoash, and his power, and how he went to war with Amaziah, king of Judah, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?
sentences.susu: Yehowasa xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, a fe fanyi naxee raba, nun a xa gere e nun Yudaya mangɛ Amasiya, na birin sɛbɛxi Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: And Jehoash went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth in Samaria with the kings of Israel; and Jeroboam his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Yehowasa naxa laaxira, e a ragata Isirayila mangɛe fɛ ma Samari. A xa di Yerobowami naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Amaziah, the son of Joash, king of Judah, went on living for fifteen years after the death of Jehoash, son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ Yehowaxasi xa di Yehowasa to faxa, Yudaya mangɛ Yowasi xa di Amasiya xa mangɛya xɔn man naxa kuya ɲɛ fu nun suuli.

sentences.english: And the rest of the acts of Amaziah, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?
sentences.susu: Amasiya xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, na sɛbɛxi Yudaya mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: Now they made a secret design against him in Jerusalem; and he went in flight to Lachish, but they sent after him to Lachish and put him to death there.
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee naxa yanfanteya maxiri a xun ma Darisalamu, a naxa a gi, a siga Lakisi. E naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra Lakisi, e sa a faxa mɛnni.

sentences.english: And they took his body on horseback and put it into the earth with his fathers in Jerusalem, the town of David.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fure xanin soe fari, e sa a ragata Darisalamu a benbae fɛ ma Dawuda xa taa kui.

sentences.english: Then all the people of Judah took Azariah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in place of his father Amaziah.
sentences.susu: Yudaya ɲama birin naxa Amasiya xa di Asaraya ti mangɛ ra a baba ɲɔxɔɛ ra. A ɲɛ fu nun senni nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: He was the builder of Elath, which he got back for Judah after the death of the king.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Amasiya xa faxɛ dangi xanbi, Asaraya naxa Elata taa ti, a a sa Yudaya xa bɔxi xun ma.

sentences.english: In the fifteenth year of the rule of Amaziah, son of Joash, king of Judah, Jeroboam, the son of Joash, king of Israel, became king in Samaria, ruling for forty-one years.
sentences.susu: Yowasi xa di Amasiya Yudaya mangɛ, xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun suuli nde ra, Yowasi xa di Yerobowami naxa ti Isirayila mangɛ ra Samari. A mangɛya ɲɛ tongo naani nun keren naba.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, not turning away from the sin which Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, did and made Israel do.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan mu rafan Ala ma, a mu gbilen Nebati xa di Yerobowami xa yunubi fɔxɔ ra, a Isirayilakae ti naxan na.

sentences.english: He got back the old limits of Israel from the way into Hamath to the sea of the Arabah, as the Lord had said by his servant Jonah, the son of Amittai, the prophet of Gath-hepher.
sentences.susu: A naxa a niya Isirayila naaninyie xa gbilen a ra kelife Lebo Xamata kɔɔla ma, han Araba baa dɛ ra yirefanyi ma, alɔ Isirayila Marigi Alatala nu bara a masen ki naxɛ Amitayi xa di Annabi Yunusa bɛ, naxan findi Gati Xeferika ra.

sentences.english: For the Lord saw how bitter was the trouble of Israel, and that everyone was cut off, he who was shut up and he who went free, and that Israel had no helper.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Isirayila xa tɔɔrɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ to, e rakisima yo mu nu na,

sentences.english: And the Lord had not said that the name of Israel was to be taken away from the earth; but he gave them a saviour in Jeroboam, the son of Joash.
sentences.susu: a naxa e rakisi Yowasi xa di Yerobowami saabui ra. A mu nu wama a xɔn Isirayila xili xa ɲɔn duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Jeroboam, and all he did, and his power, and how he went to war with Damascus, causing the wrath of the Lord to be turned away from Israel, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?
sentences.susu: Yerobowami xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, a fe fanyi naxee birin naba, nun a xa xunnakeli Damasi nun Xamata ragbilenfe ra Yudaya ma, na birin sɛbɛxi Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: And Jeroboam went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth with the kings of Israel; and Zechariah his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami naxa laaxira, e a ragata Isirayila mangɛ fɛ ma Samari. A xa di Sakari naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: In the twenty-seventh year of the rule of Jeroboam, king of Israel, Azariah, son of Amaziah, became king of Judah.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami xa mangɛya ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun solofere nde ra Isirayila xun ma, Amasiya xa di Asaraya naxa ti mangɛ ra Yudaya.

sentences.english: He was sixteen years old when he became king, and he was ruling in Jerusalem for fifty-two years; his mother's name was Jecoliah of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: A mangɛya sɔtɔ a ɲɛ fu nun senni nan ma, a fa ɲɛ tongo suuli nun firin mangɛya raba Darisalamu. A nga nu xili nɛ Yekoliya, Darisalamuka nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, as his father Amaziah had done.
sentences.susu: A Alatala waxɔnfe raba nɛ a ki ma, alɔ a baba Amasiya.

sentences.english: But he did not take away the high places, and the people still went on making offerings and burning them in the high places.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na birin kui, kuye batudee mu ɲɔn geyae yire, mixie nu luma sɛrɛxɛe nun surayi man ba ra mɛnni.

sentences.english: And the Lord sent disease on the king and he became a leper, and to the day of his death he was living separately in his private house. And Jotham his son was over his house, judging the people of the land.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa kunɛ fure sa mangɛ ma, han a faxa lɔxɔɛ. A nu sabatixi banxi nde nan kui, naxan nu na a xati ma. A xa di Yotami nan nu na a xa fɔxɔɛ xunyi ra, a man nu a xa mangɛya fan naɲɛrɛma bɔxi kui.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Azariah, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?
sentences.susu: Asaraya xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, a fe fanyi naxee birin naba, na sɛbɛxi Yudaya mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: And Azariah went to rest with his fathers and was put into the earth with his fathers in the town of David; and Jotham his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Asaraya naxa laaxira, e a ragata a benbae fɛ ma, Dawuda xa taa kui. A xa di Yotami naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: In the thirty-eighth year of Azaliah, king of Judah, Zechariah, son of Jeroboam, was king over Israel for six months.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Asaraya xa mangɛya ɲɛ tongo saxan nun solomasaxan nde ra, Yerobowami xa di Sakari naxa ti Isirayila mangɛ ra Samari, kike senni bun ma.

sentences.english: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as his father had done, not turning away from the sin which Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, did and made Israel do.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma, alɔ a benbae naxan naba. A mu gbilen Nebati xa di Yerobowami xa yunubi fɔxɔ ra, a Isirayila ti naxan na.

sentences.english: And Shallum, the son of Jabesh, made a secret design against him, and, attacking him in Ibleam, put him to death and became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Yabɛsi xa di Salumu naxa yanfanteya maxiri a xun ma, a a faxa Yibeleyami, a ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Zechariah are recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel.
sentences.susu: Sakari xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ sɛbɛxi Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: This was what the Lord had said to Jehu, Your sons to the fourth generation will be kings of Israel. And so it came about.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan kamali a xa faxɛ kui, a naxan masen Yehu bɛ, a to a masen, «I bɔnsɔɛ Isirayila yamarima nɛ han i tolontolonyi.» A raba na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Shallum, the son of Jabesh, became king in the thirty-ninth year of Uzziah, king of Judah; and he was ruling in Samaria for the space of one month.
sentences.susu: Yabɛsi xa di Salumu naxa ti mangɛ ra Isirayila, Yudaya mangɛ Osiyasi xa mangɛya ɲɛ tongo saxan nun solomanaani nde ra. A naxa mangɛya raba kike keren Samari.

sentences.english: Then Menahem, the son of Gadi, went up from Tirzah and came to Samaria, and attacking Shallum, son of Jabesh, in Samaria, put him to death and made himself king in his place.
sentences.susu: Menaxemi, Gadi xa di Salumu naxa keli Tirisa, a te Samari, a Yabɛsi xa di Salumu faxa, a ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Shallum, and the secret design which he made, are recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel.
sentences.susu: Salumu xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, nun a yanfɛ naxan ti, na sɛbɛxi Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: Then Menahem sent destruction on Tappuah and all the people in it, and its limits, from Tirzah, because they would not let him come in; and he had all the women who were with child cut open.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Menaxemi naxa keli Tirisa, a siga Tifisa taa gerede. A naxa mɛnnikae birin faxa, a nun naxee nu na naa rabilinyi, barima e mu nu tinma a xa yaamari ra. Hali ginɛ furuxie, a nu e faxa nɛ, a e furi rabɔɔ.

sentences.english: In the thirty-ninth year of Azariah, king of Judah, Menahem, the son of Gadi, became king over Israel, and was ruling in Samaria for ten years.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Asaraya xa mangɛya ɲɛ tongo saxan nun solomanaani nde ra, Gadi xa di Menaxemi naxa ti Isirayila mangɛ ra. A mangɛya ɲɛ fu nan naba Samari.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord; he did not keep himself from the sin which Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, did and made Israel do.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma. A mu gbilen Nebati xa di Yerobowami xa yunubie fɔxɔ ra, a Isirayila ɲama ti naxan na.

sentences.english: In his day, Pul, the king of Assyria, came up against the land; and Menahem gave Pul a thousand talents of silver so that he might let him keep the kingdom.
sentences.susu: Asiriya mangɛ Pulu naxa so Isirayila bɔxi kui, a xa naa gere, kɔnɔ Menaxemi naxa gbeti kilo wulu tongo saxan fi a ma, alako a xa a mali a xa mangɛya xa mabanban.

sentences.english: And Menahem got the money from Israel, from all the men of wealth, fifty silver shekels from every man, to give to the king of Assyria. So the king of Assyria went back without stopping in the land.
sentences.susu: Menaxemi naxa na kɔbiri sɔtɔ Isirayila bannae ra, mixi keren keren gbeti kole tongo suuli. A to na fi Asiriya mangɛ ma, na naxa Isirayila bɔxi gerefe lu na, a gbilen a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Menahem, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel?
sentences.susu: Menaxemi xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, nun a naxan birin naba, na sɛbɛxi Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: And Menahem went to rest with his fathers; and Pekahiah his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Menaxemi naxa laaxira, a ragata a benbae fɛ ma. A xa di Pekaxaya naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: In the fiftieth year of Azariah king of Judah, Pekahiah, the son of Menahem, became king over Israel in Samaria, ruling for two years.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Asaraya xa mangɛya ɲɛ tongo suuli nde ra, Menaxemi xa di Pekaxaya naxa ti Isirayila mangɛ ra Samari. A naxa mangɛya ɲɛ firin naba.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, not turning from the sin which Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, did and made Israel do.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma, a mu gbilen Nebati xa di Yerobowami xa yunubie fɔxɔ ra, a Isirayilakae tixi naxee ra.

sentences.english: And Pekah, the son of Remaliah, his captain, made a secret design against him, attacking him in the king's great house in Samaria; and with him were fifty men of Gilead; and he put him to death and became king in his place.
sentences.susu: A malima nde, Remaliyahu xa di Peka, naxa a yanfa, a a faxa mangɛ banxi kui Samari. Galadika mixi tongo suuli naxa a mali na kui, e Aragobo nun Ariye fan faxa. Na dangi xanbi Peka naxa ti mangɛ ra Pekaxaya ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Pekahiah, and all he did, are recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel.
sentences.susu: Pekaxaya xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, a fe fanyie naxee birin naba, na birin sɛbɛxi Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: In the fifty-second year of Azariah, king of Judah, Pekah, the son of Remaliah, became king over Israel in Samaria, ruling for twenty years.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Asaraya xa mangɛya ɲɛ tongo suuli nun firin nde ra, Remaliyahu xa di Peka naxa ti Isirayila mangɛ ra Samari. A naxa mangɛya ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn naba.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, not turning from the sin which Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, did and made Israel do.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma, A mu gbilen Nebati xa di Yerobowami xa yunubie fɔxɔ ra, a Isirayila ɲama ti naxee ra.

sentences.english: In the days of Pekah, king of Israel, Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria, came and took Ijon and Abel-beth-maacah and Janoah and Kedesh and Hazor and Gilead and Galilee and all the land of Naphtali; and he took the people away to Assyria.
sentences.susu: Peka nu mangɛ ra tɛmui naxɛ Isirayila, Asiriya mangɛ Tigilati Pileseri naxa fa, a Iyono, Abeli Beti Maaka, Yanowa, Kedesi, Xasori, Galadi, nun Galile suxu, Nafatali bɔxi birin, a na mixi birin xanin Asiriya.

sentences.english: And Hoshea, the son of Elah, made a secret design against Pekah, the son of Remaliah, and, attacking him, put him to death and became king in his place, in the twentieth year of Jotham, the son of Uzziah.
sentences.susu: Hoseya, Ela xa di xɛmɛ naxa yanfanteya maxiri, Remaliyahu xa di Peka xun ma, a na faxa. A naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra, Osiyasi xa di xɛmɛ Yotami xa mangɛya ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nde ra.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Pekah, and all he did, are recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Israel.
sentences.susu: Peka xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, a fe naxan birin naba, na sɛbɛxi Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: In the second year of Pekah, the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, Jotham, the son of Uzziah, became king of Judah.
sentences.susu: Remaliyahu xa di Peka xa mangɛya ɲɛ firin nde ra Isirayila bɔxi ma, Osiyasi xa di Yotami naxa ti mangɛ ra Yudaya xun ma.

sentences.english: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, and he was ruling for sixteen years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.
sentences.susu: A ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli nan nu a ra. A naxa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun senni raba Darisalamu. Sadɔki xa di Yerusa nan nu na a nga ra.

sentences.english: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, as his father Uzziah had done.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan nafan Alatala ma, alɔ a baba Osiyasi a raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But he did not take away the high places, and the people still went on making offerings and burning them in the high places. He was the builder of the higher doorway of the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na birin kui, kuye batudee mu ɲɔn geyae yire, mixie nu luma sɛrɛxɛe nun surayi man ba ra mɛnni. Yotami naxa Alatala xa banxi naadɛ nde ti, naxan xili Fuge Naadɛ.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?
sentences.susu: Yotami xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, a fe naxan birin naba, na sɛbɛxi Yudaya mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: In those days the Lord first sent against Judah, Rezin, the king of Aram, and Pekah, the son of Remaliah.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala naxa a niya Arami mangɛ Resin nun Remaliyahu xa di Peka xa Yudaya gere.

sentences.english: And Jotham went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth in the town of David his father; and Ahaz his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Yotami naxa laaxira, e a ragata a benbae fɛ ma a benba Dawuda xa taa kui. A xa di Axasi naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: In the seventeenth year of Pekah, the son of Remaliah, Ahaz, the son of Jotham, became king of Judah.
sentences.susu: Remaliyahu xa di Peka xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun solofere nde ra, Yotami xa di Axasi naxa ti mangɛ ra Yudaya bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Ahaz was twenty years old when he became king; he was ruling for sixteen years in Jerusalem. He did not do what was right in the eyes of the Lord his God, as David his father did.
sentences.susu: A ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nan nu a ra na tɛmui. A naxa ɲɛ fu nun senni mangɛya raba Darisalamu. A mu a Marigi Alatala waxɔnfe raba alɔ a benba Dawuda a raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But he went in the ways of the kings of Israel, and even made his son go through the fire, copying the disgusting ways of the nations whom the Lord had sent out of the land before the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: A nu birama Isirayila mangɛe xa kira nan fɔxɔ ra. A naxa a xa di yati ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, alɔ si gbɛtɛe nu a rabama ki naxɛ, Alatala naxee keri Isirayilakae ya ra.

sentences.english: And he made offerings, burning them in the high places and on the hills and under every green tree.
sentences.susu: A nu sɛrɛxɛe bama, a nu surayi gan sɛrɛxɛ ra geyae fari nun wuri bilie bun ma.

sentences.english: Then Rezin, king of Aram, and Pekah, son of Remaliah, king of Israel, came up to Jerusalem to make war; and they made an attack on Ahaz, shutting him in, but were not able to overcome him.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Arami mangɛ Resin nun Isirayila mangɛ Peka Remaliyahu xa di, naxa Darisalamu gere. E naxa Axasi rabilin a xa taa kui, kɔnɔ e mu nɔ a ra.

sentences.english: At that time the king of Edom got Elath back for Edom, and sent the Jews out of Elath; and the Edomites came back to Elath where they are living to this day.
sentences.susu: Na waxati Arami mangɛ Resin nu bara Elata taa lu Arami bɔxi xa nɔɛ bun ma. A nu bara Yuda bɔnsɔɛ tongo naa. Edonkae sabati naa e ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Nee na mɛnni han to.

sentences.english: So Ahaz sent representatives to Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria, saying, I am your servant and your son; come to my help against the kings of Aram and Israel who have taken up arms against me.
sentences.susu: Axasi naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Asiriya mangɛ Tigilati Pileseri xɔn, e xa sa a fala a bɛ, «I xa konyi nan lanxi n ma, n xaxili tixi i tan nan na. I xa fa n natangade Arami mangɛ nun Isirayila mangɛ ma, e faxi n gerede.»

sentences.english: And Ahaz took the silver and gold which were in the house of the Lord and in the king's store-house, and sent them as an offering to the king of Assyria.
sentences.susu: Axasi naxa gbeti nun xɛɛma tongo, naxan nu na Alatala xa banxi kui nun mangɛ banxi kui, a naxa a rasanba Asiriya mangɛ ma duuti ra.

sentences.english: And the king of Assyria, in answer to his request, went up against Damascus and took it, and took its people away as prisoners to Kir, and put Rezin to death.
sentences.susu: Asiriya mangɛ naxa tin na fe ra, a fa siga Damasi gerede. A to nɔ na taa ra, a naxa mɛnnikae findi konyie ra, a e rasiga Kire taa kui. A Resin faxa, mɛnni mangɛ.

sentences.english: Then King Ahaz went to Damascus for a meeting with Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria; and there he saw the altar which was at Damascus; and King Ahaz sent to Urijah the priest a copy of the altar, giving the design of it and all the details of its structure.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Axasi to siga Damasi, Asiriya mangɛ Tigilati Pileseri yire, a naxa sɛrɛxɛbade to naa. A naxa na sɛrɛxɛbade pirinti nun a yailan ki rasanba Uri sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ma Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And from the copy King Ahaz sent from Damascus, Urijah made an altar and had it ready by the time King Ahaz came back from Damascus.
sentences.susu: Uri naxa na sɛrɛxɛbade mɔɔli ti Darisalamu, beenun mangɛ Axasi xa gbilen kelife Damasi.

sentences.english: And when the king came from Damascus, he saw the altar; and he went up on it and made an offering on it.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ to gbilen kelife Damasi, a fa na sɛrɛxɛbade to, a naxa a maso a ra, a sɛrɛxɛ ba a fari.

sentences.english: He made his burned offering and his meal offering and his drink offering there, draining out the blood of his peace-offerings on the altar.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun a xa sansi xɔri sɛrɛxɛ gan na fari. A naxa wɛni sɛrɛxɛ ifili a fari, a xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ wuli makasan a ma.

sentences.english: And the brass altar, which was before the Lord, he took from the front of the house, from between his altar and the house of the Lord, and put it on the north side of his altar.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛbade naxan nu yailanxi wure gbeeli ra, naxan nu na Alatala ya i, hɔrɔmɔbanxi nun sɛrɛxɛbade nɛɛnɛ tagi, a naxa na ti sɛrɛxɛbade nɛɛnɛ fɛ ma kɔɔla biri ra.

sentences.english: And King Ahaz gave orders to Urijah the priest, saying, Make the morning burned offering and the evening meal offering and the king's burned offering and meal offering, with the burned offerings of all the people and their meal offerings and drink offerings, on the great altar, and put on it all the blood of the burned offerings and of the beasts which are offered; but the brass altar will be for my use to get directions from the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Axasi naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Uriya yamari yi ra, «Gɛɛsɛgɛ sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi, nunmare sɛrɛxɛ, mangɛ xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi, nun sansi xɔri hadiya, ɲama xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi, ɲama xa sansi xɔri hadiya, nun ɲama xa sɛrɛxɛ ture daaxi, nee birin xa ba yi sɛrɛxɛbade xungbe fari. Sɛrɛxɛbade wure gbeeli daaxi xa rawali n tan bɛ.»

sentences.english: So Urijah the priest did everything as the king said
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Uriya naxa a raba alɔ mangɛ Axasi a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And King Ahaz took off the sides of the wheeled bases, and took down the great water-vessel from off the brass oxen which were under it and put it on a floor of stone.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Axasi naxa Ala xa banxi ye sasee dɔxɔde ba a bore ra, a na ye sasee tongo e fari. A ye sase xungbe ragoro keli tuura wure gbeeli daaxie fari, a a dɔxɔ bɔxi ma. Na ye sase nu xili nɛ «Baa.»

sentences.english: ***the house of the Lord, because of the king of Assyria.
sentences.susu: A naxa malabui lɔxɔɛ malande masara Ala xa banxi kui, a nun mangɛ sode, Asiriya mangɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the things which Ahaz did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?
sentences.susu: Axasi xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, a fe naxan birin naba, na sɛbɛxi Yudaya mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: And Ahaz went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth with his fathers in the town of David; and Hezekiah his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Axasi naxa laaxira, a ragata a benbae fɛ ma Dawuda xa taa kui. A xa di Xesekiya naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: In the twelfth year of Ahaz, king of Judah, Hoshea, the son of Elah, became king over Israel in Samaria, ruling for nine years.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Axasi xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun firin nde ra, Ela xa di Hoseya naxa findi Isirayila mangɛ ra Samari. A ɲɛ solomanaani mangɛya raba.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, though not like the kings of Israel before him.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan mu rafan Ala ma, kɔnɔ a mu lu alɔ mangɛ singee, naxee xa yunubie dangi a gbe bɛ.

sentences.english: Against him came up Shalmaneser, king of Assyria, and Hoshea became his servant and sent him offerings.
sentences.susu: Asiriya mangɛ Salamanesari to sa Hoseya gere, a a lu a xa nɔɛ bun ma, Hoseya naxa tin duuti fife ra a ma.

sentences.english: But Hoshea's broken faith became clear to the king of Assyria because he had sent representatives to So, king of Egypt, and did not send his offering to the king of Assyria, as he had done year by year: so the king of Assyria had him shut up in prison and put in chains.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Asiriya mangɛ naxa a kolon fa, a Hoseya nu wama a matandife. A tondi duuti rasanbade a ma, a man xɛɛrae xɛɛ Misira mangɛ So xɔn ma, mali fende a ra. Na kui Asiriya mangɛ naxa Hoseya suxu, a a raso geeli.

sentences.english: Then the king of Assyria went through all the land and came up to Samaria, shutting it in with his forces for three years.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, a naxa din Isirayila bɔxi birin na, a Samari rabilin, ɲɛ saxan bun ma naa suxuxi a yi ra.

sentences.english: In the ninth year of Hoshea, the king of Assyria took Samaria, and took Israel away to Assyria, placing them in Halah and in Habor on the river Gozan, and in the towns of the Medes.
sentences.susu: Hoseya xa mangɛya ɲɛ solomanaani nde ra, Asiriya mangɛ naxa nɔ Samari taa ra, a Isirayilakae xanin Asiriya bɔxi ma konyiya kui. A naxa e rasabati Xala taa kui Gosan bɔxi ma Xaboro xure dɛ ra, a nun Medekae xa taae kui.

sentences.english: And the wrath of the Lord came on Israel because they had done evil against the Lord their God, who took them out of the land of Egypt from under the yoke of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and had become worshippers of other gods,
sentences.susu: Na fe birin naba nɛ, barima Isirayilakae nu bara yunubi raba e Marigi Alatala ra, naxan e ramini Misira bɔxi ra Firawuna xa nɔɛ bun ma. Isirayila nu bara bira ala gbɛtɛe fɔxɔ ra,

sentences.english: Living by the rules of the nations whom the Lord had sent out from before the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: e nu e batu alɔ si booree Alatala naxee kerixi e ya ra. Isirayilakae nu bara e tuli mati e xa mangɛe ra na fe kui.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel did secretly against the Lord their God things which were not right, building high places for themselves in all their towns, from the tower of the watchmen to the walled town.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae nu bara fee raba gundo ra e Marigi Alatala ra, e mu lan e xa naxee raba. E nu bara kuye batudee yailan yire itexie e xa taae birin kui, keli yire makantadee ma han taa makantaxie kui.

sentences.english: They put up pillars of stone and wood on every high hill and under every green tree:
sentences.susu: E naxa gɛmɛ masolixie nun Asera kuyee ti geyae kɔn na, wurie bun ma.

sentences.english: Burning their offerings in all the high places, as those nations did whom the Lord sent away from before them; they did evil things, moving the Lord to wrath;
sentences.susu: Mɛnni, e naxa surayi gan sɛrɛxɛ ra na kuyee bɛ, alɔ sie nu a rabama ki naxɛ, Alatala naxee keri e ya ra. E naxa Alatala matandi e xa na fe ɲaaxie ra.

sentences.english: And they made themselves servants of disgusting things, though the Lord had said, You are not to do this.
sentences.susu: E nu kuyee batuma, hali Alatala to bara nu tɔnyi dɔxɔ na fe ma, a falafe ra, «Wo naxa na mɔɔli raba.»

sentences.english: And he gave witness to Israel and Judah, by every prophet and seer, saying, Come back from your evil ways, and do my orders and keep my rules, and be guided by the law which I gave to your fathers and sent to you by my servants the prophets.
sentences.susu: Alatala nu bara Isirayila nun Yudaya rakolon na birin na a xa namiɲɔnmɛe saabui ra. A nu bara a fala, «Wo xa gbilen wo xa wali kobie fɔxɔ ra. Wo xa bira n ma yaamarie nun n ma tɔnyie fɔxɔ ra, alɔ n ma sɛriyɛ a masenxi ki naxɛ, n naxan yamari wo benbae ra n ma konyi namiɲɔnmɛe saabui ra.»

sentences.english: And they did not give ear, but became stiff-necked, like their fathers who had no faith in the Lord their God.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e mu e tuli mati Alatala ra. E naxa e bɔɲɛ raxɔrɔxɔ, alɔ e benbae naxee mu danxaniya e Marigi Alatala ma.

sentences.english: And they went against his rules, and the agreement which he made with their fathers, and his laws which he gave them; they gave themselves up to things without sense or value, and became foolish like the nations round them, of whom the Lord had said, Do not as they do.
sentences.susu: E naxa Alatala xa yaamarie matandi, e a xa saatɛ kana naxan nu xirixi Ala nun e benbae tagi. E naxa bira fe fufafu fɔxɔ ra, e e yɛtɛ findi fuyantee ra. E naxa bira sie xa naamunyie fɔxɔ ra, naxee e rabilinxi, Alatala tɔnyi dɔxɔ naxee ma.

sentences.english: And turning their backs on all the orders which the Lord had given them, they made for themselves images of metal, and the image of Asherah, worshipping all the stars of heaven and becoming servants to Baal.
sentences.susu: E naxa e Marigi Alatala xa yaamarie birin matandi. E naxa ninge wure daaxi firin yailan kuyee ra, e naxa Asera kuye masoli wuri ra, e naxa suyidi tunbuie bɛ, e naxa Bali kuye batu.

sentences.english: And they made their sons and their daughters go through the fire, and they made use of secret arts and unnatural powers, and gave themselves up to doing evil in the eyes of the Lord, till he was moved to wrath.
sentences.susu: E naxa e xa di xɛmɛe nun e xa di ginɛe ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra. E naxa bira duureya nun sematofe fɔxɔ ra. E naxa e yɛtɛ fi ala gbɛtɛe ma, e fe raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma.

sentences.english: So the Lord was very angry with Israel, and his face was turned away from them: only the tribe of Judah kept its place.
sentences.susu: Na nan a niya Alatala naxa xɔnɔ Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ ma, a fa e makuya a ya tode ra. Yuda bɔnsɔɛ keren nan lu fa.

sentences.english: (But even Judah did not keep the orders of the Lord their God, but were guided by the rules which Israel had made.
sentences.susu: Hali Yuda bɔnsɔɛ, e mu nu birama e Marigi Alatala xa yaamarie fɔxɔ ra a raba ki ma. E fan naxa bira Isirayila xa misaali fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: So the Lord would have nothing to do with all the offspring of Israel, and sent trouble on them, and gave them up into the hands of their attackers, till he had sent them away from before his face.)
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa mɛɛ Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin na, a naxa e ɲaxankata, a e rabolo a xunnakanamae bɛlɛxɛ i, a e keri a ya tode ra.

sentences.english: For Israel was broken off from the family of David, and they made Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, king, who, driving them away from the laws of the Lord, made them do a great sin.
sentences.susu: A to Isirayila ba Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ ra, a naxa e lu Nebati xa di Yerobowami xa mangɛya bun ma, naxan bara e ragbilen Alatala fɔxɔ ra a xa yunubi xungbe saabui ra.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel went on with all the sins which Jeroboam did; they did not keep themselves from them;
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa bira Yerobowami xa yunubie birin fɔxɔ ra. E mu e makuya nee ra,

sentences.english: Till the Lord put Israel away from before his face, as he had said by all his servants the prophets. So Israel was taken away from their land to Assyria, to this day.
sentences.susu: han Alatala naxa Isirayila makuya a ya tode ra, alɔ a a masen a xa konyi namiɲɔnmɛe bɛ ki naxɛ. Na kui Isirayilakae naxa makuya e xa bɔxi ra, e sa lu Asiriya bɔxi ma han to.

sentences.english: Then the king of Assyria took men from Babylon and from Cuthah and Avva and Hamath and Sepharvaim, and put them in the towns of Samaria in place of the children of Israel; so they got Samaria for their heritage, living in its towns.
sentences.susu: Asiriya mangɛ naxa fa mixie ra keli Babilɔn, Kuta, Awi, Xamata, nun Sefarawayimi, a fa nee lu Samari taae kui Isirayilakae ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Na kui e naxa Samari findi e gbe ra, e sabati naa.

sentences.english: Now when first they were living there they did not give worship to the Lord. So the Lord sent lions among them, causing the death of some of them.
sentences.susu: Nee to mu nu gaaxuma Alatala ya ra, Alatala naxa yɛtɛe radin e ma, e nu e faxa.

sentences.english: So they said to the king of Assyria, The nations whom you have taken as prisoners and put in the towns of Samaria, have no knowledge of the way of the god of the land: so he has sent lions among them, causing their death, because they have no knowledge of his way.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala Asiriya mangɛ bɛ, «I mixi naxee xaninxi e xa sabati Samari bɔxi ma, nee mu mɛnni alae batu ki kolon. Naa alae bara yɛtɛe radin e ma e e faxa a kolontareya ma.»

sentences.english: Then the king of Assyria gave orders, saying, Send there one of the priests whom you took away, and let him be living there and teaching the people the way of the god of the land.
sentences.susu: Asiriya mangɛ naxa yi yaamari fi, «Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nde xa sabati na bɔxi ma, a xa e xaran na bɔxi alae batu ki ra.»

sentences.english: So one of the priests whom they had taken away as a prisoner from Samaria came back, and, living in Beth-el, became their teacher in the worship of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ keren, naxan nu bara xanin Asiriya bɔxi ma, na naxa siga Beteli taa kui Samari bɔxi ma, a mɛnnikae xaran Alatala yaragaaxui ra.

sentences.english: And every nation made gods for themselves, and put them in the houses of the high places which the Samaritans had made, every nation in the towns where they were living.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na sie, kankan nu a gbe alae tima na kuye banxie kui, Samarikae nu bara naxee ti e xa taae kui nun yire itexie fari.

sentences.english: The men of Babylon made Succoth-benoth, and the men of Cuth made Nergal, and the men of Hamath made Ashima,
sentences.susu: Babilɔnkae naxa Sukɔti Bɛnɔti kuye ti. Kutakae naxa Nerigali kuye ti. Xamatakae naxa Asima kuye ti.

sentences.english: The Avvites made Nibhaz and Tartak, and the Sepharvites gave their children to be burned in the fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim.
sentences.susu: Awikae naxa Nibahasi nun Taritaki kuye ti. Sefarawayimikae tan nu luma e xa die nan ba ra sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra e xa kuyee, Adarameleki nun Anameleki bɛ.

sentences.english: So they went on worshipping the Lord, and made for themselves, from among all the people, priests for the high places, to make offerings for them in the houses of the high places.
sentences.susu: Na sie to nu gaaxuma Alatala fan ya ra, e nu mixi mɔɔli nan birin tima Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra, nee xa nu sɛrɛxɛe ba e bɛ na yire itexie fari.

sentences.english: They gave worship to the Lord, but they gave honour to their gods like the nations did from whom they had been taken as prisoners.
sentences.susu: Na kui, e nu Alatala batuma, kɔnɔ e man nu e gbe kuye fan batuma e gbe ki ma.

sentences.english: So to this day they go on in their old ways, not worshipping the Lord or keeping his orders or his ways or the law and the rule which the Lord gave to the children of Jacob, to whom he gave the name Israel;
sentences.susu: Han to e birama na naamun forie fɔxɔ ra, e mu gaaxuma Alatala ya ra. E mu nu e yɛtɛ xa naamunyie rakamalima, e man mu nu Alatala xa sɛriyɛ fan nakamalima, a naxan so Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ yi ra, a naxan xili sa Isirayila.

sentences.english: And the Lord made an agreement with them and gave them orders, saying, You are to have no other gods; you are not to give worship to them or be their servants or make them offerings:
sentences.susu: Alatala nu bara yi saatɛ tongo e bɛ, a e yamari yi ra, «Wo naxa gaaxu ala gbɛtɛe ya ra, wo naxa suyidi e bɛ, wo naxa e batu, wo naxa sɛrɛxɛ yo ba e bɛ.

sentences.english: But the Lord, who took you out of the land of Egypt with his great power and his outstretched arm, he is your God, to whom you are to give worship and make offerings:
sentences.susu: A lanma wo xa gaaxu Alatala nan keren ya ra, naxan wo raminixi Misira bɔxi ma a sɛnbɛ xungbe ra. Wo xa suyidi a tan nan bɛ, wo man xa sɛrɛxɛ ba a keren nan bɛ.

sentences.english: And the rules and the orders and the law which he put in writing for you, you are to keep and do for ever; you are to have no other gods.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo ɲɔxɔ sa a xa kiraya, a xa sɛriyɛ nun a xa yaamarie xɔn ma lɔxɔɛ birin, a naxee sɛbɛxi wo bɛ. Wo naxa gaaxu ala gbɛtɛe ya ra.

sentences.english: And you are to keep in memory the agreement which I have made with you; and you are to have no other gods.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa nɛɛmu n ma saatɛ ma, wo naxa gaaxu ala gbɛtɛe ya ra.

sentences.english: And you are to give worship to the Lord your God; for it is he who will give you salvation from the hands of all who are against you.
sentences.susu: A lanma wo xa gaaxu wo Marigi Alatala nan ya ra, barima a tan nan wo baxi wo yaxuie birin bɛlɛxɛ i.»

sentences.english: But they gave no attention, but went on in their old way.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e mu e tuli mati Alatala xui ra, e naxa bira e xa naamunyi forie fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: So these nations, worshipping the Lord, still were servants to the images they had made; their children and their children's children did the same; as their fathers did, so do they, to this day.
sentences.susu: Yi sie nu Alatala batuma, e man nu e xa kuye masolixie fan batuma. E xa die nun nee fan ma die na e benbae xa kira nan xɔn ma han to.

sentences.english: Now in the third year of Hoshea, son of Elah, king of Israel, Hezekiah, the son of Ahaz, became king of Judah.
sentences.susu: Ela xa di Hoseya xa mangɛya ɲɛ saxan nde ra, Axasi xa di Xesekiya naxa ti mangɛ ra Yudaya bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: He was twenty-five years old when he became king, ruling in Jerusalem for twenty-nine years; his mother's name was Abi, the daughter of Zechariah.
sentences.susu: A ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli nan nu a ra. A naxa mangɛya ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun solomanaani raba Darisalamu. A nga nu xili nɛ Abi, Sakari xa di ginɛ.

sentences.english: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord as David his father had done.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan nafan Alatala ma, alɔ a benba Dawuda a raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: He had the high places taken away, and the stone pillars broken to bits, and the Asherah cut down; and the brass snake which Moses had made was crushed to powder at his order, because in those days the children of Israel had offerings burned before it, and he gave it the name Nehushtan.
sentences.susu: A kuye batudee kana yire itexie fari, a gɛmɛ masolixie iwuru, a Asera kuye bolon. A naxa bɔximase wure gbeeli daaxi fan kana, Annabi Munsa naxan yailan, barima Isirayilakae nu surayi ganma a fan bɛ sɛrɛxɛ ra, e nu a xili Nexusetana.

sentences.english: He had faith in the Lord, the God of Israel; so that there was no one like him among all the kings of Judah who were before him.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya nu a xa lanlanteya sama Isirayila Marigi Alatala ma dangife Yudaya mangɛ birin na.

sentences.english: For his heart was fixed on the Lord, not turning from his ways, and he did his orders which the Lord gave to Moses.
sentences.susu: A bɔɲɛ nu xirixi Alatala ra, a tondi a xa kira bɛɲinde, a bira Alatala xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra, a naxan so Annabi Munsa yi ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord was with him; he did well in all his undertakings: and he took up arms against the king of Assyria and was his servant no longer.
sentences.susu: Alatala nu luma a sɛɛti ma, a a niya a xa fe birin xa nu sɔɔnɛya ra. Xesekiya naxa tondi lude Asiriya xa mangɛya bun ma.

sentences.english: He overcame the Philistines as far as Gaza and its limits, from the tower of the watchman to the walled town.
sentences.susu: A naxa Filisitakae bɔnbɔ han Gasa mabiri, kelife e xa yire makantadee ma han e xa taa makantaxi kui.

sentences.english: Now in the fourth year of King Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea, son of Elah, king of Israel, Shalmaneser, king of Assyria, came up against Samaria, shutting it in with his armies.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya xa mangɛya ɲɛ naani nde ra, naxan ilan Ela xa di Hoseya xa mangɛya ɲɛ solofere nde ra Isirayila, Asiriya mangɛ Salamanesari naxa fa Samari gerede, a a rabilin.

sentences.english: And at the end of three years they took it; in the sixth year of Hezekiah's rule, which was the ninth year of Hoshea, king of Israel, Samaria was taken.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ saxan dangi xanbi, Xesekiya xa mangɛya ɲɛ senni nde nan nu a ra, Isirayila mangɛ Hoseya fan xa mangɛya ɲɛ solomanaani nde, Samari naxa lu Asiriyakae bɛlɛxɛ i.

sentences.english: And the king of Assyria took Israel away as prisoners into Assyria, placing them in Halah and in Habor on the river Gozan, and in the towns of the Medes;
sentences.susu: Asiriya mangɛ naxa Isirayilakae xanin Asiriya bɔxi ma Xala mabiri nun Xaboro dɛ ra Gosan xure, a nun Medekae xa taae kui.

sentences.english: Because they did not give ear to the voice of the Lord their God, but went against his agreement, even against everything ordered by Moses, the servant of the Lord, and they did not give ear to it or do it.
sentences.susu: E Marigi Alatala na raba nɛ e ra, barima e tondi nɛ e tuli matide a ra, e a xa saatɛ kana. E mu Alatala xa konyi Annabi Munsa xa sɛriyɛ rabatu.

sentences.english: Now in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, Sennacherib, king of Assyria, came up against all the walled towns of Judah and took them.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Xesekiya xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun naani nde ra, Asiriya mangɛ Senaxeribi naxa Yudaya taa makantaxie gere, a nɔ e ra.

sentences.english: And Hezekiah, king of Judah, sent to Lachish, to the king of Assyria, saying, I have done wrong; give up attacking me, and whatever you put on me I will undergo. And the payment he was to make was fixed by the king of Assyria at three hundred talents of silver and thirty talents of gold.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Xesekiya naxa xɛɛra xɛɛ Asiriya mangɛ ma Lakisi, a naxɛ, «Diɲɛ, n bara won ma saatɛ kana. Gbilen n fɔxɔ ra, n xa tin i waxɔnfe birin na.» Na kui, Asiriya mangɛ naxa Xesekiya yamari a xa fa gbeti kilo wulu solomanaani, a nun xɛɛma kilo kɛmɛ solomanaani ra.

sentences.english: So Hezekiah gave him all the silver in the house of the Lord, and in the king's store-house.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa gbeti birin fi a ma, naxan nu na Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi nun mangɛ banxi kui.

sentences.english: And at that time Hezekiah had the gold from the doors of the Lord's house, and from the door-pillars plated by him, cut off and gave it to the king of Assyria.
sentences.susu: A naxa gbeti nun xɛɛma ba, naxan nu fatuxi Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛe nun e gbanyie ma, a na birin fi Asiriya mangɛ ma.

sentences.english: Then the king of Assyria sent the Tartan and the Rab-saris and the Rab-shakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem, to King Hezekiah, with a strong force. And they went up and came to Jerusalem, and took up their position by the stream of the higher pool, by the highway of the washerman's field.
sentences.susu: Asiriya mangɛ naxa a xa sɔɔri mangɛ, a xa kuntigie xunyi, nun a rasima singe xɛɛ Xesekiya xɔn ma Darisalamu, kelife ra Lakisi. E to Darisalamu li, e naxa ti ye yire xungbe fɛ ma, mixie nu garɛ soma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And they sent for the king, and Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, who was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, came out to them.
sentences.susu: E naxa mangɛ xili mɛnni. Xilikiya xa di Eliyakimi, mangɛ xa banxi xunyi, mangɛ xa sɛbɛliti Sebena, nun Asafi xa di Yowa, naxan findixi mangɛ xa kɛɛdi ragatɛ ra, nee naxa mini Asiriyakae ralande.

sentences.english: And the Rab-shakeh said to them, Say now to Hezekiah, These are the words of the great king, the king of Assyria: In what are you placing your hope?
sentences.susu: Asiriya mangɛ rasima singe naxa yi masenyi ti e bɛ, «Wo a fala Xesekiya bɛ, Asiriya mangɛ xungbe yi nan masenxi, ‹I xaxili tixi munse ra?

sentences.english: You say you have a design, and strength for war, but these are only words. Now to whom are you looking for support, that you have gone against my authority?
sentences.susu: I wɔyɛn fufafu nan tun falaxi! I ɲɔxɔ a ma a i bara fɛɛrɛ nun sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ n gerefe ra? I laxi nde ra, naxan a niyama i xa n matandi?

sentences.english: See, now, you are basing your hope on that broken rod of Egypt, which will go through a man's hand if he makes use of it for a support; for so is Pharaoh, king of Egypt, to all who put their faith in him.
sentences.susu: I i xa lanlanteya saxi Misirakae nan ma fa? E luxi alɔ wuri ponpoe naxan girama, a fa i sɔxɔ i kilɔnma a ra tɛmui naxɛ. Misira mangɛ Firawuna na na ki nɛ mixi birin bɛ, naxee e xaxili tixi a ra.

sentences.english: And if you say to me, Our hope is in the Lord our God: is it not he, whose high places and altars Hezekiah has taken away, saying to Judah and Jerusalem that worship may only be given before this altar in Jerusalem?
sentences.susu: Tɛmunde wo n yaabima nɛ, «Muxu xaxili tixi muxu Marigi Alatala nan na.» Kɔnɔ n xa a fala wo bɛ Xesekiya bara gɛ sɛrɛxɛbadee kanade geyae fari, a fa a fala Yudayakae nun Darisalamukae bɛ, «Wo Alatala batu Darisalamu xa sɛrɛxɛbade gbansan nɛ.»›»

sentences.english: And now, take a chance with my master, the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able to put horsemen on them.
sentences.susu: «Xa i sa nɔma soe ragi wulu firin sɔtɔde i xa ɲama ya ma, n marigi Asiriya mangɛ soe fima nɛ i ma, e naxee ragima.

sentences.english: How then may you put to shame the least of my master's servants? and you have put your hope in Egypt for war-carriages and horsemen:
sentences.susu: Hali i i xaxili ti Misirakae ra, soe ragie nun gisee xa fe ra, i sɛnbɛ xurun n ma mangɛ xa mixi xuri di nde nɔfe ra.

sentences.english: And have I now come up to send destruction on this place without the Lord's authority? It was the Lord himself who said to me, Go up against this land and make it waste.
sentences.susu: Bafe na ra, wo marigi Alatala xa mu waxi n xa be gere? Alatala nan a falaxi n bɛ, ‹Siga, i na bɔxi kana.›»

sentences.english: Then Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, and Shebna and Joah said to the Rab-shakeh, Will you kindly make use of the Aramaean language in talking to your servants, for we are used to it, and do not make use of the Jews' language in the hearing of the people on the wall.
sentences.susu: Xilikiya xa di Eliyakimi, Sebena, nun Yowa naxa a fala Asiriya mangɛ rasima bɛ, «Yandi, i xa wɔyɛn muxu bɛ Arami xui ra, muxu tan i xa konyie na xui fahaamuma. I naxa wɔyɛn muxu bɛ Yuda xui ra ɲama ya xɔri naxan na tɛtɛ fari.»

sentences.english: But the Rab-shakeh said to them, Is it to your master or to you that my master has sent me to say these words? has he not sent me to the men seated on the wall? for they are the people who will be short of food with you when the town is shut in.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Asiriya mangɛ rasima naxa e yaabi, «N marigi n xɛɛxi yi masenyi falade i xa mangɛ nun i tan nan gbansan bɛ? N mu wɔyɛnfe yi mixie fan xa bɛ, naxee dɔxɔxi tɛtɛ fari yi ki, naxee fama e yɛtɛ xa gbi fuxi donde nun e yɛtɛ xɔli minde nun wo tan na?»

sentences.english: Then the Rab-shakeh got up and said with a loud voice in the Jews' language, Give ear to the words of the great king, the king of Assyria;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ rasima naxa keli, a a fala a xui itexi ra Yudaya xui ra, a naxɛ, «Wo wo tuli mati Asiriya mangɛ xungbe xa masenyi ra,

sentences.english: This is what the king says: Do not be tricked by Hezekiah, for there is no salvation for you in him.
sentences.susu: ‹Wo naxa tin Xesekiya xa wo madaxu, barima a mu fata wo ratangade n bɛlɛxɛ i!

sentences.english: And do not let Hezekiah make you put your faith in the Lord, saying, The Lord will certainly keep us safe, and this town will not be given into the hands of the king of Assyria.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa tin a xa wo madaxu wo xaxili tife Alatala ra, a falafe ra, «Alatala muxu rakisima nɛ, yi taa mu luma Asiriyakae xa mangɛ sagoe.»

sentences.english: Do not give ear to Hezekiah, for this is what the king of Assyria says: Make peace with me and come out to me; and everyone will be free to take the fruit of his vine and of his fig-tree, and the water of his spring;
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo tuli mati Xesekiya ra de! Asiriya mangɛ yi nan falaxi, «Xa wo tin lude n ma yaamari bun ma, kankan fama a xa xɛɛ bogisee donde, kankan a xa kɔlɔnyi ye min,

sentences.english: Till I come and take you away to a land like yours, a land of grain and wine, a land of bread and vine-gardens, a land of oil-giving olives and of honey, so that life and not death may be your fate. Give no attention to Hezekiah when he says to you, The Lord will keep us safe.
sentences.susu: han n sa fama wo xaninde bɔxi nde ma tɛmui naxɛ, naxan luxi alɔ wo xa bɔxi, mɛngi nun wɛni fanyi, taami nun wɛni xɛe, oliwi bilie nun kumi na dɛnnaxɛ. Na kui, wo baloma nɛ a fanyi ra, wo ratanga faxɛ ma.» Wo naxa wo tuli mati Xesekiya ra, naxan wama wo madaxufe a falafe ra, «Marigi Alatala won nakisima nɛ.»

sentences.english: Has any one of the gods of the nations kept his land from falling into the hands of the king of Assyria?
sentences.susu: Si gbɛtɛe xa alae nɔ nɛ e xa mixie bade Asiriya mangɛ bɛlɛxɛ i?

sentences.english: Where are the gods of Hamath and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim, of Hena and Ivvah? have they kept Samaria out of my hands?
sentences.susu: Xamata nun Arapadi xa alae go? Sefarawayimi, Hena nun Iwa xa alae go? Nee bara Samari ba n bɛlɛxɛ i?

sentences.english: Who among all the gods of these countries have kept their country from falling into my hands, to give cause for the thought that the Lord will keep Jerusalem from falling into my hands?
sentences.susu: Ɲamanɛe birin xa alae ya ma, ala mundun a xa mixie rakisixi n bɛlɛxɛ i? Alatala tan nɔma Darisalamu ratangade n ma?›»

sentences.english: But the people kept quiet and gave him no answer: for the king's order was, Give him no answer.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa dundu, e mu a yaabi, barima mangɛ a fala nɛ, «Wo naxa a yaabi de.»

sentences.english: Then Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, who was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah, with their clothing parted as a sign of grief, and gave him an account of what the Rab-shakeh had said.
sentences.susu: Xilikiya xa di Eliyakimi, mangɛ xa banxi xunyi, Sebena sɛbɛliti, nun Asafi xa di Yowa kɛɛdi ragatɛ, nee naxa siga mangɛ Xesekiya yire e xa sosee ibɔɔxi e ma sunnunyi kui, e fa Asiriya mangɛ rasima xa masenyi dɛntɛgɛ a bɛ.

sentences.english: And on hearing it, King Hezekiah took off his robe, and put on haircloth, and went into the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Xesekiya to na fe mɛ, a naxa a xa donma ibɔɔ a ma, a bɛki dugi ragoro a ma sunnunyi kui, a fa siga Alatala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and the chief priests, dressed in haircloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa banxi xunyi Eliyakimi, a xa sɛbɛliti Sebena, nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ forie xɛɛ Amosu xa di Annabi Esayi xɔn, bɛki dugi ragoroxi e ma.

sentences.english: And they said to him, Hezekiah says, This day is a day of trouble and punishment and shame; for the children are ready to come to birth, but there is no strength to give birth to them.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala a bɛ, Xesekiya yi nan falaxi, «To findixi sunnunyi, ɲaxankatɛ, nun bɔɲɛ maɲaaxu lɔxɔɛ nan na. A luxi alɔ die bari tɛmui bara a li, kɔnɔ sɛnbɛ mu na sɔnɔn e xa bari.

sentences.english: It may be that the Lord your God will give ear to the words of the Rab-shakeh, whom the king of Assyria, his master, sent to say evil things against the living God, and will make his words come to nothing: so then make your prayer for the rest of the people.
sentences.susu: I Marigi Alatala na Asiriya mangɛ xa xɛɛra xa masenyi mɛ Ala ɲiɲɛ rasɔtɔfe ra, tɛmunde a a ɲaxankatama nɛ a xa na wɔyɛnyie ma. I xa Ala maxandi alako won ma mixi dɔnxɔɛe naxa faxa.»

sentences.english: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Xesekiya xa mixie naxa siga Annabi Esayi yire.

sentences.english: And Isaiah said to them, This is what you are to say to your master: The Lord says, Be not troubled by the words which the servants of the king of Assyria have said against me in your hearing.
sentences.susu: Esayi naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo a fala wo xa mangɛ bɛ, Alatala yi masenyi nan tixi, ‹I naxa gaaxu Asiriya mangɛ xa xɛɛrae xa marasɔtɔɛe xa fe ra, a naxee falaxi n bɛ.

sentences.english: See, I will put a spirit into him, and bad news will come to his ears, and he will go back to his land; and there I will have him put to death by the sword.
sentences.susu: N fama a xaxili mafindide xibaarui nde ra, a fa gbilen a xɔnyi. N a faxama santidɛgɛma ra mɛnni nɛ.›»

sentences.english: So the Rab-shakeh went back, and when he got there the king of Assyria was making war against Libnah, for it had come to his ears that he had gone away from Lachish.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa xɛɛra to gbilen Asiriya mangɛ yire, a naxa a li a xa mangɛ nu bara keli Lakisi, a nu na Libina gerefe.

sentences.english: And when news came to him that Tirhakah, king of Ethiopia, had made an attack on him, he sent representatives to Hezekiah again, saying,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Asiriya mangɛ naxa a kolon a Kusi mangɛ Tirihaka na fafe a gerede. Na kui a man naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Xesekiya ma, a falafe ra,

sentences.english: This is what you are to say to Hezekiah, king of Judah: Let not your God, in whom is your faith, give you a false hope, saying, Jerusalem will not be given into the hands of the king of Assyria.
sentences.susu: «Wo a fala Yudaya mangɛ Xesekiya bɛ, ‹I xa ala, i laxi naxan na, na naxa i madaxu de a falafe ra, «Darisalamu mu luma Asiriya mangɛ bɛlɛxɛ i.»

sentences.english: No doubt the story has come to your ears of what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, putting them to the curse; and will you be kept safe?
sentences.susu: I a kolon a fanyi ra Asiriya mangɛe naxan nabaxi ɲamanɛe birin na. E e sɔntɔ nɛ a ɲaaxi ra. I tan fa fama i bade n yi ra di?

sentences.english: Did the gods of the nations keep safe those on whom my fathers sent destruction, Gozan and Haran and Rezeph and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?
sentences.susu: N benbae si naxee bɔnbɔ, e xa alae e ratanga nɛ, alɔ Gosan, Xarani, Resefa, nun Eden bɔnsɔɛ naxee na Teli Asari?

sentences.english: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the town of Sepharvaim, of Hena and of Ivvah?
sentences.susu: Xamata mangɛ, Arapadi mangɛ, Sefarawayimi mangɛ, Hena mangɛ, nun Iwa mangɛ na minden?›»

sentences.english: And Hezekiah took the letter from the hands of those who had come with it; and after reading it, Hezekiah went up to the house of the Lord, opening the letter there before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa bataaxɛ rasuxu xɛɛrae yi ra, a naxa a xaran. Na dangi xanbi, a naxa te Alatala xa banxi, a a itala Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: And Hezekiah made his prayer to the Lord, saying, O Lord, the God of Israel, seated between the winged ones, you only are the God of all the kingdoms of the earth; you have made heaven and earth.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa Alatala maxandi, a naxɛ, «Isirayila Marigi Alatala, naxan magoroxi malekɛe tagi, i tan nan na duniɲa birin Marigi ra, i tan nan koore nun bɔxi daaxi.

sentences.english: Let your ear be turned to us, O Lord, and let your eyes be open, O Lord, and see; take note of all the words of Sennacherib who has sent men to say evil against the living God.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i i tuli mati a fanyi ra, i xa Senaxeribi xa masenyi ramɛ, naxan a xa mixi xɛɛxi Ala Ɲiɲɛ rasɔtɔde.

sentences.english: Truly, O Lord, the kings of Assyria have made waste the nations and their lands,
sentences.susu: Alatala, nɔndi na a ra, Asiriya mangɛe bara si birin sɔntɔ, a e xa fe xun nakana.

sentences.english: And have given their gods to the fire; for they were no gods, but wood and stone, the work of men's hands; so they have given them to destruction.
sentences.susu: E naxa nee xa alae woli tɛ i, e e kana. A nɔndi ki ma, na kuyee mu findixi Ala ra, barima ibunadama nan nee yailanxi wuri nun gɛmɛ ra.

sentences.english: But now, O Lord our God, give us salvation from his hands, so that it may be clear to all the kingdoms of the earth that you and only you, O Lord, are God.
sentences.susu: Yandi, muxu Marigi Alatala, i xa muxu ratanga Senaxeribi ma, alako duniɲa birin xa a kolon, a i tan nan keren na Ala ra.»

sentences.english: Then Isaiah, the son of Amoz, sent to Hezekiah, saying, The Lord, the God of Israel, says, The prayer which you have made to me against Sennacherib, king of Assyria, has come to my ears.
sentences.susu: Awa, Amosu xa di Annabi Esayi naxa xɛɛra xɛɛ mangɛ Xesekiya ma, a naxɛ, «Isirayila Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, ‹N bara i xa maxandi suxu i naxan tixi Asiriya mangɛ Senaxeribi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: This is the word which the Lord has said about him: In the eyes of the virgin daughter of Zion you are shamed and laughed at; the daughter of Jerusalem has made sport of you.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya a xili ma, Siyoni taa fama yode i ma, Darisalamu tofanyi fama i maberede.

sentences.english: Against whom have you said evil and bitter things? against whom has your voice been loud and your eyes lifted up? even against the Holy One of Israel.
sentences.susu: I nde konbixi, i nde maberexi? I sɔnxɔxi nde ma? I bara i yɛtɛ igbo Isirayila Sɛniyɛntɔɛ ma.

sentences.english: You have sent your servants with evil words against the Lord, and have said, With all my war-carriages I have come up to the top of the mountains, to the inmost parts of Lebanon; its tall cedars will be cut down, and the best trees of its woods; I will come up into his highest places, into his thick woods.
sentences.susu: I xa xɛɛrae bara Marigi rasɔtɔ. I bara a fala, «N tan bara te han Liban geyae fari n ma gisee kui. N sɛdiri wuri itexie fɔn, n sipirɛ wuri tofanyie sɛgɛ fɔtɔnyi dɛɲɛxi kui.

sentences.english: I have made water-holes and taken their waters, and with my foot I have made all the rivers of Egypt dry.
sentences.susu: N tigie ge ɲamanɛe ma, n e ye min. N Nili xure sɛnkinɛe birin xɔrima nɛ n sanyie ra.»›»

sentences.english: Has it not come to your ears how I did it long before, purposing it in times long past? Now I have given effect to my design, so that by you strong towns might be turned into masses of broken walls.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxɛ, «I mu a mɛxi ba, a n bara yi fee natɛ nu a rakuya, kafi n i daa tɛmui? N fa na e rabafe nɛ. I tan findixi taa sɛnbɛmae sɔntɔma nan tun na,

sentences.english: This is why their townsmen had no power, they were broken and put to shame; they were like the grass of the field and the green plant, like grass on the house-tops.
sentences.susu: na taa mixie sɛnbɛ mu na e xa ti wo kanke. Gaaxui nun yaagi nan tun e sɔtɔma. E luma alɔ ɲooge xare, alɔ sɛxɛ naxan na banxi kɔn na, alɔ mɛngi bili naxan xarama beenun a xa bogi.

sentences.english: But I have knowledge of your getting up and your resting, of your going out and your coming in.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n i dɔxɔ tɛmui, i mini tɛmui sigafe ra gere sode, i fa tɛmui, n na birin kolon. I man na n matandi, n na fan kolon.

sentences.english: Because your wrath against me and your words of pride have come up to my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my cord in your lips, and I will make you go back by the way you came.
sentences.susu: I to bara n matandi na ki, i i yɛtɛ igbo n ma, n na n ma xurundɛ gbakuma nɛ i ɲɔɛ ra, n na n ma karafoe sɔti i dɛ kui, n i ragbilen i kelide.»

sentences.english: And this will be the sign to you: you will get your food this year from what comes up of itself; and in the second year from the produce of the same; and in the third year you will put in your seed and get in the grain and make vine-gardens and take of their fruit.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxɛ, «Xesekiya, tɔnxuma nan ya i bɛ: Toofare wo sansi xɔri yolonxi nan donma. Tamuna wo sansi bali nan donma. Kɔnɔ tamuna boore, wo sansie nan donma wo naxee sima wo e xaba, wo wɛni min naxan kelima wɛni bilie ma, wo naxee sima.

sentences.english: And those of Judah who are still living will again take root in the earth and give fruit.
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛe naxee kisima, nee luma nɛ alɔ wuri bili naxan a sanke na bɔxi bun ma, a fa a bogi ramini a fuge biri ra.

sentences.english: For from Jerusalem those who have been kept safe will go out, and those who are still living will go out of Mount Zion: by the fixed purpose of the Lord of armies this will be done.
sentences.susu: Barima mixi ndee ratangama nɛ faxɛ ma Darisalamu, Siyoni mixi ndee kisima nɛ. Alatala Sɛnbɛma a mafurama nɛ na birin nabade.»

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord says about the king of Assyria, He will not come into this town, or send an arrow against it; he will not come before it with arms, or put up an earthwork against it;
sentences.susu: Na kui, Alatala yi masenyi nan tixi Asiriya mangɛ xa fe ra, «A mu soma yi taa kui, a mu xali yo wolima be, a mu tima wo kanke a xa wure lefa ra, a mu bɛndɛ matema tuganfe ra wo xa tɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: By the way he came he will go back, and he will not get into this town, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: A gbilenma a fa kira nan na, a mu soma yi taa kui! Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: For I will keep this town safe, for my honour, and for the honour of my servant David.
sentences.susu: N yi taa makantama nɛ, n a rakisima nɛ n xili nun n ma konyi Dawuda xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And that night the angel of the Lord went out and put to death in the army of the Assyrians a hundred and eighty-five thousand men; and when the people got up early in the morning, there was nothing to be seen but dead bodies.
sentences.susu: Na kɔɛ ra Alatala xa malekɛ naxa mini, a sa Asiriyaka wulu kɛmɛ tongo solomasaxan nun suuli faxa. A dɔnxɔɛe to keli gɛɛsɛgɛ, e naxa na furee to e ya ma.

sentences.english: So Sennacherib, king of Assyria, went back to his place at Nineveh.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Asiriya mangɛ Senaxeribi naxa gbilen a xɔnyi Ninewe.

sentences.english: And it came about, when he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer put him to death with the sword; and they went in flight into the land of Ararat. And Esar-haddon his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde, a to nu na salife a xa ala Nisiri xa banxi kui, Adarameleki nun Sareseri naxa a faxa santidɛgɛma ra, e e gi Ararati bɔxi ma. Esarixadoni naxa ti mangɛ ra a baba Senaxeribi ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: In those days Hezekiah was ill and near death. And Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, The Lord says, Put your house in order, for your death is near.
sentences.susu: Na ɲɛe ra, Xesekiya naxa fura a ɲaaxi ra. A gbe mu nu luxi a xa faxa. Amosu xa di Annabi Esayi naxa siga a yire, a a fala a bɛ, Alatala yi nan masenxi, «I xa yaamarie fi i xa mixie ma, barima i na faxafe nɛ yi ki, i mu kisima yi fure ma.»

sentences.english: Then, turning his face to the wall, he made his prayer to the Lord, saying,
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa a yatagi mafindi banxi xalɛ ma, a Alatala maxandi, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: O Lord, keep in mind how I have been true to you with all my heart, and have done what is good in your eyes. And Hezekiah gave way to bitter weeping.
sentences.susu: «Alatala, yandi hinnɛ n na, i a kolon a n nan ɲɛrɛxi nɛ kira tinxinxi xɔn ma n ma duniɲɛigiri kui n bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra. N mu i matandi, n mu gbilen i waxɔnfe fɔxɔ ra.» Xesekiya naxa wa ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Now before Isaiah had gone out of the middle of the town, the word of the Lord came to him, saying,
sentences.susu: Annabi Esayi mu nu gɛxi minide mangɛ banxi tɛtɛ kui, Alatala man naxa a masen a bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Go back and say to Hezekiah, the ruler of my people, The Lord, the God of David your father, says, Your prayer has come to my ears, and I have seen your weeping; see, I will make you well: on the third day you will go up to the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Gbilen i xa sa a fala n ma ɲama yarerati Xesekiya bɛ, i benba Dawuda Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, ‹N bara i xa maxandi mɛ, n bara i yaye to. N i yalanma nɛ, a xi saxan nde, i tema nɛ Alatala xa banxi.

sentences.english: I will give you fifteen more years of life; and I will keep you and this town safe from the hands of the king of Assyria; I will keep this town safe, for my honour, and for the honour of my servant David.
sentences.susu: N ɲɛ fu nun suuli sama nɛ i xa simaya xun ma. N i tan nun yi taa ratangama nɛ Asiriya mangɛ ma. N yi taa makantama nɛ n ma konyi Dawuda xa fe ra.›»

sentences.english: Then Isaiah said, Take a cake of figs. So they took it and put it on his wound, and he got better.
sentences.susu: Annabi Esayi naxa a fala Xesekiya xa mixie bɛ, «Wo xɔrɛ bogi xaraxi nde mɔndɔ, wo xa a sa a xa fi ya i.» E naxa na raba, Xesekiya naxa yalan.

sentences.english: And Hezekiah said to Isaiah, What is to be the sign that the Lord will make me well, and that I will go up to the house of the Lord on the third day?
sentences.susu: Xesekiya nu bara a fala Annabi Esayi bɛ, «N a kolonma tɔnxuma mundun ma, a Alatala n na yalanma nɛ, n man fa siga a xa banxi a xi saxan nde ma?»

sentences.english: And Isaiah said, This is the sign the Lord will give you, that he will do what he has said; will the shade go forward ten degrees or back?
sentences.susu: Annabi Esayi naxa a yaabi, «Yi nan findima Alatala xa tɔnxuma ra i bɛ, alako i xa a kolon a Alatala a xa masenyi rakamalima nɛ. I wama soge niini xa a magbilen a xanbi xanbi ma dɔxɔ fu, ka a xa siga a yare yare ma dɔxɔ fu?»

sentences.english: And Hezekiah said in answer, It is a simple thing for the shade to go forward; but let it go back ten degrees.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa a yaabi, «Soge niini luma siga ra a yare yare nan ma. I xa a niya a xa gbilen a xanbi xanbi ma.»

sentences.english: Then Isaiah the prophet made prayer to the Lord, and he made the shade go back ten degrees from its position on the steps of Ahaz.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Annabi Esayi naxa Ala maxandi a xa na raba. Alatala naxa soge niini magbilen a xanbi xanbi ma dɔxɔ fu. Na soge niini nu tixi Axasi tede nan ma.

sentences.english: At that time, Merodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters with an offering to Hezekiah, because he had news that Hezekiah had been ill.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Babilɔn mangɛ Merodaki Baladan naxa bataaxɛ nun buɲa rasanba Xesekiya ma, barima a nu bara Xesekiya furafe mɛ.

sentences.english: And Hezekiah was glad at their coming and let them see all his store of wealth, the silver and the gold and the spices and the oil of great price, and the house of his arms, and everything there was in his stores; there was nothing in all his house or his kingdom which Hezekiah did not let them see.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa na xɛɛrae rasɛnɛ, a a xa naafuli birin masen e bɛ, alɔ gbeti, xɛɛma, surayi, labundɛ nun ture xiri ɲɔxunmɛ, a xa geresose ragatade nun a xa bannaya birin dɛnnaxɛ. Sese mu lu, Xesekiya mu naxan masen e bɛ a xa banxi nun a xa bɔxi kui.

sentences.english: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah and said to him, What did these men say and where did they come from? And Hezekiah said, They came from a far country, even from Babylon.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Annabi Esayi naxa fa Xesekiya yire, a a maxɔrin, «Na mixie munse falaxi i bɛ? E kelixi minden?» Xesekiya naxa a yaabi, «E kelixi bɔxi makuye nde nɛ, dɛnnaxɛ xili Babilɔn.»

sentences.english: And he said, What have they seen in your house? And Hezekiah said in answer, They saw everything in my house: there is nothing among my stores which I did not let them see.
sentences.susu: Esayi man naxa a maxɔrin, «E munse matoxi i xa banxi kui?» Xesekiya naxa a yaabi, «Se naxan birin na n ma banxi kui. Sese mu luxi n xɔnyi n mu naxan masenxi e bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Isaiah said to Hezekiah, Give ear to the word of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Annabi Esayi naxa a fala Xesekiya bɛ, «I tuli mati Alatala xa masenyi ra,

sentences.english: Truly, days are coming when everything in your house, and whatever your fathers have put in store till this day, will be taken away to Babylon: all will be gone, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: ‹Lɔxɔɛ na fafe, yi mixie fama i harige birin xaninde Babilɔn, i benbae naxan luxi i yi ra. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And your sons, the offspring of your body, they will take away to be unsexed servants in the house of the king of Babylon.
sentences.susu: E fama i xa die suxude, i naxee barixi, e e bana Babilɔn mangɛ bɛ.›»

sentences.english: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, Good is the word of the Lord which you have said. Then he said, ... if in my time there is peace and righteousness?
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa a fala Esayi bɛ, «Alatala xa masenyi i naxan tixi, a fan.» A na fala nɛ barima a naxɛ, «Bɔɲɛsa nun kantari tan luma nɛ be, n ma simaya birin kui.»

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and his power, and how he made the pool and the stream, to take water into the town, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?
sentences.susu: Xesekiya xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ nun a xa wali fanyie a naxee raba, alɔ ye sase yailanfe nun ye kira rabɔɔfe sofe ra taa kui, na sɛbɛxi Yudaya mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: And Hezekiah went to rest with his fathers; and Manasseh his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa laaxira, e a bɛlɛ a benbae fɛ ma. A xa di Manasi naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king; for fifty-five years he was ruling in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Hephzi-bah.
sentences.susu: Manasi ɲɛ fu nun firin nan nu a ra a findi mangɛ ra tɛmui naxɛ. A naxa lu kibanyi kui ɲɛ tongo suuli bun ma Darisalamu. A nga nu xili nɛ Xefesiba.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, copying the disgusting ways of those nations whom the Lord had sent out before the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma, a bira sie xa naamunyi ɲaaxie fɔxɔ ra, Alatala naxee keri na bɔxi ma Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ ya ra.

sentences.english: He put up again the high places which had been pulled down by Hezekiah his father; he made altars for Baal, and an Asherah, as Ahab, king of Israel, had done; he was a worshipper and servant of all the stars of heaven.
sentences.susu: A naxa kuye batudee yailan a baba nu bara naxee kana. A naxa Bali kuye xa sɛrɛxɛbadee yailan, a Asera kuye ti, alɔ Isirayila mangɛ Akabu a raba ki naxɛ. A man naxa tunbuie batu fɔlɔ, a a xinbi sin nee bun ma.

sentences.english: And he put up altars in the house of the Lord, of which the Lord had said, In Jerusalem will I put my name.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛbade ndee ti kuyee bɛ Alatala xa banxi kui, naxan nu tixi Darisalamu Alatala xili xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And he put up altars for all the stars of heaven in the two outer squares of the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛbade ndee ti tunbuie batufe ra, Alatala xa banxi tɛtɛ firinyie kui.

sentences.english: And he made his son go through the fire, and made use of secret arts and signs for reading the future; he gave positions to those who had control of spirits and to wonder-workers; he did much evil in the eyes of the Lord, moving him to wrath.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa di gan sɛrɛxɛ ra. A nu duure fe nun sematoe fe raba, a nu wɔyɛn ɲinnɛe nun mixi faxaxie ra. A ti Alatala kanke, a nu fe raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma.

sentences.english: He put the image of Asherah which he had made in the house of which the Lord had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, the town which I have made mine out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put my name for ever.
sentences.susu: A naxa Asera kuye masolixi ti Alatala xa banxi kui. Alatala nu bara a masen Dawuda nun a xa di Sulemani bɛ banxi naxan ma fe ra, «N bara Darisalamu nun yi banxi sugandi Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin ya ma, n xili sabatide ra abadan.

sentences.english: And never again will I send the feet of Israel wandering from the land which I gave to their fathers; if only they will take care to do all my orders, and keep all the law which my servant Moses gave them.
sentences.susu: N mu Isirayila kerima e xa bɔxi ma sɔnɔn, n naxan fixi e benbae ma, xa e sa birama n ma yaamarie nun n ma sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra, n ma konyi Munsa naxan masen e bɛ.»

sentences.english: But they did not give ear; and Manasseh made them do more evil than those nations did, whom the Lord gave up to destruction before the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isirayila mu Alatala xui suxu. E xa mangɛ Manasi naxa e xun ti kira ɲaaxi xɔn ma. E xa yunubie naxa dangi sie xa yunubie ra, Alatala naxee sɔntɔ Isirayila ya ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said, by his servants the prophets,
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala naxa a xa masenyi ti a xa namiɲɔnmɛe saabui ra, a falafe ra,

sentences.english: Because Manasseh, king of Judah, has done these disgusting things, doing more evil than all the Amorites before him, and making Judah do evil with his false gods,
sentences.susu: «Yudaya mangɛ Manasi, i to bara yunubi raba dangife Amorikae ra, i a niya Yudayakae xa kuyee batu,

sentences.english: For this cause, says the Lord, the God of Israel, I will send such evil on Jerusalem and Judah that the ears of all to whom the news comes will be burning.
sentences.susu: n tan Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa a masen i bɛ, n gbaloe ragoroma nɛ Yudaya nun Darisalamu ma, naxan findima tɛrɛnna ra mixi birin bɛ.

sentences.english: And over Jerusalem will be stretched the line of Samaria and the weight of Ahab; Jerusalem will be washed clean as a plate is washed, and turned over on its face.
sentences.susu: N Darisalamu makiitima nɛ alɔ n a raba Samari ra ki naxɛ. N wo xa fe matoma nɛ alɔ n Akabu bɔnsɔɛ xa fe mato ki naxɛ. N Darisalamu mafindima nɛ a legere ma, alɔ pileti mafindima ki naxɛ a na gɛ maxade.

sentences.english: And I will put away from me the rest of my heritage, and give them up into the hands of their haters, who will take their property and their goods for themselves;
sentences.susu: N na n ma ɲama dɔnxɔɛ rabɛɲinma nɛ, n e lu e yaxuie sagoe, e xun nakana, e halaki,

sentences.english: Because they have done evil in my eyes, moving me to wrath, from the day when their fathers came out of Egypt till this day.
sentences.susu: barima e bara fe raba naxan mu rafan n ma, e ti n kanke kabi n e benbae raminixi tɛmui naxɛ Misira bɔxi ra.»

sentences.english: More than this, Manasseh took the lives of upright men, till Jerusalem from one end to the other was full of blood; in addition to his sin in making Judah do evil in the eyes of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Bafe Yudaya xun tife ra kira ɲaaxi xɔn ma, Manasi naxa Darisalamuka gbegbe man faxa tɔɔɲɛgɛ kui.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and all he did, and his sins, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?
sentences.susu: Manasi xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, a fe ɲaaxi naxee birin naba, na sɛbɛxi Yudaya mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: So Manasseh went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth in the garden of his house, in the garden of Uzza; and Amon his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: A naxa laaxira, e naxa a ragata a benbae fɛ ma gaburi nde kui mangɛ banxi xanbi ra, mangɛ Usa ragata dɛnnaxɛ. A xa di Amon naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king, ruling in Jerusalem for two years; his mother's name was Meshullemeth, the daughter of Haruz of Jotbah.
sentences.susu: Amon nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin sɔtɔ, a ti mangɛ ra tɛmui naxɛ. A naxa mangɛya ɲɛ firin naba Darisalamu. A nga nu xili nɛ Mesulemeti, Xarusu naxan bari Yotoba bɛ.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as Manasseh his father had done.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma, alɔ a baba Manasi a raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: He went in all the ways of his father, being a servant and worshipper of the false gods to which his father had been a servant;
sentences.susu: A naxa bira a baba xa kira fɔxɔ ra fe birin kui, a naxa kuyee batu a baba naxee batu, a suyidi e bɛ.

sentences.english: Turning away from the Lord, the God of his fathers, and not walking in his ways.
sentences.susu: A naxa mɛɛ a benbae Marigi Alatala ra, a mu bira a xa kira fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And the servants of Amon made a secret design against him, and put the king to death in his house.
sentences.susu: A xa kuntigie naxa a yanfa, e a faxa a yɛtɛ banxi kui.

sentences.english: But the people of the land put to death all those who had taken part in the design against the king, and made Josiah his son king in his place.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ ɲama naxa na yanfantee faxa, e a xa di Yosiya ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts which Amon did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?
sentences.susu: Amon xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, a fe naxee birin naba, na sɛbɛxi Yudaya mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: He was put in his last resting-place in the garden of Uzza, and Josiah his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: E naxa a ragata a xa gaburi kui, mangɛ banxi xanbi ra, mangɛ Usa ragata dɛnnaxɛ. A xa di Yosiya naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Josiah was eight years old when he became king; and he was ruling in Jerusalem for thirty-one years; his mother's name was Jedidah, daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.
sentences.susu: Yosiya ɲɛ solomasaxan nan nu a ra, a findi mangɛ ra tɛmui naxɛ. A naxa mangɛya ɲɛ tongo saxan nun keren naba Darisalamu. A nga nu xili nɛ Yedida, Adaya naxan bari Bɔsikati bɛ.

sentences.english: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, walking in the ways of David his father, without turning to the right hand or to the left.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan nafan Alatala ma, a a ɲɛrɛ a benba Dawuda xa kira xɔn ma. A mu ba na kira ma fefe ma.
