sentences.english: Now in the eighteenth year after he became king, Josiah sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah, the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of the Lord, saying to him,
sentences.susu: Yosiya xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun solomasaxan nde ra, a naxa Asaliya xa di, Mesulama fan xa mamadi Safan sɛbɛliti xɛɛ Alatala xa banxi, yi yaamari ra:

sentences.english: Go up to Hilkiah, the chief priest, and let him give out the money which is taken into the house of the Lord, which the keepers of the door have got together from the people;
sentences.susu: «Siga sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xungbe Xilikiya yire, a xa kɔbiri kɔnti ɲama faxi naxan na Alatala xa banxi naadɛ kantɛe xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And let it be given to the overseers of the work of the Lord's house, to give to the workmen who are making good what was damaged in the house of the Lord;
sentences.susu: A xa so walikɛ xunyie yi ra, naxee ɲɔxɔ saxi Alatala xa banxi yailanfe xɔn ma. E xa a so walikɛe yi ra naxee na yire bulaxie yailanfe banxi xalɛ ma,

sentences.english: To the woodworkers and the builders and the stone-cutters; and for getting wood and cut stones for the building up of the house.
sentences.susu: nun xabuie, banxitie yi ra. A man xa findi wuri nun gɛmɛ sare ra, walikɛe hayi na naxan ma Alatala xa banxi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: They did not have to give any account of the money which was handed to them, for they made use of it with good faith.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e naxa na kɔbiri rawali ki maxɔrin e ma de, barima mixi tinxinxie nan e ra.»

sentences.english: Then Hilkiah, the chief priest, said to Shaphan the scribe, I have made discovery of the book of the law in the house of the Lord. So Hilkiah gave it to Shaphan;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xungbe Xilikiya naxa a fala Safan sɛbɛliti bɛ, «N bara won ma sɛriyɛ kitaabui to Alatala xa banxi kui!» Xilikiya naxa a so Safan yi ra, Safan naxa a xaran fɔlɔ a xui itexi ra.

sentences.english: Then, after reading it, Shaphan the scribe went in to the king and gave him an account of what had been done, saying, Your servants have given out the money which was in the house, and have given it to the overseers of the work of the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, a naxa siga mangɛ yire, a dɛntɛgɛ sa mangɛ bɛ a falafe ra, «Kɔbiri naxan nu na Alatala xa banxi kui, i xa walikɛe bara na so walikɛ xunyie yi ra naxee ɲɔxɔ saxi Alatala xa banxi yailanfe xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: Then Shaphan the scribe said to the king, Hilkiah the priest has given me a book; and he was reading it before the king.
sentences.susu: A naxa yi masenyi fan sa na fari, a naxɛ, «Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Xilikiya bara kitaabui nde so n yi ra.» Safan naxa a xaran mangɛ bɛ a xui itexi ra.

sentences.english: And the king, hearing the words of the book of the law, took his robe in his hands, violently parting it as a sign of his grief;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ to sɛriyɛ kitaabui xa masenyi mɛ, a naxa a xa sosee ibɔɔ sunnunyi kui.

sentences.english: And he gave orders to Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, and Achbor, the son of Micaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king's servant, saying,
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Xilikiya, Safan xa di Axikama, Mike xa di Akibori, Safan sɛbɛliti, nun mangɛ rasima Asaya yamari,

sentences.english: Go and get directions from the Lord for me and for the people and for all Judah, about the words of this book which has come to light; for great is the wrath of the Lord which is burning against us, because our fathers have not given ear to the words of this book, to do all the things which are recorded in it.
sentences.susu: «Wo siga Alatala maxɔrin n tan nun Yudaya ɲama bɛ yi kitaabui xa masenyi wama naxan falafe won bɛ, won naxan toxi. Alatala xa xɔnɛ bara gbo. A xɔnɔxi won ma, barima won babae mu tin birade yi kitaabui xui fɔxɔ ra, e mu ɲɛrɛ kira xɔn ma, naxan sɛbɛxi na kitaabui kui.»

sentences.english: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam and Achbor and Shaphan and Asaiah, went to Huldah the woman prophet, the wife of Shallum, the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the robes, (now she was living in Jerusalem, in the second part of the town;) and they had talk with her.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Xilikiya, Axikama, Akibori, Safan, nun Asaya naxa siga namiɲɔnmɛ ginɛ Xulida yire, Salumu xa ginɛ, Tikifa xa di, Xaraxasi xa mamadi. Na ginɛ nu sabatixi Darisalamu taa nɛɛnɛ nan kui, a nu mɛɛnima mangɛ xa sosee ma. Xɛɛrae to dɛntɛgɛ sa na ginɛ bɛ,

sentences.english: And she said to them, The Lord, the God of Israel, says, Say to the man who sent you to me,
sentences.susu: a naxa e yaabi, «Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: ‹Wo a fala wo xɛɛma bɛ,

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord: See, I will send evil on this place and on its people, even everything which the king of Judah has been reading in the book;
sentences.susu: a Alatala naxɛ a n gbaloe ragoroma nɛ yi bɔxi nun a xa mixie ma, alɔ Yudaya mangɛ a xaranxi yi kitaabui kui ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Because they have given me up, burning offerings to other gods and moving me to wrath by all the work of their hands; so my wrath will be on fire against this place, and will not be put out.
sentences.susu: E to bara n nabolo, e nu surayi gan ala gbɛtɛe bɛ e naxee yailanxi e yɛtɛ bɛlɛxɛe ra, n bɔɲɛ bara te yi yire xili ma. A luxi alɔ tɛ naxan mu xubenma muku!›

sentences.english: But to the king of Judah who sent you to get directions from the Lord, say, This is what the Lord, the God of Israel, has said: As to the words which have come to your ears,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo a fala Yudaya mangɛ bɛ, naxan wo xɛɛxi be Alatala maxɔrinde, wo naxɛ, ‹Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya:

sentences.english: Because your heart was soft, and you made yourself low before me, when you had word of what I said against this place and its people, that they would become a waste and a curse, and you gave signs of grief, weeping before me: truly, I have given ear to you, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: I tan Yosiya to gaaxu n ya ra i i yɛtɛ magoro n tan Alatala bɛ n ma masenyi xa fe ra yi bɔxi nun a xa mixie xili ma, n bara i xa maxandi suxu. I to i xa sosee ibɔɔ sunnunyi kui, i fa wa n ya i, n bara i xui mɛ. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: For this cause I will let you go to your fathers and be put in your last resting-place in peace, and your eyes will not see all the evil which I will send on this place. So they took this news back to the king.
sentences.susu: Na xa fe ra, i ragatama nɛ i benbae fɛ ma bɔɲɛsa kui. I yae mu fama gbaloe birin tode, n naxee ragoroma yi yire ma.›» Na dangi xanbi, na xɛɛrae naxa na masenyi dɛntɛgɛ mangɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: Then the king sent and got together all the responsible men of Judah and of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa Yudaya nun Darisalamu forie birin xili.

sentences.english: And the king went up to the house of the Lord, with all the men of Judah and all the people of Jerusalem, and the priests and the prophets and all the people, small and great; and they were present at his reading of the book of the law which had come to light in the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: A naxa te Alatala xa banxi, ɲama birin biraxi a fɔxɔ ra: Yudayakae, Darisalamukae, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, namiɲɔnmɛe nun ɲama birin, kelife dimɛdie ma han a sa forie li. A naxa saatɛ kitaabui xaran e bɛ, naxan to Alatala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: And the king took his place by the pillar, and made an agreement before the Lord, to go in the way of the Lord, and keep his orders and his decisions and his rules with all his heart and all his soul, and to keep the words of the agreement recorded in the book; and all the people gave their word to keep the agreement.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nu tixi buntunyi nan na, a laayidi tongo birafe ra Alatala fɔxɔ ra, a xa a xa yaamarie, a xa sɛriyɛ, nun a xa masenyi birin nabatu a bɔɲɛ nun a nii birin na, alako na saatɛ kitaabui xa masenyi xa kamali. Ɲama fan naxa na saatɛ tongo.

sentences.english: Then the king gave orders to Hilkiah, the chief priest, and to the priests of the second order, and to the keepers of the door, to take out of the house of the Lord all the vessels made for Baal and for the Asherah and for all the stars of heaven; and he had them burned outside Jerusalem in the fields of Kidron, and took the dust of them to Beth-el.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa yamari fi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi Xilikiya ma, nun a xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ma, nun Alatala xa banxi naadɛ kantɛe ma, a e xa see birin namini Alatala xa banxi kui, naxee nu yailanxi Bali, Asera, nun kooremasee bɛ. A naxa sa e gan Darisalamu taa fari ma Sediron gulunba kui, e xube fa xanin Beteli.

sentences.english: And he put an end to the false priests, who had been put in their positions by the kings of Judah to see to the burning of offerings in the high places in the towns of Judah and the outskirts of Jerusalem, and all those who made offerings to Baal and to the sun and the moon and the twelve signs and all the stars of heaven.
sentences.susu: A naxa kuyee xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ba, Yudaya mangɛe naxee ti surayi ganfe ra kuyee bɛ geyae fari Yudaya taae kui nun Darisalamu taa fari ma. E nu sɛrɛxɛe bama Bali kuyee, soge, kike, nun tunbuie bɛ.

sentences.english: And he took the Asherah from the house of the Lord, outside Jerusalem to the stream Kidron, burning it by the stream and crushing it to dust, and he put the dust on the place where the bodies of the common people were put to rest.
sentences.susu: A naxa Asera kuye masolixi ramini Alatala xa banxi kui, a a xanin Darisalamu fari ma Sediron gulunba kui, a a gan han a findi tɛ xube ra. A naxa na xube wɔli gaburie fari.

sentences.english: And he had the houses pulled down of those who were used for sex purposes in the house of the Lord, where women were making robes for the Asherah.
sentences.susu: A naxa konkoe rabira Ala xa banxi kui, yɛnɛlae nu yɛnɛ rabama dɛnnaxɛ e xa kuyee xa fe ra. Ginɛe fan nu sosee yailanma Asera kuye bɛ naa.

sentences.english: And he made all the priests from the towns of Judah come into Jerusalem, and he made unclean the high places where the priests had been burning offerings, from Geba to Beer-sheba; and he had the high places of the evil spirits pulled down which were by the doorway of Joshua, the ruler of the town, on the left side of the way into the town.
sentences.susu: Yosiya naxa Yudaya sɛrɛxɛdubɛe birin xili, e xa kuye batudee kana geyae fari, mixie nu surayi ganma sɛrɛxɛe ra dɛnnaxɛ, kelife Geba ma han Beriseeba. A naxa kuye batudee kana, naxee nu na taa mangɛ Yosuwe xa naadɛ sode dɛ ra, nun taa naadɛ sode dɛ kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: Still the priests of the high places never came up to the altar of the Lord in Jerusalem; but they took their food of unleavened bread among their brothers.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxee nu sɛrɛxɛ bama kuyee bɛ geyae fari, nee mu nu sigama Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade yire Darisalamu, kɔnɔ e nu sunbuma e ngaxakerenyi Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra, e nu taami lɛbinitare don nee ya ma.

sentences.english: And Topheth, in the valley of the sons of Hinnom, he made unclean, so that no man might make his son or his daughter go through the fire to Molech.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Yosiya naxa sɛrɛxɛbade nde kana naxan nu xili Tofeti, alako mixi yo naxa a xa di ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra Mɔlɔkɔ kuye bɛ sɔnɔn. Na sɛrɛxɛbade nu na Ben Hinoma xa gulunba nan kui.

sentences.english: And he took away the horses which the kings of Judah had given to the sun, at the way into the house of the Lord, by the room of Nathan-melech, the unsexed servant, which was in the outer part of the building, and the carriages of the sun he put on fire.
sentences.susu: A naxa kuyee kana Alatala xa banxi sode dɛ ra, naxee nu masolixi soe daaxie nun gise daaxie ra. Yudaya mangɛe nan nee ti naa soge batufe ra. Nee nu na Natan Meleki xa konkoe nan fɛ ma Alatala xa banxi tɛtɛ kui.

sentences.english: And the altars on the roof of the high room of Ahaz, which the kings of Judah had made, and the altars which Manasseh had made in the two outer squares of the house of the Lord, were pulled down and crushed to bits, and the dust of them was put into the stream Kidron.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa sɛrɛxɛbade ndee kana, naxee nu na Axasi xa konkoe fɛ ma koore ra, Yudaya mangɛe nun Manasi naxee ti Alatala xa banxi tɛtɛ kui. A to gɛ e kanade, a naxa e gan, a e xube wɔli Sediron gulunba kui.

sentences.english: And the high places before Jerusalem, on the south side of the mountain of destruction, which Solomon, king of Israel, had made for Ashtoreth, the disgusting god of the Zidonians, and for Chemosh, the disgusting god of Moab, and for Milcom, the disgusting god of the children of Ammon, the king made unclean.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa kuye batude ndee kana, naxee nu na Darisalamu yatagi, Kasarɛ geya yirefanyi biri ra, Isirayila mangɛ Sulemani naxan ti Asitarate bɛ, Sidɔnkae xa kuye ɲaaxi. A man naxa sɛrɛxɛbadee kana naxee nu tixi Kemosi bɛ, Mowabakae xa kuye ɲaaxi, a nun Mɔlɔkɔ bɛ, Amonikae xa kuye ɲaaxi.

sentences.english: The stone pillars were broken to bits and the wood pillars cut down, and the places where they had been were made full of the bones of the dead.
sentences.susu: A naxa na gɛmɛ masolixie ibutuxun, a naxa na wuri masolixie gan, a fa mixi faxaxi xɔrie rayensen na yire sɛniyɛntaree ma.

sentences.english: And the altar at Beth-el, and the high place put up by Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, who made Israel do evil, that altar and that high place were pulled down; and the high place was burned and crushed to dust and the Asherah was burned.
sentences.susu: Yowasi naxa na mɔɔli raba Beteli sɛrɛxɛbade fan na, Nebati xa di Yerobowami naxan ti alako Isirayilakae xa yunubi raba. A naxa na sɛrɛxɛbade kana na yire itexi fari, a fa mɛnni nun na Asera kuye masolixi gan, a na birin findi tɛ xube ra.

sentences.english: Then Josiah, turning round, saw on the mountain the places of the dead, and he sent and had the bones taken out of their places and burned on the altar, so making it unclean, as the Lord had said by the man of God when Jeroboam was in his place by the altar on that feast-day. And he, turning his eyes to the resting-place of the man of God who had given word of these things, said:
sentences.susu: Yosiya to gaburi ndee to geya mabiri, a naxa mixi faxaxi xɔrie tongo naa, a e gan na sɛrɛxɛbadee fari, alako a xa findi yire sɛniyɛntare ra, Alatala xa masenyi xa kamali alɔ namiɲɔnmɛ a fala ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: What is that headstone I see over there? And the men of the town said to him, It is the resting-place of the man of God who came from Judah and gave word of all these things which you have done to the altar of Beth-el.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yosiya naxa ɲama maxɔrin, a naxɛ, «Munse na yi gɛmɛ tɔnxuma ra naxan tixi be?» Mɛnnikae naxa a yaabi, «Ala xa mixi nde xa gaburi nan a ra naxan keli Yudaya bɔxi ma, a wɔyɛn Beteli sɛrɛxɛbade xili ma, a fee fala i naxee rabaxi yi ki.»

sentences.english: So he said, Let him be; let not his bones be moved. So they let his bones be with the bones of the prophet who came from Samaria.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo yi gaburi lu na, mixi yo naxa yi Yudaya namiɲɔnmɛ xɔrie tongo, a nun namiɲɔnmɛ xɔrie naxan keli Samari, nee tan xɔrie xa ragata e xa gaburie kui.»

sentences.english: Then Josiah took away all the houses of the high places in the towns of Samaria, which the kings of Israel had put up, moving the Lord to wrath, and he did with them as he had done in Beth-el.
sentences.susu: Yosiya man naxa kuye banxie birin kana, Isirayila mangɛ naxee ti Samari taae kui, e nu Alatala matandima naxee kui. Yosiya naxa na birin kana, alɔ a a raba ki naxɛ Beteli.

sentences.english: And all the priests of the high places there he put to death on the altars, burning the bones of the dead on them; and then he went back to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: A naxa na kuye xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe faxa, a e xɔrie gan e xa sɛrɛxɛbadee fari. A to gɛ na rabade, a naxa gbilen Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And the king gave orders to all the people, saying, Keep the Passover to the Lord your God, as it says in this book of the law.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa yi yaamari fi ɲama ma, «Wo Saya Malekɛ Dangi sali raba wo Marigi Alatala xa binyɛ bun ma, alɔ a sɛbɛxi saatɛ kitaabui kui ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Truly, such a Passover had not been kept in all the days of the judges of Israel or of the kings of Israel or the kings of Judah;
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ mu nu Saya Malekɛ Dangi sali raba na ki kafi kiitisae nu bɔxi yamarima tɛmui naxɛ. Na sali mu nu rabama Isirayila mangɛe nun Yudaya mangɛe xa waxati.

sentences.english: In the eighteenth year of the rule of King Josiah this Passover was kept to the Lord in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Na rabaxi Yosiya xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun solomasaxan nde gbansan nɛ. A naxa na sali raba Alatala xa binyɛ bun ma Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And all those who had control of spirits, and the wonder-workers, and the images, and the false gods, and all the disgusting things which were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, Josiah put away, so that he might give effect to the words of the agreement recorded in the book which Hilkiah the priest made discovery of in the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Yosiya man naxa mandurulae, naxee wɔyɛnma mixi faxaxie ra, sematoee, denbaya kuyee, kuye gbɛtɛe, nun se ɲaaxie, a naxa na birin ɲɔn Yudaya nun Isirayila bɔxi ma, alako Alatala xa sɛriyɛ xa rabatu naxan sɛbɛxi saatɛ kitaabui kui, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Xilikiya naxan to Alatala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: Never before had there been a king like him, turning to the Lord with all his heart and with all his soul and with all his power, as the law of Moses says; and after him there was no king like him.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ yo mu nu na naxan luxi alɔ Yosiya, naxan gbilenxi Alatala ma a bɔɲɛ, a nii, nun a sɛnbɛ birin na, alɔ Annabi Munsa xa sɛriyɛ a masenxi ki naxɛ. Kabi a waxati han a dangi xanbi, a maniyɛ yo mu sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: But still the heat of the Lord's wrath was not turned back from Judah, because of all Manasseh had done in moving him to wrath.
sentences.susu: Hali na birin to raba, Alatala xa xɔnɛ mu gbilen Yudaya fɔxɔ ra, Manasi xa fe rabaxie saabui ra, a a matandi naxee kui.

sentences.english: And the Lord said, I will send Judah away from before my face, as I have sent Israel; I will have nothing more to do with this town, which I had made mine, even Jerusalem, and the holy house of which I said, My name will be there.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «N Yudaya fan makuyama nɛ n ya tode ra, alɔ n a rabaxi Isirayila ra ki naxɛ. N ma taa sugandixi Darisalamu raboloma nɛ, a nun n ma banxi, n a masen dɛnnaxɛ xa fe ra, ‹N xili luma be nɛ.›»

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?
sentences.susu: Yosiya xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, a fe fanyi naxan birin naba, na sɛbɛxi Yudaya mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: In his days, Pharaoh-necoh, king of Egypt, sent his armies against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates; and King Josiah went out against him; and he put him to death at Megiddo, when he had seen him.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Misira mangɛ Firawuna, naxan xili Neko, naxa siga Asiriya mangɛ gerede Efirati xure mabiri. Yosiya to mini a gere ki ma, Firawuna naxa a faxa Megido.

sentences.english: And his servants took his body in a carriage from Megiddo to Jerusalem, and put him into the earth there. And the people of the land took Jehoahaz, the son of Josiah, and put the holy oil on him and made him king in place of his father.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae naxa a fure baki sɔɔri ragise nde kui, e a xanin keli Megido sigafe ra Darisalamu, e sa a ragata a xa gaburi kui. Ɲama naxa a xa di Yehowaxasi tongo, e ture surusuru a xunyi ma, e a ti mangɛ ra a baba ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king, ruling in Jerusalem for three months; his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
sentences.susu: Yehowaxasi ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan nan nu a ra, a ti mangɛ ra tɛmui naxɛ. A naxa kike saxan mangɛya raba Darisalamu. A nga nu xili nɛ Xamutali, Yeremi xa di naxan keli Libina.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as his fathers had done.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma, alɔ a benbae a raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And Pharaoh-necoh put him in chains at Riblah in the land of Hamath, so that he might not be king in Jerusalem; and took from the land a tax of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
sentences.susu: Firawuna naxan xili Neko, na naxa nɔ a ra, a a xiri yɔlɔnxɔnyi ra Ribila, Xamata bɔxi ma. Neko naxa duuti fife ti Yudaya ma, naxan findi gbeti kilo wulu saxan nun xɛɛma kilo tongo saxan na.

sentences.english: Then Pharaoh-necoh made Eliakim, the son of Josiah, king in place of Josiah his father, changing his name to Jehoiakim; but Jehoahaz he took away to Egypt, where he was till his death.
sentences.susu: A naxa Yosiya xa di Eliyakimi ti mangɛ ra a baba Yosiya ɲɔxɔɛ ra. A naxa a xili masara Yehoyakimi ra. A naxa Yehowaxasi suxu geelimani ra, a a xanin Misira bɔxi ma. Yehowaxasi naxa faxa naa.

sentences.english: And Jehoiakim gave the silver and gold to Pharaoh, taxing the land by his orders to get the money; the people of the land had to give silver and gold, everyone as he was taxed, to make the payment to Pharaoh-necoh.
sentences.susu: Yehoyakimi naxa Yudayakae yamari e xa duuti fi e xa naafuli xasabi ma, alako a xa gbeti nun xɛɛma fi Firawuna Neko ma, a a yamarixi naxan na.

sentences.english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king; he was ruling in Jerusalem for eleven years; his mother's name was Zebidah, the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.
sentences.susu: Yehoyakimi ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli nan nu a ra, a findi mangɛ ra tɛmui naxɛ. A naxa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun keren naba Darisalamu. A nga nu xili nɛ Sebida, Pɛdaya xa di naxan keli Ruma.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord as his fathers had done.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan mu rafan Ala ma, alɔ a benbae a raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: In his days, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, came up and Jehoiakim was his servant for three years; then he took up arms against him.
sentences.susu: Yehoyakimi xa mangɛya waxati, Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari naxa gere rakeli a ma. Yehoyakimi naxa lu a xa nɔɛ bun ma ɲɛ saxan, kɔnɔ na dangi xanbi a naxa a matandi.

sentences.english: And the Lord sent against him bands of the Chaldaeans and of the Edomites and of the Moabites and of the children of Ammon; sending them against Judah for its destruction, as he had said by his servants the prophets.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Kalidikae, Aramikae, Mowabakae, nun Amonikae rakeli, e xa fa a gere. A nee xɛɛ nɛ e xa fa Yudaya sɔntɔ, alɔ a masenxi ki naxɛ a xa konyi namiɲɔnmɛe saabui ra.

sentences.english: Only by the word of the Lord did this fate come on Judah, to take them away from before his face; because of the sins of Manasseh and all the evil he did;
sentences.susu: Na raba Alatala xa yaamari nan ma, barima a nu wama Yudakae makuyafe a ra e xa yunubie xa fe ra, e naxee matinkan Manasi fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And because of the death of those who had done no wrong, for he made Jerusalem full of the blood of the upright; and the Lord had no forgiveness for it.
sentences.susu: A man nu wama e ɲaxankatafe Manasi xa tɔɔɲɛgɛ xa fe ra, naxan a niya a xa Darisalamuka gbegbe faxa. Alatala mu wa diɲɛfe na fe ma.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all he did, are they not recorded in the book of the history of the kings of Judah?
sentences.susu: Yehoyakimi xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, a fe naxan birin naba, na sɛbɛxi Yudaya mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: So Jehoiakim went to rest with his fathers; and Jehoiachin his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Yehoyakimi naxa ragata a benbae fɛ ma. A xa di Yehoyakini naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the king of Egypt did not come out of his land again, for the king of Babylon had taken all his country, from the stream of Egypt to the river Euphrates.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ mu mini a xa bɔxi kui sɔnɔn, barima Babilɔn mangɛ nu bara a xa bɔxi birin ba a yi ra, kelife ra Misira susude ma, han a sa Efirati xure li.

sentences.english: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king, he was ruling in Jerusalem for three months, and his mother's name was Nehushta, the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Yehoyakini ɲɛ fu nun solomasaxan nan nu a ra, a findi mangɛ ra tɛmui naxɛ. A naxa mangɛya kike saxan naba Darisalamu. A nga nu xili Nexuseta, Elinatan xa di, naxan keli Darisalamu.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as his father had done.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma, alɔ a baba a raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: At that time the armies of Nebuchadnezzar came up to Jerusalem and the town was shut in on every side.
sentences.susu: Na waxati Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari xa sɔɔrie naxa siga Darisalamu gerede. E naxa na taa rabilin, alako mixi yo naxa so, mixi yo naxa mini.

sentences.english: And Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, came there, while his servants were shutting in the town;
sentences.susu: Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari naxa fa, a ti taa yatagi a xa sɔɔrie nu taa rabilinfe tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then Jehoiachin, king of Judah, went out to the king of Babylon, with his mother and his servants and his chiefs and his unsexed servants; and in the eighth year of his rule the king of Babylon took him.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Yudaya mangɛ Yehoyakini naxa a yɛtɛ so Babilɔn mangɛ yi ra, a tan, a nga, a rasimae, a xa kuntigie, nun a xa banxi mɛɛnimae. Babilɔn mangɛ naxa a findi geelimani ra a xa mangɛya ɲɛ solomasaxan nde ra.

sentences.english: And he took away all the stored wealth of the Lord's house, and the goods from the king's store-house, cutting up all the gold vessels which Solomon, king of Israel, had made in the house of the Lord, as the Lord had said.
sentences.susu: A naxa naafuli birin tongo naxan nu ragataxi Alatala xa banxi nun mangɛ xa banxi kui. A naxa yirabase xɛɛma daaxie ibolon a xuntunyie ra, mangɛ Sulemani naxee yailan Alatala xa banxi xa fe ra, alɔ Alatala a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And he took away all the people of Jerusalem and all the chiefs and all the men of war, ten thousand prisoners; and all the expert workmen and the metal-workers; only the poorest sort of the people of the land were not taken away.
sentences.susu: A naxa Darisalamukae birin xanin. Kuntigie, sɔɔri fanyie, walikɛe, nun xabuie birin. E birin nalanxi mixi wulu fu. A setaree nan gbansan lu naa.

sentences.english: He took Jehoiachin a prisoner to Babylon, with his mother and his wives and his unsexed servants and the great men of the land; he took them all as prisoners from Jerusalem to Babylon.
sentences.susu: A naxa Yehoyakini xanin Babilɔn, a tan, a nga, a xa ginɛe, a xa kuntigie, nun a xa bɔxi sɛnbɛmae,

sentences.english: And all the men of war, seven thousand of them, and a thousand expert workmen and metal-workers, all of them strong and able to take up arms, the king of Babylon took away as prisoners into Babylon.
sentences.susu: sɔɔri wulu solofere, nun xabui wulu keren. Mixi naxee birin nu nɔma gere sode nu na na ɲama ya ma. Babilɔn mangɛ naxa e birin xanin Babilɔn bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the king of Babylon made Mattaniah, his father's brother, king in place of Jehoiachin, changing his name to Zedekiah.
sentences.susu: A naxa Yehoyakini sɔxɔ Mataniya naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra. A naxa a xili masara Sedekiya.

sentences.english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king, and he was king in Jerusalem for eleven years; his mother's name was Hamutal, daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
sentences.susu: Sedekiya ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun keren nan nu a ra, a ti mangɛ ra tɛmui naxɛ. A naxa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun keren naba Darisalamu. A nga nu xili nɛ Xamutali, Yeremi xa di naxan keli Libina.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as Jehoiakim had done.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe raba naxan mu rafan Alatala ma, alɔ Yehoyakimi a raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And because of the wrath of the Lord, this came about in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had sent them all away from before him: and Zedekiah took up arms against the king of Babylon.
sentences.susu: Alatala nu bara yi fe birin nagiri Darisalamu nun Yudaya ma a xa xɔnɛ kui. A e makuya a ra na nan ma. Na dangi xanbi, Sedekiya naxa Babilɔn mangɛ matandi.

sentences.english: Now in the ninth year of his rule, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, came against Jerusalem with all his army and took up his position before it, building earthworks all round the town.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari xa mangɛya ɲɛ solomanaani nde, kike fu, xi fu nde ra, a naxa fa a nun a xa sɔɔri gali ra Darisalamu gere xili ma. E naxa yonkin taa rabilinyi ra, e se nde ti alako e xa nɔ tede tɛtɛ fari.

sentences.english: And the town was shut in by their forces till the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
sentences.susu: Taa naxa lu suxui kui han mangɛ Sedekiya xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun keren nde ra.

sentences.english: Now on the ninth day of the fourth month, the store of food in the town was almost gone, so that there was no food for the people of the land.
sentences.susu: Kike naani nde xi solomanaani nde ra, kaamɛ to bara nu sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ taa kui, donse yo mu nu na ɲama yi ra sɔnɔn,

sentences.english: So an opening was made in the wall of the town, and all the men of war went in flight by night through the doorway between the two walls which was by the king's garden; (now the Chaldaeans were stationed round the town:) and the king went by the way of the Arabah.
sentences.susu: taakae naxa yale ti taa tɛtɛ ma kɔɛ ra, sɔɔri sɛnbɛmae fa mini naadɛ ra naxan na tɛtɛ firinyie tagi, mangɛ xa malabude fɛ ma, e fa siga Araba fiili ma. Kalidikae nu yonkinxi taa rabilinyi.

sentences.english: But the Chaldaean army went after the king, and overtook him in the lowlands of Jericho, and all his army went in flight from him in every direction.
sentences.susu: Kalidikae to taa sɔɔrie to e gi ra, e naxa bira e xa mangɛ fɔxɔ ra, e fa a suxu Yeriko fiili ma. Mangɛ xa sɔɔrie naxa e gi a xun ma, e yensen yɛ.

sentences.english: And they made the king a prisoner and took him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah to be judged.
sentences.susu: Kalidikae naxa mangɛ suxu, e a xanin Babilɔn mangɛ xɔn ma Ribila. Mɛnni e naxa a makiiti.

sentences.english: And they put the sons of Zedekiah to death before his eyes, and then they put out his eyes, and chaining him with iron bands, took him to Babylon.
sentences.susu: E naxa Sedekiya xa die kɔn naxaba a ya xɔri, e fa a tan yae kana. Na dangi xanbi, Babilɔn mangɛ naxa a xiri wure gbeeli yɔlɔnxɔnyi ra, a a xanin Babilɔn.

sentences.english: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, in the nineteenth year of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem;
sentences.susu: Kike suuli nde xi solofere nde ra, Nebukadansari xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun solomanaani nde nan nu a ra Babilɔn xun ma, Nebusaradan Babilɔn mangɛ xa sɔɔri xunyi naxa siga Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And he had the house of the Lord and the king's house and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, burned with fire;
sentences.susu: A naxa Alatala xa banxi, mangɛ xa banxi, nun Darisalamu banxi xungbe birin gan.

sentences.english: And the walls round Jerusalem were broken down by the Chaldaean army which was with the captain.
sentences.susu: Kalidikae xa sɔɔri naxee nu na a fɔxɔ ra, e naxa tɛtɛ rabira naxan nu Darisalamu rabilinxi.

sentences.english: And the rest of the people who were still in the town, and all those who had given themselves up to the king of Babylon, and all the rest of the workmen, Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, took away as prisoners;
sentences.susu: Nebusaradan, Babilɔn sɔɔri mangɛ naxa Darisalamu ɲama dɔnxɔɛe xanin Babilɔn, naxee nu luxi taa kui, nun naxee e yɛtɛ so Babilɔn mangɛ yi ra.

sentences.english: But he let the poorest of the land go on living there, to take care of the vines and the fields.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a naxa tin setare ndee tan xa lu naa, e xa nu bɔxi rawali, e nu wɛni bilie si.

sentences.english: And the brass pillars in the house of the Lord, and the wheeled bases, and the great brass water-vessel in the house of the Lord, were broken up by the Chaldaeans, who took the brass to Babylon.
sentences.susu: Kalidikae naxa see tongo naxee yailanxi wure gbeeli ra, e e raxunu alako e xa na wure gbeeli xanin Babilɔn. Na kui, e naxa kinki firin, ye sase xungbe, nun a dɔxɔdee kana.

sentences.english: And the pots and the spades and the scissors for the lights and the spoons, and all the brass vessels used in the Lord's house, they took away.
sentences.susu: E naxa Alatala xa banxi tundee, pelie, finɛe, tɔnbilie, nun yirabase birin tongo, naxee nu yailanxi wure gbeeli ra.

sentences.english: And the fire-trays and the basins; the gold of the gold vessels and the silver of the silver vessels, were all taken away by the captain of the armed men.
sentences.susu: A naxa yirabasee nun pɔɔtie fan birin tongo naxee nu yailanxi xɛɛma nun gbeti ra.

sentences.english: The two pillars, the great water-vessel and the wheeled bases, which Solomon had made for the house of the Lord: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
sentences.susu: Banxi kinki firinyie, ye sase xungbe naxan xili «baa,» a dɔxɔde naxee nu na a bun ma, Sulemani naxee yailan Alatala xa banxi bɛ, na birin findixi wure gbeeli gbegbe nan na, naxan xasabi mu nu nɔma kolonde.

sentences.english: One of the pillars was eighteen cubits high, with a crown of brass on it; the crown was three cubits high, circled with a network and apples all of brass; and the second pillar had the same.
sentences.susu: Na banxi kinki firinyie xa maiteya nu nɔngɔn ya fu nun solomasaxan lima. Na kinki xunyie nu yailanxi wure gbeeli nan na, e masoli kɔɔbɛ bogi maniyɛe ra. Nee xa maiteya nu nɔngɔn ya saxan lima.

sentences.english: And the captain of the armed men took Seraiah, the chief priest, and Zephaniah, the second priest, and the three door-keepers;
sentences.susu: Babilɔn sɔɔri mangɛ naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi Seraya, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ firin nde Sefaniya, nun hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛ makantɛ saxanyie xanin a xun ma.

sentences.english: And from the town he took the unsexed servant who was over the men of war, and five of the king's near friends who were in the town, and the scribe of the captain of the army, who was responsible for getting the people of the land together in military order, and sixty men of the people of the land who were in the town.
sentences.susu: A naxa yi mixi xungbee fan xanin: sɔɔri mangɛ, mangɛ rasima suuli, kuntigi nde naxan nu sɔɔrie sugandima, nun na kuntigi xa mixi tongo senni.

sentences.english: These Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, took with him to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn sɔɔri mangɛ Nebusaradan naxa na mixi birin xanin Babilɔn mangɛ xɔn ma Ribila.

sentences.english: And the king of Babylon put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was taken away prisoner from his land.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn mangɛ naxa e faxa Ribila, Xamata bɔxi ma. Yudayakae rakelixi e xa bɔxi ma na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: As for the people who were still living in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, did not take away, he made Gedaliah, the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, ruler over them.
sentences.susu: Nebukadansari ɲama dɔnxɔɛ naxan lu Yudaya, a naxa Axikama xa di, Safan xa mamadi Gɛdalaya, findi e xa mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: Now the captains of the armed forces, hearing that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah ruler, came with their men to Gedaliah at Mizpah; Ishmael, the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan, the son of Kareah, and Seraiah, the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah, the son of the Maacathite, came with all their men.
sentences.susu: Isirayila sɔɔri mangɛe to a kolon a Babilɔn mangɛ bara Gɛdalaya ti mangɛ ra, e birin naxa siga a xɛɛbude Misipa nun e xa sɔɔrie ra. Na sɔɔri mangɛe xilie nan ya: Netaniya xa di Sumayila, Kareya xa di Yoxanan, Tanxumɛti xa di Seraya Netofaka, nun Maakaka xa di Yaasaniya.

sentences.english: Then Gedaliah gave his oath to them and their men, saying, Have no fear because of the servants of the Chaldaeans; go on living in the land under the rule of the king of Babylon, and all will be well.
sentences.susu: Gɛdalaya naxa laayidi tongo e tan nun e xa sɔɔrie bɛ, a naxɛ, «Wo naxa gaaxu Kalidikae ya ra. Wo lu yi bɔxi ma Babilɔn mangɛ xa yaamari bun ma, na kui wo xa fe sɔɔnɛyama nɛ.»

sentences.english: But in the seventh month, Ishmael, the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the king's seed, came with ten men and made an attack on Gedaliah, causing his death and the death of the Jews and the Chaldaeans who were with him at Mizpah.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a kike solofere nde ra, Netaniya xa di Sumayila, naxan tanun findi Elisama ra mangɛ bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, naxa fa a nun mixi fu ra, e fa Gɛdalaya faxa, a Yudakae nun Kalidikae faxa, naxee nu na a sɛɛti ma Misipa.

sentences.english: Then all the people, small and great, and the captains of the forces, got up and went away to Egypt, for fear of the Chaldaeans.
sentences.susu: Na kui ɲama birin, forie, dimɛdie nun sɔɔri mangɛe naxa e gi e siga Misira bɔxi ma, barima e nu gaaxuxi Kalidikae ya ra.

sentences.english: And in the thirty-seventh year after Jehoiachin, king of Judah, had been taken prisoner, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evil-merodach, king of Babylon, in the first year of his rule, took Jehoiachin, king of Judah, out of prison;
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Yehoyakini xa sigɛ ɲɛ tongo saxan nun solofere nde ra Babilɔn bɔxi ma, a kike fu nun firin nde, xi mɔxɔɲɛn nun solofere nde ra, Babilɔn mangɛ Efili Merodaki naxa Yudaya mangɛ Yehoyakini ramini geeli.

sentences.english: And said kind words to him, and put his seat higher than the seats of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.
sentences.susu: A naxa hinnɛ a ra, a a xa kibanyi radangi mangɛ gbɛtɛe ra, a tan nun naxee nu a ra Babilɔn bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And his prison clothing was changed, and he was a guest at the king's table every day for the rest of his life.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa geelimani sosee masara, a nu fa lu a dɛge ra mangɛ xa teebili ra tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: And for his food, the king gave him a regular amount every day for the rest of his life.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn mangɛ naxa a ɲɔxɔ sa a xa fe xɔn ma a fanyi ra a xa simaya birin kui.

sentences.english: Adam, Seth, Enosh;
sentences.susu: Adama naxa Seti sɔtɔ. Seti naxa Enosi sɔtɔ. Enosi naxa Kenan sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,
sentences.susu: Kenan naxa Mahalaleli sɔtɔ. Mahalaleli naxa Yeredi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech;
sentences.susu: Yeredi naxa Enoki sɔtɔ. Enoki naxa Metusela sɔtɔ. Metusela naxa Lemeki sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
sentences.susu: Lemeki naxa Nuha sɔtɔ. Nuha naxa di xɛmɛ saxan sɔtɔ: Semi, Hami, nun Yefeti.

sentences.english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer and Magog and Madai and Javan and Tubal and Meshech and Tiras.
sentences.susu: Yefeti xa die nan ya: Gomeri, Magogo, Madayi, Yawani, Tubali, Meseki, nun Tirasi.

sentences.english: And the sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz and Diphath and Togarmah.
sentences.susu: Gomeri xa die nan ya: Asikenasi, Rifati, nun Togarama.

sentences.english: And the sons of Javan: Elishah and Tarshish, Kittim and Rodanim.
sentences.susu: Yawani xa die nan ya: Elisaha, Tarasisi, Kitimi, nun Rodanimi.

sentences.english: The sons of Ham: Cush and Egypt, Put and Canaan.
sentences.susu: Hami xa die nan ya: Kusi, Misirayimi, Puti, nun Kanaan.

sentences.english: And the sons of Cush: Seba and Havilah and Sabta and Raama and Sabteca. And the sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.
sentences.susu: Kusi xa die nan ya: Seba, Xawila, Sabata, Raama, nun Sabiteka. Raama xa die nan ya: Seeba nun Dedan.

sentences.english: And Cush was the father of Nimrod: he was the first to be a great man in the earth.
sentences.susu: Kusi naxa Nimirodi bari, naxan findi geresoe singe ra adamadie tagi.

sentences.english: And Egypt was the father of the Ludim and the Anamim and the Lehabim and the Naphtuhim
sentences.susu: Misirayimi naxa die sɔtɔ, naxee findixi Ludukae, Anamikae, Lehabakae, Nafatukae,

sentences.english: And the Pathrusim and the Casluhim and the Caphtorim (from whom came the Philistines).
sentences.susu: Patirusukae, Kasaluxukae, nun Kafatorokae ra. Filisitakae benba na Kafatoro nan na.

sentences.english: And Canaan was the father of Zidon, his oldest son, and Heth,
sentences.susu: Kanaan naxa die sɔtɔ, naxee findixi Sidɔnkae, Xitikae,

sentences.english: And the Jebusite and the Amorite and the Girgashite,
sentences.susu: Yebusukae, Amorikae, Girigasakae,

sentences.english: And the Hivite and the Arkite and the Sinite,
sentences.susu: Hiwikae, Arakakae, Sinikae,

sentences.english: And the Arvadite and the Zemarite and the Hamathite.
sentences.susu: Arawadakae, Semarakae, nun Xamatakae ra.

sentences.english: The sons of Shem: Elam and Asshur and Arpachshad and Lud and Aram and Uz and Hul and Gether and Meshech.
sentences.susu: Semi xa die nan ya: Elama, Asuri, Arafaxadi, Ludu, nun Arami. Arami xa die nan ya: Usu, Xulu, Geteri, nun Meseki.

sentences.english: And Arpachshad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
sentences.susu: Arafaxadi naxa Sela sɔtɔ. Sela naxa Eberi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Eber had two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, because in his days a division was made of the earth; and his brother's name was Joktan.
sentences.susu: Eberi naxa di xɛmɛ firin sɔtɔ. Keren xili Pelegi barima bɔxi itaxunxi a xa waxati. A firin nde xili Yokatan.

sentences.english: And Joktan was the father of Almodad and Sheleph and Hazarmaveth and Jerah
sentences.susu: Yokatan xa die nan ya: Alomodadi, Selefa, Xasaramawete, Yera,

sentences.english: And Hadoram and Uzal and Diklah
sentences.susu: Hadorami, Usali, Dikila,

sentences.english: And Ebal and Abimael and Sheba
sentences.susu: Obala, Abimayele, Seeba, Ofiri, Xawila, nun Yobabo.

sentences.english: And Ophir and Havilah and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
sentences.susu: Yokatan xa die nan na ki.

sentences.english: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,
sentences.susu: Semi naxa Arafaxadi sɔtɔ. Arafaxadi naxa Sela sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
sentences.susu: Sela naxa Eberi sɔtɔ. Eberi naxa Pelegi sɔtɔ. Pelegi naxa Rewu sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
sentences.susu: Rewu naxa Serugu sɔtɔ. Serugu naxa Naxori sɔtɔ. Naxori naxa Tera sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Abram (that is Abraham).
sentences.susu: Tera naxa Iburama sɔtɔ naxan findi Iburahima ra.

sentences.english: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.
sentences.susu: Iburahima xa die nan ya: Isiyaga nun Sumayila.

sentences.english: These are their generations: the oldest son of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar and Adbeel and Mibsam,
sentences.susu: Sumayila xa die nan ya: Sumayila xa di singe Nebayoti, Kedari, Adabeeli, Mibisami,

sentences.english: Mishma and Dumah, Massa, Hadad and Tema,
sentences.susu: Misema, Duma, Masa, Hadada, Tema,

sentences.english: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
sentences.susu: Yeturi, Nafisi, nun Kedema. Sumayila xa die nan na ki.

sentences.english: And the sons of Keturah, Abraham's servant-wife: she was the mother of Zimran and Jokshan and Medan and Midian and Ishbak and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.
sentences.susu: Iburahima xa konyi ginɛ Ketura xa die nan ya a naxee bari Iburahima bɛ: Simiran, Yokosan, Medan, Madiyan, Yisebaki, nun Suuwa. Yokosan naxa Seeba nun Dedan sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Midian: Ephah and Epher and Hanoch and Abida and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.
sentences.susu: Madiyan naxa Efa, Efere, Xanɔki, Abida, nun Elidaa sɔtɔ. Yi die birin fatanxi Ketura nan na.

sentences.english: And Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa Isiyaga sɔtɔ. Isiyaga xa die nan ya: Esayu nun Isirayila.

sentences.english: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel and Jeush and Jalam and Korah.
sentences.susu: Esayu xa die nan ya: Elifasi, Reyuweli, Yeyusu, Yalami, nun Kora.

sentences.english: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman and Omar, Zephi and Gatam, Kenaz and Timna and Amalek.
sentences.susu: Elifasi xa die nan ya: Teman, Omaru, Sefi, Gatami, Kenasi, Timina, nun Amalɛki.

sentences.english: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah and Mizzah.
sentences.susu: Reyuweli xa die nan ya: Naxati, Sera, Saama, nun Misa.

sentences.english: And the sons of Seir: Lotan and Shobal and Zibeon and Anah and Dishon and Ezer and Dishan.
sentences.susu: Seyiri xa die nan ya: Lotan, Sobali, Sibeyon, Ana, Dison, Eseri, nun Disan.

sentences.english: And the sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan's sister.
sentences.susu: Lotan xa die nan ya: Xori nun Homami. Lotan maaginɛ xili Timina.

sentences.english: The sons of Shobal: Alian and Manahath and Ebal, Shephi and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.
sentences.susu: Sobali xa die nan ya: Aliban, Manaxati, Ebali, Sefi, nun Onan. Sibeyon xa die nan ya: Aya nun Ana.

sentences.english: The sons of Anah: Dishon. And the sons of Dishon: Hamran and Eshban and Ithran and Cheran.
sentences.susu: Ana xa di xili Dison. Dison xa die nan ya: Xemedan, Eseban, Yitiran, nun Keran.

sentences.english: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan and Zaavan, Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
sentences.susu: Eseri xa die nan ya: Bilihan, Saawan, Yaakan. Disan xa die nan ya: Usu nun Aran.

sentences.english: Now these are the kings who were ruling in the land of Edom, before there was any king over Israel: Bela, the son of Beor; his town was named Dinhabah.
sentences.susu: Mangɛe nan ya naxee bara Edon bɔxi yamari beenu Isirayilakae xa mangɛ nde sɔtɔ: Beyori xa di Bela, naxan kelixi Dinhaba taa.

sentences.english: At his death, Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Bela to faxa, Sera xa di Yobabo, naxan kelixi Bosara, naxa bɔxi yamari.

sentences.english: At the death of Jobab, Husham, from the land of the Temanites, became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Yobabo to faxa, Xusama, naxan kelixi Teman, naxa bɔxi yamari.

sentences.english: And at the death of Husham, Hadad, the son of Bedad, who overcame Midian in the field of Moab, became king; his town was named Avith.
sentences.susu: Xusama to faxa, Bedada xa di Hadada, naxan nu bara Madiyankae bɔnbɔ Mowaba bɔxi ma, naxa bɔxi yamari. A kelixi Abiti taa nɛ.

sentences.english: And at the death of Hadad, Samlah of Masrekah became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Hadada to faxa, Masareka Samala naxa bɔxi yamari.

sentences.english: And at the death of Samlah, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river became king in his place,
sentences.susu: Samala to faxa, Sawulu naxan kelixi Rehoboti, taa naxan na xure dɛ ra, naxa bɔxi yamari.

sentences.english: And at the death of Shaul, Baal-hanan, the son of Achbor, became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Sawulu to faxa, Akibori xa di Bali Xanan naxa bɔxi yamari.

sentences.english: And at the death of Baal-hanan, Hadad became king in his place; his town was named Pai, and his wife's name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Me-zahab.
sentences.susu: Bali Xanan to faxa, Hadada, naxan kelixi Pawu, naxa bɔxi yamari. A xa ginɛ xili Mehetabeli. Na nga xili Matirɛdi, a mama xili Mesahabi.

sentences.english: And Hadad came to his end. Now the chiefs of Edom were: the chief of Timna, the chief of Aliah, the chief of Jetheth,
sentences.susu: Hadada fan naxa faxa. Edon mangɛe nan ya: Timina, Aliba, Yeteti,

sentences.english: The chief of Oholibamah, the chief of Elah, the chief of Pinon,
sentences.susu: Oholibama, Ela, Pinon,

sentences.english: The chief of Kenaz, the chief of Teman, the chief of Mibzar,
sentences.susu: Kenasi, Teman, Mibisari,

sentences.english: The chief of Magdiel, the chief of Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.
sentences.susu: Magadiyɛli, nun Irami. Edon mangɛe nan na ki.

sentences.english: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi and Judah, Issachar and Zebulun;
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa die nan ya: Ruben, Simeyɔn, Lewi, Yuda, Isakari, Sabulon,

sentences.english: Dan, Joseph and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad and Asher.
sentences.susu: Dana, Yusufu, Bunyamin, Nafatali, Gadi, nun Aseri.

sentences.english: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan and Shelah; these three were his sons by Bathshua, the Canaanite woman. And Er, Judah's oldest son, did evil in the eyes of the Lord; and he put him to death.
sentences.susu: Yuda xa die nan ya: Eri, Onan, Sela. Suwa xa di ginɛ Kanaanka nan e barixi. Yuda xa di singe Eri naxa fe ɲaaxi raba Alatala ya i. A a faxa na nan ma.

sentences.english: And Tamar, his daughter-in-law, had Perez and Zerah by him. All the sons of Judah were five.
sentences.susu: Yuda xa mamadi Tamari naxa Peresi nun Sera bari a bɛ. Yuda di suuli sɔtɔ na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.
sentences.susu: Peresi xa die nan ya: Xesiron nun Xamuli.

sentences.english: And the sons of Zerah: Zimri and Ethan and Heman and Calcol and Dara; five of them.
sentences.susu: Sera xa di suulie nan ya: Simiri, Etani, Heman, Kalikɔli, nun Darada.

sentences.english: And the sons of Carmi: Achan, the troubler of Israel, who did wrong about the cursed thing.
sentences.susu: Karimi naxa Akan sɔtɔ, naxan bara fe ɲaaxi raba Isirayila ra a to se ratɔnxi tongo.

sentences.english: And the son of Ethan: Azariah.
sentences.susu: Etani naxa Asaraya sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Hezron, the offspring of his body: Jerahmeel and Ram and Chelubai.
sentences.susu: Xesiron xa die nan ya: Yerameeli, Rami, nun Kalebi.

sentences.english: And Ram was the father of Amminadab; and Amminadab was the father of Nahshon, chief of the children of Judah;
sentences.susu: Rami naxa Aminadabo sɔtɔ. Aminadabo naxa Naxason sɔtɔ, naxan findi Yudayakae xa mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Nahshon was the father of Salma, and Salma was the father of Boaz,
sentences.susu: Naxason naxa Salimon sɔtɔ. Salimon naxa Boosu sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Boaz was the father of Obed, and Obed was the father of Jesse,
sentences.susu: Boosu naxa Obedo sɔtɔ. Obedo naxa Yisayi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Jesse was the father of Eliab, his oldest son, and Abinadab, the second, and Shimea, the third,
sentences.susu: Yisayi xa die nan ya: Eliyabi, a xa di singe, Abinadabo, a xa di firin nde, Simeya, a xa di saxan nde,

sentences.english: Nethanel, the fourth, Raddai, the fifth,
sentences.susu: Netaneeli, a xa di naani nde, Radayi, a xa di suuli nde,

sentences.english: Ozem, the sixth, David, the seventh;
sentences.susu: Osemi, a xa di senni nde, nun Dawuda, a xa di solofere nde.

sentences.english: And their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. And Zeruiah had three sons: Abishai and Joab and Asahel.
sentences.susu: Yisayi xa di ginɛe nan ya: Seruya nun Abigayili. Seruya naxa di xɛmɛ saxan sɔtɔ: Abisayi, Yowaba, nun Asahɛli.

sentences.english: And Abigail was the mother of Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.
sentences.susu: Abigayili naxa Amasa sɔtɔ Yeteri bɛ, naxan fatanxi Sumayila bɔnsɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Caleb, the son of Hezron, had children by Azubah his wife, the daughter of Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher and Shobab and Ardon.
sentences.susu: Xesiron xa di Kalebi naxa die sɔtɔ a xa ginɛ Asuba ra. E xili Yesere, Sobabo, nun Aradon. A xa ginɛ Yeriyoti fan naxa di nde sɔtɔ a bɛ.

sentences.english: And after the death of Azubah, Caleb took as his wife Ephrath, who was the mother of Hur.
sentences.susu: Asuba to faxa, Kalebi naxa Efarata dɔxɔ, naxan Xuru bari a bɛ.

sentences.english: And Hur was the father of Uri; and Uri was the father of Bezalel.
sentences.susu: Xuru naxa Uri sɔtɔ. Uri naxa Bɛsalɛli sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And after that, Hezron had connection with the daughter of Machir, the father of Gilead, whom he took as his wife when he was sixty years old; and she had Segub by him.
sentences.susu: Xesiron to ɲɛ tongo senni sɔtɔ, a naxa Galadi baba Makiri xa di ginɛ dɔxɔ. E naxa Segubu sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Segub was the father of Jair, who had twenty-three towns in the land of Gilead.
sentences.susu: Segubu naxa Yayiri sɔtɔ, naxan taa mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan yaamari Galadi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Geshur and Aram took the tent-towns of Jair from them, with Kenath and the small places round it, even sixty towns. All these were the sons of Machir, the father of Gilead.
sentences.susu: Gesurikae nun Siriyakae naxa Yayiri xa taae sɔtɔ a nun Kenata nun taa tongo senni naxee na a rabilinyi. Yi mixi birin kelixi Makiri bɔnsɔɛ nɛ, Galadi baba.

sentences.english: And after the death of Hezron, Caleb had connection with Ephrath, his father Hezron's wife, and she gave birth to his son Asshur, the father of Tekoa.
sentences.susu: Xesiron to faxa Kalebi Efarata, a xa ginɛ Abiya naxa Asexuri bari a bɛ, naxan findi Tekowa baba ra.

sentences.english: And the sons of Jerahmeel, the oldest son of Hezron, were Ram, the oldest, and Bunah and Oren and Ozem and Ahijah.
sentences.susu: Xesiron xa di singe Yerameeli xa die nan ya: Rami, a xa di singe, Buna, Oreni, Osemi, nun Ahiya.

sentences.english: And Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah: she was the mother of Onam.
sentences.susu: Yerameeli xa ginɛ boore Atara naxa Onan sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Ram, the oldest son of Jerahmeel, were Maaz and Jamin and Eker.
sentences.susu: Yerameeli xa di singe Rami xa die nan ya: Maasa, Yamin, nun Ekeri.

sentences.english: And the sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada; and the sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.
sentences.susu: Onan ma die nan ya: Samayi nun Yada. Samayi xa die nan ya: Nadabo nun Abisuri.

sentences.english: And the name of Abishur's wife was Abihail; and she had Ahban and Molid by him.
sentences.susu: Abisuri xa ginɛ Abixayili naxa Axaban nun Molidi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled came to his end without sons.
sentences.susu: Nadabo xa die nan ya: Seleda nun Apayimi. Seleda naxa faxa a ditare ra.

sentences.english: And the sons of Appaim: Ishi. And the sons of Ishi: Sheshan. And the sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.
sentences.susu: Apayimi naxa Yiseyi sɔtɔ. Yiseyi naxa Sesaan sɔtɔ. Sesaan naxa Axalayi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Jada, the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether came to his end without sons.
sentences.susu: Samayi xunya Yada xa di nan ya: Yeteri nun Yonatan. Yeteri naxa faxa a ditare ra.

sentences.english: And the sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
sentences.susu: Yonatan xa die nan ya: Peleta nun Sasa. Yerameeli xa die nan na ki.

sentences.english: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. And Sheshan had an Egyptian servant, whose name was Jarha.
sentences.susu: Sesaan mu di xɛmɛ yo sɔtɔ fo di ginɛe. A xa konyi Misiraka xili Yara.

sentences.english: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha, his servant, as a wife; and she had Attai by him.
sentences.susu: Sesaan naxa a xa di ginɛ fi a xa konyi Yara ma. A naxa Atayi bari.

sentences.english: And Attai was the father of Nathan, and Nathan was the father of Zabad,
sentences.susu: Atayi naxa Natan sɔtɔ. Natan naxa Sabadi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Zabad was the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal was the father of Obed,
sentences.susu: Sabadi naxa Efilali sɔtɔ. Efilali naxa Obedo sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Obed was the father of Jehu, and Jehu was the father of Azariah,
sentences.susu: Obedo naxa Yehu sɔtɔ. Yehu naxa Asaraya sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Azariah was the father of Helez, and Helez was the father of Eleasah,
sentences.susu: Asaraya naxa Xɛlɛsi sɔtɔ. Xɛlɛsi naxa Eleyasa sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Eleasah was the father of Sismai, and Sismai was the father of Shallum,
sentences.susu: Eleyasa naxa Sisimayi sɔtɔ. Sisimayi naxa Salumu sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Shallum was the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah was the father of Elishama.
sentences.susu: Salumu naxa Yekamiya sɔtɔ. Yekamiya naxa Elisama sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel, were Mareshah, his oldest son, who was the father of Ziph and Hebron.
sentences.susu: Yerameeli xunya Kalebi xa di singe xili Mesa. Mesa naxa Sifi nun Maresa sɔtɔ, naxan findi Xebiron baba ra.

sentences.english: And the sons of Hebron: Korah and Tappuah and Rekem and Shema.
sentences.susu: Xebiron xa die nan ya: Kora, Tapuwa, Rekemi, nun Sema.

sentences.english: And Shema was the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam, and Rekem was the father of Shammai.
sentences.susu: Sema naxa Raxami sɔtɔ. Raxami naxa Yoreyami sɔtɔ. Rekemi naxa Samayi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
sentences.susu: Samayi naxa Mayon sɔtɔ. Mayon naxa Beti Suru sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Ephah, Caleb's servant-wife, had Haran and Moza and Gazez; and Haran was the father of Gazez.
sentences.susu: Kalebi xa konyi ginɛ Efa xa die nan ya: Xarani, Mosa, nun Gasɛsi. Xarani naxa Gasɛsi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Jahdai: Regem and Jotham and Geshan and Pelet and Ephah and Shaaph.
sentences.susu: Yadayi xa die nan ya: Regemi, Yotami, Gesana, Pɛlɛti, Efa, nun Saafi.

sentences.english: Maacah, Caleb's servant-wife, was the mother of Sheber and Tirhanah,
sentences.susu: Kalebi xa konyi ginɛ Maaka xa die nan ya: Seberi nun Tirana.

sentences.english: And Shaaph, the father of Madmannah, Sheva, the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and Caleb's daughter was Achsah. These were the sons of Caleb.
sentences.susu: A man naxa Madamanna baba Saafi nun Makabena nun Gibiya baba Sewa bari. Kalebi xa di ginɛ xili Akasa.

sentences.english: The sons of Hur, the oldest son of Ephrathah; Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim,
sentences.susu: Kalebi xa die nan ya: Sobali, Xuru xa di, a xa ginɛ Efarata xa di singe, Kiriyati Yeyarimi baba,

sentences.english: Salma, the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph, the father of Beth-gader.
sentences.susu: Salima, Bɛtɛlɛɛmu baba, nun Xarefa, Beti Gaderi baba.

sentences.english: And Shobal, the father of Kiriath-jearim, had sons: Haroeh, half of the Manahathites.
sentences.susu: Kiriyati Yeyarimi baba Sobali xa die nan ya: Harowe, Menuhoti bɔnsɔɛ tagi.

sentences.english: And the families of Kiriath-jearim: the Ithrites and the Puthites and the Shumathites and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
sentences.susu: Kiriyati Yeyarimi xabilɛe nan ya: Itirikae, Putikae, Suumaka, nun Miserayikae. Soreyatakae nun Esetayolikae fatanxi e tan nan na.

sentences.english: The sons of Salma: Beth-lehem and the Netophathites, Atroth-beth-Joab and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
sentences.susu: Salima xa die nan ya: Bɛtɛlɛɛmu, Netofakae, Atiroti Beti Yowaba, Menuhoti bɔnsɔɛ tagi, Sorahakae,

sentences.english: And the families of scribes who were living at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, the Sucathites. These are the Kenites, the offspring of Hammath, the father of the family of Rechab.
sentences.susu: sɛbɛlitie xabilɛ naxee sabatixi Yabɛsi, Tiratikae, Simeyatakae, nun Sukatikae. Kenikae nan na ki, naxee fatanxi Xamata, Rekabu baba ra.

sentences.english: Now these were David's sons, whose birth took place in Hebron: the oldest Amnon, by Ahinoam of Jezreel; the second Daniel, by Abigail the Carmelite woman;
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa di naxee barixi Xebiron, nee nan ya: A xa di singe Aminon, naxan nga findi Axinowama ra Yisireelika, a xa di firin nde Daniyɛli, naxan nga findi Abigayili ra Karemeleka,

sentences.english: The third Absalom, the son of Maacah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur; the fourth Adonijah, the son of Haggith;
sentences.susu: a xa di saxan nde Abisalomi, naxan nga findi Gesuri mangɛ Talamayi xa di ginɛ Maaka ra, a xa di naani nde Adoniya, naxan nga findi Xagiti ra,

sentences.english: The fifth Shephatiah, by Abital; the sixth Ithream, by Eglah his wife.
sentences.susu: a xa di suuli nde Sɛfataya, naxan nga findi Abitali ra, a xa di senni nde Yitireyami, naxan nga findi Egela ra.

sentences.english: He had six sons in Hebron; he was ruling there for seven years and six months, and in Jerusalem for thirty-three years.
sentences.susu: Yi di senni barixi Xebiron nɛ. Dawuda naxa mangɛya raba Xebiron ɲɛ solofere, kike senni, a naxa mangɛya raba Darisalamu ɲɛ tongo saxan nun saxan.

sentences.english: And in Jerusalem he had four sons, Shimea and Shobab and Nathan and Solomon, by Bath-shua, the daughter of Ammiel;
sentences.susu: Di naani nan ya a naxee sɔtɔ Darisalamu Amiyɛli xa di ginɛ Batiseba ra: Simeya, Sobabo, Natan, Sulemani.

sentences.english: And Ibhar and Elishama and Eliphelet
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa di solomanaanie nan ya: Yibixari, Elisuwa, Elifeleti,

sentences.english: And Nogah and Nepheg and Japhia
sentences.susu: Noga, Nefegi, Yafiya,

sentences.english: And Elishama and Eliada and Eliphelet, nine.
sentences.susu: Elisama, Eliyada, nun Elifeleti.

sentences.english: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of his servant-wives; and Tamar was their sister.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa die, a naxee sɔtɔ konyi ginɛe saabui ra mu na yi die ya ma. Tamari findi e maaginɛ nan na.

sentences.english: And Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Abijah was his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa Robowami sɔtɔ. Robowami naxa Abiya sɔtɔ. Abiya naxa Asa sɔtɔ. Asa naxa Yehosafati sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
sentences.susu: Yehosafati naxa Yorami sɔtɔ. Yorami naxa Axasiya sɔtɔ. Axasiya naxa Yowasi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
sentences.susu: Yowasi naxa Amasiya sɔtɔ. Amasiya naxa Asaraya sɔtɔ. Asaraya naxa Yotami sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
sentences.susu: Yotami naxa Axasi sɔtɔ. Axasi naxa Xesekiya sɔtɔ. Xesekiya naxa Manasi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
sentences.susu: Manasi naxa Amon sɔtɔ. Amon naxa Yosiya sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Josiah: the oldest Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
sentences.susu: Yosiya xa di singe naxa findi Yoxanan na, a xa di firin nde, Yehoyakimi, a xa di saxan nde, Sidekiya, nun a xa di naani nde, Salumu.

sentences.english: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
sentences.susu: Yehoyakimi naxa Yekoniya nun Sidekiya sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Jeconiah, who was taken prisoner: Shealtiel his son,
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Yekoniya naxan nu na konyiya kui, a xa die nan ya: Salatiyeli,

sentences.english: And Malchiram and Pedaiah and Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama and Nedabiah.
sentences.susu: Malakirami, Pɛdaya, Seenasari, Yekamiya, Hosama, nun Nedabiya.

sentences.english: And the sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei; and the sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;
sentences.susu: Pɛdaya xa die nan ya: Sorobabeli nun Simeyi. Sorobabeli xa die nan ya: Mesulama nun Xananiya. Selomiti naxa findi e maaginɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Hashubah and Ohel and Berechiah and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.
sentences.susu: Pɛdaya xa di suuli booree nan ya: Xasuba, Oheli, Berekiya, Xasadiya, nun Yusabi Xeseda.

sentences.english: And the sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
sentences.susu: Xananiya xa die nan ya: Pɛlataya, Yɛsaya, Rɛfaya xa die, Aranan xa die, Abadiyasi xa die, Sɛkanaya xa die.

sentences.english: And the sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah; and the sons of Shemaiah: Hattush and Igal and Bariah and Neariah and Shaphat, six.
sentences.susu: Sɛkanaya xa di findi Semaya nan na. Semaya xa die nan ya: Xatusi, Yigali, Bariya, Neyaraya, nun Safati, e birin nalanxi mixi senni.

sentences.english: And the sons of Neariah: Elioenai and Hizkiah and Azrikam, three.
sentences.susu: Neyaraya xa die nan ya: Eliyowenayi, Xisikiya, nun Asirikama, e birin nalanxi mixi saxan.

sentences.english: And the sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah and Eliashib and Pelaiah and Akkub and Johanan and Delaiah and Anani, seven.
sentences.susu: Eliyowenayi xa die nan ya: Hodafiya, Eliyasibu, Pɛlaya, Akubu, Yoxanan, Dɛlaya, nun Anani, e birin nalanxi mixi solofere.

sentences.english: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron and Carmi and Hur and Shobal.
sentences.susu: Yuda xa die nan ya: Peresi, Xesiron, Karimi, Xuru nun Sobali.

sentences.english: And Reaiah, the son of Shobal, was the father of Jahath; and Jahath was the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
sentences.susu: Sobali xa di Reyaya naxa Yaxati sɔtɔ. Yaxati naxa Axumayi nun Lahadi sɔtɔ. Soreyatakae xabilɛe fatanxi nee nan na.

sentences.english: And these were the sons of Hur, the father of Etam: Jezreel and Ishma and Idbash, and the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi;
sentences.susu: Etami xa die nan ya: Yisireeli, Yisema, nun Yidibasi. E maaginɛ xili Haseleliponi.

sentences.english: And Penuel, the father of Gedor, and Ezer, the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the oldest son of Ephrathah, the father of Beth-lehem.
sentences.susu: Penuweli findi Gedori baba nan na. Eseri naxa findi Xusa baba ra. Yi mixie fatanxi Xuru nan na, Efarata xa di singe, Bɛtɛlɛɛmu baba.

sentences.english: And Ashhur, the father of Tekoa, had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
sentences.susu: Tekowa baba Asexuri naxa ginɛ firin dɔxɔ, Xela nun Nayara.

sentences.english: And Naarah had Ahuzzam by him, and Hepher and Temeni and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
sentences.susu: Nayara naxa Axusami, Xeferi, Temeni, nun Axasetari bari Asexuri bɛ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar and Ethnan.
sentences.susu: Xela naxa Sɛrɛti, Soxara, Etenani, nun Kosi bari a bɛ.

sentences.english: And Koz was the father of Anub and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
sentences.susu: Kosi naxa Anubi nun Sobeba sɔtɔ, a nun Harumi xa di Axaraxeli xabilɛe.

sentences.english: And Jabez was honoured more than his brothers; but his mother had given him the name Jabez, saying, Because I gave birth to him with sorrow.
sentences.susu: Yabɛsi naxa binyɛ sɔtɔ dangife a ngaxakerenyie birin na. A nga naxa a xili sa Yabɛsi barima a a sɔtɔ tɔɔrɛ nan kui.

sentences.english: And Jabez made a prayer to the God of Israel, saying, If only you would truly give me a blessing, and make wider the limits of my land, and let your hand be with me, and keep me from evil, so that I may not be troubled by it! And God gave him his desire.
sentences.susu: Yabɛsi naxa Isirayila Marigi Ala maxandi, «I xa barakɛ sa n ma, i xa n ma bɔxi xun masa, i xa n mali i sɛnbɛ ra, i xa n natanga tɔɔrɛ ma.» Ala naxa a xa dubɛ suxu.

sentences.english: And Chelub, the brother of Shuhah, was the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
sentences.susu: Suuxa ngaxakerenyi Kelubu naxa Mexiri sɔtɔ. Mexiri naxa Eseton sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Eshton was the father of Bethrapha and Paseah and Tehinnah, the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Recah.
sentences.susu: Eseton naxa Beti Rafa, Paseya, nun Texinna sɔtɔ. Texinna naxa Iri Naxasa sɔtɔ. Yi mixie findixi Rekakae nan na.

sentences.english: And the sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah; and the sons of Othniel: Hathath.
sentences.susu: Kenasi xa die nan ya: Otiniyeli nun Seraya. Otiniyeli xa die nan ya: Xatati nun Meyonotayi.

sentences.english: And Meonothai was the father of Ophrah; and Seraiah was the father of Joab, the father of Ge-harashim; they were expert workmen.
sentences.susu: Meyonotayi naxa Ofara sɔtɔ. Seraya naxa Yowaba sɔtɔ, naxan findi xabuie baba ra naxee nu na Xabuie xa gulunba.

sentences.english: And the sons of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the son of Elah: Kenaz.
sentences.susu: Yefune xa di Kalebi xa die nan ya: Iru, Ela, nun Naami. Ela naxa Kenasi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Jehallelel: Ziph and Ziphah, Tiria and Asarel.
sentences.susu: Yehaleleli xa die nan ya: Sifi, Sifa, Tiriya, nun Asareeli.

sentences.english: And the sons of Ezrah: Jether and Mered and Epher and Jalon; and these are the sons of Bithiah, the daughter of Pharaoh, the wife of Mered. And she became the mother of Miriam and Shammai and Ishbah, the father of Eshtemoa.
sentences.susu: Esira xa die nan ya: Yeteri, Meredi, Efere, nun Yalon. Meredi xa ginɛ nde naxa Mariyama, Samayi, nun Yiseba bari. Yiseba naxa findi Esitemowa baba ra.

sentences.english: And his wife, a woman of the tribe of Judah, became the mother of Jered, the father of Gedor, and Heber, the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel, the father of Zanoah.
sentences.susu: Meredi xa ginɛ Yudayaka xa die nan ya: Gedori baba Yeredi, Soko baba Xeberi, Sanowa baba Yekutiyeli. Firawuna xa di Bitiya, naxan nu bara dɔxɔ Meredi xɔn ma, na nan na die bari.

sentences.english: And the sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
sentences.susu: Hodiya xa ginɛ, Naxami maaginɛ, naxa Keyila baba Garimika sɔtɔ, a nun Esitemowa Maakaka.

sentences.english: And the sons of Shimon: Amnon and Rinnah, Ben-hanan and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi: Zoheth; and the son of Zoheth. ...
sentences.susu: Simon xa die nan ya: Aminon, Rinna, Ben Xanan, nun Tilon. Yiseyi naxa Soxeti nun Ben Soxeti sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: The sons of Shelah, the son of Judah: Er, the father of Lecah, and Laadah, the father of Mareshah, and the families of those who made delicate linen, of the family of Ashbea;
sentences.susu: Yuda xa di Sela xa die nan ya: Leka baba Eri, Maresa baba Laada, Asibeya xabilɛ naxee dugi yailanma,

sentences.english: And Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash and Saraph, who were rulers in Moab, and went back to Beth-lehem. And the records are very old.
sentences.susu: Yokimi, Kosebakae, Yowasi, nun Sarafi, naxan Mowaba nun Yasubi Lɛxɛmi yaamari kabi tɛmui xɔnnakuye.

sentences.english: These were the potters, and the people living among planted fields with walls round them; they were there to do the king's work.
sentences.susu: E tan nan nu fɛɲɛ yailanma mangɛ bɛ Netayimi nun Gedera taae kui e nu sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;
sentences.susu: Simeyɔn xa die nan ya: Nemuweli, Yamin, Yaribu, Sera, nun Sawulu.

sentences.english: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
sentences.susu: Sawulu naxa Salumu sɔtɔ. Salumu naxa Mibisami sɔtɔ. Mibisami naxa Misema sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.
sentences.susu: Misema naxa Xamuwɛli sɔtɔ. Xamuwɛli naxa Sakuru sɔtɔ. Sakuru naxa Simeyi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers had only a small number of children, and their family was not as fertile as the children of Judah.
sentences.susu: Simeyi naxa di xɛmɛ fu nun senni nun di ginɛ senni sɔtɔ. A ngaxakerenyie mu di gbegbe sɔtɔ. E xabilɛe mu wuya alɔ Yuda bɔnsɔɛ.

sentences.english: And they were living at Beer-sheba and Moladah and Hazar-shual,
sentences.susu: E sabatixi Beriseeba, Molada, Xasari Suwali,

sentences.english: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
sentences.susu: Bila, Esemi, Toladi,

sentences.english: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
sentences.susu: Betuweli, Horoma, Sikilaga,

sentences.english: And at Beth-marcaboth, and at Hazarsusim, and at Beth-biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their towns till David became king.
sentences.susu: Beti Marakaboti, Xasari Susimi, Beti Biri, nun Saarayimi. E naxa lu na taae kui han Dawuda xa mangɛya tɛmui.

sentences.english: And their small towns were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen and Ashan, five towns;
sentences.susu: E man nu na Etami, Ayin, Rimɔn, Token, nun Asan, na taa suuli

sentences.english: And all the small places round these towns, as far as Baalath-beer, the high place of the South. These were their living-places, and they have lists of their generations.
sentences.susu: nun e rabilinyi han Baalati. E xa bɔxie nun e benbae nan na ki.

sentences.english: And Meshobab and Jamlech and Joshah, the son of Amaziah,
sentences.susu: Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ xunyie nan ya: Mesobabo, Yameleki, Amasiya xa di Yosa,

sentences.english: And Joel and Jehu, the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
sentences.susu: Yoweli, Yosibiya xa di Yehu, Asiyeli xa di Seraya,

sentences.english: And Elioenai and Jaakobah and Jeshohaiah and Asaiah and Adiel and Jesimiel and Benaiah,
sentences.susu: Eliyowenayi, Yaakoba, Yesohaya, Asaya, Adiyeli, Yesimiyeli, Bɛnaya,

sentences.english: And Ziza, the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
sentences.susu: nun Sisa, Sifeyi xa di, Alon xa di, Yɛdaya xa di, Simiri xa di, Semaya xa di.

sentences.english: These, whose names are given, were chiefs in their families, and their families became very great in number.
sentences.susu: Xabilɛe mangɛe nan na ki. E xa denbayae naxa wuya ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And they went to the opening into Gedor, as far as the east side of the valley, in search of grass-land for their flocks.
sentences.susu: E naxa siga han Gedori gulunba sogetede ɲooge yire fende e xa xurusee bɛ.

sentences.english: And they came to some good fertile grass-land, in a wide quiet country of peace-loving people; for the people who were living there before were of the offspring of Ham.
sentences.susu: E naxa fiili fanyie to naa. A belebele, mixi yo mu nu na. Singe Hami bɔnsɔɛ nan nu na mɛnni.

sentences.english: And these whose names are given came in the days of Hezekiah, king of Judah, and made an attack on the Meunim who were living there, and put an end to them to this day, and took their place, because there was grass there for their flocks.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Xesekiya xa waxati kui, yi mixi naxee xili sɛbɛxi, e naxa siga naa, e banxie birin kana, e mɛnnikae ratɔn alako e xa sabati na, ɲooge fanyi nu na dɛnnaxɛ e xa xurusee bɛ.

sentences.english: And some of them, five hundred of the sons of Simeon, went to the hill-country of Seir, with Pelatiah and Neariah and Rephaiah and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi, at their head.
sentences.susu: Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ mixi kɛmɛ suuli naxa siga Seyiri geyae yire. E xa yareratie findi Yiseyi xa die nan na, Pɛlataya, Neyaraya, Rɛfaya, nun Yusiyɛli.

sentences.english: And they put to death the rest of the Amalekites who had got away safely, and made it their living-place to this day.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ Amalɛkikae bɔnbɔde, naxee nu luxi naa, e naxa sabati mɛnni. Han to e bɔnsɔɛe na naa.

sentences.english: And the sons of Reuben, the oldest son of Israel, (for he was the oldest son, but, because he made his father's bride-bed unclean, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel; but he is not to be given the place of the oldest.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa di singe findi Ruben nan na, kɔnɔ di singe tide naxa ba a yi ra, a so Isirayila xa di Yusufu xa die yi ra, barima Ruben nu bara a baba xa ginɛ kolon ginɛ ra.

sentences.english: Though Judah became stronger than his brothers, and from him came the ruler, the birthright was Joseph's:)
sentences.susu: Yuda naxa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ a ngaxakerenyie tagi han mangɛya naxa lu a bɔnsɔɛ yi, kɔnɔ di singe tide tan naxa lu Yusufu xa die yi.

sentences.english: The sons of Reuben, the oldest son of Israel: Hanoch and Pallu, Hezron and Carmi.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa di singe Ruben xa die nan ya: Xanɔki, Palu, Xesiron, nun Karimi.

sentences.english: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
sentences.susu: Yoweli bɔnsɔɛ nan ya: Semaya naxa Gogo sɔtɔ. Gogo naxa Simeyi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
sentences.susu: Simeyi naxa Mike sɔtɔ. Mike naxa Reyaya sɔtɔ. Reyaya naxa Bali sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Beerah his son, whom Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria, took away as a prisoner: he was chief of the Reubenites.
sentences.susu: Bali naxa Bɛɛra sɔtɔ. Asiriya mangɛ Tigilati Pileseri naxa Ruben bɔnsɔɛ mangɛdi Bɛɛra xanin konyiya kui.

sentences.english: And his brothers by their families, when the list of their generations was made up: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
sentences.susu: Bɛɛra ngaxakerenyie nan ya, e xabilɛ ki ma: Yeyiyeli, Sakari,

sentences.english: And Bela, the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who was living in Aroer, as far as Nebo and Baal-meon;
sentences.susu: nun Bela, Asasi xa di, Sema xa di, Yoweli xa di. E naxa sabati bɔxi ma fɔlɔfe Aroweri sa dɔxɔ Nebo nun Bali Meyoni ra.

sentences.english: And to the east his limits went as far as the starting point of the waste land, ending at the river Euphrates, because their cattle were increased in number in the land of Gilead.
sentences.susu: E nu sabatixi gbengberenyi fɔlɛ ma, han Efirati xure ra. Xuruse gbegbe nu na e yi ra Galadi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And in the days of Saul they made war on the Hagarites, and overcame them; and they put up their tents through all the land east of Gilead.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sɔlu xa waxati kui, Ruben bɔnsɔɛ naxa Hagarikae gere, naxee nu na Galadi naaninyi sogetede biri.

sentences.english: And the sons of Gad were living opposite to them, in the land of Bashan as far as Salecah:
sentences.susu: Gadi bɔnsɔɛ nun Ruben bɔnsɔɛ sabatixi e boore nan ya i Basan bɔxi kui, han Salaka.

sentences.english: Joel the chief, and Shapham the second, and Janai and Shaphat in Bashan;
sentences.susu: E xilie nan ya: Yoweli, mixi singe, Safami, a firin nde, Yaanayi, nun Safati naxee nu na Basan bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And their brothers, the men of their family: Michael and Meshullam and Sheba and Jorai and Jacan and Zia and Eber, seven of them.
sentences.susu: E xunya solofere nan ya: Mikayeli, Mesulama, Seeba, Yorayi, Yakan, Siya, nun Eberi.

sentences.english: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
sentences.susu: Abixayili xa die nan na ki, Xuri xa di, Yarowa xa di, Galadi xa di, Mikayeli xa di, Yesisayi xa di, Yado xa di, Busi xa di.

sentences.english: Ahi, the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, head of their families.
sentences.susu: Abidiyeli xa di Axi, Guni xa mamadi, e naxa findi e xabilɛe xunyi ra.

sentences.english: And they were living in Gilead in Bashan, in its small towns and in all the grass-land of Sirion as far as its limits.
sentences.susu: E sabatixi Galadi, Basan, na rabilinyi, han Sarɔn naaninyie ra.

sentences.english: All these were listed under the names of their families, in the time of Jotham, king of Judah, and in the time of Jeroboam, king of Israel.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Yotami nun Isirayila mangɛ Yerobowami naxa e xilie sɛbɛ.

sentences.english: There were forty-four thousand, seven hundred and sixty of the sons of Reuben and of the Gadites and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, all strong men, expert in the use of the body-cover, the sword, and the bow, and in the art of war, all able to take up arms.
