sentences.susu: Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti keren, e xa sɔɔri xasabi sigama han mixi wulu tongo naani nun naani, mixi kɛmɛ solofere tongo senni. E birin fata gere sode. Makantase, santidɛgɛma, nun xali nu na e yi ra.

sentences.english: And they went to war against the Hagarites, with Jetur and Naphish and Nodab.
sentences.susu: E naxa Hagarikae, Yeturikae, Nafisikae, nun Nodabokae gere.

sentences.english: And they were helped against them, so that the Hagarites, and those with them, were given into their power. For they sent up prayers to God in the fight, and he gave ear to them, because they put their faith in him.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa xun nakeli fi e ma Hagarikae xun ma, barima e nu bara Ala maxandi gere kui. Ala naxa e xa duba suxu barima e laxi a ra.

sentences.english: And they took away their cattle: fifty thousand camels, two hundred and fifty thousand sheep, and two thousand asses, and a hundred thousand men.
sentences.susu: E naxa e yaxuie xa xurusee ba e yi: ɲɔxɔmɛ wulu tongo suuli, yɛxɛɛ nun si wulu kɛmɛ firin tongo suuli, nun sofale wulu firin. E naxa mixi wulu kɛmɛ fan suxu.

sentences.english: And a very great number went to their death, because the war was God's purpose. And they went on living in their place till they were taken away as prisoners.
sentences.susu: E e yaxui gbegbe faxa nɛ barima na gere kelixi Ala yati nan ma. E naxa sabati naa han e siga konyiya kui tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the men of the half-tribe of Manasseh were living in the land: and their numbers were increased till all the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon and Senir and the mountain Hermon was theirs.
sentences.susu: Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti keren sabatixi bɔxi nan ma naxan fɔlɔxi Basan han Bali Xerimon, sa dɔxɔ Seniri, nun Xerimon geya ra. E wuya.

sentences.english: And these were the heads of their families: Epher and Ishi and Eliel and Azriel and Jeremiah and Hodaviah and Jahdiel, men of war, of great name, heads of families.
sentences.susu: E xa denbaya mangɛe nan ya: Efere, Yiseyi, Eliyeli, Asiriyɛli, Yeremi, Hodafiya, nun Yaxadiyeli. Yi denbaya mangɛe sɛnbɛ gbo, naafuli gbegbe na e yi.

sentences.english: And they did evil against the God of their fathers, worshipping the gods of the people of the land, whom God had put to destruction before them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e naxa e babae Marigi Ala yanfa, e mɛnnikae xa kuyee batu, Ala nɔ naxee ra a singe.

sentences.english: And the God of Israel put an impulse into the heart of Pul, king of Assyria, and of Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria, who took them away as prisoners, all the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, to Halah and Habor and Hara and to the river of Gozan, to this day.
sentences.susu: Na kui Ala naxa a niya, Asiriya Mangɛe Pulu nun Tigilati Pileseri bɔɲɛ xa te, e fa Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ tagi xanin Xala, Xaboro, nun Hara, han Gosan xure e na dɛnnaxɛ han to.

sentences.english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
sentences.susu: Lewi xa die nan ya: Gerison, Kehati, nun Merari.

sentences.english: And the sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
sentences.susu: Gerison ma die nan ya: Libini nun Simeyi.

sentences.english: And the sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses and Miriam. And the sons of Aaron: Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
sentences.susu: Kehati xa die nan ya: Amarama, Yisehari, Xebiron, nun Yusiyɛli.

sentences.english: Eleazar was the father of Phinehas; Phinehas was the father of Abishua;
sentences.susu: Merari xa die nan ya: Maxali nun Musi.

sentences.english: And Abishua was the father of Bukki, and Bukki was the father of Uzzi,
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛe babae nan ya: Gerison naxa Libini sɔtɔ. Libini naxa Yaxati sɔtɔ. Yaxati naxa Sima sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Uzzi was the father of Zerahiah, and Zerahiah was the father of Meraioth;
sentences.susu: Sima naxa Yowa sɔtɔ. Yowa naxa Ido sɔtɔ. Ido naxa Sera sɔtɔ. Sera naxa Yeyaterayi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Meraioth was the father of Amariah, and Amariah was the father of Ahitub,
sentences.susu: Kehati xa die nan ya: Kehati naxa Aminadabo sɔtɔ. Aminadabo naxa Kora sɔtɔ. Kora naxa Asiri sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Ahitub was the father of Zadok, and Zadok was the father of Ahimaaz,
sentences.susu: Asiri naxa Elekana sɔtɔ. Elekana naxa Ebiyasafi sɔtɔ. Ebiyasafi naxa Asiri sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Ahimaaz was the father of Azariah, and Azariah was the father of Johanan,
sentences.susu: Asiri naxa Taxati sɔtɔ. Taxati naxa Uriyeli sɔtɔ. Uriyeli naxa Yusiya sɔtɔ. Yusiya naxa Sawulu sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Johanan was the father of Azariah, (he was priest in the house which Solomon put up in Jerusalem:)
sentences.susu: Elekana xa die nan ya: Amasayi nun Aximoti.

sentences.english: And Azariah was the father of Amariah, and Amariah was the father of Ahitub,
sentences.susu: Elekana naxa Sofayi sɔtɔ. Sofayi naxa Naxati sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Ahitub was the father of Zadok, and Zadok was the father of Shallum,
sentences.susu: Naxati naxa Eliyabi sɔtɔ. Eliyabi naxa Yeroxama sɔtɔ. Yeroxama naxa Elekana sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Shallum was the father of Hilkiah, and Hilkiah was the father of Azariah,
sentences.susu: Elekana naxa Samuweli sɔtɔ. Samuweli xa die nan ya: Yoweli, a xa di singe, nun Abiya.

sentences.english: And Azariah was the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah was the father of Jehozadak;
sentences.susu: Merari xa die nan ya: Merari naxa Maxali sɔtɔ. Maxali naxa Libini sɔtɔ. Libini naxa Simeyi sɔtɔ. Simeyi naxa Usa sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Jehozadak went as a prisoner when the Lord took away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
sentences.susu: Usa naxa Simeya sɔtɔ. Simeya naxa Xagiya sɔtɔ. Xagiya naxa Asaya sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
sentences.susu: Saatɛ kankira to dɔxɔ Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, Dawuda naxa bɛɛtibae sugandi naxee bɛɛti bama.

sentences.english: And these are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
sentences.susu: Singe e nu bɛɛti bama Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira nan ya ra, Kiri Banxi Naralande. E naxa na wali raba mɛnni han mangɛ Sulemani Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi tixi Darisalamu tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
sentences.susu: Bɛɛtibae xilie nan ya a nun e xa die: Kehati xabilɛ ya ma, Heman bɛɛtiba, Yoweli xa di, Samuweli xa di,

sentences.english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites listed by the names of their fathers.
sentences.susu: Elekana xa di, Yeroxama xa di, Eliyeli xa di, Towa xa di,

sentences.english: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
sentences.susu: Sufu xa di, Elekana xa di, Maxati xa di, Amasayi xa di,

sentences.english: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeatherai his son.
sentences.susu: Elekana xa di, Yoweli xa di, Asaraya xa di, Sefaniya xa di,

sentences.english: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
sentences.susu: Taxati xa di, Asiri xa di, Ebiyasafi xa di, Kora xa di,

sentences.english: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
sentences.susu: Yisehari xa di, Kehati xa di, Lewi xa di, Isirayila xa di.

sentences.english: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
sentences.susu: Heman malima, naxan nu tixi a yirefanyi ma, na findi Asafi nan na, Berekiya xa di, Simeya xa di,

sentences.english: And the sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.
sentences.susu: Mikayeli xa di, Baaseya xa di, Malakiya xa di,

sentences.english: Elkanah his son: Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
sentences.susu: Etini xa di, Sera xa di, Adaya xa di,

sentences.english: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son, Samuel his son.
sentences.susu: Etani xa di, Sima xa di, Simeyi xa di,

sentences.english: And the sons of Samuel: the oldest Joel, and the second Abiah.
sentences.susu: Yaxati xa di, Gerison ma di, Lewi xa di.

sentences.english: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,
sentences.susu: Naxee kelixi Merari xabilɛ ya ma, nee nu tima kɔɔla nan ma. E xunyi findi Etani nan na, Kisi xa di, Abidi xa di, Maluku xa di,

sentences.english: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
sentences.susu: Xasabiya xa di, Amasiya xa di, Xilikiya xa di,

sentences.english: And these are those whom David made responsible for the music in the house of the Lord, after the ark had rest.
sentences.susu: Amasi xa di, Bani xa di, Semeri xa di,

sentences.english: They gave worship with songs before the House of the Tent of meeting, till Solomon put up the house of the Lord in Jerusalem; and they took their places for their work in their regular order.
sentences.susu: Maxali xa di, Musi xa di, Merari xa di, Lewi xa di.

sentences.english: And these are those who did this work, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman, who made melody, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
sentences.susu: E ngaxakerenyie Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, nu na Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira wali kui.

sentences.english: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
sentences.susu: Haruna nun a xa die naxa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ba sɛrɛxɛbade fari, e man surayi gan sɛrɛxɛ ra surayi sɛrɛxɛbade fari. E na wali birin naba yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante nan kui naxan findi Isirayila xunsare ra, alɔ Ala xa konyi Munsa a masenxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
sentences.susu: Haruna xa die nan ya: Eleyasari, a xa di Finexasi, a xa di Abisuwa,

sentences.english: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
sentences.susu: a xa di Buuki, a xa di Usi, a xa di Sɛraxaya,

sentences.english: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
sentences.susu: a xa di Merayoti, a xa di Amaraya, a xa di Axituba,

sentences.english: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
sentences.susu: a xa di Sadɔki, a xa di Aximaasi.

sentences.english: And his brother Asaph, whose place was at his right hand, Asaph, the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,
sentences.susu: E xa taae nan ya e sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ: Haruna xa die, naxee kelixi Kehati xabilɛ ya ma, nee nan singe bɔxi sɔtɔ Ala xa maragiri kui.

sentences.english: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
sentences.susu: Xebiron nun a rabilinyie naxa findi e gbe ra, Yudaya bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Xebiron daaxa nun taa naxee nu na na rabilinyi, nee naxa findi Yefune xa di Kalebi gbe ra.

sentences.english: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
sentences.susu: Haruna xa die naxa Xebiron sɔtɔ, naxan findixi mixi ratanga taa ra, e naxa Libina nun a rabilinyi, Yatiri, Esitemowa nun a rabilinyi sɔtɔ,

sentences.english: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
sentences.susu: e naxa Xilen nun a rabilinyi, Debiri nun a rabilinyi,

sentences.english: And on the left their brothers, the sons of Merari: Ethan, the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
sentences.susu: Asan nun a rabilinyi, Beti Semesi nun a rabilinyi fan sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
sentences.susu: E taa naxee sɔtɔ Bunyamin bɔxi ma nee nan ya: Gabayon, Geba, a rabilinyi, Alemeti, a rabilinyi, Anatɔti, nun a rabilinyi. E naxa taa fu nun saxan sɔtɔ e xabilɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,
sentences.susu: Kehati xa di booree naxa taa fu sɔtɔ Ala xa maragiri kui Efirami bɔnsɔɛ, Dana bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti keren, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti keren xa bɔxie ma.

sentences.english: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
sentences.susu: Gerison ma die naxa taa fu nun saxan sɔtɔ e xabilɛ ki ma Isakari bɔnsɔɛ, Aseri bɔnsɔɛ, Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti keren xa bɔxie ma naxee nu na Basan bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And their brothers the Levites were responsible for all the work of the Tent of the house of God.
sentences.susu: Merari xa die naxa taa fu nun firin sɔtɔ Ala xa maragiri kui Ruben bɔnsɔɛ, Gadi bɔnsɔɛ, nun Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxie ma.

sentences.english: But Aaron and his sons made offerings on the altar of burned offering, and on the altar of perfume, for all the work of the most holy place, and to take away the sin of Israel, doing everything ordered by Moses, the servant of God.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae taae nun e rabilinyie fi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ma na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And these are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
sentences.susu: E naxa na taae fi e ma Ala xa maragiri kui, taa naxee nu na Yuda, Simeyɔn, nun Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛe xa bɔxie ma.

sentences.english: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
sentences.susu: Kehati xabilɛ booree naxa taae sɔtɔ Efirami bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
sentences.susu: E naxa mixi ratanga taa Sikemi nun a rabilinyi fi e ma Efirami geya ma, a nun Geseri, a rabilinyi,

sentences.english: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
sentences.susu: Yokineyami, a rabilinyi, Beti Xoron, a rabilinyi,

sentences.english: Now these are their living-places, the limits inside which they were to put up their tents: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites, because they had the first selection,
sentences.susu: Ayalon, a rabilinyi, Gati Rimɔn, nun a rabilinyi.

sentences.english: To them they gave Hebron and its outskirts in the land of Judah;
sentences.susu: E naxa Aneri, a rabilinyi, Bileyami, nun a rabilinyi sɔtɔ Manasi bɔnsɔɛ tagi xa bɔxi ma. Kehati xabilɛ booree xa taae nan na ki.

sentences.english: But the open country of the town, and the small places round it, they gave to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.
sentences.susu: Gerison ma die xa taae nan ya: Golan, a rabilinyi, naxan na Basan bɔxi ma, Asataroti, a rabilinyi, naxee na Manasi bɔnsɔɛ tagi xa bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: And to the sons of Aaron they gave Hebron, the town to which men might go in flight and be safe, and Libnah with its outskirts, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa with its outskirts,
sentences.susu: Kadesi, a rabilinyi, Daberati, a rabilinyi,

sentences.english: And Hilen with its outskirts, Debir with its outskirts,
sentences.susu: Ramoti, a rabilinyi, Anemi, a rabilinyi, naxee na Isakari bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Ashan with its outskirts, and Beth-shemesh with its outskirts;
sentences.susu: E xa taa naxee na Aseri bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi ma nee nan ya: Masala, a rabilinyi, Abadon, a rabilinyi,

sentences.english: And from the tribe of Benjamin: Geba with its outskirts, and Alemeth with its outskirts, and Anathoth with its outskirts. All their towns among their families were thirteen towns.
sentences.susu: Hukoki, a rabilinyi, Rexobo, nun a rabilinyi.

sentences.english: And to the rest of the sons of Kohath there were given by the Lord's decision ten towns out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim and out of the tribe of Dan and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh.
sentences.susu: E xa taa naxee na Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi ma, nee nan ya: Kadesi naxan na Galile bɔxi ma, Xamɔn, a rabilinyi, Kiriyatayimi nun a rabilinyi.

sentences.english: And to the sons of Gershom, by their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen towns.
sentences.susu: Merari xa die xa taae nan ya: Rimono, a rabilinyi, Taboro, a rabilinyi, naxee na Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And to the sons of Merari, by their families, twelve towns were given by the Lord's decision, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun.
sentences.susu: E xa taa naxee na Ruben bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi ma Yurudɛn naakiri ma Yeriko ya ra, nee nan ya: Beteseri naxan na gbengberenyi ma, a rabilinyi, Yahasa, a rabilinyi,

sentences.english: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites the towns with their outskirts.
sentences.susu: Kedemoti, a rabilinyi, Mefaati, a rabilinyi.

sentences.english: And they gave by the Lord's decision out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these towns whose names are given.
sentences.susu: E xa taa naxee na Gadi bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi ma, nee nan ya: Ramoti naxan na Galadi bɔxi ma, a rabilinyi, Maxanayimi, a rabilinyi,

sentences.english: And to the families of the sons of Kohath were given towns by the Lord's decision out of the tribe of Ephraim.
sentences.susu: Xɛsibɔn, a rabilinyi, Yaasɛri, nun a rabilinyi.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Issachar: Tola and Puah, Jashub and Shimron, four.
sentences.susu: Isakari xa di naani nan ya: Tola, Puwa, Yasubu, nun Simiron.

sentences.english: And the sons of Tola: Uzzi and Rephaiah and Jeriel and Jahmai and Ibsam and Shemuel, heads of their families; they were men of war; in the record of their generations their number in the time of David was twenty-two thousand, six hundred.
sentences.susu: Tola xa die nan ya: Usi, Rɛfaya, Yeriyeli, Yamayi, Yibisami, nun Samuweli. Yi mixie nan findixi e xabilɛ mangɛe ra. Mangɛ Dawuda xa waxati kui, Tola xa di mixi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin, kɛmɛ senni findi sɔɔrie nan na.

sentences.english: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah; and the sons of Izrahiah: Michael and Obadiah and Joel and Isshiah, five; all of them chiefs.
sentences.susu: Usi xa di xili Yisiraxiya. Yisiraxiya xa die nan ya: Mikayeli, Abadiyasi, Yoweli, nun Yisiya. Yi mixi suuli nan findi e xabilɛ mangɛe ra.

sentences.english: And with them, recorded in generations by their families, were bands of fighting-men, thirty-six thousand of them, for they had a great number of wives and sons.
sentences.susu: Usi xa mixi wulu tongo saxan nun senni findi sɔɔrie nan na, barima e xa ginɛe nun e xa die wuya.

sentences.english: And there were recorded among all the families of Issachar, great men of war, eighty-seven thousand.
sentences.susu: Isakari xabilɛe birin ya ma, xɛmɛ mixi wulu tongo solomasaxan nun solofere findi sɔɔri gbangbalanyie nan na.

sentences.english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela and Becher and Jediael, three.
sentences.susu: Bunyamin xa die nan ya: Bela, Bekeri, nun Yediyayeli.

sentences.english: And the sons of Bela: Ezbon and Uzzi and Uzziel and Jerimoth and Iri, five; heads of their families, great men of war; there were twenty-two thousand and thirty-four of them recorded by their families.
sentences.susu: Bela xa di suuli nan ya: Esibon, Usi, Yusiyɛli, Yerimoti, nun Yiri. Yi mixie nan findi e xabilɛ mangɛe ra. Sɔɔri gbangbalanyi mixi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin, tongo saxan nun naani nu na e ya ma.

sentences.english: And the sons of Becher: Zemirah and Joash and Eliezer and Elioenai and Omri and Jerimoth and Abijah and Anathoth and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.
sentences.susu: Bekeri xa die nan ya: Semira, Yowasi, Eliyeseri, Eliyowenayi, Omeri, Yeremoti, Abiya, Anatɔti, nun Alemeti. Yee birin Bekeri xa die nan e ra.

sentences.english: And they were recorded by their generations, heads of their families, great men of war, twenty thousand, two hundred.
sentences.susu: E xabilɛe xunyie xilie sɛbɛxi, e sɔɔri mixi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn kɛmɛ firin nu na.

sentences.english: And the sons of Jediael: Bilhan; and the sons of Bilhan: Jeush and Benjamin and Ehud and Chenaanah and Zethan and Tarshish and Ahishahar.
sentences.susu: Yediyayeli xa di xili Bilihan. Bilihan xa die nan ya: Yeyusu, Bunyamin, Exudu, Kenaana, Setani, Tarasisi, nun Axisaxari.

sentences.english: All these were the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their families, seventeen thousand, two hundred men of war, able to go out with the army for war.
sentences.susu: Yediyayeli xa die birin findi e xabilɛe xunyie nan na. Sɔɔri mixi wulu fu nun solofere kɛmɛ firin nu na e ya ma.

sentences.english: And Shuppim and Huppim. The sons of Dan, Hushim his son, one.
sentences.susu: Iri xa die nan ya: Supimi nun Xupimi. Axeri xa di xili Xusimi.

sentences.english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel and Guni and Jezer and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
sentences.susu: Nafatali xa die nan ya: Yaxaseeli, Guni, Yeseri, nun Salumu, Bila xa di.

sentences.english: The sons of Manasseh by his servant-wife, the Aramaean woman: she gave birth to Machir, the father of Gilead;
sentences.susu: Manasi xa die nan ya: A xa konyi ginɛ naxan kelixi Siriya bɔxi ma naxa Asirɛli nun Makiri bari a bɛ. Makiri naxa Galadi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: (And Gilead took a wife, whose name was Maacah, and his sister's name was Hammoleketh;) and the name of his brother was Zelophehad, who was the father of daughters.
sentences.susu: Makiri naxa ginɛ fen Xupimi nun Supimi bɛ. Makiri maaginɛ xili Maaka. Makiri xa di firin nde xili Selofexadi. Selofexadi mu di xɛmɛ yo sɔtɔ, fo di ginɛe.

sentences.english: And Maacah, the wife of Gilead, gave birth to a son to whom she gave the name Peresh; and his brother was named Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
sentences.susu: Makiri xa ginɛ Maaka naxa di bari, a xili sa Peresi xun ma. A xunya xili Seresi. Peresi xa die nan ya: Ulami nun Rakemi.

sentences.english: And the son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir the son of Manasseh.
sentences.susu: Ulami xa di xili Bedan. Galadi xa die nan na ki, Makiri xa di, Manasi xa di.

sentences.english: And his sister Hammoleketh was the mother of Ishhod and Abiezer and Mahlah.
sentences.susu: Galadi maaginɛ Hamoleketi xa die nan ya: Isihodi, Abiyeseri, nun Maxala.

sentences.english: And the sons of Shemida were Ahian and Shechem and Likhi and Aniam.
sentences.susu: Sɛmida xa die nan ya: Axiyani, Sikemi, Likixi, nun Aniyama.

sentences.english: And the sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eleadah his son, and Tahath his son,
sentences.susu: Efirami xa die nan ya: Efirami naxa Sutela sɔtɔ. Sutela naxa Bereda sɔtɔ. Bereda naxa Taxati sɔtɔ. Taxati naxa Eleyada sɔtɔ. Eleyada naxa Taxati sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer and Elead, whom the men of Gath, who had been living in the land from their birth, put to death, because they came down to take away their cattle.
sentences.susu: Taxati naxa Sabadi sɔtɔ. Sabadi naxa Sutela sɔtɔ. Gatikae naxa Eseri nun Eleyadi faxa nee to siga e xa xurusee muɲade. Eseri nun Eleyadi bari mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: And for a long time Ephraim their father went on weeping for them, and his brothers came to give him comfort.
sentences.susu: E baba Efirami naxa sunnun tɛmui xɔnkuye. E ngaxakerenyie naxa a madundu.

sentences.english: After that, he had connection with his wife, and she became with child and gave birth to a son, to whom his father gave the name of Beriah, because trouble had come on his family.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi a xa ginɛ naxa tɛɛgɛ. A to di bari, a naxa a xili sa Beriya barima tɔɔrɛ nu bara gbo a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And his daughter was Sheerah, the builder of Beth-horon the lower and the higher, and Uzzen-sheerah.
sentences.susu: A naxa di ginɛ sɔtɔ naxan xili Seera. Na naxa Beti Xoron Labe nun Beti Xoron Fuge ti, a nun taa gbɛtɛ naxan xili Useni Seera.

sentences.english: And Rephah was his son, and Resheph; his son was Telah, and his son was Tahan;
sentences.susu: Efirami naxa Refa sɔtɔ. Refa naxa Resefa sɔtɔ. Resefa naxa Tela sɔtɔ. Tela naxa Taxani sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Ladan was his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
sentences.susu: Taxani naxa Ladana sɔtɔ. Ladana naxa Amixudi sɔtɔ. Amixudi naxa Elisama sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Nun his son, Joshua his son.
sentences.susu: Elisama naxa Nunu sɔtɔ. Nunu naxa Yosuwe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Their heritage and their living-places were Beth-el and its daughter-towns, and Naaran to the east, and Gezer to the west, with its daughter-towns, as well as Shechem and its daughter-towns as far as Azzah and its daughter-towns;
sentences.susu: E naxa sabati Beteli nun a rabilinyi, Naarani, a sogetede, Geseri nun a rabilinyi, a sogegorode, Sikemi nun a rabilinyi, han Aya nun a rabilinyi.

sentences.english: And by the limits of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and its daughter-towns, Taanach, Megiddo, and Dor, with their daughter-towns. In these the children of Joseph, the son of Israel, were living.
sentences.susu: Manasi bɔnsɔɛ xa taae nan ya: Beti Saan, a rabilinyi, Taanaki, a rabilinyi, Megido, a rabilinyi, Dɔrɔ, nun a rabilinyi. Isirayila xa di Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ sabatixi yi taae nan kui.

sentences.english: The sons of Asher: Imnah and Ishvah and Ishvi and Beriah and Serah, their sister.
sentences.susu: Aseri xa die nan ya: Yimina, Yisiwa, Yisiwi, nun Beriya. E maaginɛ xili Sera.

sentences.english: And the sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
sentences.susu: Beriya xa die nan ya: Xeberi nun Malakiyeli, naxan findi Birisafiti baba ra.

sentences.english: And Heber was the father of Japhlet and Shomer and Hotham and Shua, their sister.
sentences.susu: Xeberi xa die nan ya: Yefeleti, Someri, nun Xotama. E maaginɛ xili Suwa.

sentences.english: And the sons of Japhlet: Pasach and Bimhal and Ashvath. These are the sons of Japhlet.
sentences.susu: Yefeleti xa die nan ya: Pasaki, Bimali, nun Asefati. Yefeleti xa die nan na ki.

sentences.english: And the sons of Shomer: Ahi and Rohgah, Jehubbah and Aram.
sentences.susu: Someri xa die nan ya: Axi, Roga, Xuba, nun Arami.

sentences.english: And the sons of Hotham, his brother: Zophah and Imna and Shelesh and Amal.
sentences.susu: Someri xunya Helemi xa die nan ya: Sofaxa, Yimena, Selesi, nun Amali.

sentences.english: The sons of Zophah: Suah and Harnepher and Shual and Beri and Imrah,
sentences.susu: Sofaxa xa die nan ya: Suwa, Xaraneferi, Suwali, Beri, Yimira,

sentences.english: Bezer and Hod and Shamma and Shilshah and Ithran and Beera.
sentences.susu: Beteseri, Hodo, Saama, Silesa, Yitiran, nun Beera.

sentences.english: And the sons of Jether: Jephunneh and Pispah and Ara.
sentences.susu: Yeteri xa die nan ya: Yefune, Pisepa, nun Ara.

sentences.english: And the sons of Ulla: Arah and Hanniel and Rizia.
sentences.susu: Ula xa die nan ya: Ara, Xaniyɛli, nun Risiya.

sentences.english: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their families, specially strong men of war, chiefs of the rulers. They were recorded in the army for war, twenty-six thousand men in number.
sentences.susu: Aseri xa die nan na ki, mangɛe, mixi xungbee, sɔɔrie gbangbalanyie, mangɛdie nan nu e ra e xabilɛe ya ma, naxee kɔnti siga han mixi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun senni.

sentences.english: And Benjamin was the father of Bela his oldest son, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
sentences.susu: Bunyamin xa die nan ya: Bela, a xa di singe, Asibeli, a xa di firin nde, Axara, a xa di saxan nde,

sentences.english: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
sentences.susu: Noxa, a xa di naani nde, nun Rafa, a xa di suuli nde.

sentences.english: And Bela had sons, Addar and Gera, the father of Ehud,
sentences.susu: Bela xa die nan ya: Adari, Gera, Abihudi,

sentences.english: And Abishua and Naaman and Ahoah
sentences.susu: Abisuwa, Naaman, Axowa,

sentences.english: And Gera and Shephuphan and Huram.
sentences.susu: Gera, Sefufani, nun Xurami.

sentences.english: And these are the sons of Ehud, heads of families of those living in Geba: Iglaam and Alemeth
sentences.susu: Exudu xa die nan ya, naxee findi xabilɛ mangɛe ra:

sentences.english: And Naaman and Ahijah and Gera; and Iglaam was the father of Uzza and Ahihud.
sentences.susu: Naaman, Ahiya, nun Gera. Singe e nu na Geba, kɔnɔ Gera naxa e xanin Manaxati. Gera naxa Usa nun Axixudi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Shaharaim became the father of children in the country of the Moabites after driving out Hushim and Beerah his wives;
sentences.susu: Saxarayimi to mɛɛ a xa ginɛe Xusimi nun Baara ra, a naxa die sɔtɔ Mowaba bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And by Hodesh his wife he became the father of Jobab and Zibia and Mesha and Malcam.
sentences.susu: A xa ginɛ Xodesi xa die nan ya: Yobabo, Sibiya, Mesa, Malakama, Yeyusi, Sakiya, nun Mirima.

sentences.english: And Jeuz and Shachia and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of families.
sentences.susu: A xa die nan na ki naxee findi xabilɛ mangɛe ra.

sentences.english: And Hushim became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.
sentences.susu: A xa ginɛ Xusimi xa die nan ya: Abitubu nun Elipaali.

sentences.english: And the sons of Elpaal: Eber and Misham and Shemed (he was the builder of Ono and Lod and their daughter-towns);
sentences.susu: Elipaali xa die nan ya: Eberi, Misami, nun Semedi, naxan Ono, Lodi, nun e rabilinyi tixi.

sentences.english: And Beriah and Shema, who were heads of the families of those who were living in Aijalon, who put to flight the people living in Gath;
sentences.susu: Beriya nun Sema, naxee findi Ayalon xabilɛ mangɛe ra, naxa Gatikae keri.

sentences.english: And their brothers Shashak and Jeremoth.
sentences.susu: Beriya xa mixie nan ya: Axiyo, Sasaki, Yeremoti,

sentences.english: And Zebadiah and Arad and Eder
sentences.susu: Sebadaya, Aradi, Ederi,

sentences.english: And Michael and Ishpah and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
sentences.susu: Mikayeli, Yisepa, nun Yoxa.

sentences.english: And Zebadiah and Meshullam and Hizki and Heber
sentences.susu: Elipaali xa die nan ya: Sebadaya, Mesulama, Xisiki, Xeberi,

sentences.english: And Ishmerai and Izliah and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
sentences.susu: Yisemerayi, Yisiliya, nun Yobabo.

sentences.english: And Jakim and Zichri and Zabdi
sentences.susu: Simeyi xa die nan ya: Yakimi, Sikiri, Sabidi,

sentences.english: And Elienai and Zillethai and Eliel
sentences.susu: Eliyenayi, Siletayi, Eliyeli,

sentences.english: And Adaiah and Beraiah and Shimrath, the sons of Shimei;
sentences.susu: Adaya, Bɛraya, nun Simirati.

sentences.english: And Ishpan and Eber and Eliel
sentences.susu: Sasaki xa die nan ya: Yisepan, Eberi, Eliyeli,

sentences.english: And Abdon and Zichri and Hanan
sentences.susu: Abadon, Sikiri, Xanan,

sentences.english: And Hananiah and Elam and Anathothijah
sentences.susu: Xananiya, Elama, Antotiya,

sentences.english: And Iphdeiah and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
sentences.susu: Yifideya, nun Penuweli.

sentences.english: And Shamsherai and Shehariah and Athaliah
sentences.susu: Yeroxama xa die nan ya: Sameserayi, Sexaraya, Atalaya,

sentences.english: And Jaareshiah and Elijah and Zichri, the sons of Jeremoth.
sentences.susu: Yaaresiya, Eliya, nun Sikiri.

sentences.english: These were heads of families in their generations; chief men: these were living in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Darisalamu xabilɛ mangɛe nan na ki.

sentences.english: And in Gibeon was living the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, whose wife's name was Maacah;
sentences.susu: Gabayon baba Yeyiyeli sabati Gabayon nɛ. A xa ginɛ xili Maaka.

sentences.english: And his oldest son Abdon, and Zur and Kish and Baal and Ner and Nadab
sentences.susu: A xa die nan ya: Abadon, a xa di singe, Suru, Kisu, Bali, Neri, Nadabo,

sentences.english: And Gedor and Ahio and Zechariah and Mikloth.
sentences.susu: Gedori, Axiyo, Sekeri,

sentences.english: And Mikloth was the father of Shimeah. And they were living with their brothers in Jerusalem opposite their brothers.
sentences.susu: nun Mikiloti, naxan findi Simeyami baba ra. E fan sabati Darisalamu nɛ e bari mixie ya ma.

sentences.english: And Ner was the father of Abner, and Kish was the father of Saul, and Saul was the father of Jonathan and Malchi-shua and Abinadab and Eshbaal.
sentences.susu: Neri naxa Kisu sɔtɔ. Kisu naxa Sɔlu sɔtɔ. Sɔlu xa die nan ya: Yonatan, Malakisuwa, Abinadabo, nun Esibaali.

sentences.english: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal was the father of Micah.
sentences.susu: Yonatan xa di xili Meribaali. Meribaali naxa Mike sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Micah: Pithon and Melech and Tarea and Ahaz.
sentences.susu: Mike xa die nan ya: Piton, Meleki, Tareya, nun Axasi.

sentences.english: And Ahaz was the father of Jehoaddah; and Jehoaddah was the father of Alemeth and Azmaveth and Zimri; and Zimri was the father of Moza;
sentences.susu: Axasi naxa Yehowada sɔtɔ. Yehowada xa die nan ya: Alemeti, Asamafeti, nun Simiri.

sentences.english: And Moza was the father of Binea: Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son;
sentences.susu: Simiri naxa Mosa sɔtɔ. Mosa naxa Bineya sɔtɔ. Bineya naxa Rafa sɔtɔ. Rafa naxa Eleyasa sɔtɔ. Eleyasa naxa Aseli sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Azel had five sons, whose names are: Azrikam, his oldest, and Ishmael and Sheariah and Obadiah and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
sentences.susu: Aseli xa die nan ya: Asirikama, Bokeru, Sumayila, Seyaraya, Abadiyasi, nun Xanan. Aseli xa die nan na ki.

sentences.english: And the sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his oldest son, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
sentences.susu: Aseli xunya Eseka xa die nan ya: Ulami, a xa di singe, Yeyusu, a xa di firin nde, nun Elifeleti a xa di saxan nde.

sentences.english: And the sons of Ulam were men of war, bowmen, and had a great number of sons and sons' sons, a hundred and fifty. All these were the sons of Benjamin.
sentences.susu: Ulami xa die sɔɔri gbangbalanyie nan nu e ra. E fata xali ra. E xa die nun mamadie wuya e kɔnti sigama han mixi kɛmɛ tongo suuli. Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ nan e birin na.

sentences.english: So all Israel was listed by their families; and, truly, they are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel. And Judah was taken away as prisoners to Babylon because of their sin.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae xilie birin sɛbɛxi Isirayila mangɛe xa buki nde kui.

sentences.english: Now the first to take up their heritage in their towns were: Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinim.
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛ nu bara siga konyiya kui Babilɔn bɔxi ma e xa yanfanteya xa fe ra. Naxee singe gbilen sabatide e xɔnyi Isirayila bɔxi ma, e findi Isirayila sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, Lewikae, nun mixie nan na, naxee walima Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: And in Jerusalem there were living some of the sons of Judah, and of Benjamin, and of Ephraim and Manasseh;
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛ, Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ, Efirami bɔnsɔɛ, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ mixi ndee naxa sabati Darisalamu.

sentences.english: Uthai, the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the sons of Perez, the son of Judah.
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xa mixi, naxee sabati Darisalamu, findi Utayi nan na, Amixudi xa di, Omeri xa di, Imiri xa di, Bani xa di, Peresi xa di, Yuda xa di.

sentences.english: And of the Shilonites: Asaiah the oldest, and his sons.
sentences.susu: Siloka naxee sabati naa, nee findi Asaya nan na, di singe, nun a xa die.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel, and their brothers, six hundred and ninety.
sentences.susu: Sera xa di naxee sabati naa, nee findi Yuwɛli, nun a ngaxakerenyie nan na, mixi kɛmɛ senni, mixi tongo solomanaani.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu, the son of Meshullam, Judah, the son of Hassenuah,
sentences.susu: Bunyamin xa di naxee sabati naa, nee nan ya: Mesulama xa di Salu, Hasɛnuwa xa di, Hodafiya xa di,

sentences.english: And Ibneiah, the son of Jeroham, and Elah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
sentences.susu: a nun Yeroxama xa di Yibineya, a nun Usi xa di Ela, Mikiri xa di, a nun Sɛfataya xa di Mesulama, Reyuweli xa di, Yibiniya xa di,

sentences.english: And their brothers, in the list of their generations, nine hundred and fifty-six. All these men were heads of families, listed by the names of their fathers.
sentences.susu: a nun e ngaxakerenyie e xabilɛ ki ma, mixi kɛmɛ solomanaani, mixi tongo suuli nun senni.

sentences.english: And of the priests: Jedaiah and Jehoiarib and Jachin
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxee sabatixi Darisalamu, nee nan ya: Yɛdaya, Yehoyaribu, Yakin,

sentences.english: And Azariah, the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
sentences.susu: Xilikiya xa di Asaraya, Mesulama xa di, Sadɔki xa di, Merayoti xa di, Axituba xa di, naxan findi Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi wali xunyi ra,

sentences.english: And Adaiah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasai, the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
sentences.susu: Yeroxama xa di Adaya, Pasura xa di, Malakiya xa di, Masayi xa di, Adiyeli xa di, Yasera xa di, Mesulama xa di, Mesilemiti xa di, Imeri xa di,

sentences.english: And their brothers, heads of their families, a thousand and seven hundred and sixty: able men, doing the work of the house of God.
sentences.susu: a nun e ngaxakerenyie, e denbaya xunyie, mixi wulu keren, kɛmɛ solofere tongo senni. E birin findi kuntigie nan na, naxee walima Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: And of the Levites: Shemaiah, the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixi naxee sabatixi Darisalamu, nee nan ya: Xasubu xa di Semaya, Asirikama xa di, Xasabiya xa di, Merarika,

sentences.english: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah, the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
sentences.susu: a nun Bakibakari, Xeresi, Galali, Mataniya, Mika xa di, Sikiri xa di, Asafi xa di,

sentences.english: And Obadiah, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah, the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who were living in the small towns of the Netophathites.
sentences.susu: a nun Semaya xa di Abadiyasi, Galali xa di, Yedutun xa di, a nun Asa xa di Berekiya, Elekana xa di, naxan sabatixi Netofakae xa taae kui.

sentences.english: And the door-keepers: Shallum and Akkub and Talmon and Ahiman and their brothers: Shallum was the chief.
sentences.susu: Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛ makantɛe nan ya: Salumu, naxan findi e xunyi ra, Akubu, Talamɔn, Aximan, a nun e ngaxakerenyie.

sentences.english: Up till then they had been at the king's door to the east. They were door-keepers for the tents of the sons of Levi.
sentences.susu: Salumu bɔnsɔɛ nan naadɛ makanta wali rabafe han to hɔrɔmɔbanxi sogetede biri ra. Naadɛ naxan xili «Mangɛ naadɛ.» E benbae findi nɛ naadɛ makantɛe ra Lewikae bɛ.

sentences.english: And Shallum, the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his family, the Korahites, were responsible for everything which had to be done in connection with the order of worship, keepers of the doors of the Tent; their fathers had had the care of the tents of the Lord, being keepers of the doorway.
sentences.susu: Salumu, Kore xa di, Ebiyasafi xa di, Kora xa di, a nun a ngaxakerenyi naxee findi naadɛ makantɛe ra, naxa Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira kanta alɔ e babae singe a raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: In the past Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, had been ruler over them; may the Lord be with him!
sentences.susu: Finexasi, Eleyasari xa di, nu findixi naadɛ makantɛe xunyi nan na. Alatala nu na a sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Zechariah, the son of Meshelemiah, was keeper of the door of the Tent of meeting.
sentences.susu: Meselemiya xa di Sakari nu bara findi Kiri Banxi Naralande naadɛ makantɛ ra.

sentences.english: There were two hundred and twelve whose business it was to keep the doorway. These were listed by families in the country places where they were living, whom David and Samuel the seer put in their responsible positions.
sentences.susu: Mixi kɛmɛ firin, fu nun firin nu bara sugandi na wali rabade. E xili birin sɛbɛxi a nun taa xilie e sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ. Dawuda nun Annabi Samuweli nu bara na wali so e yi ra.

sentences.english: So they and their sons had the care of the doors of the house of the Lord, the house of the Tent, as watchers.
sentences.susu: E tan nun e xa die naxa Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira naadɛe kanta.

sentences.english: There were keepers of the doors on the four sides, to the east, west, north, and south.
sentences.susu: Naadɛ makantɛ ndee nu tixi sogetede, sogegorode, kɔɔla, nun yirefanyi ma.

sentences.english: And their brothers, in the country places where they were living, were to come in every seven days to be with them from time to time.
sentences.susu: E ngaxakerenyi naxee nu na taae kui, e nu fama e malide xi solofere bun ma.

sentences.english: For the four chief door-keepers, who were Levites, had a special position, looking after the rooms and the store-houses of the house of God.
sentences.susu: Naadɛ makantɛ kuntigie Lewikae, naxa yiree kanta Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui naafuli nu ragataxi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Their sleeping-rooms were round the house of God, for they had the care of it, and were responsible for opening it morning by morning.
sentences.susu: E nu xima Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi rabilinyi nɛ alako e xa mɛnni makanta, a nun e xa naadɛe rabi gɛɛsɛgɛ.

sentences.english: Certain of them had the care of the vessels used in worship, to keep an account of them when they came in and when they were taken out again.
sentences.susu: Lewika ndee nu yirabasee ragatama, e nu e ramini lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ, e man nu e kɔnti.

sentences.english: And some of them were responsible for the holy things and for the vessels of the holy place, and the meal and the wine and the oil and the perfume and the spices.
sentences.susu: Booree nu yirabasee ragata, naxee nu na yire sɛniyɛnxi, a nun farin, wɛni, ture, surayi, nun se ɲɔxunmɛe.

sentences.english: And some of the sons of the priests were responsible for crushing the spices.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa die nu labundɛe masunbu.

sentences.english: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, the oldest son of Shallum the Korahite, was responsible for cooking the flat cakes.
sentences.susu: Salumu xa di Matitiya Lewika, naxan keli Kora xabilɛ ya ma, nu taami ganma naxan nu bama sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: And some of their brothers, sons of the Kohathites, were responsible for the holy bread which was put in order before the Lord, to get it ready every Sabbath.
sentences.susu: E ngaxakerenyi ndee, Kehati bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, nu taami dɔxɔma teebili ra malabui lɔxɔɛ birin.

sentences.english: And these were those who had the ordering of the music and songs, heads of families of the Levites, who were living in the rooms, and were free from other work, for their work went on day and night.
sentences.susu: Bɛɛtiba naxee findi Lewi xabilɛe xunyie ra, nu sabatixi Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi yigiyadee kui. Wali gbɛtɛ yo mu nu na e yi ra, barima e findi wali birin xunyi nan na. E nu walima kɔɛ nun yanyi.

sentences.english: These were heads of families of the Levites in their generations, chief men; they were living at Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Lewi xabilɛe xunyie nan na ki, naxee sabatixi Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And in Gibeon was living the father of Gibeon, Jeiel, whose wife's name was Maacah;
sentences.susu: Gabayon baba Yeyiyeli nu sabatixi Gabayon taa nan kui. A xa ginɛ xili Maaka.

sentences.english: And Abdon his oldest son, and Zur and Kish and Baal and Ner and Nadab
sentences.susu: A xa di nan ya: Abadon, a xa di singe, Suru, Kisu, Bali, Neri, Nadabo,

sentences.english: And Gedor and Ahio and Zechariah and Mikloth
sentences.susu: Gedori, Axiyo, Sakari, nun Mikiloti.

sentences.english: Mikloth was the father of Shimeam. They were living with their brothers in Jerusalem opposite their brothers.
sentences.susu: Mikiloti naxa Simeyami sɔtɔ. E nu sabatixi e ngaxakerenyie fɛ ma Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And Ner was the father of Kish; and Kish was the father of Saul; and Saul was the father of Jonathan and Malchi-shua and Abinadab and Eshbaal.
sentences.susu: Neri naxa Kisu sɔtɔ. Kisu naxa Sɔlu sɔtɔ. Sɔlu xa die nan ya: Yonatan, Malakisuwa, Abinadabo, nun Esibaali.

sentences.english: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal was the father of Micah.
sentences.susu: Yonatan naxa Meribaali sɔtɔ. Meribaali naxa Mike sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Micah: Pithon and Melech and Tahrea and Ahaz.
sentences.susu: Mike xa die nan ya: Piton, Meleki, Tareya, nun Axasi.

sentences.english: And Ahaz was the father of Jarah; and Jarah was the father of Alemeth and Azmaveth and Zimri; and Zimri was the father of Moza.
sentences.susu: Axasi naxa Yara sɔtɔ. Yara xa die nan ya: Alemeti, Asamafeti, nun Simiri. Simiri naxa Mosa sɔtɔ. Mosa naxa Bineya sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Moza was the father of Binea; and Rephaiah was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
sentences.susu: Bineya naxa Rɛfaya sɔtɔ. Rɛfaya naxa Eleyasa sɔtɔ. Eleyasa naxa Aseli sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Azel had five sons, whose names are: Azrikam, his oldest son, and Ishmael and Sheariah and Obadiah and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
sentences.susu: Aseli xa di senni nan ya: Asirikama, Bokeru, Sumayila, Seyaraya, Abadiyasi, nun Xanan. Aseli xa die nan na ki.

sentences.english: Now the Philistines were fighting against Israel; and the men of Israel went in flight before the Philistines, falling down wounded in Mount Gilboa.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa Isirayilakae gere. Isirayilakae naxa e gi, a gbegbe naxa faxa Gilibowa geya fari.

sentences.english: And the Philistines went hard after Saul and his sons, and put to death Jonathan and Abinadab and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa bira Sɔlu nun a xa die fɔxɔ ra, han e Yonatan, Abinadabo, nun Malakisuwa faxa.

sentences.english: And the fight was going against Saul, and the archers came across him, and he was wounded by the archers.
sentences.susu: Gere naxa xɔrɔxɔ. Tanbɛ nde naxa Sɔlu sɔxɔ a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: Then Saul said to the servant who had the care of his arms, Take your sword and put it through me, before these men without circumcision come and make sport of me. But his servant, full of fear, would not do so. Then Saul took out his sword, falling on it himself.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a xa geresose maxaninyi bɛ, «N faxa i xa santidɛgɛma ra, alako yi gaantaree naxa n nayaagi.» Kɔnɔ na xɛmɛ mu suusa na rabade. Na na a ra, Sɔlu naxa a yɛtɛ faxa a xa santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: And when his servant saw that Saul was dead, he did the same, and came to his death.
sentences.susu: A xa geresose maxaninyi to na to, a fan naxa a yɛtɛ faxa.

sentences.english: So death overtook Saul and his three sons; all his family came to an end together.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu nun a xa di saxanyi faxa na ki nɛ. A xa denbaya birin naxa laaxira tɛmui keren.

sentences.english: And when all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that the men of Israel had gone in flight and that Saul and his sons were dead, they went in flight away from their towns; and the Philistines came and took them for themselves.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae, naxee nu sabatixi geya lanbanyi, e to a kolon a sɔɔrie na e gife, Sɔlu nun a xa die bara faxa, e fan naxa e gi. Filisitakae e xa taae birin sɔtɔ na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Now the day after, when the Philistines came to take their goods from the dead, they saw Saul and his sons dead in Mount Gilboa.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Filisitakae naxa gbilen gere yire, e xa sɔɔri faxaxie harige tongo. E naxa Sɔlu nun a xa die to Gilibowa geya fari.

sentences.english: And they took everything off him, and took his head and his war-dress, and sent word into the land of the Philistines round about to give the news to their gods and to the people.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ e xa harige tongode, e naxa Sɔlu xunyi nun a xa geresosee xanin sɔɔrie yire. E naxa na xibaarui masen Filisitakae birin bɛ, a nun e xa kuyee bɛ.

sentences.english: And they put his war-dress in the house of their gods, and put up his head in the house of Dagon.
sentences.susu: E naxa Sɔlu xa geresosee lu e xa ala xa banxi kui, e a xunyi gbaku e xa ala Dagɔn xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: And when the news came to Jabesh-gilead of what the Philistines had done to Saul,
sentences.susu: Yabɛsikae, naxee na Galadi, e to a mɛ Filisitakae naxan nabaxi Sɔlu ra,

sentences.english: All the fighting-men came up and took away Saul's body and the bodies of his sons, and took them to Jabesh, and put their bones to rest under the oak-tree in Jabesh, and took no food for seven days.
sentences.susu: e naxa siga e sa Sɔlu nun a xa die furee tongo, e fa e ragata Yabɛsi terebinti wuri bun ma Galadi. Yabɛsikae naxa sunyi suxu xi solofere.

sentences.english: So death came to Saul because of the sin which he did against the Lord, that is, because of the word of the Lord which he kept not; and because he went for directions to one who had an evil spirit,
sentences.susu: Sɔlu faxa a xa yanfanteya nan ma fe ra a naxan niya Alatala ra. A mu Alatala xa wɔyɛnyi suxu, a naxa marasi fen mixie ra naxee wɔyɛnma mixi faxaxie ra.

sentences.english: And not to the Lord: for this reason, he put him to death and gave the kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.
sentences.susu: A mu marasi fen Alatala ra, na na a ra Alatala naxa a faxa, a Sɔlu xa mangɛya fi Yisayi xa di Dawuda ma.

sentences.english: Then all Israel came together to David at Hebron, and said, Truly, we are your bone and your flesh.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae birin naxa a masen Dawuda bɛ Xebiron, «Won wuli keren, fasɛ keren.

sentences.english: In the past, when Saul was king, it was you who went at the head of Israel when they went out or came in; and the Lord your God said to you, You are to be the keeper of my people Israel, and their ruler.
sentences.susu: Hali Mangɛ Sɔlu xa waxati i tan nan nu Isirayila raɲɛrɛma. I Marigi Alatala naxa a masen i bɛ, ‹I xa n ma ɲama Isirayila raɲɛrɛ, i xa findi e xa yarerati ra.›»

sentences.english: So all the responsible men of Israel came to the king at Hebron; and David made an agreement with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they put the holy oil on David and made him king over Israel, as the Lord had said by Samuel.
sentences.susu: Isirayila forie birin naxa siga a fɔxɔ ra Xebiron. Dawuda naxa saatɛ xiri e tagi Alatala ya i. E naxa ture sa a xunyi ma Isirayila mangɛ ki ma, alɔ Alatala nu bara a masen Annabi Samuweli bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (which is Jebus); and the Jebusites, the people of the land, were there.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda nun Isirayilakae naxa siga Darisalamu, naxan man nu xili Yebusu, barima Yebusu bɔnsɔɛ nu sabatixi naa.

sentences.english: And the people of Jebus said to David, You will not come in here. But still, David took the strong place of Zion, which is the town of David.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala Dawuda bɛ, «I mu soma be feo.» Kɔnɔ Dawuda naxa nɔ Siyon yire makantaxi masɔtɔde. Na kui e mɛnni xili fala Dawuda xa taa.

sentences.english: And David said, The first to overcome the Jebusites will be chief and captain. And Joab, the son of Zeruiah, went up first, and became chief.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nu bara a fala, «Naxan singe na Yebusu gere, n na kanyi findima nɛ mangɛ ra.» Seruya xa di Yowaba singe nan gere so, a fa findi sɔɔrie xa mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And David took the strong tower for his living-place, so it was named the town of David.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa sabati na yire makantaxi kui, na na a ra naa xili naxa fala Dawuda xa taa.

sentences.english: And he took in hand the building of the town all round, starting from the Millo; and Joab put the rest of the town in order.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa mɛnni nun a rabilinyi yailan. Yowaba fan naxa wali gbɛtɛ raba Darisalamu alako naa xa fan.

sentences.english: And David became greater and greater in power, because the Lord of armies was with him.
sentences.susu: Dawuda sɛnbɛ nu luma gbo ra, barima a nun Mangɛ Alatala nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: Now these are the chief of David's men of war who were his strong supporters in the kingdom, and, with all Israel, made him king, as the Lord had said about Israel.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa sɔɔri xunyi, naxee bara a mali Isirayila mangɛya sɔtɔde, alɔ Alatala nu bara a masen ki naxɛ,

sentences.english: This is the list of David's men of war: Ishbaal, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the three: he put to death three hundred at one time with his spear.
sentences.susu: na sɔɔri gbangbalanyie xilie nan ya: Xakimoni xa di Yasobeyami, naxan findi e xunyi ra. A nu bara mixi kɛmɛ saxan faxa tanbɛ ra gere keren kui.

sentences.english: And after him was Eleazar, the son of Dodo the Ahohite, who was one of the three great fighters.
sentences.susu: A firin nde findi Dodayi xa di Eleyasari nan na, Axowaka. A nu na Dawuda xa sɛnbɛma saxanyie ya ma.

sentences.english: He was with David at Pas-dammim, where the Philistines had come together for the fight, near a bit of land full of barley; and the people went in flight before the Philistines.
sentences.susu: A nu bara Dawuda mali Filisitakae gerede Pasi Damimi. A xa sɔɔrie naxa e gi Filisitakae ma, mɛngi xɛ nu dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And he took up his position in the middle of the bit of land, and kept back their attack, and overcame the Philistines; and the Lord gave a great salvation.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Eleyasari naxa lu naa han a Filisitakae bɔnbɔ Alatala xa mali ra.

sentences.english: And three of the thirty went down to David, to the rock, into the strong place of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines had taken up their position in the valley of Rephaim.
sentences.susu: Yarerati saxan, Dawuda xa yarerati tongo saxanyie ya ma, naxa siga Dawuda yire Adulama fɔnmɛ ra. Filisitakae nu tixi Refa gulunba kui.

sentences.english: At that time David had taken cover in the strong place, and an armed force of the Philistines was in Beth-lehem.
sentences.susu: Na waxati Dawuda nu sabatixi yire makantaxi, Filisitakae nu sabatixi Bɛtɛlɛɛmu mabiri.

sentences.english: And David, moved by a strong desire, said, If only someone would give me a drink of the water from the water-hole of Beth-lehem by the doorway into the town!
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a sago nde fala, «A xɔli n ma n xa Bɛtɛlɛɛmu kɔlɔnyi ye min.»

sentences.english: So the three, forcing a way through the Philistine army, got water from the water-hole of Beth-lehem, by the doorway into the town, and took it back to David; but David would not take it, but made an offering of it, draining it out to the Lord,
sentences.susu: Na sɔɔri yarerati saxanyie naxa Filisitakae xa naaninyi igiri, e sa ye ba kɔlɔnyi ra naxan na Bɛtɛlɛɛmu naadɛ ra. E to fa na ye ra Dawuda bɛ, a naxa tondi a minde. A naxa a ifili bɔxi ma sɛrɛxɛ ra Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: Saying, By my God, far be it from me to do this! How may I take as drink the life-blood of these men who have put their lives in danger? so he did not take it. These things did the three great men of war.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala, «Ala xa n natanga na ma. N mu nɔma yi ye minde, n ma xɛmɛe naxan sɔtɔxi n bɛ e nii sare ra. Na luma alɔ e nii tide mu gbo n bɛ.» Na kui a naxa tondi na ye minde a xa sɛnbɛma saxanyie naxan sɔtɔ a bɛ.

sentences.english: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the thirty, for he put to death three hundred with his spear, but he had not a name among the three.
sentences.susu: Yowaba ngaxakerenyi Abisayi nan nu findixi na sɛnbɛma saxanyie xunyi ra. A nu bara xɛmɛ kɛmɛ saxan faxa a xa tanbɛ ra. A naxa xili xungbe sɔtɔ na xɛmɛ saxanyie ya ma.

sentences.english: Of the thirty, he was the noblest, and was made their captain, but he was not equal to the first three.
sentences.susu: E naxa a binya, e a findi e xa mangɛ ra, kɔnɔ a mu lu e ya ma.

sentences.english: Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, a fighting-man of Kabzeel, had done great acts; he put to death two young lions going into their secret place; and he went down into a hole and put a lion to death in time of snow.
sentences.susu: Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya Kabaseelika nu findixi sɔɔri magaaxuxi nan na. A nu bara fe xungbe gbegbe raba, alɔ Ariyɛli Mowabaka firinyi faxafe. A man naxa yɛtɛ nde faxa kɔlɔnyi kui balabalanyi tɛmui.

sentences.english: And he made an attack on an Egyptian, a very tall man about five cubits high, armed with a spear like a cloth-worker's rod; he went down to him with a stick, and pulling his spear out of the hand of the Egyptian, put him to death with that same spear.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde a naxa Misiraka gbangbalanyi nde faxa, naxan xa maiteya kanke ya firin lima. Tanbɛ belebele nu na na Misiraka yi ra, naxan gbo alɔ dugi sɔxɔ wuri. Bɛnaya naxa na ba a yi ra, a a faxa a yɛtɛ xa tanbɛ ra.

sentences.english: These were the acts of Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, who had a great name among the thirty men of war.
sentences.susu: Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya xa fe xungbe nan na ki. A xili gbo na sɛnbɛma saxanyi ya ma.

sentences.english: He was honoured over the thirty, but he was not equal to the first three: and David put him over his servants.
sentences.susu: A naxa binyɛ sɔtɔ dangi na xɛmɛ tongo saxan na, kɔnɔ a sɛnbɛ mu nu gbo na sɛnbɛma saxanyie bɛ. Dawuda xa gundo sɔɔri nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: And these were the great men of war: Asahel, the brother of Joab, Elhanan, the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,
sentences.susu: Sɛnbɛma gbɛtɛe nan ya: Yowaba xunya Asahɛli, Dodo xa di Elexanan Bɛtɛlɛɛmuka,

sentences.english: Shammoth the Harodite, Helez the Pelonite,
sentences.susu: Samoti Harorika, Xɛlɛsi Pelonka,

sentences.english: Ira, the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,
sentences.susu: Ikesi xa di Ira Tekowaka, Abiyeseri Anatɔtika,

sentences.english: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
sentences.susu: Sibekayi Xusaka, Ilayi Axowaka,

sentences.english: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled, the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
sentences.susu: Maharayi Netofaka, Baanna xa di Xeleda Netofaka,

sentences.english: Ithai, the son of Ribai of Gibeah, of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
sentences.susu: Ribayi xa di Itayi, naxan keli Gibiya Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi ma, Bɛnaya Piratonka,

sentences.english: Hurai of Nahale-gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
sentences.susu: Xurayi naxan keli Gaasi gulunba yire, Abiyɛli Arabaka,

sentences.english: Azmaveth of Bahurim, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
sentences.susu: Asamafeti Baxurimika, Eliyaba Saalabonka,

sentences.english: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan, the son of Shage the Hararite,
sentences.susu: Hasemi xa die Gisonkae, Saage xa di Yonatan Hararaka,

sentences.english: Ahiam, the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal, the son of Ur,
sentences.susu: Sakara xa di Axiyama Hararaka, Uru xa di Elifala,

sentences.english: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
sentences.susu: Xeferi Mekeraka, Ahiya Pelonka,

sentences.english: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai, the son of Ezbai,
sentences.susu: Xesero Karemeleka, Esibayi xa di Naarayi,

sentences.english: Joel, the brother of Nathan, Mibhar, the son of Hagri,
sentences.susu: Natan ngaxakerenyi Yoweli, Hagari xa di Mibixari,

sentences.english: Zelek the Ammonite, and Naharai the Berothite, the servant who had the care of the arms of Joab, the son of Zeruiah;
sentences.susu: Sɛlɛki Amonika, Naxarayi Berotika, Seruya xa di Yowaba xa geresose xaninma,

sentences.english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
sentences.susu: Ira nun Garebe Yatirikae,

sentences.english: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad, the son of Ahlai,
sentences.susu: Uriya Xitika, Axalayi xa di Sabadi,

sentences.english: Adina, the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a chief of the Reubenites, and thirty with him;
sentences.susu: Siisa xa di Adina Rubenkae xa mangɛ nun a xa mixi tongo saxan,

sentences.english: Hanan, the son of Maacah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
sentences.susu: Maaka xa di Xanan, Yosafati Mitinika,

sentences.english: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel, the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,
sentences.susu: Usiya Asatarotika, Xotama xa die Saama nun Yeyiyeli Arowerikae,

sentences.english: Jediael, the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
sentences.susu: Simiri xa die Yediyayeli, Yoxa xunya Tisika,

sentences.english: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
sentences.susu: Eliyeli Maxawika, Eliyeli xa die Yeribayi nun Yosawiya, Itima Mowabaka,

sentences.english: Eliel and Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.
sentences.susu: Eliyeli, Obedo, nun Yaasiyɛli Mesobaka.

sentences.english: Now these are the men who came to David at Ziklag, while he was still shut up, because of Saul, the son of Kish; they were among the strong men, his helpers in war.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔrie nan ya naxee siga Dawuda yire Sikilaga, alako e xa a mali gere sode. Na waxati Dawuda mu nu na Kisu xa di Sɔlu fɛ ma.

sentences.english: They were armed with bows, and were able to send stones, and arrows from the bow, with right hand or left: they were Saul's brothers, of Benjamin.
sentences.susu: Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ nan nu e ra, Sɔlu ngaxakerenyie. E nu fata tanbɛ nun gɛmɛe wolide e yirefanyi nun e kɔɔla bɛlɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: Ahiezer was their chief, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Beracah and Jehu the Anathothite;
sentences.susu: E xilie nan ya: Mangɛ Axiyeseri, Semaa xa die Yowasi Gibiyaka, Asamafeti xa die Yesiyeli nun Pɛlɛti, Beraka nun Yehu Anatɔtika,

sentences.english: And Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a great man among the thirty, and their chief; and Jeremiah and Jehaziel and Johanan and Jozabad the Gederathite;
sentences.susu: Yisemaya Gabayonka, naxan findi sɔɔri xungbe ra na sɔɔri tongo saxan ya ma, a fan findi e xa mangɛ nan na,

sentences.english: Eluzai and Jerimoth and Bealiah and Shemariah and Shephatiah the Haruphite;
sentences.susu: Yeremi, Yaxasiyeli, Yoxanan, nun Yosabadi Gederaka,

sentences.english: Elkanah and Isshiah and Azarel and Joezer and Jashobeam, the Korahites;
sentences.susu: Elusayi, Yerimoti, Beyalaya, Sɛmaraya, Sɛfataya Xarufuka,

sentences.english: And Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
sentences.susu: Elekana Koraka, Yisiya Koraka, Asarɛli Koraka, Yoweseri Koraka, Yasobeyami Koraka,

sentences.english: And some of the Gadites, siding with David, went to his strong place in the waste land, great and strong men, trained for war, expert in the use of arms, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were quick-footed like roes on the mountains;
sentences.susu: nun Yeroxama Gedorika xa die Yowela nun Sebadaya.

sentences.english: Ezer their chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri gbangbalanyi Gadika ndee naxa siga Dawuda yire wula i. Nee fata gere ra, geresose nu na e yi ra alɔ kanke makantase nun tanbɛ. E sɛnbɛ nu gbo alɔ yɛtɛe, e xulun alɔ xeli naxee e gima geyae fari.

sentences.english: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
sentences.susu: E xilie nan ya: Eseri, e xunyi, Abadiyasi, a firin nde, Eliyabi, a saxan nde,

sentences.english: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
sentences.susu: Misemanna, a naani nde, Yeremi, a suuli nde,

sentences.english: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
sentences.susu: Atayi, a senni nde, Eliyeli, a solofere nde,

sentences.english: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbannai the eleventh.
sentences.susu: Yoxanan, a solomasaxan nde, Elesabada, a solomanaani nde,

sentences.english: These Gadites were captains of the army; the least of them was captain over a hundred men, and the greatest over a thousand.
sentences.susu: Yeremi, a fu nde, a nun Makabanayi, a fu nun keren nde.

sentences.english: It was they who went over Jordan in the first month, when the river was overflowing, and put to flight all the people of the valleys, to the east and to the west.
sentences.susu: Gadikae nan yi ki naxee findi sɔɔri xungbee ra. Naxan xurun e ya ma, a sɛnbɛ gbo mixi kɛmɛ bɛ. Naxan xungbo e ya ma, a sɛnbɛ gbo mixi wulu bɛ.

sentences.english: And some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to David in his strong place.
sentences.susu: Nee naxa Yurudɛn xure giri a rafexi tɛmui naxɛ, kike singe, e fa geya lanbanyi mixie keri sogetede nun sogegorode mabiri.

sentences.english: And David went out to them, and said to them, If you have come in peace to give me help, my heart will be united with yours; but if you have come to give me up to those who would take my life, though my hands are clean from wrongdoing, then may the God of our fathers see it and give you punishment.
sentences.susu: Bunyaminka nun Yudayaka ndee naxa siga Dawuda xa yire makantaxi.

sentences.english: Then the spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, We are yours, David, we are on your side, O son of Jesse: may peace be with you and peace be with your helpers; for God is your helper. Then David took them into his army and made them captains of the band.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa e ralan, a a fala e bɛ, «Xa wo faxi bɔɲɛsa nan kui alako wo xa n mali, won bɔɲɛe findima keren nan na. Kɔnɔ xa a sa a li wo faxi n yanfade n yaxuie nan bɛ, n tan naxan mu fe ɲaaxi yo rabaxi, won benbae Marigi Ala kiiti sama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And some of the men of Manasseh came over to David, when he went with the Philistines to the war against Saul, but he gave them no help: for the lords of the Philistines, after discussion, sent him away, saying, He will go back to his master Saul, at the price of our lives.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa goro Amasayi ma, naxan findi sɔɔri tongo saxan xunyi ra. A naxa a fala, Ala xa Yisayi xa di Dawuda mali, Ala xa bɔɲɛsa fi a ma, Ala xa bɔɲɛsa fi Dawuda malima ma, barima Ala nan Dawuda malixi. Na kui Dawuda naxa e rasɛnɛ, e xa lu a xa sɔɔri mangɛe ya ma.

sentences.english: Then when he went back to Ziklag, there came over to him, of the men of Manasseh, Adnah and Jozabad and Jediael and Michael and Jozabad and Elihu and Zillethai, captains of thousands from the armies of Manasseh.
sentences.susu: Manasi sɔɔri ndee nu bara e sa Dawuda dɛ ra a nu wama kafufe Filisitakae ma tɛmui naxɛ Sɔlu gerede. E nun Dawuda mu nɔ Filisitakae malide barima Filisita mangɛ ndee nu bara gaaxu, e fa a fala, «Dawuda fama nɛ won yanfade, a kafu a marigi Sɔlu ma, e won gere.»

sentences.english: And they gave David help against the armed bands, for they were all great men of war, and captains in the army.
sentences.susu: E to na fala, Dawuda naxa gbilen Sikilaga. Manasika naxee nu biraxi a fɔxɔ ra, e xilie nan ya: Adena, Yosabadi, Yediyayeli, Mikayeli, Yosabadi, Elihu, nun Siletayi. Sɔɔri wulu keren mangɛ nan nu na e birin na.

sentences.english: And from day to day more supporters came to David, till he had a great army like the army of God.
sentences.susu: E nu Dawuda malima a xa sɔɔrie raɲɛrɛde, barima e birin fata sɔɔriɲa rabade. Singe, e nu Isirayila sɔɔrie nan naɲɛrɛma.

sentences.english: These are the numbers of the chiefs of the armed men, ready for war, who came to David at Hebron, to give the kingdom of Saul into his hands, as the Lord had said.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ Dawuda malimae xun nu masama han a xa sɔɔri gali naxa lu alɔ Ala gbe.

sentences.english: There were six thousand, eight hundred spearmen of the children of Judah, armed for war;
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri xasabi nan ya naxee fa Xebiron Dawuda yire, alako e xa Dawuda mali, Sɔlu xa mangɛya xa radangi a ma alɔ Alatala nu bara a masen ki naxɛ:

sentences.english: Seven thousand, one hundred of the children of Simeon, great men of war;
sentences.susu: Yudayakae, sɔɔri wulu senni kɛmɛ solomasaxan. Geresose nu na e birin yi ra.

sentences.english: Of the children of Levi, four thousand, six hundred.
sentences.susu: Simeyɔnkae, sɔɔri gbangbalanyie wulu solofere sɔɔri kɛmɛ.

sentences.english: And Jehoiada, chief of the family of Aaron, and with him three thousand, seven hundred men;
sentences.susu: Lewikae, sɔɔri wulu naani kɛmɛ senni.

sentences.english: And Zadok, a young man, great and strong in war, with twenty-two captains from his father's people.
sentences.susu: Yehoyada, naxan findi yarerati ra Haruna ɲɔxɔɛ ra, a nun a xa sɔɔri wulu saxan kɛmɛ solofere.

sentences.english: And of the children of Benjamin, the brothers of Saul, three thousand; for up to that time the greater part of them had been true to Saul.
sentences.susu: Sadɔki, sɛgɛtala sɔɔri gbangbalanyi, nun a xabilɛ kuntigie, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin.

sentences.english: And of the children of Ephraim, twenty thousand, eight hundred great men of war, men of great name in their families.
sentences.susu: Bunyaminkae, Sɔlu bɔnsɔɛ, sɔɔri wulu saxan. E mu nu gbo barima a gbegbe nu na Sɔlu nan ma sɛɛti.

sentences.english: And from the half-tribe of Manasseh, eighteen thousand, listed by name, came to make David king.
sentences.susu: Efiramikae, sɔɔri wulu mɔxɔɲɛn kɛmɛ solomasaxan. E birin sɔɔri gbangbalanyi naxee benbae xili nu gbo.

sentences.english: And of the children of Issachar, there were two hundred chiefs, men who had expert knowledge of the times and what it was best for Israel to do, and all their brothers were under their orders.
sentences.susu: Manasikae, sɔɔri wulu fu nun solomasaxan. E tan nan nu sugandixi mangɛya radangife ra Dawuda ma.

sentences.english: Of Zebulun, there were fifty thousand men, who went out with the army, expert in ordering the fight, to give help with all sorts of arms; true-hearted men.
sentences.susu: Isakarikae, kuntigi kɛmɛ firin nun e xa mixi naxee nu na e xa yaamari bun ma. E fan nu bara a kolon Isirayila lan a xa naxan naba na waxati.

sentences.english: And of Naphtali, a thousand captains with thirty-seven thousand spearmen.
sentences.susu: Sabulonkae, sɔɔri wulu tongo suuli. E rɛdixi gere xili ma, geresose nu na e yi ra.

sentences.english: And of the Danites, twenty-eight thousand, six hundred, expert in ordering the fight.
sentences.susu: Nafatalikae, sɔɔri xunyi wulu keren, a nun sɔɔri wulu tongo saxan nun solofere. Wure lefa nun tanbɛ nu na e birin yi ra.

sentences.english: And of Asher, forty thousand who went out with the army, expert in ordering the fight.
sentences.susu: Danakae, sɔɔri wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun solomasaxan kɛmɛ senni. Geresose na e birin yi ra.

sentences.english: From the other side of Jordan, there were a hundred and twenty thousand of the Reubenites and the Gadites and the men of the half-tribe of Manasseh, armed with every sort of instrument of war.
sentences.susu: Aserikae, sɔɔri wulu tongo naani. E birin rɛdixi.

sentences.english: All these men of war, expert in ordering the fight, came to Hebron with the full purpose of making David king over all Israel; and all the rest of Israel were united in their desire to make David king.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri naxee keli Yurudɛn naakiri ma sogetede biri, nee findi Rubenkae, Gadikae, nun Manasikae nan na, e lan mixi wulu kɛmɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nan ma. Geresosee na e birin yi ra.

sentences.english: For three days they were there with David, feasting at his table, for their brothers had made ready food for them.
sentences.susu: Yi sɔɔrie fa nɛ Xebiron alako e xa Dawuda dɔxɔ mangɛ ra Isirayila xun na. Na ɲanige nan nu na e bɛ. Isirayilakae birin nu bara na natɛ tongo.

sentences.english: And those who were near, as far as Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, came with food on asses and camels and mules and oxen, with meal for food and cakes of figs and masses of grapes, and wine and oil and oxen and sheep in great numbers, for there was joy in Israel.
sentences.susu: E naxa lu mɛnni Dawuda yire xi saxan e e dɛgema, e e minma. E ngaxakerenyie nan nu na donse rafalama e bɛ.

sentences.english: Then David had discussions with the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds and with every chief.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa sɔɔri wulu xunyie, sɔɔri kɛmɛ xunyie, nun kuntigi birin xili, e xa malan.

sentences.english: And David said to all the men of Israel who had come together there, If it seems good to you and if it is the purpose of the Lord our God, let us send to all the rest of our brothers, everywhere in the land of Israel, and to the priests and the Levites in their towns and the country round them, and get them to come together here to us;
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Isirayila ɲama birin bɛ, «Xa a findixi fe fanyi nan na, xa a kelixi won Marigi Alatala nan ma, won xa xɛɛrae xɛɛ won ngaxakerenyie ma, naxee na Isirayila bɔxie ma. Won xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae fan xili, naxee na Isirayila taae kui, alako won birin xa lu yire keren.

sentences.english: And let us get back for ourselves the ark of our God: for in the days of Saul we did not go to it for directions.
sentences.susu: Won xa won Marigi xa saatɛ kankira ragbilen won yire, barima Sɔlu xa mangɛya waxati, won mu siga a fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: And all the people said they would do so, for it seemed right to them.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa tin na fe fanyi ra.

sentences.english: So David sent for all Israel to come together, from Shihor, the river of Egypt, as far as the way into Hamath, to get the ark of God from Kiriath-jearim.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Isirayila birin malan, keli Sixori xure ma Misira bɔxi, sa dɔxɔ Xamata ra, alako e xa Ala xa saatɛ kankira tongo Kiriyati Yeyarimi.

sentences.english: And David went up, with all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath-jearim in Judah, to get up from there the ark of God, over which the holy Name is named, the name of the Lord whose place is between the winged ones.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun Isirayila birin naxa te Baala Yudaya bɔxi ma, dɛnnaxɛ xili Kiriyati Yeyarimi. E nu wama Ala xa saatɛ kankira tongofe. Alatala xa kibanyi nu na malekɛ sawurɛ firin tagi na kankira fari, Alatala maxandima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And they put the ark of God on a new cart, and took it out of the house of Abinadab; and Uzza and Ahio were the drivers of the cart.
sentences.susu: E naxa Ala xa saatɛ kankira tongo Abinadabo xɔnyi, e a dɔxɔ kote xanin se nɛɛnɛ kui. Usa nun Axiyo naxa a ragi.

sentences.english: Then David and all Israel made melody before God with all their strength, with songs and corded instruments of music, and with brass instruments and horns.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun Isirayilakae naxa sɛɛwa ki fanyi Ala ya xɔri. E naxa bɛɛti ba kɔrae, maxasee, nun sarae xui ra.

sentences.english: And when they came to the grain-floor of Chidon, Uzza put out his hand to keep the ark in its place, for the oxen were slipping.
sentences.susu: E to lɔnyi li e dɛnnaxɛ ma Kidon, ninge naxee nu kote xanin se mabɛndunma, naxa salaxun e wa birafe. Usa naxa saatɛ kankira suxu a bɛlɛxɛ ra alako a naxa bira.

sentences.english: And the wrath of the Lord, burning against Uzza, sent destruction on him because he had put his hand on the ark, and death came to him there before God.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa xɔnɔ Usa ma, a a faxa keren na, barima a mu nu lan a xa a bɛlɛxɛ din saatɛ kankira ra. Usa faxa na ki nɛ Ala ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And David was angry because of the Lord's outburst of wrath against Uzza, and he gave that place the name Perez-uzza, to this day.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa xɔnɔ Usa faxafe ma. Mɛnni xili naxa sa «Usa gbaloe.» Han ya na xili saxi naa xun.

sentences.english: And so great was David's fear of God that day, that he said, How may I let the ark of God come to me?
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa gaaxu Ala ya ra na lɔxɔɛ. A naxa a yɛtɛ maxɔrin, «N Ala xa saatɛ kankira rasoma n xɔnyi di?»

sentences.english: So David did not let the ark come back to him to the town of David, but had it turned away and put into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Dawuda mu saatɛ kankira xanin a xɔnyi Darisalamu. A naxa a raso Obedo Edon xa banxi kui, naxan na Gati.

sentences.english: And the ark of God was in the house of Obed-edom for three months; and the Lord sent a blessing on the house of Obed-edom and on all he had.
sentences.susu: Ala xa saatɛ kankira naxa lu Obedo Edon xa denbaya yire kike saxan. Alatala naxa barakɛ sa e ma na xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And Hiram, king of Tyre, sent men to David with cedar-trees, and stoneworkers and woodworkers for the building of his house.
sentences.susu: Tire mangɛ Xirami naxa mixie xɛɛ Dawuda xɔn ma alako e xa banxi belebele ti a tan Dawuda bɛ. E naxa sɛdiri wuri xanin e xun ma, a nun walikɛ naxee a rawalima.

sentences.english: And David saw that the Lord had made his position safe as king over Israel, lifting up his kingdom on high because of his people Israel.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a kolon a Alatala yati nan a findixi Isirayila mangɛ ra. A a kolon Ala luma a xa mangɛya ite ra a xa ɲama xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And while he was living in Jerusalem, David took more wives and became the father of more sons and daughters.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa ginɛ gbɛtɛe dɔxɔ Darisalamu. E naxa di ginɛe nun di xɛmɛe bari a bɛ.

sentences.english: These are the names of the children he had in Jerusalem: Shammua and Shobab, Nathan and Solomon
sentences.susu: A xa di naxee barixi Darisalamu, e xilie nan ya: Samuwa, Sobabo, Natan, Sulemani,

sentences.english: And Ibhar and Elishua and Elpelet
sentences.susu: Yibixari, Elisuwa, Elipeleti,

sentences.english: And Nogah and Nepheg and Japhia
sentences.susu: Noga, Nefegi, Yafiya,

sentences.english: And Elishama and Beeliada and Eliphelet.
sentences.susu: Elisama, Beeliyada, nun Elifeleti.

sentences.english: And when the Philistines had news that David had been made king over all Israel, they went up in search of David, and David, hearing of it, went out against them.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae to a mɛ Dawuda bara findi Isirayila mangɛ ra, e naxa siga a gerede. Dawuda fan naxa mini e ya ra.

sentences.english: Now the Philistines had come, and had gone out in every direction in the valley of Rephaim.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa gere ti Isirayilakae bɛ naxee nu na Refa gulunba.

sentences.english: And David, desiring directions from God, said, Am I to go up against the Philistines? and will you give them into my hands? And the Lord said, Go up; for I will give them into your hands.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Ala maxɔrin, «N xa siga Filisitakae gerede? I e sama n sagoe?» Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «Siga, n fama nɛ e sade i sagoe.»

sentences.english: So they went up to Baal-perazim, and David overcame them there, and David said, God has let the forces fighting against me be broken by my hand, as a wall is broken down by rushing water; so they gave that place the name of Baal-perazim.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa te Bali Perasimi, e fa Filisitakae bɔnbɔ. Na kui Dawuda naxa a fala, «Ala bara n yaxuie kana, alɔ ye gbegbe bogoni bɔɔma a ra ki naxɛ.» Na fe nan a toxi, Bali Perasimi xili falaxi yi yire xun.

sentences.english: And the Philistines did not take their images with them in their flight; and at David's orders they were burned with fire.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae nu bara e xa kuyee lu gere yire. Dawuda naxa yaamari fi e xa gan.

sentences.english: Then the Philistines again went out in every direction in the valley.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae man naxa gere ti Isirayilakae bɛ naxee nu na Refa gulunba.

sentences.english: And David went for directions to God; and God said to him, You are not to go up after them; but, turning away from them, come face to face with them opposite the spice-trees.
sentences.susu: Dawuda man naxa Ala maxɔrin xa a lanma a xa e gere. Ala naxa a yaabi, «I naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra de. I xa e mabilin han wondi yire. I xa mamɛ ti mɛnni

sentences.english: And at the sound of footsteps in the tops of the trees, go out to the fight, for God has gone out before you to overcome the army of the Philistines.
sentences.susu: han i xa xui nde mɛ wuri bilie kɔn na. Na tɛmui i fa mini wondi kui e gerede. N tan nan minima i ya ra, nee bɔnbɔ i bɛ.»
