sentences.english: And David did as the Lord had said; and they overcame the army of the Philistines, attacking them from Gibeon as far as Gezer.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a raba alɔ Ala a masenxi a bɛ ki naxɛ. E naxa Filisitakae bɔnbɔ kelife Gabayon, sa dɔxɔ Geseri ra.

sentences.english: And David's name was honoured in all lands; and the Lord put the fear of him on all nations.
sentences.susu: Na kui Dawuda xili naxa xungbo yire birin. Alatala naxa a niya si birin xa gaaxu Dawuda ya ra.

sentences.english: And David made houses for himself in the town of David; and he got ready a place for the ark of God, and put up a tent for it.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa banxie ti Darisalamu taa kui, dɛnnaxɛ nu xili Dawuda xa taa. Mɛnni a naxa kiri banxi ti Ala xa saatɛ kankira luma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Then David said, The ark of God may not be moved by any but the Levites, for they have been marked out by God to take the ark of God, and to do his work for ever.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa yaamari fi a mixi yo mu Ala xa saatɛ kankira maxaninma fo Lewikae, barima Alatala e tan nan sugandixi na ma. Na bara findi e xa wali ra tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: And David made all Israel come together at Jerusalem, to take the ark of the Lord to its place, which he had got ready for it.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Isirayila birin xunlan Darisalamu Alatala xa saatɛ kankira rasofe ra banxi kui naxan nu yailanxi na xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And David got together the sons of Aaron, and the Levites;
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Haruna xa die nun Lewikae malan:

sentences.english: Of the sons of Kohath: Uriel the chief, and his brothers, a hundred and twenty;
sentences.susu: Kehati xa die, mixi kɛmɛ mixi mɔxɔɲɛn. E xunyi na Uriyeli nan na.

sentences.english: Of the sons of Merari: Asaiah the chief, and his brothers, two hundred and twenty;
sentences.susu: Merari xa die, mixi kɛmɛ firin mixi mɔxɔɲɛn. E xunyi na Asaya nan na.

sentences.english: Of the sons of Gershom: Joel the chief, and his brothers, a hundred and thirty;
sentences.susu: Gerison xa die, mixi kɛmɛ mixi tongo saxan. E xunyi na Yoweli nan na.

sentences.english: Of the sons of Elizaphan: Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers, two hundred;
sentences.susu: Elisafan xa die, mixi kɛmɛ firin. E xunyi na Semaya nan na.

sentences.english: Of the sons of Hebron: Eliel the chief, and his brothers, eighty;
sentences.susu: Xebiron xa die, mixi tongo solomasaxan. E xunyi na Eliyeli nan na.

sentences.english: Of the sons of Uzziel: Amminadab the chief, and his brothers, a hundred and twelve.
sentences.susu: Yusiyɛli xa die, mixi kɛmɛ mixi fu nun firin. E xunyi na Aminadabo nan na.

sentences.english: And David sent for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, Uriel, Asaiah and Joel, Shemaiah and Eliel and Amminadab,
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe Sadɔki nun Abiyatari, a nun Lewikae Uriyeli, Asaya, Yoweli, Semaya, Eliyeli nun Aminadabo xili.

sentences.english: And said to them, You are the heads of the families of the Levites: make yourselves holy, you and your brothers, so that you may take the ark of the Lord, the God of Israel, to the place which I have made ready for it.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo tan nan na Lewi xa denbayae xunyie ra. Wo wo yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn, wo tan nun wo xa mixie. Wo xa te wo Marigi Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ra. Wo xa a xanin yire n dɛnnaxɛ yailanxi a bɛ.

sentences.english: For because you did not take it at the first, the Lord our God sent punishment on us, because we did not get directions from him in the right way.
sentences.susu: Tɛmui dangixi won Marigi Alatala nu bara xɔnɔ won ma, barima Lewikae nan nu lan e xa na xanin a sɛriyɛ ki ma.»

sentences.english: So the priests and the Levites made themselves holy to take up the ark of the Lord, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae naxa e yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn beenu e xa te Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ra.

sentences.english: And the sons of the Levites took up the ark of God, lifting it by its rods, as the Lord had said to Moses.
sentences.susu: Lewikae naxa Alatala xa saatɛ kankira suxu wurie ma a xaninma naxee ra, e e sa e tunkie fari alɔ Alatala Annabi Munsa yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And David gave orders to the chief of the Levites to put their brothers the music-makers in position, with instruments of music, corded instruments and brass, with glad voices making sounds of joy.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Lewikae xunyie bɛ e xa bɛɛtiba ndee sugandi e xa mixie ya ma naxee bɛɛti bama kɔrae nun maxasee xui ra ɲɛlɛxinyi kui.

sentences.english: So Heman, the son of Joel, and, of his brothers, Asaph, the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan, the son of Kushaiah, were put in position by the Levites;
sentences.susu: Lewikae naxa Yoweli xa di Heman sugandi, a nun Berekiya xa di Asafi, nun Kusaya xa di Etani, naxan nu na Merari xa die ya ma.

sentences.english: And with them their brothers of the second order, Zechariah, Bani and Jaaziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Unni, Eliab and Benaiah and Maaseiah and Mattithiah and Eliphelehu and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom and Jeiel, the door-keepers.
sentences.susu: Lewikae gbɛtɛe nan nu na naadɛ kantɛe ra: Sakari, Ben, Yasiyeli, Semiramoti, Yɛxiyɛli, Unni, Eliyabi, Bɛnaya, Maaseya, Matitiya, Elifelehu, Mikineyahu, Obedo Edon, nun Yeyiyeli.

sentences.english: So those who made melody, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were put in position, with brass instruments, sounding loudly;
sentences.susu: Lewika gbɛtɛe nan nu na bɛɛtibae ra: Heman, Asafi, nun Etani. E nu maxasee raberema ɲɛlɛxinyi kui.

sentences.english: And Zechariah and Aziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel, Unni and Eliab and Maaseiah and Benaiah, with corded instruments put to Alamoth.
sentences.susu: Sakari, Asiyɛli, Semiramoti, Yɛxiyɛli, Unni, Eliyabi, Maaseya, nun Bɛnaya nu kɔrae raberema.

sentences.english: And Mattithiah and Eliphelehu and Mikneiah and Obed-edom and Jeiel and Azaziah, with corded instruments on the octave, to give the first note of the song.
sentences.susu: Matitiya, Elifelehu, Mikineyahu, Obedo Edon, Yeyiyeli, nun Asasiya nu kɔrae luuti solomasaxan daaxi raberema.

sentences.english: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was master of the music: he gave directions about the song, because he was expert.
sentences.susu: Lewika Kenaniya naxa findi xunyi ra naxan Ala xa saatɛ kankira xaninma. A nu na wali kolon.

sentences.english: And Berechiah and Elkanah were door-keepers for the ark.
sentences.susu: Berekiya nun Elekana nu a malima na wali kui.

sentences.english: And Shebaniah and Joshaphat and Nethanel and Amasai and Zechariah and Benaiah and Eliezer, the priests, made music on the horns before the ark of God; and Obed-edom and Jehiah were door-keepers for the ark.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe Sɛbanaya, Yosafati, Netaneeli, Amasayi, Sakari, Bɛnaya, nun Eliyeseri nan nu sarae fema Ala xa saatɛ kankira ya ra. Obedo Edon nun Yexiya nan nu saatɛ kankira xaninyie ra.

sentences.english: So David, and the responsible men of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went with joy to get the ark of the agreement of the Lord out of the house of Obed-edom.
sentences.susu: Dawuda, Isirayila forie, nun sɔɔri wulu xunyie naxa ti kira xɔn alako e xa sa Alatala xa saatɛ kankira mati ɲɛlɛxinyi kui kelife ra Obedo Edon xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And when God gave help to the Levites who were lifting up the ark of the agreement of the Lord, they made an offering of seven oxen and seven sheep.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa Lewikae mali a xa saatɛ kankira xaninde. Na kui e nu bara tuura solofere nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi solofere ba sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: And David was clothed with a robe of fair linen, as were all the Levites who took up the ark, and those who made melody, and Chenaniah the master of those who made melody; and David had on a linen ephod;
sentences.susu: Dawuda, Lewika naxee saatɛ kankira xaninma, bɛɛtibae, nun Kenaniya, bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ, e birin nu maxirixi donma tofanyie kui. Dawuda naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ donma fan nagoro a ma.

sentences.english: So all Israel took up the ark of the agreement of the Lord, with loud cries and with horns and brass and corded instruments sounding loudly.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae birin naxa te Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ra ɲɛlɛxinyi kui. Ndee naxa ferie nun sarae fe, ndee naxa maxasee nun kɔrae rabere.

sentences.english: And when the ark of the agreement of the Lord came into the town of David, Michal, the daughter of Saul, looking out of the window, saw King David dancing and playing; and to her mind he seemed foolish.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu xa di ginɛ Mikala naxa Isirayilakae to Alatala xa saatɛ kankira raso ra Dawuda xa taa kui. A to mangɛ Dawuda to fare boron na ɲɛlɛxinyi kui, a naxa mangɛ Dawuda raɲaaxu.

sentences.english: Then they took in the ark of God and put it inside the tent which David had put up for it; and they made offerings, burned offerings and peace-offerings before God.
sentences.susu: E to so Darisalamu, e naxa Ala xa saatɛ kankira dɔxɔ hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, Dawuda naxan yailanxi a lude ra. E naxa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ba.

sentences.english: And when David had come to an end of making the burned offerings and peace-offerings, he gave the people a blessing in the name of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to gɛ na sɛrɛxɛe bade, a naxa duba Isirayila ɲama bɛ Alatala xili ra.

sentences.english: And he gave to everyone, every man and woman of Israel, a cake of bread, some meat, and a cake of dry grapes.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi a naxa taami, sube, nun donse ɲɔxunmɛ so Isirayilakae birin yi ra.

sentences.english: And he put some of the Levites before the ark of the Lord as servants, to keep the acts of the Lord in memory, and to give worship and praise to the Lord, the God of Israel:
sentences.susu: A Lewika naxee sugandi dubafe ra ɲama bɛ, e Isirayila Marigi Alatala matɔxɔ, e a tantu a xa saatɛ kankira ya ra. Nee xilie nan ya:

sentences.english: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, Uzziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Mattithiah and Eliab and Benaiah and Obed-edom and Jeiel, with corded instruments of music; and Asaph, with brass instruments sounding loudly;
sentences.susu: Asafi, naxan findi e xunyi ra, Sakari, naxan na na xanbi ra, Yeyiyeli, Semiramoti, Yɛxiyɛli, Matitiya, Eliyabi, Bɛnaya, Obedo Edon, nun Yeyiyeli. Kɔrae nu na e yi ra, maxasee nu na Asafi yi ra.

sentences.english: And Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests, blowing horns all the time before the ark of the agreement of God.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Bɛnaya nun Yaxasiyeli nu sarae fema Ala xa saatɛ kankira ya ra.

sentences.english: Then on that day David first made the giving of praise to the Lord the work of Asaph and his brothers.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Dawuda naxa yi bɛɛti so Asafi nun a xa mixie yi ra alako e xa Alatala tantu.

sentences.english: O give praise to the Lord; give honour to his name, talking of his doings among the peoples.
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala matɔxɔ, wo a maxandi. Wo a masen sie bɛ a fe xungbe naxee rabaxi.

sentences.english: Let your voice be sounded in songs and melody; let all your thoughts be of the wonder of his works.
sentences.susu: Wo bɛɛti ba a bɛ, wo a tantu binyɛ kui. Wo wo maɲɔxun a xa fe fanyi birin ma.

sentences.english: Have glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who are searching after the Lord be glad.
sentences.susu: Wo a xili sɛniyɛnxi matɔxɔ. Wo tan naxee na Alatala fenfe, sɛɛwɛ xa lu wo bɔɲɛe kui.

sentences.english: Let your search be for the Lord and for his strength; let your hearts ever be turned to him.
sentences.susu: Wo xa bira Alatala nun a sɛnbɛ fɔxɔ ra. Wo wo ya rafindi a ma.

sentences.english: Keep in mind the great works which he has done; his wonders, and the decisions of his mouth;
sentences.susu: Wo wo ratu a xa kaabanakoe ma, a xa fe fanyie ma a naxee rabaxi, a nun a xa marasi.

sentences.english: O you seed of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his loved ones.
sentences.susu: Wo tan Isirayila bara findi a xa konyie ra. Yaxuba xa die, Alatala bara wo sugandi.

sentences.english: He is the Lord our God: he is judge of all the earth.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan na won Marigi Ala ra, A tan nan kiiti sama bɔxi birin ma.

sentences.english: He has kept his agreement in mind for ever, the word which he gave for a thousand generations;
sentences.susu: Wo wo ratu a xa saatɛ ma tɛmui birin, a xa wɔyɛnyi ma abadan.

sentences.english: The agreement which he made with Abraham, and his oath to Isaac;
sentences.susu: A na saatɛ naxan tongo Iburahima bɛ, a a kali Isiyaga bɛ.

sentences.english: And he gave it to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an eternal agreement;
sentences.susu: A na nan xirixi e nun Yaxuba tagi, a findi saatɛ ra Isirayila bɛ naxan mu kanama abadan.

sentences.english: Saying, To you will I give the land of Canaan, the measured line of your heritage:
sentences.susu: Na saatɛ nan ya: «N Kanaan bɔxi fima nɛ wo ma, a findi wo kɛ ra.»

sentences.english: When you were still small in number, and strange in the land;
sentences.susu: Wo mu nu gbo, xɔɲɛ nan nu wo ra na bɔxi kui.

sentences.english: When they went about from one nation to another, and from one kingdom to another people;
sentences.susu: Wo to siga ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛe ma, wo naxa lu e xa mangɛya bun ma,

sentences.english: He would not let anyone do them wrong; he even kept back kings because of them,
sentences.susu: Ala mu tin mixi yo xa wo ɲaxankata. A naxa mangɛe rakɔrɔsi wo xa fe ra,

sentences.english: Saying, Put not your hand on those who have been marked with my holy oil, and do my prophets no wrong.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa wo bɛlɛxɛ din n ma mixi sugandixie ra, wo naxa n ma namiɲɔnmɛe tɔɔrɔ.»

sentences.english: Make songs to the Lord, all the earth; give the good news of his salvation day by day.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa birin xa bɛɛti ba Alatala bɛ. Lɔxɔɛ birin wo xa a xa kisi xa fe masen.

sentences.english: Make clear his glory to the nations, and his wonders to all the peoples.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a xa fe fanyie tagi raba si gbɛtɛe bɛ, wo xa a xa kaabanakoe masen duniɲa birin bɛ.

sentences.english: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised; and he is more to be feared than all other gods.
sentences.susu: Alatala sɛnbɛ gbo, a lanma won xa a matɔxɔ. A magaaxu alae birin bɛ.

sentences.english: For all the gods of the nations are false gods; but the Lord made the heavens.
sentences.susu: Wule nan na si gbɛtɛe xa alae ra, kɔnɔ Alatala nan koore daaxi.

sentences.english: Honour and glory are before him: strength and joy are in his holy place.
sentences.susu: Nɔrɛ xungbe na a yi ra, sɛnbɛ nun sɛɛwɛ gbo a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Give to the Lord, O you families of the peoples, give to the Lord glory and strength.
sentences.susu: Si birin, wo xa Alatala matɔxɔ, wo xa a sɛnbɛ kolon.

sentences.english: Give to the Lord the glory of his name; take with you an offering and come before him; give worship to the Lord in holy robes.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a xili matɔxɔ, wo xa sɛrɛxɛe ba a bɛ a xa hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, wo xa a batu sɛniyɛnyi kui.

sentences.english: Be in fear before him, all the earth: the world is ordered so that it may not be moved.
sentences.susu: Adama birin xa sɛrɛn a ya ra. Ala mu tinma duniɲa xun xa rakana.

sentences.english: Let the heavens have joy and let the earth be glad; let them say among the nations, The Lord is King.
sentences.susu: Koore nun duniɲa xa sɛɛwa, birin xa a kolon Alatala nan mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: Let the sea be thundering with all its waters; let the field be glad, and everything which is in it;
sentences.susu: Baa nun yɛxɛɛe xa Ala sɛnbɛ masen, bɔxi nun subee xa Ala xa fanyi masen.

sentences.english: Then let all the trees of the wood be sounding with joy before the Lord, for he is come to be the judge of the earth.
sentences.susu: Wondi wuri xa Alatala xili masen, naxan fafe duniɲa makiitide.

sentences.english: O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Alatala tantu barima a fan, a xa xanunteya mu kanama abadan.

sentences.english: And say, Be our saviour, O God of our salvation, and let us come back, and give us salvation from the nations, so that we may give honour to your holy name and have glory in your praise.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a masen Ala bɛ, «Ala, muxu rakisi, muxu ratanga si gbɛtɛe ma, alako muxu xa i xili matɔxɔ, na xa findi fe fanyi ra muxu bɛ.

sentences.english: Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, for ever and for ever. And all the people said, So be it; and gave praise to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Tantui na Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ tɛmui birin.» Ɲama naxa a ratin, «Tantui na Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: So he made Asaph and his brothers keep their places there before the ark of the agreement of the Lord, to do whatever had to be done before the ark at all times day by day:
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Asafi nun a xunyae yamari e xa mɛɛni Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ma tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: And Obed-edom, the son of Jeduthun, and Hosah, with their brothers, sixty-eight of them, to be door-keepers:
sentences.susu: A naxa Yedutun xa di Obedo Edon, nun Xosa, a nun a xa mixi tongo senni nun solomasaxan yamari e xa hɔrɔmɔlingira naadɛ kanta.

sentences.english: And Zadok the priest, with his brothers the priests, before the House of the Lord in the high place at Gibeon;
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Sadɔki nun a xa mixie naxa lu Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira naxan nu na Gabayon geya fari.

sentences.english: To give burned offerings to the Lord on the altar of burned offerings morning and evening, every day, as it is ordered in the law of the Lord which he gave to Israel;
sentences.susu: A nu lan nɛ e xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ba gɛɛsɛgɛ nun nunmare tɛmui Alatala bɛ alɔ a sɛbɛxi Isirayilakae bɛ kitaabui kui ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest who were marked out by name to give praise to the Lord, for his mercy is unchanging for ever;
sentences.susu: Heman, Yedutun, nun boore naxee nu sugandixi fan nu na alako e xa Alatala tantu, barima a xa fonisireya mu ɲɔnma abadan.

sentences.english: And Heman and Jeduthun had horns and brass instruments sounding loudly, and instruments of music for the songs of God; and the sons of Jeduthun were to be at the door.
sentences.susu: Heman nun Yedutun nu sarae fema, e nu maxasee raberema alako e xa bɛɛti ba Alatala bɛ. Yedutun xa die nan nu na naadɛ kantɛe ra.

sentences.english: And all the people went away, every man to his house; and David went back to give a blessing to his family.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, ɲama birin naxa siga e xɔnyi. Dawuda fan naxa gbilen a xɔnyi, a xa duba a xa denbaya bɛ.

sentences.english: Now when David was living in his house, he said to Nathan the prophet, See, I am living in a house of cedar-wood, but the ark of the Lord's agreement is under the curtains of a tent.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to gɛ sabatide a xa banxi nɛɛnɛ kui, a naxa a fala Annabi Natan bɛ, «I bara a to, n na banxi tofanyi nan kui naxan yailanxi sɛdiri wuri ra, kɔnɔ Alatala xa saatɛ kankira tan na kiri banxi nan kui.»

sentences.english: And Nathan said to David, Do whatever is in your heart, for God is with you.
sentences.susu: Annabi Natan naxa Dawuda yaabi, «I xa i waxɔnfe raba, barima wo nun Ala na a ra.»

sentences.english: But that same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
sentences.susu: Na kɔɛ ra, Ala naxa a masen Annabi Natan bɛ,

sentences.english: Go and say to David my servant, The Lord says, You are not to make me a house for my living-place:
sentences.susu: «Sa a fala n ma konyi Dawuda bɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, ‹I tan mu banxi tima n bɛ n luma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: For from the day when I took Israel up, till this day, I have had no house, but have gone from tent to tent, and from living-place to living-place.
sentences.susu: Kabi n Isirayila ramini Misira bɔxi kui han to, n na kiri banxi nan kui. Banxi gbɛtɛ yo mu nu na n yi ra.

sentences.english: In all the places where I have gone with all Israel, did I ever say to any of the judges of Israel, whom I made the keepers of my people, Why have you not made for me a house of cedar?
sentences.susu: Muxu nun Isirayila xa ɲɛrɛ kui, n mu a fala n ma ɲama xa yarerati yo bɛ, n naxee sugandi e xa mɛɛni n ma ɲama ma, e xa banxi sɛdiri wuri daaxi ti n bɛ.›

sentences.english: So now, say to my servant David, The Lord of armies says, I took you from the fields, from keeping sheep, so that you might be a ruler over my people Israel;
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi i xa a masen n ma konyi Dawuda bɛ, ‹Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: I nu na gɔɔrɛ nɛ xuruse kantade, n naxa i findi n ma ɲama Isirayila xa mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And I have been with you wherever you went, cutting off before you all those who were against you; and I will make your name like the name of the greatest ones of the earth.
sentences.susu: I nu sigama dɛnnaxɛ birin won birin nan nu a ra, n naxa i yaxuie halaki i ya ra, n naxa i xili rate alɔ mixi binye naxee na bɔxi fari.

sentences.english: And I will make a resting-place for my people Israel, planting them there, so that they may be in the place which is theirs and never again be moved; and never again will they be made waste by evil men, as they were at first,
sentences.susu: N bara yire nde sugandi n ma ɲama Isirayila bɛ e sabatima dɛnnaxɛ, alako e naxa gaaxu sɔnɔn, tinxintaree xa e lu naa.

sentences.english: From the time when I put judges over my people Israel; and I will overcome all those who are against you; and I will make you great and the head of a line of kings.
sentences.susu: N e malima nɛ alɔ n a raba ki naxɛ n to kiitisae dɔxɔ n ma ɲama Isirayila xun ma. N man na rabama i tan fan bɛ, i xa ti i yaxuie fari. N tan Alatala fama nɛ sɛnbɛ fide i ma a nun i xabilɛ birin.

sentences.english: And when the time comes for you to go to your fathers, I will put in your place your seed after you, one of your sons, and I will make his kingdom strong.
sentences.susu: I xa duniɲɛigiri na kamali tɛmui naxɛ, i naxa gbilen i benbae yire, n mɛɛnima nɛ i xa die ma. N keren sugandima nɛ, a xa findi mangɛ ra i ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: He will be the builder of my house, and I will make the seat of his authority certain for ever.
sentences.susu: Na kanyi nan fama hɔrɔmɔbanxi tide n bɛ. N a rasabatima mangɛya kui, alako a xa bu abadan.

sentences.english: I will be to him a father and he will be to me a son; and I will not take my mercy away from him as I took it from him who was before you;
sentences.susu: N findima a baba nan na, a tan fan findima n ma di nan na. N ma fonisireya mu bama a yi ra alɔ n a ba ki naxɛ mangɛ singe yi ra.

sentences.english: But I will make his place in my house and in my kingdom certain for ever; and the seat of his authority will never be overturned.
sentences.susu: N a findima n ma ɲama xa mangɛ nan na, a xa mangɛya mu kanama abadan.›»

sentences.english: So Nathan gave David an account of all these words and this vision.
sentences.susu: Annabi Natan naxa Ala xa masenyi ti Dawuda bɛ alɔ Ala a masenxi a bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then David the king went in and took his seat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God, and what is my family, that you have been my guide till now?
sentences.susu: Na xanbi mangɛ Dawuda naxa siga, a sa a yɛtɛ dɛntɛgɛ Marigi Alatala bɛ, a a fala, «N Marigi Alatala, nde na n tan na a nun n ma denbaya ra naxan a niyama i xa yi natɛ mɔɔli tongo muxu bɛ?

sentences.english: And this was only a small thing to you, O God; but your words have even been about the far-off future of your servant's family, looking on me as on one of high position, O Lord God.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, i naxan falaxi i xa konyi xa denbaya xa fe ra, fe xuri mu a ra de! N Marigi Alatala i bara hinnɛ n na alɔ mixi xungbe.

sentences.english: What more may David say to you? for you have knowledge of your servant.
sentences.susu: N tan Dawuda, n nɔma munse falade i bɛ yi xunnakeli xa fe ra i naxan fixi i xa konyi ma? I i xa konyi kolon.

sentences.english: O Lord, because of your servant, and from your heart, you have done all these great things and let them be seen.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala, i bara yi natɛ tongo n bɛ i xa xanunteya xa fe ra alako duniɲa xa i sɛnbɛ kolon.»

sentences.english: O Lord, there is no one like you, and no other God but you, as is clear from everything which has come to our ears.
sentences.susu: «Alatala, i maniyɛ mu na, ala gbɛtɛ mu na ba i tan na. Muxu bara na kolon.

sentences.english: And what other nation in the earth, like your people Israel, did a god go out to take for himself, to be his people, making his name great and to be feared, driving out the nations from before your people whom you made free and took out of Egypt?
sentences.susu: Si gbɛtɛ na duniɲa naxan luma alɔ Isirayila naxan Marigi a raminixi konyiya kui, a a findi a xa ɲama ra? I bara kaabanakoe raba, fe magaaxuxie. I bara sie keri i xa ɲama ya ra, i naxan naminixi Misira bɔxi ra, alako i xili xa kolon.

sentences.english: For your people Israel you made yours for ever; and you, Lord, became their God.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala, i bara a ragiri Isirayila xa findi i xa ɲama ra, i fan bara findi e Marigi Ala ra. Na mu kanama abadan.»

sentences.english: And now, Lord, let your words about your servant and about his family be made certain for ever, and do as you have said.
sentences.susu: «Marigi Alatala, i xa masenyi i xa konyi nun a xa denbaya xa fe ra, na xa kamali. I naxan fala, yandi i xa na ragiri.

sentences.english: So let your words be made certain and your name be made great, when men say, The Lord of armies is the God of Israel; and when the family of David your servant is made strong before you.
sentences.susu: I xa na ragiri alako i xili xa gbo tɛmui birin. Duniɲa xa a fala, ‹Mangɛ Alatala, Isirayila Marigi Ala nan a ra.› I xa konyi Dawuda, nun a xa denbaya, i xa mɛɛni e ma abadan.

sentences.english: For you, O my God, have let your servant see that you will make him head of a line of kings; and so it has come into your servant's heart to make his prayer to you.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, i bara i ɲanige masen i xa konyi bɛ a falafe ra i xa a xa denbaya xun nakeli. Na na a ra i xa konyi bara limaniya i maxandife ra.

sentences.english: And now, O Lord, you are God, and you have said you will give this good thing to your servant:
sentences.susu: Alatala, i tan nan na Ala ra. I bara yi masenyi fanyi ti i xa konyi bɛ.

sentences.english: And now you have been pleased to give your blessing to the family of your servant, so that it may go on for ever before you; you, O Lord, have given your blessing, and a blessing will be on it for ever.
sentences.susu: I bara wa i xa konyi xa denbaya barakafe, alako a xa balo i ya i abadan. Alatala barakɛ sama naxan ma, na barakɛ mu bama a yi ra abadan.»

sentences.english: And it came about after this that David made an attack on the Philistines and overcame them, and took Gath with its daughter-towns out of the hands of the Philistines.
sentences.susu: Na to dangi, Dawuda naxa Filisitakae bɔnbɔ, a e rayaagi. A naxa Gati nun a rabilinyie ba e yi ra.

sentences.english: And he overcame Moab, and the Moabites became his servants and gave him offerings.
sentences.susu: A naxa Mowabakae fan bɔnbɔ, e fa lu a xa yaamari bun ma, e duuti ba.

sentences.english: Then David overcame Hadadezer, king of Zobah, near Hamath, when he was going to make his power seen by the river Euphrates.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Soba mangɛ Hadadeseri fan bɔnbɔ Xamata mabiri, barima a nu wama Efirati xure xa lu a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: And David took from him a thousand war-carriages and seven thousand horsemen and twenty thousand footmen: and he had the leg-muscles of all the horses cut, keeping only enough of them for a hundred war-carriages.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa sɔɔri ragise wulu keren, soe ragi wulu solofere, nun sɔɔri wulu mɔxɔɲɛn ba e yi ra. A naxa soe birin tore bolon fo soe kɛmɛ ɲɔndɔn a naxee ragata a yɛtɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: And when the Aramaeans of Damascus came to the help of Hadadezer, king of Zobah, David put to the sword twenty-two thousand Aramaeans.
sentences.susu: Siriyaka naxee na Damasi naxa fa Soba mangɛ Hadadeseri malide, kɔnɔ Dawuda naxa sɔɔri wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin bɔnbɔ e ra.

sentences.english: Then David put armed forces in Damascus, and the Aramaeans became his servants and gave him offerings. And the Lord made David overcome wherever he went.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a xa sɔɔrie dɔxɔ Siriya bɔxi ma Damasi taa kui. Siriyakae naxa lu Dawuda xa yaamari bun, e duuti ba a bɛ. Dawuda siga dɛdɛ, Alatala nu xunnakeli fima nɛ a ma.

sentences.english: And the gold body-covers of the servants of Hadadezer, David took to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Hadadeseri xa sɔɔrie xa wure lefa xanin Darisalamu xɛɛma masoxi naxee ma.

sentences.english: And from Tibhath and from Cun, towns of Hadadezer, David took a great store of brass, of which Solomon made the great brass water-vessel and the brass pillars and vessels.
sentences.susu: A naxa Hadadeseri xa yɔxui gbegbe tongo Tibati nun Kunu. Sulemani naxa na yailan maxase xungbe ra, salide kɔntigibae, a nun sɛrɛxɛbade walisee ra naxee nu rawalima hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: Now when Tou, king of Hamath, had news that David had overcome all the army of Hadadezer, king of Zobah,
sentences.susu: Xamata mangɛ Tohu naxa a mɛ a Dawuda bara Soba mangɛ Hadadeseri xa sɔɔrie birin bɔnbɔ.

sentences.english: He sent his son Hadoram to King David, to give him words of peace and blessing, because he had overcome Hadadezer in the fight, for Hadadezer had been at war with Tou; and he gave him all sorts of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa di Hadorami xɛɛ mangɛ Dawuda xɔn, a xa a xɛɛbu a bɛ, a man xa a matɔxɔ a xa gere xa fe ra Hadadeseri mabiri ra. A man naxa xɛɛma, gbeti, nun yɔxui fi Dawuda ma, barima gere nu na Tohu nun Hadadeseri tagi.

sentences.english: These King David made holy to the Lord, together with the silver and gold he had taken from all nations; from Edom and Moab and from the children of Ammon and from the Philistines and from Amalek.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda naxa na birin fi Alatala ma, a nun gbeti nun xɛɛma a naxan nasuxu sie birin yi ra alɔ Edon, Mowaba, Amoni, Filisita, nun Amalɛki.

sentences.english: And when he came back from putting to the sword eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt,
sentences.susu: Seruya xa di Abisayi naxa Edonka wulu fu nun solomasaxan bɔnbɔ gulunba kui Fɔxɔɛ yire.

sentences.english: David put armed forces in all the towns of Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. The Lord made David overcome wherever he went.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɔɔrie lu Edon alako naa birin xa lu Dawuda xa yaamari bun ma. Dawuda siga dɛdɛ, Alatala nu xunnakeli fima nɛ a ma.

sentences.english: So David was king over all Israel, judging and giving right decisions for all his people.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a xa ɲama Isirayila yamari sɛriyɛ nun tinxinyi ra.

sentences.english: And Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the army; and Jehoshaphat, son of Ahilud, was keeper of the records.
sentences.susu: Seruya xa di Yowaba nan nu na sɔɔrie xa mangɛ ra. Axiludu xa di Yehosafati nan nu na mangɛ xa xui madangi ra.

sentences.english: And Zadok, the son of Ahitub; and Ahimelech, the son of Abiathar, were priests; and Shavsha was the scribe;
sentences.susu: Axituba xa di Sadɔki nun Abiyatari xa di Abimeleki nan nu na sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra. Sawesa nan nu na mangɛ xa sɛbɛliti ra.

sentences.english: And Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief of those whose places were at the king's side.
sentences.susu: Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya nan nu na Keretikae nun Peletakae xunyi ra. Mangɛ Dawuda xa die nan nu na a xanbi ra.

sentences.english: Now it came about after this that death came to Nahash, the king of the children of Ammon, and his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Na to dangi, naxan naba na nan yi ki. Amonikae xa mangɛ Naxasa naxa faxa, a xa di naxa ti a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And David said, I will be a friend to Hanun, the son of Nahash, because his father was a friend to me. So David sent men to him, to give him words of comfort on account of his father. And the servants of David came to Hanun, to the land of the children of Ammon, offering him comfort.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a maɲɔxun, «N fe fanyi rabama nɛ Naxasa xa di Xanun bɛ, barima a baba fe fanyi raba nɛ n bɛ.» Dawuda naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Xanun xɔn e xa sa a nu tɔɔrɔ a nu sɛgɛ sa a baba ɲɔnfe ma. Dawuda xa xɛɛrae naxa so Amonikae xa bɔxi ma Xanun yire, e xa a nu tɔɔrɔ sa.

sentences.english: But the chiefs of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Does it seem to you that David is honouring your father, by sending comforters to you? is it not clear that these men have only come to go through the land and to make secret observation of it so that they may overcome it?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Amonikae xa kuntigie naxa a fala Xanun bɛ, «I ɲɔxɔ a ma Dawuda yee xɛɛxi i nu tɔɔrɔ sade i baba ɲɔnfe nan ma? E faxi nɛ e xa fa be kolon, e xa be ya iso, e xa yi bɔxi tegerenya raba. A xa xɛɛrae faxi be na nan ma.»

sentences.english: So Hanun took David's servants, and cutting off their hair and the skirts of their robes up to the middle, sent them away.
sentences.susu: Na kui Xanun naxa Dawuda xa xɛɛrae suxu, a naxa e dɛ xabe maxaba, a naxa e xa donmae raxaba e xɔrɛ yailanyi, a fa e rabɛɲin.

sentences.english: Then certain men went and gave David word of what had been done to them. And he sent out with the purpose of meeting them; for the men were greatly shamed. And the king said, Keep where you are at Jericho till your hair is long again, and then come back.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde to na fe dɛntɛgɛ Dawuda bɛ, a naxa mixie xɛɛ a xa xɛɛrae yire a falafe ra, «Wo lu Yeriko han wo dɛ xabee xa mini. Na tɛmui wo xa gbilen be.» Dawuda xa xɛɛrae xaxili nu bara ifu ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves hated by David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver as payment for war-carriages and horsemen from Mesopotamia and Aram-maacah and Zobah.
sentences.susu: Xanun nun Amonikae to a kolon a e bara xɔnnanteya raso e nun Dawuda tagi, e naxa gbeti kilo wulu tongo saxan nun naani fi Siriyakae ma, naxee nu na Mesopotamiya, Maaka nun Soba, alako e xa fa sɔɔri ragisee nun soe ragie ra e bɛ.

sentences.english: So with this money they got thirty-two thousand war-carriages, and the help of the king of Maacah and his people, who came and took up their position in front of Medeba. And the children of Ammon came together from their towns for the fight.
sentences.susu: Na kui Maaka mangɛ nun a xa ɲama naxa fa sɔɔri ragise wulu tongo saxan nun firin na, e fa malan Medeba. Amonikae fan naxa mini e xa taae kui, alako e xa Dawuda gere.

sentences.english: And David, hearing of it, sent Joab with all the army of fighting-men.
sentences.susu: Dawuda fɛfɛ na kolon, a naxa sɔɔri mangɛ Yowaba nun a xa sɔɔri gbangbalanyi birin xɛɛ e yire.

sentences.english: So the children of Ammon came out and put their forces in position on the way into the town; and the kings who had come were stationed by themselves in the field.
sentences.susu: Amonikae naxa mini, e ti gere ki ma taa sode dɛ ra. Mangɛ naxee fa e malide, e nu tixi e xati ma daaxa i.

sentences.english: Now when Joab saw that their forces were in position against him in front and at his back, he took all the best men of Israel, and put them in line against the Aramaeans;
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa a kolon gere na a ya ra, a man na a xanbi ra. A naxa Isirayila sɔɔri fanyie mayegeti, a e ti Siriyakae ya ra.

sentences.english: And the rest of the people he put in position against the children of Ammon with Abishai, his brother, at their head.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɔɔri dɔnxɔɛe lu a xunya Abisayi xa yaamari bun ma, e xa ti Amonikae ya ra.

sentences.english: And he said, If the Aramaeans are stronger and get the better of me, then come to my help; and if the children of Ammon get the better of you, I will come to your help.
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa a fala a xunya bɛ, «Xa Siriyakae sɛnbɛ gbo n bɛ, i xa fa n malide. Xa Amonikae fan sɛnbɛ gbo i bɛ, n fan sigama i malide.

sentences.english: Take heart, and let us be strong for our people and for the towns of our God; and may the Lord do what seems good to him.
sentences.susu: I xa limaniya, won xa won sɛnbɛ so won bɔnsɔɛ xa fe ra nun won Marigi Ala xa taae xa fe ra. Alatala xa a waxɔnfe raba.»

sentences.english: So Joab and the people who were with him went forward into the fight against the Aramaeans, and they went in flight before him.
sentences.susu: Yowaba nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa Siriyakae gere. Nee naxa e gi Yowaba ma.

sentences.english: And when the children of Ammon saw the flight of the Aramaeans, they themselves went in flight from Abishai, his brother, and came into the town. Then Joab came back to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Amonikae to a to, Siriyakae bara e gi, e fan naxa e gi Abisayi ma. Yowaba xunya naxa so taa kui, Yowaba naxa gbilen Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And when the Aramaeans saw that Israel had overcome them, they sent men to get the Aramaeans who were on the other side of the River, with Shophach, the captain of Hadadezer's army, at their head.
sentences.susu: Siriyakae to a kolon Isirayila bara e bɔnbɔ, e naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Siriyakae ma naxee nu na xure naakiri ma. Hadadeseri xa sɔɔri mangɛ Sofaki nan nu na e xunyi ra.

sentences.english: And word of this was given to David; and he got all Israel together and went over Jordan and came to Helam and put his forces in position against them. And when David's forces were in position against the Aramaeans, the fight was started.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to na kolon, a naxa Isirayilakae birin malan, e naxa fa e Yurudɛn igiri, e siga Siriyakae gerede. Siriyakae man naxa e gi Isirayilakae ya ra.

sentences.english: And the Aramaeans went in flight before Israel; and David put to the sword the men of seven thousand Aramaean war-carriages and forty thousand footmen, and put to death Shophach, the captain of the army.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa sɔɔri nun e ragise dɔxɔ wulu solofere faxa, a nun sɔɔri wulu tongo naani gbɛtɛ. A naxa sɔɔri mangɛ Sofaki fan faxa.

sentences.english: And when the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were overcome by Israel, they made peace with David and became his servants: and the Aramaeans would give no more help to the children of Ammon.
sentences.susu: Hadadeseri malimae to a kolon a Isirayilakae bara e bɔnbɔ, e naxa lanyi xiri e nun Dawuda tagi, e naxa lu a xa yaamari bun. Kabi na waxati, Siriyakae mu tinma Amonikae malide sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Now in the spring, at the time when kings go out to war, Joab went out at the head of the armed forces and made waste all the land of the Ammonites and put his men in position before Rabbah, shutting it in. But David was still at Jerusalem. And Joab took Rabbah and made it waste.
sentences.susu: Na ɲɛ igbilenyi, gere tɛmui to a li, Yowaba nun a xa sɔɔri gbangbalanyie naxa siga Amonikae gerede. Yowaba naxa taa nde suxu naxan xili Raba, a fa mɛnni kana. Dawuda tan naxa lu Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And David took the crown of Milcom from off his head; its weight was a talent of gold and it had stones of great price in it; and it was put on David's head, and he took a great store of goods from the town.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa mangɛ tɔnxuma xɛɛma daaxi ba Amonikae xa mangɛ xunyi ma, naxan xa binyɛ dangi kilo tongo saxan na. Gɛmɛ tofanyi diyaman daaxi fan nu na a ma. Na mangɛ tɔnxuma naxa dɔxɔ Dawuda xun ma, a fa se gbegbe xanin a xun ma a naxan sɔtɔ gere kui.

sentences.english: And he took the people out of the town and put them to work with wood-cutting instruments, and iron grain-crushers, and axes. And this he did to all the towns of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people went back to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxan nu na naa, Dawuda naxa e xanin a xun ma, a e findi konyie ra naxee wuri, gɛmɛ, nun wure xabama. A Amonikae xa taa birin xa fe raba na ki nɛ. Na xanbi, Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa gbilen Darisalamu.

sentences.english: Now after this there was war with the Philistines at Gezer; then Sibbecai the Hushathite put to death Sippai, one of the offspring of the Rephaim; and they were overcome.
sentences.susu: Na to dangi, Isirayilakae nun Filisitakae naxa gere Geseri. Na gere kui, Sibekayi Xusaka naxa Sipayi faxa. Sipayi findi Refa bɔnsɔɛ nan na. Filisitakae naxa yaagi na fe ma.

sentences.english: And again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan, the son of Jair, put to death Lahmi, the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the stem of whose spear was like a cloth-worker's rod.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae nun Filisitakae man naxa gere. Yi biyaasi Yayiri xa di Elexanan naxa Goliyati xunya Laxami Gatika faxa. A sɛnbɛ nu gbo, a xa tanbɛ xa xungboe nu luxi alɔ dugi sɔxɔ wuri.

sentences.english: And again there was war at Gath, where there was a very tall man, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six fingers on his hands and six toes on his feet; he was one of the offspring of the Rephaim.
sentences.susu: Gere gbɛtɛ naxa mini Gati. Xɛmɛ kuye nde nu na, sole senni nan nu na a salonse birin ma, nee malanxi mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani. Na fan Rafa bɔnsɔɛ nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: And when he put shame on Israel, Jonathan, the son of Shimea, David's brother, put him to death.
sentences.susu: A to Isirayila konbi, Dawuda xunya Simeya xa di Yonatan naxa a faxa.

sentences.english: These were of the offspring of the Rephaim in Gath; they came to their death by the hands of David and his servants.
sentences.susu: Yi xɛmɛe birin fatanxi Rafa bɔnsɔɛ nan ma naxan nu sabatixi Gati. Dawuda nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa e birin sɔntɔ.

sentences.english: Now Satan, designing evil against Israel, put into David's mind the impulse to take the number of Israel.
sentences.susu: Sentanɛ to wa Isirayila ratantanfe, a naxa Dawuda bɔɲɛ rate a xa Isirayilakae kɔnti.

sentences.english: And David said to Joab and the captains of the people, Now let all Israel, from Beer-sheba to Dan, be numbered; and give me word so that I may be certain of their number.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Yowaba nun kuntigie bɛ, «Wo siga, wo xa sa Isirayilakae kɔnti, keli Beriseeba ma, sa dɔxɔ Dana ra. Wo xa na xasabi dɛntɛgɛ n bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Joab said, May the Lord make his people a hundred times more in number than they are; but, my lord king, are they not all my lord's servants? why would my lord have this done? why will he become a cause of sin to Israel?
sentences.susu: Yowaba naxa a yaabi, «Alatala xa Isirayila ɲama rawuya dɔxɔ kɛmɛ. Mangɛ, n marigi, i xa konyie xa mu nee birin na? I yi mɔɔli maxɔrinxi munfe ra? Munfe ra i wama Isirayila xa yi yunubi sɔtɔ?»

sentences.english: But the king's word was stronger than Joab's. So Joab went out and went through all Israel and came to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mangɛ xui mu matandima, na na a ra Yowaba naxa mini, a naxa Isirayila birin iɲɛrɛ, a fa gbilen Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And Joab gave David the number of all the people; all the men of Israel, able to take up arms, were one million, one hundred thousand men; and those of Judah were four hundred and seventy thousand men, able to take up arms.
sentences.susu: A naxa ɲama xasabi fala Dawuda bɛ. Isirayilakae xa kɔnti nan ya: xɛmɛ santidɛgɛma kanyi miliyɔn keren, wulu kɛmɛ. Yudayakae xa kɔnti nan ya: xɛmɛ santidɛgɛma kanyi wulu kɛmɛ naani, tongo solofere.

sentences.english: But Levi and Benjamin were not numbered among them, for Joab was disgusted with the king's order.
sentences.susu: Yowaba mu Lewi nun Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ kɔnti, barima mangɛ xa yaamari mu nu rafanxi a ma.

sentences.english: And God was not pleased with this thing; so he sent punishment on Israel.
sentences.susu: Yi yaamari naxa raɲaaxu Ala ma. A naxa Isirayila xa tantanyi seri ba.

sentences.english: Then David said to God, Great has been my sin in doing this; but now, be pleased to take away the sin of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Ala bɛ, «N to yi rabaxi, n bara yunubi belebele raba. Yakɔsi n bara i mayandi i xa diɲɛ i xa konyi xa yunubi ma. Na bara findi n ma daxuɲa ra.»

sentences.english: Then the word of the Lord came to Gad, David's seer, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Gadi bɛ, naxan findi namiɲɔnmɛ ra mangɛ bɛ Dawuda xa waxati,

sentences.english: Go and say to David, The Lord says, Three things are offered to you: say which of them you will have, so that I may do it to you.
sentences.susu: «I xa a fala Dawuda bɛ, Alatala yi nan masenxi i bɛ, ‹N bara fe saxan masen i bɛ, i xa keren sugandi i wama n xa naxan naba i ra.›»

sentences.english: So Gad came to David and said to him, The Lord says, Take whichever you will:
sentences.susu: Gadi naxa siga Dawuda yire, a a fala a bɛ, «Alatala yi nan masenxi i bɛ,

sentences.english: Three years when there will not be enough food; or three months of war, when you will go in flight before your haters, being in great danger of the sword; or three days of the sword of the Lord, disease in the land, and the angel of the Lord taking destruction through all the land of Israel. Now give thought to the answer I am to take back to him who sent me.
sentences.susu: ‹I bara tin ɲaxankatɛ mundun na: kaamɛ xa sin bɔxi ɲɛ saxan, xa na mu i yaxuie xa nɔ wo ra e xa santidɛgɛma ra kike saxan, xa na mu Alatala xa a xa malekɛ xɛɛ a xa Isirayila ɲama halaki, a xa bɔxi birin kana a xa santidɛgɛma ra nun fure ɲaaxi ra xi saxan. Yakɔsi i xa a mato n lan n xa naxan fala n xɛɛma bɛ.›»

sentences.english: And David said to Gad, This is a hard decision for me to make: let me come into the hands of the Lord, for great are his mercies: let me not come into the hands of men.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Gadi yaabi, «N bɔɲɛ bara maɲaaxu a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra. A lan n xa n sa Alatala bɛlɛxɛ i naxan xa kinikini gbo. Na fisa adamadie bɛlɛxɛe bɛ.»

sentences.english: So the Lord sent disease on Israel, causing the death of seventy thousand men.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa fure ɲaaxi radin Isirayila ma han xɛmɛ wulu tongo solofere naxa faxa Isirayila bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem for its destruction: and when he was about to do so, the Lord saw, and had regret for the evil, and said to the angel of destruction, It is enough; do no more. Now the angel of the Lord was by the grain-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa malekɛ xɛɛ Darisalamu, a xa sa naa kana. A nu naa kanafe tɛmui naxɛ, Alatala naxa e xa tɔɔrɛ mato, a fa nimisa. A naxa a masen malekɛ bɛ naxan nu na naa kanafe, «Na lan. E lu naa sinden.» Alatala xa malekɛ nu tixi Oronan Yebusuka xa lonyi ma.

sentences.english: And David, lifting up his eyes, saw the angel of the Lord there between earth and heaven, with an uncovered sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the responsible men, clothed in haircloth, went down on their faces.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to a ya rate, a naxa Alatala xa malekɛ to, a tixi koore ma, a xa santidɛgɛma baxi a tɛɛ i, a ya rafindixi Darisalamu ma. Dawuda nun forie naxa sunnun donma ragoro e ma, e e yatagi rafelen bɔxi.

sentences.english: And David said to God, Was it not I who gave the order for the people to be numbered? It is I who have done the sin and the great wrong; but these are only sheep; what have they done? let your hand, O Lord God, be lifted up against me and against my family, but not against your people to send disease on them.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Ala bɛ, «N tan xa mu yaamari ti e xa Isirayila ɲama kɔnti? N tan nan yunubi rabaxi, n tan nan yi fe kobi niyaxi. Ɲama tan munse rabaxi? N Marigi Alatala, i xa n tan nun ma denbaya halaki, i xa i xa ɲama lu naa.»

sentences.english: Then the angel of the Lord gave orders to Gad to say to David that he was to go and put up an altar to the Lord on the grain-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa a masen Gadi bɛ a xa a fala Dawuda bɛ, a xa te sɛrɛxɛbade yailande Alatala bɛ Oronan Yebusuka xa lonyi ma.

sentences.english: And David went up, as Gad had said in the name of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa te naa alɔ Gadi a fala a bɛ Alatala xili ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And Ornan, turning back, saw the angel, and his four sons who were with him went to a secret place. Now Ornan was crushing his grain.
sentences.susu: Oronan to nu naa lonyi ma, a mɛngi bɔnbɔfe, a naxa a mafindi, a fa malekɛ to. A tan nun a xa di naanie naxa e nɔxun.

sentences.english: And when David came, Ornan, looking, saw him, and came out from the grain-floor and went down on his face to the earth before him.
sentences.susu: Na waxati, Dawuda fan nu sigafe Oronan yire. Oronan to a to, a naxa keli lonyi ma, a sa a felen bɔxi ma Dawuda bun ma.

sentences.english: Then David said to Ornan, Give me the place where this grain-floor is, so that I may put up an altar here to the Lord: let me have it for its full price; so that this disease may be stopped among the people.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Oronan bɛ, «N wama yi lonyi sarafe i ma, alako n xa sɛrɛxɛbade ti Alatala bɛ. A mati n ma a sare ra, alako fure ɲaaxi xa ɲɔn ɲama ma.»

sentences.english: And Ornan said to David, Take it, and let my lord the king do what seems right to him. See, I give you the oxen for burned offerings and the grain-cleaning instruments for fire-wood, and the grain for the meal offering; I give it all.
sentences.susu: Oronan naxa Dawuda yaabi, «Mangɛ, a tongo. N marigi xa a waxɔnfe raba a ra. N bara yi ningee fan so i yi ra, e xa findi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra. Yi sarɛtie nɔma gande yege ra, yi mɛngi fan xa findi sɛrɛxɛ ra. N bara yi birin fi i ma.»

sentences.english: And King David said to Ornan, No; I will certainly give you the full price for it, because I will not take for the Lord what is yours, or give a burned offering without payment.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mangɛ Dawuda naxa a fala Oronan bɛ, «Ade, n wama a sarafe nɛ kɔbiri ra naxan lanma sɛriyɛ ki ma. N mu se bama sɛrɛxɛ ra Alatala bɛ, naxan findima i tan harige ra. N mu nɔma sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi bade n mu naxan sare baxi.»

sentences.english: So David gave Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.
sentences.susu: Na kui Dawuda naxa xɛɛma kilo solofere fi Oronan ma na lonyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And David put up an altar there to the Lord, offering burned offerings and peace-offerings with prayers to the Lord; and he gave him an answer from heaven, sending fire on the altar of burned offering.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa sɛrɛxɛbade ti mɛnni Alatala bɛ, a fa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ba. A to Alatala maxandi, Alatala naxa a yaabi tɛ ra naxan sinxi sɛrɛxɛbade ma keli koore ma.

sentences.english: Then the Lord gave orders to the angel, and he put back his sword into its cover.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala naxa wɔyɛn malekɛ bɛ, a fa santidɛgɛma raso a tɛɛ i.

sentences.english: At that time, when David saw that the Lord had given him an answer on the grain-floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he made an offering there.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nu sɛrɛxɛ bama Oronan Yebusuka xa lonyi nan ma sɔnɔn, barima a nu bara a kolon a Alatala a yaabima mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: For the House of the Lord, which Moses had made in the waste land, and the altar of burned offerings, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira, Annabi Munsa naxan yailan gbengberenyi ma, a nun sɛrɛxɛbade sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi bama dɛnnaxɛ, nee nu na yire itexi nde nɛ Gabayon na waxati.

sentences.english: But David was not able to go before it to get directions from the Lord, so great was his fear of the sword of the angel of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Dawuda mu nu nɔma sode naa, a xa wɔyɛn Ala ra, barima a nu hɛnmɛxi Alatala xa malekɛ xa santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: Then David said, This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar for Israel's burned offerings.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a masen, «Won Marigi Alatala xa banxi xa ti be, a nun sɛrɛxɛbade, sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi bama dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: And David gave orders to get together all the men from strange lands who were in the land of Israel; and he put stone-cutters to work, cutting stones for building the house of God.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa yaamari fi, xɔɲɛ konyi birin naxee sabatixi Isirayila bɔxi ma, e xa malan. A naxa e findi gɛmɛ xabamae ra Ala xa banxi xa wali xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And he got together a great store of iron, for the nails for the doors and for the joins; and brass, more in weight than might be measured;
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa wure gbegbe fen, naxan findima lantumae nun naadɛ gbaku see ra. A naxa yɔxui gbegbe fan fen naxan mu nu nɔma maniyade a gboe xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And cedar-trees without number, for the Zidonians and the men of Tyre came with a great amount of cedar-trees for David.
sentences.susu: Sidɔnkae nun Tirekae naxa Dawuda mali, a naxa wuri fanyi gbegbe sɔtɔ. Na wuri mɔɔli xili nɛ sɛdiri.

sentences.english: And David said, Solomon my son is young and untested, and the house which is to be put up for the Lord is to be very great, a thing of wonder and glory through all countries; so I will make ready what is needed for it. So David got ready a great store of material before his death.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nu fa a fala, «N ma di Sulemani dimɛdi na a ra, a mu wali kolon sinden. Hɔrɔmɔbanxi naxan tima Alatala bɛ, na lanma a xa tofan, a xa rayabu, a xili xa gbo si birin ya ma.» Na kui, Dawuda se gbegbe malan nɛ na banxi tima naxan na beenu a xa faxa

sentences.english: Then he sent for his son Solomon, and gave him orders for the building of a house for the Lord, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a xa di Sulemani xili, a a fala a bɛ a xa banxi ti Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And David said to Solomon, My son, it was my desire to put up a house for the name of the Lord my God.
sentences.susu: A naxɛ, «N ma di, natɛ nu na n bɛ n xa banxi ti n Marigi Alatala bɛ,

sentences.english: But the word of the Lord came to me saying, You have taken lives without number and made great wars; I will not let you be the builder of a house for my name, because of the lives you have taken on the earth before my eyes.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Alatala bara yi masen n bɛ yi ki, ‹I bara wuli ifili a gbe ra n ya i i xa yihadi geree kui, i mixie gbegbe faxa. Na nan a ra, i tan nu lan i xa banxi ti n bɛ.

sentences.english: But you will have a son who will be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from wars on every side. His name will be Solomon, and in his time I will give Israel peace and quiet;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i fama di nde sɔtɔde, naxan findima bɔɲɛsa mixi ra, n malabui fima naxan ma a yaxuie xa fe ra. A xili fama falade Sulemani. Isirayila luma bɔɲɛsa nun maraxarɛ kui a xa simaya birin kui.

sentences.english: He will be the builder of a house for my name; he will be to me a son, and I will be to him a father; and I will make the seat of his rule over Israel certain for ever.
sentences.susu: A tan nan fama banxi tide n bɛ, a fa findi n ma di ra, n fan findi a baba ra. A xa mangɛya kibanyi buma abadan Isirayila.›»

sentences.english: Now, my son, may the Lord be with you; and may you do well, and put up the house of the Lord your God, as he has said of you.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi, n ma di, Alatala xa lu i sɛɛti ma, alako i xa i Marigi Alatala xa banxi ti sɔɔnɛya ra alɔ a a falaxi i xa fe ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Only may the Lord give you wisdom, and knowledge of his orders for Israel, so that you may keep the law of the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa lɔnni nun xaxili fanyi fi i ma a i tima mangɛ ra tɛmui naxɛ Isirayila bɔxi ma, alako i xa i Marigi Alatala xa sɛriyɛ rabatu.

sentences.english: And all will go well for you, if you take care to keep the laws and the rules which the Lord gave to Moses for Israel: be strong and take heart; have no fear and do not be troubled.
sentences.susu: Fe birin fama nɛ sɔɔnɛyade i bɛ xa i Alatala xa sɛriyɛ nun a xa yaamarie rabatuma, a naxee soxi Annabi Munsa yi ra Isirayila bɛ. I xa i sɛnbɛ so, i xa limaniya. I naxa gaaxu fefe ya ra, i bɔɲɛ naxa mini.»

sentences.english: Now see, poor though I am, I have got ready for the house of the Lord a hundred thousand talents of gold and a million talents of silver; and a weight of brass and iron greater than may be measured; and wood and stone have I made ready, and you may put more to it.
sentences.susu: «N ma katɛ kui, n bara xɛɛma kilo miliyɔn saxan, kilo wulu kɛmɛ naani malan Alatala xa banxi xa fe ra. N man bara gbeti kilo miliyɔn tongo saxan nun naani malan. Yɔxui nun wure bara gbo han na kɔnti mu nɔma kolonde. N bara wuri nun gɛmɛ fan fen. I man fama nde sade na xun.

sentences.english: And you have a great number of workmen, cutters and workers of stone and wood, and experts in every sort of work,
sentences.susu: Walikɛ gbegbe na i yi ra naxee fata gɛmɛ xabade, naxee fata gɛmɛ nun wuri masolide. E wali mɔɔli birin kolon.

sentences.english: In gold and silver and brass and iron more than may be numbered. Up! then, and to work; and may the Lord be with you.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛma, gbeti, yɔxui, nun wure na i yi ra han a bara dangi a i. Keli, i xa wali suxu keren na! Alatala xa i mali.»

sentences.english: Then David gave orders to all the chiefs of Israel to give their help to Solomon his son, saying,
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala Isirayila kuntigi birin bɛ, e xa fa a xa di Sulemani mali. A naxa a fala e bɛ,

sentences.english: Is not the Lord your God with you? and has he not given you rest on every side? for the Lord has given the people of the land into my hands, and the land is overcome before the Lord and before his people.
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala mu na wo fɔxɔ ra? A mu bɔɲɛsa fixi wo ma wo yaxui birin ya ra? A bara bekae sa n bɛlɛxɛ i. Yi bɔxi bara findi Alatala nun a xa ɲama gbe ra.

sentences.english: Now give your heart and soul to the worship of the Lord your God; and get to work on the building of the holy place of the Lord God, so that you may put the ark of the Lord's agreement and the holy vessels of God in the house which is to be made for the name of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo Marigi Alatala fen wo bɔɲɛ nun wo nii birin na. Wo keli, wo xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi sɛniyɛnxi ti wo Marigi Alatala bɛ, alako wo xa fa Alatala xa saatɛ kankira nun a xa se sɛniyɛnxie raso Ala xa banxi kui.»

sentences.english: Now David was old and full of days; and he made his son Solomon king over Israel.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to bara gɛ foride, a naxa a xa di Sulemani sugandi Isirayila mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And he got together all the chiefs of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
sentences.susu: A naxa Isirayila kuntigie, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, nun Lewikae malan.

sentences.english: And the Levites, all those of thirty years old and over, were numbered; and the number of them, by heads, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.
sentences.susu: E naxa Lewikae kɔnti, naxee nu bara ɲɛ tongo saxan sɔtɔ. E kɔnti naxa siga xɛmɛ wulu tongo saxan nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: Of these, twenty-four thousand were to be overseers of the work of the house of the Lord, and six thousand were judges and men of authority;
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala, «N bara mixi wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani ba, e xa e ɲɛngi sa Alatala xa banxi wali rabafe xɔn. Mixi wulu senni xa findi kiitisae ra. Mixi wulu naani xa findi naadɛ kantɛe ra.

sentences.english: Four thousand were door-keepers; and four thousand gave praise to the Lord with the instruments which I made, said David, for giving praise.
sentences.susu: Mixi wulu naani xa Alatala matɔxɔ maxasee xui ra, n naxee yailanxi a matɔxɔ se ra.»

sentences.english: And David put them into divisions under the names of the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Lewikae itaxun xundɛ ma, e benba Lewi xa die ki ma: Gerison, Kehati, nun Merari.

sentences.english: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.
sentences.susu: Gerison xa die: Ladana nun Simeyi.

sentences.english: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, and Zetham and Joel, three.
sentences.susu: Ladana xa die: Yɛxiyɛli, di singe, Setama nun Yoweli, e mixi saxan.

sentences.english: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth and Haziel and Haran, three; these were the heads of the families of Ladan.
sentences.susu: Simeyi xa die: Selomoti, Xasiyɛli, nun Xarani, e mixi saxan. Ladana xa denbaya kuntigie nan na ki.

sentences.english: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zizah and Jeush and Beriah; these four were the sons of Shimei.
sentences.susu: Simeyi xa die: Yaxati, Sisa, Yeyusu nun Beriya. Simeyi xa di naani nan na ki.

sentences.english: Jahath was the chief and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah had only a small number of sons, so they were grouped together as one family.
sentences.susu: Yaxati, di singe, Sisa, di firin nde. Yeyusu nun Beriya mu di gbegbe sɔtɔ. E naxa findi denbaya keren na.

sentences.english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
sentences.susu: Kehati xa die: Amarama, Yisehari, Xebiron, nun Yusiyɛli, e mixi naani.

sentences.english: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was made separate and holy, he and his sons for ever, for the care of the most holy things and the burning of offerings before the Lord, to do his work and give blessings in his name for ever.
sentences.susu: Amarama xa die: Haruna nun Munsa. Haruna naxa findi Ala xa mixi sɛniyɛnxi ra, a nun a bɔnsɔɛ abadan, alako e xa surayi ba sɛrɛxɛ ra Alatala bɛ, e xa a xa wali gbɛtɛ raba, e man xa duba mixi bɛ Ala xili ra tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: And the sons of Moses, the man of God, were put into the list of the tribe of Levi.
sentences.susu: Munsa findi Ala xa mixi nan na. A xa die naxa lu Lewi bɔnsɔɛe ya ma.

sentences.english: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
sentences.susu: Munsa xa die: Gerisomi nun Eliyeseri.

sentences.english: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the first.
sentences.susu: Gerisomi xa die: Sebuweli, di singe.

sentences.english: And the sons of Eliezer: Rehabiah the first; and Eliezer had no other sons, but Rehabiah had a great number.
sentences.susu: Eliyeseri xa die: Rexabiya, di singe. Eliyeseri mu di gbɛtɛ sɔtɔ, kɔnɔ Rexabiya naxa di gbegbe bari.

sentences.english: The sons of Izhar: Shelomith the first.
sentences.susu: Yisehari xa die: Selomiti, di singe.

sentences.english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
sentences.susu: Xebiron xa die: Yeriya, di singe, Amaraya, di firin nde, Yaxasiyeli, di saxan nde, nun Yekameyami, di naani nde.

sentences.english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the first, and Isshiah the second.
sentences.susu: Yusiyɛli xa die: Mike, di singe, nun Yisiya, di firin nde.

sentences.english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.
sentences.susu: Merari xa die: Maxali nun Musi. Maxali xa die: Eleyasari nun Kisi.

sentences.english: And at his death Eleazar had no sons, but only daughters, and their relations, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.
sentences.susu: Eleyasari faxa nɛ, a mu di xɛmɛ yo lu, kɔnɔ a di ginɛe tan lu nɛ. Kisi xa die naxa e dɔxɔ ginɛ ra, barima e dɛxɔe nan nu e ra.

sentences.english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli and Eder and Jeremoth, three.
sentences.susu: Musi xa die: Maxali, Ederi nun Yerimoti, e di saxan.

sentences.english: These were the sons of Levi, grouped by families, the heads of the families of those who were numbered by name, by heads, all those of twenty years old and over who did the work of the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Yee nan findi Lewi bɔnsɔɛe ra denbaya xunyie ki ma. E birin kɔntixi keren kerenyi ra. E nu walima Alatala xa banxi kui kabi e na ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn.

sentences.english: For David said, The Lord, the God of Israel, has given his people rest, and he has made his resting-place in Jerusalem for ever;
sentences.susu: Dawuda nu bara a fala, «Isirayila Marigi Alatala bara bɔɲɛsa fi a xa ɲama ma. E xa lu Darisalamu abadan.

sentences.english: And from now, there will be no need for the House of the Lord, and the vessels used in it, to be moved about by the Levites.
sentences.susu: Lewikae mu fama Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira nun a yirabasee xaninde sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: So among the last acts of David was the numbering of the sons of Levi, from twenty years old and over.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa natɛ dɔnxɔɛ nan na ki, Lewikae kɔntife naxee bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Their place was by the side of the sons of Aaron in all the work of the house of the Lord, in the open spaces and in the rooms, in the making clean of all the holy things, in doing all the work of the house of the Lord,
sentences.susu: E nu Haruna xa die malima Alatala xa banxi wali ra, alɔ mɛɛnife tɛtɛ nun konkoe ma, se rasɛniyɛnfe, wali xunxuri rabafe Ala xa banxi kui,

sentences.english: The holy bread was in their care, and the crushed grain for the meal offering, of unleavened cakes or meal cooked over the fire or in water; they had control of all sorts of weights and measures;
sentences.susu: taami yailanfe naxan bama sɛrɛxɛ ra Ala bɛ, farin dinfe naxan findima sɛrɛxɛ ra, taami lɛbinitare yailanfe, nun donse mɔɔli birin nafalafe.

sentences.english: They had to take their places every morning to give praise and make melody to the Lord, and in the same way at evening;
sentences.susu: E nu lanma e xa Alatala matɔxɔ gɛɛsɛgɛ nun nunmare birin.

sentences.english: At every offering of burned offerings to the Lord, on Sabbaths, and at the new moons, and on the regular feasts, in the number ordered by the law, at all times before the Lord;
sentences.susu: E man nu sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie bama Alatala bɛ malabui lɔxɔɛe ma, Kike Nɛɛnɛ Sali, nun sali xungbe waxati. E nu lanma e xa Alatala rabatu a sɛriyɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: And they had the care of the Tent of meeting and the holy place, under the direction of the sons of Aaron their brothers, for the work of the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: E tan nan nu Kiri Banxi Naralande nun yire sɛniyɛnxi kantama. E man nu e ngaxakerenyi Haruna xa die xa yaamari rabatuma Alatala xa banxi wali rabafe ma.

sentences.english: Now the divisions into which the sons of Aaron were grouped were these: the sons of Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.
sentences.susu: Haruna nu bara di naani sɔtɔ: Nadabo, Abihu, Eleyasari, nun Itamari.

sentences.english: But Nadab and Abihu came to their end before their father, and had no children; so Eleazar and Ithamar did the work of priests.
sentences.susu: Nadabo nun Abihu singe naxa faxa e baba bɛ. E mu di yo bari. Eleyasari nun Itamari nan nu na sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra.

sentences.english: And David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, made distribution of them into their positions for their work.
sentences.susu: Sadɔki, Eleyasari xa di, nun Aximeleki, Itamari xa die, naxa Dawuda mali Haruna xa die itaxunfe ra e wali ki ma.

sentences.english: And there were more chiefs among the sons of Eleazar than among the sons of Ithamar; and this is how they were grouped: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, all heads of families; and of the sons of Ithamar, heads of families, there were eight.
sentences.susu: Mangɛe nu wuya Eleyasari xa die nan ya ma, dangi Itamari xa die ra. Na nan a to e naxa Eleyasari xa die findi denbaya fu nun senni ra. Itamari xa die naxa findi denbaya solomasaxan na.

sentences.english: So they were put into groups, by the Lord's decision, one with another; for there were rulers of the holy place and rulers of the house of God among the sons of Eleazar and the sons of Ithamar.
sentences.susu: E naxa e sugandi Ala xa mali ra, barima Eleyasari xa die nun Itamari xa die birin findixi Ala xa walikɛe nan na.

sentences.english: And Shemaiah, the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was a Levite, put down their names in writing, the king being present with the rulers, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech, the son of Abiathar, and the heads of families of the priests and the Levites; one family being taken for Eleazar and then one for Ithamar, and so on.
sentences.susu: Netaneeli xa di Semaya Lewika nan nu e xilie sɛbɛma mangɛ, kuntigie, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Sadɔki, Abiyatari xa di Aximeleki, nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa denbaya xunyie, nun Lewikae ya xɔri. E naxa denbaya keren sugandi Eleyasari xa die ya ma, e man naxa keren sugandi Itamari xa die ya ma.

sentences.english: Now the first name to come out was that of Jehoiarib; the second Jedaiah,
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a ragiri denbayae xa sugandi yi ki: a singe Yehoyaribu, a firin nde Yɛdaya,

sentences.english: The third Harim, the fourth Seorim,
sentences.susu: a saxan nde Xarima, a naani nde Seyorimi,

sentences.english: The fifth Malchijah, the sixth Mijamin,
sentences.susu: a suuli nde Malakiya, a senni nde Miyamin,

sentences.english: The seventh Hakkoz, the eighth Abijah,
sentences.susu: a solofere nde Hakɔsi, a solomasaxan nde Abiya,

sentences.english: The ninth Jeshua, the tenth Shecaniah,
sentences.susu: a solomanaani nde Yosuwe, a fu nde Sɛkanaya,

sentences.english: The eleventh Eliashib, the twelfth Jakim,
sentences.susu: a fu nun keren nde Eliyasibu, a fu nun firin nde Yakimi,

sentences.english: The thirteenth Huppah, the fourteenth Jeshebeab,
sentences.susu: a fu nun saxan nde Xupa, a fu nun naani nde Yesebeyabi,

sentences.english: The fifteenth Bilgah, the sixteenth Immer,
sentences.susu: a fu nun suuli nde Biliga, a fu nun senni nde Imeri,

sentences.english: The seventeenth Hezir, the eighteenth Happizzez,
sentences.susu: a fu nun solofere nde Xesiri, a fu nun solomasaxan nde Hapisɛsi,

sentences.english: The nineteenth Pethahiah, the twentieth Jehezkel,
sentences.susu: a fu nun solomanaani nde Petaxiya, a mɔxɔɲɛn nde Yesekiyeli,

sentences.english: The twenty-first Jachin, the twenty-second Gamul,
sentences.susu: a mɔxɔɲɛn nun keren nde Yakin, a mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin nde Gamulu,

sentences.english: The twenty-third Delaiah, the twenty-fourth Maaziah.
sentences.susu: a mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan nde Dɛlaya, a mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nde Maasiya.

sentences.english: So they were put into their different groups, to take their places in the house of the Lord, in agreement with the rules made by Aaron their father, as the Lord, the God of Israel, had given him orders.
sentences.susu: A nu lan e xa Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa wali suxu na ki nɛ, alɔ e benba Haruna a fala e bɛ ki naxɛ. Isirayila Marigi Alatala nu bara na yaamari so Haruna yi ra.

sentences.english: And of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ gbɛtɛe nan ya. Amarama xa die: Subayeli. Subayeli xa die: Yexedeya.

sentences.english: Of Rehabiah; of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.
sentences.susu: Rexabiya xa die: Yisiya, di singe.

sentences.english: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.
sentences.susu: Yisehari xa die: Selomoti. Selomoti xa die: Yaxati.

sentences.english: And the sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
sentences.susu: Xebiron xa die: Yeriya, di singe, Amaraya, di firin nde, Yaxasiyeli, di saxan nde, Yekameyami, a xa di naani nde.

sentences.english: The sons of Uzziel, Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.
sentences.susu: Yusiyɛli xa die: Mike. Mike xa die: Samiri.

sentences.english: The brother of Micah, Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.
sentences.susu: Mike xunya: Yisiya. Yisiya xa die: Sakari.

sentences.english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah.
sentences.susu: Merari xa die: Maxali nun Musi a nun a xa mamadi Yaasiyahu.

sentences.english: The sons of Merari: of Jaaziah, Shoham and Zaccur and Ibri.
sentences.susu: Merari xa mamadie: Yaasiyahu, Sohami, Sakuru, nun Ibiri.

sentences.english: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.
sentences.susu: Maxali xa die: Eleyasari. Eleyasari mu di yo sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Of Kish: the sons of Kish, Jerahmeel.
sentences.susu: Kisi xa die: Yerameeli.

sentences.english: And the sons of Mushi: Mahli and Eder and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites by their families.
sentences.susu: Musi xa die: Maxali, Ederi, nun Yerimoti. Lewi xa die nan ya a denbaya ki ma.

sentences.english: Selection was made of these in the same way as of their brothers the sons of Aaron, David the king being present, with Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the heads of families of the priests and of the Levites; the families of the chief in the same way as those of his younger brother.
sentences.susu: E fan sugandixi Ala xa mali nan na alɔ e ngaxakerenyie Haruna xa die. Na raba mangɛ Dawuda, Sadɔki, Aximeleki, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa denbaya xunyie, nun Lewikae ya xɔri. Na kui Eleyasari nun Itamari xa denbayae birin lan.

sentences.english: Further, David and the chiefs of the servants of the holy place made selection of certain of the sons of Asaph and of Heman and of Jeduthun for the work of prophets, to make melody with corded instruments and brass; and the number of the men for the work they had to do was:
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun sɔɔri mangɛe naxa Asafi, Heman, nun Yedutun bɔnsɔɛe sugandi e xa namiɲɔnmɛ masenyi ti bɛɛti daaxi, kɔrae nun maxasee xui ra. Xɛmɛe xilie nan ya naxee nu na wali rabama:

sentences.english: Of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur and Joseph and Nethaniah and Asharelah, sons of Asaph; under the direction of Asaph, acting as a prophet under the orders of the king;
sentences.susu: Asafi xa die: Sakuru, Yusufu, Netaniya, nun Asareela. Asafi xa die, naxee nu na a xa yaamari bun ma, naxee nu namiɲɔnmɛ masenyi tima mangɛ bɛ:

sentences.english: Of Jeduthun: the six sons of Jeduthun, Gedaliah and Zeri and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah and Mattithiah; under the direction of their father Jeduthun who, acting as a prophet, with corded instruments gave praise and glory to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Yedutun xa die: Gɛdalaya, Seri, Yɛsaya, Simeyi, Xasabiya, nun Matitiya. Na mixi senni naxa lu e baba Yedutun xa yaamari bun ma. Yedutun nu namiɲɔnmɛ masenyi tima kɔra xui ra, alako a xa Alatala matɔxɔ, a xa a tantu.

sentences.english: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth;
sentences.susu: Heman xa die: Buukiya, Mataniya, Yusiyɛli, Sebuweli, Yerimoti, Xananiya, Xanani, Eliyata, Gidaliti, Romanti Eseri, Yosobekasa, Maloti, Hotiri, Maxasiyoti.

sentences.english: All these were sons of Heman, the king's seer in the words of God. And to make great his power God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
sentences.susu: Yi mixi birin findixi Heman xa die nan na, naxan nu Ala xui madangima mangɛ bɛ. Ala naxa sɛnbɛ fi a ma, a xa di fu nun naani sɔtɔ, a nun di ginɛ saxan.

sentences.english: All these, under the direction of their father, made music in the house of the Lord, with brass and corded instruments, for the worship of the house of God; Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the orders of the king.
sentences.susu: Nee birin nu na e baba xa yaamari bun ma, e xa bɛɛti ba kɔrae xui ra Alatala xa banxi kui. Asafi, Yedutun, nun Heman nu na mangɛ xa yaamari nan bun ma.

sentences.english: And the number of them, with their brothers who were trained and expert in making melody to the Lord, was two hundred and eighty-eight.
sentences.susu: Yi karamɔxɔ naxee fata bɛɛti bade Alatala bɛ, e findi mixi kɛmɛ firin mixi tongo solomasaxan nun solomasaxan nan na.

sentences.english: And selection was made of them for their special work, all having equal chances, small as well as great, the teacher as the learner.
sentences.susu: E birin sugandixi Ala xa mali nan na e xa wali kɛɲa ma, tagi rasa yo mu nu na a lanmadi, a xungbe, a karamɔxɔɛ, nun a xarandi tagi.

sentences.english: Now of the group of Asaph, the first name to come out was Joseph; the second Gedaliah; he and his brothers and sons were twelve?
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a ragiri e xa sugandi yi ki: A singe, Asafi xa di Yusufu. A firin nde, Gɛdalaya, a xunyae, nun a xa die, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The third Zaccur, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A saxan nde, Sakuru, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The fourth Izri, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A naani nde, Yisiri, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The fifth Nethaniah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A suuli nde, Netaniya, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The sixth Bukkiah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A senni nde, Buukiya, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The seventh Jesharelah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A solofere nde, Yesarela, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The eighth Jeshaiah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A solomasaxan nde, Yɛsaya, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The ninth Mattaniah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A solomanaani nde, Mataniya, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The tenth Shimei, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A fu nde, Simeyi, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The eleventh Azarel, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A fu nun keren nde, Asarɛli, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The twelfth Hashabiah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A fu nun firin nde, Xasabiya, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The thirteenth Shubael, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A fu nun saxan nde, Subayeli, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The fourteenth Mattithiah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A fu nun naani nde, Matitiya, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The fifteenth Jeremoth, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A fu nun suuli nde, Yerimoti, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The sixteenth Hananiah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A fu nun senni nde, Xananiya, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The seventeenth Joshbekashah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A fu nun solofere nde, Yosobekasa, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The eighteenth Hanani, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A fu nun solomasaxan nde, Xanani, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The nineteenth Mallothi, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A fu nun solomanaani nde, Maloti, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The twentieth Eliathah, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A mɔxɔɲɛn nde, Eliyata, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The twenty-first Hothir, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A mɔxɔɲɛn nun keren nde, Hotiri, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The twenty-second Giddalti, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
