sentences.susu: A mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin nde, Gidaliti, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The twenty-third Mahazioth, with his sons and his brothers, twelve;
sentences.susu: A mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan nde, Maxasiyoti, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The twenty-fourth Romamti-ezer, with his sons and his brothers, twelve.
sentences.susu: A mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nde, Romanti Eseri, a xa die, nun a xunyae, e mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: For the divisions of the door-keepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah, the son of Kore, of the sons of Ebiasaph.
sentences.susu: Naadɛ kantɛe nan ya: Kore xa die naxan baba findi Asafi ra: Meselemiya.

sentences.english: And Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the oldest, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
sentences.susu: Meselemiya xa die: Sakari nan na di singe ra, Yediyayeli, nan na a firin nde ra, Sebadaya nan na a saxan nde ra,

sentences.english: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Eliehoenai the seventh.
sentences.susu: Yataniyɛli nan na a naani nde ra, Elama nan na a suuli nde ra, Yehoxanan nan na a senni nde ra, Eliyehowenayi nan na a solofere nde ra.

sentences.english: And Obed-edom had sons: Shemaiah the oldest, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethanel the fifth,
sentences.susu: Obedo Edon xa die: Semaya, di singe, Yehosabadi di firin nde, Yowa di saxan nde, Sakara di naani nde, Netaneeli, di suuli nde,

sentences.english: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peullethai the eighth; for the blessing of God was on him.
sentences.susu: Amiyɛli, di senni nde, Isakari, di solofere nde, Pewuletayi, di solomasaxan nde. Ala nu bara baraka sa Obedo Edon xa fe.

sentences.english: And Shemaiah his son had sons, rulers over the family of their father, for they were able men.
sentences.susu: A xa di singe Semaya naxa di xɛmɛe bari naxee findixi kuntigie ra e xa denbayae xun ma barima e sɛnbɛ nu gbo.

sentences.english: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni and Rephael and Obed, Elzabad, whose brothers were great men of war, Elihu and Semachiah.
sentences.susu: Semaya xa die: Otini, Refayeli, Obedo, Elesabada, nun e xunyae Elihu nun Semakiya, xɛmɛ gbangbalanyie.

sentences.english: All these were sons of Obed-edom: they and their sons and their brothers, able men and strong for the work; sixty-two sons of Obed-edom.
sentences.susu: Yi mixi tongo senni nun firin birin baba nu lanxi Obedo Edon nan ma. E sɛnbɛ nu gbo ki fanyi Ala xa wali kui.

sentences.english: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen able men.
sentences.susu: Meselemiya xa die nun a xunyae findixi mixi fu nun solomasaxan nan na. E sɛnbɛ fan nu gbo.

sentences.english: And Hosah, a son of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the oldest, his father made him chief);
sentences.susu: Merari xa di Xosa naxa di xɛmɛe bari: Simiri, a baba naxan findi xunyi ra hali di singe to mu nu a ra.

sentences.english: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: Hosah had thirteen sons and brothers.
sentences.susu: Xilikiya, a firin nde, Tebaliya, a saxan nde, Sakari, a naani nde. Xosa xa die nun a xunyae nu lanxi mixi fu nun saxan nan ma.

sentences.english: Of these were the divisions of the door-keepers, men of authority, having responsible positions like their brothers to be servants in the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Yi mixi birin nun e xunyae findixi naadɛ kantɛe nan na Alatala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: And the families were taken by the decision of the Lord for every door; the small family had the same chance as the great.
sentences.susu: E nu luma mixi sugandi ra Ala xa mali ra alako e xa a kolon nde lan a xa naadɛ mundun kanta. Denbaya birin, mixi xuri nun mixi xungbe, e birin nu na na kɔnti kui.

sentences.english: And the care of the door on the east came out for Shelemiah. Then the name of Zechariah his son, a man wise in discussion, came out, and the door on the north was given to him.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a ragiri sogetede naadɛ xa ilan Selemiya ra. Kɔɔla naadɛ naxa ilan a xa di Sakari ra, naxan findixi lɔnnila ra.

sentences.english: To Obed-edom, that on the south; and to his sons, the store-house.
sentences.susu: Yirefanyi naadɛ naxa ilan Obedo Edon na. A xa die fan naxa lan banxi ma see ragatama dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: To Hosah, the door on the west, by the door of Shallecheth, at the footway which goes up, watch by watch.
sentences.susu: Sogegorode naadɛ naxa ilan Supimi nun Xosa ra Alatala xa maragiri saabui ra. E naxa Saaleketi naadɛ fan kanta, naxan nu na kira ma naxan tema. Xundɛ firin nu na mɛnni, e ya rafindixi e boore ma.

sentences.english: On the east were six Levites a day, and on the north and the south four a day, and for the store-house two and two.
sentences.susu: Lewika senni nu na sogetede biri, mixi naani kɔɔla biri, mixi naani yirefanyi biri, mixi naani see ragatama banxi naxan kui, yire firin,

sentences.english: For the pillared way, on the west, four at the footway and two at the pillared way itself.
sentences.susu: sogegorode biri, mixi naani nu na kira dɛ ra, mixi firin banxi sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: These were the divisions of door-keepers, of the sons of the Korahites and of the sons of Merari.
sentences.susu: Naadɛ kantɛe nan na ki naxee kelixi Kore nun Merari xa die ya ma.

sentences.english: And the Levites their brothers were responsible for the stores of the house of God and the holy things.
sentences.susu: Lewikae nan ya naxee nu e ɲɛngi sama naafuli nun se sɛniyɛnxie xɔn ma naxee ragataxi Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: The sons of Ladan: sons of the Gershonites of the family of Ladan, heads of families of Ladan the Gershonite, Jehieli.
sentences.susu: Ladana xa di naxee fatanxi Gerison bɔnsɔɛ ra Ladana saabui ra, e xa denbaya xunyie nu lanxi Yexiyeli nan ma.

sentences.english: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham and Joel, his brother, had the care of the stores of the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Yexiyeli xa die fan, Setama nun a xunya Yoweli, nu e ɲɛngi saxi naafuli xɔn ma naxan nagataxi Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:
sentences.susu: Amaramakae, Yiseharikae, Xebironkae, nun Yusiyɛlikae

sentences.english: And Shebuel, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was controller of the stores.
sentences.susu: naxa Gerisomi xa di Sebuweli, Munsa xa mamadi, sugandi a xa mɛɛni naafuli ma,

sentences.english: And his brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.
sentences.susu: e nun a bari boore naxee fatanxi Eliyeseri xabilɛ ra. E findi Eliyeseri xa di Rexabiya nan na, na fan xa di Yɛsaya, na fan xa di Yorami, na fan xa di Sikiri, nun na fan xa di Selomiti.

sentences.english: Shelomoth and his brothers were responsible for all the store of holy things which David the king and the heads of families, the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and the captains of the army, had given to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Selomiti nun a bari booree nan nu e ɲɛngi sama naafuli nun se sɛniyɛnxie xɔn ma, mangɛ Dawuda naxee radaxa xabilɛ mixi wulu yarerati, mixi kɛmɛ yarerati, nun sɔɔri xunyie nan nee fixi Ala ma.

sentences.english: From the goods taken in war, they gave, as a holy offering, materials for the building of the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: E nu bara e harige ba Alatala xa banxi bɛ e naxan sɔtɔ gere kui.

sentences.english: And everything Samuel the prophet and Saul, the son of Kish, and Abner, the son of Ner, and Joab, the son of Zeruiah, had made holy; whatever anyone had given, it was under the care of Shelomoth and his brothers.
sentences.susu: Selomiti nun a xunyae man nu e ɲɛngi sama naafuli fan xɔn ma, Annabi Samuweli, Kisi xa di Sɔlu, Neri xa di Abeneri, nun Seruya xa di Yowaba naxan fixi Ala ma.

sentences.english: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons had to do all the public business of Israel, in relation to judges and men in authority.
sentences.susu: Kenaniya nun a xunyae, naxee findi Yisehari bɔnsɔɛ ra, nan nu e ɲɛngi saxi kiiti safe xɔn ma Darisalamu fari ma Isirayila.

sentences.english: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, seventeen hundred able men, were overseers of Israel on the other side of the Jordan, to the west, being responsible for all the work of the Lord's house and for the work done by the king's servants.
sentences.susu: Xasabiya nun a xunyae, naxee nu na Xebiron, xɛmɛ gbangbalanyie, e mixi wulu keren kɛmɛ solofere, e nu e ɲɛngi sama Isirayila bɔxi xɔn ma naxan nu na Yurudɛn naakiri ma sogegorode mabiri. E nu e ɲɛngi sama Alatala nun mangɛ xa wali xɔn ma mɛnni biri.

sentences.english: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of all the Hebronites, in their generations by families. In the fortieth year of the rule of David a search was made, and able men were seen among them at Jazer of Gilead.
sentences.susu: Yeriya findi Xebiron mangɛ nan na a xabilɛ ki ma. Dawuda xa mangɛya ɲɛ tongo naani nde, mixi ndee naxa taruxuie mato, e fa a kolon xɛmɛ gbangbalanyie na Yaasɛri, Galadi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And his brothers were two thousand, seven hundred able men, heads of families, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, in everything to do with God, and for the king's business.
sentences.susu: A ngaxakerenyi gbangbalanyie nu lanxi mixi wulu firin kɛmɛ solofere nan ma, e birin xabilɛ xunyie. Mangɛ Dawuda naxa e findi Ruben, Gadi, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti keren xunyie ra.

sentences.english: Now the number of the children of Israel, that is, the heads of families, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and the men in authority who were servants of the king in anything to do with the divisions which came in and went out month by month through all the months of the year, in every division were twenty-four thousand.
sentences.susu: Isirayila sɔɔrie xunyie nan ya naxee findi denbaya xunyie ra. E tan nan nu findixi mangɛ xa sɔɔri gali xunyie ra, sɔɔri wulu nun sɔɔri kɛmɛ ki ma. Kike yo kike xɛmɛ wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nu sɔɔri wali rabama.

sentences.english: Over the first division for the first month was Ishbaal, the son of Zabdiel; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
sentences.susu: Sabadiyɛli xa di Yasobeyami findi xundɛ singe xa mangɛ nan na, ɲɛ kike singe. Xɛmɛ wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nu na a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: He was of the sons of Perez, and the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.
sentences.susu: Sabadiyɛli findi Peresi xa di nde nan na. A findi sɔɔri birin xa mangɛ nan na ɲɛ kike singe.

sentences.english: And over the division for the second month was Eleazar, the son of Dodai the Ahohite, the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
sentences.susu: Dodayi Axowaka findi xundɛ firin nde mangɛ nan na ɲɛ kike firin nde. Mikiloti naxa findi a xa sɔɔrie xunyi ra. Xɛmɛ wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nu na a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the priest; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Yehoyada xa di Bɛnaya findi xundɛ saxan nde mangɛ nan na ɲɛ kike saxan nde. Xɛmɛ wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nu na a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: This is the same Benaiah who was the great man of the thirty, chief of the thirty; and in his division was Ammizabad his son.
sentences.susu: Bɛnaya nan nu na Dawuda xa sɔɔri tongo saxanyie xunyi ra. A xa di Amisabadi nu na a baba xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel, the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
sentences.susu: Yowaba xunya Asahɛli findi xundɛ naani nde mangɛ nan na ɲɛ kike naani nde. A xa di Sebadaya naxa findi a ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Xɛmɛ wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nu na a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
sentences.susu: Samehuti Yisiraka findi xundɛ suuli nde mangɛ nan na ɲɛ kike suuli nde. Xɛmɛ wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nu na a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira, the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
sentences.susu: Ikesi xa di Ira Tekowaka findixi xundɛ senni nde mangɛ nan na ɲɛ kike senni nde. Xɛmɛ wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nu na a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the sons of Ephraim; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
sentences.susu: Xɛlɛsi Pelonka naxan fatan Efirami bɔnsɔɛ ra findi xundɛ solofere nde mangɛ nan na ɲɛ kike solofere nde. Xɛmɛ wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nu na a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
sentences.susu: Sibekayi Xusaka naxan fatan Sera xabilɛ ra findi xundɛ solomasaxan nde mangɛ nan na ɲɛ kike solomasaxan nde. Xɛmɛ wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nu na a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
sentences.susu: Abiyeseri Anatɔtika naxan fatan Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ ra findi xundɛ solomanaani nde mangɛ nan na ɲɛ kike solomanaani nde. Xɛmɛ wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nu na a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
sentences.susu: Maharayi Netofaka naxan fatan Sera xabilɛ ra findi xundɛ fu nde mangɛ nan na ɲɛ kike fu nde. Xɛmɛ wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nu na a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the sons of Ephraim; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
sentences.susu: Bɛnaya Piratonka naxan fatan Efirami bɔnsɔɛ ra findi xundɛ fu nun keren nde mangɛ nan na ɲɛ kike fu nun keren nde. Xɛmɛ wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nu na a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.
sentences.susu: Xeledayi Netofaka naxan fatan Otiniyeli xabilɛ ra findi xundɛ fu nun firin nde mangɛ nan na ɲɛ kike fu nun firin nde. Xɛmɛ wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nu na a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: And over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer, the son of Zichri; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah, the son of Maacah;
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe xa sɔɔrie xa mangɛe nan ya: Ruben bɔnsɔɛ xun ma, Sikiri xa di Eliyeseri. Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ xun ma, Maaka xa di Sɛfataya,

sentences.english: Of Levi, Hashabiah, the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ xun ma, Kemuweli xa di Xasabiya. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Sadɔki nan nu na Haruna xabilɛ xun ma.

sentences.english: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David; of Issachar, Omri, the son of Michael;
sentences.susu: Yudaya bɔnsɔɛ xun ma, Dawuda taara Elihu. Isakari bɔnsɔɛ xun ma, Mikayeli xa di Omeri.

sentences.english: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah, the son of Obadiah; of Naphtali, Jerimoth, the son of Azriel;
sentences.susu: Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ xun ma, Abadiyasi xa di Yisemaya. Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ xun ma, Asiriyɛli xa di Yerimoti.

sentences.english: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea, the son of Azaziah; of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joel, the son of Pedaiah;
sentences.susu: Efirami bɔnsɔɛ xun ma, Asasiya xa di Hoseya. Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti keren xun ma, Pɛdaya xa di Yoweli.

sentences.english: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo, the son of Zechariah; of Benjamin, Jaasiel, the son of Abner;
sentences.susu: Manasi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti boore xun ma sogetede biri, Sakari xa di Ido. Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ xun ma, Abeneri xa di Yaasiyɛli.

sentences.english: Of Dan, Azarel, the son of Jeroham. These were the captains of the tribes of Israel.
sentences.susu: Dana bɔnsɔɛ xun ma, Yeroxama xa di Asarɛli. Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe xa sɔɔrie xa mangɛe nan na ki.

sentences.english: But David did not take the number of those who were under twenty years old, for the Lord had said that he would make Israel like the stars of heaven in number.
sentences.susu: Dawuda mu mixie kɔnti, naxee nu bara gɛ ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn sɔtɔde, barima Alatala nu bara a masen a Isirayilakae wuyama nɛ alɔ tunbuie.

sentences.english: The numbering was started by Joab, the son of Zeruiah, but he did not go on to the end; and because of it, wrath came on Israel and the number was not recorded in the history of King David.
sentences.susu: Seruya xa di Yowaba nu bara Isirayilakae kɔnti fɔlɔ, kɔnɔ a mu a raɲɔn Alatala xa xɔnɛ xa fe ra Isirayila ma. Na kɔnti mu sɛbɛxi Dawuda xa taruxui buki kui.

sentences.english: And Azmaveth, the son of Adiel, was controller of the king's property; Jonathan, the son of Uzziah, had control of all store-houses in country places and in the towns and little towns and strong places;
sentences.susu: Adiyeli xa di Asamafeti findi mangɛ xa naafuli ragatɛ nan na. Yusiya xa di Yonatan fan findi mangɛ xa naafuli ragatɛ nan na Darisalamu fari ma, daaxa nun taa gbɛtɛe kui.

sentences.english: Ezri, the son of Chelub, had authority over the field-workers and farmers;
sentences.susu: Kelubu xa di Esiri findi mangɛ xa xɛ sae xunyi nan na.

sentences.english: Shimei the Ramathite was responsible for the vine-gardens; Zabdi the Shiphmite was responsible for the produce of the vine-gardens and for all the stores of wine;
sentences.susu: Simeyi Ramatika nan nu a ɲɔxɔ sama mangɛ xa wɛni bilie xɔn ma. Sabidi Sefamika nan fan nu a ɲɔxɔ sama mangɛ xa wɛni ragatadee xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Baal-hanan the Gederite was responsible for the olive-trees and the sycamore-trees in the lowlands; and Joash for the stores of oil;
sentences.susu: Bali Xanan Gederika nan nu mɛɛnima mangɛ xa oliwi nun sikomoro xɛe ma Sefela bɔxi ma. Yowasi nan fan nu mɛɛnima mangɛ xa ture ragatadee ma.

sentences.english: And Shitrai the Sharonite was responsible for the herds in the grass-lands of Sharon, and Shaphat, the son of Adlai, for those in the valleys;
sentences.susu: Sitirayi Sarɔnka nan nu mɛɛnima mangɛ xa xuruse xungbee ma Sarɔn bɔxi ma. Adalayi xa di Safati nan fan nu mɛɛnima mangɛ xa xuruse xungbee ma gulunba kui.

sentences.english: Obil the Ishmaelite had control of the camels and Jehdeiah the Meronothite of the she-asses;
sentences.susu: Sumayila xa di Obili nan nu mɛɛnima mangɛ xa ɲɔxɔmɛe ma. Yexedeya Meronotika nan fan nu mɛɛnima mangɛ xa sofalee ma.

sentences.english: The flocks were in the care of Jaziz the Hagarite. All these were the controllers of King David's property.
sentences.susu: Yasisi Hagarika nan nu mɛɛnima mangɛ xa xuruse lanmae ma. Yi mixie birin nu e ɲɛngi sama mangɛ Dawuda harige nan xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Now Jonathan, David's father's brother, expert in discussion, and a man of good sense, was a scribe; and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni, had the care of the king's sons;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda baba xunya Yonatan findi mixi rasi, lɔnnila, nun sɛbɛliti nan na. Xakimoni xa di Yɛxiyɛli nan nu mɛɛnima mangɛ xa die ma.

sentences.english: And Ahithophel was the king's expert in discussion and Hushai the Archite was the king's friend.
sentences.susu: Axitofeli fan findi mangɛ rasima nan na. Arakika Xusayi findi mangɛ dɛfanboore nan na.

sentences.english: After Ahithophel was Jehoiada, the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar; and the captain of the king's army was Joab.
sentences.susu: Bɛnaya nun Abiyatari xa di Yehoyada naxa findi Axitofeli ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Yowaba naxa findi sɔɔrie xa mangɛ xungbe ra.

sentences.english: And David got together at Jerusalem all the rulers of Israel, the chiefs of the tribes and the captains of the divisions waiting on the king in turn, and the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds and the controllers of all the goods and property of the king and his sons, with the unsexed servants and the great men of war.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Isirayila xunyie birin malan Darisalamu, bɔnsɔɛ xunyie, sɔɔri xundɛe xunyie, mixi wulu nun mixi kɛmɛ xunyie, mangɛ xa naafuli mɛɛnimae, mangɛ xa xurusee mɛɛnimae, mangɛ xa die mɛɛnimae, mangɛ xa denbaya mɛɛnimae, xɛmɛ gbangbalanyie, nun kuntigi birin.

sentences.english: Then David the king got up and said, Give ear to me, my brothers and my people; it was my desire to put up a house, a resting-place for the ark of the Lord's agreement, and for the foot-rest of our God; and I had got material ready for the building of it.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda naxa ti, a a masen e bɛ, «N ngaxakerenyie nun n ma ɲama, wo wo tuli mati n na. Natɛ nu na n bɛ, n xa banxi ti Alatala xa saatɛ kankira dɔxɔma dɛnnaxɛ, naxan nɔma findide won Marigi Ala lude ra. Na kui, n bara na wali fɔlɔ.»

sentences.english: But God said to me, You are not to be the builder of a house for my name, because you are a man of war and have taken life;
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ Ala naxa a masen n bɛ ‹I mu banxi tima n bɛ n luma dɛnnaxɛ, barima yihadila nan i ra. I bara adamadie faxa.›

sentences.english: Though the Lord, the God of Israel, took me out of all my father's family, to be king over Israel for ever, marking out Judah to be chief, and, of the people of Judah, my father's family; and among the sons of my father he was pleased to make me king over all Israel;
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Alatala n tan nan sugandixi n baba xa mixi birin tagi, n xa findi Isirayila mangɛ ra abadan, barima a Yuda nan sugandixi a xa findi xunyi ra, a n baba xa denbaya sugandi Yuda bɔnsɔɛ birin tagi. N baba xa die birin ya ma, a n tan nan sugandixi, n xa findi Isirayila mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And of all my sons (for the Lord has given me a great number of sons) he has made selection of Solomon to take his place on the seat of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.
sentences.susu: N ma di xɛmɛ wuyaxie tagi, Ala naxee fixi n ma, a n ma di Sulemani nan sugandixi Isirayila mangɛ ra, Alatala xa mangɛya bun ma.»

sentences.english: And he said to me, Solomon your son will be the builder of my house and the open spaces round it; for I have taken him to be my son, and I will be his father.
sentences.susu: «Ala naxa a masen n bɛ ‹I xa di Sulemani nan n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi nun a tɛtɛ tima, barima n bara a sugandi n ma di ra, n tan yɛtɛ yati nan findima a baba ra.

sentences.english: I will keep his kingdom in its place for ever, if he is strong at all times to do my orders and keep my rules, as at this day.
sentences.susu: N fama a xa mangɛya rasabatide abadan, xa a n ma yaamarie nun n ma sɛriyɛe rabatuma alɔ a na rabafe ki naxɛ to.›»

sentences.english: So now, before the eyes of all Israel, the people of the Lord, and in the hearing of our God, keep and be true to the orders of the Lord your God; so that you may have this good land for yourselves and give it for a heritage to your children after you for ever.
sentences.susu: «To lɔxɔɛ, n bara a fala won Marigi Ala ya xɔri Isirayilaka birin bɛ, Alatala xa ɲama, wo xa wo Marigi Alatala xa sɛriyɛ birin nabatu. Wo xa na natɛ tongo Ala ya xɔri naxan wo xui birin namɛma. Wo xa na raba alako wo xa yi bɔxi fanyi masɔtɔ, a xa findi kɛ ra wo xa die bɛ naxee fama wo xanbi ra abadan.

sentences.english: And you, Solomon my son, get knowledge of the God of your father, and be his servant with a true heart and with a strong desire, for the Lord is the searcher of all hearts, and has knowledge of all the designs of men's thoughts; if you make search for him, he will be near you; but if you are turned away from him, he will give you up for ever.
sentences.susu: N ma di Sulemani, i xa i baba Marigi Alatala kolon, a naxan batuma. I fan xa a batu i bɔɲɛ nun i ɲanige birin na, barima Alatala a kolon naxan na sondonyi birin kui. A adama ɲanige birin kolon. Xa i Alatala fen, a tinma nɛ i xa a to. Kɔnɔ xa i a rabɛɲin, a fan i rabɛɲinma nɛ kerenyi ra.

sentences.english: Now then, take note; for the Lord has made selection of you to be the builder of a house for the holy place. Be strong and do it.
sentences.susu: I xa a mato, Alatala bara i sugandi, alako i xa a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ti. I xa limaniya, i xa na wali suxu.»

sentences.english: Then David gave to his son Solomon the design of the doorway of the house of God and of its houses and its store-houses, and the higher rooms and the inner rooms and the place for the mercy-seat;
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ti ki tagi raba Sulemani bɛ, a tɛtɛ, a rabilinyi banxie, naafuli yire, konkoe itexie, konkoe gbɛtɛe, nun saatɛ kankira dɔxɔde.

sentences.english: And the design of all he had in his heart for the outer squares of the house of the Lord, and for the rooms all round it, and for the store-houses of the house of the Lord, and for the store-houses for the holy things;
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa fe birin masen a xa di bɛ naxan nu na a xaxili ma Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi tife ra, alɔ tɛtɛ, konkoe, naafuli yire, nun se sɛniyɛnxie yire.

sentences.english: And for the divisions of the priests and Levites, and for all the work in connection with the worship of the house of the Lord, and all the vessels used in the house of the Lord;
sentences.susu: A man naxa a tagi raba a bɛ sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae itaxunma ki naxɛ, a nun e walima ki naxɛ Alatala xa banxi kui. A naxa se birin masen a bɛ naxan nawalima Alatala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: Of gold, by weight, for the vessels of gold, for all the vessels of different uses; and silver for all the vessels of silver by weight, for vessels of different uses;
sentences.susu: A naxa wali se xɛɛma daaxie nun gbeti daaxie xa binyɛ xasabi masen a bɛ.

sentences.english: And gold by weight for the light-supports and the vessels for the lights, the weight of gold needed for every support and every vessel for lights; and for the silver light-supports, the weight of silver needed for every support and for the different vessels as every one was to be used;
sentences.susu: A naxa lanpui dɔxɔsee nun lanpuie xa binyɛ xasabi masen a bɛ, naxee yailanma xɛɛma ra a nun naxee yailanma gbeti ra.

sentences.english: And gold by weight for the tables for the holy bread for every table, and silver for the silver tables;
sentences.susu: A naxa xɛɛma nun gbeti binyɛ xasabi masen a bɛ naxan yailanma teebilie ra sɛrɛxɛ taami sama naxee fari.

sentences.english: Clear gold for the meat-hooks and the basins and the cups; for the gold basins, gold enough by weight for every basin; and silver by weight for every silver basin;
sentences.susu: A naxa yirabase xɛɛma nun gbeti daaxi mɔɔli birin xa binyɛ xasabi masen a bɛ.

sentences.english: And the best gold for the altar of perfumes; and gold for the design of the carriage, for the winged ones whose wings were outstretched covering the ark of the Lord's agreement.
sentences.susu: A naxa surayi sɛrɛxɛbade xɛɛma daaxi xa binyɛ xasabi masen a bɛ, a nun na yailan ki. A naxa a masen a bɛ na mangɛ ragise nun na malekɛ sawurɛ xɛɛma daaxie, naxee gabutenyie italaxi Alatala xa saatɛ kankira xun ma, nee yailanma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: All this, said David, the design for all these things, has been made dear to me in writing by the hand of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala a bɛ, «Alatala nan yi birin sɛbɛxi. N naxan masenxi i bɛ a fatanxi a xaxili nan na.»

sentences.english: And David said to his son Solomon, Be strong and of a good heart and do your work; have no fear and do not be troubled, for the Lord God, my God, is with you; he will not give you up, and his face will not be turned away from you, till all the work necessary for the house of the Lord is complete.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala a xa di Sulemani bɛ, «I sɛnbɛ so, i xa limaniya. Wali suxu. I naxa gaaxu fefe ma, barima n Marigi Alatala na i sɛɛti ma. A mu i rabɛɲinma. A mu i raboloma han i gɛ a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi wali birin na.

sentences.english: And see, there are the divisions of the priests and Levites for all the work of the house of God; and every trained and expert workman will be ready to do for you whatever is needed; and the captains and the people will be under your orders in everything.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nun Lewika xundɛ birin na i xanbi ra Ala xa banxi xa wali xa fe ra. Walikɛ mɔɔli birin na naa naxee fata wali ra. Kuntigie nun ɲama fan e tuli matima i xa yaamari birin na.»

sentences.english: And David the king said to all the people, Solomon my son, the only one who has been marked out by God, is still young and untested, and the work is great, for this great house is not for man, but for the Lord God.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda naxa a fala ɲama birin bɛ, «N ma di Sulemani, Ala naxan sugandixi, a mu gɛxi mɔde, a sɛnbɛ mu gbo sinden. Wali naxan na be, a gbo, barima banxi xa mu a ra naxan tima mixi bɛ. A tima Alatala nan bɛ.

sentences.english: Now as far as I am able, I have made ready what is needed for the house of my God; the gold for the things of gold, and the silver for the silver things, and the brass for the brass things, iron for the things of iron, and wood for the things of wood; beryls and jewels to be framed, and stones of different colours for ornament; all sorts of stones of great price, and polished building-stone, as much as is needed and more.
sentences.susu: N bara n sɛnbɛ birin sa n Marigi Ala sagoe a xa banxi tife ra. N bara xɛɛma, gbeti, yɔxui, wure, wuri, gɛmɛ tofanyi, diyaman mɔɔli birin, nun gɛmɛ fiixɛ gbegbe malan, alako e xa rawali e rawali ki ma.

sentences.english: And because this house of God is dear to me, I give my private store of gold and silver to the house of my God, in addition to all I have got ready for the holy house;
sentences.susu: Dangi na ra, n bara n harige birin, xɛɛma nun gbeti, fi n Marigi Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa fe ra, barima yi wali tide gbo n bɛ.

sentences.english: Even three thousand talents of gold of Ophir and seven thousand talents of the best silver, for plating the walls of the house:
sentences.susu: N harige nan ya: xɛɛma Ofiri daaxi kilo wulu kɛmɛ wulu firin, gbeti fanyi kilo wulu kɛmɛ firin tongo saxan nun solomasaxan. Na findima banxi yiree maso se nan na.

sentences.english: Gold for the gold things, and silver for the silver things, and for every sort of work to be done by the expert workmen. Who then will come forward, offering himself this day for the Lord's work?
sentences.susu: Xɛɛma nun gbeti birin xa rawali a rawali ki ma, alako walikɛe xa wali xa sɔɔnɛya. Yakɔsi, nde bara ɲanige nde tongo Alatala bɛ to?»

sentences.english: Then the heads of families and the chiefs of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the controllers of the king's business, freely gave themselves;
sentences.susu: Denbaya xunyie, Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ kuntigie, mixi wulu nun mixi kɛmɛ xunyie, nun mangɛ xa wali xunyie naxa ɲanige tongo yi wali xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And they gave for the use of the house of the Lord, five thousand talents and ten thousand darics of gold, and ten thousand talents of silver, and eighteen thousand talents of brass, and a hundred thousand talents of iron.
sentences.susu: E naxa yi harige xasabi fi Ala xa banxi xa fe ra: xɛɛma, kilo wulu kɛmɛ tongo solofere, gbeti kilo wulu kɛmɛ saxan tongo naani, yɔxui kilo wulu kɛmɛ senni fu nun firin, a nun wure kilo miliyɔn saxan wulu kɛmɛ naani.

sentences.english: And those who had stones of great price gave them to the store of the house of the Lord, under the care of Jehiel the Gershonite.
sentences.susu: Birin naxa gɛmɛ tofanyie so Yɛxiyɛli Gerisonka yi ra, naxan nu naafuli ragatama Alatala xa banxi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Then the people were glad because their offerings were freely given, for with a true heart they freely gave what they had to the Lord; and David the king was full of joy.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa sɛɛwa e ɲanige xa fe ra, barima e na rabaxi e bɔɲɛ birin nan na Alatala bɛ. Mangɛ Dawuda fan naxa sɛɛwa na xa fe ra.

sentences.english: So David gave praise to the Lord before all the people; and David said, Praise be to you, O Lord the God of Israel, our father for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa Alatala tantu ɲama birin ya xɔri. A naxa a fala, «Muxu benba Isirayila Marigi Alatala, tantui na i bɛ abadan.

sentences.english: Yours, O Lord, is the strength and the power and the glory, and the authority and the honour: for everything in heaven and on earth is yours; yours is the kingdom, O Lord, and you are lifted up as head over all.
sentences.susu: Alatala, binyɛ, sɛnbɛ, nun matɔxɔɛ birin na i bɛ. Se naxan birin na koore nun bɔxi ma, i tan nan gbe a ra. Duniɲa birin na i tan nan xa mangɛya bun ma.

sentences.english: Wealth and honour come from you, and you are ruler over all, and in your hand is power and strength; it is in your power to make great, and to give strength to all.
sentences.susu: Bannaya nun xunnakeli fatanxi i tan nan na. I se birin yamarima, sɛnbɛ birin na i yi ra. I keren nan nɔma mixi gbode, i keren nan nɔma a rasabatide.»

sentences.english: So now, our God, we give you praise, honouring the glory of your name.
sentences.susu: «Muxu Marigi Ala, to, muxu bara i tantu, muxu bara i xili makaabaxi matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: But who am I and what is my people, that we have power to give so freely in this way? for all things come from you, and what we have given you is yours.
sentences.susu: N tan nun n ma ɲama sɛnbɛ mu nɔma yi harige mɔɔli sɔtɔde. A birin kelima i tan nan ma. Muxu tan mu sese fima, i tan singe mu naxan fixi muxu ma.

sentences.english: For we, as all our fathers were, are like men from a strange country before you, who have got a place for a time in the land; our days on the earth are like a shade, and there is no hope of going on.
sentences.susu: Muxu luma alɔ xɔɲɛe i ya i, alɔ muxu benbae. Muxu xa simaya luxi nɛ yi bɛndɛ fuɲi fari alɔ niini naxan minima a mu bu a lɔɛ. Xaxili tide yo mu na muxu bɛ.

sentences.english: O Lord our God, all this store, which we have made ready for the building of a house for your holy name, comes from your hand and is yours.
sentences.susu: Muxu Marigi Alatala, yi harige fanyi birin kelima i tan nan ma, muxu naxan xunlanxi alako muxu xa banxi ti i xili sɛniyɛnxi bɛ. I tan nan gbe na a birin na.»

sentences.english: And I am conscious, my God, that you are the searcher of hearts, taking pleasure in righteousness. As for me, with an upright heart I have freely given all these things; and I have seen with joy your people who are here to make their offerings freely to you.
sentences.susu: «N Marigi Ala, n a kolon i bɔɲɛ birin kolon, tinxinyi man rafan i ma. N yi sɛrɛxɛ ɲanigexi i bɛ n bɔɲɛ tinxinxi nan na. N man bara a to, i xa ɲama fan sɛrɛxɛ fixi i ma a tan ɲanige kerenyi nan kui e sɛɛwaxi ra.

sentences.english: O Lord, the God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this for ever in the deepest thoughts of your people, and let their hearts be fixed and true to you;
sentences.susu: Muxu babae Iburahima, Isiyaga, Isirayila Marigi Alatala, i xa yi xaxili rasabati i xa ɲama bɔɲɛ kui, alako e naxa i yanfa.

sentences.english: And give to Solomon my son a true heart, to keep your orders, your rules, and your laws, and to do all these things, and to put up this great house for which I have made ready.
sentences.susu: N ma di Sulemani mali alako a fan xa bira i xa yaamari, i xa xaranyi, nun i xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra a bɔɲɛ birin na. A man xa yi banxi ti n naxan fɔlɔxi yi ki.»

sentences.english: And David said to all the people, Now give praise to the Lord your God. And all the people gave praise to the Lord, the God of their fathers, with bent heads worshipping the Lord and the king.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa a fala ɲama birin bɛ, «Wo wo Marigi Alatala tantu.» Ɲama naxa e babae Marigi Alatala tantu, e fa e igoro, e e felen Alatala bɛ mangɛ ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And they made offerings to the Lord, and gave burned offerings to the Lord, on the day after, a thousand oxen, a thousand sheep, and a thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and a great wealth of offerings for all Israel.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ kuye iba, Isirayila naxa sɛrɛxɛe nun sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi gbegbe ba Alatala bɛ: tuura wulu keren, yɛxɛɛ kontonyi wulu keren, yɛxɛɛ lanma wulu keren, wɛni sɛrɛxɛ, a nun sɛrɛxɛ gbɛtɛe.

sentences.english: And with great joy they made a feast before the Lord that day. And they made Solomon, the son of David, king a second time, putting the holy oil on him to make him holy to the Lord as ruler, and on Zadok as priest.
sentences.susu: E naxa e dɛge na lɔxɔɛ, e e min Alatala ya i ɲɛlɛxinyi belebele kui. E man naxa Dawuda xa di Sulemani ti mangɛ ra a sanmaya firin nde. E naxa ture sa a xunyi ma Alatala ya i, a xa findi e xa yarerati ra. E naxa Sadɔki fan ti sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra.

sentences.english: So Solomon was put on the seat of the Lord as king in place of his father David, and everything went well for him; and all Israel was under his authority.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa dɔxɔ Alatala xa mangɛ kibanyi kui, a findi mangɛ ra a baba Dawuda ɲɔxɔɛ ra. A naxa xunnakeli sɔtɔ, Isirayila birin naxa a xa yaamari rabatu.

sentences.english: And all the chiefs and the men of war and all the sons of King David put themselves under the authority of Solomon the king.
sentences.susu: Kuntigie, sɔɔrie, nun mangɛ Dawuda xa die birin naxa tin lude mangɛ Sulemani xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord made Solomon great in the eyes of all Israel, clothing him with glory and honour such as no other king in Israel had had before him.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Sulemani xa fe ite Isirayilaka birin ya xɔri. A naxa a xa mangɛya ite dangi Isirayila mangɛ singee birin na.

sentences.english: Now David, the son of Jesse, was king over all Israel.
sentences.susu: Yisayi xa di Dawuda naxa mangɛya raba Isirayila birin xun na.

sentences.english: For forty years he was ruling as king over Israel, seven years in Hebron and thirty-three years in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: A ɲɛ tongo naani mangɛya nan naba. A ɲɛ solofere raba Xebiron, a ɲɛ tongo saxan nun saxan naba Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And he came to his end after a long life, full of days and great wealth and honour; and Solomon his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: A naxa simaya fanyi kamalixi sɔtɔ, a laaxiraya foriɲa fanyi nun sɛɛwɛ kui. Harige kanyi nan nu a ra, a xili fan nu gbo. A xa di Sulemani nan ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Now all the acts of David, first and last, are recorded in the words of Samuel the seer, and the words of Nathan the prophet, and the words of Gad the seer;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dawuda naxan nabaxi, a fɔlɛ nun a raɲɔnyi, na birin sɛbɛxi Annabi Samuweli, Annabi Natan, nun Annabi Gadi xa kitaabuie kui.

sentences.english: Together with all his rule and his power, and the events which took place in his time, in Israel and in all the kingdoms of other lands.
sentences.susu: Yi kitaabuie a xa mangɛya fanyi xa fe falama, naxan dangixi a xa waxati Isirayila bɔxi ma nun bɔxi gbɛtɛe ma.

sentences.english: And Solomon, the son of David, made himself strong in his kingdom, and the Lord his God was with him, and made him very great.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa di Sulemani xa mangɛya nu mabanbanxi a fanyi ra, barima a Marigi Alatala nu na a sɛɛti ma, a nu a xa fe mate.

sentences.english: And Solomon sent word to all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds and to the judges and to every chief in all Israel, heads of their families.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Sulemani naxa Isirayila ɲama birin xili, mixi wulu xunyie, mixi kɛmɛ xunyie, kiitisae, Isirayila yareratie, a nun denbaya xunyi birin.

sentences.english: Then Solomon, and all the men of Israel with him, went to the high place at Gibeon, because the Tent of meeting of God, which Moses, the servant of the Lord, had made in the waste land, was there.
sentences.susu: Sulemani nun ɲama naxa siga Gabayon, yire itexi Kiri Banxi Naralande nu na dɛnnaxɛ, Alatala xa konyi Munsa nu bara naxan yailan gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: But the ark of God had been moved by David from Kiriath-jearim to the place which he had made ready for it, for he had put up a tent for it at Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nu bara Alatala xa saatɛ kankira tan xanin Darisalamu, a a dɔxɔ kiri banxi nde kui a nu bara naxan ti. Singe, na kankira nu na Kiriyati Yeyarimi nɛ.

sentences.english: And the altar of brass which Bezalel, the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, was there before the Tent of the Lord; and Solomon and all the people went to give worship there.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛbade yɔxui daaxi, Uri xa di Bɛsalɛli, Xuru xa mamadi, nu bara naxan yailan, na nu na Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira ya ra. Sulemani nun ɲama naxa siga Alatala waxɔnfe fende mɛnni.

sentences.english: And Solomon went up there to the brass altar before the Lord at the Tent of meeting, offering on it a thousand burned offerings.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa te na sɛrɛxɛbade yɔxui daaxi fɛ ma, Alatala ya xɔri, Kiri Banxi Naralande na dɛnnaxɛ, a fa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi wulu keren ba.

sentences.english: In that night God came to Solomon in a vision, and said to him, Say what I am to give you.
sentences.susu: Na kɔɛ ra, Ala naxa mini Sulemani ma, a a masen a bɛ, «I wama se naxan xɔn, a fala n bɛ, n xa a fi i ma.»

sentences.english: And Solomon said to God, Great was your mercy to David my father, and you have made me king in his place.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa Ala yaabi, «I bara hinnɛ n baba Dawuda ra, i bara n ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Now, O Lord God, let your word to David my father come true; for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in number.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, n Marigi Alatala, i naxan masen n baba Dawuda bɛ, i xa a rakamali, barima i bara n ti ɲama xun ma naxan gbo alɔ xube.

sentences.english: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, so that I may go out and come in before this people: for who is able to be the judge of this great people of yours?
sentences.susu: N bara i maxandi yakɔsi, i xa lɔnni nun fe kolonyi fi n ma, alako n xa nɔ yi ɲama raɲɛrɛde. Xa na mu a ra nde nɔma yi ɲama gbegbe raɲɛrɛde?»

sentences.english: And God said to Solomon, Because this was in your heart, and you did not make request for money, property, or honour, or for the destruction of your haters, or for long life; but you have made request for wisdom and knowledge for yourself, so that you may be the judge of my people over whom I have made you king:
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen Sulemani bɛ, «Yi nan faxi i sondonyi ma. I mu bannaya maxandi, xa na mu a ra naafuli, xa na mu a ra binyɛ. I mu n maxandi n xa i xɔnnantee faxa. I mu n maxandi n xa i xa simaya xɔn nakuya. I lɔnni nun fe kolonyi nan maxandixi, alako i xa n ma ɲama raɲɛrɛ, n i tixi naxee xun ma.

sentences.english: Wisdom and knowledge are given to you; and I will give you wealth and honour, such as no king has had before you or ever will have after you.
sentences.susu: Na na a ra n bara i xa maxandi suxu. N lɔnni nun fe kolonyi fima nɛ i ma, n man bannaya, naafuli, nun binyɛ sama na fari dangife mangɛ birin na naxee singe ti a nun naxee tima i dangi xanbi.»

sentences.english: So Solomon went back from the high place at Gibeon, from before the Tent of meeting, to Jerusalem; and he was king over Israel.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Sulemani naxa keli Gabayon yire itexi, Kiri Banxi Naralande nu na dɛnnaxɛ, a gbilen Darisalamu, a Isirayila raɲɛrɛ.

sentences.english: And Solomon got together war-carriages and horsemen; he had one thousand, four hundred carriages and twelve thousand horsemen, which he kept, some in the carriage-towns and some with the king at Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa sɔɔri ragisee nun soe ragie malan. Sɔɔri ragise wulu keren kɛmɛ naani, nun soe ragi wulu fu nun firin nan nu na mangataa ra Darisalamu nun taa makantaxi gbɛtɛe kui.

sentences.english: And the king made silver and gold as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedar like the sycamore-trees of the lowland in number.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a niya gbeti nun xɛɛma xa wuya Darisalamu dangife gɛmɛ xɔri ra. Wuri fanyi naxan xili sɛdiri, na naxa wuya dangife sikomoro wuri ra naxee na Sefela bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Solomon's horses came out of Egypt; the king's traders got them from Kue at a price.
sentences.susu: Sulemani nu soe sarama Misira nun Kowa bɔxi nan ma. Mangɛ xa yulɛe nan nu sigama e sarade a bɛ.

sentences.english: A war-carriage might be got from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for a hundred and fifty: they got them at the same rate for all the kings of the Hittites and the kings of Aram.
sentences.susu: E sɔɔri ragise sara gbeti kilo solofere ra, e soe sara gbeti kilo keren nun a tagi ra. E na mɔɔli sara Xiti nun Siriya mangɛe fan bɛ.

sentences.english: Now it was Solomon's purpose to put up a house for the name of the Lord and a house for himself as king.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa xɛmɛ wulu tongo solofere yamari e xa findi kote xaninyie ra. A man naxa xɛmɛ wulu tongo solomasaxan tongo gɛmɛ masolie ra, naxee walima geya ma. A man naxa xɛmɛ wulu saxan kɛmɛ senni sɔtɔ wali xunyie ra.

sentences.english: And Solomon had seventy thousand men numbered for transport, and eighty thousand for cutting stone in the mountains, and three thousand, six hundred as overseers.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa xɛɛra xɛɛ Tire mangɛ Xirami xɔn, a xa sa a fala a bɛ, «Tɛmui dangixi i bara sɛdiri wuri rasanba n baba Dawuda ma alako a xa a xa banxi ti.

sentences.english: And Solomon sent to Huram, king of Tyre, saying, As you did for my father David, sending him cedar-trees for the building of his house,
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n fafe hɔrɔmɔbanxi tide n Marigi Alatala bɛ, sɛrɛxɛe bama dɛnnaxɛ. Mɛnni surayi fama gande sɛrɛxɛ ra, taami sɛrɛxɛ sama teebili ma Ala bɛ, sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi bama gɛɛsɛgɛ nun nunmare birin, sali rabama malabui lɔxɔɛe ra, kike nɛɛnɛe ra, nun sali xungbee ra. Yi sɛriyɛ mu kanama Isirayila bɔxi ma abadan.

sentences.english: See! I am building a house for the name of the Lord my God, to be made holy to him, where perfumes of sweet spices will be burned before him, and the holy bread will be placed at all times, and burned offerings will be offered morning and evening, on the Sabbaths and at the new moons, and on the regular feasts of the Lord our God. This is a law for ever to Israel.
sentences.susu: N hɔrɔmɔbanxi naxan tima, a lan a xa findi banxi xungbe nan na, barima muxu Marigi Ala dangi alae birin na.

sentences.english: And the house which I am building is to be great, for our God is greater than all gods.
sentences.susu: Nde nɔma banxi tide Ala bɛ, naxan xa gboe dangima koore xa gboe ra? N tan naxan ya, n mu nɔma hɔrɔmɔbanxi tide a bɛ. N nɔma naxan gbansan na, n yire nde yailanma sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi bama a bɛ dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: But who may have strength enough to make a house for him, seeing that the heaven and the heaven of heavens are not wide enough to be his resting-place? who am I then to make a house for him? But I am building it only for the burning of perfume before him.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi, mixi fanyi nde rasanba n ma, naxan fata xɛɛma, gbeti, yɔxui, nun wure rawalide. A xa fata gɛsɛ gbeeli nun a fɔɔrɛ rawalide, a man xa fata se masolide. A xa fa Yudaya nun Darisalamu, a xa kafu n ma walikɛ fanyie ma, n baba Dawuda naxee sugandixi.

sentences.english: So now send me an expert worker in gold and silver and brass and iron? in purple and red and blue, and in the cutting of all sorts of ornament, to be with the expert workmen who are here in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom my father David got together.
sentences.susu: I xa Liban wuri bilie rasanba n ma alɔ sɛdiri, sipirɛ, nun santali. N a kolon i xa walikɛe fata Liban wuri bolonde. N ma walikɛe fan sigama nɛ e malide.

sentences.english: And send me cedar-trees, cypress-trees and sandal-wood from Lebanon, for, to my knowledge, your servants are expert wood-cutters in Lebanon; and my servants will be with yours,
sentences.susu: E wuri gbegbe fenma nɛ n bɛ, barima n hɔrɔmɔbanxi naxan tima, a lanma a xa xungbo, a xa tofan.

sentences.english: To get trees for me in great numbers, for the house which I am building is to be great and a wonder.
sentences.susu: N sare naxan fima i xa wuri bolonyie ma na nan ya: mɛngi maniyɛ busali wulu tongo solomasaxan, fundenyi maniyɛ busali wulu tongo solomasaxan, wɛni fifa wulu suuli, nun ture fifa wulu suuli.»

sentences.english: And I will give as food to your servants, the wood-cutters, twenty thousand measures of grain, and twenty thousand measures of barley and twenty thousand measures of wine and twenty thousand measures of oil.
sentences.susu: Tire mangɛ Xirami naxa Sulemani yaabi bataaxɛ ra, «Alatala nan i tixi mangɛ ra a xa xanunteya xa fe ra a xa ɲama bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then Huram, king of Tyre, sent Solomon an answer in writing, saying, Because of his love for his people the Lord has made you king over them.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a fala, «Tantui na Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ, naxan koore nun bɔxi daaxi. A bara di xɛmɛ fi Dawuda ma naxan xa lɔnni nun xaxili gbo, naxan nɔma banxi tide Alatala bɛ a nun mangɛ banxi a yɛtɛ kan bɛ.

sentences.english: And Huram said, Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, maker of heaven and earth, who has given to David the king a wise son, full of wisdom and good sense, to be the builder of a house for the Lord and a house for himself as king.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, n bara Xuramabi xɛɛ i yire. A fata walide ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And now I am sending you a wise and expert man, Huram who is as my father,
sentences.susu: A nga kelixi Dana bɔnsɔɛ nɛ, Tireka nan na a baba ra. A fata xɛɛma, gbeti, yɔxui, wure, gɛmɛ, nun wuri rawalide, a nun gɛsɛ gbeeli nun a fɔɔrɛ rawalide. A dugie kolon. A fata se birin masolide i wama naxee xɔn. A kafuma i xa walikɛe ma wali kui, a nun n marigi i baba Dawuda xa walikɛe ma.

sentences.english: The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan, whose father was a man of Tyre, an expert worker in gold and silver and brass and iron, in stone and wood, in purple and blue and fair linen and red, trained in the cutting of every sort of ornament and the invention of every sort of design; let him be given a place among your expert workmen and those of my lord, your father David.
sentences.susu: I naxan fala mɛngi maniyɛ, fundenyi maniyɛ, ture, nun wɛni xa fe ra, i xa na raba.

sentences.english: So now let my lord send to his servants the grain and the oil and the wine as my lord has said;
sentences.susu: I wama Liban wuri xasabi naxan xɔn ma, muxu na sɛgɛma nɛ, muxu man e maxaninma nɛ kunkuie kui baa ma han Yafa. Mɛnni i nɔma e ratede Darisalamu.»

sentences.english: And we will have wood cut from Lebanon, as much as you have need of, and will send it to you on flat boats by sea to Joppa, and from there you may take it up to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa mixie kɔnti naxee nu na Isirayila bɔxi ma, kɔnɔ e mu findi Isirayilakae ra. A baba Dawuda fan nu bara na mɔɔli raba. Na mixi xasabi nu lanxi mixi wulu kɛmɛ tongo suuli nun saxan kɛmɛ senni nan ma.

sentences.english: Then Solomon took the number of all the men from strange lands who were living in Israel, as his father David had done; there were a hundred and fifty-three thousand, six hundred.
sentences.susu: Yi mixie ya ma a naxa xɛmɛ wulu tongo solofere yamari e xa findi kote xaninyie ra. A man naxa xɛmɛ wulu tongo solomasaxan tongo gɛmɛ masolie ra, naxee walima geya ma. A man naxa xɛmɛ wulu saxan kɛmɛ senni sɔtɔ wali xunyie ra naxee mixie rawalima.

sentences.english: Then Solomon made a start at building the house of the Lord on Mount Moriah in Jerusalem, where the Lord had been seen by his father David, in the place which David had made ready in the grain-floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa Alatala xa banxi ti fɔlɔ Darisalamu, Moriya geya fari, a baba Dawuda dɛnnaxɛ sugandi, Yebusuka Oronan xa lonyi fari.

sentences.english: The building was started in the second month in the fourth year of his rule.
sentences.susu: A naxa wali fɔlɔ a xa mangɛya ɲɛ naani, kike firin, xi firin nde lɔxɔɛ ma.

sentences.english: And Solomon put the base of the house of God in position; by the older measure it was sixty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.
sentences.susu: Sulemani Ala xa banxi ti yi xasabi nan na: A xa kuyɛ nɔngɔn ya tongo senni, a xa gboe nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn.

sentences.english: And the covered way in front of the house was twenty cubits long, as wide as the house, and a hundred and twenty cubits high, all plated inside with the best gold.
sentences.susu: A yatagi buntunyi xa gboe nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn, alɔ banxi xa gboe na ki naxɛ. A xa maite fan findi nɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nan na. Sulemani naxa a kui birin yailan xɛɛma tinse ra.

sentences.english: And the greater house was roofed with cypress-wood, plated with the best gold and ornamented with designs of palm-trees and chains.
sentences.susu: A naxa banxi kui banban sipirɛ wuri ra, a fa e raxunma xɛɛma tinse ra, tugi fɛnsɛ dɛnbɛxi masolixi e ma.

sentences.english: And the house was made beautiful with stones of great value, and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
sentences.susu: A man naxa e raxunma gɛmɛ tofanyie ra, a nun xɛɛma ra naxan keli Parawayimi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: All the house was plated with gold, the supports, the steps, the walls and the doors; and the walls were ornamented with designs of winged ones.
sentences.susu: A naxa banxi birin maso xɛɛma ra, a a maso banxi kinkie ma, naadɛe ma, naadɛ gbanyie ma, nun a sɛɛtie ma. A man naxa malekɛ misaali yailan banxi kankee ma.

sentences.english: And he made the most holy place; it was twenty cubits long, and twenty cubits wide, like the greater house, and was plated all over with the best gold; six hundred talents were used for it.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante ti. A xa kuyɛ nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn, alɔ hɔrɔmɔbanxi fan xa gboe to findixi nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn na. A naxa a maso xɛɛma tinse fanyi ra naxan xasabi nu lanxi kilo kɛmɛ firin kilo naani ma.

sentences.english: And fifty shekels weight of gold was used for the nails. He had all the higher rooms plated with gold.
sentences.susu: A naxa xɛɛma kilo senni findi lantuma ra. A man naxa konkoe fan naxunma xɛɛma ra naxee na koore.

sentences.english: And in the most holy place he made images of two winged beings, covering them with gold.
sentences.susu: A naxa malekɛ firin yailan yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante kui bafata raxunuxi ra, a fa a maso xɛɛma ra.

sentences.english: Their outstretched wings were twenty cubits across; one wing, five cubits long, touching the wall of the house, and the other, of the same size, meeting the wing of the other winged one.
sentences.susu: Malekɛe gabutenyie xa kuyɛ nu lanxi nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn nan ma. Malekɛ singe kɔɔla gabutenyi xa kuyɛ nɔngɔn ya suuli, a yire sɛniyɛnxi sɛɛti lixi. A yirefanyi gabutenyi boore malekɛ gabutenyi lixi. Na gabutenyi fan lanxi nɔngɔn ya suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: And in the same way, the wings of the other, five cubits long, were stretched out, one touching the wall and the other meeting the wing of the first winged one.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ firin nde yirefanyi gabutenyi xa kuyɛ nɔngɔn ya suuli, a yire sɛniyɛnxi sɛɛti lixi. A kɔɔla gabutenyi boore malekɛ gabutenyi lixi.

sentences.english: Their outstretched wings were twenty cubits across; they were placed upright on their feet, facing the inner part of the house.
sentences.susu: Na malekɛ firinyi gabutenyie xa kuyɛ nu lanxi nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn nan ma. E tixi e sanyie xun na, e yatagi rafindixi banxi ma.

sentences.english: And he made the veil of blue and purple and red, of the best linen, worked with winged ones.
sentences.susu: A naxa dugi tofanyi gbaku na, naxan nagbeelixi nun a rafɔɔrɔxi, malekɛ pirintie masɔxɔxi a ma.

sentences.english: And in front of the house he made two pillars, thirty-five cubits high, with crowns on the tops of them, five cubits high.
sentences.susu: A naxa gɛmɛ firin ti banxi yatagi, e xa maite nɔngɔn ya tongo saxan nun suuli. E xuntagie masolixi, na masoli xa kuyɛ nɔngɔn ya suuli.

sentences.english: And he made chains, like neck ornaments, and put them on the tops of the pillars, and a hundred apples on the chains.
sentences.susu: Na gɛmɛ xuntagi masolixie maniya luuti dɛnbɛxie ra, kɔɔbɛ bogi maniyɛ kɛmɛ rafalaxi gbakuxi e ra.

sentences.english: He put up the pillars in front of the Temple, one on the right side and one on the left, naming the one on the right Jachin and that on the left Boaz.
sentences.susu: A naxa na gɛmɛ firinyi ti banxi yatagi, keren na kɔɔla ma, boore na yirefanyi ma. Naxan na yirefanyi ma na xili Yakin, naxan na kɔɔla ma na xili Boosu.

sentences.english: Then he made a brass altar, twenty cubits long, twenty cubits wide and ten cubits high.
sentences.susu: A naxa yɔxui sɛrɛxɛbade yailan, naxan xa kuyɛ nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn lima, a igboe nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn, a ite nɔngɔn ya fu.

sentences.english: And he made the great water-vessel of metal, round in form, measuring ten cubits across from edge to edge; it was five cubits high and thirty cubits round.
sentences.susu: A naxa ye sase xungbe digilinxi yailan yɔxui ra. A dɛ xa maigboe nɔngɔn ya fu, a ite nɔngɔn ya suuli, a xa maradigilinyi nɔngɔn ya tongo saxan.

sentences.english: And under it was a design of flowers all round it, ten to a cubit, circling the water-vessel in two lines; they were made from liquid metal at the same time as the water-vessel.
sentences.susu: Na ye sase dɛ rabilinyi bunyi masolixi maniya ningee ra, naxee dɔxɔxi e boore ra. Ninge fu na nɔngɔn ya keren ma, suuli a fari, suuli a bun. Ningee yo, ye sase yo, na birin yailanxi a boore nan na kerenyi ra.

sentences.english: It was supported on twelve oxen, three facing to the north, three to the west, three to the south, and three to the east, the water-vessel resting on top of them; their back parts were all turned to the middle of it.
sentences.susu: Na ye sase nu dɔxɔxi ninge gbɛtɛ fu nun firin fari. Saxan ya rafindixi kɔɔla ma, saxan ya rafindixi sogegorode ma, saxan ya rafindixi yirefanyi ma, saxan ya rafindixi sogetede ma. Na ye sase naxan nu xili «Baa» nu dɔxɔxi na ningee fari, e ya rafindixi tande ma.

sentences.english: It was as thick as a man's open hand, and the edge of it was curved like the edge of a cup, like a lily flower; it would take three thousand baths.
sentences.susu: Na ye sase xa dɛ rabinyɛ suxu keren. A dɛ kiri masolixi maniya sansi fuge tofanyi ra. Ye fifa kɛmɛ solofere fifa tongo suuli nu nɔma sade a kui.

sentences.english: And he made ten washing-vessels, putting five on the right side and five on the left; such things as were used in making the burned offering were washed in them; but the great water-vessel was to be used by the priests for washing themselves.
sentences.susu: A man naxa ye sase fu gbɛtɛ yailan alako e xa xuruse sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie maxa mɛnni. Suuli nu dɔxɔxi hɔrɔmɔbanxi yirefanyi ma, suuli nu dɔxɔxi a kɔɔla ma. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe tan nu e maxama ye nan na, naxan nu na na ye sase xungbe kui, naxan nu xili «Baa.»

sentences.english: And he made the ten gold supports for the lights, as directions had been given for them, and he put them in the Temple, five on the right side and five on the left.
sentences.susu: A naxa lanpui dɔxɔse fu yailan xɛɛma ra, alɔ a nu sɛbɛxi ki naxɛ. A naxa e dɔxɔ hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, suuli yirefanyi ma, suuli kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: He made ten tables, and put them in the Temple, five on the right side and five on the left. And he made a hundred gold basins.
sentences.susu: A naxa teebili fu fan yailan, a e dɔxɔ hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, suuli yirefanyi ma, suuli kɔɔla ma. A naxa pɔɔti tofanyi kɛmɛ yailan xɛɛma ra.

sentences.english: Then he made the open space for the priests, and the great open space and its doors, plating the doors with brass.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa tɛtɛ yailan, a nun tɛtɛ xungbe gbɛtɛ nun a naadɛe. A naxa naadɛe maso yɔxui ra.

sentences.english: He put the great water-vessel on the right side of the house to the east, facing south.
sentences.susu: Na ye sase digilinxi xungbe naxan xili «Baa,» a dɔxɔxi hɔrɔmɔbanxi yirefanyi sogetede biri.

sentences.english: And Huram made all the pots and the spades and the basins. So he came to the end of all the work he did for King Solomon in the house of God:
sentences.susu: Xurami naxa tundee, suxumɛe, nun pɔɔtie fan yailan. Na kui, Xurami naxa gɛ mangɛ Sulemani xa walie ra Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa fe ra. Na walie nan ya:

sentences.english: The two pillars, and the two crowns on the tops of the pillars, and the network covering the two cups of the crowns on the tops of the pillars;
sentences.susu: gɛmɛ tofanyi tixi firin, e xuntagie masolixi alɔ luuti dɛnbɛxie,

sentences.english: And the four hundred apples for the network, two lines of apples for the network covering the two cups of the crowns on the pillars.
sentences.susu: kɔɔbɛ bogi maniyɛ kɛmɛ naani gbakuxi e ra, safɛ firin na kankan xuntagi a luutie ma,

sentences.english: And he made the ten bases and the ten washing-vessels which were on the bases;
sentences.susu: ye sasee nun e dɔxɔsee,

sentences.english: The great water-vessel with the twelve oxen under it.
sentences.susu: ye sase xungbe naxan xili «Baa,» ninge fu nun firin naxee na ye sase xungbe bun ma,

sentences.english: All the pots and the spades and the meat-hooks and their vessels, which Huram, who was as his father, made for King Solomon for the house of the Lord, were of polished brass.
sentences.susu: tundee, nun suxumɛe. Yi see birin, Xuramabi naxee yailan mangɛ Sulemani bɛ, Alatala xa banxi xa fe ra, e birin yailanxi yɔxui fanyi nan na.

sentences.english: The king made them of liquid metal in the lowland of Jordan, in the soft earth between Succoth and Zeredah.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nu na yɔxui raxunuma Yurudɛn mɛrɛ nan ma, Sukɔti nun Saratan tagi.

sentences.english: So Solomon made all these vessels, a very great store of them, and the weight of the brass used was not measured.
sentences.susu: Sulemani yɔxui naxan nawalixi naa, a binyɛ xasabi mu nɔma kolonde.

sentences.english: And Solomon made all the vessels used in the house of God, the gold altar and the tables on which the holy bread was placed,
sentences.susu: Sulemani nu bara se birin yailan Ala xa banxi bɛ: sɛrɛxɛbade xɛɛma daaxi, teebilie taami sɛrɛxɛ sama dɛnnaxɛ,

sentences.english: And the supports for the lights with their lights, to be burning in the regular way in front of the inmost room, of the best gold;
sentences.susu: lanpui nun e dɔxɔse xɛɛma daaxie naxee dɛxɛma yire sɛniyɛnxi kui sɛriyɛ ki ma,

sentences.english: The flowers and the vessels for the lights and the instruments used for them, were all of gold; it was the best gold.
sentences.susu: fugee, lanpuie, suxumɛ xɛɛma tinse daaxie,

sentences.english: The scissors and the basins and the spoons and the fire-trays, of the best gold; and the inner doors of the house, opening into the most holy place, and the doors of the Temple, were all of gold.
sentences.susu: finɛe, pɔɔti tofanyie, piletie, kolopɔɔti xɛɛma fanyi daaxie, naadɛe xɛɛma daaxi naxee nu na yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante sode dɛ ra, nun hɔrɔmɔbanxi sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: So all the work which Solomon did for the house of the Lord was complete. And Solomon took the holy things which David his father had given, the silver and the gold and all the vessels, and put them in the store-houses of the house of God.
sentences.susu: Sulemani to gɛ Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi tide, a naxa se birin naso a kui a baba Dawuda naxee fixi Ala ma, gbeti, xɛɛma, a nun se mɔɔli birin. A naxa e sa naafuli ragatade Ala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: Then Solomon sent for all the responsible men of Israel, all the chiefs of the tribes and the heads of families of the children of Israel, to come to Jerusalem and take the ark of the Lord's agreement up out of the town of David, which is Zion.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Sulemani naxa Isirayila forie, bɔnsɔɛ xunyie, nun Isirayila denbaya xunyie, maxili alako e xa te Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ra kelife Siyon, Dawuda xa taa.

sentences.english: And all the men of Israel came together to the king at the feast in the seventh month.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka birin naxa e malan mangɛ yire alako e xa kike solofere nde sali raba.

sentences.english: All the responsible men of Israel came, and the Levites took up the ark.
sentences.susu: Isirayila forie birin to mɛnni li, Lewikae naxa saatɛ kankira tongo,

sentences.english: They took up the ark and the Tent of meeting and all the holy vessels which were in the Tent; all these the priests, the Levites, took up.
sentences.susu: e a xanin a nun Ala xa Kiri Banxi Naralande, a nun se sɛniyɛnxi naxee nu na a kui. Lewi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nan na wali rabaxi.

sentences.english: And King Solomon and all the men of Israel who had come together there with him, were before the ark, making offerings of sheep and oxen more than might be numbered.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani nun Isirayila ɲama, naxee birin nu maxilixi, naxa ti saatɛ kankira ya ra. E naxa xuruse lanmae nun a xungbe gbegbe ba sɛrɛxɛ ra, naxan kɔnti mu nɔma kolonde.

sentences.english: And the priests took the ark of the Lord's agreement and put it in its place, in the inner room of the house, in the most holy place, under the wings of the winged ones.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxa Alatala xa saatɛ kankira dɔxɔ a dɔxɔde, Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante. E a dɔxɔ malekɛe gabutenyie bun ma.

sentences.english: For their wings were outstretched over the place where the ark was, covering the ark and its rods.
sentences.susu: Malekɛe gabutenyie nu italaxi saatɛ kankira nun a maxanin see xun ma.

sentences.english: The rods were so long that their ends were seen from the holy place before the inmost room; but they were not seen from outside; and there they are to this day.
sentences.susu: Saatɛ kankira maxanin see findixi wuri kuyee nan na, naxee nu minima yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante kui, kɔnɔ e mu nu nɔma tode hɔrɔmɔbanxi tande ma. Han to saatɛ kankira na mɛnni.

sentences.english: Nothing was in the ark but the two flat stones which Moses put there at Horeb, where the Lord made an agreement with the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Sese mu nu na na saatɛ kankira kui, fo na walaxɛ firinyi Annabi Munsa naxee sa a kui. A na raba Xorebe geya yire, nɛ Alatala saatɛ xiri lɔxɔɛ, Isirayilakae mini tɛmui Misira.

sentences.english: Now when the priests had come out of the holy place, (for all the priests who were present had made themselves holy, not keeping to their divisions;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxa mini yire sɛniyɛnxi kui. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxee nu na na xundɛ kui, e birin nu bara sɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: And the Levites who made the music, all of them, Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun, and their sons and brothers, robed in fair linen, were in their places with their brass and corded instruments at the east side of the altar, and with them a hundred and twenty priests blowing horns;)
sentences.susu: Lewika bɛɛtibae, Asafi, Heman Yedutun, e xa die, nun e ngaxakerenyie, e birin maxirixi dugi fanyi gɛsɛ futi daaxi ra. E nu na sɛrɛxɛbade sogetede biri, maxasee nun kɔrae nu na e yi ra. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ mixi kɛmɛ mɔxɔɲɛn fan nu na e sɛɛti ma, e sarae fema.

sentences.english: And when the players on horns, and those who made melody in song, with one voice were sounding the praise and glory of the Lord; with loud voices and with wind instruments, and brass and corded instruments of music, praising the Lord and saying, He is good; his mercy is unchanging for ever: then the house was full of the cloud of the glory of the Lord,
sentences.susu: Sara fee nun bɛɛtibae naxa kafu e boore ma Alatala matɔxɔde e xa sarae, maxasee, nun kɔrae xui ra. E naxa Alatala tantu yi masenyi ra, «Ala xa hinnɛ gbo, a xa fonisireya mu ɲɔnma abadan!» Na tɛmui, nuxui naxa Alatala xa banxi rafe.

sentences.english: So that the priests were not able to keep their places to do their work because of the cloud; for the house of God was full of the glory of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe mu nɔ lude naa e xa wali rabade na nuxui xa fe ra. Alatala xa nɔrɛ nu bara a xa banxi rafe.

sentences.english: Then Solomon said, O Lord, to the sun you have given the heaven for a living-place, but your living-place was not seen by men,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Sulemani naxa a masen, «Alatala, a fala nɛ a a luma nuxui magaaxuxi kui.

sentences.english: So I have made for you a living-place, a house in which you may be for ever present.
sentences.susu: N tan bara lingira ti Ala bɛ, a luma dɛnnaxɛ abadan.»

sentences.english: Then, turning his face about, the king gave a blessing to all the men of Israel; and they were all on their feet together.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a ya rafindi, a duba Isirayila ɲama birin bɛ. E birin nu tixi.

sentences.english: And he said, Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, who himself gave his word to my father David, and with his strong hand has made his word come true, saying,
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen, «Tantui na Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ, naxan wɔyɛn n baba Dawuda bɛ a kɛrɛ ra. A fe naxan birin fala a bɛ, a na birin nakamalixi nɛ.

sentences.english: From the day when I took my people out of the land of Egypt, no town in all the tribes of Israel has been marked out by me for the building of a house for the resting-place of my name; and I took no man to be a ruler over my people Israel;
sentences.susu: ‹Kafi n nan n ma ɲama ramini Misira bɔxi ra, n mu nu taa sugandixi Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe tagi n banxi tima dɛnnaxɛ. N man mu xɛmɛ sugandixi naxan findima n ma Isirayila ɲama xa yarerati ra.

sentences.english: But now I have made selection of Jerusalem, that my name might be there, and of David, to be over my people Israel.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n Darisalamu nan sugandixi, alako n xili xa lu naa. N man Dawuda nan sugandixi alako a xa findi n ma Isirayila ɲama xunyi ra.›»

sentences.english: Now it was in the heart of my father David to put up a house for the name of the Lord, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: «N baba Dawuda naxa natɛ tongo a bɔɲɛ kui, fo a xa banxi ti Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: But the Lord said to David my father, You did well to have in your heart the desire to make a house for my name:
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a fala n baba Dawuda bɛ, ‹I to natɛ tongo i bɔɲɛ kui n ma banxi xa fe ra, na bara findi ɲanige fanyi ra.

sentences.english: But you yourself will not be the builder of the house; but your son, the offspring of your body, he it is who will put up a house for my name.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan xa mu na banxi tima. I xa di nan tan na tima. I naxan barixi, na nan n ma banxi tima.›

sentences.english: And the Lord has kept his word; for I have taken my father David's place on the seat of the kingdom of Israel, as the Lord gave his word; and I have made the house for the name of the Lord the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a xa masenyi rakamali. N tan bara ti n baba Dawuda ɲɔxɔɛ ra Isirayila mangɛ kibanyi kui, alɔ Alatala a masen ki naxɛ. N man bara banxi ti Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And there I have put the ark, in which is the agreement of the Lord, which he made with the people of Israel.
sentences.susu: N bara Alatala xa saatɛ kankira dɔxɔ naa, a xa saatɛ walaxɛ na na kui. A na saatɛ xiri a nun Isirayilakae nan tagi.»

sentences.english: Then he took his place in front of the altar of the Lord, all the men of Israel being present,
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa ti Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade ya ra, Isirayila ɲama birin ya xɔri, a fa a bɛlɛxɛ itala.

sentences.english: (For Solomon had made a brass stage, five cubits long, five cubits wide and three cubits high, and had put it in the middle of the open space; on this he took his place and went down on his knees before all the meeting of Israel, stretching out his hands to heaven.)
sentences.susu: Sulemani nu bara tide yailan yɔxui ra tɛtɛ tagi, a kuya nɔngɔn ya suuli, a igbo nɔngɔn ya suuli, a ite nɔngɔn ya saxan. A naxa a xinbi sin naa Isirayila ɲama ya xɔri, a a bɛlɛxɛ itala, a fa a fala,

sentences.english: And he said, O Lord, the God of Israel, there is no God like you in heaven or on earth; keeping faith and mercy unchanging for your servants, while they go in your ways with all their hearts;
sentences.susu: «Isirayila Marigi Alatala, i maniyɛ mu na koore nun bɔxi ma. I dugutɛgɛxi i xa saatɛ nun i xa hinnɛ xa fe ra i xa konyie mabiri, naxee ɲɛrɛma i ya tode ra e bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra.

sentences.english: For you have kept the word which you gave to your servant David, my father; with your mouth you said it and with your hand you have made it come true this day.
sentences.susu: Na na a ra, to lɔxɔɛ i bara i xa laayidi rakamali i xa konyi n baba Dawuda bɛ.

sentences.english: So now, O Lord, the God of Israel, let your word to your servant David, my father, come true, when you said, You will never be without a man to take his place before me on the seat of the kingdom of Israel; if only your children give attention to their ways, walking in my law, as you have done before me.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, Isirayila Marigi Alatala, i laayidi naxan tongoxi i xa konyi n baba Dawuda bɛ, i xa na rakamali. I bara a masen a bɛ, ‹Xa i bɔnsɔɛ fɛntɛn e ɲɛrɛ ki ma alɔ i a rabaxi ki naxɛ, e naxa n ma sɛriyɛ binya, mixi nde luma nɛ e ya ma naxan luma Isirayila kibanyi kui abadan.›

sentences.english: So now, O Lord, the God of Israel, make your word come true which you said to your servant David.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, Isirayila Marigi Alatala, i xa i xa masenyi rakamali, i naxan fala i xa konyi Dawuda bɛ.»

sentences.english: But is it truly possible that God may be housed with men on earth? see, heaven and the heaven of heavens are not wide enough to be your resting-place: how much less this house which I have made:
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ Ala tan nɔma sabatide duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari adamadie tagi? Koore nun a xa gboe xurun i bɛ. N banxi naxan tixi i bɛ a xurun koore bɛ. I luma mɛnni di?

sentences.english: Still, let your heart be turned to the prayer of your servant and to his prayer for grace, O Lord my God, and give ear to the cry and the prayer which your servant makes before you;
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala, i xa i xa konyi xa dubɛ suxu, i xa a xa maxandi tongo, i xa i tuli mati i xa konyi wa xui ra.

sentences.english: That your eyes may be open to this house day and night, to this place of which you have said that you would put your name there; to give ear to the prayer which your servant may make, turning to this place.
sentences.susu: I xa i ɲɛngi sa yi banxi xɔn ma kɔɛ nun yanyi, barima i naxɛ a i i yɛtɛ masenma be nɛ. I xa i xa konyi xa maxandi suxu yi banxi kui.

sentences.english: And give ear to the prayers of your servant and of your people Israel, when they make their prayers, turning to this place; give ear from heaven your living-place; and hearing have mercy.
sentences.susu: I xa i tuli mati i xa konyi nun i xa ɲama wa xui ra, e i maxandima be tɛmui naxɛ. Kelife koore ma i dɔxɔxi dɛnnaxɛ, i xa i tuli mati muxu ra, i man xa diɲɛ.»

sentences.english: If a man does wrong to his neighbour and has to take an oath, and comes before your altar to take his oath in this house:
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi nde sa yunubi raba a boore ra, e fa a fala a bɛ a xa marakali nde raba i xa sɛrɛxɛbade yire yi banxi kui,

sentences.english: Then let your ear be open in heaven, and be the judge of your servants, giving punishment to the wrongdoer, so that his sin may come on his head; and, by your decision, keeping from evil him who has done no wrong.
sentences.susu: i xa na fe mato kelife koore ma, i xa kiiti sa tinxinyi ra alako yunubitɔɛ nun tinxintɔɛ birin xa e sare sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: And if your people Israel are overcome in war, because of their sin against you; if they are turned to you again, honouring your name, making prayers and requesting your grace in this house:
sentences.susu: «Xa i xa ɲama Isirayila sa yunubi raba i ra, e yaxuie fa nɔ e ra na xa fe ra, xa e tin e yɛtɛ ragbilende i ma, e i xili matɔxɔ, e i maxandi yi hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui,

sentences.english: Then give ear from heaven, and let the sin of your people Israel have forgiveness, and take them back again to the land which you gave to them and to their fathers.
sentences.susu: i xa na fe mato kelife koore ma, i xa i xa ɲama Isirayila xa yunubie xafari, i fa e ragbilen bɔxi ma, i dɛnnaxɛ fixi e tan nun e babae ma.»

sentences.english: When heaven is shut up and there is no rain, because of their sin against you: if they make prayers with their faces turned to this place, honouring your name and turning away from their sin when you send trouble on them:
sentences.susu: «Xa koore sa balan, tunɛ yo mu fa, barima e bara yunubi raba i ra, xa e fa i maxandide be, e i xili matɔxɔ, e gbilen e xa yunubi fɔxɔ ra i e rayaagixi naxan ma,

sentences.english: Then give ear from heaven, so that the sin of your servants and the sin of your people Israel may have forgiveness, when you make clear to them the good way in which they are to go; and send rain on your land which you have given to your people for their heritage.
sentences.susu: i xa na fe mato kelife koore ma, i xa i xa konyie, i xa ɲama Isirayila xa yunubie xafari, i xa i xa sɛriyɛ fanyi masen e bɛ alako e xa na raɲɛrɛ ki kolon, i fa tunɛ ragoro i xa bɔxi ma, i naxan findi e gbe ra.»

sentences.english: If there is no food in the land, if there is disease, if the fruits of the earth are damaged by heat or water, locust or worm; if their towns are shut in by their attackers: whatever trouble or whatever disease there may be:
sentences.susu: «Xa kaamɛ sa sin yi bɔxi ma, xa na mu fure, xa na mu baloe kanɛ, xa na mu gere, xa na mu gbaloe gbɛtɛ,

sentences.english: Whatever prayer or request for your grace is made by any man, or by all your people Israel, whatever his trouble may be, whose hands are stretched out to this house:
sentences.susu: xa mixi nde sa i maxandi, xa i xa ɲama Isirayila e mawa i bɛ, barima e bara e xa tɔɔrɛ saabui kolon e fa e ya rafindi yi banxi ma e i maxandi,

sentences.english: Then give ear from heaven your living-place, answering with forgiveness, and give to every man, whose secret heart is open to you, the reward of all his ways; (for you, and you only, have knowledge of the hearts of the children of men;)
sentences.susu: i xa na fe mato kelife koore ma i magoroxi dɛnnaxɛ, i xa diɲɛ, i xa mixi birin sare fi a xa wali ra, i tan naxan adama birin bɔɲɛ ma fe kolon. I keren peti nan ibunadama birin sondon ma fe kolon.

sentences.english: So that they may give you worship, walking in your ways, as long as they are living in the land which you gave to our fathers.
sentences.susu: Na kui e fama gaaxude i ya ra, e e ɲɛrɛ i xa kira xɔn e xa simaya birin kui yi bɔxi ma, i naxan fixi muxu babae ma.»

sentences.english: And as for the man from a strange land, who is not of your people Israel but comes from a far country because of the glory of your name and your strong hand and your outstretched arm; when he comes to make his prayer, turning to this house:
sentences.susu: «Xa xɔɲɛ nde sa fa kelife ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛ ma, naxan mu findi i xa ɲama Isirayila mixi nde ra, a fa i xili xungbe nun i sɛnbɛ xa fe ra, a i maxandi yi banxi kui,

sentences.english: Then give ear from heaven your living-place, and give him his desire, whatever it may be; so that all the peoples of the earth may have knowledge of your name, worshipping you as do your people Israel, and may see that this house which I have made is truly named by your name.
