sentences.susu: i xa na fe mato kelife koore ma i magoroxi dɛnnaxɛ, i xa a xa maxandi suxu alako si birin xa gaaxu i xili ya ra duniɲa, alɔ i xa ɲama Isirayila. E xa a kolon i tan nan xili maxandima yi banxi kui n naxan tixi.»

sentences.english: If your people go out to war against their attackers, by whatever way you may send them, if they make their prayers to you turning their faces to this town of yours and to this house which I have put up for your name:
sentences.susu: «Xa i xa ɲama sa mini a yaxuie gerede alɔ i a fala e bɛ ki naxɛ, xa e i maxandi yi taa mabiri ra i dɛnnaxɛ sugandixi, xa e i maxandi yi banxi mabiri n naxan tixi i xili ra,

sentences.english: Then give ear from heaven to their prayer and their cry for grace, and see right done to them.
sentences.susu: i xa na fe mato, i xa e xa dubɛ suxu, i xa kiiti tinxinxi sa e bɛ.»

sentences.english: If they do wrong against you, (for no man is without sin,) and you are angry with them, and give them up into the power of those who are fighting against them, so that they take them away prisoners to a land far off or near;
sentences.susu: «Xa e sa yunubi raba i ra, alɔ adamadi birin darixi naxan na, xa i bɔɲɛ te e ma, i fa e sa e yaxuie sagoe, e findi geelimanie ra yire makuye, xa na mu a ra yire makɔrɛxi,

sentences.english: And if they take thought, in the land where they are prisoners, turning again to you, crying out in prayer to you in that land, and saying, We are sinners, we have done wrong, we have done evil;
sentences.susu: xa e sa xaxili sɔtɔ na konyiya kui, e fa i maxandi e xa geeli kui, ‹Muxu bara yunubi raba, muxu bara fe ɲaaxi raba, muxu bara kobi,›

sentences.english: If with all their heart and soul they are turned again to you, in the land where they are prisoners, the land where they have been taken, and make their prayers, turning their eyes to their land which you gave to their fathers, and to the town which you took for yourself, and the house which I have made for your name:
sentences.susu: xa e man e yɛtɛ ragbilen i ma e bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra, e nii birin na, e fa i maxandi ɲamanɛ ma konyiya kui, e e ya rafindi yi bɔxi mabiri, i naxan fixi e babae ma, a nun yi taa mabiri, i naxan sugandixi, a nun yi banxi mabiri, n naxan tixi i bɛ,

sentences.english: Then give ear from heaven your living-place to their prayer and their cry, and see right done to them, answering with forgiveness your people who have done wrong against you.
sentences.susu: i xa na fe mato kelife koore ma i magoroxi dɛnnaxɛ, i xa i tuli mati e xa maxandi nun e wa xui ra, i xa kiiti tinxinxi sa e bɛ, i xa diɲɛ i xa ɲama ma naxan yunubi rabaxi i ra.

sentences.english: Now, O my God, may your eyes be open and your ears awake to the prayers made in this place.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, n Marigi Ala, i xa muxu xa maxandi mato, i xa a ramɛ, muxu naxan nabaxi yi banxi kui.»

sentences.english: Up! now, O Lord God, come back to your resting-place, you and the ark of your strength: let your priests, O Lord God, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints be glad in what is good.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi n Marigi Alatala, keli, i fa i xa malabude, i tan nun i sɛnbɛ xa lu saatɛ kankira fɔxɔ ra, alako kisi xa lu i xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe bɛ, alako i xa danxaniyatɔɛe xa lu hɛɛri kui, n Marigi Alatala.

sentences.english: O Lord God, let him whom you have taken for yourself never be given up by you: keep in mind your mercies to David your servant.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala i naxa i xa mixi sugandixi rabɛɲin, i xa ratu i xa konyi Dawuda xa dugutɛgɛɲa ma.»

sentences.english: Now when Solomon's prayers were ended, fire came down from heaven, burning up all the offerings; and the house was full of the glory of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sulemani to gɛ salide, tɛ naxa goro keli koore ma, a sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun sɛrɛxɛ gbɛtɛe birin gan. Alatala xa nɔrɛ fan naxa hɔrɔmɔbanxi rafe.

sentences.english: And the priests were not able to go into the house of the Lord, for the Lord's house was full of the glory of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe mu nɔ sode Alatala xa banxi kui, barima Alatala xa nɔrɛ nu bara a xa banxi rafe.

sentences.english: And all the children of Israel were looking on when the fire came down, and the glory of the Lord was on the house; and they went down on their knees, with their faces to the earth, worshipping and praising the Lord, and saying, He is good; for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae birin to tɛ nun Alatala xa nɔrɛ to hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, e naxa e yatagie rafelen bɔxi ma, e fa Alatala matɔxɔ yi masenyi ra, «Ala fan, a xa fonisireya mu ɲɔnma abadan.»

sentences.english: Then the king and all the people made offerings before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nun ɲama birin naxa sɛrɛxɛ ba Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: King Solomon made an offering of twenty-two thousand oxen, and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people kept the feast of the opening of the house of God.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani naxa ninge wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin ba sɛrɛxɛ ra, a nun yɛxɛɛ wulu kɛmɛ mɔxɔɲɛn. Na dangi xanbi, mangɛ nun ɲama naxa Ala xa banxi rabi.

sentences.english: And the priests were in their places, and the Levites with their instruments of music for the Lord's song, which David the king had made for the praise of the Lord whose mercy is unchanging for ever, when David gave praise by their hand; and the priests were sounding horns before them; and all Israel were on their feet.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae naxa ti e tide e boore ya ra. Bɛɛtibasee, mangɛ Dawuda nu bara naxee yailan Alatala matɔxɔfe ra, nu na Lewi bɛɛtibae yi ra. E naxa Alatala matɔxɔ yi masenyi ra, «Ala xa fonisireya mu ɲɔnma abadan.» Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe tan naxa sarae fe, Isirayilakae birin fa keli, e ti.

sentences.english: Then Solomon made holy the middle of the open square in front of the house of the Lord, offering the burned offerings there, and the fat of the peace-offerings; for there was not room on the brass altar which Solomon had made for all the burned offerings and the meal offerings and the fat.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa tɛtɛ yire rasɛniyɛn sɛrɛxɛ ra Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ya ra. A naxa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie gan naa, a nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛe naxee findi a ture yiree ra, barima yɔxui sɛrɛxɛbade, Sulemani naxan yailanxi, a xurun na sɛrɛxɛe birin bɛ.

sentences.english: So Solomon kept the feast at that time for seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great meeting, for the people had come together from the way into Hamath and from as far as the river of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Sulemani nun Isirayilakae birin sali raba nɛ xi solofere bun ma. Ɲama gbegbe fa nɛ kelife Xamata han Misira xure.

sentences.english: And on the eighth day they had a holy meeting; the offerings for making the altar holy went on for seven days, and the feast for seven days.
sentences.susu: A xi solomasaxan nde, e naxa sali xungbe raba. E nu bara sɛrɛxɛbade rasɛniyɛn xi solofere bun ma. Na dangi xanbi, e man naxa sali xi solofere gbɛtɛ bun ma.

sentences.english: And on the twenty-third day of the seventh month, he sent the people away to their tents, full of joy and glad in their hearts, because of all the good which the Lord had done to David and to Solomon and to Israel his people.
sentences.susu: Kike solofere nde, xi mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan lɔxɔɛ, Sulemani naxa ɲama ragbilen e xɔnyi. E birin nu bara sɛɛwa e bɔɲɛ kui fe fanyi ra, Alatala naxan nabaxi Dawuda, Sulemani, nun a xa ɲama Isirayila bɛ.

sentences.english: So Solomon came to the end of building the house of the Lord and the king's house; and everything which it was in his mind to make in the house of the Lord and for himself had been well done.
sentences.susu: Sulemani to gɛ Alatala xa banxi nun a xa mangɛ banxi wali ra, a to a waxɔnfe birin nakamali na wali firinyi xa fe ra,

sentences.english: Now the Lord came to Solomon in a vision by night, and said to him, I have given ear to your prayer, and have taken this place for myself as a house where offerings are to be made.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa mini Sulemani ma kɔɛ ra, a a masen a bɛ, «N bara i xa dubɛ suxu. Yi banxi bara findi sɛrɛxɛbade ra. N bara na natɛ tongo.

sentences.english: If, at my word, heaven is shut up, so that there is no rain, or if I send locusts on the land for its destruction, or if I send disease on my people;
sentences.susu: N na koore balan tɛmui naxɛ, tunɛ mu fa, xa na mu a ra n na katoe yamari tɛmui naxɛ, e xa sa bɔxi tuxunsan, xa na mu a ra n na fa fure ɲaaxi ra n ma ɲama ma,

sentences.english: If my people, on whom my name is named, make themselves low and come to me in prayer, searching for me and turning from their evil ways; then I will give ear from heaven, overlooking their sin, and will give life again to their land.
sentences.susu: xa n ma ɲama, n xili falaxi naxan xun, naxa e magoro, e n maxandi, e fa gbilen e xa wali kobie fɔxɔ ra, n nan n tuli matima nɛ e ra koore ma, n fa e xa yunubie xafari, n e xa bɔxi rayalan.

sentences.english: Now my eyes will be open and my ears awake to the prayers made in this place.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n nan n yae tima nɛ yi yire ra. N nan n tuli matima nɛ maxandie ra naxee rabama be.

sentences.english: For I have taken this house for myself and made it holy, so that my name may be there for ever; and my eyes and my heart will be there at all times.
sentences.susu: N bara natɛ tongo n xili xa fala be abadan. N yae nun n bɔɲɛ mu kelima be.»

sentences.english: And as for you, if you will go on your way before me as David your father did, doing whatever I have given you orders to do and keeping my laws and my decisions:
sentences.susu: «I tan fan, xa i ɲɛrɛ n ma kira xɔn ma alɔ i baba Dawuda, i fa n ma yaamarie, n ma sɛriyɛ, nun n ma xaranyi suxu a fanyi ra,

sentences.english: Then I will make strong the seat of your kingdom, as I gave my word to David your father, saying, You will never be without a man to be ruler in Israel.
sentences.susu: n i xa mangɛ kibanyi mabanbanma nɛ, alɔ n a rasaataxi i baba Dawuda bɛ ki naxɛ. N a masen nɛ a bɛ, ‹Isirayila mangɛya mu bama i bɔnsɔɛ yi ra.›

sentences.english: But if you are turned away from me, and do not keep my orders and my laws which I have put before you, but go and make yourselves servants to other gods, giving them worship:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa wo wo kobe so n na, wo fa gbilen n ma sɛriyɛ nun n ma yaamarie fɔxɔ ra, xa wo sa tuubi Ala gbɛtɛe bɛ,

sentences.english: Then I will have this people uprooted out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy for my name, I will put away from before my eyes, and make it an example and a word of shame among all peoples.
sentences.susu: n wo talama nɛ n ma bɔxi ma, n naxan fixi wo ma, n yi banxi rakasan yɛ i, n naxan findixi n xili falade ra. Na tɛmui sie birin fama nɛ yelede Isirayila xa fe ma, e yo wo ma.

sentences.english: And this house will become a mass of broken walls, and everyone who goes by will be overcome with wonder, and will say, Why has the Lord done so to this land and to this house?
sentences.susu: Mixie nɛ dangima yi banxi itexi ra, e dɛ ixarama nɛ, e a fala, ‹Alatala yi bɔxi nun yi banxi xa fe ralɔɛxi yi mɔɔli ra munfe ra?›

sentences.english: And their answer will be, Because they were turned away from the Lord, the God of their fathers, who took them out of the land of Egypt, and took for themselves other gods and gave them worship and became their servants: that is why he has sent all this evil on them.
sentences.susu: E e yaabima nɛ, ‹Ala yi birin niyaxi e ra nɛ barima e bara gbilen e babae Marigi Alatala fɔxɔ ra, naxan e ramini Misira bɔxi ra. E bara e tagi ixiri ala gbɛtɛe batufe ra, e tuubi e bɛ. E yi tɔɔrɛ sɔtɔxi na nan ma.›»

sentences.english: Now at the end of twenty years, in which time Solomon had put up the house of the Lord and a house for himself,
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn bun ma, Sulemani naxa Alatala xa banxi nun a yɛtɛ banxi ti.

sentences.english: He took in hand the building up of the towns which Huram had given him, causing the children of Israel to make living-places for themselves there.
sentences.susu: A naxa taae yailan, Xirami naxee so a yi ra, a fa Isirayilakae rasabati naa.

sentences.english: And Solomon went to Hamath-zobah and overcame it.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa Xamata Soba gere, a nɔ a ra.

sentences.english: And he put up the buildings of Tadmor in the waste land, and of all the store-towns in Hamath;
sentences.susu: A naxa Tadimoro ti gbengberenyi ma, a nun taa gbɛtɛe Xamata bɔxi ma mangɛ harige ragatama dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And of Beth-horon the higher and the lower, walled towns with walls and doorways and locks;
sentences.susu: A naxa Beti Xoron Fuge nun Beti Xoron Labe ti, a na taae makanta tɛtɛ fanyie nun naadɛ xungbee ra.

sentences.english: And of Baalath, and all the store-towns which Solomon had, and the towns where he kept his war-carriages and his horse men, and everything which it was his pleasure to put up in Jerusalem and in Lebanon and in all the land under his rule.
sentences.susu: A naxa Baalati ti a nun taa gbɛtɛe mangɛ harige ragatama dɛnnaxɛ, alɔ sɔɔri ragisee nun soee. Sulemani naxa yire gbegbe ti a yɛtɛ bɛ Darisalamu, Liban, nun a xa bɔxi birin a naxan yamarima.

sentences.english: As for all the rest of the Hittites and the Amorites and the Perizzites and the Hivites and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel:
sentences.susu: Xitikae, Amorikae, Peresikae, Hiwikae, nun Yebusukae naxee lu Isirayila bɔxi ma, naxee mu findi Isirayilakae ra,

sentences.english: Their men who were still living in the land, and whom the children of Israel had not put an end to, these Solomon put to forced work, as is done to this day;
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae mu naxee faxa, Sulemani naxa e findi konyie ra. Han to e na na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: But Solomon did not make use of the children of Israel as servants for his work; they were men of war, his chiefs and his captains, and captains of his war-carriages and his horsemen.
sentences.susu: Sulemani mu tin Isirayilaka yo xa findi konyi ra a xa walie xa fe ra, barima geresoe nun sɔɔri xunyie nan nu lanxi e tan ma, e nu mɛɛnima a xa sɔɔri ragisee nun a xa soee ma.

sentences.english: Now these were the chief men in authority whom King Solomon had: two hundred and fifty of them, in authority over the people.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani naxa mixi kɛmɛ firin mixi tongo suuli ti xunyie ra ɲama xun.

sentences.english: Then Solomon made Pharaoh's daughter come up from the town of David to the house which he had made for her; for he said, I will not have my wife living in the house of David, king of Israel, because those places where the ark of the Lord has come are holy.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa Firawuna xa di ginɛ tongo Dawuda xa taa kui, a a ratunu banxi gbɛtɛ kui, a naxan tixi a bɛ. A naxa a fala, «N ma ginɛ mu luma Isirayila mangɛ Dawuda xa banxi kui, Alatala xa saatɛ kankira na dɛnnaxɛ. Naa findixi yire sɛniyɛnxi nan na.»

sentences.english: Then Solomon made burned offerings to the Lord on the altar of the Lord which he had put up in front of the covered way,
sentences.susu: Sulemani nu sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie bama Alatala bɛ, a xa sɛrɛxɛbade fari naxan nu tixi hɔrɔmɔbanxi ya ra.

sentences.english: Offering every day what had been ordered by Moses, on the Sabbaths and at the new moon and at the regular feasts three times a year, that is at the feast of unleavened bread, the feast of weeks, and the feast of tents.
sentences.susu: A sɛrɛxɛe ba nɛ alɔ Annabi Munsa a yamari ki naxɛ lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ, malabui lɔxɔɛe ra, kike nɛɛnɛ ra, nun sali xungbe saxanyie ra ɲɛ yo ɲɛ. Nee findi Taami Lɛbinitare Sali, Lɔxunyie Sali, nun Bage Ti Sali nan na.

sentences.english: And he gave the divisions of the priests their places for their work, as ordered by his father David, and to the Levites he gave their work of praise and waiting on the priests, to do what was needed day by day; and he gave the door-keepers their places in turn at every door; for so David, the man of God, had given orders.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa a baba Dawuda xa natɛe rakamali sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae xa fe ra. Kankan nu a gbe wali rabama. Lewikae nu Ala matɔxɔma, e man nu fa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe mali. Naadɛ kantɛe fan naxa e gbe wali raba, kankan naxa ti a tide alɔ Ala xa mixi Dawuda a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: All the orders given by the king to the priests and Levites, in connection with any business or stores, were done with care.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae mu mangɛ xa yaamari yo matandi, hali a naxan fala naafuli xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And all the work of Solomon was complete, from the day when he put the base of the Lord's house in position, till Solomon had come to the end of building the Lord's house.
sentences.susu: Sulemani xa wali birin kamali na ki nɛ, kelife Alatala xa banxi kɔɔrin lɔxɔɛ ma, a sa dɔxɔ a raɲɔnyi ra. Alatala xa banxi wali birin raba nɛ, a kamali a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Then Solomon went to Ezion-geber and to Eloth by the sea in the land of Edom.
sentences.susu: Na to dangi Sulemani naxa siga Esiyon Geberi nun Elata baa dɛ ra Edon bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Huram sent him, by his servants, ships and experienced seamen, who went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir and came back with four hundred and fifty talents of gold, which they took to King Solomon.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Xirami naxa kunkuie nun e raɲɛrɛma fanyie rasanba Sulemani ma. Nee naxa sa a gbee xun ma Ofiri bɔxi ma, alako e xa xɛɛma kilo wulu fu nun suuli kilo kɛmɛ saxan tongo mangɛ Sulemani bɛ. E nun mangɛ Sulemani xa walikɛe naxa siga na ra Sulemani xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Now the queen of Sheba, hearing great things of Solomon, came to Jerusalem to put his wisdom to the test with hard questions; and with her came a very great train, and camels weighted down with spices, and great stores of gold and jewels: and when she came to Solomon she had talk with him of everything in her mind.
sentences.susu: Seeba mangɛ ginɛ to Sulemani xili xa gboe mɛ, a naxa siga Darisalamu maxɔrinyi xɔrɔxɔɛe tide a ma, alako a xa a xa lɔnni mato. A xa kuntigie naxa a mati naa, e naxa labundɛ, xɛɛma gbegbe, nun gɛmɛ tofanyie xanin ɲɔxɔmɛe fari sanbasee ra. A naxa maxɔrinyi gbegbe ti Sulemani ma.

sentences.english: And Solomon gave her answers to all her questions; there was no secret which he did not make clear to her.
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa a xa maxɔrinyi birin yaabi, na sese mu nu xɔrɔxɔ a bɛ.

sentences.english: And when the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Solomon, and the house which he had made,
sentences.susu: Seeba mangɛ ginɛ to gɛ Sulemani xa lɔnni tode, a nun a xa banxi a naxan tixi,

sentences.english: And the food at his table, and all his servants seated there, and those who were waiting on him in their places, and their robes, and his wine-servants and their robes, and the burned offerings which he made in the house of the Lord, there was no more spirit in her.
sentences.susu: a xa baloe naxan saxi a xa teebili ma, a xa walikɛe nun e xa dugi tofanyie, a nun a xa sɛrɛxɛe a naxee bama Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, a dɛ naxa ixara na fe birin ma. A naxa a fala mangɛ bɛ,

sentences.english: And she said to the king, The account which was given to me in my country of your acts and your wisdom was true.
sentences.susu: «N fe naxee birin mɛxi n ma bɔxi ma i xa masenyie nun i xa lɔnni xa fe ra, na birin bara findi nɔndi ra.

sentences.english: But I had no faith in what was said about you, till I came and saw for myself; and truly, word was not given me of half your great wisdom; you are much greater than they said.
sentences.susu: Beenun n xa be to n yɛtɛ ra, n mu nu laxi e xa masenyi ra. Kɔnɔ yakɔsi n bara a kolon i xa lɔnni gbo dangife e naxan masenxi n bɛ. E fe naxan birin tagi rabaxi n bɛ i xa fe ra, i xili dangi na birin na.

sentences.english: Happy are your wives and happy these your servants whose place is ever before you, hearing your words of wisdom.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛlɛxinyi na i xa mixie bɛ, ɲɛlɛxinyi na i xa konyie bɛ, barima e na i sɛɛti ma tɛmui birin i xa lɔnni ramɛfe ra.

sentences.english: Praise be to the Lord your God whose pleasure it was to put you on the seat of his kingdom to be king for the Lord your God: because, in his love for Israel, it was the purpose of your God to make them strong for ever, he made you king over them, to be their judge in righteousness.
sentences.susu: Tantui na i Marigi Alatala bɛ, naxan hinnɛxi i ra, a fa i dɔxɔ a xa mangɛ kibanyi kui, i xa mangɛya raba alɔ a wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ. I Marigi Ala na raba nɛ barima Isirayila rafan a ma, a man wama Isirayila xa bu tɛmui birin. A i findi nɛ e xa mangɛ ra, alako i xa e yamari tinxinyi nun nɔndi ra.»

sentences.english: And she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and a great store of spices and jewels: never had such spices been seen as the queen of Sheba gave to Solomon.
sentences.susu: A naxa xɛɛma kilo wulu naani fi mangɛ ma, a nun labundɛ gbegbe nun gɛmɛ tofanyie. Kabi na tɛmui, na labundɛ mɔɔli mu toma Isirayila, Seeba mangɛ ginɛ naxan fixi mangɛ Sulemani ma.

sentences.english: And the servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon, in addition to gold from Ophir, came back with sandal-wood and jewels.
sentences.susu: Xirami nun Sulemani xa walikɛ naxee fa xɛɛma ra kelife Ofiri bɔxi ma, nee man naxa fa wuri nun gɛmɛ tofanyie ra a bɛ.

sentences.english: And with the sandal-wood the king made steps for the house of the Lord and for the king's house, and instruments of music for the makers of melody; never before had such been seen in the land of Judah.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa na wuri rawali Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi sode dɛe ra, a nun mangɛ xa banxi sode dɛe ra. A man naxa na wuri rawali kɔrae yailanfe ra bɛɛtibae bɛ. Na fe mɔɔli mu nu toxi Yudaya sinden.

sentences.english: And King Solomon gave the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she made request for, in addition to what she had taken to the king. So she went back to her country with her servants.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani naxa Seeba mangɛ ginɛ waxɔnse birin so a yi ra dangife a tan naxan sanbaxi a ra. Na xanbi, a naxa gbilen a xa bɔxi ma, a tan nun a xa konyie.

sentences.english: Now the weight of gold which came to Solomon in one year was six hundred and sixty-six talents;
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ yo ɲɛ Sulemani nu xɛɛma kilo wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin, kilo kɛmɛ senni tongo naani nun naani sɔtɔma,

sentences.english: And in addition to what he got from traders of different sorts, all the kings of Arabia and the rulers of the country gave gold and silver to Solomon.
sentences.susu: bafe a nu naxan sɔtɔma yulɛe yi duuti ra. A man nu xɛɛma nun gbeti sɔtɔma mangɛe nun gominae ra Arabu bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And King Solomon made two hundred body-covers of hammered gold, every one having six hundred shekels of gold in it.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani naxa wure lefa kɛmɛ firin maso xɛɛma ra, kankan nafalaxi xɛɛma kilo solofere nan na.

sentences.english: And he made three hundred smaller body-covers of hammered gold, using three hundred shekels of gold for every cover, and the king put them in the house of the Woods of Lebanon.
sentences.susu: A man naxa wure lefa xunxuri kɛmɛ saxan maso xɛɛma ra, kankan masoxi xɛɛma kilo saxan nan na. A naxa e gbaku banxi kui, naxan xili falama Liban fɔtɔn banxi.

sentences.english: Then the king made a great ivory seat, plated with the best gold.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa kibanyi xungbe yailan sili ɲinyi ra, a fa a maso xɛɛma tinse ra.

sentences.english: There were six steps up to it, and a foot-rest of gold fixed to it, and arms on the two sides of the seat, with two lions at the side of the arms.
sentences.susu: Na kibanyi te see findixi xɛɛma nan na, kibanyi nu na yɛtɛ masolixi firin tagi.

sentences.english: And twelve lions were placed on one side and on the other side on the six steps: there was nothing like it in any kingdom.
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛ fu nun firin fan masolixi nu na te see sɛɛtie ma, senni na yirefanyi ma, sennie na kɔɔla ma. Na kibanyi maniyɛ mu nu na mangataa yo kui sinden.

sentences.english: All King Solomon's drinking-vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the Woods of Lebanon were of the best gold: no one gave a thought to silver in the days of Solomon.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani xa pɔɔti birin nun Liban fɔtɔn banxi xa pileti birin findixi xɛɛma nan na. A mu nu gbeti rawalima fefe ma.

sentences.english: For the king had Tarshish-ships sailing with the servants of Huram: once every three years the Tarshish-ships came back with gold and silver, ivory and monkeys and peacocks.
sentences.susu: Kunkuie nu na mangɛ yi ra naxee nu luma siga ra Tarasisi ɲɛ saxan yo ɲɛ saxan xɛɛma, gbeti, sili ɲinyi, kule, nun xɔni tofanyi tongode. Xirami xa walikɛe nu a malima na wali kui.

sentences.english: And King Solomon was greater than all the kings of the earth in wealth and in wisdom.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani xa bannaya nun a xa lɔnni naxa gbo yɛ dangi bɔxi mangɛ birin na.

sentences.english: And all the kings of the earth came to see Solomon and to give ear to his wisdom, which God had put into his heart.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi mangɛ birin nu wama Sulemani xa lɔnni ramɛfe Ala naxan fixi a ma.

sentences.english: And everyone took with him an offering, vessels of silver and vessels of gold, and robes, and coats of metal, and spices, and horses and beasts for transport, regularly year by year.
sentences.susu: Nee birin nu mangɛ sanbama gbeti, xɛɛma, dugie, geresosee, labundɛe, soe, nun sofalee ra ɲɛ yo ɲɛ.

sentences.english: Solomon had four thousand buildings for his horses and his war-carriages, and twelve thousand horsemen whom he kept, some in the carriage-towns and some with the king in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Soe nun sɔɔri ragise ragatade wulu naani nu na Sulemani yi ra. Sɔɔri soe ragi wulu fu nun firin fan nu na a yi ra taa makantaxie nun Darisalamu kui, mangɛ xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And he was ruler over all the kings from the River to the land of the Philistines, as far as the limit of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ birin, kelife xure xungbe ma, sa dɔxɔ Filisita bɔxi ra, han a sa dɔxɔ Misira naaninyi ra, e birin nu na a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem and cedars like the sycamore-trees of the lowlands in number.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nan a niya gbeti xa wuya Darisalamu alɔ gɛmɛ xɔri. Sɛdiri wuri fan naxa wuya alɔ sikomoro wuri na Sefela bɔxi ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: They got horses for Solomon from Egypt and from every land.
sentences.susu: Sulemani xa soe nu kelima Misira nɛ nun bɔxi gbɛtɛe ma.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not recorded in the history of Nathan the prophet, and in the words of Ahijah the prophet of Shiloh, and in the visions of Iddo the seer about Jeroboam, the son of Nebat?
sentences.susu: Sulemani xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, a fɔlɛ nun a raɲɔnyi, sɛbɛxi Annabi Natan xa taruxui sɛbɛxi kui, a na Annabi Ahiya Siloka xa namiɲɔnmɛ masenyi sɛbɛxi kui, nun Annabi Ido xa laamatunyi masenyi sɛbɛxi kui Nebati xa di Yerobowami xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Solomon was king over Israel in Jerusalem for forty years.
sentences.susu: Sulemani xa mangɛya naxa bu ɲɛ tongo naani Darisalamu nun Isirayila xun ma.

sentences.english: And Solomon went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth in the town of David his father; and Rehoboam his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Sulemani naxa laaxira. E naxa a ragata a babae sɛɛti ma a baba Dawuda xa taa kui. A xa di Robowami naxa ti a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Rehoboam went to Shechem, where all Israel had come together to make him king.
sentences.susu: Robowami naxa siga Sikemi, barima Isirayilakae birin nu malanxi naa nɛ, e xa a ti mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And when Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, had news of it, (for he was in Egypt where he had gone in flight from King Solomon,) he came back from Egypt.
sentences.susu: Nebati xa di Yerobowami to na fe mɛ Misira bɔxi ma, a a gi dɛnnaxɛ Sulemani ma, a naxa gbilen Isirayila.

sentences.english: And they sent for him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came to Rehoboam and said,
sentences.susu: A to Isirayila li, mixi ndee naxa a xili. A nun Isirayilakae birin naxa siga Robowami yire, e a fala a bɛ,

sentences.english: Your father put a hard yoke on us: if you will make the conditions under which your father kept us down less cruel, and the weight of the yoke he put on us less hard, then we will be your servants.
sentences.susu: «I baba muxu suxu nɛ alɔ konyie. Yakɔsi tan, xa i nde bama muxu xa kote ra i baba naxan dɔxɔ muxu fari, muxu fama i xa yaamari rabatude.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Come to me again after three days. So the people went away.
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «Xi saxan na dangi, wo xa fa.» Na kui, ɲama naxa siga.

sentences.english: Then King Rehoboam took the opinion of the old men who had been with Solomon his father when he was living, and said, In your opinion, what answer am I to give to this people?
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Robowami naxa marasi maxɔrin forie ma, naxee nu na a baba Sulemani fɛ ma a xa simaya kui. A naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo marasi mundun fima n ma n ɲama yaabima naxan na?»

sentences.english: And they said to him, If you are kind to this people, pleasing them and saying good words to them, then they will be your servants for ever.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Xa i fe fanyi rabama ɲama bɛ, xa i tin e waxɔnfe ra, xa i wɔyɛn fanyi fala e bɛ, e luma nɛ i xa yaamari bun ma tɛmui birin.»

sentences.english: But he gave no attention to the opinion of the old men, but went to the young men of his generation who were waiting before him.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Robowami mu tin forie xa marasi ra. A naxa a lanfanmae maxɔrin a lanma a xa naxan naba.

sentences.english: And he said to them, What is your opinion? What answer are we to give to this people who have said to me, Make less the weight of the yoke which your father put on us?
sentences.susu: A naxɛ e bɛ, «Wo marasi mundun fima n ma, n ɲama yaabima naxan na, ɲama naxan n mayandixi n xa nde ba e xa kote ra n baba naxan dɔxɔ e fari.»

sentences.english: And the young men of his generation said to him, This is the answer to give to the people who came to you saying, Your father put a hard yoke on us, but will you make it less; say to them, My little finger is thicker than my father's body;
sentences.susu: A lanfanmae naxa a yaabi, «I xa yi ɲama yaabi yi ki nɛ, naxee i mayandixi i xa nde ba e xa kote ra i baba naxan dɔxɔ e fari. I xa a fala e bɛ, ‹N bɛlɛxɛ sole lanmadi xungbo n baba tagi bɛ.

sentences.english: If my father put a hard yoke on you, I will make it harder: my father gave you punishment with whips, but I will give you blows with snakes.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, n baba xa kote xɔrɔxɔ a naxan dɔxɔxi wo ma, n na a xunmasama nɛ. N baba wo bɔnbɔ luxusinyie nan na, kɔnɔ n tan fama wo bɔnbɔde talie nan na.›»

sentences.english: So Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king had given orders, saying, Come to me again on the third day.
sentences.susu: Xi saxan to dangi, Yerobowami nun ɲama naxa siga Robowami yire, naxan nu bara a fala e bɛ, «Xi saxan na dangi, wo xa fa.»

sentences.english: And the king gave them a rough answer. So King Rehoboam gave no attention to the suggestion of the old men,
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Robowami naxa e yaabi a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra. A mu forie xa marasi tongo fefe ma.

sentences.english: But gave them the answer put forward by the young men, saying, My father made your yoke hard, but I will make it harder; my father gave you punishment with whips, but I will give it with snakes.
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi a lanfanmae xa marasi ra, «N baba kote xɔrɔxɔɛ naxan dɔxɔ wo xun ma, n na xunmasama nɛ. N baba wo bɔnbɔ luxusinyie nan na, kɔnɔ n tan fama wo bɔnbɔde talie nan na.»

sentences.english: So the king did not give ear to the people; for this came about by the purpose of God, so that the Lord might give effect to his word which he had said by Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam, the son of Nebat.
sentences.susu: Na kui, mangɛ mu tin a tuli matide ɲama ra. Marigi Alatala nu bara na ragiri alako a xa a xa masenyi rakamali a naxan fala Nebati xa di Yerobowami bɛ Annabi Ahiya Siloka saabui ra.

sentences.english: And when all Israel saw that the king would give no attention to them, the people in answer said to the king, What part have we in David? what is our heritage in the son of Jesse? every man to your tents, O Israel; now see to your house, David. So all Israel went to their tents.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae to a kolon mangɛ mu tin a tuli matide e ra, e naxa a yaabi, «Muxu gbe se mundun na Dawuda yi? Kɛ mu na muxu bɛ Yisayi xa die tagi. Isirayila xa gbilen e xɔnyi. Yakɔsi Dawuda, i xa mɛɛni i xa banxi ma i yɛtɛ ra.»

sentences.english: But Rehoboam was still king over those of the children of Israel who were living in the towns of Judah.
sentences.susu: Isirayila birin naxa gbilen e xɔnyi. Isirayilaka naxee nu sabatixi Yudaya taae kui, e naxa lu Robowami xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: Then Rehoboam sent Adoniram, the overseer of the forced work; and he was stoned to death by all Israel. And King Rehoboam went quickly and got into his carriage to go in flight to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, mangɛ Robowami naxa Hadorami xɛɛ, naxan ɲɛngi nu saxi wali xɔrɔxɔɛ rabafe xɔn ma, kɔnɔ Isirayilakae naxa a magɔnɔ han a faxa. Na kui, mangɛ Robowami naxa a gi keren na sigafe ra Darisalamu a xa sɔɔri ragise kui.

sentences.english: So Israel was turned away from the family of David to this day.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ matandi na ki nɛ. Han to e mu lanxi.

sentences.english: And Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, and got together the men of Judah and Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand of his best fighting-men, to make war against Israel and get the kingdom back for Rehoboam.
sentences.susu: Robowami to so Darisalamu, a naxa Yuda nun Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ sɔɔrie malan, geresoe fanyi wulu kɛmɛ tongo solomasaxan, alako e xa Isirayila gere, Isirayila xa gbilen Robowami xa mangɛya bun ma.

sentences.english: But the word of the Lord came to Shemaiah, the man of God, saying,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala naxa a masen a xa mixi Semaya bɛ,

sentences.english: Say to Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin,
sentences.susu: «A fala Sulemani xa di Robowami bɛ, Yudaya mangɛ, a nun Isirayilakae birin naxee na Yudaya nun Bunyamin bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: The Lord has said, You are not to go to war against your brothers: let every man go back to his house, for this thing is my purpose. So they gave ear to the words of the Lord and were turned back from fighting against Jeroboam.
sentences.susu: ‹Alatala xa masenyi nan yi ki: Wo naxa te de, sigafe ra wo ngaxakerenyie gerede. Wo birin xa gbilen wo xɔnyi, barima n tan nan yi fe ragirixi.›» E naxa Alatala xa wɔyɛnyi rabatu, e gbilen, e mu siga Yerobowami gerede sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Now Rehoboam kept in Jerusalem, building walled towns in Judah.
sentences.susu: Robowami naxa sabati Darisalamu, a taa makantaxie ti Yudaya,

sentences.english: He was the builder of Beth-lehem and Etam and Tekoa
sentences.susu: alɔ Bɛtɛlɛɛmu, Etami, Tekowa,

sentences.english: And Beth-zur and Soco and Adullam
sentences.susu: Beti Suru, Soko, Adulama,

sentences.english: And Gath and Mareshah and Ziph
sentences.susu: Gati, Maresa, Sifi,

sentences.english: And Adoraim and Lachish and Azekah
sentences.susu: Adorayimi, Lakisi, Aseka,

sentences.english: And Zorah and Aijalon and Hebron, walled towns in Judah and Benjamin.
sentences.susu: Soraha, Ayalon, nun Hebiron. Robowami yi taa makantaxie ti Yudaya nun Bunyamin bɔxi nan ma.

sentences.english: And he made the walled towns strong, and he put captains in them and stores of food, oil, and wine.
sentences.susu: A nee yailan a fanyi ra gere ki ma. A sɔɔri xunyie lu naa, a baloe, ture, nun wɛni so e yi ra.

sentences.english: And in every town he put stores of body-covers and spears, and made them very strong. And Judah and Benjamin were his.
sentences.susu: Wure lefa nun tanbɛe nu na e yi ra, e sɛnbɛ nu gbo. Yuda nun Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛe lu nɛ a xa yaamari bun ma na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And the priests and Levites who were in all Israel came together to him from every part of their country.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae naxa keli e xɔnyi Isirayila bɔxi birin ma, e xa fa Yudaya, e kafu Robowami ma.

sentences.english: For the Levites gave up their living-places and their property, and came to Judah and Jerusalem; for Jeroboam and his sons had sent them away, not letting them be priests to the Lord;
sentences.susu: Lewikae nu bara mɛɛ e xa banxie nun e harige ra sigafe ra Yudaya nun Darisalamu, barima Yerobowami nun a xa die mu tin e xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali raba Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And he himself made priests for the high places, and for the images of he-goats and oxen which he had made.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami nu bara sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ti kuye batudee ra geyae fari, yɛxɛɛ kontonyi nun ninge masolixie tixi dɛnnaxɛ kuye ra.

sentences.english: And after them, from all the tribes of Israel, all those whose hearts were fixed and true to the Lord, the God of Israel, came to Jerusalem to make offerings to the Lord, the God of their fathers.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka naxee nu wama e Marigi Alatala batufe, kelife bɔnsɔɛ birin, nee naxa bira Lewikae fɔxɔ ra sigafe ra Darisalamu, alako e xa sɛrɛxɛ ba e babae Marigi Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: So they went on increasing the power of the kingdom of Judah, and made Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, strong for three years; and for three years they went in the ways of David and Solomon.
sentences.susu: Na kui e naxa Sulemani xa di Robowami xa mangɛya mabanban Yudaya ɲɛ saxan bun ma. Na waxati kui, e naxa ɲɛrɛ Dawuda nun Sulemani xa kira xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And Rehoboam took as his wife Mahalath, the daughter of Jerimoth, the son of David and of Abihail, the daughter of Eliab, the son of Jesse;
sentences.susu: Robowami naxa Yerimoti xa di ginɛ Mahalata dɔxɔ. Na ginɛ findi Dawuda xa di xɛmɛ Yerimoti, nun a xa ginɛ Abixayili, xa di ginɛ nan na. Abixayili findi Yisayi xa di xɛmɛ Eliyabi xa di ginɛ nan na.

sentences.english: And she had sons by him, Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
sentences.susu: Mahalata naxa die bari a bɛ: Yeyusu, Sɛmaraya, nun Sahami.

sentences.english: And after her he took Maacah, the daughter of Absalom; and she had Abijah and Attai and Ziza and Shelomith by him.
sentences.susu: Robowami naxa Abisalomi xa di ginɛ Maaka fan dɔxɔ. Maaka naxa Abiya, Atayi, Sisa, nun Selomiti bari a bɛ.

sentences.english: Maacah, the daughter of Absalom, was dearer to Rehoboam than all his wives and his servant-wives: (for he had eighteen wives and sixty servant-wives, and was the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.)
sentences.susu: Abisalomi xa di ginɛ Maaka nu rafan Robowami ma, dangife a xa ginɛe nun a xa konyi ginɛe birin na. Ginɛ fu nun solomasaxan nun konyi ginɛe tongo senni nu na a yi ra. A naxa di xɛmɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun solomasaxan nun di ginɛ tongo senni sɔtɔ na ginɛe ra.

sentences.english: Rehoboam made Abijah, the son of Maacah, chief and ruler among his brothers, for it was his purpose to make him king.
sentences.susu: Robowami naxa Maaka xa di Abiya findi a xa di fisamante ra. A nu wama na nan xa findi mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And in his wisdom he had his sons stationed in every walled town through all the lands of Judah and Benjamin; and he gave them a great store of food, and took wives for them.
sentences.susu: A naxa xaxilimaya raba, a a xa di booree birin nasabati Yudaya nun Bunyamin taa makantaxie kui, a fa baloe nun ginɛ gbegbe fen e bɛ.

sentences.english: Now when Rehoboam's position as king had been made certain, and he was strong, he gave up the law of the Lord, and all Israel with him.
sentences.susu: Robowami xa mangɛya to mabanban, a tan nun Isirayilakae birin naxa Alatala xa sɛriyɛ rabolo.

sentences.english: Now in the fifth year of King Rehoboam, Shishak, king of Egypt, came up against Jerusalem, because of their sin against the Lord,
sentences.susu: Na bara a niya Misira mangɛ Sisaki xa Darisalamu gere Robowami xa mangɛya ɲɛ suuli nde ra.

sentences.english: With twelve hundred war-carriages and sixty thousand horsemen: and the people who came with him out of Egypt were more than might be numbered: Lubim and Sukkiim and Ethiopians.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri ragise wulu keren kɛmɛ firin nun soe ragi wulu tongo senni nan nu na a yi ra. A naxa keli Misira bɔxi ma e nun ɲama gbegbe ra, naxee findixi Libiyakae, Sukikae, nun Etiyopikae ra.

sentences.english: And he took the walled towns of Judah, and came as far as Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: A naxa nɔ Yudaya taa makantaxie ra, a so Darisalamu.

sentences.english: Now Shemaiah the prophet came to Rehoboam and the chiefs of Judah, who had come together in Jerusalem because of Shishak, and said to them, The Lord has said, Because you have given me up, I have given you up into the hands of Shishak.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Annabi Semaya naxa siga Robowami yire. Yudaya yareratie fan nu na naa, barima e fa Darisalamu Sisaki xa fe nan na. A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: ‹Wo bara n nabɛɲin, n fan wo rabɛɲinma Sisaki sagoe.›»

sentences.english: Then the chiefs of Israel and the king made themselves low and said, The Lord is upright.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ nun yareratie naxa e magoro Alatala bɛ, e fa a fala, «Alatala tinxin.»

sentences.english: And the Lord, seeing that they had made themselves low, said to Shemaiah, They have made themselves low: I will not send destruction on them, but in a short time I will give them salvation, and will not let loose my wrath on Jerusalem by the hand of Shishak.
sentences.susu: Alatala to a to e bara e magoro a bɛ, a naxa a masen Semaya bɛ, «E to bara e yɛtɛ magoro n bɛ, n mu fama e halakide. A gbe mu luxi n xa e rakisi. N ma xɔnɛ mu fama lude Darisalamu ma Sisaki saabui ra.

sentences.english: But still they will become his servants, so that they may see how different my yoke is from the yoke of the kingdoms of the lands.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e xa lu Sisaki xa nɔɛ bun ma sinden, han e xa a kolon, si gbɛtɛe xa mangɛya rabatufe nun Ala xa mangɛya rabatufe, naxan fan.»

sentences.english: So Shishak, king of Egypt, came up against Jerusalem and took away all the stored wealth of the house of the Lord and the king's house: he took everything away, and with the rest the gold body-covers which Solomon had made.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ Sisaki naxa te Darisalamu gerede. A naxa naafuli birin tongo naxan nu na Alatala xa banxi nun mangɛ xa banxi kui. A naxa wure lefae fan tongo, Sulemani nu bara naxee maso xɛɛma ra.

sentences.english: And in their place King Rehoboam had other body-covers made of brass and gave them into the care of the captains of the armed men who were stationed at the door of the king's house.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Robowami naxa e ɲɔxɔɛ yailan yɔxui ra, a e taxu sɔɔri mangɛe ra naxee mangɛ xa banxi naadɛe makantama.

sentences.english: And whenever the king went into the house of the Lord, the armed men went with him taking the body-covers, and then took them back to their room.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nu sigama Ala xa banxi kui tɛmui naxɛ, sɔɔrie nu na wure lefae xaninma a mati ra. E na gɛ na ra, e man nu fa e ragbilen sɔɔri banxi kui.

sentences.english: And when he made himself low, the wrath of the Lord was turned back from him, and complete destruction did not come on him, for there was still some good in Judah.
sentences.susu: Robowami to bara a magoro Alatala bɛ, a mu gbaloe sɔtɔ Alatala xa xɔnɛ saabui ra. Na waxati Ala yaragaaxui fanyi nde nu na Yudaya.

sentences.english: So King Rehoboam made himself strong in Jerusalem and was ruling there. Rehoboam was forty-one years old when he became king, and he was ruling for seventeen years in Jerusalem, the town which the Lord had made his out of all the tribes of Israel, to put his name there; and his mother's name was Naamah, an Ammonite woman.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Robowami mangɛya sɔtɔxi tɛmui naxɛ, a nu bara ɲɛ tongo naani nun keren sɔtɔ simaya ra. A naxa Isirayila yaamari ɲɛ fu nun solofere Darisalamu kui, Alatala taa naxan sugandi Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin ya ma, alako a xili xa matɔxɔ naa. Robowami nga Amonika nan nu a ra, a xili nɛ Naama.

sentences.english: And he did evil because his heart was not true to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Robowami fe ɲaaxi raba nɛ, barima a mu Alatala fen a bɔɲɛ birin na.

sentences.english: Now the acts of Rehoboam, first and last, are they not recorded in the words of Shemaiah the prophet and Iddo the seer? And there were wars between Rehoboam and Jeroboam all their days.
sentences.susu: Robowami xa taruxui, a fɔlɛ nun a raɲɔnyi birin sɛbɛxi Annabi Semaya xa taruxui kui, a nun Annabi Ido xa laamatunyi masenyi sɛbɛxi kui, alako mixi xa a kolon.

sentences.english: And Rehoboam went to rest with his fathers, and was put into the earth in the town of David; and Abijah his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Robowami to laaxira, e naxa a ragata a babae sɛɛti ma Dawuda xa taa kui. A xa di Abiya naxa ti a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam, Abijah became king over Judah.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun solomasaxan nde ra, Abiya naxa ti mangɛ ra Yudaya.

sentences.english: He was king in Jerusalem for three years; his mother's name was Maacah, the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya bu nɛ ɲɛ saxan Darisalamu. A nga nu xili nɛ Mikayahu, Uriyeli Gibeyaka xa di ginɛ. Gere naxa sin Abiya nun Yerobowami tagi.

sentences.english: And Abijah went out to the fight with an army of men of war, four hundred thousand of his best men; and Jeroboam put his forces in line against him, eight hundred thousand of his best men of war.
sentences.susu: Abiya naxa gere rakeli, a tan nun sɔɔri fanyi xɛmɛ wulu kɛmɛ naani, kɔnɔ Yerobowami naxa sɔɔri fanyi xɛmɛ wulu kɛmɛ solomasaxan ti a ya ra.

sentences.english: And Abijah took up his position on Mount Zemaraim, in the hill-country of Ephraim, and said, Give ear to me, O Jeroboam and all Israel:
sentences.susu: Abiya naxa te Sɛmarayima geya fari, Efirami geyae ma, a fa a fala, «Yerobowami nun Isirayilakae, wo wo tuli mati n na.

sentences.english: Is it not clear to you that the Lord, the God of Israel, gave the rule over Israel to David and to his sons for ever, by an agreement made with salt?
sentences.susu: Wo mu a kolon Isirayila Marigi Alatala bara Isirayila mangɛya fi Dawuda nun a xa die ma abadan? Na saatɛ mu nɔma kanade.

sentences.english: But Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon, the son of David, took up arms against his lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Yerobowami, naxan findixi Dawuda xa di Sulemani xa walikɛ Nebati xa di ra naxa keli, a a marigi matandi.

sentences.english: And certain foolish and good-for-nothing men were joined with him, and made themselves strong against Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, when he was young and untested and not able to keep them back.
sentences.susu: Mixi rabɛɲinxi ndee naxa a rabilin, e nɔɛ dɛrɛn Robowami ma, Sulemani xa di naxan mu nu gɛxi mɔde, naxan xa maɲɔxunyi xɔn mu nu kuyaxi. Na kui Robowami mu nɔ e ra.»

sentences.english: And now it is your purpose to put yourselves against the authority which the Lord has put into the hands of the sons of David, and you are a very great number, and you have with you the gold oxen which Jeroboam made to be your gods.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi, wo tixi a xa mangɛya nan kanke, Alatala naxan taxuxi Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ ra. Sɔɔri gbegbe na wo yi ra. Ninge masolixie fan na wo yi ra, Yerobowami naxee yailanxi wo bɛ xɛɛma ra. E bara findi wo xa alae ra.

sentences.english: And after driving out the priests of the Lord, the sons of Aaron and the Levites, have you not made priests for yourselves as the people of other lands do? so that anyone who comes to make himself priest by offering an ox or seven sheep, may be a priest of those who are no gods.
sentences.susu: Na kui wo bara Haruna xa die rabolo, Alatala naxee tixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra. Wo bara wo yɛtɛ findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra, alɔ si gbɛtɛe a rabama ki naxɛ. Mixi yo naxan fama tuura lanma nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi solofere ra, alako a xa na wali raba, wo na tima sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra ala nde bɛ naxan mu findixi Ala ra.»

sentences.english: But as for us, the Lord is our God, and we have not been turned away from him; we have priests who do the work of the Lord, even the sons of Aaron and the Levites in their places;
sentences.susu: «Alatala nan na muxu tan Marigi Ala ra. Muxu mu a raboloxi, muxu man bara tin Haruna xa die xa findi Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra, Lewikae fan xa e xa wali raba.

sentences.english: By whom burned offerings and perfumes are sent up in smoke before the Lord every morning and every evening; and they put out the holy bread on its table and the gold support for the lights with its lights burning every evening; for we keep the orders given to us by the Lord our God, but you have gone away from him.
sentences.susu: Gɛɛsɛgɛ yo gɛɛsɛgɛ, nunmare yo nunmare, muxu sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie bama Alatala bɛ, muxu surayi ganma sɛrɛxɛ ra, muxu taami sɛrɛxɛ sama Ala xa teebili sɛniyɛnxi fari, muxu lanpui xɛɛma daaxi radɛxɛma nunmare yo nunmare, barima muxu tan birama muxu Marigi Alatala xa sɛriyɛ nan fɔxɔ ra. Kɔnɔ wo tan, wo bara a rabolo.

sentences.english: And now God is with us at our head, and his priests with their loud horns sounding against you. O children of Israel, do not make war on the Lord, the God of your fathers, for it will not go well for you.
sentences.susu: Ala nun a xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nan na muxu xunyie ra. Sarae na muxu yi ra naxee nɔma xui xungbe raminide alako gere xa ramaxa wo xili ma. Isirayila xa die, wo naxa wo babae Marigi Alatala gere. Wo mu xunnakeli sɔtɔma na kui.»

sentences.english: But Jeroboam had put some of his men to make a surprise attack on them from the back, so some were facing Judah and others were stationed secretly at their back.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami xa sɔɔrie naxa Yudayakae bilin. Ndee nu na e ya ra, ndee nu na e xanbi ra.

sentences.english: And Judah, turning their faces, saw that they were being attacked in front and at the back; and they gave a cry for help to the Lord, while the priests were sounding their horns.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae to a to gere na e ya ra, a man na e xanbi ra, e naxa Alatala xili e xui itexi ra, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe fa sarae fe.

sentences.english: And the men of Judah gave a loud cry; and at their cry, God put fear into Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and Judah.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae to e xui ite, Alatala naxa Yerobowami nun Isirayilakae bɔnbɔ Abiya nun Yudayakae ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel went in flight before Judah, and God gave them up into their hands.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxa e gi Yudayakae ma, Ala naxa e sa Yudaya sagoe.

sentences.english: And Abijah and his people put them to death with great destruction: five hundred thousand of the best of Israel were put to the sword.
sentences.susu: Abiya nun a xa ɲama naxa Isirayila xa sɔɔri fanyi wulu kɛmɛ suuli faxa na gere kui.

sentences.english: So at that time the children of Israel were overcome, and the children of Judah got the better of them, because they put their faith in the Lord, the God of their fathers.
sentences.susu: Na findi nɛ yaagi ra Isirayilakae bɛ. Yudayakae tan xun nakeli nɛ, barima e babae Marigi Alatala nu bara e mali.

sentences.english: And Abijah went after Jeroboam and took some of his towns, Beth-el with its small towns and Jeshanah with its small towns and Ephron with its small towns.
sentences.susu: Abiya naxa bira Yerobowami fɔxɔ ra, a fa taae rasuxu a yi ra, alɔ Beteli, Yesana, Eferon, nun e rabilinyie.

sentences.english: And Jeroboam did not get back his power again in the life-time of Abijah; and the Lord sent death on him.
sentences.susu: Yerobowami mu sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ Abiya xa waxati. Alatala nan a bɔnbɔ, a naxa faxa.

sentences.english: But Abijah became great, and had fourteen wives, and became the father of twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Abiya xa mangɛya mabanban nɛ a fanyi ra. Ginɛ fu nun naani nu na a yi ra. E di xɛmɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin bari, nun di ginɛ fu nun senni.

sentences.english: And the rest of the acts of Abijah, and his ways and his sayings, are recorded in the account of the prophet Iddo.
sentences.susu: Abiya xa taruxui gbɛtɛe, a naxan nabaxi nun a naxan falaxi, a sɛbɛxi Annabi Ido xa taruxui sɛbɛxi kui.

sentences.english: So Abijah went to rest with his fathers, and they put him into the earth in the town of David, and Asa his son became king in his place; in his time the land was quiet for ten years.
sentences.susu: Asa naxa fe fanyi raba tinxinyi kui a Marigi Alatala ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the Lord his God;
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛbadee kana yire itexie kuye nu batuma dɛnnaxɛ. A man naxa kuye gɛmɛe nun Aseri wuri masolixie kana.

sentences.english: For he took away the altars of strange gods and the high places, and had the upright stones broken and the wood pillars cut down;
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Yuda bɔnsɔɛ bɛ a e xa e babae Marigi Alatala fen, e xa a xa sɛriyɛ nun a xa yaamarie rabatu.

sentences.english: And he made Judah go after the Lord, the God of their fathers, and keep his laws and his orders.
sentences.susu: Asa naxa kuye batude birin kana Yudaya bɔxi ma, a nun sɛrɛxɛbadee surayi nu ganma dɛnnaxɛ kuyee bɛ. A xa mangɛya lu nɛ bɔɲɛsa kui a xa waxati.

sentences.english: And he took away the high places and the sun-images from all the towns of Judah; and the kingdom was quiet under his rule.
sentences.susu: A naxa taa makantaxie ti Yudaya, bɔɲɛsa nu na bɔxi birin ma. Gere yo mu nu na naa na ɲɛe bun ma Alatala saabui ra.

sentences.english: He made walled towns in Judah, for the land was quiet and there were no wars in those years, because the Lord had given him rest.
sentences.susu: Asa naxa a fala Yudayakae bɛ, «Won xa yi taae yailan alako e xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ. Won xa tɛtɛe nun wure naadɛ ti. Han ya yi bɔxi findixi won gbe nan na, barima won bara won Marigi Alatala fen. Na bara a niya won xa lu bɔɲɛsa kui yi waxati.» Na kui e naxa bɔnbɔ wali ra, na birin naxa sɔɔnɛya.

sentences.english: He said to Judah, Let us make these towns, building walls round them with towers and doors and locks. The land is still ours, because we have been true to the Lord our God; we have been true to him and he has given us rest on every side. So they went on building and all went well for them.
sentences.susu: Yudaya sɔɔri xɛmɛ wulu kɛmɛ saxan nu na Asa yi ra. Wure lefa xungbee nun tanbɛe nu na e yi ra. Bunyamin sɔɔri xɛmɛ wulu kɛmɛ firin tongo solomasaxan fan nu na. Wure lefa lanmadie nun xalie nu na e yi ra. E birin findi gereso ɲalamae ra.

sentences.english: And Asa had an army of three hundred thousand men of Judah armed with body-covers and spears, and two hundred and eighty thousand of Benjamin armed with body-covers and bows; all these were men of war.
sentences.susu: Sera Kusika naxa mini e gerede sɔɔri gali ra. Sɔɔri ragise kɛmɛ saxan nu na e yi ra. E naxa siga han Maresa.

sentences.english: And Zerah the Ethiopian, with an army of a million, and three hundred war-carriages, came out against them to Mareshah.
sentences.susu: Asa fan naxa siga naa e gerede. E birin naxa ti gere ki ma Sɛfata gulunba Maresa mabiri.

sentences.english: And Asa went out against him, and they put their forces in position in the valley north of Mareshah.
sentences.susu: Asa naxa a Marigi Alatala maxandi, «Alatala, i maniyɛ mu na naxan nɔma sɛnbɛtare malide sɛnbɛmae ya i. Muxu Marigi Alatala, i xa muxu mali. Muxu bara muxu xaxili ti i ra yi gere xungbe xa fe ra. Alatala i tan nan na muxu Marigi Ala ra. I naxa tin mixi yo xa nɔ i ra.»

sentences.english: And Asa made prayer to the Lord his God and said, Lord, you only are able to give help against the strong to him who has no strength; come to our help, O Lord our God, for our hope is in you, and in your name we have come out against this great army. O Lord, you are our God; let not man's power be greater than yours.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Kusikae bɔnbɔ Asa nun Yudayakae ya xɔri, e naxa e gi.

sentences.english: So the Lord sent fear on the Ethiopians before Asa and Judah; and the Ethiopians went in flight.
sentences.susu: Asa nun a xa sɔɔri gali naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra han Gerara. Kusika gbegbe naxa faxa. E mu nɔ e yɛtɛ sɔtɔde sɔnɔn, barima Alatala nun a xa sɛnbɛmae nu bara gɛ e xun nakanade. Yudayakae naxa harige gbegbe xanin.

sentences.english: And Asa and the people who were with him went after them as far as Gerar; and so great was the destruction among the Ethiopians that they were not able to get their army together again, for they were broken before the Lord and before his army; and they took away a great amount of their goods.
sentences.susu: E naxa taae birin kana Gerara rabilinyie, barima mɛnnikae mu suusa Alatala ya ra. E naxa harige gbegbe ba e yi ra barima bannaya nu na mɛnni ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And they overcame all the towns round Gerar, because the Lord sent fear on them; and they took away their goods from the towns, for there were stores of wealth in them.
sentences.susu: E naxa xuruse kanyie fan suxu, e xurusee nun ɲɔxɔmɛe ba e yi ra, e gbilen Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And the spirit of God came on Azariah, the son of Oded;
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili to goro Odedi xa di Asaraya ma,

sentences.english: And he came face to face with Asa and said to him, Give ear to me, Asa and all Judah and Benjamin: the Lord is with you while you are with him; if your heart's desire is for him, he will be near you, but if you give him up, he will give you up.
sentences.susu: a naxa siga Asa yire, a a masen a bɛ, «Asa, Yudayakae, nun Bunyaminkae, wo wo tuli mati n na. Xa wo bira Alatala fɔxɔ ra, a fan na wo fɔxɔ ra. Xa wo a fen, wo a toma nɛ. Kɔnɔ xa wo a rabolo, a fan wo raboloma nɛ.

sentences.english: Now for a long time Israel has been without the true God, and without a teaching priest and without the law;
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ wuyaxi Isirayila mu Ala ɲiɲɛ fen. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ mu nu na naxan e xaranma. Sɛriyɛ mu nu na bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: But when in their trouble they were turned to the Lord, the God of Israel, searching after him, he let their search be rewarded.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e xa tɔɔrɛ kui, e naxa gbilen Isirayila Marigi Alatala ma. E to a fen, a naxa tin e xa a to.

sentences.english: In those times there was no peace for him who went out or for him who came in, but great trouble was on all the people of the lands.
sentences.susu: Na waxati mixi mu nu ɲɛrɛma bɔɲɛsa kui, barima fe xɔrɔxɔɛ nu na bɔxi birin ma.

sentences.english: And they were broken by divisions, nation against nation and town against town, because God sent all sorts of trouble on them.
sentences.susu: Sie nu e boore gerema, taae nu e boore gerema. Ala nan na tɔɔrɛ mɔɔli birin niyaxi e ra.

sentences.english: But be you strong and let not your hands be feeble, for your work will be rewarded.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan, wo wo sɛnbɛ so, wo wo tunnabɛxi, barima wo xa wali sare fama nɛ ragbilende wo ma.»

sentences.english: And Asa, hearing these words of Azariah, the son of Oded the prophet, took heart and put away all the disgusting things out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the towns which he had taken from the hill-country of Ephraim; and he made new again the altar of the Lord in front of the covered way of the Lord's house.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Asa to Annabi Odedi xa namiɲɔnmɛ masenyi mɛ, a naxa limaniya, a fa kuye birin kana Yudaya nun Bunyamin bɔxi ma, a nun a taa naxee masɔtɔ Efirami geya yire. A man naxa Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan, naxan nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi ya ra.

sentences.english: And he got together all Judah and Benjamin and those of Ephraim and Manasseh and Simeon who were living with them; for numbers of them came to him out of Israel when they saw that the Lord his God was with him.
sentences.susu: A naxa Yudayakae nun Bunyaminkae birin malan, a nun xɔɲɛ naxee kelixi Efirami, Manasi, nun Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛe xa bɔxie ma. Kabi e naxa a to Marigi Alatala nu na nee sɛɛti ma, xɔɲɛ gbegbe naxa kafu e ma kelife Isirayila bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: So they came together at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the rule of Asa.
sentences.susu: Na malanyi raba Darisalamu nɛ kike saxan nde Asa xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun suuli nde ra.

sentences.english: And that day they made offerings to the Lord of the things they had taken in war, seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ e naxa xuruse xungbe kɛmɛ solofere nun xuruse lanma wulu solofere ba sɛrɛxɛ ra Alatala bɛ. E nee sɔtɔ na gere nan kui.

sentences.english: And they made an agreement to be true to the Lord, the God of their fathers, with all their heart and all their soul;
sentences.susu: E naxa natɛ tongo e xa e babae Marigi Alatala fen e bɔɲɛ nun e nii birin na.

sentences.english: And that anyone, small or great, man or woman, who was not true to the Lord, the God of Israel, would be put to death.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo tondi Isirayila Marigi Alatala fende, na kanyi lan nɛ a xa faxa, dimɛdi yo, fori yo, xɛmɛ yo, xa na mu ginɛ.

sentences.english: And they made an oath to the Lord, with a loud voice, sounding wind-instruments and horns.
sentences.susu: E naxa e rakali Alatala ra e xui itexi ra, e fa sarae nun feri fe.

sentences.english: And all Judah was glad because of the oath, for they had taken it with all their heart, turning to the Lord with all their desire; and he was with them and gave them rest on every side.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae birin naxa sɛɛwa yi marakali ra, barima e a rabaxi e bɔɲɛ birin nan na. E nu bara Alatala fen sɔɔbɛ ra, a tan nan bara tin e xa a to. Alatala naxa bɔɲɛsa lu e xa bɔxi birin ma.

sentences.english: And Asa would not let Maacah, his mother, be queen, because she had made a disgusting image for Asherah; and Asa had her image cut down and broken up and burned by the stream Kidron.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Asa man naxa a mama Maaka tide magoro, barima a nu bara Asera kuye yailan. Asa naxa a xa kuye yensen, a fa a gan Sediron gulunba kui.

sentences.english: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel; but still the heart of Asa was true to the Lord all his life.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ hali Asa to nu bara a yɛtɛ fi Alatala ma a xa simaya birin kui, a mu gɛ kuye batudee birin kanade Isirayila geyae fari.

sentences.english: He took into the house of God all the things which his father had made holy and those which he himself had made holy, silver and gold and vessels.
sentences.susu: A naxa gbeti, xɛɛma, nun se gbɛtɛe raso Ala xa banxi kui, a tan nun a baba naxee fixi Ala ma.

sentences.english: And there was no more war till the thirty-fifth year of the rule of Asa.
sentences.susu: Gere yo mu lu Isirayila bɔxi ma, han Asa xa mangɛya ɲɛ tongo saxan nun suuli nde.

sentences.english: In the thirty-sixth year of the rule of Asa, Baasha, king of Israel, went up against Judah, building Ramah so that no one was able to go out or in to Asa, king of Judah.
sentences.susu: Asa xa mangɛya ɲɛ tongo saxan nun senni nde, Isirayila mangɛ Baasa naxa te Yudaya gerede. A naxa Rama yailan, alako Yudaya mangɛ Asa nun a xa mixie naxa fɛɛrɛ sɔtɔ sofe ra mɛnni e xa e keri.

sentences.english: Then Asa took silver and gold out of the stores of the Lord's house and of the king's store-house, and sent to Ben-hadad, king of Aram, at Damascus, saying,
sentences.susu: Asa naxa gbeti nun xɛɛma tongo Alatala xa banxi nun mangɛ xa banxi kui, a fa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Siriya mangɛ Ben Hadada yire Damasi yi masenyi ra,

sentences.english: Let there be an agreement between me and you as there was between my father and your father: see, I have sent you silver and gold; go and put an end to your agreement with Baasha, king of Israel, so that he may give up attacking me.
sentences.susu: «Won xa saatɛ xiri won tagi alɔ n baba nun i baba a raba ki naxɛ. Sanba se nan ya, xɛɛma nun gbeti, saatɛ kana naxan ma i nun Baasa tagi, alako a xa makuya n na.»

sentences.english: And Ben-hadad did as King Asa said, and sent the captains of his armies against the towns of Israel, attacking Ijon and Dan and Abel-maim, and all the store-towns of Naphtali.
sentences.susu: Ben Hadada naxa tin mangɛ Asa xa masenyi ra. A naxa a xa sɔɔri xunyie xɛɛ Isirayila taae suxude. E naxa Iyono, Dana, nun Abeli Mayimi suxu, a nun taa gbɛtɛe baloe nu ragatama dɛnnaxɛ Nafatali bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Then Baasha, hearing of it, put a stop to the building of Ramah, and let his work come to an end.
sentences.susu: Baasa to na fe mɛ, a naxa Rama taa tife wali iti.

sentences.english: Then King Asa, with all Judah, took away the stones and wood with which Baasha was building Ramah, and he made use of them for building Geba and Mizpah.
sentences.susu: Na wali to iti, mangɛ Asa naxa fa Yudayakae ra, e fa gɛmɛe nun wurie xanin, Baasa nu naxee rawalima Rama. E naxa na birin nawali Geba nun Misipa tife ra.

sentences.english: At that time Hanani the seer came to Asa, king of Judah, and said to him, Because you have put your faith in the king of Aram and not in the Lord your God, the army of the king of Aram has got away out of your hands.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Annabi Xanani naxa siga Yudaya mangɛ Asa xɔn, a a fala a bɛ, «I to i xaxili ti Siriya mangɛ ra i Marigi Alatala ɲɔxɔɛ ra, Siriya xa sɔɔrie bara gɛ e yɛtɛ sɔtɔde i ya ra.

sentences.english: Were not the Ethiopians and the Lubim a very great army, with war-carriages and horsemen more than might be numbered? but because your faith was in the Lord, he gave them up into your hands.
sentences.susu: Kusikae nun Libiyakae xa sɔɔri gali gbo, sɔɔri ragise nun soe na e yi ra. Kɔnɔ Alatala mu e sa i sago xɛ i i xaxili ti a ra tɛmui naxɛ?

sentences.english: For the eyes of the Lord go this way and that, through all the earth, letting it be seen that he is the strong support of those whose hearts are true to him. In this you have done foolishly, for from now you will have wars.
sentences.susu: Alatala adamadi birin matoma nɛ alako a xa a kolon naxee e bɔɲɛ fixi a ma. I bara lu alɔ xaxilitare yi fe kui. Yakɔsi gere luma nɛ i xa bɔxi ma tɛmui birin.»

sentences.english: Then Asa was angry with the seer, and put him in prison, burning with wrath against him because of this thing. And at the same time Asa was cruel to some of the people.
sentences.susu: Asa naxa xɔnɔ na namiɲɔnmɛ ma, a fa a raso geeli kui, a nun mixi gbɛtɛ naxee mu rafanxi a ma.

sentences.english: Now the acts of Asa, first and last, are recorded in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
sentences.susu: Asa xa taruxui, a fɔlɛ nun a raɲɔnyi, a sɛbɛxi Yudaya nun Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: In the thirty-ninth year of his rule, Asa had a very bad disease of the feet; but he did not go to the Lord for help in his disease, but to medical men.
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya ɲɛ tongo saxan nun solomanaani nde, fure ɲaaxi naxa Asa suxu a sanyie ma. Na kui a mu Alatala fen, a seribae gbansan nan fen na fure xa fe ra.

sentences.english: So Asa went to rest with his fathers, and death came to him in the forty-first year of his rule.
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya ɲɛ tongo naani nun keren nde, Asa naxa laaxiraya.

sentences.english: And they put him into the resting-place which he had made for himself in the town of David, in a bed full of sweet perfumes of all sorts of spices, made by the perfumer's art, and they made a great burning for him.
sentences.susu: E naxa a ragata a xa gaburi gexi kui Dawuda xa taa. E naxa a bɛlɛ sade nde ma, labundɛ fanyi nu saxi dɛnnaxɛ ma. Surayi gbegbe fan naxa gan a fure bɛ.

sentences.english: And Jehoshaphat his son became king in his place, and made himself strong against Israel.
sentences.susu: Asa xa di Yehosafati naxa ti mangɛ ra a baba ɲɔxɔɛ ra. A naxa a sɛnbɛ so Isirayila xili ma.

sentences.english: He put forces in all the walled towns of Judah, and responsible chiefs in the land of Judah and in the towns of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɔɔrie lu Yudaya taa makantaxie birin kui. A man naxa e lu taae kui, a baba nu bara naxee sɔtɔ Yudaya nun Efirami bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord was with Jehoshaphat, because he went in the early ways of his father, not turning to the Baals,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Yehosafati mali, barima a nu ɲɛrɛma a baba Dawuda xa kira singe nan xɔn, a mu Bali kuye batu.

sentences.english: But turning to the God of his father and keeping his laws, and not doing as Israel did.
sentences.susu: A nu a baba Marigi Ala nan batuma, a bira a xa yaamarie fɔxɔ ra, Isirayila mu nu tinma naxee ra.

sentences.english: So the Lord made his kingdom strong; and all Judah gave offerings to Jehoshaphat, and he had great wealth and honour.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Yehosafati xa mangɛya mabanban, Yudayakae birin nu fama buɲae ra a xɔn. A xa naafuli nun a xili fanyi naxa gbo.

sentences.english: His heart was lifted up in the ways of the Lord; and he went so far as to take away the high places and the wood pillars out of Judah.
sentences.susu: A bɔɲɛ naxa bira Alatala fɔxɔ ra. A naxa kuye batudee kana Yudaya geyae fari, a man naxa Aseri kuye wuri daaxie kana na.

sentences.english: In the third year of his rule he sent Benhail and Obadiah and Zechariah and Nethanel and Micaiah, his captains, as teachers into the towns of Judah;
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya ɲɛ saxan nde, a naxa a xa kuntigie Ben Xayili, Abadiyasi, Sakari, Netaneeli, nun Mike xɛɛ mixie xarande Yudaya taae kui.

sentences.english: And with them, Shemaiah and Nethaniah and Zebadiah and Asahel and Shemiramoth and Jehonathan and Adonijah and Tobijah and Tob-adonijah, the Levites; and Elishama and Jehoram the priests.
sentences.susu: Lewikae xilie nan ya, naxee siga e matide: Semaya, Netaniya, Sebadaya, Asahɛli, Semiramoti, Yonatan, Adoniya, Tobiya, Tobo Adoniya. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xilie nan ya, naxee siga e matide: Elisama nun Yehorami.

sentences.english: And they gave teaching in Judah and had the book of the law of the Lord with them; they went through all the towns of Judah teaching the people.
sentences.susu: E naxa Alatala xa kitaabui xanin e xɔn ma, e xa Tawureta Munsa xaran mixie bɛ Yudaya taa birin kui.

sentences.english: And the fear of the Lord was on all the kingdoms of the lands round Judah, so that they made no wars against Jehoshaphat.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa yaragaaxui naxa lu si gbɛtɛe yi ra Yudaya rabilinyi, e mu Yehosafati gere sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And some of the Philistines took offerings to Jehoshaphat, and made him payments of silver; and the Arabians gave him flocks, seven thousand, seven hundred sheep, and seven thousand, seven hundred he-goats.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae naxa fa buɲae nun duuti ra Yehosafati xɔn. Arabue fan naxa fa yɛxɛɛ kontonyi wulu solofere kɛmɛ solofere ra, a nun sikɔtɛ wulu solofere kɛmɛ solofere.

sentences.english: Jehoshaphat became greater and greater, and made strong towers and store-towns in Judah.
sentences.susu: Yehosafati xa fe nu tema a fanyi ra. A naxa yire makantaxie ti Yudaya, a nun taa gbɛtɛe baloe ragatama dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: He had much property in the towns of Judah; he had forces of armed men, great and strong, in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Baloe gbegbe nu na a yi ra Yudaya taae kui. A xa sɔɔrie fan nu wuya Darisalamu.

sentences.english: This is the number of them, listed by their families, the captains of thousands of Judah: Adnah, the captain, and with him three hundred thousand men of war;
sentences.susu: Na sɔɔrie xasabi nan ya e denbaya ki ma: fatanfe Yuda bɔnsɔɛ ra, sɔɔri wulu wulu mangɛ Adina, a nun a xa sɔɔri ɲalama mixi wulu kɛmɛ saxan.

sentences.english: Second to him Jehohanan, the captain, and with him two hundred and eighty thousand;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Yehoxanan nu na a sɛɛti ma, a nun xɛmɛ wulu kɛmɛ firin xɛmɛ wulu tongo solomasaxan.

sentences.english: After him Amasiah, the son of Zichri, who freely gave himself to the Lord, and with him two hundred thousand men of war;
sentences.susu: Sikiri xa di Amasiya fan nu na a sɛɛti ma, a nun a xa sɔɔri ɲalama wulu kɛmɛ firin. Amasiya nu bara a yɛtɛ fi Alatala ma.

sentences.english: And the captains of Benjamin: Eliada, a great man of war, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bows and body-covers;
sentences.susu: Fatanfe Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ ra, sɔɔri ɲalama Eliyada, a nun a xa sɔɔri wulu kɛmɛ firin nu na. Xalie nun wure lefae nu na e yi ra.

sentences.english: And after him Jehozabad, and with him a hundred and eighty thousand trained for war.
sentences.susu: Yehosabadi nu na a sɛɛti ma, a nun a xa sɔɔri wulu kɛmɛ wulu tongo solomasaxan. Geresose fan nu na e yi ra.

sentences.english: These were the men who were waiting on the king, in addition to those placed by the king in the walled towns through all Judah.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔrie nan na ki naxee nu na mangɛ bun ma, bafe naxee nu na Yudaya taa makantaxie kui.

sentences.english: Now Jehoshaphat had great wealth and honour, and his son was married to Ahab's daughter.
sentences.susu: Yehosafati naxa bannaya nun binyɛ gbegbe sɔtɔ. A naxa saatɛ xiri e nun Isirayila mangɛ Axabi tagi futi nde saabui ra.

sentences.english: And after some years he went down to Samaria to see Ahab. And Ahab made a feast for him and the people who were with him, putting to death great numbers of sheep and oxen; and he got Jehoshaphat to go with him to Ramoth-gilead.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ ndee to dangi, a naxa siga Axabi yire Samari. Axabi naxa xuruse lanmae nun a xungbe gbegbe ba sɛrɛxɛ ra a bɛ nun a xa mixie bɛ. A naxa a maxandi a xa bira a fɔxɔ ra sigafe ra Ramoti gerede Galadi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: For Ahab, king of Israel, said to Jehoshaphat, king of Judah, Will you go with me to Ramoth-gilead? And he said, I am as you are, and my people as your people; we will be with you in the war.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ Axabi naxa a fala Yudaya mangɛ Yehosafati bɛ, «Won birin na a ra sigafe ra Ramoti Galadi bɔxi ma?» Yehosafati naxa a yaabi, «Iyo, i tan yo n tan yo, won birin keren. Won ma ɲamae fan birin keren. Won birin nan sigama gere sode.»

sentences.english: Then Jehoshaphat said to the king of Israel, Let us now get directions from the Lord.
sentences.susu: Yehosafati naxa a fala Isirayila mangɛ bɛ, «Yakɔsi n bara i maxandi, won xa Alatala sagoe fen yi fe kui.»

sentences.english: So the king of Israel got together all the prophets, four hundred men, and said to them, Am I to go to Ramoth-gilead to make war or not? And they said, Go up: for God will give it into the hands of the king.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ naxa namiɲɔnmɛ kɛmɛ naani malan, a e maxɔrin, «A a lanma ka a mu lanma won xa siga Ramoti gerede Galadi bɔxi ma?» E naxa a yaabi, «Wo te, Ala fama e sade i sagoe mangɛ.»

sentences.english: But Jehoshaphat said, Is there no other prophet of the Lord here from whom we may get directions?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Yehosafati naxa mangɛ maxɔrin, «Alatala xa namiɲɔnmɛ nde mu na be, won nɔma naxan maxɔrinde?»

sentences.english: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, There is still one man by whom we may get directions from the Lord, but I have no love for him, because he has never been a prophet of good to me, but only of evil: he is Micaiah, the son of Imla. And Jehoshaphat said, Let not the king say so.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ naxa Yehosafati yaabi, «Xɛmɛ keren peti nan be, won nɔma Alatala maxɔrinde naxan saabui ra, kɔnɔ a mu rafan n ma, barima a gbaloe fe nan gbansan falama n ma fe ra. A mu xun nakeli fe yo falama n bɛ. A xili Mike. Yimila xa di na a ra.» Yehosafati naxa a fala, «A mu lanma mangɛ xa yi wɔyɛn mɔɔli fala.»

sentences.english: Then the king of Israel sent for one of his unsexed servants and said, Go quickly and come back with Micaiah, the son of Imla.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isirayila mangɛ naxa a xa batula keren xili, a a fala a bɛ, «Fa Yimila xa di Mike ra n bɛ keren na.»

sentences.english: Now the king of Israel and Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah, were seated on their seats of authority, dressed in their robes, by the doorway into Samaria; and all the prophets were acting as prophets before them.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ nun Yudaya mangɛ Yehosafati nu dɔxɔxi e xa kibanyie kui, mangɛ donmae ragoroxi e ma. E nu na lonyi ma, Samari taa sode dɛ ra. Namiɲɔnmɛe nu na e xa masenyie tife e bɛ.

sentences.english: And Zedekiah, the son of Chenaanah, made himself iron horns and said, The Lord says, Pushing back the Aramaeans with these, you will put an end to them completely.
sentences.susu: Kenaana xa di sedekiya nu bara feri wure daaxie yailan, a fa a fala mangɛe bɛ, «Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Wo Siriyakae bɔnbɔma yi ferie nan na han e sɔntɔ.»

sentences.english: And all the prophets said the same thing, saying, Go up to Ramoth-gilead, and it will go well for you, for the Lord will give it into the hands of the king.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ birin nu na masenyi mɔɔli nan falama e bɛ. E naxa a fala, «Wo te Ramoti Galadi bɔxi ma. Wo xun nakeli nan sɔtɔma, Alatala fama e sade mangɛ sagoe.»

sentences.english: Now the servant who had gone to get Micaiah said to him, See now, all the prophets with one voice are saying good things to the king; so let your words be like theirs, and say good things.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛra naxan siga Mike xilide, na naxa a fala a bɛ, «I bara a to, namiɲɔnmɛ birin bara lan e xa fe fanyi fala mangɛ bɛ. I fan xa kata, wo xui xa lu keren, i xa fe fanyi fala a bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Micaiah said, By the living Lord, whatever the Lord says to me I will say.
sentences.susu: Mike naxa a fala, «Alatala ɲiɲɛ na a ra. N Marigi Alatala na naxan yo masen, n na nan falama.»

sentences.english: When he came to the king, the king said to him, Micaiah, are we to go to Ramoth-gilead to make war or not? And he said, Go up, and it will go well for you; and they will be given up into your hands.
sentences.susu: A to mangɛ yire li, mangɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «Mike, a lanma ka a mu lanma muxu xa siga gere sode Ramoti Galadi bɔxi ma?» Mike naxa a yaabi, «Wo te, wo xun nakeli nan sɔtɔma. Alatala fama e sade wo sagoe.»

sentences.english: And the king said to him, Have I not, again and again, put you on your oath to say nothing to me but what is true in the name of the Lord?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mangɛ naxa gbilen a fala ra a bɛ, «N ɲan bara a fala i bɛ sanya wuyaxi, i xa i kali nɔndi yati nan falafe ra n bɛ Alatala xili ra.»

sentences.english: Then he said, I saw all Israel wandering on the mountains like sheep without a keeper; and the Lord said, These have no master: let them go back, every man to his house in peace.
sentences.susu: Mike naxa a yaabi, «N bara Isirayila birin to yensenxi geyae fari, alɔ xuruse rabɛɲinxie. Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Marigi mu na yi ɲama bɛ. Kankan xa gbilen a xɔnyi bɔɲɛsa kui.»

sentences.english: And the king of Israel said to Jehoshaphat, Did I not say that he would not be a prophet of good to me, but of evil?
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ naxa a fala Yehosafati bɛ, «N mu a fala xɛ i bɛ, a mu nɔma fe fanyi masende n ma fe ra, fo a ɲaaxi tun?»

sentences.english: Then he said, Give ear now to the word of the Lord: I saw the Lord seated on his seat of power, and all the army of heaven in their places, at his right hand and at his left.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Mike naxa a fala, «Yakɔsi, wo wo tuli mati Alatala xa masenyi ra. N bara Alatala to a xa kibanyi kui, a xa malekɛ gali nu tixi a yirefanyi nun a kɔɔla ma.
