sentences.english: For the Edomites had come again, attacking Judah and taking away prisoners.
sentences.susu: Edonkae nu bara fa Yudayakae gerede, e mixi ndee suxu, e e xanin.

sentences.english: And the Philistines, forcing their way into the towns of the lowlands and the south of Judah, had taken Beth-shemesh and Aijalon and Gederoth and Soco, with their daughter-towns, as well as Timnah and Gimzo and their daughter-towns, and were living there.
sentences.susu: Filisitakae fan nu bara taae gere naxee nu na Sefela nun Negewi biri Yudaya bɔxi ma. E naxa Beti Semesi, Ayalon, Gederoti, Soko, Timina, Gimiso, nun e rabilinyie suxu.

sentences.english: For the Lord made Judah low, because of Ahaz, king of Israel; for he had given up all self-control in Judah, sinning greatly against the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan wa Yudaya rayaagife, barima Isirayila mangɛ Axasi nu bara Yudaya ya iso a xa yanfanteya ra Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: Then Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria, came to him, but was a cause of trouble and not of strength to him.
sentences.susu: Asiri mangɛ Tigilati Pileseri to fa Yudaya, a mu tin a malide, a naxa a gere.

sentences.english: For Ahaz took a part of the wealth from the house of the Lord, and from the house of the king and of the great men, and gave it to the king of Assyria; but it was no help to him.
sentences.susu: Axasi naxa naafuli sɛɛti tongo Alatala xa banxi, mangɛ xa banxi, nun kuntigie xa banxi kui, a na fi Asiri mangɛ ma, kɔnɔ na mu a niya Tigilati Pileseri xa a mali.

sentences.english: And in the time of his trouble, this same King Ahaz did even more evil against the Lord.
sentences.susu: Hali a xa tɔɔrɛ kui, Axasi mu gbilen Alatala ma.

sentences.english: For he made offerings to the gods of Damascus, who were attacking him, and said, Because the gods of the kings of Aram are giving them help, I will make offerings to them so that they may give me help. But they were the cause of his downfall, and of that of all Israel.
sentences.susu: A nu sɛrɛxɛ bama Damasikae xa alae bɛ, naxee nu bara nɔ a ra. A naxa a fala, «Siriya mangɛ xa alae nan Siriya malixi, n fan sɛrɛxɛ bama nɛ e bɛ, alako e xa n fan mali.» Na birin findi tantanyi nan na Axasi nun Isirayila bɛ.

sentences.english: And Ahaz got together the vessels of the house of God, cutting up all the vessels of the house of God, and shutting the doors of the Lord's house; and he made altars in every part of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Axasi naxa Ala xa banxi se sɛniyɛnxie birin kana, a Alatala xa banxi naadɛe balan. A naxa sɛrɛxɛbadee yailan Darisalamu yire birin,

sentences.english: And in every town of Judah he made high places where perfumes were burned to other gods, awaking the wrath of the Lord, the God of his fathers.
sentences.susu: a man naxa yire itexie yailan Yudaya taa birin kui, alako e xa surayi gan sɛrɛxɛ ra ala gbɛtɛe bɛ. A a babae Marigi Alatala raxɔnɔ na ki nɛ a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: Now the rest of his acts and all his ways, first and last, are recorded in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
sentences.susu: A xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ nun a xa wali birin, a fɔlɛ nun a raɲɔnyi birin sɛbɛxi Yudaya nun Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: And Ahaz went to rest with his fathers, and they put his body into the earth in Jerusalem; but they did not put him in the resting-place of the kings of Israel: and Hezekiah his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Axasi to laaxiraya, e naxa a ragata Darisalamu taa kui, kɔnɔ e mu a ragata Isirayila mangɛe xa gaburi yire. A xa di Xesekiya naxa ti a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Hezekiah became king when he was twenty-five years old; and he was king in Jerusalem for twenty-nine years; and his mother's name was Abijah, the daughter of Zechariah.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya mangɛya sɔtɔ a ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli nan ma, a fa ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun solomanaani mangɛya raba Darisalamu. A nga nu xili nɛ Abiya, Sakari xa di ginɛ.

sentences.english: He did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, as his father David had done.
sentences.susu: A a ɲɛrɛ nɛ Alatala xa tinxinyi kui, alɔ a baba Dawuda a raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: In the first year of his rule, in the first month, opening the doors of the Lord's house, he made them strong.
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya ɲɛ singe kike singe kui, a naxa Alatala xa banxi naadɛe rabi, a e yailan.

sentences.english: And he sent for the priests and the Levites, and got them together in the wide place on the east side,
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae maxili, a e malan tɛtɛ kui sogegorode.

sentences.english: And said to them, Give ear to me, O Levites: now make yourselves holy, and make holy the house of the Lord, the God of your fathers, and take away everything unclean from the holy place.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen e bɛ, «Lewikae, wo wo tuli mati n na. Wo xa wo rasɛniyɛn, wo xa wo babae Marigi Alatala xa banxi rasɛniyɛn, wo xa se sɛniyɛntare birin ramini Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: For our fathers have done evil, sinning in the eyes of the Lord our God, and have given him up, turning away their faces from the house of the Lord, and turning their backs on him.
sentences.susu: Won babae nu bara Alatala rabɛɲin, e fe kobi raba e Marigi Alatala ra. E nu bara e kobe ti Alatala ra, nun a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ra.

sentences.english: The doors of his house have been shut and the lights put out; no perfumes have been burned or offerings made to the God of Israel in his holy place.
sentences.susu: E naxa hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛe yati balan. E naxa lanpuie raxuben, e mu surayi nun sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ba Isirayila Marigi Ala bɛ yire sɛniyɛnxi kui.

sentences.english: And so the wrath of the Lord has come on Judah and Jerusalem, and he has given them up to be a cause of fear and wonder and shame, as your eyes have seen.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Alatala naxa xɔnɔ Darisalamu nun Yudaya ma, a naa findi gbaloe yire ra. Si gbɛtɛe yoma won ma alɔ wo a toxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For see, our fathers have been put to death with the sword, and our sons and daughters and wives have been taken away prisoners because of this.
sentences.susu: Na bara a niya won babae xa faxa santidɛgɛma ra, won ma ginɛe, nun won ma di xɛmɛe nun ginɛe bara findi geelimanie ra.

sentences.english: Now it is my purpose to make an agreement with the Lord, the God of Israel, so that the heat of his wrath may be turned away from us.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n bara a ɲanige n bɔɲɛ kui won xa saatɛ tongo Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ, alako a xa xɔnɛ xa gbilen won fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: My sons, take care now: for you have been marked out by the Lord to come before him and to be his servants, burning offerings to him.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n ma die, wo xa wo tunnabɛxi, barima Alatala nan wo sugandixi, alako wo xa findi a xa konyie ra, wo xa surayi gan sɛrɛxɛ ra a bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then the Levites took their places; Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel, the son of Azariah, among the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish, the son of Abdi, and Azariah, the son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah, the son of Zimmah, and Eden, the son of Joah;
sentences.susu: Na kui yi Lewikae naxa keli: Amasayi xa di Maxati, Asaraya xa di Yoweli, Kehati xa di ndee, Merari xa di ndee, Abidi xa di Kisi, Yehaleleli xa di Asaraya, Gerison xa di ndee, Sima xa di Yowa, Yowa xa di Eden,

sentences.english: And of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeuel; and of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah;
sentences.susu: Elisafan ma die Simiri nun Yeyiyeli, Asafi xa die Sakari nun Mataniya,

sentences.english: And of the sons of Heman, Jehuel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
sentences.susu: Heman xa die Yɛxiyɛli nun Simeyi, nun Yedutun xa die Semaya nun Yusiyɛli.

sentences.english: And they got their brothers together and made themselves holy, and went in, as the king had said by the word of the Lord, to make the house of the Lord clean.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ e yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛnde, e naxa e ngaxakerenyie malan, e xa Alatala xa banxi fan rasɛniyɛn Alatala xa sɛriyɛ ki ma. Mangɛ nu bara na yaamari fi.

sentences.english: And the priests went into the inner part of the house of the Lord to make it clean, and everything unclean which was to be seen in the Temple of the Lord they took out into the outer square of the Lord's house, and the Levites got it together and took it away to the stream Kidron.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxa so Alatala xa banxi kui alako e xa naa rasɛniyɛn. E se sɛniyɛntare naxee birin li Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, nun a tɛtɛ kui, Lewikae naxa na birin tongo, e a wɔlɛ i Sediron gulunba kui.

sentences.english: On the first day of the first month the work of making the house holy was started, and on the eighth day they came to the covered way of the Lord; in eight days they made the Lord's house holy, and on the sixteenth day of the first month the work was done.
sentences.susu: E na wali fɔlɔ kike xi singe nɛ. A xi solomasaxan nde, e nu bara gɛ mɛnni birin nasɛniyɛnde han buntunyi ra. E man wali nɛ xi solomasaxan hɔrɔmɔbanxi fan yati rasɛniyɛnde. Kike singe xi fu nun senni nde, e naxa gɛ na wali birin na.

sentences.english: Then they went in to King Hezekiah and said, We have made all the house of the Lord clean, as well as the altar of burned offerings with all its vessels, and the table for the holy bread, with all its vessels.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, e naxa siga mangɛ Xesekiya yire, e dɛntɛgɛ sa a bɛ, «Muxu bara Alatala xa banxi birin nasɛniyɛn, sɛrɛxɛbade, sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi bade nun a yirabasee, teebili, taami sɛrɛxɛ sama dɛnnaxɛ, nun a yirabasee.

sentences.english: And all the vessels which were turned out by King Ahaz in his sin while he was king, we have put in order and made holy, and now they are in their places before the altar of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara se birin yailan, muxu bara se birin nasɛniyɛn, mangɛ Axasi naxan kɔsɛ a xa tinxintareya kui a xa mangɛya waxati. Na birin na Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade ya ra.»

sentences.english: Then Hezekiah the king got up early, and got together the great men of the town, and went up to the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kuye to iba, mangɛ Xesekiya naxa taa kuntigie malan, e te Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi.

sentences.english: And they took with them seven oxen and seven male sheep and seven lambs and seven he-goats as a sin-offering for the kingdom and for the holy house and for Judah. And he gave orders to the sons of Aaron, the priests, that these were to be offered on the altar of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa yaamari fi Haruna xa di sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ma, e xa tuura solofere, yɛxɛɛ kontonyi solofere, yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ xɛmɛma solofere, nun sikɔtɛ solofere ba yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade fari.

sentences.english: So they put the oxen to death and their blood was given to the priests to be drained out against the altar; then they put the male sheep to death, draining out their blood against the altar, and they put the lambs to death, draining out their blood against the altar.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxa tuurae kɔn naxaba, e e wuli kasan sɛrɛxɛbade ma. E naxa yɛxɛɛ kontonyie kɔn naxaba, e e wuli kasan sɛrɛxɛbade ma. E naxa yɛxɛɛyɔrɛe kɔn naxaba, e e wuli kasan sɛrɛxɛbade ma.

sentences.english: Then they took the he-goats for the sin-offering, placing them before the king and the meeting of the people, and they put their hands on them:
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, e naxa fa sikɔtɛe ra naxee findima yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra. Mangɛ nun ɲama naxa e bɛlɛxɛ sa e ma.

sentences.english: And the priests put them to death, and made a sin-offering with their blood on the altar, to take away the sin of all Israel: for the king gave orders that the burned offering and the sin-offering were for all Israel.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxa e kɔn naxaba, e e wuli ifili sɛrɛxɛbade ma yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra Isirayila birin bɛ. Mangɛ nu bara a fala a na sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun na yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ xa raba Isirayila birin bɛ.

sentences.english: Then he put the Levites in their places in the house of the Lord, with brass and corded instruments of music as ordered by David and Gad, the king's seer, and Nathan the prophet: for the order was the Lord's, given by his prophets.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa Lewikae ti Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, bɛɛtibasee alɔ maxasee nun kɔrae nu na e yi ra, alɔ Dawuda, Annabi Gadi, nun Annabi Natan nu bara a yamari ki naxɛ. Alatala xa yaamari nan nu a ra, a naxan masenxi a xa namiɲɔnmɛe saabui ra.

sentences.english: So the Levites took their places with David's instruments, and the priests with their horns.
sentences.susu: Lewikae naxa ti naa, Dawuda xa bɛɛtibasee suxuxi e yi ra, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe fan naxa ti naa, sarae nu na e tan fan yi ra.

sentences.english: And Hezekiah gave the word for the burned offering to be offered on the altar. And when the burned offering was started, then the song of the Lord was started, with the blowing of horns and with all the instruments of David, king of Israel.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa yaamari fi e xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ba sɛrɛxɛbade. E to na fɔlɔ, bɛɛtibae fan naxa bɛɛti ba fɔlɔ Alatala bɛ sarae xui nun Isirayila mangɛ Dawuda xa bɛɛtibasee ra.

sentences.english: And all the people gave worship, to the sound of songs and the blowing of horns; and this went on till the burned offering was ended.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa e felen bɔxi, bɛɛtibae naxa bɛɛti ba sarae xui han na sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi gɛ bade.

sentences.english: And at the end of the offering, the king and all who were present with him gave worship with bent heads.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi bade, mangɛ nun ɲama naxan bira a fɔxɔ ra, e birin naxa e tuubi, e Ala batu.

sentences.english: Then King Hezekiah and the captains gave orders to the Levites to give praise to God in the words of David and Asaph the seer. And they made songs of praise with joy, and with bent heads gave worship.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, mangɛ Xesekiya nun a xa kuntigie naxa Lewikae yaamari a e xa Alatala matɔxɔ Dawuda nun Annabi Asafi xa bɛɛtie ra. E naxa Ala matɔxɔ sɛɛwɛ ra, e fa e xin bi sin, e e felen bɔxi e Ala batu.

sentences.english: Then Hezekiah made answer and said, Now that you have given yourselves to the Lord, come near and take offerings and praise-offerings into the house of the Lord. So all the people took in offerings and praise-offerings: and those whose hearts were moved, took in burned offerings.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Xesekiya naxa a masen, «Yakɔsi, wo to nu fama, se nu na wo bɛlɛxɛ i Alatala bɛ, wo wo maso, wo nun wo xa sɛrɛxɛe nun wo xa tantui sɛrɛxɛe ra Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ra.» Ɲama naxa fa e xa sɛrɛxɛe ra, a nun e xa tantui sɛrɛxɛe ra. Naxee fan a ɲanige e bɔɲɛ fanyie kui, nee fan naxa fa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie ra.

sentences.english: The number of burned offerings which the people took in was seventy oxen, a hundred male sheep, and two hundred lambs: all these were for burned offerings to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nan ya ɲama naxee fi: ninge tongo solofere, yɛxɛɛ kontonyi kɛmɛ, nun yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ kɛmɛ firin. Na birin findi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nan na Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And the holy things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.
sentences.susu: E man naxa ninge kɛmɛ senni nun xuruse lanma wulu saxan ba sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: There were not enough priests for the work of cutting up all the burned offerings; so their brothers the Levites gave them help till the work was done and the priests had made themselves holy: for the Levites were more upright in heart to make themselves holy than the priests.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ sɛrɛxɛdubɛe to mu nu wuya, e mu nɔ sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie birin bade. Na kui, e ngaxakerenyi Lewikae naxa e mali na wali raɲɔnde, beemanun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ booree xa gɛ e yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛnde. Lewikae nu bara a ɲanige e bɔɲɛe kui a e xa e yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn mafuren, dangi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe waxɔnyi ra.

sentences.english: And there was a great amount of burned offerings, with the fat of the peace-offerings and the drink offerings for every burned offering. So the work of the Lord's house was put in order.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi gbegbe nu na, a nun ture naxan bama xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ ra, a nun sɛrɛxɛ yeerama naxan nu sama sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi xun ma. Na kui, ɲama man naxa Alatala batu fɔlɔ a xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: And Hezekiah and all the people were full of joy, because God had made the people ready: for the thing was done suddenly.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya nun ɲama birin naxa sɛɛwa, barima Alatala bara na wali birin nagiri sɔɔnɛya ra.

sentences.english: Then Hezekiah sent word to all Israel and Judah, and sent letters to Ephraim and Manasseh, requesting them to come to the house of the Lord at Jerusalem, to keep the Passover to the Lord, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Isirayila nun Yudaya birin kui. A man naxa bataaxɛe sɛbɛ Efiramikae nun Manasikae ma, alako e xa fa Alatala xa banxi Darisalamu Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali rabade Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa binyɛ bun ma.

sentences.english: For the king, after discussion with his chiefs and all the body of the people in Jerusalem, had made a decision to keep the Passover in the second month.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ, kuntigie, nun ɲama birin nu bara natɛ tongo Darisalamu e xa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali raba kike firin nde.

sentences.english: It was not possible to keep it at that time, because not enough priests had made themselves holy, and the people had not come together in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: E mu nɔ na rabade a waxati, barima sɛrɛxɛdubɛ birin mu nu gɛxi e yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛnde. Ɲama fan mu nu malanxi Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And the thing was right in the eyes of the king and all the people.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nun ɲama naxa tin na natɛ ra.

sentences.english: So it was ordered that word was to be sent out through all Israel, from Beer-sheba to Dan, that they were to come to keep the Passover to the Lord, the God of Israel, at Jerusalem: because they had not kept it in great numbers in agreement with the law.
sentences.susu: E naxa Isirayila birin maxili, kelife Bere Seeba ma, sa dɔxɔ Dana na, alako e xa fa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali raba Darisalamu Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa binyɛ bun ma. A nu bara bu ɲama mu na sali raba alɔ a sɛbɛxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So runners went with letters from the king and his chiefs through all Israel and Judah, by the order of the king, saying, O children of Israel, come back again to the Lord, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, so that he may come again to that small band of you which has been kept safe out of the hands of the kings of Assyria.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛrae naxa mangɛ nun kuntigie xa bataaxɛ xanin Isirayila nun Yudaya birin. E naxa mangɛ xa yaamari masen, «Isirayilakae, wo gbilen Alatala ma, Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Isirayila Marigi Ala, alako a fan xa gbilen wo ma, a wo tan naxee ratangaxi Asiriya mangɛe bɛlɛxɛ i.

sentences.english: Do not be like your fathers and your brothers, who were sinners against the Lord, the God of their fathers, so that he made them a cause of fear, as you see.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa lu alɔ wo babae nun wo ngaxakerenyie, naxee nu bara e babae Marigi Alatala rabɛɲin. Ala bara gbaloe ragiri e ma, alɔ wo a toxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Now do not be hard-hearted, as your fathers were; but give yourselves to the Lord, and come into his holy place, which he has made his for ever, and be the servants of the Lord your God, so that the heat of his wrath may be turned away from you.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, wo naxa wo kobe ti Ala ra alɔ wo babae a rabaxi ki naxɛ. Wo wo bɛlɛxɛ so Alatala yi ra, wo xa fa a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi, a naxan nasɛniyɛn waxati birin bun ma. Wo xa wo Marigi Alatala rabatu, alako a xa xɔnɛ xa gbilen won fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: For if you come back to the Lord, those who took away your brothers and your children will have pity on them, and let them come back to this land: for the Lord your God is full of grace and mercy, and his face will not be turned away from you if you come back to him.
sentences.susu: Xa wo gbilen Alatala ma, wo ngaxakerenyie nun wo xa die hinnɛ sɔtɔma nɛ mixie ra, naxee e xanin konyiya kui. Xa wo gbilen wo Marigi Alatala ma, a fama nɛ hinnɛde wo ra, a mu nɛɛmuma wo ma.»

sentences.english: So the runners went from town to town through all the country of Ephraim and Manasseh as far as Zebulun: but they were laughed at and made sport of.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛrae naxa siga taae birin Efirami nun Manasi bɔxi ma, han Sabulon. Kɔnɔ na mixie mu tin e xa masenyi ra, e man fa yo xɛɛrae ma.

sentences.english: However, some of Asher and Manasseh and Zebulun put away their pride and came to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Aserikae, Manasikae, nun Sabulonkae ndee naxa e yɛtɛ magoro, e siga Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And in Judah the power of God gave them one heart to do the orders of the king and the captains, which were taken as the word of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a niya Yudayakae birin xa kafu e boore ma mangɛ nun kuntigie xa yaamari rabafe ra alɔ Alatala a fala ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So a very great number of people came together at Jerusalem to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month.
sentences.susu: Ɲama gbegbe naxa e malan Darisalamu, alako e xa Taami Lɛbinitare Sali raba kike firin nde.

sentences.english: And they got to work and took away all the altars in Jerusalem, and they put all the vessels for burning perfumes into the stream Kidron.
sentences.susu: E naxa keli, e kuye sɛrɛxɛbade birin kana Darisalamu, a nun surayi gandee, e fa na birin wɔlɛ i Sediron fole kui.

sentences.english: Then on the fourteenth day of the second month they put the Passover lambs to death: and the priests and the Levites were shamed, and made themselves holy and took burned offerings into the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kike firin nde, xi fu nun naani nde ra, e naxa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali xa sɛrɛxɛ ba. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae nu bara yaagi e xa sɛniyɛntareɲa xa fe ra, e fa e yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn. E naxa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie ba Alatala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: And they took their places in their right order, as it was ordered in the law of Moses, the man of God: the priests draining out on the altar the blood given them by the Levites.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxa ti e yire alɔ Ala xa mixi Munsa a yamarixi ki naxɛ Tawureta Munsa kui. Lewikae to wuli so e yi ra, e naxa a kasan sɛrɛxɛbade ma.

sentences.english: For there were still a number of the people there who had not made themselves holy: so the Levites had to put Passover lambs to death for those who were not clean, to make them holy to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mixi sɛniyɛntaree to nu wuyaxi ɲama ya ma, Lewikae naxa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali sɛrɛxɛ ba e bɛ, alako e xa a fi Alatala ma.

sentences.english: For a great number of the people from Ephraim and Manasseh, Issachar and Zebulun, had not made themselves clean, but they took the Passover meal, though not in the right way. For Hezekiah had made prayer for them, saying, May the good Lord have mercy on everyone
sentences.susu: Mixi sɛniyɛntare wuyaxie nu na ɲama ya ma kelife Efirami, Manasi, nun Sabulon. E bara Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali sɛrɛxɛ don, kɔnɔ na mu radaxaxi Ala xa masenyi kui. Na nan a to, Xesekiya naxa Alatala maxandi e bɛ, «Alatala naxan fan, diɲɛ

sentences.english: Who, with all his heart, is turned to God the Lord, the God of his fathers, even if he has not been made clean after the rules of the holy place.
sentences.susu: sɛniyɛntaree birin ma naxee na e babae Marigi Ala fenfe e bɔɲɛ kui.»

sentences.english: And the Lord gave ear to Hezekiah, and made the people well.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Xesekiya xa dubɛ suxu, a diɲɛ ɲama ma.

sentences.english: So the children of Israel who were present in Jerusalem kept the feast of unleavened bread for seven days with great joy: and the Levites and the priests gave praise to the Lord day by day, making melody to the Lord with loud instruments.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae naxee nu malanxi Darisalamu naxa Taami Lɛbinitare Sali raba xi solofere bun ma ɲɛlɛxinyi kui. Lɔxɔɛ birin ma, Lewikae nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nu Alatala matɔxɔma e xa bɛɛtibasee ra Ala xa binyɛ bun ma e sɛnbɛ birin na.

sentences.english: And Hezekiah said kind words to the Levites who were expert in the ordering of the worship of the Lord: so they kept the feast for seven days, offering peace-offerings and praising the Lord, the God of their fathers.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa Lewikae ralimaniya, barima e nu bara Alatala xa wali raba a raba ki ma. E naxa sɛrɛxɛe don xi solofere bun ma. E man naxa xanunteya sɛrɛxɛe ba e babae Marigi Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And by the desire of all the people, the feast went on for another seven days, and they kept the seven days with joy.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa lan a ma, e xa xi solofere gbɛtɛ sa na sali xun ma. E naxa na raba sɛɛwɛ kui.

sentences.english: For Hezekiah, king of Judah, gave to the people for offerings, a thousand oxen and seven thousand sheep; and the rulers gave a thousand oxen and ten thousand sheep; and a great number of priests made themselves holy.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Xesekiya naxa tuura wulu keren nun xuruse lanma wulu solofere ba sɛrɛxɛ ra. Kuntigie fan naxa tuura wulu keren nun xuruse lanma wulu fu ba sɛrɛxɛ ra. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ gbegbe naxa e yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: And all the people of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and those who had come from Israel, and men from other lands who had come from Israel or who were living in Judah, were glad with great joy.
sentences.susu: Yudaya ɲama, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, Lewikae, Isirayilakae, nun xɔɲɛe kelife Isirayila bɔxi ma, e birin naxa sɛɛwa.

sentences.english: So there was great joy in Jerusalem: for nothing like this had been seen in Jerusalem from the time of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛlɛxinyi gbegbe naxa lu Darisalamu. Na fe mɔɔli nu bara ba tofe Darisalamu kabi Isirayila mangɛ Dawuda xa di Sulemani xa waxati.

sentences.english: Then the priests and the Levites gave the people a blessing: and the voice of their prayer went up to the holy place of God in heaven.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae naxa keli, e duba ɲama bɛ. Alatala naxa na dubɛ suxu a xa yire sɛniyɛnxi kui koore ma.

sentences.english: Now when all this was over, all the men of Israel who were present went out into the towns of Judah, causing the stone pillars to be broken up and the wood pillars to be cut down, pulling down the high places and the altars in all Judah and Benjamin, as well as in Ephraim and Manasseh, till all were gone. Then all the children of Israel went back to their towns, every man to his property.
sentences.susu: Sali to ɲɔn, Isirayilakae naxa siga Yudaya taae kui, e kuye gɛmɛ masolixie kana, e Asera kuye wuri daaxie sɛgɛ, e sɛrɛxɛbade birin kana naxee nu na geyae fari Yudaya, Bunyamin, Efirami, nun Manasi bɔxi ma. Na dangi xanbi, Isirayilakae naxa gbilen e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Then Hezekiah put in order the divisions of the priests and Levites, every man in his division, in relation to his work, for the burned offerings and peace-offerings, and for the ordering of worship and for giving praise at the doors of the Lord's house.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae ti kankan xa wali ra: sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie bafe, xanunteya sɛrɛxɛe bafe, hɔrɔmɔbanxi wali rabafe, matɔxɔɛ nun tantui bɛɛti bafe Alatala bɛ, nun Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛ makantafe.

sentences.english: And he gave the king's part of his private property for the burned offerings, that is, for the morning and evening offerings, and the offerings for the Sabbath and the new moons and the regular feasts, as it is recorded in the law of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa nde ba a harige ra a a fi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie ra naxee bama gɛɛsɛgɛ, nunmare, malabui lɔxɔɛ, kike nɛɛnɛ, sali xungbee alɔ a sɛbɛxi Alatala xa sɛriyɛ kui ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: In addition, he gave orders to the people of Jerusalem to give to the priests and Levites that part which was theirs by right, so that they might be strong in keeping the law of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa a masen ɲama nun Darisalamukae bɛ, e xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae mali e xa harige sɔtɔ, alako e xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ Alatala xa sɛriyɛ kui.

sentences.english: And when the order was made public, straight away the children of Israel gave, in great amounts, the first-fruits of their grain and wine and oil and honey, and of the produce of their fields; and they took in a tenth part of everything, a great store.
sentences.susu: E to na masenyi mɛ, Isirayilakae naxa farilɛ ba e xa sansie bogi singee ra, mɛngi, wɛni nɛɛnɛ, ture, kumi, nun daxamui gbɛtɛe. E naxan fixi, na nu gbo.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel and Judah, who were living in the towns of Judah came with the tenth part of their oxen and sheep, and a tenth of all the holy things which were to be given to the Lord their God, and put them in great masses.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae nun Yudayakae, naxee nu sabatixi Yudaya taae kui naxa farilɛ ba e xa xuruse xungbee nun e xa xuruse lanmae ra, e man naxa farilɛ ba se sɛniyɛnxie ra e naxee fixi e Marigi Alatala ma. Na naxa findi kote gbegbe ra.

sentences.english: The first store of things was put down in the third month, and in the seventh month the masses were complete.
sentences.susu: E naxa na kote malan fɔlɔ kike saxan nde ra, e gɛ kike solofere nde ra.

sentences.english: And when Hezekiah and the rulers came and saw all the store of goods, they gave praise to the Lord and to his people Israel.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya nun kuntigie to na kote to, e naxa Alatala nun a xa ɲama tantu.

sentences.english: Then Hezekiah put questions to the priests and Levites about the store of goods.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae maxɔrin na kote xa fe ma.

sentences.english: And Azariah, the chief priest, of the family of Zadok, said in answer, From the time when the people first came with their offerings into the house of the Lord, we have had food enough, and more than enough: for the blessing of the Lord is on his people; and there is this great store which has not been used.
sentences.susu: Na kui, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi Asaraya, naxan kelixi Sadɔki xabilɛ naxa a yaabi, «Kabi won yi hadiya fe fɔlɔ Alatala xa banxi kui, baloe bara gbo muxu yi ra han muxu mu nɔma na birin donde. Naxan luxi na nan ya. A gbo barima Alatala bara barakɛ sa a xa ɲama ma.»

sentences.english: Then Hezekiah said that store-rooms were to be made ready in the house of the Lord; and this was done.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa yaamari fi e xa konkoe yailan Alatala xa banxi kui. E naxa na raba.

sentences.english: And in them they put all the offerings and the tenths and the holy things, keeping nothing back, and over them was Conaniah the Levite, with Shimei his brother second to him.
sentences.susu: Mixie naxa fa hadiyae, farilɛe, nun se sɛniyɛnxie ra, e a sa na konkoe kui. Lewika Konaniyahu nun a xunya Simeyi naxa mɛɛni na birin ma.

sentences.english: And Jehiel and Azaziah and Nahath and Asahel and Jerimoth and Jozabad and Eliel and Ismachiah and Mahath and Benaiah were overseers, under the directions of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the order of Hezekiah the king and Azariah, the ruler of the house of God.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Xesekiya nun Ala xa banxi yarerati Asaraya naxa mixie sugandi naxee luma Konaniyahu nun a xunya Simeyi xa yaamari bun ma. Na mixie xilie nan ya: Yɛxiyɛli, Asaraya, Naxati, Asahɛli, Yerimoti, Yosabadi, Eliyeli, Yisimakiya, Maxati, nun Bɛnaya.

sentences.english: And Kore, the son of Imnah the Levite, the keeper of the east door, had control of the offerings freely given to God, and the distribution of the offerings of the Lord and the most holy things.
sentences.susu: Yimina xa di Lewika Kore, naxan nu sogetede naadɛ makantama, a tan nan nu a ɲɛngi saxi see xɔn ma, mixie naxee ɲanigexi Ala bɛ. A nu na se sɛniyɛnxie itaxunma.

sentences.english: And under him were Eden and Miniamin and Jeshua and Shemaiah and Amariah and Shecaniah, in the towns of the priests, who were made responsible for giving it to all their brothers, by divisions, to small and great:
sentences.susu: Eden, Minyamin, Yosuwe, Semaya, Amaraya, nun Sɛkanaya nu Kore malima see itaxunde e ngaxakerenyie ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa taae kui. Mixi xungbee nun mixi lanmae bara e gbe sɔtɔ e xundɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: As well as to all the males, of three years old and over, listed by their families, who went into the house of the Lord to do what was needed day by day, for their special work with their divisions.
sentences.susu: E naxa see itaxun xɛmɛ dimɛdi birin ma naxee nu bara gɛ ɲɛ saxan sɔtɔde, naxee xilie nu sɛbɛxi taruxui kui, naxee nu lanma e xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali raba Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui e xundɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: And the families of the priests were listed by their fathers' names, but the Levites, of twenty years old and over, were listed in relation to their work in their divisions;
sentences.susu: E naxa see itaxun sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ma, naxee xilie nu sɛbɛxi taruxui kui e xa denbaya ki ma. E naxa see itaxun Lewikae ma e xa wali nun e xundɛ ki ma, naxee nu bara gɛ ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn sɔtɔde.

sentences.english: And in the lists were all their little ones and their wives and their sons and daughters, through all the people: they made themselves holy in the positions which they were given.
sentences.susu: E man naxa see itaxun Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi walikɛ birin ma, naxee xilie nu sɛbɛxi taruxui kui, e naxa a i taxun e xa mamadie, e xa ginɛe, e xa di xɛmɛe nun e xa di ginɛe ma.

sentences.english: And as for the sons of Aaron, the priests, living in the country on the outskirts of their towns, every different town there were men, marked out by name, to give their part of the goods to all the males among the priests, and to all who were listed among the Levites.
sentences.susu: Haruna xa di sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, naxee nu na daaxa, taa fari ma, taaka ndee nu bara sugandi naxee see itaxunma yi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun yi Lewikae ma, naxee xilie nu sɛbɛxi taruxui kui.

sentences.english: This Hezekiah did through all Judah; he did what was good and right and true before the Lord his God.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya na nan naba Yudaya bɔxi ma. A wali nɛ hinnɛ, tinxinyi, nun nɔndi kui a Marigi Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And for everything he undertook, in connection with the work of the house of God and his law and orders, he got directions from God and did it with serious purpose; and things went well for him.
sentences.susu: A xa wali birin a naxan naba Ala batufe xa fe ra, a nun Ala xa sɛriyɛ nun yaamari xa fe ra, na birin sɔɔnɛyaxi nɛ a bɛ. A na birin naba a bɔɲɛ birin nan na alako a xa a Marigi Alatala sagoe raba.

sentences.english: Now after these things and this true-hearted work, Sennacherib, king of Assyria, came into Judah, and put his army in position before the walled towns of Judah, designing to make his way into them by force.
sentences.susu: Yi fe tinxinxie dangi xanbi, Asiri mangɛ Senaxeribi naxa so Yudaya bɔxi ma, a naxa taa makantaxie mabilin a xa e sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And when Hezekiah saw that Sennacherib had come for the purpose of fighting against Jerusalem,
sentences.susu: Xesekiya to a kolon a Senaxeribi wama Darisalamu gerefe nɛ,

sentences.english: He took up with his rulers and men of war the question of stopping up the water-springs outside the town; and they gave him their support.
sentences.susu: a naxa kuntigie nun sɔɔri ɲalamae maxili. E naxa natɛ tongo e xa ye badee dɛsɛ naxee na taa fari ma.

sentences.english: So they got together a great number of people, and had all the water-springs and the stream flowing through the land stopped up, saying, Why let the kings of Assyria come and have much water?
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe naxa na wali suxu, e naxa kɔlɔnyie dɛsɛ, e ye kirae dɛsɛ naxee nu kelima bɔxi bun ma. E naxa a fala, «Munfe ra won a luma Asiri mangɛe xa ye sɔtɔ be?»

sentences.english: Then he took heart, building up the wall where it was broken down, and making its towers higher, and building another wall outside; and he made strong the Millo in the town of David, and got together a great store of all sorts of instruments of war.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa wali suxu sɛnbɛ ra. A naxa tɛtɛ yailan dɛnnaxɛ nu kanaxi, a naxa nde sa a xa maite xun ma, han a sa sɔɔrie xa yire makantaxi li, a naxa tɛtɛ gbɛtɛ ti tɛtɛ singe fari ma, a naxa Milo yailan Dawuda xa taa kui, a naxa geresosee nun wure lefa gbegbe malan.

sentences.english: And he put war chiefs over the people, and sent for them all to come together to him in the wide place at the doorway into the town, and to give them heart he said to them,
sentences.susu: A naxa sɔɔri xunyie ti ɲama xun, a fa ɲama malan taa sode dɛ ra. A naxa a masen e bɛ,

sentences.english: Be strong and take heart; have no fear, and do not be troubled on account of the king of Assyria and all the great army with him: for there is a greater with us.
sentences.susu: «Wo limaniya, wo wo sɛnbɛ so. Gaaxui yo naxa lu wo yi ra, wo naxa kɔntɔfili Asiri mangɛ xa fe ra, a nun a xa sɔɔri gali. Naxan na won sɛɛti ma na gbo dangife se bɛ naxan na a tan sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: With him is an arm of flesh; but we have the Lord our God, helping us and fighting for us. And the people put their faith in what Hezekiah, king of Judah, said.
sentences.susu: Adama sɛnbɛ gbansan nan na a yi ra, kɔnɔ won Marigi Alatala nan na won malima ra yi gere kui.» Ɲama naxa e xaxili ti Yudaya mangɛ Xesekiya xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: After this, Sennacherib, king of Assyria, sent his servants to Jerusalem (at that time he was stationed with all his army in front of Lachish), to say to Hezekiah and all the men of Judah in Jerusalem,
sentences.susu: Na to dangi, Asiri mangɛ Senaxeribi naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Darisalamu. Na tɛmui a tan nu na Lakisi gerefe nun a xa sɔɔri birin na. A naxa yi xɛɛraya rasiga Yudaya mangɛ Xesekiya ma, a nun Yudaya mixie ma naxee nu sabatixi Darisalamu.

sentences.english: Sennacherib, king of Assyria, says, In what are you placing your hope, waiting here in the walled town of Jerusalem?
sentences.susu: «Senaxeribi xa masenyi nan ya: Wo xaxili tixi munse ra naxan a niyama wo xa dɔxɔ tɔɔrɛ kui Darisalamu?

sentences.english: Is it not Hezekiah who has got you to do it, causing your death from need of food and water, by saying, The Lord our God will give us salvation out of the hands of the king of Assyria?
sentences.susu: Xesekiya na wo madaxufe nɛ a falafe ra, ‹Won Marigi Alatala fama won natangade Asiri mangɛ bɛlɛxɛ ma.› A wama nɛ wo xa faxa kaamɛ nun ye xɔli ma.

sentences.english: Has not this same Hezekiah taken away his high places and his altars, saying to Judah and Jerusalem, Give worship before one altar only, burning offerings on it?
sentences.susu: Xesekiya yati bara ala batudee nun sɛrɛxɛbadee kana, a fa a fala Yudaya nun Darisalamu bɛ wo xa wo tuubi sɛrɛxɛbade keren nan gbansan bɛ, wo xa surayi gan mɛnni.

sentences.english: Have you no knowledge of what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of every land? were the gods of the nations of those lands able to keep their land from falling into my hands?
sentences.susu: Wo mu a kolon xɛ muxu naxan naba si gbɛtɛe ra, n tan nun n babae? Na sie xa alae bara nɔ e ratangade n bɛlɛxɛ ma?

sentences.english: Who was there among all the gods of those nations, which my fathers put to destruction, who was able to keep his people safe from my hands? and is it possible that your God will keep you safe from my hands?
sentences.susu: Ala mundun na sie ya ma, n babae naxee ratɔn, naxee bara nɔ a xa ɲama ratangade n bɛlɛxɛ ma? Munfe ra wo a maɲɔxunxi a wo xa ala nɔma wo ratangade n ma?

sentences.english: So do not be tricked by Hezekiah or let him get you to do this, and do not put any faith in what he says: for no god of any nation or kingdom has been able to keep his people safe from my hands, or the hands of my fathers: how much less will your God keep you safe from my hands!
sentences.susu: Wo naxa a lu Xesekiya xa wo madaxu na ki de. Wo naxa la a ra, barima si xa ala yo mu nɔ a xa ɲama ratangade n bɛlɛxɛ ma nun n babae bɛlɛxɛ ma. Mangɛya yo mu nɔ muxu ra. Wo xa alae fan mu fama wo ratangade n bɛlɛxɛ ma.»

sentences.english: And his servants said even more against the Lord God and against his servant Hezekiah.
sentences.susu: Senaxeribi xa xɛɛrae naxa na wɔyɛnyi mɔɔli xun masa Alatala nun a xa konyi Xesekiya xili ma.

sentences.english: And he sent letters, in addition, to put shame on the Lord, the God of Israel, and to say evil against him, saying, As the gods of the nations of other lands have not been able to keep their people safe from my hands, no more will the God of Hezekiah keep his people safe from my hands.
sentences.susu: Senaxeribi nu bara bataaxɛ sɛbɛ naxan Isirayila Marigi Alatala konbima yi wɔyɛnyi ra, «Si gbɛtɛe xa alae to mu nɔ e ratangade n bɛlɛxɛ ma, Xesekiya xa ala fan mu nɔma a xa ɲama ratangade n bɛlɛxɛ ma.»

sentences.english: These things they said, crying out with a loud voice in the Jews' language, to the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall, with the purpose of troubling them and putting fear into them, so that they might take the town;
sentences.susu: E naxa wɔyɛn Eburu xui ra Darisalamukae bɛ naxee nu na tɛtɛ kɔn na alako gaaxui xa lu e yi ra, e xa taa masɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Talking of the God of Jerusalem as if he was like the gods of the peoples of the earth, the work of men's hands.
sentences.susu: E naxa Darisalamu Marigi Ala maniya si gbɛtɛe xa alae ra, naxee findixi kuye yailanxie ra.

sentences.english: And Hezekiah the king, and Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, made prayer because of this, crying out to heaven.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Xesekiya nun Amosi xa di Annabi Esayi naxa Ala maxandi fɔlɔ mali ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord sent an angel who put to death all the men of war and the chiefs and the captains in the army of the king of Assyria. So he went back to his country in shame. And when he came into the house of his god, his sons, the offspring of his body, put him to death there with the sword.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala naxa malekɛ nde xɛɛ Asiri mangɛ xa sɔɔri ɲalamae xili ma, a e birin sɔntɔ a nun e xa yareratie. Mangɛ to na to, a naxa gbilen a xɔnyi yaagi kui. A naxa so a xa ala xa banxi kui, a yɛtɛ xa die naxa a faxa mɛnni santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: So the Lord gave Hezekiah and the people of Jerusalem salvation from the power of Sennacherib, the king of Assyria, and from all others, giving them rest on every side.
sentences.susu: Alatala Xesekiya nun Darisalamukae ratanga Asiriya mangɛ Senaxeribi bɛlɛxɛ ma na ki nɛ. Ala naxa e ratanga e dɔxɔboore birin ma.

sentences.english: And great numbers came to Jerusalem with offerings for the Lord, and things of great price for Hezekiah, king of Judah: so that he was honoured among all nations from that time.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe naxa fa buɲa fanyie ra Darisalamu Alatala nun Yudaya mangɛ Xesekiya bɛ. Keli na tɛmui ma Xesekiya xili naxa te si birin ya ma.

sentences.english: In those days Hezekiah was ill and near death; and he made prayer to the Lord, and the Lord in answer gave him a sign.
sentences.susu: Na waxati Xesekiya naxa fura, a gbe mu lu a xa laaxiraya. A to Alatala maxandi, Alatala naxa a xa dubɛ suxu, a kaabanako raba.

sentences.english: But Hezekiah did not do as had been done to him; for his heart was lifted up in pride; and so wrath came on him and on Judah and Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Xesekiya mu na kaabanako kolon Alatala bɛ, a a yɛtɛ igbo. Na na a ra Alatala naxa xɔnɔ a tan nun Yudaya nun Darisalamu ma.

sentences.english: But then, Hezekiah, in sorrow for what he had done, put away his pride; and he and all Jerusalem made themselves low, so that the wrath of the Lord did not come on them in Hezekiah's life-time.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa tuubi a xa yɛtɛ igboe xa fe ra. Darisalamukae fan naxa tuubi. Na kui Alatala xa xɔnɛ naxa gbilen e fɔxɔ ra Xesekiya xa mangɛya bun ma.

sentences.english: And Hezekiah had very great wealth and honour; and he made himself store-houses for his gold and silver and jewels and spices, and for body-covers and all sorts of beautiful vessels.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya xa naafuli nun a xa binyɛ nu bara gbo. Gbeti, xɛɛma, gɛmɛ tofanyie, surayi, wure lefae, nun se fanyi gbɛtɛe nu na a yi ra.

sentences.english: And store-houses for the produce of grain and wine and oil; and buildings for all sorts of beasts and flocks.
sentences.susu: Banxie fan nu na a yi ra, a nu mɛngi, wɛni nɛɛnɛ, ture, nun xurusee ragatama dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And he made towns for himself, and got together much property in flocks and herds: for God had given him great wealth.
sentences.susu: A naxa taae ti, a naxa xuruse xungbee nun a lanmae gbegbe sɔtɔ Ala saabui ra.

sentences.english: It was Hezekiah who had the higher spring of the water of Gihon stopped, and the water taken down on the west side of the town of David. In everything he undertook, Hezekiah did well.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya man naxa Gixon dulonyi dɛsɛ fuge ra, alako na ye xa dangi Dawuda xa taa sogegorode mabiri. A xa wali birin sɔɔnɛya nɛ.

sentences.english: However, in the business of the representatives sent by the rulers of Babylon to get news of the wonder which had taken place in the land, God gave up guiding him, testing him to see what was in his heart.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Babilɔn kuntigi ndee to fa Xesekiya yire kaabanako xa fe ra naxan naba a xa bɔxi ma, Ala naxa a rabolo a yɛtɛ xa na ya iba, alako a xa a bɔɲɛ ma fe kolon.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah, and the good he did, are recorded in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, and in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ nun a xa dugutɛgɛɲa wali, na birin sɛbɛxi Amosi xa di Annabi Esayi xa laamatunyi kui, a nun Isirayila nun Yudaya mangɛ xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: So Hezekiah went to rest with his fathers, and they put his body into the higher part of the resting-places of the sons of David: and all Judah and the people of Jerusalem gave him honour at his death. And Manasseh his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa laaxiraya, e a ragata binyɛ yire Dawuda xa die xa gaburie ya ma. Yudayakae nun Darisalamukae birin naxa a binya a laaxiraya tɛmui. A xa di Manasi naxa ti a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Manasseh was twelve years old when he became king, and he was ruling for fifty-five years in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Manasi mangɛya sɔtɔ a ɲɛ fu nun firin nan ma, a fa ɲɛ tongo suuli nun suuli mangɛya raba Darisalamu.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, copying the disgusting ways of the nations whom the Lord had sent out of the land before the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: A naxa bira fe ɲaaxie fɔxɔ ra alɔ sie Alatala naxee keri Isirayilakae ya ra.

sentences.english: For he put up again the high places which had been pulled down by his father Hezekiah; and he made altars for the Baals, and pillars of wood, and was a worshipper and servant of all the stars of heaven;
sentences.susu: A naxa kuye batudee yailan geyae fari, a baba Xesekiya naxee kana. A Bali kuyee xa sɛrɛxɛbadee yailan, a Aseri kuye wuri daaxie ti, a man tuubi tunbuie bɛ naxee na koore ma.

sentences.english: And he made altars in the house of the Lord, of which the Lord had said, In Jerusalem will my name be for ever.
sentences.susu: A naxa yi sɛrɛxɛbade mɔɔlie ti Alatala xa banxi kui, Alatala a fala dɛnnaxɛ ma, n xili fama falade be nɛ Darisalamu tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: And he made altars for all the stars of heaven in the two outer squares of the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛbadee ti tunbuie bɛ Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ firinyi kui.

sentences.english: More than this, he made his children go through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom; and he made use of secret arts, and signs for reading the future, and unnatural powers, and gave positions to those who had control of spirits and to wonder-workers: he did much evil in the eyes of the Lord, moving him to wrath.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa die gan sɛrɛxɛ ra Hinoma gulunba kui. A naxa duureya nun manduruɲa mɔɔli birin naba, a sematoe nun mixie maxɔrin naxee fata mixi faxie rawɔyɛnde. A xa fe ɲaaxie xun naxa masa Alatala ya xɔri han a xɔnɔ a ma.

sentences.english: And he put the image he had made in the house of God, the house of which God had said to David and to Solomon his son, In this house, and in Jerusalem, the town which I have made mine out of all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name for ever:
sentences.susu: A naxa kuye gɛmɛ masolixi ti Ala xa banxi kui Ala a fala dɛnnaxɛ ma Dawuda nun a xa di Sulemani bɛ, «N bara yi banxi sugandi, n bara Darisalamu sugandi Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin ya ma, n xili xa matɔxɔ be abadan.

sentences.english: And never again will I let the feet of Israel be moved out of the land which I have given to their fathers; if only they will take care to do all my orders, even all the law and the orders and the rules given to them by Moses.
sentences.susu: N mu Isirayila kerima yi bɔxi ma n naxan fixi wo babae ma xa wo n ma sɛriyɛ, n ma yaamarie, nun n ma xaranyie rabatuma wo naxan sɔtɔ Annabi Munsa saabui ra.»

sentences.english: And Manasseh made Judah and the people of Jerusalem go out of the true way, so that they did more evil than those nations whom the Lord gave up to destruction before the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Manasi naxa Yudaya nun Darisalamu ralɔɛ, e xa ɲaaxu dangife sie ra Alatala naxee sɔntɔ e ya ra.

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to Manasseh and his people, but they gave no attention.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa wɔyɛn Manasi nun a xa ɲama bɛ, kɔnɔ e mu e tuli mati a ra.

sentences.english: So the Lord sent against them the captains of the army of Assyria, who made Manasseh a prisoner and took him away in chains to Babylon.
sentences.susu: Na na a ra, Alatala naxa a niya Asiriya sɔɔri xunyie xa fa e gerede. E naxa Manasi suxu, e yɔlɔnxɔnyi sa a ma, e kɔnyi gbaku a banganyi ra, e a xanin Babilɔn bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And crying out to the Lord his God in his trouble, he made himself low before the God of his fathers,
sentences.susu: A to lu na ɲaxankatɛ kui, a naxa a Marigi Alatala maxandi, a a yɛtɛ magoro a babae Marigi Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: And made prayer to him; and in answer to his prayer God let him come back to Jerusalem and to his kingdom. Then Manasseh was certain that the Lord was God.
sentences.susu: A to a maxandi, Alatala naxa a xa dubɛ suxu, a a ragbilen a xa mangɛya Darisalamu. Na kui Manasi naxa a kolon Alatala nan Ala ra.

sentences.english: After this he made an outer wall for the town of David, on the west side of Gihon in the valley, as far as the way into the town by the fish doorway; and he put a very high wall round the Ophel; and he put captains of the army in all the walled towns of Judah.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Manasi naxa tɛtɛ ti Dawuda xa taa fari ma, kelife Gixon sogegorode mabiri gulunba kui, a sa dɔxɔ taa naadɛ ra naxan xili «Yɛxɛ naadɛ.» A naxa Ofeli geya mabilin. A naxa nde sa tɛtɛ xa maite xun ma. A man naxa sɔɔri xunyie lu Yudaya taa makantaxie kui.

sentences.english: He took away the strange gods and the image out of the house of the Lord, and all the altars he had put up on the hill of the Lord's house and in Jerusalem, and put them out of the town.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a naxa kuye birin ba Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, a sɛrɛxɛbadee kana a nu bara naxee ti hɔrɔmɔbanxi tentenyi fari nun Darisalamu taa kui. A naxa e birin wɔlɛ i taa fari ma.

sentences.english: And he put the altar of the Lord in order, offering peace-offerings and praise-offerings on it, and said that all Judah were to be servants of the Lord, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ na ra, a naxa Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade yailan, a fa xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ nun tantui sɛrɛxɛ ba naa. A naxa a masen Yudayakae bɛ e xa Isirayila Marigi Alatala rabatu.

sentences.english: However, the people still made offerings in the high places, but only to the Lord their God.
sentences.susu: Ɲama tan mu gbilen kuye batudee fɔxɔ ra geyae fari, kɔnɔ e nu e Marigi Alatala nan gbansan batuma mɛnnie.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Manasseh, and his prayer to his God, and the words which the seers said to him in the name of the Lord, the God of Israel, are recorded among the acts of the kings of Israel.
sentences.susu: Manasi xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛ, a xa Ala maxandi nun namiɲɔnmɛe xa masenyie Isirayila Marigi Alatala xili ra, na birin sɛbɛxi Isirayila mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: And the prayer which he made to God, and how God gave him an answer, and all his sin and his wrongdoing, and the places where he made high places and put up pillars of wood and images, before he put away his pride, are recorded in the history of the seers.
sentences.susu: A xa Ala maxandi nun Ala na suxu ki naxɛ, na sɛbɛxi Hosayi xa sɛbɛli kui. Manasi naxan nabaxi beenu a xa a yɛtɛ magoro Ala bɛ, a xa yunubie, a xa yanfanteya, a xa kuye batudee geyae fari, a xa Aseri kuye wuri daaxie, nun a xa gɛmɛ masolixie, na birin masenxi na sɛbɛli kui.

sentences.english: So Manasseh went to rest with his fathers, and they put his body to rest in his house, and Amon his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Manasi naxa laaxiraya, e a ragata a xɔnyi. A xa di Amon naxa ti a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Amon was twenty-two years old when he became king; and he was ruling for two years in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Amon mangɛya sɔtɔ a ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin nan ma, a fa ɲɛ firin mangɛya raba Darisalamu.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as Manasseh his father had done; and Amon made offerings to all the images which his father Manasseh had made, and was their servant.
sentences.susu: A naxa bira fe ɲaaxie fɔxɔ ra alɔ a baba Manasi, a sɛrɛxɛe ba kuyee bɛ a baba nu bara naxee yailan batu se ra.

sentences.english: He did not make himself low before the Lord, as his father Manasseh had done, but went on sinning more and more.
sentences.susu: A mu a magoro Alatala bɛ alɔ a baba Manasi a raba ki naxɛ. Amon xa yunubie naxa dangi a baba gbe ra.

sentences.english: And his servants made a secret design against him, and put him to death in his house.
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔri xunyie naxa natɛ tongo, e fa a faxa a xa mangɛ banxi kui.

sentences.english: But the people of the land put to death all those who had taken part in the design against King Amon, and made his son Josiah king in his place.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ ɲama tan mu tin na yanfantee ra, e naxa e fan faxa. Ɲama naxa Amon xa di Yosiya ti a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Josiah was eight years old when he became king; he was ruling in Jerusalem for thirty-one years.
sentences.susu: Yosiya mangɛya sɔtɔ a ɲɛ solomasaxan nan ma, a fa ɲɛ tongo saxan nun keren mangɛya raba Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And he did what was right in the eyes of the Lord, walking in the ways of his father David, without turning to the right hand or to the left.
sentences.susu: A Alatala waxɔnfe tinxinxi raba nɛ, a ɲɛrɛ a baba Dawuda fɔxi. A mu siga yirefanyi ma, a mu siga kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: In the eighth year of his rule, while he was still young, his heart was first turned to the God of his father David; and in the twelfth year he undertook the clearing away of all the high places and the pillars and the images of wood and metal from Judah and Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya ɲɛ solomasaxan nde, a naxa a baba Dawuda Marigi Ala fen fɔlɔ. Fonike nan nu a ra na tɛmui. A xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun firin nde, a naxa Yudaya nun Darisalamu rasɛniyɛn fɔlɔ. A naxa kuye batudee ba geyae fari, a Aseri kuye wuri daaxie kana, a kuye yɔxui daaxie ba naa.

sentences.english: He had the altars of the Baals broken down, while he himself was present; and the sun-images which were placed on high over them he had cut down; and the pillars of wood and the metal images he had broken up and crushed to dust, dropping the dust over the resting-places of the dead who had made offerings to them.
sentences.susu: A naxa yaamari fi Bali kuye xa sɛrɛxɛbadee xa kana, surayi ganma dɛnnaxɛ kuye bɛ xa ba naa, Aseri kuye wuri daaxie xa sɛgɛ, kuye naxee yailanxi yɔxui ra xa iluntun. A naxa na kuye iluntunxi fuɲi funfun e xa sɛrɛxɛbae xa gaburie fari.

sentences.english: And he had the bones of the priests burned on their altars, and so he made Judah and Jerusalem clean.
sentences.susu: A naxa kuyee xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xɔrie gan kuye sɛrɛxɛbadee fari, alako Yudaya nun Darisalamu xa sɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: And in all the towns of Manasseh and Ephraim and Simeon as far as Naphtali, he made waste their houses round about.
sentences.susu: A naxa siga Manasi, Efirami, Simeyɔn, nun Nafatali taae kui, nun e xa yire kanaxie kui,

sentences.english: He had the altars and the pillars of wood pulled down and the images crushed to dust, and all the sun-images cut down, through all the land of Israel, and then he went back to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: a fa sɛrɛxɛbadee nun Aseri kuye wuri daaxie kana. A naxa kuyee iluntun, a surayi sɛrɛxɛbadee sɛgɛ Isirayila bɔxi birin ma. Na tɛmui a naxa gbilen Darisalamu.

sentences.english: Now in the eighteenth year of his rule, when the land and the house had been made clean, he sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah, the ruler of the town, and Joah, the son of Joahaz, the recorder, to make good what was damaged in the house of the Lord his God.
sentences.susu: Yosiya xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun solomasaxan nde ra, a naxa Asaliya xa di Safan, nun taa gomina Maaseya, nun Yowaxasa xa di Yowa sɛbɛliti xɛɛ a Marigi Alatala xa banxi yailande. A nu wama bɔxi nun hɔrɔmɔbanxi rasɛniyɛnfe.

sentences.english: And they came to Hilkiah, the chief priest, and gave him all the money which had been taken into the house of God, which the Levites, the keepers of the door, had got from Manasseh and Ephraim and those of Israel who had not been taken away as prisoners, and from all Judah and Benjamin and the people of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: E naxa siga sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi Xilikiya yire, e fa kɔbiri so a yi ra naxan nu bara fi Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa fe ra. Lewikae naxee findixi naadɛ kantɛe ra nu bara na kɔbiri maxili ɲama ma, ɲama naxan kelixi Manasi, Efirami, Isirayila, Yudaya, Bunyamin bɔxi ma, nun Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And they gave it to the overseers of the work of the Lord's house, and the overseers gave it to the workmen working in the house, for building it up and making good what was damaged;
sentences.susu: E naxa na kɔbiri taxu Alatala xa banxi wali xunyie ra. Alako nee xa nɔ kamudɛrie, banxitie nun walikɛ mɔɔli birin sare fide.

sentences.english: Even to the woodworkers and builders to get cut stone and wood for joining the structure together and for making boards for the houses which the kings of Judah had given up to destruction.
sentences.susu: E man xa nɔ gɛmɛ nun wuri sarade, e xa banxi gbɛtɛe rakeli Yudaya mangɛe nu bara naxee lu e xa kana.

sentences.english: And the men did the work well; and those who had authority over them were Jahath and Obadiah, Levites of the sons of Merari, and Zechariah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, who were to be responsible for seeing that the work was done; and others of the Levites, who were expert with instruments of music,
sentences.susu: Yi mixie wali nɛ sɔɔbɛ ra Lewika ndee xa yaamari bun ma. Nee xilie nan ya: Merari xa die Yaxati nun Abadiyasi, nun Kehati xa die Sakari nun Mesulama.

sentences.english: Had authority over the transport workers, giving directions to all who were doing any sort of work; and among the Levites there were scribes and overseers and door-keepers.
sentences.susu: Yi Lewikae nan nu na bɛɛtiba fanyie ra. E naxa wali birin mato. Lewika gbɛtɛe naxa e ɲɔxɔ sa sɛbɛli tife nun naadɛ makantafe xɔnma.

sentences.english: Now when they were taking out the money which had come into the Lord's house, Hilkiah the priest came across the book of the law of the Lord, which he had given by the mouth of Moses.
sentences.susu: E to nu kɔbiri raminife, naxan nu bara xanin Alatala xa banxi kui, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Xilikiya naxa sɛriyɛ kitaabui to Alatala naxan fixi Annabi Munsa saabui ra.

sentences.english: Then Hilkiah said to Shaphan the scribe, I have made discovery of the book of the law in the house of the Lord. And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan.
sentences.susu: Xilikiya naxa a fala sɛbɛliti Safan bɛ, «N bara Tawureta Munsa to Alatala xa banxi kui.» Xilikiya naxa na kitaabui so Safan yi ra.

sentences.english: And Shaphan took the book to the king; and he gave him an account of what had been done, saying, Your servants are doing all they have been given to do;
sentences.susu: Safan naxa kitaabui xanin mangɛ xɔn, a fa a dɛntɛgɛ, «I yaamari naxan fi, i xa walikɛe bara na birin naba.

sentences.english: They have taken out all the money which was in the Lord's house and have given it to the overseers and to the workmen.
sentences.susu: E bara fa kɔbiri ra naxan nu na Alatala xa banxi kui, e na so wali xunyie yi ra a nun mixi yi ra naxee na na wali rabafe.»

sentences.english: Then Shaphan the scribe said to the king, Hilkiah the priest has given me a book; and he made a start at reading some of it to the king.
sentences.susu: Sɛbɛliti Safan man naxa a dɛntɛgɛ mangɛ bɛ, «Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Xilikiya bara kitaabui nde so n yi ra.» Safan naxa na radangi mangɛ ma.

sentences.english: And the king, hearing the words of the law, took his robe in his hands, violently parting it as a sign of his grief.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ to na kitaabui xa masenyi mɛ, a naxa a yɛtɛ xa dugie ibɔɔ sunnunyi ma.

sentences.english: And he gave orders to Hilkiah and to Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, and Abdon, the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe and Asaiah, the king's servant, saying,
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa yi yaamari so Xilikiya, Safan xa di Axikama, Mike xa di Abadon, sɛbɛliti Safan, nun mangɛ rasi Asaya yi ra,

sentences.english: Go and get directions from the Lord for me and for those who are still in Israel and for Judah, about the words of this book which has come to light; for great is the wrath of the Lord which has been let loose on us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the Lord or done what is recorded in this book.
sentences.susu: «Wo siga, wo sa Alatala maxɔrin n bɛ, a nun Isirayilakae nun Yudayakae bɛ, yi masenyi xa fe ra naxan sɛbɛxi yi kitaabui kui wo naxan toxi. Alatala xa xɔnɛ gbo won xili ma, barima won babae mu Alatala xa sɛriyɛ rabatu alɔ a sɛbɛxi yi kitaabui kui ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: So Hilkiah, and those whom the king sent, went to Huldah the woman prophet, the wife of Shallum, the son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, the keeper of the robes (now she was living in Jerusalem, in the second part of the town); and they had talk with her about this thing.
sentences.susu: Xilikiya nun mangɛ xa xɛɛra booree naxa siga Xulida xɔn ma, Salumu xa ginɛ. Salumu Tokehati xa di, Xasira xa mamadi nan nu a ɲɔxɔ saxi hɔrɔmɔbanxi dugi sɛniyɛnxie xɔnma. Xulida, namiɲɔnmɛ ginɛ nan nu a ra. A nu sabatixi Darisalamu, taa nɛɛnɛ kui. E naxa dɛ masara alɔ mangɛ a fala ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And she said to them, The Lord, the God of Israel, has said, Say to the man who sent you to me,
sentences.susu: Xulida naxa a fala e bɛ, «Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: ‹A fala mangɛ bɛ naxan wo xɛɛxi,

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord: See, I will send evil on this place and on its people, even all the curses in the book which they have been reading before the king of Judah;
sentences.susu: a Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: N fama ɲaxankatɛ ra yi taa nun a xa mixie bɛ, n dankɛ ragoroma nɛ naxee xaranxi Yudaya mangɛ bɛ yi kitaabui kui,

sentences.english: Because they have given me up, burning offerings to other gods and moving me to wrath by all the works of their hands; so my wrath is let loose on this place and will not be put out.
sentences.susu: barima e bara n nabolo, e bara surayi gan sɛrɛxɛ ra alae gbɛtɛe bɛ. Na bara a niya n xa xɔnɔ e xa wali ma. N ma xɔnɛ bara lu yi taa xun ma, a mu kelima naa.›

sentences.english: But to the king of Judah who sent you to get directions from the Lord, say, This is what the Lord, the God of Israel, has said: Because you have given ear to my words,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo xa a fala mangɛ bɛ naxan wo xɛɛxi alako a xa Alatala xa natɛ kolon, Isirayila Marigi Alatala naxan masenxi,

sentences.english: And your heart was soft, and you made yourself low before God, on hearing his words about this place and its people, and with weeping and signs of grief have made yourself low before me, I have given ear to you, says the Lord God.
sentences.susu: ‹I bɔɲɛ to bara yi fe suxu, i fa i magoro n bɛ, i i tuli mati n wɔyɛnyi ra n naxan falaxi yi taa nun a xa mixie xili ma, i fa i xa dugie ibɔɔ yɛtɛ magore kui, i i mawa n bɛ, na birin kui, n tan Alatala fan bara i xui mɛ.

sentences.english: See, I will let you go to your fathers, and be put in your last resting-place in peace, and your eyes will not see all the evil which I will send on this place and on its people. So they took this news back to the king.
sentences.susu: N i xaninma nɛ i benbae yire bɔɲɛsa kui. E fama i ragatade, i yae mu yi taa nun a xa mixie xa ɲaxankatɛ toma.›» E naxa na dɛntɛgɛ mangɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: Then the king sent and got together all the responsible men of Judah and of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa Yudaya nun Darisalamu forie xili.

sentences.english: And the king went up to the house of the Lord, with all the men of Judah and the people of Jerusalem, and the priests and the Levites and all the people, small and great; and they were present at his reading of the book of the law which had come to light in the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: A naxa te Alatala xa banxi yire, Yudayakae, Darisalamukae, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, Lewikae, nun ɲama birin, kelife mixi mɔxie ma sa dɔxɔ dimɛe ra, birin naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra. Mangɛ naxa kitaabui xaran e bɛ Ala xa saatɛ fe sɛbɛxi naxan kui, e nu bara naxan to Alatala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: Then the king, taking his place by the pillar, made an agreement before the Lord, to go in the way of the Lord, and to keep his orders and his decisions and his rules with all his heart and with all his soul, and to keep the words of the agreement recorded in this book.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa ti a tide, a saatɛ tongo Alatala bɛ a xa bira Alatala xa sɛriyɛ, a xa yaamari, nun a xa xaranyi birin fɔxɔ ra a bɔɲɛ nun a nii birin na.

sentences.english: And he made all the people in Jerusalem and Benjamin give their word to keep it. And the people of Jerusalem kept the agreement of God, the God of their fathers.
sentences.susu: A naxa yaamari fi Darisalamukae, Bunyaminkae, nun mixi birin ma naxee nu na Darisalamu na waxati, e fan xa saatɛ tongo e babae Marigi Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: Josiah took away all the disgusting things out of all the lands of the children of Israel, and made all who were in Israel servants of the Lord their God. And as long as he was living they were true to the Lord, the God of their fathers.
sentences.susu: Yosiya naxa kuye batui birin dan si gbɛtɛe nun Isirayila nu naxan nabama. A naxa Isirayilakae birin yaamari e xa e Marigi Alatala rabatu. Mangɛ xa simaya birin kui, ɲama mu tin e babae Marigi Alatala rabolode.

sentences.english: And Josiah kept a Passover to the Lord in Jerusalem; on the fourteenth day of the first month they put the Passover lamb to death.
sentences.susu: Yosiya naxa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali raba Darisalamu Alatala xa binyɛ bun ma. E naxa na sɛrɛxɛ ba kike singe xi fu nun naani lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: And he gave the priests their places, making them strong for the work of the house of God.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ti e xa wali ra Alatala xa banxi kui. A naxa e ralimaniya.

sentences.english: And he said to the Levites, the teachers of all Israel, who were holy to the Lord, See, the holy ark is in the house which Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel, made; it will no longer have to be transported on your backs: now be the servants of the Lord your God and his people Israel,
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Lewikae bɛ, naxee nu Isirayila birin xaranma, naxee nu bara sɛniyɛn Alatala xa wali xa fe ra, «Wo saatɛ kankira sɛniyɛnxi dɔxɔ salide kui Dawuda xa di Sulemani, Isirayila mangɛ, naxan tixi. Wo mu a xaninma wo tunki fari sɔnɔn. Wo xa wali wo Marigi Alatala nun a xa ɲama Isirayila bɛ.

sentences.english: And make yourselves ready in your divisions, by your families, as it is ordered in the writings of David, king of Israel, and of Solomon his son;
sentences.susu: Wo xa sali fe dɔxɔ a denbaya nun a xundɛ ki ma, alɔ Isirayila mangɛ Dawuda a sɛbɛxi ki naxɛ, alɔ a xa di Sulemani a yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And take your positions in the holy place, grouped in the families of your brothers, the children of the people, and for every division let there be a part of a family of the Levites.
sentences.susu: Lewikae, xundɛ yo xundɛ a denbaya kima xa ti yire sɛniyɛnxi kui wo ngaxakerenyi booree ti kima e xabilɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: And put the Passover lamb to death, and make yourselves holy, and make it ready for your brothers, so that the orders given by the Lord through Moses may be done.
sentences.susu: Wo lan nɛ wo xa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali sɛrɛxɛ ba, wo wo yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn, wo na rafala wo ngaxakerenyie bɛ Alatala xa sɛriyɛ ki ma, Annabi Munsa naxan fixi wo ma.»

sentences.english: And Josiah gave lambs and goats from the flock as Passover offerings for all the people who were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand oxen: these were from the king's private property.
sentences.susu: Yosiya naxa yɛxɛɛe, yɛxɛɛyɔrɛe, nun sie ba sɛrɛxɛ ra ɲama bɛ Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali xa fe ra. A man naxa ninge wulu saxan ba a harige ra na mixi wulu tongo saxan bɛ.

sentences.english: And his captains freely gave an offering to the people, the priests, and the Levites. Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, the rulers of the house of God, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand, six hundred small cattle and three hundred oxen.
sentences.susu: A xa kuntigie fan naxa xurusee ba sɛrɛxɛ ra ɲama, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, nun Lewikae bɛ. Xilikiya, Sakari, nun Yɛxiyɛli, Ala xa banxi yareratie naxa xuruse lanma wulu firin kɛmɛ senni nun ninge kɛmɛ saxan ba sɛrɛxɛ ra sɛrɛxɛdubɛe bɛ na sali tɛmui.

sentences.english: And Conaniah and Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, gave to the Levites for the Passover offerings five thousand small cattle and five hundred oxen.
sentences.susu: Lewika xunyie, Konaniyahu a ngaxakerenyie, Semaya Netaneeli, Xasabiya, Yeyiyeli nun Yosabadi naxa xuruse lanma wulu suuli nun ninge kɛmɛ suuli ba Lewikae bɛ na sali tɛmui.

sentences.english: So everything was made ready and the priests took their places with the Levites in their divisions, as the king had said.
sentences.susu: Wali raba yi ki nɛ: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae naxa ti e sanyi ra e xundɛe ki ma alɔ mangɛ a yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And they put the Passover lambs to death, the blood being drained out by the priests when it was given to them, and the Levites did the skinning.
sentences.susu: Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali sɛrɛxɛ kɔn to raxaba, Lewikae nu a wuli soma sɛrɛxɛdubɛe yi ra, nee nu fa na wuli kasan sɛrɛxɛbade ma. Lewikae na gɛ sɛrɛxɛ burade,

sentences.english: And they took away the burned offerings, so that they might give them to be offered to the Lord for the divisions of the families of the people, as it is recorded in the book of Moses. And they did the same with the oxen.
sentences.susu: e nu na sube itaxunma ɲama ma e xabilɛe ki ma. Naxan findima sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra Alatala bɛ, e nu na sama a xati ma alɔ a sɛbɛxi Tawureta Munsa kui ki naxɛ. Ningee fan naba na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And the Passover lamb was cooked over the fire, as it says in the law; and the holy offerings were cooked in pots and basins and vessels, and taken quickly to all the people.
sentences.susu: E naxa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali sɛrɛxɛ gan tɛ ra a sɛriyɛ ki ma, e man donse sɛniyɛnxi gbɛtɛe ɲin tundee kui, e na itaxun ɲama ma.

sentences.english: And after that, they made ready for themselves and for the priests; for the priests, the sons of Aaron, were offering the burned offerings and the fat till night; so the Levites made ready what was needed for themselves and for the priests, the sons of Aaron.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, e naxa e gbe nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛe gbe ɲin. E nu a rabama na ki nɛ, barima Haruna xa di sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nu sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nun ture bama sɛrɛxɛ ra han kɔɛ ra. Lewikae nan nu na birin nafalama Haruna xa di sɛrɛxɛdubɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Asaph, the makers of melody, were in their places, as ordered by David and Asaph and Heman and Jeduthun, the king's seer; and the door-keepers were stationed at every door: there was no need for them to go away from their places, for their brothers the Levites made ready for them.
sentences.susu: Asafi xa di bɛɛtibae naxa ti e tide alɔ Dawuda, Asafi, Heman, nun mangɛ rasi Yedutun a yamari ki naxɛ. Naadɛ kantɛe fan nu na e tide. E mu nu kelima e walidee, barima e ngaxakerenyi Lewikae nu e gbe donse rafalama.

sentences.english: So everything needed for the worship of the Lord was made ready that same day, for the keeping of the Passover and the offering of burned offerings on the altar of the Lord, as King Josiah had given orders.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Alatala xa wali birin naba Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali sɛriyɛ ki nan ma, alako sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi xa ba Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade fari alɔ Yosiya a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And all the children of Israel who were present kept the Passover and the feast of unleavened bread at that time for seven days.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka naxee nu na, nee naxa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali nun Taami Lɛbinitare Sali raba xi solofere bun ma.

sentences.english: No Passover like it had been kept in Israel from the days of Samuel the prophet; and not one of the kings of Israel had ever kept a Passover like the one kept by Josiah and the priests and the Levites and all those of Judah and Israel who were present, and the people of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali yo mu nu raba na ki Isirayila bɔxi ma kabi Annabi Samuweli xa waxati. Isirayila mangɛ yo mu nu lu na naxan nu bara a raba alɔ Yosiya, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, Lewikae, Yudayakae, Isirayilakae, nun Darisalamukae a rabaxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: In the eighteenth year of the rule of Josiah this Passover was kept.
sentences.susu: Na Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali raba Yosiya xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun solomasaxan nde nɛ.

sentences.english: After all this, and after Josiah had put the house in order, Neco, king of Egypt, went up to make war at Carchemish by the river Euphrates; and Josiah went out against him.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Yosiya to gɛ Alatala xa banxi yailande, Misira mangɛ Neko naxa te Karakemisi gerede, Efirati xure fɛ ma. Yosiya naxa wa gere tife Neko bɛ.

sentences.english: But he sent representatives to him, saying, What have I to do with you, O king of Judah? I have not come against you this day, but against those with whom I am at war; and God has given me orders to go forward quickly: keep out of God's way, for he is with me, or he will send destruction on you.
sentences.susu: Neko naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ a yire a falafe ra, «Yudaya mangɛ, i wama n gerefe munfe ra? N mu minixi i tan xa gerede. N minixi n yaxui nde nan gerede, alɔ Ala a fala n bɛ ki naxɛ. I naxa ti Ala kanke xa na mu a ra i xun nakanama nɛ. Muxu nun Ala na a ra.»

sentences.english: However, Josiah would not go back; but keeping to his purpose of fighting against him, and giving no attention to the words of Neco, which came from God, he went forward to the fight in the valley of Megiddo.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Yosiya mu gbilen a xa natɛ fɔxɔ ra, a naxa tondi a tuli matide Ala xa masenyi ra Neko naxan falaxi. A naxa siga Megido gulunba gere sode.

sentences.english: And the bowmen sent their arrows at King Josiah, and the king said to his servants, Take me away, for I am badly wounded.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni sɔɔrie naxa mangɛ Yosiya sɔxɔ tanbɛe ra. A naxa a fala a xa mixie bɛ, «Wo n xanin, barima n maxɔnɔxi a ɲaaxi ra.»

sentences.english: So his servants took him out of the line of war-carriages, and put him in his second carriage and took him to Jerusalem, where he came to his end, and they put his body in the resting-place of his fathers. And in all Judah and Jerusalem there was great weeping for Josiah.
sentences.susu: Yi gere yire, a xa mixie naxa a ramini na ra a xa sɔɔri ragise kui. E naxa a radangi a xa sɔɔri ragise firin nde kui, e fa a xanin Darisalamu. A naxa laaxiraya mɛnni, e fa a ragata a babae xa gaburie fɛ ma. Yudaya nun Darisalamu birin naxa lu sunnunyi kui Yosiya xa faxɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And Jeremiah made a song of grief for Josiah; and to this day Josiah is named by all the makers of melody, men and women, in their songs of grief; they made it a rule in Israel; and the songs are recorded among the songs of grief.
sentences.susu: Annabi Yeremi naxa ɲɔnfe bɛɛti nde sɛbɛ Yosiya xa binyɛ bun ma. Han to bɛɛtibae na bama Isirayila bɔxi ma, na fan sɛbɛxi ɲɔnfe bɛɛti buki kui.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and the good he did, in keeping with what is recorded in the law of the Lord,
sentences.susu: Yosiya xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛe nun a xa dugutɛgɛɲa Alatala xa sɛriyɛ ma,

sentences.english: And all his acts, first and last, are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
sentences.susu: a fɔlɛ nun a raɲɔnyi birin sɛbɛxi Isirayila nun Yudaya mangɛe xa taruxui kui.

sentences.english: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz, the son of Josiah, and made him king in Jerusalem in place of his father.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa Yosiya xa di Yehowaxasi ti mangɛ ra Darisalamu a baba ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he became king; he was ruling in Jerusalem for three months.
sentences.susu: Yehowaxasi mangɛya sɔtɔ a ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan nan ma, a kike saxan mangɛya raba Darisalamu.

sentences.english: Then the king of Egypt took the kingdom from him in Jerusalem, and put on the land a tax of a hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa a ba mangɛya ra Darisalamu, a fa gbeti kilo wulu saxan nun xɛɛma kilo tongo saxan maxili e ma duuti ra.

sentences.english: And the king of Egypt made Eliakim his brother king over Judah and Jerusalem, changing his name to Jehoiakim. And Neco took his brother Jehoahaz away to Egypt.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ naxa Yehowaxasi ngaxakerenyi Eliyakimi ti mangɛ ra Yudaya nun Darisalamu xun ma. A naxa Eliyakimi xili masara Yehoyakimi ra. Neko naxa a ngaxakerenyi Yehowaxasi xanin Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he became king; he was ruling in Jerusalem for eleven years, and he did evil in the eyes of the Lord his God.
sentences.susu: Eliyakimi mangɛya sɔtɔ a ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli nan ma, a fa ɲɛ fu nun firin mangɛya raba Darisalamu. A naxa fe ɲaaxi raba a Marigi Alatala ya xɔri.

sentences.english: Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, came up against him, and took him away in chains to Babylon.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari naxa a gere, a fa yɔlɔnxɔnyi yɔxui daaxi sa a ma, a a xanin Babilɔn bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Nebuchadnezzar took away some of the vessels of the Lord's house, and put them in the house of his god in Babylon.
