sentences.susu: Nebukadansari naxa see ba Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, a fa e xanin a xɔnyi Babilɔn.

sentences.english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim and the disgusting things he did, and all there is to be said against him, are recorded in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah; and Jehoiachin his son became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Yehoyakimi xa taruxui dɔnxɔɛe, a xa fe ɲaaxie nun a xa yunubie a naxee rabaxi, nee birin sɛbɛxi Isirayila nun Yudaya mangɛe xa taruxui kui. Yehoyakini naxa ti mangɛ ra a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he became king; he was ruling in Jerusalem for three months and ten days, and he did evil in the eyes of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Yehoyakini mangɛya sɔtɔ a ɲɛ solomasaxan nan ma, a fa kike saxan xi fu mangɛya raba Darisalamu. A naxa fe ɲaaxi raba a Marigi Alatala ya xɔri.

sentences.english: In the spring of the year King Nebuchadnezzar sent and took him away to Babylon, with the beautiful vessels of the house of the Lord, and made Zedekiah, his father's brother, king over Judah and Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Naaraba fɔlɛ, mangɛ Nebukadansari naxa a xanin Babilɔn, a nun harige naxan nu na Alatala xa banxi kui. A naxa Yehoyakimi ngaxakerenyi sedekiya ti mangɛ ra Yudaya nun Darisalamu xun ma.

sentences.english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king; he was ruling in Jerusalem for eleven years.
sentences.susu: Sedekiya mangɛya sɔtɔ a ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun keren nan ma, a fa ɲɛ fu nun keren mangɛya raba Darisalamu.

sentences.english: He did evil in the eyes of the Lord, and did not make himself low before Jeremiah the prophet who gave him the word of the Lord.
sentences.susu: A naxa fe ɲaaxi raba a Marigi Alatala ya xɔri. A mu a yɛtɛ magoro Annabi Yeremi bɛ, naxan nu wɔyɛnma Alatala xili ra.

sentences.english: And he took up arms against King Nebuchadnezzar, though he had made him take an oath by God; but he made his neck stiff and his heart hard, turning away from the Lord, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: A naxa mangɛ Nebukadansari fan matandi, naxan nu bara a rakali Ala xili ra. A naxa a kobe ti Alatala ra, a naxa a bɔɲɛ balan gbilenfe ra Isirayila Marigi Alatala ma.

sentences.english: And more than this, all the great men of Judah and the priests and the people made their sin great, turning to all the disgusting ways of the nations; and they made unclean the house of the Lord which he had made holy in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun ɲama naxa Alatala rabolo, e fe ɲaaxi raba si gbɛtɛ darixi naxan na. E naxa sɛniyɛntareɲa raba Alatala xa banxi kui, a nu bara naxan nasɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: And the Lord, the God of their fathers, sent word to them by his servants, sending early and frequently, because he had pity on his people and on his living-place;
sentences.susu: E babae Marigi Alatala nu xɛɛrae xɛɛma tɛmui birin, barima a nu wama a xa ɲama nun a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi rakisife.

sentences.english: But they put shame on the servants of God, making sport of his words and laughing at his prophets, till the wrath of God was moved against his people, till there was no help.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e naxa yo Ala xa xɛɛrae nun e xa masenyi ma. E mu tin Ala xa namiɲɔnmɛe xa wɔyɛnyi ra fefe ma. Na na a ra Alatala naxa xɔnɔ a xa ɲama ma, han na xɔnɛ seri mu na sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: So he sent against them the king of the Chaldaeans, who put their young men to death with the sword in the house of their holy place, and had no pity for any, young man or virgin, old man or white-haired: God gave them all into his hands.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala naxa Kalidi mangɛ xɛɛ e xili ma, a fa e xa sɛgɛtalae faxa salide kui. Ala naxa ɲama birin so a yi ra, ginɛe nun xɛmɛe, fonikee nun mixi mɔxie.

sentences.english: And all the vessels of the house of God, great and small, and the stored wealth of the Lord's house and the wealth of the king and his chiefs, he took away to Babylon.
sentences.susu: Nebukadansari naxa se birin ba Ala xa banxi kui, a lanmae nun a xungbee. A naxa naafuli tongo Alatala nun mangɛ nun a xa kuntigie xa banxie kui.

sentences.english: And the house of God was burned and the wall of Jerusalem broken down; all its great houses were burned with fire and all its beautiful vessels given up to destruction.
sentences.susu: A naxa Ala xa banxi gan, a Darisalamu tɛtɛ rabira. A banxi fanyie nun se fanyi birin gan taa kui.

sentences.english: And all who had not come to death by the sword he took away prisoners to Babylon; and they became servants to him and to his sons till the kingdom of Persia came to power:
sentences.susu: Naxee mu faxa gere kui, Nebukadansari naxa nee xanin Babilɔn konyiya kui a tan nun a xa die bɛ, nee lu naa nɛ han Perise mangɛya waxati.

sentences.english: So that the words of the Lord, which he said by the mouth of Jeremiah, might come true, till the land had had pleasure in her Sabbaths; for as long as she was waste the land kept the Sabbath, till seventy years were complete.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi, a naxan masenxi Annabi Yeremi saabui ra, a kamalixi na ki nɛ. Na masenyi nan ya: «Bɔxi fama a malabude ɲɛ tongo solofere, han a xa malabui waxati kamali a mu naxee raba gbaloe waxati.»

sentences.english: Now in the first year of Cyrus, king of Persia, in order that the words which the Lord had said by the mouth of Jeremiah might come true, the spirit of Cyrus, king of Persia, was moved by the Lord, and he made a public statement and had it given out through all his kingdom and put in writing, saying,
sentences.susu: Perise mangɛ Sirusi xa mangɛya ɲɛ singe, Alatala naxa a sa Sirusi xaxili ma alako a xa natɛ tongo yaamari nde xa fe ra, a man xa na masen, a xa na sɛbɛ a xa mangɛya birin kui. Alatala nu bara na birin masen Annabi Yeremi saabui ra. Na yaamari nan ya:

sentences.english: Cyrus, king of Persia, has said, All the kingdoms of the earth have been given to me by the Lord, the God of heaven; and he has made me responsible for building a house for him in Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Whoever there is among you of all his people, may the Lord his God be with him and let him go up.
sentences.susu: «Perise mangɛ Sirusi xa masenyi nan ya: Alatala naxan na koore ma, naxan bara si birin sa n ma yaamari bun ma, na bara a masen n bɛ n xa a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ti Darisalamu Yudaya bɔxi ma. Naxee kelixi a xa ɲama ya ma, e xa te Darisalamu. E Marigi Alatala xa lu a sɛɛti ma.»

sentences.english: Now in the first year of Cyrus, king of Persia, in order that the word of the Lord given by the mouth of Jeremiah might come true, the spirit of Cyrus, king of Persia, was moved by the Lord, so that he made a public statement through all his kingdom, and put it in writing, saying,
sentences.susu: Perise mangɛ Sirusi xa mangɛya fɔlɔ ɲɛ naxan na, Alatala naxa wa fe rakamalife a naxan masen Annabi Yeremi bɛ. Alatala naxa a sa Sirusi bɔɲɛ ma, a xa yi masenyi fala, a man xa a sɛbɛ mixie bɛ naxee na a xa yaamari bun ma. Na masenyi nan yi ki:

sentences.english: These are the words of Cyrus, king of Persia: The Lord God of heaven has given me all the kingdoms of the earth; and he has made me responsible for building a house for him in Jerusalem, which is in Judah.
sentences.susu: «N tan Perise mangɛ Sirusi xui nan ya. Marigi Alatala naxan na koore ma naxan duniɲa mangɛya birin fixi n ma, a bara n yaamari, n xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ti a bɛ Darisalamu, Yudaya bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Whoever there is among you of his people, may his God be with him, and let him go up to Jerusalem, which is in Judah, and take in hand the building of the house of the Lord, the God of Israel; he is the God who is in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Naxee birin findixi Ala xa ɲama ra wo ya ma, e birin xa gbilen Darisalamu, Yudaya bɔxi ma, alako e xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ti Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ, naxan na Ala ra Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And whoever there may be of the rest of Israel, living in any place, let the men of that place give him help with offerings of silver and gold and goods and beasts, in addition to the offering freely given for the house of God in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Perisekae xa e dɔxɔboore Isirayila mixie ki gbeti, xɛɛma, se fanyie, nun xurusee ra naxee bama sɛrɛxɛ ɲanigexie ra Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui Darisalamu.»

sentences.english: Then the heads of families of Judah and Benjamin, with the priests and the Levites, got ready, even all those whose spirits were moved by God to go up and take in hand the building of the Lord's house in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Yuda nun Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ kuntigie, Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxee nu na e ya ma, a nun Ala naxee birin bɔɲɛ rate sigafe ra, e birin naxa siga Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi tide Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And all their neighbours gave them help with offerings of vessels of silver and gold and goods and beasts and things of great value, in addition to what was freely offered.
sentences.susu: E dɔxɔbooree naxa e ki gbeti, xɛɛma, se fanyie, xurusee, nun harige ra, a nun sɛrɛxɛ ɲanigexie.

sentences.english: And Cyrus the king got out the vessels of the house of the Lord which Nebuchadnezzar had taken from Jerusalem and put in the house of his gods;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Nebukadansari nu bara se gbegbe ramini Darisalamu hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui a xa waxati, a fa e raso a xa ala xa banxi kui. Perise mangɛ Sirusi naxa na birin namini,

sentences.english: Even these Cyrus made Mithredath, the keeper of his wealth, get out, and he gave them, after numbering them, to Sheshbazzar, the ruler of Judah.
sentences.susu: a e taxu kɔbiri ragatama Miteredati ra, a xa a rasanba Yudaya mangɛ Sɛsɛbasari ma.

sentences.english: And this is the number of them: there were thirty gold plates, a thousand silver plates, twenty-nine knives,
sentences.susu: Na see kɔnti nan yi ki: paani xɛɛma daaxi tongo saxan, paani gbeti daaxi wulu keren, finɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun solomanaani,

sentences.english: Thirty gold basins, four hundred and ten silver basins, and a thousand other vessels.
sentences.susu: pileti xɛɛma daaxi tongo saxan, pileti gbeti daaxi kɛmɛ naani, pileti fu, a nun yirabase gbɛtɛ wulu keren.

sentences.english: There were five thousand, four hundred gold and silver vessels. All these were taken back by Sheshbazzar, when those who had been taken prisoner went up from Babylon to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Na se xɛɛma daaxi nun gbeti daaxi birin kɔnti naxa lan yirabase wulu suuli kɛmɛ naani ma. Isirayila geelimanie to keli Babilɔn gbilenfe ra Darisalamu, Sɛsɛbasari naxa na naafuli birin xanin a xun ma.

sentences.english: Now these are the people of the divisions of the kingdom, among those who had been made prisoners by Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, and taken away to Babylon, who went back to Jerusalem and Judah, everyone to his town;
sentences.susu: Mixie nan yi ki mangɛ Nebukadansari fa naxee ra Babilɔn bɔxi ma, naxee nu wama gbilenfe e xɔnyi Darisalamu nun Yudaya.

sentences.english: Who went with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, Baanah, The number of the men of the people of Israel:
sentences.susu: Sorobabeli, Yesuwa, Nehemi, Seraya, Reelaya, Morodekayi, Bilesan, Mispari, Begifayi, Rexumi, nun Baanna naxa findi e xa yareratie ra. Na Isirayila xɛmɛe kɔnti nan yi ki:

sentences.english: The children of Parosh, two thousand, one hundred and seventy-two.
sentences.susu: Paroso xa die, mixi wulu firin, mixi kɛmɛ, mixi tongo solofere nun firin.

sentences.english: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred and seventy-two.
sentences.susu: Sɛfataya xa die, mixi kɛmɛ saxan, mixi tongo solofere nun firin.

sentences.english: The children of Arah, seven hundred and seventy-five.
sentences.susu: Ara xa die, mixi kɛmɛ solofere, mixi tongo solofere nun suuli.

sentences.english: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand, eight hundred and twelve.
sentences.susu: Mowaba Paxati xa die, mixi wulu firin, mixi kɛmɛ solomasaxan nun mixi fu nun firin. Mowaba Paxati kelixi Yesuwa nun Yowaba xabilɛ nɛ.

sentences.english: The children of Elam, a thousand, two hundred and fifty-four.
sentences.susu: Elama xa die, mixi wulu keren, mixi kɛmɛ firin, mixi tongo suuli nun naani.

sentences.english: The children of Zattu, nine hundred and forty-five.
sentences.susu: Satu xa die, mixi kɛmɛ solomanaani, mixi tongo naani nun suuli.

sentences.english: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and sixty.
sentences.susu: Sakayi xa die, mixi kɛmɛ solofere nun mixi tongo senni.

sentences.english: The children of Bani, six hundred and forty-two.
sentences.susu: Bani xa die, mixi kɛmɛ senni, mixi tongo naani nun firin.

sentences.english: The children of Bebai, six hundred and twenty-three.
sentences.susu: Bibayi xa die, mixi kɛmɛ senni, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan.

sentences.english: The children of Azgad, a thousand, two hundred and twenty-two.
sentences.susu: Asigadi xa die, mixi wulu keren, mixi kɛmɛ firin, nun mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin.

sentences.english: The children of Adonikam, six hundred and sixty-six.
sentences.susu: Adonikama xa die mixi kɛmɛ senni, mixi tongo senni nun senni.

sentences.english: The children of Bigvai, two thousand and fifty-six.
sentences.susu: Begifayi xa die mixi wulu firin, mixi tongo suuli nun senni.

sentences.english: The children of Adin, four hundred and fifty-four.
sentences.susu: Adin xa die, mixi kɛmɛ naani, mixi tongo suuli nun naani.

sentences.english: The children of Ater, of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.
sentences.susu: Atɛri xa die, Xesekiya xabilɛ, mixi tongo solomanaani nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: The children of Bezai, three hundred and twenty-three.
sentences.susu: Beseyi xa die, mixi kɛmɛ saxan mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan.

sentences.english: The children of Jorah, a hundred and twelve.
sentences.susu: Yɔra xa die, mixi kɛmɛ, mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The children of Hashum, two hundred and twenty-three.
sentences.susu: Xasuma xa die, mixi kɛmɛ firin, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan.

sentences.english: The children of Gibbar, ninety-five.
sentences.susu: Gibari xa die, mixi tongo solomanaani nun suuli.

sentences.english: The children of Beth-lehem, a hundred and twenty-three.
sentences.susu: Bɛtɛlɛɛmu xɛmɛe, mixi kɛmɛ, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn, a nun saxan.

sentences.english: The men of Netophah, fifty-six.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee keli Netofa, mixi tongo suuli nun senni.

sentences.english: The men of Anathoth, a hundred and twenty-eight.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee keli Anatɔti, mixi kɛmɛ mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: The children of Azmaveth, forty-two.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee keli Asamafeti, mixi tongo naani nun firin.

sentences.english: The children of Kiriath-arim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty-three.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee keli Kiriyati Yeyarimi, Kefira, nun Beroti, mixi kɛmɛ solofere, mixi tongo naani nun saxan.

sentences.english: The children of Ramah and Geba, six hundred and twenty-one.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee keli Rama nun Geba, mixi kɛmɛ senni, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun keren.

sentences.english: The men of Michmas, a hundred and twenty-two.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee keli Mikimasi, mixi kɛmɛ, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin.

sentences.english: The men of Beth-el and Ai, two hundred and twenty-three.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee keli Beteli nun Ayi, mixi kɛmɛ firin, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan.

sentences.english: The children of Nebo, fifty-two.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee keli Nebo, mixi tongo suuli nun firin.

sentences.english: The children of Magbish, a hundred and fifty-six.
sentences.susu: Magibisa xa die, mixi kɛmɛ, mixi tongo suuli nun senni.

sentences.english: The children of the other Elam, a thousand, two hundred and fifty-four.
sentences.susu: Elama gbɛtɛ xa die, mixi wulu keren, mixi kɛmɛ firin, mixi tongo suuli nun naani.

sentences.english: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.
sentences.susu: Xarima xa die, mixi kɛmɛ saxan, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn.

sentences.english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred and twenty-five.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee keli Lodi nun Xadidi, mixi kɛmɛ solofere, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli.

sentences.english: The children of Jericho, three hundred and forty-five.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee keli Yeriko, mixi kɛmɛ saxan, mixi tongo naani nun suuli.

sentences.english: The children of Senaah, three thousand, six hundred and thirty.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee keli Senaa, mixi wulu saxan, mixi kɛmɛ senni, mixi tongo saxan.

sentences.english: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the house of Jeshua, nine hundred and seventy-three.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe kɔnti nan yi ki: Yɛdaya xa di naxee kelixi Yesuwa xabilɛ, mixi kɛmɛ solomanaani, mixi tongo solofere nun saxan.

sentences.english: The children of Immer, a thousand and fifty-two.
sentences.susu: Imeri xa die, mixi wulu keren, mixi tongo suuli nun firin.

sentences.english: The children of Pashhur, a thousand, two hundred and forty-seven.
sentences.susu: Pasura xa die, mixi wulu keren, mixi kɛmɛ firin, mixi tongo naani, nun solofere.

sentences.english: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
sentences.susu: Xarima xa die, mixi wulu keren, mixi fu nun solofere.

sentences.english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua and Kadmiel, of the children of Hodaviah, seventy-four.
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ kɔnti nan yi ki: Yesuwa nun Kadamiyɛli xa die, mixi tongo solofere nun naani.

sentences.english: The music-makers: the children of Asaph, a hundred and twenty-eight
sentences.susu: Bɛɛtibae kɔnti nan yi ki: Asafi xa die, mixi kɛmɛ, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: The children of the door-keepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, a hundred and thirty-nine.
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔbanxi makantɛe kɔnti nan yi ki: Salumu, Atɛri, Talamɔn, Akubu, Xatita, nun Sobayi xa die, mixi kɛmɛ, mixi tongo saxan nun solomanaani.

sentences.english: The Nethinim: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔbanxi walikɛe nan yi ki: Sixa xa die, Xasufa xa die, Tabayoti xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Keros, the children of Siaha, the children of Padon,
sentences.susu: Kerosi xa die, Siyaha xa die, Padon xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Lebanah, the children of Hagabah, the children of Akkub,
sentences.susu: Lebana xa die, Hagabaha xa die, Akubu xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Hagab, the children of Shamlai, the children of Hanan,
sentences.susu: Xagabi xa die, Salamayi xa die, Hanan xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Giddel, the children of Gahar, the children of Reaiah,
sentences.susu: Gidɛli xa die, Gaxari xa die, Reyaya xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda, the children of Gazzam,
sentences.susu: Resin xa die, Nekoda xa die, Gasama xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Uzza, the children of Paseah, the children of Besai,
sentences.susu: Usa xa die, Paseya xa die, Bisayi xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Asnah, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephisim,
sentences.susu: Asana xa die, Mewunima xa die, Nefusima xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
sentences.susu: Bakibuki xa die, Xakufa xa die, Xarixuri xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Bazluth, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
sentences.susu: Basiluti xa die, Mexida xa die, Xarasa xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,
sentences.susu: Barakɔsi xa die, Sisera xa die, Tema xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
sentences.susu: Nesiya xa die, nun Xatifa xa die.

sentences.english: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Hassophereth, the children of Peruda,
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sulemani xa walikɛe xa die nan yi ki: Sotayi xa die, Sofereti xa die, Peruda xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Jaalah, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
sentences.susu: Yaala xa die, Darakɔn xa die, Gidɛli xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth-hazzebaim, the children of Ami.
sentences.susu: Sɛfataya xa die, Xatili xa die, Pokɛrɛti Hasebayimi xa die, nun Ami xa die.

sentences.english: All the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon's servants, were three hundred and ninety-two.
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔbanxi walikɛe nun Sulemani xa walikɛe xa die birin findixi mixi kɛmɛ saxan, mixi tongo solomanaani, nun firin nan na.

sentences.english: And these were the people who went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addan, and Immer. But having no knowledge of their fathers' families or offspring, it was not certain that they were Israelites;
sentences.susu: Mixie nan yi ki naxee keli Mela, Xarasa, Kɛrubu Adan, nun Imeri. E mu nɔ a masende a e xabilɛ findixi Isirayilakae nan na.

sentences.english: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred and fifty-two.
sentences.susu: Dɛlaya xa die, Tobiya xa die, nun Nekoda xa die, e findixi mixi kɛmɛ senni mixi tongo suuli nun firin nan na.

sentences.english: And of the children of the priests: the children of Habaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who was married to one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and took their name.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa die fan nu na e ya ma: Xabaya xa die, Hakɔsi xa die, nun Barasilayi xa die. Barasilayi xa die benba nu bara Barasilayi Galadika xa di ginɛ dɔxɔ, a man naxa na xili tongo.

sentences.english: They made search for their record among the lists of families, but their names were nowhere to be seen; so they were looked on as unclean and no longer priests.
sentences.susu: E xilie to mu to taruxui kui, e mu nɔxi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali rabade.

sentences.english: And the Tirshatha said that they were not to have the most holy things for their food, till a priest came to give decision by Urim and Thummim.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala e bɛ, a e naxa donse sɛniyɛnxi don han sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nde nɔma e xa fe rafiixɛde Ala xa tɔnxumae Urimi nun Tumimi saabui ra tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: The number of all the people together was forty-two thousand, three hundred and sixty,
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxan gbilen Yudaya, a birin findi mixi wulu tongo naani nun firin, mixi kɛmɛ saxan mixi tongo senni nan na.

sentences.english: As well as their men-servants and their women-servants, of whom there were seven thousand, three hundred and thirty-seven: and they had two hundred men and women to make music.
sentences.susu: Konyi ginɛe nun xɛmɛe mu nu na na kɔnti ya ma. E fan lanxi mixi wulu solofere, mixi kɛmɛ saxan tongo saxan nun solofere nan ma. Bɛɛtibae fan findi mixi kɛmɛ firin nan na.

sentences.english: They had seven hundred and thirty-six horses, two hundred and forty-five transport beasts,
sentences.susu: Yi daalise xasabi nu na e yi ra: soe kɛmɛ solofere, tongo saxan nun senni, soe banaxi kɛmɛ firin, tongo naani nun suuli,

sentences.english: Four hundred and thirty-five camels, six thousand, seven hundred and twenty asses.
sentences.susu: ɲɔxɔmɛ kɛmɛ naani, tongo saxan nun suuli, a nun sofale wulu senni, kɛmɛ solofere mɔxɔɲɛn.

sentences.english: And some of the heads of families, when they came to the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem, gave freely of their wealth for the building up of the house of God in its place:
sentences.susu: Xabilɛ kuntigie to Ala xa banxi li Darisalamu, e naxa sɛrɛxɛ ɲanigexi ba Ala xa banxi xa fe ra, alako a man xa ti mɛnni.

sentences.english: Every one, as he was able, gave for the work sixty-one thousand darics of gold, five thousand pounds of silver and a hundred priests' robes.
sentences.susu: E naxa kɔbiri ba yi wali xa fe ra. Na kɔbiri findi kɔbiri kole wulu tongo senni nun keren nan na xɛɛma daaxi, a nun kɔbiri kole wulu suuli gbeti daaxi. E man naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ dugi kɛmɛ ba yi wali xa fe ra.

sentences.english: So the priests and the Levites and the people and the music-makers and the door-keepers and the Nethinim, took up their places in their towns; even all Israel in their towns.
sentences.susu: Na nan na ki sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie, bɛɛtibae, hɔrɔmɔbanxi kantae, nun hɔrɔmɔbanxi walikɛe, e birin naxa sabati e gbe taae kui, a nun Isirayilakae birin.

sentences.english: And when the seventh month came, and the children of Israel were in the towns, the people came together like one man to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Kike solofere to kamali, Isirayilaka naxee nu na na taae kui, nee birin naxa e malan Darisalamu.

sentences.english: Then Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and his brothers the priests, and Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, with his brothers, got up and made the altar of the God of Israel for burned offerings as is recorded in the law of Moses, the man of God.
sentences.susu: Yosadaki xa di Yesuwa nun a booree sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, a nun Salatiyeli xa di Sorobabeli nun a booree, e naxa kafu e boore ma, e sɛrɛxɛbade ti Isirayila Marigi Ala bɛ, alako e xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie ba alɔ Annabi Munsa a masen sɛriyɛ kui ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: They put the altar on its base; for fear was on them because of the people of the countries: and they made burned offerings on it to the Lord, even burned offerings morning and evening.
sentences.susu: E naxa na sɛrɛxɛbade ti a yire fori, e man naxa sɛrɛxɛ ba fɔlɔ gɛɛsɛgɛ nun nunmare. E nu na birin nabafe gaaxui nan kui si gbɛtɛe xa fe ra, naxee nu na e rabilinyi.

sentences.english: And they kept the feast of tents, as it is recorded, making the regular burned offerings every day by number, as it is ordered; for every day what was needed.
sentences.susu: E naxa Bage Ti Sali raba alɔ a sɛbɛxi kitaabui kui ki naxɛ, e man nu sɛrɛxɛe bama lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ sɛriyɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: And after that, the regular burned offering and the offerings for the new moons and all the fixed feasts of the Lord which had been made holy, and the offering of everyone who freely gave his offering to the Lord.
sentences.susu: E nu sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi bama Kike Nɛɛnɛ Sali nun sali xungbee waxati, a nun tɛmui gbɛtɛ mixi nde na a ɲanige tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: From the first day of the seventh month they made a start with the burned offerings, but the base of the Temple of the Lord had still not been put in its place.
sentences.susu: Na kike solofere nde lɔxɔɛ singe, e naxa sɛrɛxɛ ba fɔlɔ Ala bɛ, kɔnɔ Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi mu nu kɔɔrinxi sinden.

sentences.english: And they gave money to the stoneworkers and woodworkers; and meat and drink and oil to the people of Zidon and of Tyre, for the transport of cedar-trees from Lebanon to the sea, to Joppa, as Cyrus, king of Persia, had given them authority to do.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui e naxa kɔbiri ba alako Sidɔn nun Tire gɛmɛ masolie nun banxitie xa fa e malide. E naxa sansi xɔrie, wɛni, nun ture fan ba e bɛ, alako e xa fa wuri ra ye kira ra kelife Liban han Yafa, alɔ Perise mangɛ Sirusi a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Now in the second year of their coming into the house of God in Jerusalem, in the second month, the work was taken in hand by Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and the rest of their brothers the priests and the Levites, and all those who had come from the land where they were prisoners to Jerusalem: and they made the Levites, of twenty years old and over, responsible for overseeing the work of the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na ɲɛ igbilenyi, kike firin nde, Salatiyeli xa di Sorobabeli, Yosadaki xa di Yesuwa, e ngaxakerenyie, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie, nun ɲama naxan keli konyiya kui Perise bɔxi ma, e birin naxa wali fɔlɔ. Alatala xa banxi wali naxa taxu Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie ra, naxee nu bara ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun a xanbi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Then Jeshua with his sons and his brothers, Kadmiel with his sons, the sons of Hodaviah, together took up the work of overseeing the workmen in the house of God: the sons of Henadad with their sons and their brothers, the Levites.
sentences.susu: Yesuwa naxa a xa die, nun a ngaxakerenyi Kadamiyɛli, nun a xa die ti hɔrɔmɔbanxi walikɛe xunyie ra, a nun Xenadadi, a xa die, nun a ngaxakerenyi naxee kelixi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ.

sentences.english: And when the builders put in position the base of the Temple of the Lord, the priests, dressed in their robes, took their places with horns, and the Levites, the sons of Asaph, with brass instruments, to give praise to the Lord in the way ordered by David, king of Israel.
sentences.susu: Walikɛe to gɛ Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kɔɔrinde, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Asafi xa di Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie naxa Alatala matɔxɔ sarae nun maxasee xui ra, Isirayila mangɛ Dawuda xa sɛriyɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: And they gave praise to the Lord, answering one another in their songs and saying, For he is good, for his mercy to Israel is eternal. And all the people gave a great cry of joy, when they gave praise to the Lord, because the base of the Lord's house was put in place.
sentences.susu: E nu Alatala tantu, e a matɔxɔ yi bɛɛti ra, «Alatala nan fan, a hinnɛma Isirayila ra abadan.» Ɲama birin naxa Alatala matɔxɔ e xui itexi ra, Alatala xa banxi kɔɔrinfe xa fe ra.

sentences.english: But a number of the priests and Levites and the heads of families, old men who had seen the first house, when the base of this house was put down before their eyes, were overcome with weeping; and a number were crying out with joy:
sentences.susu: Fori naxee nu bara Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi singe to, e findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra, e findi kuntigie ra, e naxa wa e xui itexi ra. Booree naxa e xui rate sɛɛwɛ kui.

sentences.english: So that in the ears of the people the cry of joy was mixed with the sound of weeping; for the cries of the people were loud and came to the ears of those who were a long way off.
sentences.susu: Ɲama mu nɔ ɲɛlɛxinyi xui nun wa xui tagi rasade, barima ɲama xui xa gboe nu sigama han yire makuye.

sentences.english: Now news came to the haters of Judah and Benjamin that the people who had come back were building a Temple to the Lord, the God of Israel;
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛ nun Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ yaxuie naxa a kolon, mixi naxee nu na konyiya kui Perise bɔxi ma, e bara Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ti fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: Then they came to Zerubbabel and to the heads of families, and said to them, Let us take part in the building with you; for we are servants of your God, even as you are; and we have been making offerings to him from the days of Esar-haddon, king of Assyria, who put us here.
sentences.susu: E naxa siga, e a fala Sorobabeli nun Isirayila kuntigie bɛ, «Muxu wama a xɔn ma nɛ, won birin xa kafu won bore ma Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi tife ra. Muxu wo Marigi Ala nan batuma, muxu fan nu sɛrɛxɛ bama nɛ a bɛ kabi Asiriya mangɛ Esarixadoni tɛmui, naxan fa muxu ra be.»

sentences.english: But Zerubbabel and Jeshua and the rest of the heads of families in Israel said to them, You have no part with us in the building of a house for our God; we ourselves will do the work together for the Lord, the God of Israel, as Cyrus, king of Persia, has given us orders.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Sorobabeli, Yesuwa, nun Isirayila kuntigie naxa e yaabi, «A mu lanma won birin xa yi wali raba. Muxu gbansan nan Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi tima Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ, alɔ Perise mangɛ Sirusi a yamari ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Then the people of the land made the hands of the people of Judah feeble, troubling them with fear in their building;
sentences.susu: Na kui, mɛnnikae naxa kata limaniya bade Yudayakae yi ra. E naxa fe birin naba alako e xa na salide tife lu na.

sentences.english: And they gave payment to men who made designs against them and kept them from effecting their purpose, all through the time of Cyrus, king of Persia, till Darius became king.
sentences.susu: E naxa kɔbiri fi Yudaya marasima ndee ma alako na wali xa kana. Kelife Perise mangɛ Sirusi xa tɛmui, sa dɔxɔ Perise mangɛ Dariyusi xa tɛmui ra, e naxa fe birin naba na wali xun nakanafe ra.

sentences.english: And in the time of Ahasuerus, when he first became king, they put on record a statement against the people of Judah and Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Asuyerusu to mangɛya sɔtɔ Perise bɔxi ma, Yudayakae yaxuie naxa kalamui kɛɛdi nde sɛbɛ a ma Yudayakae nun Darisalamukae xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And in the time of Artaxerxes, Bishlam, Mithredath, Tabeel, and the rest of his friends, sent a letter to Artaxerxes, king of Persia, writing it in the Aramaean writing and language.
sentences.susu: Perise mangɛ Atasakasi xa waxati fan, Bikilamu, Miteredati, Tabeeli nun e boore dɔnxɔɛe naxa bataaxɛ sɛbɛ mangɛ ma Arami xui ra.

sentences.english: Rehum, the chief ruler, and Shimshai the scribe, sent a letter against Jerusalem, to Artaxerxes the king;
sentences.susu: Gomina Rexumi xa sɛbɛliti Simesayi naxa yi bataaxɛ sɛbɛ mangɛ Atasakasi ma a rakolonfe ra Darisalamu xa fe ma. A yi nan sɛbɛ:

sentences.english: The letter was sent by Rehum, the chief ruler, and Shimshai the scribe and their friends; the Dinaites and the Apharsathchites, the Tarpelites, the Apharsites, the Archevites, the Babylonians, the Shushanchites, the Dehaites, the Elamites,
sentences.susu: «Yi bataaxɛ fatanxi Gomina Rexumi nan ma, nun a xa sɛbɛliti Simesayi, a xa kuntigi naxee findixi kiitisae, sɛbɛlitie Erekikae, Babilɔnkae, nun Susaka naxee kelixi Elama bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: And the rest of the nations which the great and noble Osnappar took over and put in Samaria and the rest of the country over the river:
sentences.susu: a nun si gbɛtɛ mixie, mangɛ xungbe Usinapari naxee rasiga Efirati naakiri ma, e xa sabati Samari taae kui.

sentences.english: This is a copy of the letter which they sent to Artaxerxes the king: Your servants living across the river send these words:
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Atasakasi, yi bataaxɛ fatanxi i xa konyie nan na, naxee na xure naakiri ma.

sentences.english: We give news to the king that the Jews who came from you have come to us at Jerusalem; they are building up again that uncontrolled and evil town; the walls are complete and they are joining up the bases.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ, i xa a kolon Yuwifi naxee keli i xa bɔxi ma, e bara fa muxu mabiri, e fa sabati Darisalamu. E na na taa rakelife, naxan kolonxi matandilae xa taa ra. E bara a tɛtɛ yailan fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: The king may be certain that when the building of this town and its walls is complete, they will give no tax or payment in goods or forced payments, and in the end it will be a cause of loss to the kings.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ, i xa a kolon, xa e na tɛtɛ yailan, e naxa na taa ti, mɛnnikae mu duuti yo fima i ma sɔnɔn. Na findima fe xɔrɔxɔɛ nan na mangasanyi bɛ.

sentences.english: Now because we are responsible to the king, and it is not right for us to see the king's honour damaged, we have sent to give the king word of these things,
sentences.susu: Na na a ra, muxu tan naxan tixi i xanbi ra, muxu mu nɔma na fe binyɛtareɲa tode, a fa lu muxu mu i rakolon.

sentences.english: So that search may be made in the book of the records of your fathers: and you will see in the book of the records that this town has been uncontrolled, and a cause of trouble to kings and countries, and that there were outbursts against authority there in the past: for which reason the town was made waste.
sentences.susu: I na i babae xa taruxuie xaran, i fama a tode na taaka matandilae mu mangɛ yo binyama. Kabi tɛmui xɔnkuye e luma mangɛe matandi ra. E xa taa nu bara kana na nan ma.

sentences.english: We give you word, that if the building of this town and its walls is made complete, there will be an end of your power in the country across the river.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ, muxu xa a fala i bɛ, xa yi taa nun a tɛtɛ rakeli, i fama nɛ gande i xa bɔxi ra naxan na bebiri Efirati xure naakiri ma.»

sentences.english: Then the king sent an answer to Rehum, the chief ruler, and Shimshai the scribe, and their friends living in Samaria, and to the rest of those across the river, saying, Peace to you:
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa e yaabi yi sɛbɛli ra, «I tan gomina Rexumi, nun i xa sɛbɛliti Simesayi, nun I xa kuntigi naxee na Samari nun yire gbɛtɛ Efirati xure naakiri ma, n bara wo xɛɛbu.

sentences.english: And now the sense of the letter which you sent to us has been made clear to me,
sentences.susu: N ma mixie bara wo xa bataaxɛ madangi n ma xui ra, e a xaran n bɛ.

sentences.english: And I gave orders for a search to be made, and it is certain that in the past this town has made trouble for kings, and that outbursts against authority have taken place there.
sentences.susu: N bara e yamari e xa na taa taruxui fen. Na kui n bara a kolon, na taa luma mangasanyi matandi ra kabi tɛmui xɔnkuye.

sentences.english: Further, there have been great kings in Jerusalem, ruling over all the country across the river, to whom they gave taxes and payments in goods and forced payments.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ gbangbalanyi ndee nu na Darisalamu, naxee nu ɲamanɛ birin yamarima naxee nu na Efirati xure naakiri ma. Birin nu duuti fima e ma.

sentences.english: Give an order now, that these men are to do nothing more, and that the building of the town is to be stopped, till I give an order.
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo xa a fala na mixie bɛ a e xa wali iti han n yaamari fima tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: Be certain to do this with all care: do not let trouble be increased to the king's damage.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na mato a fanyi ra alako mangasanyi xun naxa rakana na fe ma.»

sentences.english: Then, after reading the king's letter, Rehum and Shimshai the scribe and their friends went quickly to Jerusalem, to the Jews, and had them stopped by force.
sentences.susu: Gomina Rexumi, nun a xa sɛbɛliti Simesayi, nun mangɛ gbɛtɛe to mangɛ Atasakasi xa bataaxɛ xaran, e naxa siga keren na Darisalamu Yuwifie yire, e xa na wali iti sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: So the work of the house of God at Jerusalem came to an end; so it was stopped, till the second year of the rule of Darius, king of Persia.
sentences.susu: Na kui Ala xa banxi tife Darisalamu naxa iti han Perise mangɛ Dariyusi xa mangɛya ɲɛ firin nde.

sentences.english: Now the prophets Haggai and Zechariah, the son of Iddo, were preaching to the Jews in Judah and Jerusalem in the name of the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Annabi Xagayi nun Ido xa di Annabi Sakari naxa Isirayila Marigi Ala xa masenyi ti Yuwifie bɛ, naxee nu na Yudaya nun Darisalamu.

sentences.english: Then Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, got up and made a start at building the house of God at Jerusalem: and the prophets of God were with them, helping them.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Salatiyeli xa di Sorobabeli nun Yosadaki xa di Yesuwa, naxa gbilen Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ti ra Darisalamu. Ala xa namiɲɔnmɛe naxa kafu e ma na wali kui.

sentences.english: At the same time, Tattenai, ruler of the land across the river, and Shethar-bozenai, and their men, came to them and said, Who gave you orders to go on building this house and this wall?
sentences.susu: Na waxati, Tatenayi, naxan findi gomina ra Samari bɔxi ma, a nun Setara Bosenayi, nun e xa kuntigie naxa fa, e e maxɔrin, «Nde wo yamarixi wo xa yi banxi nun yi tɛtɛ ti?

sentences.english: Then they said these words to them: What are the names of the men who are at work on this building?
sentences.susu: Ndee na yi wali kui? Wo xa na kanyie xilie fala muxu bɛ.»

sentences.english: But the eye of their God was on the chiefs of the Jews, and they did not make them give up working till the question had been put before Darius and an answer had come by letter about it.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala nu a ɲɛngi saxi Yuwifi kuntigie xɔn ma. Yuwifie yaxuie mu nɔ wali itide, beenun e xa bataaxɛ sɛbɛ mangɛ Dariyusi ma, e man xa a yaabi sɔtɔ yi wali xa fe ra.

sentences.english: This is a copy of the letter which Tattenai, the ruler of the land across the river, and Shethar-bozenai and his friends the Apharsachites, living across the river, sent to Darius the king:
sentences.susu: Samari gomina Tatenayi, Setara Bosenayi, nun e xa kuntigie naxa yi bataaxɛ sɛbɛ mangɛ Dariyusi ma:

sentences.english: They sent him a letter saying, To Darius the king, all peace:
sentences.susu: «Mangɛ Dariyusi, muxu bara i xɛɛbu.

sentences.english: This is to give the king word that we went into the land of Judah, to the house of the great God, which is made of great stones, and has its walls supported with wood, and the work is going on with industry, and they are doing it well.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ, muxu xa i rakolon muxu bara siga Yudaya bɔxi ma, e na Ala Xungbe xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi tife dɛnnaxɛ. Yuwifie na a tife gɛmɛ xungbee ra, wurie saxi a kɔn na. E xa wali na sɔɔnɛyafe a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Then we said to the men responsible, who gave you authority for the building of this house and these walls?
sentences.susu: Muxu bara e xa forie maxɔrin, ‹Nde wo yamarixi wo xa yi salide nun yi tɛtɛ ti?›

sentences.english: And we made request for their names, so that we might send you word, and give you the names of the men at the head of them.
sentences.susu: Muxu man bara e xa yareratie xilie maxɔrin, alako muxu xa nee fala i bɛ.»

sentences.english: And they made answer to us, saying, We are the servants of the God of heaven and earth, and we are building the house which was put up in times long past and was designed and made complete by a great king of Israel.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ e muxu yaabixi yi masenyi nan na: ‹Ala xa konyie nan muxu ra, naxan koore nun bɔxi daaxi. Muxu wama a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi nan tife, Isirayila mangɛ xungbe nde nu bara naxan singe ti tɛmui xɔnkuye.

sentences.english: But when the God of heaven was moved to wrath by our fathers, he gave them up into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, the Chaldaean, who sent destruction on this house and took the people away into Babylon.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ kabi muxu benbae Ala Koore Daa Mangɛ raxɔnɔ, a naxa e findi Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari xa konyie ra. Na Kalidika naxa yi salide kana, a man fa bekae xanin Babilɔn.

sentences.english: But in the first year of Cyrus, king of Babylon, Cyrus the king gave an order for the building of this house of God;
sentences.susu: Na waxati dangi xanbi, Sirusi naxa findi Babilɔn mangɛ ra, a fa yaamari fi a xa mangɛya ɲɛ singe ra, Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi man xa ti.

sentences.english: And the gold and silver vessels of the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the Temple which was in Jerusalem, and put into the house of his god in Babylon, these Cyrus the king took from the house of his god in Babylon, and gave to one named Sheshbazzar, whom he had made ruler;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Sirusi naxa xɛɛma nun gbeti ba Babilɔn salide kui, Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari naxan tongoxi Darisalamu salide kui, a na birin so Sɛsɛbasari yi ra, a naxan ti Yudaya gomina ra.

sentences.english: And he said to him, Go, take these vessels, and put them in the Temple in Jerusalem, and let the house of God be put up again in its place.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a bɛ, «Yi se birin xanin Darisalamu, e xa raso Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui. Wo xa Ala xa banxi ti a yire fori.»

sentences.english: Then this same Sheshbazzar came and put the house of God in Jerusalem on its bases: and from that time till now the building has been going on, but it is still not complete.
sentences.susu: Sɛsɛbasari to fa Darisalamu, a naxa Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kɔɔrin. Sa keli na lɔxɔɛ ma fa dɔxɔ to ra, muxu na na wali nan fari, kɔnɔ a mu ɲɔnxi sinden.›»

sentences.english: So now, if it seems good to the king, let search be made in the king's store-house at Babylon, to see if it is true that an order was given by Cyrus the king for the building of this house of God at Jerusalem, and let the king send us word of his pleasure in connection with this business.
sentences.susu: «Mangɛ, na kui xa i bara tin a ra, i xa mangɛ taruxui forie mato, alako i xa a kolon xa mangɛ Sirusi yaamari fi nɛ Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa ti Darisalamu. Na tɛmui, i xa i sago masen muxu bɛ na fe ma.»

sentences.english: Then Darius the king gave an order and a search was made in the house of the records, where the things of value were stored up in Babylon.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dariyusi naxa mixie yamari e xa na taruxui forie fen Babilɔn naafuli ragataxi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And at Achmetha, in the great house of the king in the land of Media, they came across a roll, in which this statement was put on record:
sentences.susu: E naxa sɛbɛli nde to Axameta taa kui Mediya bɔxi ma naxan yi masenxi:

sentences.english: In the first year of Cyrus the king, Cyrus the king made an order: In connection with the house of God at Jerusalem, let the house be put up, the place where they make offerings, and let the earth for the bases be put in place; let it be sixty cubits high and sixty cubits wide;
sentences.susu: «Mangɛ Sirusi xa mangɛya ɲɛ singe, a naxa a yamari a Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi, naxan nu na Darisalamu, a man xa gbilen ti ra, alako sɛrɛxɛe xa ba mɛnni. A xa ti gɛmɛ xungbee fari. A xa ite nun a xa gboe xa lan nɔngɔn ya tongo senni ma.

sentences.english: With three lines of great stones and one line of new wood supports; and let the necessary money be given out of the king's store-house;
sentences.susu: Gɛmɛ masolixi xa findi safɛ saxan na, wuri nɛɛnɛ fan xa findi safɛ keren na. Na wali sare xa keli mangasanyi xa naafuli kui.

sentences.english: And let the gold and silver vessels from the house of God, which Nebuchadnezzar took from the Temple at Jerusalem to Babylon, be given back and taken again to the Temple at Jerusalem, every one in its place, and put them in the house of God.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Nebukadansari se naxee tongo Darisalamu hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, yirabase xɛɛma nun gbeti daaxie, nee birin xa ragbilen, e xa raso Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui naxan tima Darisalamu.»

sentences.english: So now, Tattenai, ruler of the land across the river, and Shethar-bozenai and your people the Apharsachites across the river, keep far from that place:
sentences.susu: «Na nan a ra, Samari gomina Tatenayi, Setara Bosenayi, nun wo xa kuntigie, wo gbilen yi fe fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Let the work of this house of God go on; let the ruler of the Jews and their responsible men put up this house of God in its place.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a lu Yuwifi gomina nun e xa forie xa Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ti a yire fori.

sentences.english: Further, I give orders as to what you are to do for the responsible men of the Jews in connection with the building of this house of God: that from the king's wealth, that is, from the taxes got together in the land over the river, the money needed is to be given to these men readily, so that their work may not be stopped.
sentences.susu: N bara wo yamari na Yuwifie xa wali xa fe ra, wo xa wo xa duutie fi e tan nan ma, a xa findi na wali sare ra, alako Ala xa banxi tife xa sɔɔnɛya.

sentences.english: And whatever they have need of, young oxen and sheep and lambs, for burned offerings to the God of heaven, grain, salt, wine, and oil, whatever the priests in Jerusalem say is necessary, is to be given to them day by day regularly:
sentences.susu: E hayi na fe naxan birin ma, a xa findi Koore Ala xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, wo xa na fi e xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ma, alɔ tuura yɔrɛ, yɛxɛɛ kontonyi, yɛxɛɛ, mɛngi, fɔxɔɛ, wɛni, nun ture. Wo xa na fi e ma lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ alɔ e wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ. Wo naxa na wali lu na de,

sentences.english: So that they may make offerings of a sweet smell to the God of heaven, with prayers for the life of the king and of his sons.
sentences.susu: alako e xa sɛrɛxɛ fanyi ba Koore Ala bɛ, e man xa duba mangɛ nun a xa die bɛ.

sentences.english: And I have given orders that if anyone makes any change in this word, one of the supports is to be pulled out of his house, and he is to be lifted up and fixed to it; and his house is to be made waste for this;
sentences.susu: N bara yi yaamari sa na fari: Mixi yo naxan tondi n ma sɛriyɛ ratinmɛde, wo xa wuri keren ba na kanyi xa banxi ma, wo xa a gbaku na wuri ma. A xa banxi xa kana a xa matandi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And may the God who has made it a resting-place for his name send destruction on all kings and peoples whose hands are outstretched to make any change in this or to do damage to this house of God at Jerusalem. I, Darius, have given this order, let it be done with all care.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nun mixi naxan birin katama e xa Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi rabira, naxan tixi Darisalamu, Ala xa na kanyie fan nabira. N tan Dariyusi, n ma yamari nan na ki. Fo wo xa na raba nɛ teku.»

sentences.english: Then Tattenai, the ruler across the river, and Shethar-bozenai and their people, because of the order given by King Darius, did as he had said with all care.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Samari mangɛ Tatenayi, Setara Bosenayi, nun e xa kuntigie naxa na yaamari rabatu alɔ mangɛ Dariyusi a yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the responsible men of the Jews went on with their building, and did well, helped by the teaching of Haggai the prophet and Zechariah, the son of Iddo. They went on building till it was complete, in keeping with the word of the God of Israel, and the orders given by Cyrus, and Darius, and Artaxerxes, king of Persia.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi xa wali naxa sɔɔnɛya a fanyi ra alɔ e xa forie nu wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ. Annabi Xagayi nun Ido xa di Annabi Sakari fan naxa lu Ala xa masenyi kawandi ra. Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi naxa ti alɔ Isirayila Marigi Ala a yamarixi ki naxɛ, Perise mangɛe Sirusi, Dariyusi, nun Atasakasi sago bun ma.

sentences.english: And the building of this house was complete on the third day of the month Adar, in the sixth year of the rule of Darius the king.
sentences.susu: Na hɔrɔmɔbanxi naxa gɛ tide Adari kike, xi saxan nde, Dariyusi xa mangɛya ɲɛ senni nde kui.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel, the priests and the Levites, and the rest of those who had come back, kept the feast of the opening of this house of God with joy.
sentences.susu: Isirayila sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, Lewi bɔnsɔɛ, nun ɲama birin naxan kelixi konyiya kui Perise bɔxi ma, e naxa Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi rabi sɛɛwɛ ra.

sentences.english: And they gave as offerings at the opening of this house of God a hundred oxen, two hundred sheep, four hundred lambs; and for a sin-offering for all Israel, twelve he-goats, being the number of the tribes of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ e naxa tuura kɛmɛ, yɛxɛɛ kontonyi kɛmɛ firin, nun yɛxɛɛ kɛmɛ naani ba sɛrɛxɛ ra. E man naxa si kontonyi fu nun firin ba yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ fu nun firin xa yunubie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And they put the priests in their divisions and the Levites in their order, for the worship of God at Jerusalem; as it is recorded in the book of Moses.
sentences.susu: E naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie birin ti kankan xa wali ra hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui Darisalamu, alɔ a sɛbɛxi Tawureta Munsa kui ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel who had come back kept the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi naxee kelixi konyiya kui Perise bɔxi ma, nee naxa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali raba kike singe xi fu nun naani nde ma.

sentences.english: For the priests and the Levites had made themselves clean together; they were all clean: and they put the Passover lamb to death for all those who had come back, and for their brothers the priests and for themselves.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie birin nu bara e yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn, alako e xa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali sɛrɛxɛ ba e ngaxakerenyie, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, nun ɲama birin bɛ, naxee kelixi konyiya kui Perise bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the children of Israel, who had come back, and all those who were joined to them, after separating themselves from the evil ways of the people of the land to become the servants of the Lord, the God of Israel, took food together,
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka naxee keli konyiya kui nun e dɔxɔboore naxee gbilen na bɔxi xa naamunyi fɔxɔ ra, e birin naxa malan yire keren Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa fe fenfe ra.

sentences.english: And kept the feast of unleavened bread for seven days with joy: for the Lord had made them full of joy, by turning the heart of the king of Assyria to them to give them help in the work of the house of God, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: E naxa Taami Lɛbinitare Sali raba xi solofere bun ma sɛɛwɛ kui, barima Alatala nu bara Asiriya mangɛ bɔɲɛ mafindi e bɛ, alako e xa Isirayila Marigi Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ti.

sentences.english: Now after these things, when Artaxerxes was king of Persia, Ezra, the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,
sentences.susu: Na waxati to dangi, Perise mangɛ Atasakasi xa mangɛya bun ma, Annabi Esidirasi naxa fa Darisalamu. Esidirasi findi Seraya xa di nan na. Seraya findi Asaraya xa di nan na. Asaraya findi Xilikiya xa di nan na.

sentences.english: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,
sentences.susu: Xilikiya findi Salumu xa di nan na. Salumu findi Sadɔki xa di nan na. Sadɔki findi Axituba xa di nan na.

sentences.english: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,
sentences.susu: Axituba findi Amaraya xa di nan na. Amaraya findi Asaraya xa di nan na. Asaraya findi Merayoti xa di nan na.

sentences.english: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,
sentences.susu: Merayoti findi Sɛraxaya xa di nan na. Sɛraxaya findi Yusiyɛli xa di nan na. Yusiyɛli findi Buuki xa di nan na.

sentences.english: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:
sentences.susu: Buuki findi Abisuwa xa di nan na. Abisuwa findi Finexasi xa di nan na. Finexasi findi Eleyasari xa di nan na. Eleyasari findi Haruna sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xa di nan na.

sentences.english: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a scribe, expert in the law of Moses which the Lord, the God of Israel, had given: and the king, moved by the Lord his God, gave him whatever he made request for.
sentences.susu: Annabi Esidirasi naxa fa Darisalamu kelife Babilɔn bɔxi ma. Karamɔxɔ belebele nan nu a ra, a Tawureta Munsa kolon a fanyi ra, Isirayila Marigi Alatala sɛriyɛ naxan so Annabi Munsa yi ra. Perise mangɛ naxa Annabi Esidirasi waxɔnfe birin naba a bɛ, barima mixi na a ra a Marigi Alatala ɲɛngi saxi naxan xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And some of the children of Israel went up, with some of the priests and the Levites and the music-makers and the door-keepers and the Nethinim, to Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.
sentences.susu: Isirayilaka ndee, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, Lewikae, bɛɛtibae, salide naadɛ kantae, a nun walikɛe, e birin naxa te Darisalamu, mangɛ Atasakasi xa mangɛya ɲɛ solofere nde ra.

sentences.english: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, in the seventh year of the king's rule.
sentences.susu: Annabi Esidirasi soxi Darisalamu, mangɛ xa mangɛya ɲɛ solofere kike suuli nde nan ma.

sentences.english: For, starting his journey from Babylon on the first day of the first month, he came to Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month, by the good help of his God.
sentences.susu: A keli Babilɔn kike singe xi singe nɛ, a naxa so Darisalamu kike suuli nde a xi singe nde ma, Ala xa hinnɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: For Ezra had given his mind to learning the law of the Lord and doing it, and to teaching his rules and decisions in Israel.
sentences.susu: Annabi Esidirasi nu bara a tunnabɛxi xaranyi ma nun Alatala xa sɛriyɛ rabafe ma. A nu Ala xa sɛriyɛ tinxinxi masenma nɛ Isirayilakae bɛ.

sentences.english: Now this is a copy of the letter which King Artaxerxes gave to Ezra, the priest and the scribe, who put into writing the words of the orders of the Lord, and of his rules for Israel:
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Atasakasi yi bataaxɛ nan sɛbɛ Annabi Esidirasi ma, naxan findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nun karamɔxɔ ra, naxan Ala xa sɛriyɛ birin kolon Isirayila xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra the priest, scribe of the law of the God of heaven, all peace;
sentences.susu: «Yi bataaxɛ kelixi n tan Atasakasi nan ma, mangɛe xa mangɛ, katarabi Annabi Esidirasi ma, naxan mixi xaranma Koore Marigi Ala xa sɛriyɛ ra.

sentences.english: And now it is my order that all those of the people of Israel, and their priests and Levites in my kingdom, who are ready and have a desire to go to Jerusalem, are to go with you.
sentences.susu: N bara yaamari fi alako i tan xa nɔ Isirayilakae, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, nun Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie birin xaninde Darisalamu, naxee na be Perise bɔxi ma kɔnɔ e wama sigafe naa.

sentences.english: Because you are sent by the king and his seven wise men, to get knowledge about Judah and Jerusalem, as you are ordered by the law of your God which is in your hand;
sentences.susu: N tan mangɛ nun n ma santigi solofere nan i xɛɛxi, i xa sa a mato Yudayakae nun Darisalamukae na Ala xa sɛriyɛ rabatufe ki naxɛ. Na kitaabui na i yi ra.

sentences.english: And to take with you the silver and gold freely offered by the king and his wise men to the God of Israel, whose Temple is in Jerusalem,
sentences.susu: I man xa gbeti nun xɛɛma xanin, n tan nun n ma santigie naxan ɲanigexi Isirayila Marigi Ala bɛ naxan na Darisalamu.

sentences.english: As well as all the silver and gold which you get from the land of Babylon, together with the offering of the people and of the priests, freely given for the house of their God, which is in Jerusalem:
sentences.susu: I man xa gbeti nun xɛɛma xanin, Babilɔnkae naxan soma i yi ra, a nun Isirayilakae nun e xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxan ɲanigema e Marigi Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi bɛ naxan na Darisalamu.

sentences.english: So with this money get with care oxen, sheep, and lambs, with their meal offerings and their drink offerings, to be offered on the altar of the house of your God, which is in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: I xa tuurae, yɛxɛɛ kontonyie, yɛxɛɛe, mɛngi, nun wɛni sara na naafuli ra, e xa ba sɛrɛxɛ ra wo Marigi Ala xa sɛrɛxɛbade ma Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And whatever seems right to you and to your brothers to do with the rest of the silver and gold, that do, as may be pleasing to your God.
sentences.susu: I tan nun i ngaxakerenyie na wa fe naxan nabafe yi gbeti nun xɛɛma dɔnxɔɛ ra, wo xa a raba alɔ Ala wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the vessels which have been given to you for the uses of the house of your God, you are to give to the God of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: I xa siga yirabasee birin na, muxu bara naxee so i yi ra, naxee lan e xa rawali wo Marigi Ala xa banxi kui. I xa na dɛntɛgɛ Ala bɛ Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And whatever more is needed for the house of your God, and which you may have to give, take it from the king's store-house.
sentences.susu: Xa i hayi na kɔbiri gbɛtɛ ma, i xa a tongo mangɛ xa naafuli yire alako i Marigi Ala xa banxi wali xa sɔɔnɛya.»

sentences.english: And I, even I, Artaxerxes the king, now give orders to all keepers of the king's money across the river, that whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, may have need of from you, is to be done with all care,
sentences.susu: «N tan mangɛ Atasakasi bara yaamari fi n ma kɔbiri yire xunyie ma naxan na xure naakiri ma, xa a sa a li Annabi Esidirasi, Ala xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxan mixi xaranma Koore Ala xa sɛriyɛ ra, xa a hayi na kɔbiri nde ma, wo xa a so a yi ra,

sentences.english: Up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred measures of grain, a hundred measures of wine, and a hundred measures of oil, and salt without measure.
sentences.susu: han gbeti kilo wulu saxan, kilo kɛmɛ naani, mɛngi xɔri busali wulu keren, wɛni litiri wulu firin, litiri kɛmɛ firin, ture litiri wulu firin, litiri kɛmɛ firin, a nun fɔxɔɛ a na wa naxan xasabi xɔn.

sentences.english: Whatever is ordered by the God of heaven, let it be done completely for the house of the God of heaven; so that there may not be wrath against the kingdom of the king and his sons.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Koore Ala xa yaamari birin naba a fanyi ra a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa fe ra, alako a naxa xɔnɔ won ma mangɛya ma a nun n ma die ma.

sentences.english: In addition, we make it clear to you, that it will be against the law to put any tax or payment in goods or forced payment on any of the priests or Levites, the music-makers, door-keepers, Nethinim, or any servants of this house of God.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa duuti yo rasuxu yi mixie yi ra, hali bɔxi igiri sare. Wo naxa sese ba yi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe yi ra, a nun Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie, bɛɛtibae, salide naadɛ kantae, walikɛe, a nun naxee birin walima Ala xa banxi kui.»

sentences.english: And you, Ezra, by the wisdom of your God which is in you, are to put rulers and judges to have authority over all the people across the river who have knowledge of the laws of your God; and you are to give teaching to him who has no knowledge of them.
sentences.susu: «I tan Annabi Esidirasi, i xa mangɛe nun kiitisae ti ɲama bɛ naxee na xure naakiri ma alɔ Ala a masenma i bɛ ki naxɛ lɔnni ki ma. E xa Ala xa ɲama yamari tinxinyi ra. I xa Ala xa sɛriyɛ masen mixie bɛ naxee mu a kolon.

sentences.english: And if anyone does not keep the law of your God and the law of the king, take care that punishment is given to him, by death or by driving him from his country or by taking away his goods or by putting him in prison.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo naxan mu i Marigi Ala xa sɛriyɛ rabatu, a nun mangɛ xa sɛriyɛe, na kanyi xa faxa, xa na mu a xa keri bɔxi ma, xa na mu a xa kɔbiri ba, xa na mu a xa sa geeli.»

sentences.english: Praise be to the Lord, the God of our fathers, who has put such a thing into the heart of the king, to make fair the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem;
sentences.susu: Tantui na Alatala bɛ, won benbae Marigi Ala, naxan mangɛ bɔɲɛ rafalaxi a xa wali birin ma Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi tife ra Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And has given mercy to me before the king and his government and before all the king's great captains. And I was made strong by the hand of the Lord my God which was on me, and I got together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.
sentences.susu: Marigi bara hinnɛ n na mangɛ nun a xa santigie nun a xa batulae ya xɔri. N Marigi Alatala to na sɛnbɛ fi n ma, n naxa Isirayila kuntigie malan alako muxu birin xa te.

sentences.english: Now these are the heads of families who were listed of those who went up with me from Babylon, when Artaxerxes was king.
sentences.susu: Denbaya kanyie xili nan ya, naxee n mati kelife Babilɔn sigafe ra Darisalamu mangɛ Atasakasi xa waxati:

sentences.english: Of the sons of Phinehas, Gershom; of the sons of Ithamar, Daniel; of the sons of David, Hattush;
sentences.susu: Gerisomi, naxan keli Finexasi xabilɛ. Daniyɛli, naxan keli Itamari xabilɛ. Xatusi, naxan keli Dawuda xabilɛ.

sentences.english: Of the sons of Shecaniah; of the sons of Parosh, Zechariah; and with him were listed a hundred and fifty males.
sentences.susu: Sɛkanaya xa di nde. Sakari nun xɛmɛ kɛmɛ tongo suuli, naxee keli Paroso xabilɛ.

sentences.english: Of the sons of Pahath-moab, Eliehoenai, the son of Zerahiah; and with him two hundred males.
sentences.susu: Eliyehowenayi, naxan keli Mowaba Paxati xabilɛ. Sɛraxaya xa di nde nun mixi kɛmɛ firin.

sentences.english: Of the sons of Shecaniah, the son of Jahaziel; and with him three hundred males.
sentences.susu: Sɛkanaya xa di ndee. Yaxasiyeli xa di nde nun mixi kɛmɛ saxan.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Adin, Ebed, the son of Jonathan; and with him fifty males.
sentences.susu: Ebedi, naxan keli Adin xabilɛ. Yonatan xa di nun mixi tongo suuli.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Elam, Jeshaiah; the son of Athaliah; and with him seventy males.
sentences.susu: Yɛsaya, naxan keli Elama xabilɛ. Atalaya xa di, nun mixi tongo solofere.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Shephatiah, Zebadiah, the son of Michael; and with him eighty males.
sentences.susu: Sebadaya, naxan keli Sɛfataya xabilɛ. Mikayeli xa di nde nun mixi tongo solomasaxan.

sentences.english: Of the sons of Joab, Obadiah, the son of Jehiel; and with him two hundred and eighteen males.
sentences.susu: Abadiyasi, naxan keli Yowaba xabilɛ. Yɛxiyɛli xa di nun mixi kɛmɛ firin mixi fu nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Shelomith, the son of Josiphiah; and with him a hundred and sixty males.
sentences.susu: Selomiti xa di ndee. Yosifiya xa di nun mixi kɛmɛ mixi tongo senni.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Bebai, Zechariah, the son of Bebai; and with him twenty-eight males.
sentences.susu: Sakari, naxan keli Bibayi xabilɛ, a nun mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Azgad, Johanan, the son of Hakkatan; and with him a hundred and ten males.
sentences.susu: Yoxanan, naxan keli Asigadi xabilɛ, a nun mixi kɛmɛ mixi fu.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Adonikam, the last, whose names were Eliphelet, Jeuel, and Shemaiah; and with them sixty males.
sentences.susu: Elifeleti, Yuwɛli, nun Semaya, naxee keli Adonikama xabilɛ, nun mixi tongo senni.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Bigvai, Uthai and Zabbud; and with them seventy males.
sentences.susu: Utayi nun Sabudu, naxee keli Begifayi xabilɛ, nun mixi tongo solofere.

sentences.english: And I made them come together by the river flowing to Ahava; and we were there in tents for three days: and after viewing the people and the priests I saw that no sons of Levi were there.
sentences.susu: N naxa yi mixie malan xure dɛ ra, xure naxan goroma Ahawa. Muxu naxa lu mɛnni xi saxan. N to ɲama mato, n naxa a rakɔrɔsi a sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nu na, kɔnɔ Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie mu nu na ɲama ya ma.

sentences.english: Then I sent for Eliezer and Ariel and Shemaiah and Elnathan Jarib and Elnathan and Nathan and Zechariah and Meshullam, all responsible men; and for Joiarib and Elnathan, who were wise men.
sentences.susu: N naxa yi kuntigie xili: Eliyeseri, Ariyɛli, Semaya, Elinatan, Yaribu, Elinatan, Natan, Sakari, nun Mesulama. N naxa karamɔxɔ Yoyaribu nun Elinatan fan xili.

sentences.english: And I sent them to Iddo the chief at the place Casiphia, and gave them orders what to say to Iddo and his brothers the Nethinim at the place Casiphia, so that they might come back to us with men to do the work of the house of our God.
sentences.susu: N naxa e xɛɛ Kasifiya, mangɛ Ido xɔnyi. N naxa a fala e bɛ e xa Ido nun a ngaxakerenyie mayandi e xa mixi ndee so muxu yi ra naxee nɔma walide won Marigi Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: And by the help of our God they got for us Ish-sechel, one of the sons of Mahli, the son of Levi, the son of Israel; and Sherebiah with his sons and brothers, eighteen;
sentences.susu: Won Marigi Ala naxa muxu mali na fe kui, e fa Maxali xa di Serebiya xɛɛ, naxan keli Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ma. Xaxilima nan nu a ra. A naxa fa, a nun a xa die, nun a xunyae. E birin nalanxi mixi fu nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: And Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;
sentences.susu: Xasabiya nun Yɛsaya, naxan keli Merari bɔnsɔɛ, nun e xunyae nun e xa die, e fan naxa fa. E lan mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nan ma.

sentences.english: And of the Nethinim, to whom David and the captains had given the work of helping the Levites, two hundred and twenty Nethinim, all of them specially named.
sentences.susu: E naxa fa hɔrɔmɔbanxi walikɛ kɛmɛ firin nun mɔxɔɲɛn na, alɔ mangɛ Dawuda nun bɔxi kuntigie nu bara natɛ tongo ki naxɛ. Nee xa lu Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie xa yaamari bun ma. E xilie birin nu sɛbɛxi.

sentences.english: Then I gave orders for a time of going without food, there by the river Ahava, so that we might make ourselves low before our God in prayer, requesting from him a straight way for us and for our little ones and for all our substance.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, n naxa a fala mixi birin bɛ Ahawa xure dɛ ra, muxu xa sunyi suxu, muxu xa muxu magoro muxu Marigi Ala bɛ, alako muxu xa a maxandi a xa muxu xa biyaasi sɔɔnɛya muxu tan nun muxu xa die bɛ. A xa muxu harige birin kanta.

sentences.english: For I would not, for shame, make request to the king for a band of armed men and horsemen to give us help against those who might make attacks on us on the way: for we had said to the king, The hand of our God is on his servants for good, but his power and his wrath are against all those who are turned away from him.
sentences.susu: N yaagixi mangɛ maxɔrinde a xa sɔɔrie xa sa muxu mati alako e xa muxu ratanga muxu yaxuie ma kira xɔn ma. N nu bara a fala mangɛ bɛ, «Muxu Marigi Ala mɛɛnima a fɔxirabirɛe ma, kɔnɔ a xɔnɔma sɛnbɛ ra mixi birin ma naxan a raboloma.»

sentences.english: So we went without food, requesting our God for this: and his ear was open to our prayer.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi muxu naxa sunyi suxu, muxu naxa muxu Marigi Ala maxandi. A naxa na duba suxu.

sentences.english: So I put on one side twelve of the chiefs of the priests, Sherebiah, Hashabiah, and ten of their brothers with them,
sentences.susu: N naxa mixi fu nun firin sugandi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie ya ma. Nee findixi Serebiya, Xasabiya, nun e xunya fu nan na.

sentences.english: And gave to them by weight the silver and the gold and the vessels, all the offering for the house of our God which the king and his wise men and his captains and all Israel there present had given:
sentences.susu: N naxa gbeti, xɛɛma, nun yirabase maniya e bɛ, mangɛ, a xa santigie, a xa mangɛdie, nun Isirayilakae naxee soxi muxu yi ra muxu Marigi Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi bɛ.

sentences.english: Measuring into their hands six hundred and fifty talents of silver, and silver vessels, a hundred talents' weight, and a hundred talents of gold,
sentences.susu: N naxan soxi e yi ra na nan ya: gbeti kilo wulu fu nun firin, kilo kɛmɛ, yirabase gbeti daaxi kilo wulu saxan kilo kɛmɛ naani, xɛɛma kilo wulu saxan kilo kɛmɛ naani,

sentences.english: And twenty gold basins, of a thousand darics, and two vessels of the best bright brass, equal in value to gold.
sentences.susu: pɔɔti xɛɛma daaxi mɔxɔɲɛn, naxan sare kɔbiri kole xɛɛma daaxi wulu keren lima, nun yirabase firin naxan yailanxi yɔxui ra. Na sare gbo alɔ xɛɛma sare.

sentences.english: And I said to them, You are holy to the Lord and the vessels are holy: and the silver and the gold are an offering freely given to the Lord, the God of your fathers.
sentences.susu: N naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo bara findi wo benbae Marigi Alatala gbe ra, wo tan nun yi naafuli birin. Wo birin bara findi sɛrɛxɛ ɲanigexi ra a bɛ.

sentences.english: Take care of them and keep them, till you put them on the scales before the chiefs of the priests and the Levites and the chiefs of the families of Israel, in Jerusalem, in the rooms of the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo ɲɛngi sa yi birin xɔn ma han wo xa sa a dɛntɛgɛ sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie bɛ, Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie nun Isirayila xabilɛ kuntigie bɛ Darisalamu, Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa naafuli ragatama dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: So the priests and the Levites took the weight of silver and gold and the vessels, to take them to Jerusalem into the house of our God.
sentences.susu: Na nan na ki sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie naxa xɛɛma, gbeti, nun yirabase maniyaxie sɔtɔ, e naxan xaninma Darisalamu muxu Marigi Ala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: Then we went away from the river of Ahava on the twelfth day of the first month, to go to Jerusalem; and the hand of our God was on us, and he gave us salvation from our haters and those who were waiting to make an attack on us by the way.
sentences.susu: Muxu naxa keli Ahawa xure dɛ ra sigafe ra Darisalamu, kike singe xi fu nun firin nde ra. Ala naxa muxu ratanga muxu yaxuie ma kira xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And we came to Jerusalem and were there for three days.
sentences.susu: Muxu to so Darisalamu, muxu naxa muxu malabu xi saxan.

sentences.english: And on the fourth day, the silver and the gold and the vessels were measured out by weight in the house of our God into the hands of Meremoth, the son of Uriah, the priest; and with him was Eleazar, the son of Phinehas; and with them were Jozabad, the son of Jeshua, and Noadiah, the son of Binnui, the Levites;
sentences.susu: A xi naani nde, muxu naxa xɛɛma, gbeti, nun yirabasee maniya Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui. Muxu naxa na so sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Meremoti, Uriya xa di yi ra, Finexasi xa di Eliyeseri, nun Yesuwa xa di Yosabadi, nun Binuwi xa di Nowadiya ya xɔri. E birin findixi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie nan na.

sentences.english: All was handed over by number and by weight: and the weight was put on record at that time.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ na birin kɔntide nun a maniyade, e naxa na xasabi sɛbɛ.

sentences.english: And those who had been prisoners, who had come back from a strange land, made burned offerings to the God of Israel, twelve oxen for all Israel, ninety-six male sheep, seventy-seven lambs, twelve he-goats for a sin-offering: all this was a burned offering to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxan keli konyiya Perise bɔxi ma, nee naxa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ba Isirayila Marigi Ala bɛ. Na findi tuura fu nun firin nan na Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin bɛ, nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi tongo solomanaani nun senni, yɛxɛɛ tongo solofere nun solofere, nun sikɔtɛ fu nun firin. Na findi yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ nan na a gan daaxi.

sentences.english: And they gave the king's orders to the king's captains and the rulers across the river, and they gave the people and the house of God the help which was needed.
sentences.susu: E naxa mangɛ xa yaamari so a rasimae nun a xa gominae yi ra, naxee nu na naakiri ma, alako e xa Isirayilakae mali Ala xa banxi tide.

sentences.english: Now after these things were done, the captains came to me and said, The people of Israel and the priests and Levites have not kept themselves separate from the people of the lands, but have taken part in the disgusting ways of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, the Ammonites, the Moabites, the Egyptians, and the Amorites.
sentences.susu: Na fe birin to ba a ra, kuntigie naxa fa n yire, e naxa a fala n bɛ, e naxɛ, «I xa a kolon a Isirayilakae, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, nun Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mu gbilenxi si gbɛtɛe xa naamunyi ɲaaxie fɔxɔ ra. E bara bira Kanaankae, Xitikae, Perisikae, Yebusukae, Amonikae, Mowabakae, Misirakae, nun Amorikae xa wali kobie fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: For they have taken their daughters for themselves and for their sons, so that the holy seed has been mixed with the peoples of the lands; and in fact the captains and rulers have been the first to do this evil.
sentences.susu: E bara na sie xa di ginɛe dɔxɔ, e man bara e fen futi ra e xa die bɛ. E bara won ma si sɛniyɛnxi masunbu si gbɛtɛe ra. Forie nun kuntigie nan singe na fe rafɔlɔ.»

sentences.english: And hearing this, with signs of grief and pulling out the hair of my head and my chin, I took my seat on the earth deeply troubled.
sentences.susu: N to na mɛ, n naxa n ma donmae ibɔɔ, n naxa n xunsɛxɛ nun dɛ xabe matala, n fa dɔxɔ yigitɛgɛ kui.

sentences.english: Then everyone who went in fear of the words of the God of Israel, because of the sin of those who had come back, came together to me; and I kept where I was, overcome with grief, till the evening offering.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee findi Ala yaragaaxuie ra, nee birin naxa fa n yire na mixie xa wali kobi xa fe ra. N naxa lu naa han nunmare sɛrɛxɛ tɛmui.

sentences.english: And at the evening offering, having made myself low before God, I got up, and with signs of grief, falling down on my knees, with my hands stretched out to the Lord my God,
sentences.susu: Nunmare sɛrɛxɛ tɛmui, n naxa siga, n naxa n xinbi sin, n nan n bɛlɛxɛ ti n Marigi Alatala bɛ n ma donma ibɔɔxie ra n ma.

sentences.english: I said, O my God, shame keeps me from lifting up my face to you, my God: for our sins are increased higher than our heads and our evil-doing has come up to heaven.
sentences.susu: N naxa a fala, «N Marigi, n bara kɔntɔfili, n bara yaagi i xɔn ma, barima muxu xa yunubie i mabiri bara gbo han a bara dangi a i.

sentences.english: From the days of our fathers till this day we have been great sinners; and for our sins, we and our kings and our priests have been given up into the hands of the kings of the lands, to the sword and to prison and to loss of goods and to shame of face, as it is this day.
sentences.susu: Kelife muxu benbae xa tɛmui ma, fa dɔxɔ to ra, muxu na na wali kobie nan fari. Na na a ra, i bara muxu nun muxu xa mangɛe nun muxu xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ɲaxankata. I bara muxu lu si gbɛtɛe yi ra, e xa muxu faxa santidɛgɛma ra, e xa muxu xanin, e xa muxu harige birin suxu. Han to muxu na na kɔntɔfili nan kui.

sentences.english: And now for a little time grace has come to us from the Lord our God, to let a small band of us get free and to give us a nail in his holy place, so that our God may give light to our eyes and a measure of new life in our prison chains.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi, yi waxati di kui, i tan muxu Marigi Alatala bara hinnɛ muxu ra, i bara nde rakisi, i bara muxu raso i xa yire sɛniyɛnxi, alako muxu xa limaniya, muxu xa hɛɛri nde sɔtɔ muxu xa konyiya kui.

sentences.english: For we are servants; but our God has not been turned away from us in our prison, but has had mercy on us before the eyes of the kings of Persia, to give us new strength to put up again the house of our God and to make fair its waste places, and to give us a wall in Judah and Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Muxu nu na konyiya kui, kɔnɔ muxu Marigi Ala mu muxu rabolo. A naxa hinnɛ muxu ra Perise mangɛe ya xɔri. A naxa muxu rakisi alako muxu xa muxu Marigi Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ti a nu na dɛnnaxɛ, muxu man xa kantari sɔtɔ Yudaya bɔxi ma Darisalamu kui.»

sentences.english: And now, O our God, what are we to say after this? for we have not kept your laws,
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi, muxu Marigi Ala, muxu xa munse fala sɔnɔn?

sentences.english: Which you gave to your servants the prophets, saying, The land into which you are going, to take it for a heritage, is an unclean land, because of the evil lives of the peoples of the land and their disgusting ways, which have made the land unclean from end to end.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara i xa sɛriyɛ matandi, i sɛriyɛ naxan so muxu yi ra i xa konyi di namiɲɔnmɛe saabui ra. E a fala nɛ, ‹Wo fama sode bɔxi naxan ma, wo lan wo xa dɔxɔ dɛnnaxɛ, naakae xa yunubie bara gbo han a bara dangi a i. Mɛnni birin bara findi yire sɛniyɛntare ra.

sentences.english: So now do not give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons or do anything for their peace or well-being for ever; so that you may be strong, living on the good of the land, and handing it on to your children for a heritage for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa tin wo xa die fide naakae ma. Wo man naxa na di ginɛe fan tongo wo xa die bɛ. Wo naxa saatɛ yo tongo e bɛ, wo man naxa bira e harige fɔxɔ ra. Xa wo mu bira na fe ɲaaxi mɔɔlie fɔxɔ ra, wo fama nɛ sɛnbɛ sɔtɔde, wo na bɔxi daxamui donma nɛ, wo xa die fan fama na bɔxi sɔtɔde kɛ ra.›»

sentences.english: And after everything which has come on us because of our evil-doing and our great sin, and seeing that the punishment which you, O God, have given us, is less than the measure of our sins, and that you have kept from death those of us who are here;
sentences.susu: «Muxu Marigi, i bara muxu ɲaxankata muxu xa yunubie xa fe ra, kɔnɔ na ɲaxankatɛ mu gbo alɔ muxu xa yunubi gboxi ki naxɛ. I bara tin muxu rakiside, muxu tan naxee na be yi ki.

sentences.english: Are we again to go against your orders, taking wives from among the people who do these disgusting things? would you not be angry with us till our destruction was complete, till there was not one who got away safe?
sentences.susu: Munse nɔma a niyade muxu man xa gbilen i xui matandi ra, han muxu nun yi si gbɛtɛe xa lu yire keren? Xa na na a ra, i fama xɔnɔde muxu ma han i muxu birin halaki. Mixi keren mu kisima.
