sentences.english: O Lord God of Israel, righteousness is yours; we are only a small band which has been kept from death, as at this day: see, we are before you in our sin; for no one may keep his place before you because of this.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Alatala, i bara tin i xa muxu rakisi. Muxu tixi i ya tode ra, muxu tan yunubitɔɛe, hali mixi sɛniyɛntare yo mu daxa a xa ti i ya tode ra.»

sentences.english: Now while Ezra was making his prayer and his statement of wrongdoing, weeping and falling down before the house of God, a very great number of men and women and children out of Israel came together round him: for the people were weeping bitterly.
sentences.susu: Annabi Esidirasi to nu wafe Ala xa banxi dɛ ra yunubi xafari maxandife ra, Isirayilaka gbegbe naxa fa a sɛɛti ma, xɛmɛe, ginɛe, a nun dimɛe. E fan naxa wa fɔlɔ ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And Shecaniah, the son of Jehiel, one of the sons of Elam, answering, said to Ezra, We have done evil against our God, and have taken as our wives strange women of the peoples of the land: but still there is hope for Israel in this question.
sentences.susu: Awa, Yɛxiyɛli xa di Sɛkanaya, naxan kelixi Elama bɔnsɔɛ, a naxa a fala Annabi Esidirasi bɛ, «Muxu bara wali kobi raba naxan mu rafan muxu Marigi Ala ma si gbɛtɛ di ginɛe dɔxɔfe ra. Kɔnɔ hali won to bara na raba, Ala tan nɔma won nakiside.

sentences.english: Let us now make an agreement with our God to put away all the wives and all their children, if it seems right to my lord and to those who go in fear of the words of our God; and let it be done in keeping with the law.
sentences.susu: Won xa saatɛ tongo won Marigi Ala bɛ mɛɛfe si gbɛtɛ ginɛe ra, alɔ i tan nun Ala yaragaaxuie wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ. Won xa Ala xa sɛriyɛ rabatu.

sentences.english: Up, now! for this is your business, and we are with you; take heart and do it.
sentences.susu: Yandi, i xa muxu mali, muxu xaxili tixi i tan nan na. Muxu na i xanbi ra. I i sɛnbɛ so, i fe raba naxan lanma a xa raba.»

sentences.english: Then Ezra got up, and made the chiefs of the priests and the Levites and all Israel take an oath that they would do this. So they took an oath.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Annabi Esidirasi naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie, Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixie, nun Isirayilaka birin nakali na masenyi ra. E to gɛ e rakalide,

sentences.english: Then Ezra got up from before the house of God and went into the room of Jehohanan, the son of Eliashib; but when he came there, he took no food or drink, for he was sorrowing for the sin of those who had come back.
sentences.susu: Annabi Esidirasi naxa keli Ala xa banxi naadɛ ra, a siga Eliyasibu xa di Yehoxanan xɔnyi. A nu na naa tɛmui naxɛ, a mu sese don, a man mu ye min ɲama xa wali kobi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And they made a public statement through all Judah and Jerusalem, to all those who had come back, that they were to come together to Jerusalem;
sentences.susu: Masenyi naxa rayensen Yudaya nun Darisalamu kui, a mixi naxan birin keli konyiya kui, e xa e malan Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And that if anyone did not come before three days were past, as ordered by the rulers and the responsible men, all his goods would be put under the curse, and he himself would be cut off from the meeting of the people who had come back.
sentences.susu: Kuntigie nun forie man naxa a fala a mixi yo naxan tondima na ra beenun xi saxan bun, na kanyi harige birin bama nɛ a yi ra, a man fa keri Isirayilakae ya ma naxee kelixi konyiya kui.

sentences.english: Then all the men of Judah and Benjamin came together to Jerusalem before three days were past; it was the ninth month, on the twentieth day of the month; and all the people were seated in the wide square in front of the house of God, shaking with fear because of this business and because of the great rain.
sentences.susu: Xi saxan kamalixi lɔxɔɛ naxɛ, Yudayakae nun Bunyaminkae naxa e malan Darisalamu. Na naxa sa lan kike solomanaani xi mɔxɔɲɛn nde ma. Ɲama nu tixi Ala xa banxi dɛ ra. E birin nu sɛrɛnma na lɔxɔɛ natɛ tongoxi xa fe ra, nun tunɛ belebele fan nu na fafe.

sentences.english: And Ezra the priest got to his feet and said to them, You have done wrong and taken strange women for your wives, so increasing the sin of Israel.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Esidirasi naxa keli, a a masen e bɛ, «Wo bara wali ɲaaxi raba si gbɛtɛ ginɛe dɔxɔfe ra. Na bara findi yunubi xungbe ra Isirayila bɛ.

sentences.english: So now, give praise to the Lord, the God of your fathers, and do his pleasure; and make yourselves separate from the peoples of the land and from the strange women.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo xa yunubi masen wo babae Marigi Alatala bɛ. Wo man xa a sago raba. Wo xa gbilen yi si gbɛtɛ mixie nun e xa ginɛe fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: Then all the people, answering, said with a loud voice, As you have said, so it is right for us to do.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa a yaabi e xui itexi ra, «Awa, muxu bara tin na ra, alɔ i a falaxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But the number of people is great, and it is a time of much rain; it is not possible for us to go on waiting outside, and this is not a thing which may be done in one day or even two: for our sin in this business is great.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ ɲama gbo, tunɛ fan na fafe yi tɛmui. Won mu nɔma yi fe ya ibade tande ma. Xi keren xa na mu a ra xi firin fe mu yi ki, barima mixi gbegbe bara yunubi fe raba won ya ma.

sentences.english: So now let our rulers be representatives for all the people, and let all those in our towns who are married to strange women come at fixed times, and with them the responsible men and the judges of every town, till the burning wrath of our God is turned away from us, and this has been done.
sentences.susu: Kuntigie xa lu be ɲama xili ra. Naxee birin si gbɛtɛ di ginɛe dɔxɔxi won ma taae kui, e xa fa keren keren yi ra waxati ma naxan tongoxi e bɛ. Taa yo taa xa forie nun kiitisae xa nee xa fe mato han Ala diɲɛma won ma tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Only Jonathan, the son of Asahel, and Jahzeiah, the son of Tikvah, were against this, Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite supporting them.
sentences.susu: Asahɛli xa di Yonatan nun Tikifa xa di Yaxaseya naxa kafu Mesulama nun Sabɛtayi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixi ma, e gbansan mu tin na xaxili ra.

sentences.english: So those who had come back did so. And Ezra the priest, with certain heads of families, by their fathers' families, all of them by their names, were marked out; and on the first day of the tenth month they took their places to go into the question with care.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e boore naxee kelixi konyiya kui, nee naxa tin na natɛ tongoxi ra. Annabi Esidirasi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa kuntigi keren sugandi xabilɛ keren keren birin ya ma. E naxa na fe mato fɔlɔ kike fu nde, xi singe ra.

sentences.english: And they got to the end of all the men who were married to strange women by the first day of the first month.
sentences.susu: Kike singe xi singe nde ra, e naxa gɛ na xɛmɛe xa fe ya ibade naxee ginɛ gbɛtɛe dɔxɔ.

sentences.english: And among the sons of the priests who were married to strange women were these: of the sons of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak and his brothers, Maaseiah and Eliezer and Jarib and Gedaliah.
sentences.susu: A naxa a li, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe fan xa di ndee nu bara si gbɛtɛ ginɛe dɔxɔ, alɔ Yesuwa xa di ndee, Yosadaki xa di, nun a xunyae, Maaseya, Eliyeseri, Yaribu, nun Gɛdalaya.

sentences.english: And they gave their word that they would put away their wives; and for their sin, they gave an offering of a male sheep of the flock.
sentences.susu: E naxa laayidi tongo e xa e xa ginɛe bɛɲin, e man xa yɛxɛɛ kontonyi ba sɛrɛxɛ ra e xa yunubi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Immer, Hanani and Zebadiah.
sentences.susu: Nee xilie nan ya: Fatanfe Imeri xabilɛ ra: Xanani nun Sebadaya.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Harim, Maaseiah and Elijah and Shemaiah and Jehiel and Uzziah.
sentences.susu: Fatanfe Xarima xabilɛ ra: Maaseya, Eliya, Semaya, Yɛxiyɛli, nun Yusiya.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Pashhur, Elioenai, Maaseiah, Ishmael, Nethanel, Jozabad, and Elasah.
sentences.susu: Fatanfe Pasura xabilɛ ra: Eliyowenayi, Maaseya, Sumayila, Netaneeli, Yosabadi, e nun Elaasa.

sentences.english: And of the Levites, Jozabad, and Shimei, and Kelaiah (that is Kelita), Pethahiah, Judah, and Eliezer.
sentences.susu: Fatanfe Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ra: Yosabadi, Simeyi, Kɛlaya, naxan man xili Kelita, Petaxiya, Yudaya, nun Eliyeseri.

sentences.english: And of the music-makers, Eliashib; and of the door-keepers, Shallum and Telem and Uri.
sentences.susu: Kelife bɛɛtibae ya ma: Eliyasibu. Kelife Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛ makantamae ya ma: Salumu, Telemi, nun Uri.

sentences.english: And of Israel, the sons of Parosh, Ramiah and Izziah and Malchijah and Mijamin and Eleazar and Malchijah and Benaiah.
sentences.susu: Boore Isirayilakae xilie nan ya naxee na mɔɔli rabaxi: Fatanfe Paroso xabilɛ ra: Ramiya, Yɛsaya, Malakiya, Miyamin, Eliyeseri, Malakiya, nun Bɛnaya.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Elam, Mattaniah, Zechariah, and Jehiel and Abdi and Jeremoth and Elijah.
sentences.susu: Fatanfe Elama xabilɛ ra: Mataniya, Sakari, Yɛxiyɛli, Abidi, Yeremoti, nun Eliya.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Zattu, Elioenai, Eliashib, Mattaniah, and Jeremoth and Zabad and Aziza.
sentences.susu: Fatanfe Satu xabilɛ ra: Eliyowenayi, Eliyasibu, Mataniya, Yeremoti, Sabadi, nun Asisa.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Bebai, Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, Athlai.
sentences.susu: Fatanfe Bibayi xabilɛ ra Yehoxanan, Xananiya, Sabayi, nun Atɛlayi.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Bani, Meshullam, Malluch, and Adaiah, Jashub and Sheal, Jeremoth.
sentences.susu: Fatanfe Bani xabilɛ ra: Mesulama, Maluku, Adaya, Yasubu, Seyala, nun Yeremoti.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Pahath-moab, Adna and Chelal, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattaniah, Bezalel and Binnui and Manasseh.
sentences.susu: Fatanfe Mowaba Paxati xabilɛ ra: Adina, Kelali, Bɛnaya, Maaseya, Mataniya, Bɛsalɛli, Binuwi, nun Manasi.

sentences.english: And of the sons of Harim, Eliezer, Isshijah, Malchijah, Shemaiah, Shimeon,
sentences.susu: Fatanfe Xarima xabilɛ ra: Eliyeseri, Yisiya, Malakiya, Semaya, Simɛyɔn,

sentences.english: Benjamin, Malluch, Shemariah.
sentences.susu: Bunyamin, Maluku, nun Sɛmaraya.

sentences.english: Of the sons of Hashum, Mattenai, Mattattah, Zabad, Eliphelet, Jeremai, Manasseh, Shimei.
sentences.susu: Fatanfe Xasuma xabilɛ ra: Matenayi, Matata, Sabadi, Elifeleti, Yeremayi, Manasi, nun Simeyi.

sentences.english: Of the sons of Bani, Maadai, Amram, and Uel,
sentences.susu: Fatanfe Bani xabilɛ ra: Maadayi, Amarama, Yuwɛli,

sentences.english: Benaiah, Bedeiah, Cheluhi,
sentences.susu: Bɛnaya, Bɛdeya, Keluhayi,

sentences.english: Vaniah, Meremoth, Eliashib,
sentences.susu: Faniya, Meremoti, Eliyasibu,

sentences.english: Mattaniah, Mattenai, and Jaasu,
sentences.susu: Mataniya, Matenayi, nun Yaasu.

sentences.english: And Bani and Binnui, Shimei;
sentences.susu: Fatanfe Binuwi xabilɛ ra: Simeyi,

sentences.english: And Shelemiah and Nathan and Adaiah,
sentences.susu: Selemiya, Natan, Adaya,

sentences.english: Machnadebai, Shashai, Sharai,
sentences.susu: Makinadebayi, Sasayi, Sarayi,

sentences.english: Azarel and Shelemiah, Shemariah,
sentences.susu: Asarɛli, Selemiya, Sɛmaraya,

sentences.english: Shallum, Amariah, Joseph.
sentences.susu: Salumu, Amaraya, nun Yusufu.

sentences.english: Of the sons of Nebo, Jeiel, Mattithiah, Zabad, Zebina, Iddo, and Joel, Benaiah.
sentences.susu: Fatanfe Nebo xabilɛ ra: Yeyiyeli, Matitiya, Sabadi, Sebina, Yido, Yoweli, nun Bɛnaya.

sentences.english: All these had taken strange wives; and some of them had wives by whom they had offspring.
sentences.susu: Yi mixi birin nu bara si gbɛtɛ ginɛe dɔxɔ, nde nu bara die bari.

sentences.english: The history of Nehemiah, the son of Hacaliah. Now it came about, in the month Chislev, in the twentieth year, when I was in Shushan, the king's town,
sentences.susu: Annabi Nehemi, Xakalaya xa di, xa masenyi nan ya. Atasakasi xa mangɛya ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nde, Kisilewi kike ra, n tan Nehemi nu sabatixi Suse taa sɛnbɛma nan kui.

sentences.english: That Hanani, one of my brothers, came with certain men from Judah; and in answer to my request for news of the Jews who had been prisoners and had got away, and of Jerusalem,
sentences.susu: Ngaxakerenyi Xanani nun xɛmɛ ndee naxa fa, keli Yudaya bɔxi ma. N naxa e maxɔrin Yuwifie xa fe ma, naxee keli konyiya kui, e fa sabati Yudaya. N man naxa e maxɔrin Darisalamu taa xa fe ma.

sentences.english: They said to me, The small band of Jews now living there in the land are in great trouble and shame: the wall of Jerusalem has been broken down, and its doorways burned with fire.
sentences.susu: E naxa n yaabi, «Naxee kelixi konyiya kui, e siga Yudaya, e na tɔɔrɛ nun yaagi nan kui. Darisalamu tɛtɛ yire nde kanaxi, a naadɛe ganxi.»

sentences.english: Then, after hearing these words, for some days I gave myself up to weeping and sorrow, seated on the earth; and taking no food I made prayer to the God of heaven,
sentences.susu: N to na masenyi mɛ, n naxa wa, n naxa sun, n naxa Koore Mangɛ maxandi. N naxɛ,

sentences.english: And said, O Lord, the God of heaven, the great God, greatly to be feared, keeping faith and mercy with those who have love for him and are true to his laws:
sentences.susu: «Alatala, Ala naxan na koore ma, Ala xungbe naxan magaaxu, naxan saatɛ mabanbanxi mixie bɛ naxee a xanuxi, e fa bira a xa yaamarie fɔxɔ ra,

sentences.english: Let your ear now take note and let your eyes be open, so that you may give ear to the prayer of your servant, which I make before you at this time, day and night, for the children of Israel, your servants, while I put before you the sins of the children of Israel, which we have done against you: truly, I and my father's people are sinners.
sentences.susu: i xa i tuli mati i xa konyi xa maxandi ra. I xa n to. Kɔɛ nun yanyi ra n i maxandima i xa konyi Isirayilakae bɛ. Muxu bara yunubi raba i ra, n tan, n ma denbaya, nun Isirayilakae birin.

sentences.english: We have done great wrong against you, and have not kept the orders, the rules, and the decisions, which you gave to your servant Moses.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara fe ɲaaxi raba i ra. Muxu bara i xa masenyi, i xa sɛriyɛ, nun i xa yaamarie matandi, i naxee fi i xa konyi Annabi Munsa ma.

sentences.english: Keep in mind, O Lord, the order you gave your servant Moses, saying, If you do wrong I will send you wandering among the peoples:
sentences.susu: I a fala nɛ i xa konyi Annabi Munsa bɛ, ‹Xa wo mu luma tinxinyi kui, n fama nɛ wo rayensende ɲamanɛe kui.

sentences.english: But if you come back to me and keep my orders and do them, even if those of you who have been forced out are living in the farthest parts of heaven, I will get them from there, and take them back to the place marked out by me for the resting-place of my name.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa wo sa wo yɛtɛ ragbilen n ma, wo man bira n ma sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra, n sa wo tongoma nɛ yire makuye, n fa wo ra yire n dɛnnaxɛ sugandixi n xili matɔxɔfe ra.›

sentences.english: Now these are your servants and your people, whom you have made yours by your great power and by your strong hand.
sentences.susu: Muxu tan nan na i xa konyie ra, i xa ɲama, i naxee raminixi konyiya kui i sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: O Lord, let your ear take note of the prayer of your servant, and of the prayers of your servants, who take delight in worshipping your name: give help, O Lord, to your servant this day, and let him have mercy in the eyes of this man. (Now I was the king's wine-servant.)
sentences.susu: Marigi, n bara i maxandi, i xa tin i tuli matide i xa konyie xa maxandi ra, naxee gaaxuma i xili ra. I xa sɔɔnɛya raba n bɛ to. N sigama mangɛ naxan xɔn, i xa a niya a xa hinnɛ n na.» Na tɛmui n tan nan nu na mangɛ xa minse radangima ra.

sentences.english: And it came about in the month Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king, when wine was before him, that I took up the wine and gave it to the king. Now I had never before been sad when the king was present.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Atasakasi xa mangɛya ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nde Nisan kike ra, mangɛ nu na dɛgefe tɛmui naxɛ, n naxa wɛni so a yi ra sunnunyi kui. N to mu nu darixi na mɔɔli ra,

sentences.english: And the king said to me, Why is your face sad, seeing that you are not ill? this is nothing but sorrow of heart. Then I was full of fear;
sentences.susu: mangɛ naxa n maxɔrin, «I sunnunxi munfe ra? I mu furaxi, kɔnɔ i bɔɲɛ tan mu rafanxi i ma.» N naxa gaaxu a xa wɔyɛnyi ra.

sentences.english: And said to the king, May the king be living for ever: is it not natural for my face to be sad, when the town, the place where the bodies of my fathers are at rest, has been made waste and its doorways burned with fire?
sentences.susu: N naxa a yaabi, «Ala xa simaya gbegbe fi i ma! N sunnunxi nɛ barima n benbae ragataxi taa naxan kui, a birin bara kana, a naadɛe fan bara gan.»

sentences.english: Then the king said to me, What is your desire? So I made prayer to the God of heaven.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a masen n bɛ, «I wama munse xɔn ma?» N naxa Koore Ala maxandi n bɔɲɛ ma,

sentences.english: And I said to the king, If it is the king's pleasure, and if your servant has your approval, send me to Judah, to the town where the bodies of my fathers are at rest, so that I may take in hand the building of it.
sentences.susu: n fa mangɛ yaabi, «Mangɛ, xa i ɲanige fanyi rabama n tan i xa konyi bɛ, a lu n xa siga Yudaya bɔxi ma, alako n xa taa rakeli n benbae ragataxi dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: And the king said to me (the queen being seated by his side), How long will your journey take, and when will you come back? So the king was pleased to send me, and I gave him a fixed time.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa n maxɔrin, a xa ginɛ nu dɔxɔxi a sɛɛti ma, a naxɛ, «I xa biyaasi buma han mun tɛmui?» N to xi kɔnti fala a bɛ n gbilenma naxan ma, mangɛ naxa tin n xa siga.

sentences.english: Further, I said to the king, If it is the king's pleasure, let letters be given to me for the rulers across the river, so that they may let me go through till I come to Judah;
sentences.susu: N man naxa mangɛ maxandi, «Mangɛ, xa i bara tin, a xɔli n ma i xa kɛɛdi sɛbɛ n naxan soma naakiri gominae yi ra, alako e xa a lu n xa dangi e xa bɔxi ma han n Yudaya li.

sentences.english: And a letter to Asaph, the keeper of the king's park, so that he may give me wood to make boards for the doors of the tower of the house, and for the wall of the town, and for the house which is to be mine. And the king gave me this, for the hand of my God was on me.
sentences.susu: I xa kɛɛdi gbɛtɛ sɛbɛ mangɛ xa fɔtɔn makantɛ Asafi ma, alako a xa wurie so n yi ra n naxee yailanma Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ naadɛe ra, a nun n naxee rawalima tɛtɛ nun n ma banxi wali kui.» Mangɛ naxa na birin naba n bɛ, barima n Marigi Ala ɲɛngi saxi n ma fe xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Then I came to the rulers of the lands across the river and gave them the king's letters. Now the king had sent with me captains of the army and horsemen.
sentences.susu: N to xure xungbe igiri, n naxa na kɛɛdie so naakiri mangɛe yi ra, mangɛ Atasakasi naxee sɛbɛ e ma. Sɔɔri mangɛe nun soe ragie nu bara n mati naa.

sentences.english: And Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, hearing of it, were greatly troubled because a man had come to the help of the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Sanbalati Xoronka nun a xa malima Tobiya Amonika to n ma fe mɛ, e bɔɲɛ naxa raɲaaxu e ma, barima e mu nu tinma mixi xa Isirayilakae mali.

sentences.english: So I came to Jerusalem and was there three days.
sentences.susu: N to so Darisalamu, n naxa xi saxan naba mɛnni.

sentences.english: And in the night I got up, taking with me a small band of men; I said nothing to any man of what God had put into my heart to do for Jerusalem: and I had no beast with me but the one on which I was seated.
sentences.susu: N mu fefe fala mixi yo bɛ Ala naxan masenxi n bɛ n bɔɲɛ kui n xa a raba Darisalamu. Na tɛmui n nun xɛmɛ ndee naxa mini kɔɛ ra. N ma soe gbansan nu na muxu yi ra.

sentences.english: And I went out by night, through the doorway of the valley, and past the dragon's water-spring as far as the place where waste material was put, viewing the walls of Jerusalem which were broken down, and the doorways which had been burned with fire.
sentences.susu: Muxu naxa mini taa kui Gulunba naadɛ ra, muxu fa siga Daragon dula biri ra Xuruse Gbi naadɛ yire. N to Darisalamu tɛtɛ birin nabilin, n naxa a to yire nde kanaxi, naadɛe fan ganxi.

sentences.english: Then I went on to the door of the fountain and to the king's pool: but there was no room for my beast to get through.
sentences.susu: N naxa siga Dula naadɛ biri mangɛ xa ye yire na dɛnnaxɛ, kɔnɔ n ma soe mu dangide sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Then in the night, I went up by the stream, viewing the wall; then turning back, I went in by the door in the valley, and so came back.
sentences.susu: Na kui n naxa tɛtɛ mato kelife fole ra, han n so taa kui Gulunba naadɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the chiefs had no knowledge of where I had been or what I was doing; and I had not then said anything to the Jews or to the priests or the great ones or the chiefs or the rest of those who were doing the work.
sentences.susu: Taa mangɛe mu nu a kolonxi n nu na wali naxan kui. N mu nu sese tagi rabaxi Yuwifie, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, forie, kiitisae, nun kuntigie bɛ.

sentences.english: Then I said to them, You see what a bad condition we are in; how Jerusalem is a waste, and its doorways burned with fire: come, let us get to work, building up the wall of Jerusalem, so that we may no longer be put to shame.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo won ma tɔɔrɛ toxi! Darisalamu bara gɛ kanade. Tɛ bara a naadɛe gan. Wo fa, won xa Darisalamu tɛtɛ yailan. Na nan a toma won mu luma yaagi kui sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: Then I gave them an account of how the hand of my God was on me, helping me; and of the king's words which he had said to me. And they said, Let us get to work on the building. So they made their hands strong for the good work.
sentences.susu: N naxa a yaxaran e bɛ n Marigi Ala ɲɛngi saxi n xɔn ma ki naxɛ. N man naxa mangɛ xungbe xa wɔyɛnyi masen e bɛ. E to na birin mɛ, e naxa n yaabi, «Won keli, won xa a yailan.» E naxa limaniya na natɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: But Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the servant, the Ammonite, and Geshem the Arabian, hearing of it, made sport of us, laughing at us and saying, What are you doing? will you go against the king?
sentences.susu: Sanbalati Xoronka, a malima Tobiya Amonika, nun Gesemi Arabuka to yi fe mɛ, e naxa yo fɔlɔ muxu ma, e nu fa a fala muxu bɛ, «Wo na munse rabafe be? Wo wama mangasanyi matandife nɛ?»

sentences.english: Then answering them I said, The God of heaven, he will be our help; so we his servants will go on with our building: but you have no part or right or any name in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: N naxa e yaabi, «Ala naxan na koore ma, na nan fama xunnakeli fide muxu ma. A xa konyie nan muxu ra. Muxu fama kelide, muxu xa be yailan. Kɔnɔ wo tan, sese mu be naxan findima wo gbe ra. Darisalamu, wo xɔnyi mu a ra.»

sentences.english: Then Eliashib, the chief priest, got up with his brothers the priests, and took in hand the building of the sheep doorway; they made it holy and put its doors in position; as far as the tower of Hammeah they made it holy, even to the tower of Hananel.
sentences.susu: Eliyasibu sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi nun a ngaxakerenyi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxa keli, e tɛtɛ naadɛ nde yailan naxan xili Yɛxɛɛ naadɛ. E to gɛ, e naxa wali masen ɲama bɛ, e Ala maxandi a xa fe ra. E tɛtɛ raɲɔn na ki nɛ fɔlɔfe Meya yire makantaxi ma, sa dɔxɔ Xananɛli yire makantaxi ra.

sentences.english: And by his side the men of Jericho were building. And after them, Zaccur, the son of Imri.
sentences.susu: Yeriko xɛmɛe naxa tɛtɛ yire nde yailan e sɛɛti ma. Imiri xa di Sabudu naxa tɛtɛ yire nde yailan nee sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: The sons of Hassenaah were the builders of the fish doorway; they put its boards in place and put up its doors, with their locks and rods.
sentences.susu: Haseneya xa die naxa tɛtɛ naadɛ yailan naxan xili Yɛxɛ naadɛ. E naxa naadɛ see birin yailan alako a xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ, a man xa balan a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: By their side Meremoth, the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, was making good the walls. Then Meshullam, the son of Berechiah, the son of Meshezabel; and by him, Zadok, the son of Baana.
sentences.susu: Uri xa di Meremoti, naxan findixi Hakɔsi xa mamadi ra, naxa tɛtɛ yire nde yailan Haseneya xa wali sɛɛti ma. Berekiya xa di Mesulama, naxan findixi Mesesabeli xa mamadi ra, naxa wali Meremoti xa wali sɛɛti ma. Baanna xa di Sadɔki naxa wali Mesulama xa wali sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Near them, the Tekoites were at work; but their chiefs did not put their necks to the work of their Lord.
sentences.susu: Tekowa naxa tɛtɛ yire nde yailan Sadɔki xa wali sɛɛti ma, kɔnɔ e xa kuntigie mu tin lude wali yareratie xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: Joiada, the son of Paseah, and Meshullam, the son of Besodeiah, made good the old doorway; they put its boards in place and put up its doors, with their locks and rods.
sentences.susu: Paseya xa di Yoyada nun Bɛsodeya xa di Mesulama naxa Yesana naadɛ yailan. E naxa naadɛ isee birin yailan alako a xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ, a man xa balan a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: By their side were working Melatiah the Gibeonite and Jadon the Meronothite, the men of Gibeon and of Mizpah from the seat of the ruler across the river.
sentences.susu: Mɛlataya Gabayonka, Yadon Meronotika, Gabayonkae, nun Misipakae, naxee keli gomina taa naakiri ma, nee naxa wali Yoyada nun Mesulama xa wali sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Near them was working Uzziel, the son of Harhaiah, the gold-worker. And by him was Hananiah, one of the perfume-makers, building up Jerusalem as far as the wide wall.
sentences.susu: Xarihaya xa di Yusiyɛli, naxan fata xɛɛma rawalide, naxa tɛtɛ yire nde yailan Mɛlataya xa wali sɛɛti ma. Xananiya, naxan labundɛ rafalama, naxa tɛtɛ yire nde yailan Yusiyɛli xa wali sɛɛti ma. E naxa Darisalamu tɛtɛ yailan han a igbode.

sentences.english: Near them was working Rephaiah, the son of Hur, the ruler of half Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Xuru xa di Rɛfaya, naxan na Darisalamu sɛɛti mangɛ ra, naxa wali Xarihaya nun Xananiya xa walie sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: By his side was Jedaiah, the son of Harumaph, opposite his house. And by him was Hattush, the son of Hashabneiah.
sentences.susu: Xarumafi xa di Yɛdaya naxa wali Rɛfaya xa wali sɛɛti ma, a xa banxi ya ra. Xasabeneya xa di Xatusi naxa wali Yɛdaya xa wali sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Malchijah, the son of Harim, and Hasshub, the son of Pahath-moab, were working on another part, and the tower of the ovens.
sentences.susu: Xarima xa di Malakiya nun Mowaba Paxati xa di Xasubu, naxa tɛtɛ yire nde yailan nun yire makantaxi naxan xili Taami Gande.

sentences.english: Near them was Shallum, the son of Hallohesh, the ruler of half Jerusalem, with his daughters.
sentences.susu: Haloxesi xa di Salumu, naxan na Darisalamu sɛɛti xunyi ra, naxa wali suxu Malakiya nun Xasubu sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Hanun and the people of Zanoah were working on the doorway of the valley; they put it up and put up its doors, with their locks and rods, and a thousand cubits of wall as far as the doorway where the waste material was placed.
sentences.susu: Xanun nun Sanowakae naxa Gulunba naadɛ yailan. E naxa naadɛ isee birin yailan alako a xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ, a xa balan a fanyi ra. E man naxa tɛtɛ yailan han Xuruse Ɲaɲɛ naadɛ ra. Na xa kuyɛ nɔngɔn ya wulu keren.

sentences.english: And Malchijah, the son of Rechab, the ruler of the division of Beth-haccherem, made good the doorway of the waste, building it up and putting up its doors, with their locks and rods.
sentences.susu: Rekabu xa di Malakiya, naxan na Beti Hakeremi mangɛ ra, naxa Ɲaɲɛ naadɛ yailan. A naxa naadɛ isee birin yailan alako a xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ, a xa balan a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And Shallun, the son of Col-hozeh, the ruler of the division of Mizpah, made good the doorway of the fountain, building it up and covering it and putting up its doors, with their locks and rods, with the wall of the pool of Shelah by the king's garden, as far as the steps which go down from the town of David.
sentences.susu: Kolixose xa di Salumu, naxan na Misipa mangɛ ra, naxa Dulonyi naadɛ yailan. A naxa naadɛ isee birin yailan alako a xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ, a xa balan a fanyi ra. A man naxa tɛtɛ yailan fɔlɔfe Xɛɛra Ye yire ma, mangɛ xa laakɔɛ fɛ ma, sa dɔxɔ Dawuda xa taa gorode ra.

sentences.english: By his side was working Nehemiah, the son of Azbuk, ruler of half the division of Beth-zur, as far as the place opposite the last resting-places of David's family, and the pool which was made and the house of the men of war.
sentences.susu: Asibuki xa di Nehemi, naxan na Beti Suru sɛɛti mangɛ ra, naxa tɛtɛ yailan han mangɛ Dawuda xa gaburi, han ye ragata yire, han sɔɔri ɲalamae xa banxi.

sentences.english: Then came the Levites, Rehum, the son of Bani. By his side was working Hashabiah, ruler of half the division of Keilah, for his division.
sentences.susu: Bani xa di Rexumi, naxan keli Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ma, naxa wali Nehemi xa wali sɛɛti ma. Xasabiya, naxan na Keyila sɛɛti mangɛ ra, naxa wali Rexumi xa wali sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: After him were working their brothers, Bavvai, the son of Henadad, ruler of half the division of Keilah.
sentences.susu: Xenadadi xa di Bafaya, naxan na Keyila sɛɛti mangɛ ra, naxa wali a ngaxakerenyi Xasabiya xa wali sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And by his side was working Ezer, the son of Jeshua, the ruler of Mizpah, making good another part opposite the way up to the store of arms at the turning of the wall.
sentences.susu: Yesuwa xa di Eseri, naxan na Misipa taa mangɛ ra, naxa tɛtɛ yailan geresosee banxi ya ra, han tɛtɛ tuxui ra.

sentences.english: After him Baruch, the son of Zabbai, was hard at work on another part, from the turning of the wall to the door of the house of Eliashib, the chief priest.
sentences.susu: Sabayi xa di Baruki, naxa tɛtɛ yailan fɔlɔfe na tuxui ra, sa dɔxɔ Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Xungbe Eliyasibu xa banxi ra.

sentences.english: After him Meremoth, the son of Uriah, the son of Hakkoz, was working on another part, from the door of the house of Eliashib as far as the end of his house.
sentences.susu: Uriya xa di Meremoti, naxan findixi Hakɔsi xa mamadi ra, naxa tɛtɛ yailan fɔlɔfe Eliyasibu xa banxi naadɛ ra, han a xa banxi danxi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: After him were working the priests, the men of the lowland.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxee keli Darisalamu rabilinyi ra, nee naxa tɛtɛ yailan Meremoti xa wali sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: After them came Benjamin and Hasshub, opposite their house. After them Azariah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ananiah, made good the wall by the house where he himself was living.
sentences.susu: Bunyamin nun Xasubu naxa tɛtɛ yailan naxan nu na e xa banxi ya ra. Maaseya xa di Asaraya, naxan findixi Ananaya xa mamadi ra, a naxa tɛtɛ yailan a xa banxi fɛ ma.

sentences.english: After him Binnui, the son of Henadad, was working on another part, from the house of Azariah as far as the turning of the wall and the angle.
sentences.susu: Xenadadi xa di Binuwi naxa tɛtɛ yailan fɔlɔfe Asaraya xa banxi, han tɛtɛ tuxui ra.

sentences.english: Palal, the son of Uzai, made good the wall opposite the angle and the tower which comes out from the higher part of the king's house, by the open space of the watch. After him was Pedaiah, the son of Parosh.
sentences.susu: Yusayi xa di Pelali naxa tɛtɛ yailan na tuxui ya ra, yire makantaxi na dɛnnaxɛ, fɔlɔfe mangɛ xa banxi, han geeli yire. Paroso xa di Pɛdaya naxa tɛtɛ yailan Yusayi xa wali sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: (Now the Nethinim were living in the Ophel, as far as the place facing the water doorway to the east, and the tower which comes out.)
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔbanxi walikɛ naxee nu na Ofeli geya fari Darisalamu taa kui, nee naxa tɛtɛ yailan han Ye naadɛ, naxan nu na sogetede mabiri, yire makantaxi fɛ ma.

sentences.english: After him the Tekoites were making good another part, opposite the great tower which comes out, and up to the wall of the Ophel.
sentences.susu: Tekowa naxa tɛtɛ yailan fɔlɔfe yire makantaxi, han tɛtɛ Ofeli geya lima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Further on, past the horse doorway, the priests were at work, every one opposite his house.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxa tɛtɛ yailan han Soee xa naadɛ. Kankan nu walima a yɛtɛ xa banxi ya ra.

sentences.english: After them Zadok, the son of Immer, was working opposite his house. And after him Shemaiah, the son of Shecaniah, the keeper of the east door.
sentences.susu: Imeri xa di Sadɔki fan naxa tɛtɛ yailan a xa banxi ya ra. Sɛkanaya xa di Semaya, naxan Sogetede naadɛ makantama, naxa tɛtɛ yailan sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa wali sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: After him Hananiah, the son of Shelemiah, and Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, were making good another part. After him Meshullam, the son of Berechiah, made good the wall opposite his room.
sentences.susu: Selemiya xa di Xananiya nun Salafi xa di senni nde Xanun naxa tɛtɛ yailan Semaya xa wali sɛɛti ma. Berekiya xa di Mesulama naxa tɛtɛ yailan Selemiya nun Xanun xa wali sɛɛti ma, a xa konkoe ya ra.

sentences.english: After him Malchijah, one of the gold-workers to the Nethinim and the traders, made good the wall opposite the doorway of Hammiphkad and as far as the way up to the angle.
sentences.susu: Malakiya, naxan xɛɛma walima, naxa tɛtɛ yailan Mesulama xa wali sɛɛti ma, fɔlɔfe hɔrɔmɔbanxi walikɛe xa banxie nun yulɛe xa banxi, sa dɔxɔ Mifikade naadɛ han konkoe itexi tuxui ra.

sentences.english: And between the way up to the angle and the sheep door, the gold-workers and the traders made good the wall.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee xɛɛma walima, a nun yulɛe, nee naxa tɛtɛ yailan konkoe itexi tuxui ra nun Yɛxɛɛ naadɛ lan tagi.

sentences.english: Now, Sanballat, hearing that we were building the wall, was very angry, and in his wrath made sport of the Jews.
sentences.susu: Sanbalati, Tobiya, Arabukae, Amonikae, nun Asidodikae to a mɛ a Darisalamu tɛtɛ bara yailan fɔlɔ, e naxa xɔnɔ ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And in the hearing of his countrymen and the army of Samaria he said, What are these feeble Jews doing? will they make themselves strong? will they make offerings? will they get the work done in a day? will they make the stones which have been burned come again out of the dust?
sentences.susu: E birin naxa lan e xa siga gere sode Darisalamu, na wali xa kana.

sentences.english: Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, Such is their building that if a fox goes up it, their stone wall will be broken down.
sentences.susu: Na kui muxu naxa muxu Marigi Ala maxandi, a xa muxu kanta. Muxu man naxa yire makantɛe ti kɔɛ nun yanyi ra muxu yaxuie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Give ear, O our God, for we are looked down on: let their words of shame be turned back on themselves, and let them be given up to wasting in a land where they are prisoners:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Yudayakae nu a falama, «Muxu bara tagan. Tɛtɛ xa kanɛ gbo han won ɲan mu nɔma tɛtɛ nɛɛnɛ rakelide kɔrɛ.»

sentences.english: Let not their wrongdoing be covered or their sin washed away from before you: for they have made you angry before the builders.
sentences.susu: Muxu yaxuie nu a falama, «E mu fama won tode han won so e tagi, won fa e faxa. Na kui e xa wali fama dande.»

sentences.english: So we went on building the wall; and all the wall was joined together half-way up: for the people were working hard.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi naxee nu sabatixi e yaxuie sɛɛti ma, nee naxa fa a fala muxu bɛ han dɔxɔ fu, «Wo fa muxu xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: But when it came to the ears of Sanballat and Tobiah and the Arabians and the Ammonites and the Ashdodites, that the building of the walls of Jerusalem was going forward and the broken places were being made good, they were full of wrath;
sentences.susu: N naxa sɔɔrie ti xabilɛ ki ma xare ra, tɛtɛ dɛnnaxɛ mu ite, e xa mɛnni kanta santidɛgɛma, xali, nun tanbɛ ra.

sentences.english: And they made designs, all of them together, to come and make an attack on Jerusalem, causing trouble there.
sentences.susu: N to gɛ na birin matode, n naxa a fala kuntigie nun kiitisae bɛ ɲama ya xɔri, «Wo naxa gaaxu e ya ra. Wo xa ratu wo Marigi Magaaxuxi ma. Wo xa gere so won ngaxakerenyie bɛ, wo xa di xɛmɛe nun wo xa di ginɛe, wo xa ginɛe nun wo xa banxie xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: But we made our prayer to God, and had men on watch against them day and night because of them.
sentences.susu: Yaxuie to a mɛ muxu bara e ɲanige kolon, Ala naxa e xa natɛ kana. Muxu birin man naxa gbilen tɛtɛ yire, kankan naxa a xa wali suxu.

sentences.english: And Judah said, The strength of the workmen is giving way, and there is much waste material; it is impossible for us to put up the wall.
sentences.susu: Keli na lɔxɔɛ ma n ma mixie sɛɛti keren nu walima tɛtɛ yire, boore sɛɛti nu mixie makantama tanbɛe, kanke makantasee, nun xalie ra. Kuntigie tixi Yudayakae sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And those who were against us said, Without their knowledge and without their seeing us, we will come among them and put them to death, causing the work to come to a stop.
sentences.susu: Walikɛ naxee nu tɛtɛ yailanma, nun naxee nu kote maxaninma, e nu walima geresose suxuxi e bɛlɛxɛ,

sentences.english: And it came about that when the Jews who were living near them came, they said to us ten times, From all directions they are coming against us.
sentences.susu: santidɛgɛma xirixi e tagi. E nu wali na ki nɛ. Naxan feri fema alako mixi xa a kolon e yaxuie na fafe, a nu tixi n tan sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: So in the lowest part of the space at the back of the walls, in the open places, I put the people by families, with their swords, their spears, and their bows.
sentences.susu: N naxa a fala kuntigie nun kiitisae bɛ, ɲama ya xɔri, «Wali gbo, walikɛe tagi ikuya e boore ra. Won birin nayensenxi tɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: And after looking, I got up and said to the great ones and to the chiefs and to the rest of the people, Have no fear of them: keep in mind the Lord who is great and greatly to be feared, and take up arms for your brothers, your sons, and your daughters, your wives and your houses.
sentences.susu: Wo naxan nabama, wo nɛfɛ feri xui mɛ tɛmui naxɛ, wo birin xa wo malan muxu sɛɛti ma. Won Marigi Ala nan gere soma won bɛ.»

sentences.english: And when it came to the ears of those who were against us, that we had knowledge of their designs and that God had made their purpose come to nothing, we all went back to the wall, everyone to his work
sentences.susu: Muxu nu walima na lahalɛ nan na. Tanbɛe na ɲama sɛɛti keren bɛlɛxɛ i, kelife subaxɛ han tunbuie mini tɛmui.

sentences.english: And from that time, half of my servants were doing their part of the work, and half kept the spears and body-covers and the bows and the metal war-dresses; and the chiefs were at the back of the men of Judah.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui yati n man naxa a fala ɲama bɛ, «Birin nun a xa konyi xa xi Darisalamu kui alako won xa taa kanta kɔɛ ra, won man xa wali yanyi ra.»

sentences.english: Those who were building the wall and those who were moving material did their part, everyone working with one hand, with his spear in the other;
sentences.susu: N tan, n ngaxakerenyie, n ma konyie, n ma kantamixi naxee nu biraxi n fɔxɔ ra, hali muxu xa dugie, muxu mu e rate muxu ma. Kankan keren kerenma xa geresose nan nu suxuxi a yi ra, hali a sigama ye bade tɛmui.

sentences.english: Then there was a great outcry from the people and their wives against their countrymen the Jews.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Yudaya ɲama, xɛmɛe nun ginɛe, naxa kalamui sa e ngaxakerenyi ndee xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For there were some who said, We, our sons and our daughters, are a great number: let us get grain, so that we may have food for our needs.
sentences.susu: Ndee naxa a fala, «Muxu xa di xɛmɛe nun di ginɛe bara wuya. Muxu wama mɛngi xɔn ma alako muxu xa balo.»

sentences.english: And there were some who said, We are giving our fields and our vine-gardens and our houses for debt: let us get grain because we are in need.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbɛtɛe naxa a fala, «Muxu bara muxu xa xɛe, wɛni bilie, nun banxie dɔxɔ sɛɛkɛ, alako muxu xa baloe sɔtɔ kaamɛ tɛmui.»

sentences.english: And there were others who said, We have given up our fields and our vine-gardens to get money for the king's taxes.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbɛtɛe fan naxa a fala, «Muxu bara muxu xa xɛe nun muxu xa wɛni bilie dɔxɔ sɛɛkɛ ra, alako muxu xa duuti fi mangɛ ma.

sentences.english: But our flesh is the same as the flesh of our countrymen, and our children as their children: and now we are giving our sons and daughters into the hands of others, to be their servants, and some of our daughters are servants even now: and we have no power to put a stop to it; for other men have our fields and our vine-gardens.
sentences.susu: Na kui, hali won birin findixi wuli keren fasɛ keren nan na, muxu xa die bara findi muxu ngaxakerenyie xa konyie ra. Muxu xa di ginɛ gbegbe findixi konyie ra, muxu mu nɔma sese ra. Muxu xa kɔbiri bara ɲɔn, muxu xa xɛe nun wɛni bilie bara findi mixi gbɛtɛe gbe ra.»

sentences.english: And on hearing their outcry and what they said I was very angry.
sentences.susu: N to e xa kalamui mɛ, n bɔɲɛ naxa te a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: And after turning it over in my mind, I made a protest to the chiefs and the rulers, and said to them, Every one of you is taking interest from his countryman. And I got together a great meeting of protest.
sentences.susu: N naxa natɛ tongo n xa kalamui sa kuntigie nun kiitisae ma. N naxa e maxɔrin, «Munfe ra wo wo ngaxakerenyie donima kɔbiri alako wo xa geeni sɔtɔ?» N naxa malanyi belebele xili na xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And I said to them, We have given whatever we were able to give, to make our brothers the Jews free, who were servants and prisoners of the nations: and would you now give up your brothers for a price, and are they to become our property? Then they said nothing, answering not a word.
sentences.susu: N naxa a fala e bɛ, «Won bara won ngaxakerenyi Yuwifie xun sara kaafirie ma. Yakɔsi wo wo ngaxakerenyie yati nan matima wo bore ma?» E mu nɔ sese yaabide, e birin naxa dundu.

sentences.english: And I said, What you are doing is not good: is it not the more necessary for you to go in the fear of our God, because of the shame which the nations may put on us?
sentences.susu: N man naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo naxan nabaxi a mu fan feo! Wo mu gaaxuma Ala ya ra alako kaafirie naxa won nayaagi?

sentences.english: Even I and my servants have been taking interest for the money and the grain we have let them have. So now, let us give up this thing.
sentences.susu: N tan, n ngaxakerenyie, nun n ma walikɛe, muxu fan bara e doni kɔbiri nun mɛngi, kɔnɔ a mu lanma won xa geeni fen na kui.

sentences.english: Give back to them this very day their fields, their vine-gardens, their olive-gardens, and their houses, as well as a hundredth part of the money and the grain and the wine and the oil which you have taken from them.
sentences.susu: Wo xa e xa xɛe ragbilen e ma, e xa wɛni bilie, e xa oliwi bilie, a nun e xa banxie. Wo man xa wo xa geeni ragbilen e ma, naxan findixi kɔbiri, mɛngi, wɛni, nun ture ra.»

sentences.english: Then they said, We will give them back, and take nothing for them; we will do as you say. Then I sent for the priests and made them take an oath that they would keep this agreement.
sentences.susu: E naxa n yaabi, «Muxu na birin nagbilenma nɛ e ma. Muxu mu sese bama e yi ra. I naxan falaxi, muxu na nan nabama.» Na xanbi kɔrɛ n naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xili. N naxa donitie rakali e xa wɔyɛnyi ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And shaking out the folds of my robe, I said, So may God send out from his house and his work every man who does not keep this agreement; even so let him be sent out and made as nothing. And all the meeting of the people said, So be it, and gave praise to the Lord. And the people did as they had said.
sentences.susu: N man naxa n ma donma yuba fito, n naxa a ikuyukuyu, n fa a fala, «Ala xa yi mɔɔli raba mixi ra naxan mu a xa laayidi rakamalima. Ala xa na kanyi xa banxi nun a harige birin ba a yi ra, a xa lu setareɲa kui.» Mixi malanxie naxa a ratin, «Amina.» E naxa Alatala matɔxɔ. Na dangi xanbi, ɲama naxa na laayidi rakamali.

sentences.english: Now from the time when I was made ruler of the people in the land of Judah, from the twentieth year till the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes the king, for twelve years, I and my servants have never taken the food which was the right of the ruler.
sentences.susu: Kabi n naxa findi gomina ra Yudaya, fɔlɔ Atasakasi xa mangɛya ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nde ma han a ɲɛ tongo saxan nun firin nde ma, n tan nun n ngaxakerenyie mu balo duuti ra, naxan findi gomina sare ra.

sentences.english: But earlier rulers who were before me made the people responsible for their upkeep, and took from them bread and wine at the rate of forty shekels of silver; and even their servants were lords over the people: but I did not do so, because of the fear of God.
sentences.susu: Singe mangɛe nu ɲama tɔɔrɔma a ɲaaxi ra. E nu taami, wɛni, nun gbeti kilo tagi bama e yi duuti ra. E xa walikɛe fan nu mixie tɔɔrɔma. Kɔnɔ n mu na fe mɔɔli raba, barima n gaaxuma Ala ya ra.

sentences.english: And I kept on with the work of this wall, and we got no land for ourselves: and all my servants were helping with the work.
sentences.susu: N bara n yɛtɛ fi na tɛtɛ wali ma, n tan nun n ma mixi birin. Muxu mu bɔxi yo sɔtɔ na kui.

sentences.english: And more than this, a hundred and fifty of the Jews and the rulers were guests at my table, in addition to those who came to us from the nations round about us.
sentences.susu: Yuwifie nun kuntigie, mixi kɛmɛ mixi tongo suuli, nun xɔɲɛ naxee keli ɲamanɛ ma, e birin nu e dɛgema n xɔnyi nɛ.

sentences.english: Now the food made ready for one day was one ox and six fat sheep, as well as fowls; and once in ten days a store of all sorts of wine: but all the same, I did not take the food to which the ruler had a right, because the people were crushed under a hard yoke.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ birin ninge keren, yɛxɛɛ senni, nun xɔnie nu rafalama donse ra. Xi fu yo xi fu, wɛni fan nafalama. Na birin kui n mu tin gomina sare rasuxude, barima ɲama nu tɔɔrɔfe tɛtɛ wali xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Keep in mind, O my God, for my good, all I have done for this people.
sentences.susu: «N Marigi Ala, i xa ratu n ma wali xa fe ra, n naxan nabaxi yi ɲama bɛ.»

sentences.english: Now when word was given to Sanballat and Tobiah and to Geshem the Arabian and to the rest of our haters, that I had done the building of the wall and that there were no more broken places in it (though even then I had not put up the doors in the doorways);
sentences.susu: Sanbalati, Tobiya, Gesemi Arabuka, nun muxu yaxui birin to a mɛ a muxu bara gɛ tɛtɛ yailande, yale yo mu nu na a ma sɔnɔn, naadɛ gbakufe gbansan nan nu fa luxi,

sentences.english: Sanballat and Geshem sent to me saying, Come, let us have a meeting in one of the little towns in the lowland of Ono. But their purpose was to do me evil.
sentences.susu: Sanbalati nun Gesemi naxa xɛɛra xɛɛ n xɔn ma, a falafe, «Fa, won xa won bore to Kefirimi daaxa, Ono gulunba kui.» E nu wama fe ɲaaxi nan nabafe n na.

sentences.english: And I sent men to them saying, I am doing a great work, so that it is not possible for me to come down: is the work to be stopped while I go away from it and come down to you?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ yi yaabi ra, «Wali gbegbe na n yi ra, n mu nɔma gorode wo yire, xa na mu a ra wali kanama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And four times they sent to me in this way, and I sent them the same answer.
sentences.susu: E naxa xɛɛra xɛɛ n yire sanmaya naani, kɔnɔ n na yaabi kerenyi nan fi e ma.

sentences.english: Then Sanballat sent his servant to me a fifth time with an open letter in his hand;
sentences.susu: A sanmaya suuli nde, Sanbalati naxa a xa konyi xɛɛ n yire, bataaxɛ nde na a yi ra, naxan sɛbɛxi mixi birin ma.

sentences.english: And in it these words were recorded: It is said among the nations, and Geshem says so, that you and the Jews are hoping to make yourselves free from the king's authority; and that this is why you are building the wall: and they say that it is your purpose to be their king;
sentences.susu: Yi nan nu sɛbɛxi, «Si birin bara fe nde mɛ wo xa fe ra. Gesemi fan naxɛ a nɔndi na a ra. E naxɛ a i tan nun Yuwifie wama mangasanyi matandife, na nan a toxi wo na tɛtɛ yailanfe. E man naxɛ a i tan yati wama findife Isirayila mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And that you have prophets preaching about you in Jerusalem, and saying, There is a king in Judah: now an account of these things will be sent to the king. So come now, and let us have a discussion.
sentences.susu: I bara namiɲɔnmɛe sugandi naxee fama a falade Darisalamukae xa lu i xa mangɛya bun ma, i xa findi Yudaya mangɛ ra. Mangɛ xungbe fama na wɔyɛnyi birin mɛde. Awa, i xa fa, won xa won bore to.»

sentences.english: Then I sent to him, saying, No such things as you say are being done, they are only a fiction you have made up yourself.
sentences.susu: N naxa a yaabi, «I naxan birin falaxi yi ki, nɔndi keren mu na a kui. I tan nan yi wule falaxi.»

sentences.english: For they were hoping to put fear in us, saying, Their hands will become feeble and give up the work so that it may not get done. But now, O God, make my hands strong.
sentences.susu: Yi mixi birin nu wama muxu bɔɲɛ nan naminife tun. E e maɲɔxun nɛ limaniya bama muxu yi ra, muxu fa wali dan. «N Marigi, sɛnbɛ fi n ma.»

sentences.english: And I went to the house of Shemaiah, the son of Delaiah, the son of Mehetabel, who was shut up; and he said, Let us have a meeting in the house of God, inside the Temple, and let the doors be shut: for they will come to put you to death; truly, in the night they will come to put you to death.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde n naxa siga Semaya xɔnyi, Dɛlaya xa di, Mehetabeli xa mamadi. A nu a yɛtɛ balanxi banxi kui. A naxa a fala n bɛ, «Won xɛɛ Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, won xa naadɛe mabalan won ma, barima e fama kɔɛ ra i faxade.»

sentences.english: And I said, Am I the sort of man to go in flight? what man, in my position, would go into the Temple to keep himself safe? I will not go in.
sentences.susu: N naxa a yaabi, «N xa n gi? Xɛmɛ mu na n tan na? N nɔma sode Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, n man xa balo? Adama birin xa mu soma mɛnni. N tan mu soma naa feo.»

sentences.english: Then it became clear to me that God had not sent him: he had given this word of a prophet against me himself: and Tobiah and Sanballat had given him money to do so.
sentences.susu: N naxa a kolon Ala xa mu a xɛɛxi. Tobiya nun Sanbalati nu bara a sare fi alako a xa na wɔyɛnyi mɔɔli fala n bɛ.

sentences.english: For this reason they had given him money, in order that I might be overcome by fear and do what he said and do wrong, and so they would have reason to say evil about me and put shame on me.
sentences.susu: E bara wa n xa gaaxu, n xa bira e xa wɔyɛnyi fɔxɔ ra, n xa yunubi sɔtɔ na kui, alako e xa n xili kana, e xa n nayaagi.

sentences.english: Keep in mind, O my God, Tobiah and Sanballat and what they did, and Noadiah, the woman prophet, and the rest of the prophets whose purpose was to put fear into me.
sentences.susu: «N Marigi Ala, i xa ratu Tobiya, Sanbalati, Nowadiya, nun namiɲɔnmɛe wule falɛe xa fe ɲaaxi ma, e naxan nabaxi n na alako e xa n bɔɲɛ ramini a i.»

sentences.english: So the wall was complete on the twenty-fifth day of the month Elul, in fifty-two days.
sentences.susu: Tɛtɛ naxa gɛ yailande Elulu kike, xi mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli. Muxu naxa na wali raba xi tongo suuli nun firin bun ma.

sentences.english: And when our haters had news of this, all the nations round about us were full of fear and were greatly shamed, for they saw that this work had been done by our God.
sentences.susu: Muxu yaxuie to yi fe mɛ, e naxa gaaxu ki fanyi ra. Si birin naxa yaagi muxu rabilinyi, e fan naxa a kolon muxu nɔxi na birin nabade muxu Marigi Ala nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: And further, in those days the chiefs of Judah sent a number of letters to Tobiah, and his letters came to them.
sentences.susu: Na saxanyi bun ma, Yudaya kuntigi gbegbe nu bataaxɛe rasanbama Tobiya ma, e fan a xa bataaxɛe masɔtɔma.

sentences.english: For in Judah there were a number of people who had made an agreement by oath with him, because he was the son-in-law of Shecaniah, the son of Arah; and his son Jehohanan had taken as his wife the daughter of Meshullam, the son of Berechiah.
sentences.susu: Yudayaka gbegbe nu bara saatɛ tongo a bɛ marakali ra, barima a bitanyi nan nu na Sɛkanaya ra, Ara xa di. Yehoxanan nu bara Berekiya xa di Mesulama dɔxɔ.

sentences.english: And they said much before me of the good he had done, and gave him accounts of my words. And Tobiah sent letters with the purpose of causing me fear.
sentences.susu: Tɛmui birin e nu a xa fe fanyi ifalama n ya xɔri, e man n ma wɔyɛnyie radangima a ma. Tobiya nu bataaxɛe rasanbama n ma alako n xa gaaxu.

sentences.english: Now when the building of the wall was complete and I had put up the doors, and the door-keepers and the music-makers and the Levites had been given their places,
sentences.susu: Tɛtɛ nun naadɛe to gɛ yailande, naadɛ makantɛe, bɛɛtibae, nun Lewikae birin naxa e xa wali suxu.

sentences.english: I made my brother Hanani, and Hananiah, the ruler of the tower, responsible for the government of Jerusalem: for he was a man of good faith, fearing God more than most.
sentences.susu: N naxa n ma yaamarie so n xunya Xanani yi ra, a nun Xananiya naxan nu na sɔɔrie xun ma Darisalamu. Na nu bara findi mixi hagigɛ ra, a nu tinxin, a man nu gaaxuma Ala ya ra.

sentences.english: And I said to them, Do not let the doors of Jerusalem be open till the sun is high; and while the watchmen are in their places, let the doors be shut and locked: and let the people of Jerusalem be put on watch, every one in his watch, opposite his house.
sentences.susu: N naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo naxa taa naadɛe rabi han soge xɔnɔ tɛmui, e man xa balan saabi ra wo ya xɔri. Darisalamukae fan yire makantama nɛ, kankan xa lu a xa banxi naadɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Now the town was wide and great: but the people in it were only a small number, and the houses had not been put up.
sentences.susu: Darisalamu nu xungbo, kɔnɔ na tɛmui mixi mu nu wuya, banxie fan mu nu gɛxi tide.

sentences.english: And my God put it into my heart to get together the rulers and the chiefs and the people so that they might be listed by families. And I came across a record of the names of those who came up at the first, and in it I saw these words:
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala naxa a raso n xaxili kui, n xa kuntigie, kiitisae, nun ɲama malan, n xa kɔnti ti. N naxa taruxui buki to. Mixi naxee singe te, e xilie nu sɛbɛxi na kui. A sɛbɛxi,

sentences.english: These are the people of the divisions of the kingdom, among those who had been made prisoners by Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, and taken away by him, who went back to Jerusalem and Judah, every one to his town;
sentences.susu: «Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari naxa fa yi mixie ra kelife Darisalamu. E naxa lu konyiya kui, han e gbilenxi Darisalamu nun Yudaya tɛmui naxɛ. Kankan naxa siga a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Azariah, Raamiah, Nahamani, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispereth, Bigvai, Nehum, Baanah. The number of the men of the people of Israel:
sentences.susu: Sorobabeli, Yosuwe, Nehemi, Asaraya, Raamiya, Naxamani, Morodekayi, Bilesan, Misipereti, Begifayi, Nexuma, nun Baanna naxa e mati. Isirayilakae xilie nun e kɔnti nan yi ki:

sentences.english: The children of Parosh, two thousand, one hundred and seventy-two.
sentences.susu: Paroso xa die, mixi wulu firin, mixi kɛmɛ, mixi tongo solofere nun firin.

sentences.english: The children of Shephatiah, three hundred and seventy-two.
sentences.susu: Sɛfataya xa die, mixi kɛmɛ saxan, mixi tongo solofere nun firin.

sentences.english: The children of Arah, six hundred and fifty-two.
sentences.susu: Ara xa die, mixi kɛmɛ senni, mixi tongo suuli nun firin.

sentences.english: The children of Pahath-moab, of the children of Jeshua and Joab, two thousand, eight hundred and eighteen.
sentences.susu: Mowaba Paxati xa die, naxee fatanxi Yesuwa nun Yowaba ma, mixi wulu firin, mixi kɛmɛ solomasaxan, mixi fu nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: The children of Elam, a thousand, two hundred and fifty-four.
sentences.susu: Elama xa die, mixi wulu keren, mixi kɛmɛ firin, mixi tongo suuli nun naani.

sentences.english: The children of Zattu, eight hundred and forty-five.
sentences.susu: Satu xa die, mixi kɛmɛ solomasaxan, mixi tongo naani nun suuli.

sentences.english: The children of Zaccai, seven hundred and sixty.
sentences.susu: Sakayi xa die, mixi kɛmɛ solofere, mixi tongo senni.

sentences.english: The children of Binnui, six hundred and forty-eight.
sentences.susu: Binuwi xa die, mixi kɛmɛ senni, mixi tongo naani nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: The children of Bebai, six hundred and twenty-eight.
sentences.susu: Bibayi xa die, mixi kɛmɛ senni, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: The children of Azgad, two thousand, three hundred and twenty-two.
sentences.susu: Asigadi xa die, mixi wulu firin, mixi kɛmɛ saxan, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin.

sentences.english: The children of Adonikam, six hundred and sixty-seven.
sentences.susu: Adonikama xa die, mixi kɛmɛ senni, mixi tongo senni nun solofere.

sentences.english: The children of Bigvai, two thousand and sixty-seven.
sentences.susu: Begifayi xa die, mixi wulu firin, mixi tongo senni nun solofere.

sentences.english: The children of Adin, six hundred and fifty-five.
sentences.susu: Adin xa die, mixi kɛmɛ senni, mixi tongo suuli nun suuli.

sentences.english: The children of Ater, of Hezekiah, ninety-eight.
sentences.susu: Atɛri xa die, naxee fatanxi Xesekiya ra, mixi tongo solomanaani nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: The children of Hashum, three hundred and twenty-eight.
sentences.susu: Xasuma xa die, mixi kɛmɛ saxan, nun mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: The children of Bezai, three hundred and twenty-four.
sentences.susu: Beseyi xa die, mixi kɛmɛ saxan, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani.

sentences.english: The children of Hariph, a hundred and twelve.
sentences.susu: Xarifi xa die, mixi kɛmɛ, mixi fu nun firin.

sentences.english: The children of Gibeon, ninety-five.
sentences.susu: Gabayon xa die, mixi tongo solomanaani nun suuli.

sentences.english: The men of Beth-lehem and Netophah, a hundred and eighty-eight.
sentences.susu: Bɛtɛlɛɛmukae nun Netofakae, mixi kɛmɛ, mixi tongo solomasaxan nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: The men of Anathoth, a hundred and twenty-eight.
sentences.susu: Anatɔtikae, mixi kɛmɛ, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: The men of Beth-azmaveth, forty-two.
sentences.susu: Beti Asamafetikae, mixi tongo naani nun firin.

sentences.english: The men of Kiriath-jearim, Chephirah, and Beeroth, seven hundred and forty-three.
sentences.susu: Kiriyati Yeyarimi, Kefirakae, nun Berotikae, mixi kɛmɛ solofere, mixi tongo naani nun saxan.

sentences.english: The men of Ramah and Geba, six hundred and twenty-one.
sentences.susu: Ramakae nun Gebakae, mixi kɛmɛ senni, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun keren.

sentences.english: The men of Michmas, a hundred and twenty-two.
sentences.susu: Mikimasikae, mixi kɛmɛ, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin.

sentences.english: The men of Beth-el and Ai, a hundred and twenty-three.
sentences.susu: Betelikae nun Ayikae, mixi kɛmɛ, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan.

sentences.english: The men of the other Nebo, fifty-two.
sentences.susu: Neboka ndee, mixi tongo suuli nun firin.

sentences.english: The children of the other Elam, a thousand, two hundred and fifty-four.
sentences.susu: Elamaka ndee, mixi wulu keren, mixi kɛmɛ firin, mixi tongo suuli nun naani.

sentences.english: The children of Harim, three hundred and twenty.
sentences.susu: Xarima xa die, mixi kɛmɛ saxan, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn.

sentences.english: The children of Jericho, three hundred and forty-five.
sentences.susu: Yeriko xa die, mixi kɛmɛ saxan, mixi tongo naani nun suuli.

sentences.english: The children of Lod, Hadid, and Ono, seven hundred and twenty-one.
sentences.susu: Lodi xa die, Xadidi xa die, nun Ono xa die, mixi kɛmɛ solofere, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun keren.

sentences.english: The children of Senaah, three thousand, nine hundred and thirty.
sentences.susu: Senaa xa die, mixi wulu saxan, mixi kɛmɛ solomanaani, nun mixi tongo saxan.»

sentences.english: The priests: the children of Jedaiah, of the family of Jeshua, nine hundred and seventy-three.
sentences.susu: «Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe kɔnti nan yi ki: Yɛdaya xa die, naxee fatanxi Yesuwa xa denbaya ra, mixi kɛmɛ solomanaani, mixi tongo solofere nun saxan.

sentences.english: The children of Immer, a thousand and fifty-two.
sentences.susu: Imeri xa die, mixi wulu keren, mixi tongo suuli nun mixi firin.

sentences.english: The children of Pashhur, a thousand, two hundred and forty-seven.
sentences.susu: Pasura xa die, mixi wulu keren, mixi kɛmɛ firin, mixi tongo naani nun solofere.

sentences.english: The children of Harim, a thousand and seventeen.
sentences.susu: Xarima xa die, mixi wulu keren, mixi fu nun solofere.»

sentences.english: The Levites: the children of Jeshua, of Kadmiel, of the children of Hodevah, seventy-four.
sentences.susu: «Lewikae kɔnti nan yi ki: Yesuwa, Kadamiyɛli, nun Hodafiya xa die, mixi tongo solofere nun naani.»

sentences.english: The music-makers: the children of Asaph, a hundred and forty-eight.
sentences.susu: «Bɛɛti bae kɔnti nan yi ki: Asafi xa die, mixi kɛmɛ, mixi tongo naani nun solomasaxan.»

sentences.english: The door-keepers: the children of Shallum, the children of Ater, the children of Talmon, the children of Akkub, the children of Hatita, the children of Shobai, a hundred and thirty-eight.
sentences.susu: «Naadɛ makantɛe kɔnti nan yi ki: Salumu xa die, Atɛri xa die, Talamɔn xa die, Akubu xa die, Xatita xa die, nun Sobayi xa die, mixi kɛmɛ, mixi tongo saxan nun solomasaxan.»

sentences.english: The Nethinim: the children of Ziha, the children of Hasupha, the children of Tabbaoth,
sentences.susu: «Hɔrɔmɔlingira walikɛe kɔnti nan yi ki: Sixa xa die, Xasufa xa die, Tabayoti xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Keros, the children of Sia, the children of Padon,
sentences.susu: Kerosi xa die, Saya xa die, Padon xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Lebana, the children of Hagaba, the children of Salmai,
sentences.susu: Lebana xa die, Xagaba xa die, Salamayi xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Hanan, the children of Giddel, the children of Gahar,
sentences.susu: Hanan xa die, Gidɛli xa die, Gaxari xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Reaiah, the children of Rezin, the children of Nekoda,
sentences.susu: Reyaya xa die, Resin xa die, Nekoda xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Gazzam, the children of Uzza, the children of Paseah,
sentences.susu: Gasama xa die, Usa xa die, Paseya xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Besai, the children of Meunim, the children of Nephushesim,
sentences.susu: Bisayi xa die, Mewunima xa die, Nefusima xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Bakbuk, the children of Hakupha, the children of Harhur,
sentences.susu: Bakibuki xa die, Xakufa xa die, Xarixuri xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Bazlith, the children of Mehida, the children of Harsha,
sentences.susu: Basiluti xa die, Mexida xa die, Xarasa xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Barkos, the children of Sisera, the children of Temah,
sentences.susu: Barakɔsi xa die, Sisera xa die, Tema xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Neziah, the children of Hatipha.
sentences.susu: Nesiya xa die, nun Xatifa xa die.»

sentences.english: The children of Solomon's servants: the children of Sotai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Perida,
sentences.susu: «Sulemani xa walikɛe xa die kɔnti nan yi ki: Sotayi xa die, Sofereti xa die, Perdida xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Jaala, the children of Darkon, the children of Giddel,
sentences.susu: Yaala xa die, Darakɔn xa die, Gidɛli xa die,

sentences.english: The children of Shephatiah, the children of Hattil, the children of Pochereth-hazzebaim, the children of Amon.
sentences.susu: Sɛfataya xa die, Xatili xa die, Pokɛrɛti Hasebayimi xa die, nun Amon xa die.»

sentences.english: All the Nethinim and the children of Solomon's servants were three hundred and ninety-two.
sentences.susu: «Hɔrɔmɔbanxi walikɛe nun Sulemani xa walikɛe, mixi kɛmɛ saxan, mixi tongo solomanaani, nun firin.»

sentences.english: All these were the people who went up from Tel-melah, Tel-harsha, Cherub, Addon, and Immer; but because they had no knowledge of their fathers' families or offspring, it was not certain if they were Israelites:
sentences.susu: «Mixie nan yi ki naxee keli Teli Mela, Teli Xarasa, Kɛrubu, Adan, nun Imeri, kɔnɔ e mu nɔ a masende a Isirayila die yati yati nan e ra:

sentences.english: The children of Delaiah, the children of Tobiah, the children of Nekoda, six hundred and forty-two.
sentences.susu: Dɛlaya xa die, Tobiya xa die, nun Nekoda xa die, mixi kɛmɛ senni, mixi tongo naani nun firin.»

sentences.english: And of the priests: the children of Hobaiah, the children of Hakkoz, the children of Barzillai, who was married to one of the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite, and took their name.
sentences.susu: «Yi mixie nu na sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ya ma: Xabaya xa die, Hakɔsi xa die, nun Barasilayi xa die, naxan nu bara Barasilayi Galadika xa di ginɛ nde dɔxɔ, e fa na xili sa a xun ma.

sentences.english: They made search for their record among the lists of families, but their names were nowhere to be seen, so they were looked on as unclean and no longer priests.
sentences.susu: E naxa e ramini sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali kui barima e mu nɔ e xilie tode taruxui kui.

sentences.english: And the Tirshatha said that they were not to have the most holy things for their food, till a priest came to give decision by the Urim and Thummim.
sentences.susu: Gomina naxa e yaamari, e naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ donse sɛniyɛnxi don han sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nde xa Ala sagoe maxɔrin Urimi nun Tumimi ma.»

sentences.english: The number of all the people together was forty-two thousand, three hundred and sixty;
sentences.susu: «Ɲama birin kɔnti lanxi mixi wulu tongo naani nun firin, mixi kɛmɛ saxan tongo senni nan ma.

sentences.english: As well as their men-servants and their women-servants, of whom there were seven thousand, three hundred and thirty-seven; and they had two hundred and forty-five men and women to make music.
sentences.susu: E xa konyie kɔnti lanxi mixi wulu solofere, mixi kɛmɛ saxan tongo saxan nun solofere nan ma. Bɛɛtiba kɛmɛ firin tongo suuli nun suuli fan nu na e ya ma. Ɲama nu bara xuruse gbegbe xanin naa: soe kɛmɛ solofere, tongo saxan, nun senni, sofale kɛmɛ firin, tongo naani, nun suuli,

sentences.english: They had seven hundred and thirty-six horses, two hundred and forty-five transport beasts;
sentences.susu: ɲɔxɔmɛ kɛmɛ naani, tongo saxan, nun suuli, sofale mɔɔli nde wulu senni, kɛmɛ solofere mɔxɔɲɛn.»

sentences.english: Four hundred and thirty-five camels, six thousand, seven hundred and twenty asses.
sentences.susu: «Denbaya kanyie naxa see fi alako wali xa raba. Gomina naxa xɛɛma kole wulu keren, pɔɔti fanyi tongo suuli, nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ dugi kɛmɛ suuli, tongo saxan fi wali xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And some of the heads of families gave money for the work. The Tirshatha gave into the store a thousand darics of gold, fifty basins, five hundred and thirty priests' robes.
sentences.susu: Denbaya kanyie naxa xɛɛma kole wulu mɔxɔɲɛn, nun gbeti kole wulu firin nun kɛmɛ firin fi wali xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And some of the heads of families gave into the store for the work twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand, two hundred pounds of silver.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxan luxi naa naxa xɛɛma kole wulu mɔxɔɲɛn, nun gbeti kole wulu firin, nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ dugi tongo senni nun solofere fi wali xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And that which the rest of the people gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand pounds of silver, and sixty-seven priests' robes.
sentences.susu: «Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, Lewikae, hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛ makantɛe, bɛɛtibae, nun hɔrɔmɔbanxi walikɛe, nun Isirayilaka birin naxa sabati e xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: And when the seventh month came, the children of Israel were in their towns. And all the people came together like one man into the wide place in front of the water-doorway; and they made a request to Ezra the scribe that he would put before them the book of the law of Moses which the Lord had given to Israel.
sentences.susu: Kike solofere nde, Isirayilakae nu bara sabati e xa taae kui. Na tɛmui e birin naxa e malan Darisalamu taa kui naadɛ ya ra, naadɛ naxan xili «Ye naadɛ.» E naxa a fala sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ Esidirasi bɛ a xa fa Tawureta Munsa ra Alatala naxan fixi Isirayila ma.

sentences.english: And Ezra the priest put the law before the meeting of the people, before the men and women and all those who were able to take it in, on the first day of the seventh month.
sentences.susu: Esidirasi naxa fa a ra ɲama yire: xɛmɛe, ginɛe, nun mixi naxee birin nɔma masenyi fahaamude. Yi malanyi ti kike solofere nde xi singe lɔxɔɛ nɛ.

sentences.english: He was reading it in the wide place in front of the water-doorway, from early morning till the middle of the day, in the hearing of all those men and women whose minds were able to take it in; and the ears of all the people were open to the book of the law.
sentences.susu: Keli gɛɛsɛgɛ ma a sa dɔxɔ yanyi tagi ra, Esidirasi nu kitaabui xaranma ɲama bɛ naxan nu malanxi «Ye naadɛ» ya ra. Xɛmɛe, ginɛe, nun mixi naxee birin nɔma masenyi fahaamude, e naxa e tuli mati a fanyi ra na xaranyi ra.

sentences.english: And Ezra the scribe took his place on a tower of wood which they had made for the purpose; and by his side were placed Mattithiah and Shema and Anaiah and Uriah and Hilkiah and Maaseiah on the right; and on the left, Pedaiah and Mishael and Malchijah and Hashum and Hashbaddanah, Zechariah and Meshullam.
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ Esidirasi nu tixi se nde fari naxan yailanxi wuri ra alako mixi xa a to. Matitiya, Sema, Anaya, Uriya, Xilikiya, nun Maaseya nu tixi a yirefanyi ma. Pɛdaya, Mikayeli, Malakiya, Xasuma, Xasabadana, Sakari, nun Mesulama nu tixi a kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: And Ezra took the book, opening it before the eyes of all the people (for he was higher than the people); and when it was open, all the people got to their feet:
sentences.susu: Esidirasi naxa kitaabui rabi ɲama ya xɔri. A nu na dɛnnaxɛ ɲama birin a toxi. A to kitaabui rabi, birin naxa ti.

sentences.english: And Ezra gave praise to the Lord, the great God. And all the people in answer said, So be it, so be it; lifting up their hands; and with bent heads they gave worship to the Lord, going down on their faces to the earth.
sentences.susu: Esidirasi naxa Marigi Xungbe Alatala tantu. Ɲama naxa a ratin, «Amina. Amina.» E naxa e bɛlɛxɛ itala, e e mafelen bɔxi ma Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: And Jeshua and Bani and Sherebiah and Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and the Levites made the law clear to the people: and the people kept in their places.
sentences.susu: Lewika Yesuwa, Bani, Serebiya, Yamin, Akubu, Sabɛtayi, Hodiya, Maaseya, Kelita, Asaraya, Yosabadi, Hanan, nun Pɛlaya naxa yi sɛriyɛ tagi raba ɲama bɛ naxan tixi.

sentences.english: And they gave out the words of the book the law of God, clearly, and gave the sense of it, so that their minds were able to take it in.
sentences.susu: E naxa Tawureta Munsa, Ala xa sɛriyɛ, xaran ɲama bɛ a fanyi ra, e man a fasari alako birin xa a fahaamu.

sentences.english: And Nehemiah, who was the Tirshatha, and Ezra, the priest and scribe, and the Levites who were the teachers of the people, said to all the people, This day is holy to the Lord your God; let there be no sorrow or weeping; for all the people were weeping on hearing the words of the law.
sentences.susu: Ɲama to na sɛriyɛ mɛ, e naxa sunnun, e wa fɔlɔ. Na nan a toxi gomina Nehemi, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ Esidirasi, nun Lewika naxee nu ɲama xaranma, nee naxa a fala birin bɛ, «To xa findi sali lɔxɔɛ ra won Marigi Alatala bɛ. Wo naxa sunnun, wo naxa wa.»

sentences.english: Then he said to them, Go away now, and take the fat for your food and the sweet for your drink, and send some to him for whom nothing is made ready: for this day is holy to our Lord: and let there be no grief in your hearts; for the joy of the Lord is your strong place.
sentences.susu: Esidirasi man naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo siga, wo xa donse fanyi don, wo xa wo min a fanyi ra, wo man xa nde so setaree yi ra, barima to bara findi sali lɔxɔɛ ra won Marigi bɛ. Wo naxa sunnun, barima Alatala xa sɛɛwɛ sɛnbɛ fima nɛ wo ma.»

sentences.english: So the Levites made all the people quiet, saying, Be quiet, for the day is holy; and do not give way to grief.
sentences.susu: Lewikae fan naxa ɲama masabari, e nu fa a fala, «Wo wo sabari, barima to bara findi sali lɔxɔɛ ra Ala bɛ. Wo naxa sunnun.»

sentences.english: And all the people went away to take food and drink, and to send food to others, and to be glad, because the words which were said to them had been made clear.
sentences.susu: E birin naxa gbilen e xɔnyi, e xa sa e dɛge, e man xa e min. E naxa donse rasanba e booree ma ɲɛlɛxinyi kui, alɔ a fala e bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And on the second day the heads of families of all the people and the priests and the Levites came together to Ezra the scribe, to give attention to the words of the law.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, denbaya kanyie Isirayilakae ya ma, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, nun Lewikae naxa e malan sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ Esidirasi yire alako e xa Tawureta Munsa ramɛ.

sentences.english: And they saw that it was recorded in the law that the Lord had given orders by Moses, that the children of Israel were to have tents for their living-places in the feast of the seventh month:
sentences.susu: Yi sɛriyɛ kui, Alatala naxan so Annabi Munsa yi ra, a sɛbɛxi Isirayilakae xa bagee ti, e xa lu e kui kike solofere nde sali tɛmui.

sentences.english: And that they were to give out an order, and make it public in all their towns and in Jerusalem, saying, Go out to the mountain and get olive branches and branches of field olives and of myrtle, and palm branches and branches of thick trees, to make tents, as it says in the book.
sentences.susu: Yi sali lɔxɔɛ ma, a lan nɛ e xa a fala Isirayilakae birin bɛ, a nun naxee na Darisalamu, «Wo xa mini wula i oliwi salonyi, miriti salonyi, tugi fɛnsɛ, nun tufu salonyi fende, alako wo xa bagee ti alɔ a sɛbɛxi ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And the people went out and got them and made themselves tents, every one on the roof of his house, and in the open spaces and in the open squares of the house of God, and in the wide place of the water-doorway, and the wide place of the doorway of Ephraim.
sentences.susu: Na kui Isirayilakae naxa mini wuri salonyie sɛgɛde. E naxa bagee ti e xa banxie fari, tande ma, hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ kui, nun Ye Naadɛ nun Efirami xa Naadɛ ya ra.

sentences.english: All the people who had been prisoners and had come back, made tents and were living in them: for from the time of Jeshua, the son of Nun, till that day, the children of Israel had not done so. And there was very great joy.
sentences.susu: Ɲama, naxee birin keli konyiya kui, e naxa bagee ti e luma naxee kui. Na naxa findi sɛɛwɛ belebele ra. Kabi Nunu xa di Yosuwe tɛmui, e mu nu na mɔɔli raba.

sentences.english: And day by day, from the first day till the last, he was reading from the book of the law of God. And they kept the feast for seven days: and on the eighth day there was a holy meeting, as it is ordered in the law.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ, e nu fa Tawureta Munsa xaran, kelife sali fɔlɔ lɔxɔɛ han a raɲɔn lɔxɔɛ. E naxa na raba xi solofere bun ma. A solomasaxan nde, e birin naxa e malan, e fa sali belebele raba alɔ a sɛbɛxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Now on the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel came together, taking no food and putting haircloth and dust on their bodies.
sentences.susu: Na kike xi mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani lɔxɔɛ, Isirayilakae naxa e malan e xa sunyi suxu. E naxa sunnun donma ragoro e ma, e bɛndɛ maso e fate ma.

sentences.english: And the seed of Israel made themselves separate from all the men of other nations, publicly requesting forgiveness for their sins and the wrongdoing of their fathers.
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ naxa lu yire keren, xɔɲɛ yo mu nu na e ya ma. E naxa e xa yunubi nun e babae xa yunubi masen Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: And for a fourth part of the day, upright in their places, they were reading from the book of the law of their God; and for a fourth part of the day they were requesting forgiveness and worshipping the Lord their God.
sentences.susu: Kuye to iba, e naxa ti, e e tuli mati Tawureta Munsa xaranyi ra, e Marigi Alatala naxan soxi e yi ra. Soge to xɔnɔ fɔlɔ, e naxa e xa yunubi masen e Marigi Alatala bɛ, e man naxa tuubi a bɛ han soge naxa te a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Then Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani took their places on the steps of the Levites, crying in a loud voice to the Lord their God.
sentences.susu: Lewika Yesuwa, Bani, Kadamiyɛli, Sɛbanaya, Buni, Serebiya, Bani, nun Kenani naxa ti wuri yailanxi ma, e fa e Marigi Alatala xili e xui itexi ra.

sentences.english: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah said, Get up and give praise to the Lord your God for ever and ever. Praise be to your great name which is lifted up high over all blessing and praise.
sentences.susu: Lewika Yesuwa, Kadamiyɛli, Bani, Xasabeneya, Serebiya, Hodiya, Sɛbanaya, nun Petaxiya naxa a masen ɲama bɛ, «Wo keli, wo xa wo Marigi Alatala tantu, danyi mu na naxan ma.» «Muxu bara i xili xungbe matɔxɔ, naxan dangi tantui nun matɔxɔɛ birin na.

sentences.english: You are the Lord, even you only; you have made heaven, the heaven of heavens with all their armies, the earth and all things in it, the seas and everything in them; and you keep them from destruction: and the armies of heaven are your worshippers.
sentences.susu: I tan nan na muxu Marigi Alatala ra, i keren, naxan koore nun tunbuie daa, naxan bɔxi nun a isee birin daa, naxan baa nun yɛxɛ birin daa. I bara na nimase birin daa. Hali tunbui naxee na koore ma, e fan bara tuubi i bɛ.

sentences.english: You are the Lord, the God, who took Abram and made him yours, guiding him from Ur of the Chaldees, and gave him the name of Abraham;
sentences.susu: I tan nan na Marigi Alatala ra naxan Annabi Iburama sugandixi, a a ramini Uru Kalidi bɔxi kui, a Iburahima xili sa a xun ma.

sentences.english: You saw that his heart was true to you, and made an agreement with him to give the land of the Canaanite, the Hittite, the Amorite and the Perizzite and the Jebusite and the Girgashite, even to give it to his seed, and you have done what you said; for righteousness is yours:
sentences.susu: I naxa a to a bɔɲɛ tinxin i ya i. I naxa saatɛ tongo a bɛ, i xa Kanaan bɔxi fi a bɔnsɔɛ ma, Kanaankae, Xitikae, Amorikae, Perisikae, Yebusukae, nun Girigasakae nu na dɛnnaxɛ. I bara na saatɛ rakamali, barima i tinxin.»
