sentences.english: And you saw the trouble of our fathers in Egypt, and their cry came to your ears by the Red Sea;
sentences.susu: «I naxa muxu benbae xa sunnunyi to Misira bɔxi ma, i man naxa e xui mɛ Xulunyumi Baa ma.

sentences.english: And you did signs and wonders on Pharaoh and all his servants and all the people of his land; for you saw how cruel they were to them. So you got yourself a name as it is today.
sentences.susu: I naxa kaabanakoe nun tɔnxumae raba Firawuna, a xa walikɛe, nun a xa ɲama birin xili ma, barima i bara a kolon e bara e yɛtɛ igbo muxu benbae ma. Na kui i bara xili magaaxuxi sɔtɔ, naxan na i yi ra han to.

sentences.english: By you the sea was parted before them, so that they went through the sea on dry land; and those who went after them went down into the deep, like a stone into great waters.
sentences.susu: I naxa baa bolon e ya xɔri alako e xa giri. E naxa giri e xaraxi ra baa tagi, kɔnɔ naxee nu biraxi e fɔxɔ ra, i naxa ye radin nee xun ma, i e radula alɔ gɛmɛ goroma ye bɔtini ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And you went before them by day in a pillar of cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night, to give them light on the way they were to go.
sentences.susu: Yanyi ra, i naxa nuxui findi e raɲɛrɛ se ra. Kɔɛ ra, i naxa tɛ ti e bɛ naxan kira iyalanma, e e ɲɛrɛma naxan na.»

sentences.english: And you came down on Mount Sinai, and your voice came to them from heaven, giving them right decisions and true laws, good rules and orders:
sentences.susu: «I naxa goro Turusinina geya fari, i fa wɔyɛn e bɛ keli koore ma. I naxa sɛriyɛ tinxinxi, nɔndi, marasi nun yaamari fanyie masen e bɛ.

sentences.english: And you gave them word of your holy Sabbath, and gave them orders and rules and a law, by the hand of Moses your servant:
sentences.susu: I xa walikɛ Munsa saabui ra, i naxa i xa malabui lɔxɔɛ sɛniyɛnxi xa fe masen e bɛ, i xa yaamari, i xa marasi, nun i xa sɛriyɛ.

sentences.english: And you gave them bread from heaven when they were in need, and made water come out of the rock for their drink, and gave them orders to go in and take for their heritage the land which your hand had been lifted up to give them.
sentences.susu: Kaamɛ to e suxu, i naxa taami ragoro e ma keli koore. Ye xɔli nu na e ma tɛmui naxɛ, i naxa ye ramini gɛmɛ longori ra. I naxa e xɛɛ bɔxi tongode i i rakali naxan na sofe ra e yi ra.»

sentences.english: But they and our fathers, in their pride, made their necks stiff, and gave no attention to your orders,
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ muxu benbae naxa finsiriwaliya raba e xa yɛtɛ igboɲa kui. E mu e tuli mati i xa yaamari ra.

sentences.english: And would not do them, and gave no thought to the wonders you had done among them; but made their necks stiff, and turning away from you, made a captain over themselves to take them back to their prison in Egypt: but you are a God of forgiveness, full of grace and pity, slow to wrath and great in mercy, and you did not give them up.
sentences.susu: E mu tin i xui ratinmɛde. E mu ratu i xa kaabanakoe ma, i naxee raba e bɛ. E naxa e kobe ti i ra, e man naxa natɛ tongo gbilenfe ra konyiya kui. E mangɛ nde sugandi na nan ma. Kɔnɔ i tan mu e rabɛɲin, barima Ala nan lanxi i ma naxan diɲɛma, naxan kinikinima, naxan hinnɛma. I xa xɔnɛ mu mafura. I xa xanunteya gbo.

sentences.english: Even when they had made for themselves an ox of metal, and said, This is your God who took you up out of Egypt, and had done so much to make you angry;
sentences.susu: I mu e rabɛɲin hali e to ninge kuye yailan yɔxui ra, e fa a fala, ‹Muxu xa ala nan yi ki naxan muxu ramini Misira bɔxi ma.› E to fe ɲaaxi fala i xa fe ra, i mu e rabɛɲin fefe ma.

sentences.english: Even then, in your great mercy, you did not give them up in the waste land: the pillar of cloud still went before them by day, guiding them on their way, and the pillar of fire by night, to give them light, and make clear the way they were to go.
sentences.susu: I xa fonisireya kui i mu e rabɛɲin gbengberenyi ma. I mu nuxui ba e ya ra, naxan nu e raɲɛrɛma yanyi ra. I mu tɛ ba naa, naxan nu kira iyalanma e bɛ kɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And you gave your good spirit to be their teacher, and did not keep back your manna from their mouths, and gave them water when they had need of it.
sentences.susu: I naxa i Xaxili Fanyi so e yi ra alako e xaxili xa fan. I naxa mana taami nun ye so e yi ra alako e xa balo.

sentences.english: Truly, for forty years you were their support in the waste land, and they were in need of nothing; their clothing did not get old or their feet become tired.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ tongo naani bun ma, i ɲɛngi saxi e xa fe xɔn ma gbengberenyi ma. E hayi nu na se naxan birin ma, i naxa na so e yi ra. E xa dugie mu kana, e sanyie mu funtu.»

sentences.english: And you gave them kingdoms and peoples, making distribution to them in every part of the land: so they took for their heritage the land of Sihon, even the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og, king of Bashan.
sentences.susu: «I naxa mangɛyae nun si gbɛtɛe so e yi ra, bɔxi naxee nu na e xa bɔxi naaninyi ra. E naxa mangɛ Sixɔn xa bɔxi Xɛsibɔn tongo, e man naxa mangɛ Ogo xa bɔxi Basan tongo.

sentences.english: And you made their children as great in number as the stars of heaven, and took them into the land, of which you had said to their fathers that they were to go in and take it for themselves.
sentences.susu: I naxa e xa die rawuya dangife tunbuie ra naxee na koore ma. I naxa na bɔxi so e yi ra i naxan laayidi e babae bɛ.

sentences.english: So the children went in and took the land, and you overcame before them the people of the land, the Canaanites, and gave them up into their hands, with their kings and the people of the land, so that they might do with them whatever it was their pleasure to do.
sentences.susu: E xa die naxa na bɔxi sɔtɔ. I naxa Kanaankae nun e xa mangɛe ragoro e ya i, i naxa e sa e bɛlɛxɛ i, alako e xa e waxɔnfe raba e ra.

sentences.english: And they took walled towns and a fat land, and became the owners of houses full of all good things, water-holes cut in the rock, vine-gardens and olive-gardens and a wealth of fruit-trees: so they had food enough and became fat, and had joy in the good you gave them.
sentences.susu: E naxa taae nun bɔxi fanyie sɔtɔ, a nun banxi naxee rafexi harige ra, kɔlɔnyie, wɛni bilie, oliwi bilie, nun sansi gbegbe naxee bogima a fanyi ra. E naxa e dɛge, e naxa luga baloe fanyi ra, e naxan sɔtɔ i xa hinnɛ saabui ra.»

sentences.english: But they were hard-hearted, and went against your authority, turning their backs on your law, and putting to death your prophets, who gave witness against them with the purpose of turning them back again to you, and they did much to make you angry.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ e mu lu i xa yaamari bun ma. E naxa i matandi, e naxa e kobe ti i xa sɛriyɛ ra. E naxa i xa namiɲɔnmɛe faxa, naxee nu bara kawandi ti e bɛ e xa gbilen i ma. E naxa fe ɲaaxi gbegbe raba i ra.

sentences.english: And so you gave them up into the hands of their haters who were cruel to them: and in the time of their trouble, when they made their prayer to you, you gave ear to them from heaven; and in your great mercy gave them saviours, who made them free from the hands of their haters.
sentences.susu: Na kui i naxa e sa e yaxuie bɛlɛxɛ i, naxee bara e ɲaxankata. Kɔnɔ e to i xili e xa tɔɔrɛ kui, i naxa e xa maxandi suxu koore ma. I naxa marakisimae xɛɛ e xɔn ma, naxee bara e ba e yaxuie bɛlɛxɛ i.

sentences.english: But when they had rest, they did evil again before you: so you gave them into the hands of their haters, who had rule over them: but when they came back and made their prayer to you, you gave ear to them from heaven; again and again, in your mercy, you gave them salvation;
sentences.susu: E to malabui sɔtɔ, e man naxa fe ɲaaxi raba fɔlɔ i ra. Na kui, i naxa e rabɛɲin e yaxuie yi ra, naxee bara nɔ e ra. Kɔnɔ e to gbilen i xili ra, i man naxa e xa maxandi suxu koore ma i xa fonisireya saabui ra. I bara e ratanga sanmaya wuyaxi.

sentences.english: And gave witness against them so that you might make them come back again to your law: but their hearts were lifted up, and they gave no attention to your orders and went against your decisions (which, if a man keeps them, will be life to him), and turning their backs on you, made their necks stiff and did not give ear.
sentences.susu: I naxa fe birin naba, alako e xa bira i xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ e naxa e yɛtɛ igbo, e mu e tuli mati i xa yaamarie ra. E naxa tondi i xa sɛriyɛ rabatude, naxan nɔma a rabatumae rakiside. E naxa e kobe ti i ra, e mu i xui rabatu fefe ma.»

sentences.english: Year after year you put up with them, and gave witness against them by your spirit through your prophets: still they did not give ear: and so you gave them up into the hands of the peoples of the lands.
sentences.susu: «I naxa lu e sɛɛti ma kabi tɛmui xɔnkuye. I nu e ralimaniyama i Xaxili ra i xa namiɲɔnmɛe saabui ra, kɔnɔ e mu e tuli mati i ra. Na kui i naxa e sa si gbɛtɛe bɛlɛxɛ i.

sentences.english: Even then, in your great mercy, you did not put an end to them completely, or give them up; for you are a God of grace and mercy.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ hali i to na raba, i tondi nɛ e sɔntɔde i xa fonisireya xa fe ra. I mu e rabɛɲin kerenyi ra, barima Ala nan na i ra naxan hinnɛma mixie ra, naxan kinikinima e ma.»

sentences.english: And now, our God, the great, the strong, the God who is to be feared, who keeps faith and mercy, let not all this trouble seem small to you, which has come on us, and on our kings and our rulers and on our priests and our prophets and our fathers and on all your people from the time of the kings of Assyria till this day.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi, i tan muxu Marigi Ala Xungbe, i sɛnbɛ gbo, i magaaxu, i i xa saatɛ rakamalima, i hinnɛma mixi ra. Yandi, i xa i ɲɛngi sa muxu xa tɔɔrɛ xɔn ma, muxu xa mangɛe, muxu xa kuntigie, muxu xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, muxu xa namiɲɔnmɛe, muxu babae, nun muxu xa ɲama birin. Kabi Asiriya mangɛe xa tɛmui, han to muxu na tɔɔrɛ nan kui.

sentences.english: But still, you have been in the right in everything which has come on us; you have been true to us, but we have done evil:
sentences.susu: I bara fe tinxinxi raba muxu bɛ. I tan bara dugutɛgɛɲa raba, kɔnɔ muxu tan bara fe ɲaaxi raba i ra.

sentences.english: And our kings, our rulers, our priests, and our fathers have not kept your law or given attention to your orders and your witness, with which you gave witness against them.
sentences.susu: Muxu xa mangɛe, muxu xa kuntigie, muxu xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, nun muxu babae mu bira i xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra. E mu e tuli matixi i xa yaamari nun i xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: For they have not been your servants in their kingdom, and in all the good things you gave them, and in the great and fat land you gave them, and they have not been turned away from their evil-doing.
sentences.susu: Hali i to harige nun bɔxi fanyi sa e xa mangɛya bun ma tɛmui naxɛ, e mu i xui rabatu, e mu gbilen e xa wali ɲaaxie fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Now, today, we are servants, and as for the land which you gave to our fathers, so that the produce of it and the good might be theirs, see, we are servants in it:
sentences.susu: To lɔxɔɛ muxu na konyiya nan kui. Muxu bara findi konyie ra bɔxi ma i dɛnnaxɛ fixi muxu benbae ma, alako e xa balo na bɔxi fanyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: And it gives much increase to the kings whom you have put over us because of our sins: and they have power over our bodies and over our cattle at their pleasure, and we are in great trouble.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na bɔxi bogi fanyi birin luma mangɛ gbɛtɛe nan bɛ, muxu na naxee bun ma muxu xa yunubie xa fe ra. E e waxɔnfe rabama muxu fatee nun muxu xa xurusee ra. Muxu na tɔɔrɛ belebele nan kui.»

sentences.english: Now those who put down their names were Nehemiah the Tirshatha, the son of Hacaliah, and Zedekiah,
sentences.susu: Na birin kui, muxu bara yi natɛ sɛbɛxi tongo, muxu xa mangɛe, Lewikae, nun muxu xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa tɔnxuma dɔxɔxi a ma.

sentences.english: Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
sentences.susu: E xilie nan yi ki: Gomina Nehemi Xakalaya xa di, Sedekiya,

sentences.english: Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah,
sentences.susu: Seraya, Asaraya, Yeremi,

sentences.english: Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,
sentences.susu: Pasura, Amaraya, Malakiya,

sentences.english: Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
sentences.susu: Xatusi, Sɛbanaya, Maluku,

sentences.english: Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,
sentences.susu: Xarima, Meremoti, Abadiyasi,

sentences.english: Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,
sentences.susu: Daniyɛli, Ginɛtɔn, Baruki,

sentences.english: Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah; these were the priests.
sentences.susu: Mesulama, Abiya, Miyamin,

sentences.english: And the Levites: by name, Jeshua, the son of Azaniah, Binnui, of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel,
sentences.susu: Maasiya, Biligayi, nun Semaya. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nan na ki.

sentences.english: And their brothers, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
sentences.susu: Lewikae nan yi ki: Asanaya xa di Yesuwa, Xenadadi xa di Binuwi, Kadamiyɛli,

sentences.english: Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,
sentences.susu: nun e ngaxakerenyie, Sɛbanaya, Hodiya, Kelita, Pɛlaya, Hanan,

sentences.english: Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
sentences.susu: Mika, Rexobo, Xasabiya,

sentences.english: Hodiah, Bani, Beninu.
sentences.susu: Sabudu, Serebiya, Sɛbanaya,

sentences.english: The chiefs of the people: Parosh, Pahath-moab, Elam, Zattu, Bani,
sentences.susu: Hodiya, Bani, nun Bɛninu.

sentences.english: Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
sentences.susu: Kuntigie nan yi ki: Paroso, Mowaba Paxati, Elama, Satu, Bani,

sentences.english: Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
sentences.susu: Buni, Asigadi, Bibayi,

sentences.english: Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,
sentences.susu: Adoniya, Begifayi, Adin,

sentences.english: Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,
sentences.susu: Atɛri, Xesekiya, Asuru,

sentences.english: Hariph, Anathoth, Nobai,
sentences.susu: Hodiya, Xasuma, Beseyi,

sentences.english: Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
sentences.susu: Xarifi, Anatɔti, Nebayi,

sentences.english: Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
sentences.susu: Magapiyasi, Mesulama, Xesiri,

sentences.english: Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
sentences.susu: Mesesabeli, Sadɔki, Yaduwa,

sentences.english: Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,
sentences.susu: Pɛlataya, Hanan, Anaya,

sentences.english: Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
sentences.susu: Hoseya, Xananiya, Xasubu,

sentences.english: Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
sentences.susu: Haloxesi, Pilixa, Sobeki,

sentences.english: And Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,
sentences.susu: Rexumi, Xasabana, Maaseya,

sentences.english: Malluch, Harim, Baanah.
sentences.susu: Ahaya, Hanan, Anan,

sentences.english: And the rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the door-keepers, the music-makers, the Nethinim, and all those who had made themselves separate from the peoples of the lands, to keep the law of God, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, everyone who had knowledge and wisdom;
sentences.susu: Maluku, Xarima, nun Baanna.

sentences.english: They were united with their brothers, their rulers, and put themselves under a curse and an oath, to keep their steps in the way of God's law, which was given by Moses, the servant of God, and to keep and do all the orders of the Lord, our Lord, and his decisions and his rules;
sentences.susu: «Ɲama dɔnxɔɛ birin, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, Lewikae, naadɛ makantɛe, bɛɛtibae, hɔrɔmɔbanxi walikɛe, nun mixi naxee birin mini si gbɛtɛe ya ma e bira Ala xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra, e xa ginɛe, e xa di xɛmɛe, e xa di ginɛe, nun mixi naxee birin fe fahaamuma,

sentences.english: And that we would not give our daughters to the peoples of the lands, or take their daughters for our sons;
sentences.susu: nee birin naxa kafu e ngaxakerenyi kuntigie ma. E naxa e rakali e xa bira Ala xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra, Ala xa konyi Munsa naxan fixi e ma, e xa e Marigi Alatala xa yaamari, a xa masenyi, nun a xa sɛriyɛ birin nabatu.»

sentences.english: And if the peoples of the lands come to do trade in goods or food on the Sabbath day, that we would do no trade with them on the Sabbath or on a holy day: and that in the seventh year we would take no payment from any debtor.
sentences.susu: «Muxu naxa natɛ tongo muxu xa tondi muxu xa die fide yi bɔxi mixie ma. Muxu fan xa tondi e xa di ginɛe fende muxu xa di xɛmɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: And we made rules for ourselves, taxing ourselves a third of a shekel every year for the upkeep of the house of our God;
sentences.susu: Muxu mu sese sarama malabui lɔxɔɛe nun sali lɔxɔɛe, yi bɔxi mixie fama naxee ra alɔ mɛngi, xa na mu a ra se gbɛtɛ. Ɲɛ solofere nde birin na, muxu mu bɔxi rawalima, muxu man diɲɛma nɛ donie birin ma.

sentences.english: For the holy bread, and for the regular meal offering and the regular burned offering on the Sabbaths and at the new moon and the fixed feasts, and for the sin-offerings to take away the sin of Israel, and for all the work of the house of our God.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ yo ɲɛ muxu xa gbeti nde ba, a xa rawali muxu Marigi Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui,

sentences.english: And we, the priests and the Levites and the people, made selection, by the decision of the Lord, of those who were to take the wood offering into the house of God, by families at the regular times, year by year, to be burned on the altar of the Lord our God, as it is recorded in the law;
sentences.susu: alɔ sɛrɛxɛ taami, sansi xɔri naxee bama sɛrɛxɛ ra lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ, sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi naxee bama lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ, naxee bama malabui lɔxɔɛe, naxee bama kike nɛɛnɛ ti lɔxɔɛe, naxee bama sali lɔxɔɛe, naxee bama sɛniyɛnyi xa fe ra, naxee bama Isirayila xa yunubi xafarife ra, a nun wali naxan birin nabama muxu Marigi Ala xa banxi kui.»

sentences.english: And to take the first-fruits of our land, and the first-fruits of every sort of tree, year by year, into the house of the Lord;
sentences.susu: «Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, Lewikae, nun ɲama birin naxa natɛ tongo Ala xa mali ra, xabilɛe naxee fama yege ra a waxati ki ma, naxan ganma Ala xa banxi kui, alɔ a sɛbɛxi kitaabui kui ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: As well as the first of our sons and of our cattle, as it is recorded in the law, and the first lambs of our herds and of our flocks, which are to be taken to the house of our God, to the priests who are servants in the house of our God:
sentences.susu: Muxu naxa natɛ tongo ɲɛ yo ɲɛ muxu xa muxu xa bɔxi daxamui singee nun muxu xa sansi bogi singee xanin Alatala xa banxi.

sentences.english: And that we would take the first of our rough meal, and our lifted offerings, and the fruit of every sort of tree, and wine and oil, to the priests, to the rooms of the house of our God; and the tenth of the produce of our land to the Levites; for they, the Levites, take a tenth in all the towns of our ploughed land.
sentences.susu: Muxu man xa muxu xa di xɛmɛ singee nun muxu xa xuruse di singee xanin sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xɔn ma, muxu Marigi Ala xa banxi kui, alɔ a sɛbɛxi kitaabui kui ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And the priest, the son of Aaron, is to be with the Levites, when the Levites take the tenths: and the Levites are to take a tenth of the tenths into the house of our God, to the rooms, into the store-house;
sentences.susu: «Muxu naxa natɛ tongo, muxu xa muxu xa farin xun singee, sansi bogi singee, wɛni nɛɛnɛ, nun ture nɛɛnɛ xanin muxu Marigi Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi bilie kui sɛrɛxɛdubɛe bɛ. Muxu man xa farilɛ fi Lewikae ma. E luma siga ra na farilɛ fɔxɔ ra muxu walima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi are to take the lifted offering of the grain and wine and oil into the rooms where the vessels of the holy place are, together with the priests and the door-keepers and the makers of music: and we will not give up caring for the house of our God.
sentences.susu: E xa na raba Haruna bɔnsɔɛ sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nde ya xɔri. E xa farilɛ ba na farilɛ nan kui, e fa na tan xanin hɔrɔmɔbanxi bilie kui, daxamui ragatama dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And the rulers of the people were living in Jerusalem: the rest of the people made selection, by the decision of chance, of one out of every ten to be living in Jerusalem, the holy town; the other nine to go to the other towns.
sentences.susu: Ɲama kuntigie naxa sabati Darisalamu taa sɛniyɛnxi, a nun mixi gbɛtɛe naxee sugandixi Ala xa mali ra. Mixi fu yo mixi fu, keren naxa sugandi dɔxɔfe ra Darisalamu. Mixi dɔnxɔɛ naxee luxi, nee naxa sabati taa gbɛtɛe.

sentences.english: And the people gave a blessing to all the men who were freely offering to take up their places in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa duba mixie bɛ, naxee bara tin lude Darisalamu.

sentences.english: Now these are the chiefs of the divisions of the country who were living in Jerusalem: but in the towns of Judah everyone was living on his heritage in the towns, that is, Israel, the priests, the Levites, the Nethinim, and the children of Solomon's servants.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, Lewikae, hɔrɔmɔbanxi walikɛe, nun Sulemani xa konyie xa die, naxee mu nu na Darisalamu, nee naxa sabati e xɔnyi, e xa taae kui Yudaya bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And in Jerusalem there were living certain of the children of Judah and of Benjamin. Of the children of Judah: Athaiah, the son of Uzziah, the son of Zechariah, the son of Amariah, the son of Shephatiah, the son of Mahalalel, of the children of Perez;
sentences.susu: Bɔxi mangɛ naxee sabati Darisalamu, ndee keli Yuda bɔnsɔɛ nun Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ nɛ. Naxee kelixi Yuda bɔnsɔɛ, nee xilie nan yi ki: Atayaya nun Maaseya. Atayaya baba xili Yusiya. Na fan baba xili Sakari. Na fan baba xili Amaraya. Na fan baba xili Sɛfataya. Na fan baba xili Mahalaleli. Na fan baba xili Peresi.

sentences.english: And Maaseiah, the son of Baruch, the son of Col-hozeh, the son of Hazaiah, the son of Adaiah, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zechariah, the son of the Shilonite.
sentences.susu: Maaseya baba xili Baruki. Na fan baba xili Kolixose. Na fan baba xili Xasaya. Na fan baba xili Adaya. Na fan baba xili Yoyaribu. Na fan baba xili Sakari. Na fan baba xili Selaha.

sentences.english: All the sons of Perez living in Jerusalem were four hundred and sixty-eight men of good position.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Peresi xabilɛ naxee sabati Darisalamu, e findixi mixi kɛmɛ naani, mixi tongo senni nun solomasaxan nan na.

sentences.english: And these are the sons of Benjamin: Sallu, the son of Meshullam, the son of Joed, the son of Pedaiah, the son of Kolaiah, the son of Maaseiah, the son of Ithiel, the son of Jeshaiah.
sentences.susu: Naxee kelixi Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ, nee xilie nan yi ki: Salu, nun a fɔxirabirɛe Gabayi nun Salayi. Salu baba xili Mesulama. Na fan baba xili Yowedi. Na fan baba xili Pɛdaya. Na fan baba xili Kolaya. Na fan baba xili Maaseya. Na fan baba xili Itiyɛli. Na fan baba xili Yɛsaya.

sentences.english: And after him Gabbai, Sallai, nine hundred and twenty-eight.
sentences.susu: Nee xa mixie malanxi mixi kɛmɛ solomanaani, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: And Joel, the son of Zichri, was their overseer; and Judah, the son of Hassenuah, was second over the town.
sentences.susu: Sikiri xa di Yoweli nan findixi e xa mangɛ singe ra. E xa mangɛ firin nde lanxi Hasɛnuwa xa di Yuda nan ma.

sentences.english: Of the priests: Jedaiah, the son of Joiarib, Jachin,
sentences.susu: Naxee findixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra, nee xilie nan yi ki: Yoyaribu xa di Yɛdaya, Yakin,

sentences.english: Seraiah, the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God,
sentences.susu: Seraya, nun e wali booree. Seraya baba xili Xilikiya. Na fan baba xili Mesulama. Na fan baba xili Sadɔki. Na fan baba xili Merayoti. Na fan baba xili Axituba, Ala xa banxi yarerati.

sentences.english: And their brothers who did the work of the house, eight hundred and twenty-two; and Adaiah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Pelaliah, the son of Amzi, the son of Zechariah, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah,
sentences.susu: Nee birin malanxi mixi kɛmɛ solomasaxan, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun firin. Adaya fan nu na, a nun a wali boore naxee findi denbaya kanyie ra. Adaya baba xili Yeroxama. Na fan baba xili Pɛlalaya. Na fan baba xili Amasi. Na fan baba xili Sakari. Na fan baba xili Pasura. Na fan baba xili Malakiya.

sentences.english: And his brothers, heads of families, two hundred and forty-two; and Amashsai, the son of Azarel, the son of Ahzai, the son of Meshillemoth, the son of Immer,
sentences.susu: Nee birin malanxi mixi kɛmɛ firin, mixi tongo naani nun firin. Amasayi fan nu na, a nun a wali boore naxee findi kuntigie ra. A baba xili Asarɛli. Na fan baba xili Axesayi. Na fan baba xili Mesilemoti. Na fan baba xili Imeri.

sentences.english: And their brothers, men of war, a hundred and twenty-eight; and their overseer was Zabdiel, the son of Haggedolim.
sentences.susu: Nee birin malanxi mixi kɛmɛ, mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun solomasaxan. Hagidoli xa di Sabadiyɛli nan findi e xa yarerati ra.

sentences.english: And of the Levites: Shemaiah, the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Bunni,
sentences.susu: Naxee findixi Lewikae ra, nee xilie nan yi ki: Semaya, naxan baba xili Xasubu. Na fan baba xili Asirikama. Na fan baba xili Xasabiya. Na fan baba xili Buni.

sentences.english: And Shabbethai and Jozabad, of the chiefs of the Levites, who were responsible for the outside business of the house of God;
sentences.susu: Sabɛtayi nun Yosabadi, Lewikae xa mangɛ naxee nu Ala xa banxi yailanma.

sentences.english: And Mattaniah, the son of Mica, the son of Zabdi, the son of Asaph, who had to give the first note of the song of praise in prayer, and Bakbukiah, the second among his brothers, and Abda, the son of Shammua, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun.
sentences.susu: Mataniya, naxan baba xili Mika. Na fan baba xili Sabadi. Na fan baba xili Asafi, mangɛ naxan Ala matɔxɔɛ nun Ala maxandi rabama. Bakibukiya nan findi na mangɛ firin nde ra. Abeda, naxan baba xili Samuwa. Na fan baba xili Galali. Na fan baba xili Yedutun.

sentences.english: All the Levites in the holy town were two hundred and eighty-four.
sentences.susu: Lewika naxee nu sabatixi Darisalamu, Ala xa taa sɛniyɛnxi, e malanxi mixi kɛmɛ firin, mixi tongo solomasaxan nun naani.

sentences.english: In addition the door-keepers, Akkub, Talmon, and their brothers who kept watch at the doors, were a hundred and seventy-two.
sentences.susu: Naxee nu hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛe makantama, nee xilie nan yi ki: Akubu, Talamɔn, nun e ngaxakerenyie naxee nu naadɛe makantama. Nee malanxi mixi kɛmɛ, mixi tongo solofere nun firin.

sentences.english: And the rest of Israel, of the priests, the Levites, were in all the towns of Judah, every one in his heritage.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, nun Lewika naxee luxi, e tan sabatixi Yudaya taae nan kui e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: But the Nethinim were living in the Ophel; and Ziha and Gishpa were over the Nethinim.
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔbanxi walikɛe sabatixi Ofeli geya nan fari. Sixa nun Gisepa nan findi e xa mangɛe ra.

sentences.english: And the overseer of the Levites at Jerusalem was Uzzi, the son of Bani, the son of Hashabiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Mica, of the sons of Asaph, the music-makers, who was over the business of the house of God.
sentences.susu: Lewika naxee sabatixi Darisalamu, e xa mangɛ findixi Yusayi nan na. A baba xili Bani. Na fan baba xili Xasabiya. Na fan baba xili Mataniya. Na fan baba xili Mika. Na fan baba xili Asafi, naxan findixi bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ ra Ala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: For there was an order from the king about them and a regular amount for the music-makers, for their needs day by day.
sentences.susu: Bɛɛtiba birin nu na mangɛ xungbe xa yaamari nan bun ma lɔxɔɛ birin.

sentences.english: And Pethahiah, the son of Meshezabel, of the sons of Zerah, the son of Judah, was the king's servant in everything to do with the people.
sentences.susu: Petaxiya findixi mangɛ xa marasima nan na ɲama bɛ. A baba xili Mesesabeli. Na fan baba xili Sera. Na fan baba xili Yuda.

sentences.english: And for the daughter-towns with their fields, some of the men of Judah were living in Kiriath-arba and its daughter-towns, and in Dibon and its daughter-towns, and in Jekabzeel and its daughter-towns,
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛ mixie sabatixi Kiriyati Araba, Dibon, Yekabeseeli,

sentences.english: And in Jeshua, and in Moladah, and Beth-pelet,
sentences.susu: Yesuwa, Molada, Pɛlɛti,

sentences.english: And in Hazar-shual, and in Beer-sheba and its daughter-towns,
sentences.susu: Xasari, Beriseeba,

sentences.english: And in Ziklag, and in Meconah and its daughter-towns,
sentences.susu: Sikilaga, Mekona,

sentences.english: And in En-rimmon, and in Zorah, and in Jarmuth,
sentences.susu: Rimɔn, Soraha, Yaramuti,

sentences.english: Zanoah, Adullam and their daughter-towns, Lachish and its fields, Azekah and its daughter-towns. So they were living from Beer-sheba to the valley of Hinnom.
sentences.susu: Sanowa, Adulama, Lakisi, Aseka, e nun e rabilinyie. E naxa sabati fɔlɔfe Beriseeba ma sa dɔxɔ Hinoma gulunba ra.

sentences.english: And the children of Benjamin were living from Geba, at Michmash and Aija, and at Beth-el and its daughter-towns,
sentences.susu: Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ mixie sabatixi Geba, Mikimasi, Aya, Beteli, nun e rabilinyie nɛ.

sentences.english: At Anathoth, Nob, Ananiah,
sentences.susu: E man sabatixi Anatɔti, Noba, Ananaya,

sentences.english: Hazor, Ramah, Gittaim,
sentences.susu: Xasori, Rama, Gitayimi,

sentences.english: Hadid, Zeboim, Neballat,
sentences.susu: Xadidi, Seboyima, Nebalati,

sentences.english: Lod and Ono, the valley of expert workers.
sentences.susu: Lodi, Ono, nun se yailanmae xa gulunba fan kui.

sentences.english: And of the Levites, certain divisions in Judah were joined to Benjamin.
sentences.susu: Lewika ndee naxee kelixi Yudaya, nee naxa sabati Bunyamin bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Now these are the priests and the Levites who went up with Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, and Jeshua: Seraiah, Jeremiah, Ezra,
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae nan yi ki, naxee gbilen Darisalamu e nun Salatiyeli xa di Sorobabeli nun Yesuwa ra: Seraya, Yeremi, Esidirasi,

sentences.english: Amariah, Malluch, Hattush,
sentences.susu: Amaraya, Maluku, Xatusi,

sentences.english: Shecaniah, Rehum, Meremoth,
sentences.susu: Sɛkanaya, Rexumi, Meremoti,

sentences.english: Iddo, Ginnethoi, Abijah,
sentences.susu: Ido, Ginɛtɔn, Abiya,

sentences.english: Mijamin, Maadiah, Bilgah,
sentences.susu: Miyamin, Mowadiya, Biliga,

sentences.english: Shemaiah, and Joiarib, Jedaiah,
sentences.susu: Semaya, Yoyaribu, Yɛdaya,

sentences.english: Sallu, Amok, Hilkiah, Jedaiah. These were the chiefs of the priests and of their brothers in the days of Jeshua.
sentences.susu: Salu, Emɔki, Xilikiya, nun Yɛdaya. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nan na ki, nun e ngaxakerenyi naxee nu na Yesuwa xa waxati.

sentences.english: And the Levites: Jeshua, Binnui, Kadmiel, Sherebiah, Judah, and Mattaniah, who was over the music-makers, he and his brothers.
sentences.susu: Lewikae nan yi ki: Yesuwa, Binuwi, Kadamiyɛli, Serebiya, Yudaya, nun Mataniya. E nu findixi bɛɛtiba mangɛe nan na.

sentences.english: And Bakbukiah and Unno, their brothers, were opposite them in their watches.
sentences.susu: E ngaxakerenyie Bakibukiya nun Unni nu tima e ya ra na wali kui.

sentences.english: And Jeshua was the father of Joiakim, and Joiakim was the father of Eliashib, and Eliashib was the father of Joiada,
sentences.susu: Yesuwa findi nɛ Yoyakima baba ra. Yoyakima findi nɛ Eliyasibu baba ra. Eliyasibu findi nɛ Yoyada baba ra.

sentences.english: And Joiada was the father of Jonathan, and Jonathan was the father of Jaddua.
sentences.susu: Yoyada findi nɛ Yonatan baba ra. Yonatan findi nɛ Yaduwa baba ra.

sentences.english: And in the days of Joiakim there were priests, heads of families: of Seraiah, Meraiah; of Jeremiah, Hananiah;
sentences.susu: Yoyakima xa waxati, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xabilɛe nun e xunyie nan ya: Meraya nan findi Seraya xabilɛ xunyi ra. Xananiya nan findi Yeremi xabilɛ xunyi ra.

sentences.english: Of Ezra, Meshullam; of Amariah, Jehohanan;
sentences.susu: Mesulama nan findi Esidirasi xabilɛ xunyi ra. Yehoxanan nan findi Amaraya xabilɛ xunyi ra.

sentences.english: Of Malluchi, Jonathan; of Shebaniah, Joseph;
sentences.susu: Yonatan nan findi Maluku xabilɛ xunyi ra. Yusufu nan findi Sɛbanaya xabilɛ xunyi ra.

sentences.english: Of Harim, Adna; of Meraioth, Helkai;
sentences.susu: Adina nan findi Xarima xabilɛ xunyi ra. Xɛlɛkayi nan findi Merayoti xabilɛ xunyi ra.

sentences.english: Of Iddo, Zechariah; of Ginnethon, Meshullam;
sentences.susu: Sakari nan findi Ido xabilɛ xunyi ra. Mesulama nan findi Ginɛtɔn xabilɛ xunyi ra.

sentences.english: Of Abijah, Zichri; of Miniamin, of Moadiah, Piltai;
sentences.susu: Sikiri nan findi Abiya xabilɛ xunyi ra. Pilitayi nan findi Minyamin nun Mowadiya xabilɛ xunyi ra.

sentences.english: Of Bilgah, Shammua; of Shemaiah, Jehonathan;
sentences.susu: Samuwa nan findi Biliga xabilɛ xunyi ra. Yehonatan nan findi Semaya xabilɛ xunyi ra.

sentences.english: And of Joiarib, Mattenai; of Jedaiah, Uzzi;
sentences.susu: Matenayi nan findi Yoyaribu xabilɛ xunyi ra. Yusayi nan findi Yɛdaya xabilɛ xunyi ra.

sentences.english: Of Sallai, Kallai; of Amok, Eber;
sentences.susu: Kalayi nan findi Salayi xabilɛ xunyi ra. Eberi nan findi Emeki xabilɛ xunyi ra.

sentences.english: Of Hilkiah, Hashabiah; of Jedaiah, Nethanel.
sentences.susu: Xasabiya nan findi Xilikiya xabilɛ xunyi ra. Netaneeli nan findi Yɛdaya xabilɛ xunyi ra.

sentences.english: The Levites in the days of Eliashib, Joiada, and Johanan, and Jaddua, were listed as heads of families; and the priests, when Darius the Persian was king.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xilie nun Lewika denbaya kanyie xilie nu sɛbɛxi Eliyasibu, Yoyada, Yonatan, nun Yaduwa xa waxati, Perise mangɛ Dariyusi xa mangɛya bun ma.

sentences.english: The sons of Levi, heads of families, were recorded in the book of the histories, even till the days of Johanan, the son of Eliashib.
sentences.susu: Lewika denbaya kanyie xilie nu sɛbɛxi taruxui buki kui han Eliyasibu xa mamadi Yonatan xa waxati.

sentences.english: And the chiefs of the Levites: Hashabiah, Sherebiah, and Jeshua, the son of Kadmiel, with their brothers opposite them, to give blessing and praise as ordered by David, the man of God, watch against watch.
sentences.susu: Lewikae xa mangɛe Xasabiya, Serebiya, Kadamiyɛli xa di Yosuwe, nu Alatala matɔxɔma tɛmui naxɛ, e ngaxakerenyie nu tixi e ya i, alɔ Ala xa mixi Dawuda a yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Mattaniah, and Bakbukiah, Obadiah, Meshullam, Talmon, Akkub, were door-keepers keeping the watch at the store-houses of the doors.
sentences.susu: Mataniya, Bakibukiya, Abadiyasi, Mesulama, Talamɔn, nun Akubu nu hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛe kantama,

sentences.english: These were in the days of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua, the son of Jozadak, and in the days of Nehemiah the ruler and of Ezra the priest, the scribe.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe xa di Yoyakima xa waxati kui, Yosadaki xa mamadi. Na waxati Nehemi nan nu na gomina ra, Esidirasi nan nu na sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And when the time came for the wall of Jerusalem to be made holy, they sent for the Levites out of all their places to come to Jerusalem, to keep the feast with joy, and with praise and melody, with brass and corded instruments of music.
sentences.susu: Darisalamu tɛtɛ rabi, e xɛɛrae xɛɛ nɛ Lewikae birin ma Yudaya bɔxi ma, alako e xa fa Darisalamu ɲɛlɛxin xulunyi tide bɛɛtie ra, naxee bama maxa see nun kɔra mɔɔli ndee xui ra.

sentences.english: And the sons of the music-makers came together from the lowland round about Jerusalem and from the daughter-towns of the Netophathites,
sentences.susu: Bɛɛtibae naxa fa kelife Darisalamu fari ma, a nun Netofa fɔxɔɛe ra,

sentences.english: And from Beth-gilgal and from the fields of Geba and Azmaveth: for the music-makers had made daughter-towns for themselves round about Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Beti Giligali, Geba, nun Asamafeti.

sentences.english: And the priests and the Levites made themselves clean; and they made the people clean, and the doorways and the wall.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae naxa e yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn, e man naxa ɲama, nun taa naadɛe nun taa tɛtɛ fan nasɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: Then I made the rulers of Judah come up on the wall, and I put in position two great bands of them who gave praise, walking in ordered lines; one went to the right on the wall, in the direction of the doorway where the waste was put;
sentences.susu: N naxa Yudaya mangɛe rate tɛtɛ kɔn na. N man naxa bɛɛtiba ɲama firin sugandi. Ɲama singe xa ɲɛrɛ tɛtɛ kɔn na yirefanyi ma, Xuruse naadɛ mabiri.

sentences.english: And after them went Hoshaiah and half of the rulers of Judah,
sentences.susu: Hosaya nun Yudaya mangɛe sɛɛti naxa bira yi ɲama fɔxɔ ra,

sentences.english: And Azariah, Ezra, and Meshullam,
sentences.susu: e nun Asaraya, Esidirasi, Mesulama,

sentences.english: Judah and Benjamin and Shemaiah and Jeremiah,
sentences.susu: Yuda, Bunyamin, Seraya, Yeremi,

sentences.english: And certain of the priests' sons with wind instruments; Zechariah, the son of Jonathan, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Mattaniah, the son of Micaiah, the son of Zaccur, the son of Asaph,
sentences.susu: sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxee feri fema, Yonatan xa di Sakari, naxan benbae findixi Semaya, Mataniya, Mike, Sabudu, nun Asafi ra.

sentences.english: And his brothers, Shemaiah, and Azarel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Nethanel and Judah, Hanani, with the music-instruments of David, the man of God; and Ezra the scribe was at their head;
sentences.susu: Sakari ngaxakerenyie Semaya, Asarɛli, Milalayi, Gilalayi, Maayi, Netaneeli, Yuda, nun Xanani naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra. Dawuda xa bɛɛtibasee nu na e yi ra. Sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ Esidirasi nan nu na e xa yarerati ra.

sentences.english: And by the doorway of the fountain and straight in front of them, they went up by the steps of the town of David, at the slope up of the wall, over the house of David, as far as the water-doorway to the east.
sentences.susu: E to Dulonyi naadɛ li, e naxa te Dawuda xa taa kui tɛtɛ kɔn na. E naxa dangi Dawuda xa banxi ra han e sa Ye naadɛ li sogetede biri.

sentences.english: And the other band of those who gave praise went to the left, and I went after them with half the people, on the wall, over the tower of the ovens, as far as the wide wall;
sentences.susu: Na ɲama firin nde naxa siga kɔɔla ma. N naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra tɛtɛ kɔn na, muxu nun ɲama dɔnxɔɛ. Muxu naxa mini yire makantaxi ra naxan xili Taami Gande, muxu naxa siga han tɛtɛ igbode.

sentences.english: And over the doorway of Ephraim and by the old door and the fish door and the tower of Hananel and the tower of Hammeah, as far as the sheep door: and at the doorway of the watchmen they came to a stop.
sentences.susu: Muxu naxa mini Efirami naadɛ ra, Naadɛ Fori, Yɛxɛ naadɛ, Xananɛli yire makantaxi, Meya yire makantaxi, han muxu Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ naadɛ li. Muxu naxa ti Geeli naadɛ ya ra.

sentences.english: So the two bands of those who gave praise took up their positions in the house of God, and I and half of the chiefs with me:
sentences.susu: Na ɲama firinyi naxa ti Ala xa banxi kui. N tan nun kiitisae nu na, nun

sentences.english: And the priests; Eliakim, Maaseiah, Miniamin, Micaiah, Elioenai, Zechariah, and Hananiah, with wind instruments;
sentences.susu: sɛrɛxɛdubɛe Eliyakin, Maaseya, Minyamin, Mike, Eliyowenayi, Sakari, nun Xananiya. Ferie fan nu na e yi ra.

sentences.english: And Maaseiah and Shemaiah and Eleazar and Uzzi and Jehohanan and Malchijah and Elam and Ezer. And the makers of melody made their voices loud, with Jezrahiah their overseer.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe Maaseya, Semaya, Eleyasari, Usi, Yehoxanan, Malakiya, Elama, nun Eseri fan nu na. Yisiraxaya nan nu na bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And on that day they made great offerings and were glad; for God had made them glad with great joy; and the women and the children were glad with them: so that the joy of Jerusalem came to the ears of those who were far off.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa sɛrɛxɛ gbegbe ba sɛɛwɛ kui barima e Marigi Ala nu bara e rasɛɛwa. Ginɛe nun dimɛe fan nu sɛɛwaxi. Na ɲɛlɛxinyi xui naxa siga yire makuye.

sentences.english: And on that day certain men were put over the rooms where the things which had been given were stored, for the lifted offerings and the first-fruits and the tenths, and to take into them the amounts, from the fields of every town, fixed by the law for the priests and the Levites: for Judah was glad on account of the priests and the Levites who were in their places.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ muxu naxa xɛmɛe sugandi naxee bilie kantama, sɛrɛxɛ bogise singee nun farilɛ ragatama dɛnnaxɛ. Yi xɛmɛe lan nɛ e xa sansi bogi singee xun lan, naxee fixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae ma, kelife xɛe ma alɔ a sɛbɛxi kitaabui kui ki naxɛ. Yudayakae nu bara ɲɛlɛxin sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae xa wali ra.

sentences.english: And they kept the watch of their God, and were responsible for making things clean, and so did the music-makers and the door-keepers, as it was ordered by David and Solomon his son.
sentences.susu: E naxa e Marigi Ala xa wali raba a fan yi ra. E tan, bɛɛtibae, nun naadɛ makantɛe nu e rasɛniyɛnma alɔ Dawuda nun a xa di Sulemani a masenxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For in the days of David and Asaph in the past, there was a master of the music, and songs of blessing and praise to God.
sentences.susu: Dawuda nun Asafi xa waxati, bɛɛtiba mangɛe nu na naxee nu Ala matɔxɔma suukie nun tantuie ra.

sentences.english: And all Israel in the days of Zerubbabel and in the days of Nehemiah gave what was needed by the music-makers and the door-keepers day by day: and they made the offerings holy for the Levites; and the Levites did the same for the sons of Aaron.
sentences.susu: Sorobabeli nun Nehemi xa waxati, Isirayila birin nu baloe soma bɛɛtibae, naadɛ makantɛe, Lewikae, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, nun Haruna xa die yi ra lɔxɔɛ birin.

sentences.english: On that day there was a reading from the book of Moses in the hearing of the people; and they saw that it said in the book that no Ammonite or Moabite might ever come into the meeting of God;
sentences.susu: E nu na Tawureta Munsa xaranfe ɲama bɛ tɛmui naxɛ, e naxa yi sɛbɛli to, «Amonika nun Mowabaka mu daxa e xa so Ala xa mixie ya ma,

sentences.english: Because they did not give the children of Israel bread and water when they came to them, but got Balaam to put a curse on them: though the curse was turned into a blessing by our God.
sentences.susu: barima e mu fa taami nun ye ra Isirayilakae ralande e xa biyaasi kui, e kɔbiri fi Balami nan ma, a xa fa Isirayilakae danka. Kɔnɔ muxu Marigi Ala naxa na dankɛ mafindi barakɛ ra.»

sentences.english: So after hearing the law, they took out of Israel all the mixed people.
sentences.susu: E to na mɛ, e naxa si gbɛtɛ mixi birin keri Isirayilakae ya ma.

sentences.english: Now before this, Eliashib the priest, who had been placed over the rooms of the house of our God, being a friend of Tobiah,
sentences.susu: Beenu na xa raba, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Eliyasibu nan nu na bilie xunyi ra muxu Marigi Ala xa banxi kui. A bariboore nde nan nu lanxi Tobiya ma.

sentences.english: Had made ready for him a great room, where at one time they kept the meal offerings, the perfume, and the vessels and the tenths of the grain and wine and oil which were given by order to the Levites and the music-makers and the door-keepers, and the lifted offerings for the priests.
sentences.susu: A nu bara bili belebele so a yi ra yi se birin nagatama dɛnnaxɛ: mɛngi, surayi, hɔrɔmɔbanxi isee, mɛngi farilɛ, wɛni nɛɛnɛ, nun ture, naxee fima Lewikae, bɛɛtibae, nun naadɛ makantɛe ma.

sentences.english: But all this time I was not at Jerusalem: for in the thirty-second year of Artaxerxes, king of Babylon, I went to the king; and after some days, I got the king to let me go,
sentences.susu: Na birin naba tɛmui naxɛ, n mu nu na Darisalamu, barima n nu bara gbilen Babilɔn mangɛ Atasakasi yire, a xa mangɛya ɲɛ tongo saxan nun firin nde ra. Na ɲɛ to ɲɔn, mangɛ naxa tin

sentences.english: And I came to Jerusalem; and it was clear to me what evil Eliashib had done for Tobiah, in making ready for him a room in the buildings of the house of God.
sentences.susu: n bɛɲinde, n xa gbilen Darisalamu. N to naa li, n naxa Eliyasibu xa wali kobi to bili sofe ra Tobiya yi ra, Ala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: And it was evil in my eyes: so I had all Tobiah's things put out of the room.
sentences.susu: Na fe naxa n bɔɲɛ raɲaaxu n ma. N naxa Tobiya xa se birin woli tande.

sentences.english: Then I gave orders, and they made the rooms clean: and I put back in them the vessels of the house of God, with the meal offerings and the perfume.
sentences.susu: N naxa e yaamari e xa na bilie rasɛniyɛn, n fa Ala xa banxi see raso naa, alɔ sɛrɛxɛe nun surayi.

sentences.english: And I saw that the Levites had not been given what was needed for their support; so that the Levites and the music-makers, who did the work, had gone away, everyone to his field.
sentences.susu: N naxa a mɛ fan, se naxee lan e xa fi Lewikae ma, e mu nu na fixi e ma. Lewikae nun bɛɛtibae, naxee nu lanxi e xa Ala xa wali raba, nee nu bara siga e xa xɛe rawalide.

sentences.english: Then I made protests to the chiefs, and said, Why has the house of God been given up? And I got them together and put them in their places.
sentences.susu: N naxa sɔnxɔɛ rate kiitisae ma, n fa e maxɔrin, «Wo Ala xa banxi rabɛɲinxi munfe ra?» N naxa Lewikae nun bɛɛtibae malan, n fa e ragbilen e xa wali ra.

sentences.english: Then all Judah came with the tenth part of the grain and wine and oil and put it into the store-houses.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui kɔrɛ Yudayaka birin naxa fa mɛngi farilɛ, wɛni nɛɛnɛ, nun ture ra, a xa malan bilie kui.

sentences.english: And I made controllers over the store-houses, Shelemiah the priest and Zadok the scribe, and of the Levites, Pedaiah: and with them was Hanan, the son of Zaccur the son of Mattaniah: they were taken to be true men and their business was the distribution of these things to their brothers.
sentences.susu: N naxa Selemiya sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ti, a xa na bilie makanta, a nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ Sadɔki, Lewika Pɛdaya, Sabudu xa di Hanan, Mataniya xa mamadi. N na mixie sugandixi nɛ barima tinxin mixie nan nu na e ra. A nu lan nɛ e xa na see itaxun e ngaxakerenyie ma.

sentences.english: Keep me in mind, O my God, in connection with this, and do not let the good which I have done for the house of my God and its worship go from your memory completely.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, i naxa nɛɛmu n ma na xa fe ra. I xa ratu n ma, n wali tinxinxi naxan naba i xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi nun sali xa fe ra.

sentences.english: In those days, I saw in Judah some who were crushing grapes on the Sabbath, and getting in grain and putting it on asses; as well as wine and grapes and figs and all sorts of goods which they took into Jerusalem on the Sabbath day: and I gave witness against them on the day when they were marketing food.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n naxa Yudayaka ndee to wali kui malabui lɔxɔɛ. E sansi bogi bunduma, e mɛngi xabama, e a bakima sofale fari, e man wɛni bogi, wɛni, xɔrɛ, nun kote gbɛtɛ bakima, e a xanin Darisalamu malabui lɔxɔɛ, e xa a mati. N naxa na tɔnyi dɔxɔ e ma sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: And there were men of Tyre there, who came with fish and all sorts of goods, trading with the children of Judah and in Jerusalem on the Sabbath.
sentences.susu: Tireka naxee sabatixi Darisalamu, e fan nu fama nɛ yɛxɛe nun kote mɔɔli birin na Darisalamu, e xa a mati malabui lɔxɔɛ Yudayakae ma.

sentences.english: Then I made protests to the chiefs of Judah, and said to them, What is this evil which you are doing, not keeping the Sabbath day holy?
sentences.susu: N naxa sɔnxɔɛ rate Yudaya kuntigie ma yi ki, «Wo na munse rabafe? Wo na binyɛ nan bafe malabui lɔxɔɛ ma?

sentences.english: Did not your fathers do the same, and did not our God send all this evil on us and on this town? but you are causing more wrath to come on Israel by not keeping the Sabbath holy.
sentences.susu: Wo babae fan nu na nan nabama. Na nan a niyaxi won Marigi Ala naxa won ɲaxankata, a yi taa kana. Wo na a xa xɔnɛ xun masafe, barima wo mu malabui lɔxɔɛ binyaxi.»

sentences.english: And so, when the streets of Jerusalem were getting dark before the Sabbath, I gave orders for the doors to be shut and not to be open again till after the Sabbath: and I put some of my servants by the door so that nothing might be taken in on the Sabbath day.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n naxa yaamari fi, kɔɛ so tɛmui, beenu malabui lɔxɔɛ xa a li, Darisalamu naadɛe xa balan han malabui lɔxɔɛ xa ba a ra. N man naxa n ma walikɛ sɛgɛtala ndee dɔxɔ naadɛe ra, e naxa tin kote yo xa so malabui lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: So the traders in all sorts of goods took their night's rest outside Jerusalem once or twice.
sentences.susu: A bara sanya keren, xa na mu a ra firin li, yulɛe makiti sama Darisalamu fari ma, tɛtɛ sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Then I gave witness against them and said, Why are you waiting all night by the wall? if you do so again I will have you taken prisoners. From that time they did not come again on the Sabbath.
sentences.susu: N naxa na tɔnyi fan dɔxɔ e ma yi wɔyɛnyi ra, «Wo kɔɛ radangima tɛtɛ sɛɛti ma munfe ra? Xa wo na raba kɔrɛ, n bɛlɛxɛ wo lima nɛ.» Kafi na dangi, e mu fa malabui lɔxɔɛ sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And I gave the Levites orders to make themselves clean and come and keep the doors and make the Sabbath holy. Keep this in mind to my credit, O my God, and have mercy on me, for great is your mercy.
sentences.susu: N naxa a fala Lewikae bɛ, e xa e yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn, e xa fa naadɛe makantade, alako mixie xa malabui lɔxɔɛ binya. N Marigi Ala, i xa ratu n ma wali ma, i man xa n kanta i xa fonisireya kui.

sentences.english: And in those days I saw the Jews who were married to women of Ashdod and Ammon and Moab:
sentences.susu: Na waxati, n naxa Yuwifi ndee to naxee bara ginɛe dɔxɔ naxee keli Asidodi, Amoni, nun Mowaba bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And their children were talking half in the language of Ashdod; they had no knowledge of the Jews' language, but made use of the language of the two peoples.
sentences.susu: E xa di ndee nu Asidodi xui falama, xa na mu a ra si gbɛtɛ xui, e mu Yudaya xui falama.

sentences.english: And I took up the cause against them, cursing them and giving blows to some of them and pulling out their hair; and I made them take an oath by God, saying, You are not to give your daughters to their sons or take their daughters for your sons or for yourselves.
sentences.susu: N naxa na fan tɔnyi dɔxɔ e ma, n fa e danka. N naxa mixi ndee bɔnbɔ, n e xunsɛxɛ matala. N naxa fa e rakali Ala xili ra, «Wo naxa wo xa di ginɛe fi e xa di xɛmɛe ma, wo fan naxa e xa di ginɛe dɔxɔ wo yɛtɛ bɛ, xa na mu a ra wo xa die bɛ.

sentences.english: Was it not in these things that Solomon, king of Israel, did wrong? among a number of nations there was no king like him, and he was dear to his God, and God made him king over all Israel: but even he was made to do evil by strange women.
sentences.susu: Na fe xa mu a niyaxi Isirayila mangɛ Sulemani findixi yunubitɔɛ ra? A maniyɛ yo mu nu na duniɲa sie ya ma. Ala naxa a xanu, a man a findi Isirayila mangɛ ra. Kɔnɔ si gbɛtɛ ginɛe naxa a raso yunubi fe kui.

sentences.english: Are we then without protest to let you do all this great evil, sinning against our God by taking strange women for your wives?
sentences.susu: Wo fan wama na yunubi mɔɔli nan nabafe? Wo wama findife tinxintaree nan na won Marigi Ala bɛ, ginɛe futife ra si gbɛtɛe ya ma?»

sentences.english: And one of the sons of Joiada, the son of Eliashib, the chief priest, was son-in-law to Sanballat the Horonite: so I sent him away from me.
sentences.susu: Eliyasibu sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xa di Yoyada nan nu na Sanbalati Xoronka bitanyi ra. N naxa a rabolo.

sentences.english: Keep them in mind, O my God, because they have put shame on the priests' name and on the agreement of the priests and the Levites.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, i xa ratu n ma fe ma, barima e bara sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali manɔxɔ, e man bara sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae xa saatɛ kana.

sentences.english: So I made them clean from all strange people, and had regular watches fixed for the priests and for the Levites, everyone in his work;
sentences.susu: N naxa si gbɛtɛ mixi birin keri sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewikae ya ma, n naxa e ti e xa wali ra.

sentences.english: And for the wood offering, at fixed times, and for the first fruits. Keep me in mind, O my God, for good.
sentences.susu: N man naxa yege fi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ma sali tɛmui nun bɔxi daxamui singe sɛrɛxɛ ba tɛmui. N Marigi Ala, i xa ratu n ma fe ma i xa fonisireya kui.

sentences.english: Now it came about in the days of Ahasuerus, (that Ahasuerus who was ruler of a hundred and twenty-seven divisions of the kingdom, from India as far as Ethiopia:)
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nde nu na naxan nu xili Asuyerusu. A xa mangɛya fɔlɔ Inidiya bɔxi nan ma, han a sa dɔxɔ Etiyopi bɔxi ra. Bɔxi kɛmɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun solofere nan nu na a xa nɔɛ bun ma.

sentences.english: That in those days, when King Ahasuerus was ruling in Shushan, his strong town,
sentences.susu: Na waxati, a nu dɔxɔxi Suse nɛ, a xa mangataa.

sentences.english: In the third year of his rule he gave a feast to all his captains and his servants; and the captains of the army of Persia and Media, the great men and the rulers of the divisions of his kingdom, were present before him;
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya ɲɛ saxan nde, a naxa xulunyi ti a xa mangɛdie nun a xa walikɛe bɛ. Perise nun Mediya sɔɔri mangɛe, kuntigie, nun bɔxi gominae naxa fa.

sentences.english: And for a long time, even a hundred and eighty days, he let them see all the wealth and the glory of his kingdom and the great power and honour which were his.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Asuyerusu naxa a xa naafuli, nun a xa dariyɛ masen e bɛ xi kɛmɛ tongo solomasaxan bun ma.

sentences.english: And at the end of that time, the king gave a feast for all the people who were present in Shushan, the king's town, small as well as great, for seven days, in the outer square of the garden of the king's house.
sentences.susu: Na to dangi, mangɛ naxa xulunyi ti Suseka birin bɛ a xa tɛtɛ kui. Xi solofere bun ma, banna nun setare birin naxa fa na xulunyi.

sentences.english: There were fair hangings of white and green and blue, fixed with cords of purple and the best linen to silver rings and pillars of polished stone: the seats were of gold and silver on a floor of red and white and yellow and black stone.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ banxi naxa rafe ki fanyi ra. Dugi fiixɛe nun dugi fɔɔrɛe nu gbakuxi luuti fiixɛe nun luuti gbeelie ra. Dugie gbakuxi luutie ma gbeti xurundɛe ra. Na birin nu xirixi gɛmɛ dɔxɔxi tofanyie ra. Xɛɛma kibanyi nun gbeti kibanyi tofanyie nu na. Bɔxi gbaata nu yailanxi gɛmɛ tofanyi mɔɔli mɔɔlie ra.

sentences.english: And they gave them drink in gold vessels, every vessel being different, and wine of the kingdom, freely given by the king.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa wɛni gbegbe itaxun mixie ma, e xa na min xɛɛma pɔɔti mɔɔli wuyaxie kui.

sentences.english: And the drinking was in keeping with the law; no one was forced: for the king had given orders to all the chief servants of his house to do as was pleasing to every man.
sentences.susu: Wɛni xasabi naxan e kɛnɛn, e naxa na min, barima mangɛ nu bara a xa walikɛe yamari, e xa mixie waxɔnfe raba.

sentences.english: And Vashti the queen gave a feast for the women in the house of King Ahasuerus.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ ginɛ Fasati fan naxa xulunyi ti ginɛe bɛ mangɛ Asuyerusu xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: On the seventh day, when the heart of the king was glad with wine, he gave orders to Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, and Abagtha, Zethar, and Carcas, the seven unsexed servants who were waiting before Ahasuerus the king,
sentences.susu: Xulunyi xi solofere nde, mangɛ Asuyerusu to siisi wɛni ra, a naxa a xa batula solofere xili. Yi xɛmɛ solofere nu xili Mehuman, Bisita, Xarabona, Bigita, Abagita, Sɛtari, nun Karakasi.

sentences.english: That Vashti the queen was to come before him, crowned with her crown, and let the people and the captains see her: for she was very beautiful.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala e bɛ, e xa fa mangɛ ginɛ Fasati ra a xɔn ma. A xa a maxiri a fanyi ra, mangɛ ginɛ tɔnxuma xa dɔxɔ a xun ma, alako ɲama nun mangɛdi birin xa a xa tofanyi to. Ginɛ tofanyi nan nu na Fasati ra.

sentences.english: But when the servants gave her the king's order, Vashti the queen said she would not come: then the king was very angry, and his heart was burning with wrath.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mangɛ ginɛ Fasati naxa tondi mangɛ xa yaamari ra, xɛɛrae naxan masen a bɛ. Na naxa mangɛ xɔnɔ ki fanyi.

sentences.english: And the king said to the wise men, who had knowledge of the times, (for this was the king's way with all who were expert in law and in the giving of decisions:
sentences.susu: Awa, mangɛ naxa a xa lɔnnila solofere xili naxee nu sɛriyɛ nun naamunyi kolon a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And second only to him were Carshena, Shethar, Admatha, Tarshish, Meres, Marsena, and Memucan, the seven rulers of Persia and Media, who were friends of the king, and had the first places in the kingdom:)
sentences.susu: Yi mangɛdi solofere nan ya: Kasɛna, Sɛtara, Adamata, Tarasisi, Mɛrɛsi, Marasena, nun Memukan. Yi Mediyakae nun Perisekae tide nu gbo birin bɛ, barima e tan nan nu na mangɛ sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: What is to be done by law to Vashti the queen, because she has not done what King Ahasuerus, by his servants, gave her orders to do?
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa e maxɔrin, «N tan mangɛ Asuyerusu bara xɛɛrae rasiga mangɛ ginɛ Fasati ma a xa fa, kɔnɔ a bara tondi n ma yaamari suxude. Sɛriyɛ ki ma, a lanma n xa munse raba a ra?»

sentences.english: And before the king and the captains, Memucan gave his answer: Vashti the queen has done wrong, not only to the king, but to all the captains and to all the peoples in all the divisions of the kingdom of King Ahasuerus;
sentences.susu: Memukan naxa a masen mangɛ nun mangɛdie bɛ, «Mangɛ ginɛ Fasati mu fe ɲaaxi rabaxi i tan mangɛ gbansan xa ra, a man bara fe ɲaaxi raba mangɛdie nun ɲamae ra naxee na i xa mangɛya bun ma.

sentences.english: For news of what the queen has done will come to the ears of all women, and they will no longer give respect to their husbands when it is said to them, King Ahasuerus gave orders for Vashti the queen to come before him and she came not.
sentences.susu: Ginɛe na a mɛ tɛmui naxɛ, mangɛ ginɛ bara a xa mɔri matandi, bɔxi ginɛe birin fan luma nɛ e xa mɔrie matandi ra. Ginɛe a falama nɛ, ‹Mangɛ Asuyerusu xɛɛra rasiga nɛ mangɛ ginɛ Fasati ma a xa fa, kɔnɔ a mu tin.›

sentences.english: And the wives of the captains of Persia and Media, hearing what the queen has done, will say the same to all the king's captains. So there will be much shame and wrath.
sentences.susu: Perise nun Mediya mangɛdie xa ginɛe na yi fe mɛ tɛmui naxɛ, e fan tondima nɛ e xa mɔrie binyade. Na na raba maraɲaaxui nun binyatareɲa mu ɲɔnma.

sentences.english: If it is pleasing to the king, let an order go out from him, and let it be recorded among the laws of the Persians and the Medes, so that it may never be changed, that Vashti is never again to come before King Ahasuerus; and let the king give her place to another who is better than she.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ, xa i bara tin, a lanma i xa mangɛ ginɛ Fasati yamari a naxa fa i yire sɔnɔn. Ginɛ gbɛtɛ tongo naxan fisa a bɛ, na xa findi mangɛ ginɛ ra. Na yaamari xa sɛbɛ Perisekae nun Mediyakae xa sɛriyɛ kui, naxan mu nɔma masarade.

sentences.english: And when this order, given by the king, is made public through all his kingdom (for it is great), all the wives will give honour to their husbands, great as well as small.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ birin na yi yaamari xungbe mɛ i xa mangɛya bun ma, e fama nɛ e xa mɔrie binyade ki fanyi ra, kelife ginɛ xuri ma, han ginɛ xungbe.»

sentences.english: And this suggestion seemed good to the king and the captains; and the king did as Memucan said;
sentences.susu: Na marasi naxa rafan mangɛ nun mangɛdie ma. Asuyerusu naxa a raba alɔ Memukan a fala ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And sent letters to all the divisions of the kingdom, to every division in the writing commonly used there, and to every people in the language which was theirs, saying that every man was to be the ruler in his house, and that this order was to be given out in the language of his people.
sentences.susu: A naxa bataaxɛe rasanba a xa bɔxi birin ma e gbe sɛbɛli ra nun e yɛtɛ bari xui ra. Na kɛɛdi naxɛ a xɛmɛ birin xa findi denbaya xunyi ra, a nun a xa denbaya mixi birin xa a bari xui fala.

sentences.english: After these things, when the king's feelings were calmer, the thought of Vashti and what she had done and the order he had made against her, came back to his mind.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, mangɛ bɔɲɛ naxa goro. A naxa ratu mangɛ ginɛ Fasati xa fe rabaxi ma, a nun a yɛtɛ natɛ naxan tongoxi a xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Then the servants who were waiting on the king said to him, Let search be made for some fair young virgins for the king:
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa batulae naxa a fala a bɛ, «Ginɛdimɛdi tofanyi ndee xa fen i bɛ.

sentences.english: Let the king give authority to certain men in all the divisions of his kingdom, to get together all the fair young virgins and send them to Shushan, the king's town, to the women's house, under the care of Hegai, the king's servant, the keeper of the women: and let the things needed for making them clean be given to them;
sentences.susu: Yaamari fi i xa bɔxi birin ma, e xa fa ginɛdimɛdi tofanyie birin na i xa mangataa Suse. E xa lu i xa ginɛe xa banxi kui. Hege, i xa walikɛ banaxi naxan mɛɛnima i xa ginɛe ma, na xa a ɲɛngi sa e xɔn ma, alako nde xa sa e xa tofanyi xun ma.

sentences.english: And let the girl who is pleasing to the king be queen in place of Vashti. And the king was pleased with this suggestion; and he did so.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxan na rafan i ma e ya ma, na xa findi mangɛ ginɛ Fasati ɲɔxɔɛ ra.» Yi wɔyɛnyi naxa mangɛ kɛnɛn, a naxa na raba.

sentences.english: Now there was a certain Jew in Shushan named Mordecai, the son of Jair, the son of Shimei, the son of Kish, a Benjamite;
sentences.susu: Yuwifi nde nu na Suse naxan nu xili Morodekayi. A findi Yayiri xa di nan na, Simeyi xa mamadi, Kisu tolobitɛ kelife Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ ma.

sentences.english: Who had been taken away from Jerusalem among those who had been made prisoner with Jeconiah, king of Judah, when Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, had taken him away.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari nan fa a ra konyiya kui, a nun Yudaya mangɛ Yekoniya nun Isirayilaka gbɛtɛe.

sentences.english: And he had been a father to Hadassah, that is Esther, the daughter of his father's brother: for she had no father or mother, and she was very beautiful; and when her father and mother were dead, Mordecai took her for his daughter.
sentences.susu: Morodekayi baba xunya xa di ginɛ Hadasa, e nu naxan ma Esita, a nu na Morodekayi nan yi ra, kabi a baba nun a nga faxa tɛmui. A naxa a xuru, a a findi a xa di ra. Ginɛdimɛdi tofanyi nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: So when the order made by the king was publicly given out, and a number of girls had been placed in the care of Hegai in the king's house in Shushan, Esther was taken into the king's house and put in the care of Hegai, the keeper of the women.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa yaamari to masen a xa bɔxi mixie bɛ, e naxa fa di ginɛ wuyaxi ra Hege xɔn ma Suse. Esita nu na e ya ma.

sentences.english: And he was pleased with the girl and was kind to her; and he quickly gave her what was needed for making her clean, and the things which were hers by right, and seven servant-girls who were to be hers from the king's house: and he had her and her servant-girls moved to the best place in the women's part of the house.
sentences.susu: A to rafan Hege ma, Hege naxa fate ratofan ture, donse fanyi, nun konyi ginɛ solofere so a yi ra. A naxa e yigiya mangɛ xa ginɛe xa banxi kui dɛnnaxɛ fan yire birin bɛ.

sentences.english: Esther had not said what family or people she came from, for Mordecai had given her orders not to do so.
sentences.susu: Esita nu fatanxi bɔnsɔɛ nun si naxan na, a mu na masen mixi yo bɛ, barima Morodekayi nu bara na tɔnyi dɔxɔ a ma.

sentences.english: And every day Mordecai took his walk before the square of the women's house, to see how Esther was and what would be done to her.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ birin Morodekayi nu a makɔrɛma mangɛ xa ginɛe xa banxi ra, a xa Esita xa fe xibaarui kolon.

sentences.english: Now every girl, when her turn came, had to go in to King Ahasuerus, after undergoing, for a space of twelve months, what was ordered by the law for the women (for this was the time necessary for making them clean, that is, six months with oil of myrrh and six months with sweet perfumes and such things as are needed for making women clean):
sentences.susu: Na ginɛe birin naxa kike fu nun firin naba mangɛ xa ginɛe xa banxi kui. Kike senni bun ma, ture nun labundɛ mɔɔli ndee nu masoma e ma. Na dangi xanbi, ture nun labundɛ mɔɔli gbɛtɛe nu masoma e ma. Na ɲɛ keren to kamali, ginɛe naxa nɔ e yɛtɛ masende mangɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: And in this way the girl went in to the king; whatever she had a desire for was given to her to take with her from the women's house into the house of the king.
sentences.susu: Ginɛe nɛ sigama mangɛ xɔn ma, e wa sese xaninfe e xun ma, e nu na soma nɛ e yi ra.

sentences.english: In the evening she went, and on the day after she came back to the second house of the women, into the keeping of Shaashgaz, one of the king's unsexed servants who had the care of the king's wives: only if the king had delight in her and sent for her by name did she go in to him again.
sentences.susu: Ginɛe nu soma mangɛ xɔnyi nunmare tɛmui nɛ, e fa gbilen mangɛ xa ginɛe xa banxi firin nde kui. Mɛnni mangɛ xa konyi banaxi Saasagasi nu mɛɛnima e ma. Na xanbi e mu gbilenma mangɛ xɔnyi, fo naxan na a kɛnɛn e ya ma, a na xili.

sentences.english: Now when the time came for Esther, the daughter of Abihail, his father's brother, whom Mordecai had taken as his daughter, to go in to the king, she made request for nothing but what Hegai, the king's servant and keeper of the women, had given her. And Esther was looked on kindly by all who saw her.
sentences.susu: Abixayili xa di Esita, Morodekayi naxan xuruxi, na xa tɛmui to a li sigafe ra mangɛ xɔnyi, a mu sese xanin a xun ma fo mangɛ xa walikɛ Hege naxan fala a bɛ. Esita nu rafan mixi birin ma.

sentences.english: So Esther was taken in to King Ahasuerus in his house in the tenth month, which is the month Tebeth, in the seventh year of his rule.
sentences.susu: E naxa Esita raso mangɛ Asuyerusu xun ma a xa mangɛya ɲɛ solofere nde ra, Tebeti kike fu nde ra.

sentences.english: And Esther was more pleasing to the king than all the women, and to his eyes she was fairer and more full of grace than all the other virgins: so he put his crown on her head and made her queen in place of Vashti.
sentences.susu: Esita naxa rafan mangɛ ma dangi ginɛe birin na. A xa xanunteya to lu mangɛ bɔɲɛ kui dangi ginɛdimɛdie birin na, a naxa a findi mangɛ ginɛ Fasati ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then the king gave a great feast for all his captains and his servants, even Esther's feast; and he gave orders through all the divisions of his kingdom for a day of rest from work, and gave wealth from his store.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa xulunyi belebele ti Esita bɛ, a a xa kuntigie nun a xa walikɛe birin xili. A na lɔxɔɛ findi malabui lɔxɔɛ ra a xa ɲama bɛ, a e birin buɲa mangɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: And when the virgins came together in the second house of the women, Mordecai took his seat in the doorway of the king's house.
sentences.susu: Ginɛdimɛdie to malan sanya firin nde ra, Morodekayi nu dɔxɔxi mangɛ xa banxi naadɛ ra.

sentences.english: Esther had still said nothing of her family or her people, as Mordecai had given her orders; for Esther did what Mordecai said, as when she was living with him.
sentences.susu: Esita mu nu a bɔnsɔɛ nun a xa mixie xa fe falaxi mixi yo bɛ, alɔ Morodekayi nu bara a yamari ki naxɛ. Esita nu luma a xui suxu ra, alɔ a darixi a ra ki naxɛ kabi a dimɛdi tɛmui.

sentences.english: In those days, while Mordecai was seated at the king's doorway, two of the king's servants, Bigthan and Teresh, keepers of the door, being angry, were looking for a chance to make an attack on King Ahasuerus.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde Morodekayi nu dɔxɔxi mangɛ xa banxi naadɛ sɛɛti ma. Bigitana nun Tɛrɛsi, naxee nu na mangɛ xa banxi sode dɛ makantafe, e naxa xɔnɔ mangɛ Asuyerusu ma, e fa natɛ tongo e xa a faxa.

sentences.english: And Mordecai, having knowledge of their purpose, sent word of it to Esther the queen; and Esther gave the news to the king in Mordecai's name.
sentences.susu: Morodekayi to na mɛ, a naxa a fala mangɛ ginɛ Esita bɛ, alako a xa na masen mangɛ bɛ a xili ra.

sentences.english: And when the thing had been looked into, it was seen to be true, and the two of them were put to death by hanging on a tree: and it was put down in the records before the king.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ to na fe xɔn nafen, a naxa a kolon nɔndi na a ra. A naxa na xɛmɛ firinyie gbaku wuri ma e faxafe ra. Na birin naxa sɛbɛ taruxui buki kui mangɛ ya xɔri.

sentences.english: After these things, by the order of the king, Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, was lifted up and given a position of honour and a higher place than all the other captains who were with him.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, mangɛ Asuyerusu naxa Hamɛdata Agagaka xa di Haman binya, a a ti mangɛdie birin xun ma.

sentences.english: And all the king's servants who were in the king's house went down to the earth before Haman and gave him honour: for so the king had given orders. But Mordecai did not go down before him or give him honour.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa mixie birin nu e xinbi sinma Haman bun ma, alɔ mangɛ e yamari ki naxɛ. Kɔnɔ Morodekayi tan nu tondima nɛ a xinbi sinde a bun ma, a man mu a felenma a bɛ bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Then the king's servants who were in the king's house said to Mordecai, Why do you go against the king's order?
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa mixie naxa Morodekayi maxɔrin, «I mangɛ xa yaamari matandima munfe ra?»

sentences.english: Now when they had said this to him day after day and he gave no attention, they let Haman have news of it, to see if Mordecai's behaviour would be overlooked: for he had said to them that he was a Jew.
sentences.susu: E nu luma Morodekayi maxɔrin na na fe ma, kɔnɔ a mu a tuli matima e ra. Sa na fari, a nu bara a fala e bɛ a Yuwifi na a ra. Na tɛmui, e naxa na dɛntɛgɛ Haman bɛ, e xa a mato a naxan nabama.

sentences.english: And when Haman saw that Mordecai did not go down before him and give him honour, Haman was full of wrath.
sentences.susu: Haman to a to Morodekayi mu tinma a xinbi sinde a bun ma, a naxa xɔnɔ ki fanyi.

sentences.english: But it was not enough for him to make an attack on Mordecai only; for they had made clear to him who Mordecai's people were; so Haman made it his purpose to put an end to all the Jews, even Mordecai's people, through all the kingdom of Ahasuerus.
sentences.susu: A to a kolon, Yuwifi nan Morodekayi ra, a mu tin a tan gbansan xa tɔɔrɔ de fa. A nu wama a xa mixi birin nan nahalakife fa, Yuwifi naxee birin nu na Asuyerusu xa mangɛya bun ma.

sentences.english: In the first month, the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus, from day to day and from month to month they went on looking for a sign given by Pur (that is chance) before Haman, till the sign came out for the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month Adar.
sentences.susu: Awa, mangɛ Asuyerusu xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun firin nde, kike singe, naxan xili Nisan, Haman naxa sematoe maxɔrin, a xa a kolon a lanma a xa Yuwifie faxa kike nun lɔxɔɛ naxan ma. Sematoe naxa a to na lanxi kike fu nun firin nde nan ma, naxan xili Adari.

sentences.english: And Haman said to King Ahasuerus, There is a certain nation living here and there in small groups among the people in all the divisions of your kingdom; their laws are different from those of any other nation, and they do not keep the king's laws: for this reason it is not right for the king to let them be.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Haman naxa a masen mangɛ Asuyerusu bɛ, «Si nde na i xa ɲama ya ma, naxan yensenxi i xa mangɛya yire birin. E xa sɛriyɛ mu luxi alɔ si gbɛtɛe xa sɛriyɛ, barima e tondima i xa yaamarie yati suxude. A mu lanma e xa sabati i xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: If it is the king's pleasure, let a statement ordering their destruction be put in writing: and I will give to those responsible for the king's business, ten thousand talents of silver for the king's store-house.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ, xa i tinxi, yaamari fi e xa halaki. N tan yati bara tin kɔbiri gbeti kole wulu fu fide i xa mixie ma naxee yi wali rakamalima.»

sentences.english: And the king took his ring from his hand and gave it to Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, the hater of the Jews.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a xa tɔnxuma ba a bɛlɛxɛsole ra, a naxa a so Hamɛdata xa di Haman yi ra, na Agagaka naxan nu findixi Yuwifie yaxui ra.

sentences.english: And the king said to Haman, The money is yours, and the people, to do with them whatever seems right to you.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xa i xa kɔbiri ragata. I man xa i waxɔnfe raba yi mixie ra.»

sentences.english: Then on the thirteenth day of the first month, the king's scribes were sent for, and they put in writing Haman's orders to all the king's captains and the rulers of every division of his kingdom and the chiefs of every people: for every division of the kingdom in the writing commonly used there, and to every people in the language which was theirs; it was signed in the name of King Ahasuerus and stamped with the king's ring.
sentences.susu: Na kike singe, xi fu nun saxan nde, Haman naxa mangɛ xa sɛbɛlitie malan, e xa a xa yaamari sɛbɛ mangɛ rasimae, bɔxi gominae, nun si birin mangɛdie ma. Bataaxɛe naxa sɛbɛ si birin xa sɛbɛli ki ma nun si birin bari xui ra. E naxa nee sɛbɛ mangɛ Asuyerusu xili ra. E man naxa mangɛ xa tɔnxuma fɔxi sa na kɛɛdie ma.

sentences.english: And letters were sent by the runners into every division of the kingdom ordering the death and destruction of all Jews, young and old, little children and women, on the same day, even the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month Adar, and the taking of all their goods by force.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛrae naxa siga na kɛɛdie ra mangataa yire birin ma. A nu sɛbɛxi kɛɛdie kui, kike fu nun firin nde, kike naxan xili Adari, na xi fu nun saxan nde, Yuwifi birin xa faxa, dimɛdi yo, fori yo, diyɔrɛ yo, ginɛ yo. E sɔtɔse birin xa lu mixi gbɛtɛe bɛ. Yi birin xa raba na lɔxɔɛ nɛ.

sentences.english: A copy of the writing, to be made public in every part of the kingdom, was sent out to all the peoples, so that they might be ready when that day came.
sentences.susu: A nu lan nɛ yi yaamari xa fi mixi birin ma, alako e xa nɔ na rabade na lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: The runners went out quickly by the king's order, and a public statement was made in Shushan: and the king and Haman took wine together: but the town of Shushan was troubled.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa xɛɛrae naxa siga e gi ra alɔ mangɛ a fala ki naxɛ. Asuyerusu nun Haman naxa lu yire keren e xa wɛni min, kɔnɔ mixi naxee nu na Suse mangataa, e birin bɔɲɛ naxa mini a i.

sentences.english: Now when Mordecai saw what was done, pulling off his robe, he put on haircloth, with dust on his head, and went out into the middle of the town, crying out with a loud and bitter cry.
sentences.susu: Morodekayi to yi fe birin mɛ, a naxa a xa dugi ibɔɔ a ma, a sunnun donma ragoro a ma, a tɛ xube maso a fate ma, a mini taa kui a wama a xui itexi ra.

sentences.english: And he came even before the king's doorway; for no one might come inside the king's door clothed in haircloth.
sentences.susu: A naxa siga han mangɛ xɔnyi, kɔnɔ a mu nɔ sode, barima sunnun donma kanyi mu daxa sofe naa.

sentences.english: And in every part of the kingdom, wherever the king's word and his order came, there was great sorrow among the Jews, and weeping and crying and going without food; and numbers of them were stretched on the earth covered with dust and haircloth.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa yaamari to so taa birin kui, Yuwifie naxa wa e xui itexi ra sunnunyi kui. E naxa sunnun donma ragoro e ma, e tɛ xube maso e fate ma. E naxa na birin naba sunyi kui.

sentences.english: And Esther's women and her servants came and gave her word of it. Then great was the grief of the queen: and she sent robes for Mordecai, so that his clothing of haircloth might be taken off; but he would not have them.
sentences.susu: Esita xa konyi ginɛe nun xɛmɛ banaxi naxee nu mɛɛnima a ma, e to Morodekayi xa fe fala Esita bɛ, sunnunyi naxa a bɔɲɛ suxu a ɲaaxi ra. A naxa dugi nde rasanba Morodekayi ma, kɔnɔ a mu tin a xa sunnun donma ratede a ma.

sentences.english: Then Esther sent for Hathach, one of the king's unsexed servants whom he had given her for waiting on her, and she gave him orders to go to Mordecai and see what this was and why it was.
sentences.susu: Esita naxa Hataki xili, xɛmɛ banaxi mangɛ naxan yamari a xa mɛɛni Esita ma. A naxa a xɛɛ Morodekayi xɔn ma, alako a xa a kolon a sunnunxi fe naxan ma.

sentences.english: So Hathach went out and saw Mordecai in the open square of the town before the king's doorway.
sentences.susu: Hataki naxa sa Morodekayi li taa kui mangɛ xa banxi sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Mordecai gave him an account of what had taken place, and of the amount of money which Haman had said he would put into the king's store for the destruction of the Jews.
sentences.susu: Haman naxan naba, a nun a kɔbiri xasabi naxan laayidi mangɛ bɛ Yuwifie faxafe ra, Morodekayi naxa na birin dɛntɛgɛ Hataki bɛ.

sentences.english: And he gave him the copy of the order which had been given out in Shushan for their destruction, ordering him to let Esther see it, and to make it clear to her; and to say to her that she was to go in to the king, requesting his mercy, and making prayer for her people.
sentences.susu: A naxa na bataaxɛ masen a bɛ naxan xaranxi Suse taa kui Yuwifie faxafe xa fe ra. Morodekayi naxa a fala a bɛ a xa na kɛɛdi so Esita yi ra, a man xa dɛntɛgɛ sa a bɛ. A nu wama nɛ Esita xa mangɛ mayandi Yuwifie bɛ, alako a bɔnsɔɛ naxa tɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: And Hathach came back and gave Esther an account of what Mordecai had said.
sentences.susu: Hataki naxa gbilen Esita yire, a naxa Morodekayi xa masenyi birin tagi raba a bɛ.

sentences.english: Then Esther sent Hathach to say to Mordecai:
sentences.susu: Esita to na mɛ, a man naxa Hataki xɛɛ Morodekayi xɔn ma, a xa sa yi fala a bɛ,

sentences.english: It is common knowledge among all the king's servants and the people of every part of the kingdom, that if anyone, man or woman, comes to the king in his inner room without being sent for, there is only one law for him, that he is to be put to death; only those to whom the king's rod of gold is stretched out may keep their lives: but I have not been sent for to come before the king these thirty days.
sentences.susu: «Mangɛ xa walikɛe nun a xa mixi birin a kolon ginɛ yo, xɛmɛ yo naxan sigama mangɛ yire beenu mangɛ xa a xili, na kanyi lanma sɛriyɛ ki ma a xa faxa. Xa mangɛ sa tin, a a xa sawuri xɛɛma daaxi itala a bɛ, a nɔma diɲɛde na kanyi ma. Kɔnɔ a xi tongo saxan nan ya, mangɛ mu n xili!»

sentences.english: And they said these words to Mordecai.
