sentences.english: One is so near to the other that no air may come between them.
sentences.susu: A kanke luxi alɔ gɛmɛ xungbe.

sentences.english: They take a grip of one another; they are joined together, so that they may not be parted.
sentences.susu: A na ti, limaniya bama nɛ sɛnbɛmae yi ra, e sɛrɛn, e e gi.

sentences.english: His sneezings give out flames, and his eyes are like the eyes of the dawn.
sentences.susu: Santidɛgɛma na din a ra, a mu a xabama. Tanbɛ mɔɔli yo mu na naxan nɔma a sɔxɔde.

sentences.english: Out of his mouth go burning lights, and flames of fire are jumping up.
sentences.susu: Wure luxi nɛ a bɛ alɔ sɛxɛ, yɔxui lu a bɛ alɔ wuri bɔrɔxi.

sentences.english: Smoke comes out of his nose, like a pot boiling on the fire.
sentences.susu: A mu gaaxuma tanbɛe ya ra, laati kuni luma a bɛ alɔ maale lagi.

sentences.english: His breath puts fire to coals, and a flame goes out of his mouth.
sentences.susu: Gbendegela luma a bɛ alɔ sɛxɛ, tanbɛ xungbe mayele a bɛ.

sentences.english: Strength is in his neck, and fear goes dancing before him.
sentences.susu: Bɛlɛ xɛɲɛnxi nde nun tunbee na a furi bunyi, nee luma boora tirindin na nɛ alɔ sari to yire buxama.

sentences.english: The plates of his flesh are joined together, fixed, and not to be moved.
sentences.susu: A baa ixufuxufuma alɔ ye nɛ satunma, a dabonyi lu alɔ ture nɛ satunma.

sentences.english: His heart is as strong as a stone, hard as the lower crushing-stone.
sentences.susu: A na a ɲɛrɛ ye xɔɔra, mɔrɔnyi fiixɛ nan luma te ra a xanbi ra.

sentences.english: When he gets ready for the fight, the strong are overcome with fear.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ yo mu a bɛ duniɲa, a daaxi nɛ, gaaxui yo mu a yi.

sentences.english: The sword may come near him but is not able to go through him; the spear, or the arrow, or the sharp-pointed iron.
sentences.susu: A a ya ragoroma nɛ daalise yɛtɛ igboe ma, a findixi subee birin ma mangɛ nan na.»

sentences.english: And Job said in answer to the Lord,
sentences.susu: Ayuba naxa Alatala yaabi,

sentences.english: I see that you are able to do every thing, and to give effect to all your designs.
sentences.susu: «N bara a kolon i nɔma fe birin na, sese mu nɔma i ɲanige kanade.

sentences.english: Who is this who makes dark the purpose of God by words without knowledge? For I have been talking without knowledge about wonders not to be searched out.
sentences.susu: I a masen nɛ i xa masenyi kui, ‹Nde na n ma walie ya isofe a xa xaxilitare wɔyɛnyie ra?› I nɔndi, n bara wɔyɛn a xaxilitare daaxi, n mu nu i xa kaabanakoe fahaamuxi. I xa fe rabaxie gbo n xunyi bɛ.

sentences.english: Give ear to me, and I will say what is in my mind; I will put questions to you, and you will give me the answers.
sentences.susu: I man a masen nɛ, ‹I tuli mati n na, n xa wɔyɛn. N xa maxɔrinyi ndee ti i ma, i xa n yaabi.›

sentences.english: Word of you had come to my ears, but now my eye has seen you.
sentences.susu: A singe n nu i xa fe ifalɛ nan mɛma, kɔnɔ yakɔsi, n bara so na fe kui.

sentences.english: For this cause I give witness that what I said is false, and in sorrow I take my seat in the dust.
sentences.susu: N a kolonxi na nan ma n naxan nabaxi a mu fan. N bara tuubi, n bara n magoro bɛndɛ, n tɛ xube maso n ma sunnunyi kui.»

sentences.english: And it came about, after he had said these words to Job, that the Lord said to Eliphaz the Temanite, I am very angry with you and your two friends, because you have not said what is right about me, as my servant Job has.
sentences.susu: Alatala to gɛ a xa masenyi tide Ayuba bɛ, a naxa a masen Elifasi Temanka bɛ, «N bara xɔnɔ i tan nun i boore firinyie ma, barima wo mu nɔndi falaxi n ma fe ra, alɔ n ma konyi Ayuba a rabaxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And now, take seven oxen and seven sheep, and go to my servant Job, and give a burned offering for yourselves, and my servant Job will make prayer for you, that I may not send punishment on you; because you have not said what is right about me, as my servant Job has.
sentences.susu: Na kui wo ninge nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi solofere ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra wo yɛtɛ bɛ. Wo sa Ayuba fen, a xa duba wo bɛ. Wo mu nɔndi falaxi n ma fe ra alɔ Ayuba a rabaxi ki naxɛ, kɔnɔ n mu wo ɲaxankatama wo xa daxuɲa ma Ayuba xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And Eliphaz the Temanite, and Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite, went and did as the Lord had said. And the Lord gave ear to Job.
sentences.susu: Elifasi Temanka, Bilidada Suuxaka, nun Sofara Naamaka naxa fe birin naba alɔ Alatala a yamari e ra ki naxɛ. Alatala naxa Ayuba xa dubɛ suxu.

sentences.english: And the Lord made up to Job for all his losses, after he had made prayer for his friends: and all Job had before was increased by the Lord twice as much.
sentences.susu: Ayuba to gɛ dubade a booree bɛ, Alatala naxa a harige birin nagbilen a ma. A man naxa na harige xun masa dɔxɔ firin dangife a singe ra.

sentences.english: And all his brothers and sisters, and his friends of earlier days, came and took food with him in his house; and made clear their grief for him, and gave him comfort for all the evil which the Lord had sent on him; and they all gave him a bit of money and a gold ring.
sentences.susu: Ayuba xunyae nun a taarae nun a kolonma birin naxa fa a xɛɛbude a xɔnyi, e e dɛge yire keren. E naxa a nu tɔɔrɔ sa, e a kunfa ba tɔɔrɛ xa fe ra Alatala nu bara naxan dɔxɔ a ma. Kankan naxa kɔbiri kole keren nun xurundɛ xɛɛma daaxi keren fi a ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord's blessing was greater on the end of Job's life than on its start: and so he came to have fourteen thousand sheep and goats, and six thousand camels, and two thousand oxen, and a thousand she-asses.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa barakɛ sa Ayuba dangife a singe ra. A naxa yɛxɛɛ wulu fu nun naani sɔtɔ, ɲɔxɔmɛ wulu senni, ninge wulu keren, nun sofale wulu keren.

sentences.english: And he had seven sons and three daughters.
sentences.susu: A naxa di xɛmɛ solofere nun di ginɛ saxan sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And he gave the first the name of Jemimah, the second Keziah, and the third Keren-happuch;
sentences.susu: A xa di ginɛ singe nu xili nɛ Yemima, a firin nde Kesiya, a saxan nde Kerenapuku.

sentences.english: And there were no women so beautiful as the daughters of Job in all the earth: and their father gave them a heritage among their brothers.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ yo mu nu na na bɔxi ma naxan nu tofan Ayuba xa die bɛ. E baba naxa kɛ fi e fan ma, alɔ a rabaxi ki naxɛ e maaxɛmɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: And after this Job had a hundred and forty years of life, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, even four generations.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, ɲɛ kɛmɛ ɲɛ tongo naani naxa sa Ayuba xa simaya xun ma. A naxa a xa die to, a xa mamadie, a tolobitɛe, nun a tolontolonyie.

sentences.english: And Job came to his end, old and full of days.
sentences.susu: Ayuba xa simaya kamalixi nɛ a fanyi ra, a fa laaxira.

sentences.english: Happy is the man who does not go in the company of sinners, or take his place in the way of evil-doers, or in the seat of those who do not give honour to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛlɛxinyi na adama nan bɛ, naxan mu birama mixi ɲaaxi xa marasi fɔxɔ ra, naxan mu a ɲɛrɛma yunubitɔɛ fɔxɔ ra, naxan mu a makɔrɛma mixie ra, naxee yoma Ala fe ma.

sentences.english: But whose delight is in the law of the Lord, and whose mind is on his law day and night.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛlɛxinyi na adama nan bɛ, Alatala xa sɛriyɛ rafan naxan ma, naxan a ɲɔxɔ sama Alatala xa sɛriyɛ xɔn ma kɔɛ nun yanyi.

sentences.english: He will be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, which gives its fruit at the right time, whose leaves will ever be green; and he will do well in all his undertakings.
sentences.susu: Na adama maniyɛ wuri bili ra naxan tixi xure dɛ. A bogima a waxati. A burɛxɛ mu lisima. Na adama, fefe suxuma, a sɔɔnɛyama nɛ a bɛ.

sentences.english: The evil-doers are not so; but are like the dust from the grain, which the wind takes away.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a mu na ki xɛ mixi ɲaaxie tan bɛ. E tan maniyɛ maale lagi ra foye naxan xaninma.

sentences.english: For this cause there will be no mercy for sinners when they are judged, and the evil-doers will have no place among the upright,
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxie bɔnɔma nɛ kiiti waxati, e mu luma tinxin mixie ya ma. Lude mu na e bɛ.

sentences.english: Because the Lord sees the way of the upright, but the end of the sinner is destruction.
sentences.susu: Alatala mɛɛnima tinxintɔɛe ma a xa kira xɔn ma, kɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxi tan xa kira findima gbaloe kira nan na.

sentences.english: Why are the nations so violently moved, and why are the thoughts of the people so foolish?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra sie bɔɲɛ texi fufafu?

sentences.english: The kings of the earth have taken their place, and the rulers are fixed in their purpose, against the Lord, and against the king of his selection, saying,
sentences.susu: Duniɲa mangɛe bara keli, xunmatie bara ti Alatala nun a xa mixi sugandixi kanke.

sentences.english: Let their chains be broken, and their cords taken from off us.
sentences.susu: Na duniɲa mangɛe naxɛ, «Won xa won ba e yi ra, Won xa mini e xa nɔɛ bun ma.»

sentences.english: Then he whose seat is in the heavens will be laughing: the Lord will make sport of them.
sentences.susu: Marigi naxan na koore ma, na na yelefe e ma.

sentences.english: Then will his angry words come to their ears, and by his wrath they will be troubled:
sentences.susu: A xɔnɔma e ma, a e magaaxuma.

sentences.english: But I have put my king on my holy hill of Zion.
sentences.susu: Ala xa masenyi nan ya, «N tan nan mangɛ sugandi, n a dɔxɔ Siyoni geya fari, n ma yire sɛniyɛnxi.»

sentences.english: I will make clear the Lord's decision: he has said to me, You are my son, this day have I given you being.
sentences.susu: Na mangɛ sugandixi xa masenyi nan ya, «N xa Alatala xa natɛ masen wo bɛ. Ala bara a masen n bɛ, ‹To, i bara findi n ma di ra. N tan bara findi i baba ra.

sentences.english: Make your request to me, and I will give you the nations for your heritage, and the farthest limits of the earth will be under your hand.
sentences.susu: I xa n maxandi n xa si birin fi i ma, e xa findi kɛ ra i bɛ. Duniɲa birin xa findi i gbe ra.

sentences.english: They will be ruled by you with a rod of iron; they will be broken like a potter's vessel.
sentences.susu: I e yamarima sawuri ra, i e kanama alɔ wure fɛɲɛ bɔɔma ki naxɛ, a kebelae yensen yɛ.›»

sentences.english: So now be wise, you kings: take his teaching, you judges of the earth.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi wo tan mangɛe, wo xaxili sɔtɔ. Kuntigie, wo bira nɔndi fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Give worship to the Lord with fear, kissing his feet and giving him honour,
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala batu gaaxui ra, wo sɛɛwa a xa fe ra, wo gaaxu a ya ra.

sentences.english: For fear that he may be angry, causing destruction to come on you, because he is quickly moved to wrath. Happy are all those who put their faith in him.
sentences.susu: Wo wo xun sin a xa mixi sugandixi bɛ. Xa na mu a ra, a wo halakima nɛ wo xa duniɲɛigiri kui. Ala xa xɔnɛ dɛxɛma alɔ tɛ nu so fiili ra. Ɲɛlɛxinyi na adama nan bɛ, naxan kantari fenma Ala ra.

sentences.english: Lord, how greatly are they increased who make attacks on me! in great numbers they come against me.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti a nu a gima a xa di Abisalomi ma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: Unnumbered are those who say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Alatala, n yaxuie bara wuya. N gerefae bara gbo.

sentences.english: But your strength, O Lord, is round me, you are my glory and the lifter up of my head.
sentences.susu: Mixi wuyaxi a falama, Ala mu nɔma n nakiside. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: I send up a cry to the Lord with my voice, and he gives me an answer from his holy hill. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan Alatala, i findixi n kantama nan na. N ma binyɛ nun n ma xunnakeli fatanxi i tan nan na.

sentences.english: I took my rest in sleep, and then again I was awake; for the Lord was my support.
sentences.susu: N nan n xui rate Ala ma, a n yaabima keli a xa geya sɛniyɛnxi fari. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: I will have no fear, though ten thousand have come round me, putting themselves against me.
sentences.susu: N nan n sama, n xa xi, n man xunuma xaxili sa kui, barima Alatala nan na n dɛmɛnma ra.

sentences.english: Come to me, Lord; keep me safe, O my God; for you have given all my haters blows on their face-bones; the teeth of the evil-doers have been broken by you.
sentences.susu: N mu gaaxuma yi ɲama duniɲa ya ra, naxee mu wama n ma fe xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Salvation comes from the Lord; your blessing is on your people. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Alatala yandi, n nakisi, n Marigi Ala. I n yaxuie dɛ ragarinma nɛ, i mixi ɲaaxi ɲinyie magirama nɛ.

sentences.english: Give answer to my cry, O God of my righteousness; make me free from my troubles; have mercy on me, and give ear to my prayer.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba kɔra xui ra.

sentences.english: O you sons of men, how long will you go on turning my glory into shame? how long will you give your love to foolish things, going after what is false? (Selah.)
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala tinxinxi, n na n xui rate i ma, yandi a ratin n bɛ. N ma tɔɔrɛ kui, i n bɔɲɛ sama. Hinnɛ n na, n ma dubɛ suxu.

sentences.english: See how the Lord has made great his mercy for me; the Lord will give ear to my cry.
sentences.susu: Adamadie, wo n ma binyɛ masarama yaagi ra han mun tɛmui? Wo birama fe fufafu nun wule fɔxɔ ra han mun tɛmui?

sentences.english: Let there be fear in your hearts, and do no sin; have bitter feelings on your bed, but make no sound. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon Alatala bara tinxintɔɛ sugandi. N nan n xui rate Alatala ma, a a ramɛma nɛ.

sentences.english: Give the offerings of righteousness, and put your faith in the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo fan xa gaaxu, wo gbilen yunubi fe fɔxɔ ra. Wo wo yɛtɛ rasi kɔɛ ra, wo xa wo raxara.

sentences.english: There are numbers who say, Who will do us any good? the light of his face has gone from us.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɛrɛxɛ ba tinxinyi kui, wo xa wo yɛtɛ taxu Alatala ra.

sentences.english: Lord, you have put joy in my heart, more than they have when their grain and their wine are increased.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe a falama, «Nde nɔma hɛɛri masende won bɛ?» Alatala, i xa nɔrɛ masen muxu bɛ.

sentences.english: I will take my rest on my bed in peace, because you only, Lord, keep me safe.
sentences.susu: I bara n bɔɲɛ rafe sɛɛwɛ ra dangife xɛ xaba tɛmui ra.

sentences.english: Give ear to my words, O Lord; give thought to my heart-searchings.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ xule xui ra

sentences.english: Let the voice of my cry come to you, my King and my God; for to you will I make my prayer.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i tuli mati n ma maxandi ra, i xa n ma tɔɔrɛ kolon.

sentences.english: My voice will come to you in the morning, O Lord; in the morning will I send my prayer to you, and keep watch.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, i tuli mati n ma maxandi ra, n na i tan nan maxandife.

sentences.english: For you are not a God who takes pleasure in wrongdoing; there is no evil with you.
sentences.susu: Alatala, kuye nɛ ibama, i n xui ramɛma. Gɛɛsɛgɛ, n nan n yɛtɛ ragbilenma i ma, n i mɛmɛ.

sentences.english: The sons of pride have no place before you; you are a hater of all workers of evil.
sentences.susu: I mu ɲɛlɛxinma fe kobi ra. Fe ɲaaxi mu nɔma makɔrɛde i yire ra.

sentences.english: You will send destruction on those whose words are false; the cruel man and the man of deceit are hated by the Lord.
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛ igboe mu tima i ya i. I tinxintaree birin xɔnxi.

sentences.english: But as for me, I will come into your house, in the full measure of your mercy; and in your fear I will give worship, turning my eyes to your holy Temple.
sentences.susu: I wule falɛ rahalakima. I faxatie nun yanfantee xɔnma.

sentences.english: Be my guide, O Lord, in the ways of your righteousness, because of those who are against me; make your way straight before my face.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n tan soma i xa banxi kui i xa fonisireya saabui nan na. N nan n igoroma i xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi sɛniyɛnxi kui gaaxui ra.

sentences.english: For no faith may be put in their words; their inner part is nothing but evil; their throat is like an open place for the dead; smooth are the words of their tongues.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n yaxuie xa fe ra, n xun ti i xa tinxinyi ra, i xa kira yailan n ya ra.

sentences.english: Send them to destruction, O Lord; let their evil designs be the cause of their fall; let them be forced out by all their sins; because they have gone against your authority.
sentences.susu: Nɔndi mu na n yaxuie xa masenyi sese kui. E yuge mu fan. E xa wɔyɛnyi mixi rafilima nɛ, barima e dɛ iɲɔxun.

sentences.english: But let all those who put their faith in you be glad with cries of joy at all times, and let all the lovers of your name be glad in you.
sentences.susu: Ala, e ɲaxankata. E xa yanfɛ xa gbilen e ma. E keri e xa fe kobi ma, barima e bara i matandi.

sentences.english: For you, Lord, will send a blessing on the upright man; your grace will be round him, and you will be his strength.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi naxan birin a yɛtɛ taxuma i ra, e birin xa sɛɛwa, e xa ɲɛlɛxinyi naxa ɲɔn abadan. I xili rafanxi mixi naxee ma, e makanta, e xa sɛɛwa i xa fe ra,

sentences.english: O Lord, do not be bitter with me in your wrath; do not send punishment on me in the heat of your passion.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba kɔra luuti solomasaxan xui ra.

sentences.english: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am wasted away: make me well, for even my bones are troubled.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i naxa n ɲaxankata i xa xɔnɛ kui, i naxa n tɔɔrɔ i xa bɔɲɛ te kui.

sentences.english: My soul is in bitter trouble; and you, O Lord, how long?
sentences.susu: Alatala, hinnɛ n na, n bara halaki. Alatala, n nayalan, n xɔrie na sɛrɛnfe nɛ yi ki.

sentences.english: Come back, O Lord, make my soul free; O give me salvation because of your mercy.
sentences.susu: N nii birin na sɛrɛnfe tɔɔrɛ ra. Alatala, han tɛmui mundun fa?

sentences.english: For in death there is no memory of you; in the underworld who will give you praise?
sentences.susu: Alatala, fa n nii rakisi. N natanga i xa fonisireya xa fe ra.

sentences.english: The voice of my sorrow is a weariness to me; all the night I make my bed wet with weeping; it is watered by the drops flowing from my eyes.
sentences.susu: Mixi mu nɔma ratude i ma gaburi kui. Nde nɔma i tantude aligiyama?

sentences.english: My eyes are wasting away with trouble; they are becoming old because of all those who are against me.
sentences.susu: N bara tɔɔrɔ han n sɛnbɛ birin bara ɲɔn. Kɔɛ yo kɔɛ n wama, han n ma sade birin bunda n ya ye ra.

sentences.english: Go from me, all you workers of evil; for the Lord has given ear to the voice of my weeping.
sentences.susu: Sunnunyi bara n ya mafɔɔrɔ. N mu sese tofe n yaxuie xa gboe xa fe ra.

sentences.english: The Lord has given ear to my request; the Lord has let my prayer come before him.
sentences.susu: Wo wo masiga n na, wo tan tinxintaree, barima n wa xui bara Alatala li.

sentences.english: Let all those who are against me be shamed and deeply troubled; let them be turned back and suddenly put to shame.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara n ma maxandi mɛ. Alatala bara n ma dubɛ suxu.

sentences.english: O Lord my God, I put my faith in you; take me out of the hands of him who is cruel to me, and make me free;
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti mɔɔli nde Alatala bɛ Kusi Bunyaminka xa fe ra.

sentences.english: So that he may not come rushing on my soul like a lion, wounding it, while there is no one to be my saviour.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala, i tan nan na n kantama ra. N natanga n yaxuie ma, n ba e yi ra,

sentences.english: O Lord my God, if I have done this; if my hands have done any wrong;
sentences.susu: e naxa n faxa alɔ yɛtɛ mixi faxama ki naxɛ. A na naxan suxu, na mu bama a yi ra.

sentences.english: If I have given back evil to him who did evil to me, or have taken anything from him who was against me without cause;
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala, xa n bara kɔbiri ramuruta,

sentences.english: Let my hater go after my soul and take it; let my life be crushed to the earth, and my honour into the dust. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: xa n bara fe ɲaaxi raba mixi ra, muxu nun naxan dɔxɔxi bɔɲɛsa kui, xa n bara n gerefa muɲa tɔɔɲɛgɛ kui,

sentences.english: Come up, Lord, in your wrath; be lifted up against my haters; be awake, my God, give orders for the judging.
sentences.susu: n yaxuie xa n keri, e xa n masɔtɔ, e xa n maboron, e n faxa.

sentences.english: The meeting of the nations will be round you; take your seat, then, over them, on high.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n mali, i bɔɲɛ xa te n yaxuie ma. N dɛmɛn, sɛriyɛ na i tan naxan yi ra.

sentences.english: The Lord will be judge of the peoples; give a decision for me, O Lord, because of my righteousness, and let my virtue have its reward.
sentences.susu: I xa nɔɛ xa lu ɲamae xun, e xa lu i xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: O let the evil of the evil-doer come to an end, but give strength to the upright: for men's minds and hearts are tested by the God of righteousness.
sentences.susu: Alatala, ɲamae makiiti. Alatala, n ma nɔndi makɛnɛn e bɛ n ma tinxinyi nun n ma sɛriyɛ bɛrɛ ra.

sentences.english: God, who is the saviour of the upright in heart, is my breastplate.
sentences.susu: Danyi sa fe kobi rabae xa fe ma. Sɛnbɛ fi mixi tinxinxie ma i tan, Ala naxan tinxin, naxan birin sondon ma fe kolon.

sentences.english: God is the judge of the upright, and is angry with the evil-doers every day.
sentences.susu: Ala, n kantama na i tan nan na, naxan mixi tinxinxi rakisima.

sentences.english: If a man is not turned from his evil, he will make his sword sharp; his bow is bent and ready.
sentences.susu: Kiitisa fanyi nan na Ala ra, naxan xɔnɔma tinxintaree ma tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: He has made ready for him the instruments of death; he makes his arrows flames of fire.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi ɲaaxie mu gbilen e yuge fɔxɔ ra, Ala a xa santidɛgɛma raluganma nɛ, a a xa xali maxiri.

sentences.english: That man is a worker of evil; the seed of wrongdoing has given birth to deceit.
sentences.susu: Ala na faxatise yailanma mixi ɲaaxie nan xili ma, a a xa tanbɛe dɛ findi tɛ ra.

sentences.english: He has made a hole deep in the earth, and is falling into the hole which he has made
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxi luma fe ɲaaxi nan tun naba ra. A a ɲɔxɔ sa a xɔn ma han a findi a ra.

sentences.english: His wrongdoing will come back to him, and his violent behaviour will come down on his head.
sentences.susu: A yili gema han a tilin, a fa bira a yɛtɛ xa yili gexi kui.

sentences.english: I will give praise to the Lord for his righteousness; I will make a song to the name of the Lord Most High.
sentences.susu: A xa fe ɲaaxi nun a xa geregiri bara gbilen a ma.

sentences.english: O Lord, our Lord, whose glory is higher than the heavens, how noble is your name in all the earth!
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba maxase luuti daaxi xui ra.

sentences.english: You have made clear your strength even out of the mouths of babies at the breast, because of those who are against you; so that you may put to shame the cruel and violent man.
sentences.susu: Muxu Marigi Alatala! Xili xungbe kanyi nan lanxi i ma duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari, i tan naxan ma nɔrɛ na koore ma.

sentences.english: When I see your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have put in their places;
sentences.susu: Dimɛe nun diyɔrɛe i sɛnbɛ matɔxɔma, i i yaxuie nun i gerefae dɛ balanma na matɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: What is man, that you keep him in mind? the son of man, that you take him into account?
sentences.susu: N na koore mato, i naxan yailanxi i bɛlɛxɛ ra, kike a nun tunbuie,

sentences.english: For you have made him only a little lower than the gods, crowning him with glory and honour.
sentences.susu: n nan n yɛtɛ maxɔrinma nɛ, «Munse lanxi adama ma i to i maɲɔxunma a xa fe ma? Munse lanxi adamadi ma i to i ɲɛngi sama a xa fe xɔn ma?

sentences.english: You have made him ruler over the works of your hands; you have put all things under his feet;
sentences.susu: I a daaxi ki naxɛ, a gbe mu luxi a xa findi malekɛ ra. I bara binyɛ nun fisamanteya fi a ma.

sentences.english: All sheep and oxen, and all the beasts of the field;
sentences.susu: I bara yaamari so a yi ra i xa daalisee birin xun ma. I bara duniɲa findi a sanyi bun ma se ra:

sentences.english: The birds of the air and the fish of the sea, and whatever goes through the deep waters of the seas.
sentences.susu: yɛxɛɛe, ningee, wulai subee,

sentences.english: O Lord, our Lord, how noble is your name in all the earth!
sentences.susu: xɔni naxee ɲɛrɛma koore ma, yɛxɛ naxee birin ɲɛrɛma baa ma.

sentences.english: I will give you praise, O Lord, with all my heart; I will make clear all the wonder of your works.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba alɔ bɛɛti naxan xili «Di xa faxɛ.»

sentences.english: I will be glad and have delight in you: I will make a song of praise to your name, O Most High.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n i tantuma n sondonyi birin na, n i xa wali fanyi ixaranma mixi birin bɛ.

sentences.english: When my haters are turned back, they will be broken and overcome before you.
sentences.susu: N sɛɛwama nɛ i xa fe ra, i tan Alatala Xili Xungbe Kanyi, n i matɔxɔ bɛɛti ra.

sentences.english: For you gave approval to my right and my cause; you were seated in your high place judging in righteousness.
sentences.susu: N yaxuie gbilenma nɛ e kelide. Xa e bara ti i ya i, e sanyie mu xanma bɔxi, e nii mu xanma duniɲa,

sentences.english: You have said sharp words to the nations, you have sent destruction on the sinners, you have put an end to their name for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: barima i xa tinxinyi kui, i tan mangɛ bara kiiti so n yi.

sentences.english: You have given their towns to destruction; the memory of them has gone; they have become waste for ever.
sentences.susu: I bara si gbɛtɛe kalamu, i fe kobi rabae rahalakima, i e xili ralɔɛma nɛ han duniɲa ɲɔn.

sentences.english: But the Lord is King for ever: he has made ready his high seat for judging.
sentences.susu: I bara e xa taae sɔntɔ, na taa sɔntɔxie luma nɛ na ki han, e xa fe nɛɛmu mixie ra!

sentences.english: And he will be the judge of the world in righteousness, giving true decisions for the peoples.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa mangɛya tixi, danyi mu na a ma. A xa kibanyi dɔxɔxi kiiti safe nan ma.

sentences.english: The Lord will be a high tower for those who are crushed down, a high tower in times of trouble;
sentences.susu: A duniɲa makiitima tinxinyi kui, a dɔxɔxi sie xun ma tinxinyi kui.

sentences.english: And those who have knowledge of your name will put their faith in you; because you, Lord, have ever given your help to those who were waiting for you.
sentences.susu: Tɔɔrɔmixie kantama nan na Alatala ra, e ratangama na a tan nan na e xa kɔntɔfilie kui.

sentences.english: Make songs of praise to the Lord, whose house is in Zion: make his doings clear to the people.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i kolonma laxi i ra, barima i singe mu nu i fenma rabolo.

sentences.english: When he makes search for blood, he has them in his memory: he is not without thought for the cry of the poor.
sentences.susu: Alatala dɔxɔxi a xa geya sɛniyɛnxi xun, won xa a tantu bɛɛtie ra. A bara fe naxee raba, won xa nee masen si birin bɛ.

sentences.english: Have mercy on me, O Lord, and see how I am troubled by my haters; let me be lifted up from the doors of death;
sentences.susu: Ala ratuxi wuli filixi ma, a fan na ɲɔxɔma nɛ. A tɔɔrɔmixie wa xui danxunxi.

sentences.english: So that I may make clear all your praise in the house of the daughter of Zion: I will be glad because of your salvation.
sentences.susu: Alatala, kinikini n ma. I xa n mato. A mato n yaxuie na n tɔɔrɔfe ki naxɛ. I tan naxan n nakisima saya kira ma,

sentences.english: The nations have gone down into the hole which they made: in their secret net is their foot taken.
sentences.susu: alako n xa i tantu Siyoni ɲama tagi, n xa sɛɛwa i xa kisi ra.

sentences.english: The Lord has given knowledge of himself through his judging: the evil-doer is taken in the net which his hands had made. (Higgaion. Selah.)
sentences.susu: Sie nu gantanyi naxan texi e yaxuie bɛ, e bara e yɛtɛ sanyie suxu a ra.

sentences.english: The sinners and all the nations who have no memory of God will be turned into the underworld.
sentences.susu: Alatala kolonxi a xa tinxinyi nan ma. Tinxintaree suxuma e yɛtɛ bɛlɛxɛ fɔxi nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: For the poor will not be without help; the hopes of those in need will not be crushed for ever.
sentences.susu: Matandila naxee nɛɛmuma Ala ma, e birin naɲɔnma aligiyama nɛ.

sentences.english: Up! O Lord; let not man overcome you: let the nations be judged before you.
sentences.susu: Ala fama ratude tɔɔrɔmixi ma, a mu nɛɛmuma e ma abadan.

sentences.english: Put them in fear, O Lord, so that the nations may see that they are only men. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Alatala, keli, i naxa a lu adama xa nɔ i ra. A makiiti.

sentences.english: Why do you keep far away, O Lord? why are you not to be seen in times of trouble?
sentences.susu: Alatala, i i makuyaxi n na munfe ra? I i nɔxunxi muxu ma muxu xa tɔɔrɛ kui munfe ra?

sentences.english: The evil-doer in his pride is cruel to the poor; let him be taken by the tricks of his invention.
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛ igboe setaree tɔɔrɔma, a xa maɲɔxunyi kobi nɔma e ra.

sentences.english: For the evil-doer is lifted up because of the purpose of his heart, and he whose mind is fixed on wealth is turned away from the Lord, saying evil against him.
sentences.susu: A a yɛtɛ igboma a xa wali ɲaaxi xa fe ra. Alatala xɔnɔma a xa naafuli sɔtɔ ki ma.

sentences.english: The evil-doer in his pride says, God will not make a search. All his thoughts are, There is no God.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxi yɛtɛ igboe naxɛ, «Ala mu na! A mu nɔma sese rabade n na!» A xa maɲɔxunyi birin nan ya.

sentences.english: His ways are ever fixed; your decisions are higher than he may see: as for his haters, they are as nothing to him.
sentences.susu: A xa wali birin sɔɔnɛyama nɛ. A mu gaaxuma Ala xa kiiti ya ra. A yoma a yaxuie ma.

sentences.english: He has said in his heart, I will not be moved: through all generations I will never be in trouble.
sentences.susu: A maɲɔxunma a bɔɲɛ ma, «Sese mu a niyama n bira. Tɔɔrɛ man mu n suxuma.»

sentences.english: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and false words: under his tongue are evil purposes and dark thoughts.
sentences.susu: A dɛ mixi dankama, a wule fala. A fe ɲaaxi tinxintare nan tun falama.

sentences.english: He is waiting in the dark places of the towns: in the secret places he puts to death those who have done no wrong: his eyes are secretly turned against the poor.
sentences.susu: A mixi mɛlɛnma taa fari ma, a xa mixi fanyi faxa. A mu taganma fe ɲaaxi rabafe ra mixi fanyi ra.

sentences.english: He keeps himself in a secret place like a lion in his hole, waiting to put his hands on the poor man, and pulling him into his net.
sentences.susu: A setaree mɛlɛnma alɔ yɛtɛ. A e suxu a xa gantanyi ra.

sentences.english: The upright are crushed and made low, and the feeble are overcome by his strong ones.
sentences.susu: Na setaree luma a xa nɔɛ bun ma.

sentences.english: He says in his heart, God has no memory of me: his face is turned away; he will never see it.
sentences.susu: A a falama a bɔɲɛ kui, «Ala mu sese toma. A ya raxixi.»

sentences.english: Up! O Lord; let your hand be lifted: give thought to the poor.
sentences.susu: Alatala keli! I naxa nɛɛmu setare ma.

sentences.english: Why has the evil-doer a low opinion of God, saying in his heart, You will not make search for it?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra mixi ɲaaxi yoma Ala ma? Munfe ra a a falama a yɛtɛ bɛ, «Ala mu n ɲaxankatama»?

sentences.english: You have seen it; for your eyes are on sorrow and grief, to take it into your hand: the poor man puts his faith in you; you have been the helper of the child who has no father.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala, i tɔɔrɛ nun nimisɛ toma. I tɔɔrɔmixie malima. Naxan mu nɔma a yɛtɛ kantade, a a yɛtɛ taxuma i tan na na. I tan nan na kiridi malima ra.

sentences.english: Let the arm of the sinner and the evil-doer be broken; go on searching for his sin till there is no more.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxi sɛnbɛ kana! E ɲaxankata e xa fe ɲaaxi xa fe ra! E ralɔɛ yi duniɲa ma!

sentences.english: The Lord is King for ever and ever; the nations are gone from his land.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ nan Alatala ra. Na mu kanama abadan. Kuye batui mu luma a xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Lord, you have given ear to the prayer of the poor: you will make strong their hearts, you will give them a hearing:
sentences.susu: Alatala, i i tuli tixi mixi magoroxie ra. I limaniya fima e ma. I e xa maxandi suxuma.

sentences.english: To give decision for the child without a father and for the broken-hearted, so that the man of the earth may no longer be feared.
sentences.susu: I tɔɔrɔmixi nun kiridi kantama, alako adamadi naxan findixi bɛndɛ ra, a naxa e magaaxu.

sentences.english: In the Lord put I my faith; how will you say to my soul, Go in flight like a bird to the mountain?
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ N bara Alatala findi n yigi ra. Wo a falama n bɛ di, «I i gi alɔ xɔni naxan tuganma sigafe ra geya ma,

sentences.english: See, the bows of the evil-doers are bent, they make ready their arrows on the cord, so that they may send them secretly against the upright in heart.
sentences.susu: barima mixi ɲaaxie bara e xa xalie tongo, e xa mixi bɔɲɛ fanyie faxa.»

sentences.english: If the bases are broken down, what is the upright man to do?
sentences.susu: Xa sɛriyɛ mu na mixie tagi sɔnɔn, tinxintɔɛ fa munse rabama?

sentences.english: The Lord is in his holy Temple, the Lord's seat is in heaven; his eyes are watching and testing the children of men.
sentences.susu: Alatala na a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi sɛniyɛnxi kui. A xa kibanyi na ariyanna. A adamadie matoma a fanyi ra, a xa a kolon naxan na e sondonyi kui.

sentences.english: The Lord puts the upright and the sinner to the test, but he has hate in his soul for the lover of violent acts.
sentences.susu: Alatala tinxintɔɛ nun tinxintare matoma. Gbaloe rafan naxee ma, a nee raɲaaxu.

sentences.english: On the evil-doer he will send down fire and flames, and a burning wind; with these will their cup be full.
sentences.susu: A tinxintare luma tɔɔrɛ mɔɔli birin kui. Na luma nɛ alɔ tɛ wolenxi nun foye ɲaaxi.

sentences.english: For the Lord is upright; he is a lover of righteousness: the upright will see his face.
sentences.susu: Alatala tinxin. Tinxinyi rafan a ma. Tinxintɔɛ fama a yatagi tode.

sentences.english: Send help, Lord, for mercy has come to an end; there is no more faith among the children of men.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba kɔra luuti solomasaxan xui ra.

sentences.english: Everyone says false words to his neighbour: their tongues are smooth in their talk, and their hearts are full of deceit.
sentences.susu: Alatala, muxu rakisi! Lanlanteya mu na sɔnɔn, nɔndi falɛe bara ɲɔn adamadie tagi.

sentences.english: The smooth lips and the tongue of pride will be cut off by the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kankan a boore tɔɔɲɛgɛma, a a yanfama wɔyɛn ɲɔxunmɛ ra. Filankafui nan e ra.

sentences.english: They have said, With our tongues will we overcome; our lips are ours: who is lord over us?
sentences.susu: Alatala xa e dɛ balan. E dɛ igbo.

sentences.english: Because of the crushing of the poor and the weeping of those in need, now will I come to his help, says the Lord; I will give him the salvation which he is desiring.
sentences.susu: E naxɛ, «Muxu sɛnbɛ gbo, muxu fata wɔyɛnde. Nde nɔma muxu ra?»

sentences.english: The words of the Lord are true words: like silver tested by fire and burned clean seven times.
sentences.susu: Alatala a masenma, «N kelima tɔɔrɔmixi nun setare xa fe ra ya. N e ratangama mixie ma naxee e ɲaxankatama.»

sentences.english: You will keep them, O Lord, you will keep them safe from this generation for ever.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi sɛniyɛn. A luma alɔ gbeti mixi naxan naxunuma sanya solofere alako a gbi xa ba.

sentences.english: The sinners are walking on every side, and evil is honoured among the children of men.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i tɔɔrɔmixi kantama, i muxu ratangama yi mixi mɔɔli ma tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Will you for ever put me out of your memory, O Lord? will your face for ever be turned away from me?
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: How long is my soul to be in doubt, with sorrow in my heart all the day? how long will he who is against me be given power over me?
sentences.susu: Alatala, i nɛɛmuma n ma han mun tɛmui? I i nɔxunma n ma han mun tɛmui?

sentences.english: Let my voice come before you, and give me an answer, O Lord my God; let your light be shining on me, so that the sleep of death may not overtake me;
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ tɔɔrɔma han mun tɛmui? N sondonyi ɲaxankatama han mun tɛmui? N luma n yaxuie bun ma han mun tɛmui?

sentences.english: And he who is against me may not say, I have overcome him; and those who are troubling me may not be glad when I am moved.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala, a mato, i xa n yaabi. Ti n fanga ra, xa na mu n faxama nɛ,

sentences.english: But I have had faith in your mercy; my heart will be glad in your salvation.
sentences.susu: n yaxuie fa a fala, «N bara nɔ a ra.» N yaxuie ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ n ma birɛ ra.

sentences.english: I will make a song to the Lord, because he has given me my reward.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n tan bara la i xa hinnɛ ra, n bɔɲɛ bara ɲɛlɛxin i xa kisi xa fe ra. N bɛɛti bama Alatala bɛ a xa hinnɛ nan ma.

sentences.english: The foolish man has said in his heart, God will not do anything. They are unclean, they have done evil works; there is not one who does good.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ Xaxilitare a falama a bɔɲɛ kui, «Ala mu na.» A bɔɲɛ bara kana, a ɲaaxuɲa nan tun nabama. Fe fanyi rabae mu na sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: The Lord was looking down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who had wisdom, searching after God.
sentences.susu: Alatala a ya ragorofe adamadie ma keli ariyanna, a xa a to xa lɔnnila nde na na naxan Ala fenma.

sentences.english: They have all gone out of the way together; they are unclean, there is not one who does good, no, not one.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ birin bara kira bɛɲin, e ɲaaxu. Hali fe fanyi rabama keren mu na sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Have all the workers of evil no knowledge? they take my people for food as they would take bread; they make no prayer to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Maɲɔxunyi fanyi mu na fe kobi rabae bɛ? E na n ma ɲama xa geeni nan tun donfe. E mu Alatala xilima fefe ma.

sentences.english: Then were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the upright.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e fama sɛrɛnde Ala ya ra, naxan na tinxintɔɛe ya ma.

sentences.english: You have put to shame the thoughts of the poor, but the Lord is his support.
sentences.susu: Wo bara wa setaree waxɔnfe kanafe, kɔnɔ e Kanta Marigi Alatala na na.

sentences.english: May the salvation of Israel come out of Zion! when the fate of his people is changed by the Lord, Jacob will have joy and Israel will be glad.
sentences.susu: Nde fama kisi ra Isirayila bɛ kelife Siyon? Alatala nan fama a xa ɲama raminide konyiya kui. Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛwama nɛ, Isirayila ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ!

sentences.english: Lord, who may have a resting-place in your tent, a living-place on your holy hill?
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti Alatala, nde nɔma lude i xa salide kui? Nde nɔma sabatide i xa geya sɛniyɛnxi fari?

sentences.english: He who goes on his way uprightly, doing righteousness, and saying what is true in his heart;
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan ɲɛrɛma tinxinyi kira xɔn ma, naxan fe fanyi rabama, naxan nɔndi falama a bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra.

sentences.english: Whose tongue is not false, who does no evil to his friend, and does not take away the good name of his neighbour;
sentences.susu: A mu mixi mafalama, a mu fe ɲaaxi rabama a boore ra, a man mu a rayaagima.

sentences.english: Who gives honour to those who have the fear of the Lord, turning away from him who has not the Lord's approval. He who takes an oath against himself, and makes no change.
sentences.susu: A a makuyama mixi ra naxan mu rafan Ala ma, kɔnɔ a mixi binyama naxan gaaxuma Ala ya ra. Hali a tɔɔrɔma, a mu a xa marakali masarama.

sentences.english: He who does not put out his money at interest, or for payment give false decisions against men who have done no wrong. He who does these things will never be moved.
sentences.susu: A mu mixi donima kɔbiri ra alako a xa geeni sɔtɔ. A mu kɔbiri rasuxuma a xa wule sa mixi xun ma. Yi mixi mɔɔli mu dinkonma abadan.

sentences.english: Keep me safe, O God: for in you I have put my faith.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa suuki Ala, i xa n kanta! N ma kantari na i yi ra.

sentences.english: O my soul, you have said to the Lord, You are my Lord: I have no good but you.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n Marigi nan i ra. N ma fe fanyi birin na i tan nan yi.

sentences.english: As for the saints who are in the earth, they are the noble in whom is all my delight.
sentences.susu: Yi bɔxi sɛniyɛntɔɛe rafan n ma. Mixi xungbe nan e ra.

sentences.english: Their sorrows will be increased who go after another god: I will not take drink offerings from their hands, or take their names on my lips.
sentences.susu: Kuye batuie xa tɔɔrɛ gboma nɛ. Kɔnɔ n tan mu sɛrɛxɛ wuli daaxi bama kuyee bɛ. N dɛ mu e xili falama.

sentences.english: The Lord is my heritage and the wine of my cup; you are the supporter of my right.
sentences.susu: Sese mu na n yi ra, fo Alatala. N waxɔnfe birin, Ala nan a ra. N ma duniɲɛigiri birin na Ala yi ra.

sentences.english: Fair are the places marked out for me; I have a noble heritage.
sentences.susu: Ala naxan soxi n yi ra na fan n bɛ, n bara ɲɛlɛxin a ra.

sentences.english: I will give praise to the Lord who has been my guide; knowledge comes to me from my thoughts in the night.
sentences.susu: N bara Alatala tantu, a marasi fima n ma. Hali kɔɛ ra, n xaxili sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: I have put the Lord before me at all times; because he is at my right hand, I will not be moved.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ n xaxili tixi Alatala ra. Xa a na n sɛɛti ma, n mu birama.

sentences.english: Because of this my heart is glad, and my glory is full of joy: while my flesh takes its rest in hope.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ, n xaxili sɛɛwama nɛ, n fate fan malabuma nɛ bɔɲɛsa kui,

sentences.english: For you will not let my soul be prisoned in the underworld; you will not let your loved one see the place of death.
sentences.susu: barima i mu n nii rabɛɲinma aligiyama. I mu i xanuntenyi luma gaburi kui.

sentences.english: You will make clear to me the way of life; where you are joy is complete; in your right hand there are pleasures for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: I simaya kira masenma n bɛ. Ɲɛlɛxinyi gbegbe na i yire. Fe fanyi mu ɲɔnma i yire fanyi ma abadan.

sentences.english: Let my cause come to your ears, O Lord, give attention to my cry; give ear to my prayer which goes not out from false lips.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa Ala maxandi Alatala, n ma maxandi ramɛ tinxinyi xa fe ra. I tuli mati n wa xui ra. I tuli mati n ma maxandi xui ra wule mu na naxan kui.

sentences.english: Be my judge; for your eyes see what is right.
sentences.susu: I xa n ma kiiti bolon, barima naxan tinxin, i na kolon.

sentences.english: You have put my heart to the test, searching me in the night; you have put me to the test and seen no evil purpose in me; I will keep my mouth from sin.
sentences.susu: I na n bɔɲɛ mato kɔɛ ra, i na n ma duniɲɛigiri mato yanyi ra, i mu tantanyi yo toma n na. N mu tinma wɔyɛn ɲaaxi xa mini n dɛ i.

sentences.english: As for the works of men, by the word of your lips I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbɛtɛe fe ɲaaxi rabama, kɔnɔ n tan bara i xa yaamari suxu. N mu birama suutee xa kirae fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: I have kept my feet in your ways, my steps have not been turned away.
sentences.susu: N birama i tan nan fɔxɔ ra, n mu na kira bɛɲinma.

sentences.english: My cry has gone up to you, for you will give me an answer, O God: let your ear be turned to me, and give attention to my words.
sentences.susu: Ala, n i xilima nɛ, barima i yaabi fima mixi ma. Yandi, i xa i tuli mati n ma maxandi ra.

sentences.english: Make clear the wonder of your mercy, O saviour of those who put their faith in your right hand, from those who come out against them.
sentences.susu: I xa hinnɛ muxu ra, i tan naxan mixie rakisima e yaxuie ma, naxee yigiya fenma i ra.

sentences.english: Keep me as the light of your eyes, covering me with the shade of your wings,
sentences.susu: Mɛɛni n ma alɔ i ya firinyie. N nɔxun alɔ tɔxɛyɔrɛ naxan a nɔxunma a nga gabutenyie bun ma.

sentences.english: From the evil-doers who are violent to me, and from those who are round me, desiring my death.
sentences.susu: Na na a toma, mixi ɲaaxi naxee n nabilinxi, e mu nɔma n na.

sentences.english: They are shut up in their fat: with their mouths they say words of pride.
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛ igboe nan e ra, e dɛ igbo.

sentences.english: They have made a circle round our steps: their eyes are fixed on us, forcing us down to the earth;
sentences.susu: E bara fa n fɔxɔ ra yakɔsi, e n nabilin, e alako e xa n faxa.

sentences.english: Like a lion desiring its food, and like a young lion waiting in secret places.
sentences.susu: E luxi alɔ yɛtɛ naxan sube fenma, alɔ yɛtɛ kaamɛxie naxee gbataxi sube faxade.

sentences.english: Up! Lord, come out against him, make him low, with your sword be my saviour from the evil-doer.
sentences.susu: Alatala, keli! N yaxuie gere, i xa nɔ e ra. N natanga mixi ɲaaxie ma i xa santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: With your hand, O Lord, from men, even men of the world, whose heritage is in this life, and whom you make full with your secret wealth: they are full of children; after their death their offspring take the rest of their goods.
sentences.susu: N natanga na duniɲa mixi mɔɔlie ma, naxee e masundi sɔtɔma yi duniɲɛigiri gbansan kui. E raluga na masundi ra, i naxan nagataxi e bɛ. E xa die fan xa wasa na ra, a dɔnxɔɛ xa lu e xa mamadie bɛ!

sentences.english: As for me, I will see your face in righteousness: when I am awake it will be joy enough for me to see your form.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n tan fama nɛ i yatagi tode tinxinyi saabui ra. N na xunu, n wasama nɛ i yatagi ra.

sentences.english: I will give you my love, O Lord, my strength.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa konyi Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A yi bɛɛti nan ba Alatala bɛ a to a ratanga Sɔlu nun a yaxui birin ma.

sentences.english: The Lord is my Rock, my walled town, and my saviour; my God, my Rock, in him will I put my faith; my breastplate, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n sɛnbɛ nun n xanuntenyi nan i ra.

sentences.english: I will send up my cry to the Lord, who is to be praised; so will I be made safe from those who are against me.
sentences.susu: N nakisima Alatala luma alɔ fanye, a findi n bɛ tɛtɛ ra. N Marigi Ala luma alɔ gɛmɛ xungbe, n yigiyama dɛnnaxɛ. Sɛnbɛma nan a ra naxan n nakisima, naxan n makantama.

sentences.english: The cords of death were round me, and the seas of evil put me in fear.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala n xui itexi ra: Ala tantu! Ala bara n nakisi n yaxuie ma.

sentences.english: The cords of hell were round me: the nets of death came on me.
sentences.susu: Saya nu bara n nabilin, faxɛ nu bara gbaku n xun ma.

sentences.english: In my trouble my voice went up to the Lord, and my cry to my God: my voice came to his hearing in his holy Temple, and my prayer came before him, even into his ears.
sentences.susu: Laaxira nu bara makɔrɛ n na, gaburi nu bara a dɛ rabi n ya ra.

sentences.english: Then trouble and shock came on the earth; and the bases of the mountains were moved and shaking, because he was angry.
sentences.susu: N Alatala maxandima n ma tɔɔrɛ kui, n nan n Marigi Ala xilima n xui itexi ra. A n xui mɛma a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, a a tuli matima n wa xui ra.

sentences.english: There went up a smoke from his nose, and a fire of destruction from his mouth: flames were lighted by it.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi naxa sɛrɛn, geya naxa ramaxa Ala xa xɔnɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: The heavens were bent, so that he might come down; and it was dark under his feet.
sentences.susu: A xa xɔnɛ naxa lu alɔ tuuri naxan tema, alɔ tɛ naxan minima a dɛ i, alɔ tɛ wole dɛxɛxi.

sentences.english: And he went in flight through the air, seated on a storm-cloud: going quickly on the wings of the wind.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa kuye ibɔɔ firin na, a goro, a sanyie tixi nuxui ifɔɔrɔxi fari.

sentences.english: He made the dark his secret place; his tent round him was the dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.
sentences.susu: A ti malekɛ xun ma, a ɲɛrɛ koore ma foye fari.

sentences.english: Before his shining light his dark clouds went past, raining ice and fire.
sentences.susu: A a nɔxun dimi kui, tunɛ nun nuxui ifɔɔrɔxie tagi.

sentences.english: The Lord made thunder in the heavens, and the voice of the Highest was sounding out: a rain of ice and fire.
sentences.susu: Seyamakɔnyi naxa mini a ya ra nuxuie kui. Balabalanyi nun tɛ naxa goro.

sentences.english: He sent out his arrows, driving them in all directions; by his flames of fire they were troubled.
sentences.susu: Alatala xui naxa lu alɔ galanyi kelife koore, Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi naxa a xui ramini, balabalanyi nun tɛ fan naxa goro.

sentences.english: Then the deep beds of the waters were seen, and the bases of the world were uncovered, because of your words of wrath, O Lord, because of the breath from your mouth.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa tanbɛe woli, a a yaxuie rayensen seyamakɔnyi ya ra.

sentences.english: He sent from on high, he took me, pulling me out of great waters.
sentences.susu: Baa nun bɔxi naxa rabi Alatala xa xɔnɛ ya ra.

sentences.english: He made me free from my strong hater, and from those who were against me, because they were stronger than I.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa n suxu kelife koore ma, a n ba ye xɔɔra.

sentences.english: They came on me in the day of my trouble; but the Lord was my support.
sentences.susu: A naxa n natanga n yaxui sɛnbɛmae ma, n xɔnmixi naxee sɛnbɛ gbo n bɛ.

sentences.english: He took me out into a wide place; he was my saviour because he had delight in me.
sentences.susu: E naxa n gere n ma tɔɔrɛ kui, kɔnɔ Alatala naxa n natanga.

sentences.english: The Lord gives me the reward of my righteousness, because my hands are clean before him.
sentences.susu: A naxa n namini gbaloe kui a xa xanunteya saabui ra.

sentences.english: For I have kept the ways of the Lord; I have not been turned away in sin from my God.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara n ma tinxinyi sare ragbilen n ma, a bara n mali n ma kɛwali sɛniyɛnxi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For all his decisions were before me, and I did not put away his laws from me.
sentences.susu: N bara lu Alatala xa kira xɔn, n mu n Marigi Ala bɛɲin kobiɲa ra.

sentences.english: And I was upright before him, and I kept myself from sin.
sentences.susu: N bara a xa sɛriyɛ birin suxu, n mu tondixi a xa yaamarie rabatude.

sentences.english: Because of this the Lord has given me the reward of my righteousness, because my hands are clean in his eyes.
sentences.susu: N bara tinxin a ya ra, n mu tin birade yunubi fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: On him who has mercy you will have mercy; to the upright you will be upright;
sentences.susu: Alatala bara n ma tinxinyi sare ragbilen n ma, a bara n mali n ma kɛwali sɛniyɛnxi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: He who is holy will see that you are holy; but to the man whose way is not straight you will be a hard judge.
sentences.susu: I dugutɛgɛɲa masenma dugutɛgɛɲa kanyi bɛ. I tinxinyi masenma tinxintɔɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: For you are the saviour of those who are in trouble; but eyes full of pride will be made low.
sentences.susu: I sɛniyɛnyi masenma sɛniyɛntɔɛ bɛ, kɔnɔ i kɔɔta nde rabama mixi ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: You, O Lord, will be my light; by you, my God, the dark will be made bright for me.
sentences.susu: I yɛtɛ magoroe rakisima nɛ, kɔnɔ i yɛtɛ igboe tan magoroma nɛ.

sentences.english: By your help I have made a way through the wall which was shutting me in; by the help of my God I have gone over a wall.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i tan nan naiyalanyi ra n bɛ. N Marigi Ala, n ba dimi kui.

sentences.english: As for God, his way is completely good; the word of the Lord is tested; he is a breastplate for all those who put their faith in him.
sentences.susu: Xa won birin na a ra, n mu gaaxuma gali xungbe gerede. N nɔma gere xɔrɔxɔɛ ra Ala xa mali saabui ra.

sentences.english: For who is God but the Lord? or who is a Rock but our God?
sentences.susu: Ala xa kira fan. Alatala xa masenyi tinxin. A mixie kantama naxee yigiya fenma a ra.

sentences.english: God puts a strong band about me, guiding me in a straight way.
sentences.susu: Ala gbɛtɛ mu na, fo Alatala. Sɛnbɛma mu na, fo won Marigi Ala.

sentences.english: He makes my feet like roes' feet, and puts me on high places.
sentences.susu: Ala nan sɛnbɛ fima n ma, a n naɲɛrɛ sɛniyɛnyi kui.

sentences.english: He makes my hands expert in war, so that a bow of brass is bent by my arms.
sentences.susu: A n malima n xa lu alɔ xeli, naxan fata ɲɛrɛde yire xɔrɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: You have given me the breastplate of your salvation: your right hand has been my support, and your mercy has made me great.
sentences.susu: A bara n nafala gere kui, a n malima xali fanyi rawalide.

sentences.english: You have made my steps wide under me, so that my feet are kept from slipping.
sentences.susu: I bara n xun nakeli, i bara n tongo i xɔnyɛ i, i bara i ɲɛngi sa n xɔn ma. Na nan a niyaxi n dariyɛ sɔtɔxi,

sentences.english: I go after my haters and overtake them; not turning back till they are all overcome.
sentences.susu: n sɛnbɛ sɔtɔxi, alako n naxa bira.

sentences.english: I will give them wounds, so that they are not able to get up: they are stretched under my feet.
sentences.susu: N birama n yaxuie fɔxɔ ra han n e suxu. N mu gbilenma e fɔxɔ ra fo n nɔ e ra.

sentences.english: For I have been armed by you with strength for the fight: you have made low under me those who come out against me.
sentences.susu: N nee rabirama nɛ han e mu nɔ kelide sɔnɔn, e fa lu n sanyi bun.

sentences.english: By you their backs are turned in flight, so that my haters are cut off.
sentences.susu: I sɛnbɛ soma n yi ra n ma gere kui. I n yaxuie ragoroma n bun ma,

sentences.english: They were crying out, but there was no one to come to their help: even to the Lord, but he gave them no answer.
sentences.susu: i a niya n xa nɔ e ra. N xɔnmixie mu wɔyɛnma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Then they were crushed as small as dust before the wind; they were drained out like the waste of the streets.
sentences.susu: E mixie xilima e xa fa e mali, kɔnɔ mixi yo mu e rakisima. E Alatala xilima, kɔnɔ a fan mu e yaabima.

sentences.english: You have made me free from the fightings of the people; you have made me the head of the nations: a people of whom I had no knowledge will be my servants.
sentences.susu: N e luxutama nɛ e fa lu alɔ xube, foye naxan xaninma. N e boronma alɔ bɛndɛ.

sentences.english: From the time when my name comes to their ears they will be ruled by me: men of other countries will, with false hearts, put themselves under my authority.
sentences.susu: I bara n natanga ɲama murutaxi ma, i fa n findi sie xunyi ra. N mu naxan kolon na bara lu n bun ma.

sentences.english: They will be wasting away, they will come out of their secret places shaking with fear.
sentences.susu: E n xui rabatuma, xɔɲɛe wɔyɛn ɲɔxunmɛ falama n bɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord is living; praise be to my Rock, and let the God of my salvation be honoured.
sentences.susu: E mu suusama n ya ra. E minima e xa tɛtɛ makantaxi kui gaaxui ra.

sentences.english: It is God who sends punishment on my haters, and puts peoples under my rule.
sentences.susu: Alatala sɛnbɛ mu ɲɔnma abadan. Tantui na n ma Kantama bɛ. Tantui na n Marigi Ala Marakisima bɛ.

sentences.english: He makes me free from my haters; I am lifted up over those who come up against me: you have made me free from the violent man.
sentences.susu: Ala nan n gbeɲɔxɔma. Ala nan sie rabirama n ma nɔɛ bun ma.

sentences.english: Because of this I will give you praise, O Lord, among the nations, and will make a song of praise to your name.
sentences.susu: Ala nan n natangama n yaxuie ma. I tan nan n itema n yaxuie xun ma. I tan nan n natangama suutee ma.

sentences.english: Great salvation does he give to his king; he has mercy on the king of his selection, David, and on his seed for ever.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n i tantuma sie tagi na birin nan ma, n bɛɛti bama nɛ i bɛ.

sentences.english: The heavens are sounding the glory of God; the arch of the sky makes clear the work of his hands.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: Day after day it sends out its word, and night after night it gives knowledge.
sentences.susu: Koore Ala xa nɔrɛ masenma. Koore walaxɛ Ala xa wali masenma.

sentences.english: There are no words or language; their voice makes no sound.
sentences.susu: Yanyi lɔnni masenma lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ. Dimi xaxili masenma kɔɛ yo kɔɛ.

sentences.english: Their line has gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them has he put a tent for the sun,
sentences.susu: Xui yati yati mu a ra, wɔyɛnyi fan mu a ra. Tuli mu nɔma e xui mɛde.

sentences.english: Who is like a newly married man coming from his bride-tent, and is glad like a strong runner starting on his way.
sentences.susu: E fɔxi toma duniɲa birin ma. E fɔxi yire makuye birin lima, han soge sa sama kankira naxan kui.

sentences.english: His going out is from the end of the heaven, and his circle to the ends of it; there is nothing which is not open to his heat.
sentences.susu: Soge minima nɛ alɔ xɛmɛ naxan baxi ginɛ dɔxɔde, a fa mini a xa konkoe kui, alɔ mixi xungbe naxan ɲɛrɛma a yɛtɛ xa kira xɔn.

sentences.english: The law of the Lord is good, giving new life to the soul: the witness of the Lord is certain, giving wisdom to the foolish.
sentences.susu: A ɲɛrɛ fɔlɔma sogetede, a sa ɲɔn sogegorode. Sese mu nɔma a wuyenyi bade.

sentences.english: The orders of the Lord are right, making glad the heart: the rule of the Lord is holy, giving light to the eyes.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa sɛriyɛ, sɛriyɛ fanyi na a ra. A sɛnbɛ fima mixi ma. Alatala xa nɔndi, nɔndi yati na a ra. A lɔnnitare findima lɔnnila ra.

sentences.english: The fear of the Lord is clean, and has no end; the decisions of the Lord are true and full of righteousness.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa nɔɛ, nɔɛ tinxinxi na a ra. A mixi bɔɲɛ raɲɛlɛxinma nɛ. Alatala xa masenyi, masenyi tinsexi na a ra. A mixi xaxili ya rabima nɛ.

sentences.english: More to be desired are they than gold, even than much shining gold; sweeter than the dropping honey.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa yaragaaxui, fe sɛniyɛnxi na a ra. A mu ɲɔnma abadan. Alatala xa yaamari, yaamari fanyi na a ra. A birin tinxin.

sentences.english: By them is your servant made conscious of danger, and in keeping them there is great reward.
sentences.susu: Ala xa yaamari, a fan xɛɛma bɛ, a fan dangi xɛɛma fanyi birin na. Ala xa yaamari, a ɲɔxun kumi bɛ, a ɲɔxun dangi kumi fanyi birin na.

sentences.english: Who has full knowledge of his errors? make me clean from secret evil.
sentences.susu: I xa konyi xaxili sɔtɔma nɛ i xa sɛriyɛ kui. A geeni gbegbe toma nɛ naa.

sentences.english: Keep your servant back from sins of pride; let them not have rule over me: then will I be upright and free from great sin.
sentences.susu: Nde nɔma a yɛtɛ kan yuge ɲaaxie birin kolonde? I xa n ma yunubi nɔxunxi xafari n mu naxan kolon.

sentences.english: Let the words of my mouth and the thoughts of my heart be pleasing in your eyes, O Lord, my strength and my salvation.
sentences.susu: I xa n ma yunubi makɛnɛnxi makuya n na. A naxa n suxu sɛnbɛ ra. Na tɛmui n fama findide mixi tinxinxi ra, naxan mu yunubi ɲaaxi rabama.

sentences.english: May the Lord give ear to you in the day of trouble; may you be placed on high by the name of the God of Jacob;
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: May he send you help from the holy place, and give you strength from Zion;
sentences.susu: Alatala xa i yaabi i xa tɔɔrɛ kui. Yaxuba Marigi Ala xa i ratanga.

sentences.english: May he keep all your offerings in mind, and be pleased with the fat of your burned offerings; (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Ala xa i mali kelife a xa yire sɛniyɛnxi, a xa i mali kelife Siyon geya fari.

sentences.english: May he give you your heart's desire, and put all your purposes into effect.
sentences.susu: Ala xa i xa sɛrɛxɛ birin suxu, a xa ɲɛlɛxin i xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie ra. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: We will be glad in your salvation, and in the name of our God we will put up our flags: may the Lord give you all your requests.
sentences.susu: Ala xa i waxɔnfe fi i ma, a xa i xa wali sɔɔnɛya i bɛ.

sentences.english: Now am I certain that the Lord gives salvation to his king; he will give him an answer from his holy heaven with the strength of salvation in his right hand.
sentences.susu: Won won xui itema ɲɛlɛxinyi kui. Won won ma tɔnxuma itema won Marigi Ala xili ra. Alatala xa i xa maxandi birin nasuxu.

sentences.english: Some put their faith in carriages and some in horses; but we will be strong in the name of the Lord our God.
sentences.susu: N a kolon a Alatala a xa mixi sugandixi rakisima nɛ. A a yaabima nɛ a sɛnbɛ ra kelife ra a xa yire sɛniyɛnxi.

sentences.english: They are bent down and made low; but we have been lifted up.
sentences.susu: Nde lama a xa sɔɔri ragise ra, nde lama a xa soee ra, kɔnɔ won tan laxi won Marigi Alatala xili nan na.

sentences.english: Come to our help, Lord: let the king give ear to our cry.
sentences.susu: Soee tan birama nɛ, kɔnɔ won tan tixi tun.

sentences.english: The king will be glad in your strength, O Lord; how great will be his delight in your salvation!
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: You have given him his heart's desire, and have not kept back the request of his lips. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Alatala, mangɛ bara sɛɛwa i sɛnbɛ ra. A xa ɲɛlɛxinyi gbo barima i bara a rakisi.

sentences.english: For you go before him with the blessings of good things: you put a crown of fair gold on his head.
sentences.susu: I bara a waxɔnfe raba, i bara a xa dubɛ suxu. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: He made request to you for life, and you gave it to him, long life for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: I fama barakɛ ra a bɛ, i tɔnxuma mangɛ daaxi dɔxɔma a xun ma, a yailanxi xɛɛma ra.

sentences.english: His glory is great in your salvation: honour and authority have you put on him.
sentences.susu: A bara i maxandi a xa simaya xa fe ra. I bara na maxandi suxu, a xa simaya xɔn naxa kuya han.

sentences.english: For you have made him a blessing for ever: you have given him joy in the light of your face.
sentences.susu: I to a rakisi, a xa binyɛ naxa gbo. I naxa xunnakeli nun binyɛ fi a ma.

sentences.english: For the king has faith in the Lord, and through the mercy of the Most High he will not be moved.
sentences.susu: I naxa a findi barakatɔɛ xungbe ra. I naxa a rasɛɛwa i ya i.

sentences.english: Your hand will make a search for all your haters; your right hand will be hard on all those who are against you.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ lama Alatala nan na. A mu birama Ala Xili Xungbe xa hinnɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: You will make them like a flaming oven before you; the Lord in his wrath will put an end to them, and they will be burned up in the fire.
sentences.susu: I fama i yaxui birin suxude. I fama nɔde i xɔnmixie ra.

sentences.english: Their fruit will be cut off from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.
sentences.susu: I na fa, i e ɲɔnma nɛ, alɔ tɛ belebele wuri ganma ki naxɛ. Alatala xɔnɔma e ma han tɛ e gan.

sentences.english: For their thoughts were bitter against you: they had an evil design in their minds, which they were not able to put into effect.
sentences.susu: I bɔnsɔɛe bama nɛ duniɲa ma, i adamadie raɲɔn.

sentences.english: Their backs will be turned when you make ready the cords of your bow against their faces.
sentences.susu: E bara wa fe ɲaaxi rabafe i ra. E bara kata han, kɔnɔ na mu findixi sɔɔnɛya yo ra e bɛ,

sentences.english: Be lifted up, O Lord, in your strength; so will we make songs in praise of your power.
sentences.susu: barima i tan nan fama e ragide i xa xali ra.

sentences.english: My God, my God, why are you turned away from me? why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my crying?
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba alɔ bɛɛti naxan xili «Subaxɛ xeli.»

sentences.english: O my God, I make my cry in the day, and you give no answer; and in the night, and have no rest.
sentences.susu: Ala, n Marigi Ala, i n naboloxi munfe ra? I kisi makuya n na, i mu n wa xui ramɛ?

sentences.english: But you are holy, O you who are seated among the praises of Israel.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, kɔɛ nun yanyi, n i xilima, kɔnɔ i mu n ma xili ratinma.

sentences.english: Our fathers had faith in you: they had faith and you were their saviour.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan Sɛniyɛntɔɛ, i xa kibanyi rabilinxi Isirayila xa tantui ra.

sentences.english: They sent up their cry to you and were made free: they put their faith in you and were not put to shame.
sentences.susu: Muxu benbae bara danxaniya i ma. I bara e rakisi e xa danxaniya saabui ra.

sentences.english: But I am a worm and not a man; cursed by men, and looked down on by the people.
sentences.susu: E to i xili, i naxa e xɔrɛya. E bara danxaniya i ma. I mu e lu yaagi kui.

sentences.english: I am laughed at by all those who see me: pushing out their lips and shaking their heads they say,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n tan bara findi mixi xuri ra alɔ dondoli, alɔ mixi mu na n tan na. Adamadie n nayaagima, mixie n mayelema.

sentences.english: He put his faith in the Lord; let the Lord be his saviour now: let the Lord be his saviour, because he had delight in him.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan birin n toma, e yoma n ma. E dɛ pɛtɛsima n ma, e e bɛlɛxɛsole tima n ma a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: But it was you who took care of me from the day of my birth: you gave me faith even from my mother's breasts.
sentences.susu: E naxɛ, «I ya ti Alatala ra. A i rakisima, a i ratangama, barima i rafan a ma!»

sentences.english: I was in your hands even before my birth; you are my God from the time when I was in my mother's body.
sentences.susu: Ee Ala, i bara n namini n nga tɛɛgɛ, i bara n sa a kanke ma.

sentences.english: Be not far from me, for trouble is near; there is no one to give help.
sentences.susu: N xaxili tixi i ra kafi n bari tɛmui. I findixi n Marigi Ala ra kafi n baxi foye tode.

sentences.english: A great herd of oxen is round me: I am shut in by the strong oxen of Bashan.
sentences.susu: I naxa i makuya n na, barima kɔntɔfili bara wuya n xun. Malila yo mu na n fɛ ma.

sentences.english: I saw their mouths wide open, like lions crying after food.
sentences.susu: Sɛnbɛmae bara n nabilin alɔ Basan tuurae.

sentences.english: I am flowing away like water, and all my bones are out of place: my heart is like wax, it has become soft in my body.
sentences.susu: E dɛ rabixi alɔ yɛtɛ xaaɲɛe.

sentences.english: My throat is dry like a broken vessel; my tongue is fixed to the roof of my mouth, and the dust of death is on my lips.
sentences.susu: N nii na bafe n fate, n xɔrie na bafe e radɔxɔdee. N bɔɲɛ mu sama, limaniya bara ba n yi.

sentences.english: Dogs have come round me: I am shut in by the band of evil-doers; they made wounds in my hands and feet.
sentences.susu: N sɛnbɛ doloxi alɔ boora. N nɛnyi bara kankan n kɔn na. I na n mafindife bɛndɛ ra.

sentences.english: I am able to see all my bones; their looks are fixed on me:
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxi gali bara n nabilin alɔ baree. E bara n bɛlɛxɛ nun n sanyi tunba.

sentences.english: They make a division of my robes among them, by the decision of chance they take my clothing.
sentences.susu: N xɔri birin saxi kɛnɛ ma. E ya banbanxi n na.

sentences.english: Do not be far from me, O Lord: O my strength, come quickly to my help.
sentences.susu: E n ma dugie itaxunma e bore ma, E n ma dugi fanyi matoma a lanma a xa lu naxan bɛ.

sentences.english: Make my soul safe from the sword, my life from the power of the dog.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i naxa i makuya n na! N ma sɛnbɛma nan i ra. I xa i xulun n malide.

sentences.english: Be my saviour from the lion's mouth; let me go free from the horns of the cruel oxen.
sentences.susu: I xa n nii rakisi santidɛgɛma ma. I xa n natanga na baree ma.

sentences.english: I will give the knowledge of your name to my brothers: I will give you praise among the people.
sentences.susu: I xa n nakisi na yɛtɛe ma. I xa n nakisi na tuurae ferie ma.

sentences.english: You who have fear of the Lord, give him praise; all you seed of Jacob, give him glory; go in fear of him, all you seed of Israel.
sentences.susu: N i xili masenma nɛ n ma mixie bɛ, n i matɔxɔma nɛ ɲama tagi.

sentences.english: For he has not been unmoved by the pain of him who is troubled; or kept his face covered from him; but he has given an answer to his cry.
sentences.susu: Wo tan naxan gaaxuma Alatala ya ra, wo xa a tantu. Wo tan naxan kelixi wo benba Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ, wo xa a matɔxɔ. Wo tan naxan kelima Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ, wo xa gaaxu a ya ra.

sentences.english: My praise will be of you in the great meeting: I will make my offerings before his worshippers.
sentences.susu: Ala mu yoma misikiinɛ xa tɔɔrɛ ma. A mu a yɛtɛ nɔxunma a ma xɛ, a a xa maxandi suxuma nɛ.

sentences.english: The poor will have a feast of good things: those who make search for the Lord will give him praise: your heart will have life for ever.
sentences.susu: Ala, n i matɔxɔma ɲama xungbe ya ma. N fama n ma laayidi rakamalide mixie bɛ, naxee gaaxuma Ala ya ra.

sentences.english: All the ends of the earth will keep it in mind and be turned to the Lord: all the families of the nations will give him worship.
sentences.susu: Mixi magoroxie fama e dɛgede, han e wasa. Naxee Alatala fenma, e fama a matɔxɔde. Ala xa simaya fi wo ma.

sentences.english: For the kingdom is the Lord's; he is the ruler among the nations.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa birin fama ratude Alatala xa fe ma, e man birin e ya rafindima a ma. Si birin fama e magorode a bɛ,

sentences.english: All the fat ones of the earth will give him worship; all those who go down to the dust will make themselves low before him, even he who has not enough for the life of his soul.
sentences.susu: barima birin na Alatala xa mangɛya nan bun. A si birin yamarima.

sentences.english: A seed will be his servant; the doings of the Lord will be made clear to the generation which comes after.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa sɛnbɛmae na gɛ e dɛgede, e birin fama e magorode Ala bɛ. Naxee birin findima bɛndɛ ra, e fama e xun sinde Ala bɛ. E mu nɔma e yɛtɛ nii ratangade.

sentences.english: They will come and make his righteousness clear to a people of the future because he has done this.
sentences.susu: Adamadie birin fama Ala batude. E e Marigi xa fe falama e bore bɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord takes care of me as his sheep; I will not be without any good thing.
sentences.susu: Alatala n mɛɛnima alɔ xuruse kantɛ a xa xuruse mɛɛnima ki naxɛ. Se birin na n yi ra n hayi na naxan ma.

sentences.english: He makes a resting-place for me in the green fields: he is my guide by the quiet waters.
sentences.susu: Alatala n xaninma fe fanyi ma, alɔ xuruse kantɛ xurusee xaninma ɲooge fanyi ma ki naxɛ, alɔ a e xun tima ye raxaraxi ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: He gives new life to my soul: he is my guide in the ways of righteousness because of his name.
sentences.susu: A sɛnbɛ fima n ma. A n tima kira tinxinxi xɔn, barima Alatala nan a ra.

sentences.english: Yes, though I go through the valley of deep shade, I will have no fear of evil; for you are with me, your rod and your support are my comfort.
sentences.susu: Hali n ɲɛrɛ dimi kui, n mu gaaxuma, barima i na n sɛɛti ma. I n kantama, i n xun tima yire fanyi ra.

sentences.english: You make ready a table for me in front of my haters: you put oil on my head; my cup is overflowing.
sentences.susu: I donse rafalama n bɛ n yaxuie ya xɔri. I se xiri ɲɔxunmɛ sama n ma. I n ma pɔɔti rafema minse ra a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Truly, blessing and mercy will be with me all the days of my life; and I will have a place in the house of the Lord all my days.
sentences.susu: Hɛɛri nun hinnɛnteya birama n fɔxɔ ra n ma duniɲɛigiri kui. N luma nɛ Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira kui lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ, han n ma duniɲɛigiri ɲɔn.

sentences.english: The earth is the Lord's, with all its wealth; the world and all the people living in it.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan gbe na bɔxi nun a isee birin na, duniɲa nun adamadi birin.

sentences.english: For by him it was based on the seas, and made strong on the deep rivers.
sentences.susu: A tan nan bɔxi dɔxɔxi baae nun xuree tagi.

sentences.english: Who may go up into the hill of the Lord? and who may come into his holy place?
sentences.susu: Nde nɔma tede Alatala xa geya fari? Nde nɔma sode a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui?

sentences.english: He who has clean hands and a true heart; whose desire has not gone out to foolish things, who has not taken a false oath.
sentences.susu: Naxan xa wali fan, naxan bɔɲɛ sɛniyɛn, naxan mu birama fe fufafu fɔxɔ ra, naxan mu wule falama, na kanyi nan soma Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: He will have blessing from the Lord, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.
sentences.susu: Alatala barakɛ sama a ma, a rakisima Ala a sare ragbilenma a ma.

sentences.english: This is the generation of those whose hearts are turned to you, even to your face, O God of Jacob. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Yi mixi mɔɔli nan Ala fenma. Yaxuba xa mixie wama Ala kolonfe. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: Let your heads be lifted up, O doors; be lifted up, O you eternal doors: that the King of glory may come in.
sentences.susu: Tɛtɛ naadɛe xa rabi, hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛ forie fan xa rabi. Nɔrɛ Kanyi na sofe.

sentences.english: Who is the King of glory? The Lord of strength and power, the Lord strong in war.
sentences.susu: Nde na yi Nɔrɛ Kanyi ra? Alatala sɛnbɛma nan a ra, Alatala, naxan sɛnbɛ gbo gere kui.

sentences.english: Let your heads be lifted up, O doors; let them be lifted up, O you eternal doors: that the King of glory may come in.
sentences.susu: Tɛtɛ naadɛe xa rabi, hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛ forie fan xa rabi. Nɔrɛ Kanyi na sofe.

sentences.english: Who is the King of glory? The Lord of armies, he is the King of glory. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Nde na yi Nɔrɛ Kanyi ra? Mangɛ Alatala nan Nɔrɛ Kanyi ra.

sentences.english: To you, O Lord, my soul is lifted up.
sentences.susu: N xaxili tixi i tan Alatala nan na.

sentences.english: O my God, I have put my faith in you, let me not be shamed; let not my haters be glorying over me.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, n bara n yɛtɛ taxu i ra alako yaagi naxa n sɔtɔ, alako n yaxuie naxa n mayele.

sentences.english: Let no servant of yours be put to shame; may those be shamed who are false without cause.
sentences.susu: Naxan yo la i ra, na kanyi mu yaagi sɔtɔma, kɔnɔ yanfante tan, yaagi sɔtɔma nɛ a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Make your steps clear to me, O Lord; give me knowledge of your ways.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa kira masen n bɛ, n xaran i xa kira ra.

sentences.english: Be my guide and teacher in the true way; for you are the God of my salvation; I am waiting for your word all the day.
sentences.susu: N naɲɛrɛ i xa nɔndi kira xɔn, i man xa n matinkan i xa kira ra, barima i tan Ala nan n nakisima. N xaxili tixi i ra lɔxɔɛ birin.

sentences.english: O Lord, keep in mind your pity and your mercies; for they have been from the earliest times.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i maɲɔxun i xa marafanyi nun i xa fonisireya ma, barima e na na kabi duniɲa fɔlɛ.

sentences.english: Do not keep in mind my sins when I was young, or my wrongdoing: let your memory of me be full of mercy, O Lord, because of your righteousness.
sentences.susu: I naxa i maɲɔxun n ma yunubi ma, n naxan nabaxi n ma sɛgɛtalaya kui, n i raxɔnɔxi tɛmui naxɛ. Alatala, i maɲɔxun n ma i xa fonisireya kui, barima i fan.

sentences.english: Good and upright is the Lord: so he will be the teacher of sinners in the way.
sentences.susu: Alatala fan, a tinxin. Na nan a toxi a kira masenma yunubitɔɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: He will be an upright guide to the poor in spirit: he will make his way clear to them.
sentences.susu: A tan nan mixi magoroxi raɲɛrɛma tinxinyi kui. A e matinkanma a xa kira ra.

sentences.english: All the ways of the Lord are mercy and good faith for those who keep his agreement and his witness.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa fonisireya nun tinxinyi na mixie bɛ, naxee a xa saatɛ nun a xa yaamari mabanbanma.

sentences.english: Because of your name, O Lord, let me have forgiveness for my sin, which is very great.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n ma yunubie xafari i xili xa fe ra, barima e mu xurun.

sentences.english: If a man has the fear of the Lord, the Lord will be his teacher in the way of his pleasure.
sentences.susu: Nde gaaxuma Alatala ya ra? Alatala kira masenma na kanyi bɛ a lanma a xa ɲɛrɛ naxan ma.

sentences.english: His soul will be full of good things, and his seed will have the earth for its heritage.
sentences.susu: A aligiyama lima nɛ sɛɛwɛ kui. A bɔnsɔɛ fan fama sabatide yi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: The secret of the Lord is with those in whose hearts is the fear of him; he will make his agreement clear to them.
sentences.susu: Alatala a xa gundo masenma mixie bɛ, naxee gaaxu a ya ra. A a xa saatɛ masenma nɛ e bɛ.

sentences.english: My eyes are turned to the Lord at all times; for he will take my feet out of the net.
sentences.susu: N xaxili tixi Alatala ra lɔxɔɛ birin barima a tan nan n natangama fe ɲaaxi ma.

sentences.english: Be turned to me, and have mercy on me; for I am troubled and have no helper.
sentences.susu: Alatala, yandi, hinnɛ n na, barima tɔɔrɔmixi nan n na, n malima fan mu na.

sentences.english: The troubles of my heart are increased: O take me out of my sorrows.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ bara tɔɔrɔ. N namini na tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: Give thought to my grief and my pain; and take away all my sins.
sentences.susu: I ya rasiga n ma sunnunyi nun n ma ɲaxankatɛ ma, i xa diɲɛ n ma yunubi birin ma.

sentences.english: See how those who are against me are increased, for bitter is their hate of me.
sentences.susu: I xa a mato n yaxuie wuyaxi ki naxɛ. E n xɔnxi a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: O keep my soul, and take me out of danger: let me not be shamed, for I have put my faith in you.
sentences.susu: N nii makanta, i xa n natanga, alako yaagi naxa n sɔtɔ i xa niini bun ma.

sentences.english: For my clean and upright ways keep me safe, because my hope is in you.
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ nun tinxinyi xa n kanta barima n xaxili tixi i tan na.
