sentences.english: Give Israel salvation, O God, out of all his troubles.
sentences.susu: Ala, Isirayila xunsara a xa tɔɔrɛ birin ma.

sentences.english: O Lord, be my judge, for my behaviour has been upright: I have put my faith in the Lord, I am not in danger of slipping.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa n ma kiiti sa, barima n ɲɛrɛ ki tinxin. N bara n yɛtɛ taxu i ra, n mu birama.

sentences.english: Put me in the scales, O Lord, so that I may be tested; let the fire make clean my thoughts and my heart.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n bɔɲɛ mato, n sondonyi makiiti,

sentences.english: For your mercy is before my eyes; and I have gone in the way of your good faith.
sentences.susu: barima n laxi i xa hinnɛ ra, n man n ɲɛrɛma i xa sɛriyɛ ma.

sentences.english: I have not taken my seat with foolish persons, and I do not go with false men.
sentences.susu: N mu luma wule falɛe ya ma, n mu ɲɛrɛma filankafuie tagi.

sentences.english: I have been a hater of the band of wrongdoers, and I will not be seated among sinners.
sentences.susu: Fe kobi rabae mu rafan n ma, n tan nun mixi ɲaaxie mu luma yire keren.

sentences.english: I will make my hands clean from sin; so will I go round your altar, O Lord;
sentences.susu: Alatala, n nan n ɲɛrɛ ki rasɛniyɛn, n man luma nɛ i xa sɛrɛxɛbade.

sentences.english: That I may give out the voice of praise, and make public all the wonders which you have done.
sentences.susu: N tantui bɛɛti bama, n i xa kaabanakoe masenma.

sentences.english: Lord, your house has been dear to me, and the resting-place of your glory.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi rafan n ma, i xa nɔrɛ na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Let not my soul be numbered among sinners, or my life among men of blood;
sentences.susu: I naxa n nii ba alɔ yunubitɔɛe nun faxatie.

sentences.english: In whose hands are evil designs, and whose right hands take money for judging falsely.
sentences.susu: E fe ɲaaxie rabama, e kɔbiri rasuxuma tinxintareya ra.

sentences.english: But as for me, I will go on in my upright ways: be my saviour, and have mercy on me.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n tan luma tinxinyi kui. N xun sara, i xa diɲɛ.

sentences.english: I have a safe resting-place for my feet; I will give praise to the Lord in the meetings of the people.
sentences.susu: N ɲɛrɛ ki tinxin. N Alatala tantuma nɛ malanyie kui.

sentences.english: The Lord is my light and my salvation; who is then a cause of fear to me? the Lord is the strength of my life; who is a danger to me?
sentences.susu: Alatala nan na n ma naiyalanyi ra. N nakisima na a ra. N lan n xa gaaxu nde ya ra? N ma duniɲɛigiri na Alatala nan ma niini bun ma. N lan n xa gaaxu nde ya ra?

sentences.english: When evil-doers, even my haters, came on me to put an end to me, they were broken and put to shame.
sentences.susu: N gerefae nun n yaxui naxee fe ɲaaxi rabama, e na fa n nahalakide, e tan nan birama.

sentences.english: Even if an army came against me with its tents, my heart would have no fear: if war was made on me, my faith would not be moved.
sentences.susu: Hali sɔɔri gaali n nabilin, n bɔɲɛ mu sɛrɛnma. Hali sɔɔri gaali fa n gerede, n bɔɲɛ suusama nɛ.

sentences.english: One prayer have I made to the Lord, and this is my heart's desire; that I may have a place in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, looking on his glory, and getting wisdom in his Temple.
sentences.susu: N fe keren nan maxɔrin Alatala ma, n na na nan fenfe. N wama lufe Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi nan kui n ma duniɲɛigiri birin, alako n xaxili xa ti Alatala xa fe fanyi ra, n man xa nɔ a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi matode.

sentences.english: For in the time of trouble he will keep me safe in his tent: in the secret place of his tent he will keep me from men's eyes; high on a rock he will put me.
sentences.susu: A n natangama nɛ tɔɔrɛ ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui. A n nɔxunma nɛ na niini bun ma. A n natema nɛ geya fari.

sentences.english: And now my head will be lifted up higher than my haters who are round me: because of this I will make offerings of joy in his tent; I will make a song, truly I will make a song of praise to the Lord.
sentences.susu: A n xun nakelima nɛ n yaxuie ya xɔri naxee n nabilinxi. N sɛrɛxɛ bama nɛ a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui ɲɛlɛxinyi ra. N suuki ba, n bɛɛti ba Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: O Lord, let the voice of my cry come to your ears: have mercy on me, and give me an answer.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i tuli mati n xui ra, n na i maxandife. Hinnɛ n na, i man xa n yaabi.

sentences.english: When you said, Make search for my face, my heart said to you, For your face will I make my search.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ wama i fenfe. Alatala, n i fenma nɛ.

sentences.english: Let not your face be covered from me; do not put away your servant in wrath; you have been my help: do not give me up or take your support from me, O God of my salvation.
sentences.susu: I naxa i kobe ti n na. I naxa mɛɛ i xa konyi ra xɔnɛ kui. I tan nan na n malima ra. N ma marakisima Ala, i naxa n nabolo, i naxa n nabɛɲin.

sentences.english: When my father and my mother are turned away from me, then the Lord will be my support.
sentences.susu: Xa n nga nun n ba n nabolo, Alatala tan a makɔrɛma nɛ n na.

sentences.english: Make your way clear to me, O Lord, guiding me by the right way, because of my haters.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa kira masen n bɛ. N xun ti kira tinxinxi ra, alako n yaxuie naxa n suxu.

sentences.english: Do not give me into their hands, because false witnesses have come out against me, and men breathing destruction.
sentences.susu: I naxa n nabolo n yaxuie xa e sago raba n na, barima e bara findi tɔɔɲɛgɛlae ra n bɛ. Fe kobi rabae nan lanxi e ma.

sentences.english: I had almost given up my hope of seeing the blessing of the Lord in the land of the living.
sentences.susu: N laxi a ra n Alatala xa fe fanyi toma nɛ yi duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari.

sentences.english: Let your hope be in the Lord: take heart and be strong; yes, let your hope be in the Lord.
sentences.susu: I xaxili ti Alatala ra. I sɛnbɛ xun xa masa, i xa limaniya. I xaxili ti Alatala ra.

sentences.english: My cry goes up to you, O Lord, my Rock; do not keep back your answer from me, so that I may not become like those who go down into the underworld.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n bara i xili. I xa sɛnbɛ luma n bɛ alɔ fanye. I tuli mati n na, xa na mu a ra n luma alɔ faxa mixi.

sentences.english: Give ear to the voice of my prayer, when I am crying to you, when my hands are lifted up to your holy place.
sentences.susu: N na n bɛlɛxɛ ite i bɛ i xa yire sɛniyɛnxi mabiri, i xa n ma maxandi xui ramɛ.

sentences.english: Do not take me away with the sinners and the workers of evil, who say words of peace to their neighbours, but evil is in their hearts.
sentences.susu: I naxa n lu alɔ mixi ɲaaxie nun tinxintaree. E e boore yanfama, e bɔɲɛ mu fan.

sentences.english: Give them the right reward of their acts, and of their evil doings: give them punishment for the works of their hands, let them have their full reward.
sentences.susu: E xa wali kobi sare ragbilen e ma. E naxan nabaxi mixie ra, i xa na raba e fan na. A lanma e xa na mɔɔli sɔtɔ,

sentences.english: Because they have no respect for the works of the Lord, or for the things which his hands have made, they will be broken down and not lifted up by him.
sentences.susu: barima e mu Alatala xa wali kolon. A fama e rabirade, e mu keli sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: May the Lord be praised, because he has given ear to the voice of my prayer.
sentences.susu: Alatala tantu, a bara n ma dubɛ suxu.

sentences.english: The Lord is my strength and my breastplate, my heart had faith in him and I am helped; for this cause my heart is full of rapture, and I will give him praise in my song.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan na n sɛnbɛ nun n kantama ra. N xaxili tixi a tan nan na naxan n malima. N bɔɲɛ sɛɛwama nɛ, n fa bɛɛti ba a bɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord is their strength, and a strong place of salvation for his king.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan a xa ɲama sɛnbɛ ra, a findi a xa mixi sugandixi kantama ra.

sentences.english: Be a saviour to your people, and send a blessing on your heritage: be their guide, and let them be lifted up for ever.
sentences.susu: I xa ɲama rakisi, i xa barakɛ ragoro e ma. Mɛɛni e ma alɔ xuruse dɛmadonyi mɛɛnima a xa gɔɔrɛ ma ki naxɛ. I ɲɛngi dɔxɔ e xɔn ma abadan.

sentences.english: Give to the Lord, you sons of the gods, give to the Lord glory and strength.
sentences.susu: Malekɛe, wo Alatala matɔxɔ, a xa binyɛ nun a sɛnbɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Give to the Lord the full glory of his name; give him worship in holy robes.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Alatala matɔxɔ, wo xa a batu a nɔrɛ sɛniyɛnxi kui.

sentences.english: The voice of the Lord is on the waters: the God of glory is thundering, the Lord is on the great waters.
sentences.susu: Alatala xui mɛma baa ma, Ala Binyɛ Kanyi xui luma alɔ galanyi, a a xui rasigama baa xungbee ma.

sentences.english: The voice of the Lord is full of power; the voice of the Lord has a noble sound.
sentences.susu: Alatala xui sɛnbɛ gbo, a magaaxu.

sentences.english: By the voice of the Lord are the cedar-trees broken, even the cedars of Lebanon are broken by the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala xui wuri bili xungbee igirama, alɔ naxee na Liban bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: He makes them go jumping about like a young ox; Lebanon and Sirion like a young mountain ox.
sentences.susu: Alatala Liban wuri bilie ituganma alɔ ninge di, a Siriyon geya ituganma alɔ sɛxɛ i ninge.

sentences.english: At the voice of the Lord flames of fire are seen.
sentences.susu: Alatala xui tɛ rayensenma alɔ seyamakɔnyi.

sentences.english: At the voice of the Lord there is a shaking in the waste land, even a shaking in the waste land of Kadesh.
sentences.susu: Alatala xui Kadesi gbengberenyi rasɛrɛnma.

sentences.english: At the voice of the Lord the roes give birth, the leaves are taken from the trees: in his Temple everything says, Glory.
sentences.susu: Alatala xui a niyama xelie nun sie xa bari. Ɲama birin e xui itema a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, a a fala, «Matɔxɔɛ na Ala bɛ!»

sentences.english: The Lord had his seat as king when the waters came on the earth; the Lord is seated as king for ever.
sentences.susu: Alatala nu na a xa kibanyi kui duniɲa banbaran yɛ tɛmui naxɛ. A xa mangɛya mu ɲɔnma abadan.

sentences.english: The Lord will give strength to his people; the Lord will give his people the blessing of peace.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan sɛnbɛ fima a xa ɲama ma, a barakɛ nun bɔɲɛsa fima e ma.

sentences.english: I will give you praise and honour, O Lord, because through you I have been lifted up; you have not given my haters cause to be glad over me.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti a naxan sɛbɛ Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa fe ra

sentences.english: O Lord my God, I sent up my cry to you, and you have made me well.
sentences.susu: N bara i matɔxɔ Alatala, barima i bara n nakeli. I mu tin n yaxuie xa xunnakeli sɔtɔ n xun ma.

sentences.english: O Lord, you have made my soul come again from the underworld: you have given me life and kept me from going down among the dead.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala, n to i xili, i naxa n nayalan.

sentences.english: Make songs to the Lord, O you saints of his, and give praise to his holy name.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i naxa n nii rakisi saya ma, i mu tin n xa goro gaburi kui.

sentences.english: For his wrath is only for a minute; in his grace there is life; weeping may be for a night, but joy comes in the morning.
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛe, wo xa bɛɛti ba Alatala bɛ, wo xa a xili matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: When things went well for me I said, I will never be moved.
sentences.susu: A xa xɔnɛ mu buma, kɔnɔ a hinnɛma i ra i xa simaya birin kui. Nunmare, mixie wama, kɔnɔ gɛɛsɛgɛ e fa ɲɛlɛxin.

sentences.english: Lord, by your grace you have kept my mountain strong: when your face was turned from me I was troubled.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛsa sɔtɔ tɛmui naxɛ n naxa a fala, «N mu nɔma birade.»

sentences.english: My voice went up to you, O Lord; I made my prayer to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala, tɛmui dangixi i naxa n sɛnbɛ lu alɔ geya, kɔnɔ yakɔsi i bara i nɔxun n ma. N bɔɲɛ bara ifu.

sentences.english: What profit is there in my blood if I go down into the underworld? will the dust give you praise, or be a witness to your help?
sentences.susu: Alatala, n naxa i xili, n naxa i maxandi.

sentences.english: Give ear to me, O Lord, and have mercy on me: Lord, be my helper.
sentences.susu: N naxa a fala i bɛ, «N ma faxɛ findima geeni mundun na i bɛ? Xa n bara goro gaburi kui, na nɔma findide matɔxɔɛ ra i bɛ? Na nɔma i xa lanlanteya masende duniɲa bɛ?»

sentences.english: By you my sorrow is turned into dancing; you have taken away my clothing of grief, and given me robes of joy;
sentences.susu: Alatala, i tuli mati n na, i xa kinikini n ma. Alatala, n mali.

sentences.english: So that my glory may make songs of praise to you and not be quiet. O Lord my God, I will give you praise for ever.
sentences.susu: I bara n ma nimisɛ masara sɛɛwɛ ra. I bara n ma sunnun donma masara ɲɛlɛxin donma ra.

sentences.english: In you, O Lord, have I put my hope; let me never be shamed; keep me safe in your righteousness.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: Let your ear be turned to me; take me quickly out of danger; be my strong Rock, my place of strength where I may be safe.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n bara n xaxili ti i ra. I naxa tin n xa lu yaagi kui, i xa kiiti fanyi sa n ma.

sentences.english: For you are my Rock and my strong tower; go in front of me and be my guide, because of your name.
sentences.susu: I xa i tuli mati n na, n nakisi. I xa lu n bɛ alɔ fanye, alɔ yire makantaxi alako n xa kisi.

sentences.english: Take me out of the net which they have put ready for me secretly; for you are my strength.
sentences.susu: N ma sɛnbɛma nun n ma kantama nan i ra. I xa n xun ti kira fanyi xɔn i xili fanyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Into your hands I give my spirit; you are my saviour, O Lord God for ever true.
sentences.susu: N yaxuie bara yɛlɛ itala n ya ra, kɔnɔ i fama n natangade na ma.

sentences.english: I am full of hate for those who go after false gods; but my hope is in the Lord.
sentences.susu: N bara n xaxili ti i ra. Alatala Nɔndi Marigi, i bara n nakisi.

sentences.english: I will be glad and have delight in your mercy; because you have seen my trouble; you have had pity on my soul in its sorrows;
sentences.susu: Kuye batui mu rafan n ma, n tan, nan n taxuma Alatala nan na.

sentences.english: And you have not given me into the hand of my hater; you have put my feet in a wide place.
sentences.susu: N sɛɛwama nɛ i xa hinnɛ xa fe ra, barima i bara n ma tɔɔrɛe to, n sondonyi na ɲaxankata, i na kolon.

sentences.english: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am in trouble; my eyes are wasted with grief, I am wasted in soul and body.
sentences.susu: I mu n soxi n yaxuie yi ra, i bara n xɔrɛya.

sentences.english: My life goes on in sorrow, and my years in weeping; my strength is almost gone because of my sin, and my bones are wasted away.
sentences.susu: Alatala, hinnɛ n na, barima n na tɔɔrɔfe. N fate birin bara ba n ma.

sentences.english: Because of all those who are against me, I have become a word of shame to my neighbours; a cause of shaking the head and a fear to my friends: those who saw me in the street went in flight from me.
sentences.susu: N ma simaya na ɲɔnfe tɔɔrɛ kui. N ma duniɲɛigiri xɔrɔxɔ. N sɛnbɛ bara ɲɔn n ma yunubi xa fe ra. N fate bara kana

sentences.english: I have gone from men's minds and memory like a dead man; I am like a broken vessel.
sentences.susu: n yaxuie xa fe ra. N bara yaagi n dɔxɔbooree xɔn ma. N booree, xa na mu a ra naxee n toma taa kui, e e gima nɛ n ma.

sentences.english: False statements against me have come to my ears; fear was on every side: they were talking together against me, designing to take away my life.
sentences.susu: E birin bara nɛɛmu n ma alɔ n ɲan bara faxa. N luxi alɔ se lɔɛxi.

sentences.english: But I had faith in you, O Lord; I said, You are my God.
sentences.susu: N bara n yaxuie xui mɛ. Gbaloe na n nabilinyi. E bara lan a ma e xa n faxa.

sentences.english: The chances of my life are in your hand; take me out of the hands of my haters, and of those who go after me.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n tan bara n taxu i ra, i tan n Marigi Alatala.

sentences.english: Let your servant see the light of your face; in your mercy be my saviour.
sentences.susu: N na i sagoe. N natanga n yaxuie ma naxee wama n ɲaxankatafe.

sentences.english: Let me not be shamed, O Lord, for I have made my prayer to you; let the sinners be shamed, and let their mouths be shut in the underworld.
sentences.susu: I xa i xa konyi to, n nakisi i xa hinnɛ ra.

sentences.english: Let the false lips be shut, which say evil against the upright, looking down on him in their pride.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n na i xili, i naxa n lu yaagi kui. Ala xa mixi ɲaaxie rayaagi, Ala xa e rasabari faxɛ ra.

sentences.english: O how great is your grace, which you have put in store for your worshippers, and which you have made clear to those who had faith in you, before the sons of men!
sentences.susu: Ala xa e xui radundu, barima yi wule falɛe e yɛtɛ igboma, e yo tinxintɔɛe ma.

sentences.english: You will keep them safe in your house from the designs of man; in the secret of your tent will you keep them from angry tongues.
sentences.susu: I xa hinnɛ gbo, i naxan nagataxi i yaragaaxuie bɛ, naxee i xa kantari fenma.

sentences.english: May the Lord be praised, because he has made clear to me the wonder of his grace in a strong town.
sentences.susu: I bara e yigiya alako fe kobi rabae naxa e suxu. I bara e ratanga wule falɛe ma.

sentences.english: And as for me, I said in my fear, I am cut off from before your eyes; but you gave ear to the voice of my prayer, when my cry went up to you.
sentences.susu: Alatala tantu, barima a bara hinnɛ n na n ma tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: O have love for the Lord, all you his saints; for the Lord keeps safe from danger all those who are true to him, and gives the workers of pride their right reward.
sentences.susu: N ma gaaxui kui, n nu bara a fala, «I bara i nɔxun n ma,» kɔnɔ i bara n ma maxandi suxu.

sentences.english: Put away fear and let your heart be strong, all you whose hope is in the Lord.
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛe, wo xa Alatala xanu. Alatala togondiyatɔɛe rakisima nɛ, kɔnɔ a yɛtɛ igboe ɲaxankatama nɛ.

sentences.english: Happy is he who has forgiveness for his wrongdoing, and whose sin is covered.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛlɛxinyi na adama bɛ naxan xa yunubi bara ba, naxan xa fe kobi bara xafari.

sentences.english: Happy is the man in whom the Lord sees no evil, and in whose spirit there is no deceit.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛlɛxinyi na adama bɛ Alatala bara diɲɛ naxan ma fe kobi ma, a nun maifui mu na naxan xaxili ya ma.

sentences.english: When I kept my mouth shut, my bones were wasted, because of my crying all through the day.
sentences.susu: Danmi n dunduxi, n mu nɔma minide tɔɔrɛ kui. N nu tɔɔrɔma nɛ yanyi birin na.

sentences.english: For the weight of your hand was on me day and night; my body became dry like the earth in summer. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ nun yanyi i xa tɔɔrɛ na n fari. N sɛnbɛ bara kana, a bara lu alɔ gbengberen yire.

sentences.english: I made my wrongdoing clear to you, and did not keep back my sin. I said, I will put it all before the Lord; and you took away my wrongdoing and my sin. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: N bara n ma yunubi masen i bɛ, n mu n ma yunubi nɔxunxi fa. N bara a fala, «Fo n xa n ma yunubi ya xaran Alatala bɛ.» I tan Alatala bara n ma yunubi ba n ma.

sentences.english: For this cause let every saint make his prayer to you at a time when you are near: then the overflowing of the great waters will not overtake him.
sentences.susu: Mixi tinxinxi birin xa i maxandi a waxati. Xa tɔɔrɛ gbo alɔ banbaranyi, a mu sese niyama a ra.

sentences.english: You are my safe and secret place; you will keep me from trouble; you will put songs of salvation on the lips of those who are round me. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: N ma kantari lanxi i tan nan ma. I man sunnunyi bama n ma. N i tantuma nɛ i xa maratangɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: I will give you knowledge, teaching you the way to go; my eye will be your guide.
sentences.susu: N wo xaranma nɛ kira ra wo lan wo xa bira naxan fɔxɔ ra. N wo rasima nɛ, n nan n ɲɛngi sama nɛ wo xa fe xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Do not be like the horse or the ass, without sense; ...
sentences.susu: Wo naxa lu alɔ soe, xa na mu a ra sofale xaxilitare, naxan mu raɲɛrɛma fo karafoe ra.

sentences.english: The sinner will be full of trouble; but mercy will be round the man who has faith in the Lord.
sentences.susu: Fe xɔnɛ gbegbe ragataxi mixi ɲaaxi bɛ, kɔnɔ naxan a xaxili tixi Alatala ra, Ala xa fonisireya na kanyi rabilinma nɛ.

sentences.english: Be glad in the Lord with joy, you upright men; give cries of joy, all you whose hearts are true.
sentences.susu: Mixi tinxinxie, wo sɛɛwa Alatala ra, wo man xa ɲɛlɛxin. Wo Ala tantu ɲɛlɛxinyi kui wo xui itexi ra, wo tan mixi tinxinxie birin.

sentences.english: Be glad in the Lord, O doers of righteousness; for praise is beautiful for the upright.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛe, wo xa Alatala matɔxɔ wo xui itexi ra. Tinxintɔɛe lan e xa Ala matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: Give praise to the Lord on the corded instrument; make melody to him with instruments of music.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Alatala tantu kɔra ra, wo xa bɛɛti ba kɔra ra luuti fu daaxi.

sentences.english: Make a new song to him; playing expertly with a loud noise.
sentences.susu: Wo xa bɛɛti nɛɛnɛ ba a bɛ, wo xa na raba maxasee ra wo xui itexi ra.

sentences.english: For the word of the Lord is upright, and all his works are certain.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi tinxin, a a xa wali birin nabama sɔɔbɛ ra.

sentences.english: His delight is in righteousness and wisdom; the earth is full of the mercy of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Tinxinyi nun sɛriyɛ rafan a ma, duniɲa birin nafexi Alatala xa hinnɛ ra.

sentences.english: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made; and all the army of heaven by the breath of his mouth.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa koore daa a xa wɔyɛnyi ra. A to wɔyɛn keren fala, tunbuie naxa mini keren na.

sentences.english: He makes the waters of the sea come together in a mass; he keeps the deep seas in store-houses.
sentences.susu: A naxa baa fan malan yire keren, a xa ye ragata.

sentences.english: Let the earth be full of the fear of the Lord; let all the people of the world be in holy fear of him.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi birin xa gaaxu Alatala ya ra. Duniɲa mixi birin xa a binya.

sentences.english: For he gave the word, and it was done; by his order it was fixed for ever.
sentences.susu: A na wɔyɛn, a fe ragirima nɛ. A na yaamari fi, a rabama nɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord undoes the designs of the nations; he makes the thoughts of the peoples without effect.
sentences.susu: Alatala sie xa natɛe kanama nɛ. A mu e xa wali sɔɔnɛyama.

sentences.english: The Lord's purpose is eternal, the designs of his heart go on through all the generations of man.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala xa fe ragirixie buma abadan. A waxɔnfe sɔɔnɛyama nɛ waxati birin.

sentences.english: Happy is the nation whose God is the Lord; and the people whom he has taken for his heritage.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛlɛxinyi na si bɛ naxan marigi findixi Alatala ra. Ɲɛlɛxinyi na bɔnsɔɛ bɛ Alatala naxan sugandixi.

sentences.english: The Lord is looking down from heaven; he sees all the sons of men;
sentences.susu: Alatala a ya ragoroma duniɲa ma kelife ariyanna, a mixi birin mato.

sentences.english: From his house he keeps watch on all who are living on the earth;
sentences.susu: Kelife a xɔnyi, a duniɲa mixi birin matoma nɛ.

sentences.english: He makes all their hearts; their works are clear to him.
sentences.susu: Naxan adamadie bɔɲɛ daaxi, a a ɲɛngi sama e xa walie xɔn.

sentences.english: A king's salvation is not in the power of his army; a strong man does not get free by his great strength.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ yo mu kisima a xa sɔɔrie saabui ra. Sɔɔri fan mu kisima a yɛtɛ sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: A horse is a false hope; his great power will not make any man free from danger.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri ɲɔxɔ a ma a xa soe nɔma a rakiside, kɔnɔ na tan mu findima kisi ra a bɛ.

sentences.english: See, the eye of the Lord is on those in whose hearts is the fear of him, on those whose hope is in his mercy;
sentences.susu: Alatala nan mɛɛnima mixie ma naxee gaaxuma a ya ra, naxee e xaxili tima a xa hinnɛ ra,

sentences.english: To keep their souls from death; and to keep them living in time of need.
sentences.susu: alako e nii naxa laaxira, alako e xa balo kaamɛ waxati.

sentences.english: Our souls are waiting for the Lord; he is our help and our salvation.
sentences.susu: Won xaxili tixi Alatala nan na. A tan nan won malima ra, a tan nan won kantama ra.

sentences.english: For in him our hearts have joy; in his holy name is our hope.
sentences.susu: Won bɔɲɛe sɛɛwaxi a tan nan ma fe ra, barima won bara la a xili sɛniyɛnxi ra.

sentences.english: Let your mercy be on us, O Lord, as we are waiting for you.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa hinnɛ muxu ra, barima muxu xaxili tixi i tan nan na.

sentences.english: I will be blessing the Lord at all times; his praise will be ever in my mouth.
sentences.susu: Dawuda to a yɛtɛ findi daxui ra Abimeleki ya i alako a xa a bɛɲin, a naxa yi bɛɛti sɛbɛ.

sentences.english: My soul will say great things of the Lord: the poor in spirit will have knowledge of it and be glad.
sentences.susu: N Alatala tantuma waxati birin. A xa matɔxɔɛ mu bama n dɛ i.

sentences.english: O give praise to the Lord with me; let us be witnesses together of his great name.
sentences.susu: N Alatala matɔxɔma n bɔɲɛ kui. Tɔɔrɔmixie fama nɛ na mɛde, e fa sɛɛwa.

sentences.english: I was searching for the Lord, and he gave ear to my voice, and made me free from all my fears.
sentences.susu: Won birin xa Alatala binya, won xa a xili matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: Let your eyes be turned to him and you will have light, and your faces will not be shamed.
sentences.susu: N to Alatala maxandi, a naxa n yaabi, a n ma gaaxui birin ba n yi.

sentences.english: This poor man's cry came before the Lord, and he gave him salvation from all his troubles.
sentences.susu: Naxan na a ya ti Ala ra, a sɛɛwama nɛ, a mu yaagima.

sentences.english: The angel of the Lord is ever watching over those who have fear of him, to keep them safe.
sentences.susu: Xa tɔɔrɔmixi a xui ramini, Alatala a mɛma nɛ, a fa a rakisi a xa tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: By experience you will see that the Lord is good; happy is the man who has faith in him.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ Ala yaragaaxuie rabilinma nɛ, a e kanta.

sentences.english: Keep yourselves in the fear of the Lord, all you his saints; for those who do so will have no need of anything.
sentences.susu: Wo a mato, Alatala fan de! Ɲɛlɛxinyi na adama bɛ naxan xaxili tixi a ra.

sentences.english: The young lions are in need and have no food; but those who are looking to the Lord will have every good thing.
sentences.susu: Sɛniyɛntɔɛe, wo xa gaaxu Alatala ya ra, alako wo hayi birin xa fan.

sentences.english: Come, children, give attention to me; I will be your teacher in the fear of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kaamɛ yɛtɛe suxuma nɛ, kɔnɔ Alatala fenmae hayi birin fanma nɛ.

sentences.english: What man has a love of life, and a desire that his days may be increased so that he may see good?
sentences.susu: N ma die, wo fa, wo xa fa wo tuli mati n na. N xa Alatala yaragaaxui masen wo bɛ.

sentences.english: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from words of deceit.
sentences.susu: Nde wama simaya xɔnkuye xɔn? Nde wama lufe sɛɛwɛ kui tɛmui birin?

sentences.english: Be turned from evil, and do good; make a search for peace, desiring it with all your heart.
sentences.susu: Xa wo wama na xɔn, wɔyɛn ɲaaxie naxa mini wo dɛ i, wo naxa wule yo fala.

sentences.english: The eyes of the Lord are on the upright, and his ears are open to their cry.
sentences.susu: Wo xa fe ɲaaxi lu na, wo xa fe fanyi raba. Wo xa wo tunnabɛxi bɔɲɛsa fenfe ra.

sentences.english: The face of the Lord is against those who do evil, to take away the memory of them from the earth.
sentences.susu: Alatala tinxintɔɛe toma nɛ, a a tuli matima e wa xui ra.

sentences.english: The cry of the upright comes before the Lord, and he takes them out of all their troubles.
sentences.susu: Alatala a kobe soma fe kobi rabae ra, alako e xili xa nɛɛmu duniɲa ra.

sentences.english: The Lord is near the broken-hearted; he is the saviour of those whose spirits are crushed down.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛe na e mawa Alatala bɛ, a a tuli matima nɛ e ra, a e ba e xa tɔɔrɛe kui.

sentences.english: Great are the troubles of the upright: but the Lord takes him safely out of them all.
sentences.susu: Alatala luma mixi fɛ ma naxan sunnunxi a bɔɲɛ ma, a mixi rakisima naxan xaxili bara ifu.

sentences.english: He keeps all his bones: not one of them is broken.
sentences.susu: Tɔɔrɛ gbegbe tinxintɔɛ lima nɛ, kɔnɔ Alatala a rakisima na birin ma.

sentences.english: Evil will put an end to the sinner, and those who are haters of righteousness will come to destruction.
sentences.susu: Alatala mɛɛnima nɛ a ma, sese mu a toma.

sentences.english: The Lord will be the saviour of the souls of his servants, and no one who has faith in him will be put to shame.
sentences.susu: Fe ɲaaxi nan mixi ɲaaxi faxama. Tinxintɔɛ yaxuie fama ɲaxankatade.

sentences.english: O Lord, be on my side against those who are judging me; be at war with those who make war against me.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa mixi tɔɔrɔ naxan wama n tɔɔrɔfe. Naxan wama n gerefe, na kanyi gere.

sentences.english: Be a breastplate to me, and give me your help.
sentences.susu: Keli, i xa n mali i xa geresose ra.

sentences.english: Take up your spear and keep back my attackers; say to my soul, I am your salvation.
sentences.susu: I xa xali nun tanbɛ xa ite n yaxuie xili ma. A fala n bɛ, a i tan nan n ma marakisima ra.

sentences.english: Let them be overcome and put to shame who make attempts to take my soul; let those who would do me damage be turned back and made foolish.
sentences.susu: Ala xa n yaxuie rayaagi, a xa e xaxili ifu, naxee wama n faxafe. Naxee fe ɲaaxie maxirima n xun ma, Ala xa e rayaagi, a xa e keri.

sentences.english: Let them be like dust from the grain before the wind; let the angel of the Lord send them in flight.
sentences.susu: E xa lu alɔ maale lagi foye naxan nayensenma. Alatala xa malekɛ xa e keri.

sentences.english: Let their way be dark and full of danger; let them be troubled by the angel of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ala xa e lu dimi kui, Ala xa e xa kira masalaxun. Alatala xa malekɛ xa e keri.

sentences.english: For without cause they have put a net ready for me secretly, in which to take my soul.
sentences.susu: E bara yɛlɛ itala n ya ra, e bara yili ge n birama dɛnnaxɛ, alako e xa n faxa hali n mu fe ɲaaxi yo rabaxi e ra.

sentences.english: Let destruction come on them without their knowledge; let them be taken themselves in their secret nets, falling into the same destruction.
sentences.susu: Ala xa na sare ragbilen e ma. Ala xa e suxu yɛlɛ kui, Ala xa e rabira yili kui.

sentences.english: And my soul will have joy in the Lord; it will be glad in his salvation.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n bɔɲɛ ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ Alatala ra. N sɛɛwama nɛ a xa marakisi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: All my bones will say, Lord, who is like you? The saviour of the poor man from the hands of the strong, of him who is poor and in need from him who takes his goods.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ a falama nɛ, «Alatala, i maniyɛ mu na. Nde nɔma tɔɔrɔmixi ratangade sɛnbɛma ma? Nde nɔma setare ratangade muɲɛtie ma?»

sentences.english: False witnesses got up: they put questions to me about crimes of which I had no knowledge.
sentences.susu: Wule falɛe n tɔɔɲɛgɛma, e nu fe fala e mu naxan kolon.

sentences.english: They gave me back evil for good, troubling my soul.
sentences.susu: E n ma fe fanyi sare ragbilenma fe ɲaaxie ra. Mixi birin bara n nabolo.

sentences.english: But as for me, when they were ill I put on the clothing of sorrow: I went without food and was sad, and my prayer came back again to my heart.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e tan nu furaxi tɛmui naxɛ, n nu luma sunnun na e bɛ, n nu fa sunyi suxu, n Ala maxandi e bɛ tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: My behaviour was as if it had been my friend or my brother: I was bent low in grief like one whose mother is dead.
sentences.susu: N sunnunxi e bɛ alɔ n sunnunma n boore bɛ ki naxɛ, xa na mu a ra n ngaxakerenyi bɛ. N kinikinixi e bɛ alɔ n kinikinima n nga bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But they took pleasure in my trouble, and came together, yes, low persons came together against me without my knowledge; they never came to an end of wounding me.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ tɔɔrɛ to n tan li, e birin naxa ɲɛlɛxin. E naxa kafu e bore ma n xili ma, e xa n ɲaxankata, e xa n nahalaki.

sentences.english: Like men of deceit they put me to shame; the voice of their wrath was loud against me.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxie nun konbitie, e birin n ma fe xɔnxi, e nu yele.

sentences.english: Lord, how long will you be looking on? take my soul from their destruction, my life from the lions.
sentences.susu: N Marigi, munfe ra i tinma na mɔɔli xa raba? N nii ratanga e xa gere ma, n nii rakisi yi yɛtɛe ma.

sentences.english: I will give you praise in the great meeting; I will give you honour among a strong people.
sentences.susu: Na kui n i tantuma nɛ malanyi xungbe kui, N i matɔxɔma ɲama gbegbe tagi.

sentences.english: Do not let my haters be glad over me falsely; let not those who are against me without cause make sport of me.
sentences.susu: Ala xa n natanga n yaxuie ma, naxee wama yofe n ma. Ala xa n natanga n xɔnmixie naxee wama n konbife hali n mu fe yo rabaxi e ra.

sentences.english: For they do not say words of peace; in their deceit they are designing evil things against the quiet ones in the land.
sentences.susu: E mu wɔyɛn fanyi yo falama, e mixi fanyi madaxuma tun.

sentences.english: Their mouths were open wide against me, and they said, Aha, aha, our eyes have seen it.
sentences.susu: E n tɔɔɲɛgɛma a falafe ra, «Muxu bara a to.»

sentences.english: You have seen this, O Lord; be not unmoved: O Lord, be not far from me.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i bara na birin to. I naxa dundu de. N Marigi, i naxa i makuya n na.

sentences.english: Be awake, O Lord, be moved to take up my cause, my God and my Lord.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, keli, i xa n xun magere so, i xa n xun mafala.

sentences.english: Be my judge, O Lord my God, in your righteousness; do not let them be glad over me.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala, i xa n ma kiiti sa i xa tinxinyi ra, alako n yaxuie naxa n mayele.

sentences.english: Let them not say in their hearts, So we will have it: let them not say, We have put an end to him.
sentences.susu: I naxa tin e xa a fala, «Muxu bara nɔ a ra, muxu bara a masɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: Let all those who take pleasure in my troubles be shamed and come to nothing: let those who are lifted up against me be covered with shame and have no honour.
sentences.susu: Ala xa n xɔnmixie rayaagi, n yaxuie xaxili xa ifu.

sentences.english: Let those who are on my side give cries of joy; let them ever say, The Lord be praised, for he has pleasure in the peace of his servant.
sentences.susu: Ala xa n xanuntenyie rasɛɛwa, naxee a falama e xui itexi ra, «Tantui na Alatala bɛ naxan a xa konyi luma bɔɲɛsa kui.»

sentences.english: And my tongue will be talking of your righteousness and of your praise all the day.
sentences.susu: N i xa tinxinyi masenma nɛ, n i tantuma nɛ tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: The sin of the evil-doer says in his heart, There is no fear of the Lord before his eyes.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa konyi Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: For he takes comfort in the thought that his sin will not be uncovered and hated.
sentences.susu: N bara mixi ɲaaxi xa matandi maɲɔxun n bɔɲɛ kui. A mu a kolon a lanma a xa gaaxu Ala ya ra.

sentences.english: In the words of his mouth are evil and deceit; he has given up being wise and doing good.
sentences.susu: A a yɛtɛ igboma han a mu nɔma a xa yunubi tode, a mu nɔma a ɲɛrɛ ki xɔnde.

sentences.english: He gives thought to evil on his bed; he takes a way which is not good; he is not a hater of evil.
sentences.susu: A xa wɔyɛnyi ɲaaxu, a nu mixi madaxu tun. A mu fe fanyi yo kolon.

sentences.english: Your mercy, O Lord, is in the heavens, and your strong purpose is as high as the clouds.
sentences.susu: A fe ɲaaxi maɲɔxunma kɔɛ ra, a fa kira ɲaaxi suxu, barima a mu tondima fe kobi lude.

sentences.english: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God; your judging is like the great deep; O Lord, you give life to man and beast.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa hinnɛ koore lima, i xa dugutɛgɛɲa sigama han nuxui.

sentences.english: How good is your loving mercy, O God! the children of men take cover under the shade of your wings.
sentences.susu: I xa tinxinyi gbo alɔ geyae. I xa kiiti tilin alɔ baa. I tan nan adamadie nun subee rakisima.

sentences.english: The delights of your house will be showered on them; you will give them drink from the river of your pleasures.
sentences.susu: Ala, i xa hinnɛ fan. Adamadie birin yigiya sɔtɔma nɛ i yi ra, alɔ tɔxɔɛ yɔrɛe luma e nga gabutenyie bun ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For with you is the fountain of life: in your light we will see light.
sentences.susu: E wasama i xa nɛmɛ nan na, i xa fe fanyi luma e bɛ alɔ ye xinbeli.

sentences.english: O let there be no end to your loving mercy to those who have knowledge of you, or of your righteousness to the upright in heart.
sentences.susu: I tan nan gbansan nɔma adama rabalode. I xa naiyalanyi bara muxu xa kira iyalan.

sentences.english: Let not the foot of pride come against me, or the hand of the evil-doers put me out of my place.
sentences.susu: I xa hinnɛ i kolonmae ra, i xa i xa tinxinyi masen tinxintɔɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: There the workers of evil have come down: they have been made low, and will not be lifted up.
sentences.susu: I xa n natanga yɛtɛ igboee ma, i naxa a lu mixi ɲaaxie xa n keri.

sentences.english: Do not be angry because of the wrongdoers, or have envy of the workers of evil.
sentences.susu: I naxa kɔntɔfili mixi ɲaaxie ra. I naxa tin lude alɔ e tan.

sentences.english: For they will quickly be cut down like grass, and become dry like the green plants.
sentences.susu: E lisima nɛ mafuren alɔ ɲooge, e faxama nɛ alɔ sansie.

sentences.english: Have faith in the Lord, and do good; be at rest in the land, and go after righteousness.
sentences.susu: I xa i taxu Alatala ra, i xa fe fanyi rabatu. I xa lu yi bɔxi ma, nɔndi xa findi i xa baloe ra.

sentences.english: So will your delight be in the Lord, and he will give you your heart's desires.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa findi i waxɔnfe ra. Na kui a i waxɔnfe ragirima nɛ.

sentences.english: Put your life in the hands of the Lord; have faith in him and he will do it.
sentences.susu: I i xaxili ti Alatala ra, a birin taxu a ra. A tan nan fe ragirima.

sentences.english: And he will make your righteousness be seen like the light, and your cause like the shining of the sun.
sentences.susu: Ala fama i xa nɔndi makɛnɛnde alɔ a soge raminima ki naxɛ gɛɛsɛgɛ. A i xa xunnakeli makɛnɛnma alɔ soge naxan yanbama yanyi ra.

sentences.english: Take your rest in the Lord, waiting quietly for him; do not be angry because of the man who does well in his evil ways, and gives effect to his bad designs.
sentences.susu: I bɔɲɛ raxara Alatala ya i, i xa mamɛ ti, Ala na na. I naxa mixi ɲaaxi tɔɔnɛ hali a xa fe birin sɔɔnɛyaxi.

sentences.english: Put an end to your wrath and be no longer bitter; do not give way to angry feeling which is a cause of sin.
sentences.susu: I naxa xɔnɔ, i i bɔɲɛ magoro. Na tɔɔnɛ lu na, a mu fee sɔɔnɛyama i bɛ.

sentences.english: For the evil-doers will be cut off: but those who have faith in the Lord will have the earth for their heritage.
sentences.susu: Ala fama mixi ɲaaxie raɲɔnde, kɔnɔ naxee e xaxili tixi Ala ra, e fama yi bɔxi sɔtɔde kɛ ra.

sentences.english: For in a short time the evil-doer will be gone: you will go searching for his place, and it will not be there.
sentences.susu: A mu buma mixi ɲaaxie xa lɔɛ duniɲa ma. E mu toma dɛdɛ.

sentences.english: But the gentle will have the earth for their heritage; they will take their delight in peace without measure.
sentences.susu: Naxee bɔɲɛe magoroxi, e tan nan fama yi bɔxi sɔtɔde kɛ ra, e lu bɔɲɛsa kui.

sentences.english: The sinner has evil designs against the upright, lifting up the voice of wrath against him.
sentences.susu: Tinxintare tinxintɔɛ yanfama, a xɔnɔ a ma.

sentences.english: He will be laughed at by the Lord, who sees that his day is coming.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Marigi yelema na mixi ɲaaxi ma, barima a a kolon a fama naxan sɔtɔde.

sentences.english: The evil-doers have taken out their swords, their bows are bent; for crushing the poor, and to put to death those who are upright in their ways.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxie santidɛgɛma bama a tɛɛ i, e xali fan suxu, alako e xa misikiinɛ nun setare tɔɔrɔ, e xa tinxintɔɛ kɔn naxaba.

sentences.english: But their swords will be turned into their hearts, and their bows will be broken.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e tan nan fama faxade e yɛtɛ xa santidɛgɛma saabui ra. E xa xalie fama girade.

sentences.english: The little which the good man has is better than the wealth of evil-doers.
sentences.susu: Se xuri naxan na tinxintɔɛ yi ra, a fisa mixi ɲaaxie xa bannaya bɛ,

sentences.english: For the arms of the evil-doers will be broken: but the Lord is the support of the good.
sentences.susu: barima Alatala e sɛnbɛ kanama nɛ, a fa tinxintɔɛ mali.

sentences.english: The days of the upright are numbered by the Lord, and their heritage will be for ever.
sentences.susu: Alatala ɲɛngi saxi mixi fanyi xɔn. E kɛ buma nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: They will not be shamed in the evil time, and in the days when all are in need of food they will have enough.
sentences.susu: E mu yaagima tɔɔrɛ tɛmui, e lugama nɛ kaamɛ waxati.

sentences.english: But the wrongdoers will come to destruction, and the haters of the Lord will be like the fat of lambs, they will be burned up; they will go up in smoke, and never again be seen.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxie faxama nɛ. Alatala yaxuie luma nɛ alɔ fiili, naxan sɛxɛ lisima, a fa gan.

sentences.english: The sinner takes money and does not give it back; but the upright man has mercy, and gives to others.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxi doni tongoma nɛ, kɔnɔ e mu a fima. Mixi fanyi tan mixie kima a xa fonisireya kui.

sentences.english: Those who have his blessing will have the earth for their heritage; but those who are cursed by him will be cut off.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa barakatɔɛe yi bɔxi sɔtɔma nɛ kɛ ra, kɔnɔ Ala naxan dankama, na kanyi fama halakide.

sentences.english: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord, and he takes delight in his way.
sentences.susu: Naxan ɲɛrɛ ki rafan Alatala ma, a na kanyi malima nɛ a xa duniɲɛigiri kui.

sentences.english: Even if he has a fall he will not be without help: for the hand of the Lord is supporting him.
sentences.susu: Hali a sa dinkon, a mu birama, barima a bɛlɛxɛ na Alatala yi ra.

sentences.english: I have been young, and now am old, but I have not seen the good man without help, or his children looking for bread.
sentences.susu: Kabi n dimɛdi tɛmui, han n xɛmɔxi ra, n mu tinxintɔɛ keren toxi Ala naxan nabɛɲinxi, naxan xa die taami makulama.

sentences.english: All the day he is ready to have mercy and to give; his children are a blessing.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛ ki tima, a mixie donima. A xa die barakɛ sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: Be turned from evil, and do good; and your place will be for ever.
sentences.susu: I xa fe kobi lu na, i xa fe fanyi raba. Na kui i simaya xɔnkuye sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: For the Lord is a lover of righteousness, and takes care of his saints; they will be kept safe for ever; but the seed of the evil-doers will be cut off.
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ rafan Alatala ma. A mu a xa hinnɛntee rabɛɲinma. A e kantama nɛ abadan. Kɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxie bɔnsɔɛ fama nɛ halakide.

sentences.english: The upright will have the earth for their heritage, and will go on living there for ever.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛe fama nɛ yi bɔxi sɔtɔde kɛ ra, e lu be abadan.

sentences.english: The mouth of the good man says words of wisdom; the talk of his tongue is of righteousness.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛ lɔnni nan masenma, sɛriyɛ nan minima a dɛ kui.

sentences.english: The law of his God is in his heart; he will never make a false step.
sentences.susu: A Marigi Ala xa sɛriyɛ na a bɔɲɛ kui, a mu birama kira xɔn.

sentences.english: The sinners are watching the upright man, desiring to put him to death.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxi tinxintɔɛ yanfama, a xa a faxa.

sentences.english: The Lord will not give him into their hands, or be against him when he is judged.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala mu tinxintɔɛ luma a yaxuie sagoe. A mu tinma e xa a tɔɔɲɛgɛ kiiti tɛmui.

sentences.english: Be waiting for the Lord, and keep his way; and you will be lifted up, and have the land for your heritage: when the evil-doers are cut off, you will see it.
sentences.susu: I xaxili ti Alatala ra, a xa kira suxu, alako a xa i rakeli, i xa yi bɔxi sɔtɔ kɛ ra. Na tɛmui i mixi ɲaaxie toma nɛ e halakixi.

sentences.english: I have seen the evil-doer in great power, covering the earth like a great tree.
sentences.susu: Tɛmui dangixi n bara sɛnbɛma ɲaaxi nde to. A xungbo alɔ wuri tofanyi.

sentences.english: But he came to an end, and there was no sign of him; I made a search for him and he was not there.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n to dangi a yire a firin nde, n naxa a li a xa fe xuben. N naxa a fen, kɔnɔ n mu a to.

sentences.english: Give attention to the good man, and take note of the upright; because the end of that man is peace.
sentences.susu: I xa mixi fanyi nan mato, tinxintɔɛ nan igbɛ. Na mixi mɔɔli findima barakatɔɛ nan na.

sentences.english: But as for the sinners, they will be cut off together; the end of the wrongdoers is destruction.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yunubitɔɛe tan fama nɛ sɔntɔde, e bɔnsɔɛ birin fa halaki.

sentences.english: But the Lord is the saviour of the upright: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
sentences.susu: Alatala tinxintɔɛe rakisima nɛ, a findi e xa makantama ra e xa tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: And the Lord will be their help, and keep them safe: he will take them out of the hands of the evil-doers, and be their saviour, because they had faith in him.
sentences.susu: A e malima nɛ, a e ratanga. A e ratanga mixi ɲaaxie ma, a e rakisi, barima e yigiyaxi a tan nan ma.

sentences.english: O Lord, be not bitter with me in your wrath; let not your hand be on me in the heat of your passion.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa maxandi bɛɛti

sentences.english: For your arrows have gone into my flesh, and I am crushed under the weight of your hand.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i naxa n ɲaxankata i xa xɔnɛ kui, i naxa n halaki i xa bɔɲɛte kui.

sentences.english: My flesh is wasted because of your wrath; and there is no peace in my bones because of my sin.
sentences.susu: I bara n maxɔnɔ i xa tanbɛ ra, i bara n nabira.

sentences.english: For my crimes have gone over my head; they are like a great weight which is more than my strength.
sentences.susu: Yalanyi yo mu na n bɛ i xa xɔnɛ kui. N ma yunubi bara a niya n fate birin xa tɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: My wounds are poisoned and evil-smelling, because of my foolish behaviour.
sentences.susu: N ma yunubie bara gbo n xun ma. Na kote bara binya, n mu a nɔma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: I am troubled, I am made low; I go weeping all the day.
sentences.susu: N ma fie bara gbo, e xiri bara ɲaaxu. Na birin fatanxi n ma xaxilitareɲa nan na.

sentences.english: For my body is full of burning; all my flesh is unhealthy.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ bara kana, xunnakeli mu na n bɛ. N luma fɛɛɲɛn na sunnunyi nan kui.

sentences.english: I am feeble and crushed down; I gave a cry like a lion because of the grief in my heart.
sentences.susu: N fate birin wolenxi, yalanyi yo mu na sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Lord, all my desire is before you; my sorrow is not kept secret from you.
sentences.susu: N sɛnbɛ bara kana, n fate birin bara ba n ma. N bɔɲɛ tɔɔrɔxi tun.

sentences.english: My heart goes out in pain, my strength is wasting away; as for the light of my eyes, it is gone from me.
sentences.susu: N Marigi, i n waxɔnfe kolon, n ma tɔɔrɛ mu nɔxunxi i ma.

sentences.english: My lovers and my friends keep away from my disease; my relations keep far away.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ mu saxi, n sɛnbɛ bara ɲɔn. N ya mu naiyalanyi toma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Those who have a desire to take my life put nets for me; those who are designing my destruction say evil things against me, all the day their minds are full of deceit.
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie nun n booree bara keli n xun ma n ma fure xa fe ra, n ngaxakerenyie bara e makuya n na.

sentences.english: But I kept my ears shut like a man without hearing; like a man without a voice, never opening his mouth.
sentences.susu: Naxee wama n faxafe, e bara yɛlɛ itala n ya ra. Naxee wama n tɔɔrɔfe, e bara n konbi, e n tɔɔɲɛgɛma tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: So I was like a man whose ears are shut, and in whose mouth there are no sharp words.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n mu n tuli mati na wɔyɛnyie ra, n mu n dɛ rabi n xa e yaabi.

sentences.english: In you, O Lord, is my hope: you will give me an answer, O Lord, my God.
sentences.susu: N luma alɔ tuli xɔri, n luma alɔ boboe.

sentences.english: I said, Let them not be glad over me; when my foot is moved, let them not be lifted up with pride against me.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n xaxili tixi i tan nan na. N Marigi Ala, i tan nan gbansan nɔma n yaabide.

sentences.english: My feet are near to falling, and my sorrow is ever before me.
sentences.susu: N naxɛ, «I naxa tin n yaxuie xa yo n ma, e xa ɲɛlɛxin n ma tɔɔrɛ xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: I will make clear my wrongdoing, with sorrow in my heart for my sin.
sentences.susu: A gbe mu luxi n xa bira, n na tɔɔrɔfe tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: But they are strong who have hate for me without cause: those who are against me falsely are increased in numbers.
sentences.susu: N bara n ti n ma yunubi rabaxie ra, n yangoe naxee rabaxi, na fe bara n kɔntɔfili.

sentences.english: They give me back evil for good; they are my haters because I go after the thing which is right.
sentences.susu: N yaxuie tan kɛndɛ, e sɛnbɛ gbo. N xɔnmixie bara wuya, hali nɔndi mu na e bɛ.

sentences.english: Do not give me up, O Lord; O my God, be near to me.
sentences.susu: Naxee fe fanyi masarama fe ɲaaxi ra, e n tɔɔrɔma, barima n tan birama fe fanyi nan fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Come quickly to give me help, O Lord, my salvation.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i naxa n nabɛɲin. N Marigi Ala, i naxa i makuya n na.

sentences.english: I said, I will give attention to my ways, so that my tongue may do no wrong; I will keep my mouth under control, while the sinner is before me.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ Yedutun bɛ

sentences.english: I made no sound, I said no word, even of good; and I was moved with sorrow.
sentences.susu: N bara a fala, «N fe birin nabama, alako n naxa yunubi raba n dɛ ra. N fe birin nabama, alako n naxa na wɔyɛnyi mɔɔli fala mixi ɲaaxie ya xɔri.»

sentences.english: My heart was burning in my breast; while I was deep in thought the fire was lighted; then I said with my tongue,
sentences.susu: N ma tɔɔrɛ xungbe kui, n naxa dundu, n mu sese fala, n naxa n sabari tun.

sentences.english: Lord, give me knowledge of my end, and of the measure of my days, so that I may see how feeble I am.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ nu satunma, n ma tɔɔrɛ naxa lu alɔ tɛ dɛxɛxi. Na bara a niya n xa yi wɔyɛnyi fala,

sentences.english: You have made my days no longer than a hand's measure; and my years are nothing in your eyes; truly, every man is but a breath. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: «Alatala, a masen n bɛ n faxama tɛmui mundun, n ma simaya sigama han minden, alako n xa n sɛnbɛ xa xurunyi kolon.

sentences.english: Truly, every man goes on his way like an image; he is troubled for no purpose: he makes a great store of wealth, and has no knowledge of who will get it.
sentences.susu: I bara n ma simaya radunke, a xɔn mu kuya sɔnɔn. Adama luma alɔ foye naxan dangima.» Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: And now, Lord, what am I waiting for? my hope is in you.
sentences.susu: Adama luxi nɛ alɔ niini, naxan minima, a fa dangi. A naafuli malanma, kɔnɔ naxan fama a sɔtɔde, a mu na kolon.

sentences.english: Make me free from all my sins; do not let me be shamed by the man of evil behaviour.
sentences.susu: N Marigi, n fa n xaxili tima nde ra? I tan nan gbansan nɔma n malide.

sentences.english: I was quiet, and kept my mouth shut; because you had done it.
sentences.susu: N nakisi n ma yunubie birin ma. I naxa n nayaagi daxuie ya xɔri.

sentences.english: No longer let your hand be hard on me; I am wasted by the blows of your hand.
sentences.susu: N bara dundu, n mu sese falama, barima i tan nan na walife.

sentences.english: By the weight of your wrath against man's sin, the glory of his form is wasted away; truly every man is but a breath. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: I xa fure ba n ma, beenu i xa n naɲɔn tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: Let my prayer come to your ears, O Lord, and give attention to my cry, make an answer to my weeping: for my time here is short before you, and in a little time I will be gone, like all my fathers.
sentences.susu: I mixi ɲaxankatama a xa yunubi xa fe ra. Naxan nafan adama ma, i na bama a yi. Na fe luma nɛ alɔ kuli naxan bogise fanyi xun nakanama beenu mixi xa a matongo. Adamadi misaalixi foye nan na naxan dangima. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: Let your wrath be turned away from me, so that I may be comforted, before I go away from here, and become nothing.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n ma dubɛ suxu, i xa i tuli mati n ma maxandi ra. I xa n wa xui mɛ, barima i xa xɔɲɛ nan n na. N luma alɔ n benbae, n mu buma yi duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari.

sentences.english: When I was waiting quietly for the Lord, his heart was turned to me, and he gave ear to my cry.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: He took me up out of a deep waste place, out of the soft and sticky earth; he put my feet on a rock, and made my steps certain.
sentences.susu: N bara n xaxili ti Alatala ra, a bara a tuli mati n na.

sentences.english: And he put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God; numbers have seen it with fear, and put their faith in the Lord.
sentences.susu: A bara n ba boora xɔɔra, a n sanyi radiki fanye ra.

sentences.english: Happy is the man who has faith in the Lord, and does not give honour to the men of pride or to those who are turned away to deceit.
sentences.susu: A bara bɛɛti nɛɛnɛ sa n bɔɲɛ ma naxan findixi tantui ra Ala bɛ. Mixi gbegbe na na mɛ, e gaaxuma nɛ Ala ya ra, e e yɛtɛ taxu Alatala ra.

sentences.english: O Lord my God, great are the wonders which you have done in your thought for us; it is not possible to put them out in order before you; when I would give an account of them, their number is greater than I may say.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛlɛxinyi na adama nan bɛ naxan a xaxili tixi Alatala ra, naxan mu a kobe ratoxi yɛtɛ igboe ma, naxan mu a kobe ratoxi kuye batufe ma.

sentences.english: You had no desire for offerings of beasts or fruits of the earth; ears you made for me: for burned offerings and sin offerings you made no request.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala, i bara i xa fe fanyi gbegbe masen muxu bɛ. I maniyɛ mu na. N wama na birin tagi rabafe mixie bɛ, kɔnɔ i xa fe fanyi wuya han a bara dangi a i.

sentences.english: Then I said, See, I come; it is recorded of me in the roll of the book,
sentences.susu: I mu wama sɛrɛxɛ tun xa xɔn ma. I bara n tuli rabi. I mu wama sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi xɔn ma, i mu wama sɛrɛxɛ yunubi xafari daaxi fan xɔn ma.

sentences.english: My delight is to do your pleasure, O my God; truly, your law is in my heart.
sentences.susu: N bara fa kitaabui makuntanxi ra naxan sɛbɛxi n bɛ.

sentences.english: I have given news of righteousness in the great meeting; O Lord, you have knowledge that I have not kept back my words.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, n bara tin i waxɔnfe ma. I xa sɛriyɛ na n sondonyi kui.

sentences.english: Your righteousness has not been folded away in my heart; I have made clear your true word and your salvation; I have not kept secret your mercy or your faith from the great meeting.
sentences.susu: N tinxinyi masenma ɲama bɛ. I xa a kolon Alatala, n mu fama dundude i xa fe ma.

sentences.english: Take not away your gentle mercies from me, O Lord; let your mercy and your faith keep me safe for ever.
sentences.susu: N mu nɔma dundude i xa nɔndi ma. N i xa fe fanyi nun i xa marakisi fe falama nɛ. N mu i xa fonisireya nun i xa nɔndi nɔxunma ɲama ma.

sentences.english: For unnumbered evils are round about me; my sins have overtaken me, so that I am bent down with their weight; they are more than the hairs of my head, my strength is gone because of them.
sentences.susu: I tan Alatala, i mu fama tondide n bɛ i xa marafanyi ma. I xa fonisireya nun i xa nɔndi n kantama nɛ tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Be pleased, O Lord, to take me out of danger; O Lord, come quickly and give me help.
sentences.susu: Tɔɔrɛ gbegbe bara n nabilin. N ma yunubi fan bara gbo han a bara dangi a i. E bara wuya dangife n xunsɛxɛe ra. Limaniya bara ba n yi ra.

sentences.english: Let those who go after my soul for its destruction have shame and trouble together; let them be turned back and made foolish who take pleasure in my trouble.
sentences.susu: Alatala, yandi, n natanga. Alatala, yandi, n mali.

sentences.english: Let those who say to me, Aha, aha! be surprised because of their shame.
sentences.susu: Naxee wama n nii bafe, naxee wama n ma fe ɲaaxi xɔn ma, e birin xa makuya n na yaagi kui.

sentences.english: Let all those who are looking for you be glad and have joy in you; let the lovers of your salvation ever say, May the Lord be great.
sentences.susu: Naxee n mayelema, yaagi xa e dɛ ixara.

sentences.english: Though I am poor and in need, the Lord has me in mind; you are my help and my saviour; let there be no waiting, O my God.
sentences.susu: Naxee birin biraxi i fɔxɔ ra, e xa sɛɛwa, e xa ɲɛlɛxin i xa fe ra. Naxee wama i xa kisi xɔn ma, e xa a fala tɛmui birin, «Tantui na Alatala bɛ.»

sentences.english: Happy is the man who gives thought to the poor; the Lord will be his saviour in the time of trouble.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: The Lord will keep him safe, and give him life; the Lord will let him be a blessing on the earth, and will not give him into the hand of his haters.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛlɛxinyi na mixi bɛ naxan hinnɛma tɔɔrɔmixi ra. Alatala a ratangama nɛ a xa tɔɔrɛ ma.

sentences.english: The Lord will be his support on his bed of pain: by you will all his grief be turned to strength.
sentences.susu: Alatala a ratangama nɛ, a a rabalo. A ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ duniɲa. I mu a luma a yaxuie sagoe.

sentences.english: I said, Lord, have mercy on me; make my soul well, because my faith is in you.
sentences.susu: Alatala a malima nɛ a fura tɛmui, a a rayalan.

sentences.english: My haters say evil against me, When will he be dead, and his name come to an end?
sentences.susu: N a falama a bɛ, «Alatala, hinnɛ n na. N nayalan barima n bara yunubi raba i ra.»

sentences.english: If one comes to see me, deceit is in his heart; he keeps a store of evil, which he makes public in every place.
sentences.susu: N yaxuie wɔyɛn ɲaaxie falama, e naxɛ, «A faxama mun tɛmui? A xili lɔɛma mun lɔxɔɛ?»

sentences.english: All my haters are talking secretly together against me; they are designing my downfall.
sentences.susu: Naxan fama n xɛɛbude a filankafui wɔyɛnyi falama. Fe ɲaaxi gbo a bɔɲɛ kui. A na keli n xun ma, a na mɔɔli falama.

sentences.english: They say, He has an evil disease, which will not let him go: and now that he is down he will not get up again.
sentences.susu: N xɔnmixie n ma fe makɔlikɔlima e boore bɛ, e xa n tɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: Even my dearest friend, in whom I had faith, who took bread with me, is turned against me.
sentences.susu: E naxɛ, «Fure ɲaaxi bara a suxu, a bara tagan, a mu kelima sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: But you, O Lord, have mercy on me, lifting me up, so that I may give them their punishment.
sentences.susu: Hali n dɛfanboore, n nu laxi naxan na, muxu nun naxan nu muxu dɛgema yire keren, na bara a kobe ti n na.

sentences.english: By this I see that you have pleasure in me, because my hater does not overcome me.
sentences.susu: Alatala, hinnɛ n na, i xa n nakeli, alako n xa n yaxuie sare ragbilen e ma.

sentences.english: And as for me, you are my support in my righteousness, giving me a place before your face for ever.
sentences.susu: N a kolon n nafan i ma, barima i mu n luma n yaxuie sagoe.

sentences.english: May the Lord God of Israel be praised, through eternal days and for ever. So be it. So be it.
sentences.susu: I n malima nɛ barima n tinxin. I bara tin n xa lu i sɛɛti ma abadan.

sentences.english: Like the desire of the roe for the water-streams, so is my soul's desire for you, O God.
sentences.susu: Kora xa die xa lɔnni bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: My soul is dry for need of God, the living God; when may I come and see the face of God?
sentences.susu: Ala, n wama lufe i yire. N i fenma alɔ xeli ye fenma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: My tears have been my food day and night, while they keep saying to me, Where is your God?
sentences.susu: N hayi na Ala ɲiɲɛ ma. N a yire lima mun tɛmui?

sentences.english: Let my soul be overflowing with grief when these things come back to my mind, how I went in company to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with the song of those who were keeping the feast.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n wama kɔɛ ra, n wama yanyi ra. Mixi n maxɔrinma, «I Marigi Ala na minden?»

sentences.english: Why are you crushed down, O my soul? and why are you troubled in me? put your hope in God; for I will again give him praise who is my help and my God.
sentences.susu: N na ratu yi fe ma, n bɔɲɛ sɛɛwama nɛ. Singe n nu ɲama raɲɛrɛma Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi nan kui, e nu bɛɛti bafe ɲɛlɛxinyi kui, e tantui rasiga Ala ma.

sentences.english: My soul is crushed down in me, so I will keep you in mind; from the land of Jordan and of the Hermons, from the hill Mizar.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra n sondonyi nimisaxi? Munfe ra n bɔɲɛ sunnunxi? N xa n xaxili ti Ala ra, n man xa a tantu a xa kisi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Deep is sounding to deep at the noise of your waterfalls; all your waves have gone rolling over me.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, n bɔɲɛ nimisaxi n yɛtɛ kan ma fe ra. Na na a ra n nan n natuma i ma Yurudɛn, n na dɛnnaxɛ yi tɛmui, Xerimon nun Misari geyae na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: But the Lord will send his mercy in the daytime, and in the night his song will be with me, a prayer to the God of my life.
sentences.susu: N ma tɔɔrɛ xun nan tun masafe. A luma alɔ susui ye naxan sinma xure ye xun.

sentences.english: I will say to God my Rock, Why have you let me go from your memory? why do I go in sorrow because of the attacks of my haters?
sentences.susu: Alatala hinnɛma n na yanyi ra, n fan bɛɛti bama a bɛ kɔɛ ra. N Ala maxandima naxan n nabaloma.

sentences.english: The cruel words of my haters are like a crushing of my bones; when they say to me every day, Where is your God?
sentences.susu: N bara a fala Ala bɛ, naxan sɛnbɛ gbo alɔ fanye, «I nɛɛmuxi n ma munfe ra? I n luxi tɔɔrɛ kui n yaxuie xa nɔɛ bun ma munfe ra?»

sentences.english: Why are you crushed down, O my soul? and why are you troubled in me? put your hope in God; for I will again give him praise who is my help and my God.
sentences.susu: N yaxuie n tɔɔrɔma konbi ra lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ. E n maxɔrinma, «I Marigi Ala na minden?»

sentences.english: Be my judge, O God, supporting my cause against a nation without religion; O keep me from the false and evil man.
sentences.susu: Ala, i xa n ma kiiti sa. I xa n xun mafala ɲama danxaniyatare xɔn ma. I xa n natanga yanfantee nun wule falɛe ma.

sentences.english: You are the God of my strength; why have you put me from you? why do I go in sorrow because of the attacks of my haters?
sentences.susu: Ala n ma kantama na i tan nan na, i n nabɛɲinxi munfe ra? I n luxi tɔɔrɛ kui n yaxuie xa nɔɛ bun ma munfe ra?

sentences.english: O send out your light and your true word; let them be my guide: let them take me to your holy hill, and to your tents.
sentences.susu: I xa n ma kira iyalan i xa nɔndi ra, i xa n xun ti sigafe ra i yire i xa geya sɛniyɛnxi fari.

sentences.english: Then I will go up to the altar of God, to the God of my joy; I will be glad and give praise to you on an instrument of music, O God, my God.
sentences.susu: N nan n makɔrɛma nɛ Ala xa sɛrɛxɛbade ra, Ala naxan findixi n ma sɛɛwɛ nun n ma ɲɛlɛxinyi ra. N bɛɛti bama n Marigi Ala bɛ kɔra ra.

sentences.english: Why are you crushed down, O my soul? and why are you troubled in me? put your hope in God, for I will again give him praise who is my help and my God.
sentences.susu: N sondonyi nimisaxi munfe ra? N bɔɲɛ sunnunxi munfe ra? N xa n xaxili ti Ala ra, n man xa a tantu a xa kisi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: It has come to our ears, O God, our fathers have given us the story, of the works which you did in their days, in the old times,
sentences.susu: Kora xa die xa lɔnni bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: Uprooting the nations with your hand, and planting our fathers in their place; cutting down the nations, but increasing the growth of your people.
sentences.susu: Ala, muxu bara a mɛ muxu benbae saabui ra, i wali naxan nabaxi tɛmui dangixi.

sentences.english: For they did not make the land theirs by their swords, and it was not their arms which kept them safe; but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your face, because you had pleasure in them.
sentences.susu: I bara sie keri be alako muxu benbae xa sabati yi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: You are my King and my God; ordering salvation for Jacob.
sentences.susu: E mu be sɔtɔ e xa santidɛgɛma xa ra, e mu kisi sɔtɔ e yɛtɛ sɛnbɛ xa ra. I tan nan sɛnbɛ bara e rakisi, i tan nan xa hinnɛ bara findi na saabui ra.

sentences.english: Through you will we overcome our haters; by your name will they be crushed under our feet who are violent against us.
sentences.susu: Ala, i tan nan findi n ma mangɛ ra. Yandi, i xa Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ rakisi.

sentences.english: I will not put faith in my bow, my sword will not be my salvation.
sentences.susu: Muxu fama muxu yaxuie ragbilende i tan nan saabui ra, muxu fama e ragorode i xili ra.

sentences.english: But it is you who have been our saviour from those who were against us, and have put to shame those who had hate for us.
sentences.susu: N mu n xaxili tixi n ma xali xa ra, n ma santidɛgɛma mu nɔma n nakiside.

sentences.english: Our pride is in God at all times, to his name we give praise for ever. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan nan muxu ratangama muxu yaxuie ma, i tan nan muxu xɔnmixie rayaagima.

sentences.english: But now you have sent us away from you, and put us to shame; you do not go out with our armies.
sentences.susu: Muxu Ala nan matɔxɔma tɛmui birin, muxu i tan nan xili tantuma abadan. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: Because of this we are turned back by the attacker: those who have hate for us take our goods for themselves.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi i bara muxu rabɛɲin, i bara muxu rayaagi. I mu muxu xa sɔɔrie malima sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: You have made us like sheep which are taken for meat; we are put to flight among the nations.
sentences.susu: I bara muxu ragi muxu yaxuie ya ra, naxee muxu xɔnxi, nee bara muxu harige birin ba muxu yi ra.

sentences.english: You let your people go for nothing; your wealth is not increased by their price.
sentences.susu: I bara muxu rabɛɲin alako e xa muxu faxa alɔ xurusee, i bara muxu rayensen ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛe ma.

sentences.english: You have made us to be looked down on by our neighbours, we are laughed at and shamed by those who are round about us.
sentences.susu: I bara i xa ɲama mati sare xuri ra, naxan mu findima geeni ra i bɛ.

sentences.english: Our name is a word of shame among the nations, a sign for the shaking of heads among the peoples.
sentences.susu: I bara muxu rayaagi muxu dɔxɔbooree xɔn ma. Muxu rabilinyie yoma muxu ma.

sentences.english: My downfall is ever before me, and I am covered with the shame of my face;
sentences.susu: I bara a niya si gbɛtɛe xa muxu mayele, e nu e xunyie lintan muxu ma.

sentences.english: Because of the voice of him who says sharp and bitter words; because of the hater and him who is the instrument of punishment.
sentences.susu: N xaxili ifuxi tɛmui birin, n bara yaagi.

sentences.english: All this has come on us, but still we have kept you in our memory; and we have not been false to your word.
sentences.susu: Naxee n xɔnxi, nee n mayelema, e n konbima. E wama e gbeɲɔxɔfe.

sentences.english: Our hearts have not gone back, and our steps have not been turned out of your way;
sentences.susu: Hali yi birin to rabaxi muxu ra, muxu mu nɛɛmuxi i ma, muxu mu i xa saatɛ kanaxi.

sentences.english: Though you have let us be crushed in the place of jackals, though we are covered with darkest shade.
sentences.susu: Muxu bɔɲɛ mu gbilenxi i fɔxɔ ra, muxu mu muxu makuyaxi i xa kira ra,

sentences.english: If the name of our God has gone out of our minds, or if our hands have been stretched out to a strange god,
sentences.susu: naxan a niyama i xa muxu lu wulabaree tagi, muxu xa faxa.

sentences.english: Will not God make search for it? for he sees the secrets of the heart.
sentences.susu: Xa muxu sa nɛɛmu muxu Marigi Ala xili ma, xa na mu a ra muxu naxa ala gbɛtɛe batu,

sentences.english: Truly, because of you we are put to death every day; we are numbered like sheep for destruction.
sentences.susu: Ala mu a kolonma xɛ? A mu mixi gundo birin kolon?

sentences.english: Why are you sleeping, O Lord? awake! and come to our help, do not give us up for ever.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixie na muxu faxafe alɔ xurusee. E na rabama tɛmui birin i tan nan ma fe ra.

sentences.english: Why is your face covered, and why do you give no thought to our trouble and our cruel fate?
sentences.susu: N Marigi, xunu. I xife munfe ra? Keli, i naxa mɛɛ muxu ra tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: For our souls are crushed down to the dust: our bodies are stretched out on the earth.
sentences.susu: I yatagi nɔxunma muxu ma munfe ra? I nɛɛmuxi muxu xa tɔɔrɛ nun yaagi ma munfe ra?

sentences.english: Up! and come to our help, and give us salvation because of your mercy.
sentences.susu: Muxu bira nɛ bɔxi, muxu mu nɔma kelide sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: My heart is flowing over with good things; my words are of that which I have made for a king; my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.
sentences.susu: Kora xa die xa lɔnni bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba alɔ bɛɛti naxan xili «Fuge tofanyie.» Xanunteya sigi.

sentences.english: You are fairer than the children of men; grace is flowing through your lips; for this cause the blessing of God is with you for ever.
sentences.susu: Wɔyɛn fanyie bara n bɔɲɛ rafe. N xa yi wali raba mangɛ bɛ. N nɛnyi luma nɛ alɔ sɛbɛliti fanyi xa kale.

sentences.english: Put on your sword, make it ready at your side, O strong chief, with your glory and power.
sentences.susu: I tofan adamadi birin bɛ, i fata wɔyɛn ɲɔxunmɛ tide, barima Ala barakɛ sama i xa fe ma tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: And go nobly on in your power, because you are good and true and without pride; and your right hand will be teaching you things of fear.
sentences.susu: I xa i xa santidɛgɛma xiri i tagi, alako i xa xunnakeli nun i xa binyɛ xa kolon. Sɔɔri sɛnbɛma nan i ra.

sentences.english: Your arrows are sharp in the heart of the king's haters; because of them the peoples are falling under you.
sentences.susu: I sɛnbɛ gbo. Te i xa sɔɔri ragise fari, nɔndi, magoroe, nun tinxinyi xa fe ra. I xa fe xungbe raba.

sentences.english: Your seat of power, O God, is for ever and ever; the rod of your kingdom is a rod of honour.
sentences.susu: I xa tanbɛe magaaxu. E fama i yaxuie sondonyi sɔxɔde, sie birama nɛ i sanyie bun.

sentences.english: You have been a lover of righteousness and a hater of evil: and so God, your God, has put the oil of joy on your head, lifting you high over all other kings.
sentences.susu: «Ala, i xa mangɛ kibanyi buma nɛ abadan. Tinxinyi nan findixi i xa mangɛya tɔnxuma ra.»

sentences.english: Your robes are full of the smell of all sorts of perfumes and spices; music from the king's ivory houses has made you glad.
sentences.susu: Tinxinyi nan nafan i ma. Ɲaaxuiɲa mu rafan i ma fefe ma. Na nan a toxi i Marigi Ala bara i sugandi sɛɛwɛ kui. Fisamante nan i ra dangife i booree ra.

sentences.english: Kings' daughters are among your noble women: on your right is the queen in gold of Ophir.
sentences.susu: Labundɛ nun se xiri ɲɔxunmɛ na i xa dugi ma. Xulunyi tima i xa mangɛ banxi tofanyi kui. Kɔrae ɲɛlɛxinyi xui raminima i bɛ.

sentences.english: O daughter, give thought and attention, and let your ear be open; no longer keep in mind your people, and your father's house;
sentences.susu: Mangɛe xa di ginɛe luma i sɛɛti ma, i xa ginɛ fan na i fɛ ma, a maxirixi xɛɛma tofanyi ra.

sentences.english: So will the king have a great desire for you, seeing how beautiful you are; because he is your lord, give him honour.
sentences.susu: N ma di ginɛ, i tuli mati n na. I naxa kankan i bɔnsɔɛ ma, xa na mu a ra i xa denbaya nun i baba ma.

sentences.english: And the daughters of Tyre will be there with an offering; those who have wealth among the people will be looking for your approval.
sentences.susu: I xa i igoro mangɛ bɛ naxan findixi i marigi ra. I tofan, i rafan a ma ki fanyi.

sentences.english: In the great house the king's daughter is all shining: her clothing is worked with gold.
sentences.susu: Tirekae fama bunsee ra i bɛ, naafuli kanyie fan fanma i binyade.

sentences.english: She will come before the king in robes of needlework; the virgins in her train will come before you.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa di ginɛ soma banxi kui, a maxirixi dugi tofanyi ra, xɛɛma na a ma.

sentences.english: With joy and rapture will they come; they will go into the king's house.
sentences.susu: A xa konyi ginɛe a matima mangɛ xɔn. Mangɛ fan maxirixi dugi tofanyi ra.

sentences.english: Your children will take the place of your fathers; so that you may make them rulers over all the earth.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ so tɛmui, mixi birin ɲɛlɛxinxi, e xulunyi tima.

sentences.english: I will keep the memory of your name living through all generations; and because of this the people will give you praise for ever.
sentences.susu: I xa die fama lude alɔ i benbae, e findi mangɛe ra bɔxi birin xun ma.

sentences.english: God is our harbour and our strength, a very present help in trouble.
sentences.susu: Kora xa die xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ ginɛdimɛdi xui daaxi

sentences.english: For this cause we will have no fear, even though the earth is changed, and though the mountains are moved in the heart of the sea;
sentences.susu: Ala, won kantama nan a ra. Won ma kantari na a yi ra. A won malima won ma tɔɔrɛ birin kui.

sentences.english: Though its waters are sounding and troubled, and though the mountains are shaking with their violent motion. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Xa bɔxi sa sɛrɛn, won mu gaaxuma. Xa geya sa bira baa ma, won mu gaaxuma.

sentences.english: There is a river whose streams make glad the resting-place of God, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.
sentences.susu: Xa mɔrɔnyie sa xaaɲɛ, won mu gaaxuma. Xa geya sa a imaxa, a sɛrɛn, won mu gaaxuma.

sentences.english: God has taken his place in her; she will not be moved: he will come to her help at the dawn of morning.
sentences.susu: Xure nan a ra, naxan salonyie Ala xa taa rasɛɛwama. Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi xa hɔrɔmɔlingira sɛniyɛnxi na mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: The nations were angry, the kingdoms were moved; at the sound of his voice the earth became like wax.
sentences.susu: Ala na na taa kui, na taa mu a ramaxama, a a malima subaxɛ nɛfɛ a li.

sentences.english: The Lord of armies is with us; the God of Jacob is our high tower. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Sie sɔnxɔɛ ratema, mangɛyae birama nɛ. Ala nɛfɛ a xui ramini, duniɲa birin xununma nɛ.

sentences.english: Come, see the works of the Lord, the destruction which he has made in the earth.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala na won sɛɛti ma. Won ma kantari na Yaxuba Marigi Ala yi ra.

sentences.english: He puts an end to wars over all the earth; by him the bow is broken, and the spear cut in two, and the carriage burned in the fire.
sentences.susu: Wo fa Alatala xa wali mato, a gbaloe naxan luxi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Be at peace in the knowledge that I am God: I will be lifted up among the nations, I will be honoured through all the earth.
sentences.susu: A tan nan gere ɲɔnma duniɲa birin ma. A xali girama nɛ. A tanbɛ kanama nɛ, a makantase gan.

sentences.english: The Lord of armies is with us; the God of Jacob is our high tower. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: «Wo wo raxara, wo xa a kolon Ala na n tan nan na. N si birin yamarima. N ma yaamari na duniɲa birin ma.»

sentences.english: O make a glad noise with your hands, all you peoples; letting your voices go up to God with joy.
sentences.susu: Kora xa die xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: For the Lord Most High is to be feared; he is a great King over all the earth.
sentences.susu: Wo tan sie birin, wo wo bɛlɛxɛ bɔnbɔ, wo sɔnxɔ, wo xui ite ɲɛlɛxinyi kui Ala bɛ!

sentences.english: He will put down the peoples under us, and the nations under our feet.
sentences.susu: Alatala Xili Xungbe Kanyi magaaxu. Mangɛ xungbe nan a ra duniɲa birin xun ma.

sentences.english: He will give us our heritage, the glory of Jacob who is dear to him. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: A bara sie ragoro won bun ma, e xa lu won sagoe.

sentences.english: God has gone up with a glad cry, the Lord with the sound of the horn.
sentences.susu: A bara bɔxi fi won ma kɛ ra, naxan findixi Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ xa xunnakeli ra. A won xanu. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: Give praises to God, make songs of praise; give praises to our King, make songs of praise.
sentences.susu: Ala tema ɲɛlɛxin xui nan tagi, a fama sarae fe xui ma.

sentences.english: For God is the King of all the earth; make songs of praise with knowledge.
sentences.susu: Wo bɛɛti ba Ala bɛ, wo bɛɛti ba! Wo bɛɛti ba won ma mangɛ bɛ, wo bɛɛti ba!

sentences.english: God is the ruler over the nations; God is on the high seat of his holy rule.
sentences.susu: Ala nan mangɛ ra duniɲa birin xun ma, wo xa lɔnni bɛɛti ba.

sentences.english: The rulers of the peoples have come together, with the people of the God of Abraham; because the powers of the earth are God's: he is lifted up on high.
sentences.susu: Ala magoroxi mangɛ kibanyi sɛniyɛnxi kui, si birin mangɛ nan a ra.

sentences.english: Great is the Lord and greatly to be praised, in the town of our God, in his holy mountain.
sentences.susu: Kora xa die xa bɛɛti. Sigi sɛniyɛnxi.

sentences.english: Beautiful in its high position, the joy of all the earth, is the mountain of Zion, the mountain of God, the town of the great King.
sentences.susu: Alatala gbo. A lanma won xa a matɔxɔ a xa taa kui a xa geya sɛniyɛnxi fari.
