sentences.english: In its buildings God is seen to be a high tower.
sentences.susu: Ala xa geya Siyon tofan, a rafan duniɲa birin ma. Na findi Mangɛ Xungbe xa taa nan na.

sentences.english: For see! the kings came together by agreement, they were joined together.
sentences.susu: Ala a ɲɛngi sama a xa taa makantaxi xɔn, a bara a yɛtɛ findi a kantama ra.

sentences.english: They saw it, and so were full of wonder; they were troubled, and went quickly away in fear.
sentences.susu: Mangɛe to e malan Siyon gere xili ma,

sentences.english: Shaking came on them and pain, as on a woman in childbirth.
sentences.susu: e naxa kaaba na tofe ra. E naxa gaaxu, e fa e gi.

sentences.english: By you the ships of Tarshish are broken as by an east wind.
sentences.susu: E to gaaxu na ya ra, e naxa sɛrɛn alɔ ginɛ naxan na di barife,

sentences.english: As it came to our ears so have we seen it, in the town of the Lord of armies, in the town of our God; God will keep it fixed for ever. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: xa na mara alɔ Tarasisi xa kunkuie foye xungbe naxee imaxama.

sentences.english: Our thoughts were of your mercy, O God, while we were in your Temple.
sentences.susu: Won Marigi Ala kaabanako naxan nabaxi a xa taa kui, won bara na mɛ, won bara na to. Mangɛ Alatala na taa rakisima tɛmui birin. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: As your name is, O God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth; your right hand is full of righteousness.
sentences.susu: Ala, muxu na so i xa Hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, muxu ratuma i xa hinnɛ nan ma.

sentences.english: Let there be joy in the mountain of Zion, and let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of your wise decisions.
sentences.susu: Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi, i xili tantuma nɛ duniɲa yire birin. I xa mangɛya tinxin.

sentences.english: Make your way about Zion, and go round it, numbering its towers.
sentences.susu: Ɲama ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ Siyon geya fari, Yudakae sɛɛwama nɛ i xa kiiti xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Take note of its strong walls, looking well at its fair buildings; so that you may give word of it to the generation which comes after.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Siyon mabilin, wo xa a xa sɔɔri tidee kɔnti.

sentences.english: Because this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a tɛtɛ nun a yire makantaxie mato, alako wo xa na fala wo xa die bɛ.

sentences.english: Give attention to this, all you peoples; let your ears be open, all you who are living in the world.
sentences.susu: Kora xa die xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: High and low together, the poor, and those who have wealth.
sentences.susu: Wo wo tuli mati yi ra, wo tan ɲama birin. Duniɲa ɲama birin, wo wo tuli mati n na.

sentences.english: From my mouth will come words of wisdom; and in the thoughts of my heart will be knowledge.
sentences.susu: Tide xuri kanyi, tide xungbe kanyi, setare a nun se kanyi, wo birin xa wo tuli mati.

sentences.english: I will put my teaching into a story; I will make my dark sayings clear with music.
sentences.susu: N fama wɔyɛnyi hagigɛ nan falade wo bɛ, n bɔɲɛ xaxili fanyi naxan maɲɔxunxi.

sentences.english: What cause have I for fear in the days of evil, when the evil-doing of those who are working for my downfall is round about me?
sentences.susu: N nan n tuli tixi taali ra, n fama na tagi rabade wo bɛ kɔra xui ra.

sentences.english: Even of those whose faith is in their wealth, and whose hearts are lifted up because of their stores.
sentences.susu: Munfera n fa gaaxuma gbaloe lɔxɔɛ ya ra, n yaxuie xa fe kobi n nabilinma tɛmui naxɛ?

sentences.english: Truly, no man may get back his soul for a price, or give to God the payment for himself;
sentences.susu: E laxi e xa bannaya nan na, e nu fa e yɛtɛ matɔxɔ e harige xa gboe ra.

sentences.english: (Because it takes a great price to keep his soul from death, and man is not able to give it.)
sentences.susu: E mu nɔma e bore xunsarade, E mu nɔma e xunsare fide Ala ma.

sentences.english: So that he might have eternal life, and never see the underworld.
sentences.susu: E nii xunsare xɔrɔxɔ, e mu nɔma a fide abadan.

sentences.english: For he sees that wise men come to their end, and foolish persons of low behaviour come to destruction together, letting their wealth go to others.
sentences.susu: E tan mu faxama? E mu sigama aligiyama?

sentences.english: The place of the dead is their house for ever, and their resting-place through all generations; those who come after them give their names to their lands.
sentences.susu: Won a toma, lɔnnilae faxama, lɔnnitaree fan faxama nɛ. E fa e harige lu mixi gbɛtɛe yi ra.

sentences.english: But man, like the animals, does not go on for ever; he comes to an end like the beasts.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee e xilie saxi bɔxie xun ma, e maɲɔxunxi nɛ e xa banxie luma nɛ naa abadan, e xɔnyi mu kanama keli lanfanmae ma, a sa dɔxɔ lanfanma gbɛtɛe ra.

sentences.english: This is the way of the foolish; their silver is for those who come after them, and their children get the pleasure of their gold. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Hali mixi xungbe, a mu buma. A faxama nɛ alɔ subee.

sentences.english: Death will give them their food like sheep; the underworld is their fate and they will go down into it; their flesh is food for worms; their form is wasted away; the underworld is their resting-place for ever.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee laxi e yɛtɛ ra, e xa kira nan ya. E xui rafan naxee ma, nee birama nɛ e fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: But God will get back my soul; for he will take me from the power of death. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: E aligiyama lima nɛ. Faxɛ e ralɔɛma nɛ. Mixi tinxinxie e maboronma nɛ. E xa tofanyi kanama nɛ. Aligiyama findima nɛ e xɔnyi ra.

sentences.english: Have no fear when wealth comes to a man, and the glory of his house is increased;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala n nii xunsarama nɛ aligiyama, a n xanin. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: For at his death, he will take nothing away; his glory will not go down after him.
sentences.susu: Mixi na findi banna ra, a harige na gbo, i naxa gaaxu,

sentences.english: Though he might have pride in his soul in his life-time, and men will give you praise if you do well for yourself,
sentences.susu: barima a mu sese xaninma aligiyama. A harige mu birama a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: He will go to the generation of his fathers; he will not see the light again.
sentences.susu: A ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ a harige ra a xa duniɲɛigiri kui, barima birin a matɔxɔma na xa fe ra,

sentences.english: Man, like the animals, does not go on for ever; he comes to an end like the beasts.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ a fa siga aligiyama a a benbae li na, naxee mu duniɲa toma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: The God of gods, even the Lord, has sent out his voice, and the earth is full of fear; from the coming up of the sun to its going down.
sentences.susu: Alatala na wɔyɛnfe. A na duniɲa birin xilife, keli sogetede han sogegorode.

sentences.english: From Zion, most beautiful of places, God has sent out his light.
sentences.susu: Kelife Siyon, Ala xa tofanyi yanbama.

sentences.english: Our God will come, and will not keep quiet; with fire burning before him, and storm-winds round him.
sentences.susu: Won Marigi Ala na fafe, a mu dunduxi. Tɛ belebele na a ya ra, foye xungbe fan na a rabilinyi.

sentences.english: His voice will go out to the heavens and to the earth, for the judging of his people:
sentences.susu: A xui tema koore ma, a xui goroma bɔxi kiiti sade a xa mixie bɛ.

sentences.english: Let my saints come together to me; those who have made an agreement with me by offerings.
sentences.susu: «N batulae, naxee laayidi tongoxi n bɛ sɛrɛxɛ ra, wo xa wo malan.»

sentences.english: And let the heavens make clear his righteousness; for God himself is the judge. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Ala xa masenyi tinxinxi kelima koore nan ma, barima kiitisa nan na Ala ra.

sentences.english: Give ear, O my people, to my words; O Israel, I will be a witness against you; I am God, even your God.
sentences.susu: «N ma mixie, wo wo tuli mati, n xa wɔyɛn. Isirayila, n bara wo kalamu. Ala nan n na, wo Marigi Ala.

sentences.english: I will not take up a cause against you because of your offerings, or because of your burned offerings, which are ever before me.
sentences.susu: N mu xɔnɔxi wo xa sɛrɛxɛe xa fe ra. Wo sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie bama n bɛ tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: I will take no ox out of your house, or he-goats from your flocks;
sentences.susu: N mu tuura tongoma wo xɔnyi. N mu si kontonyi fan tongoma wo xa kulɛ.

sentences.english: For every beast of the woodland is mine, and the cattle on a thousand hills.
sentences.susu: N gbe nan na sube birin na wula i. N gbe nan na sube birin na geyae ma.

sentences.english: I see all the birds of the mountains, and the beasts of the field are mine.
sentences.susu: N gbe nan na xɔni birin na koore ma. N gbe nan na sube birin na fiili ma.

sentences.english: If I had need of food, I would not give you word of it; for the earth is mine and all its wealth.
sentences.susu: Xa kaamɛ n suxuma nu, n ma falama wo tan bɛ. N gbe nan na duniɲa birin na.

sentences.english: Am I to take the flesh of the ox for my food, or the blood of goats for my drink?
sentences.susu: N tan tuura sube donma? Ade. N tan si kontonyi wuli minma? Ade.

sentences.english: Make an offering of praise to God; keep the agreements which you have made with the Most High;
sentences.susu: A lanma wo xa tantui rasiga n ma, na xa findi wo xa sɛrɛxɛe ra. Wo xa wo xa laayidie rakamali n bɛ, n tan Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi.

sentences.english: Let your voice come up to me in the day of trouble; I will be your saviour, so that you may give glory to me.
sentences.susu: Wo xa n xili wo xa tɔɔrɛ kui. N fama wo ratangade, wo fan fama n matɔxɔde.»

sentences.english: But to the sinner, God says, What are you doing, talking of my laws, or taking the words of my agreement in your mouth?
sentences.susu: Ala xa masenyi nan ya, mixi ɲaaxie bɛ, «wo na n ma yaamari nun n ma saatɛ durusife munfe ra?

sentences.english: Seeing that you have no desire for my teaching, turning your back on my words.
sentences.susu: N ma sɛriyɛ mu rafan wo ma. Wo mu n ma wɔyɛnyi danxunma.

sentences.english: When you saw a thief, you were in agreement with him, and you were joined with those who took other men's wives.
sentences.susu: Wo nun muɲɛtie na a ra. Wo nun yɛnɛ rabae na a ra.

sentences.english: You have given your mouth to evil, your tongue to words of deceit.
sentences.susu: Fe ɲaaxi nan tun minima wo dɛ i, wo wule nan tun falama.

sentences.english: You say evil of your brother; you make false statements against your mother's son.
sentences.susu: Wo nun naxan nga keren a ra, wo na tɔɔɲɛgɛma.

sentences.english: These things have you done, and I said nothing; it seemed to you that I was such a one as yourself; but I will make a protest against you, and put them in order before your eyes.
sentences.susu: Wo naxan nabaxi, na nan ya. Han yakɔsi n bara n sabari. Wo ɲɔxɔ a ma a n na wo sɛɛti ma, kɔnɔ n fama xaaɲɛde wo ma, n fama a birin ya bade wo bɛ.

sentences.english: Now keep this in mind, you who have no memory of God, for fear that you may be crushed under my hand, with no one to give you help:
sentences.susu: Wo xa yi fe mɛ, wo tan naxee nɛɛmuxi Ala ma, xa na mara n wo xa fe kanama nɛ. Mixi yo mu wo ratangama.

sentences.english: Whoever makes an offering of praise gives glory to me; and to him who is upright in his ways I will make clear the salvation of God.
sentences.susu: Naxan tantui sɛrɛxɛ bama n bɛ, na mixi bara n matɔxɔ. Mixi naxan a ɲɛrɛ ki matoma a fanyi ra, n fama n tan Ala xa marakisi masende a bɛ.»

sentences.english: Have pity on me, O God, in your mercy; out of a full heart, take away my sin.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: Let all my wrongdoing be washed away, and make me clean from evil.
sentences.susu: Annabi Natan wɔyɛnfe Dawuda bɛ a yunubi raba Batiseba ra tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: For I am conscious of my error; my sin is ever before me.
sentences.susu: Ala, hinnɛ n na alɔ i darixi a ra ki naxɛ. Diɲɛ n ma fe ɲaaxi ma i xa bɔɲɛ fanyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: Against you, you only, have I done wrong, working that which is evil in your eyes; so that your words may be seen to be right, and you may be clear when you are judging.
sentences.susu: I xa n nasɛniyɛn n ma fe kobi birin ma. I xa n ma yunubi xafari.

sentences.english: Truly, I was formed in evil, and in sin did my mother give me birth.
sentences.susu: N bara n ma yunubi kolon. N mu nɔma nɛɛmude na ma.

sentences.english: Your desire is for what is true in the inner parts: in the secrets of my soul you will give me knowledge of wisdom.
sentences.susu: N na fe ɲaaxi rabaxi i keren nan na. N naxan nabaxi a mu rafan i ma. I na n makiiti, nɔndi luma nɛ i bɛ.

sentences.english: Make me free from sin with hyssop: let me be washed whiter than snow.
sentences.susu: N barixi yunubi fe nan kui, kabi nga furi ba nɛɛnɛ ra.

sentences.english: Make me full of joy and rapture; so that the bones which have been broken may be glad.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ nɔndi na lu mixi bɔɲɛ kui, na nan nafan i ma. Na lɔnni masen n bɛ.

sentences.english: Let your face be turned from my wrongdoing, and take away all my sins.
sentences.susu: N sɛniyɛn hisopi burɛxɛ ra, alako n xa fiixɛ. N sɛniyɛn, alako n xa fiixɛ fɔɛn alɔ xiɲɛ.

sentences.english: Make a clean heart in me, O God; give me a right spirit again.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛlɛxinyi nun sɛɛwɛ fi n ma, alako n bɔɲɛ xa sa.

sentences.english: Do not put me away from before you, or take your holy spirit from me.
sentences.susu: I kobe ti n ma yunubi ra, i xa n ma fe kobi birin ba n ma.

sentences.english: Give me back the joy of your salvation; let a free spirit be my support.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, n bɔɲɛ mafindi bɔɲɛ sɛniyɛnxi ra, xaxili fanyi fi n ma.

sentences.english: Then will I make your ways clear to wrongdoers; and sinners will be turned to you.
sentences.susu: I naxa n makuya i ya tode ra. I naxa i Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi ba n yi ra.

sentences.english: Be my saviour from violent death, O God, the God of my salvation; and my tongue will give praise to your righteousness.
sentences.susu: Kisi sɛɛwɛ nun limaniya fi n ma naxan n malima.

sentences.english: O Lord, let my lips be open, so that my mouth may make clear your praise.
sentences.susu: N i xa kira masenma nɛ i matandilae bɛ, alako e man xa bira i fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: You have no desire for an offering or I would give it; you have no delight in burned offerings.
sentences.susu: N nakisima Ala, n bara mixi faxa. Yandi, n xunsara, alako n xa i xa fe fanyi masen.

sentences.english: The offerings of God are a broken spirit; a broken and sorrowing heart, O God, you will not put from you.
sentences.susu: N Marigi, na niya n bɛ, n xa i tantu.

sentences.english: Do good to Zion in your good pleasure, building up the walls of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛ mu rafan i ma, xa na mu a ra n na bama nɛ i bɛ nu. I mu wama sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi xɔn.

sentences.english: Then you will have delight in the offerings of righteousness, in burned offerings and offerings of beasts; then they will make offerings of oxen on your altar.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛ fanyi findixi yɛtɛ magoroe nan na. Ala wama yi sɛrɛxɛ mɔɔli nan xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Why do you take pride in wrongdoing, lifting yourself up against the upright man all the day?
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa lɔnni bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: Purposing destruction, using deceit; your tongue is like a sharp blade.
sentences.susu: Masenyi nan ya Dowege Edonka xa fe ra, naxan a fala Sɔlu bɛ a Dawuda na Aximeleki xɔnyi.

sentences.english: You have more love for evil than for good, for deceit than for works of righteousness. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: I i yɛtɛ igboma fe kobi rabafe ra munfe ra? Ala xa hinnɛ buma nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: Destruction is in all your words, O false tongue.
sentences.susu: I dɛ luma alɔ finɛ naxan fe ɲaaxi rabama. Yanfante nan i ra.

sentences.english: But God will put an end to you for ever; driving you out from your tent, uprooting you from the land of the living. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Fe ɲaaxi rafan i ma dangife fe fanyi ra. Wule rafan i ma dangife nɔndi ra. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: The upright will see it with fear, and will say, laughing at you:
sentences.susu: I wɔyɛn xui xaaɲɛ, i dɛ mu fan.

sentences.english: See, this is the man who did not make God his strength, but had faith in his goods and his property, and made himself strong in his wealth.
sentences.susu: Na kui Ala fama i rahalakide tɛmui birin. A i suxuma nɛ, a i keri i xa banxi kui, a i keri duniɲa ma. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: But I am like a branching olive-tree in the house of God; I have put my faith in his mercy for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛ naxee findima seedee ra e fama yelede na kanyi ma yi ki nɛ,

sentences.english: I will give you praise without end for what you have done; I will give honour to your name before your saints, for it is good.
sentences.susu: «Wo na mixi mato, naxan mu nu a xaxili tixi Ala ra. A naxa la a xa naafuli ra, a a yɛtɛ kanta a xa yanfanteya ra.

sentences.english: The foolish man has said in his heart, God will not do anything. They are unclean, they have done evil works; there is not one who does good.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa lɔnni bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba xule xui ra.

sentences.english: God was looking down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who had wisdom, searching after God.
sentences.susu: Xaxilitare a falama a bɔɲɛ kui, «Ala mu na.» E fe haramuxie rabama, e mu tinxin. Mixi yo mu na naxan fe fanyi rabama.

sentences.english: Every one of them has gone back; they are unclean: there is not one who does good, no, not one.
sentences.susu: Ala a ya ragoroma adamadie ma kelife ariyanna, a xa e mato xa xaxilima nde na na naxan Ala fenma.

sentences.english: Have the workers of evil no knowledge? they take my people for food, as they would take bread; they make no prayer to God.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ birin bara makuya Ala ra, e nu fe ɲaaxi raba. Hali mixi keren mu na naxan fe fanyi rabama.

sentences.english: They were in great fear, where there was no cause for fear: for the bones of those who make war on you have been broken by God; you have put them to shame, because God has no desire for them.
sentences.susu: Tinxintaree xaxili mu na? E nu n ma ɲama tɔɔrɔ tun. E mu Ala xilima feo.

sentences.english: May the salvation of Israel come out of Zion! When the fate of his people is changed by God, Jacob will have joy, and Israel will be glad.
sentences.susu: E fama sɛrɛnde gaaxui ra na nan ma, barima Ala fama na mixi mɔɔlie rayensende, naxee wama wo tɔɔrɔfe.

sentences.english: Let your name be my salvation, O God; let my cause be judged by your strength.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa lɔnni bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba kɔra xui ra.

sentences.english: Let my prayer come before you, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
sentences.susu: Sifikae to a fala Sɔlu bɛ a Dawuda a nɔxunxi e xɔnyi, Dawuda naxa yi bɛɛti ba.

sentences.english: For men who are going after me have come out against me, violent men are purposing to take my soul; they have not put God before their eyes. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Ala, n nakisi i xili ra, n ma kiiti sa i sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: See, God is my helper: the Lord is the great supporter of my soul.
sentences.susu: Ala, n ma dubɛ suxu, i tuli mati n ma wɔyɛnyi ra.

sentences.english: Let the evil works of my haters come back on them again; let them be cut off by your good faith.
sentences.susu: Xɔɲɛ ndee bara keli n xili ma, mixi kobi naxee wama n faxafe. E mu Ala kolon fefe ma. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: Freely will I make my offerings to you; I will give praise to your name, O Lord, for it is good.
sentences.susu: Ala n malima, n Marigi tima n bun ma.

sentences.english: Because it has been my saviour from all my trouble; and my eyes have seen the punishment of my haters.
sentences.susu: A n yaxuie xa kobiɲa sare ragbilenma e ma. I xa e halaki i xa dugutɛgɛɲa kui.

sentences.english: Give hearing to my prayer, O God; and let not your ear be shut against my request.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa lɔnni bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba kɔra xui ra.

sentences.english: Give thought to me, and let my prayer be answered: I have been made low in sorrow;
sentences.susu: Ala, n ma dubɛ suxu, i naxa i nɔxun n ma maxandi ma.

sentences.english: I am troubled because of the voice of the cruel ones, because of the loud cry of the evil-doers; for they put a weight of evil on me, and they are cruel in their hate for me.
sentences.susu: I tuli mati n na, i xa n yaabi. Xanmɛri nun gaaxui bara gɛ n suxude

sentences.english: My heart is deeply wounded, and the fear of death has come on me.
sentences.susu: n yaxuie xa wɔyɛnyi xa fe ra, a nun mixi ɲaaxie xa wali kobi xa fe ra. E wama n tɔɔrɔfe, e n tɔɔɲɛgɛma xɔnɛ kui.

sentences.english: Fear and shaking have come over me, with deep fear I am covered.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ bara sɛrɛn, n sondonyi bara gaaxu faxɛ ya ra.

sentences.english: And I said, If only I had wings like a dove! for then I would go in flight from here and be at rest.
sentences.susu: Gaaxui nun sɛrɛnyi bara n suxu a ɲaaxi ra. Na bara n natagan.

sentences.english: I would go wandering far away, living in the waste land. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Xa gabutenyi nan nu na n bɛ nu alɔ ganbɛ, n nu bara siga yigiya fende nu,

sentences.english: I would quickly take cover from the driving storm and from the violent wind.
sentences.susu: n nu n gima nɛ, n siga yire makuye, n sigama wula i nɛ nu. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: Send destruction on them, O Lord, make a division of tongues among them: for I have seen fighting and violent acts in the town.
sentences.susu: N xa n gi mafuren, alɔ foye xungbe.

sentences.english: By day and night they go round the town, on the walls; trouble and sorrow are in the heart of it.
sentences.susu: N Marigi, fe kobi rabae rayensen yɛ. I naxa e lu e xa lan fe kobi ma, barima kobiɲa nun gere bara gbo taa kui.

sentences.english: Evil is there; cruel rule and deceit are ever in the streets.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ nun yanyi ra fe kobi rabae taa rabilinma, e xa fe ɲaaxi nun tinxintareya raba taa kui.

sentences.english: For it was not my hater who said evil of me; that would have been no grief to me; it was not one outside the number of my friends who made himself strong against me, or I would have kept myself from him in a secret place;
sentences.susu: E bara fe birin kana. Gbɛsɛnxɔnnɛya nun maifui bara gbo taa kui.

sentences.english: But it was you, my equal, my guide, my well-loved friend.
sentences.susu: Xa yaxui nan tun n konbima nu, n diɲɛma. Xa n xɔnmixi nan tun kelima n xili ma nu, n nan n nɔxunma nɛ a ma nu.

sentences.english: We had loving talk together, and went to the house of God in company.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan n lanfanma nan i ra, n xanuntenyi, n dɛfanboore.

sentences.english: Let the hand of death come on them suddenly, and let them go down living into the underworld; because evil is in their houses and in their hearts.
sentences.susu: Won dɛ fan, won birin sigama Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi.

sentences.english: As for me, I will make my prayer to God, and he will be my saviour.
sentences.susu: E xa e tɛrɛnna faxɛ ra, e xa goro gaburi kui e ɲiɲɛ ra, barima e e ɲɛrɛma fe ɲaaxie nan tun kui.

sentences.english: In the evening and in the morning and in the middle of the day I will make my prayer with sounds of grief; and my voice will come to his ears.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n bara Ala xili. Alatala n nakisima nɛ.

sentences.english: He has taken my soul away from the attack which was made against me, and given it peace; for great numbers were against me.
sentences.susu: N gbelegbelema kɔɛ a nun yanyi ra. A bara n xui mɛ.

sentences.english: God will give thought to me; he who from early times is strong will send pain and trouble on them. (Selah.) Because they are unchanged, they have no fear of God.
sentences.susu: N yaxuie to wuya, a bara n natanga na gere ma.

sentences.english: He has put out his hand against those who were at peace with him; he has not kept his agreement.
sentences.susu: Ala naxan na a xa kibanyi kui kabi a fɔlɛ, a a tuli matima n na, a fa n yaxuie rabira, Ɲɛngi rate barima e tondixi tuubide. E mu gaaxu Ala ya ra.

sentences.english: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart; his words were softer than oil, but they were sharp swords.
sentences.susu: Yi mixie bara e bore gere, e saatɛ kana.

sentences.english: Put your cares on the Lord, and he will be your support; he will not let the upright man be moved.
sentences.susu: E dɛ iɲɔxun alɔ xiɲɛ, kɔnɔ gere na e bɔɲɛ kui. E xa wɔyɛnyi salaxun alɔ ture, kɔnɔ e mixi tɔɔrɔma alɔ santidɛgɛma naxan baxi a tɛɛ i.

sentences.english: But you, O God, will send them down into the underworld; the cruel and the false will be cut off before half their days are ended; but I will have faith in you.
sentences.susu: I xa i xaxili ti Alatala ra, a i malima nɛ. A mu tinma tinxintɔɛ xa bira.

sentences.english: Have mercy on me, O God, for man is attempting my destruction; every day he makes cruel attacks against me.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa suuki bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba alɔ bɛɛti naxan xili, «Ganbɛ na wuri makuye fari.» A a ba Filisitakae a suxu tɛmui naxɛ Gati.

sentences.english: My haters are ever ready to put an end to me; great numbers are lifting themselves up against me.
sentences.susu: Ala, hinnɛ n na barima mixie na n gerefe. E gere tima n bɛ tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: In the time of my fear, I will have faith in you.
sentences.susu: N yaxuie fɛɛɲɛnma gere ra. Ala Xungbe, n gerefae bara wuya.

sentences.english: In God will I give praise to his word; in God have I put my hope; I will have no fear of what flesh may do to me.
sentences.susu: N na gaaxu tɛmui naxɛ, n nan n xaxili tima i tan nan na.

sentences.english: Every day they make wrong use of my words; all their thoughts are against me for evil.
sentences.susu: N Ala xa masenyi matɔxɔma. N mu gaaxuma sɔnɔn, barima n bara la Ala ra. Ibunadama gbansan nɔma munse rabade n na?

sentences.english: They come together, they are waiting in secret places, they take note of my steps, they are waiting for my soul.
sentences.susu: Tɛmui birin n yaxuie wama n tɔɔrɔfe e xa wɔyɛnyi ra. N ma fefe mu rafanxi e ma.

sentences.english: By evil-doing they will not get free from punishment. In wrath, O God, let the peoples be made low.
sentences.susu: E lanxi n ma ɲaxankatɛ ma, e bira n fɔxɔ ra yire birin alako e xa n faxa.

sentences.english: You have seen my wanderings; put the drops from my eyes into your bottle; are they not in your record?
sentences.susu: I naxa tin e xa ratanga e xa fe ɲaaxie ma. Ala, i xa xɔnɛ xa e rabira.

sentences.english: When I send up my cry to you, my haters will be turned back; I am certain of this, for God is with me.
sentences.susu: I n ma duniɲɛigiri kolon, i n yaye toxi. N ma tɔɔrɛ birin sɛbɛxi i yi ra.

sentences.english: In God will I give praise to his word; in the Lord will I give praise to his word.
sentences.susu: N na i xili tɛmui naxɛ, n yaxuie gbilenma nɛ n fɔxɔ ra. N a kolon n nun Ala na a ra.

sentences.english: In God have I put my hope, I will have no fear of what man may do to me.
sentences.susu: N Ala xa wɔyɛnyi matɔxɔma, n Alatala xa masenyi matɔxɔma.

sentences.english: I keep the memory of my debt to you, O God; I will give you the offerings of praise.
sentences.susu: N mu gaaxuma sɔnɔn, barima n bara la Ala ra. Ibunadama gbansan nɔma munse rabade n na?

sentences.english: Because you have taken my soul from the power of death; and kept my feet from falling, so that I may be walking before God in the light of life.
sentences.susu: Ala, n xa n ma laayidi rakamali i bɛ, n ma tantui sɛrɛxɛe ra,

sentences.english: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me; for the hope of my soul is in you: I will keep myself safely under the shade of your wings, till these troubles are past.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa suuki bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba alɔ bɛɛti naxan xili «I naxa halaki ti.» Dawuda naxa yi ba a to a gi Sɔlu ma, a sa so fɔnmɛ kui.

sentences.english: I will send up my cry to the Most High God; to God who does all things for me.
sentences.susu: Ala, hinnɛ n na, yandi i xa hinnɛ n na. N maratangɛ fenma i yire alɔ tɔxɛyɔrɛ a fenma a nga gabutenyi bun ma ki naxɛ han fe xɔrɔxɔɛ xa dangi.

sentences.english: He will send from heaven, and take me from the power of him whose desire is for my destruction. God will send out his mercy and his good faith.
sentences.susu: N bara Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi maxandi naxan n ma fe birin sɔɔnɛyama.

sentences.english: My soul is among lions; I am stretched out among those who are on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and whose tongue is a sharp sword.
sentences.susu: N xɔnmixie n ɲaxankatama tɛmui naxɛ, Ala n nakisima nɛ kelife ariyanna, Ɲɛngi rate a hinnɛ nun nɔndi ragoroma n ma.

sentences.english: O God, be lifted up higher than the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛe bara n nabilin, n saxi e tagi, e tan naxee adamadie faxama. E ɲinyie luxi alɔ tanbɛe, e nɛnyie luxi alɔ santidɛgɛma naxan baxi a tɛɛ i.

sentences.english: They have made ready a net for my steps; my soul is bent down; they have made a great hole before me, and have gone down into it themselves. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Ala, i xa i xa binyɛ masen koore ma, i xa a masen bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed; I will make songs, and give praise.
sentences.susu: E bara yɛlɛ ti n ya ra, a gbe mu luxi n xa so a ra. E bara yili ge n ya ra, kɔnɔ e tan nan biraxi a kui. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: You are my glory; let the instruments of music be awake; I myself will be awake with the dawn.
sentences.susu: Ala, n bɔɲɛ bara limaniya, n bara limaniya sɔtɔ. N bɛɛti bama nɛ, n i tantuma nɛ.

sentences.english: I will give you praise, O Lord, among the peoples; I will make songs to you among the nations.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ bara keli n na, n xa n ma kɔrae tongo, n xa bɛɛti ba han subaxɛ.

sentences.english: For your mercy is great, stretching up to the heavens, and your righteousness goes up to the clouds.
sentences.susu: Marigi, n i tantuma nɛ sie tagi. N bɛɛti bama nɛ i bɛ bɔnsɔɛe tagi.

sentences.english: Be lifted up, O God, higher than the heavens, let your glory be over all the earth.
sentences.susu: I xa hinnɛ koore lima nɛ, i xa tinxinyi tema nɛ han nuxuie.

sentences.english: Is there righteousness in your mouths, O you gods? are you upright judges, O you sons of men?
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa suuki bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba alɔ bɛɛti naxan xili «I naxa kasarɛ ti».

sentences.english: The purposes of your hearts are evil; your hands are full of cruel doings on the earth.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wɔyɛnyi mu tinxin. Adamadie, wo nɔma kiiti sade nɔndi ra?

sentences.english: The evil-doers are strange from the first; from the hour of their birth they go out of the true way, saying false words.
sentences.susu: Ade, wo fe ɲaaxi rabama wo bɔɲɛ kui, wo fe ɲaaxi rabama yi bɔxi ma, wo mixi ratantanma duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: Their poison is like the poison of a snake; they are like the adder, whose ears are shut;
sentences.susu: Kafi e bari tɛmui, e findixi mixi ɲaaxi nan na. Wule falɛe bara lɔɛ kabi e bari lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: Who will not be moved by the voice of the wonder-worker, however great are his powers.
sentences.susu: E xa xɔnɛ luxi nɛ alɔ bɔximase xɔnɛ, alɔ bɔximase naxan mu bɔximase suxui xui ramɛma.

sentences.english: O God, let their teeth be broken in their mouths; let the great teeth of the young lions be pulled out, O Lord.
sentences.susu: Hali bɔximase suxui fanyi, a mu nɔma a suxude.

sentences.english: Let them be turned to liquid like the ever-flowing waters; let them be cut off like the grass by the way.
sentences.susu: Ala, i xa e ɲinyi kana e dɛ i, barima e luxi nɛ alɔ yɛtɛ. Alatala, i xa e dɛ wanwan.

sentences.english: Let them be like an after-birth which is turned to water and comes to an end; like the fruit of a woman who gives birth before her time, let them not see the sun.
sentences.susu: E ɲɔnma nɛ alɔ ye naxan ifilima bɔxi. E xa tanbɛ mu ɲɛrɛma sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: Before they are conscious of it, let them be cut down like thorns; let a strong wind take them away like waste growth.
sentences.susu: A luma alɔ boe naxan fate lɔɛma lingi kui. A luma alɔ di naxan baxi a nga fate i, a mu foye to.

sentences.english: The upright man will be glad when he sees their punishment; his feet will be washed in the blood of the evil-doer.
sentences.susu: Beenun tunde xa fura yege malinsinxi ra, xa na mu a ra yege xare ra, Ala e kɔma nɛ, a e wɔlɛ a i.

sentences.english: So that men will say, Truly there is a reward for righteousness; truly there is a God who is judge on the earth.
sentences.susu: Mixi tinxinxi fama ɲɛlɛxinde barima a fama gbeɲɔxɔɛ sɔtɔde. A fama a sanyi maxade mixi ɲaaxi wuli ra.

sentences.english: Take me out of the hands of the cruel ones, O my God; keep me safe from those who come up against me.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa suuki bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba alɔ bɛɛti naxan xili «I naxa halaki ti». A naxa a ba Sɔlu to sɔɔrie xɛɛ e xa Dawuda faxa a xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: Take me out of the power of the workers of evil, and keep me safe from the men of blood.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, n natanga n yaxuie ma. N ma fe xa te dangife n yaxuie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For see, they are watching in secret for my soul; the strong have come together against me? but not because of my sin, or my evil-doing, O Lord.
sentences.susu: N natanga tinxintaree ma. N nakisi faxɛtie ma,

sentences.english: For no sin of mine they go quickly and get themselves ready; be awake and come to my help, and see.
sentences.susu: barima e wama n faxafe. Sɛnbɛmae na e malanfe n xili ma, hali n mu findi fe kobi raba ra, hali n mu yunubi yo raba Alatala ra.

sentences.english: You, O Lord God of armies, are the God of Israel; come now and give punishment to the nations; have no mercy on any workers of deceit. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Hali n mu na fe ɲaaxi rabafe, e e gima n fɔxɔ ra, e xa n gere. Keli, i fa n mali! Yandi n ma fe mato.

sentences.english: They come back in the evening; they make a noise like a dog, and go round the town.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Alatala, Mangɛ Ala, keli, i xa si danxaniyataree ratɔn. I naxa diɲɛ yi yanfante tinxintaree ma. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: See, hate is dropping from their lips; curses are on their tongues: they say, Who gives attention to it?
sentences.susu: E fama kɔɛ ra alɔ bare xaaɲɛe e fa taa rabilin.

sentences.english: But you are laughing at them, O Lord; you will make sport of all the nations.
sentences.susu: E dɛ luma alɔ bare dɛ xunfɛ minima naxan kui. E xa wɔyɛnyi mixi tɔɔrɔma alɔ santidɛgɛma. E naxɛ, «Nde nɔma won ma wɔyɛnyi mɛde?»

sentences.english: O my strength, I will put my hope in you; because God is my strong tower.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala, i tan nan yelema e ma. I si danxaniyataree birin mayelema.

sentences.english: The God of my mercy will go before me: God will let me see my desire effected on my haters.
sentences.susu: N nan n yɛtɛ ratangama e sɛnbɛ ma i tan nan saabui ra. Ala nan na n ma kantama ra.

sentences.english: Put them not to death, for so my people will keep the memory of them: let them be sent in all directions by your power; make them low, O Lord our saviour.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, naxan xa hinnɛ gbo, i xa ti n ya ra, i xa n yaxuie rabira.

sentences.english: Because of the sin of their mouths and the word of their lips, let them even be taken in their pride; and for their curses and their deceit,
sentences.susu: N Marigi, n ma kantama, i naxa e faxa keren na. I xa e rabira alako n ma ɲama naxa nɛɛmu i sɛnbɛ ma.

sentences.english: Put an end to them in your wrath, put an end to them, so that they may not be seen again; let them see that God is ruling in Jacob and to the ends of the earth. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: E yunubi rabama e xa wɔyɛnyie ra. I xa e suxu e xa yɛtɛ igboɲa kui. E dankɛe nun wulee nan tun falama.

sentences.english: And in the evening let them come back, and make a noise like a dog, and go round the town.
sentences.susu: I xa e raɲɔn i xa xɔnɛ ra, alako e naxa to sɔnɔn, alako e xa a kolon Ala nan Mangɛ ra Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ nun duniɲa birin xun ma. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: Let them go wandering up and down in search of food, and be there all night if they have not enough.
sentences.susu: E fama kɔɛ ra alɔ bare xaaɲɛe e fa taa rabilin.

sentences.english: But I will make songs of your power; yes, I will give cries of joy for your mercy in the morning; because you have been my strength and my high tower in the day of my trouble.
sentences.susu: Baree donse fenma yire birin kɔɛ ra, kɔnɔ e mu lugama.

sentences.english: To you, O my strength, will I make my song: because God is my high tower, even the God of my mercy.
sentences.susu: N i sɛnbɛ matɔxɔma bɛɛti ra. N i xa hinnɛ matɔxɔma gɛɛsɛgɛ, barima n ma kantama nan i ra, i n kantama n ma tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: God, you have put us away from you, you have sent us in all directions, you have been angry; O be turned to us again.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa lɔnni suuki bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba alɔ bɛɛti naxan xili «Fuge tofanyi alɔ Ala xa saatɛ.»

sentences.english: By the power of your hand the earth is shaking and broken; make it strong again, for it is moved.
sentences.susu: Isirayila to Sirenikae gere, e yi bɛɛti ba na tɛmui nɛ. E nu kelixi Mesopotamiya nun Soba bɔxi ma. Yowaba naxa Edonka wulu fu nun firin faxa fole kui fɔxɔɛ na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: You have made the people see hard times; you have given us the wine of shaking for our drink.
sentences.susu: Ala, i bara muxu ralɔɛ, i bara nde ba muxu xa gali ra, i bara xɔnɔ muxu ma, kɔnɔ yakɔsi, i xa sɛnbɛ fi muxu ma.

sentences.english: Give a safe place to those who have fear of you, where they may go in flight from before the bow. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: I bara bɔxi rasɛrɛn, i bara a ibɔɔ. I xa na yailan muxu bɛ barima bɔxi wama kanafe.

sentences.english: So that your loved ones may be made safe, let your right hand be my salvation, and give me an answer.
sentences.susu: I bara fe xɔrɔxɔɛe dɔxɔ i xa mixie ma, han e bara lu alɔ siisila.

sentences.english: God has said in his holy place, I will be glad: I will make a division of Shechem, and the valley of Succoth will be measured out.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ naxee gaaxuxi i ya ra, i bara tɔnxuma so e yi ra, e xa nɔ e yaxuie ra.

sentences.english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; and Ephraim is the strength of my head; Judah is my law-giver;
sentences.susu: I xa i xanuntenyie rakisi i sɛnbɛ ra, i xa muxu xa dubɛ suxu.

sentences.english: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I put out my shoe; over Philistia will a glad cry be sounded.
sentences.susu: Ala xa masenyi nan ya, a naxan falaxi hɔrɔmɔbanxi sɛniyɛnxi kui, «N Sikemi taa fima nɛ wo ma xunnakeli kui, n Sukɔti geya lanbanyi fan fi wo ma.

sentences.english: Who will take me into the strong town? who will be my guide into Edom?
sentences.susu: Galadi bɔxi, n gbe. Manasi bɔxi, n gbe. Efiramikae nan findima n ma geresoe ra. N mangɛ dɔxɔma nɛ Yudaya.

sentences.english: Have not you put us away, O God? and you have not gone out with our armies.
sentences.susu: Mowabakae findima n ma konyie nan na. Edon findi n ma bɔxi ra. N gere xui ratema nɛ Filisita.»

sentences.english: Give us help in our trouble; for there is no help in man.
sentences.susu: Ala, nde nɔma n xaninde na taa makantaxi kui? Nde nɔma n xaninde han Edon bɔxi ma?

sentences.english: Through God we will do great things, for through him our haters will be crushed under our feet.
sentences.susu: I tan gbansan, i tan naxan muxu ralɔɛ, i tan naxan mu nu na muxu xa sɔɔrie sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Let my cry come to you, O God; let your ears be open to my prayer.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba kɔra xui ra.

sentences.english: From the end of the earth will I send up my cry to you, when my heart is overcome: take me to the rock which is over-high for me.
sentences.susu: Ala, i tuli mati n ma maxandi ra. N ma maxandi ramɛ.

sentences.english: For you have been my secret place, and my high tower from those who made war on me.
sentences.susu: N i maxandima kelife ra bɔxi makuye. N bɔɲɛ mu saxi. N xanin geya fari naxan ite dangife n na.

sentences.english: I will make your tent my resting-place for ever: I will keep myself under the cover of your wings. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: I findixi n bɛ yire nan na n kantaxi dɛnnaxɛ n yaxuie ya i.

sentences.english: For you, O God, have made answer to my prayers; you have given me the heritage of those who give honour to your name.
sentences.susu: N wama lufe i xɔnyi tɛmui birin. N wama lufe i xa kantari kui, alɔ xɔni yɔrɛ luma a nga gabutenyi bun ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: You will give the king long life; and make his years go on through the generations.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, i bara i tuli mati n ma maxandi ra. I bara kɛ fi n ma, nun mixi birin ma naxee gaaxuxi i xili ya ra.

sentences.english: May the seat of his authority be before God for ever; may mercy and righteousness keep him safe.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa simaya xunmasa, alako a xa bu a gbegbe ra.

sentences.english: So will I make songs in praise of your name for ever, giving to God that which is right day by day.
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya xa bu i ya i tɛmui birin, I xa hinnɛ a ra, i xa findi a dugutɛgɛ ra.

sentences.english: My soul, put all your faith in God; for from him comes my salvation.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ Yedutun bɛ

sentences.english: He only is my Rock and my salvation; he is my high tower; I will not be greatly moved.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ saxi Ala nan saabui ra, n ma kisi fatanxi a tan nan na.

sentences.english: How long will you go on designing evil against a man? running against him as against a broken wall, which is on the point of falling?
sentences.susu: A luxi n bɛ alɔ fanye, n ma marakisima nun n makantama nan a ra. N mu nɔma birade sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Their only thought is to put him down from his place of honour; their delight is in deceit: blessing is in their mouths but cursing in their hearts. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Wo dutunma mixie ma han mun tɛmui, wo xa e rabira, alɔ banxi nun tɛtɛ fori?

sentences.english: My soul, put all your faith in God; for from him comes my hope.
sentences.susu: E wule falama alako e xa mixie ba yire fanyi e nu dɛnnaxɛ. E dubɛ tima e dɛ ra, kɔnɔ e dankɛ tan tima e bɔɲɛ ra. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: He only is my Rock and my salvation; he is my high tower; I will not be greatly moved.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛsa sɔtɔma Ala nan na, barima n xaxili tixi a tan nan na.

sentences.english: In God is my salvation, and my glory; the Rock of my strength, and my safe place.
sentences.susu: A luxi alɔ fanye na a ra n bɛ, n ma marakisima nun n ma makantama nan a ra. N mu nɔma birade sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Have faith in him at all times, you people; let your hearts go flowing out before him: God is our safe place. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: N ma kisi nun n ma binyɛ na Ala nan yi. Ala n makantama nan a ra, n yigi tide nan a ra.

sentences.english: Truly men of low birth are nothing, and men of high position are not what they seem; if they are put in the scales together they are less than a breath.
sentences.susu: Ɲama, wo xa wo taxu a ra, wo xa wo xa kɔntɔfili masen a bɛ. A tan nan nɔma won malide. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: Have no faith in the rewards of evil-doing, or in profits wrongly made: if your wealth is increased, do not put your hopes on it.
sentences.susu: Adamadie luma alɔ foye naxan dangima. Mixi xungbe findima mixi xuri ra, Xa e xa fe bara maniya, a yelebu alɔ foye.

sentences.english: Once has God said, twice has it come to my ears, that power is God's:
sentences.susu: Wo naxa harige fen fe kobi ra, wo naxa a fen muɲɛ ra. Xa wo xa naafuli sa gbo, wo naxa wo xaxili ti na ra.

sentences.english: And mercy, O Lord, is yours, for you give to every man the reward of his work.
sentences.susu: Ala bara fe firin fala n naxee mɛxi. Keren, sɛnbɛ na Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: O God, you are my God; early will I make my search for you: my soul is dry for need of you, my flesh is wasted with desire for you, as a dry and burning land where no water is;
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti, a naxan ba Yudaya, a to nu gbengberenyi ma tɛmui naxɛ

sentences.english: To see your power and your glory, as I have seen you in the holy place.
sentences.susu: Ala nan n Marigi ra. Ala n i fenma, barima n hayi na i ma, alɔ fate hayi to na ye ma gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: Because your mercy is better than life, my lips will give you praise.
sentences.susu: N luma i xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui alako n xa i sɛnbɛ nun i xa binyɛ to.

sentences.english: So will I go on blessing you all my life, lifting up my hands in your name.
sentences.susu: I xa hinnɛ fan simaya bɛ. N bara i matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: My soul will be comforted, as with good food; and my mouth will give you praise with songs of joy;
sentences.susu: N i tantuma n ma simaya birin kui, n nan n bɛlɛxɛe itema i mabiri.

sentences.english: When the memory of you comes to me on my bed, and when I give thought to you in the night-time.
sentences.susu: N bɔnsɔɛ wasama nɛ i tantufe ra sɛɛwɛ kui.

sentences.english: Because you have been my help, I will have joy in the shade of your wings.
sentences.susu: N na n sa n i xa fe maɲɔxunma kɔɛ birin,

sentences.english: My soul keeps ever near you: your right hand is my support.
sentences.susu: barima i tan nan n malima. N sɛɛwama nɛ i niini bun ma.

sentences.english: But those whose desire is my soul's destruction will go down to the lower parts of the earth.
sentences.susu: N nii bara fatu i ma, i bɛlɛxɛ luma nɛ n bun ma.

sentences.english: They will be cut off by the sword; they will be food for foxes.
sentences.susu: Naxee katama n faxade, e tan nan faxama.

sentences.english: But the king will have joy in God; everyone who takes an oath by him will have cause for pride; but the false mouth will be stopped.
sentences.susu: Santidɛgɛma fama nɛ e sɔxɔde, wulai baree fa e ibɔɔde.

sentences.english: O God, let the voice of my grief come to your ear: keep my life from the fear of those who are against me.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: Keep me safe from the secret purpose of wrongdoers; from the band of the workers of evil;
sentences.susu: Ala, i tuli mati n wa xui ra, N natanga n yaxuie ma.

sentences.english: Who make their tongues sharp like a sword, and whose arrows are pointed, even bitter words;
sentences.susu: N nɔxun mixi ɲaaxie ma naxee wama n tɔɔrɔfe tinxintareya kui.

sentences.english: So that in secret they may let loose their arrows at the upright, suddenly and unseen.
sentences.susu: E dɛ xaaɲɛ alɔ santidɛgɛma, e xa wɔyɛn ɲaaxie luma alɔ tanbɛe.

sentences.english: They make themselves strong in an evil purpose; they make holes for secret nets; they say, Who will see it,
sentences.susu: E mu gaaxuma tinxintɔɛ ya ra, e luma a ɲaxankata ra tun.

sentences.english: Or make discovery of our secret purpose? The design is framed with care; and the inner thought of a man, and his heart, is deep.
sentences.susu: E dɛ kobi, e yɛlɛ italama mixi ya ra. E naxɛ, «Nde na kolonma?»

sentences.english: But God sends out an arrow against them; suddenly they are wounded.
sentences.susu: E yanfanteya yailanma, e a fala, «Won xa keli a yanfa xili ma. A sɔɔnɛyama nɛ.» Adama xa maɲɔxunyi tilin.

sentences.english: The evil of their tongues is the cause of their fall; all those who see them are shaking their heads at them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala na tanbɛe woli, e e lima nɛ keren na.

sentences.english: And in fear men make public the works of God; and giving thought to his acts they get wisdom.
sentences.susu: E bara wule fala. Naxee e toma, e e gima nɛ.

sentences.english: The upright will be glad in the Lord and have hope in him; and all the lovers of righteousness will give him glory.
sentences.susu: Na gaaxui adama birin suxuma nɛ. E Ala xa wali masenma, e a xa wali kolonma nɛ.

sentences.english: It is right for you, O God, to have praise in Zion: to you let the offering be made.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: To you, O hearer of prayer, let the words of all flesh come.
sentences.susu: Matɔxɔɛ na i tan Ala bɛ Siyoni geya fari. Muxu laayidi naxan tongoxi i bɛ, muxu na birin nakamalima nɛ.

sentences.english: Evils have overcome us: but as for our sins, you will take them away.
sentences.susu: Ala, i muxu xa maxandi birin mɛma nɛ. Duniɲa birin fama nɛ birade i fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Happy is the man of your selection, to whom you give a resting-place in your house; we will be full of the good things out of your holy place.
sentences.susu: Tantanyi to nɔ muxu ra, i bara muxu xa yunubi xafari.

sentences.english: You will give us an answer in righteousness by great acts of power, O God of our salvation; you who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, and of the far-off lands of the sea;
sentences.susu: I naxan sugandima a xa makɔrɛ i xa salide ra, na ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ barima a buma nɛ i xɔnyi. Muxu bara wasa i xa fe fanyi ra, fe sɛniyɛnxi naxan kelixi i xa hɔrɔmɔlingira.

sentences.english: The God by whose strength the mountains are fixed; who is robed with power:
sentences.susu: I muxu xa maxandi yaabima kaabanako nun tinxinyi ra. Ala, i bara findi muxu rakisima ra. Duniɲa yire birin xaxili tixi i ra.

sentences.english: Who makes the loud voice of the sea quiet, and puts an end to the sound of its waves.
sentences.susu: I bara geya daa i sɛnbɛ ra barima sɛnbɛma nan i ra.

sentences.english: Those in the farthest parts of the earth have fear when they see your signs: the outgoings of the morning and evening are glad because of you.
sentences.susu: I bara baa xui radundu, mɔrɔnyi xui mu na. I bara ɲama fan masabari.

sentences.english: You have given your blessing to the earth, watering it and making it fertile; the river of God is full of water: and having made it ready, you give men grain.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa birin gaaxuma nɛ i xa kaabanakoe ya ra. Kelife sogetede han sogegorode, e birin e ɲɛlɛxin xui raminima nɛ i xa fe ra.

sentences.english: You make the ploughed lands full of water; you make smooth the slopes: you make the earth soft with showers, sending your blessing on its growth.
sentences.susu: I bɔxi mɛɛni, a a rafe fe fanyi ra. I xure rafema ye ra alako mixie xa baloe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: The year is crowned with the good you give; life-giving rain is dropping from your footsteps,
sentences.susu: I tunɛ ye sama bɔxi ma alako bɔxi xa bɔrɔxɔ sansi bɛ. I barakɛ sama xɛ ma, a xa fan.

sentences.english: Falling on the grass of the waste land: and the little hills are glad on every side.
sentences.susu: Xɛ xaba tɛmui i fe fanyi raminima nɛ. I xa sansi sase rafema nɛ, han a fili a ma.

sentences.english: The grass-land is thick with flocks; the valleys are full of grain; they give glad cries and songs of joy.
sentences.susu: Gbengberenyi fiilie nun geyae fanma nɛ.

sentences.english: Send up a glad cry to God, all the earth:
sentences.susu: Adamadie birin xui xa ite sɛɛwɛ ra Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: Make a song in honour of his name: give praise and glory to him.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a xili binya bɛɛti ra, wo xa a binya matɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Say to God, How greatly to be feared are your works! because of your great power your haters are forced to put themselves under your feet.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a fala Ala bɛ, «I xa kaabanakoe magaaxu. I sɛnbɛ gbo han. Hali i yaxuie sɛrɛnma i ya ra.

sentences.english: Let all the earth give you worship, and make songs to you; let them make songs to your name. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Duniɲa birin i batuma, e i binya bɛɛti ra, e i xili matɔxɔ.» Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: Come and see the works of God: he is to be feared in all he does to the children of men.
sentences.susu: Wo fa Ala xa wali matode. A na fe raba adamadie tagi, na magaaxu.

sentences.english: The sea was turned into dry land: they went through the river on foot: there did we have joy in him.
sentences.susu: A baa findi xare ra, a mixi ragiri xure ma e sanyi xaraxi ra. Na kui, won ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ a ra.

sentences.english: He is ruling in power for ever; his eyes are watching the nations: may his haters have no strength against him. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: A duniɲa yamarima sɛnbɛ ra abadan. A ya tixi sie ra, matandilae mu nɔma kelide sɔnɔn. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: Give blessings to our God, O you peoples, let the voice of his praise be loud;
sentences.susu: Sie, wo xa won Marigi Ala tantu, wo xa wo xui ramini a matɔxɔfe ra.

sentences.english: Because he gives us life, and has not let our feet be moved.
sentences.susu: A bara simaya fi won ma, a mu tin won xa bira,

sentences.english: For you, O God, have put us to the test: testing us by fire like silver.
sentences.susu: barima Ala won bɔɲɛ kolon. A bara won mato alɔ mixi gbeti matoma ki naxɛ a a raxunu alako a gbi xa ba.

sentences.english: You let us be put in prison; chains were put on our legs.
sentences.susu: I bara muxu xun ti yɛlɛ kui ra, i man bara kote dɔxɔ muxu xun ma.

sentences.english: You let men go driving over our heads; we went through fire and through water; but you took us out into a wide place.
sentences.susu: I bara a lu mixie xa nɔ muxu ra, muxu xa tɔɔrɔ ye nun tɛ xɔɔra. Kɔnɔ a raɲɔnyi, i bara muxu xun ti daxamui yire ra.

sentences.english: I will come into your house with burned offerings, I will make payment of my debt to you,
sentences.susu: N fama sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra i xa banxi kui, n nan n ma laayidi rakamalima nɛ,

sentences.english: Keeping the word which came from my lips, and which my mouth said, when I was in trouble.
sentences.susu: n naxee fala n dɛ ra n nu tɔɔrɛ kui tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: I will give you burned offerings of fat beasts, and the smoke of sheep; I will make offerings of oxen and goats. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: N xuruse turaxie bama nɛ sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, alɔ yɛxɛɛ kontonyie, tuurae, nun si donbie. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: Come, give ear to me, all you God-fearing men, so that I may make clear to you what he has done for my soul.
sentences.susu: Wo fa, wo xa wo tuli mati, wo tan naxee gaaxuma Ala ya ra. N xa a masen Ala naxan nabaxi n bɛ.

sentences.english: My voice went up to him, and I was lifted up from the underworld.
sentences.susu: N bara a xili, n bara a matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: I said in my heart, The Lord will not give ear to me:
sentences.susu: Xa yanfanteya nu na n bɔɲɛ kui nu, n Marigi mu nu a tuli matima n na.

sentences.english: But truly God's ear has been open; he has give attention to the voice of my prayer.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala bara n xui ramɛ, a n ma dubɛ suxu.

sentences.english: Praise be to God who has not taken away his good faith and his mercy from me.
sentences.susu: Tantui na Ala bɛ naxan bara n ma maxandi xui mɛ, a man bara hinnɛ n na.

sentences.english: May God give us mercy and blessing, and let the light of his face be shining on us; (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Bɛɛti nun suuki bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba kɔra xui ra.

sentences.english: So that men may see your way on the earth, and your salvation among all nations.
sentences.susu: Ala xa hinnɛ won na, Ala xa barakɛ ragoro won ma, Ala xa naiyalanyi xa yanba won ma, Ɲɛngi rate

sentences.english: Let the peoples give you praise, O God; let all the peoples give you praise.
sentences.susu: alako a xa kirae xa kolon duniɲa ma, alako si birin xa a xa marakisi kolon.

sentences.english: O let the nations be glad, and make song of joy; for you will be the judge of the peoples in righteousness, guiding the nations of the earth. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Ala, sie xa i tantu, si birin xa i tantu.

sentences.english: Let the peoples give you praise, O God; let all the peoples give you praise.
sentences.susu: E xa bɛɛti ba ɲɛlɛxinyi kui, barima i sie makiitima nɔndi ra, i tan nan e raɲɛrɛma yi duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: The earth has given her increase; and God, even our God, will give us his blessing.
sentences.susu: Ala, sie xa i tantu, si birin xa i tantu.

sentences.english: God will give us his blessing; so let all the ends of the earth be in fear of him.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi bara daxamui ramini won bɛ, tantui na won Marigi Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: Let God be seen, and let his haters be put to flight; let those who are against him be turned back before him.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: Let them be like smoke before the driving wind; as wax turning soft before the fire, so let them come to an end before the power of God.
sentences.susu: Ala xa keli, a yaxuie xa yensen yɛ. Naxee a xɔnma, e xa e gi a ya ra.

sentences.english: But let the upright be glad; let them have delight before God; let them be full of joy.
sentences.susu: I i yaxuie ralɔɛma nɛ alɔ foye tɛ tuuri ralɔɛma ki naxɛ. Kaafiri lɔɛma nɛ Ala ya i, alɔ ture xunuma tɛ i ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Make songs to God, make songs of praise to his name; make a way for him who comes through the waste lands; his name is Jah; be glad before him.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi tinxinxi ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ, e e sɛɛwɛ xui itema nɛ Ala ya i. E tan luma na ɲɛlɛxinyi nan kui.

sentences.english: A father to those who have no father, a judge of the widows, is God in his holy place.
sentences.susu: Won xa bɛɛti ba Ala bɛ, won xa a xili matɔxɔ bɛɛti ra. Naxan ɲɛrɛma nuxui fari, won xa a rasɛnɛ. A xili Alatala. Won xa won sɛɛwɛ xui rate a ma.

sentences.english: Those who are without friends, God puts in families; he makes free those who are in chains; but those who are turned away from him are given a dry land.
sentences.susu: Ala, misikiinɛ baba nan a ra. Ala, kaaɲɛ makantɛ nan a ra. Ala xɔnyi sɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: O God, when you went out before your people, wandering through the waste land; (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Ala denbaya fima denbayatare ma, Ala xɔrɛya fima geelimanie ma, e ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ. Kɔnɔ Ala matandie luma nɛ gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: The earth was shaking and the heavens were streaming, because God was present; even Sinai itself was moved before God, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: Ala, i nu na i xa ɲama ya ra wula i tɛmui naxɛ,

sentences.english: You, O God, did freely send the rain, giving strength to the weariness of your heritage.
sentences.susu: bɔxi birin nu sɛrɛnma nɛ. Tunɛ ye nu goroma Ala ya i, Isirayila Marigi Ala, naxan na Siyoni.

sentences.english: Those whose resting-place was there, even the poor, were comforted by your good things, O God.
sentences.susu: Ala nu tunɛ ye ragoroma bɔxi ma, a xa sɛnbɛ fi a xa bɔxi taganxi ma.

sentences.english: The Lord gives the word; great is the number of the women who make it public.
sentences.susu: I bara i xa ɲama rasabati naa. I bara tɔɔrɔmixi mali naa. I na birin nabaxi nɛ barima i fan.

sentences.english: Kings of armies quickly go in flight: and the women in the houses make a division of their goods.
sentences.susu: Marigi masenyi fanyi soma a xa xɛɛrae yi ra. Gali belebele nan e ra. E naxɛ,

sentences.english: Will you take your rest among the flocks? like the wings of a dove covered with silver, and its feathers with yellow gold.
sentences.susu: «Geresoe mangɛe na e gife, e na e gife wo ya ra. Wo xa ginɛe naxee luxi banxi, e fama yi gere naafuli itaxunde.

sentences.english: When the Most High put the kings to flight, it was as white as snow in Salmon.
sentences.susu: Wo fama wo malabude wo xa xurusee fɛ ma. Ala mɛɛnima nɛ a xa ɲama ma alɔ a mɛɛnima ganbɛe ma ki naxɛ. E gabutenyi luma alɔ gbeti nun xɛɛma nan na e ma.»

sentences.english: A hill of God is the hill of Bashan; a hill with high tops is the hill of Bashan.
sentences.susu: Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi bara mangɛe rayensen Salamon geya ma balabalanyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: Why are you looking with envy, you high hills, on the hill desired by God as his resting-place? truly, God will make it his house for ever.
sentences.susu: Basan geya, Ala naxan daaxi, konde wuyaxi naxan bɛ,

sentences.english: The war-carriage of God is among Israel's thousands; the Lord has come from Sinai to the holy place.
sentences.susu: wo na Ala xa geya sugandixi matofe tɔɔnɛ ra munfe ra, a bara a xa hɔrɔmɔlingira ti dɛnnaxɛ? Ala luma nɛ mɛnni tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: You have gone up on high, taking your prisoners with you; you have taken offerings from men; the Lord God has taken his place on the seat of his power.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa geresoe xa gisee wuya dangi wulu fu ra. A xa geresoe fan dangi wulu wulue ra. Ala na e ya ma. Sinayi geya na yire sɛniyɛnxi kui.

sentences.english: Praise be to the Lord, who is our support day by day, even the God of our salvation. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala, i bara te koore ma. I bara geelimanie xanin. Adamadie bara i buɲa, matandilae fan bara wa sofe i xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Our God is for us a God of salvation; his are the ways out of death.
sentences.susu: Tantui na i bɛ lɔxɔɛ birin, a won ma kote xaninfe lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ. Won ma marakisima na Ala nan na.

sentences.english: The heads of the haters of God will be crushed; even the head of him who still goes on in his evil ways.
sentences.susu: Won Marigi Alatala won nakelima nɛ faxɛ ma. Won ma marakisima na Ala nan na.

sentences.english: The Lord said, I will make them come back from Bashan, and from the deep parts of the sea;
sentences.susu: Ala a yaxuie xunyi kanama nɛ. Naxee ɲɛrɛ kira ɲaaxi xɔn ma, a nee fan xun xɔri bɔɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: So that your foot may be red with blood, and the tongues of your dogs with the same.
sentences.susu: Marigi naxɛ, «N fama nɛ e ra kelife Basan, n fa e ra kelife baa ma,

sentences.english: We see your going, O God: even the going of my God, my King, into the holy place.
sentences.susu: alako wo xa fa e wuli to wo sanlaabe ra. Wo xa baree fan e donma nɛ.»

sentences.english: The makers of songs go before, the players of music come after, among the young girls playing on brass instruments.
sentences.susu: Ala, muxu bara i to fa ra ɲama ya ma. Ala nun a xa mangɛ sugandixi na sofe hɔrɔmɔlingira kui.

sentences.english: Give praise to God in the great meeting; even the Lord, you who come from the fountain of Israel.
sentences.susu: Bɛɛtibae na yare, kɔra bɔnbɔɛe na e fɔxɔ ra, ginɛe na maxase ramaxafe e rabilinyi.

sentences.english: There is little Benjamin ruling them, the chiefs of Judah and their army, the rulers of Zebulun and the rulers of Naphtali.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Ala tantu malanyie, Isirayila xa die, wo xa Alatala tantu.

sentences.english: O God, send out your strength; the strength, O God, with which you have done great things for us,
sentences.susu: Bunyamin nan ya, naxan barixi dɔnxɔɛ ra. A tan nan findixi e xa mangɛ ra. Yudaya mangɛe nan ya, e nun e xa mixie. Sabulon mangɛe nan ya, Nafatali mangɛe nan ya.

sentences.english: Out of your Temple in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Ala, i xa masenyi ti sɛnbɛ ra. I xa i sɛnbɛ masen alɔ tɛmui dangixi.

sentences.english: Say sharp words to the beast among the water-plants, the band of strong ones, with the lords of the peoples, put an end to the people whose delight is in war.
sentences.susu: I xa banxi na Darisalamu. Mangɛe fama i buɲade naa.

sentences.english: Kings will give you offerings, they will come out of Egypt; from Pathros will come offerings of silver; Ethiopia will be stretching out her hands to God.
sentences.susu: I xa xaaɲɛ Misira ma, naxan maniyɛ mali xungbe ra naxan na ye xɔɔra. A luma alɔ tuura gali, ninge yɔrɛe biraxi naxee fɔxɔ ra. Na ninge yɔrɛe luma alɔ si gbɛtɛe naxee duuti fima Misira ma. Si gbɛtɛe naxee wama gere xɔn, i xa e rayensen yɛ.

sentences.english: Make songs to God, you kingdoms of the earth; O make songs of praise to the Lord; (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Misira xɛɛrae, a nun Kusi xɛɛrae, xa fa duuti ra Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: To him who goes or the clouds of heaven, the heaven which was from earliest times; he sends out his voice of power.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxee birin na duniɲa, nun a rabilinyi, wo xa bɛɛti ba Ala bɛ, wo xa Alatala tantu,

sentences.english: Make clear that strength is God's: he is lifted up over Israel, and his power is in the clouds.
sentences.susu: naxan ɲɛrɛma nuxui fari koore ma kabi a rakuya, naxan galanyi xui raminima sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: O God, you are to be feared in your holy place: the God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon, Ala sɛnbɛ gbo. A Isirayila yamarima a sɛnbɛ ra, sɛnbɛ naxan kelima koore ma.

sentences.english: Be my saviour, O God; because the waters have come in, even to my neck.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba alɔ bɛɛti naxan xili, «Fuge tofanyie.»

sentences.english: My feet are deep in the soft earth, where there is no support; I have come into deep waters, the waves are flowing over me.
sentences.susu: Ala, n nakisi! Ye bara te han n kɔnyi.

sentences.english: I am tired with my crying; my throat is burning: my eyes are wasted with waiting for my God.
sentences.susu: N na birife boora tilinxi kui, n sanyi mu tide yo sɔtɔfe. N na madulafe ye xɔɔra.

sentences.english: Those who have hate for me without cause are greater in number than the hairs of my head; those who are against me, falsely desiring my destruction, are very strong; I gave back what I had not taken away.
sentences.susu: N bara i xili han n bara tagan, n xui yo mu na sɔnɔn, n ya bara n xɔnɔ i fenfe ra.

sentences.english: O God, you see how foolish I am; and my wrongdoing is clear to you.
sentences.susu: N xɔnmixie bara wuya dangi n xunsɛxɛ ra. Sɛnbɛmae nan e ra naxee wama n faxafe. E findi n yaxuie ra hali n mu fefe rabaxi e ra. N mu fe ɲaaxi yo rabaxi e ra, kɔnɔ e wama n xa sare nde fi.

sentences.english: Let not those who have hope in you be put to shame because of me, O Lord God of armies: let not those who are waiting for you be made low because of me, O God of Israel.
sentences.susu: Ala, i n ma tantanyi kolon, n ma yunubie mu nɔxunxi i ma.

sentences.english: I have been wounded with sharp words because of you; my face has been covered with shame.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala, i naxa a lu danxaniyatɔɛe xa yaagi n ma fe ra. Isirayila Marigi Ala, i naxa a lu i fenmae xa ifu n ma fe ra.

sentences.english: I have become strange to my brothers, and like a man from a far country to my mother's children.
sentences.susu: E n konbima i tan nan ma fe ra. N bara yaagi han.

sentences.english: I am on fire with passion for your house; and the hard things which are said about you have come on me.
sentences.susu: N xunyae mu n kolon sɔnɔn, n bara lu n taarae bɛ alɔ xɔɲɛ nde.

sentences.english: My bitter weeping, and my going without food, were turned to my shame.
sentences.susu: N wama i waxɔnfe rabafe. I konbimae bara findi n yaxuie ra.

sentences.english: When I put on the clothing of grief, they said evil of me.
sentences.susu: N wama, n sunma. Na birin man kui, mixie n konbima.

sentences.english: I am a cause of wonder to those in authority; a song to those who are given to strong drink.
sentences.susu: N sunnun donma ragoroma n ma, e n mayelema.

sentences.english: But as for me, let my prayer be made to you, O Lord, at a time when you are pleased; O God, give me an answer in your great mercy, for your salvation is certain.
sentences.susu: Naxee dɔxɔxi taa sode dɛ ra, nee n mafalama, siisilae n mayelema sigi ra.

sentences.english: Take me from the grip of the sticky earth, so that I may not go down into it; let me be lifted up from the deep waters.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala, n bara i maxandi. Ala i xa hinnɛ n na barima i xa hinnɛ gbo.

sentences.english: Let me not be covered by the flowing waters; let not the deep waters go over my head, and let me not be shut up in the underworld.
sentences.susu: N nakisi alako n naxa biri boora xɔɔra, n natanga n xɔnmixie ma.

sentences.english: Give an answer to my words, O Lord; for your mercy is good: be turned to me, because of your great pity.
sentences.susu: I naxa tin n xa madula, ye naxa n nalɔɛ, n naxa goro aligiyama.

sentences.english: Let not your face be covered from your servant, for I am in trouble; quickly give me an answer.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n xui ratin, i tan naxan fan, naxan xa hinnɛ gbo. I xa kinikini n ma, i xa n mali.

sentences.english: Come near to my soul, for its salvation: be my saviour, because of those who are against me.
sentences.susu: I naxa i nɔxun i xa konyi ma. N na tɔɔrɛ kui, yandi n mali.

sentences.english: You have seen my shame, how I was laughed at and made low; my haters are all before you.
sentences.susu: I xa i makɔrɛ n na, i xa n xunsara, i xa n nakisi n yaxuie ma.

sentences.english: My heart is broken by bitter words, I am full of grief; I made a search for some to have pity on me, but there was no one; I had no comforter.
sentences.susu: I bara n ma tɔɔrɛ nun n ma yaagi kolon, n yaxuie birin na i ya i.

sentences.english: They gave me poison for my food; and bitter wine for my drink.
sentences.susu: Konbi bara n bɔɲɛ kana han n bara fura. N hayi na kinikini ma, kɔnɔ a mu na. N hayi na mixi madundumae ma, kɔnɔ e mu toma.

sentences.english: Let their table before them be for their destruction; let their feasts become a net to take them.
sentences.susu: E pɔsɔnɛ sama n ma donse, e minse xɔnɛ soma n yi ra, ye ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Let their eyes be blind so that they may not see; let their bodies for ever be shaking.
sentences.susu: E xa teebili xa findi gantanyi ra e bɛ, e xa naafuli xa findi yɛlɛ ra naxan e suxuma.

sentences.english: Let your curse come on them; let the heat of your wrath overtake them.
sentences.susu: E ya xa ifɔɔrɔ, e xa dɔnxu. E tagi xa e xɔnɔ han e xa bira.

sentences.english: Give their houses to destruction, and let there be no one in their tents.
sentences.susu: I xa xɔnɔ e ma, e xa na tɛ kolon.

sentences.english: Because they are cruel to him against whom your hand is turned; they make bitter the grief of him who is wounded by you.
sentences.susu: E xa gɔɔrɛ xa ɲɔn, adamadie naxa lu e xɔnyi sɔnɔn,

sentences.english: Let their punishment be increased; let them not come into your righteousness.
sentences.susu: barima e tɔɔrɔmixie xa tɔɔrɛ xun masama, i naxee ɲaxankata. E mixie mayelema, i naxee halaki.

sentences.english: Let their names be taken from the book of the living, let them not be numbered with the upright.
sentences.susu: I xa e xa yunubi birin to, alako e naxa i xa kisi sɔtɔ sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: But I am poor and full of sorrow; let me be lifted up by your salvation, O Lord.
sentences.susu: E xilie xa ba simaya sɛbɛli kui, e naxa lu tinxintɔɛe ya ma.

sentences.english: I will give praise to the name of God with a song; I will give glory to him for what he has done.
sentences.susu: N tan na tɔɔrɔfe yi tɛmui, Ala, i xa n nakisi, i xa n nakeli.

sentences.english: This will be more pleasing to the Lord than an ox, or a young ox of full growth.
sentences.susu: N fama Ala xili matɔxɔde bɛɛti ra, n fama tantui rasigade a ma.

sentences.english: The poor will see it and be glad: you who are lovers of God, let your hearts have life.
sentences.susu: Na rafan Alatala ma dangife sɛrɛxɛ ra, hali ninge kamalixi na a ra, hali tuura feri kanyi na a ra, toree na naxan bɛ.

sentences.english: For the ears of the Lord are open to the poor, and he takes thought for his prisoners.
sentences.susu: Tɔɔrɔmixie sɛɛwama nɛ na tofe ra. Naxee Ala fenma, e simaya xɔnkuye sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: Let the heavens and the earth give praise to him, the seas, and everything moving in them.
sentences.susu: Alatala a tuli matima setaree ra, a mu nɛɛmuma a xa mixie ma e xa tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: For God will be the saviour of Zion, and the builder of the towns of Judah; so that it may be their resting-place and heritage.
sentences.susu: Koore nun bɔxi xa a matɔxɔ, baa nun yɛxɛɛe xa a binya.

sentences.english: The seed of his servants will have their part in it, and there the lovers of his name will have rest.
sentences.susu: Ala fama Siyoni rakiside, a Yuda taae tima nɛ. A man ɲama sabati naa, naa xa findi e gbe ra.

sentences.english: Let your salvation come quickly, O God; come quickly to my help, O Lord.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa maxandi bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: Let those who go after my soul have shame and trouble; let those who have evil designs against me be turned back and made foolish.
sentences.susu: Ala, n nakisi! Alatala, fa n mali mafuren.

sentences.english: Let those who say Aha, aha! be turned back as a reward of their shame.
sentences.susu: Ala xa mixie rayaagi naxee wama n faxafe. Ala xa e keri, Ala xa e ya ifu, naxee wama n tɔɔrɔfe.

sentences.english: Let all those who are looking for you be glad and have joy in you; let the lovers of your salvation ever say, May God be great.
sentences.susu: Ala xa e keri yaagi kui, naxee a falama n bɛ, «I xa tɔɔrɔ!»

sentences.english: But I am poor and in need; come to me quickly, O God; you are my help and my saviour; let there be no waiting, O Lord.
sentences.susu: I fenmae xa sɛɛwa. Naxee wama i xa kisi xɔn, e xa Ala matɔxɔ tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: In you, O Lord, have I put my hope; let me never be shamed.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n kantama na i tan nan na, i naxa tin n xa lu yaagi kui.

sentences.english: Keep me safe in your righteousness, and come to my help; give ear to my voice, and be my saviour.
sentences.susu: I xa n nakisi, i xa n mali i xa tinxinyi kui. I tuli mati n na, i n nakisi.

sentences.english: Be my strong Rock, the strong place of my salvation; for you are my Rock, and my safe place.
sentences.susu: I xa n kanta. I bara a fala n bɛ n xa lu i xa niini bun ma tɛmui birin, alako n xa kisi. N kantama na i tan nan na.

sentences.english: O my God, take me out of the hand of the sinner, out of the hand of the evil and cruel man.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, n natanga mixi ɲaaxie sɛnbɛ ma, n natanga xɔnnante tinxintaree ma.

sentences.english: For you are my hope, O Lord God; I have had faith in you from the time when I was young.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala, n xaxili tixi i tan nan na kabi n dimɛdi tɛmui,

sentences.english: You have been my support from the day of my birth; you took me out of my mother's body; my praise will be ever of you.
sentences.susu: kabi n nu na n nga tɛɛgɛ i. I tan nan a niya n xa bari. N i matɔxɔma tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: I am a wonder to all; but you are my strong tower.
sentences.susu: N findixi misaali nan na mixi wuyaxi bɛ, barima n kantama sɛnbɛma na i tan nan na.

sentences.english: My mouth will be full of your praise and glory all the day.
sentences.susu: N i matɔxɔma tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Do not give me up when I am old; be my help even when my strength is gone.
sentences.susu: I naxa mɛɛ n na n ma foriɲa kui, i naxa n nabɛɲin n ma sɛnbɛtareya kui.

sentences.english: For my haters are waiting secretly for me; and those who are watching for my soul are banded together in their evil designs,
sentences.susu: N yaxuie n mafalama, e wɔyɛnma e bora ra alako e xa n faxa.

sentences.english: Saying, God has given him up; go after him and take him, for he has no helper.
sentences.susu: E naxɛ, «Ala bara a rabolo, won xa bira a fɔxɔ ra, won xa a suxu. Mixi yo mu nɔma a ratangade.»

sentences.english: O God, be not far from me; O my God, come quickly to my help.
sentences.susu: Ala, i naxa i makuya n na. N Marigi Ala, fa n mali mafuren.

sentences.english: Let those who say evil against my soul be overcome and put to shame; let my haters be made low and have no honour.
sentences.susu: Ala xa e rayaagi, a xa e raɲɔn, naxee n tɔɔɲɛgɛma. Ala xa e rayaagi, a xa e ya ifu, naxee wama n tɔɔrɔfe.

sentences.english: But I will go on ever hoping, and increasing in all your praise.
sentences.susu: N xaxili tixi i ra kudɛ i. N luma i matɔxɔ ra tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: My mouth will make clear your righteousness and your salvation all the day; for they are more than may be measured.
sentences.susu: N i xa tinxinyi nun i xa kisi tantuma lɔxɔɛ birin, barima e wuya han n ɲan mu nɔma e birin kolonde.

sentences.english: I will give news of the great acts of the Lord God; my words will be of your righteousness, and of yours only.
sentences.susu: N i xa kaabanako rabaxie matɔxɔma nɛ. N Marigi Alatala, n fama i xa tinxinyi gbansan masende.

sentences.english: O God, you have been my teacher from the time when I was young; and I have been talking of your works of wonder even till now.
sentences.susu: Ala, i na n xaranfe kabi n dimɛdi tɛmui. Han ya n i xa kaabanakoe matɔxɔma.

sentences.english: Now when I am old and grey-headed, O God, give me not up; till I have made clear your strength to this generation, and your power to all those to come.
sentences.susu: Ala, i naxa n nabɛɲin yakɔsi, n bara fori, n xunsɛxɛ fan bara fuga. I naxa n nabɛɲin alako n xa i sɛnbɛ masen to nun tina mixie bɛ.

sentences.english: Your righteousness, O God, is very high; you have done great things; O God, who is like you?
sentences.susu: Ala, i xa tinxinyi gbo alɔ geya. I xa kaabanako wuya. I maniyɛ na minden?

sentences.english: You, who have sent great and bitter troubles on me, will give me life again, lifting me up from the deep waters of the underworld.
sentences.susu: Hali i to bara a niya muxu xa tɔɔrɔ, muxu xa halaki, i fama muxu rakiside, i fama muxu rakelide gaburi tilinxi kui.

sentences.english: You will make me greater than before, and give me comfort on every side.
sentences.susu: I xa n xun nakeli, i xa n madundu.

sentences.english: I will give praise to you with instruments of music, O my God, for you are true; I will make songs to you with music, O Holy One of Israel.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, na kui n i tantuma nɛ kɔra ra i xa dugutɛgɛɲa xa fe ra. Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ, n bɛɛti bama i bɛ kɔra ra.

sentences.english: Joy will be on my lips when I make melody to you; and in my soul, to which you have given salvation.
sentences.susu: N bɛɛti bama nɛ i bɛ, n i matɔxɔ, barima i bara n xun sara.

sentences.english: My tongue will be talking of your righteousness all the day; for those whose purpose is to do me evil have been crushed and put to shame.
sentences.susu: N i xa tinxinyi matɔxɔma nɛ tɛmui birin, barima naxee nu wama n tɔɔrɔfe, e bara lu yaagi kui.

sentences.english: Give the king your authority, O God, and your righteousness to the king's son.
sentences.susu: Ala, i xa a niya mangɛ xa kiiti tinxinxi sa. I xa tinxinyi xa lu mangɛ xa di dɛ i.

sentences.english: May he be a judge of your people in righteousness, and make true decisions for the poor.
sentences.susu: Na kui a xa i xa ɲama makiiti nɔndi ra, a xa tinxin tɔɔrɔmixie bɛ.

sentences.english: May the mountains give peace to the people, and the hills righteousness.
sentences.susu: Masenyi xa ti geyae fari, ɲama bɔɲɛ saxi ra, xibaarui xa yensen bɔxi ma, tinxinyi nan ɲama yamarima.

sentences.english: May he be a judge of the poor among the people, may he give salvation to the children of those who are in need; by him let the violent be crushed.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa sɛriyɛ raba tɔɔrɔmixie bɛ, a xa setare xa die rakisi, a xa e gerefae rayensen.

sentences.english: May his life go on as long as the sun and moon, through all generations.
