sentences.susu: Mixie xa gaaxu i ya ra abadan, danmi soge nun kike yanbama.

sentences.english: May he come down like rain on the cut grass; like showers watering the earth.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa lu alɔ tunɛ naxan birama xɛe ma, naxan bɔxi rafanma.

sentences.english: In his days may the upright do well, living in peace as long as there is a moon in heaven.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛ xa fe fanma na waxati nɛ, danmi kike yanbama, bɔɲɛsa gboma nɛ.

sentences.english: Let his kingdom be from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya gboma nɛ, sa fɔlɔ sogetede han a sa dɔxɔ sogegorode ra, a fɔlɔ Efirati xure ma han sa dɔxɔ bɔxi danyi ra.

sentences.english: Let those who are against him go down before him; and let his haters be low in the dust.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee na wula i, e xinbi sinma nɛ a bun ma, a yaxuie lu a sanyi bun ma.

sentences.english: Let the kings of Tarshish and of the islands come back with offerings; let the kings of Sheba and Seba give of their stores.
sentences.susu: Tarasisi mangɛe nun Suri mangɛe fama nɛ buɲae ra. Seeba nun Seba mangɛe fan duuti fima nɛ a ma.

sentences.english: Yes, let all kings go down before him; let all nations be his servants.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ birin e xinbi sinma nɛ a bun ma, sie birin lu a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: For he will be a saviour to the poor in answer to his cry; and to him who is in need, without a helper.
sentences.susu: Na kui setaree fama nɛ a xilide marakisima. A misikiinɛ sɛnbɛtare malima nɛ.

sentences.english: He will have pity on the poor, and be the saviour of those who are in need.
sentences.susu: A kinikinima nɛ sɛnbɛtaree nun setaree ma, a tɔɔrɔmixie rakisi.

sentences.english: He will keep their souls free from evil designs and violent attacks; and their blood will be of value in his eyes.
sentences.susu: A e xɔrɛyama nɛ maifui nun fe kobie ma, barima e findixi a xanuntenyie nan na.

sentences.english: May he have long life, and may gold from Sheba be given to him: may prayers be made for him at all times; may blessings be on him every day.
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya xa bu! A Seeba bɔxi xa xɛɛma sɔtɔma nɛ. Mixie xa Ala maxandi a bɛ tɛmui birin, e naxa tagan dubade a bɛ.

sentences.english: May there be wide-stretching fields of grain in the land, shaking on the top of the mountains, full of fruit like Lebanon: may its stems be unnumbered like the grass of the earth.
sentences.susu: Ala donse yiriwama nɛ bɔxi kui. Geyae rafema nɛ sansie ra, e bogie lu alɔ sansi bogi naxee na Liban. Mixie gboma nɛ taa kui alɔ bɔxi sɛxɛ.

sentences.english: May his name go on for ever, as long as the sun: may men be blessing themselves by him; may all nations be blessing his name.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Ala xili gbo abadan! Dan mu na a xili ma soge bun ma. Si birin barakɛ sɔtɔma nɛ a saabui ra, e fa a matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: Praise be to the Lord God, the God of Israel, the only doer of wonders.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Alatala tantu. A keren nan kaabanakoe rabama.

sentences.english: Praise to the glory of his noble name for ever; let all the earth be full of his glory. So be it, So be it.
sentences.susu: A xili xungbe xa tantu abadan. Duniɲa birin xa a xa binyɛ kolon. Amina! Amina!

sentences.english: The prayers of David, the son of Jesse, are ended.
sentences.susu: Yisayi xa di Dawuda xa maxandie raɲɔnyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Truly, God is good to Israel, even to such as are clean in heart.
sentences.susu: Asafi xa bɛɛti Nɔndi hagigɛ nan ya: Ala fan Isirayila bɛ, a fan mixie bɛ naxee sondonyi sɛniyɛnxi.

sentences.english: But as for me, my feet had almost gone from under me; I was near to slipping;
sentences.susu: A gbe mu nu luxi n tan yati xa ba kira ma, n sanyie xa bira kira gbɛtɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Because of my envy of the men of pride, when I saw the well-being of the wrongdoers.
sentences.susu: N nu yɛtɛ igboe tɔɔnɛma, n to a to mixi ɲaaxie findixi naafuli kanyie ra.

sentences.english: For they have no pain; their bodies are fat and strong.
sentences.susu: Sese mu e ifuma han e xa faxɛ, e fate yalanxi tun.

sentences.english: They are not in trouble as others are; they have no part in the unhappy fate of men.
sentences.susu: E mu adamadie xa tɔɔrɛ kolon, e mu ɲaxankataxi alɔ booree.

sentences.english: For this reason pride is round them like a chain; they are clothed with violent behaviour as with a robe.
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛ igboɲa findixi xunmase nan na e bɛ, e mixi tɔɔrɔma lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ.

sentences.english: Their eyes are bursting with fat; they have more than their heart's desire.
sentences.susu: E e ya tima se birin na, e waxɔnfe bara dangi a i.

sentences.english: Their thoughts are deep with evil designs; their talk from their seats of power is of cruel acts.
sentences.susu: E yoma mixi ma, e fe ɲaaxi ɲanigema yɛtɛ igboɲa kui.

sentences.english: Their mouth goes up to heaven; their tongues go walking through the earth.
sentences.susu: E Ala fe maberema, e dɛ mu dikima sese falafe ra duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: For this reason they are full of bread; and water is ever flowing for them.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, Ala xa ɲama a xun tima e ra, e la e xa wɔyɛnyie ra.

sentences.english: And they say, How will the Lord see this? is there knowledge in the Most High?
sentences.susu: E naxɛ, «Ala tan won ɲɛrɛ ki kolonma di? Fahaamui mundun na a bɛ?»

sentences.english: Truly, such are the sinners; they do well at all times, and their wealth is increased.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxie na na ki nɛ. E bɔɲɛ saxi naafuli yiriwafe kui.

sentences.english: As for me, I have made my heart clean to no purpose, washing my hands in righteousness;
sentences.susu: N ɲɔxɔ a ma, «N nan n bɔɲɛ rasɛniyɛnxi nɛ fu. N gbilenfe fe kobie fɔxɔ ra, na mu fanxi n bɛ.

sentences.english: For I have been troubled all the day; every morning have I undergone punishment.
sentences.susu: N ɲaxankataxi tɛmui birin, lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ nde sama n ma kote xun.»

sentences.english: If I would make clear what it is like, I would say, You are false to the generation of your children.
sentences.susu: Xa n sa na mɔɔli fala nu, n bara yanfanteya raba i xa die ra nu.

sentences.english: When my thoughts were turned to see the reason of this, it was a weariness in my eyes;
sentences.susu: Awa, n naxa fahaamui fen yi fe ma. Na nu xɔrɔxɔ n bɛ,

sentences.english: Till I went into God's holy place, and saw the end of the evil-doers.
sentences.susu: han n so lɔxɔɛ Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, n fa a maɲɔxun fe naxan fe kobi rabae lima.

sentences.english: You put their feet where there was danger of slipping, so that they go down into destruction.
sentences.susu: I e tima kira salaxunxi nan xɔn ma, i fa e xun nakana.

sentences.english: How suddenly are they wasted! fears are the cause of their destruction.
sentences.susu: E xa fe ɲɔnma kerenyi nan na, fe magaaxuxi e xaninma nɛ.

sentences.english: As a dream when one is awake, they are ended; they are like an image gone out of mind when sleep is over.
sentences.susu: Marigi, alɔ xiye dangima ki naxɛ mixi xunu tɛmui, i na keli, e fan xa fe bama i ya i na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: My heart was made bitter, and I was pained by the bite of grief:
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ to nu maɲaaxuma, a nu luxi nɛ n bɛ alɔ tanbɛ nan n sɔxɔma.

sentences.english: As for me, I was foolish, and without knowledge; I was like a beast before you.
sentences.susu: Daxui nan nu n na, n mu nu sese fahaamuxi. N nu luxi nɛ alɔ xuruse xaxilitare i ya i.

sentences.english: But still I am ever with you; you have taken me by my right hand.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ han ya n na i sɛɛti ma, n yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛ suxuxi i yi ra.

sentences.english: Your wisdom will be my guide, and later you will put me in a place of honour.
sentences.susu: I n naɲɛrɛma i xa marasi ra, i man n nasɛnɛma nɛ i xa nɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: Whom have I in heaven but you? and having you I have no desire for anything on earth.
sentences.susu: Nde gbɛtɛ na n yi ra koore ma? Ba i tan na, sese gbɛtɛ xɔli mu n ma yi duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: My flesh and my heart are wasting away: but God is the Rock of my heart and my eternal heritage.
sentences.susu: N fate nun n xaxili taganma nɛ, kɔnɔ Ala n bɔɲɛ sama nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: For those who are far away from you will come to destruction: you will put an end to all those who have not kept faith with you.
sentences.susu: Naxee e makuyama i ra, bɔnɔ mixi nan e ra. I mixie dɛ balanma, naxee birin i finsiriwalima.

sentences.english: But it is good for me to come near to God: I have put my faith in the Lord God, so that I may make clear all his works.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n ma hɛɛri findixi n masofe nan na Ala ra. N bara Marigi Alatala sugandi n xun taxude ra, alako n xa i xa wali fanyie birin masen duniɲa bɛ.

sentences.english: Of God, why have you put us away from you for ever? why is the fire of your wrath smoking against the sheep who are your care?
sentences.susu: Ala, munfe ra i muxu rabɛɲinxi kerenyi ra? Munfe ra i xa xɔnɛ turuma i xa ɲama xili ma i naxan nabalofe?

sentences.english: Keep in mind your band of worshippers, for whom you gave payment in the days which are past, whom you took for yourself as the people of your heritage; even this mountain of Zion, which has been your resting-place.
sentences.susu: I xa ratu i xa ɲama ma i naxan xun saraxi, i kɛ fima naxan ma, i sabatixi naxan ya ma Siyon geya ma.

sentences.english: Go up and see the unending destruction; all the evil which your haters have done in the holy place;
sentences.susu: I xa a yire mato a yaxuie naxan kanaxi, i xa i xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi to e naxan kasaraxi.

sentences.english: Sending out their voices like lions among your worshippers; they have put up their signs to be seen.
sentences.susu: I yaxuie bara e xui ite i xa naralan banxi kui, e bara e xa fɛlɛkie rate naa.

sentences.english: They are cutting down, like a man whose blade is lifted up against the thick trees.
sentences.susu: E nu luxi alɔ beera kanyi naxee fɔtɔnyi sɛgɛma.

sentences.english: Your doors are broken down with hammers and iron blades.
sentences.susu: E bara hɔrɔmɔlingira xunmasee kana beera nun dɛrɛmae ra,

sentences.english: They have put on fire your holy place; they have made the place of your name unclean, pulling it down to the earth.
sentences.susu: e naa gan tɛ ra. E bara na yire mabere i xili sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: They have said in their hearts, Let us put an end to them all together; they have given over to the fire all God's places of worship in the land.
sentences.susu: E nu a falama nɛ e bɔɲɛ ma, «Won xa e sɔntɔ!» E bara Ala xa batudee birin gan.

sentences.english: We do not see our signs: there is no longer any prophet, or anyone among us to say how long.
sentences.susu: I xa kaabanakoe mu toma, namiɲɔnmɛe fan mu na muxu ya ma kɔrɛ. Muxu mu a kolon yi fe buma han tɛmui mundun.

sentences.english: O God, how long will those who are against us say cruel things? will the hater go on looking down on your name for ever?
sentences.susu: Ee Ala, yaxui mayele tima han tɛmui mundun? Danyi mu na e xa konbie ma?

sentences.english: Why are you keeping back your hand, and covering your right hand in your robe?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra i mu i sɛnbɛ magaaxuxi masen e bɛ? I xa keli, i xa e sɔntɔ!

sentences.english: For from the past God is my King, working salvation in the earth.
sentences.susu: Kabi tɛmui xɔnkuye, Ala nan na n ma mangɛ ra, a tan naxan findixi xunnakeli saabui ra duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: The sea was parted in two by your strength; the heads of the great sea-beasts were broken.
sentences.susu: I tan nan baa ibɔɔ i sɛnbɛ ra, i daalise magaaxuxie xunyie ibutuxun naa.

sentences.english: The heads of the great snake were crushed by you; you gave them as food to the fishes of the sea.
sentences.susu: I tan nan e xunyie ibutuxun, i e fi donse ra wulai subee ma.

sentences.english: You made valleys for fountains and springs; you made the ever-flowing rivers dry.
sentences.susu: I tan nan dulonyie nun xuree rabɔɔ, i tan nan dabonyie raxɔri, naxee mu darixi xɔri ra.

sentences.english: The day is yours and the night is yours: you made the light and the sun.
sentences.susu: Yanyi nun kɔɛ findixi i gbe nan na, kike nun soge, i tan nan e daaxi.

sentences.english: By you all the limits of the earth were fixed; you have made summer and winter.
sentences.susu: I tan nan bɔxie naaninyie birin saxi. I tan nan sogofure nun ɲɛmɛ daa.

sentences.english: Keep this in mind, O Lord, that your haters have said cruel things, and that your name has been looked down on by a people of evil behaviour.
sentences.susu: I xa ratu a ma a muxu yaxuie na i tan Alatala nan maberefe, ɲama xaxilitare na i xili bɛxufe!

sentences.english: O give not the soul of your dove to the hawk; let not the life of the poor go out of your memory for ever.
sentences.susu: Yandi, i naxa i xa ɲama xanuxi rabolo alɔ ganbɛ di raboloma sɛgɛ yi ra ki naxɛ. I naxa nɛɛmu i xa misikiinɛe ma.

sentences.english: Keep in mind your undertaking; for the dark places of the earth are full of pride and cruel acts.
sentences.susu: I xa i ɲɔxɔ sa i xa saatɛ ma, barima fe kobie bara gbo yi bɔxi ma han a bara dangi a i.

sentences.english: O let not the crushed be turned back in shame; let the low man and the poor give praise to your name.
sentences.susu: I naxa tɔɔrɔmixie lu e xa yaagi kui. Misikiinɛe nun setaree xa i xili matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: Up! O God, be the judge of your cause; keep in mind the bitter things which the man of evil behaviour says against you every day.
sentences.susu: Ala, i xa keli i xili xunmafalafe ra. I xa ratu xaxilitare xa mabere ma.

sentences.english: Keep in mind the voice of your haters; the outcry of those who come against you goes up every day.
sentences.susu: I naxa nɛɛmu i yaxuie xa wɔyɛnyie ma, i naxa nɛɛmu i gerefae xa sɔnxɔɛ ma naxan mu ɲɔnma.

sentences.english: To you, O God, we give praise, to you we give praise: and those who give honour to your name make clear your works of power.
sentences.susu: Asafi xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba alɔ bɛɛti naxan xili «I naxa kasarɛ ti.»

sentences.english: When the right time has come, I will be the judge in righteousness.
sentences.susu: Muxu Marigi Ala, muxu bara i matɔxɔ. Matɔxɔɛ na i bɛ, i tan naxan na muxu sɛɛti ma, i tan naxan xa kaabanakoe falama yire birin.

sentences.english: When the earth and all its people become feeble, I am the support of its pillars. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: I naxɛ, «N ma waxati sugandixi na a li, n tan nan kiiti sama tinxinyi ra.

sentences.english: I say to the men of pride, Let your pride be gone: and to the sinners, Let not your horn be lifted up.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa nun a xa mixie fama xunude, kɔnɔ n tan nan a kinkie sɛnbɛ soma.

sentences.english: Let not your horn be lifted up: let no more words of pride come from your outstretched necks.
sentences.susu: N a falama yɛtɛ igboe nun mixi kobie bɛ, ‹Wo naxa wo yɛtɛ igbo, wo naxa wo xunyi ite.

sentences.english: For honour does not come from the east, or from the west, or uplifting from the south;
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo xunyi ite koore ma, wo ba yɛtɛ igboɲa wɔyɛnyi falafe ra.›»

sentences.english: But God is the judge, putting down one, and lifting up another.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon xunnakeli mu kelima sogetede, a mu kelima sogegorode, a mu kelima gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: For in the hand of the Lord is a cup, and the wine is red; it is well mixed, overflowing from his hand: he will make all the sinners of the earth take of it, even to the last drop.
sentences.susu: Ala nan kiiti sama, a mixi nde xa fe ragoro, a mixi nde xa fe ite.

sentences.english: But I will ever be full of joy, making songs of praise to the God of Jacob.
sentences.susu: Tɔnbili nde na Alatala xɔnyɛ, wɛni xaaɲɛ rafalaxi na naxan kui. A na soma duniɲa mixi ɲaaxie nan yi, e a min han a ɲɔn.

sentences.english: By him will all the horns of the sinners be cut off; but the horns of the upright will be lifted up.
sentences.susu: N na masenyi tima tɛmui birin, n Yaxuba Marigi Ala matɔxɔma bɛɛti ra.

sentences.english: In Judah is the knowledge of God; his name is great in Israel,
sentences.susu: Asafi xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba kɔra xui ra.

sentences.english: In Salem is his tent, his resting-place in Zion.
sentences.susu: Ala kolonxi Yudaya bɔxi ma, a xili gbo Isirayila.

sentences.english: There were the arrows of the bow broken, there he put an end to body-cover, sword, and fight. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: A xɔnyi na Salamu, a xa banxi na Siyon.

sentences.english: You are shining and full of glory, more than the eternal mountains.
sentences.susu: A geresosee alɔ xalie, wure lefae, nun santidɛgɛmae kana mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: Gone is the wealth of the strong, their last sleep has overcome them; the men of war have become feeble.
sentences.susu: I xa nɔrɛ gbo alɔ koyinma, naxan gbilen kelife geyae ma, subee wuya dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: At the voice of your wrath, O God of Jacob, deep sleep has overcome carriage and horse.
sentences.susu: I bara nɔ sɛnbɛmae ra, naxee mu xunuma sɔnɔn, naxee mu nɔ gere tide i kanke.

sentences.english: You, you are to be feared; who may keep his place before you in the time of your wrath?
sentences.susu: I tan Yaxuba Marigi Ala to keli e xili ma, e xa soe ragie nun e xa soe naxa halaki.

sentences.english: From heaven you gave your decision; the earth, in its fear, gave no sound,
sentences.susu: I magaaxu! I xa xɔnɛ kui, nde suusama i ya ra?

sentences.english: When God took his place as judge, for the salvation of the poor on the earth. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: I to kiiti sa koore ma, duniɲa naxa sabari gaaxui kui.

sentences.english: The ... will give you praise; the rest of ...
sentences.susu: I xa kiiti naxa tɔɔrɔmixie rakisi.

sentences.english: Give to the Lord your God what is his by right; let all who are round him give offerings to him who is to be feared.
sentences.susu: I xa xɔnɛ ibunadama mabiri findixi i matɔxɔɛ nan na. I xa bɔɲɛte luxi nɛ alɔ bɛlɛti i i tagi ixirima naxan na gere kui.

sentences.english: He puts an end to the wrath of rulers; he is feared by the kings of the earth.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo xa daakan nakamali wo Marigi Alatala bɛ, wo xa fa sɛrɛxɛe ra a xɔn ma, wo tan naxee birin a rabilinxi.

sentences.english: I was crying to God with my voice; even to God with my voice, and he gave ear to me.
sentences.susu: Asafi xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ Yedutun bɛ

sentences.english: In the day of my trouble, my heart was turned to the Lord: my hand was stretched out in the night without resting; my soul would not be comforted.
sentences.susu: N nan n xui ratefe Ala nan ma. A a tuli matima nɛ n xui ra.

sentences.english: I will keep God in memory, with sounds of grief; my thoughts are troubled, and my spirit is overcome. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ xɔrɔxɔɛe na fa n ma, n nan n Marigi xilima nɛ. Kɔɛ ra, n nan n bɛlɛxɛ itala a bɛ, kɔnɔ n mu madundui sɔtɔma.

sentences.english: You keep my eyes from sleep; I am so troubled that no words come.
sentences.susu: N nan n natu Ala ma, n wa n bɔɲɛ ma. N nan n maɲɔxun a ma, limaniya ba n yi.

sentences.english: My thoughts go back to the days of the past, to the years which are gone.
sentences.susu: I mu tinma n xa xi. N xaxili ifuxi, ɲan n mu nɔma wɔyɛnde.

sentences.english: The memory of my song comes back to me in the night; my thoughts are moving in my heart; my spirit is searching with care.
sentences.susu: N nan n maɲɔxunma waxati dangixie ma.

sentences.english: Will the Lord put me away for ever? will he be kind no longer?
sentences.susu: N nan n natuma nee ma n ma bɛɛtie saabui ra. N nan n yɛtɛ maxɔrin,

sentences.english: Is his mercy quite gone for ever? has his word come to nothing?
sentences.susu: «N Marigi mɛɛma nɛ ibunadama ra abadan? A mu hinnɛma mixie ra sɔnɔn?

sentences.english: Has God put away the memory of his pity? are his mercies shut up by his wrath? (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Danyi na a xa fanyi ma? A tondima a xa laayidie kamalide?

sentences.english: And I said, It is a weight on my spirit; but I will keep in mind the years of the right hand of the Most High.
sentences.susu: A bara nɛɛmu a xa hinnɛ ma? A xa xɔnɛ bara nɔ a xa kinikini ra?

sentences.english: I will keep in mind the works of Jah: I will keep the memory of your wonders in the past.
sentences.susu: N ma tɔɔrɛ kui a luma n bɛ alɔ Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi na masarafe.»

sentences.english: I will give thought to all your work, while my mind goes over your acts of power.
sentences.susu: A lanma n xa ratu Alatala xa walie ma, a xa kaabanakoe a naxee rabaxi tɛmui dangixi.

sentences.english: Your way, O God, is holy: what god is so great as our God?
sentences.susu: N nan n xaxili rasigama nɛ i xa kɛwali birin ma, n nan n maɲɔxunma nɛ i xa walie ma.

sentences.english: You are the God who does works of power: you have made your strength clear to the nations.
sentences.susu: Ala, i xa kira sɛniyɛn. Ala gbɛtɛ mu na, i maniyɛ mu na!

sentences.english: With your arm you have made your people free, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: I tan Ala nan kaabanakoe rabama, i fe magaaxuxie masen ɲamanɛe tagi.

sentences.english: The waters saw you, O God; the waters saw you, they were in fear: even the deep was troubled.
sentences.susu: I i xa ɲama xun saraxi i sɛnbɛ nan na, Yaxuba nun Yusufu xa mamadie.

sentences.english: The clouds sent out water; the skies gave out a sound; truly, your arrows went far and wide.
sentences.susu: Ala, baa xungbe to i to, a dulonyi naxa sɛrɛn.

sentences.english: The voice of your thunder went rolling on; the world was flaming with the light of the storm; the earth was shaking.
sentences.susu: Nuxuie naxa ye gbegbe ragoro, galanyi naxa bula koore ma, seyamakɔnyie naxa lu alɔ tanbɛ wolixie.

sentences.english: Your way was in the sea, and your road in the great waters; there was no knowledge of your footsteps.
sentences.susu: I xa sarinyi xui naxa bula, seyamakɔnyi naxa duniɲa iyalan, bɔxi naxa a imaxa, a sɛrɛn.

sentences.english: You were guiding your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
sentences.susu: I naxa kira rabɔɔ baa ma, i dangi ye xungbe tagi, kɔnɔ i fɔxi mu to.

sentences.english: Give ear, O my people, to my law; let your ears be bent down to the words of my mouth.
sentences.susu: Asafi xa lɔnni bɛɛti N ma ɲama, wo wo tuli mati n ma xaranyi ra, wo wo, tuli mati n ma masenyi ra.

sentences.english: Opening my mouth I will give out a story, even the dark sayings of old times;
sentences.susu: N misaali nde falama wo bɛ, n fe dangixie madɔxɔ,

sentences.english: Which have come to our hearing and our knowledge, as they were given to us by our fathers.
sentences.susu: muxu fe naxee mɛ, muxu fe naxee kolon, muxu babae saabui ra.

sentences.english: We will not keep them secret from our children; we will make clear to the coming generation the praises of the Lord and his strength, and the great works of wonder which he has done.
sentences.susu: Muxu mu nee nɔxunma e bɔnsɔɛe ma, muxu Alatala xa matɔxɔɛ falama nɛ e xanbiratie bɛ, muxu a sɛnbɛ nun a xa kaabanakoe masenma nɛ e bɛ.

sentences.english: He put up a witness in Jacob, and made a law in Israel; which he gave to our fathers so that they might give knowledge of them to their children;
sentences.susu: Ala bara yaamarie masen Yaxuba bɛ, a sɛriyɛ sa Isirayila bɔxi kui, a won benbae yamari e xa na masen e xa die bɛ,

sentences.english: So that the generation to come might have knowledge of them, even the children of the future, who would give word of them to their children;
sentences.susu: alako di naxee fama tina, nee xa nɔ a kolonde, e fan xa a masen e gbe die bɛ e fama naxee baride.

sentences.english: So that they might put their hope in God, and not let God's works go out of their minds, but keep his laws;
sentences.susu: Na kui e fama e xa lanlanteya sade Ala ma, e mu nɛɛmuma a xa wali xungbee ma, e e ɲɔxɔ sama nɛ a xa yaamarie xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And not be like their fathers, a stiff-necked and uncontrolled generation; a generation whose heart was hard, whose spirit was not true to God.
sentences.susu: E mu luma alɔ e benbae, naxee tuli xɔrɔxɔ, naxee findi matandilae ra, naxee tun mu rabɛxi, naxee xaxili mu tixi Ala keren na.

sentences.english: The children of Ephraim, armed with bows, were turned back on the day of the fight.
sentences.susu: Efiramikae xali kanyie naxa e kobe so gere ra,

sentences.english: They were not ruled by God's word, and they would not go in the way of his law;
sentences.susu: e mu Ala xa saatɛ rakamali, e mu bira a xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: They let his works go out of their memory, and the wonders which he had made them see.
sentences.susu: E naxa nɛɛmu a xa wali magaaxuxie ra, a nun a xa kaabanakoe ra a naxee masen e bɛ.

sentences.english: He did great works before the eyes of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the fields of Zoan.
sentences.susu: A kaabanako raba nɛ e benbae ya xɔri Misira, Sowan fiili ma.

sentences.english: The sea was cut in two so that they might go through; the waters were massed together on this side and on that.
sentences.susu: A naxa baa ibɔɔ, a e ragiri, a ye rati alɔ bilixi.

sentences.english: In the daytime he was guiding them in the cloud, and all through the night with a light of fire.
sentences.susu: A naxa e raɲɛrɛ nuxui saabui ra yanyi ra, a naxa e raɲɛrɛ tɛ yanbɛ ra kɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: The rocks of the waste land were broken by his power, and he gave them drink as out of the deep waters.
sentences.susu: A naxa fanye ibɔɔ gbengberenyi ma, a ye gbegbe ramini na kui alɔ dabonyi.

sentences.english: He made streams come out of the rock; and waters came flowing down like rivers.
sentences.susu: A naxa ye ramini gɛmɛ longori ra, a lu alɔ xure.

sentences.english: And they went on sinning against him even more, turning away from the Most High in the waste land;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e mu gbilen e xa yunubi rabafe fɔxɔ ra, e fa Ala matandi gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: Testing God in their hearts, requesting meat for their desire.
sentences.susu: E naxa Ala mato donsee maxɔrinfe ra.

sentences.english: They said bitter words against God, saying, Is God able to make ready a table in the waste land?
sentences.susu: E naxa Ala mabere a falafe ra, «Ala nɔma won nabalode yi gbengberenyi kui?

sentences.english: See, the rock was cut open by his power, so that the water came rushing out, and overflowing streams; is he able to give us bread? is he able to get meat for his people?
sentences.susu: A bara ye ramini fanye kui, kɔnɔ a nɔma taami fan fide e ma?»

sentences.english: So these things came to the Lord's ears, and he was angry; and a fire was lighted against Jacob, and wrath came up against Israel;
sentences.susu: Ala to na mɛ, a naxa xɔnɔ ki fanyi ra, a fa tɛ radɛxɛ Yaxuba xa ɲama xili ma, a fa xɔnɔ Isirayila ɲama ma,

sentences.english: Because they had no faith in God, and no hope in his salvation.
sentences.susu: barima e mu nu laxi Ala ra, e mu e xaxili tixi a xa kisi ra.

sentences.english: And he gave orders to the clouds on high, and the doors of heaven were open;
sentences.susu: Na kui Ala naxa yaamari fi koore naadɛe xa rabi,

sentences.english: And he sent down manna like rain for their food, and gave them the grain of heaven.
sentences.susu: «mana» xa goro e ma baloe ra, naxan findi koore taami ra.

sentences.english: Man took part in the food of strong ones; he sent them meat in full measure.
sentences.susu: Birin naxa na sɛnbɛmae xa taami don, e fa wasa na ra.

sentences.english: He sent an east wind from heaven, driving on the south wind by his power.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa foye rafa keli sogetede biri, a foye rafa a sɛnbɛ ra keli yirefanyi ma,

sentences.english: He sent down meat on them like dust, and feathered birds like the sand of the sea,
sentences.susu: naxan a niya xɔnie xa goro e ma a gbegbe ra alɔ xube nun baa dɛ mɛyɛnyi.

sentences.english: And he let it come down into their resting-place, round about their tents.
sentences.susu: A naxa e gbegbe rayolon e yonkinde tagi, e xa kiri banxie rabilinyi ma.

sentences.english: So they had food and were full; for he gave them their desire;
sentences.susu: E naxa na don han e wasa. Ala nu bara e hayi li.

sentences.english: But they were not turned from their desires; and while the food was still in their mouths,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ hali e to nu bara donse sɔtɔ, a mu bu

sentences.english: The wrath of God came on them, and put to death the fattest of them, and put an end to the young men of Israel.
sentences.susu: Ala xa xɔnɛ man naxa goro e ma, a Isirayila sɛnbɛmae nun e fonike faxa.

sentences.english: For all this they went on sinning even more, and had no faith in his great wonders.
sentences.susu: Hali na birin to raba, ɲama mu tin gbilende e xa yunubie fɔxɔ ra. E mu la Ala xa kaabanakoe ra.

sentences.english: So their days were wasted like a breath, and their years in trouble.
sentences.susu: Na kui a naxa e lu e xa fuyante kui, han e xa fe naxa raɲɔn gaaxui kui.

sentences.english: When he sent death on them, then they made search for him; turning to him and looking for him with care;
sentences.susu: Fo faxɛ na dutun e ma, e fa so Ala fenfe, e e yɛtɛ ragbilen a ma,

sentences.english: In the memory that God was their Rock, and the Most High God their saviour.
sentences.susu: e e ratu a Ala nan e sɛnbɛ ra, a Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi nan e rakisima ra.

sentences.english: But their lips were false to him, and their tongues were untrue to him;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e nu wama a madaxufe e xa wɔyɛnyie nan na, e wule fala a bɛ e dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And their hearts were not right with him, and they did not keep their agreement with him.
sentences.susu: A xa fe mu nu na e bɔɲɛ ma, e mu nu birama a xa saatɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: But he, being full of pity, has forgiveness for sin, and does not put an end to man: frequently turning back his wrath, and not being violently angry.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala to findi hinnɛnte ra, a naxa e xa yunubie xafari, a e ɲaxankatafe lu naa. A naxa diɲɛ e ma sanya wuyaxi, a mu tin a xa xɔnɛ birin xa mini.

sentences.english: So he kept in mind that they were only flesh; a breath which is quickly gone, and will not come again.
sentences.susu: A nu a kolon a bɛndɛ nan tun lanxi e ma, e ɲɛngi na dan, a mu gbilen sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: How frequently did they go against him in the waste land, and give him cause for grief in the dry places!
sentences.susu: Sanmaya yeri e murutama a ma gbengberenyi ma, sanmaya yeri e a raxɔnɔma na yire maxare ma?

sentences.english: Again they put God to the test, and gave pain to the Holy One of Israel.
sentences.susu: E nu luma Ala mato ra, e nu ti Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ kanke.

sentences.english: They did not keep in mind the work of his hand, or the day when he took them from the power of their haters;
sentences.susu: E mu e ratu a sɛnbɛ ma. E nɛɛmu a ma a e rakisi e gerefae ma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: How he had done his signs in Egypt, and his wonders in the field of Zoan;
sentences.susu: E nɛɛmu a xa tɔnxumae ma a naxee masen Misira bɔxi ma. E nɛɛmu a xa kaabanakoe ma a naxee raba Sowan fiili ma.

sentences.english: So that their rivers were turned to blood, and they were not able to get drink from their streams.
sentences.susu: A naxa e xa Nili xure nun a salonyie findi wuli ra han e mu nɔ na ye minde.

sentences.english: He sent different sorts of flies among them, poisoning their flesh; and frogs for their destruction.
sentences.susu: A naxa xɛɛrie radin e ma e halakife ra. A naxa lanxansarimae malan mɛnni e kasarafe ra.

sentences.english: He gave the increase of their fields to worms, the fruits of their industry to the locusts.
sentences.susu: A naxa tugumie radin e xa xɛe ma, katoe naxa xɛ bogi don gbiki.

sentences.english: He sent ice for the destruction of their vines; their trees were damaged by the bitter cold.
sentences.susu: A naxa e xa wɛni sansie kana balabalanyi ra, a naxa e xa sikomoro bilie tuxunsan tunɛ xinbeli ra.

sentences.english: Ice was rained down on their cattle; thunderstorms sent destruction among the flocks.
sentences.susu: Balabalanyi naxa e xa xurusee faxa, galanyi naxa e xa gɔɔrɛe sɔntɔ.

sentences.english: He sent on them the heat of his wrath, his bitter disgust, letting loose evil angels among them.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa xɔnɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ ramini e ma, a bɔɲɛ naxa te e ma, han a naxa malekɛ kasaratie ragoro e xili ma.

sentences.english: He let his wrath have its way; he did not keep back their soul from death, but gave their life to disease.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa xɔnɛ fulun e ma, a mu e nii ratanga faxɛ ma, a fe xɔrɔxɔɛe radin e ma.

sentences.english: He gave to destruction all the first sons of Egypt; the first-fruits of their strength in the tents of Ham;
sentences.susu: A naxa Misira di singe birin faxa, e Hami bɔnsɔɛe fonike birin faxa.

sentences.english: But he took his people out like sheep, guiding them in the waste land like a flock.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra a naxa a xa ɲama ramini alɔ yɛxɛɛ gɔɔrɛ, a naxa e raɲɛrɛ alɔ xurusee gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: He took them on safely so that they had no fear; but their haters were covered by the sea.
sentences.susu: A naxa e xanin bɔɲɛsa kui gaaxui yo mu e sɔtɔ, kɔnɔ a naxa e yaxuie madula baa ma.

sentences.english: And he was their guide to his holy land, even to the mountain, which his right hand had made his;
sentences.susu: Na ki, a naxa e xanin a xa bɔxi sɛniyɛnxi ma, a xa geya a naxan sɔtɔ a sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: Driving out nations before them, marking out the line of their heritage, and giving the people of Israel their tents for a resting-place.
sentences.susu: A naxa bɔnsɔɛe keri e ya ra, a fa na bɔxie itaxun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe ma kɛ ra, a mɛnni findi e sabatide ra.

sentences.english: But they were bitter against the Most High God, testing him, and not keeping his laws;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e man naxa geregiri Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi ma, e tondi a xa yaamarie rabatude.

sentences.english: Their hearts were turned back and untrue like their fathers; they were turned to one side like a twisted bow.
sentences.susu: E naxa e makuya Ala ra, e findi yanfante ra alɔ e benbae a rabaxi ki naxɛ, e lu alɔ xali kanaxi.

sentences.english: They made him angry with their high places; moving him to wrath with their images.
sentences.susu: E naxa a raxɔnɔ e xa kuye batudee ra, e a ratɔɔnɛ e xa wuri masolixie ra.

sentences.english: When this came to God's ears he was very angry, and gave up Israel completely;
sentences.susu: Ala to na fe mɛ, a naxa xɔnɔ ki fanyi, a Isirayila rabolo.

sentences.english: So that he went away from the holy place in Shiloh, the tent which he had put among men;
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa lingira rabɛɲin Silo, a nu naxan tixi mixie tagi.

sentences.english: And he let his strength be taken prisoner, and gave his glory into the hands of his hater.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa saatɛ kankira lu yaxui sagoe, e kankan a xa nɔrɛ xa tɔnxuma ma.

sentences.english: He gave his people up to the sword, and was angry with his heritage.
sentences.susu: A to xɔnɔ a xa ɲama Isirayila ma, a naxa a niya e xa sɔntɔ santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: Their young men were burned in the fire; and their virgins were not praised in the bride-song.
sentences.susu: E xa fonikee naxa gan tɛ ra, e xa ginɛdimɛdie mu matɔxɔɛ sɔtɔ,

sentences.english: Their priests were put to death by the sword, and their widows made no weeping for them.
sentences.susu: e xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxa faxa santidɛgɛma ra, e xa kaaɲɛ ginɛe fan mu wa.

sentences.english: Then was the Lord like one awaking from sleep, and like a strong man crying out because of wine.
sentences.susu: Marigi naxa keli alɔ mixi naxan kelixi xi xɔli ma, alɔ sɔɔri naxan nɔma a xa siisi ra.

sentences.english: His haters were turned back by his blows and shamed for ever.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaxuie bɔnbɔ, a e lu yaagi kui naxan mu ɲɔnma.

sentences.english: And he put the tent of Joseph on one side, and took not the tribe of Ephraim;
sentences.susu: A naxa Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ rabɛɲin, a tondi Efirami bɔnsɔɛ sugandide.

sentences.english: But he took the tribe of Judah for himself, and the mountain of Zion, in which he had pleasure.
sentences.susu: A naxa Yuda bɔnsɔɛ sugandi, a nun Siyon geya naxan nu rafanxi a ma.

sentences.english: And he made his holy place like the high heaven, like the earth which is fixed by him for ever.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa hɔrɔmɔlingira ti alɔ yire itexi, alɔ a duniɲa tixi ki naxɛ, a xa bu xɔnkuye ra.

sentences.english: He took David to be his servant, taking him from the place of the flocks;
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa konyi Dawuda sugandi, a a tongo gɔɔrɛ ya ma,

sentences.english: From looking after the sheep which were giving milk, he took him to give food to Jacob his people, and to Israel his heritage.
sentences.susu: a nu mɛɛnife yɛxɛɛ ma dɛnnaxɛ, alako a xa mɛɛni Ala xa ɲama ma, naxan findixi Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ Isirayila ra.

sentences.english: So he gave them food with an upright heart, guiding them by the wisdom of his hands.
sentences.susu: Dawuda naxa mɛɛni e ma a bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra, a e masuxu xaxilimaya ra.

sentences.english: O God, the nations have come into your heritage; they have made your holy Temple unclean; they have made Jerusalem a mass of broken walls.
sentences.susu: Asafi xa bɛɛti Ala, sie bara so i xa bɔxi kui, e i xa hɔrɔmɔlingira findi yire sɛniyɛntare ra, e Darisalamu kana.

sentences.english: They have given the bodies of your servants as food to the birds of the air, and the flesh of your saints to the beasts of the earth.
sentences.susu: E bara i xa konyie furee findi xɔnie xa baloe ra, e bara i xanuntenyie so wulai sube yi ra.

sentences.english: Their blood has been flowing like water round about Jerusalem; there was no one to put them in their last resting-place.
sentences.susu: E bara e sɔntɔ Darisalamu rabilinyi, e mu ragata.

sentences.english: We are looked down on by our neighbours, we are laughed at and made sport of by those who are round us.
sentences.susu: Si naxee na muxu rabilinyi e muxu konbima, e yoma muxu ma.

sentences.english: How long, O Lord? will you be angry for ever? will your wrath go on burning like fire?
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xɔnɔma nɛ muxu ma abadan? I xa tɔɔnɛ danma mun tɛmui?

sentences.english: Let your wrath be on the nations who have no knowledge of you, and on the kingdoms who have not made prayer to your name.
sentences.susu: I xa xɔnɔ ɲamanɛe ma naxee mu i kolon, i xa xɔnɔ mangɛyae ma naxee mu i batuma,

sentences.english: For they have taken Jacob for their meat, and made waste his house.
sentences.susu: barima e bara Isirayila xun nakana, e bara a xa lingira rabira.

sentences.english: Do not keep in mind against us the sins of our fathers; let your mercy come to us quickly, for we have been made very low.
sentences.susu: I naxa ratu muxu xa yunubi dangixie ma. I xa hinnɛ muxu ra mafuren, barima sɛnbɛ yo mu na muxu bɛ sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Give us help, O God of our salvation, for the glory of your name; take us out of danger and give us forgiveness for our sins, because of your name.
sentences.susu: Kafu muxu ma, muxu rakisima Ala, i xili xa nɔrɛ xa fe ra. I xa muxu rakisi, i xa muxu xa yunubie xafari i xili xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Why may the nations say, Where is their God? Let payment for the blood of your servants be made openly among the nations before our eyes.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra ɲamanɛe a falama, «E Marigi Ala na minden?» E xa a kolon i fama i xa konyie wuli gbeɲɔxɔde muxu ya xɔri.

sentences.english: Let the cry of the prisoner come before you; with your strong arm make free the children of death;
sentences.susu: I xa i tuli mati geelimanie wa xui ra, i sɛnbɛ xa nee rakisi naxee xa kiitisae wama e faxafe.

sentences.english: And give punishment seven times over into the breast of our neighbours for the bitter words which they have said against you, O Lord.
sentences.susu: N Marigi, i xa sare dɔxɔ solofere ragbilen na sie ma, naxee bara i bɛxu.

sentences.english: So we your people, and the sheep of your flock, will give you glory for ever: we will go on praising you through all generations.
sentences.susu: Na kui, muxu tan i xa ɲama fan fama nɛ i batude, muxu tan i xa xurusee fama nɛ i xa matɔxɔɛ masende muxu bɔnsɔɛ bɛ abadan.

sentences.english: Give ear, O Keeper of Israel, guiding Joseph like a flock; you who have your seat on the winged ones, let your glory be seen.
sentences.susu: Asafi xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba alɔ bɛɛti naxan xili «Fuge tofanyie alɔ Ala xa saatɛ.»

sentences.english: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, let your strength be awake from sleep, and come as our salvation.
sentences.susu: Isirayila kantama, i i tuli mati n na, i tan naxan Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ raɲɛrɛma alɔ xuruse gɔɔrɛ. I xa i xa nɔrɛ masen, i tan naxan magoroxi malekɛ masolixie tagi.

sentences.english: Take us back again, O God; let us see the shining of your face, and let us be safe.
sentences.susu: I sɛnbɛ ramini Efirami, Bunyamin, nun Manasi bɔnsɔɛ ya i, i xa muxu rakisi.

sentences.english: O Lord God of armies, how long will your wrath be burning against the rest of your people?
sentences.susu: Ala, i xa muxu ragbilen, i xa hinnɛ muxu ra alako muxu xa kisi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: You have given them the bread of weeping for food; for their drink you have given them sorrow in great measure.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Ala, i tondima i xa ɲama xa maxandi suxude i xa xɔnɛ xa fe ra han mun tɛmui?

sentences.english: You make us a cause of war among our neighbours; our haters are laughing at us among themselves.
sentences.susu: I e rabaloma e yaye ra, i e yaye fima e ma minse ra han mun tɛmui?

sentences.english: Take us back again, O God of armies; let us see the shining of your face, and let us be safe.
sentences.susu: I bara lantareya raso muxu nun muxu dɔxɔbooree tagi, e yoma muxu ma.

sentences.english: You took a vine out of Egypt: driving out the nations, and planting it in their land.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Ala, i xa muxu ragbilen, i xa hinnɛ muxu ra alako muxu xa kisi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: You made ready a place for it, so that it might take deep root, and it sent out its branches over all the land.
sentences.susu: I wɛni bili nde tala nɛ Misira naxan findixi i xa ɲama ra. I naxa sie ndee keri yire nde, i fa a tan si naa.

sentences.english: The mountains were covered with its shade, and the great trees with its branches.
sentences.susu: I to na yire yailan a bɛ, a naxa a sankee masɔrɔn, a bɔxi rafe.

sentences.english: It sent out its arms to the Sea, and its branches to the River.
sentences.susu: Geyae naxa lu a xa niini bun ma, a salonyie nu xungbo alɔ sɛdiri wurie.

sentences.english: Why are its walls broken down by your hands, so that all who go by may take its fruit?
sentences.susu: A salonyie nu kuya ra han e baa nun xure dɛ li.

sentences.english: It is uprooted by the pigs from the woods, the beasts of the field get their food from it.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan bara a xa tɛtɛ kana, dangi mixie fa a bogi ba.

sentences.english: Come back, O God of armies: from heaven let your eyes be turned to this vine, and give your mind to it,
sentences.susu: Wulai xɔsɛe naa yegelenma, buurunyi subee fan baloma a bogie ra. Munfe ra?

sentences.english: Even to the tree which was planted by your right hand, and to the branch which you made strong for yourself.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Ala yandi, i xa gbilen fa ra, i ya ragoro muxu ma keli koore, i muxu mato, kinikini na wɛni bili ma,

sentences.english: It is burned with fire; it is cut down: they are made waste by the wrath of your face.
sentences.susu: i naxan si i yɛtɛ bɛ i bɛlɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi a bara gan, a sɛgɛ i xa xɔnɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: So will we not be turned back from you; keep us in life, and we will give praise to your name.
sentences.susu: I bɛlɛxɛ xa lu Adama xa Di ma, naxan na i yirefanyi ma, i naxan xun nakelixi.

sentences.english: Take us back, O Lord God of armies; let us see the shining of your face, and let us be safe.
sentences.susu: Muxu mu muxu makuyama i ra sɔnɔn. I xa kisi fi muxu ma alako muxu man xa i batu.

sentences.english: Make a song to God our strength: make a glad cry to the God of Jacob.
sentences.susu: Asafi xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba maxase luuti daaxi xui ra.

sentences.english: Take up the melody, playing on an instrument of music, even on corded instruments.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɛɛwa xui rate Ala ma, naxan findixi won sɛnbɛ ra. Wo wo xui rasiga Yaxuba Marigi Ala ma.

sentences.english: Let the horn be sounded in the time of the new moon, at the full moon, on our holy feast-day:
sentences.susu: Wo xa bɛɛti ba maxase nun kɔra xui ra.

sentences.english: For this is a rule for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.
sentences.susu: Wo xa feri fe kike nɛɛnɛ te tɛmui, won ma sali lɔxɔɛ na a ra.

sentences.english: He gave it to Joseph as a witness, when he went out over the land of Egypt; then the words of a strange tongue were sounding in my ears.
sentences.susu: Na findixi Ala xa sɛriyɛ nan na Isirayila bɛ, Yaxuba Marigi Ala xa yaamari na a ra.

sentences.english: I took the weight from his back; his hands were made free from the baskets.
sentences.susu: Yaamari na a ra Ala naxan so Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ yi ra, a to mini Misira bɔxi xili ma. N naxa xui nde mɛ n mu naxan kolon, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: You gave a cry in your trouble, and I made you free; I gave you an answer in the secret place of the thunder; I put you to the test at the waters of Meribah. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: «N bara kote ba e xun ma, n bara debe binye ba e bɛlɛxɛe.

sentences.english: Give ear, O my people, and I will give you my word, O Israel, if you will only do as I say!
sentences.susu: Wo to n xili wo xa ɲaxankatɛ kui, n naxa wo rakisi, n naxa wo yaabi kelife sesarinyi yire, n naxa wo mato Meriba ye yire.

sentences.english: There is to be no strange god among you; you are not to give worship to any other god.
sentences.susu: N ma ɲama Isirayila, wo wo tuli mati n ma marasi ra.

sentences.english: I am the Lord your God, who took you up from the land of Egypt: let your mouth be open wide, so that I may give you food.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa Ala gbɛtɛ batu, wo naxa wo xinbi sin Ala gbɛtɛ ma.

sentences.english: But my people did not give ear to my voice; Israel would have nothing to do with me.
sentences.susu: N tan nan na wo Marigi Ala ra, naxan wo ramini Misira bɔxi ra. Wo wo dɛ rabi a belebele ra, n a rafema nɛ.»

sentences.english: So I gave them up to the desires of their hearts; that they might go after their evil purposes.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ n ma ɲama mu a tuli matixi n na, Isirayila mu n xui ratinmɛ.

sentences.english: If only my people would give ear to me, walking in my ways!
sentences.susu: Na kui n naxa e lu e xa bɔɲɛ xɔrɔxɔya kui, e xa ɲɛrɛ e yɛtɛ xaxili ma.

sentences.english: I would quickly overcome their haters: my hand would be turned against those who make war on them.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li nu n ma ɲama naxa a tuli mati n na, xa Isirayila sa tin n ma kira ra nu,

sentences.english: The haters of the Lord would be broken, and their destruction would be eternal.
sentences.susu: n fama nɛ a yaxui birin nayaagide keren na, n e ragoro tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: I would give them the best grain for food; you would be full of honey from the rock.
sentences.susu: Alatala yaxuie fama gaaxude a ya ra, e halaki abadan.

sentences.english: God is in the meeting-place of God; he is judging among the gods.
sentences.susu: Asafi xa bɛɛti Ala tixi a xa malanyi ya ra, a kiiti safe koore sɛnbɛmae ya ma.

sentences.english: How long will you go on judging falsely, having respect for the persons of evil-doers? (Selah.)
sentences.susu: «Wo kiiti sama kobiɲa ra han mun tɛmui? Wo nɔndi fima mixi ɲaaxie ma munfe ra?

sentences.english: Give ear to the cause of the poor and the children without fathers; let those who are troubled and in need have their rights.
sentences.susu: Wo xa misikiinɛe nun kiridie xa kiiti sa sɛriyɛ ki ma. Wo xa setaree nun fuxarilae ratanga kiiti ɲaaxi ma.

sentences.english: Be the saviour of the poor and those who have nothing: take them out of the hand of the evil-doers.
sentences.susu: Wo xa setaree nun tɔɔrɔmixie rakisi. Wo xa e ba mixi kobie bɛlɛxɛe i.»

sentences.english: They have no knowledge or sense; they go about in the dark: all the bases of the earth are moved.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e mu fahaamui sɔtɔ na fefe ma. E e ɲɛrɛma dimi nan kui tun. Duniɲa sanbunyi birin sɛrɛnma.

sentences.english: I said, You are gods; all of you are the sons of the Most High:
sentences.susu: N a fala nɛ, «Koore sɛnbɛmae nan wo ra, Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi xa die nan wo birin na,

sentences.english: But you will come to death like men, falling like one of the rulers of the earth.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ wo faxama nɛ alɔ adamadie, wo birama nɛ alɔ duniɲa mangɛe.»

sentences.english: Up! O God, come as judge of the earth; for all the nations are your heritage.
sentences.susu: I tan Ala, keli, i xa duniɲa makiiti, barima i tan nan gbe na sie birin na.

sentences.english: O God, do not keep quiet: let your lips be open and take no rest, O God.
sentences.susu: Asafi xa bɛɛti

sentences.english: For see! those who make war on you are out of control; your haters are lifting up their heads.
sentences.susu: Ee Ala, i naxa i sabari! Ala, i naxa lu dundui kui,

sentences.english: They have made wise designs against your people, talking together against those whom you keep in a secret place.
sentences.susu: barima i yaxuie mu e raxaraxi, i xɔnmae bara e xunyie ikeli.

sentences.english: They have said, Come, let us put an end to them as a nation; so that the name of Israel may go out of man's memory.
sentences.susu: E na yanfɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ maxirife i xa ɲama xili ma, e na e boore bɔɲɛ ratefe i xanuntenyie xili ma.

sentences.english: For they have all come to an agreement; they are all joined together against you:
sentences.susu: E naxɛ, «Won xa e xili ɲɔn sie ya ma, alako birin xa nɛɛmu Isirayila xili ma.»

sentences.english: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab and the Hagarites;
sentences.susu: E bara lan e boore ma i xili ma.

sentences.english: Gebal and Ammon and Amalek; the Philistines and the people of Tyre;
sentences.susu: Edonkae, Sumayila bɔnsɔɛ, Mowabakae, Hagarikae,

sentences.english: Assur is joined with them; they have become the support of the children of Lot. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Gebalakae, Amonikae, Amalɛkikae, Filisitakae, Tirekae,

sentences.english: Do to them what you did to the Midianites; what you did to Sisera and Jabin, at the stream of Kishon:
sentences.susu: nun Asiriyakae birin bara kafu Loti bɔnsɔɛ ma.

sentences.english: Who came to destruction at En-dor; their bodies became dust and waste.
sentences.susu: I xa e bɔnbɔ alɔ i a raba Madiyankae ra ki naxɛ. I xa e bɔnbɔ alɔ i a raba mangɛ Yabini na ki naxɛ, a nun a xa sɔɔri mangɛ Sisera ra ki naxɛ Kison xure yire.

sentences.english: Make their chiefs like Oreb and Zeeb; and all their rulers like Zebah and Zalmunna:
sentences.susu: E sɔntɔ nɛ Endori, e fure naxa lu bɔxi ma, e mu ragata.

sentences.english: Who have said, Let us take for our heritage the resting-place of God.
sentences.susu: I xa fe xɔrɔxɔɛ raba e xa kuntigie ra, alɔ i raba Orebi nun Seebi ra ki naxɛ. E xa yareratie xa lu alɔ Sɛba nun Salamuna, naxee a fala,

sentences.english: O my God, make them like the rolling dust; like dry stems before the wind.
sentences.susu: «Won xa Ala xa ɲama xa bɔxi findi won gbe ra.»

sentences.english: As fire burning a wood, and as a flame causing fire on the mountains,
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, i xa na mixie lu alɔ sɛxɛ, foye naxan xaninma.

sentences.english: So go after them with your strong wind, and let them be full of fear because of your storm.
sentences.susu: I xa e xun nakana alɔ tɛ fɔtɔnyi ganma ki naxɛ geyae fari.

sentences.english: Let their faces be full of shame; so that they may give honour to your name, O Lord.
sentences.susu: I xa bira e fɔxɔ ra xɔnɛ kui alɔ turunnaadɛ magaaxuxi.

sentences.english: Let them be overcome and troubled for ever; let them be put to shame and come to destruction;
sentences.susu: Marigi, i xa e rayaagi alako e xa gbilen i ma.

sentences.english: So that men may see that you only, whose name is Yahweh, are Most High over all the earth.
sentences.susu: Yaagi nun gaaxui xa lu e bɔɲɛ ma, i xa e bɔnsɔɛ raɲɔn abadan.

sentences.english: How dear are your tents, O Lord of armies!
sentences.susu: Kora xa die xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba maxase luuti daaxi xui ra.

sentences.english: The passion of my soul's desire is for the house of the Lord; my heart and my flesh are crying out for the living God.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala, i xa lingira tofan!

sentences.english: The little birds have places for themselves, where they may put their young, even your altars, O Lord of armies, my King and my God.
sentences.susu: N wama sofe i xa tɛtɛ kui n bɔɲɛ birin na. Na waxɔnyi minima n dɛ i i tan Ala nan bɛ, i tan naxan ɲiɲɛ a ra.

sentences.english: Happy are they whose resting-place is in your house: they will still be praising you. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Hali xɔni xunxurie alɔ turunna nun debelinyi e tɛɛ sama i xa sɛrɛxɛbade sɛɛti ma e xa die luma dɛnnaxɛ. I tan Alatala Sɛnbɛma, n ma Mangɛ nun n Marigi,

sentences.english: Happy is the man whose strength is in you; in whose heart are the highways to Zion.
sentences.susu: sɛɛwɛ na mixie bɛ, naxee sabatixi i xa banxi kui. E luma i matɔxɔ ra dɛnnaxɛ abadan. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: Going through the valley of balsam-trees, they make it a place of springs; it is clothed with blessings by the early rain.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ na mixie bɛ naxee sɛnbɛ lanxi i tan Ala ma, naxee kira suxuxi sigafe ra salide xungbe.

sentences.english: They go from strength to strength; every one of them comes before God in Zion.
sentences.susu: E Baka gulunba igirima tɛmui naxɛ, e ye dulonyie to nɛ, tunɛ ye gbegbe bara naa rafe.

sentences.english: O Lord God of armies, let my prayer come to you: give ear, O God of Jacob. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: E keli yire fanyi nde, e siga yire fanyi gbɛtɛ. E na birin to nɛ kira xɔn sigafe ra Ala yire e e yɛtɛ masen a bɛ dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: O God, let your eyes be on him who is our safe cover, and let your heart be turned to your king.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala Sɛnbɛma, n ma dubɛ suxu! Yaxuba Marigi Ala, i n ma maxandi ramɛ. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: For a day in your house is better than a thousand. It is better to be a door-keeper in the house of my God, than to be living in the tents of sin.
sentences.susu: Ala, hinnɛ i xa mixi sugandixi ra naxan findixi muxu xa wure lefa ra.

sentences.english: The Lord God is our sun and our strength: the Lord will give grace and glory: he will not keep back any good thing from those whose ways are upright.
sentences.susu: Xi keren nadangife i xa banxi kui, na ɲɔxun dangife xi wulu wulu ra yire gbɛtɛ. N lufe i xa banxi dɛ ra, na fan lufe ra tinxintaree xɔnyi,

sentences.english: O Lord of armies, happy is the man whose hope is in you.
sentences.susu: barima Ala Xungbe findixi won ma kantari nan na, a hinnɛ nun binyɛ fima nɛ won ma. A mu tondima tinxintaree kide hɛɛri ra.

sentences.english: Lord, you were good to your land: changing the fate of Jacob.
sentences.susu: Kora xa die xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: The wrongdoing of your people had forgiveness; all their sin had been covered. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Marigi, i xanunteya masenma i xa ɲama bɛ, i Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ xun nakelima.

sentences.english: You were no longer angry: you were turned from the heat of your wrath.
sentences.susu: I diɲɛma i xa ɲama xa fe ɲaaxie ma, i a xa yunubie birin xafarima. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: Come back to us, O God of our salvation, and be angry with us no longer.
sentences.susu: I i xa xɔnɛ ragbilenma a fɔxɔ ra, i diɲɛma a ma.

sentences.english: Will you go on being angry with us for ever? will you keep your wrath against us through all the long generations?
sentences.susu: Ala, i man xa muxu rakisi, i man xa hinnɛ muxu ra.

sentences.english: Will you not give us life again, so that your people may be glad in you?
sentences.susu: I xɔnɔma nɛ muxu ma abadan? Na xɔnɛ mu bama muxu xa yi waxati kui?

sentences.english: Let us see your mercy, O Lord, and give us your salvation.
sentences.susu: I mu nɔma diɲɛde mu ma, i xa ɲama xa kisi, e xa sɛɛwa?

sentences.english: I will give ear to the voice of the Lord; for he will say words of peace to his people and to his saints; but let them not go back to their foolish ways.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa dugutɛgɛɲa masen muxu bɛ, i xa muxu rakisi.

sentences.english: Truly, his salvation is near to his worshippers; so that glory may be in our land.
sentences.susu: N nan n tuli matima nɛ n Marigi Ala xa masenyi ra, barima a bɔɲɛsa nan fima a xa ɲama tinxinxi ma. Ala xa e mali gbilenfe ra e xa daxuɲa ma.

sentences.english: Mercy and faith have come together; righteousness and peace have given one another a kiss.
sentences.susu: A kisi yati yati nan fima mixie ma naxee gaaxuma a ya ra, alako a xa nɔrɛ xa sabati won ma bɔxi kui.

sentences.english: Faith comes up from the earth like a plant; righteousness is looking down from heaven.
sentences.susu: Dugutɛgɛɲa nun nɔndi na yire keren. Tinxinyi nun bɔɲɛsa ɲɛrɛma kira keren xɔn.

sentences.english: The Lord will give what is good; and our land will give its increase.
sentences.susu: Nɔndi kelima lanbanyi ma, tinxinyi kelima koore ma.

sentences.english: Righteousness will go before him, making a way for his footsteps.
sentences.susu: Alatala hɛri fima nɛ won ma, alako won ma bɔxi xa daxamui ramini.

sentences.english: Let your ears be open to my voice, O Lord, and give me an answer; for I am poor and in need.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa Ala maxandi Marigi, i i tuli mati n na, i xa n yaabi. Misikiinɛ fuxarixi na n na.

sentences.english: Keep my soul, for I am true to you; O my God, give salvation to your servant, whose hope is in you.
sentences.susu: I xa n makanta, i dugutɛgɛ na n na. N Marigi Ala, i xa i xa konyi di rakisi naxan a taxuxi i ra.

sentences.english: Have mercy on me, O Lord; for my cry goes up to you all the day.
sentences.susu: Kinikini n ma, n Marigi, barima n i xilima lɔxɔɛ birin.

sentences.english: Make glad the soul of your servant; for it is lifted up to you, O Lord.
sentences.susu: I xa sɛɛwɛ fi i xa konyi di ma, n xaxili tixi i tan nan na, n Marigi.

sentences.english: You are good, O Lord, and full of forgiveness; your mercy is great to all who make their cry to you.
sentences.susu: I tan Marigi, i fan, i kinikini, i xa dugutɛgɛɲa gbo mixie bɛ naxee birin i xilima.

sentences.english: O Lord, give ear to my prayer; and take note of the sound of my requests.
sentences.susu: Marigi, i xa i tuli mati n ma maxandi ra, i xa n ma dubɛ suxu.

sentences.english: In the day of my trouble I send up my cry to you; for you will give me an answer.
sentences.susu: N i xilima n ma tɔɔrɛ kui, barima i n natinma.

sentences.english: There is no god like you, O Lord; there are no works like your works.
sentences.susu: N Marigi, i maniyɛ mu na alae tagi, i xa kaabanakoee dangi wali birin na.

sentences.english: Let all the nations whom you have made come and give worship to you, O Lord, giving glory to your name.
sentences.susu: I si naxee daa duniɲa ma, nee fama nɛ e xinbi sinde i bun ma, e i xili matɔxɔ,

sentences.english: For you are great, and do great works of wonder; you only are God.
sentences.susu: barima i gbo, i man kaabanakoe rabama. I tan keren peti na nan Ala ra.

sentences.english: Make your way clear to me, O Lord; I will go on my way in your faith: let my heart be glad in the fear of your name.
sentences.susu: N Marigi, i xa i xa kira masen n bɛ, n xa n ɲɛrɛ i xa nɔndi kui. Bɔɲɛ fanyi fi n ma, alako n xa gaaxu i xili ya ra.

sentences.english: I will give you praise, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will give glory to your name for ever.
sentences.susu: N i matɔxɔma n bɔɲɛ fiixɛ birin na, n Marigi Ala. N i xili matɔxɔma nɛ abadan,

sentences.english: For your mercy to me is great; you have taken my soul up from the deep places of the underworld.
sentences.susu: barima i xa hinnɛ tilin. I bara n nii ratanga faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: O God, men of pride have come up against me, and the army of violent men would take my life; they have not put you before them.
sentences.susu: Ee Ala, yɛtɛ igboe ndee bara keli n xili ma, gbalotɔɛe wama n faxafe. E mu i kolon feo.

sentences.english: But you, O Lord, are a God full of pity and forgiveness, slow to get angry, great in mercy and wisdom.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n Marigi, i tan nan findixi Ala ra, naxan kinikinima, naxan hinnɛma ibunadama ra, naxan bɔɲɛ mu tema mafuren, naxan mu taganma dugutɛgɛɲa nun xanunteya ma.

sentences.english: O be turned to me and have mercy on me: give your strength to your servant, and your salvation to the son of her who is your servant.
sentences.susu: I xa i ya rafindi n ma, i xa hinnɛ n na. I xa sɛnbɛ fi i xa konyi di ma, i xa i xa konyi ginɛ xa di rakisi.

sentences.english: Give me a sign for good; so that my haters may see it and be shamed; because you, Lord, have been my help and comfort.
sentences.susu: Tɔnxuma nde ramini n bɛ seede ra, alako naxee n xɔnxi, e xa a to, e xa yaagi, i xa mali nun i xa madundui xa fe ra.

sentences.english: This house is resting on the holy mountain.
sentences.susu: Kora xa die xa bɛɛti Alatala xa taa tixi geya sɛniyɛnxie fari.

sentences.english: The Lord has more love for the doors of Zion than for all the tents of Jacob.
sentences.susu: Siyoni naadɛe rafan Marigi ma, dangi Yaxuba xa lingira birin na.

sentences.english: Noble things are said of you, O town of God. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Mixie Ala xa taa matɔxɔma a fanyi ra Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: Rahab and Babylon will be named among those who have knowledge of me; see, Philistia and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man had his birth there.
sentences.susu: «N xa a fala Raxabi nun Babilɔn n kolonma, a nun Filisita, Tire, nun Kusi.

sentences.english: And of Zion it will be said, This or that man had his birth there; and the Most High will make her strong.
sentences.susu: A falaxi Siyonikae xa fe ra, ‹E to barixi naa, Marigi Ala e makantama nɛ.›»

sentences.english: The Lord will keep in mind, when he is writing the records of the people, that this man had his birth there. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a sɛbɛ sie xa buki kui, «Yi tan barixi naa.» Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: The players on instruments will be there, and the dancers will say, All my springs are in you.
sentences.susu: Bɛɛtibae a falama e xui itexi ra, «N ma saabui birin na i tan nɛ.»

sentences.english: O Lord, God of my salvation, I have been crying to you for help by day and by night:
sentences.susu: Kora xa die xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ. A xa ba xule ra. Heman Esiraka xa lɔnni bɛɛti.

sentences.english: Let my prayer come before you; give ear to my cry:
sentences.susu: Marigi, n nakisima Ala, n i xilima yanyi nun kɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: For my soul is full of evils, and my life has come near to the underworld.
sentences.susu: I xa n ma maxandi suxu, i xa n ma dubɛ tongo.

sentences.english: I am numbered among those who go down into the earth; I have become like a man for whom there is no help:
sentences.susu: N bara tɔɔrɔ n ma duniɲɛigiri kui, yakɔsi n bara makɔrɛ saya ra.

sentences.english: My soul is among the dead, like those in the underworld, to whom you give no more thought; for they are cut off from your care.
sentences.susu: N na mixie ya ma naxee na saya kira xɔn ma. N sɛnbɛ yo mu na sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: You have put me in the lowest deep, even in dark places.
sentences.susu: A luxi nɛ alɔ n ɲan saxi furee tagi gaburi kui, i mu ratuxi naxee xa fe ma sɔnɔn, naxee bara makuya i xa hinnɛ ra.

sentences.english: The weight of your wrath is crushing me, all your waves have overcome me. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: I bara n na so yili tilinxi kui dimi xɔɔra.

sentences.english: You have sent my friends far away from me; you have made me a disgusting thing in their eyes: I am shut up, and not able to come out.
sentences.susu: I xa xɔnɛ bara dutun n ma, a n makoto alɔ baa mɔrɔnyi mixi makotoma ki naxɛ. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: My eyes are wasting away because of my trouble: Lord, my cry has gone up to you every day, my hands are stretched out to you.
sentences.susu: I bara n dɛfanbooree makuya n na, i bara e bɔɲɛe raɲaaxu e ma. N luma banxi kui, n mu minima fefe ma.

sentences.english: Will you do works of wonder for the dead? will the shades come back to give you praise? (Selah.)
sentences.susu: N Marigi, n i xilima lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ yaye ra, n na n bɛlɛxɛe tixi i bɛ.

sentences.english: Will the story of your mercy be given in the house of the dead? will news of your faith come to the place of destruction?
sentences.susu: I kaabanakoe rabama mixi faxaxie nan bɛ? E nɔma kelide, e i matɔxɔ?

sentences.english: May there be knowledge of your wonders in the dark? or of your righteousness where memory is dead?
sentences.susu: I xa dugutɛgɛɲa xa fe falama gaburi kui? I xa xanunteya masenma naa?

sentences.english: But to you did I send up my cry, O Lord; in the morning my prayer came before you.
sentences.susu: I xa kaabanako toma aligiyama? I xa tinxinyi kolonma yire dɛnnaxɛ xa fe bara nɛɛmu mixi ra?

sentences.english: Lord, why have you sent away my soul? why is your face covered from me?
sentences.susu: N Marigi, n tan i xilima, gɛɛsɛgɛ yo gɛɛsɛgɛ n i maxandima.

sentences.english: I have been troubled and in fear of death from the time when I was young; your wrath is hard on me, and I have no strength.
sentences.susu: Marigi, i tondima n bɛ munfe ra? I i kobe soma n na munfe ra?

sentences.english: The heat of your wrath has gone over me; I am broken by your cruel punishments.
sentences.susu: N na tɔɔrɛ kui kabi n dimɛdi tɛmui. N gaaxuxi, xaxilisa birin bara ba n yi ra.

sentences.english: They are round me all the day like water; they have made a circle about me.
sentences.susu: I xa xɔnɛ sɛnbɛ bara dangi a i, i xa fe magaaxuxie bara nɔ n na.

sentences.english: You have sent my friends and lovers far from me; I am gone from the memory of those who are dear to me.
sentences.susu: E n nabilinxi alɔ banbaranyi, e dusu n xun na.

sentences.english: My song will be of the mercies of the Lord for ever: with my mouth will I make his faith clear to all generations.
sentences.susu: Etani Esiraka xa lɔnni bɛɛti

sentences.english: For you have said, Mercy will be made strong for ever; my faith will be unchanging in the heavens.
sentences.susu: N bɛɛti bama n Marigi xa dugutɛgɛɲa xa fe ra. N na masenma nɛ bɔnsɔɛ birin bɛ, a falafe ra,

sentences.english: I have made an agreement with the man of my selection, I have made an oath to David my servant;
sentences.susu: «I xa dugutɛgɛɲa mabanbanxi koore ma abadan. I xa hinnɛ mu kanama.»

sentences.english: I will make your seed go on for ever, your kingdom will be strong through all generations. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: «N bara saatɛ xiri n nun n ma mixi sugandixi ra, n bara yi kɛrɛ tongo n ma konyi di Dawuda bɛ.

sentences.english: In heaven let them give praise for your wonders, O Lord; and your unchanging faith among the saints.
sentences.susu: ‹N i bɔnsɔɛ rasabatima nɛ abadan, n i xa kibanyi ti tɛmui birin.›» Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: For who is there in the heavens in comparison with the Lord? who is like the Lord among the sons of the gods?
sentences.susu: N Marigi, naxee na koore ma e i matɔxɔma, malekɛe i tantuma i xa dugutɛgɛɲa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: God is greatly to be feared among the saints, and to be honoured over all those who are about him.
sentences.susu: Nde na koore ma naxan maniyama Marigi Ala ra? Nde luxi alɔ Marigi Ala malekɛe ya ma?

sentences.english: O Lord God of armies, who is strong like you, O Jah? and your unchanging faith is round about you.
sentences.susu: Ala magaaxu a xa sɛniyɛntɔɛe xa malanyi, e birin e magoro a bɛ.

sentences.english: You have rule over the sea in storm; when its waves are troubled, you make them calm.
sentences.susu: Marigi Ala, nde sɛnbɛ gbo alɔ i tan Mangɛ Ala? I xa dugutɛgɛɲa na yire birin.

sentences.english: Rahab was crushed by you like one wounded to death; with your strong arm you put to flight all your haters.
sentences.susu: I tan nan baa yamarima, i a mɔrɔnyie raxara.

sentences.english: Yours are the heavens, and the earth is yours; you have made the world, and everything which is in it.
sentences.susu: I tan nan nɔ Misira ra, i a sɔntɔ. I i yaxuie rayensen i sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: You have made the north and the south; Tabor and Hermon are sounding with joy at your name.
sentences.susu: I tan nan gbe koore ra, i tan nan gbe bɔxi ra. I tan nan duniɲa birin daa.

sentences.english: Yours is an arm of power; strong is your hand and high your right hand.
sentences.susu: Se naxan na kɔɔla ma, se naxan na yirefanyi ma, i tan nan a birin daaxi. Taboro nun Xerimon geyae i xili matɔxɔma.

sentences.english: The seat of your kingdom is resting on righteousness and right judging: mercy and good faith come before your face.
sentences.susu: I sɛnbɛ gbo.

sentences.english: Happy are the people who have knowledge of the holy cry: the light of your face, O Lord, will be shining on their way.
sentences.susu: Tinxinyi nun nɔndi nan na i xa kibanyi sanbunyi ra, xanunteya nun dugutɛgɛɲa fan tixi i ya ra.

sentences.english: In your name will they have joy all the day: in your righteousness will they be lifted up.
sentences.susu: Marigi, sɛɛwɛ na ɲama bɛ naxan i xili matɔxɔma, e e ɲɛrɛma i xa naiyalanyi nan ma.

sentences.english: For you are the glory of their strength; in your pleasure will our horn be lifted up.
sentences.susu: E sɛɛwama i xili xa fe ra, e xun nakelima i xa tinxinyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: For our breastplate is the Lord; and our king is the Holy One of Israel's.
sentences.susu: I tan nan findixi e xa naiyalanyi nun e sɛnbɛ ra. Muxu sɛnbɛ gbo i xa hinnɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Then your voice came to your holy one in a vision, saying, I have put the crown on a strong one, lifting up one taken from among the people.
sentences.susu: Muxu Marigi nan na muxu kantama nun muxu xa mangɛ ra, Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ na a ra.

sentences.english: I have made discovery of David my servant; I have put my holy oil on his head.
sentences.susu: I wɔyɛn nɛ i xa ɲama bɛ laamatunyi ra, a falafe ra, «N bara sɛnbɛ fi geresoe nde ma, n naxan xun nakelixi ɲama tagi.

sentences.english: My hand will be his support; my arm will give him strength.
sentences.susu: N bara n ma konyi Dawuda to, n ture sɛniyɛnxi surusuru a xunyi ma sugandi ra.

sentences.english: The deceit of those who are against him will not overcome him; he will not be troubled by the sons of evil.
sentences.susu: N na n bɛlɛxɛ rasoma a bun ma, n sɛnbɛ fima nɛ a ma a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: I will have those who are against him broken before his face, and his haters will be crushed under my blows.
sentences.susu: A yaxui mu a tɛrɛnnama, tinxintare mu a tɔɔrɔma.

sentences.english: But my faith and my mercy will be with him; and in my name will his horn be lifted up.
sentences.susu: N a yaxuie ibutuxunma nɛ, n a xɔnmae bɔnbɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: I will put his hand in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
sentences.susu: N xanunteya nun n ma dugutɛgɛɲa luma nɛ a ma, a sɛnbɛ gboma n xili nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: He will say to me, You are my father, my God, and the Rock of my salvation.
sentences.susu: Baae nun xuree birin sama nɛ a xa mangɛya bun ma.

sentences.english: And I will make him the first of my sons, most high over the kings of the earth.
sentences.susu: A a falama nɛ n bɛ, ‹N Baba nan i ra, n Marigi Ala, n ma marakisima.›

sentences.english: I will keep my mercy for him for ever; my agreement with him will not be changed.
sentences.susu: N a findima nɛ n ma di singe ra, naxan xungbo duniɲa mangɛe birin bɛ.

sentences.english: His seed will keep their place for ever; his kingdom will be eternal, like the heavens.
sentences.susu: N na n ma dugutɛgɛɲa mabanbanma nɛ a bɛ, muxu saatɛ naxan xirixi, a mu kanama abadan.

sentences.english: If his children give up my law, and are not ruled by my decisions;
sentences.susu: N a bɔnsɔɛ rasabatima nɛ, n a xa mangɛ kibanyi mabanbanma nɛ fanni koore na.

sentences.english: If my rules are broken, and my orders are not kept;
sentences.susu: A xa die na n ma sɛriyɛ rabolo, e mu e ɲɛrɛ n ma yaamari bun ma,

sentences.english: Then I will send punishment on them for their sin; my rod will be the reward of their evil-doing.
sentences.susu: e n xui matandi, e mu n waxɔnfe suxu,

sentences.english: But I will not take away my mercy from him, and will not be false to my faith.
sentences.susu: n e bɔnbɔma luxusinyi nan na, n e ɲaxankatama fure ɲaaxie ra.

sentences.english: I will be true to my agreement; the things which have gone out of my lips will not be changed.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n mu n ma dugutɛgɛɲa bama a ma. N mu n xui yanfama,

sentences.english: I have made an oath once by my holy name, that I will not be false to David.
sentences.susu: n mu n ma saatɛ kanama, n man mu n xui masarama.

sentences.english: His seed will not come to an end for ever; the seat of his kingdom will be like the sun before me.
sentences.susu: N na n kalixi n ma sɛniyɛnyi ra, n mu Annabi Dawuda yanfama.

sentences.english: It will be fixed for ever like the moon; and the witness in heaven is true. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: A bɔnsɔɛ kisima nɛ abadan, a xa kibanyi luma nɛ n ya i alɔ soge,

sentences.english: But you have put him away in disgust; you have been angry with the king of your selection.
sentences.susu: a rasabatima nɛ alɔ kike, naxan findima seedeɲɔxɔya ra abadan.» Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: You have made your agreement with your servant of no effect: you have had no respect for his crown, it has come down even to the earth.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan bara i xa mixi sugandixi makuya i ra, i bara mɛɛ a ra, i xɔnɔ a ma.

sentences.english: All his walls are broken down; you have given his strong towers to destruction.
sentences.susu: I bara i xa saatɛ kana i xa konyi bɛ, i a ba a xa kibanyi kui.

sentences.english: All those who come by take away his goods; he is laughed at by his neighbours.
sentences.susu: I bara a xa tɛtɛ bɔɔ, i bara a makantade kana.

sentences.english: You have given power to the right hand of his haters; you have made glad all those who are against him.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee dangima, e harige bama naa. A dɔxɔbooree yoma a ma.

sentences.english: His sword is turned back; you have not been his support in the fight.
sentences.susu: I bara a yaxuie sɛnbɛ so, han e bara sɛɛwa.

sentences.english: You have put an end to his glory: the seat of his kingdom has been levelled to the earth.
sentences.susu: I mu a xa santidɛgɛma wali rasɔɔnɛya, i mu a malixi gere kui.

sentences.english: You have made him old before his time; he is covered with shame. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: I bara a xa fe raxuben, i bara a xa kibanyi woli bɔxi.

sentences.english: How long, O Lord, will you Keep yourself for ever from our eyes? how long will your wrath be burning like fire?
sentences.susu: I bara nde ba a xa fonikeya ra, i yaagi dusu a xun na. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: See how short my time is; why have you made all men for no purpose?
sentences.susu: Alatala, i i nɔxunma n ma han mun tɛmui? I xa xɔnɛ dɛxɛma alɔ tɛ han mun lɔxɔɛ?

sentences.english: What man now living will not see death? will he be able to keep back his soul from the underworld? (Selah.)
sentences.susu: I xa ratu a ma n ma simaya dunke ki naxɛ. I ibunadama daaxi fuyan nan na?

sentences.english: Lord, where are your earlier mercies? where is the oath which you made to David in unchanging faith?
sentences.susu: Nde baloxi naxan mu faxama? Nde nɔma a yɛtɛ bade saya kira xɔn ma?

sentences.english: Keep in mind, O Lord, the shame of your servants, and how the bitter words of all the people have come into my heart;
sentences.susu: N Marigi, i xa dugutɛgɛɲa singe na minden, i i kali naxan na Dawuda bɛ i xa tinxinyi kui?

sentences.english: The bitter words of your haters, O Lord, shaming the footsteps of your king.
sentences.susu: N Marigi, i xa i ɲɔxɔ sa i xa konyie xa yaagi xɔn ma. I xa na kote to mixi wuyaxie naxan dɔxɔ n xun ma.

sentences.english: Let the Lord be praised for ever. So be it, So be it.
sentences.susu: N Marigi, i xa i ratu a ma i yaxuie n maberema ki naxɛ, n tan i xa mixi sugandixi.

sentences.english: Lord, you have been our resting-place in all generations.
sentences.susu: Ala xa mixi Munsa xa Ala maxandi N Marigi, i tan findixi muxu kantama nan na abadan.

sentences.english: Before the mountains were made, before you had given birth to the earth and the world, before time was, and for ever, you are God.
sentences.susu: Beenun geyae nun duniɲa xa daa, i tan nan nu na Ala ra abadan.

sentences.english: You send man back to his dust; and say, Go back, you children of men.
sentences.susu: I ibunadama ragbilenma bɛndɛ i. I na nan fala, «Adamadi xa gbilen bɛndɛ.»

sentences.english: For to you a thousand years are no more than yesterday when it is past, and like a watch in the night.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ wulu keren luxi nɛ i bɛ alɔ lɔxɔ keren naxan bara dangi, alɔ waxati keren naxan bara dangi kɔɛ kui.
I a niya adamadi mu keli a xa xixɔli ma. A luxi alɔ ɲooge naxan minima a yɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: In the morning it is green; in the evening it is cut down, and becomes dry.
sentences.susu: A keli subaxɛ ma, a fuga, nunmare tɛmui a ɲan bara lisi, a xara.

sentences.english: We are burned up by the heat of your passion, and troubled by your wrath.
sentences.susu: I xa xɔnɛ muxu ɲɔnma nɛ, a muxu magaaxu.

sentences.english: You have put our evil doings before you, our secret sins in the light of your face.
sentences.susu: I muxu xa yunubi birin kolon, hali muxu xa fe ɲaaxi naxee findixi gundo ra.

sentences.english: For all our days have gone by in your wrath; our years come to an end like a breath.
sentences.susu: Muxu xa simaya birin luma i xa xɔnɛ bun ma. Muxu xa duniɲɛigiri xa bui birin, ɲɛngi rate keren.

sentences.english: The measure of our life is seventy years; and if through strength it may be eighty years, its pride is only trouble and sorrow, for it comes to an end and we are quickly gone.
sentences.susu: Muxu xa simaya buma ɲɛ tongo solofere, ɲɛ tongo solomasaxan xa a sɔɔnɛya, kɔnɔ na birin findixi tɔɔrɛ nun ɲaxankatɛ nan na. Simaya dangima nɛ mafuren mafuren, a muxu lu dimi kui.

sentences.english: Who has knowledge of the power of your wrath, or who takes note of the weight of your passion?
sentences.susu: Nde i xa xɔnɛ sɛnbɛ kolon? Nde gaaxuma na ya ra?

sentences.english: So give us knowledge of the number of our days, that we may get a heart of wisdom.
sentences.susu: A muxu ratu simaya raɲɔnyi ma, alako muxu xa xaxili sɔtɔ muxu xa duniɲɛigiri kui.

sentences.english: Come back, O Lord; how long? let your purpose for your servants be changed.
sentences.susu: N Marigi, i xa i ya rafindi muxu ma I xa xɔnɛ buma han mun tɛmui? Kinikini i xa konyi die ma.

sentences.english: In the morning give us your mercy in full measure; so that we may have joy and delight all our days.
sentences.susu: Kuye na iba, i xa muxu rawasa i xa dugutɛgɛɲa ra, alako muxu xa sɛɛwa muxu xa simaya birin kui.
