sentences.english: Make us glad in reward for the days of our sorrow, and for the years in which we have seen evil.
sentences.susu: I tɔɔrɛ xasabi naxan dɔxɔ muxu ma, i yaagi xasabi naxan sa muxu ma, i man xa muxu rasɛɛwa na xasabi ra.

sentences.english: Make your work clear to your servants, and your glory to their children.
sentences.susu: I xa i xa kaabanakoe masen muxu bɛ, i xa konyie. I xa nɔrɛ xa mini muxu xa die ma.

sentences.english: Let the pleasure of the Lord our God be on us: O Lord, give strength to the work of our hands.
sentences.susu: Muxu Marigi Ala xa tofanyi xa lu muxu ya i. A xa muxu xa wali sɔɔnɛya, a xa baraka sa muxu xa wali ma!

sentences.english: Happy is he whose resting-place is in the secret of the Lord, and under the shade of the wings of the Most High;
sentences.susu: Naxan luma Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi xa kantari bun ma, a a malabuma nɛ Ala xa kantɛ kui.

sentences.english: Who says of the Lord, He is my safe place and my tower of strength: he is my God, in whom is my hope.
sentences.susu: N na a masenma Alatala bɛ, «I tan nan na n ma kantari nun n makantade ra, i tan n Marigi Ala, n laxi naxan na.»

sentences.english: He will take you out of the bird-net, and keep you safe from wasting disease.
sentences.susu: A tan nan i ratangama gantanyie ma naxee tema i bɛ, a i ratanga wuganyi ma.

sentences.english: You will be covered by his feathers; under his wings you will be safe: his good faith will be your salvation.
sentences.susu: A i makantama nɛ alɔ tɔxɔɛ a xa die makantama ki naxɛ a gabutenyi bun ma. A xa dugutɛgɛɲa luma nɛ alɔ sɔɔri xa wure lefa.

sentences.english: You will have no fear of the evil things of the night, or of the arrow in flight by day,
sentences.susu: I mu gaaxuma gbaloe ra kɔɛ ra, i mu gaaxuma xalie ra yanyi ra,

sentences.english: Or of the disease which takes men in the dark, or of the destruction which makes waste when the sun is high.
sentences.susu: i mu gaaxuma wuganyi ra dimi kui, i mu gaaxuma fure ɲaaxi ra soge bun ma.

sentences.english: You will see a thousand falling by your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.
sentences.susu: Mixi wulu nɔma nɛ birade i kɔɔla ma, mixi wulu fu nɔma birade i yirefanyi ma, kɔnɔ sese mu i toma.

sentences.english: Only with your eyes will you see the reward of the evil-doers.
sentences.susu: I na birin toma nɛ i ya i, i findi seede ra tinxintare xa ɲaxankatɛ ma,

sentences.english: Because you have said, I am in the hands of the Lord, the Most High is my safe resting-place;
sentences.susu: barima i bara la i Marigi ra, a bara findi i xa kantari ra. Ala Xili Xungbe kanyi findixi i xa makantade nan na.

sentences.english: No evil will come on you, and no disease will come near your tent.
sentences.susu: Sese mu i lima, wuganyi yo mu soma i xɔnyi,

sentences.english: For he will give you into the care of his angels to keep you wherever you go.
sentences.susu: barima a a xa malekɛe yamarima e xa i makanta yire birin.

sentences.english: In their hands they will keep you up, so that your foot may not be crushed against a stone.
sentences.susu: E i tongoma nɛ e bɛlɛxɛe kui, alako i naxa i sanyi radin gɛmɛ ra.

sentences.english: You will put your foot on the lion and the snake; the young lion and the great snake will be crushed under your feet.
sentences.susu: I nɔma yɛtɛe nun bɔximasee ra, i sɛnbɛ dangi baratɛe nun biidae ra.

sentences.english: Because he has given me his love, I will take him out of danger: I will put him in a place of honour, because he has kept my name in his heart.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «A to laxi n na, n a rakisima nɛ. N a makantama nɛ barima a n xili kolon.

sentences.english: When his cry comes up to me, I will give him an answer: I will be with him in trouble; I will make him free from danger and give him honour.
sentences.susu: A na n xili, n a yaabima nɛ. Tɔɔrɛ na a li, n luma nɛ a sɛɛti ma. N a rakisima nɛ, n a xun nakeli.

sentences.english: With long life will he be rewarded; and I will let him see my salvation.
sentences.susu: N simaya xɔnkuye fima nɛ a ma, n na n ma kisi masen a bɛ.»

sentences.english: It is a good thing to give praise to the Lord, and to make melody to your name, O Most High;
sentences.susu: Bɛɛti naxan bama malabui lɔxɔɛ

sentences.english: To make clear your mercy in the morning, and your unchanging faith every night;
sentences.susu: Marigi batufe fe fanyi na a ra. Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi, a lanma i xili xa matɔxɔ bɛɛti ra.

sentences.english: On a ten-corded instrument, and on an instrument of music with a quiet sound.
sentences.susu: Kuye iba, a lanma i xa xanunteya xa matɔxɔ, kɔɛ kui, muxu xa i tantu i xa dugutɛgɛɲa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For you, O Lord, have made me glad through your work; I will have joy in the works of your hands.
sentences.susu: Matɔxɔɛ xa ba kɔra luuti fu daaxi xui ra nun adamadi xui ra.

sentences.english: O Lord, how great are your works! and your thoughts are very deep.
sentences.susu: Marigi, n ɲɛlɛxinma i xa kaabanakoe ra, n nan n sɛɛwɛ xui itema i xa wali xa fe ra.

sentences.english: A man without sense has no knowledge of this; and a foolish man may not take it in.
sentences.susu: Marigi, i naxan nabama, a makaaba, i xaxili tilin.

sentences.english: When the sinners come up like the grass, and all the workers of evil do well for themselves, it is so that their end may be eternal destruction.
sentences.susu: Xaxilitare mu sese kolonma na kui, a mu fahaamui sɔtɔma i xa fe ma.

sentences.english: But you, O Lord, are on high for ever.
sentences.susu: Ala kolontaree luma alɔ sansi naxan bulama fiili ma, a fuga, kɔnɔ na dangi xanbi, a ɲɔn abadan.

sentences.english: For see! your haters, O Lord, will be put to death; all the workers of evil will be put to flight;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan Marigi, matɔxɔɛ na i bɛ tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: But my horn is lifted up like the horn of the ox: the best oil is flowing on my head.
sentences.susu: N Marigi, i yaxuie halakima nɛ, i fe kobi rabae birin nayensen yɛ.

sentences.english: My eyes have seen trouble come on my haters; my ears have news of the fate of the evil-doers who have come up against me.
sentences.susu: I sɛnbɛ fima nɛ n ma alɔ sɛxɛ ninge, i ture fanyi sa n ma.

sentences.english: The good man will be like a tall tree in his strength; his growth will be as the wide-stretching trees of Lebanon.
sentences.susu: N yae a toma n gerefae xun goroma ki naxɛ, n tuli e gi xui mɛ.

sentences.english: Those who are planted in the house of the Lord will come up tall and strong in his gardens.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛe xa fe fanma nɛ alɔ tugi bili, e xa fe te alɔ sɛdiri wuri bili naxee na Liban.

sentences.english: They will give fruit even when they are old; they will be fertile and full of growth;
sentences.susu: E sabatixi Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ kui, e xa fe fanma nɛ won Marigi Ala ya i.

sentences.english: For a sign that the Lord is upright; he is my Rock, there is no deceit in him.
sentences.susu: Hali e forixi e xunsɛxɛ fiixɛxi, sɛnbɛ na e bɛ fe fanyi rabafe ra,

sentences.english: The Lord is King; he is clothed with glory; the Lord is clothed with strength; power is the cord of his robe; the world is fixed, so that it may not be moved.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala nan na mangɛ ra. Xunnakeli na a yi, a sɛnbɛ gbo. A xa duniɲa xanxi, a mu sɛrɛnma.

sentences.english: The seat of your power has been from the past; you are eternal.
sentences.susu: I xa mangɛya fɔlɛ mu na, a dan mu na. I tan nan na Ala ra abadan.

sentences.english: The rivers send up, O Lord, the rivers send up their voices; they send them up with a loud cry.
sentences.susu: Marigi, baa mɔrɔnyi rawunduma alɔ galanyi, galanyi naxan goroma, a bula.

sentences.english: The Lord in heaven is stronger than the noise of great waters, yes, he is stronger than the great waves of the sea.
sentences.susu: I sɛnbɛ gbo na xui bɛ, i xa xunnakeli dangi baa mɔrɔnyie ra. Marigi sɛnbɛ gbo koore ma.

sentences.english: Your witness is most certain; it is right for your house to be holy, O Lord, for ever.
sentences.susu: I xa sɛriyɛ xanxi, sɛniyɛntɔɛ nan lanxi i ma abadan.

sentences.english: O God, in whose hands is punishment, O God of punishment, let your shining face be seen.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala naxan a gbeɲɔxɔma, i xa i makɛnɛn i xa nɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: Be lifted up, O judge of the earth; let their reward come to the men of pride.
sentences.susu: I tan naxan duniɲa kiiti sama, i xa keli, i xa yɛtɛ igboe xa walie ragbilen e ma.

sentences.english: How long will sinners, O Lord, how long will sinners have joy over us?
sentences.susu: N Marigi, a lanma mixi kobie xun xa rakeli han mun tɛmui?

sentences.english: Words of pride come from their lips; all the workers of evil say great things of themselves.
sentences.susu: A lanma mixi ɲaaxie xa e yɛtɛ matɔxɔ tun e xa yɛtɛ igboɲa kui?

sentences.english: Your people are crushed by them, O Lord, your heritage is troubled,
sentences.susu: Alatala, e i xa ɲama tɔɔrɔma, e i xa mixie halakima.

sentences.english: They put to death the widow and the guest, they take the lives of children who have no father;
sentences.susu: E kaaɲɛ ginɛe nun xɔɲɛ faxama, e kiridie nii bama.

sentences.english: And they say, Jah will not see it, the God of Jacob will not give thought to it.
sentences.susu: E nu fa a fala, «Alatala mu yi fee toma, Yaxuba Marigi Ala mu yi rakɔrɔsima.»

sentences.english: Give your mind to my words, you who are without wisdom among the people; you foolish men, when will you be wise?
sentences.susu: Wo tan xaxilitaree, naxee luma ɲama tagi, wo xaxili sɔtɔma mun tɛmui?

sentences.english: Has he by whom your ears were planted no hearing? or is he blind by whom your eyes were formed?
sentences.susu: Naxan tuli daaxi, na luma a mu fe mɛ? Naxan ya daaxi, na luma a mu se to?

sentences.english: He who is the judge of the nations, will he not give men the reward of their acts, even he who gives knowledge to man?
sentences.susu: Naxan ɲamanɛe xuruma, na mu e ɲaxankatama? A tan nan xaxili fima ibunadama ma.

sentences.english: The Lord has knowledge of the thoughts of man, for they are only a breath.
sentences.susu: Alatala a kolon a adamadie xa maɲɔxunyie na nɛ fufafu.

sentences.english: Happy is the man who is guided by you, O Jah, and to whom you give teaching out of your law;
sentences.susu: Alatala, Sɛɛwɛ na mixi bɛ i naxan matinxinma, i naxan matinxinma i xa sɛriyɛ ra,

sentences.english: So that you may give him rest from the days of evil, till a hole is made ready for the destruction of the sinners.
sentences.susu: alako a xaxili xa sa tɔɔrɛ lɔxɔɛe, han mixi ɲaaxie e gbe ɲaxankatɛ sɔtɔma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord will not give up his people, or take away his support from his heritage;
sentences.susu: Alatala mu a xa ɲama raboloma, a mu a xa mixie rabɛɲinma.

sentences.english: But decisions will again be made in righteousness; and they will be kept by all whose hearts are true.
sentences.susu: Kiiti tinxinxi fama nɛ sade, tinxintɔɛe bɔɲɛ birama nɛ na fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Who will give me help against the sinners? and who will be my support against the workers of evil?
sentences.susu: Nde n xun mafalama mixi ɲaaxie xɔn ma? Nde tima n bɛ mixi kobie xili ma?

sentences.english: If the Lord had not been my helper, my soul would quickly have gone down into death.
sentences.susu: Xa n Marigi mu findi n malima ra nu, n ma fe danma nɛ gaburi kui nu.

sentences.english: If I say, My foot is slipping; your mercy, O Lord, is my support.
sentences.susu: N Marigi, n na maɲɔxun a n sanyi mu tima sɔnɔn, i xa dugutɛgɛɲa n dɛmɛnma.

sentences.english: Among all my troubled thoughts, your comforts are the delight of my soul.
sentences.susu: N ma kɔntɔfilie na wuya, i e bama n ma, i fa n nasɛɛwa.

sentences.english: What part with you has the seat of sin, which makes evil into a law?
sentences.susu: I nɔma tinde mangɛya tinxintare ra, naxan yaamari tima fe kobi ra?

sentences.english: They are banded together against the soul of the upright, to give decisions against those who have done no wrong.
sentences.susu: E kafuma e bore ma tinxintɔɛ faxafe ra, e mixi tɔɔɲɛgɛ kiiti kui.

sentences.english: But the Lord is my safe resting-place; my God is the Rock where I am safe.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Marigi nan na n kantama ra, a luma alɔ fanye n sabatima naxan fari.

sentences.english: And he has made their evil designs come back on themselves, cutting them off in their sin; the Lord our God will put an end to them.
sentences.susu: A e xa wali kobie ragbilenma nɛ e ma, a e xun nakana e xa ɲaaxuɲa ra. Muxu Marigi Ala e sɔntɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: O come, let us make songs to the Lord; sending up glad voices to the Rock of our salvation.
sentences.susu: Won xa bɛɛti ba Marigi bɛ sɛɛwɛ ra, won xa won xui ite won nakisima sɛnbɛma bɛ.

sentences.english: Let us come before his face with praises; and make melody with holy songs.
sentences.susu: Won xa a matɔxɔ, won xa a matɔxɔɛ ba a bɛ bɛɛtie ra,

sentences.english: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King over all gods.
sentences.susu: barima Alatala, Ala xungbe na a ra, naxan findixi mangɛ xungbe ra sɛnbɛmae birin xun ma.

sentences.english: The deep places of the earth are in his hand; and the tops of the mountains are his.
sentences.susu: Yire tilinxi na a bɛlɛxɛ. Geya xuntagie findixi a gbe nan na,

sentences.english: The sea is his, and he made it; and the dry land was formed by his hands.
sentences.susu: alɔ baa nun bɔxi a naxee daaxi a bɛlɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: O come, let us give worship, falling down on our knees before the Lord our Maker.
sentences.susu: Wo fa, won xa suyidi, won xa won igoro, won xa won xinbi sin Alatala ya i naxan won daa,

sentences.english: For he is our God; and we are the people to whom he gives food, and the sheep of his flock. Today, if you would only give ear to his voice!
sentences.susu: barima a tan nan won Marigi Ala ra. Won findixi a xa ɲama nan na a naxan dɛmadonma, alɔ xuruse dɛmadonyi mɛɛnima gɔɔrɛ ma ki naxɛ. Wo xa a xui mɛ to.

sentences.english: Let not your hearts be hard, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the waste land;
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo bɔɲɛe raxɔrɔxɔ alɔ naxan nabaxi Meriba, alɔ naxan nabaxi Masa gbengberenyi ma tɛmui dangixi.

sentences.english: When your fathers put me to the test and saw my power and my work.
sentences.susu: Wo benbae n mato nɛ na lɔxɔɛ, hali e to nu bara n wali fɔxi to.

sentences.english: For forty years I was angry with this generation, and said, They are a people whose hearts are turned away from me, for they have no knowledge of my ways;
sentences.susu: Na bɔnsɔɛ xa fe naxa raɲaaxu n ma ɲɛ tongo naani bun ma. N naxa a fala, «Ɲama xurutare nan yi ki, naxan mu n waxɔnfe kolon.»

sentences.english: And I made an oath in my wrath, that they might not come into my place of rest.
sentences.susu: Na kui n naxa n kali n ma xɔnɛ kui, «E mu soma n ma malabude kui fefe ma!»

sentences.english: O make a new song to the Lord; let all the earth make melody to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo bɛɛti nɛɛnɛ nde ba Alatala bɛ! Duniɲa birin xa bɛɛti ba Alatala bɛ!

sentences.english: Make songs to the Lord, blessing his name; give the good news of his salvation day by day.
sentences.susu: Wo bɛɛti ba Marigi bɛ, wo a xili matɔxɔ. Wo xa a xa kisi masen mixie bɛ tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Make clear his glory to the nations, and his wonders to all the peoples.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a xa nɔrɛ fala si birin bɛ, wo a xa kaabanakoe masen ɲama birin tagi.

sentences.english: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised; he is more to be feared than all other gods.
sentences.susu: Marigi Ala gbo, a lanma won xa a matɔxɔ, naxan dangi sɛnbɛmae birin na.

sentences.english: For all the gods of the nations are false gods; but the Lord made the heavens.
sentences.susu: Sie birama ala naxee fɔxɔ ra, e findixi kuyee fufafu gbansan nan na, kɔnɔ Alatala nan koore daa.

sentences.english: Honour and glory are before him: strong and fair is his holy place.
sentences.susu: Nɔrɛ nun naiyalanyi kelima a tan nan ma, sɛnbɛ nun naiyalanyi luma nɛ a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: Give to the Lord, O you families of the peoples, give to the Lord glory and strength.
sentences.susu: Bɔnsɔɛ birin, wo xa tantui rasiga Alatala ma, wo Alatala matɔxɔ a xunnakeli nun a xa sɛnbɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Give to the Lord the glory of his name; take with you an offering and come into his house.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a xili binya alɔ a lanma wo xa a raba ki naxɛ. Wo xa fa hadiya ra, wo xa a raso a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ kui.

sentences.english: O give worship to the Lord in holy robes; be in fear before him, all the earth.
sentences.susu: Wo xa suyidi Marigi bɛ a xa nɔrɛ ya i. Duniɲa birin xa sɛrɛn a ya ra.

sentences.english: Say among the nations, The Lord is King; yes, the world is ordered so that it may not be moved; he will be an upright judge of the peoples.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a fala si birin bɛ, «Alatala nan na Mangɛ ra. Duniɲa xanxi, a mu a imaxama. Ala ɲamae makiitima tinxinyi ra.

sentences.english: Let the heavens have joy and the earth be glad; let the sea be thundering with all its waters;
sentences.susu: Koore xa sɛɛwa, bɔxi xa ɲɛlɛxin. Baa nun a kui isee xa wundu sɛɛwɛ ra.

sentences.english: Let the field be glad, and everything which is in it; yes, let all the trees of the wood be sounding with joy,
sentences.susu: Xɛe nun e xa bogi see xui xa ite, wondi wuri bilie xa e sɛɛwa xui ite

sentences.english: Before the Lord, for he is come; he is come to be the judge of the earth; the earth will be judged in righteousness, and the peoples with unchanging faith.
sentences.susu: Alatala ya ra naxan fafe. A fafe duniɲa makiitide. A duniɲa makiitima tinxinyi nan na, a ɲamae makiiti nɔndi ra.»

sentences.english: The Lord is King, let the earth have joy; let all the sea-lands be glad.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan na mangɛ ra. Duniɲa xa ɲɛlɛxin, surie xa sɛɛwa.

sentences.english: Dark clouds are round him; his kingdom is based on righteousness and right judging.
sentences.susu: Nuxui nun kuye ifɔɔrɔxi a rabilinma. A xa kibanyi dɔxɔxi tinxinyi nun nɔndi fari.

sentences.english: Fire goes before him, burning up all those who are against him round about.
sentences.susu: Tɛ tixi a ya ra, a a yaxuie birin ganma a rabilinyi.

sentences.english: His bright flames give light to the world; the earth saw it with fear.
sentences.susu: A duniɲa iyalanma a xa seyamakɔnyie ra, duniɲa mixie na a to, e sɛrɛnma nɛ.

sentences.english: The mountains became like wax at the coming of the Lord, at the coming of the Lord of all the earth.
sentences.susu: Geyae xunuma duniɲa Marigi Alatala ya ra alɔ kumi dole.

sentences.english: The heavens gave out the news of his righteousness, and all the people saw his glory.
sentences.susu: Koore a xa tinxinyi masenma, si birin a xa nɔrɛ toma.

sentences.english: Shamed be all those who give worship to images, and take pride in false gods; give him worship, all you gods.
sentences.susu: Kuye batue fama nɛ yaagide a ya ra, sɛnbɛmae e felenma nɛ a bun ma.

sentences.english: Zion gave ear and was glad; and the daughters of Judah were full of joy, because of your decisions, O Lord.
sentences.susu: Siyonikae na a xui mɛ, e sɛɛwama nɛ, Yudayakae ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ i tan Alatala xa kiiti ra,

sentences.english: For you, Lord, are most high over the earth; you are lifted up over all other gods.
sentences.susu: barima i tan Marigi xun nakelixi sɛnbɛmae birin bɛ.

sentences.english: You who are lovers of the Lord, be haters of evil; he keeps the souls of his saints; he takes them out of the hand of sinners.
sentences.susu: Alatala xanuntenyi xa fe ɲaaxi xɔn. Alatala a batulae makantama nɛ, a e ba mixi kobie bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: Light is shining on the lovers of righteousness, and for the upright in heart there is joy.
sentences.susu: Naiyalanyi na tinxintɔɛe nan bɛ, sɛɛwɛ na mixie bɛ naxee bɔɲɛ fiixɛ.

sentences.english: Be glad in the Lord, you upright men; praising the memory of his holy name.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛe, wo sɛɛwa Marigi ra, wo xa tantui rasiga a xili sɛniyɛnxi ma.

sentences.english: O make a new song to the Lord, because he has done works of wonder; with his right hand, and with his holy arm, he has overcome.
sentences.susu: Bɛɛti Wo bɛɛti nɛɛnɛ ba Alatala bɛ, barima a bara kaabanakoe raba, a bɛlɛxɛ sɛnbɛma bara xunnakeli sɔtɔ a bɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord has given to all the knowledge of his salvation; he has made clear his righteousness in the eyes of the nations.
sentences.susu: Marigi bara a xa kisi masen, a bara a xa tinxinyi sa kɛnɛ ma ɲamanɛe ya i.

sentences.english: He has kept in mind his mercy and his unchanging faith to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
sentences.susu: A mu nɛɛmu a xa dugutɛgɛɲa nun a xa xanunteya ma Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ mabiri. Duniɲa birin bara won Marigi Ala xa kisi to.

sentences.english: Let all the earth send out a glad cry to the Lord; sounding with a loud voice, and praising him with songs of joy.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa birin xa Alatala matɔxɔ, e xa bɛɛti ba sɛɛwɛ kui.

sentences.english: Make melody to the Lord with instruments of music; with a corded instrument and the voice of song.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Alatala matɔxɔ kɔra xui nun bɛɛti ra,

sentences.english: With wind instruments and the sound of the horn, make a glad cry before the Lord, the King.
sentences.susu: wo xa sarae fe sɛɛwɛ ra wo Mangɛ Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: Let the sea be thundering, with all its waters; the world, and all who are living in it;
sentences.susu: Baa nun duniɲa xa e xui ramini,

sentences.english: Let the streams make sounds of joy with their hands; let the mountains be glad together,
sentences.susu: xuree xa e bɛlɛxɛe bɔnbɔ, geyae xa e xui ite sɛɛwɛ ra

sentences.english: Before the Lord, for he has come as judge of the earth; judging the world in righteousness, and giving true decisions for the peoples.
sentences.susu: Alatala ya ra, barima a fafe duniɲa makiitide. A duniɲa makiitima tinxinyi nan na, a ɲamae makiitima nɔndi ra.

sentences.english: The Lord is King; let the peoples be in fear: his seat is on the winged ones; let the earth be moved.
sentences.susu: Ala dɔxɔxi a xa kibanyi kui kerubimi malekɛe tagi. A xa ɲama tixi gaaxui kui, bɔxi na sɛrɛnfe.

sentences.english: The Lord is great in Zion; he is high over all the nations.
sentences.susu: Alatala gbo Siyoni, a tixi sie birin xun ma.

sentences.english: Let them give praise to your name, for it is great and to be feared; holy is he.
sentences.susu: E xa i xili xungbe magaaxuxi matɔxɔ a xa sɛniyɛnyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: The king's power is used for righteousness; you give true decisions, judging rightly in the land of Jacob.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ sɛnbɛ xa matɔxɔ, tinxinyi rafan a ma, a kiiti sama nɔndi ra Yaxuba xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Give high honour to the Lord our God, worshipping at his feet; holy is he.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala matɔxɔ, wo wo magoro a bun ma a xa sɛniyɛnyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among those who gave honour to his name; they made prayers to the Lord, and he gave answers to them.
sentences.susu: Munsa nun Haruna nu na a xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ya ma, Annabi Samuweli nu na mixie ya ma naxee a maxandima. E to a xili, a naxa e yaabi.

sentences.english: His voice came to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept his witness, and the law which he gave them.
sentences.susu: A to sɛriyɛ nun yaamari masen e bɛ nuxui kui, e naxa a xui suxu.

sentences.english: You gave them an answer, O Lord our God; you took away their sin, though you gave them punishment for their wrongdoing.
sentences.susu: Muxu Marigi Alatala, i bara e xa maxandi suxu. I to Isirayila ɲaxankata e xa yunubi xa fe ra, i man bara diɲɛ e ma.

sentences.english: Give high honour to the Lord our God, worshipping with your faces turned to his holy hill; for the Lord our God is holy.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo Marigi Alatala matɔxɔ, wo xa wo xinbi sin a xa geya sɛniyɛnxi fari, barima won Marigi Alatala sɛniyɛn!

sentences.english: Make a glad sound to the Lord, all the earth.
sentences.susu: Tantui bɛɛti Duniɲa birin xa Alatala matɔxɔ!

sentences.english: Give worship to the Lord with joy; come before him with a song.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Alatala batu sɛɛwɛ kui. Wo xa fa a ya i wo sɛɛwɛ xui itexi ra.

sentences.english: Be certain that the Lord is God; it is he who has made us, and we are his; we are his people, and the sheep to whom he gives food.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon Alatala nan wo Marigi Ala ra. A tan nan won daaxi, won findixi a gbe nan na. Won findixi a xa ɲama nan na, naxan luxi alɔ a xa xuruse gɔɔrɛ a naxan dɛmadonma.

sentences.english: Come into his doors with joy, and into his house with praise; give him honour, blessing his name.
sentences.susu: Wo so a xa naadɛe ra a tantufe ra, wo so a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ kui a matɔxɔfe ra! Wo tantui rasiga a ma, wo a xili matɔxɔ,

sentences.english: For the Lord is good, and his mercy is never-ending; his faith is unchanging through all generations.
sentences.susu: barima Alatala fan, a xa xanunteya buma nɛ abadan, a xa dugutɛgɛɲa mu ɲɔnma duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari ma.

sentences.english: I will make a song of mercy and righteousness; to you, O Lord, will I make melody.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti N dugutɛgɛɲa nun tinxinyi matɔxɔma nɛ. N bɛɛti bama i tan nan bɛ Alatala.

sentences.english: I will do wisely in the way of righteousness: O when will you come to me? I will be walking in my house with a true heart.
sentences.susu: N fe birin nabama lufe ra tinxintɔɛ xa kira xɔn. I fama n yire mun tɛmui? N na n ɲɛrɛma nɛ n bɔɲɛ fiixɛxi ra n ma mixie tagi.

sentences.english: I will not put any evil thing before my eyes; I am against all turning to one side; I will not have it near me.
sentences.susu: N mu n ya tima fe tinxintare ra, n mu tinma yanfante xa kira ra, n nun e tan mu lanma fe yo ma.

sentences.english: The false heart I will send away from me: I will not have an evil-doer for a friend.
sentences.susu: N tan nun mixi ɲaaxi tagi kuya, n mu wama yunubi xɔn.

sentences.english: I will put to death anyone who says evil of his neighbour secretly; the man with a high look and a heart of pride is disgusting to me.
sentences.susu: N mixi dɛ balanma nɛ naxan a boore mafalama. N mu tinma yɛtɛ matɔxɔɛ nun yɛtɛ igboɲa ra.

sentences.english: My eyes will be on those of good faith in the land, so that they may be living in my house; he who is walking in the right way will be my servant.
sentences.susu: N na n ɲɔxɔ sama nɛ yi bɔxi dugutɛgɛe xɔn ma, alako e xa lu n sɛɛti ma. N wama tinxintɔɛe nan xɔn ma, e xa n mali.

sentences.english: The worker of deceit will not come into my house; the false man will have no place before my eyes.
sentences.susu: Yanfantee mu luma n ma mixie ya ma, wule falɛe mu tima n ya i.

sentences.english: Morning by morning will I put to death all the sinners in the land, so that all evil-doers may be cut off from Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Gɛɛsɛgɛ birin n mixi kobie sɔntɔma nɛ, alako na mixi mɔɔli naxa lu Alatala xa taa kui.

sentences.english: Give ear to my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry come to you.
sentences.susu: Tɔɔrɔmixi naxan Alatala maxandife a xa tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: Let not your face be veiled from me in the day of my trouble; give ear to me, and let my cry be answered quickly.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa n ma maxandi suxu, i xa i tuli mati n wa xui ra.

sentences.english: My days are wasted like smoke, and my bones are burned up as in a fire.
sentences.susu: I naxa i kobe so n na n ma tɔɔrɛ kui. I xa n ma maxandi suxu mafuren.

sentences.english: My heart is broken; it has become dry and dead like grass, so that I give no thought to food.
sentences.susu: N ma simaya na lɔɛfe alɔ tuuri lɔɛma kuye ma ki naxɛ, n xɔrie na ɲɔnfe alɔ yege ganma tɛ ra ki naxɛ,

sentences.english: Because of the voice of my sorrow, my flesh is wasted to the bone.
sentences.susu: n bɔɲɛ na lisife alɔ sɛxɛ naxan na fiili ma. N mu donse donma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: I am like a bird living by itself in the waste places; like the night-bird in a waste of sand.
sentences.susu: N na wa n xui itexi ra, n xɔrie birin makɛnɛnma nɛ.

sentences.english: I keep watch like a bird by itself on the house-top.
sentences.susu: N bara lu alɔ xundi naxan toma wula i, alɔ koofole naxan na banxi tonbolonyi kui.

sentences.english: My haters say evil of me all day; those who are violent against me make use of my name as a curse.
sentences.susu: N mu nɔma xide. N kiroxi alɔ xɔni naxan na kerenyi ma banxi fari.

sentences.english: I have had dust for bread and my drink has been mixed with weeping:
sentences.susu: N yaxuie yoma n ma lɔxɔɛ birin, e n xili rawalima dankɛ wɔyɛnyi ra.

sentences.english: Because of your passion and your wrath, for I have been lifted up and then made low by you.
sentences.susu: N dɛ rafexi tɛxube ra alɔ donse, n yaye silɔnma n ma minse xun ma

sentences.english: My days are like a shade which is stretched out; I am dry like the grass.
sentences.susu: i xa bɔɲɛte nun i xa xɔnɛ xa fe ra. I bara n keri pon!

sentences.english: But you, O Lord, are eternal; and your name will never come to an end.
sentences.susu: N ma simaya bara lu alɔ niini naxan lɔɛma dimi kui, alɔ sɛxɛ naxan lisima fiili ma.

sentences.english: You will again get up and have mercy on Zion: for the time has come for her to be comforted.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan Alatala luma nɛ i xa kibanyi kui abadan, i xili mu lɔɛma duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, looking with love on her dust.
sentences.susu: I fama nɛ kelide i xa kinikini Siyoni ma, barima a lanxi i xa hinnɛ a ra yi waxati sugandixi ma.

sentences.english: So the nations will give honour to the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth will be in fear of his glory:
sentences.susu: A gɛmɛe nun a bɔxi rafan i xa konyi die ma.

sentences.english: When the Lord has put up the walls of Zion, and has been been in his glory;
sentences.susu: Sie birin fama gaaxude Alatala xili ya ra, mangɛe birin fama e xinbi sinde i xa nɔrɛ ya ra.

sentences.english: When he has given ear to the prayer of the poor, and has not put his request on one side.
sentences.susu: Alatala man fama nɛ Siyoni tide, a a yɛtɛ masen a xa nɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: This will be put in writing for the coming generation, and the people of the future will give praise to the Lord.
sentences.susu: A a ya rafindima nɛ misikiinɛ xa maxandi ma, a mu yo a xa dubɛ ma.

sentences.english: For from his holy place the Lord has seen, looking down on the earth from heaven;
sentences.susu: Na xa sɛbɛ bɔnsɔɛe bɛ naxee fama, alako mixi naxee mu daaxi sinden e xa Alatala matɔxɔ,

sentences.english: Hearing the cry of the prisoner, making free those for whom death is ordered;
sentences.susu: barima a a ya ragoroma won ma kelife a xa yire sɛniyɛnxi itexi. Alatala bɔxi matoma kelife koore ma,

sentences.english: So that they may give out the name of the Lord in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
sentences.susu: alako a xa geelimanie wa xui ramɛ, a xa mixie ratanga naxee na faxɛ xa kira ma,

sentences.english: When the peoples are come together, and the kingdoms, to give worship to the Lord.
sentences.susu: alako e xa Alatala xili masen Siyoni taa kui, e xa a matɔxɔ bɛɛti ra Darisalamu,

sentences.english: He has taken my strength from me in the way; he has made short my days.
sentences.susu: sie na e malan tɛmui naxɛ Alatala batufe ra.

sentences.english: I will say, O my God, take me not away before my time; your years go on through all generations:
sentences.susu: A bara n ma sɛnbɛ ba n yi ra n ma duniɲɛigiri kui, a bara n ma simaya radunke.

sentences.english: In the past you put the earth on its base, and the heavens are the work of your hands.
sentences.susu: N naxa a fala a bɛ, «N Marigi Ala, i naxa n nii ba n ma simaya tagi ra, i tan naxan buma abadan,

sentences.english: They will come to an end, but you will still go on; they all will become old like a coat, and like a robe they will be changed:
sentences.susu: I tan nan duniɲa daa, i tan nan koore itala i xɔnyɛ ra.

sentences.english: But you are the unchanging One, and your years will have no end.
sentences.susu: E tan ɲɔnma nɛ, kɔnɔ i tan buma nɛ abadan, e birin forima nɛ alɔ sose, kɔnɔ i tan e masarama nɛ alɔ donma. I e masarama nɛ, alɔ donma naxan nagoroma, a wɔlɛ.

sentences.english: The children of your servants will have a safe resting-place, and their seed will be ever before you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan mu masarama, i mu ɲɔnma abadan.

sentences.english: Give praise to the Lord, O my soul; let everything in me give praise to his holy name.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti N xa Alatala tantu n nii birin na, n xa a xili sɛniyɛnxi matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: Give praise to the Lord, O my soul; let not all his blessings go from your memory.
sentences.susu: N xa Alatala tantu n nii birin na, n naxa nɛɛmu a xa hinnɛ ma.

sentences.english: He has forgiveness for all your sins; he takes away all your diseases;
sentences.susu: A tan nan diɲɛma i xa yunubie ma, a i xa furee rayalan,

sentences.english: He keeps back your life from destruction, crowning you with mercy and grace.
sentences.susu: a i ratanga faxɛ ma, a i rabilin a xa xanunteya nun a xa kinikini ra.

sentences.english: He makes your mouth full of good things, so that your strength is made new again like the eagle's.
sentences.susu: A hinnɛma i ra i xa duniɲɛigiri kui, alako i man xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ i xa foriɲa kui alɔ sɛgɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord gives decisions in righteousness for all who are in trouble.
sentences.susu: Alatala ɲɛrɛma tinxinyi kui, a kiiti tinxinxi sama tɔɔrɔmixie bɛ.

sentences.english: He gave knowledge of his way to Moses, and made his acts clear to the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: A bara a xa kira masen Annabi Munsa bɛ, a a xa kaabanakoee masen Isirayilakae bɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord is kind and full of pity, not quickly made angry, but ever ready to have mercy.
sentences.susu: Alatala kinikinima mixie ma, a hinnɛ e ra, a mu xɔnɔma e ma mafuren mafuren, a xa xanunteya gbo.

sentences.english: His feeling will no longer be bitter; he will not keep his wrath for ever.
sentences.susu: A mu mixie tɔɔrɔma tɛmui birin, a xa xɔnnanteya mu buma.

sentences.english: He has not given us the punishment for our sins, or the reward of our wrongdoing.
sentences.susu: A mu won ɲaxankatama won ma yunubi rabaxi ki ma, a mu won ma yunubi sare ragbilenma won ma.

sentences.english: For as the heaven is high over the earth, so great is his mercy to his worshippers.
sentences.susu: Koore itexi bɔxi xun ma ki naxɛ, a xa xanunteya fan gboxi na ki nɛ a yaragaaxuie bɛ.

sentences.english: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he put our sins from us.
sentences.susu: Sogetede makuyaxi sogegorode ra ki naxɛ, a won ma yunubie fan makuyaxi won na na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: As a father has pity on his children, so the Lord has pity on his worshippers.
sentences.susu: Babae kinikinima e xa die ma ki naxɛ, Alatala fan kinikinima a yaragaaxuie ma na ki nɛ,

sentences.english: For he has knowledge of our feeble frame; he sees that we are only dust.
sentences.susu: barima a a kolon won yailanxi se naxan na, a ratuxi a ma a bɛndɛ nan won na.

sentences.english: As for man, his days are as grass: his beautiful growth is like the flower of the field.
sentences.susu: Adamadie xa simaya maniya sansi ra naxan fugama fiili ma,

sentences.english: The wind goes over it and it is gone; and its place sees it no longer.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ foye na bɔnbɔ a ra, a xarama nɛ, a lɔɛ.

sentences.english: But the mercy of the Lord is eternal for his worshippers, and their children's children will see his righteousness;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala a yaragaaxuie xanuma nɛ abadan, a xa tinxinyi birama nɛ e bɔnsɔɛe fɔxɔ ra,

sentences.english: If they keep his agreement, and have his laws in mind to do them.
sentences.susu: naxee a xa saatɛ binyama, e a xa sɛriyɛ rabatu.

sentences.english: The Lord has made ready his high seat in the heavens; his kingdom is ruling over all.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a xa kibanyi dɔxɔ koore ma, a duniɲa birin yamari.

sentences.english: Give praise to the Lord, you his angels, who are great in strength, doing his orders, and waiting for his voice.
sentences.susu: Wo tan malekɛe, wo xa Alatala tantu, wo tan naxee sɛnbɛ gbo, wo tan naxee a rabatuma.

sentences.english: Give praise to the Lord, all you his armies; and you his servants who do his pleasure.
sentences.susu: Wo tan sɛnbɛma naxee na koore ma, wo xa Alatala tantu, wo tan naxee a waxɔnfe rabama.

sentences.english: Give praise to the Lord, all his works, in all places under his rule: give praise to the Lord, O my soul.
sentences.susu: Wo tan birin naxee daaxi, wo xa Alatala tantu yire birin a xa mangɛya bun ma. N xa Alatala tantu n nii birin na.

sentences.english: Give praise to the Lord, O my soul. O Lord my God, you are very great; you are robed with honour and power.
sentences.susu: N xa Alatala tantu n nii birin na. N Marigi Alatala, i sɛnbɛ gbo, nɔrɛ nun yanbɛ na i ma,

sentences.english: You are clothed with light as with a robe; stretching out the heavens like a curtain:
sentences.susu: a luxi alɔ naiyalanyi yati findixi i xa guba nan na. I koore italaxi alɔ dugi xungbe i sabatixi naxan bun ma,

sentences.english: The arch of your house is based on the waters; you make the clouds your carriage; you go on the wings of the wind:
sentences.susu: i xa konkoe tixi nuxuie fari ye ragataxi dɛnnaxɛ. I nuxuie findi i xa ɲɛrɛ se ra, i i ɲɛrɛ foye fari.

sentences.english: He makes winds his angels, and flames of fire his servants.
sentences.susu: I foye xɛɛma i xa masenyi ra, i tɛ rasanbama i xa wali rabafe ra.

sentences.english: He has made the earth strong on its bases, so that it may not be moved for ever and ever;
sentences.susu: Ala duniɲa tixi nɛ alɔ banxi tixi ki naxɛ, a mu a mamaxama feo.

sentences.english: Covering it with the sea as with a robe: the waters were high over the mountains;
sentences.susu: A baa dusu nɛ a xun ma alɔ dugi, a geyae xuntagi makoto.

sentences.english: At the voice of your word they went in flight; at the sound of your thunder they went away in fear;
sentences.susu: I to xaaɲɛ ye ma, a a gi i xa galanyi xui ma,

sentences.english: The mountains came up and the valleys went down into the place which you had made ready for them.
sentences.susu: geyae nun gulunbae fa lu yire i nu wa dɛnnaxɛ xɔn.

sentences.english: You made a limit over which they might not go, so that the earth would never again be covered by them.
sentences.susu: I naaninyi saxi ye bɛ a mu tuganma naxan xun ma, alako a naxa gbilen din na xare ma.

sentences.english: You sent the springs into the valleys; they are flowing between the hills.
sentences.susu: I dulonyie findi xuree ra, naxee susuma geya longorie ra,

sentences.english: They give drink to every beast of the field; the mountain asses come to them for water.
sentences.susu: a ye xɔli ba burunyi subee birin ma, a ye xɔli ba wulai sofalee ma.

sentences.english: The birds of the air have their resting-places by them, and make their song among the branches.
sentences.susu: Xɔnie sabatixi nee fɛ ma, e e xui raminima wuri salonyie kɔn na burɛxɛe longori ra.

sentences.english: He sends down rain from his store-houses on the hills: the earth is full of the fruit of his works.
sentences.susu: I geyae bundama ye ra keli koore ma, bɔxi wasama i xa wali ra.

sentences.english: He makes the grass come up for the cattle, and plants for the use of man; so that bread may come out of the earth;
sentences.susu: I ɲooge raminima xurusee bɛ, i sansie rabulama adamadie bɛ, e baloe sɔtɔma naxee ra.

sentences.english: And wine to make glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face shining, and bread giving strength to his heart.
sentences.susu: I wɛni fima mixie ma, naxan e bɔɲɛ rafanma e ma, i ture raminima e bɛ, naxan e kiri ratofanma, i e baloma donse ra, naxan sɛnbɛ fima e ma.

sentences.english: The trees of the Lord are full of growth, the cedars of Lebanon of his planting;
sentences.susu: Liban wuri bilie, Marigi naxee sixi, e bara ye sɔtɔ a fanyi ra,

sentences.english: Where the birds have their resting-places; as for the stork, the tall trees are her house.
sentences.susu: xɔnie e tɛɛ sama e kɔn na. Gbongboe e tɛɛ sama sipirɛ wuri bilie kɔn na,

sentences.english: The high hills are a safe place for the mountain goats, and the rocks for the small beasts.
sentences.susu: wulai sie xima geyae fari, sagalee luma gɛmɛ longorie ra.

sentences.english: He made the moon for a sign of the divisions of the year; teaching the sun the time of its going down.
sentences.susu: I kike yailanxi sali waxatie kolonfe nan na. Soge a dula tɛmui kolon.

sentences.english: When you make it dark, it is night, when all the beasts of the woods come quietly out of their secret places.
sentences.susu: I dimi rafama kɔɛ ra, burun subee ɲɛrɛma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: The young lions go thundering after their food; searching for their meat from God.
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛe na e xui ramini donse fenfe ra, Ala e kima baloe ra.

sentences.english: The sun comes up, and they come together, and go back to their secret places to take their rest.
sentences.susu: Soge nɛfɛ mini, e gbilen e xa fɔnmɛe ra.

sentences.english: Man goes out to his work, and to his business, till the evening.
sentences.susu: Mixie tan mini, e sa fɛɛɲɛn walide.

sentences.english: O Lord, how great is the number of your works! in wisdom you have made them all; the earth is full of the things you have made.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa daalisee wuya. I e birin daaxi xaxilimaya nan na. Bɔxi rafexi i xa daalisee ra,

sentences.english: There is the great, wide sea, where there are living things, great and small, more than may be numbered.
sentences.susu: baa fan nafexi i xa daalisee ra, ndee xurun, ndee xungbo, e wuya.

sentences.english: There go the ships; there is that great beast, which you have made as a plaything.
sentences.susu: Kunkui xungbee ɲɛrɛma mɛnni fari, peremui ɲɛrɛma baa bun ma ɲɛlɛxinyi ra.

sentences.english: All of them are waiting for you, to give them their food in its time.
sentences.susu: Yi daalise birin e xaxili tixi i tan nan na e baloe xa fe ra.

sentences.english: They take what you give them; they are full of the good things which come from your open hand.
sentences.susu: I na e ki, e a sɔtɔma nɛ i saabui ra, e wasa.

sentences.english: If your face is veiled, they are troubled; when you take away their breath, they come to an end, and go back to the dust.
sentences.susu: I na e kuma, e gaaxuma nɛ. I na e ɲɛngi ba, e faxama nɛ, e gbilen bɛndɛ.

sentences.english: If you send out your spirit, they are given life; you make new the face of the earth.
sentences.susu: I na i ɲɛngi raso e fate, e man balo, bɔxi man fa fan.

sentences.english: Let the glory of the Lord be for ever; let the Lord have joy in his works:
sentences.susu: Alatala xa nɔrɛ xa bu abadan! Alatala xa sɛɛwa a xa daalie ra!

sentences.english: At whose look the earth is shaking; at whose touch the mountains send out smoke.
sentences.susu: A na bɔxi mato, a sɛrɛnma nɛ, a na din geyae ra, e ganma nɛ.

sentences.english: I will make songs to the Lord all my life; I will make melody to my God while I have my being.
sentences.susu: N Alatala matɔxɔma nɛ fanni n baloxi, n bɛɛti bama nɛ n Marigi Ala bɛ fanni n na duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: Let my thoughts be sweet to him: I will be glad in the Lord.
sentences.susu: N ma dubɛ xa rafan a ma. N sɛɛwama nɛ Alatala xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Let sinners be cut off from the earth, and let all evil-doers come to an end. Give praise to the Lord, O my soul. Give praise to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yunubitɔɛe tan xa lɔɛ duniɲa ma. Mixi ɲaaxie naxa lu naa sɔnɔn! N bara Alatala matɔxɔ n nii birin na. Wo Alatala tantu!

sentences.english: O give praise to the Lord; give honour to his name, talking of his doings among the peoples.
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala xili matɔxɔ, wo a xa kaabanakoe masen ɲamae tagi.

sentences.english: Let your voice be sounding in songs and melody; let all your thoughts be of the wonder of his works.
sentences.susu: Wo bɛɛti ba a bɛ a xa kaabanakoee xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Have glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who are searching after the Lord be glad.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɛɛwa a xili sɛniyɛnxi xa fe ra, mixi naxee Alatala fenma, e xa ɲɛlɛxin.

sentences.english: Let your search be for the Lord and for his strength; let your hearts ever be turned to him.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Alatala xa sɛnbɛ fen, wo xa kata lude a ya i tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Keep in mind the great works which he has done; his wonders, and the decisions of his mouth;
sentences.susu: Wo xa ratu a xa kaabanakoe ma, wo naxa nɛɛmu a xa kiiti ma,

sentences.english: O you seed of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his loved ones.
sentences.susu: wo tan Ala xa konyi Iburahima bɔnsɔɛ, wo tan Yaxuba xa die a naxee sugandi.

sentences.english: He is the Lord our God: he is judge of all the earth.
sentences.susu: A tan nan won Marigi Alatala ra, a kiiti sama duniɲa birin ma.

sentences.english: He has kept his agreement in mind for ever, the word which he gave for a thousand generations;
sentences.susu: Alatala a ratuma a xa saatɛ ma tɛmui birin, a mu nɛɛmuma a xa laayidi ma abadan,

sentences.english: The agreement which he made with Abraham, and his oath to Isaac;
sentences.susu: a naxan tongoxi Iburahima nun Isiyaga bɛ marakali ra.

sentences.english: And he gave it to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an eternal agreement;
sentences.susu: A bara na natɛ tongo Yaxuba bɛ, a bara na saatɛ xiri Isirayila ra,

sentences.english: Saying, To you will I give the land of Canaan, the measured line of your heritage:
sentences.susu: a masenfe ra, «N bara Kanaan bɔxi fi wo ma kɛ ra.»

sentences.english: When they were still small in number, and strange in the land;
sentences.susu: Beenu e xa wuya mɛnni,

sentences.english: When they went about from one nation to another, and from one kingdom to another people.
sentences.susu: e nu na lintanfe tun,

sentences.english: He would not let anyone do them wrong; he even kept back kings because of them,
sentences.susu: Ala mu tin mixi yo xa nɔ e ra. A naxa a xɔrɔxɔ ɲamanɛ mangɛe bɛ a falafe ra,

sentences.english: Saying, Put not your hand on those who have been marked with my holy oil, and do my prophets no wrong.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa n ma ɲama sugandixi tɔɔrɔ de, wo naxa fe ɲaaxi raba n ma namiɲɔnmɛe ra.»

sentences.english: And he took away all food from the land, so that the people were without bread.
sentences.susu: Beenu Ala xa kaamɛ ragoro duniɲa ma, a baloe ba duniɲa yi ra,

sentences.english: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was given as a servant for a price:
sentences.susu: a naxa a xa mixi nde Yusufu rasiga e yara konyiya kui.

sentences.english: His feet were fixed in chains; his neck was put in iron bands;
sentences.susu: A sanyie nun a kɔnyi nu balanxi yɔlɔnxɔnyi ra,

sentences.english: Till the time when his word came true; he was tested by the word of the Lord.
sentences.susu: han Ala xa laayidi naxa kamali, a nɔndi fi a ma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: The king sent men to take off his chains; even the ruler of the people, who let him go free.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui mangɛ xungbe naxa yaamari fi a xa mini geeli kui, a xa fulun.

sentences.english: He made him lord of his house, and ruler over everything he had;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa Yusufu findi a xa banxi xunyi ra, a a gbe se birin sa a nɔɛ bun ma,

sentences.english: To give his chiefs teaching at his pleasure, and so that his law-givers might get wisdom from him.
sentences.susu: alako mangɛ xa mixie xa lu a waxɔn ki, bɔxi forie xa xaxili sɔtɔ a saabui ra.

sentences.english: Then Israel came into Egypt, and Jacob was living in the land of Ham.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Isirayila ɲama Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ naxa fa Misira, e sabati Hami xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And his people were greatly increased, and became stronger than those who were against them.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a xa ɲama wuya dangife e yaxuie ra.

sentences.english: Their hearts were turned to hate against his people, so that they made secret designs against them.
sentences.susu: A naxa Misirakae bɔɲɛ masara, han e fa a xa ɲama xɔn, e natɛ ɲaaxi tongo e xa fe ra.

sentences.english: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, the man of his selection.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a naxa a xa konyi di Munsa xɛɛ, a nun a xa mixi sugandixi Haruna.

sentences.english: He let his signs be seen among the people, and his wonders in the land of Ham.
sentences.susu: E naxa Ala xa tɔnxumae makaabaxie raba, Hami xa bɔxi xa mixie tagi.

sentences.english: He sent black night and made it dark; and they did not go against his word.
sentences.susu: E to Ala xa masenyi ti Misirakae bɛ, Ala naxa dimi rasin bɔxi ma, kuye naxa ifɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: At his word their waters were turned to blood, and he sent death on all their fish.
sentences.susu: A naxa mɛnni ye mafindi wuli ra, yɛxɛe fa faxa.

sentences.english: Their land was full of frogs, even in the rooms of the king.
sentences.susu: E xa bɔxi naxa rafe lanxansarimae ra, e so han mangɛ xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: He gave the word, and there came the dog-fly, and insects over all the land.
sentences.susu: A naxa yaamari fi xɛɛrie nun saasie xa din bɔxi birin na.

sentences.english: He gave them ice for rain, and flaming fire in their land.
sentences.susu: A naxa balabalanyi nun tunɛ ragoro bɔxi ma, seyamakɔnyi naxa din mɛnni ra.

sentences.english: He gave their vines and their fig-trees to destruction, and the trees of their land were broken down.
sentences.susu: A naxa e xa wɛni bilie nun e xa xɔrɛ bilie kana, a nun wuri bilie birin naxee nu na e xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: At his word the locusts came, and young locusts more than might be numbered,
sentences.susu: A naxa yaamari fi katoe xa wuya han,

sentences.english: And put an end to all the plants of their land, taking all the fruit of the earth for food.
sentences.susu: e fa sansie birin kana Misira bɔxi ma, e bɔxi daxamui birin don.

sentences.english: He put to death the first child of every family in the land, the first-fruits of their strength.
sentences.susu: A raɲɔnyi a naxa di singe birin faxa e xa bɔxi kui, e naxee bari e sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: He took his people out with silver and gold: there was not one feeble person among them.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a xa ɲama ramini kɔbiri nun xɛɛma ra, mixi yo mu faxa e ya ma.

sentences.english: Egypt was glad when they went; for the fear of them had come down on them.
sentences.susu: Misirakae naxa sɛɛwa e xa mini ra, barima e nu bara gaaxu Isirayilakae ya ra.

sentences.english: A cloud was stretched over them for a cover; and he sent fire to give light in the night.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa nuxui itala e xun ma yanyi ra, a tɛ ti koore ma kɔɛ ra naiyalanyi ra.

sentences.english: At the people's request he sent birds, and gave them the bread of heaven for food.
sentences.susu: E to a maxandi, a naxa fa kɔnkɔlɛe ra e bɛ, naxan findixi koore baloe ra e bɛ.

sentences.english: His hand made the rock open, and the waters came streaming out; they went down through the dry places like a river.
sentences.susu: A naxa fanye rabi, a ye ramini e bɛ, alɔ xure naxan ɲɛrɛma gbengberen yire tagi.

sentences.english: For he kept in mind his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.
sentences.susu: Ala to ratu a xa laayidi sɛniyɛnxi ma, a naxan tongo a xa konyi di Iburahima bɛ,

sentences.english: And he took his people out with joy, the men of his selection with glad cries:
sentences.susu: a naxa a xa ɲama ramini sɛɛwɛ kui, a a ragiri a xa mixi sugandixie xa ɲɛlɛxin bɛɛti ba.

sentences.english: And gave them the lands of the nations; and they took the work of the peoples for a heritage;
sentences.susu: A naxa si gbɛtɛe xa bɔxi fi e ma, ɲamanɛe xa naafuli naxa findi e gbe ra,

sentences.english: So that they might keep his orders, and be true to his laws. Give praise to the Lord.
sentences.susu: alako e xa Ala xui suxu, e xa a xa yaamarie rabatu. Wo xa Alatala matɔxɔ!

sentences.english: Let the Lord be praised. O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Alatala matɔxɔ. Wo xa a tantu barima a fan, a xa xanunteya buma abadan.

sentences.english: Who is able to give an account of the great acts of the Lord, or to make clear all his praise?
sentences.susu: Nde Alatala xa wali xungbe masenma, nde a xa matɔxɔɛ bama?

sentences.english: Happy are they whose decisions are upright, and he who does righteousness at all times.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ na tinxintɔɛe bɛ, naxee birama tinxinyi fɔxɔ ra lɔxɔɛ birin.

sentences.english: Keep me in mind, O Lord, when you are good to your people; O let your salvation come to me;
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa ratu n ma i hinnɛma i xa ɲama ra tɛmui naxɛ, i na e rakisi, i xa n fan mali,

sentences.english: So that I may see the well-being of the people of your selection, and have a part in the joy of your nation, and take pride in your heritage.
sentences.susu: alako n xa i xa mixi sugandixie xa hɛri sɔtɔ, n xa sɛɛwa i xa ɲama ra, n xa ɲɛlɛxin i kɛ tongomae ya ma.

sentences.english: We are sinners like our fathers, we have done wrong, our acts are evil.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara yunubi raba alɔ muxu benbae, muxu bara fe kobie raba ɲaaxuɲa kui.

sentences.english: Our fathers did not give thought to your wonders in Egypt; they did not keep in memory the great number of your mercies, but gave you cause for wrath at the sea, even at the Red Sea.
sentences.susu: Muxu benbae to nu na Misira bɔxi ma, e mu e ɲɔxɔ sa i xa kaabanakoe xɔn ma, e mu ratu i xa xanunteya ma. E naxa e kobe raso i ra Xulunyumi baa fɛ ma.

sentences.english: But he was their saviour because of his name, so that men might see his great power.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a naxa e rakisi a xili xa fe ra, alako a xa a sɛnbɛ masen.

sentences.english: By his word the Red Sea was made dry: and he took them through the deep waters as through the waste land.
sentences.susu: A to xaaɲɛ Xulunyumi baa ma, a naxa xɔri, e naxa a igiri a xaraxi ra.

sentences.english: And he took them safely out of the hands of their haters, and kept them from the attacks of those who were against them.
sentences.susu: A naxa e rakisi e xɔnmixie bɛlɛxɛ i, a e xunsara e yaxuie bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And the waters went over their haters; all of them came to an end.
sentences.susu: Ye naxa dusu e yaxuie xun na, hali mixi keren a mu kisi.

sentences.english: Then they had faith in his words; they gave him songs of praise.
sentences.susu: Na kui e naxa la a xa masenyi ra, e a matɔxɔ bɛɛti ra.

sentences.english: But their memory of his works was short; not waiting to be guided by him,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a mu bu, e man naxa nɛɛmu a xa walie ma, e tondi a waxɔnfe rabade.

sentences.english: They gave way to their evil desires in the waste land, and put God to the test in the dry places.
sentences.susu: E naxa bira e yɛtɛ waxɔnfe fɔxɔ ra gbengberenyi ma, e Alatala mato.

sentences.english: And he gave them their request, but sent a wasting disease into their souls.
sentences.susu: A naxa e waxɔnse so e yi ra, kɔnɔ na dangi xanbi, a naxa e raɲɔn.

sentences.english: They were full of envy against Moses among the tents, and against Aaron, the holy one of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ala xa ɲama naxa Munsa nun Haruna tɔɔnɛ, naxee findixi Alatala xa konyi sɛniyɛnxie ra.

sentences.english: The earth opening put an end to Dathan, covering up Abiram and his band.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi naxa a rabi, a Datan nun Abirami xa mixie ragoro a kui.

sentences.english: And a fire was lighted among their tents; the sinners were burned up by the flames.
sentences.susu: Tɛ naxa e fɔxirabirɛ ɲaaxie gan.

sentences.english: They made a young ox in Horeb, and gave worship to an image of gold.
sentences.susu: E naxa ninge misaali yailan wure ra, e a batu kuye ra.

sentences.english: And their glory was changed into the image of an ox, whose food is grass.
sentences.susu: Ninge naxan sɛxɛ donma, e naxa na misaali findi e Marigi Alatala ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: They had no memory of God their saviour, who had done great things in Egypt;
sentences.susu: E naxa nɛɛmu e Rakisima Ala ma, naxan fe xungbee raba Misira,

sentences.english: Works of wonder in the land of Ham, and things of fear by the Red Sea.
sentences.susu: naxan kaabanakoee raba Hami bɔxi ma, naxan fe magaaxuxie raba Xulunyumi baa ma.

sentences.english: And he was purposing to put an end to them if Moses, his special servant, had not gone up before him, between him and his people, turning back his wrath, to keep them from destruction.
sentences.susu: Ala nu wama e sɔntɔfe, kɔnɔ a xa mixi sugandixi Munsa naxa a maxandi, a xa a xa xɔnɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ lu na.

sentences.english: They were disgusted with the good land; they had no belief in his word;
sentences.susu: E naxa tondi a xa bɔxi fanyi suxude, e mu la a xa laayidi ra.

sentences.english: Talking against him secretly in their tents, they did not give ear to the voice of the Lord.
sentences.susu: E naxa ti Alatala kanke e xa kiri banxie kui, e mu a xui suxu.

sentences.english: So he made an oath against them, to put an end to them in the waste land:
sentences.susu: Na kui a naxa laayidi tongo e bɛ, a xa e faxa gbengberenyi ma,

sentences.english: That their children might be mixed among the nations, and sent away into other lands.
sentences.susu: a xa e bɔnsɔɛ faxa ɲamanɛe tagi, a xa e rayensen duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: And they were joined to Baal-peor, and took part in the offerings to the dead.
sentences.susu: E naxa Bali Peyori batu, e sɛrɛxɛ sube don naxan baxi mixi faxaxie bɛ.

sentences.english: So they made him angry by their behaviour; and he sent disease on them.
sentences.susu: E naxa Ala raxɔnɔ e xa fe kobie ra, han a naxa fure ɲaaxi nde ragoro e ma.

sentences.english: Then Phinehas got up, and made prayer for them; and the disease went no farther.
sentences.susu: Finexasi to keli, a naxa Ala maxandi e bɛ, fure ɲaaxi naxa ba e ra.

sentences.english: And all the generations coming after him kept the memory of his righteousness for ever.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxa na tinxinyi kolon a bɛ abadan.

sentences.english: They made God angry again at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled because of them;
sentences.susu: Alatala xa ɲama naxa a raxɔnɔ Meriba xure fɛ ma. Annabi Munsa naxa tɔɔrɔ e xa fe ra,

sentences.english: For they made his spirit bitter, and he said unwise things.
sentences.susu: a to wɔyɛn xɔrɔxɔɛ fala e xa Ala matandi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: They did not put an end to the peoples, as the Lord had said;
sentences.susu: E mu Kanaan sie sɔntɔ alɔ Alatala e yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But they were joined to the nations, learning their works.
sentences.susu: E naxa sabati e ya ma, e bira e naamunyie fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And they gave worship to images; which were a danger to them:
sentences.susu: E naxa nee xa kuyee batu, na fa findi gantanyi ra e bɛ.

sentences.english: They even made offerings of their sons and their daughters to evil spirits,
sentences.susu: E naxa e xa di xɛmɛe nun e xa di ginɛ ba sɛrɛxɛ ra ɲinnɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: And gave the blood of their sons and their daughters who had done no wrong, offering them to the images of Canaan; and the land was made unclean with blood.
sentences.susu: E to e xa die faxa sɛrɛxɛ ra Kanaan xa kuyee bɛ, e naxa bɔxi findi bɔxi sɛniyɛntare ra.

sentences.english: So they became unclean through their works, going after their evil desires.
sentences.susu: E e yɛtɛ findi mixi sɛniyɛntare ra na ki nɛ, e e Marigi yanfa.

sentences.english: Then the wrath of the Lord was burning against his people, and he was angry with his heritage.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala naxa xɔnɔ a xa ɲama ma, a kɛ tongomae mu rafanxi a ma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And he gave them into the hands of the nations; and they were ruled by their haters.
sentences.susu: A naxa e rabolo si gbɛtɛe yi ra, e yaxuie naxa e yamari.

sentences.english: By them they were crushed, and made low under their hands.
sentences.susu: E yaxuie naxa nɔ e ra, e fa lu e sɛnbɛ bun ma.

sentences.english: Again and again he made them free; but their hearts were turned against his purpose, and they were overcome by their sins.
sentences.susu: Sanya wuyaxi Ala naxa e rakisi, kɔnɔ e mu gbilen a matandife ra. Na kui e naxa lɔɛ e xa yunubie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: But when their cry came to his ears, he had pity on their trouble:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala naxa e tɔɔrɛ to, a naxa e wa xui mɛ.

sentences.english: And kept in mind his agreement with them, and in his great mercy gave them forgiveness.
sentences.susu: A naxa ratu a xa saatɛ ma, a kinikini e ma a xa xanunteya tilinxi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: He put pity into the hearts of those who made them prisoners.
sentences.susu: A naxa a niya mixie xa kinikini e ma konyiya kui.

sentences.english: Be our saviour, O Lord our God, and let us come back together from among the nations, so that we may give honour to your holy name, and have glory in your praise.
sentences.susu: Muxu Marigi Alatala, muxu rakisi. I xa muxu ramini sie tagi, alako muxu xa i xili sɛniyɛnxi tantu, muxu xa sɛɛwa i matɔxɔfe ra.

sentences.english: Praise be to the Lord God of Israel for ever and for ever; and let all the people say, So be it. Give praise to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Tantui na Isirayila Marigi Alatala bɛ abadan! Ɲama birin xa a fala: «Amina!» Wo xa Ala matɔxɔ!

sentences.english: O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala tantu, barima a fan, a xa xanunteya buma abadan!

sentences.english: Let those whose cause the Lord has taken up say so, his people whom he has taken out of the hands of their haters;
sentences.susu: Alatala naxan xun sara, a naxee baxi e yaxuie yi ra,

sentences.english: Making them come together out of all the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.
sentences.susu: a naxee raminixi sie tagi sogetede nun sogegorode mabiri, a naxee faxi kelife kɔɔla nun baa mabiri, e birin xa Alatala tantu.

sentences.english: They were wandering in the waste places; they saw no way to a resting-place.
sentences.susu: Ndee lɔɛxi gbengberenyi ma, e mu sabatide yo toxi.

sentences.english: Their souls became feeble for need of food and drink.
sentences.susu: Kaamɛ nun ye xɔli nu e halakima, limaniya naxa ba e yi.

sentences.english: Then they sent up their cry to the Lord in their sorrow, and he gave them salvation out of all their troubles;
sentences.susu: E to e dɛ rawa Alatala bɛ e xa tɔɔrɛ kui, a naxa e fulun e xa ɲaxankatɛ ma.

sentences.english: Guiding them in the right way, so that they might come into the town of their resting-place.
sentences.susu: A naxa e raɲɛrɛ kira tinxinxi nde xɔn ma, alako e xa yire fanyi to e sabatima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Let men give praise to the Lord for his mercy, and for the wonders which he does for the children of men!
sentences.susu: E xa Alatala tantu a xa xanunteya xa fe ra, nun a xa kaabanakoee xa fe ra a naxan nabaxi adamadie bɛ,

sentences.english: He gives its desire to the unresting soul, so that it is full of good things.
sentences.susu: barima a ye xɔli bama mixie ma, a kaamɛtɔɛe rawasama donse fanyie ra.

sentences.english: Those who were in the dark, in the black night, in chains of sorrow and iron;
sentences.susu: Ndee nu sabatixi dimi kui nun faxɛ xa nɔɛ bun ma, geeli xɔrɔxɔɛ kui, yɔlɔnxɔnyi mabalanxi e ma.

sentences.english: Because they went against the words of God, and gave no thought to the laws of the Most High:
sentences.susu: Barima e muruta nɛ Ala xa masenyi xili ma, e Ala xa marasi xɔn.

sentences.english: So that he made their hearts weighted down with grief; they were falling, and had no helper.
sentences.susu: A naxa e bɔɲɛ mafiixɛ tɔɔrɛ ra. E naxa dagalan yɛ, mixi yo mu e mali.

sentences.english: Then they sent up their cry to the Lord in their sorrow, and he gave them salvation out of all their troubles.
sentences.susu: E naxa Marigi maxandi nimisɛ kui, a naxa e rakisi e xa ɲaxankatɛ ma.

sentences.english: He took them out of the dark and the black night, and all their chains were broken.
sentences.susu: A naxa e ramini dimi kui nun faxɛ xa nɔɛ bunma, a naxa luutie bolon e nu xirixi naxee ra.

sentences.english: Let men give praise to the Lord for his mercy, and for the wonders which he does for the children of men!
sentences.susu: E xa Marigi batu a xa dugutɛgɛɲa xa fe ra, nun a xa wali makaabaxie xa fe ra adamadie bɛ.

sentences.english: The doors of brass are broken by his arm, and the bands of iron are cut in two.
sentences.susu: Barima a bara wure naadɛe wuru, a kondonyie kana.

sentences.english: Foolish men, because of their sins, and because of their wrongdoing, are troubled;
sentences.susu: Xaxilitaree nu bara e yɛtɛ suxu e xa murutɛ nun e xa fe ɲaaxie ra, e lu nimisɛ kui.

sentences.english: They are disgusted by all food, and they come near to the doors of death.
sentences.susu: Donse birin bara nu raɲaaxu e ma, e nu fa na faxɛ nan dɛi.

sentences.english: Then they send up their cry to the Lord in their sorrow, and he gives them salvation out of all their troubles.
sentences.susu: E xa na xɔrɔrɔɛ kui, e naxa e xui rate Alatala ma, a naxa e rakisi e xa xɔrɔrɔɛ ma.

sentences.english: He sent his word and made them well, and kept them safe from the underworld.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa masenyi rasanba e ma, a e rayalan, a e ba e xa ɲaxankatɛ kui.

sentences.english: Let men give praise to the Lord for his mercy, and for the wonders which he does for the children of men!
sentences.susu: E xa Marigi tantu a xa dugutɛgɛɲa nun a xa wali makaabaxie xa fe ra adamadie bɛ.

sentences.english: Let them make offerings of praise, giving news of his works with cries of joy.
sentences.susu: E xa sɛrɛxɛe ba a xa wali fanyie kolon fe ra a bɛ. E man xa a xa wali fanyie ifala e xui itexi ra sɛɛwɛ kui!

sentences.english: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in the great waters;
sentences.susu: Naxee nu biyaasima kunkui xungbee kui baa ma, e man nu yulɛya raba yee xun ma,

sentences.english: They see the works of the Lord, and his wonders in the deep.
sentences.susu: nee bara Marigi wali fɔxie nun a xa wali makaabaxie to baa ma.

sentences.english: For at his word comes up the storm-wind, lifting high the waves.
sentences.susu: A naxa masenyi ti, turunnaadɛ foye naxa keli a mɔrɔnyie ramaxa,

sentences.english: The sailors go up to heaven, and down into the deep; their souls are wasted because of their trouble.
sentences.susu: a nu biyaasilae xa kunkui ite a nu a sin, e nu na ɲaxankatɛ kui.

sentences.english: They are turned here and there, rolling like a man who is full of wine; and all their wisdom comes to nothing.
sentences.susu: E xun naxa magi a ra e naxa lu alɔ siisilae. E xa xaxilimaya birin naxa lu e ma fu.

sentences.english: Then they send up their cry to the Lord in their sorrow, and he gives them salvation out of all their troubles.
sentences.susu: E xa nimisɛ kui e naxa Marigi xili e xui itexi ra, a naxa e ratanga na gbaloe ma.

sentences.english: He makes the storm into a calm, so that the waves are at peace.
sentences.susu: A naxa turunnaadɛ foye iti, a a masabari, mɔrɔnyie naxa e raxara.

sentences.english: Then they are glad, because the sea is quiet, and he takes them to the harbour of their desire.
sentences.susu: E naxa sɛɛwa nee xa maraxarɛ ra, a naxa e xunti e waxɔnde ra.

sentences.english: Let men give praise to the Lord for his mercy, and for the wonders which he does for the children of men!
sentences.susu: E xa Marigi tantu a xa dugutɛgɛɲa nun a wali makaabaxie xa fe ra adamadie bɛ!

sentences.english: Let them give glory to him in the meeting of the people, and praise among the chiefs.
sentences.susu: E xa a xa fe gbo ɲama bɛ, e xa a matɔxɔ Forie xa malanyi!

sentences.english: He makes rivers into waste places, and springs of water into a dry land;
sentences.susu: A xure xungbee masarama gbengberenyi ra, a dulonyi findi bɔxi maxare ra.

sentences.english: He makes a fertile country into a salt waste, because of the sins of those who are living there.
sentences.susu: A bɔxi fanyi findima fɔxɔɛ yire ra, na bɔxikae xa fe ɲaaxi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: He makes a waste land into a place of water, and a dry land into water-springs.
sentences.susu: A gbengberenyi findima xure ra a yire maxare findi xure guli ra,

sentences.english: And there he gives the poor a resting-place, so that they may make themselves a town;
sentences.susu: a kaamɛtɔɛe rasabati naa, e taa ti naa e sabatide.

sentences.english: And put seed in the fields and make vine-gardens, to give them fruit.
sentences.susu: E xɛ sama, e wuri bilie sima naxee bogi barakama.

sentences.english: He gives them his blessing so that they are increased greatly, and their cattle do not become less.
sentences.susu: A dubama e bɛ, e wuya, a mu sese bama e xa xuruse kɔnti ra.

sentences.english: And when they are made low, and crushed by trouble and sorrow,
sentences.susu: Ndee gbee xurunma, tɔɔrɛ nun ɲaxankatɛ ra.

sentences.english: He puts an end to the pride of kings, and sends them wandering in the waste lands where there is no way.
sentences.susu: A maraɲaaxui dusuma forie xun na, a e ralɔɛ gbengberenyi ma kirae mu dɛnnaxɛ ma,

sentences.english: But he puts the poor man on high from his troubles, and gives him families like a flock.
sentences.susu: A misikiinɛe bama tɔɔrɛ kui, a e xa denbayae rawuya alɔ xurusee.

sentences.english: The upright see it and are glad: the mouth of the sinner is stopped.
sentences.susu: Mixi tinxinxie na toma e ɲɛlɛxinma a ra, Kɔnɔ tinxintaree birin dɛ balanma nɛ.

sentences.english: Let the wise give thought to these things, and see the mercies of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Xaxilima naxan na, a xa a ɲɔxɔ sa yi fe birin xɔnma, a xa Marigi xa dugutɛgɛɲa fahaamu.

sentences.english: O God, my heart is fixed; I will make songs and melody, even with my glory.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti

sentences.english: Give out your sounds, O corded instruments: the dawn will be awaking with my song.
sentences.susu: Ala, n bara natɛ tongo n bɔɲɛ kui. N Marigi Xunnakeli Kanyi, n n xui raminima nɛ bɛɛtie ra.

sentences.english: I will give you praise, O Lord, among the peoples; I will make melody to you among the nations.
sentences.susu: N n ma kɔrae nun n ma maxasee berema nɛ subaxɛ ma.

sentences.english: For your mercy is higher than the heavens: and your unchanging faith than the clouds.
sentences.susu: N Marigi, n i batuma nɛ sie tagi, n i matɔxɔma nɛ bɛɛti ra ɲamanɛe ya ma,

sentences.english: Be lifted up, O God, higher than the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.
sentences.susu: barima i xa dugutɛgɛɲa gbo dangi koore ra, i xa xanunteya ite alɔ nuxuie.

sentences.english: Let your right hand be stretched out for salvation, and give me an answer, so that your loved ones may be safe from danger.
sentences.susu: Ala, i xunyi rakeli koore ma, i xa nɔrɛ xa lu bɔxi birin xun ma,

sentences.english: This is the word of the holy God: I will be glad; I will make Shechem a heritage, measuring out the valley of Succoth.
sentences.susu: alako i xanuntenyie xa kisi i sɛnbɛ saabui ra. Yandi, n ma duba suxu.

sentences.english: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is the strength of my head; Judah is my law-giver;
sentences.susu: Ala bara wɔyɛn a xa lingira sɛniyɛnxi kui, «N n xun nakelima nɛ, n Sikemi bɔxi itaxun, n Sukɔti gulunba sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: Moab is my washpot; on Edom is the resting-place of my shoe; over Philistia will I send out a glad cry.
sentences.susu: N gbe nan Galadi ra, n gbe nan Manasi ra. Efirami bɔxi tan luma nɛ alɔ n xun makantase, Yudaya findi n ma munyaati ra.

sentences.english: Who will take me into the strong town? who will be my guide into Edom?
sentences.susu: N n sanyi maxama Mowaba bɔxi ma, n n ma sankiri wolima Edon nan ma a xa findi n gbe ra. N gere ti xui mɛma nɛ Filisita bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: Have you not sent us away from you, O God? and you go not out with our armies.
sentences.susu: «Nde n xun tima taa makantaxi ra? Nde n xaninma Edon bɔxi ma?

sentences.english: Give us help in our trouble; for there is no help in man.
sentences.susu: Ala mu a ra, naxan muxu rabɛɲinxi gere kui?

sentences.english: With God we will do great things; for by him will our haters be crushed underfoot.
sentences.susu: I xa fa muxu malide, i xa muxu ba muxu yaxuie yi ra. Adamadie xa mali fufafu na a ra.

sentences.english: God of my praise, let my prayer be answered;
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ N Marigi Ala, n naxan matɔxɔma, i naxa lu dundui kui,

sentences.english: For the mouth of the sinner is open against me in deceit: his tongue has said false things against me.
sentences.susu: barima mixi ɲaaxie na wule falafe n xun ma. E dɛ mu fan, e wule fala tun.

sentences.english: Words of hate are round about me; they have made war against me without cause.
sentences.susu: E na n nabilinfe xɔnnanteya wɔyɛnyie ra, hali n mu fe ɲaaxi yo rabaxi e ra.

sentences.english: For my love they give me back hate; but I have given myself to prayer.
sentences.susu: N na fe fanyi raba e bɛ, e n gere. N a ragbilenma i tan Ala nan ma.

sentences.english: They have put on me evil for good; hate in exchange for my love.
sentences.susu: E n ma wali fanyi sare ragbilenma n ma a kobi ra, n ma xanunteya, e na masarama n bɛ xɔnnanteya ra.

sentences.english: Put an evil man over him; and let one be placed at his right hand to say evil of him.
sentences.susu: I xa na tɔɔɲɛgɛtɔɛ taxu mixi kobi nde ra, a dɛfanboore xa a yanfa.

sentences.english: When he is judged, let the decision go against him; and may his prayer become sin.
sentences.susu: A na makiiti, kiiti xa kana a ra. I naxa a xa maxandi suxu.

sentences.english: Let his life be short; let another take his position of authority.
sentences.susu: A xa simaya xa dunke kɔti. Mixi gbɛtɛ xa a xa wali tongo.

sentences.english: Let his children have no father, and his wife be made a widow.
sentences.susu: A xa die xa findi kiridie ra, a xa ginɛ xa findi kaaɲɛ ra.

sentences.english: Let his children be wanderers, looking to others for their food; let them be sent away from the company of their friends.
sentences.susu: A xa die xa findi ɲɛrɛtie ra naxee kulɛ matima tun. E xa makuya e baride ra naxan bara kana.

sentences.english: Let his creditor take all his goods; and let others have the profit of his work.
sentences.susu: Donifa xa a kɛ birin tongo, a xa geeni birin xa findi si gbɛtɛe gbe ra.

sentences.english: Let no man have pity on him, or give help to his children when he is dead.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo naxa kinikini a ma, mixi yo naxa hinnɛ a xa kiridie ra.

sentences.english: Let his seed be cut off; in the coming generation let their name go out of memory.
sentences.susu: A bɔnsɔɛ xa sɔntɔ, e xilie xa nɛɛmu mixie ra.

sentences.english: Let the Lord keep in mind the wrongdoing of his fathers; and may the sin of his mother have no forgiveness.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa ratu a xa fe kobie ma, a nga xa yunubi naxa xafari.

sentences.english: Let them be ever before the eyes of the Lord, so that the memory of them may be cut off from the earth.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa ratu na yunubie ma tɛmui birin, a xa e xa fe ranɛɛmu duniɲa ra,

sentences.english: Because he had no mercy, but was cruel to the low and the poor, designing the death of the broken-hearted.
sentences.susu: barima e mu dugutɛgɛɲa rakamalima, e misikiinɛe nun fuxarilae tɔɔrɔma, han e faxa sunnunyi kui.

sentences.english: As he took pleasure in cursing, so let it come on him; and as he had no delight in blessing, let it be far from him.
sentences.susu: Naxan mixi dankama, na kanyi xa dankɛ sɔtɔ. Naxan dubama mixie bɛ, a xa barakɛ sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: He put on cursing like a robe, and it has come into his body like water, and into his bones like oil.
sentences.susu: Dankɛ xa ragoro a ma alɔ a donma ragoroma a ma ki naxɛ. A xa so a fate i alɔ ye, a xa so a xɔrie alɔ ture.

sentences.english: Let it be to him as a robe which he puts on, let it be like a band which is round him at all times.
sentences.susu: A xa lu a ma alɔ a xa sose luma a ma ki naxɛ, a xa bilin a ma alɔ a bɛlɛti bilinma a tagi ki naxɛ tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Let this be the reward given to my haters from the Lord, and to those who say evil of my soul.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa na sare fi n ma yaxuie bɛ, naxee fe kobi falama n xun ma.

sentences.english: But, O Lord God, give me your help, because of your name; take me out of danger, because your mercy is good.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan n Marigi Alatala, i xa hinnɛ n na i xili xa fe ra, i xa n nakisi i xa dugutɛgɛɲa fanyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: For I am poor and in need, and my heart is wounded in me.
sentences.susu: N luxi nɛ alɔ misikiinɛ fuxarila, naxan bɔɲɛ na tɔɔrɔfe ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: I am gone like the shade when it is stretched out: I am forced out of my place like a locust.
sentences.susu: N ma fe ɲɔnfe alɔ niini naxan kuyama nunmare ra. Mixi n kerima alɔ katoe kerima ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: My knees are feeble for need of food; there is no fat on my bones.
sentences.susu: N xinbie sɛrɛnma, n fate ɲɔnma, sunyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: As for me, they make sport of me; shaking their heads when they see me.
sentences.susu: E n nayaagima tɛmui birin. E na n to, e yoma n ma tun.

sentences.english: Give me help, O Lord my God; in your mercy be my saviour;
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, i xa n mali, i xa n nakisi i xa dugutɛgɛɲa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: So that they may see that it is the work of your hand; that you, Lord, have done it.
sentences.susu: E xa a kolon, i sɛnbɛ na n malife.

sentences.english: They may give curses but you give blessing; when they come up against me, put them to shame; but let your servant be glad.
sentences.susu: E tan n dankama, kɔnɔ i barakɛ nan fima n ma. Yaagi fama nɛ dusude e xun na, kɔnɔ n tan i xa konyi di, n sɛɛwama nɛ.

sentences.english: Let my haters be clothed with shame, covering themselves with shame as with a robe.
sentences.susu: N yaxuie xa ifu, e xa yaagi xa dusu e xun na.

sentences.english: I will give the Lord great praise with my mouth; yes, I will give praise to him among all the people.
sentences.susu: N Alatala tantuma nɛ n xui itexi ra, n a matɔxɔma nɛ ɲama ya ma,

sentences.english: For he is ever at the right hand of the poor, to take him out of the hands of those who go after his soul.
sentences.susu: barima a tixi misikiinɛ sɛɛti ma, a xa e ratanga mixie ma naxee wama e faxafe.

sentences.english: The Lord said to my lord, Be seated at my right hand, till I put all those who are against you under your feet.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi n marigi bɛ: «I magoro n yifanyi ma, han n xa i sanyi ti i yaxuie fari.»

sentences.english: The Lord will send out the rod of your strength from Zion; be king over your haters.
sentences.susu: Alatala i sɛnbɛ ragboma nɛ kelife Siyoni, han i i yaxuie yamari.

sentences.english: Your people give themselves gladly in the day of your power; like the dew of the morning on the holy mountains is the army of your young men.
sentences.susu: I xa sɔɔrie luma nɛ i fɔxɔ ra gere kui. Na kuye na iba subaxɛ ma, i sɛnbɛ gboma nɛ sɛniyɛnyi kui alɔ i fonike waxati.
