sentences.english: The Lord has made an oath, and will not take it back. You are a priest for ever, after the order of Melchizedek.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a kali yi laayidi ra, naxan mu kanama: «N bara i findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra abadan, a Melekisedeki daaxi.»

sentences.english: In the day of his wrath kings will be wounded by the Lord at your right hand.
sentences.susu: Marigi luma i yifanyi ma, a mangɛe kanama nɛ a xa xɔnɛ lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: He will be judge among the nations, the valleys will be full of dead bodies; the head over a great country will be wounded by him.
sentences.susu: A a xa kiiti raɲɛrɛma nɛ ɲamanɛe fari, a e sɔntɔ, a mangɛ xungbe nde xun nakana.

sentences.english: He will take of the stream by the way; so his head will be lifted up.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xure ye minma kira i. A xun nakelima na nan ma.

sentences.english: Let the Lord be praised. I will give praise to the Lord with all my heart, among the upright, and in the meeting of the people.
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala matɔxɔ! N Alatala batuma nɛ n bɔɲɛ birin na, tinxintɔɛe nun ɲama ya ma.

sentences.english: The works of the Lord are great, searched out by all those who have delight in them.
sentences.susu: Marigi xa walie makaaba. E rafan mixie ma naxee tinma e matode.

sentences.english: His work is full of honour and glory; and his righteousness is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: A xa walie nɔrɔxi, a xa tinxinyi buma nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: Certain for ever is the memory of his wonders: the Lord is full of pity and mercy.
sentences.susu: A a niya birin xa ratu a xa kaabanakoe ma. Alatala hinnɛma adamadie ra, a kinikini e ma.

sentences.english: He has given food to his worshippers; he will keep his agreement in mind for ever.
sentences.susu: A baloe fima mixi ma naxan gaaxuma a ya ra, a ratu a xa saatɛ ma abadan.

sentences.english: He has made clear to his people the power of his works, giving them the heritage of the nations.
sentences.susu: A bara a xa wali sɛnbɛ masen a xa ɲama bɛ, ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛe kɛ sofe ra e yi.

sentences.english: The works of his hands are faith and righteousness; all his laws are unchanging.
sentences.susu: A walima nɔndi nun tinxinyi nan fari. A xa yaamarie findima sɛriyɛ fanyi nan na,

sentences.english: They are fixed for ever and ever, they are done in faith and righteousness.
sentences.susu: naxee mu kanama abadan, adamadie lanma e xa naxee rakamali.

sentences.english: He has sent salvation to his people; he has given his word for ever: holy is his name and greatly to be feared.
sentences.susu: A bara a xa ɲama xun sara, a bara a xa saatɛ mabanban abadan. A xili sɛniyɛn, a magaaxu.

sentences.english: The fear of the Lord is the best part of wisdom: all those who keep his laws are wise: his praise is eternal.
sentences.susu: Xaxilimaya fɔlɔma Alatala yaragaaxui nan ma. Mixi naxan gaaxuma Ala ya ra, a xaxili fanyi sɔtɔma nɛ. Adamadie lanma e xa a matɔxɔ abadan.

sentences.english: Let the Lord be praised. Happy is the man who gives honour to the Lord, and has great delight in his laws.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Ala matɔxɔ! Hɛɛri na mixi bɛ naxan gaaxuma Marigi ya ra, naxan tinma a xa yaamarie rabatude.

sentences.english: His seed will be strong on the earth; blessings will be on the generation of the upright.
sentences.susu: A bɔnsɔɛ sɛnbɛ gboma nɛ bɔxi ma. Barakɛ luma tinxintɔɛ nan ma.

sentences.english: A store of wealth will be in his house, and his righteousness will be for ever.
sentences.susu: Naafuli nun bannaya luma a yi ra, a xa tinxinyi xanxi abadan.

sentences.english: For the upright there is a light shining in the dark; he is full of grace and pity.
sentences.susu: Yanbɛ minima dimi kui tinxintɔɛ bɛ, naxan kinikinima a boore ma, naxan hinnɛma adamadie ra, naxan luma ɲɛrɛ ra tinxinyi kui.

sentences.english: All is well for the man who is kind and gives freely to others; he will make good his cause when he is judged.
sentences.susu: Barakɛ luma mixi bɛ naxan mixie kima, naxan tinma mixi donide, naxan walima tinxinyi ra.

sentences.english: He will not ever be moved; the memory of the upright will be living for ever.
sentences.susu: Na kanyi mu birama, mixie mu nɛɛmuma a xa tinxinyi ma.

sentences.english: He will have no fear of evil news; his heart is fixed, for his hope is in the Lord.
sentences.susu: A mu gaaxuma xibaaru ɲaaxi ya ra, barima a xaxili tixi Alatala ra, a bɔɲɛ xanxi.

sentences.english: His heart is resting safely, he will have no fear, till he sees trouble come on his haters.
sentences.susu: A bɔɲɛ raxara, gaaxui yo mu a ma. A raɲɔnyi, a nɔma nɛ a yaxuie ra.

sentences.english: He has given with open hands to the poor; his righteousness is for ever; his horn will be lifted up with honour.
sentences.susu: A misikiinɛ kima, a ɲɛrɛma tinxinyi kui tɛmui birin, a xun nakelima tun.

sentences.english: The sinner will see it with grief; he will be wasted away with envy; the desire of the evil-doers will come to nothing.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxi tɔɔrɔma na tofe ra, a a ɲinyi maxinma, a xa fe xun nakanama. Mixi ɲaaxie xa natɛ mu kamalima fefe ma.

sentences.english: Let the Lord be praised. O you servants of the Lord, give praise to the name of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala matɔxɔ! Alatala xa konyi die, wo xa a matɔxɔ. Wo Alatala xili matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: Let blessing be on the name of the Lord, from this time and for ever.
sentences.susu: Tantui na Alatala bɛ abadan.

sentences.english: From the coming up of the sun to its going down, the Lord's name is to be praised.
sentences.susu: Tantui na Alatala bɛ yire birin, kelife sogetede mabiri, han sogegorode.

sentences.english: The Lord is high over all nations, and his glory is higher than the heavens.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa nɔɛ na ɲamanɛe xun ma, a xa nɔrɛ na koore ma.

sentences.english: Who is like the Lord our God, who is seated on high,
sentences.susu: Nde maniyɛ won Marigi Alatala ra, naxan magoroxi a xa kibanyi kui koore ma,

sentences.english: Looking down on the heavens, and on the earth?
sentences.susu: naxan a ya ragoroma koore nun bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: He takes the poor man out of the dust, lifting him up from his low position;
sentences.susu: A misikiinɛ xun nakelima, a tɔɔrɔmixi bama a xa setareɲa kui.

sentences.english: To give him a place among the rulers, even with the rulers of his people.
sentences.susu: A a tima a xa kuntigie sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: He gives the unfertile woman a family, making her a happy mother of children. Give praise to the Lord.
sentences.susu: A di gbegbe fima ginɛ dibaritare ma, alako a xa sɛɛwa sɔtɔ a xa die ya ma. Wo Alatala matɔxɔ!

sentences.english: When Israel came out of Egypt, the children of Jacob from a people whose language was strange to them;
sentences.susu: Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ naxan findixi Isirayila ra, e naxa mini Misira xa konyiya ra,

sentences.english: Judah became his holy place, and Israel his kingdom.
sentences.susu: e sabati Yudaya Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira luxi dɛnnaxɛ. Isirayila bɔxi naxa findi Ala xa mangɛya ra.

sentences.english: The sea saw it, and went in flight; Jordan was turned back.
sentences.susu: Xulunyumi baa to Isirayila ɲama to, a naxa rabi mafuren. Yurudɛn xure to e to fa ra, a man naxa kira fi e ma.

sentences.english: The mountains were jumping like goats, and the little hills like lambs.
sentences.susu: Isirayila geyae to e to, e naxa tugan tugan ɲɛlɛxinyi ra, alɔ yɛxɛɛ kontonyie nun yɛxɛɛ yɔrɛe tuganma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: What was wrong with you, O sea, that you went in flight? O Jordan, that you were turned back?
sentences.susu: Munse a niyaxi na baa xa rabi mafuren? Munse a niyaxi Yurudɛn xure kira fixi e ma?

sentences.english: You mountains, why were you jumping like goats, and you little hills like lambs?
sentences.susu: Munse a niyaxi Isirayila geyae xa ɲɛlɛxin alɔ yɛxɛɛ kontonyie nun yɛxɛe yɔrɛe?

sentences.english: Be troubled, O earth, before the Lord, before the God of Jacob;
sentences.susu: Duniɲa birin xa sɛrɛn Marigi ya ra, naxan findi Yaxuba Marigi Ala ra,

sentences.english: Who made the rock into a water-spring, and the hard stone into a fountain.
sentences.susu: naxan ye dulonyi ramini fanye xɔrɔxɔɛ kui.

sentences.english: Not to us, O Lord, not to us, but to your name let glory be given, because of your mercy and your unchanging faith.
sentences.susu: Matɔxɔɛ mu lanma muxu tan bɛ, matɔxɔɛ lanma Alatala nan bɛ, a xa hinnɛ nun dugutɛgɛɲa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Why may the nations say, Where is now their God?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra ɲamanɛe a falama, «E xa Ala na minden?»

sentences.english: But our God is in heaven: he has done whatever was pleasing to him.
sentences.susu: Muxu Marigi Ala na koore ma, a a waxɔnfe birin nabama.

sentences.english: Their images are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e xa kuyee yailanxi xɛɛma nun gbeti nan na, e yɛtɛ bɛlɛxɛe saabui ra.

sentences.english: They have mouths, but no voice; they have eyes, but they see not;
sentences.susu: Dɛ na e bɛ, kɔnɔ e mu wɔyɛnma, ya na e bɛ, kɔnɔ e mu se toma,

sentences.english: They have ears, but no hearing; they have noses, but no sense of smell;
sentences.susu: tuli na e bɛ, kɔnɔ e mu xui mɛma, ɲɔɛ na e bɛ, kɔnɔ e mu se xiri mɛma.

sentences.english: They have hands without feeling, and feet without power of walking; and no sound comes from their throat.
sentences.susu: Bɛlɛxɛ na e bɛ, kɔnɔ e mu se masuxuma, sanyi na e bɛ, kɔnɔ e mu e ɲɛrɛma. Xui yo mu minima e kɔn na!

sentences.english: Those who make them are like them; and so is everyone who puts his faith in them.
sentences.susu: E yailanmae fama nɛ lude alɔ e tan. Mixi naxee e xaxili tima e ra e findima sɛnbɛtaree nan na.

sentences.english: O Israel, have faith in the Lord: he is their help and their breastplate.
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ, i xaxili ti Alatala ra, naxan findi i xa dɛmɛri nun i kantama ra.

sentences.english: O house of Aaron, have faith in the Lord: he is their help and their breastplate.
sentences.susu: Haruna bɔnsɔɛ, i xaxili ti Alatala ra, naxan findi i xa dɛmɛri nun i kantama ra.

sentences.english: You worshippers of the Lord, have faith in the Lord: he is their help and their breastplate.
sentences.susu: Wo tan naxee findixi Ala yaragaaxuie ra, wo wo xaxili ti Alatala ra, naxan findi i xa dɛmɛri nun i kantama ra.

sentences.english: The Lord has kept us in mind and will give us his blessing; he will send blessings on the house of Israel and on the house of Aaron.
sentences.susu: Marigi a ɲɔxɔ saxi won xɔn ma. A won barakama nɛ. Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ yo, Haruna bɔnsɔɛ yo,

sentences.english: He will send blessings on the worshippers of the Lord, on the small and on the great.
sentences.susu: nun Ala yaragaaxuie birin yo, e barakɛ sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: May the Lord give you and your children still greater increase.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa wo tan nun wo xa die yiriwa.

sentences.english: May you have the blessing of the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxan koore nun bɔxi daa, a xa barakɛ fi wo ma.

sentences.english: The heavens are the Lord's; but the earth he has given to the children of men.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan gbe koore ra, kɔnɔ a naxa duniɲa tan fi adamadie ma.

sentences.english: The dead do not give praise to the Lord; or those who go down to the underworld.
sentences.susu: Mixi faxaxie xa mu Alatala matɔxɔma, mixi naxee sigama aligiyama e mu nɔma matɔxɔɛ rabade,

sentences.english: But we will give praise to the Lord now and for ever. Praise be to the Lord.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ won tan naxee na duniɲa, a lanma won xa tantui rasiga Alatala ma, fɔlɔ yi tɛmui ma han dan mu naxan ma. Wo Alatala matɔxɔ!

sentences.english: I have given my love to the Lord, because he has given ear to the voice of my cry and my prayer.
sentences.susu: N Alatala xanuma barima a n xui mɛma. A naxa kinikini n wa xui ma.

sentences.english: He has let my request come before him, and I will make my prayer to him all my days.
sentences.susu: A to a tuli mati n na, n a maxandima nɛ n ma simaya birin kui.

sentences.english: The nets of death were round me, and the pains of the underworld had me in their grip; I was full of trouble and sorrow.
sentences.susu: Faxɛ luuti nu bara n xiri, aligiyama tɔɔrɛ nu bara n li, nimisɛ nun kɔntɔfili nu bara nɔ n na,

sentences.english: Then I made my prayer to the Lord, saying, O Lord, take my soul out of trouble.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ na tɛmui n naxa Alatala maxandi, «Alatala, yandi, n nakisi!»

sentences.english: The Lord is full of grace and righteousness; truly, he is a God of mercy.
sentences.susu: Hinnɛnte nan Alatala ra, a tinxin. Won Marigi Ala kinikinima won ma.

sentences.english: The Lord keeps the simple; I was made low, and he was my saviour.
sentences.susu: A mixi magoroxi kantama. N sɛnbɛ to ɲɔn, a naxa n nakisi.

sentences.english: Come back to your rest, O my soul; for the Lord has given you your reward.
sentences.susu: N xa n nii raxara, barima Alatala bara fe fanyi raba n bɛ.

sentences.english: You have taken my soul from the power of death, keeping my eyes from weeping, and my feet from falling.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i bara n nii ratanga faxɛ ma, i yaye ba n ya ra, i n sanyi sɛnbɛ so,

sentences.english: I will go before the Lord in the land of the living.
sentences.susu: alako n xa ɲɛrɛ i tan Alatala ya ra mixi baloxi ya ma.

sentences.english: I still had faith, though I said, I am in great trouble;
sentences.susu: N to nu n xaxili tima i ra, n naxa a fala i bɛ, «N na tɔɔrɔfe.»

sentences.english: Though I said in my fear, All men are false.
sentences.susu: Limaniya to ba n yi ra, n naxa a fala, «Wule falɛ nan mixi birin na.»

sentences.english: What may I give to the Lord for all the good things which he has done for me?
sentences.susu: Alatala, n i sare fima di, i xa hinnɛ xa fe ra?

sentences.english: I will take the cup of salvation, and give praise to the name of the Lord.
sentences.susu: N i xa maratangɛ masenma nɛ ɲama bɛ, Alatala xili matɔxɔfe ra.

sentences.english: I will make the offering of my oath to the Lord, even before all his people.
sentences.susu: N na n ma laayidie rakamalima nɛ Alatala bɛ, a xa ɲama birin ya xɔri.

sentences.english: Dear in the eyes of the Lord is the death of his saints.
sentences.susu: Alatala a ɲɔxɔ sama nɛ a batulae xa simaya xɔn ma.

sentences.english: O Lord, truly I am your servant; I am your servant, the son of her who is your servant; by you have my cords been broken.
sentences.susu: I tan Alatala xa konyi di nan n na, i xa konyi ginɛ xa di, i naxan nafulunxi saya luuti ra.

sentences.english: I will give an offering of praise to you, and make my prayer in the name of the Lord.
sentences.susu: N tantui sɛrɛxɛ bama nɛ i bɛ, n i xili matɔxɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: I will make the offerings of my oath, even before all his people;
sentences.susu: N na n ma laayidie rakamalima nɛ Alatala bɛ, a xa ɲama birin ya xɔri,

sentences.english: In the Lord's house, even in Jerusalem. Praise be to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa banxi tɛtɛ kui, Darisalamu ɲama ya xɔri. Wo Marigi matɔxɔ!

sentences.english: Let all the nations give praise to the Lord: let all the people give him praise.
sentences.susu: Si birin xa Alatala matɔxɔ, bɔnsɔɛ birin xa a tantu,

sentences.english: For great is his mercy to us, and his faith is unchanging for ever. Praise be to the Lord.
sentences.susu: barima a xa xanunteya gbo won mabiri, a xa dugutɛgɛɲa mu ɲɔnma abadan. Wo Alatala matɔxɔ!

sentences.english: O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala tantu barima a fan, a xa xanunteya mu ɲɔnma abadan.

sentences.english: Let Israel now say, that his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa a fala, «A xa xanunteya mu ɲɔnma abadan!»

sentences.english: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: Haruna bɔnsɔɛ xa a fala, «A xa xanunteya mu ɲɔnma abadan!»

sentences.english: Let all worshippers of the Lord now say, that his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: Ala yaragaaxuie xa a fala, «A xa xanunteya mu ɲɔnma abadan!»

sentences.english: I made my prayer to the Lord in my trouble: and the Lord gave me an answer, and put me in a wide place.
sentences.susu: N ma tɔɔrɛ kui, n naxa Alatala maxandi. A naxa n ma duba suxu n fulunfe ra.

sentences.english: The Lord is on my side; I will have no fear: what is man able to do to me?
sentences.susu: Alatala na n sɛɛti ma, n mu gaaxuma fefe ma. Adamadi nɔma munse niyade n na?

sentences.english: The Lord is my great helper: I will see my desire against my haters.
sentences.susu: Alatala na n fɔxɔ ra, a n malima. N fama nɛ nɔde n yaxuie ra.

sentences.english: It is better to have faith in the Lord than to put one's hope in man.
sentences.susu: Xaxili tife Alatala ra, na nan fan beenun xaxili tife adamadi ra.

sentences.english: It is better to have faith in the Lord than to put one's hope in rulers.
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛ taxufe Alatala ra dangi yɛtɛ taxufe duniɲa mangɛe ra.

sentences.english: All the nations have come round me; but in the name of the Lord I will have them cut down.
sentences.susu: Si birin nu n nabilinxi n gere xili ma, kɔnɔ Alatala naxa a niya n xa nɔ e ra.

sentences.english: They are round me, yes, they are all about me; but in the name of the Lord I will have them cut down.
sentences.susu: E nu n nabilinxi a ɲaaxi ra, kɔnɔ n naxa nɔ e ra Alatala xili ra.

sentences.english: They are round me like bees; but they are put out like a fire among thorns; for in the name of the Lord I will have them cut down.
sentences.susu: E naxa din n na alɔ kumi tɔnsɔɛ, kɔnɔ e naxa ɲɔn alɔ sɛxɛ xaraxi ganma ki naxɛ. Alatala nan a niya n xa nɔ e ra.

sentences.english: I have been hard pushed by you, so that I might have a fall: but the Lord was my helper.
sentences.susu: E nu n matutunma sɛnbɛ ra, a gbe mu nu luxi n xa bira, kɔnɔ Alatala naxa n mali.

sentences.english: The Lord is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan na n sɛnbɛ nun n ma sɛɛwɛ ra, A bara n nakisi!

sentences.english: The sound of joy and salvation is in the tents of the upright; the right hand of the Lord does works of power.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ nun xunnakeli xui naxa mini tinxintɔɛe xɔnyi a falafe ra,

sentences.english: The right hand of the Lord is lifted up; the right hand of the Lord does works of power.
sentences.susu: «Alatala naxa wali sɛnbɛ ra! A naxa a mangɛya masen, a kaabanakoe raba.»

sentences.english: Life and not death will be my part, and I will give out the story of the works of the Lord.
sentences.susu: N mu faxa, n naxa kisi, alako n xa Alatala xa kaabanakoe masen ɲama bɛ.

sentences.english: The hand of Jah has been hard on me; but he has not given me up to death.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara n ɲaxankata, kɔnɔ a mu n luxi n xa faxa.

sentences.english: Let the doors of righteousness be open to me; I will go in and give praise to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo tinxinyi naadɛe rabi n bɛ, n soma mɛnni Alatala tantufe ra.

sentences.english: This is the door of the Lord's house; the workers of righteousness will go in through it.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa naadɛ nan yi ki, tinxintɔɛe soma naxan kui.

sentences.english: I will give you praise, for you have given me an answer, and have become my salvation.
sentences.susu: N i tantuma nɛ, barima i bara n ma duba suxu, i bara findi n nakisima ra.

sentences.english: The stone which the builders put on one side has become the chief stone of the building.
sentences.susu: Banxitie mɛɛ gɛmɛ naxan na, na bara findi banxi sangantimɛ ra.

sentences.english: This is the Lord's doing; it is a wonder in our eyes.
sentences.susu: Na kelixi Marigi nan ma. Kaabanakoe na a ra won tan bɛ.

sentences.english: This is the day which the Lord has made; we will be full of joy and delight in it.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nan yi ki Alatala naxan ɲanigexi, won xa ɲɛlɛxin, won xa sɛɛwa a xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Send salvation now, O Lord; Lord, send us your blessing.
sentences.susu: Yandi Alatala, muxu rakisi! Yandi Alatala, muxu xun nakeli.

sentences.english: A blessing be on him who comes in the name of the Lord; we give you blessing from the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Baraka na mixi ma naxan fafe Marigi xili ra. Muxu Alatala matɔxɔma a xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: The Lord is God, and he has given us light; let the holy dance be ordered with branches, even up to the horns of the altar.
sentences.susu: Marigi nan na Alatala ra, naxan xa nɔrɛ bara yanba won ma. Wo xa sɛrɛxɛ xiri sɛrɛxɛbade sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: You are my God, and I will give you praise; my God, and I will give honour to your name.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala nan i ra, n i tantuma nɛ, n Marigi Ala nan i ra, n i matɔxɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala tantu barima a fan. A xa xanunteya mu ɲɔnma abadan.

sentences.english: Happy are they who are without sin in their ways, walking in the law of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ na mixie bɛ naxee ɲɛrɛ ki tinxin, naxee biraxi Alatala xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Happy are they who keep his unchanging word, searching after him with all their heart.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ na mixie bɛ naxee Ala xa masenyi mɛma, naxee a fenma e bɔɲɛ birin na.

sentences.english: They do no evil; they go in his ways.
sentences.susu: Nee mu tinxintareya rabama fefe ma, e birama Ala xa kira nan fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: You have put your orders into our hearts, so that we might keep them with care.
sentences.susu: I bara i sago masen muxu bɛ, alako muxu xa muxu ɲɔxɔ sa a xɔn ma a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: If only my ways were ordered so that I might keep your rules!
sentences.susu: N wama fe birin nabafe alako n xa i xa yaamarie rabatu.

sentences.english: Then I would not be put to shame, as long as I have respect for all your teaching.
sentences.susu: Na kui n mu fama yaagide i waxɔnfe xa fe ra.

sentences.english: I will give you praise with an upright heart in learning your right decisions.
sentences.susu: N na i xa yaamarie kolon, n i batuma nɛ n bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra.

sentences.english: I will keep your rules: O give me not up completely. BETH
sentences.susu: N i xa yaamarie ratinmɛma nɛ, i naxa mɛ n na kerenyi ra.

sentences.english: How may a young man make his way clean? by guiding it after your word.
sentences.susu: Fonike ɲɛrɛma sɛniyɛnyi kui di? A bira i xa masenyi fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: I have made search for you with all my heart: O let me not go wandering far from your teaching.
sentences.susu: N i fenma n bɔɲɛ birin nan na. I naxa n lu n xa makuya i xa yaamarie ra.

sentences.english: I have kept your sayings secretly in my heart, so that I might do no sin against you.
sentences.susu: N i xa masenyi ragatama nɛ n bɔɲɛ ma, alako n naxa yunubi raba i ra.

sentences.english: Praise be to you, O Lord: give me knowledge of your rules.
sentences.susu: Matɔxɔɛ na i bɛ Alatala. I xa yaamarie masen n bɛ.

sentences.english: With my lips have I made clear all the decisions of your mouth.
sentences.susu: N i xa sɛriyɛ durusima nɛ, i naxan masenxi i kɛrɛ ra.

sentences.english: I have taken as much delight in the way of your unchanging word, as in all wealth.
sentences.susu: N sɛɛwaxi birafe ra i xa masenyi fɔxɔ ra, alɔ n na findi banna belebele ra.

sentences.english: I will give thought to your orders, and have respect for your ways.
sentences.susu: N n ɲɔxɔ saxi i sago xɔn ma, n i xa kira matoma nɛ.

sentences.english: I will have delight in your rules; I will not let your word go out of my mind. GIMEL
sentences.susu: I xa yaamarie rafan n ma, n mu nɛɛmuma i xa masenyi ma.

sentences.english: Give me, your servant, the reward of life, so that I may keep your word;
sentences.susu: Fe fanyi raba n tan, i xa konyi di bɛ, alako n xa kisi, n xa i xa masenyi ratinmɛ.

sentences.english: Let my eyes be open to see the wonders of your law.
sentences.susu: N ya rabi alako n xa i xa sɛriyɛ fanyi igbɛ.

sentences.english: I am living in a strange land: do not let your teachings be kept secret from me.
sentences.susu: Xɔɲɛ nan lanxi n ma yi duniɲa ma, i naxa i xa yaamarie nɔxun n ma.

sentences.english: My soul is broken with desire for your decisions at all times.
sentences.susu: N hayi na i xa tinxinyi ma.

sentences.english: Your hand has been against the men of pride, a curse is on those who go wandering out of your way.
sentences.susu: I i xui ratema yɛtɛ igboe xili ma, mixi dankaxi naxee i xa yaamarie rabɛɲinma.

sentences.english: Take away from me shame and bitter words; for I have kept your unchanging word in my heart.
sentences.susu: I xa n natanga yaagi nun maraɲaaxui ma, barima n i xa masenyi suxuxi.

sentences.english: Rulers make evil designs against me; but your servant gives thought to your rules.
sentences.susu: Hali mangɛe n tɔɔɲɛgɛma, i xa konyi di a ɲɔxɔ sama nɛ i xa yaamarie nan xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Your unchanging word is my delight, and the guide of my footsteps. DALETH
sentences.susu: I xa masenyi rafan n ma, e n nasima a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: My soul is joined to the dust: O give me life, in keeping with your word.
sentences.susu: N na tɔɔrɛ xungbe kui. Yandi, i xa n nakisi i xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: I put the record of my ways before you, and you gave me an answer: O give me knowledge of your rules.
sentences.susu: N to n ma ɲɛrɛ ki masen i bɛ, i n yaabi nɛ. Yandi, i xa i xa yaamari masen n bɛ.

sentences.english: Make the way of your orders clear to me; then my thoughts will be ever on your wonders.
sentences.susu: N mali i sago fahaamufe ra, alako n xa n ɲɔxɔ sa i xa kaabanakoe xɔn ma.

sentences.english: My soul is wasted with sorrow; give me strength again in keeping with your word
sentences.susu: N na wafe nimisɛ ma. N xun nakeli alɔ i a laayidixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Take from me every false way; and in mercy give me your law.
sentences.susu: Wule falafe makuya n na. Hinnɛ n na i xa sɛriyɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: I have taken the way of faith: I have kept your decisions before me.
sentences.susu: N bara dugutɛgɛɲa kira sugandi, n bɔɲɛ birama i xa sɛriyɛ nan fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: I have been true to your unchanging word; O Lord, do not put me to shame.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n xirixi i xa sɛriyɛ nan na, i naxa n lu yaagi kui.

sentences.english: I will go quickly in the way of your teaching, because you have given me a free heart. HE
sentences.susu: N na n ɲɛrɛfe i xa yaamarie xa kira nan xɔn ma, barima i bara a niya i waxɔnfe xa lu n bɔɲɛ ma.

sentences.english: O Lord, let me see the way of your rules, and I will keep it to the end.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n matinxin i xa yaamarie ra, alako n xa lu i xa kira xɔn ma n ma simaya birin kui.

sentences.english: Give me wisdom, so that I may keep your law; going after it with all my heart.
sentences.susu: Xaxili fanyi fi n ma, alako n xa n ɲɔxɔ sa i xa sɛriyɛ xɔn ma, n man xa a rabatu n bɔɲɛ birin na

sentences.english: Make me go in the way of your teachings; for they are my delight.
sentences.susu: N naɲɛrɛ i xa yaamarie xa kira xɔn ma, barima e rafan n ma

sentences.english: Let my heart be turned to your unchanging word, and not to evil desire.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ rafindi i xa masenyi ma, i naxa a rafindi bannaya tinxintareya ma.

sentences.english: Let my eyes be turned away from what is false; give me life in your ways.
sentences.susu: N yae ba see ra naxee ɲɔnma, n nakisi i xa kira xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Give effect to your word to your servant, in whose heart is the fear of you.
sentences.susu: I xa laayidi rakamali i xa konyi di bɛ, i naxan nagataxi i yaragaaxuie ya ra.

sentences.english: Take away the shame which is my fear; for your decisions are good.
sentences.susu: N ba yaagi kui n gaaxuxi naxan ya ra, barima i xa sɛriyɛ fan.

sentences.english: See how great is my desire for your orders: give me life in your righteousness. VAU
sentences.susu: N wama birafe i xa masenyi fɔxɔ ra a fanyi ra. N nakisi i xa tinxinyi kui.

sentences.english: Let your mercies come to me, O Lord, even your salvation, as you have said.
sentences.susu: Alatala, fa i xa xanunteya nun i xa kisi ra n bɛ, alɔ i a laayidi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So that I may have an answer for the man who would put me to shame; for I have faith in your word.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, n nɔma nɛ n maberema yaabide, barima n tan laxi i xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: Take not your true word quite out of my mouth; for I have put my hope in your decisions.
sentences.susu: I naxa nɔndi masenyi ba n dɛ i, barima n xaxili tixi i xa kiiti ra.

sentences.english: So that I may keep your law for ever and ever;
sentences.susu: N i xa sɛriyɛ rabatuma nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: So that my way may be in a wide place: because my search has been for your orders.
sentences.susu: N luma xɔrɛya nan kui, barima n na i sago nan fenfe.

sentences.english: So that I may give knowledge of your unchanging word before kings, and not be put to shame.
sentences.susu: N i xa masenyi falama nɛ mangɛe bɛ, n mu fama lude yaagi kui.

sentences.english: And so that I may take delight in your teachings, to which I have given my love.
sentences.susu: Birafe i xa yaamarie fɔxɔ ra, na rafan n ma.

sentences.english: And so that my hands may be stretched out to you; and I will give thought to your rules. ZAIN
sentences.susu: N na n bɛlɛxɛe itema tantui ra i xa yaamarie xa fe ra, naxee rafan n ma. N wama n ɲɔxɔ safe i xa sɛriyɛe xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Keep in mind your word to your servant, for on it has my hope been fixed.
sentences.susu: I xa ratu i xa masenyi ma, i naxan masen i xa konyi di bɛ, naxan xaxili sa fima n ma yare.

sentences.english: This is my comfort in my trouble; that your sayings have given me life.
sentences.susu: N madunduma n ma tɔɔrɛ kui i xa laayidi nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: The men of pride have made great sport of me; but I have not been turned from your law.
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛ igboe n mayelema nɛ, kɔnɔ n mu i xa sɛriyɛ kira bɛɲinma.

sentences.english: I have kept the memory of your decisions from times past, O Lord; and they have been my comfort.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n to n natu i xa kiiti tinxinxie ma i naxan saxi tɛmui dangixi, n bɔɲɛ limaniyama nɛ.

sentences.english: I am burning with wrath, because of the sinners who have given up your law.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ texi a ɲaaxi ra tinxintaree xili ma naxee i xa sɛriyɛ raboloma.

sentences.english: Your rules have been melodies to me, while I have been living in strange lands.
sentences.susu: N sabati dɛdɛ, n bɛɛti bama nɛ i xa yaamarie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: I have given thought to your name in the night, O Lord, and have kept your law.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ ra n na n natuma nɛ i xili ma. Alatala, n fama nɛ i xa sɛriyɛe ratinmɛde.

sentences.english: This has been true of me, that I have kept your orders in my heart. CHETH
sentences.susu: N darixi i sago rabatufe nan na.

sentences.english: The Lord is my heritage: I have said that I would be ruled by your words.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i tide gbo n bɛ. N bara laayidi tongo i xa masenyi rabatufe ra.

sentences.english: I have given my mind to do your pleasure with all my heart; have mercy on me, as you have said.
sentences.susu: N wama lufe i sɛɛti ma n bɔɲɛ birin na. Hinnɛ n na alɔ i a masen ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: I gave thought to my steps, and my feet were turned into the way of your unchanging word.
sentences.susu: N to n ɲɛrɛ ki mato, n bara gbilen i xa masenyi ma.

sentences.english: I was quick to do your orders, and let no time be wasted.
sentences.susu: N gbatama nɛ, n mu dugundima i xa yaamarie rabatufe ra.

sentences.english: The cords of evil-doers are round me; but I have kept in mind your law.
sentences.susu: Hali mixi ɲaaxie kankan n ma, n mu nɛɛmuma i xa sɛriyɛe ma.

sentences.english: In the middle of the night I will get up to give you praise, because of all your right decisions.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ tagi, n kelima nɛ, n i matɔxɔ i xa kiiti tinxinxi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: I keep company with all your worshippers, and those who have your orders in their memory.
sentences.susu: I yaragaaxui birin findixi n ɲɛrɛboore nan na, nun naxee i sago rabatuma.

sentences.english: The earth, O Lord, is full of your mercy: give me knowledge of your rules. TETH
sentences.susu: Alatala i xa xanunteya na duniɲa birin ma, n xaran i xa yaamarie ra.

sentences.english: You have done good to your servant, O Lord, in keeping with your word.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i bara fe fanyi raba n tan i xa konyi bɛ, alɔ i a laayidixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Give me knowledge and good sense; for I have put my faith in your teachings.
sentences.susu: N xaran fe tagi rasade nun fe kolonyi ra, barima n laxi i xa yaamarie ra.

sentences.english: Before I was in trouble I went out of the way; but now I keep your word.
sentences.susu: N nu bara lɔɛ beemanu i xa n ma fe magoro, kɔnɔ yakɔsi fa n na i xa masenyi nan nabatufe.

sentences.english: You are good, and your works are good; give me knowledge of your rules.
sentences.susu: I fan, i fe fanyi rabama, n xaran i xa yaamarie ra.

sentences.english: The men of pride have said false things about me; but I will keep your orders in my heart.
sentences.susu: Hali yɛtɛ igboe wule sama n xun, n i xa yaamarie rabatuma nɛ n bɔɲɛ birin na.

sentences.english: Their hearts are shut up with fat; but my delight is in your law.
sentences.susu: E bɔɲɛ xɔrɔxɔ alɔ gɛmɛ, kɔnɔ i xa sɛriyɛ ɲɔxun n bɛ.

sentences.english: It is good for me to have been through trouble; so that I might come to the knowledge of your rules.
sentences.susu: N ma tɔɔrɛ bara n mali i xa yaamarie kolonfe ra.

sentences.english: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of gold and silver. JOD
sentences.susu: I xa masenyi fan n bɛ xɛɛma nun gbeti ra.

sentences.english: Your hands have made me, and given me form: give me wisdom, so that I may have knowledge of your teaching.
sentences.susu: I tan nan n daaxi, i tan nan n nafalaxi i xɔnyɛ ra. Fahaamui fi n ma i xa yaamarie kolonfe ra.

sentences.english: Your worshippers will see me and be glad; because my hope has been in your word.
sentences.susu: I yaragaaxuie xa sɛɛwa n tofe ra, barima n xaxili tixi i xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: I have seen, O Lord, that your decisions are right, and that in unchanging faith you have sent trouble on me.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n a kolon i xa kiiti tinxinxi ra, n a kolon i n ma fe magoroxi xanunteya nan ma.

sentences.english: Let your mercy now be my comfort, as you have said to your servant.
sentences.susu: Yandi, i xa xanunteya xa n madundu, alɔ i a laayidi n tan, i xa konyi bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Let your gentle mercies come to me, so that I may have life; for your law is my delight.
sentences.susu: I xa kinikini n ma alako n xa kisi, barima i xa sɛriyɛ rafan n ma.

sentences.english: Let the men of pride be shamed; because they have falsely given decision against me; but I will give thought to your orders.
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛ igboe xa yaagi sɔtɔ, barima n mu fe yo rabaxi e ra e n tɔɔrɔma naxan ma. N tan ɲɔxɔ sama i sago nan xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Let your worshippers be turned to me, and those who have knowledge of your words.
sentences.susu: I yaragaaxuie xa gbilen n ma, a nun naxee i xa masenyi kolon.

sentences.english: Let all my heart be given to your orders, so that I may not be put to shame. CAPH
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ xa i xa yaamarie suxu, alako yaagi naxa fa dusu n xun na.

sentences.english: My soul is wasted with desire for your salvation: but I have hope in your word.
sentences.susu: A xɔli n ma n xa i xa kisi sɔtɔ, kɔnɔ n xaxili tixi i xa masenyi nan na.

sentences.english: My eyes are full of weariness with searching for your word, saying, When will you give me comfort?
sentences.susu: N i xa laayidi rakamalixi mamɛfe. N a falama n bɔɲɛ kui, «I n madunduma mun tɛmui?»

sentences.english: For I have become like a wine-skin black with smoke; but I still keep the memory of your rules.
sentences.susu: N luxi alɔ kundi naxan na raxarafe, kɔnɔ n mu nɛɛmuma i xa yaamarie ra.

sentences.english: How short is the life of your servant! when will you give your decision against those who are attacking me?
sentences.susu: N xa mamɛ ti han mun tɛmui, beenun i xa n yaxuie ɲaxankata?

sentences.english: The men of pride, who are turned away from your law, have put nets for me.
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛ igboe gantanyi tima n ya ra. Sɛriyɛ mu na ki.

sentences.english: All your teachings are certain; they go after me with evil design; give me your help.
sentences.susu: I xa yaamari birin tinxin. N natanga tɔɔɲɛgɛ ma.

sentences.english: They had almost put an end to me on earth; but I did not give up your orders.
sentences.susu: A gbe mu luxi e xa n ma fe kana, kɔnɔ n tondi nɛ i xa yaamarie rabolode.

sentences.english: Give me life in your mercy; so that I may be ruled by the unchanging word of your mouth. LAMED
sentences.susu: N nakisi i xa xanunteya ra, alako n xa i xa masenyi suxu.

sentences.english: For ever, O Lord, your word is fixed in heaven.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa masenyi na koore ma abadan.

sentences.english: Your faith is unchanging from generation to generation: you have put the earth in its place, and it is not moved.
sentences.susu: I xa xanunteya buma nɛ kelife to bɔnsɔɛ ma han bɔnsɔɛ naxee sa fama. I duniɲa xanxi nan daa.

sentences.english: They are ruled this day by your decisions; for all things are your servants.
sentences.susu: I xa sɛriyɛ buma han to, birin na i xa mangɛya nan bun ma.

sentences.english: If your law had not been my delight, my troubles would have put an end to me.
sentences.susu: Xa n mu sɛɛwa i xa sɛriyɛ ra nu, n bara bɔnɔ n ma tɔɔrɛ kui nu.

sentences.english: I will ever keep your orders in mind; for in them I have life.
sentences.susu: N mu nɛɛmuma i xa masenyi ra feo, barima i n kisixi e tan nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: I am yours, O be my saviour; for my desire has been for your rules.
sentences.susu: N bara n yɛtɛ fi i ma, n nakisi. N tinma i sago suxufe ra.

sentences.english: The sinners have been waiting for me to give me up to destruction; but I will give all my mind to your unchanging ward.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxie wama n faxafe, kɔnɔ n tan ɲɔxɔ saxi i xa masenyi xɔn ma.

sentences.english: I have seen that nothing on earth is complete; but your teaching is very wide. MEM
sentences.susu: N a kolon duniɲa fe birin ɲɔnma nɛ, kɔnɔ i xa sɛriyɛ mu kanama abadan.

sentences.english: O what love I have for your law! I give thought to it all the day.
sentences.susu: I xa sɛriyɛ rafan n ma. N na n ɲɔxɔ saxi a xɔn ma kudɛ.

sentences.english: Your teaching has made me wiser than my haters: for it is mine for ever.
sentences.susu: I xa yaamarie n findima fahaamula nan na dangi n yaxuie ra, barima e na n bɔɲɛ kui tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: I have more knowledge than all my teachers, because I give thought to your unchanging word.
sentences.susu: N xaxili fan n karamɔxɔe xaxili bɛ, barima n na n ɲɔxɔ saxi i xa masenyi nan xɔn ma.

sentences.english: I have more wisdom than the old, because I have kept your orders.
sentences.susu: N fe kolon dangife forie ra, barima n i sago rabatuxi.

sentences.english: I have kept back my feet from all evil ways, so that I might be true to your word.
sentences.susu: N bara n sanyi ba kira ɲaaxie xɔn ma, n xa bira i xa masenyi fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: My heart has not been turned away from your decisions; for you have been my teacher.
sentences.susu: N mu i xa sɛriyɛ bɛɲin, barima i tan nan yati n xaran na ra.

sentences.english: How sweet are your sayings to my taste! truly, they are sweeter than honey in my mouth!
sentences.susu: I xa masenyi ɲɔxun n dɛ kui dangi kumi ra.

sentences.english: Through your orders I get wisdom; for this reason I am a hater of every false way. NUN
sentences.susu: N xaxili fanyi sɔtɔ i sago nan na. Na kui n bara kira ɲaaxie tan xɔn.

sentences.english: Your word is a light for my feet, ever shining on my way.
sentences.susu: I xa masenyi findixi lanpui nan na n san tide, a findi naiyalanyi ra n ma kira xɔn ma.

sentences.english: I have made an oath and kept it, to be guided by your upright decisions.
sentences.susu: N bara laayidi tongo naxan mu kanama, n fama nɛ birade i xa sɛriyɛ tinxinxi fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: I am greatly troubled, O Lord, give me life in keeping with your word.
sentences.susu: N bara tɔɔrɔ a gbe ra. Alatala, n nakisi i xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: Take, O Lord, the free offerings of my mouth, and give me knowledge of your decisions.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n bara i maxandi, i xa n ma matɔxɔɛ suxu sɛrɛxɛ ra, i xa n xaran i sago ra.

sentences.english: My soul is ever in danger; but I still keep the memory of your law.
sentences.susu: N nii na faxɛ ya i tɛmui birin, kɔnɔ n mu nɛɛmuma i xa sɛriyɛ ma.

sentences.english: Sinners have put a net to take me; but I was true to your orders.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxie gantanyi tema n bɛ, kɔnɔ n mu n makuyama i sago ra.

sentences.english: I have taken your unchanging word as an eternal heritage; for it is the joy of my heart.
sentences.susu: I xa masenyi findixi n kɛ nan na abadan, a n bɔɲɛ rasɛɛwama nɛ.

sentences.english: My heart is ever ready to keep your rules, even to the end. SAMECH
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ birama nɛ i xa yaamarie fɔxɔ ra abadan.

sentences.english: I am a hater of men of doubting mind; but I am a lover of your law.
sentences.susu: N filankafui xɔnma, kɔnɔ i xa sɛriyɛ rafan n ma.

sentences.english: You are my secret place and my breastplate against danger; my hope is in your word.
sentences.susu: N kantari nun n makantama na i tan nan na, n xaxili tixi i xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: Go far from me, you evil-doers; so that I may keep the teachings of my God.
sentences.susu: Wo wo masiga n na, wo tan mixi kobie, alako n xa Ala xa yaamarie ratinmɛ.

sentences.english: Be my support as you have said, and give me life; let not my hope be turned to shame.
sentences.susu: N dɛmɛn alɔ i a laayidi ki naxɛ, alako n xa kisi. I naxa fe kana n xaxili tixi naxan na.

sentences.english: Let me not be moved, and I will be safe, and ever take delight in your rules.
sentences.susu: I xa ti n fanga ra, alako n xa kisi. N ya tixi i xa yaamarie ra.

sentences.english: You have overcome all those who are wandering from your rules; for all their thoughts are false.
sentences.susu: I xa tondi mixie ra naxee e makuyama i xa sɛriyɛ ra, barima madaxuɲa nun wule na e xa fe birin kui.

sentences.english: All the sinners of the earth are like waste metal in your eyes; and for this cause I give my love to your unchanging word.
sentences.susu: I mixi kobie ɲɔnma nɛ yi duniɲa ma, alɔ xabui gbeti gbi bama ki naxɛ. Na nan a ra i xa masenyi rafan n ma.

sentences.english: My flesh is moved for fear of you; I give honour to your decisions. AIN
sentences.susu: N fate sɛrɛnma i xa magaaxui ra, n hanmɛxi i xa kiiti ra.

sentences.english: I have done what is good and right: you will not give me into the hands of those who are working against me.
sentences.susu: N walima nɔndi nun tinxinyi nan na. I naxa n lu n yaxuie yi ra.

sentences.english: Take your servant's interests into your keeping; let me not be crushed by the men of pride.
sentences.susu: I xa n ma fe sɔɔnɛya i sɛnbɛ ra, I naxa lu yɛtɛ igboe xa nɔ n na.

sentences.english: My eyes are wasted with desire for your salvation, and for the word of your righteousness.
sentences.susu: N ya tixi i xa kisi ra tɛmui birin, a nun i xa masenyi tinxinxi.

sentences.english: Be good to your servant in your mercy, and give me teaching in your rules.
sentences.susu: Hinnɛ i xa konyi ra i xa xanunteya kui. N xaran i xa yaamarie ra.

sentences.english: I am your servant; give me wisdom, so that I may have knowledge of your unchanging word.
sentences.susu: Fahaamui fi n tan, i xa konyi ma, alako n xa i xa masenyi kui kolon.

sentences.english: It is time, O Lord, for you to let your work be seen; for they have made your law without effect.
sentences.susu: Mixie na i xa sɛriyɛ matandife. Alatala, a lanma i xa ti e ya ra yakɔsi.

sentences.english: For this reason I have greater love far your teachings than for gold, even for shining gold.
sentences.susu: I xa yaamarie rafanxi n ma dangife xɛɛma fanyi ra,

sentences.english: Because of it I keep straight in all things by your orders; and I am a hater of every false way. PE
sentences.susu: n to a maɲɔxun i sago tinxin, n kira birin xɔnma nɛ naxan mu findi nɔndi ra.

sentences.english: Your unchanging word is full of wonder; for this reason my soul keeps it.
sentences.susu: I xa masenyi n dɛ ixarama, n a rabatuma na nan ma.

sentences.english: The opening of your words gives light; it gives good sense to the simple.
sentences.susu: I xa masenyi kui matofe, a xaxili fima nɛ xaxilitaree ma.

sentences.english: My mouth was open wide, waiting with great desire for your teachings.
sentences.susu: A na n nii ra n xa i sago kolon.

sentences.english: Let your eyes be turned to me, and have mercy on me, as it is right for you to do to those who are lovers of your name.
sentences.susu: I ya rafindi n ma, i xa hinnɛ n na, alɔ i darixi a raba ra ki naxɛ i xanuntenyie bɛ.

sentences.english: Let my steps be guided by your word; and let not sin have control over me.
sentences.susu: I xa n ti i xa masenyi fari, i naxa lu fe ɲaaxi yo xa nɔ n na.

sentences.english: Make me free from the cruel rule of man; then I will keep your orders.
sentences.susu: N ba adamadie xa nɔɛ bun ma, alako n xa i xa yaamarie ratinmɛ.

sentences.english: Let your servant see the shining of your face; give me knowledge of your rules.
sentences.susu: I yatagi nɔrɛ rayanba i xa konyi ma, i xa n xaran i xa yaamarie ra.

sentences.english: Rivers of water are flowing from my eyes, because men do not keep your law. TZADE
sentences.susu: N luma wa ra a gbe ra, barima n a kolon mixie mu i xa sɛriyɛ ratinmɛma.

sentences.english: O Lord, great is your righteousness, and upright are your decisions.
sentences.susu: Alatala i tinxin, i xa kiitie fan tinxin.

sentences.english: You have given your unchanging word in righteousness, and it is for ever.
sentences.susu: I xa masenyi tinxin, a man findixi nɔndi yati nan na.

sentences.english: My passion has overcome me; because my haters are turned away from your words.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ raɲaaxuma nɛ n ma, barima n yaxuie mu e tuli matima i xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: Your word is of tested value; and it is dear to your servant.
sentences.susu: I xa masenyi bara a yɛtɛ xa nɔndi masen, a rafan n tan i xa konyi ma.

sentences.english: I am small and of no account; but I keep your orders in mind.
sentences.susu: Hali n xurun, mixie yoma n ma, n mu nɛɛmuma i sago ma.

sentences.english: Your righteousness is an unchanging righteousness, and your law is certain.
sentences.susu: I xa tinxinyi buma abadan. I xa sɛriyɛ nɔndi na a ra.

sentences.english: Pain and trouble have overcome me: but your teachings are my delight.
sentences.susu: Sunnunyi nun tɔɔrɛ n suxuxi, kɔnɔ i xa yaamarie nɔxun n bɛ.

sentences.english: The righteousness of your unchanging word is eternal; give me wisdom so that I may have life. KOPH
sentences.susu: I xa sɛriyɛe tinxin abadan. Fahaamui fi n ma alako n xa kisi.

sentences.english: I have made my prayer with all my heart; give answer to me, O Lord: I will keep your rules.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n na n dɛ rawafe i bɛ n bɔɲɛ birin na. N yaabi, alako n xa nɔ i xa yaamarie ratinmɛde.

sentences.english: My cry has gone up to you; take me out of trouble, and I will be guided by your unchanging word.
sentences.susu: N na n dɛ rawafe i bɛ. N nakisi, alako n xa nɔ i sago rabade.

sentences.english: Before the sun is up, my cry for help comes to your ear; my hope is in your words.
sentences.susu: N kelima beemanu subaxɛ xa a li, n i maxandi i xa n dɛmɛn. N xaxili tixi i xa masenyi nan na.

sentences.english: In the night watches I am awake, so that I may give thought to your saying.
sentences.susu: N mu xima kɔɛ ra, n na n maɲɔxunma i xa masenyi nan tun ma.

sentences.english: Let my voice come to you, in your mercy; O Lord, by your decisions give me life.
sentences.susu: I i tuli mati n xui ra i xa xanunteya xa fe ra. Alatala, n nakisi i xa kiiti bɛrɛ ra.

sentences.english: Those who have evil designs against me come near; they are far from your law.
sentences.susu: Mixie bara maso n na, naxee wama fe ɲaaxie xɔn. E makuya i xa sɛriyɛ ra.

sentences.english: You are near, O Lord; and all your teachings are true.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan Alatala, i makɔrɛ n na, i xa yaamarie findixi nɔndi nan na.

sentences.english: I have long had knowledge that your unchanging word is for ever. RESH
sentences.susu: N a kolon kabi a rakuya, i bara i xa masenyi mabanban alako a xa bu abadan.

sentences.english: O see my trouble, and be my saviour; for I keep your law in my mind,
sentences.susu: N ma tɔɔrɛ mato, i xa n nakisi, barima n mu nɛɛmuxi i xa sɛriyɛ ma.

sentences.english: Undertake my cause, and come to my help, give me life, as you have said.
sentences.susu: I xa n xun mafala, i xa n xun sara. N nakisi alɔ i a laayidi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Salvation is far from evil-doers; for they have made no search for your rules.
sentences.susu: Kisi makuya mixi ɲaaxie ra, barima e mu birama i xa yaamarie fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Great is the number of your mercies, O Lord; give me life in keeping with your decisions.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa kinikini gbo. N nakisi i xa kiiti bɛrɛ ra.

sentences.english: Great is the number of those who are against me; but I have not been turned away from your unchanging word.
sentences.susu: N gerefae wuya, kɔnɔ n mu gbilen i sago fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: I saw with hate those who were untrue to you; for they did not keep your saying.
sentences.susu: I yanfamae tofe raɲaaxu n ma, barima e mu i xa masenyi suxuma.

sentences.english: See how great is my love for your orders: give me life, O Lord, in keeping with your mercy.
sentences.susu: A mato, i xa yaamarie rafan n ma. Alatala, n nakisi i xa xanunteya xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Your word is true from the first; and your upright decision is unchanging for ever. SHIN
sentences.susu: I xa masenyi nɔndi na a ra, i xa kiiti tinxinxi buma nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: Rulers have been cruel to me without cause; but I have the fear of your word in my heart.
sentences.susu: Mangɛe n tɔɔrɔma hali n mu fe ɲaaxi yo rabaxi e ra, kɔnɔ n gaaxuma i xa masenyi ya ra n bɔɲɛ birin na.

sentences.english: I am delighted by your saying, like a man who makes discovery of great wealth.
sentences.susu: N sɛɛwaxi i xa laayidi ra, alɔ mixi naxan geeni xungbe sɔtɔxi.

sentences.english: I am full of hate and disgust for false words; but I am a lover of your law.
sentences.susu: N wule xɔnxi, a raɲaaxu n ma, kɔnɔ i xa sɛriyɛ n xanuntenyi na a ra.

sentences.english: Seven times a day do I give you praise, because of your upright decisions.
sentences.susu: N i matɔxɔma sanmaya solofere lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ i xa kiiti tinxinxi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Great peace have lovers of your law; they have no cause for falling.
sentences.susu: Bɔɲɛsa gbegbe nan na mixie bɛ, i xa sɛriyɛ rafanxi naxee ma. Fefe mu e rabirama.

sentences.english: Lord, my hope has been in your salvation; and I have kept your teachings.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n xaxili tixi i xa kisi ra, n birama nɛ i xa yaamarie fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: My soul has kept your unchanging word; great is my love for it.
sentences.susu: N i xa masenyi suxuma nɛ, barima e rafan n ma ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: I have been ruled by your orders; for all my ways are before you. TAU
sentences.susu: N birama nɛ i sago nun i xa masenyi fɔxɔ ra. I n ɲɛrɛ ki birin kolon.

sentences.english: Let my cry come before you, O Lord; give me wisdom in keeping with your word.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa n ma duba suxu. Fahaamui fi n ma i xa masenyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: Let my prayer come before you; take me out of trouble, as you have said.
sentences.susu: N ma maxandi xa i li. N nakisi alɔ i a laayidi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Let my lips be flowing with praise, because you have given me knowledge of your rules.
sentences.susu: I matɔxɔɛ xa mini n dɛ i, barima i n xaranfe i xa yaamarie nan na.

sentences.english: Let my tongue make songs in praise of your word; for all your teachings are righteousness.
sentences.susu: N dɛ xa bɛɛti nde ba i xa masenyi xa fe ra, barima i xa yaamarie birin tinxin.

sentences.english: Let your hand be near for my help; for I have given my heart to your orders.
sentences.susu: I xa fa n dɛmɛn, barima n i sago nan sugandixi.

sentences.english: All my desire has been for your salvation, O Lord; and your law is my delight.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n nii na i xa kisi ma, i xa sɛriyɛ n nasɛɛwama nɛ.

sentences.english: Give life to my soul so that it may give you praise; and let your decisions be my support.
sentences.susu: I xa n nakisi alako n xa nɔ i matɔxɔde. I xa kiitie xa n dɛmɛn.

sentences.english: I have gone out of the way like a wandering sheep; make search for your servant; for I keep your teachings ever in mind.
sentences.susu: N nabɛɲinxi nɛ alɔ yɛxɛ lɔɛxi. I xa n tan i xa konyi fen, barima n mu nɛɛmuxi i xa yaamarie ma.

sentences.english: In my trouble my cry went up to the Lord, and he gave me an answer.
sentences.susu: Biyaasilae xa bɛɛti nde N na Alatala maxandi n ma tɔɔrɛ kui, a n yaabima nɛ.

sentences.english: O Lord, be the saviour of my soul from false lips, and from the tongue of deceit.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n natanga wule falɛe dɛ ma, naxee mixie madaxuma.

sentences.english: What punishment will he give you? what more will he do to you, you false tongue?
sentences.susu: Mixi madaxui, a fama munse rabade?

sentences.english: Sharp arrows of the strong, and burning fire.
sentences.susu: A fama sɔxɔɛ nan tide tanbɛ raluganxie ra, a fama ganyi tide tɛ wolee ra.

sentences.english: Sorrow is mine because I am strange in Meshech, and living in the tents of Kedar.
sentences.susu: A xɔrɔxɔ n bɛ lufe ra Meseki bɔxi ma, a xɔrɔxɔ n bɛ lufe ra Kedari bɔnsɔɛ ya ma.

sentences.english: My soul has long been living with the haters of peace.
sentences.susu: N bara bu yi mixie ya ma, naxee bɔɲɛsa xɔnxi.

sentences.english: I am for peace: but when I say so, they are for war.
sentences.susu: N tan na bɔɲɛsa nan bɛ, kɔnɔ n nɛfɛ wɔyɛn, e tan wama gere nan xɔn ma.

sentences.english: My eyes are lifted up to the hills: O where will my help come from?
sentences.susu: Biyaasilae xa bɛɛti nde N na n ya ratema geyae mabiri. N ma dɛmɛri kelima minden?

sentences.english: Your help comes from the Lord, who made heaven and earth.
sentences.susu: N ma dɛmɛri fatanma Alatala nan na, naxan koore nun bɔxi daaxi.

sentences.english: May he not let your foot be moved: no need of sleep has he who keeps you.
sentences.susu: A mu tinma i xa bira. A i kantama, a mu kinsɔnma.

sentences.english: See, the eyes of Israel's keeper will not be shut in sleep.
sentences.susu: Isirayila kantama mu kinsɔnma, a mu xima.

sentences.english: The Lord is your keeper; the Lord is your shade on your right hand.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan i kantama. A findixi niini nan na i bɛ,

sentences.english: You will not be touched by the sun in the day, or by the moon at night.
sentences.susu: alako soge naxa i tɔɔrɔ yanyi ra, kike naxa i tɔɔrɔ kɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: The Lord will keep you safe from all evil; he will take care of your soul.
sentences.susu: Alatala i ratangama nɛ tɔɔrɛ birin ma, a i nii makantama.

sentences.english: The Lord will keep watch over your going out and your coming in, from this time and for ever.
sentences.susu: I na mini, Alatala luma nɛ i sɛɛti ma. I na so, Alatala birama nɛ i fɔxɔ ra. A na i sɛɛti ma yakɔsi, a na i sɛɛti ma abadan.

sentences.english: I was glad because they said to me, We will go into the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Biyaasilae xa bɛɛti nde Dawuda naxan sɛbɛ N bara sɛɛwa n biyaasi booree xa wɔyɛnyi ma, a falafe ra, «Won xɛɛ Alatala xa banxi!»

sentences.english: At last our feet were inside your doors, O Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi muxu sanyie tixi i tan Darisalamu sode dɛ ra.»

sentences.english: O Jerusalem, you are like a town which is well joined together;
sentences.susu: Darisalamu taa na a ra naxan tixi lanyi kui.

sentences.english: To which the tribes went up, even the tribes of the Lord, for a witness to Israel, to give praise to the name of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa mixie tema nɛ naa e bɔnsɔɛ ki ma alako e xa Alatala xili matɔxɔ alɔ a yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For there seats for the judges were placed, even the rulers' seats of the line of David.
sentences.susu: Kiitisa xa kibanyie dɔxɔxi mɛnni nɛ, Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ xa mangɛ kibanyie.

sentences.english: O make prayers for the peace of Jerusalem; may they whose love is given to you do well.
sentences.susu: Wo bɔɲɛsa maxandi Darisalamu bɛ! «Ala xa i xanuntenyie ratanga fe xɔrɔxɔɛ ma.

sentences.english: May peace be inside your walls, and wealth in your noble houses.
sentences.susu: Ala xa a niya bɔɲɛsa xa lu i xa tɛtɛ kui. Ala xa i ratanga gere ma.»

sentences.english: Because of my brothers and friends, I will now say, Let peace be with you.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie nun n xanuntenyie xa fe ra, n a falama nɛ, «Bɔɲɛsa xa lu wo bɛ!

sentences.english: Because of the house of the Lord our God, I will be working for your good.
sentences.susu: N i xa hɛɛri fenma nɛ won Marigi Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: To you my eyes are lifted up, even to you whose seat is in the heavens.
sentences.susu: Biyaasilae xa bɛɛti nde N na n ya ratema i tan nan na, i tan naxan ma kibanyi na koore ma.

sentences.english: See! as the eyes of servants are turned to the hands of their masters, and the eyes of a servant-girl to her owner, so our eyes are waiting for the Lord our God, till he has mercy on us.
sentences.susu: Muxu yae tixi muxu Marigi Alatala nan na a xa kinikini xa fe ra, alɔ konyie yae tixi e marigi ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us: for all men are looking down on us.
sentences.susu: Alatala, kinikini muxu ma, barima ɲama bara yo muxu ma,

sentences.english: For long enough have men of pride made sport of our soul.
sentences.susu: yɛtɛ igboe bara muxu mabere.

sentences.english: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side (let Israel now say);
sentences.susu: Biyaasilae xa bɛɛti nde Dawuda naxan sɛbɛ Isirayila ɲama xa a fala: Xa Alatala mu lu won sɛɛti ma nu,

sentences.english: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, when men came up against us;
sentences.susu: xa Alatala mu won mali gere kui nu,

sentences.english: They would have made a meal of us while still living, in the heat of their wrath against us:
sentences.susu: na gerefae bara won xun nakana e xa xɔnɛ ra nu,

sentences.english: We would have been covered by the waters; the streams would have gone over our soul;
sentences.susu: alɔ banbaranyi dinma xure ma ki naxɛ,

sentences.english: Yes, the waters of pride would have gone over our soul.
sentences.susu: a fa mixie madula ye xɔɔra sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: Praise be to the Lord, who has not let us be wounded by their teeth.
sentences.susu: Tantui na Alatala bɛ, naxan mu tin e xa nɔ won na.

sentences.english: Our soul has gone free like a bird out of the net of those who would take her: the net is broken, and we are free.
sentences.susu: Won bara kisi alɔ xɔni naxan kisixi gantanyi ra. Gantanyi bara kana, yɛlɛ bara bɔɔ a ra, won bara e lu naa.

sentences.english: Our help is in the name of the Lord, the maker of heaven and earth.
sentences.susu: Won ma dɛmɛri na Alatala xili nan na, naxan koore nun bɔxi daaxi.

sentences.english: Those whose hope is in the Lord are like the mountain of Zion, which may not be moved, but keeps its place for ever.
sentences.susu: Biyaasilae xa bɛɛti nde Naxee e xaxili tima Alatala ra, e sɛnbɛ sɔtɔma nɛ alɔ Siyoni geya naxan mu sɛrɛnma, a bu abadan.

sentences.english: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Lord is round about his people, from this time and for ever.
sentences.susu: Darisalamu rabilinxi geyae ra ki naxɛ, Alatala a xa ɲama fan nabilinxi na ki nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: For the rod of sinners will not be resting on the heritage of the upright; so that the upright may not put out their hands to evil.
sentences.susu: Mangasanyi ɲaaxi mu tinxintɔɛ xa bɔxi yamarima, alako tinxintɔɛ bɛlɛxɛ naxa lan fe ɲaaxi.

sentences.english: Do good, O Lord, to those who are good, and to those who are upright in heart.
sentences.susu: Alatala, hinnɛ mixi fanyie ra, naxee bɔɲɛ fiixɛ,

sentences.english: But as for such as are turned out of the straight way, the Lord will take them away with the workers of evil. Let peace be on Israel.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ i tan Alatala, i xa tinxintaree keri e yuge ma. Ala xa bɔɲɛsa lu Isirayila bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: When the Lord made a change in Zion's fate, we were like men in a dream.
sentences.susu: Biyaasilae xa bɛɛti nde Alatala to geelimanie ragbilen Siyoni, a lu nɛ muxu bɛ alɔ xiye.

sentences.english: Then our mouths were full of laughing, and our tongues gave a glad cry; they said among the nations, The Lord has done great things for them.
sentences.susu: Muxu naxa yele, muxu naxa bɛɛti ba sɛɛwɛ ra. Sie nu a falama nɛ e bore bɛ, «Alatala bara kaabanakoe raba yie bɛ.»

sentences.english: The Lord has done great things for us; because of which we are glad.
sentences.susu: Iyo, Alatala bara kaabanakoe raba muxu bɛ, muxu sɛɛwaxi ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Let our fate be changed, O Lord, like the streams in the South.
sentences.susu: Alatala, muxu harige ragbilen muxu ma alɔ ye ragbilenma Negewi bɔxi xure xɔrixie ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Those who put in seed with weeping will get in the grain with cries of joy.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee xɛ sama yaye ra, e fama nɛ a xabade sɛɛwɛ kui.

sentences.english: Though a man may go out weeping, taking his vessel of seed with him; he will come again in joy, with the corded stems of grain in his arms.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan sigama sansi side, e na wafe, na mixi gbilenma nɛ baloe ra, a sɛɛwaxi.

sentences.english: If the Lord is not helping the builders, then the building of a house is to no purpose: if the Lord does not keep the town, the watchman keeps his watch for nothing.
sentences.susu: Biyaasilae xa bɛɛti nde Sulemani naxan ba Xa Alatala xa mu banxi ti, a timae walima nɛ fufafu. Xa Alatala xa mu taa makantama, a kantamae walima nɛ fufafu.

sentences.english: It is of no use for you to get up early, and to go late to your rest, with the bread of sorrow for your food; for the Lord gives to his loved ones in sleep.
sentences.susu: Wo kelima subaxɛ ma, wo walima han kɔɛ ra baloe sɔtɔfe ra. Na kui wo walima tun. Kɔnɔ Ala a xanuntenyie man kima e sa tɛmui.

sentences.english: See, sons are a heritage from the Lord; the fruit of the body is his reward.
sentences.susu: Die findima nɛ kɛ ra mixi bɛ Alatala naxan kima, fe fanyi sare nan e ra, naxee kelima a tan ma.

sentences.english: Like arrows in the hand of a man of war, are the children of the young.
sentences.susu: Die naxee sɔtɔxi fonike tɛmui, nee tide luma nɛ alɔ sɔɔrie xa xalie.

sentences.english: Happy is the man who has a good store of them; he will not be put to shame, but his cause will be supported by them against his haters.
sentences.susu: Barakɛ na mixi bɛ naxan xa xali sase rafexi. A yaxuie mu nɔma a rayaagide ɲama ya i.

sentences.english: Happy is the worshipper of the Lord, who is walking in his ways.
sentences.susu: Biyaasilae xa bɛɛti nde Sɛɛwɛ na Alatala xa yaragaaxui nan bɛ, naxan ɲɛrɛma a xa kira xɔn ma.

sentences.english: You will have the fruit of the work of your hands: happy will you be, and all will be well for you.
sentences.susu: I xa wali geeni luma i tan nan bɛ, a findi sɛɛwɛ nun harige ra i bɛ.

sentences.english: Your wife will be like a fertile vine in the inmost parts of your house: your children will be like olive plants round your table.
sentences.susu: I xa ginɛ luma nɛ alɔ wuri bogila i xa banxi kui, i xa die luma nɛ alɔ wuri nɛɛnɛe i xa teebili sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: See! this is the blessing of the worshipper of the Lord.
sentences.susu: A na na ki nɛ Alatala xa yaragaaxui bɛ, a barakaxi.

sentences.english: May the Lord send you blessing out of Zion: may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa i baraka kelife Siyoni. I xa Darisalamu harige to i xa simaya birin kui.

sentences.english: May you see your children's children. Peace be on Israel.
sentences.susu: I xa i xa die xa die to. Ala xa bɔɲɛsa lu Isirayila bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Great have been my troubles from the time when I was young (let Israel now say);
sentences.susu: Biyaasilae xa bɛɛti nde Isirayila xa a fala: N gerefae bara n tɔɔrɔ kabi n fonike tɛmui.

sentences.english: Great have been my troubles from the time when I was young, but my troubles have not overcome me.
sentences.susu: E bara n tɔɔrɔ a ɲaaxi ra kabi a fɔlɛ, kɔnɔ e mu nɔ n na.

sentences.english: The ploughmen were ploughing on my back; long were the wounds they made.
sentences.susu: E bara n fari ibɔɔ alɔ xɛ sae bɔxi bɔɔma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord is true: the cords of the evil-doers are broken in two.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala tinxin. A bara mixi kobie xa luuti xirixie bolon.

sentences.english: Let all the haters of Zion be shamed and turned back.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Siyoni xɔnmixie rayaagi.

sentences.english: Let them be like the grass on the house-tops, which is dry before it comes to full growth.
sentences.susu: Ala xa e lu alɔ banxi fari ɲooge, naxan xarama beenun a xa tala,

sentences.english: He who gets in the grain has no use for it; and they do not make bands of it for the grain-stems.
sentences.susu: naxan mu findima baloe ra xɛ sae bɛ.

sentences.english: And those who go by do not say, The blessing of the Lord be on you; we give you blessing in the name of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Dangi mixie naxa duba wo bɛ, a falafe ra, «Ala xa wo baraka. Muxu bara duba wo bɛ Alatala xili ra.»

sentences.english: Out of the deep have I sent up my cry to you, O Lord.
sentences.susu: Biyaasilae xa bɛɛti nde Alatala, n i xilima n ma tɔɔrɛ tilinxi nan kui.

sentences.english: Lord, let my voice come before you: let your ears be awake to the voice of my prayer.
sentences.susu: N Marigi, i xa i tuli mati n xui ra, i xa n ma maxandi ramɛ kinikini kui.

sentences.english: O Jah, if you took note of every sin, who would go free?
sentences.susu: Xa i tan Alatala ratuma mixie xa yunubie ma, nde nɔma tide i ya ra sɔnɔn?

sentences.english: But there is forgiveness with you, so that you may be feared.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan yunubie xafarima nɛ. Na kui mixi gaaxuma nɛ i ya ra.

sentences.english: I am waiting for the Lord, my soul is waiting for him, and my hope is in his word.
sentences.susu: N xaxili tixi Alatala nan na n nii birin na, n ya tixi a xa masenyi nan na.

sentences.english: My soul is watching for the Lord more than those who are watching for the morning; yes, more than the watchers for the morning.
sentences.susu: N xaxili naxan tixi n Marigi ra, na dangi taa makantɛ xa mamɛ ti ra kuye iba ra. A gbo na bɛ.

sentences.english: O Israel, have hope in the Lord; for with the Lord is mercy and full salvation.
sentences.susu: Isirayila, i xa i xaxili ti Alatala ra, barima i xa xanunteya na a bɔɲɛ kui, a i xunsare birin fima nɛ.

sentences.english: And he will make Israel free from all his sins.
sentences.susu: A tan nan Isirayila xun sarama a xa yunubie birin ma.

sentences.english: Lord, there is no pride in my heart and my eyes are not lifted up; and I have not taken part in great undertakings, or in things over-hard for me.
sentences.susu: Biyaasilae xa bɛɛti nde Dawuda naxan ba Alatala, yɛtɛ igboe mu n na, n mu la n yɛtɛ ra. N mu soma fee ya ma naxee sɛnbɛ gbo n bɛ, naxee dangi n ma fahaamui ra.

sentences.english: See, I have made my soul calm and quiet, like a child on its mother's breast; my soul is like a child on its mother's breast.
sentences.susu: N naxan nabaxi, n na n sabarixi nɛ, n na n nii raxara alɔ di dɛ baxi.

sentences.english: O Israel, have hope in the Lord, from this time and for ever.
sentences.susu: Isirayila, i xa i xaxili ti Alatala ra tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Lord, give thought to David, and to all his troubles;
sentences.susu: Biyaasilae xa bɛɛti nde Alatala, i xa ratu Dawuda ma a nun a xa tɔɔrɛ birin ma.

sentences.english: How he made an oath to the Lord, and gave his word to the great God of Jacob, saying,
sentences.susu: A naxa a rakali Alatala bɛ, a naxa a rakali Yaxuba Marigi Ala Sɛnbɛma bɛ,

sentences.english: Truly, I will not come into my house, or go to my bed,
sentences.susu: «N mu soma n xɔnyi, n mu n sama,

sentences.english: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or rest to my eyeballs,
sentences.susu: n mu n ya maxima, n mu n ya magirama,

sentences.english: Till I have got a place for the Lord, a resting-place for the great God of Jacob.
sentences.susu: han n sa lingira sɔtɔma Yaxuba Marigi Ala Sɛnbɛma bɛ tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: We had news of it at Ephrathah: we came to it in the fields of the wood.
sentences.susu: Won nu bara a xa fe mɛ Efarata bɔxi ma. Won naxa a li Yaara xa xɛ ma.

sentences.english: Let us go into his tent; let us give worship at his feet.
sentences.susu: «Won xɛɛ a xa hɔrɔmɔlingira yire, won xa won xinbi sin a santide ya i.

sentences.english: Come back, O Lord, to your resting-place; you and the ark of your strength.
sentences.susu: Alatala, keli i xa talu i sabatide, i tan nun i xa saatɛ kankira.

sentences.english: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness; and let your saints give cries of joy.
sentences.susu: I xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa lu xunnakeli kui, i dugutɛgɛe xa e sɛɛwɛ xui rate.»

sentences.english: Because of your servant David, do not give up your king.
sentences.susu: I xa konyi Dawuda xa fe ra, i naxa mɛɛ i xa mangɛ sugandixi ra.

sentences.english: The Lord gave a true oath to David, which he will not take back, saying, I will give your kingdom to the fruit of your body.
sentences.susu: Alatala a kali nɛ Dawuda bɛ, marakali naxan mu kanama, a naxɛ, «N i bɔnsɔɛ nde nan dɔxɔma i xa kibanyi ma.

sentences.english: If your children keep my word, and the teachings which I will give them, their children will be rulers of your kingdom for ever.
sentences.susu: Xa i xa die sa n ma saatɛ binya, e n ma yaamarie rabatu, e xa die fan luma nɛ i xa kibanyi ma abadan.»

sentences.english: For the Lord's heart is on Zion, desiring it for his resting-place.
sentences.susu: Barima Alatala bara Siyoni sugandi, mɛnni nan nafanxi a ma a sabatide ra.

sentences.english: This is my rest for ever: here will I ever be; for this is my desire.
sentences.susu: A naxɛ, «N sabatide nan be ra abadan. N dɔxɔma be n ma kibanyi kui barima be rafanxi n ma.

sentences.english: My blessing will be on her food; and her poor will be full of bread.
sentences.susu: N barakɛ sama nɛ Siyonikae ma, n baloe fi e xa misikiinɛe ma.

sentences.english: Her priests will be clothed with salvation; and her saints will give cries of joy.
sentences.susu: N kisi fima nɛ e xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ma, e dugutɛgɛe bɛɛti bama nɛ sɛɛwɛ kui.»

sentences.english: There I will make the horn of David fertile: I have made ready a light for my king.
sentences.susu: «Be n Dawuda sɛnbɛ rakelima nɛ, n naiyalanyi raminima nɛ n ma Mixi Sugandixi bɛ.

sentences.english: His haters will be clothed with shame; but I will make his crown shining.
sentences.susu: N yaagi dusuma nɛ a yaxuie xun na, kɔnɔ n nɔrɛ dusuma a tan nan xun na.»

sentences.english: See how good and how pleasing it is for brothers to be living together in harmony!
sentences.susu: Biyaasilae xa bɛɛti nde Dawuda naxan ba Ngaxakerenyie lanma e xa lu lanyi kui. Fe fanyi yati yati nan na ki.

sentences.english: It is like oil of great price on the head, flowing down over the face, even Aaron's face: coming down to the edge of his robe;
sentences.susu: Na fan alɔ ture naxan surusuruma Haruna xunyi ma, a fa goro a dɛxabe ma, han a dugi li.

sentences.english: Like the dew of Hermon, which comes down on the mountains of Zion: for there the Lord gave orders for the blessing, even life for ever.
sentences.susu: Na luma nɛ alɔ xini naxan goroma Xerimon nun Siyoni geyae ma, barima Alatala barakɛ nun kisi ragoroma naa abadan.

sentences.english: Give praise to the Lord, all you servants of the Lord, who take your places in the house of the Lord by night.
sentences.susu: Biyaasilae xa bɛɛti nde Wo tan Alatala xa konyie, wo xa Alatala matɔxɔ, wo tan naxee walima kɔɛ ra Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: Give praise to the Lord, lifting up your hands in his holy place.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo bɛlɛxɛ ite hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui Alatala matɔxɔfe ra.

sentences.english: May the Lord, who made heaven and earth, send you blessing out of Zion,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxan koore nun bɔxi daa, a xa barakɛ sa wo ma kelife Siyoni.

sentences.english: Let the Lord be praised. O you servants of the Lord, give praise to the name of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala matɔxɔ, wo a xili matɔxɔ. Alatala xa konyie, wo xa a matɔxɔ,

sentences.english: You who are in the house of the Lord, and in the open spaces of the house of our God,
sentences.susu: wo tan naxee walima Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, won tan naxee walima Ala xa banxi tɛtɛ kui.

sentences.english: Give praise to Jah, for he is good: make melody to his name, for it is pleasing.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Alatala matɔxɔ, barima a fan. Wo xa bɛɛti ba a xili matɔxɔfe ra, barima a rafan a ma.

sentences.english: For the Lord has taken Jacob for himself, and Israel for his property.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara Yaxuba sugandi a yɛtɛ bɛ, alako Isirayila xa findi a xa ɲama fanyi ra.

sentences.english: I know that the Lord is great, and that our Lord is greater than all other gods.
sentences.susu: N tan a kolon a Alatala gbo, won Marigi dangi alae birin na.

sentences.english: The Lord has done whatever was pleasing to him, in heaven, and on the earth, in the seas and in all the deep waters.
sentences.susu: Alatala a waxɔnfe rabama nɛ koore nun bɔxi ma, a a rabama nɛ baa tilinxie ma.

sentences.english: He makes the mists go up from the ends of the earth; he makes thunder-flames for the rain; he sends out the winds from his store-houses.
sentences.susu: A nuxuie ratema keli duniɲa tunxunyi naani ma, a tunɛ rafa nun seyamakɔnyi, a foye xungbe ramini a ragatade kui.

sentences.english: He put to death the first-fruits of Egypt, of man and of beast.
sentences.susu: A Misira di singee birin faxa, keli mixie ma han a sa xurusee li.

sentences.english: He sent signs and wonders among you, O Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.
sentences.susu: A naxa tɔnxumae nun kaabanakoe raba Misira, Firawuna nun a xa walikɛe birin xili ma.

sentences.english: He overcame great nations, and put strong kings to death;
sentences.susu: A naxa sie wuyaxi bɔnbɔ, a mangɛ sɛnbɛma gbegbe faxa.

sentences.english: Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan;
sentences.susu: A naxa Amorikae xa mangɛ Sixɔn, Basan mangɛ Ogo, nun Kanaan mangɛ birin xa bɔxi tongo,

sentences.english: And gave their land for a heritage, even for a heritage to Israel his people.
sentences.susu: a naxa a fi a xa ɲama Isirayila ma kɛ ra.

sentences.english: O Lord, your name is eternal; and the memory of you will have no end.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xili mu lɔɛma abadan, i xili ifalama nɛ tɛmui birin,

sentences.english: For the Lord will be judge of his people's cause; his feelings will be changed to his servants.
sentences.susu: barima Alatala fama nɛ a xa ɲama gbeɲɔxɔde, a fa kinikini a xa konyie ma.

sentences.english: The images of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
sentences.susu: Si naxee mu Ala kolon, e kuyee yailanma xɛɛma nun gbeti nan na e bɛlɛxɛe ra.

sentences.english: They have mouths, but no voice, they have eyes, but they do not see;
sentences.susu: Dɛ na na kuyee bɛ, kɔnɔ e mu wɔyɛnma. Yae na e bɛ, kɔnɔ e mu se toma.

sentences.english: They have ears, but no hearing; and there is no breath in their mouths.
sentences.susu: Tulie na e bɛ, kɔnɔ e mu fe mɛma. Ɲɛngi yo mu e fate i.

sentences.english: Those who make them are like them; and so is everyone who puts his hope in them.
sentences.susu: E rafalamae xa lu alɔ e tan, a nun naxee birin lama e ra.

sentences.english: Give praise to the Lord, O children of Israel: give praise to the Lord, O sons of Aaron:
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae, wo tan xa Alatala tantu. Haruna bɔnsɔɛ, wo xa Alatala tantu.

sentences.english: Give praise to the Lord, O sons of Levi: let all the worshippers of the Lord give him praise.
sentences.susu: Lewi bɔnsɔɛ, wo xa Alatala tantu. Wo tan Ala yaragaaxuie, wo xa Alatala tantu.

sentences.english: Praise be to the Lord out of Zion, even to the Lord whose house is in Jerusalem, Let the Lord be praised.
sentences.susu: Tantui na Alatala bɛ kelife Siyoni. Tantui na Alatala bɛ naxan sabatixi Darisalamu. Wo xa Alatala matɔxɔ!

sentences.english: O give praise to the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala tantu, barima a fan, dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma.

sentences.english: O give praise to the God of gods: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala tantu naxan dangi alae birin na, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma.

sentences.english: O give praise to the Lord of lords: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo marigie xa Marigi tantu, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma.

sentences.english: To him who only does great wonders: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a tan tantu, a tan naxan keren kaabanakoe rabama, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma,

sentences.english: To him who by wisdom made the heavens: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: a tan naxan koore daaxi a xa fahaamui ra, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma,

sentences.english: To him by whom the earth was stretched out over the waters: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: a tan naxan bɔxi itala yee fari, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma,

sentences.english: To him who made great lights: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: a tan naxan yanba se xungbee daaxi, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma,

sentences.english: The sun to have rule by day: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: soge, alako a xa yanyi iyalan, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma,

sentences.english: The moon and the stars to have rule by night: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: kike nun tunbuie, alako e xa kɔɛ iyalan, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma.

sentences.english: To him who put to death the first-fruits of Egypt: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:
sentences.susu: Wo xa a tan nan tantu, a tan naxan Misirakae xa di singee faxa, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma,

sentences.english: And took out Israel from among them: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:
sentences.susu: a tan naxan Isirayila ramini Misira bɔxi ma a sɛnbɛ nun a xa nɔɛ ra, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma,

sentences.english: With a strong hand and an outstretched arm: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: <range>

sentences.english: To him who made a way through the Red Sea: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:
sentences.susu: a tan naxan Xulunyumi baa ibolon firin na, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma,
