sentences.english: And let Israel go through it: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:
sentences.susu: a tan naxan Isirayilakae radangi baa tagi, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma,

sentences.english: By him Pharaoh and his army were overturned in the Red Sea: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: a tan naxan Firawuna nun a xa ɲama rasin Xulunyumi baa xɔɔra, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma.

sentences.english: To him who took his people through the waste land: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a tan nan tantu, a tan naxan a xa ɲama radangi gbengberenyi ra, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma,

sentences.english: To him who overcame great kings: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:
sentences.susu: a tan naxan mangɛ xungbee faxa, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma,

sentences.english: And put noble kings to death: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:
sentences.susu: a tan naxan mangɛ sɛnbɛmae faxa, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma,

sentences.english: Sihon, king of the Amorites: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:
sentences.susu: alɔ Amori mangɛ Sixɔn, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma,

sentences.english: And Og, king of Bashan: for his mercy is unchanging for ever:
sentences.susu: alɔ Basan mangɛ Ogo, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma,

sentences.english: And gave their land to his people for a heritage: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: a tan naxan e xa bɔxi fi a xa konyi Isirayila ma kɛ ra, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma.

sentences.english: Even a heritage for his servant Israel: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: <range>

sentences.english: Who kept us in mind when we were in trouble: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a tan nan tantu, a tan naxan ratuxi muxu xa konyiya ma, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma,

sentences.english: And has taken us out of the hands of our haters: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: a tan naxan muxu baxi muxu yaxuie yi ra, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma,

sentences.english: Who gives food to all flesh: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: a tan naxan nɛmɛ fima a xa daali birin ma, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma.

sentences.english: O give praise to the God of heaven: for his mercy is unchanging for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo Ala tantu naxan na koore ma, barima dan mu na a xa xanunteya ma.

sentences.english: By the rivers of Babylon we were seated, weeping at the memory of Zion,
sentences.susu: Muxu nu dɔxɔxi Babilɔn xuree dɛ ra Siyoni xa fe ratufe ra.

sentences.english: Hanging our instruments of music on the trees by the waterside.
sentences.susu: Muxu nu bara muxu xa kɔrae gbaku wuri bilie kɔn na.

sentences.english: For there those who had taken us prisoners made request for a song; and those who had taken away all we had gave us orders to be glad, saying, Give us one of the songs of Zion.
sentences.susu: Muxu yaxuie nu Siyoni bɛɛtie maxɔrin muxu ma, e nu wama bɛɛti sɛɛwaxi nde xɔn. E naxɛ, «Siyoni bɛɛti nde ba muxu bɛ.»

sentences.english: How may we give the Lord's song in a strange land?
sentences.susu: Muxu nɔma bɛɛti bade Alatala bɛ yi konyiya kui di?

sentences.english: If I keep not your memory, O Jerusalem, let not my right hand keep the memory of its art.
sentences.susu: Darisalamu, xa n nɛɛmu i ma, n bɛlɛxɛ naxa nɔ kɔra raberede sɔnɔn,

sentences.english: If I let you go out of my thoughts, and if I do not put Jerusalem before my greatest joy, let my tongue be fixed to the roof of my mouth.
sentences.susu: n nɛnyi xa kankan n dɛ kui. Na xa raba n na xa a sa li n naxa nɛɛmu Darisalamu ma, xa a xa fe mu findi n ma sɛɛwɛ ra.

sentences.english: O Lord, keep in mind against the children of Edom the day of Jerusalem; how they said, Let it be uncovered, uncovered even to its base.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa ratu Edonkae xa fe raba ma Darisalamu xa nimisɛ lɔxɔɛ. E tan nan nu a falama, «Won xa a kana han won sa a ba a bunyi ra.»

sentences.english: O daughter of Babylon, whose fate is destruction; happy is the man who does to you what you have done to us.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn, wo xa xunnagore bara gɛ ɲanigede, sɛɛwɛ na a bɛ naxan i sare ragbilenma i ma, i fe ɲaaxi naxan nabaxi muxu ra.

sentences.english: Happy is the man who takes your little ones, crushing them against the rocks.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ na mixi bɛ naxan i xa die suxuma, a e butuxun fanye fari.

sentences.english: I will give you praise with all my heart: I will make melody to you before the gods.
sentences.susu: N i batuma nɛ n bɔɲɛ birin na, n i matɔxɔ alae ya i.

sentences.english: I will give worship before your holy Temple, praising your name for your mercy and for your unchanging faith: for you have made your word greater than all your name.
sentences.susu: N na n xinbi sinma nɛ i xa hɔrɔmɔlingira mabiri, n i xili matɔxɔ i xa xanunteya nun dugutɛgɛɲa xa fe ra, barima i bara i xili nun i xa masenyi rate fe birin xun na.

sentences.english: When my cry came to your ears you gave me an answer, and made me great with strength in my soul.
sentences.susu: N to i xili, i naxa n yaabi, i naxa n nalimaniya i sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: All the kings of the earth will give you praise, O Lord, when the words of your mouth come to their ears.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxee birin na yi duniɲa ma, e na i xa masenyi ramɛ, e xa i matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: They will make songs about the ways of the Lord; for great is the glory of the Lord.
sentences.susu: E xa Alatala xa kira matɔxɔ, barima Alatala xa nɔrɛ gbo.

sentences.english: Though the Lord is high, he sees those who are low; and he has knowledge from far off of those who are lifted up.
sentences.susu: Hali Alatala na koore ma, a mɛɛnima nɛ mixi magoroxie ma, kɔnɔ a makuyama nɛ yɛtɛ igboee ra.

sentences.english: Even when trouble is round me, you will give me life; your hand will be stretched out against the wrath of my haters, and your right hand will be my salvation.
sentences.susu: N na lu tɔɔrɛ kui, i n nakisima nɛ, i n yaxuie xa xɔnɛ xun nakanama nɛ, i fa n nakisi i sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: The Lord will make all things complete for me: O Lord, your mercy is eternal; do not give up the works of your hands.
sentences.susu: Alatala n ma fee rakamalima nɛ. Alatala, dan mu na i xa xanunteya ma. I naxa i xa daalie rabolo.

sentences.english: O Lord, you have knowledge of me, searching out all my secrets.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ Alatala, i n bɔɲɛ birin kolon.

sentences.english: You have knowledge when I am seated and when I get up, you see my thoughts from far away.
sentences.susu: I n dɔxɔ tɛmui kolon, i n keli tɛmui kolon, i n ma maɲɔxunyie birin kolon beenun n xa e maɲɔxun.

sentences.english: You keep watch over my steps and my sleep, and have knowledge of all my ways.
sentences.susu: I n ɲɛrɛ tɛmui kolon, i n sa tɛmui kolon, i n ma kirae birin kolon.

sentences.english: For there is not a word on my tongue which is not clear to you, O Lord.
sentences.susu: Beenun wɔyɛnyi xa mini n dɛ i, i tan ɲan bara a birin kolon.

sentences.english: I am shut in by you on every side, and you have put your hand on me.
sentences.susu: I n nabilinma nɛ i xɔnyɛe ra.

sentences.english: Such knowledge is a wonder greater than my powers; it is so high that I may not come near it.
sentences.susu: Na fe kolonyi makaabaxi gbo n tan bɛ, a dangi n ma fahaamui ra.

sentences.english: Where may I go from your spirit? how may I go in flight from you?
sentences.susu: N sigama minden, n xa n makuya i Xaxili ra? N na n gima minden, n xa n nɔxun i ma?

sentences.english: If I go up to heaven, you are there: or if I make my bed in the underworld, you are there.
sentences.susu: Xa n sa te koore nɛ, i na mɛnni. Xa n sa goro aligiyama nɛ, n i lima nɛ naa.

sentences.english: If I take the wings of the morning, and go to the farthest parts of the sea;
sentences.susu: Xa n sa keli subaxɛ ma, n baa igiri,

sentences.english: Even there will I be guided by your hand, and your right hand will keep me.
sentences.susu: i bɛlɛxɛ n naɲɛrɛma nɛ, i sɛnbɛ n malima nɛ.

sentences.english: If I say, Only let me be covered by the dark, and the light about me be night;
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li n fa a fala, «N nɔma n nɔxunde dimi kui naiyalanyi mu na dɛnnaxɛ,»

sentences.english: Even the dark is not dark to you; the night is as bright as the day: for dark and light are the same to you.
sentences.susu: i n toma nɛ na dimi kui alɔ n na soge nan bun ma.

sentences.english: My flesh was made by you, and my parts joined together in my mother's body.
sentences.susu: I tan nan n nii daaxi, i tan nan n nafalaxi n nga tɛɛgɛ.

sentences.english: I will give you praise, for I am strangely and delicately formed; your works are great wonders, and of this my soul is fully conscious.
sentences.susu: N i matɔxɔma nɛ barima n daa ki makaaba. I xa wali maniyɛ mu na. N na kolonxi a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: My frame was not unseen by you when I was made secretly, and strangely formed in the lowest parts of the earth.
sentences.susu: N fate ki mu nu nɔxunxi i ma a to yailanxi gundo kui.

sentences.english: Your eyes saw my unformed substance; in your book all my days were recorded, even those which were purposed before they had come into being.
sentences.susu: I yae naxa n to beenun n xa findi a ra. N ma lɔxɔɛe birin nu sɛbɛxi i xa buki kui beenun n xa daali.

sentences.english: How dear are your thoughts to me, O God! how great is the number of them!
sentences.susu: Ala, i xa maɲɔxunyie gbo, e tilin.

sentences.english: If I made up their number, it would be more than the grains of sand; when I am awake, I am still with you.
sentences.susu: Xa n sa e kɔntima nɛ nu, e wuya mɛyɛnyi xɔri bɛ. Na birin kui, n luma i yi.

sentences.english: If only you would put the sinners to death, O God; go far from me, you men of blood.
sentences.susu: Ala, yandi, i xa mixi ɲaaxie faxa, i xa faxɛtie makuya n na.

sentences.english: For they go against you with evil designs, and your haters make sport of your name.
sentences.susu: I yaxuie fe ɲaaxi falama i xa fe ra, e i xili kanama.

sentences.english: Are not your haters hated by me, O Lord? are not those who are lifted up against you a cause of grief to me?
sentences.susu: Alatala, a mu lanma n xa i xɔnmixie xɔn? A mu lanma i matandilae xa raɲaaxu n ma?

sentences.english: My hate for them is complete; my thoughts of them are as if they were making war on me.
sentences.susu: N e xɔnma nɛ. E bara findi n yaxuie ra.

sentences.english: O God, let the secrets of my heart be uncovered, and let my wandering thoughts be tested:
sentences.susu: Ala i xa n bɔɲɛ kui mato, i xa n ma kɔntɔfili kolon.

sentences.english: See if there is any way of sorrow in me, and be my guide in the eternal way.
sentences.susu: A mato xa n na kira kobi nde nan xɔn ma, i naxan xɔnxi. Xa a na na ki nɛ, i xa n ti kisi kira nan xɔn ma.

sentences.english: O Lord, take me out of the power of the evil man; keep me safe from the violent man:
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti bɛɛtibae xa mangɛ bɛ

sentences.english: For their hearts are full of evil designs; and they are ever making ready causes of war.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n natanga mixi ɲaaxie yi ra, naxee wama n tɔɔrɔfe,

sentences.english: Their tongues are sharp like the tongue of a snake; the poison of snakes is under their lips. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: naxee natɛ tongoma e bɔɲɛ ma gere masofe ra lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ.

sentences.english: O Lord, take me out of the hands of sinners; keep me safe from the violent man: for they are designing my downfall.
sentences.susu: E xa wɔyɛnyi xɔnɔ alɔ bɔximase xa xɔnɛ. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: The men of pride have put secret cords for my feet; stretching nets in my way, so that they may take me with their tricks. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa n natanga mixi ɲaaxie bɛlɛxɛ i. I xa n natanga mixi kobie ma naxee wama n nabirafe.

sentences.english: I have said to the Lord, You are my God: give ear, O Lord, to the voice of my prayer.
sentences.susu: I xa n natanga yɛtɛ igboe xa gantanyi nun luutie ma, naxee yɛlɛe italama n ma kirae ra n suxufe ra.

sentences.english: O Lord God, the strength of my salvation, you have been a cover over my head in the day of the fight.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n Marigi Ala nan i ra. I xa i tuli mati n wa xui ra.

sentences.english: O Lord, give not the wrongdoer his desire; give him no help in his evil designs, or he may be uplifted in pride. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: Alatala, n nakisima sɛnbɛma, naxan n natangama n gere lɔxɔɛ,

sentences.english: As for those who come round me, let their heads be covered by the evil of their lips.
sentences.susu: i naxa tin mixi kobie waxɔnfe ra, i naxa na sɔɔnɛya e bɛ alako e xun naxa fa rakeli. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: Let burning flames come down on them: let them be put into the fire, and into deep waters, so that they may not get up again.
sentences.susu: N gerefae xa fe ɲaaxi maxirixie xa gbilen e ma.

sentences.english: Let not a man of evil tongue be safe on earth: let destruction overtake the violent man with blow on blow.
sentences.susu: Tɛ wole xa dɔxɔ e xun na, e xa radin tɛ xɔɔra, e naxa fa mini na kui sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: I am certain that the Lord will take care of the cause of the poor, and of the rights of those who are troubled.
sentences.susu: Fe ɲaaxi rabae naxa sabati yi bɔxi ma, tɔɔrɛ nan tun xa ragiri e ma.

sentences.english: Truly, the upright will give praise to your name: the holy will have a place in your house.
sentences.susu: N a kolon Alatala kiiti fanyi sama nɛ misikiinɛe bɛ, a nɔndi fima setaree ma.

sentences.english: Lord, I have made my cry to you; come to me quickly; give ear to my voice, when it goes up to you.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti Alatala, n bara i maxandi, i xulun n malife ra, i xa i tuli mati n ma maxandi ra.

sentences.english: Let my prayer be ordered before you like a sweet smell; and let the lifting up of my hands be like the evening offering.
sentences.susu: N ma duba xa te i mabiri alɔ surayi xiri, n ma bɛlɛxɛ ti xa lu alɔ nunmare sɛrɛxɛ.

sentences.english: O Lord, keep a watch over my mouth; keep the door of my lips.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n dɛ makanta alako fe ɲaaxi yo naxa mini n dɛ kui.

sentences.english: Keep my heart from desiring any evil thing, or from taking part in the sins of the evil-doers with men who do wrong: and let me have no part in their good things.
sentences.susu: I naxa tin n bɔɲɛ xa siga fe ɲaaxi ma, n naxa lan wali kobi rabae ma n ma geeni xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Let the upright give me punishment; and let the god-fearing man put me in the right way; but I will not let the oil of sinners come on my head: when they do evil I will give myself to prayer.
sentences.susu: Xa tinxintɔɛ n bɔnbɔ, a fan n bɛ, a xa xurui fan alɔ labundɛ naxan sama n fate ma. N mu tondima na fe ra. Kɔnɔ n Ala maxandima a xa mixi ɲaaxi waxɔnfe kana.

sentences.english: When destruction comes to their judges by the side of the rock, they will give ear to my words, for they are sweet.
sentences.susu: E xa kiitisae xa radin gelenyi ra. Mixi ɲaaxie xa a kolon n ma masenyi fan.

sentences.english: Our bones are broken up at the mouth of the underworld, as the earth is broken by the plough.
sentences.susu: E xa a fala, «Muxu xɔrie bara yensen aligiyama, alɔ xɛ sa bɔxi buxama ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: But my eyes are turned to you, O Lord God: my hope is in you; let not my soul be given up to death.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n Marigi Alatala, n ya tixi i tan na. N kantari toma i sɛɛti ma, i naxa n nii rabolo.

sentences.english: Keep me from the net which they have put down for me, and from the designs of the workers of evil.
sentences.susu: N natanga gantanyie ma e naxee tema n bɛ, n natanga mixi ɲaaxie xa yɛlɛe ma.

sentences.english: Let the sinners be taken in the nets which they themselves have put down, while I go free.
sentences.susu: E tan xa suxu nee ra, n tan xa kisi.

sentences.english: The sound of my cry went up to the Lord; with my voice I made my prayer for grace to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa lɔnni bɛɛti a to nu na fɔnmɛ ra

sentences.english: I put all my sorrows before him; and made clear to him all my trouble.
sentences.susu: N na n xui ratema Alatala nan ma kinikini xa fe ra.

sentences.english: When my spirit is overcome, your eyes are on my goings; nets have been secretly placed in the way in which I go.
sentences.susu: N na n ma kɔntɔfili dɛntɛgɛma a tan nan bɛ, n na n ma nimisɛ ya ba a bɛ.

sentences.english: Looking to my right side, I saw no man who was my friend: I had no safe place; no one had any care for my soul.
sentences.susu: Limaniya na ba n yi ra, i tan n sigade kolon. E bara gantanyi te n bɛ n ma kira ra.

sentences.english: I have made my cry to you, O Lord; I have said, You are my safe place, and my heritage in the land of the living.
sentences.susu: N nabilinyi mato: mixi yo mu na n bɛ, kantari mu na n bɛ, mɛɛnima yo mu na n bɛ.

sentences.english: Give ear to my cry, for I am made very low: take me out of the hands of my haters, for they are stronger than I.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i tan nan keren peti na n bɛ sɔnɔn. I keren nan findixi n kantama ra yi duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari.

sentences.english: Take my soul out of prison, so that I may give praise to your name: the upright will give praise because of me; for you have given me a full reward.
sentences.susu: I xa n wa xui mɛ, barima n sɛnbɛ birin bara ɲɔn. N ba n kerimae yi ra, barima e sɛnbɛ gbo n bɛ.

sentences.english: Let my prayer come to you, O Lord; give ear to my requests for your grace; keep faith with me, and give me an answer in your righteousness;
sentences.susu: Alatala, i tuli mati n ma maxandi ra, i xa kinikini n wa xui ma. I xa n ma duba suxu i xa dugutɛgɛɲa nun i xa tinxinyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Let not your servant come before you to be judged; for no man living is upright in your eyes.
sentences.susu: I naxa i xa konyi makiiti, barima daali yo mu tinxin i ya i.

sentences.english: The evil man has gone after my soul; my life is crushed down to the earth: he has put me in the dark, like those who have long been dead.
sentences.susu: N yaxui birama nɛ n fɔxɔ ra, a n boronma nɛ bɔxi ma, a n luma nɛ faxɛ niini bun ma alɔ faxamixie.

sentences.english: Because of this my spirit is overcome; and my heart is full of fear.
sentences.susu: Na kui n xaxili bara ifu. Limaniya bara ba n yi.

sentences.english: I keep in mind the early days of the past, giving thought to all your acts, even to the work of your hands.
sentences.susu: N natuma nɛ lɔxɔɛ dangixie ma, n na n xaxili rasigama i xa wali birin ma, n na n ɲɔxɔ rasiga i xa daalie ma.

sentences.english: My hands are stretched out to you: my soul is turned to you, like a land in need of water. (Selah.)
sentences.susu: N na n bɛlɛxɛ italama nɛ i bɛ, n nii i fenma nɛ alɔ gbengberenyi ye fenma ki naxɛ. Ɲɛngi rate.

sentences.english: Be quick in answering me, O Lord, for the strength of my spirit is gone: let me see your face, so that I may not be like those who go down into the underworld.
sentences.susu: Alatala, yandi, i xulun n yaabife ra. Limaniya bara gɛ bade n yi ra. I naxa i kobe raso n na, xa na mu n luma nɛ alɔ faxamixie.

sentences.english: Let the story of your mercy come to me in the morning, for my hope is in you: give me knowledge of the way in which I am to go; for my soul is lifted up to you.
sentences.susu: Kuye na iba, i xa i xa dugutɛgɛɲa masen n bɛ, barima n xaxili tixi i tan nan na. N ɲɛrɛ kira masen n bɛ, barima n xaxili tixi i tan nan na.

sentences.english: O Lord, take me out of the hands of my haters; my soul is waiting for you.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n natanga n yaxuie ma, barima n kantari sɔtɔma i niini nan bun ma.

sentences.english: Give me teaching so that I may do your pleasure; for you are my God: let your good Spirit be my guide into the land of righteousness.
sentences.susu: N xaran i waxɔnfe rabafe ra, barima i tan nan na n Marigi Ala ra. I Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa n ti kira fanyi xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Give me life, O Lord, because of your name; in your righteousness take my soul out of trouble.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa n nakisi i xili xa fe ra, i xa n ba tɔɔrɛ kui i xa tinxinyi xa fe ra,

sentences.english: And in your mercy put an end to my haters, and send destruction on all those who are against my soul; for I am your servant.
sentences.susu: i xa n yaxuie dɛ balan i xa dugutɛgɛɲa xa fe ra, i xa n gerefae xun nakana, barima i xa konyi nan lanxi n ma.

sentences.english: Praise be to the God of my strength, teaching my hands the use of the sword, and my fingers the art of fighting:
sentences.susu: Dawuda xa bɛɛti Tantui na Alatala bɛ, naxan findixi n ma fanye ra, naxan n bɛlɛxɛ rawalima a xa gere kui,

sentences.english: He is my strength, and my Rock; my high tower, and my saviour; my keeper and my hope: he gives me authority over my people.
sentences.susu: naxan findixi n xanuntenyi sɛnbɛma ra, naxan findixi n kantama nun n nakisima ra, naxan nɔma n yaxuie ra alako n xa kantari sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Lord, what is man, that you keep him in mind? or the son of man that you take him into account?
sentences.susu: Alatala, munse na adama ra i to fa mɛɛnixi a ma? Munse na adama xa di ra i to fa i ɲɔxɔ saxi a xɔn ma?

sentences.english: Man is like a breath: his life is like a shade which is quickly gone.
sentences.susu: Adamadi luxi nɛ alɔ ɲɛngi foye, a xa simaya dangima nɛ alɔ niini dangima ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Come down, O Lord, from your heavens: at your touch let the mountains give out smoke.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa koore rabi i gorofe ra, i fa din geyae ra alako tuuri xa te.

sentences.english: With your storm-flames send them in flight: send out your arrows for their destruction.
sentences.susu: I xa seyamakɔnyi rabula yaxuie rayensenfe ra. Xalie woli alako e xa siga.

sentences.english: Put out your hand from on high; make me free, take me safely out of the great waters, and out of the hands of strange men;
sentences.susu: I xa i bɛlɛxɛ itala kelife koore ma, alako i xa n nakisi, i xa n natanga n yaxuie ma alɔ mixi ratangama mɔrɔnyie ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: In whose mouths are false words, and whose right hand is a right hand of deceit.
sentences.susu: N nakisi wule falɛe ma naxee wama n madaxufe.

sentences.english: I will make a new song to you, O God; I will make melody to you on an instrument of ten cords.
sentences.susu: Ala, n bɛɛti nɛɛnɛ bama nɛ i bɛ n ma kɔra luuti fu daaxi xui ra.

sentences.english: It is God who gives salvation to kings; and who kept his servant David from the wounding sword.
sentences.susu: N i matɔxɔma nɛ, i tan naxan mangɛe xun nakelima, naxan i xa konyi Dawuda ratangama santidɛgɛma ɲaaxi ma.

sentences.english: Make me free, and take me out of the hands of strange men, in whose mouths are false words, and whose right hand is a right hand of deceit.
sentences.susu: N nakisi, n natanga n yaxuie ma, naxan wule falama mixi madaxufe ra.

sentences.english: Our sons are like tall young plants; and our daughters like the shining stones of a king's house;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui muxu xa di xɛmɛe fanma nɛ alɔ wuri bilie, muxu xa di ginɛe tofanma nɛ alɔ kɔntigiba, naxee masolixi mangɛ banxi kui.

sentences.english: Our store-houses are full of all good things; and our sheep give birth to thousands and ten thousands in our fields.
sentences.susu: Muxu xa banxie rafema nɛ daxamui mɔɔli birin na, muxu xa gɔɔrɛe wuyama nɛ a wulu wulu ma,

sentences.english: Our oxen are well weighted down; our cows give birth safely; there is no going out, and there is no cry of sorrow in our open places.
sentences.susu: Muxu xa ningee xungboma nɛ, lanyuru yo mu luma e ma, e furi mu birama, sɔnxɔɛ mu mɛma muxu malandee.

sentences.english: Happy is the nation whose ways are so ordered: yes, happy is the nation whose God is the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ na ɲama bɛ Ala fama yi fe mɔɔli rabade naxan na. Sɛɛwɛ na ɲama bɛ Alatala findixi naxan Marigi Ala ra.

sentences.english: Let me give glory to you, O God, my King; and blessing to your name for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: N ma Mangɛ Ala, n i matɔxɔma nɛ, n i xili tantuma nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: Every day will I give you blessing, praising your name for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ n i matɔxɔma nɛ, n i xili tantuma nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; his power may never be searched out.
sentences.susu: Alatala sɛnbɛ gbo, matɔxɔɛ birin na a tan nan bɛ, adamadi mu nɔma sode na birin kui.

sentences.english: One generation after another will give praise to your great acts, and make clear the operation of your strength.
sentences.susu: Yi waxati mixie fama nɛ i xa kaabanakoe falade boore waxati mixie bɛ.

sentences.english: My thoughts will be of the honour and glory of your rule, and of the wonder of your works.
sentences.susu: E fama nɛ i xa nɔrɛ tofanyi masende. N luma nɛ i xa kaabanakoe maɲɔxun na.

sentences.english: Men will be talking of the power and fear of your acts; I will give word of your glory.
sentences.susu: E fama nɛ i sɛnbɛ magaaxuxi xa fe falade. N luma nɛ i xa kaabanakoe masen na.

sentences.english: Their sayings will be full of the memory of all your mercy, and they will make songs of your righteousness.
sentences.susu: E fama nɛ ɲɛlɛxinde i xa hinnɛ xungbe ra, e i xa tinxinyi masenma nɛ bɛɛti sɛɛwaxi ra.

sentences.english: The Lord is full of grace and pity; not quickly angry, but great in mercy.
sentences.susu: Alatala hinnɛ mixi ra, a kinikini, a diɲɛxi, a xa xanunteya gbo.

sentences.english: The Lord is good to all men; and his mercies are over all his works.
sentences.susu: Alatala fe fanyi rabama mixi birin bɛ, a kinikini a xa daali birin ma.

sentences.english: All the works of your hands give praise to you, O Lord; and your saints give you blessing.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa daalie birin i matɔxɔma nɛ, i xa sɛniyɛntɔɛe i tantuma nɛ.

sentences.english: Their words will be of the glory of your kingdom, and their talk of your strength;
sentences.susu: E i xa mangɛya xungbe xa fe masenma nɛ, e i sɛnbɛ xa fe falama nɛ,

sentences.english: So that the sons of men may have knowledge of his acts of power, and of the great glory of his kingdom.
sentences.susu: alako mixie xa i xa kaabanakoe kolon, a nun i xa mangɛya nɔrɔxi.

sentences.english: Your kingdom is an eternal kingdom, and your rule is through all generations.
sentences.susu: I xa mangɛya mu ɲɔnma nɛ, i xa nɔɛ buma nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: The Lord is the support of all who are crushed, and the lifter up of all who are bent down.
sentences.susu: Alatala bira mixi malima, a mixi magoroxi xun nakelima nɛ.

sentences.english: The eyes of all men are waiting for you; and you give them their food in its time.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa birin a xaxili tixi i ra, i tan nan e baloma a waxati.

sentences.english: By the opening of your hand, every living thing has its desire in full measure.
sentences.susu: I tan nan i bɛlɛxɛ rabima, i birin nawasa e hayi na naxan ma.

sentences.english: The Lord is upright in all his ways, and kind in all his works.
sentences.susu: Alatala tinxin a xa fe birin kui, a dugutɛgɛxi a xa daalie ma.

sentences.english: The Lord is near all those who give honour to his name; even to all who give honour to him with true hearts.
sentences.susu: Alatala makɔrɛ a maxandilae ra, naxee a maxandima e bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra.

sentences.english: To his worshippers, he will give their desire; their cry comes to his ears, and he gives them salvation.
sentences.susu: A a yaragaaxuie waxɔnfe rabama nɛ, a e xa duba suxuma nɛ, a e rakisi.

sentences.english: The Lord will keep all his worshippers from danger; but he will send destruction on all sinners.
sentences.susu: Alatala a xanuntenyie makantama nɛ, kɔnɔ a mixi ɲaaxie birin sɔntɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: My mouth will give praise to the Lord; let all flesh be blessing his holy name for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: N dɛ Alatala matɔxɔma nɛ. Daali xa a xili sɛniyɛnxi matɔxɔ tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Let the Lord be praised. Give praise to the Lord, O my soul.
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala matɔxɔ! N nii xa Alatala matɔxɔ,

sentences.english: While I have breath I will give praise to the Lord: I will make melody to my God while I have my being.
sentences.susu: n xa a matɔxɔ n ma simaya birin na. N n Marigi Alatala matɔxɔma nɛ bɛɛti ra, fanni n na n nii ra.

sentences.english: Put not your faith in rulers, or in the son of man, in whom there is no salvation.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo yɛtɛ taxu mixi xungbee ra, barima adamadie na e ra, naxee mu nɔma mixi rakiside.

sentences.english: Man's breath goes out, he is turned back again to dust; in that day all his purposes come to an end.
sentences.susu: E nii bama nɛ e fate i, e gbilen bɛndɛ. Na lɔxɔɛ yati, e naxan ɲanigexi, na birin ɲɔnma nɛ.

sentences.english: Happy is the man who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the Lord his God:
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ na mixi bɛ, Yaxuba Marigi Ala naxan malima. Sɛɛwɛ na mixi bɛ, naxan a xaxili tima a Marigi Alatala ra,

sentences.english: Who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all things in them; who keeps faith for ever:
sentences.susu: Ala naxan koore nun bɔxi daa, Ala naxan baa nun a kui see birin daa, dugutɛgɛɲa na Ala naxan bɛ abadan.

sentences.english: Who gives their rights to those who are crushed down; and gives food to those who are in need of it: the Lord makes the prisoners free;
sentences.susu: Alatala tɔɔɲɛgɛtɔɛe xun mafalama, a donse fima kaamɛtɔɛe ma, a geelimanie raminima geeli kui,

sentences.english: The Lord makes open the eyes of the blind; the Lord is the lifter up of those who are bent down; the Lord is a lover of the upright;
sentences.susu: a dɔnxuie ya rabɔɔma, a mixi magoroxie xun nakelima, a tinxintɔɛe xanuma,

sentences.english: The Lord takes care of those who are in a strange land; he gives help to the widow and to the child who has no father; but he sends destruction on the way of sinners.
sentences.susu: a mɛɛnima xɔɲɛe ma, a kiridie nun kaaɲɛ ginɛe bun tima, kɔnɔ a mixi ɲaaxie tan xun nakanama nɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord will be King for ever; your God, O Zion, will be King through all generations. Praise be to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Siyoni, wo Marigi Alatala xa mangɛya mu ɲɔnma abadan. Wo xa Alatala matɔxɔ!

sentences.english: Give praise to the Lord; for it is good to make melody to our God; praise is pleasing and beautiful.
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala matɔxɔ. A lanma Alatala xa matɔxɔ bɛɛti ra. Fe fanyi na a ra.

sentences.english: The Lord is building up Jerusalem; he makes all the outlaws of Israel come together.
sentences.susu: Alatala na gbilenfe Darisalamu ti ra, a Isirayila xa mixi rafama nɛ kelife konyiya kui,

sentences.english: He makes the broken-hearted well, and puts oil on their wounds.
sentences.susu: a tɔɔrɔmixie ralimaniyama, a e rayalanma e xa fure kui.

sentences.english: He sees the number of the stars; he gives them all their names.
sentences.susu: Alatala tunbuie kɔnti kolon, a e birin xilima e xili ra.

sentences.english: Great is our Lord, and great his power; there is no limit to his wisdom.
sentences.susu: Won Marigi Alatala sɛnbɛ gbo, dan mu na a xa fahaamui ma.

sentences.english: The Lord gives help to the poor in spirit; but he sends sinners down in shame.
sentences.susu: Alatala mixi magoroxi bun tima, kɔnɔ a yɛtɛ igboe xa fe kanama.

sentences.english: Make songs of praise to the Lord; make melody to our God with instruments of music.
sentences.susu: Wo xa bɛɛti ba Alatala bɛ tantui ra, wo xa bɛɛti ba Ala bɛ kɔrae xui ra.

sentences.english: By his hand the heaven is covered with clouds and rain is stored up for the earth; he makes the grass tall on the mountains.
sentences.susu: A tan nan nuxui raminima koore ma, a tunɛ rafa bɔxi ma, a sansie rasoli geyae fari.

sentences.english: He gives food to every beast, and to the young ravens in answer to their cry.
sentences.susu: A xurusee rabaloma, a donse fima xaxa yɔrɛe ma, e na e xui ramini tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: He has no delight in the strength of a horse; he takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
sentences.susu: Soe sɛnbɛ mu findixi fefe ra Ala bɛ. Xɛmɛ xa sɛnbɛ mu findixi fefe ra Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord takes pleasure in his worshippers, and in those whose hope is in his mercy.
sentences.susu: Ala yaragaaxuiya nan nafanma a ma. Ala wama mixi xɔn naxan xaxili tixi a xa xanunteya ra.

sentences.english: Give praise to the Lord, O Jerusalem; give praise to your God, O Zion.
sentences.susu: Darisalamu, i xa Alatala matɔxɔ. Siyoni, i xa Ala tantu,

sentences.english: He has made strong the iron bands of your doors; he has sent blessings on your children inside your walls.
sentences.susu: barima a tan nan i xa naadɛ makantama, a tan nan barakɛ sama i xa ɲama ma.

sentences.english: He gives peace in all your land, making your stores full of fat grain.
sentences.susu: A bɔɲɛsa fima i xa bɔxi ma, a donse fanyi fima i ma.

sentences.english: He sends out his orders to the earth; his word goes out quickly.
sentences.susu: Alatala duniɲa yamarima, a a waxɔnfe rayensenma mafuren mafuren.

sentences.english: He gives snow like wool; he sends out ice-drops like dust.
sentences.susu: A balabalanyi ragoroma nɛ alɔ gɛsɛ fute, a na rayensen alɔ tɛ xube.

sentences.english: He sends down ice like raindrops: water is made hard by his cold.
sentences.susu: A ragoro bɔxi ma, nde nɔma tide na xinbeli ya ra?

sentences.english: At the outgoing of his word, the ice is turned to water; when he sends out his wind, there is a flowing of waters.
sentences.susu: A na a xui ramini e ma, e xunuma nɛ, a na foye rafa, balabalanyi man findima nɛ ye ra.

sentences.english: He makes his word clear to Jacob, teaching Israel his laws and his decisions.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara Annabi Yaxuba rakolon a xa masenyi ra, a bara a xa sɛriyɛ nun a xa yaamarie masen Isirayila bɛ.

sentences.english: He has not done these things for any other nation: and as for his laws, they have no knowledge of them. Let the Lord be praised.
sentences.susu: A mu na mɔɔli ragirixi si gbɛtɛ yo bɛ. Nee luma Ala xa sɛriyɛe kolontareya nan kui. Wo xa Alatala matɔxɔ!

sentences.english: Give praise to the Lord. Let the Lord be praised from the heavens: give him praise in the skies.
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala matɔxɔ! Wo Alatala matɔxɔ kelife koore ma. Wo a matɔxɔ yire itexi kui.

sentences.english: Give praise to him, all you his angels: give praise to him, all his armies.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛe xa a matɔxɔ, a xa galie xa a matɔxɔ koore ma.

sentences.english: Give praise to him, you sun and moon: give praise to him, all you stars of light.
sentences.susu: Soge nun kike xa a matɔxɔ, tunbui dɛxɛxie fan xa a matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: Give praise to him, you highest heavens, and you waters which are over the heavens.
sentences.susu: Koore xa a matɔxɔ, a nun ye naxan toma naa.

sentences.english: Let them give praise to the name of the Lord: for he gave the order, and they were made.
sentences.susu: E birin xa Alatala xili matɔxɔ, barima a yamari nan fi, e naxa daa.

sentences.english: He has put them in their places for ever; he has given them their limits which may not be broken.
sentences.susu: A naxa e ti e tide, e xa lu naa abadan. A naxa na sɛriyɛ sa, naxan mu kanama.

sentences.english: Give praise to the Lord from the earth, you great sea-beasts, and deep places:
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala matɔxɔ kelife bɔxi ma. Baa nun nimase birin naxee na baa tilinyi kui,

sentences.english: Fire and rain of ice, snow and mists; storm-wind, doing his word:
sentences.susu: seyamakɔnyi, balabalanyi, kunda, nuxuie, nun foye xungbe naxan a xa yaamari ratinmɛma,

sentences.english: Mountains and all hills; fruit-trees and all trees of the mountains:
sentences.susu: geyae nun tentenyie, wuri bogilae nun sɛdiri bilie,

sentences.english: Beasts and all cattle; insects and winged birds:
sentences.susu: wulai subee nun xurusee, bubusee nun xɔnie,

sentences.english: Kings of the earth, and all peoples; rulers and all judges of the earth:
sentences.susu: duniɲa mangɛe nun sie, mangɛdie nun duniɲa kuntigie,

sentences.english: Young men and virgins; old men and children:
sentences.susu: fonikee nun ginɛdimɛdie, dimɛe nun forie,

sentences.english: Let them give glory to the name of the Lord: for his name only is to be praised: his kingdom is over the earth and the heaven.
sentences.susu: e birin xa Alatala xili matɔxɔ, barima a xili gbansan nan itexi, a nɔrɛ dangi koore nun bɔxi ra.

sentences.english: He has put on high the horn of his people, for the praise of all his saints; even the children of Israel, a people which is near to him. Let the Lord be praised.
sentences.susu: A bara mangɛ sɛnbɛma rakeli a xa ɲama xun na, a xa sɛniyɛntɔɛe naxan matɔxɔma, sɛniyɛntɔɛe naxan findixi Isirayila a xa ɲama xanuxi ra. Wo Alatala matɔxɔ!

sentences.english: Let the Lord be praised. Make a new song to the Lord, let his praise be in the meeting of his saints.
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala matɔxɔ! Wo bɛɛti nɛɛnɛ ba a bɛ, wo matɔxɔɛ raba a batulae tagi.

sentences.english: Let Israel have joy in his maker; let the children of Zion be glad in their King.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa sɛɛwa a daali Marigi ra. Siyoni ɲama xa sɛɛwa e xa Mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: Let them give praise to his name in the dance: let them make melody to him with instruments of brass and corded instruments of music.
sentences.susu: E xa a xili matɔxɔ fare boron yi ra, e xa bɛɛtie ba maxase nun kɔra xui ra,

sentences.english: For the Lord has pleasure in his people: he gives the poor in spirit a crown of salvation.
sentences.susu: barima Alatala sɛɛwaxi a xa ɲama ra, a kisi fima nɛ yɛtɛ magoroe ma.

sentences.english: Let the saints have joy and glory: let them give cries of joy on their beds.
sentences.susu: A xa sɛniyɛntɔɛe xa sɛɛwa yi binyɛ ra, e xa e sɛɛwɛ xui ite hali e xa sadee ma.

sentences.english: Let the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hands;
sentences.susu: Ala matɔxɔɛ xa lu e dɛ i. Na luxi alɔ santidɛgɛma xaaɲɛxi e bɛlɛxɛ kui,

sentences.english: To give the nations the reward of their sins, and the peoples their punishment;
sentences.susu: e naxan nawalima e gbe ɲɔxɔfe ra, si ɲaaxie ɲaxankatafe ra.

sentences.english: To put their kings in chains, and their rulers in bands of iron;
sentences.susu: E e yaxuie xa mangɛe sama nɛ yɔlɔnxɔnyie ra, e e xa yareratie xirima nɛ a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra,

sentences.english: To give them the punishment which is in the holy writings: this honour is given to all his saints. Praise be to the Lord.
sentences.susu: na fa findi e xa kobiɲa sare ra. Xunnakeli belebele nan na ki Ala xa sɛniyɛntɔɛe bɛ. Wo xa Alatala matɔxɔ!

sentences.english: Let the Lord be praised. Give praise to God in his holy place: give him praise in the heaven of his power.
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala matɔxɔ! Wo xa Ala matɔxɔ a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui. Wo xa a matɔxɔ koore ma.

sentences.english: Give him praise for his acts of power: give him praise in the measure of his great strength.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a matɔxɔ a xa kaabanakoe xa fe ra. Wo xa a matɔxɔ a sɛnbɛ xungbe xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Give him praise with the sound of the horn: give him praise with corded instruments of music.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a matɔxɔ feri xui nun kɔra xui ra,

sentences.english: Give him praise with instruments of brass and in the dance: give him praise with horns and corded instruments.
sentences.susu: wo xa a matɔxɔ maxase nun fare boron yi ra, wo xa a matɔxɔ kɔra maniyɛ nun xule xui ra,

sentences.english: Give him praise with the loud brass: give him praise with the high-sounding brass.
sentences.susu: wo xa a matɔxɔ maxase xui itexi ra.

sentences.english: Let everything which has breath give praise to the Lord. Let the Lord be praised.
sentences.susu: Nimase birin xa Alatala matɔxɔ. Wo Alatala matɔxɔ!

sentences.english: The wise sayings of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ Dawuda xa di Sulemani, xa taalie nan ya:

sentences.english: To have knowledge of wise teaching; to be clear about the words of reason:
sentences.susu: E sɛbɛxi nɛ mixie bɛ alako e xa lɔnni, e xa rasi, xaxili fanyi xa lu e bɛ,

sentences.english: To be trained in the ways of wisdom, in righteousness and judging truly and straight behaviour:
sentences.susu: xurui fanyi xa lu e yi, e xa bira tinxinyi, nɔndi, nun fe fanyi fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: To make the simple-minded sharp, and to give the young man knowledge, and serious purpose:
sentences.susu: Xaxili fanyi mu naxee yi, nee xa na sɔtɔ, maɲɔxunyi fanyi xa lu fonikee bɛ, e xa fe fanyie kolon, e lan e xa naxee raba.

sentences.english: (The wise man, hearing, will get greater learning, and the acts of the man of good sense will be wisely guided:)
sentences.susu: Lɔnnila xa a tuli mati alako a xa fe kolonyi xun xa masa. Xaxilima xa a tuli mati, alako a xa ɲɛrɛ ki fanyi kolon,

sentences.english: To get the sense of wise sayings and secrets, and of the words of the wise and their dark sayings.
sentences.susu: taali kui fiixɛfe xa sɔɔnɛya e bɛ, e xa fahaamui sɔtɔ lɔnnilae xa masenyie nun taalie ma.

sentences.english: The fear of the Lord is the start of knowledge: but the foolish have no use for wisdom and teaching.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa yaragaaxui findixi lɔnni fɔlɛ nan na. Xaxilitaree nan yoma lɔnni nun marasi ma.

sentences.english: My son, give ear to the training of your father, and do not give up the teaching of your mother:
sentences.susu: N ma di, i i tuli mati i baba xa marasi ra, i naxa tondi i nga xa xurui ra,

sentences.english: For they will be a crown of grace for your head, and chain-ornaments about your neck.
sentences.susu: barima xunmase tofanyi nan findima a ra i xunyi ma, kɔn magore nan a ra i kɔnyi ma.

sentences.english: My son, if sinners would take you out of the right way, do not go with them.
sentences.susu: N ma di, i naxa tin yunubitɔɛe xa i ratantan.

sentences.english: If they say, Come with us; let us make designs against the good, waiting secretly for the upright, without cause;
sentences.susu: Xa e a fala, «Bira muxu fɔxɔ ra, won xa sa kira madɔxɔ mixie bɛ, won xa e faxa, won xa gantanyi te mixie bɛ naxee mu fefe rabaxi won na,

sentences.english: Let us overcome them living, like the underworld, and in their strength, as those who go down to death;
sentences.susu: Won xa e xun nakana, alɔ gaburi a rabama ki naxɛ mixie ra naxee sigama aligiyama.

sentences.english: Goods of great price will be ours, our houses will be full of wealth;
sentences.susu: Won fama naafuli sɔtɔde na kui, won ma banxie rafema nɛ se fanyie ra.

sentences.english: Take your chance with us, and we will all have one money-bag:
sentences.susu: Lu muxu ya ma alako i xa nde sɔtɔ, won ma kɔbiri malande xa findi keren na.»

sentences.english: My son, do not go with them; keep your feet from their ways:
sentences.susu: N ma di, i naxa bira na mixi mɔɔli fɔxɔ ra, i naxa lu na kira xɔn ma,

sentences.english: For their feet are running after evil, and they are quick to take a man's life.
sentences.susu: barima e fe ɲaaxi nan tun nabama, e gbataxi mixi nii bade.

sentences.english: Truly, to no purpose is the net stretched out before the eyes of the bird:
sentences.susu: Gantanyi mu tema xɔni ya xɔri,

sentences.english: And they are secretly waiting for their blood and making ready destruction for themselves.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ e tan gantanyi tema e yɛtɛ kan suxuse nan na. E e yɛtɛ nan nii bafe e yɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: Such is the fate of everyone who goes in search of profit; it takes away the life of its owners.
sentences.susu: Birafe geeni tinxintare fɔxɔ ra, nun mixi nii bafe, na kira mɔɔli findima gantanyi nan na.

sentences.english: Wisdom is crying out in the street; her voice is loud in the open places;
sentences.susu: Xaxilimaya xili tima kira xunyie ra, a a xui raminima taa malandee.

sentences.english: Her words are sounding in the meeting-places, and in the doorways of the town:
sentences.susu: A xili tima ɲama tagi, a wɔyɛnma taa sode dɛe ra.

sentences.english: How long, you simple ones, will foolish things be dear to you? and pride a delight to the haters of authority? how long will the foolish go on hating knowledge?
sentences.susu: A naxɛ, «I tan xaxilitare, i birama xaxilitareɲa fɔxɔ ra han mun tɛmui? Mixi mayelee yoma mixi ma han mun tɛmui? Xaxilitaree fe kolonyi xɔnma han mun tɛmui?

sentences.english: Be turned again by my sharp words: see, I will send the flow of my spirit on you, and make my words clear to you.
sentences.susu: Wo gbilen fa ra n ma marasie ma. N na n xaxili luma nɛ wo ma, n fahaamui fima nɛ wo ma n ma masenyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Because your ears were shut to my voice; no one gave attention to my out-stretched hand;
sentences.susu: N bara wo xili, kɔnɔ wo mu n ma xili ratinxi. N bara n bɛlɛxɛ itala wo bɛ, kɔnɔ wo bara tondi.

sentences.english: You were not controlled by my guiding, and would have nothing to do with my sharp words:
sentences.susu: Wo to bara tondi n ma marasie birin na, wo to mu tinxi n ma sɛriyɛ ra,

sentences.english: So in the day of your trouble I will be laughing; I will make sport of your fear;
sentences.susu: n fan fama nɛ yelede wo ma wo xa tɔɔrɛ kui. Gaaxui na wo bɔɲɛe ramini a i, n mu wo malima fefe ma.

sentences.english: When your fear comes on you like a storm, and your trouble like a rushing wind; when pain and sorrow come on you.
sentences.susu: Gaaxui fama nɛ wo lide alɔ turunnaadɛ foye, tɔɔrɛ fama nɛ wo suxude alɔ foye xungbe. Na tɔɔrɛ nun kɔntɔfili na wo li tɛmui naxɛ,

sentences.english: Then I will give no answer to their cries; searching for me early, they will not see me:
sentences.susu: wo n xilima nɛ, kɔnɔ n mu wo xa xili ratinma. Wo n fenma nɛ, kɔnɔ wo mu n toma,

sentences.english: For they were haters of knowledge, and did not give their hearts to the fear of the Lord:
sentences.susu: barima wo bara xaxilimaya xɔn, wo bara tondi Alatala xa yaragaaxui ra.

sentences.english: They had no desire for my teaching, and my words of protest were as nothing to them.
sentences.susu: E mu nu wama n ma marasie xɔn, e mu nu wama n ma sɛriyɛ suxufe.

sentences.english: So the fruit of their way will be their food, and with the designs of their hearts they will be made full.
sentences.susu: Na kui e fama e xa wali sare sɔtɔde, e fama e ɲɛrɛ ki raɲɔnyi tode.

sentences.english: For the turning back of the simple from teaching will be the cause of their death, and the peace of the foolish will be their destruction.
sentences.susu: Xaxilitareɲa nan fama xaxilitaree gande. Lɔnnitareɲa nan fama lɔnnitaree gande.

sentences.english: But whoever gives ear to me will take his rest safely, living in peace without fear of evil.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ naxan tan a tuli matima n na, na kanyi luma nɛ kantari kui a xɔnyi, a lu bɔɲɛsa kui, a mu gaaxuma tɔɔrɛ ya ra.»

sentences.english: My son, if you will take my words to your heart, storing up my laws in your mind;
sentences.susu: N ma di, xa i n ma masenyie suxu, xa i n ma sɛriyɛ rabatu,

sentences.english: So that your ear gives attention to wisdom, and your heart is turned to knowledge;
sentences.susu: xa i i tuli mati lɔnni ra, xa nɔndi rafan i bɔɲɛ ma,

sentences.english: Truly, if you are crying out for good sense, and your request is for knowledge;
sentences.susu: xa i xaxili fanyi fen, xa i nɔndi maxili,

sentences.english: If you are looking for her as for silver, and searching for her as for stored-up wealth;
sentences.susu: xa i a fen alɔ gbeti, xa i a fen a fanyi ra alɔ bannaya fenma ki naxɛ,

sentences.english: Then the fear of the Lord will be clear to you, and knowledge of God will be yours.
sentences.susu: na kui, i Alatala xa yaragaaxui kolonma nɛ, i Ala xa fe fahaamuma nɛ,

sentences.english: For the Lord gives wisdom; out of his mouth come knowledge and reason:
sentences.susu: barima Alatala nan lɔnni fima, xaxili fanyi nun nɔndi minima a kɛrɛ i.

sentences.english: He has salvation stored up for the upright, he is a breastplate to those in whom there is no evil;
sentences.susu: A fe fanyi gbegbe ragatama tinxintɔɛe bɛ. A nɔndi falɛ makantama.

sentences.english: He keeps watch on the ways which are right, and takes care of those who have the fear of him.
sentences.susu: A mixi tinxinxi makantama, a a xanuntenyie ratangama kira xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Then you will have knowledge of righteousness and right acting, and upright behaviour, even of every good way.
sentences.susu: Na kui, i nɔndi nun tinxinyi kolonma nɛ, kira tinxinxi naxee mixi tima fe fanyi ma.

sentences.english: For wisdom will come into your heart, and knowledge will be pleasing to your soul;
sentences.susu: Lɔnni fama i bɔɲɛ nan ma, fe kolonyi ɲɔxunma i bɛ,

sentences.english: Wise purposes will be watching over you, and knowledge will keep you;
sentences.susu: xaxili fanyi i ratangama, nɔndi i makantama,

sentences.english: Giving you salvation from the evil man, from those whose words are false;
sentences.susu: a i ratangama kira ɲaaxi ma, a i ratangama wɔyɛn kobi falɛ ma,

sentences.english: Who give up the way of righteousness, to go by dark roads;
sentences.susu: naxee gbilenma tinxinyi kira fɔxɔ ra, naxee ɲɛrɛma dimi kui,

sentences.english: Who take pleasure in wrongdoing, and have joy in the evil designs of the sinner;
sentences.susu: fe ɲaaxi rafanxi naxee ma, naxee ɲɛlɛxinxi kobiɲa ra,

sentences.english: Whose ways are not straight, and whose footsteps are turned to evil:
sentences.susu: naxee xa kira mu tinxin, naxee ɲɛrɛ ki mu fan.

sentences.english: To take you out of the power of the strange woman, who says smooth words with her tongue;
sentences.susu: Lɔnni i ratangama nɛ ginɛ ɲaaxi ma, langoe ginɛ xa dɛ iɲɔxunyi ma,

sentences.english: Who is false to the husband of her early years, and does not keep the agreement of her God in mind:
sentences.susu: naxan a xa xɛmɛ singe finsiriwalima, naxan nɛɛmuma a Marigi Ala xa saatɛ ma.

sentences.english: For her house is on the way down to death; her footsteps go down to the shades:
sentences.susu: A xa wali kobi a rabirama nɛ, a ɲɛrɛ ki a xanin aligiyama.

sentences.english: Those who go to her do not come back again; their feet do not keep in the ways of life:
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee birama a fɔxɔ ra, e mu gbilenma sɔnɔn, e mu kisi sɔtɔma.

sentences.english: So that you may go in the way of good men, and keep in the footsteps of the upright.
sentences.susu: A lanma i xa i ɲɛrɛ mixi fanyie nan ma kira ra, i xa tinxintɔɛe xa kira suxu.

sentences.english: For the upright will be living in the land, and the good will have it for their heritage.
sentences.susu: Mixi tinxinxie luma nɛ yi bɔxi ma, mixi hagigɛe mu kelima be,

sentences.english: But sinners will be cut off from the land, and those whose acts are false will be uprooted.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxie tan ɲɔnma nɛ yi bɔxi ma, tinxintaree kerima nɛ.

sentences.english: My son, keep my teaching in your memory, and my rules in your heart:
sentences.susu: N ma di, i naxa nɛɛmu n ma marasie ma, i bɔɲɛ xa n ma sɛriyɛ rabatu,

sentences.english: For they will give you increase of days, years of life, and peace.
sentences.susu: barima e fama i xa simaya xɔn nakuyade bɔɲɛsa kui.

sentences.english: Let not mercy and good faith go from you; let them be hanging round your neck, recorded on your heart;
sentences.susu: I naxa dugutɛgɛɲa nun nɔndi rabɛɲin, i xa e xiri i kɔn ma, i xa e sɛbɛ i sondonyi ma.

sentences.english: So you will have grace and a good name in the eyes of God and men.
sentences.susu: I fama hinnɛ nun xaxili fanyi sɔtɔde na ki nɛ, Ala nun adamadie ya i.

sentences.english: Put all your hope in God, not looking to your reason for support.
sentences.susu: I yɛtɛ taxu Alatala ra i bɔɲɛ birin na, i naxa la i yɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: In all your ways give ear to him, and he will make straight your footsteps.
sentences.susu: I xa Ala kolon i xa kira birin xɔn, a tan nan fama ɲɛrɛ ki fanyi masende i bɛ.

sentences.english: Put no high value on your wisdom: let the fear of the Lord be before you, and keep yourself from evil:
sentences.susu: I naxa i xaxili ti i yɛtɛ ra, i xa gaaxu Alatala ya ra, i xa gbilen fe ɲaaxi fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: This will give strength to your flesh, and new life to your bones.
sentences.susu: Na findima yalanyi nan na i fate bɛ, a sɛnbɛ fi i xɔrie ma.

sentences.english: Give honour to the Lord with your wealth, and with the first-fruits of all your increase:
sentences.susu: Alatala binya i harige ra, i xa daxamui singe fi a ma.

sentences.english: So your store-houses will be full of grain, and your vessels overflowing with new wine.
sentences.susu: Na nan a niyama baloe nun minse gbo i yi ra, i xa sagae birin nafe.

sentences.english: My son, do not make your heart hard against the Lord's teaching; do not be made angry by his training:
sentences.susu: N ma di, i naxa tondi Alatala xa matinxinyi ra, i xa a xa marasie suxu,

sentences.english: For to those who are dear to him the Lord says sharp words, and makes the son in whom he has delight undergo pain.
sentences.susu: barima Alatala marasi fima nɛ a xanuntenyie ma, alɔ babae e xa di matinxinma marafanyi kui ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Happy is the man who makes discovery of wisdom, and he who gets knowledge.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ na mixi bɛ naxan xaxilimaya sɔtɔxi, sɛɛwɛ na adama bɛ naxan fahaamui sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: For trading in it is better than trading in silver, and its profit greater than bright gold.
sentences.susu: Xaxilimaya xa geeni gbo gbeti bɛ, a tide dangi xɛɛma ra.

sentences.english: She is of more value than jewels, and nothing for which you may have a desire is fair in comparison with her.
sentences.susu: A fan gɛmɛ tofanyi bɛ, a tide dangi i waxɔnse birin na.

sentences.english: Long life is in her right hand, and in her left are wealth and honour.
sentences.susu: Xaxilimaya findima simaya xɔnkuye nan na, a findi bannaya nun xunnakeli ra.

sentences.english: Her ways are ways of delight, and all her goings are peace.
sentences.susu: Xaxilimaya kira fan, a bɔɲɛsa fima adamadie ma.

sentences.english: She is a tree of life to all who take her in their hands, and happy is everyone who keeps her.
sentences.susu: A findixi simaya wuri nan na a suxumae bɛ. Mixi naxee kankanma lɔnni ma, nee sɛɛwama nɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord by wisdom put in position the bases of the earth; by reason he put the heavens in their place.
sentences.susu: Alatala bɔxi yailanxi lɔnni nan na, a koore yailanxi xaxili fanyi nan na.

sentences.english: By his knowledge the deep was parted, and dew came dropping from the skies.
sentences.susu: A xa lɔnni nan ye raminixi bɔxi ma, a xa xaxili fanyi nan ye ragataxi nuxuie kui.

sentences.english: My son, keep good sense, and do not let wise purpose go from your eyes.
sentences.susu: N ma di, sɛriyɛ nun nɔndi ragata i bɔɲɛ kui, e naxa makuya i ra.

sentences.english: So they will be life for your soul, and grace for your neck.
sentences.susu: E simaya nun hinnɛ fima nɛ i ma,

sentences.english: Then you will go safely on your way, and your feet will have no cause for slipping.
sentences.susu: i xa duniɲɛigiri sɔɔnɛyama nɛ, i mu dinkonma.

sentences.english: When you take your rest you will have no fear, and on your bed sleep will be sweet to you.
sentences.susu: I na i sa, i mu gaaxuma, i xima nɛ a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Have no fear of sudden danger, or of the storm which will come on evil-doers:
sentences.susu: I naxa gaaxu gbaloe ya ra, i naxa gaaxu mixi ɲaaxie xa gere ya ra,

sentences.english: For the Lord will be your hope, and will keep your foot from being taken in the net.
sentences.susu: barima Alatala nan na i xa xaxilisa ra. A i ratangama nɛ gantanyi birin ma.

sentences.english: Do not keep back good from those who have a right to it, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.
sentences.susu: I naxa tondi mixi malide i nɔma naxan na.

sentences.english: Say not to your neighbour, Go, and come again, and tomorrow I will give; when you have it by you at the time.
sentences.susu: I naxa a fala i boore bɛ, «Siga, tina i fa,» xa a mali xa fɛɛrɛ na i bɛ to.

sentences.english: Do not make evil designs against your neighbour, when he is living with you without fear.
sentences.susu: I naxa i dɛfanboore yanfa.

sentences.english: Do not take up a cause at law against a man for nothing, if he has done you no wrong.
sentences.susu: I naxa mixi tɔɔɲɛgɛ, naxan mu fe ɲaaxi yo rabaxi i ra.

sentences.english: Have no envy of the violent man, or take any of his ways as an example.
sentences.susu: I naxa geresoe tɔɔnɛ, i naxa bira a ɲɛrɛ ki fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: For the wrong-hearted man is hated by the Lord, but he is a friend to the upright.
sentences.susu: Alatala mixi ɲaaxi xɔnma, kɔnɔ tinxintɔɛ tan nafan a ma.

sentences.english: The curse of the Lord is on the house of the evil-doer, but his blessing is on the tent of the upright.
sentences.susu: Alatala mixi ɲaaxi xa banxi dankama nɛ, kɔnɔ a barakɛ sama nɛ tinxintɔɛ sabatide ma.

sentences.english: He makes sport of the men of pride, but he gives grace to the gentle-hearted.
sentences.susu: Ala yɛtɛ igboe igoroma nɛ, kɔnɔ a hinnɛma mixi magoroxi tan na.

sentences.english: The wise will have glory for their heritage, but shame will be the reward of the foolish.
sentences.susu: Xaxilimae nɔrɔma nɛ, kɔnɔ xaxilitaree tan yaagi nan sɔtɔma.

sentences.english: Give ear, my sons, to the teaching of a father; give attention so that you may have knowledge:
sentences.susu: N ma die, wo wo tuli mati wo baba xa marasi ra, wo wo ɲɛngi sa na xɔn ma alako wo xa xaxili sɔtɔ,

sentences.english: For I give you good teaching; do not give up the knowledge you are getting from me.
sentences.susu: barima n na lɔnni fanyi nan fife wo ma yi ki. Wo naxa tondi n ma masenyi ra.

sentences.english: For I was a son to my father, a gentle and an only one to my mother.
sentences.susu: Di fanyi nan nu n na n baba bɛ. Di kerenyi nan nu n na n nga bɛ.

sentences.english: And he gave me teaching, saying to me, Keep my words in your heart; keep my rules so that you may have life:
sentences.susu: N baba nu n nasima yi wɔyɛnyi nan na, a naxɛ, «I xa n ma masenyi ragata i bɔɲɛ kui, i xa n ma sɛriyɛ suxu alako i xa simaya sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Get wisdom, get true knowledge; keep it in memory, do not be turned away from the words of my mouth.
sentences.susu: I xa lɔnni fen, xaxili fanyi xa lu i bɛ. I naxa nɛɛmu n ma masenyi ma, i naxa nɛɛmu n ma sɛriyɛ ma.

sentences.english: Do not give her up, and she will keep you; give her your love, and she will make you safe.
sentences.susu: I naxa e rabɛɲin, e i makantama nɛ. N ma sɛriyɛ xa rafan i ma, a i ratangama nɛ.»

sentences.english: The first sign of wisdom is to get wisdom; go, give all you have to get true knowledge.
sentences.susu: Lɔnni fɔlɛ nan yi ki: I xa lɔnni fen, i xa fe birin naba alako i xa xaxili sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Put her in a high place, and you will be lifted up by her; she will give you honour, when you give her your love.
sentences.susu: Xa i xaxilimaya binya, a i itema nɛ. Xa i a suxu, a i xunnakelima nɛ.

sentences.english: She will put a crown of grace on your head, giving you a head-dress of glory.
sentences.susu: A findima xunmase tofanyi nan na i xunyi ma, a findi diyaman xa yanbɛ ra i bɛ.

sentences.english: Give ear, O my son, and let your heart be open to my sayings; and long life will be yours.
sentences.susu: N ma di, xa i i tuli mati n ma masenyi ra, i xa simaya xɔn kuyama nɛ.

sentences.english: I have given you teaching in the way of wisdom, guiding your steps in the straight way.
sentences.susu: N bara xaxilimaya kira masen i bɛ, n bara i ti kira tinxinxi xɔn ma.

sentences.english: When you go, your way will not be narrow, and in running you will not have a fall.
sentences.susu: Xa i i ɲɛrɛma na kira nan ma, i mu tɔɔrɔma. Xa i i gima na kira nan xɔn ma, i mu dinkonma.

sentences.english: Take learning in your hands, do not let her go: keep her, for she is your life.
sentences.susu: Lɔnni suxu, i naxa a rabolo, i naxa a rabɛɲin, barima a findima simaya nan na i bɛ.

sentences.english: Do not go in the road of sinners, or be walking in the way of evil men.
sentences.susu: I naxa bira mixi ɲaaxi fɔxɔ ra, i naxa mixi kobi xa kira suxu.

sentences.english: Keep far from it, do not go near; be turned from it, and go on your way.
sentences.susu: I naxa ɲɛrɛ na xɔn, i naxa i makɔrɛ na ra. I kobe so na ra, i dangi.

sentences.english: For they take no rest till they have done evil; their sleep is taken away if they have not been the cause of someone's fall.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxie mu nɔma xide e mu fe ɲaaxi raba. Xi xɔli mu nɔma e suxude e mu mixi ratantan.

sentences.english: The bread of evil-doing is their food, the wine of violent acts their drink.
sentences.susu: Fe ɲaaxi findixi e xa donse nun minse nan na.

sentences.english: But the way of the upright is like the light of early morning, getting brighter and brighter till the full day.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛ xa kira nɔrɔma nɛ, a yanbɛ naiyalanyi raminima nɛ alɔ soge.

sentences.english: The way of sinners is dark; they see not the cause of their fall.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxie xa kira luxi nɛ alɔ dimi, e mu fe kolon naxan fama e rabirade.

sentences.english: My son, give attention to my words; let your ear be turned to my sayings.
sentences.susu: N ma di, i i ɲɛngi sa n ma masenyi xɔn ma, i i tuli mati n ma marasi ra.

sentences.english: Let them not go from your eyes; keep them deep in your heart.
sentences.susu: E mato tɛmui birin, i e ragata i sondonyi kui,

sentences.english: For they are life to him who gets them, and strength to all his flesh.
sentences.susu: barima e findima simaya nan na mixie bɛ, naxee e fahaamuma. E findima yalanyi nan na e fate bɛ.

sentences.english: And keep watch over your heart with all care; so you will have life.
sentences.susu: I bɔɲɛ kanta dangife se birin na, barima simaya kelima a tan nan ma.

sentences.english: Put away from you an evil tongue, and let false lips be far from you.
sentences.susu: Wule naxa mini i dɛ i, i naxa mixi madaxu i xa wɔyɛnyi ra.

sentences.english: Keep your eyes on what is in front of you, looking straight before you.
sentences.susu: I nɛ wɔyɛnma mixi bɛ, i i ya ti a ra, i naxa i ya rasiga yire gbɛtɛ.

sentences.english: Keep a watch on your behaviour; let all your ways be rightly ordered.
sentences.susu: I ɲɛngi sa i ɲɛrɛ ki xɔn ma, i lu kira fanyi xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Let there be no turning to the right or to the left, keep your feet from evil.
sentences.susu: I naxa binya yirefanyi ma, i naxa binya kɔɔla ma. I naxa i sanyi ti kira ɲaaxi xɔn ma.

sentences.english: My son, give attention to my wisdom; let your ear be turned to my teaching:
sentences.susu: N ma di, mɛɛni n ma lɔnni ma, i i tuli mati n ma xaxili fanyi ra,

sentences.english: So that you may be ruled by a wise purpose, and your lips may keep knowledge.
sentences.susu: alako i xa fahaamui sɔtɔ, i dɛ xa wɔyɛnyi xɔri fala.

sentences.english: For honey is dropping from the lips of the strange woman, and her mouth is smoother than oil;
sentences.susu: Langoe xa wɔyɛnyie ɲɔxun alɔ kumi, a masalaxun alɔ suloɲi,

sentences.english: But her end is bitter as wormwood, and sharp as a two-edged sword;
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ a raɲɔnyi xɔnɔ alɔ meli, a xɛɲɛn alɔ santidɛgɛma dɛ firinyi.

sentences.english: Her feet go down to death, and her steps to the underworld;
sentences.susu: A sanyie a xun tima gbaloe ra, a xa kira mixi xaninma aligiyama nɛ.

sentences.english: She never keeps her mind on the road of life; her ways are uncertain, she has no knowledge.
sentences.susu: A mu luma simaya kira xɔn ma. A lɔɛxi, kɔnɔ a mu a kolon.

sentences.english: Give ear to me then, my sons, and do not put away my words from you.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, n ma di, i i tuli mati n na, i naxa i makuya n ma masenyi ra.

sentences.english: Go far away from her, do not come near the door of her house;
sentences.susu: I makuya langoe xa kira ra, i naxa i makɔrɛ a xa banxi naadɛ ra,

sentences.english: For fear that you may give your honour to others, and your wealth to strange men:
sentences.susu: alako binyɛ naxa ba i ma, xɛmɛ ya ixaraxi naxa fa i xa duniɲɛigiri kana.

sentences.english: And strange men may be full of your wealth, and the fruit of your work go to the house of others;
sentences.susu: Xa na mu a ra mixi gbɛtɛe nan lugama i harige ra, i xa wali tɔnɛ lu booree bɛ,

sentences.english: And you will be full of grief at the end of your life, when your flesh and your body are wasted;
sentences.susu: i i xa simaya raɲɔn tɔɔrɛ kui, i fate birin ba i ma a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: And you will say, How was teaching hated by me, and my heart put no value on training;
sentences.susu: I a falama nɛ kɔrɛ, «N na marasi xɔn munfe ra? N bɔɲɛ tondi na sɛriyɛ ra munfe ra?

sentences.english: I did not give attention to the voice of my teachers, my ear was not turned to those who were guiding me!
sentences.susu: Munfe ra n mu n tuli mati n karamɔxɔɛe ra, n mu n tuli mati n nasimae ra?

sentences.english: I was in almost all evil in the company of the people.
sentences.susu: N fa na tɔɔrɛ birin dɔnxɔɛ nan kui yi ki ɲama ya xɔri.»

sentences.english: Let water from your store and not that of others be your drink, and running water from your fountain.
sentences.susu: Ye min, naxan minima i yɛtɛ xa kɔlɔnyi ra.

sentences.english: Let not your springs be flowing in the streets, or your streams of water in the open places.
sentences.susu: I naxa tin i xa kɔlɔnyi ye xa goro mixie bun ma, i naxa tin i xa ye xa makana taa kui.

sentences.english: Let them be for yourself only, not for other men with you.
sentences.susu: Na ye xa findi i keren nan gbe ra, i tan nun xɔɲɛe naxa na itaxun.

sentences.english: Let blessing be on your fountain; have joy in the wife of your early years.
sentences.susu: Barakɛ xa lu i xa kɔlɔnyi ma, i xa sɛɛwa i xa ginɛ ra i naxan futi i fonike ra.

sentences.english: As a loving hind and a gentle doe, let her breasts ever give you rapture; let your passion at all times be moved by her love.
sentences.susu: I xa ginɛ tofan alɔ bole, a fan alɔ xeli. A xa marafanyi xa lu i bɔɲɛ kui, i xa a maxanu tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Why let yourself, my son, go out of the way with a strange woman, and take another woman in your arms?
sentences.susu: N ma di, i birama mixi gbɛtɛ xa ginɛ fɔxɔ ra munfe ra? Munfe ra i ginɛ xiɲɛ sunbuma i gbe mu naxan na?

sentences.english: For a man's ways are before the eyes of the Lord, and he puts all his goings in the scales.
sentences.susu: Alatala adama ɲɛrɛ ki birin kolon. A adama xa kira birin toma.

sentences.english: The evil-doer will be taken in the net of his crimes, and prisoned in the cords of his sin.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxi xa wali ɲaaxie nan a suxuxi, a xa yangoe nan findixi gantanyi ra a bɛ.

sentences.english: He will come to his end for need of teaching; he is so foolish that he will go wandering from the right way.
sentences.susu: A xa xurutareɲa nan a niyama a faxa, a xa daxuɲa nan a niyama a bɔnɔ.

sentences.english: My son, if you have made yourself responsible for your neighbour, or given your word for another,
sentences.susu: N ma di, xa i i yɛtɛ taanixi i boore nde bɛ, i findixi hamilu ra a bɛ e nun mixi gbɛtɛ tagi,

sentences.english: You are taken as in a net by the words of your mouth, the sayings of your lips have overcome you.
sentences.susu: xa i i yɛtɛ raxɛtɛnxi i xa wɔyɛnyi nde ra, xa i i yɛtɛ xirixi na laayidi mɔɔli ra,

sentences.english: Do this, my son, and make yourself free, because you have come into the power of your neighbour; go without waiting, and make a strong request to your neighbour.
sentences.susu: n ma di, i xa fe birin naba i yɛtɛ raminide a kui, xa na mu a ra i luma nɛ i boore sagoe. Siga, i i felen i boore bɛ, i xa a mayandi.

sentences.english: Give no sleep to your eyes, or rest to them;
sentences.susu: I naxa xi de, na raba keren na.

sentences.english: Make yourself free, like the roe from the hand of the archer, and the bird from him who puts a net for her.
sentences.susu: I i yɛtɛ ratanga yi fe mɔɔli ma, alɔ xeli a yɛtɛ ratangama koyinma bɛlɛxɛ ma ki naxɛ, alɔ xɔni fan a yɛtɛ ratangama gantanyi ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Go to the ant, you hater of work; give thought to her ways and be wise:
sentences.susu: Tunnaxɔnɛ, siga dondoli yire. Marasi fen a ra, alako i xa findi xaxilima ra.

sentences.english: Having no chief, overseer, or ruler,
sentences.susu: Mangɛ mu na dondoli bɛ, kuntigi nun yarerati fan mu a bɛ,

sentences.english: She gets her meat in the summer, storing up food at the time of the grain-cutting.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ a walima sogofure tɛmui, alako a xa baloe sɔtɔ a naxan donma ɲɛmɛ ra.

sentences.english: How long will you be sleeping, O hater of work? when will you get up from your sleep?
sentences.susu: I tan tunnaxɔnɛ, i i sama han mun tɛmui? I kelima xixɔli ma tɛmui mundun?

sentences.english: A little sleep, a little rest, a little folding of the hands in sleep:
sentences.susu: Xixɔli na i suxu, i na kinsɔn, i na i sa,

sentences.english: Then loss will come on you like an outlaw, and your need like an armed man
sentences.susu: setareɲa fan fama nɛ i suxude tɛrɛnna ra, alɔ muɲɛti mixi tɛrɛnnama ki naxɛ. Kaamɛ i suxuma nɛ, alɔ sɔɔri mixi suxuma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: A good-for-nothing man is an evil-doer; he goes on his way causing trouble with false words;
sentences.susu: Fuyante mu tinxin, a wule raɲɛrɛma a dɛ i nɛ.

sentences.english: Making signs with his eyes, rubbing with his feet, and giving news with his fingers;
sentences.susu: A luma a ya magira ra, a nu mixi makebentin a sanyie nun a bɛlɛxɛe ra wule tɔnxuma ra.

sentences.english: His mind is ever designing evil: he lets loose violent acts.
sentences.susu: Fe ɲaaxi na a xaxili kui, a gere masoma tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: For this cause his downfall will be sudden; quickly he will be broken, and there will be no help for him.
sentences.susu: Na kui kasarɛ fama nɛ a suxude, a a xun nakana kerenyi ra.

sentences.english: Six things are hated by the Lord; seven things are disgusting to him:
sentences.susu: Fe senni na Alatala naxee xɔnxi, a mu tinma nee ra fefe ma:

sentences.english: Eyes of pride, a false tongue, hands which take life without cause;
sentences.susu: yɛtɛ igboe xa mixi mato ki, wule minima dɛ naxan kui, bɛlɛxɛ naxan nii bama fufafu ra,

sentences.english: A heart full of evil designs, feet which are quick in running after sin;
sentences.susu: bɔɲɛ naxan fe tinxintare maɲɔxunma, sanyi naxee e gima sigafe ra fe kobi rabade,

sentences.english: A false witness, breathing out untrue words, and one who lets loose violent acts among brothers.
sentences.susu: seede naxan wule falama, a nun mixi naxan ngaxakerenmae tagi isoma.

sentences.english: My son, keep the rule of your father, and have in memory the teaching of your mother:
sentences.susu: N ma di, i baba xa sɛriyɛ ragata, i naxa tondi i nga xa marasi ra.

sentences.english: Keep them ever folded in your heart, and have them hanging round your neck.
sentences.susu: E xa lu i bɔɲɛ kui tɛmui birin, e xiri i kɔn ma.

sentences.english: In your walking, it will be your guide; when you are sleeping, it will keep watch over you; when you are awake, it will have talk with you.
sentences.susu: E i raɲɛrɛma nɛ i xa duniɲɛigiri kui, e i makanta i xa sade ma, e i rasi i keli tɛmui.

sentences.english: For the rule is a light, and the teaching a shining light; and the guiding words of training are the way of life.
sentences.susu: Na sɛriyɛ findixi lanpui nan na, na xaranyi kira masenma nɛ i bɛ, na marasi i xun tima simaya kira nan xɔn ma.

sentences.english: They will keep you from the evil woman, from the smooth tongue of the strange woman.
sentences.susu: E i ratangama ginɛ kobi ma, nun xɔɲɛ ginɛ dɛ iɲɔxunxi ma.

sentences.english: Let not your heart's desire go after her fair body; let not her eyes take you prisoner.
sentences.susu: I naxa wa na ginɛ xɔn ma a xa tofanyi ma, i naxa tin a xa nɔ i ra a yae ra.

sentences.english: For a loose woman is looking for a cake of bread, but another man's wife goes after one's very life.
sentences.susu: Langoe ginɛ naxan mu na xɛmɛ taa, a mixi findima setare nan na, kɔnɔ ginɛ yɛnɛla naxan dɔxɔxi xɛmɛ nde xɔn, a mixi faxama nɛ.

sentences.english: May a man take fire to his breast without burning his clothing?
sentences.susu: Mixi nde nɔma tɛ tongode, a a sa a yuba kui, a fa lu a xa donma mu gan?

sentences.english: Or may one go on lighted coals, and his feet not be burned?
sentences.susu: Mixi nde nɔma a ɲɛrɛde tɛ wole tagi, a fa lu a sanyi mu gan?

sentences.english: So it is with him who goes in to his neighbour's wife; he who has anything to do with her will not go free from punishment.
sentences.susu: Na maniyama nɛ alɔ xɛmɛ naxan yabuma ginɛ xɛmɛ taa idɔxɔɛ ra. Xɛmɛ yo din na ginɛ ra, a fama ɲaxankatɛ nan sɔtɔde.

sentences.english: Men do not have a low opinion of a thief who takes food when he is in need of it:
sentences.susu: Mixi mu yoma muɲɛti ma, naxan muɲɛ tixi a xa kaamɛ ma,

sentences.english: But if he is taken in the act he will have to give back seven times as much, giving up all his property which is in his house.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ a na suxu fo a xa muɲafe sare fi, hali na findi a xa naafuli birin na.

sentences.english: Where there is much talk there will be no end to sin, but he who keeps his mouth shut does wisely.
sentences.susu: Wɔyɛnyi rawuyafe nɔma mixi findide yunubitɔɛ ra, kɔnɔ xaxilima tan a dɛ suxuma nɛ.

sentences.english: The tongue of the upright man is like tested silver: the heart of the evil-doer is of little value.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛ xa wɔyɛnyi tide gbo gbeti bɛ, kɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxi bɔɲɛ tide xurun.

sentences.english: The lips of the upright man give food to men, but the foolish come to death for need of sense.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛ xa marasi mixi raɲɛrɛma nɛ, kɔnɔ xaxilitare faxama lɔnnitareɲa nan kui.

sentences.english: The blessing of the Lord gives wealth: hard work makes it no greater.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa barakɛ nan mixi bannama, mixi sɛnbɛ mu sese sama na fari.

sentences.english: It is sport to the foolish man to do evil, but the man of good sense takes delight in wisdom.
sentences.susu: Fe ɲaaxi rafan mixi kobi ma, kɔnɔ lɔnni rafan xaxilima ma.

sentences.english: The thing feared by the evil-doer will come to him, but the upright man will get his desire.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxi hɛnmɛma fe naxan na, na nan a lima. Mixi tinxinxi waxɔnfe, Ala nan na nabama a bɛ.

sentences.english: When the storm-wind is past, the sinner is seen no longer, but the upright man is safe for ever.
sentences.susu: Fe xɔrɔxɔɛ na fa, mixi ɲaaxi yo mu tima, kɔnɔ tinxintɔɛ tan tima nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: Like acid drink to the teeth and as smoke to the eyes, so is the hater of work to those who send him.
sentences.susu: Muluxunyi fe naxan niyama mixi ɲinyi ra, tuuri fe naxan niyama mixi ya ra, tunnaxɔnɛ fan na nan niyama a xɛɛma ra.

sentences.english: The fear of the Lord gives long life, but the years of the evil-doer will be cut short.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa yaragaaxui simaya nan fima mixi ma, kɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxie xa simaya xɔn mu kuya.

sentences.english: The hope of the upright man will give joy, but the waiting of the evil-doer will have its end in sorrow.
sentences.susu: Mixi tinxinxie xa tina findima e bɛ sɛɛwɛ nan na, kɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxie xa tina findima e bɛ tɔɔrɛ nan na.

sentences.english: The way of the Lord is a strong tower for the upright man, but destruction to the workers of evil.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa kira findixi kantari nan na mixi tinxinxie bɛ, kɔnɔ a findixi halaki nan na tinxintaree bɛ.

sentences.english: The upright man will never be moved, but evil-doers will not have a safe resting-place in the land.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛ mu birama fefe ma, kɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxi mu luma bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: The mouth of the upright man is budding with wisdom, but the twisted tongue will be cut off.
sentences.susu: Mixi tinxinxi dɛ lɔnni nan masenma, kɔnɔ wule falɛ nɛnyi bolonma nɛ.

sentences.english: The lips of the upright man have knowledge of what is pleasing, but twisted are the mouths of evil-doers.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛ dɛ fe fanyi nan falama, kɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxi fe ɲaaxi nan falama.

sentences.english: Scales of deceit are hated by the Lord, but a true weight is his delight.
sentences.susu: Alatala sikeeli kamalitare nan xɔnxi, kɔnɔ sikeeli kamalixi rafan a ma.

sentences.english: When pride comes, there comes shame, but wisdom is with the quiet in spirit.
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛ igboɲa findima yaagi nan na, kɔnɔ yɛtɛ magore findima lɔnni nan na.

sentences.english: The righteousness of the upright will be their guide, but the twisted ways of the false will be their destruction.
sentences.susu: Tinxinyi tinxintɔɛ raɲɛrɛma nɛ, kɔnɔ tinxintareya yanfante halakima nɛ.

sentences.english: Wealth is of no profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness keeps a man safe from death.
sentences.susu: Naafuli mu mixi malima Ala xa kiiti lɔxɔɛ, tinxinyi gbansan nan mixi ratangama na faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: The righteousness of the good man will make his way straight, but the sin of the evil-doer will be the cause of his fall.
sentences.susu: Tinxinyi tinxintɔɛ raɲɛrɛma nɛ kira fanyi xɔn, kɔnɔ ɲaaxuɲa mixi ɲaaxi halakima nɛ.

sentences.english: The righteousness of the upright will be their salvation, but the false will themselves be taken in their evil designs.
sentences.susu: Tinxinyi tinxintɔɛ rakisima nɛ, yanfante tan luma milɛ gantanyi nan kui.

sentences.english: At the death of an upright man his hope does not come to an end, but the hope of the evil-doer comes to destruction.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxi na faxa, sese mu sɔɔnɛyama a bɛ sɔnɔn. A xa naafuli mu sɛnbɛ yo fima a ma na tɛmui.

sentences.english: The upright man is taken out of trouble, and in his place comes the sinner.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛ ratangama nɛ ɲaxankatɛ ma, mixi ɲaaxi tan luma na ɲaxankatɛ nan kui.

sentences.english: With his mouth the evil man sends destruction on his neighbour; but through knowledge the upright are taken out of trouble.
sentences.susu: Mixi kobi a boore xun nakanama a xa wɔyɛnyie nan na, kɔnɔ tinxintɔɛ ratangama nɛ a xa lɔnni saabui ra.

sentences.english: When things go well for the upright man, all the town is glad; at the death of sinners, there are cries of joy.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛe na hɛɛri sɔtɔ, taa ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ. Mixi ɲaaxi na faxa, birin bara geeni.

sentences.english: By the blessing of the upright man the town is made great, but it is overturned by the mouth of the evil-doer.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛe munafanyi rafama nɛ a xa taa ma, mixi ɲaaxie tan taa xun nakanama e xa wɔyɛnyie nan na.

sentences.english: He who has a poor opinion of his neighbour has no sense, but a wise man keeps quiet.
sentences.susu: Lɔnnitare yoma nɛ a boore ma, lɔnnila tan luma sabari nan kui.

sentences.english: He who goes about talking of others makes secrets public, but the true-hearted man keeps things covered.
sentences.susu: Naafixi gundo makɛnɛnma nɛ, dugutɛgɛ tan a suturama nɛ.

sentences.english: When there is no helping suggestion the people will have a fall, but with a number of wise guides they will be safe.
sentences.susu: Marasitareɲa ɲama rabirama nɛ, kɔnɔ marasima wuyaxi tan findima kisi nan na e bɛ.

sentences.english: He who makes himself responsible for a strange man will undergo much loss; but the hater of such undertakings will be safe.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo taani mixi bɛ fe nde ma, a fama nɛ nimisade. Tondife na rabade, na nan fisa.
