sentences.susu: Darisalamu na birafe, Yudaya xun na kanafe, barima e Alatala matandima e xa wɔyɛnyi nun e xa wali ra, e bara muruta Alatala xa mangɛya ma.

sentences.english: Their respect for a man's position is a witness against them; and their sin is open to the view of all; like that of Sodom, it is not covered. A curse on their soul! for the measure of their sin is full.
sentences.susu: E xa kaarinyi findi seede ɲaaxi nan na e xili ma. E yunubi rabama kɛnɛ nan ma, alɔ Sodomaka naxee mu e xa yunubi nɔxun. Ɲaxankatɛ na e bɛ, e na gbaloe nan bɛndunfe e yɛtɛ ma na ki.

sentences.english: Happy is the upright man! for he will have joy of the fruit of his ways.
sentences.susu: Wo a fala tinxintɔɛ bɛ, a na kira fanyi xɔn ma, a fama nɛ a xa tinxinyi sare sɔtɔde.

sentences.english: Unhappy is the sinner! for the reward of his evil doings will come on him.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na mixi ɲaaxi tan bɛ, gbaloe fama nɛ a lide a ɲaaxi ra, a fama nɛ a xa tinxintareya sare sɔtɔde.

sentences.english: As for my people, their ruler is acting like a child, and those who have authority over them are women. O my people, your guides are the cause of your wandering, turning your footsteps out of the right way.
sentences.susu: Dimɛe nan na n ma ɲama ɲaxankatafe, ginɛe nan nɔɛ dɔxɔxi a ma, mangɛe na a ralɔɛfe kira ɲaaxi xɔn ma.

sentences.english: The Lord is ready to take up his cause against his people, and is about to come forward as their judge.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala bara a ikeli kiitisa yire, a xa kalamui tinxinxi masen, a xa kiiti sa nɔndi ra.

sentences.english: The Lord comes to be the judge of their responsible men and of their rulers: it is you who have made waste the vine-garden, and in your houses is the property of the poor which you have taken by force.
sentences.susu: Alatala na a xa ɲama kuntigie nun a mangɛe makiitife yi wɔyɛnyi ra, «Wo bara n ma ɲama xun nakana. Wo bara misikiinɛe muɲa.

sentences.english: By what right are you crushing my people, and putting a bitter yoke on the necks of the poor? This is the word of the Lord, the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Won n ma ɲama halakima munfe ra? Wo setaree tɔɔrɔma munfe ra?» Marigi Alatala Sɛnbɛma xui nan na ki.

sentences.english: Again, the Lord has said, Because the daughters of Zion are full of pride, and go with outstretched necks and wandering eyes, with their foot-chains sounding when they go:
sentences.susu: Alatala naxɛ, «Siyoni ginɛe findixi yɛtɛ igboe nan na, naxee e ɲɛrɛma e xunyi rakelixi, e e ɲɛrɛ mɛrɛmɛrɛ ra e sankɔnyi xunmasee nu e xui ramini.

sentences.english: The Lord will send disease on the heads of the daughters of Zion, and the Lord will let their secret parts be seen.
sentences.susu: Alatala fama nɛ suuri raminide e xunyi ma, a e xunsɛxɛ birin ba e ma.»

sentences.english: In that day the Lord will take away the glory of their foot-rings, and their sun-jewels, and their moon-ornaments,
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, Alatala e xa xunmase birin bama nɛ e yi ra: e xa sankɔnyi xunmase tofanyie, e xa kɔnmagore, e xa xunmase naxee misaalixi kike ra,

sentences.english: The ear-rings, and the chains, and the delicate clothing,
sentences.susu: e xa tulirasoe, e xa bɛlɛxɛrasoe, e xa mafelenyie,

sentences.english: The head-bands, and the arm-chains, and the worked bands, and the perfume-boxes, and the jewels with secret powers,
sentences.susu: e xa xun maxirisee, e xa sankɔnyi xunmasee, e xa bɛlɛtie, e xa labundɛ sasee, e xa makantasee,

sentences.english: The rings, and the nose-jewels,
sentences.susu: e xa bɛlɛxɛsole xurundɛe, e xa ɲɔɛ xurundɛe,

sentences.english: The feast-day dresses, and the robes, and the wide skirts, and the handbags,
sentences.susu: e xa xulun dugie, e xa donma kuyee, e xa donma fari igoroe, e xa gbɔnfɔɛe,

sentences.english: The looking-glasses, and the fair linen, and the high head-dresses, and the veils.
sentences.susu: e xa dugie, e xa donma bunmagore, e xa xunmaxirie, nun e xa mafelenyie. Alatala na birin bama nɛ e yi ra.

sentences.english: And in the place of sweet spices will be an evil smell, and for a fair band a thick cord; for a well-dressed head there will be the cutting-off of the hair, and for a beautiful robe there will be the clothing of sorrow; the mark of the prisoner in place of the ornaments of the free.
sentences.susu: Se bɔrɔxi nan findima e xa labundɛ ra. Luuti nan findima e xa bɛlɛti ra. E xunyi dɛnbɛxi bima nɛ. Bɛki nan findima e xa dugi ra. E fate kiri tofanyi ganma nɛ.

sentences.english: Your men will be put to the sword, and your men of war will come to destruction in the fight.
sentences.susu: Santidɛgɛma e xa mɔrie faxama nɛ, e xa ɲalamae faxama gere nan kui.

sentences.english: And in the public places of her towns will be sorrow and weeping; and she will be seated on the earth, waste and uncovered.
sentences.susu: Siyoni ɲama wa xui minima nɛ sunnunyi kui, alɔ kaaɲɛ ginɛ naxan dɔxɔ bɔxi ma, a wa.

sentences.english: And in that day seven women will put their hands on one man, saying, There will be no need for you to give us food or clothing, only let us go under your name, so that our shame may be taken away.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ ginɛ solofere a falama nɛ xɛmɛ keren bɛ, «Muxu xa baloe nun muxu xa maxirisee xa findi muxu xa kote ra, kɔnɔ i tan xa muxu dɔxɔ, i xili xa lu muxu xun, alako yaagi xa ba muxu ma.»

sentences.english: In that day will the young growth of the Lord be beautiful in glory, and the fruit of the earth will be the pride of those who are still living in Israel.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Alatala xa salonyi tofanyi minima nɛ a xa nɔrɛ kui, Isirayila bɔxi xa daxamui fanyi xa lu a xa mixie bɛ naxee kisixi.

sentences.english: And it will come about that the rest of the living in Zion, and of those who have been kept from destruction in Jerusalem, will be named holy, even everyone who has been recorded for life in Jerusalem:
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee fama lude Siyoni nun Darisalamu, e findima nɛ sɛniyɛntɔɛe ra naxee xili sɛbɛxi kisi mixie ya ma.

sentences.english: When Zion has been washed from her sin by the Lord, and Jerusalem made clean from her blood by a judging and a burning wind.
sentences.susu: Marigi fama nɛ Siyoni ginɛe xa sɛniyɛntareɲa maxade, a Darisalamukae rasɛniyɛn e xa faxɛ tife ma kiiti tinxinxi saabui ra, a fa e sare ragbilen e ma.

sentences.english: And over every living-place on Mount Zion, all over all her meetings, the Lord will make a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all, the glory of the Lord will be a cover and a tent;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala fama Siyoni geya makotode nuxui nun tuuri nan na yanyi ra, a tɛ xungbe ramini e xun ma kɔɛ ra. A xa nɔrɛ nan luma se birin xun ma,

sentences.english: And a shade in the daytime from the heat, and a safe cover from storm and from rain.
sentences.susu: alɔ bage xungbe naxan niini mixi makantama soge ma, a findi yire kantaxi ra tunɛ goro tɛmui.

sentences.english: Let me make a song about my loved one, a song of love for his vine-garden. My loved one had a vine-garden on a fertile hill:
sentences.susu: N xa bɛɛti ba n xanuntenyi bɛ, n xanuntenyi naxan bara wɛni xɛ sa. Wɛni xɛ nu na n xanuntenyi yi ra bɔxi turaxi ma.

sentences.english: And after working the earth of it with a spade, he took away its stones, and put in it a very special vine; and he put up a watchtower in the middle of it, hollowing out in the rock a place for the grape-crushing; and he was hoping that it would give the best grapes, but it gave common grapes.
sentences.susu: A naxa bɔxi buxa, a gɛmɛe matongo, a sansi fanyie si a ma. A naxa tide itexi ti naa tagi, a yili ge wɛni bogi bunduma dɛnnaxɛ. A ɲɔxɔ nu a ma a sansi fama nɛ wɛni bogi raminide, kɔnɔ a bogi kanaxi nan naminixi.

sentences.english: And now, you people of Jerusalem and you men of Judah, be the judges between me and my vine-garden.
sentences.susu: Darisalamukae nun Yudayakae, wo kiiti n tan nun n ma wɛni xɛ ma.

sentences.english: Is there anything which might have been done for my vine-garden which I have not done? why then, when I was hoping for the best grapes did it give me common grapes?
sentences.susu: Munse man luxi, n mu naxan nabaxi n ma xɛ bɛ? Munfe ra n xaxili to nu tixi bogi fanyi ra, a fa bogi kanaxi ramini n bɛ?

sentences.english: And now, this is what I will do to my vine-garden: I will take away the circle of thorns round it, and it will be burned up; its wall will be broken down and the beasts of the field will go through it;
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ n naxan nabama n ma xɛ ra. N sansanyi talama nɛ alako xurusee xa a maxin. N tɛtɛ bama nɛ alako a xa maboron.

sentences.english: And I will make it waste; its branches will not be touched with the knife, or the earth worked with the spade; but blackberries and thorns will come up in it: and I will give orders to the clouds not to send rain on it.
sentences.susu: N a raboloma nɛ alako tunbe nun ɲooge xa bula sansi fanyi ɲɔxɔ ra. N nuxuie yamarima, e naxa tunɛ yo rayolon a ma.

sentences.english: For the vine-garden of the Lord of armies is the people of Israel, and the men of Judah are the plant of his delight: and he was looking for upright judging, and there was blood; for righteousness, and there was a cry for help.
sentences.susu: Na wɛni xɛ misaalixi Alatala Sɛnbɛma xa ɲama Isirayila nan na, a man misaali Yudaya ɲama fan na. Alatala nu wama tinxinyi nan xɔn, kɔnɔ a faxɛ tife nan tun to naa. A nu wama fe fanyi nan xɔn, kɔnɔ a wa xui nan tun mɛ naa.

sentences.english: Cursed are those who are joining house to house, and putting field to field, till there is no more living-space for any but themselves in all the land!
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na mixie bɛ, naxee banxie tima e fari idɔxɔ, naxee xɛe dɔxɔma e bore ra, han e bɔxi birin tongo, e tan keren gbansan lu naa.

sentences.english: The Lord of armies has said to me secretly, Truly, numbers of great and fair houses will be waste, with no one living in them.
sentences.susu: Alatala Sɛnbɛma a masen nɛ n bɛ, «Na banxi galie fama nɛ tuxunsande, mixi mu sabatima na banxi tofanyie kui fa.

sentences.english: For ten fields of vines will only give one measure of wine, and a great amount of seed will only give a small measure of grain.
sentences.susu: Wɛni xɛ xungbe, bogi dondoronti raminima nɛ. Sansi xɔri gbegbe, findima maale dondoronti nan na.»

sentences.english: Cursed are those who get up early in the morning to give themselves up to strong drink; who keep on drinking far into the night till they are heated with wine!
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na mixie bɛ naxee kelima subaxɛ ma sigafe ra beere fende, e fa na min han e ya gbeeli kɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And corded instruments and wind-instruments and wine are in their feasts: but they give no thought to the work of the Lord, and they are not interested in what his hands are doing.
sentences.susu: E kɔrae, maxasee, nun sarae raberema e xa xulunyie kui, kɔnɔ e mu Alatala xa wali tan kolonma, e mu a bɛlɛxɛ fɔxi toma.

sentences.english: For this cause my people are taken away as prisoners into strange countries for need of knowledge: and their rulers are wasted for need of food, and their loud-voiced feasters are dry for need of water.
sentences.susu: Na fahaamutareɲa nan a niyama e xa xanin konyiya kui ɲamanɛ ma. E xa ɲalamae faxama nɛ kaamɛ ra, e xa mixie tɔɔrɔma nɛ ye xɔli ma.

sentences.english: For this cause the underworld has made wide its throat, opening its mouth without limit: and her glory, and the noise of her masses, and her loud-voiced feasters, will go down into it.
sentences.susu: Aligiyama naadɛ rabima nɛ e bɛ, Siyoni kuntigie nun e xa ɲama xa so naa, a nun taa xurutaree nun mixi ɲaaxie.

sentences.english: And the poor man's head is bent, and the great man goes down on his face, and the eyes of pride are put to shame:
sentences.susu: Adama xa fe xun nakanama nɛ, yɛtɛ igboe xa fe goroma nɛ.

sentences.english: But the Lord of armies is lifted up as judge, and the Holy God is seen to be holy in righteousness.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala Sɛnbɛma tantuma nɛ a xa tinxinyi xa fe ra. Ala Sɛniyɛntɔɛ a yɛtɛ masenma a xa fe fanyie nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: Then the lambs will get food as in their grass-lands, and the fat cattle will be feasting in the waste places.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui yɛxɛɛe e dɛ madonma nɛ na yire kanaxie ma alɔ e na e xɔnyi nɛ, xɔɲɛe fan baloe toma naa.

sentences.english: Cursed are those who make use of ox-cords for pulling the evil thing, and the bands of a young ox for their sin!
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na mixie bɛ, naxee yunubie bɛndunma e yɛtɛ ma wule ra, naxee e e yɛtɛ xirima fe ɲaaxie ra alɔ kote naxan xirima sofale fari.

sentences.english: Who say, Let him do his work quickly, let him make it sudden, so that we may see it: let the design of the Holy One of Israel come near, so that it may be clear to us.
sentences.susu: Na mixie nu fa a fala e dɛ ra, «Alatala xa a xulun a xa wali raba ra, alako muxu xa a to. Isirayila Marigi Ala sago sɛniyɛnxi xa raba, alako muxu xa a kolon.»

sentences.english: Cursed are those who give the name of good to evil, and of evil to what is good: who make light dark, and dark light: who make bitter sweet, and sweet bitter!
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na mixie bɛ, naxee fe ɲaaxi findima fe fanyi ra, e fe fanyi findi fe ɲaaxi ra. E dimi xili naiyalanyi, e naiyalanyi xili dimi. Fe xɔnɛ luxi nɛ a bɛ alɔ fe ɲɔxunmɛ, fe ɲɔxunmɛ lu e bɛ alɔ fe xɔnɛ.

sentences.english: Cursed are those who seem wise to themselves, and who take pride in their knowledge!
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na mixie bɛ, naxee e yɛtɛ maɲɔxunxi fe kolonyie ra, e e yɛtɛ findi xaxilimae ra.

sentences.english: Cursed are those who are strong to take wine, and great in making mixed drinks!
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na mixie bɛ, naxee xili xungbe sɔtɔma beere minfe kui, e fisa e boore bɛ siisi fe kui.

sentences.english: Who for a reward give support to the cause of the sinner, and who take away the righteousness of the upright from him.
sentences.susu: E nɔndi fi funmala ma kɔbiri xa fe ra, e nɔndi ba nɔndi kanyi yi ra.

sentences.english: For this cause, as the waste of the grain is burned up by tongues of fire, and as the dry grass goes down before the flame, so their root will be like the dry stems of grain, and their flower will go up in dust: because they have gone against the law of the Lord of armies, and have given no honour to the word of the Holy One of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na mixie xa fe xun nakanama nɛ alɔ sɛxɛ xaraxi ganma ki naxɛ. E luma nɛ alɔ sansi naxee sankee bɔrɔma, e fugee yensen alɔ xube, barima e bara mɛ Alatala Sɛnbɛma xa sɛriyɛ ra, e Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ xa masenyi mabere.

sentences.english: For this reason the wrath of the Lord has been burning against his people, and his hand has been stretched out against them in punishment, and the hills were shaking, and their dead bodies were like waste in the open places of the town.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra Alatala bɔɲɛ texi a xa ɲama xili ma, a bɛlɛxɛ italaxi, a xa e bɔnbɔ. Geyae bara sɛrɛn, binbie bara yensen taa kui. Hali na birin to rabaxi, a xa xɔnɛ mu ɲɔnxi, a bɛlɛxɛ man italaxi e xili ma.

sentences.english: And he will let a flag be lifted up as a sign to a far-off nation, whistling to them from the ends of the earth: and they will come quickly and suddenly.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara tɔnxuma masen ɲamanɛ ma, a e xili e xa fa kelife yire makuye.

sentences.english: There is no weariness among them, and no man is feeble-footed: they come without resting or sleeping, and the cord of their shoes is not broken.
sentences.susu: Mixi taganxi yo mu na e ya ma, mixi yo sanyie mu binyaxi a bun ma, mixi yo mu kinsɔnfe a xa xi, mixi yo xa bɛlɛti mu fulunxi a tagi, mixi yo xa sankiri luuti mu bolonxi.

sentences.english: Their arrows are sharp, and every bow is bent: the feet of their horses are like rock, and their wheels are like a rushing storm.
sentences.susu: Na mixie xa xalie ɲɔɛe raxaɲɛnxi, e xa tanbɛ woli see birin italaxi a fanyi ra, e xa soe toree xɔrɔxɔ alɔ gɛmɛ, e xa sɔɔri ragise sanyie xui gbo alɔ turunnaadɛ.

sentences.english: The sound of their armies will be like the voice of a lion, and their war-cry like the noise of young lions: with loud cries they will come down on their food and will take it away safely, and there will be no one to take it out of their hands.
sentences.susu: E ɲarandan alɔ yɛtɛ naxan sube suxuma, a a xanin yire makuye.

sentences.english: And his voice will be loud over him in that day like the sounding of the sea: and if a man's eyes are turned to the earth, it is all dark and full of trouble; and the light is made dark by thick clouds.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ e ɲarandanyi mɛma nɛ alɔ baa mɔrɔnyie, tɔɔrɛ nan tun toma bɔxi ma, naiyalanyi findima dimi nan na, nuxui ifɔɔrɔxie lu koore ma.

sentences.english: In the year of King Uzziah's death I saw the Lord seated in his place, high and lifted up, and the Temple was full of the wide skirts of his robe.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Osiyasi faxa ɲɛ naxan na, n naxa n Marigi Ala to a xa kibanyi itexi kui. A xa nɔrɛ nu gbo, a xa donma xungbe nu italaxi a xa hɔrɔmɔlingira kui.

sentences.english: Over him were the winged ones: every one had six wings; two for covering his face, two for covering his feed, and two for flight.
sentences.susu: Malekɛe nu na a xun ma. Gabutenyi senni nu na kankan bɛ: gabutenyi firin nu e yatagi makotoxi, firin nu e sanyie makotoxi, firin nan nu a niyama e xa ɲɛrɛ koore ma.

sentences.english: And one said in a loud voice to another, Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord of armies: all the earth is full of his glory.
sentences.susu: E nu fa a fala e boore bɛ e xui itexi ra, Alatala Sɛnbɛma sɛniyɛn han! A xa nɔrɛ duniɲa birin lima nɛ!

sentences.english: And the bases of the door-pillars were shaking at the sound of his cry, and the house was full of smoke.
sentences.susu: E xui nu hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛe rasɛrɛnma, banxi fa rafe tuuri ra.

sentences.english: Then I said, The curse is on me, and my fate is destruction; for I am a man of unclean lips, living among a people of unclean lips; for my eyes have seen the King, the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Na kui n naxa gbelegbele, «Ɲaxankatɛ na n bɛ, barima n findixi adamadi sɛniyɛntare nan na, naxan sabatixi ɲama sɛniyɛntare ya ma. N yae na n Marigi Ala Sɛnbɛma to, n faxama nɛ!»

sentences.english: Then a winged one came to me with a burning coal in his hand, which he had taken from off the altar with the fire-spoon.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui na malekɛ keren naxa tugan, a fa n yire, tɛ wole keren na a yi ra a nu bara naxan tongo sɛrɛxɛbade kui.

sentences.english: And after touching my mouth with it, he said, See, your lips have been touched with this; and your evil is taken away, and you are made clean from sin.
sentences.susu: A naxa a dɔxɔ n dɛ ra a fa a fala, «Yi to bara din i dɛ ra, i xa tinxintareya bara ba, i xa yunubi bara xafari.»

sentences.english: And the voice of the Lord came to my ears, saying, Whom am I to send, and who will go for us? Then I said, Here am I, send me.
sentences.susu: N naxa n Marigi xui mɛ a masen na, «N na n nde xɛɛma? Nde sigama xɛɛra ibade muxu bɛ?» N naxa a yaabi, «N tan nan ya. I xa n tan xɛɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said, Go, and say to this people, You will go on hearing, but learning nothing; you will go on seeing, but without getting wiser.
sentences.susu: Awa, a naxa a fala n bɛ, «Sa a fala yi ɲama bɛ, ‹Wo wo tuli matima n na, kɔnɔ wo mu fahaamui sɔtɔ? Wo fe matoma, kɔnɔ wo mu a kui kolon?›

sentences.english: Make the hearts of this people fat, and let their ears be stopped, and their eyes shut; for fear that they may see with their eyes, and be hearing with their ears, and their heart may become wise, and they may be turned to me and made well.
sentences.susu: I xa yi ɲama xaxili raxɔrɔxɔ, i xa e tuli dɛsɛ, i xa e ya ragali. E ya nu nɔma to tide, e tuli nu nɔma fe mɛde, e xaxili nu nɔma fahaamui sɔtɔde, e fa tuubi, e kisi.»

sentences.english: Then I said, Lord, how long? And he said in answer, Till the towns are waste and unpeopled, and the houses have no men, and the land becomes completely waste,
sentences.susu: N naxa a maxɔrin, «N marigi, na buma han tɛmui mundun?» A naxa n yaabi, «Han e xa taae na gɛ kanade, mixie xa ɲɔn naa, e xa banxi xa bira, e xa xɛe xa gan.

sentences.english: And the Lord has taken men far away, and there are wide waste places in the land.
sentences.susu: Han Alatala na gɛ ɲama xaninde yire makuye, e xa bɔxi fa rabɛɲin.

sentences.english: And even if there is still a tenth part in it, it will again be burned, like a tree of the woods whose broken end is still in the earth after the tree has been cut down (the holy seed is the broken end).
sentences.susu: Hali mixi ndee fa kisi naa, gbaloe man fama nɛ dinde naa ra.» «Kɔnɔ wuri bili xungbe na sɛgɛ, a sanke sɛniyɛnxi luma nɛ bɔxi bun ma.»

sentences.english: Now it came about in the days of Ahaz, the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin, the king of Aram, and Pekah, the son of Remaliah, the king of Israel, came up to Jerusalem to make war against it, but were not able to overcome it.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Axasi xa waxati, naxan findixi Yotami xa di nun Osiyasi xa mamadi ra, Arami mangɛ Resin nun Isirayila mangɛ Peka, Remaliyahu xa di, e naxa siga Darisalamu gerede, kɔnɔ e mu nɔ a ra.

sentences.english: And word came to the family of David that Aram had put up its tents in Ephraim. And the king's heart, and the hearts of his people, were moved, like the trees of the wood shaking in the wind.
sentences.susu: Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ mixie to a kolon a Aramikae bara lanyi xiri Efirami bɔnsɔɛ ra, Mangɛ Axasi nun a xa ɲama naxa sɛrɛn gaaxui kui, alɔ foye wuri bilie ramaxama ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to Isaiah, Go out now, you and Shear-jashub, your son, and you will come across Ahaz at the end of the stream flowing from the higher pool, in the highway of the washerman's field;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Esayi bɛ, «I tan nun i xa di Seyara Yasubu, wo xa siga mangɛ Axasi naralande ye ragatade xungbe xanbi ra, kira naxan sigama dugi xama dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And say to him, Take care and be quiet; have no fear, and do not let your heart be feeble, because of these two ends of smoking fire-wood, because of the bitter wrath of Rezin and Aram, and of the son of Remaliah.
sentences.susu: A fala a bɛ, ‹I naxa kɔntɔfili. I xa limaniya. Hali i mu gaaxu yi mixi firinyi ra, naxee luma alɔ tɛ xubenxi naxan tuuri tun raminima. I naxa gaaxu Arami mangɛ Resin nun Remaliyahu bɔnsɔɛ ya ra.

sentences.english: Because Aram has made evil designs against you, saying,
sentences.susu: Aramikae, nun Remaliyahu xa mixie Efiramikae bara yanfanteya nan xiri i xun ma na ki, a falafe ra,

sentences.english: Let us go up against Judah, troubling her, and forcing our way into her, and let us put up a king in her, even the son of Tabeel:
sentences.susu: «Won xa Yudaya gere, won xa a ya iso, won xa nɔ a ra, Tabeeli xa findi e xa mangɛ ra.»›»

sentences.english: This is the word of the Lord God: This design will not come about or be effected.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya na xa fe ra, «Na mu sɔɔnɛyama, n mu na rabama feo,

sentences.english: For the head of Aram is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin (and in sixty-five years from now Ephraim will be broken, and will no longer be a people):
sentences.susu: barima Damasi mangɛ Resin nan Arami yamarima. Ɲɛ tongo senni nun suuli gbansan nan luxi, Efirami bɔnsɔɛ xa yensen.

sentences.english: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah's son. If you will not have faith, your kingdom will be broken.
sentences.susu: Samari mangɛ Remaliyahu nan Efirami yamarima. Xa wo mu wo yɛtɛ taxu wo Marigi Ala ra, wo mu kisima.»

sentences.english: And Isaiah said again to Ahaz,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi masenyi fan ti Axasi bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Make a request to the Lord your God for a sign, a sign in the deep places of the underworld, or in the high heavens.
sentences.susu: «I xa n tan i Marigi Alatala maxandi tɔnxuma ma n ma masenyi xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: But Ahaz said, I will not put the Lord to the test by making such a request.
sentences.susu: Axasi naxa a yaabi, «N mu sese maxandima i ma, barima n mu wama i tan Alatala matofe siikɛ kui.»

sentences.english: And he said, Give ear now, O family of David: is it not enough that you are driving men to disgust? will you do the same to my God?
sentences.susu: Na kui Annabi Esayi naxa a fala, «Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ, wo luma mixie ratagan na, kɔnɔ yakɔsi wo wama Alatala nan fan nataganfe?

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord himself will give you a sign; a young woman is now with child, and she will give birth to a son, and she will give him the name Immanuel.
sentences.susu: Alatala yɛtɛ yati fama nɛ tɔnxuma nde fide wo ma: Ginɛ dimɛdi nde fama tɛgɛde, a di bari, a na di xili sa Emanuwɛli, naxan fasarixi, ‹Ala na won ya ma.›

sentences.english: Butter and honey will be his food, when he is old enough to make a decision between evil and good.
sentences.susu: A xiɲɛ fɛnɛ nun kumi nan donma han a mɔ, a nɔ fe kobi nun fe fanyi tagi raba kolonde.

sentences.english: For before the child is old enough to make a decision between evil and good, the land whose two kings you are now fearing will have become waste.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ beenun a xa na simaya sɔtɔ, na mangɛ firinyi i gaaxuxi naxee ra, nee xa bɔxie fama nɛ kanade.

sentences.english: The Lord is about to send on you, and on your people, and on your father's house, such a time of trouble as there has not been from the days of the separating of Ephraim from Judah; even the coming of the king of Assyria.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala fama nɛ gbaloe nde ra wo xun ma naxan mu kolonxi wo nun wo babae xa waxati kafi Efirami a makuyaxi Yudaya ra tɛmui naxɛ. Alatala Asiriya mangɛ nan xɛɛma wo yire.»

sentences.english: And it will be in that day that the Lord will make a piping sound for the fly which is in the end of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee which is in the land of Assyria.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, Alatala xɛɛrie rafama nɛ kelife Misira xuree ma, a nun kumie kelife Asiriya bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And they will come, covering all the waste valleys, and the holes of the rocks, and the thorns, and all the watering-places.
sentences.susu: E fama nɛ lude folee kui, gɛmɛ longorie ra, kunsie fari, nun ye yiree.

sentences.english: In that day will the Lord take away the hair of the head and of the feet, as well as the hair of the face, with a blade got for a price from the other side of the River; even with the king of Assyria.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Marigi fama nɛ Asiriya mangɛ ra kelife xure xungbe naakiri ma, a xa wo rayaagi a ɲaaxi ra, alɔ mixi naxan fate maxabe birin mabima.

sentences.english: And it will be in that day that a man will give food to a young cow and two sheep;
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, mixi fama ninge keren nun si firin nan gbansan sɔtɔde,

sentences.english: And they will give so much milk that he will be able to have butter for his food: for butter and honey will be the food of all who are still living in the land.
sentences.susu: e xiɲɛ fɛnɛ sɔtɔma naxan na. E luma na nun kumi gbansan nan don na.

sentences.english: And it will be in that day that in every place where before there were a thousand vines valued at a thousand shekels of silver, there will be nothing but blackberries and thorns.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, wɛni bili wulu keren nu na xɛ naxan ma, naxan sare nu gbeti kole wulu keren lima, naa findima nɛ tunbe nun baagi yire ra,

sentences.english: Men will come there with bows and arrows, because all the land will be full of blackberries and thorns.
sentences.susu: koyinmae xalie wolima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And they will send out the oxen and the sheep on all the hills which before were worked with the spade, ... fear of blackberries and thorns.
sentences.susu: Xɛe nu sama geya naxee fari, tunbe nun baagi dinma nɛ naa ra, mixi yo mu suusa sigade naa sɔnɔn. Naa findima xurusee madonde nan gbansan na.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to me, Take a great writing-board, and on it put down in common letters, Maher-shalal-hash-baz;
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ, «I xa kɛɛdi tongo, a sɛbɛ kale ra, ‹Maheri Salali Hasi Basi,› naxan fasarixi ‹Kasarɛ ti, se birin xaninma mafuren mafuren.›

sentences.english: And take true witnesses to the writing, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah, the son of Jeberechiah.
sentences.susu: I xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Uri nun Yeberekiya xa di Sakari xili seedee ra n bɛ.»

sentences.english: And I went in to my wife, and she became with child, and gave birth to a son. Then the Lord said to me, Give him the name Maher-shalal-hash-baz,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, n naxa n maso n ma ginɛ ra, a naxa tɛgɛ a di bari. Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, «A xili sa, ‹Maheri Salali Hasi Basi.›

sentences.english: For before the child is able to say, Father, or, Mother, the wealth of Damascus and the goods of Samaria will be taken away by the king of Assyria.
sentences.susu: Beenun na di xa mɔ, a fa nɔ a falade, ‹N nga, n ba,› Asiriya mangɛ fama nɛ naafuli xaninde a naxan toma Damasi taa kui nun Samari bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said again to me,
sentences.susu: Alatala man naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Because this people will have nothing to do with the softly-flowing waters of Shiloah, and have fear of Rezin and Remaliah's son;
sentences.susu: «Yi ɲama to bara Silowa xure xa baraka bɛɲin, Ala naxan fixi e ma, e fa bira Resin nun Remaliyahu xa di xa fe fɔxɔ ra,

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord is sending on them the waters of the River, deep and strong, even the king of Assyria and all his glory: and it will come up through all its streams, overflowing all its edges:
sentences.susu: n tan Alatala fama nɛ banbaranyi xungbe ra e xili ma, naxan findi Asiriya mangɛ yɛtɛ igboe ra. A sɛnbɛ luma nɛ alɔ banbaranyi naxan kelima xure, a fa dangi bɔxi birin ma,

sentences.english: And it will come on into Judah; rushing on and overflowing, till the waters are up to the neck; ***and his outstretched wings will be covering the land from side to side: for God is with us.
sentences.susu: a din Yudaya ra, a te han a gbe mu nu luxi mɛnnikae fan xa madula. Emanuwɛli, na fama nɛ wo xa bɔxi birin xun nakanade.»

sentences.english: Have knowledge, O peoples, and be in fear; give ear, all you far-off parts of the earth:
sentences.susu: «Wo tan ɲamanɛ naxee na duniɲa, wo gere xui rate, kɔnɔ wo xun nakanama nɛ. Wo wo yɛtɛ yailan gere xili ma, kɔnɔ wo faxama nɛ. Wo xa ti gere ki ma, kɔnɔ wo birama nɛ.

sentences.english: Let your designs be formed, and they will come to nothing; give your orders, and they will not be effected: for God is with us.
sentences.susu: Wo natɛe tongo, kɔnɔ a mu sɔɔnɛyama. Wo lanyi xiri wo boore tagi, kɔnɔ wo mu tima nɛ, barima Ala na muxu ya ma.»

sentences.english: For the Lord, controlling me with a strong hand, gave me orders not to go in the way of this people, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa n nasi sɛnbɛ ra, a falafe ra n bɛ, a n naxa bira yi ɲama ɲɛrɛ ki kobi fɔxɔ ra. A naxɛ,

sentences.english: Do not say, It is holy, about everything of which this people says, It is holy; and do not be in fear of what they go in fear of.
sentences.susu: «I naxa yanfanteya xili fala fe ma, yi ɲama a falama fe naxan ma yanfanteya. I naxa gaaxu fe ya ra, yi ɲama gaaxuma fe naxan ya ra.

sentences.english: But let the Lord of armies be holy to you, and go in fear of him, giving honour to him.
sentences.susu: I xa Mangɛ Alatala nan kolon sɛniyɛntɔɛ ra, i xa xanmɛ a tan nan xa fe ra, i xa gaaxu a tan nan ya ra.

sentences.english: And he will be for a holy place: but for a stone of falling and a rock of trouble to the two houses of Israel, and to the men of Jerusalem, for a net in which they may be taken.
sentences.susu: Na kui a findima nɛ wo bɛ yire sɛniyɛnxi ra. Kɔnɔ Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ firinyie bɛ, a findima nɛ gɛmɛ ra e dinma naxan na, e fa bira, a findima nɛ gantanyi ra Darisalamukae bɛ.

sentences.english: And numbers of them, falling on the stone, will be broken, and will be taken in the net.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe e sanyi radinma nɛ a ra, e bira, e e maxɔnɔ, e xanin konyiya kui.»

sentences.english: Let my teaching be kept secret: and my words be given to my disciples only.
sentences.susu: Yi seedeɲɔxɔya naxan sɛbɛxi, wo xa tɔnxuma sa a ma, wo xa a ragata n ma fɔxirabirɛe yire.

sentences.english: And I will be waiting for the Lord, whose face is veiled from the house of Jacob, and I will be looking for him.
sentences.susu: N tan xaxili tixi Alatala ra, naxan a kobe soxi Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ ra sinden. N bara n ma lanlanteya sa a ma.

sentences.english: See, I and the children whom the Lord has given me, are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the Lord of armies, whose resting-place is in Mount Zion.
sentences.susu: N tan nun n ma die, Alatala naxee fixi n ma, muxu findixi tɔnxumae nan na Isirayila bɔxi ma Mangɛ Alatala bɛ, naxan sabatixi Siyoni geya fari.

sentences.english: And when they say to you, Make request for us to those who have control of spirits, and to those wise in secret arts, who make hollow bird-like sounds; is it not right for a people to make request to their gods, to make request for the living to the dead?
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee a falama wo bɛ, wo xa siga karamɔxɔɛe yire, naxee mixi faxaxie rawɔyɛnma makɔyikɔyi ra, wo xa gundo kolon. Kɔnɔ a mu lanma mixie xa e xa maxɔrinyie ti e Marigi Ala tan ma? A lanma mixi baloxi xa maxɔrinyi ti mixi faxaxi ma?

sentences.english: Then say to them, Put your faith in the teaching and the witness. ... If they do not say such things. ... For him there is no dawn. ...
sentences.susu: Won xa won tuli mati Ala xa sɛriyɛ ra a seedeɲɔxɔya fixi naxan ma. Xa na mu a ra, ɲama luma dimi nan tun kui,

sentences.english: And he will go through the land in bitter trouble and in need of food; and when he is unable to get food, he will become angry, cursing his king and his God, and his eyes will be turned to heaven on high;
sentences.susu: E bɔxi igirima kaamɛ nun kɔntɔfili nan na. Kaamɛ na xɔrɔxɔ e ma tɛmui naxɛ, e e ya ratema nɛ koore ma, e e xa mangɛ nun e Marigi Ala danka.

sentences.english: And he will be looking down on the earth, and there will be trouble and dark clouds, black night where there is no seeing.
sentences.susu: E na gɛ na rabade, e fa e ya ragoro duniɲa ma, e mu sese toma fo tɔɔrɛ, dimi, nun bɔɲɛsatareya.

sentences.english: In earlier times he made the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali of small value, but after that he gave it glory, by the way of the sea, on the other side of Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxan nu na a ɲɛrɛfe dimi kui, e bara naiyalanyi xungbe to. Tɔɔrɛ xa nɔɛ nu na naxee fari, naiyalanyi xungbe bara yanba e ma.

sentences.english: The people who went in the dark have seen a great light, and for those who were living in the land of the deepest night, the light is shining.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i bara na ɲama xun nakeli, i bara sɛɛwɛ xungbe fi e ma. E sɛɛwaxi i ya ra alɔ mixie sɛɛwama sansi xaba tɛmui ki naxɛ, alɔ mixie sɛɛwama harige sɔtɔfe ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: You have made them very glad, increasing their joy. They are glad before you as men are glad in the time of getting in the grain, or when they make division of the goods taken in war.
sentences.susu: E sɛɛwaxi barima kote binye naxan nu dɛtɛnxi e ma, i bara na ba naa, luxusinyi naxan nu e bɔnbɔma e fari ma, i bara na kana alɔ i Madiyankae rabira tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: For by your hand the yoke on his neck and the rod on his back, even the rod of his cruel master, have been broken, as in the day of Midian.
sentences.susu: E yaxuie xa sankiri naxee nu e maboronma, e donma naxee nɔxɔxi wuli ra, nee birin bara wɔlɛ tɛ xɔɔra, e gan feo.

sentences.english: For every boot of the man of war with his sounding step, and the clothing rolled in blood, will be for burning, food for the fire.
sentences.susu: Barima Ala bara a niya won xa di nde sɔtɔ, a mangɛya fixi naxan ma. Na di fama xilide yi ki nɛ: Marasima fisamante, Ala Sɛnbɛma, Baba naxan buma abadan, Bɔɲɛsa Mangɛ.

sentences.english: For to us a child has come, to us a son is given; and the government has been placed in his hands; and he has been named Wise Guide, Strong God, Father for ever, Prince of Peace.
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya nun a xa bɔɲɛsa mu ɲɔnma. A dɔxɔma nɛ Dawuda xa kibanyi kui abadan. A na mangɛya rabama tinxinyi nun nɔndi nan na, kelife yakɔsi ma han dan mu naxan ma. Mangɛ Alatala fama na nan nabade, barima a mu wama a firin nde xɔn.

sentences.english: Of the increase of his rule and of peace there will be no end, on the seat of David, and in his kingdom; to make it strong, supporting it with wise decision and righteousness, now and for ever. By the fixed purpose of the Lord of armies this will be done.
sentences.susu: Marigi nu bara kiiti ɲaaxi sa Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ ma, a naxan dɔxɔ Isirayila ma.

sentences.english: The Lord has sent a word to Jacob, and it has come on Israel;
sentences.susu: Efiramikae nun Samarikae nu bara na kolon, kɔnɔ e naxa a fala e xa yɛtɛ igboya kui,

sentences.english: And all the people will have experience of it, even Ephraim and the men of Samaria, who say in the pride of their uplifted hearts,
sentences.susu: «Biriki banxi bara bira, kɔnɔ muxu fama a tide gɛmɛ masolixie nan na. Sikomoro bilie bara sɛgɛ, kɔnɔ muxu fama sɛdiri bilie side e ɲɔxɔɛ ra.»

sentences.english: The bricks have come down, but we will put up buildings of cut stone in their place: the sycamores are cut down, but they will be changed to cedars.
sentences.susu: Na wɔyɛnyi ma Alatala fama nɛ Resin yaxuie rageenide e xili ma,

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord has made strong the haters of Israel, driving them on to make war against him;
sentences.susu: A fama nɛ Aramikae ra kelife sogetede, A fa Filisitakae fan na keli sogegorode, alako e xa Isirayilakae sɔntɔ a ɲaaxi ra. Hali na birin to raba, Alatala xa xɔnɛ mu gbilenxi e fɔxɔ ra, a bɛlɛxɛ man itexi e xili ma,

sentences.english: Aram on the east, and the Philistines on the west, who have come against Israel with open mouths. For all this his wrath is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
sentences.susu: barima ɲama tan tondi nɛ a yɛtɛ ragbilende a bɔnbɔma ma, e mu Mangɛ Alatala fen.

sentences.english: But the heart of the people was not turned to him who sent punishment on them, and they made no prayer to the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala Isirayila xunyi nun a xuli bolonma nɛ, a tugi bili nun kale xunxuri rabirama nɛ.

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord took away from Israel head and tail, high and low, in one day.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xunyi na a xa yareratie nan na, a xuli na a xa namiɲɔnmɛ wule falɛe nan na.

sentences.english: The man who is honoured and responsible is the head, and the prophet who gives false teaching is the tail.
sentences.susu: Na yareratie bara ɲama ralɔɛ, e bara e ifu.

sentences.english: For the guides of this people are the cause of their wandering from the right way, and those who are guided by them come to destruction.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, Alatala mu ɲɛlɛxinma e xa fonikee ra, a mu kinikinima e xa kiridie nun kaaɲɛ ginɛe ma, barima e birin yunubi ɲaaxie rabama, wɔyɛn kobie nan tun minima e dɛ i.

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord will have no pleasure in their young men, and no pity on their widows and the children without fathers: for they are all haters of God and evil-doers, and foolish words come from every mouth. For all this his wrath is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
sentences.susu: Gbaloe na fafe e ma alɔ tɛ naxan na fili ma, a fa ɲooge ɲaaxi nun tunbe birin gan, tuuri fa te koore ma.

sentences.english: For evil was burning like a fire; the blackberries and thorns were burned up; the thick woods took fire, rolling up in dark clouds of smoke.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa xɔnɛ bara duniɲa rasɛrɛn, adamadie bara lu alɔ tɛ naxee e boore gan, mixi yo mu kisi.

sentences.english: The land was dark with the wrath of the Lord of armies: the people were like those who take men's flesh for food.
sentences.susu: E bara e boore muɲa naxan nu na e yirefanyi ma, kɔnɔ e naxa lu kaamɛ kui. E bara nde muɲa naxan nu na e kɔɔla ma, kɔnɔ e mu wasa, kankan naxa din a boore ra.

sentences.english: On the right a man was cutting off bits and was still in need; on the left a man took a meal but had not enough; no man had pity on his brother; every man was making a meal of the flesh of his neighbour.
sentences.susu: Manasikae bara Efiramikae tɔɔrɔ, Efiramikae bara Manasikae tɔɔrɔ, e firin bara din Yudaya ra. Hali na birin to raba, Alatala xa xɔnɛ mu gbilenxi e fɔxɔ ra, a bɛlɛxɛ man itexi e xili ma.

sentences.english: Cursed are those who make evil decisions, and the writers who make the records of their cruel acts:
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na yareratie bɛ, naxee yaamari ɲaaxie sɛbɛma, naxee tɔɔɲɛgɛ tima,

sentences.english: Who do wrong to the poor in their cause, and take away the right of the crushed among my people, so that they may have the property of widows, and get under their power those who have no father.
sentences.susu: alako e xa misikiinɛ tɔɔrɔ kiiti ɲaaxi ra, e tinxintareya raba setaree ra naxan baloe bama kaaɲɛ ginɛe nun kiridie yi ra.

sentences.english: And what will you do in the day of punishment, and in the destruction which is coming from far? to whom will you go for help, and what will become of your glory?
sentences.susu: Wo munse rabama dɛntɛgɛ sa lɔxɔɛ Alatala ya i? Wo wo xaxili tima nde ra alako wo xa ratanga?

sentences.english: ... For all this his wrath is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
sentences.susu: Wo birama nɛ geelimanie bun ma, wo bɔnɔ mixi faxaxie ya ma. Hali na birin to rabama, Alatala xa xɔnɛ mu gbilenma wo fɔxɔ ra, a bɛlɛxɛ man itema nɛ wo xili ma.

sentences.english: Ho! Assyrian, the rod of my wrath, the instrument of my punishment!
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na Asiriya bɛ, naxan findixi n ma wuri bɔnbɔ ti se ra n ma xɔnɛ kui. N ma gbendegela na a ra.

sentences.english: I will send him against a nation of wrongdoers, and against the people of my wrath I will give him orders, to take their wealth in war, crushing them down like the dust in the streets.
sentences.susu: N e tan nan xɛɛma ɲamanɛ murutaxi xili ma, n e tan nan nasigama ɲama xili ma, naxan n naxɔnɔxi, alako e xa naafuli ba na ɲama yi ra, e fa e maboron taa kui alɔ boora.

sentences.english: But this is not what is in his mind, and this is not his design; but his purpose is destruction, and the cutting off of more and more nations.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Asiriyakae xa natɛ tan nu na fe gbɛtɛ nan ma. E nu bara natɛ tongo e xa e xun nakana kerenyi ra, alɔ e luma a raba ra duniɲa ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For he says, Are not all my captains kings?
sentences.susu: E xa mangɛ naxɛ, «N ma sɔɔri yareratie birin mu findixi mangɛe xa ra?

sentences.english: Will not the fate of Calno be like that of Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?
sentences.susu: Kalano taa mu sɔntɔ xɛ alɔ Karakemisi? Xamata fan mu faxa xɛ alɔ Arapadi? Samari mu kana xɛ alɔ Damasi?

sentences.english: As my hand has come on the kingdoms of the images, whose pictured images were more in number than those of Jerusalem and Samaria;
sentences.susu: Xa n bara nɔ na bɔxie ra a nun e xa kuyee, kuye naxee sɛnbɛ gbo Darisalamu nun Samari gbee bɛ,

sentences.english: So, as I have done to Samaria and her images, I will do to Jerusalem and her images.
sentences.susu: n mu na mɔɔli rabama xɛ Darisalamu fan nun a xa kuyee ra? N naxan nabaxi Samari nun a xa kuye ra, n mu nɔma xɛ na fan nabade Darisalamu ra xɛ?»

sentences.english: For this cause it will be that, when the purpose of the Lord against Mount Zion and Jerusalem is complete, I will send punishment on the pride of the heart of the king of Assyria, and on the glory of his uplifted eyes.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ n tan Alatala na gɛ n ma wali birin nakamalide Siyoni geya fari nun Darisalamu, n fama nɛ n ya rafindide Asiriya mangɛ ma, n a xa yɛtɛ igboya sare ragbilen a ma,

sentences.english: For he has said, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my knowledge, for I am wise: and I have taken away the limits of the peoples' lands, and the stores of their wealth have become mine; and I have made towns low in the dust, sending destruction on those living in them;
sentences.susu: barima a luma a fala ra, ‹N bara yi birin naba n yɛtɛ sɛnbɛ ra, n ma fahaamui nan a niya duniɲa bɔxi birin xa lu n yi ra, n bara sie xa naafuli tongo n yɛtɛ bɛ, n bara nɔ mangɛ birin na, n findixi mangɛ sɛnbɛma nan na.

sentences.english: And I have put my hands on the wealth of the peoples, as on the place where a bird has put her eggs; and as a man may take the eggs from which a bird has gone, so I have taken all the earth for myself: and not a wing was moved, and not a mouth gave out a sound.
sentences.susu: N bara n bɛlɛxɛ itala sie xa bannaya tagi, n fa naafuli tongo alɔ mixi xɔni xɛlɛe bama a tɛɛ kui ki naxɛ. Mixi yo mu nɔ tɔnyi dɔxɔde n ma.›»

sentences.english: Will the axe say high-sounding words against him who is using it, or the blade be full of pride against him who is cutting with it? As if a rod had the power of shaking him who is using it, or as if a stick might take up him who is not wood.
sentences.susu: «Bera kole a yɛtɛ matɔxɔma a rawalima bɛ? Sɛra a yɛtɛ matɔxɔma kamudɛri bɛ? Bɔnbɔ wuri nɔma mixi bɛlɛxɛ ratede? Luxusinyi nɔma mixi bɔnbɔde?

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord, the Lord of armies, will make his fat become wasted; and in his inner parts a fire will be lighted like a burning flame.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala Sɛnbɛma fama nɛ a xa sɔɔri xungbee xɔside, a fa e gan tɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: wasting and burning up his thorns in one day.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Alatala luma nɛ alɔ tɛ sɛniyɛnxi, naxan e xa tunbe nun baagi birin ganma lɔxɔ keren.

sentences.english: And he will put an end to the glory of his woods and of his planted fields, soul and body together; and it will be as when a man is wasted by disease.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa fɔtɔnyi nun a xa xɛe xun fama nɛ kanade alɔ furema naxan na xɔsife.

sentences.english: And the rest of the trees of his wood will be small in number, so that a child may put them down in writing.
sentences.susu: Dimɛdi yati nɔma a xa wuri bili dɔnxɔɛe kɔntide naxee luma a xa fɔtɔnyie kui.»

sentences.english: And it will be in that day that the rest of Israel, and those of Jacob who have come safely through these troubles, will no longer go for help to him whose rod was on their back, but their faith will be in the Lord, the Holy One of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Isirayila mixi dɔnxɔɛe mu e xaxili tima mixie ra sɔnɔn, naxee nu bara nɔ e ra. Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ e xaxili tima Alatala nan na, naxan findixi Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: The rest, even the rest of Jacob, will come back to the Strong God.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ mixi dɔnxɔɛe fama nɛ gbilende Ala Sɛnbɛma ma.

sentences.english: For though your people, O Israel, are as the sand of the sea, only a small number will come back: for the destruction is fixed, overflowing in righteousness.
sentences.susu: Isirayila, hali i xa ɲama sa gbo nɛ alɔ mɛyɛnyi naxan na baa dɛ ra, dondoronti nan tun gbilenma e xɔnyi. Alatala bara natɛ tongo tinxinyi kui Isirayilakae sɔntɔfe ra.

sentences.english: For the Lord, the Lord of armies, is about to make destruction complete in all the land.
sentences.susu: Alatala Sɛnbɛma fama nɛ na natɛ rakamalide bɔxi birin kanafe ra.

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord, the Lord of armies, says, O my people living in Zion, have no fear of the Assyrian, even if his rod comes on your back, and his stick is lifted up as in Egypt.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala Sɛnbɛma bara yi masenyi ti, a naxɛ, «Wo tan, n ma ɲama naxan sabatixi Siyoni, hali wo mu gaaxu Asiriyakae ya ra, naxee na wo bɔnbɔfe luxusinyi nun wuri ra, alɔ Misirakae nu a rabama ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For in a very short time my passion will be over, and my wrath will be turned to their destruction.
sentences.susu: A gbe mu luxi n ma xɔnɛ xa gbilen wo fɔxɔ ra, a fa e tan xun nakana.»

sentences.english: And the Lord of armies will be shaking a whip against him, as when he overcame Midian at the rock of Oreb: and his rod will be lifted up against them as it was against the Egyptians.
sentences.susu: Alatala Sɛnbɛma fama nɛ a xa luxusinyi itede e xili ma, alɔ a naxan naba Madiyankae xa mangɛ Orebi ra. A fama nɛ a xa yisuxuwuri itede baa xun ma, alɔ a raba Misira bɔxi ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And in that day the weight which he put on your back will be taken away, and his yoke broken from off your neck.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Ala wo xa kote binye bama nɛ wo tunki ma e naxan saxi wo xun ma. Wo xun nakelima nɛ han na kote birin ba wo xun ma.

sentences.english: He has gone up from Pene-Rimmon, he has come to Aiath; he has gone past Migron, at Michmash he puts his forces in order.
sentences.susu: Wo yaxuie soma nɛ Ayata, e dangi Migiron ra, e kote nde lu Mikimasi.

sentences.english: They have gone across the mountain; Geba will be our resting-place tonight, they say: Ramah is shaking with fear; Gibeah of Saul has gone in flight.
sentences.susu: E dangima mɛnni nɛ, e yonkin Gebali. Gaaxui Ramakae suxuma nɛ, mixie e gima nɛ Sɔlu xa bɔxi ma Gibeya.

sentences.english: Give a loud cry, daughter of Gallim; let Laishah give ear; let Anathoth give answer to her.
sentences.susu: Bati Galimukae na wafe. «Layisakae, wo xa wo tuli mati. Anatɔtikae, wo makinikini.»

sentences.english: Madmenah has gone; the men of Gebim are putting their goods in a safe place.
sentences.susu: Madamenakae na yesenfe, Gebimikae na e nɔxunfe.

sentences.english: This very day he is stopping at Nob; he is shaking his hand against the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ na yaxuie danma Nobo nɛ, e e bɛlɛxɛ ramaxa Siyoni geya xili ma Darisalamu.

sentences.english: See, the Lord, the Lord of armies, is cutting off his branches with a great noise, and his strong ones are falling and his high ones are coming down.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala Sɛnbɛma mato, a na wuri bili salonyi bolonfe sɛnbɛ ra. A na wuri bili itexi rabirafe bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And he is cutting down the thick places of the wood with an axe, and Lebanon with its tall trees is coming down.
sentences.susu: A fama nɛ Liban fɔtɔnyi belebele fɔnde a xa bera ra.

sentences.english: And there will come a rod out of the broken tree of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots will give fruit.
sentences.susu: Salonyi nde bulama nɛ Yisayi bɔnsɔɛ ma, a sanke a niyama nɛ a xa bogi fanyi ramini.

sentences.english: And the spirit of the Lord will be resting on him, the spirit of wisdom and good sense, the spirit of wise guiding and strength, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord;
sentences.susu: Alatala Xaxili goroma nɛ a ma, a findi fahaamui, kolonyi, marasi, sɛnbɛ, nun Ala yaragaaxui ra.

sentences.english: And he will not be guided in his judging by what he sees, or give decisions by the hearing of his ears:
sentences.susu: A sɛɛwama nɛ Alatala xa yaragaaxui kui. A mu kiiti sama fe toxi xa na mu a ra fe mɛxi tun xa ma.

sentences.english: But he will do right in the cause of the poor, and give wise decisions for those in the land who are in need; and the rod of his mouth will come down on the cruel, and with the breath of his lips he will put an end to the evil-doer.
sentences.susu: A misikiinɛe makiitima nɛ tinxinyi ra, a natɛ fanyi tongo setaree bɛ. A duniɲa makiitima nɛ a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra, a yaamari fi mixi ɲaaxie xa sɔntɔ.

sentences.english: And righteousness will be the cord of his robe, and good faith the band round his breast.
sentences.susu: A fe birin nabama tinxinyi nan na, a xa laayidi mu kanama feo.

sentences.english: And the wolf will be living with the lamb, and the leopard will take his rest with the young goat; and the lion will take grass for food like the ox; and the young lion will go with the young ones of the herd; and a little child will be their guide.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, wulai bare nun yɛxɛɛ luma nɛ yire keren, xulumase nun si, ninge yɔrɛ nun yɛtɛ, e birin luma nɛ yire keren, dimɛdi nde fa e dɛ madon.

sentences.english: And the cow and the bear will be friends while their young ones are sleeping together.
sentences.susu: Ninge nun baratɛ e dɛ madonma nɛ yire keren, e xa die sa yire keren. Yɛtɛ nun ninge birin fama sɛxɛ nan donde.

sentences.english: And the child at the breast will be playing by the hole of the snake, and the older child will put his hand on the bright eye of the poison-snake.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ diyɔrɛ berema nɛ tanbalunbe ra, dimɛdi a bɛlɛxɛ raso sagale yili kui.

sentences.english: There will be no cause of pain or destruction in all my holy mountain: for the earth will be full of the knowledge of the Lord as the sea is covered by the waters.
sentences.susu: Fe xɔrɔxɔɛ yo mu sɔtɔma n tan Alatala xa geya sɛniyɛnxi fari, duniɲa birin n kolonma nɛ alɔ yɛxɛe baa kolonma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And in that day, the eyes of the nations will be turned to the root of Jesse which will be lifted up as the flag of the peoples; and his resting-place will be glory.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, Yisayi bɔnsɔɛ findima tɔnxuma nan na si birin bɛ, e fa e xun ti a ra binyɛ kui.

sentences.english: And in that day the hand of the Lord will be stretched out the second time to get back the rest of his people, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the sea-lands.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, Alatala man a xɔnyɛ italama nɛ a xa ɲama dɔnxɔɛ rakisife ra, naxee nu luma Asiriya, Misira, Patirosi, Kusi, Elama, Sinara, Xamata, nun baa surie ma.

sentences.english: And he will put up a flag as a sign to the nations, and he will get together those of Israel who had been sent away, and the wandering ones of Judah, from the four ends of the earth.
sentences.susu: A tɔnxuma masenma nɛ si birin bɛ. A Isirayila nun Yudaya mixie malanma nɛ, naxee nu rayensenxi duniɲa tunxun naani ma.

sentences.english: And the envy of Ephraim will be gone, and those who make trouble for Judah will come to an end: Ephraim will have no more envy of Judah, and there will be an end of Judah's hate for Ephraim.
sentences.susu: Efirami bɔnsɔɛ xa tɔɔnɛ ɲɔnma nɛ, Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xa gere masofe fan ɲɔnma nɛ. Efirami bɔɲɛ xinbelima nɛ Yudaya mabiri, Yudaya fan gere luma nɛ.

sentences.english: And they will be united in attacking the Philistines on the west, and together they will take the goods of the children of the east: their hand will be on Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon will be under their rule.
sentences.susu: E lanma nɛ Filisitakae gerefe ma sogetede mabiri, e e yaxuie fan gere naxee na sogegorode mabiri. E nɔma nɛ Edonkae nun Mowabakae ra, Amonikae fan lu e sagoe.

sentences.english: And the Lord will make the tongue of the Egyptian sea completely dry; and with his burning wind his hand will be stretched out over the River, and it will be parted into seven streams, so that men may go over it with dry feet.
sentences.susu: Alatala baa itaxun nɛ a xa ɲama bɛ e to keli Misira bɔxi ma. A Efirati xure fan itaxunma nɛ a xa foye magaaxuxi ra, a fa findi kira ra, ɲama naxee igirima e xaraxi ra.

sentences.english: And there will be a highway for the rest of his people from Assyria; as there was for Israel in the day when he came up out of the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Alatala kira fima nɛ a xa ɲama dɔnxɔɛ ma, alako e xa keli Asiriya, alɔ e benbae Isirayilakae mini Misira bɔxi ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And in that day you will say I will give praise to you, O Lord; for though you were angry with me, your wrath is turned away, and I am comforted.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ wo fama nɛ a falade, «Muxu bara i tan Alatala matɔxɔ. I nu bara xɔnɔ muxu ma, kɔnɔ i xa xɔnɛ bara gbilen muxu fɔxɔ ra, i fa muxu madundu.

sentences.english: See, God is my salvation; I will have faith in the Lord, without fear: for the Lord Jah is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.
sentences.susu: Muxu Rakisima nan na Ala ra. Muxu bara la i ra, sese mu muxu magaaxuma sɔnɔn, barima i tan Alatala nan na muxu sɛnbɛ ra, i tan nan na muxu xa kisi ra. Na bara a niya muxu xa bɛɛti ba i matɔxɔfe ra.»

sentences.english: So with joy will you get water out of the springs of salvation.
sentences.susu: Wo fama nɛ ye bade kisi dulonyi kui sɛɛwɛ ra.

sentences.english: And in that day you will say, Give praise to the Lord, let his name be honoured, give word of his doings among the peoples, say that his name is lifted up.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, wo fama nɛ a falade, «Wo xa Alatala matɔxɔ, wo xa a xili masen duniɲa bɛ, wo xa a xa wali fanyie fala ɲamanɛ ma.

sentences.english: Make a song to the Lord; for he has done noble things: give news of them through all the earth.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Alatala matɔxɔ bɛɛtie ra a xa kaabanakoe xa fe ra. Wo xa duniɲa birin nakolon a xa nɔrɛ ra.

sentences.english: Let your voice be sounding in a cry of joy, O daughter of Zion, for great is the Holy One of Israel among you.
sentences.susu: Wo tan Siyonikae, wo xa wo xui ramini sɛɛwɛ ra, barima Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ sɛnbɛ gbo wo tagi!»

sentences.english: The word of the Lord about Babylon which Isaiah, the son of Amoz, saw.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi Amosi xa di Annabi Esayi bɛ Babilɔn xili ma.

sentences.english: Put up a flag on a clear mountain-top, make a loud outcry to them, give directions with the hand, so that they may go into the doors of the great ones.
sentences.susu: Wo tɔnxuma raba geya fari, wo wo xui rate e yamarife ra, e xa kuntigie xa naadɛe igbusan.

sentences.english: I have given orders to my holy ones, I have sent out my men of war, those of mine who take pride in their power, to give effect to my wrath.
sentences.susu: N bara yaamari fi n ma mixi sugandixie ma, n bara n ma ɲalamae xili n ma xɔnɛ masende xunnakeli kui.

sentences.english: The noise of great numbers in the mountains, like the noise of a strong people! The noise of the kingdoms of the nations meeting together! The Lord of armies is numbering his forces for war.
sentences.susu: Ɲama xui wunduma geyae fari, ɲamae na e malanfe naa. Mangɛ Alatala na a xa sɔɔrie xilife gere ma,

sentences.english: They come from a far country, from the farthest part of heaven, even the Lord and the instruments of his wrath, with destruction for all the land.
sentences.susu: e kelixi yire makuye koore baanyi. Alatala nun a xa mixie fama nɛ yi bɔxi ɲaxankatade a xa xɔnɛ kui.

sentences.english: Send out a cry of grief; for the day of the Lord is near; it comes as destruction from the Most High.
sentences.susu: Wo xa gbelegbele tɔɔrɛ kui, barima Alatala xa lɔxɔɛ bara makɔrɛ, a na fafe alɔ gbaloe naxan kelixi Ala Sɛnbɛma ma.

sentences.english: For this cause all hands will be feeble, and every heart of man be turned to water;
sentences.susu: Mixie sɛnbɛ ɲɔnma nɛ, limaniya ba e bɔɲɛ ma.

sentences.english: Their hearts will be full of fear; pains and sorrows will overcome them; they will be in pain like a woman in childbirth; they will be shocked at one another; their faces will be like flames.
sentences.susu: Gaaxui nun tɔɔrɛ nɔma nɛ e ra, e e kutun xɔnɛ bɛ alɔ ginɛ di furi na keli a ra. Gaaxui belebele toma nɛ e yatagie ma.

sentences.english: See, the day of the Lord is coming, cruel, with wrath and burning passion: to make the land a waste, driving the sinners in it to destruction.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa lɔxɔɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ na fafe, a fama nɛ a xa xɔnɛ ra naxan bɔxi xun nakanama, naxan yunubitɔɛe sɔntɔma.

sentences.english: For the stars of heaven and its bright armies will not give their light: the sun will be made dark in his journey through the heaven, and the moon will keep back her light.
sentences.susu: Tunbuie xa yanbɛ ɲɔnma nɛ, soge ifɔɔrɔma nɛ, kike mu yanbama sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And I will send punishment on the world for its evil, and on the sinners for their wrongdoing; and I will put an end to all pride, and will make low the power of the cruel.
sentences.susu: N duniɲa ratɔnma nɛ a xa fe ɲaaxi xa fe ra, n yunubitɔɛ ɲaxankata e xa yunubie xa fe ra. N yɛtɛ igboe xun nakanama nɛ, n funmalae xa nɔɛ rabira.

sentences.english: I will make men so small in number, that a man will be harder to get than gold, even the best gold of Ophir.
sentences.susu: N adamadie xurunma nɛ, alɔ xɛɛma fanyi xurunma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For this cause the heavens will be shaking, and the earth will be moved out of its place, in the wrath of the Lord of armies, and in the day of his burning passion.
sentences.susu: N tan Mangɛ Alatala, n koore nun bɔxi rasɛrɛnma nɛ n ma xɔnɛ kui.

sentences.english: And it will be that, like a roe in flight, and like wandering sheep, they will go every man to his people and to his land.
sentences.susu: Mixie luma nɛ e gi ra alɔ bole naxan na wula i, e lu alɔ xuruse kantama mu naxan fɔxɔ ra. E gbilenma nɛ e xɔnyi e kelixi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Everyone who is overtaken will have a spear put through him, and everyone who goes in flight will be put to the sword.
sentences.susu: E naxee suxuma kira ra, e fama nɛ e sɔxɔde tanbɛ ra, e fa faxade santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: Their young children will be broken up before their eyes; their goods will be taken away, and their wives made the property of others.
sentences.susu: E xa die sɔntɔma nɛ a ɲaaxi ra e ya xɔri, e xa banxie kasara, e xa ginɛe masa e ya xɔri.

sentences.english: See, I am driving the Medes against them, who put no value on silver and have no pleasure in gold.
sentences.susu: N na birin nabama Medekae nan saabui ra, gbeti nun xɛɛma mu naxee madaxuma.

sentences.english: In their hands are bows and spears; they are cruel, violently putting the young men to death, and crushing the young women; they have no pity for children, and no mercy for the fruit of the body.
sentences.susu: E xa xalie fonikee rabirama nɛ, e mu kinikinima diyɔrɛe ma, e mu kinikinima dimɛdie ma.

sentences.english: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beautiful town which is the pride of the Chaldaeans, will be like God's destruction of Sodom and Gomorrah.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan Babilɔn xa fe xun nakanama, alɔ a rabaxi Sodoma nun Gomora ra ki naxɛ. Babilɔn, naxan xa nɔrɛ gbo duniɲa ma, a birama nɛ a xa yɛtɛ igboɲa kui.

sentences.english: People will never be living in it again, and it will have no more men from generation to generation: the Arab will not put up his tent there; and those who keep sheep will not make it a resting-place for their flocks.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu sabatima mɛnni sɔnɔn. Hali biyaasilae nun xuruse dɛmadonyie mu yonkinma naa.

sentences.english: But the beasts of the waste land will have their holes there; and the houses will be full of crying jackals, and ostriches will have their place there, and evil spirits will be dancing there.
sentences.susu: Wulai subee gbansan nan luma naa. Wulai baree nun xundie nan xima naa banxi kanaxie kui. Wulai sie toma nɛ naa tuganfe ra. Sikɔtɛ toma nɛ naa e tuganma.

sentences.english: And wolves will be answering one another in their towers, and jackals in their houses of pleasure: her time is near, and her days of power will quickly be ended.
sentences.susu: Xulumasee nan luma e xui ramini ra mangɛ banxie kui, wulai baree e ɲɛrɛ na longori birin. Babilɔn ɲaxankata tɛmui bara a li, a gbe mu luxi sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will again make Israel his special people, and will put them in their land; and the man from a strange country will take his place among them and be joined to the family of Jacob.
sentences.susu: Alatala kinikinima nɛ Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ ma, a fa e rasabati e xɔnyi Isirayila bɔxi ma. Xɔɲɛe fan kafuma nɛ e ma, e lu lanyi kui Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ ya ma.

sentences.english: And the people will take them with them to their place: and the children of Israel will give them a heritage in the Lord's land as men-servants and women-servants, making them prisoners whose prisoners they were; and they will be rulers over their masters.
sentences.susu: Sie e malima nɛ sabatide e xɔnyi, na sie fa findi Isirayila xa konyie ra. Mixi naxee nu bara e suxu, e tan yati bara findi Isirayila xa konyie ra.

sentences.english: And it will be, in the day when the Lord gives you rest from your sorrow, and from your trouble, and from the hard yoke which they had put on you,
sentences.susu: Alatala na malabui fi wo ma wo xa tɔɔrɛ nun fe xɔrɔxɔɛ xa fe ra tɛmui naxɛ, a fa wo ramini wo xa konyiɲa wali xɔrɔxɔɛ kui naxan nu bara dɔxɔ wo ma,

sentences.english: That you will take up this bitter song against the king of Babylon, and say, How has the cruel overseer come to an end! He who was lifted up in pride is cut off;
sentences.susu: wo fama nɛ yi masenyi tide Babilɔn mangɛ bɛ, «Munse ɲaxankatɛ kanyi ralɔɛxi? A tɔɔrɛ naxan dɔxɔxi mixie ma, na ɲɔnxi di?

sentences.english: The stick of the evil-doers, the rod of the rulers, is broken by the Lord;
sentences.susu: Alatala bara mixi ɲaaxi xa wuri bɔnbɔ ti se ibolon, a bara mangɛ kobi xa munyaati igira,

sentences.english: He whose rod was on the peoples with an unending wrath, ruling the nations in passion, with an uncontrolled rule.
sentences.susu: naxan nu ɲamae bɔnbɔma a xa bɔɲɛ te ra, naxan mu danma naxan nu nɔɛ dɔxɔma ɲamanɛe ma a xa xɔnɛ kui.»

sentences.english: All the earth is at rest and is quiet: they are bursting into song.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi duniɲa na malabui nun xaxilisa nan kui fa, birin na e xui itefe sɛɛwɛ kui.

sentences.english: Even the trees of the wood are glad over you, the trees of Lebanon, saying, From the time of your fall no wood-cutter has come up against us with an axe.
sentences.susu: Hali wuri bili naxee na Liban, e na ɲɛlɛxinfe i xa fe danyi ra, e nu fa a fala, ‹Kafi i bira, mixi yo mu muxu fɔnma sɔnɔn.›

sentences.english: The underworld is moved at your coming: the shades of the dead are awake before you, even the strong ones of the earth; all the kings of the world have got up from their seats.
sentences.susu: Aligiyama na a yailanfe i fafe ra. Kuntigie furee rakelima nɛ i ya ra aligiyama dimi kui, si mangɛe birin nakelima nɛ e xa kibanyie kui,

sentences.english: They all make answer and say to you, Have you become feeble like us? have you been made even as we are?
sentences.susu: i rasɛnɛfe yi wɔyɛnyi ra, ‹I fan sɛnbɛ bara kana alɔ muxu tan, won birin bara lu yire keren.

sentences.english: Your pride has gone down into the underworld, and the noise of your instruments of music; the worms are under you, and your body is covered with them.
sentences.susu: I xa yɛtɛ igboya bara ragoro gaburi kui, i xa sigie bara dundu, kulie bara lu i xa sade ma.›»

sentences.english: How great is your fall from heaven, O shining one, son of the morning! How are you cut down to the earth, low among the dead bodies!
sentences.susu: «I bara bira kelife koore ma, i tan naxan nu yanbama alɔ subaxɛ looloe. E bara i rabira bɔxi, i tan naxan nu nɔxi ɲamanɛe ra.

sentences.english: For you said in your heart, I will go up to heaven, I will make my seat higher than the stars of God; I will take my place on the mountain of the meeting-place of the gods, in the inmost parts of the north.
sentences.susu: I nu a fala nɛ i bɔɲɛ kui, ‹N tan tema nɛ han ariyanna, n findi naa mangɛ ra, n dɔxɔ n ma kibanyi kui malanyi ya ma naxan nabama na geya sɛniyɛnxi fari.

sentences.english: I will go higher than the clouds; I will be like the Most High.
sentences.susu: N tema nɛ nuxui fari, n lu alɔ Ala Sɛnbɛma.›»

sentences.english: But you will come down to the underworld, even to its inmost parts.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ i xa nate bara kana, e bara i ragoro kelife koore ma han gaburi kui, i xa lu yili tilinxi kui aligiyama.

sentences.english: Those who see you will be looking on you with care, they will be in deep thought, saying, Is this the troubler of the earth, the shaker of kingdoms?
sentences.susu: Faxa mixi naxee i toma naa, nee e ya banbanma nɛ i ra, e fa a maɲɔxun, ‹Yi nan findixi na mixi ra naxan nu duniɲa imaxama, naxan nu mangɛya kanama,

sentences.english: Who made the world a waste, overturning its towns; who did not let his prisoners loose from the prison-house.
sentences.susu: naxan nu duniɲa findima gbengberenyi ra a xa taae kanafe ra, naxan nu tondima a xa geelimanie bɛɲinde?›»

sentences.english: All the kings of the earth are at rest in glory, every man in his house,
sentences.susu: «Ɲamanɛ mangɛe birin nagataxi e xa gaburi binyɛ nan kui,

sentences.english: But you, like a birth before its time, are stretched out with no resting-place in the earth; clothed with the bodies of the dead who have been put to the sword, who go down to the lowest parts of the underworld; a dead body, crushed under foot.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ i tan mu ragataxi i xa gaburi kui, alɔ salonyi naxan sɛgɛma wuri ma, alɔ sɔɔri naxan faxaxi santidɛgɛma ra a lu a booree furee ya ma, e birin fa goro aligiyama yili kui.

sentences.english: As for your fathers, you will not be united with them in their resting-place, because you have been the cause of destruction to your land, and of death to your people; the seed of the evil-doer will have no place in the memory of man.
sentences.susu: Binyɛ yo mu luma i xa ɲɔn fe kui alɔ e tan, barima i bara i xa bɔxi tuxunsan, i bara i xa ɲama sɔntɔ.» «Mixi ɲaaxi xa die xili nɛɛmuma nɛ duniɲa ra.

sentences.english: Make ready a place of death for his children, because of the evil-doing of their father; so that they may not come up and take the earth for their heritage, covering the face of the world with waste places.
sentences.susu: E xa die kɔn xa raxaba e babae xa yunubie xa fe ra, e naxa e ikeli fa, e bɔxi sɔtɔ e taae tima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: For I will come up against them, says the Lord of armies, cutting off from Babylon name and offspring, son and son's son, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N tan Alatala Sɛnbɛma kelima nɛ e xili ma, n Babilɔn xili nun a bɔnsɔɛ dɔnxɔɛ raɲɔnma nɛ, e xa di yo mu luma naa.

sentences.english: And I will make you a heritage for the hedgehog, and pools of water: and I will go through it with the brush of destruction, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: N e xɔnyi findima xundi yire nan na ye ɲaaxi luma dɛnnaxɛ. N nee xun nakanama feo.» Alatala Sɛnbɛma xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: The Lord has taken an oath, saying, My design will certainly come about, and my purpose will be effected:
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala bara a kali yi masenyi ra, «N natɛ naxan tongoxi a fama kamalide, n waxɔnfe mu kanama.

sentences.english: To let the Assyrian be broken in my land, and crushed under foot on my mountains: there will his yoke be taken away from them, and his rule over them come to an end.
sentences.susu: N Asiriya butuxunma nɛ n ma bɔxi kui, n e boronma nɛ n ma geyae fari. E xa nɔɛ bama nɛ n ma ɲama fari, n e xa kote bama nɛ n ma mixie xun.»

sentences.english: This is the purpose for all the earth: and this is the hand stretched out over all nations.
sentences.susu: Natɛ nan na ki naxan tongoxi duniɲa birin xili ma. Alatala Sɛnbɛma bɛlɛxɛ nan na ki, a naxan italaxi ɲamanɛe birin xili ma.

sentences.english: For it is the purpose of the Lord of armies, and who will make it of no effect? when his hand is stretched out, by whom may it be turned back?
sentences.susu: Alatala bara na natɛ tongo. Nde na kanama? Alatala nan bɛlɛxɛ italaxi. Nde na isoma?

sentences.english: In the year of the death of King Ahaz this word came to the prophet:
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Axasi faxa ɲɛ naxan na, Ala yi masenyi nan ti,

sentences.english: Be not glad, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod which was on you is broken: for out of the snake's root will come a poison-snake, and its fruit will be a winged poison-snake.
sentences.susu: «Filisitakae, wo naxa sɛɛwa wo yaxuie birafe ra. Kelife bɔximase nde ma, bɔximase gbɛtɛ nan barima, naxan xulun, a xɔnɔ na singe bɛ.

sentences.english: And the poorest of the land will have food, and those in need will be given a safe resting-place: but your seed will come to an end for need of food, and the rest of you will be put to the sword.
sentences.susu: Na kui, misikiinɛe fama nɛ balode, tɔɔrɔmixie malabuma nɛ xaxilisa kui, kɔnɔ wo tan Filisitakae, n wo faxama nɛ kaamɛ ra, n wo bɔnsɔɛ dɔnxɔɛ sɔntɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: Send out a cry, O door! Make sounds of sorrow, O town! All your land has come to nothing, O Philistia; for there comes a smoke out of the north, and everyone keeps his place in the line.
sentences.susu: Wa xui xa mini wo ya ma, limaniya xa ba wo yi! Tuuri fɔɔrɛ na tefe kɔɔla biri ra, sɔɔri yo mu baxi e ra.»

sentences.english: What answer, then, will my people give to the representatives of the nation? That the Lord is the builder of Zion, and she will be a safe place for the poor of his people.
sentences.susu: Yaabi mundun fima sie xa xɛɛrae ma? E a falama nɛ, «Alatala nan Siyoni xa fe mabanbanxi, a a xa ɲama tɔɔrɔxi kanta.»

sentences.english: The word about Moab. For in a night Ar of Moab has become waste, and is seen no longer; for in a night Kir of Moab has become waste, and is seen no longer.
sentences.susu: Masenyi nan ya Mowaba xa fe ra: A xa taa Ari xun bara rakana kɔɛ keren kui. A xa taa Kiri xun bara rakana kɔɛ keren kui.

sentences.english: The daughter of Dibon has gone up to the high places, weeping: Moab is sounding her cry of sorrow over Nebo, and over Medeba: everywhere the hair of the head and of the face is cut off.
sentences.susu: Dibonkae sigama nɛ wade e xa kuyee yire. Mowabakae na wafe e xa taae Nebo nun Medeba xa fe ra, e e xunyi bii, e e dɛ xabee maxaba sunnunyi kui.

sentences.english: In their streets they are covering themselves with haircloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their public places, there is crying and bitter weeping.
sentences.susu: E ɲɔnyi dugie ragoroma e ma kira ra. E birin wama nɛ e xui itexi ra e xa banxie kɔn na nun e xa taa malandee kui.

sentences.english: Heshbon is crying out, and Elealeh; their voice is sounding even to Jahaz: for this cause the heart of Moab is shaking; his soul is shaking with fear.
sentences.susu: Xɛsibɔnkae nun Eleyalekae na gbelegbelefe, e wa xui sa mɛma han Yahasi taa kui. Mowaba sɔɔrie na gbelegbelefe na nan ma, limaniya bara ba e yi ra.

sentences.english: My heart is crying out for Moab; her people go in flight to Zoar, and to Eglath-shelishiyah: for they go up with weeping by the slope of Luhith; on the way to Horonaim they send up a cry of destruction.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ fan na wafe Mowabakae xa fe ra. E xa mixie e gima nɛ han Sowari taa, han Egelati Selisiya taa. E tema nɛ wa ra Luxiti, e wa Xoronayimi kira ra,

sentences.english: The waters of Nimrim will become dry: for the grass is burned up, the young grass is coming to an end, every green thing is dead.
sentences.susu: barima Nimirin xure bara xɔri, fiilie bara xara, sansie bara kana, burɛxɛ xinde yo mu na sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: For this cause they will take away their wealth, and the stores they have got together, over the stream of the water-plants.
sentences.susu: Na bara a niya e xa e xa se dɔnxɔɛe xanin konde yire xure fɛ ma.

sentences.english: For the cry has gone round the limits of Moab; as far as to Eglaim and Beer-elim.
sentences.susu: Mowaba wa xui mɛma nɛ naaninyie ra, han Egelayimi, han Beera Elimi.

sentences.english: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood: and I'm sending even more on Moab, a lion on those of Moab who go in flight, and on the rest of the land.
sentences.susu: Dimɔn xuree ragbeelixi wuli ra, kɔnɔ n mu gɛxi sinden. Gbaloe dinma nɛ Mowabakae birin na, naxee e gima, nun naxee luma e xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And they will send ... to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.
sentences.susu: Wo xa yɛxɛɛ kontonyi nde rasanba bɔxi mangɛ xɔn ma, kelife Sela naxan na Mowaba wula i, han Siyoni geya tofanyi.

sentences.english: For the daughters of Moab will be like wandering birds, like a place from which the young birds have gone in flight, at the ways across the Arnon.
sentences.susu: Mowaba ginɛe e gima nɛ Arinon xure igiridee, kɔnɔ e luma nɛ alɔ xɔni naxee kerixi e tɛɛ kui.

sentences.english: Give wise directions, make a decision; let your shade be as night in full day: keep safe those who are in flight; do not give up the wandering ones.
sentences.susu: Mowabakae naxɛ, «Darisalamukae, wo xa wo bore to, wo xa natɛ nde tongo muxu xa fe ra. Wo xa muxu nɔxun wo xɔnyi, wo naxa muxu yanfa won yaxuie ma.

sentences.english: Let those who have been forced out of Moab have a resting-place with you; be a cover to them from him who is making waste their land: till the cruel ones are cut off, and wasting has come to an end, and those who take pleasure in crushing the poor are gone from the land.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Mowabakae ratanga kasarati ma, naxee kantari fenma wo xɔnyi, wo xa e makanta.» Kasarati fama sigade, a xa natɛ mu kamalima bɔxi kanafe ra.

sentences.english: Then a king's seat will be based on mercy, and one will be seated on it in the tent of David for ever; judging uprightly, and quick to do righteousness.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ kibanyi fama nɛ mabanbande dugutɛgɛya ra. Tinxintɔɛ nde naxan fatanxi Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ ra, naxan kiiti sama nɔndi ra tinxintɔɛe bɛ, a fama nɛ a magorode a xa kibanyi kui.

sentences.english: We have had word of the pride of Moab, how great it is; how he is lifted up in pride and passion: his high words about himself are false.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara Mowabakae xa yɛtɛ igboɲa kolon. A ɲɔxɔ a ma a fisa mixi birin bɛ. A a yɛtɛ matɔxɔma tɛmui birin, kɔnɔ nɔndi yo mu na na matɔxɔɛ kui.

sentences.english: For this cause everyone in Moab will give cries of grief for Moab: crushed to the earth, they will be weeping for the men of Kir-hareseth.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi Mowabakae na wafe e xa bɔxi xa fe ra, e na sunnunyi kui Kire Xareseti xa daxamui kanɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For the fields of Heshbon are waste, the vine of Sibmah is dead; the lords of nations were overcome by the produce of her vines; her vine-plants went as far as Jazer, and came even to the waste land; her branches were stretched out to the sea.
sentences.susu: Xɛsibɔn nun Sibima wɛni bilie bara kana. Ɲamanɛ mangɛe bara nee birin kana, naxee nu sigama Yaasɛri taa mabiri, han gbengberenyi ma, han baa dɛ ra.

sentences.english: For this cause my sorrow for the vine of Sibmah will be like the weeping for Jazer: my eyes are dropping water on you, O Heshbon and Elealeh! For they are sounding the war-cry over your summer fruits and the getting in of your grain;
sentences.susu: Na kui n fan wama nɛ Yaasɛri sɛɛti ma Sibima wɛni xɛ xa fe ra. N yaye Xɛsibɔn nun Eleyale lima nɛ, barima wo mu sɛɛwɛ xui raminima sɔnɔn wo xa xɛe nun wo xa wɛni bogie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And all joy is gone; no longer are they glad for the fertile field; and in the vine-gardens there are no songs or sounds of joy: the crushing of grapes has come to an end, and its glad cry has been stopped.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ xui bara ɲɔn wo xa sansi yiree. Ɲɛlɛxin xui mu mɛma wo xa wɛni xɛe yire sɔnɔn. Wɛni yailanmae mu wɛni bogi bunduma sɔnɔn, e mu ɲɛlɛxin sigi sama na wali xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For this cause the cords of my heart are sounding for Moab, and I am full of sorrow for Kir-heres.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ na tɔɔrɔfe Mowaba xa fe ra, n sondonyi na wafe Kiri Xareseti xa fe ra.
