sentences.english: And when Moab goes up to the high place, and makes prayer in the house of his god, it will have no effect.
sentences.susu: Mowabakae bara mini sigafe ra e xa kuyee yire, e xa sa e xa alae makula, kɔnɔ na fan findima fe fufafu nan na.

sentences.english: This is the word which the Lord said about Moab in the past.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki Mowaba xa fe ra, naxan masenxi tɛmui dangixi.

sentences.english: But now the Lord has said, In three years, the years of a servant working for payment, the glory of Moab, all that great people, will be turned to shame, and the rest of Moab will be very small and without honour.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi Alatala naxɛ, «Beenun ɲɛ saxan xa kamali, alɔ a kamalima walikɛ bɛ a xa lanyi kui ki naxɛ, Mowabakae xa xunnakeli ɲɔnma nɛ, a xa ɲama mabere. Mixi dondoronti nan natangama gbaloe ma.»

sentences.english: The word about Damascus. See, they have made Damascus a town no longer; it has become a waste place.
sentences.susu: Masenyi nan ya Damasi xa fe ra: Damasi taa xun nakanama nɛ.

sentences.english: Her towns are unpeopled for ever; there the flocks take their rest in peace, without fear.
sentences.susu: Aroweri taae rabɛɲinma nɛ, e findi fiili ra xuruse dɛ madonma dɛnnaxɛ. Mixi yo mu luma naa naxan xurusee tɔɔrɔma.

sentences.english: The strong tower has gone from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus: the rest of Aram will come to destruction, and be made like the glory of the children of Israel, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Efirami taa makantaxi xun nakanama nɛ. Damasi mu findima mangataa ra sɔnɔn. Arami mixi dɔnxɔɛe luma nɛ alɔ Isirayilakae.

sentences.english: And it will be in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made small, and the strength of his body will become feeble.
sentences.susu: «Na lɔxɔɛ Yaxuba xa dariyɛ xurunma nɛ, a fate xɔsima nɛ.

sentences.english: And it will be like a man cutting the growth of his grain, pulling together the heads of the grain with his arm; even as when they get in the grain in the valley of Rephaim.
sentences.susu: A luma nɛ alɔ xɛɛ xaba tɛmui Refa gulunba kui. Sansie tixi, e xabamae fa e xaba.

sentences.english: But it will be like a man shaking an olive-tree, something will still be there, two or three berries on the top of the highest branch, four or five on the outside branches of a fertile tree, says the Lord, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: Bogi keren keren nan luma a sansi kɔn na, alɔ Oliwi bogi keren keren luma a bili kɔn na ki naxɛ, firin xa na mu a ra saxan lu a kɔn na, naani xa na mu a ra suuli to salonyi keren ma.» Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: In that day a man's heart will be turned to his Maker, and his eyes to the Holy One of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ mixie fama nɛ Daali Marigi tode, naxan findixi Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: He will not be looking to the altars, the work of his hands, or to the wood pillars or to the sun-images which his fingers have made.
sentences.susu: E mu e ya rafindima kuyee ma sɔnɔn, e bɛlɛxɛ naxee yailanxi. E mu sigama surayi gande e xa wuri masolixie yire, e bɛlɛxɛ sole naxee rafalaxi.

sentences.english: In that day your towns will be like the waste places of the Hivites and the Amorites which the children of Israel took for a heritage, and they will come to destruction.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ e xa taa sɛnbɛmae rabɛɲinma nɛ, e findi fɔtɔnyi ra geya fari, alɔ Amori xa taae rabɛɲin ki naxɛ Isirayilakae ya ra. A birin kanama nɛ.

sentences.english: For you have not given honour to the God of your salvation, and have not kept in mind the Rock of your strength; for this cause you made a garden of Adonis, and put in it the vine-cuttings of a strange god;
sentences.susu: Wo bara nɛɛmu wo Rakisima Ala ma, naxan findixi wo kantama ra. Wo bara sansi fanyi si naxan kelixi yire makuye.

sentences.english: In the day of your planting you were watching its growth, and in the morning your seed was flowering: but its fruit is wasted away in the day of grief and bitter sorrow.
sentences.susu: Wo to e si, e naxa bula wo ya xɔri na kuye iba gɛɛsɛgɛ. E naxa fuga keren na, kɔnɔ a xaba tɛmui wo mu bogi yo toma naa. Wo luma tɔɔrɛ nan tun kui.

sentences.english: Ah! the voice of peoples, like the loud sounding of the seas, and the thundering of great nations rushing on like the bursting out of waters!
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ xungbe nan na ki. Ɲama gbegbe na wundufe alɔ baa mɔrɔnyi, e na sɔnxɔɛ ratefe alɔ susui belebele.

sentences.english: But he will put a stop to them, and make them go in flight far away, driving them like the waste of the grain on the tops of the mountains before the wind, and like the circling dust before the storm.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ hali e wundu, e e gima nɛ Alatala xa xaaɲɛ ya ra, e siga yire makuye alɔ foye maale lagi xaninma ki naxɛ, alɔ foye sɛxɛ xaninma ki naxɛ geyae fari, alɔ turunnaadɛ xube rakelima ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: In the evening there is fear, and in the morning they are gone. This is the fate of those who take our goods, and the reward of those who violently take our property for themselves.
sentences.susu: E fama gere ra nunmare tɛmui nɛ, kɔnɔ beenun kuye xa iba, sese mu luma naa sɔnɔn. Naxee dusuma won xun na, e fu won ma, nee xa fe rabama na ki nɛ. Naxee baganma won ma, e won ma naafuli tongo, e xa fe raɲɔnma na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Ho! land of the sounding of wings, on the other side of the rivers of Ethiopia:
sentences.susu: Wo tan naxee na Kusi xuree naakiri ma, xɔni gabutenyi xui mɛma dɛnnaxɛ,

sentences.english: Which sends its representatives by the sea, even in ships of papyrus on the waters. Go back quickly, O representatives, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people causing fear through all their history; a strong nation, crushing down its haters, whose land is cut through by rivers.
sentences.susu: naxee xɛɛrae xɛɛma kunkui kui baa ma. N tan bara xɛɛrae xulunxie xɛɛ na si ma, si bɔnsɔɛ kuye rayabuxi, naxan magaaxu kabi e fɔlɛ gere xa fe ra, naxan sabatixi bɔxi ma xure wuyaxi na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: All you peoples of the world, and you who are living on the earth, when a flag is lifted up on the mountains, give attention; and when the horn is sounded, give ear.
sentences.susu: Wo tan duniɲa mixi birin, naxee sabatixi wo xa bɔxi ma, wo na tɔnxuma to geya fari, wo wo ya ti na ra. Wo na sare xui mɛ, wo wo tuli mati na ra,

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord has said to me: I will be quiet, watching from my place; like the clear heat when the sun is shining, like a mist of dew in the heat of summer.
sentences.susu: barima Alatala yi nan masenxi n bɛ, a naxɛ, «N magoroxi n xɔnyi xaxilisa kui, alɔ wuyenyi luxi sansi ma sogofure tɛmui ki naxɛ, alɔ nuxui na ti xɛ xun ma ɲɛmɛ ra.»

sentences.english: For before the time of getting in the grapes, after the opening of the bud, when the flower has become a grape ready for crushing, he will take away the small branches with knives, cutting down and taking away the wide-stretching branches.
sentences.susu: Beenun sansi xaba tɛmui xa a li, sansi na gɛ fugade, kɔnɔ a bogi mu minixi sinden, Alatala fama nɛ sansi fuge bolonde finɛ ra, a fa salonyie yati masɛgɛ.

sentences.english: They will be for the birds of the mountains, and for the beasts of the earth: the birds will come down on them in the summer, and the beasts of the earth in the winter.
sentences.susu: A bogi nan luma xɔnie nun wulai sube bɛ, e naxan donma sogofure nun ɲɛmɛ ra.

sentences.english: In that time an offering will be made to the Lord of armies from a people tall and smooth, causing fear through all their history; a strong nation, crushing down its haters, whose land is cut through by rivers, an offering taken to the place of the name of the Lord of armies, even Mount Zion.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui si sɛnbɛma nde fama nɛ hadiya ra Mangɛ Alatala bɛ, si bɔnsɔɛ kuye, rayabuxi, naxan magaaxu yire birin, naxan xa xui fala xɔnɔ. E fama na hadiya ra Siyoni geya nan fari, Alatala Sɛnbɛma xili matɔxɔma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: The word about Egypt. See, the Lord is seated on a quick-moving cloud, and is coming to Egypt: and the false gods of Egypt will be troubled at his coming, and the heart of Egypt will be turned to water.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na Misira bɛ. Alatala na fafe Misirakae xili ma nuxui fari. E xa kuyee na sɛrɛnfe a ya ra, gaaxui bara lu e bɔɲɛ ma.

sentences.english: And I will send the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they will be fighting every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; town against town, and kingdom against kingdom.
sentences.susu: N Misirakae radinma nɛ e boore ra, kankan nu fa a ngaxakerenyi nun a dɛ fan boore gere taa nun mangɛya xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And the spirit of Egypt will be troubled in her, and I will make her decisions without effect: and they will be turning to the false gods, and to those who make hollow sounds, and to those who have control of spirits, and to those who are wise in secret arts.
sentences.susu: Limaniya bama nɛ Misirakae yi ra, n e xa natɛ birin kana nɛ e ra. E marasi fenma nɛ e xa alae ra, e e benba faxaxie maxandi sematoee nun duuree saabui ra.

sentences.english: And I will give the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord; and a hard king will be their ruler, says the Lord, the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: N Misirakae soma nɛ mangɛe yi ra naxee xa fe maxɔrɔxɔ, naxee xa yaamari findi tɔɔrɛ ra ɲama bɛ. Alatala Sɛnbɛma xa masenyi nan ya.

sentences.english: And the waters of the sea will be cut off, and the river will become dry and waste:
sentences.susu: Baa nun xuree ye xɔrima nɛ.

sentences.english: And the rivers will have an evil smell; the stream of Egypt will become small and dry: all the water-plants will come to nothing.
sentences.susu: Ye naxan luma xureguli, a bɔrɔma nɛ, a xiri ɲaaxi fa te. Sansi birin naxee na xure dɛ ra e lisima nɛ.

sentences.english: The grass-lands by the Nile, and everything planted by the Nile, will become dry, or taken away by the wind, and will come to an end.
sentences.susu: Hali naxee na Nili xure xungbe dɛ ra, a soma baa ma dɛnnaxɛ, e fan lisima nɛ. Xɛ naxee na xure dɛ ra, e xarama nɛ, foye fa a birin xanin.

sentences.english: The fishermen will be sad, and all those who put fishing-lines into the Nile will be full of grief, and those whose nets are stretched out on the waters will have sorrow in their hearts.
sentences.susu: Yɛxɛ suxui birin wama nɛ, naxee kɔnyi nun yɛlɛ wolima xure ma.

sentences.english: And all the workers in linen thread, and those who make cotton cloth, will be put to shame.
sentences.susu: Naxee gɛsɛ rawalima, e fan luma nɛ tɔɔrɛ kui, limaniya ba e yi ra.

sentences.english: And the makers of twisted thread will be crushed, and those who ... will be sad in heart.
sentences.susu: Naxee dugie rawalima, e xun nakanama nɛ, e bɔɲɛ raɲaaxu e ma.

sentences.english: The chiefs of Zoan are completely foolish; the wisest guides of Pharaoh have become like beasts: how do you say to Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the offspring of early kings?
sentences.susu: Sowan mangɛe mu sese fahaamuma, Firawuna xa marasie mu xaxili fanyi yo sɔtɔxi yi fe kui. Mixi a falama di Firawuna bɛ, «Muxu tan findixi lɔnnilae nan na, mangɛ forie xa die nan muxu ra?»

sentences.english: Where, then, are your wise men? let them make clear to you, let them give you knowledge of the purpose of the Lord of armies for Egypt.
sentences.susu: Wo xa lɔnnilae na minden? E xa wo rakolon Mangɛ Alatala fama naxan nabade Misira ra.

sentences.english: The chiefs of Zoan have become foolish, the chiefs of Noph are tricked, the heads of her tribes are the cause of Egypt's wandering out of the way.
sentences.susu: Sowan mangɛe findixi xaxilitare nan na, Nofa mangɛe mu gɛxi fahaamui sɔtɔde. Misira bɔnsɔɛ yareratie na Misirakae ralɔɛfe nɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord has sent among them a spirit of error: and by them Egypt is turned out of the right way in all her doings, as a man overcome by wine is uncertain in his steps.
sentences.susu: Marigi bara e xaxili ya iso, alako e xa Misirakae ralɔɛ e xa fe birin kui, e fa lu alɔ siisila naxan birama a xa bɔxunyi ma.

sentences.english: And in Egypt there will be no work for any man, head or tail, high or low, to do.
sentences.susu: Misirakae mu nɔma sese ra e xa mangɛe nun e xa kuntigie saabui ra.

sentences.english: In that day the Egyptians will be like women: and the land will be shaking with fear because of the waving of the Lord's hand stretched out over it.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Misirakae na Mangɛ Alatala xa sɛnbɛ to, e sɛrɛnma nɛ gaaxui kui alɔ ginɛe.

sentences.english: And the land of Judah will become a cause of great fear to Egypt; whenever its name comes to mind, Egypt will be in fear before the Lord of armies because of his purpose against it.
sentences.susu: Yudaya xili nan fama Misirakae magaaxude a ɲaaxi ra, fe ma Alatala Sɛnbɛma naxan natɛxi e xili ma.

sentences.english: In that day there will be five towns in the land of Egypt using the language of Canaan, and making oaths to the Lord of armies; and one of them will be named, The Town of the Sun.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ taa suuli nan luma Misira bɔxi ma, naxee Kanaan xui falama, e man lu Alatala Sɛnbɛma yi ra. Na taa nde fama nɛ xilide Heresi.

sentences.english: In that day there will be an altar to the Lord in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the Lord at the edge of the land.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ sɛrɛxɛbade keren luma nɛ Alatala bɛ Misira bɔxi tagi, tɔnxuma gɛmɛ fan tima nɛ a bɛ Misira naaninyi ra.

sentences.english: And it will be a sign and a witness to the Lord of armies in the land of Egypt: when they are crying out to the Lord because of their cruel masters, then he will send them a saviour and a strong one to make them free.
sentences.susu: Na findima Alatala Sɛnbɛma xa tɔnxuma nun seedeɲɔxɔya nan na Misira bɛ. E na e xui rate Alatala ma, a marakisima xɛɛma nɛ e ratangade e xa ɲaxankatamae ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord will give the knowledge of himself to Egypt, and the Egyptians will give honour to the Lord in that day; they will give him worship with offerings and meal offerings, and will take an oath to the Lord and give effect to it.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Alatala a yɛtɛ masenma nɛ Misirakae bɛ, e fa a kolon Ala ra. E fama a batude sɛrɛxɛ nun sansi xɔri hadiya nan na, e kɛrɛ tongo a bɛ e naxan nakamalima.

sentences.english: And the Lord will send punishment on Egypt, and will make them well again; and when they come back to the Lord he will give ear to their prayer and take away their disease.
sentences.susu: Alatala gbaloe ragoroma nɛ Misirakae ma, kɔnɔ e na e yɛtɛ ragbilen a ma, Alatala man kinikinima nɛ e ma a xa hinnɛ ra.

sentences.english: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and Assyria will come into Egypt, and Egypt will come into Assyria; and the Egyptians will give worship to the Lord together with the Assyrians.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ kira luma nɛ Misira nun Asiriya tagi. Asiriyakae sigama nɛ Misira, Misirakae fan siga Asiriya. E malanma nɛ yire keren Alatala batufe ra.

sentences.english: In that day Israel will be the third together with Egypt and Assyria, a blessing in the earth:
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Isirayila, Misira, nun Asiriya, barakɛ luma nɛ e saxanyi birin ma duniɲa.

sentences.english: Because of the blessing of the Lord of armies which he has given them, saying, A blessing on Egypt my people, and on Assyria the work of my hands, and on Israel my heritage.
sentences.susu: Alatala Sɛnbɛma dubama nɛ e bɛ, a a masen, «Barakɛ xa lu n ma ɲama Misira ma, barakɛ xa lu n ma daalise Asiriya bɛ, barakɛ xa lu n kɛ tongoma Isirayila bɛ.»

sentences.english: In the year when the Tartan came to Ashdod, sent by Sargon, king of Assyria, and made war against it and took it;
sentences.susu: Asiriya mangɛ Saragɔn to a xa sɔɔri mangɛ xɛ Asidodi taa gerede, a fa nɔ a ra, a a suxu,

sentences.english: At that time the word of the Lord came to Isaiah, the son of Amoz, saying, Go, and take off your robe, and your shoes from your feet; and he did so, walking unclothed and without shoes on his feet.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yaamari nde fi Amosu xa di Annabi Esayi ma. A naxɛ, «I xa i xa sunnunyi dugi nun i xa sankiri ba, i lu na ki fa.» Esayi naxa a rabatu, a fa a ɲɛrɛ a mageli ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said, As my servant Isaiah has gone unclothed and without shoes for three years as a sign and a wonder to Egypt and Ethiopia,
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ saxan to dangi, Alatala naxa a masen, «N ma konyi Esayi a ɲɛrɛxi a mageli nan na yi ɲɛ saxan bun ma tɔnxuma ki ma Misira nun Kusi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: So will the king of Assyria take away the prisoners of Egypt and those forced out of Ethiopia, young and old, unclothed and without shoes, and with backs uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Asiriya mangɛ fama Misiraka nun Kusika mixi suxuxie xaninde na ki nɛ. Dimɛdie nun forie birin sigama e mageli nan na yaagi kui.

sentences.english: And they will be full of fear, and will no longer have faith in Ethiopia which was their hope, or in Egypt which was their glory.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee xaxili nu tixi Misira nun Kusi ra, e luma gaaxui nun yaagi nan kui.

sentences.english: And those living by the sea will say in that day, See the fate of our hope to whom we went for help and salvation from the king of Assyria: what hope have we then of salvation?
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ naxee nu sabatixi baa dɛ ra e a falama nɛ, ‹Fe mato naxan nabaxi Misirakae nun Kusikae ra. Muxu xaxili nu tixi e tan nan na e xa muxu ratanga Asiriya ma. Yakɔsi muxu fa ratangama di fa?›»

sentences.english: The word about the waste land. As storm-winds in the South go rushing through, it comes from the waste land, from the land greatly to be feared.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ masenyi nan ya gbengberenyi bɛ naxan na baa dɛ ra. Mixi magaaxuxie na fafe alɔ turunnaadɛ kelife Negewi gbengberenyi ma fe xɔrɔxɔɛ kelima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: A vision of fear comes before my eyes; the worker of deceit goes on in his false way, and the waster goes on making waste. Up! Elam; to the attack! Media; I have put an end to her sorrow.
sentences.susu: N bara laamatunyi magaaxuxi to. «Yanfante na yanfɛ tife, kasarati na kasarɛ tife. Elama, gere ti a bɛ. Mediya, a rabilin. N fama tɔɔrɛ dande Babilɔn findixi naxan saabui ra.»

sentences.english: For this cause I am full of bitter grief; pains like the pains of a woman in childbirth have come on me: I am bent down with sorrow at what comes to my ears; I am shocked by what I see.
sentences.susu: «Na kui n fate yati na tɔɔrɔfe alɔ ginɛ di furi na keli a ra. N naxan to, n naxan mɛ, na bara n kaaba.

sentences.english: My mind is wandering, fear has overcome me: the evening of my desire has been turned into shaking for me.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ na tɔɔrɔfe, n na sɛrɛnfe gaaxui kui. N nu na bɔɲɛsa mamɛfe alako n xa malabui sɔtɔ, kɔnɔ yakɔsi na bara findi fe magaaxuxi ra n bɛ.»

sentences.english: They make ready the table, they put down the covers, they take food and drink. Up! you captains; put oil on your breastplates.
sentences.susu: «Donse yailan, won xa won dɛgɛ yire keren. Sɔɔri yareratie wo wo xa kanta see yailan.»

sentences.english: For so has the Lord said to me, Go, let a watchman be placed; let him give word of what he sees:
sentences.susu: Alatala a masen nɛ n bɛ, a naxɛ, «Yire makantɛ ti, alako a fe naxan toma a xa na masen wo bɛ.

sentences.english: And when he sees war-carriages, horsemen by twos, war-carriages with asses, war-carriages with camels, let him give special attention.
sentences.susu: A fama nɛ sɔɔrie tode firin firin na, soee, sofalee, nun ɲɔxɔmɛe fari. A xa e mato a fanyi ra.»

sentences.english: And the watchman gave a loud cry, O my lord, I am on the watchtower all day, and am placed in my watch every night:
sentences.susu: A mu bu, yire makantɛ naxa a xui ramini alɔ yɛtɛ xaaɲɛ, a falafe ra, «Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ n tima naa fe matode, kɔɛ yo kɔɛ n mamɛ tima naa.

sentences.english: See, here come war-carriages with men, horsemen by twos: and in answer he said, Babylon is made low, is made low, and all her images are broken on the earth.
sentences.susu: N sɔɔri ragie toma fa ra firin firin na. E naxɛ, ‹Babilɔn bara bira, e xa kuyee birin saxi bɔxi ma xuntun xuntunyi ra.›

sentences.english: O my crushed ones, the grain of my floor! I have given you the word which came to me from the Lord of armies, the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: Wo tan n ma ɲama naxan bara bɔnbɔ alɔ maale naxan na lonyi ma, Isirayila Marigi Alatala Sɛnbɛma xa masenyi nan yi ki.»

sentences.english: The word about Edom. A voice comes to me from Seir, Watchman, how far gone is the night? how far gone is the night?
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na Dumakae bɛ. Mixi nde n xilima kelife Seyiri, a naxɛ, «Yire kantama, munse rabaxi yi kɔɛ ra? Munse dangixi naa?»

sentences.english: The watchman says, The morning has come, but night is still to come: if you have questions to put, put them, and come back again.
sentences.susu: Yire kantama fa a yaabi, «Kuye na ibafe, kɔnɔ kɔɛ man soma nɛ. Xa wo wama na kolonfe, wo man xa fa n maxɔrin. Iyo, wo man xa fa.»

sentences.english: The word about Arabia. In the thick woods of Arabia will be your night's resting-place, O travelling bands of Dedanites!
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na Arabue bɛ. Wo tan Dedanka naxee yonkinma kɔɛ ra Arabu wula i,

sentences.english: Give water to him who is in need of water; give bread, O men of the land of Tema, to those in flight.
sentences.susu: wo xa fa ye ra mixie bɛ ye xɔli na naxee ma. Temakae wo xa fa taami ra mixi bɛ

sentences.english: For they are in flight from the sharp sword, and the bent bow, and from the trouble of war.
sentences.susu: naxee na e gife santidɛgɛma ya ra naxan wama e faxafe, naxee na e gife xali ya ra naxan wama e sɔntɔfe.

sentences.english: For so has the Lord said to me, In a year, by the years of a servant working for payment, all the glory of Kedar will come to an end:
sentences.susu: Alatala yi nan masenxi n bɛ, «Ɲɛ keren nan tun luxi Kedari xa fe xa dan, alɔ walikɛ ɲɛ kɔntima ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the rest of the bowmen, the men of war of the children of Kedar, will be small in number: for the Lord, the God of Israel, has said it.
sentences.susu: Kedari xa sɔɔrie xa xalie xurunma nɛ.» Alatala nan xui a ra, Isirayila Marigi Ala.

sentences.english: The word about the valley of vision. Why have all your people gone up to the house-tops?
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na gulunba bɛ toe tima dɛnnaxɛ. Munse a niyaxi wo birin texi wo xa banxie fari?

sentences.english: You, who are full of loud voices, a town of outcries, given up to joy; your dead men have not been put to the sword, or come to their death in war.
sentences.susu: Singe wo nu xulunyi rabama, wo nu wo xui ite ɲɛlɛxinyi kui, kɔnɔ yakɔsi wo xa fe na di? Wo xa mixie mu faxa santidɛgɛma ra, e mu faxa gere kui.

sentences.english: All your rulers ... have gone in flight; all your strong ones have gone far away.
sentences.susu: Wo xa mangɛe nan tun e gixi e siga yire makuye. Mixi naxee luxi, nee bara suxu gere yo mu so.

sentences.english: For this cause I have said, Let your eyes be turned away from me in my bitter weeping; I will not be comforted for the wasting of the daughter of my people.
sentences.susu: Na kui n naxa a fala, «Wo n lu na, n xa wa a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra. Wo naxa kata n madundufe ra n ma ɲama xa kasarɛ ma.»

sentences.english: For it is a day of trouble and of crushing down and of destruction from the Lord, the Lord of armies, in the valley of vision; ...
sentences.susu: Alatala Sɛnbɛma xa lɔxɔɛ ya isoxi nan nu a ra, kasarɛ nun tɔɔrɛ nu gboxi tɛmui naxɛ gulunba kui toe tima dɛnnaxɛ. Tɛtɛ nu birama, sɔnxɔɛ nu tema geya fari.

sentences.english: And Elam was armed with arrows, and Aram came on horseback; and the breastplate of Kir was uncovered.
sentences.susu: Elamakae e xa xali sase gbakuma e ma, e nu sigama sɔɔri ragisee kui nun soe fari. Kirikae e xa wure lefae mabama.

sentences.english: And your most fertile valleys were full of war-carriages, and the horsemen took up their positions in front of the town.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri nu bara wuya wo xa gulunba fanyie kui, e nu wuya wo xa taa naadɛ ra.

sentences.english: He took away the cover of Judah; and in that day you were looking with care at the store of arms in the house of the woods.
sentences.susu: Sese mu luxi wo nun wo yaxuie tagi sɔnɔn. Na lɔxɔɛ wo naxa geresosee tongo naxan nu nu mangɛ xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: And you saw all the broken places in the wall of the town of David: and you got together the waters of the lower pool.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa a to yale gbegbe nu bara ti Dawuda xa taa tɛtɛ ma. Wo naxa ye ragata yire nde lanbanyi.

sentences.english: And you had the houses of Jerusalem numbered, pulling down the houses to make the wall stronger.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa Darisalamu banxie mato, wo fa nde rabira alako wo xa tɛtɛ sɛnbɛ so.

sentences.english: And you made a place between the two walls for storing the waters of the old pool: but you gave no thought to him who had done this, and were not looking to him by whom it had been purposed long before.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa ye ragatade yailan tɛtɛ firinyie tagi, ye sama naxan kui kelife ye ragatade fori. Kɔnɔ wo mu wo ya rafindixi Ala ma naxan nu bara na fori yailan. Wo mu la a yailanma ra naxan nu bara natɛ tongo na wali xa fe ra kafi a rakuya.

sentences.english: And in that day the Lord, the Lord of armies, was looking for weeping, and cries of sorrow, cutting off of the hair, and putting on the clothing of grief:
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala nu bara xili ti na lɔxɔɛ ɲama xa wa sunnunyi kui, wo xa wo xunyie bi, wo xa sunnunyi dugi ragoro wo ma.

sentences.english: But in place of these there was joy and delight, oxen and sheep were being made ready for food, there was feasting and drinking: men said, Now is the time for food and wine, for tomorrow death comes.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo mu tin na ra, wo naxa xulunyi ti ɲɛlɛxinyi kui, wo ninge nun yɛxɛɛ faxa wo naxee donma, wo wɛni min a falafe ra, «Won xa won dɛge, won xa wo min, barima tina won faxama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord of armies said to me secretly, Truly, this sin will not be taken from you till your death, says the Lord, the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Alatala Sɛnbɛma bara a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ, «Wo xa yi yunubi tan mu xafarima han wo faxa lɔxɔɛ.» Mangɛ Alatala xui nan yi ki.

sentences.english: The Lord, the Lord of armies, says, Go to this person in authority, this Shebna, who is over the house; who has made himself a resting-place on high, cutting out a place for himself in the rock, and say,
sentences.susu: N Mangɛ Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ, «Siga mangɛ banxi xunyi Sebina yire, a fala a bɛ,

sentences.english: Who are you, and by what right have you made for yourself a resting-place here?
sentences.susu: ‹I gbe na munse ra be? Nde na i bɛ be naxan a niyama i xa gaburi tofanyi ge yi geya fari?

sentences.english: See, O strong man, the Lord will send you violently away, gripping you with force,
sentences.susu: A gbe mu luxi, Alatala xa i suxu, a xa i woli yire makuye. A i maxirima nɛ alɔ kote,

sentences.english: Twisting you round and round like a ball he will send you out into a wide country: there you will come to your end, and there will be the carriages of your pride, O shame of your lord's house!
sentences.susu: a i woli bɔxi belebele nde ma. I tan nun i xa sɔɔri ragise fanyie xa fe ɲɔnma mɛnni nɛ, i tan naxan i xa mangɛ bɔnsɔɛ rayaagi.

sentences.english: And I will have you forced out of your place of authority, and pulled down from your position.
sentences.susu: N i kerima nɛ i xa walide, n i tide bama nɛ i yi ra.›»

sentences.english: And in that day I will send for my servant, Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah:
sentences.susu: «Na lɔxɔɛ n Xilikiya xa di Eliyakimi xilima nɛ, a xa n ma wali raba.

sentences.english: And I will put your robe on him, and put your band about him, and I will give your authority into his hand: and he will be a father to the men of Jerusalem, and to the family of Judah.
sentences.susu: N i xa mangɛ guba ragoroma nɛ a ma, n i xa bɛlɛti xiri a tagi, n fa i xa mangɛya fi a ma. A findima Darisalamukae nun Yudayakae baba nan na.

sentences.english: And I will give the key of the family of David into his care; and what he keeps open will be shut by no one, and what he keeps shut no one will make open.
sentences.susu: N Dawuda xa mangɛya saabi soma nɛ a yi ra. A na naadɛ nde rabi, mixi yo mu a balanma. A na naadɛ nde balan, mixi yo mu a rabima.

sentences.english: And I will put him like a nail in a safe place; and he will be for a seat of glory to his father's family.
sentences.susu: A fama nɛ binyɛ ra a baba bɔnsɔɛ bɛ. N a tima nɛ alɔ wuri di naxan banbanxi a fanyi ra banxi bili ma,

sentences.english: And all the glory of his father's family will be hanging on him, all their offspring, every small vessel, even the cups and the basins.
sentences.susu: a baba bɔnsɔɛ xa fe birin gbakuma naxan na, fe xunxurie nun fe xungbee.»

sentences.english: In that day, says the Lord of armies, will the nail fixed in a safe place give way; and it will be cut down, and in its fall the weight hanging on it will be cut off, for the Lord has said it.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala man naxa a masen, «Kɔnɔ lɔxɔɛ nde na wuri di naxan nu banbanxi a fanyi ra banxi bili ma, a fama nɛ bolonde, a bira a nun fe naxan birin nu gbakuxi a ra.» Alatala xui nan na ki.

sentences.english: The word about Tyre. Let a cry of sorrow go up, O ships of Tarshish, because your strong place is made waste; on the way back from the land of Kittim the news is given to them.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na Tirekae bɛ. «Tarasisi kunkui kanyie, wo xa wo wa xui ite, barima Tire bɔxi xun bara rakana. Banxi mu luma naa sɔnɔn, wafu birin bara kana.» Sipirika ndee xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Send out a cry of grief, you men of the sea-land, traders of Zidon, who go over the sea, whose representatives are on great waters;
sentences.susu: Wo wo sabari, wo tan naxee sabatixi baa dɛ ra, wo tan naxee findixi yulɛe ra Sidɔn taa kui, wo tan naxee bara naafuli sɔtɔ yulɛya ra wafu dɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: Who get in the seed of Shihor, whose wealth is the trade of the nations.
sentences.susu: Baa bara a niya wo xa sansi xɔri sɔtɔ kelife Sixori. Daxamui naxan mini Nili xure dɛ ra, na nan findixi bannaya ra wo bɛ. Ɲamanɛe xa makiti xungbe raba nɛ wo xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Be shamed, O Zidon: for the sea, the strong place of the sea has said, I have not been with child, or given birth; I have not taken care of young men, or kept watch over the growth of virgins.
sentences.susu: Sidɔnkae, wo yaagi, wo tan naxee xa nɔɛ nu na baa xun ma. Xui nde minima kelife baa ma, a naxɛ, «N luxi nɛ alɔ di baritare, naxan mu di bari xɔnɛ kolon, naxan mu di yo barima, naxan mu di yo ramɔma, xɛmɛ xa na mu a ra ginɛ.»

sentences.english: When the news comes to Egypt they will be bitterly pained at the fate of Tyre.
sentences.susu: Misirakae na na xibaaru mɛ Tire xa fe ra, e fama nɛ gaaxude.

sentences.english: Go over to Tarshish; give cries of sorrow, O men of the sea-land.
sentences.susu: Wo xa siga Tarasisi. Wo tan naxee na baa dɛ ra, wo xa wo wa xui ite.

sentences.english: Is this the town which was full of joy, whose start goes back to times long past, whose wanderings took her into far-off countries?
sentences.susu: Singe wo xa taa nu na ɲɛlɛxinyi nan kui, kɔnɔ yakɔsi nde wo xa mixie xaninxi yire makuye?

sentences.english: By whom was this purposed against Tyre, the crowning town, whose traders are chiefs, whose business men are honoured in the land?
sentences.susu: Nde yi natɛ tongoxi Tire xili ma, a tan naxan nu mangɛ tima, a tan naxan xa yulɛe nu findixi kuntigie ra, a tan naxan xa yulɛe nu binyaxi duniɲa birin ma?

sentences.english: It was the purpose of the Lord of armies to put pride to shame, to make sport of the glory of those who are honoured in the earth.
sentences.susu: Alatala Sɛnbɛma nan yi natɛ tongoxi, alako yɛtɛ igboya xa kana, xili xungbe kanyie xa magoro.

sentences.english: Let your land be worked with the plough, O daughter of Tarshish; there is no longer any harbour.
sentences.susu: Tarasisikae, wo xa bɔxi rawali alɔ a rabama Nili xure dɛ ra ki naxɛ, barima Sidɔn nun Tire xa wafue mu na sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: His hand is stretched out over the sea, the kingdoms are shaking: the Lord has given orders about Canaan, to make waste its strong places.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a bɛlɛxɛ itala baa xun ma, a bara mangɛyae rasɛrɛn. A bara yaamari fi Fenisiya xa yire makantaxie xa kana.

sentences.english: And he said, There is no more joy for you, O crushed virgin daughter of Zidon: up! go over to Kittim; even there you will have no rest.
sentences.susu: A naxɛ, «I tan Sidɔn taa tofanyi, i mu luma bere ra sɔnɔn, e fama nɛ i xun nakanade feo. Hali wo wo gi Sipiri suri ma, wo mu bɔɲɛsa sɔtɔma.
Kalide bɔxi mato ba. E xun bara rakana. Asiriyakae bara sa wulai subee sagoe. E bara e xa yire makantaxie rabilin, e fa e gere han sese mu luxi sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: Let a cry of sorrow go up, O ships of Tarshish: because your strong place is made waste.
sentences.susu: «Tarasisi kunkui kanyie, wo xa wo wa xui ite, barima wo xa wafu makantaxi xun bara rakana.»

sentences.english: And it will be in that day that Tyre will go out of mind for seventy years, that is, the days of one king: after the end of seventy years it will be for Tyre as in the song of the loose woman.
sentences.susu: Tire luma nɛɛmui nan kui han ɲɛ tongo solofere, mangɛ keren xa bui xasabi. Ɲɛ tongo solofere raɲɔnyi, fe fama rabade Tire bɛ alɔ a falaxi sigi kui langoe ginɛ xa fe ra ki naxɛ,

sentences.english: Take an instrument of music, go about the town, O loose woman who has gone out from the memory of man; make sweet melody with songs, so that you may come back to men's minds.
sentences.susu: «I tan langoe ginɛ, birin nɛɛmuxi naxan ma, i xa kɔra bɔnbɔ a fanyi ra taa kui, i xa sigi sa alako mixie xa ratu i xa fe ma.»

sentences.english: And it will be after the end of seventy years, that the Lord will have mercy on Tyre, and she will go back to her trade, acting as a loose woman with all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ tongo solofere raɲɔnyi, Marigi a ya rafindima nɛ Tire ma. A gbilenma nɛ a xa langoeɲa fori ma, a a yɛtɛ sa duniɲa mangɛyae birin sagoe kɔbiri xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And her goods and her trade will be holy to the Lord: they will not be kept back or stored up; for her produce will be for those living in the Lord's land, to give them food for their needs, and fair clothing.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a xa geeni fama rawalide Alatala xa fe nan kui. A mu nɔma na ragatade a yɛtɛ bɛ, a luma mixie nan bɛ naxee birama Alatala fɔxɔ ra, alako e xa donma fanyie nun baloe gbegbe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: See, the Lord is making the earth waste and unpeopled, he is turning it upside down, and sending the people in all directions.
sentences.susu: Alatala fama nɛ duniɲa kanade, sese mu lu bɔxi ma sɔnɔn, adamadie yensenma nɛ.

sentences.english: And it will be the same for the people as for the priest; for the servant as for his master; and for the woman-servant as for her owner; the same for the one offering goods for a price as for him who takes them; the same for him who gives money at interest and for him who takes it; the same for him who lets others have the use of his property as for those who make use of it.
sentences.susu: Mixi birin luma tɔɔrɛ nan kui: sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nun ɲama, kuntigi nun konyi, ginɛ banxi kanyi nun konyi ginɛ, yulɛ nun saresoe, yefu ti nun setare, doni tongoe nun doni kanyi.

sentences.english: The earth will be completely waste and without men; for this is the word of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa fama nɛ kanade, a isee birin ɲɔnma nɛ a ma. Alatala xui nan na ki.

sentences.english: The earth is sorrowing and wasting away, the world is full of grief and wasting away, the high ones of the earth come to nothing.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa tuxunsanma nɛ, a ixarama nɛ, kuntigie yati halakima nɛ.

sentences.english: The earth has been made unclean by those living in it; because the laws have not been kept by them, the orders have been changed, and the eternal agreement has been broken.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa mixie bara duniɲa kɔsɔ, e bara e kobe so sɛriyɛ ra, e Ala xa yaamarie matandi, e a xa saatɛ kana.

sentences.english: For this cause the earth is given up to the curse, and those in it are judged as sinners: for this cause those living on the earth are burned up, and the rest are small in number.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra Alatala duniɲa halakima, na kote dusu adamadie xun na, duniɲa mixie mu gbo sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: The new wine is thin, the vine is feeble, and all the glad-hearted make sounds of grief.
sentences.susu: Xɛ xaba tɛmui sansie xurunma nɛ, xɛ xabae nimisa.

sentences.english: The pleasing sound of all instruments of music has come to an end, and the voices of those who are glad.
sentences.susu: Sanbanyi nun kɔra xui danma nɛ, xulunyi yensen.

sentences.english: There is no more drinking of wine with a song; strong drink will be bitter to those who take it.
sentences.susu: Mixie mu e sɛɛwama sigi xui ra, donse yati mu rafanma e ma.

sentences.english: The town is waste and broken down: every house is shut up, so that no man may come in.
sentences.susu: Taa kanaxi luma na ki nɛ tun, a banxie birin balan.

sentences.english: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine; there is an end of all delight, the joy of the land is gone.
sentences.susu: Sɔnxɔɛ tema nɛ taa kui minse nun donse xa fe ra. Sɛɛwɛ bara ɲɔn, ɲɛlɛxinyi bara siga.

sentences.english: In the town all is waste, and in the public place is destruction.
sentences.susu: Sɔntɔɛ nan tun luma taa kui fa, taa naadɛ kana feo.

sentences.english: For it will be in the heart of the earth among the peoples, like the shaking of an olive-tree, as the last of the grapes after the getting-in is done.
sentences.susu: Na ɲaxankatɛ na ɲɔn duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari ɲamanɛe tagi, na luma nɛ alɔ oliwi bili naxan imaxama alako a bogie xa ba, na luma nɛ alɔ sansi tɔnsɔɛ keren keren naxee luma xɛ ma xɛ xabae dangi xanbi.

sentences.english: But those will be making sounds of joy; they will be crying loudly from the sea for the glory of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ naxee na sogegorode biri, nee e xui itema nɛ sɛɛwɛ ra, e bɛɛti ba Alatala matɔxɔfe ra.

sentences.english: Give praise to the Lord in the east, to the name of the Lord, the God of Israel, in the sea-lands.
sentences.susu: Naxee na sogetede biri, nee Alatala matɔxɔma nɛ, e Isirayila Marigi Alatala xili matɔxɔ baa surie ma.

sentences.english: From the farthest part of the earth comes the sound of songs, glory to the upright. But I said, I am wasting away, wasting away, the curse is on me! The false ones go on in their false way, yes, they go on acting falsely.
sentences.susu: Kelife duniɲa tunxun naanie ra, won bɛɛti mɛma nɛ naxan a falama, «Nɔrɛ kanyi nan Tinxintɔɛ ra.» Kɔnɔ n tan naxa e yaabi, «N xun nakanafe, n fate na bafe n ma. Ɲaxankatɛ na n bɛ. Tinxintaree bara n yanfa a ɲaaxi ra.»

sentences.english: Fear, and death, and the net, are come on you, O people of the earth.
sentences.susu: Gbaloe nan wo lima, wo tan duniɲa mixie.

sentences.english: And it will be that he who goes in flight from the sound of fear will be overtaken by death; and he who gets free from death will be taken in the net: for the windows on high are open, and the bases of the earth are shaking.
sentences.susu: Naxan na a gi na gbaloe ya ra, a birama yili nan kui. Naxan na te na yili kui, yɛlɛ nan dusuma a xun na. Koore walaxɛ birama nɛ, bɔxi fan sɛrɛn.

sentences.english: The earth is completely broken, it is parted in two, it is violently moved.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa kanama nɛ, a ibɔɔ, a sɛrɛn.

sentences.english: The earth will be moving uncertainly, like a man overcome by drink; it will be shaking like a tent; and the weight of its sin will be on it, crushing it down so that it will not get up again.
sentences.susu: A dagalanma nɛ alɔ siisila, a imaxa alɔ bage turunnaadɛ mini tɛmui, barima a xa yunubie bara gbo. A birama nɛ, a mu kelima sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And in that day the Lord will send punishment on the army of the high ones on high, and on the kings of the earth on the earth.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Alatala koore daalie nun duniɲa mangɛe ɲaxankatama nɛ e xa walie ma.

sentences.english: And they will be got together, like prisoners in the prison-house; and after a long time they will have their punishment.
sentences.susu: E fama nɛ malande yire keren alɔ geelimanie naxee na geeli kui. E buma nɛ naa han e fa kiiti.

sentences.english: Then the moon will be veiled, and the sun put to shame; for the Lord of armies will be ruling in Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and before his judges he will let his glory be seen.
sentences.susu: Kike nun soge lɔɛma nɛ, Mangɛ Alatala yaamari tima nɛ Siyoni geya fari Darisalamu forie ya i a nɔrɛ fanyi bun ma.

sentences.english: O Lord, you are my God; I will give praise to you, I will give honour to your name; for you have done great acts of power; your purposes in the past have been made true and certain in effect.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n Marigi na i tan nan na. N i xili matɔxɔma nɛ i xa fe makaabaxie xa fe ra, i naxee natɛxi kabi tɛmui xɔnkuye dugutɛgɛɲa kui.

sentences.english: For you have made a town a waste place: a strong town a mass of broken walls; the tower of the men of pride has come to an end; it will never be put up again.
sentences.susu: I bara muxu yaxuie xa taa makantaxi rabira, a findi gɛmɛ yensenxie ra naxan mu tima sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: For this cause will the strong people give glory to you, the town of the cruel ones will be in fear of you.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra ɲama sɛnbɛmae i matɔxɔma nɛ, si ɲaaxie fa i binyade.

sentences.english: For you have been a strong place for the poor and the crushed in their trouble, a safe place from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the wrath of the cruel ones is like a winter storm.
sentences.susu: I findixi misikiinɛ xa kantari nan na, yire makantaxi tɔɔrɔmixi luma dɛnnaxɛ. I luxi alɔ banxi fanyi turunnaadɛ kui, alɔ bage naxan tixi soge ya ma. Si ɲaaxi maniyaxi turunnaadɛ nan na naxan bɔnbɔma banxi ra,

sentences.english: As heat by the shade of a cloud, the noise of the men of pride has been made quiet by you; as heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the cruel ones has been stopped.
sentences.susu: a lu alɔ wuyenyi naxan na gbengberenyi ma. I ɲamanɛ xa sɔnxɔɛ raxinbelima nɛ, alɔ nuxui niini nde bama soge xa wuyenyi ra ki naxɛ. Na ɲama ɲaaxi xa sigi sa danma na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And in this mountain will the Lord of armies make for all peoples a feast of good things, a feast of wines long stored, of good things sweet to the taste, of wines long kept and tested.
sentences.susu: Yi geya fari, Alatala Sɛnbɛma fama nɛ xulunyi belebele tide, ɲama birin xa minse nun donse ɲɔxunmɛe li naa.

sentences.english: And in this mountain he will put an end to the shade covering the face of all peoples, and the veil which is stretched over all nations.
sentences.susu: Yi geya fari, Alatala fama nɛ mafelenyi bade bɔnsɔɛ birin ma,

sentences.english: He has put an end to death for ever; and the Lord God will take away all weeping; and he will put an end to the shame of his people in all the earth: for the Lord has said it.
sentences.susu: a saya xa fe kanama nɛ abadan. Won Marigi Alatala yaye mafurukuma nɛ yatagi birin ma, a a xa ɲama xa yaagi birin ba duniɲa ya xɔri. Alatala xui nan na ki.

sentences.english: And in that day it will be said, See, this is our God; we have been waiting for him, and he will be our saviour: this is the Lord in whom is our hope; we will be glad and have delight in his salvation.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ e a falama nɛ, «Won Marigi Ala nan yi ki won won xaxili tixi naxan na. A bara won nakisi. Alatala nan yi ki won won xaxili tixi naxan na. Won xa sɛɛwa a xa kisi ra.»

sentences.english: For in this mountain will the hand of the Lord come to rest, and Moab will be crushed down in his place, even as the dry stems of the grain are crushed under foot in the waste place.
sentences.susu: Alatala xɔnyɛ luma nɛ yi geya fari, kɔnɔ Mowabakae maboronma nɛ alɔ sɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And if he puts out his hands, like a man stretching out his hands in swimming, the Lord will make low his pride, however expert his designs.
sentences.susu: E katama nɛ e xa e ba a yi ra, kɔnɔ Alatala e xa yɛtɛ igboya ragoroma nɛ, a e sɛnbɛ birin ɲɔn.

sentences.english: And the strong tower of your walls has been broken by him, made low, and crushed even to the dust.
sentences.susu: A e xa yire makantaxie rabirama nɛ, a na birin butuxun han a findi xube ra. A e xa yɛtɛ igboya ragoroma nɛ feo.

sentences.english: In that day will this song be made in the land of Judah: We have a strong town; he will make salvation our walls and towers.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ e yi bɛɛti nan bama Yudaya bɔxi ma: Ala bara taa sɛnbɛma fi won ma, naxan xa tɛtɛ findima kisi ra won bɛ.

sentences.english: Let the doors be open, so that the upright nation which keeps faith may come in.
sentences.susu: Naadɛ xa rabi, ɲama tinxinxi xa so, ɲama naxan mu lanlanteya kana.

sentences.english: The man whose heart is unmoved you will keep in peace, because his hope is in you.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan ɲanige fan, a findima bɔɲɛsa kanyi nan na, barima a laxi i ra.

sentences.english: Let your hope be in the Lord for ever: for the Lord Jah is an unchanging Rock.
sentences.susu: Wo wo yɛtɛ taxu Alatala ra tɛmui birin, barima Alatala nan na Ala ra naxan na abadan, naxan sɛnbɛ gbo alɔ fanye.

sentences.english: For he has made low those who are lifted up, all the people of the town of pride: he makes it low, crushing it down to the earth; he makes it low in the dust.
sentences.susu: A bara yɛtɛ igboe ragoro, a e xa taa itexi igoro, a findi xube ra,

sentences.english: It will be crushed under the feet of the poor and the steps of those who are in need.
sentences.susu: misikiinɛe nun setaree naxan iboronma.

sentences.english: The way of the good man is straight; the road of the upright is made smooth by you.
sentences.susu: I tan Alatala tinxinxi, i tinxintɔɛ xa fe sɔɔnɛyama nɛ.

sentences.english: We have been waiting for you, O Lord; the desire of our soul is for the memory of your name.
sentences.susu: Muxu ɲɛrɛma i xa sɛriyɛ nan ma, muxu xaxili tixi i ra. Muxu i xili matɔxɔma muxu bɔɲɛ birin na.

sentences.english: In the night the desire of my soul has been for you; early will my spirit be searching for you; for when your punishments come on the earth, the people of the world will get the knowledge of righteousness.
sentences.susu: Muxu nii yati hayi na i ma kɔɛ ra, a i fenma gɛɛsɛgɛ. I na i xa kiiti sa duniɲa ma, na nan duniɲa mixie matinkanma tinxinyi ra.

sentences.english: Even if you are kind to the evil-doer, he will not go after righteousness; even in the land of the upright he will still go on in his wrongdoing, and will not see the glory of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxie tan, hali e kinikini e ma, e mu birama tinxinyi fɔxɔ ra. Hali ɲama birin birama tinxinyi fɔxɔ ra, e tan tondima nɛ gbilende fe ɲaaxi fɔxɔ ra, e mu gaaxuma Alatala xa mangɛya ya ra.

sentences.english: Lord, your hand is lifted up, but they do not see: let them see ... yes, your haters will be burned up in the fire.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i sɛnbɛ gbo, kɔnɔ e mu na toma. I xanunteya naxan saxi i xa ɲama ma, a niya e xa na to, na xa findi e bɛ yaagi ra, i xa tɛ fa e gan.

sentences.english: Lord, you will give us peace: for all our works are the outcome of your purpose.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i bara bɔɲɛsa fi muxu ma, barima i tan nan muxu xa wali birin nakamalima muxu bɛ.

sentences.english: O Lord, our God, other lords than you have had rule over us; but in you only is our salvation, and no other name will we take on our lips.
sentences.susu: Muxu Marigi Alatala, marigi gbɛtɛe bara nɔɛ dɔxɔ muxu ma bafe ra i tan na, kɔnɔ muxu i tan nan keren batuma.

sentences.english: The dead will not come back to life: their spirits will not come back to earth; for this cause you have sent destruction on them, so that the memory of them is dead.
sentences.susu: Na marigie bara faxa, e mu baloma sɔnɔn, e nii mu kelima abadan. I bara keli e xili ma, i e sɔntɔ. I bara e xa fe birin nalɔɛ.

sentences.english: You have made the nation great, O Lord, you have made it great; glory is yours: you have made wide the limits of the land.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i bara i xa ɲamanɛ ragbo yɛ, i bara e xa bɔxi naaninyie masara, bɔxi xa gbo. I bara matɔxɔɛ sɔtɔ na fe kui.

sentences.english: Lord, in trouble our eyes have been turned to you, we sent up a prayer when your punishment was on us.
sentences.susu: Alatala, e nu na i fenfe i xa ɲaxankatɛ kui, e fa i maxandi.

sentences.english: As a woman with child, whose time is near, is troubled, crying out in her pain; so have we been before you, O Lord.
sentences.susu: E nu e xui itema i ma alɔ ginɛ naxan na di barife tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have given birth to wind; no salvation has come to the earth through us, and no children have come into the world.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara tɔɔrɔ na di barife kui, kɔnɔ na fe findixi fufafu nan na. Muxu mu wali yo rabaxi naxan findixi kisi ra duniɲa bɛ, e mu kisi sɔtɔ muxu saabui ra.

sentences.english: Your dead will come back; their dead bodies will come to life again. Those in the dust, awaking from their sleep, will send out a song; for your dew is a dew of light, and the earth will give birth to the shades.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan nan faxa mixie rakelima faxɛ ma. «Wo tan naxee saxi bɛndɛ bun ma, wo xa keli, wo xa sɛɛwa. Wo luxi nɛ alɔ xini soge naxan ralɔɛma. Wo fan nalɔɛma na ki nɛ.»

sentences.english: Come, my people, into your secret places, and let your doors be shut: keep yourself safe for a short time, till his wrath is over.
sentences.susu: N ma ɲama, wo xa gbilen wo xɔnyi, wo xa naadɛ balan saabi ra. Wo xa wo nɔxun dondoronti han yi xɔnɛ xa dangi sinden.

sentences.english: For the Lord is coming out of his place to send punishment on the people of the earth for their evil-doing: the earth will let the blood drained out on her be seen, and will keep her dead covered no longer.
sentences.susu: Alatala fama nɛ kelife a xɔnyi, a fa duniɲa mixie ratɔn e xa yunubie xa fe ra. Bɔxi wuli dɛntɛgɛma nɛ a naxan minxi, a mu mixi faxaxie ragatama sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: In that day the Lord, with his great and strong and cruel sword, will send punishment on Leviathan, the quick-moving snake, and on Leviathan, the twisted snake; and he will put to death the dragon which is in the sea.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, Alatala ninginangɛ magaaxuxi ɲaxankatama nɛ a xa santidɛgɛma xungbe ra. Na xili Lewitan, a sabatixi baa nan ma. A suxufe xɔrɔxɔ, barima a salaxun a gbe ra, kɔnɔ Alatala a sɔntɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: In that day it will be said, A vine-garden of delight, make a song about it.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, wo xa bɛɛti ba n ma wɛni bili fanyie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: I, the Lord, am watching it; I will give it water at all times: I will keep it night and day, for fear that any damage comes to it.
sentences.susu: N tan Alatala nan na a kantama ra. N ye sama nɛ a ma tɛmui birin. N a kantama nɛ kɔɛ nun yanyi ra alako mixi yo naxa a tɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: My passion is over: if the thorns were fighting against me, I would make an attack on them, and they would be burned up together.
sentences.susu: N xɔnɔ xɔnɔ, kɔnɔ xa n sa tunbee li naa, n e gerema nɛ, n tɛ din e ra.

sentences.english: Or let him put himself under my power, and make peace with me.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li e naxa fa n yire lanyi xiride, n tinma nɛ a ra a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: In days to come Jacob will take root: Israel will put out buds and flowers; and the face of the world will be full of fruit.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ na fafe, Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ a sanke sɔrɔnma nɛ, Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ a salonyie nun a fugee ramini, a duniɲa rafe a bogie ra.

sentences.english: Is his punishment like the punishment of those who overcame him? or are his dead as great in number as those he put to the sword?
sentences.susu: Alatala Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ bɔnbɔ nɛ, alɔ a e yaxuie bɔnbɔ ki naxɛ? A e faxa nɛ, alɔ a e faxa ki naxɛ?

sentences.english: Your anger against her has been made clear by driving her away; he has taken her away with his storm-wind in the day of his east wind.
sentences.susu: A xa xɔnɛ naxa din e ra, a e xanin alɔ foye xungbe.

sentences.english: So by this will the sin of Jacob be covered, and this is all the fruit of taking away his punishment; when all the stones of the altar are crushed together, so that the wood pillars and the sun-images will not be put up again.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ xa yunubie xafari na ki nɛ. Na kui, e naxa kuye sɛrɛxɛbadee kana, e naxa Asera wuri masolixie ba e xa bɔxi ma, e naxa kuye xa surayi gansee kana.

sentences.english: For the strong town is without men, an unpeopled living-place; and she has become a waste land: there the young ox will take his rest, and its branches will be food for him.
sentences.susu: Taa sɛnbɛmae bara kiro, e findi nɛ yire rabɛɲinxi ra alɔ gbengberenyi. Ningee nu luma naa e dɛmadonde, e e sa, e mɛnni wuri burɛxɛ birin don.

sentences.english: When its branches are dry they will be broken off; the women will come and put fire to them: for it is a foolish people; for this cause he who made them will have no mercy on them, and he whose work they are will not have pity on them.
sentences.susu: Wuri salonyie na xara, ginɛe nu e gan tɛ ra. Ɲama xaxilitare nan nu a ra. E daali mangɛ mu kinikinixi e ma na nan ma. Naxan e daaxi, na mu hinnɛxi e ra.

sentences.english: And it will be in that day that the Lord will get together his grain, from the River to the stream of Egypt, and you will be got together with care, O children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, Alatala wuri bilie imaxama nɛ, keli Efirati xure dɛ ra han Misira xure dɛ ra. A wo tan Isirayila xa die birin matongoma nɛ keren keren.

sentences.english: And it will be in that day that a great horn will be sounded; and those who were wandering in the land of Assyria, and those who had been sent away into the land of Egypt, will come; and they will give worship to the Lord in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, feri xungbe fema nɛ, alako mixi naxee nu lɔɛxi Asiriya bɔxi ma, a nun naxee nu yensenxi Misira bɔxi ma, e birin gbilenma nɛ, e fa suyidi Alatala bɛ geya sɛniyɛnxi fari Darisalamu.

sentences.english: Ho! crown of pride of those who are given up to wine in Ephraim, and the dead flower of his glory which is on the head of those who are overcome by strong drink!
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na Efirami taa yɛtɛ igboe siisilae bɛ, naxan tixi gulunba koore ra, kɔnɔ a xa tofanyi luxi nɛ alɔ sansi fuge lisixi.

sentences.english: See, the Lord has a strong and cruel one; like a rain of ice, a storm of destruction, like the overflowing of a strong river, he will violently overcome them.
sentences.susu: Sɛnbɛmae nan fafe yi ki Marigi xili ra, naxan luxi alɔ turunnaadɛ foye xungbe, alɔ balabalan tunɛ naxan sɛnbɛ Samari xun nagoroma.

sentences.english: The crown of pride of those who are given up to wine in Ephraim will be crushed under foot;
sentences.susu: Efirami taa yɛtɛ igboe siisilae birama nɛ, e maboron.

sentences.english: And the dead flower of his glory, which is on the head of the fertile valley, will be like the first early fruit before the summer; which a man takes and puts in his mouth the minute he sees it.
sentences.susu: Na sansi fuge lisixi naxan tixi gulunba koore ra, a luxi nɛ alɔ xɔrɛ bogi mɔxi naxan donma kerenyi ra.

sentences.english: In that day will the Lord of armies be a crown of glory, and a fair ornament, to the rest of his people;
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, Alatala Sɛnbɛma luma nɛ alɔ mangɛ katanyi tofanyi a xa ɲama dɔnxɔɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: And a spirit of wisdom to the judge, and strength to those who keep back the attackers at the door of the town.
sentences.susu: A xaxili tinxinxi fima nɛ kiitisae ma, a sɛnbɛ fi sɔɔrie ma naxee na gere kui.

sentences.english: And further, these are uncertain through wine, and have gone out of the right way through strong drink: the priest and the prophet are uncertain through strong drink, they are overcome by wine, they have gone out of the way through strong drink; their vision is false, they go wrong in their decisions.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun namiɲɔnmɛe bara lɔɛ. Beere e dagalanma nɛ, e daxu laamatunyi to tɛmui, e mu fata fe tagi rabade.

sentences.english: For all the tables are covered with coughed-up food, so that there is not a clean place.
sentences.susu: E tixi e yɛtɛ xa bɔxunyi tagi, e birin nɔxɔxi a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: To whom will he give knowledge? and to whom will he make clear the word? Will it be to those who have newly given up milk, and who have only now been taken from the breast?
sentences.susu: «Ala wama e xaranfe? A fahaamui fima e ma? E luxi alɔ diyɔrɛ naxee dɛ baxi e nga xiɲɛ ra.

sentences.english: For it is one rule after another; one line after another; here a little, there a little.
sentences.susu: Fo a xa wɔyɛn e bɛ diyɔrɛ daaxi.»

sentences.english: No, but with broken talk, and with a strange tongue, he will give his word to this people:
sentences.susu: Alatala fama a masende yi ɲama bɛ xɔɲɛ saabui ra,

sentences.english: To whom he said, This is the rest, give rest to him who is tired; and by this you may get new strength; but they would not give ear.
sentences.susu: «Malabude nan yi ki, wo xa wo malabu. Yire raxaraxi na a ra.» Kɔnɔ e mu tin e tuli matide a ra.

sentences.english: For this cause the word of the Lord will be to them rule after rule, line after line, here a little, there a little; so that they may go on their way, and falling back may be broken, and taken in the net.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala fama nɛ masenyi tide e bɛ diyɔrɛ daaxi, alako e xun xa rakana, yaxuie xa e suxu, e e xanin.

sentences.english: Give ear then to the word of the Lord, you men of pride, the rulers of this people in Jerusalem:
sentences.susu: Awa, wo tan mixi mayelee, wo tan naxee Darisalamu yamarima, wo wo tuli mati Alatala xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: Because you have said, We have made death our friend, and with the underworld we have made an agreement; when the overflowing waters come through they will not come near us; for we are looking to false words for help, taking cover in what is untrue:
sentences.susu: Wo naxɛ, «Muxu nun saya bara saata, muxu nun gaburi bara lanyi xiri. Gbaloe yo mu muxu lima won ma kantari kui.» Kɔnɔ e na e nɔxunfe wule xanbi ra.

sentences.english: For this cause says the Lord God, See, I am placing in Zion as a base, a stone, a tested stone, an angle-stone which is certain and of great value: and he who has faith will not give way.
sentences.susu: Alatala e yaabima nɛ, «N bara gɛmɛ hagigɛ dɔxɔ Siyoni, gɛmɛ fanyi naxan mu kanama. Limaniya mu bama mixi yi ra naxan a taxuma na gɛmɛ ra.

sentences.english: And I will make right decision the measuring-line, and righteousness the weight: and the ice-storm will take away the safe place of false words, and the secret place will be covered by the flowing waters.
sentences.susu: N bara tinxinyi ti sɛriyɛ ra, n bara nɔndi sa kiiti ki ra. Wo xa wule naxee findixi wo xa kantari ra, banbaranyi fama nɛ e xaninde.

sentences.english: And the help you were looking for from death will come to nothing, and your agreement with the underworld will be broken; when the overflowing waters come through, then you will be overcome by them.
sentences.susu: Wo xa saatɛ, wo nun saya ra, a kanama nɛ, wo xa lanyi, wo nun gaburi ra, a fulunma nɛ. Gbaloe nɔma nɛ wo ra a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Whenever they come through they will overtake you; for they will come through morning after morning, by day and by night: and the news will be nothing but fear.
sentences.susu: Fe xɔrɔxɔɛ na wo li, a wo xun nakanama nɛ, gɛɛsɛgɛ yo gɛɛsɛgɛ, fɛɛɲɛn yo fɛɛɲɛn, kɔɛ yo kɔɛ. Wo na so yi fe kui, wo ifuma nɛ gaaxui ra.»

sentences.english: For the bed is not long enough for a man to be stretched out on: and the cover is not wide enough for him to be covered with.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa sade xurun, wo mu nɔma wo sade a ma. Wo xa xinbeli dugi xurun, a mu wo kantama xinbeli ra.

sentences.english: For the Lord will come up as on Mount Perazim, he will be moved to wrath as in the valley of Gibeon; so that he may do his work — strange is his work; and give effect to his act — unnatural is his act.
sentences.susu: Alatala kelima nɛ alɔ a keli Perasimi geya fari ki naxɛ, a xɔnɔma nɛ alɔ a xɔnɔ Gabayon gulunba kui ki naxɛ, alako a xa a xa wali makaabaxi raba.

sentences.english: And now, take care that you do not make sport of him, or your bands will be made strong; for I have had word from the Lord, the Lord of armies, of an end, of a complete end, which is to come on all the land.
sentences.susu: Na kui wo ba mayele tife, alako a naxa fa gbilen wo xiri ra, barima Ala bara a xa natɛ masen n bɛ bɔxi kanafe ra.»

sentences.english: Let your ears be open to my voice; give attention to what I say.
sentences.susu: «Wo wo tuli mati n xui ra, wo wo tuli mati n ma masenyi ra.

sentences.english: Is the ploughman for ever ploughing? does he not get the earth ready and broken up for the seed?
sentences.susu: Xɛ sa xɛ buxama tɛmui birin? A bɛndɛ ramaxama lɔxɔɛ birin?

sentences.english: When the face of the earth has been levelled, does he not put in the different sorts of seed, and the grain in lines, and the barley in its place, and the spelt at the edge?
sentences.susu: A na gɛ bɔxi buxade, a mu sansi garansanma? A mu sansi xɔri birin wolima a ki ma?

sentences.english: For his God is his teacher, giving him the knowledge of these things.
sentences.susu: A Marigi Ala a xaran a si ki ra.

sentences.english: For the fitches are not crushed with a sharp instrument, and a cart-wheel is not rolled over the cummin; but the grain of the fitches is hammered out with a stick, and of the cummin with a rod.
sentences.susu: Sansi mɔɔli nde mu bɔnbɔma wure ra, a bɔnbɔma wuri nan na.

sentences.english: Is the grain for bread crushed? He does not go on crushing it for ever, but he lets his cart-wheels and his horses go over it without crushing it.
sentences.susu: Sansi mɔɔli gbɛtɛ nɔma bɔnbɔde wure ra, kɔnɔ a mu radangima a i.

sentences.english: This comes from the Lord of armies, purposing wonders, and wise in all his acts.
sentences.susu: Na wali ki birin fatanxi Alatala Sɛnbɛma nan ma. A xa walie makaaba, a xa fe fanyie gbo.»

sentences.english: Ho! Ariel, Ariel, the town against which David made war; put year to year, let the feasts come round:
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na Ariyɛli taa bɛ, mangɛ Dawuda nu sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ. Wo xa nu wo xa salie raba ra ɲɛ yo ɲɛ alɔ wo darixi a ra ki naxɛ,

sentences.english: And I will send trouble on Ariel, and there will be weeping and cries of grief; and she will be to me as Ariel.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ n fama nɛ Ariyɛli xa tɛtɛ rabilinde, a fa tɔɔrɔ gere kui, a xa lu alɔ sɛrɛxɛbade naxan dɛxɛxi.

sentences.english: And I will make war on you like David, and you will be shut in by earthworks, and I will make towers round you.
sentences.susu: N fama nɛ wo rabilinde n ma sɔɔrie ra, muxu xa wali raba wo xa tɛtɛ kanade.

sentences.english: And you will be made low, and your voice will come out of the earth, and your words will be low out of the dust; and your voice will come out of the earth like that of a spirit, making bird-like noises out of the dust.
sentences.susu: Wo xa fe fama nɛ magorode han a lu alɔ wo xui na minife bɔxi nan bun ma. Wo xa wɔyɛnyi makɔlikɔlima nɛ kelife gaburi kui.

sentences.english: And the army of your attackers will be like small dust, and all the cruel ones like dry stems gone before the wind; suddenly it will come about.
sentences.susu: Wo yaxuie wuyama nɛ alɔ xubutanyi, e xa sɔɔrie luma nɛ alɔ maale lagi foye ma. Kɔnɔ na tɛmui ya magirɛ keren kui,

sentences.english: The Lord of armies will come in with thunder and earth-shaking and great noise, with rushing wind and storm, and the flame of burning fire.
sentences.susu: Alatala Sɛnbɛma fama nɛ sesarinyi nun galanyi ra, bɔxi sɛrɛnma nɛ, turunnaadɛ goroma nɛ, tɛ minima nɛ.

sentences.english: And all the nations making war on Ariel, and all those who are fighting against her and shutting her in with their towers, will be like a dream, like a vision of the night.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Ariyɛli yaxuie lɔɛma nɛ keren na, e fa lu alɔ xiye ɲaaxi mixi raxunuma tɛmui naxɛ. Na sɔɔrie nun e xa gereso wali birin ɲɔnma nɛ feo.

sentences.english: And it will be like a man desiring food, and dreaming that he is feasting; but when he is awake there is nothing in his mouth: or like a man in need of water, dreaming that he is drinking; but when he is awake he is feeble and his soul is full of desire: so will all the nations be which make war on Mount Zion.
sentences.susu: A luma nɛ alɔ kaamɛtɔɛ naxan xiye sa a na a dɛgefe, kɔnɔ a fa xunu kaamɛ ra a ma. A luma nɛ alɔ mixi naxan xiye sa a na ye minfe, kɔnɔ a fa xunu ye xɔli ra a ma. A luma na ki nɛ na sɔɔri gali xa fe ra naxan na Siyoni mixie gerefe.

sentences.english: Be surprised and full of wonder; let your eyes be covered and be blind: be overcome, but not with wine; go with uncertain steps, but not because of strong drink.
sentences.susu: A xa findi wo bɛ tɛrɛnna ra, wo dɛ xa ixara. Wo wo yae raxi, wo xa findi dɔnxuie ra. Wo na dagalanfe siisi daaxi, kɔnɔ beere mu a ra.

sentences.english: For the Lord has sent on you a spirit of deep sleep; and by him your eyes, the prophets, are shut, and your heads, the seers, are covered.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan wo raxixi, a bara wo xa namiɲɔnmɛe yae balan, a bara wo xa sematoe xunyi makoto.

sentences.english: And the vision of all this has become to you like the words of a book which is shut, which men give to one who has knowledge of writing, saying, Make clear to us what is in the book: and he says, I am not able to, for the book is shut:
sentences.susu: Yi laamatunyi luxi nɛ alɔ sɛbɛli matɔnxumaxi. Na soma mixi nan yi naxan fata a xarande alako a xa a xaran, kɔnɔ a fa a yaabi, «N mu nɔma a xarande wo bɛ, barima a balanxi tɔnxuma ra.»

sentences.english: And they give it to one without learning, saying, Make clear to us what is in the book: and he says, I have no knowledge of writing.
sentences.susu: Xa na mu a ra, a luxi alɔ sɛbɛli naxan soma mixi xarantare yi ra alako a xa a xaran, kɔnɔ a fa a yaabi, «N tan mu fata a xarande.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said, because this people come near to me with their mouths, and give honour to me with their lips, but their heart is far from me, and their fear of me is false, a rule given them by the teaching of men;
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Yi ɲama bara fa, e xa n matɔxɔ e dɛ ra, kɔnɔ e bɔɲɛ tan makuya n na. E xa batui findixi adamadie xa yaamari ratinmɛfe nan tun na.

sentences.english: For this cause I will again do a strange thing among this people, a thing to be wondered at: and the wisdom of their wise men will come to nothing, and the sense of their guides will no longer be seen.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi n man yi ɲama dɛ ixarama nɛ kaabanakoe ra. Lɔnnilae xa lɔnni mu gɛma na kolonde, fe kolonyie mu soma na fe kui.

sentences.english: Cursed are those who go deep to keep their designs secret from the Lord, and whose works are in the dark, and who say, Who sees us? and who has knowledge of our acts?
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na mixie bɛ naxee e nɔxunma Alatala ma natɛ kobi rabafe ra. E to e xa walie rabama dimi nan kui, e maɲɔxun, ‹Nde muxu toxi? Nde a kolon muxu naxan nabama?›

sentences.english: You are turning things upside down! Is the wet earth the same to you as the one who is forming it? will the thing made say of him who made it, He made me not: or the thing formed say of him who gave it form, He has no knowledge?
sentences.susu: Wo xa daxuɲa sɛnbɛ gbo. Bɛndɛ nɔma lude alɔ a yailanma? Se yailanxi nɔma a falade a yailanma bɛ, a mu n yailanxi? Fɛɲɛ nɔma a falade a yailanma bɛ, a xaxili mu fan?»

sentences.english: In a very short time Lebanon will become a fertile field, and the fertile field will seem like a wood.
sentences.susu: A gbe mu luxi Liban wondi xa masara xɛ ra, xɛ fan xa masara wondi ra.

sentences.english: And in that day those whose ears are stopped will be hearing the words of the book; and the eyes of the blind will see through the mist and the dark.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, tuli xɔrie kitaabui xaranmae xui mɛma nɛ, dɔnxuie fan minima nɛ dimi xɔɔra, e se to.

sentences.english: And the poor will have their joy in the Lord increased, and those in need will be glad in the Holy One of Israel.
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛ magoroe sɛɛwama nɛ Alatala ra, misikiinɛe sɛɛwama nɛ Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: For the cruel one has come to nothing; and those who make sport of the Lord are gone; and those who are watching to do evil are cut off:
sentences.susu: Funmala mu luma naa sɔnɔn, mixi mayele lɔɛma nɛ. Fe kobi rabae lɔɛma nɛ.

sentences.english: Who give help to a man in a wrong cause, and who put a net for the feet of him who gives decisions in the public place, taking away a man's right without cause.
sentences.susu: E mixi tɔɔɲɛgɛma wule ra, e gantanyi italama tinxintɔɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: For this reason the Lord, the saviour of Abraham, says about the family of Jacob, Jacob will not now be put to shame, or his face be clouded with fear.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ Marigi xa masenyi nan ya naxan Iburahima xun saraxi: «To dangi xanbi, Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ mu yaagima sɔnɔn, a bɔɲɛ mu raɲaaxuma a ma.

sentences.english: But when they, the children of Jacob, see the work of my hands among them, they will give honour to my name; yes, they will give honour to the Holy One of Jacob, and go in fear of the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: A xa die na n ma walie to e tagi, e n xili binyama nɛ, e e magoroma nɛ Yaxuba xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ bɛ, e gaaxuma nɛ Isirayila Marigi Ala ya ra.

sentences.english: Those whose hearts were turned away from him will get knowledge, and those who made an outcry against him will give attention to his teaching.
sentences.susu: Mixi ifuxi fahaamui sɔtɔma nɛ, sɔnxɔɛ ratee tinma nɛ lɔnni ra.»

sentences.english: Ho! uncontrolled children, says the Lord, who give effect to a purpose which is not mine, and who make an agreement, but not by my spirit, increasing their sin:
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Ɲaxankatɛ na bɔnsɔɛ murutɛla bɛ. E natɛe tongoma, naxee mu kelixi n tan ma. E saatɛe xirima, n Xaxili mu e yamarixi naxee ra. Na kui e yunubi xun masama tun.

sentences.english: Who make a move to go down into Egypt, without authority from me; who are looking to the strength of Pharaoh for help, and whose hope is in the shade of Egypt.
sentences.susu: E sigama Misira, e e yɛtɛ taxu mɛnni mangɛ ra. E wama lufe a xa kantɛ bun ma. E na birin naba n tan xanbi.

sentences.english: And the strength of Pharaoh will be your shame, and your hope in the shade of Egypt will come to nothing.
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ xa kantɛ findima yaagi nan na wo bɛ, lufe a xa niini bun ma na wo tɔɔrɔma nɛ tun.

sentences.english: For his chiefs are at Zoan, and his representatives have come to Hanes.
sentences.susu: Hali wo kuntigie xɛɛ Sowan nun Xanɛsi Misira bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: For they have all come with offerings to a people of no use to them, in whom is no help or profit, but only shame and a bad name.
sentences.susu: e birin fama lude yaagi nan kui na ɲama xa fe ra naxan mu e malima. E mu wo dɛmɛnma, e wo rayaagima tun.»

sentences.english: The word about the Beasts of the South. Through the land of trouble and grief, the land of the she-lion and the voice of the lion, of the snake and the burning winged snake, they take their wealth on the backs of young asses, and their stores on camels, to a people in whom is no profit.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na Negewi gbengberenyi subee bɛ. E bɔxi xɔrɔxɔɛ nan igirima yɛtɛe nun bɔximasee na dɛnnaxɛ, e xa bannaya xaninfe ra sofalee nun ɲɔxɔmɛe fari ɲama xɔn ma, naxan mu fata e malide fefe ma.

sentences.english: For there is no use or purpose in the help of Egypt: so I have said about her, She is Rahab, who has come to an end.
sentences.susu: Misira xa mali findima fe fufafu nan tun na! Na nan a ra, n naxa yi xili sa a xun ma: Turunnaadɛ taganxi.

sentences.english: Now go, put it in writing before them on a board, and make a record of it in a book, so that it may be for the future, a witness for all time to come.
sentences.susu: Yi fe sɛbɛ walaxɛ ma e bɛ, a sɛbɛ buki ma alako a xa findi seede ra abadan.

sentences.english: For they are an uncontrolled people, false-hearted, who will not give ear to the teaching of the Lord:
sentences.susu: Ɲama murutɛla nan a ra, naxan a booree madaxuma, naxan mu wama a tuli matife Alatala xa sɛriyɛ ra.

sentences.english: Who say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Do not give us word of what is true, but say false things to give us pleasure:
sentences.susu: E a falama sematoe bɛ, «Wo naxa laamatunyie to.» E a falama namiɲɔnmɛe bɛ, «Wo naxa masenyi tinxinxi ti.» E naxɛ, «Wo xa masenyi ɲɔxunmɛe ti, wo xa wɔyɛn fanyi fala, hali nɔndi mu a ra.

sentences.english: Get out of the good way, turning from the right road; do not keep the Holy One of Israel before our minds.
sentences.susu: Wo xa keli yi kira xɔn ma, wo xa Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ masenyi lu naa.»

sentences.english: For this cause the Holy One of Israel says, Because you will not give ear to this word, and are looking for help in ways of deceit and evil, and are putting your hope in them:
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ xa yaabi nan ya, «Wo to tondi yi masenyi ra, wo fa la tɔɔrɛ nun madaxui ra,

sentences.english: This sin will be to you like a crack in a high wall, causing its fall suddenly and in a minute.
sentences.susu: yi yunubi luma nɛ wo bɛ alɔ tɛtɛ kanaxi, naxan birama tɛrɛnna ra.

sentences.english: And he will let it be broken as a potter's vessel is broken: it will be smashed to bits without mercy; so that there will not be a bit in which one may take fire from the fireplace, or water from the spring.
sentences.susu: A kanama nɛ alɔ fɛɲɛ kanaxi, hali tɛ kɔ se, xa na mu a ra ye base mu mini a kui.»

sentences.english: For the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, said, In quiet and rest is your salvation: peace and hope are your strength: but you would not have it so.
sentences.susu: Marigi Ala naxan findixi Isirayila Sɛniyɛntɔɛ ra, a xa masenyi nan ya: «Xa wo gbilen n ma, wo fa wo raxara, n wo rakisima nɛ. Xa wo dɔxɔ, wo fa wo taxu n na, n sɛnbɛ fima nɛ wo ma. Kɔnɔ wo mu tin na ra.

sentences.english: Saying, No, for we will go in flight on horses; so you will certainly go in flight: and, We will go on the backs of quick-running beasts; so those who go after you will be quick-footed.
sentences.susu: Wo naxɛ, ‹Ade, muxu tan muxu gima soee nan fari.› Awa yire, wo fama gide. Wo naxɛ, ‹Muxu tan muxu gima soe xulunxie nan fari.› Awa yire, kɔnɔ wo kerimae xulun wo bɛ.

sentences.english: A thousand will go in fear before one; even before five you will go in flight: till you are like a pillar by itself on the top of a mountain, and like a flag on a hill.
sentences.susu: Wo wulu keren, wo gima nɛ wo yaxui keren ya ra. Xa yaxui suuli na a ra, wo birin wo gima nɛ, wo fa lu alɔ geya wuri keren gbansan tixi naxan fari.»

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord will be waiting, so that he may be kind to you; and he will be lifted up, so that he may have mercy on you; for the Lord is a God of righteousness: there is a blessing on all whose hope is in him.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na kui Alatala na mamɛ tife alako a xa hinnɛ wo ra. A fama nɛ kelide, a kinikini wo ma, barima Alatala tinxin. Sɛɛwɛ na mixi bɛ, naxan a xaxili tixi a ra.

sentences.english: O people, living in Zion, at Jerusalem, your weeping will be ended; he will certainly have mercy on you at the sound of your cry; when it comes to his ear, he will give you an answer.
sentences.susu: Siyonikae, wo tan naxee sabatixi Darisalamu, wo mu yaye raminima sɔnɔn. Wo na a xili, a hinnɛma nɛ wo ra, a na wo xui mɛ, a wo yaabima nɛ keren na.

sentences.english: And though the Lord will give you the bread of trouble and the water of grief, you will no longer put your teacher on one side, but you will see your teacher:
sentences.susu: Hali wo Marigi a niya wo xa lu fe xɔrɔxɔɛ kui, wo karamɔxɔɛe mu e nɔxunma wo ma sɔnɔn, wo fama nɛ e tode wo yae ra.

sentences.english: And at your back, when you are turning to the right hand or to the left, a voice will be sounding in your ears, saying, This is the way in which you are to go.
sentences.susu: Wo na siga yirefanyi ma, wo na siga kɔɔla ma, wo fama nɛ masenyi mɛde wo xanbi ra naxan a falama wo bɛ, «Kira fanyi nan ya, wo xa wo ɲɛrɛ a xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: And you will make unclean what is covering your pictured images of silver, and the plating of your images of gold: you will send them away as an unclean thing, saying, Be gone!
sentences.susu: Na kui wo xa kuye naxee yailanxi gbeti nun xɛɛma ra, wo fama nɛ nee wolide alɔ se sɛniyɛntaree, wo fa a fala, «Wo keli be!»

sentences.english: And he will give rain for your seed, so that you may put it in the earth; and you will have bread from the produce of the earth, good and more than enough for your needs: in that day the cattle will get their food in wide grass-lands.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala tunɛ rafama nɛ wo xa sansie ma, wo xa bɔxi daxamui gboma nɛ. Na tɛmui wo xa xurusee sigama nɛ e dɛmadonde fiili xungbee ma.

sentences.english: And the oxen and the young asses which are used for ploughing, will have salted grain which has been made free from the waste with fork and basket.
sentences.susu: Ninge nun sofale naxee xɛ buxama, e fama se fanyi nan donde naxan nafalaxi e bɛ.

sentences.english: And there will be rivers and streams of water on every tall mountain and on every high hill, in the day when great numbers are put to the sword, when the towers come down.
sentences.susu: Xuree wuyama nɛ wo xa geyae fari. Na tɛmui faxɛ xungbe nan tima, yire sɛnbɛma itexie rabirama nɛ.

sentences.english: And the light of the moon will be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be seven times greater, as the light of seven days, in the day when the Lord puts oil on the wounds of his people, and makes them well from the blows they have undergone.
sentences.susu: Alatala fama nɛ a xa ɲama xa maxɔnɛe nun fie rayalande. Na lɔxɔɛ kike yanbama nɛ alɔ soge, soge xa yanbɛ fan xun masama nɛ dɔxɔ solofere.

sentences.english: See, the name of the Lord is coming from far, burning with his wrath, with thick smoke going up: his lips are full of passion, and his tongue is like a burning fire:
sentences.susu: Alatala na fafe kelife yire makuye, a xɔnɔxi a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra, a fama nɛ tuuri belebele kui. Tɛ minima nɛ a kɛrɛ kui xɔnɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And his breath is as an overflowing stream, coming up even to the neck, shaking the nations for their destruction, like the shaking of grain in a basket: and he will put a cord in the mouths of the people, turning them out of their way.
sentences.susu: A ɲɛngi luxi nɛ alɔ banbaranyi naxan tema han mixi kɔnyi. A ɲamanɛe suxuma nɛ, a karafoe sa e ma, a se nde raso e banganyie ra, a e xanin yire e mu wama sigafe dɛnnaxɛ.
