sentences.english: You will have a song, as in the night when a holy feast is kept; and you will be glad in heart, as when they go with music of the pipe to the mountain of the Lord, the Rock of Israel.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan bɛɛti bama nɛ na lɔxɔɛ alɔ sali tɛmui, wo bɔɲɛe sɛɛwama nɛ alɔ mixi naxee xule fema sigafe ra Alatala xa geya fari, Alatala naxan luxi alɔ fanye Isirayila bɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord will send out the sound of his great voice, and they will see his arm stretched out, with the heat of his wrath, and the flame of a burning fire; with a cloud-burst, and storm, and a rain of ice.
sentences.susu: Alatala a xui xaaɲɛ raminima nɛ, a a sɛnbɛ masenma nɛ xɔnɛ belebele nun tɛ kasarɛ ra. A fama nɛ sesarinyi, galanyi, tunɛ xungbe, turunnaadɛ, nun balabalanyi ra.

sentences.english: For through the voice of the Lord the Assyrian will be broken, and the Lord's rod will be lifted up against him.
sentences.susu: Alatala xui fama nɛ Asiriyakae butuxunde, a e rabira a xa mangɛya ra.

sentences.english: And every blow of the rod of his punishment, which the Lord will send on him, will be with the sound of music: and with the waving of his sword the Lord will make war against him.
sentences.susu: A na e bɔnbɔ wuri xɔrɔxɔɛ ra tɛmui naxɛ, a xa ɲama bɛɛti bama nɛ maxasee nun kɔrae xui ra.

sentences.english: For a place of fire has long been ready; yes, it has been made ready for the king; he has made it deep and wide: it is massed with fire and much wood; the breath of the Lord, like a stream of fire, puts a light to it.
sentences.susu: Tɛ yire bara yailan mangɛ xili ma a rakuya. A tilin, a igbo. Yege gbegbe malanxi na tɛ belebele xa fe ra. Alatala ɲɛngi luxi nɛ alɔ tɛ ɲaaxi naxan ganma a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Cursed are those who go down to Egypt for help, and who put their faith in horses; looking to war-carriages for salvation, because of their numbers; and to horsemen, because they are very strong; but they are not looking to the Holy One of Israel, or turning their hearts to the Lord;
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na wo bɛ, wo tan naxee wo yɛtɛ taxuma Misira ra, wo tan naxee lama e xa sɔɔri ragise wuyaxie ra, wo tan naxee e xa soe ragimae matoma. Wo mu Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ fenma, wo mu wama Alatala xa mali xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Though he is wise, and able to send evil, and his purpose will not be changed; but he will go against the house of the evil-doers, and against those to whom they are looking for help.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala xaxili nan gbo, a fata ɲaxankatɛ ragorode mixie ma. A xui mu kanama. A kelima ɲama ɲaaxi xili ma, naxee mixi kobie malima.

sentences.english: For the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses are flesh, and not spirit: and when the Lord's hand is stretched out, the helper and he who is helped will come down together.
sentences.susu: Misirakae mu findixi Ala ra, adamadie nan tun na e ra. E xa soee mu findixi xaxili xa ra, sube nan tun na e ra. Alatala na keli tɛmui naxɛ mixie xili ma, naxan mali tima yo, naxan mali fenma yo, a e birin halakima nɛ.

sentences.english: For the Lord has said to me, As a lion, or a young lion, makes an angry noise over his food, and if a band of herdsmen come out against him, he will not be in fear of their voices, or give up his food for their noise: so the Lord of armies will come down to make war against Mount Zion and its hill.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Yɛtɛ na yirindin a xa sube suxuxi xun ma, hali xuruse dɛmadonyi gbegbee katama nɛ a keride, a mu gaaxuma e xa sɔnxɔɛ rate ya ra, a mu kelima na sube xun ma fefe ma. Alatala Sɛnbɛma fan goroma nɛ gere sode Siyoni geya fari na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Like birds with outstretched wings, so will the Lord of armies be a cover to Jerusalem; he will be a cover and salvation for it, going over it he will keep it from danger.
sentences.susu: Alatala Sɛnbɛma Darisalamu makantama nɛ, alɔ xɔni a gabutenyie italama a yɔrɛe xun ma ki naxɛ, a e kanta, a e rakisi, a a ti e xun ma.»

sentences.english: Come back to him who has been so deeply sinned against by the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae, wo xa gbilen Ala ma wo bara wo makuya naxan na.

sentences.english: For in that day they will all give up their images of silver and of gold, the sin which they made for themselves.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ wo fama nɛ wo xa kuyee rabɛɲinde wo naxee yailanxi gbeti nun xɛɛma ra yunubi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Then the Assyrian will come down by the sword, but not of man; the sword, not of men, will be the cause of his destruction: and he will go in flight from the sword, and his young men will be put to forced work.
sentences.susu: «Asiriyakae fama nɛ sɔntɔde santidɛgɛma ra, naxan mu fatanxi ɲɛngi kanyi ra. E e gima nɛ na ya ra, e xa fonikee xaninma nɛ konyiya kui.

sentences.english: And his rock will come to nothing because of fear, and his chiefs will go in flight from the flag, says the Lord, whose fire is in Zion, and his altar in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: E xa yire makantaxi birama nɛ gaaxui kui, limaniya bama nɛ e xa sɔɔri mangɛe yi ra gere fa tɛmui.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki, naxan na gere tɛ radɛxɛma Siyoni geya ma Darisalamu kui.

sentences.english: See, a king will be ruling in righteousness, and chiefs will give right decisions.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ fama nɛ mangɛya raɲɛrɛde tinxinyi ra, a xa kuntigie kiiti sama nɛ sɛriyɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: And a man will be as a safe place from the wind, and a cover from the storm; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shade of a great rock in a waste land.
sentences.susu: Kankan luma nɛ alɔ banxi fanyi turunnaadɛ dinma naxan na, alɔ xure naxee ye xaninma gbengberen yire, alɔ gɛmɛ niini bɔxi ixaraxi ma.

sentences.english: And the eyes of those who see will not be shut, and those who have hearing will give ear to the word.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui ya naxee se fenma, nee se igbɛma nɛ. Tuli naxee e matima, nee fe mɛma nɛ.

sentences.english: The man of sudden impulses will become wise in heart, and he whose tongue is slow will get the power of talking clearly.
sentences.susu: Xaxilitaree fama nɛ fahaamui sɔtɔde, boboe nɛnyi fama nɛ kelide, nee fa wɔyɛn a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: The foolish man will no longer be named noble, and they will not say of the false man that he is a man of honour.
sentences.susu: Mixi kobi mu xilima kuntigi, mixi tinxintare mu binyɛ sɔtɔma sɔnɔn,

sentences.english: For the foolish man will say foolish things, having evil thoughts in his heart, working what is unclean, and talking falsely about the Lord, to keep food from him who is in need of it, and water from him whose soul is desiring it.
sentences.susu: barima e mu nɔndi falama, e mu fe fanyi maɲɔxunma. A fe sɛniyɛnxi bɔtɛ rabama, a wule falama Alatala xa fe ra, a kaamɛtɔɛ luma a xa kaamɛ kui, a tondi ye ma mixi bɛ, ye xɔli na naxan ma.

sentences.english: The designs of the false are evil, purposing the destruction of the poor man by false words, even when he is in the right.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxi wali ki mu fan, a a mato a misikiinɛ xun nakanama tɔɔɲɛgɛ ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But the noble-hearted man has noble purposes, and by these he will be guided.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi fanyi tan a matoma nɛ a fe fanyi rabama ki naxɛ, a xun nakeli a xa wali fanyi saabui ra,

sentences.english: Give ear to my voice, you women who are living in comfort; give attention to my words, you daughters who have no fear of danger.
sentences.susu: Banna ginɛe, wo xa wo tuli mati n xui ra. Wo tan naxee laxi wo yɛtɛ ra, wo xa n ma masenyi ramɛ.

sentences.english: In not much more than a year, you, who are not looking for evil, will be troubled: for the produce of the vine-gardens will be cut off, and there will be no getting in of the grapes.
sentences.susu: Beenun ɲɛ keren xa dangi, wo sɛrɛnma nɛ gaaxui ra, wo tan naxee laxi wo yɛtɛ ra, barima wɛni bogie kanama nɛ, xɛ xabɛ fan mu fanma.

sentences.english: Be shaking with fear, you women who are living in comfort; be troubled, you who have no fear of danger: take off your robes and put on clothing of grief.
sentences.susu: Banna ginɛe, wo xa wo magoro, wo tan naxee laxi wo yɛtɛ ra, wo xa gaaxu. Wo xa wo xa dugi fanyi masara kaaɲɛ dugi ra.

sentences.english: Have sorrow for the fields, the pleasing fields, the fertile vine;
sentences.susu: Wo xa wa wo xa wɛni bogi nun xɛ kanaxie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And for the land of my people, where thorns will come up; even for all the houses of joy in the glad town.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wa n ma ɲama xa bɔxi xa fe ra, naxan bara findi ɲooge nun tunbe yire ra. Wo xa wa wo xa taae xa fe ra ɲɛlɛxinyi ɲɔnxi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: For the fair houses will have no man living in them; the town which was full of noise will become a waste; the hill and the watchtower will be unpeopled for ever, a joy for the asses of the woods, a place of food for the flocks;
sentences.susu: Wo xa yire makantaxi raboloma nɛ, wo xa taa fanyi findima nɛ wula ra, sofale nun xurusee dɛ madonma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Till the spirit comes on us from on high, and the waste land becomes a fertile field, and the fertile field is changed into a wood.
sentences.susu: A luma na ki nɛ han Ala a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi ragoroma won ma tɛmui naxɛ keli koore ma. Na tɛmui na gbengberenyi findima nɛ sansi yire ra, a gbo yɛ alɔ fɔtɔnyi.

sentences.english: Then in the waste land there will be an upright rule, and righteousness will have its place in the fertile field.
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ raɲɛrɛma nɛ gbengberenyi ma, tinxinyi fan sabatima nɛ sansi yire.

sentences.english: And the work of righteousness will be peace; and the effect of an upright rule will be to take away fear for ever.
sentences.susu: Tinxinyi xa wali findima bɔɲɛsa nan na, a findi xaxilisa nun kantari ra waxati birin.

sentences.english: And my people will be living in peace, in houses where there is no fear, and in quiet resting-places.
sentences.susu: N ma ɲama luma nɛ naa bɔɲɛsa kui, maraxarɛ kui.

sentences.english: But the tall trees will come down with a great fall, and the town will be low in a low place.
sentences.susu: Hali fɔtɔnyi kana, taa bira,

sentences.english: Happy are you who are planting seed by all the waters, and sending out the ox and the ass.
sentences.susu: hɛɛri nan luma wo bɛ, wo tan naxee sansi sima xure dɛ ra, wo tan naxee tinma wo xa ningee nun wo xa sofalee xa e dɛ madon.

sentences.english: Ho! you who make waste those who did not make you waste; acting falsely to those who were not false to you. When you have come to an end of wasting, you will be made waste, and after your false acts, they will do the same to you.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na i bɛ, i tan naxan gbaloe rabama. Ɲaxankatɛ na i bɛ, i tan naxan yanfɛ tima. I na gɛ na rabade, i xun fa rakana, yanfɛ gbilen i ma.

sentences.english: O Lord, have mercy on us; for we have been waiting for your help: be our strength every morning, our salvation in time of trouble.
sentences.susu: Alatala hinnɛ muxu ra, muxu xaxili tixi i tan nan na. I xa muxu sɛnbɛ xun masa, i xa muxu ratanga fe xɔrɔxɔɛ ma.

sentences.english: At the loud noise the peoples have gone in flight; at your coming up the nations have gone in all directions.
sentences.susu: Sie e gima nɛ i xui ya ra, ɲamanɛe yensenma nɛ i xa gere xui ra.

sentences.english: And the goods taken in war will be got together like the massing of young locusts; men will be rushing on them like the rushing of locusts.
sentences.susu: Wo tan sie, mixie fama nɛ wo xa naafuli suxude, alɔ katoe dinma xɛ ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord is lifted up; his place is on high: he has made Zion full of righteousness and true religion.
sentences.susu: Wo tan Siyonikae, Alatala gbo, a sabatixi koore nan ma. A tinxinyi nun nɔndi fima nɛ wo ma.

sentences.english: And she will have no more fear of change, being full of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge: the fear of the Lord is her wealth.
sentences.susu: A wo bun ti. A kisi, xaxili fanyi, nun fahaamui ragatama nɛ wo bɛ, wo tan naxee gaaxuma a ya ra.

sentences.english: See, the men of war are sorrowing outside the town: those who came looking for peace are weeping bitterly.
sentences.susu: Wo a mato, ɲalamae nun xɛɛrae na wafe tande.

sentences.english: The highways are waste, no man is journeying there: the agreement is broken, he has made sport of the towns, he has no thought for man.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu toma kirae ma sɔnɔn. Saatɛ bara kana, saatɛ seedee bara yaagi, binyɛ yo mu na sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: The earth is sorrowing and wasting away; Lebanon is put to shame and has become waste; Sharon is like the Arabah; and in Bashan and Carmel the leaves are falling.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi na sunnunyi nun halaki nan kui. Liban xa mɛrɛ bara maxara, Basan nun Karemele fɔtɔnyi burɛxɛe na yolonfe.

sentences.english: Now will I come forward, says the Lord; now will I be lifted up; now will my power be seen.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxɛ, «Yakɔsi n kelima nɛ fa, wo fa n matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: Your designs will be without profit, and their effect will be nothing: you will be burned up by the fire of my breath.
sentences.susu: Wo to natɛ fufafu tongo, wo man fe fufafu nan sɔtɔma. Wo ɲɛngi luxi nɛ alɔ tɛ naxan fama wo gande.

sentences.english: And the peoples will be like the burning of chalk: as thorns cut down, which are burned in the fire.
sentences.susu: Tɛ dinma nɛ sie ra, e gan alɔ tunbe masɛgɛxi, sese mu lu.»

sentences.english: Give ear, you who are far off, to what I have done: see my power, you who are near.
sentences.susu: Wo tan naxee makuya n na, wo xa wo tuli mati n ma fe rabaxie ra. Wo tan naxee makɔrɛ n na, wo xa la n sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: The sinners in Zion are full of fear; the haters of God are shaking with wonder. Who among us may keep his place before the burning fire? who among us may see the eternal burnings?
sentences.susu: Yunubitɔɛ naxee na Siyoni, e bara gaaxu. Alatala yaxuie bara sɛrɛn fɔlɔ. «Nde nɔma lude tɛ kasarati sɛɛti ma? Nde ratangama tɛ xubentare ma won ya ma?»

sentences.english: He whose ways are true, and whose words are upright; he who gives no thought to the profits of false acts, whose hands have not taken rewards, who will have no part in putting men to death, and whose eyes are shut against evil;
sentences.susu: Mixi nan a ra naxan ɲɛrɛma tinxinyi ra, naxan nɔndi falama, naxan tondima geeni sɔtɔ ki ɲaaxi ra, naxan mu a bɛlɛxɛ italama buɲa kobi bɛ, naxan mu a tuli matima mixi faxafe natɛ tongoe ra, naxan mu a xaxili tima fe ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: He will have a place on high: he will be safely shut in by the high rocks: his bread will be given to him; his waters will be certain.
sentences.susu: Na mixi mɔɔli tan sabatima nɛ geya fari yire makantaxi kui, a baloe nun ye sɔtɔ a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Your eyes will see the king in his glory: they will be looking on a far-stretching land.
sentences.susu: Wo yae mangɛ toma nɛ a xa tofanyi kui, wo man fa bɔxi to naxan xa gboe mu ɲɔnma.

sentences.english: Your heart will give thought to the cause of your fear: where is the scribe, where is he who made a record of the payments, where is he by whom the towers were numbered?
sentences.susu: Wo ratuma nɛ wo gaaxu ki ma, a falafe ra, «Na mangɛ na minden? Duuti maxili go? Yire makantaxi xunmato go?»

sentences.english: Never again will you see the cruel people, a people whose tongue has no sense for you; whose language is strange to you.
sentences.susu: Wo mu fama na bɔnsɔɛ yɛtɛ igboe tode sɔnɔn, naxee xa xui fahaamufe xɔrɔxɔ.

sentences.english: Let your eyes be resting on Zion, the town of our holy feasts: you will see Jerusalem, a quiet resting-place, a tent which will not be moved, whose tent-pins will never be pulled up, and whose cords will never be broken.
sentences.susu: Siyoni mato, won ma sali rabama dɛnnaxɛ. Mɛnni wo Darisalamu toma nɛ, taa naxan naxaraxi, ɲama naxan mu talama e xɔnyi sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: But there the Lord will be with us in his glory, ... wide rivers and streams; where no boat will go with blades, and no fair ship will be sailing.
sentences.susu: Won Marigi Sɛnbɛma luma nɛ naa won ya ma xuree sɛɛti ma. Won yaxuie mu nɔma tide na xuree ma e xa kunkuie kui,

sentences.english: For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our law-giver, the Lord is our king; he will be our saviour.
sentences.susu: barima Alatala nan na won ma kiitisa ra, a sɛriyɛ yati nan fima won ma. Alatala nan na won ma Mangɛ ra, a won natangama fe ɲaaxi nan ma.

sentences.english: Your cords have become loose; they were not able to make strong the support of their sails, the sail was not stretched out: then the blind will take much property, the feeble-footed will make division of the goods of war.
sentences.susu: Wo tan sie, wo xa luutie bara yɔntɔn, wo xa kunkui wuri mu tixi, wo xa bɛla mu gɛxi italade. Na kui wo xa naafuli fama nɛ xaninde, hali mabɛnyie nɔma na rabade.

sentences.english: And the men of Zion will not say, I am ill: for its people will have forgiveness for their sin.
sentences.susu: Siyonika yo mu a falama, «N mu yalanxi.» E xa yunubie fama nɛ xafaride.

sentences.english: Come near, you nations, and give ear; take note, you peoples: let the earth and everything in it give ear; the world and all those living in it.
sentences.susu: Wo wo maso, wo tan ɲamanɛe, alako wo xa wo tuli mati. Sie, wo xa wo tuli mati n na a fanyi ra. Duniɲa ɲama birin xa e tuli mati n ma masenyi ra,

sentences.english: For the Lord is angry with all the nations, and his wrath is burning against all their armies: he has put them to the curse, he has given them to destruction.
sentences.susu: barima Alatala xɔnɔxi ɲamanɛ nun e xa sɔɔri gaali birin ma. A fama nɛ dinde e ra, a e ratɔn.

sentences.english: Their dead bodies will be thick on the face of the earth, and their smell will come up, and the mountains will be flowing with their blood, and all the hills will come to nothing.
sentences.susu: E xa mixi faxaxie mu ragatama. E binbie bɔrɔma nɛ, e xiri fa te koore ma. E wuli ifilima nɛ geyae ma.

sentences.english: And the heavens will be rolled together like the roll of a book: and all their army will be gone, like a dead leaf from the vine, or a dry fruit from the fig-tree.
sentences.susu: Hali tunbui naxee na koore ma, e birama nɛ, alɔ burɛxɛe nun xɔrɛe birama ki naxɛ. Koore walaxɛ makuntanma nɛ alɔ dagi.

sentences.english: For my sword in heaven is full of wrath: see, it is coming down on Edom, in punishment on the people of my curse.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxɛ, «N ma santidɛgɛma na gɛ na wali ra, a goroma nɛ Edon ɲama xili ma, n fa e sɔntɔ kiiti xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: The sword of the Lord is full of blood, it is fat with the best of the meat, with the blood of lambs and goats, with the best parts of the sheep: for the Lord has a feast in Bozrah, and much cattle will be put to death in the land of Edom.
sentences.susu: Wuli na Alatala xa santidɛgɛma ma. A bara gɛ sɛrɛxɛ kɔn naxabade a ra, xurusee wuli nun ture na a ma. Alatala na sɛrɛxɛ nde kɔn naxabafe Bosara, a na faxɛ tife a ɲaaxi ra Edon bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the strong oxen will go down to death together with the smaller cattle.
sentences.susu: Ɲama sɔntɔma nɛ, sɛxɛ ningee nun tuurae fan faxa, han bɔxi yati bara nɔxɔ na wuli birin na.

sentences.english: For it is the day of the Lord's punishment, when he gives payment for the wrongs done to Zion.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa natɛ nan na ki, alako Siyoni gbe xa ɲɔxɔ Edon xa yaxuya xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And its streams will be turned into boiling oil, and its dust into burning stone, and all the land will be on fire.
sentences.susu: Edon xa xuree nun bɔxi luma nɛ alɔ dole, a fa lu gan na.

sentences.english: It will not be put out day or night; its smoke will go up for ever: it will be waste from generation to generation; no one will go through it for ever.
sentences.susu: A mu xubenma kɔɛ nun yanyi ra, a tuuri luma nɛ te ra tun. Mɛnni findima gbengberenyi yire nan na abadan, mixi yo mu dangima naa sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: But the birds of the waste land will have their place there; it will be a heritage for the bittern and the raven: and it will be measured out with line and weight as a waste land.
sentences.susu: Xɔni nun wulai sube mɔɔli birin luma nɛ naa. Alatala bara natɛ tongo mɛnni xa findi gbengberen yire ra.

sentences.english: The jackals will be there, and her great ones will be gone; they will say, There is no longer a kingdom there, and all her chiefs will have come to an end.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni mangɛ mu sese toma naa e yamarima rabama naxan xun na, e xa kuntigie yensenma nɛ feo.

sentences.english: And thorns will come up in her fair houses, and waste plants in her strong towers: and foxes will make their holes there, and it will be a meeting-place for ostriches.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni xa yire makantaxie findima tunbee yire, e xa taae luma nɛ alɔ wulai, wule baree nun xɔnie luma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And the beasts of the waste places will come together with the jackals, and the evil spirits will be crying to one another, even the night-spirit will come and make her resting-place there.
sentences.susu: Wulai subee mɔɔli birin sabatima naa,

sentences.english: The arrowsnake will make her hole and put her eggs there, and get her young together under her shade: there the hawks will come together by twos.
sentences.susu: Bɔximase a xalɛ sama nɛ naa, a fa e rasɛgɛ, a e kanta. Hali yubɛe sabatima mɛnni nɛ, e fa die rasɛgɛ.

sentences.english: See what is recorded in the book of the Lord: all these will be there, not one without the other: the mouth of the Lord has given the order, and his spirit has made them come together.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa sɛbɛli mato a fanyi ra. Yi sube birin fama nɛ lude naa, e fa wuya. Alatala bara na natɛ tongo, a Xaxili yati fama nɛ na rakamalide.

sentences.english: And he has given them their heritage, and by his hand it has been measured out to them: it will be theirs for ever, their resting-place from generation to generation.
sentences.susu: A tan nan yati e xa fe matoma, a na bɔxi itaxun e ra, a fa findi e gbe ra abadan.

sentences.english: The waste land and the dry places will be glad; the lowland will have joy and be full of flowers.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛlɛxinyi xa lu gbengberen yire, sɛɛwɛ xa lu wulai alɔ sansi fugaxie yire.

sentences.english: It will be flowering like the rose; it will be full of delight and songs; the glory of Lebanon will be given to it; the pride of Carmel and Sharon: they will see the glory of the Lord, the power of our God.
sentences.susu: Sansi tofanyie xa lu naa, sɛɛwɛ xui xa ite. A xa lu alɔ Liban fɔtɔnyi, a xa tofan alɔ Karemele geya nun Sarɔn yire. Won Marigi Alatala xa nɔrɛ toma nɛ naa a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Make strong the feeble hands, give support to the shaking knees.
sentences.susu: Wo tan naxee bara gaaxu han wo bɛlɛxɛ mu se suxuma, wo xinbi fa sɛrɛn, wo sɛnbɛ xa so.

sentences.english: Say to those who are full of fear, Be strong and take heart: see, your God will give punishment; the reward of God will come; he himself will come to be your saviour.
sentences.susu: Wo a fala mixie bɛ naxee bara gaaxu, «Wo xa limaniya, hali wo mu gaaxu! Wo Marigi Ala bara fa wo gbe ɲɔxɔde. A fama wo rakiside a sɛnbɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Then the eyes of the blind will see, and the ears which are stopped will be open.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, dɔnxuie ya rabɔɔma nɛ, tulixɔrie fe mɛma nɛ.

sentences.english: Then will the feeble-footed be jumping like a roe, and the voice which was stopped will be loud in song: for in the waste land streams will be bursting out, and waters in the dry places.
sentences.susu: Mabɛnyie tuganma nɛ alɔ xeli, boboe fan sɛɛwɛ xui raminima nɛ, barima xuree minima nɛ gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: And the burning sand will become a pool, and the dry earth springs of waters: the fields where the sheep take their food will become wet land, and water-plants will take the place of grass.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi maxaraxi mafindima nɛ baa ra, dulonyi minima nɛ gbengberen yire. Wulai baree xɔnyi bara findi ye yire ra.

sentences.english: And a highway will be there; its name will be, The Holy Way; the unclean and the sinner may not go over it, and those who go on it will not be turned out of the way by the foolish.
sentences.susu: Kira mabama naa naxan xili falama, «Kira Sɛniyɛnxi.» Mixi sɛniyɛntare mu dangima mɛnni, fo naxan lanma a xa dangi na. Xaxilitaree mu tima na kira xɔn ma.

sentences.english: No lion will be there, or any cruel beast; they will not be seen there; but those for whom the Lord has given a price,
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛe nun burunyi sube mu toma naa, fo lasiri mixi.

sentences.english: Even those whom he has made free, will come back again; they will come with songs to Zion; on their heads will be eternal joy; delight and joy will be theirs, and sorrow and sounds of grief will be gone for ever.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxee xɔrɛyaxi, nee nan gbilenma e xɔnyi na kira xɔn ma. E soma nɛ Siyoni sɛɛwɛ ra naxan mu ɲɔnma. E ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ tun. Sunnunyi nun tɔɔrɛ bama nɛ e ma abadan.

sentences.english: And it came about in the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah that Sennacherib, king of Assyria, came up against all the walled towns of Judah and took them.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Xesekiya xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun naani nde ra, Asiriya mangɛ Senaxeribi naxa nɔ Yudaya taa sɛnbɛmae ra.

sentences.english: And the king of Assyria sent the Rab-shakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem to King Hezekiah with a strong force, and he took up his position by the stream of the higher pool, by the highway of the washerman's
sentences.susu: A to gɛ na rabade, Asiriya mangɛ naxa a xa sɔɔri mangɛ xɛɛ Darisalamu mangɛ xɔn ma, kelife ra Lakisi, a tan nun a xa sɔɔri sɛnbɛmae. E naxa ti ye yire xungbe fɛ ma, mixie nu garɛ soma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And there came out to him Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, who was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder.
sentences.susu: Xilikiya xa di Eliyakimi, mangɛ xa banxi xunyi, mangɛ xa sɛbɛliti Sebena, nun Asafi xa di Yowa, naxan findixi mangɛ xa kɛɛdi ragatɛ ra, nee naxa mini Asiriyakae ralande.

sentences.english: And the Rab-shakeh said to them, Say now to Hezekiah, These are the words of the great king, the king of Assyria: In what are you placing your hope?
sentences.susu: Asiriya mangɛ rasima singe naxa yi masenyi ti e bɛ, «Wo a fala Xesekiya bɛ, Asiriya mangɛ xungbe yi nan masenxi, ‹I xaxili tixi munse ra?

sentences.english: You say you have a design and strength for war, but these are only words: now to whom are you looking for support, that you have gone against my authority?
sentences.susu: I wɔyɛn fufafu nan tun falaxi! I ɲɔxɔ a ma i bara fɛɛrɛ nun sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ n gerefe ra? I laxi nde ra, naxan a niyama i xa n matandi?

sentences.english: See, you are basing your hope on that broken rod of Egypt, which will go into a man's hand if he makes use of it for a support; for so is Pharaoh, king of Egypt, to all who put their faith in him.
sentences.susu: I i xa lanlanteya saxi Misirakae nan ma fa? E luxi alɔ wuri ponpoe naxan girama, a fa i sɔxɔ i kilɔnma a ra tɛmui naxɛ. Misira mangɛ Firawuna na na ki nɛ mixi birin bɛ, naxee e xaxili tixi a ra.

sentences.english: And if you say to me, Our hope is in the Lord our God; is it not he whose high places and altars Hezekiah has taken away, saying to Judah and Jerusalem that worship may only be given before this altar?
sentences.susu: Tɛmunde wo n yaabima nɛ, «Muxu xaxili tixi muxu Marigi Alatala nan na.» Kɔnɔ n xa a fala wo bɛ Xesekiya bara gɛ sɛrɛxɛbadee kanade geyae fari, a fa a fala Yudayakae nun Darisalamukae bɛ, «Wo Alatala batu Darisalamu xa sɛrɛxɛbade gbansan nɛ.»›»

sentences.english: And now, take a chance with my master, the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses, if you are able to put horsemen on them.
sentences.susu: «Xa i sa nɔma soe ragi wulu firin sɔtɔde i xa ɲama ya ma, n marigi Asiriya mangɛ soe fima nɛ i ma, e naxee ragima.

sentences.english: How then may you put to shame the least of my master's servants? and you have put your hope in Egypt for war-carriages and horsemen:
sentences.susu: Hali i i xaxili ti Misirakae ra, soe ragie nun gisee xa fe ra, i sɛnbɛ xurun n ma mangɛ xa mixi xuri di nde nɔfe ra.

sentences.english: And have I now come to send destruction on this land without the Lord's authority? It was the Lord himself who said to me, Go up against this land and make it waste.
sentences.susu: Bafe na ra, wo Marigi Alatala xa mu waxi n xa be gere? Alatala nan a falaxi n bɛ, ‹Siga, i na bɔxi kana.›»

sentences.english: Then Eliakim and Shebna and Joah said to the Rab-shakeh, Please make use of the Aramaean language in talking to your servants, for we are used to it, and do not make use of the Jews' language in the hearing of the people on the wall.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Eliyakimi, Sebena, nun Yowa naxa a fala Asiriya mangɛ rasima bɛ, «Yandi, i xa wɔyɛn muxu bɛ Arami xui ra, muxu tan i xa konyie na xui fahaamuma. I naxa wɔyɛn muxu bɛ Yuda xui ra ɲama ya xɔri naxan na tɛtɛ fari ma.»

sentences.english: But the Rab-shakeh said, Is it to your master or to you that my master has sent me to say these words? has he not sent me to the men seated on the wall? for they are the people who will be short of food with you when the town is shut in.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Asiriya mangɛ rasima naxa e yaabi, «N marigi n xɛɛxi yi masenyi falade i xa mangɛ nun i tan nan gbansan bɛ? N mu wɔyɛnfe yi mixie fan xa bɛ, naxee dɔxɔxi tɛtɛ fari yi ki, naxee fama e yɛtɛ xa gbi fuxi donde nun e yɛtɛ xɔli minde nun wo tan na?»

sentences.english: Then the Rab-shakeh got up and said with a loud voice in the Jews' language, Give ear to the words of the great king, the king of Assyria:
sentences.susu: Mangɛ rasima naxa keli, a a fala a xui itexi ra Yudaya xui ra, a naxɛ, «Wo wo tuli mati Asiriya mangɛ xungbe xa masenyi ra,

sentences.english: This is what the king says: Do not be tricked by Hezekiah, for there is no salvation for you in him.
sentences.susu: ‹Wo naxa tin Xesekiya xa wo madaxu, barima a mu fata wo ratangade n bɛlɛxɛ i!

sentences.english: And do not let Hezekiah make you put your faith in the Lord, saying, The Lord will certainly keep us safe, and this town will not be given into the hands of the king of Assyria.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa tin a xa wo madaxu wo xaxili tife Alatala ra, a falafe ra, «Alatala muxu rakisima nɛ, yi taa mu luma Asiriyakae xa mangɛ sagoe.»

sentences.english: Do not give ear to Hezekiah, for this is what the king of Assyria says, Make peace with me, and come out to me; and everyone will be free to take the fruit of his vine and of his fig-tree, and the water of his spring;
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo tuli mati Xesekiya ra de! Asiriya mangɛ yi nan falaxi, «Xa wo tin lude n ma yaamari bun ma, kankan fama nɛ a xa xɛɛ bogisee donde, kankan a xa kɔlɔnyi ye min,

sentences.english: Till I come and take you away to a land like yours, a land of grain and wine, a land of bread and vine-gardens.
sentences.susu: han n sa fama wo xaninde bɔxi nde ma tɛmui naxɛ, naxan luxi alɔ wo xa bɔxi, mɛngi nun wɛni fanyi, taami nun wɛni xɛe na dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: Give no attention to Hezekiah when he says to you, The Lord will keep us safe. Has any one of the gods of the nations kept his land from falling into the hands of the king of Assyria?
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo tuli mati Xesekiya ra, naxan wama wo madaxufe a falafe ra, «Marigi Alatala won nakisima nɛ.» Si gbɛtɛe xa alae nɔ nɛ e xa mixie bade Asiriya mangɛ bɛlɛxɛ i?

sentences.english: Where are the gods of Hamath and of Arpad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? where are the gods of Samaria? and have they kept Samaria out of my hand?
sentences.susu: Xamata nun Arapadi xa alae go? Sefarawayimi, Hena nun Iwa xa alae go? Nee bara Samari ba n bɛlɛxɛ i?

sentences.english: Who among all the gods of these countries have kept their country from falling into my hand, to give cause for the thought that the Lord will keep Jerusalem from falling into my hand?
sentences.susu: Ɲamanɛe birin xa alae ya ma, ala mundun a xa mixie rakisixi n bɛlɛxɛ i? Alatala tan nɔma Darisalamu ratangade n ma?›»

sentences.english: But they kept quiet and gave him no answer: for the king's order was, Give him no answer.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa dundu, e mu a yaabi, barima mangɛ a fala nɛ, «Wo naxa a yaabi de.»

sentences.english: Then Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, who was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah with their clothing parted as a sign of grief, and gave him an account of what the Rab-shakeh had said.
sentences.susu: Xilikiya xa di Eliyakimi, mangɛ xa banxi xunyi, Sebena sɛbɛliti, nun Asafi xa di Yowa kɛɛdi ragatɛ, nee naxa siga mangɛ Xesekiya yire e xa sosee ibɔɔxi ra e ma sunnunyi kui, e fa Asiriya mangɛ rasima xa masenyi dɛntɛgɛ a bɛ.

sentences.english: And on hearing it Hezekiah took off his robe and put on haircloth and went into the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Xesekiya to na fe mɛ, a naxa a xa donma ibɔɔ a ma, a bɛki dugi ragoro a ma sunnunyi kui, a fa siga Alatala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and the chief priests, dressed in haircloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa banxi xunyi Eliyakimi, a xa sɛbɛliti Sebena, nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ forie xɛɛ Amosu xa di Annabi Esayi xɔn, bɛki dugi ragoroxi e ma.

sentences.english: And they said to him, Hezekiah says, This day is a day of trouble and punishment and shame: for the children are ready to come to birth, but there is no strength to give birth to them.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala a bɛ, Xesekiya yi nan falaxi, «To findixi sunnunyi, ɲaxankatɛ, nun bɔɲɛ maɲaaxu lɔxɔɛ nan na. A luxi alɔ die bari tɛmui bara a li, kɔnɔ sɛnbɛ mu na sɔnɔn e xa bari.

sentences.english: It may be that the Lord your God will give ear to the words of the Rab-shakeh, whom the king of Assyria, his master, has sent to say evil things against the living God, and will make his words come to nothing: so make your prayer for the rest of the people.
sentences.susu: I Marigi Alatala na Asiriya mangɛ xa xɛɛra xa masenyi mɛ Ala ɲiɲɛ rasɔtɔfe ra, tɛmunde a a ɲaxankatama nɛ a xa na wɔyɛnyie ma. I xa Ala maxandi alako won ma mixi dɔnxɔɛe naxa faxa.»

sentences.english: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Xesekiya xa mixie naxa siga Annabi Esayi yire.

sentences.english: And Isaiah said to them, This is what you are to say to your master: The Lord says, Be not troubled by the words which the servants of the king of Assyria have said against me in your hearing.
sentences.susu: Esayi naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo a fala wo xa mangɛ bɛ, Alatala yi masenyi nan tixi, ‹I naxa gaaxu Asiriya mangɛ xa xɛɛrae xa marasɔtɔɛe xa fe ra, a naxee falaxi n bɛ.

sentences.english: See, I will put a spirit into him, and bad news will come to his ears, and he will go back to his land; and there I will have him put to death.
sentences.susu: N fama a xaxili mafindide xibaarui nde ra, a fa gbilen a xɔnyi. N a faxama santidɛgɛma ra mɛnni nɛ.›»

sentences.english: So the Rab-shakeh went back, and when he got there the king of Assyria was making war against Libnah: for it had come to his ears that the king of Assyria had gone away from Lachish.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa xɛɛra to gbilen Asiriya mangɛ yire, a naxa a li a xa mangɛ nu bara keli Lakisi, a nu na Libina gerefe.

sentences.english: And when news came to him that Tirhakah, king of Ethiopia, had made an attack on him, ... And he sent representatives to Hezekiah, king of Judah, saying,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Asiriya mangɛ naxa a kolon a Kusi mangɛ Tirihaka na fafe a gerede. Na kui a man naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Xesekiya ma, a falafe ra,

sentences.english: This is what you are to say to Hezekiah, king of Judah: Let not your God, in whom is your faith, give you a false hope, saying, Jerusalem will not be given into the hands of the king of Assyria.
sentences.susu: «Wo a fala Yudaya mangɛ Xesekiya bɛ, ‹I xa ala, i laxi naxan na, na naxa i madaxu de a falafe ra, «Darisalamu mu luma Asiriya mangɛ bɛlɛxɛ i.»

sentences.english: No doubt the story has come to your ears of what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands, putting them to the curse: and will you be kept safe from their fate?
sentences.susu: I a kolon a fanyi ra Asiriya mangɛe naxan nabaxi ɲamanɛe birin na. E e sɔntɔ nɛ a ɲaaxi ra. I tan fa fama i bade n yi ra di?

sentences.english: Did the gods of the nations keep safe those on whom my fathers sent destruction, Gozan and Haran and Rezeph, and the children of Eden who were in Telassar?
sentences.susu: N benbae si naxee bɔnbɔ, e xa alae e ratanga nɛ, alɔ Gosan, Xarani, Resefa, nun Eden bɔnsɔɛ naxee na Teli Asari?

sentences.english: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the town of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivva?
sentences.susu: Xamata mangɛ, Arapadi mangɛ, Sefarawayimi mangɛ, Hena mangɛ, nun Iwa mangɛ na minden?›»

sentences.english: And Hezekiah took the letter from the hands of those who had come with it; and after reading it, Hezekiah went up to the house of the Lord, opening the letter there before the Lord,
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa bataaxɛ rasuxu xɛɛrae yi ra, a naxa a xaran. Na dangi xanbi, a naxa te Alatala xa banxi, a a itala Alatala ya i.

sentences.english: And he made prayer to the Lord, saying,
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa Alatala maxandi, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: O Lord of armies, the God of Israel, seated between the winged ones, you only are the God of all the kingdoms of the earth; you have made heaven and earth.
sentences.susu: «Isirayila Marigi Alatala, naxan magoroxi malekɛe tagi, i tan nan na duniɲa birin Marigi ra, i tan nan koore nun bɔxi daaxi.

sentences.english: Let your ear be turned to us, O Lord; let your eyes be open, O Lord, and see: take note of all the words of Sennacherib who has sent men to say evil against the living God.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i i tuli mati a fanyi ra, i xa Senaxeribi xa masenyi ramɛ, naxan a xa mixi xɛɛxi Ala Ɲiɲɛ rasɔtɔde.

sentences.english: Truly, O Lord, the kings of Assyria have made waste all the nations and their lands,
sentences.susu: Alatala, nɔndi na a ra, Asiriya mangɛe bara si birin sɔntɔ, a e xa fe xun nakana.

sentences.english: And have given their gods to the fire: for they were no gods, but wood and stone, the work of men's hands; so they have given them to destruction.
sentences.susu: E naxa nee xa alae woli tɛ i, e e kana. A nɔndi ki ma, na kuyee mu findixi Ala ra, barima ibunadama nan nee yailanxi wuri nun gɛmɛ ra.

sentences.english: But now, O Lord our God, give us salvation from his hand, so that it may be clear to all the kingdoms of the earth that you, and you only, are the Lord.
sentences.susu: Yandi, muxu Marigi Alatala, i xa muxu ratanga Senaxeribi ma, alako duniɲa birin xa a kolon, a i tan nan keren na Ala ra.»

sentences.english: Then Isaiah, the son of Amoz, sent to Hezekiah, saying, The Lord, the God of Israel, says, The prayer you have made to me against Sennacherib, king of Assyria, has come to my ears.
sentences.susu: Awa, Amosu xa di Annabi Esayi naxa xɛɛra xɛɛ mangɛ Xesekiya ma, a naxɛ, «Isirayila Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, ‹N bara i xa maxandi suxu i naxan tixi Asiriya mangɛ Senaxeribi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: This is the word which the Lord has said about him: In the eyes of the virgin daughter of Zion you are shamed and laughed at; the daughter of Jerusalem has made sport of you.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya a xili ma, Siyoni taa fama nɛ yode i ma, Darisalamu tofanyi fa i maberede.

sentences.english: Against whom have you said evil and bitter things? and against whom has your voice been loud and your eyes lifted up? even against the Holy One of Israel.
sentences.susu: I nde konbixi, i nde maberexi? I sɔnxɔxi nde ma? I bara i yɛtɛ igbo Isirayila Sɛniyɛntɔɛ ma.

sentences.english: You have sent your servants with evil words against the Lord, and have said, With all my war-carriages I have come up to the top of the mountains, to the inmost parts of Lebanon; and its tall cedars will be cut down, and the best trees of its woods: I will come up into his highest places, into his thick woods.
sentences.susu: I xa xɛɛrae bara Marigi rasɔtɔ. I bara a fala, «N tan bara te han Liban geyae fari n ma gisee kui. N sɛdiri wuri itexie fɔn, n sipirɛ wuri tofanyie sɛgɛ fɔtɔnyi dɛɲɛxi kui.

sentences.english: I have made water-holes and taken their waters, and with my foot I have made all the rivers of Egypt dry.
sentences.susu: N tigie ge ɲamanɛe ma, n e ye min. N Nili xure sɛnkinɛe birin xɔrima nɛ n sanyie ra.»›»

sentences.english: Has it not come to your ears how I did it long before, purposing it in times long past? Now I have given effect to my design, so that by you strong towns might be turned into masses of broken walls.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxɛ, «I mu a mɛxi ba, n bara yi fee natɛ nu a rakuya, kafi n i daa tɛmui? N fa na e rabafe nɛ. I tan findixi taa sɛnbɛmae sɔntɔma nan tun na,

sentences.english: This is why their townsmen had no power, they were broken and put to shame; they were like the grass of the field, or a green plant; like the grass on the house-tops, which a cold wind makes waste.
sentences.susu: na taa mixie sɛnbɛ mu na e xa ti wo kanke. Gaaxui nun yaagi nan tun e sɔtɔma. E luma nɛ alɔ ɲooge xare, alɔ sɛxɛ naxan na banxi kɔn na, alɔ mɛngi bili naxan xarama beenun a xa bogi.

sentences.english: But I have knowledge of your getting up and your resting, of your going out and your coming in.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n i dɔxɔ tɛmui, i mini tɛmui sigafe ra gere sode, i fa tɛmui, n na birin kolon. I man na n matandi, n na fan kolon.

sentences.english: Because your wrath against me and your pride have come to my ears, I will put my hook in your nose and my cord in your lips, and I will make you go back by the way you came.
sentences.susu: I to bara n matandi na ki, i i yɛtɛ igbo n ma, n na n ma xurundɛ gbakuma nɛ i ɲɔɛ ra, n na n ma karafoe sɔti i dɛ kui, n i ragbilen i kelide.»

sentences.english: And this will be the sign to you: you will get your food this year from what comes up of itself, and in the second year from the produce of the same; and in the third year you will put in your seed, and get in the grain, and make vine-gardens, and take of their fruit.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxɛ, «Xesekiya, tɔnxuma nan ya i bɛ: Toofare wo sansi xɔri yolonxi nan donma. Tamuna wo sansi bali nan donma. Kɔnɔ tamuna boore, wo sansie nan donma wo naxee sima wo e xaba, wo wɛni min naxan kelima wɛni bilie ma, wo naxee sima.

sentences.english: And those of Judah who are still living will again take root in the earth, and give fruit.
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛe naxee kisima, nee luma nɛ alɔ wuri bili naxan sanke na bɔxi bun ma, a fa a bogi ramini.

sentences.english: For from Jerusalem those who have been kept safe will go out, and those who are still living will go out of Mount Zion: by the fixed purpose of the Lord of armies this will be done.
sentences.susu: Barima mixi ndee ratangama nɛ faxɛ ma Darisalamu, Siyoni mixi ndee kisima nɛ. Alatala Sɛnbɛma a mafurama nɛ na birin nabade.»

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord says about the king of Assyria, He will not come into this town, or send an arrow against it; he will not come before it with arms, or put up an earthwork against it.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Alatala yi masenyi nan tixi Asiriya mangɛ xa fe ra, «A mu soma yi taa kui, a mu xali yo wolima be, a mu tima wo kanke a xa wure lefa ra, a mu bɛndɛ matema tuganfe ra wo xa tɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: By the way he came he will go back, and he will not get into this town.
sentences.susu: A gbilenma a fa kira nan na, a mu soma yi taa kui! Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: For I will keep this town safe, for my honour, and for the honour of my servant David.
sentences.susu: N yi taa makantama nɛ, n a rakisima nɛ n xili nun n ma konyi Dawuda xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And the angel of the Lord went out and put to death in the army of the Assyrians a hundred and eighty-five thousand men: and when the people got up early in the morning, there was nothing to be seen but dead bodies.
sentences.susu: Na kɔɛ ra Alatala xa malekɛ naxa mini, a sa Asiriyaka wulu kɛmɛ tongo solomasaxan nun suuli faxa. A dɔnxɔɛe to keli gɛɛsɛgɛ, e naxa na furee to e ya ma.

sentences.english: Sennacherib, king of Assyria, went back to his place at Nineveh.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Asiriya mangɛ Senaxeribi naxa gbilen a xɔnyi Ninewe.

sentences.english: And it came about, when he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer put him to death with the sword, and they went in flight into the land of Ararat. And Esar-haddon, his son, became king in his place.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ nde, a to nu na salife a xa ala Nisiri xa banxi kui, Adarameleki nun Sareseri naxa a faxa santidɛgɛma ra, e e gi Ararati bɔxi ma. Esarixadoni naxa ti mangɛ ra a baba Senaxeribi ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: In those days Hezekiah was ill and near death. And Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, came to him, and said to him, The Lord says, Put your house in order; for your death is near.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛe mangɛ Xesekiya naxa fura a ɲaaxi ra. A gbe mu nu luxi a xa faxa. Amosu xa di Annabi Esayi naxa siga a yire, a a fala a bɛ, Alatala yi nan masenxi, «I xa yaamarie fi i xa mixie ma, barima i na faxafe nɛ yi ki, i mu kisima yi fure ma.»

sentences.english: And Hezekiah, turning his face to the wall, made his prayer to the Lord, saying,
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa a yatagi mafindi banxi xalɛ ma, a Alatala maxandi, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: O Lord, keep in mind how I have been true to you with all my heart, and have done what is good in your eyes. And Hezekiah gave way to bitter weeping.
sentences.susu: «Alatala, yandi hinnɛ n na, i a kolon n nan ɲɛrɛxi nɛ kira tinxinxi nan xɔn ma n ma duniɲɛigiri kui n bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra. N mu i matandi, n mu gbilen i waxɔnfe fɔxɔ ra.» Xesekiya naxa wa ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Then the word of the Lord came to Isaiah, saying,
sentences.susu: Annabi Esayi mu nu gɛxi minide mangɛ banxi tɛtɛ kui, Alatala man naxa a masen a bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Go to Hezekiah, and say, The Lord, the God of David, your father, says, Your prayer has come to my ears, and I have seen your weeping: see, I will give you fifteen more years of life.
sentences.susu: «Gbilen i xa sa a fala n ma ɲama yarerati Xesekiya bɛ, i benba Dawuda Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, ‹N bara i xa maxandi mɛ, n bara i yaye to. N i yalanma nɛ, a xi saxan nde. N ɲɛ fu nun suuli sama nɛ i xa simaya xun ma.

sentences.english: And I will keep you and this town safe from the hands of the king of Assyria: and I will keep watch over this town.
sentences.susu: N i tan nun yi taa ratangama nɛ Asiriya mangɛ ma. N yi taa makantama nɛ n ma konyi Dawuda xa fe ra.›»

sentences.english: And Isaiah said, This is the sign the Lord will give you, that he will do what he has said:
sentences.susu: Annabi Esayi naxa a yaabi, «Yi nan findima Alatala xa tɔnxuma ra i bɛ, alako i xa a kolon a Alatala a xa masenyi rakamalima nɛ.

sentences.english: See, I will make the shade which has gone down on the steps of Ahaz with the sun, go back ten steps. So the shade went back the ten steps by which it had gone down.
sentences.susu: Ala naxɛ, ‹N a niyama nɛ soge niini xa gbilen a xanbi xanbi ma dɔxɔ fu Axasi tede ma.›» Na tɛmui, soge niini naxa magbilen a xanbi xanbi ma dɔxɔ fu a goroxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: The writing of Hezekiah, king of Judah, after he had been ill, and had got better from his disease.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Xesekiya xa bɛɛti nan ya, a naxan sɛbɛxi a to yalan a xa fure ma:

sentences.english: I said, In the quiet of my days I am going down into the underworld: the rest of my years are being taken away from me.
sentences.susu: N nu a fala nɛ nu, «A lanma n xa laaxira yi waxati fanyi n ma duniɲɛigiri kui? N ma simaya xa dunke na ki?»

sentences.english: I said, I will not see the Lord, even the Lord in the land of the living: I will not see man again or those living in the world.
sentences.susu: N man nu a fala nɛ nu, «N mu Alatala toma yi duniɲa ma sɔnɔn, n man mu ibunadama yo toma fa naxan sabatixi yi bɛndɛ fuɲi fari.

sentences.english: My resting-place is pulled up and taken away from me like a herdsman's tent: my life is rolled up like a linen-worker's thread; I am cut off from the cloth on the frame: from day even to night you give me up to pain.
sentences.susu: N ma lingira bara tongo n xun, alɔ xuruse kantɛ xa leele italama ki naxɛ. N ma simaya na mafilinfe alɔ mabɔɛ xa gɛsɛ. Mabɔɛ na gɛ gɛsɛ sɔxɔde, a dɔnxɔɛ naxan luxi, a na xaba. Alatala, i tan fan, beenun nunmare xa so, i bara n ma simaya raɲɔn.

sentences.english: I am crying out with pain till the morning; it is as if a lion was crushing all my bones.
sentences.susu: N naxa mamɛ ti han gɛɛsɛgɛ, kɔnɔ i bara n xɔrie igira alɔ yɛtɛ a rabama ki naxɛ. Beenun kɔɛ xa so, i bara dan ti n ma simaya ma.

sentences.english: I make cries like a bird; I give out sounds of grief like a dove: my eyes are looking up with desire; O Lord, I am crushed, take up my cause.
sentences.susu: N nu n xui xurudi raminima nɛ alɔ debelin xɔni, n nu wama nɛ alɔ ganbɛ sunnunxi. N nu n ya rate koore ma, n nu fa a fala, ‹N Marigi n na tɔɔrɔfe, i xa n mali.›»

sentences.english: What am I to say? seeing that it is he who has done it: all my time of sleeping I am turning from side to side without rest.
sentences.susu: «N nɔma na tagi rabade di? A tan yati bara n yaabi, a fa n ma duba suxu. Na kui n fama n ɲɛrɛde yɛtɛ magore nan kui n ma simaya birin na.

sentences.english: O Lord, for this cause I am waiting for you, give rest to my spirit: make me well again, and let me come back to life.
sentences.susu: N Marigi, ibunadama kisima na ki nɛ. N ɲɛngife to na nan ma.» «I tan bara n ma yalanyi ragbilen n ma, n xa kisi.

sentences.english: See, in place of peace my soul had bitter sorrow. but you have kept back my soul from the underworld; for you have put all my sins out of your memory.
sentences.susu: I bara n mali na tɔɔrɛ kui. I xa xanunteya bara n natanga faxɛ ma, i bara n ma yunubie birin woli i kobe ra.

sentences.english: For the underworld is not able to give you praise, death gives you no honour: for those who go down into the underworld there is no hope in your mercy.
sentences.susu: I a kolon a n ma gaburi mu findima matɔxɔɛ ra i bɛ, saya mu i matɔxɔma, faxa mixie fan mu i tantuma bɛɛti ra. Naxee goroma gaburi kui, nee xaxili mu tixi i xa hinnɛ ra sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: The living, the living man, he will give you praise, as I do this day: the father will give the story of your mercy to his children.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲiɲɛ nan i matɔxɔma, alɔ n na i matɔxɔfe ki naxɛ to lɔxɔɛ. Babae masenyi tima e xa die bɛ i xa hinnɛ xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: O Lord, quickly be my saviour; so we will make my songs to corded instruments all the days of our lives in the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara n nakisi. Won xa bɛɛti ba a bɛ kɔrae ra a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui. Won xa lu na raba ra won ma simaya birin na.

sentences.english: And Isaiah said, Let them take a cake of figs, and put it on the diseased place, and he will get well.
sentences.susu: Annabi Esayi nu bara a fala, a e xa fa xɔrɛ bogi yailan, e a fatu mangɛ Xesekiya xa fi ma, alako a xa yalan.

sentences.english: And Hezekiah said, What is the sign that I will go up to the house of the Lord?
sentences.susu: Xesekiya nu bara a yaabi, «Tɔnxuma mundun a niyama n xa a kolon n man nɔma tede Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi?»

sentences.english: At that time Merodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters with an offering to Hezekiah, because he had news that Hezekiah had been ill, and was well again.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Babilɔn mangɛ Merodaki Baladan naxa bataaxɛ nun buɲa rasanba Xesekiya ma, barima a nu bara Xesekiya furafe nun a yalanfe mɛ.

sentences.english: And Hezekiah was glad at their coming, and let them see all his store of wealth, the silver and the gold and the spices and the oil, and all the house of his arms, and everything there was in his stores: there was nothing in all his house or his kingdom which he did not let them see.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa na xɛɛrae rasɛnɛ, a a xa naafuli birin masen e bɛ, alɔ gbeti, xɛɛma, surayi, labundɛ nun ture xiri ɲɔxunmɛ, a xa geresose ragatade nun a xa bannaya birin na dɛnnaxɛ. Sese mu lu, Xesekiya mu naxan masen e bɛ a xa banxi nun a xa bɔxi kui.

sentences.english: Then Isaiah the prophet came to King Hezekiah, and said to him, What did these men say, and where did they come from? And Hezekiah said, They came from a far country, even from Babylon.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Annabi Esayi naxa fa Xesekiya yire, a a maxɔrin, «Na mixie munse falaxi i bɛ? E kelixi minden?» Xesekiya naxa a yaabi, «E kelixi bɔxi makuye nde nɛ, dɛnnaxɛ xili Babilɔn.»

sentences.english: And he said, What have they seen in your house? And Hezekiah said in answer, They saw everything in my house: there is nothing among my stores which I did not let them see.
sentences.susu: Esayi man naxa a maxɔrin, «E munse matoxi i xa banxi kui?» Xesekiya naxa a yaabi, «Se naxan birin na n ma banxi kui. Sese mu luxi n xɔnyi n mu naxan masenxi e bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Give ear to the word of the Lord of armies:
sentences.susu: Na kui, Annabi Esayi naxa a fala Xesekiya bɛ, «I tuli mati Alatala xa masenyi ra,

sentences.english: Truly, the days are coming when everything in your house, and whatever your fathers have put in store till this day, will be taken away to Babylon: all will be gone.
sentences.susu: ‹Lɔxɔɛ na fafe, yi mixie fama nɛ i harige birin xaninde Babilɔn, i benbae naxan luxi i yi ra. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And your sons, even your offspring, will they take away to be unsexed servants in the house of the king of Babylon.
sentences.susu: E fama nɛ i xa die suxude, i naxee barixi, e e bana Babilɔn mangɛ bɛ.›»

sentences.english: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of the Lord which you have said. And he said in his heart, There will be peace and quiet in my days.
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa a fala Esayi bɛ, «Alatala xa masenyi i naxan tixi, a fan.» A na fala nɛ barima a naxɛ, «Bɔɲɛsa nun kantari tan luma nɛ be, n ma simaya birin kui.»

sentences.english: Give comfort, give comfort, to my people, says your God.
sentences.susu: Ala xa masenyi nan ya: «Wo xa n ma ɲama madundu e xa tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: Say kind words to the heart of Jerusalem, crying out to her that her time of trouble is ended, that her punishment is complete; that she has been rewarded by the Lord's hand twice over for all her sins.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a fala Darisalamu bɛ a a xa ɲaxankatɛ bara ɲɔn, a xa yunubie sare bara gɛ fide, a Alatala bara na ragbilen a ma han dɔxɔ firin.»

sentences.english: A voice of one crying, Make ready in the waste land the way of the Lord, make level in the lowland a highway for our God.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde na a xui raminife gbengberen yire a falafe ra, «Wo xa kira yailan Alatala bɛ, wo sankira matinxin wo Marigi ya ra.

sentences.english: Let every valley be lifted up, and every mountain and hill be made low, and let the rough places become level, and the hilltops become a valley,
sentences.susu: Gulunba xa ite, geya xa igoro, kira ɲaaxi xa yailan a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And the glory of the Lord will be made clear, and all flesh will see it together, for the mouth of the Lord has said it.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa nɔrɛ makɛnɛnma nɛ daali birin ya xɔri.» Alatala xa masenyi yati nan na ki.

sentences.english: A voice of one saying, Give a cry! And I said, What is my cry to be? All flesh is grass, and all its strength like the flower of the field.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde bara a fala n bɛ, «I xui rate.» N bara a yaabi, «N xa munse fala?» A naxɛ, «Adama xa nɔrɛ luxi nɛ alɔ sansie.

sentences.english: The grass becomes dry, the flower is dead; because the breath of the Lord goes over it: truly the people is grass.
sentences.susu: E lisima nɛ, Alatala xa foye e fuge kana. Adamadie maniyaxi sansie nan na.

sentences.english: The grass is dry, the flower is dead; but the word of our God is eternal.
sentences.susu: Sansie xarama nɛ, e fuge kana, kɔnɔ Alatala tan xa masenyi mu kanama abadan.»

sentences.english: You who give good news to Zion, get up into the high mountain; you who give good news to Jerusalem, let your voice be strong; let it be sounding without fear; say to the towns of Judah, See, your God!
sentences.susu: Siyoni, i xa te geya itexi nde fari. Darisalamu, i xa i xui ite sɛnbɛ ra limaniya kui. A fala Yudaya taae bɛ, «Wo Marigi Ala na be.»

sentences.english: See, the Lord God will come as a strong one, ruling in power: see, those made free by him are with him, and those whom he has made safe go before him.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala na fafe sɛnbɛ ra, nɔɛ xanxi a bɛlɛxɛ i. Xunnakeli na a bɛ.

sentences.english: He will give food to his flock like a keeper of sheep; with his arm he will get it together, and will take up the lambs on his breast, gently guiding those which are with young.
sentences.susu: A mɛɛnima nɛ a xa xurusee ma, a a xa yɛxɛ yɔrɛe tongoma nɛ, a e sa a kanke ma, a e ngae ragbɛngbɛn.

sentences.english: In the hollow of whose hand have the waters been measured? and who is able to take the heavens in his stretched-out fingers? who has got together the dust of the earth in a measure? who has taken the weight of the mountains, or put the hills into the scales?
sentences.susu: Nde baa ye maniyaxi a bɛlɛxɛ kui? Nde koore walaxɛ maniyaxi? Nde duniɲa bɛndɛ maniyaxi? Nde geyae dɔxɔxi sikeeli ra?

sentences.english: By whom has the spirit of the Lord been guided, or who has been his teacher?
sentences.susu: Nde Alatala Xaxili kolon? Nde nɔma marasi fide a ma?

sentences.english: Who gave him suggestions, and made clear to him the right way? who gave him knowledge, guiding him in the way of wisdom?
sentences.susu: Nde a yamarima? Nde a matinkanma? Nde fe kolonyi masenma a bɛ? Nde a masenma a bɛ se yailanma ki naxɛ?

sentences.english: See, the nations are to him like a drop hanging from a bucket, and like the small dust in the scales: he takes up the islands like small dust.
sentences.susu: Ɲamanɛe luxi nɛ a bɛ alɔ se xunxurie. A e rakelima nɛ a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And Lebanon is not enough to make a fire with, or all its cattle enough for a burned offering.
sentences.susu: Liban sube birin nalanxi mu sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi lima naxan daxa a bɛ, Liban fɔtɔnyi belebele mu yege lima a xa sɛrɛxɛ ganfe ra.

sentences.english: All the nations are as nothing before him; even less than nothing, a thing of no value.
sentences.susu: Sese mu ɲamanɛe ra a ya i, e findixi a bɛ fe fufafu nan na.

sentences.english: Whom then is God like, in your opinion? or what will you put forward as a comparison with him?
sentences.susu: Wo wama Ala maniyafe nde ra? Wo a misaalima munse ra?

sentences.english: The workman makes an image, and the gold-worker puts gold plates over it, and makes silver bands for it.
sentences.susu: Yirawali kuye nan masolima, xabui xɛɛma radin a ma, a fa gbeti yɔlɔnxɔnyie yailan a kuye gbakuma naxan na.

sentences.english: The wise workman makes selection of the mulberry-tree of the offering, a wood which will not become soft; so that the image may be fixed to it and not be moved.
sentences.susu: Setaree wuri nde nan fenma naxan mu kanama mafuren mafuren, a mixi fen naxan fata a masolide alako a naxa bira.

sentences.english: Have you no knowledge of it? has it not come to your ears? has not news of it been given to you from the first? has it not been clear to you from the time when the earth was placed on its base?
sentences.susu: Wo mu a kolon? Wo mu na fe mɛxi kabi tɛmui xɔnkuye? Wo mu na fahaamuxi kabi duniɲa daa tɛmui?

sentences.english: It is he who is seated over the arch of the earth, and the people in it are as small as locusts; by him the heavens are stretched out like an arch, and made ready like a tent for a living-place.
sentences.susu: A tan nan sabatixi duniɲa birin xun ma. Duniɲa mixie luxi nɛ a bɛ alɔ katoee. A tan koore walaxɛ italaxi nɛ alɔ dugi naxan sama leele ma.

sentences.english: He makes rulers come to nothing; the judges of the earth are of no value.
sentences.susu: A tan nan mangɛe xun nakanama, a mixi xungbee xa fe magoro.

sentences.english: They have only now been planted, and their seed put into the earth, and they have only now taken root, when he sends out his breath over them and they become dry, and the storm-wind takes them away like dry grass.
sentences.susu: E luxi nɛ alɔ sansi naxan si to, kɔnɔ beenu e xa mɔ, a fa wuyenyi radin e ma naxan e xarama gben. Na tɛmui foye xungbe e xaninma nɛ alɔ sɛxɛ xare.

sentences.english: Who then seems to you to be my equal? says the Holy One.
sentences.susu: Ala Sɛniyɛntɔɛ xa masenyi nan ya: «Wo n tan Ala maniyama nde ra? N misaalixi nde bɛ?

sentences.english: Let your eyes be lifted up on high, and see: who has made these? He who sends out their numbered army: who has knowledge of all their names: by whose great strength, because he is strong in power, all of them are in their places.
sentences.susu: Wo wo yae rakeli koore ma. Nde na se yanbaxie daaxi? Ala nan e yamarima, a e xilie kolon. A sɛnbɛ xa saabui ra, sese mu luxi e ma.»

sentences.english: Why do you say, O Jacob, such words as these, O Israel, The Lord's eyes are not on my way, and my God gives no attention to my cause?
sentences.susu: «Na kui, wo tan n ma ɲama, naxan fatanxi Yaxuba ra, naxan findixi Isirayila ra, munfe ra wo a falama, ‹Alatala mu fe toxi naxan dɔxɔxi muxu ma. Muxu Marigi Alatala mu wama muxu gbe ɲɔxɔfe.›

sentences.english: Have you no knowledge of it? has it not come to your ears? The eternal God, the Lord, the Maker of the ends of the earth, is never feeble or tired; there is no searching out of his wisdom.
sentences.susu: Wo mu a kolon? Wo mu na fe mɛxi? Alatala findixi Ala nan na kabi abadan, a duniɲa yati nan daaxi a fɔlɛ ra. A mu taganma, danyi mu na a xaxili ma.

sentences.english: He gives power to the feeble, increasing the strength of him who has no force.
sentences.susu: A sɛnbɛ fima nɛ mixi taganxi ma, a limaniya fi sɛnbɛtaree ma.

sentences.english: Even the young men will become feeble and tired, and the best of them will come to the end of his strength;
sentences.susu: Hali dimɛdie e taganma, sɛgɛtalae birama,

sentences.english: But those who are waiting for the Lord will have new strength; they will get wings like eagles: running, they will not be tired, and walking, they will have no weariness.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ naxee e xaxili tima Alatala ra, nee sɛnbɛ nɛɛnɛ sɔtɔma nɛ, e fa tugan alɔ sɛgɛe. E e ɲɛrɛ, e e gi, e mu taganma fefe ma.»

sentences.english: Come quietly before me, O sea-lands, and let the peoples get together their strength: let them come near; then let them say what they have to say: let us put forward our cause against one another.
sentences.susu: «Ɲamanɛe, wo wo sabari. Si yensenxie, wo limaniya, wo xa wo maso n ma kiiti yire ra.»

sentences.english: Who sent out from the east one who is right wherever he goes? he gives the nations into his hands, and makes him ruler over kings; he gives them as the dust to his sword, as dry stems before the wind to his bow.
sentences.susu: «Nde mixi tixi kira xɔn ma keli sogetede, wo xa kiiti sama naxan xili ra? Nde ɲamanɛe saxi a sagoe, a mangɛe xa fe igoro a bɛ? A xa santidɛgɛma e xun nakanama nɛ, a xa xali e rayensen yɛ.

sentences.english: He goes after them safely, not touching the road with his feet.
sentences.susu: A e kerima nɛ sɛnbɛ ra, a man siga yire gbɛtɛ na rabade.

sentences.english: Whose purpose and work was it? His who sent out the generations from the start. I the Lord, the first, and with the last, I am he.
sentences.susu: Nde na fee ragirixi a xa yaamari ra kabi duniɲa fɔlɛ? N tan Alatala, naxan na fe fɔlɛ nun fe raɲɔnyi ra, n tan bara na mɔɔli birin nagiri.»

sentences.english: The sea-lands saw it, and were in fear; the ends of the earth were shaking: they came near.
sentences.susu: «Ɲamanɛe gaaxuma nɛ na birin ya ra, sie sɛrɛn gaaxui ra duniɲa birin.

sentences.english: They gave help everyone to his neighbour; and everyone said to his brother, Take heart!
sentences.susu: E limaniya fima e bore ma, a falafe ra, ‹Wo wo sɛnbɛ so!›

sentences.english: So the metal-worker put heart into the gold-worker, and he who was hammering the metal smooth said kind words to the iron-worker, saying of the plate, It is ready: and he put it together with nails, so that there might be no slipping.
sentences.susu: Yirawalie e bore malima alako xɛɛma xa sa kuye ma. E naxɛ, ‹A fan na ki nɛ.› E kuye banbanma lantumae ra alako a naxa fa bira.»

sentences.english: But as for you, Israel, my servant, and you, Jacob, whom I have taken for myself, the seed of Abraham my friend:
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ wo tan Isirayila findixi n ma konyi nan na. N wo tan Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ nan sugandixi, naxan fatanxi n xanuntenyi Iburahima bɔnsɔɛ.

sentences.english: You whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and sent for from its farthest parts, saying to you, You are my servant, whom I have taken for myself, and whom I have not given up:
sentences.susu: N wo tongoxi duniɲa tunxunyie nan na, a falafe ra, ‹N ma konyi sugandixie nan wo ra, n mu mɛma naxee ra.›

sentences.english: Have no fear, for I am with you; do not be looking about in trouble, for I am your God; I will give you strength, yes, I will be your helper; yes, my true right hand will be your support.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa gaaxu, barima n na wo fɔxɔ ra. Wo naxa kɔntɔfili, barima n tan nan na wo Marigi Ala ra. N sɛnbɛ fima wo ma n bɛlɛxɛ tinxinxi nan na.»

sentences.english: Truly, all those who are angry with you will be made low and put to shame: those desiring to do you wrong will come to nothing and never again be seen.
sentences.susu: «Naxee birin wo maberefe, e fama yaagi nan tun sɔtɔde. Naxee wo fenfe gere ra, e halakima nɛ, e ɲɔn.

sentences.english: You will make search for your haters but they will not be there; those who make war against you will be as nothing and will come to destruction.
sentences.susu: Wo na wo yaxuie fen, wo mu fama e tode, barima e lɔɛma nɛ. Naxee wo fenma gere ra, nee ɲɔnma nɛ.

sentences.english: For I, the Lord your God, have taken your right hand in mine, saying to you, Have no fear; I will be your helper.
sentences.susu: Na rabama nɛ barima n tan nan na wo Marigi Alatala ra, naxan wo bɛlɛxɛ rasuxu, a a fala, ‹Wo naxa gaaxu, n fafe wo malide.›

sentences.english: Have no fear, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel; I will be your helper, says the Lord, even he who takes up your cause, the Holy One of Israel.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ, wo naxa gaaxu. Isirayila, wo wo sɛnbɛ so. Hali wo findixi mixi xunxurie nan na alɔ kuli di, n tan naxan lanxi wo Rakisima ma, naxan findixi wo xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ ra, n tan yɛtɛ yati fama nɛ wo malide. N xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: See, I will make you like a new grain-crushing instrument with teeth, crushing the mountains small, and making the hills like dry stems.
sentences.susu: «N a niyama nɛ wo xa sɛnbɛ magaaxuxi sɔtɔ wo yaxuie ya ra. Wo luma nɛ alɔ wure wali se naxan geyae rabɔɔma, a e findi xube ra.

sentences.english: You will send the wind over them, and it will take them away; they will go in all directions before the storm-wind: you will have joy in the Lord, and be glad in the Holy One of Israel.
sentences.susu: Wo yaxuie rayensenma nɛ alɔ xɛ sa naxee maale bɔnbɔ, foye fa maale lagi xanin. Wo sɛɛwama nɛ Alatala ra, wo Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ tantuma nɛ.»

sentences.english: The poor and crushed are looking for water where no water is, and their tongue is dry for need of it: I the Lord will give ear to their prayer, I the God of Israel will not give them up.
sentences.susu: «Misikiinɛe nun setaree ye fenma, kɔnɔ e mu a toma. E nɛnyi xarama ye xɔli ra. Kɔnɔ n tan Alatala, n e xa maxandi tongoma nɛ. N tan Isirayila Marigi Ala, n mu nɛɛmuma e ma.

sentences.english: I will make rivers on the dry mountain-tops, and fountains in the valleys: I will make the waste land a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
sentences.susu: N xuree rabɔɔma nɛ geya maxaraxie ma, n dulonyi raminima ma gulunbae kui. N gbengberenyi mafindima nɛ ye yire ra.

sentences.english: I will put in the waste land the cedar, the acacia, the myrtle, and the olive-tree; and in the lowland will be planted the fir-tree, the plane, and the cypress together:
sentences.susu: N sɛdiri, kasiya, miriti, nun oliwi wuri bilie sima nɛ gbengberenyi ma. N sipirɛ, orimi, nun buyisi sansi bilie si wula i,

sentences.english: So that they may see and be wise and give their mind to it, and that it may be clear to them all that the hand of the Lord has done this, and that the Holy One of Israel has made it.
sentences.susu: alako ɲama xa na to, e fa fahaamui sɔtɔ, a na birin findixi Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ Alatala sɛnbɛ wali nan na.»

sentences.english: Put forward your cause, says the Lord; let your strong argument come out, says the King of Jacob.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxɛ, «Wo fa, wo wo xa marakɔrɔsi masen n bɛ. Wo xa na birin tagi raba a fanyi ra Yaxuba Marigi bɛ.

sentences.english: Let the future be made clear to us: give us news of the past things, so that we may give thought to them; or of the things to come, so that we may see if they are true.
sentences.susu: Wo xa fa wo xa kuyee ra alako e xa a fala muxu bɛ fe naxee fama rabade. Fe naxee singe rabaxi, e xa e raba ki fala muxu bɛ, alako muxu xa xaxili sɔtɔ na kui. E xa a fala muxu bɛ fe naxan fama rabade,

sentences.english: Give us word of what will be after this, so that we may be certain that you are gods: yes, do good or do evil, so that we may all see it and be surprised.
sentences.susu: alako muxu xa a kolon a e findixi alae nan na. E xa fe nde raba, a na findi fefe yo ra, naxan nɔma muxu dɛ ixarade, muxu xa gaaxu e ya ra.

sentences.english: But you are nothing, and your work is of no value: foolish is he who takes you for his gods.
sentences.susu: Wo tan kuyee, ‹Wo mu nɔma na sese ra, wo tide yo mu na. Mixi naxan wo batuma, na mixi findixi mixi xɔnxi nan na.›»

sentences.english: I have sent for one from the north, and from the dawn he has come; in my name he will get rulers together and go against them; they will be like dust, even as the wet earth is stamped on by the feet of the potter.
sentences.susu: «N bara mixi nde rakeli kɔɔla mabiri, a fama n xili ra kelife sogetede mabiri. A mangɛe iboronma nɛ alɔ fɛɲɛ rafalɛ bɛndɛ iboronma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Who has given knowledge of it from the first, so that we may be certain of it? and from the start, so that we may say, His word is true? There is no one who gives news, or says anything, or who gives ear to your words.
sentences.susu: Nde na fe masenxi kabi a fɔlɛ, alako muxu xa na kolon beenun a xa raba? Nde na falaxi, alako muxu xa a kolon nɔndi falɛ nan a ra? Kuye yo mu na fe masen. Kuye yo mu na xibaarui fi. Kuye yo mu e xui ite.

sentences.english: I was the first to give word of it to Zion, and I gave the good news to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: N tan nan na singe masen Siyoni bɛ, ‹Yi nan fama rabade.› N tan xɛɛra nan xɛɛ Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And I saw that there was no man, even no wise man among them, who might give an answer to my questions.
sentences.susu: N naxan toma yi kuyee tagi, keren mu na naxan nɔma masenyi nde tide, naxan nɔma n ma maxɔrinyie yaabide.

sentences.english: Truly they are all nothing, their works are nothing and of no value: their metal images are of no more use than wind.
sentences.susu: Wo xa e mato: Kuye fufafu nan e ra! E wali fɔxi yo mu na! Sese mu na yi kuyee ra!»

sentences.english: See my servant, whom I am supporting, my loved one, in whom I take delight: I have put my spirit on him; he will give the knowledge of the true God to the nations.
sentences.susu: N ma Konyi Sugandixi nan yi ki, n ɲɔxɔ saxi naxan xɔn ma, n naxan xanuma n nii birin na. N bara n Xaxili ragoro a ma. A tinxinyi masenma nɛ ɲamanɛe bɛ,

sentences.english: He will make no cry, his voice will not be loud: his words will not come to men's ears in the streets.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ a mu xaaɲɛma e ma, a mu sɔnxɔɛ ratema e ma, a mu a yɛtɛ igboma.

sentences.english: He will not let a crushed stem be quite broken, and he will not let a feebly burning light be put out: he will go on sending out the true word to the peoples.
sentences.susu: A mu kale kuntinxi igirama, a mu lanpui dɛxɛ xuri raxubenma. A kiiti sama a sɛriyɛ ki nan ma.

sentences.english: His light will not be put out, and he will not be crushed, till he has given the knowledge of the true God to the earth, and the sea-lands will be waiting for his teaching.
sentences.susu: A mu dagalanma, a mu birama, han a gɛ tinxinyi rasabatide duniɲa ma. Ɲamanɛe xaxili tima a xa yaamari tinxinxi nan na.

sentences.english: God the Lord, even he who made the heavens, measuring them out on high; stretching out the earth, and giving its produce; he who gives breath to the people on it, and life to those who go about on it, says:
sentences.susu: Alatala Nɔndi Kanyi xa masenyi nan ya, Ala naxan koore daa, a a walaxɛ itala, naxan bɔxi daa, a nun se birin naxan toma naa, naxan ɲɛngi fixi duniɲa mixie ma, alako e xa duniɲa igiri.

sentences.english: I the Lord have made you the vessel of my purpose, I have taken you by the hand, and kept you safe, and I have given you to be an agreement to the people, and a light to the nations:
sentences.susu: «N tan Alatala nan na, naxan i xɛɛxi, naxan i makantaxi, naxan a niya i xa findi saatɛ saabui ra ibunadama bɛ, naxan a niya i xa findi naiyalanyi ra ɲamanɛe bɛ,

sentences.english: To give eyes to the blind, to make free the prisoners from the prison, to let out those who are shut up in the dark.
sentences.susu: alako i xa dɔnxuie ya rabɔɔ, i xa geelimanie ramini geeli, i xa mixie xɔrɛya naxee na dimi kui.»

sentences.english: I am the Lord; that is my name: I will not give my glory to another, or my praise to pictured images.
sentences.susu: «Alatala nan n na, n xili nan na ki. N mu wama n firin nde xɔn, n mu tinma n ma matɔxɔɛ xa fi kuyee ma.

sentences.english: See, the things said before have come about, and now I give word of new things: before they come I give you news of them.
sentences.susu: N ma masenyi singee bara rakamali, n man fe nɛɛnɛ masenma nɛ wo bɛ naxan fama rakamalide. N nee xa fe rakolon wo ra beenu e xa raba.»

sentences.english: Make a new song to the Lord, and let his praise be sounded from the end of the earth; you who go down to the sea, and everything in it, the sea-lands and their people.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa bɛɛti nɛɛnɛ ba Alatala bɛ, wo a matɔxɔ sa keli duniɲa baanyi ra, wo tan naxee biyaasima baa xun ma, wo tan naxee baloma baa kui, wo tan naxee sabatixi ɲamanɛe kui.

sentences.english: Let the waste land and its flocks be glad, the tent-circles of Kedar; let the people of the rock give a glad cry, from the top of the mountains let them make a sound of joy.
sentences.susu: Gbengberenyi nun taae xa e xui ite, Kedarikae sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ. Selakae xa e sɛɛwɛ xui ite geyae fari.

sentences.english: Let them give glory to the Lord, sounding his praise in the sea-lands.
sentences.susu: E xa Alatala matɔxɔ alɔ a lan a xa matɔxɔ ki naxɛ. Ɲamanɛ birin xa a matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: The Lord will go out as a man of war, he will be moved to wrath like a fighting-man: his voice will be strong, he will give a loud cry; he will go against his attackers like a man of war.
sentences.susu: Alatala minima nɛ alɔ ɲalama, a bɔɲɛ te gere xa fe ra, a gereso xui ramini sɛnbɛ ra.»

sentences.english: I have long been quiet, I have kept myself in and done nothing: now I will make sounds of pain like a woman in childbirth, breathing hard and quickly.
sentences.susu: «Kabi a rakuya n sabarixi, n dunduxi, n nan n yɛtɛ suxuxi. Kɔnɔ yakɔsi n nan n xui raminima alɔ ginɛ naxan di barife.

sentences.english: I will make waste mountains and hills, drying up all their plants; and I will make rivers dry, and pools dry land.
sentences.susu: N sansie ralisima nɛ geyae fari, geya findi gbengberenyi ra. N xuree mafindima nɛ xare ra, n ye yiree xɔri.

sentences.english: And I will take the blind by a way of which they had no knowledge, guiding them by roads strange to them: I will make the dark places light before them, and the rough places level. These things will I do and will not give them up.
sentences.susu: N dɔnxuie raɲɛrɛma nɛ kira nde ra, e mu naxan kolon, n dimi findi e bɛ naiyalanyi ra, n bɔxi magexi findi bɔxi saxi ra e ɲɛrɛma dɛnnaxɛ. N na nan yati rabama e bɛ, n mu e rabɛɲinma.

sentences.english: They will be turned back and be greatly shamed who put their hope in pictured images, who say to metal images, You are our gods.
sentences.susu: Naxee e xaxili tixi kuyee ra, e gbilenma nɛ yaagi kui. Na kuyee yailanxi wure raxunuxi nan tun na, kɔnɔ na mixie a falama e bɛ, ‹Wo findixi won ma alae nan na.›»

sentences.english: Give ear, you whose ears are shut; and let your eyes be open, you blind, so that you may see.
sentences.susu: «Tulixɔrie, wo wo tuli mati. Dɔnxuie, wo wo ya ti n na.

sentences.english: Who is blind, but my servant? who has his ears stopped, but he whom I send? who is blind as my true one, or who has his ears shut like the Lord's servant?
sentences.susu: Nde dɔnxuxi, xa n ma konyi xa mu a ra? Nde tuli xɔrixi, xa n n ma xɛɛra xa mu a ra? Nde dɔnxuxi, xa n ma konyi bɔɲɛ saxi xa mu a ra?

sentences.english: Seeing much, but keeping nothing in mind; his ears are open, but there is no hearing.
sentences.susu: Wo bara fe gbegbe to, kɔnɔ wo mu wo ɲɔxɔ saxi e xɔn ma. E bara e tuli mati, kɔnɔ e mu fefe fahaamuxi.

sentences.english: It was the Lord's pleasure, because of his righteousness, to make the teaching great and give it honour.
sentences.susu: Tinxinyi to rafan Alatala ma, a bara wa a xa sɛriyɛ binyafe, ɲama xa a kolon.

sentences.english: But this is a people whose property has been taken away from them by force; they are all taken in holes, and shut up in prisons: they are made prisoners, and no one makes them free; they are taken by force and no one says, Give them back.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yi ɲama xun bara rakana, e suxuxi yili nun geeli nan kui. E yaxuie bara e xanin, mixi yo mu na naxan e rakisima, mixi yo mu na naxan maxandi tima e bɛ e xa gbilen.»

sentences.english: Who is there among you who will give ear to this? who will give attention to it for the time to come?
sentences.susu: Nde a tuli matima na fee ra wo ya ma? Nde a ɲɔxɔ sama na fee xɔn ma tɛmui naxan sa fama?

sentences.english: Who gave up Jacob to those who took away his goods, and Israel to his attackers? Did not the Lord? he against whom they did wrong, and in whose ways they would not go, turning away from his teaching.
sentences.susu: Nde Yaxuba soxi muɲɛti yi ra? Nde Isirayila soxi kasaratie yi ra? Alatala xa mu a ra, won yunubi rabaxi naxan na? E mu waxi ɲɛrɛfe a xa kira xa xɔn ma, e man mu e tuli matixi a xa sɛriyɛ xa ra.

sentences.english: For this reason he let loose on him the heat of his wrath, and his strength was like a flame; and it put fire round about him, but he did not see it; he was burned, but did not take it to heart.
sentences.susu: Na kui a naxa a xa xɔnɛ dusu Isirayila xun na, a niya gere xa e xun nakana. Na tɛ bara dɛxɛ e rabilinyi, kɔnɔ e mu e ɲɔxɔ saxi na xɔn ma.
