sentences.english: But now, says the Lord your Maker, O Jacob, and your life-giver, O Israel: have no fear, for I have taken up your cause; naming you by your name, I have made you mine.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, naxan Yaxuba daaxi, naxan Isirayila yailanxi bɛndɛ ra: «Hali wo mu gaaxu, barima n bara wo xun sara, n bara wo xili wo xili ra, barima n gbe nan wo ra.

sentences.english: When you go through the waters, I will be with you; and through the rivers, they will not go over you: when you go through the fire, you will not be burned; and the flame will have no power over you.
sentences.susu: Wo na baa igiri, won birin nan a ra. Wo na xure igiri, a mu wo xaninma. Wo na dangi tɛ xɔɔra, a mu wo ganma, a mu wo tɔɔrɔma,

sentences.english: For I am the Lord your God, the Holy One of Israel, your saviour; I have given Egypt as a price for you, Ethiopia and Seba for you.
sentences.susu: barima n tan Alatala nan na wo Marigi Ala ra, Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ, wo Rakisima. N Misira nan fixi i xunsare ra, n Etiyopi nun Seba fixi wo ɲɔxɔɛ nan na.

sentences.english: Because of your value in my eyes, you have been honoured, and loved by me; so I will give men for you, and peoples for your life.
sentences.susu: Wo tide to gbo n bɛ n ma xanunteya xa fe ra, n mixie nan bama wo ɲɔxɔɛ ra, n ɲama fi wo nii rakisife ra.

sentences.english: Have no fear, for I am with you: I will take your seed from the east, and get you together from the west;
sentences.susu: Wo naxa gaaxu, n na wo fɔxɔ ra. N fama nɛ wo bɔnsɔɛ ra, kelife sogetede nun sogegorode mabiri,

sentences.english: I will say to the north, Give them up; and to the south, Do not keep them back; send back my sons from far, and my daughters from the end of the earth;
sentences.susu: n fama wo xilide kelife yirefanyi nun kɔɔla ma. ‹Wo fa n ma die ra, kelife yire makuye,

sentences.english: Every one who is named by my name, and whom I have made for my glory, who has been formed and designed by me.
sentences.susu: e birin naxee xilixi n xili ra, n naxan daaxi n ma nɔrɛ xa fe ra.›

sentences.english: Send out the blind people who have eyes, and those who have ears, but they are shut.
sentences.susu: Ɲamae xa fa naxee ya na kɔnɔ e mu se toma, e tuli na kɔnɔ e mu fe mɛma.

sentences.english: Let all the nations come together, and let the peoples be present: who among them is able to make this clear, and give us word of earlier things? let their witnesses come forward, so that they may be seen to be true, and that they may give ear, and say, It is true.
sentences.susu: Ɲamae nun sie xa e malan. Nde na e ya ma naxan nu bara yi fe masen won bɛ beenu a xa raba? E xa seedee ramini, naxee nɔma a fe rafiixɛde, alako booree xa a kolon a nɔndi na a ra.»

sentences.english: You are my witnesses, says the Lord, and my servant whom I have taken for myself: so that you may see and have faith in me, and that it may be clear to you that I am he; before me there was no God formed, and there will not be after me.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Wo tan nan na n ma seedee ra, n ma konyi sugandixi, alako wo xa n kolon, wo xa la n na. Ala yo mu nu na n ya ra, Ala yo mu fama n xanbi ra.

sentences.english: I, even I, am the Lord; and there is no saviour but me.
sentences.susu: N tan keren nan na Alatala ra. Mixi rakisima yo mu na bafe n tan na.

sentences.english: I gave the word, and made it clear, and there was no strange god among you: for this reason you are my witnesses, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N tan nan nɔndi masenxi, n tan nan wo rakisixi, n tan nan fe nɛɛnɛ masenma wo bɛ. Ala xɔɲɛ nde xa mu n na wo tagi. Wo tan nan na n ma seedee ra a n keren nan na Ala ra.

sentences.english: From time long past I am God, and from this day I am he: there is no one who is able to take you out of my hand: when I undertake a thing, by whom will my purpose be changed?
sentences.susu: Kabi fɔlɔ fɔlɛ n tan nan Ala ra. Mixi yo mu nɔma mixi bade n bɛlɛxɛ, mixi yo mu nɔma n ma fe rabaxi masarade.»

sentences.english: The Lord, who has taken up your cause, the Holy One of Israel, says, Because of you I have sent to Babylon, and made all their seers come south, and the Chaldaeans whose cry is in the ships.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, Ala naxan wo xun sara, Ala naxan findixi Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ ra. A naxɛ, «N yaamari fima nɛ Babilɔn geelimanie xa fa e xa kunkuie kui, e nu laxi naxee ra.

sentences.english: I am the Lord, your Holy One, the Maker of Israel, your King.
sentences.susu: Alatala na n tan nan na, wo xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ, naxan Isirayila daa, naxan findixi wo xa mangɛ ra.»

sentences.english: This is the word of the Lord, who makes a way in the sea, and a road through the deep waters;
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, Ala naxan kira bɔɔ baa tagi, naxan dangide ramini mɔrɔnyie xɔɔra,

sentences.english: Who sends out the war-carriages and the horses, the army with all its force; they have come down, they will not get up again; like a feebly burning light they are put out.
sentences.susu: naxan a niya sɔɔri ragi see nun soe ragie xa kata dangide mɛnni, e fa lu baa xɔɔra abadan, e mu te. Na sɔɔri gali xubenxi nɛ alɔ lanpui xubenma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Give no thought to the things which are past; let the early times go out of your minds.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa wo maɲɔxun fe singee ma, wo fe forie lu na.

sentences.english: See, I am doing a new thing; now it is starting; will you not take note of it? I will even make a way in the waste land, and rivers in the dry country.
sentences.susu: Wo mu a toxi, n na fe nɛɛnɛe rabafe? Wo mu gɛxi na kolonde? N na kira nde bɔɔfe gbengberenyi ma, n na xuree raminife yire maxaraxi ma.

sentences.english: The beasts of the field will give me honour, the jackals and the ostriches: because I send out waters in the waste land, and rivers in the dry country, to give drink to the people whom I have taken for myself:
sentences.susu: Burunyi daalise n matɔxɔma, alɔ wulai bare nun xundi, barima n ye raminima gbengberenyi ma, n xure xungbee rabɔɔ yire maxaraxi ma, alako n ma ɲama sugandixi xa ye min,

sentences.english: Even the people whom I made to be the witnesses of my praise.
sentences.susu: alako n ɲama naxan daaxi a xa n matɔxɔ.»

sentences.english: But you have made no prayer to me, O Jacob: and you have given no thought to me, O Israel.
sentences.susu: «Yaxuba, wo mu maxandi tima n xili ra. Isirayila, wo mu fefe rabafe birafe ra n fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: You have not made me burned offerings of sheep, or given me honour with your offerings of beasts; I did not make you servants to give me an offering, and I did not make you tired with requests for perfumes.
sentences.susu: Wo mu tin yɛxɛɛe bade sɛrɛxɛ ra n bɛ, wo mu tin n binyade sɛrɛxɛe ra. N mu kote dɔxɔxi wo xun ma sansi sɛrɛxɛ ra, n mu wo karaxan surayi ganfe ra.

sentences.english: You have not got me sweet-smelling plants with your money, or given me pleasure with the fat of your offerings: but you have made me a servant to your sins, and you have made me tired with your evil doings.
sentences.susu: Wo mu labundɛ fanyi sara n bɛ, wo mu ninge ture gbegbe ba sɛrɛxɛ ra. Wo naxan nabaxi, wo bara n natagan wo xa yunubie ra, wo bara n naxɔnɔ wo xa ɲaaxuɲa ra.»

sentences.english: I, even I, am he who takes away your sins; and I will no longer keep your evil doings in mind.
sentences.susu: «N tan nan a ra, naxan i xa yunubie xafarima n xili xa fe ra, n fa nɛɛmu i xa yunubie ma feo.

sentences.english: Put me in mind of this; let us take up the cause between us: put forward your cause, so that you may be seen to be in the right.
sentences.susu: I xa i xa fe dangixi masen n bɛ, won xa a mato kiiti na ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Your first father was a sinner, and your guides have gone against my word.
sentences.susu: I benba singe yunubi raba nɛ. I xa yarerati muruta nɛ n xili ma.

sentences.english: Your chiefs have made my holy place unclean, so I have made Jacob a curse, and Israel a thing of shame.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, n fama i xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe rayaagide, naxee walima n ma hɔrɔmɔlingira kui. N a niyama nɛ Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ xun xa rakana, Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ xa yaagi.»

sentences.english: And now, give ear, O Jacob my servant, and Israel whom I have taken for myself:
sentences.susu: «N ma konyi Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ, wo xa wo tuli mati, n ma ɲama sugandixi Isirayila, wo xa n xui ramɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord who made you, forming you in your mother's body, the Lord, your helper, says, Have no fear, O Jacob my servant, and you, Jeshurun, whom I have taken for myself.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, naxan wo daaxi wo nga tɛɛgɛ i, naxan wo bun tima. N ma konyi Yaxuba, hali i mu hanmɛ, wo tan Yesurun n naxan sugandixi,

sentences.english: For I will send water on the land needing it, and streams on the dry earth: I will let my spirit come down on your seed, and my blessing on your offspring.
sentences.susu: barima n ye ragoroma nɛ wo xa bɔxi maxaraxi ma, n xure raminima nɛ gbengberen yire ma. N nan n Xaxili ragoroma nɛ wo bɔnsɔɛ ma, n barakɛ sama nɛ wo xa die ma.

sentences.english: And they will come up like grass in a well-watered field, like water-plants by the streams.
sentences.susu: E fanma nɛ alɔ ɲooge naxan toma fiili tagi, alɔ wuri naxee sixi xure dɛ i.

sentences.english: One will say, I am the Lord's; and another will give himself the name, Jacob; another will put a mark on his hand, I am the Lord's, and another will take the name of Israel for himself.
sentences.susu: Nde a falama nɛ, ‹Alatala gbe nan n na,› a Yaxuba xili sa a xun ma. Nde a sɛbɛma nɛ a bɛlɛxɛ ma, ‹Alatala gbe,› a Isirayila xili sa a xun ma.»

sentences.english: The Lord, the King of Israel, even the Lord of armies who has taken up his cause, says, I am the first and the last, and there is no God but me.
sentences.susu: «Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, Alatala Sɛnbɛma naxan findixi Isirayila mangɛ nun a rakisima ra. N tan nan na fe fɔlɛ ra, n tan nan na fe raɲɔnyi ra. Ala gbɛtɛ yo mu na bafe n tan na.

sentences.english: If there is one like me, let him come forward and say it, let him make it clear and put it in order before me: who has made clear in the past the things to come? let him make clear the future to me.
sentences.susu: Nde maniyaxi n tan na? A xa na fala. Na kanyi xa wɔyɛn ba, a xa fe dangixi masen kabi n ma ɲama daa tɛmui. A xa fe masen naxan fama rabade, iyo a xa na fala kɛnɛ ma.

sentences.english: Have no fear, be strong in heart; have I not made it clear to you in the past, and let you see it? and you are my witnesses. Is there any God but me, or a Rock of whom I have no knowledge?
sentences.susu: Wo naxa gaaxu, wo naxa sɛrɛn. N mu na masenxi wo bɛ xɛ, beenu na fee xa raba? N ma seedee nan wo ra. Ala gbɛtɛ na na, ba n tan na? Ade, fanye gbɛtɛ mu na hali keren.»

sentences.english: Those who make a pictured image are all of them as nothing, and the things of their desire will be of no profit to them: and their servants see not, and have no knowledge; so they will be put to shame.
sentences.susu: Fuyantee nan kuye yailanmae ra. E xa wali tide yo mu na. E xa seedee ya mu na, e xaxili ifuxi. E fama lude na yaagi nan kui.

sentences.english: Whoever makes a god, makes nothing but a metal image in which there is no profit.
sentences.susu: Nde kuye yailanma, naxan mu nɔma a malide fefe ra?

sentences.english: Truly, all those who make use of secret arts will be put to shame, and their words of power are only words of men: let them all come forward together; they will all be in fear and be put to shame.
sentences.susu: Na kanyie yaagima nɛ. Adamadi nan tun na e ra. E birin xa e malan, e xa ti n ya ra. N e birin nagoroma nɛ gaaxui nun ɲaxankatɛ ra.

sentences.english: The iron-worker is heating the metal in the fire, giving it form with his hammers, and working on it with his strong arm: then for need of food his strength gives way, and for need of water he becomes feeble.
sentences.susu: Kuye yailanma wure xabuma tɛ xɔɔra, a kuyee yailan dɛrɛma ra, a a rawali a yɛtɛ sɛnbɛ ra. Kaamɛ nun ye xɔli luma nɛ a suxu ra, a fa tagan.

sentences.english: The woodworker is measuring out the wood with his line, marking it out with his pencil: after smoothing it with his plane, and making circles on it with his instrument, he gives it the form and glory of a man, so that it may be placed in the house.
sentences.susu: Kamudɛri luuti italama nɛ a maniyafe ra, a a kɔɔrin. A wali fɔlɔ wali see ra, a a yailan han a lu alɔ mixi tofanyi naxan tima a xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: He has cedars cut down for himself, he takes an oak and lets it get strong among the trees of the wood; he has an ash-tree planted, and the rain gives it growth.
sentences.susu: A nu wuri ndee si fɔtɔnyi yire, a mamɛ ti han tunɛ ye a ramɔ, a fa a sɛgɛ.

sentences.english: Then it will be used to make a fire, so that a man may get warm; he has the oven heated with it and makes bread: he makes a god with it, to which he gives worship: he makes a pictured image out of it, and goes down on his face before it.
sentences.susu: A nde findi yege ra, alako xinbeli naxa a suxu, a nde rawali taami ganfe ra. Kɔnɔ naxan luxi, a na findi ala ra a naxan batuma, a kuye rafala, a suyidi a bɛ.

sentences.english: With part of it he makes a fire, and on the fire he gets meat cooked and takes a full meal: he makes himself warm, and says, Aha! I am warm, I have seen the fire:
sentences.susu: A sɛɛti findi yege ra, a sube ganma naxan na, a fa a dɛge, a a fala, «Yi tɛ fan. Xinbeli mu n suxuma be.»

sentences.english: And the rest of it he makes into a god, even his pictured image: he goes down on his face before it, giving worship to it, and making prayer to it, saying, Be my saviour; for you are my god.
sentences.susu: A wuri dɔnxɔɛ nan findima a xa kuye ala ra, a suyidi naxan bɛ a batufe ra. A maxandi ti a bɛ, a falafe ra, «N nakisi, barima i tan nan n ma ala ra.»

sentences.english: They have no knowledge or wisdom; for he has put a veil over their eyes, so that they may not see; and on their hearts, so that they may not give attention.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na mixi mu gɛxi fahaamui sɔtɔde. A luxi alɔ dɔnxui naxan mu se toma, a xaxili mu fata fee tagi rabade.

sentences.english: And no one takes note, no one has enough knowledge or wisdom to say, I have put part of it in the fire, and made bread on it; I have had a meal of the flesh cooked with it: and am I now to make the rest of it into a false god? am I to go down on my face before a bit of wood?
sentences.susu: Sese mu a a bɔɲɛ ratima sɔnɔn, a xa a maɲɔxun, «N bara wuri sɛɛti sa tɛ i, alako n xa taami nun sube gan a tɛ wole ra n naxan donma. A lanma n xa na wuri dɔnxɔɛ rafala kuye ra Ala naxan xɔnma? N xa n suyidi wuri xuntunyi bɛ?»

sentences.english: As for him whose food is the dust of a dead fire, he has been turned from the way by a twisted mind, so that he is unable to keep himself safe by saying, What I have here in my hand is false.
sentences.susu: Na kuye yailanma birama se nan fɔxɔ ra naxan findima tɛ xube ra. A bɔɲɛ bara a yɛtɛ yanfa. A mu fata a yɛtɛ rakiside, a man mu xaxili sɔtɔ a falafe ra, «N naxan tixi n bɛlɛxɛ ra wule ala nan a ra.»

sentences.english: Keep these things in mind, O Jacob; and you Israel, for you are my servant: I have made you; you are my servant; O Israel, I will not let you go out of my memory.
sentences.susu: «Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ, wo xa ratu yi fee ma, wo tan Isirayila ɲama naxan findixi n ma konyi ra. N wo daa nɛ, alako wo xa findi n ma konyi ra. Isirayila, n mu nɛɛmuma wo ma.

sentences.english: I have put your evil doings out of my mind like a thick cloud, and your sins like a mist: come back to me; for I have taken up your cause.
sentences.susu: N bara wo xa yunubie xafari, wo naxan sɔtɔ wo xa murutɛ kui, n bara nee ba naa alɔ nuxui bama koore ma ki naxɛ. Wo xa gbilen n ma, barima n bara wo xun sara.»

sentences.english: Make a song, O heavens, for the Lord has done it: give a loud cry, you deep parts of the earth: let your voices be loud in song, you mountains, and you woods with all your trees: for the Lord has taken up the cause of Jacob, and will let his glory be seen in Israel.
sentences.susu: Koore xa sɛɛwa Alatala xa wali xa fe ra. Bɔxi bunyi xa a xui ramini. Geyae xa e xui ite alɔ wuri naxee na fɔtɔnyi kui, barima Alatala bara Yaxuba xun sara, a bara a nɔrɛ masen Isirayila ya ma.

sentences.english: The Lord, who has taken up your cause, and who gave you life in your mother's body, says, I am the Lord who makes all things; stretching out the heavens by myself, and giving the earth its limits; who was with me?
sentences.susu: Wo Rakisima Alatala xa masenyi nan ya naxan wo rafalaxi wo nga tɛɛgɛ, «N tan, Alatala nan n na, naxan fe birin daaxi, naxan koore itala, naxan bɔxi rafala a bɛlɛxɛ ra,

sentences.english: Who makes the signs of those who give word of the future come to nothing, so that those who have knowledge of secret arts go off their heads; turning the wise men back, and making their knowledge foolish:
sentences.susu: naxan namiɲɔnmɛ wule falɛe xa tɔnxumae kana, naxan sematoe rayaagi, naxan lɔnnilae xa marasi mafindi lɔnnitareɲa ra,

sentences.english: Who makes the word of his servants certain, and gives effect to the purposes of his representatives; who says of Jerusalem, Her people will come back to her; and of the towns of Judah, I will give orders for their building, and will make her waste places fertile again:
sentences.susu: naxan a xa namiɲɔnmɛ konyie xa masenyie rakamali, naxan a xa xɛɛrae xui findi nɔndi ra, naxan a masenma Darisalamu xa fe ra, ‹Ɲama fama sabatide naa,› naxan a masenma Yudaya taae xa fe ra, ‹E man fama nɛ tide,›

sentences.english: Who says to the deep, Be dry, and I will make your rivers dry:
sentences.susu: naxan a falama baa bɛ, ‹Xara, n i xa ye raxɔrima nɛ,›

sentences.english: Who says of Cyrus, He will take care of my sheep, and will do all my pleasure: who says of Jerusalem, I will give the word for your building; and of the Temple, Your bases will be put in place.
sentences.susu: naxan mangɛ Sirusi xɛɛma a sago rabade, alɔ xuruse madonyi a rabama ki naxɛ, naxan a masenma Darisalamu xa fe ra, ‹A man xa ti,› naxan a masenma hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa fe ra, ‹A man xa ti!›»

sentences.english: The Lord says to the man of his selection, to Cyrus, whom I have taken by the right hand, putting down nations before him, and taking away the arms of kings; making the doors open before him, so that the ways into the towns may not be shut;
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya a xa mixi sugandixi Sirusi bɛ, a naxan xɛɛxi ɲamanɛe xun nakanafe ra, e xa lu a xa yaamari bun ma, a naadɛ rabixi naxan bɛ alako a xa wali xa sɔɔnɛya.

sentences.english: I will go before you, and make the rough places level: the doors of brass will be broken, and the iron rods cut in two:
sentences.susu: «N tima nɛ i ya ra, n tentenyi magoro i bɛ, n wure gbeeli naadɛe kana, n wure naadɛe yensen yɛ i ya ra.

sentences.english: And I will give you the stores of the dark, and the wealth of secret places, so that you may be certain that I am the Lord, who gave you your name, even the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: N naafuli nɔxunxi fima nɛ i ma, alako i xa a kolon n tan nan Isirayila Marigi Alatala ra, naxan i xilixi i xili yati ra.

sentences.english: Because of Jacob my servant, and Israel whom I have taken for myself, I have sent for you by name, giving you a name of honour, though you had no knowledge of me.
sentences.susu: N ma konyi Yaxuba xa fe ra, n ma ɲama sugandixi Isirayila, n i xilixi i xili nan na, n binyɛ fima nɛ i ma hali i to mu n kolonxi sinden.

sentences.english: I am the Lord, and there is no other; there is no God but me: I will make you ready for war, though you had no knowledge of me:
sentences.susu: N tan nan na Alatala ra, Ala gbɛtɛ yo mu na bafe n tan na. N sɛnbɛ fima nɛ i ma hali i to mu n kolonxi sinden.

sentences.english: So that they may see from the east and from the west that there is no God but me: I am the Lord, and there is no other.
sentences.susu: Na kui mixi birin fama nɛ a kolonde a Ala kerenyi nan n na, kelife sogetede han sogegorode, Ala gbɛtɛ yo mu na.

sentences.english: I am the giver of light and the maker of the dark; causing blessing, and sending troubles; I am the Lord, who does all these things.
sentences.susu: N tan nan koore iyalanma, n dimi rasin, n tan nan hɛri raminima, n gbaloe raba. N tan Alatala na n na fee birin nabama.»

sentences.english: Let righteousness come down, O heavens, from on high, and let the sky send it down like rain: let the earth be open to give the fruit of salvation, causing righteousness to come up with it; I the Lord have made it come about.
sentences.susu: «Tunɛ ye xa goro kelife koore ma, nuxui xa rabi ye raminife ra. Bɔxi fan xa rabi na ye sɔtɔfe ra. Kisi xa sɔtɔ alɔ sansi bulama ki naxɛ, tinxinyi xa lu na. N tan Alatala nan na birin daaxi.»

sentences.english: Cursed is he who has an argument with his Maker, the pot which has an argument with the Potter! Will the wet earth say to him who is working with it, What are you doing, that your work has nothing by which it may be gripped?
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na mixi bɛ, naxan a yailanma matandima, naxan findixi fɛɲɛ xuntunyi tun na. Bɛndɛ doloxi a falama fɛɲɛ yailanma bɛ, «I n yailanfe munse ra? I xa wali mu fan!»

sentences.english: Cursed is he who says to a father, To what are you giving life? or to a woman, What are you in birth-pains with?
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na mixi bɛ, naxan a falama a baba nun a nga bɛ, «Wo munse barixi?»

sentences.english: The Lord, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, says, Will you put a question to me about the things which are to come, or will you give me orders about my sons, and the work of my hands?
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ naxan wo daaxi, «Wo wama n maxɔrinfe tina fe nan ma n naxan nabama n ma die ra? Wo wama n yamarife n ma wali xa fe nan na?

sentences.english: I have made the earth, forming man on it: by my hands the heavens have been stretched out, and all the stars put in their ordered places.
sentences.susu: N tan nan bɔxi yailanxi, n fa mixi daa a fari. N tan nan koore itala n bɛlɛxɛ ra, n tunbuie yamari.

sentences.english: I have sent him out to overcome the nations, and I will make all his ways straight: I will give him the work of building my town, and he will let my prisoners go free, without price or reward, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: N tan nan man Sirusi xɛɛma n ma tinxinyi xa fe ra. N kira rabɔɔma nɛ a bɛ alako a xa n ma taa ti, a xa n ma ɲama xɔrɔya xunsare xanbi.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: The Lord says, The workmen of Egypt, and the traders of Ethiopia, and the tall Sabaeans, will come over the sea to you, and they will be yours; they will go after you; in chains they will come over: and they will go down on their faces before you, and will make prayer to you, saying, Truly, God is among you; and there is no other God.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Misira nun Etiyopi xa naafuli luma nɛ i yi ra, Sebakae findima nɛ i xa konyie ra, e bira i fɔxɔ ra yɔlɔnxɔnyi kui, e suyidi i bɛ, e a fala i bɛ, ‹Ala na i fɔxɔ ra, a maniyɛ mu na, Ala gbɛtɛ mu na.›»

sentences.english: Truly, you have a secret God, the God of Israel is a Saviour!
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Ala, a Rakisima, Ala nan i ra, naxan mu a yɛtɛ masenma kɛnɛ ma.

sentences.english: All those who have gone against him will be put to shame; the makers of images will be made low.
sentences.susu: Kuye yailanmae fama nɛ lude yaagi kui, e e birin xanin,

sentences.english: But the Lord will make Israel free with an eternal salvation: you will not be put to shame or made low for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Alatala Isirayila tan rakisima nɛ abadan, a mu fama yaagide feo.

sentences.english: For this is the word of the Lord who made the heavens; he is God; the maker and designer of the earth; who made it not to be a waste, but as a living-place for man: I am the Lord, and there is no other.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxan koore daaxi, naxan firin nde mu na, naxan duniɲa daaxi a ki nun a kɛɲa nan ma, a fa adamadie rasabati a ma, a fa a fala, «Alatala nan na, Ala gbɛtɛ yo mu na.

sentences.english: I have not given my word in secret, in a place in the underworld; I did not say to the seed of Jacob, Go into a waste land to make request of me: I the Lord say what is true, my word is righteousness.
sentences.susu: N mu wɔyɛnxi dunxui xa ra de. N mu a fala Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ bɛ e xa n fen na ki tun. N tan Alatala nɔndi nan falama, n tinxinyi nan masenma.»

sentences.english: Come together, even come near, you nations who are still living: they have no knowledge who take up their image of wood, and make prayer to a god in whom is no salvation.
sentences.susu: «Wo wo malan, wo fa, wo wo maso, wo tan mixi gixie kelife ɲamanɛe ma, Kuye batuie mu sese kolon, e kuye maxandima naxee mu nɔma mixi rakiside.

sentences.english: Give the word, put forward your cause, let us have a discussion together: who has given news of this in the past? who made it clear in early times? did not I, the Lord? and there is no God but me; a true God and a saviour; there is no other.
sentences.susu: Wo wo xui ramini, wo xa marakolonyi ti e bɛ. E xa e bore rasi. Nde yi masenyi tixi kabi tɛmui xɔnkuye? N tan xa mu a ra? Ala gbɛtɛ yo mu na bafe n tan na, Ala naxan tinxin, naxan mixi rakisima.

sentences.english: Let your hearts be turned to me, so that you may have salvation, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is no other.
sentences.susu: Wo xa gbilen n ma, wo tan naxee kelima duniɲa tunxunyie ma, alako wo xa kisi sɔtɔ, barima Ala gbɛtɛ yo mu na bafe n tan na.

sentences.english: By myself have I taken an oath, a true word has gone from my mouth, and will not be changed, that to me every knee will be bent, and every tongue will give honour.
sentences.susu: N bara n kali n yɛtɛ ra nɔndi ki ma, n ma masenyi mu kanama fefe ma. Xinbi birin sinma nɛ n bun ma, kali birin nabama n tan nan xili ra.

sentences.english: Only in the Lord will Jacob overcome and be strong: together all those who were angry with him will be put to shame and come to destruction.
sentences.susu: Ɲama a falama nɛ n bɛ, ‹Tinxinyi nun sɛnbɛ toma i tan Alatala nan gbansan yi.›» Mixi naxee nu murutaxi a ma, e fama nɛ a yire yaagi kui.

sentences.english: In the Lord will all the seed of Israel get their rights, and they will give glory to him.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ gbe ɲɔxɔma nɛ Alatala saabui ra, e fa xunnakeli sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Bel is bent down, Nebo is falling; their images are on the beasts and on the cattle: the things which you took about have become a weight to the tired beast.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn xa kuye Beli a xinbi sinma. A xa kuye Nebo fan a felenma bɔxi ma. Sofalee e bɛndunma xanin se fari. Na kote binya, a sofalee rataganma nɛ.

sentences.english: They are bent down, they are falling together: they were not able to keep their images safe, but they themselves have been taken prisoner.
sentences.susu: E mu nɔ na kuyee ratangade. E birin xa siga konyiya kui.

sentences.english: Give ear to me, O family of Jacob, and all the rest of the people of Israel, who have been supported by me from their birth, and have been my care from their earliest days:
sentences.susu: «Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ, wo wo tuli mati n na. Isirayilaka naxee luxi, wo wo tuli mati n na. Kabi wo barixi tɛmui naxɛ, n bara wo xanin n bɛlɛxɛ, n bara wo bun ti.

sentences.english: Even when you are old I will be the same, and when you are grey-haired I will take care of you: I will still be responsible for what I made; yes, I will take you and keep you safe.
sentences.susu: N nu na raba nɛ han wo fori waxati. Wo xunsɛxɛ to nu fiixɛma, n tan nan man nu wo bun tima. N to wo daa, n man nu wo malima nɛ, n wo xanin, n wo rakisi.

sentences.english: Who in your eyes is my equal? or what comparison will you make with me?
sentences.susu: Wo n ma maniyɛ toma minden? Wo n firin nde kolon?

sentences.english: As for those who take gold out of a bag, and put silver in the scales, they give payment to a gold-worker, to make it into a god; they go down on their faces and give it worship.
sentences.susu: Naafuli kanyi xɛɛma nun gbeti raminima, a a sa sikeeli fari, alako xabui xa kuye nde yailan a bɛ, a a xinbi sinma naxan bɛ a batufe ra.

sentences.english: They put him on their backs, and take him up, and put him in his fixed place, from which he may not be moved; if a man gives a cry for help to him, he is unable to give an answer, or get him out of his trouble.
sentences.susu: E na tongo, e a dɔxɔ e tunki fari, e a xanin yire, e a tima dɛnnaxɛ. Mɛnni a tixi tun, a mu sigama dɛdɛ. Hali mixi nde a mawa a bɛ, a mu a yaabima, a mu mixi ratangama a xa tɔɔrɛ ma.»

sentences.english: Keep this in mind and be shamed; let it come back to your memory, you sinners.
sentences.susu: «Wo tan murutɛlae, wo xa ratu na fee ma, alako wo xa nɔ kiside.

sentences.english: Let the things which are past come to your memory: for I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is no one like me;
sentences.susu: Wo xa ratu n naxan nabaxi tɛmui dangixi. Ala gbɛtɛ yo mu na bafe n tan na, n firin nde mu na.

sentences.english: Making clear from the first what is to come, and from past times the things which have not so far come about; saying, My purpose is fixed, and I will do all my pleasure;
sentences.susu: Ala gbɛtɛ mu na naxan fe masenma beenun a xa raba, naxan nɔma a falade, ‹N waxɔnfe fama nɛ rakamalide. N tan nan a ragirima.›

sentences.english: Sending for a bird of strong flight from the east, the man of my purpose from a far country; I have said it, and I will give effect to it; the thing designed by me will certainly be done.
sentences.susu: N tan nan xɔni nde xilima kelife sogetede mabiri, naxan n waxɔnfe rabama n bɛ. Iyo, n naxan falaxi, n a rabama nɛ, n naxan natɛxi, n a rakamalima nɛ.

sentences.english: Give ear to me, you feeble-hearted, who have no faith in my righteousness:
sentences.susu: Wo wo tuli mati n na, wo tan naxee xaxili xɔrɔxɔ, wo tan naxee makuyaxi tinxinyi ra.

sentences.english: My righteousness is near, it is not far off; salvation will come quickly; and I will make Zion free, and give Israel my glory.
sentences.susu: N ma kiiti tinxinxi bara makɔrɛ, a mu makuya feo. N fama n ma kisi fan na, a mu buma. N Siyon rakisima nɛ, N nan n ma nɔrɛ ragoroma nɛ Isirayila ma.»

sentences.english: Come and take your seat in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon; come down from your seat of power, and take your place on the earth, O daughter of the Chaldaeans: for you will never again seem soft and delicate.
sentences.susu: «Babilɔn taa, keli i xa kibanyi kui, i dɔxɔ bɔxi ma. I xa tofanyi nun i xa bannaya bama nɛ i yi.

sentences.english: Take the crushing-stones and get the meal crushed: take off your veil, put away your robe, let your legs be uncovered, go through the rivers.
sentences.susu: Wali see tongo kuri sofe ra. I xa mafelenyi bama nɛ i ma, i xa dugi mate, i xure igiri i mageli ra.

sentences.english: The shame of your unclothed condition will be seen by all: I will give punishment without mercy,
sentences.susu: I ɲaibɔma nɛ yaagi kui, n fama nɛ n gbe ɲɔxɔde kinikini xanbi.»

sentences.english: Says the Lord who takes up our cause; the Lord of armies is his name, the Holy One of Israel.
sentences.susu: Alatala Sɛnbɛma nan findi muxu xunsarama ra, Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ.

sentences.english: Be seated in the dark without a word, O daughter of the Chaldaeans: for you will no longer be named, The Queen of Kingdoms.
sentences.susu: «Babilɔn ɲama, wo dɔxɔ, wo wo dɛ balan. Wo xa mangɛya bara ɲɔn.

sentences.english: I was angry with my people, I put shame on my heritage, and gave them into your hands: you had no mercy on them; you put a cruel yoke on those who were old;
sentences.susu: N nu xɔnɔxi n ma ɲama ma, n fa e kɛ tongomae xun nakana. N naxa e lu wo sagoe, kɔnɔ wo mu kinikini e ma fefe ma. Hali forie, wo bara e ɲaxankata a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: And you said, I will be a queen for ever: you did not give attention to these things, and did not keep in mind what would come after.
sentences.susu: Wo nu a falama nɛ, ‹N ma mangɛya mu ɲɔnma abadan!› Kɔnɔ wo mu wo ɲɔxɔ saxi fe xɔn ma naxan nɔma wo lide.»

sentences.english: So now take note of this, you who are given up to pleasure, living without fear of evil, saying in your heart, I am, and there is no one like me; I will never be a widow, or have my children taken from me.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi wo wo tuli mati n na, wo tan banna naxee a maɲɔxunxi a fefe mu nɔma wo tɔɔrɔde, naxee a falama, ‹N keren nan tide gbo duniɲa, n mu findima kaaɲɛ ra, n ma die mu bama n yi.›

sentences.english: But these two things will come on you suddenly in one day, the loss of children and of husband: in full measure they will come on you, for all your secret arts, and all your wonders.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n xa a fala wo bɛ, na fe firinyie wo lima nɛ fɛɛɲɛn keren kui. Wo ganma nɛ wo xa die ra, wo findi kaaɲɛ ra hali wo duureya nun karamɔxɔ wali rawuya.

sentences.english: For you had faith in your evil-doing; you said, No one sees me; by your wisdom and knowledge you have been turned out of the way: and you have said in your heart, I am, and there is no other.
sentences.susu: Wo nu laxi wo xa ɲaaxuɲa nan na, wo ɲɔxɔ a ma na mu toma. Wo xa fe kolonyi bara wo madaxu. Wo bara a fala wo bɔɲɛ ma, ‹N keren nan be, n tan nan gbansan tide gbo.›

sentences.english: Because of this evil will come on you, which may not be turned away for any price: and trouble will overtake you, from which no money will give salvation: destruction will come on you suddenly, without your knowledge.
sentences.susu: Gbaloe fama nɛ wo lide, wo mu nɔma wo yɛtɛ ratangade naxan ma wo xa naafuli ra, gbaloe naxan wo tɛrɛnnama.»

sentences.english: Go on now with your secret arts, and all your wonder-working, to which you have given yourself up from your earliest days; it may be that they will be of profit to you, or by them you may put fear into your attackers.
sentences.susu: «Wo to laxi na fe mɔɔli nan na, wo xa lu wo xa duureya, nun wo xa manduruya kui wo darixi naxan na. Wo a maɲɔxun a na sɔɔnɛyama nɛ wo bɛ, wo fa geeni wo yaxui xun ma,

sentences.english: But your mind is troubled by the number of your guides: let them now come forward for your salvation: the measurers of the heavens, the watchers of the stars, and those who are able to say from month to month what things are coming on you.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ na birin fama nɛ wo ratagande. Wo xa se matoe xili, naxee koore matoma, e fe fala naxan fama wo lide.

sentences.english: Truly, they have become like dry stems, they have been burned in the fire; they are not able to keep themselves safe from the power of the flame: it is not a coal for warming them, or a fire by which a man may be seated.
sentences.susu: Nee tan fan luma nɛ alɔ sɛxɛ naxan ganma tɛ ra. E mu nɔma e yɛtɛ rakiside tɛ xɔɔra. Sese mu luma e yi ra, hali tɛ xunxuri e dɔxɔma naxan sɛɛti ma xinbeli tɛmui.

sentences.english: Small profit have you had from those who, from your earliest days, got great profit out of you; they have gone in flight, every one straight before him, and you have no saviour.
sentences.susu: E mu nɔma fefe rabade wo bɛ, hali wo to bara wo xaxili ti e ra kabi wo dimɛdi tɛmui. E sigama nɛ yare e xa kira ɲaaxi xɔn ma. Mixi yo mu nɔma wo rakiside.»

sentences.english: Give ear to this, O family of Jacob, you who are named by the name of Israel, and have come out of the body of Judah; who take oaths by the name of the Lord, and make use of the name of the God of Israel, but not truly and not in good faith.
sentences.susu: «Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ naxan xili Isirayila, naxan fatanxi Yudaya ra, wo wo tuli mati n na. Wo tan naxee wo kalima Alatala xili ra, wo tan naxee Isirayila Marigi Ala maxandima tinxintareya kui,

sentences.english: For they say that they are of the holy town, and put their faith in the God of Israel: the Lord of armies is his name.
sentences.susu: wo tan naxee wo yɛtɛ xilima Taa Sɛniyɛnxi Kanyie, wo tan naxee wo xaxili tima Isirayila Marigi Alatala ra,

sentences.english: I gave word in the past of the things which came about; they came from my mouth, and I made them clear: suddenly I did them, and they came about.
sentences.susu: n naxan masenxi wo bɛ tɛmui dangixi, n bara gɛ na ragiride.

sentences.english: Because I saw that your heart was hard, and that your neck was an iron cord, and your brow brass;
sentences.susu: N to a kolon wo xaxili xɔrɔxɔ alɔ wure,

sentences.english: For this reason I made it clear to you in the past, before it came I gave you word of it: for fear that you might say, My god did these things, and my pictured and metal images made them come about.
sentences.susu: n naxa wo rakolon na fe ra beenun a xa raba, alako wo naxa fa a fala, ‹Muxu xa kuye wuri daaxie nun wure daaxie nan na fe natɛxi.›

sentences.english: All this has come to your ears and you have seen it; will you not give witness to it? I am now making clear new things, even secret things, of which you had no knowledge.
sentences.susu: Wo bara na mɛ? Wo bara so na fe kui?» «Yakɔsi n fe nɛɛnɛe masenma nɛ wo bɛ, naxee nu bara nɔxun wo ma.

sentences.english: They have only now been effected, and not in the past: and before this day they had not come to your ears; for fear that you might say, I had knowledge of them.
sentences.susu: Nee minixi yi waxati nɛ, wo mu nu naxee kolon. Na kui wo mu nɔma a falade, ‹Iyo, muxu nu nee kolon.›

sentences.english: Truly you had no word of them, no knowledge of them; no news of them in the past had come to your ears; because I saw how false was your behaviour, and that your heart was turned against me from your earliest days.
sentences.susu: Wo mu na fee fahaamuxi tɛmui dangixi barima wo tuli xɔrɔxɔ. Yanfantee nan wo ra kabi wo bari tɛmui.

sentences.english: Because of my name I will put away my wrath, and for my praise I will keep myself from cutting you off.
sentences.susu: N xili xa fe ra, n mu n ma xɔnɛ ramini wo ma kerenyi ra. N ma matɔxɔɛ xa fe ra, n mu wo rabolo.

sentences.english: See, I have been testing you for myself like silver; I have put you through the fire of trouble.
sentences.susu: N bara wo mato, kɔnɔ n mu a rabaxi alɔ xabui a rabama ki naxɛ gbeti ra. N wo matoma tɔɔrɛ nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: For myself, even because of my name, I will do it; for I will not let my name be shamed; and my glory I will not give to another.
sentences.susu: N yi rabama n yɛtɛ bɛ alako n xili naxa kana, alako n ma matɔxɔɛ naxa fi n firin nde ma.»

sentences.english: Give ear to me, Jacob, and Israel, my loved one; I am he, I am the first and I am the last.
sentences.susu: «Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ, wo wo tuli mati n na. Isirayila n naxan xilixi, wo wo tuli mati n na. N tan nan na a singe ra, n tan nan na a dɔnxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Yes, by my hand was the earth placed on its base, and by my right hand the heavens were stretched out; at my word they take up their places.
sentences.susu: N bɛlɛxɛ nan duniɲa bunyi saxi, n sɛnbɛ nan koore italaxi. N na e xili, e tima nɛ keren na.»

sentences.english: Come together, all of you, and give ear; who among you has given news of these things? the Lord's loved one will do his pleasure with Babylon, and with the seed of the Chaldaeans.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa wo malan, wo xa wo tuli mati n na. Kuye mundun bara yi fe masen wo bɛ beenun a xa raba? Alatala bara mixi nde sugandi naxan a sagoe rabama Babilɔn na, naxan e xili xun nakanama.

sentences.english: I, even I, have given the word; I have sent for him: I have made him come, and have given effect to his undertakings.
sentences.susu: Iyo, n tan yati bara n ma masenyi ti, n bara a xili, a xa na wali rakamali.»

sentences.english: Come near to me, and give ear to this; from the start I did not keep it secret; from the time of its coming into existence I was there: and now the Lord God has sent me, and given me his spirit.
sentences.susu: «Wo wo maso n na, wo xa wo tuli mati. Kabi a fɔlɛ, n mu wɔyɛn dunxui ra. Na fe rabama n ya xɔri.» Yakɔsi, n Marigi Alatala na n xɛɛfe, a a Xaxili ragoroxi n ma.

sentences.english: The Lord who takes up your cause, the Holy One of Israel, says, I am the Lord your God, who is teaching you for your profit, guiding you by the way in which you are to go.
sentences.susu: Wo Rakisima Alatala, Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ, a xa masenyi nan ya, «N tan findixi wo Marigi Alatala nan na, naxan wo xa fe sɔɔnɛya ki masenma, naxan wo raɲɛrɛma ɲɛrɛ ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: If only you had given ear to my orders, then your peace would have been like a river, and your righteousness as the waves of the sea:
sentences.susu: Xa wo wo ɲɔxɔ sa n ma sɛriyɛ xɔn ma nu, bɔɲɛsa nun kisi nu gboma nɛ wo yi ra alɔ ye naxan na baa ma.

sentences.english: Your seed would have been like the sand, and your offspring like the dust: your name would not be cut off or come to an end before me.
sentences.susu: Wo bɔnsɔɛ nu wuyama nɛ alɔ mɛyɛnyi naxan na baa dɛ ra, wo xa die xilie mu nu bama n ya i.

sentences.english: Go out of Babylon, go in flight from the Chaldaeans; with the sound of song make it clear, give the news, let the word go out even to the end of the earth: say, The Lord has taken up the cause of his servant Jacob.
sentences.susu: Wo xa keli Babilɔn sɛɛwɛ xui ra. Wo xa na masen duniɲa birin bɛ. Wo xa a fala, ‹Alatala bara a konyi Yaxuba xun sara.›

sentences.english: They had no need of water when he was guiding them through the waste lands: he made water come out of the rock for them: the rock was parted and the waters came flowing out.
sentences.susu: Ye xɔli mu luma e ma gbengberenyi ma, a fanye ibɔɔma, a ye ramini a kui.

sentences.english: There is no peace, says the Lord, for the evil-doers.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxi xa fe mu sɔɔnɛyama.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Give ear, O sea-lands, to me; and take note, you peoples from far: I have been marked out by the Lord from the first; when I was still in my mother's body, he had my name in mind:
sentences.susu: Si yensenxie, wo xa wo tuli mati n na. Yire makuyee, wo xa wo ɲɔxɔ sa n wɔyɛn xui xɔn ma. Alatala n xili nɛ kabi n nga tɛgɛ, a naxa n xili fala beenun n xa mini foye ra.

sentences.english: And he has made my mouth like a sharp sword, in the shade of his hand he has kept me; and he has made me like a polished arrow, keeping me in his secret place;
sentences.susu: A naxa n dɛ lu alɔ santidɛgɛma xɛɲɛnxi a bɛlɛxɛ, a naxa n findi xali ɲɔɛ rameluxi ra, a naxa n sa a xa xali gbɔnfɔɛ kui.

sentences.english: And he said to me, You are my servant, Israel, in whom my glory will be seen;
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala n bɛ, «Isirayila, n ma konyi nan i ra, n na n ma nɔrɛ masenma naxan saabui ra.»

sentences.english: And I said, I have undergone weariness for nothing, I have given my strength for no purpose or profit: but still the Lord will take up my cause, and my God will give me my reward.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n naxa a yaabi, «N ma wali mu sɔɔnɛyaxi, n bara kata, kɔnɔ fufafu na a ra. N ma wali sare na n Marigi Alatala nan yi.»

sentences.english: And now, says the Lord, who made me his servant when I was still in my mother's body, so that I might make Jacob come back to him, and so that Israel might come together to him: and I was honoured in the eyes of the Lord, and my God became my strength.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala naxa masenyi nde ti, naxan n daa n nga tɛgɛ i, n xa findi a xa konyi ra, alako n xa Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ ragbilen a ma, Isirayila ɲama man xa malan a fɛ ma. Alatala bara binyɛ xungbe fi n ma, a tan naxan findixi n sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: It is not enough for one who is my servant to put the tribes of Jacob again in their place, and to get back those of Israel who have been sent away: my purpose is to give you as a light to the nations, so that you may be my salvation to the end of the earth.
sentences.susu: A naxɛ, «Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ Isirayila ragbilenfe n ma, wali na a ra naxan xurun i bɛ n ma konyi. N man i findima nɛ naiyalanyi ra si gbɛtɛe bɛ, alako n ma kisi xa masen duniɲa yire birin.»

sentences.english: The Lord who takes up Israel's cause, even his Holy One, says to him whom men make sport of, who is hated by the nations, a servant of rulers: Kings will see and get up from their places, and chiefs will give worship: because of the Lord who keeps faith; even the Holy One of Israel who has taken you for himself.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, Alatala naxan findixi Isirayila Xunsarama ra, Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ, won bɔnsɔɛ naxan xɔnxi, naxan walixi mangɛe bɛ, «Mangɛe na wo to, e tima nɛ, kuntigie na wo to, e e xinbi sinma nɛ wo bun ma, barima dugutɛgɛ Alatala naxan Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ ra, na nan wo sugandixi.»

sentences.english: This is the word of the Lord: I have given ear to you at a good time, and I have been your helper in a day of salvation: and I will keep you safe, and will make you a glory for the people, putting the land in order, and giving them the heritages which now are waste;
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «N wo yaabima yaabi tɛmui nɛ, n wo rakisima kisi lɔxɔɛ nɛ. N wo makantama nɛ, n wo tima nɛ alɔ ɲama n saatɛ tongo naxan bɛ, alako wo xa bɔxi xa fan, naxan kanaxi a xa yailan.

sentences.english: Saying to those who are in chains, Go free; to those who are in the dark, Come out into the light. They will get food by the way wherever they go, and have grass-lands on all the dry mountain-tops.
sentences.susu: Geelimanie minima nɛ, mixi naxee na dimi xɔɔra, nee xɔrɛya sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: They will not be in need of food or drink, or be troubled by the heat or the sun: for he who has mercy on them will be their guide, taking them by the springs of water.
sentences.susu: E luma nɛ alɔ xurusee naxee e dɛmadonma fiilie ma, kaamɛ nun ye xɔli mu e suxuma, kuyefure nun soge xɔnɛ mu e tɔɔrɔma. E rahinnɛma nan luma e raɲɛrɛ ra, a e xun ti dulon yire ra.

sentences.english: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways will be lifted up.
sentences.susu: Tentenyi ragoroma nɛ, yili rafe, alako e xa kira xa fan.

sentences.english: See, these are coming from far; and these from the north and the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
sentences.susu: E fama nɛ kelife yire makuye, kelife kɔɔla nun sogegorode ma, kelife Asuwan bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: Let your voice be loud in song, O heavens; and be glad, O earth; make sounds of joy, O mountains, for the Lord has given comfort to his people, and will have mercy on his crushed ones.
sentences.susu: «Naxee na koore ma, e xa e sɛɛwɛ xui ite, naxee na bɔxi ma, e xa ɲɛlɛxin, naxee na geyae fari, e xa bɛɛti ba, barima Alatala a xa ɲama madunduma nɛ, a kinikini tɔɔrɔ mixie ma.»

sentences.english: But Zion said, The Lord has given me up, I have gone from his memory.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Siyonkae nu a falama nɛ, «Alatala bara muxu rabolo, Muxu Marigi bara nɛɛmu muxu ma.»

sentences.english: Will a woman give up the child at her breast, will she be without pity for the fruit of her body? yes, these may, but I will not let you go out of my memory.
sentences.susu: «Dingɛ nɔma nɛɛmude a xa diyɔrɛ ma? A mu kinikinima xɛ a xa di ma? Hali a tan nɛɛmu, n tan mu nɛɛmuma wo ma.

sentences.english: See, your name is marked on my hands; your walls are ever before me.
sentences.susu: Wo xilie korinxi n bɛlɛxɛ kui, n yae tixi nɛ i xa banxi ra tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Your builders are coming quickly; your haters and those who made you waste will go out of you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa die na gbilenfe wo xɔnyi. Naxee wo tɔɔrɔxi, nee na kelife wo xun ma.

sentences.english: Let your eyes be lifted up round about, and see: they are all coming together to you. By my life, says the Lord, truly you will put them all on you as an ornament, and be clothed with them like a bride.
sentences.susu: Wo wo ya ite. Wo xa die bara e malan, e na fafe. N tan Alatala bara n kali n yɛtɛ ra, wo xa mixie fama nɛ lude wo sɛɛti ma, alɔ dugi tofanyie luma ginɛ ma ki naxɛ a xa futi xiri lɔxɔɛ.»

sentences.english: For though the waste places of your land have been given to destruction, now you will not be wide enough for your people, and those who made you waste will be far away.
sentences.susu: «Hali wo yaxuie to wo xɔnyi kanaxi, e wo xa ɲama rayensen yɛ, yakɔsi wo fama nɛ wuyade han wo gbo wo xa bɔxi bɛ. Mixi naxee kasarɛ tixi wo xɔnyi, e bara siga.

sentences.english: The children to whom you gave birth in other lands will say in your ears, The place is not wide enough for me: make room for me to have a resting-place.
sentences.susu: Wo xa di naxee barixi yi tɔɔrɔ waxati, e fama nɛ a falade, ‹Be xurun won bɛ. Won xa yire nɛɛnɛ ti won luma dɛnnaxɛ.›

sentences.english: Then you will say in your heart, Who has given me all these children? when my children had been taken from me, and I was no longer able to have others, who took care of these? when I was by myself, where then were these?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui wo fama nɛ a falade, ‹Nde yi die barixi n bɛ? Mixi rabɛɲinxi nan nu na n na. Ala nu bara n nabolo, a mɛɛ n na. Nde yi die ramɔxi? N keren peti nan nu a ra. Yi die kelixi minden?›»

sentences.english: This is the word of the Lord God: See, I will make a sign with my hand to the nations, and put up my flag for the peoples; and they will take up your sons on their beasts, and your daughters on their backs.
sentences.susu: Won Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «N nan n bɛlɛxɛ itema nɛ ɲamanɛe bɛ, n tɔnxuma masen e bɛ, alako e xa fa wo xa di xɛmɛe ra e bɛlɛxɛ, e xa fa wo xa di ginɛe ra e tunki ma.

sentences.english: And kings will take care of you, and queens will give you their milk: they will go down on their faces before you, kissing the dust of your feet; and you will be certain that I am the Lord, and that those who put their hope in me will not be shamed.
sentences.susu: Mangɛe mɛɛnima nɛ wo xa die ma, mangɛ ginɛe e ramɔ. Na mixi xungbee e xinbi sinma nɛ wo bun ma, e wo sanyie masunbuma nɛ. Na kui wo fama nɛ a kolonde a Alatala na n tan nan na. Mixi naxee e xaxili tima n na, na kanyi mu yaagima.»

sentences.english: Will the goods of war be taken from the strong man, or the prisoners of the cruel one be let go?
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri xa se tongoxi nɔma rasuxude a yi ra? Sɛnbɛma xa mixi suxuxi nɔma bade a yi ra?

sentences.english: But the Lord says, Even the prisoners of the strong will be taken from him, and the cruel made to let go his goods: for I will take up your cause against your haters, and I will keep your children safe.
sentences.susu: Alatala wo yaabima yi ki nɛ: «Iyo, n sɔɔri xa se tongoxi rasuxuma nɛ a yi ra, n sɛnbɛma xa mixi suxuxi bama nɛ a yi ra. N wo gerefae gerema nɛ, n wo xa die rakisi.

sentences.english: And the flesh of your attackers will be taken by themselves for food; and they will take their blood for drink, as if it was sweet wine: and all men will see that I the Lord am your saviour, even he who takes up your cause, the Strong One of Jacob.
sentences.susu: Naxee wo ɲaxankatama, e fama nɛ e yɛtɛ sube donde, e siisima nɛ e yɛtɛ wuli ra. Na kui ibunadama birin a kolonma nɛ, a n tan nan Alatala ra, wo Rakisima, wo Xunsarama, Yaxuba xa Sɛnbɛma.»

sentences.english: This is the word of the Lord: Where is the statement which I gave your mother when I put her away? or to which of my creditors have I given you for money? It was for your sins that you were given into the hands of others, and for your evil-doing was your mother put away.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «N kɛɛdi mundun sɛbɛxi n xa mɛɛ wo nga ra? N sare mundun sɔtɔxi wo matife ra? Wo matixi wo yɛtɛ xa yunubie nan ma fe ra. N mɛɛxi wo nga ra a xa matandi nan ma.

sentences.english: Why, then, when I came, was there no man? and no one to give answer to my voice? has my hand become feeble, so that it is unable to take up your cause? or have I no power to make you free? See, at my word the sea becomes dry, I make the rivers a waste land: their fish are dead for need of water, and make an evil smell.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra wo mu n yaabima? Munfe ra wo mu tima n ya ra? Wo a maɲɔxunxi nɛ n bɛlɛxɛ mu fata wo fulunde? Wo a maɲɔxunxi nɛ n sɛnbɛ mu nɔma wo rakiside? N ma wɔyɛn keren nɔma baa xarade. N nɔma xure findide gbengberenyi ra, yɛxɛe xa faxa, e xa bɔrɔ.

sentences.english: By me the heavens are clothed with black, and I make haircloth their robe.
sentences.susu: N fata koore rafɔɔrɔde, alɔ mixi na kaaɲɛ dugi ragoroxi a ma.»

sentences.english: The Lord God has given me the tongue of those who are experienced, so that I may be able to give the word a special sense for the feeble: every morning my ear is open to his teaching, like those who are experienced:
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala bara masenyi so n yi ra naxan nɔma mixi taganxi malide. A n na naxunuma gɛɛsɛgɛ birin, a n tuli ibama, alako n xa n tuli mati a ra alɔ xarandi fanyi.

sentences.english: And I have not put myself against him, or let my heart be turned back from him.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala bara n tuli rabi, n tan mu tondima birade a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: I was offering my back to those who gave me blows, and my face to those who were pulling out my hair: I did not keep my face covered from marks of shame.
sentences.susu: N nan n fari tima nɛ n yaxuie xa n bɔnbɔ. N na n xɛrɛ fan tima nɛ e xa n dɛ xabe matala. N mu n ya tagi nɔxun e xa konbie ma, n mu tondi e xa e dɛ ye bɔxun n ma.

sentences.english: For the Lord God is my helper; I will not be put to shame: so I have made my face like a rock, and I am certain that he will give me my right.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala to n mali, n mu yaagi, n mu n gi. N luma nɛ alɔ fanye, barima n a kolon n mu luma yaagi kui.

sentences.english: He who takes up my cause is near; who will go to law with me? let us come together before the judge: who is against me? let him come near to me.
sentences.susu: Naxan n gbe ɲɔxɔma a na n sɛɛti ma. Nde wama n sɔnxɔfe? Won xa wɔyɛn. Nde wama n kalamufe? Kiiti xa sa.

sentences.english: See, the Lord God is my helper; who will give a decision against me? truly, all of them will become old like a robe; they will be food for the worm.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala nan n malife. Nde nɔma a ra? E xa kalamui kanama nɛ alɔ dugi fori teese naxan donma.

sentences.english: Who among you has the fear of the Lord, giving ear to the voice of his servant who has been walking in the dark and has no light? Let him put his faith in the name of the Lord, looking to his God for support.
sentences.susu: Nde gaaxuma Alatala ya ra wo ya ma, a Ala xa konyi xui suxu? Naxan birin na ɲɛrɛfe dimi xɔɔra naiyalanyi xanbi, a xa a xaxili ti Alatala xili ra, a la a ra.

sentences.english: See, all you who make a fire, arming yourselves with burning branches: go in the flame of your fire, and among the branches you have put a light to. This will you have from my hand, you will make your bed in sorrow.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ, wo tan naxee tɛ radɛxɛma, wo fa tanbɛ raxaɲɛnma gere xili ma, N fama nɛ wo tɔɔrɔde a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Give ear to me, you who are searching for righteousness, who are looking for the Lord: see the rock from which you were cut out, and the hole out of which you were taken.
sentences.susu: «Wo wo tuli mati n na, wo tan naxee tinxinyi nun Alatala fenfe. Wo xa wo ya ti fanye ra Alatala wo raminixi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Let your thoughts be turned to Abraham, your father, and to Sarah, who gave you birth: for when he was but one, my voice came to him, and I gave him my blessing, and made him a great people.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo ya ti wo baba Iburahima nun wo nga Sara ra naxee wo barixi. N to a xili a keren nan nu a ra, kɔnɔ n to gɛ dubade a bɛ, a findi nɛ bɔnsɔɛ wuyaxi benba ra.

sentences.english: For the Lord has given comfort to Zion: he has made glad all her broken walls; making her waste places like Eden, and changing her dry land into the garden of the Lord; joy and delight will be there, praise and the sound of melody.
sentences.susu: Alatala Siyon madunduma nɛ, a kinikini a xa kasarɛ birin ma. Alatala a xa gbengberenyi findima nɛ yire fanyi ra alɔ Eden bɔxi, a a xa bɔxi ratofanma nɛ alɔ a darixi a ra ki naxɛ. Sɛɛwɛ nun ɲɛlɛxinyi lu naa, suuki nun bɛɛti ba tɛmui birin.»

sentences.english: Give attention to me, O my people; and give ear to me, O my nation; for teaching will go out from me, and the knowledge of the true God will be a light to the peoples.
sentences.susu: «N ma ɲama, wo wo tuli mati n na. N ma si, wo xa n xui ramɛ. Sɛriyɛ fatanxi n tan nan na, n ma kiiti tinxinxi findima nɛ naiyalanyi ra sie bɛ.

sentences.english: Suddenly will my righteousness come near, and my salvation will be shining out like the light; the sea-lands will be waiting for me, and they will put their hope in my strong arm.
sentences.susu: N ma kiiti tinxinxi bara makɔrɛ, n ma kisi na fafe, sie fama nɛ e xaxili tide n sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: Let your eyes be lifted up to the heavens, and turned to the earth which is under them: for the heavens will go in flight like smoke, and the earth will become old like a coat, and its people will come to destruction like insects: but my salvation will be for ever, and my righteousness will not come to an end.
sentences.susu: Wo wo ya rate koore ma. Mɛnni lɔɛma nɛ alɔ foye tuuri ralɔɛma ki naxɛ. Wo wo ya ti bɔxi ra. Mɛnni ɲɔnma nɛ alɔ dugi fori. Mɛnnikae faxama nɛ alɔ tugitugi. Kɔnɔ n ma kisi tan abadan nan a ra, n ma tinxinyi mu kanama.»

sentences.english: Give ear to me, you who have knowledge of righteousness, in whose heart is my law; have no fear of the evil words of men, and give no thought to their curses.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa wo tuli mati n xui ra, wo naxan kolon tinxinyi ra. N ma sɛriyɛ sabatixi wo bɔɲɛ kui. Wo naxa gaaxu mixie xa mabere ya ra, wo naxa wo gi e xa sɔnxɔɛ ya ra.

sentences.english: For like a coat they will be food for the insect, the worm will make a meal of them like wool: but my righteousness will be for ever, and my salvation to all generations.
sentences.susu: Nimase xunxurie e donma nɛ alɔ dugi, teese e raɲɔn alɔ gɛsɛ fute. Kɔnɔ n ma tinxinyi buma nɛ abadan, n ma kisi luma nɛ bɔnsɔɛ ya ma tɛmui birin.»

sentences.english: Awake! awake! put on strength, O arm of the Lord, awake! as in the old days, in the generations long past. Was it not by you that Rahab was cut in two, and the dragon Wounded?
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa keli sɛnbɛ ra. I xa keli alɔ singe ra. I tan xa mu Misirakae bɔnbɔ alɔ wulai sube magaaxuxi?

sentences.english: Did you not make the sea dry, the waters of the great deep? did you not make the deep waters of the sea a way for the Lord's people to go through?
sentences.susu: I tan xa mu baa xungbe raxɔri, i fa kira ibɔɔ baa tagi i xa mixi rakisixie dangima dɛnnaxɛ?

sentences.english: Those whom the Lord has made free will come back with songs to Zion; and on their heads will be eternal joy: delight and joy will be theirs, and sorrow and sounds of grief will be gone for ever.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa mixi xɔrɛyaxie gbilenma nɛ, e fa so Siyon kui bɛɛti ra, sɛɛwɛ nan luma e bɛ abadan. E bɔɲɛ rafanxi e ma, ɲɛlɛxinyi luma nɛ e sondonyi kui. Nimisɛ nun yaye makuyama nɛ e ra.

sentences.english: I, even I, am your comforter: are you so poor in heart as to be in fear of man who will come to an end, and of the son of man who will be like grass?
sentences.susu: «N tan nan wo bɔɲɛ madunduma. Nde nɔma gaaxude adamadi ya ra, naxan faxama, naxan ɲɔnma alɔ sɛxɛ?

sentences.english: And you have given no thought to the Lord your Maker, by whom the heavens were stretched out, and the earth placed on its base; and you went all day in fear of the wrath of the cruel one, when he was making ready for your destruction. And where is the wrath of the cruel one?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra wo fa nɛɛmuxi wo daalima Alatala ma, naxan koore italaxi, a bɔxi bunyi sa? Munfe ra wo luma gaaxui kui tɛmui birin wo yaxuie ya ra naxee wama wo tɔɔrɔfe? Wo gaaxuma e ya ra munfe ra?

sentences.english: The prisoner, bent under his chain, will quickly be made free, and will not go down into the underworld, and his bread will not come to an end.
sentences.susu: A gbe mu luxi, wo xa geelimanie fama nɛ xɔrɛya sɔtɔde, e mu faxama geeli kui, e mu faxama kaamɛ ra.

sentences.english: For I am the Lord your God, who makes the sea calm when its waves are thundering: the Lord of armies is his name.
sentences.susu: N tan nan na wo Marigi Alatala ra, naxan baa imaxama, a mɔrɔnyie ramini. N xili nɛ Alatala Sɛnbɛma.

sentences.english: And I have put my words in your mouth, covering you with the shade of my hand, stretching out the heavens, and placing the earth on its base, and saying to Zion, You are my people.
sentences.susu: N nan n ma masenyi saxi nɛ i dɛ i, n na n bɛlɛxɛ ti i xun ma, n tan naxan koore itala, n bɔxi bunyi sa, naxan Siyonkae xilima, ‹N ma ɲama.›»

sentences.english: Awake! awake! up! O Jerusalem, you who have taken from the Lord's hand the cup of his wrath; tasting in full measure the wine which overcomes.
sentences.susu: «Darisalamukae, wo keli keren na, wo tan naxee Alatala xa minse xɔrɔxɔɛ minxi, wo tan naxee a xa xɔnɛ kolonxi, a to din wo ra, a fa a lu wo xa bira alɔ siisilae.

sentences.english: She has no one among all her children to be her guide; not one of the sons she has taken care of takes her by the hand.
sentences.susu: A xa di yo mu nu na naxan a malima a xa ɲɛrɛ kui, naxan lu a sɛɛti ma a suxufe ra.

sentences.english: These two things have come on you; who will be weeping for you? wasting and destruction; death from need of food, and from the sword; how may you be comforted?
sentences.susu: Na gbaloe xɔrɔxɔɛ bara wo sɔtɔ, kasarɛ nun sɔntɔɛ, kaamɛ nun gere, nde nɔma wo madundude?

sentences.english: Your sons are overcome, like a roe in a net; they are full of the wrath of the Lord, the punishment of your God.
sentences.susu: Wo xa die bara bira, e saxi kira xunyi ra, alɔ xeli naxan suxuxi yɛlɛ ra. Alatala xa xɔnɛ bara din e ra, a bara e ɲaxankata a ɲaaxi ra.»

sentences.english: So now give ear to this, you who are troubled and overcome, but not with wine:
sentences.susu: Na kui wo tan tɔɔrɔmixie, wo xa wo tuli mati yi masenyi ra wo tan naxee luxi alɔ siisilae beere xanbi.

sentences.english: This is the word of the Lord your master, even your God who takes up the cause of his people: See, I have taken out of your hand the cup which overcomes, even the cup of my wrath; it will not again be given to you:
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala naxan a xa ɲama makantama, a xa masenyi nan ya, «Awa, n mu xɔnɔxi wo ma sɔnɔn, na xɔnɛ mu wo lima sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And I will put it into the hand of your cruel masters, and of those whose yoke has been hard on you; who have said to your soul, Down on your face! so that we may go over you: and you have given your backs like the earth, even like the street, for them to go over.
sentences.susu: N ma xɔnɛ sigama wo yaxuie nan ma naxee bara wo tɔɔrɔ, e fa a fala ‹Wo wo felen bɔxi ma, muxu xa ti wo fari.› E bara wo tɔɔrɔ na ki, e fa ɲɛrɛ wo fari alɔ bɔxi.»

sentences.english: Awake! awake! put on your strength, O Zion; put on your beautiful robes, O Jerusalem, the holy town: for from now there will never again come into you the unclean and those without circumcision.
sentences.susu: Siyonikae, wo xa keli sɛnbɛ ra, wo xa dugi tofanyi ragoro wo ma, wo tan taa sɛniyɛnxi. Sunnataree nun sɛniyɛntaree mu soma wo xɔnyi sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Make yourself clean from the dust; up! and take the seat of your power, O Jerusalem: the bands of your neck are loose, O prisoned daughter of Zion.
sentences.susu: Darisalamukae, wo xa keli, wo xube ba wo ma, wo dɔxɔ kibanyi kui. Yɔlɔnxɔnyi xa ba wo kɔnyi ma.

sentences.english: For the Lord says, You were given for nothing, and you will be made free without price.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «E wo matixi nɛ fufafu, wo xun mu sarama kɔbiri ra.»

sentences.english: For the Lord God says, My people went down at first into Egypt, to get a place for themselves there: and the Assyrian put a cruel yoke on them without cause.
sentences.susu: Alatala Sɛnbɛma xa masenyi nan ya, «Singe n ma ɲama nu na Misira bɔxi nan ma konyiya kui. Na dangi xanbi, Asiriyakae naxa e ɲaxankata, e e xanin.

sentences.english: Now then, what have I here? says the Lord, for my people are taken away without cause; they are made waste and give cries of sorrow, says the Lord, and all the day the nations put shame on my name.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi na findixi munse ra n bɛ? E bara n ma ɲama xanin fufafu, e fa yo e ma e xa yaamari kui.» Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Tɛmui birin n xili na kanafe.

sentences.english: For this cause I will make my name clear to my people; in that day they will be certain that it is my word which comes to them; see, here am I.
sentences.susu: Na kui n bara natɛ tongo a n ma ɲama fama nɛ n xili kolonde, e fa a kolon a n tan nan yi masenyi tixi, a n tan nan na e sɛɛti ma.»

sentences.english: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who comes with good news, who gives word of peace, saying that salvation is near; who says to Zion, Your God is ruling!
sentences.susu: Xɛɛra tofe fa ra geya fari, fe fanyi na a ra. A fama nɛ xibaaru fanyi ra naxan bɔɲɛsa fima mixi ma, naxan findima kisi ra, naxan a masenma Siyoni bɛ, «Wo Marigi Ala nan mangɛ ra!»

sentences.english: The voice of your watchmen! their voices are loud in song together; for they will see him, eye to eye, when the Lord comes back to Zion.
sentences.susu: Wo wo tuli mati wo kantamae ra, e bara e xui ite sɛɛwɛ ra. Alatala na gbilen Siyoni, e fama nɛ a tode e yae ra.

sentences.english: Give sounds of joy, make melody together, waste places of Jerusalem: for the Lord has given comfort to his people, he has taken up the cause of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Darisalamukae, wo birin xa wo xui ite sɛɛwɛ ra, barima Alatala na a xa ɲama mayotofe, a na Darisalamu xun sarafe.

sentences.english: The Lord has let his holy arm be seen by the eyes of all nations; and all the ends of the earth will see the salvation of our God.
sentences.susu: Alatala na a sɛnbɛ sɛniyɛnxi masenfe ɲamanɛ ma. Duniɲa birin fama nɛ Alatala xa kisi tode.

sentences.english: Away! away! go out from there, touching no unclean thing; go out from among her; be clean, you who take up the vessels of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo siga, wo siga. Wo naxa wo maso se sɛniyɛntare yo ra. Wo xa mini na kui sɛniyɛnyi kui, wo tan naxee hɔrɔmɔlingira see xaninma Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: For you will not go out suddenly, and you will not go in flight: for the Lord will go before you, and the God of Israel will come after you to keep you.
sentences.susu: Kɔntɔfili naxa a niya wo xa gbata, gaaxui naxa a niya wo xa wo gi, barima Alatala nan tixi wo ya ra, Isirayila Marigi Ala nan tixi wo xanbi ra.

sentences.english: See, my servant will do well in his undertakings, he will be honoured, and lifted up, and be very high.
sentences.susu: «N ma konyi xa fe sɔɔnɛyama nɛ, a xa fe te, a xun nakeli, a tide xungbe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: As peoples were surprised at him, And his face was not beautiful, so as to be desired: his face was so changed by disease as to be unlike that of a man, and his form was no longer that of the sons of men.
sentences.susu: A xa fe magore findima tɛrɛnna nan na mixi gbegbe bɛ, a lahalɛ mafindi, a mu lu adama ki ma sɔnɔn,

sentences.english: So will nations give him honour; kings will keep quiet because of him: for what had not been made clear to them they will see; and they will give their minds to what had not come to their ears.
sentences.susu: a man mangɛe dɛ ixarama nɛ marasɛniyɛnyi ra, a naxan fima bɔnsɔɛ gbegbe ma. E findima nɛ seedee ra fe nde ma, e mu naxan singe toxi, e fahaamui sɔtɔma nɛ fe nde xa fe ra, e mu naxan singe mɛxi.»

sentences.english: Who would have had faith in the word which has come to our ears, and to whom had the arm of the Lord been unveiled?
sentences.susu: Nde laxi won ma masenyi ra? Nde Alatala sɛnbɛ toxi?

sentences.english: For his growth was like that of a delicate plant before him, and like a root out of a dry place: he had no grace of form, to give us pleasure;
sentences.susu: A xa konyi lu nɛ alɔ sansi xuri, naxan tixi bɔxi xare ma. A to ki mu nu rayabu, a xa tofanyi mu gbo.

sentences.english: Men made sport of him, turning away from him; he was a man of sorrows, marked by disease; and like one from whom men's faces are turned away, he was looked down on, and we put no value on him.
sentences.susu: Mixi raɲaaxuxi nan nu a ra ɲama mu tinxi naxan na. Tɔɔrɔmixi nan nu a ra, naxan darixi ɲaxankatɛ ra. Mixie mu tinxi e ya tide a bɛ. E nu yo a ma, e mu tide yo fixi a ma.

sentences.english: But it was our pain he took, and our diseases were put on him: while to us he seemed as one diseased, on whom God's punishment had come.
sentences.susu: A bara won ma tɔɔrɛ findi a gbe ra, a bara won ma kɔntɔfili findi a gbe ra. Won tan bara a maɲɔxun a Ala nan a dankaxi, a a xa tɔɔrɛ fatanxi Ala nan na.

sentences.english: But it was for our sins he was wounded, and for our evil doings he was crushed: he took the punishment by which we have peace, and by his wounds we are made well.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a sɔxɔ nɛ won ma yunubie xa fe ra, a butuxun won ma ɲaaxuɲa xa fe ra. A ɲaxankatɛ sɔtɔ nɛ alako won xa yalanyi sɔtɔ, a xa fie findixi kisi nan na won bɛ.

sentences.english: We all went wandering like sheep; going every one of us after his desire; and the Lord put on him the punishment of us all.
sentences.susu: Won birin nu lɔɛxi nɛ alɔ xuruse naxee yensenma wula i, kankan naxa siga a xa kira xɔn ma. Kɔnɔ Alatala bara won ma yunubie kote dɔxɔ a xun.

sentences.english: Men were cruel to him, but he was gentle and quiet; as a lamb taken to its death, and as a sheep before those who take her wool makes no sound, so he said not a word.
sentences.susu: Tɔɔrɛ nun fe xɔrɔxɔɛ to a li, a mu a dɛ rabi hali keren. A lu nɛ alɔ yɛxɛɛ naxan xaninfe a faxade. A a sabari nɛ tɔɔrɛ kui, alɔ yɛxɛɛ xabe maxaba tɛmui.

sentences.english: They took away from him help and right, and who gave a thought to his fate? for he was cut off from the land of the living: he came to his death for the sin of my people.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ kiiti tinxintare sɔtɔde, a naxa faxa. Nde nɔ a bade duniɲa mixie yi ra? A ɲaxankataxi n ma ɲama xa yunubie nan ma fe ra.

sentences.english: And they put his body into the earth with sinners, and his last resting-place was with the evil-doers, though he had done no wrong, and no deceit was in his mouth.
sentences.susu: E nu wama a fure ragatafe mixi ɲaaxie nan ya ma, kɔnɔ a raɲɔnyi a ragata mixi bannaxie nan ya ma, barima a mu mixi tɔɔrɔ, a mu mixi madaxu.

sentences.english: And the Lord was pleased ... see a seed, long life, ... will do well in his hand. ...
sentences.susu: Alatala bara natɛ tongo a xa a ɲaxankata tɔɔrɛ ra, kɔnɔ sɛrɛxɛ na ba yunubie xa fe ra, a fama nɛ a bɔnsɔɛ tode, a bu abadan. Alatala waxɔnfe rakamalima a tan nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: ... made clear his righteousness before men ... had taken their sins on himself.
sentences.susu: A na gɛ a xa wali rabade, a fama nɛ sɛɛwade. «N ma konyi tinxinxi ɲama findima nɛ tinxintɔɛe ra, a e xun sara e xa yunubie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For this cause he will have a heritage with the great, and he will have a part in the goods of war with the strong, because he gave up his life, and was numbered with the evil-doers; taking on himself the sins of the people, and making prayer for the wrongdoers.
sentences.susu: N tide xungbe soma nɛ a yi ra, a xunnakeli sare sɔtɔ sɛnbɛ ra, a to faxa matandilae yi ra, a nu bara a yɛtɛ fi sɛrɛxɛ ra mixi gbegbe xa yunubie xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: Let your voice be loud in song, O woman without children; make melody and sounds of joy, you who did not give birth: for the children of her who had no husband are more than those of the married wife, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Dibaritare, naxee mu nɔma di baride, wo xa sɛɛwa, wo xa bɛɛti ba, wo tan naxee mu di sɔtɔxi sinden. Wo fama nɛ di wuyaxi sɔtɔde dangife ginɛ gbɛtɛe ra. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: Make wide the place of your tent, and let the curtains of your house be stretched out without limit: make your cords long, and your tent-pins strong.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa wo xɔnyi raxungbo, wo xa nde sa wo xa banxie xa gboe xun, wo xa na birin yailan a fanyi ra,

sentences.english: For I will make wide your limits on the right hand and on the left; and your seed will take the nations for a heritage, and make the waste towns full of people.
sentences.susu: barima wo yiriwama nɛ yirefanyi nun kɔɔla ma wo xa bɔxi kui. Wo xa mixie ɲamanɛ nde mixie kerima nɛ, e fa sabati e xa taae kui.

sentences.english: Have no fear; for you will not be shamed or without hope: you will not be put to shame, for the shame of your earlier days will go out of your memory, and you will no longer keep in mind the sorrows of your widowed years.
sentences.susu: Hali wo mu hanmɛ, wo mu yaagi yo sɔtɔma. Wo naxa gaaxu na ya ra, wo xa fe mu ragoroma nɛ. Wo fama nɛ nɛɛmude na yaagi xa fe ra wo naxan sɔtɔ wo fonike tɛmui, wo mu lu ra maɲɔxun na wo xa kaaɲɛ fe ra,

sentences.english: For your Maker is your husband; the Lord of armies is his name: and the Holy One of Israel is he who takes up your cause; he will be named the God of all the earth.
sentences.susu: barima wo Daali Mangɛ mɛɛnima wo ma alɔ xɛmɛ mɛɛnima a xa ginɛ ma ki naxɛ, naxan xili falama wo Marigi Alatala Sɛnbɛma, naxan findixi Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ ra, naxan wo Rakisima, naxan xili Ala duniɲa kanyi.

sentences.english: For the Lord has made you come back to him, like a wife who has been sent away in grief of spirit; for one may not give up the wife of one's early days.
sentences.susu: Alatala fama nɛ wo ragbilende a ma, alɔ ginɛ naxan nu bara rabolo, a fa lu tɔɔrɛ kui, alɔ sungbutunyi naxan xa mɔri bara mɛɛ a ra. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: For a short time I gave you up; but with great mercies I will take you back again.
sentences.susu: «Ala naxɛ, ‹N i rabolo nɛ tɛmui dunke di, kɔnɔ n man i masoma nɛ n na n ma xanunteya xungbe kui.

sentences.english: In overflowing wrath my face was veiled from you for a minute, but I will have pity on you for ever, says the Lord who takes up your cause.
sentences.susu: N i keri bɔɲɛte xungbe nan kui tɛmui dunke di, kɔnɔ n man kinikinima nɛ i ma marafanyi kui abadan.› N tan Alatala wo kantama xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: For this is like the days of Noah to me: for as I took an oath that the waters of Noah would never again go over the earth, so have I taken an oath that I will not again be angry with you, or say bitter words to you.
sentences.susu: «A luma nɛ n bɛ alɔ Nuha xa tɛmui, n to n kali a banbaranyi mu duniɲa kanama sɔnɔn. N bara n kali a n mu xɔnɔma wo ma, n mu wo sɔntɔma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: For the mountains may be taken away, and the hills be moved out of their places, but my love will not be taken from you, or my agreement of peace broken, says the Lord, who has had mercy on you.
sentences.susu: Hali geyae sa sɛrɛnfe nɛ, tentenyie naxa gira a ra, n ma xanunteya mu nɔma xurunde wo bɛ, n mu ma bɔɲɛsa saatɛ kanama n naxan tongoxi won bɛ. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki naxan kinikinima wo ma.»

sentences.english: O troubled one, storm-crushed, uncomforted! see, your stones will be framed in fair colours, and your bases will be sapphires.
sentences.susu: «Wo tan bɔnsɔɛ ɲaxankataxi, naxee bara tɔɔrɔ kinikinitareɲa kui, n man wo xa taa tima nɛ gɛmɛ fanyi fari, n wo raxunma diyaman na,

sentences.english: I will make your towers of rubies, and your doors of carbuncles, and the wall round you will be of all sorts of beautiful stones.
sentences.susu: N wo xa yire itexi yailanma gɛmɛ tofanyie nan na, n wo xa naadɛe raxunma gɛmɛ rayabuxie ra, n wo xa tɛtɛ ti gɛmɛ yanbaxie ra.

sentences.english: And all your builders will be made wise by the Lord; and great will be the peace of your children.
sentences.susu: Wo xa die birin birama nɛ Alatala fɔxɔ ra, e xa fe birin sɔɔnɛya.

sentences.english: All your rights will be made certain to you: have no fear of evil, and destruction will not come near you.
sentences.susu: N to wo gbe ɲɔxɔma, wo man fama nɛ tide sɛnbɛ ra. Wo yaxuie mu wo tɔɔrɔma sɔnɔn, wo mu luma gaaxui kui. Wo mu gaaxuma fefe ya ra sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: See, they may be moved to war, but not by my authority: all those who come together to make an attack on you, will be broken against you.
sentences.susu: Xa gere sa bula wo xili ma, na mu kelixi n tan xa ma. N xa a fala wo bɛ, wo gerefae xa fe kanama nɛ.

sentences.english: See, I have made the iron-worker, blowing on the burning coals, and making the instrument of war by his work; and I have made the waster for destruction.
sentences.susu: N tan nan xabui daa, naxan wure raxunuma tɛ ra, a fa geresose yailan. Na kui n man fa sɔɔri daa, naxan a yaxuie xa fe kanama.

sentences.english: No instrument of war which is formed against you will be of any use; and every tongue which says evil against you will be judged false. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness comes from me, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ geresose naxan birin yailanxi wo tan xili ma, n a niyama nɛ e mu wo li fefe ma. Naxan yo wo tɔɔɲɛgɛ, kiiti nan kanama na kanyi ra. Alatala a xa konyie gbe ɲɔxɔma nɛ. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: Ho! everyone in need, come to the waters, and he who has no strength, let him get food: come, get bread without money; wine and milk without price.
sentences.susu: «Ye xɔli na wo tan naxee ma, wo fa ye yire, wo xa fa ye min. Hali kɔbiri mu na wo yi ra, wo fa, wo xa fa donse sɔtɔ, wo xa wo dɛge. Wo fa, wo xa wɛni nun xiɲɛ min hali wo mu a sare fi.

sentences.english: Why do you give your money for what is not bread, and the fruit of your work for what will not give you pleasure? Give ear to me, so that your food may be good, and you may have the best in full measure.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra wo kɔbiri bama see xa fe ra naxee mu findi baloe ra? Munfe ra wo wali rabama naxan tide mu na wo bɛ? Wo wo tuli mati n na, wo xa wo balo fe fanyi ra naxan sɛɛwɛ fima wo ma.

sentences.english: Give ear, and come to me, take note with care, so that your souls may have life: and I will make an eternal agreement with you, even the certain mercies of David.
sentences.susu: Wo wo tuli mati n na, wo xa fa n yire alako wo xa baloe sɔtɔ. Na kui n fama xanunteya saatɛ xiride won tagi naxan mu kanama. Na luma nɛ alɔ n saatɛ naxan xiri Annabi Dawuda nun n tan tagi a sɛriyɛ ki ma,

sentences.english: See, I have given him as a witness to the peoples, a ruler and a guide to the nations.
sentences.susu: n naxan tixi seede ra sie bɛ, a findi mangɛ xungbe ra e bɛ.

sentences.english: See, you will send for a nation of which you had no knowledge, and those who had no knowledge of you will come running to you, because of the Lord your God, and because of the Holy One of Israel, for he has given you glory.
sentences.susu: Wo fama nɛ sie xilide wo mu naxee kolon, sie fama nɛ wo yire naxee mu nu wo kolon, barima wo Marigi Alatala, Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ fama nɛ binyɛ fide wo ma.

sentences.english: Make search for the Lord while he is there, make prayer to him while he is near:
sentences.susu: Wo xa gbilen Alatala ma, a to nɔma tode. Wo xa a xili, a to na yire makɔrɛxi.

sentences.english: Let the sinner give up his way, and the evil-doer his purpose: and let him come back to the Lord, and he will have mercy on him; and to our God, for there is full forgiveness with him.
