sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxi xa gbilen a xa kira kobi fɔxɔ ra, yunubitɔɛ xa a xa natɛ lu naa. A xa gbilen won Marigi Alatala ma, alako a xa kinikini a ma, a xa a xa yunubie xafari.

sentences.english: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, or your ways my ways, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N ma maɲɔxunyie nun wo tan xa maɲɔxunyie, e keren mu a ra. N ma kirae nun wo xa kirae fan, e keren mu a ra. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
sentences.susu: «Koore makuyaxi bɔxi ra ki naxɛ, n ma kira makuyaxi wo gbee ra na ki nɛ. N ma maɲɔxunyie makuya wo gbee ra pon.

sentences.english: For as the rain comes down, and the snow from heaven, and does not go back again, but gives water to the earth, and makes it fertile, giving seed to the planter, and bread for food;
sentences.susu: Tunɛ na goro bɔxi ma, a mu gbilenma fo a bɔxi bunda, a sansie rafan, naxee adamadie birin nabaloma.

sentences.english: So will my word be which goes out of my mouth: it will not come back to me with nothing done, but it will give effect to my purpose, and do that for which I have sent it.
sentences.susu: N ma masenyi fan na na ki nɛ naxan minima n dɛ i. A mu gbilenma n ma fo a n sagoe rakamali, a n waxɔnfe raba, n a xɛɛxi naxan ma.

sentences.english: For you will go out with joy, and be guided in peace: the mountains and the hills will make melody before you, and all the trees of the fields will make sounds of joy.
sentences.susu: Wo minima sɛɛwɛ nun bɔɲɛsa nan kui, geyae yati ɲɛlɛxinyi sigi sama nɛ wo ya ra, daaxa sansie e bɛlɛxɛ bɔnbɔma nɛ wo bɛ.

sentences.english: In place of the thorn will come up the fir-tree, and in place of the blackberry the myrtle: and it will be to the Lord for a name, for an eternal sign which will not be cut off.
sentences.susu: Sipirɛ wuri bulama nɛ tunbe sansi nu na dɛnnaxɛ, wuri gbɛtɛe bulama nɛ ɲooge ɲaaxi nu na dɛnnaxɛ. Na birin findima tɔnxuma nan na Alatala xa fe ra, tɔnxuma naxan mu kanama abadan.»

sentences.english: The Lord says, Let your way of life be upright, and let your behaviour be rightly ordered: for my salvation is near, and my righteousness will quickly be seen.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Wo bira nɔndi nun tinxinyi fɔxɔ ra, barima n ma kisi na fafe, a gbe mu luxi n ma tinxinyi xa to.

sentences.english: Happy is the man who does this, and the son of man whose behaviour is so ordered; who keeps the Sabbath holy, and his hand from doing any evil.
sentences.susu: Baraka na mixi bɛ naxan walima na ki, naxan na sɛriyɛ suxuma a fanyi ra, naxan a ɲɔxɔ sama malabu lɔxɔɛ xa fe xɔn ma, a mu a mabere, a mu a bɛlɛxɛ ti wali ɲaaxi ma.»

sentences.english: And let not the man from a strange country, who has been joined to the Lord, say, The Lord will certainly put a division between me and his people: and let not the unsexed man say, See, I am a dry tree.
sentences.susu: «Xɔɲɛ naxan a xaxili ti Alatala ra, na naxa a fala, ‹Alatala n bama nɛ a xa ɲama ya ma n ma xɔɲɛya xa fe ra.› Mixi banaxi naxa a fala, ‹N luxi nɛ Ala bɛ alɔ wuri xaraxi naxan tide mu gbo.›»

sentences.english: For the Lord says, As for the unsexed who keep my Sabbaths, and give their hearts to pleasing me, and keep their agreement with me:
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Mixi banaxi naxee e ɲɔxɔ sama malabui lɔxɔɛ xa fe xɔn ma, naxee n waxɔnfe rabama, naxee n ma saatɛ mabanbanma,

sentences.english: I will give to them in my house, and inside my walls, a place and a name better than that of sons and daughters; I will give them an eternal name which will not be cut off.
sentences.susu: n tɔnxuma nde tima nɛ nee bɛ n ma banxi kui, naxan tide dangi di barife ra. N e xili xungboma nɛ abadan, na binyɛ mu bama e ma fefe ma.

sentences.english: And as for those from a strange country, who are joined to the Lord, to give worship to him and honour to his name, to be his servants, even everyone who keeps the Sabbath holy, and keeps his agreement with me:
sentences.susu: Xɔɲɛ naxee e xaxili tima Alatala ra, e bira a xili fɔxɔ ra xanunteya kui, e a batu, e e ɲɔxɔ sa a xa malabui lɔxɔɛ xa fe xɔn ma, e mu a mabere, naxee n ma saatɛ mabanbanma,

sentences.english: I will make them come to my holy mountain, and will give them joy in my house of prayer; I will take pleasure in the burned offerings which they make on my altar: for my house will be named a house of prayer for all peoples.
sentences.susu: n e xaninma nɛ n ma geya sɛniyɛnxi ma, e xa sɛɛwa n ma banxi kui mixi n maxandima dɛnnaxɛ. N e xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun e xa sɛrɛxɛ gbɛtɛe suxuma nɛ n ma sɛrɛxɛbade fari, barima n ma banxi xili falama nɛ ‹Salide banxi si birin bɛ.›

sentences.english: The Lord God, who gets together the wandering ones of Israel, says, I will get together others in addition to those of Israel who have come back.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, Ala naxan Isirayila di rayensenxie malanma, a naxɛ, ‹N man e malanma nɛ n yire.›»

sentences.english: All you beasts of the field, come together for your meat, even all you beasts of the wood.
sentences.susu: Wo tan sube naxee na burunyi, wo fa wo dɛ madon.

sentences.english: His watchmen are blind, they are all without knowledge; they are all dogs without tongues, unable to make a sound; stretched out dreaming, loving sleep.
sentences.susu: E kantamae luxi nɛ alɔ dɔnxuie, e mu gɛxi fahaamui sɔtɔde. E luxi nɛ alɔ bare naxee mu nɔma wonwonde, e saxi tɛmui birin, xi xɔli nan tun ɲɔxun e bɛ.

sentences.english: Yes, the dogs are for ever looking for food; while these, the keepers of the sheep, are without wisdom: they have all gone after their pleasure, every one looking for profit; they are all the same.
sentences.susu: E luxi nɛ alɔ bare naxee mu lugama e xa donse ra. E luxi nɛ alɔ xuruse kantɛe naxee mu gɛxi fahaamui sɔtɔde, kankan biraxi a yɛtɛ xa kira nan fɔxɔ ra geeni xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Come, they say, I will get wine, and we will take strong drink in full measure; and tomorrow will be like today, full of pleasure.
sentences.susu: E a falama e booree bɛ, «Wo fa, won xa beere fen, won xa sisi. Tina fan won xa gbilen na raba ra. Tɛmunde tina fama nɛ fisade to bɛ.»

sentences.english: The upright man goes to his death, and no one gives a thought to it; and god-fearing men are taken away, and no one is troubled by it; for the upright man is taken away because of evil-doing, and goes into peace.
sentences.susu: Tinxintɔɛ na saya kira xɔn ma, kɔnɔ mixi yo mu a ɲɔxɔ sa na hinnɛtɔɛ xa fe xɔn ma. Mixie mu a kolon a Ala nan tinxintɔɛe bama tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: They are at rest in their last resting-places, every one going straight before him.
sentences.susu: Naxan luma tinxinyi xa kira xɔn ma, a malabui fanyi sɔtɔma nɛ yare.

sentences.english: But come near, you sons of her who is wise in secret arts, the seed of her who is false to her husband, and of the loose woman.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ wo tan sematoe bɔnsɔɛ, naxee fatanxi yɛnɛ nun langoeɲa ra, wo fa be.

sentences.english: Of whom do you make sport? against whom is your mouth open wide and your tongue put out? are you not uncontrolled children, a false seed,
sentences.susu: Wo nde mayelefe? Wo nde maberefe wo dɛ ra? Matandilae nan wo ra naxee fatanxi wule falɛe ra.

sentences.english: You who are burning with evil desire among the oaks, under every green tree; putting children to death in the valleys, under the cracks of the rocks?
sentences.susu: Wo yɛnɛ rabama wurie bun ma mixi kuyee batuma dɛnnaxɛ. Wo die faxama sɛrɛxɛ ra fole kui na kuyee bɛ.

sentences.english: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your heritage; they, even they, are your part: even to them have you made a drink offering and a meal offering. Is it possible for such things to be overlooked by me?
sentences.susu: Na kuyee findixi wo xa alae nan na wo birama naxee fɔxɔ ra. Wo minse sɛrɛxɛ bama e bɛ, wo sansi xɔri fima e ma. A mu lanma n xa n gbe ɲɔxɔ na fe ma?»

sentences.english: You have put your bed on a high mountain: there you went up to make your offering.
sentences.susu: «Wo bara sade yailan geya fari wo sɛrɛxɛe bama dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And on the back of the doors and on the pillars you have put your sign: for you have been false to me with another; you have made your bed wide, and made an agreement with them; you had a desire for their bed where you saw it
sentences.susu: Wo wo xa kuye tɔnxumae tima wo xa naadɛ sɛɛti ma. Wo bara gbilen n tan fɔxɔ ra, wo fa kuyee xili e xa sa wo fɛ ma sade ma. Wo to gɛ saatɛ xiride wo bore tagi, wo naxa sade fe raba.

sentences.english: And you went to Melech with oil and much perfume, and you sent your representatives far off, and went as low as the underworld.
sentences.susu: Wo bara ture nun labundɛ xanin wo xa mangɛ xɔn, wo bara xɛɛrae xɛɛ han aligiyama.

sentences.english: You were tired with your long journeys; but you did not say, There is no hope: you got new strength, and so you were not feeble.
sentences.susu: Na birin findixi taganyi nan na wo bɛ, kɔnɔ wo man tondixi gbilende na fɔxɔ ra. Wo wo sɛnbɛ nan tun sofe, lufe ra na kira xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: And of whom were you in fear, so that you were false, and did not keep me in mind, or give thought to it? Have I not been quiet, keeping myself secret, and so you were not in fear of me?
sentences.susu: «Pe, wo kɔntɔfilixi nde xa fe ra, naxan a niyama wo xa nɛɛmu n ma? Wo gaaxuxi nde ya ra, naxan a niyama wo mu n ma fe mato sɔnɔn? Munse a niyaxi wo xa n yanfa? N to dunduxi a xɔnkuye ra, na nan a niyaxi wo mu gaaxuxi n ya ra sɔnɔn?

sentences.english: I will make clear what your righteousness is like and your works; you will have no profit in them.
sentences.susu: N wo makiitima nɛ wo xa wali ma, wo naxan xilima wali fanyi. Na mu fanma wo bɛ fefe ma.

sentences.english: Your false gods will not keep you safe in answer to your cry; but the wind will take them, they will be gone like a breath: but he who puts his hope in me will take the land, and will have my holy mountain as his heritage.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo xa kuyee xili. Won xa a mato xa e nɔma wo malide. Foye e xaninma nɛ! Kɔnɔ naxan yo na a xaxili ti n tan na, a yi bɔxi sɔtɔma nɛ kɛ ra, a te n ma geya sɛniyɛnxi nan fari.»

sentences.english: And I will say, Make it high, make it high, get ready the way, take the stones out of the way of my people.
sentences.susu: Alatala a falama nɛ, «Wo wakili, wo xa kira yailan, wo xa se ɲaaxi birin ba n ma ɲama ya ra!»

sentences.english: For this is the word of him who is high and lifted up, whose resting-place is eternal, whose name is Holy: my resting-place is in the high and holy place, and with him who is crushed and poor in spirit, to give life to the spirit of the poor, and to make strong the heart of the crushed.
sentences.susu: Marigi Ala, naxan ma fe mu kanama abadan, naxan xili sɛniyɛn, a xa masenyi nan ya, «N sabatixi koore nan na sɛniyɛnyi kui. N mixi xilima nɛ n sɛɛti ma naxan bɔɲɛ tɔɔrɔxi, naxan bara a yɛtɛ magoro. N wama e ralimaniyafe, n wama e xun nakelife.

sentences.english: For I will not give punishment for ever, or be angry without end: for from me breath goes out; and I it was who made the souls.
sentences.susu: N mu wama n ma xɔnɛ xa bu e fɔxɔ ra, xa na mu n na n xaxili fixi mixi naxee ma, nee taganma nɛ.

sentences.english: I was quickly angry with his evil ways, and sent punishment on him, veiling my face in wrath: and he went on, turning his heart from me.
sentences.susu: Isirayila to mila yunubi rabafe ma, n naxa e ɲaxankata, n e rabolo, kɔnɔ e xa murutɛ nan tun xun nu masama.

sentences.english: I have seen his ways, and I will make him well: I will give him rest, comforting him and his people who are sad.
sentences.susu: N bara e wali ki yati to, kɔnɔ n e dandanma nɛ, n e mali, n e bɔɲɛ dɔxɔ,

sentences.english: I will give the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him who is near and to him who is far off, says the Lord; and I will make him well.
sentences.susu: alako e man xa bɛɛti ba n bɛ. N tan Alatala naxɛ, ‹Bɔɲɛsa xa lu yire makuyekae bɛ! N e rayalanma nɛ.›

sentences.english: But the evil-doers are like the troubled sea, for which there is no rest, and its waters send up earth and waste.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxie tan luma nɛ alɔ baa mɔrɔnyie, naxee mu raxara, naxee nɔxɔɛ tun natema.

sentences.english: There is no peace, says my God, for the evil-doers.
sentences.susu: N tan Alatala naxɛ, ‹Bɔɲɛsa yo mu na mixi ɲaaxie tan bɛ.›»

sentences.english: Make a loud cry, do not be quiet, let your voice be sounding like a horn, and make clear to my people their evil doings, and to the family of Jacob their sins.
sentences.susu: «I xa i xui ite alɔ sara fe xui, a falafe ra n ma ɲama bɛ e bara muruta, Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ bara yunubi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Though they make prayer to me every day, and take pleasure in the knowledge of my ways: like a nation which has done righteousness, and has not given up the rules of their God, they make requests to me for the right orders, it is their delight to come near to God.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ e ya rafindixi n ma. A luxi nɛ alɔ e wama n waxɔnyi nan kolonfe, alɔ ɲama naxan wama tinxinyi xɔn, naxan mu gbilenxi Ala xa yaamari fɔxɔ ra. E n maxandima kiiti tinxinxi safe ra, a luxi nɛ alɔ e na wa Ala xa makɔrɛ e ra.»

sentences.english: They say, Why have we kept ourselves from food, and you do not see it? why have we kept ourselves from pleasure, and you take no note of it? If, in the days when you keep from food, you take the chance to do your business, and get in your debts;
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ e a falama, ‹Munfe ra muxu sunma, kɔnɔ i mu a suxuma? Munfe ra muxu muxu suyidima i bɛ, kɔnɔ i mu a toma?› N xa a fala wo bɛ wo xa sunyi kui wo wo yɛtɛ waxɔnfe nan tun nabama, wo kote xɔrɔxɔɛ dɔxɔ wo xa walikɛe xun ma.

sentences.english: If keeping from food makes you quickly angry, ready for fighting and giving blows with evil hands; your holy days are not such as to make your voice come to my ears on high.
sentences.susu: Wo sunxi tɛmui naxɛ, wo wo bore gerema, wo sɔnxɔɛ ratema, wo wo bore bɔnbɔ mixi kobiɲa kui. N mu na sunyi mɔɔli suxuma feo!

sentences.english: Have I given orders for such a day as this? a day for keeping yourselves from pleasure? is it only a question of the bent head, of putting on haircloth, and being seated in the dust? is this what seems to you a holy day, well-pleasing to the Lord?
sentences.susu: N wama sunyi naxan xɔn, na findima mixi xa suyidi nan tun na? Mixi a tigi tife bɔxi, alɔ maale mɔxi foye naxan ramaxama, na keren findima sunyi ra? Sunnunyi dugi ragorofe mixi ma, xube tefe mixi xunyi ra, na xili falama sunyi fanyi naxan nafan Alatala ma?»

sentences.english: Is not this the holy day for which I have given orders: to let loose those who have wrongly been made prisoners, to undo the bands of the yoke, and to let the crushed go free, and every yoke be broken?
sentences.susu: «N wama sunyi mɔɔli naxan xɔn, wo xa gbilen tinxintareya fɔxɔ ra, wo xa kote xɔrɔxɔɛ ba mixi xun ma. Geelimani xa xɔrɛya, kote xɔrɔxɔɛ xa ba mixi xun ma.

sentences.english: Is it not to give your bread to those in need, and to let the poor who have no resting-place come into your house? to put a robe on the unclothed one when you see him, and not to keep your eyes shut for fear of seeing his flesh?
sentences.susu: Wo xa donse fi kaamɛtɔɛ ma, wo xa xide fi mixi ma a mu naxan yi, wo xa dugi ragoro mixi ma a mu naxan yi, wo naxa a lu wo ngaxakerenyi xa siga a bɛlɛxɛ igeli ra.

sentences.english: Then will light be shining on you like the morning, and your wounds will quickly be well: and your righteousness will go before you, and the glory of the Lord will come after you.
sentences.susu: Na kui wo yanbama nɛ alɔ subaxɛ looloe, wo yalanma mafuren mafuren, wo xa tinxinyi kolonma nɛ wo ya ra, Alatala xa nɔrɛ wo kantama nɛ wo xanbi ra.

sentences.english: Then at the sound of your voice, the Lord will give an answer; at your cry he will say, Here am I. If you take away from among you the yoke, the putting out of the finger of shame, and the evil word;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui wo Alatala maxandima nɛ, a fa na suxu. Wo na a xili a xa wo mali, a wo xa xili ratinma nɛ, ‹N na be.›» «Xa wo mu mixi tɔɔrɔma, xa wo mu mixi tɔɔɲɛgɛma,

sentences.english: And if you give your bread to those in need of it, so that the troubled one may have his desire; then you will have light in the dark, and your night will be as the full light of the sun:
sentences.susu: xa wo kaamɛtɔɛ malima, xa wo tɔɔrɔmixi kima, na kui wo yanbama nɛ dimi kui, wo fa dimi kana alɔ soge yanyi tagi.

sentences.english: And the Lord will be your guide at all times; in dry places he will give you water in full measure, and will make strong your bones; and you will be like a watered garden, and like an ever-flowing spring.
sentences.susu: Alatala wo raɲɛrɛma nɛ tɛmui birin, a wo hayi fanma nɛ wo bɛ hali tɛmui xɔrɔxɔɛ kui. A sɛnbɛ fima nɛ wo ma, wo fa lu alɔ laakɔɛ ye mu xɔrima naxan ma.

sentences.english: And your sons will be building again the old waste places: you will make strong the bases of old generations: and you will be named, He who puts up the broken walls, and, He who makes ready the ways for use.
sentences.susu: Wo xa ɲama fama nɛ wo xa yire kanaxie tide alɔ a singe. E fama nɛ wo xili falade, ‹Taa bilitie, banxitie, nun taa yalanmae.›»

sentences.english: If you keep the Sabbath with care, not doing your business on my holy day; and if the Sabbath seems to you a delight, and the new moon of the Lord a thing to be honoured; and if you give respect to him by not doing your business, or going after your pleasure, or saying unholy words;
sentences.susu: «Xa wo malabui lɔxɔɛ sɛriyɛ rabatu, xa wo mu wo waxɔnfe raba n ma lɔxɔɛ sɛniyɛnxi kui, xa wo sɛɛwa na lɔxɔɛ xa fe ra, wo a binya wo xa ɲɛrɛ ki fanyi ra, wo mu tin wɔyɛnyi fufafu ra,

sentences.english: Then the Lord will be your delight; and I will put you on the high places of the earth; and I will give you the heritage of Jacob your father: for the mouth of the Lord has said it.
sentences.susu: na kui wo fama nɛ sɛɛwade Alatala xa fe kui, n fa wo xa fe ite wo xa bɔxi fanyi ma, wo xa ɲɛlɛxinyi na wo benba Yaxuba kɛ nan na.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Truly, the Lord's hand has not become short, so that he is unable to give salvation; and his ear is not shut from hearing:
sentences.susu: Alatala fata wo rakiside, a fata wo xa duba ramɛde,

sentences.english: But your sins have come between you and your God, and by your evil doings his face has been veiled from you, so that he will give you no answer.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ wo xa wali ɲaaxi nan wo makuyaxi wo Marigi Ala ra, wo xa yunubie nan a yatagi nɔxunxi wo ma. Na nan a ra, a mu wo xa maxandi suxuma.

sentences.english: For your hands are unclean with blood, and your fingers with sin; your lips have said false things, and your tongue gives out deceit.
sentences.susu: Wuli na wo bɛlɛxɛe ma, yunubi na wo ma. Wo wule falama, fe ɲaaxi na wo dɛ kui.

sentences.english: No one puts forward an upright cause, or gives a true decision: their hope is in deceit, and their words are false; they are with child with sin, and give birth to evil.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu birama kiiti tinxinxi fɔxɔ ra, nɔndi tide mu na wo xa kiitife kui. Wo birama wɔyɛnyi fufafu nan fɔxɔ ra, wo wulee falama naxee tɔɔrɛ nun fe ɲaaxi raminima.

sentences.english: They give birth to snake's eggs, and make spider's threads: whoever takes their eggs for food comes to his death, and the egg which is crushed becomes a poison-snake.
sentences.susu: Wo luxi nɛ alɔ bɔximase xɛlɛ. Naxan na donma, a kanyi faxama nɛ. Na xalɛ na bula, bɔximase nan minima. Wo luxi nɛ alɔ sayɛlɛ.

sentences.english: Their twisted threads will not make clothing, and their works will give them nothing for covering themselves: their works are works of sin, and violent acts are in their hands.
sentences.susu: A gɛsɛ mu findima dugi ra. A naxan yailanma na mu nɔma a makotode. Fe ɲaaxi na a ra, naxan mu tinxin feo.

sentences.english: Their feet go quickly to evil, and they take delight in the death of the upright; their thoughts are thoughts of sin; wasting and destruction are in their ways.
sentences.susu: E xulun fe ɲaaxi rabade, e gbata mixi tɔɔɲɛgɛde, e a faxa. E xa maɲɔxunyi kobi, e fe xun nakanama nan tun.

sentences.english: They have no knowledge of the way of peace, and there is no sense of what is right in their behaviour: they have made for themselves ways which are not straight; whoever goes in them has no knowledge of peace.
sentences.susu: E mu wama bɔɲɛsa xɔn ma, tinxinyi yo mu na e xa kira xɔn ma. E kira madalinxie nan yailanxi, naxan mixi xun tima tinxintareya xɔn.

sentences.english: For this cause our right is far from us, and righteousness does not overtake us: we are looking for light, but there is only the dark; for the shining of the sun, but our way is in the night.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, won makuyaxi tinxinyi ra, a mu nɔma won lide. Won naiyalanyi nan fenma, kɔnɔ dimi nan tun sinma won ma. Won kuye iba nan mamɛfe, kɔnɔ won luma kɔɛ tan nan kui.

sentences.english: We go on our way, like blind men feeling for the wall, even like those who have no eyes: we are running against things in daylight as if it was evening; our place is in the dark like dead men.
sentences.susu: Won na won santide fenfe alɔ dɔnxui naxan ɲɛrɛma a yire masuxu ma. Won birama yanyi ra, alɔ won na ɲɛrɛfe dimi nan kui. Won luxi nɛ alɔ mixi faxaxi sɛnbɛmae tagi.

sentences.english: We make noises of grief, like bears, and sad sounds like doves: we are looking for our right, but it is not there; for salvation, but it is far from us.
sentences.susu: Won xurundunma alɔ burun subee, won wa xui raminima alɔ ganbɛ. Won gbe ɲɔxɔɛ nan fenfe, kɔnɔ won mu a sɔtɔma. Won xaxili tixi kisi nan na, kɔnɔ a makuya won na.

sentences.english: For our evil doings are increased before you, and our sins give witness against us: for our evil doings are with us, and we have knowledge of our sins:
sentences.susu: Muxu na na ki nɛ, barima muxu xa yunubie wuya, e findixi seede nan na muxu xilima. Muxu xa yunubie toma nɛ muxu ya ma, muxu bara e kolon, muxu bara muxu ti e ra.

sentences.english: We have gone against the Lord, and been false to him, turning away from our God, our words have been uncontrolled, and in our hearts are thoughts of deceit.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara i matandi, muxu bara i yanfa. Muxu bara gbilen muxu Marigi Ala fɔxɔ ra. Muxu bara fe xɔrɔxɔɛ dɔxɔ muxu ngaxakerenyie ma, muxu bara wule fala naxee fatanxi muxu bɔɲɛ kui.

sentences.english: And the right is turned back, and righteousness is far away: for good faith is not to be seen in the public places, and upright behaviour may not come into the town.
sentences.susu: Muxu nun tinxinyi tagi ikuya. Nɔndi mu toma won ya ma sɔnɔn. Yanfanteya gbo.

sentences.english: Yes, faith is gone; and he whose heart is turned from evil comes into the power of the cruel: and the Lord saw it, and he was angry that there was no one to take up their cause.
sentences.susu: Nɔndi to xɔnɔ, tinxintɔɛ nan tun tɔɔrɔma. Alatala to a to, a tinxinyi mu na sɔnɔn, na mu rafan a ma.

sentences.english: And he saw that there was no man, and was surprised that there was no one to take up their cause: so his arm gave salvation, and he made righteousness his support.
sentences.susu: A a toxi nɛ mixi yo mu nimisaxi, a a dɛ rawa Alatala xɔn ma na fe ma. Na kui a bara na kisi wali suxu a yɛtɛ ra a xa tinxinyi xa fe ma.

sentences.english: Yes, he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and salvation as a head-dress; and he put on punishment as clothing, and wrath as a robe.
sentences.susu: A xa tinxinyi luxi nɛ alɔ kanke makantase, a xa kisi lu alɔ a xunyi makantase. Gbeɲɔxɔɛ luxi nɛ a bɛ alɔ donma a naxan nagoroma a ma, a xa wakili lu a bɛ alɔ xinbeli donma.

sentences.english: He will give them the right reward of their doings, wrath to his attackers, punishment to his haters, and even on the sea-lands he will send punishment.
sentences.susu: Ala kankan sare fima nɛ a xa wali ra, a xɔnɔ a yaxuie ma yire makuye, a e sare fi.

sentences.english: So they will see the name of the Lord from the west, and his glory from the east: for he will come like a rushing stream, forced on by a wind of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ibunadama gaaxuma nɛ Alatala xili ya ra, e a xa nɔrɛ binya kelife sogetede ma han sogegorode, barima Alatala sɛnbɛ e lima nɛ alɔ ye naxan diki bɔɔma a ra.

sentences.english: And as a saviour he will come to Zion, turning away sin from Jacob, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Xunsarama na fafe Siyon, Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ bɛ naxee tuubima e xa yunubie xa fe ra. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And as for me, this is my agreement with them, says the Lord: my spirit which is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth, will not go away from your mouth, or from the mouth of your seed, or from the mouth of your seed's seed, says the Lord, from now and for ever.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxɛ, «N ma saatɛ nan ya e bɛ: ‹N Xaxili naxan goroxi i ma, na n ma masenyi naxan saxi i dɛ i, nee mu kelima wo xun ma, nee mu kelima wo xa die xun ma, nee mu kelima e fan xa die xun ma abadan.› Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: Up! let your face be bright, for your light has come, and the glory of the Lord is shining on you.
sentences.susu: «Wo keli, wo xa naiyalanyi bara fa, Alatala xa nɔrɛ bara ti wo ma.

sentences.english: For truly, the earth will be dark, and the peoples veiled in blackest night; but the Lord will be shining on you, and his glory will be seen among you.
sentences.susu: Dimi bara dusu bɔxi birin xun na, kuye bara ifɔɔrɔ na ɲamae ma, kɔnɔ Alatala bara ti wo xun ma, a xa nɔrɛ bara lu wo ya ma.

sentences.english: And nations will come to your light, and kings to your bright dawn.
sentences.susu: Ɲamanɛe fama nɛ wo xa nɔrɛ ma, mangɛe bɛndunma nɛ wo xa looloe xa yanbɛ ma.»

sentences.english: Let your eyes be lifted up, and see: they are all coming together to you: your sons will come from far, and your daughters taken with loving care.
sentences.susu: «Wo wo ya rage wo rabilinyi. E birin malanxi wo yire, wo xa die fafe kelife yire makuye, wo xa di ginɛe dɔxɔxi mixie tunki fari.

sentences.english: Then you will see, and be bright with joy, and your heart will be shaking with increase of delight: for the produce of the sea will be turned to you, the wealth of the nations will come to you.
sentences.susu: Wo na na to, wo sɛɛwama nɛ hɛri ra, wo bɔɲɛ ɲɛlɛxin. Bannaya naxan na baa naakiri ma a findima nɛ wo gbe ra, ɲamanɛe xa bannaya fa lu wo xɔnyi.

sentences.english: You will be full of camel-trains, even the young camels of Midian and Ephah; all from Sheba will come, with gold and spices, giving word of the great acts of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ɲɔxɔmɛ gali wuyama nɛ wo xa bɔxi ma, fafe ra kelife Madiyan nun Efa bɔxi ma. Naxee fama kelife Seeba, e fama xɛɛma nun surayi nan na, e nu Alatala matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: All the flocks of Kedar will come together to you, the sheep of Nebaioth will be ready for your need; they will be pleasing offerings on my altar, and my house of prayer will be beautiful.
sentences.susu: Kedari xa xurusee malanma nɛ wo xɔnyi, Nebayoti yɛxɛɛ kontonyie lu wo sagoe, ndee ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra n ma sɛrɛxɛbade fari. N ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi yanbama nɛ n ma nɔrɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Who are these coming like a cloud, like a flight of doves to their windows?
sentences.susu: «Laaba fiixɛe ɲɛrɛma koore ma alɔ ganbɛ naxee gbilenma e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Vessels of the sea-lands are waiting for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, so that your sons may come from far, and their silver and gold with them, to the place of the name of the Lord your God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he has made you beautiful.
sentences.susu: Ɲamanɛe xaxili tixi n na, Tarasisi kunkuie na yare fafe ra wo xa die ra kelife yire makuye. E fama nɛ gbeti nun xɛɛma ra wo Marigi Alatala binyafe ra, Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ naxan bara wo xun nakeli.»

sentences.english: And men from strange countries will be building up your walls, and their kings will be your servants: for in my wrath I sent punishment on you, but in my grace I have had mercy on you.
sentences.susu: «Xɔɲɛe yati fama nɛ wo xa tɛtɛ rakelide, ɲamanɛe mangɛe walima nɛ wo bɛ. Hali n to wo ɲaxankata n ma xɔnɛ kui, n fama nɛ hinnɛde wo ra n ma kinikini xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Your doors will be open at all times; they will not be shut day or night; so that men may come into you with the wealth of the nations, with their kings at their head.
sentences.susu: Hali wo mu wo xa taa naadɛe balan, barima mixie fama nɛ naafuli ra kelife ɲamanɛ ma, e xa mangɛe tixi yare.

sentences.english: For the nation or kingdom which will not be your servant will come to destruction; such nations will be completely waste.
sentences.susu: Si yo naxan tondima walide wo bɛ, a xun nakanama nɛ.»

sentences.english: The glory of Lebanon will come to you, the cypress, the plane, and the sherbin-tree together, to make my holy place beautiful; and the resting-place of my feet will be full of glory.
sentences.susu: «Liban xa wuri fanyie xaninma nɛ wo xɔnyi, alako n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa rakeli, nɔrɛ xa lu n sanyi tide.

sentences.english: And the sons of those who were cruel to you will come before you with bent heads; and those who made sport of you will go down on their faces at your feet; and you will be named, The Town of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
sentences.susu: Wo gerefae xa die fama nɛ e yɛtɛ magorode wo bɛ, wo yaxuie e xinbi sin wo bun ma. E fama nɛ wo xili falade, ‹Siyoni, Isirayila Marigi Sɛniyɛnxi Alatala xa taa.›»

sentences.english: And though you were turned away from, and hated, and had no helper, I will make you a pride for ever, a joy from generation to generation.
sentences.susu: «Hali n wo rabolo nɛ nu, mixi yo mu lu wo xa bɔxi ma, n fama nɛ wo findide si xungbe ra, naxan luma xunnakeli kui abadan.

sentences.english: And you will take the milk of the nations, flowing from the breast of kings; and you will see that I, the Lord, am your saviour, and he who takes up your cause, the Strong One of Jacob.
sentences.susu: Ɲamanɛe xa mangɛe xiɲɛ fima nɛ wo ma. Na kui wo a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra, wo Rakisima, wo Xunsarama, Yaxuba Marigi Sɛnbɛma.

sentences.english: In place of brass, I will give gold, and for iron silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: and I will make Peace your judge, and Righteousness your overseer.
sentences.susu: N xɛɛma fima nɛ wo ma wure gbeeli ɲɔxɔɛ ra, n gbeti fi wo ma wure ɲɔxɔɛ ra, n wure gbeeli fi wo ma wuri ɲɔxɔɛ ra, n wure fi wo ma gɛmɛ ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Bɔɲɛsa nun tinxinyi nan findima wo xa mangɛe ra.

sentences.english: Violent acts will no longer be seen in your land, wasting or destruction in your limits; but your walls will be named, Salvation, and your doors Praise.
sentences.susu: Fe kobi mu toma wo xa bɔxi ma, gbaloe mu wo xɔnyi lima. Wo xa tɛtɛ xili falama nɛ ‹Kisi,› wo xa taa naadɛ xili fala ‹Matɔxɔɛ.›

sentences.english: The sun will not be your light by day, and the moon will no longer be bright for you by night: but the Lord will be to you an eternal light, and your God your glory.
sentences.susu: Soge xa mu yire iyalanma wo bɛ yanyi ra sɔnɔn, kike xa mu yire iyalanma wo bɛ kɔɛ ra sɔnɔn. A kelima Alatala yati nan ma, a a xa nɔrɛ fima nɛ wo ma abadan.

sentences.english: Your sun will never again go down, or your moon keep back her light: for the Lord will be your eternal light, and the days of your sorrow will be ended.
sentences.susu: Soge nun kike mu dulama sɔnɔn, Alatala nan findima wo xa naiyalanyi ra tɛmui birin. Wo xa sunnunyi tɛmui ɲɔnma nɛ.

sentences.english: Your people will all be upright, the land will be their heritage for ever; the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, to be for my glory.
sentences.susu: Wo xa ɲama luma tinxinyi nan kui, wo xa bɔxi lu wo bɛ abadan. Wo luxi nɛ alɔ sansi solie n naxee sixi n bɛlɛxɛ ra, alako n xa n ma nɔrɛ masen duniɲa bɛ.

sentences.english: The smallest of their families will become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I, the Lord, will make it come quickly in its time.
sentences.susu: Hali wo xurun, wo sɛnbɛ luma nɛ alɔ gali belebele. Alatala nan n na. N yi wali rabama nɛ mafuren mafuren.»

sentences.english: The spirit of the Lord is on me, because I am marked out by him to give good news to the poor; he has sent me to make the broken-hearted well, to say that the prisoners will be made free, and that those in chains will see the light again;
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala Xaxili na n ma, barima a bara n sugandi xibaaru fanyi kawandide tɔɔrɔmixie bɛ, n xa e bɔɲɛ nimisaxi rayalan. A bara n xɛɛ geelimanie xɔrɛyade, n xa mixie ramini e xa dimi kui.

sentences.english: To give knowledge that the year of the Lord's good pleasure has come, and the day of punishment from our God; to give comfort to all who are sad;
sentences.susu: N xa mixie rakolon a Alatala xa hinnɛ tɛmui bara fa, a e gbe ɲɔxɔma nɛ. A fama nɛ e madundude,

sentences.english: To give them a fair head-dress in place of dust, the oil of joy in place of the clothing of grief, praise in place of sorrow; so that they may be named trees of righteousness, the planting of the Lord, and so that he may have glory.
sentences.susu: a xa hinnɛ ra a naxan fima Siyonikae ma, naxee na sunnunyi kui. A dariyɛ fima nɛ e ma e xa tɔɔrɛ ɲɔxɔɛ ra, a e wa xui madunduma sɛɛwɛ nan na. E xa nimisɛ findima matɔxɔɛ nan na. E xili falama nɛ «Konde fanyi Alatala naxan sixi,» alako a xa a nɔrɛ masen duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: And they will be building again the old broken walls, and will make new the old waste places, and will put up again the towns which have been waste for long generations.
sentences.susu: E e xa taa kanaxi yailanma nɛ, e e xa tɛtɛ biraxi rakeli, e xa yire kanaxi fori findi yire fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And men from strange countries will be your herdsmen, and those who are not Israelites will be your ploughmen and vine-keepers.
sentences.susu: Xɔɲɛe fama nɛ wo xa xurusee dɛ madonde, e wo xa xɛe rawalima nɛ.

sentences.english: But you will be named the priests of the Lord, the servants of our God: you will have the wealth of the nations for your food, and you will be clothed with their glory.
sentences.susu: Wo tan xili falama nɛ «Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ, naxee Ala xa wali rabama.»

sentences.english: As they had twice as much grief, and marks of shame were their heritage, so in their land they will be rewarded twice over, and will have eternal joy.
sentences.susu: «N ma ɲama xa yaagi masarama hɛɛri gbegbe nan na, e kɛ belebele nan sɔtɔma e xa yaagi ɲɔxɔ ra. E yire belebele sɔtɔma nɛ e xa bɔxi singe tagi, e fa sɛɛwa abadan.»

sentences.english: For I, the Lord, take pleasure in upright judging; I will not put up with the violent taking away of right; and I will certainly give them their reward, and I will make an eternal agreement with them.
sentences.susu: «Tinxinyi nan nafan n tan Alatala ma, kɔnɔ funmaya raɲaaxu n ma ki fanyi. N mixi sare fima n xui bɛrɛ nan na, n mu n ma saatɛ kanama abadan.

sentences.english: And their seed will be noted among the nations, and their offspring among the peoples: it will be clear to all who see them that they are the seed to which the Lord has given his blessing.
sentences.susu: E bɔnsɔɛ kolonma nɛ sie tagi, e bɔnsɔɛ luma nɛ bɔnsɔɛ gbɛtɛ ya ma. Mixi naxee e toma, e a kolon Alatala xa ɲama barakaxi nan e ra.»

sentences.english: I will be full of joy in the Lord, my soul will be glad in my God; for he has put on me the clothing of salvation, covering me with the robe of righteousness, as the husband puts on a fair head-dress, and the bride makes herself beautiful with jewels.
sentences.susu: N bara sɛɛwa Alatala ra ki fanyi, n ɲɛlɛxinxi n Marigi Ala xa fe ra, barima a bara n nakisi, a bara n matinxin, alɔ guba ragoroma mixi ma ki naxɛ. A luxi nɛ alɔ tɔnxuma naxan tima sɛrɛxɛdubɛ xun ma, alɔ kɔnmagore naxan gbakuma kɔn ma.

sentences.english: For as the earth puts out buds, and as the garden gives growth to the seeds which are planted in it, so the Lord will make righteousness and praise to be flowering before all the nations.
sentences.susu: Alatala tinxinyi nun matɔxɔɛ raminima nɛ duniɲa ya ma, alɔ sansi xɔrie findima solie ra ki naxɛ laakɔɛ tagi.

sentences.english: Because of Zion I will not keep quiet, and because of Jerusalem I will take no rest, till her righteousness goes out like the shining of the sun, and her salvation like a burning light.
sentences.susu: «N mu dunduma Siyoni xa fe ra, n mu taganma Darisalamu xa fe ra, han e gbe ɲɔxɔma tɛmui naxɛ, han e kisi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the nations will see your righteousness, and all kings your glory: and you will have a new name, given by the mouth of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui ɲamanɛe wo xa tinxinyi toma nɛ, e xa mangɛe kaabama nɛ wo xa dariyɛ ma. Alatala xili nɛɛnɛ fima nɛ wo ma.

sentences.english: And you will be a fair crown in the hand of the Lord, and a king's head-dress in the hand of your God.
sentences.susu: Wo findima nɛ ɲama tofanyi ra Alatala bɛlɛxɛ kui, wo xa mangɛya yanba a yi.

sentences.english: You will not now be named, She who is given up; and your land will no longer be named, The waste land: but you will have the name, My pleasure is in her, and your land will be named, Married: for the Lord has pleasure in you, and your land will be married.
sentences.susu: E mu wo xili falama sɔnɔn ‹Bɔxi raboloxi,› xa na mu a ra ‹Bɔxi kanaxi.› E wo xili falama nɛ ‹N ma baatɛ,› e wo xa bɔxi xili fala ‹Ginɛ dɔxɔɛ.› E wo xilima na ki nɛ barima Ala wo xanuxi, a bara wo xa bɔxi tongo a yɛtɛ bɛ alɔ xɛmɛ ginɛ tongoma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For as a young man takes a virgin for his wife, so will your maker be married to you: and as a husband has joy in his bride, so will the Lord your God be glad over you.
sentences.susu: Wo fan wo xa bɔxi tongoma wo yɛtɛ bɛ na ki nɛ, Ala fan ɲɛlɛxin wo ra.

sentences.english: I have put watchmen on your walls, O Jerusalem; they will not keep quiet day or night: you who are the Lord's recorders, take no rest,
sentences.susu: N kantamae tima nɛ Darisalamu tɛtɛ fari, naxee luma Ala maxandi ra wo bɛ yanyi nun kɔɛ ra. Wo tan naxee Alatala xilima, wo naxa tagan na raba ra,

sentences.english: And give him no rest, till he puts Jerusalem in her place to be praised in the earth.
sentences.susu: wo naxa wo sabari han a xa Darisalamu rasabati, a fa findi tantui ra duniɲa birin ma.»

sentences.english: The Lord has taken an oath by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Truly, I will no longer give your grain to be food for your haters; and men of strange countries will not take the wine for which your work has been done:
sentences.susu: Alatala a kalixi nɛ a sɛnbɛ ra, «N mu i xa donse sama i yaxuie bɛlɛxɛ sɔnɔn, e mu wo xa wɛni nɛɛnɛ minma wo naxan nawalixi.

sentences.english: But those who have got in the grain will have it for their food, and will give praise to the Lord; and those who have got in the grapes will take the wine of them in the open places of my holy house.
sentences.susu: Naxee xɛ sama, nee nan a donma tantui ra Alatala bɛ. Naxee wɛni bogi bunduma, nee nan a minma n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi buntunyi ra.»

sentences.english: Go through, go through the doors; make ready the way of the people; let the highway be lifted up; let the stones be taken away; let a flag be lifted up over the peoples.
sentences.susu: «Wo mini taa kui naadɛe ra, wo sa n ma ɲama xa kira rafala! Wo a yailan, wo gɛmɛe ba kirae ra! Wo xa tɔnxuma ti sie bɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord has sent out word to the end of the earth, Say to the daughter of Zion, See, your saviour comes; those whom he has made free are with him, and those to whom he has given salvation go before him.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan yi ki duniɲa bɛ, ‹Wo a fala Siyonikae bɛ, Wo Rakisima na fafe. A fama wo sare ra.›

sentences.english: And they will be named, The holy people, Those whose cause has been taken up by the Lord: and you will be named, Desired, A town not given up.
sentences.susu: E xili falama nɛ ‹Ɲama Sɛniyɛnxi,› Alatala naxan xun saraxi. Wo xili falama nɛ ‹Ɲama fenxi,› ‹Ɲama naxan mu raboloxi.›»

sentences.english: Who is this who comes from Edom, with blood-red robes from Bozrah? he whose clothing is fair, stepping with pride in his great strength? I whose glory is in the right, strong for salvation.
sentences.susu: Nde na fafe kelife Edon bɔxi ma, dugi gbeeli ragoroxi naxan ma, dugi naxan yailanxi Bosara taa kui? A sɛnbɛ gbo, a tofan. A fa a fala, «N xa a fala wo bɛ nɔndi ki ma, n faxi wo rakiside nɛ!»

sentences.english: Why is your clothing red, and why are your robes like those of one who is crushing the grapes?
sentences.susu: «Munfe ra i xa dugi gbeelixi alɔ mixi naxan wɛni bogi bunduma?»

sentences.english: I have been crushing the grapes by myself, and of the peoples there was no man with me: in my wrath and in my passion, they were crushed under my feet; and my robes are marked with their life-blood, and all my clothing is red.
sentences.susu: «N tan keren bara wali alɔ mixi naxan wɛni bunduma. Si yo mu n malixi na wali kui. N bara e boron n ma xɔnɛ kui, e wuli fa kasan n ma dugi ma han a gbeeli soe.

sentences.english: For the day of punishment is in my heart, and the year for the payment of the price for my people has come.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ nu wama gbe ɲɔxɔɛ nan xɔn. Xunsare tɛmui bara a li.

sentences.english: And I saw that there was no helper, and I was wondering that no one gave them support: so my arm did the work of salvation, and my wrath was my support.
sentences.susu: N mu mixi to naxan n malima, na kui n bara kisi wali suxu n yɛtɛ ra, n ma xɔnɛ fa n tutun yare.

sentences.english: And in my passion the peoples were crushed under my feet, and broken in my wrath, and I put down their strength to the earth.
sentences.susu: N bara sie boron n ma xɔnɛ kui, e fa lu alɔ siisilae, e wuli lu bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: I will give news of the mercies of the Lord, and his great acts, even all the things the Lord has done for us, in his great grace to the house of Israel; even all he has done for us in his unnumbered mercies.
sentences.susu: N Alatala xa hinnɛ fe falama nɛ wo bɛ. Won xa a tantu a xa fe rabaxie xa fe ra, a naxan nabaxi won bɛ. A bara fe fanyi wuyaxi raba Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ bɛ, a xa hinnɛ nun kinikini saabui ra.

sentences.english: For he said, Truly they are my people, children who will not be false: so he was their saviour out of all their trouble.
sentences.susu: A a fala nɛ, «N laxi a ra n ma ɲama nan yi ki, maifuya mu na naxee ya ma!» Na kui a naxa findi e rakisima ra.

sentences.english: It was no sent one or angel, but he himself who was their saviour: in his love and in his pity he took up their cause, and he took them in his arms, caring for them all through the years.
sentences.susu: E xa tɔɔrɛ xa fe nu a tɔɔrɔma, kɔnɔ a fafe bara findi e xunsare ra. A bara e tongo, a e xanin a xa xanunteya nun kinikini kui kabi tɛmui xɔn kuye.

sentences.english: But they went against him, causing grief to his holy spirit: so he was turned against them, and made war on them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e naxa muruta a ma, e fa a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi tɔɔrɔ. Na kui a naxa e bɛɲin, a findi e yaxui ra e gerefa.

sentences.english: Then the early days came to their minds, the days of Moses his servant: and they said, Where is he who made the keeper of his flock come up from the sea? where is he who put his holy spirit among them,
sentences.susu: Ɲama bara a maɲɔxun fe singee ma, naxan nabaxi Annabi Munsa xa waxati. E bara e yɛtɛ maxɔrin, «Ala naxan Isirayilakae ragiri Xulunyumi baa ma, na na minden? Ala naxan a xa ɲama tongo alɔ xuruse dɛmadonyi, na na minden? Ala naxan a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi ragoro a xa ɲama ma, na na minden?

sentences.english: He who made the arm of his glory go at the right hand of Moses, by whom the waters were parted before them, to make himself an eternal name;
sentences.susu: Ala naxan Munsa mali a sɛnbɛ karalanke ra, naxan baa ibɔɔ e ya ra e ragirife ra, alako a xili xa binya abadan,

sentences.english: He who made them go through the deep waters, like a horse in the waste land?
sentences.susu: na na minden?» Na kui e mu bira. E sɛnbɛ nu gbo alɔ soe naxan a gima.

sentences.english: Like the cattle which go down into the valley, they went without falling, the spirit of the Lord guiding them: so you went before your people, to make yourself a great name.
sentences.susu: Alatala Xaxili nu malabui fima e ma, e fa lu alɔ ninge naxan ɲooge donma fiili ma. I bara i xa ɲama raɲɛrɛ na ki. I bara xili fanyi sɔtɔ na ma.

sentences.english: Let your eyes be looking down from heaven, from your holy and beautiful house: where is your deep feeling, the working of your power? do not keep back the moving of your pity and your mercies:
sentences.susu: I xa i ya ragoro keli koore ma, kelife i xa kibanyi sɛniyɛnxi kui, naxan itexi, naxan luma nɔrɛ kui, i fa a mato i xa xanunteya nun sɛnbɛ na e yɛtɛ masenfe di? I xa hinnɛ nun kinikini makuya muxu ra.

sentences.english: For you are our father, though Abraham has no knowledge of us, and Israel gives no thought to us: you, O Lord, are our father; from the earliest days you have taken up our cause.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ hali Iburahima nun Isirayila nɛɛmu muxu ma, i tan nan na muxu Baba ra. Alatala nan muxu Baba ra, muxu Xunsarama kabi tɛmui xɔnkuye.

sentences.english: O Lord, why do you send us wandering from your ways, making our hearts hard, so that we have no fear of you? Come back, because of your servants, the tribes of your heritage.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra i a niyama, muxu xa i xa kira rabɛɲin? Munfe ra i muxu bɔɲɛ xɔrɔxɔma han muxu xa susa i ra? Muxu Marigi, i xa muxu ragbilen i xa yaragaaxui kui.

sentences.english: Why have evil men gone over your holy place, so that it has been crushed under the feet of our haters?
sentences.susu: I xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi nu na muxu bɛlɛxɛ, kɔnɔ yakɔsi muxu yaxuie bara mɛnni boron.

sentences.english: We have become as those who were never ruled by you, on whom your name was not named.
sentences.susu: I gbe nan muxu ra kabi tɛmui xɔnkuye, kɔnɔ e tan mu tinxi i xa yaamari ra, e mu i xili falama. Xa i sa koore rabi nɛ nu gorofe ra duniɲa, geyae sɛrɛnma nɛ i ya ra nu.

sentences.english: O let the heavens be broken open and come down, so that the mountains may be shaking before you,
sentences.susu: Duniɲa rakolon i xili sɛnbɛma ra, alako sie xa sɛrɛn gaaxui kui i ya ra. A xa lu alɔ yege naxan dɛxɛma, a fa ye satun a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: As when fire puts the brushwood in flames, or as when water is boiling from the heat of the fire: to make your name feared by your haters, so that the nations may be shaking before you;
sentences.susu: I bara kaabanakoe raba naxee bara muxu tɛrɛnna, i bara goro, geyae fa sɛrɛn i ya ra.

sentences.english: While you do acts of power for which we are not looking, and which have not come to the ears of men in the past.
sentences.susu: Yi fe mɔɔli mu kolonxi sinden. I keren nan bara na fe mɔɔli kolon, i tan naxan mixi malima naxee laxi i ra.

sentences.english: The ear has not had news of, or the eye seen, ... any God but you, working for the man who is waiting for him.
sentences.susu: I fa nɛ mixi malide naxee tinma tinxinyi ra, naxee wama birafe i xa kira fɔxɔ ra. Kɔnɔ muxu tan bara yunubi raba, i fa xɔnɔ muxu ma. Muxu nɔma kiside sɔnɔn?

sentences.english: Will you not have mercy on him who takes pleasure in doing righteousness, even on those who keep in mind your ways? Truly you were angry, and we went on doing evil, and sinning against you in the past.
sentences.susu: Muxu birin bara findi mixi sɛniyɛntare ra. Muxu naxan nabama i bɛ a nɔxɔxi alɔ dunkobi. Muxu xa fe luxi nɛ alɔ burɛxɛ lisixi. Muxu xa yunubie na muxu xaninfe alɔ foye burɛxɛ xaninma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For we have all become like an unclean person, and all our good acts are like a dirty robe: and we have all become old like a dead leaf, and our sins, like the wind, take us away.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi yo mu na muxu ya ma naxan i xilima, e mu i xa fe suxuma, barima i bara i yɛtɛ makuya muxu ra, i bara muxu tɔɔrɔ muxu xa yunubi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And there is no one who makes prayer to your name, or who is moved to keep true to you: for your face is veiled from us, and you have given us into the power of our sins.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi, Muxu Marigi, Muxu Baba, muxu bara lu alɔ bɛndɛ doloxi i yi ra, i naxan nawalima a xa findi fɛɲɛ tofanyi ra. Muxu tan nan i bɛlɛxɛ wali fɔxi masenma.

sentences.english: But now, O Lord, you are our father; we are the earth, and you are our maker; and we are all the work of your hand.
sentences.susu: I naxa xɔnɔ muxu ma Marigi. I naxa ratu muxu xa yunubie ma. I ya ti muxu ra, i xa ɲama.

sentences.english: Be not very angry, O Lord, and do not keep our sins in mind for ever: give ear to our prayer, for we are all your people.
sentences.susu: I xa taa sɛniyɛnxie bara findi gbengberen yire ra, Siyoni bara findi yire maxaraxi ra, Darisalamu bara kana,

sentences.english: Your holy towns have become a waste, Zion has become a waste, Jerusalem is a mass of broken walls.
sentences.susu: i xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi muxu nu sɛɛwaxi naxan na, na bara gan. Muxu harige fanyi birin bara kana.

sentences.english: Our holy and beautiful house, where our fathers gave praise to you, is burned with fire; and all the things of our desire have come to destruction.
sentences.susu: Na birin kui, i tondixi muxu malide? I i sabarima han mun tɛmui? I muxu ɲaxankatama nan tui?

sentences.english: I have been ready to give an answer to those who did not make prayer to me; I have been offering myself to those who were not searching for me; I said, Here am I, here am I, to a nation which gave no respect to my name.
sentences.susu: «N bara n yɛtɛ masen mixie be naxee mu nu n xilixi, mixie bara n to naxee mu nu n fenma. N bara a fala, ‹N tan nan ya,› si nde bɛ naxan mu nu xilima.

sentences.english: All day my hands have been stretched out to an uncontrolled people, who go in an evil way, after the purposes of their hearts;
sentences.susu: N na n bɛlɛxɛ ti nɛ lɔxɔɛ birin ɲama tuli xɔrɔxɔxi bɛ, naxan ɲɛrɛma kira ɲaaxi xɔn e yɛtɛ waxɔnyi fenfe ra.

sentences.english: A people who make me angry every day, making offerings in gardens, and burning perfumes on bricks.
sentences.susu: Na ɲama katama tɛmui birin n naxɔnɔfe ra. E sɛrɛxɛe bama sansi yire, e surayi fan gan sɛrɛxɛ ra e xa alae bɛ.

sentences.english: Who are seated in the resting-places of the dead, and by night are in the secret places; who take pig's flesh for food, and have the liquid of disgusting things in their vessels.
sentences.susu: E dɔxɔma gaburi sɛɛti ma kɔɛ ra, e xɔsɛ sube don, a nun se sɛniyɛntare gbɛtɛe.

sentences.english: Who say, Keep away, do not come near me, for fear that I make you holy: these are a smoke in my nose, a fire burning all day.
sentences.susu: E a falama mixie bɛ, ‹Wo naxa wo maso n na de, barima n sɛniyɛnxi dangife wo ra.› Na mixi mɔɔli xa fe xɔrɔxɔ alɔ tuuri naxan tema tɛ yire, a siga mixi ma.»

sentences.english: See, it is recorded before me, says the Lord: I will not keep back my hand, till I have sent punishment,
sentences.susu: «Yi nan sɛbɛxi n ya i, N mu dunduma na ma feo. N na sare birin fima nɛ e ma.

sentences.english: For their sins and the sins of their fathers, who were burning perfumes on the mountains, and saying evil things against me on the hills: so I will take the measure of their sins, and will send the punishment for them into their breast.
sentences.susu: N tan wo Marigi naxɛ, ‹N wo xa yunubi sare fima nɛ, wo tan nun wo benbae ma, barima wo nu sɛrɛxɛe bama geyae nan fari, wo nu fe ɲaaxi raba n na mɛnni. Na kui n wo xa yunubi sare fima nɛ wo ma, wo xa fe ɲaaxie xa fe ra.›»

sentences.english: This is the word of the Lord: As the new wine is seen in the grapes, and they say, Do not send destruction on it, for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants, in order that I may not put an end to them all.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Mixi na bogi nde bundufe tɛmui naxɛ, e fa wa na bogi wɔlɛfe, mixi gbɛtɛ a falama nɛ e bɛ, ‹I naxa na wɔlɛ. Ye nde man luxi a kui.› N fan na mɔɔli rabama nɛ n fɔxirabirɛe ra. N mu e birin ɲaxankatama.

sentences.english: And I will take a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah one who will have my mountains for a heritage: and the people I have taken to be mine will have it for themselves, and my servants will have their resting-place there.
sentences.susu: N Yaxuba xa di ndee rakelima nɛ, n Yuda xa di ndee ki n ma geyae ra. N na n ma geyae fima nɛ n ma ɲama sugandixi ma, e xa sabati naa, a fa findi e kɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Sharon will be a grass-land for the flocks, and the valley of Achor a resting-place for the herds: for my people whose hearts have been turned back to me.
sentences.susu: Sarɔn fiili fima nɛ e ma e xurusee madonma dɛnnaxɛ, Akori gulunba findima malabude nan na e xa gɔɔrɛ be. N na birin nabama nɛ n ma ɲama bɛ naxan n fenma.»

sentences.english: But as for you who have given up the Lord, who have no care for my holy mountain, who get ready a table for Chance, and make offerings of mixed wine to Fate;
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ wo tan naxee wo kobe soxi n tan Alatala ra, wo fa nɛɛmu n ma geya sɛniyɛnxi ma, wo fa sɛrɛxɛ ba wo xa alae bɛ, naxan xilima Gadi ‹Xunnafanyi kanyi› xa na mu a ra, naxan xilima Meni ‹Maragiri kanyi,›

sentences.english: Your fate will be the sword, and you will all go down to death: because when my voice came to you, you made no answer; you did not give ear to my word; but you did what was evil in my eyes, desiring what was not pleasing to me.
sentences.susu: n bara natɛ tongo wo tan ɲaxankatama santidɛgɛma nan na, wo birin fa faxa. N bara wo xili, kɔnɔ wo mu fa. N bara wɔyɛn, kɔnɔ wo mu wo tuli mati. Wo bara fe ɲaaxi raba naxan mu rafan n ma feo.»

sentences.english: For this cause says the Lord God, My servants will have food, but you will be in need of food: my servants will have drink, but you will be dry: my servants will have joy, but you will be shamed:
sentences.susu: Na kui wo Marigi Ala yi nan fala, «N ma konyie e dɛgema nɛ, kɔnɔ n wo tan luma kaamɛ nan kui. N ma konyie e minma, kɔnɔ ye xɔli luma nɛ wo tan ma. N ma konyie sɛɛwama nɛ, kɔnɔ yaagi dusuma nɛ wo tan xun na.

sentences.english: My servants will make songs in the joy of their hearts, but you will be crying for sorrow, and making sounds of grief from a broken spirit.
sentences.susu: N ma konyie bɛɛti bama sɛɛwɛ nan kui, kɔnɔ wo tan wama nɛ tɔɔrɛ kui, wo bɔɲɛ fa raɲaaxu wo ma.

sentences.english: And your name will become a curse to my people, and the Lord God will put you to death, and give his servants another name:
sentences.susu: Wo xili findima nɛ dankɛ ra n ma ɲama tagi. Alatala Sɛnbɛma wo faxama nɛ, kɔnɔ a xili nɛɛnɛ fima nɛ a xa konyie ma.

sentences.english: So that he who is requesting a blessing will make use of the name of the true God, and he who takes an oath will do so by the true God; because the past troubles are gone out of mind, and because they are covered from my eyes.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan dubɛ rabama yi bɔxi ma, a na rabama Nɔndi nan kui Ala xili ra. Mixi naxan kali tima yi bɔxi ma, a na rabama Nɔndi nan kui Ala xili ra. Tɔɔrɛ dangixi nɛɛmuma nɛ n na, a ba n ya i.»

sentences.english: For see, I am making a new heaven and a new earth: and the past things will be gone completely out of mind.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa a kolon n fama nɛ koore nun bɔxi nɛɛnɛ daade. Mixi mu ratuma fe forie ma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: But men will be glad and have joy for ever in what I am making; for I am making Jerusalem a delight, and her people a joy.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n ma daali, wo xa sɛɛwa abadan, barima n Darisalamu daama nɛ a xa wo rasɛɛwa han.

sentences.english: And I will be glad over Jerusalem, and have joy in my people: and the voice of weeping will no longer be sounding in her, or the voice of grief.
sentences.susu: N sɛɛwama nɛ Darisalamu tagi, n fe fanyi raba n ma mixie bɛ, wa xui mu mɛma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: No longer will there be there a child whose days are cut short, or an old man whose days have not come to their full measure: for the young man at his death will be a hundred years old, and he whose life is shorter than a hundred years will seem as one cursed.
sentences.susu: Di yo mu faxama a yɔrɛ ra sɔnɔn, mixi mɔxi yo fan mu faxama fo a xa simaya kamali. Mixi naxan ɲɛ kɛmɛ simaya sɔtɔma, a fa faxa, a luma nɛ alɔ a na faxa a dimɛdi tɛmui, a findi mixi dankaxi ra.

sentences.english: And they will be building houses and living in them; planting vine-gardens and getting the fruit of them.
sentences.susu: E banxie tima nɛ, e sabati e kui. E wuri bilie sima nɛ, e e bogi don.

sentences.english: They will no longer be building for the use of others, or planting for others to have the fruit: for the days of my people will be like the days of a tree, and my loved ones will have joy in full measure in the work of their hands.
sentences.susu: E mu banxie tima sɔnɔn, mixi gbɛtɛe fa sabati nee kui. E mu sansi sima sɔnɔn, mixi gbɛtɛe fa na bogi don. N ma ɲama buma nɛ, alɔ wuri xungbee. N ma mixi sugandixie sɛɛwama nɛ e xa wali ra.

sentences.english: Their work will not be for nothing, and they will not give birth to children for destruction; for they are a seed to whom the Lord has given his blessing, and their offspring will be with them.
sentences.susu: E mu walima fu ra, e xa die mu gbaloe sɔtɔma. E findima Ala bɔnsɔɛ barakaxi nan na, e tan nun e xa die luma na ki nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: And before they make their request I will give an answer, and while they are still making prayer to me, I will give ear.
sentences.susu: Beenu e xa n maxandi, a lima nɛ n ɲan bara e xui suxu. Beenu e xa gɛ fe nde falade, n ɲan bara na mɛ.

sentences.english: The wolf and the lamb will take their food together, and the lion will make a meal of grass like the ox: but dust will be the snake's food. There will be no cause of pain or destruction in all my holy mountain, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Xulumase nun si luma nɛ kulɛ keren. Yɛtɛ nun ninge ɲooge donma nɛ yire keren. Kɔnɔ bɔximase luma a balo ra xubutanyi nan na. E mu fe yo kanama n ma geya sɛniyɛnxi fari.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: The Lord says, Heaven is the seat of my power, and earth is the resting-place for my feet: what sort of house will you make for me, and what place will be my resting-place?
sentences.susu: Marigi xa masenyi nan ya, «Koore nan na n ma kibanyi ra, duniɲa nan na n san tide ra. Banxi mɔɔli mundun nɔma tide n tan bɛ? Yire mundun nɔma findide n malabude ra?

sentences.english: For all these things my hand has made, and they are mine, says the Lord; but to this man only will I give attention, to him who is poor and broken in spirit, fearing my word.
sentences.susu: N bɛlɛxɛ nan see birin nafalaxi naxee na duniɲa.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki. «Mixi naxan nafan n ma, a findixi yɛtɛ magore nan na, a gaaxu n ya ra, a n xui suxu.

sentences.english: He who puts an ox to death puts a man to death; he who makes an offering of a lamb puts a dog to death; he who makes a meal offering makes an offering of pig's blood; he who makes an offering of perfumes for a sign gives worship to an image: as they have gone after their desires, and their soul takes pleasure in their disgusting things;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi naxan ninge bama sɛrɛxɛ ra gbansan, na tan luma nɛ alɔ faxɛti. Mixi naxan yɛxɛɛ bama sɛrɛxɛ ra gbansan, na tan luma nɛ alɔ mixi naxan bare kɔnyi girama. Mixi naxan sansi xɔri bama sɛrɛxɛ ra gbansan, na tan luma nɛ alɔ mixi naxan xɔsɛ wuli bama sɛrɛxɛ ra. Mixi naxan surayi ganma sɛrɛxɛ ra gbansan, na tan luma nɛ alɔ kuye batui. E bara e xa kira sugandi, kira naxan findixi sɛniyɛntareɲa xɔnxi ra.

sentences.english: So I will go after trouble for them, and will send on them what they are fearing: because no one made answer to my voice, or gave ear to my word; but they did what was evil in my eyes, going after that in which I took no pleasure.
sentences.susu: Na kui n fan e ɲaxankatama nɛ, n fe magaaxuxi ragoroma nɛ e ma, barima n to e xili, e mu n ma xili ratinxi, n to wɔyɛn, e mu e tuli mati n na. E bara fe ɲaaxi raba n ya xɔri, e bara kira sugandi, naxan mu rafan n ma.»

sentences.english: Give ear to the word of the Lord, you who are in fear at his word: your countrymen, hating you, and driving you out because of my name, have said, Let the Lord's glory be made clear, so that we may see your joy; but they will be put to shame.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo tuli mati Alatala xui ra, wo tan naxee gaaxuxi a ya ra, «Wo ngaxakerenyi naxee wo xɔnma, e wo keri n xili xa fe ra, e naxɛ, ‹Wo xa Alatala tantu alako muxu xa wo xa sɛɛwɛ to.› Kɔnɔ e fama nɛ yaagide.

sentences.english: There is a noise of war from the town, a sound from the Temple, the voice of the Lord giving punishment to his haters.
sentences.susu: Wo bara na sɔnxɔɛ mɛ kelife taa kui, kelife Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui? Alatala na a yaxuie sare fife. Na findixi na xui nan na wo naxan mɛma.»

sentences.english: Before her pains came, she gave birth; before her pains, she gave birth to a man-child.
sentences.susu: Beenu di bari xɔnɛ xa a li, a ɲan gɛ di baride. Beenu tɔɔrɛ xa fa, a ɲan bara di xɛmɛ sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: When has such a story come to men's ears? who has seen such things? will a land come to birth in one day? will a nation be given birth in a minute? For when Zion's pains came on her, she gave birth to her children straight away.
sentences.susu: Nde singe bara yi fe mɔɔli mɛ? Nde singe bara yi fe mɔɔli to? Ɲamanɛ nɔma findide a ra lɔxɔɛ keren kui? Bɔnsɔɛ nɔma sɛnbɛ sɔtɔde tɛmui keren kui? Kɔnɔ Siyoni bara foye to keren na.

sentences.english: Will I by whom the birth was started, not make it complete? says the Lord. Will I who make children come to birth, let them be kept back? says your God.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala naxɛ, «N mixi malima han e di bari tɛmui, n fa e rabolo na kui? Ginɛ furi na mɔ, n mu fama na di bari sɔɔnɛyade xɛ?»

sentences.english: Have joy with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all you her lovers: take part in her joy, all you who are sorrowing for her:
sentences.susu: Wo tan Darisalamu rafan naxee ma, wo xa sɛɛwa a xa fe ra. Wo tan naxee wama a bɛ, wo xa ɲɛlɛxin a xa fe ra.

sentences.english: So that you may take of the comfort flowing from her breasts, and be delighted with the full measure of her glory.
sentences.susu: Wo fama nɛ a xiɲɛ minde han wo luga, wo bɔɲɛsa sɔtɔ a saabui ra, a wo hayi birin fan.

sentences.english: For the Lord says, See, I will make her peace like a river, and the glory of the nations like an overflowing stream, and she will take her children in her arms, gently caring for them on her knees.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «N bɔɲɛsa fima nɛ a ma alɔ xure xungbe, n ɲamanɛ naafuli xaninma nɛ a xɔn ma alɔ banbaranyi. A fama nɛ mɛɛnide wo ma alɔ dingɛ mɛɛnima a xa di ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: As to one who is comforted by his mother, so will I give you comfort: and you will be comforted in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: N wo xa tɔɔrɛ bama nɛ wo ma alɔ dingɛ a xa di xa tɔɔrɛ bama ki naxɛ. Na birin toma nɛ Darisalamu.»

sentences.english: And you will see it and your heart will be glad, and your bones will get new strength, like young grass: and the hand of the Lord will be seen at work for his servants, and his wrath against his haters.
sentences.susu: Wo na na to, wo bɔɲɛ sɛɛwama nɛ, wo xa fe sɔɔnɛya alɔ ɲooge naxan toma fiili ma. Alatala a sɛnbɛ masenma nɛ a xa konyie bɛ, a yaxui fama nɛ a xa xɔnɛ kolonde.

sentences.english: For the Lord is coming with fire, and his war-carriages will be like the storm-wind; to give punishment in the heat of his wrath, and his passion is like flames of fire.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan na ki, a na fafe tɛ xɔɔra, a ɲɛrɛma foye xungbe fari. A a xa xɔnɛ ragoroma nɛ sɛnbɛ ra, a ɲaxankatɛ ti tɛ ra.

sentences.english: For with fire and sword will the Lord come, judging all the earth, and his sword will be on all flesh: and great numbers will be put to death by him.
sentences.susu: Alatala a xa kiiti sama nɛ tɛ nun santidɛgɛma ra, a fa mixi gbegbe sɔntɔde.

sentences.english: As for those who keep themselves separate, and make themselves clean in the gardens, going after one in the middle, taking pig's flesh for food, and other disgusting things, such as the mouse: their works and their thoughts will come to an end together, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxɛ, «Mixi naxee sɛrɛxɛ bama wondi kui, e fa xɔsɛ nun bale sube don, a nun donse sɛniyɛntare gbɛtɛe Alatala naxee xɔnxi, e xa fe fama nɛ raɲɔnde kerenyi ra.»

sentences.english: And I am coming to get together all nations and tongues: and they will come and will see my glory.
sentences.susu: «N fama nɛ si birin malande, si naxee xui wuyaxi falama, n fa n ma nɔrɛ masen e bɛ e xa fe rabaxie nun e xa maɲɔxunyie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And I will put a sign among them, and I will send those who are still living to the nations, to Tarshish, Put, and Lud, Meshech and Rosh, Tubal and Javan, to the sea-lands far away, who have not had word of me, or seen my glory; and they will give the knowledge of my glory to the nations.
sentences.susu: N tɔnxuma nde luma nɛ e tagi, n fa e xa mixi kisixie xɛɛ bɔnsɔɛe tagi, alɔ Tarasisi, Pulu, Ludu xali wolie, Tubali, Yawani, nun si gbɛtɛ naxee na yire makuyee, naxee mu n xili kolon, naxee mu n ma nɔrɛ toxi sinden. N ma xɛɛrae fama nɛ n ma nɔrɛ masende e bɛ.

sentences.english: And they will take your countrymen out of all the nations for an offering to the Lord, on horses, and in carriages, and in carts, and on asses, and on camels, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, says the Lord, as the children of Israel take their offering in a clean vessel into the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: E man fama nɛ wo ngaxakerenyie ra naxee toma na ɲamanɛe tagi. E fama nɛ e ra n ma geya sɛniyɛnxi fari alɔ sɛrɛxɛ fama ki naxɛ. E fama nɛ e ra soee nun ɲɔxɔmɛe fari, e tixi sarɛtie kui. E fama nɛ na birin na alɔ Isirayilakae fama e xa hadiyae ra sesase sɛniyɛnxie kui ki naxɛ Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: And some of them will I take for priests and Levites, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ndee sugandima nɛ e fan ya ma, e xa lu Lewi bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti ma.»

sentences.english: For as the new heaven and the new earth which I will make will be for ever before me, says the Lord, so will your seed and your name be for ever.
sentences.susu: «N tan Alatala, n xa a fala wo bɛ, a n fama nɛ koore nɛɛnɛ nun bɔxi nɛɛnɛ yailande wo bɛ. Na buma ki naxɛ, wo xili nun wo bɔnsɔɛ buma na ki nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: And it will be, that from new moon to new moon, and from Sabbath to Sabbath, all flesh will come to give worship before me, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Keli kike nɛɛnɛ sɛrɛxɛ ma han kike nɛɛnɛ sɛrɛxɛ gbɛtɛ, keli malabu lɔxɔɛ ma han malabu lɔxɔɛ gbɛtɛ, ibunadama birin fama nɛ suyidide n ya i.

sentences.english: And they will go out to see the dead bodies of the men who have done evil against me: for their worm will ever be living, and their fire will never be put out, and they will be a thing of fear to all flesh.
sentences.susu: E mixi faxaxie toma nɛ naxee murutaxi n ma. Nimasee e furee donma nɛ, tɛ fan e sube gan, e fa findi fe magaaxuxi ra adamadie bɛ.»

sentences.english: The words of Jeremiah, the son of Hilkiah, of the priests who were in Anathoth in the land of Benjamin:
sentences.susu: Annabi Yeremi xa masenyi nan ya. A baba xili Xilikiya, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxan keli Anatɔti, Bunyamin bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: To whom the word of the Lord came in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah, in the thirteenth year of his rule.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Yosiya naxan nu findixi Amon xa di ra, a xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun saxan nde, Alatala naxa wɔyɛn Annabi Yeremi bɛ.

sentences.english: And it came again in the days of Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, up to the eleventh year of Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah; till Jerusalem was taken away in the fifth month.
sentences.susu: Annabi Yeremi man nu kawandi tima Yudaya mangɛ Yehoyakimi xa waxati, han Yudaya mangɛ Sedekiya xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun keren nde, kike suuli nde, Darisalamukae nu xaninma konyiya kui tɛmui naxɛ. Yehoyakimi nun Sedekiya nan nu na Yosiya xa die ra.

sentences.english: Now the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti n bɛ yi ki,

sentences.english: Before you were formed in the body of your mother I had knowledge of you, and before your birth I made you holy; I have given you the work of being a prophet to the nations.
sentences.susu: «Beenu n xa i nɔnɔ i nga tɛɛgɛ, n tan nu i kolon. Beenu i nga xa i sɔtɔ, n nu bara xɛɛraya ragiri i ma, i xa findi namiɲɔnmɛ ra sie birin xun ma.»

sentences.english: Then said I, O Lord God! see, I have no power of words, for I am a child.
sentences.susu: N naxa a yaabi, «N Marigi Alatala, n mu fata masenyi tide, barima fonike nan n na.»

sentences.english: But the Lord said to me, Do not say, I am a child: for wherever I send you, you are to go, and whatever I give you orders to say, you are to say.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, «I naxa a fala a fonike nan i ra, barima i tan nan sigama mixie xɔn ma, n i xɛɛma dɛnnaxɛ. I xa n ma yaamari birin masen e bɛ.

sentences.english: Have no fear because of them: for I am with you, to keep you safe, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: I naxa gaaxu e ya ra, barima won birin nan a ra. N i makantama nɛ.» Alatala xa masenyi nan ya.

sentences.english: Then the Lord put out his hand, touching my mouth; and the Lord said to me, See, I have put my words in your mouth:
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala naxa a xɔnyɛ itala n dɛ ma, a fa a masen n bɛ, «I bara a to, n bara n ma masenyi sa i xaxili ma.

sentences.english: See, this day I have put you over the nations and over the kingdoms, for uprooting and smashing down, for destruction and overturning, for building up and planting.
sentences.susu: To n bara i sugandi i xa findi n ma xɛɛra ra duniɲa sie tagi. I xunnakanɛ xa fe falama nɛ mangɛya ndee bɛ, e fa bira, e kana. I xunnakeli xa fe falama nɛ mangɛya gbɛtɛe bɛ, e fa e sanke sɔrɔn, e sabati a fanyi ra.»

sentences.english: Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Jeremiah, what do you see? And I said, I see a branch of an almond-tree.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi wɔyɛnyi masen n bɛ yi ki, «Annabi Yeremi, i munse toxi?» N naxa a yaabi, «N wuri nan toxi naxan bogima sinnanyi ma.»

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to me, You have seen well: for I keep watch over my word to give effect to it.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, «I bara a to a fanyi ra, n ma masenyi rakamalife mu kanama.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me a second time, saying, What do you see? And I said, I see a boiling pot, and its face is from the north.
sentences.susu: Alatala man naxa yi wɔyɛnyi masen n bɛ yi ki, «I munse toxi?» N naxa a yaabi, «N tunde satunxi nan toxi kɔɔla biri.»

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to me, Out of the north evil will come, bursting out on all the people of the land.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, «Ɲaxankatɛ birin kelima kɔɔla nan ma, a fa bɔxi ɲama birin halaki.

sentences.english: For see, I will send for all the families of the kingdoms of the north, says the Lord; and they will come, everyone placing his high seat at the way into Jerusalem, and against its walls on every side, and against all the towns of Judah.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya. N fama nɛ ɲama birin xilide kelife kɔɔla ma, e xa e xa mangɛ kibanyie dɔxɔ Darisalamu sode dɛ ra, e yi tɛtɛ birin nabilin, e Yudaya taae birin suxu.

sentences.english: And I will give my decision against them on account of all their evil-doing; because they have given me up, burning perfumes to other gods and worshipping the works of their hands.
sentences.susu: N e makiitima nɛ e xa fe kobi rabaxie ma, barima e bara n finsiriwali, e surayi gan sɛrɛxɛ ra kuyee bɛ, e tuubi e bɛ e naxee yailanxi e bɛlɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: So make yourself ready, and go and say to them everything I give you orders to say: do not be overcome by fear of them, or I will send fear on you before them.
sentences.susu: I tan xa i tagi ixiri, i xa keli, i xa n ma masenyi birin tagi raba e bɛ. I naxa gaaxu e ya ra, xa na mu a ra n fe nde masenma nɛ i bɛ naxan dangi nee ra pon.

sentences.english: For see, this day have I made you a walled town, and an iron pillar, and walls of brass, against all the land, against the kings of Judah, against its captains, against its priests, and against the people of the land.
sentences.susu: To n bara i findi xɛɛra ra Yudaya mangɛ, kuntigie, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, nun ɲama birin xun ma. I luma nɛ alɔ tɛtɛ belebele wure daaxi, alɔ yire makantaxi.

sentences.english: They will be fighting against you, but they will not overcome you: for I am with you, says the Lord, to give you salvation.
sentences.susu: E i gerema nɛ, kɔnɔ e mu xutu sɔtɔma i ma, barima n na i fɔxɔ ra i makantafe nan na.» Alatala xa masenyi nan ya.

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi wɔyɛnyi masen n bɛ yi ki,

sentences.english: Go and say in the ears of Jerusalem, The Lord says, I still keep the memory of your kind heart when you were young, and your love when you became my bride; how you went after me in the waste of sand, in an unplanted land.
sentences.susu: «I xa sa a fala Darisalamukae bɛ, Alatala bara a masen, ‹N bara ratu wo xa xanunteya ma, a nu na ki naxɛ singe ra wo fonike tɛmui. Wo nu bara bira n fɔxɔ ra gbengberen yire, xɛɛ mu nu saxi dɛnnaxɛ. Wo na raba marafanyi nan kui.

sentences.english: Israel was holy to the Lord, the first-fruits of his increase: all who made attacks on him were judged as wrongdoers, evil came on them, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Isirayila nu findixi Alatala nan gbe ra, alɔ sansi bogi singe. Naxee e tɔɔrɔ, nee fan fama nɛ tɔɔrɔde.›» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Give ear to the words of the Lord, O sons of Jacob and all the families of Israel:
sentences.susu: Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ, wo xa wo tuli mati Alatala xa masenyi ra. Isirayila xabilɛ birin, wo xa wo tuli mati.

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord: What evil have your fathers seen in me that they have gone far from me, and, walking after what is false, have become false?
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a masen, «Wo babae n ma fe kobi mundun toxi naxan a niyaxi e xa gbilen n fɔxɔ ra? Wo bara bira fe fufafu fɔxɔ ra, awa wo tan fan findima mixi fufafu nan na.

sentences.english: And they never said, Where is the Lord, who took us up out of the land of Egypt; who was our guide through the waste of sand, through an unplanted land full of deep holes, through a dry land of deep shade, which no one went through and where no man was living?
sentences.susu: E mu a falaxi wo bɛ, ‹Alatala na minden, naxan won naminixi Misira bɔxi ra, naxan won xanin gbengberen yire? Folee nun bɔxi maxare gbansan nan na mɛnni. Adamadie mu nɔma balode na bɔxi ma.›

sentences.english: And I took you into a fertile land, where you were living on its fruit and its wealth; but when you came in, you made my land unclean, and made my heritage a disgusting thing.
sentences.susu: N bara wo xanin bɔxi fanyi ma, alako wo xa baloe fanyi sɔtɔ. Kɔnɔ wo to fa, wo bara n ma bɔxi findi yire sɛniyɛntare ra, wo bara fe xɔnxi raba naa n dɛnnaxɛ fixi wo ma kɛ ra.

sentences.english: The priests did not say, Where is the Lord? and those who were expert in the law had no knowledge of me: and the rulers did evil against me, and the prophets became prophets of the Baal, going after things without value.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe mu Alatala fenxi. Karamɔxɔɛ mu n kolon. Yareratie bara n yanfa. Namiɲɔnmɛe bara Bala kuye masenyi ti. E bara bira se fɔxɔ ra naxan mu nɔma e malide.

sentences.english: For this reason, I will again put forward my cause against you, says the Lord, even against you and against your children's children.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi n wo ɲaxankatama.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki. «N wo xa mamadie fan makiiti.

sentences.english: For go over to the sea-lands of Kittim and see; send to Kedar and give deep thought to it; and see if there has ever been such a thing.
sentences.susu: Wo sa Kitimi suuri mato, wo xa mixie xɛɛ Kedari, wo na birin mato a fanyi ra. Wo mu yi kuye batufe mɔɔli toma naa.

sentences.english: Has any nation ever made a change in their gods, though they are no gods? but my people have given up their glory in exchange for what is of no profit.
sentences.susu: Si nde na na naxan Ala bɛɲin, e fa kuye findi e xa ala ra? N ma ɲama bara e xa xunnakeli masara, e fa e xaxili ti kuye ra naxan mu nɔma e malide.

sentences.english: Be full of wonder, O heavens, at this; be overcome with fear, be completely waste, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Koore bara findi seede ra na fe ma. Na bara findi kinikini nun kaabanako ra. A lanma na xa wo xaxili ifu, a xa wo dɛ ixara.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: For my people have done two evils; they have given up me, the fountain of living waters, and have made for themselves water-holes, cut out from the rock, broken water-holes, of no use for storing water.
sentences.susu: «N ma ɲama bara fe ɲaaxi firin naba: E bara n bɛɲin, n tan naxan nu luxi alɔ ye fanyi e bɛ, ye naxan mu ɲɔnma. E bara fɛɲɛe yailan, ye ragatama dɛnnaxɛ, kɔnɔ e ibɔɔxi, ye birin bara mini a ra.»

sentences.english: Is Israel a servant? has he been a house-servant from birth? why has he been made waste?
sentences.susu: «Konyi nan na Isirayila ra, ka a findixi di lasiri nan na? Munfe ra a ɲaxankataxi?

sentences.english: The young lions have made an outcry against him with a loud voice: they have made his land waste; his towns are burned up, with no one living in them.
sentences.susu: A luxi nɛ alɔ yɛtɛ xaaɲɛ nan na xaaɲɛfe e ma. E xa bɔxi bara findi gbaloe yire ra. Mixi yo mu na sɔnɔn e xa taa ganxie kui.

sentences.english: Even the children of Noph and Tahpanhes have put shame on you.
sentences.susu: Misiraka naxee na Nofi nun Tapanxɛsi, e fama nɛ wo xun nakanade.

sentences.english: Has not this come on you because you have given up the Lord your God, who was your guide by the way?
sentences.susu: Na fatanxi fe naxan ma, wo gbilenxi wo Marigi Alatala xa kira fanyi fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And now, what have you to do on the way to Egypt, to get your drink from the waters of the Nile? or what have you to do on the way to Assyria, to get your drink from the waters of the River?
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi munfe ra wo na Misira kira xɔn? Wo wama Nili xure ye nan minfe? Munfe ra wo na Asiri kira xɔn? Wo wama Efirati xure ye nan minfe?

sentences.english: The evil you yourselves have done will be your punishment, your errors will be your judge: be certain then, and see that it is an evil and a bitter thing to give up the Lord your God, and no longer to be moved by fear of me, says the Lord, the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Ala xa wo xa kobiɲa ragbilen wo ma. Ala xa wo xa finsiriwaliya sare fi wo ma, alako wo xa a kolon gbilenfe wo Marigi Alatala fɔxɔ ra, a findixi fe ɲaaxi nun fe xɔnɛ nan na. Wo ɲaxankataxi nɛ barima wo bara tondi gaaxude n ya ra.» Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: For in the past, your yoke was broken by your hands and your cords parted; and you said, I will not be your servant; for on every high hill and under every branching tree, your behaviour was like that of a loose woman
