sentences.susu: «Kabi tɛmui xɔnnakuye n bara wo lu wo yɛtɛ yi. Wo bara a fala a yanfanteya mu na wo bɔɲɛ kui, kɔnɔ wo bara siga kuye batude geyae fari wuri bun ma. Na bara findi langoeɲa ra wo bɛ.

sentences.english: But when you were planted by me, you were a noble vine, in every way a true seed: how then have you been changed into the branching plant of a strange vine?
sentences.susu: Wo nu luxi nɛ alɔ wɛni bili fanyi n naxan sixi. Munse a niyaxi wo xa n nabolo? Yakɔsi wo luxi nɛ alɔ wɛni bili ɲaaxi naxan mu bogi fanyi raminima.

sentences.english: For even if you are washed with soda and take much soap, still your evil-doing is marked before me, says the Lord God.
sentences.susu: Hali wo wo maxa soda saafunyi ra, wo xa yunubi mu nɔma bade.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: How are you able to say, I am not unclean, I have not gone after the Baals? see your way in the valley, be clear about what you have done: you are a quick-footed camel twisting her way in and out;
sentences.susu: «Wo nɔma a falade di, ‹N mu nɔxɔxi. N mu biraxi Bali kuye fɔxɔ ra?› Wo wo fɔxi mato gulunba yire. Wo xa wo ɲɔxɔ ti wo xa fe rabaxie ra. Wo bara lu alɔ ɲɔxɔmɛ ginɛ rabɛɲinxi,

sentences.english: An untrained ass, used to the waste land, breathing up the wind in her desire; at her time, who is able to send her away? all those who are looking for her will have no need to make themselves tired; in her month they will get her.
sentences.susu: alɔ wulai sofale naxan sofale xɛmɛ fenma a xiri ma gbengberen yire. Nde nɔma a bade na ma? Mixi naxan katama a suxude, a taganma nɛ. A mu masɔtɔma fo na waxati dangi.

sentences.english: Do not let your foot be without shoes, or your throat dry from need of water: but you said, There is no hope: no, for I have been a lover of strange gods, and after them I will go.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa gbata birade kuye fɔxɔ ra. Wo wo gima naa wo sanyi igeli ra, hali ye xɔli na wo ma. Kɔnɔ wo bara n yaabi, ‹Ade, muxu mu nɔma gbilende kuyee fɔxɔ ra. E rafan muxu ma, muxu wama kafufe e ra.›»

sentences.english: As the thief is shamed when he is taken, so is Israel shamed; they, their kings and their rulers, their priests and their prophets;
sentences.susu: «Isirayilakae fama nɛ lude yaagi kui alɔ muɲɛti naxan suxuxi. Mangɛe, kuntigie, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, nun namiɲɔnmɛe, e birin luma nɛ yaagi kui,

sentences.english: Who say to a tree, You are my father; and to a stone, You have given me life: for their backs have been turned to me, not their faces: but in the time of their trouble they will say, Up! and be our saviour.
sentences.susu: naxee a falama wuri masolixi bɛ, ‹N baba,› naxee a falama gɛmɛ masolixi bɛ, ‹N daa mangɛ.› Na mixi mɔɔli bara e kobe ti n na, e bara tondi e ya rafindide n ma. Kɔnɔ e xa tɔɔrɛ kui, e man a falama n bɛ, ‹Keli, i xa muxu rakisi.›

sentences.english: But where are the gods you have made for yourselves? let them come, if they are able to give you salvation in the time of your trouble: for the number of your gods is as the number of your towns, O Judah.
sentences.susu: Wo xa kuyee na minden, wo naxee yailanxi, naxee bara wuya Yudaya taae kui? E tan xa keli, e xa wo ratanga wo xa tɔɔrɛ ma, xa e fata na rabade.

sentences.english: Why will you put forward your cause against me? You have all done evil against me, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra wo tan matandilae wama n makiitife?» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: I gave your children blows to no purpose; they got no good from training: your sword has been the destruction of your prophets, like a death-giving lion.
sentences.susu: «N bara wo xa die bɔnbɔ alako e xa matinxin, kɔnɔ e mu matinxinxi. Wo bara wo xa namiɲɔnmɛe faxa wo xa santidɛgɛma ra, alɔ yɛtɛ xaaɲɛxi.

sentences.english: O generation, see the word of the Lord. Have I been a waste land to Israel? or a land of dark night? why do my people say, We have got loose, we will not come to you again?
sentences.susu: To mixie, wo xa la Ala xa masenyi ra. N Isirayila luxi gbengberen yire nɛ, xa na mu a ra dimi kui? Munfe ra n ma ɲama a falama, ‹Muxu wama lufe muxu yɛtɛ ra, muxu mu birama i fɔxɔ ra sɔnɔn?›

sentences.english: Is it possible for a virgin to put out of her memory her ornaments, or a bride her robes? but my people have put me out of their memories for unnumbered days.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ dimɛdi nɔma nɛɛmude a xa kɔnmagore ma, xa na mu a xa demui? N ma ɲama bara nɛɛmu n tan ma kabi tɛmui xɔnnakuye.

sentences.english: With what care are your ways ordered when you are looking for love! so ... your ways.
sentences.susu: Wo bara wo maxiri alako wo xa xanuntenyi nde fen. Wo bara dangi mixi birin na na wali kobi mɔɔli kui.

sentences.english: And in the skirts of your robe may be seen the life-blood of those who have done no wrong: ...
sentences.susu: Wo bara setaree faxa, naxee mu fe ɲaaxi yo rabaxi. Wo xa dugie nɔxɔxi e wuli ra.

sentences.english: And still you said, I have done no wrong; truly, his wrath is turned away from me. See, I will take up the cause against you, because you say, I have done no wrong.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo a falama, ‹Muxu mu fe kobi rabaxi. Ala xa xɔnɛ xa gbilen muxu fɔxɔ ra.› N tan nan wo makiitima nɔndi ra, barima wo bara a fala, ‹Muxu mu yunubi rabaxi.›

sentences.english: Why do you go about so much for the purpose of changing your way? you will be shamed on account of Egypt, as you were shamed on account of Assyria.
sentences.susu: Wo kira masaraxi munfe ra, wo fa wo xaxili ti Misira ra? Wo fama nɛ yaagide e xɔn ma, alɔ wo yaagixi Asiriya xɔn ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Truly, you will go out from him with your hands on your head: for the Lord has given up those in whom you have put your faith, and they will be of no help to you.
sentences.susu: Wo minima nɛ e xɔnyi wo bɛlɛxɛ igeli ra, barima wo taxuxi naxee ra, Alatala bara nee rabɛɲin. Wo mu xunnakeli yo sɔtɔma e saabui ra.»

sentences.english: They say, If a man puts away his wife and she goes from him and becomes another man's, will he go back to her again? will not that land have been made unclean? but though you have been acting like a loose woman with a number of lovers, will you now come back to me? says the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Xa xɛmɛ mɛɛ a xa ginɛ ra, na ginɛ naxa sa dɔxɔ xɛmɛ gbɛtɛ xɔn, a xa xɛmɛ singe man nɔma gbilende a ma sɔnɔn? Yi bɔxi bara lu sɛniyɛntareɲa kui. Wo tan naxee bara langoeɲa raba wo xanuntenyi kuyee ra, yakɔsi wo man fa wama gbilenfe n ma nɛ?» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Let your eyes be lifted up to the open hilltops, and see; where have you not been taken by your lovers? You have been seated waiting for them by the wayside like an Arabian in the waste land; you have made the land unclean with your loose ways and your evil-doing.
sentences.susu: «Wo wo ya rate, wo xa a mato, xa yire nde na wo mu langoeɲa rabaxi dɛnnaxɛ. Wo nu na wo xanuntenyi alae mɛmɛfe kira xɔn ma, alɔ muɲɛtie naxee e nɔxunma kira dɛ e xa dutun mixie ma. Wo bara yi bɔxi nɔxɔ wo ɲɛrɛ ki sɛniyɛntare ra.

sentences.english: So the showers have been kept back, and there has been no spring rain; still your brow is the brow of a loose woman, you will not let yourself be shamed.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra n mu tunɛ rafaxi, n mu ɲɛmɛ tunɛ ragoro wo bɛ. Kɔnɔ wo ya xɔrɔxɔ alɔ langoe ginɛ, wo mu yaagixi fefe ma.

sentences.english: Will you not, from this time, make your prayer to me, crying, My father, you are the friend of my early years?
sentences.susu: Han ya wo a falama n bɛ, ‹Muxu baba, naxan mɛɛnixi muxu ma muxu fonike tɛmui,

sentences.english: Will he be angry for ever? will he keep his wrath to the end? These things you have said, and have done evil and have had your way.
sentences.susu: han to i xɔnɔxi muxu ma? I mu diɲɛma sɔnɔn?› Iyo, wo na nan falaxi, kɔnɔ wo mu wo baxi na kira ɲaaxi xɔn fefe ma.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to me in the days of Josiah the king, Have you seen what Israel, turning away from me, has done? She has gone up on every high mountain and under every branching tree, acting like a loose woman there.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ mangɛ Yosiya xa waxati, «I bara Isirayila xa yanfanteya to? A bara yɛnɛ raba geya birin fari, a nun wuri bili tofanyi birin bun ma.

sentences.english: And I said, After she has done all these things she will come back to me; but she did not. And her false sister Judah saw it.
sentences.susu: N bara a maɲɔxun, na dangi xanbi a man fama nɛ gbilende n ma, kɔnɔ a mu fa. A maaginɛ tinxintare Yudaya fan a toxi.

sentences.english: And though she saw that, because Israel, turning away from me, had been untrue to me, I had put her away and given her a statement in writing ending the relation between us, still Judah, her false sister, had no fear, but went and did the same.
sentences.susu: N to mɛɛ Isirayila ra, n to fatan kɛɛdi so a yi ra a xa yɛnɛ xa fe ra, a maaginɛ Yudaya tinxintare mu gaaxu n ya ra feo. A fan bara siga yɛnɛ rabade.

sentences.english: So that through all her loose behaviour the land became unclean, and she was untrue, giving herself to stones and trees.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa kuye batufe, gɛmɛ nun wuri daaxi, na bara bɔxi findi yire sɛniyɛntare ra.

sentences.english: But for all this, her false sister Judah has not come back to me with all her heart, but with deceit, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na birin kui Yudaya tinxintare, Isirayila maaginɛ, a mu ɲanige tongoxi a bɔɲɛ kui a xa a yɛtɛ ragbilen n ma. A na fala a dɛ gbansan nan na.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to me, Israel in her turning away is seen to be more upright than false Judah.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, «Isirayila tinxintare fisa Yudaya sɛniyɛntare bɛ.

sentences.english: Go, and give out these words to the north, and say, Come back, O Israel, though you have been turned away from me, says the Lord; my face will not be against you in wrath: for I am full of mercy, says the Lord, I will not be angry for ever.
sentences.susu: I xa sa masenyi ti kɔɔla biri ra, ‹Isirayila sɛniyɛntare, i yɛtɛ ragbilen n ma. N mu xɔnɔxi wo ma sɔnɔn. Hinnɛnte nan n na, n bɔɲɛ mu luma xɔnɔ ra tɛmui birin.›» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Only be conscious of your sin, the evil you have done against the Lord your God; you have gone with strange men under every branching tree, giving no attention to my voice, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa wo ti wo xa wali kobi ra. Wo bara wo Marigi Alatala matandi, wo bara bira ala gbɛtɛe fɔxɔ ra wuri bilie bun ma. Wo mu tin wo tuli matide n xui ra.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Come back, O children who are turned away, says the Lord; for I am a husband to you, and I will take you, one from a town and two from a family, and will make you come to Zion;
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Wo tan kalabantee, wo gbilen n ma. N tan nan na wo Marigi ra. N fama nɛ wo mayegetide taa nun xabilɛ kui, n fa wo ragbilen Siyon.

sentences.english: And I will give you keepers, pleasing to my heart, who will give you your food with knowledge and wisdom.
sentences.susu: N yareratie tima nɛ wo bɛ, naxee rafan n ma. E lɔnni nun xaxili fanyi masenma nɛ wo bɛ.»

sentences.english: And it will come about, when your numbers are increased in the land, in those days, says the Lord, that they will no longer say, The ark of the agreement of the Lord: it will not come into their minds, they will not have any memory of it, or be conscious of the loss of it, and it will not be made again.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya. «Wo na wuya wo xa bɔxi kui, wo fama nɛ nɛɛmude Alatala xa saatɛ kankira ma. Wo mu a xa fe falama, wo xa maɲɔxunyi mu sigama a ma. Wo mu a kolonma a bara lɔɛ, wo mu gbɛtɛ fenma.

sentences.english: At that time Jerusalem will be named the seat of the Lord's kingdom; and all the nations will come together to it, to the name of the Lord, to Jerusalem: and no longer will their steps be guided by the purposes of their evil hearts.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na tɛmui Darisalamu xili fama nɛ falade ‹Alatala xa kibanyi.› Si birin sigama naa Alatala xili ra. E gbilenma nɛ e xa maɲɔxunyi ɲaaxi fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: In those days the family of Judah will go with the family of Israel, and they will come together out of the land of the north into the land which I gave for a heritage to your fathers.
sentences.susu: Na waxati Yudayakae fama nɛ kafude Isirayilakae ma. E birin kelima bɔxi nan ma naxan na kɔɔla ma, e fa gbilen bɔxi ma n dɛnnaxɛ fixi wo babae ma kɛ ra.

sentences.english: But I said, How am I to put you among the children, and give you a desired land, a heritage of glory among the armies of the nations? and I said, You are to say to me, My father; and not be turned away from me.
sentences.susu: N tan nu bara a fala, ‹N wama nɛ wo xa lu alɔ n ma die, n xa bɔxi fi wo ma kɛ ra, naxan tofan bɔxi birin bɛ.› N bara a maɲɔxun a wo n xili falama nɛ ‹N Baba.› N bara a maɲɔxun wo mu gbilenma n fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Truly, as a wife is false to her husband, so have you been false to me, O Israel, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan Isirayila, wo bara n yanfa alɔ ginɛ naxan a xa mɔri yanfa a yɛnɛ raba.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: A voice is sounding on the open hilltops, the weeping and the prayers of the children of Israel; because their way is twisted, they have not kept the Lord their God in mind.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae e xui itema geya fari, e wama, e Ala maxandima, barima e bara kira ɲaaxi suxu, e bara nɛɛmu e Marigi Alatala ma.

sentences.english: Come back, you children who have been turned away, and I will take away your desire for wandering. See, we have come to you, for you are the Lord our God.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxɛ, «Wo tan matandilae, wo gbilen, n nɔma wo rakiside wo xa yanfanteya ma.» Isirayilakae naxa a yaabi, «Awa, muxu gbilenma nɛ i ma, barima i tan nan na muxu Marigi Alatala ra.

sentences.english: Truly, the hills, and the noise of an army on the mountains, are a false hope: truly, in the Lord our God is the salvation of Israel.
sentences.susu: Iyo, xui naxan kelima geya fari, wule na a ra. Iyo, muxu Marigi Alatala nan na Isirayila rakisima ra.

sentences.english: But the Baal has taken all the work of our fathers from our earliest days; their flocks and their herds, their sons and their daughters.
sentences.susu: Kabi muxu dimɛdi tɛmui, kuye ratɔnxie bara muxu babae xa harige xun nakana, e xa xurusee nun e xa die.

sentences.english: Let us be stretched on the earth in our downfall, covering ourselves with our shame: for we have been sinners against the Lord our God, we and our fathers, from our earliest years even till this day: and we have not given ear to the voice of the Lord our God.
sentences.susu: Na yaagi bara muxu sɔtɔ, binyɛ birin bara ba muxu ma, barima muxu bara yunubi raba won Marigi Alatala ra, muxu tan nun won babae, kabi muxu dimɛdi tɛmui han to. Muxu mu muxu tuli matixi muxu Marigi Alatala xui ra.»

sentences.english: If you will come back, O Israel, says the Lord, you will come back to me: and if you will put away your disgusting ways, you will not be sent away from before me.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Isirayila, xa wo wo yɛtɛ ragbilen n ma, xa wo fe ratɔnxi ba n ya tode ra, xa wo mu lintan wo xa kɛwali ra,

sentences.english: And you will take your oath, By the living Lord, in good faith and wisdom and righteousness; and the nations will make use of you as a blessing, and in you will they take a pride.
sentences.susu: xa wo wo kali Alatala xili ra tinxinyi nun nɔndi ra, sie fama nɛ baraka nun binyɛ sɔtɔde Alatala saabui ra.»

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord says to the men of Judah and to Jerusalem: Get your unworked land ploughed up, do not put in your seeds among thorns.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya xɛmɛe bɛ naxee na Yudaya nun Darisalamu: «Wo xa xɛ nɛɛnɛ masɛgɛ, wo naxa sansi xɔri si kunsi tunbe xɔɔra.

sentences.english: Undergo a circumcision of the heart, you men of Judah and people of Jerusalem: or my wrath may come out like fire, burning so that no one is able to put it out, because of the evil of your doings.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ naxee na Yudaya nun Darisalamu, wo xa wo bɔɲɛ sɛniyɛn Alatala bɛ. Wo xa fe ɲaaxi ba wo sondonyi kui, alɔ fe ɲaaxi bama wo ma ki naxɛ wo sunna tɛmui. Wo xa na raba alako n bɔɲɛ naxa te wo ma, n ma xɔnɛ fa wo gan alɔ tɛ naxan mu nɔma xubende wo xa fe kobi rabaxie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Say openly in Judah, give it out in Jerusalem, and say, Let the horn be sounded in the land: crying out in a loud voice, Come together, and let us go into the walled towns.
sentences.susu: Wo xa yi masenyi ti Yudayakae bɛ, wo man xa a fala Darisalamukae bɛ. Wo xa feri fe Isirayila yire birin, wo xa a fala wo xui itexi ra, ‹Wo xa so taa makantaxie kui.›

sentences.english: Put up a flag for a sign to Zion: go in flight so that you may be safe, waiting no longer: for I will send evil from the north, and a great destruction.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a matɔnxuma Siyonkae bɛ e xa e gi, e naxa ti kira xɔn ma, barima n na fafe tɔɔrɛ nun ɲaxankatɛ ra kelife kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: A lion has gone up from his secret place in the woods, and one who makes waste the nations is on his way; he has gone out from his place, to make your land unpeopled, so that your towns will be made waste, with no man living in them.
sentences.susu: Sie kanama bara kira suxu, alɔ yɛtɛ naxan minima sube fende. A bara keli a xɔnyi alako a xa wo xa bɔxi kana. Wo xa taae birin fama nɛ kanade, mixi yo mu luma naa.

sentences.english: For this put on haircloth, with weeping and loud crying: for the burning wrath of the Lord is not turned back from us.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra wo lanma wo xa sunnun donma ragoro wo ma, wo xa sunnun, wo xa ɲɔnfe raba, barima Alatala xa xɔnɛ mu gbilenma wo fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: And it will come about in that day, says the Lord, that the heart of the king will be dead in him, and the hearts of the rulers; and the priests will be overcome with fear, and the prophets with wonder.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Na lɔxɔɛ limaniya bama nɛ mangɛ nun kuntigie yi ra. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun namiɲɔnmɛe dɛe ixarama nɛ.»

sentences.english: Then said I, Ah, Lord God! your words were not true when you said to this people and to Jerusalem, You will have peace; when the sword has come even to the soul.
sentences.susu: N bara Ala yaabi, «N Marigi Alatala, munfe ra i bara a fala i xa ɲama nun Darisalamu bɛ, ‹Wo fama bɔɲɛsa sɔtɔde,› kɔnɔ santidɛgɛma bara gɛ e faxade?»

sentences.english: At that time it will be said to this people and to Jerusalem, A burning wind from the open hilltops in the waste land is blowing on the daughter of my people, not for separating or cleaning the grain;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a fama nɛ a falade ɲama nun Darisalamu bɛ, «Foye bara keli gbengberen yire. A mu fama fe fanyi ra, a fama n ma ɲama nan tɔɔrɔde.

sentences.english: A full wind will come for me: and now I will give my decision against them.
sentences.susu: A findixi foye magaaxuxi nan na, naxan kelixi n yire. Yakɔsi n e ɲaxankatama nɛ.»

sentences.english: See, he will come up like the clouds, and his war-carriages like the storm-wind: his horses are quicker than eagles. Sorrow is ours, for destruction has come on us.
sentences.susu: Yaxuie na fafe alɔ foye belebele naxan kelife koore ma. E xa sɔɔri ragisee luma nɛ alɔ turunnaadɛ. E xa soe xulun alɔ sɛgɛe. Gbaloe bara won li, won bara halaki.

sentences.english: O Jerusalem, make your heart clean from evil, so that you may have salvation. How long are evil purposes to have a resting-place in you?
sentences.susu: Darisalamu, wo wo bɔɲɛ rasɛniyɛn, alako wo xa kisi. Kɛwali kobi luma wo bɔɲɛ ma han tɛmui mundun?

sentences.english: For a voice is sounding from Dan, giving out evil from the hills of Ephraim:
sentences.susu: Danakae bara na gbaloe masenyi ti, Efiramikae fan bara na fala.

sentences.english: Make this come to the minds of the nations, make a statement openly against Jerusalem, that attackers are coming from a far country and their voices will be loud against the towns of Judah.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sie rasi, wo xa Darisalamu fan nasi, yaxuie na kelife yire makuye nɛ, e na fafe Yudaya taae kui.

sentences.english: Like keepers of a field they are against her on every side; because she has been fighting against me, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «E bara Darisalamu rabilin alɔ xɛ kantamae xɛ rabilinma ki naxɛ. Na fama nɛ Darisalamu lide barima e bara n matandi.

sentences.english: Your ways and your doings have made these things come on you; this is your sin; truly it is bitter, going deep into your heart.
sentences.susu: Na findixi wo xa wali kobi sare nan na. Wo naxan nabaxi, na bara gbilen wo ma a ɲaaxi ra, han a wo sondonyi sɔxɔ.»

sentences.english: My soul, my soul! I am pained to my inmost heart; my heart is troubled in me; I am not able to be quiet, because the sound of the horn, the note of war, has come to my ears.
sentences.susu: N bɔɲɛ fan na tɔɔrɔfe. N bara sunnun. N mu nɔma madundude, barima n bara sarae nun gere xui mɛ fa ra.

sentences.english: News is given of destruction on destruction; all the land is made waste: suddenly my tents, straight away my curtains, are made waste.
sentences.susu: E a falama gbaloe na fafe, bɔxi birin bara kana. N ma kiri banxie bara bira keren na, lingira yo mu na n yi ra.

sentences.english: How long will I go on seeing the flag and hearing the sound of the war-horn?
sentences.susu: Gere tɔnxuma a itima han mun tɛmui? Gere xui minima han mun lɔxɔɛ?

sentences.english: For my people are foolish, they have no knowledge of me; they are evil-minded children, without sense, all of them: they are wise in evil-doing, but have no knowledge of doing good.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxɛ, «N ma ɲama xaxili mu na, e mu n kolon, e luxi nɛ alɔ di lɔnnitaree. E fe ɲaaxi nan gbansan kolon, kɔnɔ e mu fata fe fanyi rabade.»

sentences.english: Looking at the earth, I saw that it was waste and without form; and to the heavens, that they had no light.
sentences.susu: N bara laamatunyi to yi bɔxi xa fe ra. Sese mu luma yi bɔxi ma, hali koore mu yanbama a ma.

sentences.english: Looking at the mountains, I saw them shaking, and all the hills were moved about.
sentences.susu: N bara laamatunyi to geyae xa fe ra. Geyae fama nɛ sɛrɛnde, tentenyie ramaxa.

sentences.english: Looking, I saw that there was no man, and all the birds of heaven had gone in flight.
sentences.susu: N bara laamatunyi to nimase xa fe ra. Mixi mu luma yi bɔxi ma sɔnɔn, xɔnie fan bara e gi.

sentences.english: Looking, I saw that the fertile field was a waste, and all its towns were broken down before the Lord and before his burning wrath.
sentences.susu: N bara laamatunyi to yi yire xa fe ra. Karemele geya findima nɛ gbengberenyi ra, taa birin fama gande Alatala nun a xa xɔnɛ xa fe nan na.

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord has said: All the land will become a waste; I will make destruction complete.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a masen, «Yi bɔxi birin ɲaxankatama nɛ, kɔnɔ n mu a birin xun nakanama.

sentences.english: The earth will be weeping for this, and the heavens on high will be black: because I have said it, and I will not go back from it; it is my purpose, and it will not be changed.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra yi bɔxi na sunnunyi kui, koore bara ifɔɔrɔ. N tan nan a ragirixi, n mu gbilenma n ma natɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: All the land is in flight because of the noise of the horsemen and the bowmen; they have taken cover in the woodland and up on the rocks: every town has been given up, not a man is living in them.
sentences.susu: Geresoe na fa soe fari, mixi birin e gima nɛ. Geresoe na fa tanbɛe ra, mixi yo mu luma taa kui. Ndee e gima nɛ wondi yire, ndee e gi geyae fari. Mixi birin kelima nɛ taa kui.

sentences.english: And you, when you are made waste, what will you do? Though you are clothed in red, though you make yourself beautiful with ornaments of gold, though you make your eyes wide with paint, it is for nothing that you make yourself fair; your lovers have no more desire for you, they have designs on your life.
sentences.susu: I tan naxan xun nakanaxi, i na munse rabafe? I wama i maxirife dugi fanyi ra, i wama kɔnmagore xɛɛma daaxi ragorofe i ma, i wama tofan se safe i ya kiri ma? I na na birin nabafe i xanuntenyie bɛ fufafu, barima i mu rafan e ma sɔnɔn. E wama i faxafe tun.

sentences.english: A voice has come to my ears like the voice of a woman in birth-pains, the pain of one giving birth to her first child, the voice of the daughter of Zion, fighting for breath, stretching out her hands, saying, Now sorrow is mine! for my strength is gone from me before the takers of life.
sentences.susu: N bara wa xui nde mɛ. Na wa xui luxi nɛ alɔ furi ginɛ naxan na a xa di singe barife. Darisalamu na saya kira xɔn ma, a na a falafe, ‹A gbe mu luxi sɔnɔn, faxɛtie xa n nii ba.›»

sentences.english: Go quickly through the streets of Jerusalem, and see now, and get knowledge, and make a search in her wide places if there is a man, if there is one in her who is upright, who keeps faith; and she will have my forgiveness.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa yire birin mato Darisalamu, wo xa maxɔrinyi ti taa kui, alako wo xa tinxintɔɛ nde to, naxan ɲɛrɛma kira fanyi xɔn ma, naxan birama nɔndi fɔxɔ ra. Xa wo sa na mixi mɔɔli to, n diɲɛma nɛ Darisalamu ma.

sentences.english: And though they say, By the living Lord; truly their oaths are false.
sentences.susu: E e kalima nɛ Alatala xili ra, kɔnɔ na birin findixi wule nan na.

sentences.english: O Lord, do not your eyes see good faith? you have given them punishment, but they were not troubled; you have sent destruction on them, but they did not take your teaching to heart: they have made their faces harder than a rock; they would not come back.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n a kolon i wama tinxinyi nan xɔn ma. I bara Isirayilakae ɲaxankata, kɔnɔ e mu fahaamui yo sɔtɔxi na kui. I bara e tɔɔrɔ, kɔnɔ e mu lɔnni sɔtɔxi na kui. E bɔɲɛ bara xɔrɔxɔ alɔ gɛmɛ, e tondi danxaniyade.

sentences.english: Then I said, But these are the poor: they are foolish, for they have no knowledge of the way of the Lord or of the behaviour desired by their God.
sentences.susu: N bara a fala, setaree gbansan nan yi ɲama ra. Na nan a ra e mu Alatala xa kira kolon, e mu e Marigi Ala xa sɛriyɛ fahaamuma.

sentences.english: I will go to the great men and have talk with them; for they have knowledge of the way of the Lord and of the behaviour desired by their God. But as for these, their one purpose is a broken yoke and burst bands.
sentences.susu: A lanma n xa yi masenyi ti kuntigie nan bɛ, barima e tan Alatala xa kira kolon, e e Marigi Ala xa sɛriyɛ fahaamuma. Kɔnɔ e birin lan, e sese mu tin birade Ala fɔxɔ ra. E birin bara a matandi.

sentences.english: And so a lion from the woods will put them to death, a wolf of the waste land will make them waste, a leopard will keep watch on their towns, and everyone who goes out from them will be food for the beasts; because of the great number of their sins and the increase of their wrongdoing.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra burunyi yɛtɛ e faxama, wulai bare e ibɔɔ. Baratɛ e mɛlɛnma e xa taa sode dɛe ra, a xa e faxa, barima e xa kɛwali kobi bara gbo, han a bara dangi a i.»

sentences.english: How is it possible for you to have my forgiveness for this? your children have given me up, taking their oaths by those who are no gods: when I had given them food in full measure, they were false to their wives, taking their pleasure in the houses of loose women.
sentences.susu: «Darisalamu, a lanma n xa diɲɛ i ma? I xa die bara n nabolo, e e kalima kuye nan xili ra. N nu bara e balo, kɔnɔ e bara n yanfa, e bira langoee fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: They were full of desire, like horses after a meal of grain: everyone went after his neighbour's wife.
sentences.susu: E maniyaxi soe xɛmɛmae nan na, kankan fa bira a dɔxɔboore xa ginɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Am I not to give punishment for these things? says the Lord: will not my soul take payment from such a nation as this?
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: A mu lanma n xa yi mixi mɔɔli ɲaxankata? A mu lanma n xa n gbeɲɔxɔ yi si mɔɔli ma?

sentences.english: Go up against her vines and make waste; let the destruction be complete: take away her branches, for they are not the Lord's.
sentences.susu: Wo te e xa tɛtɛe fari, wo xa e rabira, kɔnɔ wo naxa ɲama birin xun nakana. Wo xa e tɔɔrɔ, barima e mu tinxi birade Alatala fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: For the people of Israel and the people of Judah have been very false to me, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Isirayila nun Yudaya birin bara n yanfa.

sentences.english: They would have nothing to do with the Lord, saying, He will do nothing, and no evil will come to us; we will not see the sword or be short of food:
sentences.susu: E bara Alatala rabolo, e fa a fala, ‹Ala mu na. Won mu fama gbaloe sɔtɔde santidɛgɛma nun kaamɛ ra.›

sentences.english: And the prophets will become wind, and the word is not in them; so it will be done to them.
sentences.susu: E xa namiɲɔnmɛ mu n xui xa masenma. E fe ɲaaxi naxan masenma, na xa gbilen e ma.»

sentences.english: For this reason the Lord, the God of armies, has said: Because you have said this, I will make my words in your mouth a fire, and this people wood, and they will be burned up by it.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra Mangɛ Alatala bara a masen, «Wo to na mɔɔli fala, n bara n ma masenyi lu i dɛ kui. N ma masenyi luxi nɛ alɔ tɛ naxan fama yi ɲama gande alɔ tɛ yege ganma ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: See, I will send you a nation from far away, O people of Israel, says the Lord; a strong nation and an old nation, a nation whose language is strange to you, so that you may not get the sense of their words.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «N xa a fala wo bɛ Isirayila, n fama nɛ ɲama nde ra wo xili ma. Ɲama sɛnbɛma nan a ra naxan kelima yire makuye, naxan bara bu duniɲa, i mu naxan xui kolon, i mu nɔma naxan fahaamude.

sentences.english: Their arrows give certain death, they are all men of war.
sentences.susu: E xa tanbɛ ɲaaxu, e mixi faxama nɛ. Geresoe gbangbalanxi nan e ra.

sentences.english: They will take all the produce of your fields, which would have been food for your sons and your daughters: they will take your flocks and your herds: they will take all your vines and your fig-trees: and with the sword they will make waste your walled towns in which you put your faith.
sentences.susu: E wo xa baloe donma nɛ, e wo xa di birin tongoma nɛ, e wo xa xuruse birin muɲama nɛ, e wo xa sansi sixi birin kanama nɛ, e wo xa taa makantaxie rabirama nɛ e xa santidɛgɛma ra, wo nu laxi taa naxee ra.»

sentences.english: But even in those days, says the Lord, I will not let your destruction be complete.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Kɔnɔ n mu wo birin sɔntɔma.

sentences.english: And it will come about, when you say, Why has the Lord our God done all these things to us? that you will say to them, As you gave me up, making yourselves servants to strange gods in your land, so will you be servants to strange men in a land which is not yours.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li wo a fala, ‹Munfe ra muxu Marigi Ala bara yi fe mɔɔli raba muxu ra?› Ala wo yaabima nɛ, ‹Wo to n nabolo alako wo xa kuyee batu wo xɔnyi, naxee kelixi ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛ ma, wo tan findima na ɲamanɛ xa konyie nan na e tan xɔnyi.›

sentences.english: Say this openly in Jacob and give it out in Judah, saying,
sentences.susu: Wo xa yi masen Yaxuba xa die bɛ, wo xa a fala Yudayakae bɛ,

sentences.english: Give ear now to this, O foolish people without sense; who have eyes but see nothing, and ears without the power of hearing:
sentences.susu: ‹Wo wo tuli mati, wo tan ɲama xaxilitare, ɲama kinikinitare, naxan ya mu se toma, naxan tuli mu fe mɛma.

sentences.english: Have you no fear of me? says the Lord; will you not be shaking with fear before me, who have put the sand as a limit for the sea, by an eternal order, so that it may not go past it? and though it is ever in motion, it is not able to have its way; though the sound of its waves is loud, they are not able to go past it.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Wo mu gaaxuma n ya ra? Wo mu sɛrɛnma n tofe ra, n tan naxan baa naaninyi saxi mɛyɛnyi ra, alako baa naxa dangi yire nde? Baa mɔrɔnyi kelima nɛ, kɔnɔ e mu nɔma dangide naaninyi ra naxan saxi.›

sentences.english: But the heart of this people is uncontrolled and turned away from me; they are broken loose and gone.
sentences.susu: Yi ɲama sondonyi xɔrɔxɔ. E bara Ala matandi, e bara gbilen a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And they do not say in their hearts, Now let us give worship to our God, who gives the rain, the winter and the spring rain, at the right time; who keeps for us the ordered weeks of the grain-cutting.
sentences.susu: E mu a falama e bɔɲɛ kui, ‹Won xa gaaxu won Marigi Alatala ya ra, naxan tunɛ ye ragoroma ɲɛmɛ tɛmui, a fɔlɛ nun a raɲɔnyi, alako xɛ xa xaba a waxati.›

sentences.english: Through your evil-doing these things have been turned away, and your sins have kept back good from you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa kɛwali kobi bara na birin kana, wo xa yunubie bara a niya baloe xa ba wo yi ra.

sentences.english: For there are sinners among my people: they keep watch, like men watching for birds; they put a net and take men in it.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxi ndee masunbuxi n ma ɲama ra, naxee gantanyi italama mixi bɛ alɔ xɔni suxuie.

sentences.english: As the fowl-house is full of birds, so are their houses full of deceit: for this reason they have become great and have got wealth.
sentences.susu: E e xa banxi rafema se muɲaxie ra, alɔ tɔxɔɛ kulɛ naxan nafexi tɔxɔɛe ra. E bannaxi na naafuli mɔɔli nan na.

sentences.english: They have become fat and strong: they have gone far in works of evil: they give no support to the cause of the child without a father, so that they may do well; they do not see that the poor man gets his rights.
sentences.susu: Fe ɲaaxie bara e xungbo han a bara dangi a i. E mu fe fanyi rabama kiridie bɛ, e mu tinxin setaree mabiri. E naafuli nan tun fenma.

sentences.english: Am I not to give punishment for these things? says the Lord: will not my soul take payment from such a nation as this?
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: A mu lanma n xa yi mixi mɔɔli ɲaxankata? A mu lanma n xa n gbeɲɔxɔ yi si mɔɔli ma?

sentences.english: A thing of wonder and fear has come about in the land;
sentences.susu: Fe ratɔnxi naxee mu daxa, nee bara so yi bɔxi kui.

sentences.english: The prophets give false words and the priests give decisions by their direction; and my people are glad to have it so: and what will you do in the end?
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛe na wule falafe, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe na muɲɛ tife, na birin bara rafan n ma ɲama ma. Wo munse rabama wo xa bɔxi munafanyi xa fe ra?»

sentences.english: Go in flight out of Jerusalem, so that you may be safe, you children of Benjamin, and let the horn be sounded in Tekoa, and the flag be lifted up on Beth-haccherem: for evil is looking out from the north, and a great destruction.
sentences.susu: «Bunyaminkae, wo wo gi, wo keli Darisalamu. Sara fe Tekowa, gere tɔnxuma rate Beti Hakeremi, barima ɲaxankatɛ na fafe kelife kɔɔla ma, a gbe mu luxi gbaloe xa wo li.

sentences.english: The fair and delicate one, the daughter of Zion, will be cut off by my hand.
sentences.susu: Siyon, taa tofanyi, n wo xun nakanama nɛ.

sentences.english: Keepers of sheep with their flocks will come to her; they will put up their tents round her; everyone will get food in his place.
sentences.susu: Xuruse dɛmadonyie fama nɛ e xa kiri banxie tide yire, wo xa taa nu na dɛnnaxɛ, e fa e xa xurusee makanta mɛnni.»

sentences.english: Make war ready against her; up! let us go up when the sun is high. Sorrow is ours! for the day is turned and the shades of evening are stretched out.
sentences.susu: «Siyon yaxuie, wo keli, wo gere so na taa xili ma. Wo xa siga yanyi ra. Soge na goro, wo naxa kɔntɔfili,

sentences.english: Up! let us go up by night, and send destruction on her great houses.
sentences.susu: wo man xa siga kɔɛ ra, banxi makantaxie kanade.»

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord of armies has said: Let trees be cut down and an earthwork be placed against Jerusalem: sorrow on the false town! inside her there is nothing but cruel ways.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala bara a masen Siyon yaxuie bɛ, «Wo sa wuri bilie xaba, wo te se yailan alako wo xa so Darisalamu tɛtɛ kui. Taa na a ra naxan lanxi a xa ratɔn, barima e luma e boore tɔɔrɔ ra tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: As the spring keeps its waters cold, so she keeps her evil in her: the sound of cruel and violent behaviour is in her; before me at all times are disease and wounds.
sentences.susu: Fe ɲaaxi minima yi taa kui tɛmui birin, alɔ ye minima kɔlɔnyi kui ki naxɛ. Kobiɲa nun fe ɲaaxi gbansan nan na e tagi. Na birin luxi nɛ alɔ fure n naxan toma tɛmui birin.»

sentences.english: Undergo teaching, O Jerusalem, or my soul will be turned away from you, and I will make you a waste, an unpeopled land.
sentences.susu: «Darisalamu, i xa i tuli mati n ma marasi ra, alako n naxa n makuya i ra, i fa lu alɔ gbengberenyi, mixi mu sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: Everything will be taken from the rest of Israel as the last grapes are taken from the vine; let your hand be turned to the small branches, like one pulling off grapes.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala bara a masen, «Isirayilaka naxee luxi, e birin bama nɛ bɔxi ma, alɔ sansi bogi gbilenma ba ra ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: To whom am I to give word, witnessing so that they may take note? see, their ears are stopped, and they are not able to give attention: see, the word of the Lord has been a cause of shame to them, they have no delight in it.
sentences.susu: «Nde n ma masenyi ramɛma? Nde findima na seede ra? Wo tuli xɔrɔxɔ, wo mu fe mɛma. Wo yoma Alatala xa masenyi ma, wo mu wama a xa marasi xɔn.

sentences.english: For this reason I am full of the wrath of the Lord, I am tired of keeping it in: may it be let loose on the children in the street, and on the band of the young men together: for even the husband with his wife will be taken, the old man with him who is full of days.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa xɔnɛ gbo n bɔɲɛ kui, n xa na fala wo bɛ.» «Ala xa xɔnɛ Isirayilakae birin lima nɛ, dimɛdi naxee berema kira ra, fonike naxee malanma, xɛmɛ nun ginɛ naxee mɔxi a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And their houses will be handed over to others, their fields and their wives together: for my hand will be stretched out against the people of the land, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N nan n bɛlɛxɛ tima e ma tɛmui naxɛ, mixi gbɛtɛe fama nɛ e xa banxie tongode, e xa xɛe, a nun e xa ginɛe.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: For from the least of them even to the greatest, everyone is given up to getting money; from the prophet even to the priest, everyone is working deceit.
sentences.susu: «Kelife dimɛdi ma, dɔxɔfe xɛmɔxi ra, e birin na e yɛtɛ xa geeni nan fenfe. Namiɲɔnmɛ nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ fan na mixi madaxufe.

sentences.english: And they have made little of the wounds of my people, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
sentences.susu: E mu fe gbegbe rabama n ma ɲama malife ra. E a falama, ‹Wo naxa kɔntɔfili, wo bɔɲɛ xa sa.› Kɔnɔ bɔɲɛsa yo mu na.

sentences.english: Let them be put to shame because they have done disgusting things. They had no shame, they were not able to become red with shame: so they will come down with those who are falling: when my punishment comes on them, they will be made low, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: A lanma e xa yaagi e xa fe kobie ra, kɔnɔ e mu yaagima. Yaagitare nan lanxi e ma. Na nan a ra, n fama e rabirade kiiti waxati.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: Take your place looking out on the ways; make search for the old roads, saying, Where is the good way? and go in it that you may have rest for your souls. But they said, We will not go in it.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a masen, «Wo xa kira fanyi fen, wo xa a kolon kira forie nu na ki naxɛ. Kira tinxinxi na minden? Wo xa lu na kira fari alako wo xa bɔɲɛsa sɔtɔ.» Kɔnɔ ɲama bara a yaabi, «Muxu mu wama lufe na kira xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: And I put watchmen over you, saying, Give attention to the sound of the horn; but they said, We will not give attention.
sentences.susu: Ala bara a masen, «N bara wo xa sɔɔrie ti wo xa tɛtɛ fari, naxee mɛɛnima wo ma. Wo xa e xui ramɛ.» Kɔnɔ ɲama bara a yaabi, «Muxu mu wama e xui ramɛfe.»

sentences.english: So then, give ear, you nations, and ...
sentences.susu: Ala bara a masen, «Ɲamanɛ birin, wo wo tuli mati, wo xa a mato naxan fama rabade be.

sentences.english: Give ear, O earth: see, I will make evil come on this people, even the fruit of their thoughts, because they have not given attention to my words, and they would have nothing to do with my law.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa birin, wo wo tuli mati. N tan nan fama yi ɲama ɲaxankatade, n tan nan fama e maɲɔxunyi sare ragbilende e ma, barima e mu tin e tuli matide n ma masenyi ra, e bara yo n ma sɛriyɛ ma.

sentences.english: To what purpose does sweet perfume come to me from Sheba, and spices from a far country? your burned offerings give me no pleasure, your offerings of beasts are not pleasing to me.
sentences.susu: N hayi na e xa surayi sɛrɛxɛ ma, naxan kelixi Seeba? N hayi na e xa labundɛ sɛrɛxɛ ma, naxan kelixi yire makuye? Wo xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie mu rafan n ma, n mu tinma wo xa sɛrɛxɛ sese rasuxude.

sentences.english: For this reason the Lord has said, See, I will put stones in the way of this people: and the fathers and the sons together will go falling over them; the neighbour and his friend will come to destruction.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra Alatala bara a masen, N fama nɛ gɛmɛ dɔxɔde yi ɲama ya ra, e fama e sanyi radinde naxan na. Babae nun e xa die, dɔxɔbooree nun dɛfanbooree, e birin sɔntɔma nɛ.»

sentences.english: The Lord has said, See, a people is coming from the north country, a great nation will be put in motion from the inmost parts of the earth.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a masen, «Ɲama nde na fafe kelife kɔɔla ma, ɲama gbegbe naxan na duniɲa yire birin.

sentences.english: Bows and spears are in their hands; they are cruel and have no mercy; their voice is like the thunder of the sea, and they go on horses; everyone in his place like men going to the fight, against you, O daughter of Zion.
sentences.susu: Xali nun tanbɛ na e yi ra. E ɲaaxu, e mu kinikini kolon. E xui gbo alɔ mɔrɔnyi. Soe kanyie nan e ra. E birin malanxi alako e xa Siyon gere.»

sentences.english: The news of it has come to our ears; our hands have become feeble: trouble has come on us and pain, like the pain of a woman in childbirth.
sentences.susu: Isirayila na wɔyɛnfe e bore tagi, «Won bara e xibaaru mɛ, limaniya bara ba won yi ra, kɔntɔfili bara won suxu. Won na tɔɔrɔfe alɔ ginɛ naxan na di barife.

sentences.english: Go not out into the field or by the way; for there is the sword of the attacker, and fear on every side.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa mini daaxa de, wo naxa ɲɛrɛ kira xɔn ma, barima won yaxuie won nabilinxi, santidɛgɛma na e yi ra.»

sentences.english: O daughter of my people, put on haircloth, rolling yourself in the dust: give yourself to sorrow, as for an only son, with most bitter cries of grief; for he who makes waste will come on us suddenly.
sentences.susu: N bara e yaabi, «N ma ɲama, wo sunnun donma ragoro wo ma, wo xa sunnun alɔ mixi naxan xa di kerenyi bara faxa. Wo xa sunnunyi xa gbo, barima won yaxuie na fafe keren na.»

sentences.english: I have made you a tester among my people, so that you may have knowledge of their way and put it to the test.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a masen n bɛ, «N i findixi mixi nan na naxan n ma ɲama matoma. I xa e mato alako i xa a kolon xa e ɲɛrɛ ki fan. I luxi nɛ alɔ mixi naxan wure nun gbeti raxunuma, a e gbi ba.

sentences.english: All of them are turned away, going about with false stories; they are brass and iron: they are all workers of deceit.
sentences.susu: E birin findixi matandilae nan na naxee yoma Ala ma. E luxi alɔ wure nun yɔxui, naxan gbi mu baxi. E mu fan.

sentences.english: The blower is blowing strongly, the lead is burned away in the fire: they go on heating the metal to no purpose, for the evil-doers are not taken away.
sentences.susu: Xabui tɛ radɛxɛma a fanyi ra alako a xa wure nun yɔxui raxunu, e gbi xa ba. Kɔnɔ fe ɲaaxi mu ɲɔnma n ma ɲama tagi. E luxi nɛ alɔ sunbui naxan mu bama wure kui.

sentences.english: They will be named waste silver, because the Lord has given them up.
sentences.susu: E xili falama ‹gbeti kanaxi›, barima Alatala bara e rabɛɲin.»

sentences.english: The word which came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti Annabi Yeremi bɛ,

sentences.english: Take your place in the doorway of the Lord's house, and give out this word there, and say, Give ear to the word of the Lord, all you of Judah who come inside these doors to give worship to the Lord.
sentences.susu: «I xa ti Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛ ra, i fa yi wɔyɛnyi masen naa, ‹Wo wo tuli mati Alatala xa masenyi ra, wo tan Yudayaka naxee birin soma yi naadɛe ra fafe tuubide Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord of armies, the God of Israel, says, Let your ways and your doings be changed for the better and I will let you go on living in this place.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Mangɛ Alatala naxɛ, xa wo kira masara, wo naxa fe fanyi suxu, n wo luma nɛ yi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Put no faith in false words, saying, The Temple of the Lord, the Temple of the Lord, the Temple of the Lord, are these.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa la yi wule masenyi ra, wo nu fa a fala: Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi nan yi ki, Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi, Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi.

sentences.english: For if your ways and your doings are truly changed for the better; if you truly give right decisions between a man and his neighbour;
sentences.susu: Xa wo kira masara, xa wo fe fanyi suxu, xa wo tinxin wo booree tagi,

sentences.english: If you are not cruel to the man from a strange country, and to the child without a father, and to the widow, and do not put the upright to death in this place, or go after other gods, causing damage to yourselves:
sentences.susu: xa wo mu xɔɲɛ, kiridi, nun kaaɲɛ ginɛ tɔɔrɔ, xa wo mu mixi faxa tɔɔɲɛgɛ ra yi bɔxi ma, xa wo mu bira ala gbɛtɛe fɔxɔ ra, naxee findima tɔɔrɛ ra wo bɛ,

sentences.english: Then I will let you go on living in this place, in the land which I gave to your fathers in the past and for ever.
sentences.susu: na tɛmui n wo luma nɛ yi bɔxi ma abadan, n naxan fixi wo babae ma.

sentences.english: See, you put your faith in false words which are of no profit.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo bara bira wule fɔxɔ ra, naxan mu sese fanma wo ma.

sentences.english: Will you take the goods of others, put men to death, and be untrue to your wives, and take false oaths, and have perfumes burned to the Baal, and go after other gods which are strange to you;
sentences.susu: Munfe ra wo wama faxɛ nun yɛnɛ rabafe, wo wo kali wule ra, wo surayi gan sɛrɛxɛ ra Bala kuye bɛ, wo bira ala gbɛtɛe fɔxɔ ra, wo mu naxee kolon?

sentences.english: And come and take your place before me in this house, which is named by my name, and say, We have been made safe; so that you may do all these disgusting things?
sentences.susu: Na xanbi wo fa fa tide n ya i, n ma banxi kui, n xili matɔxɔma dɛnnaxɛ. Wo naxɛ wo bara kisi, kɔnɔ wo fe xɔnxi rabama.

sentences.english: Has this house, which is named by my name, become a hole of thieves to you? Truly I, even I, have seen it, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo yi banxi findixi mixi ɲaaxi banxi nan na, n xili falama dɛnnaxɛ? N tan Alatala bara a birin to.

sentences.english: But go now to my place which was in Shiloh, where I put my name at first, and see what I did to it because of the evil-doing of my people Israel.
sentences.susu: Wo xa ratu Silo ma, n ma yire sɛniyɛnxi singe nu na dɛnnaxɛ. N bara mɛnni fan ɲaxankata, n ma Isirayila ɲama xa ɲaaxuɲa xa fe ra.›»

sentences.english: And now, because you have done all these works, says the Lord, and I sent my word to you, getting up early and sending, but you did not give ear; and my voice came to you, but you gave no answer:
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya. «Yakɔsi, wo to bara yi fe birin naba, wo to tondi n ma masenyi suxude, n naxan falaxi wo bɛ tɛmui birin, wo to tondi n ma xili ratinde,

sentences.english: For this reason I will do to the house which is named by my name, and in which you have put your faith, and to the place which I gave to you and to your fathers, as I have done to Shiloh.
sentences.susu: n fama nɛ fe rabade yi hɔrɔmɔbanxi ra, alɔ n naxan nabaxi Silo ra. N na mɔɔli rabama nɛ yi banxi ra, n naxan fixi wo nun wo babae ma, wo laxi naxan na.

sentences.english: And I will send you away from before my face, as I have sent away all your brothers, even all the seed of Ephraim.
sentences.susu: N wo makuyama nɛ n yire ra, alɔ n wo ngaxakerenyie Efirami bɔnsɔɛ makuyaxi n na ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And as for you (Jeremiah), make no prayers for this people, send up no cry or prayer for them, make no request for them to me: for I will not give ear.
sentences.susu: «I tan, hali i mu Ala maxandi yi ɲama bɛ, hali i mu i xui ite salide, hali i mu n makula, barima n mu i danxunma.

sentences.english: Do you not see what they are doing in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem?
sentences.susu: I mu a toxi fe naxan nabama Yudaya taae nun Darisalamu kui?

sentences.english: The children go for wood, the fathers get the fire burning, the women are working the paste to make cakes for the queen of heaven, and drink offerings are drained out to other gods, moving me to wrath.
sentences.susu: E xa die yege matongoma, babae tɛ radɛxɛma, ginɛe fan taami xinde ramulanma, e a ramɔndɔ kuye bɛ, wo naxan xilima koore mangɛ ginɛ. E man minse bama sɛrɛxɛ ra. Na kui e bara n naxɔnɔ,

sentences.english: Are they moving me to wrath? says the Lord; are they not moving themselves to their shame?
sentences.susu: n tan fan fama nɛ e tɔɔrɔde.» Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «E bara e yɛtɛ tɔɔrɔ, e bara e yɛtɛ kan nayaagi.

sentences.english: So this is what the Lord God has said: See, my wrath and my passion will be let loose on this place, on man and beast, and on the trees of the field, and on the produce of the earth; it will be burning and will not be put out.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi n tan Marigi Alatala naxɛ, ‹N ma ɲaxankatɛ na yi bɔxi ma, mixie nun subee nun bogisee ma. E birin fama nɛ gande tɛ ra, naxan mu xubenma.›»

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord of armies, the God of Israel: Put your burned offerings with your offerings of beasts, and take flesh for your food.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Mangɛ Alatala naxa a masen, «Wo xa wo xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi fan don.

sentences.english: For I said nothing to your fathers, and gave them no orders, on the day when I took them out of Egypt, about burned offerings or offerings of beasts:
sentences.susu: N mu sɛrɛxɛ fe gbansan xa fala wo babae bɛ, n to e ramini Misira bɔxi ra.

sentences.english: But this was the order I gave them, saying, Give ear to my voice, and I will be your God, and you will be my people: go in all the way ordered by me, so that all may be well for you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n e yaamari yi nan na, ‹Wo bira n xui fɔxɔ ra, alako n xa findi wo Marigi Ala ra, wo fan xa findi n ma ɲama ra. Wo xa ɲɛrɛ n ma kira xɔn ma, n naxan masenxi wo bɛ, alako wo xa hɛɛri sɔtɔ.›

sentences.english: But they took no note and did not give ear, but were guided by the thoughts and the pride of their evil hearts, going back and not forward.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e mu e tuli mati n na, e bara bira e xa maɲɔxun kobi fɔxɔ ra, e bara e kobe ti n na, e mu biraxi n fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: From the day when your fathers came out of Egypt till this day, I have sent my servants the prophets to you, getting up early every day and sending them:
sentences.susu: Kabi wo babae naxa mini Misira bɔxi ra han to, n na n ma konyi namiɲɔnmɛe xɛɛfe wo ma.

sentences.english: But still they took no note and would not give ear, but they made their necks stiff, doing worse than their fathers.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo mu wo tuli matixi n na. Wo xaxili xɔrɔxɔxi, wo bara kobi dangife wo babae ra.»

sentences.english: And you are to say all these words to them, but they will not give ear to you: you will send out your voice to them, but they will give no answer.
sentences.susu: «I na yi wɔyɛnyi birin fala e bɛ, e mu i danxunma. I na e xili, e mu a ratinma.

sentences.english: And you are to say to them, This is the nation which has not given ear to the voice of their God, or taken his teaching to heart: good faith is dead and is cut off from their mouths.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui i xa a fala e bɛ, ‹Si nan ya naxan mu e tuli matima e Marigi Alatala xa masenyi ra. E mu marasi mɛma. Sɛriyɛ yo mu na e yi ra.›

sentences.english: Let your hair be cut off, O Jerusalem, and let it go, and let a song of grief go up on the open hilltops; for the Lord is turned away from the generation of his wrath and has given them up.
sentences.susu: I xunsɛxɛ maxaba, i naxan naluxi i xa kali xa fe ra. Alatala bara xɔnɔ, a bara yi ɲama rabɛɲin.

sentences.english: For the children of Judah have done what is evil in my eyes, says the Lord: they have put their disgusting images in the house which is named by my name, making it unclean.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae bara fe raba n mu wama naxan tofe. E bara fe xɔnxi dɔxɔ n ma banxi kui, n xili falama dɛnnaxɛ. E bara na findi yire sɛniyɛntare ra.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And they have put up the high place of Topheth in the valley of the son of Hinnom, burning their sons and their daughters there in the fire; a thing which was not ordered by me and never came into my mind.
sentences.susu: «E bara kuye batude yailan geya fari Tofeti nun Hinoma gulunba kui, alako e xa e xa die gan sɛrɛxɛ ra. N tan mu e yamarixi na fe mɔɔli ra, a makuya n ma maɲɔxunyi ra pon.»

sentences.english: For this cause, the days are coming, says the Lord, when it will no longer be named Topheth, or, The valley of the son of Hinnom, but, The valley of Death: for they will put the dead into the earth in Topheth till there is no more room.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya. «Lɔxɔɛ fama fade Tofeti xili masarama nɛ. Hinoma gulunba fama nɛ xilide Faxɛ Tide. Tofeti findima nɛ gaburi yire ra.

sentences.english: And the bodies of this people will be food for the birds of heaven and for the beasts of the earth; and there will be no one to send them away.
sentences.susu: Xɔnie nun subee fama nɛ na ɲama binbie donde. Mixi yo mu luma naa naxan e kerima.

sentences.english: And in the towns of Judah and in the streets of Jerusalem, I will put an end to the laughing voices, the voice of joy and the voice of the newly-married man and the voice of the bride: for the land will become a waste.
sentences.susu: Xulunyi ɲɔnma nɛ Yudaya nun Darisalamu bɔxi kui. Sigi mu sama, yeliba mu wɔyɛnma. Fuuti mu xirima na gbaloe xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: At that time, says the Lord, they will take the bones of the kings of Judah, and the bones of his rulers, and the bones of the priests, and the bones of the prophets, and the bones of the people of Jerusalem out of their resting-places:
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Na waxati Yudaya mangɛe, kuntigie, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, namiɲɔnmɛe, nun Darisalamukae, e xɔrie ratema nɛ gaburi kui,

sentences.english: And they will put them out before the sun and the moon and all the stars of heaven, whose lovers and servants they have been, after whom they have gone, to whom they have made prayers, and to whom they have given worship: they will not be put together or placed in the earth; they will be waste on the face of the earth.
sentences.susu: e sa rayensen kɛnɛ ma soge, kike, nun tunbuie bun ma, e naxee xanu, e naxee batu, e bira naxee fɔxɔ ra, e naxee fen, e tuubi naxee bɛ. Na nan a ra, e xɔrie mu sama gaburi kui, e xa rayensen bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And death will be desired more than life by the rest of this evil family who are still living in all the places where I have sent them away, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee mu faxa na ɲama ɲaaxi ya ma, n fama nɛ e rayensende ɲamanɛ ma, faxɛ xɔli e suxuma dɛnnaxɛ.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Further, you are to say to them, This is what the Lord has said: Will those who are falling not be lifted up again? will he who has gone away not come back?
sentences.susu: I xa a fala e bɛ, «Alatala bara a masen, ‹Mixi nɔma birade, e mu keli? Mixi nɔma e mafindide, e mu gbilen?›

sentences.english: Why do these people of Jerusalem go back, for ever turning away? they will not give up their deceit, they will not come back.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra Darisalamu ɲama n matandima? Munfe ra e gbilenxi kira fanyi fɔxɔ ra, e bira kira ɲaaxi fɔxɔ ra? Yi mixie luma nɛ e xa yanfɛ kui, e tondi gbilende n ma.

sentences.english: I took note and gave ear, but no one said what is right: no man had regret for his evil-doing, saying, What have I done? everyone goes off on his way like a horse rushing to the fight.
sentences.susu: N nan n tuli matima nɛ e xui ra, kɔnɔ e xa wɔyɛnyi mu lanma. Mixi yo mu gbilenma a xa kobiɲa fɔxɔ ra. A mu a falama, ‹N na munse rabafe?› Kankan birama a yɛtɛ waxɔnfe nan fɔxɔ ra, alɔ soe naxan gbataxi sigafe gere sode.

sentences.english: Truly, the stork in the heavens is conscious of her fixed times; the dove and the swallow and the crane keep to the times of their coming; but my people have no knowledge of the law of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Hali gbongboe naxan na koore ma, a gbilen waxati kolon. Ganbɛ, turunna, nun yedɔnmɛ birin e e gbilen waxati kolon. Kɔnɔ n ma ɲama mu Alatala xa sɛriyɛ kolon.»

sentences.english: How is it that you say, We are wise and the law of the Lord is with us? But see, the false pen of the scribes has made it false.
sentences.susu: «Wo a falama, ‹Lɔnnilae nan muxu ra, muxu Alatala xa sɛriyɛ kolon.› Kɔnɔ wo na falama di? Wo xa diinɛ sɛbɛlitie bara Ala xa sɛriyɛ masara wule ra.

sentences.english: The wise men are shamed, they are overcome with fear and taken: see, they have given up the word of the Lord; and what use is their wisdom to them?
sentences.susu: Wo xa lɔnnilae bara yaagi, e xaxili bara ifu, barima e bara xanin konyiya kui. E bara na sɔtɔ barima e yoxi Alatala xa masenyi ma. E findixi lɔnnila mɔɔli mundun na?»

sentences.english: So I will give their wives to others, and their fields to those who will take them for themselves: for everyone, from the least to the greatest, is given up to getting money; from the priest even to the prophet, everyone is false.
sentences.susu: «Na nan a ra n fama e xa ginɛe fide xɛmɛ gbɛtɛe ma. Mixi gbɛtɛe fama e xa xɛe bade e yi ra, barima e birin na e yɛtɛ xa geeni gbansan nan fenfe. A fɔlɔfe e xa namiɲɔnmɛe ma, a sa dɔxɔ e xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra, e birin na wule falafe.

sentences.english: And they have made little of the wounds of the daughter of Zion, saying, Peace, peace; when there is no peace.
sentences.susu: E mu fe gbegbe rabama n ma ɲama malife ra. E a falama, ‹Wo naxa kɔntɔfili, wo bɔɲɛ xa sa.› Kɔnɔ bɔɲɛsa yo mu na.

sentences.english: Let them be put to shame because they have done disgusting things. They had no shame, they were not able to become red with shame: so they will come down with those who are falling: in the time of their punishment they will be made low, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: A lanma e xa yaagi e xa fe kobie ra, kɔnɔ e mu yaagima. Yaagitare nan lanxi e ma. Na nan a ra, n fama e rabirade kiiti waxati.» Alatala xa wɔyɛnyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: I will put an end to them completely, says the Lord: there are no grapes on the vine and no figs on the fig-tree, and the leaf is dry.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «N bara natɛ tongo n xa e rabolo. N mu wɛni bogi fima e ma, n mu xɔrɛ bogi raminima e xa xɔrɛ bilie kɔn na. E burɛxɛ lisima nɛ, mixi gbɛtɛe fa e bogi bade.»

sentences.english: Why are we seated doing nothing? come together, and let us go to the walled towns, and let destruction overtake us there, for the Lord our God has sent destruction on us, and given us bitter water for our drink, because we have done evil against the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Won na munse rabafe be? Won xa malan, won xa won gi taa makantaxie kui, won xa faxa naa, barima won Marigi Alatala bara natɛ tongo a xa won sɔntɔ, a xa xɔnɛ dɔxɔ won ma won ma yunubie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: We were looking for peace, but no good came; and for a time of well-being, but there is only a great fear.
sentences.susu: Won bara wa bɔɲɛsa xɔn, kɔnɔ bɔɲɛsa yo mu na. Won bara wa yalanyi xɔn, kɔnɔ gere bara keli.

sentences.english: The loud breathing of the horses comes to our ears from Dan: at the sound of the outcry of his war-horses, all the land is shaking with fear; for they have come, and have made a meal of the land and everything in it; the town and the people living in it.
sentences.susu: Won yaxuie xa soe xui mɛma Dana bɔxi mabiri, bɔxi birin na sɛrɛnfe na xui ma. E fama nɛ bɔxi birin xun nakanade, e fa mixi birin sɔntɔde.»

sentences.english: See, I will send snakes and poison-snakes among you, against which the wonder-worker has no power; and they will give you wounds which may not be made well, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «N na be. N bara bɔximase ɲaaxie rasanba wo ma. Mixi yo mu nɔma e ra, e wo xinma nɛ.»

sentences.english: Sorrow has come on me! my heart in me is feeble.
sentences.susu: «Fɛɛrɛ yo mu na, n bɔɲɛ bara tɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: The voice of the cry of the daughter of my people comes from a far land: Is the Lord not in Zion? is not her King in her? Why have they made me angry with their images and their strange gods which are no gods?
sentences.susu: I tuli mati n bɔnsɔɛ wa xui ra naxan kelife yire makuye. E a falama, ‹Alatala mu na Siyon? Siyon mangɛ mu na sɔnɔn?› Ala e yaabima nɛ, ‹Munfe ra e wama n naxɔnɔfe e xa kuyee ra naxee tide yo mu na, naxee kelixi yire makuye?›

sentences.english: The grain-cutting is past, the summer is ended, and no salvation has come to us.
sentences.susu: Xɛ xaba tɛmui bara dangi, sogofure fan bara dangi. Han ya won mu kisi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: For the destruction of the daughter of my people I am broken: I am dressed in the clothing of grief; fear has taken me in its grip.
sentences.susu: N bɔnsɔɛ xa tɔɔrɛ bara findi kote ra n bɛ. N bara kinikini, limaniya bara ba n yi ra.

sentences.english: Is there no life-giving oil in Gilead? is there no expert in medical arts? why then have my people not been made well?
sentences.susu: Seri yo mu na Galadi bɔxi ma? Seriba yo mu naa? Munfe ra n bɔnsɔɛ mu nɔma yalande?

sentences.english: If only my head was a stream of waters and my eyes fountains of weeping, so that I might go on weeping day and night for the dead of the daughter of my people!
sentences.susu: «Xa a sa li n mixi nde sɔtɔ naxee na biyaasi kui, n kafuma nee nan ma, n na n ma ɲama rabɛɲin. N wama n makuyafe nɛ e ra, barima yɛnɛlae nun yanfantee nan e ra.

sentences.english: If only I had in the waste land a night's resting-place for travellers, so that I might go away, far from my people! for they are all untrue, a band of false men.
sentences.susu: E dɛ wule falama alɔ sɔɔri naxan tanbɛ wolima. Wule sɛnbɛ gbo e ya ma, e mu nɔndi kolon. E luma yunubi raba ra, e mu n kolon.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Their tongues are bent like a bow to send out false words: they have become strong in the land, but not for good faith: they go on from evil to evil, and they have no knowledge of me, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa la wo boore ra, wo naxa la wo ngaxakerenyi ra, barima birin luma nɛ e boore madaxu ra, e birin bira tɔɔɲɛgɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Let everyone keep watch on his neighbour, and put no faith in any brother: for every brother will certainly be tricking his brother, and every neighbour will go about saying evil.
sentences.susu: Kankan wule falama e boore bɛ, yanfanteya gbo e ya ma. E dɛ bara wule matinkan, e luma na yunubi kira nan xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Everyone will make sport of his neighbour with deceit, not saying what is true: their tongues have been trained to say false words; they are twisted, hating to come back.
sentences.susu: Yanfantee nan e ra, e mu wama n tan kolonfe.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: There is wrong on wrong, deceit on deceit; they have given up the knowledge of me, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala bara a masen, «N fama nɛ e matode, alɔ xabui naxan wure raxunuma alako a gbi xa ba. N fama nɛ fe nde rabade e xa ɲaaxuɲa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: So the Lord of armies has said, See, I will make them soft in the fire and put them to the test; this I will do because of their evil-doing.
sentences.susu: Wule falɛ nan e ra, yanfanteya rafan e ma. E fe fanyi falama e boore bɛ e dɛ nan kui, kɔnɔ yanfanteya na e bɔɲɛ ma.

sentences.english: His tongue is an arrow causing death; the words of his mouth are deceit: he says words of peace to his neighbour, but in his heart he is waiting secretly for him.
sentences.susu: A mu lanma n xa e ɲaxankata na fe ma? A mu lanma xɛ e sare xa fi?» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Am I not to send punishment for these things? says the Lord: will not my soul take payment from such a nation as this?
sentences.susu: «N ya ye raminima geyae nun gbengberenyie xa fe ra. Na birin ganxi, mixi mu na, xuruse mu na.

sentences.english: Give yourselves to weeping, crying out in sorrow for the mountains; and for the fields of the waste land send up a song of grief, because they are burned up, so that no one goes through; there is no sound of cattle; the bird of the heavens and the beast are in flight and are gone.
sentences.susu: N gɛmɛe malanma nɛ yire Darisalamu nu na dɛnnaxɛ, mɛnni xa findi wulai baree xɔnyi ra. N Yudaya taae findima nɛ gbaloe yire ra, mixi yo mu lu naa.»

sentences.english: And I will make Jerusalem a mass of broken stones, the living-place of jackals; and I will make the towns of Judah a waste, with no man living there.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi mundun nɔma na fe fahaamude? Xa Ala bara na tagi raba mixi nde bɛ, a xa a masen muxu bɛ. Be bɔxi findixi gbaloe bɔxi nan na, a birin ganxi, mixi mu na.»

sentences.english: Who is the wise man able to see this? who is he to whom the word of the Lord has come, so that he may make it clear? why is the land given to destruction and burned up like a waste place, so that no one goes through?
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a masen, «Na gbaloe e lixi nɛ barima e bara n ma sɛriyɛ rabolo n naxan fixi e ma. E mu e tuli matixi n ma masenyi ra, e mu n ma yaamarie rabatuxi.

sentences.english: And the Lord said, Because they have given up my law which I put before them, giving no attention to my voice and not being guided by it;
sentences.susu: E bara bira e yɛtɛ waxɔnfe fɔxɔ ra, e nu Bali kuyee batu e babae naxee masenxi e bɛ.

sentences.english: But they have been walking in the pride of their hearts, going after the Baals, as their fathers gave them teaching.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra n tan Isirayila Marigi Alatala bara natɛ tongo yi ɲama xa pɔsɔnɛ gerun.

sentences.english: So the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said, I will give them, even this people, bitter plants for food and bitter water for drink.
sentences.susu: N e rayensenma nɛ ɲamanɛ ma, e tan nun e babae mu dɛnnaxɛ kolon, n e sɔntɔma nɛ santidɛgɛma ra.»

sentences.english: And I will send them wandering among the nations, among people strange to them and to their fathers: and I will send the sword after them till I have put an end to them.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Wo wo tuli mati. Wo mixie xili naxee fata wade, e xa e wa xui ramini.

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: Take thought and send for the weeping women, so that they may come; and send for the wise women, so that they may come:
sentences.susu: E xa e xulun e wa xui raminide. Won tan fan xa wa, ya ye xa mini.»

sentences.english: Let them quickly make cries of sorrow for us, so that drops may be flowing from our eyes till they are streaming with water.
sentences.susu: Wa xui minima Siyon taa kui: «Won bara gbaloe sɔtɔ, won bara lu yaagi kui. Won bara keli won ma bɔxi ma, won ma banxie bara kana.»

sentences.english: For a sound of weeping goes up from Zion, a cry, How has destruction come on us? we are overcome with shame because we have gone away from our land; he has sent us out from our house.
sentences.susu: «Wo tan ginɛe, wo wo tuli mati Alatala xa masenyi ra, wo wo tuli mati a xa wɔyɛnyi ra. Wo wo xa die nun wo booree matinkan wa ra,

sentences.english: But even now, give ear to the word of the Lord, O you women; let your ears be open to the word of his mouth, training your daughters to give cries of sorrow, everyone teaching her neighbour a song of grief.
sentences.susu: barima faxɛ bara so won xɔnyi. Won ma die bara faxa kira ra, won ma fonikee bara faxa taa kui.»

sentences.english: For death has come up into our windows, forcing its way into our great houses; cutting off the children in the streets and the young men in the wide places.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «A fala ɲama bɛ mixie na faxafe, e luxi bɔxi ma alɔ maale xiri naxee xabaxi, kɔnɔ mixi mu na naxan e malanma.»

sentences.english: The bodies of men will be falling like waste on the open fields, and like grain dropped by the grain-cutter, and no one will take them up.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Lɔnnila naxa a yɛtɛ matɔxɔ a xa lɔnni xa fe ra. Sɛnbɛma naxa a yɛtɛ matɔxɔ a sɛnbɛ xa fe ra. Banna mixi naxa a yɛtɛ matɔxɔ a xa bannaya xa fe ra.

sentences.english: This is the word of the Lord: Let not the wise man take pride in his wisdom, or the strong man in his strength, or the man of wealth in his wealth:
sentences.susu: Xa mixi wama a yɛtɛ matɔxɔfe fe nde ma, a xa a yɛtɛ matɔxɔ a xa danxaniya nan ma fe ra. Alatala nan n na, hinnɛnte naxan tinxinyi nun sɛriyɛ rawalima duniɲa ma. Na fe mɔɔli rafan n ma.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: But if any man has pride, let it be in this, that he has the wisdom to have knowledge of me, that I am the Lord, working mercy, giving true decisions, and doing righteousness in the earth: for in these things I have delight, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Lɔxɔɛ fama fade, n mixi halakima nɛ, naxan sunnaxi kɔnɔ a bɔɲɛ mu sɛniyɛn,

sentences.english: See, the day is coming, says the Lord, when I will send punishment on all those who have circumcision in the flesh;
sentences.susu: alɔ Misirakae, Yudayakae, Edonkae, Amonikae, Mowabakae, naxee birin e xunsɛxɛ maxabama naxan na e xunyi sɛɛtie ma. Yi si birin naxee na gbengberenyi ma, e sunnaxi, kɔnɔ e mu sunna wali rabama. Hali Isirayilakae mu sunna wali rabama, e bɔɲɛ mu sɛniyɛn.»

sentences.english: Give ear to the word which the Lord says to you, O people of Israel:
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ, wo wo tuli mati Alatala xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: Do not go in the way of the nations; have no fear of the signs of heaven, for the nations go in fear of them.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Wo naxa bira si gbɛtɛe ɲɛrɛ ki fɔxɔ ra. Wo naxa gaaxu tɔnxumae ya ra naxee na koore ma. Si gbɛtɛe gaaxuma na fe mɔɔli nan ya ra.

sentences.english: For that which is feared by the people is foolish: it is the work of the hands of the workman; for a tree is cut down by him out of the woods with his axe.
sentences.susu: E xa diinɛ mu findixi nɔndi ra. E wuri sɛgɛma wula i, mixi nde a masoli beera ra.

sentences.english: They make it beautiful with silver and gold; they make it strong with nails and hammers, so that it may not be moved.
sentences.susu: E a raxunma gbeti nun xɛɛma ra, e lantuma mabanban dɛrɛma ra alako a naxa bira.

sentences.english: It is like a pillar in a garden of plants, and has no voice: it has to be lifted, for it has no power of walking. Have no fear of it; for it has no power of doing evil and it is not able to do any good.
sentences.susu: Na kuyee mu nɔma wɔyɛnde. A luxi nɛ alɔ wuri naxan tixi laakɔɛ yire xɔnie magaaxu se. A mu nɔma ɲɛrɛde, fo mixi a xanin. Wo naxa gaaxu na kuye mɔɔli ya ra, barima a mu nɔma fe ɲaaxi xa na mu a fanyi rabade.

sentences.english: There is no one like you, O Lord; you are great and your name is great in power.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i maniyɛ mu na. I sɛnbɛ gbo, i xili magaaxu.

sentences.english: Who would not have fear of you, O King of the nations? for it is your right: for among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is no one like you.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa mangɛ, nde na naxan mu gaaxuma i ya ra? A lanma duniɲa birin xa gaaxu i ya ra, barima i maniyɛ yo mu na duniɲa lɔnnilae tagi, xa na mu a ra duniɲa mangɛe ya ma.

sentences.english: But they are together like beasts and foolish: the teaching of false gods is wood.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa mixi findixi lɔnnitare nun xaxilitare nan na. Na kolonma e xa wuri batui nan kui.

sentences.english: Silver hammered into plates is sent from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz, the work of the expert workman and of the hands of the gold-worker; blue and purple is their clothing, all the work of expert men.
sentences.susu: Kuyee findixi gbeti nan na Tarasisi daaxi, a findixi xɛɛma ra Ufasi daaxi. Xabui nan a yailanma. Dugi gbeeli ragoroxi a ma. Walikɛe nan kuye yailanma.

sentences.english: But the Lord is the true God; he is the living God and an eternal king: when he is angry, the earth is shaking with fear, and the nations give way before his wrath.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala nan findixi Ala ra nɔndi ki ma. Ala ɲiɲɛ nan Mangɛ ra abadan. Duniɲa sɛrɛnma a xa xɔnɛ nan ya ra, sie mu nɔma tide a ya ra.

sentences.english: This is what you are to say to them: The gods who have not made the heavens and the earth will be cut off from the earth and from under the heavens.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a masen e bɛ, ‹Yi kuyee xa mu duniɲa nun koore daaxi, e mu nɔma bude duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari.›»

sentences.english: He has made the earth by his power, he has made the world strong in its place by his wisdom, and by his wise design the heavens have been stretched out.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan bɔxi daa a sɛnbɛ ra, a duniɲa ti a xa lɔnni ra, a koore walaxɛ itala a xaxili ra.

sentences.english: At the sound of his voice there is a massing of waters in the heavens, and he makes the mists go up from the ends of the earth; he makes the thunder-flames for the rain, and sends out the wind from his store-houses.
sentences.susu: A na yaamari fi, ye xa malan koore ma, a malanma nɛ, a findi nuxui ra duniɲa xun ma, ye nun foye na mini, galanyi fan a xui ramini.

sentences.english: Then every man becomes like a beast without knowledge; every gold-worker is put to shame by the image he has made: for his metal image is deceit, and there is no breath in them.
sentences.susu: Adamadi xaxili mu na. Kuye yailanma fama nɛ yaagide a xa wali xa fe ra, barima kuyee findixi wule nan na, e mu ɲɛngima fefe ma.

sentences.english: They are nothing, a work of error: in the time of their punishment, destruction will overtake them.
sentences.susu: Se fufafu nan e ra, e findixi mixi xa wali nan na naxee tide yo mu na, naxee dangima duniɲa ɲaxankatama lɔxɔɛ naxɛ.

sentences.english: The heritage of Jacob is not like these; for the maker of all things is his heritage: the Lord of armies is his name.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba Marigi mu maniyama kuye ra. Yaxuba Marigi nan birin daaxi, a Isirayila sugandi a xa ɲama ra. A xili falama nɛ Mangɛ Alatala.

sentences.english: Get your goods together and go out of the land, O you who are shut up in the walled town.
sentences.susu: Wo wo harige malan, wo tan naxee na taa suxuxi kui,

sentences.english: For the Lord has said, I will send the people in flight like a stone from the land at this time, troubling them so that they will be conscious of it.
sentences.susu: barima Alatala bara a masen, «N bekae kerima nɛ alɔ mixi naxan gɛmɛ wolima laati ra. N e halakima nɛ, e mu kisima.»

sentences.english: Sorrow is mine for I am wounded! my wound may not be made well; and I said, Cruel is my disease, I may not be free from it.
sentences.susu: «Ɲaxankatɛ birin na n bɛ, n ma tɔɔrɛ gbo. Kɔnɔ n a falama nɛ n yɛtɛ bɛ, tɔɔrɛ nan a ra n naxan sɔtɔ, n xa tin na ra.

sentences.english: My tent is pulled down and all my cords are broken: my children have gone from me, and they are not: no longer is there anyone to give help in stretching out my tent and hanging up my curtains.
sentences.susu: N ma kiri banxi bara bira, a luutie bara bolon. N ma die bara keli n xun ma, mixi yo mu na naxan n malima banxi tide.

sentences.english: For the keepers of the sheep have become like beasts, not looking to the Lord for directions: so they have not done wisely and all their flocks have been put to flight.
sentences.susu: Isirayila yareratie xaxili mu na, e mu Alatala fenxi. E xaxilitareɲa toma na kui. E fɔxirabirɛe yensenxi na nan ma.

sentences.english: News is going about, see, it is coming, a great shaking is coming from the north country, so that the towns of Judah may be made waste and become the living-place of jackals.
sentences.susu: Won xui magaaxuxi mɛma nɛ naxan kelixi kɔɔla ma, naxan fama Yudaya xa taae kanade, e xa findi wulai baree xɔnyi ra.

sentences.english: O Lord, I am conscious that a man's way is not in himself: man has no power of guiding his steps.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n a kolon adamadi mu fefe ragirima, a mu a yɛtɛ raɲɛrɛma duniɲɛigiri kui.

sentences.english: O Lord, put me right, but with wise purpose; not in your wrath, or you will make me small.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n matinxin i xa sɛriyɛ ra, kɔnɔ i naxa xɔnɔ n ma, xa na mu a ra n faxama nɛ.

sentences.english: Let your wrath be let loose on the nations which have no knowledge of you, and on the families who give no worship to your name: for they have made a meal of Jacob, truly they have made a meal of him and put an end to him and made his fields a waste.
sentences.susu: I xa xɔnɔ si gbɛtɛe nan ma naxee mu i kolon, i xa xɔnɔ ɲamae nan ma naxee mu i xili falama, barima e wama Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ nan faxafe, e wama e xun nakanafe nɛ, e xa e sɔntɔ, e wa e xɔnyi xa findi gbaloe yire ra.»

sentences.english: The word which came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti Annabi Yeremi bɛ,

sentences.english: Give ear to the words of this agreement, and say to the men of Judah and to the people of Jerusalem,
sentences.susu: «A fala Yudayakae nun Darisalamukae bɛ, ‹Wo wo tuli mati yi saatɛ ra.

sentences.english: The Lord, the God of Israel, has said, Let that man be cursed who does not give ear to the words of this agreement,
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Ala bara a masen, dankɛ na tuli xɔri bɛ naxan mu yi saatɛ ramɛma,

sentences.english: To the order which I gave your fathers on the day when I took them out of the land of Egypt, out of the oven of iron, saying, Give ear to my voice, and do all the orders I have given you: so you will be my people, and I will be your God:
sentences.susu: saatɛ n naxan masenxi wo babae bɛ e mini lɔxɔɛ kelife ra Misira bɔxi ma. E to keli naa fe xɔrɔxɔɛ kui, n naxa a fala e bɛ, Wo xa wo tuli mati n na, wo xa n ma yaamari rabatu. Na kui wo findima nɛ n ma ɲama ra, n fan findi wo Marigi Ala ra.
