sentences.susu: Si gbegbe dangima nɛ naa, e fa a fala e boore bɛ, ‹Munfe ra Alatala yi mɔɔli rabaxi yi taa xungbe ra?›

sentences.english: And they will say, Because they gave up the agreement of the Lord their God, and became worshippers and servants of other gods.
sentences.susu: Nde e yaabima nɛ, ‹E Marigi Alatala na rabaxi nɛ barima e bara a xa saatɛ rabɛɲin, e fa ala gbɛtɛe batu, e tuubi e bɛ.›»

sentences.english: Let there be no weeping for the dead, and make no songs of grief for him: but make bitter weeping for him who has gone away, for he will never come back or see again the country of his birth.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa ɲɔnfe raba mixi faxaxie bɛ, wo naxa sunnun. Wo xa wa mixie bɛ naxee xaninma ɲamanɛ ma, barima e mu gbilenma e xɔnyi abadan.

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord has said about Shallum, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, who became king in place of Josiah his father, who went out from this place: He will never come back there again:
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a masen Yosiya xa di Salumu xa fe ra, naxan nu bara ti mangɛ ra a baba ɲɔxɔɛ ra, ‹A mu gbilenma abadan.

sentences.english: But death will come to him in the place where they have taken him away prisoner, and he will never see this land again.
sentences.susu: A faxama ɲamanɛ nan ma e a xaninma dɛnnaxɛ. A mu yi bɔxi toma sɔnɔn.›»

sentences.english: A curse is on him who is building his house by wrongdoing, and his rooms by doing what is not right; who makes use of his neighbour without payment, and gives him nothing for his work;
sentences.susu: «Ɲaxankatɛ na mixi bɛ naxan banxi tima tinxintareya kui, naxan a fari idɔxɔma muɲɛ saabui ra, naxan mixi rawalima tɔɔrɛ kui, a tondi sare sode a xa walikɛ yi ra.

sentences.english: Who says, I will make a wide house for myself, and rooms of great size, and has windows cut out, and has it roofed with cedar and painted with bright red.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na mixi bɛ naxan a falama, ‹N xa banxi belebele ti n yɛtɛ bɛ, naxan kui gbo, wundɛri wuya naxan ma, naxan xunmasaxi sɛdiri wuri ra, naxan masoxi se gbeeli ra.›

sentences.english: Are you to be a king because you make more use of cedar than your father? did not your father take food and drink and do right, judging in righteousness, and then it was well for him?
sentences.susu: I findixi mangɛ ra sɛdiri wuri nan ma fe ra? I baba mu baloe nun minse sɔtɔxi xɛ? Kɔnɔ a naxa tinxinyi nun fe fanyi raba, na nan findixi sɔɔnɛya ra a bɛ.

sentences.english: He was judge in the cause of the poor and those in need; then it was well. Was not this to have knowledge of me? says the Lord.
sentences.susu: A naxa setare nun tɔɔrɔmixi ratanga, na nan findixi sɔɔnɛya ra a bɛ. Na birin a masenxi nɛ a bara n kolon.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: But your eyes and your heart are fixed only on profit for yourself, on causing the death of him who has done no wrong, and on violent and cruel acts.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ i tan birama i yɛtɛ xa geeni nan tun fɔxɔ ra, hali na fa findi faxɛ tife ra, hali na fa findi mixi tɔɔrɔfe ra.

sentences.english: So this is what the Lord has said about Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, king of Judah: They will make no weeping for him, saying, Ah my brother! or, Ah sister! they will make no weeping for him, saying, Ah lord! or, Ah his glory!
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi Alatala masenyi tixi Yosiya xa di Yehoyakimi xa fe ra, Yudaya mangɛ, ‹E mu nɔma a binyade ɲɔnfe ra, e mu a falama, N taara, N marigi.›

sentences.english: They will do to him what they do to the dead body of an ass; his body will be pulled out and placed on the earth outside the doors of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: E mu a ragatama, a luma nɛ alɔ sofale faxaxi naxan wɔlɛma Darisalamu fari ma.»

sentences.english: Go up to Lebanon and give a cry; let your voice be loud in Bashan, crying out from Abarim; for all your lovers have come to destruction
sentences.susu: «Wo xa te Liban, wo xa wo xui ite Basan bɔxi ma, wo xa gbelegbele Abarimi, barima wo dɛfanboore birin bara bira.

sentences.english: My word came to you in the time of your well-being; but you said, I will not give ear. This has been your way from your earliest years, you did not give attention to my voice.
sentences.susu: Beenun tɔɔrɛ xa wo suxu, n nu bara masenyi ti wo bɛ, kɔnɔ wo mu tin na ramɛde. Wo na na ki nɛ kabi wo dimɛdi tɛmui, wo mu wama n ma sɛriyɛ rabatufe.

sentences.english: All the keepers of your sheep will be food for the wind, and your lovers will be taken away prisoners: truly, then you will be shamed and unhonoured because of all your evil-doing.
sentences.susu: Wo xa yareratie bara lɔɛ alɔ foye, wo mɛɛnimae bara siga konyiya kui. Wo tan bara yaagi, wo xaxili bara ifu wo xa kobiɲa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: O you who are living in Lebanon, making your living-place in the cedars, how greatly to be pitied will you be when pains come on you, as on a woman in childbirth!
sentences.susu: Wo tan naxee na Liban, naxee luxi alɔ xɔnie e tɛɛ kui sɛdiri wuri kɔn na, wo fama nɛ tɔɔrɔde a ɲaaxi ra gbaloe xa fe ra. Wo fama nɛ lude tɔɔrɛ kui alɔ ginɛ naxan na di barife.»

sentences.english: By my life, says the Lord, even if Coniah, the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, was the ring on my right hand, even from there I would have you pulled off;
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «N bara n kali, hali Yehoyakimi xa di Yekoyakini, Yudaya mangɛ, sa fatu n ma alɔ n ma xurundɛ fanyi, n mu tondima na bade n bɛlɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: And I will give you into the hands of those desiring your death, and into the hands of those whom you are fearing, even into the hands of Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, and into the hands of the Chaldaeans.
sentences.susu: N i soma i yaxuie nan yi ra naxee wama i sɔntɔfe, i gaaxuma naxee ya ra, Nebukadansari, Babilɔn mangɛ, nun Babilɔnkae.

sentences.english: I will send you out, and your mother who gave you birth, into another country not the land of your birth; and there death will come to you.
sentences.susu: N wo kerima nɛ ɲamanɛ ma, i tan nun i nga, wo mu barixi dɛnnaxɛ. Wo faxama naa nɛ.

sentences.english: But to the land on which their soul's desire is fixed, they will never come back.
sentences.susu: Wo mu gbilenma wo xɔnyi sɔnɔn, wo wama lufe dɛnnaxɛ. Wo mu gbilenma naa abadan.»

sentences.english: Is this man Coniah a broken vessel of no value? is he a vessel in which there is no pleasure? why are they violently sent out, he and his seed, into a land which is strange to them?
sentences.susu: «Yehoyakini bara lu alɔ fɛɲɛ ibɔɔxi, mixi mu wama naxan xɔn? Munfe ra e a tan nun a xa die kerima ɲamanɛ ma, e mu dɛnnaxɛ kolon?

sentences.english: O earth, earth, earth, give ear to the word of the Lord!
sentences.susu: N ma ɲama naxan sabatixi n ma bɔxi ma, wo xa wo tuli mati Alatala ra.

sentences.english: The Lord has said, Let this man be recorded as having no children, a man who will not do well in all his life: for no man of his seed will do well, seated on the seat of the kingdom of David and ruling again in Judah.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a masen, ‹Wo xa sɛbɛli ti yi mixi xa fe ra, a mu di sɔtɔma, a xa duniɲɛigiri mu sɔɔnɛyama, a xa di yo mu luma Dawuda xa kibanyi kui, a xa di yo mu Yudaya yamarima sɔnɔn.›»

sentences.english: A curse is on the keepers who are causing the destruction and loss of the sheep of my field, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Ɲaxankatɛ na n ma ɲama yareratie bɛ naxee bara n ma ɲama ralɔɛ, e bara e rayensen.

sentences.english: So this is what the Lord, the God of Israel, has said against the keepers who have the care of my people: You have let my flock be broken up, driving them away and not caring for them; see, I will send on you the punishment for the evil of your doings, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Alatala bara a masen a xa ɲama yareratie xa fe ra, wo bara n ma ɲama rayensen nɛ, wo bara e keri. Wo mu mɛɛnixi e ma. N fama wo ɲaxankatade wo xa kobiɲa nan ma.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And I will get the rest of my flock together from all the countries where I have sent them, and will make them come back again to their resting-place; and they will have offspring and be increased.
sentences.susu: «N fama nɛ n ma ɲama birin na, n nu bara naxan xanin ɲamanɛ ma. N fama nɛ e ragbilende e xɔnyi alako e man xa wuya, e xa fe man xa sɔɔnɛya.

sentences.english: And I will put over them keepers who will take care of them: never again will they be overcome with fear or be troubled, and there will not be the loss of one of them, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N yareratie tima nɛ e bɛ naxee mɛɛnima e ma. E mu gaaxuma sɔnɔn, e mu sɛrɛnma. N e hayi birin fanma nɛ e bɛ.» Alatala bara na masen.

sentences.english: See, the days are coming, says the Lord, when I will give to David a true Branch, and he will be ruling as king, acting wisely, doing what is right, and judging uprightly in the land.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Lɔxɔɛ fama nɛ fade n Dawuda xa di tinxinxi rakelima lɔxɔɛ naxɛ. A ɲama yamarima nɛ lɔnni, tinxinyi, nun sɛriyɛ ra bɔxi kui.

sentences.english: In his days Judah will have salvation and Israel will be living without fear: and this is the name by which he will be named, The Lord is our righteousness.
sentences.susu: Na waxati Yudaya kisima nɛ, Isirayila bɔɲɛsa sɔtɔ, mixie a fala, ‹Alatala findixi won ma tinxinyi nan na.›»

sentences.english: And so, truly, the days are coming when they will say no longer, By the living Lord, who took the children of Israel up out of the land of Egypt;
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Lɔxɔɛ fama fade mixi mu a falama, ‹Alatala ɲiɲɛ naxan Isirayilakae raminixi Misira bɔxi ra.›

sentences.english: But, By the living Lord, who took up the seed of Israel, and made them come out of the north country, and from all the countries where I had sent them; and they will be living in the land which is theirs.
sentences.susu: E a falama nɛ, ‹Won bara won kali Alatala xili ra, naxan Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ rakelixi, a e ramini ɲamanɛ ra naxan na kɔɔla ma a nun yire birin a e kerixi dɛnnaxɛ. E man fama nɛ e xa bɔxi rasabatide.›»

sentences.english: About the prophets. My heart is broken in me, all my bones are shaking; I am like a man full of strong drink, like a man overcome by wine; because of the Lord, and because of his holy words.
sentences.susu: «Masenyie nan ya namiɲɔnmɛe xa fe ra: N bɔɲɛ bara kinikini. N xɔri birin na sɛrɛnfe, n luxi nɛ alɔ siisila barima Alatala xa masenyi sɛniyɛnxi xɔrɔxɔ.»

sentences.english: For the land is full of men who are untrue to their wives; because of the curse the land is full of grief; the green fields of the waste land have become dry; and they are quick to do evil, their strength is for what is not right.
sentences.susu: «Yi bɔxi rafexi yɛnɛlae nan na. Bɔxi yati yati na dankɛ kui na nan ma, fiili bara xara, ɲooge bara ɲɔn. Mixi mafura tinxintareya rabade. E suusama na ra a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: For the prophet as well as the priest is unclean; even in my house I have seen their evil-doing, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ mu tinxin. N bara kobiɲa to n ma banxi kui.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: For this cause their steps will be slipping on their way: they will be forced on into the dark and have a fall there: for I will send evil on them in the year of their punishment, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Na nan a ra e xa kira xɔrɔxɔ. Dimi bara sin e xun ma. E luma nɛ bira ra, barima n bara natɛ tongo n xa e ɲaxankata. Na waxati na fafe.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And I have seen ways without sense in the prophets of Samaria; they became prophets of the Baal, causing my people Israel to go wrong.
sentences.susu: «N bara fe ɲaaxie to namiɲɔnmɛ Samarikae ya ma. E na masenyi tife Bali xili ra, e bara n ma ɲama Isirayila ralɔɛ.

sentences.english: And in the prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a shocking thing; they are untrue to their wives, walking in deceit, and they make strong the hands of evil-doers, so that a man may not be turned back from his evil-doing: they have all become like Sodom to me, and its people like Gomorrah.
sentences.susu: N man bara fe ratɔnxie to namiɲɔnmɛ Darisalamukae ya ma. E findixi yɛnɛlae nan na, e ɲɛrɛma wule ra, e tinxintaree malima alako e naxa gbilen e xa wali kobi fɔxɔ ra. E bara lu n bɛ alɔ Sodomakae, e xa mixie maniyaxi Gomorakae nan na.»

sentences.english: So this is what the Lord of armies has said about the prophets: See, I will give them a bitter plant for their food, and bitter water for their drink: for from the prophets of Jerusalem unclean behaviour has gone out into all the land.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra Mangɛ Alatala a masenxi namiɲɔnmɛe xa fe ra, «N fe xɔnɛ soma nɛ i yi ra baloe ra, n ye ɲaaxi so i yi ra minse ra, barima Darisalamu namiɲɔnmɛe bara a niya n ma bɔxi birin xa findi bɔxi sɛniyɛntare ra.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: Do not give ear to the words which the prophets say to you: they give you teaching of no value: it is from themselves that their vision comes, and not out of the mouth of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a masen, «Wo naxa wo tuli mati namiɲɔnmɛe xa masenyi ra. E naxan masenma wo bɛ a findixi wule nan na. E laamatunyie xa fe falama wo bɛ naxee fatanxi e yɛtɛ xaxili ma. Alatala xa mu a masenxi.

sentences.english: They keep on saying to those who have no respect for the word of the Lord, You will have peace; and to everyone who goes on his way in the pride of his heart, they say, No evil will come to you.
sentences.susu: E bara suusa a falade n matandilae bɛ, ‹Alatala naxɛ wo bɔɲɛsa sɔtɔma nɛ.› E man nu a fala mixie bɛ, naxee birama e yɛtɛ waxɔnfe fɔxɔ ra, ‹Fe ɲaaxi yo mu wo sɔtɔma.›

sentences.english: For which of them has knowledge of the secret of the Lord, and has seen him, and given ear to his word? which of them has taken note of his word and given attention to it?
sentences.susu: Nde bara ti Alatala sɛɛti ma, a xa a xa masenyi ramɛ? Nde bara a tuli mati a xa masenyi ra? Nde bara na mɛ?

sentences.english: See, the storm-wind of the Lord, even the heat of his wrath, has gone out, a rolling storm, bursting on the heads of the evil-doers.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara xɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxi ma. Na luxi nɛ alɔ foye xungbe naxan dangima e xun ma.

sentences.english: The wrath of the Lord will not be turned back till he has done, till he has put into effect, the purposes of his heart: in days to come you will have full knowledge of this.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa xɔnɛ mu gbilenma, fo a xa kamali, fo a xa natɛ birin xa raba. Na birin na ɲɔn, wo xaxili sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: I did not send these prophets, but they went running: I said nothing to them, but they gave out the prophet's word.
sentences.susu: N tan xa mu yi namiɲɔnmɛe xɛɛxi, e e yɛtɛ xaxili nan nawalife. N mu masenyi tixi e bɛ, e masenyi tixi e yɛtɛ nan na.

sentences.english: But if they had been in my secret, then they would have made my people give ear to my words, turning them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa a li e nu na n tan nan sɛɛti ma, e n ma masenyi nan masenma n ma ɲama bɛ, alako e xa gbilen e xa kira ɲaaxi fɔxɔ ra, e xa kobiɲa lu na.»

sentences.english: Am I only a God who is near, says the Lord, and not a God at a distance?
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Ala nan n na naxan makɔrɛ wo ra, n mu na yire makuye.

sentences.english: In what secret place may a man take cover without my seeing him? says the Lord. Is there any place in heaven or earth where I am not? says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Adamadi nɔma a nɔxunde n ma?» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki. «N mu na koore nun bɔxi birin ma xɛ?» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: My ears have been open to what the prophets have said, who say false words in my name, saying, I have had a dream, I have had a dream, I have had a dream,
sentences.susu: «N bara na namiɲɔnmɛe xui mɛ. E wule nan falama, e naxɛ, ‹N bara laamatunyi to, n bara laamatunyi to.›»

sentences.english: Is (my word) in the hearts of the prophets who give out false words, even the prophets of the deceit of their hearts?
sentences.susu: «Namiɲɔnmɛe luma wule fala ra han mun tɛmui? E e yɛtɛ madaxuma han mun tɛmui?

sentences.english: Whose purpose is to take away the memory of my name from my people by their dreams, of which every man is talking to his neighbour, as their fathers gave up the memory of my name for the Baal.
sentences.susu: E maɲɔxunxi nɛ a ɲama nɔma nɛɛmude n xili ra e xa laamatunyie saabui ra, e naxan falama e boore bɛ, alɔ e babae nɛɛmuxi n xili ma ki naxɛ e fa Bali batu.

sentences.english: If a prophet has a dream, let him give out his dream; and he who has my word, let him give out my word in good faith. What has the dry stem to do with the grain? says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Naxan bara xiye sa, a xa na nan fala. Naxan bara n ma masenyi sɔtɔ, a xa na fala nɔndi ra. Munse na maale xɔri nun maale lagi tagi?» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Is not my word like fire? says the Lord; and like a hammer, smashing the rock to bits?
sentences.susu: «N ma masenyi mu luxi xɛ alɔ tɛ?» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki. «N ma masenyi mu luxi xɛ alɔ dɛrɛma naxan gɛmɛ ibɔɔma?»

sentences.english: For this cause I am against the prophets, says the Lord, who take my words, every one from his neighbour.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Yi namiɲɔnmɛe mu rafanxi n ma. E masenyi muɲama e boore ma, e fa a fala Ala xa masenyi na a ra.»

sentences.english: See, I am against the prophets, says the Lord, who let their tongues say, He has said.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Yi namiɲɔnmɛe mu rafanxi n ma. E a falama, ‹Ala xa masenyi nan ya,› kɔnɔ e dɛ nan tun wuyaxi.»

sentences.english: See, I am against the prophets of false dreams, says the Lord, who give them out and make my people go out of the way by their deceit and their uncontrolled words: but I did not send them or give them orders; and they will be of no profit to this people, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Yi namiɲɔnmɛe mu rafanxi n ma, naxee laamatunyi wule falama, naxee n ma ɲama ralɔɛma e xa wule fufafue ra. N mu e xɛɛxi, n mu yaamari yo fixi e ma, ɲama hayi mu na e ma feo.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And if this people, or the prophet, or a priest, questioning you, says, What word of weight is there from the Lord? then you are to say to them, You are the word, for I will not be troubled with you any more, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Xa ɲama i maxɔrin, xa na mu a ra namiɲɔnmɛ, xa na mu a ra sɛrɛxɛdubɛ, ‹Munse findixi Alatala xa natɛ ra,› i xa yi natɛ fala e bɛ, ‹Alatala bara wo rabɛɲin.›

sentences.english: And as for the prophet and the priest and the people who say, A word of weight from the Lord! I will send punishment on that man and on his house.
sentences.susu: Xa namiɲɔnmɛ, xa na mu a ra sɛrɛxɛdubɛ, xa na mu a ra mixi nde a fala ɲama bɛ, ‹Alatala xa masenyi nan ya,› n fama nɛ na kanyi nun a bɔnsɔɛ ɲaxankatade.

sentences.english: But this is what you are to say, every man to his neighbour and every man to his brother, What answer has the Lord given? and, What has the Lord said?
sentences.susu: Wo wo boore maxɔrinma, ‹Alatala munse yaabixi? Alatala munse masenxi?›

sentences.english: And you will no longer put people in mind of the word of weight of the Lord: for every man's word will be a weight on himself; for the words of the living God, of the Lord of armies, our God, have been twisted by you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a mu lanma wo xa a fala, ‹Alatala xa masenyi nan ya,› barima na findixi wo yɛtɛ xa masenyi nan na. Wo wama Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan masarafe.

sentences.english: This is what you are to say to the prophet, What answer has the Lord given to you? and, What has the Lord said?
sentences.susu: Wo namiɲɔnmɛ maxɔrinma, ‹Alatala munse yaabixi? Alatala munse masenxi?›

sentences.english: But if you say, The word of weight of the Lord; this is what the Lord has said: Because you say, The weight of the Lord, and I have sent to you, saying, You are not to say, The weight of the Lord;
sentences.susu: Xa wo man a falama, ‹Alatala xa masenyi nan ya,› n to a fala wo bɛ a wo naxa na mɔɔli fala,

sentences.english: For this reason, truly, I will put you completely out of my memory, and I will put you, and the town which I gave to you and to your fathers, away from before my face:
sentences.susu: n wo rabɛɲinma nɛ kerenyi ra, n wo makuya n na, wo tan nun wo xa taa n naxan fixi wo nun wo babae ma.

sentences.english: And I will give you a name without honour for ever, and unending shame which will never go from the memory of men.
sentences.susu: N wo rayaagima nɛ abadan. Na yaagi mu bama wo ma, mixi mu nɛɛmuma a ra.»

sentences.english: The Lord gave me a vision, and I saw two baskets full of figs put in front of the Temple of the Lord, after Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, had taken prisoner Jeconiah, the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and the chiefs of Judah, and the expert workmen and metal-workers from Jerusalem, and had taken them to Babylon.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari to gɛ Yudaya mangɛ Yehoyakini, Yehoyakimi xa di, a xa kuntigie, Yudaya kamudɛrie nun xabuie xaninde konyiya kui Babilɔn bɔxi ma, Alatala naxa laamatunyi nde masen n bɛ. Paani firin nu na Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ya ra. E nu rafexi xɔrɛe ra.

sentences.english: One basket had very good figs, like the figs which first come to growth: and the other basket had very bad figs, so bad that they were of no use for food.
sentences.susu: Xɔrɛ bogi fanyie, naxee luxi alɔ xɔrɛ bogi ba singee, e nu saxi paani keren kui. Xɔrɛ bogi ɲaaxie, naxee kanaxi, nee fan nu saxi paani boore kui.

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to me, What do you see, Jeremiah? And I said, Figs; the good figs are very good, and the bad very bad, and of no use for food, they are so bad.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, «Annabi Yeremi, i munse toxi?» N naxa a yaabi, «N xɔrɛe nan toxi. Ndee fan han, ndee fan kanaxi. Xɔrɛ naxee kanaxi, e mu nɔma donde.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti n bɛ,

sentences.english: This is what the Lord, the God of Israel, has said: Like these good figs, so in my eyes will be the prisoners of Judah, whom I have sent from this place into the land of the Chaldaeans for their good.
sentences.susu: «Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: I xɔrɛ bogi fanyie toxi ki naxɛ, n tan fan Isirayilakae toxi na ki nɛ, naxee xaninxi konyiya kui Babilɔn bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: For I will keep my eyes on them for good, and I will take them back again to this land, building them up and not pulling them down, planting them and not uprooting them.
sentences.susu: N nan n ɲɛngi sama nɛ e xɔn ma a fanyi ra. N e ragbilenma nɛ yi bɔxi ma, n e xa fe sɔɔnɛyama nɛ. N mu e halakima sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And I will give them a heart to have knowledge of me, that I am the Lord: and they will be my people, and I will be their God: for they will come back to me with all their heart.
sentences.susu: N xaxili fanyi fima nɛ e ma alako e xa a kolon n tan nan na Alatala ra. Xa e yɛtɛ ragbilen n ma e bɔɲɛ birin na, e tan nan findima n ma ɲama ra, n tan fan findi e Marigi Ala ra.»

sentences.english: And like the bad figs which are so bad that they are of no use for food, so I will give up Zedekiah, king of Judah, and his chiefs and the rest of Jerusalem who are still in this land, and those who are in the land of Egypt:
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «Yi xɔrɛ bogi ɲaaxi naxee mu donma, e misaalixi Yudaya mangɛ Sedekiya nun a xa kuntigie nan na, a nun Darisalamukae naxee birin luxi yi bɔxi ma, nun naxee sabatixi Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: I will give them up to be a cause of fear and of trouble among all the kingdoms of the earth; to be a name of shame and common talk and a cutting word and a curse in all the places wherever I will send them wandering.
sentences.susu: N e findima ɲama xɔnxi nan na duniɲa birin. E luma yaagi kui. Mixi yoma nɛ e ma, e e danka yire birin n e xaninma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And I will send the sword, and need of food, and disease, among them till they are all cut off from the land which I gave to them and to their fathers.
sentences.susu: N e raɲɔnma nɛ santidɛgɛma, kaamɛ, nun fure ɲaaxi ra. E mu luma yi bɔxi ma, n dɛnnaxɛ fixi e nun e babae ma.»

sentences.english: The word which came to Jeremiah about all the people of Judah in the fourth year of Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah king of Judah; this was the first year of Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa masenyi nde ti Annabi Yeremi bɛ, Yosiya xa di Yehoyakimi xa mangɛya ɲɛ naani nde kui Yudaya bɔxi ma. Na nu findixi Nebukadansari xa mangɛya ɲɛ singe nan na Babilɔn bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: This word Jeremiah gave out to all the people of Judah and to those living in Jerusalem, saying,
sentences.susu: Annabi Yeremi naxa yi masenyi ti Yudayakae nun Darisalamukae bɛ,

sentences.english: From the thirteenth year of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah, even till this day, for twenty-three years, the word of the Lord has been coming to me, and I have given it to you, getting up early and talking to you; but you have not given ear.
sentences.susu: «Kabi Amon xa di Yosiya xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun saxan nde Yudaya bɔxi ma, han to, na ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan nan ya. Na waxati Alatala nu bara masenyi nde ti n bɛ. N bara na fala wo bɛ tɛmui birin, kɔnɔ wo mu tinxi wo tuli matide n na.

sentences.english: And the Lord has sent to you all his servants the prophets, getting up early and sending them; but you have not given attention and your ear has not been open to give hearing;
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a xa konyi namiɲɔnmɛe xɛɛ wo ma waxati birin, kɔnɔ wo mu e xui ramɛxi, wo mu e xa masenyi suxuxi.

sentences.english: Saying, Come back now, everyone from his evil way and from the evil of your doings, and keep your place in the land which the Lord has given to you and to your fathers, from times long past even for ever:
sentences.susu: E naxa a masen wo bɛ wo xa gbilen wo xa ɲɛrɛ ki ɲaaxi fɔxɔ ra, alako wo xa bu yi bɔxi ma, Alatala naxan fixi wo nun wo babae ma, a xa findi wo gbe ra abadan.»

sentences.english: Do not go after other gods to be their servants and to give them worship, and do not make me angry with the work of your hands, causing evil to yourselves.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa bira ala gbɛtɛe fɔxɔ ra, wo naxa e batu, wo naxa tuubi e bɛ. Wo naxa n naxɔnɔ, alako n naxa wo ɲaxankata.

sentences.english: But you have not given ear to me, says the Lord; so that you have made me angry with the work of your hands, causing evil to yourselves.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo mu n xui suxuxi. Wo ɲɛrɛ ki bara n naxɔnɔ, n xa wo ɲaxankata. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: So this is what the Lord of armies has said: Because you have not given ear to my words,
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra Mangɛ Alatala naxa a masen, «Wo to tondi n ma masenyi ra,

sentences.english: See, I will send and take all the families of the north, says the Lord, and Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, my servant, and make them come against this land, and against its people, and against all these nations on every side; and I will give them up to complete destruction, and make them a cause of fear and surprise and a waste place for ever.
sentences.susu: n gali fenma nɛ kɔɔla ma, naxan na n ma konyi Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari xa yaamari bun ma. N e xɛɛma nɛ wo nun wo dɔxɔboore sɔntɔde. Mixi dɛ ixarama nɛ wo xa fe ra, e fa yo wo ma. Wo luma naa xunnakanɛ nan kui abadan.

sentences.english: And more than this, I will take from them the sound of laughing voices, the voice of joy, the voice of the newly-married man, and the voice of the bride, the sound of the stones crushing the grain, and the shining of lights.
sentences.susu: Sigi mu sama wo xɔnyi sɔnɔn, xulunyi mu rabama. Mixi mu maale din xui mɛma, e mu lanpui xa naiyalanyi toma.

sentences.english: All this land will be a waste and a cause of wonder; and these nations will be the servants of the king of Babylon for seventy years.
sentences.susu: Gbaloe yi bɔxi lima nɛ, se birin kana. Wo nun wo dɔxɔbooree luma konyiya nan kui Babilɔn mangɛ xa nɔɛ bun ma ɲɛ tongo solofere.»

sentences.english: And it will come about, after seventy years are ended, that I will send punishment on the king of Babylon, and on that nation, says the Lord, for their evil-doing, and on the land of the Chaldaeans; and I will make it a waste for ever.
sentences.susu: «Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Kɔnɔ na ɲɛ tongo solofere na kamali, n Babilɔn mangɛ nun a xa ɲama ɲaxankatama nɛ e xa fe ɲaaxi xa fe ra. N e xa bɔxi xun nakanama nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: And I will make that land undergo everything I have said against it, even everything recorded in this book, which Jeremiah the prophet has said against all the nations.
sentences.susu: N fe naxan birin falaxi yi ɲamae xili ma yi kitaabui kui Annabi Yeremi saabui ra, n fama nɛ na birin nakamalide.

sentences.english: For a number of nations and great kings will make servants of them, even of them: and I will give them the reward of their acts, even the reward of the work of their hands.
sentences.susu: Babilɔnkae fama nɛ lude si sɛnbɛma wuyaxie xa yaamari bun ma. N e xa wali sare ragbilenma nɛ e ma.»

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord, the God of Israel, has said to me: Take the cup of the wine of this wrath from my hand, and make all the nations to whom I send you take of it.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Ala bara a masen n bɛ, «N ma xɔnɛ xa fe fala si birin bɛ n i xɛɛma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And after drinking it, they will go rolling from side to side, and be off their heads, because of the sword which I will send among them.
sentences.susu: E na n ma xɔnɛ to, e luma nɛ alɔ siisilae santidɛgɛma ya ra.»

sentences.english: Then I took the cup from the Lord's hand, and gave a drink from it to all the nations to whom the Lord sent me;
sentences.susu: «N bara Alatala xa xɔnɛ masen si birin bɛ, a n xɛɛxi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Jerusalem and the towns of Judah and their kings and their princes, to make them a waste place, a cause of fear and surprise and a curse, as it is this day;
sentences.susu: N bara a masen Darisalamu nun Yudaya taae kui, e xa mangɛe nun kuntigie bɛ. Mixie dɛ fama nɛ ixarade e xa gbaloe sɔtɔxie xa fe ra, e fa yo e ma, e e danka alɔ a rabafe ki naxɛ to lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and his servants and his princes and all his people;
sentences.susu: N bara a masen Misira mangɛ firawuna bɛ, a xa konyie, a xa kuntigie, nun a xa ɲama birin bɛ.

sentences.english: And all the mixed people and all the kings of the land of Uz, and all the kings of the land of the Philistines, and Ashkelon and Gaza and Ekron and the rest of Ashdod;
sentences.susu: N bara a masen sie bɛ naxee na sogegorode mabiri. N bara a masen Usi mangɛe bɛ, a nun Filisita mangɛe bɛ, naxee na Asikalɔn, Gasa, Ekiron, nun Asidodi.

sentences.english: Edom and Moab and the children of Ammon,
sentences.susu: N bara a masen Edon, Mowaba, nun Amoni mangɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: And all the kings of Tyre, and all the kings of Zidon, and the kings of the lands across the sea;
sentences.susu: N bara a masen Tire nun Sidɔn mangɛe bɛ, naxee na baa dɛ ra.

sentences.english: Dedan and Tema and Buz, and all who have the ends of their hair cut;
sentences.susu: N bara a masen Dedan, Tema, nun Busi mangɛe bɛ, naxee na yire makuye.

sentences.english: And all the kings of Arabia, and all the kings of the mixed people living in the waste land;
sentences.susu: N bara a masen Arabu mangɛe bɛ, naxee na gbengberen yire.

sentences.english: And all the kings of Zimri, and all the kings of Elam, and all the kings of the Medes;
sentences.susu: N bara a masen Sabidi, Elama, nun Mediya mangɛe bɛ,

sentences.english: And all the kings of the north, far and near, one with another; and all the kingdoms of the world on the face of the earth.
sentences.susu: a nun mangɛ birin naxee na kɔɔla ma, naxee makɔrɛ nun naxee makuya duniɲa yire birin. Nee birin dangi xanbi, n man bara a masen Seesaki mangɛ bɛ.»

sentences.english: And you are to say to them, This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said: Take of this cup and be overcome, and let it come out again from your lips, and from your fall you will never be lifted up again, because of the sword which I will send among you.
sentences.susu: «I xa a masen e bɛ, ‹Isirayila Mangɛ Alatala bara a masen, wo xa a xa xɔnɛ kolon, wo xa lu na xɔnɛ kui han santidɛgɛma xa gɛ wo sɔntɔde n naxan xɛɛma wo tagi.›

sentences.english: And it will be, if they will not take of the cup in your hand, then you are to say to them, This is what the Lord of armies has said: You will certainly take of it.
sentences.susu: Xa e tondi n ma xɔnɛ kolonde, a fala e bɛ, Alatala bara natɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ tongo, e xa n ma xɔnɛ kolon.»

sentences.english: For see, I am starting to send evil on the town which is named by my name, and are you to be without any punishment? You will not be without punishment: for I will send a sword on all people living on the earth, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «N bara natɛ tongo n xa n ma taa sugandixi ɲaxankata, n xili falama naxan xun ma. Wo naxɛ a wo mu fe ɲaaxi yo rabaxi kɔnɔ wo bara fe ɲaaxi raba. Na nan a ra n bara natɛ tongo, wo xa sɔntɔ santidɛgɛma ra.» Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: So, as a prophet, give out these words among them, and say to them, The voice of the Lord will be sounding like a lion from on high; he will send out his voice from his holy place, like the loud voice of a lion, against his flock; he will give a cry, like those who are crushing the grapes, against all the people of the earth.
sentences.susu: «I xa yi birin fala e bɛ. I xa a fala e bɛ Alatala xui magaaxuxi bara mini a xa hɔrɔmɔlingira kui koore ma a xa bɔxi xili ma. A bara a xui ramini a ɲaaxi ra duniɲa xili ma.

sentences.english: A noise will come, even to the end of the earth; for the Lord has a cause against the nations, he will give his decision against all flesh; as for the evil-doers, he will give them to the sword, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na xui bara duniɲa birin li. Alatala na kiiti safe si birin ma naxee na duniɲa. Naxan ɲaaxu, a sɔntɔma nɛ santidɛgɛma ra.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: See, evil is going out from nation to nation, and a great storm will come up from the inmost parts of the earth.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a masen, «Alatala xa xɔnɛ bara keli alɔ foye xungbe naxan sigama si birin ma duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari.

sentences.english: And at that day, the bodies of those whom the Lord has put to death will be seen from one end of the earth even to the other end of the earth: there will be no weeping for them, their bodies will not be taken up or put to rest in the earth; they will be like waste on the face of the land.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxee sɔntɔma duniɲa ma na lɔxɔɛ, ɲɔn fe mu rabama e bɛ, e mu gaburi sɔtɔma, e findima ɲaɲɛ nan na bɛndɛ fuɲi fari.

sentences.english: Give cries of grief, you keepers of sheep; give cries for help, rolling yourselves in the dust, you chiefs of the flock: for the days of your destruction have fully come, and I will send you in all directions, and your fall will be like that of the males of the flock.
sentences.susu: Ɲama yareratie, wo xa gbelegbele, wo xa wo wa xui ramini, barima gbaloe lɔxɔɛ bara wo li. Wo fama nɛ yensende, wo bira, alɔ se xunxuri naxan tide mu na.

sentences.english: There will be no way of flight for the keepers of sheep, no road for the chiefs of the flock to get away safely.
sentences.susu: Wo xa yareratie mu kisima sɔnɔn, wo mu yigiya sɔtɔma.

sentences.english: A sound of the cry of the keepers of sheep, and the bitter crying of the chiefs of the flock! for the Lord has made waste their green fields.
sentences.susu: Wo wo xa yareratie wa xui mɛma nɛ, wo e gbelegbele xui mɛ, barima Alatala na e xa bɔxi kanafe.

sentences.english: And there is no sound in the fields of peace, because of the burning wrath of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa xɔnɛ magaaxuxi bara a niya xui yo mu minima sɔnɔn e xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: The lion has come out of his secret place, for the land has become a waste because of the cruel sword, and because of the heat of his wrath.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara lu alɔ yɛtɛ naxan bara a yire masara. A bara bɔxi kana a xa xɔnɛ xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: When Jehoiakim, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, first became king, this word came from the Lord, saying,
sentences.susu: Yosiya xa di Yehoyakimi xa mangɛya fɔlɛ Yudaya kui, Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti Annabi Yeremi bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: Take your place in the open square of the Lord's house and say to all the towns of Judah, who come into the Lord's house for worship, everything I give you orders to say to them: keep back not a word;
sentences.susu: «I xa ti n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ kui, i sa wɔyɛn ɲama bɛ naxan kelixi Yudaya taae kui fafe ra Alatala batude a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui. I xa fe birin masen e bɛ n naxan falama i bɛ. I naxa sese lu.

sentences.english: It may be that they will give ear, and that every man will be turned from his evil way, so that my purpose of sending evil on them because of the evil of their doings may be changed.
sentences.susu: Tɛmunde e e tuli matima nɛ na ra, e gbilen e xa wali kobie fɔxɔ ra. Na tɛmui n fan gbilen n ma natɛ fɔxɔ ra e xa fe ɲaaxi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And you are to say to them, This is what the Lord has said: If you do not give ear to me and go in the way of my law which I have put before you,
sentences.susu: I xa a fala e bɛ, ‹Alatala bara a masen, xa wo mu wo tuli mati n ma sɛriyɛ ra n wo yamarixi naxan na,

sentences.english: And give ear to the words of my servants the prophets whom I send to you, getting up early and sending them, though you gave no attention;
sentences.susu: xa wo mu wo tuli mati n ma konyi namiɲɔnmɛe ra, n naxee xɛɛxi wo ma, wo tondixi naxee xa masenyi ra,

sentences.english: Then I will make this house like Shiloh, and will make this town a curse to all the nations of the earth.
sentences.susu: na tɛmui n fe rabama nɛ wo ra alɔ n naxan nabaxi Silo ra. Yi taa findima nɛ taa dankaxi ra duniɲa si birin tagi.›»

sentences.english: And in the hearing of the priests and the prophets and all the people, Jeremiah said these words in the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, namiɲɔnmɛe, nun ɲama birin naxa Annabi Yeremi xa masenyi mɛ Alatala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: Now, when Jeremiah had come to the end of saying everything the Lord had given him orders to say to all the people, the priests and the prophets and all the people took him by force, saying, Death will certainly be your fate.
sentences.susu: Annabi Yeremi to gɛ Alatala xa masenyi tide ɲama bɛ, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, namiɲɔnmɛe, nun ɲama birin naxa a suxu, e fa a fala, «Won xa a faxa, won xa a faxa!»

sentences.english: Why have you said in the name of the Lord, This house will be like Shiloh, and this land a waste with no one living in it? And all the people had come together to Jeremiah in the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: E naxa a maxɔrin, «Munfe ra i a masenxi Alatala xili ra a falafe, yi banxi fama nɛ lude alɔ banxi naxan na Silo, yi taa fan fa kana, mixi yo mu lu a kui?» Gali birin nu bara Annabi Yeremi rabilin Alatala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: And the rulers of Judah, hearing of these things, came up from the king's house to the house of the Lord, and took their seats by the new door of the Lord's house.
sentences.susu: Yudaya kuntigie to na fe mɛ, e naxa keli mangɛ xɔnyi, e siga Alatala xa banxi, e sa dɔxɔ Naadɛ Nɛɛnɛ sɛɛti ma Marigi xa banxi sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then the priests and the prophets said to the rulers and to all the people, The right fate for this man is death; for he has said words against this town in your hearing.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun namiɲɔnmɛe naxa a fala kuntigie nun ɲama bɛ, «A lanma yi xɛmɛ xa faxa, barima a bara yi taa xa fe ɲaaxi fala. Wo bara na mɛ wo yɛtɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Then Jeremiah said to all the rulers and to all the people, The Lord has sent me as his prophet to say against this house and against this town all the words which have come to your ears.
sentences.susu: Annabi Yeremi naxa a fala kuntigie nun ɲama bɛ, «Alatala nan n xɛɛxi yi masenyi tide yi banxi nun yi taa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: So now, make a change for the better in your ways and your doings, and give ear to the voice of the Lord your God; then the Lord will let himself be turned from the decision he has made against you for evil.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi wo tan xa wo ɲɛrɛ ki masara, wo xa wo tuli mati wo Marigi Alatala xui ra, alako a xa gbilen a xa natɛ fɔxɔ ra wo xa fe ra.

sentences.english: As for me, here I am in your hands: do with me whatever seems good and right in your opinion.
sentences.susu: N na wo sagoe. Wo xa wo waxɔnfe raba n na.

sentences.english: Only be certain that, if you put me to death, you will make yourselves and your town and its people responsible for the blood of one who has done no wrong: for truly, the Lord has sent me to you to say all these words in your ears.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo xa a kolon, xa wo n faxa, wo tan nun Darisalamukae bara yunubi sɔtɔ n ma faxɛ xa fe ra, barima n tan mu fe ɲaaxi yo rabaxi. Alatala nan n xɛɛxi yi masenyi falade wo bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then the rulers and all the people said to the priests and the prophets, It is not right for this man to be put to death: for he has said words to us in the name of the Lord our God.
sentences.susu: Kuntigie nun ɲama naxa a fala sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun xɛɛrae bɛ, «Wo mu nɔma yi xɛmɛ faxade, barima a wɔyɛnxi won bɛ Alatala nan xili ra.»

sentences.english: Then some of the responsible men of the land got up and said to all the meeting of the people,
sentences.susu: Fori ndee naxa keli, e fa a fala ɲama bɛ,

sentences.english: Micah the Morashtite, who was a prophet in the days of Hezekiah, king of Judah, said to all the people of Judah, This is what the Lord of armies has said: Zion will become like a ploughed field, and Jerusalem will become a mass of broken walls, and the mountain of the house like the high places of the woodland.
sentences.susu: «Mika Moresetika fan nu namiɲɔnmɛ masenyi tima nɛ Yudaya mangɛ Xesekiya xa waxati. A nu bara a fala, ‹Mangɛ Alatala bara a masen, Siyon fama nɛ lude alɔ xɛ naxan buxaxi, Darisalamu findi gɛmɛ malanxie ra, Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi findi fɔtɔnyi ra.›»

sentences.english: Did Hezekiah and all Judah put him to death? did he not in the fear of the Lord make prayer for the grace of the Lord, and the Lord let himself be turned from the decision he had made against them for evil? By this act we might do great evil against ourselves.
sentences.susu: «Yudaya mangɛ Xesekiya bara faxa? A mu Alatala maxandixi xɛ? Na tɛmui Alatala naxa gbilen a xa natɛ fɔxɔ ra. Yakɔsi, won naxa won yɛtɛ yo tɔɔrɔ.»

sentences.english: And there was another man who was a prophet of the Lord, Uriah, the son of Shemaiah of Kiriath-jearim; he said against this town and against this land all the words which Jeremiah had said:
sentences.susu: Mixi gbɛtɛ fan nu na, naxan nu bara yi masenyi mɔɔli ti Alatala xili ra Darisalamu nun Yudaya xili ma, alɔ Annabi Yeremi a rabaxi ki naxɛ. A nu xili Uriya Semaya xa di Kiriyati Yeyarimi.

sentences.english: And when his words came to the ears of Jehoiakim the king and all his men of war and his captains, the king would have put him to death; but Uriah, hearing of it, was full of fear and went in flight into Egypt:
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Yehoyakimi nun a xa kuntigie nun a xa sɔɔrie to na masenyi mɛ, e naxa kata a faxade, kɔnɔ Uriya to a mɛ, a naxa gaaxu, a gi sigafe ra Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Jehoiakim the king sent Elnathan, the son of Achbor, and certain men with him, into Egypt.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Yehoyakimi naxa Akibori xa di Elinatan nun mixi ndee xɛɛ a fɔxɔ ra Misira.

sentences.english: And they took Uriah out of Egypt and came back with him to Jehoiakim the king; who put him to death with the sword, and had his dead body put into the resting-place of the bodies of the common people.
sentences.susu: E naxa fa Uriya ra kelife Misira, e a xanin mangɛ Yehoyakimi yire. Yehoyakimi naxa a faxa santidɛgɛma ra, a fa a ragata setaree xa gaburi yire.

sentences.english: But Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, gave Jeremiah his help, so that he was not given into the hands of the people to be put to death.
sentences.susu: Na kui Safan xa di Axikama naxa Annabi Yeremi mali, alako ɲama naxa a faxa.

sentences.english: When Zedekiah, the son of Josiah, king of Judah, first became king this word came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
sentences.susu: Yosiya xa di Yehoyakimi xa mangɛya fɔlɛ Yudaya kui, Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti Annabi Yeremi bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said to me: Make for yourself bands and yokes and put them on your neck;
sentences.susu: «I xa karafoe ragoro i kɔn ma.

sentences.english: And send them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the children of Ammon, and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Zidon, by their servants who come to Jerusalem, to Zedekiah, king of Judah;
sentences.susu: I xa xɛɛra xɛɛ Edon, Mowaba, Amon, Tire, nun Sidɔn mangɛe xɔn e xa mixie saabui ra, naxee faxi Darisalamu, Yudaya mangɛ Sedekiya yire.

sentences.english: And give them orders to say to their masters, This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said: Say to your masters,
sentences.susu: E xa a fala mangɛe bɛ, ‹Isirayila Mangɛ Alatala bara yi masenyi ti mangɛe bɛ,

sentences.english: I have made the earth, and man and beast on the face of the earth, by my great power and by my outstretched arm; and I will give it to anyone at my pleasure.
sentences.susu: n tan nan bɔxi, adamadie, nun daalise birin daaxi naxan na duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari. N e daaxi n sɛnbɛ magaaxuxi nan na. N a birin fima mixi nan ma n wama naxan xɔn.›»

sentences.english: And now I have given all these lands into the hands of Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, my servant; and I have given the beasts of the field to him for his use.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi n bara yi bɔxi birin so Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari yi ra. A tan nan findixi n ma konyi ra. N bara wulai subee fan lu a sagoe.

sentences.english: And all the nations will be servants to him and to his son and to his son's son, till the time comes for his land to be overcome: and then a number of nations and great kings will take it for their use.
sentences.susu: Ɲamanɛ birin fama lude a tan nan ma yaamari bun ma. E man luma nɛ a xa di nun a xa mamadi fan ma yaamari bun ma, beenun a xa waxati xa kamali. Na tɛmui ɲamanɛ sɛnbɛmae nun mangɛ xungbee fama nɛ dusude a xun na.»

sentences.english: And it will come about, that if any nation does not become a servant to this same Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, and does not put its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon, then I will send punishment on that nation, says the Lord, by the sword and need of food and by disease, till I have given them into his hands.
sentences.susu: «Xa ɲamanɛ mangɛ nde tondi Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari rabatude, n tan nan fama santidɛgɛma, kaamɛ, nun fure ɲaaxi ra na kanyi ma, han a xa ɲamanɛ ɲɔn Nebukadansari saabui ra. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And you are not to give attention to your prophets or your readers of signs or your dreamers or those who see into the future or those who make use of secret arts, who say to you, You will not become servants of the king of Babylon:
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo tuli mati wo xa namiɲɔnmɛe, wo xa sematoe, wo xa duuree, nun wo xa mandurulae ra, naxee a falama wo bɛ, ‹Wo mu luma Babilɔn mangɛ sagoe.›

sentences.english: For they say false words to you, so that you may be sent away far from your land, and so that you may be forced out by me and come to destruction.
sentences.susu: E na wule nan falafe wo bɛ, alako wo xa makuya wo xa bɔxi ra, wo xa lu konyiya kui, han wo xa ɲɔn.

sentences.english: But as for that nation which puts its neck under the yoke of the king of Babylon and becomes his servant, I will let that nation keep on in its land, farming it and living in it, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ ɲama naxan na a yɛtɛ magoro Babilɔn mangɛ bɛ, a a rabatu, n na ɲama xun nafanma nɛ a xa bɔxi ma, a xa wali mɛnni, a sabati naa. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And I said all this to Zedekiah, king of Judah, saying, Put your necks under the yoke of the king of Babylon and become his servants and his people, so that you may keep your lives.
sentences.susu: N naxa yi masenyi ti Yudaya mangɛ Sedekiya bɛ, «Wo xa lu Babilɔn mangɛ xa yaamari bun ma, wo xa wo magoro a tan nun a xa ɲama bɛ alako wo xa kisi.

sentences.english: Why are you desiring death, you and your people, by the sword, and because food is gone, and by disease, as the Lord has said of the nation which does not become the servant of the king of Babylon?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra i nun i xa ɲama wama faxafe santidɛgɛma, kaamɛ, nun fure ɲaaxi ra, alɔ Alatala a masenxi ki naxɛ ɲama birin bɛ naxan mu tin a magorode Babilɔn mangɛ bɛ?

sentences.english: And you are not to give ear to the prophets who say to you, You will not become servants of the king of Babylon: for what they say is not true.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo tuli mati namiɲɔnmɛe ra naxee a falama, ‹Wo mu luma Babilɔn mangɛ xa yaamari bun ma.› E wule nan tun falafe.

sentences.english: For I have not sent them, says the Lord, but they are saying what is false in my name, so that I might send you out by force, causing destruction to come on you and on your prophets.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: ‹N tan xa mu e xɛɛxi. E wule nan tun falafe wo bɛ n xili ra, alako n xa wo keri, n man xa wo xun nakana, wo tan nun namiɲɔnmɛ naxee wɔyɛnfe wo bɛ.›»

sentences.english: And I said to the priests and to all the people, This is what the Lord has said: Give no attention to the words of your prophets who say to you, See, in a very little time now the vessels of the Lord's house will come back again from Babylon: for what they say to you is false.
sentences.susu: N bara yi masenyi ti sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun ɲama bɛ, «Alatala naxa a masen, ‹Wo naxa wo tuli mati wo xa namiɲɔnmɛe ra naxee a falama wo bɛ a Alatala xa banxi yirabasee fama nɛ ragbilende wo yire kelife ra Babilɔn bɔxi ma. E na wule nan tun falafe.

sentences.english: Give no attention to them; become servants of the king of Babylon and keep yourselves from death: why let this town become a waste?
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo tuli mati e ra, wo wo magoro Babilɔn mangɛ bɛ, alako wo xa kisi. Munfe ra wo wama yi taa xa kana?

sentences.english: But if they are prophets, and if the word of the Lord is with them, let them now make request to the Lord of armies that the vessels which are still in the house of the Lord and in the house of the king of Judah and at Jerusalem, may not go to Babylon.
sentences.susu: Xa namiɲɔnmɛe nan e ra, xa e na Alatala xa masenyi nan tife, e xa Mangɛ Alatala maxandi alako yirabase naxee luxi Alatala xa banxi kui, Yudaya mangɛ xa banxi kui, nun Darisalamu kui, e naxa e xanin Babilɔn bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord has said about the rest of the vessels which are still in this town,
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala bara fe nde fala a xa banxi sanyie xa fe ra, na ye ragatade xungbe, nun na ye ragatade xunxurie, nun se gbɛtɛ xa fe ra naxee na taa kui,

sentences.english: Which Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, did not take away, when he took Jeconiah, the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, a prisoner from Jerusalem to Babylon, with all the great men of Judah and Jerusalem;
sentences.susu: Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari mu naxee xanin, a to nu Yehoyakimi xa di Yudaya mangɛ Yehoyakini, Yudaya kuntigie, nun Darisalamukae xaninfe a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said about the rest of the vessels in the house of the Lord and in the house of the king of Judah and at Jerusalem:
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ Alatala naxa masenyi ti yirabasee xa fe ra naxee nu luxi a xa banxi kui, Yudaya mangɛ xa banxi kui, nun Darisalamu kui,

sentences.english: They will be taken away to Babylon, and there they will be till the day when I send their punishment on them, says the Lord. Then I will take them up and put them back in their place.
sentences.susu: e birin xaninma nɛ Babilɔn bɔxi ma. E luma nɛ naa han a natɛ tongoma tɛmui naxɛ, a man xa e ragbilen Darisalamu.›»

sentences.english: And it came about in that year, when Zedekiah first became king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, that Hananiah, the son of Azzur the prophet, who came from Gibeon, said to Jeremiah in the house of the Lord, before the priests and all the people,
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Sedekiya xa mangɛya ɲɛ naani, kike suuli nde ra, Asuru xa di Annabi Xananiya Gabayonka naxa wɔyɛn Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun ɲama ya xɔri.

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord of armies, the God of Israel: By me the yoke of the king of Babylon has been broken.
sentences.susu: A naxɛ, «Isirayila Marigi Alatala bara a masen, ‹N fama nɛ Babilɔn mangɛ xa yaamari kanade.

sentences.english: In the space of two years I will send back into this place all the vessels of the Lord's house which Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, took away from this place to Babylon:
sentences.susu: Beenun ɲɛ firin xa kamali, n man fama nɛ Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira xunmase birin nagbilende be, Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari naxan tongo, a e xanin Babilɔn bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And I will let Jeconiah, the son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, come back to this place, with all the prisoners of Judah who went to Babylon, says the Lord: for I will have the yoke of the king of Babylon broken.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, n man fama nɛ Yehoyakimi xa di, Yudaya mangɛ Yehoyakini ragbilende, a nun mixi birin naxee nu xaninxi Babilɔn. N Babilɔn mangɛ xa yaamari kanama nɛ.›»

sentences.english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to the prophet Hananiah, before the priests and all the people who had come into the house of the Lord,
sentences.susu: Annabi Yeremi naxa Annabi Xananiya yaabi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun ɲama ya xɔri Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: The prophet Jeremiah said, So be it: may the Lord do so: may the Lord give effect to the words which you have said, and let the vessels of the Lord's house, and all the people who have been taken away, come back from Babylon to this place.
sentences.susu: Annabi Yeremi naxa a fala, «Amina, Alatala xa a raba na ki. Alatala xa i xa masenyi rakamali. A xa a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xunmasee ragbilen be kelife Babilɔn bɔxi ma, a nun Isirayila ɲama naxee na konyiya kui mɛnni.

sentences.english: But still, give ear to this word which I am saying to you and to all the people:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n xa a fala i bɛ, a nun ɲama birin bɛ, wo xa wo tuli mati n na.

sentences.english: The prophets, who were before me and before you, from early times gave word to a number of countries and great kingdoms about war and destruction and disease.
sentences.susu: Kabi tɛmui xɔnnakuye beenun won ma waxati, namiɲɔnmɛe bara masenyi ti ɲamanɛe nun mangɛyae xili ma, a falafe ra e xa gere sɔtɔ, tɔɔrɛ, nun fure ɲaaxi.

sentences.english: The prophet whose words are of peace, when his words come true, will be seen to be a prophet whom the Lord has sent.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa a sa li namiɲɔnmɛ nde masenyi ti bɔɲɛsa xa fe ra, fo na masenyi xa kamali nɛ beenun mixie xa a kolon Alatala nan na namiɲɔnmɛ xɛɛxi.»

sentences.english: Then Hananiah the prophet took the yoke from the neck of the prophet Jeremiah and it was broken by his hands.
sentences.susu: Annabi Xananiya naxa karafoe ba Annabi Yeremi kɔn ma, a naxa a igira.

sentences.english: And before all the people Hananiah said, The Lord has said, Even so will I let the yoke of the king of Babylon be broken off the necks of all the nations in the space of two years. Then the prophet Jeremiah went away.
sentences.susu: Na kui a naxa a fala ɲama bɛ, «Alatala xa masenyi nan ya. Beenun ɲɛ firin, n fama nɛ Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari xa yaamari bade ɲamanɛ birin ma.» Annabi Yeremi naxa siga.

sentences.english: Then after the yoke had been broken off the neck of the prophet Jeremiah by Hananiah the prophet, the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah, saying,
sentences.susu: Annabi Xananiya to gɛ Annabi Yeremi xa karafoe igirade, Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti Annabi Yeremi bɛ,

sentences.english: Go and say to Hananiah, This is what the Lord has said: Yokes of wood have been broken by you, but in their place I will make yokes of iron.
sentences.susu: «Siga, i sa a fala Xananiya bɛ, ‹Alatala bara a masen i bɛ, i bara karafoe wuri daaxi igira, kɔnɔ n fama karafoe wure daaxi nan nagorode i kɔn ma.›

sentences.english: For the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said: I have put a yoke of iron on the necks of all these nations, making them servants to Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon; and they are to be his servants: and in addition I have given him the beasts of the field.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, ‹N fama karafoe wure daaxi nan sade ɲamanɛ birin kɔn ma, alako e xa lu Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari xa yaamari bun ma. N man bara wulai sube birin sa a sagoe.›»

sentences.english: Then the prophet Jeremiah said to Hananiah the prophet, Give ear, now, Hananiah; the Lord has not sent you; but you are making this people put their faith in what is false.
sentences.susu: Annabi Yeremi naxa a fala Xananiya bɛ, «I tuli mati Xananiya. Alatala xa mu i xɛɛxi. I xaxilisa wɔyɛnyi naxan falafe ɲama bɛ, a findixi wule nan na.

sentences.english: For this reason the Lord has said, See, I will send you away from off the face of the earth: this year death will overtake you, because you have said words against the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, ‹N xa a fala i bɛ, n i kerima nɛ yi bɔxi ma, i fa faxa toofare, barima i bara Alatala xa masenyi matandi.›»

sentences.english: So death came to Hananiah the prophet the same year, in the seventh month.
sentences.susu: Annabi Xananiya naxa faxa na ɲɛ kui, kike solofere nde.

sentences.english: Now these are the words of the letter which Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the responsible men among those who had been taken away, and to the priests and the prophets and to all the rest of the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had taken away prisoners from Jerusalem to Babylon;
sentences.susu: Bataaxɛ nan ya, Annabi Yeremi naxan nasanba kelife Darisalamu, sigafe Babilɔn. A a sɛbɛ forie, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, namiɲɔnmɛe, nun Isirayila ɲama birin nan ma, Nebukadansari nu bara naxee xanin Babilɔn kelife Darisalamu.

sentences.english: (After Jeconiah the king and the queen-mother and the unsexed servants and the rulers of Judah and Jerusalem and the expert workmen and the metal-workers had gone away from Jerusalem;)
sentences.susu: Singe nu, mangɛ Yehoyakini, a nga, mangɛ batulae, Yudaya nun Darisalamu kuntigie, nun walikɛ fanyie nu bara keli Darisalamu sigafe ra Babilɔn.

sentences.english: By the hand of Elasah, the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah, the son of Hilkiah, (whom Zedekiah, king of Judah, sent to Babylon, to Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon,) saying,
sentences.susu: Annabi Yeremi naxa yi bataaxɛ taxu Safan xa di Elaasa ra, a nun Xilikiya xa di Gɛmaraya ra. Yudaya mangɛ Sedekiya nu bara Xilikiya singe xɛɛ mangɛ Nebukadansari xɔn Babilɔn bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said to all those whom I have taken away prisoners from Jerusalem to Babylon:
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, katarabi mixi ma naxee xaninxi konyiya kui Babilɔn bɔxi ma:

sentences.english: Go on building houses and living in them, and planting gardens and using the fruit of them;
sentences.susu: «Wo xa banxie ti, wo xa sabati naa. Wo xa laakɔɛ sa, wo xa balo a bogi xun na.

sentences.english: Take wives and have sons and daughters, and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, so that they may have sons and daughters; and be increased in number there and do not become less.
sentences.susu: Wo xa ginɛe dɔxɔ, wo xa die sɔtɔ. Wo xa ginɛe fen wo xa die bɛ, wo xa wo xa di ginɛe fi xɛmɛe ma futi ra, alako nee fan xa die sɔtɔ. Wo xa wuya naa, wo naxa xurun.

sentences.english: And be working for the peace of the land to which I have had you taken away prisoners, and make prayer to the Lord for it: for in its peace you will have peace.
sentences.susu: Wo xa xunnafanyi fen na taa bɛ n wo xaninxi dɛnnaxɛ. Wo man xa Alatala maxandi e bɛ, barima wo xa hɛɛri fatanxi e xa hɛɛri nan na.»

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said: Do not let yourselves be tricked by the prophets who are among you, and the readers of signs, and give no attention to their dreams which they may have;
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Alatala naxa a masen, «Wo naxa tin wo xa namiɲɔnmɛe xa wo madaxu. Wo naxa wo tuli mati se matoe ra, wo naxa la wo yɛtɛ xa xiye ra.

sentences.english: For they are saying to you what is false in my name: I have not sent them, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa namiɲɔnmɛe xa masenyi findixi wule nan na. E wɔyɛnma n xili nan na, kɔnɔ n tan xa mu e xɛɛxi. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord has said: When seventy years are ended for Babylon, I will have pity on you and give effect to my good purpose for you, causing you to come back to this place.
sentences.susu: Alatala tan naxan masenxi na nan ya, «Wo na gɛ ɲɛ tongo solofere rabade Babilɔn, n nan n ma laayidi rakamalima nɛ wo ragbilenfe ra be.

sentences.english: For I am conscious of my thoughts about you, says the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil, to give you hope at the end.
sentences.susu: N a kolon n fe naxan ɲanigexi wo bɛ, fe fanyi na a ra, tɔɔrɛ mu na naxan kui. N a ragirima nɛ wo ma alako wo xa hɛɛri sɔtɔ yare. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And you will go on crying to me and making prayer to me, and I will give ear to you.
sentences.susu: Wo na n xili, n fama nɛ wo ragbilende. Wo na n maxandi, n fama nɛ wo xa duba suxude.

sentences.english: And you will be searching for me and I will be there, when you have gone after me with all your heart.
sentences.susu: Wo na n fen, wo fama nɛ n tode, barima wo n fenma wo bɔɲɛ birin nan na.

sentences.english: I will be near you again, says the Lord, and your fate will be changed, and I will get you together from all the nations and from all the places where I had sent you away, says the Lord; and I will take you back again to the place from which I sent you away prisoners.
sentences.susu: N mu tinma n nɔxunde wo ma. N fama nɛ wo xa mixie raminide konyiya kui, n fa e ragbilende be kelife ɲamanɛ birin ma, n e xanin dɛnnaxɛ. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: For you have said, The Lord has given us prophets in Babylon.
sentences.susu: Wo a falama, «Ala bara namiɲɔnmɛ ndee ramini won ya ma Babilɔn bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord has said about the king who is seated on the seat of David's kingdom, and about all the people living in this town, your countrymen who have not gone out with you as prisoners;
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya a naxan masenxi mangɛ bɛ naxan dɔxɔxi Dawuda xa kibanyi kui, a nun ɲama naxan sabatixi yi taa kui, wo ngaxakerenyi naxee mu xaninxi konyiya kui.

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: See, I will send on them the sword and need of food and disease, and will make them like bad figs, which are of no use for food, they are so bad.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «N fama nɛ santidɛgɛma, kaamɛ, nun fure ɲaaxi ra e xili ma. N e luma nɛ alɔ xɔrɛ kanaxi naxan mu nɔma donde.

sentences.english: I will go after them, attacking them with the sword and with need of food and with disease, and will make them a cause of fear to all the kingdoms of the earth, to be a curse and a wonder and a surprise and a name of shame among all the nations where I have sent them:
sentences.susu: N birama nɛ e fɔxɔ ra santidɛgɛma, kaamɛ, nun fure ɲaaxi ra. N e findima nɛ mixi dankaxie ra duniɲa birin ma. Mixie dɛ ixarama nɛ e xa fe ra, e yo e ma. E yaagima nɛ si birin tagi n nee rayensenxi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Because they have not given ear to my words, says the Lord, when I sent to them my servants the prophets, getting up early and sending them; but you did not give ear, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya. N na birin nabaxi nɛ barima e mu n ma masenyi suxuxi. N bara n ma konyi namiɲɔnmɛe xɛɛ e yire kabi fɔlɛ, kɔnɔ e mu e tuli matixi e xui ra. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And now, give ear to the word of the Lord, all you whom I have sent away prisoners from Jerusalem to Babylon.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ wo tan, n naxee xɛɛxi Babilɔn, kelife Darisalamu, wo xa wo tuli mati Alatala xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said about Ahab, the son of Kolaiah, and about Zedekiah, the son of Maaseiah, who are saying to you what is false in my name: See, I will give them up into the hands of Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, and he will put them to death before your eyes.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya Kolaya xa di Akabu, a nun Maaseya xa di Sedekiya xa fe ra, naxee namiɲɔnmɛ masenyi wule daaxi falaxi wo bɛ n xili ra. N e sama nɛ Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari sagoe, a e faxa wo ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And their fate will be used as a curse by all the prisoners of Judah who are in Babylon, who will say, May the Lord make you like Zedekiah and like Ahab, who were burned in the fire by the king of Babylon;
sentences.susu: Yudayakae naxee xaninxi konyiya kui Babilɔn bɔxi ma, e fama dankɛ tide yi ki nɛ: ‹Alatala xa i xa fe raba alɔ a Sedekiya nun Akabu xa fe raba ki naxɛ.› Babilɔn mangɛ naxa e gan tɛ ra,

sentences.english: Because they have done shame in Israel, and have taken their neighbours' wives, and in my name have said false words, which I did not give them orders to say; and I myself am the witness, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: barima e nu bara fe ɲaaxi raba Isirayila bɔxi ma. E nu yɛnɛ raba e dɔxɔbooree xa ginɛe ra, e man nu wule fala n xili ra, hali n mu yaamari naxan soxi e yi.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: About Shemaiah the Nehelamite.
sentences.susu: I xa a masen Semaya Nexelamika bɛ,

sentences.english: Shemaiah the Nehelamite sent a letter in his name to Zephaniah, the son of Maaseiah the priest, saying,
sentences.susu: «Isirayila Marigi Alatala bara a masen, ‹I bara bataaxɛe rasanba i xili ra Darisalamu ɲama birin ma, a nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Maaseya xa di Sefaniya, nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ birin ma. Yi nan sɛbɛxi e kui:

sentences.english: The Lord has made you priest in place of Jehoiada the priest, to be an overseer in the house of the Lord for every man who is off his head and is acting as a prophet, to put such men in prison and in chains.
sentences.susu: «Alatala bara i findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra Yehoyada ɲɔxɔɛ ra, alako i xa mixie mato Alatala xa banxi kui naxee wama e yɛtɛ findife namiɲɔnmɛ ra. A lanma na kanyie xa xiri wuri ma, xa na mu a ra yɔlɔnxɔnyi xa sa e ma.

sentences.english: So why have you made no protest against Jeremiah of Anathoth, who is acting as a prophet to you?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra i mu Annabi Yeremi Anatɔtika tan suxu, naxan bara a yɛtɛ findi namiɲɔnmɛ ra wo tagi,

sentences.english: For he has sent to us in Babylon saying, The time will be long: go on building houses and living in them, and planting gardens and using the fruit of them.
sentences.susu: naxan bara bataaxɛ rasanba won ma Babilɔn a falafe ra won buma nɛ, a lanma won xa banxie ti, won xa sabati be, won xa laakɔɛ sa, won xa e bogi don.»›»

sentences.english: And Zephaniah the priest made clear to Jeremiah the prophet what was said in the letter, reading it to him.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Sefaniya naxa na bataaxɛ xaran Annabi Yeremi ya xɔri.

sentences.english: Then the word of the Lord came to Jeremiah the prophet, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi masenyi so Annabi Yeremi yi ra:

sentences.english: Send to all those who have been taken away, saying, This is what the Lord has said about Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because Shemaiah has been acting as a prophet to you, and I did not send him, and has made you put your faith in what is false;
sentences.susu: «A masen Isirayilakae birin bɛ naxee na konyiya kui Babilɔn bɔxi ma, ‹Alatala xa masenyi Semaya Nexelamika xa fe ra, na nan ya: Semaya to bara a yɛtɛ findi namiɲɔnmɛ ra, hali n tan xa mu a xɛɛxi, a nu fa wo madaxu wule ra,

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord has said, Truly I will send punishment on Shemaiah and on his seed; not a man of his family will have a place among this people, and he will not see the good which I am going to do to my people, says the Lord: because he has said words against the Lord.
sentences.susu: n tan Alatala bara natɛ tongo n xa Semaya Nexelamika nun a bɔnsɔɛ ɲaxankata. N e birin bama nɛ yi ɲama ya ma. A mu fama n ma fe fanyi tode n naxan nabama yi ɲama bɛ, barima a xa masenyi bara a niya mixie xa n matandi. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.›»

sentences.english: The word which came to Jeremiah from the Lord, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya a naxan masenxi Annabi Yeremi bɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord, the God of Israel, has said, Put down in a book all the words which I have said to you.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «N ma masenyi sɛbɛ kitaabui.

sentences.english: For see, the days are coming, says the Lord, when I will let the fate of my people Israel and Judah be changed, says the Lord: and I will make them come back to the land which I gave to their fathers, so that they may take it for their heritage.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: N xa a fala wo bɛ, lɔxɔɛ fama a lide n nan n ma ɲama raminima konyiya kui tɛmui naxɛ. N Isirayila nun Yudaya ragbilenma nɛ bɔxi ma n dɛnnaxɛ fixi e benbae ma. Na bɔxi man xa findi e gbe ra.»

sentences.english: And these are the words which the Lord said about Israel and about Judah.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya Isirayila nun Yudaya xa fe ra:

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: A voice of shaking fear has come to our ears, of fear and not of peace.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a masen, «Won bara sɔnxɔɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ mɛ, a magaaxu, bɔɲɛsa yo mu na.

sentences.english: Put the question and see if it is possible for a man to have birth-pains: why do I see every man with his hands gripping his sides, as a woman does when the pains of birth are on her, and all faces are turned green?
sentences.susu: Wo a kolon xɛmɛ mu di barima, kɔnɔ yi waxati xɛmɛ e furi suxuma e bɛlɛxɛ ra alɔ ginɛ e furi suxuma ki naxɛ e di bari tɛmui. Munfe ra e yatagi masaraxi?

sentences.english: Ha! for that day is so great that there is no day like it: it is the time of Jacob's trouble: but he will get salvation from it.
sentences.susu: Gbaloe lɔxɔɛ na a ra naxan dangima a birin na. A xɔrɔxɔ Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ bɛ, kɔnɔ e kisima nɛ.»

sentences.english: For it will come about on that day, says the Lord of armies, that his yoke will be broken off his neck, and his bands will be burst; and men of strange lands will no longer make use of him as their servant:
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Na waxati na li, n fama nɛ Babilɔn xa nɔɛ bade wo fari. N wo xa yɔlɔnxɔnyi bolonma nɛ, wo mu luma ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛ sagoe sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: But they will be servants to the Lord their God and to David their king, whom I will give back to them.
sentences.susu: Wo fama nɛ wo Marigi Alatala batude, a nun wo xa mangɛ Dawuda n naxan nakelima.»

sentences.english: So have no fear, O Jacob, my servant, says the Lord; and do not be troubled, O Israel: for see, I will make you come back from far away, and your seed from the land where they are prisoners; and Jacob will come back, and will be quiet and at peace, and no one will give him cause for fear.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «N ma konyi Yaxuba, wo naxa gaaxu. Isirayila, wo naxa sɛrɛn. N fama nɛ wo xɔrɛyade, n wo bɔnsɔɛ ramini konyiya kui yire makuye, Yaxuba fa sabati bɔɲɛsa kui yi bɔxi ma. Mixi yo mu i tɔɔrɔma sɔnɔn,

sentences.english: For I am with you, says the Lord, to be your saviour: for I will put an end to all the nations where I have sent you wandering, but I will not put an end to you completely: though with wise purpose I will put right your errors, and will not let you go quite without punishment.
sentences.susu: barima won birin na a ra. N wo tan nakisima nɛ, kɔnɔ n si gbɛtɛe tan ɲaxankata, n wo rayensen yɛ dɛnnaxɛ. N wo ɲaxankatama nɛ tinxinyi kui, alɔ a lan a xa raba ki naxɛ, kɔnɔ n mu fama wo sɔntɔde.

sentences.english: For the Lord has said, Your disease may not be made well and your wound is bitter.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen: Wo xa gbaloe mu kanama, fo wo xa tɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: There is no help for your wound, there is nothing to make you well.
sentences.susu: Mixi mu na naxan wo malima, naxan wo xa tɔɔrɛ dandanma. Seri mu na wo bɛ.

sentences.english: Your lovers have no more thought for you, they go after you no longer; for I have given you the wound of a hater, even cruel punishment;
sentences.susu: Wo xanuntenyie bara nɛɛmu wo ma, e mu wo fenma sɔnɔn, barima n tan bara wo bɔnbɔ a ɲaaxi ra, n bara ɲaxankatɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ dɔxɔ wo ma, wo xa yunubi wuyaxie nun wo xa kobiɲa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Why are you crying for help because of your wound? for your pain may never be taken away: because your evil-doing was so great and because your sins were increased, I have done these things to you.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra wo na wafe na gbaloe xa fe ra? Munfe ra wo mu tinma na ɲaxankatɛ ra? N na birin nabaxi wo xa kobiɲa nun wo xa yunubi wuyaxie nan ma fe ra.

sentences.english: For this cause, all those who take you for their food will themselves become your food; and all your attackers, every one of them, will be taken prisoners; and those who send destruction on you will come to destruction; and all those who take away your goods by force will undergo the same themselves.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, mixi naxee bara wo tɔɔrɔ, e fan tɔɔrɛ nan sɔtɔma. Wo yaxui birin sigama nɛ konyiya kui. Mixi naxee bara wo harige ba wo yi, e fan harige bama nɛ e yi ra. Mixi naxee bara wo xa taae kana, n a niyama nɛ e tan fan xa taae xa kana.»

sentences.english: For I will make you healthy again and I will make you well from your wounds, says the Lord; because they have given you the name of an outlaw, saying, It is Zion cared for by no man.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «N fama nɛ wo rakelide, n fa wo rayalande. E bara wo xili Siyon rabɛɲinxi,

sentences.english: The Lord has said, See, I am changing the fate of the tents of Jacob, and I will have pity on his houses; the town will be put up on its hill, and the great houses will be living-places again.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Alatala bara a masen, n Yaxuba harige ragbilenma nɛ a bɔnsɔɛ ma, n e xa lingirae rakelima nɛ, n e xa taae tima nɛ taa fori kanaxi fari, n e xa mangɛ banxi yailan a yire fori.

sentences.english: And from them will go out praise and the sound of laughing: and I will make them great in number, and they will not become less; and I will give them glory, and they will not be small.
sentences.susu: E fama nɛ n matɔxɔde e xui itexi sɛɛwɛ kui. N e rawuyama nɛ, e mu xurunma. N e binyama nɛ, alako e naxa lu yaagi kui sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And their children will be as they were in the old days, and the meeting of the people will have its place before me, and I will send punishment on all who are cruel to them.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba xa die man luma nɛ alɔ a singe, a bɔnsɔɛ sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ n ya xɔri. N e yaxuie gerema nɛ.

sentences.english: And their chief will be of their number; their ruler will come from among themselves; and I will let him be present before me, so that he may come near to me: for who may have strength of heart to come near me? says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ minima nɛ Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ, e xa mangɛ fama findide e xa mixi nde nan na. N tan na a raminima, a xa a makɔrɛ n na, xa na mu a ra mixi yo mu nɔma na rabade a yɛtɛ ra. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And you will be my people, and I will be your God.
sentences.susu: «Wo findima nɛ n ma ɲama ra, n fan findi wo Marigi Ala ra.

sentences.english: See, the storm-wind of the Lord, even the heat of his wrath, has gone out, a rolling storm, bursting on the heads of the evil-doers.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa xɔnɛ nan ya, a bɔɲɛ tema nɛ alɔ foye belebele, a fa mixi ɲaaxi xun nakana.

sentences.english: The wrath of the Lord will not be turned back till he has done, till he has put into effect, the purposes of his heart: in days to come you will have full knowledge of this.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa xɔnɛ mu bama han a gɛ wali birin nabade a wama naxan xɔn. Wo fama nɛ na birin fahaamude a waxati.»

sentences.english: At that time, says the Lord, I will be the God of all the families of Israel, and they will be my people.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Waxati nde fama, n findima nɛ Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin Marigi Ala ra. E tan fan findima nɛ n ma ɲama ra.»

sentences.english: The Lord has said, Grace came in the waste land to a people kept safe from the sword, even to Israel on the way to his resting-place.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a masen, «Alatala bara hinnɛ Isirayila ra a naxan natangaxi santidɛgɛma ra gbengberen yire. Isirayila fama nɛ malabui sɔtɔde.»

sentences.english: From far away he saw the Lord: my love for you is an eternal love: so with mercy I have made you come with me.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a masen n bɛ kelife yire makuye, «N i xanuma nɛ abadan. N ma hinnɛ mu ɲɔnma i bɛ.

sentences.english: I will again make new your buildings, O virgin of Israel, and you will take up your place: again you will take up your instruments of music, and go out in the dances of those who are glad.
sentences.susu: Isirayila, n i rakelima nɛ, n i yailan. I man bɛɛti bama nɛ sɛɛwɛ kui maxasee xui nun fare ra.

sentences.english: Again will your vine-gardens be planted on the hill of Samaria: the planters will be planting and using the fruit.
sentences.susu: I man sansi sima nɛ Samari geyae fari. Bɔxi rawalimae sansi sima nɛ, e man a bogi ba.

sentences.english: For there will be a day when those who get in the grapes on the hills of Ephraim will be crying, Up! let us go up to Zion to the Lord our God.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ fama a lide, kantamae xili tima nɛ Efirami geya fari, ‹Wo keli, won xa te Siyon geya fari won Marigi Ala na dɛnnaxɛ.›»

sentences.english: For the Lord has said, Make a glad song for Jacob and give a cry on the top of the mountains: give the news, give praise, and say, The Lord has given salvation to his people, even to the rest of Israel.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a masen, «Wo xa sɛɛwa Yaxuba xa fe ra, wo xa si birin xun ti Ala matɔxɔɛ ra. Wo wo xui ramini, wo xa Alatala tantu, naxan bara Isirayila rakisi, a xa ɲama naxan luxi.
