sentences.susu: Wo xa e xa kiri banxie, e xa xurusee, e xa kote birin, nun e xa ɲɔxɔmɛe suxu. Wo xa a fala e bɛ, ‹Fe xɔrɔxɔɛ na wo life yire birin.›

sentences.english: Go in flight, go wandering far off, take cover in deep places, O people of Hazor, says the Lord; for Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, has made a design against you, he has a purpose against you in mind.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Xasorikae, wo xa wo gi, wo xa yili ge wo wo nɔxunma dɛnnaxɛ, barima Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari bara natɛ tongo wo xa fe ra, a bara a ɲanige a xa wo gere.»

sentences.english: Up! go against a nation which is living in comfort and without fear of danger, says the Lord, without doors or locks, living by themselves.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a masen, «Wo keli, wo xa si nde gere naxan bɔɲɛ saxi. A xa naadɛe mu balanxi, a yiree mu makantaxi. A na a kerenyi nan ma.

sentences.english: And their camels will be taken from them by force, and their great herds will come into the hands of their attackers: those who have the ends of their hair cut I will send in flight to all the winds; and I will send their fate on them from every side, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo fama nɛ e xa ɲɔxɔmɛe nun e xa xuruse wuyaxie sɔtɔde. Yi mixi naxee e dɛ xabe sɛɛti bima, n e ralɔɛma nɛ foye kui, e xa tɔɔrɔ yire birin.

sentences.english: And Hazor will be a hole for jackals, a waste for ever: no one will be living in it, and no son of man will have a resting-place there.
sentences.susu: Xasori findima nɛ wulai bare yire ra, gbaloe na dɛnnaxɛ. Mixi yo mu sabatima mɛnni sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: The word of the Lord which came to Jeremiah the prophet about Elam, when Zedekiah first became king of Judah, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala nan yi masenyi tixi Annabi Yeremi bɛ Elama xa fe ra Yudaya mangɛ Sedekiya xa mangɛya fɔlɛ tɛmui:

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: See, I will have the bow of Elam, their chief strength, broken.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala bara a masen, «N Elama xa xali kanama nɛ, naxan findixi a sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: And I will send on Elam four winds from the four quarters of heaven, driving them out to all those winds; there will be no nation into which the wanderers from Elam do not come.
sentences.susu: N gere tima nɛ a bɛ yire birin, n xa a ralɔɛ foye kui. Na gere dangi xanbi, si birin fama nɛ gi mixi nde sɔtɔde kelife Edon.

sentences.english: And I will let Elam be broken before their haters, and before those who are making designs against their lives: I will send evil on them, even my burning wrath, says the Lord; and I will send the sword after them till I have put an end to them:
sentences.susu: N fama nɛ Elamakae rasɛrɛnde e yaxuie ya ra naxee wama e faxafe. N e ɲaxankatama nɛ n ma xɔnɛ kui, n ma santidɛgɛma fa e birin sɔntɔde. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: I will put the seat of my power in Elam, and in Elam I will put an end to kings and rulers, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N ma kibanyi luma nɛ Elama, n e xa mangɛ nun e xa kuntigie faxa. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: But it will come about that, in the last days, I will let the fate of Elam be changed, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ waxati dɔnxɔɛ ra, n man Edonkae ragbilenma nɛ kelife konyiya kui. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: The word which the Lord said about Babylon, about the land of the Chaldaeans, by Jeremiah the prophet.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi a naxan fixi Annabi Yeremi ma Babilɔnkae xa fe ra, naxee na Kalidi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Give it out among the nations, make it public, and let the flag be lifted up; give the word and keep nothing back; say, Babylon is taken, Bel is put to shame, Merodach is broken, her images are put to shame, her gods are broken.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa a fala si birin bɛ, wo xa e rakolon a ra, wo xa tɔnxuma ti na xa fe ra, wo naxa a nɔxun. Wo xa a fala, ‹Babilɔn bara suxu, a xa ala kuye Beli nun Merodaki bara yaagi, e bara gaaxu,

sentences.english: For out of the north a nation is coming up against her, which will make her land waste and unpeopled: they are in flight, man and beast are gone.
sentences.susu: barima si nde kelife kɔɔla ma, na tefe e xili ma. Si nan a ra naxan findixi gbaloe raba ra, mixi yo, sube yo, sese mu luxi sɔnɔn, e birin bara e gi.›»

sentences.english: In those days and in that time, says the Lord, the children of Israel will come, they and the children of Judah together; they will go on their way weeping and making prayer to the Lord their God.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Na waxati Isirayilakae nun Yudayakae gbilenma nɛ. E fama nɛ wa ra, e e Marigi Alatala fen.

sentences.english: They will be questioning about the way to Zion, with their faces turned in its direction, saying, Come, and be united to the Lord in an eternal agreement which will be kept in mind for ever.
sentences.susu: E maxɔrinyi tima nɛ Siyon xa fe ra, e e xunti naa ra. ‹Won xɛɛ, won xa saatɛ xiri won nun Alatala tagi, saatɛ naxan mu nɛɛmuma won na sɔnɔn.›

sentences.english: My people have been wandering sheep: their keepers have made them go out of the right way, turning them loose on the mountains: they have gone from mountain to hill, having no memory of their resting-place.
sentences.susu: N ma ɲama nu luxi nɛ alɔ xuruse lɔɛxie. E kantamae bara e ralɔɛ geyae fari. E nu te, e nu goro, e mu a kolon e na dɛdɛ.

sentences.english: They have been attacked by all those who came across them: and their attackers said, We are doing no wrong, because they have done evil against the Lord in whom is righteousness, against the Lord, the hope of their fathers.
sentences.susu: Naxee na e to, e e tɔɔrɔ. E yaxuie bara a fala, ‹Muxu fɔxi mu a ra. E yi sɔtɔxi nɛ barima e bara yunubi raba Alatala ra, naxan nu bara tinxinyi masen e bɛ, e babae xaxili nu tixi naxan na.›»

sentences.english: Go in flight out of Babylon, go out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and be like he-goats before the flocks.
sentences.susu: «Wo wo gi, wo xa mini Babilɔn, wo mini Kalidi bɔxi ra. Wo xa lu alɔ sikɔtɛ naxan tixi xurusee ya ra.

sentences.english: For see, I am moving and sending up against Babylon a band of great nations from the north country: and they will put their armies in position against her; and from there she will be taken: their arrows will be like those of an expert man of war; not one will come back without getting its mark.
sentences.susu: N tan yati sie rakelima nɛ Babilɔn xili ma, kelife kɔɔla ma. E fama nɛ gere xɔrɔxɔɛ tide e bɛ. E xa tanbɛe sɛnbɛ gbo, e xa gere sɔɔnɛyama nɛ.

sentences.english: And the wealth of Chaldaea will come into the hands of her attackers: all those who take her wealth will have enough, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kalidi bɔxi fama nɛ kanade, e yaxuie fa e waxɔnse tongode. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: Because you are glad, because you are lifted up with pride, you wasters of my heritage, because you are playing like a young cow put out to grass, and you make a noise like strong horses;
sentences.susu: «Iyo, wo xa sɛɛwa, wo xa ɲɛlɛxin, wo tan naxee bara n kɛ xun nakana. Iyo, wo xa tugan alɔ ningee, wo xa wo xui ramini alɔ soee.

sentences.english: Your mother will be put to shame; she who gave you birth will be looked down on: see, she will be the last of the nations, a waste place, a dry and unwatered land.
sentences.susu: Wo nga bara yaagi, naxan wo barixi a bara lu yaagi kui. A bara findi si dɔnxɔɛ ra, a xa bɔxi bara findi gbengberenyi ra, yire maxaraxi ra.

sentences.english: Because of the wrath of the Lord no one will be living in it, and it will be quite unpeopled: everyone who goes by Babylon will be overcome with wonder, and make sounds of fear at all her punishments.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara xɔnɔ a ma, a xa bɔxi mu rasabatima sɔnɔn. A bara findi gbaloe yire ra. Mixi naxan nɛ dangima naa, na kanyi dɛ ixarama nɛ, e kaaba na gbaloe ma.»

sentences.english: Put your armies in position against Babylon on every side, all you bowmen; let loose your arrows at her, not keeping any back: for she has done evil against the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa ti Babilɔn ya ra gere ki ma. Xali kanyie, wo xa tanbɛe woli e ma. Wo xa gere ti sɛnbɛ ra, barima a bara yunubi raba Alatala ra.

sentences.english: Give a loud cry against her on every side; she has given herself up, her supports are overturned, her walls are broken down: for it is the payment taken by the Lord; give her payment; as she has done, so do to her.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɔnxɔɛ rate a ma. A wama a yɛtɛ nan fife wo ma, a xa banxie bara kana, a xa tɛtɛ bara bira Alatala gbeɲɔxɔɛ saabui ra. Wo fan xa wo gbeɲɔxɔ. Wo xa a raba a ra alɔ a a rabaxi wo ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Let the planter of seed be cut off from Babylon, and everyone using the curved blade at the time of the grain-cutting: for fear of the cruel sword, everyone will be turned to his people, everyone will go in flight to his land.
sentences.susu: Wo xa xɛɛ sae nun xɛɛ xabamae faxa Babilɔn. Santidɛgɛma xa a niya e birin xa e gi e xɔnyi ma.

sentences.english: Israel is a wandering sheep; the lions have been driving him away: first he was attacked by the king of Assyria, and now his bones have been broken by Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon.
sentences.susu: Isirayila luxi nɛ alɔ xuruse lɔɛxi, yɛtɛ bara naxee keri. Asiri mangɛ nan singe a tɔɔrɔ, Babilɔn mangɛ fan fa a halaki a dɔnxɔɛ ra.»

sentences.english: So this is what the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, has said: See, I will send punishment on the king of Babylon and on his land, as I have given punishment to the king of Assyria.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra Isirayila Marigi Alatala a masenxi, «N Babilɔn mangɛ nun a xa ɲama ɲaxankatama nɛ alɔ n a rabaxi Asiriya mangɛ ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And I will make Israel come back to his resting-place, and he will get his food on Carmel and Bashan, and have his desire in full measure on the hills of Ephraim and in Gilead.
sentences.susu: N Isirayila ragbilenma nɛ a xɔnyi, a xa gɔɔrɛ man xa lu Karemele nun Basan, a xa wasa fe fanyi ra Efirami nun Galadi geyae fari.

sentences.english: In those days and in that time, says the Lord, when the evil-doing of Israel is looked for, there will be nothing; and in Judah no sins will be seen: for I will have forgiveness for those whom I will keep safe.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Na waxati n diɲɛma nɛ Isirayila xa yunubie ma, n diɲɛ Yudaya xa yunubie fan ma, barima n bara mixi dɔnxɔɛ xa yunubie xafari.»

sentences.english: Go up against the land of Merathaim, even against it, and against the people of Pekod; put them to death and send destruction after them, says the Lord, and do everything I have given you orders to do.
sentences.susu: «Wo te Meratayimi bɔxi ma Pekodikae xili ma. Wo xa e ratɔn, wo xa n ma yaamari birin nakamali.

sentences.english: There is a sound of war in the land and of great destruction.
sentences.susu: Gere sɔnxɔɛ na e xa bɔxi ma, gbaloe na a ra.

sentences.english: How is the hammer of all the earth cut in two and broken! how has Babylon become a waste among the nations!
sentences.susu: Babilɔn sɛnbɛma bara kana, naxan nu luxi alɔ dɛrɛma duniɲa birin kui. Yakɔsi a bara findi gbaloe yire ra.

sentences.english: I have put a net for you, and you have been taken, O Babylon, without your knowledge: you have been uncovered and taken because you were fighting against the Lord.
sentences.susu: N bara Babilɔn suxu gantanyi ra a mu naxan toxi. N bara i to, n bara i masɔtɔ barima Ala matandi nan nu i ra.

sentences.english: From his store-house the Lord has taken the instruments of his wrath: for the Lord, the Lord of armies, has a work to do in the land of the Chaldaeans.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan gere soxi Babilɔn a xa xɔnɛ kui. Mangɛ Alatala na walife Kalidi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Come up against her one and all, let her store-houses be broken open: make her into a mass of stones, give her to the curse, till there is nothing of her to be seen.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa birin xa fa Babilɔn, wo xa e xa banxie rabi e sansi bogie ragatama dɛnnaxɛ. Na birin xa ratɔn, sese naxa lu.

sentences.english: Put all her oxen to the sword; let them go down to death: sorrow is theirs, for their day has come, the time of their punishment.
sentences.susu: Wo xa e xa tuurae birin kɔn naxaba xuruse kɔn naxabama dɛnnaxɛ. Ɲaxankatɛ na e bɛ, e xa kiiti waxati bara a li.

sentences.english: The voice of those who are in flight, who have got away safe from the land of Babylon, to give news in Zion of punishment from the Lord our God, even payment for his Temple.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee kelixi Babilɔn konyiya kui, e na masenyi tife Siyon, ‹Muxu Marigi Alatala bara a gbeɲɔxɔ, a bara a xa hɔrɔmɔlingira gbeɲɔxɔ.›

sentences.english: Send for the archers to come together against Babylon, all the bowmen; put up your tents against her on every side; let no one get away: give her the reward of her work; as she has done, so do to her: for she has been uplifted in pride against the Lord, against the Holy One of Israel.
sentences.susu: Xali kanyie xa fa Babilɔn xili ma, naxee fata tanbɛ wolide. Wo xa Babilɔn nabilin, mixi yo naxa mini. Wo xa a xa kɛwali sare ragbilen a ma, wo xa a raba a ra alɔ a rabaxi mixi gbɛtɛ ra ki naxɛ. A bara a yɛtɛ igbo Alatala ma, Isirayila sɛniyɛntɔɛ.

sentences.english: For this cause her young men will be falling in her streets, and all her men of war will be cut off in that day, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra a xa fonikee fama birade taa kui, a xa sɔɔrie dundu na tɛmui. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: See, I am against you, O pride, says the Lord, the Lord of armies, for your day has come, the time when I will send punishment on you.
sentences.susu: «I tan yɛtɛ igboe, n xa i ɲaxankata. I xa kiiti lɔxɔɛ bara a li. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And pride will go with uncertain steps and have a fall, and there will be no one to come to his help: and I will put a fire in his towns, burning up everything round about him.
sentences.susu: «Na yɛtɛ igboe birama nɛ, mixi yo mu a rakelima. N a xa taae ganma nɛ, n a rabilinyi birin kana.

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: The children of Israel and the children of Judah are crushed down together: all those who took them prisoner keep them in a tight grip; they will not let them go.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala bara a masen, Isirayilakae nun Yudayakae na ɲaxankatɛ kui. Mixi naxee e rasoxi konyiya kui e tondima nɛ e rabɛɲinde.

sentences.english: Their saviour is strong; the Lord of armies is his name: he will certainly take up their cause, so that he may give rest to the earth and trouble to the people of Babylon.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e xunsarama sɛnbɛ gbo, a xili Mangɛ Alatala. A e xun mafalama nɛ alako e xa bɔɲɛsa sɔtɔ, Babilɔnkae xun xa rakana.

sentences.english: A sword is on the Chaldaeans, says the Lord, and on the people of Babylon, and on her rulers and on her wise men.
sentences.susu: Santidɛgɛma xa Kalidikae faxa, a xa Babilɔnkae, e xa kuntigie, nun e xa karamɔxɔɛ sɔntɔ.

sentences.english: A sword is on the men of pride, and they will become foolish: a sword is on her men of war, and they will be broken.
sentences.susu: Santidɛgɛma xa e xa namiɲɔnmɛ wule falɛe faxa. Xaxilitaree nan e ra. Santidɛgɛma xa e xa sɔɔrie faxa. E xa lu gaaxui kui.

sentences.english: A sword is on all the mixed people in her, and they will become like women: a sword is on her store-houses, and they will be taken by her attackers.
sentences.susu: Santidɛgɛma xa e xa soee faxa, a xa e xa sɔɔri ragisee kana. Santidɛgɛma xa e xa sɔɔri saraxie faxa. E xa lu alɔ ginɛe. Santidɛgɛma xa e xa naafuli kana, e xa xanin.

sentences.english: A sword is on her waters, drying them up; for it is a land of images, and their minds are fixed on false gods.
sentences.susu: E xa xuree xa xɔri. Kuye bɔxi na a ra. Kuyee nan mixi madaxuma.

sentences.english: For this reason the beasts of the waste land with the wolves will make their holes there and the ostriches will be living in it: never again will men be living there, it will be unpeopled from generation to generation.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra wulai subee luma naa, wulai baree, baratɛe, nun xɔni ɲaaxie. Mixi yo mu sabatima naa sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: As when Sodom and Gomorrah and their neighbouring towns were overturned by God, says the Lord, so no man will be living in it, and no son of man will have a resting-place there.
sentences.susu: A luma nɛ alɔ Sodoma nun Gomora Ala naxan kana. Mixi mu toma naa, adamadi yo mu sabatima naa. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: See, a people is coming from the north; a great nation and a number of kings will be put in motion from the inmost parts of the earth.
sentences.susu: «Ɲama na fafe kelife kɔɔla ma. Si sɛnbɛma na a ra, naxan xa mangɛe na duniɲa yire birin.

sentences.english: Bows and spears are in their hands; they are cruel and have no mercy; their voice is like the thunder of the sea, and they go on horses; everyone in his place like men going to the fight, against you, O daughter of Babylon.
sentences.susu: Xali nun tanbɛ na e yi ra. E ɲaaxu, e mu kinikini kolon. E xui gbo alɔ mɔrɔnyi xui. E ɲɛrɛma soe nan fari, e fata gere ra. E na fafe Babilɔn nan fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: The king of Babylon has had news of them, and his hands have become feeble: trouble has come on him and pain like the pain of a woman in childbirth.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn mangɛ to na mɛ, a sɛnbɛ naxa kana, a bɔɲɛ naxa gaaxu, alɔ ginɛ naxan na di barife.

sentences.english: See, he will come up like a lion from the thick growth of Jordan against the resting-place of Teman: but I will suddenly make them go in flight from her; and I will put over her the man of my selection: for who is like me? and who will put forward his cause against me? and what keeper of sheep will keep his place before me?
sentences.susu: N luma nɛ alɔ yɛtɛ naxan kelima Yurudɛn xure fɛ ma, a siga sube fende yire gbɛtɛ. N Babilɔn kerima nɛ a xɔnyi, n fa mangɛ sugandixi ti a xun. Nde maniya n na? Nde n nasima? Nde nɔma n natondide?

sentences.english: So give ear to the decision of the Lord which he has made against Babylon, and to his purposes designed against the land of the Chaldaeans; Truly, they will be pulled away by the smallest of the flock; truly, he will make waste their fields with them.
sentences.susu: Na kui wo xa wo tuli mati Alatala xa natɛ ra, a naxan tongoxi Babilɔn xili ma, a naxan ɲanigexi Kalidi xa bɔxi xa fe ra. A e xaninma nɛ alɔ xurusee, a fa e xɔnyi kana.

sentences.english: At the cry, Babylon is taken! the earth is shaking, and the cry comes to the ears of the nations.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa na a kolon a Babilɔn bara suxu, e sɛrɛnma nɛ, e fa lu gaaxui kui.»

sentences.english: The Lord has said: See, I will make a wind of destruction come up against Babylon and against those who are living in Chaldaea;
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a masen, «N turunnaadɛ xɛɛma nɛ Babilɔn xili ma,

sentences.english: And I will send men to Babylon to make her clean and get her land cleared: for in the day of trouble they will put up their tents against her on every side.
sentences.susu: turunnaadɛ naxan findixi a yaxuie ra. E fama nɛ a rayensende foye kui, e a harige birin ba a yi ra, e ti a kanke a yire birin.

sentences.english: Against her the bow of the archer is bent, and he puts on his coat of metal: have no mercy on her young men, give all her army up to the curse.
sentences.susu: Xali woli xa a kanke makantase tongo. A naxa kinikini Babilɔn sɛgɛtalae ma, a xa e sɔntɔ.

sentences.english: And the dead will be stretched out in the land of the Chaldaeans, and the wounded in her streets.
sentences.susu: Kalidika faxaxie toma nɛ e xa bɔxi ma yire birin, e rabiraxi kirae ma, e sɔxɔxi a ɲaaxi ra.»

sentences.english: For Israel has not been given up, or Judah, by his God, by the Lord of armies; for their land is full of sin against the Holy One of Israel.
sentences.susu: «Mangɛ Alatala mu Isirayila nun Yudaya raboloma, hali e xa yunubie to bara gbo e ma e xɔnyi Isirayila sɛniyɛntɔɛ ya xɔri.

sentences.english: Go in flight out of Babylon, so that every man may keep his life; do not be cut off in her evil-doing: for it is the time of the Lord's punishment; he will give her her reward.
sentences.susu: Wo xa keli Babilɔn bɔxi ma. Kankan xa a yɛtɛ rakisi, barima Alatala fama nɛ a gbe ɲɔxɔde, a e sare ragbilen e ma.

sentences.english: Babylon has been a gold cup in the hand of the Lord, which has made all the earth overcome with wine: the nations have taken of her wine, and for this cause the nations have gone off their heads.
sentences.susu: Singe, Alatala nan nu findixi saabui ra Babilɔn bɛ, duniɲa birin xa ɲaxankata, e xa madaxu alɔ siisilae.

sentences.english: Sudden is the downfall of Babylon and her destruction: make cries of grief for her; take sweet oil for her pain, if it is possible for her to be made well.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi a gbe mu luxi a xa bira, a xun xa rakana. Wo xa a kunfa ba, wo xa kata seri sɔtɔde a bɛ alako a xa yalan.»

sentences.english: We would have made Babylon well, but she is not made well: give her up, and let us go everyone to his country: for her punishment is stretching up to heaven, and lifted up even to the skies.
sentences.susu: «Won bara kata Babilɔn rayalande, kɔnɔ a mu sɔɔnɛyaxi. Won xa a lu naa, won xa siga won xɔnyi, barima a xa yunubie bara gbo yɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord has made clear our righteousness: come, and let us give an account in Zion of the work of the Lord our God.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara won nakisi tinxinyi ra. Won xa won Marigi Alatala xa kaabanakoe dɛntɛgɛ Siyon.

sentences.english: Make bright the arrows; take up the body-covers: the Lord has been moving the spirit of the king of the Medes; because his design against Babylon is its destruction: for it is the punishment from the Lord, the payment for his Temple.
sentences.susu: Tanbɛe yailan, xali sase rafe. Alatala bara a niya Mede mangɛ bɔɲɛ xa te, a xa Babilɔn ɲaxankata a Marigi bɛ. Alatala gbeɲɔxɔɛ nan na ki a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Let the flag be lifted up against the walls of Babylon, make the watch strong, put the watchmen in their places, make ready a surprise attack: for it is the Lord's purpose, and he has done what he said about the people of Babylon.
sentences.susu: Wo xa tɔnxuma rate Babilɔn xa tɛtɛ xili ma, wo xa sɔɔrie xa wuya, e xa e yɛtɛ yailan gere xili ma. Alatala fama nɛ a sago rabade, a a xa natɛ rakamali Babilɔnkae xili ma.»

sentences.english: O you whose living-place is by the wide waters, whose stores are great, your end is come, your evil profit is ended.
sentences.susu: Wo tan Babilɔnka naafuli kanyi naxee sabatixi xure dɛ ra, wo ɲɔn waxati bara a li.

sentences.english: The Lord of armies has taken an oath by himself, saying, Truly, I will make you full with men as with locusts, and their voices will be loud against you.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala bara a kali a yɛtɛ xili ra, «N fama nɛ sɔɔrie ra wo xili ma, e wuya alɔ tugumi gali, e fa sɔnxɔɛ belebele rate.»

sentences.english: He has made the earth by his power, he has made the world strong in its place by his wisdom, and by his wise design the heavens have been stretched out:
sentences.susu: Alatala duniɲa daaxi a sɛnbɛ nan na, a xare sa a xa lɔnni ra, a koore itala a xa fe kolonyi ra.

sentences.english: At the sound of his voice there is a massing of the waters in the heavens, and he makes the mists go up from the ends of the earth; he makes the thunder-flames for the rain and sends out the wind from his store-houses.
sentences.susu: A na galanyi rabula, tunɛ ye kelima nɛ koore ma, nuxui te bɔxi xun ma. A seyamakɔnyi raminima tunɛ, a foye ramini a kelide.

sentences.english: Then every man becomes like a beast without knowledge; every gold-worker is put to shame by the image he has made: for his metal image is deceit, and there is no breath in them.
sentences.susu: Adamadi findixi xaxilitare nan na naxan mu fahaamui sɔtɔ, xɛɛma xabui yaagi sɔtɔma nɛ a xa kuyee saabui ra, naxee findixi kuye wule ɲɛngitaree ra.

sentences.english: They are nothing, a work of error: in the time of their punishment, destruction will overtake them.
sentences.susu: Se fufafu nan na e ra, lɔnnila yoma naxan ma. E fama nɛ ɲɔnde e xa kiiti waxati.

sentences.english: The heritage of Jacob is not like these; for the maker of all things is his heritage: the Lord of armies is his name.
sentences.susu: Annabi Yaxuba Marigi tan mu na ki xɛ, barima Daali mangɛ na a ra naxan xili Alatala Sɛnbɛma, naxan a xa ɲama daa a yɛtɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: You are my fighting axe and my instrument of war: with you the nations will be broken; with you kingdoms will be broken;
sentences.susu: «I tan findixi n ma geresose nan na, n sie rayensenma naxan na, n mangɛya xun nakanama naxan saabui ra,

sentences.english: With you the horse and the horseman will be broken; with you the war-carriage and he who goes in it will be broken;
sentences.susu: n soe nun a ragima xa fe danma naxan na, n sɔɔri ragise kanama naxan saabui ra,

sentences.english: With you man and woman will be broken; with you the old man and the boy will be broken; with you the young man and the virgin will be broken;
sentences.susu: n xɛmɛ nun ginɛ sɔntɔma naxan na, n sɛgɛtala nun ginɛdimɛdi faxama naxan saabui ra,

sentences.english: With you the keeper of sheep with his flock will be broken, and with you the farmer and his oxen will be broken, and with you captains and rulers will be broken.
sentences.susu: n xurusee nun a dɛmadonyie rayensenma naxan na, n xɛ sae nun e xa ninge rayensenma naxan saabui ra, n mangɛ nun kuntigie rayensenma naxan na.

sentences.english: And I will give to Babylon, and to all the people of Chaldaea, their reward for all the evil they have done in Zion before your eyes, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N sare ragbilenma nɛ Babilɔn bɔxi nun Babilɔnkae ma, e xa fe ɲaaxie xa fe ra e naxan nabaxi Siyon na. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: See, I am against you, says the Lord, O mountain of destruction, causing the destruction of all the earth: and my hand will be stretched out on you, rolling you down from the rocks, and making you a burned mountain.
sentences.susu: N tixi i kanke, i tan mangɛya xungbe naxan duniɲa xun nakana. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki. N na n xɔnyɛ italama nɛ i xili ma, n i radin tentenyi ra, n i findi geya ra naxan kui igeli.

sentences.english: And they will not take from you a stone for the angle of a wall or the base of a building; but you will be a waste place for ever, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Tide yo mu luma i ma sɔnɔn, sese mu tima i xɔnyi. I mu findima a ra abadan. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: Let a flag be lifted up in the land, let the horn be sounded among the nations, make the nations ready against her; get the kingdoms of Ararat, Minni, and Ashkenaz together against her, make ready a scribe against her; let the horses come up against her like massed locusts.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa tɔnxuma rate duniɲa ma. Wo xa gere sara xui ramini sie tagi. Wo xa keli, gere xa ti Babilɔn xili ma. Mangɛya birin xa fa kelife Ararati, Mini, nun Asikenasi. Sɔɔri mangɛ xa sugandi wo ya ma, wo xa soe xa wuya alɔ tugumi gali.

sentences.english: Make the nations ready for war against her, the king of the Medes and his rulers and all his captains, and all the land under his rule.
sentences.susu: Sie xa fa gere xili ma, Mede xa mangɛe nun a xa kuntigie, a nun e yamarima ɲamanɛ naxee ma.

sentences.english: And the land is shaking and in pain: for the purposes of the Lord are fixed, to make the land of Babylon an unpeopled waste.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn bɔxi sɛrɛnma nɛ tɔɔrɛ kui, barima Alatala xa natɛe mu kanama. Na bɔxi fama nɛ xun nakanade, mixi yo mu sabatima mɛnni sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Babylon's men of war have kept back from the fight, waiting in their strong places; their strength has given way, they have become like women: her houses have been put on fire, her locks are broken.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn xa sɔɔrie mu gere tima sɔnɔn, e luma e xa yire kantaxie nan kui tun. E sɛnbɛ bara ɲɔn, e fa luxi nɛ alɔ ginɛe. E xa banxie birin ganxi, e xa tɛtɛ naadɛ kanaxi.

sentences.english: One man, running, will give word to another, and one who goes with news will be handing it on to another, to give word to the king of Babylon that his town has been taken from every quarter:
sentences.susu: Xɛɛrae lu ra nɛ fa ra mangɛ xɔnyi, e a fala a bɛ a yaxuie bara dɛnnaxɛ suxu.

sentences.english: And the ways across the river have been taken, and the water-holes ... burned with fire, and the men of war are in the grip of fear.
sentences.susu: E bara xure igiridee suxu, e bara tɛ so xɛe ra, Babilɔn sɔɔrie bara lu gaaxui kui.

sentences.english: For these are the words of the Lord of armies, the God of Israel: The daughter of Babylon is like a grain-floor when it is stamped down; before long, the time of her grain-cutting will come.
sentences.susu: N tan Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, Babilɔn taa luxi nɛ alɔ lonyi sansi xɔri boronma dɛnnaxɛ. A xa xɛ xaba tɛmui na fafe.»

sentences.english: Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, has made a meal of me, violently crushing me, he has made me a vessel with nothing in it, he has taken me in his mouth like a dragon, he has made his stomach full with my delicate flesh, crushing me with his teeth.
sentences.susu: «Babilɔn Mangɛ Nebukadansari bara won tɔɔrɔ, a bara won xaxili ifu, a bara won lu alɔ bɛki igeli. A luxi nɛ alɔ sube magaaxuxi naxan bara won don, naxan luga won na, a won bɔxun.

sentences.english: May the violent things done to me, and my downfall, come on Babylon, the daughter of Zion will say; and, May my blood be on the people of Chaldaea, Jerusalem will say.
sentences.susu: A fe ɲaaxi naxan nabaxi won tan Siyonkae ra, na xa gbilen Babilɔn ma. A nii naxee baxi Darisalamu, na sare xa gbilen Babilɔnkae ma.»

sentences.english: For this reason the Lord has said: See, I will give support to your cause, and take payment for what you have undergone; I will make her sea dry, and her fountain without water.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala naxɛ, «Wo xa a mato, n fama nɛ wo xun mafalade, n fa wo gbe ɲɔxɔde. N Babilɔn baa xɔrima nɛ, n a xa dulonyie xarama nɛ.

sentences.english: And Babylon will become a mass of broken walls, a hole for jackals, a cause of wonder and surprise, without a living man in it.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn findima nɛ yire kanaxi ra wulai baree luma dɛnnaxɛ. Mixie mu tinma lude na yire magaaxuxi.

sentences.english: They will be crying out together like lions, their voices will be like the voices of young lions.
sentences.susu: A xa ɲama xaaɲɛxi alɔ yɛtɛe, e e xui raminima alɔ yɛtɛ yɔrɛ,

sentences.english: When they are heated, I will make a feast for them, and overcome them with wine, so that they may become unconscious, sleeping an eternal sleep without awaking, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ e na keli, n e findima siisilae nan na, naxee yelema han, kɔnɔ e na xi, e mu xunuma sɔnɔn. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: I will make them go down to death like lambs, like he-goats together.
sentences.susu: «N e ragoroma nɛ alɔ yɛxɛɛ naxee kɔn naxabama, alɔ yɛxɛɛ nun si kontonyie.

sentences.english: How is Babylon taken! and the praise of all the earth surprised! how has Babylon become a cause of wonder among the nations!
sentences.susu: Babilɔn xungbe, duniɲa birin naxan matɔxɔma, na biraxi di? Munse a niyaxi a xa findi gbaloe ra sie tagi?

sentences.english: The sea has come up over Babylon; she is covered with the mass of its waves.
sentences.susu: Baa fama nɛ a makotode, mɔrɔnyie din a ra.

sentences.english: Her towns have become a waste, a dry and unwatered land, where no man has his living-place and no son of man goes by.
sentences.susu: A xa taae bɛɲinma nɛ, e findi gbengberenyi ra, mixi mu sabatima dɛnnaxɛ. Hali biyaasilae mu luma naa.

sentences.english: And I will send punishment on Bel in Babylon, and take out of his mouth what went into it; no longer will the nations be flowing together to him: truly, the wall of Babylon will come down.
sentences.susu: N e xa kuye Beli ɲaxankatama nɛ, n fa a niya a xa mixie bɛɲin a naxee sɔtɔ. Mixie mu kelima ɲamanɛe ma fafe a batude sɔnɔn. Babilɔn xa tɛtɛ birama nɛ kerenyi ra.»

sentences.english: My people, go out from her, and let every man get away safe from the burning wrath of the Lord.
sentences.susu: «N ma ɲama, wo xa keli naa. Wo xa wo gi, barima Alatala xa xɔnɛ bulama mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: So that your hearts may not become feeble and full of fear because of the news which will go about in the land; for a story will go about one year, and after that in another year another story, and violent acts in the land, ruler against ruler.
sentences.susu: Limaniya naxa ba wo yi ra, wo naxa gaaxu wɔyɛnyi ra naxee fama mɛde naa. Wɔyɛnyi luma fala ra nɛ sɛnbɛmae xa fe ra nun gere xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For this cause, truly, the days are coming when I will send punishment on the images of Babylon, and all her land will be shamed, and her dead will be falling down in her.
sentences.susu: Waxati fama a lide n Babilɔn xa kuyee ɲaxankatama tɛmui naxɛ. A xa bɔxi birin luma yaagi kui na tɛmui nɛ, a xa mixie fa sɔntɔde.

sentences.english: And the heaven and the earth and everything in them, will make a song of joy over Babylon: for those who make her waste will come from the north, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na kui koore nun bɔxi fama nɛ ɲɛlɛxinde a xa birɛ xa fe ra, a yaxuie sago ma, yaxui naxee kelixi kɔɔla ma. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: As Babylon had the dead of Israel put to the sword, so in Babylon the dead of all the land will be stretched out.
sentences.susu: «Babilɔn xa bira Isirayilaka mixi faxaxie xa fe ra, alɔ mixi gbegbe faxaxi duniɲa ma ki naxɛ Babilɔn bɛlɛxɛ fɔxi ra.

sentences.english: You who have got away safe from the sword, go, waiting for nothing; have the Lord in memory when you are far away, and keep Jerusalem in mind.
sentences.susu: Wo tan naxee bara wo yɛtɛ ratanga santidɛgɛma ma, wo naxa dugundi, wo xa siga. Hali wo na yire makuye, wo xa ratu Alatala ma, wo ɲɔxɔ xa sa Darisalamu xɔn.»

sentences.english: We are shamed because bitter words have come to our ears; our faces are covered with shame: for men from strange lands have come into the holy places of the Lord's house.
sentences.susu: «Won bara yaagi sɔtɔ, won bara konbi, won mu nɔma won xun nakelide sɔnɔn, barima si gbɛtɛe bara so yire sɛniyɛnxie kui Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi yire.»

sentences.english: For this reason, see, the days are coming, says the Lord, when I will send punishment on her images; and through all her land the wounded will be crying out in pain.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «N na gɛ Babilɔn xa kuyee ɲaxankatade, a xa ɲama luma wa ra nɛ bɔxi birin ma.

sentences.english: Even if Babylon was lifted up to heaven, even if she had the high places of her strength shut in with walls, still I would send against her those who will make her waste, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Hali Babilɔn xa fe fama sɔɔnɛyade nu, a xa xunnakeli sɔtɔ, n fama nɛ a niyade a xa fe birin xa kana. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: There is the sound of a cry from Babylon, and of a great destruction from the land of the Chaldaeans:
sentences.susu: «Xui xɔrɔxɔɛ minima Babilɔn bɔxi ma a xa kanari nan xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For the Lord is making Babylon waste, and putting an end to the great voice coming out of her; and her waves are thundering like great waters, their voice is sounding loud:
sentences.susu: Alatala fama nɛ Babilɔn xun nakanade, a e xa sɔnxɔɛ dan. E yaxuie dinma nɛ e ra alɔ baa mɔrɔnyie, e xui xaaɲɛ a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: For the waster has come on her, even on Babylon, and her men of war are taken, their bows are broken: for the Lord is a rewarding God, and he will certainly give payment.
sentences.susu: Kanaritie birama nɛ Babilɔnkae fɔxɔ ra, e e xa sɔɔrie suxu, e e xa xalie igira, barima Alatala gbeɲɔxɔɛ tima nɛ, a e sare birin nagbilen e ma.

sentences.english: And I will make her chiefs and her wise men, her rulers and her captains and her men of war, overcome with wine; their sleep will be an eternal sleep without awaking, says the King; the Lord of armies is his name.
sentences.susu: N e xa mangɛe, kuntigie, lɔnnilae nun sɔɔrie findima siisilae nan na, naxee luma xi ra abadan, e mu xunuma fefe ma. Mangɛ xa masenyi nan na ki, naxan xili Alatala Sɛnbɛma.»

sentences.english: The Lord of armies has said: The wide walls of Babylon will be completely uncovered and her high doorways will be burned with fire; so peoples keep on working for nothing, and the weariness of nations comes to an end in the smoke.
sentences.susu: «Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, Babilɔn xa tɛtɛ xungbe birama nɛ, a xa naadɛ itexie gan, a xa ɲama a yɛtɛ ratagan fe fufafu ma, a wali naxan nabaxi, na birin gan tɛ ra.»

sentences.english: The order which Jeremiah the prophet gave to Seraiah, the son of Neriah, the son of Mahseiah, when he went with Zedekiah, the king of Judah, to Babylon in the fourth year of his rule. Now Seraiah was the chief controller of the house.
sentences.susu: Annabi Yeremi to Yudaya mangɛ Sedekiya mati Babilɔn a xa mangɛya ɲɛ naani nde ra, a naxa yi masenyi so Neriya xa di Seraya yi ra, naxan findixi Maxaseya xa mamadi ra.

sentences.english: And Jeremiah put in a book all the evil which was to come on Babylon.
sentences.susu: A nu bara Babilɔn xa gbaloe xa fe birin sɛbɛ kɛɛdi nde ma, a nu lanma e xa naxee sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Jeremiah said to Seraiah, When you come to Babylon, see that you give them all these words;
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Seraya bɛ, «I na Babilɔn bɔxi li, i xa yi masenyi birin xaran i xui itexi ra.

sentences.english: And after reading them, say, O Lord, you have said about this place that it is to be cut off, so that no one will be living in it, not a man or a beast, but it will be unpeopled for ever.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, i xa a fala, ‹Alatala, i bara a masen a yi yire birin fama nɛ kanade, mixie nun xuruse mu toma be sɔnɔn, yi bɔxi fa findi gbengberenyi ra.›

sentences.english: And it will be that, when you have come to an end of reading this book, you are to have a stone fixed to it, and have it dropped into the Euphrates:
sentences.susu: I na gɛ yi sɛbɛli xarande, i xa a xiri gɛmɛ nde ra, i fa na gɛmɛ woli Efirati xure xɔɔra.

sentences.english: And you are to say, So Babylon will go down, never to be lifted up again, because of the evil which I will send on her: and weariness will overcome them. So far, these are the words of Jeremiah.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui i xa a fala, ‹Babilɔn fan dulama na ki nɛ, a mu tema sɔnɔn gbaloe xa fe ra Alatala naxan nagirixi a ma. A xa ɲama xun mu rakelima sɔnɔn.›» Annabi Yeremi xa masenyi danxi be nɛ.

sentences.english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he became king; he was king for eleven years in Jerusalem: and his mother's name was Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
sentences.susu: Sedekiya mangɛya sɔtɔ a ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun keren nan ma, a fa ɲɛ fu nun keren mangɛya raba Darisalamu. A nga nu findixi Yeremi xa di Xamutali naxan keli Libina ma.

sentences.english: And he did evil in the eyes of the Lord, as Jehoiakim had done.
sentences.susu: Sedekiya naxa fe ɲaaxi raba a Marigi Alatala ya xɔri alɔ Yehoyakimi nu bara a raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And because of the wrath of the Lord this came about in Jerusalem and Judah, till he had sent them away from before him: and Zedekiah took up arms against the king of Babylon.
sentences.susu: Darisalamu nun Yudaya nu bara fe xɔrɔxɔɛ sɔtɔ Alatala xa xɔnɛ xa fe ra. A raɲɔnyi Alatala naxa a gbilen e fɔxɔ ra. Na tɛmui Sedekiya naxa mangɛ Nebukadansari matandi.

sentences.english: And in the ninth year of his rule, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, came against Jerusalem with all his army and took up his position before it, building earthworks all round it.
sentences.susu: Na kui a xa mangɛya ɲɛ solomanaani nde, kike fu, xi fu nde ra, Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari naxa fa a nun a xa sɔɔri gali ra Darisalamu gere xili ma. E naxa yonkin taa rabilinyi ra, e se nde ti alako e xa nɔ tede tɛtɛ fari.

sentences.english: So the town was shut in by their forces till the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
sentences.susu: Taa naxa lu suxui kui han mangɛ Sedekiya xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun keren nde ra.

sentences.english: In the fourth month, on the ninth day of the month, the store of food in the town was almost gone, so that there was no food for the people of the land.
sentences.susu: Kike naani nde xi solomanaani nde ra, kaamɛ nu bara sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ taa kui, donse yo mu nu na ɲama yi ra sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Then an opening was made in the wall of the town, and all the men of war went in flight out of the town by night through the doorway between the two walls which was by the king's garden; (now the Chaldaeans were stationed round the town:) and they went by the way of the Arabah.
sentences.susu: Taa tɛtɛ to kana, sɔɔrie naxa e gi naadɛ ra naxan na tɛtɛ firinyie tagi, mangɛ xa malabude fɛ ma, e fa siga Araba fiili ma. Kalidikae nu yonkinxi taa rabilinyi.

sentences.english: And the Chaldaean army went after King Zedekiah and overtook him on the other side of Jericho, and all his army went in flight from him in every direction.
sentences.susu: Kalidikae to taa sɔɔrie to e gi ra, e naxa bira e xa mangɛ fɔxɔ ra, e fa a suxu Yeriko fiili ma. Mangɛ xa sɔɔrie naxa e gi a xun ma, e yensen yɛ.

sentences.english: Then they made the king a prisoner and took him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah in the land of Hamath to be judged.
sentences.susu: Kalidikae naxa mangɛ suxu, e a xanin Babilɔn mangɛ xɔn ma Ribila a makiitife ra.

sentences.english: And the king of Babylon put the sons of Zedekiah to death before his eyes: and he put to death all the rulers of Judah in Riblah.
sentences.susu: E naxa Sedekiya xa die kɔn naxaba a ya xɔri, e fa a tan yae kana.

sentences.english: And he put out Zedekiah's eyes; and the king of Babylon, chaining him in iron bands, took him to Babylon, and put him in prison till the day of his death.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Babilɔn mangɛ naxa a xiri wure gbeeli yɔlɔnxɔnyi ra, a a xanin Babilɔn. Mɛnni a naxa lu geeli kui han a faxa tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: Now in the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month, in the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, a servant of the king of Babylon, came into Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Kike suuli nde xi fu nde ra, Nebukadansari xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun solomanaani nde Babilɔn xun ma, Nebusaradan Babilɔn mangɛ xa sɔɔri xunyi naxa siga Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And he had the house of the Lord and the king's house and all the houses of Jerusalem, even every great house, burned with fire:
sentences.susu: A naxa Alatala xa banxi, mangɛ xa banxi, nun Darisalamu banxi xungbe birin gan.

sentences.english: And the walls round Jerusalem were broken down by the Chaldaean army which was with the captain.
sentences.susu: Kalidikae xa sɔɔri naxee nu na a fɔxɔ ra, e naxa tɛtɛ rabira naxan nu Darisalamu rabilinxi.

sentences.english: Then Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, took away as prisoners the rest of the people who were still in the town, and those who had given themselves up to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the workmen.
sentences.susu: Nebusaradan, Babilɔn sɔɔri mangɛ naxa Darisalamu ɲama dɔnxɔɛe xanin Babilɔn, alɔ setaree, walikɛe, nun mixi naxee e yɛtɛ so Babilɔn mangɛ yi ra.

sentences.english: But Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, let the poorest of the land go on living there, to take care of the vines and the fields.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a naxa tin setare ndee tan xa lu naa, e xa nu bɔxi rawali, e nu wɛni bilie si.

sentences.english: And the brass pillars which were in the house of the Lord, and the wheeled bases and the great brass water-vessel in the house of the Lord, were broken up by the Chaldaeans, who took all the brass away to Babylon.
sentences.susu: Kalidikae naxa see tongo naxee yailanxi wure gbeeli ra, e e raxunu alako e xa na wure gbeeli xanin Babilɔn. Na kui, e naxa kinki firin, ye sase xungbe, nun a dɔxɔdee kana.

sentences.english: And the pots and the spades and the scissors for the lights and the spoons, and all the brass vessels used in the Lord's house, they took away.
sentences.susu: E naxa Alatala xa banxi tundee, pelie, finɛe, tɔnbilie, nun yirabase birin tongo, naxee nu yailanxi wure gbeeli ra.

sentences.english: And the cups and the fire-trays and the basins and the pots and the supports for the lights and the spoons and the wide basins; the gold of the gold vessels, and the silver of the silver vessels, the captain of the armed men took away.
sentences.susu: A naxa yirabasee nun pɔɔtie fan birin tongo naxee nu yailanxi xɛɛma nun gbeti ra.

sentences.english: The two pillars, the great water-vessel, and the twelve brass oxen which were under it, and the ten wheeled bases, which King Solomon had made for the house of the Lord: the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
sentences.susu: Banxi kinki firinyie, ye sase xungbe naxan xili «baa,» a dɔxɔde fu nun firinyi naxee nu na a bun ma, e masolixi tuurae ra, Sulemani naxee yailan Alatala xa banxi bɛ, na birin findixi wure gbeeli gbegbe nan na, naxan xasabi mu nu nɔma kolonde.

sentences.english: And as for the pillars, one pillar was eighteen cubits high, and twelve cubits measured all round, and it was as thick as a man's hand: it was hollow.
sentences.susu: Na banxi kinki firinyie xa maiteya nu nɔngɔn ya fu nun solomasaxan lima, e rabilinyi nu nɔngɔn ya fu nun firin lima. Nee nu yailanxi wure gbeeli nan na naxan tilinyi suxui tagi lima, e kui igelixi.

sentences.english: And there was a crown of brass on it: the crown was five cubits high, circled with a network and apples all of brass; and the second pillar had the same.
sentences.susu: Na kinki xunyie nu yailanxi wure gbeeli nan na, e masoli kɔɔbɛ bogi maniyɛe ra. Nee xa maiteya nu nɔngɔn ya suuli lima.

sentences.english: There were ninety-six apples on the outside; the number of apples all round the network was a hundred.
sentences.susu: Kɔɔbɛ bogi maniyɛ tongo solomanaani nun senni nu na tande mabiri, naani nu na banxi kui mabiri, naxee birin nalanxi lan kɛmɛ ma.

sentences.english: And the captain of the armed men took Seraiah, the chief priest, and Zephaniah, the second priest, and the three door-keepers;
sentences.susu: Babilɔn sɔɔri mangɛ naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi Seraya, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ firin nde Sefaniya, nun hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛ makantɛ saxanyie xanin a xun ma.

sentences.english: And from the town he took the unsexed servant who was over the men of war, and seven of the king's near friends who were in the town, and the scribe of the captain of the army, who was responsible for getting the people of the land together in military order, and sixty men of the people of the land who were in the town.
sentences.susu: A naxa yi mixi xungbee fan xanin: sɔɔri mangɛ, mangɛ rasima solofere naxee toxi taa kui, kuntigi nde naxan nu sɔɔrie sugandima, nun na taakae mixi tongo senni.

sentences.english: These Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, took with him to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn sɔɔri mangɛ Nebusaradan naxa na mixi birin xanin Babilɔn mangɛ xɔn ma Ribila.

sentences.english: And the king of Babylon put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was taken prisoner away from his land.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn mangɛ naxa e faxa Ribila, Xamata bɔxi ma. Yudayakae tongoxi e xa bɔxi ma na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: These are the people whom Nebuchadrezzar took away prisoner: in the seventh year, three thousand and twenty-three Jews:
sentences.susu: Mixi xasabi nan ya Nebukadansari naxan xanin konyiya kui Babilɔn bɔxi ma: A xa mangɛya ɲɛ solofere nde, Yudayaka mixi wulu saxan mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan.

sentences.english: And in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he took away as prisoners from Jerusalem eight hundred and thirty-two persons:
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun solomasaxan nde, Darisalamuka mixi kɛmɛ solomasaxan, mixi tongo saxan nun firin.

sentences.english: In the twenty-third year of Nebuchadrezzar, Nebuzaradan, the captain of the armed men, took away as prisoners seven hundred and forty-five of the Jews: all the persons were four thousand and six hundred.
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun saxan nde, Yudayaka mixi kɛmɛ solofere, mixi tongo naani nun suuli. Na birin lanxi mixi wulu naani, mixi kɛmɛ senni nan ma.

sentences.english: And in the thirty-seventh year after Jehoiachin, king of Judah, had been taken prisoner, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-fifth day of the month, Evil-merodach, king of Babylon, in the first year after he became king, took Jehoiachin, king of Judah, out of prison.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Yehoyakini xa sigɛ ɲɛ tongo saxan nun solofere nde ra Babilɔn bɔxi ma, a kike fu nun firin nde, xi mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli nde ra, Efili Merodaki naxa findi Babilɔn mangɛ ra, a fa Yudaya mangɛ Yehoyakini ramini geeli.

sentences.english: And he said kind words to him and put his seat higher than the seats of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.
sentences.susu: A naxa hinnɛ a ra, a a xa kibanyi radangi mangɛ gbɛtɛe ra, a tan nun naxee nu a ra Babilɔn bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And his prison clothing was changed, and he was a guest at the king's table every day for the rest of his life.
sentences.susu: Yehoyakini naxa a xa geelimani sosee masara, a nu fa a dɛge mangɛ xa teebili ra tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: And for his food, the king gave him a regular amount every day till the day of his death, for the rest of his life.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn mangɛ naxa a ɲɔxɔ sa a xa fe xɔn ma a fanyi ra, a naxa a ki a xa simaya birin kui.

sentences.english: See her seated by herself, the town which was full of people! She who was great among the nations has become like a widow! She who was a princess among the countries has come under the yoke of forced work!
sentences.susu: Munse Darisalamu sɔtɔxi? Singe mixi nu wuya, kɔnɔ yakɔsi e mu wuya. A bara lu alɔ kaaɲɛ ginɛ. Singe a xili nu xungbo ɲamanɛe tagi, a findi mangɛ taa nan na e ya ma, kɔnɔ yakɔsi a na konyiya kui.

sentences.english: She is sorrowing bitterly in the night, and her face is wet with weeping; among all her lovers she has no comforter: all her friends have been false to her, they have become her haters.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ birin a wafe, a yaye nu a xɛrɛe maxa. A xanuntenyie mu na sɔnɔn naxee a madunduma. A booree birin bara a yanfa, e findi a yaxuie ra.

sentences.english: Judah has been taken away as a prisoner because of trouble and hard work; her living-place is among the nations, there is no rest for her: all her attackers have overtaken her in a narrow place.
sentences.susu: E bara Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xanin konyiya kui, e a rayaagi. Yakɔsi a dɔxɔxi sie tagi, malabui yo mu na a bɛ. A yaxuie a tɔɔrɔma.

sentences.english: The ways of Zion are sad, because no one comes to the holy meeting; all her doorways are made waste, her priests are breathing out sorrow: her virgins are troubled, and it is bitter for her.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu na Siyon kirae xɔn ma sɔnɔn, sigafe salide. Siyon xa naadɛe birin bara kana, a xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe tɔɔrɔfe, a xa ginɛdimɛdie sunnunfe. Siyon na fe xɔnɛ nan kui.

sentences.english: Those who are against her have become the head, everything goes well for her haters; for the Lord has sent sorrow on her because of the great number of her sins: her young children have gone away as prisoners before the attacker.
sentences.susu: A yaxuie bara nɔ a ra, e fa lu bɔɲɛsa kui. Alatala na ragirixi, Siyon xa fe ɲaaxie nan ma fe ra. A gerefae bara a xa die xanin konyiya kui.

sentences.english: And all her glory has gone from the daughter of Zion: her rulers have become like harts with no place for food, and they have gone in flight without strength before the attacker.
sentences.susu: Siyon sɛnbɛ birin bara kana. A xa kuntigie bara lu alɔ xeli, naxee mu ɲooge toma, naxee bara tagan koyinma ya ra.

sentences.english: Jerusalem keeps in mind, in the days of her sorrow and of her wanderings, all the desired things which were hers in days gone by; when her people came into the power of her hater and she had no helper, her attackers saw their desire effected on her and made sport of her destruction.
sentences.susu: Darisalamu xa yaagi nun a xa kui ifui kui, a bara a maɲɔxun a xa se fanyie birin xa fe, naxee nu na a yi ra tɛmui dangixi. A xa ɲama to sa a gerefae bɛlɛxɛ, a malima yo mu nu na. A yaxuie naxa yele a xa kasarɛ ma.

sentences.english: Great is the sin of Jerusalem; for this cause she has become an unclean thing: all those who gave her honour are looking down on her, because they have seen her shame: now truly, breathing out grief, she is turned back.
sentences.susu: Darisalamu xa yunubi bara gbo, a bara findi sɛniyɛntare ra. Naxee birin nu a matɔxɔma, e na yofe a ma yakɔsi. A bara lu alɔ mixi mageli, a yaagi, a fa a yɛtɛ nɔxun.

sentences.english: In her skirts were her unclean ways; she gave no thought to her end; and her fall has been a wonder; she has no comforter: see her sorrow, O Lord; for the attacker is lifted up.
sentences.susu: Nɔxɔɛ nu na a xa dugi ma, kɔnɔ a mu a maɲɔxun a xa fe raɲɔnyi ma. Kasarɛ naxan a masɔtɔ, a magaaxu. Mixi yo mu na, naxan a madunduma. «Alatala, n ma marayaagi mato, barima n yaxuie bara xunnakeli sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: The hand of her hater is stretched out over all her desired things; for she has seen that the nations have come into her holy place, about whom you gave orders that they were not to come into the meeting of your people.
sentences.susu: A yaxuie bara a xa se fanyi birin tongo. A si gbɛtɛe to nɛ so ra a xa salide kui, naxee mu daxa e xa so naa.

sentences.english: Breathing out grief all her people are looking for bread; they have given their desired things for food to give them life: see, O Lord, and take note; for she has become a thing of shame.
sentences.susu: A xa ɲama birin bara kɔntɔfili baloe fende. E bara e xa naafuli birin masara donse ra, alako e xa balo. «Alatala, n ma yaagi mato.

sentences.english: Come to me, all you who go by! Keep your eyes on me, and see if there is any pain like the pain of my wound, which the Lord has sent on me in the day of his burning wrath.
sentences.susu: Ala xa dangi mixi ratanga na fe mɔɔli ma. Wo a mato xa n ma tɔɔrɛ maniyɛ na fe ra, Alatala naxan dɔxɔxi n ma a xa xɔnɛ kui.

sentences.english: From on high he has sent fire into my bones, and it has overcome them: his net is stretched out for my feet, I am turned back by him; he has made me waste and feeble all the day.
sentences.susu: A bara tɛ ragoro kelife koore, naxan bara n fate gan. A bara gantanyi ti n bɛ, a yɛlɛ itala n santide. A bara n nabira bɔxi, a n halakixi lu naa.

sentences.english: A watch is kept on my sins; they are joined together by his hand, they have come on to my neck; he has made my strength give way: the Lord has given me up into the hands of those against whom I have no power.
sentences.susu: A bara n ma yunubie sare sa n kɔn ma alɔ karafoe. A bara n sɛnbɛ xun nakana. Alatala bara n sa n yaxuie bɛlɛxɛ, naxee sɛnbɛ gbo n bɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord has made sport of all my men of war in me, he has got men together against me to send destruction on my young men: the virgin daughter of Judah has been crushed like grapes under the feet of the Lord.
sentences.susu: A bara n ma geresoe birin matutun, naxee nu na n bɛ. A bara n yaxuie maxili, alako e xa n ma fonikee sɛnbɛ kana. Alatala bara Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xa di halaki a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: For these things I am weeping; my eye is streaming with water; because the comforter who might give me new life is far from me: my children are made waste, because the hater is strong.
sentences.susu: N na wafe yi tɔɔrɛ nan ma, n yaye raminima e bɛ. Naxan n madunduma, a gbilen limaniya fi ra n ma. Na bara makuya n na. N ma die bara halaki, barima yaxui sɛnbɛ nu gbo n bɛ.

sentences.english: Zion's hands are outstretched; she has no comforter; the Lord has given orders to the attackers of Jacob round about him: Jerusalem has become like an unclean thing among them.
sentences.susu: Siyon bara a bɛlɛxɛe itala, kɔnɔ mixi yo mu na naxan a madunduma. Alatala bara yaamari fi Yaxuba dɔxɔbooree xa findi a gerefae ra. Darisalamu bara findi sɛniyɛntare ra e tagi.

sentences.english: The Lord is upright; for I have gone against his orders: give ear, now, all you peoples, and see my pain, my virgins and my young men have gone away as prisoners.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa maragiri tinxin, barima n bara a xa yaamarie matandi. Wo tan si birin, wo wo tuli mati, wo xa n ma tɔɔrɛ mato. N ma ginɛdimɛdie nun n ma fonike xɛmɛe birin bara xanin konyiya kui.

sentences.english: I sent for my lovers, but they were false to me: my priests and my responsible men were breathing their last breath in the town, while they were looking for food to give them new life.
sentences.susu: N bara n xanuntenyie xili, kɔnɔ e bara n yanfa. N ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun n ma forie bara faxa taa kui. E faxi donse fende naxan nɔma sɛnbɛ di fide e ma.

sentences.english: See, O Lord, for I am in trouble; the inmost parts of my body are deeply moved; my heart is turned in me; for I have been uncontrolled: outside the children are put to the sword, and in the house there is death.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n ma tɔɔrɛ mato. N bɔɲɛ mu rafanxi n ma, barima n a kolon n mɛɛ nɛ i xa sɛriyɛ ra, n findi matandila yati nan na. Santidɛgɛma mixi sɔntɔ taa fari ma, fure ɲaaxi mixi faxama taa kui.

sentences.english: Give ear to the voice of my grief; I have no comforter; all my haters have news of my troubles, they are glad because you have done it: let the day of fate come when they will be like me.
sentences.susu: Mixie bara n wa xui mɛ, kɔnɔ mixi yo mu na naxan n madunduma. N yaxuie birin bara n ma tɔɔrɛ xa fe mɛ, e bara ɲɛlɛxin i bɛlɛxɛ fɔxi ra. I bara fa lɔxɔɛ ra, i lɔxɔɛ naxan ma fe fala. A niya n yaxuie fan xa lu alɔ n tan.

sentences.english: Let all their evil-doing come before you; do to them as you have done to me for all my sins: for loud is the sound of my grief, and the strength of my heart is gone.
sentences.susu: I xa e xa ɲaaxuɲa birin mato. I xa a niya e fan na alɔ i a niyaxi n na ki naxɛ, n ma fe kobi rabaxi ma. N ma kɔntɔfili wuya, n bɔɲɛ tɔɔrɔxi a gbe ra.»

sentences.english: How has the daughter of Zion been covered with a cloud by the Lord in his wrath! he has sent down from heaven to earth the glory of Israel, and has not kept in memory the resting-place of his feet in the day of his wrath.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa xɔnɛ bara a niya kuye xa ifɔɔrɔ Darisalamu xun ma. A bara barakɛ ba Isirayila ma. A to xɔnɔ, a naxa Isirayila rabolo, a nu ɲɛrɛma ɲama naxan ya ma.

sentences.english: The Lord has given up to destruction all the living-places of Jacob without pity; pulling down in his wrath the strong places of the daughter of Judah, stretching out on the earth the wounded, even her king and her rulers.
sentences.susu: Marigi mu kinikini e ma. A bara Yaxuba xa banxi birin kana, a bara Yudaya taa makantaxie rabira, a e xa mangɛya masara yaagi ra a xa xɔnɛ kui.

sentences.english: In his burning wrath every horn of Israel has been cut off; his right hand has been turned back before the attacker: he has put a fire in Jacob, causing destruction round about.
sentences.susu: A to xɔnɔ e ma, a bara Isirayila sɛnbɛ birin kana. E yaxuie to nu e ixɛtɛnfe, Ala bara tondi Isirayila malide. Na xunnakanɛ bara lu alɔ tɛ soxi, a Yaxuba xa bɔxi birin gan.

sentences.english: His bow has been bent for the attack, he has taken his place with his hand ready, in his hate he has put to death all who were pleasing to the eye: on the tent of the daughter of Zion he has let loose his passion like fire.
sentences.susu: A bara a xa xali suxu won xili ma alɔ won yaxui a rabama ki naxɛ. A bara won bɔnbɔ sɛnbɛ ra alɔ a findi won gerefa nan na. A bara won ma mixi birin faxa, won nu ɲɛlɛxinma naxee ra. A xa xɔnɛ bara lu alɔ tɛ naxan bara so Darisalamu hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: The Lord has become like one fighting against her, sending destruction on Israel; he has sent destruction on all her great houses, making waste his strong places: increasing the grief and the sorrow of the daughter of Judah.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara lu alɔ won yaxui. A bara Isirayila nun a xa banxi fanyie birin kana. A bara a xa yire makantaxie rabira. A bara Yudaya xa kinikini nun sunnunyi xunmasa.

sentences.english: And he has violently taken away his tent, as from a garden; he has made waste his meeting-place: the Lord has taken away the memory of feast and Sabbath in Zion, and in the passion of his wrath he is against king and priest.
sentences.susu: A bara a sɛnbɛ ramini na ma, a a xa mixie malande kana. Alatala bara a niya sali xungbe nun malabui lɔxɔɛ sali xa nɛɛmu Siyon na. A bara mangɛ nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ rayaagi a xa xɔnɛ kui.

sentences.english: The Lord has given up his altar and has been turned in hate from his holy place; he has given up into the hands of the attacker the walls of her great houses: their voices have been loud in the house of the Lord as in the day of a holy meeting.
sentences.susu: Alatala bara makuya a xa sɛrɛxɛbade ra, a mɛɛ a xa yire sɛniyɛnxi ra. A bara Siyon banxi fanyie sa won yaxui bɛlɛxɛ. Won yaxuie bara gere sɔnxɔɛ rate Alatala xa banxi kui. Na xui nu gbo alɔ xui naxan itema sali lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: It is the Lord's purpose to make waste the wall of the daughter of Zion; his line has been stretched out, he has not kept back his hand from destruction: he has sent sorrow on tower and wall, they have become feeble together.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan a ɲanige a xa Siyon tɛtɛ rabira. A mu siikɛ a rabafe ma. A bara tɛtɛ fari nun a bunyi birin nabira.

sentences.english: Her doors have gone down into the earth; he has sent destruction on her locks: her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not; even her prophets have had no vision from the Lord.
sentences.susu: A bara taa naadɛe rabira bɔxi, e balandee birin bara kana. Mangɛe nun kuntigie bara xanin ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛ ma. Sɛriyɛ rabatufe mu na, xɛɛraya fan mu na namiɲɔnmɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: The responsible men of the daughter of Zion are seated on the earth without a word; they have put dust on their heads, they are clothed in haircloth: the heads of the virgins of Jerusalem are bent down to the earth.
sentences.susu: Siyon forie dɔxɔxi bɔxi, e dɛ bara bobo, e bara xube maso e xunyie ma sunnunyi xa fe ra, e bara sunnun donmae ragoro e ma. Darisalamu ginɛdimɛdie bara e xun sin bɔxi.

sentences.english: My eyes are wasted with weeping, the inmost parts of my body are deeply moved, my inner parts are drained out on the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because of the young children and babies at the breast who are falling without strength in the open squares of the town.
sentences.susu: N yaye bara mini han, n bɔɲɛ bara n tɔɔrɔ, n sondonyi bara sunnun n ma ɲama xa gbaloe xa fe ra. Dimɛe nun diyɔrɛe na faxafe taa kui.

sentences.english: They say to their mothers, Where is grain and wine? when they are falling like the wounded in the open squares of the town, when their life is drained out on their mother's breast.
sentences.susu: Dimɛe a falama e ngae bɛ, «Donse nun minse sɔtɔma minden?» E nu siga tuxunsan na alɔ mixi maxɔnɔxie, e bira taa kui kirae ra, e ɲɛngi bolon e ngae bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: What example am I to give you? what comparison am I to make for you, O daughter of Jerusalem? what am I to make equal to you, so that I may give you comfort, O virgin daughter of Zion? for your destruction is great like the sea: who is able to make you well?
sentences.susu: N fa munse falama i bɛ kɔrɛ? Siyon, i maniyɛ mu na n bɛ. N i madunduma di? I xa ɲaxankatɛ bara gbo dangi baa ra. Nde nɔma i rayalande?

sentences.english: The visions which your prophets have seen for you are false and foolish; they have not made clear to you your sin so that your fate might be changed: but they have seen for you false words, driving you away.
sentences.susu: I xa namiɲɔnmɛe bara wule laamatunyie masen, e mu i xa yunubi fiixɛ i bɛ, alako i naxa fa lu konyiya kui. E bara wo madaxu wule laamatunyie ra.

sentences.english: All who go by make a noise with their hands at you; they make hisses, shaking their heads at the daughter of Jerusalem, and saying, Is this the town which was the crown of everything beautiful, the joy of all the earth?
sentences.susu: Dangi mixi birin e bɛlɛxɛ bɔnbɔma i ma, e kolinma, e e xunyie malintanma Darisalamu xa fe ra. E a falama, «Singe yi taa tofanyi maniyɛ mu nu na duniɲa, kɔnɔ yakɔsi go?»

sentences.english: All your haters are opening their mouths wide against you; making hisses and whistling through their teeth, they say, We have made a meal of her: certainly this is the day we have been looking for; it has come, we have seen it.
sentences.susu: I yaxuie birin na wo mafalafe, e kolinma, e e ɲinyie maxinma wo xa fe ra, e nu a fala, «Won bara e xun nakana alɔ won nu wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ. Na bara sɔɔnɛya won bɛ.»

sentences.english: The Lord has done that which was his purpose; he has put into force the orders which he gave in the days which are past; pulling down without pity, he has made your hater glad over you, lifting up the horn of those who were against you.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxan ɲanige, a na nan nabaxi. A bara a xa wɔyɛnyi rakamali, a naxan masen tɛmui xɔnnakuye. A bara kanari raba, a mu kinikini. A bara a niya i yaxuie xa i mayele. A bara i gerefae sɛnbɛ ragbo yɛ.

sentences.english: Let your cry go up to the Lord: O wall of the daughter of Zion, let your weeping be flowing down like a stream day and night; give yourself no rest, let not your eyes keep back the drops of sorrow.
sentences.susu: Mixie na wafe Marigi ra e bɔɲɛ birin na. Siyon ɲama, yaye ramini alɔ xure. I naxa i malabu, i xa wa tun.

sentences.english: Up! give cries in the night, at the starting of the night-watches; let your heart be flowing out like water before the face of the Lord, lifting up your hands to him for the life of your young children who are falling down, feeble for need of food, at the top of every street.
sentences.susu: Keli, sɔnxɔɛ rate kɔɛ ra. I bɔɲɛ rayensen yɛ alɔ ye, Marigi ya tode ra. I bɛlɛxɛ ti a bɛ i xa die xa simaya xa fe ra, barima e na halakife kaamɛ ra tunxunyie birin na.

sentences.english: Look! O Lord, see to whom you have done this! Are the women to take as their food the fruit of their bodies, the children who are folded in their arms? are the priest and the prophet to be put to death in the holy place of the Lord?
sentences.susu: Alatala, i ya ti i bara yi niya naxee ra. A lan ginɛe xa e xa die don, e naxee bari? A lan sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun namiɲɔnmɛe xa faxa Marigi xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui?

sentences.english: The young men and the old are stretched on the earth in the streets; my virgins and my young men have been put to the sword: you have sent death on them in the day of your wrath, causing death without pity.
sentences.susu: Fonikee nun xɛmɔxie, e birin lantanxi bɔxi ma taa tunxunyie ra. N ma ginɛdimɛdie nun n ma sɛgɛtalae, santidɛgɛma bara e birin faxa. I bara faxɛ ti i xɔnɔ lɔxɔɛ. I bara e kɔn naxaba, I mu kinikini.

sentences.english: As in the day of a holy meeting you have made fears come round me on every side, and no one got away or was kept safe in the day of the Lord's wrath: those who were folded in my arms, whom I took care of, have been sent to their destruction by my hater.
sentences.susu: I bara n yaxuie malan n xili ma, alɔ mixie malanma ki naxɛ sali lɔxɔɛ. Alatala xɔnɔ lɔxɔɛ, mixi yo mu lu, mixi fan mu a imini. N naxee xanu, n naxee ramɔ, n yaxuie bara e birin faxa.

sentences.english: I am the man who has seen trouble by the rod of his wrath.
sentences.susu: Mixi nan n na, naxan bara tɔɔrɛ kolon Ala xa xɔnɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: By him I have been made to go in the dark where there is no light.
sentences.susu: A bara n tongo kuye iyalanxi, a n naɲɛrɛ dimi kui.

sentences.english: Truly against me his hand has been turned again and again all the day.
sentences.susu: A n tɔɔrɔma lɔxɔɛ birin. Danyi yo mu na n ma tɔɔrɛ ma

sentences.english: My flesh and my skin have been used up by him and my bones broken.
sentences.susu: A bara n naxɔsi kelife n xunyi ma sa dɔxɔfe n sanyie ra. A bara n xɔrie birin magira.

sentences.english: He has put up a wall against me, shutting me in with bitter sorrow.
sentences.susu: A bara n tɔɔrɔ, a n nabilin ɲaxankatɛ ra.

sentences.english: He has kept me in dark places, like those who have been long dead.
sentences.susu: A bara n lu dimi kui alɔ singe ra mixi faxaxie.

sentences.english: He has put a wall round me, so that I am not able to go out; he has made great the weight of my chain.
sentences.susu: A bara n nabilin sansanyi ra, a yɔlɔnxɔnyi sa n ma, alako n naxa fa mini.

sentences.english: Even when I send up a cry for help, he keeps my prayer shut out.
sentences.susu: N bara gbelegbele, n bara xili ti dɛmɛri ra, kɔnɔ a bara naadɛ balan n ma maxandi ma.

sentences.english: He has put up a wall of cut stones about my ways, he has made my roads twisted.
sentences.susu: A bara kira balan n ya ra gɛmɛ belebelee ra, a n ti tɔɔrɛ kira xɔn ma.

sentences.english: He is like a bear waiting for me, like a lion in secret places.
sentences.susu: A bara lu alɔ sube xaaɲɛ naxan n mamɛfe burunyi, alɔ yɛtɛ naxan a nɔxunxi n ya ra.

sentences.english: By him my ways have been turned on one side and I have been pulled in bits; he has made me waste.
sentences.susu: A bara duniɲa ixutu n ma, a bara n kana.

sentences.english: With his bow bent, he has made me the mark for his arrows.
sentences.susu: A bara a xa xali itala a a xa tanbɛe ti n na.

sentences.english: He has let loose his arrows into the inmost parts of my body.
sentences.susu: A to a xa tanbɛe bɛɲin, e naxa n bɔɲɛ sɔxɔ.

sentences.english: I have become the sport of all the peoples; I am their song all the day.
sentences.susu: N bara findi n ma mixi birin ma mayele se ra, lɔxɔɛ birin, e n findima e xa sigie ra.

sentences.english: He has made my life nothing but pain, he has given me the bitter root in full measure.
sentences.susu: A bara n naluga ɲooge xɔnɛ ra, a bara xɔnɛ findi n ma donse ra.

sentences.english: By him my teeth have been broken with crushed stones, and I am bent low in the dust.
sentences.susu: A bara a niya n xa gɛmɛ xɔrie maxin, han n ɲinyie birin bara magira. A bara n maboron xube xɔɔra.

sentences.english: My soul is sent far away from peace, I have no more memory of good.
sentences.susu: A bara bɔɲɛsa makuya n na han fe fanyi mɔɔli birin bara nɛɛmu n na.

sentences.english: And I said, My strength is cut off, and my hope from the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi n bara a fala, «N ma fe bara kana. Alatala bara n kuma se birin na n xaxili nu tixi naxee ra.»

sentences.english: Keep in mind my trouble and my wandering, the bitter root and the poison.
sentences.susu: N bara n maɲɔxun n ma marayaagi ma, n bara n maɲɔxun n ma simaya naxasixi ma.

sentences.english: My soul still keeps the memory of them; and is bent down in me.
sentences.susu: N mu nɔma nɛɛmude n ma tɔɔrɛ ma. A xun bara masa han a bara gɛ n kuntinde.

sentences.english: This I keep in mind, and because of this I have hope.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na birin kui, n nan n xaxili tima fe naxan na, a tan nan ya:

sentences.english: It is through the Lord's love that we have not come to destruction, because his mercies have no limit.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa hinnɛ mu ɲɔnma, danyi yo mu na a xa xanunteya ma.

sentences.english: They are new every morning; great is your good faith.
sentences.susu: A gbilenma a ra gɛɛsɛgɛ yo gɛɛsɛgɛ. «Alatala, i mu mɛɛma i xa mixie ra abadan!»

sentences.english: I said to myself, The Lord is my heritage; and because of this I will have hope in him.
sentences.susu: N a kolon n bɔɲɛ kui, Alatala nan na n harige ra. N xaxili tixi a tan nan na.

sentences.english: The Lord is good to those who are waiting for him, to the soul which is looking for him.
sentences.susu: Alatala fe fanyi rabama a fenma bɛ, naxan xaxili tixi a ra.

sentences.english: It is good to go on hoping and quietly waiting for the salvation of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mixi lan a xa sabari Alatala ya i naxan fama a rakiside.

sentences.english: It is good for a man to undergo the yoke when he is young.
sentences.susu: A lanma adama xa tɔɔrɛ kolon a fonike tɛmui.

sentences.english: Let him be seated by himself, saying nothing, because he has put it on him.
sentences.susu: A xa dundu, a xa dɔxɔ a xati ma, barima Alatala nan a ragirixi a ma.

sentences.english: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if by chance there may be hope.
sentences.susu: A xa a xun sin bɔxi, tɛmunde Ala fama nɛ a xa dubɛ suxude.

sentences.english: Let his face be turned to him who gives him blows; let him be full of shame.
sentences.susu: A xa a xɛrɛ ti mixi bɛ, naxan a ragarinma, a xa tin na yaagi ra.

sentences.english: For the Lord does not give a man up for ever.
sentences.susu: Marigi mu mixi ratutunma abadan.

sentences.english: For though he sends grief, still he will have pity in the full measure of his love.
sentences.susu: A na mixi nde tɔɔrɔ, a man fama nɛ hinnɛde a ra a xa fonisireya kui.

sentences.english: For he has no pleasure in troubling and causing grief to the children of men.
sentences.susu: A waxɔnfe xa mu a ra, a xa mixi rayaagi, a xa ibunadama tɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: In a man's crushing under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
sentences.susu: Mixi na geelimanie tɔɔrɔ a ɲaaxi ra bɔxi kui,

sentences.english: In his turning away the right of a man before the face of the Most High.
sentences.susu: e na tinxintareya raba mixi ra Ala Xungbe ya i,

sentences.english: In his doing wrong to a man in his cause, the Lord has no pleasure.
sentences.susu: e na mixi tɔɔɲɛgɛ a makiiti tɛmui, Alatala mu a birin toma xɛ?

sentences.english: Who is able to say a thing, and give effect to it, if it has not been ordered by the Lord?
sentences.susu: Nde nɔma fe ra, xa Ala xa mu a ragirixi?

sentences.english: Do not evil and good come from the mouth of the Most High?
sentences.susu: Fe fanyi nun fe ɲaaxi, a birin mu kelima Ala Xungbe xui xa ma?

sentences.english: What protest may a living man make, even a man about the punishment of his sin?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra ibunadama a mawama, xa a tɔɔrɛ sɔtɔ a yɛtɛ xa yunubi saabui ra?

sentences.english: Let us make search and put our ways to the test, turning again to the Lord;
sentences.susu: Won xa won ɲɛrɛ ki mato, won xa a igbɛ, won xa gbilen Alatala ma.

sentences.english: Lifting up our hearts with our hands to God in the heavens.
sentences.susu: Won xa Ala maxandi won bɔɲɛ birin na, won xa won bɛlɛxɛ ite Ala bɛ naxan na koore ma.

sentences.english: We have done wrong and gone against your law; we have not had your forgiveness.
sentences.susu: «Muxu xa yunubi nun matandi bara gbo, i fan mu diɲɛxi muxu ma.

sentences.english: Covering yourself with wrath you have gone after us, cutting us off without pity;
sentences.susu: I xa bɔɲɛ xɔnɛ bara lu muxu fɔxɔ ra, i bara faxɛ ti, i mu kinikini.

sentences.english: Covering yourself with a cloud, so that prayer may not get through.
sentences.susu: I bara nuxui ti won tagi, alako muxu xa maxandi naxa i li.

sentences.english: You have made us like waste and that for which there is no use, among the peoples.
sentences.susu: I bara muxu findi suuti ra ɲamanɛe tagi.

sentences.english: The mouths of all our haters are open wide against us.
sentences.susu: Muxu yaxuie birin bara e dɛ ibi muxu xili ma.

sentences.english: Fear and deep waters have come on us, wasting and destruction.
sentences.susu: Gaaxui nun bɔɲɛ mini bara nɔ muxu ra, muxu xa fe findixi kanari nun gbaloe nan tun na.

sentences.english: Rivers of water are running down from my eyes, for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
sentences.susu: N ya suusama yaye ra, n ma mixie xa gbaloe xa fe ra.

sentences.english: My eyes are streaming without stopping, they have no rest,
sentences.susu: Danyi yo mu na n wafe ma, malabui yo mu na n bɛ,

sentences.english: Till the Lord's eye is turned on me, till he sees my trouble from heaven.
sentences.susu: han beenun Alatala xa a ya ragoro won ma.

sentences.english: The Lord is unkind to my soul, more than all the daughters of my town.
sentences.susu: N bara kinikini ginɛdimɛdie xa tɔɔrɛ ma.»

sentences.english: They who are against me without cause have gone hard after me as if I was a bird;
sentences.susu: Mixie bara n keri alɔ xɔni, hali n mu fe ɲaaxi yo rabaxi e ra.

sentences.english: They have put an end to my life in the prison, stoning me with stones.
sentences.susu: E bara n nagoro kɔlɔnyi kui, e nu fa gɛmɛe ragoro n ma.

sentences.english: Waters were flowing over my head; I said, I am cut off.
sentences.susu: Ye to din n xun na, n naxa a fala, «N bara lɔɛ!»

sentences.english: I was making prayer to your name, O Lord, out of the lowest prison.
sentences.susu: N naxa i tan Alatala xili kɔlɔnyi gbaata ma.

sentences.english: My voice came to you; let not your ear be shut to my breathing, to my cry.
sentences.susu: I fan naxa n xui mɛ n to a fala, «I naxa tondi n xui ramɛde. Yandi, n mali.»

sentences.english: You came near in the day when I made my prayer to you: you said, Have no fear.
sentences.susu: N to i maxandi, i naxa i maso n na, i a fala n bɛ, «I naxa gaaxu.»

sentences.english: O Lord, you have taken up the cause of my soul, you have made my life safe.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i bara n ma fe suxu, i bara n nii rakisi.

sentences.english: O Lord, you have seen my wrong; be judge in my cause.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i a toxi e fe naxee niyaxi n na. I xa n ma nɔndi makɛnɛn.

sentences.english: You have seen all the evil rewards they have sent on me, and all their designs against me.
sentences.susu: I bara a to e kɔnkɔxi n ma ki naxɛ, e yanfanteya naxan birin xirima n xun ma.

sentences.english: Their bitter words have come to your ears, O Lord, and all their designs against me;
sentences.susu: Alatala, i bara e xui mɛ konbi ti ra, e yanfanteya naxan birin xirima n xun ma.

sentences.english: The lips of those who came up against me, and their thoughts against me all the day.
sentences.susu: N gerefae xa wɔyɛnyi nun e xa maɲɔxunyi na n tan nan fɔxɔ ra lɔxɔɛ birin.

sentences.english: Take note of them when they are seated, and when they get up; I am their song.
sentences.susu: A mato, xa e dɔxɔxi, xa e tixi, e n tan nan findixi e xa sigie ra.

sentences.english: You will give them their reward, O Lord, answering to the work of their hands.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa n gbeɲɔxɔ e ma. E naxan niyaxi n na, i xa na ragbilen e ma.

sentences.english: You will let their hearts be covered over with your curse on them.
sentences.susu: I xa e xaxili dɔnxu, i e danka, barakatareɲa xa bira e fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: You will go after them in wrath, and put an end to them from under the heavens of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala, i xa bɔɲɛ xɔnɛ xa lu e fɔxɔ ra, i xa e ba duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari.

sentences.english: How dark has the gold become! how changed the best gold! the stones of the holy place are dropping out at the top of every street.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛma mu yilenma sɔnɔn, a mu sɛniyɛn. Gɛmɛ tofanyie bara ralantan yɛ taa tunxunyie birin na.
