sentences.english: The valued sons of Zion, whose price was the best gold, are looked on as vessels of earth, the work of the hands of the potter!
sentences.susu: Siyon die tide nu gbo alɔ xɛɛma, kɔnɔ yakɔsi e tide bara xurun alɔ fɛɲɛe naxee yailanxi bɛndɛ ra.

sentences.english: Even the beasts of the waste land have full breasts, they give milk to their young ones: the daughter of my people has become cruel like the ostriches in the waste land.
sentences.susu: Hali wulabare ginɛ xiɲɛ fima a xa die ma, kɔnɔ n ma ɲama bara lu alɔ dingɛ naxee mu mixiɲa rakamalixi. E kobi alɔ sɛgɛ.

sentences.english: The tongue of the child at the breast is fixed to the roof of his mouth for need of drink: the young children are crying out for bread, and no man gives it to them.
sentences.susu: Kaamɛ bara a niya, diyɔrɛ nɛnyi bara kankan a naxare. Dimɛe taami maxɔrinma, kɔnɔ mixi yo mu e kima.

sentences.english: Those who were used to feasting on delicate food are wasted in the streets: those who as children were dressed in purple are stretched out on the dust.
sentences.susu: Naxee nu donse fanyi donma, kaamɛ bara e rabira taa kui. Naxee ramɔxi fe fanyi kui, e fa na ɲooge nan yegelenfe e bɛlɛxɛe ra.

sentences.english: For the punishment of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of Sodom, which was overturned suddenly without any hand falling on her.
sentences.susu: N ma ɲama xa ɲaxankatɛ bara gbo dangife Sodomakae gbe ra, naxee halaki ya magirɛ keren kui, mixi keren bɛlɛxɛ mu din e ra.

sentences.english: Her holy ones were cleaner than snow, they were whiter than milk, their bodies were redder than corals, their form was as the sapphire:
sentences.susu: E xa mangɛdie nu tofan dangi xɛɛma ra, e nu fiixɛ dangi xiɲɛ ra. E fate rayabu alɔ ye xɔɔra sinbonyi, e yatagi nu luxi nɛ alɔ diyaman.

sentences.english: Their face is blacker than night; in the streets no one has knowledge of them: their skin is hanging on their bones, they are dry, they have become like wood.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi e fate bara fɔɔrɔ dangi tige ra, e mu kolonma taa kui sɔnɔn. E kiri fatuxi e xɔrie ma, a bara xara alɔ bole.

sentences.english: Those who have been put to the sword are better off than those whose death is caused by need of food; for these come to death slowly, burned up like the fruit of the field.
sentences.susu: Naxee faxa santidɛgɛma ra, e tan nan xun nu rafan dangi mixi birin na kaamɛ naxee ɲaxankatafe. Kaamɛtɔɛe bara xɔsi, e taganxi, e mu donse yo sɔtɔma kɔrɛ.

sentences.english: The hands of kind-hearted women have been boiling their children; they were their food in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
sentences.susu: Dingɛe, marafanyi nu na naxee bɛ, e bara e yɛtɛ xa die ɲin, e e don, alako e xa balo alibalawi kui.

sentences.english: The Lord has given full effect to his passion, he has let loose his burning wrath; he has made a fire in Zion, causing the destruction of its bases.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa xɔnɛ bara kamali. A bara a ralantan yɛ, a tɛ xuru Siyon, naxan bara yire tixie birin gan.

sentences.english: To the kings of the earth and to all the people of the world it did not seem possible that the attackers and the haters would go into the doors of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi mangɛe mu la a ra, duniɲa mixie sese fan mu la a ra, xa yaxuie nɔma sode Darisalamu naadɛe ra.

sentences.english: It is because of the sins of her prophets and the evil-doing of her priests, by whom the blood of the upright has been drained out in her.
sentences.susu: Yi gbaloe kelixi a xa namiɲɔnmɛe xa yunubie nan ma, a nun a xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa fe kobi rabaxie ma, e tan naxee tinxintɔɛe nii baxi.

sentences.english: They are wandering like blind men in the streets, they are made unclean with blood, so that their robes may not be touched by men.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi e ɲɛrɛma taa kui alɔ dɔnxuie, mixi yo mu a bɛlɛxɛ dinma e ra barima wuli naxan goroma e ma, a bara e findi sɛniyɛntaree ra.

sentences.english: Away! unclean! they were crying out to them, Away! away! let there be no touching: when they went away in flight and wandering, men said among the nations, There is no further resting-place for them.
sentences.susu: Mixie luma gbelegbele ra, «Wo keli be! Wo tan mixi sɛniyɛntaree! Wo keli be, wo keli be! Wo wo makuya muxu ra!» Na kui e naxa e gi sigafe ra ɲamanɛe ma. Naakae fan bara a fala, «E mu luma muxu xɔnyi kɔrɛ!»

sentences.english: The face of the Lord has sent them in all directions; he will no longer take care of them: they had no respect for the priests, they gave no honour to the old men.
sentences.susu: Alatala yɛtɛ yati nan e rayensen yɛ, a mu fa a ɲɔxɔ saxi e xɔn ma sɔnɔn. A bara binyɛ ba sɛrɛxɛdubɛe yi, xunnakeli mu na forie bɛ sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Our eyes are still wasting away in looking for our false help: we have been watching for a nation unable to give salvation.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara mali nde mamɛ, kɔnɔ mixi yo mu fa. Muxu bara muxu ya ti kira ra han muxu ya bara rafɔɔrɔ, kɔnɔ si yo mu fa muxu ratangade.

sentences.english: They go after our steps so that we may not go in our streets: our end is near, our days are numbered; for our end has come.
sentences.susu: Muxu yaxuie nu muxu ɲɛrɛ ki birin toxi, alako muxu naxa fa mini taa kui. Muxu xa fe danyi nu bara makɔrɛ, lɔxɔɛ gbegbe mu nu luxi muxu bɛ sɔnɔn, barima muxu xa fe danyi nu bara gɛ a lide.

sentences.english: Those who went after us were quicker than the eagles of the heaven, driving us before them on the mountains, waiting secretly for us in the waste land.
sentences.susu: Muxu kerimae nu xulun dangi sɛgɛe ra, naxee na koore ma. E naxa muxu keri han geyae fari, e e nɔxun muxu ya ra, e muxu mamɛ burunyi.

sentences.english: Our breath of life, he on whom the holy oil was put, was taken in their holes; of whom we said, Under his shade we will be living among the nations.
sentences.susu: E naxa muxu rakisima fan suxu, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi. Won nu bara a fala a xa fe ra, «Muxu yiriwama nɛ a niini bun ma ɲamanɛe tagi.»

sentences.english: Have joy and be glad, O daughter of Edom, living in the land of Uz: the cup will be given to you in your turn, and you will be overcome with wine and your shame will be seen.
sentences.susu: I tan Edon ɲama naxan sabatixi Usu bɔxi ma ɲɛlɛxin yire, yakɔsi i na sɛɛwɛ kui, kɔnɔ i fan xa kiiti waxati na fafe. I fama nɛ ɲaxankatɛ nun yaagi sɔtɔde.

sentences.english: The punishment of your evil-doing is complete, O daughter of Zion; never again will he take you away as a prisoner: he will give you the reward of your evil-doing, O daughter of Edom; he will let your sin be uncovered.
sentences.susu: Siyon ɲama, a gbe mu luxi i xa ɲaxankatɛ xa dan. Ala mu i xa konyiya rabuma, kɔnɔ i tan Edon ɲama, Alatala fama nɛ i makiitide i xa yunubie ma, a xa i ɲaxankata nee xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Keep in mind, O Lord, what has come to us: take note and see our shame.
sentences.susu: Alatala, muxu xa tɔɔrɛ mato, muxu xa yaagi igbɛ!

sentences.english: Our heritage is given up to men of strange lands, our houses to those who are not our countrymen.
sentences.susu: Xɔɲɛe bara muxu kɛ tongo. Mixie bara sabati muxu xa banxie kui, muxu kolonmae mu naxee ra.

sentences.english: We are children without fathers, our mothers are like widows.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara findi misikiinɛ babataree ra, muxu ngae bara lu alɔ kaaɲɛ ginɛe.

sentences.english: We give money for a drink of water, we get our wood for a price.
sentences.susu: Muxu mu nɔma muxu xa ye minde, fo muxu xa a sara kɔbiri ra. Muxu mu nɔma muxu xa yege fan gande, fo muxu xa a sara.

sentences.english: Our attackers are on our necks: overcome with weariness, we have no rest.
sentences.susu: Muxu ɲaxankatamae dɔxɔxi muxu fari. Muxu bara tagan, malabui yo mu na.

sentences.english: We have given our hands to the Egyptians and to the Assyrians so that we might have enough bread.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara muxu bɛlɛxɛ itala Misira nun Asiriya biri ra, alako e xa muxu ki taami ra.

sentences.english: Our fathers were sinners and are dead; and the weight of their evil-doing is on us.
sentences.susu: Muxu babae bara yunubi raba, kɔnɔ e mu na duniɲa sɔnɔn. Muxu tan nan fa e xa fe kobie tɔruɲɔɛ xaninfe.

sentences.english: Servants are ruling over us, and there is no one to make us free from their hands.
sentences.susu: Konyie nan fa tixi muxu xun ma, mixi yo mu na naxan muxu bama e yi ra.

sentences.english: We put our lives in danger to get our bread, because of the sword of the waste land.
sentences.susu: Muxu baloe fenma wula i gaaxui kui, barima santidɛgɛma kanyie na yire birin.

sentences.english: Our skin is heated like an oven because of our burning heat from need of food.
sentences.susu: Kaamɛ bara muxu suxu.

sentences.english: They took by force the women in Zion, the virgins in the towns of Judah.
sentences.susu: Muxu yaxuie bara e waxɔnfe raba Siyon nun Yudaya ginɛdimɛdie ra.

sentences.english: Their hands put princes to death by hanging: the faces of old men were not honoured.
sentences.susu: E bara kuntigie gbaku wurie ma, e binyɛ ba forie yi.

sentences.english: The young men were crushing the grain, and the boys were falling under the wood.
sentences.susu: Fonikee mɛngi dinma, e yege maxanin han yege kote bara bira e ma.

sentences.english: The old men are no longer seated in the doorway, and the music of the young men has come to an end.
sentences.susu: Forie bara ba e malanfe, fonikee fan bara ba ɲaxaɲaxafe.

sentences.english: The joy of our hearts is ended; our dancing is changed into sorrow.
sentences.susu: Muxu bɔɲɛe bara ba sɛɛwafe, muxu xa xulunyi bara masara sunnunyi ra.

sentences.english: The crown has been taken from our head: sorrow is ours, for we are sinners.
sentences.susu: Xunnakeli bara ba muxu yi, muxu bara makinikini muxu xa yunubie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Because of this our hearts are feeble; for these things our eyes are dark;
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, muxu bɔɲɛe tɔɔrɔxi, muxu ya fan bara rafɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: Because of the mountain of Zion which is a waste; jackals go over it.
sentences.susu: Siyon geya bara findi gbengberenyi ra, a bara findi xulumasee maɲɛrɛde ra.

sentences.english: You, O Lord, are seated as King for ever; the seat of your power is eternal.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan, Marigi Alatala, i tan nan mangɛ ra tɛmui birin. Danyi mu na i xa mangɛya ma, keli lanfanmae ma, sa dɔxɔ lanfanmae birin na.

sentences.english: Why have we gone from your memory for ever? why have you been turned away from us for so long?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra, i fa nɛɛmuxi muxu ma yi mɔɔli ra, ka i muxu rabɛɲinma nɛ muxu xa simaya birin kui?

sentences.english: Make us come back to you, O Lord, and let us be turned; make our days new again as in the past.
sentences.susu: Alatala, muxu ragbilen i ma, muxu xa fa i ma alɔ a singe.

sentences.english: But you have quite given us up; you are full of wrath against us.
sentences.susu: I mɛɛxi nɛ muxu ra kerenyi ra? I xɔnɔma nɛ muxu ma abadan?

sentences.english: Now it came about in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth day of the month, while I was by the river Chebar among those who had been made prisoners, that the heavens were made open and I saw visions of God.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ tongo saxan nde, a kike naani nde, xi suuli nde ra, n nu na Isirayilaka suxuxie ya ma Kebara xure fɛ ma. Koore naxa rabi, n naxa Ala xa laamatunyi to.

sentences.english: On the fifth day of the month, in the fifth year after King Jehoiachin had been made a prisoner,
sentences.susu: Na ɲɛ nu findixi Yudaya Mangɛ Yehoyakini xa ɲɛ suuli nde nan na konyiya kui. Na xi suuli nde

sentences.english: The word of the Lord came to me, Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldaeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the Lord was on me there.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa masenyi ti n tan sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Esekiyeli bɛ, Busi xa di. N nu na Kalidi bɔxi nan ma Kebara xure fɛ ma. Alatala xɔnyɛ nu na n ma.

sentences.english: And, looking, I saw a storm-wind coming out of the north, a great cloud with flames of fire coming after one another, and a bright light shining round about it and in the heart of it was something coloured like electrum.
sentences.susu: N naxa turunnaadɛ to kelife kɔɔla mabiri, nuxui xungbe yanbama naxan nabilinxi naiyalanyi magaaxuxi ra. A xɔri nu luxi nɛ alɔ wure raxunuxi.

sentences.english: And in the heart of it were the forms of four living beings. And this was what they were like; they had the form of a man.
sentences.susu: Daalise naani nu na na tɛ xɔɔra. E nu maniyaxi xɛmɛe nan na,

sentences.english: And every one had four faces, and every one of them had four wings.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ yatagi naani nun gabutenyi naani nan nu na kankan ma.

sentences.english: And their feet were straight feet; and the under sides of their feet were like the feet of oxen; and they were shining like polished brass.
sentences.susu: E sanwurie nu tinxin, e sanbɔnbɔlae nu maniyaxi ninge toree nan na naxee yanbaxi alɔ wure gbeeli.

sentences.english: And they had the hands of a man under their wings; the four of them had faces on their four sides.
sentences.susu: Mixi bɛlɛxɛe nu na e bɛ e gabutenyie bun ma e sɛɛti naanie ma. Yatagie nun gabutenyie nu na e naani birin ma,

sentences.english: They went without turning, every one went straight forward.
sentences.susu: e gabutenyie nu dɔxɔxi e bore ra. Na ki e mu nu e ya ragbilenma sigafe ra, e nu siga yare tun.

sentences.english: As for the form of their faces, they had the face of a man, and the four of them had the face of a lion on the right side, and the four of them had the face of an ox on the left side, and the four of them had the face of an eagle.
sentences.susu: E yatagie nu na yi ki nɛ: yatagi adama daaxi, yatagi yɛtɛ daaxi, yatagi ninge daaxi, nun yatagi sɛgɛ daaxi nan nu na kankan bɛ.

sentences.english: And their wings were separate at the top; two of the wings of every one were joined one to another, and two were covering their bodies.
sentences.susu: E yatagie nu na na ki nɛ. Gabutenyi naani nu na kankan ma. Firin na sɛɛti keren ma, naxee nu italaxi e bore fɛ ma. Gabutenyi firin nan fan nu e fatee makotoxi.

sentences.english: Every one of them went straight forward; wherever the spirit was to go they went; they went on without turning.
sentences.susu: Kankan nu biraxi Ala Xaxili nan fɔxɔ ra. Na kui, e mu nu e ya ragbilenma, e nu fa siga yare tun.

sentences.english: And between the living beings it was like burning coals of fire, as if flames were going one after the other between the living beings; and the fire was bright, and out of the fire went thunder-flames.
sentences.susu: Na daalisee lahalɛ nu luxi nɛ alɔ tɛ wolee nun tɛ fulefulee. Na tɛ yanbaxi nu a lintanma na daalisee longori ra alɔ seyamakɔnyie.

sentences.english: And the living beings went out and came back as quickly as a thunder-flame.
sentences.susu: Na daalisee nu siga e gi ra, e xulun alɔ seyamakɔnyi.

sentences.english: Now while I was looking at the four living beings, I saw one wheel on the earth, by the side of the living beings, for the four of them.
sentences.susu: N to nu yi daalisee matofe, n naxa sanyi radigilinxi keren to bɔxi ma kankan sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: The form of the wheels and their work was like a beryl; the four of them had the same form and design, and they were like a wheel inside a wheel.
sentences.susu: Nee nu yanbama alɔ diyaman, e birin nu maniya. E rafala ki nu luxi nɛ alɔ sanyi radigilinxi nu na sanyi radigilinxi gbɛtɛ kui.

sentences.english: The four of them went straight forward without turning to one side.
sentences.susu: E nɛ sigama, e nu e ɲɛrɛma e sɛɛti naani nan ma, e mu nu e mafindima e xa ɲɛrɛ kui.

sentences.english: And I saw that they had edges, and their edges, even of the four, were full of eyes round about.
sentences.susu: E nu ite, e tofan, e luxi alɔ yae nu na e bɛ.

sentences.english: And when the living beings went on, the wheels went by their side; and when the living beings were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
sentences.susu: Daalisee na e ɲɛrɛ, e sanyie fan e ɲɛrɛ. E na te koore ma, e sanyie fan te.

sentences.english: Wherever the spirit was to go they went; and the wheels were lifted up by their side: for the spirit of the living beings was in the wheels.
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili nu siga dɛdɛ, e fan nu birama nɛ a fɔxɔ ra, a nun e sanyie, barima na daalisee xaxili nu na e sanyie nan kui.

sentences.english: When these went on, the others went; and when these came to rest, the others came to rest; and when these were lifted up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up by their side: for the spirit of the living beings was in the wheels.
sentences.susu: Na daalisee na siga, e sanyie fan siga. Daalisee na ti, e sanyie fan ti. Daalisee na te koore ma, e sanyi fan te, barima na daalisee xaxili nu na e sanyie nan kui.

sentences.english: And over the heads of the living beings there was the form of an arch, looking like ice, stretched out over their heads on high.
sentences.susu: Koore walaxɛ tofanyi alɔ diyaman nu italaxi e xun ma.

sentences.english: Under the arch their wings were straight, one stretched out to another: every one had two wings covering their bodies on this side and two covering their bodies on that side.
sentences.susu: Na daalisee gabutenyi firin nu italaxi e bore sɛɛti ma, gabutenyi firin nu e fate makotoxi.

sentences.english: And when they went, the sound of their wings was like the sound of great waters to my ears, like the voice of the Ruler of all, a sound like the rushing of an army: when they came to rest they let down their wings.
sentences.susu: E e ɲɛrɛ tɛmui naxɛ, xui nde nu minima alɔ baa mɔrɔnyi xui, alɔ Ala Sɛnbɛma xui, alɔ sɔɔri gaali xui. Daalisee na ti, e nu fa e gabutenyie iso.

sentences.english: And there was a voice from the top of the arch which was over their heads: when they came to rest they let down their wings.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui xui nde naxa mini koore walaxɛ fari naxan nu na daalisee xun ma, e gabutenyie isoxi.

sentences.english: And on the top of the arch which was over their heads was the form of a king's seat, like a sapphire stone; and on the form of the seat was the form of a man seated on it on high.
sentences.susu: Se nde nu na na koore walaxɛ fari naxan nu luxi alɔ kibanyi naxan yailanxi diyaman na. Se nde nu na kibanyi kui naxan nu maniyaxi adamadi nde ra.

sentences.english: And I saw it coloured like electrum, with the look of fire in it and round it, going up from what seemed to be the middle of his body; and going down from what seemed to be the middle of his body I saw what was like fire, and there was a bright light shining round him.
sentences.susu: A kanke nu yanbama alɔ wure raxunuxi, a sanyie fan nu yanba alɔ tɛ. Naiyalanyi magaaxuxi nu na a rabilinyi birin ma.

sentences.english: Like the bow in the cloud on a day of rain, so was the light shining round him. And this is what the glory of the Lord was like. And when I saw it I went down on my face, and the voice of one talking came to my ears.
sentences.susu: A yanbɛ nu luxi nɛ alɔ senkui naxan minima koore ma tunɛ furu tɛmui. N to na to, n naxa bira n na n yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma, n naxa xui nde mɛ.

sentences.english: And he said to me, Son of man, get up on your feet, so that I may say words to you.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, «Adamadi, keli, n xa masenyi ti i bɛ.»

sentences.english: And at his words the spirit came into me and put me on my feet; and his voice came to my ears.
sentences.susu: A fɛfɛ na wɔyɛnyi fala n bɛ, Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa goro n ma, a n ti n sanyie xun ma. N naxa a xui mɛ a falafe ra n bɛ,

sentences.english: And he said to me, Son of man, I am sending you to the children of Israel, to an uncontrolled nation which has gone against me: they and their fathers have been sinners against me even to this very day.
sentences.susu: «I tan adamadi, n tan nan i xɛɛfe Isirayilakae ma, naxee bara muruta n ma, kelife e benbae xa tɛmui ma han yi waxati.

sentences.english: And the children are hard and stiff-hearted; I am sending you to them: and you are to say to them, These are the words of the Lord.
sentences.susu: N i xɛɛma naxee xɔn, e tuli xɔrɔxɔ. I xa a fala e bɛ, ‹Alatala yi masenyi nan tixi.›

sentences.english: And they, if they give ear to you or if they do not give ear (for they are an uncontrolled people), will see that there has been a prophet among them.
sentences.susu: Bɔnsɔɛ murutaxi nan e ra, kɔnɔ e fama nɛ a kolonde namiɲɔnmɛ nde bara lu e ya ma, hali e tondi i xui suxude.

sentences.english: And you, son of man, have no fear of them or of their words, even if sharp thorns are round you and you are living among scorpions: have no fear of their words and do not be overcome by their looks, for they are an uncontrolled people.
sentences.susu: I tan adamadi, i naxa gaaxu e ya ra, i naxa kɔntɔfili e xa wɔyɛnyi xa fe ra, hali na birin fa findi tɔɔrɛ ra i bɛ, e fa lu alɔ talie. I naxa gaaxu na bɔnsɔɛ murutaxi ya ra.

sentences.english: And you are to give them my words, if they give ear to you or if they do not: for they are uncontrolled.
sentences.susu: Fo i xa n ma masenyi ti e bɛ, hali e tondi e tuli matide i ra e xa matandi kui.

sentences.english: But you, son of man, give ear to what I say to you, and do not be uncontrolled like that uncontrolled people: let your mouth be open and take what I give you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan adamadi, i xa i tuli mati n xui ra, i naxa muruta alɔ yi bɔnsɔɛ a rabama ki naxɛ. I xa i dɛ rabi, i xa donse don n naxan soma i yi ra.»

sentences.english: And looking, I saw a hand stretched out to me, and I saw the roll of a book in it;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n naxa bɛlɛxɛ italaxi nde to n ya i, kɛɛdi mafilinxi nu na a kui.

sentences.english: And he put it open before me, and it had writing on the front and on the back; words of grief and sorrow and trouble were recorded in it.
sentences.susu: A naxa a itala n ya i, sɛbɛli nu tixi a kui nun a fari naxan tɔɔrɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ xa fe masenma.

sentences.english: And he said to me, Son of man, take this roll for your food, and go and say my words to the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, «Adamadi, i xa yi kɛɛdi don, i sa masenyi tife Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ bɛ.»

sentences.english: And, on my opening my mouth, he made me take the roll as food.
sentences.susu: Awa, n naxa n dɛ rabi, a naxa na kɛɛdi raso n dɛ kui.

sentences.english: And he said to me, Son of man, let your stomach make a meal of it and let your inside be full of this roll which I am giving you. Then I took it, and it was sweet as honey in my mouth.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a masen n bɛ, «Adamadi, i xa yi kɛɛdi birin don n naxan soxi i yi ra.» N to a don, a nu ɲɔxun n dɛ i alɔ kumi.

sentences.english: And he said to me, Son of man, go now to the children of Israel, and say my words to them.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, «Adamadi, siga Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ yire, i sa n ma masenyi ti e bɛ.

sentences.english: For you are not sent to a people whose talk is strange and whose language is hard, but to the children of Israel;
sentences.susu: N mu na i xɛɛfe ɲama xa ma, i mu naxan xa xui xɔrɔxɔɛ mɛma. N bara i xɛɛ Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ nan ma.

sentences.english: Not to a number of peoples whose talk is strange and whose language is hard and whose words are not clear to you. Truly, if I sent you to them they would give ear to you.
sentences.susu: N mu na i xɛɛfe bɔnsɔɛ wuyaxi xa ma, i mu naxee xa xui falama, i mu naxee xa xui mɛma. Xa a sa li n i xɛɛ nɛ nee fan ma nu, e i xui suxuma nɛ keren na.

sentences.english: But the children of Israel will not give ear to you; for they have no mind to give ear to me: for all the children of Israel have a hard brow and a stiff heart.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isirayila tan mu wama a tuli matife i ra, barima e mu tinma n ma masenyi ra. E xaxili xɔrɔxɔ, matandi bara e bɔɲɛ suxu.

sentences.english: See, I have made your face hard against their faces, and your brow hard against their brows.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n i ya xɔrɔxɔma nɛ dangife e tan na, n i xa limaniya xun masama nɛ.

sentences.english: Like a diamond harder than rock I have made your brow: have no fear of them and do not be overcome by their looks, for they are an uncontrolled people.
sentences.susu: N a niyama nɛ i xa i tunnabɛxi alɔ fanye, i xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ naxan xɔrɔxɔ alɔ gɛmɛ. I naxa gaaxu e ya ra, i naxa ifu e ya i de, hali e to findixi bɔnsɔɛ murutaxi ra.»

sentences.english: Then he said to me, Son of man, take into your heart all my words which I am about to say to you, and let your ears be open to them.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, «Adamadi, I tuli mati n ma masenyi ra n naxan masenfe i bɛ. I xa e ragata i bɔɲɛ ma.

sentences.english: And go now to those who have been taken away as prisoners, to the children of your people, and say to them, This is what the Lord has said; if they give ear or if they do not.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi i xa siga i xa ɲama yire, naxan na konyiya kui, i sa wɔyɛn e ra. I xa a fala e bɛ, ‹Ala xa masenyi nan ya.› Xa e sa e tuli mati ba, xa e mu e tuli mati ba, i tan xa n ma masenyi ti.»

sentences.english: Then I was lifted up by the wind, and at my back the sound of a great rushing came to my ears when the glory of the Lord was lifted up from his place.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala Xaxili naxa n tongo, n naxa xui nde mɛ n xanbi ra a falafe ra, «Matɔxɔɛ na Alatala nɔrɛ kanyi bɛ a sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ!»

sentences.english: And there was the sound of the wings of the living beings touching one another, and the sound of the wheels at their side, the sound of a great rushing.
sentences.susu: N naxa na daalisee gabutenyie xui mɛ e garinfe e bore ra, a nun e sanyi digilinxie xui. Na sɛnbɛ gbo.

sentences.english: And the wind, lifting me up, took me away: and I went in the heat of my spirit, and the hand of the Lord was strong on me.
sentences.susu: Ala xaxili naxa n nate koore ma, a n xanin. Xɔnɛ nu bara n bɔɲɛ rate, kɔnɔ Ala xɔnyɛ naxa nɔ n na.

sentences.english: Then I came to those who had been taken away as prisoners, who were at Telabib by the river Chebar, and I was seated among them full of wonder for seven days.
sentences.susu: Na kui n naxa n ma ɲama li naxan nu na konyiya kui Teli Abibi taa kui Kebara xure fɛ ma. N naxa xi solofere raba e tagi, n nakorixi kɔfu.

sentences.english: And at the end of seven days, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Xi solofere to dangi, Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, I have made you a watchman for the children of Israel: so give ear to the word of my mouth, and give them word from me of their danger.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, n bara i findi Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ kantama ra. I na n ma masenyi mɛ, i xa na fala e bɛ.

sentences.english: When I say to the evil-doer, Death will certainly be your fate; and you give him no word of it and say nothing to make clear to the evil-doer the danger of his evil way, so that he may be safe; that same evil man will come to death in his evil-doing; but I will make you responsible for his blood.
sentences.susu: N na a masen mixi ɲaaxi bɛ, ‹I faxama nɛ,› xa i mu a rasi a xa gbilen fe ɲaaxi fɔxɔ ra alako a xa kisi, n a faxama nɛ a xa yunubi xa fe ra. Na kui n a nii sare maxɔrinma i tan nan ma.

sentences.english: But if you give the evil-doer word of his danger, and he is not turned from his sin or from his evil way, death will overtake him in his evil-doing; but your life will be safe.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa i bara a rasi, a fa lu a mu a yɛtɛ ragbilen n ma, a faxama nɛ a xa yunubi kui, kɔnɔ a lima nɛ i tan nii bara rakisi.»

sentences.english: Again, when an upright man, turning away from his righteousness, does evil, and I put a cause of falling in his way, death will overtake him: because you have given him no word of his danger, death will overtake him in his evil-doing, and there will be no memory of the upright acts which he has done; but I will make you responsible for his blood.
sentences.susu: «Xa tinxintɔɛ nde sa gbilen tinxinyi fɔxɔ ra, a kira gbɛtɛ suxu, n a tɔɔrɔma nɛ na kira xɔn, alako a naxa fa faxa. Xa i mu a rasi, a faxama nɛ a xa yunubi kui. A xa wali fanyie birin luma nɛ fu. Na kui n a nii sare maxɔrinma i tan nan ma.

sentences.english: But if you say to the upright man that he is not to do evil, he will certainly keep his life because he took note of your word; and your life will be safe.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa i bara a rasi alako a naxa yunubi raba, a fa a tuli mati i ra, a kisima i tan nan saabui ra. Na kui i bara i yɛtɛ fan nakisi.»

sentences.english: And the hand of the Lord was on me there; and he said, Get up and go out into the valley and there I will have talk with you.
sentences.susu: Alatala xɔnyɛ nu na n ma mɛnni, a fa a masen n bɛ, «Keli, mini fiili ma. N sa wɔyɛnma i bɛ mɛnni nɛ.»

sentences.english: Then I got up and went out into the valley; and I saw the glory of the Lord resting there as I had seen it by the river Chebar; and I went down on my face.
sentences.susu: N naxa keli, n siga fiili ma. Mɛnni n naxa Alatala xa nɔrɛ to, alɔ n a toxi Kebara xure dɛ ra ki naxɛ. N naxa n yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Then the spirit came into me and put me on my feet; and he had talk with me and said to me, Go and keep yourself shut up inside your house.
sentences.susu: Alatala Xaxili naxa so n bɔɲɛ kui, a naxa n nakeli. A naxa a masen n bɛ, «Siga i xɔnyi, i so banxi, i naadɛ balan i yɛtɛ xun na.

sentences.english: But see, O son of man, I will put bands on you, prisoning you in them, and you will not go out among them:
sentences.susu: I tan Adamadi, e i xirima nɛ luuti ra alako i naxa so ɲama ya ma.

sentences.english: And I will make your tongue fixed to the roof of your mouth, so that you have no voice and may not make protests to them: for they are an uncontrolled people.
sentences.susu: N i nɛnyi xirima nɛ, alako i naxa nɔ sese falade na bɔnsɔɛ murutaxi bɛ.

sentences.english: But when I have talk with you I will make your mouth open, and you are to say to them, This is what the Lord has said: Let the hearer give ear; and as for him who will not, let him keep his ears shut: for they are an uncontrolled people.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n nɛ wɔyɛnma i bɛ, n i nɛnyi fulunma nɛ, alako i xa a fala e bɛ, ‹Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi wo bɛ.› Xa a naxan kɛnɛn, a xa na ramɛ. Xa a mu naxan kɛnɛn, a xa na lu na. Bɔnsɔɛ murutaxi nan e ra.»

sentences.english: And you, son of man, take a back and put it before you and on it make a picture of a town, even Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: «I tan adamadi, i xa walaxɛ bɛndɛ daaxi tongo, i fa pirinti korin a ma naxan misaalixi Darisalamu taa ra.

sentences.english: And make an attack on it, shutting it in, building strong places against it, and making high an earthwork against it; and put up tents against it, placing engines all round it for smashing down its walls.
sentences.susu: I xa se ndee yailan na walaxɛ rabilinyi ma naxan misaalixi gere ra Darisalamu xili ma. Bɛndɛ nde malan misaali ra yaxuie fama tede tɛtɛ ra naxan fari. Wuri die tongo naxee misaalixi wurie ra yaxuie naxee rawalima naadɛ kanafe ra. Yonkindee yailan misaali ra yaxuie luma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And take a flat iron plate, and put it for a wall of iron between you and the town: and let your face be turned to it, and it will be shut in and you will make an attack on it. This will be a sign to the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Wure nde ti i tan nun na walaxɛ tagi. Na xa findi misaali ra Darisalamu suxuma ki naxɛ. A xa findi tɔnxuma ra Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then, stretching yourself out on your left side, take the sin of the children of Israel on yourself: for as long as you are stretched out, so long will the sin of the children of Israel be on you.
sentences.susu: «I xa i sa i kɔɔla sɛɛti ma na walaxɛ ya i. Na misaalima Isirayila xa yunubie nan na, naxee luma i ma i xa xi xasabi.

sentences.english: For I have had the years of their sin measured for you by a number of days, even three hundred and ninety days: and you will take on yourself the sin of the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: I xa xi xasabi lanma e xa yunubi raba ɲɛ xasabi nan ma. Na findixi xi kɛmɛ saxan xi tongo solomanaani nan na. Isirayilakae xa yunubi kote dɔxɔma i xun ma na ki nɛ.»

sentences.english: And when these days are ended, turning on your right side, you are to take on yourself the sin of the children of Judah: forty days, a day for a year, I have had it fixed for you.
sentences.susu: «I na gɛ na rabade, i man xa i sa i yirefanyi sɛɛti ma. Na kui i xa Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xa yunubi kote tongo xi tongo naani bun ma, naxan a masenma e lu yunubi raba ra na ɲɛ nan na.

sentences.english: And let your face be turned to where Jerusalem is shut in, with your arm uncovered, and be a prophet against it.
sentences.susu: I xa i ya ti na walaxɛ ra, i i bɛlɛxɛ itala, i wɔyɛn Darisalamu bɛ n xili ra.

sentences.english: And see, I will put bands on you; and you will be stretched out without turning from one side to the other till the days of your attack are ended.
sentences.susu: N i xirima nɛ luutie ra alako i naxa fa i mafindi i sɛɛti nde ma, han i gɛ na waxati rakamalide.»

sentences.english: And take for yourself wheat and barley and different sorts of grain, and put them in one vessel and make bread for yourself from them; all the days when you are stretched on your side it will be your food.
sentences.susu: «Mɛngi xɔrie, toge, tenge, nun na maniyɛ tongo, i e sa se sase kui taami yailanfe ra i bɛ na waxati. I fama nɛ na donde i saxi i sɛɛti ma na xi kɛmɛ saxan xi tongo solomanaani bun ma.

sentences.english: And you are to take your food by weight, twenty shekels a day: you are to take it at regular times.
sentences.susu: I xa na donse maniya giramu kɛmɛ firin, kɛmɛ firin ma, i naxan donma lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ a waxati ma.

sentences.english: And you are to take water by measure, the sixth part of a hin: you are to take it at regular times.
sentences.susu: I xa ye fan litiri tagi maniya, i naxan minma lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ a waxati.

sentences.english: And let your food be barley cakes, cooking it before their eyes with the waste which comes out of a man.
sentences.susu: I xa taami yailan na mɛngi ra ɲama ya xɔri. I na gan mixi gbi ra.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said, Even so the children of Israel will have unclean bread for their food among the nations where I am driving them.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala naxa a masen, «Na kui Isirayilakae fama nɛ taami sɛniyɛntare donde ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛe tagi, n e rayensenma dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: Then I said, Ah, Lord! see, my soul has never been unclean, and I have never taken as my food anything which has come to a natural death or has been broken by beasts, from the time when I was young even till now; no disgusting flesh has ever come into my mouth.
sentences.susu: N naxa a yaabi, «N Marigi Alatala astɔfulahi! N tan luma sɛniyɛnyi nan kui. Kabi n dimɛdi tɛmui n mu sese raharamuxi don, alɔ sube naxan faxaxi a yɛtɛ ma, xa na mu a ra sube naxan ibɔɔxi sube xaaɲɛ nde saabui ra.»

sentences.english: Then he said to me, See, I have given you cow's waste in place of man's waste, and you will make your bread ready on it.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, a naxa a fala n bɛ, «Awa yire, i i xa taami ganma ninge ɲaɲɛ nan fari, n bara mixi gbi fe lu na.»

sentences.english: And he said to me, Son of man, see, I will take away from Jerusalem her necessary bread: they will take their bread by weight and with care, measuring out their drinking-water with fear and wonder:
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a naxa a fala n bɛ, «Adamadi, n mu tinma baloe xa Darisalamu li. Taakae fama donse nun ye sɔtɔde a xuri xuri nan na, e fa lu tɔɔrɛ nun kɔntɔfili kui.

sentences.english: So that they may be in need of bread and water and be wondering at one another, wasting away in their sin.
sentences.susu: Baloe nun ye xurunma nɛ e yi, e fate ɲɔn e gaaxu e bore tofe ra. Na birin e lima e xa yunubi nan xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And you, son of man, take a sharp sword, using it like a haircutter's blade, and making it go over your head and the hair of your chin: and take scales for separating the hair by weight.
sentences.susu: «I tan adamadi, i xa i xunyi nun i dɛxabe bi. I na gɛ na rabade, i xa na xunsɛxɛ nun na dɛxabe itaxun dɔxɔ saxan na.

sentences.english: You are to have a third part burned with fire inside the town, when the days of the attack are ended; and a third part you are to take and give blows with the sword round about it; and give a third part for the wind to take away, and let loose a sword after them.
sentences.susu: Darisalamu xa suxui xi kɔnti na gɛ kamalide, i xunsɛxɛ nun dɛxabe dɔxɔ keren gan taa pirinti ma. I xa dɔxɔ keren maxaba santidɛgɛma ra pirinti rabilinyi ma. I xa dɔxɔ keren woli koore ma, foye xa a rayensen. Na birin a masenma nɛ n fama i keride santidɛgɛma ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And take from them a small number of hairs, folding them in your skirts.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i xa xunsɛxɛ dondoronti tongo, i nee nɔxun i xa dugi kui.

sentences.english: And again take some of these and put them in the fire, burning them up in the fire; and say to all the children of Israel,
sentences.susu: I man xa xunsɛxɛ nde woli tɛ xɔɔra, naxan a masenma yi ɲaxankatɛ fama nɛ dinde Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin na.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: This is Jerusalem: I have put her among the nations, and countries are round her on every side;
sentences.susu: «N tan Marigi Alatala nan yi masenxi: Darisalamu nan ya n naxan dɔxɔ sie tagi. Ɲamanɛe nan na a rabilinyi birin ma.

sentences.english: And she has gone against my orders by doing evil more than the nations, and against my rules more than the countries round her: for they have given up my orders, and as for my rules, they have not gone in the way of them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a bara muruta n ma sɛriyɛ nun n ma yaamarie ma a xa ɲaaxuɲa kui. A bara a kobe raso n na, a gbilen n fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord has said: Because you have been more uncontrolled than the nations round about you, and have not been guided by my rules or kept my orders, but have kept the orders of the nations round about you;
sentences.susu: «N tan Marigi Alatala nan yi masenxi: Wo bara ɲaaxu dangife wo dɔxɔbooree birin na. Wo to mu tinxi birade n ma kira fɔxɔ ra, wo mu n ma sɛriyɛ suxu. Hali wo dɔxɔbooree xa sɛriyɛ, wo mu a binyama.»

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord has said: See, I, even I, am against you; and I will be judging among you before the eyes of the nations.
sentences.susu: «N tan Marigi Alatala nan yi masenxi: N tan bara ti wo kanke Darisalamukae. N fama nɛ wo ɲaxankatade sie ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And I will do in you what I have not done and will not do again, because of all your disgusting ways.
sentences.susu: Wo to bira kuye xɔnxie batufe ra, n fe rabama nɛ wo ra n mu naxan singe rabaxi, n mu naxan nabama yare.

sentences.english: For this cause fathers will take their sons for food among you, and sons will make a meal of their fathers; and I will be judge among you, and all the rest of you I will send away to every wind.
sentences.susu: Wo babae fama nɛ e xa die donde, wo xa die fama nɛ e babae donde. N wo ɲaxankatama na ki nɛ, naxee luxi n fa e rayensen ɲamanɛe ma.»

sentences.english: For this cause, by my life, says the Lord, because you have made my holy place unclean with all your hated things and all your disgusting ways, you will become disgusting to me; my eye will have no mercy and I will have no pity.
sentences.susu: «N tan Marigi Alatala n bara n kali: Wo to n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi rafe kuye ɲaaxie ra, wo fa batui raba n naxan xɔnxi, n na n ma hinnɛ bama nɛ wo yi ra, n mu kinikinima wo ma, n mu wo rakisima fefe ma.

sentences.english: A third of you will come to death from disease, wasting away among you through need of food; a third will be put to the sword round about you; and a third I will send away to every wind, letting loose a sword after them.
sentences.susu: Wo xa ɲama dɔxɔ keren faxama nɛ wuganyi nun kaamɛ ra. A dɔxɔ firin nde faxama santidɛgɛma nan na taa fari ma. A dɔxɔ saxan nde rayensen yɛ ɲamanɛe ma, n e keri santidɛgɛma ra.»

sentences.english: So my wrath will be complete and my passion will come to rest on them; and they will be certain that I the Lord have given the word of decision, when my wrath against them is complete.
sentences.susu: «Na tɛmui, n ma xɔnɛ danma nɛ. N gbe fama nɛ ɲɔxɔde na kui. N na xɔnɔ e ma na ki, e fama nɛ a kolonde n tan Alatala bɔɲɛ na ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And I will make you a waste and a name of shame among the nations round about you, in the eyes of everyone who goes by.
sentences.susu: N i findima yire kanaxi nan na, si gbɛtɛe na naa to, e fa wo mabere.

sentences.english: And you will be a name of shame and a cause of bitter words, an example and a wonder to the nations round about you, when I give effect to my judging among you in wrath and in passion and in burning protests: I the Lord have said it:
sentences.susu: N na gɛ wo ɲaxankatade n ma xɔnɛ kui, e fe ɲaaxi falama nɛ wo xun ma, e wo konbi. Wo findima masenyi magaaxuxi nan na sie bɛ naxee na wo rabilinyi. Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: When I send on you the evil arrows of disease, causing destruction, which I will send to put an end to you; and, further, I will take away your necessary food.
sentences.susu: «N na n ma xali faxatise wolima nɛ wo ma, naxan lanxi kaamɛ ma. Nee wolima nɛ alako n xa wo sɔntɔ. N luma nɛ wo xa kaamɛ xun masa ra, wo xa baloe xa ɲɔn feo.

sentences.english: And I will send on you need of food and evil beasts, and they will be a cause of loss to you; and disease and violent death will go through you; and I will send the sword on you: I the Lord have said it.
sentences.susu: N kaamɛ radinma nɛ wo ma, n sube xaaɲɛe xɛɛma nɛ wo yire. Na birin wo xa die sɔntɔma nɛ. Wuganyi, faxɛ, nun gere mu ɲɔnma wo tagi. Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti n bɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, let your face be turned to the mountains of Israel, and be a prophet to them, and say,
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i ya rafindi Isirayila geyae ma, i xa n xui radangi e ma.

sentences.english: You mountains of Israel, give ear to the words of the Lord: this is what the Lord has said to the mountains and the hills, to the waterways and the valleys: See, I, even I, am sending on you a sword for the destruction of your high places.
sentences.susu: I xa a fala, ‹Isirayilakae, wo wo tuli mati wo Marigi Alatala xa masenyi ra. N naxɛ wo tan naxee na geyae fari nun gulunbae kui, n fama nɛ wo sɔntɔde santidɛgɛma ra, n wo xa kuye batudee kana.

sentences.english: And your altars will be made waste, and your sun-images will be broken: and I will have your dead men placed before your images.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɛrɛxɛbadee kanama nɛ, wo xa surayi sɛrɛxɛbadee yensen, wo faxa wo xa kuyee ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And I will put the dead bodies of the children of Israel in front of their images, sending your bones in all directions about your altars.
sentences.susu: N wo tan Isirayilakae binbie luma nɛ na sɛrɛxɛbadee rabilinyi, wo xɔrie rayensenma nɛ naa.

sentences.english: In all your living-places the towns will become broken walls, and the high places made waste; so that your altars may be broken down and made waste, and your images broken and ended, and so that your sun-images may be cut down and your works rubbed out.
sentences.susu: Wo sabati dɛdɛ, wo xa taae nun wo xa batudee kanama nɛ. Wo xa sɛrɛxɛbadee nun wo xa kuyee butuxunma nɛ, wo xa surayi sɛrɛxɛbadee rabira. Wo xa wali birin xun nakanama nɛ.

sentences.english: And the dead will be falling down among you, and you will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe na faxa wo ya ma, wo fama a kolonde a Alatala na n tan nan na.›»

sentences.english: But still, I will keep a small band safe from the sword among the nations, when you are sent wandering among the countries.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ n wo dɔnxɔɛe ratangama nɛ santidɛgɛma ma, n fa wo lu ɲamanɛe ma.

sentences.english: And those of you who are kept safe will have me in mind among the nations where they have been taken away as prisoners, how I sent punishment on their hearts which were untrue to me, and on their eyes which were turned to their false gods: and they will be full of hate for themselves because of the evil things which they have done in all their disgusting ways.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui wo xa mixi naxee xaninxi konyiya kui, e fama nɛ ratude n ma. E fa e xa yanfanteya kolon n mabiri, e xa birɛ kuyee fɔxɔ ra, na birin bara n bɔɲɛ tɔɔrɔ. E na fahaamui sɔtɔ e xa ɲaaxuɲa ma, e bɔɲɛ fan tɔɔrɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: And they will be certain that I am the Lord: not for nothing did I say that I would do this evil to them.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui e a kolonma nɛ a Alatala na n tan nan na. N mu wɔyɛnxi fufafu ra n to yi gbaloe fe fala e bɛ.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: Give blows with your hand, stamping with your foot, and say, O sorrow! because of all the evil and disgusting ways of the children of Israel: for death will overtake them by the sword and through need of food and by disease.
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Wo wo bɛlɛxɛ bɔnbɔ, wo wo sanyi ramaxa, a falafe ra, ‹Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ xa ɲaaxuɲa birin bara a niya e xa faxa gere, kaamɛ, nun wuganyi ra.

sentences.english: He who is far away will come to his death by disease; he who is near will be put to the sword; he who is shut up will come to his death through need of food; and I will give full effect to my passion against them.
sentences.susu: Naxee makuya, wuganyi nan nee faxama. Naxee makɔrɛ, nee faxama gere nan kui. Naxee na ratanga na gbaloe ma, kaamɛ nan nee fan faxama. N na n ma xɔnɛ fulunma nɛ e xili ma.

sentences.english: And you will be certain that I am the Lord, when their dead men are stretched among their images round about their altars on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, and under every branching tree, and under every thick oak-tree, the places where they made sweet smells to all their images.
sentences.susu: E na e xa mixi binbie to e xa kuyee sɛɛti ma na sɛrɛxɛbadee yire geyae fari wurie bun ma e nu surayi fanyi ganma dɛnnaxɛ sɛrɛxɛ ra e xa kuyee bɛ, e a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.

sentences.english: And my hand will be stretched out against them, making the land waste and unpeopled, from the waste land to Riblah, through all their living-places: and they will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: N fama nɛ n bɛlɛxɛ italade e xili ma, e xa bɔxi fa kana kelife gbengberenyi ma han Dibila. Na kui e a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: And you, son of man, say, This is what the Lord has said to the land of Israel: An end has come, the end has come on the four quarters of the land.
sentences.susu: «I tan adamadi, wo Marigi Alatala xui nan yi ki Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ bɛ, ‹Wo xa fe raɲɔnyi bara wo xa bɔxi tunxun naani birin li!

sentences.english: Now the end has come on you, and I will send my wrath on you, judging you for your ways, I will send punishment on you for all your disgusting acts.
sentences.susu: A gbe mu luxi n xa n ma xɔnɛ radin wo ma, wo xa wo xa wali ɲaaxi sare sɔtɔ, wo xa fe xa ɲɔn.

sentences.english: My eye will not have mercy on you, and I will have no pity: but I will send the punishment of your ways on you, and your disgusting works will be among you: and you will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: N mu kinikinima wo ma fefe ma. N wo xa wali kobi birin nagbilenma nɛ wo ma. Na kui wo fama nɛ a kolonde n tan nan na Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: An evil, even one evil; see, it is coming.
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan yi ki, wo xa gbaloe magaaxuxi bara wo li.

sentences.english: An end has come, the end has come; see, it is coming on you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa fe raɲɔnyi bara fa, a bara wo yire li, a bara keli wo xili ma!

sentences.english: The crowning time has come on you, O people of the land: the time has come, the day is near; the day will not be slow in coming, it will not keep back.
sentences.susu: Fe xɔrɔxɔɛ bara wo li, wo tan naxee sabatixi Isirayila bɔxi ma. N ma kiiti lɔxɔɛ bara fa. Sɛɛwɛ bara masara kɔntɔfili ra wo xa geyae fari.

sentences.english: Now, in a little time, I will let loose my passion on you, and give full effect to my wrath against you, judging you for your ways, and sending punishment on you for all your disgusting works.
sentences.susu: A gbe mu luxi n xa n ma xɔnɛ radin wo ma a ɲaaxi ra. N wo makiitima nɛ wo xa wali ɲaaxi xa fe ra, n wo xa yunubie sare ragbilen wo ma.

sentences.english: My eye will not have mercy, and I will have no pity: I will send on you the punishment of your ways, and your disgusting works will be among you; and you will see that I am the Lord who gives punishment.
sentences.susu: N mu kinikinima wo ma fefe ma. N wo xa wali kobi birin nagbilenma nɛ wo ma. Na kui wo fama nɛ a kolonde n tan nan na Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: See, the day; see, it is coming: the crowning time has gone out; the twisted way is flowering, pride has put out buds.
sentences.susu: «Na lɔxɔɛ nan yi ki! Gbaloe bara ramini alɔ fuge minima sansi wuri ma ki naxɛ. Wo xa yɛtɛ igboɲa bara dangɛ.

sentences.english: Violent behaviour has been lifted up into a rod of evil; it will not be slow in coming, it will not keep back.
sentences.susu: Wo xa fe kobi bara findi luxusinyi ra n bɛlɛxɛ kui. Ɲama yo mu luma wo xɔnyi, e harige birin ɲɔnma nɛ.

sentences.english: The time has come, the day is near: let not him who gives a price for goods be glad, or him who gets the price have sorrow:
sentences.susu: Kiiti waxati bara fa, na lɔxɔɛ bara a li. Saresoe naxa sɛɛwa, saremati naxa sunnun, barima Alatala xa xɔnɛ na tefe ɲama birin xili ma.

sentences.english: For the trader will not go back to the things for which he had his price, even while he is still living:
sentences.susu: Saresoe mu sese fima sarematie ma e xa duniɲɛigiri kui, barima Ala xa natɛ mu masarama. E birin faxama nɛ e xa yunubie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And he who has given a price for goods will not get them, for my wrath is on all of them.
sentences.susu: Hali e sara fe, e gere fe yailan, mixi yo mu sigama gere sode barima n ma xɔnɛ bara din e birin na sinnanyi ma.»

sentences.english: Outside is the sword, and inside disease and need of food: he who is in the open country will be put to the sword; he who is in the town will come to his end through need of food and disease.
sentences.susu: «Gere na taa fari ma, wuganyi nun kaamɛ na taa kui. Naxan na daaxa na faxama gere nan kui, naxan na taa kui na kanyi faxa kaamɛ nun wuganyi ra.

sentences.english: And those of them who get away safely will go and be in the secret places like the doves of the valleys, all of them will come to death, every one in his sin.
sentences.susu: Naxee na ratanga na ma, nee sa e nɔxunma geyae nan fari. E wama nɛ alɔ kolokonde e xa yunubie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: All hands will be feeble and all knees without strength, like water.
sentences.susu: E sɛnbɛ ɲɔnma nɛ, e xinbie rakori.

sentences.english: And they will put haircloth round them, and deep fear will be covering them; and shame will be on all faces, and the hair gone from all their heads.
sentences.susu: E sunnunyi dugi nan nagoroma e ma, e e xunyi nun e dɛxabe bi yaagi kui.

sentences.english: They will put out their silver into the streets, and their gold will be as an unclean thing; their silver and their gold will not be able to keep them safe in the day of the wrath of the Lord; they will not get their desire or have food for their need: because it has been the cause of their falling into sin.
sentences.susu: E gbeti nun xɛɛma wolima nɛ tande alɔ se sɛniyɛntare, kɔnɔ na sese mu findima kisi ra e bɛ Ala xa xɔnɛ lɔxɔɛ. Na naafuli mu findima donse ra e bɛ, barima a findi nɛ e ratantanse ra.

sentences.english: As for their beautiful ornament, they had put it on high, and had made the images of their disgusting and hated things in it: for this cause I have made it an unclean thing to them.
sentences.susu: E nu bara ɲɛlɛxin e xa xunmase fanyie ra, e naxee rawalixi kuye ɲaaxie yailanfe ra. Na kui n nee findima nɛ se sɛniyɛntaree ra,

sentences.english: And I will give it into the hands of men from strange lands who will take it by force, and to the evil-doers of the earth to have for themselves; and they will make it unholy.
sentences.susu: n nee so e yaxui ɲaaxie yi ra naxee e rawalima fe kobi ra ɲamanɛ ma.

sentences.english: And my face will be turned away from them, and they will make my secret place unholy: violent men will go into it and make it unholy.
sentences.susu: N na n kobe soma nɛ e ra. E fama nɛ sode n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, e fe sɛniyɛntare raba naa, e n ma see muɲa.»

sentences.english: Make the chain: for the land is full of crimes of blood, and the town is full of violent acts.
sentences.susu: «Yɔlɔnxɔnyie xa yailan, barima wo xa bɔxi rafexi suute nun faxɛtie nan na.

sentences.english: For this reason I will send the worst of the nations and they will take their houses for themselves: I will make the pride of their strength come to an end; and their holy places will be made unclean.
sentences.susu: N mixi ɲaaxie nan nafama kelife ɲamanɛe ma, alako e xa wo xa banxie tongo, e xa wo rayaagi, e xa wo xa batudee mabere.

sentences.english: Shaking fear is coming; and they will be looking for peace, and there will be no peace.
sentences.susu: Fe xɔrɔxɔɛ na wo li, wo bɔɲɛsa fenma nɛ, kɔnɔ wo mu na toma fefe ma.

sentences.english: Destruction will come on destruction, and one story after another; and the vision of the prophet will be shamed, and knowledge of the law will come to an end among the priests, and wisdom among the old.
sentences.susu: Gbaloe luma fa ra nɛ a bore fɔxɔ ra. Wo luma nɛ fe xɔrɔxɔɛ mɛ ra. Wo xibaaru fanyi fenma nɛ namiɲɔnmɛ ra, kɔnɔ marasi yo mu luma sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun forie yi ra.

sentences.english: The king will give himself up to sorrow, and the ruler will be clothed with wonder, and the hands of the people of the land will be troubled: I will give them punishment for their ways, judging them as it is right for them to be judged; and they will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ luma nɛ sunnun na, a xa kuntigie nimisa, a xa ɲama birin sɛrɛn gaaxui kui. N e makiitima e ɲɛrɛ ki nan ma, alɔ e darixi a ra ki naxɛ. Na tɛmui e a kolonma nɛ n tan nan na Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: Now in the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the fifth day of the month, when I was in my house and the responsible men of Judah were seated before me, the hand of the Lord came on me there.
sentences.susu: A ɲɛ senni nde, kike senni, xi suuli nde ra, n nu dɔxɔxi n ma banxi nan kui, Yuda forie fan nu na n sɛɛti ma. Na tɛmui Muxu Marigi Alatala naxa a sɛnbɛ masen n bɛ.

sentences.english: And looking, I saw a form like fire; from the middle of his body and down there was fire: and up from the middle of his body a sort of shining, like electrum.
sentences.susu: N naxa laamatunyi to naxan lanxi xɛmɛ nde ma naxan sanyie nu luxi alɔ tɛ, a kanke nu yanbama alɔ bafata raxunuxi.

sentences.english: And he put out the form of a hand and took me by the hair of my head; and the wind, lifting me up between the earth and the heaven, took me in the visions of God to Jerusalem, to the way into the inner door facing to the north; where was the seat of the image of envy.
sentences.susu: A naxa a bɛlɛxɛ itala, a n xunsɛxɛ suxu. Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa n tongo, a n ite koore nun bɔxi tagi, a fa laamatunyi masen n bɛ. N naxa Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi to Darisalamu. N to na sode dɛ li naxan nu na kɔɔla ma, n naxa kuye nde to naa naxan Ala raxɔnɔma.

sentences.english: And I saw the glory of the Lord there, as in the vision which I saw in the valley.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Ala xa nɔrɛ fan nu na mɛnni, alɔ n a to ki naxɛ a singe ra fiili ma.

sentences.english: Then he said to me, Son of man, now let your eyes be lifted up in the direction of the north; and on looking in the direction of the north, to the north of the doorway of the altar, I saw this image of envy by the way in.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen n bɛ, «I tan Adamadi, i ya ti kɔɔla biri ra.» N to n ya rasiga naa, n naxa na kuye to hɔrɔmɔbanxi sode dɛ kɔɔla biri ra, naxan Alatala raxɔnɔma.

sentences.english: And he said to me, Son of man, do you see what they are doing? even the very disgusting things which the children of Israel are doing here, causing me to go far away from my holy place? but you will see other most disgusting things.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen n bɛ, «Adamadi, i bara Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ xa wali ɲaaxi to, wali naxan a niyama n xa n makuya n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi ra? I fama nɛ fe gbɛtɛ tode naxee ɲaaxu na bɛ.»

sentences.english: And he took me to the door of the open place; and looking, I saw a hole in the wall.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa n xanin hɔrɔmɔbanxi sode dɛ gbɛtɛ ra. Mɛnni n naxa yale nde to tɛtɛ ma.

sentences.english: And he said to me, Son of man, make a hole in the wall: and after making a hole in the wall I saw a door.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen n bɛ, «Adamadi, i xa na yale raxungbo.» N to na raba, n naxa naadɛ nde to.

sentences.english: And he said to me, Go in and see the evil and disgusting things which they are doing here.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen n bɛ, «I xa so naa ɲama xa wali ɲaaxi matode.»

sentences.english: So I went in and saw; and there every sort of living thing which goes flat on the earth, and unclean beasts, and all the images of the children of Israel, were pictured round about on the wall.
sentences.susu: N to so mɛnni kui, n naxa bubusee, sube raharamuxie, nun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ xa kuye birin xa pirinti to na banxi xalɛ rabilinyi ma.

sentences.english: And before them seventy of the responsible men of the children of Israel had taken their places, every man with a vessel for burning perfumes in his hand, and in the middle of them was Jaazaniah, the son of Shaphan; and a cloud of smoke went up from the burning perfume.
sentences.susu: Isirayila fori tongo solofere nun Safan xa di Yaasaniya nu na mɛnni, surayi ganse suxuxi kankan yi ra, tuuri nu fa te a fa mɛnni rafe.

sentences.english: And he said to me, Son of man, have you seen what the responsible men of the children of Israel do in the dark, every man in his room of pictured images? for they say, The Lord does not see us; the Lord has gone away from the land.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen n bɛ, «Adamadi, i bara Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ forie xa wali to, e naxan nabafe dimi kui e xa kuyee ra? E naxɛ, ‹Alatala mu won toxi feo. A bara won ma bɔxi rabolo.›»

sentences.english: Then he said to me, You will see even more disgusting things which they do.
sentences.susu: Ala man naxa a masen n bɛ, «I fama nɛ fe gbɛtɛ tode naxee ɲaaxu na bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then he took me to the door of the way into the Lord's house looking to the north; and there women were seated weeping for Tammuz.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a naxa n xanin Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi sode dɛ ra kɔɔla mabiri. N naxa ginɛ ndee li mɛnni, e dɔxɔxi, e ɲɔnfe rabafe kuye nde bɛ naxan xili Tamusu.

sentences.english: Then he said to me, Have you seen this, O son of man? you will see even more disgusting things than these.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen n bɛ, «Adamadi, i bara a to? I fama nɛ fe gbɛtɛ tode naxee ɲaaxu na bɛ.»

sentences.english: And he took me into the inner square of the Lord's house, and at the door of the Temple of the Lord, between the covered way and the altar, there were about twenty-five men with their backs turned to the Temple of the Lord and their faces turned to the east; and they were worshipping the sun, turning to the east.
sentences.susu: A naxa n naso Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa tɛtɛ kui. N naxa mixi mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli to hɔrɔmɔbanxi sode dɛ ra, gbutunyi nun sɛrɛxɛbade tagi, e kobe soxi Alatala xa banxi ra, e ya rafindixi sogetede ma e nu suyidi soge bɛ.

sentences.english: Then he said to me, Have you seen this, O son of man? is it a small thing to the children of Judah that they do the disgusting things which they are doing here? for they have made the land full of violent behaviour, making me angry again and again: and see, they put the branch to my nose.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a masen n bɛ, «Adamadi, i bara a to? Fe xuri di nan yi ra Yudayakae na naxee rabafe be? E man na fe ɲaaxi nan nabama bɔxi birin kui, fe naxan n naxɔnɔma han. A mato e na kuye salonsee sunbufe ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For this reason I will let loose my wrath: my eye will not have mercy, and I will have no pity.
sentences.susu: Na kui n na n gbe ɲɔxɔma n ma xɔnɛ kui. N mu kinikinima e ma, n mu gbilenma na ɲaxankatɛ fɔxɔ ra. Hali e n maxandi e xui itexi ra, n mu n tuli matima e ra fefe ma.»

sentences.english: Then crying out in my hearing in a loud voice, he said, Let the overseers of the town come near, every man armed.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n naxa Ala xui itexi mɛ, a naxɛ, «Taa kantamae, wo xa fa wo xa geresosee ra!»

sentences.english: And six men came from the way of the higher doorway looking to the north, every man with his axe in his hand: and one man among them was clothed in linen, with a writer's inkpot at his side. And they went in and took their places by the brass altar.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ senni naxa mini naadɛ fuge biri ra, naadɛ naxan ya rafindixi kɔɔla ma, birin nun a xa geresose ra a bɛlɛxɛ i. Xɛmɛ gbɛtɛ nu na e ya ma, dugi fiixɛ ragoroxi a ma, sɛbɛli ti se nu na a bɛlɛxɛ i. E naxa fa, e ti sɛrɛxɛbade fɛ ma, naxan yailanxi wure gbeeli ra.

sentences.english: And the glory of the God of Israel had gone up from the winged ones on which it was resting, to the doorstep of the house. And crying out to the man clothed in linen who had the writer's inkpot at his side,
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Ala xa nɔrɛ naxa keli malekɛe sawurɛe xun, a nu magoroxi naxee fari, a a xun ti banxi sode dɛ ra. Alatala naxa na xɛmɛ xili dugi fiixɛ ragoroxi naxan ma, sɛbɛli ti se nu na naxan bɛlɛxɛ,

sentences.english: The Lord said to him, Go through the town, through the middle of Jerusalem, and put a mark on the brows of the men who are sorrowing and crying for all the disgusting things which are done in it.
sentences.susu: a a masen a bɛ, «I xa i ɲɛrɛ Darisalamu taa kui tɔnxuma safe ra xɛmɛe birin tigi ra, naxee na tɔɔrɔfe, naxee na wafe yi fe ɲaaxie xa fe ra naxee rabama Darisalamu.»

sentences.english: And to these he said in my hearing, Go through the town after him using your axes: do not let your eyes have mercy, and have no pity:
sentences.susu: A man naxa a masen a booree bɛ n ya xɔri, «Wo bira yi xɛmɛ fɔxɔ ra, wo xa faxɛ ti kinikinitareɲa kui!

sentences.english: Give up to destruction old men and young men and virgins, little children and women: but do not come near any man who has the mark on him: and make a start at my holy place. So they made a start with the old men who were before the house.
sentences.susu: Wo xa mixi birin faxa, forie, sɛgɛtalae, sungbutunyie, ginɛe nun dimɛdie. Kɔnɔ tɔnxuma na naxee tigi ma, wo nee lu na! Wo xa yi wali fɔlɔ n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi sɛniyɛnxi yire.» Na kui e naxa na forie faxa naxee nu tixi hɔrɔmɔbanxi ya ra.

sentences.english: And he said to them, Make the house unclean, make the open places full of dead: go forward and send destruction on the town.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a masen e bɛ, «Hali a findixi fe sɛniyɛntare nan na, wo xa n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa tɛtɛ rafe binbie ra! Yakɔsi, wo siga!» Na kui e naxa mini, e faxɛ belebele ti taa kui.

sentences.english: Now while they were doing so, and I was untouched, I went down on my face, and crying out, I said, Ah, Lord! will you give all the rest of Israel to destruction in letting loose your wrath on Jerusalem?
sentences.susu: E nu faxɛ tima tɛmui naxɛ, n naxa n felen bɔxi ma n keren. N nu n mawafe Ala bɛ a falafe ra, «N Marigi Alatala, i wama Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin sɔntɔfe nɛ i xa xɔnɛ kui naxan na tefe Darisalamu taa kui?»

sentences.english: Then he said to me, The sin of the children of Israel and Judah is very, very great, and the land is full of blood and the town full of evil ways: for they say, The Lord has gone away from the land, and the Lord does not see.
sentences.susu: A naxa n yaabi, «Isirayila nun Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xa yunubi gbo! E luma faxɛ ti ra tɛmui birin, e fe tinxintaree raba bɔxi birin kui. E naxɛ, ‹Alatala bara yi bɔxi rabolo, a mu won ma fe toma sɔnɔn.›

sentences.english: And as for me, my eye will not have mercy, and I will have no pity, but I will send the punishment of their ways on their heads.
sentences.susu: Na kui n mu kinikinima e ma fefe ma. N e xa wali ɲaaxi sare ragbilenma nɛ e ma a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Then the man clothed in linen, who had the inkpot at his side, came back and said, I have done what you gave me orders to do.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui na xɛmɛ dugi fiixɛ ragoroxi naxan ma, sɛbɛli ti se suxuxi naxan yi ra, a naxa gbilen, a dɛntɛgɛ sa a xɛɛma bɛ, «N bara gɛ i xa yaamari rabade.»

sentences.english: Then looking, I saw that on the arch which was over the head of the winged ones there was seen over them what seemed like a sapphire stone, having the form of a king's seat.
sentences.susu: Na laamatunyi kui n naxa kibanyi nde to malekɛe xun ma naxan nu luxi alɔ diyaman maniyɛ.

sentences.english: And he said to the man clothed in linen, Go in between the wheels, under the winged ones, and get your two hands full of burning coals from between the winged ones and send them in a shower over the town. And he went in before my eyes.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen xɛmɛ bɛ dugi fiixɛ nu ragoroxi naxan ma, «I xa so malekɛe bun ma, sanyi radigilinxie na dɛnnaxɛ, i xa tɛ wolee tongo, i e rayensen taa ma.» A naxa na raba n ya xɔri.

sentences.english: Now the winged ones were stationed on the right side of the house when the man went in; and the inner square was full of the cloud.
sentences.susu: Na malekɛe nu tixi hɔrɔmɔbanxi yirefanyi ma na xɛmɛ so tɛmui naxɛ. Kunda nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ kui.

sentences.english: And the glory of the Lord went up from the winged ones and came to rest over the doorstep of the house; and the house was full of the cloud and the open square was full of the shining of the Lord's glory.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa nɔrɛ naxa keli na malekɛe xun ma, a siga hɔrɔmɔbanxi sode dɛ ra. Kunda naxa hɔrɔmɔbanxi rafe, Alatala xa nɔrɛ xa yanbɛ fanyi nu na tɛtɛ birin kui.

sentences.english: And the sound of the wings of the winged ones was clear even in the outer square, like the voice of the Ruler of all.
sentences.susu: Na malekɛe gabutenyie xui nu mɛma boore tɛtɛ kui, a nu gbo alɔ Ala Sɛnbɛma wɔyɛn xui.

sentences.english: And when he gave orders to the man clothed in linen, saying, Take fire from between the wheels, from between the winged ones, then he went in and took his place at the side of a wheel.
sentences.susu: Alatala to xɛmɛ yamari, dugi fiixɛ nu ragoroxi naxan ma, a xa tɛ wolee tongo se digilinxie tagi malekɛe bun ma, a naxa so, a sa ti naa.

sentences.english: And stretching out his hand to the fire which was between the winged ones, he took some of it and went out.
sentences.susu: Na malekɛ keren naxa tɛ wole ndee kɔ, a a sa na xɛmɛ bɛlɛxɛ i. Na naxa a rasuxu, a mini.

sentences.english: And I saw the form of a man's hands among the winged ones under their wings.
sentences.susu: Mixi bɛlɛxɛ maniyɛ nan nu minima na malekɛe gabutenyie bun ma.

sentences.english: And looking, I saw four wheels by the side of the winged ones, one wheel by the side of a winged one and another wheel by the side of another: and the wheels were like the colour of a beryl stone to the eye.
sentences.susu: N naxa sanyi radigilinxi naani to malekɛe fɛ ma, keren keren nu na kankan bun ma. E nu mayanbama alɔ diyaman maniyɛ.

sentences.english: In form the four of them were all the same, they seemed like a wheel inside a wheel.
sentences.susu: Na sanyi radigilinxi naani birin nu maniya, kankan luxi alɔ a nu na sanyi radigilinxi gbɛtɛ nan kui.

sentences.english: When they were moving, they went on their four sides without turning; they went after the head in the direction in which it was looking; they went without turning.
sentences.susu: E nɛ sigama, malekɛ yatagi nu tixi dɛnnaxɛ ra e nu e ɲɛrɛma mɛnni biri nɛ, hali na sanyi to nu a mafindima.

sentences.english: And the edges of the four wheels were full of eyes round about.
sentences.susu: Yae nu na na malekɛ naanie birin fatee ma, a nun e farie ma, e bɛlɛxɛe ma, e gabutenyie ma, nun e sanyi radigilinxi naanie ma

sentences.english: As for the wheels, they were named in my hearing, the circling wheels.
sentences.susu: N naxa a mɛ, e na sanyi radigilinxie xilima «sanyi firi firi.»

sentences.english: And every one had four faces: the first face was the face of a winged one, and the second was the face of a man, and the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.
sentences.susu: Yatagi naani nan nu na na malekɛe birin bɛ. Keren nu luxi nɛ alɔ malekɛ yatagi, a firin nde nu luxi nɛ alɔ mixi yatagi, a saxan nde nu luxi nɛ alɔ yɛtɛ yatagi, a naani nde nu luxi nɛ alɔ sɛgɛ yatagi.

sentences.english: And the winged ones went up on high: this is the living being which I saw by the river Chebar.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui na malekɛe naxa keli. E nu maniyaxi na daalisee nan na n nu bara naxee to Kebara xure dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And when the winged ones went, the wheels went by their side: and when their wings were lifted to take them up from the earth, the wheels were not turned from their side.
sentences.susu: Na malekɛe nɛ e ɲɛrɛma, e nun na sanyi radigilinxie nan a ra. E na e gabutenyie itala e xa keli, e nun na sanyie nan a ra.

sentences.english: When they were at rest in their place, these were at rest; when they were lifted up, these went up with them: for the spirit of life was in them.
sentences.susu: E na ti, e nun e sanyie nan a ra, e na te, e nun e sanyie nan a ra, barima na daalisee nii nu na e sanyi radigilinxie nan kui.

sentences.english: Then the glory of the Lord went out from the doorstep of the house, and came to rest over the winged ones.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala xa nɔrɛ naxa keli hɔrɔmɔbanxi sode dɛ ra, a sa a magoro na malekɛe xun ma.

sentences.english: And the winged ones, lifting up their wings, went up from the earth before my eyes, with the wheels by their side: and they came to rest at the east doorway of the Lord's house; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them on high.
sentences.susu: E naxa e gabutenyie itala, e keli bɔxi ma n ya xɔri e nun e sanyi radigilinxie ra. E naxa e sa ti Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi dɛ ra sogetede biri ra. Isirayila Marigi Ala xa nɔrɛ nu na e xun ma.

sentences.english: This is the living being which I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and it was clear to me that they were the winged ones.
sentences.susu: A raɲɔnyi n naxa a kolon n na daalise naani n naxee toxi Kebara xure dɛ ra, e nu maniyaxi malekɛe nan na.

sentences.english: Every one had four faces and every one had four wings; and hands like a man's hands were under their wings.
sentences.susu: Yatagi naani nun gabutenyi naani nu na e birin ma. Bɛlɛxɛe fan nu na e gabutenyie bun ma.

sentences.english: As for the form of their faces, they were the faces whose form I saw by the river Chebar; when they went, every one of them went straight forward.
sentences.susu: E yatagie nu maniyaxi yatagie nan na n naxee to Kebara xure dɛ ra. E birin nu sigama yare nan tun.

sentences.english: And the wind, lifting me up, took me to the east doorway of the Lord's house, looking to the east: and at the door I saw twenty-five men; and among them I saw Jaazaniah, the son of Azzur, and Pelatiah, the son of Benaiah, rulers of the people.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa n tongo mɛnni, a n xanin Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛ ra, naxan na sogetede biri ra. Xɛmɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli nu na mɛnni. Ɲama kuntigie Asuru xa di Yaasaniya nun Bɛnaya xa di Pɛlataya fan nu na e ya ma.

sentences.english: Then he said to me, Son of man, these are the men who are designing evil, who are teaching evil ways in this town:
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, «Adamadi, yi mixie na fe ɲaaxi kui. E wama ɲama ratantanfe e xa marasi ra.

sentences.english: Who say, This is not the time for building houses: this town is the cooking-pot and we are the flesh.
sentences.susu: E naxɛ, ‹Hali won mu banxi ti, barima yi taa luxi nɛ alɔ tunde won ɲinma naxan kui.›

sentences.english: For this cause be a prophet against them, be a prophet, O son of man.
sentences.susu: Na kui i tan adamadi, i xa n ma wɔyɛnyi radangi e ma.»

sentences.english: And the spirit of the Lord came on me, and he said to me, Say, These are the words of the Lord: This is what you have said, O children of Israel; what comes into your mind is clear to me.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Alatala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa goro n ma, a yi masenyi ti n bɛ n xa a radangi e ma, «Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Wo tan Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ, n wo xa maɲɔxunyi kolon.

sentences.english: You have made great the number of your dead in this town, you have made its streets full of dead men.
sentences.susu: Wo bara mixi gbegbe faxa yi taa kui, wo bara e binbie lu kira ra.

sentences.english: For this reason the Lord has said: Your dead whom you have put down in its streets, they are the flesh, and this town is the cooking-pot: but I will make you come out from inside it.
sentences.susu: Na kui n tan, wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: Wo binbie naxee wolixi kira ra, e findixi subee nan na naxan fama gande yi tunde kui, kɔnɔ n wo tan kerima nɛ.

sentences.english: You have been fearing the sword, and I will send the sword on you, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo to gaaxuxi gere ya ra, n gere rafama nɛ wo ma! N tan Alatala xui nan ya.

sentences.english: I will make you come out from inside the town and will give you up into the hands of men from other lands, and will be judge among you.
sentences.susu: N wo raminima nɛ taa kui, n wo sa si gbɛtɛ sagoe. Na nan findima wo xa ɲaxankatɛ ra.

sentences.english: You will come to your death by the sword; and I will be your judge in the land of Israel; and you will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo faxama gere nan kui Isirayila naaninyi ra. Na kui wo a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.

sentences.english: This town will not be your cooking-pot, and you will not be the flesh inside it; I will be your judge at the limit of the land of Israel;
sentences.susu: Yi taa mu findima wo bɛ tunde ra, wo tan mu findima sube ra naxan ganma be taa kui. N wo tan makiitima Isirayila naaninyi nan na.

sentences.english: And you will be certain that I am the Lord: for you have not been guided by my rules or given effect to my orders, but you have been living by the orders of the nations round about you.
sentences.susu: Wo a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra, wo tondi birade naxan xa yaamarie fɔxɔ ra. Wo bara n ma sɛriyɛ rabolo, wo bira si gbɛtɛe xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: Now while I was saying these things, death came to Pelatiah, the son of Benaiah. Then falling down on my face and crying out with a loud voice, I said, Ah, Lord! will you put an end to all the rest of Israel?
sentences.susu: N to gɛ na masenyi falade, Bɛnaya xa di Pɛlataya naxa faxa. N naxa n yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma keren na, n fa a fala n xui itexi ra, «N Marigi Alatala, i wama Isirayila mixi dɔnxɔɛ birin sɔntɔfe nɛ?»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa n yaabi,

sentences.english: Son of man, your countrymen, your relations, and all the children of Israel, all of them, are those to whom the people of Jerusalem have said, Go far from the Lord; this land is given to us for a heritage:
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, Darisalamukae na a falafe i baribooree nun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin bɛ e xa e makuya Alatala ra, barima e naxɛ yi bɔxi findixi e gbe nan na.

sentences.english: For this reason say, This is what the Lord has said: Though I have had them moved far off among the nations, and though I have sent them wandering among the countries, still I have been a safe place for them for a little time in the countries where they have come.
sentences.susu: Na kui i xa a fala e bɛ, ‹Alatala xa masenyi nan ya. Hali n e makuya, n e xanin ɲamanɛe ma, n luma nɛ e sɛɛti ma mɛnni fan.›»

sentences.english: Then say, This is what the Lord has said: I will get you together from the peoples, and make you come out of the countries where you have been sent in flight, and I will give you the land of Israel.
sentences.susu: «I xa yi masenyi ti: ‹Wo Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya. N wo malanma nɛ kelife ɲamanɛe tagi wo yensenxi dɛnnaxɛ, n man Isirayila bɔxi so wo yi ra.›»

sentences.english: And they will come there, and take away all the hated and disgusting things from it.
sentences.susu: «E gbilenma nɛ e xa bɔxi ma, e fa kuye ɲaaxie birin ba naa.

sentences.english: And I will give them a new heart, and I will put a new spirit in them; and I will take the heart of stone out of their flesh and give them a heart of flesh:
sentences.susu: N e bɔɲɛ findima bɔɲɛ keren nan na. N xaxili nɛɛnɛ so e yi ra. N e xa bɔɲɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ bama nɛ, n bɔɲɛ fanyi so e yi ra,

sentences.english: So that they may be guided by my rules and keep my orders and do them: and they will be to me a people, and I will be to them a God.
sentences.susu: alako e xa bira n ma yaamarie fɔxɔ ra, e xa n ma sɛriyɛ binya. E findima n ma ɲama nan na fa, n tan findi e Marigi Ala ra.

sentences.english: But as for those whose heart goes after their hated and disgusting things, I will send on their heads the punishment of their ways, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi naxee birama e xa kuye batufe fɔxɔ ra, n e xa wali ɲaaxi sare ragbilenma nɛ e ma. Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: Then the wings of the winged ones were lifted up, and the wheels were by their side; and the glory of the God of Israel was over them on high.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui na malekɛe naxa e gabutenyie itala nun e sanyi radigilinxie, Isirayila Marigi Alatala xa nɔrɛ nu na e xun ma.

sentences.english: And the glory of the Lord went up from inside the town, and came to rest on the mountain on the east side of the town.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa nɔrɛ naxa keli taa kui, a sa a magoro geya fari naxan nu na sogetede.

sentences.english: And the wind, lifting me up, took me in the visions of God into Chaldaea, to those who had been taken away as prisoners. So the vision which I had seen went away from me.
sentences.susu: Na laamatunyi kui, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa n tongo mɛnni, a n xanin Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ yire naxan nu na konyiya kui Kalide bɔxi ma. Laamatunyi to ɲɔn,

sentences.english: Then I gave an account to those who had been taken prisoners of all the things which the Lord had made me see.
sentences.susu: n naxa Alatala xa masenyi birin nadangi e ma, a naxee masen n bɛ.

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, you are living among an uncontrolled people, who have eyes to see but see not, and ears for hearing but they do not give ear; for they are an uncontrolled people.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i na bɔnsɔɛ murutaxi nan tagi yi ki. E ya na na, kɔnɔ e mu se toma. E tuli na na, kɔnɔ e mu fe mɛma, barima bɔnsɔɛ murutɛla nan e ra.
