sentences.english: And you, O son of man, by day, before their eyes, get ready the vessels of one who is taken away, and go away from your place to another place before their eyes: it may be that they will see, though they are an uncontrolled people.
sentences.susu: Adamadi, i naxan nabama, i xa kote yailan alɔ i na sigafe konyiya nan kui. I xa mini e ya xɔri yanyi xare ra alɔ mixi suxuxi naxan xaninfe ɲamanɛ ma. Na kui, hali e findixi bɔnsɔɛ murutaxi nan na, e fama nɛ fahaamui sɔtɔde i xa taali kui.

sentences.english: By day, before their eyes, take out your vessels like those of one who is taken away: and go out in the evening before their eyes, like those who are taken away as prisoners.
sentences.susu: I xa i xa kote yailan yanyi ra e ya xɔri. Nunmare tɛmui i xa mini taa kui e ya xɔri alɔ i na sigafe konyiya nan kui ɲamanɛ ma.

sentences.english: Make a hole in the wall, before their eyes, and go out through it.
sentences.susu: I xa yale ti taa tɛtɛ ma e ya xɔri, i fa mini na kui a nun i xa kote.

sentences.english: And before their eyes, take your goods on your back and go out in the dark; go with your face covered: for I have made you a sign to the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: I xa i xa kote dɔxɔ i tunki ma e ya xɔri, i mini nunmare tɛmui. I xa i yatagi makoto alako i naxa nɔ bɔxi tode. Na birin bara findi tɔnxuma ra Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ bɛ.»

sentences.english: And I did as I was ordered: I took out my vessels by day, like those of one who is taken away, and in the evening I made a hole through the wall with a tent-pin; and in the dark I went out, taking my things on my back before their eyes.
sentences.susu: N naxa na raba alɔ Ala a masen n bɛ ki naxɛ. N naxa n ma kote yailan yanyi xare ra. Nunmare ra, n naxa yale ti taa tɛtɛ ma n bɛlɛxɛ ra, n fa mini n ma kote ra e ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And in the morning the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Alatala naxa n maxɔrin,

sentences.english: Son of man, has not Israel, the uncontrolled people, said to you, What are you doing?
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, yi bɔnsɔɛ murutaxi mu i maxɔrin nu, i na fe naxan nabafe?

sentences.english: You are to say to them, This is what the Lord has said: This word has to do with the ruler in Jerusalem and all the children of Israel in it.
sentences.susu: A fala e bɛ, ‹Alatala yi nan masenxi: Yi kiiti saxi Darisalamu mangɛe nun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ nan birin ma naxee sabatixi be.›

sentences.english: Say, I am your sign: as I have done, so will it be done to them: they will go away as prisoners.
sentences.susu: A fala e bɛ, ‹N tan findixi wo bɛ tɔnxuma nan na. N naxan nabaxi na ki, na nan fama rabade wo fan na. E wo suxuma nɛ, e wo xanin konyiya kui ɲamanɛ ma.›»

sentences.english: And the ruler who is among them will take his goods on his back in the dark and go out: he will make a hole in the wall through which to go out: he will have his face covered so that he may not be seen.
sentences.susu: «Mangɛ naxan na e xun ma, a a xa kote dɔxɔma a tunki nan ma nunmare tɛmui, a a gi. E yale tima nɛ taa tɛtɛ ma alako a xa mini na ra. A a yatagi makotoma nɛ alako a naxa bɔxi to.

sentences.english: And my net will be stretched out on him, and he will be taken in my cords: and I will take him to Babylon to the land of the Chaldaeans; but he will not see it, and there death will come to him.
sentences.susu: N na n ma yɛlɛ italama nɛ a xun ma, n ma gantanyi a suxu. N a xaninma nɛ Babilɔn, Kalidi bɔnsɔɛ xa bɔxi ma, kɔnɔ a mu mɛnni toma a ya ra. A faxama naa.

sentences.english: And all his helpers round about him and all his armies I will send in flight to every wind; and I will let loose a sword after them.
sentences.susu: N fama nɛ a xa mixi birin nayensende, a xa kuntigie nun a xa sɔɔrie. N e birin nakerima nɛ santidɛgɛma ra.»

sentences.english: And they will be certain that I am the Lord, when I send them in flight among the nations, driving them out through the countries.
sentences.susu: «N na e keri ɲamanɛe ma duniɲa yire birin, e a kolonma nɛ na kui a n tan nan na Alatala ra.

sentences.english: But a small number of them I will keep from the sword, from the need of food, and from disease, so that they may make clear all their disgusting ways among the nations where they come; and they will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n mixi ndee ratangama nɛ e ya ma gere kui, n e ratanga kaamɛ nun wuganyi ma, alako e xa nɔ e xa wali kobie mataalide si gbɛtɛe bɛ e na lu dɛnnaxɛ. E a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, take your food with shaking fear, and your water with trouble and care;
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i nɛ i dɛgema tɛmui naxɛ, i xa sɛrɛn gaaxui ra. I nɛ ye minma tɛmui naxɛ, i imaxa kɔntɔfili ra.

sentences.english: And say to the people of the land, This is what the Lord has said about the people of Jerusalem and the land of Israel: They will take their food with care and their drink with wonder, so that all the wealth of their land may be taken from it because of the violent ways of the people living in it.
sentences.susu: A fala ɲama bɛ, ‹Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi Darisalamukae nun Isirayilakae xa fe ra. A naxɛ e e dɛgema gaaxui nan kui, e ye min kɔntɔfili ra, barima gbaloe ɲaaxi a niyama nɛ harige birin ba e xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the peopled towns will be made waste, and the land will become a wonder; and you will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Taae kanama nɛ, bɔxi xara. Na kui wo a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, what is this saying which you have about the land of Israel, The time is long and every vision comes to nothing?
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, munse na yi taali wɔyɛnyi ra, naxan na falafe wo tagi Isirayila bɔxi ma? Na taali naxɛ, ‹Lɔxɔɛe na e ikuyafe de, kɔnɔ Alatala xa laamatunyi mu kamalixi fefe ma.›

sentences.english: For this cause say to them, This is what the Lord has said: I have made this saying come to an end, and it will no longer be used as a common saying in Israel; but say to them, The days are near, and the effect of every vision.
sentences.susu: A fala e bɛ, ‹Alatala yi nan masenxi: N fama nɛ na taali wɔyɛnyi ifalɛ dande. Mixi yo mu na falama sɔnɔn Isirayila bɔxi ma.› A fala e bɛ, ‹A gbe mu luxi laamatunyi birin xa kamali.

sentences.english: For there will be no more false visions or smooth use of secret arts in Israel.
sentences.susu: Wule laamatunyi nun wule masenyi ɲɔnma nɛ sematoe yi ra Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ ya ma.

sentences.english: For I am the Lord; I will say the word and what I say I will do; it will not be put off: for in your days, O uncontrolled people, I will say the word and do it, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n tan Alatala na naxan masen, na kamalima nɛ a waxati ma. N fama n ma masenyi rakamalide wo tan murutɛlae nan bɛ. Alatala xui nan na ki.›»

sentences.english: Again the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, see, the children of Israel say, The vision which he sees is for the days which are a long way off, and his words are of times still far away.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ luma nɛ a fala ra i xa laamatunyi fe masen naxan buma a fa raba. A naxɛ namiɲɔnmɛ xa masenyi mu kamalima fo ɲɛ wuyaxi na dangi.

sentences.english: Say to them then, This is what the Lord has said: Not one of my words will be put off any longer, but what I say I will do, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a fala e bɛ, ‹Alatala yi nan masenxi: N mu dugundima n ma masenyi rakamalide sɔnɔn. N naxan masenxi, na fama nɛ rabade. Alatala xui nan na ki.›»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, be a prophet against the prophets of Israel, and say to those prophets whose words are the invention of their hearts, Give ear to the word of the Lord;
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i xa masenyi ti n xili ra Isirayila namiɲɔnmɛe bɛ. A fala e bɛ, naxee masenyi tima e yɛtɛ bɔɲɛ ma fe ma, i naxɛ, ‹Wo wo tuli mati Alatala xa masenyi ra!

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: A curse on the foolish prophets who go after the spirit which is in them and have seen nothing!
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Ɲaxankatɛ na namiɲɔnmɛ wule falɛe bɛ, naxee birama e yɛtɛ xaxili fɔxɔ ra, e mu laamatunyi yo toxi.

sentences.english: O Israel, your prophets have been like jackals in the waste places.
sentences.susu: Isirayila, wo xa namiɲɔnmɛ wule falɛe luma nɛ alɔ xulumasee banxi kanaxi kui.

sentences.english: You have not gone up into the broken places or made up the wall for the children of Israel to take your place in the fight in the day of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo mu Isirayila xa tɛtɛ yailanxi alako a xa ti gere kui Alatala xa lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: They have seen visions without substance and made use of secret arts, who say, The Lord has said; and the Lord has not sent them: hoping that the word would have effect.
sentences.susu: E xa laamatunyie findixi wule nan na. E xa masenyi mu findixi nɔndi ra fefe ma. E naxɛ, Alatala xui nan na ki, a fa li Alatala xa mu e xɛɛxi. E wama na xa kamali tun.

sentences.english: Have you not seen a vision without substance and have you not falsely made use of secret arts, when you say, The Lord has said; though I have said nothing?
sentences.susu: Fu xa mu na wo xa laamatunyie nun wo xa masenyie ra? Wo a falama, Ala xui nan na ki, a fa li n tan Ala xa xui mu a ra!›»

sentences.english: So this is what the Lord has said: Because your words are without substance and your visions are false, see, I am against you, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi wo xa fe ra, a naxɛ: ‹N bara keli wo xili ma wo xa wule masenyie nun wo xa wule laamatunyie xa fe ra. Alatala xui nan na ki.

sentences.english: And my hand will be against the prophets who see visions without substance and who make false use of secret arts: they will not be in the secret of my people, and they will not be recorded in the list of the children of Israel, and they will not come into the land of Israel; and it will be clear to you that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: N na n bɛlɛxɛ italama nɛ namiɲɔnmɛ wule falɛe bɛ, naxee wule laamatunyie nun wule masenyie xa fe falama. E mu luma n ma ɲama kuntigie ya ma, e xili bama nɛ Isirayila xa taruxui kui, e mu soma Isirayila bɔxi ma sɔnɔn. Na kui wo a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: Because, even because they have been guiding my people into error, saying, Peace; when there is no peace; and in the building of a division wall they put whitewash on it:
sentences.susu: «E to fa na n ma ɲama ralɔɛfe nɛ na ki a falafe ra, ‹Wo bɔɲɛ xa sa,› kɔnɔ a fa li gbaloe na na. E tɛtɛ kobi nan ti, e fa a pɛnti a fiixɛ ra.

sentences.english: Say to those who put whitewash on it, There will be an overflowing shower; and you, O ice-drops, will come raining down; and it will be broken in two by the storm-wind.
sentences.susu: A fala e bɛ na tɛtɛ birama nɛ. Turunnaadɛ nun tunɛ xungbe na fa, balabalanyi goroma nɛ.

sentences.english: And when the wall has come down, will they not say to you, Where is the whitewash which you put on it?
sentences.susu: Na tɛtɛ na bira, a mu falama xɛ wo bɛ, ‹Wo mu a pɛntixi xɛ? Munse fa niyaxi?›»

sentences.english: For this reason, the Lord has said: I will have it broken in two by a storm-wind in my passion; and there will be an overflowing shower in my wrath, and you, O ice-drops, will come raining angrily down.
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: ‹N turunnaadɛ xungbe radinma nɛ wo ma n ma xɔnɛ kui, tunɛ belebele nun balabalanyi sinma nɛ wo ma sɛnbɛ ra, a kasarɛ ti.

sentences.english: So I will let the wall, which you were covering with whitewash, be broken down; I will have it levelled to the earth so that its base is uncovered: it will come down, and destruction will come on you with it; and it will be clear to you that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: N tɛtɛ rabirama nɛ, wo naxan pɛntixi, n a sanbunyi maba. A na bira wo ma, wo faxa a bun ma. Na tɛmui, wo a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.

sentences.english: So I will let loose my passion on the wall in full measure, and on those who put whitewash on it; and I will say to you, Where is the wall, and where are those who put whitewash on it?
sentences.susu: N na n ma xɔnɛ birin naminima nɛ na tɛtɛ ma, nun mixi naxee a pɛntixi. N a falama nɛ wo bɛ, Tɛtɛ mu na sɔnɔn, naxee fan a pɛntixi, nee fan mu na sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Even the prophets of Israel who say words to Jerusalem, who see visions of peace for her when there is no peace, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Nee findixi na namiɲɔnmɛ wule falɛe nan na, naxee nu wɔyɛnma Darisalamu xa fe ra, a bɔɲɛsa xa fe fala e bɛ, a fa li gbaloe nan tun nu na fafe e ma. Alatala xui nan na ki.›»

sentences.english: And you, son of man, let your face be turned against the daughters of your people, who are acting the part of prophets at their pleasure; be a prophet against them, and say,
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi adamadi, i ya rafindi i xa ɲama xa ginɛ dimɛdie ma, naxee namiɲɔnmɛ masenyi tima e yɛtɛ bɔɲɛ ma fe ma. I xa masenyi ti e xili ma,

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: A curse is on the women who are stitching bands on all arms and putting veils on the heads of those of every size, so that they may go after souls! Will you go after the souls of my people and keep yourselves safe from death?
sentences.susu: a falafe ra, ‹Alatala yi nan masenxi e bɛ, «Ɲaxankatɛ na ginɛe bɛ naxee bɛlɛxɛkɔnnasoe yailanma karafili ra, xa na mu a ra e mafelenyie yailan mixi ratantanfe ra. Wo a maɲɔxunxi nɛ a wo na n ma mixie ratantan, wo mu tɔɔrɛ sɔtɔma na kui?

sentences.english: And you have put me to shame among my people for a little barley and some bits of bread, sending death on souls for whom there is no cause of death, and keeping those souls living who have no right to life, by the false words you say to my people who give ear to what is false.
sentences.susu: Wo bara n mabere donse di xa fe ra. Wo to wule fala n ma ɲama bɛ naxan a tuli matima wule ra, wo bara mixi faxa naxan mu nu lanma a xa faxa, wo bara mixi lu naa naxan mu nu lanma a xa lu naa.»›»

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord has said: See, I am against your bands with which you go after souls, and I will violently take them off their arms; and I will let loose the souls, even the souls whom you go after freely.
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: ‹Wo xa karafilie mu rafan n ma, wo mixi ratantanma naxan na alɔ gantanyi sama xɔnie bɛ ki naxɛ. N na karafilie bama nɛ wo bɛlɛxɛe ra, n xɔrɛya fima nɛ mixi ma wo naxan suxu gantanyi kui alɔ xɔnie.

sentences.english: And I will have your veils violently parted in two, and will make my people free from your hands, and they will no longer be in your power for you to go after them; and you will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: N wo xa mafelenyie bama nɛ wo ma, n na n ma ɲama ba wo xa nɔɛ bun ma. Na kui wo a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.

sentences.english: Because with your false words you have given pain to the heart of the upright man when I had not made him sad; in order to make strong the hands of the evil-doer so that he may not be turned from his evil way and get life:
sentences.susu: Wo bara limaniya ba tinxintɔɛe yi ra wo xa wulee ra, n nu wama naxan malife. Wo bara tinxintare rasi e xa lu e xa fe ɲaaxie kui, n nu wama naxan nakisife.

sentences.english: For this cause you will see no more foolish visions or make false use of secret arts: and I will make my people free from your power; and you will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo to na mɔɔli raba, wo mu wule masenyi tife sɔnɔn, wo mu luma sematoe xa wali kui. N fama nɛ n ma ɲama ratangade wo bɛlɛxɛ. Na kui wo a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: Then certain of the responsible men of Israel came to me and took their seats before me.
sentences.susu: Isirayila fori ndee naxa fa n xɔnyi. E to dɔxɔ,

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, these men have taken their false gods into their hearts and put before their faces the sin which is the cause of their fall: am I to give ear when they come to me for directions?
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, yi mixie bara kuyee fe tongo e a sa e nii ra, e fe ɲaaxie suxu naxee e rabirama. A lanma n xa tin e xa n maxandi?

sentences.english: For this cause say to them, These are the words of the Lord: Every man of Israel who has taken his false god into his heart, and put before his face the sin which is the cause of his fall, and comes to the prophet; I the Lord will give him an answer by myself in agreement with the number of his false gods;
sentences.susu: A fala e bɛ, ‹Wo Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Isirayilaka naxan yo kuye fe sa a nii ra, a fe ɲaaxi suxu naxan a rabirama, a na siga namiɲɔnmɛ yire Ala maxandide, n a xa duba mafindima a xa yunubi raba xasabi nan ma.

sentences.english: So as to take the children of Israel in the thoughts of their hearts, because they have become strange to me through their false gods.
sentences.susu: N yi rabama nɛ alako n xa Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ bɔɲɛ rafindi n ma, hali e to bara e makuya n na e xa kuye batufe ra.›»

sentences.english: For this cause say to the children of Israel, These are the words of the Lord: Come back and give up your false gods and let your faces be turned from your disgusting things.
sentences.susu: «A fala Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ bɛ, ‹Wo Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Wo tuubi, wo gbilen wo xa kuye batufe fɔxɔ ra, wo wo kobe so wo xa fe ɲaaxie ra!

sentences.english: When any one of the men of Israel, or of those from other lands who are living in Israel, who has become strange to me, and takes his false gods into his heart, and puts before his face the sin which is the cause of his fall, comes to the prophet to get directions from me; I the Lord will give him an answer by myself:
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae birin, xa na mu a ra wo xa xɔɲɛe, mixi yo naxan kuye fe sama a nii ra, a fe ɲaaxi suxu naxan a rabirama, na kanyi na siga namiɲɔnmɛ yire n maxandife ra, n tan Alatala yati fama na kanyi yaabide.

sentences.english: And my face will be turned against that man, and I will make him a sign and a common saying, cutting him off from among my people; and you will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: N tima nɛ a kanke, n a findima misaali nan na ɲama bɛ, a xili findi konbi ra e ya ma. N a kerima nɛ n ma ɲama ya ma. Na kui wo a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: And if the prophet, tricked by deceit, says anything, it is I the Lord by whom he has been tricked, and I will put out my hand against him, and he will be cut off from among my people Israel.
sentences.susu: «Xa na namiɲɔnmɛ fa tin masenyi falade n xili ra, n tan yati bara a madaxu a xa na raba. Na kui n na n bɛlɛxɛ itala a xili ma, n a xa fe xun nakana n ma ɲama Isirayila ya ma.

sentences.english: And the punishment of their sin will be on them: the sin of the prophet will be the same as the sin of him who goes to him for directions;
sentences.susu: E bara yunubi sɔtɔ na kui, namiɲɔnmɛ yo, nun mixi yo naxan maxandi tima a saabui ra.

sentences.english: So that the children of Israel may no longer go wandering away from me, or make themselves unclean with all their wrongdoing; but they will be my people, and I will be their God, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ mu luma e makuya ra n na, e sɛniyɛntareɲa bɛɲinma nɛ. E findima nɛ n ma ɲama ra, n fan findi e Marigi Ala ra. Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, when a land, sinning against me, does wrong, and my hand is stretched out against it, and the support of its bread is broken, and I make it short of food, cutting off man and beast from it:
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, xa ɲama nde n bɛɲin e xa yunubie xa fe ra, n fama nɛ n bɛlɛxɛ italade e xili ma, n e xa baloe ɲɔn, n kaamɛ radin e ma, n e xa mixie nun e xa xurusee faxa.

sentences.english: Even if these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, only themselves would they keep safe by their righteousness, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Hali Annabi Nuha, Annabi Daniyɛli, nun Annabi Ayuba nu na e ya ma nu, ɲama nɔma kiside e xa tinxinyi gbansan nan saabui ra. Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: Or if I send evil beasts through the land causing destruction and making it waste, so that no man may go through because of the beasts:
sentences.susu: «Xa n sube xaaɲɛe radin na bɔxi ma e xa dimɛe faxa, mixi birin xa keli naa na subee xa fe ra,

sentences.english: Even if these three men were in it, by my life, says the Lord, they would not keep safe their sons or daughters, but only themselves, and the land would be made waste.
sentences.susu: hali na namiɲɔnmɛ saxan sa lu naa, n tan wo Marigi Alatala bara n kali, ɲama mu nɔma e xa die rakiside. Na namiɲɔnmɛe gbansan nan kisima, bɔxikae tan lɔɛ.»

sentences.english: Or if I send a sword against that land, and say, Sword, go through the land, cutting off from it man and beast:
sentences.susu: «Xa n gere rabula na bɔxi ma, n fa a fala ‹Santidɛgɛma xa be kana,› n fa a niya na bɔxikae nun e xa xurusee birin xa sɔntɔ,

sentences.english: Even if these three men were in it, by my life, says the Lord, they would not keep safe their sons or daughters, but only themselves.
sentences.susu: hali na namiɲɔnmɛ saxan sa lu naa, n tan wo Marigi Alatala bara n kali, ɲama mu nɔma e xa die rakiside. Na namiɲɔnmɛe gbansan nan kisima.»

sentences.english: Or if I send disease into that land, letting loose my wrath on it in blood, cutting off from it man and beast:
sentences.susu: «Xa n wuganyi radin na bɔxi ma e xa mixi birin nun e xa xurusee faxa fe ra n ma xɔnɛ xa fe ma,

sentences.english: Even if Noah, Daniel, and Job were in it, by my life, says the Lord, they would not keep son or daughter safe; only themselves would they keep safe through their righteousness.
sentences.susu: hali Annabi Nuha, Annabi Daniyɛli, nun Annabi Ayuba sa lu naa, n tan wo Marigi Alatala bara n kali, ɲama mu nɔma e xa die rakiside. Ɲama nɔma kiside e xa tinxinyi gbansan nan saabui ra.»

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord has said: How much more when I send my four bitter punishments on Jerusalem, the sword and need of food and evil beasts and disease, cutting off from it man and beast?
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Wo xa fe xɔrɔxɔma nɛ dangife na tan na n na n ma kasarɛ naani ti wo bɛ, naxee findixi gere, kaamɛ, sube xaaɲɛe, nun wuganyi ra. Na birin wo xa mixie nun wo xa xurusee sɔntɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: But truly, there will still be a small band who will be safe, even sons and daughters: and they will come out to you, and you will see their ways and their doings: and you will be comforted about the evil which I have sent on Jerusalem, even about everything I have sent on it.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo xa di ndee fama nɛ ratangade na ma. E fama nɛ wo yire, wo fa sɛɛwa e ɲɛrɛ ki matofe ra, wo fa madundu gbaloe xa fe ra n naxan nagirixi Darisalamu ma.

sentences.english: They will give you comfort when you see their ways and their doings: and you will be certain that not for nothing have I done all the things I have done in it, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo madundui sɔtɔma nɛ e ɲɛrɛ ki matofe ra, barima wo fama nɛ a kolonde a n na birin naba fe nde nan ma. Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ:

sentences.english: Son of man, what is the vine-tree more than any branching tree which is among the trees of the woods?
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, wɛni bili fan fɔtɔnyi wuri salonyi bɛ?

sentences.english: Will its wood be used for any work? do men make of it a pin for hanging any vessel on?
sentences.susu: Wɛni bili wuri rawalima a xa findi se gbaku se ra, xa na mu a ra se gbɛtɛ naxan tide na na?

sentences.english: See, it is put into the fire for burning: the fire has made a meal of its two ends and the middle part of it is burned; is it good for any work?
sentences.susu: Na wuri mɔɔli na gan, keli a xunyi ma han a sa dɔxɔ a xɔrɛ ra, a nɔma rawalide se nde ra fa?

sentences.english: Truly, before it was cut down, it was not used for any purpose: how much less, when the fire has made a meal of it and it is burned, will it be made into anything?
sentences.susu: Xa a mu nu nɔma rawalide se nde ra a to nu sixi, a na gan, tide yo mu luma a ma sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord has said: Like the vine-tree among the trees of the woods which I have given to the fire for burning, so will I give the people of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: «Na kui, wo Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: N fe rabama nɛ Darisalamukae ra, alɔ n fe naxan naba na wɛni bili wuri ra n naxan ganxi.

sentences.english: And my face will be turned against them; and though they have come out of the fire they will be burned up by it; and it will be clear to you that I am the Lord when my face is turned against them.
sentences.susu: N tima nɛ e kanke. Hali e mini tɛ i, na tɛ fanma e donde. N na ti e kanke ma, wo a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.

sentences.english: And I will make the land a waste because they have done evil, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N e xa bɔxi xun nakanama nɛ, barima e bara n yanfa. Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti n bɛ, a naxɛ:

sentences.english: Son of man, make clear to Jerusalem her disgusting ways,
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, Darisalamu rakolon a xa fe kobie ra.

sentences.english: And say, This is what the Lord has said to Jerusalem: Your start and your birth was from the land of the Canaanite; an Amorite was your father and your mother was a Hittite.
sentences.susu: A fala a bɛ, ‹I Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: I barixi Kanaan bɔxi nan ma, Amorika nan nu na i baba ra, i nga findixi Xitika nan na.

sentences.english: As for your birth, on the day of your birth your cord was not cut and you were not washed in water to make you clean; you were not salted or folded in linen bands.
sentences.susu: I barixi lɔxɔɛ naxɛ, mixi yo mu wo furixuli xaba, e mu i maxa ye nun fɔxɛ ra alako i xa sɛniyɛn, e mu i mafilin dugi kui.

sentences.english: No eye had pity on you to do any of these things to you or to be kind to you; but you were put out into the open country, because your life was hated at the time of your birth.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu kinikini i ma na fe mɔɔli rabafe ra. E i wɔli burunyi, barima i nu maɲaaxin birin bɛ.›»

sentences.english: And when I went past you and saw you stretched out in your blood, I said to you, Though you are stretched out in your blood, have life;
sentences.susu: «N nu na dangife i yire tɛmui naxɛ, n naxa i to i na i nii magagafe i saxi wuli xɔɔra. N naxa a fala i bɛ, ‹I xa kisi.›

sentences.english: And be increased in number like the buds of the field; and you were increased and became great, and you came to the time of love: your breasts were formed and your hair was long; but you were uncovered and without clothing.
sentences.susu: N naxa i ramɔ alɔ sansi mɔma ki naxɛ. I bara findi ginɛdimɛdi tofanyi ra. I fate bara mɔ, i xunsɛxɛ bara kuya, kɔnɔ han na tɛmui dugi mu nu ragoroxi i ma. I mageli nan nu a ra.»

sentences.english: Now when I went past you, looking at you, I saw that your time was the time of love; and I put my skirts over you, covering your unclothed body: and I gave you my oath and made an agreement with you, says the Lord, and you became mine.
sentences.susu: «Tɛmui nde to dangi, n naxa a to i findixi sungbutunyi ra. Na kui n naxa n ma dugi sanbunyi felen i ma i suturafe ra, a findi saatɛ ra won tagi. Na kui i findixi n tan nan gbe ra, i Marigi Alatala.»

sentences.english: Then I had you washed with water, washing away all your blood and rubbing you with oil.
sentences.susu: «N naxa i maxa ye ra, n wuli ba i ma, n fa ture xiri fanyi so i ma.

sentences.english: And I had you clothed with needlework, and put leather shoes on your feet, folding fair linen about you and covering you with silk.
sentences.susu: N naxa dugi fanyi dɛgɛ i bɛ, n na ragoro i ma. N naxan sankiri fanyi so i sanyi.

sentences.english: And I made you fair with ornaments and put jewels on your hands and a chain on your neck.
sentences.susu: N naxa i raxunma bɛlɛxɛ rasoe nun kɔnmagore ra.

sentences.english: And I put a ring in your nose and ear-rings in your ears and a beautiful crown on your head.
sentences.susu: N naxa xurundɛ sa i ɲɔɛ ra, n tulirasoe sa i tulie ra, n mangɛ tɔnxuma dusu i xun na.

sentences.english: So you were made beautiful with gold and silver; and your clothing was of the best linen and silk and needlework; your food was the best meal and honey and oil: and you were very beautiful.
sentences.susu: I nu raxunmaxi xɛɛma nun gbeti nan na, i nu maxirixi dugi tofanyie nan na, i nu donse fanyi donma naxan findi kumi nun ture ra. I xa tofanyi xun nu fa masa tun, mangɛya naxa radaxa i bɛ.

sentences.english: You were so beautiful that the story of you went out into all nations; you were completely beautiful because of my glory which I had put on you, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: I xili naxa din ɲamanɛe ra i xa tofanyi xa fe ra, barima tofanyi kamalixi nan nu a ra i xa nɔrɛ saabui ra n naxan fixi i ma. Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: But you put your faith in the fact that you were beautiful, acting like a loose woman because you were widely talked of, and offering your cheap love to everyone who went by, whoever it might be.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ na tɛmui i naxa la fɔlɔ i xa tofanyi nun i xili fanyi ra, i fa so langoeɲa rabafe. I nu i yɛtɛ soma mixi birin yi ra, i lu e sagoe.

sentences.english: And you took your robes and made high places for yourself ornamented with every colour, acting like a loose woman on them, without shame or fear.
sentences.susu: I naxa i xa dugi tofanyie itala geya fari i langoeɲa raba dɛnnaxɛ. Na fe mɔɔli mu lanma feo. Na rabafe mu fan.

sentences.english: And you took the fair jewels, my silver and gold which I had given to you, and made for yourself male images, acting like a loose woman with them;
sentences.susu: I naxa i xa xunmase xɛɛma nun gbeti daaxie tongo, n naxee fixi i ma, i e yailan kuye xɛmɛe ra, i fa langoeɲa raba nee ra.

sentences.english: And you took your robes of needlework for their clothing, and put my oil and my perfume before them.
sentences.susu: I naxa i xa dugi tofanyie ragoro e ma, i fa n ma ture nun n ma surayi ba sɛrɛxɛ ra e bɛ.

sentences.english: And my bread which I gave you, the best meal and oil and honey which I gave you for your food, you put it before them for a sweet smell, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N donse naxan so i yi ra, i bara na taami fanyi, na ture, nun na kumi birin ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra e bɛ. I na nan nabaxi. Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And you took your sons and your daughters whom I had by you, offering even these to them to be their food. Was your loose behaviour so small a thing,
sentences.susu: «I naxa i xa die tongo, n naxee fixi i ma, i e fan ba sɛrɛxɛ ra na kuyee bɛ. I xa langoeɲa mu nu i wasama nu?

sentences.english: That you put my children to death and gave them up to go through the fire to them?
sentences.susu: I bara n ma die kɔn naxaba, i e ba sɛrɛxɛ ra kuyee bɛ!

sentences.english: And in all your disgusting and false behaviour you had no memory of your early days, when you were uncovered and without clothing, stretched out in your blood.
sentences.susu: I xa fe kobie nun i xa langoeɲa birin kui, i mu ratu a ma n naxan nabaxi i bɛ i mageli to nu a ra, i nu i nii magagafe i wuli xɔɔra tɛmui naxɛ?»

sentences.english: And it came about, after all your evil-doing, says the Lord,
sentences.susu: «Ɲaxankatɛ na i bɛ! Alatala xui nan na ki. Safe i xa wali ɲaaxi xun ma, i bara fe gbɛtɛ fan naba.

sentences.english: That you made for yourself an arched room in every open place.
sentences.susu: I bara yiree ti taa tagi kira dɛ ra,

sentences.english: You put up your high places at the top of every street, and made the grace of your form a disgusting thing, opening your feet to everyone who went by, increasing your loose ways.
sentences.susu: i fa i fate xa tofanyi masen ɲama bɛ kɛnɛ ma, alɔ langoe naxan wama xɛmɛ mabɛndunfe a ma.

sentences.english: And you went with the Egyptians, your neighbours, great of flesh; increasing your loose ways, moving me to wrath.
sentences.susu: I bara langoeɲa raba Misirakae ra, i dɔxɔboore naxee xa ginɛ fe xɔrɔxɔ. I xa langoeɲa radangixi bara n naxɔnɔ.

sentences.english: Now, then, my hand is stretched out against you, cutting down your fixed amount, and I have given you up to the desire of your haters, the daughters of the Philistines who are shamed by your loose ways.
sentences.susu: Na kui n bara n bɛlɛxɛ itala i xili ma, n fa nde ba i xa bɔxi ra, n a sa i yaxuie Filisitakae sagoe, i xa wali kobie xa fe ra naxee bara e ratɛrɛnna.

sentences.english: And you went with the Assyrians, because of your desire which was without measure; you were acting like a loose woman with them, and still you had not enough.
sentences.susu: I bara langoeɲa raba Asiriyakae fan na, barima sese mu i wasama.

sentences.english: And you went on in your loose ways, even as far as the land of Chaldaea, and still you had not enough.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi i bara langoeɲa raba Babilɔn yulɛe ra, kɔnɔ nee fan mu i wasa.»

sentences.english: How feeble is your heart, says the Lord, seeing that you do all these things, the work of a loose and overruling woman;
sentences.susu: «I bɔɲɛ kobi! Alatala xui nan na ki. I yi langoeɲa mɔɔli rabama di?

sentences.english: For you have made your arched room at the top of every street, and your high place in every open place; though you were not like a loose woman in getting together your payment.
sentences.susu: I to i xa langoe yiree ti taa kui kira dɛ ra, i mu nu luxi alɔ langoe yati barima i nu langoeɲa rabafe nɛ tun kɔbiri xanbi!»

sentences.english: The untrue wife who takes strange lovers in place of her husband!
sentences.susu: «Yɛnɛ ginɛ, xɔɲɛe rafan i ma dangife i xa mɔri ra.

sentences.english: They give payment to all loose women: but you give rewards to your lovers, offering them payment so that they may come to you on every side for your cheap love.
sentences.susu: Langoe birin wama langoe sare xɔn, kɔnɔ i tan nan luma i ɲɛngɛe ki ra, alako i xa e mabɛndun i ma a mɔɔli birin na.

sentences.english: And in your loose behaviour you are different from other women, for no one goes after you to make love to you: and because you give payment and no payment is given to you, in this you are different from them.
sentences.susu: I mu luxi alɔ langoe gbɛtɛe. Mixi yo mu i mayandima i xa wali ra. I tan nan e mayandima, i fa e sare fi, i mu se sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: For this cause, O loose woman, give ear to the voice of the Lord:
sentences.susu: «I tan langoe ginɛ, i tuli mati Alatala xa masenyi ra!

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: Because your unclean behaviour was let loose and your body uncovered in your loose ways with your lovers and with your disgusting images, and for the blood of your children which you gave to them;
sentences.susu: I Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: I to i xa naafuli ba alako i xa langoeɲa raba i ɲɛngɛe ra, i to kuyee mɔɔli birin ti, i fa i xa die wuli ba sɛrɛxɛ ra e bɛ,

sentences.english: For this cause I will get together all your lovers with whom you have taken your pleasure, and all those to whom you have given your love, with all those who were hated by you; I will even make them come together against you on every side, and I will have you uncovered before them so that they may see your shame.
sentences.susu: n fama nɛ i ɲɛngɛe birin malande, naxee nu rafan i ma nun naxee mu nu rafan i ma, n i ɲaibɔɛ masen e bɛ a kɛnɛ ma, i xa yaagi.

sentences.english: And you will be judged by me as women are judged who have been untrue to their husbands and have taken life; and I will let loose against you passion and bitter feeling.
sentences.susu: N i makiitima nɛ alɔ ginɛ yɛnɛla nun faxɛti makiitima ki naxɛ. N nan n gbe ɲɔxɔma nɛ i ma n ma xɔnɛ nun n ma tɔɔnɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: I will give you into their hands, and your arched room will be overturned and your high places broken down; they will take your clothing off you and take away your fair jewels: and when they have done, you will be uncovered and shamed.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n i sama nɛ i ɲɛngɛe sagoe, e i xa langoe yiree kana, e i xa dugie nun i xa xunmasee ba i ma, e fa i lu i mageli ra fɔɛn.

sentences.english: And they will get together a meeting against you, stoning you with stones and wounding you with their swords.
sentences.susu: E e malanma nɛ i xili ma, e i magɔnɔ gɛmɛe ra, e i masɔxɔ e xa santidɛgɛmae ra.

sentences.english: And they will have you burned with fire, sending punishments on you before the eyes of great numbers of women; and I will put an end to your loose ways, and you will no longer give payment.
sentences.susu: E i xa banxie ganma nɛ, e i ɲaxankata ginɛ gbegbe ya xɔri. N i xa langoeɲa danma nɛ, i mu i ɲɛngɛe kima sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And the heat of my wrath against you will have an end, and my bitter feeling will be turned away from you, and I will be quiet and will be angry no longer.
sentences.susu: N na gɛ na rabade i ra, n ma xɔnɛ goroma nɛ i xa yanfanteya xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: Because you have not kept in mind the days when you were young, but have been troubling me with all these things; for this reason I will make the punishment of your ways come on your head, says the Lord, because you have done this evil thing in addition to all your disgusting acts.
sentences.susu: «N fama nɛ i xa wali sare birin nagbilende i ma, barima i mu i ratu i fonike tɛmui ma. I Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki. I mu langoeɲa xa sa i xa fe kobi gbɛtɛe fari?»

sentences.english: See, in every common saying about you it will be said, As the mother is, so is her daughter.
sentences.susu: «Taali falɛe fama yi taali falade i xun ma, ‹Nga lu ki yo ki, a xa di ginɛ fan luma na ki nɛ!›

sentences.english: You are the daughter of your mother whose soul is turned in disgust from her husband and her children; and you are the sister of your sisters who were turned in disgust from their husbands and their children: your mother was a Hittite and your father an Amorite.
sentences.susu: I nga xa di yati nan i ra, naxan mɛ a xa mɔri nun a xa die ra. I taara ginɛmae fan mɛ nɛ e xa mɔrie ra, nun e xa die ra. I nga findixi Xitika nan na, i baba findixi Amorika nan na.

sentences.english: Your older sister is Samaria, living at your left hand, she and her daughters: and your younger sister, living at your right hand, is Sodom and her daughters.
sentences.susu: Samari findixi i taara ginɛma nan na naxan sabatixi i kɔɔla ma, a nun a xa taa gbɛtɛe kui. Sodoma nan findixi i xunya ginɛma ra naxan sabatixi i yirefanyi ma, a nun a xa taa gbɛtɛe ra.

sentences.english: Still you have not gone in their ways or done the disgusting things which they have done; but, as if that was only a little thing, you have gone deeper in evil than they in all your ways.
sentences.susu: I bara bira e xa wali ɲaaxi fɔxɔ ra, i man bara ɲaaxu dangife e tan na.

sentences.english: By my life, says the Lord, Sodom your sister never did, she or her daughters, what you and your daughters have done.
sentences.susu: N bara n kali, Sodoma nun a xa taae mu i xa ɲaaxuɲa lixi. Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: Truly, this was the sin of your sister Sodom: pride, a full measure of food, and the comforts of wealth in peace, were seen in her and her daughters, and she gave no help to the poor or to those in need.
sentences.susu: «I xunya Sodoma xa yunubie findixi yi nan na: yɛtɛ igboɲa, bannaya, nun kinikinitareɲa tɔɔrɔmixie mabiri.

sentences.english: They were full of pride and did what was disgusting to me: and so I took them away as you have seen.
sentences.susu: E dɛ igbo, e fe ɲaaxie rabama n ya xɔri. Na kui, n naxa e xa fe ɲɔn!

sentences.english: And Samaria has not done half your sins; but you have made the number of your disgusting acts greater than theirs, making your sisters seem more upright than you by all the disgusting things which you have done.
sentences.susu: Samari mu yunubi raba alɔ i tan. I xa fe kobi raba gbo dangi a gbe ra pon! Na taa ɲaaxi tinxin i bɛ.

sentences.english: And you yourself will be put to shame, in that you have given the decision for your sisters; through your sins, which are more disgusting than theirs, they are more upright than you: truly, you will be shamed and made low, for you have made your sisters seem upright.
sentences.susu: I xa yaagi tun! I xa ɲaaxuɲa kui, a luxi nɛ alɔ i xunyae na fisa i bɛ. I xa na kote xanin.»

sentences.english: And I will let their fate be changed, the fate of Sodom and her daughters, and the fate of Samaria and her daughters, and your fate with theirs.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ a raɲɔnyi, n fama nɛ Sodoma nun a xa taae nun Samari nun a xa taae xa fe xun nakelide. I fan luma nɛ na xunnakeli kui.

sentences.english: So that you will be shamed and made low because of all you have done, when I have mercy on you.
sentences.susu: I bara yaagi sɔtɔ i xa wali kobi xa fe ra. Na bara a niya Sodoma nun Samari xili xa fan dondoronti.

sentences.english: And your sisters, Sodom and her daughters, will go back to their first condition, and Samaria and her daughters will go back to their first condition, and you and your daughters will go back to your first condition.
sentences.susu: I xunya Sodoma nun a xa taae nun i taara Samari nun a xa taae xun nakelima nɛ alɔ singe. I fan nun i xa taae luma na xunnakeli nan kui.

sentences.english: Was not your sister Sodom an oath in your mouth in the day of your pride,
sentences.susu: I nu i yɛtɛ igboma tɛmui naxɛ, i mu tin fe fanyi falade i xunya Sodoma xa fe ra,

sentences.english: Before your shame was uncovered? Now you have become like her a word of shame to the daughters of Edom and all who are round about you, the daughters of the Philistines who put shame on you round about.
sentences.susu: beenun i xa ɲaaxuɲa xa sa kɛnɛ ma. Yakɔsi Edon nun a xa taae nun Filisita nun a xa taae, e birin i maberema.

sentences.english: The reward of your evil designs and your disgusting ways has come on you, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na langoeɲa nun fe kobie yaagi luma nɛ i ma. Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord has said: I will do to you as you have done, you who, putting the oath on one side, have let the agreement be broken.
sentences.susu: «I Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: N i sare ragbilenma nɛ i ma sɛriyɛ ki ma, barima i bara n ma kali mabere n ma saatɛ kanafe ra.

sentences.english: But still I will keep in mind the agreement made with you in the days when you were young, and I will make with you an eternal agreement.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n tan mu nɛɛmuma won ma saatɛ ma, won naxan tongo i fonike tɛmui. N fama nɛ saatɛ tongode i bɛ naxan mu ɲɔnma abadan.

sentences.english: Then at the memory of your ways you will be overcome with shame, when I take your sisters, the older and the younger, and give them to you for daughters, but not by your agreement.
sentences.susu: Na kui, i taara nun i xunya na gbilen i ma, i ratuma nɛ i xa kira ɲaaxi ma yaagi ra. N e fima nɛ i ma, kɔnɔ na fe mu na won ma saatɛ singe kui.

sentences.english: And I will make my agreement with you; and you will be certain that I am the Lord:
sentences.susu: N saatɛ tongoma nɛ i bɛ, i a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.

sentences.english: So that, at the memory of these things, you may be at a loss, never opening your mouth because of your shame; when you have my forgiveness for all you have done, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N na gɛ i xun sarade i xa yunubie xa fe ra, i fama nɛ ratude fe dangixie ma yaagi kui, i fa i dɛ ragali i xa yaagi xa fe ra. Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, give out a dark saying, and make a comparison for the children of Israel,
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i xa yi taali fala Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: And say, This is what the Lord has said: A great eagle with great wings, full of long feathers of different colours, came to Lebanon, and took the top of the cedar:
sentences.susu: A fala e bɛ, ‹Won Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: Sɛgɛ xungbe, gabutenyi sɛnbɛmae, xabe kuye tofanxie, naxa fa Liban, a sɛdiri bili salonyi bolon a kɔn na.

sentences.english: Biting off the highest of its young branches, he took it to the land of Canaan, and put it in a town of traders.
sentences.susu: A naxa na xanin yulɛ bɔxi ma, a a si e xa taa kui.›»

sentences.english: And he took some of the seed of the land, planting it in fertile earth, placing it by great waters; he put it in like a willow-tree.
sentences.susu: «A naxa sansi xɔri nde tongo Isirayila bɔxi ma, a sa na si bɔxi fanyi ma, ye gboxi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And its growth went on and it became a vine, low and widely stretching, whose branches were turned to him and its roots were under him: so it became a vine, putting out branches and young leaves.
sentences.susu: Na sansi xɔri naxa bula, a findi wɛni sansi dunke ra naxan salonyie nu kuyama a gbe ra. A salonyie nu fa e ramaxa koore ma, a sanke nu goro ye fenfe ra. Na sansie naxa fan, a salonyie naxa wuya a burɛxɛe naxa fan.»

sentences.english: And there was another eagle with great wings and thick feathers: and now this vine, pushing out its roots to him, sent out its branches in his direction from the bed where it was planted, so that he might give it water.
sentences.susu: «Sɛgɛ xungbe gbɛtɛ naxa mini naa ra, a gabutenyie xungbo, a xabee wuya. Wɛni bili naxa a sankee nun a salonyie raɲɛrɛ kelife bɔxi ma a nu sixi dɛnnaxɛ, sigafe ra sɛgɛ mabiri ye sɔtɔfe ra.

sentences.english: He had it planted in a good field by great waters so that it might put out branches and have fruit and be a strong vine.
sentences.susu: A nu sixi bɔxi fanyi nan ma, ye gbegbe nu na dɛnnaxɛ, alako a xa findi a ra, a wɛni bogi fanyi ramini.»

sentences.english: Say, This is what the Lord has said: Will it do well? will he not have its roots pulled up and its branches cut off, so that all its young leaves may become dry and it may be pulled up by its roots?
sentences.susu: «A fala e bɛ, ‹Won Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: Na wɛni bili fanma? A mu fama a italade, a bogi bira, a xara? A salonyie nun a burɛxɛ kanama nɛ. A italafe mu xɔrɔxɔ.

sentences.english: And if it is planted will it do well? will it not become quite dry at the touch of the east wind, drying up in the bed where it was planted?
sentences.susu: Hali a itala, a si yire gbɛtɛ, foye naxan kelima sogetede mabiri a mu a xarama xɛ gbiki?›»

sentences.english: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Say now to this uncontrolled people, Are these things not clear to you? Say to them, See, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and took its king and its rulers away with him to Babylon;
sentences.susu: «A fala yi bɔnsɔɛ murutaxi bɛ, ‹Wo mu na taali fahaamuxi? Babilɔn mangɛ bara siga Darisalamu, a naa mangɛ nun a kuntigie suxu, a e xanin Babilɔn.

sentences.english: And he took one of the sons of the king and made an agreement with him; and he put him under an oath, and took away the great men of the land:
sentences.susu: A bara mixi keren sugandi mangɛ bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, a saatɛ xiri a nun na tagi, a a ti mangɛya ra kali ra. A man bara bɔxi kuntigie tan xanin,

sentences.english: So that the kingdom might be made low with no power of lifting itself up, but might keep his agreement to be his servants.
sentences.susu: alako bɔxi sɛnbɛ xa xurun, han a mu nɔ a ikelide sɔnɔn, fo a nu saatɛ rabatu tun.›»

sentences.english: But he went against his authority in sending representatives to Egypt to get from them horses and a great army. Will he do well? will he be safe who does such things? if the agreement is broken will he be safe?
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ na mangɛ sugandixi fan naxa muruta, a xɛɛrae rasiga Misira mangɛ ma soee nun sɔɔrie fende. Na fe mɔɔli sɔɔnɛyama? Naxan matandi tima na ki, a mu tɔɔrɔma yare?

sentences.english: By my life, says the Lord, truly in the place of the king who made him king, whose oath he put on one side and let his agreement with him be broken, even in Babylon he will come to his death.
sentences.susu: N bara n kali, n tan Alatala nan xui a ra, a faxama Babilɔn bɔxi nan ma, mangɛ fɛ ma naxan mangɛya soxi a yi ra, a naxan xa saatɛ maberexi, a a kana.

sentences.english: And Pharaoh with his strong army and great forces will be no help to him in the war, when they put up earthworks and make strong walls for the cutting off of lives:
sentences.susu: Misira mangɛ mu nɔma a malide gere kui, a yaxuie see yailanma taa tɛtɛ kanafe ra tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: For he put his oath on one side in letting the agreement be broken; and though he had given his hand to it, he did all these things; he will not get away safe.
sentences.susu: A to a xa kali mabere saatɛ kanafe ra, a fama nɛ na sare sɔtɔde.»

sentences.english: And so the Lord has said, By my life, truly, for my oath which he put on one side, and my agreement which has been broken, I will send punishment on his head.
sentences.susu: Na xa fe ra, Alatala yi nan masenxi, a naxɛ, «N bara n kali n yɛtɛ ra, a to n ma kali mabere, a to n ma saatɛ kana, n na sare ragbilenma nɛ a ma.

sentences.english: My net will be stretched out over him, and he will be taken in my cords, and I will send him to Babylon, and there I will be his judge for the wrong which he has done against me.
sentences.susu: N na n ma yɛlɛ italama nɛ a ya ra, n a suxu n ma gantanyi ra. N a xaninma nɛ Babilɔn bɔxi ma, n fa a ɲaxankata a xa yanfanteya xa fe ra mɛnni, a naxan nabaxi n na.

sentences.english: All his best fighting-men will be put to the sword, and the rest will be sent away to every wind: and you will be certain that I the Lord have said it.
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔrie sɔntɔma nɛ santidɛgɛma ra, mixi dɔnxɔɛ yensenma nɛ. Wo a kolonma nɛ na kui a n tan Alatala nan na natɛ tongoxi.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: Further, I will take the highest top of the cedar and put it in the earth; cutting off from the highest of his young branches a soft one, I will have it planted on a high and great mountain;
sentences.susu: Won Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, a naxɛ, «N sɛdiri salonyi bama nɛ a kɔn na, salonyi fanyi naxan na koore ma, n fa a si geya itexi fari.

sentences.english: It will be planted on the high mountain of Israel: it will put out branches and have fruit and be a fair cedar: under it all birds of every sort will make their living-place, resting in the shade of its branches.
sentences.susu: N a sima nɛ Isirayila geya ma, a salonyie fan, e bogi gbegbe ramini. A findima nɛ sɛdiri wuri bili tofanyi ra. Xɔni mɔɔli birin fama nɛ e malabude, a salonyie niini bun ma a kɔn na.

sentences.english: And it will be clear to all the trees of the field that I the Lord have made low the high tree and made high the low tree, drying up the green tree and making the dry tree full of growth; I the Lord have said it and have done it.
sentences.susu: Na kui wuri bili birin a kolonma nɛ, a n tan Alatala nan wuri bili itexi igoroma, n wuri bili igoroxi ite. N wuri xinde xara, n wuri xare rafan. N tan Alatala xui nan na ki. N fama nɛ na rakamalide.»

sentences.english: The word of the Lord came to me again, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Why do you make use of this saying about the land of Israel, The fathers have been tasting bitter grapes and the children's teeth are on edge?
sentences.susu: «Wo yi taali wɔyɛnyi falama nɛ Isirayila bɔxi ma. Wo naxɛ, ‹Forie na mangoe yɔxɔɛ don, e xa die nan ɲinyie muluxunma.› Wo na falama munfe ra?

sentences.english: By my life, says the Lord, you will no longer have this saying in Israel.
sentences.susu: N bara n kali n yɛtɛ ra, a mu lanma wo xa yi taali fala Isirayila bɔxi ma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: See, all souls are mine; as the soul of the father, so the soul of the son is mine: death will be the fate of the sinner's soul.
sentences.susu: N tan nan gbe na nii birin na, babɛ ba, di ba. N tan nan gbe e birin na. Nii naxan na yunubi raba, na nii nan bɔnɔma.»

sentences.english: But if a man is upright, living rightly and doing righteousness,
sentences.susu: «Mixi naxan tinxin, naxan fe fanyi rabama,

sentences.english: And has not taken flesh with the blood for food, or given worship to the images of the children of Israel; if he has not had connection with his neighbour's wife, or come near to a woman at the time when she is unclean;
sentences.susu: naxan mu sɛrɛxɛ donma kuye bɛ geyae fari, naxan mu a ya tima Isirayila xa kuyee ra, naxan mu yɛnɛ rabama a dɔxɔboore ginɛ ra, naxan mu ginɛ masama a xa kike wali kui,

sentences.english: And has done no wrong to any, but has given back to the debtor what is his, and has taken no one's goods by force, and has given food to him who was in need of it, and clothing to him who was without it;
sentences.susu: naxan mu mixi rawalima a yɛtɛ xa geeni xa fe ra, naxan donifa xa sɛɛkɛ ragbilenma a ma, naxan mu muɲɛ tima, kɔnɔ a fa setare ki, a dugi fi misikiinɛ ma,

sentences.english: And has not given his money out at interest or taken great profits, and, turning his hand from evil-doing, has kept faith between man and man,
sentences.susu: naxan mu geeni mɔɔli yo fenma doni kui, naxan a yɛtɛ suxuma fe ɲaaxi rabafe ra, naxan kiiti tinxinxi sama mixie tagi,

sentences.english: And has been guided by my rules and has kept my laws and done them: he is upright, life will certainly be his, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: naxan n ma yaamarie rabama, a n ma sɛriyɛ rabatu, na kanyi findixi tinxintɔɛ nan na. Na kisima nɛ. Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: If he has a son who is a thief, a taker of life, who does any of these things,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa a sa li a xa di nde na na, naxan mixi bɔnbɔma, a faxɛ tima, a fe ɲaaxi gbɛtɛ raba

sentences.english: Who has taken flesh with the blood as food, and has had connection with his neighbour's wife,
sentences.susu: a baba mu darixi naxan na, a xa fe na di? A sɛrɛxɛ donma kuye bɛ geya fari, a yɛnɛ raba a dɔxɔboore xa ginɛ ra,

sentences.english: Has done wrong to the poor and to him who is in need, and taken property by force, and has not given back to one in his debt what is his, and has given worship to images and has done disgusting things,
sentences.susu: a setare nun misikiinɛ tɔɔrɔma, a muɲɛ tima, a tondi sɛɛkɛ ragbilende, a a yae tima kuyee ra, a fe ɲaaxie rabama,

sentences.english: And has given out his money at interest and taken great profits: he will certainly not go on living: he has done all these disgusting things: death will certainly be his fate; his blood will be on him.
sentences.susu: a geeni fenma doni kui. Na mixi mɔɔli kisima? Ade, a a yɛtɛ nii sare fima nɛ faxɛ ra a xa fe ɲaaxie ma!

sentences.english: Now if he has a son who sees all his father's sins which he has done, and in fear does not do the same:
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ xa na di ɲaaxi di nde sɔtɔ, naxan bara a baba xa yunubie to, a fa lu a mu tin na wali mɔɔli rabade, a xa fe luma di?

sentences.english: Who has not taken the flesh with the blood for food, or given worship to the images of the children of Israel, and has not had connection with his neighbour's wife,
sentences.susu: A mu sɛrɛxɛ donma kuye bɛ geya fari. A mu a ya tima Isirayila kuyee ra. A mu yɛnɛ rabama a dɔxɔboore ginɛ ra.

sentences.english: Or done wrong to any, or taken anything from one in his debt, or taken goods by force, but has given food to him who was in need of it, and clothing to him who was without it;
sentences.susu: A mu mixi rawalima a yɛtɛ xa geeni xa fe ra. A mu sɛɛkɛ maxɔrinma. A mu muɲɛ tima, kɔnɔ a setare kima, a dugi fima misikiinɛ ma,

sentences.english: Who has kept his hand from evil-doing and has not taken interest or great profits, who has done my orders and been guided by my rules: he will certainly not be put to death for the evil-doing of his father; life will certainly be his.
sentences.susu: a a yɛtɛ suxuma fe ɲaaxi rabafe ra, a mu geeni mɔɔli yo fenma doni kui. Na di mu bɔnɔma a baba xa fe ɲaaxi xa fe ra. A kisima nɛ.

sentences.english: As for his father, because he was cruel, took goods by force, and did what is not good among his people, truly, death will overtake him in his evil-doing.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a baba tan, naxan findi funmala ra, naxan a boore muɲa, naxan fe ɲaaxie raba a xa mixie tagi, a tan nan bɔnɔma a xa yunubie xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: But you say, Why does not the son undergo punishment for the evil-doing of the father? When the son has done what is ordered and right, and has kept my rules and done them, life will certainly be his.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ wo n maxɔrinma, ‹Munfera na di mu a baba xa yunubi kote tongoma?› N xa a fala wo bɛ, na di tinxintɔɛ, naxan bara n ma sɛriyɛ rabatu, a kisima nɛ.

sentences.english: The soul which does sin will be put to death: the son will not be made responsible for the evil-doing of the father, or the father for the evil-doing of the son; the righteousness of the upright will be on himself, and the evil-doing of the evil-doer on himself.
sentences.susu: Naxan na yunubi raba, na nan bɔnɔma. Di mu a baba xa yunubi kote xaninma. Baba fan mu a xa di xa yunubi kote xaninma. Tinxintɔɛ fama nɛ tinxinyi sare sɔtɔde. Yunubitɔɛ tan fama yunubi sare sɔtɔde.»

sentences.english: But if the evil-doer, turning away from all the sins which he has done, keeps my rules and does what is ordered and right, life will certainly be his; death will not be his fate.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ xa yunubitɔɛ gbilen a xa yunubie fɔxɔ ra, a bira Ala xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra tinxinyi kui, a kisima nɛ, a mu bɔnɔma.

sentences.english: Not one of the sins which he has done will be kept in memory against him: in the righteousness which he has done he will have life.
sentences.susu: A fe kobi naxee birin naba, na birin bama nɛ a ma, a fa kisi a xa tinxinyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: Have I any pleasure in the death of the evil-doer? says the Lord: am I not pleased if he is turned from his way so that he may have life?
sentences.susu: N tan wo Marigi Alatala ɲɛlɛxinma yunubitɔɛ xa ɲaxankatɛ ra? A xa gbilen a xa yunubi fɔxɔ ra, a xa kisi, na nan nafan n ma.»

sentences.english: But when the upright man, turning away from his righteousness, does evil, like all the disgusting things which the evil man does, will he have life? Not one of his upright acts will be kept in memory: in the wrong which he has done and in his sin death will overtake him.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ xa tinxintɔɛ gbilen a xa tinxinyi fɔxɔ ra, a fa fe ɲaaxi raba alɔ yunubitɔɛ a rabama ki naxɛ, a kisima? A fe fanyi naxee birin naba, na birin bama nɛ a ma, a yunubi sɔtɔ, a fa bɔnɔ a xa fe ɲaaxie saabui ra.»

sentences.english: But you say, The way of the Lord is not equal. Give ear, now, O children of Israel; is my way not equal? are not your ways unequal?
sentences.susu: «Wo naxɛ, ‹Marigi xa kira mu tinxin.› Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ, wo wo tuli mati n na. N ma kira mu tinxinxi xɛ, ka wo tan nan xa kira mu tinxin?

sentences.english: When the upright man, turning away from his righteousness, does evil, death will overtake him; in the evil which he has done death will overtake him.
sentences.susu: Xa tinxintɔɛ a kobe so fe fanyi rabafe ra, a bɔnɔma a xa yunubie nan ma fe ra.

sentences.english: Again, when the evil-doer, turning away from the evil he has done, does what is ordered and right, he will have life for his soul.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa tinxintare a kobe so fe ɲaaxi rabafe ra, a bira tinxinyi fɔxɔ ra, a kisima nɛ.

sentences.english: Because he had fear and was turned away from all the wrong which he had done, life will certainly be his, death will not be his fate.
sentences.susu: A to a xa wali kobie birin mato, a natɛ tongo a xa gbilen nee fɔxɔ ra, na nan a ra a kisima, a mu bɔnɔma.

sentences.english: But still the children of Israel say, The way of the Lord is not equal. O children of Israel, are my ways not equal? are not your ways unequal?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ naxɛ, ‹Ala xa kira mu tinxin.› N tan nan ma kira mu tinxin ba, ka wo tan nan xa kira mu tinxin?»

sentences.english: For this cause I will be your judge, O children of Israel, judging every man by his ways, says the Lord. Come back and be turned from all your sins; so that they may not be the cause of your falling into evil.
sentences.susu: «Na kui Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ, n wo kankan makiitima a xa fe rabaxi bɛrɛ nan ma. Wo xa tuubi! Wo gbilen wo xa yunubie rabafe fɔxɔ ra, alako nee naxa wo bɔnɔ.

sentences.english: Put away all your evil-doing in which you have done sin; and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit: why are you desiring death, O children of Israel?
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo makuya wo xa yunubie ra wo naxee rabaxi, wo wo bɔɲɛ masara, wo xaxili nɛɛnɛ tongo. Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ, wo tima bɔnɔɛ kira ra munfe ra?

sentences.english: For I have no pleasure in the death of him on whom death comes, says the Lord: be turned back then, and have life.
sentences.susu: N mu wama mixi yo xa bɔnɔ. Wo tuubi alako wo xa kisi! Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: Take up now a song of grief for the ruler of Israel, and say,
sentences.susu: Wo xa kinikini Isirayila mangɛ suukibae ma yi ki:

sentences.english: What was your mother? Like a she-lion among lions, stretched out among the young lions she gave food to her little ones.
sentences.susu: «Wo nga findi yɛtɛ ginɛ fanyi nan na yɛtɛe tagi. A saxi a xa die tagi, a e xuru.

sentences.english: And one of her little ones came to growth under her care, and became a young lion, learning to go after beasts for his food; and he took men for his meat.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa di nde ramɔ, a findi sɛnbɛma ra. Na di naxa fata a baloe fende, a mixie yati faxa.

sentences.english: And the nations had news of him; he was taken in the hole they had made: and, pulling him with hooks, they took him into the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Ɲamanɛe to a xa fe mɛ, e naxa a suxu e xa gantanyi ra, e a xanin Misira wure ra a ɲɔɛ kui.»

sentences.english: Now when she saw that her hope was made foolish and gone, she took another of her little ones and made him into a young lion.
sentences.susu: «Na yɛtɛ ginɛ to a to, a xa fe mu sɔɔnɛyaxi, a naxa a xa di gbɛtɛ tongo, a a findi yɛtɛ sɛnbɛma ra.

sentences.english: And he went up and down among the lions and became a young lion, learning to go after beasts for his food; and he took men for his meat.
sentences.susu: Na di nu a ɲɛrɛma yɛtɛe tagi a sɛnbɛ ma. A naxa fata a baloe fende, a mixie faxa.

sentences.english: And he sent destruction on their widows and made waste their towns; and the land and everything in it became waste because of the loud sound of his voice.
sentences.susu: A naxa nee xa tɛtɛe kana, a taakae faxa. Ɲama birin nu bara gaaxu a xa yirindinyi yara.

sentences.english: Then the nations came against him from the kingdoms round about: their net was stretched over him and he was taken in the hole they had made.
sentences.susu: Ɲamanɛe man naxa keli a rabilinyi, e naxa e xa yɛlɛe itala, e a suxu gantanyi ra.

sentences.english: They made him a prisoner with hooks, and took him to the king of Babylon; they put him in the strong place so that his voice might be sounding no longer on the mountains of Israel.
sentences.susu: E naxa a raso kulɛ kui wuree ra, e a xanin Babilɔn mangɛ xɔn ma. Mɛnni e naxa a raso geeli kui. A yirindin xui mu mɛ Isirayila geyae fari sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: Your mother was in comparison like a vine, planted by the waters: she was fertile and full of branches because of the great waters.
sentences.susu: «Wo nga nu luxi nɛ alɔ wɛni bili naxan sixi xure dɛ ra. A nu bogima, a salonyie nu wuya, barima ye nu gbo a yire.

sentences.english: And she had a strong rod for a rod of authority for the rulers, and it became tall among the clouds and it was seen lifted up among the number of its branches.
sentences.susu: Salon fanyie nu na a bɛ, naxee fan mangɛ sawuri ra. A nu tixi sansie birin xun ma a xa maite nun a salon wuyaxie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: But she was uprooted in burning wrath, and made low on the earth; the east wind came, drying her up, and her branches were broken off; her strong rod became dry, the fire made a meal of it.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a bara tala xɔnɛ kui, a rabira bɔxi ma. Sogetede foye naxa a xara, a bogie kana. A salon fanyie naxa lisi, tɛ naxa e gan.

sentences.english: And now she is planted in the waste land, in a dry and unwatered country.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi a sixi gbengberenyi nan ma, bɔxi xɔrɔxɔɛ, ye mu na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And fire has gone out from her rod, causing the destruction of her branches, so that there is no strong rod in her to be the ruler's rod of authority. This is a song of grief, and it was for a song of grief.
sentences.susu: Tɛ bara mini a salonyi nde kui, a a bogie gan. Salon fanyi yo mu na a bɛ sɔnɔn, naxan findima mangɛ sawuri ra.» Kinikini suuki nan na ki naxan bama nimisɛ kui.

sentences.english: Now it came about in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month, that certain of the responsible men of Israel came to get directions from the Lord and were seated before me.
sentences.susu: A ɲɛ solofere nde, kike suuli, xi fu nde ra, Isirayila fori ndee naxa fa n yire, e xa Alatala xa marasi fen.

sentences.english: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, say to the responsible men of Israel, This is what the Lord has said: Have you come to get directions from me? By my life, says the Lord, you will get no directions from me.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, Isirayila forie maxɔrin munfe ra e faxi n ma marasi fende, n to a fala e bɛ n mu tin e xa n maxandi na ki. Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: Will you be their judge, O son of man, will you be their judge? make clear to them the disgusting ways of their fathers,
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i xa e makiiti e xa fe ɲaaxie nun e benbae xa fe ɲaaxie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And say to them, This is what the Lord has said: In the day when I took Israel for myself, when I made an oath to the seed of the family of Jacob, and I gave them knowledge of myself in the land of Egypt, saying to them with an oath, I am the Lord your God;
sentences.susu: A fala e bɛ, ‹Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: N Isirayila sugandi tɛmui naxɛ, n na n kali nɛ n bɛlɛxɛ itexi ra Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ bɛ a n tan nan na e Marigi Alatala ra. N na n yɛtɛ masen e bɛ Misira bɔxi ma,

sentences.english: In that day I gave my oath to take them out of the land of Egypt into a land which I had been searching out for them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the glory of all lands:
sentences.susu: n fa n kali e bɛ a n e raminima nɛ mɛnni sigafe ra bɔxi fanyi ma, n dɛnnaxɛ sugandixi e bɛ, kumi nun xiɲɛ xɛlɛma bɔxi naxan ma.

sentences.english: And I said to them, Let every man among you put away the disgusting things to which his eyes are turned, and do not make yourselves unclean with the images of Egypt; I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: N a masen e bɛ, e xa Misira kuyee wɔlɛ, alako e naxa fa e yɛtɛ findi sɛniyɛntaree ra. N tan nan na e Marigi Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: But they would not be controlled by me, and did not give ear to me; they did not put away the disgusting things to which their eyes were turned, or give up the images of Egypt: then I said I would let loose my passion on them to give full effect to my wrath against them in the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ e naxa n xui matandi. E mu Misira kuyee wɔlɛ, e mu gbilen nee fɔxɔ ra. Na kui n naxa a masen e bɛ a n fama nɛ n ma xɔnɛ radinde e ma Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And I was acting for the honour of my name, so that it might not be made unclean before the eyes of the nations among whom they were, and before whose eyes I gave them knowledge of myself, by taking them out of the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, n naxa natɛ tongo n xa e ramini naa, alako n xili naxa fa mabere ɲamanɛe tagi e nu dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: So I made them go out of the land of Egypt and took them into the waste land.
sentences.susu: N naxa e ramini Misira bɔxi ra, n fa e xun ti gbengberenyi ra.

sentences.english: And I gave them my rules and made clear to them my orders, which, if a man keeps them, will be life to him.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni n naxa n ma yaamarie so e yi ra, n e rakolon n ma sɛriyɛ ra. Mixi naxee birama nee fɔxɔ ra, e kisima nɛ.

sentences.english: And further, I gave them my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, so that it might be clear that I, who make them holy, am the Lord.
sentences.susu: N naxa malabui lɔxɔɛ xa yaamari fan fi e ma tɔnxuma ra n tan nun e tan tagi, alako e xa a kolon n tan Alatala nan e rasɛniyɛnma.»

sentences.english: But the children of Israel would not be controlled by me in the waste land: they were not guided by my rules, and they were turned away from my orders, which, if a man does them, will be life to him; and they had no respect for my Sabbaths: then I said that I would let loose my passion on them in the waste land, and put an end to them.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ naxa e kobe raso n na gbengberenyi ma. E n ma malabui lɔxɔɛ xa yaamari mabere. E mu bira n ma yaamarie fɔxɔ ra, e mu n ma sɛriyɛ suxu, naxee nu nɔma e rakiside. Na kui n naxa a natɛ, n xa n ma xɔnɛ birin namini e ma, n xa e sɔntɔ gbengberen yire.

sentences.english: And I was acting for the honour of my name, so that it might not be made unclean in the eyes of the nations, before whose eyes I had taken them out.
sentences.susu: Hali n mu na raba, alako n xili naxa fa mabere ɲamanɛe tagi, n e ramini naxee ya xɔri Misira bɔxi ra,

sentences.english: And further, I gave my oath to them in the waste land, that I would not take them into the land which I had given them, a land flowing with milk and honey, the glory of all lands;
sentences.susu: n naxa n kali n bɛlɛxɛ itexi ra gbengberenyi ma, a n mu e xaninma na bɔxi fanyi ma sɔnɔn, n nu bara naxan fi e ma, xiɲɛ nun kumi xɛlɛma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Because they were turned away from my orders, and were not guided by my rules, and had no respect for my Sabbaths: for their hearts went after their images.
sentences.susu: N na natɛ tongo nɛ, barima e nu n ma yaamarie nun n ma sɛriyɛ nan maberema, e tondi n ma malabui lɔxɔɛ xa yaamari suxude a ki ma. E xa kuye fe nan nu na e bɔɲɛ ma.

sentences.english: But still my eye had pity on them and I kept them from destruction and did not put an end to them completely in the waste land.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n naxa kinikini e ma, n mu e sɔntɔ gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: And I said to their children in the waste land, Do not be guided by the rules of your fathers or keep their orders or make yourselves unclean with their images:
sentences.susu: N naxa a masen e xa die bɛ mɛnni, n naxɛ, ‹Wo naxa bira wo benbae xa yaamarie nun e xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra de. Wo naxa wo yɛtɛ findi sɛniyɛntaree ra e xa kuyee batufe ra.

sentences.english: I am the Lord your God; be guided by my rules and keep my orders and do them:
sentences.susu: N tan nan na wo Marigi Alatala ra. Wo xa bira n tan nan ma yaamarie fɔxɔ ra, wo xa n ma sɛriyɛ suxu.

sentences.english: And keep my Sabbaths holy; and they will be a sign between me and you so that it may be clear to you that I am the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: Wo xa n ma malabui lɔxɔɛ rasɛniyɛn, alako na xa findi tɔnxuma ra won tagi. Na kui wo a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na wo Marigi Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: But the children would not be controlled by me; they were not guided by my rules, and they did not keep and do my orders, which, if a man does them, will be life to him; and they had no respect for my Sabbaths: then I said I would let loose my passion on them to give full effect to my wrath against them in the waste land.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ Isirayila die naxa muruta n ma, e mu n ma yaamarie rabatu, e mu e ɲɔxɔ sa n ma sɛriyɛ xɔn ma naxan mixi rakisima, e fa n ma malabui lɔxɔɛ xa yaamari mabere. Na kui n naxa a masen, n xa n ma xɔnɛ birin namini e ma gbengberen yire.

sentences.english: And I was acting for the honour of my name, so that it might not be made unclean in the eyes of the nations, before whose eyes I had taken them out.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n mu na raba, alako n xili naxa fa mabere ɲamanɛe tagi, n e ramini naxee ya xɔri Misira bɔxi ra.

sentences.english: Further, I gave my oath to them in the waste land that I would send them wandering among the nations, driving them out among the countries;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n na n kali n bɛlɛxɛ itexi nan na gbengberenyi ma, n xa e rayensen yɛ ɲamanɛe tagi,

sentences.english: Because they had not done my orders, but had been turned away from my rules, and had not given respect to my Sabbaths, and their eyes were turned to the images of their fathers.
sentences.susu: barima e mu n ma sɛriyɛ rabatu, e n ma yaamarie matandi, e n ma malabui lɔxɔɛ xa yaamari mabere, e man fa e ya rafindi e benbae xa kuyee ma.

sentences.english: And further, I gave them rules which were not good and orders in which there was no life for them;
sentences.susu: N naxa e lu e xa bira e yɛtɛ xa yaamari ɲaaxie fɔxɔ ra, sɛriyɛ mɔɔli nde naxan mu nɔma sɔɔnɛyade.

sentences.english: I made them unclean in the offerings they gave, causing them to make every first child go through the fire, so that I might put an end to them.
sentences.susu: N naxa a lu e xa findi sɛniyɛntaree ra sɛrɛxɛ mɔɔli nde xa fe ra, mixi xa di singe faxama sɛrɛxɛ naxan ma fe ra. N nu wama nɛ e xa na fɔxi magaaxuxi to, alako e xa a kolon a n tan nan na Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: For this cause, son of man, say to the children of Israel, This is what the Lord has said: In this your fathers have further put shame on my name by doing wrong against me.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i xa a fala Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe bɛ, i naxɛ, ‹Wo marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: Wo benbae bara n finsiriwali, e bara n yanfa.

sentences.english: For when I had taken them into the land which I made an oath to give to them, then they saw every high hill and every branching tree and made their offerings there, moving me to wrath by their offerings; and there the sweet smell of their offerings went up and their drink offerings were drained out.
sentences.susu: N to bara e raso bɔxi ma, n na n kali naxan na fife ra e ma, e naxa sɛrɛxɛe ba fɔlɔ kuyee bɛ geyae fari nun wurie bun ma. E nu surayi ganma e bɛ, e minse fan ba sɛrɛxɛ ra. Na birin naxa na xɔnɔ ki fanyi ra,

sentences.english: Then I said to them, What is this high place where you go to no purpose? And it is named Bamah to this day.
sentences.susu: n fa e maxɔrin, Munse na yi yire itexi ra wo sigafe dɛnnaxɛ? Han ya na batudee xili falama Yire itexie.›»

sentences.english: For this cause say to the children of Israel, This is what the Lord has said: Are you making yourselves unclean as your fathers did? are you being untrue to me by going after their disgusting works?
sentences.susu: «Na nan a ra, a fala Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ bɛ, ‹Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: Wo wama findife sɛniyɛntaree ra alɔ wo benbae, wo fa bira e xa kuye ɲaaxie fɔxɔ ra?

sentences.english: And when you give your offerings, causing your sons to go through the fire, you make yourselves unclean with all your images to this day; and will you come to me for directions, O children of Israel? By my life, says the Lord, you will get no direction from me.
sentences.susu: Wo na wo xa die ba sɛrɛxɛ ra tɛ xɔɔra, wo na wo xa sɛniyɛnyi nan kanafe na ki. A lanma n xa tin wo xa n maxandi? N tan wo Marigi Alatala, n bara n kali n mu wo luma wo xa n maxandi.›»

sentences.english: And that which comes into your minds will never take place; when you say, We will be like the nations, like the families of the countries, servants of wood and stone;
sentences.susu: «Wo naxɛ wo wama nɛ lufe alɔ duniɲa ɲamanɛe, naxee wuri nun gɛmɛ batuma.

sentences.english: By my life, says the Lord, truly, with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm and with burning wrath let loose, I will be King over you:
sentences.susu: N tan wo Marigi Alatala, n bara n kali a n na n ma mangɛya raɲɛrɛma nɛ wo xun ma sɛnbɛ ra, n na n ma xɔnɛ birin namini wo ma.

sentences.english: And I will take you out from the peoples and get you together out of the countries where you are wandering, with a strong hand and with an outstretched arm and with burning wrath let loose:
sentences.susu: N wo raminima nɛ ɲamanɛe ya ma sɛnbɛ ra, n wo malan yire keren n ma xɔnɛ kui.

sentences.english: And I will take you into the waste land of the peoples, and there I will take up the cause with you face to face.
sentences.susu: N wo xaninma nɛ gbengberenyi ma ɲamanɛe tagi, n wo ɲaxankata mɛnni.

sentences.english: As I took up the cause with your fathers in the waste land of the land of Egypt, so will I take up the cause with you says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N naxan nabaxi wo benbae ra Misira gbengberenyi ma, n na fan nabama nɛ wo fan na. Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.

sentences.english: And I will make you go under the rod and will make you small in number:
sentences.susu: N wo radangima nɛ n ma yisuxuwuri bun ma, n fa wo raɲɛrɛ n ma saatɛ ra.

sentences.english: Clearing out from among you all those who are uncontrolled and who are sinning against me; I will take them out of the land where they are living, but they will not come into the land of Israel: and you will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: N murutɛlae nun matandilae bama nɛ wo ya ma, naxee na n gerefe. N e raminima nɛ bɔxi ra e sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ konyiya kui, kɔnɔ n mu e xaninma Isirayila bɔxi ma. Na kui wo fama nɛ a kolonde a n tan nan na Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: As for you, O children of Israel, the Lord has said: Let every man completely put away his images and give ear to me: and let my holy name no longer be shamed by your offerings and your images.
sentences.susu: «Wo tan Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ, wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi wo bɛ: ‹Xa wo wama sigafe wo xa kuyee batude, awa yire, kɔnɔ xa a sa li wo wo tuli matima n xili sɛniyɛnxi nan na, wo naxa n mabere sɔnɔn wo xa kuye batui ra.

sentences.english: For in my holy mountain, in the high mountain of Israel, says the Lord, there all the children of Israel, all of them, will be my servants in the land; there I will take pleasure in them, and there I will be worshipped with your offerings and the first-fruits of the things you give, and with all your holy things.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan yi ki: Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ fama nɛ n batude yi geya itexi sɛniyɛnxi fari. N e rasɛnɛma nɛ a fanyi ra, n e xa sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxie tongo a nun e xa hadiya birin.
