sentences.english: I will take pleasure in you as in a sweet smell, when I take you out from the peoples and get you together from the countries where you have been sent in flight; and I will make myself holy in you before the eyes of the nations.
sentences.susu: N na wo ramini ɲamanɛe tagi wo rayensenxi dɛnnaxɛ, n wo rasɛnɛma nɛ a fanyi ra, alɔ surayi xiri fanyi. N na n ma sɛniyɛnyi masenma nɛ ɲamanɛe bɛ wo saabui ra.

sentences.english: And you will be certain that I am the Lord, when I take you into the land of Israel, into the country which I made an oath to give to your fathers.
sentences.susu: N na wo ragbilen wo xa bɔxi ma Isirayila, n na n kalixi naxan fife ra wo benbae ma, wo fama nɛ a kolonde a n tan nan na Alatala ra.

sentences.english: And there, at the memory of your ways and of all the things you did to make yourselves unclean, you will have bitter hate for yourselves because of all the evil things you have done.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni, wo wo ratuma nɛ wo xa fe ɲaaxie birin ma, naxee wo findi mixi sɛniyɛntaree ra, wo fa lu na yaagi kui tun.

sentences.english: And you will be certain that I am the Lord, when I take you in hand for the honour of my name, and not for your evil ways or your unclean doings, O children of Israel, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N na wo rakisi n xili xa fe ra, n mu wo xa wali ɲaaxie sare fi wo ma, wo fama nɛ a kolonde a n tan nan na Alatala ra. Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ, wo Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.›»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, let your face be turned to Jerusalem, let your words be dropped in the direction of her holy place, and be a prophet against the land of Israel;
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i ya rafindi i yirefanyi ma, i kawandi ti Negewi fɔtɔnyi bɛ.

sentences.english: And say to the land of Israel, These are the words of the Lord: See, I am against you, and I will take my sword out of its cover, cutting off from you the upright and the evil.
sentences.susu: A fala: ‹Negewi fɔtɔnyi, i i tuli mati i Marigi Alatala xa masenyi ra. A xui nan ya: N tɛ radɛxɛma nɛ i xɔnyi, naxan i xa wuri xindee nun wuri xaree birin ganma. Na tɛ mu tuma. A fɔxi toma nɛ keli yirefanyi ma han kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: Because I am going to have the upright and the evil cut off from you, for this cause my sword will go out from its cover against all flesh from the south to the north:
sentences.susu: Mixi birin a kolonma nɛ a n tan Alatala nan na tɛ radɛxɛxi. A mu tuma.›»

sentences.english: And all flesh will see that I the Lord have taken my sword out of its cover: and it will never go back.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n naxa a fala a bɛ, «N Marigi Alatala, ɲama naxɛ, a n taali wɔyɛnyi nan tun falama.»

sentences.english: Make sounds of grief, son of man; with body bent and a bitter heart make sounds of grief before their eyes.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ,

sentences.english: And when they say to you, Why are you making sounds of grief? then say, Because of the news, for it is coming: and every heart will become soft, and all hands will be feeble, and every spirit will be burning low, and all knees will be turned to water: see, it is coming and it will be done, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i ya rafindi Darisalamu ma, i xa kawandi ti hɔrɔmɔlingira xa fe ra. I xa masenyi ti n xili ra Isirayila xili ma.

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: A fala Isirayila ɲama bɛ: ‹Alatala yi nan masenxi: N tixi wo kanke. N na n ma santidɛgɛma bama nɛ a tɛɛ i, n fa wo xa tinxintɔɛe nun wo xa tinxintaree faxa.

sentences.english: Son of man, say as a prophet, These are the words of the Lord: Say, A sword, a sword which has been made sharp and polished:
sentences.susu: N to natɛ tongo tinxintɔɛe nun tinxintaree xili ma, n ma santidɛgɛma bama nɛ a tɛɛ i yi ɲama birin xa fe ra, naxee na yirefanyi nun kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: It has been made sharp to give death; it is polished so that it may be like a thunder-flame: ...
sentences.susu: Na kui, birin a kolonma nɛ, a n tan nan n ma santidɛgɛma raminixi a tɛɛ i wo xilima. N mu a rasoma sɔnɔn.›»

sentences.english: And I have given it to the polisher so that it may be taken in the hand: he has made the sword sharp, he has had it polished, to put it into the hand of him who gives death.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i xa i wa xui ramini i bɔɲɛ tɔɔrɔxi sunnunxi xɔrɔxɔɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Give loud cries and make sounds of grief, O son of man: for it has come on my people, it has come on all the rulers of Israel: fear of the sword has come on my people: for this cause give signs of grief.
sentences.susu: E na i maxɔrin i wafe fe naxan ma, i xa e yaabi, ‹Xibaaru xɔrɔxɔɛ bara n li. Limaniya bama nɛ mixi birin yi ra na xa fe ra. Mixi birin bɔɲɛ kɔntɔfilima nɛ, mixi birin sanyi sɛrɛn gaaxui kui.› N xa a fala i bɛ, a na fafe. I Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.»
Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ,

sentences.english: So then, son of man, be a prophet, and put your hands together with a loud sound, and give two blows with the sword, and even three; it is the sword of those who are wounded, even the sword of the wounded; the great sword which goes round about them.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, n ma xɛɛra iba, a falafe ra, ‹Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, a naxɛ: Santidɛgɛma fanyi, santidɛgɛma xaɲɛnxi!

sentences.english: In order that hearts may become soft, and the number of those who are falling may be increased, I have sent death by the sword against all their doors: you are made like a flame, you are polished for death.
sentences.susu: Santidɛgɛma naxan gbaloe rabama, santidɛgɛma naxan dangima alɔ seyamakɔnyi. Won nɔma ɲɛlɛxinde n ma di xa mangɛ sa wuri ra? Ade, santidɛgɛma fama nɛ birin xun nakanade.

sentences.english: Be pointed to the right, to the left, wherever your edge is ordered.
sentences.susu: Santidɛgɛma faxi nɛ a fe xa sɔɔnɛya, a xaɲɛn, a suxuxi faxɛti yi ra.

sentences.english: And I will put my hands together with a loud sound, and I will let my wrath have rest: I the Lord have said it.
sentences.susu: Adamadi, i wa xui ite, barima na santidɛgɛma tima nɛ n ma ɲama kanke, a Isirayila mangɛe faxa, a nun n ma ɲama. Na kui, i kanke madin sunnunyi kui.›»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me again, saying,
sentences.susu: «Matoe nan a ra. Munse fama rabade xa Yudaya mangɛya mu fa nɔ tide yi santidɛgɛma yara? Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And you, son of man, have two ways marked out, so that the sword of the king of Babylon may come; let the two of them come out of one land: and let there be a pillar at the top of the road:
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i xa masenyi ti n xili ra. I xa i bɛlɛxɛe bɔnbɔ keren. Santidɛgɛma man xa bɔnbɔ firin, a xa bɔnbɔ saxan. Santidɛgɛma nan a ra naxan gbaloe rabama, naxan faxɛ tima yire birin.

sentences.english: Put a pillar at the top of the road for the sword to come to Rabbah in the land of the children of Ammon, and to Judah and to Jerusalem in the middle of her.
sentences.susu: Na kui limaniya bama nɛ mixie yi ra, mixi gbegbe sɔntɔ. N ma santidɛgɛma tima nɛ naadɛe birin na faxɛ tife ra. A dangima nɛ alɔ seyamakɔnyi.

sentences.english: For the king of Babylon took his place at the parting of the ways, at the top of the two roads, to make use of secret arts: shaking the arrows this way and that, he put questions to the images of his gods, he took note of the inner parts of dead beasts.
sentences.susu: Santidɛgɛma xabɛ tima nɛ yirefanyi ma, a xabɛ ti kɔɔla ma, a dɛ ya rafindixi yire birin ma.

sentences.english: At his right hand was the fate of Jerusalem, to give orders for destruction, to send up the war-cry, to put engines of war against the doors, lifting up earthworks, building walls.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, n tan Alatala fama nɛ n bɛlɛxɛe bɔnbɔde, n ma xɔnɛ fa dan. Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And this answer given by secret arts will seem false to those who have given their oaths and have let them be broken: but he will keep the memory of evil-doing so that they may be taken.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord has said: Because you have made your evil-doing come to mind by the uncovering of your wrongdoing, causing your sins to be seen in all your evil-doings; because you have come to mind, you will be taken in them.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i naxan nabama, i xa kira firin nabɔɔ Babilɔn mangɛ xa santidɛgɛma ɲɛrɛma naxee ra. E firin xa keli yire keren, tɔnxuma xa ti yire nde e fatanma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And you, O evil one, wounded to death, O ruler of Israel, whose day has come in the time of the last punishment;
sentences.susu: Kira keren xa siga Amorikae xɔnyi naxan xili Raaba. Kira firin nde xa siga Yudaya xa taa makantaxi naxan xili Darisalamu.

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: Take away the holy head-dress, take off the crown: this will not be again: let that which is low be lifted up, and that which is high be made low.
sentences.susu: Babilɔn mangɛ tima nɛ na kira firin xunyi ra, a xa sematoe wali raba alɔ xalie mawolife, kuyee maxɔrinfe, nun sube bɔɲɛ matofe.

sentences.english: I will let it be overturned, overturned, overturned: this will not be again till he comes whose right it is; and I will give it to him.
sentences.susu: Na sematoe wali a masenma nɛ a bɛ a xa siga Darisalamu mabiri, a xa geresosee tongo tɛtɛ longori ra, a xa na naadɛe rabira, a fa gbaloe ti taa kui.

sentences.english: And you, son of man, say as a prophet, This is what the Lord has said about the children of Ammon and about their shame: Say, A sword, even a sword let loose, polished for death, to make it shining so that it may be like a flame:
sentences.susu: Darisalamukae to saatɛ xiri e nun Babilɔn mangɛ ra, e na sematoe wali toma wule nan na. Kɔnɔ Babilɔn mangɛ mu a tuli matima e ra, barima a naxɛ e fan bara haakɛ sɔtɔ a mabiri. Na nan a ra, a e xaninma konyiya kui.»

sentences.english: Your vision is to no purpose, your use of secret arts gives a false answer, to put it on the necks of evil-doers who are wounded to death, whose day has come, in the time of the last punishment.
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: Wo xa wali ɲaaxi bara a niya n xa ratu wo xa yunubi dangixie ma, n xa wo xanin konyiya kui.

sentences.english: Go back into your cover. In the place where you were made, in the land from which you were taken, I will be your judge.
sentences.susu: I tan Isirayila mangɛ tinxintare, i xa ɲaxankatɛ lɔxɔɛ bara a li.

sentences.english: And I will let loose my burning passion on you, breathing out on you the fire of my wrath: and I will give you up into the hands of men like beasts, trained to destruction.
sentences.susu: I Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, a naxɛ, ‹Mangɛ tɔnxuma ba i xunyi ma! Mangɛya bara ba i yi ra. Mixi magoroxi xa fe itema nɛ, mixi matexi xa fe magoro.

sentences.english: You will be food for the fire; your blood will be drained out in the land; there will be no more memory of you: for I the Lord have said it.
sentences.susu: I xa mangɛya xun nakanama nɛ, a ɲɔn. Na mangɛya mu gbilenma a ra fo mixi fa, a lan a xa so naxan yi ra. Na fima na kanyi nan ma.›»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: And you, son of man, will you be a judge, will you be a judge of the town of blood? then make clear to her all her disgusting ways.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, a mu lanma xɛ i xa yi taa faxɛti makiiti, i xa a rakolon a xa wali kobie birin na?

sentences.english: And you are to say, This is what the Lord has said: A town causing blood to be drained out in her streets so that her time may come, and making images in her to make her unclean!
sentences.susu: A fala a bɛ, ‹Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: Taa nan yi ki, naxan xun nakanama a xa faxɛ tife ra, naxan a findima taa sɛniyɛntare ra a xa kuye batufe ra.

sentences.english: You are responsible for the blood drained out by you, and you are unclean through the images which you have made; and you have made your day come near, and the time of your judging has come; for this cause I have made you a name of shame to the nations and a cause of laughing to all countries.
sentences.susu: Wo bara yunubi sɔtɔ na faxɛ tife kui, wo bara sɛniyɛntareɲa sɔtɔ na kuyee batufe ra, wo naxee yailanxi wo bɛlɛxɛ ra. A gbe mu luxi wo xa simaya xa ɲɔn, si gbɛtɛe xa wo xili mabere.

sentences.english: Those who are near and those who are far from you will make sport of you; your name is unclean, you are full of sounds of fear.
sentences.susu: Si naxee na rabilinyi nun si naxee na yire makuye, e birin wo mayelema nɛ wo xa yunubie xa fe ra. Wo xa fe xɔrɔxɔ!›»

sentences.english: See, the rulers of Israel, every one in his family, have been causing death in you.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa mangɛe faxɛ tima e xa nɔɛ saabui ra,

sentences.english: In you they have had no respect for father and mother; in you they have been cruel to the man from a strange land; in you they have done wrong to the child without a father and to the widow.
sentences.susu: e mixie baba nun e nga maberema, e wo xa xɔɲɛ nun wo xa kiridie tɔɔrɔma.

sentences.english: You have made little of my holy things, and have made my Sabbaths unclean.
sentences.susu: Wo n ma se sɛniyɛnxie bɔtɛ baxi, wo n ma malabui lɔxɔɛe maberema.

sentences.english: In you there are men who say evil of others, causing death; in you they have taken the flesh with the blood for food; in your streets they have put evil designs into effect.
sentences.susu: Tɔɔɲɛgɛlae na wo ya ma naxee faxɛ tima. Kuye batue na wo ya ma naxee sɛrɛxɛ bama geya fari, e fa yɛnɛ ɲaaxi raba naa.

sentences.english: In you they have let the shame of their fathers be seen; in you they have done wrong to a woman at the time when she was unclean.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛe na na naxee sama e baba xa ginɛ fɛ ma, e ginɛ masama naxan mu sɛniyɛnxi a xa kike wali xa fe ra,

sentences.english: And in you one man has done what was disgusting with his neighbour's wife; and another has made his daughter-in-law unclean; and another has done wrong to his sister, his father's daughter.
sentences.susu: e yɛnɛ rabama e dɔxɔboore xa ginɛ ra, e yɛnɛ rabama e xa di xa ginɛ ra, e yɛnɛ rabama e maaginɛ yati ra e nun naxan baba keren.

sentences.english: In you they have taken rewards as the price of blood; you have taken interest and great profits, and you have taken away your neighbours' goods by force, and have not kept me in mind, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mixie na wo ya ma naxee sare rasuxuma mixi faxafe ma. Ndee na na naxee geeni sama doni fari, e fuma e ngaxakerenyi ma. Wo bara nɛɛmu n tan ma! Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: See, then, I have made my hands come together in wrath against your taking of goods by force and against the blood which has been flowing in you.
sentences.susu: «N na n bɛlɛxɛ bɔnbɔma nɛ xɔnɛ kui wo xa naafuli tinxintare nun wo xa faxɛ tife xa fe ra

sentences.english: Will your heart be high or your hands strong in the days when I take you in hand? I the Lord have said it and will do it.
sentences.susu: Sɛnbɛ luma wo bɛ n ma kiiti sa lɔxɔɛ? Wo suusama n na? N xa a fala wo bɛ, n wo ɲaxankatama nɛ. Alatala xui nan na ki.

sentences.english: And I will send you in flight among the nations and wandering among the countries; and I will completely take away out of you everything which is unclean.
sentences.susu: N wo rayensenma nɛ ɲamanɛe ma, n wo rayensen yɛ bɔxi birin ma. N wo xa sɛniyɛntareɲa ɲɔnma nɛ.

sentences.english: And you will be made low before the eyes of the nations; and it will be clear to you that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo na lu yaagi kui ɲamanɛe tagi, wo fama nɛ a kolonde a n tan nan na Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, the children of Israel have become like the poorest sort of waste metal to me: they are all silver and brass and tin and iron and lead mixed with waste.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ bara lu n bɛ alɔ gbeti gbi xabude. E maniyaxi na wure gbeeli nan na, yɔxui, wure, nun sunbui naxan bama gbeti raxunuxi ra.

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord has said: Because you have all become waste metal, see, I will get you together inside Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: ‹Wo to bara lu alɔ gbeti gbi, n wo malanma nɛ Darisalamu,

sentences.english: As they put silver and brass and iron and lead and tin together inside the oven, heating up the fire on it to make it soft; so will I get you together in my wrath and in my passion, and, heating the fire with my breath, will make you soft.
sentences.susu: n ma xɔnɛ fa wo raxunu alɔ gbeti, wure gbeeli, wure, yɔxui, nun sunbui raxunuma ki naxɛ tɛ ra.

sentences.english: Yes, I will take you, breathing on you the fire of my wrath, and you will become soft in it.
sentences.susu: N wo malanma nɛ n ma bɔɲɛte kui, n fa wo raxunu Darisalamu taa kui.

sentences.english: As silver becomes soft in the oven, so you will become soft in it; and you will be certain that I the Lord have let loose my passion on you.
sentences.susu: Wo na raxunu naa, wo a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra, naxan a xa xɔnɛ radinxi wo ma.›»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, say to her, You are a land on which no rain or thunderstorm has come in the day of wrath.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, a fala Isirayila bɔxi bɛ, i naxɛ: ‹Bɔxi nan i ra, naxan mu tunɛ toma n ma xɔnɛ lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: Her rulers in her are like a loud-voiced lion violently taking his food; they have made a meal of souls; they have taken wealth and valued property; they have made great the number of widows in her.
sentences.susu: I xa mangɛe xaxili luma nɛ alɔ yɛtɛ xaaɲɛ naxan sube ibɔɔma. E na na mɔɔli rabafe mixie ra. Ginɛe na findife kaaɲɛe ra e xa faxɛ tife xa fe ra. E na muɲɛ tife alɔ fe.

sentences.english: Her priests have been acting violently against my law; they have made my holy things unclean: they have made no division between what is holy and what is common, and they have not made it clear that the unclean is different from the clean, and their eyes have been shut to my Sabbaths, and I am not honoured among them.
sentences.susu: I xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe n ma sɛriyɛ matandima, e see sɛniyɛnxi findima se sɛniyɛntare ra. E mu se sɛniyɛnxi nun se sɛniyɛntare tagi rasama, e mu mixie fan nakolonma na tagi rasa ra. E mu n ma malabui lɔxɔɛ xa yaamari suxuma. Na birin kui, e n xili maberema e ya ma.

sentences.english: Her rulers in her are like wolves violently taking their food; putting men to death and causing the destruction of souls, so that they may get their profit.
sentences.susu: I xa kuntigie luxi nɛ alɔ wulai bare naxee sube ibɔɔma. E mixie faxa muɲɛ tife ma.

sentences.english: And her prophets have been using whitewash, seeing foolish visions and making false use of secret arts, saying, This is what the Lord has said, when the Lord has said nothing.
sentences.susu: I xa namiɲɔnmɛe dugi felenma na birin ma e xa wule laamatunyie nun e xa wule masenyie ra. E naxɛ, «Ala nan a masenxi,» a fa li Ala mu sese masenxi e bɛ.

sentences.english: The people of the land have been acting cruelly, taking men's goods by force; they have been hard on the poor and those in need, and have done wrong to the man from a strange land.
sentences.susu: Bɔxikae e bore rawalima tinxintareya kui. E muɲɛ tima, e setaree nun xɔɲɛe tɔɔrɔma. E mu tinxin feo.›»

sentences.english: And I was looking for a man among them who would make up the wall and take his station in the broken place before me for the land, so that I might not send destruction on it: but there was no one.
sentences.susu: «N bara mixi nde fen e ya ma, naxan nɔma tɛtɛ rakelide, a fa ti naadɛ ya ra n ya i, alako na bɔxi naxa kana. Kɔnɔ n mu na mixi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And I let loose my passion on them, and have put an end to them in the fire of my wrath: I have made the punishment of their ways come on their heads, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, n fama n ma xɔnɛ raminide e ma alɔ tɛ, n e sɔntɔ e xa wali ɲaaxi sare ma. Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: The word of the Lord came to me again, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother:
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, ginɛ firin xa taruxui nan yi ki, e birin nga keren.

sentences.english: They were acting like loose women in Egypt; when they were young their behaviour was loose: there their breasts were crushed, even the points of their young breasts were crushed.
sentences.susu: E fonike tɛmui, e naxa e yɛtɛ findi langoe ginɛe ra Misira bɔxi ma. Na ginɛdimɛdie naxa tin xɛmɛe xa e xiɲɛe masuxu.

sentences.english: Their names were Oholah, the older, and Oholibah, her sister: and they became mine, and gave birth to sons and daughters. As for their names, Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem, Oholibah.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxan fori, a nu xili Ohola, a xunya xili Oholiba. E nu na n ma ɲama nan ya ma, e fa die bari. Ohola misaalixi Samari nan na, Oholiba misaalixi Darisalamu nan na.»

sentences.english: And Oholah was untrue to me when she was mine; she was full of desire for her lovers, even for the Assyrians, her neighbours,
sentences.susu: «Ohola naxa a yɛtɛ mati langoeɲa ra a nu na n ma niini bun ma tɛmui naxɛ. A naxa a ɲɛngɛ maxanu naxee findi Asiriyakae ra, sɔɔri tofanyi naxee

sentences.english: Who were clothed in blue, captains and rulers, all of them young men to be desired, horsemen seated on horses.
sentences.susu: gɛrɛ dugi ragoroma e ma, e findi mangɛe ra, e findi soe ragie ra.

sentences.english: And she gave her unclean love to them, all of them the noblest men of Assyria: and she made herself unclean with the images of all who were desired by her.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yɛtɛ fi e ma langoeɲa ra e tide to nu gbo, a man fa bira e xa kuyee fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And she has not given up her loose ways from the time when she was in Egypt; for when she was young they were her lovers, and by them her young breasts were crushed, and they let loose on her their unclean desire.
sentences.susu: A mu a xa langoe fe lu na, a naxan fɔlɔxi Misira bɔxi ma, xɛmɛe xa a xiɲɛ fanyie masuxu, e e waxɔnfe raba a ra.»

sentences.english: For this cause I gave her up into the hands of her lovers, into the hands of the Assyrians on whom her desire was fixed.
sentences.susu: «Na nan a to, n naxa a lu a ɲɛngɛ Asiriyakae sagoe, a naxee maxanu.

sentences.english: By these her shame was uncovered: they took her sons and daughters and put her to death with the sword: and she became a cause of wonder to women; for they gave her the punishment which was right.
sentences.susu: Nee nan a rageli ti, e naxa a xa die tongo, e a fan faxa santidɛgɛma ra. A xili naxa findi konbi ra ginɛe tagi a xa ɲaxankatɛ xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And her sister Oholibah saw this, but her desire was even more unmeasured, and her loose behaviour was worse than that of her sister.
sentences.susu: «A xunya Oholiba naxa na to, kɔnɔ a tan xa ɲɛngɛ suxufe nu xɔrɔxɔ a taara bɛ, a naxa bu langoeɲa kui.

sentences.english: She was full of desire for the Assyrians, captains and rulers, her neighbours, clothed in blue, horsemen going on horses, all of them young men to be desired.
sentences.susu: A fan nu wama sɔɔri Asiriyakae xɔn, naxee findi mangɛ ra, naxee findi soe ragie ra. E birin tofan e xa sɔɔri dugi kui.

sentences.english: And I saw that she had become unclean; the two of them went the same way.
sentences.susu: N naxa a to a fan nu na sɛniyɛntareɲa kui alɔ a taara.»

sentences.english: And her loose behaviour became worse; for she saw men pictured on a wall, pictures of the Chaldaeans painted in bright red,
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ a tan bara fe gbɛtɛ sa na fari. A to Kalidikae xa pirinti gbeeli to banxi xalɛ nde ma,

sentences.english: With bands round their bodies and with head-dresses hanging round their heads, all of them looking like rulers, like the Babylonians, the land of whose birth is Chaldaea.
sentences.susu: bɛlɛti xirixi e tagi, xun sase dɔxɔxi e xun, naxee findi sɔɔri mangɛ Kalidikae ra, naxee sɔɔri ragise ragima,

sentences.english: And when she saw them she was full of desire for them, and sent servants to them in Chaldaea.
sentences.susu: a naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ Kalidi bɔxi ma e xilide barima a nu wama e xɔn.

sentences.english: And the Babylonians came to her, into the bed of love, and made her unclean with their loose desire, and she became unclean with them, and her soul was turned from them.
sentences.susu: E to fa a yire, e naxa sa e bore fɛ ma, e e sago raba. E to na fe sɛniyɛntare raba, e xa fe naxa raɲaaxu a ma, a gbilen e fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: So her loose behaviour was clearly seen and her shame uncovered: then my soul was turned from her as it had been turned from her sister.
sentences.susu: A to nu na na langoeɲa yaagitareya kui, a naxa raɲaaxu n fan ma, n fa a rabolo alɔ n na rabaxi a xunya ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But still she went on the more with her loose behaviour, keeping in mind the early days when she had been a loose woman in the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: A to ratu a xa fonikeya sɛniyɛntareya ma Misira bɔxi ma, a naxa lu langoeɲa raba ra dangife a singe ra.

sentences.english: And she was full of desire for her lovers, whose flesh is like the flesh of asses and whose seed is like the seed of horses.
sentences.susu: A ɲɛngɛ xa fe nu xɔrɔxɔ a ma. E sɛnbɛ to gboxi yɛnɛ rabade alɔ sofalee nun soee.

sentences.english: And she made the memory of the loose ways of her early years come back to mind, when her young breasts were crushed by the Egyptians.
sentences.susu: Na nan na ki, wo xa langoeɲa wo fonike ra na xɔli bara wo suxu alɔ a singe ra, Misira xɛmɛe nu wo xiɲɛ masuxuma tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: For this cause, O Oholibah, this is what the Lord has said: See, I will make your lovers come up against you, even those from whom your soul is turned away in disgust; and I will make them come up against you on every side;
sentences.susu: «Oholiba, Alatala yi nan masenxi na xa fe ra: ‹N i ɲɛngɛe bɔɲɛ ratema nɛ i gerefe ma, i mɛxi naxee ra. N e rakelima yire birin fafe ra i gerede.

sentences.english: The Babylonians and all the Chaldaeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them: young men to be desired, captains and rulers all of them, and chiefs, her neighbours, all of them on horseback.
sentences.susu: Babilɔnkae Kalidikae, Pekodikae, Sowakae, Kowakae, nun Asiriyakae xa sɔɔri sɛnbɛmae, mangɛe nun soe ragie,

sentences.english: And they will come against you from the north on horseback, with war-carriages and a great band of peoples; they will put themselves in order against you with breastplate and body-cover and metal head-dress round about you: and I will make them your judges, and they will give their decision against you as seems right to them.
sentences.susu: e birin fama nɛ i xili ma nun e xa geresosee ra, e xa sɔɔri ragisee ra, e xa kote xanin see ra, nun e xa sɔɔri gaali ra. E i rabilinma nɛ, wure lefae na e bɛlɛxɛe, makantasee na e xunyi ma. N i soma nɛ e yi ra, alako e xa i ɲaxankata e gbe ki ma.

sentences.english: And my bitter feeling will be working against you, and they will take you in hand with passion; they will take away your nose and your ears, and the rest of you will be put to the sword: they will take your sons and daughters, and the rest of you will be burned up in the fire.
sentences.susu: N n ma xɔnɛ raminima nɛ i ma, e fan i gerema nɛ e xa xɔnɛ ra. E i xa mixie ɲɔɛ nun tulie xabama nɛ. Naxee luxi, e e tan faxama nɛ santidɛgɛma ra. E i xa die xaninma nɛ. Naxee luxi, e e tan ganma nɛ.

sentences.english: And they will take all your clothing off you and take away your ornaments.
sentences.susu: E i xa sosee nun i xa xunmasee tofanyie xaninma nɛ.

sentences.english: So I will put an end to your evil ways and your loose behaviour which came from the land of Egypt: and your eyes will never be lifted up to them again, and you will have no more memory of Egypt.
sentences.susu: N i xa langoeɲa danma nɛ, i naxan fɔlɔxi Misira. I mu i ɲɔxɔ rasigama na ma sɔnɔn.›»

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord has said: See, I will give you up into the hands of those who are hated by you, into the hands of those from whom your soul is turned away in disgust:
sentences.susu: «I Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: ‹A gbe mu luxi n xa i sa i yaxuie sagoe, naxee nu raɲaaxu i ma a singe ra, i fa gbilen e fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And they will take you in hand with hate, and take away all the fruit of your work, and let you be unveiled and without clothing: and the shame of your loose behaviour will be uncovered, your evil designs and your loose ways.
sentences.susu: E i gerema nɛ, e i harige birin ba i yi ra. E i luma i mageli nan na i xa langoeɲa xa yaagi kui.

sentences.english: They will do these things to you because you have been untrue to me, and have gone after the nations, and have become unclean with their images.
sentences.susu: I xa wali sɛniyɛntare bara yi gbaloe fi i ma, barima si gbɛtɛe xɔli nu na i ma, i fa fe ɲaaxi raba e xa kuyee ra.

sentences.english: You have gone in the way of your sister; and I will give her cup into your hand.
sentences.susu: I to iɲɛrɛ i taara xa kira xɔn ma, n a xa ɲaxankatɛ tɔnbili nan soma i yi ra.›»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: You will take a drink from your sister's cup, which is deep and wide: you will be laughed at and looked down on, more than you are able to undergo.
sentences.susu: «Alatala yi nan masenxi: ‹I i taara xa ɲaxankatɛ tɔnbili xungbe tongoma nɛ, i fa ɲaxankatɛ gbegbe sɔtɔ, naxan na a kui, a fa findi yaagi belebele ra i bɛ.

sentences.english: You will be broken and full of sorrow, with the cup of wonder and destruction, with the cup of your sister Samaria.
sentences.susu: Na ɲaxankatɛ nan a niyama i fa lu alɔ siisila nimisaxi. Na findima kasarɛ nun kanari nan na i bɛ, alɔ a nu na ki naxɛ i xunya Samari bɛ.

sentences.english: And after drinking it and draining it out, you will take the last drops of it to the end, pulling off your breasts: for I have said it, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: I fama nɛ na birin sɔtɔde han a dangi a i, i fa i yɛtɛ xiɲɛ ibɔɔ sunnunyi kui. I Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.›»

sentences.english: So this is what the Lord has said: Because you have not kept me in your memory, and because your back has been turned to me, you will even undergo the punishment of your evil designs and your loose ways.
sentences.susu: «Alatala yi nan masenxi na xa fe ra: ‹I to bara nɛɛmu n ma, i fa i kobe raso n na, a lanma nɛ i xa i xa langoeɲa kote xanin.›»

sentences.english: Then the Lord said to me: Son of man, will you be the judge of Oholibah? then make clear to her the disgusting things she has done.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ, «Adamadi, i Ohola nun Oholiba makiitima nɛ? E rakolon e xa wali ɲaaxie ra.

sentences.english: For she has been false to me, and blood is on her hands, and with her images she has been untrue; and more than this, she made her sons, whom she had by me, go through the fire to them to be burned up.
sentences.susu: E bara yɛnɛ raba, e bara faxɛ ti, e bara yɛnɛ raba e xa kuyee ra, e bara e xa die fan gan sɛrɛxɛ ra na kuyee bɛ. Na die nu findixi n tan nan gbe ra.

sentences.english: Further, this is what she has done to me: she has made my holy place unclean and has made my Sabbaths unclean.
sentences.susu: E man yi nan nabaxi n na: E bara n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi findi yire sɛniyɛntare ra, e n ma malabui lɔxɔɛe fan mabere.

sentences.english: For when she had made an offering of her children to her images, she came into my holy place to make it unclean; see, this is what she has done inside my house.
sentences.susu: E to nu e xa die bama sɛrɛxɛ ra e xa kuyee bɛ lɔxɔɛ naxɛ, e man so nɛ n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, e a findi yire sɛniyɛntare ra. E na nan nabaxi n ma banxi kui.»

sentences.english: And she even sent for men to come from far away, to whom a servant was sent, and they came: for whom she was washing her body and painting her eyes and making herself fair with ornaments.
sentences.susu: «E naxa xɛɛrae xɛɛ yire makuye, alako mixie xa fa. E to i yire li, i naxa i maxa, i lini ti i yae ra, i i xa xunmase tofanyi gbaku i kɔn ma alako i xa rafan e ma.

sentences.english: And she took her seat on a great bed, with a table put ready before it on which she put my perfume and my oil.
sentences.susu: I naxa e rasɛnɛ sade fanyi ma, i n ma surayi nun ture dɔxɔ teebili ra.»

sentences.english: ... and they put jewels on her hands and beautiful crowns on her head.
sentences.susu: «Ɲama nu na i rabilinyi. Sebakae fan nu na naxee keli gbengberenyi ma. E nu bɛlɛxɛrasoe soma i tan nun i xunya bɛlɛxɛ ra, e fa mangɛ nimitɛ tofanyi dusu wo xunyie ma.

sentences.english: Then I said ... now she will go on with her loose ways.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n naxa a fala na ginɛ xa fe ra naxan nu bara tagan a xa langoeɲa rabafe ra, ‹Wo xa a tongo langoe ginɛ ra, barima a na gbansan nan kolon.›

sentences.english: And they went in to her, as men go to a loose woman: so they went in to Oholibah, the loose woman.
sentences.susu: E naxa sa na ginɛ fɛ ma langoe ki ma. E e sa Ohola nun Oholiba fɛ ma na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And upright men will be her judges, judging her as false wives and women who take lives are judged; because she has been untrue to me and blood is on her hands.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ tinxintɔɛ e makiitima nɛ e xa yɛnɛ xa fe ra, a nun e xa faxɛ tife xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord has said: I will make a great meeting of the people come together against her, and will send on her shaking fear and take everything from her.
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: ‹Gali nde xa te e xili ma, e xa e xun nakana, e harige birin xanin.

sentences.english: And the meeting, after stoning her with stones, will put an end to her with their swords; they will put her sons and daughters to death and have her house burned up with fire.
sentences.susu: Na gali e magɔnɔma nɛ gɛmɛe ra, a e faxa e xa santidɛgɛmae ra. A e xa die faxa, a e xa banxie gan tɛ ra.›»

sentences.english: And I will put an end to evil in all the land, teaching all women not to do as you have done.
sentences.susu: «N langoeɲa ɲɔnma na ki nɛ wo xa bɔxi kui, alako ginɛe xa a kolon a mu lanma e xa ɲɛrɛ wo gbe ki ma.

sentences.english: And I will send on you the punishment of your evil ways, and you will be rewarded for your sins with your images: and you will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa yɛnɛ kote nun wo xa kuye batui kote na dɔxɔ wo xun ma, wo a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na wo Marigi Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, saying,
sentences.susu: A ɲɛ solomanaani nde, kike fu, xi fu nde ra, Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, put down in writing this very day: The king of Babylon let loose the weight of his attack against Jerusalem on this very day.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i xa yi ɲɛ, yi kike, nun yi lɔxɔɛ sɛbɛ, barima to Babilɔn mangɛ gere fɔlɔma nɛ Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And make a comparison for this uncontrolled people, and say to them, This is what the Lord has said: Put on the cooking-pot, put it on the fire and put water in it:
sentences.susu: I xa yi taali wɔyɛnyi fala yi bɔnsɔɛ murutaxi bɛ. A fala e bɛ: ‹Alatala yi nan masenxi: Ye sa tunde kui, tunde dɔxɔ tɛ ma.

sentences.english: And get the bits together, the fat tail, every good part, the leg and the top part of it: make it full of the best bones.
sentences.susu: Sube xuti fanyie sa a kui, xutie naxee fan a birin bɛ alɔ tabe nun tunki sube,

sentences.english: Take the best of the flock, put much wood under it: see that its bits are boiling well; let the bones be cooked inside it.
sentences.susu: naxan xabaxi xuruse fate fanyi ra. Yege sa tɛ han tunde xa satun, sube xa ɲin.›»

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord has said: A curse is on the town of blood, the cooking-pot which is unclean inside, which has never been made clean! take out its bits; its fate is still to come on it.
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: Gbaloe bara yi bɔxi li. Ye bara so sube ra tunde kui. Sube xuti birin ba keren kerenyi ra.

sentences.english: For her blood is in her; she has put it on the open rock not draining it on to the earth so that it might be covered with dust;
sentences.susu: Mixi kɔn to raxaba, a raba fanye nan fari. Xa a sa raba bɔxi nɛ nu, bɛndɛ nu nɔma a makotode.

sentences.english: In order that it might make wrath come up to give punishment, she has put her blood on the open rock, so that it may not be covered.
sentences.susu: N fan fama nɛ wo wuli rafilide n gbeɲɔxɔɛ ra fanye fari, alako a naxa makoto.»

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord has said: A curse is on the town of blood! and I will make great the burning mass.
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: ‹Ɲaxankatɛ na yi taa faxɛti bɛ. N yege gbegbe sama nɛ na tɛ xɔɔra.

sentences.english: Put on much wood, heating up the fire, boiling the flesh well, and making the soup thick, and let the bones be burned.
sentences.susu: Wo fan yege sa tɛ, a xa xungbo. Sube ɲin a fanyi ra, bɔrɛ se sa a fari, a xɔrie xa gan feo.

sentences.english: And I will put her on the coals so that she may be heated and her brass burned, so that what is unclean in her may become soft and her waste be completely taken away.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, tunde igeli xa dɔxɔ tige wolenxi fari, han tunde xa fura alɔ wure gbeeli naxan wama raxunufe, alako se birin naxan luxi tunde kui a xa ɲɔn.

sentences.english: I have made myself tired to no purpose: still all the waste which is in her has not come out, it has an evil smell.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na mu sɔɔnɛyama. Tɛ mu nɔma se birin xɔride naxan luma tunde kui.›»

sentences.english: As for your unclean purpose: because I have been attempting to make you clean, but you have not been made clean from it, you will not be made clean till I have let loose my passion on you in full measure.
sentences.susu: «Wo bara findi sɛniyɛntaree ra wo xa yɛnɛ xa fe ra. N bara kata wo rasɛniyɛnde, kɔnɔ wo mu tin. Na kui wo mu sɛniyɛnyi sɔtɔma han n gɛ n ma xɔnɛ birin naminide wo ma.

sentences.english: I the Lord have said the word and I will do it; I will not go back or have mercy, and my purpose will not be changed; in the measure of your ways and of your evil doings you will be judged, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N tan Alatala xa a fala wo bɛ, na waxati bara a li. N mu kinikinima wo ma, n mu gbilenma n ma natɛ ma. N wo makiitima wo ɲɛrɛ ki nun wo xa wali nan ma. Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan nan ki.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, see, I am taking away the desire of your eyes by disease: but let there be no sorrow or weeping or drops running from your eyes.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, a gbe mu luxi n xa a niya a naxan nafan i ma dangife i yae yati ra, n fama nɛ na ralɔɛde i ma keren na. Kɔnɔ i naxan nabama, i naxa wa xui yo ramini, i naxa ya ye keren namini.

sentences.english: Let there be no sound of sorrow; make no weeping for your dead, put on your head-dress and your shoes on your feet, let not your lips be covered, and do not take the food of those in grief.
sentences.susu: I xa i sabari i xa sunnunyi kui, i naxa i xui ramini alɔ mixie darixi a raba ra faxa mixie bɛ ki naxɛ. I naxa i xunyi mageli ti, i naxa sankiri ba i sanyi, i naxa i yatagi makoto, i naxa donse don mixie darixi naxan don na ɲɔn fe tɛmui.»

sentences.english: So in the morning I was teaching the people and in the evening death took my wife; and in the morning I did what I had been ordered to do.
sentences.susu: N ma ginɛ naxa faxa na nunmare ra. Na kuye iba gɛɛsɛgɛ, n naxa a raba alɔ Alatala nu bara n yamari ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the people said to me, Will you not make clear to us the sense of these things; is it for us you do them?
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa n maxɔrin, «I na yi ɲɔn fe rabafe ki naxɛ, na munse masenma muxu tan bɛ?»

sentences.english: Then I said to them, The word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: N naxa e yaabi, «Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Say to the people of Israel, The Lord has said, See, I will make my holy place unclean, the pride of your strength, the pleasure of your eyes, and the desire of your soul; and your sons and daughters, who did not come with you here, will be put to the sword.
sentences.susu: ‹A fala Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ bɛ, wo Marigi Alatala naxɛ, a gbe mu luxi n xa a niya n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa findi yire sɛniyɛntare ra, na banxi naxan nafan wo ma ki fanyi ra. Wo xa die man faxama nɛ santidɛgɛma ra.›

sentences.english: And you will do as I have done, not covering your lips or taking the food of those in grief.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui wo fama na ɲɔn fe suxude alɔ n a suxu ki naxɛ. Wo mu wo yatagi makotoma, wo mu ɲɔn fe donse donma,

sentences.english: And your head-dresses will be on your heads and your shoes on your feet: there will be no sorrow or weeping; but you will be wasting away in the punishment of your evil-doing, and you will be looking at one another in wonder.
sentences.susu: wo mu wo xunyi mageli tima, wo mu sankiri bama wo sanyi. Wo mu ɲɔn fe rabama wa xui ra. Wo xa yunubie nan tun wo xun nakanama.

sentences.english: And Ezekiel will be a sign to you; everything he has done you will do: when this takes place, you will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ala man naxɛ, ‹Annabi Esekiyeli findima wo bɛ misaali nan na. A naxan nabaxi, wo fan fama na nan nabade. Na fee na raba, wo a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na wo Marigi Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: And as for you, son of man, your mouth will be shut in the day when I take from them their strength, the joy of their glory, the desire of their eyes, and that on which their hearts are fixed, and their sons and daughters.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, n xa a fala i bɛ, n e xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi, naxan nafanxi e ma ki fanyi ra, a nun e xa die, n nee bama e yi ra lɔxɔɛ naxɛ,

sentences.english: In that day, one who has got away safe will come to you to give you news of it.
sentences.susu: na lɔxɔɛ yati mixi ratangaxi fama nɛ i yire, a na xibaarui fala i bɛ.

sentences.english: In that day your mouth will be open to him who has got away safe, and you will say words to him and your lips will no longer be shut: so you will be a sign to them and they will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, i nɛnyi fulunma nɛ na mixi ratangaxi ya xɔri, i mu findima boboe ra sɔnɔn. Na birin findima misaali nan na ɲama bɛ, e fa a kolonde a n tan nan na Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, let your face be turned to the children of Ammon, and be a prophet against them:
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i xa n ma masenyi ti Amonikae xili ma.

sentences.english: And say to the children of Ammon, Give ear to the word of the Lord; this is what the Lord has said: Because you said, Aha! against my holy place when it was made unclean, and against the land of Israel when it was made waste, and against the people of Judah when they were taken away as prisoners;
sentences.susu: A fala e bɛ, ‹Wo wo tuli mati wo Marigi Alatala xui ra. A yi nan masenxi: Wo to yele n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa sɛniyɛnyi kanafe ra, a nun Isirayila xa bɔxi xa kanari, a nun Yuda bɔnsɔɛ sigafe ra konyiya kui,

sentences.english: For this cause I will give you up to the children of the east for their heritage, and they will put their tent-circles in you and make their houses in you; they will take your fruit for their food and your milk for their drink.
sentences.susu: n wo sama nɛ sogetedekae sagoe. E yonkinma nɛ wo tagi, e wo xa donse don, e wo xa xiɲɛ min.

sentences.english: And I will make Rabbah a place for housing camels, and the children of Ammon a resting-place for flocks: and you will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: N Raaba findima ɲɔxɔmɛ gɔɔrɛ nan na, n Amoni bɔxi findi yɛxɛɛ malabude ra. Wo a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: For the Lord has said, Because you have made sounds of joy with your hands, stamping your feet, and have been glad, putting shame with all your soul on the land of Israel;
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala yi masenxi, a naxɛ, ‹Wo tan bɔɲɛ ɲaaxie to fare boron ɲɛlɛxinyi kui n ma ɲama xa gbaloe xa fe ra,

sentences.english: For this cause my hand has been stretched out against you, and I will give up your goods to be taken by the nations; I will have you cut off from the peoples and will put an end to you among the countries: I will give you up to destruction; and you will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: n fama nɛ n bɛlɛxɛ italade wo xili ma, n wo sa si gbɛtɛe sagoe. N wo si ɲɔnma nɛ duniɲa ma. N na gɛ na rabade, wo a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: Because Moab and Seir are saying, See, the people of Judah are like all the nations;
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, a naxɛ, ‹Mowaba nun Seyiri to bara a fala a Yuda bɔnsɔɛ luxi nɛ alɔ ɲamanɛe birin,

sentences.english: For this cause, I will let the side of Moab be uncovered, and his towns on every side, the glory of the land, Beth-jeshimoth, Baal-meon and as far as Kiriathaim.
sentences.susu: n fama nɛ a niyade a xa bɔxi fanyi keli Beti Yesimoti ma, Bali Meyoni, han Kiriyatayimi, birin xa lu a yaxuie sagoe.

sentences.english: To the children of the east I have given her for a heritage, as well as the children of Ammon, so that there may be no memory of her among the nations:
sentences.susu: N a fima nɛ sogetedekae ma, a nun Amoni bɔxi n fama naxan xili ɲɔnde duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: And I will be the judge of Moab; and they will see that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: N na gɛ Mowaba ɲaxankatade, e a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: Because Edom has taken his payment from the people of Judah, and has done great wrong in taking payment from them;
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, a naxɛ, ‹Edon bɔnsɔɛ to a gbeɲɔxɔ Yuda bɔnsɔɛ ma, e bara haakɛ sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: The Lord has said, My hand will be stretched out against Edom, cutting off from it man and beast: and I will make it waste, from Teman even as far as Dedan they will be put to the sword.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Alatala yi nan masenxi: N Edon gerema nɛ santidɛgɛma ra, n mixi nun xuruse birin sɔntɔ kelife Teman ma han Dedan.

sentences.english: I will take payment from Edom because of my people Israel; and I will take Edom in hand in my wrath and in my passion: and they will have experience of my reward, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N na n gbeɲɔxɔma nɛ Edon ma n ma ɲama Isirayila saabui ra n ma xɔnɛ bɛrɛ ra. E fama nɛ gbeɲɔxɔɛ kolonde. Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.›»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: Because the Philistines have taken payment, with the purpose of causing shame and destruction with unending hate;
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, a naxɛ, ‹Filisitakae to e gbeɲɔxɔ Yudaya ma e naxan xɔnxi kabi tɛmui xɔnkuye,

sentences.english: The Lord has said, See, my hand will be stretched out against the Philistines, cutting off the Cherethites and sending destruction on the rest of the sea-land.
sentences.susu: n tan wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: N Filisitakae gerema nɛ, n Keriti bɔnsɔɛ ɲɔn, n mixie sɔntɔ naxee sabatixi baa dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And I will take great payment from them with acts of wrath; and they will be certain that I am the Lord when I send my punishment on them.
sentences.susu: N na n gbeɲɔxɔma nɛ e ma n ma xɔnɛ kui. Na tɛmui e a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: Now in the eleventh year, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: A ɲɛ fu nun keren nde, kike xi singe ra, Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, because Tyre has said against Jerusalem, Aha, she who was the doorway of the peoples is broken; she is turned over to them; she who was full is made waste;
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, Tire to bara a kolon a Darisalamu na safe si gbɛtɛe sagoe, a fa a maɲɔxun a nɔma naafuli sɔtɔde na gbaloe raba xa fe ra,

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord has said, See, I am against you, O Tyre, and will send up a number of nations against you as the sea sends up its waves.
sentences.susu: wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, ‹Tire, n tixi wo kanke! N fama nɛ si gbɛtɛe ra wo yire, e din wo ra alɔ baa mɔrɔnyie.

sentences.english: And they will give the walls of Tyre to destruction and have its towers broken: and I will take even her dust away from her, and make her an uncovered rock
sentences.susu: E Tire tɛtɛe birin yensenma nɛ, e wo xa yire makantaxie kana, wo xɔnyi fa findi fanye mageli ra,

sentences.english: She will be a place for the stretching out of nets in the middle of the sea; for I have said it, says the Lord: and her goods will be given over to the nations.
sentences.susu: yɛxɛsuxuie e xa yɛlɛe raxarama dɛnnaxɛ. Alatala xui nan na ki. N a xa naafuli fima nɛ si gbɛtɛe ma,

sentences.english: And her daughters in the open country will be put to the sword: and they will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: a xa mixie faxama nɛ santidɛgɛma ra. Na kui, e a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord has said: See, I will send up from the north Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, king of kings, against Tyre, with horses and war-carriages and with an army and great numbers of people.
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, a naxɛ, ‹N fama nɛ Babilɔn mangɛ xungbe Nebukadansari ra kelife kɔɔla ma, a xa wo tan Tirekae gere a xa sɔɔri gali nun a xa soe ragi gali ra.

sentences.english: He will put to the sword your daughters in the open country: he will make strong walls against you and put up an earthwork against you, arming himself for war against you.
sentences.susu: A wo xa mixie sɔntɔma nɛ santidɛgɛma ra. A yiree mate wo xa tɛtɛe sɛɛti ma alako a xa naa kana. Wo mu nɔma a tɔɔrɔde a xa wure lefae xa fe ra.

sentences.english: He will put up his engines of war against your walls, and your towers will be broken down by his axes.
sentences.susu: A dinma nɛ wo xa naadɛe nun wo xa yire makantaxie ra a xa geresosee ra, han e bira.

sentences.english: Because of the number of his horses you will be covered with their dust: your walls will be shaking at the noise of the horsemen and of the wheels and of the war-carriages, when he comes through your doorways, as into a town which has been broken open.
sentences.susu: A xa soe gali xube ratema nɛ han. Wo xa tɛtɛ sɛrɛnma nɛ e xa soe, e xa sɔɔri ragisee, nun e xa se xanin see xui ra, e na so wo xa tɛtɛ biraxi tagi tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: Your streets will be stamped down by the feet of his horses: he will put your people to the sword, and will send down the pillars of your strength to the earth.
sentences.susu: E wo xa kirae boronma nɛ, e wo xa mixie faxa santidɛgɛma ra, e wo xa banxi fanyie rabira.

sentences.english: They will take by force all your wealth and go off with the goods with which you do trade: they will have your walls broken down and all the houses of your desire given up to destruction: they will put your stones and your wood and your dust deep in the water.
sentences.susu: E wo xa naafuli xaninma nɛ, e wo harige xun nakana. E wo xa tɛtɛ rabira, e wo xa banxie kana, naxan na lu, e na wɔlɛ baa ma.

sentences.english: I will put an end to the noise of your songs, and the sound of your instruments of music will be gone for ever.
sentences.susu: N wo xa sigi sa danma nɛ, wo xa kɔra xui mu mɛma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: I will make you an uncovered rock: you will be a place for the stretching out of nets; there will be no building you up again: for I the Lord have said it, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N i findima fanye mabaxi nan na, yɛlɛ raxarama dɛnnaxɛ. Wo xa taa mu gbilenma ti ra sɔnɔn, barima n xui nan na ki. Wo Marigi Alatala na nan masenxi.›»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said to Tyre: Will not the sea-lands be shaking at the sound of your fall, when the wounded give cries of pain, when men are put to the sword in you?
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi Tire bɛ, a naxɛ, ‹Si gbɛtɛ naxee sabatixi baa dɛ ra, e fama nɛ wo wa xui mɛde yi gbaloe xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Then all the rulers of the sea will come down from their high seats, and put away their robes and take off their clothing of needlework: they will put on the clothing of grief, they will take their seats on the earth, shaking with fear every minute and overcome with wonder at you.
sentences.susu: E xa mangɛe goroma nɛ e xa kibanyie kui, e e xa dugi fanyie ba e ma, e fa sunnun dugi ragoro e ma, alako e xa dɔxɔ wo sɛɛti ma bɔxi ma yaragaaxui kui.

sentences.english: And they will send up a song of grief for you, and say to you, What destruction has come on you, how are you cut off from the sea, the noted town, which was strong in the sea, she and her people, causing the fear of them to come on all the dry land!
sentences.susu: E sunnun suuki nde xabuma nɛ wo xun ma, naxan a falama, Wo xa fe xun bara rakana, wo tan taa sɛnbɛma kunkui raɲɛrɛe. Wo sɛnbɛ nu gbo baa ma, birin nu gaaxuma wo ya ra.

sentences.english: Now the sea-lands will be shaking in the day of your fall; and all the ships on the sea will be overcome with fear at your going.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi si naxee sabatixi baa dɛ ra, e bara gaaxu a fanyi ra wo xa gbaloe xa fe ra.›»

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord has said: I will make you a waste town, like the towns which are unpeopled; when I make the deep come upon you, covering you with great waters.
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, a naxɛ, ‹N na wo xa taa kana, mixi yo mu lu naa sɔnɔn, baa ye fa din na yire ma,

sentences.english: Then I will make you go down with those who go down into the underworld, to the people of the past, causing your living-place to be in the deepest parts of the earth, in places long unpeopled, with those who go down into the deep, so that there will be no one living in you; and you will have no glory in the land of the living.
sentences.susu: na luma nɛ alɔ mixi dangixi naxee bara siga aligiyama. N wo nɔxunma nɛ bɔxi bun ma, wo mu gbilen duniɲa ma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: I will make you a thing of fear, and you will come to an end: even if you are looked for, you will not be seen again for ever, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N wo raɲɔnma nɛ yi gbaloe kui feo. Mixi naxan wo fenma, a mu wo toma sɔnɔn. Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.›»

sentences.english: The word of the Lord came to me again, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: And you, son of man, make a song of grief for Tyre;
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, sunnun suuki ba Tire bɛ.

sentences.english: And say to Tyre, O you who are seated at the doorway of the sea, trading for the peoples with the great sea-lands, these are the words of the Lord: You, O Tyre, have said, I am a ship completely beautiful.
sentences.susu: I xa a fala yi bɔnsɔɛ bɛ, naxan sabatixi baa dɛ ra, naxan yulɛya raba duniɲa birin, ‹Alatala yi nan masenxi: Wo tan Tire, wo naxɛ wo tofan dangi birin na.

sentences.english: Your builders have made your outlines in the heart of the seas, they have made you completely beautiful.
sentences.susu: Wo sɛnbɛ nu gbo baa ma, wo xa kunkui yailanyie nu walima a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: They have made all your boards of fir-trees from Senir: they have taken cedars from Lebanon to make the supports for your sails.
sentences.susu: E nu sipirɛ wuri rawalima kelife Seniri bɔxi ma, e nu sɛdiri wuri rawali kelife Liban bɛla ra.

sentences.english: Of oak-trees from Bashan they have made your driving blades; they have made your floors of ivory and boxwood from the sea-lands of Kittim.
sentences.susu: E nu konde wuri yailan laala ra naxan kelixi Basan. E nu santali wuri rawali kelife Sipiri bɔxi ma kunkui raxunmase ra, e fa gɛmɛ tofanyie raso na wuri kui.

sentences.english: The best linen with needlework from Egypt was your sail, stretched out to be a flag for you; blue and purple from the sea-lands of Elishah gave you shade.
sentences.susu: I xa bɛla yailanxi tasɔxɔɛ tofanyi nan na kelife Misira. Dugi gbɛtɛe fan nu gbakuma wo xa kunkuie ra naxee findixi garɛ dugi ra kelife Elisaha bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: The people of Zidon and Arvad were your boatmen; the wise men of Zemer were in you; they were guiding your ships;
sentences.susu: Sidɔnkae nun Arawadakae nan nu na wo xa laalabae ra, Tirekae nan nu na wo xa kunkui raɲɛrɛe ra.

sentences.english: The responsible men of Gebal and its wise men were in you, making your boards watertight: all the ships of the sea with their seamen were in you trading in your goods.
sentences.susu: Gebalikae nan nu na wo xa kunkui yailanyie ra. Kunkuie nu fama wo yire kelife duniɲa birin ma yulɛya rabade.›»

sentences.english: Cush and Lud and Put were in your army, your men of war, hanging up their body-covers and head-dresses of war in you: they gave you your glory.
sentences.susu: «Perisekae, Lidikae, nun Putikae nan nu na wo xa sɔɔri galie ra, e xa geresosee nun e xa makantasee nu gbakuma wo xɔnyi nɛ. Na birin findixi xili fanyi nan na wo bɛ.

sentences.english: The men of Arvad in your army were on your walls, and were watchmen in your towers, hanging up their arms on your walls round about; they made you completely beautiful.
sentences.susu: Arawada nun Helexi sɔɔrie nan nu wo xa tɛtɛ makantama, Gamadikae nan nu mɛɛnima wo xa yire makantaxie ma, e xa geresosee nun e xa makantasee nu gbakuma wo xɔnyi nɛ. Na birin findixi xili fanyi nan na wo bɛ.»

sentences.english: Tarshish did business with you because of the great amount of your wealth; they gave silver, iron, tin, and lead for your goods.
sentences.susu: Tarasisikae nu gbeti, wure, yɔxui, nun sunbui nan masarama wo xa yirabasee ra.

sentences.english: Javan, Tubal, and Meshech were your traders; they gave living men and brass vessels for your goods.
sentences.susu: Girɛkikae, Tubalikae, nun Mesekikae nu konyie nun wure gbeeli nan masarama wo xa yirabasee ra.

sentences.english: The people of Togarmah gave horses and war-horses and transport beasts for your goods.
sentences.susu: Togaramakae nu soe nun sofale mɔɔli birin nan masarama wo xa yirabasee ra.

sentences.english: The men of Rodan were your traders: a great number of sea-lands did business with you: they gave you horns of ivory and ebony as an offering.
sentences.susu: Dedankae nu sare soma wo xɔnyi sili ɲinyie nun wuri fanyi nan na.

sentences.english: Edom did business with you because of the great number of things which you made; they gave emeralds, purple, and needlework, and the best linen and coral and rubies for your goods.
sentences.susu: Wo tan nun Aramikae nu yulɛya rabama wo bore tagi. E nu gɛmɛ tofanyi, garɛ dugi, dugi rawalixi, dugi masɔxɔxie, baa bun ma gɛmɛ, nun gɛmɛ tofanyi gbeelie nan masarama wo xa yirabasee ra.

sentences.english: Judah and the land of Israel were your traders; they gave grain of Minnith and sweet cakes and honey and oil and perfume for your goods.
sentences.susu: Yudakae nun Isirayilakae nu mɛngi nun fundenyi maniyɛ naxee kelixi Miniti bɔxi ma, donse ɲɔxunmɛe, kumi, ture, nun seri nan masarama wo xa yirabasee ra.

sentences.english: Damascus did business with you because of the great amount of your wealth, with wine of Helbon and white wool.
sentences.susu: Damasikae nu fama wɛni nan na kelife Xelebon nun yɛxɛɛ xabe kelife Saxaru, e nu e masarama wo xa yirabasee ra.

sentences.english: ... for your goods: they gave polished iron and spices for your goods.
sentences.susu: Danakae nun Yawanikae naxee kelixi Usali, e nu wure, kasiya wuri, nun seri nan masarama wo xa yirabasee ra.

sentences.english: Dedan did trade with you in cloths for the backs of horses.
sentences.susu: Dedankae nu fama soe maxiri dugie nan na.

sentences.english: Arabia and all the rulers of Kedar did business with you; in lambs and sheep and goats, in these they did business with you.
sentences.susu: Arabikae nun Kedari mangɛe nu yulɛya rabama wo xɔnyi yɛxɛɛe, si kontonyie, nun sie nan na.

sentences.english: The traders of Sheba and Raamah did trade with you; they gave the best of all sorts of spices and all sorts of stones of great price and gold for your goods.
sentences.susu: Seeba nun Rama yulɛe nu se xiri ɲɔxunmɛ, gɛmɛ tofanyie, nun xɛɛma nan masarama wo xa yirabasee ra.

sentences.english: Haran and Canneh and Eden, the traders of Asshur and all the Medes:
sentences.susu: «Xaranikae, Kannekae, Edenkae, Seebakae, Asiriyakae, nun Kilimadakae birin nu yulɛya rabama wo xɔnyi nɛ.

sentences.english: These were your traders in beautiful robes, in rolls of blue and needlework, and in chests of coloured cloth, corded with cords and made of cedar-wood, in them they did trade with you.
sentences.susu: E nu fama dugi tofanyie, garɛ dugie, dugi tasɔxɔɛe, nun dugi masɔxɔxie mɔɔli birin nan na.»

sentences.english: Tarshish ships did business for you in your goods: and you were made full, and great was your glory in the heart of the seas.
sentences.susu: «Tarasisi kunkuie nan wo xa yulɛya see maxaninma wo bɛ. Wo xa kote gbo naxan ɲɛrɛma baa ma.

sentences.english: Your boatmen have taken you into great waters: you have been broken by the east wind in the heart of the seas.
sentences.susu: Wo xa laala bae wo xaninma yire makuye baa ma, kɔnɔ foye naxan kelima sogetede mabiri, a wo madulama nɛ baa ma.

sentences.english: Your wealth and your goods, the things in which you do trade, your seamen and those guiding your ships, those who make your boards watertight, and those who do business with your goods, and all your men of war who are in you, with all who have come together in you, will go down into the heart of the seas in the day of your downfall.
sentences.susu: Wo xa naafuli, wo xa yulɛya see, wo xa yirabasee, wo xa kunkui ragie, wo xa kunkui yailanyie, wo xa sɔɔrie, wo xa yulɛe, mixi birin naxee na wo xa kunkuie kui, e madulama nɛ na gbaloe lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: At the sound of the cry of your ships' guides, the boards of the ship will be shaking.
sentences.susu: Kunkui raɲɛrɛe gbelegbele xui mɛma nɛ kelife baa dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And all the boatmen, the seamen and those who are expert at guiding a ship through the sea, will come down from their ships and take their places on the land;
sentences.susu: Laala bae, kunkui raɲɛrɛe birin tima baa dɛ ra na fe ma.

sentences.english: And their voices will be sounding over you, and crying bitterly they will put dust on their heads, rolling themselves in the dust:
sentences.susu: E wama, e xa sunnunyi xui ratema wo xa gbaloe xa fe ra, e xube so e xunyie ma wo xa ɲɔn fe tɛmui.

sentences.english: And they will have the hair of their heads cut off because of you, and will put haircloth on their bodies, weeping for you with bitter grief in their souls, even with bitter sorrow.
sentences.susu: E e xunyie bima nɛ sunnunyi kui, e sunnun dugie ragoro e ma. E wa e xui itexi ra, e bɔɲɛ tɔɔrɔma nɛ ki fanyi ra.»

sentences.english: And in their weeping they will make a song of grief for you, sorrowing over you and saying, Who is like Tyre, who has come to an end in the deep sea?
sentences.susu: «Na birin kui e sunnun suuki nde bama nɛ wo bɛ, a falafe ra, ‹Si mundun ɲɔnma yi ki alɔ Tire ɲɔnxi ki naxɛ?›

sentences.english: When your goods went out over the seas, you made numbers of peoples full; the wealth of the kings of the earth was increased with your great wealth and all your goods.
sentences.susu: Wo xa yulɛya kote to ɲɛrɛma baa ma, ɲamanɛe nu ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ wo xa yirabasee ra. Wo xa naafuli nun wo harige nan nu a niyama duniɲa mangɛe xa bannaya sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Now that you are broken by the seas in the deep waters, your goods and all your people will go down with you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi baa tan bara wo xun nakana, a bara wo xa kote nun wo xa mixie don gbiki.

sentences.english: All the people of the sea-lands are overcome with wonder at you, and their kings are full of fear, their faces are troubled.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee sabatixi baa dɛ, e bara gaaxu, hali mangɛe dɛ bara ixara.

sentences.english: Those who do business among the peoples make sounds of surprise at you; you have become a thing of fear, you have come to an end for ever.
sentences.susu: Yulɛ naxee na duniɲa, e birin bara kaaba wo xa gbaloe xa fe ra. Wo xa fe bara ɲɔn kerenyi ra.»

sentences.english: The word of the Lord came to me again, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, This is what the Lord has said: Because your heart has been lifted up, and you have said, I am a god, I am seated on the seat of God in the heart of the seas; but you are man and not God, though you have made your heart as the heart of God:
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, a fala Tire mangɛ bɛ, ‹I Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: I bara la i yɛtɛ ra a falafe ra, «Ala nan n tan na! N dɔxɔxi alae xa kibanyi nan kui baa dɛ ra!» Kɔnɔ i mu findixi ala yo ra, hali i to a maɲɔxunxi a i xaxili luxi nɛ alɔ Ala gbe. Ibunadama tun nan na i ra.

sentences.english: See, you are wiser than Daniel; there is no secret which is deeper than your knowledge:
sentences.susu: I ɲɔxɔ a ma a i xaxili fan dangi Annabi Daniyɛli gbe ra? I gundo fe birin kolon?

sentences.english: By your wisdom and deep knowledge you have got power for yourself, and put silver and gold in your store-houses:
sentences.susu: I xa xaxilimaya bara a niya i xa bannaya sɔtɔ, xɛɛma nun gbeti gboxi i xa naafuli ya ma.

sentences.english: By your great wisdom and by your trade your power is increased, and your heart is lifted up because of your power:
sentences.susu: I fata yulɛya rabade. Na bara findi bannaya ra i bɛ, kɔnɔ a man bara a niya i xa findi yɛtɛ igboe ra.›»

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord has said: Because you have made your heart as the heart of God,
sentences.susu: «Na fe ma, i Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: I ɲɔxɔ a ma i xaxili luxi nɛ alɔ Ala gbe,

sentences.english: See, I am sending against you strange men, feared among the nations: they will let loose their swords against your bright wisdom, they will make your glory a common thing.
sentences.susu: n i yaxui kobie radinma nɛ i ma, alako e xa e xa santidɛgɛmae ba e tɛɛ kui, e xa wo xa tofanyi nun wo xaxilimaya ragoro, i xa fe fanyi xun fa rakana.

sentences.english: They will send you down to the underworld, and your death will be the death of those who are put to the sword in the heart of the seas.
sentences.susu: E i madulama nɛ baa ma, i fa faxɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ sɔtɔ, i goro aligiyama.

sentences.english: Will you say, in the face of those who are taking your life, I am God? but you are man and not God in the hands of those who are wounding you.
sentences.susu: I fama nɛ a falade faxɛtie ya i, ‹Ala na n na›? Mixi nan tun na i ra naxan faxama mixie bɛlɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: Your death will be the death of those who are without circumcision, by the hands of men from strange lands: for I have said it, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: I faxama nɛ yaagi kui alɔ bilakɔrɛ. I Marigi Alatala xui nan nan ki.»

sentences.english: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, make a song of grief for the king of Tyre, and say to him, This is what the Lord has said: You are all-wise and completely beautiful;
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, sunnun suuki nde ba Tire mangɛ bɛ, a falafe ra, ‹I Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: I nu kamalixi xaxilimaya nun tofanyi nan na.

sentences.english: You were in Eden, the garden of God; every stone of great price was your clothing, the sardius, the topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the emerald and the carbuncle: your store-houses were full of gold, and things of great price were in you; in the day when you were made they were got ready.
sentences.susu: A nu luxi nɛ alɔ i sabatixi Ala xa yire fanyi nan kui naxan xili Eden bɔxi. Gɛmɛ tofanyi naxee sare gbo e nu na i yi ra. E xili nu falama: sariduwani, topasi, diyaman, kirosolite, onixi, yasape, safiri, esikaribukulu, nun emerode. Nee nu saxi xɛɛma raxunmasee nan tagi, e findi xurundɛ, bɛlɛxɛrasoe, nun kɔnmagoree ra. Ala na nan birin rafalaxi i bɛ i daa tɛmui.

sentences.english: I gave you your place with the winged one; I put you on the mountain of God; you went up and down among the stones of fire.
sentences.susu: N to i ti mangɛ ra, n malekɛ sɛnbɛ so i yi ra. I nu ɲɛrɛma tɛ nan tagi n ma geya fari.

sentences.english: There has been no evil in your ways from the day when you were made, till sin was seen in you.
sentences.susu: I nu sɛniyɛn kabi i daa lɔxɔɛ, kɔnɔ tinxintareya bara i suxu.

sentences.english: Through all your trading you have become full of violent ways, and have done evil: so I sent you out shamed from the mountain of God; the winged one put an end to you from among the stones of fire.
sentences.susu: I xa yulɛya xa gboe bara i findi yunubitɔɛ ɲaaxi ra. Na kui n naxa i keri Ala xa geya fari, n naxa malekɛ sɛnbɛ ba i yi.

sentences.english: Your heart was lifted up because you were beautiful, you made your wisdom evil through your sin: I have sent you down, even to the earth; I have made you low before kings, so that they may see you.
sentences.susu: I xa tofanyi nan a niya i xa findi yɛtɛ igboe ra. I xa fe kolonyi nan a niya i xun xa rakana. Na kui n naxa i xa fe magoro bɔxi ma alako mangɛe xa i to.

sentences.english: By all your sin, even by your evil trading, you have made your holy places unclean; so I will make a fire come out from you, it will make a meal of you, and I will make you as dust on the earth before the eyes of all who see you.
sentences.susu: I xa yunubie nun i xa tinxintareya i xa yulɛya kui, na bara i xa salidee findi yire sɛniyɛntaree ra. N bara tɛ ramini i xili ma naxan i xun nakanama, n bara i findi xube ra ɲama ya xɔri.

sentences.english: All who have knowledge of you among the peoples will be overcome with wonder at you: you have become a thing of fear, and you will never be seen again.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxee nu i kolon, e birin bara makaaba i xa gbaloe xa fe ra. I xa fe bara ɲɔn kerenyi ra.›»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, let your face be turned to Zidon, and be a prophet against it, and say,
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i xa ti Sidɔn kanke, i xa masenyi ti a bɛ n xili ra, a falafe ra,

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord: See, I am against you, O Zidon; and I will get glory for myself in you: and they will be certain that I am the Lord, when I send my punishments on her, and I will be seen to be holy in her.
sentences.susu: ‹Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: N bara keli i xili ma Sidɔn! N na n ma nɔrɛ masenma nɛ wo tagi. N na wo ɲaxankata, mixie a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra. Na lɔxɔɛ n na n ma sɛniyɛnyi masenma nɛ wo ya ma.

sentences.english: And I will send on her disease and blood in her streets; and the wounded will be falling in the middle of her, and the sword will be against her on every side; and they will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: N wuganyi radinma nɛ wo ma, mixi gbegbe xa faxa taa kui. N santidɛgɛma rawalima nɛ wo xili ma, mixi gbegbe xa sɔntɔ yire birin. Na kui mixie a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: And there will no longer be a plant with sharp points wounding the children of Israel, or a thorn troubling them among any who are round about them, who put shame on them; and they will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Na tɛmui wo mu luma alɔ tunbee Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ sɛɛti ma sɔnɔn, e fa a kolon a n tan nan na e Marigi Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: When I have got together the children of Israel from the peoples among whom they are wandering, and have been made holy among them before the eyes of the nations, then they will have rest in the land which is theirs, which I gave to my servant Jacob
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ, «N na gɛ Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe birin tongode ɲamanɛe tagi e rayensenxi dɛnnaxɛ, n na n ma sɛniyɛnyi masenma nɛ e bɛ ɲamanɛe ya xɔri. Na tɛmui e sabatima nɛ fa e xa bɔxi ma, n naxan fixi n ma konyi Yaxuba ma.

sentences.english: And they will be safe there, building houses and planting vine-gardens and living without fear; when I have sent my punishments on all those who put shame on them round about them; and they will be certain that I am the Lord their God.
sentences.susu: E luma nɛ naa xaxilisa kui, e banxie ti, e sansie si. E dɔxɔ naa xaxilisa kui, n na e dɔxɔbooree ɲaxankatama tɛmui naxɛ, naxee nu bara e tɔɔrɔ ki fanyi ra. Na tɛmui, e a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan e Marigi Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: In the tenth year, in the tenth month, on the twelfth day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: A ɲɛ fu nde, kike fu, xi fu nun firin nde ra, Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, let your face be turned against Pharaoh, king of Egypt, and be a prophet against him and against all Egypt:
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i xa n ma masenyi ti Misira mangɛ nun a xa ɲama bɛ.

sentences.english: Say to them, These are the words of the Lord: See, I am against you, Pharaoh, king of Egypt, the great river-beast stretched out among his Nile streams, who has said, The Nile is mine, and I have made it for myself.
sentences.susu: A fala a bɛ, ‹Alatala yi nan masenxi: N bara keli i xili ma, i tan Misira Firawuna, naxan luxi alɔ sɔɲɛ magaaxuxi xure sɛnkinɛe ma. I naxɛ, «N bara Nili xure daa n yɛtɛ bɛ.»

sentences.english: And I will put hooks in your mouth, and the fish of your streams will be hanging from your skin; and I will make you come up out of your streams, with all the fish of your streams hanging from your skin.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n kɔnyi belebele sɔtima nɛ i banganyie kui, n a niyama nɛ yɛxɛe xa bɔni i xalee ma, n fa i rate xure kui, i tan nun na yɛxɛe birin na.

sentences.english: And I will let you be in the waste land, you and all the fish of your streams: you will go down on the face of the land; you will not be taken up or put to rest in the earth; I have given you for food to the beasts of the field and the birds of the heaven.
sentences.susu: N i luma gbengberenyi nan ma, i tan nun na yɛxɛe birin. Wo luma naa, mixi yo mu wo makɔma. Wo findima donse nan na wulai subee nun xɔnie bɛ.

sentences.english: And it will be clear to all the people of Egypt that I am the Lord, because you have been a false support to the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Misirakae birin a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.›» «Wo bara lu alɔ kale Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ naxan suxu mali se ra,

sentences.english: When they took a grip of you in their hands, you were crushed so that their arms were broken: and when they put their weight on you for support, you were broken and all their muscles gave way.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ wo fa ibɔɔ a bɛlɛxɛ kui, wo a tunki sɔxɔ. E to e xaxili ti wo ra, wo e yanfa nɛ, e fa lu tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord has said: See, I am sending a sword on you, cutting off from you man and beast.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: N fama nɛ santidɛgɛma ra wo xa mixie nun wo xa xuruse faxafe ra.

sentences.english: And the land of Egypt will be an unpeopled waste; and they will be certain that I am the Lord: because he has said, The Nile is mine, and I made it.
sentences.susu: Misira bɔxi na findi yire maxaraxi ra naxan nabɛɲinxi, e a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.» «Wo to a fala, ‹N bara Nili xure daa n yɛtɛ bɛ,›

sentences.english: See, then, I am against you and against your streams, and I will make the land of Egypt an unpeopled waste, from Migdol to Syene, even as far as the edge of Ethiopia.
sentences.susu: n kelima nɛ wo xili ma nun wo xa xuree xili ma. N Misira bɔxi raxarama nɛ, n a rabɛɲin, kelife Migidoli ma, han a sa dɔxɔ Asuwan ra, han Kusi naaninyi ra.

sentences.english: No foot of man will go through it and no foot of beast, and it will be unpeopled for forty years.
sentences.susu: Mixie mu dangima naa, subee mu dangima naa. Mixi yo mu sabatima naa han ɲɛ tongo naani.

sentences.english: I will make the land of Egypt a waste among the countries which are made waste, and her towns will be unpeopled among the towns which have been made waste, for forty years: and I will send the Egyptians in flight among the nations and wandering through the countries.
sentences.susu: N Misira bɔxi rabɛɲinma alɔ yire gbɛtɛe, n a xa taae xun nakanama nɛ alɔ taa gbɛtɛe. N Misirakae rayensenma nɛ duniɲa yire birin.»

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord has said: At the end of forty years I will get the Egyptians together from the peoples where they have gone in flight:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo Marigi Alatala man yi nan masenxi: «Ɲɛ tongo naani dangi xanbi, n man Misirakae malanma nɛ, kelife ɲamanɛe ma n e rayensen dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: I will let the fate of Egypt be changed, and will make them come back into the land of Pathros, into the land from which they came; and there they will be an unimportant kingdom.
sentences.susu: N e ragbilenma nɛ e xɔnyi Patirosi mabiri kelife konyiya kui. N e luma nɛ e xa e yɛtɛ yamari, kɔnɔ e xa mangɛya mu sɛnbɛ gbegbe sɔtɔma.

sentences.english: It will be the lowest of the kingdoms, and never again will it be lifted up over the nations: I will make them small, so that they may not have rule over the nations.
sentences.susu: E mu e xunyi itema bɔxi gbɛtɛ yo xun ma sɔnɔn. N e magoroma nɛ, alako e naxa nɔ ɲamanɛe ra.

sentences.english: And Egypt will no longer be the hope of the children of Israel, causing sin to come to mind when their eyes are turned to them: and they will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: E mu limaniya fima Isirayila ma sɔnɔn. Isirayila na Misira fe maɲɔxun, e ratuma e xa yunubie nan tun ma, e to e xaxili ti e ra. Na tɛmui, e a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na e Marigi Alatala ra.»

sentences.english: Now in the twenty-seventh year, in the first month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: A ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nde, kike singe, xi singe ra, Alatala naxa masen n bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Son of man, Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon, made his army do hard work against Tyre, and the hair came off every head and every arm was rubbed smooth: but he and his army got no payment out of Tyre for the hard work which he had done against it.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, Babilɔn mangɛ Nebukadansari nun a xa sɔɔrie bara kata Tire ragorode, kɔnɔ e mu nɔ a ra fefe ma. E tɔɔrɔ nɛ tun, e mu naafuli yo sɔtɔ na kui.
