sentences.english: And it will come about in that day, when Gog comes up against the land of Israel, says the Lord, that my wrath will come up, and my passion and my bitter feeling.
sentences.susu: Yi nan fama rabade na lɔxɔɛ: Gogo na din Isirayila ra, n ma xɔnɛ tema nɛ alɔ tɛ.

sentences.english: For in the fire of my wrath I have said, Truly, in that day there will be a great shaking in the land of Israel;
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔxi sɛrɛnma nɛ n ma xɔnɛ xungbe kui.

sentences.english: So that the fish of the sea and the birds of heaven and the beasts of the field and everything moving on the earth, and all the men who are on the face of the earth, will be shaking before me, and the mountains will be overturned and the high places will come down, and every wall will come falling down to the earth.
sentences.susu: Yɛxɛe, xɔnie, wulai subee, bubusee, nun adamadie birin, e gaaxuma nɛ n ya ra. Geyae nun tentenyie birama nɛ, banxie xalɛe kana.

sentences.english: And I will send to all my mountains for a sword against him, says the Lord: every man's sword will be against his brother.
sentences.susu: N gere ya rafindima nɛ Gogo ma n ma geyae birin fari! Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki. A xa sɔɔrie e xa santidɛgɛma raminima nɛ e tɛɛ kui e ngaxakerenyie xili ma.

sentences.english: And I will take up my cause against him with disease and with blood; and I will send down on him and on his forces and on the peoples who are with him, an overflowing shower and great ice-drops, fire, and burning.
sentences.susu: N Gogo xun nakanama nɛ wuganyi nun faxɛ tife ra. N tunɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ, balabalanyi, nun tɛ ragoroma nɛ a ma, a nun a xa sɔɔri galie ma kelife duniɲa birin ma.

sentences.english: And I will make my name great and make myself holy, and I will make myself clear to a number of nations; and they will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n na n ma mangɛya nun n ma sɛniyɛnyi masenma nɛ duniɲa si birin bɛ. Na tɛmui, e a kolonma nɛ a Alatala nan n na.»

sentences.english: And you, son of man, be a prophet against Gog, and say, These are the words of the Lord: See, I am against you, O Gog, ruler of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal:
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, n ma masenyi xɔrɔxɔɛ ti mangɛ Gogo bɛ, a falafe ra, ‹Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: Meseki nun Tubali mangɛ Gogo, n bara ti i kanke!

sentences.english: And turning you round, I will be your guide, and make you come up from the inmost parts of the north; I will make you come on to the mountains of Israel:
sentences.susu: N i mafindima nɛ alɔ n wama a xɔn ki naxɛ. N i rakelima i xɔnyi kɔɔla ma, n fa i ra Isirayila geyae ma gere tife ra.

sentences.english: And with a blow I will send your bow out of your left hand and your arrows falling from your right hand.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni n i xa xali nun i xa xali woli se rabirama nɛ.

sentences.english: On the mountains of Israel you will come down, you and all your forces and the peoples who are with you: I will give you to cruel birds of every sort and to the beasts of the field to be their food.
sentences.susu: I tan nun i xa sɔɔrie birin faxama nɛ na geyae longori. N wo findima yubɛe nun burunyi subee xa donse nan na,

sentences.english: You will come down in the open field: for I have said it, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: wo binbie fa lu kɛnɛ ma. Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.

sentences.english: And I will send a fire on Magog, and on those who are living in the sea-lands without fear: and they will be certain that I am the Lord.
sentences.susu: N tɛ soma nɛ Magogo ra, nun yire raxaraxi baa dɛ ra. Na tɛmui, e a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na Alatala ra.›»

sentences.english: And I will make clear my holy name among my people Israel; I will no longer let my holy name be made unclean: and the nations will be certain that I am the Lord, the Holy One in Israel.
sentences.susu: «N na n xili sɛniyɛnxi masenma nɛ n ma ɲama Isirayila bɛ, n man mu tinma sɔnɔn e xa n mabere. Si gbɛtɛe fama nɛ a kolonde, a n tan Alatala nan na Isirayila xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: See, it is coming and it will be done, says the Lord; this is the day of which I have given word.
sentences.susu: Na fe birin fama nɛ rabade. Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki. Lɔxɔɛ na a ra, n naxan xa fe fala.»

sentences.english: And those who are living in the towns of Israel will go out and make fires of the instruments of war, burning the body-covers and the breastplates, the bows and the arrows and the sticks and the spears, and for seven years they will make fires of them:
sentences.susu: «Isirayilaka naxee sabatixi taae kui, e minima geresosee matongode bɔxi ma, alɔ wure lefae, xalie, xalie woli see, tanbɛe, nun wuri faxɛti see, e fa e gan yege fari. Na e hayi fanma ɲɛ solofere nan bun ma.

sentences.english: And they will take no wood out of the field or have any cut down in the woods; for they will make their fires of the instruments of war: and they will take by force the property of those who took their property, and go off with the goods of those who took their goods, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: E mu yege fenma fiili nun fɔtɔnyi ma sɔnɔn, barima geresosee nan findima yege ra e bɛ. Naxee bara wa harige bafe e yi ra, e tan nan fama harige bade nee yi ra. Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And it will come about in those days, that I will give to Gog a last resting-place there in Israel, in the valley of Abarim on the east of the sea: and those who go through will be stopped: and there Gog and all his people will be put to rest, and the place will be named, The valley of Hamon-gog.
sentences.susu: «Na lɔxɔɛ, n a niyama nɛ Gogo xa ragata Isirayila bɔxi ma, gulunba nde kui mixie dangima dɛnnaxɛ sigafe ra baa dɛ ra sogetede mabiri. Na gulunba kira ibolonma nɛ Gogo nun a xa sɔɔrie ragatade xa fe ra. E mɛnni xili sama nɛ ‹Gogo xa ɲama xa gulunba.›»

sentences.english: And the children of Israel will be seven months putting them in the earth, so as to make the land clean.
sentences.susu: «Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ kike solofere nan nabama na mixie ragatafe ra, alako e xa bɔxi xa sɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: And all the people of the land will put them in the earth; and it will be to their honour in the day when I let my glory be seen, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin luma nɛ na wali raba ra. N ma nɔrɛ to lɔxɔɛ findima fe belebele nan na e bɛ. Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.

sentences.english: And they will put on one side men to do no other work but to go through the land and put in the earth the rest of those who are still on the face of the land, to make it clean: after seven months are ended they are to make a search.
sentences.susu: E mixie sugandima nɛ bɔxi rasɛniyɛnde. Nee tan nun e booree luma nɛ bɔxi birin iɲɛrɛ ra binbie ragatafe ra. Na wali buma nɛ ɲɛ solofere.

sentences.english: And while they go through the land, if anyone sees a man's bone, he is to put up a sign by the place till those who are doing the work have put it in the earth in the valley of Hamon-gog.
sentences.susu: E na gɛ na ra, e man bɔxi iɲɛrɛma nɛ mixi xɔrie fende. E na nde to, e tɔnxuma nde ti naa alako gaburi gemae xa a to, e xa na xɔrie xanin Gogo xa ɲama xa gulunba yire.

sentences.english: And there they will put all the army of Gog in the earth. So they will make the land clean.
sentences.susu: E bɔxi rasɛniyɛnma na ki nɛ. Taa nde tima naa, naxan xilima Hamona. Xili nan na ki naxan a falama ‹Ɲama› e gbe xui ra.»

sentences.english: And you, son of man, this is what the Lord has said: Say to the birds of every sort and to all the beasts of the field, Get together and come; come together on every side to the offering which I am putting to death for you, a great offering on the mountains of Israel, so that you may have flesh for your food and blood for your drink.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: A fala wulai xɔnie nun sube mɔɔli birin bɛ, ‹Wo birin xa fa be, n xa n ma sɛrɛxɛ xungbe rafala Isirayila geyae ma. Mɛnni wo sube nun wuli donma nɛ.

sentences.english: The flesh of the men of war will be your food, and your drink the blood of the princes of the earth, of sheep and lambs, of he-goats, of oxen, all of them fat beasts of Bashan.
sentences.susu: Wo sɛnbɛmae sube donma nɛ, wo bɔxi mangɛe wuli min alɔ xuruse naxee raturaxi Basan bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: You will go on feasting on the fat till you are full, and drinking the blood till you are overcome with it, of my offering which I have put to death for you.
sentences.susu: Na sɛrɛxɛ tɛmui, wo wasama nɛ e sube ra, wo siisi e wuli ra.

sentences.english: At my table you will have food in full measure, horses and war-carriages, great men and all the men of war, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo lugama nɛ soe nun a ragimae sube ra, mangɛe nun sɔɔri mɔɔli birin sube. Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.›»

sentences.english: And I will put my glory among the nations, and all the nations will see my punishments which I have put into effect, and my hand which I have put on them.
sentences.susu: «N na n ma nɔrɛ masenma nɛ duniɲa birin bɛ Gogo ɲama xa ɲaxankatɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: So the children of Israel will be certain that I am the Lord their God, from that day and for the future.
sentences.susu: Keli na lɔxɔɛ ma, Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na e Marigi Alatala ra.

sentences.english: And it will be clear to the nations that the children of Israel were taken away prisoners for their evil-doing; because they did wrong against me, and my face was covered from them: so I gave them up into the hands of their attackers, and they all came to their end by the sword.
sentences.susu: Si gbɛtɛe a kolonma nɛ a Isirayila xa yunubie nan a niya e xa siga konyiya kui. E to n yanfa, n naxa n kobe raso e ra, n fa e sa e yaxuie sagoe. Na nan a ra, e naxa faxa santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: In the measure of their unclean ways and their sins, so I did to them; and I kept my face covered from them.
sentences.susu: N e ɲaxankataxi e xa yunubie nun e xa sɛniyɛntareɲa nan ma. Na nan a niyaxi n xa n kobe so e ra.»

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord has said, Now I will let the fate of Jacob be changed, and I will have mercy on all the children of Israel, and will take care of the honour of my holy name.
sentences.susu: «Awa, i Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, a naxɛ: Yakɔsi, n Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ ragbilenma nɛ kelife konyiya kui. N kinikinima nɛ Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe ma, n fa a ragiri n xili xa binya.

sentences.english: And they will be conscious of their shame and of all the wrong which they have done against me, when they are living in their land with no sense of danger and with no one to be a cause of fear to them;
sentences.susu: E na sabati e xɔnyi xaxilisa kui, mixi yo mu e tɔɔrɔ, yaagi man luma nɛ e ma e xa yanfanteya xa fe ra n tan mabiri.

sentences.english: When I have taken them back from among the peoples and got them together out of the lands of their haters, and have made myself holy in them before the eyes of a great number of nations.
sentences.susu: N na e raminima nɛ ɲamanɛe kui, n fa e ra e xɔnyi, ɲamanɛe fa n ma sɛniyɛnyi tode na saabui ra.

sentences.english: And they will be certain that I am the Lord their God, because I sent them away as prisoners among the nations, and have taken them together back to their land; and I have not let one of them be there any longer.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan na e Marigi Alatala ra, barima hali n to e rasiga konyiya kui ɲamanɛe tagi, n man bara e birin nagbilen, mixi yo mu lu e xanbi ra.

sentences.english: And my face will no longer be covered from them: for I have sent the out-flowing of my spirit on the children of Israel, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N mu n kobe soma e ra sɔnɔn, barima n na n Xaxili luma nɛ Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ ma. I Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: In the twenty-fifth year after we had been taken away prisoners, in the first month of the year, on the tenth day of the month, in the fourteenth year after the town was taken, on the very same day, the hand of the Lord was on me, and he took me there.
sentences.susu: Muxu xa konyiya ɲɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli nde ra, ɲɛ kike singe ra, xi fu nde ra, naxan nu ilanxi Darisalamu xa kanɛ dangi xanbi ɲɛ fu nun naani nde ma, na lɔxɔɛ yati yati, Alatala sɛnbɛ naxa goro n ma,

sentences.english: In the visions of God he took me into the land of Israel, and put me down on a very high mountain, on which there was, as it seemed, a building like a town opposite me.
sentences.susu: a n xanin laamatunyi ki ma Isirayila geya itexi nde fari. N naxa taa nde to kɔɔla mabiri.

sentences.english: He took me there, and I saw a man, looking like brass, with a linen cord in his hand and a measuring rod: and he was stationed in the doorway.
sentences.susu: Alatala to n xanin naa, n naxa xɛmɛ nde to, naxan fate nu yanbafe alɔ wure gbeeli. A nu tixi sode dɛ ra, luuti nun maniya se wuri suxuxi a yi ra.

sentences.english: And the man said to me, Son of man, see with your eyes and give hearing with your ears, and take to heart everything I am going to let you see; for in order that I might let you see them, you have come here: and give an account of all you see to the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ naxa a fala n bɛ, a naxɛ, «Adamadi, i ya ti a fanyi ra, i tuli mati n xui ra. N fe naxan birin masenma i bɛ, i xa i ɲɔxɔ sa a xɔn ma, barima i rafaxi nɛ be alako i xa na kolon, i xa na birin tagi raba Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ bɛ.»

sentences.english: And there was a wall on the outside of the house all round, and in the man's hand there was a measuring rod six cubits long by a cubit and a hand's measure: so he took the measure of the building from side to side, one rod; and from base to top, one rod.
sentences.susu: N naxa tɛtɛ nde to naxan hɔrɔmɔbanxi rabilinxi. Wuri maniya se nu na na xɛmɛ yi ra, naxan kuya nɔngɔn ya senni a nun suxui senni. A naxa tɛtɛ xɛlɛ xa maigboe nun a xa maite maniya, e firinyi birin lan na wuri maniyase ya keren nan ma.

sentences.english: Then he came to the doorway looking to the east, and went up by its steps; and he took the measure of the doorstep, one rod wide.
sentences.susu: A naxa siga sode dɛ ra, naxan ya rafindixi sogetede ma. A naxa te na tede ra naxee nu na a ya ra, a sode dɛ xa maite maniya, naxan lan na wuri maniyase ya keren ma.

sentences.english: And the watchmen's rooms were one rod long and one rod wide; and the space between the rooms was five cubits; the doorstep of the doorway, by the covered way of the doorway inside, was one rod.
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔlingira kantamae xa tede nu na sode dɛ sɛɛti ma, kankan xa maite nun maigboe lan na wuri maniyase ya keren nan ma. Xɛlɛ naxan nu na e tagi, na lan nɔngɔn ya suuli nan ma. Buntunyi sode dɛ xa maite fan lan na wuri maniyase ya keren nan ma, naxan ya nu rafindixi hɔrɔmɔbanxi ma.

sentences.english: And he took the measure of the covered way of the doorway inside,
sentences.susu: A naxa buntunyi maniya,

sentences.english: Eight cubits; and its uprights, two cubits; the covered way of the doorway was inside.
sentences.susu: naxan xa kuyɛ lan nɔngɔn ya solomasaxan ma, a kinkie lan nɔngɔn ya firin ma. Na buntunyi ya nu rafindixi hɔrɔmɔbanxi nan ma tɛtɛ kui.

sentences.english: And the rooms of the doorway on the east were three on this side and three on that; all three were of the same size; and the uprights on this side and on that were of the same size.
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔbanxi kantamae tide senni nu na sogetede sode dɛ sɛɛtie ma, sɛɛti keren saxan, sɛɛti boore fan saxan. Nee birin xa maniyɛ xasabi lan, e kinkie fan birin xa maniyɛ xasabi lan.

sentences.english: And he took the measure of the opening of the doorway, ten cubits wide; and the way down the doorway was thirteen cubits;
sentences.susu: A naxa sode dɛ xa maigboe maniya, naxan lan nɔngɔn fu ma, a xa maite lan nɔngɔn fu nun saxan nan ma.

sentences.english: And the space in front of the rooms, a cubit on this side and a cubit on that side; and the rooms six cubits on this side and six cubits on that.
sentences.susu: Xɛlɛ di nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi kantamae xa tidee ya ra, naxan nu ite nɔngɔn ya keren. Na tidee xa maigboe nun e xa maite lan nɔngɔn ya senni nan ma.

sentences.english: And he took the measure of the doorway from the back of one room to the back of the other, twenty-five cubits across, from door to door.
sentences.susu: A naxa a maniya kelife kantama singe xa tide xanbi ra, han boore kantama xa tide xanbi ra, na fa lan nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli ma, kelife yire fanyi ma, han kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: And he took the measure of the covered way, twenty cubits; and opening from the covered way of the doorway was the open square round about.
sentences.susu: A naxa xɛlɛ birin maniya na sode dɛ longori han tɛtɛ kui, na lan nɔngɔn ya tongo senni nan ma.

sentences.english: And from before the opening of the doorway to before the inner covered way of the doorway was fifty cubits.
sentences.susu: Kelife sode dɛ ra, han tɛtɛ kui buntunyi xanbi ra, na lan nɔngɔn ya tongo suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: And the rooms and their uprights had sloping windows inside the doorway all round, and in the same way the covered way had windows all round on the inside: and on every upright there were palm-trees.
sentences.susu: Wundɛrie nu na na xalɛe ma sode dɛ mabiri, alɔ wundɛri gbɛtɛe to nu na xalɛe ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi mabiri. Tugi fɛnsɛe nu masolixi na longori birin.

sentences.english: Then he took me into the outer square, and there were rooms and a stone floor made for the open square all round: there were thirty rooms on the stone floor.
sentences.susu: A to n naso tɛtɛ kui, n naxa yire tongo saxan to naxee fatuxi tɛtɛ ma.

sentences.english: And the stone floor was by the side of the doorways, and was as wide as the doorways were long, even the lower floor.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi nu yailanxi gɛmɛ fanyie nan na naxan xa maite lan tɛtɛ sode dɛ ma.

sentences.english: Then he took the measure of the square across, from before the lower doorway inside to before the inner doorway outside, one hundred cubits. And he took me in the direction of the north,
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ naxa a maniya kelife sode dɛ fɔlɛ ma, han tɛtɛ gbɛtɛ sode dɛ ra naxan nu na na tɛtɛ singe kui. Na lan nɔngɔn kɛmɛ nan ma sogetede mabiri nun kɔɔla mabiri.

sentences.english: And there was a doorway to the outer square, looking to the north; and he took the measure of it to see how wide and how long it was.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, na xɛmɛ naxa tɛtɛ sode dɛ maniya naxan nu na kɔɔla mabiri.

sentences.english: And it had three rooms on this side of it and three on that; its uprights and its covered ways were the same size as those of the first doorway: it was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔbanxi kantamae tidee fan nu na mɛnni alɔ boore sode dɛe ra. Saxan nu na sɛɛti keren, saxan nu na boore sɛɛti. Na xa maite lan nɔngɔn tongo suuli nan ma, a maigboe lan nɔngɔn mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: And its windows, and the windows of its covered ways, and its palm-trees, were the same as those of the doorway looking to the east; and there were seven steps up to it; and the covered way went inside.
sentences.susu: A xa wundɛrie, a xa buntunyi, a xa tugi fɛnsɛ naxee masolixi a ma, nee nun sogetede sode dɛ xa maniyɛ xasabi lan. Santide solofere nan nu na a bɛ tede ra, a xa buntunyi nu na nee nan ya i.

sentences.english: And there was a doorway to the inner square opposite the doorway on the north, like the doorway on the east; and he took the measure from doorway to doorway, a hundred cubits.
sentences.susu: Tɛtɛ firin nde sode dɛ nu na tɛtɛ singe sode dɛ nan ya ra kɔɔla nun sogetede mabiri. Nɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ nu na e tagi.

sentences.english: And he took me to the south, and I saw a doorway looking to the south: and he took the measure of its rooms and its uprights and its covered ways by these measures.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, na xɛmɛ naxa n xanin tɛtɛ sode dɛ yirefanyi mabiri. Mɛnni xa maniyɛ xasabi lan boore sode dɛe xa maniyɛ nan ma.

sentences.english: And there were windows in it and in the covered way all round, like the other windows: it was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
sentences.susu: Wundɛrie nu na na sode dɛ nun a xa buntunyi bɛ e rabilinyi birin ma, alɔ boore sode dɛe. Na sode dɛ nu ite nɔngɔn ya tongo suuli, a nu igbo nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli.

sentences.english: And there were seven steps up to it, and its covered way went inside: and it had palm-trees, one on this side and one on that, on its uprights.
sentences.susu: Santide solofere nan nu na a bɛ tede ra, a xa buntunyi nu na nee nan ya i. Tugi fɛnsɛe nu masolixi a kinkie sɛɛti birin ma.

sentences.english: And there was a doorway to the inner square looking to the south: he took the measure from doorway to doorway to the south, a hundred cubits.
sentences.susu: Tɛtɛ firin nde sode dɛ fan nu na yirefanyi mabiri. Kelife na sode dɛ ma han na tɛtɛ singe sode dɛ yirefanyi mabiri, a lan nɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ nan ma.

sentences.english: Then he took me to the inner square by the south doorway: and he took the measure of the south doorway by these measures;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, na xɛmɛ naxa n xanin na tɛtɛ firin nde kui naxan nu na boore tɛtɛ kui. A naxa n naso na yirefanyi sode dɛ ra. A naxa na maniya. A tan nun sode dɛ booree birin nu lan.

sentences.english: And the rooms in it and the uprights and the covered ways, by these measures:
sentences.susu: A kantamae tidee, a xa kinkie, nun a xa buntunyi xa maniyɛ xasabi lan booree xasabi nan ma. Wundɛrie nu na na sode dɛ nun a xa buntunyi birin nabilinyi ra. Kelife na sode dɛ fɔlɛ ma, han tɛtɛ kui lan nɔngɔn ya tongo suuli nan ma, a igboe lan nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: And there were windows in it and in the covered way all round: it was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
sentences.susu: Buntunyi naxee nu na na tɛtɛ firin nde kui, e xa maigboe lan nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli nan ma, e xa maite lan nɔngɔn ya suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: The covered way was on the side nearest the outer square; and there were palm-trees on the uprights: and there were eight steps going up to it.
sentences.susu: Na buntunyi ya nu rafindixi tɛtɛ singe nan ma. Tugi fɛnsɛe nu masolixi e kinkie ma, tede solomasaxan nan nu na e bɛ.

sentences.english: And he took me into the inner square facing the east: and he took the measure of the doorway by these measures;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, na xɛmɛ naxa n xanin yi tɛtɛ firin nde sode dɛ ra naxan nu na sogetede mabiri. A naxa na maniya. A tan nun sode dɛ booree birin nu lan.

sentences.english: And of the rooms in it and its uprights and its covered ways, by these measures: and there were windows in it and in the covered way round about: it was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
sentences.susu: A kantamae tidee, a xa kinkie, nun a xa buntunyi xa maniyɛ nu lanxi booree xa maniyɛ nan ma. Wundɛrie nu na na sode dɛ nun a xa buntunyi rabilinyi birin ma. A xa maigboe lan nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli nan ma, a xa maite lan nɔngɔn ya suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: And the covered way was on the side nearest the outer square; there were palm-trees on the uprights, on this side and on that: and there were eight steps going up to it.
sentences.susu: Na buntunyi ya nu rafindixi tɛtɛ singe nan ma. Tugi fɛnsɛe nu masolixi e kinkie ma, tede solomasaxan nan nu na e bɛ.

sentences.english: And he took me to the north doorway: and he took the measure of it by these measures;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, na xɛmɛ naxa n xanin yi tɛtɛ firin nde sode dɛ ra, naxan nu na kɔɔla mabiri. A naxa na maniya. A tan nun sode dɛ booree birin nu lan.

sentences.english: Its rooms, its uprights, and its covered way had the same measures, and its covered way had windows all round: it was fifty cubits long and twenty-five cubits wide.
sentences.susu: A kantamae tidee, a xa kinkie, nun a xa buntunyi xa maniyɛ nu lanxi booree xa maniyɛ nan ma. Wundɛrie nu na na sode dɛ nun a xa buntunyi rabilinyi birin ma. A xa maigboe lan nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli nan ma, a xa maite lan nɔngɔn ya suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: Its uprights were on the side nearest to the outer square; there were palm-trees on the uprights, on this side and on that: and there were eight steps going up to it.
sentences.susu: Na buntunyi ya nu rafindixi tɛtɛ singe nan ma. Tugi fɛnsɛe nu masolixi e kinkie ma, tede solomasaxan nan nu na e bɛ.

sentences.english: And there was a room with a door in the covered way of the doorway, where the burned offering was washed.
sentences.susu: Yire nde nu na kankan xa sode dɛ ra, xuruse naxee bama sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, nee nu maxama mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: And in the covered way of the doorway there were two tables on this side and two tables on that side, on which the burned offering and the sin-offering and the offering for error were put to death:
sentences.susu: Teebilie nu na sode dɛ buntun firinyi kui, firin nu na sɛɛti keren ma, firin nu na boore sɛɛti fan ma. Xurusee kɔn naxabama na teebilie nan fari, naxee findi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: On the outer side, to the north, as one goes up to the opening of the doorway, were two tables.
sentences.susu: Teebili gbɛtɛe nu na sode dɛ tede sɛɛtie ma, firin sɛɛti keren, firin boore sɛɛti fan ma, tɛtɛ fari ma buntunyi kui.

sentences.english: There were four tables on one side and four tables on the other, by the side of the doorway; eight tables, on which they put to death the beasts for the offerings.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra teebili naani nu na sode dɛ sɛɛti keren na, naani nu na boore sɛɛti ra. Xurusee nu rafalama na teebilie nan fari beenun e xa ba sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: And there were four tables for the burned offering, made of cut stone, one and a half cubits long, one and a half cubits wide and a cubit high, where the instruments were placed which were used for putting to death the burned offering and the beasts for the offerings.
sentences.susu: Na teebili naanie nu yailanxi gɛmɛe nan na, e nu kuya nɔngɔn ya keren nun a tagi, e nu igbo nɔngɔn ya keren. Yirabasee nu sama nee nan fari, naxee nu lanma e xa rawali xuruse rafalafe ra naxee nu findima sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nun sɛrɛxɛ mɔɔli gbɛtɛe ra.

sentences.english: And they had edges all round as wide as a man's hand: and on the tables was the flesh of the offerings.
sentences.susu: Wuree nu na banxi xɛlɛ ma xurusee nu gbakuma dɛnnaxɛ, e sube sa teebilie fari.

sentences.english: And he took me into the inner square, and there were two rooms in the inner square, one at the side of the north doorway, facing south; and one at the side of the south doorway, facing north.
sentences.susu: Tɛtɛ firin nde sode dɛ sɛɛti firinyie ma, yire nde nu na naxan ya rafindixi yirefanyi ma, yire nde fan nu na naxan ya rafindixi kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: And he said to me, This room, facing south, is for the priests who have the care of the house.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ naxa a fala n bɛ, a naxɛ: «Yire naxan ya rafindixi yirefanyi ma, na findixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe gbe nan na, naxee hɔrɔmɔbanxi makantama.

sentences.english: And the room facing north is for the priests who have the care of the altar: these are the sons of Zadok, who, from among the sons of Levi, come near to the Lord to do the work of his house.
sentences.susu: Yire naxan ya rafindixi kɔɔla ma, na findixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe gbe nan na, naxee sɛrɛxɛbade makantama. Nee findi Sadɔki xa die nan na, naxee findi Lewi bɔnsɔɛ mixi ra, naxee gbansan lan e xa makɔrɛ Alatala yire ra e xa wali kui.»

sentences.english: And he took the measure of the open square, a hundred cubits long and a hundred cubits wide, being square; and the altar was in front of the house.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ naxa tɛtɛ maniya. A xa kuyɛ lan nɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ nan ma, a xa gboe fan lan nɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ nan ma. Sɛrɛxɛbade nu tixi hɔrɔmɔbanxi nan yatagi.

sentences.english: Then he took me to the covered way before the house, and took the measure of its uprights, five cubits on one side and five cubits on the other: and the doorway was fourteen cubits wide; and the side-walls of the doorway were three cubits on one side and three cubits on the other.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ naxa n xanin hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa buntunyi ra. A naxa buntunyi xɛlɛ bun se maniya. Keren lan nɔngɔn ya suuli nan ma, boore fan naxa lan nɔngɔn ya suuli ma. Sode dɛ xa gboe lan nɔngɔn ya fu nun naani nan ma. Banxi xɛlɛ naxee nu na na sɛɛti firinyie ma lan nɔngɔn ya saxan nan ma.

sentences.english: The covered way was twenty cubits long and twelve cubits wide, and they went up to it by ten steps; and there were pillars by the uprights, one on one side and one on the other.
sentences.susu: Na buntunyi xa maigboe lan nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn nan ma, a xa maite lan nɔngɔn ya fu nun firin nan ma. Tedee nu na a bɛ. Kinki firin nu tixi buntunyi xɛlɛ sɛɛtie ma.

sentences.english: And he took me to the Temple, and took the measure of the uprights, six cubits wide on one side and six cubits wide on the other.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ naxa n xanin hɔrɔmɔbanxi yire sɛniyɛnxi kui. A naxa a kinkie maniya naxee nu na naadɛ sɛɛtie ma. Kankan xa gboe naxa lan nɔngɔn ya senni ma.

sentences.english: And the door-opening was ten cubits wide; and the side walls of the door-opening were five cubits on one side and five cubits on the other: and it was forty cubits long and twenty cubits wide.
sentences.susu: Sode dɛ xa gboe lan nɔngɔn ya fu nan ma. Banxi xɛlɛ naxee nu na na sɛɛti firinyie ma, e lan nɔngɔn ya suuli nan ma. A naxa na hɔrɔmɔbanxi maniya. A xa kuyɛ lan nɔngɔn ya tongo naani nan ma, a xa gboe lan nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn nan ma.

sentences.english: And he went inside and took the measure of the uprights of the door-opening, two cubits: and the door-opening, six cubits; and the side-walls of the door-opening were seven cubits on one side and seven cubits on the other.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, na xɛmɛ naxa so hɔrɔmɔbanxi yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante kui. A naxa a kinkie maniya naxee nu na naadɛ sɛɛtie ma. Kankan xa gboe naxa lan nɔngɔn ya firin ma. A sode dɛ lan nɔngɔn ya senni nan ma. Banxi xɛlɛ naxee nu na na sɛɛti firinyie ma, e lan nɔngɔn ya solofere nan ma.

sentences.english: And by his measure it was twenty cubits long and twenty cubits wide in front of the Temple: and he said to me, This is the most holy place.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xa kuyɛ nun a xa gboe maniya, kankan naxa lan nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn ma. A naxa a fala n bɛ, «Yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante nan yi ki.»

sentences.english: Then he took the measure of the wall of the house, which was six cubits; and of the side-rooms round the house, which were four cubits wide.
sentences.susu: A naxa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xɛlɛ maniya. A xa marabinye naxa lan nɔngɔn ya senni ma. Yire naxee nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi rabilinyi ma, kankan xa gboe lan nɔngɔn ya naani nan ma.

sentences.english: And the side-rooms, room over room, were three times thirty; there were inlets in the wall of the house for the side-rooms round about, for supports in the wall of the house.
sentences.susu: Na yiree nu dɔxɔxi e bore nan kɔn na dɛki saxan na. Konkoe tongo saxan nan nu na na dɛki keren keren birin ma. Bun se nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi rabilinyi, kɔnɔ e mu nu rasoxi hɔrɔmɔbanxi xɛlɛ tan kui.

sentences.english: The side-rooms became wider as they went higher up the house, by the amount of the space let into the wall up round about the house, because of the inlets in the house; and one went up from the lowest floor by steps to the middle, and from the middle to the upper floor.
sentences.susu: Dɛkie nu te igbo ra e bore bɛ alako naxan na koore ma naxa igbo dangi lanbanyi daaxi ra. Tedee nu na keli lanbanyi ma a sa dɔxɔ dɛki dɔnxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And I saw that the house had a stone floor all round; the bases of the side-rooms were a full rod of six great cubits high.
sentences.susu: N naxa a rabɛn, sanbunyi nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi rabilinyi ma, naxan kuya nɔngɔn ya senni. Na yire naxee nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi rabilinyi, e nu tixi na sanbunyi fari.

sentences.english: The wall supporting the side-rooms on the outside was five cubits thick: and there was a free space of five cubits between the side-rooms of the house.
sentences.susu: Na yiree xɛlɛ xa marabinye lan nɔngɔn ya suuli nan ma. Kɛnɛ naxan nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi

sentences.english: And between the rooms was a space twenty cubits wide all round the house.
sentences.susu: nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa konkoe tagi, a lan nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn nan ma, a rabilinyi birin na.

sentences.english: And the free space had doors opening from the side-rooms, one door on the north and one door on the south: and the free space was five cubits wide all round.
sentences.susu: Na yire naxee nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi rabilinyi, e sode dɛ keren nu na kɔɔla ma, keren fan nu na yirefanyi ma. Kɛnɛ nu na e rabilinyi ma, naxan lan nɔngɔn ya suuli ma.

sentences.english: And the building which was in front of the separate place at the side to the west was seventy cubits wide; the wall of the building was five cubits thick all round and ninety cubits long.
sentences.susu: Banxi gbɛtɛ nde nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi sogegorode mabiri, naxan xa maigboe nu lanxi nɔngɔn ya tongo solofere ma, a xa kuyɛ nu lanxi nɔngɔn ya tongo solomanaani nan ma. A xɛlɛ xa marabinye nu lanxi nɔngɔn ya suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: And he took the measure of the house; it was a hundred cubits long; and the separate place and the building with its walls was a hundred cubits long;
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ naxa hɔrɔmɔbanxi maniya. A xa kuyɛ lan nɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ nan ma. Kɛnɛ, banxi, nun a xɛlɛ, nee fan xa kuyɛ lan nɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ nan ma.

sentences.english: And the east front of the house and of the separate place was a hundred cubits wide.
sentences.susu: Kɛnɛ naxan nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi sogetede mabiri, a lan nɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ nan ma.

sentences.english: And he took the measure of the building in front of the separate place which was at the back of it, and the pillared walks on one side and on the other side; they were a hundred cubits long; and the Temple and the inner part and its outer covered way were covered in;
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ naxa banxi maniya, naxan nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi xanbi ra, nun dangide naxee nu na a sɛɛti firinyi ma, na lan nɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ nan ma. Hɔrɔmɔbanxi, a xa buntunyi,

sentences.english: And the sloping windows and the covered ways round all three of them were of shakiph-wood all round from the level of the earth up to the windows;
sentences.susu: a sode dɛe, nun a wundɛrie, na birin nu ratofanxi wuri fanyi nan na, kelife lanbanyi ma han koore.

sentences.english: And there was a roof over the doorway and as far as the inner house, and to the outside and on the wall all round, inside and outside.
sentences.susu: Sode dɛ xun ma nun banxi xɛlɛ birin nabilinyi, a kui nun a fari,

sentences.english: And it had pictured forms of winged beings and palm-trees; a palm-tree between two winged ones, and every winged one had two faces;
sentences.susu: malekɛe nun tugi fɛnsɛe nan nu masolixi a ma a raxunmase ra. Tugi fɛnsɛ keren nan nu masolixi malekɛ firin tagi. Yatagi firin nan nu na na malekɛ birin bɛ,

sentences.english: So that there was the face of a man turned to the palm-tree on one side, and the face of a young lion on the other side: so it was made all round the house.
sentences.susu: a mixi daaxi nun a yɛtɛ daaxi. Na mixi yatagi nu rafindixi tugi fɛnsɛ nan ma, na yɛtɛ yatagi nu rafindixi tugi fɛnsɛ nan ma boore sɛɛti mabiri.

sentences.english: From earth level up to the windows there were winged ones and palm-trees pictured on the wall.
sentences.susu: Malekɛe nun tugi fɛnsɛe nu masolixi kelife hɔrɔmɔbanxi lanbanyi ma han koore.
Sode dɛ nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa yire sɛniyɛnxi ma, a maniyɛ fan nu na a xa yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante ma.

sentences.english: The altar was made of wood, and was three cubits high and two cubits long; it had angles, and its base and sides were of wood; and he said to me, This is the table which is before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛbade nde nu na mɛnni, naxan nu rafalaxi wuri ra, a xa maite lan nɔngɔn ya saxan nan ma, a xa kuyɛ lan nɔngɔn ya firin nan ma, a xa maigboe nu lanxi nɔngɔn ya firin nan ma. A tunxunyie, a dɛ kirie, nun a sɛɛtie birin nu yailanxi wuri nan na. Na xɛmɛ naxa a fala n bɛ, «Yi teebili nan na Alatala ya i.»

sentences.english: The Temple had two doors.
sentences.susu: Naadɛ firin nan nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi yire sɛniyɛnxi sode dɛ ra, naadɛ firin nan nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi yire sɛniyɛnxi fisamante sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the holy place had two doors, and the doors had two turning leaves, two for one and two for the other.
sentences.susu: Naadɛ bɛla firin nan nu na na sode dɛ firinyi, naxee nu ragalima sode dɛ ma.

sentences.english: And on them were pictured winged ones and palm-trees, as on the walls; and a ... of wood was on the front of the covered way outside.
sentences.susu: Malekɛe nun tugi fɛnsɛe nu masolixi hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛe ma, alɔ a nu masolixi a xɛlɛe ma ki naxɛ. Wurie fan nu na buntunyi ma koore ma.

sentences.english: And there were sloping windows and palm-trees on one side and on the other, on the sides of the covered way: and the side-rooms of the house and the ...
sentences.susu: Wundɛrie nu na buntunyi xɛlɛ ma a sɛɛtie ma, tugi fɛnsɛe nu masolixi wundɛrie sɛɛtie ma. Wurie fan nu na na yiree xun na, naxee nu tixi hɔrɔmɔbanxi rabilinyi.

sentences.english: And he took me out into the inner square in the direction of the north: and he took me into the rooms which were opposite the separate place and opposite the building to the north.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, na xɛmɛ naxa n namini na tɛtɛ singe kui kɔɔla ma. A naxa n xanin banxi yire, naxan nu na tɛtɛ singe xɛlɛ kɔɔla mabiri nun hɔrɔmɔbanxi tagi.

sentences.english: On the north side it was a hundred cubits long and fifty cubits wide,
sentences.susu: Na banxi xa sode dɛ ya nu rafindixi kɔɔla nan ma. Na banxi nu kuya nɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ, a nu igbo nɔngɔn ya tongo suuli.

sentences.english: Opposite the space of twenty cubits which was part of the inner square, and opposite the stone floor of the outer square. There were covered ways facing one another on the third floor.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛti naxan nu kuya tɛtɛ mabiri nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn, a nun sɛɛti naxan nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi mabiri, konkoee yire dɛki saxan nde nu tixi na yire firinyi ma.

sentences.english: And in front of the rooms was a walk, ten cubits wide and a hundred cubits long; and their doors were facing north.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛrɛdee nu na na sɛɛti firinyi ma naxee nu igbo nɔngɔn ya fu, e nu kuya nɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ alɔ banxi. Konkoee sode dɛe nu rafindixi kɔɔla nan ma.

sentences.english: And the higher rooms were shorter: for the covered ways took up more space from these than from the lower and middle rooms.
sentences.susu: Konkoe naxee nu na koore dɛki saxan nde ma, nee nu ixutu dangife boore ra lanbanyi.

sentences.english: For they were on three floors, and they had no pillars like the pillars of the outer square; so the highest was narrower than the lowest and middle floors from the earth level.
sentences.susu: Kinki yo mu nu na na dɛki saxan nde bɛ, e ixutuxi na nan ma.

sentences.english: And the wall which went outside by the side of the rooms, in the direction of the outer square in front of the rooms, was fifty cubits long.
sentences.susu: Xɛlɛ nu tixi konkoe nun tɛtɛ singe tagi, a nu kuya nɔngɔn ya tongo suuli.

sentences.english: For the rooms in the outer square were fifty cubits long: and in front of the Temple was a space of a hundred cubits.
sentences.susu: Boore sɛɛti hɔrɔmɔbanxi mabiri a nu kuya nɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ.

sentences.english: And under these rooms was the way in from the east side, as one goes into them from the outer square at the head of the outer wall.
sentences.susu: Konkoe naxee nu na lanbanyi, e sode dɛe nu na sogetede mabiri.

sentences.english: (And he took me) to the south, and in front of the separate place and in front of the building there were rooms.
sentences.susu: Konkoe gbɛtɛe nu na yirefanyi mabiri tɛtɛ singe xɛlɛ longori ra hɔrɔmɔbanxi ya i.

sentences.english: And there was a walk in front of them like that by the rooms on the north; they were equally long and wide; and the ways out of them were the same in design and had the same sort of doors.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛrɛde nde nu na e ya ra. Na konkoe nu maniyaxi konkoe nan na naxee nu na kɔɔla mabiri. E firin nafala ki, e xa kuyɛ nun e xa gboe, na birin lan.

sentences.english: And under the rooms on the south was a door at the head of the outer wall in the direction of the east as one goes in.
sentences.susu: E xa sode dɛe nu na yirefanyi nan ma. Naadɛ xungbe nde nu na sogetede mabiri.

sentences.english: And he said to me, The north rooms and the south rooms in front of the separate place are the holy rooms, where the priests who come near the Lord take the most holy things for their food: there the most holy things are placed, with the meal offering and the sin-offering and the offering for error; for the place is holy.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ naxa a fala n bɛ, a naxɛ, «Konkoe naxee na yirefanyi nun kɔɔla ma tɛtɛ ya i, nee findixi yire sɛniyɛnxie nan na, Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe sɛrɛxɛ sube donma dɛnnaxɛ. E sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxie ragatama mɛnni nɛ naxee findixi sansi xɔri sɛrɛxɛe, yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛe ra. Yire sɛniyɛnxi nan mɛnni ra.

sentences.english: When the priests go in, they may not go out of the holy place into the outer square, and there they are to put the robes in which they do the work of the Lord's house, for they are holy: and they have to put on other clothing before they come near that which has to do with the people.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe na so yire sɛniyɛnxie, a mu lanma e xa mini ɲama ya ma tɛtɛ kui, fo e xa e xa dugi sɛniyɛnxie ba.»

sentences.english: And when he had come to the end of measuring the inner house, he took me out to the doorway looking to the east, and took its measure all round.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ to gɛ hɔrɔmɔbanxi yire maniyade, a naxa n namini sogetede sode dɛ ra, a fa na tɛtɛ rabilinyi birin maniya.

sentences.english: He went round and took the measure of it on the east side with the measuring rod, five hundred, measured with the rod all round.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fɔlɔ sogetede mabiri. Na sɛɛti xa kuyɛ lan nɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ suuli nan ma.

sentences.english: And he went round and took the measure of it on the north side with the measuring rod, five hundred, measured with the rod all round.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, a naxa kɔɔla sɛɛti maniya, naxan xa kuyɛ fan lan a ya kɛmɛ suuli ma.

sentences.english: And he went round and took the measure of it on the south side with the measuring rod, five hundred, measured with the rod all round.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, a naxa yirefanyi sɛɛti maniya, naxan xa kuyɛ fan lan a ya kɛmɛ suuli ma.

sentences.english: And he went round and took the measure of it on the west side with the measuring rod, five hundred, measured with the rod all round.
sentences.susu: A raɲɔnyi, a naxa sogegorode sɛɛti maniya, naxan xa kuyɛ fan lan a ya kɛmɛ suuli ma.

sentences.english: He took its measure on the four sides: and it had a wall all round, five hundred long and five hundred wide, separating what was holy from what was common.
sentences.susu: A naxa tɛtɛ rabilinyi birin maniya a xa wuri maniyase ra. Tɛtɛ sɛɛti naanie birin lan wuri ya kɛmɛ suuli nan ma. Na tɛtɛ nu tixi yire sɛniyɛnxi nun yire sɛniyɛntare nan tagi.

sentences.english: And he took me to the doorway looking to the east:
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, na xɛmɛ naxa n xanin sogetede sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And there was the glory of the God of Israel coming from the way of the east: and his voice was like the sound of great waters, and the earth was shining with his glory.
sentences.susu: N naxa Isirayila Marigi Ala xa nɔrɛ to fafe ra kelife sogetede mabiri. A nu xui naxan naminima, na nu luxi nɛ alɔ baa xungbe mɔrɔnyie, bɔxi fan nu iyalanma a yanbɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the vision which I saw was like the vision I had seen when he came for the destruction of the town: and like the vision which I saw by the river Chebar; and I went down on my face.
sentences.susu: N laamatunyi naxan to, na nu luxi nɛ alɔ n naxan to Marigi fa lɔxɔɛ Darisalamu kanade. A nu luxi nɛ alɔ n naxan to Kebara xure dɛ ra. N to a to, n naxa n yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the glory of the Lord came into the house by the way of the doorway looking to the east.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa nɔrɛ naxa so hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui sogetede sode dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the spirit, lifting me up, took me into the inner square; and I saw that the house was full of the glory of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa n tongo, a n xanin hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ firin nde kui, Alatala xa nɔrɛ nu bara gbo dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And the voice of one talking to me came to my ears from inside the house; and the man was by my side.
sentences.susu: N nu na na xɛmɛ sɛɛti ma, kɔnɔ n naxa xui nde mɛ wɔyɛnfe n na kelife hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: And he said to me, Son of man, this is the place where the seat of my power is and the resting-place of my feet, where I will be among the children of Israel for ever: and no longer will the people of Israel make my holy name unclean, they or their kings, by their loose ways and by the dead bodies of their kings;
sentences.susu: Na xui naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ, «Adamadi, n ma kibanyi yire nan ya, n sanyi tima dɛnnaxɛ. N sabatima nɛ be Isirayilakae ya ma abadan. Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ nun a xa mangɛe mu n xili sɛniyɛnxi maberema sɔnɔn e xa langoeɲa ra, nun e xa gaburi tife ra e xa salide itexie ma.

sentences.english: By putting their doorstep by my doorstep, and the pillar of their door by the pillar of my door, with only a wall between me and them; and they have made my holy name unclean by the disgusting things which they have done: so in my wrath I sent destruction on them.
sentences.susu: Mangɛe na e xa banxi sode dɛe nun e xa banxi xalɛe ti n gbee sɛɛti ma, e n xili sɛniyɛnxi maberexi na ki nɛ e xa wali kobi ra. N e sɔntɔxi n ma xɔnɛ kui na nan ma.

sentences.english: Now let them put their loose ways and the dead bodies of their kings far from me, and I will be among them for ever.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi fa, e xa e xa kuye batui nun e xa mangɛe furee makuya n na, alako n xa lu e ya ma abadan.»

sentences.english: You, son of man, give the children of Israel an account of this house, so that they may be shamed because of their evil-doing: and let them see the vision of it and its image.
sentences.susu: «Adamadi, i xa yi hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa fe masen Isirayilakae bɛ, alako e xa yaagi e xa yunubie ra. E xa yi banxi ti ki mato.

sentences.english: And they will be shamed by what they have done; so give them the knowledge of the form of the house and its structure, and the ways out of it and into it, and all its laws and its rules, writing it down for them: so that they may keep all its laws and do them.
sentences.susu: Xa e bara yaagi e xa wali kobie ra, yi banxi xa fe rakolon e ra, a tixi mɔɔli naxan na, a sode dɛe nun a minide dɛe na ki naxɛ, nun a xa fe raba kɛɲa, alako e xa bira na yaamarie fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: This is the law of the house: On the top of the mountain all the space round it on every side will be most holy. See, this is the law of the house.
sentences.susu: «Hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa sɛriyɛ nan ya: Bɔxi naxan birin na yi geya fari, na birin sɛniyɛnxi. Hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa sɛriyɛ nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And these are the measures of the altar in cubits: (the cubit being a cubit and a hand's measure;) its hollow base is a cubit high and a cubit wide, and it has an overhanging edge as wide as a hand-stretch all round it:
sentences.susu: «Sɛrɛxɛbade xa maniyɛ xasabi nan yi ki, naxan maniyaxi maniyase ra singe maniyase nu dangi naxan na bɛlɛxɛ suxu keren. Fole naxan gexi sɛrɛxɛbade rabilinyi, a tilin nɔngɔn ya keren, a igbo nɔngɔn ya keren. A dɛ kiri igboe lanxi nɔngɔn tagi nan ma. Sɛrɛxɛbade xa maite

sentences.english: And from the base on the earth level to the lower shelf, the altar is two cubits high and a cubit wide; and from the smaller shelf to the greater shelf it is four cubits high and a cubit wide.
sentences.susu: kelife na fole ma han sɛrɛxɛbade bunyi, a lanxi nɔngɔn ya firin nan ma. A igboe lanxi nɔngɔn ya keren nan ma. Sɛrɛxɛbade xa maite kelife a bunyi ma han a koore, na lanxi nɔngɔn ya naani nan ma, a igboe lanxi nɔngɔn ya keren nan ma.

sentences.english: And the fireplace is four cubits high: and coming up from the fireplace are the horns, a cubit high.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛbade xa tɛ sade tilinyi lanxi nɔngɔn ya naani nan ma. Feri naani tixi sɛrɛxɛbade tunxunyie ma.

sentences.english: And the fireplace is twelve cubits long and twelve cubits wide, square on its four sides.
sentences.susu: Na tɛ sade xa kuyɛ lanxi nɔngɔn ya fu nun firin nan ma. A igboe fan lanxi nɔngɔn ya fu nun firin nan ma.

sentences.english: And the shelf is fourteen cubits long and fourteen cubits wide, on its four sides; the edge round it is half a cubit; the base of it is a cubit all round, and its steps are facing the east.
sentences.susu: A dɛ rabilinyi xa kuyɛ lanxi nɔngɔn ya fu nun naani nan ma, a igboe fan lanxi nɔngɔn ya fu nun naani nan ma. Na dɛ rabilinyi dɛ kiri lanxi nɔngɔn tagi nan ma, a dɛnnaxɛ kui igexi a lanxi nɔngɔn ya keren nan ma. Sɛrɛxɛbade santidee ya nu rafindixi sogetede nan ma.»

sentences.english: And he said to me, Son of man, the Lord God has said, These are the rules for the altar, when they make it, for the offering of burned offerings on it and the draining out of the blood.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, na xɛmɛ naxa a fala n bɛ, a naxɛ, «Adamadi, i Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: ‹Sɛriyɛ nan yi ki sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi xa fe ra nun wuli kasanfe xa fe ra yi sɛrɛxɛbade bɛ a ti tɛmui.

sentences.english: You are to give to the priests, the Levites of the seed of Zadok, who come near to me, says the Lord God, to do my work, a young ox for a sin-offering.
sentences.susu: A lanma i xa tuura keren so Lewi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe Sadɔki bɔnsɔɛ yi ra, naxee na bama yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra. Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.

sentences.english: You are to take some of its blood and put it on the four horns and on the four angles of the shelf and on the edge all round: and you are to make it clean and free from sin.
sentences.susu: E xa na wuli di sa sɛrɛxɛbade ferie ma, a tunxun naani birin ma lanbanyi, nun a dɛ rabilinyi birin ma. Sɛrɛxɛbade rasɛniyɛnma na ki nɛ, a findi xunsare ra a bɛ.

sentences.english: And you are to take the ox of the sin-offering, and have it burned in the special place ordered for it in the house, outside the holy place.
sentences.susu: E xa na tuura tongo, naxan bama yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, a xa gan hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ kui a lanma a xa gan dɛnnaxɛ sɛriyɛ ki ma.›»

sentences.english: And on the second day you are to have a he-goat without any mark on it offered for a sin-offering; and they are to make the altar clean as they did with the young ox.
sentences.susu: «Na lɔxɔɛ kuye iba, e xa sikɔtɛ keren tongo, lanyuru yo mu na naxan ma, e xa a ba yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra sɛrɛxɛbade rasɛniyɛnfe ra, alɔ e a raba ki naxɛ tuura ra.

sentences.english: And after you have made it clean, let a young ox without a mark be offered, and a male sheep from the flock without a mark.
sentences.susu: E na gɛ sɛrɛxɛbade rasɛniyɛnde na ki, e man xa tuura keren nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren tongo, lanyuru yo mu naxee ma,

sentences.english: And you are to take them before the Lord, and the priests will put salt on them, offering them up for a burned offering to the Lord.
sentences.susu: e xa nee ba Alatala bɛ sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe lanma e xa fɔxɛ kasan na birin ma.»

sentences.english: Every day for seven days you are to give a goat for a sin-offering: and let them give in addition a young ox and a male sheep from the flock without any mark on them.
sentences.susu: «Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ han xi solofere, e xa sikɔtɛ keren ba yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra, a nun tuura nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi, lanyuru yo mu na naxee ma.

sentences.english: For seven days they are to make offerings to take away sin from the altar and to make it clean; so they are to make it holy.
sentences.susu: Han xi solofere bun ma, yi sɛrɛxɛbade rasɛniyɛnma na ki nɛ, a xa findi wo xa sɛrɛxɛbade ra.

sentences.english: And when these days have come to an end, then on the eighth day and after, the priests will make your burned offerings on the altar and your peace-offerings; and I will take pleasure in you, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛe na ba a ra, keli a xi solomasaxan nde ma, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe luma wo xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nun wo xa sɛrɛxɛ ɲanigexie ba ra nɛ mɛnni fa. Na kui, n wo rasɛnɛma nɛ. Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And he took me back to the outer doorway of the holy place, looking to the east; and it was shut.
sentences.susu: Na xɛmɛ naxa n xanin hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ sode dɛ ra, naxan nu na sogetede mabiri. Na naadɛ nu balanxi.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to me, This doorway is to be shut, it is not to be open, and no man is to go in by it, because the Lord, the God of Israel, has gone in by it; and it is to be shut.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, «Na naadɛ balanxi, a mu rabima. Ibunadama yo mu soma naa, barima, n tan Isirayila Marigi Alatala nan soxi mɛnni ra.

sentences.english: But the ruler will be seated there to take his food before the Lord; he will go in by the covered way to the door, and will come out by the same way.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isirayila mangɛ nan gbansan nɔma dɔxɔde na sode dɛ ra a sɛrɛxɛ don n ya i. A soma buntunyi sode dɛ nan na, a man mini mɛnni ra.»

sentences.english: And he took me to the north doorway in front of the house; and, looking, I saw that the house of the Lord was full of the glory of the Lord; and I went down on my face.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, na xɛmɛ naxa n xanin hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ sode dɛ kɔɔla biri ra hɔrɔmɔbanxi ya i. Mɛnni n naxa Alatala xa nɔrɛ to so ra a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, n fa n yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to me, Son of man, take to heart, and let your eyes see and your ears be open to everything I say to you about all the rules of the house of the Lord and all its laws; and take note of the ways into the house and all the ways out of the holy place.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxɛ, «Adamadi, i xa i tuli mati n ma masenyi ra a gbengbenyi, n tan Alatala naxan masenma i bɛ n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa fe ra. I xa i ɲɔxɔ sa na sode dɛe nun a minidee xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And say to the uncontrolled children of Israel, This is what the Lord has said: O you children of Israel, let it be enough for you, among the disgusting things which you have done,
sentences.susu: I xa a fala Isirayila matandilae bɛ, ‹N tan Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: Na lan. Wo xa fe ɲaaxie bara dangi a i!

sentences.english: To have let men from strange lands, without circumcision of heart or flesh, come into my holy place, making my house unclean; and to have made the offering of my food, even the fat and the blood; and in addition to all your disgusting ways, you have let my agreement be broken.
sentences.susu: Wo man bara a xunmasa, sunnataree rasofe n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi sɛniyɛnxi kui, naxee bɔɲɛ makuya n na. Na kui wo bara fe raharamuxi raba n ma banxi ra, hali wo to nu donse, ture, nun wuli bafe sɛrɛxɛ ra a kui. Wo bara n ma sɛriyɛ kana na mɔɔli ra.

sentences.english: And you have not taken care of my holy things; but you have put them as keepers to take care of my work in my holy place.
sentences.susu: Wo bara tondi n ma wali sɛniyɛnxi rabade, wo fa na wali so mixi gbɛtɛ yi ra.

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord has said, No man from a strange land, without circumcision of heart and flesh, of all those who are living among the children of Israel, is to come into my holy place.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: Sunnatare yo naxa so n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, naxan bɔɲɛ makuya n na, hali e sabatixi Isirayilakae ya ma.›»

sentences.english: But as for the Levites, who went far from me, when Israel went out of the right way, turning away from me to go after their images; their punishment will come on them.
sentences.susu: «Lewi bɔnsɔɛ to e makuya n na, e bira e xa kuyee fɔxɔ ra, a nun Isirayila ɲama, n nee sare ragbilenma nɛ e ma.

sentences.english: But they may be caretakers in my holy place, and overseers at the doors of the house, doing the work of the house: they will put to death the burned offering and the beasts offered for the people, and they will take their place before them as their servants.
sentences.susu: N e luma nɛ e xa wali kui n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi yire, e xa na sode dɛe kanta, e xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun sɛrɛxɛ gbɛtɛe ba ɲama bɛ.

sentences.english: Because they did this work for them before their images, and became a cause of sin to the children of Israel; for this cause my hand has been lifted up against them, says the Lord, and their punishment will be on them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e to n ma wali raba e xa kuyee ya i, e a niya Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ fan xa bira yunubi fɔxɔ ra, n bara n kali n bɛlɛxɛ itexi ra, e fama nɛ na sare sɔtɔde. Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan nan ki.

sentences.english: And they will not come near me to do the work of priests to me, or come near any of my holy things, or the things which are most holy: but their shame will be on them, and the punishment for the disgusting things which they have done.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n mu tinma e xa e maso n na sɛrɛxɛ bade, n mu tinma e xa e maso n ma se sɛniyɛnxie ra, n mu tinma e xa e maso n ma se sɛniyɛnxi fisamantee ra. A lanma e xa yaagi sɔtɔ e xa fe ɲaaxie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: But I will make them responsible for the care of the house and all its work and everything which is done in it.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n e luma nɛ e xa wali nde raba n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi yire, e xa e ɲɔxɔ sa naa xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: But as for the priests, the sons of Zadok, who took care of my holy place when the children of Israel were turned away from me, they are to come near me to do my work, they will take their places before me, offering to me the fat and the blood, says the Lord;
sentences.susu: «Isirayilakae to nu e makuyama n na, Lewi bɔnsɔɛ sɛrɛxɛdubɛe tan, Sadɔki xa mixie, e nu bara e tunnabɛxi n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa wali kui. Na nan a ra, n naxa a lu nee peti xa e maso n na, e xa ture nun wuli ba sɛrɛxɛ ra n bɛ. Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.

sentences.english: They are to come into my holy place and they are to come near to my table, to do my work and have the care of my house.
sentences.susu: Nee nan gbansan soma n ma yire sɛniyɛnxi kui, e fa n ma wali raba n ma teebili ya i.»

sentences.english: And when they come in by the doorways of the inner square, they are to be clothed in linen robes; there is to be no wool on them while they are doing my work in the doorway of the inner square and inside the house.
sentences.susu: «E na so n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa tɛtɛ kui naxan na na tɛtɛ singe kui, a lanma e xa suwa dugi ragoro e ma. E naxa dugi binye ragoro e ma e nɛ walima hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ sode dɛe yire tɛmui naxɛ, xa na mu a ra hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: They are to have linen head-dresses on their heads and linen trousers on their legs, and they are to have nothing round them to make their skin wet with heat.
sentences.susu: A lanma e xa suwa dugi nan xiri e xunyi e raxunmase ra, e man xa suwa dugi xiri e tagi. E naxa sese ragoro e ma, naxan kuyefure raminima e fate ma.

sentences.english: And when they go out into the outer square to the people, they are to take off the robes in which they do the work of priests, and put them away in the holy rooms, and put on other clothing, so that the people may not be made holy by their robes.
sentences.susu: Beenu e xa mini boore tɛtɛ kui ɲama tixi dɛnnaxɛ, e xa e xa sose sɛniyɛnxie ba e ma, e xa e lu e xa konkoe kui hɔrɔmɔbanxi yire. Na ki e mu mixi rasɛniyɛnma e xa dugie ra.»

sentences.english: They are not to have all the hair cut off their heads, and they are not to let their hair get long, but they are to have the ends of their hair cut.
sentences.susu: «A mu lanma e xa e xunyi bi, a mu lanma e xa e xunsɛxɛ rakuya. E xa a maxaba a sɛriyɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: The priests are not to take wine when they go into the inner square.
sentences.susu: A mu lanma sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa bere yo min, e na so hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ kui tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And they are not to take as wives any widow or woman whose husband has put her away: but they may take virgins of the seed of Israel, or a widow who is the widow of a priest.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe mu lan e xa kaaɲɛ ginɛ dɔxɔ, a mu lan e xa ginɛ dɔxɔ, xɛmɛ nde mɛxi naxan na. E xa Isirayila ginɛ dimɛdi gbansan nan dɔxɔ, xa na mu sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nde xa kaaɲɛ ginɛ.

sentences.english: And they are to make clear to my people the division between what is holy and what is common, and to give them the knowledge of what is clean and what is unclean.
sentences.susu: E xa n ma ɲama xaran se radaxaxi nun se raharamuxi tagi raba kolonde. E xa a masen e bɛ naxan findi se sɛniyɛnxi nun se sɛniyɛntare ra.»

sentences.english: In any cause, they are to be in the position of judges, judging in harmony with my decisions: they are to keep my laws and my rules in all my fixed feasts; and they are to keep my Sabbaths holy.
sentences.susu: «Ɲɔxɔnsɔsɔɛ na mini ɲama tagi, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nan kiiti sama n ma sɛriyɛ ki ma. E xa n ma yaamarie suxu, e xa n ma salie raba, e xa n ma malabui lɔxɔɛe binya.»

sentences.english: They are not to come near any dead person so as to become unclean: but for a father or mother or son or daughter or brother or for a sister who has no husband, they may make themselves unclean.
sentences.susu: «Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ naxa a maso fure ra, xa na mu a ra a findima nɛ sɛniyɛntare ra. Kɔnɔ xa a baba, a nga, a xa di xɛmɛma, xa na mu a ra ginɛma sa faxa, na tɛmui a nɔma a masode nee tan fure ra.

sentences.english: And after he has been made clean, seven days are to be numbered for him.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, a xa a yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn, a fa mamɛ ti xi solofere bun ma.

sentences.english: And on the day when he goes into the inner square, to do the work of the holy place, he is to make his sin-offering, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: A na so hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ kui a xa wali sɛniyɛnxi rabade, a xa fɔlɔ yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ma a yɛtɛ bɛ. Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And they are to have no heritage; I am their heritage: you are to give them no property in Israel; I am their property.
sentences.susu: «N tan nan findixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe kɛ ra. Wo naxa bɔxi fi e ma Isirayila bɔxi ma, barima n tan nan findixi e kɛ ra.

sentences.english: Their food is to be the meal offering and the sin-offering and the offering for error; and everything given specially to the Lord in Israel will be theirs.
sentences.susu: E baloma sɛrɛxɛe nan na, alɔ sansi xɔri sɛrɛxɛ, yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ, yunubi sɔtɔɛ sɛrɛxɛ, nun se birin naxee fixi Ala ma Isirayila bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the best of all the first-fruits of everything, and every offering which is lifted up of all your offerings, will be for the priests: and you are to give the priest the first of your bread-making, so causing a blessing to come on your house.
sentences.susu: E gbe nan sansi bogi singe ra, a nun hadiya birin naxee fima wo ya ma. A man lanma wo xa taami fi e ma sɛrɛxɛ ra, alako wo xa denbaya xa baraka sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: The priests may not take for food any bird or beast which has come to a natural death or whose death has been caused by another animal.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe mu lanma e xa xɔni nun xuruse sube yo don naxan faxa a yɛtɛ ma, xa na mu a ra, wulai sube naxan ibɔɔxi.»

sentences.english: And when you are making a distribution of the land, by the decision of the Lord, for your heritage, you are to make an offering to the Lord of a part of the land as holy: it is to be twenty-five thousand long and twenty thousand wide: all the land inside these limits is to be holy.
sentences.susu: «Wo na Isirayila bɔxi itaxun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe ma tɛmui naxɛ, wo xa yire nde ragata a xati ma Alatala bɛ, a xa findi a xa yire sɛniyɛnxi ra. Na yire xa kuyɛ lanma nɔngɔn ya wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli nan ma, a xa gboe lan nɔngɔn ya wulu fu ma.

sentences.english: Of this, a square five hundred long and five hundred wide is to be for the holy place, with a space of fifty cubits all round it.
sentences.susu: Na kui, yire gbɛtɛ xa maniya hɔrɔmɔbanxi tima dɛnnaxɛ. Na xa kuyɛ lanma nɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ suuli nan ma, a xa gboe fan lan nɔngɔn ya kɛmɛ suuli ma, nun yire nde naxan xa tilinyi nɔngɔn ya tongo suuli lima, na xa lu na rabilinyi.

sentences.english: And of this measure, let a space be measured, twenty-five thousand long and ten thousand wide: in it there will be the holy place, even the most holy.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi sɛniyɛnxi ti na yire kui, naxan xa kuyɛ nɔngɔn ya wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli lima, a igboe nɔngɔn ya wulu fu.

sentences.english: This holy part of the land is to be for the priests, the servants of the holy place, who come near to the Lord to do his work; it is to be a place for their houses and for grass-land and for cattle.
sentences.susu: Yire sɛniyɛnxi na a ra, naxan bama Isirayila bɔxi ra sɛrɛxɛdubɛe bɛ, naxee tima Alatala ya i a xa wali rabafe ra a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui. E xa banxie fan tima naa nɛ Alatala xa yire sɛniyɛnxi sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: A space of land twenty-five thousand long and ten thousand wide is to be for the Levites, the servants of the house, a property for themselves, for towns for their living-places.
sentences.susu: Na bɔxi naxan xa kuyɛ nɔngɔn ya wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli lima, naxan xa gboe nɔngɔn ya wulu fu lima, na findima Lewi bɔnsɔɛ gbe nan na, naxee walima hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui. E sabatide nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And as the property for the town you are to have a part five thousand wide and twenty-five thousand long, by the side of the offering of the holy part of the land: this is to be for all the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa yire gbɛtɛ maniya yire sɛniyɛnxi fɛ ma, naxan findima taa gbe ra. A xa kuya nɔngɔn ya wulu mɔxɔɲɛn nun suuli, a igboe nɔngɔn ya wulu suuli. Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin gbe nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And for the ruler there is to be a part on one side and on the other side of the holy offering and of the property of the town, in front of the holy offering and in front of the property of the town on the west of it and on the east: measured in the same line as one of the parts of the land, from its limit on the west to its limit on the east of the land.
sentences.susu: «Isirayila mangɛ xa bɔxi luma na yire sɛniyɛnxi nun taa xa bɔxi sɛɛtie nan ma sogetede nun sogegorode mabiri, han Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe naaninyie ra.

sentences.english: And this will be his heritage in Israel: and my rulers will no longer be cruel masters to my people; but they will give the land as a heritage to the children of Israel by their tribes.
sentences.susu: Na bɔxi findima a gbe nan na. A hayi mu na sɔnɔn Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe tɔɔrɔfe ma e xa bɔxi xa fe ra. Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin xa e gbe sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: Let this be enough for you, O rulers of Israel: let there be an end of violent behaviour and wasting; do what is right, judging uprightly; let there be no more driving out of my people, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi: ‹Isirayila mangɛe, na xa wo wasa! Wo naxa n ma ɲama tɔɔrɔ, wo naxa fe xɔrɔxɔɛ raba e ra! Wo xa bira sɛriyɛ nun tinxinyi fɔxɔ ra! Wo xa ba n ma ɲama kɛ muɲafe! Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.›»

sentences.english: Have true scales and a true ephah and a true bath.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa maniyasee xa kamali. Wo xa busali xa findi busali yati nan na. Wo xa fifa xa findi fifa yati nan na.

sentences.english: The ephah and the bath are to be of the same measure, so that the bath is equal to a tenth of a homer, and the ephah to a tenth of a homer: the unit of measure is to be a homer.
sentences.susu: Na firinyie xa lan, hali keren to rawalima sansi xɔri maniyafe nan na, boore rawali ture maniyafe ra. Na busali nun na fifa, e birin xa maniyase nde ya fu li a sɛriyɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: And the shekel is to be twenty gerahs: five shekels are five, and ten shekels are ten, and your maneh is to be fifty shekels
sentences.susu: Kɔbiri kole naxan xili ‹sikili,› na xa lan maniyase nde ya mɔxɔɲɛn ma, naxan xili ‹gera.› Sikili tongo senni lanxi maniyase nde nan ma, naxan xili ‹mina.›»

sentences.english: This is the offering you are to give: a sixth of an ephah out of a homer of wheat, and a sixth of an ephah out of a homer of barley;
sentences.susu: «Wo xa hadiyae xa findi yi see nan na: mɛngi maniyɛ xɔri konbo ya mɔxɔɲɛn kui, wo xa konbo ya saxan ba a ra, fundenyi maniyɛ xɔri konbo ya mɔxɔɲɛn kui, wo xa konbo ya saxan ba a ra,

sentences.english: And the fixed measure of oil is to be a tenth of a bath from the cor, for ten baths make up the cor;
sentences.susu: ture fifa keren kui, wo xa litiri firin ba a ra (fifa keren findi litiri kɛmɛ firin litiri mɔxɔɲɛn nan na),

sentences.english: And one lamb from the flock out of every two hundred, from all the families of Israel, for a meal offering and for a burned offering and for peace-offerings, to take away their sin, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: yɛxɛɛ kɛmɛ firin ya ma, wo xa yɛxɛɛ keren ba a ra Isirayila bɔxi fanyi birin ma. Yie nan bama sansi xɔri sɛrɛxɛe ra, sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie ra, xanunteya sɛrɛxɛe ra ɲama xunsare xa fe ra. Wo Marigi Alatala xui nan na ki.

sentences.english: All the people are to give this offering to the ruler.
sentences.susu: Isirayila ɲama birin xa lu na fe kui e xa mangɛ malife ra.

sentences.english: And the ruler will be responsible for the burned offering and the meal offering and the drink offering, at the feasts and the new moons and the Sabbaths, at all the fixed feasts of the children of Israel: he will give the sin-offering and meal offering and burned offering and the peace-offerings, to take away the sin of the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ lanma a xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie nun sansi xɔri nun minse sɛrɛxɛe ba kike salie nun malabui lɔxɔɛ sali tɛmui. A man xa yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛe, sansi xɔri hadiyae, sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie, nun xanunteya sɛrɛxɛe ba Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ xunsare xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: In the first month, on the first day of the month, you are to take a young ox without any mark on him, and you are to make the holy place clean.
sentences.susu: «Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, a naxɛ, ‹Kike singe, xi singe, wo xa tuura keren ba sɛrɛxɛ ra, lanyuru yo mu na naxan ma, hɔrɔmɔbanxi rasɛniyɛnfe ra.

sentences.english: And the priest is to take some of the blood of the sin-offering and put it on the uprights at the sides of the doors of the house, and on the four angles of the shelf of the altar, and on the sides of the doorway of the inner square.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nde xa xuruse wuli tongo, naxan baxi yunubi xafari xa fe ra, a a maso hɔrɔmɔbanxi sode dɛ sɛɛtie ra, sɛrɛxɛbade tunxui naani ra, a nun hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ sode dɛ sɛɛtie ra.

sentences.english: And this you are to do on the seventh day of the month for everyone who is in error and for the feeble-minded: you are to make the house free from sin.
sentences.susu: Wo man xa na raba na kike xi solofere nde ra, barima xa mixi nde bara yunubi raba a mu naxan kolon, na sɛrɛxɛ hɔrɔmɔbanxi rasɛniyɛnma nɛ.›»

sentences.english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you are to have the Passover, a feast of seven days; unleavened bread is to be your food.
sentences.susu: «Kike singe, xi fu nun naani nde ra, wo xa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali raba xi solofere bun ma. Wo naxa taami lɛbinitare yo don na tɛmui.

sentences.english: And on that day the ruler is to give for himself and for all the people of the land an ox for a sin-offering.
sentences.susu: Na sali lɔxɔɛ, mangɛ xa tuura keren ba yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra a yɛtɛ bɛ a nun ɲama bɛ.

sentences.english: And on the seven days of the feast he is to give a burned offering to the Lord, seven oxen and seven sheep without any mark on them, every day for seven days; and a he-goat every day for a sin-offering.
sentences.susu: Na sali xi solofere bun ma lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ, mangɛ xa tuura solofere ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra, a nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi solofere lanyuru yo mu na naxee ma. A man xa sikɔtɛ keren ba yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ na xi solofere bun ma.

sentences.english: And he is to give a meal offering, an ephah for every ox and an ephah for every sheep and a hin of oil to every ephah.
sentences.susu: A man xa sansi xɔri konbo ya saxan nun ture litiri ya naani ba sɛrɛxɛ ra na tuurae nun na yɛxɛɛ kontonyie birin sɛɛti ma.»

sentences.english: In the seventh month, on the fifteenth day of the month, at the feast, he is to give the same for seven days; the sin-offering, the burned offering, the meal offering, and the oil as before.
sentences.susu: «Na sali waxati, na xi solofere bun ma, a man xa na mɔɔli ba sɛrɛxɛ ra yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛe sɛɛti ma, a nun sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie sɛɛti ma, a nun sansi xɔri nun ture hadiyae sɛɛti ma. Na sali fɔlɔma kike solofere, xi fu nun suuli nde nan na.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: The doorway of the inner square looking to the east is to be shut on the six working days; but on the Sabbath it is to be open, and at the time of the new moon it is to be open.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, a naxɛ: «Sode dɛ xa naadɛ, naxan na hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ kui sogetede biri ra, na balanma nɛ xi senni bun ma, kɔnɔ a rabima malabu lɔxɔɛ nun kike nɛɛnɛ sali tɛmui nɛ.

sentences.english: And the ruler is to go in through the covered way of the outer doorway outside, and take his place by the pillar of the doorway, and the priests will make his burned offering and his peace-offerings and he will give worship at the doorstep of the doorway; then he will go out, and the door will not be shut till the evening.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ a maso naa buntunyi sode dɛ ra, a ti mɛnni. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ a xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun a xa xanunteya sɛrɛxɛe bama tɛmui naxɛ, a xa a xinbi sin. A na gɛ na rabade, a xa mini. Sode dɛ naadɛ mu balanma, fo nunmare.

sentences.english: And the people of the land are to give worship at the door of that doorway before the Lord on the Sabbaths and at the new moons.
sentences.susu: Ɲama e xinbi sinma nɛ naa Alatala ya i malabui lɔxɔɛ nun kike nɛɛnɛ sali lɔxɔɛe ra.

sentences.english: And the burned offering offered to the Lord by the ruler on the Sabbath day is to be six lambs without a mark on them and a male sheep without a mark;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ tan xa yɛxɛɛ xɛmɛ senni nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren ba sɛrɛxɛ ra malabui lɔxɔɛ. Lanyuru yo naxa lu e ma.

sentences.english: And the meal offering is to be an ephah for the sheep, and for the lambs whatever he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri busali keren xa ba hadiya ra yɛxɛɛ kontonyi sɛɛti ma. A man xa sansi xɔri nde ba hadiya ra yɛxɛɛ booree sɛɛti ma, a wama xasabi naxan xɔn, a nun ture litiri naani sansi xɔri busali keren bɛ.

sentences.english: And at the time of the new moon it is to be a young ox of the herd without a mark on him, and six lambs and a male sheep, all without a mark:
sentences.susu: Kike nɛɛnɛ xi singe, a xa tuura keren, yɛxɛɛ xɛmɛ senni, nun yɛxɛɛ kontonyi keren nan ba sɛrɛxɛ ra, lanyuru yo mu na naxee ma.

sentences.english: And he is to give a meal offering, an ephah for the ox and an ephah for the sheep, and for the lambs whatever he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.
sentences.susu: A xa sansi xɔri busali keren ba tuura bɛ, a xa keren ba yɛxɛɛ kontonyi bɛ, a nun a wama naxan xɔn yɛxɛɛ xɛmɛ booree fan bɛ. A xa ture litiri naani sa busali keren keren sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And when the ruler comes in, he is to go in through the covered way of the doorway, and he is to go out by the same way.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa so buntunyi sode dɛ ra, a man xa mini mɛnni nan na.»

sentences.english: But when the people of the land come before the Lord at the fixed feasts, he who comes in by the north doorway to give worship is to go out by the south doorway; and he who comes in by the south doorway is to go out by the north doorway: he is not to come back by the doorway through which he went in, but is to go straight before him.
sentences.susu: «Ɲama na fa tɛmui naxɛ Alatala batude sali lɔxɔɛe ma, naxan na so kɔɔla sode dɛ ra, a xa mini yirefanyi sode dɛ ra. Naxan na so yirefanyi sode dɛ ra, a xa mini kɔɔla sode dɛ ra. Mixi yo naxa mini a soxi dɛnnaxɛ ra. A xa mini naadɛ gbɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the ruler, when they come in, is to come among them, and is to go out when they go out.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ fan xa lu e ya ma, e so tɛmui nun e mini tɛmui.»

sentences.english: At the feasts and the fixed meetings the meal offerings are to be an ephah for an ox, and an ephah for a male sheep, and for the lambs whatever he is able to give, and a hin of oil to an ephah.
sentences.susu: «Sali lɔxɔɛe nun lɔxɔɛ sugandixie, mangɛ xa sansi xɔri busali keren ba tuura bɛ, a xa keren ba yɛxɛɛ kontonyi bɛ, a nun a wama naxan xasabi xɔn yɛxɛɛ xɛmɛ booree bɛ. A xa ture litiri naani sa busali keren keren sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And when the ruler makes a free offering, a burned offering or a peace-offering freely given to the Lord, the doorway looking to the east is to be made open for him, and he is to make his burned offering and his peace-offerings as he does on the Sabbath day: and he will go out; and the door will be shut after he has gone out.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ na wa sɛrɛxɛ ɲanigexi bafe Alatala bɛ, naxan findixi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi, xa na mu a ra, xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ, a lanma sogetede naadɛ xa rabi a bɛ. A xa a xa sɛrɛxɛe ba alɔ a a bama ki naxɛ malabui lɔxɔɛ. A na gɛ na ra, a xa mini, naadɛ fa balan.»

sentences.english: And you are to give a lamb a year old without any mark on it for a burned offering to the Lord every day: morning by morning you are to give it.
sentences.susu: «Gɛɛsɛgɛ birin wo xa yɛxɛɛ ɲɛ keren daaxi ba sɛrɛxɛ ra, lanyuru mu na naxan ma.

sentences.english: And you are to give, morning by morning, a meal offering with it, a sixth of an ephah and a third of a hin of oil dropped on the best meal; a meal offering offered to the Lord at all times by an eternal order.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sansi xɔri konbo ya saxan nun ture litiri keren ba na yɛxɛɛ sɛɛti ma gɛɛsɛgɛ birin. Yaamari na a ra naxan mu kanama abadan.

sentences.english: And they are to give the lamb and the meal offering and the oil, morning by morning, for a burned offering at all times.
sentences.susu: Na kui gɛɛsɛgɛ birin, yɛxɛɛ, sansi xɔri, nun ture xa ba sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi ra.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: If the ruler gives a property to any of his sons, it is his heritage and will be the property of his sons; it is theirs for their heritage.
sentences.susu: «Marigi Alatala yi nan masenxi, a naxɛ: Xa mangɛ bɔxi nde fima a xa di nde ma, na findima a xa di bɛ kɛ nan na, a fa lu a xa di xa die bɛ.

sentences.english: And if he gives a part of his heritage to one of his servants, it will be his till the year of making free, and then it will go back to the ruler; for it is his sons' heritage, and is to be theirs.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa a bɔxi nde fi a xa konyi nde ma, na luma nɛ na yi ra han xɔrɛya ɲɛ waxati. Na tɛmui, na bɔxi man gbilenma mangɛ nan ma. Mangɛ xa bɔxi findima a xa die kɛ nan gbansan na.

sentences.english: And the ruler is not to take the heritage of any of the people, driving them out of their property; he is to give a heritage to his sons out of the property which is his: so that my people may not be sent away from their property.
