sentences.susu: ‹Parisin› na nan na ki ‹maitaxunyi›. Ala bara i xa mangɛya itaxun Medekae nun Perisekae ma.»

sentences.english: Then, by the order of Belshazzar, they put a purple robe on Daniel, and a gold chain round his neck, and a public statement was made that he was to be a ruler of high authority in the kingdom.
sentences.susu: Belisasari naxa yaamari fi keren na, a Daniyɛli xa maxiri mangɛ dugi ra, a nun xɛɛma kɔnmagore ra, a man xa findi mangɛ saxan nde ra bɔxi birin xun ma.

sentences.english: That very night Belshazzar, the king of the Chaldaeans, was put to death.
sentences.susu: Na kɔɛ kerenyi kui mixi nde naxa Babilɔn mangɛ Belisasari faxa.

sentences.english: Darius was pleased to put over the kingdom a hundred and twenty captains, who were to be all through the kingdom;
sentences.susu: Dariyusi Medeka naxa findi mangɛ ra a ɲɛ tongo senni nun firin ma.

sentences.english: And over them were three chief rulers, of whom Daniel was one; and the captains were to be responsible to the chief rulers, so that the king might undergo no loss.
sentences.susu: A naxa marasi ti e xa mixi kɛmɛ mixi mɔxɔɲɛn sugandi e xa a xa bɔxi yamari.

sentences.english: Then this Daniel did his work better than the chief rulers and the captains, because there was a special spirit in him; and it was the king's purpose to put him over all the kingdom.
sentences.susu: A man naxa mixi saxan ti e xun na, marasitie e dɛntɛgɛma naxee bɛ alako mangɛ xa fe birin xa sɔɔnɛya. Daniyɛli nu na na mixi saxanyie nan ya ma.

sentences.english: Then the chief rulers and the captains were looking for some cause for putting Daniel in the wrong in connection with the kingdom, but they were unable to put forward any wrongdoing or error against him; because he was true, and no error or wrong was to be seen in him.
sentences.susu: Xaxili fanyi mɔɔli naxan nu Daniyɛli bɛ, na nu dangi marasimae nun e xa mangɛe gbe birin na. Maɲɔxunyi naxa lu mangɛ bɛ a Daniyɛli xa a xa bɔxi birin yamari.

sentences.english: Then these men said, We will only get a reason for attacking Daniel in connection with the law of his God.
sentences.susu: Na xa fe ra, boore yareratie nun marasimae naxa kata e xa Daniyɛli kalamu a xa mangɛ wali kui, kɔnɔ e mu tantanyi yo to a ra. A nu tinxin, e dugutɛgɛ na a ra, a fata walide.

sentences.english: Then these chief rulers and the captains came to the king and said to him, O King Darius, have life for ever.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui e naxa a fala, «Won mu kalamui yo toma Daniyɛli mabiri, fo a Marigi Ala xa sɛriyɛ kui.»

sentences.english: All the chief rulers of the kingdom, the chiefs and the captains, the wise men and the rulers, have made a common decision to put in force a law having the king's authority, and to give a strong order, that whoever makes any request to any god or man but you, O King, for thirty days, is to be put into the lions' hole.
sentences.susu: Na kui marasimae nun e xunyie naxa siga keren na mangɛ yire, e fa a fala a bɛ, «Mangɛ Dariyusi, simaya xa lu i bɛ.

sentences.english: Now, O King, put the order in force, signing the writing so that it may not be changed, like the law of the Medes and Persians which may not come to an end.
sentences.susu: I xa bɔxi mangɛe, mangɛ rasie, gominae, nun kuntigie birin a maɲɔxunxi a a lanma yi tɔnyi xa dɔxɔ: ‹Mixi yo naxan tuubima ala nde bɛ, xa na mu a ra mixi nde bɛ, bafe i tan mangɛ ra xi tongo saxan bun ma, na kanyi xa raso yɛtɛe tagi.›

sentences.english: For this reason King Darius put his name on the writing and the order.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi mangɛ, i xa tin yi tɔnyi ra, i xa i bɛlɛxɛ fɔxi sa a ma alako a xa findi yaamari ra naxan mu masarama alɔ Medekae nun Perisekae darixi a ra ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And Daniel, on hearing that the writing had been signed, went into his house; (now he had windows in his room on the roof opening in the direction of Jerusalem;) and three times a day he went down on his knees in prayer and praise before his God, as he had done before.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dariyusi naxa a bɛlɛxɛ fɔxi sa kɛɛdi ma yaamari sɛbɛxi a ma, a a findi tɔnyi ra.

sentences.english: Then these men were watching and saw Daniel making prayers and requesting grace before his God.
sentences.susu: Daniyɛli to a kolon a mangɛ nu bara a bɛlɛxɛ fɔxi sa na yaamari kɛɛdi ma, a naxa te a xɔnyi. A xa wundɛri nu rabixi Darisalamu mabiri. Sanmaya saxan lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ a nu a xinbi sinma, a a Marigi Ala maxandi, a a matɔxɔ alɔ a nu darixi a ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Then they came near before the king and said, O King, have you not put your name to an order that any man who makes a request to any god or man but you, O King, for thirty days, is to be put into the lions' hole? The king made answer and said, The thing is fixed by the law of the Medes and Persians which may not come to an end.
sentences.susu: Yi mixie naxa siga a xɔnyi keren na, e fa li a na a tuubife a Marigi Ala bɛ maxandi kui.

sentences.english: Then they made answer and said before the king, Daniel, one of the prisoners of Judah, has no respect for you, O King, or for the order signed by you, but three times a day he makes his prayer to God.
sentences.susu: E naxa siga mangɛ yire keren na, e fa a maxɔrin a xa yaamari ma, «Mangɛ i mu tɔnyi dɔxɔ xɛ a mixi yo naxan tuubima ala nde bɛ, xa na mu a ra mixi nde bɛ, bafe i tan na xi tongo saxan bun ma, a na kanyi xa raso yɛtɛe tagi.» Mangɛ naxa e yaabi, «Iyo. Yaamari na a ra naxan mu masarama alɔ Medekae nun Perisekae darixi a ra ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: When this thing came to the king's ears, it was very evil to him, and his heart was fixed on keeping Daniel safe, and till the going down of the sun he was doing everything in his power to get him free.
sentences.susu: E naxa fa a fala mangɛ bɛ, «Mangɛ, Daniyɛli naxan kelixi Yudaya a mu i xui binyaxi, a mu i xa yaamari suxuxi. A Ala maxandima sanya saxan lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ.»

sentences.english: Then these men said to the king, Be certain, O King, that by the law of the Medes and Persians no order or law which the king has put into force may be changed.
sentences.susu: Na wɔyɛnyi naxa mangɛ tɔɔrɔ ki fanyi ra. A nu wama Daniyɛli ratangafe sɛriyɛ ma. A naxa fe birin naba beenun kɔɛ xa so alako Daniyɛli xa kisi.

sentences.english: Then the king gave the order, and they took Daniel and put him into the lions' hole. The king made answer and said to Daniel, Your God, whose servant you are at all times, will keep you safe.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na xɛmɛe man naxa siga mangɛ yire, e fa a fala a bɛ, «Mangɛ, i xa ratu Medekae nun Perisekae xa sɛriyɛ ma. Mangɛ xa sɛriyɛ mu nɔma masarade.»

sentences.english: Then they got a stone and put it over the mouth of the hole, and it was stamped with the king's stamp and with the stamp of the lords, so that the decision about Daniel might not be changed.
sentences.susu: Na kui Mangɛ naxa yaamari fi e xa Daniyɛli woli yɛtɛe tagi. Mangɛ naxa a fala Daniyɛli bɛ, «I Marigi Ala, i birama naxan fɔxɔ ra tunnabɛxiya kui, a xa i rakisi.»

sentences.english: Then the king went to his great house, and took no food that night, and no ... were placed before him, and his sleep went from him.
sentences.susu: E naxa gɛmɛ xungbe sa yɛtɛe yire naadɛ ra, mangɛ fan naxa a xa tɔnxuma sa naadɛ ma a xa xurundɛ ra, alako sese naxa masara Daniyɛli xa fe ra. Kuntigie fan naxa na raba.

sentences.english: Then very early in the morning the king got up and went quickly to the lions' hole.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa gbilen a xɔnyi. A mu a dɛge, a mu tin fefe rabade, na kɔɛ birin a mu xi feo.

sentences.english: And when he came near the hole where Daniel was, he gave a loud cry of grief; the king made answer and said to Daniel, O Daniel, servant of the living God, is your God, whose servant you are at all times, able to keep you safe from the lions?
sentences.susu: Kuye to iba, a naxa kurun, a siga yɛtɛe yire.

sentences.english: Then Daniel said to the king, O King, have life for ever.
sentences.susu: A to mɛnni li, a naxa Daniyɛli xili a xui makinikinixi ra, «Daniyɛli, Ala ɲiɲɛ xa konyi. I Marigi Ala, i birama naxan fɔxɔ ra tunnabɛxiya kui, a bara nɔ i ratangade yɛtɛe ma?»

sentences.english: My God has sent his angel to keep the lions' mouths shut, and they have done me no damage: because I was seen to be without sin before him; and further, before you, O King, I have done no wrong.
sentences.susu: Daniyɛli naxa mangɛ yaabi, «Mangɛ, i xa simaya xɔn xa kuya.

sentences.english: Then the king was very glad, and gave orders for them to take Daniel up out of the hole. So Daniel was taken up out of the hole and he was seen to be untouched, because he had faith in his God.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala bara a xa malekɛ xɛɛ yɛtɛe dɛe balande. E mu n tɔɔrɔ fefe ma, barima Ala a kolon a n mu fe ɲaaxi yo rabaxi. Hali i tan mabiri mangɛ, n mu fe kobi yo rabaxi.»

sentences.english: And at the king's order, they took those men who had said evil against Daniel, and put them in the lions' hole, with their wives and their children; and they had not got to the floor of the hole before the lions overcame them and all their bones were broken.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa sɛɛwa ki fanyi, a fa yaamari fi e xa Daniyɛli rate naa kui. E to na raba, e naxa a to a fate mu maxɔnɔxi, barima a nu bara la a Marigi Ala ra.

sentences.english: Then King Darius sent a letter to all the peoples, nations, and languages, living in all the earth: May your peace be increased.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa yaamari fi, a na xɛmɛ naxee Daniyɛli kalamu, e xa woli yɛtɛe tagi, e nun e xa ginɛe nun e xa die ra. Beenu e xa yili bɔtini li, yɛtɛe nu bara gɛ e faxade, e e xɔri birin magira.

sentences.english: It is my order that in all the kingdom of which I am ruler, men are to be shaking with fear before the God of Daniel: for he is the living God, unchanging for ever, and his kingdom is one which will never come to destruction, his rule will go on to the end.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Mangɛ Dariyusi naxa yaamari sɛbɛ sie nun bɔnsɔɛe birin ma, a nun xui birin falae naxee na duniɲa ma, «Bɔɲɛsa fanyi xa lu wo bɛ.

sentences.english: He gives salvation and makes men free from danger, and does signs and wonders in heaven and earth, who has kept Daniel safe from the power of the lions.
sentences.susu: N bara n ma mangɛya birin yaamari, wo xa gaaxu Daniyɛli Marigi Ala ya ra, wo xa a binya.» «Ala ɲiɲɛ na a ra. A na na tɛmui birin. A xa mangɛya mu kanama abadan. A xa yaamari buma nɛ han duniɲa ɲɔn.

sentences.english: So this Daniel did well in the kingdom of Darius and in the kingdom of Cyrus the Persian.
sentences.susu: A tan nan mixi rakisima, a e ratanga. A tɔnxumae nun kaabanakoe rabama koore nun bɔxi ma. A tan nan Daniyɛli ratangaxi yɛtɛe ma.»

sentences.english: In the first year of Belshazzar, king of Babylon, Daniel saw a dream, and visions came into his head on his bed: then he put the dream in writing.
sentences.susu: Belisasari xa mangɛya ɲɛ singe ra Babilɔn, Daniyɛli naxa xiye sa, laamatunyie naxa ragoro a ma a saxi tɛmui naxɛ. Na dangi xanbi, a naxa na xiye kui ife sɛbɛ.

sentences.english: I had a vision by night, and saw the four winds of heaven violently moving the great sea.
sentences.susu: Daniyɛli naxa a fala, «N bara laamatunyi to xiye kui kɔɛ ra, foye kelixi koore ma duniɲa tunxun naanie ra, a din baa ra, a a i maxa.»

sentences.english: And four great beasts came up from the sea, different one from another.
sentences.susu: «Sube magaaxuxi naani naxa mini baa ma, e sese keren mu a ra.

sentences.english: The first was like a lion and had eagle's wings; while I was watching its wings were pulled off, and it was lifted up from the earth and placed on two feet like a man, and a man's heart was given to it.
sentences.susu: A singe nu luxi nɛ alɔ yɛtɛ, sɛgɛ gabutenyie na naxan ma. N a to nɛ, e a gabutenyie italama, e a ti bɔxi ma alɔ mixi, e adama sondonyi raso a fate.»

sentences.english: And I saw another beast, like a bear, and it was lifted up on one side, and three side-bones were in its mouth, between its teeth: and they said to it, Up! take much flesh.
sentences.susu: «Sube firin nde nu luxi nɛ alɔ wulai bare xungbe. A saxi a sɛɛti ma, ganyanxɔri saxan na a dɛ i, a e xinma. E naxa a fala a bɛ, ‹Keli, i xa sube gbegbe don.›»

sentences.english: After this I saw another beast, like a leopard, which had on its back four wings like those of a bird; and the beast had four heads, and the power of a ruler was given to it.
sentences.susu: «Na dangi xanbi, n naxa sube nde to naxan luxi alɔ baratɛ, kɔnɔ xɔni gabutenyi naani na a bɛ, xunyi naani fan na a bɛ. A naxa nɔɛ sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: After this, in my vision of the night, I saw a fourth beast, a thing causing fear and very troubling, full of power and very strong; and it had great iron teeth: it took its food, crushing some of it to bits and stamping down the rest with its feet: it was different from all the beasts before it; and it had ten horns.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, n naxa sube naani nde to xiye kui kɔɛ ra. Na fan nu magaaxu ki fanyi, a gbangbalan han. A nu sube donma a wure ɲinyi gbangbalanyie nan na, sube dɔnxɔɛ naxan lu, a naxa na maboron a sanyi ra. A tan mu nu luxi alɔ sube booree. Feri fu nu na a xunyi ma.

sentences.english: I was watching the horns with care, and I saw another coming up among them, a little one, before which three of the first horns were pulled up by the roots: and there were eyes like a man's eyes in this horn, and a mouth saying great things.
sentences.susu: N to n ya rasiga n xa a ferie igbɛ, feri lanmadi naxa mini booree tagi. Feri saxanyie naxa tala na feri lanmadi ya ra. Ya nu na na feri bɛ naxee nu luxi alɔ adamadi yae. Dɛ fan nu na na feri bɛ, naxan nu na yɛtɛ igboe wɔyɛnyie falafe.»

sentences.english: I went on looking till the seats of kings were placed, and one like a very old man took his seat: his clothing was white as snow, and the hair of his head was like clean wool; his seat was flames of fire and its wheels burning fire.
sentences.susu: «N naxa a to, kibanyie dɔxɔxi, Ala, fɔlɛ mu na naxan bɛ, a naxa a magoro. A xa dugi birin fiixɛ alɔ xiɲɛ, a xunsɛxɛ luxi alɔ gɛsɛ fute, a xa kibanyi luxi nɛ alɔ tɛ, sanyi digilinxie nu na a xa kibanyi ma.

sentences.english: A stream of fire was flowing and coming out from before him: a thousand thousands were his servants, and ten thousand times ten thousand were in their places before him: the judge was seated and the books were open.
sentences.susu: Xure tɛ nu goroma a ya ra. Mixi wulu wulu nu na a batufe. Mixi wulu wulu nu tixi a ya ra. Kiitisae naxa e magoro, e bukie rabi.

sentences.english: Then I saw — because of the voice of the great words which the horn said — I saw till the beast was put to death, and its body was given to destruction, and the beast was given to the burning of fire.
sentences.susu: N naxa a to, na feri lanmadi nu na yɛtɛ igboe wɔyɛnyie falafe. N naxa a to, e sube naani nde faxaxi n ya xɔri, e fa a binbi wɔlɛ tɛ xɔɔra, a xa gan.

sentences.english: As for the rest of the beasts, their authority was taken away: but they let them go on living for a measure of time.
sentences.susu: Sɛnbɛ naxa ba sube booree yi ra, kɔnɔ waxati nde naxa sa e xa simaya tan xun ma.

sentences.english: I saw in visions of the night, and there was coming with the clouds of heaven one like a man, and he came to the one who was very old, and they took him near before him.
sentences.susu: N naxa a to xiye kui kɔɛ ra, Adamadi maniyɛ kelima nuxui fari, a a masoma Ala ra, fɔlɛ mu na naxan bɛ.

sentences.english: And to him was given authority and glory and a kingdom; and all peoples, nations, and languages were his servants: his authority is an eternal authority which will not come to an end, and his kingdom is one which will not come to destruction.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa sɛnbɛ, binyɛ, nun mangɛya so a yi, alako sie birin, bɔnsɔɛ birin, nun xui birin falɛe xa lu a xa yaamari bun ma. A xa yaamari mu ɲɔnma abadan, a xa mangɛya buma nɛ tɛmui birin, danyi yo mu na a ma.»

sentences.english: As for me, Daniel, my spirit was pained because of this, and the visions of my head were troubling me.
sentences.susu: «N tan Daniyɛli, n xaxili naxa ifu, n ma xiye naxa n magaaxu.

sentences.english: I came near to one of those who were waiting there, questioning him about what all this was. And he said to me that he would make clear to me the sense of these things.
sentences.susu: N naxa n maso mixi nde ra naxan nu na mɛnni n ma xiye kui, n naxa a maxɔrin, a xa na fe fiixɛ n bɛ.

sentences.english: These great beasts are four kings who will be cut off from the earth.
sentences.susu: A naxa na tagi raba n bɛ, ‹Yi sube magaaxuxi naanie, duniɲa mangɛ naani nan na e ra naxee fama bulade bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: But the saints of the Most High will take the kingdom, and it will be theirs for ever, even for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala Xungbe xa sɛniyɛntɔɛe fama nɛ mangɛya sɔtɔde, a mu bama e yi ra abadan.›»

sentences.english: Then it was my desire to have certain knowledge about the fourth beast, which was different from all the others, a cause of great fear, whose teeth were of iron and his nails of brass; who took his food, crushing some of it to bits and stamping on the rest with his feet;
sentences.susu: «Na dangi xanbi, n naxa wa na sube naani nde xa fe fahaamufe. A mu nu luxi alɔ sube booree. A magaaxu, wure ɲinyie nun yɔxui sanxalee nan nu na a bɛ. A na gɛ sube donde, a naxan luma, a na maboronma nɛ.

sentences.english: And about the ten horns on his head and the other which came up, causing the fall of three; that horn which had eyes, and a mouth saying great things, which seemed to be greater than the other horns.
sentences.susu: N man naxa wa na feri xa fe kolonfe. Feri fu nu na a xunyi ma, kɔnɔ feri gbɛtɛ to mini, feri saxan naxa bira na feri booree ya ra. Ya nu na feri bɛ, a dɛ fan nu na yɛtɛ igboe wɔyɛnyie falafe. A nu gbo boore feri birin bɛ.»

sentences.english: And I saw how that horn made war on the saints and overcame them,
sentences.susu: «N naxa na feri to sɛniyɛntɔɛe gere ra, a naxa nɔ e ra,

sentences.english: Till he came, who was very old, and the decision was made and the authority was given to the saints of the Most High; and the time came when the saints took the kingdom.
sentences.susu: han Ala Xungbe, fɔlɛ mu na naxan bɛ, na fa kiiti sade e tagi tɛmui naxɛ, a fa nɔndi fi a xa sɛniyɛntɔɛe ma, alako e xa mangɛya sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: This is what he said: The fourth beast is a fourth kingdom which will come on earth, different from all the kingdoms, and it will overcome all the earth, crushing it down and smashing it.
sentences.susu: «A naxa na fasari n bɛ yi ki, ‹Na sube naani nde findixi duniɲa mangɛya nde nan na, naxan mu luxi alɔ boore mangɛyae. A fama nɛ duniɲa birin sɔtɔde, a a halaki, a a maboron.

sentences.english: And as for the ten horns, out of this kingdom ten kings will come to power; and after them another will come up: he will be different from the first ones and will put down three kings.
sentences.susu: Na feri fu findixi mangɛ fu nan na, naxee fama tide na mangɛya xun ma. E na dangi, mangɛ gbɛtɛ tima nɛ. A mu luma alɔ e tan, a fama mangɛ saxan nagorode.

sentences.english: And he will say words against the Most High, attempting to put an end to the saints of the Most High; and he will have the idea of changing times and law; and the saints will be given into his hands for a time and times and half a time.
sentences.susu: A wɔyɛnma nɛ Ala Xungbe xili ra, a sɛniyɛntɔɛe ɲaxankata, a wa waxatie nun sɛriyɛe masarafe. Sɛniyɛntɔɛe fama nɛ lude a bɛlɛxɛ waxati saxan nun a tagi bun ma.

sentences.english: But the judge will be seated, and they will put an end to his authority, to overcome it and send complete destruction on it.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, kiiti sama nɛ, mangɛya bama nɛ a yi ra, a halaki kerenyi ra.

sentences.english: And the kingdom and the authority and the power of the kingdoms under all the heaven will be given to the people of the saints of the Most High: his kingdom is an eternal kingdom, and all powers will be his servants and do his pleasure.
sentences.susu: Mangɛya, yaamari, nun binyɛ naxan birin na duniɲa, na fama nɛ fide Ala Xungbe xa sɛniyɛntɔɛe ma. Ala xa mangɛya mu ɲɔnma abadan. Sɛnbɛ kanyi birin fama nɛ a xa yaamari suxude, e a rabatu.›»

sentences.english: Here is the end of the account. As for me, Daniel, I was greatly troubled by my thoughts, and the colour went from my face: but I kept the thing in my heart.
sentences.susu: «Masenyi danyi nan yi ki. N tan Daniyɛli, n naxa gaaxu n ma maɲɔxunyie ra han n yatagi naxa masara. N naxa yi masenyi birin nagata n bɔɲɛ ma.»

sentences.english: In the third year of the rule of Belshazzar the king, a vision was seen by me, Daniel, after the one I saw at first.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Belisasari xa mangɛya ɲɛ saxan nde ra, n tan Daniyɛli naxa xiye gbɛtɛ sa.

sentences.english: And I saw in the vision; and when I saw it, I was in the strong town Shushan, which is in the country of Elam; and in the vision I was by the water-door of the Ulai.
sentences.susu: N nu na Suse nɛ, Elama bɔxi mangɛ taa, xure nde dɛ ra naxan xili «Ulayi xure.»

sentences.english: And lifting up my eyes, I saw, there before the stream, a male sheep with two horns: and the two horns were high, but one was higher than the other, the higher one coming up last.
sentences.susu: N to n ya rakeli, n yɛxɛɛ kontonyi nan to, a tixi xure dɛ ra. Feri kuye firin nu na a xunyi. Naxan bula a dɔnxɔɛ ra, na nu kuya boore bɛ.

sentences.english: I saw the sheep pushing to the west and to the north and to the south; and no beasts were able to keep their place before him, and no one was able to get people out of his power; but he did whatever his pleasure was and made himself great.
sentences.susu: N naxa yɛxɛɛ kontonyi to, a kuye bɔtima a ferie ma sogegorode biri, kɔɔla biri, nun yirefanyi biri. Sube yo mu nu nɔma tide a kanke, birin nu na a xa nɔɛ nan bun ma. A nu a waxɔnfe birin nabama, a sɛnbɛ fan nu gboma nan tui.

sentences.english: And while I was giving thought to this, I saw a he-goat coming from the west over the face of all the earth without touching the earth: and the he-goat had a great horn between his eyes.
sentences.susu: N nu na n maɲɔxunfe na ma tɛmui naxɛ, sikɔtɛ nde naxa fa keli sogegorode. A naxa bɔxi birin iɲɛrɛ, kɔnɔ a sanyi mu din bɔxi ra. Feri magaaxuxi nde nu na a yae tagi.

sentences.english: And he came to the two-horned sheep which I saw before the stream, rushing at him in the heat of his power.
sentences.susu: A naxa fa han yɛxɛɛ kontonyi feri firin kanyi yire, n naxan to xure dɛ ra. A naxa a gi, a bɔnbɔ a ra a sɛnbɛ birin na.

sentences.english: And I saw him come right up to the sheep, and he was moved with wrath against him, attacking the sheep so that his two horns were broken; and the sheep had not strength to keep his place before him, but was pushed down on the earth and crushed under his feet: and there was no one to get the sheep out of his power.
sentences.susu: N naxa a to a yɛxɛɛ kontonyi gerema, a naxa a feri firinyi kana. Kontonyi mu nɔ a ra. Sikɔtɛ naxa a rabira bɔxi, a a maboron, mixi yo mu nɔ e tagi ibade.

sentences.english: And the he-goat became very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken, and in its place came up four other horns turned to the four winds of heaven.
sentences.susu: Sikɔtɛ naxa xungbo a fanyi ra, kɔnɔ a sɛnbɛ to gbo, a feri magaaxuxi naxa gira. Feri magaaxuxi naani gbɛtɛ naxa bula a ɲɔxɔɛ ra. E ya nu rafindixi duniɲa tunxun naanie biri ra.

sentences.english: And out of one of them came another horn, a little one, which became very great, stretching to the south and to the east and to the beautiful land.
sentences.susu: Feri lanmadi naxa mini feri nde ma, a kuya fɔlɔ yirefanyi biri, sogetede biri, nun bɔxi nde mabiri ra naxan tofan bɔxi birin bɛ.

sentences.english: And it became great, even as high as the army of heaven, pulling down some of the army, even of the stars, to the earth and crushing them under its feet.
sentences.susu: A naxa kuya han a te koore malekɛ galie xili ma. A naxa na malekɛ ndee nun tunbui ndee rabira bɔxi ma, a e maboron.

sentences.english: It made itself great, even as great as the lord of the army; and by it the regular burned offering was taken away, and the place overturned and the holy place made waste.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yɛtɛ ite han koore malekɛ galie xa mangɛ fan xili ma, a fa na mangɛ xa sɛrɛxɛ ba a yi ra, naxan nu bama lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ. A man naxa a xa yire sɛniyɛnxi fan mabere.

sentences.english: ... against the regular burned offering; and ... crushed down to the earth, and it did its pleasure and things went well for it.
sentences.susu: Koore malekɛ galie naxa lu sikɔtɛ xa nɔɛ bun. Sɛrɛxɛ naxan nu bama lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ, na fan naxa kana matandi saabui ra. Feri naxa nɔndi wɔlɛ. A xa fe naxa sɔɔnɛya.

sentences.english: Then there came to my ears the voice of a holy one talking; and another holy one said to that certain one who was talking, How long will the vision be while the regular burned offering is taken away, and the unclean thing causing fear is put up, and the holy place crushed under foot?
sentences.susu: N naxa sɛniyɛntɔɛ nde xui mɛ, a wɔyɛnfe a boore sɛniyɛntɔɛ bɛ, «Yi laamatunyi naxan findixi sɛrɛxɛ kanafe ra, tinxintareya xa gbaloe, yire sɛniyɛnxi maberefe, nun koore malekɛ galie lufe na nɔɛ bun, e maboron, na birin buma xi yire?»

sentences.english: And he said to him, For two thousand, three hundred evenings and mornings; then the holy place will be made clean.
sentences.susu: A naxa n yaabi, «Xi wulu keren xi kɛmɛ xi tongo suuli, na dangi xanbi, na yire sɛniyɛnxi man nasɛniyɛnma nɛ.»

sentences.english: And it came about that when I, Daniel, had seen this vision, I had a desire for the sense of it to be unfolded; and I saw one before me in the form of a man.
sentences.susu: N tan Daniyɛli, n to nu na laamatunyi xa fe maɲɔxunma, alako n xa a fahaamu, daali nde naxa ti n ya i naxan nun mixi maniyɛ.

sentences.english: And the voice of a man came to my ears between the sides of the Ulai, crying out and saying, Gabriel, make the vision clear to this man.
sentences.susu: N naxa mixi nde xui mɛ keli xure ra naxan xili «Ulayi xure,» a a falama a xui itexi ra, «Yibirila, laamatunyi tagiraba a bɛ.»

sentences.english: So he came and took his place near where I was; and when he came, I was full of fear and went down on my face: but he said to me, Let it be clear to you, O son of man; for the vision has to do with the time of the end.
sentences.susu: A naxa a maso n na. N naxa gaaxu a ya ra ki fanyi, n nan n felen bɔxi ma. A naxa a fala n bɛ, «Adamadi, i xa a kolon yi laamatunyi waxati dɔnxɔɛ nan ma fe masenma.»

sentences.english: Now while he was talking to me, I went into a deep sleep with my face to the earth: but touching me, he put me on my feet where I had been.
sentences.susu: A nu wɔyɛnfe n bɛ tɛmui naxɛ, n naxa matu a ra, n nan n yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma, kɔnɔ a naxa a bɛlɛxɛ din n na, a n nakeli.

sentences.english: And he said, See, I will make clear to you what is to come in the later time of the wrath: for it has to do with the fixed time of the end.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a fala n bɛ, «N xa i rakolon fe ma naxan fama rabade xɔnɛ ɲɔn tɛmui, barima waxati bara sugandi na ɲɔnfe ma.

sentences.english: The sheep which you saw with two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia.
sentences.susu: I yɛxɛɛ kontonyi feri firinyie naxee toxi, nee misaalixi Mede nun Perise mangɛe nan na.

sentences.english: And the he-goat is the king of Greece: and the great horn between his eyes is the first king.
sentences.susu: Sikɔtɛ xabe kanyi tan misaalixi Girɛki bɔxi mangɛ nan na. Feri belebele naxan na a yatagi, na misaalixi mangɛ singe nan na.

sentences.english: And as for that which was broken, in place of which four came up, four kingdoms will come up from his nation, but not with his power.
sentences.susu: Feri singe to gira, feri naani naxa mini a ɲɔxɔɛ ra. Nee misaalixi na bɔxi mangɛya naanie nan na, kɔnɔ e sɛnbɛ mu gbo alɔ na singe.»

sentences.english: And in the later years of their kingdom, when their evil doings have become complete, there will come up a king full of pride and expert in dark sayings.
sentences.susu: «Na mangɛyae na ɲɔn, yunubitɔɛe xa fe kobie na kamali, mangɛ gbɛtɛ kelima nɛ, a a yɛtɛ igbo, a mixie madaxu.

sentences.english: And his power will be great, and he will be purposing strange things. And all will go well for him and he will do his pleasure; and he will send destruction on the strong ones.
sentences.susu: A sɛnbɛ fama nɛ gbode, kɔnɔ na mu kelima a tan xa ma. A gbaloe magaaxuxie rabama nɛ, a waxɔnfe birin sɔɔnɛyama nɛ, a sɛnbɛmae nun sɛniyɛntɔɛe halakima nɛ.

sentences.english: And his designs will be turned against the holy people, causing deceit to do well in his hand; in his heart he will make himself great, and send destruction on numbers who are living unconscious of their danger; and he will put himself up against the prince of princes; but he will be broken, though not by men's hands.
sentences.susu: A a yɛtɛ igboma nɛ a xa naafuli nun a xa yanfanteya xa fe ra. A mixi gbegbe faxama nɛ, naxee bɔɲɛ nu saxi. A kelima nɛ mangɛe xa mangɛ xili ma. Kɔnɔ na birin dangi xanbi, a fama nɛ halakide, halaki naxan mu kelixi adama ma.

sentences.english: And the vision of evenings and mornings which has been talked of is true: and keep the vision secret; for it has to do with the far-off future.
sentences.susu: Na laamatunyi naxan xi xasabi xa fe falaxi, na mu kanama, kɔnɔ i xa a ragata gundo ra, barima a tɛmui xɔnnakuye nan ma fe masenma.»

sentences.english: And I, Daniel, was ill for some days; then I got up and did the king's business: and I was full of wonder at the vision, but no one was able to give the sense of it.
sentences.susu: «N tan Daniyɛli, n sɛnbɛ birin naxa ɲɔn, n man fa fura xi wuyaxi bun ma. N to yalan, n naxa keli, n fa mangɛ xa walie suxu. Na laamatunyi naxa n ifu, n mu nɔ a fahaamude.»

sentences.english: In the first year of Darius, the son of Ahasuerus, of the seed of the Medes, who was made king over the kingdom of the Chaldaeans;
sentences.susu: Dariyusi, Asuyerusu xa di naxan keli Mede bɔnsɔɛ, a naxa findi Kalidi mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: In the first year of his rule, I, Daniel, saw clearly from the books the number of years given by the word of the Lord to the prophet Jeremiah, in which the making waste of Jerusalem was to be complete, that is, seventy years.
sentences.susu: A xa mangɛya ɲɛ singe, n tan Daniyɛli, n naxa a kolon kitaabui saabui ra a Alatala nu bara a fala Annabi Yeremi bɛ, a Darisalamu xa kasarɛ buma nɛ ɲɛ tongo solofere.

sentences.english: And turning my face to the Lord God, I gave myself up to prayer, requesting his grace, going without food, in haircloth and dust.
sentences.susu: Na na a to, n naxa sunyi suxu, n sunnun donma ragoro n ma, n tɛ xube maso n xunyi ma, n naxa n ya rafindi n Marigi Ala ma, n a maxandi.

sentences.english: And I made prayer to the Lord my God, putting our sins before him, and said, O Lord, the great God, greatly to be feared. keeping your agreement and mercy with those who have love for you and do your orders;
sentences.susu: N naxa n Marigi Alatala maxandi yi ki, «N Marigi Ala, naxan sɛnbɛ gbo, naxan magaaxu, naxan a xa saatɛ rakamalima, naxan hinnɛma a xanuntenyie ra nun a fɔxirabirɛe ra,

sentences.english: We are sinners, acting wrongly and doing evil; we have gone against you, turning away from your orders and from your laws:
sentences.susu: muxu bara yunubi raba, muxu bara tantan, muxu bara findi mixi ɲaaxi nun matandilae ra, muxu bara gbilen i xa sɛriyɛ nun i xa yaamarie fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: We have not given ear to your servants the prophets, who said words in your name to our kings and our rulers and our fathers and all the people of the land.
sentences.susu: Muxu mu i xa konyie xui suxu, i xa namiɲɔnmɛ naxee wɔyɛn i xili ra muxu xa mangɛe bɛ, a nun muxu xa mangɛdie, muxu babae, nun muxu xa ɲama birin bɛ.»

sentences.english: O Lord, righteousness is yours, but shame is on us, even to this day; and on the men of Judah and the people of Jerusalem, and on all Israel, those who are near and those who are far off, in all the countries where you have sent them because of the sin which they have done against you.
sentences.susu: «I tan Marigi, i tinxin, kɔnɔ muxu nu bara i yanfa. To lɔxɔɛ muxu birin yaagixi na nan ma, Yudayakae, Darisalamukae, Isirayilakae, naxee na be, naxee na yire makuye, naxee na ɲamanɛ birin i muxu rayensenxi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: O Lord, shame is on us, on our kings and our rulers and our fathers, because of our sin against you.
sentences.susu: Alatala, muxu birin yaagixi, muxu xa mangɛe, muxu xa mangɛdie, nun muxu babae. Muxu yaagixi barima muxu bara yunubi raba i ra.

sentences.english: With the Lord our God are mercies and forgiveness, for we have gone against him;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan muxu Marigi Ala, i bara hinnɛ muxu ra, i bara diɲɛ muxu ma, hali muxu to i matandi.

sentences.english: And have not given ear to the voice of the Lord our God to go in the way of his laws which he put before us by the mouth of his servants the prophets.
sentences.susu: Muxu mu muxu Marigi Alatala xui suxu. Muxu mu bira a xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra, a naxan masenxi a xa konyi namiɲɔnmɛe saabui ra.

sentences.english: And all Israel have been sinners against your law, turning away so as not to give ear to your voice: and the curse has been let loose on us, and the oath recorded in the law of Moses, the servant of God, for we have done evil against him.
sentences.susu: Isirayila ɲama birin bara i xa sɛriyɛ matandi, muxu bara muxu makuya i ra, muxu mu i xui suxu.» «Na nan a ra, dankɛ naxee sɛbɛxi Tawureta Munsa kui a bara goro muxu ma. Muxu bara Ala xa konyi Munsa xa sɛriyɛ kana, na bara findi yunubi ra muxu bɛ Ala mabiri.

sentences.english: And he has given effect to his words which he said against us and against those who were our judges, by sending a great evil on us: for under all heaven there has not been done what has been done to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: I naxan fala muxu xa fe ra, a nun muxu xa mangɛ xa fe ra, naxee nu muxu yamarima, i bara na wɔyɛnyi rakamali. I bara muxu ɲaxankata a ɲaaxi ra. I naxan nabaxi Darisalamu ra, ɲama yo mu nu na ɲaxankatɛ mɔɔli singe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: As it was recorded in the law of Moses, all this evil has come on us: but we have made no prayer for grace from the Lord our God that we might be turned from our evil doings and come to true wisdom.
sentences.susu: Na tɔɔrɛ birin bara muxu li alɔ Tawureta Munsa a masenxi ki naxɛ. Kɔnɔ muxu mu muxu Marigi Alatala maxandi, muxu mu gbilen muxu xa fe ɲaaxie fɔxɔ ra, muxu mu i xa nɔndi suxu.

sentences.english: So the Lord has been watching over this evil and has made it come on us: for the Lord our God is upright in all his acts which he has done, and we have not given ear to his voice.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, Alatala bara yi tɔɔrɛ ragoro muxu ma, barima muxu Marigi Alatala xa kɛwali tinxin, kɔnɔ muxu mu a xui suxu.»

sentences.english: And now, O Lord our God, who took your people out of the land of Egypt with a strong hand and made a great name for yourself even to this day; we are sinners, we have done evil.
sentences.susu: «Muxu Marigi Ala, i bara i xa ɲama ramini Misira bɔxi ma i bɛlɛxɛ sɛnbɛma ra. Han to i xili itexi falama na xa fe ra. Kɔnɔ muxu tan bara yunubi raba, muxu bara yunubi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: O Lord, because of your righteousness, let your wrath and your passion be turned away from your town Jerusalem, your holy mountain: because, through our sins and the evil-doing of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people have become a cause of shame to all who are round about us.
sentences.susu: Marigi, i to darixi fe tinxinxie raba ra, i xa diɲɛ Darisalamu nun i xa geya sɛniyɛnxi ma. I bɔɲɛ xa xinbeli, i naxa xɔnɔ. Muxu xa yunubie nun muxu babae xa yunubie bara Darisalamuka birin nayaagi muxu dɔxɔbooree xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: And now, give ear, O our God, to the prayer of your servant and to his request for grace, and let your face be shining on your holy place which is made waste, because of your servants, O Lord.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi, muxu Marigi Ala, yandi, i xa i xa konyi xa dubɛ suxu, i xa tin yi maxandi ra i xili fanyi xa fe ra. I xa i xa nɔrɛ ragoro i xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ma, naxan birin kanaxi.

sentences.english: O my God, let your ear be turned and give hearing; let your eyes be open and see how we have been made waste and the town which is named by your name: for we are not offering our prayers before you because of our righteousness, but because of your great mercies.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala, i tuli mati n na. I xa muxu xa taa kanaxi mato, i xili saxi naxan xun ma. Muxu mu i maxandima muxu xa kɛwali tinxinxie xa saabui ra. Muxu i maxandima i xa kinikini xungbe nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: O Lord, give ear; O Lord, have forgiveness; O Lord, take note and do; let there be no more waiting; for the honour of your name, O my God, because your town and your people are named by your name.
sentences.susu: Marigi, i xa muxu xa dubɛ suxu. Marigi, i xa diɲɛ. Marigi, i xa i ɲɛngi sa muxu xɔn ma. N Marigi Ala, i naxa dugundi, fe nde raba i xili fanyi xa fe ra, barima i xili saxi yi taa nun yi ɲama nan xun ma.»

sentences.english: And while I was still saying these words in prayer, and putting my sins and the sins of my people Israel before the Lord, and requesting grace from the Lord my God for the holy mountain of my God;
sentences.susu: N naxa wɔyɛn n Marigi Alatala bɛ, n naxa n ma yunubie nun Isirayila ɲama xa yunubie masen a bɛ. N man naxa n Marigi Alatala maxandi a xa geya sɛniyɛnxi bɛ.

sentences.english: Even while I was still in prayer, the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at first when my weariness was great, put his hand on me about the time of the evening offering.
sentences.susu: N to nu na Ala maxandife, Yibirila, n malekɛ naxan to n ma xiye singe kui naxa fa a gi ra keli koore ma nunmare sɛrɛxɛ ba tɛmui.

sentences.english: And teaching me and talking to me he said, O Daniel, I have come now to give you wisdom.
sentences.susu: A naxa n xaran yi wɔyɛnyi ra, «Daniyɛli n bara fa yakɔsi alako i xa fahaamui sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: At the first word of your prayer a word went out, and I have come to give you knowledge; for you are a man dearly loved: so give thought to the word and let the vision be clear to you.
sentences.susu: I to Ala maxandi fɔlɔ tun, Ala naxa n xɛɛ alako n xa masenyi ti i bɛ, barima Ala xanuntenyi nan na i ra. I xa yi wɔyɛnyi ramɛ, i xa yi laamatunyi fahaamu.»

sentences.english: Seventy weeks have been fixed for your people and your holy town, to let wrongdoing be complete and sin come to its full limit, and for the clearing away of evil-doing and the coming in of eternal righteousness: so that the vision and the word of the prophet may be stamped as true, and to put the holy oil on a most holy place.
sentences.susu: «Ala bara natɛ tongo i xa ɲama nun i xa taa sɛniyɛnxi xa lu konyiya kui lɔxɔxun tongo solofere bun ma, alako e xa fe ɲaaxie nun e xa yunubie xa dan. Na waxati bun ma e e xa yunubi sare fima nɛ, e Ala xa tinxinyi sɔtɔ naxan mu ɲɔnma abadan. Na kui, laamatunyi nun namiɲɔnmɛ xa wɔyɛnyi kamalima nɛ, Ala man gbilen a xa yire sɛniyɛnxi.

sentences.english: Have then the certain knowledge that from the going out of the word for the building again of Jerusalem till the coming of a prince, on whom the holy oil has been put, will be seven weeks: in sixty-two weeks its building will be complete, with square and earthwork.
sentences.susu: I xa a kolon, i xa a fahaamu. Darisalamu tife yaamari ma tɛmui naxɛ, han mangɛ sugandixi fa tɛmui, lɔxɔxun solofere nan dangima. Beenun lɔxɔxun tongo senni nun firin xa dangi, taa nun a tɛtɛ fama nɛ tide, hali na fa rabama tɔɔrɛ nan na.

sentences.english: And at the end of the times, even after the sixty-two weeks, one on whom the holy oil has been put will be cut off and have no...; and the town and the holy place will be made waste together with a prince; and the end will come with an overflowing of waters, and even to the end there will be war; the making waste which has been fixed.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔxun tongo senni nun firin dangi xanbi, e Ala xa mixi sugandixi faxama nɛ, mixi yo mu a xun mafalama. Na dangi xanbi, mangɛ nde xa ɲama fama nɛ, a na taa nun na yire sɛniyɛnxi kana. Na gbaloe mixie tɛrɛnnama nɛ, alɔ banbaranyi mixie tɛrɛnnama ki naxɛ. Gere ɲaaxi mu ɲɔnma han a ɲɔn waxati naxan natɛxi.

sentences.english: And a strong order will be sent out against the great number for one week; and so for half of the week the offering and the meal offering will come to an end; and in its place will be an unclean thing causing fear; till the destruction which has been fixed is let loose on him who has made waste.
sentences.susu: Na mangɛ fama nɛ saatɛ xiride a tan nun mixi gbegbe tagi lɔxɔxun keren bun ma. Na lɔxɔxun tagi, a tɔnyi dɔxɔma nɛ sɛrɛxɛ bafe ma. A xa kanɛ kamalima fe raharamuxi ɲaaxi ndee nan na. A luma nɛ na fe birin kui han a faxa tɛmui, alɔ a natɛxi ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: In the third year of Cyrus, king of Persia, a secret was unfolded to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, even a hard work: and he had knowledge of it, and the vision was clear to him.
sentences.susu: Perise mangɛ Sirusi xa mangɛya ɲɛ saxan nde ra, Ala naxa masenyi nde so Daniyɛli yi ra, naxan xili Beletesasari. Masenyi hagigɛ nan nu na ra, a gere belebele nan ma fe masenma. Daniyɛli naxa na mɛ, a na xiye fahaamu.

sentences.english: In those days I, Daniel, gave myself up to grief for three full weeks.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, n tan Daniyɛli, n naxa lɔxɔxun saxan naba sunnunyi kui.

sentences.english: I had no pleasing food, no meat or wine came into my mouth, and I put no oil on my body till three full weeks were ended.
sentences.susu: N mu donse fanyi yo don, n mu sube don, n mu wɛni min, n mu ture xiri ɲɔxunmɛ yo maso n ma, han na lɔxɔxun saxan kamali tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And on the twenty-fourth day of the first month I was by the side of the great river;
sentences.susu: Kike singe xi mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nde ra, n nu na Tigiri xure dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And lifting up my eyes I saw the form of a man clothed in a linen robe, and round him there was a band of gold, of the best gold:
sentences.susu: N to n ya rakeli, n naxa mixi nde to, dugi fiixɛ fanyi ragoroxi a ma, a tagi ixirixi bɛlɛti xɛɛma daaxi ra naxan keli Ufasi.

sentences.english: And his body was like the beryl, and his face had the look of a thunder-flame, and his eyes were like burning lights, and his arms and feet like the colour of polished brass, and the sound of his voice was like the sound of an army.
sentences.susu: A fate nu yanbama alɔ diyaman gɛmɛ, a yatagi alɔ seyamakɔnyi, a yae alɔ tɛ, a bɛlɛxɛe nun a sanyie alɔ yɔxui fanyi. A xui nu luxi nɛ alɔ galanyi.

sentences.english: And I, Daniel, was the only one who saw the vision, for the men who were with me did not see it; but a great shaking came on them and they went in flight to take cover.
sentences.susu: N tan, Daniyɛli, n keren nan na laamatunyi toxi. Mixi naxee nu na n sɛɛti ma, e mu laamatunyi to, kɔnɔ gaaxui naxa e suxu, e naxa e gi, e sa e nɔxun.

sentences.english: So I was by myself, and I saw this great vision, and all my strength went from me; and the colour went from my face.
sentences.susu: N naxa lu naa n keren. N to na laamatunyi fanyi to, n naxa matu a ra, n yatagi fan naxa masara.

sentences.english: But the sound of his words came to my ears, and on hearing his voice I went into a deep sleep with my face to the earth.
sentences.susu: N to na mixi wɔyɛn xui mɛ, n naxa n felen bɔxi ma, n dɛ naxa ixara.

sentences.english: Then a hand gave me a touch, awaking me, and putting me on my knees and my hands.
sentences.susu: Bɛlɛxɛ nde to din n na, n naxa n felen, n xinbi nun n bɛlɛxɛe xun na, kɔnɔ n fate birin nu sɛrɛnfe n ma.

sentences.english: And he said to me, O Daniel, you man dearly loved, take in the sense of the words I say to you and get up on to your feet: for to you I am now sent; and when he had said this to me I got on to my feet, shaking with fear.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen n bɛ, «Daniyɛli, mixi xanuxi, i xa n ma masenyi fahaamu. Keli, i ti, barima n xɛɛxi i tan nan ma.» A to na fala n bɛ, n naxa keli n sɛrɛnfe ra.

sentences.english: Then he said to me, Have no fear, Daniel; for from the first day when you gave your heart to getting wisdom and making yourself poor in spirit before your God, your words have come to his ears: and I have come because of your words.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen n bɛ, «Daniyɛli i naxa gaaxu, barima i to wa fahaamui fenfe yɛtɛ magoroe kui Ala ya i, Ala bara i xa maxandi suxu. N faxi be na nan ma.

sentences.english: But the angel of the kingdom of Persia put himself against me for twenty-one days; but Michael, one of the chief angels, came to my help; and when I came he was still there with the angel of the kings of Persia.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Sentanɛ xa malekɛ naxan na Perise bɔxi ma, a naxa ti n ya ra xi mɔxɔɲɛn nun keren, han Mikayeli, Ala xa malekɛe xa mangɛ xungbe nde, naxa fa n malide. Na kui n bara bu Perise mangɛe yire,

sentences.english: Now I have come to give you knowledge of the fate of your people in the later days; for there is still a vision for the days.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ yakɔsi n bara fa i rakolonde fe ma naxan fama rabade i xa ɲama ra tɛmui naxan sa fama, barima laamatunyi keren luxi na waxati xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And after he had said these words to me, I kept my face turned to the earth and was unable to say anything.
sentences.susu: A to nu na wɔyɛnfe n bɛ, n naxa n yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma, n dundu yen.

sentences.english: Then one whose form was like the sons of men put his finger on my lips; and opening my mouth, I said to him who was before me, O my lord, because of the vision my pains have come on me, and I have no more strength.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, adamadi maniyɛ nde naxa fa, a a bɛlɛxɛ din n dɛ kiri ra. N naxa n dɛ rabi, n fa a fala na bɛ, «N marigi, na laamatunyi bara n yatagi masara, a n matu a ra.

sentences.english: For how may this servant of my lord have talk with my lord? for, as for me, straight away my strength went from me and there was no breath in my body.
sentences.susu: N tan i xa konyi di wɔyɛnma n marigi ra di? N sɛnbɛ birin bara ɲɔn, ɲɛngife yati bara xɔrɔxɔ n bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then again one having the form of a man put his hand on me and gave me strength.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui na adamadi maniyɛ naxa a bɛlɛxɛ din n na a firin nde ra, n fa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And he said to me, O man greatly loved, have no fear: peace be with you, be strong and let your heart be lifted up. And at his words I became strong, and said, Let my lord say on, for you have given me strength.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen n bɛ, «Ala Xanuntenyi, i naxa gaaxu, i bɔɲɛ xa sa. Limaniya gben, i i sɛnbɛ so.» A to na fala n bɛ, n naxa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ keren na. N naxa a fala a bɛ, «N marigi, i xa i xa masenyi ti n bɛ, barima n bara sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ i saabui ra.»

sentences.english: Then he said, It is clear to you why I have come to you. And now I will give you an account of what is recorded in the true writings:
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen n bɛ, «N faxi i yire fe naxan ma i a kolon? Yakɔsi n xa gbilen, n xa sa Perise mangɛ gere. N na siga, Girɛki mangɛ fama nɛ.

sentences.english: But I am going back to make war with the angel of Persia, and when I am gone, the angel of Greece will come. And there is no one on my side against these, but Michael, your angel.
sentences.susu: Wo xa mangɛ Mikayeli gbansan na n malife na gere kui. Kɔnɔ beenu n xa siga, n xa nɔndi buki masenyi masen i bɛ.»

sentences.english: And as for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede I was on his side to make his position safe and make him strong.
sentences.susu: «N to nu na Mede mangɛ Dariyusi malife a xa mangɛya ɲɛ singe ra.

sentences.english: And now I will make clear to you what is true. There are still three kings to come in Persia, and the fourth will have much greater wealth than all of them: and when he has become strong through his wealth, he will put his forces in motion against all the kingdoms of Greece.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n xa nɔndi fala i bɛ. Mangɛ saxan fama nɛ Perise yamaride. Mangɛ naani nde fama nɛ naafuli gbegbe sɔtɔde dangife booree ra. A na sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ tɛmui naxɛ a naafuli ki ma, a kelima nɛ Girɛki mangɛya xili ma.»

sentences.english: And a strong king will come to power, ruling with great authority and doing whatever is his pleasure.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ mangɛ sɛnbɛma nde fama nɛ kelide, a bɔxi yamari sɛnbɛ belebele ra. Naxan yo a kɛnɛn, a na rabama nɛ.

sentences.english: And when he has become strong, his kingdom will be broken and parted to the four winds of heaven; but not to his offspring, for it will be uprooted; and his kingdom will be for the others and not for these: but not with the same authority as his.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na dangi xanbi, a xa mangɛya fama nɛ kanade, a rayensen duniɲa birin ma. A mu luma a bɔnsɔɛ bɛ, a mu findima mangɛya sɛnbɛma ra alɔ a singe. A xa mangɛya bama nɛ a yi ra, a lu mixi gbɛtɛe bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the king of the south will be strong, but one of his captains will be stronger than he and will be ruler; and his rule will be a great rule.
sentences.susu: «Mangɛ naxan na yirefanyi ma, na findima nɛ sɛnbɛma ra, kɔnɔ a xa mangɛdi nde fa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔde dangife a tan na, a bɔxi yamari nɔɛ xungbe ra.»

sentences.english: And at the end of years they will be joined together; and the daughter of the king of the south will come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she will not keep the strength of her arm; and his offspring will not keep their place; but she will be uprooted, with those who were the cause of her coming, and her son, and he who took her in those times.
sentences.susu: «Ɲɛ ndee na dangi, mangɛ naxan na yirefanyi ma, a fama nɛ a xa di ginɛ fide mangɛ ma naxan na kɔɔla ma, alako saatɛ xa lu e tagi. Kɔnɔ na ginɛ sɛnbɛ mu a ikuyama. A tan yo, a xa mɔri yo, a baba yo, nun a xa mixi birin bɔnɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: But out of a branch from her roots one will come up to take his place, who will come against the army, forcing his way into the strong place of the king of the north, and he will take them in hand and overcome them:
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ xa di nde fama nɛ kelide, a fa findi a baba ɲɔxɔɛ ra. A fama nɛ nɔde na mangɛ ra naxan na kɔɔla ma, a findi sɛnbɛma ra.

sentences.english: And their gods and their metal images and their fair vessels of silver and gold he will take away into the south; and for some years he will keep away from the king of the north.
sentences.susu: A e xa kuyee nun e xa xɛɛma nun gbeti birin xaninma nɛ Misira bɔxi ma. A makuyama nɛ kɔɔla mangɛ ra ɲɛ ndee bun ma.

sentences.english: And he will come into the kingdom of the king of the south, but he will go back to his land.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxan na kɔɔla ma, na yirefanyi mangɛ gerema nɛ, a fa gbilenma a xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: And his son will make war, and will get together an army of great forces, and he will make an attack on him, overflowing and going past: and he will again take the war even to his strong place.
sentences.susu: «Na mangɛ naxan na kɔɔla ma, na xa die sɔɔri gbegbe malanma nɛ, e xa gere ti a ifure ra alɔ banbaranyi dinma bɔxi ra ki naxɛ. E fama nɛ gere ti ra han e tan nun e yaxuie xa naaninyi ra. Na dangi xanbi, e man gbilenma nɛ e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And the king of the south will be moved with wrath, and will come out and make war on him, on this same king of the north: and he will get together a great army, but the army will be given into his hand.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxan na yirefanyi ma, na fama nɛ xɔnɔde, a mini kɔɔla mangɛ xili ma, sɔɔri gbegbe na naxan yi ra. A na nɔ na sɔɔri gali ra tɛmui naxɛ,

sentences.english: And the army will be taken away, and his heart will be uplifted: he will be the cause of the downfall of tens of thousands, but he will not be strong.
sentences.susu: a e xaninma nɛ konyiya kui. A a yɛtɛ igboma nɛ na xa fe ra. A sɔɔri wulu wulu faxama nɛ, kɔnɔ a mu xunnakeli yo sɔtɔma.»

sentences.english: And again the king of the north will get together an army greater than the first; and he will make an attack on him at the end of years, with a great army and much wealth.
sentences.susu: «Mangɛ naxan na kɔɔla ma, a sɔɔri gbegbe malanma nɛ dangife a naxan singe malan na. Ɲɛ ndee na dangi, a man gere tima nɛ sɔɔri nun naafuli gbegbe ra.

sentences.english: In those times, a number will take up arms against the king of the south: and the children of the violent among your people will be lifting themselves up to make the vision come true; but it will be their downfall.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe fama nɛ kelide yirefanyi mangɛ xili ma. I xa mixi kalabante ndee kelima nɛ alako laamatunyi xa kamali, kɔnɔ a mu sɔɔnɛyama e bɛ.

sentences.english: So the king of the north will come, and put up earthworks and take a well-armed town: and the forces of the king of the south will make an attempt to keep their position, even the best of his army, but they will not have strength to do so.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxan kelima kɔɔla ma, a bɛndɛ malanma nɛ tɛtɛ sɛɛti ma alako a xa nɔ taa makantaxi masɔtɔde. Boore xa sɔɔri fanyie mu nɔma e yɛtɛ makantade, e fama lude e yaxuie nan bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And he who comes against him will do his pleasure, and no one will be able to keep his place before him: he will take up his position in the beautiful land and in his hand there will be destruction.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxan kelima kɔɔla ma, na fama nɛ a waxɔnfe birin nabade a yaxuie ra. A na ti na bɔxi tofanyi ma, a wama naxan yo rabafe, a nɔma nɛ na ra.»

sentences.english: And it will be his purpose to come with the strength of all his kingdom, but in place of this he will make an agreement with him; and he will give him the daughter of women to send destruction on it; but this will not take place or come about.
sentences.susu: «A natɛ tongoma nɛ a xa na bɔxi yamari a sɛnbɛ birin na, a lanyi xiri a nun na mangɛ. A a xa di ginɛ nde soma nɛ a yi ra, alako a xa nɔ na mangɛya sɔtɔde, kɔnɔ na mu sɔɔnɛyama.

sentences.english: After this, his face will be turned to the islands, and he will take a number of them: but a chief, by his destruction, will put an end to the shame offered by him; and more than this, he will make his shame come back on him.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, a katama nɛ bɔxie sɔtɔde naxee na baa dɛ ra. A ndee sɔtɔma nɛ, kɔnɔ sɔɔri mangɛ nde a xa yɛtɛ igboɲa kanama nɛ, a a rayaagi.

sentences.english: Then his face will be turned to the strong places of his land: but his way will be stopped, causing his downfall, and he will not be seen again.
sentences.susu: Na nan a niyama, a gbilen a xɔnyi, a xa taa makantaxie na dɛnnaxɛ. Na kui a sɛnbɛ kanama nɛ, a bira, a mu kelima sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: Then his place will be taken by one who will send out a man with the glory of a king to get wealth together; but after a short time destruction will overtake him, but not in wrath or in the fight.
sentences.susu: «Mangɛ naxan tima na xanbi ra, na duuti maxili ɲaaxi nde xɛɛma nɛ bɔxi yire nde ma, dɛnnaxɛ tofan a birin bɛ. A mu buma, na mangɛ fan birama nɛ, kɔnɔ a xa birɛ mu fatanma gere xa ra, xa na mu a ra xɔnnanteya.»

sentences.english: And his place will be taken by a low person, to whom the honour of the kingdom had not been given: but he will come in time of peace and will get the kingdom by fair words.
sentences.susu: «Mixi ɲaaxi nde tima nɛ a ɲɔxɔɛ ra, naxan mu fatanxi mangɛ xabilɛ ra. A soma nɛ bɔxi ra bɔɲɛsa tɛmui, a mangɛya masɔtɔ yanfanteya ra.

sentences.english: And his forces will be completely taken away from before him and broken; and even the ruler of the agreement will have the same fate.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri gali katama nɛ nɔde a ra, kɔnɔ a e birin faxama nɛ, e tan nun mangɛ saatɛ na e nun naxan tagi.

sentences.english: And from the time when they make an agreement with him, he will be working falsely: for he will take up arms suddenly with a small force,
sentences.susu: A tan nun naxee yo saata, a fama nɛ nee yanfade. Na kui, hali a xa gali mu gbo, a sɛnbɛ sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: Against fertile places, and will make waste a part of the country; and he will do what his fathers have not done, or his fathers' fathers; he will make distribution among them of goods taken in war and by force, and of property: he will even make designs against the strong places for a time.
sentences.susu: A man soma nɛ bɔxi fanyie kui, a naafuli birin ba bannae yi ra, a a so a xa mixie yi ra. A fe rabama nɛ a babae nun a benbae singe mu nu naxan naba. A na birin nabama yanfanteya nan na waxati nde bun ma.»

sentences.english: And he will put in motion his power and his strength against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south will go to war with a very great and strong army: but he will be forced to give way, because of their designs against him;
sentences.susu: «A sɔɔri gali belebele rakelima nɛ, e xa a sɛnbɛ masen yirefanyi mangɛ bɛ. Sɔɔri gali belebele luma nɛ na mangɛ fan yi ra, kɔnɔ e mu tima kɔɔla mangɛ ya ra yanfanteya saabui ra.

sentences.english: And his fears will overcome him and be the cause of his downfall, and his army will come to complete destruction, and a great number will be put to the sword.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxan kelima yire fanyi ma, a xa mixie nan yati fama a yanfade. A yaxuie geenima nɛ, e a xa sɔɔri gbegbe faxa.

sentences.english: And as for these two kings, their hearts will be fixed on doing evil and they will say false words at one table; but it will come to nothing: for the end will be at the time fixed.
sentences.susu: Na mangɛ firinyi fama nɛ lude yire keren, e xa e boore tɔɔrɔ. E wule falama nɛ e boore bɛ, kɔnɔ e bore faxafe mu sɔɔnɛyama han waxati sugandixi xa a li.

sentences.english: And he will go back to his land with great wealth; and his heart will be against the holy agreement; and he will do his pleasure and go back to his land.
sentences.susu: Kɔɔla mangɛ gbilenma nɛ a xɔnyi a nun naafuli belebele ra. A kelima nɛ saatɛ sɛniyɛnxi xili ma, a fa gbilen.»

sentences.english: At the time fixed he will come back and come into the south; but in the later time it will not be as it was before.
sentences.susu: «Waxati na kamali, a man sigama nɛ yirefanyi ma gere sode. Kɔnɔ yi biyaasi mu luma alɔ a singe.

sentences.english: For those who go out from the west will come against him, and he will be in fear and will go back, full of wrath against the holy agreement; and he will do his pleasure: and he will go back and be united with those who have given up the holy agreement.
sentences.susu: Mixie fama nɛ kunkuie kui a gerede kelife sogegorode. E na nɔ a ra, a man gbilen a xɔnyi. A xa xɔnɛ kui, a fe ɲaaxi rabama nɛ mixie ra naxee na saatɛ sɛniyɛnxi kui, kɔnɔ naxee na saatɛ sɛniyɛnxi rabɛɲin, a fe fanyi rabama nɛ nee tan bɛ.»

sentences.english: And armies sent by him will take up their position and they will make unclean the holy place, even the strong place, and take away the regular burned offering and put in its place an unclean thing causing fear.
sentences.susu: «A sɔɔrie yamarima nɛ, e xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kana. Na kui sɛrɛxɛ mu bama lɔxɔɛ birin alɔ a nu darixi raba ra ki naxɛ. Yaxuie fama nɛ fe haramuxi rabade mɛnni.

sentences.english: And those who do evil against the agreement will be turned to sin by his fair words: but the people who have knowledge of their God will be strong and do well.
sentences.susu: A saatɛ kanɛe sɔtɔma nɛ wule matɔxɔɛ ra, kɔnɔ naxee tan e Marigi Ala kolon, nee tondima nɛ.

sentences.english: And those who are wise among the people will be the teachers of the mass of the people: but they will come to their downfall by the sword and by the flame, being made prisoners and undergoing loss for a long time.
sentences.susu: Lɔnnilae ɲama xaranma nɛ, kɔnɔ e yaxuie fa e faxade santidɛgɛma nun tɛ ra, xa na mu a ra e e xanin konyiya kui, e e xa se birin ba e yi ra.

sentences.english: Now at the time of their downfall they will have a little help, but numbers will be joined to them in the town, and in their separate heritages.
sentences.susu: Ndee fama nɛ lɔnnilae malide, kɔnɔ a gbegbe e yanfama nɛ.

sentences.english: And some of those who are wise will have wisdom in testing themselves and making themselves clean, till the time of the end: for it is still for the fixed time.
sentences.susu: Lɔnnila ndee birama nɛ, alako e xa sɛniyɛn tɔɔrɛ saabui ra beenun waxati xa kamali.»

sentences.english: And the king will do his pleasure; he will put himself on high, lifting himself over every god, and saying things to be wondered at against the God of gods; and all will be well for him till the wrath is complete; for what has been purposed will be done.
sentences.susu: «Na mangɛ fama nɛ a waxɔnfe rabade. A a yɛtɛ itema nɛ, a a yɛtɛ igbo dangife alae birin na, a wɔyɛnyi magaaxuxi fala Ala xili ma, naxan gbo alae birin bɛ. A na fe mɔɔli birin nabama nɛ han Ala xa xɔnɛ xa waxati xa kamali.

sentences.english: He will have no respect for the gods of his fathers or for the god desired by women; he will have no respect for any god: for he will put himself on high over all.
sentences.susu: A mu ala yo binyama, hali a babae gbee nun a xa ginɛe gbee. A mu ala yo binyama barima a a yɛtɛ igboma nɛ dangife e birin na.

sentences.english: But in place of this he will give honour to the god of armed places, and to a god of whom his fathers had no knowledge he will give honour with gold and silver and jewels and things to be desired.
sentences.susu: A xa taa makantaxie findima nɛ a xa alae ra, a fa e batu xɛɛma, gbeti, gɛmɛ tofanyie, nun naafuli mɔɔli birin na. A babae mu nu darixi na fe mɔɔli ra.

sentences.english: And he will make use of the people of a strange god to keep his strongest places; to those whom he takes note of he will give high honour: and he will make them rulers over the mass of the people, and will make division of the land for a price.
sentences.susu: A gere tima bɔnsɔɛ nde xa ala nan xa mali ra. A mixi binyama nɛ naxan a yɛtɛ magoroma a bɛ, a a niya mixi gbegbe xa lu e fan bun ma. A bɔxie itaxunma nɛ mixie ma naxee kɔbiri soma a yi ra.»

sentences.english: And at the time of the end, the king of the south will make an attack on him: and the king of the north will come against him like a storm-wind, with war-carriages and horsemen and numbers of ships; and he will go through many lands like overflowing waters.
sentences.susu: «Waxati dɔnxɔɛ na a li, yirefanyi mangɛ kelima nɛ kɔɔla mangɛ xili ma. Mangɛ fama nɛ kelide kɔɔla ma, a din boore ra alɔ banbaranyi dinma bɔxi ra ki naxɛ. Sɔɔri ragisee, soe ragie, nun kunkui gbegbe na a yi ra.

sentences.english: And he will come into the beautiful land, and tens of thousands will be overcome: but these will be kept from falling into his hands: Edom and Moab and the chief of the children of Ammon.
sentences.susu: A fama nɛ bɔxi ma dɛnnaxɛ tofan dangi bɔxi birin na, mixi wuyaxi halaki, kɔnɔ Edon, Mowaba, nun Amoni kuntigie e yɛtɛ sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: And his hand will be stretched out on the countries: and the land of the south will not be safe from him.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi gbegbe luma nɛ a xa nɔɛ bun ma, hali Misira, a mu nɔma a yɛtɛ sɔtɔde a yi.

sentences.english: But he will have power over the stores of gold and silver, and over all the valued things of the south: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians will be at his steps.
sentences.susu: A Misira xɛɛma, gbeti, nun naafuli birin tongoma nɛ. Libiyakae nun Etiyopikae fan birama nɛ a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: But he will be troubled by news from the east and from the north; and he will go out in great wrath, to send destruction on, and put an end to, great numbers.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xibaaru naxan kelima sogetede nun kɔɔla biri ra, na fama nɛ a magaaxude han a siga a bɔɲɛ texi ra, a xa ɲama wuyaxi halaki.

sentences.english: He will put the tents of his great house between the sea and the beautiful holy mountain: but he will come to his end with no helper.
sentences.susu: A a xa mangɛ leele tima baae nan longori ra, geya sɛniyɛnxi mabiri naxan tofan geya birin bɛ. Faxɛ a tɛrɛnnama mɛnni nɛ, mixi yo mu fa a malide.»

sentences.english: And at that time Michael will take up his place, the great angel, who is the supporter of the children of your people: and there will be a time of trouble, such as there never was from the time there was a nation even till that same time: and at that time your people will be kept safe, everyone who is recorded in the book.
sentences.susu: «Na waxati, malekɛ mangɛ Mikayeli kelima nɛ, malekɛ naxan i xa ɲama makantama. Na findima waxati xɔrɔxɔɛ nan na, naxan maniyɛ singe mu nu to, kabi ɲamanɛe fɔlɛ han yakɔsi. Na waxati, naxee xilie sɛbɛxi buki kui, e kisi sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: And a number of those who are sleeping in the dust of the earth will come out of their sleep, some to eternal life and some to eternal shame.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe naxee faxaxi e na gaburi kui, e kelima nɛ. Ndee sigama nɛ ariyanna, ndee siga yahannama yaagi kui.

sentences.english: And those who are wise will be shining like the light of the outstretched sky; and those by whom numbers have been turned to righteousness will be like the stars for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: Lɔnnilae yanbama nɛ alɔ koore xɔri, karamɔxɔ tinxinxi naxee ɲama rafama tinxinyi ma, nee yanbama nɛ alɔ tunbuie, naxee mu xubenma abadan.»

sentences.english: But as for you, O Daniel, let the words be kept secret and the book rolled up and kept shut till the time of the end: numbers will be going out of the way and troubles will be increased.
sentences.susu: «Daniyɛli, i xa yi masenyi findi gundo ra. Yi buki ragali han waxati raɲɔnyi. Na tɛmui mixi gbegbe a xaranma nɛ, e xa fahaamui xun masa.»

sentences.english: Then I, Daniel, looking, saw two others, one at the edge of the river on this side and one at the edge of the river on that side.
sentences.susu: N tan Daniyɛli, n naxa xɛmɛ gbɛtɛ firin to xiye kui. Keren tixi xure dɛ ra be biri, boore tixi naakiri ma.

sentences.english: And I said to the man clothed in linen, who was over the waters of the river, How long will it be to the end of these wonders?
sentences.susu: Keren naxa xɛmɛ maxɔrin naxan nu na xure xun ma, dugi fiixɛ ragoroxi naxan ma, «Na fe magaaxuxie ɲɔnma tɛmui mundun?»

sentences.english: Then in my hearing the man clothed in linen, who was over the river, lifting up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, took an oath by him who is living for ever that it would be a time, times, and a half; and when the power of the crusher of the holy people comes to an end, all these things will be ended.
sentences.susu: Dugi fiixɛ kanyi, naxan nu tixi xure xun ma, na naxa a bɛlɛxɛ firinyie ite koore ma, a fa a fala, «N bara n kali Ala xili ra naxan na abadan, yi fe xa bui, waxati saxan nun a tagi nan a ra. A fama kamalide ɲama sɛniyɛnxi sɛnbɛ na ɲɔn tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And the words came to my ears, but the sense of them was not clear to me: then I said, O my lord, what is the sense of these things?
sentences.susu: N na mɛ nɛ, kɔnɔ n mu a fahaamu. N naxa a maxɔrin, «N marigi, yi fe ɲɔnma di?»

sentences.english: And he said, Go on your way, Daniel: for the words are secret and shut up till the time of the end;
sentences.susu: A naxa n yaabi, «Daniyɛli, siga, barima yi masenyi gundo na a ra, a nɔxunxi han waxati raɲɔnyi.

sentences.english: Till a number are tested and make themselves clean; and the evil-doers will do evil; for not one of the evil-doers will have knowledge; but all will be made clear to those who are wise.
sentences.susu: Mixi wuyaxi sɛniyɛnma nɛ, e fiixɛ, nɔxɔɛ birin ba e ma. Kɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxie mu sese fahaamuma, e luma nɛ fe ɲaaxi raba ra. Lɔnnilae tan fahaamui sɔtɔma nɛ.»

sentences.english: And from the time when the regular burned offering is taken away, and an unclean thing causing fear is put up, there will be a thousand, two hundred and ninety days.
sentences.susu: «Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ sɛrɛxɛ dan tɛmui ma, han fe raharamuxi dɔnxɔɛ raba tɛmui, xi wulu keren, xi kɛmɛ firin tongo solomanaani nan na e tagi.

sentences.english: A blessing will be on the man who goes on waiting, and comes to the thousand, three hundred and thirty-five days.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ na mixi bɛ naxan a tunnabɛxima han xi wulu keren, xi kɛmɛ saxan, xi tongo saxan a nun suuli xa kamali.

sentences.english: But you, go on your way and take your rest: for you will be in your place at the end of the days.
sentences.susu: I tan Daniyɛli, i xa i tunnabɛxi han a ɲɔnma tɛmui naxɛ. Na tɛmui i fama nɛ i malabude, i man gbilen keli ra alako i xa i kɛ sɔtɔ saamin ti lɔxɔɛ.»

sentences.english: The word of the Lord which came to Hosea, the son of Beeri, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam, the son of Joash, king of Israel.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa masenyi ti Beeri xa di Hose bɛ, Yusiya, Yotami, Axasi, nun Xesekiya mangɛ xa waxatie kui Yudaya. Yerobowami nan nu na Isirayila mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: The start of the word of the Lord by Hosea: And the Lord said to Hosea, Go, take for yourself a wife of loose ways, and children of the same, for the land has been untrue to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya Annabi Hose bɛ: Alatala naxa a fala Annabi Hose bɛ, «Siga, i sa langoe ginɛ nde tongo, a man xa die bari i bɛ, barima bekae langoeɲa nan nabama Alatala rabɛɲinfe kui!»

sentences.english: So he took as his wife Gomer, the daughter of Diblaim, and she gave birth to a son.
sentences.susu: Hose naxa siga, a sa Gomeri tongo, Dibilayimi xa di ginɛ. Na naxa tɛɛgɛ, a di bari a bɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to him, Give him the name of Jezreel, for after a little time I will send punishment for the blood of Jezreel on the line of Jehu, and put an end to the kingdom of Israel.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Hose bɛ, «I xa a xili sa Yisireeli, a gbe mu luxi n xa Yehu xa denbaya ɲaxankata, barima e faxɛ ti nɛ Yisireeli. N Isirayila xa mangɛya ɲɔnma na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: And in that day I will let the bow of Israel be broken in the valley of Jezreel.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ n Isirayila xa geresoe sɛnbɛ kanama nɛ Yisireeli taa kui.»

sentences.english: And after that she gave birth to a daughter. And the Lord said, Give her the name Lo-ruhamah; for I will not again have mercy on Israel, to give them forgiveness.
sentences.susu: Gomeri man naxa tɛɛgɛ, a di ginɛ bari. Alatala naxa a masen Hose bɛ, «A xili sa ‹Mixi xɔnxi,› barima n mu kinikinima Isirayila ma, n mu a xa yunubi xafarima sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: But I will have mercy on Judah and will give them salvation by the Lord their God, but not by the bow or the sword or by fighting or by horses or horsemen.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n kinikinima nɛ Yudaya tan ma, n fa a rakisi a Marigi Alatala sɛnbɛ ra. N mu e rakisima tanbɛ ra, xa na mu a ra santidɛgɛma ra, gere ra, soee ra, nun soe ragie ra.»

sentences.english: Now when Lo-ruhamah had been taken from the breast, the woman gave birth to a son.
sentences.susu: Gomeri to «Mixi xɔnxi» dɛ ba, a man naxa tɛɛgɛ, a di bari a xa mɔri Hose bɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said, Give him the name Lo-ammi; for you are not my people, and I will not be your God.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «I xa a xili sa ‹N gbe mu a ra,› barima n ma ɲama mu wo ra sɔnɔn, wo Marigi mu n na sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: Say to your brothers, Ammi; and to your sisters, Ruhamah.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae fama nɛ wuyade alɔ baa dɛ ra mɛyɛnyi, naxan mu nɔma maniyade, naxan mu nɔma kɔntide. Singe ra, a nu a falama e bɛ dɛnnaxɛ, «N ma ɲama mu wo ra,» a a falama nɛ e bɛ, «Ala Ɲiɲɛ xa die.»

sentences.english: Take up the cause against your mother, take it up, for she is not my wife, and I am not her husband; let her put away her loose ways from her face, and her false ways from between her breasts;
sentences.susu: Yuda bɔnsɔɛe nun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe malanma nɛ, e mangɛ keren sugandi e birin bɛ. Na lɔxɔɛ xungbe Ala e raminima nɛ konyiya kui, a e rasabati e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: For fear that I may take away her robe from her, making her uncovered as in the day of her birth; making her like a waste place and a dry land, causing her death through need of water.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa a fala wo taarae xa fe ra, ‹Ala xa ɲama.› Wo xa a fala wo xunyae xa fe ra, ‹Ala xanuntenyie.›

sentences.english: And I will have no mercy on her children, for they are the children of her loose ways.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo nga Isirayila kalamu, barima n ma ginɛ mu a ra, a xa mɔri mu n fan na! A xa a xa langoeɲa maxiri see ba a yatagi ma, a a xa ɲɛngɛya maxiri see ba a xiɲɛe tagi.

sentences.english: For their mother has been untrue; she who gave them birth has done things of shame, for she said, I will go after my lovers, who give me my bread and my water, my wool and my linen, my oil and my wine.
sentences.susu: Xa na mu a ra, n Isirayila luma a rageli nan na, alɔ a nu ki naxɛ a bari lɔxɔɛ. N e xa bɔxi mafindima nɛ gbengberenyi ra,

sentences.english: For this cause I will put thorns in her road, building up a wall round her so that she may not go on her way.
sentences.susu: a findima yire maxare nan na. N e faxama ye xɔli nan na. N mu kinikinima a xa die ma, barima langoe di nan e ra.

sentences.english: And if she goes after her lovers she will not overtake them; if she makes search for them she will not see them; then will she say, I will go back to my first husband, for then it was better for me than now.
sentences.susu: E nga e sɔtɔ langoeɲa nan kui. Na bara findi yaagi ra e bɛ. A naxa a fala, ‹N birama nɛ n ɲɛngɛe fɔxɔ ra, naxee donse nun ye soma n yi, naxee dugi fima n ma, naxee n kima ture nun minse ra.›

sentences.english: For she had no knowledge that it was I who gave her the grain and the wine and the oil, increasing her silver and gold which they gave to the Baal.
sentences.susu: N i xa kira findima tunbe kunsi ra na nan ma, n i rabilin tɛtɛ ra, alako i naxa kira to.

sentences.english: So I will take away again my grain in its time and my wine, and I will take away my wool and my linen with which her body might have been covered.
sentences.susu: A sigama a ɲɛngɛe fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ a mu e masɔtɔma. A e fenma, kɔnɔ a mu e toma. A a falama nɛ, ‹N xa gbilen n ma mɔri xɔn, barima ɲɛlɛxinyi nu na n bɛ mɛnni dangi yakɔsi ra.›

sentences.english: And now I will make her shame clear before the eyes of her lovers, and no one will take her out of my hand.
sentences.susu: A mu a kolon fa fala n tan nan nu baloe soma a yi, mɛngi, ture, nun minse. N tan nan nu gbeti nun xɛɛma fan soma a yi, kɔnɔ a naxa na birin nawali Bali kuye bɛ.

sentences.english: And I will put an end to all her joy, her feasts, her new moons, and her Sabbaths, and all her regular meetings.
sentences.susu: Na nan a to n ma mɛngi na mɔ, n a bama a yi. Wɛni bogi bundu tɛmui, n na fan bama a yi. Xuruse xabe xaba tɛmui, n mu tinma e xa se sɔtɔ, naxan nɔma findide e xa dugie ra.

sentences.english: And I will make waste her vines and her fig-trees, of which she has said, These are the payments which my lovers have made to me; and I will make them a waste of trees, and the beasts of the field will take them for food.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n xa a rayaagi a ɲɛngɛe ya xɔri, alako mixi yo naxa a ba n yi ra.

sentences.english: And I will give her punishment for the days of the Baals, to whom she has been burning perfumes, when she made herself fair with her nose-rings and her jewels, and went after her lovers, giving no thought to me, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N ɲɛlɛxinyi birin bama nɛ e yi, alɔ e xa malabui lɔxɔɛ sali, e xa kike nɛɛnɛ sali, a nun e xa sali birin.

sentences.english: For this cause I will make her come into the waste land and will say words of comfort to her.
sentences.susu: N xa e xa wɛni bilie, nun e xa xɔrɛ bilie kana. E naxɛ a na findixi e xa langoeɲa sare nan na. N na sansi birin kanama nɛ, a xa findi wula ra subee sabatima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And I will give her vine-gardens from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will give her answer there as in the days when she was young, and as in the time when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
sentences.susu: N Isirayila ɲaxankatama nɛ, barima a sɛrɛxɛ bama Bali kuye bɛ, a lu alɔ langoe naxan a yɛtɛ maxirima dugi fanyi ra, a bira a ɲɛngɛ fɔxɔ ra. Na kui a naxa nɛɛmu n tan ma.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And in that day, says the Lord, you will say to me, Ishi; and you will never again give me the name of Baali;
sentences.susu: «N a xaninma gbengberenyi ma na nan ma, n fa wɔyɛnyi ɲɔxunmɛ fala a bɛ.

sentences.english: For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and never again will she say their names.
sentences.susu: A na keli mɛnni, n man wuri bogilae fi a ma. Akori gulunba findima nɛ xaxilisa ra a bɛ, a fa sigi sa alɔ a fonike tɛmui alɔ a mini lɔxɔɛ Misira bɔxi ra.»

sentences.english: And in that day I will make an agreement for them with the beasts of the field and the birds of heaven and the things which go low on the earth; I will put an end to the bow and the sword and war in all the land, and will make them take their rest in peace.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Na lɔxɔɛ i n xilima nɛ ‹N ma mɔri.› I mu n xilima ‹N kanyi› sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And I will take you as my bride for ever; truly, I will take you as my bride in righteousness and in right judging, in love and in mercies.
sentences.susu: N Bali kuye xilie bama nɛ i dɛ i, alako i xa nɛɛmu e ma.

sentences.english: I will take you as my bride in good faith, and you will have knowledge of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ n saatɛ tongoma nɛ e bɛ, nun wulai subee, xɔnie, a nun bubusee ra. N xali, santidɛgɛma, nun gere bama nɛ e xa bɔxi ma, alako e xa sabati naa bɔɲɛsa kui.

sentences.english: And it will be, in that day, says the Lord, that I will give an answer to the heavens, and the heavens to the earth;
sentences.susu: N i findima n ma ginɛ nan na tinxinyi, dugutɛgɛɲa, nun hinnɛ kui. N mu mɛɛma i ra abadan.

sentences.english: And the earth will give its answer to the grain and the wine and the oil, and they will give an answer to Jezreel;
sentences.susu: Lanlanteya luma nɛ won tagi, i fa Alatala kolon.»

sentences.english: And I will put her as seed in the earth, and I will have mercy on her to whom no mercy was given; and I will say to those who were not my people, You are my people, and they will say, My God.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya. «Na lɔxɔɛ, n i xa dubɛ suxuma nɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to me, Give your love again to a woman who has a lover and is false to her husband, even as the Lord has love for the children of Israel, though they are turned to other gods and are lovers of grape-cakes.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, «I man xa i xa ginɛ xanu, hali a to yɛnɛ rabama a nun a ɲɛngɛe ra. Na luma nɛ alɔ Alatala xa xanunteya Isirayilakae bɛ, e tan naxee birama ala gbɛtɛe fɔxɔ ra, e nu sɛrɛxɛ ba e bɛ.»

sentences.english: So I got her for myself for fifteen shekels of silver and a homer and a half of barley;
sentences.susu: N naxa gbilen na ginɛ xa kote dɔxɔ ra gbeti kole fu nun suuli ra, nun mɛngi busali keren nun a tagi.

sentences.english: And I said to her, You are to be mine for a long space of time; you are not to be false to me, and no other man is to have you for his wife; and so will I be to you.
