sentences.susu: N naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xa i raxara n xɔnyi. I naxa langoeɲa raba sɔnɔn, i naxa xɛmɛ gbɛtɛ yo kolon fa. N fan luma i bɛ na ki nɛ.»

sentences.english: For the children of Israel will for a long time be without king and without ruler, without offerings and without pillars, and without ephod or images.
sentences.susu: Waxati xɔnnakuye kui, Isirayila fama nɛ lude mangɛ mu na, yareratie, sɛrɛxɛe, kuyee, nun Ala maxɔrin se xanbi.

sentences.english: And after that, the children of Israel will come back and go in search of the Lord their God and David their king; and they will come in fear to the Lord and to his mercies in the days to come.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Isirayilakae gbilenma nɛ, e fa e Marigi Alatala fen, a nun e xa mangɛ Dawuda. Na tɛmui, e fama nɛ gaaxude Alatala ya ra, e man lu a xa hinnɛ bun ma tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Give ear to the word of the Lord, O children of Israel; for the Lord has a cause against the people of this land, because there is no good faith in it, and no mercy and no knowledge of God in the land.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae, wo Alatala xa wɔyɛnyi ramɛ, barima kiiti na wo nun Alatala tagi. «Nɔndi nun hinnɛ bara ɲɔn wo ya ma. Wo mu n kolonxi Ala ra wo xɔnyi sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: There is cursing and broken faith, violent death and attacks on property, men are untrue in married life, houses are broken into, and there is blood touching blood.
sentences.susu: Dankɛ matife, wule, faxɛ ti, muɲɛ, langoeɲa nan gbansan gboxi wo yi ra. Faxɛ tima tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Because of this the land will be dry, and everyone living in it will be wasted away, with the beasts of the field and the birds of heaven; even the fishes of the sea will be taken away.
sentences.susu: Wo xa bɔxi fama lude sunnunyi kui na nan ma. Naxee birin sabatixi a ma, e faxama nɛ e nun subee, xɔnie, nun yɛxɛe ra. E birin faxama nɛ.»

sentences.english: Let no man go to law or make protests, for your people are like those who go to law with a priest.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ mixi yo naxa kalamui ti, mixi yo naxa ɲama rakiiti. Wo xa ɲama nan wo tan sɛrɛxɛdubɛe kalamuma.

sentences.english: You will not be able to keep on your feet by day, and by night the prophet will be falling down with you, and I will give your mother to destruction.
sentences.susu: Wo birama nɛ yanyi ra, wo bira kɔɛ ra. Hali namiɲɔnmɛe, e tantanma. N fama wo nga Isirayila faxade na nan ma.

sentences.english: Destruction has overtaken my people because they have no knowledge; because you have given up knowledge, I will give you up, so that you will be no priest to me, because you have not kept in mind the law of your God, I will not keep your children in my memory.
sentences.susu: N ma ɲama na faxafe, a kolontareya ma. Wo to bara wo makuya n kolonfe ra, n fan bara wo makuya n ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛɲa ra. Wo to bara wo Marigi Ala xa sɛriyɛ rabɛɲin, n fan bara wo xa die rabɛɲin.

sentences.english: Even while they were increasing in number they were sinning against me; I will let their glory be changed into shame.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe wuyaxi ki naxɛ, e xa yunubie fan wuyaxi na ki nɛ. N e xa binyɛ masarama yaagi ra na nan ma.

sentences.english: The sin of my people is like food to them; and their desire is for their wrongdoing.
sentences.susu: E baloma n ma ɲama xa sɛrɛxɛe ra. Na kui, e man nee radin yɛ yunubi rabafe ma e tan yɛtɛ naxan nabama, alako e man xa sɛrɛxɛ gbɛtɛe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the priest will be like the people; I will give them punishment for their evil ways, and the reward of their acts.
sentences.susu: Ɲama yo, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe yo, n e birin ɲaxankatama nɛ e xa yunubie xa fe ra, n e sare ragbilenma nɛ e ma.»

sentences.english: They will have food, but they will not be full; they will be false to me, but they will not be increased, because they no longer give thought to the Lord.
sentences.susu: «E e dɛgema nɛ, kɔnɔ e mu fama lugade. E kuyee batuma nɛ, kɔnɔ nee mu e rageenima, barima e bara Alatala rabɛɲin.

sentences.english: Loose ways and new wine take away wisdom.
sentences.susu: E langoeɲa rabama, e beere mɔɔli birin minma. Na nan e xaxili kanaxi.

sentences.english: My people get knowledge from their tree, and their rod gives them news; for a false spirit is the cause of their wandering, and they have been false to their God.
sentences.susu: N ma ɲama maxɔrinyi tima kuye ma. E yaabi nde sɔtɔma na wuri xuntunyi ra. Langoeɲa rabafe bara lu e bɔɲɛ kui. Na bara e ralɔɛ, na bara e makuya Ala ra.

sentences.english: They make offerings on the tops of mountains, burning perfumes in high places, under trees of every sort, because their shade is good: and so your daughters are given up to loose ways and your brides are false to their husbands.
sentences.susu: E sɛrɛxɛ bama geyae fari, mɛnni e surayi fan ganma sɛrɛxɛ ra. E na rabama wuri xungbee bun ma, niini gbo dɛnnaxɛ. Na kui wo xa di ginɛe langoeɲa rabama, wo xa mamadie fan bara findi yɛnɛ rabae ra.»

sentences.english: I will not give punishment to your daughters or your brides for their evil behaviour; for they make themselves separate with loose women, and make offerings with those who are used for sex purposes in the worship of the gods: the people who have no wisdom will be sent away.
sentences.susu: «N mu fama wo xa di ginɛe nun wo xa mamadie ɲaxankatade e xa langoeɲa xa fe ra, barima wo tan fan ɲɛngɛe suxuma. Wo birin sɛrɛxɛ bama kuyee bɛ. Ɲama xaxilitare luma na gantanyi kui.

sentences.english: Do not you, O Israel, come into error; do not you, O Judah, come to Gilgal, or go up to Beth-aven, or take an oath, By the living Lord.
sentences.susu: Xa Isirayila bara bira langoeɲa fɔxɔ ra, wo tan Yudayakae, wo naxa na mɔɔli raba. Wo naxa siga Giligali, wo naxa te Beti Aweni. Wo naxa wo kali Alatala xili ra mɛnni.

sentences.english: For Israel is uncontrolled, like a cow which may not be controlled; now will the Lord give them food like a lamb in a wide place.
sentences.susu: Xa Isirayila luma alɔ ninge kalabante, Alatala mu nɔma e rabalode alɔ yɛxɛɛ fanyie, e naxee dɛ madonma fiili xungbee ma.

sentences.english: Ephraim is joined to false gods; let him be.
sentences.susu: Efiramikae bara kankan kuye ma. Wo xa e lu na.

sentences.english: Their drink has become bitter; they are completely false; her rulers take pleasure in shame.
sentences.susu: E xa beere na ɲɔn, e xa langoeɲa fan tongo. E xa mangɛe waxi yaagi nan tun xɔn ma.

sentences.english: They are folded in the skirts of the wind; they will be shamed because of their offerings.
sentences.susu: Foye fama e ra fanafanande na nan ma. E fama nɛ yaagide e xa sɛrɛxɛe xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: Give ear to this, O priests; give attention, O Israel, and you, family of the king; for you are to be judged; you have been a deceit at Mizpah and a net stretched out on Tabor.
sentences.susu: «Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, wo yi ramɛ. Isirayilakae, wo a mato. Mangɛ xa denbaya, wo wo tuli mati. Kiiti na won tagi, barima wo bara findi gantanyi ra Misipa, wo bara findi yɛlɛ ra Taboro geya fari.

sentences.english: They have gone deep in the evil ways of Shittim, but I am the judge of all.
sentences.susu: Wo na mixi nan tun mafaxafe yi ki, n xa n yaxaseri masa wo bɛ.»

sentences.english: I have knowledge of Ephraim, and Israel is not secret from me; for now, O Ephraim, you have been false to me, Israel has become unclean.
sentences.susu: «N Efirami kolon, Isirayila mu nɔxunxi n ma. Efirami na langoeɲa rabafe, Isirayila fan bara so sɛniyɛntareɲa kui.

sentences.english: Their works will not let them come back to their God, for a false spirit is in them and they have no knowledge of the Lord.
sentences.susu: E xa fe kobie bara e makuya e Marigi Ala ra. Langoeɲa xaxili bara lu e ya ma. E mu Alatala kolon.

sentences.english: And the pride of Israel gives an answer to his face; and Ephraim will have a fall through his sins, and the fall of Judah will be the same as theirs.
sentences.susu: Isirayila xa yɛtɛ igboya nan a niyama e xa bira, e nun Efirami. Yudaya fan birama nɛ e xa yunubi saabui ra.

sentences.english: They will go, with their flocks and their herds, in search of the Lord, but they will not see him; he has taken himself out of their view.
sentences.susu: E xurusee xaninma sɛrɛxɛ ra, e xa Alatala fen, kɔnɔ e mu a toma barima a makuya e ra.

sentences.english: They have been false to the Lord; they have given birth to strange children; now the new moon will make them waste with their fields.
sentences.susu: E bara Alatala yanfa, e ɲɛngɛ die bari. Beenun kike keren, e xa bɔxi fama nɛ kanade, e fa halaki.»

sentences.english: Let the horn be sounded in Gibeah and in Ramah; give a loud cry in Beth-aven, They are after you, O Benjamin.
sentences.susu: «Wo sara fe Gibiya. Wo xa a fe Rama. Wo gere sɔnxɔɛ ite Beti Aweni. Bunyaminkae, yaxuie na wo xanbi ra.

sentences.english: Ephraim will become a waste in the day of punishment; I have given knowledge among the tribes of Israel of what is certain.
sentences.susu: Efirami ɲaxankatama nɛ na lɔxɔɛ. Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ, n xa nɔndi masen wo bɛ.»

sentences.english: The rulers of Judah are like those who take away a landmark; I will let loose my wrath on them like flowing water.
sentences.susu: «Yudaya kuntigie fama nɛ n ma xɔnɛ kolonde, barima e ifu bɔxi naaninyie ma.

sentences.english: Ephraim is troubled; he is crushed by his judges, because he took pleasure in walking after deceit.
sentences.susu: Efiramikae fan fama nɛ ɲaxankatade, barima e biraxi e yɛtɛ waxɔnfe nan fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And so to Ephraim I am like a wasting insect, and a destruction to the children of Judah.
sentences.susu: N findima suuri nan na Efirami bɔnsɔɛ bɛ, N lu Yuda bɔnsɔɛ bɛ alɔ fi ɲaaxi.

sentences.english: When Ephraim saw his disease and Judah his wound, then Ephraim went to Assyria and sent to the great king; but he is not able to make you well or give you help for your wound.
sentences.susu: Efirami nun Yudaya a kolon e furaxi. Efirami sigama Asiriya, a xɛɛrae xɛɛma naa mangɛ xungbe xɔn ma, kɔnɔ a mu nɔma wo rayalande, a mu nɔma wo xa fie baride.

sentences.english: For I will be to Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the children of Judah; I, even I, will give him wounds and go away; I will take him away, and there will be no helper.
sentences.susu: N luma nɛ alɔ yɛtɛ Efirami bɛ, alɔ yɛtɛ yɔrɛ Yudaya bɛ. N nee ibɔɔma nɛ, n siga e ra, mixi yo mu e bama n yi.

sentences.english: I will go back to my place till they are made waste; in their trouble they will go after me early and will make search for me.
sentences.susu: N xa gbilen n xɔnyi, han e xa e xa yunubi kolon, e fa n fen. E fama nɛ n fende e xa tɔɔrɛ kui.»

sentences.english: Come, let us go back to the Lord; for he has given us wounds and he will make us well; he has given blows and he will give help.
sentences.susu: Wo fa be, won xa gbilen Alatala ma! A bara won tɔɔrɔ, kɔnɔ yakɔsi a won nayalanma nɛ. A bara won bɔnbɔ, kɔnɔ yakɔsi a won ma fie maxirima nɛ.

sentences.english: After two days he will give us life, and on the third day he will make us get up, and we will be living before him.
sentences.susu: Xi firin na dangi, a fama nɛ won nayalande, a xi saxan nde a won nakeli, won fa lu a sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And let us have knowledge, let us go after the knowledge of the Lord; his going out is certain as the dawn, his decisions go out like the light; he will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain watering the earth.
sentences.susu: Won xa Alatala fen, won xa a kolon. Ala fafe mu kanama. Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ kuye ibama, ɲɛmɛ birin tunɛ fama. Ala fan mu tondima fade won yire.

sentences.english: O Ephraim, what am I to do to you? O Judah, what am I to do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the dew which goes early away.
sentences.susu: «N munse rabama i tan na, Efirami? N munse rabama i ra, Yudaya? I xa hinnɛ n mabiri, luxi nɛ alɔ xini naxan goroma gɛɛsɛgɛ, kɔnɔ beenun soge xa xɔnɔ, a ɲɔn.

sentences.english: So I have had it cut in stones; I gave them teaching by the words of my mouth;
sentences.susu: N wo gerema namiɲɔnmɛe xa masenyie ra na nan ma, n wo faxama nɛ n ma masenyie ra. N ma kiitie fiixɛ alɔ naiyalanyi.

sentences.english: Because my desire is for mercy and not offerings; for the knowledge of God more than for burned offerings.
sentences.susu: Hinnɛ rafan n ma dangife sɛrɛxɛ ra, Ala kolonfe dangi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie ra.

sentences.english: But like a man, they have gone against the agreement; there they were false to me.
sentences.susu: E bara n ma saatɛ kana, alɔ adamadie darixi a ra ki naxɛ. E bara n yanfa.

sentences.english: Gilead is a town of evil-doers, marked with blood.
sentences.susu: Mixi ɲaaxi wuya Galadi, faxɛtie bara gbo naa.

sentences.english: And like a band of thieves waiting for a man, so are the priests watching secretly the way of those going quickly to Shechem, for they are working with an evil design.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe baganma mixi ma Sikemi kira xɔn ma alɔ muɲɛtie. Na faxɛ tife, fe ɲaaxi na a ra.

sentences.english: In Israel I have seen a very evil thing; there false ways are seen in Ephraim, Israel is unclean;
sentences.susu: N bara fe ɲaaxie to Isirayilakae tagi: Efirami bara langoeɲa raba, Isirayila bara nɔxɔ.

sentences.english: And Judah has put up disgusting images for himself.
sentences.susu: Yudaya, n na gɛ n ma ɲama ragbilende konyiya kui, n wo fan ɲaxankatama nɛ.»

sentences.english: When my desire was for the fate of my people to be changed and to make Israel well, then the sin of Ephraim was made clear, and the evil-doing of Samaria; for their ways are false, and the thief comes into the house, while the band of outlaws takes property by force in the streets.
sentences.susu: «N to wa Isirayila rayalanfe, Efirami xa yunubi man naxa makɛnɛn. Samari xa fe ɲaaxi naxa mini kɛnɛ ma. Na yanfantee muɲɛ tima, e yensen yɛ yire birin.

sentences.english: And they do not say to themselves that I keep in mind all their sin; now their evil acts come round them on every side; they are before my face.
sentences.susu: E e maɲɔxun n mu ratuxi e xa kobiɲa ma, kɔnɔ n e xa wali birin toma nɛ.

sentences.english: In their sin they make a king for themselves, and rulers in their deceit.
sentences.susu: Yi mixi kobie rafan mangɛ ma, kuntigie tinma e xa wali ra.

sentences.english: They are all untrue; they are like a burning oven; the bread-maker does not make up the fire from the time when the paste is mixed till it is leavened.
sentences.susu: E xa langoeɲa gbo alɔ tɛ xungbe, taami ganyi naxan nadɛxɛma, a fa wolen han a gɛ farin nafalade.

sentences.english: On the day of our king, the rulers made him ill with the heat of wine; his hand was stretched out with the men of pride.
sentences.susu: Kuntigie siisima nɛ mangɛ xa xulunyi, mangɛ fan tinxi na fe mɔɔli ra.

sentences.english: For they have made their hearts ready like an oven, while they are waiting secretly; their wrath is sleeping all night; in the morning it is burning like a flaming fire.
sentences.susu: E bɔɲɛ bara te alɔ tɛ xungbe, e e maso mangɛ ra, e xa a yanfa. E na fe birin xirima kɔɛ nan na alako gɛɛsɛgɛ e xa wali ɲaaxi xa kamali.

sentences.english: They are all heated like an oven, and they put an end to their judges; all their kings have been made low; not one among them makes prayer to me.
sentences.susu: E bɔɲɛ naxa te han e kiitisae birin nabira, e e xa mangɛe birin faxa. Na mixi mɔɔli mu n ma kiiti mamɛma fefe ma.

sentences.english: Ephraim is mixed with the peoples; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
sentences.susu: Efirami wama lufe nɛ alɔ si gbɛtɛe, kɔnɔ a luxi nɛ alɔ taami naxan ganxi a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: Men from other lands have made waste his strength, and he is not conscious of it; grey hairs have come on him here and there, and he has no knowledge of it.
sentences.susu: Si gbɛtɛe a sɛnbɛ kanama, kɔnɔ a mu a kolon. A forixi, kɔnɔ a mu na rakɔrɔsi.

sentences.english: And the pride of Israel gives an answer to his face; but for all this, they have not gone back to the Lord their God, or made search for him.
sentences.susu: Isirayila a yɛtɛ igboma, a mu gbilen a Marigi Alatala ma, a mu bira a xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And Ephraim is like a foolish dove, without wisdom; they send out their cry to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
sentences.susu: Efirami luxi nɛ alɔ ganbɛ xaxilitare. A Misirakae xilima, a saatɛ tongoma Asiriyakae bɛ.

sentences.english: When they go, my net will be stretched out over them; I will take them like the birds of heaven, I will give them punishment, I will take them away in the net for their sin.
sentences.susu: E na siga naa, n fama nɛ n ma yɛlɛ wolide e ma, e xa bira alɔ xɔni. N e ɲaxankatama nɛ, alɔ a masenxi e bɛ e xa malanyi kui ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: May trouble be theirs! for they have gone far away from me; and destruction, for they have been sinning against me; I was ready to be their saviour, but they said false words against me.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na e bɛ, barima e bara e gi n xun ma. Gbaloe na e bɛ, barima e bara n matandi. N nu waxi nɛ e xun sarafe, kɔnɔ e wulee sama n xun ma.

sentences.english: And they have not made prayer to me in their hearts, but they make loud cries on their beds; they are cutting themselves for food and wine, they are turned against me.
sentences.susu: E yaye raminima e xa sade ma, kɔnɔ e mu sunnunxi e bɔɲɛ ma. E e malanma alako e xa donse nun wɛni fen, kɔnɔ e e makuyama n tan na.

sentences.english: Though I have given training and strength to their arms, they have evil designs against me.
sentences.susu: N tan nan e xuru, n tan nan sɛnbɛ fi e ma, kɔnɔ e finsiriwaliya rabama n na.

sentences.english: They have gone to what is of no value; they are like a false bow; their captains will come to destruction by the sword, and their ruler by my wrath; for this, the land of Egypt will make sport of them.
sentences.susu: E mu e ya tima koore ra, e yanfɛ tima alɔ yanfɛ yili. Na nan a ra, e kuntigie faxama santidɛgɛma ra, e yaagi Misira bɔxi ma e xa wɔyɛnyi xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: Put the horn to your mouth. He comes like an eagle against the house of the Lord; because they have gone against my agreement, they have not kept my law.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa gere sara fe! Yaxui goroma nɛ Alatala xa banxi ma alɔ sɛgɛ, barima ɲama bara n ma laayidi kana, e naxa muruta n ma sɛriyɛ ma.

sentences.english: They will send up to me a cry for help: We, Israel, have knowledge of you, O God of Israel.
sentences.susu: E n xilima, ‹Muxu Marigi Ala, muxu i kolon, muxu tan, Isirayila.›

sentences.english: Israel has given up what is good; his haters will go after him.
sentences.susu: Isirayila to bara fe fanyi bɛɲin, yaxui birama nɛ a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: They have put up kings, but not by me; they have made princes, but I had no knowledge of it; they have made images of silver and gold, so that they may be cut off.
sentences.susu: E bara mangɛe ti n ma yaamari mu naxan na, e bara kuntigie ti e mu n maxɔrin. E bara kuyee rafala e xa gbeti nun xɛɛma ra. Nee halakima na nan ma.

sentences.english: I will have nothing to do with your young ox, O Samaria; my wrath is burning against them; how long will it be before the children of Israel make themselves clean?
sentences.susu: Samarikae, wo wo xa ninge kuye wɔlɛ. N bara xɔnɔ wo ma a ɲaaxi ra. Wo wo yɛtɛ manɔxɔma yi fe mɔɔli ra han mun tɛmui?

sentences.english: The workman made it, it is no god; the ox of Samaria will be broken into bits.
sentences.susu: Yi kuye fatanxi wo tan Isirayila nan na. Mixi nde nan a rafalaxi, Ala mu a ra! Samari xa ninge kuye fama nɛ butuxunde.

sentences.english: For they have been planting the wind, and their fruit will be the storm; his grain has no stem, it will give no meal, and if it does, a strange nation will take it.
sentences.susu: Naxan ɲɛrɛma fe ɲaaxi kui, gbaloe fama nɛ a lide. Hali mɛngi tɔnsɔɛ keren, e mu a sɔtɔma xɛ ma. Sansi naxan bulama, a mu findima baloe ra. Hali nde findi a ra, si gbɛtɛ nan a donma.

sentences.english: Israel has come to destruction; now they are among the nations like a cup in which there is no pleasure.
sentences.susu: E bara Isirayila xun nakana, e e xanin ɲamanɛ konyiya kui.

sentences.english: For they have gone up to Assyria like an ass going by himself; Ephraim has given money to get lovers.
sentences.susu: Isirayilakae bara siga Asiriya bɔxi ma, alɔ sofale naxan luma a keren.

sentences.english: But though they give money to the nations for help, still I will send them in all directions; and in a short time they will be without a king and rulers.
sentences.susu: Hali e mixi naxee saraxi sie tagi e kantafe ma, n e birin malanma nɛ, alako e xa tɔɔrɔ mangɛe xa kote bun ma.

sentences.english: Because Ephraim has been increasing altars for sin, altars have become a cause of sin to him.
sentences.susu: Efirami bara sɛrɛxɛbadee rawuya alako e xa yunubie xa xafari, kɔnɔ na sɛrɛxɛbadee bara a niya e xa yunubie sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Though I put my law in writing for him in ten thousand rules, they are to him as a strange thing.
sentences.susu: N bara n ma sɛriyɛe birin sɛbɛ, e xa na kolon, kɔnɔ e mu tide toxi a ma.

sentences.english: He gives the offerings of his lovers, and takes the flesh for food; but the Lord has no pleasure in them; now he will keep in mind their evil-doing and give them the punishment of their sins; they will go back to Egypt.
sentences.susu: E sɛrɛxɛe bama n bɛ, e na sube don, kɔnɔ na mu rafan Alatala ma. Yakɔsi, Alatala fama nɛ e ɲaxankatade e xa yunubie xa fe ra, e xa gbilen Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: For Israel has no memory of his Maker, and has put up the houses of kings; and Judah has made great the number of his walled towns. But I will send a fire on his towns and put an end to his great houses.
sentences.susu: Isirayila bara nɛɛmu Ala ma, naxan e daaxi. E na mangɛ banxie tife. Yudaya fan na taae tife, naxee sɛnbɛ gbo, kɔnɔ n na birin ganma nɛ tɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Have no joy, O Israel, and do not be glad like the nations; for you have been untrue to your God; your desire has been for the loose woman's reward on every grain-floor.
sentences.susu: Isirayila, i naxa ɲɛlɛxin, i naxa sɛɛwa alɔ si gbɛtɛe. I to i Marigi Ala bɛɲin, i bara findi langoe ra. Langoe masundi bara rafan i ma, i naxan sɔtɔma lonyi yire.

sentences.english: The grain-floor and the place where the grapes are crushed will not give them food; there will be no new wine for them.
sentences.susu: Wo mu baloe sɔtɔma lonyi yire, wo mu wɛni sɔtɔma wɛni bogi bundu se kui.

sentences.english: They will have no resting-place in the Lord's land, but Ephraim will go back to Egypt, and they will take unclean food in Assyria.
sentences.susu: E mu luma Alatala xa bɔxi ma, Efirami gbilenma nɛ Misira, e fama donse haramuxie donde Asiriya bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: They will give no wine offering to the Lord, they will not make offerings ready for him; their bread will be like the bread of those in sorrow; all who take it will be unclean, because their bread will be only for their desire, it will not come into the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: E mu sɛrɛxɛ ye daaxie bama Alatala bɛ. E xa sɛrɛxɛe mu rafanma a ma, e luma alɔ ɲɔn yire taami. Naxee nee donma e findima sɛniyɛntaree nan na. Na findima donse nan na e bɛ, kɔnɔ a mu findima sɛrɛxɛ ra Alatala bɛ a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: What will you do on the day of worship, and on the day of the feast of the Lord?
sentences.susu: Wo munse rabama sali lɔxɔɛ Alatala ya i?

sentences.english: For see, they are going away into Assyria; Egypt will get them together, Memphis will be their last resting-place; their fair silver vessels will be covered over with field plants, and thorns will come up in their tents.
sentences.susu: Hali e sa e ratanga gbaloe ma, Misirakae fama nɛ e faxade, e e ragata Nofi. E xa harige birin lɔɛma nɛ, e xɔnyi findima nɛ wula ra.

sentences.english: The days of punishment, the days of reward are come; Israel will be put to shame; the prophet is foolish, the man who has the spirit is off his head, because of your great sin.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ lɔxɔɛe na fafe, yunubi sare ragbilenma tɛmui naxɛ. Isirayila xa na kolon. Isirayila xa yunubi gbo, na na a ra e namiɲɔnmɛe xɔnma, e daxui xili sa e xun ma.

sentences.english: There is great hate against the watchman of Ephraim, the people of my God; as for the prophet, there is a net in all his ways, and hate in the house of his God.
sentences.susu: Ala nun namiɲɔnmɛe Efirami kantama, kɔnɔ mixie tan gantanyi tema namiɲɔnmɛe bɛ. E mu rafan mixie ma Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: They have gone deep in evil as in the days of Gibeah; he will keep in mind their wrongdoing, he will give them punishment for their sins.
sentences.susu: Efiramikae bara so yanfanteya kui, alɔ naxan nabaxi Gibiya. Ala mu nɛɛmuxi e xa yunubi ma, a fama e ɲaxankatade na nan ma.

sentences.english: I made discovery of Israel as of grapes in the waste land; I saw your fathers as the first-fruits of the fig-tree in her early fruit time; but they came to Baal-peor, and made themselves holy to the thing of shame, and became disgusting like that to which they gave their love.
sentences.susu: «N to Isirayila to, a nu fan alɔ bogi se naxan toma wula i. Wo benbae nu luxi nɛ alɔ xɔrɛ bogi singee, kɔnɔ e naxa bira kuye xɔnxi fɔxɔ ra naxan nu na Peyori.

sentences.english: As for Ephraim, their glory will go in flight like a bird: there will be no birth and no one with child and no giving of life.
sentences.susu: Efirami xa binyɛ sigama nɛ alɔ xɔni naxan tuganma. Di bari mu na, tɛɛgɛ mu na.

sentences.english: Even though their children have come to growth I will take them away, so that not a man will be there; for their evil-doing will be complete and they will be put to shame because of it.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa a li e naxa die xuru, n e birin bama nɛ e yi. E fe ɲaaxi sɔtɔma nɛ n na e rabolo tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: As I have seen a beast whose young have been taken from her, so Ephraim will give birth to children only for them to be put to death.
sentences.susu: N bara Efirami to a sabatixi yire fanyi, alɔ Tire na ki naxɛ, kɔnɔ Efirami xa die soma nɛ faxɛtie yi ra.»

sentences.english: O Lord, what will you give them? Give them bodies which may not give birth and breasts without milk.
sentences.susu: Alatala, a lanma i xa munse raba e bɛ? I xa ginɛ furuxie furi kana, i xa e xiɲɛ xara.

sentences.english: All their evil-doing is in Gilgal; there I had hate for them; because of their evil-doing I will send them out of my house; they will no longer be dear to me; all their rulers are uncontrolled.
sentences.susu: E ɲaaxui birin masenxi nɛ Giligali. Mɛnni n bara e xɔn fɔlɔ e xa fe ɲaaxie xa fe ra. E mu rafanma n ma sɔnɔn. E xa kuntigie findixi matandilae nan na.

sentences.english: The rod has come on Ephraim, their root is dry, let them have no fruit; even though they give birth, I will put to death the dearest fruit of their bodies.
sentences.susu: «N bara Efirami bɔnbɔ. A luxi nɛ alɔ sansi naxan sanke bara xara, a mu bogima sɔnɔn. Xa Efiramikae fa die bari, n e halakima nɛ.»

sentences.english: My God will give them up because they did not give ear to him; they will be wandering among the nations.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala fama nɛ e rabɛɲinde, barima e mu e tuli matixi a ra. E findima nɛ biyaasilae ra sie tagi.

sentences.english: Israel is a branching vine, full of fruit; as his fruit is increased, so the number of his altars is increased; as the land is fair, so they have made fair pillars.
sentences.susu: Isirayila luxi nɛ alɔ sansi bili fanyi naxan bogima a fanyi ra. Kɔnɔ a xa bogi to wuya, a naxa sɛrɛxɛbade fan rawuya. A xa bɔxi to tofan, a naxa tɔnxuma gɛmɛ ti kuye bɛ.

sentences.english: Their mind is taken away; now they will be made waste: he will have their altars broken down, he will give their pillars to destruction.
sentences.susu: E bɔɲɛ mu na Alatala gbansan xa ra, na na a ra e bara yunubi sɔtɔ. Alatala e xa sɛrɛxɛbadee rabirama nɛ, a e xa tɔnxuma gɛmɛe kana.

sentences.english: Now, truly, they will say, We have no king, we have no fear of the Lord; and the king, what is he able to do for us?
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi e a falama, «Mangɛ mu na muxu xun ma, barima muxu mu gaaxuma Alatala ya ra sɔnɔn. Mangɛ nɔma munse rabade muxu bɛ?»

sentences.english: Their words are foolish; they make agreements with false oaths, so punishment will come up like a poison-plant in a ploughed field.
sentences.susu: E wɔyɛnma, e e kalima, e saatɛ tongoma, kɔnɔ na birin fufafu. Kiiti fanyi mu luma e yi, alɔ ɲooge ɲaaxi naxan bulama xɛ ma.

sentences.english: The people of Samaria will be full of fear because of the ox of Beth-aven; its people will have sorrow for it, and its priests will give cries of grief for its glory, for the glory has gone in flight.
sentences.susu: Samarikae fama nɛ kɔntɔfilide e xa ninge kuyee xa fe ra naxee na Beti Aweni. Ɲama wa tima, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe fan sunnunma, barima e ɲɛlɛxinxi naxan na, na fama nɛ bade e yi ra.

sentences.english: And they will take it to Assyria and give it to the great king; shame will come on Ephraim, and Israel will be shamed because of its image.
sentences.susu: Na kuyee xaninma nɛ Asiriya bɔxi ma, a fa lu Mangɛ xungbe ma. Efirami yaagima nɛ, birin fama nɛ yode Isirayila xa kɛwali ma.

sentences.english: As for Samaria, her king is cut off, like mist on the water.
sentences.susu: Samari nun a mangɛ xaninma nɛ, alɔ wuri xuntunyi ye naxan xaninma.

sentences.english: And the high places of Aven, the sin of Israel, will come to destruction; thorns and waste plants will come up on their altars; they will say to the mountains, Be a cover over us; and to the hills, Come down on us.
sentences.susu: Kuye batudee naxee na Beti Aweni, e kanama nɛ. Na sɛrɛxɛbadee, Isirayilakae yunubi raba dɛnnaxɛ, e findima tunbe yiree nan na. E fama nɛ a falade geyae bɛ, «Muxu makoto, muxu ragata!»

sentences.english: O Israel, you have done evil from the days of Gibeah; there they took up their position, so that the fighting against the children of evil might not overtake them in Gibeah.
sentences.susu: «Isirayila, kabi wo naxa na yunubi ɲaaxi raba Gibiya, wo na yunubi sɔtɔfe tun. Ɲaxankatɛ fama e lide Gibiya na nan ma.

sentences.english: I will come and give them punishment; and the peoples will come together against them when I give them the reward of their two sins.
sentences.susu: A bara n kɛnɛn n xa e halaki. Sie fama nɛ e gerede, e e suxu e xa yunubi gbegbe xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And Ephraim is a trained cow, taking pleasure in crushing the grain; but I have put a yoke on her fair neck; I will put a horseman on the back of Ephraim; Judah will be working the plough, Jacob will be turning up the earth.
sentences.susu: Efirami luxi nɛ alɔ ninge xuruxi, wali rafan naxan ma. N fama nɛ luuti xiride a xunyi ma, a xa wali raba n bɛ. Yudaya fan xa wali, Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ xa kote xanin.

sentences.english: Put in the seed of righteousness, get in your grain in mercy, let your unploughed earth be turned up: for it is time to make search for the Lord, till he comes and sends righteousness on you like rain.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wali tinxinxi raba, alako wo xa fe fanyi sɔtɔ. Wo xa wakili nɛɛnɛ tongo, wo xa Alatala fen han a fa tɛmui wo yire, a tinxinyi lu wo bɔɲɛ kui.

sentences.english: You have been ploughing sin, you have got in a store of evil, the fruit of deceit has been your food: for you put faith in your way, in the number of your men of war.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan mu tin na wali tinxinxi ra. Wo bara fe ɲaaxi raba. Yanfanteya nun yɛtɛ igboɲa bara gbo wo yi ra. Wo bara la wo xa sɔɔrie sɛnbɛ ra,

sentences.english: So a great outcry will go up from among your people, and all your strong places will be broken, as Beth-arbel was broken by Shalman in the day of war, as the mother was broken on the rocks with her children.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ e ya fama isode, e xa yire kantaxie fama nɛ kanade, alɔ na gere lɔxɔɛ Salaman xutu sɔtɔ Beti Arabeli xun ma tɛmui naxɛ. Na lɔxɔɛ ginɛe nun e xa di birin faxa nɛ.

sentences.english: So will Beth-el do to you because of your evil-doing; at dawn will the king of Israel be cut off completely.
sentences.susu: Na mɔɔli fama nɛ Beteli lide a xa yunubie xa fe ra. Subaxɛ na a li, Isirayila mangɛ faxama nɛ.»

sentences.english: When Israel was a child he was dear to me; and I took my son out of Egypt.
sentences.susu: «N Isirayila xanu nɛ a dimɛdi tɛmui. N naxa n ma di xili a xa keli Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: When I sent for them, then they went away from me; they made offerings to the Baals, burning perfumes to images.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n to nu e xilima, e naxa e makuya n na, e sɛrɛxɛ ba Bali kuyee bɛ, e surayi gan gɛmɛ masolixie bɛ.

sentences.english: But I was guiding Ephraim's footsteps; I took them up in my arms, but they were not conscious that I was ready to make them well.
sentences.susu: N tan nan nu Efirami malife a xa ɲɛrɛ kui, kɔnɔ e mu a kolonxi a n tan nan nu mɛɛnife e ma.

sentences.english: I made them come after me with the cords of a man, with the bands of love; I was to them as one who took the yoke from off their mouths, putting meat before them.
sentences.susu: N nu na e mabɛndunfe marafanyi nun xanunteya ra. N tan nan e ramini konyiya kui, alako e xa balo a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: He will go back to the land of Egypt and the Assyrian will be his king, because they would not come back to me.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, hali e mu fa sa gbilen Misira bɔxi ma, Asiriya nan nɔɛ sɔtɔma e xun na, barima e bara tondi gbilende n ma.

sentences.english: And the sword will go through his towns, wasting his children and causing destruction because of their evil designs.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra santidɛgɛma fama e xa taae lide, a fa e xɔnyi birin kana. E waxɔnfe mu sɔɔnɛyama sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: My people are given up to sinning against me; though their voice goes up on high, no one will be lifting them up.
sentences.susu: N ma ɲama bara gbilen n fɔxɔ ra. Hali e birin n xili, n mu e xun nakelima.»

sentences.english: How may I give you up, O Ephraim? how may I be your saviour, O Israel? how may I make you like Admah? how may I do to you as I did to Zeboim? My heart is turned in me, it is soft with pity.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ Efirami, n xa i rabɛɲin di? N xa Isirayila rabolo di? N mu nɔma fe rabade i ra alɔ n naxan nabaxi Adamaha. N xa i lu alɔ Seboyimi? Tɔɔrɛ bara n bɔɲɛ suxu. N bara kinikini wo ma.

sentences.english: I will not put into effect the heat of my wrath; I will not again send destruction on Ephraim; for I am God and not man, the Holy One among you; I will not put an end to you.
sentences.susu: N bara n ma natɛ masara, n bɔɲɛ bara xinbeli. N bara diɲɛ Efirami ma, barima Ala nan n na. Adama mu na n tan na. Sɛniyɛntɔɛ nan n na wo tagi. N bara n ma xɔnɛ lu na.

sentences.english: They will go after the Lord; his cry will be like that of a lion; his cry will be loud, and the children will come from the west, shaking with fear;
sentences.susu: E fama nɛ birade Alatala fɔxɔ ra. Ala na a xui ramini sɛnbɛ ra alɔ yɛtɛ magaaxuxi, e fama nɛ lude a xanbi ra kelife sogegorode mabiri.

sentences.english: Shaking with fear like a bird, they will come out of Egypt, like a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will give them rest in their houses, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: E kelima nɛ Misira bɔxi ma alɔ xɔnie, e kelima nɛ Asiriya bɔxi ma alɔ ganbɛe.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Ephraim's food is the wind, and he goes after the east wind: deceit and destruction are increasing day by day; they make an agreement with Assyria, and take oil into Egypt.
sentences.susu: «Efirami wama n madaxufe. Isirayila wama n yanfafe. Yudaya tan birama nɛ Ala fɔxɔ ra, a mu lanlanteya kana Ala sɛniyɛnxi mabiri.

sentences.english: The Lord has a cause against Judah, and will give punishment to Jacob for his ways; he will give him the reward of his acts.
sentences.susu: Efirami fe fufafu fenma, a birama mixie fɔxɔ ra naxee na fuge ra. A xa wulee nun fe ɲaaxie gbo. A saatɛ tongoma Asiriya bɛ, a oliwi ture fima nɛ Misira mangɛ ma.

sentences.english: In the body of his mother he took his brother by the foot, and in his strength he was fighting with God;
sentences.susu: Ala Yudayakae makiitima nɛ, a Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ ɲaxankatama nɛ, a fa a xa kɛwali sare ragbilen a ma.»

sentences.english: He had a fight with the angel and overcame him; he made request for grace to him with weeping; he came face to face with him in Beth-el and there his words came to him;
sentences.susu: E na e nga furi kui, Yaxuba naxa a taara tingilinyi suxu. A to fori, e nun Ala naxa gere so.

sentences.english: Even the Lord, the God of armies; the Lord is his name.
sentences.susu: E nun malekɛ naxa gere so, a xutu sɔtɔ a ma. A naxa wa, a a mayandi a xa hinnɛ a ra. Yaxuba a to nɛ Beteli. E nun Ala wɔyɛn mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: So then, come back to your God; keep mercy and right, and be waiting at all times on your God.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan Mangɛ ra. Xili xungbe kanyi nan Alatala ra.

sentences.english: As for Canaan, the scales of deceit are in his hands; he takes pleasure in twisted ways.
sentences.susu: I tan xa fa i Marigi Ala ma, i naxa dugutɛgɛɲa kana, i xa sɛriyɛ tinxinxi suxu. I xaxili ti i Marigi Ala ra tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: And Ephraim said, Now I have got wealth and much property; in all my works no sin may be seen in me.
sentences.susu: Yulɛ sikeeli wule rawalima, a mixi tɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: But I am the Lord your God from the land of Egypt; I will give you tents for your living-places again as in the days of the holy meeting.
sentences.susu: Efirami bara a fala, «N bara banna han! N bara naafuli sɔtɔ n yɛtɛ sɛnbɛ ra. N mu yunubi yo rabaxi.»

sentences.english: My word came to the ears of the prophets and I gave them visions in great number, and by the mouths of the prophets I made use of comparisons.
sentences.susu: «N tan nan i Marigi Alatala ra, naxan i raminixi Misira bɔxi ma. N man i radɔxɔma nɛ kiri banxie kui, alɔ won ma sali tɛmui dangixie.

sentences.english: In Gilead there is evil. They are quite without value; in Gilgal they make offerings of oxen; truly their altars are like masses of stones in the hollows of a ploughed field.
sentences.susu: N nu wɔyɛnma namiɲɔnmɛe bɛ, n laamatunyie wuyaxi so e yi ra. N nu taalie masenma wo bɛ namiɲɔnmɛe saabui ra.

sentences.english: And Jacob went in flight into the field of Aram, and Israel became a servant for a wife, and for a wife he kept sheep.
sentences.susu: Galadikae luma nɛ fe ɲaaxi raba ra. Na fe na a niyama n fama e xun nakanade. E ningee bama sɛrɛxɛ ra Giligali, kɔnɔ n fama nɛ e xa sɛrɛxɛbadee kanade, e xa lu alɔ gɛmɛ malanxie xɛe ma.»

sentences.english: And by a prophet the Lord made Israel come up out of Egypt, and by a prophet he was kept safe.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a gi Arami bɔxi ma. Isirayila naxa findi xurusee dɛmadonyi ra, alako a xa ginɛ nde sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: I have been bitterly moved to wrath by Ephraim; so that his blood will be on him, and the Lord will make his shame come back on him.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Isirayila ramini Misira bɔxi ma namiɲɔnmɛ nde saabui ra. Alatala naxa mɛɛni Isirayila ma a xa xɛɛrae saabui ra.

sentences.english: When the words of my law came from Ephraim, he was lifted up in Israel; but when he did evil through the Baal, death overtook him.
sentences.susu: Ɲama nu gaaxuma nɛ Efirami xa wɔyɛnyi ya ra, barima mixi binyɛ nan nu a ra, kɔnɔ a naxa yunubi sɔtɔ Bali kuye batufe ra, a fa faxa.

sentences.english: And now their sins are increased; they have made themselves a metal image, false gods from their silver, after their designs, all of them the work of the metal-workers; they say of them, Let them give offerings, let men give kisses to the oxen.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi e man yunubie nan nabama, e kuye rafalama gbeti ra. E kuye yailanma, kɔnɔ xabui wali gbansan nan a ra. E adamadie bama sɛrɛxɛ ra, e ninge kuye sunbuma.

sentences.english: So they will be like the morning cloud, like the dew which goes early away, like the dust of the grain which the wind is driving out of the crushing-floor, like smoke going up from the fireplace.
sentences.susu: Na na a niyama e fama ɲɔnde alɔ kunda naxan goroma gɛɛsɛgɛ, alɔ xini naxan yolonma gɛɛsɛgɛ, alɔ maale lagi foye naxan xaninma foye ra, alɔ tuuri naxan minima kuri kui.

sentences.english: But I am the Lord your God, from the land of Egypt; you have knowledge of no other God and there is no saviour but me.
sentences.susu: «N tan nan i Marigi Alatala ra, naxan i raminixi Misira bɔxi ma. I naxa ala gbɛtɛ kolon fo n tan. Marakisima mu na i bɛ ba n tan na.

sentences.english: I had knowledge of you in the waste land where no water was.
sentences.susu: N ɲɛngi saxi i xɔn gbengberen yire.

sentences.english: When I gave them food they were full, and their hearts were full of pride, and they did not keep me in mind.
sentences.susu: E to baloe sɔtɔ, e naxa luga. E to luga, e naxa findi yɛtɛ igboe ra. Na nan a ra e nɛɛmuxi n ma.

sentences.english: So I will be like a lion to them; as a cruel beast I will keep watch by the road;
sentences.susu: N luma nɛ e bɛ alɔ yɛtɛ, naxan a nɔxunma kira xɔn han a sube sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: I will come face to face with them like a bear whose young ones have been taken from her, and their inmost hearts will be broken; there the dogs will make a meal of them; they will be wounded by the beasts of the field.
sentences.susu: N e suxuma nɛ alɔ sube xaaɲɛ, naxan ma die baxi a yi. N e ibɔɔma nɛ alɔ yɛtɛ, naxan wulai sube faxama. Wula subee man e ibɔɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: I have sent destruction on you, O Israel; who will be your helper?
sentences.susu: Isirayila, i bara i yɛtɛ kana, barima i bara i malima yanfa, naxan findi n tan na.

sentences.english: Where is your king, that he may be your saviour? and all your rulers, that they may take up your cause? of whom you said, Give me a king and rulers.
sentences.susu: I xa mangɛ na minden, naxan nu lanma a xa wo rakisi? I xa kiitisae na minden, i nu wama naxee xɔn alako i xa mangɛ nun mangɛdie sɔtɔ?

sentences.english: I have given you a king, because I was angry, and have taken him away in my wrath.
sentences.susu: N to xɔnɔ wo ma, n bara mangɛ so wo yi ra. Yakɔsi n a bama nɛ wo yi ra n ma xɔnɛ kui.

sentences.english: The wrongdoing of Ephraim is shut up; his sin is put away in secret.
sentences.susu: Efirami xa fe ɲaaxi birin sɛbɛxi, Ala mu nɛɛmuma a xa yunubie ma.

sentences.english: The pains of a woman in childbirth will come on him: he is an unwise son, for at this time it is not right for him to keep his place when children come to birth.
sentences.susu: Tɔɔrɛ fama nɛ a lide, alɔ ginɛ naxan di barima. Kɔnɔ di xaxilitare na a ra. A bari tɛmui na a li, a mu tinma minide a nga tɛɛgɛ.»

sentences.english: I will give the price to make them free from the power of the underworld, I will be their saviour from death: O death! where are your pains? O underworld! where is your destruction? my eyes will have no pity.
sentences.susu: «N xa e xun sara aligiyama sɛnbɛ yi? N xa e rakisi saya ma? Saya, i xa xɔnɛ na minden? Aligiyama, i xa sɛnbɛ na minden? N mu kinikinima wo ma feo!

sentences.english: Though he gives fruit among his brothers, an east wind will come, the wind of the Lord coming up from the waste land, and his spring will become dry, his fountain will be without water: it will make waste the store of all the vessels of his desire.
sentences.susu: Hali a sɛnbɛ gbo a ngaxakerenyie tagi, Alatala foye xare rafama nɛ keli gbengberenyi sogetede mabiri, a fa xuree nun kɔlɔnyie xɔride. Harige birin bama nɛ a yi ra.»

sentences.english: O Israel, come back to the Lord your God; for your evil-doing has been the cause of your fall.
sentences.susu: Samarikae bara yunubi sɔtɔ e Marigi Alatala matandife ra. Na nan a ra e faxama santidɛgɛma ra, e xa diyɔrɛe wolima nɛ bɔxi ma, e xa ginɛ furuxie furi rabɔɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: Take with you words, and come back to the Lord; say to him, Let there be forgiveness for all wrongdoing, so that we may take what is good, and give in payment the fruit of our lips.
sentences.susu: Isirayila, gbilen i Marigi Alatala ma, barima i xa wali kobi bara i rabira.

sentences.english: Assyria will not be our salvation; we will not go on horses; we will not again say to the work of our hands, You are our gods; for in you there is mercy for the child who has no father.
sentences.susu: Wo tuubi Alatala ma, wo fa yi wɔyɛn fanyi fala a bɛ, «I xa diɲɛ muxu xa yunubie ma, i xa hinnɛ muxu ra. Muxu xa tantui ba sɛrɛxɛ ra, tuurae xa lu na.

sentences.english: I will put right their errors; freely will my love be given to them, for my wrath is turned away from him.
sentences.susu: Asiriya mu nɔma muxu rakiside, muxu mu tema soee fari gere xili ma. Muxu mu kuyee xilima ‹Muxu Marigi Ala› naxee yailanxi mixi bɛlɛxɛ ra. I tan nan gbansan kinikinima kiridie ma.»

sentences.english: I will be as the dew to Israel; he will put out flowers like a lily, and send out his roots like Lebanon.
sentences.susu: «N e xa yanfanteya yailanma nɛ. N e xanuma nɛ fonisireya ra, barima n ma xɔnɛ bara gbilen e fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: His branches will be stretched out, he will be beautiful as the olive-tree and sweet-smelling as Lebanon.
sentences.susu: N luma nɛ Isirayila bɛ alɔ xini, e tofanma nɛ alɔ sansi fugaxi. E sabatima nɛ alɔ wuri bili fanyi naxan na Liban.

sentences.english: They will come back and have rest in his shade; their life will be made new like the grain, and they will put out flowers like the vine; his name will be like the wine of Lebanon.
sentences.susu: A salonyi kuyama nɛ. A tofanma nɛ alɔ oliwi wuri, a xiri fanyi raminima nɛ alɔ wondi naxan na Liban.

sentences.english: As for Ephraim, what has he to do with false gods any longer? I have given an answer and I will keep watch over him; I am like a branching fir-tree, from me comes your fruit.
sentences.susu: Ɲama man sabatima nɛ Isirayila bɔxi ma Ala xa niini bun ma. E xa mɛngi fanma nɛ. E xa fe ɲɔxunma nɛ alɔ wɛni bogi, e fa xili fanyi sɔtɔ alɔ Liban xa wɛni.

sentences.english: He who is wise will see these things; he who has good sense will have knowledge of them. For the ways of the Lord are straight, and the upright will go in them, but sinners will be falling in them.
sentences.susu: Efirami bɔnsɔɛ, munse na n nun kuyee tagi? N tan nan wo xa dubɛ suxuma, n nan n ɲɛngi sama nɛ wo xɔn. N luma nɛ wo bɛ alɔ wuri xinde fanyi. Wo baloe sɔtɔma n tan nan saabui ra.»

sentences.english: The word of the Lord which came to Joel, the son of Pethuel.
sentences.susu: Masenyi nan yi ki Alatala naxan masen Petuweli xa di Yoweli bɛ:

sentences.english: Give ear to this, you old men, and take note, you people of the land. Has this ever been in your days, or in the days of your fathers?
sentences.susu: Forie, wo yi fe ramɛ, bɔxikae, wo wo tuli mati. Yi fe mɔɔli bara raba nu wo xa waxati, xa na mu wo benbae xa waxati?

sentences.english: Give the story of it to your children, and let them give it to their children, and their children to another generation.
sentences.susu: Wo yi ya maxaran wo xa die bɛ, wo xa die fan xa a ya maxaran e gbe die bɛ, e gbe die fan xa a ya maxaran e gbe die bɛ e fama naxee baride.

sentences.english: What the worm did not make a meal of, has been taken by the locust; and what the locust did not take, has been food for the plant-worm; and what the plant-worm did not take, has been food for the field-fly.
sentences.susu: Kulie naxan lu, katoe xunxurie bara na don. Katoe xunxurie naxan lu, katoe xungbee bara na don. Katoe xungbee naxan lu, katoe mɔɔli gbɛtɛe fan bara na don.

sentences.english: Come out of your sleep, you who are overcome with wine, and give yourselves to weeping; give cries of sorrow, all you drinkers of wine, because of the sweet wine; for it has been cut off from your mouths.
sentences.susu: Wo tan siisilae, wo xunu, wo xa wa. Beere minyie, wo xa wo xui ite, barima wo mu fama wɛni nɛɛnɛ sɔtɔde sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: For a nation has come up over my land, strong and without number; his teeth are the teeth of a lion, and he has the back teeth of a great lion.
sentences.susu: Ɲamanɛ sɛnbɛma nde naxan xa mixi kɔnti mu kolon, na bara din n ma bɔxi ra. A ɲinyie luxi nɛ alɔ yɛtɛ ɲinyi, a banganyie luxi nɛ alɔ yɛtɛ ginɛ banganyie.

sentences.english: By him my vine is made waste and my fig-tree broken: he has taken all its fruit and sent it down to the earth; its branches are made white.
sentences.susu: A bara n ma wɛni xɛe kana, a n ma xɔrɛ bilie ibolon. A bara e kobole ba han e salonyi bara fiixɛ fɔɛn.

sentences.english: Make sounds of grief like a virgin dressed in haircloth for the husband of her early years.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wa alɔ sungbutunyi naxan xa xɛmɛ bara faxa.

sentences.english: The meal offering and the drink offering have been cut off from the house of the Lord; the priests, the Lord's servants, are sorrowing.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe sunnunxi, barima hadiya donse mu na Alatala xa banxi kui sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: The fields are wasted, the land has become dry; for the grain is wasted, the new wine is kept back, the oil is poor.
sentences.susu: Xɛe bara kana, bɔxi fan na sunnunyi kui, barima donse xun bara rakana, wɛni nun ture mu na.

sentences.english: The farmers are shamed, the workers in the vine-gardens give cries of grief, for the wheat and the barley; for the produce of the fields has come to destruction.
sentences.susu: Xɛ sae wama nɛ, wɛni sansi sie sunnunma nɛ, barima naxan birin bogixi xɛe ma, na birin bara kasara.

sentences.english: The vine has become dry and the fig-tree is feeble; the pomegranate and the palm-tree and the apple-tree, even all the trees of the field, are dry: because joy has gone from the sons of men.
sentences.susu: Wɛni bilie bara xara, xɔrɛ bilie bara lɔxɔsin. Wɛni bilie, tugi bilie, mangoe bilie, nee birin bara xara. Mixie xa ɲɛlɛxinyi bara ɲɔn.

sentences.english: Put haircloth round you and give yourselves to sorrow, you priests; give cries of grief, you servants of the altar: come in, and, clothed in haircloth, let the night go past, you servants of my God: for the meal offering and the drink offering have been kept back from the house of your God.
sentences.susu: Na kui a lanma wo tan sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, wo xa sunnunyi dugi ragoro wo ma. Wo tan naxee sɛrɛxɛ ganma sɛrɛxɛbade fari, wo xa wa. Wo xa kɔɛ radangi nimisɛ kui, wo tan naxee walima n Marigi Ala bɛ, barima hadiya donse bara ɲɔn Ala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: Let a time be fixed for going without food, have a holy meeting, let the old men, even all the people of the land, come together to the house of the Lord your God, crying out to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sunyi suxu, wo xa sali raba. Wo xa forie nun ɲama malan wo Marigi Alatala xa banxi kui, wo fa a maxandi wo bɔɲɛ birin na.

sentences.english: Sorrow for the day! for the day of the Lord is near, and as destruction from the Ruler of all it will come.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa lɔxɔɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ bara makɔrɛ. A fama nɛ kanari belebele tide Ala Sɛnbɛma xili ra.

sentences.english: Is not food cut off before our eyes? joy and delight from the house of our God?
sentences.susu: Wo mu a toxi won ma donse bara ɲɔn, sɛɛwɛ nun ɲɛlɛxinyi mu na Ala xa banxi yire sɔnɔn?

sentences.english: The grains have become small and dry under the spade; the store-houses are made waste, the grain-stores are broken down; for the grain is dry and dead.
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔrie bara xara bɛndɛ bun ma. Sansi xɔrie ragatadee bara bira, donse bara ɲɔn.

sentences.english: What sounds of pain come from the beasts! the herds of cattle are at a loss because there is no grass for them; even the flocks of sheep are no longer to be seen.
sentences.susu: Xurusee wama donse fe ra. Yɛxɛɛ tɔɔrɔma barima ɲooge mu na.

sentences.english: O Lord, my cry goes up to you: for fire has put an end to the grass-lands of the waste, and all the trees of the field are burned with its flame.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n i tan nan maxandima, barima tɛ bara fiilie nun burunyi gan.

sentences.english: The beasts of the field are turning to you with desire: for the water-streams are dry and fire has put an end to the grass-lands of the waste.
sentences.susu: Hali burunyi subee ya tixi i ra, barima xuree bara xɔri, tɛ bara fiilie gan.

sentences.english: Let the horn be sounded in Zion, and a war-cry in my holy mountain; let all the people of the land be troubled: for the day of the Lord is coming;
sentences.susu: Wo sarae fe n ma geya sɛniyɛnxi Siyoni fari! Bɔxikae birin xa sɛrɛn gaaxui ra, barima Alatala xa lɔxɔɛ na fafe, a bara makɔrɛ.

sentences.english: For a day of dark and deep shade is near, a day of cloud and black night: like a black cloud a great and strong people is covering the mountains; there has never been any like them and will not be after them again, from generation to generation.
sentences.susu: Dimi nun kuye ifɔɔrɛ lɔxɔɛ nan a ra. A luxi nɛ alɔ kunda nun nuxui ifɔɔrɛ naxan dinma geya ra, alɔ subaxɛ naiyalanyi yensenma ki naxɛ. Ɲama sɛnbɛma belebele fama nɛ, naxan maniyɛ mu toxi tɛmui dangixi, a man mu toma tɛmui naxan sa fama.

sentences.english: Before them fire sends destruction, and after them flame is burning: the land is like the garden of Eden before them, and after them an unpeopled waste; truly, nothing has been kept safe from them.
sentences.susu: Tɛ saxi e ya ra, tɛ saxi e xanbi ra. Bɔxi naxan na e ya ra, a tofan alɔ sansi yire Ala naxan daaxi Adama bɛ, kɔnɔ e na dangi, na bɔxi fa findi gbengberenyi magaaxuxi yire ra. E a birin kana!

sentences.english: Their form is like the form of horses, and they are running like war-horses.
sentences.susu: E luxi alɔ soe galie, sɔɔrie dɔxɔxi naxee fari.

sentences.english: Like the sound of war-carriages they go jumping on the tops of the mountains; like the noise of a flame of fire burning up the grain-stems, like a strong people lined up for the fight.
sentences.susu: E tuganma nɛ alɔ sɔɔri ragisee naxee goroma geyae tagi. E xui maniya tɛ wundui xui ra naxan sɛxɛ ganma. E maniya sɔɔri gali sɛnbɛma ra naxan tixi gere ki ma.

sentences.english: At their coming the people are bent with pain: all faces become red together.
sentences.susu: Mixie na e to, gaaxui luma nɛ e suxu ra, e yatagie birin ifɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: They are running like strong men, they go over the wall like men of war; every man goes straight on his way, their lines are not broken.
sentences.susu: E e gima nɛ alɔ ɲalamae, e tema taa tɛtɛ ma alɔ korogbae. Kankan siga a xa kira ra, e mu e bama kira ma feo.

sentences.english: No one is pushing against another; everyone goes straight on his way: bursting through the sword points, their order is not broken.
sentences.susu: E mu dinma e boore ra, kankan biraxi a xa kira nan fɔxɔ ra. Hali e gerefae ti e ya ra, e soma nɛ nee ra e xa safɛ mu kana.

sentences.english: They make a rush on the town, running on the wall; they go up into the houses and in through the windows like a thief.
sentences.susu: E dinma nɛ taa ra, e e gima nɛ tɛtɛ fari. E tema nɛ banxie fari, e so wundɛrie ra alɔ muɲɛtie.

sentences.english: The earth is troubled before them and the heavens are shaking: the sun and the moon have become dark, and the stars keep back their shining:
sentences.susu: Bɔxi sɛrɛnma nɛ e ya ra, koore a imaxa. Soge nun kike ifɔɔrɔma nɛ, tunbuie mu yanbama sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And the Lord is thundering before his forces; for very great is his army; for he is strong who gives effect to his word: for the day of the Lord is great and greatly to be feared, and who has strength against it?
sentences.susu: Alatala a xui raminima nɛ a xa geresoe ya ra. E wuya, e a xa yaamari suxu sɛnbɛ ra. Alatala xa lɔxɔɛ xungbe magaaxu. Nde nɔma na lɔxɔɛ raxande?

sentences.english: But even now, says the Lord, come back to me with all your heart, keeping from food, with weeping and with sorrow:
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Wo xa wo yɛtɛ ragbilen n ma yakɔsi. Wo xa na raba wo ɲanige fiixɛ ra, sunyi ra, wa ra, nun mayandi ra!

sentences.english: Let your hearts be broken, and not your clothing, and come back to the Lord your God: for he is full of grace and pity, slow to be angry and great in mercy, ready to be turned from his purpose of punishment.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo xa dugie ibɔɔ sunnunyi kui, wo xa wo bɔɲɛ nan masara. Wo xa wo yɛtɛ ragbilen wo Marigi Alatala ma, barima a hinnɛma nɛ wo ra, a kinikini wo ma, a mu xɔnɔma mafuren, a xa mixi xanui gbo, a gbilenma a xa gbaloe fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: May it not be that he will again let his purpose be changed and let a blessing come after him, even a meal offering and a drink offering for the Lord your God?
sentences.susu: Nde a kolon xa a mu a xa natɛ masarama, xa a mu diɲɛma, a fe fanyi raba wo bɛ? Na tɛmui wo fama nɛ donse nun minse hadiya ra wo Marigi Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: Let a horn be sounded in Zion, let a time be fixed for going without food, have a holy meeting:
sentences.susu: Wo xa sarae fe Siyoni! Wo xa sunyi suxu, wo sali xungbe raba.

sentences.english: Get the people together, make the mass of the people holy, send for the old men, get together the children and babies at the breast: let the newly married man come out of his room and the bride from her tent.
sentences.susu: Wo xa ɲama malan sɛniyɛnyi kui. Wo xa forie, dimɛe, nun diyɔrɛe xili. Xɛmɛ naxan bara ginɛ dɔxɔ, a tan nun a xa ginɛ xa lu na malanyi kui.

sentences.english: Let the priests, the servants of the Lord, be weeping between the covered way and the altar, and let them say, Have mercy on your people, O Lord, do not give up your heritage to shame, so that the nations become their rulers: why let them say among the peoples, Where is their God?
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, wo tan naxee walima Alatala bɛ, wo xa wo mawa Ala bɛ sɛrɛxɛbade nun hɔrɔmɔbanxi tagi, a falafe ra, ‹Alatala, i xa i xa ɲama ratanga. I naxa i kɛ tongomae rayaagi, e xa findi mayele se ra ɲamanɛe bɛ, mixi fa a fala, E Marigi Ala na minden?›»

sentences.english: Then the Lord had a care for the honour of his land and had pity on his people.
sentences.susu: Alatala wama a xa ɲama xa lu a yi ra. A kinikinima e ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord made answer and said to his people, See, I will send you grain and wine and oil in full measure: and I will no longer let you be shamed among the nations:
sentences.susu: Alatala bara a xa ɲama yaabi, a bara a masen a xa ɲama bɛ: «N donse, wɛni, nun ture fima nɛ wo ma han wo wasa. N mu luma sie xa wo rayaagi sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: I will send the one from the north far away from you, driving him into a dry and waste land, with his front to the sea of the east and his back to the sea of the west, and the smell of him will go up, even his evil smell will go up.
sentences.susu: N wo yaxuie makuyama nɛ wo ra, naxee kelima kɔɔla ma, n e radin gbengberen yire dɛnnaxɛ kanaxi. E xa geresoe naxee tima yare, n nee madulama sogetede baa nan xɔɔra, naxee tima xanbi, n nee tan madulama sogegorode baa nan xɔɔra. E bɔrɔ xiri mini, a din yire birin na.» Alatala bara kaabanakoe raba!

sentences.english: Have no fear, O land; be glad with great joy; for the Lord has done great things.
sentences.susu: Isirayila bɔxi, hali i mu gaaxu! I xa ɲɛlɛxin, i xa lu sɛɛwɛ kui, barima Alatala fe xungbee rabama.

sentences.english: Have no fear, you beasts of the field, for the grass-lands of the waste are becoming green, for the trees are producing fruit, the fig-tree and the vine give out their strength.
sentences.susu: Burunyi subee, hali wo mu gaaxu, barima ɲooge man gbilenma nɛ fiili ma, sansi bilie man bogima nɛ, xɔrɛ bilie nun wɛni bilie fan daxamui raminima nɛ.

sentences.english: Be glad, then, you children of Zion, and have joy in the Lord your God: for he gives you food in full measure, making the rain come down for you, the early and the late rain as at the first.
sentences.susu: Wo tan Siyoni ɲama, wo xa sɛɛwa, wo xa ɲɛlɛxin wo Marigi Alatala xili ra, barima a tunɛ fanyi rafama nɛ wo bɛ, a tunɛ gbegbe ragoroma nɛ wo bɛ a waxati ma, alɔ a nu a rabama ki naxɛ a singe.

sentences.english: And the floors will be full of grain, and the crushing-places overflowing with wine and oil.
sentences.susu: Lonyie rafema nɛ sansi xɔri ra, fifae rafema nɛ wɛni nɛɛnɛ nun ture ra.

sentences.english: I will give back to you the years which were food for the locust, the plant-worm, the field-fly, and the worm, my great army which I sent among you.
sentences.susu: N wo xa daxamui ɲɔxɔɛ fima nɛ, n ma geresoe sɛnbɛmae naxan kana, n ma geresoe naxee lanxi kulie, katoe, nun katoe maniyɛe ma, n naxee rasanba wo xili ma.

sentences.english: You will have food in full measure, and give praise to the name of the Lord your God, who has done wonders for you:
sentences.susu: Wo fama nɛ wo dɛgede han wo luga. Wo n matɔxɔma nɛ, n tan wo Marigi Ala, naxan bara kaabanakoe raba wo bɛ. N ma ɲama mu rayarabima sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And you will be certain that I am in Israel, and that I am the Lord your God, and there is no other: and my people will never be shamed.
sentences.susu: Na kui wo a kolonma nɛ a n na Isirayila fɔxɔ ra, a n tan nan na wo Marigi Alatala ra, a Ala gbɛtɛ mu na. N ma ɲama mu rayarabima sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: For in those days and in that time, when I let the fate of Judah and Jerusalem be changed,
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, n na n Xaxili ragoroma nɛ mixi birin ma. Wo xa di xɛmɛe nun di ginɛe namiɲɔnmɛɲa rabama nɛ, wo xa forie xiyee sama nɛ, laamatunyie goroma nɛ wo xa fonikee ma.

sentences.english: I will get together all the nations, and make them come down into the valley of Jehoshaphat; and there I will take up with them the cause of my people and of my heritage Israel, whom they have sent wandering among the nations, and of my land which has been parted by them.
sentences.susu: N na n Xaxili ragoroma nɛ konyi xɛmɛe nun konyi ginɛe ma.

sentences.english: And they have put the fate of my people to the decision of chance: giving a boy for the price of a loose woman and a girl for a drink of wine.
sentences.susu: N tɔnxumae raminima nɛ koore nun bɔxi ma, naxee findima wuli, tɛ, nun tuuri ra.

sentences.english: And further, what are you to me, O Tyre and Zidon and all the circle of Philistia? will you give me back any payment? and if you do, quickly and suddenly I will send it back on your head,
sentences.susu: Soge dimima nɛ, kike masarama nɛ a findi wuli ra, beenun Marigi xa lɔxɔɛ xungbe magaaxuxi xa a li.

sentences.english: For you have taken my silver and my gold, putting in the houses of your gods my beautiful and pleasing things.
sentences.susu: Na kui, naxan yo na Alatala xili, na kanyi kisima nɛ. Mixi kisixie luma nɛ Siyoni nun Darisalamu, alɔ Alatala a masenxi ki naxɛ. Alatala kisi ragirixi naxee ma, nee luma nɛ kisi mixie dɔnxɔɛ ya ma.

sentences.english: The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa; what he saw about Israel in the days of Uzziah, king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam, the son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earth-shock.
sentences.susu: Annabi Amosi, Tekowaka xuruse kanyi, naxa laamatunyi to Isirayila xa fe ra Yudaya mangɛ Yusiya nun Isirayila mangɛ Yerobowami, Yowasi xa di xa waxati, ɲɛ firin beenun bɔxi xa sɛrɛn. Annabi Amosi xa masenyi nan ya:

sentences.english: And he said, The Lord will give a lion's cry from Zion, his voice will be sounding from Jerusalem; and the fields of the keepers of sheep will become dry, and the top of Carmel will be wasted away.
sentences.susu: «Alatala a xaaɲɛ xui raminima Siyoni ma alɔ yɛtɛ, a a xui itexi raminima keli Darisalamu. Sɛxɛ mu na fiilie ma xurusee naxan donma, Karemele geya fan bara xara.»

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Damascus, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because they have been crushing Gilead with iron grain-crushing instruments.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «Damasi xa yunubi rabaxi saxanyi, xa na mu a ra naani xa fe ra, n mu gbilenma n ma natɛ fɔxɔ ra. E bara Galadi kana a ɲaaxi ra, alɔ bɔxi buxama ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, burning up the great houses of Ben-hadad.
sentences.susu: N tɛ dinma Xasayeli xa banxi ra na nan ma. Na tɛ nan fama Ben Hadada xa yire makantaxie gande.

sentences.english: And I will have the locks of the door of Damascus broken, and him who is seated in power cut off from the valley of Aven, and him in whose hand is the rod from the house of Eden; and the people of Aram will go away as prisoners into Kir, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N Damasi xa naadɛ balan se girama nɛ. N Awenikae halakima nɛ gulunba kui, a nun mangɛ naxan na Beti Eden. Siriya ɲama xaninma nɛ Kiriya konyiya kui.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Gaza, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because they took all the people away prisoners, to give them up to Edom.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «Gasa xa yunubi rabaxi saxanyi, xa na mu a ra naani xa fe ra, n mu gbilenma n ma natɛ fɔxɔ ra. E bara taa ndee xa ɲama birin xanin Edon konyiya kui.

sentences.english: And I will send a fire on the wall of Gaza, burning up its great houses:
sentences.susu: N tɛ dinma Gasa tɛtɛ ra na nan ma. Na fama nɛ a yire makantaxie gande.

sentences.english: Him who is seated in power I will have cut off from Ashdod, and him in whose hand is the rod from Ashkelon; and my hand will be turned against Ekron, and the rest of the Philistines will come to destruction, says the Lord God.
sentences.susu: N Asidodikae halakima nɛ, a nun mangɛ naxan na Asikalɔn. N Ekiron ɲaxankatama nɛ, Filisitakae birin faxama nɛ.» Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Tyre, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because they gave up all the people prisoners to Edom, without giving a thought to the brothers' agreement between them.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «Tire xa yunubi rabaxi saxanyi, xa na mu a ra naani xa fe ra, n mu gbilenma n ma natɛ fɔxɔ ra. E bara taa ndee xa ɲama birin xanin Edon konyiya kui, e saatɛ kana e naxan tongo e nun e ngaxakerenyi Isirayilakae tagi.

sentences.english: And I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, burning up its great houses.
sentences.susu: N tɛ dinma Tire tɛtɛ ra na nan ma. Na tɛ fama nɛ a yire makantaxie gande.»

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Edom, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because his sword was turned against his brother, without pity, and his wrath was burning at all times, and he was angry for ever.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «Edon xa yunubi rabaxi saxanyi, xa na mu a ra naani xa fe ra, n mu gbilenma n ma natɛ fɔxɔ ra. E bara e ngaxakerenyie gere santidɛgɛma ra. E mu kinikini e ma, e xa xɔnɛ xun nan tun masama.

sentences.english: And I will send a fire on Teman, burning up the great houses of Bozrah.
sentences.susu: N tɛ dinma nɛ Teman na. Na tɛ nan fama Bosara yire makantaxie gande.»

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because in Gilead they had women with child cut open, so that they might make wider the limits of their land.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «Amonikae xa yunubi rabaxi saxanyi, xa na mu a ra naani xa fe ra, n mu gbilenma n ma natɛ fɔxɔ ra. E bara Galadi ginɛ furuxie furie rabɔɔ santidɛgɛma ra, alako e xa bɔxi xun xa masa.

sentences.english: And I will make a fire in the wall of Rabbah, burning up its great houses, with loud cries in the days of war, with a storm in the day of the great wind:
sentences.susu: N tɛ radɛxɛma Raaba tɛtɛ ra na nan ma. Na tɛ nan fama a yire makantaxie gande.

sentences.english: And their king will be made prisoner, he and his captains together, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: E xa mangɛ nun a xa kuntigie fama nɛ xaninde konyiya kui, gere sɔnxɔɛ rate gere so lɔxɔɛ, turunnaadɛ foye mini xui lɔxɔɛ.» Ala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Moab, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because he had the bones of the king of Edom burned to dust.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «Mowaba xa yunubi rabaxi saxanyi, xa na mu a ra naani xa fe ra, n mu gbilenma n ma natɛ fɔxɔ ra. E bara Edon mangɛ xɔrie gan han e bara findi xube ra.

sentences.english: And I will send a fire on Moab, burning up the great houses of Kerioth: and death will come on Moab with noise and outcries and the sound of the horn:
sentences.susu: N tɛ dinma Mowaba ra na nan ma. Na tɛ fama nɛ Keriyoti yire makantaxie gande. Mowaba xa fe ɲɔnma gere sɔnxɔɛ nan kui, gere feri fe xui kui.

sentences.english: And I will have the judge cut off from among them, and all their captains I will put to death with him, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N e xa kiitisa xungbe halakima nɛ nun a xa kuntigie ra.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Judah, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because they have given up the law of the Lord, and have not kept his rules; and their false ways, in which their fathers went, have made them go out of the right way.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «Yudaya xa yunubi rabaxi saxanyi, xa na mu a ra naani xa fe ra, n mu gbilenma n ma natɛ fɔxɔ ra. E bara n ma sɛriyɛ matandi, e mu n ma yaamarie suxu, barima e bara e yɛtɛ ralɔɛ lafe ra ala wule daaxie ra, e babae la naxee ra.

sentences.english: And I will send a fire on Judah, burning up the great houses of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: N tɛ dinma Yudaya ra na nan ma. Na tɛ nan fama Darisalamu yire makantaxie gande.»

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord: For three crimes of Israel, and for four, I will not let its fate be changed; because they have given the upright man for silver, and the poor for the price of two shoes;
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «Isirayila xa yunubi rabaxi saxanyi, xa na mu a ra naani xa fe ra, n mu gbilenma n ma natɛ fɔxɔ ra. E tinxintɔɛ matima kɔbiri ra, e misikiinɛ matima sankiri sare xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Crushing the head of the poor, and turning the steps of the gentle out of the way: and a man and his father go in to the same young woman, putting shame on my holy name:
sentences.susu: E tɔɔrɔmixie xa fe mayo, e tondi setare xa kiiti sade. Babɛ nun a xa di, ginɛdimɛdi keren masama. Na kui e bara n xili sɛniyɛnxi rasɔtɔ.

sentences.english: By every altar they are stretched on clothing taken from those who are in their debt, drinking in the house of their god the wine of those who have made payment for wrongdoing.
sentences.susu: E dugi italama e naxan nasuxuxi sɛɛkɛ ra, e e sa na ma sɛrɛxɛbade fɛ ma. E wɛni sɔtɔma tinxintareya ra, e na min e xa alae xa banxie kui.»

sentences.english: Though I sent destruction on the Amorite before them, who was tall as the cedar and strong as the oak-tree, cutting off his fruit from on high and his roots from under the earth.
sentences.susu: «E na finsiriwaliya birin nabama n ya i, n tan naxan Amorikae halaki e bɛ, Amorikae naxee xungbo e sɛnbɛ gbo alɔ konde bili. N naxa Amorikae fɔxi birin ba naa, alako e naxa nɔ sɛnbɛ sɔtɔde sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And I took you up out of the land of Egypt, guiding you for forty years in the waste land, so that you might take for your heritage the land of the Amorite.
sentences.susu: N man naxa wo ramini Misira bɔxi ra, n fa wo raɲɛrɛ ɲɛ tongo naani bun ma gbengberenyi ma, alako wo xa Amori bɔxi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And some of your sons I made prophets, and some of your young men I made separate for myself. Is it not even so, O children of Israel? says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N naxa namiɲɔnmɛe rakeli wo ya ma, a nun Nasari sɛgɛtalae naxee bara fi n ma. Isirayilakae, a mu na na ki xɛ?» Alatala xa wɔyɛnyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: But to those who were separate you gave wine for drink; and to the prophets you said, Be prophets no longer.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ wo tan bara beere so Nasari mixie yi ra. Wo bara tɔnyi dɔxɔ namiɲɔnmɛe ra a e naxa Ala xa masenyi masen.»

sentences.english: See, I am crushing you down, as one is crushed under a cart full of grain.
sentences.susu: «N fama wo butuxunde na nan ma, alɔ kote binye a maxanin se butuxunma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And flight will be impossible for the quick-footed, and the force of the strong will become feeble, and the man of war will not get away safely:
sentences.susu: Mixi xulunxi mu nɔma a gide. Sɛnbɛma sɛnbɛ bama nɛ a yi ra. Geresoe faxama nɛ gere kui.

sentences.english: And the bowman will not keep his place; he who is quick-footed will not get away safely: and the horseman will not keep his life.
sentences.susu: Tanbɛ woli mu tima. Naxan xulun a gide na sanyi mu a bama e i. Soe ragi mu kisima.

sentences.english: And he who is without fear among the fighting men will go in flight without his clothing in that day, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ geresoe suusaxi a gima a mageli nan na.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Give ear to this word which the Lord has said against you, O children of Israel, against all the family which I took up out of the land of Egypt, saying,
sentences.susu: Wo wo tuli mati yi masenyi ra, Alatala naxan masenma Isirayilakae bɛ, a xabilɛ naxan namini Misira bɔxi ra.

sentences.english: You only of all the families of the earth have I taken care of: for this reason I will send punishment on you for all your sins.
sentences.susu: «N wo tan nan gbansan sugandi duniɲa xabilɛe birin ya ma. Na nan a ra, n a ɲanigexi wo xa ɲaxankatɛ sɔtɔ wo xa yunubie xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: Is it possible for two to go walking together, if not by agreement?
sentences.susu: Mixi firin nɔma ɲɛrɛ ralande xa e mu lanxi na ma?

sentences.english: Will a lion give his loud cry in the woodland when no food is there? will the voice of the young lion be sounding from his hole if he has taken nothing?
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛ a xui raminima wula i xa a mu sube nde sɔtɔxi?

sentences.english: Is it possible for a bird to be taken in a net on the earth where no net has been put for him? will the net come up from the earth if it has taken nothing at all?
sentences.susu: Xɔni goroma yɛlɛ kui xa donse mu na yɛlɛ ra? Gantanyi nɔma fulade xa xɔni mu suxuxi a ra?

sentences.english: If the horn is sounded in the town will the people not be full of fear? will evil come on a town if the Lord has not done it?
sentences.susu: Feri fema taa nde kui ɲama kui mu ifu? Gbaloe taa nde lima, xa Alatala xa mu a ragiri?

sentences.english: Certainly the Lord will do nothing without making clear his secret to his servants, the prophets.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala mu fefe rabama, a mu a xa gundo masen a xa konyi namiɲɔnmɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: The cry of the lion is sounding; who will not have fear? The Lord God has said the word; is it possible for the prophet to keep quiet?
sentences.susu: Yɛtɛ na a xui ramini, nde mu gaaxuma? Marigi Alatala na wɔyɛn, nde tondima na masende?

sentences.english: Give out the news in the great houses of Assyria and in the land of Egypt, and say, Come together on the mountains of Samaria, and see what great outcries are there, and what cruel acts are done in it.
sentences.susu: Wo xa yi fala Asidodi yire makantaxie kui, wo man xa yi fala Misira yire makantaxie kui, «Wo xa wo malan Samari geyae fari, wo xa a mato mɛnnikae kɔntɔfilixi ki naxɛ, a nun e e boore tɔɔrɔma ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: For they have no knowledge of how to do what is right, says the Lord, who are storing up violent acts and destruction in their great houses.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «E mu tinxinyi yo kolon, e xa fe ɲaaxi nun muɲɛ xun nan tun masafe. E naxan sɔtɔma, e na malanma e xa yire makantaxie nan kui.»

sentences.english: For this reason, says the Lord, an attacker will come, shutting in the land on every side; and your strength will come down and your great houses will be made waste.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxan masen, na nan yi ki. «Wo wo ya rabi, wo yaxui na fafe wo xa bɔxi kanade. E fama nɛ wo xun nakanade, e fa wo xa yire makantaxie kana.»

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord: As the keeper of sheep takes out of the mouth of the lion two legs or part of an ear; so will the children of Israel be made safe, who are resting in Samaria on seats of honour or on the silk cushions of a bed.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «Yɛtɛ na yɛxɛɛ ibɔɔ, xuruse dɛmadonyi nɔma yɛxɛɛ sanyi firin, xa na mu a ra a tuli xuntunyi rakiside yɛtɛ ma. Isirayilakae fan kisima na ki nɛ. Samarika naxee e malabuma sade ma, naxee e magoroma Damasi magoro see kui, wo tan mu kisima.»

sentences.english: Give ear now, and give witness against the family of Jacob, says the Lord God, the God of armies;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Wo wo tuli mati n na, wo na masen Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: For in the day when I give Israel punishment for his sins, I will send punishment on the altars of Beth-el, and the horns of the altar will be cut off and come down to the earth.
sentences.susu: N na Isirayila ɲaxankata a xa yunubie xa fe ra tɛmui naxɛ, n man e ɲaxankatama nɛ e xa sɛrɛxɛbadee xa fe ra naxee na Beteli. Na sɛrɛxɛbade suxusee birama nɛ bɔxi.

sentences.english: And I will send destruction on the winter house with the summer house; the ivory houses will be falling down and the great houses will come to an end, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N man e xa banxi tofanyie rabirama nɛ, ɲɛmɛ nun sogofure banxi birin, naxee ratofanxi sili ɲinyi ra. N na birin kanama nɛ.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Give ear to this word, you cows of Bashan, who are in the hill of Samaria, by whom the poor are kept down, and those in need are crushed; who say to their lords, Get out the wine and give us drink.
sentences.susu: Wo wo tuli mati yi masenyi ra, wo tan ginɛ naxee luxi alɔ ningee, ninge tofanyie naxee na Basan bɔxi ma. Wo tan naxee sabatixi Samari geya fari, wo tan naxee misikiinɛ tɔɔrɔma, wo tan naxee tima setaree fari. Wo nu fa a falama wo xa mɔrie bɛ, «Wo fa beere ra, won naxan minma.»

sentences.english: The Lord God has taken an oath by his holy name, that the days are coming when they will take you away with hooks, and the rest of you with fish-hooks.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala bara a kali a xa sɛniyɛnyi ra, «Kiiti lɔxɔɛ na fafe. E fama nɛ wo suxude wure kɔnkɔrɔnxie ra, e wo nun wo xa die xanin.

sentences.english: And you will go out through the broken places, every one going straight before her, and you will be sent into Harmon, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo minima nɛ wo xa tɛtɛ kanaxi kui, kankan tixi a boore xanbi ra. E wo xaninma nɛ yire makantaxi.» Alatala xa wɔyɛnyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Come to Beth-el and do evil; to Gilgal, increasing the number of your sins; come with your offerings every morning and your tenths every three days:
sentences.susu: «Wo siga Beteli, alako wo xa yunubi raba naa. Wo siga Giligali, alako wo man xa yunubi sɔtɔ. Wo xa sɛrɛxɛ ba gɛɛsɛgɛ birin, wo man xa farilɛ ba ɲɛ saxan yo ɲɛ saxan.

sentences.english: Let that which is leavened be burned as a praise-offering, let the news of your free offerings be given out publicly; for this is pleasing to you, O children of Israel, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo lɛbini taami ba tantui sɛrɛxɛ ra. Wo wo xa ɲanige sɛrɛxɛ masen birin bɛ, barima na fe mɔɔlie rafan wo ma, wo tan Isirayilakae.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.
