sentences.english: But in all your towns I have kept food from your teeth, and in all your places there has been need of bread: and still you have not come back to me, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: «N nu bara kaamɛ raso wo xa taae kui. Taami yo mu lu wo xɔnyi. Kɔnɔ hali n to na birin naba, wo mu tuubi n bɛ.» Alatala xa wɔyɛnyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And I have kept back the rain from you, when it was still three months before the grain-cutting: I sent rain on one town and kept it back from another: one part was rained on, and the part where there was no rain became a waste.
sentences.susu: «Kike saxan to nu luxi xɛ xa xaba, n tondi nɛ tunɛ ragorode wo ma. N bara a niya taa ndee xa tunɛ sɔtɔ, taa ndee naxa a sɔtɔ. N bara a ragiri ndee xa tunɛ sɔtɔ, xɛ ndee naxa tunɛ sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: So two or three towns went wandering to one town looking for water, and did not get enough: and still you have not come back to me, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mixie bara keli taa ndee, e siga ye fende taa gbɛtɛ kui, kɔnɔ ye xɔli mu ba e ma. Hali n to na birin naba, wo mu tuubi n bɛ.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: I have sent destruction on your fields by burning and disease: the increase of your gardens and your vine-gardens, your fig-trees and your olive-trees, has been food for worms: and still you have not come back to me, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: «N bara fure ragoro wo xa sansie ma, n bara e xara foye ra. Katoee bara wo xa laakɔɛ kana, a nun wo xa wɛni sansie, wo xa xɔrɛ sansie, nun wo xa oliwi sansie. Hali n to na birin naba, wo mu tuubi n bɛ.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: I have sent disease among you, as it was in Egypt: I have put your young men to the sword, and have taken away your horses; I have made the evil smell from your tents come up to your noses: and still you have not come back to me, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: «N bara fure ɲaaxie ragoro wo ma, alɔ n a rabaxi Misira bɔxi ma ki naxɛ. N bara wo xa sɛgɛtalae faxa santidɛgɛma ra, e bɔrɔ xiri naxa te wo ra. Wo yaxuie bara e xa soee tongo. Hali n to na birin naba, wo mu tuubi n bɛ.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And I have sent destruction among you, as when God sent destruction on Sodom and Gomorrah, and you were like a burning stick pulled out of the fire: and still you have not come back to me, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: «N bara wo ɲaxankata, alɔ n Sodoma nun Gomora ɲaxankataxi ki naxɛ. Wo luxi nɛ alɔ wuri naxan naminixi tɛ. Hali n to na birin naba, wo mu tuubi n bɛ.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: So this is what I will do to you, O Israel: and because I will do this to you, be ready for a meeting with your God, O Israel.
sentences.susu: «N fama i tan Isirayila ɲaxankatade na nan ma. N na yi raba i ra, i fama nɛ i Marigi Ala kolonde.»

sentences.english: For see, he who gave form to the mountains and made the wind, giving knowledge of his purpose to man, who makes the morning dark, and is walking on the high places of the earth: the Lord, the God of armies, is his name.
sentences.susu: Naxan geyae nun foye daaxi, naxan adama xa maɲɔxunyi birin kolon, naxan subaxɛ findima kɔɛ ra, naxan ɲɛrɛma yire itexi fari, a xili Mangɛ Alatala.

sentences.english: Give ear to this word, my song of sorrow over you, O children of Israel.
sentences.susu: Wo wo tuli mati yi masenyi ra. N bara yi bɛɛti ba Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ ɲɔn fe ma.

sentences.english: The virgin of Israel has been made low, never again to be lifted up: she is stretched out by herself on her land; there is no one to put her on her feet again.
sentences.susu: «Isirayila sɛniyɛntɔɛ bara faxa, a mu kelima sɔnɔn, a bara bira, mixi yo mu a rakelima.»

sentences.english: For these are the words of the Lord God: The town which was able to send out a thousand, will have only a hundred; and that which sent out a hundred, will have only ten, in Israel.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa a masen, «Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ, Taa naxan xɛmɛ wulu keren xɛɛma gere sode, a xɛmɛ kɛmɛ nan gbansan toma gbilen na. Taa naxan xɛmɛ kɛmɛ xɛɛma gere sode, a xɛmɛ fu nan gbansan toma gbilen na.»

sentences.english: For these are the words of the Lord to the children of Israel: Let your hearts be turned to me, so that you may have life:
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ bɛ, «Wo fa n fen alako wo xa kisi.

sentences.english: Do not be looking for help to Beth-el, and do not go to Gilgal, or make your way to Beer-sheba: for Gilgal will certainly be taken prisoner, and Beth-el will come to nothing.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa n fen Beteli, wo naxa siga Giligali, xa na mu a ra Beriseeba, barima Giligalika birin sigama nɛ konyiya kui, Beteli fan halakima nɛ.»

sentences.english: Go to the Lord for help so that you may have life; for fear that he may come like fire bursting out in the family of Joseph, causing destruction, and there will be no one to put it out in Beth-el.
sentences.susu: Wo Alatala fen alako wo xa kisi. Xa na mu a ra, Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ, Alatala wo sɔntɔma nɛ tɛ ra. Betelika yo mu na naxan na tɛ raxubenma.

sentences.english: You who make the work of judging a bitter thing, crushing down righteousness to the earth;
sentences.susu: Wo tan bara tinxinyi mafindi n naxɔnfe ra, wo bara yo sɛriyɛ ma.

sentences.english: Go for help to him who makes Orion and the Pleiades, by whom the deep dark is turned into morning, who makes the day black with night; whose voice goes out to the waters of the sea, sending them out over the face of the earth: the Lord is his name;
sentences.susu: Alatala nan tunbuie sa koore ma, a dimi iyalan subaxɛ ma, a soge radula, kɔɛ xa so, a ye tongo baa ma, a na findi tunɛ ra, a goro bɔxi ma. Naxan na birin nabama, a xili nɛ Alatala.

sentences.english: Who sends sudden destruction on the strong, so that destruction comes on the walled town.
sentences.susu: Alatala mixi xungbee halakima nɛ, a e xa yire makantaxie kana.

sentences.english: They have hate for him who makes protest against evil in the public place, and he whose words are upright is disgusting to them.
sentences.susu: E mixi xɔnma naxan kiiti sama sɛriyɛ ra, nɔndi falɛ mu rafan e ma.

sentences.english: So because the poor man is crushed under your feet, and you take taxes from him of grain: you have made for yourselves houses of cut stone, but you will not take your rest in them; the fair vine-gardens planted by your hands will not give you wine.
sentences.susu: Wo misikiinɛ tɔɔrɔma, wo baloe bama e yi ra duuti ra. Wo bara banxi tofanyie ti gɛmɛe ra, kɔnɔ wo mu fama sabatide nee kui. Wo bara wɛni sansi fanyie si, kɔnɔ wo mu fama na wɛni minde.

sentences.english: For I have seen how your evil-doing is increased and how strong are your sins, you troublers of the upright, who take rewards and do wrong to the cause of the poor in the public place.
sentences.susu: N a kolon wo xa haakɛ nun wo xa yunubi gbo. Wo tinxintɔɛ tɔɔrɔma, wo sɛriyɛ bɛɲinma kɔbiri xa fe ra, wo mu setaree makiitima nɔndi ra.

sentences.english: So the wise will say nothing in that time; for it is an evil time.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi xaxilima dunduma, barima yi waxati mu fan.

sentences.english: Go after good and not evil, so that life may be yours: and so the Lord, the God of armies, will be with you, as you say.
sentences.susu: Wo fe fanyi fen, wo wo yi ba fe ɲaaxi ra, alako wo xa kisi, Mangɛ Alatala xa lu wo sɛɛti ma, alɔ wo a falama ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Be haters of evil and lovers of good, and let right be done in the public place: it may be that the Lord, the God of armies, will have mercy on the rest of Joseph.
sentences.susu: Wo xa fe ɲaaxi xɔn. Fe fanyi xa rafan wo ma. Wo xa kiiti xa tinxin. Xa wo na raba, tɛmunde, Mangɛ Alatala kinikinima nɛ wo tan Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ dɔnxɔɛe ma.

sentences.english: So these are the words of the Lord, the God of armies, the Lord: There will be weeping in all the open spaces; and in all the streets they will say, Sorrow! sorrow! and they will get in the farmer to the weeping, and the makers of sad songs to give cries of grief.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi won Marigi Alatala, Duniɲa Daa Mangɛ naxa a masen, «E e wa xui itema nɛ taa kui, e e wa xui itema nɛ kira xɔn ma. E xɛ sa xilima nɛ e xa e wa xui ite ɲɔn fe ma, e bɛɛtibae xilima nɛ e xa faxɛ bɛɛti ba.

sentences.english: In all the vine-gardens there will be cries of grief: for I will go through among you, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N nɛ dangima xɛ ra tɛmui naxɛ, n wa xui nan tun mɛma.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Sorrow to you who are looking for the day of the Lord! what is the day of the Lord to you? it is dark and not light.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na mixi bɛ naxan wama Alatala xa kiiti lɔxɔɛ xa fa. Wo wama munse xɔn ma na lɔxɔɛ? Na findima dimi nan na wo bɛ, Na mu findima naiyalanyi xa ra.

sentences.english: As if a man, running away from a lion, came face to face with a bear; or went into the house and put his hand on the wall and got a bite from a snake.
sentences.susu: Na luma nɛ alɔ mixi naxan a gima yɛtɛ ya ra, a fa sɔɲɛ li. A na so banxi kui, a a kilɔn banxi ra, bɔximase fa a xin.

sentences.english: Will not the day of the Lord be dark and not light? even very dark, with no light shining in it?
sentences.susu: Alatala xa kiiti lɔxɔɛ mu findixi dimi xa ra? Naiyalanyi yo mu na wo bɛ na lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: Your feasts are disgusting to me, I will have nothing to do with them; I will take no delight in your holy meetings.
sentences.susu: «N bara wo xa sali xɔn, e mu rafan n ma fefe ma. N mu wama e xɔn feo.

sentences.english: Even if you give me your burned offerings and your meal offerings, I will not take pleasure in them: I will have nothing to do with the peace-offerings of your fat beasts.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi yo, wo xa farilɛ sɛrɛxɛ yo, wo xa xanunteya sɛrɛxɛ yo, e sese mu rafan n ma. N mu tinma e rasuxude, hali keren.

sentences.english: Take away from me the noise of your songs; my ears are shut to the melody of your instruments.
sentences.susu: Wo bɛɛti xui makuya n na. N mu wama wo xa kɔra bɛɛti xui ramɛfe.

sentences.english: But let the right go rolling on like waters, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream.
sentences.susu: N wama naxan xɔn, tinxintɔɛe xa gbo wo ya ma alɔ ye naxan na baa ma. Wo xa fe fanyi xa lu alɔ xure naxan mu xɔrima.

sentences.english: Did you come to me with offerings of beasts and meal offerings in the waste land for forty years, O Israel?
sentences.susu: Wo to nu na gbengberen yire ɲɛ tongo naani bun ma, wo sɛrɛxɛe ba nɛ? Ade.

sentences.english: Truly, you will take up Saccuth your king and Kaiwan your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.
sentences.susu: Wo kuye maxanin nɛ, alɔ wo xa mangɛ ala, naxan xili Sikoti, xa na mu a ra wo xa tunbui ala, naxan xili Kiyun, wo naxee yailanxi wo yɛtɛ ra? Ade.

sentences.english: And I will send you away as prisoners farther than Damascus, says the Lord, whose name is the God of armies.
sentences.susu: N fama nɛ wo xaninde konyiya kui Damasi xanbi ra.» Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Sorrow to those who are resting in comfort in Zion, and to those who have no fear of danger in the mountain of Samaria, the noted men of the chief of the nations, to whom the people of Israel come!
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na wo bɛ, wo tan naxee laxi wo yɛtɛ ra Siyoni nun Samari geyae fari, Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ a xaxili tima wo tan naxee ra.

sentences.english: Go on to Calneh and see; and from there go to Hamath the great; then go down to Gath of the Philistines: are you better than these kingdoms? or is your land wider than theirs?
sentences.susu: Wo sa Kalene mato, a nun Xamata, na taa xungbee. Wo man xa goro Filisita bɔxi ma Gati matode. Nee fisa wo bɛ? E xa bɔxi gbo wo gbe bɛ?

sentences.english: You who put far away the evil day, causing the rule of the violent to come near;
sentences.susu: Wo a maɲɔxunxi nɛ a ɲaxankatɛ lɔxɔɛ mu wo lima, kɔnɔ wo a niyama nɛ fe ɲaaxi xa wo sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Who are resting on beds of ivory, stretched out on soft seats, feasting on lambs from the flock and young oxen from the cattle-house;
sentences.susu: Wo wo malabuma sade tofanyi ma, wo yɛxɛɛ nun ninge fanyi donma,

sentences.english: Making foolish songs to the sound of corded instruments, and designing for themselves instruments of music, like David;
sentences.susu: wo sigi sa kɔra ra. Wo ɲɔxɔ a ma a wo fata na rabade alɔ Annabi Dawuda.

sentences.english: Drinking wine in basins, rubbing themselves with the best oils; but they have no grief for the destruction of Joseph.
sentences.susu: Wo wɛni gbegbe minma, wo ture fanyi maso wo fate ma. Na kui, wo mu kɔntɔfilima Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ xa ɲaxankatɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: So now they will go away prisoners with the first of those who are made prisoners, and the loud cry of those who were stretched out will come to an end.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, wo singe sigama konyiya kui. Wo xa xulunyie danma nɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord God has taken an oath by himself, says the Lord, the God of armies: the pride of Jacob is disgusting to me, and I have hate for his great houses: so I will give up the town with everything in it.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala bara a kali a yɛtɛ ra. Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «N Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ xa yɛtɛ igboɲa xɔnxi. E xa yire makantaxie mu rafan n ma. N fama nɛ e birin halakide.»

sentences.english: Then it will come about that if there are still ten men in a house, death will overtake them.
sentences.susu: Xa xɛmɛ fu na banxi nde kui, e birin fama nɛ faxade.

sentences.english: And when a man's relation, even the one who is responsible for burning his body, lifting him up to take his bones out of the house, says to him who is in the inmost part of the house, Is there still anyone with you? and he says, No; then he will say, Keep quiet, for the name of the Lord may not be named.
sentences.susu: E barenyi na so na banxi kui e furee tongode, a xa e gan, a fama nɛ mixi maxɔrinde naxan nɔxunxi banxi kui, «Mixi gbɛtɛ na be bafe i tan na?» A a yaabima nɛ, «Ade.» A man gbilenma nɛ a fala ra, «I sabari, a mu lanma Alatala xili xa fala,

sentences.english: For see, at the order of the Lord the great house will be full of cracks and the little house will be broken.
sentences.susu: barima Alatala nan yaamari fima a banxi xungbe yo, banxi lanma yo, e birin xa rabira, e xa kana.»

sentences.english: Is it possible for horses to go running on the rock? may the sea be ploughed with oxen? for the right to be turned by you into poison, and the fruit of righteousness into a bitter plant?
sentences.susu: Soee nɔma e gide gɛmɛ yire? Ningee nɔma mɛnni buxade? Awa, munfe ra wo tinxinyi mafindima tinxintareya ra, wo sɛriyɛ mafindi fe ɲaaxi ra?

sentences.english: You whose joy is in a thing of no value, who say, Have we not taken for ourselves horns by the strength which is ours?
sentences.susu: Wo sɛɛwama fe fufafu ra. Wo naxɛ a wo xa fe bara sɔɔnɛya wo yɛtɛ sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: For see, I will send against you a nation, O Israel, says the Lord, the God of armies, ruling you cruelly from the way into Hamath as far as the stream of the Arabah.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Na nan a toxi, n fama kelide wo xili ma, Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ. Wo tan naxee na Xamata han Araba xure, si nde fama nɛ wo tɔɔrɔde.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord God let me see: and I saw that, when the growth of the late grass was starting, he made locusts; it was the late growth after the king's cutting was done.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa yi laamatunyi masen n bɛ: Xɛ to xaba, mangɛ xa sansi nɛɛnɛ fan nu na minife, Alatala naxa katoe ramini.

sentences.english: And it came about that after they had taken all the grass of the land, I said, O Lord God, have mercy: how will Jacob be able to keep his place? for he is small.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ sansi birin donde bɔxi ma, n naxa a fala, «Marigi Alatala, n bara i mayandi, i xa e xa yunubi xafari, xa na mu a ra Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ fa baloma di? A sɛnbɛ mu gbo.»

sentences.english: The Lord, changing his purpose about this, said, It will not be.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa kinikini e ma, a fa a masen, «Awa, yi mu rabama kɔrɛ.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: This is what the Lord let me see: and I saw that the Lord God sent for a great fire to be the instrument of his punishment; and, after burning up the great deep, it was about to put an end to the Lord's heritage.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa yi laamatunyi masen n bɛ: Marigi Alatala naxa a ɲanige tɛ xa dɛxɛ. Tɛ naxa bɔxi birin gan, bɔxi ye birin naxa xara.

sentences.english: Then said I, O Lord God, let there be an end: how will Jacob be able to keep his place? for he is small.
sentences.susu: N naxa a fala, «Marigi Alatala, n bara i mayandi, dan mɛnni, xa na mu a ra Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ fa baloma di? A sɛnbɛ mu gbo.»

sentences.english: The Lord, changing his purpose about this, said, And this will not be.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa kinikini e ma, a fa a fala, «Awa, yi mu rabama kɔrɛ.» Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: This is what he let me see: and I saw the Lord stationed by a wall made straight by a weighted line, and he had a weighted line in his hand.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa yi laamatunyi masen n bɛ: Marigi nu tixi bilixi tinxinxi fari, biriki matinxin se nu suxuxi a yi ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to me, Amos, what do you see? And I said, A weighted line. Then the Lord said, See, I will let down a weighted line among my people Israel; never again will my eyes be shut to their sin:
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa n maxɔrin, «Amosi, i munse toxi?» N naxa a yaabi, «Biriki matinxin se.» Marigi naxa a masen, «N wama n ma ɲama xa matinxin. N mu diɲɛma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And the high places of Isaac will be unpeopled, and the holy places of Israel will be made waste; and I will come up against the family of Jeroboam with the sword.
sentences.susu: Kuye batudee kanama nɛ Isiyaga xa bɔxi ma. Isirayila xa salidee rabirama nɛ. N kelima nɛ Yerobowami bɔnsɔɛ xili ma santidɛgɛma ra.»

sentences.english: Then Amaziah, the priest of Beth-el, sent to Jeroboam, king of Israel, saying, Amos has made designs against you among the people of Israel: the land is troubled by his words.
sentences.susu: Beteli sɛrɛxɛdubɛ Amasiya, naxa a masen Isirayila mangɛ Yerobowami bɛ, «Amosi na i yanfafe Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ ya ma. A naxan falama a mu fan bɔxi bɛ.

sentences.english: For Amos has said, Jeroboam will be put to the sword, and Israel will certainly be taken away as a prisoner out of his land.
sentences.susu: Amosi naxɛ, ‹Yerobowami fama nɛ faxade santidɛgɛma ra. Isirayila sigama nɛ konyiya kui ɲamanɛ ma.›»

sentences.english: And Amaziah said to Amos, O seer, go in flight into the land of Judah, and there get your living by working as a prophet:
sentences.susu: Amasiya naxa a fala Amosi bɛ, «I tan naxan laamatunyi toma, keli be i siga Yudaya. I xa sa i baloe fen mɛnni namiɲɔnmɛ wali kui,

sentences.english: But be a prophet no longer at Beth-el: for it is the holy place of the king, and the king's house.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ i naxa namiɲɔnmɛ masenyi ti Beteli de, barima mangɛ xa salide na mɛnni nɛ, a xa mangataa nan naa ra.»

sentences.english: Then Amos in answer said to Amaziah, I am no prophet, or one of the sons of the prophets; I am a herdman and one who takes care of sycamore-trees:
sentences.susu: Amosi naxa Amasiya yaabi, «Namiɲɔnmɛ mu na n na. N baba fan namiɲɔnmɛ mu a ra. Xuruse kanyi nan n na. N sikomoro sansi fan nawalima.

sentences.english: And the Lord took me from the flock, and the Lord said to me, Go, be a prophet to my people Israel.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa n xili xurusee tagi, a fa a masen n bɛ, ‹Siga, i sa namiɲɔnmɛ masenyi ti n ma ɲama Isirayila bɛ.›

sentences.english: Now then, give ear to the word of the Lord: You say, Be no prophet to Israel, and say not a word against the people of Isaac.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, i tuli mati Alatala xa masenyi ra, i tan naxan a falama n bɛ, ‹I naxa namiɲɔnmɛ masenyi ti Isirayila bɛ, i naxa wɔyɛn Isiyaga bɔnsɔɛ bɛ.›

sentences.english: So this is what the Lord has said: Your wife will be a loose woman in the town, and your sons and your daughters will be put to the sword, and your land will be cut up into parts by a line; and you yourself will come to your end in an unclean land, and Israel will certainly be taken away a prisoner out of his land.
sentences.susu: Na wɔyɛnyi ma, Alatala naxɛ, ‹I xa ginɛ findima nɛ langoe ra taa kui. I xa die faxama nɛ santidɛgɛma ra. I xa bɔxi bama nɛ i yi ra, a itaxun mixi gbɛtɛe ma. I tan, i faxama nɛ bɔxi sɛniyɛntare ma. Isirayila fan xaninma nɛ yire, naxan makuya a xa bɔxi ra.›»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord God let me see: and I saw a basket of summer fruit.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala naxa yi laamatunyi masen n bɛ: Debe nan nu a ra naxan nafexi sansi bogi mɔxi ra.

sentences.english: And he said, Amos, what do you see? And I said, A basket of summer fruit. Then the Lord said to me, The end has come to my people Israel; never again will my eyes be shut to their sin.
sentences.susu: A naxa n maxɔrin, «Amosi, i munse toxi be?» N naxa a yaabi, «Debe rafexi sansi bogi mɔxi ra.» Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, «N ma ɲama Isirayila fan bara mɔ. N mu diɲɛma sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: And the songs of the king's house will be cries of pain in that day, says the Lord God: great will be the number of the dead bodies, and everywhere they will put them out without a word.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Na lɔxɔɛe sigi naxan sama mangɛ xa banxi kui, na masarama nɛ wa xui ra. Furee ralantanma nɛ yire birin, birin dunduma nɛ na lɔxɔɛ.»

sentences.english: Give ear to this, you who are crushing the poor, and whose purpose is to put an end to those who are in need in the land,
sentences.susu: Wo wo tuli mati yi masenyi ra, wo tan naxee setare tɔɔrɔma, wo tan naxee tɔɔrɔmixi ɲaxankatama.

sentences.english: Saying, When will the new moon be gone, so that we may do trade in grain? and the Sabbath, so that we may put out in the market the produce of our fields? making the measure small and the price great, and trading falsely with scales of deceit;
sentences.susu: Wo naxɛ, «Kike nɛɛnɛ sali ɲɔnma mun tɛmui, alako won xa sare mati? Malabui lɔxɔɛ ɲɔnma mun tɛmui, alako won xa maale mati? Won xa nde ba won ma se maniya see ra, won xa nde sa won ma saresoe xun ma. Won xa sikeeli kamalitare yailan.

sentences.english: Getting the poor for silver, and him who is in need for the price of two shoes, and taking a price for the waste parts of the grain.
sentences.susu: Won xa misikiinɛ mati kɔbiri ra, won setare mati sankiri sare ra. Won xa maale xɔri mati a lagi ra a xun ma.»

sentences.english: The Lord has taken an oath by the pride of Jacob, Truly I will ever keep in mind all their works.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a kali a yɛtɛ ra, Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ a yɛtɛ igboma Ala naxan na: «N mu nɛɛmuma e raba fee ma, han duniɲa ɲɔn.

sentences.english: Will not the land be shaking with fear because of this, and everyone in it have sorrow? and all of it will be overflowing like the River; and it will be troubled and go down again like the River of Egypt.
sentences.susu: Yi bɔxi fama kanade na nan ma. Bekae birin luma sunnunyi nan kui. Bɔxi sɛrɛnma nɛ alɔ Misira xure, naxan banbaranma, a man gbilen.»

sentences.english: And it will come about in that day, says the Lord God, that I will make the sun go down in the middle of the day, and I will make the earth dark in daylight:
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «N fama nɛ a ragiride na lɔxɔɛ, soge goro a goro tɛmui mu a lixi, dimi sin bɔxi ma yanyi ra.

sentences.english: Your feasts will be turned into sorrow and all your melody into songs of grief; everyone will be clothed with haircloth, and the hair of every head will be cut; I will make the weeping like that for an only son, and the end of it like a bitter day.
sentences.susu: Wo xa salie masarama ɲɔn soe nan na, wo xa sigie masarama wa xui nan na. N sunnun donma ragoroma nɛ wo ma, n wo xunyi bi sunnun fe ma. N fama nɛ sunnunyi xungbe ragorode bɔxi ma, alɔ di kerenyi na faxa. Na xɔnɛ mu bama wo ma abadan.»

sentences.english: See, the days are coming, says the Lord God, when I will send times of great need on the land, not need of food or desire for water, but for hearing the words of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Na lɔxɔɛe kaamɛ sinma nɛ bɔxi ma, kɔnɔ donyi kaamɛ mu a ra, ye xɔli fan mu a ra. Wo kaamɛma Alatala xa masenyi nan ma fe ra.

sentences.english: And they will go wandering from sea to sea, and from the north even to the east, running here and there in search of the word of the Lord, and they will not get it.
sentences.susu: Wo bɔxi birin igirima nɛ, kelife kɔɔla ma han sogetede, Alatala xa masenyi fende, kɔnɔ wo mu a toma.

sentences.english: In that day the fair virgins and the young men will be feeble from need of water.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ wo xa ginɛdimɛdie nun wo xa sɛgɛtalae faxama nɛ na kaamɛ ma.

sentences.english: Those who make their oaths by the sin of Samaria and say, By the life of your God, O Dan; and, By the living way of Beer-sheba; even they will go down, never again to be lifted up.
sentences.susu: Singe, e nu e kalima Samari xa ala wule daaxi nan na. E nu a fala, ‹N bara n kali Dana xa ala ra.› ‹N bara n kali Beriseeba xa ala ra.› Kɔnɔ e fama nɛ birade, e mu kelima abadan.»

sentences.english: I saw the Lord stationed by the side of the altar, giving blows to the tops of the pillars so that the doorsteps were shaking: and he said, I will let all of them be broken with earth-shocks; I will put the last of them to the sword: if any one of them goes in flight he will not get away, not one of them will be safe.
sentences.susu: N naxa laamatunyi nde to, Marigi nu na sɛrɛxɛbade fari. A naxa a yamari, «Salide xunyi rabira, salide sanyi itala. A birin xa bira mixie xun ma. N e xa die halakima nɛ santidɛgɛma ra. Mixi keren mu kisima. Mixi keren mu a nɔxunma n ma.

sentences.english: Even if they go deep into the underworld, my hand will take them up from there; if they go up to heaven, I will get them down:
sentences.susu: Hali e goro aligiyama, n nee suxuma nɛ. Xa e te koore ma, n nee ragoroma nɛ.

sentences.english: Though they take cover on the top of Carmel, I will go in search of them and get them out; though they keep themselves from my eyes in the bed of the sea, I will give orders to the great snake there and he will give them a bite:
sentences.susu: Xa e e nɔxun n ma Karemele geya fari, n e fenma nɛ, n e suxu. Xa e e nɔxun n ma baa bun ma, n bɔximasee yamarima nɛ a xa e xin.

sentences.english: And though they are taken away as prisoners by their attackers, even there will I give orders to the sword to put them to death: my eyes will be fixed on them for evil and not for good.
sentences.susu: Xa e yaxuie e xanin konyiya kui, n yaamari fima nɛ e xa e faxa santidɛgɛma ra. N nan n ya tima nɛ e ra, kɔnɔ na mu findima munafanyi ra e bɛ, a findima ɲaxankatɛ nan na e bɛ.»

sentences.english: For the Lord, the God of armies, is he at whose touch the land is turned to water, and everyone in it will be given up to sorrow; all of it will be overflowing like the River, and will go down again like the River of Egypt;
sentences.susu: Marigi Alatala, naxan na Mangɛ ra, xa a a ɲanige a xa din bɔxi ra, bɔxi sɛrɛnma nɛ, mixi birin lu sunnunyi kui, a itema nɛ, a man a igoro alɔ Misira xure Nili na banbaran ɲɛ.

sentences.english: It is he who makes his rooms in the heaven, basing his arch on the earth; whose voice goes out to the waters of the sea, and sends them flowing over the face of the earth; the Lord is his name.
sentences.susu: A bara a xa lingira ti koore ma. A bara koore walaxɛ lu bɔxi xun ma. A ye rakelima baa ma, a radin bɔxi ma. A xili nɛ Alatala.

sentences.english: Are you not as the children of the Ethiopians to me, O children of Israel? says the Lord. Have I not taken Israel up out of the land of Egypt, and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Aramaeans from Kir?
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Isirayilakae, wo tide mu gbo n bɛ alɔ Etiyopikae? N mu wo ramini xɛ Misira bɔxi ra, alɔ n Filisitakae ramini Kafatoro ki naxɛ? N mu wo ramini xɛ Misira bɔxi ra, alɔ n Siriyakae ramini Kiro ki naxɛ?

sentences.english: See, the eyes of the Lord are on the evil kingdom, and I will put an end to it in all the earth; but I will not send complete destruction on Jacob, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo wo yae rabi: Marigi Alatala bara yunubitɔɛe xa mangɛya to, a fama nɛ na halakide yi duniɲɛ bɛndɛ fuɲi fari.»

sentences.english: For see, I will give orders, and I will have Israel moved about among all the nations, as grain is moved about by the shaking of the tray, but not the smallest seed will be dropped on the earth.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Kɔnɔ n mu Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ birin halakima. N yaamari fima nɛ alako Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ xa mayegeti. N a ifema nɛ alɔ maale ifema ki naxɛ, alako xɔri fanyi keren naxa bira.

sentences.english: All those sinners among my people will be put to the sword who say, Evil will not overtake us or come face to face with us.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yunubitɔɛe naxee birin na n ma ɲama ya ma, n e faxama nɛ santidɛgɛma ra, e tan naxee a falama, ‹I mu fama muxu ɲaxankatade, na ɲaxankatɛ mu muxu lima.›»

sentences.english: In that day I will put up the tent of David which has come down, and make good its broken places; and I will put up again his damaged walls, building it up as in the past;
sentences.susu: «Na lɔxɔɛ n Dawuda xa mangɛya kanaxi itema nɛ. N fama nɛ na yailande, n fama nɛ a rakelide alɔ a singe.

sentences.english: So that the rest of Edom may be their heritage, and all the nations who have been named by my name, says the Lord, who is doing this.
sentences.susu: E man Edon masɔtɔma nɛ, a nun si birin n xili saxi naxee xun ma.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki, a fama nɛ na birin nakamalide.

sentences.english: See, the days will come, says the Lord, when the ploughman will overtake him who is cutting the grain, and the crusher of the grapes him who is planting seed; and sweet wine will be dropping from the mountains, and the hills will be turned into streams of wine.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Wo wo yae rabi: Lɔxɔɛe fama a lide, xɛ sae nun xɛ xabae walima waxati keren nɛ. Wɛni bae nun xɛ sae, fan walima waxati keren nɛ. Wɛni gboma nɛ geyae fari, han geyae birin bunda.

sentences.english: And I will let the fate of my people Israel be changed, and they will be building up again the waste towns and living in them; they will again be planting vine-gardens and taking the wine for their drink; and they will make gardens and get the fruit of them.
sentences.susu: N nan n ma ɲama ragbilenma nɛ a xɔnyi kelife ra konyiya kui. E fama nɛ taa kanaxie tide, e sabatima dɛnnaxɛ. E wɛni bilie sima nɛ, e a wɛni min. E laakɔɛ sama nɛ, e a bogi don.

sentences.english: And I will have them planted in their land, and never again will they be uprooted from their land which I have given them, says the Lord your God.
sentences.susu: N man e rasabatima nɛ e xa bɔxi ma. E mu kelima bɔxi ma sɔnɔn n dɛnnaxɛ fixi e ma.» Wo Marigi Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: The vision of Obadiah. This is what the Lord has said about Edom: We have had word from the Lord, and a representative has been sent among the nations, saying, Up! and let us make war against her.
sentences.susu: Annabi Abadiyasi xa laamatunyi nan ya. Marigi Alatala xa masenyi Edon ɲama xa fe ra. Muxu bara xibaaru nde mɛ kelife Alatala ma. Mixi nde xɛɛxi ɲamanɛe ma yi yaamari ra: «Wo keli! Won xa siga Edon gerede!»

sentences.english: See, I have made you small among the nations: you are much looked down on.
sentences.susu: «N i magoroma nɛ sie tagi, i fa lu yaagi kui.

sentences.english: You have been tricked by the pride of your heart, O you whose living-place is in the cracks of the rock, whose house is high up; who has said in his heart, Who will make me come down to earth?
sentences.susu: I xa yɛtɛ igboya bara i madaxu, i tan naxan sabatixi fɔnmɛe ra geyae kɔn na. I a falama, ‹Nde nɔma n nagorode lanbanyi?›

sentences.english: Though you go up on high like an eagle, though your house is placed among the stars, I will make you come down from there, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Hali i te koore ma alɔ sɛgɛ, i sa i tɛɛ sa tunbuie ya ma, n tan i ragoroma nɛ han bɔxi.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: If thieves came, attacking you by night, (how are you cut off!) would they not go on taking till they had enough? if men came cutting your grapes would they take them all?
sentences.susu: «Xa muɲɛtie soma i xɔnyi kɔɛ ra, e mu e waxɔnse tongoma xɛ e hayi na naxan ma? Xa sansi xabɛe fama i xɔnyi, e mu tɔnsɔɛ ndee luma xɛ naa?

sentences.english: How are the things of Esau searched out! how are his secret stores looked for!
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Esayu bɔnsɔɛ tan, e harige birin bama nɛ e yi, e xa naafuli nɔxunxi tongoma nɛ.

sentences.english: All the men who were united with you have been false to you, driving you out to the edge of the land: the men who were at peace with you have overcome you; they have taken their heritage in your place.
sentences.susu: Wo saata tongo booree wo kerima nɛ wo xa bɔxi ma. Wo mali booree wo yanfama nɛ, wo nun naxee nu wo dɛgema lenge keren kui, nee gantanyi tema nɛ wo ya ra.»

sentences.english: Will I not, in that day, says the Lord, take away the wise men out of Edom, and wisdom out of the mountain of Esau?
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «N lɔnnilae sɔntɔma nɛ Edon bɔxi ma na lɔxɔɛ, n xaxilimae faxama nɛ Edon benba Esayu xa geyae fari.

sentences.english: And your men of war, O Teman, will be overcome with fear, so that every one of them may be cut off from the mountain of Esau.
sentences.susu: E benba Teman xa sɔɔrie gaaxuma nɛ, e birin fa sɔntɔ Esayu xa geya longori.

sentences.english: Because you were the cause of violent death and because of your cruel behaviour to your brother Jacob, you will be covered with shame and will be cut off for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo na gbaloe sɔtɔma nɛ wo xa fe ɲaaxi ma wo naxan nabaxi wo ngaxakerenyi Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ ra. Yaagi dusuma nɛ wo xun na, wo fa ɲɔn abadan.

sentences.english: Because you were there watching when men from other lands took away his goods, and strange men came into his doors, and put the fate of Jerusalem to the decision of chance; you were like one of them.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ e yaxuie to e xa bannaya xanin, e na raba nɛ wo ya xɔri. E to so e xa taa kui, e xa Darisalamu findi e gbe ra, wo nu saxi e yaxuie dɛ ra.

sentences.english: Do not see with pleasure your brother's evil day, the day of his fate, and do not be glad over the children of Judah on the day of their destruction, or make wide your mouth on the day of trouble.
sentences.susu: Wo mu lan wo xa ɲɛlɛxin wo ngaxakerenyie xa tɔɔrɛ ra. Wo mu lan wo xa sɛɛwa Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xa gbaloe ra. Wo mu lan wo xa wo yɛtɛ igbo e xa tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: Do not go into the doors of my people on the day of their downfall; do not be looking on their trouble with pleasure on the day of their downfall, or put your hands on their goods on the day of their downfall.
sentences.susu: Wo mu lan wo xa so n ma ɲama xa taa kui a kasarɛ lɔxɔɛ. Wo mu lan wo xa yo e ma e kasarɛ lɔxɔɛ. Wo mu lan wo xa e harige ba e yi e kasarɛ lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: And do not take your place at the cross-roads, cutting off those of his people who get away; and do not give up to their haters those who are still there in the day of trouble.
sentences.susu: Wo mu lan wo xa wo nɔxun kira dɛ ra e xa mixie faxafe ra naxee e gixi gere ma. Wo mu lan wo xa e sa e yaxuie sagoe e xa kasarɛ lɔxɔɛ.»

sentences.english: For the day of the Lord is coming quickly on all nations: as you have done it will be done to you; the reward of your acts will come on your head.
sentences.susu: «Alatala xa kiiti lɔxɔɛ na fafe si birin bɛ. I naxan naba, na nan nabama i fan na. I xa wali sare gbilenma nɛ i ma.

sentences.english: For as you have been drinking on my holy mountain, so will all the nations go on drinking without end; they will go on drinking and the wine will go down their throats, and they will be as if they had never been.
sentences.susu: Wo n ma xɔnɛ naxan sɔtɔxi n ma geya sɛniyɛnxi fari, sie fan fama nɛ na mɔɔli sɔtɔde han e bɔnsɔɛ ɲɔn.

sentences.english: But in Mount Zion some will be kept safe, and it will be holy; and the children of Jacob will take their heritage.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi fama kisi sɔtɔde Siyoni geya fari. Mɛnni findima yire sɛniyɛnxi nan na. Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ fama nɛ a kɛ masɔtɔde.

sentences.english: And the children of Jacob will be a fire and those of Joseph a flame, and the children of Esau dry stems of grass, burned up by them till all is gone: and there will be no people living in Esau; for the Lord has said it.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ nun Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ luma nɛ alɔ tɛ, naxan Esayu bɔnsɔɛ ganma alɔ sɛxɛ. Mixi yo mu kisima Esayu bɔnsɔɛ ya ma.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And they will take the South, and the lowland, and the country of Ephraim, and Gilead, as their heritage.
sentences.susu: «Negewikae Esayu xa geyae suxuma nɛ, Sefelakae Filisitakae xa bɔxi tongoma nɛ, a nun Efirami nun Samari bɔxie. Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ fan Galadi bɔxi sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: And those of the children of Israel who were the first to be taken away as prisoners, will have their heritage among the Canaanites as far as Zarephath; and those who were taken away from Jerusalem, who are in Sepharad, will have the towns of the South.
sentences.susu: Yi Isirayilaka naxee gbilen e fama nɛ nɔde Kanaan bɔxi ra han Sarepeta. Darisalamukae naxee gbilen Sefarada, nee fama nɛ Negewi taae suxude.

sentences.english: And those who have been kept safe will come up from Mount Zion to be judges of the mountain of Esau; and the kingdom will be the Lord's.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee geenima nu fama nɛ tede Siyoni geya fari, e xa Esayu xa geyae yamari. Mangɛya luma Alatala nan bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to Jonah, the son of Amittai, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen Amitayi xa di Yunusa bɛ,

sentences.english: Up! go to Nineveh, that great town, and let your voice come to it; for their evil-doing has come up before me.
sentences.susu: «Keli, i siga taa xungbe naxan xili Ninewe, i xa n ma natɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ masen e bɛ naxan fatanxi e xa fe ɲaaxie ra n naxee toxi n na dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: And Jonah got up to go in flight to Tarshish, away from the Lord; and he went down to Joppa, and saw there a ship going to Tarshish: so he gave them the price of the journey and went down into it to go with them to Tarshish, away from the Lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Annabi Yunusa to wa a gife Ala xa xɛɛraya ma, a naxa natɛ tongo a xa siga Tarasisi. A naxa goro Yafa wafu ra, a kunkui to naxan nu sigafe Tarasisi. A naxa kunkui masundi fi, a baki kunkui kui mixie xun ma sigafe ra Tarasisi, alako a xa a makuya Alatala ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord sent out a great wind on to the sea and there was a violent storm in the sea, so that the ship seemed in danger of being broken.
sentences.susu: Na kui Alatala naxa foye xungbe ramini baa ma, a findi turunnaadɛ ra, a kunkui imaxa han a wa a kanafe.

sentences.english: Then the sailors were full of fear, every man crying to his god; and the goods in the ship were dropped out into the sea to make the weight less. But Jonah had gone down into the inmost part of the ship where he was stretched out in a deep sleep.
sentences.susu: Kunkuimae naxa gaaxu, kankan naxa a dɛ rawa a xa ala bɛ. E naxa nde ba kunkui xa kote ra, e a woli baa ma alako nde xa ba a binyɛ ra. Yunusa naxa goro kunkui bɔtini ma, a a sa mɛnni, a xi paxi.

sentences.english: And the ship's captain came to him and said to him, What are you doing sleeping? Up! say a prayer to your God, if by chance God will give a thought to us, so that we may not come to destruction.
sentences.susu: Kunkui kɛpini naxa siga a yire, a a fala a bɛ, «I tan na xife nɛ? Keli, i xa i xa ala maxandi. Tɛmunde a nɔma nɛ kinikinide won ma, a won natanga yi gbaloe ma.»

sentences.english: And they said to one another, Come, let us put this to the decision of chance and see on whose account this evil has come on us. So they did so, and Jonah was seen to be the man.
sentences.susu: Kunkuimae naxa a fala e booree bɛ, «Won xa kanda bun alako won xa a kolon, naxan yi gbaloe bɛndunxi won ma.» E to na raba, a naxa ilan Yunusa ra.

sentences.english: Then they said to him, Now make clear to us what is your work, and where you come from? what is your country, and who are your people?
sentences.susu: E naxa a maxɔrin, «Nde yi gbaloe bɛndunxi muxu ma? I munse wali rabama? I kelixi minden? Si mundun na i ra?»

sentences.english: And he said to them, I am a Hebrew, a worshipper of the Lord, the God of heaven, who made the sea and the dry land.
sentences.susu: Annabi Yunusa naxa e yaabi, «Eburu nan n na. N Alatala nan batuma, Ala naxan na koore ma, naxan baa nun bɔxi daa.»

sentences.english: And the men were in great fear, and they said to him, What is this you have done? For the men had knowledge of his flight from the Lord because he had not kept it from them.
sentences.susu: Na kui kunkuimae naxa gaaxu ki fanyi ra, e a fala a bɛ, «I yi rabaxi munfe ra?» A naxa a fala e bɛ a nu a gife Alatala nan ma.

sentences.english: And they said to him, What are we to do to you so that the sea may become calm for us? For the sea was getting rougher and rougher.
sentences.susu: Baa xa xaaɲɛ to nu gboma nan tun, e naxa a maxɔrin, «Muxu xa munse raba i ra, alako baa xa a raxara muxu bɛ?»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Take me up and put me into the sea, and the sea will become calm for you: for I am certain that because of me this great storm has come on you.
sentences.susu: Annabi Yunusa naxa e yaabi, «N a kolon a yi turunnaadɛ xungbe xun tixi wo ra n tan nan ma fe ra. Wo xa n woli baa ma. Na kui a raxarama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And the men were working hard to get back to the land, but they were not able to do so: for the sea got rougher and rougher against them.
sentences.susu: Kunkuimae naxa kata laala bade e xa xare masɔtɔ, kɔnɔ na mu sɔɔnɛya. Baa nu sigama xaaɲɛ ra nan tun e xili ma.

sentences.english: So, crying to the Lord, they said, Give ear to our prayer, O Lord, give ear, and do not let destruction overtake us because of this man's life; do not put on us the sin of taking life without cause: for you, O Lord, have done what seemed good to you.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui e naxa Alatala maxandi, «Alatala, muxu bara i maxandi i xa muxu ratanga yi xɛmɛ xa faxɛ ma. Mixi fanyi nii bafe kote naxa dɔxɔ muxu xun ma, barima i tan Alatala na i waxɔnfe nan tun nabafe yi ki.»

sentences.english: So they took Jonah up and put him into the sea: and the sea was no longer angry.
sentences.susu: Na fala xanbi, e naxa Yunusa tongo fa, e a woli baa ma. Baa xa xaaɲɛ naxa dan.

sentences.english: Then great was the men's fear of the Lord; and they made an offering to the Lord and took oaths to him.
sentences.susu: Na fe naxa na mixie ragaaxu Alatala ya ra ki fanyi ra. E naxa sɛrɛxɛ ba Alatala bɛ, e kɛrɛ tongo a bɛ.

sentences.english: Then Jonah made prayer to the Lord his God from the inside of the fish, and said,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yɛxɛ xungbe nde yamari baa ma a xa Yunusa gerun. Yunusa naxa lu yɛxɛ furi kui fɛɛɲɛn saxan, kɔɛ saxan.

sentences.english: In my trouble I was crying to the Lord, and he gave me an answer; out of the deepest underworld I sent up a cry, and you gave ear to my voice.
sentences.susu: A naxa a Marigi Alatala maxandi yɛxɛ furi kui yi ki:

sentences.english: For you have put me down into the deep, into the heart of the sea; and the river was round about me; all your waves and your rolling waters went over me.
sentences.susu: «Alatala, n to n xui rate i ma n ma bɔɲɛ mini kui, i bara n yaabi. N to i xili kelife aligiyama, i bara n xui mɛ.

sentences.english: And I said, I have been sent away from before your eyes; how may I ever again see your holy Temple?
sentences.susu: I to n woli baa bɔtini ma, ye bara n makoto, i nu fa i xa mɔrɔnyie radin n ma.

sentences.english: The waters were circling round me, even to the neck; the deep was about me; the sea-grass was twisted round my head.
sentences.susu: N naxa a maɲɔxun i bara n keri, kɔnɔ n a kolon n man fama nɛ i xa banxi sɛniyɛnxi tode.

sentences.english: I went down to the bases of the mountains; as for the earth, her walls were about me for ever: but you have taken up my life from the underworld, O Lord my God.
sentences.susu: N naxa madula ye xɔɔra, baa naxa nɔ n na. Baa ɲooge naxa filin filin n kɔnyi ma.

sentences.english: When my soul in me was overcome, I kept the memory of the Lord: and my prayer came in to you, into your holy Temple.
sentences.susu: N goro nɛ baa bɔtini ma han geyae fɔlɔde. N nu na geeli aligiyama, kɔnɔ i tan Marigi Alatala, i naxa n namini na yili tilinxi kui n ɲiɲɛ ra.

sentences.english: The worshippers of false gods have given up their only hope.
sentences.susu: N nii to nu na bafe n fate i, n naxa n maɲɔxun Alatala ma. N ma maxandi naxa siga han a sa i li, i xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi sɛniyɛnxi.

sentences.english: But I will make an offering to you with the voice of praise; I will give effect to my oaths. Salvation is the Lord's.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee e nii taxu kuye sɛnbɛtare ra, nee e yɛtɛ raganma hinnɛ fanyi nan na.

sentences.english: And at the Lord's order, the fish sent Jonah out of its mouth on to the dry land.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n tan tantui bɛɛti nan bama i bɛ sɛrɛxɛ ra, n na n ma kɛrɛ tongoxi rakamalima nɛ. Kisi fatanxi Alatala nan na.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to Jonah a second time, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa gbilen masenyi ti ra Yunusa bɛ, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Up! go to Nineveh, that great town, and give it the word which I have given you.
sentences.susu: «Keli, i siga yi taa xungbe naxan xili Ninewe. I xa sa n ma xɛɛra iba e bɛ, n i tixi naxan na.»

sentences.english: So Jonah got up and went to Nineveh as the Lord had said. Now Nineveh was a very great town, three days' journey from end to end.
sentences.susu: Annabi Yunusa naxa keli a siga Ninewe, alɔ Alatala a masen a bɛ ki naxɛ. Taa nan nu Ninewe ra naxan xungbo ki fanyi ra xi saxan ɲɛrɛ rabama dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And Jonah first of all went a day's journey into the town, and crying out said, In forty days destruction will overtake Nineveh.
sentences.susu: Annabi Yunusa to fɛɛɲɛn keren ɲɛrɛ raba taa kui, a naxa yi masenyi ti fɔlɔ, «Xi tongo naani nan luxi, Ninewe taa xa kana.»

sentences.english: And the people of Nineveh had belief in God; and a time was fixed for going without food, and they put on haircloth, from the greatest to the least.
sentences.susu: Ninewekae naxa la Ala ra, e birin fa sunyi suxu, e sunnunyi dugi ragoro e ma tuubi fe ra, keli bannae ma han misikiinɛe.

sentences.english: And the word came to the king of Nineveh, and he got up from his seat of authority, and took off his robe, and covering himself with haircloth, took his seat in the dust.
sentences.susu: Yi xibaarui to Ninewe mangɛ li, a fan naxa keli a xa kibanyi kui, a a xa mangɛ donma rate a ma, a a sunnun dugi ragoro a ma, a fa sa dɔxɔ tɛ xube xɔɔra tuubi fe ra.

sentences.english: And he had it given out in Nineveh, By the order of the king and his great men, no man or beast, herd or flock, is to have a taste of anything; let them have no food or water:
sentences.susu: Na kui a naxa yi masenyi ti Ninewe bɛ, «Mangɛ nun a xa kuntigie xili ra, sunyi bara maxandi mixie nun xurusee birin ma.

sentences.english: And let man and beast be covered with haircloth, and let them make strong prayers to God: and let everyone be turned from his evil way and the violent acts of their hands.
sentences.susu: Mixie nun xurusee birin xa sunnun dugi ragoro e ma, e xa Alatala xili sɛnbɛ ra, birin xa gbilen a xa kira ɲaaxi nun e xa kobiɲa fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Who may say that God will not be turned, changing his purpose and turning away from his burning wrath, so that destruction may not overtake us?
sentences.susu: Nde a kolon xa Ala mu a xa natɛ tongoxi masarama, a won natanga a xa xɔnɛ gbe ma, a fa won nakisi faxɛ ma?»

sentences.english: And God saw what they did, how they were turned from their evil way; and God's purpose was changed as to the evil which he said he would do to them, and he did it not.
sentences.susu: Ala to a to Ninewekae bara tuubi, e bara e kobe so e xa kira ɲaaxi ra, a naxa kinikini e ma, a mu gbaloe ragoro e ma sɔnɔn, alɔ a nu bara a ɲanige ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But this seemed very wrong to Jonah, and he was angry.
sentences.susu: Na fe mu nu rafanxi Annabi Yunusa ma fefe ma, a fa xɔnɔ.

sentences.english: And he made prayer to the Lord and said, O Lord, is this not what I said when I was still in my country? This is why I took care to go in flight to Tarshish: for I was certain that you were a loving God, full of pity, slow to be angry and great in mercy, and ready to be turned from your purpose of evil.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Alatala bɛ, «Alatala, n mu nu yi fe xa falama n to nu na n xɔnyi tɛmui naxɛ? N na n gi yi nan ma sigafe ra Tarasisi, barima n nu a kolon Ala nan i ra, naxan hinnɛ nun kinikini masenma mixie bɛ, naxan mu xɔnɔma mafuren, naxan xa xanunteya gbo, naxan gbilenma a xa natɛ tongoxi fɔxɔ ra, a gbaloe lu na a nu wama naxan nabafe.

sentences.english: So now, O Lord, give ear to my prayer and take my life from me; for death is better for me than life.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi Alatala, n nii tongo, barima n faxaxi nan fisa n baloxi bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said, Have you any right to be angry?
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a maxɔrin, «A lanma i xa xɔnɔ yi fe ma yi ki nɛ?»

sentences.english: Then Jonah went out of the town, and took his seat on the east side of the town and made himself a roof of branches and took his seat under its shade till he saw what would become of the town.
sentences.susu: Annabi Yunusa naxa mini taa fari ma, a sa dɔxɔ taa sogetede mabiri leele bun ma, a naxan yailan a yɛtɛ bɛ. A nu wama a tofe nɛ fe naxan fama rabade Ninewe ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord God made a vine come up over Jonah to give him shade over his head. And Jonah was very glad because of the vine.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa wuri bili nde rabula a a ti Yunusa xun ma, alako a niini xa ti a xun, a naxa soge xa xɔnɛ kolon. Yunusa naxa ɲɛlɛxin ki fanyi ra na wuri bili niini xa fe ra.

sentences.english: But early on the morning after, God made ready a worm for the destruction of the vine, and it became dry and dead.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na lɔxɔɛ kuye iba, Ala naxa a niya kuli nde xa sa na wuri bili don, a xa xara.

sentences.english: Then when the sun came up, God sent a burning east wind: and so great was the heat of the sun on his head that Jonah was overcome, and, requesting death for himself, said, Death is better for me than life.
sentences.susu: Soge to mini, Ala naxa foye fure ramini kelife sogetede, a soge xɔrɔxɔɛ ti Yunusa ma. Na naxa a niya Yunusa ya naxa ifɔɔrɔ, a fa wa faxafe. A naxa Ala maxandi, «N faxaxi fisa n baloxi bɛ to.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Jonah, Have you any right to be angry about the vine? And he said, I have a right to be truly angry.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa Annabi Yunusa maxɔrin, «A lanma i xa xɔnɔ yi wuri bili xa fe ma yi ki?» Yunusa naxa a yaabi, «Iyo. N xɔnɔxi han n ɲan wama nɛ n xa faxa!»

sentences.english: And the Lord said, You had pity on the vine, for which you did no work and for the growth of which you were not responsible; which came up in a night and came to an end in a night;
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen a bɛ, «I tan mɛɛnixi yi wuri bili nan ma, i mu naxan sixi, i mu naxan namɔxi. A bulaxi kɔɛ keren nan na, na kuye iba, a man naxa faxa.

sentences.english: And am I not to have mercy on Nineveh, that great town, in which there are more than a hundred and twenty thousand persons without the power of judging between right and left, as well as much cattle?
sentences.susu: A mu lanma xɛ n tan xa kinikini Ninewe ma, yi taa xungbe, mixi wulu kɛmɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nun a xanbi na dɛnnaxɛ, naxee mu fe fanyi nun fe ɲaaxi tagi raba kolon, xurusee gbegbe fan na dɛnnaxɛ?»

sentences.english: The word of the Lord which came to Micah the Morashtite, in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah: his vision about Samaria and Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya a naxan ti Annabi Mika Moresetika bɛ Samari nun Darisalamu xa fe ra. A a ti a bɛ Yudaya mangɛ Yotami, Axasi, nun Xesekiya xa waxati nɛ.

sentences.english: Give ear, you peoples, all of you; give attention, O earth and everything in it: let the Lord God be witness against you, the Lord from his holy Temple.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa si birin, wo xa wo tuli mati n na. Ibunadama birin naxee na yi bɛndɛ fuɲi fari, wo xa n ma masenyi ramɛ, won Marigi Alatala fama wo kalamude naxan na, kelife a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi sɛniyɛnxi kui.

sentences.english: For see, the Lord is coming out from his place, and will come down, stepping on the high places of the earth.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a mato, Alatala na fafe kelife a xa lingira, a na gorofe geyae fari, a a ɲɛrɛ.

sentences.english: And the mountains will be turned to water under him, and the deep valleys will be broken open, like wax before the fire, like waters flowing down a slope.
sentences.susu: Geyae na xunufe a sanyi bun ma, alɔ kumi dole naxan sama tɛ fɛ ma, alɔ ye naxan susufe kelife yire itexi. Geyae na ibɔɔfe, e findi gulunbae ra.

sentences.english: All this is because of the wrongdoing of Jacob and the sins of the children of Israel. What is the wrongdoing of Jacob? is it not Samaria? and what are the high places of Judah? are they not Jerusalem?
sentences.susu: Na birin kelixi Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ xa murutɛ nan ma, a fatanxi Isirayila ɲama xa yunubie nan ma. Nde Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛe ramurutaxi? Samari xa mu a ra? Nde kuye batude tixi yire itexi fari Yudaya? Darisalamu xa mu a ra?

sentences.english: So I will make Samaria into a field and the plantings of a vine-garden: I will send its stones falling down into the valley, uncovering its bases.
sentences.susu: Na kui n fama Samari findide gɛmɛ malanxie nan na, n a findi wɛni sansi side ra. N a xa gɛmɛ bilie rabira, n e radin gulunbae kui, han a xa banxie bunyi lu kɛnɛ ma.

sentences.english: And all her pictured images will be hammered into bits, and all the payments for her loose ways will be burned with fire, and all the images of her gods I will make waste: for with the price of a loose woman she got them together, and as the price of a loose woman will they be given back.
sentences.susu: N a xa kuyee butuxunma nɛ, n a xa batu see ganma nɛ tɛ ra, n a xa ala masolixie xun nakanama nɛ. Nee fɔlɔxi bafata nan na naxan nawalixi langoe sare ra, nee man findima bafata nan na langoe sare fima naxan na.

sentences.english: For this I will be full of sorrow and give cries of grief; I will go uncovered and unclothed: I will give cries of grief like the jackals and will be in sorrow like the ostriches.
sentences.susu: N fama sunnunde na nan ma, n na n kui iwa. N na n ɲɛrɛma nɛ n sanyi nun n fate mageli ra, n na n gbelegbele xui itema nɛ alɔ wulai bare, n na n kui iwa alɔ xundi.

sentences.english: For her wounds may not be made well: for it has come even to Judah, stretching up to the doorway of my people, even to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Samari xa fure ɲaaxi mu nɔma dandande, a man bara din Yudaya bɔxi ra, han a bara Darisalamu masɔtɔ n ma ɲama sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Give no word of it in Gath, let there be no weeping at all: at Beth-le-aphrah be rolling in the dust.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa na fe rakolon Gatikae ra de wo wa xui ra. N dɔxɔxi xube xɔɔra sunnunyi kui Beti Leyafera.

sentences.english: Be uncovered and go away, you who are living in Shaphir: the one living in Zaanan has not come out of her town; Beth-ezel is taken away from its base, even from its resting-place.
sentences.susu: Safirikae, wo xa dangi wo mageli ra yaagi kui. Saanan ɲama mu suusama minide. Wo mu nɔma wo xaxili tide Beti Eseli ra, e fan na wafe.

sentences.english: For the one living in Maroth is waiting for good: for evil has come down from the Lord to the doorways of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Marotikae bara lu kɔntɔfili kui, barima gbaloe bara goro kelife e Marigi Alatala ma, a Darisalamu naadɛ li.

sentences.english: Let the war-carriage be yoked to the quick-running horse, you who are living in Lachish: she was the first cause of sin to the daughter of Zion; for the wrongdoings of Israel were seen in you.
sentences.susu: Lakisikae, wo xa sɔɔri ragisee yailan. Wo bara a niya Siyonikae xa muruta Ala ma, Isirayila bara bira wo xa yunubie fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: For this cause give a parting offering to Moresheth-gath: the daughter of Achzib will be a deceit to the king of Israel.
sentences.susu: I tan nun Moreseti Gatikae fatanma na nan ma, Akisibukae fama nɛ Isirayila mangɛe yanfade.

sentences.english: Even now will the taker of your heritage come to you, you who are living in Mareshah: the glory of Israel will come to destruction for ever.
sentences.susu: Maresakae, n gerefa gbɛtɛ xɛɛma nɛ a xa wo gere. Isirayila mangɛ ɲalama sigama nɛ Adulama.

sentences.english: Let your head be uncovered and your hair cut off in sorrow for the children of your delight: let the hair be pulled from your head like an eagle's; for they have been taken away from you as prisoners.
sentences.susu: Wo wo xunyie bi alɔ yubɛ, sunnunyi xa fe ra, barima wo xa di xanuxie fama xaninde konyiya kui ɲamanɛ ma.

sentences.english: A curse on the designers of evil, working on their beds! in the morning light they do it, because it is in their power.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na mixie bɛ, naxee e maɲɔxunma maifuya nun fe ɲaaxi rabafe ma e sa tɛmui, kuye nɛfɛ iba, e fa fe kobie raba, barima na nɔɛ na e yi ra.

sentences.english: They have a desire for fields and take them by force; and for houses and take them away: they are cruel to a man and his family, even to a man and his heritage.
sentences.susu: E na milɛ xɛe ma, e nee ba e kanyie yi ra. E na milɛ banxie ma, e nee tongo e sɛnbɛ ra. E fu mixi ma, e a xa banxi muɲa. E fu mixi ma, e a kɛ rasuxu a yi.

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord has said, See, against this family I am purposing an evil from which you will not be able to take your necks away, and you will be weighted down by it; for it is an evil time.
sentences.susu: Na xa fe ra, Marigi Alatala naxɛ, «N ɲaxankatɛ dɔxɔma nɛ na mixi mɔɔli ma, wo mu nɔma wo ratangade naxan ma. N fama wo xun gorode na ɲaxankatɛ tɛmui.

sentences.english: In that day this saying will be said about you, and this song of grief will be made: The heritage of my people is measured out, and there is no one to give it back; those who have made us prisoners have taken our fields from us, and complete destruction has come to us.
sentences.susu: E wo xa fe ifalama taali daaxi nɛ na lɔxɔɛ, e wo masigi a mayele ki ma, e nu fa a fala, ‹Muxu xa fe bara kana feo. Muxu xa bɔxie bara ba muxu yi ra. A bara e ba muxu yi, a e so muxu yaxuie yi ra.›»

sentences.english: For this cause you will have no one to make the decision by the measuring line in the meeting of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, wo mu mixi yo sɔtɔma Alatala xa ɲama ya ma, naxan nɔma bɔxi itaxunde wo bɛ Ala xa tɔnxumae saabui ra.

sentences.english: Let not words like these be dropped, they say: Shame and the curse will not come to the family of Jacob!
sentences.susu: E xa namiɲɔnmɛe a falama, «Ba yi masenyi mɔɔli tife, namiɲɔnmɛ mu lanma a xa na fala. Won mu fama lude yaagi yo kui.

sentences.english: Is the Lord quickly made angry? are these his doings? do not his words do good to his people Israel?
sentences.susu: Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ, a lanma a xa fala, Alatala xɔnɔma a bɔɲɛ ma? A darixi na wali mɔɔli raba ra?» Alatala naxa e yaabi, «N ma masenyie mu fanxi xɛ tinxintɔɛe bɛ?

sentences.english: As for you, you have become haters of those who were at peace with you: you take the clothing of those who go by without fear, and make them prisoners of war.
sentences.susu: Yi waxati n ma ɲama bara lu alɔ n yaxui. Wo donma fanyi bama dangi mixie ma, naxee fafe bɔɲɛsa kui kelife gere sode.

sentences.english: The women of my people you have been driving away from their dearly loved children; from their young ones you are taking my glory for ever.
sentences.susu: Wo n ma ɲama xa ginɛe kerima e xa banxi fanyie kui, wo e xa die xa xunnakeli bama e yi ra n naxan fi e ma.

sentences.english: Up! and go; for this is not your rest: because it has been made unclean, the destruction ordered will come on you.
sentences.susu: Wo keli, wo siga, n bara yi bɔxi ba wo yi ra sabatide ra, barima a mu sɛniyɛn, a bara kana kerenyi ra.

sentences.english: If a man came with a false spirit of deceit, saying, I will be a prophet to you of wine and strong drink: he would be the sort of prophet for this people.
sentences.susu: Xa wule falɛ nun mixi madaxui fa a fala wo bɛ, ‹Wo fama beere nun wɛni sɔtɔde›, na mixi mɔɔli nan nafan wo ma namiɲɔnmɛ ra.»

sentences.english: I will certainly make all of you, O Jacob, come together; I will get together the rest of Israel; I will put them together like the sheep in their circle: like a flock in their green field; they will be full of the noise of men.
sentences.susu: «Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ, n wo birin malanma nɛ. Isirayila mixi dɔnxɔɛe, n wo xun lanma nɛ. N wo malanma nɛ, alɔ yɛxɛɛe naxee malanma gɔɔrɛ kui, alɔ xurusee naxee na fiili ma e dɛ madonde. Ɲama gbegbe sabatima nɛ naa.

sentences.english: The opener of the way will go up before them: forcing their way out they will go on to the doorway and out through it: their king will go on before them, and the Lord at their head.
sentences.susu: E xa mangɛ fama nɛ taa tɛtɛ ibɔɔde, a fa ti ɲama ya ra, a e birin naminima nɛ naa. Alatala nan findi e xunyi ra.»

sentences.english: And I said, Give ear, now, you heads of Jacob and rulers of the people of Israel: is it not for you to have knowledge of what is right?
sentences.susu: N naxɛ, «Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ mangɛe, Isirayila yareratie, wo xa wo tuli mati. Wo tan xa mu daxa wo xa sɛriyɛ kolon?

sentences.english: You who are haters of good and lovers of evil, pulling off their skin from them and their flesh from their bones;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo fe fanyie xɔnma, fe ɲaaxie nan nafan wo ma. Wo mixie tɔɔrɔma han, a luxi nɛ alɔ wo e xa kiri nun sube bama e fatee ma,

sentences.english: Like meat they take the flesh of my people for their food, skinning them and crushing their bones, yes, cutting them up as if for the pot, like flesh inside the cooking-pot.
sentences.susu: wo na ibolon a xuntunyie ra, wo a ɲin tunde kui, wo fa a don.»

sentences.english: Then they will be crying to the Lord for help, but he will not give them an answer: yes, he will keep his face veiled from them at that time, because their acts have been evil.
sentences.susu: Na mixi mɔɔli fama nɛ Alatala xilide, kɔnɔ a mu e yaabima. Na lɔxɔɛ a a kobe soma nɛ e ra, barima e ɲɛrɛ ki mu fan.

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said about the prophets by whom my people have been turned from the right way; who, biting with their teeth, say, Peace; and if anyone puts nothing in their mouths they make ready for war against him.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Wo tan namiɲɔnmɛ naxee n ma ɲama ratantanma, naxee bɔɲɛsa masenma mixie bɛ naxee wo kima, kɔnɔ wo mixie tan gere naxee wo kuma.

sentences.english: For this cause it will be night for you, without a vision; and it will be dark for you, without knowledge of the future; the sun will go down over the prophets, and the day will be black over them.
sentences.susu: Na xa fe ra, kɔɛ soma nɛ wo xun, wo mu toe tima, wo mu laamatunyie sɔtɔma, wo luma dimi nan kui tun. Soge dulama nɛ na namiɲɔnmɛe xun, yanyi fan ifɔɔrɔ e bɛ.

sentences.english: And the seers will be shamed, and the readers of the future will be at a loss, all of them covering their lips; for there is no answer from God.
sentences.susu: Se matoe yaagima nɛ, naxee yare toma, e xun sinma nɛ, e e yatagi nɔxun, barima n tan Ala mu e yaabima.»

sentences.english: But I truly am full of the spirit of the Lord, with power of judging and with strength to make clear to Jacob his wrongdoing and to Israel his sin.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi bara sɛnbɛ fi n ma, tinxinyi nun limaniya bara lu n yi ra, alako n xa Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛe rakolon e xa murutɛ ra, n xa Isirayila xa yunubie masen a bɛ.

sentences.english: Then give ear to this, you heads of the children of Jacob, you rulers of the children of Israel, hating what is right, twisting what is straight.
sentences.susu: Wo tan Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛe yareratie, wo tan Isirayila ɲama xa mangɛe, wo xa wo tuli mati n na. Wo na tinxinyi xɔnfe, wo a mafindi.

sentences.english: They are building up Zion with blood, and Jerusalem with evil-doing.
sentences.susu: Wo na mixie nii bafe Siyoni tife ra, wo na Darisalamu tife tinxintareya kui.

sentences.english: Its heads take rewards for judging, and the priests take payment for teaching, and the prophets get silver for reading the future: but still, supporting themselves on the Lord, they say, Is not the Lord among us? no evil will overtake us.
sentences.susu: E xa mangɛe kiiti sama kɔbiri sɔtɔfe nan ma. E xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xaranyi tima naafuli xa fe nan na. E xa namiɲɔnmɛe masenyie tima e xa geeni nan ma. Kɔnɔ e birin e ya tima Alatala ra, e nu a fala mixie bɛ, «Alatala mu na xɛ won ya ma? Ɲaxankatɛ yo mu won lima.»

sentences.english: For this reason, Zion will be ploughed like a field because of you, and Jerusalem will become a mass of broken walls, and the mountain of the house like a high place in the woods.
sentences.susu: Wo xa fe nan yati a niyama Siyoni fama buxade alɔ xɛ, Darisalamu findima nɛ gɛmɛ malanxie ra, fɔtɔnyi fa bula hɔrɔmɔbanxi rabilinyi ma.

sentences.english: But in the last days it will come about that the mountain of the Lord's house will be placed on the top of the mountains, and be lifted up over the hills; and peoples will be flowing to it.
sentences.susu: Tɛmui fama a lide, Alatala xa banxi tixi geya naxan fari, na fama nɛ tide geya birin xun ma. A itema nɛ tentenyi birin bɛ, ɲamae luma nɛ siga ra mɛnni.

sentences.english: And a number of nations will go and say, Come, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, and to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will give us knowledge of his ways and we will be guided by his word: for from Zion the law will go out, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Si gbegbe e xun tima nɛ naa ra, e a fala, «Won xa siga Alatala xa geya fari, Yaxuba Marigi Ala xa banxi. A won xaranma nɛ a xa sɛriyɛ ra, alako won xa won ɲɛrɛ a xa kira xɔn ma.» Sɛriyɛ fatanma Siyoni nan na, Alatala xa masenyi kelima Darisalamu nan kui.

sentences.english: And he will be judge between great peoples, and strong nations far away will be ruled by his decisions; their swords will be hammered into plough-blades and their spears into vine-knives: nations will no longer be lifting up their swords against one another, and knowledge of war will have gone for ever.
sentences.susu: A findima nɛ kiitisa ra si gbegbe tagi, a fa si sɛnbɛmae xa gere raɲɔnde duniɲa birin kui. E e xa santidɛgɛmae xabuma sari xa kerie nan na, e e xa wɔrɔtɛe yailan tanbɛe ra. Si yo mu a xa santidɛgɛma itema si gbɛtɛ xili ma sɔnɔn. Na waxati, mixie mu gere mɔɔli yo matinkanma.

sentences.english: But every man will be seated under his vine and under his fig-tree, and no one will be a cause of fear to them: for the mouth of the Lord of armies has said it.
sentences.susu: E tima e xa wɛni sansi nan sɛɛti ma, e dɔxɔ e xa xɔrɛ bili niini bun ma. Mixi yo mu fama e bɔɲɛ raminide, barima Alatala Sɛnbɛma bara wɔyɛn.

sentences.english: For all the peoples will be walking, every one in the name of his god, and we will be walking in the name of the Lord our God for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: Si birin nɔma ɲɛrɛde e xa alae waxɔn ki nɛ, kɔnɔ won tan won ɲɛrɛma Alatala nan waxɔn ki abadan.

sentences.english: In that day, says the Lord, I will get together her who goes with uncertain steps, I will get together her who has been sent away, and her on whom I have sent evil;
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «Lɔxɔɛ nde fama, n lanyurutɔɛe malanma nɛ. N mixie xunlanma nɛ, n naxee rayensenxi tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: And I will make her whose steps were uncertain a small band, and her who was feeble a strong nation: and the Lord will be their King in Mount Zion from now and for ever.
sentences.susu: N lanyurutɔɛe findima nɛ mixi kisixi dɔnxɔɛe ra, n mixi rayensenxie findima nɛ si sɛnbɛma ra. Alatala nan tima e xun ma Siyoni geya fari abadan.

sentences.english: And you, O tower of the flock, Ophel of the daughter of Zion, to you it will come, even the earlier authority, the kingdom of the daughter of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: I tan Siyoni, naxan a ɲɔxɔ sama ɲama xɔn ma, naxan findixi taa makanta xi ra, nɔɛ fisamante gbilenma i tan nan ma, mangɛya fa lu Darisalamu yi ra.»

sentences.english: Now why are you crying so loudly? is there no king in you? has destruction come on your wise helper? so that pains have taken you like the pains of a woman in childbirth:
sentences.susu: Wo fa gbelegbelema munfe ra? Mangɛ mu na wo xɔnyi sɔnɔn? Wo rasima bara faxa? Na bara a niya wo xa tɔɔrɔ alɔ ginɛ naxan na ditinyi ra?

sentences.english: Be in pain, make sounds of grief, O daughter of Zion, like a woman in childbirth: for now you will go out of the town, living in the open country, and will come even to Babylon; there you will have salvation; there the Lord will make you free from the hands of your haters.
sentences.susu: Siyonikae, wo furie xa wo matolin alɔ furi ginɛ, barima e wo raminima nɛ taa kui, wo fa xi burunyi. E wo xaninma Babilɔn konyiya kui, kɔnɔ mɛnni wo fama nɛ fulunde. Alatala wo bama nɛ wo yaxuie bɛlɛxɛ i.

sentences.english: And now a number of nations have come together against you, and they say, Let her be made unclean and let our eyes see the fate of Zion.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi si gbegbe tixi wo xili ma, a falafe ra, «Siyoni xa yaagi won ya xɔri!»

sentences.english: But they have no knowledge of the thoughts of the Lord, their minds are not able to see his purpose: for he has got them together like stems of grain to the crushing-floor.
sentences.susu: Nee mu Alatala xa maɲɔxunyi kolonxi, e mu a xa wali fahaamuxi. Alatala bara e malan lonyi ma maale bɔnbɔma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Up! and let the grain be crushed, O daughter of Zion, for I will make your horn iron and your feet brass, and a number of peoples will be broken by you, and you will give up their increase to the Lord and their wealth to the Lord of all the earth.
sentences.susu: Siyonikae, wo keli wo xa e bɔnbɔ. N wo sɛnbɛ gboma nɛ alɔ tuura, naxan ferie yailanxi wure ra, naxan tore findixi wure gbeeli ra. Na kui wo ɲamanɛ wuyaxi butuxunma nɛ, wo e xa naafuli findima n tan Duniɲa Marigi Alatala nan gbe ra.

sentences.english: Now you will give yourselves deep wounds for grief; they will put up a wall round us: they will give the judge of Israel a blow on the face with a rod.
sentences.susu: «I tan, Bɛtɛlɛɛmu Efarata, naxan xurun Yuda xabilɛe ya ma, mixi nde minima nɛ i ya ma naxan Isirayila yamarima n bɛ. A xa fe fɔlɔxi tɛmui dangixi nɛ naxan makuya pon.»

sentences.english: And you, Beth-lehem Ephrathah, the least among the families of Judah, out of you one will come to me who is to be ruler in Israel; whose going out has been purposed from time past, from the eternal days.
sentences.susu: Na na a toma, Alatala Isirayila raboloma, han furi ginɛ fa a xa di baride. Na tɛmui, na di ngaxakerenyie dɔnxɔɛe fama nɛ gbilende Isirayila.

sentences.english: For this cause he will give them up till the time when she who is with child has given birth: then the rest of his brothers will come back to the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: A kelima nɛ, a ti a xa xurusee ya ra, a e dɛ madon a Marigi Alatala Xili Xungbe Kanyi sɛnbɛ ra. E sabatima nɛ a fanyi ra, barima a xa xunnakeli duniɲa birin lima nɛ.

sentences.english: And he will take his place and give food to his flock in the strength of the Lord, in the glory of the name of the Lord his God; and their resting-place will be safe: for now he will be great to the ends of the earth.
sentences.susu: A tan nan findima won ma bɔɲɛsa ra. Asiriyakae na fa won ma bɔxi ma, e so won ma yire makantaxie kui, won kantama solofere nun mangɛ solomasaxan nan kelima e xili ma.

sentences.english: And this will be our peace: when the Assyrian comes into our country and his feet are in our land, then we will put up against him seven keepers of the flocks and eight chiefs among men.
sentences.susu: E Asiriya bɔxi yamarima nɛ santidɛgɛma ra, e dɔxɔ Nimirodi xa bɔxi xun ma tanbɛ ra. Won ma mangɛ won bama nɛ Asiriyakae yi ra, e na tugan won ma naaninyi xun ma, e so won ma bɔxi kui.

sentences.english: And they will make waste the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod with the edge of the sword: he will give us salvation from the Assyrian when he comes into our country, when his feet come inside the limit of our land.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ dɔnxɔɛe luma nɛ duniɲa sie ya ma, alɔ xini naxan kelima Alatala ma, alɔ tunɛ ye naxan dɔxɔma burɛxɛ ra. E mu e xaxili tima ibunadama ra, e mu e yɛtɛ taxuma mixi yo ra.

sentences.english: And the rest of Jacob will be among the mass of peoples like dew from the Lord, like showers on the grass, which may not be kept back by man, or be waiting for the sons of men.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ dɔnxɔɛe luma nɛ duniɲa si gbegbe ya ma, alɔ yɛtɛ naxan tima wulai subee tagi, alɔ yɛtɛ yɔrɛ naxan ɲɛrɛma xurusee ya ma, a fa dutun ndee ma, a e ibɔɔ, mixi yo mu nɔma e bade a yi ra.

sentences.english: And the rest of Jacob will be among the nations, in the middle of the mass of peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the woods, like a young lion among the flocks of sheep: if he goes through, they will be crushed under foot and pulled to bits, and there will be no saviour.
sentences.susu: I xun nakelima nɛ i yaxuie ya i, e birin sɔntɔ.

sentences.english: Your hand is lifted up against those who are against you, and all your haters will be cut off.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «Lɔxɔ nde fama a lide, n wo xa soee nun wo xa sɔɔri ragisee xa fe kanama nɛ.

sentences.english: And it will come about in that day, says the Lord, that I will take away your horses from you, and will give your war-carriages to destruction:
sentences.susu: N wo xa bɔxi xa taae kanama nɛ, n wo xa yire makantaxie rabira.

sentences.english: I will have the towns of your land cut off and all your strong places pulled down:
sentences.susu: N wo xa duureya kanama nɛ, n wo xa se matoe rayensen yɛ.

sentences.english: I will put an end to your use of secret arts, and you will have no more readers of signs:
sentences.susu: N wo xa kuyee nun wo xa gɛmɛ masolixi birin kanama nɛ. Na tɛmui, wo mu suyidima se yailanxie bɛ sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And I will have your images and your pillars cut off from you; and you will no longer give worship to the work of your hands.
sentences.susu: N wo xa Aseri wuri masolixie talama nɛ wo tagi, n wo xa taae kanama nɛ,

sentences.english: I will have your Asherahs pulled up from among you: and I will send destruction on your images.
sentences.susu: n n gbeɲɔxɔma xɔnɛ nan kui, sie ma naxee mu tin n xui suxude.»

sentences.english: Give ear now to the words of the Lord: Up! put forward your cause before the mountains, let your voice be sounding among the hills.
sentences.susu: Wo wo tuli mati Alatala xa masenyi ra: «Keli, wo xa wo xa kalamui ti geyae ya xɔri, duniɲa birin xa i xui mɛ.

sentences.english: Give ear, O you mountains, to the Lord's cause, and take note, you bases of the earth: for the Lord has a cause against his people, and he will take it up with Israel.
sentences.susu: Geya naxee na duniɲa ma kabi a fɔlɛ, wo xa n tan Alatala xa kalamui mɛ, n naxan tima n ma ɲama Isirayila xili ma.»

sentences.english: O my people, what have I done to you? how have I been a weariness to you? give answer against me.
sentences.susu: «N ma ɲama, n munse rabaxi wo ra? N kote mundun dɔxɔxi wo xun ma? Wo xa n yaabi.

sentences.english: For I took you up out of the land of Egypt and made you free from the prison-house; I sent before you Moses, Aaron, and Miriam.
sentences.susu: N wo raminixi nɛ Misira bɔxi ra, n wo xun sara konyiya kui. N naxa Munsa, Haruna, nun Mariyama xɛɛ wo raminide.

sentences.english: O my people, keep in mind now what was designed by Balak, king of Moab, and the answer which Balaam, son of Beor, gave him; the events, from Shittim to Gilgal, so that you may be certain of the upright acts of the Lord.
sentences.susu: N ma ɲama, wo xa wo ratu a ma, Mowaba mangɛ Balaki nu wama naxan nabafe wo ra, a nun Beyori xa di Balami xa yaabi. Wo xa wo ratu wo xa biyaasi ma kelife Sitimi han Giligali, Alatala xa fe tinxinxie a naxee rabaxi wo bɛ.»

sentences.english: With what am I to come before the Lord and go with bent head before the high God? am I to come before him with burned offerings, with young oxen a year old?
sentences.susu: N fama munse ra Alatala bɛ n xa Mangɛ Ala batu? A lanma n xa fa sɛrɛxɛ nan na a bɛ, sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi alɔ ninge naxee bara ɲɛ keren sɔtɔ?

sentences.english: Will the Lord be pleased with thousands of sheep or with ten thousand rivers of oil? am I to give my first child for my wrongdoing, the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
sentences.susu: Alatala wama yɛxɛɛ kontonyi gali nan xɔn ma, xa na mu a ra, ture gbegbe naxan mu ɲɔnma? A lanma n xa n ma di singe ba sɛrɛxɛ ra n ma yunubi sare ra? N di naxan sɔtɔ, na nɔma findide na xafari se ra?

sentences.english: He has made clear to you, O man, what is good; and what is desired from you by the Lord; only doing what is right, and loving mercy, and walking without pride before your God.
sentences.susu: Ala bara adamadi rakolon fe ra naxan fan, a wama i xa naxan naba? A wama nɛ i xa tinxin, dugutɛgɛya xa rafan i ma, i man xa bira Alatala fɔxɔ ra yɛtɛ magore kui.

sentences.english: The voice of the Lord is crying out to the town: Give ear, you tribes and the meeting of the town.
sentences.susu: Alatala na taakae xilife. Xaxilima fama na tode, a fa gaaxu Ala ya ra. «Wo wo tuli mati a xa kiiti ra, wo naxa wo kobe so na kiitisa ra.

sentences.english: Am I to let the stores of the evil-doer go out of my memory, and the short measure, which is cursed?
sentences.susu: Naafuli na wo xɔnyi wo naxan sɔtɔ tinxintareya kui? Maniya se kamalitaree na wo xɔnyi n naxee xɔnxi?

sentences.english: Is it possible for me to let wrong scales and the bag of false weights go without punishment?
sentences.susu: N nɔma diɲɛde maniya se tinxintaree kanyi ma?

sentences.english: For its men of wealth are cruel, and its people have said what is not true, and their tongue is false in their mouth.
sentences.susu: Taa bannae findixi fe kobi rabae nan na, taakae wule nan tun falama, e mixie madaxu.»

sentences.english: So I have made a start with your punishment; I have made you waste because of your sins.
sentences.susu: «Na kui n bara wo tɔɔrɔ fɔlɔ, n xa wo halaki wo xa yunubie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: You will have food, but not enough; your shame will be ever with you: you will get your goods moved, but you will not take them away safely; and what you do take away I will give to the sword.
