sentences.susu: Wo wo dɛgema nɛ, kɔnɔ wo mu fama lugade, wo donse ragatama nɛ, kɔnɔ a mu luma naa. Na bama nɛ wo yi ra santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: You will put in seed, but you will not get in the grain; you will be crushing olives, but your bodies will not be rubbed with the oil; and you will get in the grapes, but you will have no wine.
sentences.susu: Wo xɛ sama nɛ, kɔnɔ wo mu a xabama, wo oliwi bogi bunduma nɛ, kɔnɔ wo mu a ture donma, wo wɛni bogi dunduma nɛ, kɔnɔ wo mu a minma.

sentences.english: For you have kept the laws of Omri and all the works of the family of Ahab, and you have been guided by their designs: so that I might make you a cause of wonder and your people a cause of hisses; and the shame of my people will be on you.
sentences.susu: Wo bira nɛ Omiri xa yaamarie fɔxɔ ra, wo Akabu xa naamunyie findi wo gbe ra. N wo sɔntɔma na nan ma, n wo xa ɲama findima nɛ mayele se ra duniɲa ya xɔri, n wo luma nɛ yaagi kui sie tagi.»

sentences.english: Sorrow is mine! for I am as when they have got in the summer fruits, like the last of the grapes: there is nothing for food, not even an early fig for my desire.
sentences.susu: N na tɔɔrɔfe yi ki! N luxi nɛ alɔ mixi naxan sigama sansi bogi bade a ba tɛmui, kɔnɔ a mu wɛni bogi toma naa, a mu xɔrɛ fanyi lima wuri kɔn na alɔ a wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: The good man is gone from the earth, there is no one upright among men: they are all waiting secretly for blood, every man is going after his brother with a net.
sentences.susu: Ala xanuntenyie bara ɲɔn bɔxi ma, tinxintɔɛ keren mu luma naa. E birin na e boore tɔɔrɔfe a ɲaaxi ra, kankan gantanyi tema a ngaxakerenyi bɛ.

sentences.english: Their hands are made ready to do evil; the ruler makes requests for money, and the judge is looking for a reward; and the great man gives decisions at his pleasure, and the right is twisted.
sentences.susu: E birin fata fe ɲaaxi rabade. Mangɛe, nee wama buɲa tinxintare xɔn ma. Kiitisae, nee kiiti sama kɔbiri nan tun ma fe ra. Kuntigie, nee fan e xa wasabaliya masenma. E birin na fe keren nɛ.

sentences.english: The best of them is like a waste plant, and their upright ones are like a wall of thorns. Sorrow! the day of their fate has come; now will trouble come on them.
sentences.susu: Naxan na fisamante ra wo ya ma, na tan luma nɛ alɔ tunbe xɔnɛ. Ala xa kiiti lɔxɔɛ bara a li, alɔ ɲama makantɛ a fala ki naxɛ. Ɲama bɔɲɛ mini tɛmui bara fa.

sentences.english: Put no faith in a friend, do not let your hope be placed in a relation: keep watch on the doors of your mouth against her who is resting on your breast.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa la wo dɛ fan boore ra, wo naxa la wo xanuntenyi ra, hali wo xa ginɛ naxan a sama wo fɛ ma, wo naxa wo xa gundo birin masen a bɛ.

sentences.english: For the son puts shame on his father, the daughter goes against her mother and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law; and a man's haters are those of his family.
sentences.susu: Na waxati di xɛmɛ a baba maberema nɛ, di ginɛ ti a nga kanke i, mamadi nun a xa mɔri nga kɔnɲɛma nɛ. Kankan yaxui findima a bari boore yati nan na.

sentences.english: But as for me, I am looking to the Lord; I am waiting for the God of my salvation: the ears of my God will be open to me.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n tan, n ya tima Alatala nan na, n na n xaxili tima n nakisima Ala nan na, barima n Marigi n xui suxuma nɛ.

sentences.english: Do not be glad because of my sorrow, O my hater: after my fall I will be lifted up; when I am seated in the dark, the Lord will be a light to me.
sentences.susu: I tan Isirayila yaxui, i naxa ɲɛlɛxin n ma tɔɔrɛ ra. Hali n bira nɛ, n man kelima nɛ. Hali n lu nɛ dimi xɔɔra, Alatala nan na n ma yanbɛ ra.

sentences.english: I will undergo the wrath of the Lord, because of my sin against him; till he takes up my cause and does what is right for me: when he makes me come out into the light, I will see his righteousness;
sentences.susu: N to yunubi raba Alatala ra, n fama nɛ a xa xɔnɛ sɔtɔde han a kamali, a fa n xun mafalade, a a xa tinxinyi masen n bɛ.

sentences.english: And my hater will see it and be covered with shame; she who said to me, Where is the Lord your God? my eyes will see their desire effected on her, now she will be crushed under foot like the dust of the streets.
sentences.susu: N yaxuie na na to, e yaagima nɛ. Singe e nu a falama, «I Marigi Alatala na minden?» Kɔnɔ na tɛmui n tan nan e xa birɛ toma, e maboron sanyi ra alɔ boora naxan na kira ra.

sentences.english: A day for building your walls! in that day will your limits be stretched far and wide.
sentences.susu: I tan Isirayila, wo xa tɛtɛ rakeli lɔxɔɛ fama nɛ, wo xa naaninyie igboma nɛ.

sentences.english: In that day they will come to you from Assyria and the towns of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River, and from sea to sea and from mountain to mountain.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ mixie fama nɛ wo yire, kelife Asiriya nun Misira taae kui, kelife Misira bɔxi han Efirati xure, kelife baa nde ma a sa dɔxɔ baa gbɛtɛ ra, kelife geya nde ma a sa dɔxɔ geya gbɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: But the land will become a waste because of its people, as the fruit of their works.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa bɔxi fama nɛ kanade mixie xa wali ɲaaxie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Keep your people safe with your rod, the flock of your heritage, living by themselves in the woods in the middle of Carmel: let them get their food in Bashan and Gilead as in the past.
sentences.susu: Mɛɛni i xa ɲama ma, barima e findixi i kɛ nan na, naxee sabatixi e kerenyi ma fɔtɔnyi kui fiili fanyi sɛɛti ma. E xa e dɛ madon a fanyi ra, alɔ e nu a rabaxi Basan nun Galadi bɔxi ma tɛmui dangixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: As in the days when you came out from the land of Egypt, let us see things of wonder.
sentences.susu: N kaabanakoe masenma nɛ e bɛ, alɔ e mini Misira bɔxi ra lɔxɔɛ naxɛ.

sentences.english: The nations will see and be shamed because of all their strength; they will put their hands on their mouths, their ears will be stopped.
sentences.susu: Sie na wo sɛnbɛ to, e yaagima nɛ e xa sɛnbɛtareya kui.

sentences.english: They will take dust as their food like a snake, like the things which go flat on the earth; they will come shaking with fear out of their secret places: they will come with fear to the Lord our God, full of fear because of you.
sentences.susu: E xube donma nɛ alɔ bɔximase, e luma gaaxui nan kui won Marigi Alatala ya ra, e fa sɛrɛn.

sentences.english: Who is a God like you, offering forgiveness for evil-doing and overlooking the sins of the rest of his heritage? he does not keep his wrath for ever, because his delight is in mercy.
sentences.susu: Ala mundun na naxan maniya i ra, naxan yunubi xafarima, naxan diɲɛma a xa kɛ tongomae dɔnxɔɛe ma? I mu xɔnɛ ragatama abadan, barima dugutɛgɛya masenfe muxu bɛ a rafan i ma.

sentences.english: He will again have pity on us; he will put our sins under his feet: and you will send all our sins down into the heart of the sea.
sentences.susu: I man kinikinima nɛ muxu ma, i fama nɛ muxu xa yunubie lude naa, i fa e woli baa bɔtini ma.

sentences.english: You will make clear your good faith to Jacob and your mercy to Abraham, as you gave your oath to our fathers from times long past.
sentences.susu: I i xui rakamalima nɛ Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ bɛ, i hinnɛma nɛ Iburahima bɔnsɔɛ ra, alɔ i i kali a ra muxu benbae bɛ ki naxɛ tɛmui dangixi.

sentences.english: The word about Nineveh. The book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite.
sentences.susu: Masenyi xɔrɔxɔɛ nan ya Ninewe xa fe ra, Ala naxan masen Annabi Naxumu Elekosika bɛ. Alatala magaaxu, a gbeɲɔxɔfe mu kanama.

sentences.english: The Lord is a God who takes care of his honour and gives punishment for wrong; the Lord gives punishment and is angry; the Lord sends punishment on those who are against him, being angry with his haters.
sentences.susu: Alatala a gbeɲɔxɔma nɛ, a xa xɔnɛ sɛnbɛ gbo a yaxuie mabiri, a mu diɲɛma e ma mafuren mafuren.

sentences.english: The Lord is slow to get angry and great in power, and will not let the sinner go without punishment: the way of the Lord is in the wind and the storm, and the clouds are the dust of his feet.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala mu xɔnɔma mafuren mafuren, a sɛnbɛ gbo han. Alatala mixi ɲaaxi sare ragbilenma nɛ fe ɲaaxi rabae ma. A xa ɲɛrɛ luma nɛ alɔ turunnaadɛ naxan xube ratema, a tixi nuxuie fari.

sentences.english: He says sharp words to the sea and makes it dry, drying up all the rivers: Bashan is feeble, and Carmel, and the flower of Lebanon is without strength.
sentences.susu: A na xaaɲɛ baa ma, a xɔrima nɛ, a xure birin naxara, a Basan nun Karemele findi gbengberenyi ra, a Liban sansie lisima nɛ.

sentences.english: The mountains are shaking because of him, and the hills flowing away; the earth is falling to bits before him, the world and all who are in it.
sentences.susu: A geyae rasɛrɛnma nɛ, e xunu alɔ kumi ture. Bɔxi sɛrɛnma nɛ a ya i, duniɲa mixie bɔɲɛ minima nɛ.

sentences.english: Who may keep his place before his wrath? and who may undergo the heat of his passion? his wrath is let loose like fire and the rocks are broken open by him.
sentences.susu: Nde nɔma tide a xa xɔnɛ ya ra? Nde nɔma tide a xa bɔɲɛte ya i? A xa xɔnɛ luma nɛ alɔ tɛ, naxan gɛmɛe bulama.

sentences.english: The Lord is good, a strong place in the day of trouble; and he has knowledge of those who take him for their safe cover.
sentences.susu: Alatala fan, a kantari fima nɛ tɔɔrɔmixie ma, a mɛɛnima nɛ mixie ma naxee e yɛtɛ taxuma a ra.

sentences.english: But like water overflowing he will take them away; he will put an end to those who come up against him, driving his haters into the dark.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a Ninewe xun nakanama nɛ, a a yaxuie kerima dimi nan kui.

sentences.english: What are you designing against the Lord? he will put an end to it: his haters will not come up again a second time.
sentences.susu: Ninewe, wo fɛɛrɛ mundun fenfe Alatala xili ma? A tan nan sɔntɔɛ tima kerenyi ra.

sentences.english: For though they are like twisted thorns, and are overcome as with drink, they will come to destruction like stems of grass fully dry.
sentences.susu: E fama nɛ lude alɔ e kankanxi tunbe kunsie nan na, alɔ e siisixi beere nan na, alɔ sɛxɛ xaraxi naxan ganxi feo.

sentences.english: One has gone out from you who is designing evil against the Lord, whose purposes are of no value.
sentences.susu: Nineweka nde bara fe ɲaaxi raba Alatala ra, a mixie rasixi fe kobi nan ma.

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: The days of my cause against you are ended; they are cut off and past. Though I have sent trouble on you, you will no longer be troubled.
sentences.susu: Ala xa masenyi nan ya e xa fe ra: «Hali wo yaxuie wuya, e xun fama nɛ rakanade, e ɲɔn. N bara wo tan Yudayakae tɔɔrɔ, kɔnɔ n mu na rabama sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And now I will let his yoke be broken off you, and your chains be parted.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n wo bama nɛ wo yaxuie xa nɔɛ bun ma, n luutie bolon wo xirixi naxee ra.»

sentences.english: The Lord has given an order about you, that no more of your name are to be planted: from the house of your gods I will have the pictured and metal images cut off; I will make your last resting-place a place of shame; for you are completely evil.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya wo tan Ninewekae xa fe ra: «Wo bɔnsɔɛ fama nɛ ɲɔnde. N wo xa kuye masolixie nun wo xa kuye naxee yailanxi wure ra, naxee na wo xa alae xa banxie kui, n nee birin kanama nɛ. N wo sɔntɔma nɛ, barima wo ɲaaxu.»

sentences.english: A crusher has come up before your face: keep a good look-out, let the way be watched, make yourself strong, let your power be greatly increased.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛra na fafe geyae fari, a fafe xibaarui fanyi ra wo bɛ, a bɔɲɛsa masenyi nan tima wo bɛ. Yudayakae, wo xa wo xa salie raba, wo xa wo xa laayidie rakamali Ala bɛ, barima mixi ɲaaxie mu fama wo sɔntɔde sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: For the Lord will make good the vine of Jacob, as well as the vine of Israel: for the wasters have made them waste and sent destruction on the branches of their vine.
sentences.susu: Ninewekae, wo yaxuie na fafe wo xili ma. Wo wo xa tɛtɛ makanta, wo mɛɛni wo xa kira ma, wo wo tagi ixiri, wo xa limaniya, wo xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ,

sentences.english: The body-covers of his fighting men have been made red, the men of war are clothed in bright red: the war-carriages are like flames of fire in the day when he gets ready, the horses are shaking.
sentences.susu: barima Alatala fama nɛ Yaxuba xun nakelide, a fama nɛ Isirayila itede, hali kasarɛ to ti e xa bɔxi ma, e xa sansie naxa tuxunsan.

sentences.english: The war-carriages are rushing through the streets, pushing against one another in the wide ways, looking like burning lights, running like thunder-flames.
sentences.susu: Wo yaxuie xa sɔɔrie na wure lefae gbeelixi xaninfe, donma gbeeli ragoroxi e ma. E xa sɔɔri ragisee yanbama a fanyi ra, e xa tanbɛe xaaɲɛxi gere xili ma.

sentences.english: He takes the record of his great men: they go falling on their way; they go quickly to the wall, the cover is made ready.
sentences.susu: Na gisee e gima kirae ra, e gbataxi sofe ra gere kui. E luxi alɔ seyamakɔnyi naxan dangima koore ra.

sentences.english: The river doorways are forced open, and the king's house is flowing away.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri sugandixie xɛɛma naa, e xulun sigafe ra taa tɛtɛ yire, e sa gere so.

sentences.english: And the queen is uncovered, she is taken away and her servant-girls are weeping like the sound of doves, hammering on their breasts.
sentences.susu: E mangɛ xa banxi naadɛ rabi, e birin so na kui.

sentences.english: But Nineveh is like a pool of water whose waters are flowing away; Keep your place, they say; but no one is turning back.
sentences.susu: Yaamari fixi taakae xa xanin konyiya kui. A xa ginɛe sigama nɛ wa ra sunnunyi kui.

sentences.english: Take silver, take gold; for there is no end to the store; take for yourselves a weight of things to be desired.
sentences.susu: Ninewe bara lu alɔ ye ragatade ibɔɔxi, a ye fa mini bɔxi ma. Nde a falama, «Wo ba na rabafe, wo keli naa.» Kɔnɔ mixi yo mu gbilenma na fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Everything has been taken from her, all is gone, she has nothing more: the heart is turned to water, the knees are shaking, all are twisted in pain, and colour has gone from all faces.
sentences.susu: Booree a falama, «Wo gbeti nun xɛɛma tongo. Naafuli gbegbe na e yi ra.»

sentences.english: Where is the lions' hole, the place where the young lions got their food, where the lion and the she-lion were walking with their young, without cause for fear?
sentences.susu: Kasarɛ, tuxunsanyi, nun gbaloe! Limaniya bara ba e yi ra, e sanyie mu xanfe e bun ma, e bɔɲɛ na tɔɔrɔfe, e lahalɛ bara masara.

sentences.english: Food enough for his young and for his she-lions was pulled down by the lion; his hole was full of flesh and his resting-place stored with meat.
sentences.susu: Taa sɛnbɛma naxan nu luxi alɔ yɛtɛ lude, yɛtɛ yɔrɛe nun e nga nu malabuxi xaxilisa kui dɛnnaxɛ, na taa munse sɔtɔxi yi ki?

sentences.english: See, I am against you, says the Lord of armies, and I will have your war-carriages burned in the smoke, and your young lions will be food for the sword: you will no longer get your food by force on the earth, and the voice of your she-lions will be stopped for ever.
sentences.susu: Na yɛtɛ sɛnbɛma nu sube faxama a xa ginɛ nun a xa die bɛ, a nu a xɔnyi rafema sube ibɔɔxi ra.

sentences.english: A curse is on the town of blood; it is full of deceit and violent acts; and there is no end to the taking of life.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na yi taa faxɛti bɛ, naxan nafexi yanfanteya, se muɲaxie, nun tɔɔrɔmixie ra.

sentences.english: The noise of the whip, and the noise of thundering wheels; horses rushing and war-carriages jumping,
sentences.susu: Luxusinyi xui minima naa, sɔɔri ragise sanyie xui minima, soee e gima, sɔɔri ragise e imaxama.

sentences.english: Horsemen driving forward, and the shining sword and the bright spear: and a great number of wounded, and masses of dead bodies; they are falling over the bodies of the dead:
sentences.susu: Soe ragie geresoma, santidɛgɛma lintanma alɔ tɛ luutie, tanbɛ wolima alɔ seyamakɔnyie, mixi faxaxie ralantanxi yire birin ma, fure saxie mu ɲɔnma, mixie e sanyi radinma furee ra.

sentences.english: Because of all the false ways of the loose woman, expert in attraction and wise in secret arts, who takes nations in the net of her false ways, and families through her secret arts.
sentences.susu: Na birin fatanxi a xa sɛniyɛntareɲa nan ma. A sie mabɛndunma a xa langoeɲa ra, a ɲamanɛe madaxuma a duureya ra.

sentences.english: See, I am against you, says the Lord of armies, and I will have your skirts pulled over your face, and let the nations see you unclothed, and the kingdoms your shame.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «N kelima nɛ wo xili ma, n wo rayaagima nɛ si birin ya xɔri, n wo mageli ti ɲamanɛe birin ya i.

sentences.english: I will make you completely disgusting and full of shame, and will put you up to be looked at by all.
sentences.susu: N wo makotoma nɛ nɔxɔɛ ra, n wo rayaagi.

sentences.english: And it will come about that all who see you will go in flight from you and say, Nineveh is made waste: who will be weeping for her? where am I to get comforters for her?
sentences.susu: Na kui, mixi yo na wo to, a a gima nɛ wo ma, a fa a fala, ‹Ninewe bara kana. Nde kinikinima a ma? Nde a madunduma?›»

sentences.english: Are you better than No-amon, seated on the Nile streams, with waters all round her; whose wall was the sea and her earthwork the waters?
sentences.susu: Ninewe, wo fisa Tebese bɛ, taa naxan dɔxɔxi Nili xure salonyie tagi, ye gbo dɛnnaxɛ? Baa nu findixi a xa tɛtɛ makantaxi nan na.

sentences.english: Ethiopia was her strength and Egyptians without number; Put and Lubim were her helpers.
sentences.susu: Kusi nun Misira nu sɛnbɛ fima nɛ a ma, Puti nun Libiya nu a malima.

sentences.english: But even she has been taken away, she has gone away as a prisoner: even her young children are smashed to bits at the top of all the streets: the fate of her honoured men is put to the decision of chance, and all her great men are put in chains.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Tebese fan bara xanin konyiya kui ɲamanɛ ma, a xa die bara faxa kira xunyie ra, a xa kuntigie bara mayegeti sigafe ra konyiya kui.

sentences.english: And you will be overcome with wine, you will become feeble; you will be looking for a safe place from those who are fighting against you.
sentences.susu: Wo tan dagalanma nɛ alɔ siisilae, wo wo nɔxunma nɛ wo yaxuie ya ra.

sentences.english: All your walled places will be like fig-trees and your people like the first figs, falling at a shake into the mouth which is open for them.
sentences.susu: Wo xa banxi makantaxie luxi nɛ alɔ xɔrɛ bilie, foye naxee bogi rayolonma mixie xa debe kui naxee wama e donfe.

sentences.english: See, the people who are in you are women; the doorways of your land are wide open to your attackers: the locks of your doors have been burned away in the fire.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ doro nan fa luxi wo xa bɔxi ma, sɔɔrie mu na sɔnɔn naxee wo makantama, wo xa naadɛe rabixi wo yaxuie ya ra, tɛ bara na balansee gan.

sentences.english: Get water for the time when you are shut in, make strong your towns: go into the potter's earth, stamping it down with your feet, make strong the brickworks.
sentences.susu: Wo ye ba, barima gere na fafe, wo nde sa wo xa tɛtɛ fari. Wo boora rafala, wo biriki bɔnbɔ.

sentences.english: There the fire will make you waste; you will be cut off by the sword: make yourself as great in number as the worms, as great in number as the locusts.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni, tɛ fama nɛ wo xa taa gande alɔ tugumie, santidɛgɛma fama nɛ wo sɔntɔde. Wo wo malan alɔ tugumie, wo wo malan alɔ katoe.

sentences.english: Let your traders be increased more than the stars of heaven:
sentences.susu: Wo bara yulɛe rawuya wo xɔnyi dangife tunbuie ra koore ma. Wo bara lu alɔ tugumie naxee tuganma, e siga.

sentences.english: Your crowned ones are like the locusts, and your scribes like the clouds of insects which take cover in the walls on a cold day, but when the sun comes up they go in flight, and are seen no longer in their place.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɔɔrie luxi nɛ alɔ tugumi naxee na tɛtɛ fari gɛɛsɛgɛ, kɔnɔ soge na te, e tugan, e siga yire mixi mu dɛnnaxɛ kolon.

sentences.english: Sorrow! how are the keepers of your flock sleeping, O king of Assyria! your strong men are at rest; your people are wandering on the mountains, and there is no one to get them together.
sentences.susu: Asiriya mangɛ, i xa yareratie na xife, i xa kuntigie saxi, i xa ɲama bara yensen yɛ geyae fari, mixi yo mu nɔma e xunlande.

sentences.english: Your pain may not be made better; you are wounded to death: all those hearing the news about you will be waving their hands in joy over you: for who has not undergone the weight of your evil-doing again and again?
sentences.susu: I xa gbaloe gbo, i xa fi mu yalanma. Mixi naxee birin i xa tɔɔrɛ xa fe mɛma, e e bɛlɛxɛ bɔnbɔma nɛ ɲɛlɛxinyi ma, barima mixi yo mu na wo mu kobiɲa rabaxi naxan na.

sentences.english: The word which Habakkuk the prophet saw.
sentences.susu: Annabi Habakuku xa masenyi nan ya, Alatala naxan masen a bɛ:

sentences.english: How long, O Lord, will your ears be shut to my voice? I make an outcry to you about violent behaviour, but you do not send salvation.
sentences.susu: «Alatala, n xa i maxandi han tɛmui mundun? Munfe ra i mu n ma dubɛ suxuxi? N bara n mawa i bɛ gere xa fe ra, kɔnɔ han ya i mu nu muxu ratanga.

sentences.english: Why do you make me see evil-doing, and why are my eyes fixed on wrong? for wasting and violent acts are before me: and there is fighting and bitter argument.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra i tinxi n ya xa kobiɲa to? I tinxi yi tɔɔrɛ mɔɔli ra munfe ra? Gbaloe nun gere na n ya ra tɛmui birin. Lantareya nun kalamui bara gbo yɛ.

sentences.english: For this reason the law is feeble and decisions are not effected: for the upright man is circled round by evil-doers; because of which right is twisted.
sentences.susu: Mixie bara gbilen i xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra. E bara i xa yaamari lu na. Tinxintare fuma tinxintɔɛ ma. Sɛriyɛ mu na sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: See among the nations, and take note, and be full of wonder: for in your days I am doing a work in which you will have no belief, even if news of it is given to you.
sentences.susu: «Wo wo ya ti ɲamanɛe ra, wo e mato. Wo kaabama nɛ, wo dɛ ixara, barima fe nde na rabafe wo xa waxati kui wo mu lama naxan na, hali na sa fala wo bɛ.

sentences.english: For see, I am sending the Chaldaeans, that bitter and quick-moving nation; who go through the wide spaces of the earth to get for themselves living-places which are not theirs.
sentences.susu: N na Kalidikae xun nakelife. Si kinikinitare nan e ra. E ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛe isama alako e xa bɔxie rasuxu, e gbe mu naxan na.

sentences.english: They are greatly to be feared: their right comes from themselves.
sentences.susu: E magaaxu, e mu fan. E yaamari tima yɛtɛ igboɲa nan na.

sentences.english: And their horses are quicker than leopards and their horsemen more cruel than evening wolves; they come from far away, like an eagle in flight rushing on its food.
sentences.susu: E xa soee xulun baratɛe bɛ. E xaaɲɛ wulai baree bɛ naxee minima kɔɛ ra. E xa soee fama sɛnbɛ ra kelife yire makuye. E mafura alɔ sɛgɛ, naxan goroma tɔxɔɛ yɔrɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: They are coming all of them with force; the direction of their faces is forward, the number of their prisoners is like the sands of the sea.
sentences.susu: Yi ɲama fama kanari nan xili ma, e yae banbanxi e sigade ra. E mixi suxuxie malanma alɔ mɛyɛnyi.

sentences.english: He makes little of kings, rulers are a sport to him; all the strong places are to be laughed at; for he makes earthworks and takes them.
sentences.susu: E yoma mangɛe ma, e kuntigie mayelema. E mu gaaxuma yire makantaxi ya ra. E bɛndɛ matema tɛtɛ ra, alako e xa so naa kui.

sentences.english: Then his purpose will be changed, over-stepping the limit; he will make his strength his god.
sentences.susu: E dangima alɔ foye belebele. E gbataxi fe ɲaaxi rabade. E bara e sɛnbɛ findi e xa ala ra.»

sentences.english: Are you not eternal, O Lord my God, my Holy One? for you there is no death. O Lord, he has been ordered by you for our punishment; and by you, O Rock, he has been marked out to put us right.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Sɛniyɛntɔɛ, n Marigi Alatala, i na na kabi fe fɔlɔ fɔlɛ. E mu fama muxu faxade. Alatala, i fama e tan nan makiitide. N Kanta Gɛmɛ na i tan nan na, i e ɲaxankatama nɛ.

sentences.english: Before your holy eyes sin may not be seen, and you are unable to put up with wrong; why, then, are your eyes on the false? why do you say nothing when the evil-doer puts an end to one who is more upright than himself?
sentences.susu: I yae sɛniyɛn, i mu wama kobiɲa tofe, i fe ɲaaxi xɔnxi. Awa, munfe ra i mu yanfantee halakima? Munfe ra i mu sese niyama tinxintaree ra e tinxintɔɛe tɔɔrɔma tɛmui naxɛ?

sentences.english: He has made men like the fishes of the sea, like the worms which have no ruler over them.
sentences.susu: I bara adamadie lu alɔ yɛxɛ naxee na baa ma, alɔ subee mangɛ mu na naxee bɛ.

sentences.english: He takes them all up with his hook, he takes them in his net, getting them together in his fishing-net: for which cause he is glad and full of joy.
sentences.susu: Muxu yaxuie muxu suxuma kɔnyi ra, e muxu suxuma yɛlɛ ra. E na gɛ muxu malande bɛki kui, e ɲɛlɛxin.

sentences.english: For this reason he makes an offering to his net, burning perfume to his fishing-net; because by them he gets much food and his meat is fat.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui e sɛrɛxɛ mɔɔli birin bama a xa yɛlɛ bɛ, barima na nan bara a niya e xa fɛɛrɛ gbegbe sɔtɔ. E donse fanyi donma a tan nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: For this cause his net is ever open, and there is no end to his destruction of the nations.
sentences.susu: A lanma e xa yɛlɛ xa nu siga yɛxɛe suxu ra, e xa nu bɔnsɔɛe rahalaki kinikinitareɲa kui?

sentences.english: I will take my position and be on watch, placing myself on my tower, looking out to see what he will say to me, and what answer he will give to my protest.
sentences.susu: «N fa tima tɛtɛ nan fari. N xa mamɛ ti. N xa a kolon a naxan masenma n bɛ, a n ma yaxaseri masa yaabima ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And the Lord gave me an answer, and said, Put the vision in writing and make it clear on stones, so that the reader may go quickly.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa n yaabi yi masenyi ra: «I xa n ma masenyi sɛbɛ, i xa a sɛbɛ a fanyi ra walaxɛe ma, alako naxee a xaranma, e xa nɔ birade a fɔxɔ ra sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: For the vision is still for the fixed time, and it is moving quickly to the end, and it will not be false: even if it is slow in coming, go on waiting for it; because it will certainly come, it will not be kept back.
sentences.susu: Yi masenyi kamali waxati fafe, a mu kanama, wule mu a ra. Xa i a to a taaxirima kamalide, i xa mamɛ ti. A kamalife mu buma.»

sentences.english: As for the man of pride, my soul has no pleasure in him; but the upright man will have life through his good faith.
sentences.susu: «Yɛtɛ igboe mato. A waxɔnfe mu tinxin, kɔnɔ tinxintɔɛ tan kisima a xa danxaniya nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: A curse on the cruel and false one! the man full of pride, who never has enough; who makes his desires wide as the underworld! he is like death; he is never full, but he makes all nations come to him, getting all peoples together to himself.
sentences.susu: Beere mixi mayanfama. Yɛtɛ igboe mu raxaraxi. A mu wasama, alɔ aligiyama mu wasama ki naxɛ. A ɲamanɛ birin findima a gbe nan na, a si birin sa a xa nɔɛ bun ma.

sentences.english: Will not all these take up a word of shame against him and a bitter saying against him, and say, A curse on him who goes on taking what is not his and is weighted down with the property of debtors!
sentences.susu: Na sie mu yoma a ma xɛ? E mu a mayelema xɛ, e a findi dɛi sigi ra?» «E fama nɛ a falade, ‹Ɲaxankatɛ na mixi bɛ naxan se malanma a gbe mu naxan na. A xa doni xun nan tun luma masa ra. Yi fe mɔɔli buma han mun tɛmui?

sentences.english: Will not your creditors suddenly be moved against you, and your troublers get up from their sleep, and you will be to them like goods taken in war?
sentences.susu: Naxee xa doni na i ma, nee mu kelima xɛ, e i raxunu, e i suxu, e e gbe ɲɔxɔ i ma?

sentences.english: Because you have taken their goods from great nations, all the rest of the peoples will take your goods from you; because of men's blood and violent acts against the land and the town and all who are living in it.
sentences.susu: I to bara si gbegbe xun nakana, naxee luxi fa, nee nan fama i fan xun nakanade. E na rabama nɛ i to bara mixi wuli ifili, i to bara bɔxie nun taae kana, i naakae fan faxa.›»

sentences.english: A curse on him who gets evil profits for his family, so that he may put his resting-place on high and be safe from the hand of the wrongdoer!
sentences.susu: «Ɲaxankatɛ na mixi bɛ naxan geenima tinxintareya kui alako a xa banxi fanyi ti a yɛtɛ bɛ tɔɔrɛ yo mu na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: You have been a cause of shame to your house by cutting off a number of peoples, and sinning against your soul.
sentences.susu: I naxan nabaxi a findima yaagi nan na i xa mixie bɛ. I ɲaxankatɛ naxan saxi ɲamae ma, a fama gbilende nɛ i ma.

sentences.english: For the stone will give a cry out of the wall, and it will be answered by the board out of the woodwork.
sentences.susu: I xa banxi tixi gɛmɛ naxan na, wuri naxan banbanxi a fari, e fama nɛ seedeɲɔxɔya bade i xili ma.»

sentences.english: A curse on him who is building a place with blood, and basing a town on evil-doing!
sentences.susu: «Ɲaxankatɛ na mixi bɛ naxan taa tima faxɛ ti saabui ra, naxan a xa taa ragboma fe kobi saabui ra.

sentences.english: See, is it not the pleasure of the Lord of armies that the peoples are working for the fire and using themselves up for nothing?
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala bara a niya, ɲamae xa wali birin xa gan, e xa wakili findima fe fufafui nan na.

sentences.english: For the earth will be full of the knowledge of the glory of the Lord as the sea is covered by the waters.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa birin fama nɛ Alatala xa nɔrɛ kolonde, alɔ banbaranyi gboma ki naxɛ baa ma.»

sentences.english: A curse on him who gives his neighbour the wine of his wrath, making him overcome with strong drink from the cup of his passion, so that you may be a witness of their shame!
sentences.susu: «Ɲaxankatɛ na mixi bɛ naxan a boore rasiisima alako sade fe xa lu e tagi.

sentences.english: You are full of shame in place of glory: take your part in the drinking, and let your shame be uncovered: the cup of the Lord's right hand will come round to you and your glory will be covered with shame.
sentences.susu: I xa xunnakeli findima nɛ yaagi ra. I fan xa beere min, i xa sade fe kolon. Alatala xa xɔnɛ fafe i ma, a i xa xunnakeli mafindima yaagi nan na.

sentences.english: For the violent acts against Lebanon will come on you, and the destruction of the cattle will be a cause of fear to you, because of men's blood and the violent acts against the land and the town and all who are living in it.
sentences.susu: I fe kobi naxan nabaxi Liban, na sare fama nɛ gbilende i ma. I bara xurusee kasara, i bara mixie faxa, i bara bɔxi nun taae kana, a nun e xa mixie. Na ɲaxankatɛ birin fama nɛ gbilende i ma.»

sentences.english: What profit is the pictured image to its maker? and as for the metal image, the false teacher, why does its maker put his faith in it, making false gods without a voice?
sentences.susu: «Kuye munse fanxi mixi ma? Mixi xa mu a yailanma? A wule nan tun masenma. A yailanma man fa a yɛtɛ taxu a ra. A bara ala boboe yailan.

sentences.english: A curse on him who says to the wood, Awake! to the unbreathing stone, Up! let it be a teacher! See, it is plated with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all inside it.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na mixi bɛ naxan a falama wuri masolixi bɛ, ‹Keli,› naxan wɔyɛnma gɛmɛ boboxi bɛ, ‹Xunu.› Kuye munse masenma i bɛ? Hali xɛɛma nun gbeti lu a ma, xaxili tan yo mu na a bɛ.

sentences.english: But the Lord is in his holy Temple: let all the earth be quiet before him.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Alatala na a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui. Duniɲa birin xa a sabari a ya i.»

sentences.english: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, put to Shigionoth.
sentences.susu: Annabi Habakuku xa Ala maxandi nan ya, naxan bama bɛɛti ki ma.

sentences.english: O Lord, word of you has come to my ears; I have seen your work, O Lord; when the years come near make it clear; in wrath keep mercy in mind.
sentences.susu: Alatala, n bara i xa masenyi mɛ, n bara kaaba i xa wali ma. I xa a ragiri yi waxati ma, i xa a rakamali mixie ya xɔri. Kɔnɔ i naxa nɛɛmu i xa kinikini ma i xa xɔnɛ kui.

sentences.english: God came from Teman, and the Holy One from Mount Paran. Selah. The heavens were covered with his glory, and the earth was full of his praise.
sentences.susu: N bara Ala Sɛniyɛnxi to fa ra kelife Teman mabiri, kelife Paran geya ma. Koore naxa rafe a xa nɔrɛ ra, duniɲa naxa rafe a xa matɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: He was shining like the light; he had rays coming out from his hand: there his power was kept secret.
sentences.susu: Ala xa yanbɛ sɛnbɛ gbo. Naiyalanyi nu kelima a bɛlɛxɛ kui, a sɛnbɛ nɔxunxi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Before him went disease, and flames went out at his feet.
sentences.susu: Wugan fure nu a ɲɛrɛma a ya ra, ɲaxankatɛ fan na a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: From his high place he sent shaking on the earth; he saw and nations were suddenly moved: and the eternal mountains were broken, the unchanging hills were bent down; his ways are eternal.
sentences.susu: A naxa ti, a duniɲa rasɛrɛn. A nɛfɛ a mato, bɔnsɔɛe bara halaki. Geya naxee ti duniɲa fɔlɛ ra, nee naxa sɛrɛn, e e igoro Alatala ya ra. Fɔlɛ mu na Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: The curtains of Cushan were troubled, and the tents of Midian were shaking.
sentences.susu: N naxa Kusankae to ɲaxankata ra, n naxa Madiyankae to sɛrɛn na.

sentences.english: Was your wrath burning against the rivers? were you angry with the sea, that you went on your horses, on your war-carriages of salvation?
sentences.susu: Alatala, i nu xɔnɔxi nɛ xuree ma? I to ti i xa geresoe ya ra, e nun e xa soee nun e xa gisee, i nu xɔnɔxi nɛ baa ma?

sentences.english: Your bow was quite uncovered. Selah. By you the earth was cut through with rivers.
sentences.susu: I naxa i xa xali ramini, i naxa tanbɛ wuyaxi suxu. I naxa xuree rabɔɔ bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: The mountains saw you and were moved with fear; the clouds were streaming with water: the voice of the deep was sounding; the sun did not come up, and the moon kept still in her place.
sentences.susu: Geyae to i to, e naxa sɛrɛn. Tunɛ xungbe naxa fa. Baa naxa a xui ramini, mɔrɔnyie naxa te.

sentences.english: At the light of your arrows they went away, at the shining of your polished spear.
sentences.susu: Soge nun kike naxa e xa wali iti e to i xa tanbɛe to yanba ra koore alɔ seyamakɔnyi.

sentences.english: You went stepping through the land in wrath, crushing the nations in your passion.
sentences.susu: I naxa ti bɔxi fari, i fa ɲamanɛe raboron ɲɛ i xa xɔnɛ kui.

sentences.english: You went out for the salvation of your people, for the salvation of the one on whom your holy oil was put; wounding the head of the family of the evil-doer, uncovering the base even to the neck. Selah.
sentences.susu: I naxa i xa ɲama rakisi, i man fa i xa Mixi Sugandixi ratanga. I naxa bɔnsɔɛ kobie xa mangɛ butuxun, i a xa see birin findi xube ra.

sentences.english: You have put your spears through his head, his horsemen were sent in flight like dry stems; they had joy in driving away the poor, in making a meal of them secretly.
sentences.susu: A xa sɔɔrie naxa mini muxu xili ma, e xa tɔɔrɔmixie halaki ɲɛlɛxinyi kui gundo ra, kɔnɔ i tan naxa e xa mangɛ sɔxɔ a yɛtɛ xa tanbɛ ra.

sentences.english: The feet of your horses were on the sea, on the mass of great waters.
sentences.susu: I naxa kira rabɔɔ i xa soee bɛ, e xa dangi baa tagi.

sentences.english: Hearing it, my inner parts were moved, and my lips were shaking at the sound; my bones became feeble, and my steps were uncertain under me: I gave sounds of grief in the day of trouble, when his forces came up against the people in bands.
sentences.susu: N to i xa masenyi mɛ, n bɔɲɛ naxa mini a i, n dɛ naxa ixara, n xɔrie naxa tagan, n sanyie naxa sɛrɛn. N na lɔxɔɛ mamɛfe i muxu yaxuie ɲaxankatama lɔxɔɛ naxɛ.

sentences.english: For though the fig-tree has no flowers, and there is no fruit on the vine, and work on the olive comes to nothing, and the fields give no food; and the flock is cut off from its resting-place, and there is no herd in the cattle-house:
sentences.susu: Hali fuge mu na xɔrɛ bili ma, hali wɛni bogi mu na a firi ma, hali bogi yo mu bama wuri bilie kɔn na, hali sansie mu fanma xɛ ma, hali xurusee mu na kulɛ kui, hali ninge keren mu lu gɔɔrɛ,

sentences.english: Still, I will be glad in the Lord, my joy will be in the God of my salvation.
sentences.susu: na birin kui, n Alatala matɔxɔma nɛ, n sɛɛwa Ala ra, n ma Marakisima.

sentences.english: The Lord God is my strength, and he makes my feet like roes' feet, guiding me on my high places. For the chief music-maker on corded instruments.
sentences.susu: N sɛnbɛ na n Marigi Alatala nan na. A n ma ɲɛrɛ sɔɔnɛyama nɛ fe xɔrɔxɔɛ kui, alɔ xeli xa ɲɛrɛ sɔɔnɛyama geyae fari ki naxɛ. Yi sɛbɛxi bɛɛtiba mangɛ nan bɛ. A xa a ba kɔra xui ra.

sentences.english: The word of the Lord which came to Zephaniah, the son of Cushi, the son of Gedaliah, the son of Amariah, the son of Hezekiah, in the days of Josiah, the son of Amon, king of Judah.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, a naxan tixi Annabi Sofoni bɛ. Sofoni findi Kuusi xa di nan na, Gɛdalaya xa mamadi, Amaraya tolobitɛ, Xesekiya bɔnsɔɛ. A masenyi ti nɛ Yudaya mangɛ Yosiya xa waxati, naxan findixi Amon xa di ra.

sentences.english: I will take away everything from the face of the earth, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: «Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: N birin ɲɔnma nɛ duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari.

sentences.english: I will take away man and beast; I will take away the birds of the heaven and the fishes of the sea; causing the downfall of the evil-doers, and cutting man off from the face of the earth, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N adama nun sube ɲɔnma nɛ, n xɔni ba koore ma, n yɛxɛ ba baa ma. N maratantanyi nun mixi ɲaaxi ɲɔnma nɛ, n adamadie ba duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And my hand will be stretched out on Judah and on all the people of Jerusalem, cutting off the name of the Baal from this place, and the name of the false priests,
sentences.susu: «N nan n bɛlɛxɛ italama nɛ Yudaya nun Darisalamukae xili ma. N Bali kuye bama nɛ, naxee luxi bɔxi ma. N e xa batui yareratie nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛe sɔntɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: And the worshippers of the army of heaven on the house-tops, and the Lord's worshippers who take oaths by Milcom,
sentences.susu: N mixie halakima nɛ, naxee tunbuie batuma e xa banxi fari. N filankafuie ɲaxankatama nɛ, naxee e kali Alatala xili ra, e man e kali Mɔlɔkɔ kuye xili ra.

sentences.english: And those who are turned back from going after the Lord, and those who have not made prayer to the Lord or got directions from him.
sentences.susu: N mixie rabɛɲinma nɛ naxee bara gbilen Alatala fɔxɔ ra, naxee mu Alatala fenma, naxee mu birama a xa marasi fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: Let there be no sound before the Lord God: for the day of the Lord is near: for the Lord has made ready an offering, he has made his guests holy.
sentences.susu: «Wo sabari Marigi Alatala bɛ, barima a xa lɔxɔɛ xungbe na fafe. Alatala tan sɛrɛxɛ nan bama. A mixi ndee sugandixi na nan ma.

sentences.english: And it will come about in the day of the Lord's offering, that I will send punishment on the rulers and the king's sons and all who are clothed in robes from strange lands.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛ lɔxɔɛ, n mangɛ xa die nun kuntigie halakima nɛ, a nun mixi naxee si gbɛtɛ xa dugie ragoroma e ma.

sentences.english: And in that day I will send punishment on all those who come jumping over the doorstep and make their master's house full of violent behaviour and deceit.
sentences.susu: N mixie halakima nɛ naxee tuganma sode dɛ ra, naxee e marigi xa banxi rafema gere nun yanfanteya ra.»

sentences.english: And in that day, says the Lord, there will be the sound of a cry from the fish doorway, and an outcry from the new town, and a great thundering from the hills, and cries of grief from the people of the Hollow;
sentences.susu: «Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Na lɔxɔɛ mixi gbelegbelema nɛ, kelife taa naadɛ ma naxan xili Yɛxɛ Naadɛ, han taa nɛɛnɛ, kelife taa fari geyae ma,

sentences.english: Because of the downfall of all the people of Canaan: all those who were weighted down with silver have been cut off.
sentences.susu: han makiti yire, barima yulɛe xa fe bara kana, n bara e birin faxa.

sentences.english: And it will come about at that time, that I will go searching through Jerusalem with lights; and I will send punishment on the men who have become like wine stored over-long, who say to themselves, The Lord will not do good and will not do evil.
sentences.susu: Na waxati n Darisalamu yire birin matoma nɛ a fanyi ra, alako n xa mixi sɔntɔ, naxee dɔxɔxi e xa naafuli makantafe ra, e a falafe e bɔɲɛ kui, ‹Fe fanyi yo, fe ɲaaxi yo, Ala mu fama fefe rabade n na.›

sentences.english: And their wealth will be violently taken away, and their houses will be made waste: they will go on building houses and never living in them, and planting vine-gardens but not drinking the wine from them.
sentences.susu: E xa naafuli lɔɛma nɛ, e xa banxie kana. E bara banxi ti, kɔnɔ e mu sabatima na kui. E bara wɛni bogi si, kɔnɔ e mu na wɛni minma sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: The great day of the Lord is near, it is near and coming very quickly; the bitter day of the Lord is near, coming on more quickly than a man of war.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa lɔxɔɛ xungbe bara makɔrɛ, a gbe mu luxi a xa fa. Sɛnbɛmae fama nɛ gbelegbelede Alatala xa lɔxɔɛ magaaxuxi ma.

sentences.english: That day is a day of wrath, a day of trouble and sorrow, a day of wasting and destruction, a day of dark night and deep shade, a day of cloud and thick dark.
sentences.susu: Xɔnɛ lɔxɔɛ na a ra, tɔɔrɛ lɔxɔɛ na a ra, gbaloe lɔxɔɛ na a ra, dimi lɔxɔɛ na a ra, nuxui ifɔɔrɔxi lɔxɔɛ na a ra.

sentences.english: A day of sounding the horn and the war-cry against the walled towns and the high towers.
sentences.susu: Gere xui minima nɛ na lɔxɔɛ taa sɛnbɛmae xili ma, e xa yire makantaxie xili ma.

sentences.english: And I will send trouble on men so that they will go about like the blind, because they have done evil against the Lord: and their blood will be drained out like dust, and their strength like waste.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxɛ, «N adamadie tɔɔrɔma nɛ na lɔxɔɛ, e fa ɲɛrɛ alɔ dɔnxuie, barima e bara yunubi raba Alatala ra. Na kui e sɔntɔma nɛ a ɲaaxi ra, e wuli ramini bɔxi ma a gbegbe ra, e binbie wɔlɛ ɲooge xɔɔra.

sentences.english: Even their silver and their gold will not be able to keep them safe in the day of the Lord's wrath; but all the land will be burned up in the fire of his bitter wrath: for he will put an end, even suddenly, to all who are living in the land.
sentences.susu: E xa xɛɛma nun gbeti mu nɔma e ratangade Alatala xa xɔnɛ lɔxɔɛ ma. Duniɲa birin ganma nɛ na lɔxɔɛ a ɲaaxi ra Alatala xa xɔnɛ xa fe ra, barima a xa ɲama bara bira ala gbɛtɛe fɔxɔ ra. Na kui duniɲa mixi birin sɔntɔma nɛ.»

sentences.english: Come together, make everyone come together, O nation without shame;
sentences.susu: «Si yaagitare, wo xa wo yɛtɛ mato,

sentences.english: Before the Lord sends you violently away in flight like the waste from the grain; before the burning wrath of the Lord comes on you, before the day of the Lord's wrath comes on you.
sentences.susu: beenu waxati xa kamali, beenu Alatala xa xɔnɛ xa wo li, beenu Alatala xa lɔxɔɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ xa fa wo ma. Na lɔxɔɛ dangima nɛ alɔ maale lagi foye naxan tutunma.

sentences.english: Make search for the Lord, all you quiet ones of the earth, who have done what is right in his eyes; make search for righteousness and a quiet heart: it may be that you will be safely covered in the day of the Lord's wrath.
sentences.susu: Wo tan mixi magoroxi naxee na Isirayila, wo xa Alatala fen, wo xa a xa sɛriyɛ rabatu, wo xa tinxinyi, nun yɛtɛ magore fen. Tɛmunde na kui wo nɔma nɛ ratangade Alatala xa xɔnɛ lɔxɔɛ ma.»

sentences.english: For Gaza will be given up and Ashkelon will become waste: they will send Ashdod out in the middle of the day, and Ekron will be uprooted.
sentences.susu: «Gasa rabɛɲinma nɛ, Asikalɔn kana, Asidodi keri ɲama ya xɔri, Ekiron tala.

sentences.english: Sorrow to the people living by the sea, the nation of the Cherethites! The word of the Lord is against you, O Canaan, the land of the Philistines; I will send destruction on you till there is no one living in you.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na wo bɛ, wo tan naxee sabatixi baa dɛ ra, wo tan naxee kelixi Kirɛti. Alatala bara natɛ tongo wo xa fe ra, Kanaanka naxee na Filisita bɔxi ma, n wo xun nakanama nɛ han mixi birin ɲɔn wo yi.

sentences.english: And the land by the sea will be grass-land, with houses for keepers of sheep and walled places for flocks.
sentences.susu: Xurusee fama nɛ lude wo xa bɔxi ma, wo xɔnyi findi gɔɔrɛ ra xuruse dɛmadonyie bɛ.

sentences.english: The land by the sea will be for the rest of the children of Judah; by the sea they will give their flocks food: in the houses of Ashkelon they will take their rest in the evening; for the Lord their God will take them in hand and their fate will be changed.
sentences.susu: Na bɔxi findima Yudayaka mixi dɔnxɔɛe nan gbe ra, e fa e xa xurusee dɛ madonde naa. Nunmare tɛmui e e malabuma nɛ Asikalɔn xa banxie kui, barima e Marigi Alatala fama nɛ e malide, a e xa mixi suxuxie ragbilen e xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: My ears have been open to the bitter words of Moab and the words of shame of the children of Ammon, which they have said against my people, lifting themselves up against the limit of their land.
sentences.susu: «N bara Mowabakae xa konbie mɛ, Amonikae xa wɔyɛn bɛxuxie bara n li. E bara n ma ɲama rayaagi, e bara dangi naaninyi ra.»

sentences.english: For this cause, by my life, says the Lord of armies, the God of Israel, truly Moab will become like Sodom and the children of Ammon like Gomorrah, given up to waste plants and salt pools and unpeopled for ever: the rest of my people will take their property, the overflow of my nation will take their heritage.
sentences.susu: «N tan Isirayila Marigi Alatala, Xili Xungbe Kanyi, n bara n kali Mowaba luma nɛ alɔ Sodoma, Amonikae lu alɔ Gomorakae, e xa bɔxi kana, ɲooge ɲaaxi nun fɔxɛ lu naa.

sentences.english: This will be their fate because of their pride, because they have said evil, lifting themselves up against the people of the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: E na sɔtɔma e xa yɛtɛ igboɲa nan ma. E bara Alatala Xili Xungbe Kanyi xa ɲama rayaagi, e bara te a xa ɲama xili ma.

sentences.english: The Lord will let himself be seen by them: for he will make all the gods of the earth feeble; and men will go down before him in worship, everyone from his place, even all the sea-lands of the nations.
sentences.susu: Alatala magaaxu, a e ɲaxankatama nɛ a ɲaaxi ra. A kuye birin kanama nɛ duniɲa ma, si birin fa Alatala batu e xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: And you Ethiopians will be put to death by my sword.
sentences.susu: «Wo tan Kusikae, wo fan sɔxɔma nɛ n ma santidɛgɛma ra.»

sentences.english: And his hand will be stretched out against the north, for the destruction of Assyria; and he will make Nineveh unpeopled and dry like the waste land.
sentences.susu: «Ala a sɛnbɛ raminima nɛ kɔɔla ma, a fa Asiriya sɔntɔ. A Ninewe xun nakanama nɛ, a na findi gbengberen yire ra.

sentences.english: And herds will take their rest in the middle of her, all the beasts of the valley: the pelican and the porcupine will make their living-places on the tops of its pillars; the owl will be crying in the window; the raven will be seen on the doorstep.
sentences.susu: Xurusee luma nɛ e dɛ madon na na taa kui, a nun wulai sube mɔɔli birin. Yubɛ nun xundi kɔɛ radangima nɛ na banxi kanaxie fari. Naadɛ nun wundɛri birin kanaxi, e xa wuri bara bɔrɔ.

sentences.english: This is the town which was full of joy, living without fear of danger, saying in her heart, I am, and there is no other: how has she been made waste, a place for beasts to take their rest in! everyone who goes by her will make hisses, waving his hand.
sentences.susu: Yi taa xungbe naxan nu luma ɲɛlɛxin na, naxan bɔɲɛ nu saxi, naxan nu bara a fala a yɛtɛ bɛ, ‹N keren nan tide gbo,› a xun bara rakana han a bara findi wulai subee xɔnyi ra. Dangi mixi birin yoma nɛ a ma sɔnɔn, a findi dɛi sigi ra e bɛ.»

sentences.english: Sorrow to her who is uncontrolled and unclean, the cruel town!
sentences.susu: «Ɲaxankatɛ na i bɛ, taa matandila sɛniyɛntare, naxan luma mixi tɔɔrɔ ra.

sentences.english: She gave no attention to the voice, she had no use for teaching, she put no faith in the Lord, she did not come near to her God.
sentences.susu: A mu n xui suxuma, a mu n ma marasi rabatuma, a mu a xaxili tima Alatala ra, a mu makɔrɛxi a Marigi Ala ra.

sentences.english: Her rulers are like loud-voiced lions in her; her judges are wolves of the evening, crushing up the bones before the morning.
sentences.susu: A xa kuntigie luma nɛ alɔ yɛtɛ naxee e xui raminima ɲama tagi, a xa kiitisamae luxi alɔ wulai bare naxee sube donma keren na.

sentences.english: Her prophets are good-for-nothing persons, full of deceit: her priests have made the holy place unclean and have gone violently against the law.
sentences.susu: A xa namiɲɔnmɛe findixi yɛtɛ igboee nun yanfantee nan na, a xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe bara fe sɛniyɛnxie nɔxɔ, a bara Ala xa sɛriyɛ matandi.

sentences.english: The Lord in her is upright; he will not do evil; every morning he lets his righteousness be seen, he is unchanging; but the evil-doer has no sense of shame.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala nan tinxin na mixie ya ma. A mu mixi madaxuma, lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ a xa nɔndi yanbama. A tan mu lanlanteya kanama, kɔnɔ tinxintare mu yaagi kolon.»

sentences.english: I have had the nations cut off, their towers are broken down; I have made their streets a waste so that no one goes through them: destruction has overtaken their towns, so that there is no man living in them.
sentences.susu: «N bara sie ɲaxankata, n bara e xa yire makantaxie rabira, n bara e xa kirae kana. Mixi yo mu na e xa taae kui sɔnɔn, e birin xun nakanaxi.

sentences.english: I said, Certainly you will go in fear of me, and come under my training, so that whatever I may send on her may not be cut off before her eyes: but they got up early and made all their works evil.
sentences.susu: N nu bara a fala e bɛ, ‹Xa wo gaaxu n ya ra, xa wo n ma marasi suxu, wo xun mu rakanama.› Kɔnɔ e gbata fe ɲaaxi rabade. Na nan a toxi n bara e ɲaxankata.

sentences.english: For this reason, go on waiting for me, says the Lord, till the day when I come up as a witness: for my purpose is to send for the nations and to get the kingdoms together, so that I may let loose on them my passion, even all my burning wrath: for all the earth will be burned up in the fire of my bitter passion.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Wo xa mamɛ ti, lɔxɔɛ fama a lide n ma natɛ kamalima tɛmui naxɛ. N bara a fala wo bɛ, na lɔxɔɛ n sie ɲaxankatama nɛ n ma xɔnɛ ɲaaxi ra, duniɲa birin xa kana.»

sentences.english: For then I will give the people a clean language, so that they may all make prayer to the Lord and be his servants with one mind.
sentences.susu: «N fama sie rasɛniyɛnde, alako e xa Alatala xili fala, e birin xa a rabatu lanyi kui.

sentences.english: From over the rivers of Ethiopia, and from the sides of the north, they will come to me with an offering.
sentences.susu: Kelife yire makuye dangife Kusi xuree ra, n batulae fama nɛ sɛrɛxɛe ra n bɛ.

sentences.english: In that day you will have no shame on account of all the things in which you did evil against me: for then I will take away from among you those who were lifted up in pride, and you will no longer be lifted up with pride in my holy mountain.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ wo mu yaagima sɔnɔn wo xa fe rabaxie ra, wo fe ɲaaxi naxee rabaxi n na, barima n yɛtɛ igboee bama nɛ wo ya ma, alako yɛtɛ igboɲa xa ɲɔn n ma geya sɛniyɛnxi yire.

sentences.english: But I will still have among you a quiet and poor people, and they will put their faith in the name of the Lord.
sentences.susu: N tɔɔrɔmixie nun mixi magoroxie luma nɛ wo ya ma, naxee xaxili tima Alatala ra.

sentences.english: The rest of Israel will do no evil and say no false words; the tongue of deceit will not be seen in their mouth: for they will take their food and their rest, and no one will be a cause of fear to them.
sentences.susu: Isirayila dɔnxɔɛ mu fe ɲaaxi rabama sɔnɔn, e mu wule falama, e mu mixi madaxuma. E luma nɛ e malabu ra bɔɲɛsa kui, mixi yo mu e tɔɔrɔma sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: Make melody, O daughter of Zion; give a loud cry, O Israel; be glad and let your heart be full of joy, O daughter of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Siyon mixie, wo xa Ala matɔxɔ. Isirayila, wo xa sɛɛwa. Darisalamu, wo xa ɲɛlɛxin wo bɔɲɛ birin na.

sentences.english: The Lord has taken away those who were judging you, he has sent your haters far away: the King of Israel, even the Lord, is among you: you will have no more fear of evil.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa xɔnɛ bara gbilen wo fɔxɔ ra, a bara wo yaxuie ragbilen e xɔnyi. Isirayila Mangɛ Alatala bara lu wo tagi. Wo naxa gaaxu, wo mu tɔɔrɔma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: In that day it will be said to Jerusalem, Have no fear: O Zion, let not your hands be feeble.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ a a falama nɛ Darisalamu bɛ, «Siyon mixie, wo naxa gaaxu, limaniya naxa ba wo yi ra.»

sentences.english: The Lord your God is among you, as a strong saviour: he will be glad over you with joy, he will make his love new again, he will make a song of joy over you as in the time of a holy feast.
sentences.susu: Wo Marigi Alatala wo Rakisima na wo ya ma. A sɛɛwama nɛ wo xa fe ra, a wo madundu a xa xanunteya ra, a ɲɛlɛxin wo ra a xui itexi ra.

sentences.english: I will take away your troubles, lifting up your shame from off you.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxɛ, «N sunnunyi bama nɛ wo xa salie kui, n wo ba wo xa yaagi xɔrɔxɔɛ kui.

sentences.english: See, at that time I will put an end to all who have been troubling you: I will give salvation to her whose steps are uncertain, and get together her who has been sent in flight; and I will make them a cause of praise and an honoured name in all the earth, when I let their fate be changed.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ n wo yaxuie ɲaxankatama nɛ, n tɔɔrɔmixie rakisi, n mixi kerixie ragbilen e xɔnyi. N e xa yaagi ɲɔxɔma nɛ matɔxɔɛ nun binyɛ ra yire birin.

sentences.english: At that time I will make you come in, at that time I will get you together: for I will make you a name and a praise among all the peoples of the earth when I let your fate be changed before your eyes, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ n wo ragbilenma nɛ wo xɔnyi. N wo malanma nɛ alako wo xa matɔxɔɛ nun binyɛ sɔtɔ, duniɲa ɲamanɛ birin kui. N wo ragbilenma nɛ, wo fa na tode. Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: In the second year of Darius the king, in the sixth month, on the first day of the month, came the word of the Lord by Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, ruler of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, saying,
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Dariyusi xa mangɛya ɲɛ firin nde, kike senni nde, xi singe ra, Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti Salatiyeli xa di Sorobabeli bɛ, Yudaya gomina, Annabi Hage saabui ra. A man naxa yi masenyi ti sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi Yosadaki xa di Yosuwe bɛ.

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord of armies: These people say, The time has not come for building the Lord's house.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Yi ɲama a falama, ‹A mu lan won xa Alatala xa banxi yailan sinden.›»

sentences.english: Then the word of the Lord came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
sentences.susu: Na kui, Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti e bɛ Annabi Hage saabui ra,

sentences.english: Is it a time for you to be living in roofed houses while this house is a waste?
sentences.susu: «A lanma wo tan xa lu banxi raxunmaxi kui, n tan ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi kanaxi?»

sentences.english: For this cause the Lord of armies has said, Give thought to your ways.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Wo wo xa wali mato.

sentences.english: Much has been planted, but little got in; you take food, but have not enough; you take drink, but are not full; you are clothed, but no one is warm; and he who gets payment for his work, gets it to put it into a bag full of holes.
sentences.susu: Wo sansi xɔri gbegbe sima, kɔnɔ wo naxan sɔtɔma, na xurun. Wo wo dɛgema, kɔnɔ wo mu lugama. Wo wo minma, kɔnɔ a mu wo ralima. Wo xinbeli donma ragoroma wo ma, kɔnɔ xinbeli mu bama wo ma. Wo wo xa wali sare sɔtɔma, kɔnɔ yale na wo xa yubae ma.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: Give thought to your ways.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Wo wo xa wali mato.

sentences.english: Go up to the hills and get wood and put up the house; and I will take pleasure in it and be honoured, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo te geya fari wuri fende, wo xa n ma banxi ti alako n xa binyɛ sɔtɔ naxan nafanxi n ma.» Alatala xa masenyi nan a ra.

sentences.english: You were looking for much, and it came to little; and when you got it into your house, I took it away with a breath. Why? says the Lord of armies. Because of my house which is a waste, while every man takes care of the house which is his.
sentences.susu: «Wo bara wa harige gbegbe xɔn ma, kɔnɔ wo dondoronti gbansan nan sɔtɔxi. Wo bara na xanin wo xɔnyie, n bara na fan nayensen ɲɛ. Na kelixi munse ma? Na kelixi n ma banxi xa kanɛ nan ma fe ra. A fa li, kankan singanxi wakili ma a gbe wali tan na, kɔnɔ wo mu sese rabama n gbe wali tan xa fe ra.» Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan a ra.

sentences.english: For this cause the heaven over you is kept from giving dew, and the earth from giving her fruit.
sentences.susu: «Na fe bara a niya tunɛ ye mu goroma, bɔxi mu daxamui raminima.

sentences.english: And by my order no rain came on the land or on the mountains or the grain or the wine or the oil or the produce of the earth or on men or cattle or on any work of man's hands.
sentences.susu: N bara a niya bɔxi nun geyae xa xara, wo xa mɛngi, wo xa wɛni nɛɛnɛ, wo xa ture, wo xa sansie, wo xa mixie, wo xa xurusee, nun wo xa wali birin xa naxasi.»

sentences.english: Then Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, and Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and all the rest of the people, gave ear to the voice of the Lord their God and to the words of Haggai the prophet, because the Lord their God had sent him, and the people were in fear before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Salatiyeli xa di Sorobabeli, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi Yosadaki xa di Yosuwe, nun ɲama dɔnxɔɛ birin naxa e Marigi Alatala xui suxu, a naxan fixi Annabi Hage ma. Ɲama naxa gaaxu Alatala ya ra.

sentences.english: Then Haggai, whom the Lord had sent to give his words to the people, said, I am with you, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa xɛɛra Annabi Hage naxa Alatala xa yi masenyi fala ɲama bɛ, «Won birin nan a ra.» Alatala xa masenyi nan a ra.

sentences.english: And the spirit of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, ruler of Judah, was moved by the Lord, as was the spirit of Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and the spirit of all the rest of the people; and they came and did work in the house of the Lord of armies, their God.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa Salatiyeli xa di Sorobabeli, Yudaya gomina bɔɲɛ rawutun. A man naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi Yosadaki xa di Yosuwe nun ɲama dɔnxɔɛ bɔɲɛ rawutun. Na naxa a niya e xa e Marigi Alatala xa banxi ti wali suxu,

sentences.english: On the twenty-fourth day of the month, in the sixth month, in the second year of Darius the king.
sentences.susu: Dariyusi xa mangɛya ɲɛ firin nde, kike senni nde, xi mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nde ra.

sentences.english: In the seventh month, on the twenty-first day of the month, the word of the Lord came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
sentences.susu: A kike solofere nde, xi mɔxɔɲɛn nun keren nde ra, Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti Annabi Hage saabui ra,

sentences.english: Say now to Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, ruler of Judah, and to Joshua, the son of Jehozadak, the high priest, and to the rest of the people,
sentences.susu: «A fala Salatiyeli xa di Sorobabeli bɛ, Yudaya gomina, nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi Yosadaki xa di Yosuwe, nun ɲama dɔnxɔɛ bɛ,

sentences.english: Who is there still among you who saw this house in its first glory? and how do you see it now? is it not in your eyes as nothing?
sentences.susu: ‹Nde na wo ya ma naxan bara yi banxi to nu a forima ki a xa nɔrɛ kui? Yakɔsi tan go, wo a toma di? Tide yo mu na a ma wo bɛ sɔnɔn, ka?›»

sentences.english: But now be strong, O Zerubbabel, says the Lord; and be strong, O Joshua, son of Jehozadak, the high priest; and be strong, all you people of the land, says the Lord, and get to work: for I am with you, says the Lord of armies:
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Sorobabeli, i i sɛnbɛ so. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi Yosuwe Yosadaki xa di, i i sɛnbɛ so. Ɲama birin, wo wo sɛnbɛ so.» Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Wo wali suxu, won birin na a ra.» Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: The agreement which I made with you when you came out of Egypt, and my spirit, are with you still; have no fear.
sentences.susu: «N to wo ramini Misira bɔxi ma, n nu bara yi saatɛ tongo wo bɛ. N xaxili na wo tagi, wo naxa gaaxu fefe ma.»

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord of armies has said: In a short time I will make a shaking of the heavens and the earth and the sea and the dry land;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «A gbe mu luxi n xa koore nun bɔxi rasɛrɛn, n xa baa nun xare ramaxa.

sentences.english: And I will make a shaking of all the nations, and the desired things of all nations will come: and I will make this house full of my glory, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: N si birin nasɛrɛnma nɛ, e fama nɛ harige gbegbe ra n bɛ naxee fan a birin bɛ. Yi banxi kui rafema nɛ nɔrɛ ra.» Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: The silver is mine and the gold is mine, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: «N tan nan gbe na gbeti ra, n tan nan gbe na xɛɛma ra.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: The second glory of this house will be greater than the first, says the Lord of armies: and in this place I will give peace, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: «Nɔrɛ naxan fama lude n ma banxi ma, na dangima nɛ a singe ra.» Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki. «N yi banxi findima bɔɲɛsa yire nan na mixie bɛ.» Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: On the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came by Haggai the prophet, saying,
sentences.susu: Dariyusi xa mangɛya ɲɛ firin nde, kike solomanaani, xi mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nde ra, Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti Annabi Hage bɛ,

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord of armies: Put now a point of law to the priests, saying,
sentences.susu: «Alatala xa masenyi nan ya. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe maxɔrin,

sentences.english: If anyone has some holy flesh folded in the skirt of his robe, will bread or soup or wine or oil or any other food be made holy if touched by his skirt? And the priests answering said, No.
sentences.susu: ‹Xa mixi nde sube sɛniyɛnxi sa a xa sose kui, a fa na sose din taami, wɛni, ture, xa na mu a ra donse gbɛtɛ ra naxan mu sɛniyɛnxi, na sɛniyɛnma na sube sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra?› Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe i yaabima nɛ, ‹Ade.›»

sentences.english: Then Haggai said, Will any of these be made unclean by the touch of one who is unclean through touching a dead body? And the priests answering said, It will be made unclean.
sentences.susu: Annabi Hage naxa e maxɔrin, «Xa mixi nde din fure ra, a fa findi sɛniyɛntare ra, a din sese ra, na fan findima nɛ se sɛniyɛntare ra?» Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxa a yaabi, «Iyo, na fan findima nɛ se sɛniyɛntare ra.»

sentences.english: Then Haggai said, So is this people and so is this nation before me, says the Lord; and so is every work of their hands; and the offering they give there is unclean.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Annabi Hage man naxa a masen, «Yi ɲama na na ki nɛ. Si naxan na n ya tode ra, e na na ki nɛ.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki. «E bɛlɛxɛ fɔxi mu sɛniyɛn, e naxan bama sɛrɛxɛ ra se sɛniyɛntare nan a ra.»

sentences.english: And now, give thought, looking back from this day to the time before one stone was put on another in the Temple of the Lord:
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi, wo fe mato a fanyi ra naxan fama rabade keli to ma han yare. Beenun wo xa gɛmɛ dɔxɔ a boore fari Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi wali kui, wo xa ratu yi ma:

sentences.english: How, when anyone came to a store of twenty measures, there were only ten: when anyone went to the wine-store to get fifty vessels full, there were only twenty.
sentences.susu: Wo to nu busali mɔxɔɲɛn fenma, wo nu fu gbansan nan sɔtɔma. Wo to nu ture litiri tongo suuli fenma, wo nu litiri mɔxɔɲɛn gbansan nan sɔtɔma.

sentences.english: And I sent burning and wasting and a rain of ice-drops on all the works of your hands; but still you were not turned to me, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N bara wo xa wali birin kana fure nun balabalanyi ra, kɔnɔ wo mu tin gbilende n ma.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And now, give thought; looking on from this day, from the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month, from the time when the base of the Lord's house was put in its place, give thought to it.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi, wo a mato a fanyi ra, fe naxan fama rabade keli to ma han yare, keli yi kike solomanaani xi mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani ma, keli Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa gɛmɛ singe dɔxɔ lɔxɔɛ ma. Wo xa wo ɲɔxɔ sa na xɔn ma a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Is the seed still in the store-house? have the vine and the fig-tree, the pomegranate and the olive-tree, still not given their fruit? from this day I will send my blessing on you.
sentences.susu: Mɛngi ragataxi mu na wo xa sentie kui, ka? Wɛni bili, xɔrɛ bili, kɔɔbɛ bili, nun oliwi bili, nee fan mu bogife hali keren. Kɔnɔ, fɔlɔ to ma, n fama nɛ barakɛ sade wo ma.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came a second time to Haggai, on the twenty-fourth day of the month, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala man naxa masenyi firin nde ti Annabi Hage bɛ, xi mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nde ra.

sentences.english: Say to Zerubbabel, ruler of Judah, I will make a shaking of the heavens and the earth,
sentences.susu: «A fala Sorobabeli bɛ Yudaya gomina, ‹N koore nun bɔxi rasɛrɛnma nɛ.

sentences.english: Overturning the power of kingdoms; and I will send destruction on the strength of the kingdoms of the nations; by me war-carriages will be overturned with those who are in them; and the horses and the horsemen will come down, everyone by the sword of his brother.
sentences.susu: N mangɛe ragoroma nɛ e xa kibanyi kui. N si gbɛtɛe sɛnbɛ kanama nɛ. N sɔɔri ragisee nun e ragimae rabirama nɛ. N soe nun soe ragie faxama nɛ e ngaxakerenyi xa santidɛgɛma ra.›»

sentences.english: In that day, says the Lord of armies, I will take you, O Zerubbabel, my servant, the son of Shealtiel, says the Lord, and will make you as a jewelled ring: for I have taken you to be mine, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Na lɔxɔɛ, Sorobabeli Salatiyeli xa di n i findima nɛ n ma konyi ra, i luma nɛ alɔ n ma xurundɛ tɔnxuma. N bara i sugandi.» Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: In the eighth month, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
sentences.susu: Dariyusi xa mangɛya ɲɛ firin nde kike solomasaxan nde kui, Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Sakari bɛ, Bɛrɛkaya xa di, Ido xa mamadi fanyi, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: The Lord has been very angry with your fathers:
sentences.susu: «Alatala bara xɔnɔ wo benbae ma.

sentences.english: And you are to say to them, These are the words of the Lord of armies: Come back to me, says the Lord of armies, and I will come back to you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ, i xa a fala, Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: ‹N tan Mangɛ Alatala bara a fala wo bɛ, wo xa gbilen n ma. Na tɛmui n fan gbilenma nɛ wo ma.

sentences.english: Be not like your fathers, to whom the voice of the earlier prophets came, saying, Be turned now from your evil ways and from your evil doings: but they did not give ear to me or take note, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa lu alɔ wo benbae. Singe namiɲɔnmɛe nu bara a masen e bɛ, «Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, wo gbilen wo xa fe ɲaaxie nun wo xa kɛwali ɲaaxie fɔxɔ ra.» Kɔnɔ e mu e tuli mati n ma masenyi ra, e mu n xui suxu. N tan Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Your fathers, where are they? and the prophets, do they go on living for ever?
sentences.susu: Wo benbae na minden? Namiɲɔnmɛe go? E mu faxama xɛ?

sentences.english: But my words and my orders, which I gave to my servants the prophets, have they not overtaken your fathers? and turning back they said, As it was the purpose of the Lord of armies to do to us, in reward for our ways and our doings, so has he done.
sentences.susu: N ma masenyi nun n ma sɛriyɛ, a mu wo benbae lixi?›» A to gɛ na masenyi ra, ɲama naxa tuubi, e fa a fala e boore bɛ, «Mangɛ Alatala bara won ma fe rabaxie sare ragbilen won ma.»

sentences.english: On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, the month Shebat, in the second year of Darius, the word of the Lord came to Zechariah, the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo the prophet, saying,
sentences.susu: Kike fu nun keren nde xi mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nde, Sebati kike, Dariyusi xa mangɛya ɲɛ firin nde, Alatala naxa a masen Annabi Sakari bɛ, Bɛrɛkaya xa di, Ido xa mamadi,

sentences.english: I saw in the night a man on a red horse, between the mountains in the valley, and at his back were horses, red, black, white, and of mixed colours.
sentences.susu: «To kɔɛ ra n bara yi laamatunyi to. Xɛmɛ nde nu na soe gbeeli fari, a nu tixi miriti wurie tagi fole kui. Soe gbeelie, soe fɔɔrɛe, nun soe fiixɛe nu na a xanbi ra.

sentences.english: Then I said, O my lord, what are these? And the angel who was talking to me said to me, I will make clear to you what they are.
sentences.susu: N naxa a maxɔrin, ‹N Marigi, munse na yee tan na?› Malekɛ naxan nu wɔyɛnma n na, a naxa a fala, ‹N a masenma nɛ i bɛ.›

sentences.english: And the man who was between the mountains, answering me, said, These are those whom the Lord has sent to go up and down through the earth.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan nu tixi miriti wurie tagi, a naxa a fala, ‹Alatala xa xɛɛrae nan e ra naxee duniɲa iɲɛrɛma.›

sentences.english: And the man who was between the mountains, answering, said to the angel of the Lord, We have gone up and down through the earth, and all the earth is quiet and at rest.
sentences.susu: E naxa dɛntɛgɛ sa Alatala xa malekɛ bɛ naxan nu tixi miriti wurie tagi, ‹Muxu bara duniɲa birin iɲɛrɛ, duniɲa mixi birin raxaraxi, e na bɔɲɛsa kui.›

sentences.english: Then the angel of the Lord, answering, said, O Lord of armies, how long will it be before you have mercy on Jerusalem and on the towns of Judah against which your wrath has been burning for seventy years?
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa a fala, ‹Mangɛ Alatala, i fama kinikinide Darisalamu nun Yudaya xa taae ma mun tɛmui? I xɔnɔxi e ma kabi ɲɛ tongo solofere.›

sentences.english: And the Lord gave an answer in good and comforting words to the angel who was talking to me.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa na malekɛ ralimaniya, a a madundu, malekɛ naxan nu wɔyɛnma n na.»

sentences.english: And the angel who was talking to me said to me, Let your voice be loud and say, These are the words of the Lord of armies: I am greatly moved about the fate of Jerusalem and of Zion.
sentences.susu: «Na malekɛ naxa a fala n bɛ, ‹I xa a fala, Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Darisalamu nun Siyon rafan n ma. N mu tinma e xa bira xanuntenyi gbɛtɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And I am very angry with the nations who are living untroubled: for when I was only a little angry, they made the evil worse.
sentences.susu: N bara xɔnɔ si gbɛtɛe ma naxee ɲɔxɔ a ma tɔɔrɛ yo mu nɔma e lide. Singe n nu xɔnɔxi dondoronti n ma ɲama ma, kɔnɔ sie tan bara nde sa n ma ɲama xa tɔɔrɛ xun ma.›»

sentences.english: So this is what the Lord has said: I have come back to Jerusalem with mercies; my house is to be put up in her, says the Lord of armies, and a line is to be stretched out over Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: «Na nan a ra, Alatala naxa a masen, ‹N man kinikinima nɛ Darisalamu ma, n man n ma banxi tima nɛ. Luuti ibɛndunma nɛ Darisalamu taa xun ma alako na xa maniya, na taa man xa gbilen ti ra.› Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And again let your voice be loud and say, This is what the Lord of armies has said: My towns will again be overflowing with good things, and again the Lord will give comfort to Zion and take Jerusalem for himself.
sentences.susu: I man xa a fala, ‹Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Harige man luma n ma taae kui, n man Siyon madundu ma nɛ, n man Darisalamu sugandima nɛ.›»

sentences.english: And lifting up my eyes, I saw a man with a measuring-line in his hand.
sentences.susu: N naxa yi laamatunyi to: N bara feri naani to.

sentences.english: And I said to him, Where are you going? And he said to me, To take the measure of Jerusalem, to see how wide and how long it is.
sentences.susu: N bara malekɛ maxɔrin, naxan nu wɔyɛnma n na, «Munse na yee ra?» A naxa n yaabi, «Sɛnbɛmae nan yee ra naxee Yudaya, Isirayila, nun Darisalamu rayensenxi.»

sentences.english: And the angel who was talking to me went out, and another angel went out, and, meeting him,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Alatala naxa xabui naani masen n bɛ.

sentences.english: Said to him, Go quickly and say to this young man, Jerusalem will be an unwalled town, because of the great number of men and cattle in her.
sentences.susu: N naxa maxɔrinyi ti, «Yee faxi munse rabade be?» A naxa n yaabi, «Yi feri naani misaalixi sɛnbɛmae nan na naxee Yudaya rayensenxi mixi yo mu nɔ a xunyi rakelide. Kɔnɔ yi xabuie faxi e magaaxude nɛ, e si gbɛtɛ sɛnbɛmae rabira, naxee kelixi Yudaya bɔxi xili ma alako e xa Yudayakae rayensen.»

sentences.english: For I, says the Lord, will be a wall of fire round about her, and I will be the glory inside her.
sentences.susu: N naxa yi laamatunyi to: Xɛmɛ nde nu na, maniya luuti nu suxuxi a yi ra.

sentences.english: Ho, ho! go in flight from the land of the north, says the Lord: for I have sent you far and wide to the four winds of heaven, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N naxa a maxɔrin, «I siga minden?» A naxa n yaabi, «N Darisalamu nan maniyafe, alako n xa a gboe nun a kuyɛya kolon.»

sentences.english: Ho! Zion, go in flight from danger, you who are living with the daughter of Babylon.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxan nu wɔyɛnma n na, a naxa siga yare, malekɛ gbɛtɛ naxa fa a ralande.

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord of armies has said: In the way of glory he has sent me to the nations which have taken your goods: for anyone touching you is touching what is most dear to him.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a bɛ, «I gi, sa a fala yi sɛgɛtala bɛ, a Darisalamukae nun xurusee fama nɛ wuyade han tɛtɛ mu nɔ e rabilinde sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: For at the shaking of my hand over them, their goods will be taken by those who were their servants: and you will see that the Lord of armies has sent me.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «N tan yati e makantama nɛ. N luma nɛ e bɛ alɔ tɛtɛ tɛ daaxi, n ma nɔrɛ fa lu e tagi.»

sentences.english: Give songs of joy, O daughter of Zion: for I come, and I will make my resting-place among you, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Wo wo gi, wo wo gi! Wo xa keli ɲamanɛ ma naxan na kɔɔla ma.» Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Singe n nu bara wo rayensen yɛ duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: And a number of nations will be joined to the Lord in that day, and will become my people; and I will be living among you, and you will see that the Lord of armies has sent me to you.
sentences.susu: Siyon mixie, wo wo gi. Wo tan naxee na Babilɔn, wo xa keli naa.»

sentences.english: And Judah will be the Lord's heritage in the holy land, and Jerusalem will again be his.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala naxa a masen n bɛ, a naxan xɛɛxi binyɛ kui, fe falafe yi sie xa fe ra naxee wo tɔɔrɔxi: «Naxan a bɛlɛxɛ dinma wo ra, a luxi nɛ alɔ na kanyi bara a bɛlɛxɛ din Ala ra.»

sentences.english: Let all flesh be quiet and make no sound before the Lord: for he is awake and has come from his holy resting-place.
sentences.susu: N na keli e xili ma, e findi e xa konyie xa konyie ra. Na kui wo a kolonma nɛ a Mangɛ Alatala nan n xɛɛxi.

sentences.english: And he let me see Joshua, the high priest, in his place before the angel of the Lord, and the Satan at his right hand ready to take up a cause against him.
sentences.susu: A naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi Yosuwe masen n bɛ, a nu tixi Alatala xa malekɛ ya i. Sentanɛ nu tixi a yirefanyi ma a xa a tɔɔɲɛgɛ.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to the Satan, May the Lord's word be sharp against you, O Satan, the word of the Lord who has taken Jerusalem for himself: is this not a burning branch pulled out of the fire?
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a fala Sentanɛ bɛ, «N tan, Alatala naxan Darisalamu sugandixi, n bara a fala i bɛ Sentanɛ, i sabari! Yege xuntunyi xa mu na yi xɛmɛ ra naxan baxi tɛ dɛ i?»

sentences.english: Now Joshua was clothed in unclean robes, and he was in his place before the angel.
sentences.susu: Yosuwe nu tixi malekɛ ya i, dugi nɔxɔxi nan nu ragoroxi a ma.

sentences.english: And he made answer and said to those who were there before him, Take the unclean robes off him, and let him be clothed in clean robes;
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa a fala a booree bɛ naxee nu tixi Yosuwe sɛɛti ma, «Wo dugi nɔxɔxie ba a ma.» A man naxa a fala Yosuwe bɛ, «A mato, n bara i xa yunubi ba, n bara dugi tofanyie ragoro i ma.»

sentences.english: And let them put a clean head-dress on his head. So they put a clean head-dress on his head, clothing him with clean robes: and to him he said, See, I have taken your sin away from you.
sentences.susu: N naxa a fala, «Wo xa xunyi ratofan se sɛniyɛnxi dɔxɔ a xunyi ma.» E naxa xunyi ratofan se sɛniyɛnxi dɔxɔ a xunyi ma, e naxa dugie ragoro a ma. Alatala xa malekɛ nu tixi naa.

sentences.english: And the angel of the Lord made a statement to Joshua, and said,
sentences.susu: Alatala xa malekɛ naxa yi masenyi ti Yosuwe bɛ,

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord of armies: If you will go in my ways and keep what I have put in your care, then you will be judge over my Temple and have the care of my house, and I will give you the right to come in among those who are there.
sentences.susu: «Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Xa i ɲɛrɛ n ma kirae xɔn, xa i n ma yaamarie suxu, i fama nɛ n ma banxi raɲɛrɛde, i fa n ma tɛtɛ makantade. Na tɛmui i yire sɔtɔma nɛ be yee tagi.
