sentences.english: Give ear now, O Joshua, the high priest, you and your friends who are seated before you; for these are men who are a sign: for see, I will let my servant the Branch be seen.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi Yosuwe, i tan nun naxee dɔxɔxi i ya i, wo wo tuli mati. Wo bara findi misaali ra. N fama n ma konyi xɛɛde, naxan xili ‹Salonyi.›

sentences.english: For see, the stone which I have put before Joshua; on one stone are seven eyes: see, the design cut on it will be my work, says the Lord of armies, and I will take away the sin of that land in one day.
sentences.susu: Wo xa gɛmɛ mato n naxan dɔxɔxi Yosuwe ya i. Ya solofere na na gɛmɛ kerenyi ma. N sɛbɛli tima nɛ a ma, n man fa yi bɔxi xa yunubi ba lɔxɔɛ keren kui.» Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: In that day, says the Lord of armies, you will be one another's guests under the vine and under the fig-tree.
sentences.susu: «Na lɔxɔɛ, wo wo boore xilima nɛ, wo xa lu yire keren wo xa wɛni bili nun xɔrɛ bili bun ma.» Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And the angel who was talking to me came again, awaking me as a man out of his sleep.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxan nu wɔyɛnma n na, a naxa fa n naxunude, alɔ e mixi raxunuma ki naxɛ xixɔli ma.

sentences.english: And he said to me, What do you see? And I said, I see a light-support, made all of gold, with its cup on the top of it and seven lights on it; and there are seven pipes to every one of the lights which are on the top of it;
sentences.susu: A naxa n maxɔrin, «I munse toxi?» N naxa a yaabi, «N lanpui dɔxɔ se xɛɛma daaxi nan toxi, bitirɛ na a xuntagi, ture ra a kui. Lanpui solofere gbakuxi a ma, ture gorode solofere, ture rasoma na lanpui soloferee kui.

sentences.english: And two olive-trees by it, one on the right side of the cup and one on the left.
sentences.susu: Oliwi wuri bili firin tixi ture bitirɛ sɛɛti firinyie ma, keren a yirefanyi ma, keren a kɔɔla ma.»

sentences.english: And I made answer and said to the angel who was talking to me, What are these, my lord?
sentences.susu: N naxa malekɛ maxɔrin, naxan nu wɔyɛnma n na, «N marigi, munse na yee ra?»

sentences.english: Then the angel who was talking to me, answering me, said, Have you no knowledge of what these are? And I said, No, my lord.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala n bɛ, «I mu a kolon?» N naxa a yaabi: «N marigi, n mu a kolon.»

sentences.english: This is the word of the Lord to Zerubbabel, saying, Not by force or by power, but by my spirit, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a naxa a masen n bɛ, «Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, a naxan tixi Sorobabeli bɛ, ‹Wo sɛnbɛ mu nɔma sese ra. N tan nan Xaxili nɔma a rabade.› Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya.»

sentences.english: Who are you, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel you will become level: and he will let all see the headstone, with cries of Grace, grace, to it.
sentences.susu: «Geya xungbe naxan na Sorobabeli ya ra, n na findima nɛ fiili ra. A fama nɛ gɛmɛ fanyi raminide banxi ti se ra, ɲama fa a fala e xui itexi ra, ‹Ala xa hinnɛ a ra, Ala xa hinnɛ a ra!›»

sentences.english: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa yi masenyi ti n bɛ,

sentences.english: The hands of Zerubbabel have put the base of this house in place, and his hands will make it complete; and it will be clear to you that the Lord of armies has sent me to you.
sentences.susu: «Sorobabeli bara yi banxi ti fɔlɔ, a man a raɲɔnma nɛ.» Na kui wo a kolonma nɛ a Mangɛ Alatala nan n xɛɛxi wo yire.

sentences.english: For who has had a poor opinion of the day of small things? for they will be glad when they see the weighted measuring-line in the hand of Zerubbabel. Then he said in answer to me, These seven lights are the eyes of the Lord which go quickly up and down through all the earth.
sentences.susu: Nde yoma fe fɔlɛ xuri ma? Ɲama na wali se to Sorobabeli bɛlɛxɛ, e ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ. Malekɛ naxa a fala n bɛ, «Na lanpui solofere findixi Alatala yae nan na naxee duniɲa iɲɛrɛma.»

sentences.english: And I made answer and said to him, What are these two olive-trees on the right side of the light-support and on the left?
sentences.susu: N naxa a maxɔrin a ma, «Munse na na oliwi wuri bili firinyi ra, naxee na lanpui dɔxɔ se yirefanyi ma nun a kɔɔla ma?»

sentences.english: And answering a second time, I said to him, What are these two olive branches, through whose gold pipes the oil is drained out?
sentences.susu: N man naxa a maxɔrin a ma, «Munse na na oliwi salonyi firinyie ra, naxee na ture gorode xɛɛma daaxi firinyie sɛɛti ma, oliwi ture dangima naxee kui?»

sentences.english: And he said in answer to me, Have you no knowledge what these are? And I said, No, my lord.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala n bɛ, «I mu a kolon e naxee misaalixi?» N naxa a yaabi, «N marigi, n mu a kolon.»

sentences.english: And he said, These are the two sons of oil, whose place is by the Lord of all the earth.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala n bɛ, «Mixi firin nan e ra Ala naxee sugandixi, a ture ifili e xunyie ma, e xa wali duniɲa birin Marigi bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then again lifting up my eyes I saw a roll in flight through the air.
sentences.susu: N man naxa laamatunyi to naxan findixi kɛɛdi makuntanxi ra koore ma.

sentences.english: And he said to me, What do you see? And I said, A roll going through the air; it is twenty cubits long and ten cubits wide.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa n maxɔrin, «I munse toxi?» N naxa a yaabi, «N kɛɛdi makuntanxi nan toxi koore ma, a kuya nɔngɔn ya mɔxɔɲɛn, a igbo nɔngɔn ya fu.»

sentences.english: Then he said to me, This is the curse which goes out over the face of all the land: for long enough has every thief gone without punishment, and long enough has every taker of false oaths gone without punishment.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala n bɛ, «Dankɛ sɛbɛxi na kɛɛdi ma naxan masenxi bɔxi yire birin. A sɛbɛxi muɲɛti nun mixie nan bɛ, naxee e kalima wule ra, e birin fama nɛ keride yi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And I will send it out, says the Lord of armies, and it will go into the house of the thief and into the house of him who takes a false oath by my name: and it will be in his house, causing its complete destruction, with its woodwork and its stones.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, ‹N yi dankɛ rasoma nɛ muɲɛtie xa banxie kui, a nun mixi naxee e kalima n xili ra kɔnɔ e fa wule fala. Na dankɛ luma nɛ e xa banxie kui han a birin kana.›»

sentences.english: And the angel who was talking to me went out and said to me, Let your eyes be lifted up now, and see the ephah which is going out.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxan nu wɔyɛnma n na, a naxa makɔrɛ n na, a fa a fala n bɛ, «A mato naxan na minife yakɔsi.»

sentences.english: And I said, What is it? And he said, This is an ephah which is going out. And he said further, This is their evil-doing in all the land.
sentences.susu: N naxa a maxɔrin, «Munse a ra?» A naxa n yaabi, «Busali nan a ra, ɲama xa fe ɲaaxie na naxan kui.»

sentences.english: And I saw a round cover of lead lifted up; and a woman was seated in the middle of the ephah.
sentences.susu: Dɛrakote binye to ba a dɛ ra, a naxa a to ginɛ nde dɔxɔxi a kui.

sentences.english: And he said, This is Sin; and pushing her down into the ephah, he put the weight of lead on the mouth of it.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa a fala n bɛ, «Fe ɲaaxi misaali nan yi ginɛ ra.» A man naxa ginɛ radin busali kui, a fa a dɛ rakoto dɛrakote binye ra.

sentences.english: And lifting up my eyes I saw two women coming out, and the wind was in their wings; and they had wings like the wings of a stork: and they took the ephah, lifting it up between earth and heaven.
sentences.susu: N to n ya rakeli, n naxa ginɛ firin to. Gabutenyi gbongboe daaxie nu na e ma, e nu na ɲɛrɛfe koore ma. E naxa na busali tongo, e a xanin koore ma.

sentences.english: And I said to the angel who was talking to me, Where are they taking the ephah?
sentences.susu: N naxa malekɛ maxɔrin, naxan nu wɔyɛnma n na, «E na busali xaninfe minden?»

sentences.english: And he said to me, To make a house for her in the land of Shinar: and they will make a place ready, and put her there in the place which is hers.
sentences.susu: A naxa n yaabi, «E na a xaninfe Babilɔn bɔxi nan ma, e banxi tima a bɛ dɛnnaxɛ, a xa lu naa.»

sentences.english: And again lifting up my eyes I saw four war-carriages coming out from between the two mountains; and the mountains were mountains of brass.
sentences.susu: N man naxa laamatunyi to. Sɔɔri ragise naani nu na minife geya firinyie longori ra. Na geyae nu yailanxi yɔxui nan na.

sentences.english: In the first war-carriage were red horses; and in the second, black horses;
sentences.susu: Soe gbeelie nan nu na sɔɔri ragise singe bɛndunfe, soe fɔɔrɛe nan nu na sɔɔri ragise firin nde bɛndunfe,

sentences.english: And in the third, white horses; and in the fourth, horses of mixed colour.
sentences.susu: soe fiixɛe nan nu na sɔɔri ragise saxan nde bɛndunfe, soe makatunxie nan nu na sɔɔri ragise naani nde bɛndunfe.

sentences.english: And I made answer and said to the angel who was talking to me, What are these, my lord?
sentences.susu: N naxa malekɛ maxɔrin, naxan nu wɔyɛnma n na, «N marigi, munse yee ra?»

sentences.english: And the angel, answering, said to me, These go out to the four winds of heaven from their place before the Lord of all the earth.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa n yaabi, «Foye naani nan e ra, Duniɲa Marigi na naxee raminife.

sentences.english: The carriage in which are the black horses goes in the direction of the north country; the white go to the west; and those of mixed colour go in the direction of the south country.
sentences.susu: Soe fɔɔrɛe sigama ɲamanɛ kɔɔla nan ma, soe fiixɛe sigama ɲamanɛ sogegorode nan ma, soe makatunxie sigama ɲamanɛ yirefanyi nan ma.»

sentences.english: And the red ones go to the east; and they made request that they might go up and down through the earth: and he said, Go up and down through the earth. So they went up and down through the earth.
sentences.susu: Yi soe sɛnbɛmae to nu wama sigafe duniɲa iɲɛrɛde, malekɛ nde naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo siga bɔxi iɲɛrɛde.» E naxa keli keren na.

sentences.english: Then crying out to me, he said, See, those who are going to the north country have given rest to the spirit of the Lord in the north country.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a fala n bɛ a xui itexi ra, «I bara a mato, naxee sigaxi ɲamanɛ kɔɔla ma, e bara n waxɔnfe raba naa.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya:

sentences.english: Take the offerings of those who went away as prisoners, from Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah, and from the family of Josiah, the son of Zephaniah, who have come from Babylon;
sentences.susu: «Xeledayi, Tobiya, nun Yɛdaya na fa kelife konyiya kui Babilɔn bɔxi ma, i xa e xa fangadamae rasuxu. Na lɔxɔɛ i xa siga Sofoni xa di Yosiya yire

sentences.english: And take silver and gold and make a crown and put it on the head of Zerubbabel;
sentences.susu: na gbeti nun na xɛɛma ra. I xa mangɛya tɔnxuma rafala na ra, i fa a dɔxɔ sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi Yosuwe xun ma, Yehosadaki xa di.

sentences.english: And say to him, These are the words of the Lord of armies: See, the man whose name is the Branch, under whom there will be fertile growth.
sentences.susu: I xa a fala a bɛ, ‹Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: Yi mixi naxan xili «Salonyi.» Na salonyi bulama nɛ, a fa Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ti.

sentences.english: And he will be the builder of the Temple of the Lord; and the glory will be his, and he will take his place as ruler on the seat of power; and Joshua will be a priest at his right hand, and between them there will be a design of peace.
sentences.susu: A tan nan Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi tima, mangɛya tɔnxuma luma nɛ a yi, a dɔxɔ a xa kibanyi kui, a ɲama yamari. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nde fan dɔxɔma nɛ a xa kibanyi kui. Bɔɲɛsa lu e firinyi tagi.›

sentences.english: And the crown will be for grace to Heldai and Tobijah and Jedaiah and the son of Zephaniah, to keep their memory living in the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Mangɛya tɔnxuma luma nɛ Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui Helemi, Tobiya, Yɛdaya, nun Sofoni xa di Heni yi ra.»

sentences.english: And those who are far away will come and be builders in the Temple of the Lord, and it will be clear to you that the Lord of armies has sent me to you.
sentences.susu: «Mixi naxee makuya, nee fama nɛ Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi tide. Na kui wo a kolonma nɛ a Mangɛ Alatala nan n xɛɛxi wo ma. Na birin fama nɛ rabade xa wo wo Marigi Alatala xui suxu a fanyi ra.»

sentences.english: And it came about in the fourth year of King Darius, that the word of the Lord came to Zechariah on the fourth day of the ninth month, the month Chislev.
sentences.susu: Dariyusi xa mangɛya ɲɛ naani nde, Kisilewi kike solomanaani nde, xi naani nde lɔxɔɛ, Alatala naxa masenyi ti Annabi Sakari bɛ.

sentences.english: Now they of Beth-el had sent Sharezer and Regem-melech to make a request for grace from the Lord,
sentences.susu: Betelikae nu bara Sareseri nun Regemi Meleki nun e xa mixie xɛɛ Alatala maxandide.

sentences.english: And to say to the priests of the house of the Lord of armies and to the prophets, Am I to go on weeping in the fifth month, separating myself as I have done in past years?
sentences.susu: E man xa Mangɛ Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, naxee nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, a nun namiɲɔnmɛe maxɔrin, «Muxu lan muxu xa muxu wa xui ramini kike suuli nde ra, muxu xa sunyi suxu alɔ muxu a rabaxi ɲɛ wuyaxie ra ki naxɛ?»

sentences.english: Then the word of the Lord of armies came to me, saying
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala naxa masenyi ti n bɛ yi ki,

sentences.english: Say to all the people of the land and to the priests, When you went without food and gave yourselves to grief in the fifth and the seventh months for these seventy years, did you ever do it because of me?
sentences.susu: «Ɲama nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛe maxɔrin n bɛ, ‹Wo to nu sunyi suxuma sunnunyi kui na kike suuli ndee nun na kike solofere ndee ɲɛ tongo solofere bun ma, wo nu sunma n tan nan bɛ?

sentences.english: And when you are feasting and drinking, are you not doing it only for yourselves?
sentences.susu: Wo to nu wo dɛgema nun wo wo minma, wo mu a rabaxi wo yɛtɛ xa bɛ?

sentences.english: Are not these the words which the Lord said to you by the earlier prophets, when Jerusalem was full of people and wealth, and the towns round about her and the South and the Lowland were peopled?
sentences.susu: Alatala mu na masenyi mɔɔli ti a xa namiɲɔnmɛ singee saabui xa ra, Darisalamu nun a rabilinyi nu sabatixi bɔɲɛsa kui tɛmui naxɛ? Na tɛmui, mixie nu na Negewi nun Sefela bɔxi ma.›»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord came to Zechariah, saying,
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa masenyi ti Annabi Sakari bɛ yi ki,

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: Let your judging be upright and done in good faith, let every man have mercy and pity for his brother:
sentences.susu: «Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: ‹Wo xa kiiti sa tinxinyi kui. Wo xa hinnɛ wo boore ra kinikini kui.

sentences.english: Do not be hard on the widow, or the child without a father, on the man from a strange country, or on the poor; let there be no evil thought in your heart against your brother.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa kaaɲɛ ginɛe, kiridie, bɔxi xɔɲɛe, nun setaree tɔɔrɔ. Wo naxa natɛ ɲaaxi tongo wo bɔɲɛ kui wo booree xa fe ra.›

sentences.english: But they would not give attention, turning their backs and stopping their ears from hearing;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e mu tin na masenyi ra, e naxa e kobe so, e mu e tuli mati na ra.

sentences.english: And they made their hearts like the hardest stone, so that they might not give ear to the law and the words which the Lord of armies had said by the earlier prophets: and there came great wrath from the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: E bɔɲɛe naxa xɔrɔxɔ alɔ diyaman, e naxa tondi Mangɛ Alatala xa sɛriyɛ suxude, a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nu bara naxan nasanba namiɲɔnmɛ singee ma. Na nan a ra Mangɛ Alatala naxa xɔnɔ e ma a belebele ra.

sentences.english: And it came about that as they would not give ear to his voice, so I would not give ear to their voice, says the Lord of armies:
sentences.susu: A to e xili, e naxa tondi a xui suxude. Yakɔsi, xa e tan bara a xili, a mu e xa maxandi suxuma de.» Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya,

sentences.english: But with a storm-wind I sent them in flight among all the nations of whom they had no knowledge. So the land was waste after them, so that no man went through or came back: for they had made waste the desired land.
sentences.susu: «N e rayensen nɛ sie birin ya ma e mu naxee kolon. E to keli e xa bɔxi ma, dɛnnaxɛ nu bara rabɛɲin, mixi yo mu dangima dɛnnaxɛ, mixi yo mu sigama dɛnnaxɛ. Bɔxi fanyi findi gbaloe bɔxi ra e tan nan saabui ra.»

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord of armies came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya:

sentences.english: These are the words of the Lord of armies: I am angry about the fate of Zion, I am angry about her with great wrath.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala naxa a masen, «N mu wama n firin nde xɔn Siyon. N ma ɲama xa fe xɔrɔxɔ n ma ki fanyi.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord has said: I have come back to Zion, and will make my living-place in Jerusalem: and Jerusalem will be named The town of good faith; and the mountain of the Lord of armies The holy mountain.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a masen, «N man fama nɛ Siyon, n xa lu wo tagi Darisalamu. Darisalamu fama nɛ xilide ‹Taa nɔndila.› Mangɛ Alatala xa geya fama nɛ xilide ‹Geya Sɛniyɛnxi.›»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: There will again be old men and old women seated in the open spaces of Jerusalem, every man with his stick in his hand because he is so old.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Xɛmɔxie nun ɲɛlɛxɛforie man luma nɛ Darisalamu malan yire, yisuxuwuri suxu e yi e xa simaya xɔnnakuye xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And the open spaces of the town will be full of boys and girls playing in its open spaces.
sentences.susu: Dimɛdie fan luma nɛ bere ra taa malandee.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: If this is a wonder to the rest of this people, is it a wonder to me? says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Hali a fa findi tɛrɛnna ra yi waxati ɲama dɔnxɔɛ bɛ, Mangɛ Alatala mu nɔma kaabade na fe ma.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: See, I will be the saviour of my people from the east country, and from the west country;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «N nan n ma ɲama rakisima nɛ ɲamanɛe ma naxee kelima sogetede nun sogegorode.

sentences.english: And I will make them come and be living in Jerusalem and they will be to me a people and I will be to them a God, in good faith and in righteousness.
sentences.susu: N e ragbilenma nɛ Darisalamu. E findima nɛ n ma ɲama ra, n fan findi e Marigi Ala ra nɔndi nun tinxinyi kui.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: Let your hands be strong, you who are now hearing these words from the mouths of the prophets, that is to say, in the days when the base of the house of the Lord of armies has been put in place for the building of the house, that is the Temple.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Wo wo sɛnbɛ so, wo tan naxee nu bara yi masenyi mɛ namiɲɔnmɛe saabui ra Mangɛ Alatala xa banxi kɔɔrin tɛmui naxɛ. Wo wo sɛnbɛ so alako yi banxi xa ɲɔn.

sentences.english: For before those days there was no payment for a man's work, or for the use of a beast, and there was no peace for him who went out or him who came in, because of the attacker: for I had every man turned against his neighbour.
sentences.susu: Beenu na wali xa fɔlɔ, wali sare yo mu nu na walikɛe bɛ. Hali ningee mu donse sɔtɔ e xa wali kui. Wali birin mu nu nɔma sɔɔnɛyade, barima n nu bara yaxuiɲa ramini mixie tagi.

sentences.english: But now I will not be to the rest of this people as I was in the past, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi n mu yi ɲama dɔnxɔɛ tɔɔrɔma alɔ singe.» Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: For I will let the seed of peace be planted; the vine will give her fruit and the land will give her increase and the heavens will give their dew; and I will give to the rest of this people all these things for their heritage.
sentences.susu: «Bɔɲɛsa luma nɛ bɔxi ma. Wɛni bilie bogima nɛ, bɔxi daxamui raminima nɛ, tunɛ ye fama nɛ. N na birin soma nɛ yi ɲama dɔnxɔɛ yi ra e kɛ ra.

sentences.english: And it will come about that, as you were a curse among the nations, O children of Judah and children of Israel, so I will give you salvation and you will be a blessing: have no fear and let your hands be strong.
sentences.susu: Singe Yudaya bɔnsɔɛ nun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ findi nɛ dankɛ ra sie tagi, kɔnɔ yakɔsi, n to wo rakisi, wo findima nɛ e bɛ saabui ra e barakɛ sɔtɔ. Wo naxa gaaxu, wo wo sɛnbɛ so.»

sentences.english: For this is what the Lord of armies has said: As it was my purpose to do evil to you when your fathers made me angry, says the Lord of armies, and my purpose was not changed:
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Wo benbae to n naxɔnɔ, n naxa natɛ tongo n xa wo ɲaxankata. N mu tin gbilende na natɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: So in these days it is again my purpose to do good to Jerusalem and to the children of Judah: have no fear.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi n bara natɛ tongo, n xa fe fanyi raba wo bɛ, Darisalamu nun Yudaya bɔnsɔɛ. Wo naxa gaaxu.

sentences.english: These are the things which you are to do: Let every man say what is true to his neighbour; and let your judging give peace in your towns.
sentences.susu: Wo xa yi masenyi rabatu: Wo xa nɔndi fala wo boore bɛ, wo xa kiiti sa nɔndi nun tinxinyi kui.

sentences.english: Let no one have any evil thought in his heart against his neighbour; and have no love for false oaths: for all these things are hated by me, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ɲaaxuiɲa naxa lu wo bɔɲɛ kui wo booree mabiri. Wo naxa wo kali wule kui, barima na fe mɔɔli mu rafan n ma.» Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord of armies came to me, saying,
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya,

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: The times of going without food in the fourth month and in the fifth and the seventh and the tenth months, will be for the people of Judah times of joy and happy meetings; so be lovers of good faith and of peace.
sentences.susu: «Mangɛ Alatala naxa a masen wo sunyi naxee suxuma kike naani nde, kike suuli nde, kike solofere nde, nun kike fu nde ra, nee xa findi sali sɛɛwɛ daaxie ra. Nɔndi nun bɔɲɛsa xa rafan wo ma.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: It will again come about that when peoples and those living in great towns come,
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Mixi gbegbe fama nɛ fade kelife ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛe ma.

sentences.english: And the people of one town go to another and say, Let us certainly go with a request for grace from the Lord, and to give worship to the Lord of armies, then I will go with you.
sentences.susu: Mixie luma siga ra yire gbɛtɛ e sa a fala mɛnnikae bɛ, ‹Won xɛɛ Mangɛ Alatala maxandide, won birin na a ra.›

sentences.english: And great peoples and strong nations will come to give worship to the Lord of armies in Jerusalem and to make requests for grace from the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛnbɛma wuyaxie kelife ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛe ma, e fama nɛ Mangɛ Alatala fende Darisalamu, e a maxandi.»

sentences.english: This is what the Lord of armies has said: In those days, ten men from all the languages of the nations will put out their hands and take a grip of the skirt of him who is a Jew, saying, We will go with you, for it has come to our ears that God is with you.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «Na lɔxɔɛe ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛe mixi fu fama nɛ kankande Yuwifi keren ma, e fa a fala a bɛ, ‹Won birin na a ra, barima muxu bara a kolon Ala na wo fɛ ma.›»

sentences.english: A word of the Lord: The Lord has come to the land of Hadrach, and Damascus is his resting-place: for the towns of Aram are the Lord's,
sentences.susu: Alatala bara masenyi xɔrɔxɔɛ ti Xadaraki xa bɔxi xa fe ra. Na masenyi bara Damasi taa fan li. Alatala gbe nan adamadi birin na, Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe fan a gbe.

sentences.english: As well as Hamath, which is by its limit, and Tyre and Zidon, because they are very wise.
sentences.susu: Na masenyi bara Xamata taa li, naxan na Damasi naaninyi mabiri. A bara Tire nun Sidɔn fan li, hali lɔnnilae nan to e ra.

sentences.english: And Tyre made for herself a strong place, and got together silver like dust and the best gold like the earth of the streets.
sentences.susu: Tire bara taa makantaxi ti, a xa gbeti bara gbo alɔ mɛyɛnyi, a xa xɛɛma bara gbo alɔ boora.

sentences.english: See, the Lord will take away her heritage, overturning her power in the sea; and she will be burned up with fire.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Marigi na birin bama nɛ a yi, a a xa tɛtɛ radin baa ma, a fa taa gan.

sentences.english: Ashkelon will see it with fear, and Gaza, bent with pain; and Ekron, for her hope will be shamed: and the king will be cut off from Gaza, and Ashkelon will be unpeopled.
sentences.susu: Asikalɔn na na to, a fan luma nɛ gaaxui kui. Gasa nun Ekiron fan gaaxuma nɛ, e sɛrɛnma nɛ barima e xa xunnakeli bara findi yaagi ra. Gasa mangɛ faxama nɛ, mixi yo mu luma Asikalɔn sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And a mixed people will be living in Ashdod, and I will have the pride of the Philistines cut off.
sentences.susu: Si masunbuxi fama nɛ sabatide Asidodi. «N Filisitakae xa yɛtɛ igboɲa ragoroma nɛ.

sentences.english: And I will take away his blood from his mouth, and his disgusting things from between his teeth; and some of his people will be kept for our God: and he will be as a family in Judah, and Ekron as one living in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: N faxɛ tife ɲɔnma nɛ mɛnni.» Ɲama dɔnxɔɛ fama nɛ birade muxu Marigi Ala fɔxɔ ra. E sabatima nɛ Yudaya xabilɛe ya ma. Ekiron luma nɛ alɔ Yebusu.

sentences.english: And I will put my forces in position round my house, so that there may be no coming and going: and no cruel master will again go through them: for now I have seen his trouble.
sentences.susu: «N na n ma banxi kanta ma nɛ, alako sɔɔri gali yo naxa a kana. Naxan fama, naxan dangima, e mu nɔma sese ra, barima yakɔsi n ɲɛngi saxi a xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: Be full of joy, O daughter of Zion; give a glad cry, O daughter of Jerusalem: see, your king comes to you: he is upright and has overcome; gentle and seated on an ass, on a young ass.
sentences.susu: Siyonkae, wo xa ɲɛlɛxin. Darisalamukae, wo xa wo xui ite sɛɛwɛ kui. Wo xa mangɛ na fafe wo yire. A tinxin. A kisixi. A mu a yɛtɛ igboma, a soma taa kui sofale nan fari, sofale xɛmɛma, sofale ginɛma xa di.

sentences.english: And he will have the war-carriage cut off from Ephraim, and the horse from Jerusalem, and the bow of war will be cut off: and he will say words of peace to the nations: and his rule will be from sea to sea, and from the River to the ends of the earth.
sentences.susu: «N sɔɔri ragise bama nɛ Efirami bɔxi ma, n soee bama nɛ Darisalamu. Gereso xalie mu luma naa.» A bɔɲɛsa nan masenma sie bɛ. A xa mangɛya xungboma nɛ yire birin, kelife baa xungbe ma, a sa dɔxɔ xure xungbe ra.

sentences.english: And as for you, because of the blood of your agreement, I have sent out your prisoners from the deep hole in which there is no water.
sentences.susu: «N bara wo xa mixi suxuxie xun sara won ma saatɛ xa fe ra naxan xirixi sɛrɛxɛ wuli daaxi ra. E nu na fe xɔrɔxɔɛ kui, alɔ mixi naxee ragoroxi kɔlɔnyi nde kui, ye mu na naxan kui.

sentences.english: And they will come back to you, O daughter of Zion, as prisoners of hope: today I say to you that I will give you back twice as much;
sentences.susu: Wo xa gbilen taa makantaxi kui, wo tan geelimani naxee xaxili tixi n na. To n xa a fala wo bɛ, n wo harige ragbilenma nɛ wo ma, n man fa a xunmasa.

sentences.english: For I have made Judah a bow bent for my use, I have made Ephraim the arrows of the bow; I will make your sons, O Zion, take up arms against your sons, O Greece, and will make you like the sword of a man of war.
sentences.susu: Yudaya findima nɛ n ma xali ra. Efirami luma nɛ alɔ n ma tanbɛe. Siyonikae findima nɛ n ma sɔɔrie ra Girɛkikae xili ma. N ma santidɛgɛma nan i ra.»

sentences.english: And the Lord will be seen over them, and his arrow will go out like the thunder-flame: and the Lord God, sounding the war-horn, will go in the storm-winds of the South.
sentences.susu: Alatala a yɛtɛ makɛnɛnma nɛ e bɛ, a xa tanbɛ lu alɔ seyamakɔnyi. Marigi Alatala sara fema nɛ, a lu alɔ turunnaadɛ.

sentences.english: The Lord of armies will be a cover for them; and they will overcome, crushing under foot the armed men; they will take their blood for drink like wine: they will be full like the sides of the altar.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala e makantama nɛ. E xa geresosee kanari rabama nɛ, e wuli ifili alɔ sɛrɛxɛdubɛe naxan xuruse kɔn naxabama, e fa na wuli kasan sɛrɛxɛbade ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord their God will be their saviour in that day, giving them food like the flock of his people: for they will be like the jewels of a crown shining over his land.
sentences.susu: E Marigi Alatala e rakisima nɛ na lɔxɔɛ, alɔ xuruse dɛmadonyi a xa xurusee kantama ki naxɛ. Ala xa ɲama luma nɛ alɔ diyaman naxan yanbama bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: For how good it is and how beautiful! grain will make the young men strong and new wine the virgins.
sentences.susu: E tofanma nɛ, e rayabu. Baloe fanyi sɛgɛtalae xungboma nɛ, minse fanyie sungbutunyie rayabu.

sentences.english: Make your request to the Lord for rain in the time of the spring rains, even to the Lord who makes the thunder-flames; and he will give them showers of rain, to every man grass in the field.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Alatala maxandi ɲɛmɛ tɛmui. Alatala fama nɛ tunɛ belebele ra wo bɛ, alako wo xa xɛe xa fan.

sentences.english: For the images have said what is not true, and the readers of signs have seen deceit; they have given accounts of false dreams, they give comfort to no purpose: so they go out of the way like sheep, they are troubled because they have no keeper.
sentences.susu: Kuyee wule falama, sematoee mu nɔndi toma, e xiyee fasarima wule ra, e xa madundui fufafu na a ra. Na birin bara a niya ɲama xa lɔɛ alɔ xurusee. E na tɔɔrɛ kui barima xuruse dɛmadonyi mu na e bɛ.

sentences.english: My wrath is burning against the keepers of the flock, and I will send punishment on the he-goats: for the Lord of armies takes care of his flock, the people of Judah, and will make them like the horse of his pride in the fight.
sentences.susu: N bara xɔnɔ na xuruse dɛmadonyie ma. N e xa yareratie ɲaxankatama nɛ. Yudaya luma nɛ alɔ Mangɛ Alatala xa xurusee, a mɛɛnima nɛ e ma. E fama nɛ binyɛ sɔtɔde, alɔ sɔɔri mangɛ xa soe.

sentences.english: From him will come the keystone, from him the nail, from him the bow of war, from him will come every ruler;
sentences.susu: Mixi nde kelima nɛ Yudaya naxan misaalima gɛmɛ ra banxi tixi naxan fari, naxan misaalima wuri ra kiri banxi xirixi naxan na, naxan misaalima xali geresose ra. Mangɛ birin fatanxi Yudaya bɔnsɔɛ nan na.

sentences.english: Together they will be like men of war, crushing down their haters into the earth of the streets in the fight; they will make war because the Lord is with them: and the horsemen will be shamed.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae findima nɛ sɛnbɛmae ra, naxee e yaxuie maboronma gere kui, barima Alatala na e fɛ ma. E yaxuie xa soe ragimae luma nɛ yaagi kui.

sentences.english: And I will make the children of Judah strong, and I will be the saviour of the children of Joseph, and I will make them come back again, for I have had mercy on them: they will be as if I had not given them up: for I am the Lord their God and I will give them an answer.
sentences.susu: «N Yudaya bɔnsɔɛ xun nakelima nɛ, n Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ rakisi, n e xa taae yailan, barima n bara kinikini e ma. E fama nɛ lude alɔ n mu e rabɛɲin. E Marigi Alatala nan n na, n e xa duba suxuma nɛ.

sentences.english: And Ephraim will be like a man of war, and their hearts will be glad as with wine; and their children will see it with joy; their hearts will be glad in the Lord.
sentences.susu: Efirami bɔnsɔɛ fan findima nɛ sɛnbɛmae ra. E sɛɛwama nɛ dangife siisilae ra. E xa die na birin toma nɛ, e fan ɲɛlɛxin. E birin bɔɲɛ sɛɛwama nɛ Alatala xa fe ra.

sentences.english: With the sound of the pipe I will get them together; for I have given the price to make them free: and they will be increased as they were increased.
sentences.susu: N nan n ma ɲama maxilima nɛ, n xa e xun sara, e xa wuya dangife singe ra.

sentences.english: Though I had them planted among the peoples, they will keep me in mind in far countries: and they will take care of their children and will come back.
sentences.susu: Hali n to e rayensenxi sie ya ma, e e ratuma nɛ n ma fe ma yire makuye. E tan nun e xa die kisima nɛ, e man fa gbilen e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: And I will make them come back out of the land of Egypt, and will get them together out of Assyria; and I will take them into the land of Gilead, and it will not be wide enough for them.
sentences.susu: N e rafama nɛ kelife Misira bɔxi ma, n e malan kelife Asiriya bɔxi ma. N man Galadi nun Liban bɔxi fima nɛ e ma, kɔnɔ e kɔnti dangima nɛ na birin na.

sentences.english: And they will go through the sea of Egypt, and all the deep waters of the Nile will become dry: and the pride of Assyria will be made low, and the power of Egypt will be taken away.
sentences.susu: E xa tɔɔrɛ bara lu alɔ baa mɔrɔnyie, kɔnɔ Ala na mɔrɔnyie ragoroma nɛ. Nili xure bara a niya e xa lu konyiya kui, kɔnɔ na xure bara xɔri. Asiriya xa yɛtɛ igboɲa goroma nɛ, Misira xa mangɛya ɲɔn.

sentences.english: And their strength will be in the Lord; and their pride will be in his name, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N tan nan e sɛnbɛ soma, e fama nɛ ɲɛrɛde n xili ra.» Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: Let your doors be open, O Lebanon, so that fire may be burning among your cedars.
sentences.susu: Liban bɔxi, i xa wuri birin fama nɛ gande.

sentences.english: Give a cry of grief, O fir-tree, for the fall of the cedar, because the great ones have been made low: give cries of grief, O you oaks of Bashan, for the strong trees of the wood have come down.
sentences.susu: Wo fama nɛ wade wo xui itexi ra, barima sipirɛ, sɛdiri, nun konde bilie fama nɛ birade. Basan wondi belebele bara kana.

sentences.english: The sound of the crying of the keepers of the flock! for their glory is made waste: the sound of the loud crying of the young lions! for the pride of Jordan is made waste.
sentences.susu: Xuruse dɛmadonyie wama nɛ, barima fiili bara kana. Yɛtɛe xaaɲɛma nɛ, barima Yurudɛn fɔtɔnyi bara kana.

sentences.english: This is what the Lord my God has said: Take care of the flock of death;
sentences.susu: N Marigi Alatala a masen nɛ, «Wo xa xurusee dɛ madon, naxee fama faxade.

sentences.english: Whose owners put them to death and have no sense of sin; and those who get a price for them say, May the Lord be praised for I have much wealth: and the keepers of the flock have no pity for them.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee e sarama e fama nɛ e kɔn naxabade kinikinitareɲa kui. Naxee e matima e a falama nɛ, ‹Ala tantu. N bara banna.› Xuruse dɛmadonyie mu kinikinima e ma.»

sentences.english: For I will have no more pity for the people of the land, says the Lord; but I will give up everyone into his neighbour's hand and into the hand of his king: and they will make the land waste, and I will not keep them safe from their hands.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «N fan mu kinikinima yi ɲama ma. N bara e birin lu e boore yi ra, e xa mangɛ yi ra, alako ɲama xa ɲaxankata. N mu mixi yo ratangama na ma.»

sentences.english: So I took care of the flock of death, for those who made profit out of the flock; and I took for myself two rods, naming one Beautiful, and the other Bands; and I took care of the flock.
sentences.susu: Na kui n naxa xurusee tɔɔrɔxi dɛ madon, naxee nu lanxi e xa faxa. N naxa yisuxuwuri firin tongo. N naxa keren xili sa «Hinnɛ,» boore «Lanyi.» N naxa xurusee dɛ madon.

sentences.english: And in one month I put an end to the three keepers of the flock; for my soul was tired of them, and their souls were disgusted with me.
sentences.susu: N naxa xuruse dɛmadonyi saxan keri kike keren bun, barima e mu rafanxi n ma sɔnɔn, n fan mu rafanxi e ma.

sentences.english: And I said, I will not take care of you: If death comes to any, let death be its fate; if any is cut off, let it be cut off; and let the rest take one another's flesh for food.
sentences.susu: N naxa a fala xurusee bɛ, «N mu wo dɛ madonma sɔnɔn. Naxan lan a xa faxa, a xa faxa. Naxan lan a xa siga, a xa siga. Naxan lan a xa lu be, a xa a boore faxa.»

sentences.english: And I took my rod Beautiful, cutting it in two, so that the Lord's agreement, which he had made with all the peoples, might be broken.
sentences.susu: N naxa n ma yisuxuwuri tongo naxan xili «Hinnɛ,» n naxa a igira. Na misaalixi saatɛ nan na naxan xirixi n tan nun sie birin tagi. Na saatɛ bara kana.

sentences.english: And it was broken on that day: and the sheep-traders, who were watching me, were certain that it was the word of the Lord.
sentences.susu: N to na kana xurusee tɔɔrɔxi ya xɔri, e naxa a kolon n nu bara Alatala xa masenyi fala.

sentences.english: And I said to them, If it seems good to you, give me my payment; and if not, do not give it. So they gave me my payment by weight, thirty shekels of silver.
sentences.susu: N naxa a fala e bɛ, «Xa a wo kɛnɛn, wo n ma wali sare fi n ma, xa na mu a ra wo a lu na.» E naxa kɔbiri kole tongo saxan fi n ma wali sare ra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to me, Put it into the store-house, the price at which I was valued by them. And I took the thirty shekels of silver and put them into the store-house in the house of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a fala n bɛ, «Xa e n ma wali tide toma na ki nɛ, a sare mu gbo, a wɔlɛ. Fɛɲɛ yailanma xa na tongo.» N naxa na kɔbiri kole tongo saxan tongo, n naxa e wɔlɛ Alatala xa banxi kui mixi nde bɛ naxan fɛɲɛe yailanma.

sentences.english: Then I took my other rod, the one named Bands, cutting it in two, so that the relation of brothers between Judah and Israel might be broken.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, n naxa n ma yisuxuwuri igira naxan nu xili «Lanyi,» barima lanyi mu na Yudaya nun Isirayila tagi sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to me, Take again the instruments of a foolish keeper of sheep.
sentences.susu: Alatala naxa a fala n bɛ, «I man xa xuruse dɛmadonyi xaxilitare xa walisee tongo.

sentences.english: For see, I will put a sheep-keeper over the land, who will have no care for that which is cut off, and will not go in search of the wanderers, or make well what is broken, and he will not give food to that which is ill, but he will take for his food the flesh of the fat, and let their feet be broken.
sentences.susu: N xuruse dɛmadonyi rakelima nɛ yi bɔxi ma naxan mu a ɲɛngi sama xurusee xɔn ma. Xa xuruse keren bara lɔɛ, a mu sigama a fende. Xa keren bara maxɔnɔ, a mu a dandanma. Xa keren bara xungbo fɔlɔ, a a sube birin donma nɛ han a a tore li.»

sentences.english: A curse on the foolish keeper who goes away from the flock! the sword will be on his arm and on his right eye: his arm will become quite dry and his eye will be made completely dark.
sentences.susu: «Ɲaxankatɛ na xuruse dɛmadonyi ɲaaxi bɛ, naxan xurusee rabɛɲinma. Santidɛgɛma xa a bɛlɛxɛ sɛgɛ, a xa a ya sɔxɔ. A bɛlɛxɛ naxa nɔ fefe ra, a ya naxa fe yo to.»

sentences.english: The word of the Lord about Israel. The Lord by whom the heavens are stretched out and the bases of the earth put in place, and the spirit of man formed inside him, has said:
sentences.susu: Alatala bara masenyi xɔrɔxɔɛ ti Isirayila xa fe ra. Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, naxan koore nun bɔxi daaxi, naxan xaxili so adamadi yi ra:

sentences.english: See, I will make Jerusalem a cup of shaking fear to all the peoples round about, when Jerusalem is shut in.
sentences.susu: «N fe xungbe rabama nɛ Darisalamu bɛ, duniɲa sie tagi. Mixi na fa Darisalamu gerede, n kaabanako rabama nɛ Yudaya bɛ.

sentences.english: And it will come about in that day that I will make Jerusalem a stone of great weight for all the peoples; all those who take it up will be badly wounded; and all the nations of the earth will come together against it.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, n Darisalamu findima nɛ gɛmɛ binye ra si birin bɛ. Naxan katama na itefe ra, na kanyi maxɔnɔma nɛ. Duniɲa si birin malanma nɛ a xili ma.»

sentences.english: In that day, says the Lord, I will put fear into every horse and make every horseman go off his head: and my eyes will be open on the people of Judah, and I will make every horse of the peoples blind.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Na lɔxɔɛ, n sɔɔri nun a xa soe radaxuma nɛ. N nee findi dɔnxui ra. N Yudaya bɔnsɔɛ matoma nɛ, n nan n ɲɛngi sa e xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And the families of Judah will say in their hearts, The people of Jerusalem have their strength in the Lord of armies, their God.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛe a falama nɛ e bɔɲɛ kui, ‹Darisalamukae sɛnbɛ gboxi e Marigi Alatala nan saabui ra.›

sentences.english: In that day I will make the families of Judah like a pot with fire in it among trees, and like a flaming stick among cut grain; they will send destruction on all the peoples round about, on the right hand and on the left: and Jerusalem will be living again in the place which is hers, that is, in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, n Yudaya mangɛe luma nɛ alɔ tɛ wolenxi yege xɔɔra, xa na mu alɔ tɛ na din sɛxɛ ra. E fama nɛ si birin halakide naxan na e rabilinyi. Darisalamu mu kanama.

sentences.english: And the Lord will give salvation to the tents of Judah first, so that the glory of the family of David and the glory of the people of Jerusalem may not be greater than that of Judah.
sentences.susu: Alatala Yudaya taae nan singe rakisima, alako Dawuda xabilɛ nun Darisalamukae xa binyɛ naxa dangi Yudaya mixie ra.

sentences.english: In that day the Lord will be a cover over the people of Jerusalem; and he who is feeble among them in that day will be as strong as David, and the family of David will be as God, as the angel of the Lord before them.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, Alatala Darisalamukae makantama nɛ. Ala a niyama nɛ mixi taganxi xa Dawuda sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ. Dawuda xabilɛ sɛnbɛ gboma nɛ Ala saabui ra. Alatala xa malekɛ a ɲɛrɛma nɛ e ya ra.

sentences.english: And it will come about on that day that I will take in hand the destruction of all the nations who come against Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, n si birin halakima nɛ naxee Darisalamu gerema.

sentences.english: And I will send down on the family of David and on the people of Jerusalem the spirit of grace and of prayer; and their eyes will be turned to the one who was wounded by their hands: and they will be weeping for him as for an only son, and their grief for him will be bitter, like the grief of one sorrowing for his oldest son.
sentences.susu: N hinnɛ nun kinikini luma nɛ Dawuda xabilɛ nun Darisalamukae xaxili ma. E fama nɛ e ya rafindide n ma, e n tan naxan sɔxɔxi. E sunnunma nɛ n ma fe ra, alɔ mixi naxan xa di singe bara faxa. E e wa xui raminima na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: In that day there will be a great weeping in Jerusalem, like the weeping of Hadad-rimmon in the valley of Megiddon.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, sunnunyi gboma nɛ Darisalamu, alɔ Hadada Rimɔn sunnunxi Megido gulunba kui ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the land will give itself to weeping, every family separately; the family of David by themselves, and their wives by themselves; the family of Nathan by themselves, and their wives by themselves;
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin sunnunma nɛ xabilɛ ki ma. Dawuda xabilɛ luma nɛ a xati ma. Natan xabilɛ fan luma nɛ a xati ma. Xɛmɛe nun ginɛe mu sunnunma yire keren.

sentences.english: The family of Levi by themselves, and their wives by themselves; the family of Shimei by themselves, and their wives by themselves;
sentences.susu: Lewi xabilɛ luma nɛ a xati ma. Simeyi xabilɛ luma nɛ a xati ma. Xɛmɛe nun ginɛe mu sunnunma yire keren.

sentences.english: And all the other families by themselves, and their wives by themselves.
sentences.susu: Xabilɛ birin luma nɛ a xati ma.»

sentences.english: In that day there will be a fountain open to the family of David and to the people of Jerusalem, for sin and for that which is unclean.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, dulonyi minima nɛ naxan nɔma Dawuda xabilɛ nun Darisalamukae yunubi bade.

sentences.english: And it will come about on that day, says the Lord of armies, that I will have the names of the images cut off out of the land, and there will be no more memory of them: and I will send all the prophets and the unclean spirit away from the land.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Na lɔxɔɛ, n kuyee xili bama nɛ wo dɛ kui, wo nɛɛmu e ma. N e xa namiɲɔnmɛe nun e xa sɛniyɛntareɲa kerima nɛ.

sentences.english: And if anyone goes on acting as a prophet, then his father and his mother who gave him life will say to him, You may not go on living, for you are saying what is false in the name of the Lord; and his father and his mother will put a sword through him when he does so.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde suusama namiɲɔnmɛ masenyi tide, a nga nun a baba naxan a barixi e a falama a bɛ, ‹I xa faxa, barima i bara wule fala Alatala xili ra.› A nga nun a baba naxan a barixi, e a sɔxɔma nɛ na masenyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And it will come about in that day that the prophets will be shamed, every man on account of his vision, when he is talking as a prophet; and they will not put on a robe of hair for purposes of deceit:
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, namiɲɔnmɛe birin yaagima nɛ e xa masenyie xa fe ra. E mu namiɲɔnmɛ dugi ragoroma e ma sɔnɔn alako e xa mixi madaxu.

sentences.english: But he will say, I am no prophet, but a worker on the land; for I have been an owner of land from the time when I was young.
sentences.susu: E birin a falama nɛ, ‹Namiɲɔnmɛ mu n na. Kabi n dimɛdi tɛmui n xɛ nan tun safe.›

sentences.english: And if anyone says to him, What are these wounds between your hands? then he will say, Those with which I was wounded in the house of my friends.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e a maxɔrinma nɛ, ‹Munse na yi nari ra i bɛlɛxɛe ma?› A e yaabima nɛ: ‹N xanuntenyi nan n maxɔnɔxi.›»

sentences.english: Awake! O sword, against the keeper of my flock, and against him who is with me, says the Lord of armies: put to death the keeper of the sheep, and the sheep will go in flight: and my hand will be turned against the little ones.
sentences.susu: «Santidɛgɛma, keli n ma xuruse dɛmadonyi xili ma, keli mixi xili ma naxan na n sɛɛti ma.» Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Santidɛgɛma, xuruse dɛmadonyi faxa, yɛxɛɛe rayensen yɛ. N fama nɛ yɛxɛɛyɔrɛe ɲaxankatade.»

sentences.english: And it will come about that in all the land, says the Lord, two parts of it will be cut off and come to an end; but the third will be still living there.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya: «Ɲama dɔxɔ firin faxama nɛ, kɔnɔ a dɔxɔ saxan nde baloma nɛ.

sentences.english: And I will make the third part go through the fire, cleaning them as silver is made clean, and testing them as gold is tested: and they will make their prayer to me and I will give them an answer: I will say, It is my people; and they will say, The Lord is my God.
sentences.susu: N na dɔxɔ saxan nde sama nɛ tɛ i, n e raxunu alɔ gbeti. N xa e mato alɔ xɛɛma. A na n maxandi, n a xa duba suxuma nɛ. N fama nɛ a masende, ‹N ma ɲama nan ya,› a fan a masen, ‹Alatala nan muxu Marigi Ala ra.›»

sentences.english: See, a day of the Lord is coming when they will make division of your goods taken by force before your eyes.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa lɔxɔɛ fafe. Wo yaxuie wo harige itaxunma nɛ e boore ma wo ya xɔri.

sentences.english: For I will get all the nations together to make war against Jerusalem; and the town will be overcome, and the goods taken from the houses, and the women taken by force: and half the town will go away as prisoners, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the town.
sentences.susu: N si birin malanma nɛ Darisalamu gere xili ma. E soma nɛ taa kui, e banxi kana, e dutun ginɛe ma. E ɲama sɛɛti xaninma nɛ konyiya kui, e boore sɛɛti lu taa kui.

sentences.english: Then the Lord will go out and make war against those nations, as he did in the day of the fight.
sentences.susu: Alatala kelima nɛ a sa na sie gere a gere ki ma.

sentences.english: And in that day his feet will be on the Mount of Olives, which is opposite Jerusalem on the east, and the Mount of Olives will be parted in the middle to the east and to the west, forming a very great valley; and half the mountain will be moved to the north and half of it to the south.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Ala tima nɛ Oliwi geya fari, naxan na Darisalamu ya ra sogetede mabiri. Oliwi geya ibɔɔma nɛ a tagi, kelife sogetede han sogegorode. Gulunba luma nɛ geya firin tagi, keren na kɔɔla ma, keren na yirefanyi ma.

sentences.english: And the valley will be stopped ... and you will go in flight as you went in flight from the earth-shock in the days of Uzziah, king of Judah: and the Lord my God will come, and all his holy ones with him.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui wo wo gima nɛ gulunba kui n ma geyae tagi han Aseli. Wo wo gima nɛ alɔ wo wo gixi bɔxi xa sɛrɛnyi ya ra ki naxɛ, Yudaya mangɛ Yusiya xa waxati. Na tɛmui n Marigi Alatala fama nɛ, a nun a xa sɛniyɛntɔɛe ra.

sentences.english: And in that day there will be no heat or cold or ice;
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, naiyalanyi mu luma duniɲa ma, yanbasee xunuma nɛ.

sentences.english: And it will be unbroken day, such as the Lord has knowledge of, without change of day and night, and even at nightfall it will be light.
sentences.susu: Yanyi nun kɔɛ mu na na lɔxɔɛ. Alatala nan na lɔxɔɛ mɔɔli kolon. Kɔnɔ nunmare tɛmui naiyalanma nɛ.

sentences.english: And on that day living waters will go out from Jerusalem; half of them flowing to the sea on the east and half to the sea on the west: in summer and in winter it will be so.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, kisi ye minima nɛ Darisalamu, sɛɛti te sogetede baa mabiri, sɛɛti goro sogegorode baa mabiri. A minima nɛ soge fure nun ɲɛmɛ tɛmui.

sentences.english: And the Lord will be King over all the earth: in that day there will be one Lord and his name one.
sentences.susu: Alatala nan findima duniɲa birin mangɛ ra. Na lɔxɔɛ, Alatala nan keren fama batude, a xili nan gbansan falama.

sentences.english: And all the land will become like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up and be living in her place; from the doorway of Benjamin to the place of the first doorway, to the doorway of the angle, and from the tower of Hananel to the king's wine-crushing places, men will be living in her.
sentences.susu: Darisalamu bɔxi rabilinyi birin findima nɛ mɛrɛ ra, kelife Geba, sa dɔxɔ Rimɔn na, Darisalamu yirefanyi ma. Darisalamu xa fe itema nɛ, a xa nɔɛ fa yensen yɛ kelife Bunyamin naadɛ ma, sa dɔxɔ naadɛ singe ra, han tunxui naadɛ, han Xananɛli koore banxi, han mangɛ xa wɛni yailande.

sentences.english: And there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will be living without fear of danger.
sentences.susu: Mixie sabatima nɛ taa kui, e mu halakima sɔnɔn. Darisalamu luma nɛ bɔɲɛsa kui.

sentences.english: And this will be the disease which the Lord will send on all the peoples which have been warring against Jerusalem: their flesh will be wasted away while they are on their feet, their eyes will be wasted in their heads and their tongues in their mouths.
sentences.susu: Alatala fama nɛ fure ɲaaxi sinde sie ma naxee Darisalamu gerexi. E fate kiri birin bɔrɔma nɛ beenu e xa faxa. E yae bɔrɔma nɛ e ya yili kui, e nɛnyi bɔrɔma nɛ e dɛ kui.

sentences.english: And it will be on that day that a great fear will be sent among them from the Lord; and everyone will take his neighbour's hand, and every man's hand will be lifted against his neighbour's.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, Alatala mixie ya isoma nɛ, e e boore suxu, e e boore bɔnbɔ.

sentences.english: And even Judah will be fighting against Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the nations round about will be massed together, a great store of gold and silver and clothing.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae gere tima nɛ Darisalamu. E naafuli bama nɛ sie yi ra naxee na e rabilinyi, xɛɛma, gbeti, nun dugi gbegbe.

sentences.english: And the horses and the transport beasts, the camels and the asses and all the beasts in those tents will be attacked by the same disease.
sentences.susu: Na fure ɲaaxi mɔɔli nde fan sinma nɛ xuruse birin ma: soee, sofalee, ɲɔxɔmɛe.

sentences.english: And it will come about that everyone who is still living, of all those nations who came against Jerusalem, will go up from year to year to give worship to the King, the Lord of armies, and to keep the feast of tents.
sentences.susu: Darisalamu yaxui naxee mu faxaxi na kui, nee luma nɛ te ra ɲɛ birin Mangɛ Alatala batude, e xa Bage Ti Sali raba na.

sentences.english: And it will be that if any one of all the families of the earth does not go up to Jerusalem to give worship to the King, the Lord of armies, on them there will be no rain.
sentences.susu: Xa duniɲa xabilɛ nde tondi sigade Darisalamu Mangɛ Alatala batude, tunɛ mu sinma e xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And if the family of Egypt does not go up or come there, they will be attacked by the disease which the Lord will send on the nations:
sentences.susu: Xa Misira xabilɛ nde tondi sigade, tunɛ mu goroma mɛnni. Alatala xa fure ɲaaxi nan na ki, a naxan nagoro sie ma, naxee tondixi sigade Bage Ti Sali rabade.

sentences.english: This will be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all the nations who do not go up to keep the feast of tents.
sentences.susu: Alatala Misira nun si birin ɲaxankatama na ki nɛ, naxee tondi sigade Bage Ti Sali rabade.

sentences.english: On that day all the bells of the horses will be holy to the Lord, and the pots in the Lord's house will be like the basins before the altar.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, birin findima Alatala gbe nan na. A fama nɛ sɛbɛde tɔlɔnyie ma naxee gbakuxi soee ra, «Alatala gbe.» Tunde naxee sube gbansan ɲinma Alatala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, nee sɛniyɛnma nɛ alɔ yirabasee naxee rawalima sɛrɛxɛbade sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to the Lord of armies: and all those who make offerings will come and take them for boiling their offerings: in that day there will be no more traders in the house of the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Tunde birin naxee na Darisalamu nun Yudaya, nee birin sɛniyɛnma nɛ, nee birin findima nɛ Mangɛ Alatala gbe ra. Mixi birin naxee fama sɛrɛxɛ bade, nee fama nɛ tunde ndee ra alako e xa kuri so. Na lɔxɔɛ, Kanaan kaafiri yo mu soma Mangɛ Alatala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: The word of the Lord to Israel by Malachi.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa wɔyɛnyi xɔrɔxɔɛ Isirayilakae bɛ Annabi Malaki saabui ra:

sentences.english: You have been loved by me, says the Lord. But you say, Where was your love for us? Was not Esau Jacob's brother? says the Lord: but Jacob was loved by me,
sentences.susu: Alatala xa masenyi nan ya, «N bara wo xanu, kɔnɔ wo maxɔrinyi tima n ma, ‹Ala, muxu xa marafanyi na minden?›» Ala naxɛ, «Yaxuba taara xa mu lanxi Esayu ma? Yaxuba tan a rafan n tan Ala ma,

sentences.english: And Esau was hated, and I sent destruction on his mountains, and gave his heritage to the beasts of the waste land.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ n bara Esayu tan naɲaaxu. N bara a xa bɔxi geya yire mafindi gbengberen yire ra. N bara a kɛ so wulai baree yi ra naxee na gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: Though Edom says, We are crushed down but we will come back, building up the waste places; this is what the Lord of armies has said: They may put up buildings, but I will have them pulled down; and they will be named The land of evil-doing, and The people against whom the Lord keeps his wrath for ever.
sentences.susu: Xa Edonkae, naxee kelixi Esayu bɔnsɔɛ, a fala, ‹Won bara gbaloe sɔtɔ, kɔnɔ won na yailanma,› Mangɛ Alatala e yaabima nɛ, ‹Xa wo banxi ti, n na rabirama nɛ.› E xili fama nɛ falade, ‹Ɲaaxuɲa bɔxi.› E a falama nɛ ɲama na a ra Alatala xɔnɔxi naxan ma tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: And your eyes will see it; and you will say, The Lord is great even outside the limits of Israel.
sentences.susu: Wo yae fama nɛ a tode. Wo yɛtɛ yati a falama nɛ, ‹Alatala xa mangɛya sɛnbɛ gbo duniɲa birin, hali Isirayila bɔxi fari ma.›»

sentences.english: A son gives honour to his father, and a servant has fear of his master: if then I am a father, where is my honour? and if I am a master, where is the fear of me? says the Lord of armies to you, O priests, who give no value to my name. And you say, How have we not given value to your name?
sentences.susu: «Di tan a baba binyama nɛ, konyi fan a marigi binya. Xa n tan nan na wo baba ra, n ma binyɛ na minden? Xa n tan nan na wo marigi ra, n ma binyɛ na minden? N tan wo xa Mangɛ Alatala, n xa a fala wo bɛ, wo na n xili yelebufe. Kɔnɔ wo n maxɔrinfe, ‹Muxu i xili yelebuxi di?›

sentences.english: You put unclean bread on my altar. And you say, How have we made it unclean? By your saying, The table of the Lord is of no value.
sentences.susu: Wo na n xili yelebufe wo xa sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛntaree nan na wo naxee sama n ma sɛrɛxɛbade fari. Wo man n maxɔrinma, ‹Muxu faxi sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛntare mundun na?› N xa a fala wo bɛ, wo bara n ma sɛrɛxɛbade xa fe yelebu.

sentences.english: And when you give what is blind for an offering, it is no evil! and when you give what is damaged and ill, it is no evil! Give it now to your ruler; will he be pleased with you, or will you have his approval? says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Wo na xuruse dɔnxui ba sɛrɛxɛ ra, na fan? Wo na fa xuruse mabɛnxi ra, xa na mu xuruse furaxi ra, na fan? Xa wo bara na sɛrɛxɛ mɔɔli so wo xa mangɛ yi ra, a ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ wo ra? A wo rasɛnɛma nɛ a fanyi ra? Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And now, make request for the grace of God so that he may have mercy on us: this has been your doing: will he give his approval to any of you? says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: «Xa wo Ala makula na sɛrɛxɛ mɔɔli ra, a hinnɛma wo ra, a wo rasɛnɛma a fanyi ra? Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: If only there was one among you who would see that the doors were shut, so that you might not put a light to the fire on my altar for nothing! I have no pleasure in you, says the Lord of armies, and I will not take an offering from your hands.
sentences.susu: «A lanma mixi nde wo ya ma a xa n ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛ balan, alako wo naxa tɛ radɛxɛ n ma sɛrɛxɛbade fari fufafu. Wo xa fe mu rafan n ma. N tan Mangɛ Alatala, n xa a fala wo bɛ a n mu wama wo xa sɛrɛxɛ xɔn, n mu a tongoma! Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: For, from the coming up of the sun till its going down, my name is great among the Gentiles; and in every place the smell of burning flesh is offered to my name, and a clean offering: for my name is great among the Gentiles, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: «Kelife sogetede, sigafe han sogegorode n xili xungbo si birin tagi. Yire birin, e fama nɛ surayi gande n xili ra, e fa sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxi ra n ma binyɛ xa fe ra. Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: But you make it unholy by saying, The Lord's table has become unclean, and his food is of no value.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ wo tan n xili yelebuma. Wo nu fa a fala, ‹Marigi xa sɛrɛxɛbade mu sɛniyɛnxi, sɛrɛxɛ naxan bama mɛnni a mu fan.›

sentences.english: And you say, See, what a weariness it is! and you let out your breath at it, says the Lord of armies; and you have given what has been cut about by beasts, and what is damaged in its feet and ill; this is the offering you give: will this be pleasing to me from your hands? says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo wo xunyi suxuma, wo nu fa sɔnxɔ, ‹Taganyi mundun yi ki!› N tan Mangɛ Alatala, n xa a fala wo bɛ, n mu fama wo xa xuruse maxɔnɔxi, wo xa xuruse mabɛnxi, nun wo xa xuruse furaxi tongode n ma sɛrɛxɛbade sɔnɔn. Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: A curse on the false man who has a male in his flock, and takes his oath, and gives to the Lord a damaged thing: for I am a great King, says the Lord of armies, and my name is to be feared among the Gentiles.
sentences.susu: «Dankɛ na mixi korintexi bɛ yɛxɛɛ kontonyi na naxan xa gɔɔrɛ ya ma, kɔnɔ a fa xuruse maxɔnɔxi tan ba sɛrɛxɛ ra a xa marakali rakamalife ra. Mangɛ xungbe na n na, naxan xili magaaxu si birin tagi. Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And now, O you priests, this order is for you.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, wo xa wo tuli mati.

sentences.english: If you will not give ear and take it to heart, to give glory to my name, says the Lord of armies, then I will send the curse on you and will put a curse on your blessing: truly, even now I have put a curse on it, because you do not take it to heart.
sentences.susu: Xa wo mu wo tuli mati n na, xa wo mu ɲanige tongo n xili binyafe ma, n tan Mangɛ Alatala wo dankama nɛ. N wo xa dubɛ mafindima nɛ dankɛ ra. N bara wo xa duba kana barima n ma binyɛ mu na wo ɲanige ma. Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: See, I will have your arm cut off, and will put waste on your faces, even the waste from your feasts; and you will be taken away with it.
sentences.susu: «Wo a toma nɛ! N wo bɔnsɔɛ ɲaxankatama nɛ. Wo xuruse naxee bama sɛrɛxɛ ra, n e gbi kasanma nɛ wo yatagi. Wo nun na yaagi nan sigama.

sentences.english: And you will be certain that I have sent this order to you, so that it might be my agreement with Levi, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: N tan Mangɛ Alatala bara yi wɔyɛnyi xɔrɔxɔɛ fala wo bɛ alako n ma saatɛ, n naxan tongoxi wo benba Lewi bɛ, a naxa kana sɔnɔn. Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: My agreement with him was on my side life and peace, and I gave them to him; on his side fear, and he had fear of me and gave honour to my name.
sentences.susu: «N naxa saatɛ tongo a bɛ. N naxa simaya nun bɔɲɛsa fi a ma, alako a xa gaaxu n ya ra. Na tɛmui a bara gaaxu n ya ra, a bara sɛrɛn n xili ra.

sentences.english: True teaching was in his mouth, and no evil was seen on his lips: he was walking with me in peace and righteousness, turning numbers of people away from evil-doing.
sentences.susu: N ma sɛriyɛ yati nu na a dɛ kui, maifui yo mu nu na a bɔɲɛ kui. A bira nɛ n fɔxɔ ra bɔɲɛsa nun tinxinyi kui, a mixie ragbilen kira ɲaaxi fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: For it is right for the priest's lips to keep knowledge, and for men to be waiting for the law from his mouth: for he is the servant sent from the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ dɛ lɔnni nan nagatama. Ala xa sɛriyɛ minima nɛ a dɛ i, barima Mangɛ Alatala xa xɛɛra nan na a ra.»

sentences.english: But you are turned out of the way; you have made the law hard for numbers of people; you have made the agreement of Levi of no value, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ wo tan, wo bara gbilen Ala xa kira fɔxɔ ra. Wo bara mixi wuyaxi ramini na kira ra wo xa xaranyi ra. N tan Mangɛ Alatala naxɛ wo bara Lewi xa saatɛ kana. Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And so I have taken away your honour and made you low before all the people, even as you have not kept my ways, and have given no thought to me in using the law.
sentences.susu: N wo rayaagima nɛ, n wo xa fe magoro ɲama ya xɔri, barima wo mu n ma kira kolon. Wo bara mixi rafisa e boore bɛ wo xa kiiti kui.»

sentences.english: Have we not all one father? has not one God made us? why are we, every one of us, acting falsely to his brother, putting shame on the agreement of our fathers?
sentences.susu: Annabi Malaki naxɛ, won birin baba keren xa mu a ra? Ala keren xa mu won birin daaxi? Munfe ra won won boore yanfama? Munfe ra won bara won benba xa saatɛ kana?

sentences.english: Judah has been acting falsely, and a disgusting thing has been done in Jerusalem; for Judah has made unclean the holy place of the Lord which is dear to him, and has taken as his wife the daughter of a strange god.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae naxa Ala yanfa, barima fe ɲaaxi bara raba Isirayila nun Darisalamu bɔxi ma. Yudaya bara Alatala batude yelebu naxan nafan a ma. A bara kuye batui xa di ginɛ dɔxɔ.

sentences.english: The Lord will have the man who does this cut off root and branch out of the tents of Jacob, and him who makes an offering to the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Alatala na xɛmɛ mɔɔli, nun a xa die, a nun a xa denbaya birin kerima nɛ Yaxuba xa kiri banxi kui. A na xɛmɛ mɔɔli kerima nɛ, a nun a sɛrɛxɛ naxan bama Mangɛ Alatala bɛ.

sentences.english: And this again you do: covering the altar of the Lord with weeping and with grief, so that he gives no more thought to the offering, and does not take it with pleasure from your hand.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, wo tan wo ya ye gbegbe raminima Alatala xa sɛrɛxɛbade, barima wo naxɛ a mu wo xa sɛrɛxɛ tongoma, a mu wama a xɔn sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: But you say, For what reason? Because the Lord has been a witness between you and the wife of your early years, to whom you have been untrue, though she is your friend and the wife to whom you have given your word.
sentences.susu: Wo n maxɔrinma «Munfe ra?» N a falama wo bɛ. Wo ginɛ naxan sugandi wo fonike tɛmui, wo naxan xa futi xiri Alatala xa seedeɲɔxɔya kui, wo bara na ginɛ yanfa.

sentences.english: ... So give thought to your spirit, and let no one be false to the wife of his early years.
sentences.susu: Alatala xa mu adama daaxi, a a nii raso a fate? Adama mu die fenma xɛ Ala naxee ragirima a ma? Wo mɛɛni wo nii ma, wo naxa wo xa ginɛ yanfa, wo naxan sɔtɔ wo fonike tɛmui.

sentences.english: For I am against the putting away of a wife, says the Lord, the God of Israel, and against him who is clothed with violent acts, says the Lord of armies: so give thought to your spirit and do not be false in your acts.
sentences.susu: Isirayila Marigi Alatala naxɛ, mɛɛfe i xa ginɛ ra, nun gere tife, fee nan e ra n naxee xɔnxi. Wo mɛɛni wo nii ma, wo naxa findi yanfante mixie ra.

sentences.english: You have made the Lord tired with your words. And still you say, How have we made him tired? By your saying, Everyone who does evil is good in the eyes of the Lord, and he has delight in them; or, Where is God the judge?
sentences.susu: Wo bara Alatala ratagan wo xa wɔyɛnyi ra, kɔnɔ wo fa maxɔrinyi tife, «Muxu a rataganxi di?» N xa wo yaabi. Wo a rataganxi a falafe ra, «Fe kobi rabama nan nafan Alatala ma, a na mixi mɔɔli nan fenma.» Wo man a rataganxi a falafe ra, «Ala kiitisa na minden?»

sentences.english: See, I am sending my servant, and he will make ready the way before me; and the Lord, whom you are looking for, will suddenly come to his Temple; and the angel of the agreement, in whom you have delight, see, he is coming, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: «Wo wo ya ti, n fama nɛ n ma xɛɛra xɛɛde naxan kira yailanma n bɛ. Wo Marigi, wo naxan fenfe, a fama nɛ sode a xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui keren na. Saatɛ xɛɛra, wo wama naxan xɔn, a na fafe. Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: But by whom may the day of his coming be faced? and who may keep his place when he is seen? for he is like the metal-tester's fire and the cleaner's soap.
sentences.susu: «A na fa, nde nɔma suusade a ra? Nde nɔma tide a ya i? Barima a luma nɛ alɔ xabure tɛ naxan se raxunuma. A luma nɛ alɔ xɔsi base dugi xae naxan nawalima.

sentences.english: He will take his seat, testing and cleaning the sons of Levi, burning away the evil from them as from gold and silver; so that they may make offerings to the Lord in righteousness.
sentences.susu: A fama nɛ gbeti raxunude, a a gbi ba. A Lewi xa die rasɛniyɛnma nɛ. A e raxunuma nɛ alɔ xɛɛma a nun gbeti, a e gbi ba. E xa findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra Alatala bɛ naxee sɛrɛxɛ bama tinxinyi kui.»

sentences.english: Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasing to the Lord, as in days gone by, and as in past years.
sentences.susu: «Na tɛmui, Yudaya nun Darisalamu xa sɛrɛxɛ rafanma nɛ Alatala ma alɔ tɛmui dangixi, alɔ waxati fori.

sentences.english: And I will come near to you for judging; I will quickly be a witness against the wonder-workers, against those who have been untrue in married life, against those who take false oaths; against those who keep back from the servant his payment, and who are hard on the widow and the child without a father, who do not give his rights to the man from a strange country, and have no fear of me, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: N fama nɛ wo xa kiiti sade. N kiiti sama nɛ keren na mandurulae, yɛnɛlae, wule falɛe, nun mixi kobie ma naxee walikɛ sare donma, naxee kaaɲɛ ginɛe, kiridie, nun xɔɲɛe tɔɔrɔma. N kiiti sama nɛ mixie ma naxee mu gaaxuma n ya ra. Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: For I am the Lord, I am unchanged; and so you, O sons of Jacob, have not been cut off.
sentences.susu: «N to findixi Alatala nan na, naxan mu a xui masarama, wo tan Yaxuba xa die tan mu faxa.

sentences.english: From the days of your fathers you have been turned away from my rules and have not kept them. Come back to me, and I will come back to you, says the Lord of armies. But you say, How are we to come back?
sentences.susu: Kabi wo benbae xa tɛmui, wo bara n ma sɛriyɛ kana, wo bara a matandi. Yakɔsi, wo xa gbilen n ma, n fan gbilenma nɛ wo yire. Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.» «Kɔnɔ wo na n maxɔrinfe, ‹Muxu xa gbilen i ma di?›

sentences.english: Will a man keep back from God what is right? But you have kept back what is mine. But you say, What have we kept back from you? Tenths and offerings.
sentences.susu: N fan xa wo maxɔrin. Adamadi nɔma a Marigi Ala muɲade? Kɔnɔ wo tan yati bara n muɲa. Wo nu fa n maxɔrin, ‹Muxu bara munse muɲa i ma?› N xa wo yaabi. Wo bara n ma farilɛe nun n ma sɛrɛxɛe muɲa.

sentences.english: You are cursed with a curse; for you have kept back from me what is mine, even all this nation.
sentences.susu: N bara wo bɔnsɔɛ birin danka na muɲɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Let your tenths come into the store-house so that there may be food in my house, and put me to the test by doing so, says the Lord of armies, and see if I do not make the windows of heaven open and send down such a blessing on you that there is no room for it.
sentences.susu: Wo xa fa farilɛ birin na Ala xa banxi, farilɛ ragatade, alako baloe xa lu n ma banxi kui. Wo xa n tan Mangɛ Alatala mato, xa n mu fama barakɛ gbegbe ragorode wo ma kelife koore naxan dangi wo xa se ragatadee ra.

sentences.english: And on your account I will keep back the locusts from wasting the fruits of your land; and the fruit of your vine will not be dropped on the field before its time, says the Lord of armies
sentences.susu: N nimasee faxama nɛ naxee wo xa xɛe nun wo xa wɛni bilie kanama. Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: And you will be named happy by all nations: for you will be a land of delight, says the Lord of armies.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui si birin fama nɛ wo xa bɔxi xili falade ɲɛlɛxin bɔxi, barima barakɛ na wo xɔnyi. Mangɛ Alatala xa masenyi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: Your words have been strong against me, says the Lord. And still you say, What have we said against you?
sentences.susu: Alatala naxɛ, «Wo bara wɔyɛnyi xɔrɔxɔɛ fala n bɛ, kɔnɔ wo n maxɔrinfe, ‹Muxu bara wɔyɛnyi xɔrɔxɔɛ mundun fala i bɛ?›

sentences.english: You have said, It is no use worshipping God: what profit have we had from keeping his orders, and going in clothing of sorrow before the Lord of armies?
sentences.susu: N xa wo yaabi. Wo naxɛ, ‹Geeni yo mu na Ala xa batui kui. Muxu bara a xa sɛriyɛ suxu, muxu bara tɔɔrɔ a xa fe ra, kɔnɔ muxu geeni mundun sɔtɔxi Mangɛ Alatala ra?

sentences.english: And now to us the men of pride seem happy; yes, the evil-doers are doing well; they put God to the test and are safe.
sentences.susu: Muxu tan bɛ, mixi naxan a yɛtɛ itema, a ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ, mixi kobi nan geenima, Ala matandila mu ɲaxankatama.›»

sentences.english: Then those in whom was the fear of the Lord had talk together: and the Lord gave ear, and it was recorded in a book to be kept in mind before him, for those who had the fear of the Lord and gave thought to his name.
sentences.susu: Na wɔyɛnyi xanbi, mixi naxan nu gaaxuma Ala ya ra, e bara lu yire keren, e wɔyɛn e boore ra. Alatala bara e xui mɛ a fanyi ra. Na Ala yaragaaxuie xili bara sɛbɛ sɛbɛli nde ra Ala ya i, barima e nu bara Alatala xili binya.

sentences.english: And they will be mine, says the Lord, in the day when I make them my special property; and I will have mercy on them as a man has mercy on his son who is his servant.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Alatala naxɛ, «Nee findixi n ma ɲama yati yati nan na. N e ratangama nɛ kiiti sa lɔxɔɛ alɔ baba naxan kinikinima a xa di fanyi ma.

sentences.english: Then you will again see how the upright man is different from the sinner, and the servant of God from him who is not.
sentences.susu: Na kui wo man fama nɛ mixi kobi nun mixi fanyi tagi rasa kolonde, Ala batulae nun Ala matandilae.»

sentences.english: The book of the generations of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.
sentences.susu: Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi naxan fatan Dawuda nun Iburahima bɔnsɔɛ ra, a benbae xilie nan yi ki:

sentences.english: The son of Abraham was Isaac; and the son of Isaac was Jacob; and the sons of Jacob were Judah and his brothers;
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa Isiyaga sɔtɔ. Isiyaga naxa Yaxuba sɔtɔ. Yaxuba naxa Yuda nun a taarae nun a xunyae sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Judah were Perez and Zerah by Tamar; and the son of Perez was Hezron; and the son of Hezron was Ram;
sentences.susu: Yuda naxa Peresi nun Sera sɔtɔ, Tamari xa die. Peresi naxa Xesiron sɔtɔ. Xesiron naxa Arami sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the son of Ram was Amminadab; and the son of Amminadab was Nahshon; and the son of Nahshon was Salmon;
sentences.susu: Arami naxa Aminadabo sɔtɔ. Aminadabo naxa Naxason sɔtɔ. Naxason naxa Salimon sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the son of Salmon by Rahab was Boaz; and the son of Boaz by Ruth was Obed; and the son of Obed was Jesse;
sentences.susu: Salimon naxa Boosu sɔtɔ, Raxabi xa di. Boosu naxa Obedo sɔtɔ, Ruti xa di.

sentences.english: And the son of Jesse was David the king; and the son of David was Solomon by her who had been the wife of Uriah;
sentences.susu: Obedo naxa Yisayi sɔtɔ. Yisayi naxa Dawuda sɔtɔ. Mangɛ Dawuda naxa Sulemani sɔtɔ Uriya xa ginɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: And the son of Solomon was Rehoboam; and the son of Rehoboam was Abijah; and the son of Abijah was Asa;
sentences.susu: Sulemani naxa Robowami sɔtɔ. Robowami naxa Abiya sɔtɔ. Abiya naxa Asa sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the son of Asa was Jehoshaphat; and the son of Jehoshaphat was Joram; and the son of Joram was Uzziah;
sentences.susu: Asa naxa Yehosafati sɔtɔ. Yehosafati naxa Yehorami sɔtɔ. Yehorami naxa Yusiya sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the son of Uzziah was Jotham; and the son of Jotham was Ahaz; and the son of Ahaz was Hezekiah;
sentences.susu: Yusiya naxa Yotami sɔtɔ. Yotami naxa Axasi sɔtɔ. Axasi naxa Xesekiya sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the son of Hezekiah was Manasseh; and the son of Manasseh was Amon; and the son of Amon was Josiah;
sentences.susu: Xesekiya naxa Manasi sɔtɔ. Manasi naxa Amon sɔtɔ. Amon naxa Yosiya sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the sons of Josiah were Jechoniah and his brothers, at the time of the taking away to Babylon.
sentences.susu: Yosiya naxa Yekoniya nun a xunyae sɔtɔ, Isirayilakae xaninxi Babilɔn tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And after the taking away to Babylon, Jechoniah had a son Shealtiel; and Shealtiel had Zerubbabel;
sentences.susu: E to siga Babilɔn, Yekoniya naxa Salatiyeli sɔtɔ. Salatiyeli naxa Sorobabeli sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Zerubbabel had Abiud; and Abiud had Eliakim; and Eliakim had Azor;
sentences.susu: Sorobabeli naxa Abiyudi sɔtɔ. Abiyudi naxa Eliyakimi sɔtɔ. Eliyakimi naxa Asoro sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Azor had Zadok; and Zadok had Achim; and Achim had Eliud;
sentences.susu: Asoro naxa Sadɔki sɔtɔ. Sadɔki naxa Aximi sɔtɔ. Aximi naxa Eliyudi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And Eliud had Eleazar; and Eleazar had Matthan; and Matthan had Jacob;
sentences.susu: Eliyudi naxa Eleyasari sɔtɔ. Eleyasari naxa Matan sɔtɔ. Matan naxa Yaxuba sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the son of Jacob was Joseph the husband of Mary, who gave birth to Jesus, whose name is Christ.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa Yusufu sɔtɔ. Yusufu naxa Mariyama dɔxɔ. Mariyama nan findi Isa nga ra, naxan xili Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi.

sentences.english: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; and from David to the taking away to Babylon, fourteen generations; and from the taking away to Babylon to the coming of Christ, fourteen generations.
sentences.susu: A birin nalanxi benba dɔxɔ fu nun naani, keli Iburahima ma sa dɔxɔ Dawuda ra. A birin nalanxi benba dɔxɔ fu nun naani, keli Dawuda ma, han Isirayilakae siga tɛmui naxɛ Babilɔn. A birin nalanxi benba dɔxɔ fu nun naani, keli Isirayilakae siga tɛmui ma Babilɔn, han a sa dɔxɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa waxati ra.

sentences.english: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was in this way: when his mother Mary was going to be married to Joseph, before they came together the discovery was made that she was with child by the Holy Spirit.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa bari raba yi ki nɛ: Yusufu nu bara Isa nga Mariyama xa kote dɔxɔ, kɔnɔ beenun e xa kafu, Mariyama naxa tɛɛgɛ Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa kaabanako saabui ra.

sentences.english: And Joseph, her husband, being an upright man, and not desiring to make her a public example, had a mind to put her away privately.
sentences.susu: A xa mɔri Yusufu to findixi tinxintɔɛ ra, a mu nu waxi Mariyama xili kanafe. A naxa natɛ tongo e xa fatan gundoɲɔxɔɲa kui.

sentences.english: But when he was giving thought to these things, an angel of the Lord came to him in a dream, saying, Joseph, son of David, have no fear of taking Mary as your wife; because that which is in her body is of the Holy Spirit.
sentences.susu: A nu a maɲɔxunma na fe ma tɛmui naxɛ, Marigi xa malekɛ nde naxa mini a ma xiye kui, a a masen a bɛ, «Yusufu, i tan naxan kelixi Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ, i naxa gaaxu i xa ginɛ Mariyama futife ra, barima a tɛɛgɛxi di naxan ma, a fatanxi Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa kaabanako nan na.

sentences.english: And she will give birth to a son; and you will give him the name Jesus; for he will give his people salvation from their sins.
sentences.susu: Mariyama fama di xɛmɛ nan baride. I xa a xili sa Isa, barima a tan nan fama a xa ɲama rakiside e xa yunubie ma.»

sentences.english: Now all this took place so that the word of the Lord by the prophet might come true,
sentences.susu: Na birin naba nɛ alako Marigi naxan masen namiɲɔnmɛ saabui ra, a xa kamali alɔ a sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui ki naxɛ,

sentences.english: See, the virgin will be with child, and will give birth to a son, and they will give him the name Immanuel, that is, God with us.
sentences.susu: «Ginɛdimɛdi tɛɛgɛma nɛ, a di xɛmɛ bari. E a xili falama nɛ Emanuwɛli.» Na nan na ki, «Ala na won ya ma.»

sentences.english: And Joseph did as the angel of the Lord had said to him, and took her as his wife;
