sentences.english: To say to him, Are you he who is to come, or are we waiting for another?
sentences.susu: E naxa a maxɔrin, «I findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan na naxan lanma a xa fa, ka muxu xa mixi gbɛtɛ nan mamɛ?»

sentences.english: And Jesus, answering, said to them, Go and give news to John of the things which you are seeing and hearing:
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Wo fe naxan mɛxi nun wo fe naxan toxi, wo sa na dɛntɛgɛ sa Yaya bɛ.

sentences.english: The blind see; those who were not able to, are walking; lepers are made clean; those who were without hearing, now have their ears open; the dead come to life again, and the poor have the good news given to them.
sentences.susu: Dɔnxuie se toma, namatɛe ɲɛrɛma, kunɛ kanyie yalanma, tulixɔrie fe mɛma, faxamixie kelima, fuxarilae kawandima xibaaru fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And a blessing will be on him who has no doubts about me.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ na mixi bɛ naxan mu siikɛma n ma fe ra.»

sentences.english: And when they were going away, Jesus, talking of John, said to all the people, What went you out into the waste land to see? a tall stem moving in the wind?
sentences.susu: Annabi Yaya fɔxirabirɛe to siga, Isa naxa ɲama maxɔrin Yaya xa fe ma, «Wo siga munse matode wula i? Kale, foye naxan namaxama?

sentences.english: But what went you out to see? a man delicately clothed? Those who have fair robes are in kings' houses.
sentences.susu: Xa na mu a ra, wo siga munse matode? Dugi tofanyi kanyi? Dugi tofanyi kanyie toma mangɛ banxie nan kui.

sentences.english: But why did you go out? to see a prophet? Yes, I say to you, and more than a prophet.
sentences.susu: Wo fa siga munse matode? Namiɲɔnmɛ? Iyo, n xa a fala wo bɛ, a ɲan dangi namiɲɔnmɛ ra.

sentences.english: This is he of whom it has been said, See, I send my servant before your face, who will make ready your way before you.
sentences.susu: A tan nan xa fe sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, ‹N fama n ma xɛɛra rasanbade i ya ra alako a xa kira yailan i bɛ.›

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, Among the sons of women there has not been a greater than John the Baptist: but he who is least in the kingdom of heaven is greater than he.
sentences.susu: N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, ginɛ yo mu di bari naxan dangi Yaya Xunxa ra. Kɔnɔ n man xa a fala wo bɛ, mixi naxan na Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma, a xurun kiyoki, a fan dangi Yaya ra.

sentences.english: And from the days of John the Baptist till now, the kingdom of heaven is forcing its way in, and men of force take it.
sentences.susu: Kabi Yaya Xunxa xa waxati han to, Ala xa mangɛya sɛnbɛ nan tun sɔtɔma. Sɛnbɛmae nan luma a niini bun ma.

sentences.english: For all the prophets and the law were in force till John.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛe birin nun Tawureta Munsa bara Ala xa mangɛya niini xa fe fala han Annabi Yaya waxati.

sentences.english: And if you are able to see it, this is Elijah who was to come.
sentences.susu: Xa wo tinma nɔndi ra, wo xa a kolon Kitaabui to a fala a Annabi Eliya gbilenma fa ra, a nu Yaya nan ma fe falafe.

sentences.english: He who has ears, let him give ear.
sentences.susu: Xa wo tuli fe mɛma, wo xa wo tuli mati yi masenyi ra.»

sentences.english: But what comparison may I make of this generation? It is like children seated in the market-places, crying out to one another,
sentences.susu: «N nɔma to mixie misaalide munse ra? E maniyaxi dimɛdie nan na naxee dɔxɔxi taa kui, e nu a fala e booree bɛ,

sentences.english: We made music for you and you did not take part in the dance; we gave cries of sorrow and you made no signs of grief.
sentences.susu: ‹Muxu bara xule fe wo bɛ, kɔnɔ wo mu fare boronxi. Muxu bara ɲɔn bɛɛti ba, kɔnɔ wo mu sunnunxi.›»

sentences.english: For John came, taking no food or drink, and they say, He has an evil spirit.
sentences.susu: «Annabi Yaya to nu sunma, e naxa a fala a xa fe ra, ‹Ɲinnɛ na a fɔxɔ ra.›

sentences.english: The Son of man has come feasting, and they say, See, a lover of food and wine, a friend of tax-farmers and sinners! And wisdom is judged to be right by her works.
sentences.susu: Adama xa Di to fa, a tan mu tondi sigade xulunyi yire. Na kui, e bara a fala, ‹Furi ɲaaxi siisila mato! E nun duuti maxilie nun yunubitɔɛe nan a ra!› Kɔnɔ xaxilimaya kolonma a kɛwali nan ma.»

sentences.english: Then he went on to say hard things to the towns where most of his works of power were done, because they had not been turned from their sins.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isa naxa xɔnɔ mixie ma naxee nu sabatixi taae kui a kaabanako gbegbe rabaxi dɛnnaxɛ, barima e mu tuubi.

sentences.english: Unhappy are you, Chorazin! Unhappy are you, Beth-saida! For if the works of power which were done in you had been done in Tyre and Sidon, they would have been turned from their sins in days gone by, clothing themselves in haircloth and putting dust on their heads.
sentences.susu: «Gbaloe na wo bɛ, Korasinkae! Gbaloe na wo fan bɛ, Betesayidakae! Kaabanako naxee raba wo tagi, xa nee sa raba Tire nun Sidɔn nɛ nu, a a lima e tan bara tuubi nu a rakuya, e sunnun donma ragoro e ma, e tɛ xube maso e ma e xa tuubi tɔnxuma ra.

sentences.english: But I say to you, It will be better for Tyre and Sidon in the day of judging, than for you.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra n xa a fala wo bɛ, kiiti sa lɔxɔɛ xɔrɔxɔma wo tan ma dangi Tirekae nun Sidɔnkae ra.

sentences.english: And you, Capernaum, were you not to be lifted up to heaven? you will go down into hell: for if the works of power which were done in you had been done in Sodom, it would have been here to this day.
sentences.susu: I tan Kapɛrɛnamu go, i ɲɔxɔ a ma a i tema han ariyanna kui? Ade, i ragoroma nɛ han yahannama, barima kaabanako naxee raba i tagi, xa nee sa raba Sodoma nɛ nu, a a lima na taa mu sɔntɔma nu.

sentences.english: But I say to you that it will be better for the land of Sodom in the day of judging, than for you.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, n xa a fala wo bɛ, kiitisa lɔxɔɛ xɔrɔxɔma wo tan ma dangi Sodomakae ra.»

sentences.english: At that time Jesus made answer and said, I give praise to you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have kept these things secret from the wise and the men of learning, and have made them clear to little children.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isa naxa a fala, «Baba Ala, koore nun bɔxi Marigi, n bara i tantu i to yi fee nɔxunxi lɔnnilae nun xaxilimae ma, i e masen dimɛdie bɛ.

sentences.english: Yes, Father, for so it was pleasing in your eyes.
sentences.susu: Iyo, n Baba, n bara i tantu barima i kɛnɛn fe nan ya.»

sentences.english: All things have been given to me by my Father; and no one has knowledge of the Son, but the Father; and no one has knowledge of the Father, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will make it clear.
sentences.susu: «N Baba bara fe birin taxu n na. Mixi yo mu Ala xa Di kolon, fo Baba Ala. Mixi yo mu Baba Ala kolon, fo Ala xa Di, a nun Di nu tin a masende naxan bɛ.

sentences.english: Come to me, all you who are troubled and weighted down with care, and I will give you rest.
sentences.susu: Wo fa n ma, wo tan naxee taganxi, kote binye naxee xun, n xa malabui fi wo ma.

sentences.english: Take my yoke on you and become like me, for I am gentle and without pride, and you will have rest for your souls;
sentences.susu: Wo xa n ma karafoe nan nagoro wo kɔn ma, wo xa findi n ma taalibie ra, barima n bɔɲɛ bɛɛxi, a mu tema. Na kui, wo bɔɲɛ malabui sɔtɔma nɛ,

sentences.english: For my yoke is good, and the weight I take up is not hard.
sentences.susu: barima n karafoe naxan nagoroma wo kɔn, a mu xɔrɔxɔ, n kote naxan dɔxɔma wo xun, a mu binya.»

sentences.english: At that time Jesus went through the fields on the Sabbath day; and his disciples, being in need of food, were taking the heads of grain.
sentences.susu: Na waxati, malabu lɔxɔɛ ma, Isa nu ɲɛrɛfe xɛe tagi. Kaamɛ to nu a fɔxirabirɛe suxuxi, e naxa mɛngi tɔnsɔɛ ndee ba, e xa e don.

sentences.english: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, See, your disciples do that which it is not right to do on the Sabbath.
sentences.susu: Farisɛnie to na to, e naxa wɔyɛn Isa bɛ, «A mato, i fɔxirabirɛe na malabu lɔxɔɛ sɛriyɛ matandife.»

sentences.english: But he said to them, Have you no knowledge of what David did when he had need of food, and those who were with him?
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «Wo mu nu a xaran Dawuda naxan naba kaamɛ to a suxu, a tan nun naxee nu na a fɔxɔ ra?

sentences.english: How he went into the house of God and took for food the holy bread which it was not right for him or for those who were with him to take, but only for the priests?
sentences.susu: A so nɛ Ala xa banxi kui, a taami don naxan fixi Ala ma, hali a to mu daxa a tan nun a fɔxirabirɛe xa na don, fo sɛrɛxɛdubɛe.

sentences.english: Or is it not said in the law, how the Sabbath is broken by the priests in the Temple and they do no wrong?
sentences.susu: Wo man mu nu a xaran Tawureta Munsa kui, a sɛrɛxɛdubɛe walima malabu lɔxɔɛ hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, kɔnɔ e mu yunubi sɔtɔma na kui?

sentences.english: But I say to you that a greater thing than the Temple is here.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ, naxan na wo yire be, a tide gbo hɔrɔmɔbanxi bɛ.

sentences.english: But if these words had been in your minds, My desire is for mercy and not for offerings, you would not have been judging those who have done no wrong.
sentences.susu: Xa wo fahaamui sɔtɔxi sɛbɛli ma nu, naxan a masenxi, ‹Hinnɛ rafan n ma dangife sɛrɛxɛ ra,› wo mu tinxintɔɛe tɔɔɲɛgɛma nu.

sentences.english: For the Son of man is lord of the Sabbath.
sentences.susu: Adama xa Di nan na malabu lɔxɔɛ marigi ra.»

sentences.english: And he went from there into their Synagogue:
sentences.susu: Isa to keli mɛnni, a naxa so e xa salide kui.

sentences.english: And there was a man with a dead hand. And they put a question to him, saying, Is it right to make a man well on the Sabbath day? so that they might have something against him.
sentences.susu: A naxa xɛmɛ nde li naa, naxan bɛlɛxɛ tuuxi a ma. E naxa Isa maxɔrin, «A daxa mixi xa furema rayalan malabu lɔxɔɛ?» E nu katafe nɛ e xa nɔ Isa kalamude.

sentences.english: And he said to them, Which of you, having a sheep, if it gets into a hole on the Sabbath day, will not put out a helping hand and get it back?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Xa wo xa yɛxɛɛ nde sin yili kui malabu lɔxɔɛ ma, nde na wo ya ma naxan tondima a ratede?

sentences.english: Of how much more value is a man than a sheep! For this reason it is right to do good on the Sabbath day.
sentences.susu: Adama tide gbo dangi yɛxɛɛ ra pon! Na nan a ra, fe fanyi rabafe daxa malabu lɔxɔɛ ma.»

sentences.english: Then said he to the man, Put out your hand. And he put it out, and it was made as well as the other.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a naxa a fala bɛlɛxɛ tuuxi kanyi bɛ, «I bɛlɛxɛ itala.» A naxa a itala, a naxa yalan alɔ a bɛlɛxɛ boore.

sentences.english: But the Pharisees went out and made designs against him, how they might put him to death.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Farisɛnie to mini, e naxa e malan, e xa sa kira fen Isa faxafe ma.

sentences.english: And Jesus, having knowledge of this, went away from there, and a great number went after him; and he made them all well,
sentences.susu: Isa to na kolon, a naxa keli naa. Mixi gbegbe naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra. A naxa furema birin nayalan,

sentences.english: Ordering them not to give people word of him:
sentences.susu: a naxa e ratɔn e naxa a xa fe fala mixie bɛ.

sentences.english: So that what was said by Isaiah the prophet might come true,
sentences.susu: Na kui, Annabi Esayi xa masenyi naxa kamali, a to a masen,

sentences.english: See my servant, the man of my selection, my loved one in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my Spirit on him, and he will make my decision clear to the Gentiles.
sentences.susu: «N ma walikɛ sugandixi nan ya, n xanuntenyi naxan nafanxi n bɔɲɛ ma. N nan n Xaxili ragoroma nɛ a ma, a fan tinxinyi masen sie bɛ.

sentences.english: His coming will not be with fighting or loud cries; and his voice will not be lifted up in the streets.
sentences.susu: A mu sɔnxɔɛ ratema, a mu gbelegbelema, mixi yo mu a xui itexi mɛma taa kui.

sentences.english: The crushed stem will not be broken by him; and the feebly burning light will he not put out, till he has made righteousness overcome all.
sentences.susu: A mu kale kɔnkɔrɔnxi girama, a mu lanpui dɛxɛ xuri raxubenma, han a tinxinyi xunnakelima tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And in his name will the Gentiles put their hope.
sentences.susu: Si birin e xaxili tima nɛ a xili ra.»

sentences.english: Then they took to him one with an evil spirit, who was blind and had no power of talking: and he made him well so that he had the power of talking and seeing.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa fa xɛmɛ nde ra Isa xɔn ɲinnɛ nu bara naxan findi dɔnxui nun boboe ra. Isa naxa a rayalan, a ya naxa se to, a tuli naxa fe mɛ.

sentences.english: And all the people were surprised and said, Is not this the Son of David?
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa kaaba, e nu e bore maxɔrin, «Dawuda xa Di xa mu yi ra?»

sentences.english: But the Pharisees, hearing of it, said, This man only sends evil spirits out of men by Beelzebub, the ruler of evil spirits.
sentences.susu: Farisɛnie to e xui mɛ, e naxa a fala, «Yi xɛmɛ ɲinnɛ kerima ɲinnɛ mangɛ Bɛlɛsɛbulu nan saabui ra.»

sentences.english: And having knowledge of their thoughts he said to them, Every kingdom having division in itself is made waste, and every town or house having division in itself will come to destruction.
sentences.susu: Isa to e xaxili ma fe kolon, a naxa a masen e bɛ, «Ɲamanɛ yo a yɛtɛ gere lantareya kui, na ɲamanɛ xun nakanama nɛ feo! Taa fan, xa na mu a ra denbaya, xa e e yɛtɛ gere lantareya kui, e mu xanma.

sentences.english: And if Satan sends out Satan, he makes war against himself; how then will he keep his kingdom?
sentences.susu: Xa Sentanɛ Sentanɛ keri, a na a yɛtɛ nan gerefe. A xa mangɛya fa xanma di?

sentences.english: And if I by Beelzebub send evil spirits out of men, by whom do your sons send them out? So let them be your judges.
sentences.susu: Xa n tan ɲinnɛe kerima Bɛlɛsɛbulu nan saabui ra, wo tan xa mixie e kerima nde saabui ra? Na kui e tan nan yati wo makiitima.

sentences.english: But if I by the Spirit of God send out evil spirits, then is the kingdom of God come on you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa n tan ɲinnɛe kerima Ala Xaxili nan saabui ra, na nan na ki Ala xa mangɛya niini yati nan bara wo li.

sentences.english: Or how may one go into a strong man's house and take his goods, if he does not first put cords round the strong man? and then he may take his goods.
sentences.susu: Mixi nɔma sode sɛnbɛma xa banxi kui, a a harige ba a yi ra, xa a mu a xiri sinden? Kɔnɔ xa mixi banxi kanyi xiri, a nɔma nɛ a harige birin muɲade.»

sentences.english: Whoever is not with me is against me; and he who does not take part with me in getting people together, is driving them away.
sentences.susu: «Mixi naxan mu birama n fɔxɔ ra, a tixi n kanke nɛ. Naxan mu n malima mixi malande, a na mixie rayensenfe nɛ.

sentences.english: So I say to you, Every sin and every evil word against God will have forgiveness; but for evil words against the Spirit there will be no forgiveness.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, n xa a fala wo bɛ, adamadie xa yunubie nun marasɔtɔɛe birin nɔma nɛ xafaride, kɔnɔ Ala Xaxili rasɔtɔfe tan mu xafarima mixi bɛ muku.

sentences.english: And whoever says a word against the Son of man, will have forgiveness; but whoever says a word against the Holy Spirit, will not have forgiveness in this life or in that which is to come.
sentences.susu: Mixi na Adama xa Di rasɔtɔ, na yunubi nɔma nɛ xafaride a kanyi bɛ. Kɔnɔ mixi na Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi rasɔtɔ, na yunubi mu nɔma xafaride na kanyi bɛ duniɲa, a mu nɔma xafaride aligiyama.»

sentences.english: Make the tree good, and its fruit good; or make the tree bad, and its fruit bad; for by its fruit you will get knowledge of the tree.
sentences.susu: «Xa sansi findi a fanyi nan na, a bogi fanyi nan naminima. Xa sansi findi a kobi nan na, a bogi kobi nan naminima. Sansi kolonma a bogi nan ma.

sentences.english: You offspring of snakes, how are you, being evil, able to say good things? because out of the heart's store come the words of the mouth.
sentences.susu: Wo tan bɔximase bɔnsɔɛ, wo mu nɔma wɔyɛn fanyi falade, barima wo bɔɲɛ kobi. Mixi bɔɲɛ rafexi naxan na, na nan minima a dɛ i.

sentences.english: The good man out of his good store gives good things; and the evil man out of his evil store gives evil things.
sentences.susu: Fe fanyi to ragataxi mixi fanyi bɔɲɛ kui, a fe fanyi nan naminima. Fe kobi to ragataxi mixi kobi bɔɲɛ kui, a fe kobi nan naminima.

sentences.english: And I say to you that in the day when they are judged, men will have to give an account of every foolish word they have said.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ, kiitisa lɔxɔɛ, adamadie dɛntɛgɛ sama nɛ wɔyɛn kobi birin ma naxee mini e dɛ i.

sentences.english: For by your words will your righteousness be seen, and by your words you will be judged.
sentences.susu: I wɔyɛnyi naxan falama duniɲɛigiri kui, na nan kiiti fanma i ra, na nan kiiti kanama i ra.»

sentences.english: Then some of the scribes and Pharisees, hearing this, said to him, Master, we are looking for a sign from you.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe nun Farisɛnie naxa wɔyɛnyi tongo, e a fala Isa bɛ, «Karamɔxɔ, muxu wama i xa kaabanako nde tofe, a xa findi tɔnxuma ra muxu bɛ.»

sentences.english: But he, answering, said to them, An evil and false generation is looking for a sign; and no sign will be given to it but the sign of the prophet Jonah:
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «To mixie kobi, e bara gbilen Ala fɔxɔ ra. E wama tɔnxuma makaabaxi tofe, kɔnɔ tɔnxuma yo mu fima e ma bafe Annabi Yunusa xa tɔnxuma ra.

sentences.english: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the stomach of the great fish, so will the Son of man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
sentences.susu: Annabi Yunusa xi saxan, kɔɛ saxan nadangi yɛxɛ xungbe furi kui ki naxɛ, Adama xa Di fan xi saxan, kɔɛ saxan nadangima na ki nɛ bɔxi bun ma.

sentences.english: The men of Nineveh will come up in the day of judging and give their decision against this generation: because they were turned from their sins at the preaching of Jonah; and now a greater than Jonah is here.
sentences.susu: Kiiti lɔxɔɛ, Ninewekae tima nɛ e nun to mixie, e seedeɲɔxɔya ba wo xili ma, barima e tan tuubi nɛ Annabi Yunusa xa kawandi saabui ra, a fa li naxan na wo yire yi ki be, a tide gbo Annabi Yunusa bɛ.

sentences.english: The queen of the South will come up in the day of judging and give her decision against this generation: for she came from the ends of the earth to give ear to the wisdom of Solomon; and now a greater than Solomon is here.
sentences.susu: Kiiti lɔxɔɛ, Seeba mangɛ ginɛ fan tima nɛ e nun to mixie, a seedeɲɔxɔya ba wo xili ma, barima a tan fa nɛ kelife yire makuye Sulemani xa lɔnni ramɛde, a fa li naxan na wo yire yi ki be, a tide gbo Sulemani bɛ.»

sentences.english: But the unclean spirit, when he is gone out of a man, goes through dry places looking for rest, and getting it not.
sentences.susu: «Ɲinnɛ na gbilen mixi fɔxɔ ra, a sigama yire maxare nɛ lingira gbɛtɛ fende, kɔnɔ a mu a toma.

sentences.english: Then he says, I will go back into my house from which I came out; and when he comes, he sees that there is no one in it, but that it has been made fair and clean.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a a falama a yɛtɛ bɛ, ‹N xa gbilen n ma banxi kui n kelixi dɛnnaxɛ.› A na gbilen mɛnni a a lima nɛ na banxi makɔxi, a raxunmaxi a fanyi ra, ɲinnɛ gbɛtɛ yo mu na.

sentences.english: Then he goes and takes with him seven other spirits worse than himself, and they go in and make it their living-place: and the last condition of that man is worse than the first. Even so will it be with this evil generation.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, a sigama nɛ a sa fa ɲinnɛ solofere gbɛtɛe ra naxee ɲaaxu a bɛ, e birin so na banxi kui, e sabati naa. Na kui, na mixi xa fe ɲaaxuma nɛ dangife a singe ra. Na nan mɔɔli rabama to mixi kobie bɛ.»

sentences.english: While he was still talking to the people, his mother and his brothers came, desiring to have talk with him.
sentences.susu: Beenun Isa xa gɛ wɔyɛnde ɲama bɛ, a nga nun a xunya xɛmɛmae naxa fa, e ti tande, e nun Isa xa dɛ masara.

sentences.english: And one said to him, See, your mother and your brothers are outside, desiring to have talk with you.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa a fala a bɛ, «I nga nun i xunyae na tande, e wama wo xa dɛ masara.»

sentences.english: But he in answer said to him who gave the news, Who is my mother and who are my brothers?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa naxa na kanyi yaabi, «Nde findixi nga ra? Nde findixi n xunyae ra?»

sentences.english: And he put out his hand to his disciples and said, See, my mother and my brothers!
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isa naxa a bɛlɛxɛ ti a fɔxirabirɛe ma, a a masen, «A mato, n nga nun n xunyae nan ya.

sentences.english: For whoever does the pleasure of my Father in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo naxan n Baba sago rabama naxan na ariyanna, na kanyi nan findixi n xunya xɛmɛma, n maaginɛ, nun n nga ra.»

sentences.english: On that day Jesus went out of the house and was seated by the seaside.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, Isa naxa mini banxi, a sa dɔxɔ baa dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And great numbers of people came together to him, so that he got into a boat; and the people took up their position by the sea.
sentences.susu: Ɲama gbegbe to malan a yire, a naxa sa dɔxɔ kunkui kui, ɲama naxa lu baa dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And he gave them teaching in the form of a story, saying, A man went out to put seed in the earth;
sentences.susu: A naxa fe wuyaxi masen e bɛ taalie ra. A naxa a masen, «Wo wo tuli mati. Xɛ rawali nde nan mini sansi xɔri garansande.

sentences.english: And while he did so, some seeds were dropped by the wayside, and the birds came and took them for food:
sentences.susu: A to nu sansi xɔri garansanma, xɔri ndee naxa bira sankira xɔn, xɔnie naxa fa, e e don gbiki.

sentences.english: And some of the seed went among the stones, where it had not much earth, and straight away it came up because the earth was not deep:
sentences.susu: Xɔri ndee fan naxa bira gɛmɛ yire, bɛndɛ mu gbo dɛnnaxɛ. Nee naxa bula mafuren na, barima na bɛndɛ mu tilin.

sentences.english: And when the sun was high, it was burned; and because it had no root it became dry and dead.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ soge to xɔnɔ, na sansie naxa ragan, e xara gben, barima sanke mu nu na e bɛ.

sentences.english: And some seeds went among thorns, and the thorns came up and they had no room for growth:
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri ndee fan naxa bira tunbe kunsie tagi. Tunbe kunsie naxa gbo, e sansie ixɛtɛn, e e kana.

sentences.english: And some, falling on good earth, gave fruit, some a hundred, some sixty, some thirty times as much.
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri ndee fan naxa bira bɛndɛ fanyi ma. Na xɔrie tan, e keren keren birin naxa sansi tɔnsɔɛ ramini, ndee naxa xɔri kɛmɛ ramini, ndee xɔri tongo senni, ndee xɔri tongo saxan.

sentences.english: He who has ears, let him give ear.
sentences.susu: Xa wo tuli fe mɛma, wo wo tuli mati yi masenyi ra.»

sentences.english: And the disciples came and said to him, Why do you say things to them in the form of stories?
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa e maso a ra, e a maxɔrin, «Munfe ra i wɔyɛnma ɲama bɛ taali ra?»

sentences.english: And he said to them in answer, To you is given the knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Ala bara fahaamui fi wo ma wo xa a xa mangɛya niini gundo kolon, kɔnɔ na fahaamui mu fixi mixi gbɛtɛe tan ma.

sentences.english: Because whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have more; but from him who has not, even what he has will be taken away.
sentences.susu: Mixi fahaamuxi xa fahaamui xun masama, kɔnɔ mixi fahaamutare, hali a naxan maɲɔxun a gbe ra, na fama bade a yi ra.

sentences.english: For this reason I put things into the form of stories; because they see without seeing, and give ear without hearing, and the sense is not clear to them.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi n wɔyɛnma mixie bɛ taali wɔyɛnyi ra, barima e ya se toma, kɔnɔ e mu a igbɛma, e tuli fe mɛma, kɔnɔ e mu a fahaamuma.

sentences.english: And for them the words of Isaiah have come true, Though you give ear, you will not get knowledge; and seeing, you will see, but the sense will not be clear to you:
sentences.susu: Na kui, Annabi Esayi xa masenyi bara rakamali e xa fe ra, naxan a masenxi, ‹Wo fe mɛma, kɔnɔ wo mu a fahaamuma. Wo fe toma, kɔnɔ wo mu a igbɛma.

sentences.english: For the heart of this people has become fat and their ears are slow in hearing and their eyes are shut; for fear that they might see with their eyes and give hearing with their ears and become wise in their hearts and be turned again to me, so that I might make them well.
sentences.susu: Yi ɲama bɔɲɛ bara xɔrɔxɔ. E bara e tuli dɛsɛ, e bara e ya raxi, alako e ya naxa fa fe igbɛ, e tuli naxa fa fe mɛ, e bɔɲɛe naxa fa fe kolon, e naxa fa e ya rafindi n ma n xa e rayalan.›»

sentences.english: But a blessing be on your eyes, because they see; and on your ears, because they are open.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ ɲɛlɛxinyi na wo tan bɛ, barima wo yae se igbɛma, wo tulie fe mɛma.

sentences.english: For truly, I say to you that prophets and upright men had a desire to see the things which you see, and saw them not; and to have knowledge of the words which have come to your ears, and they had it not.
sentences.susu: N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, namiɲɔnmɛ nun tinxintɔɛ gbegbe bara wa e xa fee to wo naxee tofe, kɔnɔ e mu e to. E bara wa e xa fee mɛ wo naxee mɛfe, kɔnɔ e mu e mɛ.»

sentences.english: Give ear, then, to the story of the man who put the seed in the earth.
sentences.susu: «Wo wo tuli mati, wo xa fahaamui sɔtɔ xɛsa xa taali ma.

sentences.english: When the word of the kingdom comes to anyone, and the sense of it is not clear to him, then the Evil One comes, and quickly takes away that which was put in his heart. He is the seed dropped by the wayside.
sentences.susu: Mixi na Ala xa mangɛya niini xa masenyi mɛ, a mu a fahaamu, Sentanɛ fama nɛ na masenyi bade a bɔɲɛ ma. Na kanyi misaalixi sansi xɔri nan na naxan biraxi kira xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And that which went on the stones, this is he who, hearing the word, straight away takes it with joy;
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri naxee bira gɛmɛ yire, nee misaalixi mixi nan na naxan Ala xa masenyi mɛma, a a suxu mafuren sɛɛwɛ ra.

sentences.english: But having no root in himself, he goes on for a time; and when trouble comes or pain, because of the word, he quickly becomes full of doubts.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ sanke to mu na a bɛ, a xa danxaniya mu buma. Tɔɔrɛ nun ɲaxankatɛ na a li Ala xa masenyi xa fe ra, a gbilenma Ala xa fe fɔxɔ ra keren na.

sentences.english: And that which was dropped among the thorns, this is he who has the word; and the cares of this life, and the deceits of wealth, put a stop to the growth of the word and it gives no fruit.
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri naxan bira tunbe kunsie tagi, na misaalixi mixi nan na naxan Ala xa masenyi mɛma, kɔnɔ yi duniɲa kɔntɔfili nun naafuli xɔli a suxu han a Ala xa masenyi bɛɲin. Na kui, Ala xa masenyi mu nɔma a bɔɲɛ masarade.

sentences.english: And the seed which was put in good earth, this is he who gives ear to the word, and gets the sense of it; who gives fruit, some a hundred, some sixty, some thirty times as much.
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri naxan bira bɛndɛ fanyi tan ma, na misaalixi mixi nan na naxan Ala xa masenyi mɛma, a a fahaamu, a a bɔɲɛ masara. Na sansi xɔri a bogi raminima nɛ, nde xɔri kɛmɛ ramini, nde tongo senni, nde tongo saxan.»

sentences.english: And he gave them another story, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like a man who put good seed in his field:
sentences.susu: Isa naxa taali gbɛtɛ masen e bɛ, «Ala xa mangɛya luxi nɛ alɔ xɛmɛ naxan a xa xɛ garansan sansi xɔri fanyi ra.

sentences.english: But while men were sleeping, one who had hate for him came and put evil seeds among the grain, and went away.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixie nu xife tɛmui naxɛ, a yaxui naxa fa, a ɲooge ɲaaxi xɔri garansan sansi fanyi xɔri longori ra, a siga.

sentences.english: But when the green stem came up and gave fruit, the evil plants were seen at the same time.
sentences.susu: Sansie to bula, e te han e dendenyi bara mini fɔlɔ, walikɛe naxa ɲooge ɲaaxi fan to sansie longori ra.

sentences.english: And the servants of the master of the house came and said to him, Sir, did you not put good seed in your field? how then has it evil plants?
sentences.susu: E naxa xɛ kanyi maxɔrin, ‹Marigi, i mu sansi xɔri fanyi xa garansan i xa xɛ ma? Na ɲooge ɲaaxi fa kelixi minden?›

sentences.english: And he said, Someone has done this in hate. And the servants say to him, Is it your pleasure that we go and take them up?
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, ‹N yaxui nde nan na rabaxi.› Walikɛe naxa a maxɔrin, ‹I wama muxu xa sa a tala?›

sentences.english: But he says, No, for fear that by chance while you take up the evil plants, you may be rooting up the grain with them.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala, ‹Ade, xa na mu a ra sansi fanyi fan talama nɛ ɲooge ɲaaxi fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Let them come up together till the getting in of the grain; and then I will say to the workers, Take up first the evil plants, and put them together for burning: but put the grain into my store-house.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a lu e birin xa mɔ han xɛ xaba lɔxɔɛ. Na tɛmui n a falama nɛ xɛ xabae bɛ, wo ɲooge ɲaaxi nan singe tala, wo a raxiri alako a xa gan. Kɔnɔ wo sansi fanyi tan xaba, wo a xɔri ragata n ma bili kui.›»

sentences.english: He put another story before them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his field:
sentences.susu: Isa naxa taali gbɛtɛ masen e bɛ, «Ala xa mangɛya maniyaxi konde xɔri nan na, mixi naxan si a xa daaxa.

sentences.english: Which is smaller than all seeds; but when it has come up it is greater than the plants, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of heaven come and make their resting-places in its branches.
sentences.susu: A xɔri xurun sansi xɔri birin bɛ, kɔnɔ a na mɔ, a bili xungbo bɔxi sansi birin bɛ. A findima wuri bili nan na, xɔnie fama e tɛɛe sade naxan salonyie kɔn na.»

sentences.english: Another story he gave to them: The kingdom of heaven is like leaven, which a woman took, and put in three measures of meal, till it was all leavened.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa taali gbɛtɛ masen e bɛ, «Ala xa mangɛya maniyaxi lɛbini nan na, ginɛ naxan sa farin busali tagi xun ma, na fa farin birin nate.»

sentences.english: All these things Jesus said to the people in the form of stories; and without a story he said nothing to them:
sentences.susu: Isa naxa na fe birin masen ɲama bɛ taalie ra. A ɲan mu nu masenyi yo tima e bɛ a mu a fala taali daaxi.

sentences.english: That it might come true which was said by the prophet, Opening my mouth, I will give out stories; I will give knowledge of things kept secret from before all time.
sentences.susu: Na kui, namiɲɔnmɛ xa masenyi naxa kamali, «Taali wɔyɛnyie nan minima n dɛ i. N fee masenma nɛ naxee nu nɔxunxi kabi duniɲa daa tɛmui.»

sentences.english: Then he went away from the people, and went into the house; and his disciples came to him, saying, Make clear to us the story of the evil plants in the field.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Isa naxa keli ɲama xun ma, a so banxi. A fɔxirabirɛe naxa e makɔrɛ a ra, e a fala a bɛ, «Ɲooge ɲaaxi xa taali tagi raba muxu bɛ.»

sentences.english: And he made answer and said, He who puts the good seed in the earth is the Son of man;
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «Naxan sansi fanyi garansanma, na misaalixi Adama xa Di nan na.

sentences.english: And the field is the world; and the good seed is the sons of the kingdom; and the evil seeds are the sons of the Evil One;
sentences.susu: Xɛ misaalixi duniɲa nan na. Sansi fanyi misaalixi mixie nan na, naxee na Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma. Ɲooge ɲaaxi misaalixi Sentanɛ xa die nan na.

sentences.english: And he who put them in the earth is Satan; and the getting in of the grain is the end of the world; and those who get it in are the angels.
sentences.susu: Yaxui naxan ɲooge xɔri garansan, a misaalixi Ibulisa nan na. Xɛ xabɛ misaalixi duniɲa raɲɔnyi nan na. Xɛ xabae misaalixi malekɛe nan na.

sentences.english: As then the evil plants are got together and burned with fire, so will it be in the end of the world.
sentences.susu: Na ɲooge ɲaaxi talama ki naxɛ, a woli tɛ i, duniɲa raɲɔnyi fan luma na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: The Son of man will send out his angels, and they will take out of his kingdom everything which is a cause of error, and all those who do wrong,
sentences.susu: Adama xa Di fama a xa malekɛe xɛɛde, e mixi ratantanyie nun mixi kobie ba mixi gbɛtɛe ya ma, naxee na Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma.

sentences.english: And will put them into the fire; there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.
sentences.susu: E e wolima nɛ tɛ mankanɛ xɔɔra, wa nun ɲin maxinyi na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Then will the upright be shining as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. He who has ears, let him give ear.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui tinxintɔɛe tan yanbama nɛ alɔ soge e Baba xa mangɛya niini bun ma. Xa wo tuli fe mɛma, wo wo tuli mati yi masenyi ra.»

sentences.english: The kingdom of heaven is like a secret store of wealth in a field, which a man came across and put back again; and in his joy he goes and gives all he has, to get that field.
sentences.susu: «Ala xa mangɛya man luxi nɛ alɔ naafuli xungbe naxan nu nɔxunxi xɛ ma. Mixi nde to mini a ma, a naxa gbilen a nɔxun na, a siga ɲɛlɛxinyi kui. A naxa a sɔtɔse birin mati a fa na xɛ sara.»

sentences.english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a trader searching for beautiful jewels.
sentences.susu: «Ala xa mangɛya man luxi nɛ alɔ yulɛ naxan diyaman tofanyi fenfe.

sentences.english: And having come across one jewel of great price, he went and gave all he had in exchange for it.
sentences.susu: A to diyaman hagigɛ keren to, a naxa sa a sɔtɔse birin mati, a fa na diyaman sara.»

sentences.english: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net, which was put into the sea and took in every sort of fish:
sentences.susu: «Ala xa mangɛya man luxi nɛ alɔ yɛlɛ naxan bara sa baa ma, a yɛxɛ mɔɔli birin suxu.

sentences.english: When it was full, they took it up on the sands; and seated there they put the good into vessels, but the bad they put away.
sentences.susu: Yɛlɛ to rafe, mixie naxa a mabɛndun baa dɛ ra. E naxa dɔxɔ, e yɛxɛe mayegeti, e a fanyie sa paanie kui, e a ɲaaxie wɔlɛ.

sentences.english: So will it be in the end of the world: the angels will come and take out the bad from the good,
sentences.susu: Duniɲa raɲɔnyi luma na ki nɛ. Malekɛe fama mixi kobie nun mixi tinxinxie mayegetide,

sentences.english: And will put them into the fire: there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.
sentences.susu: e mixi kobie woli tɛ mankanɛ xɔɔra, wa nun ɲin maxinyie na dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: Are all these things now clear to you? They say to him, Yes.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo bara na birin fahaamu?» E naxa a yaabi, «Iyo.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, For this reason every scribe who has become a disciple of the kingdom of heaven is like the owner of a house, who gives out from his store things new and old.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen e bɛ, «Na nan a toxi, sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ naxan bara fahaamui sɔtɔ Ala xa mangɛya niini xa fe ma, a luxi alɔ banxi kanyi naxan se nɛɛnɛe nun se forie raminima a harige ya ma.»

sentences.english: And when Jesus had come to the end of these stories he went away from there.
sentences.susu: Isa to gɛ na taalie masende, a naxa siga,

sentences.english: And coming into his country, he gave them teaching in their Synagogue, so that they were greatly surprised and said, Where did this man get this wisdom and these works of power?
sentences.susu: a sa so a xɔnyi, a mɔxi dɛnnaxɛ. A to na mixie xaran e xa salide kui, e dɛ naxa ixara. E naxa e bore maxɔrin, «Yi xɛmɛ yi lɔnni sɔtɔxi minden? A nɔxi yi kaabanako fee rabade di?

sentences.english: Is not this the woodworker's son? is not his mother named Mary? and his brothers James and Joseph and Simon and Judas?
sentences.susu: Kamudɛri xa di xa mu yi ki? A nga xa mu xili Mariyama? A xunyae xa mu findi Yaki, Yusufu, Yuda, nun Simɔn na?

sentences.english: And his sisters, are they not all with us? from where, then, has he all these things?
sentences.susu: A xunya ginɛmae fan mu na won ya ma be? A fa yi birin sɔtɔxi minden?»

sentences.english: And they were bitter against him. But Jesus said to them, A prophet is nowhere without honour but in his country and among his family.
sentences.susu: Na kui, e naxa xɔnɔ a ma, e tondi lade a ra. Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Namiɲɔnmɛ binyaxi yire birin fo a xɔnyi, a ngaxakerenyie tagi.»

sentences.english: And the works of power which he did there were small in number because they had no faith.
sentences.susu: A mu kaabanako gbegbe raba naa e xa danxaniyatareɲa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: At that time news of Jesus came to Herod the king;
sentences.susu: Na waxati, Galile mangɛ Herode naxa Isa xa fe mɛ. A naxa a fala a xa mixie bɛ,

sentences.english: And he said to his servants, This is John the Baptist; he has come back from the dead, and so these powers are working in him.
sentences.susu: «Yaya Xunxa nan kelixi faxɛ ma. Na nan a toxi nɔɛ na a yi a xa kaabanakoe raba.»

sentences.english: For Herod had taken John and put him in prison because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.
sentences.susu: A na fala nɛ, barima a tan Herode nu bara yaamari fi Yaya xa suxu, yɔlɔnxɔnyi xa sa a ma, a xa sa geeli Herodiyasi xa fe ra, a taara Filipu xa ginɛ.

sentences.english: Because John had said to him, It is not right for you to have her.
sentences.susu: Yaya nu a falama Herode bɛ, «A mu daxa i xa yi ginɛ tongo.»

sentences.english: And he would have put him to death, but for his fear of the people, because in their eyes John was a prophet.
sentences.susu: Herode nu wama Yaya faxafe nɛ, kɔnɔ a nu gaaxuxi ɲama ya ra, barima e nu laxi a ra a namiɲɔnmɛ nan nu Yaya ra.

sentences.english: But when Herod's birthday came, the daughter of Herodias was dancing before them, and Herod was pleased with her.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, e to nu Herode bari ɲɛ xungbilenyi xulunyi tife, Herodiyasi xa di ginɛ naxa fare boron mixie bɛ. A naxa rafan Herode ma

sentences.english: So he gave her his word with an oath to let her have whatever she might make request for.
sentences.susu: han a naxa a kali a a na sese maxɔrin a ma, a a fima nɛ a ma.

sentences.english: And she, at her mother's suggestion, said, Give me here on a plate the head of John the Baptist.
sentences.susu: Herodiyasi xa marasi ma, a xa di naxa a fala Herode bɛ, «Yaya Xunxa xunyi so n yi ra pileti ma.»

sentences.english: And the king was sad; but because of his oaths and because of his guests, he gave the order for it to be given to her;
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa nimisa, kɔnɔ a xa marakali nun a xa xɔɲɛe xa fe ra, a naxa yaamari fi e xa Yaya xunyi so na ginɛdimɛdi yi ra.

sentences.english: And he sent and had John's head cut off in the prison.
sentences.susu: A naxa mixie xɛɛ geeli, e xa Yaya xunyi bolon a dɛ i.

sentences.english: And his head was put on a plate and given to the girl; and she took it to her mother.
sentences.susu: E naxa fa a xunyi ra pileti ma, e a so ginɛdimɛdi yi ra. Ginɛdimɛdi fan naxa a xanin a nga xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And his disciples came, and took up his body and put it in the earth; and they went and gave Jesus news of what had taken place.
sentences.susu: Yaya fɔxirabirɛe naxa sa a fure tongo, e sa a ragata, e naxa sa na dɛntɛgɛ sa Isa bɛ.

sentences.english: Now when it came to the ears of Jesus, he went away from there in a boat, to a waste place by himself: and the people hearing of it, went after him on foot from the towns.
sentences.susu: Isa to na fe mɛ, a naxa keli mɛnni kunkui kui, a siga a kerenyi ma wula i. Ɲama to a kolon, e fan naxa keli e xa taae, e siga a fɔxɔ ra e sanyi ra.

sentences.english: And he came out and saw a great number of people and he had pity on them, and made well those of them who were ill.
sentences.susu: Isa to goro kunkui kui, a naxa ɲama gbegbe to naa. A naxa kinikini e ma, a e xa furemae rayalan.

sentences.english: And when evening had come, the disciples came to him, saying, This place is waste land, and the time is now past; send the people away so that they may go into the towns and get themselves food.
sentences.susu: Nunmare to so fɔlɔ, Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa e maso a ra, e a fala a bɛ, «Won na wula nɛ yi ki, kɔɛ fan bara so. Ɲama rayensen alako e xa siga donse sara taae kui.»

sentences.english: But Jesus said to them, There is no need for them to go away; give them food yourselves.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Hali e mu siga. Wo tan nan xa donse fi e ma.»

sentences.english: And they say to him, We have here but five cakes of bread and two fishes.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e naxa a fala a bɛ, «Taami gundi suuli nun yɛxɛ firin gbansan nan na muxu yi ra.»

sentences.english: And he said, Give them to me.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo fa nee ra n xɔn ma be.»

sentences.english: And he gave orders for the people to be seated on the grass; and he took the five cakes of bread and the two fishes and, looking up to heaven, he said words of blessing, and made division of the food, and gave it to the disciples, and the disciples gave it to the people.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa ɲama yamari e xa e magoro na ɲooge xinde ma. A naxa na taami suuli nun na yɛxɛ firin tongo, a a ya rate koore ma, a fa Ala nuwali sa. A naxa taamie igira, a fa e so a fɔxirabirɛe yi ra, e xa e itaxun ɲama ma.

sentences.english: And they all took of the food and had enough: and they took up twelve baskets full of broken bits which were not used.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa e dɛge han e wasa. Donse dɔnxɔɛ xuntunyie to matongo, debe fu nun firin nan nafe.

sentences.english: And those who had food were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee e dɛge, xɛmɛ wulu suuli ɲɔndɔn nan nu e ra, bafe ginɛe nun dimɛe ra.

sentences.english: And straight away he made the disciples get into the boat and go before him to the other side, till he had sent the people away.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi Isa naxa a fala a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, a e xa baki kunkui kui, e xa siga a ya ra naakiri ma, a tan xa nu ɲama ragbilen.

sentences.english: And after he had sent the people away, he went up into the mountain by himself for prayer: and when evening was come, he was there by himself.
sentences.susu: Isa to gɛ ɲama ragbilende, a naxa te geya fari a kerenyi ma, alako a xa Ala maxandi. Kɔɛ naxa a li naa, a keren.

sentences.english: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, and was troubled by the waves: for the wind was against them.
sentences.susu: A a lixi kunkui nu bara makuya xare ra, mɔrɔnyie nu na a mabɔnbɔfe ki fanyi ra barima foye ya nu rafindixi a ma.

sentences.english: And in the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea.
sentences.susu: Subaxɛ ma, Isa ɲɛrɛfe baa fari.

sentences.english: And when they saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It is a spirit; and they gave cries of fear.
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛe to a to ɲɛrɛ ra ye fari, e naxa gaaxu ki fanyi. E naxa gbelegbele, e a fala, «Tubari nan a ra!»

sentences.english: But straight away Jesus said to them, Take heart; it is I, have no fear.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa naxa a masen e bɛ keren na, «Wo naxa kɔntɔfili, n tan nan a ra. Wo naxa gaaxu.»

sentences.english: And Peter, answering, said to him, Lord, if it is you, give me the order to come to you on the water.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a yaabi, «Marigi, xa i tan nan a ra, yaamari fi n xa siga i yire ye fari.»

sentences.english: And he said, Come. And Peter got out of the boat, and walking on the water, went to Jesus.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «Fa.» Piyɛri to goro kunkui kui, a naxa ɲɛrɛ ye fari sigafe ra Isa yire.

sentences.english: But when he saw the wind he was in fear and, starting to go down, he gave a cry, saying, Help, Lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a to foye belebele mato, a naxa gaaxu, a madula fɔlɔ. A naxa gbelegbele, «N Marigi, n nakisi!»

sentences.english: And straight away Jesus put out his hand and took a grip of him, and said to him, O man of little faith, why were you in doubt?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a bɛlɛxɛ itala keren na, a Piyɛri suxu. A naxa a masen a bɛ, «I xa danxaniya xurun. I siikɛxi munfe ra?»

sentences.english: And when they had got into the boat, the wind went down.
sentences.susu: E to baki kunkui kui, foye naxa raxara.

sentences.english: And those who were in the boat gave him worship, saying, Truly you are the Son of God.
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛ naxee nu na kunkui kui, e naxa suyidi Isa bɛ, e a fala, «Ala xa Di yati nan lanxi i ma.»

sentences.english: And when they had gone across, they came to land at Gennesaret.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ baa igiride, e naxa so Genesareti.

sentences.english: And when the men of that place had news of him, they sent into all the country round about, and took to him all who were ill,
sentences.susu: Naakae to a kolon Isa nan a ra, e naxa na rabilinyi mixi birin nakolon. Mixie naxa fa furemae birin na Isa xɔn.

sentences.english: With the request that they might only put their hands on the edge of his robe: and all those who did so were made well.
sentences.susu: E nu a mayandima furemae xa e bɛlɛxɛ din a xa donma sanbunyi gbansan na. Furema birin naxee na raba, e birin naxa yalan.

sentences.english: Then there came to Jesus from Jerusalem Pharisees and scribes, saying,
sentences.susu: Farisɛni nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ ndee naxa fa Isa yire kelife Darisalamu. E naxa a maxɔrin,

sentences.english: Why do your disciples go against the teaching of the fathers? for they take food with unwashed hands.
sentences.susu: «Munfe ra i fɔxirabirɛe luma forie xa naamunyie matandi ra? E mu e bɛlɛxɛ raxama beenun e xa e dɛge alɔ forie xa naamunyie a masenxi ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And in answer he said to them, Why do you, yourselves, go against the word of God on account of the teaching which has been handed down to you?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Munfe ra wo tan Ala xa sɛriyɛ matandima wo xa naamunyie xa fe ra?

sentences.english: For God said, Give honour to your father and mother: and, He who says evil of father or mother will be put to death.
sentences.susu: Ala bara a masen, ‹Wo xa wo baba nun wo nga binya.› A man bara a masen, ‹Mixi yo naxan na a baba nun a nga konbi, a lan nɛ na kanyi xa faxa.›

sentences.english: But you say, If a man says to his father or his mother, That by which you might have had profit from me is given to God;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan naxɛ, xa mixi nde a fala a baba xa na mu a nga bɛ, ‹I nu lanma i xa naxan sɔtɔ n na i malise ra, n bara a fi Ala ma,›

sentences.english: There is no need for him to give honour to his father. And you have made the word of God without effect because of your teaching.
sentences.susu: hali na kanyi mu fefe raba a baba bɛ. Na kui, wo Ala xa sɛriyɛ matandima wo xa naamunyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: You false ones, well did Isaiah say of you,
sentences.susu: Wo tan filankafuie! Annabi Esayi nɔndi yati nan masen wo xa fe ra,

sentences.english: These people give me honour with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
sentences.susu: ‹Yi ɲama n binyama e dɛ nɛ, kɔnɔ e bɔɲɛ makuya n na pon!

sentences.english: But their worship is to no purpose, while they give as their teaching the rules of men.
sentences.susu: E xa sali fufafu nan a ra, barima e mixi xaranma adamadie xa maɲɔxunyie nan na alɔ na maɲɔxunyie findixi n tan ma sɛriyɛ nan na.›»

sentences.english: And he got the people together and said to them, Give ear, and let my words be clear to you:
sentences.susu: Isa naxa ɲama xili, a a masen e bɛ, «Wo wo tuli mati, wo xa fahaamui sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Not that which goes into the mouth makes a man unclean, but that which comes out of the mouth.
sentences.susu: Se naxan soma mixi dɛ kui, na xa mu a findima mixi sɛniyɛntare ra. Naxan minima a dɛ kui, na nan a findima mixi sɛniyɛntare ra.»

sentences.english: Then the disciples came and said to him, Did you see that the Pharisees were troubled when these words came to their ears?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa e maso a ra, e a fala a bɛ, «I mu a kolon i xa masenyi bara Farisɛnie raxɔnɔ?»

sentences.english: But he said in answer, Every plant which my Father in heaven has not put in the earth, will be taken up by the roots.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «N Baba naxan na ariyanna, a sansi birin talama nɛ a tan mu naxan sixi.

sentences.english: Let them be: they are blind guides. And if a blind man is guiding a blind man, the two will go falling into a hole together.
sentences.susu: Wo e lu na. Dɔnxui nan na e ra naxee dɔnxuie raɲɛrɛma. Xa dɔnxui dɔnxui raɲɛrɛ, e firin birin birama nɛ yili kui.»

sentences.english: Then Peter said to him, Make the story clear to us.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a fala a bɛ, «Yi taali tagi raba muxu bɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said, Are you, like them, still without wisdom?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «Han ya wo fan mu fahaamui sɔtɔ?

sentences.english: Do you not see that whatever goes into the mouth goes on into the stomach, and is sent out as waste?
sentences.susu: Wo mu a kolon a se naxan birin soma mixi dɛ kui, a goroma furi nan kui, a fa mini fate i?

sentences.english: But the things which come out of the mouth come from the heart; and they make a man unclean.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ masenyi naxan minima mixi dɛ kui, a kelima a bɔɲɛ nan ma. Na nan nɔma a findide mixi sɛniyɛntare ra.

sentences.english: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, the taking of life, broken faith between the married, unclean desires of the flesh, taking of property, false witness, bitter words:
sentences.susu: Barima maɲɔxun kobie, faxɛ tife, yɛnɛ, langoeɲa, muɲɛ, tɔɔɲɛgɛ, mixi xili kanafe, nee birin fatanma mixi bɔɲɛ nan na.

sentences.english: These are the things which make a man unclean; but to take food with unwashed hands does not make a man unclean.
sentences.susu: Nee nan mixi findima mixi sɛniyɛntare ra, kɔnɔ mixi a dɛgefe a bɛlɛxɛ raxatare ra, na xa mu a findima mixi sɛniyɛntare ra.»

sentences.english: And Jesus went away from there into the country of Tyre and Sidon.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa keli mɛnni, a siga Tire nun Sidɔn bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And a woman of Canaan came out from those parts, crying and saying, Have pity on me, O Lord, Son of David; my daughter is greatly troubled with an unclean spirit.
sentences.susu: Kanaan ginɛ nde naxan kelixi na longori, a naxa fa Isa yire a a xui ite, «Marigi, Dawuda xa Di, kinikini n ma. Ɲinnɛ bara n ma di ginɛ ɲaxankata feo!»

sentences.english: But he gave her no answer. And his disciples came and said to him, Send her away, for she is crying after us.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa mu sese fala a bɛ. A fɔxirabirɛe naxa e maso Isa ra, e a fala a bɛ, «Yi ginɛ keri, a na gbelegbelefe won fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: But he made answer and said, I was sent only to the wandering sheep of the house of Israel.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen, «N xɛɛxi Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ gbansan nan ma, naxee luxi alɔ yɛxɛɛ lɔɛxie.»

sentences.english: But she came and gave him worship, saying, Help, Lord.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ ginɛ naxa fa a suyidi a bɛ, a a fala, «Marigi, i xa n mali!»

sentences.english: And he made answer and said, It is not right to take the children's bread and give it to the dogs.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «A mu lan taami xa ba dimɛdie yi ra, a sa baree bun ma.»

sentences.english: But she said, Yes, Lord: but even the dogs take the bits from under their masters' table.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a fala, «Marigi, i nɔndi, kɔnɔ hali baree, e donse xuntunyi nde sɔtɔma naxan birama e kanyi xa teebili ra.»

sentences.english: Then Jesus, answering, said to her, O woman, great is your faith: let your desire be done. And her daughter was made well from that hour.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa naxa a masen a bɛ, «Ginɛ, i xa danxaniya gbo! I waxɔnfe bara raba i bɛ.» A xa di ginɛ naxa yalan keren na.

sentences.english: And Jesus went from there and came to the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and took his seat there.
sentences.susu: Isa to keli mɛnni, a naxa ɲɛrɛ Galile baa dɛ ra han a naxa geya li. A naxa te geya fari, a dɔxɔ.

sentences.english: And there came to him great numbers of people having with them those who were broken in body, or blind, or without voice, or wounded, or ill in any way, and a number of others; they put them down at his feet and he made them well:
sentences.susu: Ɲama gbegbe naxa fa a yire naa, e fa namatɛe ra, a nun dɔnxuie, mabɛnyie, boboe, nun furema gbɛtɛe gbegbe ra. E naxa furemae sa Isa bun ma, a fan naxa e rayalan.

sentences.english: So that the people were full of wonder when they saw that those who had no voice were talking, the feeble were made strong, those whose bodies were broken had the power of walking, and the blind were able to see: and they gave glory to the God of Israel.
sentences.susu: Ɲama to a to boboe wɔyɛnma, mabɛnyie yalanma, namatɛe ɲɛrɛma, dɔnxuie se toma, e naxa kaaba. E naxa Isirayila Marigi Ala matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: And Jesus got his disciples together and said, I have pity for the people, because they have now been with me three days and have no food: and I will not send them away without food, or they will have no strength for the journey.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fɔxirabirɛe xili, a a masen e bɛ, «N bara kinikini yi ɲama ma, barima xi saxan nan yi ki, e na n yire be, kɔnɔ donse mu na e naxan donma. N mu wama e xa gbilen e xɔnyi kaamɛ ra e ma, xa na mu a ra e tɔɔrɔma nɛ kira xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: And the disciples say to him, How may we get enough bread in a waste place, to give food to such a number of people?
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛe naxa a maxɔrin, «Won donse sɔtɔma yi ɲama gbegbe bɛ minden? Won na wula nɛ yi ki.»

sentences.english: And Jesus says to them, How much bread have you? And they said, Seven cakes, and some small fishes.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Taami gundi yeri na wo yi?» E naxa a fala, «Solofere, a nun yɛxɛ xunxuri ndee.»

sentences.english: Then he gave an order to the people to be seated on the earth,
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala ɲama bɛ e xa dɔxɔ bɔxi.

sentences.english: And he took the seven cakes of bread and the fishes; and having given praise, he gave the broken bread to the disciples, and the disciples gave it to the people.
sentences.susu: A naxa na taami gundi solofere nun na yɛxɛe tongo, a Ala nuwali sa. A to e igira, a naxa e so a fɔxirabirɛe yi ra, e xa e itaxun ɲama ma.

sentences.english: And they all took food, and had enough; and they took up of the broken bits, seven baskets full.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa e dɛge han e wasa. Donse dɔnxɔɛ fan naxa matongo han debe solofere naxa rafe.

sentences.english: And there were four thousand men who took food, together with women and children.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ mixi wulu naani nan e dɛge, bafe ginɛe nun dimɛe ra.

sentences.english: And when he had sent the people away, he got into the boat, and came into the country of Magadan.
sentences.susu: Isa to gɛ ɲama ragbilende, a naxa baki kunkui kui, a siga Magadan bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the Pharisees and Sadducees came and, testing him, made a request to him to give them a sign from heaven.
sentences.susu: Farisɛnie nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe naxa fa Isa yire. E to nu wama gantanyi safe a bɛ, e naxa a maxɔrin a xa tɔnxuma makaabaxi nde masen e bɛ kelife koore ma.

sentences.english: But in answer he said to them, At nightfall you say, The weather will be good, for the sky is red.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Nunmare na a li wo naxɛ, ‹Kuye fanma tina, barima koore igbeelixi.›

sentences.english: And in the morning, The weather will be bad today, for the sky is red and angry. You are able to see the face of heaven, but not the signs of the times.
sentences.susu: Kuye nɛ iba wo naxɛ, ‹Tunɛ nun foye minima nɛ to, barima koore igbeelixi, nuxuie ifɔɔrɔ.› Wo fata koore ɲingi tagi rabade, kɔnɔ wo mu fata yi waxati fee tan tagi rabade.

sentences.english: An evil and false generation is searching after a sign; and no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah. And he went away from them.
sentences.susu: To mixie kobi, e bara gbilen Ala fɔxɔ ra. E wama tɔnxuma makaabaxi tofe, kɔnɔ tɔnxuma yo mu fima e ma bafe Annabi Yunusa xa tɔnxuma ra.» Na xanbi Isa naxa keli e xun ma, a siga.

sentences.english: And when the disciples came to the other side they had not taken thought to get bread.
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa giri naakiri ma, e nɛɛmu taami ma.

sentences.english: And Jesus said to them, Take care to have nothing to do with the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo wo yɛtɛ ratanga Farisɛnie nun Sadusenie xa lɛbini ma.»

sentences.english: And they were reasoning among themselves, saying, We took no bread.
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa na fe mato, e fa a fala e bore bɛ, «A na falaxi nɛ barima won mu faxi taami ra.»

sentences.english: And Jesus, seeing it, said, O you of little faith, why are you reasoning among yourselves, because you have no bread?
sentences.susu: Isa to nu e xa maɲɔxunyi kolon, a naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo taami fe falama wo bore bɛ munfe ra? Wo xa danxaniya xurun.

sentences.english: Do you still not see, or keep in mind the five cakes of bread of the five thousand, and the number of baskets you took up?
sentences.susu: Han ya wo mu xaxili sɔtɔ? Ka wo nɛɛmuxi nɛ taami gundi suuli to xɛmɛ wulu suuli wasa? Wo to na taami dɔnxɔɛ matongo, wo debee yeri rafe?

sentences.english: Or the seven cakes of bread of the four thousand, and the number of baskets you took up?
sentences.susu: Ka wo man nɛɛmuxi nɛ taami gundi solofere to xɛmɛ wulu naani wasa? Wo to na fan dɔnxɔɛ matongo, wo debee yeri rafe?

sentences.english: How is it that you do not see that I was not talking to you about bread, but about keeping away from the leaven of the Pharisees and Sadducees?
sentences.susu: Munse a toxi wo mu a kolon a n mu taami fe xa falafe wo bɛ? Wo xa wo yɛtɛ ratanga Farisɛnie nun Sadusenie xa lɛbini ma.»

sentences.english: Then they saw that it was not the leaven of bread which he had in mind, but the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
sentences.susu: Na kui, e naxa a fahaamu a Isa mu a falaxi xɛ e bɛ a e xa e yɛtɛ ratanga taami lɛbini daaxi ma. A nu a falafe nɛ e xa e yɛtɛ ratanga Farisɛnie nun Sadusenie xa xaranyi ma.

sentences.english: Now when Jesus had come into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he said, questioning his disciples, Who do men say that the Son of man is?
sentences.susu: Isa to Sesareya Filipi bɔxi li, a naxa a fɔxirabirɛe maxɔrin, «Mixie munse falama Adama xa Di xa fe ra? Nde lanxi a ma?»

sentences.english: And they said, Some say, John the Baptist; some, Elijah; and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Ndee a falama Annabi Yaya Xunxa. Ndee a falama Annabi Eliya. Ndee a falama Annabi Yeremi, xa na mu a ra namiɲɔnmɛ gbɛtɛ.»

sentences.english: He says to them, But who do you say that I am?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e maxɔrin, «Kɔnɔ wo tan naxɛ a di? Nde n na?»

sentences.english: And Simon Peter made answer and said, You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.
sentences.susu: Simon Piyɛri naxa a yaabi, «Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan na i ra, Abadan Ala xa Di.»

sentences.english: And Jesus made answer and said to him, A blessing on you, Simon Bar-jonah: because this knowledge has not come to you from flesh and blood, but from my Father in heaven.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «Sɛɛwɛ na i bɛ, i tan Yunusa xa di Simɔn, barima ibunadama xa mu na masenxi i bɛ. N Baba naxan na ariyanna, na nan a masenxi i bɛ.

sentences.english: And I say to you that you are Peter, and on this rock will my church be based, and the doors of hell will not overcome it.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala i bɛ, i findixi Piyɛri nan na, naxan falaxi ‹gɛmɛ.› N nan n ma danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama tima na gɛmɛ nan fari. Hali faxɛ, a mu nɔma n ma ɲama ra.

sentences.english: I will give to you the keys of the kingdom of heaven: and whatever is fixed by you on earth will be fixed in heaven: and whatever you make free on earth will be made free in heaven.
sentences.susu: N Ala xa mangɛya saabi soma nɛ i yi ra. I na tɔnyi dɔxɔ fe naxan ma duniɲa, Ala naxan na ariyanna, a fan tɔnyi dɔxɔma nɛ na fe ra. I na tin fe naxan na duniɲa, Ala naxan na ariyanna, a fan tinma nɛ na fe ra.»

sentences.english: Then he gave orders to the disciples to give no man word that he was the Christ.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a naxa a matintin a fɔxirabirɛe ra, a e naxa a fala mixi yo bɛ, a a tan nan findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra.

sentences.english: From that time Jesus went on to make clear to his disciples how he would have to go up to Jerusalem, and undergo much at the hands of those in authority and the chief priests and scribes, and be put to death, and the third day come again from the dead.
sentences.susu: Keli na tɛmui ma, Isa naxa a tagi raba fɔlɔ a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, a fo a xa siga Darisalamu, a xa tɔɔrɛ gbegbe sɔtɔ Yuwifie xa forie, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie, nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe ra, e a faxa, kɔnɔ a man xa keli faxɛ ma a xi saxan nde ma.

sentences.english: And Peter, protesting, said to him, Be it far from you, Lord; it is impossible that this will come about.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri to a bɛndun, e sa ti e xati ma, a naxa so wɔyɛnfe Isa ra, a a fala a bɛ, «Ala xa i tanga na ma, n Marigi! Na fe mɔɔli mu i sɔtɔma feo!»

sentences.english: But he, turning to Peter, said, Get out of my way, Satan: you are a danger to me because your mind is not on the things of God, but on the things of men.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a ya rafindi Piyɛri ma, a a fala, «Keli n ya i, i tan Sentanɛ! I katafe nɛ i xa n natantan, barima i xaxili mu tixi Ala fee xa ra, a tixi adama fee nan na.»

sentences.english: Then Jesus said to his disciples, If any man would come after me, let him give up all, and take up his cross, and come after me.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isa naxa a masen a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, «Xa mixi wa birafe n fɔxɔ ra, a xa a yɛtɛ waxɔnfe gere, a xa tondi a yɛtɛ ma, a tin tɔɔrɛ nun faxɛ ra, a bira n fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Because whoever has a desire to keep his life safe will have it taken from him; but whoever gives up his life because of me, will have it given back to him.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan wama a yɛtɛ rakisife, na kanyi lɔɛma nɛ. Naxan a yɛtɛ ralɔɛma n tan ma fe ra, na kanyi kisima nɛ.

sentences.english: For what profit has a man, if he gets all the world with the loss of his life? or what will a man give in exchange for his life?
sentences.susu: Duniɲa birin sɔtɔɛ munse fanma mixi ma, xa a sigama yahannama? Fe mundun na, mixi nɔma a xa ariyanna masarade naxan na?

sentences.english: For the Son of man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels; and then he will give to every man the reward of his works.
sentences.susu: Adama xa Di fama fade a Baba xa nɔrɛ kui, e nun a xa malekɛe. Na tɛmui a mixi birin sare fima nɛ, kankan nun a kɛwali.

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, There are some of those here who will not have a taste of death, till they see the Son of man coming in his kingdom.
sentences.susu: N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, mixi ndee tixi wo ya ma be, naxee mu faxama fo e Adama xa Di to fa ra a xa mangɛya kui.»

sentences.english: And after six days Jesus takes with him Peter, and James, and John, his brother, and makes them go up with him into a high mountain by themselves.
sentences.susu: Xi senni dangi xanbi, Isa naxa Piyɛri, Yaki, nun Yaki xunya Yaya xanin e doro ma geya itexi nde fari.

sentences.english: And he was changed in form before them; and his face was shining like the sun, and his clothing became white as light.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni Isa naxa masara, a nɔrɔ e ya xɔri. A yatagi naxa yanba alɔ soge, a xa sosee naxa fiixɛ alɔ naiyalanyi.

sentences.english: And Moses and Elijah came before their eyes, talking with him.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Annabi Eliya nun Annabi Munsa naxa mini fɔxirabirɛe ya xɔri, e naxa e to e nun Isa wɔyɛnfe.

sentences.english: And Peter made answer and said to Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here: if you will let me, I will make here three tents, one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a fala Isa bɛ, «Marigi, fe fanyi nan a ra muxu to na be yi ki. Xa i wa, n lingira saxan yailanma be, keren i gbe, keren Annabi Munsa gbe, keren Annabi Eliya gbe.»

sentences.english: While he was still talking, a bright cloud came over them: and a voice out of the cloud, saying, This is my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased; give ear to him.
sentences.susu: A nu wɔyɛnfe tɛmui naxɛ, nuxui yanbaxi naxa goro e xun na, xui nde fan naxa mini nuxui kui, a a masen, «N ma Di maxanuxi nan yi ki naxan n kɛnɛnxi ki fanyi ra. Wo wo tuli mati a ra.»

sentences.english: And at these words the disciples went down on their faces in great fear.
sentences.susu: Fɔxirabirɛe to na xui mɛ, e naxa gaaxu ki fanyi, e e yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And Jesus came and put his hand on them and said, Get up and have no fear.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa naxa a maso e ra, a a bɛlɛxɛ sa e ma, a a fala, «Wo keli. Wo naxa gaaxu.»

sentences.english: And lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, but Jesus only.
sentences.susu: E to e ya rakeli, e mu mixi yo to fo Isa.

sentences.english: And when they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus gave them orders, saying, Let no man have word of what you have seen, till the Son of man has come again from the dead.
sentences.susu: E to nu na gorofe geya fari, Isa naxa a matintin e ra, «Wo fe naxan toxi, wo naxa a fala mixi yo bɛ, han beemanun Adama xa Di xa keli faxɛ ma.»

sentences.english: And his disciples, questioning him, said, Why then do the scribes say that Elijah has to come first?
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa a maxɔrin, «Munfe ra sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe a falama a fo Annabi Eliya nan singe xa fa?»

sentences.english: And in answer he said, Elijah truly has to come and put all things right:
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «Nɔndi nan a ra. Annabi Eliya nan singe fama yati, a fe birin yailan.

sentences.english: But I say to you that Elijah has come, and they had no knowledge of him, but did to him whatever they were pleased to do; the same will the Son of man undergo at their hands.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n xa a fala wo bɛ, Annabi Eliya ɲan bara fa, kɔnɔ e mu a kolonxi, e bara e waxɔnfe birin niya a ra. E man fafe Adama xa Di tɔɔrɔde na ki nɛ.»

sentences.english: Then the disciples saw that he was talking to them of John the Baptist.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa a kolon a a nu na Yaya Xunxa nan ma fe falafe e bɛ.

sentences.english: And when they came to the people, a man went down on his knees to him, saying,
sentences.susu: E to ɲama yire li, xɛmɛ nde naxa fa Isa xɔn, a a xinbi sin a bun ma,

sentences.english: Lord have mercy on my son: for he is off his head, and is in great pain; and frequently he goes falling into the fire, and frequently into the water.
sentences.susu: a a fala, «Marigi, kinikini n ma di ma, xaxili fure a ɲaxankataxi ki fanyi. A luma bira ra tɛ xɔɔra, a nun ye xɔɔra. A na rabama han.

sentences.english: And I took him to your disciples, and they were not able to make him well.
sentences.susu: N bara fa a ra i fɔxirabirɛe xɔn, kɔnɔ e mu nɔxi a rayalande.»

sentences.english: And Jesus, answering, said, O false and foolish generation, how long will I be with you? how long will I put up with you? let him come here to me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Wo tan bɔnsɔɛ danxaniyatare, wo kobi! N xa lu wo sɛɛti ma han mun tɛmui? N xa ti wo bun ma han mun lɔxɔɛ? Wo fa na di ra n xɔn.»

sentences.english: And Jesus gave orders to the unclean spirit, and it went out of him: and the boy was made well from that hour.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa ɲinnɛ yamari, ɲinnɛ naxa gbilen dimɛdi fɔxɔ ra, dimɛdi naxa yalan keren na.

sentences.english: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, Why were we not able to send it out?
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa e maso Isa ra, e a maxɔrin e doro ma, «Munfe ra muxu tan mu nɔ na ɲinnɛ keride?»

sentences.english: And he says to them, Because of your little faith: for truly I say to you, If you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will say to this mountain, Be moved from this place to that; and it will be moved; and nothing will be impossible to you.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Wo xa danxaniya nan xurun. N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, xa danxaniya na wo bɛ, hali a xurun alɔ konde xɔri, wo na a fala yi geya bɛ, ‹Keli be, i i masiga mɛnni,› a masigama nɛ. Fefe mu na wo mu nɔma naxan nabade.
Kɔnɔ yi ɲinnɛ mɔɔli tan mu kerima fo Ala maxandi nun sunyi saabui ra.»

sentences.english: And while they were going about in Galilee, Jesus said to them, The Son of man will be given up into the hands of men;
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛe to malan Galile, Isa naxa a fala e bɛ, «Adama xa Di sama nɛ mixie bɛlɛxɛ,

sentences.english: And they will put him to death, and the third day he will come again from the dead. And they were very sad.
sentences.susu: e a faxa. A xa faxɛ xi saxan nde ma, a man kelima nɛ faxɛ ma.» A xa wɔyɛnyi naxa a fɔxirabirɛe nimisa ki fanyi.

sentences.english: And when they had come to Capernaum, those who took the Temple tax came to Peter and said, Does not your master make payment of the Temple tax?
sentences.susu: Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛe to so Kapɛrɛnamu, hɔrɔmɔbanxi duuti maxilie naxa Piyɛri maxɔrin, «Pe, i karamɔxɔ mu hɔrɔmɔbanxi duuti fima?»

sentences.english: He says, Yes. And when he came into the house, Jesus said to him, What is your opinion, Simon? from whom do the kings of the earth get payment or tax? from their sons or from other people?
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa e yaabi, «Iyo, a a fima.» Piyɛri to so banxi, Isa nan singe wɔyɛn a bɛ, «Piyɛri, i a toxi di? Duniɲa mangɛe duuti maxilima nde ma, e xa die ka mixi gbɛtɛe?»

sentences.english: And when he said, From other people, Jesus said to him, Then are the sons free.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a yaabi, «Mixi gbɛtɛe.» Isa fan naxa a masen, «Na kui, mangɛ xa die tan mu duuti fima.

sentences.english: But, so that we may not be a cause of trouble to them, go to the sea, and let down a hook, and take the first fish which comes up; and in his mouth you will see a bit of money: take that, and give it to them for me and you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ alako won naxa yi mixie raxɔnɔ, i xa siga baa dɛ ra, i kɔnyi woli. I na yɛxɛ naxan singe suxu, a rate, i a dɛ rabi. I kɔbiri kole toma nɛ a dɛ kui. I xa na so duuti maxilie yi ra, a xa findi won firin ma duuti ra.»

sentences.english: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Who is greatest in the kingdom of heaven?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa e maso Isa ra, e a maxɔrin, «Nde binyaxi dangi birin na Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma?»

sentences.english: And he took a little child, and put him in the middle of them,
sentences.susu: Isa naxa dimɛdi nde xili, a a ti e tagi,

sentences.english: And said, Truly, I say to you, If you do not have a change of heart and become like little children, you will not go into the kingdom of heaven.
sentences.susu: a a masen e bɛ, «N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, xa wo mu wo yɛtɛ magoro, wo lu alɔ dimɛdie, wo mu soma Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma.

sentences.english: Whoever, then, will make himself as low as this little child, the same is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
sentences.susu: Na kui, mixi yo naxan a yɛtɛ magoroma alɔ dimɛdi, na nan findixi mixi xungbe ra dangi birin na Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma.

sentences.english: And whoever gives honour to one such little child in my name, gives honour to me:
sentences.susu: Mixi yo naxan yi dimɛdi mɔɔli rasɛnɛma n xili ra, na kanyi bara n tan yɛtɛ yati rasɛnɛ.»

sentences.english: But whoever is a cause of trouble to one of these little ones who have faith in me, it would be better for him to have a great stone fixed to his neck, and to come to his end in the deep sea.
sentences.susu: «Mixi yo yi mixi xuri keren natantan, naxan danxaniyaxi n ma, a fisa na kanyi bɛ gɛmɛ binye xa xiri a kɔn ma, a rasin baa ma.

sentences.english: A curse is on the earth because of trouble! for it is necessary for trouble to come; but unhappy is that man through whom the trouble comes.
sentences.susu: Gbaloe na duniɲa mixie bɛ e xa maratantanyi xa fe ra. A fɛɛrɛ mu na tan, fo maratantanyi xa mini, kɔnɔ gbaloe na mixi bɛ naxan findima na saabui ra.

sentences.english: And if your hand or your foot is a cause of trouble, let it be cut off and put it away from you: it is better for you to go into life with the loss of a hand or a foot than, having two hands or two feet, to go into the eternal fire.
sentences.susu: Xa i bɛlɛxɛ, xa na mu i sanyi findi i ratantanse ra, a bolon, i a wɔlɛ. I sofe ariyanna i bɛlɛxɛ, xa na mu i sanyi bolonxi, na fisa i bɛ dinɛ i bɛlɛxɛ firin nun i sanyi firin luxi na, kɔnɔ i woli yahannama, tɛ mu xubenma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And if your eye is a cause of trouble to you, take it out, and put it away from you: it is better for you to go into life with one eye than, having two eyes, to go into the hell of fire.
sentences.susu: Xa i ya findi i ratantanse ra, a ba na, i a wɔlɛ. I sofe ariyanna i ya keren kanaxi, na fisa i bɛ dinɛ i ya firin lu na, kɔnɔ i woli yahannama.»

sentences.english: Let it not seem to you that one of these little ones is of no value; for I say to you that in heaven their angels see at all times the face of my Father in heaven.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa yo yi mixi xuri sese ma, barima n xa a fala wo bɛ, e xa malekɛe n Baba yatagi toma tɛmui birin, naxan na ariyanna.»
<range>

sentences.english: What would you say now? if a man has a hundred sheep, and one of them has gone wandering away, will he not let the ninety-nine be, and go to the mountains in search of the wandering one?
sentences.susu: «Wo a toxi di? Xa yɛxɛɛ kɛmɛ na mixi nde yi ra, keren fa lɔɛ e ya ma, a mu na yɛxɛɛ tongo solomanaani nun solomanaani luma xɛ geya fari, a siga na kerenyi fende?

sentences.english: And if he comes across it, truly I say to you, he has more joy over it than over the ninety-nine which have not gone out of the way.
sentences.susu: N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, xa a sa a to, a ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ na yɛxɛɛ kerenyi xa fe ra, dangife yɛxɛɛ tongo solomanaani nun solomanaani boore ra, naxee mu lɔɛ.

sentences.english: Even so it is not the pleasure of your Father in heaven for one of these little ones to come to destruction.
sentences.susu: A na na ki nɛ fan, wo Baba naxan na ariyanna, a mu tinma yi mixi xuri sese xa lɔɛ.»

sentences.english: And if your brother does wrong to you, go, make clear to him his error between you and him in private: if he gives ear to you, you have got your brother back again.
sentences.susu: «Xa i ngaxakerenyi bara haakɛ sɔtɔ i ra, siga, wo firin xa sa lu yire keren, i xa a masen a bɛ a tantanxi ki naxɛ. Xa a sa i xui mɛ, i ngaxakerenyi bara ragbilen i ma.

sentences.english: But if he will not give ear to you, take with you one or two more, that by the lips of two or three witnesses every word may be made certain.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa a tondi i xui mɛde, i xa mixi keren xa na mu mixi firin fen, wo birin xa siga a yire alako kiiti xa sa seede firin, xa na mu seede saxan xui ma.

sentences.english: And if he will not give ear to them, let it come to the hearing of the church: and if he will not give ear to the church, let him be to you as a Gentile and a tax-farmer.
sentences.susu: Xa a tondi nee fan xui mɛde, na fe masen danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama bɛ. Xa a tondi danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xui fan mɛde, a xa lu wo bɛ alɔ kaafiri, xa na mu a ra, duuti maxili.

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, Whatever things are fixed by you on earth will be fixed in heaven: and whatever you make free on earth will be made free in heaven.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, wo na naxan xiri duniɲa, a xirima nɛ koore fan ma. Wo na naxan fulun duniɲa, a fulunma nɛ koore fan ma.

sentences.english: Again, I say to you, that if two of you are in agreement on earth about anything for which they will make a request, it will be done for them by my Father in heaven.
sentences.susu: N man xa a fala wo bɛ, xa mixi firin lan fefe ma wo ya ma yi duniɲa ma, e Ala maxandi, n Baba naxan na ariyanna, a na fe rabama nɛ e bɛ.

sentences.english: For where two or three are come together in my name, there am I among them.
sentences.susu: Mixi firin, xa na mu a ra mixi saxan nu malan n xili ra dɛdɛ, n na e ya ma.»

sentences.english: Then Peter came and said to him, Lord, what number of times may my brother do wrong against me, and I give him forgiveness? till seven times?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Piyɛri naxa a maso Isa ra, a a fala a bɛ, «N Marigi, n lanma n xa diɲɛ n ngaxakerenyi xa haakɛ ma sanmaya yeri? Han sanmaya solofere?» Isa naxa a yaabi,

sentences.english: Jesus says to him, I say not to you, Till seven times; but, Till seventy times seven.
sentences.susu: «N xa a fala i bɛ, sanmaya solofere xa mu a ra de! I xa diɲɛ a ma sanmaya solofere dɔxɔ tongo solofere.»

sentences.english: For this reason the kingdom of heaven is like a king, who went over his accounts with his servants.
sentences.susu: «Ala xa mangɛya maniyaxi mangɛ nde nan na, naxan nu wama a xa kɔbiri fe ya ibafe a tan nun a xa walikɛe tagi.

sentences.english: And at the start, one came to him who was in his debt for ten thousand talents.
sentences.susu: A to a fɔlɔ, e naxa fa a xa walikɛ nde ra a xɔn, mangɛ xa doni nu naxan ma han gbeti kilo wulu kɛmɛ saxan, kilo wulu tongo naani.

sentences.english: And because he was not able to make payment, his lord gave orders for him, and his wife, and his sons and daughters, and all he had, to be given for money, and payment to be made.
sentences.susu: Konyi to mu nu nɔma a xa doni fide, a xa mangɛ naxa yaamari fi, a tan yo, a xa ginɛ yo, a xa die yo, e nun a harige birin xa mati alako na doni xa fi.

sentences.english: So the servant went down on his face and gave him worship, saying, Lord, give me time to make payment and I will give you all.
sentences.susu: Na walikɛ naxa a igoro bɔxi, a suyidi mangɛ bɛ, a a maxandi, ‹Yandi, diɲɛ n ma. N fama i xa doni birin fide.›

sentences.english: And the lord of that servant, being moved with pity, let him go, and made him free of the debt.
sentences.susu: Na kui, mangɛ naxa kinikini a xa walikɛ ma, a diɲɛ na doni birin ma, a a xa walikɛ rabɛɲin.»

sentences.english: But that servant went out, and meeting one of the other servants, who was in debt to him for one hundred pence, he took him by the throat, saying, Make payment of your debt.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ a tan walikɛ to mini, a naxa a boore walikɛ nde to a xa gbeti kilo tagi doni nu na naxan ma. A naxa bagan a ma, a a kɔnyi dekun, a sɔnxɔ a ra, ‹N ma doni fi!›

sentences.english: So that servant went down on his face, requesting him and saying, Give me time and I will make payment to you.
sentences.susu: A boore naxa suyidi a bɛ, a a maxandi, ‹Yandi, diɲɛ n ma. N i xa doni fima.›

sentences.english: And he would not: but went and put him into prison till he had made payment of the debt.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a naxa tondi. A naxa a raso geeli kui, a xa lu mɛnni han a xa gɛ doni fide.»
