sentences.susu: Na waxati, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun Yuwifie xa forie nu malanxi Kayafa xɔnyi, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie xunyi.

sentences.english: And they made designs together to take Jesus by some trick, and put him to death.
sentences.susu: E naxa lan a ma e xa Isa suxu yanfanteya saabui ra, e xa a faxa.

sentences.english: But they said, Not while the feast is going on, for fear of trouble among the people.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e naxa a fala, «Won naxa a suxu sali lɔxɔɛ, xa na mu a ra ɲama a xunyi ikelima nɛ.»

sentences.english: Now when Jesus was in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper,
sentences.susu: Isa to nu na Betani, Simɔn kunɛ kanyi xɔnyi,

sentences.english: There came to him a woman having a bottle of perfume of great price, and she put the perfume on his head when he was seated at table.
sentences.susu: ginɛ nde naxa fa a yire. Labundɛ ture nu na a yi ra, naxan sare xɔrɔxɔ ki fanyi. A nu saxi a bitirɛ tofanyi kui naxan nu rafalaxi alabatira gɛmɛ ra. Isa nu na teebili ra tɛmui naxɛ, ginɛ naxa fa, a na labundɛ ture ifili Isa xunyi ma.

sentences.english: But when the disciples saw it they were angry, saying, To what purpose is this waste?
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛe to na to, e naxa xɔnɔ, e a fala, «Yi birin makanaxi munfe ra?

sentences.english: For we might have got much money for this and given it to the poor.
sentences.susu: Xa yi labundɛ ture sa mati nu, kɔbiri gbegbe nan sɔtɔma nu a xa fe ra, na fan nɔ fide setaree ma.»

sentences.english: But Jesus, seeing it, said to them, Why are you troubling the woman? she has done a kind act to me.
sentences.susu: Isa to nu a kolon e naxan falafe e bore bɛ, a naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo na yi ginɛ tɔɔrɔfe munfe ra? Kɛwali fanyi nan yi ki, a naxan nabaxi n bɛ.

sentences.english: For the poor you have ever with you, but me you have not for ever.
sentences.susu: Setaree luma nɛ wo ya ma tɛmui birin, kɔnɔ n tan mu luma wo yi ra be abadan xɛ.

sentences.english: For in putting this perfume on my body, she did it to make me ready for my last resting-place.
sentences.susu: Yi ginɛ to labundɛ ture saxi n fate ma, a a rabaxi n fure ragatafe nan xa fe ma.

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, Wherever this good news goes out in all the world, what this woman has done will be talked of in memory of her.
sentences.susu: N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, Ala xa xibaaru fanyi sa kawandima dɛdɛ duniɲa birin kui, yi ginɛ xa kɛwali xa fe fan falama nɛ, mixie xa e ratu a xa fe ma.»

sentences.english: Then one of the twelve, who was named Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests and said,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Yudasi Isikariyoti, naxan nu na Isa fɔxirabirɛ fu nun firinyie ya ma, a naxa siga sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie xɔn ma,

sentences.english: What will you give me, if I give him up to you? And the price was fixed at thirty bits of silver.
sentences.susu: a e maxɔrin, «Wo munse soma n yi n xa Isa sa wo bɛlɛxɛ?» E fan naxa gbeti kole tongo saxan so a yi.

sentences.english: And from that time he was watching for a chance to give him into their hands.
sentences.susu: Keli na tɛmui ma, a naxa so waxati fenfe a nɔma Isa sode e yi ra tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: Now on the first day of unleavened bread the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Where are we to make ready for you to take the Passover meal?
sentences.susu: Taami Lɛbinitare Sali to a li, a lɔxɔɛ singe ma, Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa sa a maxɔrin, «I wama muxu xa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali donyi rafala i bɛ minden?»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Go into the town to such a man, and say to him, The Master says, My time is near: I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «Wo siga taa kui xɛmɛ nde xɔn, wo a fala a bɛ, ‹Karamɔxɔ naxɛ a a xa waxati bara makɔrɛ. A wama Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali rabafe i xɔnyi, a nun a fɔxirabirɛe.›»

sentences.english: And the disciples did as Jesus had said to them; and they made ready the Passover.
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa a raba alɔ Isa e yamari ki naxɛ, e Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali donyi rafala.

sentences.english: Now when evening was come, he was seated at table with the twelve disciples;
sentences.susu: Nunmare to so, Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛ fu nun firinyie nu na teebili ra.

sentences.english: And while they were taking food, he said, Truly I say to you that one of you will be false to me.
sentences.susu: E nu e dɛgefe tɛmui naxɛ, a naxa a masen, «N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, mixi keren na wo ya ma naxan fama n yanfade.»

sentences.english: And they were very said, and said to him, one by one, Is it I, Lord?
sentences.susu: Na naxa e sunnun ki fanyi, kankan naxa a maxɔrin, «Kɔnɔ n Marigi, n tan mu a ra de, ka?»

sentences.english: And he made answer and said, He who puts his hand into the plate with me, the same will be false to me.
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «N nun naxan bara bɛlɛxɛ ragoro paani keren kui, na kanyi nan n yanfama.

sentences.english: The Son of man goes, even as the Writings say of him: but a curse is on that man through whom the Son of man is given up; it would have been well for that man if he had never come into the world.
sentences.susu: Adama xa Di sigama nɛ alɔ a xa fe sɛbɛxi ki naxɛ, kɔnɔ gbaloe nan na Adama xa Di yanfama bɛ. A fisa na kanyi bɛ hali a mu bari nu.»

sentences.english: And Judas, who was false to him, made answer and said, Is it I, Master? He says to him, Yes.
sentences.susu: Yudasi naxan nu fafe a yanfade, a naxa Isa maxɔrin, «Karamɔxɔ, n tan mu a ra de, ka?» Isa naxa a yaabi, «I tan nan a falaxi.»

sentences.english: And when they were taking food, Jesus took bread and, after blessing it, he gave the broken bread to the disciples and said, Take it; this is my body.
sentences.susu: E to nu e dɛgefe, Isa naxa taami tongo. A to tantui rasiga Ala ma, a naxa taami igira, a a so a fɔxirabirɛe yi ra, a a masen e bɛ, a naxɛ, «Wo n ko, wo a don. Yi findixi n fate nan na.»

sentences.english: And he took a cup and, having given praise, he gave it to them, saying,
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Isa naxa tɔnbili fan tongo. A man to tantui rasiga Ala ma, a naxa tɔnbili so e yi ra, a a fala e bɛ, «Wo birin xa a min.

sentences.english: Take of it, all of you, for this is my blood of the testament, which is given for men for the forgiveness of sins.
sentences.susu: Yi findixi n wuli nan na, saatɛ wuli naxan baxi mixi gbegbe bɛ e xa yunubie xafarife ra.

sentences.english: But I say to you that from now I will not take of this fruit of the vine, till that day when I take it new with you in my Father's kingdom.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ, n to yi wɛni minma, n mu yi minma sɔnɔn, han won birin man sa a minma lɔxɔ naxɛ n Baba xɔnyi ariyanna.»

sentences.english: And after a song of praise to God, they went out to the Mountain of Olives.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ bɛɛti bade, e naxa te Oliwi geya fari.

sentences.english: Then said Jesus to them, All of you will be turned away from me this night: for it is said in the Writings, I will put to death the keeper of the sheep, and the sheep of the flock will be put to flight.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo birin gbilenma nɛ n fɔxɔ ra to kɔɛ ra, wo mɛɛ n ma fe ra, barima a sɛbɛxi, ‹N xuruse dɛmadonyi faxama nɛ, yɛxɛɛe fan yensen.›

sentences.english: But after I am come back from the dead, I will go before you into Galilee.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n na keli faxɛ ma, n sigama wo ya ra Galile.»

sentences.english: But Peter made answer and said to him, Though all may be turned away from you, I will never be turned away.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a fala a bɛ, «Hali birin gbilen i fɔxɔ ra, n tan mu gbilenma i fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: Jesus said to him, Truly I say to you that this night, before the hour of the cock's cry, you will say three times that you have no knowledge of me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa Piyɛri yaabi, «N xa nɔndi fala i bɛ, to kɔɛ yati, beenun konkore xa a rate, i i yɛtɛ rasanma nɛ n ma sanmaya saxan.»

sentences.english: Peter says to him, Even if I am put to death with you, I will not be false to you. So said all the disciples.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri man naxa a yaabi, «Hali won birin nan sa faxama, n mu n yɛtɛ rasanma i ma!» Isa fɔxirabirɛ birin naxa na wɔyɛn keren fala.

sentences.english: Then comes Jesus with them to a place named Gethsemane, and says to his disciples, Be seated here, while I go over there for prayer.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛe naxa siga yire nde, dɛnnaxɛ xili Getesemani. Isa naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo dɔxɔ be. N tan xa siga mɛnni Ala maxandide.»

sentences.english: And he took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and became sad and very troubled.
sentences.susu: A naxa Piyɛri nun Sebede xa di firinyie xanin a xun ma. Sunnunyi nun kɔntɔfili to Isa bɔɲɛ suxu,

sentences.english: Then says he to them, My soul is very sad, even to death: keep watch with me here.
sentences.susu: a naxa a masen e bɛ, «Sunnunyi bara nɔ n bɔɲɛ ra alɔ a xa n faxa. Wo lu be, kɔnɔ wo naxa xi.»

sentences.english: And he went forward a little, and falling down on his face in prayer, he said, O my Father, if it is possible, let this cup go from me; but let not my pleasure, but yours be done.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masiga dondoronti, a a yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma, a Ala maxandi, «N Baba, xa a sa nɔma rabade, i xa n natanga yi ɲaxankatɛ ma. Kɔnɔ n sago naxa raba, i tan nan sago xa raba.»

sentences.english: And he comes to the disciples, and sees that they are sleeping, and says to Peter, What, were you not able to keep watch with me one hour?
sentences.susu: A to gbilen a fɔxirabirɛe yire, a naxa e li e na xife. A naxa a fala Piyɛri bɛ, «I mu nɔxi waxati keren xi xɔli kanade n ma fe ra?

sentences.english: Keep watch with prayer, so that you may not be put to the test: the spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is feeble.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa xi. Wo Ala maxandi nɛ alako wo naxa bira tantanyi kui. Maɲɔxun fanyi na adama bɛ, kɔnɔ a fate bɛndɛ tan sɛnbɛ mu na.»

sentences.english: Again, a second time he went away, and said in prayer, O my Father, if this may not go from me without my taking it, let your pleasure be done.
sentences.susu: Isa man to a masiga e ra, a naxa gbilen Ala maxandi ra, «N Baba, xa yi ɲaxankatɛ mu nɔma bade n yi ra, fo n xa tin a ra, i sago nan xa raba.»

sentences.english: And he came again and saw them sleeping, for their eyes were tired.
sentences.susu: A to gbilen a fɔxirabirɛe yire, a man naxa e li e xife, barima xi xɔli nu bara nɔ e ra.

sentences.english: And he went away from them again, and a third time said the same prayer.
sentences.susu: A naxa e lu naa, a siga sanmaya saxan nde, a sa Ala maxandi na maxandi kerenyi ra.

sentences.english: Then he comes to the disciples; and says to them, Go on sleeping now, and take your rest: for the hour is come, and the Son of man is given into the hands of evil men.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, a naxa gbilen a fɔxirabirɛe yire, a a masen e bɛ, «Wo xife nɛ? Wo na wo malabufe han ya? Wo a mato, waxati bara a li. Adama xa Di fafe sade yunubitɔɛe bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: Up, let us be going: see, he who gives me up is near.
sentences.susu: Wo keli, won xɛɛ. Wo a mato, n yanfama bara fa.»

sentences.english: And while he was still talking, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a band armed with swords and sticks, from the chief priests and those in authority over the people.
sentences.susu: Isa ɲan mu nu gɛxi wɔyɛnde, Yudasi, naxan nu na a fɔxirabirɛ fu nun firinyie ya ma, a naxa fa e nun ɲama gbegbe, santidɛgɛmae nun gbengbetae suxuxi e yi ra. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun Yuwifie xa forie nan nu e xɛɛxi.

sentences.english: Now the false one had given them a sign saying, The one to whom I give a kiss, that is he: take him.
sentences.susu: Isa yanfama nun na ɲama nu bara lan a ma, a a xa Isa matɔnxuma e bɛ. A nu bara a fala e bɛ, «N na mixi naxan sunbu, a tan nan na ki. Wo na suxu.»

sentences.english: And straight away he came to Jesus and said, Master! and gave him a kiss.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Yudasi naxa a maso Isa ra keren na, a a fala, «Karamɔxɔ, i nuwali,» a fa a sunbu.

sentences.english: And Jesus said to him, Friend, do that for which you have come. Then they came and put hands on Jesus, and took him.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen a bɛ, «N boore, i faxi naxan nabade, a raba.» Na tɛmui, na mixie naxa e maso Isa ra, e a suxu.

sentences.english: And one of those who were with Jesus put out his hand, and took out his sword and gave the servant of the high priest a blow, cutting off his ear.
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛ nde naxa a xa santidɛgɛma ramini, a sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xa konyi tuli bolon.

sentences.english: Then says Jesus to him, Put up your sword again into its place: for all those who take the sword will come to death by the sword.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «Santidɛgɛma raso a tɛɛ i. Naxan yo na findi a xa geresose ra, na kanyi fan faxama santidɛgɛma nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: Does it not seem possible to you that if I make request to my Father he will even now send me an army of angels?
sentences.susu: Ka i ɲɔxɔ a ma a n mu nɔma n Baba xilide, a malekɛe rasanba n ma keren na, naxee dangi malekɛ gali fu nun firin na?

sentences.english: But how then would the Writings come true, which say that so it has to be?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa na raba, Kitaabuie xa masenyie fa kamalima di? Barima e a masenxi nɛ a fo a xa raba yi ki nɛ.»

sentences.english: In that hour Jesus said to the people, Have you come out as against a thief with swords and sticks to take me? I was teaching every day in the Temple and you took me not.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Isa naxa a fala ɲama bɛ, «Wo to minixi n xili ma santidɛgɛma nun gbengbeta suxuxi wo yi ra, suute nan na n na? Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ, n dɔxɔxi hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, n kawandi tima, wo mu n suxu.

sentences.english: But all this has taken place so that the writings of the prophets might come true. Then all his disciples went from him in flight.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yi birin nabaxi nɛ alako namiɲɔnmɛe naxan sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, a xa kamali.» Na xanbi, Isa fɔxirabirɛe birin naxa e gi a xun ma.

sentences.english: And those who had made Jesus prisoner took him away to the house of Caiaphas, the high priest, where the scribes and those in authority over the people had come together.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee Isa suxu, e naxa a xanin sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi Kayafa xɔnyi, sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe nun forie nu malanxi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: But Peter went after him at a distance, to the house of the high priest, and went in and took his seat with the servants, to see the end.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri fan, a nu biraxi Isa fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ a ndedi nu makuyaxi ɲama ra. A naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra han a so sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie xunyi xa tɛtɛ kui. A naxa dɔxɔ hɔrɔmɔbanxi kantamae fɛ ma, alako a xa a mato Isa xa fe dangima ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Now the chief priests and all the Sanhedrin were looking for false witness against Jesus, so that they might put him to death;
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun Yuwifie xa kiitisa dɔnxɔɛ birin, e nu wule seede nde nan fenfe naxan bama Isa xili ma, e sa nɔma a faxade naxan ma.

sentences.english: And they were not able to get it, though a number of false witnesses came.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e mu se to, hali tɔɔɲɛgɛti gbegbe to fa. A dɔnxɔɛ ra, xɛmɛ firin naxa fa,

sentences.english: But later there came two who said, This man said, I am able to give the Temple of God to destruction, and to put it up again in three days.
sentences.susu: e a fala, «Yi xɛmɛ a fala nɛ, ‹N tan nɔma Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kanade, n man fa a ti xi saxan bun ma.›»

sentences.english: And the high priest got up and said to him, Have you no answer? what is it which these say against you?
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xunyi naxa keli, a Isa maxɔrin, «Pe, i mu e yaabima? Yi xɛmɛe munse safe i xun ma yi ki?»

sentences.english: But Jesus said not a word. And the high priest said to him, I put you on oath, by the living God, that you will say to us if you are the Christ, the Son of God.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa mu sese fala. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie xunyi naxa a fala a bɛ, «N bara i yamari i xa i kali Ala Ɲiɲɛ ra, i a fala muxu bɛ xa i findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan na, Ala xa Di.»

sentences.english: Jesus says to him, You say so: but I say to you, From now you will see the Son of man seated at the right hand of power, and coming on the clouds of heaven.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «I tan nan a falaxi. N man xa a fala wo bɛ, keli yi waxati ma, wo fama Adama xa Di tode, a dɔxɔxi Ala Sɛnbɛma yirefanyi ma, wo a toma fa ra nuxuie kui.»

sentences.english: Then the high priest, violently parting his robes, said, He has said evil against God: what more need have we of witnesses? for now his words against God have come to your ears:
sentences.susu: Na kui, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi naxa a yɛtɛ xa donma suxu, a ibɔɔ xɔnɛ ra, a a fala, «A bara Ala rasɔtɔ! Won hayi na seede gbɛtɛe ma yire? Wo bara a mɛ a Ala rasɔtɔxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: What is your opinion? They made answer and said, It is right for him to be put to death.
sentences.susu: Wo kiiti toxi di?» E naxa a yaabi, «A lanma a xa faxa nɛ.»

sentences.english: Then they put shame on him, and were cruel to him: and some gave him blows, saying,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, e naxa dɛye bɔxun Isa yatagi, e kamui sin a ma. Ndee naxa a dɛ ragarin, e nu a fala,

sentences.english: Be a prophet, O Christ, and say who gave you a blow!
sentences.susu: «I tan, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, namiɲɔnmɛɲa raba! A fala ba, naxan i bɔnbɔxi!»

sentences.english: Now Peter was seated in the open square outside the house: and a servant-girl came to him, saying, You were with Jesus the Galilaean.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri nu dɔxɔxi tande, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xa tɛtɛ kui. Konyi ginɛ nde naxa a makɔrɛ a ra, a a fala, «I tan, wo nun Isa Galileka birin nan nu a ra.»

sentences.english: But he said before them all that it was false, saying, I have no knowledge of what you say.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Piyɛri naxa a matandi birin ya xɔri, a a fala, «N mu a kolon i na fefe falafe!»

sentences.english: And when he had gone out into the doorway, another saw him and says to those who were there, This man was with Jesus the Nazarene.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri to mini fɔlɔ tɛtɛ naadɛ ra, konyi ginɛ gbɛtɛ nde naxa a to, a a fala mixie bɛ naxee nu na naa, «Yi xɛmɛ naxan yi ki, e nun Isa Nasarɛtika nan nu a ra.»

sentences.english: And again he said with an oath, I have no knowledge of the man.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri man naxa a matandi, a a kali, «N mu na xɛmɛ kolon!»

sentences.english: And after a little time those who were near came and said to Peter, Truly you are one of them; because your talk is witness against you.
sentences.susu: A mu bu, naxee nu tixi naa, e naxa e maso Piyɛri ra, e a fala a bɛ, «Nɔndi nan a ra, a tan mixi nde nan yati i ra, barima i wɔyɛnma alɔ Galileka.»

sentences.english: Then with curses and oaths he said, I have no knowledge of the man. And straight away there came the cry of a cock.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa so a kalife, a a fala «Ala xa n danka! N tan mu na xɛmɛ kolon feo!» Na fala xanbi, konkore naxa a rate.

sentences.english: And the word of Jesus came back to Peter, when he said, Before the hour of the cock's cry, you will say three times that you have no knowledge of me. And he went out, weeping bitterly.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa ratu fa Isa xa wɔyɛnyi ma, «Beemanun konkore xa a rate, i i yɛtɛ rasanma nɛ n ma sanmaya saxan.» Na kui, a naxa mini, a sa wa han.

sentences.english: Now when it was morning, all the chief priests and those in authority took thought together with the purpose of putting Jesus to death.
sentences.susu: Kuye to iba, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie birin nun Yuwifie xa forie to nu malanxi, e naxa natɛ tongo e xa Isa faxa.

sentences.english: And they put cords on him and took him away, and gave him up to Pilate, the ruler.
sentences.susu: E to Isa xiri, e naxa a xanin gomina Pilati xɔn.

sentences.english: Then Judas, who was false to him, seeing that he was to be put to death, in his regret took back the thirty bits of silver to the chief priests and those in authority,
sentences.susu: Yudasi, Isa yanfama, a to a to e bara Isa makiiti a lan a xa faxa, a naxa nimisa a xa yanfanteya xa fe ra. A naxa na gbeti kole tongo saxan nagbilen sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun forie ma,

sentences.english: Saying, I have done wrong in giving into your hands an upright man. But they said, What is that to us? it is your business.
sentences.susu: a a fala, «N bara yunubi raba! Xɛmɛ naxan faxama yi ki, sɛniyɛntɔɛ nan a ra, a fa li n tan nan a yanfaxi!» E naxa a yaabi, «Na mu muxu tan matoxi. Na i tan nan matoxi.»

sentences.english: And he put down the silver in the Temple and went out, and put himself to death by hanging.
sentences.susu: A to gbeti kolee woli hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, Yudasi naxa siga a yɛtɛ gbakude wuri kɔn na.

sentences.english: And the chief priests took the silver and said, It is not right to put it in the Temple store for it is the price of blood.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie to gbeti kolee matongo, e naxa a fala, «A mu daxa muxu xa yi gbeti kolee sa hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa kɔbiri xun ma, barima nii sare nan a ra.»

sentences.english: And they made a decision to get with the silver the potter's field, as a place for the dead of other countries.
sentences.susu: E to wɔyɛn, e naxa fɛɲɛ yailanyi xa xɛ yire sara na kɔbiri ra, na xa findi gaburi yire ra xɔɲɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: For this cause that field was named, The field of blood, to this day.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, han to na xɛ xili falama «Wuli Bɔxi.»

sentences.english: Then came true that which was said by Jeremiah the prophet, And they took the thirty bits of silver, the price of him who was valued by the children of Israel;
sentences.susu: Na kui, Annabi Yeremi xa masenyi naxa kamali, a to a masen, «E naxa gbeti kole tongo saxan tongo, Isirayilakae ndee sare naxan saxi a xun,

sentences.english: And they gave them for the potter's field, as I had word from the Lord.
sentences.susu: e fɛɲɛ yailanyi xa xɛ sara na kɔbiri ra, alɔ Marigi n yamari ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And Jesus was before the ruler, who put a question to him, Are you the King of the Jews? And Jesus said to him, You say so.
sentences.susu: Isa to ti gomina Pilati ya i, gomina naxa a maxɔrin, «I tan nan findixi Yuwifie xa mangɛ ra?» Isa naxa a yaabi, «I tan nan a falaxi.»

sentences.english: But when the chief priests and those in authority made statements against him, he gave no answer.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun forie nu a tɔɔɲɛgɛma tɛmui naxɛ, Isa mu yaabi yo fi.

sentences.english: Then says Pilate to him, Do you give no attention to what their witnesses say against you?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Pilati naxa a maxɔrin, «I mu yi fee mɛxi e naxan birin safe i xun ma yi ki?»

sentences.english: And he gave him no answer, not even a word: so that the ruler was greatly surprised.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa mu e xa wɔyɛnyi yo yaabi. Na naxa gomina kaaba ki fanyi.

sentences.english: Now at the feast it was the way for the ruler to let free to the people one prisoner, at their selection.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ yo ɲɛ, sali tɛmui, gomina darife nan nu a ra, a xa geelimani keren nabɛɲin ɲama bɛ, e na wa naxan yo xɔn.

sentences.english: And they had then an important prisoner, whose name was Barabbas.
sentences.susu: Na waxati, geelimani nde nu na, birin nu naxan kolon a xa ɲaaxuɲa ma. A nu xili Barabasi.

sentences.english: So when they came together, Pilate said to them, Whom will you have? Barabbas, or Jesus, who is named Christ?
sentences.susu: Ɲama to malan, Pilati naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo wama n xa nde rabɛɲin wo bɛ, Barabasi ba, ka Isa, naxan xili falama Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi?»

sentences.english: For he saw that for envy they had given him up.
sentences.susu: Pilati nu a kolon a sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nu Isa saxi a bɛlɛxɛ tɔɔnɛ nan ma.

sentences.english: And while he was on the judge's seat, his wife sent to him, saying, Have nothing to do with that upright man, for I have had much trouble this day in a dream because of him.
sentences.susu: Ba na ra, a to nu dɔxɔxi kiiti sade, a xa ginɛ naxa xɛɛra rasiga a ma, a a fala a bɛ, «I naxa so yi tinxintɔɛ xa fe kui fefe ma, barima n bara xiye sa a xa fe ra, xiye naxan bara n tɔɔrɔ to ki fanyi.»

sentences.english: Now the chief priests and those in authority got the people to make request for Barabbas, and for Jesus to be put to death.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun Yuwifie xa forie naxa ɲama kui iso e xa Barabasi maxɔrin Pilati ma, Isa tan xa faxa.

sentences.english: But the ruler made answer and said to them, Which of the two is it your pleasure that I let go free? And they said, Barabbas.
sentences.susu: Gomina man naxa e maxɔrin, «Yi mixi firin ya ma, wo wama n xa mundun nabɛɲin wo bɛ?» E naxa a yaabi, «Barabasi!»

sentences.english: Pilate says to them, What, then, am I to do with Jesus, who is named Christ? They all say, Let him be put to death on the cross.
sentences.susu: Pilati fan naxa e maxɔrin, «N xa munse raba Isa ra, naxan xili falama Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi?» Ɲama birin naxa a yaabi, «A banban wuri magalanbuxi ma!»

sentences.english: And he said, Why, what evil has he done? But they gave loud cries, saying, To the cross with him!
sentences.susu: A man naxa e maxɔrin, «Munfe ma? A fe ɲaaxi mundun nabaxi?» Kɔnɔ e tan sɔnxɔɛ nan tun xun masa, «A banban wuri ma!»

sentences.english: So when Pilate saw that he was able to do nothing, but that trouble was working up, he took water and, washing his hands before the people, said, The blood of this upright man is not on my hands: you are responsible.
sentences.susu: Pilati to a to a a mu nɔxi fefe ra, ɲama fan nu waxi kelife a ra, a naxa ye tongo, a a bɛlɛxɛ raxa e ya xɔri, a a fala e bɛ, «Yi xɛmɛ faxafe mu na n tan ma de! A luma wo tan nan ma.»

sentences.english: And all the people made answer and said, Let his blood be on us, and on our children.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa a yaabi, «A xa faxɛ wuli xa lu muxu nun muxu xa die xun ma!»

sentences.english: Then he let Barabbas go free: but after having Jesus whipped, he gave him up to be put to death on the cross.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Pilati naxa Barabasi rabɛɲin e bɛ. A naxa yaamari fi sɔɔrie xa Isa bɔnbɔ sɛbɛrɛ ra. Na xanbi, a naxa Isa so e yi e xa sa a banban wuri magalanbuxi ma.

sentences.english: Then the ruler's armed men took Jesus into the open square, and got all their band together.
sentences.susu: Rɔma sɔɔrie to Isa xanin gomina xɔnyi, e naxa e boore sɔɔrie birin xili, e gali naxa ti a rabilinyi.

sentences.english: And they took off his clothing, and put on him a red robe.
sentences.susu: E naxa Isa xa sose ba a ma, e mangɛ guba gbeeli ragoro a ma.

sentences.english: And they made a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and put a rod in his right hand, and they went down on their knees before him, and made sport of him, saying, Long life to the King of the Jews.
sentences.susu: E naxa tunbee mafilin, e e yailan mangɛ katanyi maniyɛ ra, e a sa a xun ma. E naxa wuri raso a yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛ kui, e a mayele, e nu e xinbi sin a bun ma, e nu a fala, «I kɛna, Yuwifie xa mangɛ.»

sentences.english: And they put shame on him, and gave him blows on the head with the rod.
sentences.susu: E naxa dɛye bɔxun a ma, e na wuri ba a yi, e nu a xunyi bɔnbɔ a ra.

sentences.english: And when they had made sport of him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothing on him, and took him away to put him on the cross.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ Isa mayelede, e naxa mangɛ guba rate a ma, e a gbe dugi ragoro a ma, e fa a ramini e xa sa a banban wuri magalanbuxi ma.

sentences.english: And while they were coming out, they saw a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they made him go with them, so that he might take up his cross.
sentences.susu: E to nu minife taa ra, e naxa Sirenika xɛmɛ nde to naxan nu xili Simɔn. Sɔɔrie naxa a yamari, a tan xa Isa xa wuri magalanbuxi xanin.

sentences.english: And when they came to the place named Golgotha, that is to say, Dead Man's Head,
sentences.susu: E to yire li naxan xili Gologota, na nan falaxi e xa xui, «xunkonkota yire,»

sentences.english: They gave him wine mixed with bitter drink: and after tasting it, he took no more.
sentences.susu: e naxa wɛni so a yi, seri saxi naxan xun, kɔnɔ a to a nɛmunnɛmun, a mu tin a minde.

sentences.english: And when they had put him on the cross, they made division of his clothing among them by the decision of chance.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ a mabanbande wuri ma, e naxa kanda bun a xa dugie xa fe ra, alako e xa a kolon kankan naxan sɔtɔma.

sentences.english: And they were seated there watching him.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, e naxa dɔxɔ a kantade.

sentences.english: And they put up over his head the statement of his crime in writing, THIS IS JESUS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
sentences.susu: E to nu wama birin xa a kolon e a banbanxi fe naxan ma, e yi sɛbɛli nan gbaku a xun ma, «Isa nan ya, Yuwifie xa mangɛ.»

sentences.english: Then two thieves were put on crosses with him, one on the right and one on the left.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, e naxa suute mixi firin fan banban wuri magalanbuxie ma Isa fɛ ma, keren a yirefanyi ma, boore a kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: And those who went by said bitter words to him, shaking their heads and saying,
sentences.susu: Mixie nu dangima Isa konbi ra, e nu e xunyi lintan a ma,

sentences.english: You who would give the Temple to destruction and put it up again in three days, get yourself free: if you are the Son of God, come down from the cross.
sentences.susu: e a fala, «I tan naxan hɔrɔmɔbanxi rabirama, i man fa a ti xi saxan bun ma, i yɛtɛ rakisi! Xa Ala xa Di nan i ra, goro wuri kɔn na!»

sentences.english: In the same way, the chief priests, making sport of him, with the scribes and those in authority, said,
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie, sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe, nun Yuwifie xa forie fan nu a mayelefe, e nu a fala,

sentences.english: A saviour of others, he has no salvation for himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him now come down from the cross, and we will have faith in him.
sentences.susu: «A bara mixi gbɛtɛe rakisi, kɔnɔ a mu nɔma a yɛtɛ tan nakiside. Isirayila mangɛ xa mu a ra? A xa goro wuri kɔn na be ya, alako muxu xa la a ra.

sentences.english: He put his faith in God; let God be his saviour now, if he will have him; for he said, I am the Son of God.
sentences.susu: A bara a xaxili ti Ala ra, a man fa a fala, ‹N findixi Ala xa Di nan na.› Yakɔsi, xa a rafanxi Ala ma, a xa a rakisi!»

sentences.english: And the thieves who were on the crosses said evil words to him.
sentences.susu: Suute naxee nu banbanxi a fɛ ma, e fan nu Isa konbife na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Now from the sixth hour it was dark over all the land till the ninth hour.
sentences.susu: Yanyi tagi, dimi naxa sin bɔxi birin ma lɛɛri saxan bun ma.

sentences.english: And about the ninth hour Jesus gave a loud cry, saying, Eli, Eli, lama sabachthani? that is, My God, my God, why are you turned away from me?
sentences.susu: Na waxati ma, Isa naxa gbelegbele sɛnbɛ ra, «Eloyi, Eloyi, lɛma sabaxatani?» Na nan falaxi e xa xui, «N Marigi Ala, n Marigi Ala, i n nabɛɲinxi munfe ra?»

sentences.english: And some of those who were near by, hearing it, said, This man is crying to Elijah.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee nu na naa, e to a xui mɛ, e naxa a fala, «A na Annabi Eliya nan xilife!»

sentences.english: And straight away one of them went quickly, and took a sponge, and made it full of bitter wine, and put it on a rod and gave him drink.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa a gi, a sa dunkobi rasin wɛni xɔnɛ xɔɔra, a a so wuri dɛ i, a fa a ti Isa bɛ alako a xa a min.

sentences.english: And the rest said, Let him be; let us see if Elijah will come to his help.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ booree naxa a fala, «Wo a lu, won xa a mato xa Annabi Eliya fama a rakiside.»

sentences.english: And Jesus gave another loud cry, and gave up his spirit.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a xui ite sɛnbɛ ra, a fa laaxira.

sentences.english: And the curtain of the Temple was parted in two from end to end; and there was an earth-shock; and the rocks were broken;
sentences.susu: Na waxati, dugi xungbe naxan singanxi hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, a naxa ibɔɔ firin na, keli a fuge han a laabe. Bɔxi naxa sɛrɛn, gɛmɛe naxa ibɔɔ,

sentences.english: And the resting-places of the dead came open; and the bodies of a number of sleeping saints came to life;
sentences.susu: gaburie fan naxa rabi. Sɛniyɛntɔɛ laaxiraxi gbegbe naxa keli faxɛ ma,

sentences.english: And coming out of their resting-places, after he had come again from the dead, they went into the holy town and were seen by a number of people.
sentences.susu: e mini gaburie kui. Isa to keli faxɛ ma, e so nɛ Darisalamu, taa sɛniyɛnxi kui, e fa mini mixi wuyaxi ma.

sentences.english: Now the captain and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earth-shock and the things which were done, were in great fear and said, Truly this was a son of God.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri mangɛ nun a boore sɔɔrie naxee nu Isa kantafe, e to bɔxi xa sɛrɛnyi to, a nun naxan naba Isa faxa tɛmui, e naxa gaaxu ki fanyi, e a fala, «Nɔndi nan a ra yati, Ala xa Di nan nu yi xɛmɛ ra!»

sentences.english: And a number of women were there, watching from a distance, who had come with Jesus from Galilee, waiting on his needs.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ wuyaxi fan nu na naa, e ndedi makuyaxi Isa yire ra, e yi fe birin matoma. E nu bara bira Isa fɔxɔ ra kelife Galile bɔxi ma, e nu a mali.

sentences.english: Among whom was Mary Magdalene, and Mary, the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.
sentences.susu: Mariyama Magidalaka nu na e ya ma, a nun Mariyama Yaki nun Yusufu nga, a nun Sebede xa die nga.

sentences.english: And in the evening, there came a man of wealth from Arimathaea, Joseph by name, who was a disciple of Jesus:
sentences.susu: Nunmare to so, Arimateka bannamixi nde naxa fa naxan nu xili Yusufu. Isa fɔxirabirɛ nde nan nu a fan na.

sentences.english: This man went in to Pilate, and made a request for the body of Jesus. Then Pilate gave orders for it to be given to him.
sentences.susu: A naxa siga Pilati yire, a Isa fure maxandi a ma. Pilati naxa yaamari fi e xa a so a yi ra.

sentences.english: And Joseph took the body, folding it in clean linen,
sentences.susu: Yusufu naxa Isa fure tongo, a a mafilin kasange fanyi kui,

sentences.english: And put it in the resting-place which had been cut out of the rock for himself; and after rolling a great stone to the door of it he went away.
sentences.susu: a a bɛlɛ gaburi nɛɛnɛ kui, naxan nu gexi gɛmɛ kui a tan Yusufu bɛ. A to gɛmɛ xungbe maɲindigilin, a a dɔxɔ gaburi dɛ ma, a naxa siga.

sentences.english: And Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, seated by the place of the dead.
sentences.susu: Mariyama Magidalaka nun boore Mariyama nu na naa, e dɔxɔxi gaburi ya ra.

sentences.english: Now on the day after the getting ready of the Passover, the chief priests and Pharisees came together to Pilate,
sentences.susu: Malabu lɔxɔɛ see rafala lɔxɔɛ kuye iba, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun Farisɛnie naxa siga Pilati yire.

sentences.english: Saying, Sir, we have in mind how that false man said, while he was still living, After three days I will come again from the dead.
sentences.susu: E naxa a masen a bɛ, «Mangɛ, muxu ratuxi a ma yi wule falɛ, beenun a xa faxa, a a fala nɛ, ‹Xi saxan dangi xanbi, n kelima nɛ faxɛ ma.›

sentences.english: Give orders, then, that the place where his body is may be made safe till the third day, for fear that his disciples come and take him away secretly and say to the people, He has come back from the dead: and the last error will be worse than the first.
sentences.susu: Na kui, i xa yaamari fi a xa gaburi xa makanta han a xi saxan nde, alako a fɔxirabirɛe naxa fa a fure muɲa, e fa a fala ɲama bɛ, ‹A bara keli faxɛ ma.› Xa na sa raba, wule dɔnxɔɛ dangima nɛ wule singe ra.»

sentences.english: Pilate said to them, You have watchmen; go and make it as safe as you are able.
sentences.susu: Pilati naxa e yaabi, «Awa, n bara sɔɔrie so wo yi. Wo sa gaburi makanta alɔ wo wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: So they went, and made safe the place where his body was, putting a stamp on the stone, and the watchmen were with them.
sentences.susu: E naxa siga, e sa tɔnxuma sa gɛmɛ ma naxan nu na gaburi dɛ ma, alako xa gaburi fa sa rabi, a kolonma nɛ. E naxa sɔɔrie lu naa, na kantafe ra.

sentences.english: Now late on the Sabbath, when the dawn of the first day of the week was near, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the place where his body was.
sentences.susu: Malabu lɔxɔɛ kuye iba, sande lɔxɔɛ subaxɛ ma, Mariyama Magidalaka nun boore Mariyama, e naxa siga gaburi matode.

sentences.english: And there was a great earth-shock; for an angel of the Lord came down from heaven and, rolling back the stone, took his seat on it.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, bɔxi naxa sɛrɛn sɛnbɛ ra, barima Marigi xa malekɛ nde nu bara goro keli koore, a gɛmɛ maɲindigilin, a a ba gaburi dɛ ma, a fa dɔxɔ a fari.

sentences.english: His form was shining like the light, and his clothing was white as snow:
sentences.susu: Malekɛ nu yanbama alɔ seyamakɔnyi, a xa sosee nu fiixɛ fɔɛn.

sentences.english: And for fear of him the watchmen were shaking, and became as dead men.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri naxee nu na kantafe, e naxa gaaxu han e sɛrɛn, e lu alɔ faxamixie.

sentences.english: And the angel said to the women, Have no fear: for I see that you are searching for Jesus, who was put to death on the cross.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ malekɛ naxa a masen ginɛe bɛ, «Wo naxa gaaxu, barima n a kolon wo na Isa nan fenfe, e naxan banban wuri magalanbuxi ma.

sentences.english: He is not here, for he has come to life again, even as he said. Come, see the Lord's resting-place.
sentences.susu: A mu be, a bara keli faxɛ ma, alɔ a a fala ki naxɛ. Wo fa, wo a mato a nu saxi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And go quickly and give his disciples the news that he has come back from the dead, and is going before you into Galilee; there you will see him, as I have said to you.
sentences.susu: Wo man xa siga mafuren, wo sa a masen a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, ‹A bara keli faxɛ ma. A na sigafe wo ya ra Galile. Wo a toma mɛnni nɛ.› A tan nan na ki, n bara a ragbilen wo ma.»

sentences.english: And they went away quickly, with fear and great joy, to give his disciples the news.
sentences.susu: Ginɛe naxa e xulun, e keli gaburi yire, gaaxui nun sɛɛwɛ gbegbe ra, e siga e gi ra na xibaaru masende Isa fɔxirabirɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: And on the way, Jesus came to them, saying, Be glad. And they came and put their hands on his feet, and gave him worship.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa naxa e ralan, a e xɛɛbu, «Wo mama.» E to e maso a ra, e naxa suyidi a bɛ, e a sanyie suxu.

sentences.english: Then said Jesus to them, Have no fear: go and give word to my brothers to go into Galilee, and there they will see me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo naxa gaaxu. Wo sa a fala n ngaxakerenyie bɛ e xa siga Galile. E n toma mɛnni nɛ.»

sentences.english: Now, while they were going, some of the watchmen came into the town and gave news to the chief priests of all the things which had taken place.
sentences.susu: Ginɛe nu sigafe tɛmui naxɛ, sɔɔri nde naxee nu gaburi kantafe, e naxa so taa kui. Fe naxan birin naba, e naxa sa a dɛntɛgɛ sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie bɛ.

sentences.english: And when they had come together with those in authority, and had made their decision, they gave much money to the watchmen, saying,
sentences.susu: Nee nun forie fan to e malan yire keren, e naxa natɛ tongo, e kɔbiri gbegbe fi sɔɔrie ma

sentences.english: Say, His disciples came by night and took him away secretly while we were sleeping.
sentences.susu: yi yaamari ra, «Wo xa yi nan fala, ‹Isa fɔxirabirɛe nan fa kɔɛ ra, e a fure muɲa muxu nu na xife tɛmui naxɛ.›

sentences.english: And if this comes to the ruler's ears, we will see that he does not make you responsible.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li gomina naxa yi fe mɛ, muxu sa wɔyɛnma a bɛ alako sese naxa wo to.»

sentences.english: So they took the money, and did as they had been ordered: and this account has been current among the Jews till the present time.
sentences.susu: Na kui, sɔɔrie naxa kɔbiri rasuxu, e fe birin naba alɔ a falaxi e bɛ ki naxɛ. Na masenyi naxa yensen yɛ Yuwifie tagi. Han to na fe mɛma.

sentences.english: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had given them orders to go.
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛ fu nun kerenyie naxa siga Galile bɔxi ma, e te geya fari Isa dɛnnaxan masen e bɛ.

sentences.english: And when they saw him they gave him worship: but some were in doubt.
sentences.susu: E to a to, e naxa suyidi a bɛ, kɔnɔ e man nu siikɛxi.

sentences.english: And Jesus came to them and said, All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a maso e ra, a a masen e bɛ, «Sɛnbɛ birin bara so n yi ra koore nun duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: Go then, and make disciples of all the nations, giving them baptism in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit:
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo xa siga, wo sa si birin findi n fɔxirabirɛe ra. Wo xa e xunxa ye xɔɔra Baba Ala, a xa Di, nun a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xili ra.

sentences.english: Teaching them to keep all the rules which I have given you: and see, I am ever with you, even to the end of the world.
sentences.susu: Wo xa e tinkan n ma yaamari birin nabatude. Wo a mato, n na wo fɛ ma tɛmui birin, han duniɲa raɲɔnyi.»

sentences.english: The first words of the good news of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.
sentences.susu: Inyila Isa fɔlɛ nan ya, naxan Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa fe masenma, naxan findixi Ala xa Di ra.

sentences.english: Even as it is said in the book of Isaiah the prophet, See, I send my servant before your face, who will make ready your way;
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi Annabi Esayi xa Kitaabui kui, «N fama n ma xɛɛra rasanbade i ya ra, a xa kira rabɔɔ i bɛ.

sentences.english: The voice of one crying in the waste land, Make ready the way of the Lord, make his roads straight;
sentences.susu: A a xui itema gbengberen yire, ‹Wo kira yailan Marigi bɛ, wo sankirae matinxin a ya ra.›»

sentences.english: John came, and gave baptism in the waste land, preaching baptism as a sign of forgiveness of sin for those whose hearts were changed.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Yaya Xunxa naxa to gbengberenyi ma. A nu kawandi tima mixie bɛ, e xa e xunxa ye xɔɔra tuubi ra, alako Ala xa e xa yunubie xafari.

sentences.english: And there went out to him all the people of Judaea, and all those of Jerusalem, and they were given baptism by him in the river Jordan, saying that they were sinners.
sentences.susu: Yudayakae nun Darisalamuka birin nu sigama a yire. E nu e xa yunubie masenma kɛnɛ ma, Yaya fan nu e xunxama Yurudɛn xure xɔɔra.

sentences.english: And John was clothed in camel's hair, with a leather band about him; and his food was locusts and honey.
sentences.susu: Ɲɔxɔmɛ xabe donma nan nu ragoroxi Yaya ma, bɛlɛti kiri daaxi nu xirixi a tagi. A nu baloma katoe nun wula kumi nan na.

sentences.english: And he said to them all, There is one coming after me who is greater than I, whose shoes I am not good enough to undo.
sentences.susu: A nu kawandi tima, a nu a fala, «Naxan fama fade n xanbi ra, na sɛnbɛ gbo n tan bɛ. Na binyɛ mu na n tan yi ra, n ɲan xa n felen a xa sankiri luuti yati fulunde.

sentences.english: I have given you baptism with water, but he will give you baptism with the Holy Spirit.
sentences.susu: N tan bara wo xunxa ye xɔɔra, kɔnɔ a tan Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nan nagoroma wo ma.»

sentences.english: And it came about in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was given baptism by John in the Jordan.
sentences.susu: Na waxati ma, Isa naxa fa keli Nasarɛti, Galile bɔxi ma, Yaya naxa a xunxa Yurudɛn xure xɔɔra.

sentences.english: And straight away, coming up out of the water, he saw the heavens broken open and the Spirit coming down on him as a dove:
sentences.susu: A fɛfɛ te ye xɔɔra tɛmui naxɛ, a naxa koore to rabi ra, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa goro a ma alɔ ganbɛ.

sentences.english: And a voice came out of heaven, You are my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased.
sentences.susu: Xui nde naxa mɛ keli koore ma, a a masen, «N ma Di maxanuxi nan na i ra. I n kɛnɛnxi ki fanyi ra.»

sentences.english: And straight away the Spirit sent him out into the waste land.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi Ala Xaxili naxa Isa xanin gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: And he was in the waste land for forty days, being tested by Satan; and he was with the beasts; and the angels took care of him.
sentences.susu: Xi tongo naani bun ma, a nu na gbengberen yire, Sentanɛ nu katafe a ratantande. Wula subee nu na naa. Malekɛe naxa a bun ti.

sentences.english: Now after John had been put in prison, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the good news of God,
sentences.susu: Yaya sa xanbi geeli, Isa naxa siga Galile bɔxi ma Ala xa xibaaru fanyi kawandi ra.

sentences.english: And saying, The time has come, and the kingdom of God is near: let your hearts be turned from sin and have faith in the good news.
sentences.susu: A nu a masenma, «Waxati sugandixi bara a li, Ala xa mangɛya niini bara makɔrɛ. Wo tuubi, wo la Ala xa xibaaru fanyi ra.»

sentences.english: And going by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon, and Andrew, the brother of Simon, putting a net into the sea: for they were fishermen.
sentences.susu: A to nu dangife Galile baa dɛ ra, a naxa Simɔn nun a xunya Andire to, e yɛlɛ wolife, barima yɛxɛsuxuie nan nu e ra.

sentences.english: And Jesus said to them, Come after me, and I will make you fishers of men.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo bira n fɔxɔ ra. Tɛmui dangixi, wo nu yɛxɛ nan sɔtɔma, kɔnɔ yakɔsi n a niyama wo xa nu mixie nan sɔtɔ n bɛ.»

sentences.english: And they went straight from their nets, and came after him.
sentences.susu: E naxa e xa yɛlɛe lu na keren na, e bira Isa fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And going on a little farther, he saw James, the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were in their boat stitching up their nets.
sentences.susu: E to dangi na ra dondoronti, a naxa Sebede xa di Yaki nun a xunya Yaya to, e nu na yɛlɛe madɛgɛfe e xa kunkui kui.

sentences.english: And he said, Come after me: and they went away from their father Zebedee, who was in the boat with the servants, and came after him.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e xili keren na, e fan naxa e baba Sebede nun walikɛe lu kunkui kui, e bira Isa fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And they came to Capernaum; and on the Sabbath he went into the Synagogue and gave teaching.
sentences.susu: Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛe naxa so Kapɛrɛnamu. Malabu lɔxɔɛ ma, Isa naxa so salide kui, a kawandi ti fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: And they were full of wonder at his teaching, because he gave it as one having authority, and not like the scribes.
sentences.susu: Mixie naxa kaaba a xa xaranyi ma, barima a mu nu luxi alɔ e xa sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe. A tan nu wɔyɛnma mangɛ sɛnbɛ nan na.

sentences.english: And there was in their Synagogue a man with an unclean spirit; and he gave a cry,
sentences.susu: Na waxati yati, xɛmɛ nde ɲinnɛ nu naxan fɔxɔ ra, a naxa sɔnxɔɛ rate fɔlɔ e xa salide banxi kui,

sentences.english: Saying, What have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? have you come to put an end to us? I see well who you are, the Holy One of God.
sentences.susu: «Isa Nasarɛtika, i waxi munse xɔn ma muxu bɛ? I faxi muxu sɔntɔde nɛ? N a kolon mixi naxan lanxi i ma. Ala xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ nan na i ra.»

sentences.english: And Jesus said to him sharply, Be quiet, and come out of him.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa wɔyɛn a ma a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra, «I sabari. Gbilen yi xɛmɛ fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: And the unclean spirit, shaking him violently, and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.
sentences.susu: Ɲinnɛ naxa xɛmɛ raketun a ra, a sɔnxɔ, a fa gbilen a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And they were all greatly surprised, so that they put questions to one another, saying, What is this? a new teaching! with authority he gives orders even to the unclean spirits, and they do what he says.
sentences.susu: Birin dɛ naxa ixara, e nu fa e bore maxɔrin, «Munse yi ki? Xaranyi nɛɛnɛ a nun sɛnbɛ! Hali ɲinnɛe, a e yamarima, e a xui rabatu.»

sentences.english: And news of him went out quickly everywhere into all parts of Galilee round about.
sentences.susu: A mu bu, a xili naxa din Galile bɔxi yire birin na.

sentences.english: And when they came out of the Synagogue, they went into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.
sentences.susu: E to mini salide kui, Isa nun Yaki nun Yaya naxa siga Simɔn nun Andire xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Now Simon's wife's mother was ill, with a burning heat; and they gave him word of her:
sentences.susu: Simɔn bitanyi ginɛma nu saxi, a fate wolenxi. E naxa a xa fe fala Isa bɛ keren na.

sentences.english: And he came and took her by the hand, lifting her up; and she became well, and took care of their needs.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a maso ginɛ ra, a a bɛlɛxɛ suxu, a a rakeli. Fure naxa a bɛɲin, a naxa e bun ti fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: And in the evening, at sundown, they took to him all who were diseased, and those who had evil spirits.
sentences.susu: Nunmare to so, soge naxa dula, mixie naxa fa furemae birin na a xɔn, a nun ɲinnɛe biraxi naxee fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And all the town had come together at the door.
sentences.susu: Taa birin naxa e malan naadɛ ra.

sentences.english: And a number, who were ill with different diseases, he made well, and sent out evil spirits; but he did not let the evil spirits say anything, because they had knowledge of him.
sentences.susu: A naxa furema gbegbe rayalan, fure mɔɔli wuyaxi nu naxee ma. A naxa ɲinnɛ gbegbe fan keri mixie fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ a mu tin ɲinnɛe xa wɔyɛn, barima e nu a kolon.

sentences.english: And in the morning, a long time before daylight, he got up and went out to a quiet place, and there he gave himself up to prayer.
sentences.susu: Subaxɛ ma, Isa naxa keli, a naxa mini wula i Ala maxandide.

sentences.english: And Simon and those who were with him came after him.
sentences.susu: Simɔn nun a booree ya koto naxa mɔ Isa fende.

sentences.english: And when they came up with him, they said to him, Everyone is looking for you.
sentences.susu: E to a to, e naxa a fala a bɛ, «Birin na i fenfe.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Let us go to other parts into the nearest towns, so that I may give teaching there, because for this purpose I came.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Won xɛɛ taa gbɛtɛe naxee na be rabilinyi alako n xa kawandi raba mɛnni fan, barima n faxi na nan ma.»

sentences.english: And he went into their Synagogues in every part of Galilee, preaching and driving out evil spirits.
sentences.susu: A naxa siga Galile bɔxi birin ma, a nu kawandi ti e xa salide banxie kui, a nu ɲinnɛe fan keri mixie fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And a leper came to him and, going down on his knees before him, made a request, saying, If it is your pleasure, you have the power to make me clean.
sentences.susu: Kunɛ kanyi nde naxa fa Isa yire, a a xinbi sin a bun ma, a a mayandi, «Xa i tin, i nɔma n nasɛniyɛnde.»

sentences.english: And being moved with pity, he put out his hand, and touching him said to him, It is my pleasure; be made clean.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa kinikini a ma. A naxa a bɛlɛxɛ itala, a a sa kunɛ kanyi ma, a a fala a bɛ, «N tinxi. I xa sɛniyɛn.»

sentences.english: And straight away the disease went from him, and he was made clean.
sentences.susu: Kunɛ fure naxa ba xɛmɛ ma keren na, a naxa sɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: And he sent him away, saying to him very sharply,
sentences.susu: Isa to a ragbilen, a naxa a matintin a ra

sentences.english: See that you say nothing to any man: but go and let the priest see you, and make yourself clean by an offering of the things ordered by Moses, for a witness to them.
sentences.susu: yi masenyi ra, «I naxa yi fe fala mixi yo bɛ. Siga i sa i yɛtɛ dɛntɛgɛ sɛrɛxɛdubɛ bɛ, i sɛrɛxɛ ba i xa sɛniyɛnyi xa fe ra, alɔ Annabi Munsa a yamarixi ki naxɛ. Na findima seedeɲɔxɔya nan na e bɛ.»

sentences.english: But he went out, and made it public, giving an account of it everywhere, so that Jesus was no longer able to go openly into a town, but was outside in the waste land; and they came to him from every part.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xɛmɛ to siga, a naxa so yi fe tagi rabafe birin bɛ, a nu a xibaaru rayensen yɛ. Na naxa a niya Isa mu nɔ sode taa kui sɔnɔn kɛnɛ ma. Fo a to nu sa luma taa fari ma mixi yo mu sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ. Mixie fan nu kelima yire birin fafe ra a yire.

sentences.english: And when he came into Capernaum again after some days, the news went about that he was in the house.
sentences.susu: Xi ndee to dangi, Isa man naxa gbilen Kapɛrɛnamu, mixie fa a mɛ a a na banxi.

sentences.english: And a great number had come together, so that there was no longer room for them, no, not even about the door: and he gave them teaching.
sentences.susu: Ɲama gbegbe naxa fa a yire, banxi kui naxa rafe, tide naxa ɲɔn tande birin ma. Isa naxa e kawandi Ala xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: And four men came to him with one on a bed who had no power of moving.
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee naxa fa namatɛ ra Isa xɔn. Xɛmɛ naani nan nu a xaninfe.

sentences.english: And when they were unable to get near him because of all the people, they got the roof uncovered where he was: and when it was broken up, they let down the bed on which the man was.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ ɲama to nu gbo, e mu nu nɔma e makɔrɛde Isa ra. Na kui, e naxa banxi fari yire nde maba Isa yailanyi. E naxa namatɛ ragoro mɛnni ra a xa sade fari.

sentences.english: And Jesus, seeing their faith, said to him, Son, you have forgiveness for your sins.
sentences.susu: Isa to e xa danxaniya to, a naxa a fala namatɛ bɛ, «N ma di, i xa yunubie bara xafari.»

sentences.english: But there were certain of the scribes seated there, and reasoning in their hearts,
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ ndee nu dɔxɔxi naa, e naxa e xaxili raɲɛrɛ,

sentences.english: Why does this man say such things? he has no respect for God: from whom does forgiveness come but from God only?
sentences.susu: «Yi wɔyɛnma yi mɔɔli ra munfe ra? A na Ala rasɔtɔfe nɛ yi ki! Nde nɔma yunubie xafaride, bafe Ala keren na?»

sentences.english: And Jesus, having knowledge in his spirit of their thoughts, said to them, Why are you reasoning about these things in your hearts?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e xa maɲɔxunyi kolon a xaxili ma keren na. A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Munfe ra yi maɲɔxunyi mɔɔli na wo bɔɲɛ ma?

sentences.english: Which is the simpler, to say to a man who is ill, You have forgiveness for your sins, or, Get up, take up your bed, and go?
sentences.susu: Wɔyɛnyi mundun sɔɔnɛya, a falafe yi namatɛ bɛ, ‹I xa yunubie bara xafari,› ka a falafe a bɛ, ‹Keli, i xa sade tongo, i ɲɛrɛ›?

sentences.english: But so that you may see that the Son of man has authority for the forgiveness of sins on earth, (he said to the man,)
sentences.susu: N xa a masen wo bɛ a Adama xa Di nɔma yunubi xafaride duniɲa ma.» Isa naxa a masen namatɛ bɛ,

sentences.english: I say to you, Get up, take up your bed, and go to your house.
sentences.susu: «N naxɛ i bɛ, keli, i i xa sade tongo, i siga i xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: And he got up, and straight away took up the bed and went out before them all, so that they were all full of wonder, and gave glory to God, saying, We have never seen anything like this.
sentences.susu: A naxa keli keren na, a a xa sade tongo, a mini birin ya xɔri. Ɲama birin dɛ naxa ixara, e nu fa Ala matɔxɔ, «Han to muxu singe mu nu yi ɲɔndɔn to.»

sentences.english: And he went out again by the seaside; and all the people came to him, and he gave them teaching.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa goro baa dɛ ra. Ɲama birin naxa fa a yire, a nu e kawandi.

sentences.english: And when he went by, he saw Levi, the son of Alphaeus, seated at the place where taxes were taken, and he said to him, Come with me. And he got up, and went with him.
sentences.susu: A to nu dangife, a naxa Alifa xa di Lewi to, a dɔxɔxi duuti maxilide. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «Bira n fɔxɔ ra.» Lewi naxa keli, a bira a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And it came about that he was seated at meat in his house, and a number of tax-farmers and sinners were at table with Jesus and his disciples: for there were a great number of them, and they came after him.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ nde Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛe nu na e dɛgefe Lewi xɔnyi. Duuti maxilie nun yunubitɔɛ gbegbe fan nu na, e birin nu e dɛgefe yire keren, barima na mixi mɔɔli wuyaxi nu bara bira Isa fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And the scribes of the Pharisees, when they saw that he was taking food with the tax-farmers and sinners, said to his disciples, Why does he take food and drink with such men?
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ naxee nu na Farisɛnie ya ma, e to Isa to a dɛge ra e nun duuti maxilie nun yunubitɔɛe, e naxa a fɔxirabirɛe maxɔrin, «Munfe ra Isa nun duuti maxilie nun yunubitɔɛe e dɛgema yire keren?»

sentences.english: And Jesus, hearing it, said to them, Those who are well have no need of a medical man, but those who are ill: I have come not to get the upright but sinners.
sentences.susu: Isa to na mɛ, a naxa e yaabi, «Mixi yalanxi hayi mu na seriba ma. Furema nan hayi na a ma. N mu faxi tinxintɔɛe xa xilide. N faxi yunubitɔɛe nan xilide.»

sentences.english: And John's disciples and the Pharisees were taking no food: and they came and said to him, Why do John's disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees go without food, but your disciples do not?
sentences.susu: Annabi Yaya fɔxirabirɛe nun Farisɛnie to nu na sunyi, mixie naxa fa Isa maxɔrinde, «Munfe ra Yaya fɔxirabirɛe nun Farisɛnie fɔxirabirɛe sunyi suxuma, kɔnɔ i gbee tan mu sunma?»

sentences.english: And Jesus said to them, Will the friends of a newly-married man go without food while he is with them? as long as they have him with them they will not go without food.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Ginɛfenyi xa futixiri xulunyi, a booree nɔma sunyi suxude a na e fɛ ma tɛmui naxɛ? Xa e nun ginɛfenyi na a ra, e mu nɔma sunde.

sentences.english: But the days will come when the husband will be taken away from them, and then they will go without food.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ fama, ginɛfenyi bama nɛ e ya ma. Na waxati tan, e sunyi suxuma nɛ.

sentences.english: No man puts a bit of new cloth on an old coat: or the new, by pulling away from the old, makes a worse hole.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu dugi fori lonpoma dugi nɛɛnɛ ra, xa na mu a ra na dugi nɛɛnɛ xuntunyi dugi fori ibɛndunma, dugi ibɔɔ dangi a singe ra.

sentences.english: And no man puts new wine into old wine-skins: or the skins will be burst by the wine, and the wine and the skins will be wasted: but new wine has to be put into new wine-skins.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo man mu wɛni nɛɛnɛ sama lɛbɛ fori kui, xa na mu a ra na wɛni nɛɛnɛ na funtu, wɛni lɛbɛ fori bulama nɛ. Na kui, wɛni yo, lɛbɛ yo, a kanyi ganma nɛ e birin na. A lan nɛ wɛni nɛɛnɛ xa sa lɛbɛ nɛɛnɛ nan kui.»

sentences.english: And it came about that on the Sabbath day he was going through the grain-fields; and while they were walking, his disciples took the heads of grain.
sentences.susu: Malabu lɔxɔ nde, Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛe nu ɲɛrɛfe sankira ma xɛe tagi. E to nu dangife, a fɔxirabirɛe naxa mɛngi tɔnsɔɛ nde ba fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: And the Pharisees said to him, Why are they doing what it is not right to do on the Sabbath?
sentences.susu: Na kui, Farisɛnie naxa wɔyɛn Isa bɛ, «Munfe ra e na malabu lɔxɔɛ sɛriyɛ matandife?»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Have you no knowledge of what David did, when he had need and was without food, he, and those who were with him?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Wo mu nu a xaran Dawuda naxan naba kaamɛ to a suxu, a tan nun naxee nu na a fɔxɔ ra?

sentences.english: How he went into the house of God when Abiathar was high priest, and took for food the holy bread, which only the priests may take, and gave it to those who were with him?
sentences.susu: A so nɛ Ala xa banxi kui, Abiyatari nu findixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi ra tɛmui naxɛ, a taami don naxan fixi Ala ma, a nde so a fɔxirabirɛe fan yi ra, hali a to mu nu daxa mixi yo xa na don, fo sɛrɛxɛdubɛe.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, The Sabbath was made for man, and not man for the Sabbath;
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a masen e bɛ, «Malabu lɔxɔɛ na mixi nan bɛ, mixi xa mu daaxi malabu lɔxɔɛ bɛ.

sentences.english: So that the Son of man is lord even of the Sabbath.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Adama xa Di findixi Marigi nan na hali malabu lɔxɔɛ xun ma.»

sentences.english: And he went again into the Synagogue; and there was a man there whose hand was dead.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa so salide kui. A naxa xɛmɛ nde li naa, naxan bɛlɛxɛ tuuxi a ma.

sentences.english: And they were watching him to see if he would make him well on the Sabbath day, so that they might have something against him.
sentences.susu: Farisɛnie nu e ya tixi Isa ra e xa a mato xa a a rayalanma malabu lɔxɔɛ ma, alako e xa nɔ a kalamude fe nde ma.

sentences.english: And he said to the man, Get up and come forward.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala xɛmɛ bɛ naxan bɛlɛxɛ tuuxi a ma, «Keli, i fa ti be, ɲama tagi.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Is it right to do good on the Sabbath or to do evil? to give life or to put to death? But they said nothing.
sentences.susu: A naxa e maxɔrin, «A daxa fe fanyi nan xa raba malabu lɔxɔɛ, ka fe ɲaaxi? Nii rakisife nan daxa ka nii sɔntɔfe?» Kɔnɔ mixi yo mu a yaabi.

sentences.english: And looking round on them he was angry, being sad because of their hard hearts; and he said to the man, Put out your hand. And he put it out, and his hand was made well.
sentences.susu: Isa xɔnɔxi naxa e mato, a bɔɲɛ tɔɔrɔxi ki fanyi barima kinikinitare nan nu e ra. A naxa a fala xɛmɛ bɛ naxan bɛlɛxɛ tuuxi a ma, «I bɛlɛxɛ itala.» A naxa a itala, a bɛlɛxɛ naxa yalan.

sentences.english: And the Pharisees went out, and straight away made designs with the Herodians about how they might put him to death.
sentences.susu: Farisɛnie naxa mini keren na, e tan nun Herode fɔxirabirɛe naxa sa malanyi raba Isa xili ma. E naxa kira fen fɔlɔ Isa faxafe ma.

sentences.english: And Jesus went away with his disciples to the sea, and a great number from Galilee came after him: and from Judaea,
sentences.susu: Isa naxa keli naa e nun a fɔxirabirɛe, e naxa siga baa dɛ ra. Ɲama gbegbe naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra kelife Galile, Yudaya,

sentences.english: And from Jerusalem, and from Idumaea, and the other side of Jordan, and the country about Tyre and Sidon, a great number, hearing what great things he did, came to him.
sentences.susu: Darisalamu, Idumeya, Yurudɛn naakiri, a nun Tire nun Sidɔn nabilinyie. Ɲama nu bara a mɛ Isa nu na fee naxee rabafe. Na nan a to e gbegbe naxa fa a yire.

sentences.english: And he made a request to his disciples to have a little boat ready for him, so that he might not be crushed by the people;
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, e xa kunkui nde xiri a bɛ baa dɛ ra, alako ɲama naxa fa a xɛtɛn.

sentences.english: For he had made such a great number well that all those who were diseased were falling down before him for the purpose of touching him.
sentences.susu: Barima a to nu bara mixi gbegbe rayalan, furemae birin nu katama e xa e bɛlɛxɛ din a ra.

sentences.english: And the unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, went down before him, crying out, and saying, You are the Son of God.
sentences.susu: Ɲinnɛe nɛfɛ Isa to, e nu birama a bun ma, e nu gbelegbele, «Ala xa Di nan na i ra.»

sentences.english: And he gave them special orders not to say who he was.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa naxa tɔnyi dɔxɔ e ma e naxa mixie rakolon a xa fe ma.

sentences.english: And he went up into the mountain, and sent for those whom it was his pleasure to have with him: and they went to him.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Isa naxa te geya fari. A naxa mixie xili a waxi naxee xɔn, e fan naxa fa a fɛ ma.

sentences.english: And he took twelve to be with him, so that he might send them out as preachers,
sentences.susu: A naxa fɔxirabirɛ fu nun firin sugandi, alako e xa lu a sɛɛti ma, a man xa e xɛɛ kawandi rabade,

sentences.english: And give them the power of driving out evil spirits:
sentences.susu: a man xa sɛnbɛ fi e ma ɲinnɛ kerife ra mixie fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: To Simon he gave the second name of Peter;
sentences.susu: A mixi fu nun firin nan sugandi: Simɔn, a naxan xili sa Piyɛri,

sentences.english: And to James, the son of Zebedee, and John, the brother of James, he gave the second name of Boanerges, which is, Sons of thunder:
sentences.susu: Yaki, Sebede xa di, nun Yaya, Yaki xunya, (a naxa yi firinyie fan xili sa Bowanerige, na nan falaxi «sesarinyi xa die»),

sentences.english: And Andrew, and Philip, and Bartholomew, and Matthew, and Thomas, and James, the son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus, and Simon the Zealot;
sentences.susu: Andire, Filipu, Barotolome, Matiyu, Tomasi, Alifa xa di Yaki, Tadayo, Simɔn Kanaanka,

sentences.english: And Judas Iscariot, who was false to him.
sentences.susu: nun Yudasi Isikariyoti naxan Isa yanfa, a a sa mixi kobie bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And he went into a house. And the people came together again, so that they were not even able to take bread.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, e naxa gbilen banxi, kɔnɔ ɲama man naxa e malan e yire. E ɲan mu nɔ e dɛgede.

sentences.english: And when his friends had news of it, they went out to get him, saying, He is off his head.
sentences.susu: Isa xa mixie to a mɛ, e naxa siga a fɔxɔ ra, barima e nu a falafe, «A bara daxu.»

sentences.english: And the scribes who came down from Jerusalem, said, He has Beelzebub, and, By the ruler of evil spirits he sends evil spirits out of men.
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ naxee keli Darisalamu, nee fan nu a falafe, «A ɲinnɛe kerima ɲinnɛ mangɛ Bɛlɛsɛbulu nan saabui ra.»

sentences.english: And turning to them, he said to them in the form of a story, How is it possible for Satan to put out Satan?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e xili, a taali sa e bɛ, «Sentanɛ nɔma Sentanɛ keride?

sentences.english: If there is division in a kingdom, that kingdom will come to destruction;
sentences.susu: Xa ɲamanɛ a yɛtɛ gere lantareya kui, na ɲamanɛ mu xanma.

sentences.english: And if there is division in a house, that house will come to destruction;
sentences.susu: Xa denbaya fan a yɛtɛ gere lantareya kui, na denbaya mu xanma.

sentences.english: And if Satan is at war with himself, and there is division in him, he will not keep his place but will come to an end.
sentences.susu: Sentanɛ fan, xa a a yɛtɛ gere lantareya kui, a xa fe bara ɲɔn, a a yɛtɛ kanama nɛ.

sentences.english: But no one is able to go into the house of the strong man and take his goods, without first putting cords round the strong man, and then he will take his goods.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon, mixi yo mu nɔma sode sɛnbɛma xa banxi kui, a a harige ba a yi ra, xa a mu a xiri sinden. Na tɛmui, a nɔma nɛ a harige birin muɲade.»

sentences.english: Truly, I say to you, The sons of men will have forgiveness for all their sins and for all the evil words they say:
sentences.susu: «N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, Ala diɲɛma nɛ adamadie xa yunubi nun marasɔtɔɛ birin ma,

sentences.english: But whoever says evil things against the Holy Spirit will never have forgiveness, but the evil he has done will be with him for ever:
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ mixi naxan Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi rasɔtɔma, na yunubi tan mu nɔma xafaride na kanyi bɛ abadan.»

sentences.english: Because they said, He has an unclean spirit.
sentences.susu: Isa yi fe birin masen nɛ e bɛ, barima e nu a falafe nɛ, «Ɲinnɛ kanyi na a ra.»

sentences.english: And his mother and brothers came and were outside, and sent for him, requesting to see him.
sentences.susu: Isa nga nun a xunya xɛmɛmae naxa fa, e ti tande, e mixi xɛɛ Isa xilide.

sentences.english: And a great number were seated round him; and they said to him, See, your mother and your brothers are outside looking for you.
sentences.susu: Ɲama nu dɔxɔxi Isa rabilinyi. E naxa a fala a bɛ, «I nga nun i xunyae na tande, e wama wo xa dɛ masara.»

sentences.english: And he said in answer, Who are my mother and my brothers?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Nde findixi n nga nun n xunyae ra?»

sentences.english: And looking round at those who were seated about him, he said, See, my mother and my brothers!
sentences.susu: A naxa a ya rage mixie tagi naxee nu dɔxɔxi a rabilinyi, a fa a masen, «A mato, n nga nun n xunyae nan ya.

sentences.english: Whoever does God's pleasure, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo naxan Ala waxɔnfe rabama, na kanyi nan findixi n xunya xɛmɛma, n maaginɛ, nun n nga ra.»

sentences.english: And again he was teaching by the seaside. And a very great number of people had come to him, so that he got into a boat on the sea and took his seat; and all the people were on the land by the seaside.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa kawandi ti fɔlɔ baa dɛ ra. Ɲama gbegbe to e malan, a naxa sa dɔxɔ kunkui kui, ɲama naxa lu baa dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And he gave them teaching about a number of things in the form of stories, and said to them in his teaching, Give ear:
sentences.susu: A naxa fe wuyaxi masen e bɛ taalie ra. A xa kawandi kui, a naxa a masen e bɛ,

sentences.english: A man went out to put seed in the earth:
sentences.susu: «Wo wo tuli mati. Xɛ rawali nde nan mini sansi xɔri garansande.

sentences.english: And while he was doing it, some was dropped by the wayside, and the birds came and took it for food.
sentences.susu: A to nu sansi xɔri garansanma, xɔri ndee naxa bira sankira xɔn, xɔnie naxa fa, e e don gbiki.

sentences.english: And some went on the stones, where it had not much earth; and it came up straight away, because the earth was not deep:
sentences.susu: Xɔri ndee fan naxa bira gɛmɛ yire, bɛndɛ mu gbo dɛnnaxɛ. Nee naxa bula mafuren na, barima na bɛndɛ mu tilin.

sentences.english: And when the sun was high, it was burned; and because it had no root, it became dry and dead.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ soge to xɔnɔ, na sansie naxa ragan, e xara gben, barima sanke mu nu na e bɛ.

sentences.english: And some went among the thorns, and the thorns came up, and it had no room for growth and gave no fruit.
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri ndee fan naxa bira tunbe kunsie tagi. Tunbe kunsie naxa gbo, e sansie ixɛtɛn, e e kana, e mu bogi yo ramini.

sentences.english: And some, falling on good earth, gave fruit, coming up and increasing, and giving thirty, sixty, and a hundred times as much.
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri ndee fan naxa bira bɛndɛ fanyi ma. Na xɔrie tan, e keren keren birin sansie naxa tɔnsɔɛ ramini, ndee naxa xɔri tongo saxan namini, ndee xɔri tongo senni, ndee xɔri kɛmɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Whoever has ears, let him give ear.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, a naxa a masen, «Xa wo tuli fe mɛma, wo wo tuli mati yi masenyi ra.»

sentences.english: And when he was by himself, those who were round him with the twelve put questions to him about the purpose of the stories.
sentences.susu: Isa to lu a xati ma, a fɔxirabirɛ fu nun firinyie a nun naxee nu na a rabilinyi, e naxa a maxɔrin a xa taalie ma.

sentences.english: And he said to them, To you is given the secret of the kingdom of God, but to those who are outside, all things are given in the form of stories;
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen e bɛ, «Ala bara fahaamui fi wo ma wo xa a xa mangɛya niini gundo kolon, kɔnɔ mixi gbɛtɛe tan fe birin mɛma taali wɔyɛnyie nan na,

sentences.english: So that seeing they may see, and it will not be clear to them; and hearing it, they will not get the sense; for fear that they may be turned again to me and have forgiveness.
sentences.susu: alako ‹E xa fe to a fanyi ra, kɔnɔ e naxa a igbɛ. E xa fe mɛ a fanyi ra, kɔnɔ e naxa a fahaamu. Na rabaxi nɛ alako e naxa fa e ya rafindi Ala ma, Ala fa diɲɛ e ma.›»

sentences.english: And he said to them, If you are not clear about this story, how will you be clear about the others?
sentences.susu: A naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo to mu fa yi taali kui kolonxi, wo taali gbɛtɛe kolonma di?

sentences.english: The seed is the word.
sentences.susu: Xɛ rawali naxan sansi xɔri garansanma, a maniya mixi ra naxan Ala xa masenyi kawandima.

sentences.english: And these are they by the wayside, where the word is planted; and when they have given ear, the Evil One comes straight away and takes away the word which has been planted in them.
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee maniyaxi na sansi xɔrie ra naxee bira kira xɔn. E nɛfɛ Ala xa masenyi mɛ, Sentanɛ a ba e xaxili ma.

sentences.english: And in the same way, these are they who are planted on the stones, who, when the word has come to their ears, straight away take it with joy;
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri naxee bira gɛmɛ yire, nee misaalixi mixie nan na naxee Ala xa masenyi mɛma, e a suxu mafuren sɛɛwɛ ra.

sentences.english: And they have no root in themselves, but go on for a time; then, when trouble comes or pain, because of the word, they quickly become full of doubts.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ sanke to mu na e bɛ, e xa danxaniya mu buma. Tɔɔrɛ nun ɲaxankatɛ na e li Ala xa masenyi xa fe ra, e gbilenma nɛ Ala xa fe fɔxɔ ra keren na.

sentences.english: And others are those planted among the thorns; these are they who have given ear to the word,
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri naxee bira tunbe kunsie tagi, nee misaalixi mixie nan na naxee Ala xa masenyi mɛma,

sentences.english: And the cares of this life, and the deceits of wealth, and the desire for other things coming in, put a stop to the growth of the word, and it gives no fruit.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ yi duniɲa kɔntɔfili, nun naafuli xɔli, nun fe gbɛtɛe xɔli nan e suxuma han e Ala xa masenyi bɛɲin. Na kui, Ala xa masenyi mu nɔma e bɔɲɛ masarade.

sentences.english: And these are they who were planted on the good earth; such as give ear to the word, and take it into their hearts, and give fruit, thirty and sixty and a hundred times as much.
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri naxee bira bɛndɛ fanyi tan ma, nee misaalixi mixie nan na naxee Ala xa masenyi mɛma, e man a suxu, a e bɔɲɛ masara. Xɔri keren bogi tongo saxan naminima, ndee bogi tongo senni, gbɛtɛe fan bogi kɛmɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, When the light comes in, do people put it under a vessel, or under the bed, and not on its table?
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a masen e bɛ, «Lanpui nɔma dɔxɔde debe bun ma, xa na mu sade bun ma? A mu dɔxɔma lanpui dɔxɔse xa fari?

sentences.english: There is nothing covered which will not be seen openly, and nothing has been made secret which will not come to light.
sentences.susu: Barima se naxan birin nɔxunxi, fo a birin xa makɛnɛn. Se naxan birin findixi gundo ra, fo a birin xa sa kɛnɛ ma.

sentences.english: If any man has ears, let him give ear.
sentences.susu: Xa wo tuli fe mɛma, wo wo tuli mati yi masenyi ra.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Take care what you give ear to: in the same measure as you give you will get, and more will be given to you.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo wo ɲɔxɔ sa n ma masenyi xɔn. Wo maniyase naxan nawalima booree bɛ, na nan nawalima wo fan bɛ, Ala man nde sa a xun.

sentences.english: He who has, to him will be given: and he who has not, from him will be taken even that which he has.
sentences.susu: Fahaamui kanyi xa fahaamui xun masama, kɔnɔ fahaamutare, hali a naxan di maɲɔxunxi a gbe ra, na fama bade a yi ra.»

sentences.english: And he said, Such is the kingdom of God, as if a man put seed in the earth,
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a masen, «Ala xa mangɛya maniyaxi xɛmɛ nan na naxan sansi xɔri garansanma xɛ ma.

sentences.english: And went to sleep and got up, night and day, and the seed came to growth, though he had no idea how.
sentences.susu: Xa a xife, xa a mu xife, kɔɛ nun yanyi, sansi bulama nɛ, a te, kɔnɔ a tan mu a kolon na rabama kiyoki.

sentences.english: The earth gives fruit by herself; first the leaf, then the head, then the full grain.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi nan sansi ramɔma a yɛtɛ ma. A bulama nɛ sinden, a te, a tɔnsɔɛ mini, a xɔri fa rafe.

sentences.english: But when the grain is ready, he quickly sends men to get it cut, because the time for cutting has come.
sentences.susu: A nɛfɛ mɔ, a kanyi a xabama nɛ, barima a xaba tɛmui bara a li.»

sentences.english: And he said, What picture may we give of the kingdom of God, or with what story may we make it clear?
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a masen, «Won nɔma Ala xa mangɛya misaalide munse ra? Won nɔma a xa fe masende taali wɔyɛnyi mundun na?

sentences.english: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is put in the earth, is smaller than all the seeds on the earth,
sentences.susu: A maniyaxi konde xɔri nan na. A nɛ sima bɔxi tɛmui naxɛ, a xɔri xurun bɔxi sansi birin bɛ,

sentences.english: But when it is planted, it comes up, and becomes taller than all the plants, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of heaven are able to take rest in its shade.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ xa a bara bula, a findi a ra, a bili nun a salonyie gboma dangife sansi birin na, xɔnie nu fa e tɛɛ sa a kɔn na, niini bun ma.»

sentences.english: And with a number of such stories he gave them his teaching, as they were able to take it:
sentences.susu: A nu mixie kawandima yi taali wɔyɛnyi mɔɔli gbegbe nan na e xaxili bɛrɛ ra.

sentences.english: And without a story he said nothing to them: but privately to his disciples he made all things clear.
sentences.susu: A ɲan mu nu masenyi yo tima e bɛ xa taali daaxi xa ma ra. Kɔnɔ xa e nun a fɔxirabirɛe doro bara lu a ra, a nu a birin tagi rabama nɛ e bɛ.

sentences.english: And on that day, when the evening had come, he said to them, Let us go over to the other side.
sentences.susu: Nunmare to so na lɔxɔɛ kerenyi, Isa naxa a fala a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, «Won xɛɛ naakiri ma.»

sentences.english: And going away from the people, they took him with them, as he was, in the boat. And other boats were with him.
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛe naxa keli ɲama xun, e Isa xanin kunkui kui a nu naxan kui. E naxa kunkui gbɛtɛe fan xanin.

sentences.english: And a great storm of wind came up, and the waves came into the boat, so that the boat was now becoming full.
sentences.susu: Foye belebele naxa keli baa ma, mɔrɔnyi nu fa sa kunkui kui.

sentences.english: And he himself was in the back of the boat, sleeping on the cushion: and they, awaking him, said, Master, is it nothing to you that we are in danger of destruction?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa tan nu na xife kunkui xɔrɛ ra, a xunyi saxi xunsase ma. A fɔxirabirɛe naxa fa a raxunu, e a fala a bɛ, «Karamɔxɔ, i mu kɔntɔfilixi won faxafe ra?»

sentences.english: And he came out of his sleep, and gave strong orders to the wind, and said to the sea, Peace, be at rest. And the wind went down, and there was a great calm.
sentences.susu: Isa to xunu, a naxa xaaɲɛ foye ma, a fa baa yamari, «Dundu! I raxara!» Foye naxa iti, baa naxa raxara yen!

sentences.english: And he said to them, Why are you full of fear? have you still no faith?
sentences.susu: Isa fa e maxɔrin, «Wo gaaxuxi munfe ra? Han ya danxaniya mu na wo bɛ?»

sentences.english: And their fear was great, and they said one to another, Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea do his orders?
sentences.susu: E fan naxa gaaxu ki fanyi, e nu a fala e bore bɛ, «Nde lanxi yi ma? Hali foye nun baa, e a xui rabatuma.»

sentences.english: And they came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gerasenes.
sentences.susu: Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛe naxa fa naakiri ma, Gadara bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And when he had got out of the boat, straight away there came to him from the place of the dead a man with an unclean spirit.
