sentences.susu: Isa to goro kunkui kui, xɛmɛ nde naxa fa a ralande, ɲinnɛ nu naxan fɔxɔ ra. A nu kelixi gaburie yire,

sentences.english: He was living in the place of the dead: and no man was able to keep him down, no, not with a chain;
sentences.susu: barima a nu sabatixi mɛnni nɛ. Mixi yo mu nu nɔma a xiride sɔnɔn, hali yɔlɔnxɔnyi ra.

sentences.english: Because he had frequently been prisoned in chains and iron bands, and the chains had been parted and the bands broken by him: and no man was strong enough to make him quiet.
sentences.susu: Sanya wuyaxi, e nu bara wure balan a sanyie ma, e yɔlɔnxɔnyi balan a bɛlɛxɛe fan ma. Kɔnɔ a nu yɔlɔnxɔnyie bolonma nɛ, a wuree fan birin igira. Mixi yo mu nu na naa naxan nɔma a ra.

sentences.english: And all the time, by day and by night, in the place of the dead, and in the mountains, he was crying out and cutting himself with stones.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ nun yanyi a nu na gaburie yire nɛ, a nun geyae fari. A nu gbelegbelema, a nu a yɛtɛ maxɔnɔ gɛmɛ ra.

sentences.english: And when he saw Jesus from far off, he went quickly to him and gave him worship;
sentences.susu: A to Isa to keli yire makuye, a naxa a gi, a sa suyidi a bɛ.

sentences.english: And crying out with a loud voice he said, What have I to do with you, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? In God's name, do not be cruel to me.
sentences.susu: A naxa gbelegbele, «Isa, i tan Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi xa Di, i wama munse xɔn ma n bɛ? N bara i mayandi Ala xa fe ra, i naxa n ɲaxankata.»

sentences.english: For Jesus had said to him, Come out of the man, you unclean spirit.
sentences.susu: Isa nu bara a yamari, «I tan ɲinnɛ, gbilen yi xɛmɛ fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: And Jesus said, What is your name? And he made answer, My name is Legion, because there are a great number of us.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a maxɔrin, «I xili di?» A naxa a yaabi, «N xili nɛ Gali, barima muxu gali nan a ra.»

sentences.english: And he made strong prayers to him not to send them away out of the country.
sentences.susu: A naxa Isa mayandi ki fanyi, a a naxa e keri na bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Now on the mountain side there was a great herd of pigs getting their food.
sentences.susu: Xɔsɛ gali nu na e dɛmadonfe geya nde ma.

sentences.english: And they said to him, Send us into the pigs, so that we may go into them.
sentences.susu: Ɲinnɛe naxa Isa mayandi, «Muxu raso yi xɔsɛe alako muxu xa lu e fate.»

sentences.english: And he let them do it. And the unclean spirits came out and went into the pigs; and the herd went rushing down a sharp slope into the sea, about two thousand of them; and they came to their death in the sea.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa tin. Ɲinnɛe naxa gbilen na xɛmɛ fɔxɔ ra, e so xɔsɛe. Xɔsɛe naxa goro e gi ra tentenyi ra, e sin baa ma. E wulu firin nan nu a ra. E birin naxa madula, e faxa.

sentences.english: And their keepers went running and gave an account of it in the town and in the country. And people came to see what had taken place.
sentences.susu: Naxee nu na xɔsɛe dɛmadonfe, e naxa e gi. E naxa sa na fe fala taakae nun daaxakae bɛ, mixie fan naxa siga na fe matode.

sentences.english: And they came to Jesus, and saw the man in whom had been the evil spirits seated, clothed and with full use of his senses, and they were full of fear.
sentences.susu: E to Isa yire li, e naxa na xɛmɛ to ɲinnɛ gali nu naxan fɔxɔ ra, a dɔxɔxi, sose ragoroxi a ma, a bara xaxili sɔtɔ. Na naxa e gaaxu.

sentences.english: And those who had seen it gave them an account of what had been done to him who had the evil spirits, and of the fate of the pigs.
sentences.susu: Naxee nu bara a to Isa ɲinnɛe kerixi xɛmɛ fɔxɔ ra ki naxɛ, a nun naxan naba xɔsɛe ra, e naxa a tagi raba e birin bɛ.

sentences.english: And they made a request to him to go out of their country.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, naakae naxa so Isa mayandife alako a xa keli e xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And when he was getting into the boat, the man in whom had been the evil spirits had a great desire to come with him.
sentences.susu: Isa to nu bakife kunkui kui, ɲinnɛe nu xɛmɛ naxan fɔxɔ ra, a naxa Isa mayandi a e birin xa lu a ra.

sentences.english: And he would not let him, but said to him, Go to your house, to your friends, and give them news of the great things the Lord has done for you, and how he had mercy on you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa mu tin, a a fala a bɛ, «Gbilen i xɔnyi, i xa mixie yire. Sa dɛntɛgɛ sa e bɛ, Marigi fe naxan birin nabaxi i bɛ, a nun a kinikinixi i ma ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And he went on his way, and made public in the country of Decapolis what great things Jesus had done for him: and all men were full of wonder.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ naxa siga, a sa na bɔxi isa fɔlɔ, naxan xili Taa Fu. Isa naxan birin nabaxi a bɛ, a naxa a tagi raba naakae bɛ, birin naxa kaaba.

sentences.english: And when Jesus had gone over again in the boat to the other side, a great number of people came to him: and he was by the sea.
sentences.susu: Isa man to giri naakiri ma kunkui kui, ɲama gbegbe naxa e malan a yire baa dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And one of the rulers of the Synagogue, Jairus by name, came, and seeing him, went down at his feet,
sentences.susu: Salide yarerati nde naxa fa a xɔn naxan xili Yayiru. A to Isa to, a naxa suyidi a bɛ.

sentences.english: And made strong prayers to him, saying, My little daughter is near to death: it is my prayer that you will come and put your hands on her, so that she may be made well, and have life.
sentences.susu: A naxa a mayandi ki fanyi, «N ma di ginɛ na a nii magagafe! Yandi, fa i fa i bɛlɛxɛ sa a ma alako a xa yalan, a xa kisi.»

sentences.english: And he went with him; and a great number of people went after him, and came round him.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa siga a fɔxɔ ra. Ɲama gbegbe fan naxa bira Isa fɔxɔ ra, e nu fa a xɛtɛn.

sentences.english: And a woman, who had had a flow of blood for twelve years,
sentences.susu: Ginɛ nde nu na e ya ma naxan xa kike wali mu nu a itima ɲɛ fu nun firin bun ma.

sentences.english: And had undergone much at the hands of a number of medical men, and had given all she had, and was no better, but even worse,
sentences.susu: A nu bara tɔɔrɔ seriba wuyaxi yi, a a harige birin so e yi ra, kɔnɔ a mu fisa. A xa fure xun nu masama nan tui.

sentences.english: When she had news of the things which Jesus did, went among the people coming after him, and put her hand on his robe.
sentences.susu: A to nu bara Isa xa fe mɛ, a naxa so ɲama tagi, a fa Isa xanbi ra, a a bɛlɛxɛ din a xa donma ra.

sentences.english: For she said, If I may only put my hand on his robe, I will be made well.
sentences.susu: Barima a nu bara a fala a yɛtɛ bɛ, «Xa n nɔ n bɛlɛxɛ dinde Isa xa donma ra gbansan, n yalanma nɛ.»

sentences.english: And straight away the fountain of her blood was stopped, and she had a feeling in her body that her disease had gone and she was well.
sentences.susu: A xa kike wali naxa dan keren na, a naxa a kolon a fate ma a a bara yalan.

sentences.english: And straight away Jesus was conscious that power had gone out of him; and, turning to the people, he said, Who was touching my robe?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a kolon keren na a sɛnbɛ nde bara mini a fate yi kaabanako rabafe ra. A naxa a ya rafindi ɲama ma, a maxɔrinyi ti, «Nde a bɛlɛxɛ dinxi n ma donma ra?»

sentences.english: And his disciples said to him, You see the people round you on every side, and you say, Who was touching me?
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛe naxa a fala a bɛ, «I mu ɲama toxi e i xɛtɛnfe ki naxɛ? I man nu fa maxɔrinyi ti, ‹Nde dinxi n na?›»

sentences.english: And on his looking round to see her who had done this thing,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa naxa a ya rage a xa a kanyi kolon.

sentences.english: The woman, shaking with fear, conscious of what had been done to her, came and, falling on her face before him, gave him a true account of everything.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ to a kolon fe naxan a sɔtɔxi, a naxa gaaxu han a sɛrɛn. A naxa suyidi Isa bɛ, a nɔndi birin fala a bɛ.

sentences.english: And he said to her, Daughter, your faith has made you well; go in peace, and be free from your disease.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala ginɛ bɛ, «N ma di, i xa danxaniya bara i rayalan. Siga bɔɲɛsa kui, i xa tɔɔrɛ bara ba i ma.»

sentences.english: And while he was still talking, they came from the ruler of the Synagogue's house, saying, Your daughter is dead: why are you still troubling the Master?
sentences.susu: Isa to nu wɔyɛnfe, mixi ndee naxa fa kelife salide yarerati xɔnyi, e a fala a bɛ, «I xa di ginɛ bara faxa. Hali i mu karamɔxɔ tɔɔrɔ sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: But Jesus, giving no attention to their words, said to the ruler of the Synagogue, Have no fear, only have faith.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa mu e xui danxun. A naxa a fala salide yarerati bɛ, «I naxa gaaxu. I tan xa la Ala ra tun.»

sentences.english: And he did not let anyone come with him, but Peter and James and John, the brother of James.
sentences.susu: Isa mu tin mixi yo xa bira a fɔxɔ ra, fo Piyɛri, Yaki, nun Yaya, Yaki xunya.

sentences.english: And they came to the house of the ruler of the Synagogue; and he saw people running this way and that, and weeping and crying loudly.
sentences.susu: E to salide yarerati xɔnyi li, Isa naxa mixie li, e wafe, e gbelegbelefe.

sentences.english: And when he had gone in, he said to them, Why are you making such a noise and weeping? The child is not dead, but sleeping.
sentences.susu: A to so banxi kui, a naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo wafe munfe ra? Wo gbelegbelema mun ma? Yi dimɛdi mu faxaxi. A na xife nɛ.»

sentences.english: And they were laughing at him. But he, having sent them all out, took the father of the child and her mother and those who were with him, and went in where the child was.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e tan naxa so a mayelefe. Isa to e birin namini, a naxa so dimɛdi saxi dɛnnaxɛ, a tan nun a fɔxirabirɛe, a nun di baba, nun a nga.

sentences.english: And taking her by the hand, he said to her, Talitha cumi, which is, My child, I say to you, Get up.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a suxu a bɛlɛxɛ ma, a a fala a bɛ, «Talita kumi». Na nan falaxi e xa xui, «Ginɛdimɛdi, n naxɛ i bɛ, keli!»

sentences.english: And the young girl got up straight away, and was walking about; she being twelve years old. And they were overcome with wonder.
sentences.susu: Ginɛdimɛdi naxa keli keren na, a a ɲɛrɛ. A ɲɛ fu nun firin nan nu a ra. Naxee nu na, e naxa kaaba ki fanyi, e birin dɛ naxa ixara.

sentences.english: And he gave them special orders that they were not to say anything of this; and he said that some food was to be given to her.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a matintin e ra, a e naxa yi fe tagi raba mixi yo bɛ. A naxa a fala e bɛ e xa donse fi tɛmɛdi ma.

sentences.english: And he went away from there, and came into his country; and his disciples went with him.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa keli mɛnni, a siga a xɔnyi, a mɔxi dɛnnaxɛ. A fɔxirabirɛe naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And when the Sabbath day had come, he was teaching in the Synagogue; and a number of people hearing him were surprised, saying, From where did this man get these things? and, What is the wisdom given to this man, and what are these works of power done by his hands?
sentences.susu: Malabu lɔxɔɛ, a naxa mixie kawandi fɔlɔ salide kui. Mixi gbegbe naxa a xui mɛ. E dɛ naxa ixara, e e bore maxɔrin, «Nde yi masenxi yi bɛ? A lɔnni mundun sɔtɔxi yi ki? A nɔxi yi kaabanako fee rabade di?

sentences.english: Is not this the woodworker, the son of Mary, and brother of James and Joses and Judas and Simon? and are not his sisters here with us? And they were bitter against him.
sentences.susu: Kamudɛri xa mu a ra, Mariyama xa di? Yaki, Yusufu, Yuda, nun Simɔn taara xa mu a ra? A xunya ginɛmae fan mu na won ya ma be?» Na kui, e mu la a ra, e xɔnɔ a ma.

sentences.english: And Jesus said to them, A prophet is nowhere without honour, but in his country, and among his relations, and in his family.
sentences.susu: Isa fan naxa a masen e bɛ, «Namiɲɔnmɛ binyaxi yire birin, fo a xɔnyi, a baribooree, nun a ngaxakerenyie tagi.»

sentences.english: And he was unable to do any work of power there, but only to put his hands on one or two persons who were ill, and make them well.
sentences.susu: Isa mu nɔ kaabanako yo rabade naa, fo a to a bɛlɛxɛ sa furema keren keren ma, a e rayalan.

sentences.english: And he was greatly surprised because they had no faith. And he went about the country places teaching.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa kaaba e xa danxaniyatareɲa ma.

sentences.english: And he gave orders to the twelve, and sent them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits;
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fɔxirabirɛ fu nun firinyie xili, a e xɛɛ firin firin na. A naxa nɔɛ fi e ma e xa nɔ ɲinnɛe keride mixie fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And he said that they were to take nothing for their journey, but a stick only; no bread, no bag, no money in their pockets;
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo naxa sese xanin wo xun ma, hali taami, gbɔnfɔɛ, nun kɔbiri. Wo xuli gbansan nan xanin.

sentences.english: They were to go with common shoes on their feet, and not to take two coats.
sentences.susu: Wo sankirie so, kɔnɔ wo naxa donma firin xanin wo xun.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Wherever you go into a house, make that your resting-place till you go away.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo na so banxi naxan kui, wo xa yigiya mɛnni nɛ han wo sigama yire gbɛtɛ tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And whatever place will not take you in and will not give ear to you, when you go away, put off the dust from your feet as a witness against them.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi ndee tondi wo rasɛnɛde, e mu e tuli mati wo ra, wo nɛ kelima naa, wo xa mɛnni bɛndɛ rakɔnkɔn wo sanyie ra, a xa findi seedeɲɔxɔya ra e bɛ, wo bara e rabolo.»

sentences.english: And they went out, preaching the need for a change of heart in men.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa siga kawandi tide mixie bɛ alako e xa tuubi.

sentences.english: And they sent out a number of evil spirits, and put oil on a great number who were ill, and made them well.
sentences.susu: E naxa ɲinnɛe keri mixi gbegbe fɔxɔ ra. E naxa ture sa furema gbegbe ma, e e rayalan.

sentences.english: And king Herod had news of him, because his name was on the lips of all; and he said, John the Baptist has come back from the dead, and for this reason these powers are working in him.
sentences.susu: Galile mangɛ Herode naxa yi fe mɛ, barima Isa xili nu bara te, a din yire birin na. Ndee nu a falama, «Yaya Xunxa nan kelixi faxɛ ma. Na nan a toxi nɔɛ na a yi a xa kaabanakoe raba.»

sentences.english: But others said, It is Elijah. And others said, It is a prophet, even like one of the prophets.
sentences.susu: Gbɛtɛe fan nu a falama, «Annabi Eliya na a ra.» Ndee fan nu a falama, «Namiɲɔnmɛ nan a ra naxan luxi alɔ namiɲɔnmɛ dangixie.»

sentences.english: But Herod, when he had news of it, said, John, whom I put to death, has come back from the dead.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Herode to Isa xa fe mɛ, a naxa a fala, «N Yaya naxan xunyi bolon, na nan kelixi faxɛ ma.»

sentences.english: For Herod himself had sent men out to take John and put him in prison, because of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, whom he had taken for himself.
sentences.susu: A na fala nɛ, barima a tan Herode yati nan mixie xɛɛ Yaya suxude, yɔlɔnxɔnyi xa sa a ma, a xa sa geeli Herodiyasi xa fe ra, a taara Filipu xa ginɛ, Herode naxan dɔxɔ.

sentences.english: For John said to Herod, It is wrong for you to have your brother's wife.
sentences.susu: Yaya nu a falama Herode bɛ, «A mu daxa i xa i taara xa ginɛ tongo.»

sentences.english: And Herodias was bitter against him, desiring to put him to death; but she was not able;
sentences.susu: Na naxa a niya Yaya naxa raɲaaxu Herodiyasi ma, a naxa wa a xa faxɛ xɔn. Kɔnɔ a faxa fɛɛrɛ mu nu na a bɛ,

sentences.english: For Herod was in fear of John, being conscious that he was an upright and holy man, and kept him safe. And hearing him, he was much troubled; and he gave ear to him gladly.
sentences.susu: barima Herode mu nu suusama Yaya ra. A nu a kolon mixi na a ra, naxan tinxin, a man sɛniyɛn. Na na a toxi, a nu a makantama. Herode nu a tuli tima Yaya ra tɛmui naxɛ, a nu kɔntɔfilima a xa wɔyɛnyi ra, kɔnɔ a man nu rafan a ma a xa nu a tuli mati a ra.

sentences.english: And the chance came when Herod on his birthday gave a feast to his lords, and the high captains, and the chief men of Galilee;
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ nde, Herodiyasi naxa fɛɛrɛ sɔtɔ Yaya faxafe ma. Herode naxa ɲɛlɛxin xulunyi ti a bari lɔxɔɛ igbilenyi xa fe ra. A naxa mixi binyee xili, a xa sɔɔrie xa mangɛe, a nun Galile bɔxi mixi xungbee.

sentences.english: And when the daughter of Herodias herself came in and did a dance, Herod and those who were at table with him were pleased with her; and the king said to the girl, Make a request for anything and I will give it you.
sentences.susu: Herodiyasi xa di ginɛ to so mɛnni, a fare boron mixie bɛ, a naxa rafan Herode nun a xa xɔɲɛe ma. Mangɛ naxa a fala yi ginɛdimɛdi bɛ, «I wama naxan yo xɔn, a fala n bɛ n xa a fi i ma.»

sentences.english: And he took an oath, saying to her, Whatever is your desire I will give it to you, even half of my kingdom.
sentences.susu: A naxa a kali, a a fala a bɛ, «I na naxan yo maxɔrin n ma, n na soma nɛ i yi ra, hali a findi n ma mangɛya sɛɛti ra.»

sentences.english: And she went out and said to her mother, What is my request to be? And she said, The head of John the Baptist.
sentences.susu: Ginɛdimɛdi naxa mini a sa a nga maxɔrin, «A lan n xa munse maxɔrin a ma?» A nga naxa a yaabi, «Yaya xunyi.»

sentences.english: And she came in quickly to the king, and said, My desire is that you give me straight away on a plate the head of John the Baptist.
sentences.susu: Ginɛdimɛdi naxa a xulun mafuren sigafe mangɛ yire, a a fala a bɛ, «N wama a xɔn ma nɛ, i xa Yaya xunyi so n yi ra pileti ma keren na.»

sentences.english: And the king was very sad; but because of his oaths, and those who were with him at table, he would not say 'No' to her.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ naxa nimisa na ma ki fanyi, kɔnɔ a xa marakali nun a xa xɔɲɛe xa fe ra, a mu nɔ tondide a bɛ.

sentences.english: And straight away the king sent out one of his armed men, and gave him an order to come back with the head: and he went and took off John's head in prison,
sentences.susu: A naxa sɔɔri xɛɛ keren na, a xa sa fa Yaya xunyi ra. Sɔɔri naxa siga geeli kui, a sa Yaya xunyi bolon a dɛ i.

sentences.english: And came back with the head on a plate, and gave it to the girl; and the girl gave it to her mother.
sentences.susu: A naxa fa a xunyi ra pileti ma, a na so ginɛdimɛdi yi ra. Ginɛdimɛdi fan naxa a xanin a nga xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And when his disciples had news of it, they came and took up his body, and put it in its last resting-place.
sentences.susu: Yaya fɔxirabirɛe to yi fe mɛ, e naxa sa a fure tongo, e a ragata.

sentences.english: And the twelve came together to Jesus; and they gave him an account of all the things they had done, and all they had been teaching.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛrae man naxa naralan Isa yire. E fe naxee raba, e kawandi naxee ti, e naxa a birin dɛntɛgɛ sa a bɛ.

sentences.english: And he said to them, Come away by yourselves to a quiet place, and take a rest for a time. Because there were a great number coming and going, and they had no time even for food.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala e bɛ, «Won xɛɛ yire madunduxi alako won doro xa lu yire keren, wo xa wo malabu.» A na fala nɛ, barima mixie xa fa nun sigɛ gbo e yire. E ɲan mu nu nɔma e yɛtɛ sɔtɔde, e xa e dɛge.

sentences.english: And they went away in the boat to a waste place by themselves.
sentences.susu: Na kui, e naxa baki kunkui kui, e doro xa siga wula i.

sentences.english: And the people saw them going, and a number of them, having knowledge who they were, went running there together on foot from all the towns, and got there before them.
sentences.susu: Mixi wuyaxi naxa e to siga ra, e naxa e kolon. E gbegbe naxa keli na taae, e e gi e sanyi ra han e tan singe sa so Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛe nu sigafe dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And he got out, and saw a great mass of people, and he had pity on them, because they were like sheep without a keeper: and he gave them teaching about a number of things.
sentences.susu: Isa to goro kunkui kui, a naxa ɲama gbegbe to naa. A naxa kinikini e ma, barima e nu luxi nɛ alɔ yɛxɛɛ naxee makantama mu na. A naxa e kawandi fɔlɔ fe gbegbe ra.

sentences.english: And at the end of the day, his disciples came to him and said, This place is waste land, and it is late:
sentences.susu: Nunmare to so fɔlɔ, Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa e maso Isa ra, e a fala a bɛ, «Won na wula nɛ yi ki, kɔɛ fan bara so.

sentences.english: Send them away, so that they may go into the country and small towns round about, and get some food for themselves.
sentences.susu: Ɲama rayensen alako e xa siga taae nun daaxae naxee na be rabilinyi, e xa sa donsee sara.»

sentences.english: But he said to them in answer, Give them food yourselves. And they said to him, Are we to go and get bread for two hundred pence, and give it to them?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa naxa e yaabi, «Wo tan xa donse so e yi.» E tan naxa a fala a bɛ, «Xa muxu sa taami sara yi ɲama birin bɛ, na kɔbiri sigama han walikɛ xa kike solomasaxan sare!»

sentences.english: And he said to them, How much bread have you? go and see. And when they had seen, they said, Five cakes of bread and two fishes.
sentences.susu: A naxa e maxɔrin, «Taami yeri na wo yi ra? Wo sa na mato.» E to a mato, e naxa a yaabi, «Taami suuli, a nun yɛxɛ firin.»

sentences.english: And he made them all be seated in groups on the green grass.
sentences.susu: A naxa yaamari fi mixi birin ma, e xa e magoro e xundɛ xundɛ ma ɲooge xinde fari.

sentences.english: And they were placed in groups, by hundreds and by fifties.
sentences.susu: Na kui, mixie naxa siga dɔxɔ ra e kɛmɛ kɛmɛ nun e tongo suuli suuli ma.

sentences.english: And he took the five cakes of bread and the two fishes and, looking up to heaven, he said words of blessing over them; and when the cakes were broken, he gave them to the disciples to put before the people; and he made division of the two fishes among them all.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa na taami suuli nun na yɛxɛ firin tongo, a a ya rate koore ma, a fa Ala nuwali sa. A naxa taamie igira, a fa a so a fɔxirabirɛe yi ra, e xa e itaxun ɲama ma. A naxa na yɛxɛ firinyie fan itaxun birin ma.

sentences.english: And they all took of the food and had enough.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa e dɛge han e wasa.

sentences.english: And they took up twelve baskets full of the broken bits and of the fishes.
sentences.susu: Taami nun yɛxɛ dɔnxɔɛ to matongo, debe fu nun firin nan nafe.

sentences.english: And those who took of the bread were five thousand men.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee taami don, xɛmɛ wulu suuli nan nu e ra.

sentences.english: And straight away he made his disciples get into the boat, and go before him to the other side to Beth-saida, while he himself sent the people away.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Isa naxa a fala a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, e xa baki kunkui kui, e giri naakiri ma. E xa siga a ya ra Betesayida, a tan xa nu ɲama ragbilen.

sentences.english: And after he had sent them away, he went up into a mountain for prayer.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ a ɲungude ɲama ma, a naxa te Ala maxandide geya fari.

sentences.english: And by evening, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he by himself on the land.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ to so, kunkui nu na baa tagi. Isa keren nan nu na xare ma.

sentences.english: And seeing that they had trouble in getting their boat through the water, because the wind was against them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have gone past them;
sentences.susu: A naxa a fɔxirabirɛe to e na tɔɔrɔfe a ɲaaxi ra laala bade, barima foye ya nu rafindixi e ma. Subaxɛ, Isa naxa fa a fɔxirabirɛe ma, a ɲɛrɛfe baa fari. A gbe mu nu luxi a xa dangi e ra,

sentences.english: But they, when they saw him walking on the sea, took him for a spirit, and gave a loud cry:
sentences.susu: e fa a to ɲɛrɛ ra ye fari. E naxa a maɲɔxun tubari ra, e sɔnxɔɛ rate,

sentences.english: For they all saw him, and were troubled. But straight away he said to them, Take heart, it is I, have no fear.
sentences.susu: barima e birin nu Isa toxi, e birin gaaxuxi. Kɔnɔ Isa naxa a masen e bɛ keren na, «Wo naxa kɔntɔfili, n tan nan a ra. Wo naxa gaaxu.»

sentences.english: And he went to them into the boat, and the wind went down, and they were full of wonder in themselves;
sentences.susu: Isa naxa te e xa kunkui kui, foye fan naxa a raxara. E birin naxa kaaba, e dɛ ixara.

sentences.english: For it was not clear to them about the bread; but their hearts were hard.
sentences.susu: E mu nu taamie xa kaabanako fe fahaamuxi, barima e xaxili mu nu rabixi.

sentences.english: And when they had gone across, they came to Gennesaret, and got their boat to land.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ baa igiride, e naxa so Genesareti bɔxi, e kunkui xiri naa.

sentences.english: And when they had got out of the boat, the people quickly had news of him,
sentences.susu: E to goro kunkui kui, mixie naxa Isa kolon keren na,

sentences.english: And went running through all the country round about, and took on their beds those who were ill, to where it was said that he was.
sentences.susu: e naxa na bɔxi birin isa. E nu Isa xili mɛma dɛdɛ, e nu fama e gi ra furemae ra a xɔn, e saxi e xa sadee ma.

sentences.english: And wherever he went, into small towns, or great towns, or into the country, they took those who were ill into the market-places, requesting him that they might put their hands even on the edge of his robe: and all those who did so were made well.
sentences.susu: Isa nu soma daaxa nun taa yo kui, mixie nu furemae sama a ya ra yire makɛnɛnxie, e a mayandi e xa e bɛlɛxɛ din a xa donma sanbunyi gbansan na. Furema birin naxee na raba, e birin naxa yalan.

sentences.english: And there came together to him the Pharisees and certain of the scribes who had come from Jerusalem,
sentences.susu: Farisɛnie naxa e malan Isa yire, e nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ ndee naxee nu bara fa kelife Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And had seen that some of his disciples took their bread with unclean, that is, unwashed, hands.
sentences.susu: E naxa a to, a fɔxirabirɛ ndee e dɛgema e bɛlɛxɛ sɛniyɛntaree ra, e mu e raxaxi naamunyi ki ma.

sentences.english: Now the Pharisees, and all the Jews, do not take food without washing their hands with care, keeping the old rule which has been handed down to them:
sentences.susu: Farisɛnie nun Yuwifi birin nɛ e dɛgema fo e e bɛlɛxɛ raxa sinden e xa naamunyi ki ma naxan fatanxi e benbae ra.

sentences.english: And when they come from the market-place, they take no food till their hands are washed; and a number of other orders there are, which have been handed down to them to keep — washings of cups and pots and brass vessels.
sentences.susu: Xa e keli ɲama yire, e mu e dɛgema sinden, fo e gɛ e maxade a diinɛ ki ma. Naamunyi wuyaxi man na e yi ra, alɔ tɔnbili, tunde, nun paani maxa ki.

sentences.english: And the Pharisees and the scribes put the question to him, Why do your disciples not keep the rules of the fathers, but take their bread with unwashed hands?
sentences.susu: Na kui, Farisɛnie nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe naxa Isa maxɔrin, «Munfe ra i fɔxirabirɛe mu biraxi forie xa naamunyie fɔxɔ ra, e nu e dɛge e bɛlɛxɛ sɛniyɛntaree ra?»

sentences.english: And he said, Well did Isaiah say of you, you false ones: These people give me honour with their lips, but their heart is far from me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Wo tan filankafuie, Annabi Esayi nɔndi yati nan masen wo xa fe ra a xa Kitaabui kui, ‹Yi ɲama n binyama e dɛ nɛ, kɔnɔ e bɔɲɛ makuya n na pon!

sentences.english: But their worship is to no purpose, while they give as their teaching the rules of men.
sentences.susu: E xa sali fufafu na a ra, barima e mixi xaranma adamadie xa maɲɔxunyie nan na alɔ na naamunyie nan findixi n tan ma sɛriyɛ nan na.›»

sentences.english: For, turning away from the law of God, you keep the rules of men.
sentences.susu: «Wo bara Ala xa sɛriyɛ bɛɲin, wo bira mixie xa naamunyi fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Truly you put on one side the law of God, so that you may keep the rules which have been handed down to you.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo fataxi de! Wo gbilenxi Ala xa sɛriyɛ nan fɔxɔ ra alako wo xa bira wo gbe naamunyi fɔxɔ ra!

sentences.english: For Moses said, Give honour to your father and mother, and, He who says evil of father or mother, let him have the punishment of death:
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa bara a masen, ‹Wo xa wo baba nun wo nga binya.› A man bara a masen, ‹Mixi yo naxan a baba nun a nga konbi, a lan nɛ na kanyi xa faxa.›

sentences.english: But you say, If a man says to his father or his mother, That by which you might have had profit from me is Corban, that is to say, Given to God,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan naxɛ, xa mixi nde a fala a baba xa na mu a nga bɛ, ‹I nu lanma i xa naxan sɔtɔ n na i malise ra, n bara a fi Ala ma,›

sentences.english: You no longer let him do anything for his father or his mother;
sentences.susu: hali na kanyi mu fefe raba a baba nun a nga bɛ.

sentences.english: Making the word of God of no effect by your rule, which you have given: and a number of other such things you do.
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo Ala xa sɛriyɛ matandima wo xa naamunyie saabui ra, wo man fa nee nan masenma wo xa die bɛ. Wo na fe mɔɔli gbegbe nan nabama, bafe yi ra.»

sentences.english: And turning to the people again, he said to them, Give ear to me all of you, and let my words be clear to you:
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa ɲama xili, a a masen e bɛ, «Wo birin xa wo tuli mati n na, wo xa fahaamui sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: There is nothing outside the man which, going into him, is able to make him unclean: but the things which come out of the man are those which make the man unclean.
sentences.susu: Donse naxan keli a fari ma, a so mixi fate i, a sese mu na naxan nɔma a kanyi findide mixi sɛniyɛntare ra. Fe kobi naxee kelima mixi bɔɲɛ ma, nee nan a kanyi findima mixi sɛniyɛntare ra.»
<range>

sentences.english: And when he had gone into the house away from all the people, his disciples put questions to him about the saying.
sentences.susu: Isa to bara keli ɲama xun, a so banxi, a fɔxirabirɛe naxa a maxɔrin yi taali wɔyɛnyi ma.

sentences.english: And he said to them, Have even you so little wisdom? Do you not see that whatever goes into a man from outside is not able to make him unclean,
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen e bɛ, «Yaxa wo fan mu fahaamui sɔtɔ? Wo mu a kolon, a donse yo keli a fari ma, a so mixi fate i, na mu nɔma a kanyi findide mixi sɛniyɛntare ra?

sentences.english: Because it goes not into the heart but into the stomach, and goes out with the waste? He said this, making all food clean.
sentences.susu: Barima na mu soma bɔɲɛ xa kui, a goroma furi nɛ, a fa mini mixi fate i.» Na kui, Isa a masen nɛ, a donse birin sɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: And he said, That which comes out of the man, that makes the man unclean.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a masen, «Fe kobi naxan kelima mixi bɔɲɛ ma, na nan a kanyi findima mixi sɛniyɛntare ra.

sentences.english: Because from inside, from the heart of men, come evil thoughts and unclean pleasures,
sentences.susu: Barima xaxili kobi fatanma mixi bɔɲɛ nan na, alɔ langoeɲa, muɲɛ, faxɛ tife,

sentences.english: The taking of goods and of life, broken faith between husband and wife, the desire of wealth, wrongdoing, deceit, sins of the flesh, an evil eye, angry words, pride, foolish acts:
sentences.susu: yɛnɛ, wasatareya, ɲaaxui, yanfanteya, ɲɛngɛya, tɔɔnɛ, konbi, yɛtɛ igboe, nun daxuɲa.

sentences.english: All these evil things come from inside, and make the man unclean.
sentences.susu: Na fe kobie birin kelima mixi bɔɲɛ nan ma, e a kanyi findi mixi sɛniyɛntare ra.»

sentences.english: And he went away from there to the country of Tyre and Sidon. And he went into a house, desiring that no man might have knowledge of it: and he was not able to keep it secret.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa keli mɛnni, a siga Tire bɔxi ma. A naxa so a yigiyade. A mu nu wama mixi yo xa a yire kolon, kɔnɔ a mu nɔ a nɔxunde.

sentences.english: But a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having had news of him, came straight away and went down at his feet.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ nde nu na, ɲinnɛ nu naxan xa di ginɛ fɔxɔ ra. A to Isa xa fe mɛ, a naxa fa a yire, a suyidi a bɛ.

sentences.english: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syro-phoenician by birth: and she made a request to him that he would send the evil spirit out of her daughter.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi xa mu nu yi ginɛ ra, a nu barixi Siriya Fenisiya nɛ. A naxa Isa mayandi, a xa ɲinnɛ keri a xa di ginɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And he said to her, Let the children first have their food: for it is not right to take the children's bread and give it to the dogs.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «A lu dimɛe nan singe xa e dɛge, barima a mu lan taami xa ba dimɛdie yi ra, a sa baree bun.»

sentences.english: But she said to him in answer, Yes, Lord: even the dogs under the table take the bits dropped by the children.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ fan naxa a yaabi, «Marigi, i nɔndi, kɔnɔ baredi naxee na teebili bun ma, e fan dimɛe xa donse donma naxan birama bɔxi.»

sentences.english: And he said to her, For this saying go your way; the evil spirit has gone out of your daughter.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xa yaabi xa fe ra, siga, ɲinnɛ bara gbilen i xa di ginɛ fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: And she went away to her house, and saw the child on the bed, and the evil spirit gone out.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ to gbilen a xɔnyi, a naxa a xa di li a saxi sade ma, ɲinnɛ bara gbilen a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And again he went out from Tyre, and came through Sidon to the sea of Galilee, through the country of Decapolis.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa keli Tire bɔxi, a dangi Sidɔn, a gbilen Galile baa mabiri, Taa Fu bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And they came to him with one who had no power of hearing and had trouble in talking; and they made a request to him to put his hands on him.
sentences.susu: E naxa fa tulixɔri nde ra a xɔn ma, wɔyɛnfe xɔrɔxɔxi naxan ma, e Isa mayandi a xa a bɛlɛxɛ sa a ma.

sentences.english: And he took him on one side from the people privately, and put his fingers into his ears, and he put water from his mouth on the man's tongue with his finger;
sentences.susu: Isa naxa tulixɔri tongo ɲama yire, e sa ti e xati ma. Isa naxa a bɛlɛxɛsolee raso tulixɔri tulie kui, a a yɛtɛ kan dɛye sa a nɛnyi ma.

sentences.english: And looking up to heaven, he took a deep breath, and said to him, Ephphatha, that is, Be open.
sentences.susu: A naxa a ya rate koore, a a ɲɛngi rate a belebele ra. A fa a fala tulixɔri bɛ, «Efafata!» Na nan falaxi e xa xui, «I xa rabi!»

sentences.english: And his ears became open, and the band of his tongue was made loose, and his words became clear.
sentences.susu: A tulie naxa fe mɛ keren na, a nɛnyi fan naxa keli, a naxa wɔyɛn fɔlɔ a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And he gave them orders not to give news of it to anyone; but the more he made this request, so much the more they made it public.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yamari, a e naxa yi fe fala mixi yo bɛ. Kɔnɔ hali Isa to nu tɔnyi dɔxɔma e ma kiyoki, e tan nu sigama a xa xibaaru fala ra nan tui.

sentences.english: And they were overcome with wonder, saying, He has done all things well: he even gives back the power of hearing and the power of talking to those who have been without them.
sentences.susu: E nu bara kaaba ki fanyi, e nu a fala, «A fe fanyi mɔɔli birin nabama! A a niyama tulixɔri xa fe mɛ, boboe fan xa wɔyɛn!»

sentences.english: In those days again, when there was a great mass of people and they had no food, he made his disciples come to him and said to them,
sentences.susu: Na saxanyi, ɲama gbegbe man nu bara e malan. Donse to mu nu e yi ra, Isa naxa a fɔxirabirɛe xili, a a masen e bɛ,

sentences.english: I have pity for these people because they have been with me now three days, and have no food;
sentences.susu: «N bara kinikini yi ɲama ma, barima a xi saxan nan yi ki, e na n yire. Donse yo mu e bɛ yi ki.

sentences.english: If I send them away to their houses with no food, they will be overcome by weariness on the way; and some of them have come from far.
sentences.susu: N na a fala ya, e xa siga e xɔnyi kaamɛ ra e ma, e tɔɔrɔma nɛ kira xɔn ki fanyi. Ndee na e ya ma, e kelide makuya.»

sentences.english: And his disciples said in answer, How will it be possible to get enough bread for these men here in a waste place?
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa a yaabi, «Taami sɔtɔma di yi wula kui naxan yi ɲama wasama?»

sentences.english: And he put the question, How much bread have you? And they said, Seven cakes.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e maxɔrin, «Taami gundi yeri na wo yi?» E naxa a yaabi, «Solofere.»

sentences.english: And he made the people be seated on the earth: and he took the seven cakes and, having given praise, he gave the broken bread to his disciples to put before them; and they put it before the people.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala ɲama bɛ e xa dɔxɔ bɔxi. A naxa na taami gundi solofere tongo, a Ala nuwali sa. A to e igira, a naxa e so a fɔxirabirɛe yi ra, e xa e itaxun ɲama ma. E fan naxa a raba na ki.

sentences.english: And they had some small fishes; and blessing them he had them put before the people in the same way.
sentences.susu: Yɛxɛ lanma ndee fan nu na e yi ra. Isa to Ala nuwali sa e xa fe ra, a naxa a fala, a e fan xa itaxun.

sentences.english: And they took the food, and had enough; and they took up seven baskets full of the broken bits.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa a dɛge han e wasa. Donse dɔnxɔɛ fan naxa matongo han debe solofere naxa rafe.

sentences.english: And there were about four thousand people: and he sent them away.
sentences.susu: Mixi wulu naani ɲɔndɔn nan nu na naa. Isa to e ragbilen,

sentences.english: And he got into the boat with his disciples straight away, and came into the country of Dalmanutha.
sentences.susu: a naxa te kunkui kui keren na, e nun a fɔxirabirɛe naxa siga Dalamanuta bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the Pharisees came out and put questions to him, requesting from him a sign from heaven, testing him.
sentences.susu: Farisɛnie naxa fa, e nun Isa naxa wɔyɛn fɔlɔ. E to nu wama a matofe, e naxa a maxɔrin a xa tɔnxuma makaabaxi nde masen e bɛ kelife koore ma.

sentences.english: And he was very sad in spirit, and said, Why is this generation looking for a sign? truly, I say to you, No sign will be given to this generation.
sentences.susu: Na naxa Isa bɔɲɛ tɔɔrɔ ki fanyi. A naxa a masen, «Munfe ra yi waxati mixie n maxɔrinma tɔnxuma makaabaxi ma? N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, tɔnxuma yo mu fima yi waxati mixie ma.»

sentences.english: And he went away from them, and again got into the boat and went across to the other side.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi a naxa keli e xun ma, a man baki kunkui kui girife ra naakiri ma.

sentences.english: And they had taken no thought to get bread; and they had only one cake of bread with them in the boat.
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛe nu bara nɛɛmu fade taami nde ra e xun. Taami gundi keren peti nan nu na e yi ra kunkui kui.

sentences.english: And he said to them, Take care to be on the watch against the leaven of the Pharisees and the leaven of Herod.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa yi matintin e ra, «Wo wo yɛtɛ ratanga Farisɛnie nun Herode xa lɛbini ma.»

sentences.english: And they said to one another, We have no bread.
sentences.susu: E naxa so wɔyɛnfe e bore bɛ na fe ma, a a na falaxi nɛ barima taami mu na e yi ra.

sentences.english: And Jesus, hearing it, said to them, Why are you reasoning among yourselves because you have no bread? do you still not see, and is it still not clear to you? are your hearts so hard?
sentences.susu: Isa to e xa wɔyɛnyi kolon, a naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo taami fe falama wo bore bɛ munfe ra? Han ya wo mu xaxili sɔtɔ, wo mu fe fahaamu? Wo xaxili mu rabixi?

sentences.english: Having eyes, do you not see? and having ears, have you no hearing? and have you no memory?
sentences.susu: Ya na wo bɛ, kɔnɔ wo mu se toma. Tuli na wo bɛ, kɔnɔ wo mu fe mɛma. Wo nɛɛmuxi nɛ?

sentences.english: When I made a division of the five cakes of bread among the five thousand, what number of baskets full of broken bits did you take up? They said to him, Twelve.
sentences.susu: N taami gundi suuli itaxun mixi wulu suuli ma dɛnnaxɛ, wo debe yeri rafe taami dɔnxɔɛ ra?» E naxa a yaabi, «Fu nun firin.»

sentences.english: And when the seven among the four thousand, what number of baskets full of broken bits did you take up? And they said to him, Seven.
sentences.susu: «N man to taami gundi solofere itaxun xɛmɛ wulu naani ma, wo debe yeri rafe taami dɔnxɔɛ ra?» E naxa a yaabi, «Solofere.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Is it still not clear to you?
sentences.susu: A fa e maxɔrin, «Han ya wo mu fahaamui sɔtɔ?»

sentences.english: And they came to Beth-saida. And they took a blind man to him, requesting him to put his hands on him.
sentences.susu: E to so Betesayida, mixie naxa fa dɔnxui nde ra Isa xɔn, e a mayandi a xa a bɛlɛxɛ sa a ma.

sentences.english: And he took the blind man by the hand, and went with him out of the town; and when he had put water from his mouth on his eyes, and put his hands on him, he said, Do you see anything?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa dɔnxui bɛlɛxɛ suxu, a mini a ra taa fari ma. A naxa a dɛye sa a ya ma, a a bɛlɛxɛ sa a ma, a fa a maxɔrin, «I se nde toma?»

sentences.english: And looking up, he said, I see men; I see them like trees, walking.
sentences.susu: Dɔnxui naxa a ya rabi, a fa a fala, «N bara mixie to ɲɛrɛ ra, kɔnɔ e luxi alɔ wuri bilie.»

sentences.english: Then again he put his hands on his eyes; and looking hard, he was able to see, and saw all things clearly.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a bɛlɛxɛ sa a ya ma. Dɔnxui to a ya rabi sɔnɔn, a nu bara yalan, a se birin igbɛma a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And he sent him away to his house, saying, Do not even go into the town.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «Gbilen i xɔnyi keren na, hali i mu so taa kui.»

sentences.english: And Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the little towns round Caesarea Philippi; and on the way he put a question to his disciples, saying, Who do men say that I am?
sentences.susu: Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛe man naxa mini sigafe ra taa naxee na Sesareya Filipi rabilinyi. Kira xɔn, Isa naxa a fɔxirabirɛe maxɔrin, «Mixie munse falama n ma fe ra? Nde lanxi n ma?»

sentences.english: And they made answer, John the Baptist; and others, Elijah; but others, One of the prophets.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Ndee a falama, Annabi Yaya Xunxa. Ndee a falama, Annabi Eliya, xa na mu a ra namiɲɔnmɛ gbɛtɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, But who do you say I am? Peter said in answer, You are the Christ.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa e maxɔrin, «Kɔnɔ wo tan naxɛ di? Nde n na?» Piyɛri naxa a yaabi, «Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan na i ra.»

sentences.english: And he put them under orders not to say this of him to anyone.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a matintin e ra, a e naxa a xa fe fala mixi yo bɛ.

sentences.english: And teaching them, he said that the Son of man would have to undergo much, and be hated by those in authority, and the chief priests, and the scribes, and be put to death, and after three days come back from the dead.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen fɔlɔ e bɛ, a fo Adama xa Di xa tɔɔrɛ gbegbe sɔtɔ. Yuwifie xa forie, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie, nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe mu lama a ra, e a faxa, kɔnɔ xi saxan dangi xanbi, a man kelima nɛ faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: And he said this openly. And Peter took him, and was protesting.
sentences.susu: A naxa yi wɔyɛnyi birin masen e bɛ a fiixɛ ra. Piyɛri to a bɛndun, e sa ti e xati ma, a naxa so wɔyɛnfe Isa ma, a xa ba na mɔɔli falafe.

sentences.english: But he, turning about, and seeing his disciples, said sharply to Peter, Get out of my way, Satan: for your mind is not on the things of God, but on the things of men.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa naxa a ya rafindi a fɔxirabirɛe ma, a fa a fala Piyɛri bɛ, «Keli n ya i, i tan Sentanɛ! I xaxili mu tixi Ala fee xa ra, a tixi adama fee nan na.»

sentences.english: And turning to the mass of people with his disciples, he said to them, If any man has the desire to come after me, let him give up all other desires, and take up his cross and come after me.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Isa naxa ɲama xili a nun a fɔxirabirɛe, a a masen e bɛ, «Xa mixi wa birafe n fɔxɔ ra, a xa tondi a yɛtɛ ma, a tin tɔɔrɛ nun faxɛ ra, a bira n fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Whoever has a desire to keep his life, will have it taken from him; and whoever gives up his life because of me and the good news, will keep it.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan wama a yɛtɛ rakisife, na kanyi lɔɛma nɛ. Naxan a yɛtɛ ralɔɛma n tan ma fe ra a nun n ma xibaaru fanyi xa fe ra, na kanyi kisima nɛ.

sentences.english: What profit has a man if he gets all the world with the loss of his life?
sentences.susu: Duniɲa birin sɔtɔɛ munse fanma mixi ma, xa a sigama yahannama?

sentences.english: And what would a man give in exchange for his life?
sentences.susu: Fe mundun na, mixi nɔma a xa ariyanna masarade naxan na?

sentences.english: Whoever has a feeling of shame because of me and my words in this false and evil generation, the Son of man will have a feeling of shame because of him, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.
sentences.susu: Naxan yo yaagima n tan nun n ma wɔyɛnyi xa fe ra yi waxati mixi kobie nun yunubitɔɛe tagi, n tan Adama xa Di fama n Baba xa nɔrɛ kui tɛmui naxɛ n nun malekɛ sɛniyɛnxie, n fan yaagima nɛ na kanyi xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Truly I say to you, There are some here who will have no taste of death till they see the kingdom of God come with power.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a masen e bɛ, «N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, mixi ndee tixi wo ya ma be, naxee mu faxama fo e Ala xa mangɛya niini to fa ra sɛnbɛ kui.»

sentences.english: And after six days Jesus took with him Peter and James and John, and made them go up with him into a high mountain by themselves: and he was changed in form before them:
sentences.susu: Xi senni dangi xanbi, Isa naxa Piyɛri, Yaki, nun Yaya xanin e doro ma geya itexi nde fari. Mɛnni Isa naxa masara, a nɔrɔ e ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And his clothing became shining, very white, as no cleaner on earth would make it.
sentences.susu: A xa sosee naxa fiixɛ a mɔɔli nde ra naxan mu toma duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: And there came before them Elijah with Moses, and they were talking with Jesus.
sentences.susu: Annabi Eliya nun Annabi Munsa naxa mini fɔxirabirɛe ya xɔri, e naxa e to naa e nun Isa wɔyɛnfe.

sentences.english: And Peter said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here: and let us make three tents; one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a fala Isa bɛ, «Karamɔxɔ, fe fanyi na a ra muxu to na be yi ki. Muxu xa lingira saxan yailan, keren i gbe, keren Annabi Munsa gbe, keren Annabi Eliya gbe.»

sentences.english: Because he was not certain what to say, for they were in great fear.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri na fala nɛ a to mu nu sese kolon a naxan falama, barima a tan nun a booree nu bara gaaxu ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And a cloud came over them; and a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my dearly loved Son, give ear to him.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, nuxui naxa goro e xun ma, xui nde naxa mini nuxui kui, a a masen, «N ma Di maxanuxi nan yi ki. Wo wo tuli mati a ra.»

sentences.english: And suddenly looking round about, they saw no one any longer, but Jesus only with themselves.
sentences.susu: Na ikɔrɔxi ra, Isa fɔxirabirɛe to e ya rage, e mu mixi yo to e yire fo Isa.

sentences.english: And while they were coming down from the mountain, he gave them orders not to give word to any man of the things they had seen, till the Son of man had come back from the dead.
sentences.susu: E to nu na gorofe geya fari, Isa naxa a matintin e ra, e fe naxan toxi e ya ra, e naxa a fala mixi yo bɛ, han beemanun Adama xa Di xa keli faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: And they kept the saying, questioning among themselves what the coming back from the dead might be.
sentences.susu: E naxa na ragata e xaxili ma, e nu e bore maxɔrin, «A to a fala a a kelima faxɛ ma, na munse masenxi?»

sentences.english: And they put a question to him, saying, Why do the scribes say that Elijah has to come first?
sentences.susu: E naxa Isa maxɔrin, «Munfe ra sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe a falama a fo Annabi Eliya nan singe xa fa?»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Truly, Elijah does come first, and puts all things in order; and how is it said in the Writings that the Son of man will go through much sorrow and be made as nothing?
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen e bɛ, «Nɔndi na a ra. Annabi Eliya nan singe fama yati, a fe birin yailan. A man sɛbɛxi munfe ra, a fo Adama xa Di xa tɔɔrɛ gbegbe sɔtɔ, mixie a mabere?

sentences.english: But I say to you that Elijah has come, and they have done to him whatever they were pleased to do, even as the Writings say about him.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n xa a fala wo bɛ, Annabi Eliya ɲan bara fa, kɔnɔ e bara e waxɔnfe birin niya a ra, alɔ a xa fe sɛbɛxi ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And when they came to the disciples, they saw a great mass of people about them, and scribes questioning them.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, e naxa sa fɔxirabirɛ booree li, e nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe nu na xɔrɔxɔfe e xa wɔyɛnyie kui, ɲama gbegbe fan nu na e rabilinyi.

sentences.english: And straight away all the people, when they saw him, were full of wonder, and running to him, gave him worship.
sentences.susu: Ɲama fɛfɛ Isa to, e naxa kaaba, e e gi, e xa sa a xɛɛbu.

sentences.english: And he said, What are you questioning them about?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo nun yee na wɔyɛnfe yi mɔɔli ra munfe ma?»

sentences.english: And one of the number said to him in answer, Master, I came to you with my son, who has in him a spirit which takes away his power of talking;
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ nde naxa a yaabi ɲama tagi, «Karamɔxɔ, n faxi n ma di xɛmɛ nan na i xɔn, barima ɲinnɛ na a fɔxɔ ra naxan bara a dɛ bobo.

sentences.english: And wherever it takes him, it puts him down violently, streaming at the lips and twisted with pain; and his strength goes from him; and I made a request to your disciples to send it out, and they were not able.
sentences.susu: A na keli a ra dɛdɛ, a a rabirama nɛ bɔxi, a dɛ xunfɛ nu fa mini, a nu a ɲinyi raxin, a fate birin xɔrɔxɔ a ra. N bara i fɔxirabirɛe mayandi e xa yi ɲinnɛ keri a fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ e mu nɔ.»

sentences.english: And he said to them in answer, O generation without faith, how long will I have to be with you? how long will I put up with you? let him come to me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Wo tan danxaniyatare bɔnsɔɛ, n xa lu wo sɛɛti ma han mun tɛmui? N xa ti wo bun ma han mun lɔxɔɛ? Wo fa na di ra n xɔn.»

sentences.english: And they took him to him: and when he saw him, the spirit in him straight away became violent; and he went down on the earth, rolling about and streaming at the lips.
sentences.susu: E naxa fa a ra a xɔn. Ɲinnɛ to Isa to, a naxa di rabira keren na, a nu fa a maɲindigilin bɔxi, a dɛ xunfɛ nu mini.

sentences.english: And Jesus questioning the father said, How long has he been like this? And he said, From a child.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a baba maxɔrin, «Yi rabama a ra kabi mun tɛmui?» A naxa a yaabi, «Kabi a dimɛdi tɛmui.

sentences.english: And frequently it has sent him into the fire and into the water, for his destruction; but if you are able to do anything, have pity on us, and give us help.
sentences.susu: Sanmaya wuyaxi yi ɲinnɛ a rabirama tɛ xɔɔra, xa na mu ye, alako a xa a faxa. Kɔnɔ xa i nɔma fe nde ra, muxu mali. Kinikini muxu ma!»

sentences.english: And Jesus said to him, If you are able! All things are possible to him who has faith.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen a bɛ, «I naxɛ, xa n nɔma. Fefe mu na naxan mu nɔma rabade mixi bɛ xa danxaniya na a bɛ.»

sentences.english: Straight away the father of the child gave a cry, saying, I have faith; make my feeble faith stronger.
sentences.susu: Di baba fan naxa a xui ite keren na Isa mayandife ra, «Danxaniya na n bɛ, kɔnɔ n mali n ma danxaniyatareɲa xa fe ra!»

sentences.english: And when Jesus saw that the people came running together, he gave orders to the unclean spirit, saying to him, You, spirit, who are the cause of his loss of voice and hearing, I say to you, come out of him, and never again go into him.
sentences.susu: Isa to ɲama to, e fafe e gi ra, a naxa wɔyɛn ɲinnɛ ra, «I tan ɲinnɛ naxan bara yi di dɛ bobo, i a tuli xɔri, n bara i yaamari, gbilen a fɔxɔ ra, i man naxa a tɔɔrɔ sɔnɔn!»

sentences.english: And after crying out and shaking him violently, it came out: and the child became like one dead; so that most of them said, He is dead.
sentences.susu: Ɲinnɛ naxa sɔnxɔ, a di raketun a ra a ɲaaxi ra, a fa gbilen a fɔxɔ ra. Di naxa lu alɔ a faxaxi nɛ. Mixi gbegbe naxa a fala, «A bara faxa.»

sentences.english: But Jesus took him by the hand, lifting him up; and he got up.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa naxa a suxu a bɛlɛxɛ ma, a a rakeli, di fan naxa ti.

sentences.english: And when he had gone into the house, his disciples said to him privately, Why were we unable to send it out?
sentences.susu: Isa to so banxi, a fɔxirabirɛe naxa a maxɔrin e doro ma, «Munfe ra muxu tan mu nɔ na ɲinnɛ keride?»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Nothing will make this sort come out but prayer.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Yi ɲinnɛ mɔɔli tan kerima mixi fɔxɔ ra Ala maxandi nan tun na.»

sentences.english: And they went out from there, through Galilee; and it was his desire that no man might have knowledge of it;
sentences.susu: E naxa keli mɛnni, e Galile bɔxi igiri. Isa mu nu wama mixie xa a yire kolon,

sentences.english: For he was giving his disciples teaching, and saying to them, The Son of man is given up into the hands of men, and they will put him to death; and when he is dead, after three days he will come back from the dead.
sentences.susu: barima a nu na a fɔxirabirɛe xaranfe nɛ. A naxa a masen e bɛ, «Adama xa Di sama nɛ mixie bɛlɛxɛ, e a faxa. A xa faxɛ xi saxan dangi xanbi, a man kelima nɛ faxɛ ma.»

sentences.english: But the saying was not clear to them, and they were in fear of questioning him about it.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a fɔxirabirɛe mu a xa wɔyɛnyi fahaamu, e man mu suusa a maxɔrinde.

sentences.english: And they came to Capernaum: and when he was in the house, he put the question to them, What were you talking about on the way?
sentences.susu: E naxa so Kapɛrɛnamu. E man to so banxi kui, Isa naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo nu na wɔyɛnyi mundun kira xɔn?»

sentences.english: But they said nothing: because they had had an argument between themselves on the way, about who was the greatest.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e mu sese fala, barima e to nu wɔyɛnma e bore bɛ kira xɔn, e nu wama a kolonfe nɛ naxan tide gbo e ya ma.

sentences.english: And seating himself, he made the twelve come to him; and he said to them, If any man has the desire to be first, he will be last of all and servant of all.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa to a magoro, a naxa yi mixi fu nun firin xili, a a masen e bɛ, «Xa mixi yo wa findife yarerati ra, fo na kanyi xa findi birin xa xanbirati ra, a findi birin hayi fanma ra.»

sentences.english: And he took a little child, and put him in the middle of them; and taking him in his arms, he said to them,
sentences.susu: Isa naxa dimɛdi nde tongo, a a ti e tagi. A naxa dimɛdi dɔxɔ a san ma, a fa a masen a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ,

sentences.english: Whoever will give honour to one such little child in my name, gives honour to me: and whoever gives honour to me, gives honour not to me, but to him who sent me.
sentences.susu: «Mixi yo naxan yi dimɛdi mɔɔli rasɛnɛma n xili ra, na kanyi bara n tan yɛtɛ yati rasɛnɛ. Mixi yo n nasɛnɛ, na kanyi mu n tan gbansan xa rasɛnɛxi. A bara n xɛɛma fan nasɛnɛ.»

sentences.english: John said to him, Master, we saw one driving out evil spirits in your name: and we said that he might not, because he is not one of us.
sentences.susu: Yaya naxa a fala a bɛ, «Karamɔxɔ, muxu bara xɛmɛ nde to a ɲinnɛ kerima mixi fɔxɔ ra i xili saabui ra. Muxu bara kata a xa ba na ma, barima a mu biraxi won fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: But Jesus said, Say not so: for there is no man who will do a great work in my name, and be able at the same time to say evil of me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen, «Wo naxa a ratɔn, barima mixi yo kaabanako raba n xili saabui ra, na kanyi mu nɔma fe ɲaaxi falade n ma fe ra mafuren.

sentences.english: He who is not against us is for us.
sentences.susu: Na kui, mixi naxan mu a ikelixi won xili ma, a kanyi na won bɛ nɛ.

sentences.english: Whoever gives you a cup of water, because you are Christ's, truly I say to you, he will in no way be without his reward.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo wo ki ye n xili ra wo to biraxi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi fɔxɔ ra, n xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, na kanyi mu ganma a baraayi ra muku.»

sentences.english: And whoever is a cause of trouble to one of these little ones who have faith in me, it would be better for him if a great stone was put round his neck and he was dropped into the sea.
sentences.susu: «Mixi yo yi mixi xuri keren natantan, naxan danxaniyaxi n ma, a fisa na kanyi bɛ gɛmɛ binye xa xiri a kɔnyi ra, a rasin baa ma.

sentences.english: And if your hand is a cause of trouble to you, let it be cut off; it is better for you to go into life with one hand than to have two hands and go into hell, into the eternal fire.
sentences.susu: Xa i bɛlɛxɛ findi i ratantanse ra, a bolon. I sofe ariyanna i bɛlɛxɛ keren bolonxi, na fisa i bɛ dinɛ i bɛlɛxɛ firin luxi na, i fa siga yahannama, tɛ mu xubenma dɛnnaxɛ.
<range>

sentences.english: And if your foot is a cause of trouble to you, let it be cut off: it is better for you to go into life with one foot than to have two feet and go into hell.
sentences.susu: Xa i sanyi findi i ratantanse ra, a bolon. I sofe ariyanna i sanyi keren bolonxi, na fisa i bɛ dinɛ i sanyi firin luxi na, i fa woli yahannama.
<range>

sentences.english: And if your eye is a cause of trouble to you, take it out: it is better for you to go into the kingdom of God with one eye than, having two eyes, to go into hell,
sentences.susu: Xa i ya findi i ratantanse ra, a ba na. I sofe ariyanna i ya keren kanaxi, na fisa i bɛ dinɛ i ya firin luxi na, i fa woli yahannama,

sentences.english: Where their worm is ever living and the fire is not put out.
sentences.susu: kuli mu faxama dɛnnaxɛ, tɛ fan mu xubenma.»

sentences.english: Everyone will be salted with fire.
sentences.susu: «Tɛ sama nɛ mixi birin ma, alɔ fɔxɛ sama donse ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Salt is good; but if the taste goes from it, how will you make it salt again? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace one with another.
sentences.susu: Fɔxɛ findixi fe fanyi nan na, kɔnɔ xa fɔxɛ mɛxɛmɛxɛnyi bara ba, a fa mɛxɛmɛxɛnma di? Fɔxɛ xa lu wo i, wo xa lu bɔɲɛsa kui wo bore tagi.»

sentences.english: And he got up, and went into the country of Judaea on the other side of Jordan: and great numbers of people came together to him again; and, as was his way, he gave them teaching.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa keli mɛnni, a siga Yudaya bɔxi a nun Yurudɛn naakiri ma. Ɲama gbegbe man naxa e malan a yire, a fan naxa e kawandi fɔlɔ, alɔ a nu darixi a ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And Pharisees came to him, testing him with the question, Is it right for a man to put away his wife?
sentences.susu: Farisɛnie naxa fa Isa yire alako e xa gantanyi te a bɛ. E naxa a maxɔrin, «A daxa xɛmɛ xa mɛɛ a xa ginɛ ra?»

sentences.english: And he said to them in answer, What did Moses say you were to do?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Annabi Munsa wo yamari munse ra?»

sentences.english: And they said to him, Moses let us give her a statement in writing, and be free from her.
sentences.susu: E fan naxa a yaabi, «Annabi Munsa a fala nɛ, a xa xɛmɛ wa mɛɛfe a xa ginɛ ra, a xa fatan kɛɛdi nan nafala, a fa mɛɛ ginɛ ra.»

sentences.english: But Jesus said to them, Because of your hard hearts he gave you this law.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Annabi Munsa yi yaamari sɛbɛxi nɛ wo bɛ wo xaxili to xɔrɔxɔ.

sentences.english: But from the first, male and female made he them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ duniɲa fɔlɔ fɔlɛ ra, Ala naxa xɛmɛ nun ginɛ daa.

sentences.english: For this cause will a man go away from his father and mother, and be joined to his wife;
sentences.susu: ‹Na kui, xɛmɛ kelima a baba nun a nga xun ma, a a xa ginɛ xa futi xiri,

sentences.english: And the two will become one flesh; so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.
sentences.susu: e firin findi keren na.› Na nan a toxi, mixi firin xa mu e ra sɔnɔn, e firin bara findi keren na.

sentences.english: Let not that which has been joined together by God be parted by man.
sentences.susu: Ala bara naxee xiri e boore ra, adama naxa e rafatan.»

sentences.english: And in the house the disciples put questions to him again about this thing.
sentences.susu: E to so banxi, Isa fɔxirabirɛe man naxa a maxɔrin na masenyi ma.

sentences.english: And he said to them, Whoever puts away his wife and takes another, is false to his wife;
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Mixi yo mɛɛ a xa ginɛ ra, a sa gbɛtɛ dɔxɔ, a kanyi bara yɛnɛ raba.

sentences.english: And if she herself puts away her husband and takes another, she is false to her husband.
sentences.susu: Xa ginɛ fan mɛɛ a xa xɛmɛ ra, a sa dɔxɔ xɛmɛ gbɛtɛ xɔn, a fan bara yɛnɛ raba.»

sentences.english: And they took to him little children, so that he might put his hands on them: and the disciples said sharp words to them.
sentences.susu: Mixie nu fafe dimɛdie ra Isa xɔn, alako a xa a bɛlɛxɛ sa e ma, kɔnɔ a fɔxirabirɛe naxa wɔyɛn na mixie ma.

sentences.english: And when Jesus saw it, he was angry, and said to them, Let the little children come to me, and do not keep them away; for of such is the kingdom of God.
sentences.susu: Isa to na fe to, a naxa xɔnɔ, a fa a masen a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, «Wo a lu dimɛdie xa fa n yire. Wo naxa tɔnyi dɔxɔ e ma, barima naxee maniyaxi e ra, nee nan soma Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma.

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, Whoever does not put himself under the kingdom of God like a little child, will not come into it at all.
sentences.susu: N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, mixi naxan mu tinma Ala xa mangɛya niini ra alɔ dimɛdi, na kanyi mu soma Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma feo!»

sentences.english: And he took them in his arms, and gave them a blessing, putting his hands on them.
sentences.susu: A naxa dimɛdie dɔxɔ a san ma, a a bɛlɛxɛ sa e ma, a duba e bɛ.

sentences.english: And while he was going out into the way, a man came running to him, and went down on his knees, saying, Good Master, what have I to do so that I may have eternal life?
sentences.susu: Isa to nu bara kira suxu, xɛmɛ nde naxa fa a gi ra a fɔxɔ ra, a a xinbi sin a bun ma. A naxa Isa maxɔrin, «Karamɔxɔ fanyi, a lan n xa munse raba alako n xa abadan kisi sɔtɔ kɛ ra?»

sentences.english: And Jesus said to him, Why do you say I am good? no one is good but one, and that is God.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen a bɛ, «Munfe ra i n xilima karamɔxɔ fanyi? Mixi yo mu fan. Ala keren peti nan fan.

sentences.english: You have knowledge of what is said in the law, Do not put any one to death, Do not be untrue in married life, Do not take what is not yours, Do not give false witness, Do not get money by deceit, Give honour to your father and mother.
sentences.susu: I sɛriyɛ kolon: ‹I naxa faxɛ ti. I naxa yɛnɛ raba. I naxa muɲɛ ti. I naxa mixi tɔɔɲɛgɛ. I naxa fu mixi ma. I baba nun i nga binya.›»

sentences.english: And he said to him, Master, all these laws I have kept from the time when I was young.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ naxa Isa yaabi, «Karamɔxɔ, n bara na birin nabatu kafi n dimɛdi tɛmui.»

sentences.english: And Jesus, looking on him and loving him, said, There is one thing needed: go, get money for your goods, and give it to the poor, and you will have wealth in heaven: and come with me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa xɛmɛ mato, a naxa a xanu. A naxa a masen a bɛ, «Fe keren nan fa luxi i bɛ. Siga, se naxan birin na i yi ra, i sa a mati, i a kɔbiri fi setaree ma. Na kui, i fama bannaya sɔtɔde ariyanna. I na na raba, fa, i bira n fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: But his face became sad at the saying, and he went away sorrowing: for he was one who had much property.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ to na wɔyɛnyi mɛ, a naxa siga sunnunyi kui, barima harige gbegbe nu na a yi ra.

sentences.english: And Jesus, looking round about, said to his disciples, How hard it is for those who have wealth to come into the kingdom of God!
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a ya rage a rabilinyi, a fa a masen a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, «Sofe Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma, a xɔrɔxɔ naafuli kanyie bɛ ki fanyi!»

sentences.english: And the disciples were full of wonder at his words. But Jesus said to them again, Children, how hard it is for those who put faith in wealth to come into the kingdom of God!
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛe naxa kaaba a xa wɔyɛnyi ma, kɔnɔ Isa man naxa a masen e bɛ, «N ma die, sofe Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma, a xɔrɔxɔ ki fanyi!

sentences.english: It is simpler for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a man of wealth to come into the kingdom of God.
sentences.susu: Ɲɔxɔmɛ so ɲɔxun sɛnbɛ yale ra, dinɛ bannamixi sofe ra Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma.»

sentences.english: And they were greatly surprised, saying to him, Who then may have salvation?
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛe dɛ naxa ixara ki fanyi ra, e nu e bore maxɔrin, «Nde fa nɔma kiside fa?»

sentences.english: Jesus, looking on them, said, With men it is impossible, but not with God: for all things are possible with God.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e mato, a fa a masen e bɛ, «Adama mu nɔma a yɛtɛ rakiside, kɔnɔ Ala tan nɔma fe birin na.»

sentences.english: Peter said to him, See, we have given up everything, and come after you.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa wɔyɛn fɔlɔ Isa bɛ, «A mato, muxu bara keli se birin xun ma, muxu bira i fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: Jesus said, Truly I say to you, There is no man who has given up house, or brothers, or sisters, or mother, or father, or children, or land, because of me and the good news,
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen, «N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, mixi yo naxan na keli a xa se nde xun ma n tan nun n ma xibaaru fanyi xa fe ra, a findi banxi ra ba, xunyae ba, taarae ba, baba ba, nga ba, die ba, bɔxie ba,

sentences.english: Who will not get a hundred times as much now in this time, houses, and brothers, and sisters, and mothers, and children, and land — though with great troubles; and, in the world to come, eternal life.
sentences.susu: na kanyi fama na birin ɲɔxɔɛ kɛmɛ kɛmɛ nan sɔtɔde. Fɔxɔɛe yo, xunyae yo, taarae yo, babae yo, ngae yo, bɔxie yo, a e sɔtɔma yi duniɲa ma a nun ɲaxankatɛ ra, a man fa abadan kisi sɔtɔ aligiyama.

sentences.english: But a great number who are first will be last: and those who are last will be first.
sentences.susu: Yarerati wuyaxi fama findide xanbiratie ra, xanbiratie fan findi yareratie ra.»

sentences.english: And they were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going before them: and they were full of wonder; but those who came after him were in fear. And again he took the twelve, and gave them word of the things which were to come on him,
sentences.susu: Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛe naxa kira suxu tefe Darisalamu, Isa tixi e ya ra. A fɔxirabirɛe nu kɔntɔfilixi, naxee fan nu biraxi e fɔxɔ ra, nee fan nu gaaxuxi. Isa man naxa a fɔxirabirɛ fu nun firin xun lan, a so fe tagi rabafe e bɛ naxan fama a tan lide.

sentences.english: Saying, See, we go up to Jerusalem; and the Son of man will be given up to the chief priests and the scribes; and they will give an order for his death, and will give him up to the Gentiles:
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen, «Wo a mato, won na tefe Darisalamu nɛ yi ki. Adama xa Di sama nɛ sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie, nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe bɛlɛxɛ, e a makiiti faxɛ kiiti ra, e a so kaafirie yi ra.

sentences.english: And they will make sport of him, and put shame on him, and give him cruel blows, and will put him to death; and after three days he will come back from the dead.
sentences.susu: E a mayelema nɛ, e dɛye bɔxun a ma, e a bɔnbɔ sɛbɛrɛ ra, e man fa a faxa. Kɔnɔ a xa faxɛ xi saxan dangi xanbi, a man kelima nɛ faxɛ ma.»

sentences.english: And there came to him James and John, the sons of Zebedee, saying to him, Master, will you give us whatever may be our request?
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Sebede xa die, Yaki nun Yaya, e naxa e maso Isa ra, e a fala a bɛ, «Karamɔxɔ, muxu wama a xɔn ma nɛ, muxu na fe naxan yo maxɔrin i ma, i xa na raba muxu bɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, What would you have me do for you?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo wama n xa munse raba wo bɛ?»

sentences.english: And they said to him, Let us be seated, one at your right hand and one at your left, in your glory.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Tin muxu bɛ, keren xa dɔxɔ i yirefanyi ma, boore fan xa dɔxɔ i kɔɔla ma i xa nɔrɛ kui.»

sentences.english: But Jesus said to them, You have no knowledge of what you are saying. Are you able to take of my cup? or to undergo the baptism which I am to undergo?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo mu a kolon wo fe naxan maxɔrinfe. Wo nɔma tinde tɔɔrɛ ra, alɔ n tan tinma a ra ki naxɛ? Wo nɔma tide tɔɔrɛ ya i naxan fafe n lide?»

sentences.english: And they said to him, We are able. And Jesus said to them, You will take of the cup from which I take; and the baptism which I am about to undergo you will undergo:
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Muxu nɔma.» Isa fan naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo fan yati fama ɲaxankatɛ sɔtɔde alɔ n tan. Wo fan fama tide n ma tɔɔrɛ bun ma naxan fafe n lide.

sentences.english: But to be seated at my right hand or at my left is not for me to give: but it is for those for whom it has been made ready.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ dɔxɔfe n yirefanyi nun n kɔɔla ma, na mu fatanma n tan xa ra. Na na mixie nan bɛ, a ragataxi naxee bɛ.»

sentences.english: And hearing this, the ten became very angry with James and John.
sentences.susu: Fɔxirabirɛ fu dɔnxɔɛ to na fe mɛ, e bɔɲɛ naxa te fɔlɔ Yaki nun Yaya ma.

sentences.english: And Jesus made them come to him, and said to them, You see that those who are made rulers over the Gentiles are lords over them, and their great ones have authority over them.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e xili a yire, a a masen e bɛ, «Wo a kolon, naxee kolonxi ɲamanɛ mangɛe ra, e mixie yamarima a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra, e e sɛnbɛ raminima e ma alako e xa mangɛya xa kolon.

sentences.english: But it is not so among you: but whoever has a desire to become great among you, let him be your servant:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a naxa lu na ki wo tan tagi. Mixi naxan wama a tide xa gbo wo ya ma, a xa findi wo malima nan na.

sentences.english: And whoever has a desire to be first among you, let him be servant of all.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan wama findife wo xa yarerati ra, a kanyi xa findi birin xa konyi nan na.

sentences.english: For truly the Son of man did not come to have servants, but to be a servant, and to give his life for the salvation of men.
sentences.susu: Hali Adama xa Di a faxi na nan ma. A mu faxi xɛ mixie xa wali a tan bɛ. A faxi nɛ alako a tan nan xa wali mixie bɛ, a xa mixi gbegbe xunsara a xa faxɛ saabui ra.»

sentences.english: And they came to Jericho: and when he was going out of Jericho, with his disciples and a great number of people, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind man, was seated by the wayside, with his hand out for money.
sentences.susu: E naxa so Yeriko. Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛe man to nu kelife naa, e nun ɲama gbegbe, Timeyo xa di xɛmɛ Baritimeyo nu dɔxɔxi kira dɛ ra kulɛ matide. Dɔnxui nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: And when it came to his ears that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he gave a cry, and said, Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me.
sentences.susu: A to a mɛ a Isa Nasarɛtika nan nu dangife naa, a naxa so a xilife a xui itexi ra, «Isa, Dawuda xa Di, kinikini n ma.»

sentences.english: And some of them, turning in protest, gave him an order to be quiet: but he went on crying out all the more, Son of David, have mercy on me.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa wɔyɛn dɔnxui ma a a xa a sabari, kɔnɔ a ɲan naxa a xui ite dangi a singe ra, a nu xili ti, «Dawuda xa Di, kinikini n ma.»

sentences.english: And Jesus came to a stop and said, Let him come. And crying out to the blind man, they said to him, Be comforted: come, he has sent for you.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa ti, a a fala, «Wo a xili.» E naxa dɔnxui xili, e a fala a bɛ, «Limaniya! Keli, Isa na i xilife!»

sentences.english: And he, putting off his coat, got up quickly, and came to Jesus.
sentences.susu: Dɔnxui naxa a xa donma binye wɔlɛ keren na, a keli, a tugan, a siga Isa yire.

sentences.english: And Jesus said to him, What would you have me do to you? And the blind man said, Master, make me able to see.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a maxɔrin, «I wama n xa munse raba i bɛ?» Dɔnxui naxa a yaabi, «Karamɔxɔ, n wama nɛ n ya xa se to.»

sentences.english: And Jesus said to him, Go on your way; your faith has made you well. And straight away he was able to see, and went after him in the way.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen a bɛ, «Siga, i xa danxaniya bara i rakisi.» A ya naxa se to keren na, a fa bira Isa fɔxɔ ra kira xɔn.

sentences.english: And when they came near to Jerusalem, to Beth-phage and Bethany, at the Mountain of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,
sentences.susu: E to makɔrɛ Darisalamu ra, e na Betifage nun Betani yire li, Oliwi geya mabiri, Isa naxa a fɔxirabirɛ mixi firin xɛɛ,

sentences.english: And said to them, Go into the little town opposite: and when you come to it, you will see a young ass with a cord round his neck, on which no man has ever been seated; let him loose, and come back with him.
sentences.susu: a a fala e bɛ, «Wo xa so taa kui naxan na yare. Wo nɛfɛ so naa, wo sofale lanma lima a xirixi na, mixi singe mu nu dɔxɔ naxan fari. Wo xa a fulun, wo fa a ra n xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And if anyone says to you, Why are you doing this? say, The Lord has need of him and will send him back straight away.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde fa sa wo maxɔrin, ‹Wo a fulunfe munfe ra,› wo xa a yaabi, ‹Marigi nan hayi na a ma. A a ragbilenma ya.›»

sentences.english: And they went away and saw a young ass by the door outside in the open street; and they were getting him loose.
sentences.susu: E to siga, e naxa a li sofale lanma xirixi naadɛ nde sɛɛti ma kira dɛ ra. E to a fulun,

sentences.english: And some of those who were there said to them, What are you doing, taking the ass?
sentences.susu: mixi naxee nu tixi naa, e naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo munse rabafe, wo to yi sofale lanma fulunxi?»

sentences.english: And they said to them the words which Jesus had said; and they let them go.
sentences.susu: E naxa e yaabi alɔ Isa a masen e bɛ ki naxɛ. Nee fan naxa e lu e xa siga.

sentences.english: And they took the young ass to Jesus, and put their clothing on him, and he got on his back.
sentences.susu: E to fa sofale lanma ra Isa xɔn, e naxa e xa donmae sa a fari, Isa fa a magoro a ma.

sentences.english: And a great number put down their clothing in the way; and others put down branches which they had taken from the fields.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe naxa e xa donmae itala kira xɔn ma, ndee fan naxa fɛnsɛ sɛgɛ, e nee fan sa kira xɔn ma Isa binyafe ra.

sentences.english: And those who went in front, and those who came after, were crying, Glory: A blessing on him who comes in the name of the Lord:
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxee nu ɲɛrɛfe Isa ya ra, a nun naxee nu ɲɛrɛfe a xanbi ra, e birin nu e xui itefe, e a fala, «Tantui na won Nakisima bɛ! Baraka na a bɛ naxan fafe Marigi xili ra!

sentences.english: A blessing on the coming kingdom of our father David: Glory in the highest.
sentences.susu: Baraka na won Baba Dawuda xa mangɛya bɛ naxan na fafe! Tantui na won Nakisima bɛ naxan na koore ma!»

sentences.english: And he went into Jerusalem into the Temple; and after looking round about on all things, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.
sentences.susu: Isa to so Darisalamu, a naxa siga hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui. A to gɛ naa rabilinyi birin matode, e nun a fɔxirabirɛ mixi fu nun firinyie naxa siga Betani, barima kɔɛ nu bara so.

sentences.english: And on the day after, when they had come out from Bethany, he was in need of food.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, e to nu kelife Betani, kaamɛ naxa Isa suxu.

sentences.english: And seeing a fig-tree in the distance with leaves, he went to see if by chance it had anything on it: and when he came to it, he saw nothing but leaves, for it was not the time for the fruit.
sentences.susu: A to xɔrɛ bili nde to, a ndedi makuyaxi e ra, a burɛxɛ na a kɔn na, a naxa sa na mato, xa a nɔma a bogi nde masɔtɔde. Kɔnɔ a to makɔrɛ xɔrɛ bili ra, a mu sese li a kɔn na fo a burɛxɛ, barima xɔrɛ bogi tɛmui mu nu a lixi.

sentences.english: And he said to it, Let no man take fruit from you for ever. And his disciples took note of his words.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala xɔrɛ bili bɛ, «Mixi yo naxa i tan bogi don sɔnɔn!» A fɔxirabirɛe fan naxa a xui mɛ.

sentences.english: And they came to Jerusalem; and he went into the Temple, and sent out those who were trading there, overturning the tables of the money-changers and the seats of those who were offering doves for money;
sentences.susu: E to siga Darisalamu, Isa naxa so hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, a sarematie nun saresoe keri fɔlɔ, naxee nu na naa. A naxa kɔbiri masarɛe xa teebilie nun ganbɛ matie xa dɔxɔsee rabira.

sentences.english: And he would not let any man take a vessel through the Temple.
sentences.susu: A man mu tin mixi yo xa dangi hɔrɔmɔbanxi sansanyi kui, e na findi e xa kote maxanin kira ra.

sentences.english: And he gave them teaching, and said to them, Is it not in the Writings, My house is to be named a house of prayer for all the nations? but you have made it a hole of thieves.
sentences.susu: A naxa e kawandi, a a masen, «A mu sɛbɛxi xɛ, ‹N ma banxi xili falama nɛ, si birin ma salide banxi›? Kɔnɔ wo tan bara a findi muɲɛtie dɔxɔde ra.»

sentences.english: And it came to the ears of the chief priests and scribes, and they took thought how they might put him to death; being in fear of him, because all the people were full of wonder at his teaching.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe to yi fe mɛ, e naxa fɛɛrɛ fen fɔlɔ e nɔma Isa faxade ki naxɛ. E nu gaaxuxi a ya ra, barima a nu ɲama birin dɛ ixarama a xa kawandi ra.

sentences.english: And every evening he went out of the town.
sentences.susu: Nunmare to so, Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛe man naxa keli taa kui.

sentences.english: And when they were going by in the morning, they saw the fig-tree dead from the roots.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, e to nu dangife, a fɔxirabirɛe naxa xɔrɛ bili to a bara xara han a sanke.

sentences.english: And Peter, having a memory of it, said to him, Master, see, the tree which was cursed by you is dead.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri to ratu, a naxa a fala Isa bɛ, «Karamɔxɔ, a mato, i xɔrɛ bili naxan danka, a bara xara gben.»

sentences.english: And Jesus, answering, said to them, Have God's faith.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo xa danxaniya Ala ma.
