sentences.english: Truly I say to you, Whoever says to this mountain, Be taken up and be put into the sea; and has no doubt in his heart, but has faith that what he says will come about, he will have his desire.
sentences.susu: N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, xa wo a fala yi geya bɛ, ‹Keli be, i sa sin baa ma,› xa na kanyi mu siikɛ a bɔɲɛ ma, a la a ra, a naxan falaxi a rabama nɛ, na fe rabama nɛ na kanyi bɛ.

sentences.english: For this reason I say to you, Whatever you make a request for in prayer, have faith that it has been given to you, and you will have it.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, n xa a fala wo bɛ, wo na Ala maxandi fefe ra, xa wo la a ra a wo bara a sɔtɔ, wo a sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: And whenever you make a prayer, let there be forgiveness in your hearts, if you have anything against anyone; so that you may have forgiveness for your sins from your Father who is in heaven.
sentences.susu: Wo na ti Ala maxandide tɛmui naxɛ, xa fe nde na wo nun mixi nde tagi, wo xa diɲɛ a ma, alako wo Baba naxan na ariyanna, a fan xa diɲɛ wo xa yunubie ma.»
<range>

sentences.english: And they came again to Jerusalem: and while he was walking in the Temple, there came to him the chief priests and the scribes and those in authority:
sentences.susu: E man naxa so Darisalamu. Isa to nu a ɲɛrɛfe hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie, sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe, nun Yuwifie xa forie naxa fa a yire,

sentences.english: And they said to him, By what authority do you do these things? or who gave you authority to do these things?
sentences.susu: e a maxɔrin, «I yi fee rabama nde xa yaamari ma? Nde yi sɛnbɛ fixi i ma, i xa yi fee raba?»

sentences.english: And Jesus said to them, I will put to you one question; give me an answer, and I will say by what authority I do these things.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «N fan xa wo maxɔrin fe keren ma. Xa wo n yaabi, n a falama nɛ wo bɛ n yi fee rabama naxan ma yaamari ma.

sentences.english: The baptism of John, was it from heaven or from men? give me an answer.
sentences.susu: Yaya to nu mixie xunxama ye xɔɔra, Ala nan a xɛɛxi ba, ka adama? Wo n yaabi.»

sentences.english: And they gave thought to it among themselves, saying, If we say, From heaven; he will say, Why then did you not have faith in him?
sentences.susu: Na kui e naxa so wɔyɛnfe e bore tagi, «Xa won na a yaabi, won naxɛ, ‹Ala,› a a falama nɛ won bɛ, ‹Munfe ra wo mu fa la a ra?›

sentences.english: But if we say, From men — they were in fear of the people, because all took John to be truly a prophet.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ won na a yaabi, ‹Adama,› na fan findima fe nan na won bɛ.» E nu gaaxuxi ɲama nan ya ra, barima birin Yaya maɲɔxunxi namiɲɔnmɛ yati nan na.

sentences.english: And they said in answer to Jesus, We have no idea. And Jesus said to them, And I will not say to you by what authority I do these things.
sentences.susu: Na kui, e naxa Isa yaabi, «Muxu mu a kolon.» Isa fan naxa a masen e bɛ, «N fan mu a falama wo bɛ n yi fee rabama naxan ma yaamari ma.»

sentences.english: And he gave them teaching in the form of stories. A man had a vine-garden planted, and put a wall about it, and made a place for crushing out the wine, and put up a tower, and let it out to field-workers, and went into another country.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa so taali wɔyɛnyie falafe e bɛ, a a masen, «Xɛmɛ nde naxa wɛni bilie si. A naxa tɛtɛ rabilin bɔxi ra, a baye ti, a yili ge wɛni bogi bunduma dɛnnaxɛ. Na xanbi, a naxa na hɛri bɔxi rawalie ma, a fa biyaasi.»

sentences.english: And when the time came, he sent a servant to get from the workmen some of the fruit of the garden.
sentences.susu: «Wɛni bogi ba tɛmui to a li, bɔxi kanyi naxa konyi nde xɛɛ bɔxi rawalie xɔn ma, e xa wɛni bogi nde so a yi ra.

sentences.english: And they took him, and gave him blows, and sent him away with nothing.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ, bɔxi rawalie naxa na konyi suxu, e a bɔnbɔ, e a ragbilen a bɛlɛxɛ igeli ra.»

sentences.english: And again he sent to them another servant; and they gave him wounds on the head, and were very cruel to him.
sentences.susu: «Bɔxi kanyi man naxa konyi gbɛtɛ xɛɛ e xɔn ma. E naxa na fan bɔnbɔ a xunyi ma, e a konbi a mayaagixi ra.

sentences.english: And he sent another; and they put him to death: and a number of others, whipping some, and putting some to death.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi kanyi man to mixi gbɛtɛ xɛɛ, e naxa na tan faxa. Bɔxi kanyi mixi wuyaxi gbɛtɛe xɛɛ nɛ e xɔn ma na ki. E naxa ndee bɔnbɔ, e ndee faxa.»

sentences.english: He still had one, a dearly loved son: he sent him last to them, saying, They will have respect for my son.
sentences.susu: «Bɔxi kanyi xa di xanuxi kerenyi nan nu fa luxi. A dɔnxɔɛ ra, a naxa na xɛɛ e xɔn ma, barima a nu bara a fala, ‹E n ma di tan binyama nɛ.›

sentences.english: But those workmen said among themselves, This is he who will one day be the owner of the property; come, let us put him to death, and the heritage will be ours.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yi bɔxi rawalie naxa a fala e bore bɛ, ‹Yi nan na kɛ tongoma ra, wo fa, won xa a faxa alako kɛ xa findi won gbe ra.›

sentences.english: And they took him and put him to death, pushing his body out of the garden.
sentences.susu: E naxa a suxu, e a faxa, e fa a woli tɛtɛ xanbi ra.»

sentences.english: What then will the master of the garden do? He will come and put the workmen to death, and will give the garden into the hands of others.
sentences.susu: «Na kui, bɔxi kanyi munse rabama fa? A sigama nɛ naa, a bɔxi rawalie faxa, a a xa bɔxi so mixi gbɛtɛe yi.

sentences.english: Have you not seen this which is in the Writings: The stone which the builders put on one side, the same was made the chief stone of the building:
sentences.susu: Wo mu nu yi masenyi xaran Kitaabui kui? ‹Banxitie mɛɛ gɛmɛ naxan na, a bara findi tuxui gɛmɛ hagigɛ ra.

sentences.english: This was the Lord's doing, and it is a wonder in our eyes?
sentences.susu: Marigi fɔxi nan a ra. Fe makaabaxi nan ya won bɛ.›»

sentences.english: And they made attempts to take him; but they were in fear of the people, because they saw that the story was against them; and they went away from him.
sentences.susu: A nu wɔyɛnfe naxee bɛ, e naxa a kolon a Isa yi taali wɔyɛnyi masenxi e tan nan bɛ. E nu katafe e xa a suxu, kɔnɔ e nu gaaxuxi ɲama nan ya ra. Na kui, e naxa keli a xun, e siga.

sentences.english: Then they sent to him certain of the Pharisees and the Herodians, so that they might make use of his words to take him by a trick.
sentences.susu: E naxa Farisɛni nun Herode fɔxirabirɛ ndee xɛɛ Isa xɔn alako e xa gantanyi te a bɛ, e xa a masɔtɔ wɔyɛnyi kui.

sentences.english: And when they had come, they said to him, Master, we are certain that you are true, and have no fear of anyone: you have no respect for a man's position, but you are teaching the true way of God: Is it right to give taxes to Caesar or not?
sentences.susu: E to siga a yire, e naxa a fala a bɛ, «Karamɔxɔ, muxu a kolon nɔndi falɛ nan i ra. I mu gaaxuma mixi yo xɔn, barima i mu mixi rafisama e booree bɛ. I mixie xaranma Ala xa kira nan na a nɔndi ki ma. A lanma ka a mu lanma muxu xa duuti fi Rɔma mangɛ ma? Muxu xa a fi, ka muxu naxa a fi?»

sentences.english: Are we to give or not to give? But he, conscious of their false hearts, said to them, Why do you put me to the test? give me a penny, so that I may see it.
sentences.susu: Isa to e xa filankafuiɲa kolon, a naxa e yaabi, «Wo katafe n masɔtɔde munfe ra? Wo fa gbeti kɔbiri kole keren na n xɔn ma, n xa a mato.»

sentences.english: And they gave him one. And he said to them, Whose is this image and name on it? And they said to him, Caesar's.
sentences.susu: E to fa keren na, a naxa e maxɔrin, «Nde xili nun misaali na yi kɔbiri kole ma yi ki?» E naxa a yaabi, «Rɔma Mangɛ gbe.»

sentences.english: And Jesus said to them, Give to Caesar the things which are Caesar's, and to God the things which are God's. And they were full of wonder at him.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo mangɛ gbe ragbilen mangɛ ma, wo Ala fan gbe ragbilen Ala ma.» E fan naxa kaaba Isa xa fe ma.

sentences.english: And there came to him Sadducees, who say there is no coming back from the dead; and they put a question to him, saying,
sentences.susu: Sadusenie, naxee a falama a faxamixie mu kelima faxɛ ma, e naxa fa yi maxɔrinyi ra Isa xɔn ma,

sentences.english: Master, in the law Moses says, If a man's brother comes to his end, and has a wife still living and no child, it is right for his brother to take his wife, and get a family for his brother.
sentences.susu: «Karamɔxɔ, Annabi Munsa yi nan sɛbɛ muxu bɛ Kitaabui kui, ‹Xa xɛmɛ nde taara faxa, a naxa a xa ginɛ lu a mu di yo bari, a na xunya nan na ginɛ dɔxɔma, alako a xa bɔnsɔɛ fi a taara ma.›

sentences.english: There were seven brothers: and the first took a wife, and at his death there were no offspring;
sentences.susu: Na kui, xɛmɛ nde naxa di xɛmɛ solofere sɔtɔ. A xa di singe naxa ginɛ dɔxɔ, a faxa, a mu bɔnsɔɛ yo lu.

sentences.english: And the second took her, and at his death there were no offspring; and the third the same:
sentences.susu: A xanbiratoe naxa na kaaɲɛ ginɛ tongo, kɔnɔ a fan naxa faxa, a mu bɔnsɔɛ yo lu. Na nan man naba na fan xanbiratoe ra.

sentences.english: And all the seven had no seed. Last of all the woman herself came to her death.
sentences.susu: Yi mixi solofere birin, e sese mu bɔnsɔɛ lu. A dɔnxɔɛ ra, ginɛ fan naxa faxa.

sentences.english: In the future life, when they come back from the dead, whose wife will she be? for the seven had her for a wife.
sentences.susu: Na kui, marakeli lɔxɔɛ, na ginɛ to dɔxɔxi yi mixi solofere birin xɔn ma, a sa findima nde gbe ra?»

sentences.english: Jesus said to them, Is not this the reason for your error, that you have no knowledge of the holy Writings or of the power of God?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo mu Ala xa Kitaabui kolon, wo mu Ala sɛnbɛ fan kolon. Wo xa tantanyi kelide xa mu na ki?

sentences.english: When they come back from the dead, they do not get married, but are like the angels in heaven.
sentences.susu: Mixie na keli faxɛ ma marakeli lɔxɔɛ, xɛmɛ mu ginɛ dɔxɔma, ginɛ fan mu dɔxɔma xɛmɛ xɔn. E luma nɛ alɔ malekɛe na ariyanna ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But as to the dead coming back to life; have you not seen in the book of Moses, about the burning thorn-tree, how God said to him, I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?
sentences.susu: A falafe tan, a faxamixie mu kelima faxɛ ma, wo mu nu Annabi Munsa xa Kitaabui xaran, wuri bili xa fe falaxi dɛnnaxɛ? Ala a masen nɛ a bɛ, ‹N tan nan na Marigi Alatala ra, Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Yaxuba naxan batuma.›

sentences.english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living: you are greatly in error.
sentences.susu: Faxamixie xa mu Ala batuma, fo naxee baloxi. Na tan findixi wo bɛ tantanyi nan na.»

sentences.english: And one of the scribes came, and hearing their argument together, and seeing that he had given them a good answer, put the question to him, Which law is the first of all?
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ nde naxa a maso e ra, a a tuli mati e xa wɔyɛnyi ra. A to a to a Isa bara yaabi fanyi fi, a naxa a maxɔrin, «Sɛriyɛ mundun tide gbo sɛriyɛ birin ya ma?»

sentences.english: Jesus said in answer, The first is, Give ear, O Israel: The Lord our God is one Lord;
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «A singe nan yi ki, ‹Isirayila, i tuli mati, won Marigi Ala, Marigi keren peti na a ra.

sentences.english: And you are to have love for the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.
sentences.susu: I xa i Marigi Ala xanu i bɔɲɛ birin na, i nii birin na, i xaxili birin na, a nun i sɛnbɛ birin na.›

sentences.english: The second is this, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself. There is no other law greater than these.
sentences.susu: A firin nde nan yi ki, ‹I xa i ngaxakerenyi xanu alɔ i i yɛtɛ xanuxi ki naxɛ.› Sɛriyɛ gbɛtɛ yo mu na naxan dangi nee ra.»

sentences.english: And the scribe said to him, Truly, Master, you have well said that he is one, and there is no other but he:
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ naxa a fala Isa bɛ, «I nɔndi, karamɔxɔ. I bara nɔndi masen a Ala keren peti nan a ra, a boore mu na, fo a keren.

sentences.english: And to have love for him with all the heart, and with all the mind, and with all the strength, and to have the same love for his neighbour as for himself, is much more than all forms of offerings.
sentences.susu: Mixi xa a xanu a bɔɲɛ birin na, a xaxili birin na, a nun a sɛnbɛ birin na. Mixi man xa a ngaxakerenyi xanu alɔ a a yɛtɛ xanuxi ki naxɛ. Nee rabatufe dangi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxi nun sɛrɛxɛ birin na.»

sentences.english: And when Jesus saw that he gave a wise answer, he said to him, You are not far from the kingdom of God. And every man after that was in fear of questioning him any more.
sentences.susu: Isa to a to, a a bara xaxilimaya yaabi fi, a naxa a masen a bɛ, «A gbe mu luxi i xa so Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma.» Na xanbi, mixi yo mu suusa Isa maxɔrinde sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And Jesus, when he was teaching in the Temple, said, How do the scribes say that the Christ is the Son of David?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa kawandi ti fɔlɔ hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui. «Munfe ra sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe a falama, a Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi findixi Dawuda xa di nan na?

sentences.english: David himself said in the Holy Spirit, The Lord said to my Lord, Be seated at my right hand, till I put those who are against you under your feet.
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra, Dawuda yɛtɛ a masen nɛ, ‹Marigi bara a masen n Marigi bɛ, “I magoro n yirefanyi ma, han beemanun n xa i yaxuie ragoro i sanyi bun.”›»

sentences.english: David himself gives him the name of Lord; and how then is he his son? And the common people gave ear to him gladly.
sentences.susu: «Dawuda yɛtɛ yati a falama a bɛ, ‹N Marigi›. Dawuda fa nɔma findide a baba ra di?» Ɲama gbegbe nu e tuli matima a ra, a xa kawandi nu rafan e ma.

sentences.english: And in his teaching he said, Be on your watch against the scribes, whose pleasure it is to go about in long robes and be respected in the market-places,
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ a xa kawandi kui, «Wo wo yɛtɛ ratanga sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe ma. A rafan e ma e xa e maɲɛrɛ guba xungbe ragoroxi e ma, mixie xa nu e xɛɛbu taa kui binyɛ xɛɛbuie ra.

sentences.english: And to have the chief seats in the Synagogues and the first places at feasts;
sentences.susu: E wama dɔxɔfe salide safɛ singee, e man xa binyɛ sɔtɔ xulunyi.

sentences.english: Who take away the property of widows, and before the eyes of men make long prayers; these will be judged more hardly.
sentences.susu: E kaaɲɛ ginɛe harige muɲama. E salima a xɔnkuye ra, alako mixie xa e to. Gbaloe naxan nagataxi e bɛ, a gbo ki fanyi.»

sentences.english: And he took a seat by the place where the money was kept, and saw how the people put money into the boxes: and a number who had wealth put in much.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa dɔxɔ salide kui, a ya rafindixi kɔbiri kankira ma, a nu mixie mato e kɔbiri sama a kui ki naxɛ. Bannamixi wuyaxi nu kɔbiri gbegbe safe.

sentences.english: And there came a poor widow, and she put in two little bits of money, which make a farthing.
sentences.susu: Kaaɲɛ ginɛ misikiinɛ fan to fa, a tan naxa kɔbiri kole firin sa naxee yusi mu gbo.

sentences.english: And he made his disciples come to him, and said to them, Truly I say to you, This poor widow has put in more than all those who are putting money into the box:
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa naxa a fɔxirabirɛe xili, a a masen e bɛ, «N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, yi kaaɲɛ ginɛ misikiinɛ xa kɔbiri saxi gbo dangi birin gbe ra naxee bara kɔbiri sa kankira kui.

sentences.english: Because they all put in something out of what they had no need for; but she out of her need put in all she had, even all her living.
sentences.susu: E tan xa hadiya kelixi e xa naafuli nan kui, kɔnɔ yi kaaɲɛ ginɛ tan xa hadiya kelixi a xa baloe nan kui.»

sentences.english: And when he was going out of the Temple, one of his disciples said to him, Master, see, what stones and what buildings!
sentences.susu: Isa to mini hɔrɔmɔbanxi, a fɔxirabirɛ keren naxa a fala a bɛ, «Karamɔxɔ, yi banxie mato, e tixi gɛmɛ xungbe naxee ra, e ti ki man tofanxi ki naxɛ!»

sentences.english: And Jesus said to him, Do you see these great buildings? there is not one stone here resting on another which will not be overturned.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «I yi banxi belebelee toxi? Yi gɛmɛ keren mu luma a boore fari be, a birin nabirama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And while he was seated on the Mountain of Olives opposite the Temple, Peter and James and John and Andrew said to him privately,
sentences.susu: Isa to nu magoroxi Oliwi geya fari, a ya rafindixi hɔrɔmɔbanxi ma, Piyɛri, Yaki, Yaya, nun Andire naxa a maxɔrin e doro ma,

sentences.english: Say when these things will be, and what will be the sign when these things are all about to be done.
sentences.susu: «Na fe sa rabama mun tɛmui? A man sa kolonma tɔnxuma mundun ma a a fafe rabade?»

sentences.english: And Jesus said to them, Take care that you are not tricked by anyone.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa so wɔyɛnfe e bɛ, «Wo wo mɛɛni.

sentences.english: People will come in my name, saying, I am he; and a number will be turned from the true way.
sentences.susu: Mixi wuyaxi fama n tan xili falade e yɛtɛ xun ma a falafe ra, ‹N tan nan na Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra!› Na kui, e fama mixi gbegbe ratantande.

sentences.english: And when you have news of wars and talk of wars, do not be troubled; these things have to be, but it is still not the end.
sentences.susu: Wo na gere fe mɛ, wo na gere nde xili mɛ, wo naxa kɔntɔfili, barima fo na fe mɔɔlie xa raba. Na xa mu findima duniɲa raɲɔnyi ra sinden.

sentences.english: Nation will go to war with nation, and kingdom with kingdom: there will be earth-shocks in different places; there will be times when there is no food; these things are the first of the troubles.
sentences.susu: Sie kelima nɛ e boore xili ma, ɲamanɛe e boore gere. Bɔxi fama nɛ sɛrɛnde yire wuyaxi, kaamɛ fan sin bɔxi ma. Na birin findima mantɔɔrɔli fɔlɛ nan na.»

sentences.english: But take care: for they will give you up to the Sanhedrins; and in Synagogues you will be whipped; and you will be taken before rulers and kings because of me, for a sign to them.
sentences.susu: «Wo xa mɛɛni wo yɛtɛ ma, barima e wo soma nɛ kiitisae yi ra, e wo bɔnbɔ salide banxie kui. Wo tima nɛ gominae nun mangɛe ya i n tan ma fe ra, wo findima nɛ n ma seedee ra e tan bɛ.

sentences.english: And the good news has first to be given to all the nations.
sentences.susu: Fo xibaaru fanyi xa kawandi si birin bɛ sinden.

sentences.english: And when you are taken and given up to be judged, do not be troubled about what to say: but whatever is given to you in that hour, say: because it is not you who say it, but the Holy Spirit.
sentences.susu: E na wo xanin wo makiitide tɛmui naxɛ, wo naxa kɔntɔfili wo xa masenyi xa fe ra beenun wo xa a ti. Ala na wɔyɛnyi naxan yo fi wo ma na waxati ma, wo xa na nan fala, barima wo tan xa mu wɔyɛnma, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nan fama wɔyɛnde.»

sentences.english: And brother will give up brother to death, and the father his child; and children will go against their fathers and mothers, and put them to death.
sentences.susu: «Mixi fama a ngaxakerenyi yanfade, a a sa mixie bɛlɛxɛ, e xa a faxa. Babɛ fan na mɔɔli niyama a xa di ra, die fan kelima nɛ e barimae xili ma, e xa e faxa.

sentences.english: And you will be hated by all men, because of my name; but he who goes through to the end will have salvation.
sentences.susu: Mixi birin fama wo xɔnde n tan ma fe ra, kɔnɔ naxan na a tunnabɛxi han a raɲɔnyi, na kanyi kisima nɛ.»

sentences.english: But when you see the unclean thing which makes destruction, in the place where it has no right to be (let this be clear to the reader), then let those who are in Judaea go quickly to the mountains:
sentences.susu: «Wo tan naxee na yi xaranfe, wo wo tuli mati de! Wo na se haramuxi ɲaaxi to kasarɛ na naxan xanbi ra, a tixi yire a mu lan a xa ti dɛnnaxɛ, wo tan naxee na Yudaya na tɛmui, wo xa wo gi geyae fari.

sentences.english: And let him who is on the house-top not go down, or go in, to take anything out of his house:
sentences.susu: Naxan na tande, a naxa so sese tongode a xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: And let not him who is in the field go back to take his coat.
sentences.susu: Naxan na xɛ ma, a naxa gbilen a xa xinbeli donma tongode.

sentences.english: And it will be hard for women who are with child and for her who has a baby at the breast in those days.
sentences.susu: Na waxati findima gbaloe nan na furuginɛe nun dingɛe bɛ!

sentences.english: And say a prayer that it may not be in the winter.
sentences.susu: Wo Ala maxandi na naxa wo li ɲɛmɛ tɛmui!

sentences.english: For in those days there will be sorrow, such as there has not been from the time when God made the world till now, and will not ever be again.
sentences.susu: Barima tɔɔrɛ a lima na waxati ma, naxan maniyɛ singe mu nu to kabi Ala naxa duniɲa daa, a man mu gbilenma to ra abadan.

sentences.english: And if the Lord had not made the time short, no flesh would have been kept from destruction; but because of the saints he has made the time short.
sentences.susu: Xa Marigi mu a ragirixi nu nde xa ba na xi kɔnti ra, adama yo mu kisima nu. Kɔnɔ a nde baxi a kɔnti ra mixi sugandixie nan xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And then if any man says to you, See, here is Christ; or, See, there; have no faith in it:
sentences.susu: «Xa mixi nde sa a fala wo bɛ, ‹A mato, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi na be›, xa na mu a ra, ‹Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi na mɛnni,› wo naxa la a ra.

sentences.english: Because there will be false Christs and false prophets, and they will give signs and wonders in the hope of turning even the saints from the true way.
sentences.susu: Barima wule falɛe fama Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xili falade e yɛtɛ xun, xa na mu e e yɛtɛ findi namiɲɔnmɛe ra. E fama tɔnxuma makaabaxie nun kaabanakoe rabade alako e xa Ala xa mixi sugandixie ratantan, xa e sa nɔma.

sentences.english: But take care; see, I have made all things clear to you before the time.
sentences.susu: Wo mɛɛni wo yɛtɛ ma. N bara fe birin masen wo bɛ beenun a waxati xa a li.»

sentences.english: But in those days, after that time of trouble, the sun will be made dark and the moon will not give her light,
sentences.susu: «Na ɲaxankatɛ waxati dangi xanbi, ‹soge ifɔɔrɔma nɛ, kike yanbɛ bama nɛ,

sentences.english: And the stars will be falling from heaven, and the powers which are in the heavens will be moved.
sentences.susu: tunbuie birama nɛ bɔxi, se naxan birin na koore ma a sɛrɛnma nɛ.›»

sentences.english: And then they will see the Son of man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
sentences.susu: «Na tɛmui Adama xa Di toma nɛ fa ra nuxui kui, sɛnbɛ nun nɔrɛ ra.

sentences.english: And then he will send out the angels, and will get together his saints from the four winds, from the farthest part of the earth to the farthest part of heaven.
sentences.susu: A a xa malekɛe xɛɛma nɛ duniɲa tunxun naani birin na, e xa sa a xa mixi sugandixie malan keli sɛɛti han sɛɛti.»

sentences.english: Take an example from the fig-tree: when its branches become soft and put out their leaves, you see that the summer is near;
sentences.susu: «Wo xɔrɛ bili mato misaali ra, wo xa xaxili sɔtɔ. A salonyi na ɲingi, a burɛxɛ nɛɛnɛ naxa mini, wo a kolonma nɛ ɲɛmɛ bara makɔrɛ.

sentences.english: Even so, when you see these things taking place, you may be certain that he is near, even at the doors.
sentences.susu: Adama xa Di fafe fan na na ki nɛ. Wo na yi fe birin to raba ra, wo xa a kolon Adama xa Di bara makɔrɛ, a ɲan tixi naadɛ ra.

sentences.english: Truly, I say to you, This generation will not come to an end till all these things are complete.
sentences.susu: N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, to mixie mu dangima fo na fe birin naba.

sentences.english: Heaven and earth will come to an end, but my words will not come to an end.
sentences.susu: Koore nun bɔxi dangima nɛ, kɔnɔ n ma masenyi tan mu dangima abadan.»

sentences.english: But of that day or that hour no one has knowledge, not even the angels in heaven, or the Son, but the Father.
sentences.susu: «Mixi yo mu a kolon yi fee sa rabama lɔxɔɛ nun waxati yo ma. Hali malekɛ naxee na ariyanna, e mu a kolon, Ala xa Di fan mu a kolon, fo Baba Ala keren peti.

sentences.english: Take care, keep watch with prayer: for you are not certain when the time will be.
sentences.susu: Wo mɛɛni wo yɛtɛ ma, wo naxa yanfa, barima wo fan mu a kolon yi fee sa kamalima tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: It is as when a man who is in another country for a time, having gone away from his house, and given authority to his servants and to everyone his work, gives the porter an order to keep watch.
sentences.susu: «A maniyaxi xɛmɛ nan na, naxan na sigafe biyaasi. A na keli a xa fɔxɔɛ xun, a na birin taxuma a xa konyie ra, a kankan ti a xa wali dɛ, a man a fala naadɛ kantɛ bɛ, a a naxa yanfa.

sentences.english: So you are to keep watch: because you are not certain when the master of the house is coming, in the evening, or in the middle of the night, or at the cock's cry, or in the morning;
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo naxa yanfa. Xa fɔxɔɛ kanyi gbilenma nunmare nan na ba, xa na mu kɔɛ tagi, xa na mu konkore dɛya singe, xa na mu gɛɛsɛgɛ, wo mu a waxati yo kolon.

sentences.english: For fear that, coming suddenly, he sees you sleeping.
sentences.susu: Xa a fa wo tɛrɛnna, a naxa a li de wo xife!

sentences.english: And what I say to you, I say to all, Keep watch.
sentences.susu: N naxan falama wo bɛ, n na nan a falama birin bɛ: Wo naxa yanfa!»

sentences.english: It was now two days before the feast of the Passover and the unleavened bread: and the chief priests and the scribes made designs how they might take him by deceit and put him to death:
sentences.susu: Xi firin nan nu luxi beenun Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali xa a li, naxan man xili falama Taami Lɛbinitare Sali. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe nu na fɛɛrɛ fenfe e xa Isa suxu yanfanteya saabui ra, e xa a faxa.

sentences.english: But they said, Not while the feast is going on, for fear there may be trouble among the people.
sentences.susu: E naxa lan a ma, «Won naxa a suxu sali lɔxɔɛ, xa na mu a ra ɲama a xunyi kelima nɛ.»

sentences.english: And while he was in Bethany in the house of Simon the leper, seated at table, there came a woman with a bottle of perfumed oil of great price; and when the bottle was broken she put the perfume on his head.
sentences.susu: Isa to nu na Betani, Simɔn kunɛ kanyi xɔnyi, a a dɛgefe teebili ra, ginɛ nde naxa fa. Narada labundɛ ture nu na a yi ra, naxan sare xɔrɔxɔ ki fanyi. A nu saxi a bitirɛ tofanyi kui naxan nu rafalaxi alabatira gɛmɛ ra. Ginɛ to bitirɛ dɛ rabi, a naxa labundɛ ture sa Isa xunyi.

sentences.english: But some of them were angry among themselves, saying, For what purpose has this oil been wasted?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi ndee nu na naa, e naxa xɔnɔ, e a fala e bore bɛ, «Yi labundɛ ture makanaxi yi mɔɔli ra munfe ra?

sentences.english: We might have got more than three hundred pence for it, and given the money to the poor. And they said things against her among themselves.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa mati nɛ nu, a sare nɔma dangide walikɛ xa ɲɛ keren wali sare ra, na kɔbiri fan nɔ fide setaree ma.» E bɔɲɛ naxa te ginɛ xili ma.

sentences.english: But Jesus said, Let her be; why are you troubling her? she has done a kind act to me.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa naxa a masen, «Wo yi ginɛ lu na. Wo na a tɔɔrɔfe munfe ra? Kɛwali fanyi nan yi ki, a naxan nabaxi n bɛ.

sentences.english: The poor you have ever with you, and whenever you have the desire you may do them good: but me you have not for ever.
sentences.susu: Setaree luma nɛ wo ya ma tɛmui birin. Wo na wa a xɔn ma tɛmui yo, wo nɔma fe fanyi rabade e bɛ, kɔnɔ n tan mu luma wo yi ra be abadan xɛ.

sentences.english: She has done what she was able: she has put oil on my body to make it ready for its last resting-place.
sentences.susu: Yi ginɛ nɔxi naxan na, a na nan nabaxi. A labundɛ saxi n ma n ma maragatɛ lɔxɔɛ nan ma fe ra.

sentences.english: And truly I say to you, Wherever the good news goes out through all the earth, what this woman has done will be talked of in memory of her.
sentences.susu: N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, Ala xa xibaaru fanyi sa kawandima dɛdɛ duniɲa birin kui, yi ginɛ xa kɛwali xa fe fan falama nɛ, mixie xa e ratu a xa fe ma.»

sentences.english: And Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, so that he might give him up to them.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Yudasi Isikariyoti, naxan nu na Isa fɔxirabirɛ fu nun firinyie ya ma, a naxa siga sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie yire, e xa wɔyɛn alako a xa Isa sa e bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And hearing what he said, they were glad, and gave him their word to make him a payment of money. And he took thought how he might best give him up to them.
sentences.susu: E to a mɛ, e naxa ɲɛlɛxin ki fanyi ra, e kɔbiri laayidi tongo a bɛ. Na kui, Yudasi naxa so waxati fenfe a nɔma Isa sade e bɛlɛxɛ tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And on the first day of unleavened bread, when the Passover lamb is put to death, his disciples said to him, Where are we to go and make ready for you to take the Passover meal?
sentences.susu: Taami Lɛbinitare Sali to a li, a lɔxɔɛ singe, yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ bama sɛrɛxɛ ra lɔxɔ naxɛ, Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa a maxɔrin, «I wama muxu xa sa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali donyi rafala i bɛ minden?»

sentences.english: And he sent two of his disciples, and said to them, Go into the town, and there will come to you a man with a vessel of water: go after him;
sentences.susu: A naxa a fɔxirabirɛ mixi firin xɛɛ, a a fala e bɛ, «Wo siga taa kui. Wo naralanma xɛmɛ nde ra, ye fɛɲɛ dɔxɔxi a xun. Wo xa bira a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And wherever he goes in, say to the owner of the house, The Master says, Where is my guest-room, where I may take the Passover with my disciples?
sentences.susu: A na so dɛnnaxɛ, wo xa a fala na banxi kanyi bɛ, ‹Karamɔxɔ wama a kolonfe a nɔma Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali donyi donde dɛnnaxɛ, a tan nun a fɔxirabirɛe.›

sentences.english: And he will take you up himself to a great room with a table and seats: there make ready for us.
sentences.susu: A fama banxi kui xungbe masende wo bɛ koore ra, se birin yailanxi naa a fanyi ra. Wo xa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali donyi rafala mɛnni.»

sentences.english: And the disciples went out and came into the town, and saw that it was as he had said: and they made ready the Passover.
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛe naxa siga, e so taa kui, e fe birin li alɔ Isa a masen e bɛ ki naxɛ. E naxa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali donyi rafala.

sentences.english: And when it was evening he came with the twelve.
sentences.susu: Nunmare to so, Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛ fu nun firinyie naxa fa.

sentences.english: And while they were seated taking food, Jesus said, Truly I say to you, One of you will be false to me, one who is taking food with me.
sentences.susu: E nu na e dɛgefe teebili ra tɛmui naxɛ, Isa naxa a masen, «N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, wo tan naxee na wo dɛgefe n fɛ ma yi ki, mixi keren na wo ya ma naxan fafe n yanfade.»

sentences.english: They were sad, and said to him one by one, Is it I?
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛe naxa sunnun fɔlɔ, kankan nu fa Isa maxɔrin, «N tan mu a ra?»

sentences.english: And he said to them, It is one of the twelve, one who is putting his bread with me into the same plate.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «A kanyi na wo tan mixi fu nun firinyie ya ma, n nun naxan bɛlɛxɛ ragoroma paani keren kui.

sentences.english: The Son of man goes, even as the Writings say of him: but cursed is that man through whom the Son of man is given up! It would have been well for that man if he had never been given birth.
sentences.susu: Adama xa Di sigama nɛ alɔ a xa fe sɛbɛxi ki naxɛ, kɔnɔ gbaloe nan na Adama xa Di yanfama bɛ. A fisa na kanyi bɛ hali a mu bari nu.»

sentences.english: And while they were taking food, he took bread, and after blessing it, he gave the broken bread to them, and said, Take it: this is my body.
sentences.susu: E to nu e dɛgefe, Isa naxa taami tongo. A to tantui rasiga Ala ma, a naxa taami igira, a a so a fɔxirabirɛe yi ra, a a fala e bɛ, «Wo n ko, wo a don. Yi findixi n fate nan na.»

sentences.english: And he took a cup, and when he had given praise, he gave it to them: and they all had a drink from it.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Isa naxa tɔnbili fan tongo. A man to tantui rasiga Ala ma, a naxa tɔnbili so e yi ra, e birin naxa a min.

sentences.english: And he said to them, This is my blood of the testament, which is given for men.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Yi findixi n wuli nan na, saatɛ wuli naxan baxi mixi gbegbe bɛ.

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, I will take no more of the fruit of the vine till the day when I take it new in the kingdom of God.
sentences.susu: N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, n to yi wɛni minfe yi ki, n mu yi minma sɔnɔn, han won birin man sa a minma lɔxɔ naxɛ Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma.»

sentences.english: And after a song of praise to God they went out to the Mountain of Olives.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ bɛɛti bade, e naxa te Oliwi geya fari.

sentences.english: And Jesus said to them, You will all be turned away from me: for it is in the Writings, I will put the keeper of the sheep to death, and the sheep will be put to flight.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, «Wo birin gbilenma nɛ n fɔxɔ ra, barima a sɛbɛxi, ‹N xuruse dɛmadonyi faxama nɛ, yɛxɛɛe fan yensen.›

sentences.english: But after I have come back from the dead, I will go before you into Galilee.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n na keli faxɛ ma, n sigama wo ya ra Galile.»

sentences.english: But Peter said to him, Though the others may be turned away from you, I will not.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a fala a bɛ, «Hali birin gbilen i fɔxɔ ra, n tan mu gbilenma i fɔxɔ ra!»

sentences.english: And Jesus said to him, Truly, I say to you that you, today, even this night, before the cock's second cry, will say three times that you have no knowledge of me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa Piyɛri yaabi, «N xa nɔndi fala i bɛ, to kɔɛ yati, beenun konkore xa a rate dɛya firin, i i yɛtɛ rasanma nɛ n ma sanmaya saxan.»

sentences.english: But he said with passion, If I have to be put to death with you, I will not be false to you. And they all said the same.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Piyɛri naxa a fala sɛnbɛ ra, «Hali won birin nan sa faxama, n mu n yɛtɛ rasanma i ma!» Isa fɔxirabirɛ birin naxa gbilen na wɔyɛn keren fala ra.

sentences.english: And they came to a place which was named Gethsemane: and he said to his disciples, Be seated here while I say a prayer.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛe naxa siga yire nde, dɛnnaxɛ xili Getesemani. Isa naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo dɔxɔ be. N tan xa sa Ala maxandi.»

sentences.english: And he took with him Peter and James and John, and grief and great trouble came on him.
sentences.susu: A naxa Piyɛri, Yaki, nun Yaya xanin a xun ma. Ɲaxankatɛ nun kɔntɔfili naxa Isa bɔɲɛ suxu.

sentences.english: And he said to them, My soul is very sad, even to death: be here a little time, and keep watch.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen e bɛ, «Sunnunyi bara nɔ n bɔɲɛ ra alɔ a xa n faxa. Wo lu be, kɔnɔ wo naxa xi.»

sentences.english: And he went forward a little, and falling down on the earth, made request that, if possible, the hour might go from him.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masiga dondoronti, a a yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma, a Ala maxandi na waxati xa makuya a ra, xa na sa nɔma rabade.

sentences.english: And he said, Abba, Father, all things are possible to you; take away this cup from me: but even so let not my pleasure, but yours be done.
sentences.susu: A naxa Ala maxandi, «N Baba, i nɔma fe birin na. I xa n natanga yi ɲaxankatɛ ma. Kɔnɔ n sago naxa raba, i tan nan sago xa raba.»

sentences.english: And he came, and saw them sleeping, and said to Peter, Simon, are you sleeping? were you not able to keep watch one hour?
sentences.susu: A to gbilen a fɔxirabirɛe yire, a naxa e li e na xife. A naxa a fala Piyɛri bɛ, «Simɔn, i xife nɛ yi ki? I mu nɔxi waxati keren xi xɔli kanade n ma fe ra?

sentences.english: Keep watch with prayer, so that you may not be put to the test; the spirit truly is ready, but the flesh is feeble.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa xi. Wo Ala maxandi nɛ alako wo naxa bira tantanyi kui. Maɲɔxun fanyi na adama bɛ, kɔnɔ a fate bɛndɛ tan sɛnbɛ mu na.»

sentences.english: And again he went away, and said a prayer, using the same words.
sentences.susu: Isa man to a masiga e ra, a man naxa Ala maxandi na maxandi kerenyi ra.

sentences.english: And again he came and saw them sleeping, because their eyes were very tired; and they had nothing to say in answer.
sentences.susu: A to gbilen a fɔxirabirɛe yire, a man naxa e li e xife, barima xi xɔli nu bara nɔ e ra. Yaabi yo mu nu e yi Isa bɛ.

sentences.english: And he came the third time, and said to them, Go on sleeping now and take your rest: it is enough; the hour has come; see, the Son of man is given up into the hands of evil men.
sentences.susu: Isa man to gbilen e yire a sanmaya saxan nde, a naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo xife nɛ? Wo na wo malabufe han ya? A tan nan na ki, waxati bara a li. Adama xa Di fafe sade yunubitɔɛe bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: Get up, let us be going; see, he who gives me up is near.
sentences.susu: Wo keli, won xɛɛ. Wo a mato, n yanfama bara fa.»

sentences.english: And straight away, while he was still talking, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great band with swords and sticks, from the chief priests and the scribes and those in authority.
sentences.susu: Isa ɲan mu nu gɛxi wɔyɛnde, Yudasi, naxan nu na a fɔxirabirɛ fu nun firinyie ya ma, a naxa fa keren na e nun ɲama, santidɛgɛma nun gbengbeta suxuxi e yi ra. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie, sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe, nun Yuwifie xa forie nan nu e xɛɛxi.

sentences.english: Now he who had been false to him had given them a sign, saying, The one to whom I give a kiss, that is he; take him, and get him away safely.
sentences.susu: Isa yanfama nun na ɲama nu bara lan a ma, a xa Isa matɔnxuma e bɛ. A nu bara a fala e bɛ, «N na mixi naxan sunbu, a tan nan na ki. Wo a suxu, wo a xanin, wo a kanta.»

sentences.english: And when he had come, he went straight to him and said, Master; and gave him a kiss.
sentences.susu: Yudasi fɛfɛ fa, a naxa a maso Isa ra, a a fala a bɛ, «Karamɔxɔ,» a fa a sunbu.

sentences.english: And they put their hands on him, and took him.
sentences.susu: Na kui, ɲama naxa Isa suxu.

sentences.english: But a certain one of those who were near took out his sword, and gave the servant of the high priest a blow, cutting off his ear.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde nu tixi naa, a naxa a xa santidɛgɛma ramini, a sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xa konyi tuli bolon.

sentences.english: And Jesus said to them, Have you come out as against a thief, with swords and sticks to take me?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo to minixi n xili ma santidɛgɛma nun gbengbeta suxuxi wo yi ra, suute nan na n na?

sentences.english: I was with you every day in the Temple teaching, and you did not take me; but this is done so that the Writings may come true.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ, n nu na wo ya ma, n nu kawandi ti hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, wo mu n suxu. Kɔnɔ naxan sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, fo a xa kamali.»

sentences.english: And they all went away from him in fear.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Isa fɔxirabirɛe birin naxa e gi a xun ma.

sentences.english: And a certain young man went after him, with only a linen cloth about his body; and they put their hands on him;
sentences.susu: Sɛgɛtala nde fan nu na naxan nu biraxi Isa fɔxɔ ra, dugi nan gbansan nu felenxi a ma. E naxa a suxu,

sentences.english: But he got away unclothed, without the linen cloth.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ a naxa mini a xa dugi kui, a a gi a mageli ra.

sentences.english: And they took Jesus away to the high priest; and there came together with him all the chief priests and those in authority and the scribes.
sentences.susu: E naxa Isa xanin sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie xunyi xɔn. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe kuntigie, Yuwifie xa forie, nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ birin nu malanxi naa.

sentences.english: And Peter had come after him at a distance, even into the house of the high priest; and he was seated with the captains, warming himself in the light of the fire.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri nu bara bira Isa fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ a mu nu a makɔrɛma a gbe ra. A naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra han a so sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie xunyi xa tɛtɛ kui. E nun hɔrɔmɔbanxi kantamae naxa dɔxɔ tɛ ra, e nu fa e maxara.

sentences.english: Now the chief priests and all the Sanhedrin were looking for witness against Jesus so that they might put him to death; and they were unable to get any.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun Yuwifie xa kiitisa dɔnxɔɛ birin, e nu seede fenfe Isa xili ma, alako e xa a faxa, kɔnɔ e mu se to.

sentences.english: For a number gave false witness against him and their witness was not in agreement.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe naxa fa Isa tɔɔɲɛgɛde, kɔnɔ e xa wulee mu nu lanma e boore ma.

sentences.english: Then some got up and gave false witness against him, saying,
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee to keli wule seede bade a xili ma, e naxa a fala,

sentences.english: He said in our hearing, I will put an end to this Temple which is made with hands, and in three days I will make another without hands.
sentences.susu: «Muxu a xui mɛxi nɛ, a a falama, ‹N yi hɔrɔmɔbanxi rabirama nɛ, adama bɛlɛxɛ naxan tixi, n gbɛtɛ ti xi saxan bun ma, naxan mu tixi adama bɛlɛxɛ ra.›»

sentences.english: And even so their witness was not in agreement.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ hali na wɔyɛnyi kui, e xa seedeɲɔxɔya mu nu lanxi a boore ma.

sentences.english: And the high priest got up in the middle of them, and said to Jesus, Do you say nothing in answer? what is it which these say against you?
sentences.susu: Na kui, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie xunyi naxa keli ɲama tagi, a Isa maxɔrin, «Pe, i mu e yaabima? Yi xɛmɛe munse safe i xun ma yi ki?»

sentences.english: But he kept quiet and said nothing. Again the high priest questioning him said, Are you the Christ, the son of the Holy One?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa mu yaabi yo fi, a mu sese fala. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xunyi man naxa a maxɔrin, «I tan nan na Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra, Batu Mangɛ xa Di?»

sentences.english: And Jesus said, I am: and you will see the Son of man seated at the right hand of power, and coming with the clouds of heaven.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen, «N tan nan na a ra. Wo fama Adama xa Di tode, a dɔxɔxi Ala Sɛnbɛma yirefanyi ma, wo a to fafe ra nuxuie kui.»

sentences.english: And the high priest, violently parting his robes, said, What more need have we of witnesses?
sentences.susu: Na kui, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi naxa a yɛtɛ xa donma suxu, a ibɔɔ xɔnɛ ra, a a fala, «Won hayi na seede gbɛtɛe ma yire?

sentences.english: His words against God have come to your ears: what is your opinion? And they all said it was right for him to be put to death.
sentences.susu: Wo bara a mɛ a Ala mabɛxuxi ki naxɛ! Wo kiiti toxi di?» E birin naxa a fala a lanma a xa faxa nɛ.

sentences.english: And some put shame on him and, covering his face, gave him blows and said to him, Now say what is to come: and the captains took him and gave him blows with their hands.
sentences.susu: Ndee naxa dɛye bɔxun fɔlɔ a ma. E naxa a ya maxiri, e nu a madin, e nu fa a fala a bɛ, «Namiɲɔnmɛɲa raba! A fala ba, naxan i bɔnbɔxi!» A to sa kɔsibilie bɛlɛxɛ, nee fan naxa a bɔnbɔ.

sentences.english: And while Peter was down in the open square of the building, one of the servant-girls of the high priest came;
sentences.susu: Piyɛri nu na tɛtɛ kui tɛmui naxɛ lanbanyi, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie xunyi xa konyi ginɛ keren naxa fa.

sentences.english: And seeing Peter warming himself by the fire, she gave him a look, and said, You were with this Nazarene, even Jesus.
sentences.susu: A to Piyɛri to, a a maxarafe tɛ ra, a naxa a igbɛ, a a fala, «I tan, wo nun Isa Nasarɛtika birin nan nu a ra.»

sentences.english: But he said, I have no knowledge of him, or of what you are saying: and he went out into the doorway; and there came the cry of a cock.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a matandi, a a fala, «N mu a kolon i na fefe falafe!» A naxa mini tɛtɛ kui.

sentences.english: And the girl saw him, and said again to those who were near, This is one of them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ konyi ginɛ man to a to, a man naxa wɔyɛn fɔlɔ mixie bɛ naxee nu na naa, «A xa mixi nde nan ya.»

sentences.english: But again he said it was not so. And after a little time, again those who were near said to Peter, Truly you are one of them; for you are a Galilaean.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri man naxa a matandi. A mu bu, naxee nu na naa, e man naxa a fala Piyɛri bɛ, «Nɔndi na a ra, a tan mixi nde nan yati i ra, barima Galileka nan i ra.»

sentences.english: But, with curses and oaths, he said, I have no knowledge of the man about whom you are talking.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Piyɛri naxa so a kalife, a a fala «Ala xa n danka! Wo yi xɛmɛ naxan ma fe falafe, n tan mu a kolon feo!»

sentences.english: And in the same minute, the cock gave a second cry. And it came to Peter's mind how Jesus had said to him, Before the cock's second cry, you will say three times that you have no knowledge of me. And at this thought he was overcome with weeping.
sentences.susu: Konkore naxa a rate keren na a dɛya firin nde. Piyɛri naxa ratu fa Isa xa wɔyɛnyi ma a bɛ, «Beemanun konkore xa a rate dɛya firin, i i yɛtɛ rasanma nɛ n ma sanmaya saxan.» Na kui, a naxa so wafe.

sentences.english: And the first thing in the morning the chief priests, with those in authority and the scribes and all the Sanhedrin, had a meeting, and put cords round Jesus, and took him away, and gave him up to Pilate.
sentences.susu: Kuye to iba, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie, Yuwifie xa forie, sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe, nun Yuwifie xa kiitisa dɔnxɔɛ birin, e to nu bara gɛ e xa malanyi ra, e naxa Isa xiri, e a xanin Pilati xɔn.

sentences.english: And Pilate put a question to him, Are you the King of the Jews? And he, answering, said to him, You say so.
sentences.susu: Pilati naxa Isa maxɔrin, «I tan nan findixi Yuwifie xa mangɛ ra?» Isa naxa a yaabi, «I tan nan a falaxi.»

sentences.english: And the chief priests said a number of things against him.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie naxa fa Isa tɔɔɲɛgɛ fe gbegbe ma.

sentences.english: And Pilate again put a question, Do you say nothing in answer? see how much evil they say you have done.
sentences.susu: Pilati man naxa a maxɔrin, «I mu e yaabima? I mu a mɛxi e fe naxan birin safe i xun ma?»

sentences.english: But Jesus gave no more answers, so that Pilate was full of wonder.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa mu yaabi gbɛtɛ yo fi sɔnɔn. Pilati fan naxa kaaba na ma.

sentences.english: Now at the feast every year he let one prisoner go free at their request.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ yo ɲɛ, sali na a li, Pilati dari fe nan nu a ra, a xa geelimani keren nabɛɲin ɲama bɛ, e na wa naxan yo xɔn.

sentences.english: And there was one named Barabbas, in prison with those who had gone against the government and in the fight had taken life.
sentences.susu: Na waxati, geresoe ndee nu na geeli naxee nu bara keli mangasanyi xili ma. Ɲaxasi to bira, e nu bara faxɛ ti. Xɛmɛ nde nu na e ya ma naxan nu xili Barabasi.

sentences.english: And the people went up, requesting him to do as he had done for them in other years.
sentences.susu: Awa ɲama naxa fa Pilati xɔn, e a maxɔrin, a xa a raba e bɛ, alɔ a darixi a ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And Pilate said in answer to them, Is it your desire that I let the King of the Jews go free?
sentences.susu: Pilati naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo wama n xa Yuwifie xa mangɛ bɛɲin wo bɛ?»

sentences.english: For he saw that the chief priests had given him up through envy.
sentences.susu: Pilati nu a kolon a sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nu Isa saxi a bɛlɛxɛ tɔɔnɛ nan ma.

sentences.english: But the people were moved by the chief priests to make him let Barabbas go free.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie naxa ɲama kui iso, alako Pilati xa Barabasi nan bɛɲin e bɛ.

sentences.english: And Pilate again said in answer to them, What then am I to do to him to whom you give the name of the King of the Jews?
sentences.susu: Pilati man naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo fa wama a xɔn ma n xa munse raba yi xɛmɛ ra, wo naxan ma, a Yuwifie xa mangɛ?»

sentences.english: And they said again loudly, To the cross with him!
sentences.susu: Ɲama man naxa sɔnxɔ, «A banban wuri magalanbuxi ma!»

sentences.english: And Pilate said to them, Why, what evil has he done? But their cry was the louder, To the cross!
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Pilati naxa e maxɔrin, «Munfe ma? A fe ɲaaxi mundun nabaxi?» Kɔnɔ e tan sɔnxɔɛ nan tun xun masama, e nu a fala, «A banban wuri magalanbuxi ma!»

sentences.english: And Pilate, desiring to do what was pleasing to the people, let Barabbas go free, and gave up Jesus, when he had been whipped, to be put to death on the cross.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Pilati to wa ɲama bɔɲɛ rafanfe e ma, a naxa Barabasi rabɛɲin e bɛ. A naxa yaamari fi sɔɔrie xa Isa bɔnbɔ sɛbɛrɛ ra. Na xanbi, a naxa Isa so e yi e xa sa a banban wuri magalanbuxi ma.

sentences.english: And the men of the army took him away into the square in front of the building which is the Praetorium, and they got together all the band.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔrie naxa Isa xanin gomina xɔnyi, na tɛtɛ kui, e e boore sɔɔrie birin xili.

sentences.english: And they put a purple robe on him, and twisting a crown of thorns, they put it on him;
sentences.susu: E naxa mangɛ guba gbeeli ragoro Isa ma, e fa tunbee mafilin, e e yailan mangɛ katanyi maniyɛ ra. E naxa na sa a xun ma,

sentences.english: And, as if honouring him, they said, Long life to the King of the Jews!
sentences.susu: e nu a xɛɛbu, «I kɛna, Yuwifie xa mangɛ.»

sentences.english: And they gave him blows on the head with a stick and put shame on him and, going down on their knees, gave him worship.
sentences.susu: E nu a xunyi bɔnbɔma wuri ra, e dɛye bɔxun a ma, e e xinbi sin, e suyidi a bɛ.

sentences.english: And when they had made sport of him, they took the purple robe off him and put his clothing on him. And they took him out to put him to death on the cross.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ Isa mayelede, e naxa mangɛ guba rate a ma, e a gbe dugi ragoro a ma, e fa a ramini e xa sa a banban wuri magalanbuxi ma.

sentences.english: And they made one, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, who was going by, coming from the country, go with them, so that he might take his cross.
sentences.susu: Sirenika xɛmɛ nde nu na dangife kira ra, a kelixi daaxa. A nu xili Simɔn, Alesandire nun Rufu baba. Sɔɔrie naxa a yamari, a xa Isa xa wuri magalanbuxi xanin.

sentences.english: And they took him to the place named Golgotha, which is, Dead Man's Head.
sentences.susu: E naxa Isa xanin yire dɛnnaxan xili falama Gologota, na nan falaxi e xa xui, «xunkonkota yire».

sentences.english: And they gave him wine mixed with myrrh; but he did not take it.
sentences.susu: E naxa wɛni so a yi, miri seri saxi a xun, kɔnɔ a mu tin a minde.

sentences.english: And he was nailed to the cross; and they made a division of his clothing among them, putting to the decision of chance what everyone was to take.
sentences.susu: E naxa a mabanban wuri magalanbuxi ma, e kanda bun a xa dugie xa fe ra, alako e xa a kolon kankan naxan sɔtɔma.

sentences.english: And it was the third hour when they put him on the cross.
sentences.susu: E nu a banbanfe tɛmui naxɛ, gɛɛsɛgɛ tagi nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: And the statement of his crime was put in writing on the cross, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
sentences.susu: E to nu wama birin xa a kolon e a banbanxi fe naxan ma, e yi sɛbɛli nan gbaku a xun ma, «Yuwifie xa mangɛ.»

sentences.english: And they put two thieves on crosses with him, one on his right side, and one on his left.
sentences.susu: E naxa suute mixi firin fan banban wuri magalanbuxie ma Isa fɛ ma, keren a yirefanyi ma, boore a kɔɔla ma.
<range>

sentences.english: And those who went by made sport of him, shaking their heads, and saying, Ha! you who give the Temple to destruction, and put it up again in three days,
sentences.susu: Mixie nu dangima Isa konbi ra, e nu e xunyi lintan a ma, e a fala, «Ee, i tan naxan hɔrɔmɔbanxi rabirama, i man fa a ti xi saxan bun ma,

sentences.english: Keep yourself from death, and come down from the cross.
sentences.susu: i yɛtɛ rakisi! Goro wuri magalanbuxi kɔn na!»

sentences.english: In the same way the chief priests, laughing at him among themselves with the scribes, said, A saviour of others, he has no salvation for himself.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe fan nu a mayelefe, e nu a fala, «A bara mixi gbɛtɛe rakisi, kɔnɔ a mu nɔma a yɛtɛ tan nakiside.

sentences.english: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, come down now from the cross, so that we may see and have belief. And those who were put on crosses with him said evil things against him.
sentences.susu: Isirayila mangɛ xa mu a ra, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi? A xa goro wuri magalanbuxi kɔn be ya, muxu xa a to, muxu xa la a ra.» Naxee nu banbanxi a fɛ ma, nee fan nu Isa konbife nɛ.

sentences.english: And when the sixth hour had come, it was dark over all the land till the ninth hour.
sentences.susu: Yanyi tagi to a li, yanyi xare ra, dimi naxa sin bɔxi birin ma lɛɛri saxan bun ma.

sentences.english: And at the ninth hour, Jesus said in a loud voice, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, My God, my God, why are you turned away from me?
sentences.susu: Na waxati ma, Isa naxa gbelegbele sɛnbɛ ra, «Eloyi, Eloyi, lɛma sabaxatani?» Na nan falaxi e xa xui, «N Marigi Ala, n Marigi Ala, i n nabɛɲinxi munfe ra?»

sentences.english: And some of those who were near, hearing it, said, See, he is crying to Elijah.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee nu na naa, e to a xui mɛ, e naxa a fala, «Wo a mato, a na Annabi Eliya nan xilife!»

sentences.english: And one of them went quickly and, getting a sponge full of bitter wine, put it on a rod, and gave it to him for drink, saying, Let be; let us see if Elijah will come to take him down.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa a gi, a sa dunkobi rasin wɛni xɔnɛ xɔɔra, a a so wuri dɛ i, a fa a ti Isa bɛ alako a xa a min. A naxa a fala, «Wo a lu, won xa a mato xa Annabi Eliya fama a ragorode.»

sentences.english: And Jesus gave a loud cry, and gave up his spirit.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a xui ite sɛnbɛ ra, a fa laaxira.

sentences.english: And the curtain of the Temple was parted in two from end to end.
sentences.susu: Na waxati, dugi xungbe naxan singanxi hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, a naxa ibɔɔ firin na, keli a fuge han a laabe.

sentences.english: And when the captain, who was near, saw how he gave up his spirit, he said, Truly this man was a son of God.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri mangɛ naxan nu tixi Isa ya i, a to Isa laaxira ki to, a naxa a fala, «Nɔndi nan a ra yati, Ala xa Di nan nu yi xɛmɛ ra!»

sentences.english: And there were women watching from a distance: among them were Mary Magdalene, and Mary, the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome,
sentences.susu: Ginɛ ndee fan nu na naa, e ndedi makuyaxi Isa yire ra, e yi fe birin matoma. Mariyama Magidalaka nu na e ya ma, a nun Salome, a nun Mariyama, Yaki lanmadi nun Yusufu nga.

sentences.english: Who went with him when he was in Galilee and took care of him; and a number of other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Isa nu na Galile tɛmui naxɛ, yi ginɛe nan nu birama a fɔxɔ ra, e nu walie raba a bɛ. Ginɛ gbɛtɛ gbegbe fan nu na naa naxee nu bara Isa mati han Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And when it was evening, because it was the time of getting ready, that is, the day before the Sabbath,
sentences.susu: Nunmare to so, beenun malabu lɔxɔɛ xa fɔlɔ,

sentences.english: There came Joseph of Arimathaea, a responsible man in high honour, who was himself waiting for the kingdom of God; and he went in to Pilate without fear, and made a request for the body of Jesus.
sentences.susu: Yusufu Arimateka naxa siga Pilati xɔn. Yuwifie xa kiitisa binye nde nan nu a ra naxan nu Ala xa mangɛya niini mamɛfe. Limaniya kui, a naxa sa Pilati maxandi Isa fure ma.

sentences.english: And Pilate was surprised that he was dead; and, sending for the captain, he put a question to see if he had been dead for long.
sentences.susu: Pilati naxa tɛrɛnna a kolonfe ra a Isa ɲan bara faxa. A naxa sɔɔri mangɛ xili, a a maxɔrin na fe ma.

sentences.english: And when he had news of it from the captain, he let Joseph have the body.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri mangɛ fan to a rakolon a Isa bara faxa, Pilati naxa Isa fure so Yusufu yi ra.

sentences.english: And he got a linen cloth and, taking him down, put the linen cloth round him, and put him in a place for the dead which had been cut out of a rock; and a stone was rolled against the door.
sentences.susu: Yusufu to kasange sara, a naxa Isa fure ragoro wuri magalanbuxi kɔn, a a kasange, a fa a bɛlɛ gaburi kui, naxan nu gexi gɛmɛ kui. Na xanbi, a naxa gɛmɛ xungbe maɲindigilin, a a dɔxɔ gaburi dɛ ma.

sentences.english: And Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of Joses, saw where he was put.
sentences.susu: Mariyama Magidalaka nun Mariyama Yusufu nga, e naxa a to e Isa ragatafe dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And when the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of James, and Salome, got spices, so that they might come and put them on him.
sentences.susu: Malabu lɔxɔɛ to ba a ra, Mariyama Magidalaka, Mariyama Yaki nga, nun Salome, e naxa labundɛ ture sara alako e xa a sa Isa fure ma.

sentences.english: And very early after dawn on the first day of the week, they came at the time of the coming up of the sun to the place where the body had been put.
sentences.susu: Sande lɔxɔɛ, kuye baxi ibade, e naxa kurun gaburi yire ra.

sentences.english: And they were saying among themselves, Who will get the stone rolled away from the door for us?
sentences.susu: Kira ra, e naxa e bore maxɔrin, «Nde gɛmɛ bama won bɛ gaburi dɛ ma?»

sentences.english: And looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back; and it was of great size.
sentences.susu: Gɛmɛ naxan nu dɔxɔxi gaburi dɛ ma, a nu xungbo ki fanyi. Kɔnɔ e to e ya rasiga, e naxa a to gɛmɛ bara ba naa.

sentences.english: And when they went in, they saw a young man seated on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were full of wonder.
sentences.susu: E to so gaburi kui, e naxa sɛgɛtala nde to a dɔxɔxi yirefanyi ma, guba fiixɛ ragoroxi a ma. E naxa gaaxu.

sentences.english: And he said to them, Do not be troubled: you are looking for Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been put to death on the cross; he has come back from the dead; he is not here: see, the place where they put him!
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo naxa gaaxu. Wo na Isa Nasarɛtika nan fenfe, e naxan banban wuri magalanbuxi ma. A mu be, a bara keli faxɛ ma. Wo a mato, e nu a saxi mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: But go, say to his disciples and to Peter, He goes before you into Galilee: there you will see him, as he said to you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo siga, wo sa a fala a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, a nun Piyɛri, a Isa na sigafe wo ya ra Galile. Wo a toma mɛnni nɛ alɔ a a masen wo bɛ ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And they went out quickly from the place, because fear and great wonder had come on them: and they said nothing to anyone, because they were full of fear that ...
sentences.susu: Ginɛe naxa mini gaburi kui, e siga e gi ra, e kaabaxi fo e sɛrɛnma. E mu sese fala mixi yo bɛ, barima e nu bara gɛ gaaxude.

sentences.english: Now when he came back from the dead early on the first day of the week, he went first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had sent out seven evil spirits.
sentences.susu: Isa to keli faxɛ ma sande lɔxɔɛ kuye iba, a mini Mariyama Magidalaka nan singe ma, a ɲinnɛ solofere keri naxan fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: She went and gave news of it to those who had been with him, while they were sorrowing and weeping.
sentences.susu: Mariyama naxa siga Isa xibaaru falade mixie bɛ e nun naxee nu a ra. E birin nu sunnunxi, e man nu wafe Isa xa ɲɔnfe ma.

sentences.english: And they, when it came to their ears that he was living, and had been seen by her, had no belief in it.
sentences.susu: E to a mɛ a a Isa ɲiɲɛ to nɛ, e mu la a ra.

sentences.english: And after these things he was seen in another form by two of them, while they were walking on their way into the country.
sentences.susu: Na fee dangi xanbi, Isa naxa mini kɛɲa gbɛtɛ ra a fɔxirabirɛ mixi firin ma, e to nu na daaxa nde kira xɔn.

sentences.english: And they went away and gave news of it to the rest; and they had no belief in what was said.
sentences.susu: Nee fan naxa gbilen yi fe tagi raba ra booree bɛ, kɔnɔ e mu la nee fan xui ra.

sentences.english: And later he was seen by the eleven themselves while they were taking food; and he said sharp words to them because they had no faith and their hearts were hard, and because they had no belief in those who had seen him after he had come back from the dead.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Isa naxa mini a fɔxirabirɛ fu nun keren ma, e nu e dɛgefe teebili ra tɛmui naxɛ. Isa naxa wɔyɛn e ma e xa danxaniyatareɲa nun xaxili xɔrɔxɔya xa fe ra, barima e mu nu laxi mixie ra naxee Isa to, a to nu bara keli faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: And he said to them, Go into all the world, and give the good news to everyone.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo siga duniɲa birin kui, wo daali birin kawandi xibaaru fanyi ra.

sentences.english: He who has faith and is given baptism will get salvation; but he who has not faith will be judged.
sentences.susu: Naxan na danxaniya n ma, a xunxa ye xɔɔra, na kanyi kisima nɛ. Kɔnɔ xa naxan mu danxaniya n ma, na kanyi bɔnɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: And these signs will be with those who have faith: in my name they will send out evil spirits; and they will make use of new languages;
sentences.susu: Naxee na danxaniya n ma e yi kaabanako fee rabama nɛ n xili ra. E fama nɛ ɲinnɛe keride mixie fɔxɔ ra, e xui nɛɛnɛe falama nɛ,

sentences.english: They will take up snakes, and if there is poison in their drink, it will do them no evil; they will put their hands on those who are ill, and they will get well.
sentences.susu: e bɔximasee suxuma nɛ e bɛlɛxɛ ra e mu e xin, e sefi minma nɛ se mu e to, e e bɛlɛxɛ sama nɛ furemae ma, furemae yalan.»

sentences.english: So then the Lord Jesus, after he had said these words to them, was taken up into heaven and took his seat at the right hand of God.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Marigi Isa to gɛ wɔyɛnde e bɛ, a naxa te koore ma. A naxa sa a magoro Ala yirefanyi ma.

sentences.english: And they went out, preaching everywhere, the Lord working with them, and giving witness to the word by the signs which came after. So be it.
sentences.susu: E tan naxa siga kawandi tide yire birin, e nun Marigi naxa wali. Marigi naxa fɛɛrɛ fi e ma, e xa tɔnxuma makaabaxie raba, mixie xa la e xa kawandi ra.

sentences.english: As a number of attempts have been made to put together in order an account of those events which took place among us,
sentences.susu: Mixi wuyaxi bara kata e xa dɛntɛgɛ sa fee ma naxee dangixi muxu tagi.

sentences.english: As they were handed down to us by those who saw them from the first and were preachers of the word,
sentences.susu: E a sɛbɛxi nɛ alɔ muxu fan a mɛxi mixie ra ki naxɛ, naxee a birin to kabi a fɔlɛ, e man fa findi xibaaru fanyi xa masenyi kawandilae ra.

sentences.english: It seemed good to me, having made observation, with great care, of the direction of events in their order, to put the facts in writing for you, most noble Theophilus;
sentences.susu: Na kui, n fan to bara na fe birin mato ki fanyi naxee rabaxi kabi a fɔlɛ, n bara a maɲɔxun fe fanyi ra, n xa a birin sɛbɛ i bɛ, n ba Teyofilo.

sentences.english: So that you might have certain knowledge of those things about which you were given teaching.
sentences.susu: N yi rabaxi nɛ, alako i xa a kolon, a i xaranxi naxan na, a findixi nɔndi nan yati ra.

sentences.english: In the days of Herod, king of Judaea, there was a certain priest, by name Zacharias, of the order of Abijah; and he had a wife of the family of Aaron, and her name was Elisabeth.
sentences.susu: Yudaya mangɛ Herode xa waxati, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nde nu na naxan xili Sakari. A nu na Abiya xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ lanxundɛ nan kui. A xa ginɛ Elisabɛti fan kelixi Haruna bɔnsɔɛ nɛ.

sentences.english: They were upright in the eyes of God, keeping all the rules and orders of God, and doing no wrong.
sentences.susu: E firin birin nu tinxin Ala ya i. E nu ɲɛrɛma Ala xa sɛriyɛ nun yaamari birin ma sɛniyɛnyi kui.

sentences.english: And they were without children, because Elisabeth had never given birth, and they were at that time very old.
sentences.susu: Di yo mu nu na e yi ra barima Elisabɛti mu nu nɔma di baride, e firin birin man nu bara fori.

sentences.english: Now it came about that in his turn he was acting as priest before God,
sentences.susu: Sakari xa lanxundɛ wali tɛmui to a li, a naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ walie suxu Ala ya i.

sentences.english: And as was the way of the priests, he had to go into the Temple to see to the burning of perfumes.
sentences.susu: Alɔ sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nu darixi a ra ki naxɛ, Sakari booree nu bara a sugandi Ala xa mali ra, a tan nan xa so hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui surayi gande Ala ya i.

sentences.english: And all the people were offering prayers outside, at the time of the burning of perfumes.
sentences.susu: Surayi gan tɛmui, ɲama birin nu na salife tande.

sentences.english: And he saw an angel of the Lord in his place on the right side of the altar.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Marigi xa malekɛ nde naxa mini Sakari ma surayi sɛrɛxɛbade yirefanyi ma.

sentences.english: And Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear came on him.
sentences.susu: Na naxa Sakari tɛrɛnna, a naxa a gaaxu ki fanyi.

sentences.english: But the angel said, Have no fear, Zacharias, for your prayer has come to the ears of God, and your wife Elisabeth will have a son, and his name will be John.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ malekɛ naxa a masen a bɛ, «Sakari, i naxa gaaxu, barima Ala bara i xa duba suxu. I xa ginɛ Elisabɛti fama di xɛmɛ sɔtɔde i bɛ. I xa a xili sa Yaya.

sentences.english: And you will be glad and have great delight; and numbers of people will have joy at his birth.
sentences.susu: Na findima sɛɛwɛ nun ɲɛlɛxinyi nan na i bɛ, mixi gbegbe fan ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ a barife ra,

sentences.english: For he will be great in the eyes of the Lord; he will not take wine or strong drink; and he will be full of the Spirit of God from his birth.
sentences.susu: barima a binyɛ sɔtɔma nɛ Ala ya i. A mu wɛni nun sese gbɛtɛ minma naxan mixi siisima. Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi luma nɛ a ma kabi a na a nga tɛɛgɛ tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And through him great numbers of the children of Israel will be turned to the Lord their God.
sentences.susu: A Isirayila di gbegbe ragbilenma nɛ e Marigi Ala ma.

sentences.english: And he will go before his face in the spirit and power of Elijah, turning the hearts of fathers to their children, and wrongdoers to the way of righteousness; to make ready a people whose hearts have been turned to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Sɛnbɛ nun Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi fima nɛ a ma alɔ a fi Annabi Eliya ma ki naxɛ. Marigi a xɛɛma nɛ a ya ra, a xa babae bɔɲɛ rafindi e xa die ma, a yunubitɔɛe ya rafindi tinxintɔɛe xa fahaamui ma. A sigama nɛ ɲama xɔn ma Marigi ya ra alako a xa e ya rafindi a ma.»

sentences.english: And Zacharias said to the angel, How may I be certain of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is far on in years.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Sakari naxa malekɛ maxɔrin, «N yi fe kolonma di? N tan bara fori a nun n ma ginɛ.»

sentences.english: And the angel, answering, said, I am Gabriel, whose place is before God; I have been sent to say these words to you and to give you this good news.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa a yaabi, «Yibirila nan n tan na, naxan tima Ala ya i a xa yaamari rabafe ra. A n xɛɛxi nɛ yi xibaaru fanyi masende i bɛ.

sentences.english: Now, see, you will be without voice or language till the day when these things come about, because you had not faith in my words, which will have effect at the right time.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a mato, i boboma nɛ, i mu nɔ wɔyɛnde han yi fee sa rabama lɔxɔ naxan ma, barima i mu laxi n ma masenyi ra, naxan sa kamalima a waxati.»

sentences.english: And the people were waiting for Zacharias and were surprised because he was in the Temple for such a long time.
sentences.susu: Ɲama to nu na Sakari mamɛfe tande, e naxa kɔntɔfili Sakari bufe ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: And when he came out he was not able to say anything, and they saw that he had seen a vision in the Temple; and he was making signs to them without words.
sentences.susu: A to mini a mu nɔ wɔyɛnde e bɛ, e naxa a kolon a a laamatunyi nan toxi hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui. A boboxi ra a nu katafe a xa masenyi ti e bɛ a bɛlɛxɛe ra.

sentences.english: And when the days of his work in the Temple were ended, he went back to his house.
sentences.susu: Sakari to gɛ a xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali ra, a naxa siga a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: After that time, Elisabeth, being certain that she was to become a mother, kept herself from men's eyes for five months, saying,
sentences.susu: Na waxati dangi xanbi, Sakari xa ginɛ Elisabɛti naxa tɛɛgɛ. A naxa a ya manɔxun mixie ma kike suuli. A naxa a fala,

sentences.english: The Lord has done this to me, for his eyes were on me, to take away my shame in the eyes of men.
sentences.susu: «Marigi yi nan nabaxi n bɛ, a to a ya ragoroxi n ma a xa fonisireya kui! A bara yaagi ba n ma, mixie tagi.»

sentences.english: Now in the sixth month the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a town in Galilee, named Nazareth,
sentences.susu: Elisabɛti xa tɛɛgɛ to kike senni li, Ala naxa malekɛ Yibirila xɛɛ Galile bɔxi taa nde ma, naxan xili «Nasarɛti».

sentences.english: To a virgin who was to be married to a man named Joseph, of the family of David; and the name of the virgin was Mary.
sentences.susu: A a xɛɛ ginɛdimɛdi nde nan xɔn ma, xɛmɛ nu bara naxan xa kote dɔxɔ. Na xɛmɛ nu fatanxi Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ nɛ, a nu xili Yusufu. Ginɛdimɛdi fan nu xili Mariyama.

sentences.english: And the angel came in to her and said, Peace be with you, to whom special grace has been given; the Lord is with you.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ to siga a xɔn, a naxa a masen a bɛ, «I kɛna, i tan Marigi hinnɛxi naxan na. Marigi na i fɛ ma!»

sentences.english: But she was greatly troubled at his words, and said to herself, What may be the purpose of these words?
sentences.susu: Mariyama naxa ifu na wɔyɛnyi ma. A mu nu a kolon yi findixi xɛɛbui mɔɔli yo ra.

sentences.english: And the angel said to her, Have no fear, Mary, for you have God's approval.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa a masen a bɛ, «Mariyama, i naxa gaaxu, barima Ala bara hinnɛ i ra.

sentences.english: And see, you will give birth to a son, and his name will be Jesus.
sentences.susu: A mato, i fama tɛɛgɛde di xɛmɛ ma. I na a bari, i xa a xili sa Isa.

sentences.english: He will be great, and will be named the Son of the Most High: and the Lord God will give him the kingdom of David, his father:
sentences.susu: A binyɛ sɔtɔma, a xili fala Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi xa Di. Marigi Ala fama nɛ a benba Dawuda xa mangɛya fide a ma.

sentences.english: He will have rule over the house of Jacob for ever, and of his kingdom there will be no end.
sentences.susu: A findima nɛ Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ xa mangɛ ra abadan, danyi yo mu luma a xa mangɛya ma.»

sentences.english: And Mary said to the angel, How may this be, because I have had no knowledge of a man?
sentences.susu: Mariyama naxa malekɛ maxɔrin, «Yi fe nɔma rabade di, n to fa findixi ginɛdimɛdi nan na?»

sentences.english: And the angel in answer said to her, The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will come to rest on you, and so that which will come to birth will be named holy, Son of God.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa a yaabi, «Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nan fama i ma, Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi sɛnbɛ fa i xun ma. Na nan a toxi, i fama yi di naxan baride, a findima sɛniyɛntɔɛ ra, a xili fala Ala xa Di.

sentences.english: Even now Elisabeth, who is of your family, is to be a mother, though she is old: and this is the sixth month with her who was without children.
sentences.susu: A mato, i barenyi Elisabɛti fan bara tɛɛgɛ di xɛmɛ ma a xa foriɲa kui. E nu a xili falama dibaritare, kɔnɔ a furi kike senni nan a ra yi ki.

sentences.english: For there is nothing which God is not able to do.
sentences.susu: Sese mu na Ala mu nɔma naxan nabade.»

sentences.english: And Mary said: I am the servant of the Lord; may it be to me as you say. And the angel went away.
sentences.susu: Mariyama naxa a yaabi, «Marigi xa konyi nan n na. A xa raba n bɛ alɔ i a falaxi ki naxɛ.» Na xanbi, malekɛ naxa keli a xun ma.

sentences.english: Then Mary got up and went quickly into the high lands, to a town of Judah;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Mariyama naxa siga mafuren taa nde Yudaya geya yire.

sentences.english: And went into the house of Zacharias and took Elisabeth in her arms.
sentences.susu: A to so Sakari xɔnyi, a naxa Elisabɛti xɛɛbu.

sentences.english: And when the voice of Mary came to the ears of Elisabeth, the baby made a sudden move inside her; then Elisabeth was full of the Holy Spirit,
sentences.susu: Elisabɛti to Mariyama xa xɛɛbui mɛ, diyɔrɛ naxa a ramaxa a tɛɛgɛ, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi fa goro Elisabɛti ma.

sentences.english: And she said with a loud voice: May blessing be on you among women, and a blessing on the child of your body.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a xui itexi ra, «Ala bara baraka sa i ma dangi ginɛ birin na, a bara baraka sa i xa di ma naxan na i tɛɛgɛ.

sentences.english: How is it that the mother of my Lord comes to me?
sentences.susu: N tan yi hɛɛri sɔtɔxi di, n Marigi nga xa fa n xɔnyi?

sentences.english: For, truly, when the sound of your voice came to my ears, the baby in my body made a sudden move for joy.
sentences.susu: A mato, n to i xa xɛɛbui mɛ, n ma diyɔrɛ bara a ramaxa n tɛɛgɛ sɛɛwɛ ra.

sentences.english: Happy will she be who had faith that the things which the Lord has said to her will be done.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ na i bɛ, i tan naxan laxi a ra a Marigi xa masenyi kamalima nɛ, a naxan masen i bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Mary said: My soul gives glory to God;
sentences.susu: Mariyama naxa fa a masen, «N nii birin Marigi matɔxɔma!

sentences.english: My spirit is glad in God my Saviour.
sentences.susu: N xaxili bara sɛɛwa Ala n Nakisima ra,

sentences.english: For he has had pity on his servant, though she is poor and lowly placed: and from this hour will all generations give witness to the blessing which has come to me.
sentences.susu: a to a ya ragoroxi a xa konyi magoroxi ma. Keli yi waxati ma han waxati naxan birin sa fama, mixie n xili falama nɛ ‹sɛɛwatɔɛ›,

sentences.english: For he who is strong has done great things for me; and holy is his name.
sentences.susu: barima Sɛnbɛ Kanyi bara fe xungbee raba n bɛ. A xili sɛniyɛn.

sentences.english: His mercy is for all generations in whom is the fear of him.
sentences.susu: A kinikinima waxati birin mixie ma, naxee gaaxuma a ya ra.

sentences.english: With his arm he has done acts of power; he has put to flight those who have pride in their hearts.
sentences.susu: A xa walie bara a sɛnbɛ masen. A bara yɛtɛ igboe rayensen.

sentences.english: He has put down kings from their seats, lifting up on high the men of low degree.
sentences.susu: A bara mangɛe ba e xa kibanyie kui, a mixi magoroxie xa fe ite.

sentences.english: Those who had no food he made full of good things; the men of wealth he sent away with nothing in their hands;
sentences.susu: A bara kaamɛtɔɛe rawasa se fanyi ra, a bannamixie rasiga e yi igeli ra.

sentences.english: His help he has given to Israel, his servant, so that he might keep in mind his mercy to Abraham and his seed for ever,
sentences.susu: A bara a xa konyi Isirayila mali, a mu nɛɛmuxi kinikinide a ma.

sentences.english: As he gave his word to our fathers.
sentences.susu: A kinikinima nɛ Iburahima nun a xa die ma abadan, alɔ a a fala won benbae bɛ ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And Mary was with her for about three months and then went back to her house.
sentences.susu: Mariyama naxa lu Elisabɛti yire kike saxan ɲɔndɔn, a fa gbilen a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Now it was time for Elisabeth to give birth, and she had a son.
sentences.susu: Elisabɛti xa di bari tɛmui to a li, a naxa di xɛmɛ sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And it came to the ears of her neighbours and relations that the Lord had been very good to her, and they took part in her joy.
sentences.susu: A dɔxɔbooree nun a barenyie to a mɛ a Marigi bara kinikini a ma ki fanyi, e nun Elisabɛti naxa sɛɛwa.

sentences.english: And on the eighth day they came to see to the circumcision of the child, and they would have given him the name of Zacharias, his father's name;
sentences.susu: A xi solomasaxan lɔxɔɛ, mixie naxa fa diyɔrɛ sunnade. E nu waxi di xili safe a baba Sakari xun ma,

sentences.english: But his mother made answer and said, No, his name is John.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ a nga naxa a fala, «Ade, a xili sama nɛ Yaya.»

sentences.english: And they said, Not one of your relations has that name.
sentences.susu: E naxa wɔyɛn a bɛ, «Mixi yo mu na i xa mixie ya ma yi xili na naxan xun ma.»

sentences.english: And they made signs to his father, to say what name was to be given to him.
sentences.susu: E naxa tɔnxuma raba di baba bɛ e xa a kolon a wama a xili xa sa ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And he sent for writing materials and put down: His name is John; and they were all surprised.
sentences.susu: Sakari to walaxɛ maxɔrin, a naxa a sɛbɛ, «A xili Yaya.» E birin naxa kaaba.

sentences.english: And straight away his mouth was open and his tongue was free and he gave praise to God.
sentences.susu: Keren na, Sakari nɛnyi naxa keli, a wɔyɛn, a so Ala tantufe.

sentences.english: And fear came on all those who were living round about them: and there was much talk about all these things in all the hill-country of Judaea.
sentences.susu: E dɔxɔboore birin naxa gaaxu na fe ma. Yudaya geya bɔxi birin ma, mixie nu na fee nan ifalama.

sentences.english: And all who had word of them kept them in their minds and said, What will this child be? For the hand of the Lord was with him.
sentences.susu: E to a mɛ, birin nu e ɲɔxɔ saxi yi fee xɔn ma, e nu a fala, «Yi di findima nde ra?» E a kolon Marigi bɛlɛxɛ nu na a xun ma.

sentences.english: And his father, Zacharias, was full of the Holy Spirit, and with the voice of a prophet said these words:
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa goro a baba Sakari ma, a naxa yi masenyi ti Ala xili ra,

sentences.english: Praise be to the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has come to his people and made them free,
sentences.susu: «Tantui na Ala bɛ, Isirayila Marigi Ala! A bara fa a xa mixie xunmatode, a e xunsara.

sentences.english: Lifting up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David,
sentences.susu: A bara Marakisima Sɛnbɛma rakeli a xa konyi Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ ya ma,

sentences.english: (As he said, by the mouth of his holy prophets, from the earliest times,)
sentences.susu: alɔ a nu a masenxi ki naxɛ tɛmui dangixi, a xa namiɲɔnmɛ sɛniyɛntɔɛe saabui ra.

sentences.english: Salvation from those who are against us, and from the hands of those who have hate for us;
sentences.susu: A a masen nɛ, a a won nakisima won yaxuie yi ra, a won ba won xɔnmae birin bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: To do acts of mercy to our fathers and to keep in mind his holy word,
sentences.susu: A bara kinikini won benbae ma, a bara ratu a xa saatɛ sɛniyɛnxi ma.

sentences.english: The oath which he made to Abraham, our father,
sentences.susu: A laayidi nan tongo won benba Iburahima bɛ,
