sentences.english: That we, being made free from the fear of those who are against us, might give him worship,
sentences.susu: a a won bama won yaxuie bɛlɛxɛ, alako won xa nɔ a batude bɔɲɛsa kui,

sentences.english: In righteousness and holy living before him all our days.
sentences.susu: won xa nɔ ɲɛrɛde sɛniyɛnyi nun tinxinyi kui, won ɲɛrɛ a ya i won ma simaya lɔxɔɛ birin.

sentences.english: And you, child, will be named the prophet of the Most High: you will go before the face of the Lord, to make ready his ways;
sentences.susu: I tan, n ma di, i xili falama nɛ Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi xa Namiɲɔnmɛ, barima i sigama nɛ Marigi ya ra kirae yailande a bɛ,

sentences.english: To give knowledge of salvation to his people, through the forgiveness of sins,
sentences.susu: alako Marigi xa mixie xa kisi kolon, e naxan sɔtɔma e xa yunubie na xafari.

sentences.english: Because of the loving mercies of our God, by which the dawn from heaven has come to us,
sentences.susu: Na kisi kelima won Marigi Ala xa kinikini xungbe nan ma. A naiyalanyi xɛɛma won ma keli ariyanna,

sentences.english: To give light to those in dark places, and in the shade of death, so that our feet may be guided into the way of peace.
sentences.susu: alako a xa yanba mixie bɛ naxee na dimi kui, naxee dɔxɔxi faxɛ xa dimi kui, alako a xa won naɲɛrɛ bɔɲɛsa kira xɔn.»

sentences.english: And the child became tall, and strong in spirit; and he was living in the waste land till the day when he came before the eyes of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na kui, di naxa mɔ, a nu sɛnbɛ nun xaxili sɔtɔ. A naxa sabati wula i han a a yɛtɛ masen Isirayila bɛ lɔxɔ naxɛ.

sentences.english: Now it came about in those days that an order went out from Caesar Augustus that there was to be a numbering of all the world.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Rɔma mangɛ xungbe Ogusutu naxa yaamari fi duniɲa birin xa xili sɛbɛ raba.

sentences.english: This was the first numbering, which was made when Quirinius was ruler of Syria.
sentences.susu: Yi xili sɛbɛ singe raba tɛmui naxɛ, Kirinyusi nan nu findixi Siriya gomina ra.

sentences.english: And all men went to be numbered, everyone to his town.
sentences.susu: Birin naxa siga a bari taa a xili sɛbɛde.

sentences.english: And Joseph went up from Galilee, out of the town of Nazareth, into Judaea, to Beth-lehem, the town of David, because he was of the house and family of David,
sentences.susu: Yusufu fan naxa keli Nasarɛti, taa naxan na Galile bɔxi ma, sigafe ra Bɛtɛlɛɛmu, mangɛ Dawuda baride naxan na Yudaya bɔxi ma. Yusufu siga naa nɛ, barima a nu kelixi Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ nun a xabilɛ nan kui,

sentences.english: To be put on the list with Mary, his future wife, who was about to become a mother.
sentences.susu: a siga a xa sa a xili sɛbɛ, e nun Mariyama, a nu bara naxan xa kote dɔxɔ. Mariyama tɛɛgɛxi nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: And while they were there, the time came for her to give birth.
sentences.susu: E nu na mɛnni tɛmui naxɛ, Mariyama di sɔtɔ tɛmui naxa a li,

sentences.english: And she had her first son; and folding him in linen, she put him to rest in the place where the cattle had their food, because there was no room for them in the house.
sentences.susu: a fa a xa di singe bari, di xɛmɛ. A naxa a mafilin dugi kui, a a sa xuruse dɛgede kui, barima yigiya fanyi mu nu na e bɛ.

sentences.english: And in the same country there were keepers of sheep in the fields, watching over their flock by night.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni xuruse dɛmadonyi ndee nu na wula i, xurusee kantade kɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And an angel of the Lord came to them, and the glory of the Lord was shining round about them: and fear came on them.
sentences.susu: Marigi xa malekɛ nde naxa mini e ma, e naxa Marigi xa nɔrɛ to yanba ra e rabilinyi. E naxa gaaxu ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And the angel said, Have no fear; for truly, I give you good news of great joy which will be for all the people:
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo naxa gaaxu barima n faxi xibaaru fanyi nan masende wo bɛ, naxan findima sɛɛwɛ xungbe ra ɲama birin bɛ.

sentences.english: For on this day, in the town of David, a Saviour has come to birth, who is Christ the Lord.
sentences.susu: To, wo Rakisima, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, a bara bari Dawuda xa taa kui. Wo Marigi nan a ra.

sentences.english: And this is the sign to you: you will see a young child folded in linen, in the place where the cattle have their food.
sentences.susu: Wo a kolonma yi tɔnxuma nan na, wo diyɔrɛ lima a mafilinxi dugi kui, a man saxi xuruse dɛgede kui.»

sentences.english: And suddenly there was with the angel a great band of spirits from heaven, giving praise to God, and saying,
sentences.susu: Malekɛ gɛ wɔyɛnde tan mu a ra, malekɛ gali naxa fa boore fɛ ma. E nu Ala matɔxɔfe, e nu a fala,

sentences.english: Glory to God in the highest, and on the earth peace among men with whom he is well pleased.
sentences.susu: «Matɔxɔɛ na Ala bɛ han koore ma! Bɔɲɛsa na adamadie bɛ duniɲa ma, a hinnɛxi naxee ra!»

sentences.english: And when the angels had gone away from them into heaven, the keepers of the sheep said to one another, Let us go now to Beth-lehem, and see this thing which has come about, which the Lord has made clear to us.
sentences.susu: Malekɛe to keli e xun ma tefe ra koore ma, xuruse dɛmadonyie naxa a fala e bore bɛ, «Won xɛɛ Bɛtɛlɛɛmu, won xa sa yi fe mato naxan nabaxi naa, Marigi bara naxan masen won bɛ.»

sentences.english: And they came quickly, and saw Mary and Joseph, and the child in the place where the cattle had their food.
sentences.susu: E naxa siga e xulun na, e Mariyama nun Yusufu li, e nun diyɔrɛ, a saxi xuruse dɛgede kui.

sentences.english: And when they saw it, they gave them an account of the things which had been said to them about the child.
sentences.susu: E to na to, e naxa fe birin tagi raba, malekɛ naxan masen e bɛ na di xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And all those to whose ears it came were full of wonder at the things said by the keepers of the sheep.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee xuruse dɛmadonyie xui mɛ, e birin naxa kaaba e xa wɔyɛnyi ma.

sentences.english: But Mary kept all these words in her heart, and gave much thought to them.
sentences.susu: Mariyama fan naxa yi fe birin nagata a bɔɲɛ ma, a nu a ɲɔxɔ sa a xɔn.

sentences.english: Then the keepers of the sheep went back, giving glory and praise to God for all the things which had come to their ears and which they had seen, as it had been said to them.
sentences.susu: Xuruse dɛmadonyie naxa gbilen Ala matɔxɔ ra, e nu a tantu fe birin ma e bara naxee mɛ, e man bara naxee to. E a birin lixi nɛ alɔ a masen e bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And when, after eight days, the time came for his circumcision, he was named Jesus, the name which the angel had given to him before his birth.
sentences.susu: Xi solomasaxan to kamali, diyɔrɛ naxa sunna. A xili naxa sa Isa, malekɛ nu bara xili naxan masen a nga bɛ beenun a xa tɛɛgɛ a ma.

sentences.english: And when the necessary days for making them clean by the law of Moses had come to an end, they took him to Jerusalem to give him to the Lord
sentences.susu: Marasɛniyɛnyi waxati to kamali Annabi Munsa xa sɛriyɛ ki ma, Yusufu nun Mariyama naxa Isa xanin Darisalamu, a xa masen Marigi bɛ,

sentences.english: (As it says in the law of the Lord, Every mother's first male child is to be holy to the Lord),
sentences.susu: alɔ a sɛbɛxi ki naxɛ Marigi xa sɛriyɛ kui, «Wo di xɛmɛ singe birin fima n tan nan ma.»

sentences.english: And to make an offering, as it is ordered in the law of the Lord, of two doves or other young birds.
sentences.susu: E man siga nɛ e xa sa sɛrɛxɛ ba alɔ a sɛbɛxi Marigi xa sɛriyɛ kui ki naxɛ, «ganbɛ firin, xa na mu a ra kolokonde lanma firin.»

sentences.english: And there was then in Jerusalem a man whose name was Simeon; and he was an upright man, fearing God and waiting for the comfort of Israel: and the Holy Spirit was on him.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ nde nu na Darisalamu, naxan xili Simeyɔn. Diinɛla tinxinxi nan nu a ra, naxan nu Isirayila Rakisima mamɛfe. Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nu na a xun ma.

sentences.english: And he had knowledge, through the Holy Spirit, that he would not see death till he had seen the Lord's Christ.
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nu bara a masen a bɛ, a a mu faxama fo a Marigi xa Mixi Sugandixi to.

sentences.english: And full of the Spirit he came into the Temple; and when the father and mother came in with the child Jesus, to do with him what was ordered by the law,
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa a niya a xa siga hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui. Isa barimae fan to so naa e xa di ra, alako e xa Ala xa sɛriyɛ rabatu a xa fe ra,

sentences.english: Then he took him in his arms and gave praise to God and said,
sentences.susu: Simeyɔn naxa Isa rasuxu, a a sa a kanke ma. A naxa Ala matɔxɔ, a a masen,

sentences.english: Now you are letting your servant go in peace, O Lord, as you have said;
sentences.susu: «Marigi, i bara fa i xa laayidi rakamali n bɛ to, i xa konyi xa taa masara bɔɲɛsa kui,

sentences.english: For my eyes have seen your salvation,
sentences.susu: barima n ya bara i xa kisi to,

sentences.english: Which you have made ready before the face of all nations;
sentences.susu: i naxan xɛɛxi adamadie birin ya xɔri.

sentences.english: A light of revelation to the Gentiles, and the glory of your people Israel.
sentences.susu: Naiyalanyi nan a ra naxan Ala makɛnɛnma si gbɛtɛe bɛ, a findi nɔrɛ ra i xa Isirayila ɲama bɛ.»

sentences.english: And his father and mother were full of wonder at the things which were said about him.
sentences.susu: Isa baba nun a nga to a mɛ naxan masenxi a xa fe ra, e naxa kaaba.

sentences.english: And Simeon gave them his blessing and said to Mary, his mother, See, this child will be the cause of the downfall and the lifting up of great numbers of people in Israel, and he will be a sign against which hard words will be said;
sentences.susu: Simeyɔn to duba e bɛ, a naxa a fala Isa nga Mariyama bɛ, «Ala bara ɲanige tongo yi di xa fe ra. Isirayilakae xa fe gbegbe magoroma nɛ a saabui ra, ndee fan xa fe itema nɛ. A findima tɔnxuma nan na, kɔnɔ mixi wuyaxi fama nɛ a matandide.

sentences.english: (And a sword will go through your heart;) so that the secret thoughts of men may come to light.
sentences.susu: Na kui, mixi gbegbe bɔɲɛ ma fee fama makɛnɛnde. I tan fan, sunnunyi fama i bɔɲɛ tunbade alɔ santidɛgɛma.»

sentences.english: And there was one, Anna, a woman prophet, the daughter of Phanuel, of the family of Asher (she was very old, and after seven years of married life
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ ginɛ fori fan nu na, naxan xili Anna. A xa simaya nu bara masiga ki fanyi. Fanuweli xa di nan nu a ra kelife Aseri bɔnsɔɛ. A nu bara dɔxɔ xɛmɛ taa a ginɛdimɛdi ra, kɔnɔ ɲɛ solofere dangi xanbi, a xa mɔri naxa laaxira.

sentences.english: She had been a widow for eighty-four years); she was in the Temple at all times, worshipping with prayers and going without food, night and day.
sentences.susu: Kabi na tɛmui, a nu bara lu kaaɲɛ kui han a xa simaya nu bara ɲɛ tongo solomasaxan nun naani li. A mu nu kelima hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, a nu Ala batu naa, kɔɛ nun yanyi, sunyi nun sali ra.

sentences.english: And coming up at that time, she gave praise to God, talking of him to all those who were waiting for the freeing of Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Na waxati kerenyi, Anna naxa fa naralan Isa nun a xa mixie ra. A naxa so Ala matɔxɔfe, a nu fa yi di xa fe fala birin bɛ, naxee nu e ya tixi Ala ra Darisalamu xunsarafe ra.

sentences.english: And when they had done all the things which were ordered by the law of the Lord, they went back to Galilee, to Nazareth, the town where they were living.
sentences.susu: Yusufu nun Mariyama to gɛ fe birin nakamalide alɔ Marigi xa sɛriyɛ a masenxi ki naxɛ, e naxa gbilen Nasarɛti, e xɔnyi Galile bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the child became tall and strong and full of wisdom, and the grace of God was on him.
sentences.susu: Di naxa mɔ, a nu sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ, a xa lɔnni xun nu siga masa ra ki fanyi. Ala xa hinnɛ nu na a xun ma.

sentences.english: And every year his father and mother went to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ yo ɲɛ, Isa barimae nu sigama Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali rabade Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And when he was twelve years old, they went up, as their way was, to the feast;
sentences.susu: Isa ɲɛ fu nun firin sɔtɔ ɲɛ naxan na, e birin naxa te sali rabade Darisalamu alɔ e darixi a ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And when the days of the feast came to an end and they were going back, the boy Jesus was still in Jerusalem, but they had no knowledge of it:
sentences.susu: Sali lɔxɔɛe birin to dangi, Isa barimae naxa biyaasi fɔlɔ gbilenfe e xɔnyi, kɔnɔ e xa di Isa naxa lu Darisalamu, e tan mu a kolon.

sentences.english: And in the belief that he was with some of their number, they went a day's journey; and after looking for him among their relations and friends,
sentences.susu: E nu bara a maɲɔxun a a na e biyaasibooree ya ma. E to gɛ fɛɛɲɛn keren ɲɛrɛ rabade, e nu a fenfe e barenyie nun e booree ya ma.

sentences.english: And seeing that he was not there, they went back to Jerusalem, to make search for him.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e to mu a to, e naxa gbilen Darisalamu a fende.

sentences.english: And after three days they came across him in the Temple, seated among the wise men, giving ear to their words and putting questions to them.
sentences.susu: Xi saxan dangi xanbi, e naxa fa a to hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui karamɔxɔe ya ma, a a tuli matife e ra, a nu maxɔrinyi tife e ma.

sentences.english: And all to whose ears it came were full of wonder at his knowledge and the answers which he gave.
sentences.susu: Naxan birin nu na Isa xui mɛfe, e nu kaabama a xa xaxili fanyi nun a xa yaabie ma.

sentences.english: And when they saw him they were surprised, and his mother said to him, Son, why have you done this to us? see, your father and I have been looking for you with sorrow.
sentences.susu: A barimae to a to, e fan naxa kaaba. A nga naxa a fala a bɛ, «N ma di, i yi fe mɔɔli rabaxi muxu ra munfe ra? N tan nun i baba kɔntɔfilixi nan i fenxi yi ki.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Why were you looking for me? was it not clear to you that my right place was in my Father's house?
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo n fenma munfe ra? Wo mu a kolon fo n xa n Baba xa wali raba?»

sentences.english: And his words seemed strange to them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e mu fahaamui sɔtɔ a xa wɔyɛnyi ma.

sentences.english: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth; and did as he was ordered: and his mother kept all these words in her heart.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Isa naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra gorofe ra Nasarɛti, a nu e sago raba. A nga naxa yi fe birin nagata a bɔɲɛ ma.

sentences.english: And Jesus was increasing in wisdom and in years, and in grace before God and men.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa mɔ lɔnni nun hinnɛ ra. A naxa rafan Ala nun mixie ma.

sentences.english: Now in the fifteenth year of the rule of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being ruler of Judaea, and Herod being king of Galilee, his brother Philip king of the country of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias king of Abilene,
sentences.susu: Rɔma mangɛ xungbe Tiberiyo nu na a xa mangɛya ɲɛ fu nun suuli nde kui. Ponsi Pilati nan nu findixi Yudaya gomina ra. Herode nan nu findixi Galile mangɛ ra, a taara Filipu fan nu findixi Itureya nun Tirakoniti bɔxie mangɛ ra. Lisaniya nan nu findixi Abilen mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: When Annas and Caiaphas were high priests, the word of the Lord came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the waste land.
sentences.susu: Anani nun Kayafa nan nu findixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie ra. Na waxati, Ala xa masenyi naxa fa Sakari xa di Yaya ma, a to nu na wula i.

sentences.english: And he came into all the country round about Jordan, preaching baptism as a sign of forgiveness of sin for those whose hearts were changed.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a naxa siga kawandi rabade Yurudɛn xure longori birin. A nu kawandi tima mixie bɛ, e xa e xunxa ye xɔɔra tuubi ra, alako Ala xa e xa yunubie xafari.

sentences.english: As it says in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, The voice of one crying in the waste land, Make ready the way of the Lord, make his roads straight.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi Annabi Esayi xa Kitaabui kui, «Mixi nde a xui itema gbengberenyi ma, ‹Wo kira yailan Marigi bɛ, wo sankirae matinxin a ya ra.

sentences.english: Every valley will be lifted up, and all the mountains and hills made low, and the twisted will be made straight, and the rough ways smooth;
sentences.susu: Fole birin nafema nɛ. Geya xungbe nun a lanma, a birin igoroma nɛ. Kira madalinxi tinxinma nɛ, kira ɲaaxi yailanma nɛ.

sentences.english: And all flesh will see the salvation of God.
sentences.susu: Adamadi birin fama nɛ Ala xa kisi tode.›»

sentences.english: So he said to the people who went out to him for baptism: You offspring of snakes, at whose word are you going in flight from the wrath to come?
sentences.susu: Na kui, ɲama to nu sigama Yaya xɔn ma a xa e xunxa ye xɔɔra, a naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo tan bɔximase bɔnsɔɛ! Nde wo rakolonxi wo xa wo gi Ala xa xɔnɛ ma naxan na fafe?

sentences.english: Make clear by your acts that your hearts have been changed; and do not say to yourselves, We have Abraham for our father: for I say to you that God is able from these stones to make children of Abraham.
sentences.susu: Wo kɛɲa xa wali fanyi ramini alɔ wuri bili fanyi bogi fanyi raminima ki naxɛ, bogi naxan a masenma a wo bara tuubi. Wo naxa a fala wo yɛtɛ ma, ‹Iburahima nan na muxu benba ra,› barima fɛɛrɛ na Ala yi a xa yi gɛmɛe mafindi Iburahima xa die ra.

sentences.english: And even now the axe is put to the root of the trees; and every tree which does not have good fruit will be cut down and put into the fire.
sentences.susu: Beera ɲan na wurie sankee ra a xa e bilie sɛgɛ. Wuri naxan yo mu bogi fanyi raminima, a fɔnma nɛ, a woli tɛ i.»

sentences.english: And the people put questions to him, saying, What have we to do?
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa a maxɔrin, «Muxu xa munse raba fa?»

sentences.english: And he made answer and said to them, He who has two coats, let him give to him who has not even one; and he who has food, let him do the same.
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «Donma firin na naxan yi ra, a kanyi xa keren fi boore ma, se mu na naxan yi. Donse na naxan yi ra, a kanyi fan xa a raba na ki.»

sentences.english: Then tax-farmers came to him for baptism and said to him, Master, what have we to do?
sentences.susu: Duuti maxilie fan naxa fa e xunxade ye xɔɔra, e a maxɔrin, «Karamɔxɔ, a lanma muxu xa munse raba?»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Do not make an attempt to get more money than the right amount.
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «Wo naxa duuti xun masa dangi yaamari ra.»

sentences.english: And men of the army put questions to him, saying, And what have we to do? And he said to them, Do no violent acts to any man, and do not take anything without right, and let your payment be enough for you.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri ndee fan naxa a maxɔrin, «Muxu tan go? A lanma muxu fan xa munse raba?» A naxa e yaabi, «Wo naxa mixi yo muɲa, wo naxa mixi yo tɔɔɲɛgɛ. Wo xa wo wasa so wo wali sare nan na.»

sentences.english: And while the people were waiting, and all men were questioning in their hearts about John, if he was the Christ or not,
sentences.susu: Mixie naxa e xaxili ti Yaya ra, e nu e maɲɔxun, a tɛmunde Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi na a ra.

sentences.english: John made answer, saying to them all, Truly, I give you baptism with water, but one is coming who is greater than I, whose shoes I am not good enough to undo: he will give you baptism with the Holy Spirit, and with fire:
sentences.susu: Yaya naxa a fala e birin bɛ, «N tan wo xunxama ye nan xɔɔra, kɔnɔ naxan fama n xanbi ra, na sɛnbɛ gbo n tan bɛ. Na binyɛ mu na n tan yi ra, n ɲan xa a xa sankiri luuti yati fulun. A tan nan Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi ragoroma wo ma, a tan nan wo xunxama tɛ ra.

sentences.english: In whose hand is the instrument with which he will make clean his grain; he will put the good grain in his store, but the waste will be burned in the fire which will never be put out.
sentences.susu: A xa segere suxuxi a yi ra, a maale nun a lagi yegetima naxan na lɔnyi ma. A maale rasoma a xa bili kui, kɔnɔ a lagi tan ganma tɛ ra naxan mu xubenma.»

sentences.english: And so comforting them with these and other words, he gave the good news to the people;
sentences.susu: Yaya man nu mixie rasima a mɔɔli wuyaxi ra, a nu e kawandi xibaaru fanyi ra.

sentences.english: But Herod the king, because John had made a protest on account of Herodias, his brother's wife, and other evil things which Herod had done,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Yaya to wɔyɛn mangɛ Herode ma, a taara xa ginɛ Herodiyasi xa fe ra, a nun a nu bara fe ɲaaxi naxan birin naba,

sentences.english: Did this most evil thing of all, and had John shut up in prison.
sentences.susu: Herode man naxa yi fe kobi keren sa na birin xun: A naxa Yaya sa geeli.

sentences.english: Now it came about that when all the people had been given baptism, Jesus, having had baptism with them, was in prayer, when, the heaven being open,
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin to nu bara e xunxa ye xɔɔra, Isa fan naxa a xunxa ye xɔɔra. A to nu Ala maxandife, koore naxa rabi,

sentences.english: The Holy Spirit came down in the form of a dove, and a voice came from heaven, saying, You are my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased.
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa goro a ma alɔ ganbɛ. Xui nde naxa keli koore ma, a a masen, «N ma Di maxanuxi nan na i ra. I n kɛnɛnxi ki fanyi ra.»

sentences.english: And Jesus at this time was about thirty years old, being the son (as it seemed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,
sentences.susu: Isa to ɲɛ tongo saxan ɲɔndɔn sɔtɔ, a naxa a xa wali fɔlɔ. Mixie nu laxi a ra Yusufu xa di nan a ra. Yusufu findixi Heli xa di nan na,

sentences.english: The son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,
sentences.susu: Heli findixi Matahati xa di nan na, Matahati findixi Lewi xa di nan na, Lewi findixi Meliki xa di nan na, Meliki findixi Yannayi xa di nan na, Yannayi findixi Yusufu xa di nan na,

sentences.english: The son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,
sentences.susu: Yusufu findixi Matahisa xa di nan na, Matahisa findixi Amosi xa di nan na, Amosi findixi Naxumu xa di nan na, Naxumu findixi Esili xa di nan na, Esili findixi Nagayi xa di nan na,

sentences.english: The son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Josech, the son of Joda,
sentences.susu: Nagayi findixi Maati xa di nan na, Maati findixi Matahisa xa di nan na, Matahisa findixi Semeyin xa di nan na, Semeyin findixi Yoseke xa di nan na, Yoseke findixi Yoda xa di nan na,

sentences.english: The son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,
sentences.susu: Yoda findixi Yohana xa di nan na, Yohana findixi Resa xa di nan na, Resa findixi Sorobabeli xa di nan na, Sorobabeli findixi Salatiyeli xa di nan na, Salatiyeli findixi Neri xa di nan na,

sentences.english: The son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmadam, the son of Er,
sentences.susu: Neri findixi Meliki xa di nan na, Meliki findixi Adi xa di nan na, Adi findixi Kosan xa di nan na, Kosan findixi Elemadan xa di nan na, Elemadan findixi Eru xa di nan na,

sentences.english: The son of Jesus, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,
sentences.susu: Eru findixi Yosuwe xa di nan na, Yosuwe findixi Eliyeseri xa di nan na, Eliyeseri findixi Yorimi xa di nan na, Yorimi findixi Matahati xa di nan na, Matahati findixi Lewi xa di nan na,

sentences.english: The son of Symeon, the son of Judas, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonam, the son of Eliakim,
sentences.susu: Lewi findixi Simeyɔn xa di nan na, Simeyɔn findixi Yuda xa di nan na, Yuda findixi Yusufu xa di nan na, Yusufu findixi Yonan xa di nan na, Yonan findixi Eliyakin xa di nan na,

sentences.english: The son of Melea, the son of Menna, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,
sentences.susu: Eliyakin findixi Meleya xa di nan na, Meleya findixi Mena xa di nan na, Mena findixi Matata xa di nan na, Matata findixi Natan xa di nan na, Natan findixi Dawuda xa di nan na,

sentences.english: The son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,
sentences.susu: Dawuda findixi Yisayi xa di nan na, Yisayi findixi Obedo xa di nan na, Obedo findixi Boosu xa di nan na, Boosu findixi Salimon xa di nan na, Salimon findixi Naxason xa di nan na,

sentences.english: The son of Amminadab, the son of Arni, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,
sentences.susu: Naxason findixi Aminadabo xa di nan na, Aminadabo findixi Adimin xa di nan na, Adimin findixi Arini xa di nan na, Arini findixi Xesiron xa di nan na, Xesiron findixi Peresi xa di nan na, Peresi findixi Yuda xa di nan na,

sentences.english: The son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,
sentences.susu: Yuda findixi Yaxuba xa di nan na, Yaxuba findixi Isiyaga xa di nan na, Isiyaga findixi Iburahima xa di nan na, Iburahima findixi Tera xa di nan na, Tera findixi Naxori xa di nan na,

sentences.english: The son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,
sentences.susu: Naxori findixi Serugu xa di nan na, Serugu findixi Rewu xa di nan na, Rewu findixi Pelegi xa di nan na, Pelegi findixi Eberi xa di nan na, Eberi findixi Selaha xa di nan na,

sentences.english: The son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,
sentences.susu: Selaha findixi Kayinan xa di nan na, Kayinan findixi Arafaxadi xa di nan na, Arafaxadi findixi Semi xa di nan na, Semi findixi Nuha xa di nan na, Nuha findixi Lemeki xa di nan na,

sentences.english: The son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,
sentences.susu: Lemeki findixi Metusela xa di nan na, Metusela findixi Enoki xa di nan na, Enoki findixi Yeredi xa di nan na, Yeredi findixi Mahalaleli xa di nan na, Mahalaleli findixi Kenan xa di nan na,

sentences.english: The son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.
sentences.susu: Kenan findixi Enosi xa di nan na, Enosi findixi Seti xa di nan na, Seti findixi Adama xa di nan na, Adama findixi Ala xa di nan na.

sentences.english: And Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, came back from the Jordan, and was guided by the Spirit in the waste land
sentences.susu: Isa to keli Yurudɛn, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nu goroxi a ma, a Isa xun ti gbengberenyi ra.

sentences.english: For forty days, being tested by the Evil One. And he had no food in those days; and when they came to an end, he was in need of food.
sentences.susu: Xi tongo naani bun ma, a nu na naa, Ibulisa nu katafe a ratantande. Isa mu sese don na waxati birin bun. Na xi kɔnti to kamali, kaamɛ nu na a ma.

sentences.english: And the Evil One said to him, If you are the Son of God, give orders to this stone to become bread.
sentences.susu: Ibulisa naxa a fala a bɛ, «Xa Ala xa Di nan i ra, yaamari fi yi gɛmɛ xa findi taami ra.»

sentences.english: And Jesus made answer to him, It has been said in the Writings, Bread is not man's only need.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, ‹Mixi mu baloma taami gbansan xa ra.›»

sentences.english: And he took him up and let him see all the kingdoms of the earth in a minute of time.
sentences.susu: Ibulisa naxa fa a xanin geya fari, a duniɲa mangɛya birin masen a bɛ kerenyi ra.

sentences.english: And the Evil One said, I will give you authority over all these, and the glory of them, for it has been given to me, and I give it to anyone at my pleasure.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a bɛ, «N yi mangɛya birin fima nɛ i ma a nun a dariyɛ, barima a soxi n tan nan yi. N fan nɔma a fide, n na wa a fife naxan yo ma.

sentences.english: If then you will give worship to me, it will all be yours.
sentences.susu: Na kui, xa i i felen n bɛ, i n batu, n a birin findima nɛ i gbe ra.»

sentences.english: And Jesus in answer said to him, It has been said in the Writings, Give worship to the Lord your God, and be his servant only.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, ‹I xa i Marigi Ala gbansan nan batu, i xa suyidi a keren nan bɛ.›»

sentences.english: And he took him to Jerusalem and put him on the highest point of the Temple and said to him, If you are the Son of God, let yourself go down from here; for it is said in the Writings,
sentences.susu: Ibulisa man naxa a xanin Darisalamu, a a ti Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi fari, yire itexi. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «Xa Ala xa Di nan lanxi i ma, tugan be ra,

sentences.english: He will give his angels orders to take care of you:
sentences.susu: barima a sɛbɛxi, ‹Ala yaamari fima nɛ a xa malekɛe ma i xa fe ra, e xa i kanta.›

sentences.english: And, In their hands they will keep you up, so that your foot may not be crushed against a stone.
sentences.susu: A man sɛbɛxi, ‹E e bɛlɛxɛe rasoma nɛ i bun ma, e i rate alako i sanyi naxa din gɛmɛ ra.›»

sentences.english: And Jesus made answer and said to him, It is said in the Writings, You may not put the Lord your God to the test.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «Kitaabui man a masenxi, ‹I naxa i Marigi Ala mato.›»

sentences.english: And when all these tests were ended the Evil One went away from him for a time.
sentences.susu: Ibulisa to gɛ katɛ birin nabade a xa Isa ratantan, a naxa keli a xun ma, han beenun a xa waxati gbɛtɛ xa a li.

sentences.english: And Jesus came back to Galilee in the power of the Spirit, and the news of him went through all the country round about.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa gbilen Galile bɔxi ma. Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa sɛnbɛ nu na a ma. A xa fe xibaaru naxa siga rayensen na yire birin.

sentences.english: And he was teaching in their Synagogues and all men gave him praise.
sentences.susu: Isa nu mixie xaranma e xa salidee kui, birin nu a matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: And he came to Nazareth, where he had been as a child, and he went, as his way was, into the Synagogue on the Sabbath, and got up to give a reading.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa siga Nasarɛti, a xuruxi dɛnnaxɛ. Malabu lɔxɔɛ ma, a naxa so salide kui alɔ a nu darixi a ra ki naxɛ, a ti, a xa Kitaabui xaran mixie bɛ.

sentences.english: And the book of the prophet Isaiah was given to him and, opening the book, he came on the place where it is said,
sentences.susu: E naxa Annabi Esayi xa Kitaabui so a yi. A to a itala, a naxa yire to a sɛbɛxi dɛnnaxɛ,

sentences.english: The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because I am marked out by him to give good news to the poor; he has sent me to make well those who are broken-hearted; to say that the prisoners will be let go, and the blind will see, and to make the wounded free from their chains,
sentences.susu: «Marigi Xaxili na n xun ma, barima a bara n sugandi, a a ragoro n ma, n xa setaree kawandi xibaaru fanyi ra. A n xɛɛxi nɛ n xa xɛɛra iba mixi suxuxie bɛ, e xɔrɛyama nɛ, n xa xɛɛra iba dɔnxuie bɛ, e ya se toma nɛ, n xa tɔɔrɔmixie xɔrɛya naxee na nɔɛ bun ma,

sentences.english: To give knowledge that the year of the Lord's good pleasure is come.
sentences.susu: n xa xɛɛra iba mixie bɛ, Ala xa hinnɛ waxati bara a li.»

sentences.english: And shutting the book he gave it back to the servant and took his seat: and the eyes of all in the Synagogue were fixed on him.
sentences.susu: A naxa fa Kitaabui makuntan, a a so taalibi yi, a dɔxɔ. Birin e ya banbanxi a ra salide kui.

sentences.english: Then he said to them, Today this word has come true in your hearing.
sentences.susu: A naxa masenyi ti fɔlɔ e bɛ, «To, yi sɛbɛli naxan xaranxi wo bɛ yi ki, a bara kamali.»

sentences.english: And they were all giving witness, with wonder, to the words of grace which came from his mouth: and they said, Is not this the son of Joseph?
sentences.susu: Birin nu a xa fe fanyi falama, e nu kaaba wɔyɛn fanyie ma naxee nu minima a kɛrɛ i. E naxa so e bore maxɔrinfe, «Yusufu xa di xa mu yi ki?»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Without doubt you will say to me, Let the medical man make himself well: the things which to our knowledge were done at Capernaum, do them here in your country.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala e bɛ, «N na a kolon wo yi taali sama nɛ n bɛ, ‹Seriba, i yɛtɛ dandan.› Wo man a falama nɛ n bɛ, ‹Muxu bara fe naxan birin mɛ i naxan nabaxi Kapɛrɛnamu, i man xa a mɔɔli raba i xɔnyi be.›

sentences.english: And he said to them, Truly I say to you, No prophet is honoured in his country.
sentences.susu: N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, namiɲɔnmɛ yo mu binyama a xɔnyi tan.

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, There were a number of widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the heaven was shut up for three years and six months and there was no food in the land;
sentences.susu: Wo man xa wo tuli ti nɔndi ra. Kaaɲɛ ginɛ wuyaxi nu na Isirayila bɔxi ma Annabi Eliya xa waxati, kaamɛ to sin bɔxi ma, tunɛ ye mu bira ɲɛ saxan kike senni.

sentences.english: But Elijah was not sent to one of them, but only to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala mu Annabi Eliya xɛɛ e tan Isirayilaka ginɛe sese ma, fo a to a xɛɛ kaaɲɛ ginɛ nde nan gbansan ma naxan nu na Sarepeta, Sidɔn bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And there were a number of lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, and not one of them was made clean, but only Naaman the Syrian.
sentences.susu: Kunɛ kanyi wuyaxi fan nu na Isirayila bɔxi ma Annabi Elise xa waxati, kɔnɔ a mu e tan sese rayalan, fo Naaman Siriyaka gbansan, a na nan nayalan.»

sentences.english: And all who were in the Synagogue were very angry when these things were said to them.
sentences.susu: E to yi fee mɛ, mixi birin naxee nu na salide kui, e bɔɲɛ naxa te Isa xili ma.

sentences.english: And they got up and took him out of the town to the edge of the mountain on which their town was, so that they might send him down to his death.
sentences.susu: E naxa keli, e a ramini taa fari ma. E xa taa to nu tixi geya ra, e naxa a xanin yire nde e xa a radin yɛ gelenyi ra.

sentences.english: But he came through them and went on his way.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa naxa mini e tagi, a a xa kira suxu.

sentences.english: And he came down to Capernaum, a town of Galilee; and he was giving them teaching on the Sabbath.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa goro Kapɛrɛnamu, Galile bɔxi taa nde. A to nu na mixie kawandife malabu lɔxɔɛ,

sentences.english: And they were surprised at his teaching, for his word was with authority.
sentences.susu: e naxa kaaba a xa xaranyi ma, barima a nu wɔyɛnma mangɛ sɛnbɛ nan na.

sentences.english: And there was a man in the Synagogue who had an unclean spirit; and he gave a loud cry and said,
sentences.susu: Na salide kui, xɛmɛ nde nu na ɲinnɛ nu naxan fɔxɔ ra. A naxa sɔnxɔɛ rate fɔlɔ, a gbelegbele,

sentences.english: Let us be! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? have you come to put an end to us? I have knowledge who you are, the Holy One of God.
sentences.susu: «Ee! Isa Nasarɛtika, i waxi munse xɔn ma muxu bɛ? I faxi muxu sɔntɔde nɛ? N na a kolon mixi naxan lanxi i ma. Ala xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ nan na i ra.»

sentences.english: And Jesus said to him, Be quiet, and come out of him. And when the evil spirit had put him down on the earth in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no damage.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa wɔyɛn a ma a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra, a a yamari, «I sabari. Gbilen yi xɛmɛ fɔxɔ ra.» Ɲinnɛ naxa xɛmɛ rabira bɔxi ɲama tagi, a fa gbilen a fɔxɔ ra. Xɛmɛ mu maxɔnɔ hali keren.

sentences.english: And wonder came on them all and they said to one another, What are these words? for with authority and power he gives orders to the evil spirits and they come out.
sentences.susu: Birin dɛ naxa ixara, e nu fa e bore maxɔrin, «Masenyi mɔɔli mundun yi ki? A ɲinnɛe yamarima nɔɛ nun sɛnbɛ ra, nee gbilen mixi fɔxɔ ra!»

sentences.english: And there was much talk about him in all the places round about.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa xa fe xibaaru naxa yensen yɛ na bɔxi rabilinyi yire birin.

sentences.english: And he got up and went out of the Synagogue and went into the house of Simon. And Simon's wife's mother was very ill with a burning heat; and in answer to their prayers for her
sentences.susu: Isa to mini salide kui, a naxa siga Simɔn xɔnyi. Simɔn bitanyi mu nu yalanxi. A fate nu ganxi a ma. E naxa Isa maxandi a xa a mali.

sentences.english: He went near her, and with a sharp word he gave orders to the disease and it went away from her; and straight away she got up and took care of their needs.
sentences.susu: Isa to ti a xun ma, a naxa wɔyɛn na fure ma, fure naxa a bɛɲin. A naxa keli keren na, a kuri so e bɛ.

sentences.english: And at sundown all those who had anyone ill with any sort of disease, took them to him, and he put his hands on every one of them and made them well.
sentences.susu: Soge to dula, e naxa fa furema mɔɔli birin na Isa xɔn ma. A naxa a bɛlɛxɛ sa e ma keren keren, a fa e rayalan.

sentences.english: And evil spirits came out of a number of them, crying out and saying, You are the Son of God. But he gave them sharp orders not to say a word, because they had knowledge that he was the Christ.
sentences.susu: A naxa ɲinnɛe fan keri mixi wuyaxi fɔxɔ ra. Ɲinnɛe nu furemae bɛɲinma, e nu gbelegbele e nu a fala, «Ala xa Di nan na i ra!» Kɔnɔ Isa naxa e yamari, a e ratɔn wɔyɛnfe ra, barima e nu a kolon a Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan a ra.

sentences.english: And when it was day, he came out and went to a waste place; and great numbers of people came looking for him, and they came to him and would have kept him from going away.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, a naxa mini, a siga yire madunduxi nde. Ɲama naxa a fen han e a to. E nu katafe nɛ e xa kankan a ma, a naxa fa keli e xun.

sentences.english: But he said to them, I have to give the good news of the kingdom of God in other towns, because that is why I was sent.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a naxa a masen e bɛ, «Fo n xa taa gbɛtɛe fan kawandi Ala xa mangɛya niini xa xibaaru fanyi ra, barima n xɛɛxi na nan ma.»

sentences.english: And he was teaching in the Synagogues of Galilee.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a nu kawandi tima salidee kui Yudaya bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Now it came about that while the people came pushing to be near him, and to have knowledge of the word of God, he was by a wide stretch of water named Gennesaret;
sentences.susu: Isa nu na Genesareti baa dɛ ra. Ɲama fan nu e bore xɛtɛnma alako e xa a xui mɛ Ala xa masenyi kawandide.

sentences.english: And he saw two boats by the edge of the water, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa kunkui firin to baa dɛ ra. Yɛxɛsuxuie nu bara goro e kui, e nu e xa yɛlɛe raxafe.

sentences.english: And he got into one of the boats, the property of Simon, and made a request to him to go a little way out from the land. And being seated he gave the people teaching from the boat.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa baki Simɔn xa kunkui kui, a a maxɔrin a xa kunkui ndedi mamini xare dɛ ra. Na xanbi, Isa naxa dɔxɔ kunkui kui, a so ɲama kawandife.

sentences.english: And when his talk was ended, he said to Simon, Go out into deep water, and let down your nets for fish.
sentences.susu: Isa to gɛ masenyi tide, a naxa a fala Simɔn bɛ, «Won xɛɛ dula ma. Wo yɛlɛ sa naa, wo xa sa yɛxɛ suxu.»

sentences.english: And Simon, answering, said, Master, we were working all night and we took nothing: but at your word I will let down the nets.
sentences.susu: Simɔn naxa a yaabi, «Karamɔxɔ, muxu kɔɛ birin nan nadangixi yakotomɔɛ nan na, muxu mu sese suxu. Kɔnɔ i tan nan to a falaxi, n man sa yɛlɛ sama.»

sentences.english: And when they had done this, they got such a great number of fish that it seemed as if their nets would be broken;
sentences.susu: E to na raba, e naxa yɛxɛ gbegbe suxu yɛlɛ kui, yɛlɛ naxa bɔɔ fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: And they made signs to their friends in the other boat to come to their help. And they came, and the two boats were so full that they were going down.
sentences.susu: E naxa e bɛlɛxɛ magira booree bɛ naxee nu na kunkui boore kui, e xa fa e mali. E to fa, e naxa na kunkui firinyie rafe yɛxɛ ra han e firin birin naxa wa dulafe.

sentences.english: But Simon, when he saw it, went down at the knees of Jesus and said, Go away from me, O Lord, for I am a sinner.
sentences.susu: Simɔn Piyɛri to na fe to, a naxa bira Isa bun ma, a a fala, «Marigi, i xa i makuya n na, barima yunubitɔɛ nan n na!»

sentences.english: For he was full of wonder and so were all those who were with him, at the number of fish which they had taken;
sentences.susu: A na fala nɛ barima a tan nun a boore birin nu bara gɛ kaabade na yɛxɛ suxufe ra,

sentences.english: And so were James and John, the sons of Zebedee, who were working with Simon. And Jesus said to Simon, Have no fear; from this time forward you will be a fisher of men.
sentences.susu: Simɔn walibooree, Sebede xa di firinyie Yaki nun Yaya, e fan nu bara kaaba. Na kui, Isa naxa a fala Simɔn bɛ, «I naxa gaaxu. I darixi yɛxɛ nan suxu ra, kɔnɔ keli yi waxati ma, i fama mixie nan sɔtɔde n bɛ.»

sentences.english: And when they had got their boats to the land, they gave up everything and went after him.
sentences.susu: E to kunkui rate xare ma, e naxa se birin lu naa, e bira Isa fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And it came about that while he was in one of the towns, there was a leper there: and when he saw Jesus he went down on his face in prayer to him, saying, Lord, if it is your pleasure, you have power to make me clean.
sentences.susu: Isa to nu na taa nde kui, a naxa xɛmɛ nde li naa, kunɛ dinxi a fate birin na. A to Isa to, a naxa a yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma, a a mayandi, «N Marigi, xa i tin, i nɔma n nasɛniyɛnde.»

sentences.english: And he put out his hand to him and said, It is my pleasure; be clean. And straight away his disease went from him.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a bɛlɛxɛ itala, a a sa kunɛ kanyi ma, a a fala a bɛ, «N tinxi. Findi mixi sɛniyɛnxi ra.» Kunɛ fure naxa a bɛɲin keren na.

sentences.english: And he gave him orders: Say nothing to any man, but let the priest see you and give an offering so that you may be made clean, as the law of Moses says, and for a witness to them.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Isa naxa a yamari, «I naxa yi fe fala mixi yo bɛ. Siga i sa i dɛntɛgɛ sɛrɛxɛdubɛ bɛ, i sɛrɛxɛ ba i xa sɛniyɛnyi xa fe ra, alɔ Annabi Munsa a yamarixi ki naxɛ. Na findima seedeɲɔxɔya nan na e bɛ.»

sentences.english: But news of him went out all the more, in every direction, and great numbers of people came together to give hearing to his words and to be made well from their diseases.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa xa fe xibaaru ɲan naxa yensen yɛ dangi a singe ra. Ɲama gbegbe nu e malanma e xa a xui ramɛ, a man xa e rayalan e xa furee ma.

sentences.english: But he went away by himself to a waste place for prayer.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa fan nu luma siga ra yire madunduxie, a sa Ala maxandi.

sentences.english: And it came about that on one of these days he was teaching; and some Pharisees and teachers of the law were seated there, who had come from every town of Galilee and Judaea and from Jerusalem; and the power of the Lord was with him, to make those who were ill free from their diseases.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ nde, Isa nu kawandi tife. Farisɛnie nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe nu bara fa dɔxɔ, naxee kelixi Darisalamu, a nun Galile nun Yudaya taa birin. Marigi xa sɛnbɛ nu na Isa ma furemae rayalanfe ra.

sentences.english: And some men had with them, on a bed, a man who was ill, without power of moving; and they made attempts to get him in and put him before Jesus.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, mixi ndee naxa fa namatɛ nde ra, a saxi sade ma. E nu katafe nɛ e xa fa a sa Isa bun,

sentences.english: And because of the mass of people, there was no way to get him in; so they went up on the top of the house and let him down through the roof, on his bed, into the middle in front of Jesus.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ ɲama xa fe naxa a niya e mu nɔ sode a ra. Na kui, e naxa te banxi fari, e a fari yire nde maba, e fa namatɛ ragoro mɛnni ra, a saxi a xa sade fari, a goro ɲama tagi Isa ya i.

sentences.english: And seeing their faith he said, Man, you have forgiveness for your sins.
sentences.susu: Isa to e xa danxaniya to, a naxa a fala namatɛ bɛ, «N boore, i xa yunubie bara xafari i bɛ.»

sentences.english: And the scribes and Pharisees were having an argument, saying, Who is this, who has no respect for God? who is able to give forgiveness for sins, but God only?
sentences.susu: Farisɛnie nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe naxa so e maɲɔxunfe, «Pe, nde yi ra, a to Ala rasɔtɔma yi ki? Nde nɔma yunubie xafaride, bafe Ala keren na?»

sentences.english: But Jesus, who had knowledge of their thoughts, said to them, Why are you reasoning in your hearts?
sentences.susu: Isa to e xa maɲɔxunyi kolon, a naxa e maxɔrin, «Munfe ra yi maɲɔxunyi mɔɔli na wo bɔɲɛ ma?

sentences.english: Which is the simpler: to say, You have forgiveness for your sins; or to say, Get up and go?
sentences.susu: Wɔyɛnyi mundun sɔɔnɛya, a falafe ‹I xa yunubie bara xafari,› ka a falafe ‹Keli, i ɲɛrɛ›?

sentences.english: But so that you may see that on earth the Son of man has authority for the forgiveness of sins, (he said to the man who was ill,) I say to you, Get up, and take up your bed, and go into your house.
sentences.susu: N xa a masen wo bɛ a Adama xa Di nɔma yunubi xafaride duniɲa ma.» A naxa fa a fala namatɛ bɛ, «N naxɛ i bɛ, keli, i xa sade tongo, i xa siga i xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: And straight away he got up before them, and took up his bed and went away to his house giving praise to God.
sentences.susu: Namatɛ naxa keli mixie ya xɔri keren na. A naxa se tongo a nu saxi naxan ma, a fa siga a xɔnyi Ala matɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And wonder overcame them all, and they gave glory to God; and they were full of fear, saying, We have seen strange things today.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin dɛ naxa ixara ki fanyi, e nu Ala matɔxɔ. Ala xa yaragaaxui fan naxa lu e bɔɲɛ ma, e a fala, «To, muxu bara kaabanako fee to.»

sentences.english: And after these things he went out, and saw Levi, a tax-farmer, seated at the place where taxes were taken, and said to him, Come after me.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Isa naxa mini, a duuti maxili nde to naxan xili Lewi, a dɔxɔxi duuti maxilide. Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «Bira n fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: And giving up his business, he got up and went after him.
sentences.susu: Lewi naxa keli, a fe birin nabolo, a bira a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And Levi made a great feast for him in his house: and a great number of tax-farmers and others were seated at table with them.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Lewi naxa xulunyi belebele ti a xɔnyi Isa bɛ. E birin nu na e dɛgefe yire keren, duuti maxili wuyaxi nun mixi gbɛtɛe fan nu na naa.

sentences.english: And the Pharisees and their scribes made protests against his disciples, saying, Why do you take food and drink with tax-farmers and sinners?
sentences.susu: Farisɛnie nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe naxa Isa fɔxirabirɛe maxɔrin, «Munfe ra wo nun duuti maxilie nun yunubitɔɛe wo dɛgema yire keren?»

sentences.english: And Jesus, answering, said to them, Those who are well have no need of a medical man, but those who are ill.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Mixi yalanxi hayi mu na seriba ma. Furema nan hayi na a ma.

sentences.english: I have come, not to get the upright, but sinners, so that they may be turned from their sins.
sentences.susu: N mu faxi tinxintɔɛe xa xilide. N faxi yunubitɔɛe nan xilide, e xa tuubi.»

sentences.english: And they said to him, The disciples of John frequently go without food, and make prayers, and so do the disciples of the Pharisees; but your disciples take food and drink.
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee naxa fa a fala Isa bɛ, «Annabi Yaya nun Farisɛnie fɔxirabirɛe sunyi nun salie rabama han, kɔnɔ i gbee tan e dɛgema tun.»

sentences.english: And Jesus said, Are you able to make the friends of the newly-married man go without food when he is with them?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Xa futixiri xulunyi a li, wo nɔma a falade ginɛfenyi booree bɛ e xa sunyi suxu a na e fɛ ma tɛmui naxɛ?

sentences.english: But the days will come when he will be taken away from them, and then they will go without food.
sentences.susu: Waxati fama, ginɛfenyi bama e yi ra tɛmui naxɛ. Na waxati tan, e sunyi suxuma nɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, in a story, No man takes a bit of cloth from a new coat and puts it on to an old coat, for so the new coat would be damaged and the bit from the new would not go well with the old.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa taali nde sa e bɛ, «Mixi yo mu dugi xuntunyi bama dugi nɛɛnɛ ra a xa dugi fori lonpo a ra. Xa na raba, dugi nɛɛnɛ kanama nɛ, na xuntunyi fan mu lanma dugi fori ma.

sentences.english: And no man puts new wine into old wine-skins, for fear that the skins will be burst by the new wine, and the wine be let out, and the skins come to destruction.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo man mu wɛni nɛɛnɛ sama lɛbɛ fori kui, xa na mu a ra wɛni nɛɛnɛ na funtu, na lɛbɛ fori bulama nɛ, wɛni fili, a sase fan kana.

sentences.english: But new wine has to be put into new wine-skins.
sentences.susu: A lan nɛ wɛni nɛɛnɛ xa sa lɛbɛ nɛɛnɛ nan kui.

sentences.english: And no man, having had old wine, has any desire for new, for he says, The old is better.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo man mu wama wɛni nɛɛnɛ xɔn xa a bara wɛni fori min, barima a a falama nɛ, ‹Wɛni fori nan fan.›»

sentences.english: Now it came about that on the Sabbath he was going through the fields of grain, and his disciples took the heads of the grain for food, crushing them in their hands.
sentences.susu: Malabu lɔxɔ nde, Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛe nu ɲɛrɛfe sankira ra xɛe tagi. Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa mɛngi tɔnsɔɛ ndee ba, e e tuxutuxu e bɛlɛxɛ, e a xɔrie don.

sentences.english: But some of the Pharisees said, Why do you do what it is not right to do on the Sabbath?
sentences.susu: Farisɛni ndee naxa wɔyɛn, «Munfe ra wo na malabu lɔxɔɛ sɛriyɛ matandife?»

sentences.english: And Jesus said, Have you not seen in the Writings what David did when he was in need of food, he, and those who were with him;
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Wo mu nu a xaran Dawuda naxan naba kaamɛ to a suxu, a tan nun naxee nu na a fɔxɔ ra?

sentences.english: How he went into the house of God and took for food the holy bread, which only the priests may take, and gave it to those who were with him?
sentences.susu: A so nɛ Ala xa banxi kui, a taami don naxan fixi Ala ma, a nde so a fɔxirabirɛe fan yi ra, hali a to mu nu daxa mixi yo xa na don, fo sɛrɛxɛdubɛe.»

sentences.english: And he said, The Son of man is lord even of the Sabbath.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a fala e bɛ, «Adama xa Di nan findixi marigi ra malabu lɔxɔɛ xun ma.»

sentences.english: And it came about, on another Sabbath, that he went into the Synagogue and was teaching there. And a man was there whose right hand was dead.
sentences.susu: Malabu lɔxɔɛ gbɛtɛ ma, Isa man naxa so salide kui, a mixie kawandi. A naxa xɛmɛ nde li naa, naxan yire fan bɛlɛxɛ tuuxi a ma.

sentences.english: And the scribes and Pharisees were watching him to see if he would make him well on the Sabbath, so that they might be able to say something against him.
sentences.susu: Farisɛnie nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe nu e ya tixi Isa ra e xa a mato xa a mixi rayalanma malabu lɔxɔɛ ma, alako e xa nɔ a kalamude fe nde ma.

sentences.english: But he had knowledge of their thoughts; and he said to the man whose hand was dead, Get up and come into the middle. And he got up and came forward.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa to nu e xa maɲɔxunyi kolon, a naxa a fala xɛmɛ bɛ naxan bɛlɛxɛ tuuxi a ma, «Keli, i fa ti be ɲama tagi.» A naxa keli, a ti.

sentences.english: And Jesus said, I put the question to you, Is it right to do good on the Sabbath or to do evil? to give life or to take it away?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «N xa wo maxɔrin. A daxa fe fanyi nan xa raba malabu lɔxɔɛ ma, ka fe ɲaaxi? Nii rakisife nan daxa ka nii sɔntɔfe?»

sentences.english: And looking round on all of them, he said to him, Put out your hand. And he did so: and his hand was made well.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ a ya raɲɛrɛde mixi birin kanke ma, a naxa a fala na xɛmɛ bɛ, «I bɛlɛxɛ itala.» A naxa a itala, a bɛlɛxɛ naxa yalan.

sentences.english: But they were full of wrath, and were talking together about what they might do to Jesus.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Farisɛnie tan naxa xɔnɔ ki fanyi. E naxa so wɔyɛnfe e bore bɛ, e xa lan fe ma, e nɔma naxan niyade Isa ra.

sentences.english: And it came about in those days that he went out to the mountain for prayer; and he was all night in prayer to God.
sentences.susu: Na waxati ma, Isa naxa siga geya fari Ala maxandide, a kɔɛ birin nadangi a Ala maxandima.

sentences.english: And the day came and, turning to his disciples, he made a selection from among them of twelve, to whom he gave the name of Apostles;
sentences.susu: Kuye to iba a naxa a fɔxirabirɛe xili. A naxa fu nun firin sugandi e ya ma, a e xili sa xɛɛrae. E tan nan ya:

sentences.english: Simon, to whom he gave the name of Peter, and Andrew, his brother, and James and John and Philip and Bartholomew
sentences.susu: Simɔn, Isa naxan xili sa Piyɛri, Piyɛri xunya Andire, Yaki, Yaya, Filipu, Barotolome,

sentences.english: And Matthew and Thomas and James, the son of Alphaeus, and Simon, who was named the Zealot,
sentences.susu: Matiyu, Tomasi, Alifa xa di Yaki, Simɔn naxan xili nu falama Seloti,

sentences.english: And Judas, the son of James, and Judas Iscariot, he who was false to him.
sentences.susu: Yaki xa di Yudasi, nun Yudasi Isikariyoti naxan findi yanfante ra, a Isa sa mixi kobie bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And he came down with them to a level place, and a great band of his disciples, and a very great number of people from all Judaea and Jerusalem and from the parts of Tyre and Sidon by the sea, came to give hearing to him, and to be made well from their diseases;
sentences.susu: Isa nun na mixi fu nun firinyie to goro, a naxa ti kɛnɛ nde ma. A fɔxirabirɛe gali nu na naa, a nun ɲama gbegbe naxee nu kelixi Yudaya nun Darisalamu, a nun baa dɛ ra, Tire nun Sidɔn nabilinyi.

sentences.english: And those who were troubled with unclean spirits were made well.
sentences.susu: E birin nu faxi Isa xui ramɛde, a man xa e rayalan e xa furee ma. Ɲinnɛ nu naxee tɔɔrɔma, a nu e rayalanma.

sentences.english: And all the people were desiring to be touched by him, for power came from him and made them all well.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin nu katafe e xa din a ra, barima sɛnbɛ nu minife a i, a nu e birin nayalan.

sentences.english: And turning his eyes to his disciples he said, Happy are you who are poor: for the kingdom of God is yours.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isa naxa a ya ti a fɔxirabirɛe ra, a a masen e bɛ, «Sɛɛwɛ na wo bɛ, wo tan setaree, barima wo ɲan na Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma.

sentences.english: Happy are you who are in need of food now: for you will be made full. Happy are you who are weeping now; for you will be glad.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ na wo bɛ, wo tan naxee kaamɛxi yakɔsi, barima wo fama nɛ wasade. Sɛɛwɛ na wo bɛ, wo tan naxee wama yakɔsi, barima wo fama nɛ yelede.

sentences.english: Happy are you, when men have hate for you, and put you away from among them and say angry words to you, turning away in disgust at your name, because of the Son of man.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ na wo bɛ, mixie na wo xɔn tɛmui naxɛ, e na wo keri, e na wo konbi, e na wo xili kana Adama xa Di xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Be glad in that day, and be lifted up for joy, for your reward in heaven will be great: for their fathers did these same things to the prophets.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɛɛwa na lɔxɔɛ, wo tugan ɲɛlɛxinyi ra, barima wo baraayi gboma nɛ ariyanna. E benbae nu namiɲɔnmɛe fan tɔɔrɔma na ki nɛ.»

sentences.english: But unhappy are you who have wealth: for you have been comforted now.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ gbaloe na wo bɛ, wo tan bannae, barima wo ɲan bara wo xa fe fanyi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Unhappy are you who are full of food now: for you will be in need. Unhappy are you who are laughing now: for you will be crying in sorrow.
sentences.susu: Gbaloe na wo bɛ, wo tan naxee wasaxi yakɔsi, barima kaamɛ fama nɛ wo suxude. Gbaloe na wo bɛ, wo tan naxee yelema yakɔsi, barima sunnunyi nun wa fama nɛ wo suxude.

sentences.english: Unhappy are you when all men give you their approval: for so their fathers did to the false prophets.
sentences.susu: Gbaloe na wo bɛ, mixi birin na wo xili fanyi fala tɛmui naxɛ, barima e benbae nu wule falɛe fan xunmafalama na ki nɛ naxee nu e yɛtɛ findixi namiɲɔnmɛe ra.»

sentences.english: But I say to you who give ear to me, Have love for those who are against you, do good to those who have hate for you,
sentences.susu: «N xa a fala wo bɛ, wo tan naxee na wo tuli matife n na, wo xa wo yaxuie xanu, wo fe fanyi nan naba wo xɔnmae bɛ,

sentences.english: Give blessing to those who give you curses, say prayers for those who are cruel to you.
sentences.susu: wo Ala maxandi wo dankamae bɛ, wo Ala maxandi wo tɔɔrɔmae bɛ.

sentences.english: If a man gives you a blow on one side of your face, then let the other side be turned to him; from him who takes away your coat, do not keep back your robe.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi i xɛrɛ garin, i xa boore sɛɛti fan ti a bɛ. Xa mixi i xa donma tongo, i naxa tondi a xa i xa mafelenyi fan tongo.

sentences.english: Give to everyone who comes with a request, and if a man takes away your property, make no attempt to get it back again.
sentences.susu: Naxan yo na i makula, i xa a ki. Naxan na see ba i yi, i naxa a maxɔrin a xa a ragbilen.

sentences.english: Do to others as you would have them do to you.
sentences.susu: Wo wama mixie xa naxan birin naba wo bɛ, wo fan xa na nan naba e bɛ.»

sentences.english: If you have love for those who have love for you, what credit is it to you? for even sinners have love for those who have love for them.
sentences.susu: «Xa wo sa mixi gbansan nan xanuma, naxee wo fan xanuxi, wo baraayi mundun sɔtɔma na kui? Hali yunubitɔɛe, e mixie nan xanuma naxee e tan fan xanuxi.

sentences.english: And if you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is it to you? for even sinners do the same.
sentences.susu: Xa wo sa fe fanyi rabama mixie bɛ, naxee fe fanyi rabama wo fan bɛ, wo baraayi mundun sɔtɔma na kui? Na tan, hali yunubitɔɛ a rabama.

sentences.english: And if you let those have the use of your money, from whom you are hoping to get it back, what credit is it to you? even sinners do so to sinners, hoping to get back as much as they gave.
sentences.susu: Xa wo sa doni tima mixi nan bɛ, wo laxi naxan na a wo xa doni fima, wo baraayi mundun sɔtɔma na kui? Hali yunubitɔɛe, e doni tima e boore bɛ, alako e man xa doni birin sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: But be loving to those who are against you and do them good, and give them your money, not giving up hope, and your reward will be great and you will be the sons of the Most High: for he is kind to evil men, and to those who have hard hearts.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan xa wo yaxuie xanu. Wo xa fe fanyi nan naba. Wo xa doni ti, hali wo mu laxi a fife ra. Na kui, wo baraayi gboma nɛ, wo findi Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi xa die ra, barima a tan fe fanyi rabama finsiriwalie nun mixi kobie bɛ.

sentences.english: Be full of pity, even as your Father is full of pity.
sentences.susu: Wo fan xa kinikini mixi ma, alɔ wo Baba Ala kinikinima mixi ma ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Be not judges of others, and you will not be judged: do not give punishment to others, and you will not get punishment yourselves: make others free, and you will be made free:
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa wo yɛtɛ findi wo boore adama kɛwalie makiitima ra, alako kiiti naxa fa kana wo fan na Ala yi. Wo naxa mixi makiiti kiiti xɔrɔxɔɛ ra, alako wo fan naxa makiiti kiiti xɔrɔxɔɛ ra. Wo diɲɛ mixi ma, alako Ala xa diɲɛ wo fan ma.

sentences.english: Give, and it will be given to you; good measure, crushed down, full and running over, they will give to you. For in the same measure as you give, it will be given to you again.
sentences.susu: Wo mixi ki, alako Ala fan xa wo ki. Wo kima ki naxɛ, a luma nɛ alɔ maale na maniya, a maniyase rafe a fanyi ra, maale madɛtɛn, a xɛyɛ xɛyɛ, nde man fa sa a xun han a fili a ma. Na kui, wo maniyase naxan nawalima booree bɛ, na nan nawalima wo fan bɛ.»

sentences.english: And he gave them teaching in the form of a story, saying, Is it possible for one blind man to be guide to another? will they not go falling together into a hole?
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa yi taali wɔyɛnyi fala e bɛ, «Dɔnxui nɔma xuli suxude dɔnxui bɛ yire? A di, e firin birin mu birama xɛ yili kui?

sentences.english: The disciple is not greater than his master, but everyone whose learning is complete will be like his master.
sentences.susu: Taalibi mu dangima a karamɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ taalibi naxan birin nu gɛ a matinkande, a luma nɛ alɔ a karamɔxɔ.»

sentences.english: And why do you take note of the grain of dust in your brother's eye, but take no note of the bit of wood which is in your eye?
sentences.susu: «Munfe ra i wuri fuɲi toma i ngaxakerenyi ya ma, a fa li i mu xebenyi toxi naxan na i tan yɛtɛ ya ma?

sentences.english: How will you say to your brother, Brother, let me take the grain of dust out of your eye, when you yourself do not see the bit of wood in your eye? O false one! first take the wood out of your eye and then you will see clearly to take the dust out of your brother's eye.
sentences.susu: I nɔma a falade i ngaxakerenyi bɛ di, ‹A lu n xa na wuri fuɲi ba i yɛtɛ ya ma,› a fa li i tan mu xebenyi toxi naxan na i tan ya ma? I tan filankafui, xebenyi nan singe ba i ya ma! Na ba xanbi, i nɔma nɛ se igbɛde a fanyi ra, alako i xa wuri fuɲi ba i ngaxakerenyi fan ya ma.»

sentences.english: For no good tree gives bad fruit, and no bad tree gives good fruit.
sentences.susu: «Sansi fanyi mu na naxan bogi kobi raminima, sansi kobi fan mu na naxan bogi fanyi raminima.

sentences.english: For every tree is judged by its fruit. Men do not get figs from thorns, or grapes from blackberry plants.
sentences.susu: Sansi birin kolonma a bogi nan ma. Xɔrɛ mu bama tunbe bili ra, kusu fan mu bama baagi bili kɔn na.

sentences.english: The good man, out of the good store of his heart, gives good things; and the evil man, out of his evil store, gives evil: for out of the full store of the heart come the words of the mouth.
sentences.susu: Fe fanyi to ragataxi mixi fanyi bɔɲɛ kui, a fe fanyi nan naminima. Fe kobi to ragataxi mixi kobi bɔɲɛ kui, a fe kobi nan naminima. Naxan na gbo mixi bɔɲɛ kui, na nan dɔnxɔɛ minima a dɛ i.»

sentences.english: Why do you say to me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
sentences.susu: «Munfe ra wo n xilima ‹N Marigi, n Marigi,› kɔnɔ wo mu n xui rabatuma?

sentences.english: Everyone who comes to me and gives ear to my words and does them, I will make clear to you what he is like:
sentences.susu: Mixi yo fa n ma, a n ma masenyi ramɛ, a fa a rabatu, wo wo tuli mati n xa a masen wo bɛ na kanyi maniyaxi mixi naxan na.

sentences.english: He is like a man building a house, who went deep and put the base of it on a rock; and when the water came up and the river was driving against that house, it was not moved, because the building was good.
sentences.susu: A maniyaxi banxiti nan na, naxan bɔxi ge han a sa fanye li, a fa a xa banxi bili ti na fanye fari. Lɔxɔ nde, xure naxa banbaran yɛ han a din banxi ma, kɔnɔ a mu nɔ sese niyade a ra, barima a nu tixi a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: But he who gives hearing, without doing, is like a man building a house on the earth without a base for it; and when the force of the river came against it, straight away it came down; and the destruction of that house was great.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi yo naxan n ma masenyi ramɛ, a fa li a mu a rabatu, na kanyi tan maniyaxi xɛmɛ nan na naxan banxi ti bɔxi fari ma, bili mu a bɛ. Xure to banbaran, a din banxi ma, a naxa a rabira keren na, banxi naxa kana a ɲaaxi ra.»

sentences.english: After he had come to the end of all his words in the hearing of the people, he went into Capernaum.
sentences.susu: Isa to gɛ a xa masenyi birin tide ɲama bɛ, a naxa so Kapɛrɛnamu.

sentences.english: And a certain captain had a servant who was very dear to him; this servant was ill and near to death.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri mixi kɛmɛ xunmati nde nu na naa, naxan ma konyi xɛmɛ nde nu furaxi, a gbe mu nu luxi a xa faxa. Konyi nan nu a ra naxan nu rafan a marigi ma ki fanyi.

sentences.english: And when news of Jesus came to his ears, he sent to him rulers of the Jews, requesting that he would come and make his servant well.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri xunmati to Isa xa fe mɛ, a naxa Yuwifi kuntigi ndee xɛɛ Isa xɔn, a xa fa a xa konyi rayalan.

sentences.english: And they, when they came to Jesus, made their request warmly, saying,
sentences.susu: Yuwifi kuntigie to Isa yire li, e naxa a mayandi ki fanyi, e a fala, «Mixi na a ra, a lan nɛ i xa yi fe raba a bɛ,

sentences.english: It is right for you to do this for him, because he is a friend to our nation, and himself has put up a Synagogue for us.
sentences.susu: barima won si rafan a ma. A tan nan salide tixi muxu bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Jesus went with them. And when he was not far from the house, the man sent friends to him, saying, Lord, do not give yourself trouble: for I am not important enough for you to come into my house:
sentences.susu: Isa naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra. A to makɔrɛ banxi ra, na sɔɔri mixi kɛmɛ xunmati naxa a boore ndee xɛɛ e xa a fala a bɛ, «Marigi, i naxa i yɛtɛ tɔɔrɔ, barima na binyɛ mu na n yi ra i tan xa so n ma banxi kui.

sentences.english: And I had the feeling that I was not even good enough to come to you: but say the word only, and my servant will be well.
sentences.susu: Na nan a niya, n ɲan mu tin n yɛtɛ xa fa i xɔn. I xa yaamari gbansan nan fi, n ma konyi xa yalan.

sentences.english: For I, myself, am a man under authority, having men under me; and I say to this one, Go, and he goes; and to another, Come, and he comes; and to my servant, Do this, and he does it.
sentences.susu: N a kolon barima n fan na mangɛ ndee xa yaamari bun ma, sɔɔri ndee man na n yi, naxee na n fan ma yaamari bun ma. N na a fala sɔɔri nde bɛ, ‹Siga,› a sigama nɛ. N na a fala, ‹Fa,› a fama nɛ. N na n ma konyi nde yamari, ‹Yi fe raba,› a a rabama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And when these things were said to Jesus, he was surprised, and, turning to the mass of people coming after him, said, I have not seen such great faith, no, not in Israel.
sentences.susu: Isa to a xa wɔyɛnyi mɛ, a naxa kaaba a xa fe ma. A naxa a ya rafindi ɲama ma naxan nu biraxi a fɔxɔ ra, a a masen e bɛ, «N xa a fala wo bɛ, n mu yi danxaniya mɔɔli toxi hali Isirayila bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: And when those who were sent came back to the house they saw that the servant was well.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛrae to gbilen sɔɔri xunmati xɔnyi, e naxa konyi li, a yalanxi.

sentences.english: And it came about, after a little time, that he went to a town named Nain; and his disciples went with him, and a great number of people.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Isa naxa siga taa nde, dɛnnaxɛ xili Nayin, a fɔxirabirɛe nun ɲama gbegbe nu na a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Now when he came near the door of the town, a dead man was being taken out, the only son of his mother, who was a widow: and a great number of people from the town were with her.
sentences.susu: A to makɔrɛ taa sode dɛ ra, Isa naxa a to mixie minife xɛmɛ nde fure ra. Kaaɲɛ ginɛ nde xa di kerenyi nan nu faxaxi, na taa ɲama gbegbe fan nu ɲɛrɛfe kaaɲɛ ginɛ fɛ ma.

sentences.english: And when the Lord saw her, he had pity on her and said to her, Be not sad.
sentences.susu: Marigi to kaaɲɛ ginɛ to, a naxa kinikini a ma, a a fala a bɛ, «I naxa wa.»

sentences.english: And he came near, and put his hand on the stretcher where the dead man was: and those who were moving it came to a stop. And he said, Young man, I say to you, Get up.
sentences.susu: A naxa a maso fure ra, a a bɛlɛxɛ sa a xaninse fari, a xaninmae naxa ti. Isa naxa a masen, «I tan sɛgɛtala, n naxɛ i bɛ, keli!»

sentences.english: And the dead man got up, and words came from his lips. And he gave him to his mother.
sentences.susu: Faxamixi naxa keli, a so wɔyɛnfe. Isa naxa a ragbilen a nga ma.

sentences.english: And fear came on all, and they gave praise to God, saying, A great prophet is among us: and, God has given thought to his people.
sentences.susu: Gaaxui naxa e birin suxu, e nu Ala matɔxɔ, e nu a fala, «Ala namiɲɔnmɛ xungbe nan nakelixi won tagi!» E man nu a fala, «Ala bara fa a xa mixie xunmatode!»

sentences.english: And this story about him went through all Judaea and the places round about.
sentences.susu: Isa xa xibaaru naxa siga rayensen na Yudaya bɔxi birin ma a nun naa rabilinyi.

sentences.english: And the disciples of John gave him an account of all these things.
sentences.susu: Yaya fɔxirabirɛe naxa yi fe birin fala Yaya bɛ.

sentences.english: Then John sent two of his disciples to the Lord, saying, Are you he who is to come, or are we waiting for another?
sentences.susu: A fan naxa mixi firin xili e ya ma, a e xɛɛ Isa maxɔrinde, «I findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan na naxan lanma a xa fa, ka muxu xa mixi gbɛtɛ nan mamɛ?»

sentences.english: And when the men came to him they said, John the Baptist has sent us to you, saying, Are you he who is to come, or are we waiting for another?
sentences.susu: E to Isa yire li e naxa a maxɔrin, «Yaya Xunxa nan muxu xɛɛxi i maxɔrinde. I findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan na naxan lanma a xa fa, ka muxu xa mixi gbɛtɛ nan mamɛ?»

sentences.english: At that time, he made a number of people free from their diseases and their pains, and from evil spirits; and to others who were blind he gave back the use of their eyes.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui yati, Isa nu furemae, ɲinnɛ kanyie, nun dɔnxui gbegbe rayalanfe.

sentences.english: And answering them he said, Go back and give news to John of what you have seen, and the things which have come to your ears; the blind now see, those who had no power in their legs are walking, lepers are made clean, those who had no hearing now have their ears open, dead men come to life again, and the poor have the good news given to them.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a naxa Yaya xa xɛɛrae yaabi, «Wo fe naxan mɛxi nun wo fe naxan toxi, wo sa na dɛntɛgɛ Yaya bɛ. Dɔnxuie se toma, namatɛe ɲɛrɛma, kunɛ kanyie yalanma, tulixɔrie wɔyɛnyi mɛma, faxamixie kelima, fuxarilae kawandima xibaaru fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And a blessing will be on him who has no doubts about me.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ na mixi bɛ naxan mu siikɛma n ma fe ra.»

sentences.english: And when the men who were sent by John had gone away, he said to the people, about John, What did you go out into the waste land to see? a tall stem moving in the wind?
sentences.susu: Yaya xa xɛɛrae to siga, Isa naxa ɲama maxɔrin Yaya xa fe ma, «Wo siga munse matode wula i? Foye kale naxan namaxama?

sentences.english: But what did you go out to see? a man in soft clothing? See now, those who have beautiful clothing and delicate food are in kings' houses.
sentences.susu: Xa na mu a ra, wo siga munse matode? Dugi tofanyi kanyi? Naxee maxirixi a fanyi ra, e xa duniɲɛ igiri bannaya kui, nee toma mangɛ banxie nan kui.

sentences.english: But what did you go out to see? a prophet? Yes, I say to you, and more than a prophet.
sentences.susu: Wo fa siga munse matode? Namiɲɔnmɛ? Iyo, n xa a fala wo bɛ, a ɲan dangi namiɲɔnmɛ ra.

sentences.english: This is he of whom it has been said, See, I send my servant before your face, who will make ready your way before you.
sentences.susu: A tan nan xa fe sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, ‹N fama n ma xɛɛra rasanbade i ya ra alako a xa kira yailan i bɛ.›

sentences.english: I say to you, Among all the sons of women, not one is greater than John: but he who is least in the kingdom of God is greater than he.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ, ginɛ yo mu di bari naxan dangi Yaya ra. Kɔnɔ n man xa a fala wo bɛ, mixi naxan na Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma, a xurun kiyoki, a fan dangi Yaya ra.»

sentences.english: (And all the people, and the tax-farmers, to whom John had given baptism, when they had knowledge of these things, gave glory to God.
sentences.susu: «Ɲama nun duuti maxilie to a xui mɛ, e la nɛ Ala ra, e fa lu Yaya xa e xunxa ye xɔɔra.

sentences.english: But the Pharisees and the teachers of the law were against the purpose of God for themselves, not having had his baptism.)
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Farisɛnie nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe tan tondi nɛ Ala waxɔnfe ra e bɛ barima e tondi nɛ Yaya xa e xunxa ye xɔɔra.»

sentences.english: What comparison am I to make of the men of this generation? what are they like?
sentences.susu: «N nɔma to mixie misaalide munse ra? E maniyaxi nde ra?

sentences.english: They are like children who are seated in the market-place, crying out to one another, and saying, We made music for you, but you did not take part in the dance; we gave cries of sorrow, but you were not sad.
sentences.susu: E maniyaxi dimɛdie nan na naxee dɔxɔxi taa kui, e nu a fala e booree bɛ, ‹Muxu bara xule fe wo bɛ, kɔnɔ wo mu fare boronxi. Muxu bara ɲɔn bɛɛti ba, kɔnɔ wo mu wa.›»

sentences.english: For John the Baptist came, taking no food or drink, and you say, He has an evil spirit.
sentences.susu: «Yaya Xunxa to bara fa, a mu taami don, a mu wɛni min. Wo bara a fala, ‹Ɲinnɛ na a fɔxɔ ra.›

sentences.english: The Son of man came feasting, and you say, Here is a lover of food and wine, a friend of tax-farmers and sinners.
sentences.susu: Adama xa Di to fa, a tan mu tondi sigade xulunyi yire. Na kui, wo bara a fala, ‹Furi ɲaaxi siisila mato! E nun duuti maxilie nun yunubitɔɛe nan a ra!›

sentences.english: But wisdom is judged to be right by all her children.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xaxilimaya kolonma a kɛwali nan ma.»

sentences.english: And one of the Pharisees made a request that he would take a meal with him. And he went into the Pharisee's house and took his seat at the table.
sentences.susu: Farisɛni nde naxa Isa xili e xa e dɛge a xɔnyi. Isa naxa so naa, a a magoro.

sentences.english: And there was a woman in the town who was a sinner; and when she had news that he was a guest in the Pharisee's house, she took a bottle of perfume,
sentences.susu: Ginɛ yunubitɔɛ nde nu na taa kui, a naxa a mɛ a Isa a dɛgɛfe na Farisɛni xɔnyi. Na kui, a naxa labundɛ ture suxu a yi ra, na saxi a bitirɛ tofanyi kui naxan nu rafalaxi alabatira gɛmɛ ra.

sentences.english: And went in and took her place at the back of him, near his feet, weeping, so that his feet were washed with the drops from her eyes, and with her hair she made them dry, and kissing his feet she put the perfume on them.
sentences.susu: A to so naa, a naxa ti Isa xanbi ra a sanyi yire. A to wa fɔlɔ, a naxa Isa sanyie bunda a yaye ra. A naxa e mafuruku a xunsɛxɛ ra, a e sunbu, a fa labundɛ maso e ma.

sentences.english: Now when the Pharisee in whose house he was saw it, he said to himself, This man, if he was a prophet, would be conscious what sort of woman this is who has put her hands on him, that she is a sinner.
sentences.susu: Farisɛni naxan Isa xili a dɛgede a xɔnyi, a to na fe to, a naxa a fala a yɛtɛ ma, «Xa yi xɛmɛ findixi namiɲɔnmɛ nan na nu, a yi ginɛ xa fe kolonma nɛ nu, a a kolonma nɛ nu a yunubitɔɛ nan dinfe a ra yi ki.»

sentences.english: And Jesus, answering, said, Simon, I have something to say to you. And he said, Master, say on.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «Simɔn, n xa fe nde masen i bɛ.» Na naxa a yaabi, «Karamɔxɔ, a masen n bɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said, Two men were in debt to a certain man of business: one had a debt of five hundred pence, and the other of fifty.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa yi taali sa a bɛ, «Kɔbiri kanyi nde nu bara mixi firin doni. A singe xa doni findixi gbeti kɔbiri kole kɛmɛ suuli nan na, a firin nde, gbeti kɔbiri kole tongo suuli.

sentences.english: When they were unable to make payment, he made the two of them free of their debts. Which of them, now, will have the greater love for him?
sentences.susu: Fɛɛrɛ to mu nu na e sese yi ra, kɔbiri kanyi naxa diɲɛ e firin birin xa doni ma. Na mixi firinyi tagi, kɔbiri kanyi rafanma nde ma dangi boore ra?»

sentences.english: Simon, in answer, said, It seems he whose debt was greater. And he said, Your decision is right.
sentences.susu: Simɔn naxa a yaabi, «N laxi a ra, naxan xa doni nu gbo boore bɛ.» Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «I nɔndi.»

sentences.english: And turning to the woman he said to Simon, You see this woman? I came into your house; you did not give me water for my feet: but she has been washing my feet with the drops from her eyes, and drying them with her hair.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a naxa a ya rafindi ginɛ ma, a fa a masen Simɔn bɛ, «I yi ginɛ to? N so nɛ i xɔnyi, i mu ye fi n ma n xa n sanyie maxa, kɔnɔ a tan n sanyie maxaxi a yaye nan na, a e mafuruku a xunsɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: You did not give me a kiss: but she, from the time when I came in, has gone on kissing my feet.
sentences.susu: I tan mu n sunbu, kɔnɔ a tan, kabi n soxi i xɔnyi, a mu baxi n sanyie masunbufe.

sentences.english: You put no oil on my head: but she has put perfume on my feet.
sentences.susu: I tan mu ture maso n xunyi ma, kɔnɔ a tan labundɛ ture nan masoxi n sanyie ma.

sentences.english: And so I say to you, She will have forgiveness for her sins which are great in number, because of her great love: but he who has small need of forgiveness gives little love.
sentences.susu: Na na a ra, n xa a fala i bɛ, a xa yunubie naxee gboxi na ki, e bara xafari a bɛ, barima a xa xanunteya fan gbo. Kɔnɔ naxan xa yunubi xafarixie xurun, na kanyi xa xanunteya fan xurun.»

sentences.english: And he said to her, You have forgiveness for your sins.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa fa a masen ginɛ bɛ, «I xa yunubie bara xafari.»

sentences.english: And those who were seated at table with him said to themselves, Who is this who even gives forgiveness of sins?
sentences.susu: Naxee nu magoroxi e dɛgede, nee fan naxa so a falafe e yɛtɛ ma, «Nde yi ra a to yunubi xafarima?»

sentences.english: And he said to the woman, By your faith you have salvation; go in peace.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a masen ginɛ bɛ, «I xa danxaniya bara i rakisi. Siga bɔɲɛsa kui.»

sentences.english: And it came about, after a short time, that he went through town and country giving the good news of the kingdom of God, and with him were the twelve,
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Isa naxa siga taa birin isa ra, a xungbe nun a xuri, a nu mixie xaran, a nu e kawandi Ala xa mangɛya niini xa xibaaru fanyi ra. A fɔxirabirɛ fu nun firinyie nu na a fɔxɔ ra,

sentences.english: And certain women who had been made free from evil spirits and diseases, Mary named Magdalene, from whom seven evil spirits had gone out,
sentences.susu: a nun ginɛ nde naxee nu bara rayalan ɲinnɛe nun fure gbɛtɛe ma. E xilie nan ya: Mariyama, a nu falama naxan bɛ Magidalaka, Isa ɲinnɛ solofere keri naxan fɔxɔ ra,

sentences.english: And Joanna, the wife of Chuza, Herod's chief house-servant, and Susanna and a number of others, who gave him of their wealth for his needs.
sentences.susu: a nun Yohanna, naxan nu dɔxɔxi Herode xa walikɛe xunyi Kusa xɔn, a nun Susanna, a nun mixi gbɛtɛ wuyaxi. E nu Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛe malima e yɛtɛ harige ra.

sentences.english: And when a great number of people came together, and men from every town went out to him, he gave them teaching in the form of a story:
sentences.susu: Ɲama gbegbe to malan Isa yire kelife taa wuyaxi, a naxa yi taali wɔyɛnyi masen e bɛ,
