sentences.susu: Isa naxa e maxɔrin, «Munfe ra e a falama a Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi findixi Dawuda xa di nan na?

sentences.english: For David himself says in the book of Psalms, The Lord said to my Lord, Take your seat at my right hand,
sentences.susu: Dawuda yɛtɛ a masen nɛ Yabura Kitaabui kui, ‹Marigi bara a masen n Marigi bɛ, “I magoro n yirefanyi ma,

sentences.english: Till I put under your feet all those who are against you.
sentences.susu: han beemanun n xa i yaxuie findi i sanyi kilɔnse ra.”›»

sentences.english: David then gives him the name of Lord, so how is it possible for him to be his son?
sentences.susu: «Xa Dawuda a xili ‹N Marigi›, Dawuda fa nɔma findide a baba ra di?»

sentences.english: And in the hearing of all the people he said to his disciples,
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin to nu e tuli tixi a ra, Isa naxa a masen a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ,

sentences.english: Keep away from the scribes, whose pleasure it is to go about in long robes, and to have words of respect said to them in the market-places, and to take the chief seats in the Synagogues and the first places at feasts;
sentences.susu: «Wo wo yɛtɛ ratanga sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe ma. A rafan e ma e xa e maɲɛrɛ guba xungbe ragoroxi e ma, mixi xa nu e xɛɛbu taa kui binyɛ xɛɛbui ra. E wama dɔxɔfe salide safɛ singee, e man xa binyɛ sɔtɔ xulunyi.

sentences.english: Who take the property of widows and before the eyes of men make long prayers; they will get a greater punishment.
sentences.susu: E kaaɲɛ ginɛe harige bama e yi. E salima a xɔnnakuye ra, alako mixie xa e to. Gbaloe naxan nagataxi e tan bɛ, a gbo ki fanyi.»

sentences.english: And looking up, he saw the men of wealth putting their offerings in the money-box.
sentences.susu: Isa to a ya rasiga, a naxa bannamixie to, e e xa hadiya sama hadiya a sase kui.

sentences.english: And he saw a certain poor widow putting in a farthing.
sentences.susu: A naxa kaaɲɛ ginɛ misikiinɛ nde fan to, naxan a gbe hadiya sa, wure gbeeli kɔbiri kole firin gbansan.

sentences.english: And he said, Truly I say to you, This poor widow has given more than all of them:
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen, «N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, yi kaaɲɛ ginɛ misikiinɛ xa hadiya gbo dangi na boore birin gbe ra,

sentences.english: For they gave out of their wealth, having more than enough for themselves: but she, even out of her need, has put in all her living.
sentences.susu: barima e tan xa hadiya kelima e xa naafuli nan kui, kɔnɔ yi kaaɲɛ ginɛ xa hadiya kelima a xa baloe nan kui.»

sentences.english: And some were talking about the Temple, how it was made fair with beautiful stones and with offerings, but he said,
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee nu wɔyɛnfe hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa fe ra, a to nu ratofanxi gɛmɛ sare xɔrɔxɔɛe ra, a nun se gbɛtɛe, mixi naxee baxi sɛrɛxɛ ra. Na kui, Isa naxa a masen,

sentences.english: As for these things which you see, the days will come when not one stone will be resting on another, but all will be broken down.
sentences.susu: «Wo yi se naxee birin toxi yi ki, lɔxɔɛ fama a lide, gɛmɛ keren mu luma a boore fari be, a birin nabirama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And they said to him, Master, when will these things be? and what sign will there be when these events are to take place?
sentences.susu: E naxa a maxɔrin, «Karamɔxɔ, na fe sa rabama mun tɛmui? A man sa kolonma tɔnxuma mundun ma a a fafe rabade?»

sentences.english: And he said, Take care that you are not tricked: for a number of people will come in my name, saying, I am he; and, The time is near: do not go after them.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa yi yaabi ti, «Wo wo yɛtɛ ratanga alako mixi yo naxa fa wo ratantan. Mixi wuyaxi fama n xili falade e yɛtɛ xun ma, a falafe ra, ‹N tan nan na Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra. Waxati bara makɔrɛ.› Wo naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And when news of wars and troubled times comes to your ears, have no fear; for these things have to be, but the end will not be now.
sentences.susu: Wo na geree nun ɲaxasie xa fe mɛ, wo naxa gaaxu, barima fo na fe mɔɔlie xa raba sinden. Kɔnɔ na waxati ma, duniɲa raɲɔnyi mu a lima keren na.»

sentences.english: Then he said to them, Nation will be moved against nation and kingdom against kingdom:
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, a naxa a masen e bɛ, «Sie kelima nɛ e boore xili ma, ɲamanɛe e boore gere.

sentences.english: There will be great earth-shocks and outbursts of disease in a number of places, and men will be without food; and there will be wonders and great signs from heaven.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi fama nɛ sɛrɛnde a xungbe ra, kaamɛ nun fure sin yire wuyaxi. Fe magaaxuxie nun tɔnxuma makaabaxie fama minide kuye ma.»

sentences.english: But before all this, they will take you and be very cruel to you, giving you up to the Synagogues and to prisons, taking you before kings and rulers, because of my name.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ beemanun na birin xa raba, e fama nɛ wo suxude, e wo ɲaxankata. E wo sama nɛ salide kuntigie bɛlɛxɛ, e man wo sama nɛ geeli. E wo xaninma nɛ mangɛ nun gominae yire n xili xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And it will be turned to a witness for you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na birin kui, wo findima n ma seedee nan na.

sentences.english: So take care not to be troubled before the time comes, about what answers you will give:
sentences.susu: Wo naxa kɔntɔfili wo yɛtɛ xunmafalafe ra,

sentences.english: For I will give you words and wisdom, so that not one of those who are against you will be able to get the better of you, or to put you in the wrong.
sentences.susu: barima n masenyi nun xaxilimaya fima wo ma, alako wo yaxuie naxa nɔ wo ra, e naxa nɔ wo matandide.

sentences.english: But you will be given up even by your fathers and mothers, your brothers and relations and friends; and some of you will be put to death.
sentences.susu: Wo barimae, wo ngaxakerenmae, wo baribooree, nun wo dɛfanbooree, e fama nɛ wo yanfade, e wo sa mixie bɛlɛxɛ. Nee tan mixi ndee faxama nɛ wo ya ma.

sentences.english: And you will be hated by all men, because of me.
sentences.susu: Birin fama nɛ wo xɔnde n tan ma fe ra,

sentences.english: But not a hair of your head will come to destruction.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ wo ratangama nɛ. Hali wo xunsɛxɛ keren, a mu lɔɛma.

sentences.english: By going through all these things, you will keep your lives.
sentences.susu: Wo xa tunnabɛxiya kui, wo kisima nɛ.»

sentences.english: But when you see armies all round about Jerusalem, then be certain that her destruction is near.
sentences.susu: «Wo na Darisalamu to, sɔɔri gali bara a rabilin, wo xa a kolon nɛ a a xa kasarɛ bara makɔrɛ.

sentences.english: Then let those who are in Judaea go in flight to the mountains; and those who are in the middle of the town go out; and let not those who are in the country come in.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, mixi naxee na Yudaya, e xa e gi geyae fari. Naxee na Darisalamu taa kui, e xa keli naa. Naxee fan na daaxae, e naxa so taa kui,

sentences.english: For these are the days of punishment, in which all the things in the Writings will be put into effect.
sentences.susu: barima na lɔxɔɛe findima gbeɲɔxɔ waxati nan na, alako naxan sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui a birin xa kamali.

sentences.english: It will be hard for women who are with child, and for her with a baby at the breast, in those days. For great trouble will come on the land, and wrath on this people.
sentences.susu: Na waxati findima gbaloe nan na furuginɛe nun dingɛe bɛ! Barima tɔɔrɛ gboma nɛ bɔxi ma, Ala xa xɔnɛ makɛnɛnma yi ɲama xili ma.

sentences.english: And they will be put to death with the sword, and will be taken as prisoners into all the nations; and Jerusalem will be crushed under the feet of the Gentiles, till the times of the Gentiles are complete.
sentences.susu: Ndee faxama nɛ santidɛgɛma ra, ndee xaninma nɛ, e sa findi konyie ra ɲamanɛ birin kui. Si gbɛtɛe fama nɛ Darisalamu maboronde, han e xa waxati kamalima tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And there will be signs in the sun and moon and stars; and on the earth, fear among the nations and doubt because of the loud noise of the sea and the waves;
sentences.susu: «Na tɛmui, tɔnxumae minima nɛ soge, kike, nun tunbuie ma. Si birin gaaxuma nɛ, e kɔntɔfili baa wundu xui nun a mɔrɔnyie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Men's strength will go from them in fear and in waiting for the things which are coming on the earth; for the powers of the heavens will be moved.
sentences.susu: Mixie na a kolon fe naxan fama rabade bɔxi ma, e birama nɛ gaaxui saabui ra, barima koore fama nɛ imaxade.

sentences.english: And then they will see the Son of man coming in a cloud, with power and great glory.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Adama xa Di toma nɛ fa ra nuxui kui, sɛnbɛ nun nɔrɛ ra.

sentences.english: But when these things come about, let your heads be lifted up, because your salvation is near.
sentences.susu: Na fee na raba fɔlɔ, wo ti, wo wo xun nakeli, barima wo xa kisi bara makɔrɛ.»

sentences.english: And he made a story for them: See the fig-tree, and all the trees;
sentences.susu: Isa naxa taali wɔyɛnyi masen e bɛ, «Wo xɔrɛ bili mato, a tan nun wuri bili birin.

sentences.english: When they put out their young leaves, you take note of it, and it is clear to you that summer is coming.
sentences.susu: Wo na a to, e bara e burɛxɛ nɛɛnɛ ramini, wo a kolonma ɲɛmɛ tɛmui ɲan bara makɔrɛ.

sentences.english: In the same way, when you see these things taking place you may be certain that the kingdom of God is near.
sentences.susu: Adama xa Di fafe fan na na ki nɛ. Wo na yi fe birin to raba ra, wo xa a kolon a Ala xa mangɛya niini bara makɔrɛ.

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, This generation will not come to an end till all things are complete.
sentences.susu: N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, to mixie mu dangima fo na fe birin naba.

sentences.english: Heaven and earth will come to an end, but my words will not come to an end.
sentences.susu: Koore nun bɔxi dangima nɛ, kɔnɔ n ma masenyi tan mu dangima abadan, a mu kanama muku.»

sentences.english: But give attention to yourselves, for fear that your hearts become over-full of the pleasures of food and wine, and the cares of this life, and that day may come on you suddenly, and take you as in a net:
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ wo mɛɛni wo yɛtɛ ma! Wo naxa yanfa xurutareɲa nun siisife ma, wo man naxa yanfa yi duniɲɛigiri xa kɔntɔfili ma, alako na lɔxɔɛ naxa fa wo tɛrɛnna,

sentences.english: For so it will come on all those who are living on the face of all the earth.
sentences.susu: alɔ gantanyi xɔni suxuma ki naxɛ. Barima na lɔxɔɛ tan fama duniɲa mixi birin lide.

sentences.english: But keep watch at all times with prayer, that you may be strong enough to come through all these things and take your place before the Son of man.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa yanfa! Wo xa Ala maxandi nɛ tɛmui birin alako wo xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ, wo xa nɔ ratangade fe birin ma naxee fama a lide, wo man xa nɔ tide Adama xa Di ya i.»

sentences.english: And every day he was teaching in the Temple and every night he went out to the mountain which is named the Mountain of Olives to take his rest.
sentences.susu: Isa nu mixie kawandima hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui yanyi ra, a nu sa kɔɛ radangi Oliwi geya fari.

sentences.english: And all the people came early in the morning to give ear to his words in the Temple.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin nu kurunma sigafe ra a xɔn ma, e xa sa a xui ramɛ hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: Now the feast of unleavened bread was near, which is called the Passover.
sentences.susu: Taami Lɛbinitare Sali naxa makɔrɛ, naxan man xili falama Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali.

sentences.english: And the chief priests and the scribes were looking for a chance to put him to death, but they went in fear of the people.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe nu na fɛɛrɛ fenfe e xa Isa suxu, e xa a faxa, kɔnɔ e nu gaaxuxi ɲama nan ya ra.

sentences.english: And Satan came into Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Sentanɛ naxa bira Isa fɔxirabirɛ Yudasi Isikariyoti fɔxɔ ra, naxan nu na Isa xa xɛɛra fu nun firinyie ya ma.

sentences.english: And he went away and had a discussion with the chief priests and the rulers, about how he might give him up to them.
sentences.susu: A tan Yudasi naxa siga sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun kɔsibili mangɛe xɔn, e naxa wɔyɛn, a sa nɔma Isa sade e bɛlɛxɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And they were glad, and undertook to give him money.
sentences.susu: E fan naxa ɲɛlɛxin ki fanyi ra, e kɔbiri laayidi tongo a bɛ.

sentences.english: And he made an agreement with them to give him up to them, if he got a chance, when the people were not present.
sentences.susu: Yudasi naxa tin na ra, a so waxati fenfe a Isa sama e bɛlɛxɛ tɛmui naxɛ ɲama xanbi.

sentences.english: And the day of unleavened bread came, when the Passover lamb is put to death.
sentences.susu: Taami Lɛbinitare Sali naxa a li, yɛxɛɛ lanma faxama lɔxɔ naxɛ Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, Go and make the Passover ready for us, so that we may take it.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa Piyɛri nun Yaya yamari a falafe ra, «Wo xa siga Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali yire rafala won bɛ, alako won birin xa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali donyi don.»

sentences.english: And they said to him, Where are we to get it ready?
sentences.susu: E naxa a maxɔrin, «I wama muxu xa sa a rafala minden?»

sentences.english: And he said to them, When you go into the town you will see a man coming to you with a vessel of water; go after him into the house into which he goes.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo nu so taa kui, wo nun xɛmɛ nde naralanma, ye fɛɲɛ dɔxɔxi a xun ma. Wo xa bira a fɔxɔ ra han a sa soma banxi naxan kui.

sentences.english: And say to the master of the house, The Master says, Where is the guest-room, where I may take the Passover with my disciples?
sentences.susu: Wo xa a fala na banxi kanyi bɛ, ‹Karamɔxɔ wama a kolonfe a nɔma Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali donyi donde dɛnnaxɛ, a tan nun a fɔxirabirɛe.›

sentences.english: And he will take you up to a great room with a table and seats: there make ready.
sentences.susu: A fama banxi kui xungbe masende wo bɛ koore ra, na se birin yailanxi a fanyi ra. Wo xa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali donyi rafala mɛnni.»

sentences.english: And they went, and it was as he had said: and they made the Passover ready.
sentences.susu: E naxa siga, e sa fe birin li alɔ Isa a masen e bɛ ki naxɛ. E naxa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali donyi rafala.

sentences.english: And when the time had come, he took his seat, and the Apostles with him.
sentences.susu: Waxati to a li, Isa naxa a magoro a xa a dɛge e nun a xa xɛɛra fu nun firinyie.

sentences.english: And he said, I have had a great desire to keep this Passover with you before I come to my death;
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen e bɛ, «Kabi tɛmui dangixi, a xɔli n ma ki fanyi won xa yi Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali donyi don yire keren beenun n xa ɲaxankatɛ sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: For I say to you, I will not take it till it is made complete in the kingdom of God.
sentences.susu: Barima n xa a fala wo bɛ, yi na dangi, n mu a donma sɔnɔn fo a kamali Ala xɔnyi ariyanna.»

sentences.english: And he took a cup and, having given praise, he said, Make division of this among yourselves;
sentences.susu: A to tɔnbili nde tongo, a naxa tantui rasiga Ala ma, a fa a masen, «Wo xa yi tɔnbili tongo, wo birin xa a min.

sentences.english: For I say to you, I will not take of the fruit of the vine till the kingdom of God has come.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ, n mu yi wɛni minma fo Ala xa mangɛya niini na fa tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And he took bread and, having given praise, he gave it to them when it had been broken, saying, This is my body, which is given for you: do this in memory of me.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi Isa naxa taami tongo. A to tantui rasiga Ala ma, a naxa taami igira, a a so a fɔxirabirɛe yi ra a falafe ra, «Wo n ko, wo a don. Yi findixi n fate nan na, naxan fixi wo bɛ. Wo xa ratu n ma fe ma yi saabui ra.»

sentences.english: And in the same way, after the meal, he took the cup, saying, This cup is the new testament, made with my blood which is given for you.
sentences.susu: Na mɔɔli man na, e to gɛ e dɛgede, Isa naxa tɔnbili fan tongo, a a masen, «N wuli nan ya, saatɛ nɛɛnɛ wuli naxan baxi mixi gbegbe bɛ.

sentences.english: But the hand of him who is false to me is with me at the table.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n xa a fala wo bɛ, yanfante naxan n sama mixie bɛlɛxɛ, a magoroxi yi teebili ra.

sentences.english: For it will be done to the Son of man after the purpose of God, but unhappy is that man by whom he is given up.
sentences.susu: Adama xa Di sigama alɔ Ala a ragirixi ki naxɛ, kɔnɔ gbaloe na xɛmɛ bɛ naxan Adama xa Di yanfama.»

sentences.english: And they were wondering among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.
sentences.susu: E fan naxa so e bore maxɔrinfe, «Nde nɔma na mɔɔli rabade won ya ma?»

sentences.english: And there was an argument among them about which of them was the greatest.
sentences.susu: Wɔyɛnyi naxa mini Isa fɔxirabirɛe tagi e xa a kolon naxan tide gbo e ya ma.

sentences.english: And he said, The kings of the Gentiles are lords over them, and those who have authority are given names of honour.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Ɲamanɛ mangɛe mixie yamarima a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra. E tan naxee e sɛnbɛ raminima mixie ma, e ‹fe fanyi rabae› xili nan natema e yɛtɛ xun.

sentences.english: But let it not be so with you; but he who is greater, let him become like the younger; and he who is chief, like a servant.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan naxa lu na ki. Naxan tide gbo wo ya ma, a xa lu alɔ wo birin xunya. Yarerati man xa lu alɔ birin ma walikɛ.

sentences.english: For which is greater, the guest who is seated at a meal or the servant who is waiting on him? is it not the guest? but I am among you as a servant.
sentences.susu: Nde tide gbo, naxan a magoroxi a xa a dɛge, ka naxan donyi radangima a ma? Naxan magoroxi a dɛgede, na nan tide gbo, kɔnɔ n tan na wo ya ma alɔ mixi naxan walima wo bɛ.»

sentences.english: But you are those who have kept with me through my troubles;
sentences.susu: «Wo tan nan findixi n fɔxirabirɛe ra naxee mu nu keli n xun n ma tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: And I will give you a kingdom as my Father has given one to me,
sentences.susu: N fan bara mangɛya fi wo ma, alɔ n Baba Ala a fixi n ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So that you may take food and drink at my table in my kingdom, and be seated like kings, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
sentences.susu: Na kui, won birin won dɛgema nɛ n xɔnyi n ma mangɛya kui, wo man wo magoroma nɛ kibanyie ma, wo Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ fu nun firin makiiti.»

sentences.english: Simon, Simon, Satan has made a request to have you, so that he may put you to the test as grain is tested:
sentences.susu: «Simɔn, Simɔn, a kolon Sentanɛ bara Ala maxɔrin wo tan xa sa a bɛlɛxɛ, a xa wo ife alɔ maale ifema ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But I have made prayer for you, that your faith may not go from you: and when you are turned again, make your brothers strong.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n bara Ala maxandi i bɛ, alako danxaniya naxa gɛ bade i yi. I na gbilen n ma, i xa i ngaxakerenyie ralimaniya.»

sentences.english: And he said to him, Lord, I am ready to go with you to prison and to death.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a fala a bɛ, «Xa won birin nan a ra, n tinxi, hali a findi geeli ra, hali a findi faxɛ ra!»

sentences.english: And he said, I say to you, Peter, before the cock's second cry today, you will say three times that you have no knowledge of me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen, «Piyɛri, n xa a fala i bɛ, beenun konkore xa a rate, i a falama nɛ dɔxɔ saxan, a i mu n kolon.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, When I sent you out without money or bag or shoes, were you in need of anything? And they said, Nothing.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a masen a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, «N to wo xɛɛ kɔbiri, gbɔnfɔɛ, nun sankiri mu wo xun, wo tɔɔrɔ nɛ?» E naxa a yaabi, «Ade.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, But now, he who has a money-bag, or a bag for food, let him take it: and he who has not, let him give his coat for money and get a sword.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a masen e bɛ, «Kɔnɔ yakɔsi tan, xa kɔbiri nun gbɔnfɔɛ na naxan yi, a xa e tongo. Xa santidɛgɛma mu na naxan yi ra, a xa a xa xinbeli donma mati, a santidɛgɛma sara,

sentences.english: For I say to you that these words will be put into effect in me, And he was numbered among the evil-doers: for what has been said in the Writings about me has an end.
sentences.susu: barima n xa a fala wo bɛ, yi masenyi naxan sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, fo a xa n li, ‹A ɲaxankatɛ nan sɔtɔma fe kobi rabae ya ma.› Naxan nagirixi n ma, na n lima nɛ. Naxan sɛbɛxi, na fama nɛ kamalide.»

sentences.english: And they said, Lord, here are two swords. And he said, It is enough.
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛe naxa a masen, «Marigi, a mato, santidɛgɛma firin nan ya.» A naxa e yaabi, «Na bara wasakɛ.»

sentences.english: And he came out, and went, as his way was, to the Mountain of Olives, and the disciples went with him.
sentences.susu: Isa to mini, a naxa siga Oliwi geya ma alɔ a nu darixi a ra ki naxɛ, a fɔxirabirɛe fan naxa a mati.

sentences.english: And when he came to the place, he said to them, Make a prayer that you may not be put to the test.
sentences.susu: E to mɛnni li, Isa naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo Ala maxandi nɛ, wo naxa fa bira tantanyi kui.»

sentences.english: And he went a little distance away from them and, falling on his knees in prayer, he said,
sentences.susu: A naxa a ndedi masiga e ra, a a xinbi sin, a Ala maxandi,

sentences.english: Father, if it is your pleasure, take this cup from me: but still, let your pleasure, not mine, be done.
sentences.susu: «N Baba, xa i sago na a ra, i xa n natanga yi ɲaxankatɛ ma. Kɔnɔ n sago naxa raba, i tan nan sago xa raba.»

sentences.english: And an angel from heaven came to him, to give him strength.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui malekɛ nde naxa mini a ma keli koore, a a sɛnbɛ so.

sentences.english: And being in great trouble of soul, the force of his prayer became stronger, and great drops, like blood, came from him, falling to the earth.
sentences.susu: Isa bɔɲɛ to nu ɲaxankatafe, a naxa a xa Ala maxandife sɛnbɛ xun masa. A yilenfure naxa silɔn bɔxi alɔ wuli.

sentences.english: And, getting up from prayer, he came to the disciples, and saw that they were sleeping for sorrow.
sentences.susu: A to keli Ala maxandide, a naxa gbilen a fɔxirabirɛe yire, a naxa e li e na xife nimisɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And he said, Why are you sleeping? Get up, and give yourselves to prayer, so that you may not be put to the test.
sentences.susu: A naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo xife munfe ra? Wo keli, wo Ala maxandi, alako wo naxa bira tantanyi kui.»

sentences.english: And while he was saying these words, there came a band of people, and Judas, one of the twelve, was in front of them, and he came near to Jesus to give him a kiss.
sentences.susu: Isa ɲan mu nu gɛxi wɔyɛnde, mixi gali naxa a yire li. Yudasi, naxan nu na Isa fɔxirabirɛ fu nun firinyie ya ma, a tan nan nu tixi e ya ra. A naxa a maso Isa ra, a xa a sunbu.

sentences.english: But Jesus said to him, Judas, will you be false to the Son of man with a kiss?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen a bɛ, «Yudasi, i Adama xa Di yanfama sunbui nan na?»

sentences.english: And when those who were with him saw what was coming, they said, Lord, may we not make use of our swords?
sentences.susu: Naxee nu na Isa fɔxɔ ra, e to a to naxan fafe rabade, e naxa a maxɔrin, «Marigi, muxu xa gere so santidɛgɛma ra?»

sentences.english: And one of them gave a blow to the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear.
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛ nde naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xa konyi yirefanyi tuli bolon.

sentences.english: But Jesus, answering, said, Put up with this, at least. And touching his ear, he made it well.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa naxa a fala, «Wo a lu!» A naxa fa a bɛlɛxɛ sa na xɛmɛ tuli ma, a a rayalan.

sentences.english: And Jesus said to the chief priests and the captains of the Temple and the rulers, who had come against him, Have you come out as against a thief, with swords and sticks?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Isa naxa wɔyɛn sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie, hɔrɔmɔlingira kɔsibili mangɛe, nun forie bɛ naxee nu faxi a xili ma. A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo to minixi n xili ma santidɛgɛma nun gbengbeta suxuxi wo yi ra, suute nan n na?

sentences.english: When I was in the Temple with you every day, your hands were not stretched out against me: but this is your hour, and the authority of the dark power.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ n nu na wo ya ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, wo mu n suxu. Kɔnɔ yi waxati tan findixi wo gbe nun dimi nɔɛ kanyi gbe nan na.»

sentences.english: And they made him a prisoner and took him away to the house of the high priest. But Peter went after them at a distance.
sentences.susu: E to Isa suxu, e naxa a xanin sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie xunyi xɔnyi. Piyɛri fan naxa bira e fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ a mu nu a makɔrɛma a gbe ra.

sentences.english: And a fire was lighted in the middle of the open square, and they were seated together, and Peter was among them.
sentences.susu: E to so, e naxa tɛ xuru tande, e birin dɔxɔ mɛnni, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xa tɛtɛ kui. Piyɛri fan nu dɔxɔxi e ya ma.

sentences.english: And a certain woman-servant, seeing him in the light of the fire, and looking at him with attention, said, This man was with him.
sentences.susu: Konyi ginɛ nde to Piyɛri to tɛ fɛ ma, a naxa a ya ti a ra, a fa a fala, «Isa nun yi xɛmɛ nan nu a ra.»

sentences.english: But he said, Woman, it is not true; I have no knowledge of him.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Piyɛri naxa a matandi, a a fala, «N tan mu na xɛmɛ kolon feo!»

sentences.english: And after a little time, another saw him and said, You are one of them; and he said, Man, I am not.
sentences.susu: A mu bu, mixi gbɛtɛ fan naxa Piyɛri to, a a fala a bɛ, «I fan findixi a xa mixi nde nan na.» Piyɛri naxa a yaabi, «Ade, n tan mu na ki!»

sentences.english: And after about an hour, another man said, with decision, Certainly this man was with him, for he is a Galilaean.
sentences.susu: Waxati keren to dangi, mixi gbɛtɛ naxa a maxɔrɔxɔ, a a fala, «Yi mixi nun Isa nan nu a ra, barima Galileka nan a ra.»

sentences.english: And Peter said, Man, I have no knowledge of these things of which you are talking. And straight away, while he was saying these words, there came the cry of a cock.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a yaabi, «N tan mu a kolon i na fefe falafe!» A ɲan mu nu gɛxi wɔyɛnde, konkore naxa a rate keren na.

sentences.english: And the Lord, turning, gave Peter a look. And the words of the Lord came to Peter's mind, how he had said, This night, before the hour of the cock's cry, you will be false to me three times.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Marigi naxa a mafindi, a a ya ti Piyɛri ra. Piyɛri fan naxa ratu Marigi xa masenyi ma, a to a fala a bɛ, «Beemanun konkore xa a rate to, i i yɛtɛ rasanma nɛ n ma dɔxɔ saxan.»

sentences.english: And he went out, weeping bitterly.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa mini, a wa a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra sunnunyi kui.

sentences.english: And the men in whose hands Jesus was, made sport of him and gave him blows.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ naxee nu Isa suxuxi, e naxa a rasɔtɔ, e naxa a bɔnbɔ.

sentences.english: And, covering his eyes, they said to him, Are you prophet enough to say who gave you that blow?
sentences.susu: E naxa a ya maxiri, e nu fa a fala, «Namiɲɔnmɛɲa raba! A fala ba, naxan i bɔnbɔxi!»

sentences.english: And they said a number of other evil things against him.
sentences.susu: E man naxa konbi mɔɔli birin sa a fari.

sentences.english: And when it was day, the rulers of the people came together, with the chief priests and the scribes, and they took him before their Sanhedrin, saying,
sentences.susu: Kuye to iba, Yuwifie xa forie, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie, nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe naxa Sanederɛn malanyi raba Isa makiitife ra. E to fa Isa ra,

sentences.english: If you are the Christ, say so. But he said, If I say so you will not have belief;
sentences.susu: e naxa a maxɔrin, «Xa i findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan na, a fala muxu bɛ.» Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «N na a fala wo bɛ, wo mu lama a ra.

sentences.english: And if I put a question to you, you will not give an answer.
sentences.susu: Xa n maxɔrinyi ti, wo mu n yaabima.

sentences.english: But in the future the Son of man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ keli yi waxati ma, Adama xa Di dɔxɔma Ala Sɛnbɛ Kanyi yirefanyi ma.»

sentences.english: And they all said, Are you then the Son of God? and he said, You say that I am.
sentences.susu: E birin naxa fa a maxɔrin, «Na kui, i findixi Ala xa Di nan na?» A naxa e yaabi, «Wo tan nan yati a falaxi na ki, a n findixi Ala xa Di nan na.»

sentences.english: And they said, What more need have we of witness? we have the very words of his mouth.
sentences.susu: E fan naxa a fala, «Won hayi mundun na seede gbɛtɛ ma sɔnɔn? Won bara a tan yɛtɛ yati wɔyɛn xui mɛ.»

sentences.english: And they all went and took him before Pilate.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui ɲama birin naxa keli, e Isa xanin mangɛ Pilati xɔn.

sentences.english: And they made statements against him, saying, This man has to our knowledge been teaching our nation to do wrong, and not to make payment of taxes to Caesar, even saying that he himself is Christ, a king.
sentences.susu: E naxa so a kalamufe, e nu a fala, «Muxu bara yi xɛmɛ li a na muxu xa ɲama ramurutafe. A bara a fala e bɛ a e naxa duuti fi Rɔma mangɛ xungbe ma. A man naxɛ, a a tan yɛtɛ findixi mangɛ nan na, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi.»

sentences.english: And Pilate said to him, Are you the King of the Jews? And he said in answer, You say so.
sentences.susu: Pilati naxa Isa maxɔrin, «I tan nan findixi Yuwifie xa mangɛ ra?» Isa naxa a yaabi, «I tan nan a falaxi.»

sentences.english: And Pilate said to the chief priests and the people, In my opinion this man has done no wrong.
sentences.susu: Pilati naxa fa a fala sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun ɲama bɛ, «N mu fe kobi yo toxi yi xɛmɛ xa fe.»

sentences.english: But they became more violent than before, saying, He has made trouble among the people, teaching through all Judaea from Galilee to this place.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ ɲama man naxa a karaxan, e nu a fala, «A bara mixie kui iso a xa xaranyi ra Yudaya bɔxi birin ma, kelife Galile bɔxi ma, han be.»

sentences.english: But at these words Pilate said, Is the man a Galilaean?
sentences.susu: Pilati to Galile xili mɛ, a naxa maxɔrinyi ti xa Isa Galileka nan a ra.

sentences.english: And when he saw that he was under the authority of Herod, he sent him to Herod, who was in Jerusalem himself at that time.
sentences.susu: A to a kolon a Isa nu na Galile mangɛ Herode xa yaamari nan bun ma, a naxa a rasanba Herode ma, naxan fan nu na Darisalamu taa kui na waxati.

sentences.english: Now when Herod saw Jesus he was very glad, having for a long time had a desire to see him, for he had had accounts of him, and was hoping to see some wonders done by him.
sentences.susu: Herode naxa sɛɛwa Isa tofe ra, barima kafi tɛmui xɔnkuye a nu wama a tofe. A to nu bara a xa fe mɛ, a xɔli nu a ma Isa xa tɔnxuma makaabaxi nde raba a ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And he put a great number of questions to him, but he said nothing.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Herode naxa maxɔrinyi gbegbe ti Isa ma, kɔnɔ Isa mu yaabi keren fi.

sentences.english: And the chief priests and the scribes were there, making statements against him violently.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe nu tixi naa, e nu Isa kalamu a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: And Herod, with the men of his army, put shame on him and made sport of him, and dressing him in shining robes, he sent him back to Pilate.
sentences.susu: Herode nun a xa sɔɔrie fan naxa a konbi a mayaagixi ra, e nu a mayele. E to guba tofanyi ragoro a ma mayele se ra, Herode naxa a ragbilen Pilati ma.

sentences.english: And that day Herod and Pilate became friends with one another, for before they had been against one another.
sentences.susu: Singe, Pilati nun Herode dɛ mu nu fan, kɔnɔ na lɔxɔɛ booreɲa naxa lu e tagi.

sentences.english: And Pilate sent for the chief priests and the rulers and the people, and said to them,
sentences.susu: Pilati naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie, mangɛe, nun ɲama malan,

sentences.english: You say that this man has been teaching the people evil things: now I, after going into the question before you, see nothing wrong in this man in connection with the things which you have said against him:
sentences.susu: a a masen e bɛ, «Wo bara fa yi xɛmɛ ra n xɔn a kalamufe ra a a na mixie bɔɲɛ ratefe. Muxu bara dɛ masara wo ya xɔri, kɔnɔ n mu fe kobi yo toxi a ra, wo a kalamuxi naxan ma.

sentences.english: And Herod is of the same opinion, for he has sent him back to us; for, you see, he has done nothing for which I might put him to death.
sentences.susu: Herode fan mu se toxi, barima a bara a ragbilen won ma. A mato, yi xɛmɛ mu fefe rabaxi a lanma a xa faxa naxan ma.

sentences.english: And so I will give him punishment and let him go.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n yaamari fima nɛ a xa bɔnbɔ, n fa a rabɛɲin.»
<range>

sentences.english: But with loud voices they said all together, Put this man to death, and make Barabbas free.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ birin naxa sɔnxɔɛ rate, e a fala, «Yi xɛmɛ faxa! Barabasi rabɛɲin muxu bɛ.»

sentences.english: Now this man was in prison because of an attack against the government in the town, in which there had been loss of life.
sentences.susu: Geresoe nde nan nu Barabasi ra naxan nu bara sa geeli a to keli mangasanyi xili ma. Ɲaxasi to bira taa kui, a naxa faxɛ ti.

sentences.english: And Pilate again said to them that it was his desire to let Jesus go free.
sentences.susu: Pilati to nu wama Isa rabɛɲinfe, a man naxa wɔyɛn ɲama bɛ,

sentences.english: But crying out they said, To the cross with him!
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ e nu sɔnxɔfe nan tui, «A banban! A banban wuri magalanbuxi ma!»

sentences.english: And he said to them a third time, Why, what evil has he done? I see no reason for putting him to death: I will give him punishment and let him go.
sentences.susu: Pilati man naxa wɔyɛn e bɛ a sanmaya saxan nde, «Munfe ma? A fe ɲaaxi mundun nabaxi? N mu sese rakɔrɔsixi a xa fe, a lanma a xa faxa naxan ma. Na kui, n yaamari fima nɛ a xa bɔnbɔ, n fa a rabɛɲin.»

sentences.english: But they went on crying out loudly, Let him be put to death on the cross. And they had their way.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ ɲama nu sɔnxɔɛ ratefe nan tui, e Pilati karaxan, Isa xa banban wuri magalanbuxi ma. Na kui, e xui naxa nɔ mangɛ ra.

sentences.english: And Pilate gave his decision for their desire to be put into effect.
sentences.susu: Pilati naxa natɛ tongo, e waxɔnfe xa raba.

sentences.english: And in answer to their request, he let that man go free who had been in prison for acting against the government and causing death, and Jesus he gave up to their pleasure.
sentences.susu: A naxa Barabasi rabɛɲin, naxan nu na geeli kui gere sofe nun faxɛ tife ma, a fa Isa sa ɲama sagoe.

sentences.english: And while they were taking him away, they put their hands on Simon of Cyrene, who was coming from the country, and made him take the cross after Jesus.
sentences.susu: E to nu Isa xaninfe, e naxa Simɔn Sirenika li, a sofe taa kui keli daaxa. E naxa a suxu, e wuri magalanbuxi sa a fari, a tan xa a xanin Isa bɛ a xanbi ra.

sentences.english: And a great band of people went after him, and of women making signs of grief and weeping for him.
sentences.susu: Ɲama gbegbe nu biraxi Isa fɔxɔ ra. Ginɛ ndee fan nu na e ya ma, naxee nu wafe a gbegbe ra.

sentences.english: But Jesus, turning to them, said, Daughters of Jerusalem, let not your weeping be for me, but for yourselves and for your children.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a ya rafindi e ma, a a masen e bɛ, «Darisalamu di ginɛe, wo naxa wa n tan ma fe ra. Wo wa wo yɛtɛ nun wo xa die nan ma fe ra,

sentences.english: For the days are coming in which they will say, Happy are those who have had no children, whose bodies have never given birth, whose breasts have never given milk.
sentences.susu: barima waxati fafe, mixie a falama nɛ, ‹Sɛɛwɛ na dibaritaree bɛ, naxee mu xiɲɛ fi diyɔrɛ ma.›»

sentences.english: And they will say to the mountains, Come down on us, and to the hills, Be a cover over us.
sentences.susu: «E man fama nɛ a falade geyae bɛ, ‹Wo bira muxu ma!› E a fala tentenyie bɛ, ‹Wo muxu makoto, muxu xa ragata!›»

sentences.english: For if they do these things when the tree is green, what will they do when it is dry?
sentences.susu: «Xa yi fe mɔɔli nan nabama wuri xinde ra, wuri xare tan fa luma di?»

sentences.english: And two others, evil-doers, were taken with him to be put to death.
sentences.susu: E naxa suute firin fan xanin, e xa e faxa e nun Isa.

sentences.english: And when they came to the place which is named Golgotha, they put him on the cross, and the evil-doers, one on the right side, and the other on the left.
sentences.susu: E to yire nde li, dɛnnaxɛ xili xunkonkota yire, e naxa Isa banban wuri magalanbuxi ma. E naxa na geelimani firin fan mabanban, e keren ti Isa yirefanyi ma, e boore ti Isa kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: And Jesus said, Father, let them have forgiveness, for they have no knowledge of what they are doing. And they made division of his clothing among them by the decision of chance.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen, «N Baba, diɲɛ yi mixie ma, barima e mu a kolon e fefe naxan nabafe.» E naxa kanda bun a xa dugie xa fe ra, alako e xa a kolon kankan naxan sɔtɔma.

sentences.english: And the people were looking on. And the rulers made sport of him, saying, He was a saviour of others; let him do something for himself, if he is the Christ, the man of God's selection.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa ti naa, e nu e ya ti na fe birin na. Kuntigie fan nu na Isa mayelefe, e nu a fala, «A bara mixi gbɛtɛe rakisi. A xa a yɛtɛ fan nakisi, xa a findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan na!»

sentences.english: And the men of the army made sport of him, coming to him and giving him bitter wine,
sentences.susu: Sɔɔrie fan naxa a mayele, e fa, e wɛni muluxunxi ti a bɛ,

sentences.english: And saying, If you are the King of the Jews, get yourself free.
sentences.susu: e a fala, «Xa i findixi Yuwifie xa mangɛ nan na, i yɛtɛ rakisi!»

sentences.english: And these words were put in writing over him, THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.
sentences.susu: Yi sɛbɛli nan nu gbakuxi a xun ma, «Yuwifie xa mangɛ nan ya.»

sentences.english: And one of the evil-doers on the cross, with bitter feeling, said to him, Are you not the Christ? Get yourself and us out of this.
sentences.susu: Suute keren naxan nu banbanxi a fɛ ma, a nu Isa makonbife, a nu a fala, «I mu findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa ra? I yɛtɛ rakisi, i muxu fan nakisi!»

sentences.english: But the other, protesting, said, Have you no fear of God? for you have a part in the same punishment,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a boore suute naxa wɔyɛn a ma, a a maxɔrin, «Won birin to gbaloe nan sɔtɔxi yi ki, i mu gaaxuma Ala ya ra?

sentences.english: And with reason; for we have the right reward of our acts, but this man has done nothing wrong.
sentences.susu: A lanxi tan won firin xa yi fe sɔtɔ, barima a findixi won ma kɛwali kobie sare nan na. Kɔnɔ yi tan mu fefe kobi rabaxi.»

sentences.english: And he said, Jesus, keep me in mind when you come in your kingdom.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ na falade a boore bɛ, a naxa a fala Isa bɛ, «Isa, i xa ratu n ma i soma i xa mangɛya kui tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And he said to him, Truly I say to you, Today you will be with me in Paradise.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «N xa nɔndi fala i bɛ, to yati, i soma nɛ n fɔxɔ ra ariyanna.»

sentences.english: And it was now about the sixth hour; and all the land was dark till the ninth hour;
sentences.susu: Yanyi tagi ɲɔndɔn to a li, dimi naxa sin bɔxi birin ma, lɛɛri saxan bun ma.

sentences.english: The light of the sun went out, and the curtain in the Temple was parted in two.
sentences.susu: Soge naxa ifɔɔrɔ. Dugi xungbe naxan singanxi hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, a naxa ibɔɔ firin na.

sentences.english: And Jesus gave a loud cry and said, Father, into your hands I give my spirit: and when he had said this, he gave up his spirit.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Isa man naxa a xui rate sɛnbɛ ra, a a fala, «N Baba, n bara n nii sa i bɛlɛxɛ.» A to na fala, a naxa laaxira.

sentences.english: And when the captain saw what was done, he gave praise to God, saying, Without doubt this was an upright man.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri kɛmɛ xunmati naxan nu na naa, a to a to naxan nabaxi, a naxa Ala matɔxɔ yi masenyi ra, «Nɔndi na a ra yati, tinxintɔɛ nan nu yi xɛmɛ ra!»

sentences.english: And all the people who had come together to see it, when they saw the things which were done, went back again making signs of grief.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxan birin nu malanxi na faxɛ matode, e fan to fe birin to naxee rabaxi, e nu gbilenfe sunnunyi nan kui, e bɛlɛxɛ saxi e xunyi.

sentences.english: And all his friends and the women who came with him from Galilee, were waiting at a distance, watching these things.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa kolonmae birin nun ginɛ naxee bira a fɔxɔ ra keli Galile, e tan nu tixi, e na fe birin matoma, e ndedi nu makuyaxi naa ra.

sentences.english: Now there was a man named Joseph, a man of authority and a good and upright man
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ fanyi tinxintɔɛ nde nu na, naxan nu xili Yusufu. Yuwifie xa kiitisa nde nan nu a ra,

sentences.english: (He had not given his approval to their decision or their acts), of Arimathaea, a town of the Jews, who was waiting for the kingdom of God:
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ a tan mu tin a boore kiitisae xa natɛ kobi ra, e fe naxan niya Isa ra. A nu kelixi Arimate nɛ, Yudaya bɔxi ma. A nu na Ala xa mangɛya niini mamɛfe.

sentences.english: This man went to Pilate and made a request for the body of Jesus.
sentences.susu: A tan yi xɛmɛ naxa siga Pilati yire, a sa Isa fure maxandi a ma.

sentences.english: And he took it down, and folding it in a linen cloth, he put it in a place cut in the rock for a dead body; and no one had ever been put in it.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, a to Isa fure ragoro wuri magalanbuxi kɔn na, a naxa a kasange, a a bɛlɛ gaburi, naxan nu gexi gɛmɛ kui, fure yo mu nu ragata dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Now it was the day of making ready and the Sabbath was coming on.
sentences.susu: Yi fe birin nabaxi malabu lɔxɔɛ nan ya ra.

sentences.english: And the women who had come with him from Galilee went after him and saw the place and how his body had been put to rest;
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxee nu bara bira Isa fɔxɔ ra keli Galile, e naxa siga Yusufu xanbi ra, e sa gaburi to, e man a to Isa fure ragata ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And they went back and got ready spices and perfumes; and on the Sabbath they took their rest, in agreement with the law.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, e naxa gbilen se xiri ɲɔxunmɛ nun labundɛ rafalade. Malabu lɔxɔɛ e naxa e malabu, alɔ a sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But on the first day of the week, at dawn, they came to the place where his body had been put, taking the spices which they had got ready.
sentences.susu: Sande lɔxɔɛ subaxɛ ma, ginɛe naxa kurun siga ra gaburi yire, e labundɛ ture xanin, e nu bara naxan nafala.

sentences.english: And they saw that the stone had been rolled away.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e naxa a li, gɛmɛ naxan nu dɔxɔxi gaburi dɛ ma, a nu bara ba naa.

sentences.english: And they went in, but the body of the Lord Jesus was not there.
sentences.susu: E to so gaburi kui, e mu Marigi Isa fure to.

sentences.english: And while they were in doubt about it, they saw two men in shining clothing by them:
sentences.susu: E kɔntɔfilixi to nu tixi, xɛmɛ firin naxa mini e ma, e xa sosee mayilenma.

sentences.english: And while their faces were bent down to the earth in fear, these said to them, Why are you looking for the living among the dead?
sentences.susu: Ginɛe naxa gaaxu, e e xun sin bɔxi. Na xɛmɛ firin naxa a fala e bɛ, «Munfe ra wo mixi ɲiɲɛ fenma faxamixie ya ma?

sentences.english: He is not here, he has come back to life: have in mind what he said to you when he was still in Galilee, saying,
sentences.susu: Isa mu na be, a bara keli faxɛ ma. Wo xa wo ratu a naxan masenxi wo bɛ Galile.

sentences.english: The Son of man will be given up into the hands of evil-doers, and be put to death on the cross, and on the third day he will come back to life.
sentences.susu: A a masen nɛ, a fo Adama xa Di xa sa yunubitɔɛe bɛlɛxɛ, a banban wuri magalanbuxi ma, a man fa keli faxɛ ma a xi saxan nde ma.»

sentences.english: And his words came back into their minds,
sentences.susu: Na kui, e naxa ratu Isa xa wɔyɛnyie ma.

sentences.english: And they went away from that place and gave an account of all these things to the eleven disciples and all the others.
sentences.susu: E to gbilen kelife gaburi yire, e naxa na fe birin masen Isa fɔxirabirɛ fu nu kerenyie bɛ, a nun a fɔxirabirɛ boore birin bɛ.

sentences.english: Now they were Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary, the mother of James: and the other women with them said these things to the Apostles.
sentences.susu: Mariyama Magidalaka, Yohanna, Yaki nga Mariyama, a nun ginɛ gbɛtɛe naxee nu na e fɔxɔ ra, e tan nan na fe birin fala Isa xa xɛɛrae bɛ.

sentences.english: But these words seemed foolish to them, and they had no belief in them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ nee mu la e ra, barima na masenyi naxa lu e bɛ alɔ daxu wɔyɛnyi.

sentences.english: But Peter got up and went to the place where the body had been put, and looking in he saw nothing but the linen cloths, and he went to his house full of wonder at what had taken place.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Piyɛri tan naxa keli, a a gi han gaburi yire. A naxa a felen na kui matofe ra, kɔnɔ a mu sese to fo kasange, a saxi a kui igeli. A naxa gbilen a xɔnyi, a kaabaxi na fe ma naxan bara raba.

sentences.english: And then, two of them, on that very day, were going to a little town named Emmaus, which was about seven miles from Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ kerenyi, Isa fɔxirabirɛ mixi firin ndee nu na kira ra sigafe Emayusi, taa lanma naxan makuya Darisalamu ra kilomɛtiri fu nun keren ɲɔndɔn.

sentences.english: And they were talking together about all those things which had taken place.
sentences.susu: E nu na wɔyɛnfe e bore bɛ yi fe birin ma naxee nu bara raba.

sentences.english: And while they were talking and questioning together, Jesus himself came near and went with them.
sentences.susu: E nu wɔyɛnfe tɛmui naxɛ, Isa naxa a maso e ra, e birin naxa siga kira keren xɔn,

sentences.english: But their eyes were not open that they might have knowledge of him.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ e mu a kolon a Isa nan a ra.

sentences.english: And he said to them, What are you talking about together while you go?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo nu na munse falafe kira xɔn?» Na maxɔrinyi ma, e naxa ti kira ra, e sunnunxi.

sentences.english: Then stopping, and looking sadly at him, one of them, named Cleopas, said to him, Are you the only man living in Jerusalem who has not had news of the things which have taken place there at this time?
sentences.susu: Kelopa naxa a yaabi, «I keren nan mu a kolonxi fe naxan dangixi yi waxati Darisalamu?»

sentences.english: And he said to them, What things? And they said, The things to do with Jesus of Nazareth, who was a prophet, great in his acts and his words, before God and all the people:
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a maxɔrin, «Munse niyaxi?» E naxa dɛntɛgɛ sa a bɛ fe naxan Isa Nasarɛtika lixi. E naxa a fala a bɛ, «Namiɲɔnmɛ xungbe nan nu a ra a kɛwali ki ma nun a xa masenyi ki ma Ala nun ɲama bɛ.

sentences.english: And how the chief priests and our rulers gave him up to be put to death on the cross.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun muxu xa mangɛe bara a sa mixie bɛlɛxɛ, e xa a makiiti faxɛ kiiti ra, e a banban wuri magalanbuxi ma.

sentences.english: But we were hoping that he would be the Saviour of Israel. In addition to all this he has now let three days go by from the time when these things took place;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ muxu tan nan nu laxi a ra, a a tan nan nu fama Isirayila xɔrɛyade. Sa na birin xun ma, a xa faxɛ xi saxan nde nan to,

sentences.english: And certain women among us gave us cause for wonder, for they went early to the place where his body had been put,
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ ginɛ ndee na muxu ya ma, e bara muxu rakaaba e xa dɛntɛgɛ ra. E to kurun siga ra gaburi yire,

sentences.english: And it was not there; then they came saying that they had seen a vision of angels who said that he was living.
sentences.susu: e mu a fure li naa. E naxa fa a fala muxu bɛ, a malekɛ ndee nan mini e ma, e a fala e bɛ a Isa ɲiɲɛ na a ra.

sentences.english: And some of those who were with us went to the place, and saw that it was as the women had said, but him they did not see.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbɛtɛe muxu ya ma, e fan naxa siga gaburi yire, e a birin li alɔ ginɛe a masenxi ki naxɛ, kɔnɔ e mu a tan Isa to.»

sentences.english: And he said, O foolish men! how slow you are to give belief to what the prophets have said.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Ee, wo xaxili xɔrɔxɔ! Namiɲɔnmɛe naxan birin masenxi, wo bɔɲɛ mu lama a ra mafuren!

sentences.english: Was it not necessary for the Christ to go through these things, and to come into his glory?
sentences.susu: Wo mu a kolon a fo Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa na tɔɔrɛ sɔtɔ, a fa so a xa nɔrɛ kui?»

sentences.english: And he made clear to them all the things in the Writings, from Moses and from all the prophets, which had to do with himself.
sentences.susu: A naxa fa a fɔlɔ Annabi Munsa ma, dɔxɔ namiɲɔnmɛ birin na, a Kitaabuie yire birin fasari e bɛ, a tan yɛtɛ xa fe masenxi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And they came near the town to which they were going, and he seemed as if he was going on;
sentences.susu: E to makɔrɛ na taa lanma ra e nu sigafe dɛnnaxɛ, Isa naxa lu alɔ a nu wama dangife nɛ,

sentences.english: But they kept him back, saying, Do not go, for evening is near, the day is almost gone. And he went in with them.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ e naxa a mayandi, e a fala a bɛ, «Lu muxu xɔnyi nɛ. Nunmare na a ra yi ki, kɔɛ ɲan bara so.» Na kui, a naxa so e xɔnyi a xa lu naa.

sentences.english: And when he was seated with them at table, he took the bread, and said words of blessing and, making division of it, he gave it to them.
sentences.susu: E birin to dɔxɔ e dɛgede, Isa naxa taami tongo, a tantui rasiga Ala ma, a a igira, a a itaxun e ma.

sentences.english: And then their eyes were open, and they had knowledge of him, but he went from their view.
sentences.susu: A naxa makɛnɛn e xaxili bɛ keren na, e a kolon a Isa na a ra, kɔnɔ a man naxa lɔɛ e ma yen!

sentences.english: And they said to one another, Were not our hearts burning in us while he was talking to us on the way, making clear to us the holy Writings?
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala e bore bɛ, «A to nu Kitaabui kui fasarima won bɛ kira xɔn, a mu nu luxi xɛ alɔ a tɛ nan xuruxi won bɔɲɛ kui?»

sentences.english: And that very hour they got up and went back to Jerusalem, where the eleven and the others had come together.
sentences.susu: E naxa keli keren na, e gbilen Darisalamu. E naxa sa Isa fɔxirabirɛ fu nun kerenyie li, a nun naxee nu na e fɔxɔ ra, e birin malanxi yire keren.

sentences.english: And they said to them, The Lord has truly come back to life again, and Simon has seen him.
sentences.susu: Nee naxa a fala e bɛ, «Marigi bara keli faxɛ ma yati! A bara mini Simɔn ma!»

sentences.english: And they gave an account of the things which had taken place on the way, and how, when he gave them bread, they had knowledge of him.
sentences.susu: E fan naxa dɛntɛgɛ sa nee bɛ fe birin ma naxee dangixi kira xɔn, a nun Isa makɛnɛn e bɛ ki naxɛ a to taami igira.

sentences.english: And while they were saying these things, he himself was among them, and said to them, Peace be with you!
sentences.susu: E to nu wɔyɛnfe na fe birin ma, Isa yɛtɛ naxa mini e ma, a tixi e tagi. A naxa e xɛɛbu, «Ala xa wo bɔɲɛ sa.»

sentences.english: But they were full of fear, being of the opinion that they were seeing a spirit.
sentences.susu: E bɔɲɛ naxa mini, e gaaxu, barima e nu a maɲɔxunxi tubari nan na.

sentences.english: And he said to them, Why are you troubled, and why are your hearts full of doubt?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Munfe ra wo kɔntɔfilixi, wo bɔɲɛ man siikɛxi?

sentences.english: See; my hands and my feet: it is I myself; put your hands on me and make certain; for a spirit has not flesh and bones as you see that I have.
sentences.susu: Wo n bɛlɛxɛe nun n sanyie mato, wo xa a kolon n tan nan yati a ra. Wo xa n masuxu, wo xa n mato, barima sube nun xɔri mu na tubari bɛ, alɔ wo naxan toma n ma yi ki.»

sentences.english: And when he had said this, he let them see his hands and his feet.
sentences.susu: A to na fala e bɛ, a naxa a bɛlɛxɛe nun a sanyie masen e bɛ,

sentences.english: And because, for joy and wonder, they were still in doubt, he said to them, Have you any food here?
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ na fe sɛɛwɛ nun kaabɛ nu gbo e bɛ. E to mu nu gɛxi lade a ra, Isa naxa e maxɔrin, «Donse na wo yi ra be?»

sentences.english: And they gave him a bit of cooked fish.
sentences.susu: E to yɛxɛ ganxi nde so a yi,

sentences.english: And before their eyes he took a meal.
sentences.susu: a naxa a tongo, a a don e ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And he said to them, These are the words which I said to you when I was still with you, how it was necessary for all the things which are in the writings of Moses and the prophets and in the Psalms about me, to be put into effect.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, a naxa a masen e bɛ, «N nu na wo tagi tɛmui naxɛ, n yi fe birin masen nɛ wo bɛ. N a masen nɛ wo bɛ, fa fala naxan birin sɛbɛxi n tan ma fe ra Annabi Munsa xa sɛriyɛ kui, a nun namiɲɔnmɛe xa Kitaabuie kui, a nun Yabura Dawuda kui, fo na birin xa kamali nɛ.»

sentences.english: Then he made the holy Writings clear to their minds.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, a naxa e xaxili rabi alako e xa Kitaabuie fahaamu.

sentences.english: And he said to them, So it is in the Writings that the Christ would undergo death, and come back to life again on the third day;
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen e bɛ, «A sɛbɛxi nɛ, a fo Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa tɔɔrɔ, fo a man xa keli faxɛ ma a xi saxan nde.

sentences.english: And that teaching about a change of heart and forgiveness of sins is to be given to Jerusalem first and to all nations in his name.
sentences.susu: A tan xili ra, fo si birin xa kawandi nɛ tuubi fe nun yunubi xafarife ra, fɔlɔfe Darisalamu ma.

sentences.english: You are witnesses of these things.
sentences.susu: Wo tan bara findi yi fee seedee ra.

sentences.english: And now I will send to you what my father has undertaken to give you, but do not go from the town, till the power from heaven comes to you.
sentences.susu: N Baba naxan laayidixi, n na rasanbama nɛ wo ma. Wo tan xa lu be taa kui, han sɛnbɛ xa keli koore gorofe wo ma.»

sentences.english: And he took them out till they were near Bethany, and lifting up his hands, he gave them a blessing.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Isa naxa e xanin han Betani biri ra. A naxa a bɛlɛxɛ ite, a duba e bɛ.

sentences.english: And while he was doing so, he went from them and was taken up into heaven.
sentences.susu: A nu dubama e bɛ tɛmui naxɛ, a naxa keli e xun, a rate koore.

sentences.english: And they gave him worship and went back to Jerusalem with great joy.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ a suyidide, e naxa gbilen Darisalamu sɛɛwɛ xungbe kui.

sentences.english: And they were in the Temple at all times, giving praise to God.
sentences.susu: E nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui tɛmui birin Ala tantude.

sentences.english: From the first he was the Word, and the Word was in relation with God and was God.
sentences.susu: A fɔlɔ fɔlɛ, Ala Xui nu na, Ala Xui nu na e nun Ala, Ala Xui nu findixi Ala yɛtɛ kan nan na.

sentences.english: This Word was from the first in relation with God.
sentences.susu: Kabi a fɔlɛ, Ala nun a Xui nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: All things came into existence through him, and without him nothing was.
sentences.susu: Ala se birin daaxi a tan nan saabui ra, sese mu na naxan mu daaxi a tan saabui ra.

sentences.english: What came into existence in him was life, and the life was the light of men.
sentences.susu: Marakisi sɔtɔma a tan nan na, kisi naxan findixi naiyalanyi ra adamadie bɛ.

sentences.english: And the light goes on shining in the dark; it is not overcome by the dark.
sentences.susu: Na naiyalanyi yanbama dimi kui, dimi fan mu tin a ra.

sentences.english: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa xɛmɛ nde xɛɛ, naxan nu xili Yaya.

sentences.english: He came for witness, to give witness about the light, so that all men might have faith through him.
sentences.susu: Seede nan nu a ra, naxan fa seedeɲɔxɔya bade na naiyalanyi xa fe ra, alako birin xa danxaniya a saabui ra.

sentences.english: He himself was not the light: he was sent to give witness about the light.
sentences.susu: A tan xa mu findixi na naiyalanyi ra, kɔnɔ a tan fa nɛ a xa seede ba na naiyalanyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: The true light, which gives light to every man, was then coming into the world.
sentences.susu: Naxan findixi naiyalanyi ra, naiyalanyi yati na a ra, naxan fama duniɲa ma, a xa adamadie birin iyalan.

sentences.english: He was in the world, the world which came into being through him, but the world had no knowledge of him.
sentences.susu: Ala Xui naxa sabati duniɲa ma. Duniɲa daa a tan nan saabui ra, kɔnɔ duniɲa tondi nɛ a kolonde.

sentences.english: He came to the things which were his and his people did not take him to their hearts.
sentences.susu: A fa nɛ a xɔnyi, kɔnɔ a xa mixie mu a rasɛnɛ.

sentences.english: To all those who did so take him, however, he gave the right of becoming children of God — that is, to those who had faith in his name:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ naxan tan birin a rasɛnɛ, e danxaniya a ma, a naxa nɔɛ fi nee tan ma, e xa findi Ala xa die ra.

sentences.english: Whose birth was from God and not from blood, or from an impulse of the flesh and man's desire.
sentences.susu: Na mu keli e bɔnsɔɛ xa ma, xa na mu fate bɛndɛ waxɔnyi ma, xa na mu mixi nde waxɔnyi ma. Ala yɛtɛ nan a niya e xa bari a nɛɛnɛ ra, e findi a xa die ra.

sentences.english: And so the Word became flesh and took a place among us for a time; and we saw his glory — such glory as is given to an only son by his father — saw it to be true and full of grace.
sentences.susu: Ala Xui naxa findi ibunadama ra, a sabati muxu ya ma. Muxu bara a xa nɔrɛ to, a Baba nɔrɛ naxan fixi a xa Di kerenyi ma, hinnɛnteya nun nɔndi kamalixi naxan yi.

sentences.english: John gave witness about him, crying, This is he of whom I said, He who is coming after me is put over me because he was in existence before me.
sentences.susu: Yaya naxa a xui ite, a seedeɲɔxɔya ba a xa fe ma, «N yi nan ma fe masen wo bɛ, n to a fala, ‹Naxan fama n xanbi ra, a tide gbo n bɛ, barima beenun n tan xa daa, a tan nu na.›»

sentences.english: From his full measure we have all been given grace on grace.
sentences.susu: Won birin bara hinnɛ sɔtɔ a saabui ra. A xa hinnɛ bara gbo yɛ won yi ra.

sentences.english: For the law was given through Moses; grace and the true way of life are ours through Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Ala sɛriyɛ Kitaabui fi won ma Annabi Munsa nan saabui ra. A xa hinnɛ nun nɔndi tan faxi won ma a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: No man has seen God at any time; the only Son, who is on the breast of the Father, he has made clear what God is.
sentences.susu: Adama yo mu na naxan bara Ala to, kɔnɔ Ala xa Di kerenyi, naxan na a Baba Ala fɛ ma, a tan bara a masen.

sentences.english: And this is the witness of John when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to him with the question, Who are you?
sentences.susu: Yaya xa seedeɲɔxɔya nan ya. Darisalamu Yuwifi kuntigie naxa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nun Lewi di ndee xɛɛ Yaya xɔn ma, e xa a maxɔrin, «Nde i tan na?»

sentences.english: He said quite openly and straightforwardly, I am not the Christ.
sentences.susu: Yaya mu tondi e yaabide, a naxa a masen e bɛ a fiixɛ ra, «Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi mu n tan xa ra.»

sentences.english: And they said to him, What then? Are you Elijah? And he said, I am not. Are you the prophet? And his answer was, I am not.
sentences.susu: E man naxa a maxɔrin, «I fa findixi nde ra? Annabi Eliya nan na i ra?» Yaya naxa e yaabi, «Ade, Eliya mu n na.» E naxa a maxɔrin, «Namiɲɔnmɛ nan i ra muxu naxan mamɛfe a xa fa?» Yaya naxa e yaabi, «Ade.»

sentences.english: So they said to him, Who are you then? We have to give some answer to those who sent us. What have you to say about yourself?
sentences.susu: Na kui, e naxa gbilen a maxɔrin na, «Nde i ra? I i yɛtɛ maɲɔxunxi nde ra? A yaba muxu bɛ, muxu xa sa dɛntɛgɛ sa muxu xɛɛmae bɛ.»

sentences.english: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the waste land, Make straight the way of the Lord, as said Isaiah the prophet.
sentences.susu: Yaya naxa a masen e bɛ alɔ a sɛbɛxi Annabi Esayi xa Kitaabui kui ki naxɛ, «N tan findixi mixi nan na naxan a xui itema gbengberenyi ma, ‹Wo kira matinxin Marigi bɛ!›»

sentences.english: Those who had been sent came from the Pharisees.
sentences.susu: Farisɛni nde naxee nu bara xɛɛ Yaya xɔn,

sentences.english: And they put this question to him, saying, Why then are you giving baptism if you are not the Christ, or Elijah, or the prophet?
sentences.susu: e naxa a maxɔrin, «Xa i mu findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra, i mu findixi Eliya ra, i mu findixi namiɲɔnmɛ ra muxu naxan mamɛfe, i fa mixie xunxama ye xɔɔra munfe ra?»

sentences.english: John's answer was: I give baptism with water; but there is one among you of whom you have no knowledge;
sentences.susu: Yaya naxa e yaabi, «N tan mixie xunxama ye nan xɔɔra, kɔnɔ mixi keren na wo ya ma, wo mu naxan kolon.

sentences.english: It is he who is coming after me; I am not good enough to undo his shoes.
sentences.susu: Na nan fama n xanbi ra. Na binyɛ mu na n tan yi ra, n ɲan xa a xa sankiri luuti yati fulun.»

sentences.english: These things took place at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan, where John was giving baptism.
sentences.susu: Na fe birin dangi Betani nɛ, Yurudɛn xure naakiri ma, Yaya nu mixie xunxama ye xɔɔra dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: The day after, John sees Jesus coming to him and says, See, here is the Lamb of God who takes away the sin of the world!
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Yaya naxa Isa to fa ra a yire, a naxa a masen, «Ala xa sɛrɛxɛ nan yi ki, duniɲa xa yunubi xafarima naxan na.

sentences.english: This is he of whom I said, One is coming after me who is put over me because he was in existence before me.
sentences.susu: N nu yi nan ma fe masenfe wo bɛ n to a fala, n naxɛ, ‹Xɛmɛ naxan fama n xanbi ra, a tide gbo n bɛ, barima beenun n tan xa daa, a tan nu na.›

sentences.english: I myself had no knowledge of him, but I came giving baptism with water so that he might be seen openly by Israel.
sentences.susu: N tan yati mu nu na kanyi kolon, kɔnɔ n fa mixie xunxade ye xɔɔra nɛ alako a tan xa makɛnɛn Isirayilakae bɛ.»

sentences.english: And John gave this witness, saying, I saw the Spirit coming down from heaven like a dove and resting on him.
sentences.susu: Yaya naxa seedeɲɔxɔya ba, a a masen, «N bara Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi to goro ra kelife koore ma alɔ ganbɛ, a dɔxɔ a ma.

sentences.english: I had no knowledge who he was, but he who sent me to give baptism with water said to me, The one on whom you see the Spirit coming down and resting, it is he who gives baptism with the Holy Spirit.
sentences.susu: N tan yati mu nu a kolon, kɔnɔ Ala naxan n xɛɛ mixie xunxade ye xɔɔra, a nu bara a masen n bɛ, ‹I n Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi toma goro ra naxan ma, a lu a ma, na kanyi nan n Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi ragoroma mixie ma.›

sentences.english: This I saw myself and my witness is that he is the Son of God.
sentences.susu: N tan bara a to. N bara findi seede ra a Ala xa Di nan a ra.»

sentences.english: The day after, John was there again with two of his disciples;
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Yaya man nu na naa, a nun a fɔxirabirɛ mixi firin.

sentences.english: And looking at Jesus while he was walking he said, See, there is the Lamb of God!
sentences.susu: Yaya to Isa to dangi ra, a naxa a masen, «Ala xa sɛrɛxɛ nan yi ki!»

sentences.english: Hearing what he said, the two disciples went after Jesus.
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛ firinyie to a xui mɛ, e naxa bira Isa fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And Jesus, turning round, saw them coming after him and said to them, What are you looking for? They said to him, Rabbi (which is to say, Master), where are you living?
sentences.susu: Isa to a kobe rato, a naxa e to a fɔxɔ ra, a naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo munse fenfe?» E fan naxa a yaabi, «Rabuni, i yigiyaxi minden?» E to a xili «Rabuni», na nan falaxi e xa xui «Karamɔxɔ».

sentences.english: He said to them, Come and see. They went with him then and saw where he was living; and they were with him all that day: it was then about the tenth hour of the day.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Won xɛɛ, wo xa sa na kolon.» Nunmare tɛmui nan nu a ra. E naxa siga na yire kolonde, e fa lu Isa fɛ ma.

sentences.english: Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, was one of the two men who, hearing what John said, went after Jesus.
sentences.susu: Simɔn Piyɛri xunya Andire nu na na mixi firinyie ya ma, naxee Yaya xa masenyi mɛ, e fa bira Isa fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Early in the morning he came across his brother and said to him, We have made discovery! It is the Messiah! (which is to say, the Christ).
sentences.susu: A naxa siga a taara yire keren na, a a fala a bɛ, «Muxu bara Al Masiihu to!» Na nan falaxi e xa xui, «Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi».

sentences.english: And he took him to Jesus. Looking at him fixedly Jesus said, You are Simon, the son of John; your name will be Cephas (which is to say, Peter).
sentences.susu: Andire naxa Piyɛri xanin Isa yire. Isa to a to, a naxa a fala a bɛ, «Yunusa xa di Simɔn nan i ra, kɔnɔ i xili fama falade Kefasi, na nan na ki ‹Piyɛri,› naxan wama a falafe ‹fanye›.»

sentences.english: The day after this, Jesus had a desire to go into Galilee. He came across Philip and said to him, Come and be my disciple.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Isa naxa natɛ tongo a xa siga Galile. A to Filipu to, a naxa a fala a bɛ, «Bira n fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: Now Philip's town was Beth-saida, where Andrew and Peter came from.
sentences.susu: Filipu, Andire, nun Piyɛri birin findi Betesayidakae nan na.

sentences.english: Philip came across Nathanael and said to him, We have made a discovery! It is he of whom Moses, in the law, and the prophets were writing, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.
sentences.susu: Filipu naxa siga Natanayɛli yire, a a fala a bɛ, «Mixi naxan ma fe falaxi Munsa nun namiɲɔnmɛe xa Kitaabuie kui, muxu bara a to. Isa Nasarɛtika nan a ra, Yusufu xa di!»

sentences.english: Nazareth! said Nathanael, Is it possible for any good to come out of Nazareth? Philip said to him, Come and see.
sentences.susu: Natanayɛli naxa a maxɔrin, «Fe fanyi nde nɔma minide Nasarɛti?» Filipu naxa a yaabi, «Fa, i yɛtɛ yati xa a to.»

sentences.english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him and said of him, See, here is a true son of Israel in whom there is nothing false.
sentences.susu: Isa to Natanayɛli to fa ra, a naxa a fala a xa fe ra, «Isirayilaka yati nan yi ki, maifuya yo mu na naxan bɔɲɛ ma!»

sentences.english: Nathanael said to him, Where did you get knowledge of me? In answer Jesus said, Before Philip was talking with you, while you were still under the fig-tree, I saw you.
sentences.susu: Natanayɛli naxa a maxɔrin, «I n kolonxi di?» Isa naxa a yaabi, «Beenun Filipu xa i xili, i to nu xɔrɛ bili bun ma, n tan i to nɛ.»

sentences.english: Nathanael said to him, Rabbi, you are the Son of God, you are King of Israel!
sentences.susu: Natanayɛli naxa a fala a bɛ, «Karamɔxɔ, i tan findixi Ala xa Di yati nan na! Isirayila Mangɛ nan i ra!»

sentences.english: In answer Jesus said to him, You have faith because I said to you, I saw you under the fig-tree. You will see greater things than these.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «N to a falaxi, a n i to nɛ xɔrɛ bili bun ma, i laxi n na na fe nan ma? I fe gbɛtɛe toma nɛ naxee dangi na ra.»

sentences.english: And he said to him, Truly I say to you all, You will see heaven opening and God's angels going up and coming down on the Son of man.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a masen a bɛ, «N xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, wo fama nɛ koore tode, a rabixi, Ala xa malekɛe nu te e nu goro Adama xa Di ma.»

sentences.english: On the third day two people were going to be married at Cana in Galilee. The mother of Jesus was there:
sentences.susu: Na xi saxan nde ma, futixiri xulunyi nde naxa raba Kaana, naxan na Galile bɔxi ma. Isa nga nu na na xulun mixie ya ma.

sentences.english: And Jesus with his disciples came as guests.
sentences.susu: Isa fan nu xilixi naa, a nun a fɔxirabirɛe.

sentences.english: When they had not enough wine, the mother of Jesus said to him, They have no wine.
sentences.susu: Wɛni to ɲɔn, Isa nga naxa a fala a bɛ, «Wɛni bara ɲɔn yi mixie yi ra.»

sentences.english: Jesus said to her, Woman, this is not your business; my time is still to come.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a maxɔrin, «N nga, i wama munse xɔn ma n na? N ma waxati mu nu a li sinden.»

sentences.english: His mother said to the servants, Whatever he says to you, do it.
sentences.susu: A nga naxa a fala banxi konyie bɛ, «A na naxan yo fala wo bɛ, wo a raba.»

sentences.english: Now six pots of stone, every one taking two or three firkins of water, were placed there for the purpose of washing, as is the way of the Jews.
sentences.susu: Fɛɲɛ senni gɛmɛ daaxi nu na mɛnni, naxee rafema ye ra Yuwifie e yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛnma naxan na. Litiri tongo solomasaxan han litiri kɛmɛ mɔxɔɲɛn nu nɔma sade fɛɲɛ keren kui.

sentences.english: Jesus said to the servants, Make the pots full of water. And they made them full to the top.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala konyie bɛ, «Wo yi fɛɲɛe rafe ye ra.» E naxa e birin nafe tapu.

sentences.english: Then he said to them, Now take some, and give it to the master of the feast. So they took it to him.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a fala e bɛ, «Yakɔsi, wo a nde ba, wo a xanin xulun xunyi xɔn ma.» E naxa na fan naba.

sentences.english: After tasting the water which had now become wine, the master of the feast (having no idea where it came from, though it was clear to the servants who took the water out) sent for the newly-married man,
sentences.susu: Xulun xunyi to na ye min Isa nu bara naxan mafindi wɛni ra, a mu nu a kelide kolon, kɔnɔ konyi naxee ye baxi, nee tan a kolon. A to a min, a naxa ginɛfenyi xili,

sentences.english: And said to him, Every man first puts out his best wine and when all have had enough he puts out what is not so good; but you have kept the good wine till now.
sentences.susu: a a fala a bɛ, «Xulun kanyi birin wɛni fanyi nan singe raminima, mixie na siisi, e fa wɛni gbɛtɛ ramini. Kɔnɔ i tan bara wɛni fanyi ragata han yi tɛmui!»

sentences.english: This, the first of his signs, Jesus did at Cana in Galilee and let his glory be seen openly; and his disciples put their faith in him.
sentences.susu: Na naxa findi Isa xa tɔnxuma singe ra. A a raba Kaana nɛ, Galile bɔxi ma. Na fe kui, a a xa nɔrɛ nan makɛnɛn, a fɔxirabirɛe naxa la a ra.

sentences.english: After this he went down to Capernaum, with his mother, his brothers, and his disciples, and they were there not more than two or three days.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, a naxa sa goro Kapɛrɛnamu, a nun a nga, a xunyae, nun a fɔxirabirɛe. E naxa sa xi ndee radangi naa.

sentences.english: The time of the Passover of the Jews was near and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Yuwifie xa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali to makɔrɛ, Isa naxa te Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And there in the Temple he saw men trading in oxen and sheep and doves, and he saw the changers of money in their seats:
sentences.susu: A naxa sa li, ninge, yɛxɛɛ, nun ganbɛ matie nu na hɔrɔmɔbanxi yire, kɔbiri masarɛe fan nu dɔxɔxi naa.

sentences.english: And he made a whip of small cords and put them all out of the Temple, with the sheep and the oxen, sending in all directions the small money of the changers and overturning their tables;
sentences.susu: Isa naxa luuti ndee yailan luxusinyi ra, a yulɛe birin keri hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, a nun e xa ningee nun yɛxɛɛe. A naxa kɔbiri masarɛe xa kɔbiri rayensen bɔxi, a e xa teebilie rabira.

sentences.english: And to those who were trading in doves he said, Take these things away; do not make my Father's house a market.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala ganbɛ matie fan bɛ, «Wo yee tongo be! Wo ba n Baba xa banxi findife makiti ra!»

sentences.english: And it came to the minds of the disciples that the Writings say, I am on fire with passion for your house.
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛe naxa ratu na Kitaabui sɛbɛli ma naxan a falama, «Xanunteya bara gbo yɛ n bɔɲɛ kui i xa banxi xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: Then the Jews put this question to him: What sign of authority have you to give us, seeing that you do these things?
sentences.susu: Na kui, Yuwifi kuntigie naxa a maxɔrin, «I tɔnxuma makaabaxi mundun nabama naxan a masenma muxu bɛ a a lan i xa yi mɔɔli raba?»

sentences.english: And Jesus said to them, Send destruction on this Temple and I will put it up again in three days.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Wo yi hɔrɔmɔbanxi rabira. Xi saxan bun ma n tan a rakelima.»

sentences.english: The Jews said, The building of this Temple took forty-six years; and you will put it up in three days!
sentences.susu: Yuwifi kuntigie naxa a fala, «Yi hɔrɔmɔbanxi naxan tixi ɲɛ tongo naani nun senni bun ma, i tan na rakelima nɛ xi saxan bun ma?»

sentences.english: But his words were about that holy building which was his body.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa to hɔrɔmɔbanxi xa fe fala, taali wɔyɛnyi nan nu a ra. A nu a fate nan ma fe falafe.

sentences.english: So when he had come back again from the dead, the memory of these words came back to the disciples, and they had faith in the holy Writings and in the word which Jesus had said.
sentences.susu: A to keli faxɛ ma, a fɔxirabirɛe naxa ratu a xa wɔyɛnyi ma. Na kui, e naxa la Kitaabui xui ra, e naxa la Isa xui ra.

sentences.english: Now while he was in Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover, a great number of people came to have faith in his name, after seeing the signs which he did.
sentences.susu: Isa to nu na Darisalamu, Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali waxati, mixi gbegbe naxa danxaniya a ma e to tɔnxuma makaabaxie to, a nu naxee rabama.

sentences.english: But Jesus did not have faith in them, because he had knowledge of them all.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa mu nu lama e ra, barima a nu adamadi birin kolon.

sentences.english: He had no need for any witness about man; for he himself had knowledge of what was in man.
sentences.susu: A hayi yo mu nu a ma, mixi yo xa ibunadama xa fe fala a bɛ, barima a tan nu adamadi bɔɲɛ kolon.

sentences.english: Now there was among the Pharisees a man named Nicodemus, who was one of the rulers of the Jews.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi kuntigi nde nu na Farisɛnie ya ma, naxan xili Nikodemu.

sentences.english: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, Rabbi, we are certain that you have come from God as a teacher, because no man would be able to do these signs which you do if God was not with him.
sentences.susu: A naxa siga Isa xɔn ma kɔɛ ra, a a fala a bɛ, «Karamɔxɔ, muxu a kolon karamɔxɔ nan i ra Ala naxan xɛɛxi. I tɔnxuma makaabaxi naxee rabafe, mixi yo mu nɔma e rabade xa a kanyi nun Ala xa mu a ra.»

sentences.english: Jesus said to him, Truly, I say to you, Without a new birth no man is able to see the kingdom of God.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen a bɛ, «N xa nɔndi yati fala i bɛ, xa mixi mu bari a nɛɛnɛ ra, a mu nɔma sode Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma.»

sentences.english: Nicodemus said to him, How is it possible for a man to be given birth when he is old? Is he able to go into his mother's body a second time and come to birth again?
sentences.susu: Nikodemu naxa a maxɔrin, «Mixi mɔxi nɔma gbilende a nga tɛɛgɛ, a man gbilen bari ra?»

sentences.english: Jesus said in answer, Truly, I say to you, If a man's birth is not from water and from the Spirit, it is not possible for him to go into the kingdom of God.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «A nɔndi i ma n xa a fala i bɛ, xa mixi mu bari a nɛɛnɛ ra, ye nun Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra, a mu nɔma sode Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma.»

sentences.english: That which has birth from the flesh is flesh, and that which has birth from the Spirit is spirit.
sentences.susu: «Fate bɛndɛ nan mixi fate bɛndɛ barima. Kɔnɔ mixi xaxili tan barima Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: Do not be surprised that I say to you, It is necessary for you to have a second birth.
sentences.susu: N to a falaxi i bɛ a fo wo xa bari a nɛɛnɛ ra, na naxa i tɛrɛnna.

sentences.english: The wind goes where its pleasure takes it, and the sound of it comes to your ears, but you are unable to say where it comes from and where it goes: so it is with everyone whose birth is from the Spirit.
sentences.susu: Foye minima a na wa minife dɛdɛ biri ra. I a xui nan mɛma, kɔnɔ i mu a kelide kolon, i mu a sigade fan kolon. Mixi na bari a nɛɛnɛ ra Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra, a luma na ki nɛ.»

sentences.english: And Nicodemus said to him, How is it possible for these things to be?
sentences.susu: Nikodemu naxa a maxɔrin, «Na rabama di?»

sentences.english: And Jesus, answering, said, Are you the teacher of Israel and have no knowledge of these things?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «I tan naxan findixi Isirayila karamɔxɔ xungbe ra, i mu na kolon?

sentences.english: Truly, I say to you, We say that of which we have knowledge; we give witness of what we have seen; and you do not take our witness to be true.
sentences.susu: N xa nɔndi yati fala i bɛ, muxu fee nan falama muxu naxee kolon. Muxu man fee nan seede bama muxu naxee toxi, kɔnɔ wo bara tondi muxu xa seedeɲɔxɔya ra.

sentences.english: If you have no belief when my words are about the things of earth, how will you have belief if my words are about the things of heaven?
sentences.susu: Xa wo mu la n xui ra, n to yi duniɲa fee falafe wo bɛ, xa n sa ariyanna fee nan fala wo bɛ, wo lama a ra di?

sentences.english: And no one has ever gone up to heaven but he who came down from heaven, the Son of man.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu nu te ariyanna, fo Adama xa Di naxan kelixi ariyanna.»

sentences.english: As the snake was lifted up by Moses in the waste land, even so it is necessary for the Son of man to be lifted up:
sentences.susu: «Annabi Munsa to nu na gbengberenyi ma, a naxa bɔximase misaali nde yailan wure gbeeli ra, a a ite wuri kuye ma. Adama xa Di fan lanma a xa ite wuri kɔn na na ki nɛ,

sentences.english: So that whoever has faith may have in him eternal life.
sentences.susu: alako naxan yo danxaniya a ma, na kanyi xa kisi sɔtɔ naxan mu ɲɔnma abadan.

sentences.english: For God had such love for the world that he gave his only Son, so that whoever has faith in him may not come to destruction but have eternal life.
sentences.susu: Ala duniɲa xanu nɛ han a naxa a xa Di kerenyi fi, alako mixi yo naxan na danxaniya a ma, a naxa lɔɛ, a xa kisi nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: God did not send his Son into the world to be judge of the world; he sent him so that the world might have salvation through him.
sentences.susu: Ala mu a xa Di xɛɛ duniɲa xa ratɔnde, a a xɛɛ nɛ a xa fa duniɲa rakisi.
