sentences.english: The man who has faith in him does not come up to be judged; but he who has no faith in him has been judged even now, because he has no faith in the name of the only Son of God.
sentences.susu: Naxan yo na danxaniya a ma, kiiti mu kanama na kanyi ra, kɔnɔ naxan yo mu danxaniya a ma, kiiti ɲan bara gɛ kanade na kanyi ra, barima a mu danxaniyaxi Ala xa Di kerenyi ma.

sentences.english: And this is the test by which men are judged: the light has come into the world and men have more love for the dark than for the light, because their acts are evil.
sentences.susu: Kiiti nan ya: Ala xa naiyalanyi bara fa duniɲa, kɔnɔ dimi rafan adamadie ma dangi na naiyalanyi ra, barima e kɛwali mu fan.

sentences.english: The light is hated by everyone whose acts are evil and he does not come to the light for fear that his acts will be seen.
sentences.susu: Naiyalanyi mu rafan fe kobi raba yo ma. E mu minima naiyalanyi ma, e xa wali kobie naxa fa sa kɛnɛ ma.

sentences.english: But he whose life is true comes to the light, so that it may be clearly seen that his acts have been done by the help of God.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ naxan yo ɲɛrɛma Ala xa nɔndi ma, a tan minima naiyalanyi ma, alako Ala waxɔnfe e naxan nabafe, na xa sa kɛnɛ ma.»

sentences.english: After these things Jesus and his disciples went into the land of Judaea, and there he was with them for some time, giving baptism.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛe naxa keli Darisalamu e so Yudaya bɔxi ma. Isa naxa waxati nde raba mɛnni a nun a fɔxirabirɛe, e nu mixie xunxama ye xɔɔra.

sentences.english: Now John was then giving baptism at Aenon near Salim, because there was much water there; and people came and were given baptism.
sentences.susu: Yaya fan nu mixie xunxama ye xɔɔra Enon nɛ, Salimon fɛ ma, barima ye gbegbe nu na naa. Mixie nu sigama a xɔn, a tan nu e xunxa ye xɔɔra.

sentences.english: For at this time John had not been put into prison.
sentences.susu: A a lixi na tɛmui, a mu nu saxi geeli sinden.

sentences.english: Then a question came up between John's disciples and a Jew about washing.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ nde, wɔyɛnyi naxa mini Yaya fɔxirabirɛe nun Yuwifi nde tagi marasɛniyɛnyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And they went to John and said to him, Rabbi, the man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan, the man to whom you gave witness, is now giving baptism, and everyone is going to him.
sentences.susu: E naxa siga Yaya yire, e a fala a bɛ, «Karamɔxɔ, wo nun xɛmɛ naxan nu a ra Yurudɛn naakiri ma, i bara naxan ma fe seede ba, a na mixie xunxafe ye xɔɔra. Birin na sigafe a yire.»

sentences.english: And this was John's answer: A man is unable to have anything if it is not given to him from heaven.
sentences.susu: Yaya naxa e yaabi, «Mixi mu fefe sɔtɔma, fo Ala na naxan fi a ma.

sentences.english: You yourselves give witness that I said, I am not the Christ. What I said was, I am sent before the Christ.
sentences.susu: Wo tan yati bara findi n ma seedee ra, a n a masen nɛ, ‹N tan xa mu findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra. N xɛɛxi a ya ra nɛ.›

sentences.english: He who has the bride is the husband: but the husband's friend, whose place is by his side and whose ears are open to him, is full of joy because of the husband's voice: such is my joy, and it is complete.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ naxan ginɛ fenxi, a tan nan findima ginɛ kanyi ra. A dɛfanboore tan luma a fɛ ma nɛ, a a tuli mati a ra ɲɛlɛxinyi kui. N tan luma na ki nɛ Isa bɛ. N ma sɛɛwɛ bara kamali.

sentences.english: He has to become greater while I become less.
sentences.susu: Fo Isa xa fe xa ite nɛ, n gbe xa igoro.»

sentences.english: He who comes from heaven is greater than all others: he who comes from earth is of the earth, and of the earth are his words: he who comes from heaven is over all.
sentences.susu: «Naxan kelixi koore, a tan dangi birin na. Naxan kelixi duniɲa ma, duniɲa mixi nan a ra naxan wɔyɛnma a duniɲa ki ma, kɔnɔ naxan tan kelixi ariyanna, a tan dangi birin na.

sentences.english: He gives witness of what he has seen and of what has come to his ears; and no man takes his witness as true.
sentences.susu: A tan fe nan seede bama, a bara naxan to, a man bara naxan mɛ, kɔnɔ mixi yo mu lama a xa seedeɲɔxɔya ra.

sentences.english: He who so takes his witness has made clear his faith that God is true.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan lama na seedeɲɔxɔya ra, a bara a kolon a Ala nɔndi nan falama.

sentences.english: For he whom God has sent says God's words; and God does not give him the Spirit by measure.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Xɛɛra Ala xa masenyi nan tima, barima a kamalixi Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi ra.

sentences.english: The Father has love for the Son and has put all things into his hands.
sentences.susu: Baba Ala a xa Di xanuxi nɛ, a fe birin sa a bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: He who has faith in the Son has eternal life; but he who has not faith in the Son will not see life; God's wrath is resting on him.
sentences.susu: Naxan na danxaniya Ala xa Di ma, a bara abadan kisi sɔtɔ. Kɔnɔ naxan na Ala xa Di xui matandi, na kanyi tan mu kisima. Ala xa xɔnɛ nan birama a fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: Now when it was clear to the Lord that word had come to the ears of the Pharisees that Jesus was making more disciples than John and was giving them baptism
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a kolon a Farisɛnie bara a mɛ, a fɔxirabirɛe na wuyafe, a man na mixie xunxafe ye xɔɔra dangi Yaya ra.

sentences.english: (Though, in fact, it was his disciples who gave baptism, not Jesus himself),
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a fa li Isa yɛtɛ xa mu nu mixie xunxama ye xɔɔra, a fɔxirabirɛe nan nu a rabama.

sentences.english: He went out of Judaea into Galilee again.
sentences.susu: Isa to rakolon na fe ma, a naxa keli Yudaya, a gbilen Galile bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And it was necessary for him to go through Samaria.
sentences.susu: Na biyaasi kui, a nu lan a xa Samari bɔxi igiri sigafe ra Galile.

sentences.english: So he came to a town of Samaria which was named Sychar, near to the bit of land which Jacob gave to his son Joseph:
sentences.susu: A naxa Samari taa nde li naxan xili Sukaru, dɛnnaxɛ makɔrɛ xɛ ra, Yuwifie benba Yaxuba naxan fi a xa di Yusufu ma.

sentences.english: Now Jacob's fountain was there. Jesus, being tired after his journey, was resting by the fountain. It was about the sixth hour.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba xa kɔlɔnyi na mɛnni nɛ. Isa to nu bara tagan a xa biyaasi kui, a naxa a magoro na kɔlɔn dɛ ra. Yanyi tagi nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: A woman of Samaria came to get water, and Jesus said to her, Give me some water.
sentences.susu: Samari ginɛ nde to fa ye bade, Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «N ki ye, n xa a min.»

sentences.english: For his disciples had gone to the town to get food.
sentences.susu: A a lixi Isa fɔxirabirɛe nu bara siga donse sarade taa kui.

sentences.english: The woman of Samaria said to him, Why do you, a Jew, make a request for water to me, a woman of Samaria? She said this because Jews have nothing to do with the people of Samaria.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a fala Isa bɛ, «I tan Yuwifi, n tan Samari ginɛ. I n maxɔrinma ye min daaxi ma munfe ra?» Ginɛ na fala nɛ barima Yuwifie nun Samarikae mu sese masarama e bore tagi.

sentences.english: In answer Jesus said, If you had knowledge of what God gives freely and who it is who says to you, Give me water, you would make your prayer to him, and he would give you living water.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala, «Xa i sa a kolon nu, Ala wama i kife naxan na, i tan nan a makulama kisi ye ra nu, a fa na fi i ma. Xa i sa a kolon nu mixi naxan a falafe i bɛ yi ki, ‹n ki ye ra,› i tan fan a makulama nɛ ye ra nu naxan i rakisima.»

sentences.english: The woman said to him, Sir, you have no vessel and the fountain is deep; from where will you get the living water?
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a maxɔrin, «N ba, ye base yo mu i yi ra, yi kɔlɔnyi fan tilin. I fa na kisi ye sɔtɔma minden?

sentences.english: Are you greater than our father Jacob who gave us the fountain and took the water of it himself, with his children and his cattle?
sentences.susu: Ka i tan dangi muxu benba Yaxuba ra? A tan nan yi kɔlɔnyi fi muxu ma. A tan yɛtɛ bara a ye min, a nun a xa die, a nun a xa gɔɔrɛ.»

sentences.english: Jesus said to her, Everyone who takes this water will be in need of it again:
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «Naxan yo yi kɔlɔn ye min, ye xɔli man gbilenma a suxu ra.

sentences.english: But whoever takes the water I give him will never be in need of drink again; for the water I give him will become in him a fountain of eternal life.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ naxan ye minma n naxan fima a ma, ye xɔli mu a suxuma sɔnɔn. Na ye findima dulonyi nan na a bɔɲɛ ma, a gbo a i, a findi abadan kisi ra.»

sentences.english: The woman said to him, Sir, give me this water, so that I may not be in need again of drink and will not have to come all this way for it.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «N ba, na ye fi n ma, alako ye xɔli naxa n suxu, n naxa fa ye bade sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: Jesus said to her, Go, get your husband and come back here with him.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «Siga i sa i xa mɔri xili, wo fa be.»

sentences.english: In answer, the woman said, I have no husband. Jesus said to her, You have said rightly, I have no husband:
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a yaabi, «N mu dɔxɔxi xɛmɛ xɔn.» Isa naxa a fala, «I nɔndi nan falaxi, a i mu dɔxɔxi xɛmɛ xɔn.

sentences.english: You have had five husbands, and the man you have now is not your husband: that was truly said.
sentences.susu: I bara dɔxɔ xɛmɛ suuli birin xɔn ma, i man nun xɛmɛ naxan a ra yi tɛmui, futi mu wo tagi. Na tan, i nɔndi nan falaxi.»

sentences.english: The woman said to him, Sir, I see that you are a prophet.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a fala Isa bɛ, «Awa, n bara a kolon fa, a namiɲɔnmɛ nan na i ra.

sentences.english: Our fathers gave worship on this mountain, but you Jews say that the right place for worship is in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Muxu benbae Ala batu yi geya nan fari, kɔnɔ wo tan Yuwifie a falama a fo Ala xa batu Darisalamu nɛ.»

sentences.english: Jesus said to her, Woman, take my word for this; the time is coming when you will not give worship to the Father on this mountain or in Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «N ma di, i xa la n na, waxati na fafe Baba Ala mu batuma yi geya ma, a mu batuma Darisalamu fan.

sentences.english: You give worship, but without knowledge of what you are worshipping: we give worship to what we have knowledge of: for salvation comes from the Jews.
sentences.susu: Wo tan Samarikae, wo salima, kɔnɔ wo mu Ala kolon. Muxu tan Yuwifie, muxu salima, muxu man Ala kolon, barima Ala xa kisi fatanma Yuwifie nan na.

sentences.english: But the time is coming, and is even now here, when the true worshippers will give worship to the Father in the true way of the spirit, for these are the worshippers desired by the Father.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ waxati na fafe, a ɲan bara a li, Baba Ala batulae a batuma a nɔndi ki ma e xaxili fiixɛ nan na. Baba Ala wama na batula mɔɔlie nan xɔn ma.

sentences.english: God is Spirit: then let his worshippers give him worship in the true way of the spirit.
sentences.susu: Ala findixi Xaxili nan na. A batulae lan nɛ e xa a batu e xaxili fiixɛ nan na a nɔndi ki ma.»

sentences.english: The woman said to him, I am certain that the Messiah, who is named Christ, is coming; when he comes he will make all things clear to us.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «N a kolon a Al Masiihu fafe, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi. A tan na fa, a fe birin tagi rabama nɛ won bɛ.»

sentences.english: Jesus said to her, I, who am talking to you, am he.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «N tan nan na ra, n tan Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan wɔyɛnfe i bɛ yi ki.»

sentences.english: At that point the disciples came back, and they were surprised to see him talking to a woman; but not one of them said to him, What is your purpose? or, Why are you talking to her?
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛe to Isa li, a na wɔyɛnfe na ginɛ ra, e dɛ naxa ixara, kɔnɔ e mu a maxɔrin, «I wama munse xɔn» xa na mu a ra «Wo na munse falafe?»

sentences.english: Then the woman put down her water-pot and went into the town, and said to the people,
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a xa fɛɲɛ lu naa, a siga taa kui, a sa a fala mixie bɛ,

sentences.english: Come and see a man who has been talking to me of everything I ever did! Is it possible that this is the Christ?
sentences.susu: «Wo fa. Wo xa xɛmɛ nde mato naxan bara n ma kɛwali birin fala n bɛ, a mu n kolon. Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi na a ra ba, ka?»

sentences.english: So they went out of the town and came to him.
sentences.susu: Na kui, taakae naxa mini sigafe ra Isa yire.

sentences.english: While this was taking place, the disciples were saying to Jesus, Master, take some food.
sentences.susu: Na waxati bun ma, Isa fɔxirabirɛe nu wɔyɛnfe a bɛ, e a fala, «Karamɔxɔ, i dɛge.»

sentences.english: But he said to them, I have food of which you have no knowledge.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Baloe na n tan yi ra, wo tan mu naxan kolon.»

sentences.english: So the disciples said one to another, Did anyone give him food?
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛe naxa e bore maxɔrin, «Pe, mixi nde nan faxi donse ra a xɔn ma ba?»

sentences.english: Jesus said, My food is to do the pleasure of him who sent me and to make his work complete.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «N tan ma baloe findixi n Xɛɛma waxɔnfe rabafe nan na, n xa a xa wali rakamali a bara naxan so n yi.

sentences.english: You would say, Four months from now is the time of the grain-cutting. Take a look, I say to you, at the fields; they are even now white for cutting.
sentences.susu: Wo tan mu a falama xɛ, ‹Kike naani nan luxi beenun xɛ xabɛ xa a li›? N xa a fala wo bɛ, wo wo ya rasiga, wo xɛe mato, e ragbeelixi ki naxɛ. Xɛ xaba tɛmui bara a li.

sentences.english: He who does the cutting now has his reward; he is getting together fruit for eternal life, so that he who did the planting and he who gets in the grain may have joy together.
sentences.susu: Xɛ xabɛ ɲan bara a xa wali sare sɔtɔ fɔlɔ. A xa wali a niyama nɛ mixi xa kisi sɔtɔ abadan. Na kui, naxan xɛ bima nun naxan xɛ xabama, e birin luma sɛɛwɛ keren nɛ.

sentences.english: In this the saying is a true one, One does the planting, and another gets in the grain.
sentences.susu: Yi masenyi findixi nɔndi nan na, ‹Mixi nde xɛ garansanma, gbɛtɛ a xabama.›

sentences.english: I sent you to get in grain which you had no hand in planting: other men did that work, and you take the reward.
sentences.susu: N tan wo xɛɛxi xɛ xabade nɛ, wo mu naxan nawalixi. Mixi gbɛtɛe nan walixi, kɔnɔ wo tan nan e xa wali raɲɔnyi toma.»

sentences.english: Now a number of the people of that town had faith in him because of the woman's witness: He has been talking to me of everything I ever did.
sentences.susu: Samarika naxee nu sabatixi na taa kui, e gbegbe naxa danxaniya Isa ma na ginɛ xa seedeɲɔxɔya xa fe ra, a to a fala, «N bara kɛwali naxan birin naba, a bara a birin tagi raba n bɛ.»

sentences.english: So when the people came to him they made request to him to be among them for a time, and he was there two days.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Samarikae to fa Isa yire, e naxa a mayandi a xa lu e xɔnyi. Isa naxa xi firin naba naa.

sentences.english: And a great number more of them came to have faith in him because of what he himself said.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe man naxa danxaniya a xa masenyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: And they said to the woman, Now we have faith, but not because of your story: we ourselves have given ear to his words, and we are certain that he is truly the Saviour of the world.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala na ginɛ bɛ, «Singe muxu nu danxaniyaxi i tan nan xa wɔyɛnyi xa fe ra, kɔnɔ yakɔsi muxu tan yɛtɛ bara a xui mɛ. Muxu bara a kolon fa, a yi findixi duniɲa rakisima nan yati ra.»

sentences.english: And after the two days he went on from there into Galilee.
sentences.susu: Na xi firin dangi xanbi, Isa naxa keli naa, a siga Galile,

sentences.english: For Jesus himself said that a prophet has no honour in the country of his birth.
sentences.susu: barima a tan yati a a masen nɛ a namiɲɔnmɛ sese yo mu binyama a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: So when he came into Galilee, the Galilaeans took him to their hearts because of the things which they had seen him do in Jerusalem at the feast — they themselves having been there at the feast.
sentences.susu: A to so Galile, naakae naxa a rasɛnɛ a fanyi ra, barima e fan nu bara Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali raba Darisalamu, e a xa kaabanakoe to, a naxee raba naa.

sentences.english: So he came to Cana in Galilee, where he had made the water wine. And there was a certain man of high position whose son was ill at Capernaum.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa man naxa so Kaana, Galile bɔxi ma, a ye mafindi wɛni ra dɛnnaxɛ. Mangɛ xa walikɛ xungbe nde nu na naa, naxan xa di nu furaxi Kapɛrɛnamu.

sentences.english: When it came to his ears that Jesus had come from Judaea into Galilee, he went to him and made a request that he would come down to his son, who was near to death, and make him well.
sentences.susu: A to a mɛ a Isa bara fa Galile kelife Yudaya, a naxa siga a yire, a a maxandi a xa fa a xa di xɛmɛ rayalan naxan nu saxi saya fure ma.

sentences.english: Then Jesus said to him, You will not have faith if you do not see signs and wonders.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «Wo tan mu danxaniyama feo, fo wo tɔnxumae nun kaabanakoe to!»

sentences.english: The man said, Sir, come down before my boy is dead.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ xa walikɛ naxa a mayandi, «Marigi, talu n xɔnyi beenun n ma di xa faxa!»

sentences.english: And Jesus said, Go in peace; your son is living. The man had faith in the word which Jesus said to him and went away.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «Siga, i xa di bara kisi.» Na walikɛ naxa la Isa xa masenyi ra, a naxa siga.

sentences.english: And while he was going down, his servants came to him and said, Your boy is living.
sentences.susu: A nu na gbilenfe tɛmui naxɛ, a xa konyie naxa a ralan, e a fala a bɛ, «I xa di bara kisi!»

sentences.english: So he put a question to them as to the hour when he became better; and they said to him, The disease went from him yesterday at the seventh hour.
sentences.susu: A fan naxa e maxɔrin, «A fisa mun tɛmui?» E naxa a yaabi, «A fate xinbelixi xoro yanyi tagi ɲɔndɔn.»

sentences.english: It was clear then to the father that this was the very time at which Jesus said to him, Your son is living. And he had faith in Jesus, he and all his family.
sentences.susu: Na di baba naxa a kolon a xa di yalan fɔlɔ kabi Isa a fala a bɛ tɛmui naxɛ, «I xa di bara kisi.» Na nan a ra, na xɛmɛ nun a xa denbaya birin naxa danxaniya Isa ma.

sentences.english: Now this is the second sign which Jesus did after he had come out of Judaea into Galilee.
sentences.susu: Na naxa findi Isa xa tɔnxuma makaabaxi firin nde ra. A a raba Galile nɛ, a to gbilen kelife Yudaya.

sentences.english: After these things there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Yuwifie xa sali nde to a li, Isa naxa te Darisalamu.

sentences.english: Now in Jerusalem near the sheep-market there is a public bath which in Hebrew is named Beth-zatha. It has five doorways.
sentences.susu: Ye yire nde nu na Darisalamu, naxan xili Beteseda Eburu xui. A nu na taa naadɛ xungbe nan fɛ ma, naxan xili Xurusee Naadɛ. Leele suuli nan nu na na ye yire.

sentences.english: In these doorways there were a great number of people with different diseases: some unable to see, some without the power of walking, some with wasted bodies.
sentences.susu: Furema wuyaxi nu saxi na leelee bun ma, alɔ dɔnxuie, namatɛe, nun naxee salonyie birin tuuxi a ma.
<range>

sentences.english: One man was there who had been ill for thirty-eight years.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ nde nu na naa, naxan nu namataxi kabi ɲɛ tongo saxan nun solomasaxan.

sentences.english: When Jesus saw him there on the floor it was clear to him that he had been now a long time in that condition, and so he said to the man, Is it your desire to get well?
sentences.susu: Isa to nu a kolon a yi xɛmɛ nu bara bu a namataxi ra, a to a saxi to, a naxa a maxɔrin, «I wama a xɔn i xa yalan?»

sentences.english: The ill man said in answer, Sir, I have nobody to put me into the bath when the water is moving; and while I am on the way down some other person gets in before me.
sentences.susu: Namatɛ naxa a yaabi, «Marigi, ye na imaxa, mixi yo mu na naxan n nagoroma a xɔɔra. Beenun n tan xa ye yire li, mixi gbɛtɛ bara goro a xɔɔra.»

sentences.english: Jesus said to him, Get up, take your bed and go.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «Keli, i i xa dagi tongo, i i ɲɛrɛ.»

sentences.english: And the man became well straight away, and took up his bed and went. Now that day was the Sabbath.
sentences.susu: A naxa yalan keren na. A naxa a xa dagi tongo, a a ɲɛrɛ. Na lɔxɔɛ to nu findixi malabu lɔxɔɛ nan na,

sentences.english: So the Jews said to the man who had been made well, It is the Sabbath; and it is against the law for you to take up your bed.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi kuntigie naxa a fala na xɛmɛ rayalanxi bɛ, «Malabu lɔxɔɛ nan to, a mu lanma i xa i xa dagi xanin i xun.»

sentences.english: He said to them, But he who made me well, said to me, Take up your bed and go.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a tan naxa e yaabi, «Xɛmɛ naxan n nayalanxi, na nan a fala n bɛ, ‹I i xa dagi tongo, i i ɲɛrɛ.›»

sentences.english: Then they put to him the question: Who is the man who said to you, Take it up and go?
sentences.susu: E naxa a maxɔrin, «Nde na falaxi i bɛ?»

sentences.english: Now he who had been made well had no knowledge who it was, Jesus having gone away because of the number of people who were in that place.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xɛmɛ mu nu a kolon naxan a rayalanxi, barima Isa nu bara lɔɛ a ma ɲama ya ma.

sentences.english: After a time Jesus came across him in the Temple and said to him, See, you are well and strong; do no more sin for fear a worse thing comes to you.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Isa man naxa na xɛmɛ li hɔrɔmɔbanxi, a naxa a fala a bɛ, «Yakɔsi i bara yalan, kɔnɔ a lanma i xa gbilen yunubi fɔxɔ ra alako fe gbɛtɛ naxa i sɔtɔ naxan dangi na fure singe ra.»

sentences.english: The man went away and said to the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ naxa siga a sa a fala Yuwifi kuntigie bɛ, a Isa nan a rayalanxi.

sentences.english: And for this reason the Jews were turned against Jesus, because he was doing these things on the Sabbath.
sentences.susu: Isa to na fe raba malabu lɔxɔɛ nɛ, Yuwifi kuntigie naxa so Isa gerefe.

sentences.english: But his answer was: My Father is still working even now, and so I am working.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala e bɛ, «Han to n Baba na walife, n fan na walife.»

sentences.english: For this cause the Jews had an even greater desire to put Jesus to death, because not only did he not keep the Sabbath but he said God was his Father, so making himself equal with God.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Yuwifie naxa fe birin naba alako e xa a faxa, barima a nu malabu lɔxɔɛ sɛriyɛ kanama, a man nu a falama a Ala nan a Baba ra. Na na a ra e birin tide lanxi.

sentences.english: So Jesus made answer and said, Truly I say to you, The Son is not able to do anything himself; he is able to do only what he sees the Father doing; whatever the Father does the Son does it in the same way.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «N xa nɔndi yati fala wo bɛ, Ala xa Di mu nɔma fefe rabade a yɛtɛ ra, fo a na naxan to a Baba Ala ra. Ala xa Di, a Baba Ala nan fɔxi rabama.

sentences.english: For the Father has love for the Son and lets him see everything which he does: and he will let him see greater works than these so that you may be full of wonder.
sentences.susu: Barima Baba Ala a xa Di xanuxi nɛ, a man fe naxan birin nabama, a a masenma a xa Di bɛ. A ɲan fama fee masende a bɛ naxee makaaba dangi yee ra, alako wo dɛ xa ixara.

sentences.english: In the same way, as the Father gives life to the dead, even so the Son gives life to those to whom he is pleased to give it.
sentences.susu: Baba Ala mixie rakelima faxɛ ma ki naxɛ, a e rakisi, Ala xa Di fan kisi fima a na wa a fife naxee ma.

sentences.english: The Father is not the judge of men, but he has given all decisions into the hands of the Son;
sentences.susu: Baba Ala ɲan mu mixi yo makiitima, a mixi makiitife birin luxi a xa Di nan ma,

sentences.english: So that all men may give honour to the Son even as they give honour to the Father. He who gives no honour to the Son gives no honour to the Father who sent him.
sentences.susu: alako birin xa Ala xa Di binya alɔ e Baba Ala binyama ki naxɛ. Naxan yo mu Ala xa Di binya, a mu Baba Ala fan binyaxi naxan a xa Di xɛɛxi duniɲa.»

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, The man whose ears are open to my word and who has faith in him who sent me, has eternal life; he will not be judged, but has come from death into life.
sentences.susu: «N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, naxan a tuli matima n na, a fa la n Xɛɛma ra, na kanyi bara kisi abadan. Na kanyi mu kiiti xɔrɔxɔɛ sɔtɔma, a bara gɛ ratangade yahannama ma, a bara kisi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, The time is coming, it has even now come, when the voice of the Son of God will come to the ears of the dead, and those hearing it will have life.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, waxati fafe a lide, a ɲan bara a li, faxamixie Ala xa Di xui mɛma nɛ. Naxee na a xui mɛ, nee kisima nɛ.

sentences.english: For even as the Father has life in himself, so he has given to the Son to have life in himself.
sentences.susu: Baba Ala to findixi kisi kanyi ra kisi sɔtɔma naxan na, a bara a xa Di fan findi kisi kanyi ra kisi sɔtɔma naxan na.

sentences.english: And he has given him authority to be judge because he is the Son of man.
sentences.susu: A man bara nɔɛ so a yi ra adamadie makiitife ma, barima Adama xa Di nan a ra.

sentences.english: Do not be surprised at this: for the time is coming when his voice will come to all who are in the place of the dead,
sentences.susu: Wo naxa kaaba yi fe ma, barima waxati fafe a lide, naxee na gaburi kui, e birin a xui mɛma nɛ,

sentences.english: And they will come out; those who have done good, into the new life; and those who have done evil, to be judged.
sentences.susu: e mini e xa gaburie kui. Naxee findi fe fanyi rabae ra, nee na keli, e kisi nan sɔtɔma. Kɔnɔ naxee findi fe kobi rabae ra, nee tan na keli, e gbaloe nan sɔtɔma.»

sentences.english: Of myself I am unable to do anything: as the voice comes to me so I give a decision: and my decision is right because I have no desire to do what is pleasing to myself, but only what is pleasing to him who sent me.
sentences.susu: «N tan mu nɔma fefe rabade n yɛtɛ ra. N a mɛma Baba Ala ra ki naxɛ, n tan kiiti sama na ki nɛ. Na kui, n ma kiiti tinxin, barima n mu birama n yɛtɛ waxɔnfe xa fɔxɔ ra, n biraxi n Xɛɛma nan waxɔnfe fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: If I gave witness about myself, my witness would not be true.
sentences.susu: «Xa n sa seede ba n yɛtɛ bɛ, a mu lanma.

sentences.english: There is another who gives witness about me and I am certain that the witness he gives about me is true.
sentences.susu: Baba Ala nan seede bama n bɛ. N fan a kolon a tan seedeɲɔxɔya naxan bama n ma fe ra, a findixi nɔndi nan na.

sentences.english: You sent to John and he gave true witness.
sentences.susu: Wo tan yati bara mixie xɛɛ Yaya xɔn, a fan naxa seedeɲɔxɔya ba nɔndi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: But I have no need of a man's witness: I only say these things so that you may have salvation.
sentences.susu: N hayi mu na adama tan xa seedeɲɔxɔya ma, kɔnɔ n yi fee masenxi nɛ wo bɛ alako wo xa kisi.

sentences.english: He was a burning and shining light, and for a time you were ready to be happy in his light.
sentences.susu: Yaya nu luxi nɛ alɔ lanpui radɛxɛxi naxan yanbama. Wo bara sɛɛwa na naiyalanyi ra waxati nde bun ma.»

sentences.english: But the witness which I have is greater than that of John: the work which the Father has given me to do, the very work which I am now doing, is a witness that the Father has sent me.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ seedeɲɔxɔya nde na n bɛ naxan dangi Yaya gbe ra. N fee naxee rabama, Baba Ala bara naxee so n yi n xa e raba, nee nan findixi seedeɲɔxɔya ra n ma fe ra, a Baba Ala nan n xɛɛxi.

sentences.english: And the Father himself who sent me has given witness about me. Not one of you has ever given ear to his voice; his form you have not seen.
sentences.susu: Baba Ala naxan n xɛɛxi, a fan yati bara seede ba n ma fe ra. Wo singe mu nu a xui mɛ, wo mu nu a yatagi to,

sentences.english: And you have not kept his word in your hearts, because you have not faith in him whom he has sent.
sentences.susu: a xa masenyi man mu sabatixi wo bɔɲɛ ma, barima wo mu laxi a xa xɛɛra ra.

sentences.english: You make search in the holy Writings, in the belief that through them you get eternal life; and it is those Writings which give witness about me.
sentences.susu: Wo luma Kitaabuie mato ra, barima wo ɲɔxɔ a ma, a wo abadan kisi sɔtɔma e tan nan saabui ra. A fa li, na Kitaabuie yati nan n ma fe seede bama,

sentences.english: And still you have no desire to come to me so that you may have life.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ wo tondixi fade n ma wo xa kisi sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: I do not take honour from men;
sentences.susu: «N mu wama adamadie xa matɔxɔɛ xɔn.

sentences.english: But I have knowledge of you that you have no love for God in your hearts.
sentences.susu: N wo kolon. Ala xa xanunteya mu na wo bɔɲɛ kui.

sentences.english: I have come in my Father's name, and your hearts are not open to me. If another comes with no other authority but himself, you will give him your approval.
sentences.susu: N faxi n Baba nan xili ra, kɔnɔ wo mu n nasɛnɛxi. Xa mixi gbɛtɛ sa fa a yɛtɛ kan nan xili ra, wo mu tondima na tan nasɛnɛde.

sentences.english: How is it possible for you to have faith while you take honour one from another and have no desire for the honour which comes from the only God?
sentences.susu: Wo to wama wo xa matɔxɔɛ sɔtɔ wo bore ra, kɔnɔ wo mu matɔxɔɛ fenma naxan fatanxi Ala Kerenyi tan na, wo fa danxaniyama di?»

sentences.english: Put out of your minds the thought that I will say things against you to the Father: the one who says things against you is Moses, on whom you put your hopes.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa a maɲɔxun de a n tan nan wo kalamuma Baba Ala xɔn. Annabi Munsa, wo xaxili tixi naxan na, na nan wo kalamuma.

sentences.english: If you had belief in Moses you would have belief in me; for his writings are about me.
sentences.susu: Xa wo sa laxi Munsa ra nu, wo lama nɛ n fan na nu, barima Munsa n tan nan ma fe sɛbɛ.

sentences.english: If you have no belief in his writings, how will you have belief in my words?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa wo mu laxi a xa Kitaabui ra, wo fa lama n tan ma masenyi ra di?»

sentences.english: After these things Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee — that is, the sea of Tiberias.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Isa naxa giri Galile Baa naakiri ma, e naxan xili falama Tiberiyasi Baa.

sentences.english: And a great number of people went after him because they saw the signs which he did on those who were ill.
sentences.susu: Ɲama gbegbe nu biraxi a fɔxɔ ra, barima e nu a xa tɔnxuma makaabaxie toxi, a nu naxee rabama furemae bɛ.

sentences.english: Then Jesus went up the mountain and was seated there with his disciples.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa te geya fari, a sa dɔxɔ naa a nun a fɔxirabirɛe.

sentences.english: Now the Passover, a feast of the Jews, was near.
sentences.susu: Yuwifie xa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali nu bara makɔrɛ.

sentences.english: Lifting up his eyes, Jesus saw a great number of people coming to where he was, and he said to Philip, Where may we get bread for all these people?
sentences.susu: Isa to a ya rasiga, a naxa ɲama gbegbe to fa ra a yire, a naxa Filipu maxɔrin, «Won sa nɔma taami sarade minden alako yi mixi birin xa e dɛge?»

sentences.english: This he said, testing him: for he had no doubt what he himself would do.
sentences.susu: A na fala nɛ alako a xa Filipu mato, barima Isa ɲan nu a kolon a fafe naxan nabade.

sentences.english: Philip made answer, Bread to the value of two hundred pence would not be enough even to give everyone a little.
sentences.susu: Filipu naxa a yaabi, «Hali won taami sara xi kɛmɛ firin wali sare nan na, na mu a niyama yi ɲama mixi birin xa nɔ taami xuntundi sɔtɔde.»

sentences.english: One of his disciples, Andrew, the brother of Simon Peter, said to Jesus,
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛ Andire, Simɔn Piyɛri xunya, a naxa a fala,

sentences.english: There is a boy here with five barley cakes and two fishes: but what is that among such a number?
sentences.susu: «Mɛngi taami suuli na yi xɛmɛ dimɛdi yi ra, a nun yɛxɛ firin, kɔnɔ na findixi munse ra yi ɲama bɛ?»

sentences.english: Jesus said, Let the people be seated. Now there was much grass in that place. And those seated on the grass were about five thousand.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen, «Wo a fala ɲama bɛ e xa e magoro.» Ɲooge xinde gbegbe to nu na naa, mixie naxa dɔxɔ bɔxi, e xɛmɛ mixi wulu suuli ɲɔndɔn.

sentences.english: Then Jesus took the cakes and having given praise to God, he gave them to the people who were seated, and the fishes in the same way, as much as they had need of.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Isa naxa na taami suuli tongo, a Ala tantu, a e itaxun ɲama magoroxi ma, a a raba na ki nɛ yɛxɛ fan na. Birin naxa a sɔtɔ, han e birin naxa wasa.

sentences.english: And when they had had enough, Jesus said to his disciples, Take up the broken bits which are over, so that nothing may be wasted.
sentences.susu: Ɲama to luga, Isa naxa a fala a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, «Wo donse dɔnxɔɛ xuntunyie malan, alako sese naxa makana.»

sentences.english: So they took them up: twelve baskets full of broken bits of the five cakes which were over after the people had had enough.
sentences.susu: Na kui, e naxa mixie xa donse dɔnxɔɛ xuntunyie malan han debe fu nun firin naxa rafe. Na birin fatan mɛngi taami gundi suuli nan na.

sentences.english: And when the people saw the sign which he had done, they said, Truly, this is the prophet who is to come into the world.
sentences.susu: Ɲama to Isa xa tɔnxuma makaabaxi to, e naxa a fala, «Muxu bara namiɲɔnmɛ naxan mamɛ a xa fa duniɲa ma, a tan nan yati yi ki!»

sentences.english: Now when Jesus saw that the people were about to come and take him by force to make him a king, he went away again up the mountain by himself.
sentences.susu: Isa to a kolon a e nu fafe a suxude nɛ e xa a findi mangɛ ra, a naxa keli e xun ma, a sa lu a kerenyi ma geya fari.

sentences.english: When evening came the disciples went down to the sea;
sentences.susu: Nunmare to so, Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa goro baa dɛ ra,

sentences.english: And they took a boat and went across the sea in the direction of Capernaum. By then it was dark and still Jesus had not come to them.
sentences.susu: e baki kunkui kui, e xa baa igiri sigafe ra Kapɛrɛnamu. Dimi nu bara sin, kɔnɔ Isa mu nu gbilen e yire sinden.

sentences.english: The sea was getting rough because of a strong wind which was blowing.
sentences.susu: Foye belebele naxa mini, baa naxa xaaɲɛ.

sentences.english: After they had gone three or four miles they saw Jesus walking on the sea and coming near to the boat; and they had great fear.
sentences.susu: E to laala ba kilo suuli xa na mu senni ɲɔndɔn, e naxa Isa to ɲɛrɛ ra ye fari, a fafe e mabiri kunkui yire. E naxa gaaxu.

sentences.english: But he said to them, It is I, have no fear.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa naxa a fala e bɛ, «N tan nan a ra. Wo naxa gaaxu.»

sentences.english: Then they readily took him into the boat: and straight away the boat was at the land to which they were going.
sentences.susu: E to nu wama a xa te kunkui kui, kunkui naxa e sigade li keren na.

sentences.english: The day after, the people who were on the other side of the sea saw that only one small boat had been there, that Jesus had not gone in that boat with the disciples, but that the disciples had gone away by themselves.
sentences.susu: Kuye naxa iba ɲama ra baa dɛ, Isa fɔxirabirɛe kunkui tongo dɛnnaxɛ. E nu a kolon a na kunkui kerenyi nan nu na naa, a fa li Isa mu baki a kui, fo a fɔxirabirɛe doro.

sentences.english: Some other boats, however, came from Tiberias near to the place where they had taken the bread after the Lord had given praise.
sentences.susu: Kunkui gbɛtɛ naxee keli Tiberiyasi, nee naxa e li mɛnni, e taami don dɛnnaxɛ, Marigi naxan so e yi a to gɛ Ala tantude.

sentences.english: So when the people saw that Jesus was not there, or his disciples, they got into those boats and went over to Capernaum looking for Jesus.
sentences.susu: Mixie to a kolon a Isa mu nu na mɛnni sɔnɔn, a fɔxirabirɛe fan mu na, e fan naxa baki kunkuie kui, e giri Kapɛrɛnamu, Isa fende.

sentences.english: And when they came across him on the other side of the sea they said, Rabbi, when did you come here?
sentences.susu: E to Isa li baa naakiri ma, e naxa a maxɔrin, «Karamɔxɔ, i faxi be mun tɛmui?»

sentences.english: Jesus, answering them, said, Truly I say to you, You come after me, not because you saw signs, but because you were given the bread and had enough.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «A nɔndi ki ma n xa a fala wo bɛ, wo mu n fenfe xɛ n to tɔnxuma makaabaxi raba wo ya xɔri. Wo n fenfe nɛ wo to lugaxi taami ra.

sentences.english: Let your work not be for the food which comes to an end, but for the food which goes on for eternal life, which the Son of man will give to you, for on him has God the Father put his mark.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wali duniɲa baloe xa fe ra, naxan bɔrɔma. Wo xa wali baloe nan ma fe ra naxan buma, a abadan kisi fi wo ma. Adama xa Di nan na baloe fima wo ma, barima Baba Ala bara a tan nan matɔnxuma a xa Mixi Sugandixi ra.»

sentences.english: Then they said to him, How may we do the works of God?
sentences.susu: Na kui, ɲama naxa Isa maxɔrin, «Muxu lanma muxu xa munse raba alako muxu xa nu kɛwalie raba Ala wama naxee xɔn?»

sentences.english: Jesus, answering, said to them, This is to do the work of God: to have faith in him whom God has sent.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Ala wama kɛwali naxan xɔn, a findixi yi nan na: Wo xa danxaniya a xa xɛɛra ma.»

sentences.english: So they said, What sign do you give us, so that we may see and have faith in you? What do you do?
sentences.susu: E man naxa a maxɔrin, «I tɔnxuma makaabaxi mundun nabama muxu ya xɔri alako muxu xa la i ra? I fa kɛwali mundun nabama?

sentences.english: Our fathers had the manna in the waste land, as the Writings say, He gave them bread from heaven.
sentences.susu: Muxu benbae taami nde don nɛ gbengberenyi ma naxan goro kelife koore ma. A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, ‹Ala naxa taami fi e ma baloe ra, naxan keli koore ma.›»

sentences.english: Jesus then said to them, Truly I say to you, What Moses gave you was not the bread from heaven; it is my Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a masen e bɛ, «N xa a masen wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, Annabi Munsa mu koore taami fi wo ma. N Baba nan koore taami yati fima wo ma.

sentences.english: The bread of God is the bread which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.
sentences.susu: Barima taami naxan fatanxi Ala ra, a tan nan goroma keli koore, a kisi fi duniɲa ma.»

sentences.english: Ah, Lord, they said, give us that bread for ever!
sentences.susu: Na kui, e naxa a fala a bɛ, «Marigi, muxu ki na taami ra tɛmui birin.»

sentences.english: And this was the answer of Jesus: I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will never be in need of food, and he who has faith in me will never be in need of drink.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «N tan nan na kisi taami ra. Naxan na fa n tan ma, a mu kaamɛ kolonma abadan. Naxan na danxaniya n tan ma, a mu ye xɔli kolonma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: But it is as I said to you: you have seen me, and still you have no faith.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ alɔ n a falaxi wo bɛ ki naxɛ, hali wo to bara n to, wo mu laxi n na.

sentences.english: Whatever the Father gives to me will come to me; and I will not send away anyone who comes to me.
sentences.susu: Baba Ala mixi naxan birin fima n ma, a fama nɛ n ma, n mu mɛɛma e ra abadan,

sentences.english: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my pleasure, but the pleasure of him who sent me.
sentences.susu: barima n kelixi koore ma n Xɛɛma waxɔnfe nan nabade. N mu faxi n yɛtɛ waxɔnfe xa rabade.

sentences.english: And this is the pleasure of him who sent me, that I am not to let out of my hands anything which he has given me, but I am to give it new life on the last day.
sentences.susu: N Xɛɛma wama nɛ n xa a xa mixi birin nakeli faxɛ ma lɔxɔ dɔnxɔɛ. A mixi naxee fixi n ma, hali keren naxa lɔɛ.

sentences.english: This, I say, is my Father's pleasure, that everyone who sees the Son and has faith in him may have eternal life: and I will take him up on the last day.
sentences.susu: Na nan findixi n Baba sagoe ra, a naxan yo na danxaniya a xa Di ma, na kanyi xa abadan kisi sɔtɔ, n man xa a rakeli faxɛ ma lɔxɔ dɔnxɔɛ ma.»

sentences.english: Now the Jews said bitter things about Jesus because of his words, I am the bread which came down from heaven.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Yuwifie naxa so a mafalafe, barima a nu bara a fala, «N tan nan na taami ra naxan goro keli koore.»

sentences.english: And they said, Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we have seen? How is it then that he now says, I have come down from heaven?
sentences.susu: E nu a falama nɛ, e naxɛ, «Isa xa mu yi ki, Yusufu xa di? Won mu a nga nun a baba kolon? A fa a falama di, a a goroxi nɛ keli koore?»

sentences.english: Jesus made answer and said, Do not say things against me, one to another.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Wo ba wɔyɛnfe wo bore tagi na mɔɔli ra.

sentences.english: No man is able to come to me if the Father who sent me does not give him the desire to come: and I will take him up from the dead on the last day.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu nɔma fade n ma, xa Baba Ala, naxan n xɛɛxi, mu a kanyi mabɛndun n ma. N fan fama a kanyi rakelide faxɛ ma lɔxɔ dɔnxɔɛ.

sentences.english: The writings of the prophets say, And they will all have teaching from God. Everyone whose ears have been open to the teaching of the Father comes to me.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi namiɲɔnmɛe xa Kitaabui kui, ‹Ala fama nɛ e birin xarande.› Naxan yo na Baba Ala xui ramɛ, a a xa masenyi suxu, na kanyi tan fama nɛ n ma.

sentences.english: Not that anyone has ever seen the Father; only he who is from God, he has seen the Father.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu na naxan bara Baba Ala to, bafe mixi ra naxan fatanxi Ala ra. Na keren nan bara Baba Ala to.»

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, He who has faith in me has eternal life.
sentences.susu: «N xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, naxan na danxaniya n ma, a bara abadan kisi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: I am the bread of life.
sentences.susu: N tan nan na kisi taami ra.

sentences.english: Your fathers took the manna in the waste land — and they are dead.
sentences.susu: Wo benbae taami don nɛ gbengberenyi ma, kɔnɔ e birin naxa faxa.

sentences.english: The bread which comes from heaven is such bread that a man may take it for food and never see death.
sentences.susu: Taami naxan goroxi keli koore, a na be. Naxan yo na yi tan don, na kanyi mu faxama.

sentences.english: I am the living bread which has come from heaven: if any man takes this bread for food he will have life for ever: and more than this, the bread which I will give is my flesh which I will give for the life of the world.
sentences.susu: N tan nan na na kisi taami ra naxan goroxi keli koore. Naxan yo na yi taami tan don, a kisima nɛ abadan. Yi taami findixi n fate nan na, n naxan fima sɛrɛxɛ ra alako duniɲa xa kisi sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: Then the Jews had an angry discussion among themselves, saying, How is it possible for this man to give us his flesh for food?
sentences.susu: Na kui, sɔnxɔɛ naxa mini Yuwifie tagi, e nu a fala, «Pe, yi xɛmɛ nɔma a fate sube sode won yi ra di, won xa a don?»

sentences.english: Then Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you, If you do not take the flesh of the Son of man for food, and if you do not take his blood for drink, you have no life in you.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «N xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, xa wo mu Adama xa Di fate sube don, xa wo mu a wuli min, kisi mu wo bɛ.

sentences.english: He who takes my flesh for food and my blood for drink has eternal life: and I will take him up from the dead at the last day.
sentences.susu: Naxan n sube donma, a n wuli min, na kanyi kisima nɛ abadan, n a rakelima nɛ faxɛ ma lɔxɔ dɔnxɔɛ.

sentences.english: My flesh is true food and my blood is true drink.
sentences.susu: N fate nan findixi baloe yati ra. N wuli nan findixi minse yati ra.

sentences.english: He who takes my flesh for food and my blood for drink is in me and I in him.
sentences.susu: Naxan n sube donma, a n wuli min, n bara sabati na kanyi i, a fan bara sabati n fan i.

sentences.english: As the living Father has sent me, and I have life because of the Father, even so he who takes me for his food will have life because of me.
sentences.susu: Baba Ala to n xɛɛxi, kisi fatanma naxan na, kisi na n fan yi a tan saabui ra. Na mɔɔli man na, naxan baloma n tan ma, na kanyi kisima n saabui ra.

sentences.english: This is the bread which has come down from heaven. It is not like the food which your fathers had: they took of the manna, and are dead; but he who takes this bread for food will have life for ever.
sentences.susu: Taami naxan goroxi keli koore, a na be. A mu luxi alɔ wo benbae taami naxan don. E tan faxa nɛ. Naxan yi taami tan donma, na kanyi kisima nɛ abadan.»

sentences.english: Jesus said these things in the Synagogue while he was teaching at Capernaum.
sentences.susu: Isa yi masenyi ti nɛ a nu mixie kawandima tɛmui naxɛ Kapɛrɛnamu salide kui.

sentences.english: Then, hearing this, a number of his disciples said, This is a hard saying; who is able to take in such teaching?
sentences.susu: E to a xa masenyi mɛ, a fɔxirabirɛ wuyaxi naxa a fala, «Yi masenyi tan xɔrɔxɔ de! Nde nɔma tinde a ra?»

sentences.english: When Jesus became conscious that his disciples were protesting about what he said, he said to them, Does this give you trouble?
sentences.susu: Isa to a kolon a a fɔxirabirɛe na yi wɔyɛnyi falafe e bore tagi, a naxa e maxɔrin, «N ma masenyi bara wo raxɔnɔ?

sentences.english: What then will you say if you see the Son of man going up to where he was before?
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li go, wo sa Adama xa Di to te ra koore ma, a kelixi dɛnnaxɛ?

sentences.english: The spirit is the life giver; the flesh is of no value: the words which I have said to you are spirit and they are life.
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nan kisi fima mixi ma. Fate bɛndɛ tan mu nɔma sese ra. N masenyi naxan tixi wo bɛ, a Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nun kisi sɔtɔ ki nan masenma.

sentences.english: But still some of you have no faith. For it was clear to Jesus from the first who they were who had no faith, and who it was who would be false to him.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi ndee na wo ya ma, naxee mu danxaniyaxi.» Isa na fala nɛ barima kabi a fɔlɛ, a nu a kolon naxee mu danxaniyaxi, a nun naxan fama a yanfade, a a sa kuntigie bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And he said, This is why I said to you, No man is able to come to me if he is not given the power to do so by the Father.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a masen, «Na nan a ra, n a falaxi nɛ wo bɛ, a mixi yo mu nɔma fade n xɔn ma, xa Baba Ala mu na danxaniya fi a ma.»

sentences.english: Because of what he said, a number of the disciples went back and would no longer go with him.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, a fɔxirabirɛ gbegbe naxa ɲanige masara, e gbilen a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: So Jesus said to the twelve, Have you a desire to go away?
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa naxa a fɔxirabirɛ fu nun firinyie maxɔrin, «Wo tan go? Wo fan wama kelife n xun ma?»

sentences.english: Then Simon Peter gave this answer: Lord, to whom are we to go? you have the words of eternal life;
sentences.susu: Simɔn Piyɛri naxa a yaabi, «Marigi, xa muxu gbilen i fɔxɔ ra, muxu fa sigama nde xɔn ma? Abadan kisi masenyi na i tan nan yi.

sentences.english: And we have faith and are certain that you are the Holy One of God.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara la a ra, muxu man bara gɛ a kolonde, a i tan nan na Ala xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Then Jesus said, Did I not make a selection of you, the twelve, and one of you is a son of the Evil One?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «N tan xa mu wo sugandi, wo tan mixi fu nun firinyie? Kɔnɔ mixi keren na wo ya ma, adama sentanɛ nan a ra.»

sentences.english: He was talking of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot. It was he who was to be false to Jesus — one of the twelve.
sentences.susu: A nu Simɔn Isikariyoti xa di Yudasi nan ma, naxan nu na a fɔxirabirɛ fu nun firinyie ya ma. A tan nan nu fama a yanfade, a a sa kuntigie bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: After this, Jesus went from place to place in Galilee. He did not go about in Judaea, because the Jews were looking for a chance to put him to death.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Isa naxa Galile bɔxi isa fɔlɔ. A mu nu Yudaya tan iɲɛrɛma, barima Yuwifi kuntigie nu katafe nɛ e xa a faxa.

sentences.english: But the feast of the Jews, the feast of tents, was near.
sentences.susu: Yuwifie xa Bage Ti Sali to nu bara makɔrɛ,

sentences.english: So his brothers said to him, Go away from here into Judaea so that your disciples may see the works which you do.
sentences.susu: Isa xunyae naxa a fala a bɛ, «A lan nɛ i xa keli yi bɔxi ma, i siga Yudaya, alako i fɔxirabirɛe naxee sa na naa, e fan xa i xa walie to, i naxee rabama.

sentences.english: Because no man does things secretly if he has a desire that men may have knowledge of him. If you do these things, let yourself be seen by all men.
sentences.susu: Mixi mu a xa wali nɔxunma xa a wama duniɲa xa a kolon. I to yi tɔnxumae rabama, a lanma i xa e raba kɛnɛ ma.»

sentences.english: For even his brothers had no belief in him.
sentences.susu: E na fala nɛ, barima hali e to findixi a xunyae ra, e mu nu laxi a ra.

sentences.english: Jesus said to them, My time is still to come, but any time is good for you.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «N ma waxati mu nu a li sinden, kɔnɔ waxati yo mu na wo tan xa fe ma.

sentences.english: It is not possible for you to be hated by the world; but I am hated by it, because I give witness that what it does is evil.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa mu nɔma wo tan xɔnde, kɔnɔ e n tan xɔnma, barima n seedeɲɔxɔya bama e xa fe ra, a e xa walie kobi.

sentences.english: Go you up to the feast: I am not going up now to the feast because my time has not fully come.
sentences.susu: Wo tan xa te Darisalamu, wo sa sali raba naa. N tan mu sigama, barima n ma waxati mu gɛxi a lide sinden.»

sentences.english: Having said these things to them, he still kept in Galilee.
sentences.susu: A na fala xanbi, a naxa lu Galile.

sentences.english: But after his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he went up, not publicly, but in secret.
sentences.susu: A xunyae to te sali rabade Darisalamu, Isa fan naxa siga, kɔnɔ a gundo ki ma.

sentences.english: At the feast the Jews were looking for him and saying, Where is he?
sentences.susu: Sali to nu rabafe, Yuwifi kuntigie nu a fenfe Darisalamu, e nu maxɔrinyi ti, «A na minden?»

sentences.english: And there was much discussion about him among the mass of the people. Some said, He is a good man; but others said, No, he is giving people false ideas.
sentences.susu: Mixie nu wɔyɛn gbegbe makɔyikɔyima e bore tuli Isa xa fe ra. Ndee a falama a mixi fanyi nan a ra, ndee a falama a a na ɲama ratantanfe nan tui.

sentences.english: But no man said anything about him openly for fear of the Jews.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e to nu gaaxuxi Yuwifi kuntigie ya ra, mixi yo mu nu suusama a xa fe falade kɛnɛ ma.

sentences.english: Now in the middle of the feast Jesus went up to the Temple and was teaching.
sentences.susu: Yuwifie nu sali naxan nabafe, lɔxun keren na a ra. Na to nu bara siga han a tagi, Isa naxa te hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, a kawandi ti fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: Then the Jews were surprised and said, How has this man got knowledge of books? He has never been to school.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi kuntigie naxa kaaba, e nu a fala, «Yi xɛmɛ lɔnnixi yi mɔɔli ra di, a to mu xaranxi?»

sentences.english: Jesus gave them this answer: It is not my teaching, but his who sent me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «N kawandi naxan tima, a mu kelixi n tan xa ma. A kelixi n Xɛɛma nan ma.

sentences.english: If any man is ready to do God's pleasure he will have knowledge of the teaching and of where it comes from — from God or from myself.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan wama Ala waxɔnfe rabafe, a nɔma nɛ a kolonde xa yi xaranyi fatanxi Ala nan na. Xa n gbe gbansan na a ra, mixie a kolonma nɛ nu.

sentences.english: The man whose words come from himself is looking for glory for himself, but he who is looking for the glory of him who sent him — that man is true and there is no evil in him.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan wɔyɛnma a yɛtɛ xaxili ma, a matɔxɔɛ fenfe a yɛtɛ nan bɛ. Kɔnɔ naxan matɔxɔɛ fenfe a Xɛɛma bɛ, nɔndi falɛ nan na kanyi ra, tinxintareya yo mu naxan bɔɲɛ ma.

sentences.english: Did not Moses give you the law? Even so, not one of you keeps the law. Why have you a desire to put me to death?
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa yati nan Ala xa sɛriyɛ soxi wo yi ra, kɔnɔ wo mu a ratinmɛxi. Munfe ra wo wama n faxafe?»

sentences.english: The people said in answer, You have an evil spirit: who has any desire to put you to death?
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa a fala, «Ɲinnɛ nan na i fɔxɔ ra! Nde katafe i faxade?»

sentences.english: This was the answer of Jesus: I have done one work and you are all surprised at it.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «N kaabanako keren nan naba, a fa wo birin dɛ ixara.

sentences.english: Moses gave you circumcision — not that it comes from Moses, but from the fathers — and even on the Sabbath you give a child circumcision.
sentences.susu: Munsa a benbae xa sɛriyɛ falaxi nɛ wo bɛ a wo xa wo xa di xɛmɛe sunna. Wo na rabama hali malabu lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: If a child is given circumcision on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses may not be broken, why are you angry with me because I made a man completely well on the Sabbath?
sentences.susu: Xa xɛmɛ sunnama malabu lɔxɔɛ alako Annabi Munsa xa sɛriyɛ naxa fa kana, wo xɔnɔma n tan ma munfe ra, n to furema fate birin nayalan malabu lɔxɔɛ ma?

sentences.english: Let not your decisions be based on what you see, but on righteousness.
sentences.susu: Wo xa fee kui mato a fanyi ra beenun wo xa kiiti sa. Kiiti xa tinxin.»

sentences.english: Then some of the people of Jerusalem said, Is not this the man whose death is desired?
sentences.susu: Darisalamuka ndee nu a falafe, «Kuntigie mu na katafe yi xa faxade?

sentences.english: And here he is talking openly and they say nothing to him! Is it possible that the rulers have knowledge that this is truly the Christ?
sentences.susu: A mato, a tan nan wɔyɛnfe kɛnɛ ma yi ki, kɔnɔ e mu sese falama a bɛ! Ka e bara la a ra, a Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi na a ra?

sentences.english: However, it is clear to us where this man comes from: but when the Christ comes no one will have knowledge where he comes from.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ won birin Isa baride kolon. Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi tan na fa, a baride mu kolonma.»

sentences.english: Then, when he was teaching in the Temple, Jesus said with a loud voice, You have knowledge of me and you have knowledge of where I come from; and I have not come of myself; but there is One who has sent me; he is true, but you have no knowledge of him.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa naxa kawandi ti a xui itexi ra hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, «Wo n kolon, wo n kelide fan kolon? Kɔnɔ n tan mu faxi n yɛtɛ kan ɲanige xa ma. Nɔndi Kanyi nan n xɛɛxi, kɔnɔ wo tan mu a kolon.

sentences.english: I have knowledge of him because I came from him and he sent me.
sentences.susu: N tan a kolon, barima n fatanxi a tan nan na. A tan nan n xɛɛxi.»

sentences.english: Then they had a desire to take him: but no man put hands on him because his hour was still to come.
sentences.susu: Na kui, e naxa kata a suxude, kɔnɔ e mu nɔ, barima a xa waxati mu nu a lixi sinden.

sentences.english: And numbers of the people had belief in him, and they said, When the Christ comes will he do more signs than this man has done?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ ɲama ya ma mixi gbegbe naxa danxaniya Isa ma, e nu a fala, «Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi na fa, a tɔnxuma makaabaxie rabama dangi yi xɛmɛ ra?»

sentences.english: This discussion of the people came to the ears of the Pharisees; and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent servants to take him.
sentences.susu: Farisɛnie to a mɛ, ɲama nu naxan makɔyikɔyife Isa xa fe ra, e tan nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie naxa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kɔsibilie xɛɛ, e xa sa Isa suxu.

sentences.english: Then Jesus said, I will be with you a little longer and then I go to him who sent me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen, «N na wo ya ma sinden dondoronti, n fa siga n Xɛɛma yire.

sentences.english: You will be looking for me, and you will not see me: and where I am you may not come.
sentences.susu: Wo fama nɛ n fende, kɔnɔ wo mu n toma. N sa luma dɛnnaxɛ, wo mu nɔma naa lide.»

sentences.english: So the Jews said among themselves, To what place is he going where we will not see him? will he go to the Jews living among the Greeks and become the teacher of the Greeks?
sentences.susu: Yuwifi kuntigie naxa e bore maxɔrin, «Yi wama sigafe minden, won mu sa nɔma a tode dɛnnaxɛ? Ka a waxi nɛ a xa sa sabati ɲamanɛ gbɛtɛ alɔ muxu xa mixi ndee, alako a xa sa si gbɛtɛe xaran?

sentences.english: What is this saying of his, You will be looking for me and will not see me, and where I am you may not come?
sentences.susu: A to a masenxi a muxu fama a fende kɔnɔ muxu mu a toma, a a sa luma dɛnnaxɛ, muxu mu nɔma naa lide, a waxi munse falafe?»

sentences.english: On the last day, the great day of the feast, Jesus got up and said in a loud voice, If any man is in need of drink let him come to me and I will give it to him.
sentences.susu: Na sali waxati lɔxɔ dɔnxɔɛ ma, naxan tide gbo boore birin bɛ, Isa naxa keli, a a masen a xui itexi ra, «Ye xɔli na naxan yo ma, a xa fa n xɔn, a xa a min.

sentences.english: He who has faith in me, out of his body, as the Writings have said, will come rivers of living water.
sentences.susu: Alɔ Kitaabui a masenxi ki naxɛ, naxan yo na danxaniya n ma, kisi ye bulama nɛ a bɔɲɛ kui, alɔ xure naxan susuma.»

sentences.english: This he said of the Spirit which would be given to those who had faith in him: the Spirit had not been given then, because the glory of Jesus was still to come.
sentences.susu: A nu na Ala Xaxili nan ma fe masenfe, a xa danxaniyatɔɛe nu fama naxan sɔtɔde. Na waxati, Ala Xaxili mu nu faxi sinden, barima Isa xa xunnakeli mu nu makɛnɛnxi sinden.

sentences.english: When these words came to their ears, some of the people said, This is certainly the prophet.
sentences.susu: Ɲama to a xa masenyi mɛ, ndee naxa a fala, «Muxu nu namiɲɔnmɛ naxan mamɛxi a xa fa, a tan nan yati yi ki!»

sentences.english: Others said, This is the Christ. But others said, Not so; will the Christ come from Galilee?
sentences.susu: Gbɛtɛ fan naxa a fala, «Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan na yi ra!» Kɔnɔ ndee fan naxa a fala, «Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi findima Galileka ra?

sentences.english: Do not the Writings say that the Christ comes of the seed of David and from Beth-lehem, the little town where David was?
sentences.susu: Kitaabui mu a masenxi xɛ, a Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi kelima Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ nɛ, a keli Bɛtɛlɛɛmu, Dawuda xɔnyi?»

sentences.english: So there was a division among the people because of him.
sentences.susu: Na kui, ɲama mu nu lanxi Isa xa fe ma.

sentences.english: And some of them had a desire to take him; but no man put hands on him.
sentences.susu: Ndee nu wama a suxufe, kɔnɔ mixi yo mu nɔ.

sentences.english: Then the servants went back to the chief priests and Pharisees, who said to them, Why have you not got him with you?
sentences.susu: Na kui, kɔsibilie naxa gbilen sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun Farisɛnie yire. Na kuntigie naxa e maxɔrin, «Munfe ra wo mu faxi a ra be?»

sentences.english: The servants made answer, No man ever said things like this man.
sentences.susu: Kɔsibilie naxa e yaabi, «A xa masenyi dangi adamadie xa masenyi birin na.»

sentences.english: Then the Pharisees said to them, Have you, like the others, been given false ideas?
sentences.susu: Farisɛnie fan naxa e yaabi, «Pe, a bara wo fan madaxu?

sentences.english: Have any of the rulers belief in him, or any one of the Pharisees?
sentences.susu: Mixi keren na kuntigie xa na mu Farisɛnie ya ma naxan laxi a ra?

sentences.english: But these people who have no knowledge of the law are cursed.
sentences.susu: Yi ɲama tan mu sɛriyɛ Kitaabui kolon. Mixi dankaxie nan e ra.»

sentences.english: Nicodemus — he who had come to Jesus before, being himself one of them — said to them,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Nikodemu, naxan nu bara siga Isa yire, a naxa a fala a boore kuntigie bɛ,

sentences.english: Is a man judged by our law before it has given him a hearing and has knowledge of what he has done?
sentences.susu: «Won ma sɛriyɛ ki ma, mixi nɛ makiitima, a mu maxɔrinma xɛ alako a xa kolon sinden a fe naxan nabaxi?»

sentences.english: This was their answer: And do you come from Galilee? Make search and you will see that no prophet comes out of Galilee.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Galileka nan na i fan na? A mato Kitaabui kui, namiɲɔnmɛ yo mu kelima Galile bɔxi!»

sentences.english: [And every man went to his house;
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, kankan naxa siga a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: But Jesus went to the Mountain of Olives.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa siga Oliwi geya ma.

sentences.english: And early in the morning he came again into the Temple and all the people came to him and he was seated teaching them.
sentences.susu: Kuye to iba, a naxa siga hɔrɔmɔbanxi. Ɲama to fa a yire, a naxa dɔxɔ, a so e kawandife.

sentences.english: Now the scribes and Pharisees came, with a woman who had been taken in the act of sinning against the married relation;
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe nun Farisɛnie fan naxa fa ginɛ nde ra, e naxan suxuxi a na yɛnɛ rabafe. E naxa a ti mixi birin ya i,

sentences.english: And putting her forward, they said to him, Master, this woman has been taken in the very act of sinning against the married relation.
sentences.susu: e a fala Isa bɛ, «Karamɔxɔ, muxu yi ginɛ suxuxi yɛnɛ nan xun.

sentences.english: Now in the law Moses gave directions that such women were to be stoned; what do you say about it?
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ ki ma, Annabi Munsa muxu yamarixi nɛ muxu xa yi ginɛ mɔɔli magɔnɔ gɛmɛ ra han a faxa. I tan a toxi di?»

sentences.english: They said this, testing him, so that they might have something against him. But Jesus, with his head bent down, made letters on the floor with his finger.
sentences.susu: E nu na gantanyi nan tefe a bɛ na maxɔrinyi ra, a xa fe nde fala, e nɔma a kalamude naxan ma. Isa naxa a igoro, a nu fa sɛbɛli ti bɔxi ma a bɛlɛxɛsole ra.

sentences.english: But when they went on with their questions, he got up and said to them, Let him among you who is without sin be the first to send a stone at her.
sentences.susu: E to dɔxɔ a ra, a naxa keli, a a fala e bɛ, «Yunubi mu na naxan ma wo ya ma, na singe xa yi ginɛ gɔnɔ.»

sentences.english: And again, with bent head, he made letters on the floor.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a igoro, a nu fa sɛbɛli ti bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And when his words came to their ears, they went out one by one, starting with the oldest even to the last, because they were conscious of what was in their hearts: and Jesus was there by himself with the woman before him.
sentences.susu: E to a xa wɔyɛnyi mɛ, e birin naxa siga keren keren, fɔlɔfe forie ma. Ginɛ gbansan to lu Isa ya i,

sentences.english: Then Jesus got up, and seeing nobody but the woman, he said to her, Where are the men who said things against you? did no one give a decision against you?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa keli, a ginɛ maxɔrin, «Naxee fa i ra, e na minden? Mixi yo mu lu naxan i makiitima?»

sentences.english: And she said, No man, Lord. And Jesus said, And I do not give a decision against you: go, and never do wrong again.]
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a yaabi, «N marigi, mixi yo mu lu.» Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «Awa, n fan mu i makiitima. Siga, i naxa yunubi raba sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: Then again Jesus said to them, I am the light of the world; he who comes with me will not be walking in the dark but will have the light of life.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa wɔyɛnyi tongo, a a masen ɲama bɛ, «N tan nan na duniɲa naiyalanyi ra. Naxan na bira n fɔxɔ ra, a mu ɲɛrɛma dimi kui muku. Kisi naiyalanyi nan yanbama na kanyi bɛ.»

sentences.english: So the Pharisees said to him, The witness you give is about yourself: your witness is not true.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Farisɛnie naxa a fala a bɛ, «I na i yɛtɛ kan nan seede bafe. I xa seedeɲɔxɔya mu findixi nɔndi ra.»

sentences.english: Jesus said in answer, Even if I give witness about myself, my witness is true, because I have knowledge of where I came from and where I am going; but you have no knowledge of where I come from or of where I am going.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Hali n seede ba n yɛtɛ bɛ, n ma seedeɲɔxɔya findixi nɔndi nan na, barima n a kolon n kelixi dɛnnaxɛ, n man a kolon n sigafe dɛnnaxɛ. Kɔnɔ wo tan mu n kelide kolon, wo mu n sigade fan kolon.

sentences.english: You are judging from what you see; I am judging no man.
sentences.susu: Wo tan mixi makiitima adama xaxili nan na. N tan mu mixi yo makiitima.

sentences.english: Even if I am judging, my decision is right, because I am not by myself — with me is the Father who sent me.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa n sa mixi makiitima, n ma kiiti findima nɔndi nan na, barima n keren xa mu a ra. N tan nun Baba Ala nan a ra, a tan naxan n xɛɛxi.

sentences.english: Even in your law it is said that the witness of two men is true.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi wo xa sɛriyɛ Kitaabui kui, a xa mixi firin xa seedeɲɔxɔya baxi lan e bore ma, na xa suxu nɔndi ra.

sentences.english: I give witness about myself and the Father who sent me gives witness about me.
sentences.susu: N tan nan na n yɛtɛ seede ra. Baba Ala fan, a tan naxan n xɛɛxi, a fan seedeɲɔxɔya bama n ma fe ra.»

sentences.english: Then they said to him, Where is your Father? Jesus said in answer, You have no knowledge of me or of my Father: if you had knowledge of me you would have knowledge of my Father.
sentences.susu: E naxa Isa maxɔrin, «I baba na minden?» A naxa e yaabi, «Wo mu n kolon, wo mu n Baba fan kolon. Xa wo n kolon nɛ nu, wo n Baba fan kolonma nɛ nu.»

sentences.english: Jesus said these words in the place where the offerings were stored, while he was teaching in the Temple: but no man took him because his time was still to come.
sentences.susu: Isa yi masenyi ti hɔrɔmɔbanxi, hadiya sase yire nɛ, kɔnɔ mixi yo mu a suxu, barima a xa waxati mu nu a lixi sinden.

sentences.english: Then he said to them again, I am going away and you will be looking for me, but death will overtake you in your sins. It is not possible for you to come where I am going.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a masen e bɛ, «N fama nɛ sigade. Wo n fenma nɛ, kɔnɔ wo lɔɛma nɛ wo xa yunubie xa fe ra. N sigama dɛnnaxɛ, wo tan mu nɔma sigade naa.»

sentences.english: So the Jews said, Will he take his life? Is that why he says, Where I go it is not possible for you to come?
sentences.susu: Yuwifi kuntigie naxa a fala e bore tagi, «Pe, a to a falama, a a sigama dɛnnaxɛ, won tan mu nɔma sigade naa, a waxi a yɛtɛ nan faxafe ba?»

sentences.english: And he said to them, You are of the earth; I am from heaven: you are of this world; I am not of this world.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Duniɲa mixie nan na wo ra. Kɔnɔ n tan kelixi koore nɛ. Wo xɔnyi findixi yi duniɲa nan na, kɔnɔ n tan xɔnyi mu a ra.

sentences.english: For this reason I said to you that death will overtake you in your sins: for if you have not faith that I am he, death will come to you while you are in your sins.
sentences.susu: N a falaxi wo bɛ na nan ma, a wo lɔɛma nɛ wo xa yunubie xa fe ra. Xa wo mu la a ra, a n tan nan na naxan na abadan, wo faxama nɛ wo xa yunubie na wo ma.»

sentences.english: Then they said to him, Who are you? Jesus said, What I said to you from the first.
sentences.susu: E naxa a maxɔrin, «I findixi nde ra?» Isa naxa e yaabi, «Kabi a fɔlɛ, n na falama wo bɛ.

sentences.english: I have much to say about you and against you: but he who sent me is true and what he has said to me I say to the world.
sentences.susu: Marakɔrɔsi gbegbe nan n yi ra wo tan mabiri, naxan findima kiiti xɔrɔxɔɛ ra wo bɛ. Nɔndi falɛ nan n Xɛɛma ra. N naxan mɛxi a ra, n na nan falama duniɲa bɛ.»

sentences.english: They did not see that his words were about the Father.
sentences.susu: E mu a fahaamu a Isa nu wɔyɛnfe e bɛ Baba Ala nan ma fe ra.

sentences.english: So Jesus said, When the Son of man has been lifted up by you, then it will be clear to you who I am, and that I do nothing of myself, but say as the Father gave me teaching.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Wo na Adama xa Di rate wuri kɔn na tɛmui naxɛ, wo a kolonma nɛ, a n tan nan na naxan na abadan, n man mu fefe rabama n yɛtɛ ra, n mu fefe falama fo n Baba na naxan masen n bɛ.

sentences.english: He who sent me is with me; he has not gone from me, because at all times I do the things which are pleasing to him.
sentences.susu: N tan nun n Xɛɛma nan a ra. A mu n nabɛɲinxi, barima n a waxɔnfe nan nabama tɛmui birin.»

sentences.english: When he said this a number came to have faith in him.
sentences.susu: Isa to nu yi fee masenma, mixi gbegbe naxa danxaniya a ma.

sentences.english: Then Jesus said to the Jews who had faith in him, If you keep my word, then you are truly my disciples;
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa naxa a masen Yuwifie bɛ naxee nu bara danxaniya a ma, «Xa wo lu n xui rabatu ra, wo findixi n fɔxirabirɛe yati nan na.

sentences.english: And you will have knowledge of what is true, and that will make you free.
sentences.susu: Wo na nɔndi kolon, a wo xɔrɛyama nɛ.»

sentences.english: They said to him in answer, We are Abraham's seed and have never been any man's servant: why do you say, You will become free?
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Annabi Iburahima bɔnsɔɛ nan na muxu ra. Han to, muxu tan mu nu findi mixi yo xa konyie ra! Munfe ra i a falaxi a muxu xɔrɛyama nɛ?»

sentences.english: And this was the answer Jesus gave them: Truly I say to you, Everyone who does evil is the servant of sin.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala e bɛ, «N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, mixi naxan yunubi rabama a bara lu yunubi xa konyiya kui.

sentences.english: Now the servant does not go on living in the house for ever, but the son does.
sentences.susu: Mixi xa konyi mu luma fɔxɔɛ ra abadan. Kɔnɔ mixi xa di tan, a xɔnyi nan na fɔxɔɛ ra abadan.

sentences.english: If then the son makes you free, you will be truly free.
sentences.susu: Na kui, xa Ala xa Di wo xɔrɛya, a lima wo xɔrɛya nan yati sɔtɔxi.»

sentences.english: I am conscious that you are Abraham's seed; but you have a desire to put me to death because my word has no place in you.
sentences.susu: «N a kolon tan, a Iburahima bɔnsɔɛ nan na wo ra, kɔnɔ wo katafe n faxade nɛ wo to tondixi n ma masenyi ra.

sentences.english: I say the things which I have seen in my Father's house: and you do the things which come to you from your father's house.
sentences.susu: N tan bara naxan to Baba Ala ra, n na nan falama. Wo fan bara naxan mɛ wo baba ra, wo na nan nabama.»

sentences.english: In answer they said to him, Our father is Abraham. Jesus said to them, If you were Abraham's children you would do what Abraham did.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Annabi Iburahima nan na muxu baba ra.» Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Xa Iburahima xa die nan yati wo ra nu, wo luma Iburahima fɔxi nan naba ra nu.

sentences.english: But now you have a desire to put me to death, a man who has said to you what is true, as I had it from God: Abraham did not do that.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan na katafe n faxade, n tan naxan nɔndi falama wo bɛ n naxan mɛxi Ala ra. Iburahima wali ki mu lanxi na ma.

sentences.english: You are doing the works of your father. They said to him, We are true sons of Abraham; we have one Father, who is God.
sentences.susu: Wo na wo baba nan fɔxi rabafe.» E naxa a fala a bɛ, «Yɛnɛ die xa mu na muxu tan na de! Ala keren nan na muxu Baba ra.»

sentences.english: Jesus said to them, If God was your Father you would have love for me, because it was from God I came and am here. I did not come of myself, but he sent me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Xa Ala nan wo Baba ra nu, wo n xanuma nɛ nu, barima n to na wo ya ma be, n kelixi Ala nan ma. N mu faxi n yɛtɛ xa ra, a tan nan n xɛɛxi.

sentences.english: Why are my words not clear to you? It is because your ears are shut to my teaching.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra wo mu n xui fahaamuma? Wo mu nɔxi n ma masenyi ramɛde.

sentences.english: You are the children of your father the Evil One and it is your pleasure to do his desires. From the first he was a taker of life; and he did not go in the true way because there is no true thing in him. When he says what is false, it is natural to him, for he is false and the father of what is false.
sentences.susu: Wo tan baba findixi Ibulisa nan na, a xɔli man wo ma wo xa a tan nan sago raba. Kabi a fɔlɛ, faxɛti nan a ra. A mu tinma nɔndi ra, barima nɔndi yo mu na a xa fe kui. A to wule falama, a a yɛtɛ xui nan yati falafe, barima wule falɛ nan a ra naxan findixi wule birin baba ra.

sentences.english: But because I say what is true, you have no belief in me.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n tan to nɔndi nan falama, wo mu lama n na.

sentences.english: Which of you is able truly to say that I am a sinner? If I say what is true, why have you no belief in me?
sentences.susu: Nde nɔma n kalamude yunubi ma? Xa n nɔndi nan falama, munfe ra wo mu laxi n na?

sentences.english: He who is a child of God gives ear to the words of God: your ears are not open to them because you are not from God.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan kelixi Ala ma, na Ala xui mɛma. Na kui, wo tan mu a mɛma barima wo mu kelixi Ala ma.»

sentences.english: The Jews said to him in answer, Are we not right in saying that you are of Samaria and have an evil spirit?
sentences.susu: Yuwifi kuntigie naxa a fala, «Nɔndi na muxu bɛ. Samarika ɲinnɛ kanyi nan i tan na.»

sentences.english: And this was the answer of Jesus: I have not an evil spirit; but I give honour to my Father and you do not give honour to me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Ɲinnɛ mu n tan fɔxɔ ra. N tan n Baba nan binyama, kɔnɔ wo tan n yelebuma.

sentences.english: I, however, am not in search of glory for myself: there is One who is searching for it and he is judge.
sentences.susu: N mu n yɛtɛ igboma. Ala nan n ma fe itema. Kiiti birin na a tan nan yi ra.

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, If a man keeps my word he will never see death.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, xa naxan yo n xui suxu, na kanyi mu saya kolonma abadan.»

sentences.english: The Jews said to him, Now we are certain that you have an evil spirit. Abraham is dead, and the prophets are dead; and you say, If a man keeps my word he will never see death.
sentences.susu: Yuwifie naxa a fala a bɛ, «Muxu bara gɛ a kolonde fa a ɲinnɛ nan na i fɔxɔ ra. Iburahima nun namiɲɔnmɛe birin laaxira nɛ, kɔnɔ i tan naxɛ, ‹Xa naxan yo n xui suxu, a kanyi mu saya kolonma abadan.›

sentences.english: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who is dead? and the prophets are dead: who do you say that you are?
sentences.susu: Pe, muxu benba Iburahima to fa laaxira nɛ, i tan dangi a ra? Namiɲɔnmɛe fan laaxira nɛ. I tan fa i yɛtɛ findixi nde ra?»

sentences.english: Jesus said in answer, If I take glory for myself, my glory is nothing: it is my Father who gives me glory, of whom you say that he is your God.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Xa n tan nan n yɛtɛ matɔxɔma, matɔxɔɛ fufafu nan na ki. N Baba nan n ma fe itexi, wo naxan ma, a wo Marigi Ala!

sentences.english: You have no knowledge of him, but I have knowledge of him; and if I said I have no knowledge of him I would be talking falsely like you: but I have full knowledge of him, and I keep his word.
sentences.susu: Wo mu a tan Ala kolon, kɔnɔ n tan a kolon. Xa n a fala, a n mu a kolon, n bara findi wule falɛ ra, alɔ wo tan. N tan Ala kolon, n man a xa masenyi rabatuma.

sentences.english: Your father Abraham was full of joy at the hope of seeing my day: he saw it and was glad.
sentences.susu: Wo benba Iburahima sɛɛwa nɛ n fa lɔxɔɛ tofe ra. A a to nɛ yati, a ɲɛlɛxin.»

sentences.english: Then the Jews said to him, You are not fifty years old; have you seen Abraham?
sentences.susu: Yuwifi kuntigie naxa a yaabi, «Hali ɲɛ tongo suuli, i mu nu a sɔtɔ sinden. Munse a niyaxi i xa a fala a i tan bara Iburahima to?»

sentences.english: Jesus said to them, Truly I say to you, Before Abraham came into being, I am.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «N xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, beenun Iburahima xa bari, n tan na.»

sentences.english: So they took up stones to send at him: but Jesus got secretly out of their way and went out of the Temple.
sentences.susu: E naxa gɛmɛe tongo keren na, e xa a magɔnɔ na masenyi xa fe ra, kɔnɔ Isa naxa a nɔxun, a mini hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: And when he went on his way, he saw a man blind from birth.
sentences.susu: Isa to nu kira xɔn, a naxa dɔnxui nde to naxan barixi dɔnxuya kui.

sentences.english: And his disciples put a question to him, saying, Master, was it because of this man's sin, or the sin of his father and mother, that he has been blind from birth?
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛe naxa a maxɔrin, «Karamɔxɔ, nde xa yunubi a niyaxi yi xɛmɛ xa bari a dɔnxuxi, a tan ka a barimixie?»

sentences.english: Jesus said in answer, It was not because of his sin, or because of his father's or mother's; it was so that the works of God might be seen openly in him.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «A xa yunubi mu a ra, a barimixie fan gbe mu a ra. A rabaxi nɛ alako Ala xa wali xa makɛnɛn a xa fe kui.

sentences.english: While it is day we have to do the works of him who sent me: the night comes when no work may be done.
sentences.susu: Fanni kuye ibaxi, fo won xa n Xɛɛma xa wali raba, barima kɔɛ na fafe. A na so, mixi mu nɔma walide sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
sentences.susu: N to na duniɲa ma yi ki, n tan nan na duniɲa naiyalanyi ra.»

sentences.english: Having said these words, he put earth, mixed with water from his mouth, on the man's eyes,
sentences.susu: A na fala xanbi, Isa naxa dɛye bɔxun bɔxi, a bɛndɛ yogon a ra. A naxa na maso dɔnxui ya ma,

sentences.english: And said to him, Go and make yourself clean in the bath of Siloam (the sense of the name is, Sent). So he went away and, after washing, came back able to see.
sentences.susu: a fa a fala a bɛ, «Sa i ya raxa Silɔmu ye yire.» Na Silɔmu xili nan falaxi e xa xui, «Xɛɛra». Na kui, dɔnxui naxa sa a ya raxa, a gbilen, a ya se toma.

sentences.english: Then the neighbours and others who had seen him before in the street, with his hand out for money, said, Is not this the man who got money from people?
