sentences.susu: A dɔxɔbooree nun naxee nu darixi a to ra kulɛ matide, e naxa a fala, «Yi xɛmɛ xa mu nu dɔxɔma be, a nu kulɛ mati?»

sentences.english: Some said, It is he: others said, No, but he is like him. He said, I am he.
sentences.susu: Ndee naxɛ, «Iyo, a tan nan a ra.» Gbɛtɛe naxɛ, «Ade, e maniyaxi nɛ.» Kɔnɔ a tan xɛmɛ naxa wɔyɛn e bɛ, a a fala, «N tan nan yati a ra!»

sentences.english: So they said to him, How then were your eyes made open?
sentences.susu: Na kui, e naxa a maxɔrin, «I ya fa rabɔɔxi di?»

sentences.english: His answer was: The man who is named Jesus put earth mixed with water on my eyes, and said to me, Go and make yourself clean in Siloam: so I went away and, after washing, am now able to see.
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «Xɛmɛ naxan xili falama Isa, na nan bɛndɛ yogon dɛye ra, a a sa n ya ma, a fa a fala n bɛ, ‹Sa i ya raxa Silɔmu ye yire.› Na kui, n to sa n ya raxa, n naxa se to.»

sentences.english: And they said to him, Where is he? His answer was: I have no knowledge.
sentences.susu: E naxa fa a maxɔrin, «Yi xɛmɛ na minden?» A naxa e yaabi, «N mu a kolon.»

sentences.english: They took him before the Pharisees — this man who had been blind.
sentences.susu: E naxa dɔnxui rayalanxi xanin Farisɛnie yire.

sentences.english: Now the day on which the earth was mixed by Jesus and the man's eyes were made open was the Sabbath.
sentences.susu: Isa dɛye masunbuxi bɛndɛ ra lɔxɔ naxɛ, a dɔnxui ya rabɔɔ, malabu lɔxɔɛ nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: So the Pharisees put more questions to him about how his eyes had been made open. And he said to them, He put earth on my eyes, and I had a wash and am able to see.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Farisɛnie fan naxa so a maxɔrinfe, a ya rabɔɔxi ki naxɛ. A naxa e yaabi, «A bɛndɛ yogonxi nan sa n ya ma, n e raxa, e se to.»

sentences.english: Then some of the Pharisees said, That man has not come from God, for he does not keep the Sabbath. Others said, How is it possible for a sinner to do such signs? So there was a division among them.
sentences.susu: Farisɛni ndee naxa a fala, «Yi xɛmɛ Isa, a mu kelixi Ala xa ma, barima a mu malabu lɔxɔɛ sɛriyɛ rabatuma.» Kɔnɔ gbɛtɛe nu a falama, «Yunubitɔɛ nɔma yi kaabanako mɔɔlie rabade?» Na kui, Farisɛnie mu nu lanxi e bore ma.

sentences.english: Again they said to the blind man, What have you to say about him for opening your eyes? And he said, He is a prophet.
sentences.susu: E man naxa dɔnxui rayalanxi maxɔrin, «A to i tan nan ya rabɔɔxi, I tan a xa fe toxi di?» A naxa e yaabi, «Namiɲɔnmɛ nan a ra.»

sentences.english: Now the Jews had no belief in the statement that he had been blind and was now able to see, till they sent for the father and mother of the man whose eyes had been made open,
sentences.susu: Yuwifi kuntigie nu siikɛxi na dɔnxui xa fe ra. E mu nu a kolon xa dɔnxui yati yati nan nu a ra. Na kui, e naxa a barimixie xili,

sentences.english: And put the question to them, saying, Is this your son, of whom you say that he was blind at birth? how is it then that he is now able to see?
sentences.susu: e e maxɔrin, «Wo xa di nan ya, wo naxan ma a a dɔnxuxi nan barixi? A ya fa rabɔɔxi di?»

sentences.english: In answer his father and mother said, We are certain that this is our son and that he was blind at birth:
sentences.susu: A barimixie naxa e yaabi, «Muxu a kolon, a muxu xa di nan a ra. Muxu man a kolon, a a barixi dɔnxuya nan kui.

sentences.english: But how it is he is now able to see, or who made his eyes open, we are not able to say: put the question to him; he is old enough to give an answer for himself.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a ya fa rabɔɔxi ki naxɛ, muxu mu na tan kolon. Muxu man mu a kolon mixi yo na rabaxi a bɛ. Wo a tan nan maxɔrin. Dimɛdi xa mu a ra, a yɛtɛ a xa dɛntɛgɛ sama.»

sentences.english: They said this because of their fear of the Jews: for the Jews had come to an agreement that if any man said that Jesus was the Christ he would be put out of the Synagogue.
sentences.susu: A xa mixie na yaabi ti nɛ, barima e nu gaaxuxi Yuwifi kuntigie ya ra. Nee nu bara lan a ma a mixi yo naxan na a fala Isa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan a ra, e xa tɔnyi dɔxɔ na kanyi ma a naxa so salide kui.

sentences.english: That was the reason why they said, He is old enough; put the question to him.
sentences.susu: Na nan a niya a barimixie naxa a fala, «Dimɛdi xa mu a ra, wo a tan nan maxɔrin.»

sentences.english: So they sent a second time for the man who had been blind and they said to him, Give glory to God: it is clear to us that this man is a sinner.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Farisɛnie naxa na dɔnxui rayalanxi xili a firin nde, e a fala a bɛ, «I i kali Ala ra, i nɔndi fala. Muxu tan a kolon a yunubitɔɛ nan na na xɛmɛ ra.»

sentences.english: He said in answer, I have no knowledge if he is a sinner or not, but one thing I am certain about; I was blind, and now I see.
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «Xa yunubitɔɛ nan a ra, n tan mu a kolon. Kɔnɔ n fe keren tan kolon: N nu dɔnxuxi nɛ, kɔnɔ n ya bara fa se to.»

sentences.english: Then they said to him, What did he do to you? how did he give you the use of your eyes?
sentences.susu: E man naxa a maxɔrin, «A munse raba i ra? A i ya rabɔɔxi di?»

sentences.english: His answer was: I have said it before, but your ears were shut: why would you have me say it again? is it your desire to become his disciples?
sentences.susu: A naxa e yaabi, «N ɲan bara na fala wo bɛ, kɔnɔ wo mu tin n xui ramɛde. Wo man fa wama n xa gbilen a ma munfe ra? Ka wo fan waxi findife a fɔxirabirɛe nan na?»

sentences.english: And they were angry with him and said, You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
sentences.susu: E naxa a konbi, e a fala a bɛ, «I tan nan findixi a fɔxirabirɛ ra! Annabi Munsa fɔxirabirɛe nan na muxu tan na!

sentences.english: We are certain that God gave his word to Moses: but as for this man, we have no knowledge where he comes from.
sentences.susu: Muxu a kolon tan, a Ala wɔyɛn nɛ Annabi Munsa bɛ, kɔnɔ yi xɛmɛ Isa tan, muxu mu a kelide kolon.»

sentences.english: The man said in answer, Why, here is a strange thing! You have no knowledge where he comes from though he gave me the use of my eyes.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ naxa e yaabi, «Fe makaabaxi nan ya! A bara n ya rabɔɔ, kɔnɔ wo tan mu a kelide kolon!

sentences.english: We have knowledge that God does not give ear to sinners, but if any man is a worshipper of God and does his pleasure, to him God's ears are open.
sentences.susu: Won a kolon tan, a Ala mu yunubitɔɛ xa duba tongoma. Naxan gaaxuma a ya ra, a a sago raba, a na nan xa maxandi suxuma.

sentences.english: In all the years nobody has ever before seen the eyes of a man blind from birth made open.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa birin a kolon mixi mu nɔma dɔnxui ya rabɔɔde naxan barixi dɔnxuya kui.

sentences.english: If this man did not come from God he would be unable to do anything.
sentences.susu: Xa yi xɛmɛ mu kelixi Ala xa ma nu, a mu nɔma fefe rabade.»

sentences.english: Their answer was: You came to birth through sin; do you make yourself our teacher? And they put him out of the Synagogue.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «I tan naxan barixi yunubi kui, i waxi findife muxu karamɔxɔ ra?» E naxa fa a keri salide.

sentences.english: It came to the ears of Jesus that they had put him out, and meeting him he said, Have you faith in the Son of man?
sentences.susu: Isa to a mɛ, a e bara a keri salide, a naxa sa a fen, a a maxɔrin, «I danxaniyaxi Adama xa Di ma?»

sentences.english: He said in answer, And who is he, Lord? Say, so that I may have faith in him.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «Marigi, a fala n bɛ mixi naxan a ra, alako n xa danxaniya a ma.»

sentences.english: Jesus said to him, You have seen him; it is he who is talking to you.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «I ɲan bara a to. A tan nan man wɔyɛnfe i bɛ yi ki.»

sentences.english: And he said, Lord, I have faith. And he gave him worship.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala Isa bɛ, «Marigi, n bara danxaniya.» A fa a suyidi a bɛ.

sentences.english: And Jesus said, I came into this world to be a judge, so that those who do not see may see, and those who see may become blind.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen, «N faxi yi duniɲa ma mixie makiitife nan ma, alako dɔnxui xa se to, ya kanyi xa dɔnxu.»

sentences.english: These words came to the ears of the Pharisees who were with him and they said to him, Are we, then, blind?
sentences.susu: Farisɛni naxee nu na naa, e naxa a xui mɛ, e a maxɔrin, «Pe, dɔnxui nan na muxu fan na?»

sentences.english: Jesus said to them, If you were blind you would have no sin: but now that you say, We see; your sin is there still.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Xa dɔnxui nan na wo ra nu, yunubi mu luma wo ma. Kɔnɔ wo to a falama, a wo ya fan, wo xa yunubi bara lu wo ma.»

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, He who does not go through the door into the place where the sheep are kept, but gets in by some other way, is a thief and an outlaw.
sentences.susu: «N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, muɲɛti nun suute mu soma gɔɔrɛ naadɛ ra. E tuganma nɛ sansanyi xun ma.

sentences.english: He who goes in by the door is the keeper of the sheep.
sentences.susu: Naxan soma gɔɔrɛ naadɛ ra, na nan findixi xuruse dɛmadonyi ra.

sentences.english: The porter lets him in; and the sheep give ear to his voice; he says over the names of the sheep, and takes them out.
sentences.susu: Naadɛ kantama nan naadɛ rabima a bɛ. A na wɔyɛn xurusee ra, e birin bira a fɔxɔ ra. A kankan xili a xili ra, e birin mini tande.

sentences.english: When he has got them all out, he goes before them, and the sheep go after him, for they have knowledge of his voice.
sentences.susu: A na a gbe birin namini, a sa tima e ya ra nɛ, e fan bira a fɔxɔ ra, barima e a xui kolon.

sentences.english: They will not go after another who is not their keeper, but will go from him in flight, because his voice is strange to them.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi gbɛtɛ na a ra e mu naxan kolon, e mu birama a fɔxɔ ra muku. E e gima nɛ na tan ya ra, barima e mu a xui kolon.»

sentences.english: In this Jesus was teaching them in the form of a story: but what he said was not clear to them.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa na taali wɔyɛnyi fala e bɛ, kɔnɔ e mu a xa masenyi fahaamu.

sentences.english: So Jesus said again, Truly I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa man naxa a masen, «N xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, n tan nan na yɛxɛɛe xa naadɛ ra.

sentences.english: All who came before me are thieves and outlaws: but the sheep did not give ear to them.
sentences.susu: Naxee singe fa n bɛ, muɲɛtie nun suutee nan na e birin na. Yɛxɛɛe mu e tan xui ramɛ.

sentences.english: I am the door: if any man goes in through me he will have salvation, and will go in and go out, and will get food.
sentences.susu: N tan nan na gɔɔrɛ naadɛ ra. Naxan yo na so n saabui ra, a kanyi kisima nɛ, a nu so, a nu mini, a nu baloe sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: The thief comes only to take the sheep and to put them to death: he comes for their destruction: I have come so that they may have life and have it in greater measure.
sentences.susu: Muɲɛti tan mu fama fefe ma bafe muɲɛ tide, faxɛ tide, nun kasarɛ sade. N tan faxi nɛ, alako mixie xa kisi sɔtɔ, e xa duniɲɛigiri xa fan a fanyi ra.»

sentences.english: I am the good keeper of sheep: the good keeper gives his life for the sheep.
sentences.susu: «N misaalixi xuruse kantama fanyi nan na, naxan mu tondima faxade a xa xuruse kantɛ kui.

sentences.english: He who is a servant, and not the keeper or the owner of the sheep, sees the wolf coming and goes in flight, away from the sheep; and the wolf comes down on them and sends them in all directions:
sentences.susu: Walikɛ nan a gima wula bare ya ra, barima xurusee mu findixi a gbe ra, a bɔɲɛ mu na e kantafe ra. A xurusee rabɛɲinma nɛ, wula bare ndee faxa, a ndee rayensen yɛ.

sentences.english: Because he is a servant he has no interest in the sheep.
sentences.susu: Walikɛ mu a ɲɛngi sama xurusee xa fe xɔn.

sentences.english: I am the good keeper; I have knowledge of my sheep, and they have knowledge of me,
sentences.susu: N tan misaalixi xuruse kantɛ fanyi nan na. Xurusee kantɛ nun a xa xurusee, e e bore kolon,

sentences.english: Even as the Father has knowledge of me and I of the Father; and I am giving my life for the sheep.
sentences.susu: alɔ n tan nun Baba Ala muxu muxu bore kolonxi ki naxɛ. N fan bara tin faxade n ma xurusee bɛ.»

sentences.english: And I have other sheep which are not of this field: I will be their guide in the same way, and they will give ear to my voice, so there will be one flock and one keeper.
sentences.susu: «Yɛxɛɛ gbɛtɛe fan na n bɛ naxee mu na yi gɔɔrɛ kui. Fo n xa fa nɛ nee fan na. E fan n xui ramɛma nɛ, yɛxɛɛe birin findi gɔɔrɛ keren na, xuruse dɛmadonyi keren bɛ.

sentences.english: For this reason am I loved by the Father, because I give up my life so that I may take it again.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi Baba Ala n xanuxi, barima n nan n nii fima, alako n man xa a rasuxu.

sentences.english: No one takes it away from me; I give it up of myself. I have power to give it up, and I have power to take it again. These orders I have from my Father.
sentences.susu: Mixi xa mu n tan nii bama de, n tan yɛtɛ yati a fima. Nɔɛ na n bɛ, n xa n nii fi. Nɔɛ man na n bɛ, n xa gbilen a rasuxu ra. N Baba n yamarixi na nan na.»

sentences.english: There was a division again among the Jews because of these words.
sentences.susu: Yuwifie man mu nu lanxi e bore ma na masenyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And a number of them said, He has an evil spirit and is out of his mind; why do you give ear to him?
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe nu a falafe nɛ, «Ɲinnɛ nan na yi fɔxɔ ra. A bara daxu. Wo wo tuli matima a ra munfe ra?»

sentences.english: Others said, These are not the words of one who has an evil spirit. Is it possible for an evil spirit to make blind people see?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ booree nu e yaabima, «Ɲinnɛ na mixi naxan fɔxɔ ra, a mu wɔyɛnma yi mɔɔli ra de! Ka ɲinnɛ nɔma dɔnxui ya rabɔɔde?»

sentences.english: Then came the feast of the opening of the Temple in Jerusalem: it was winter;
sentences.susu: Xinbeli tɛmui to nu a ra, Darisalamukae nu na Hɔrɔmɔbanxi Rabi Sali nan nabafe.

sentences.english: And Jesus was walking in the Temple, in Solomon's covered way.
sentences.susu: Isa nu ɲɛrɛfe hɔrɔmɔbanxi yire nde, dɛnnaxɛ xili «Mangɛ Sulemani xa buntunyi.»

sentences.english: Then the Jews came round him, saying, how long are you going to keep us in doubt? If you are the Christ, say so clearly.
sentences.susu: Yuwifie naxa Isa rabilin mɛnni, e a fala a bɛ, «I siikɛ bama muxu ma mun tɛmui? Xa i tan nan findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra, a fala muxu bɛ a fiixɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Jesus said in answer, I have said it and you have no belief: the works which I do in my Father's name, these give witness about me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «N ɲan bara a fala wo bɛ, kɔnɔ wo mu laxi n na. N fe naxee rabama n Baba xili ra, nee nan findixi seedeɲɔxɔya ra n ma fe ra.

sentences.english: But you have no belief because you are not of my sheep.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo mu danxaniyaxi, barima n ma yɛxɛɛe xa mu wo ra.

sentences.english: My sheep give ear to my voice, and I have knowledge of them, and they come after me:
sentences.susu: N gbe yɛxɛɛe tan n xui mɛma, n e kolon, e birama n fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And I give them eternal life; they will never come to destruction, and no one will ever take them out of my hand.
sentences.susu: N tan abadan kisi nan fima e ma. E mu lɔɛma abadan, sese man mu e bama n yi ra.

sentences.english: That which my Father has given to me has more value than all; and no one is able to take anything out of the Father's hand.
sentences.susu: N Baba, a tan naxan e so n yi ra, a dangi birin na. Sese mu nɔma e bade a tan Baba Ala yi ra.

sentences.english: I and my Father are one.
sentences.susu: N tan nun Baba Ala, muxu birin keren.»

sentences.english: Then the Jews took up stones again to send at him.
sentences.susu: Yuwifie man naxa gɛmɛe tongo, e xa Isa magɔnɔ a faxa xili ma,

sentences.english: Jesus said to them in answer, I have let you see a number of good works from the Father; for which of those works are you stoning me?
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ a naxa a fala e bɛ, «N bara wali fanyi gbegbe raba wo ya xɔri, naxee fatanxi Baba Ala ma. Wo a fala n bɛ ba, wo fa waxi n faxafe n ma wali fanyi mundun ma?»

sentences.english: This was their answer: We are not stoning you for a good work but for evil words; because being a man you make yourself God.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Muxu mu i magɔnɔfe xɛ i xa wali fanyi nde xa ma. Muxu i magɔnɔma i to Ala rasɔtɔfe. I tan ibunadama waxi i yɛtɛ findife Ala ra!»

sentences.english: In answer, Jesus said, Is there not a saying in your law, I said, You are gods?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «A mu sɛbɛxi xɛ wo xa sɛriyɛ Kitaabui kui, a Ala a masen nɛ, ‹N tan Ala bara a fala, alae nan wo ra›?

sentences.english: If he said they were gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Writings may not be broken),
sentences.susu: Kitaabui xui tan mu kanama. A xa masenyi faxi naxee ma, Ala bara e xili fala, ‹alae›.

sentences.english: Do you say of him whom the Father made holy and sent into the world, Your words are evil; because I said, I am God's Son?
sentences.susu: N bara a fala Ala xa Di nan n na, kɔnɔ a mu lanma wo xa a fala n bara Ala rasɔtɔ, barima Baba Ala n tan nan sugandixi, a n xɛɛ duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: If I am not doing the works of my Father, do not have belief in me;
sentences.susu: Xa n mu n Baba xa walie xa rabama, wo naxa la n na.

sentences.english: But if I am doing them, then have belief in the works even if you have no belief in me; so that you may see clearly and be certain that the Father is in me and I am in the Father.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa n a raba, wo xa la na wali ra, hali wo mu la n tan na. Wo xa la n ma wali ra, alako wo xa a kolon a Baba Ala na n i, n fan na Baba Ala i.»

sentences.english: Then again they made an attempt to take him; but he got away from them.
sentences.susu: Isa to na fala, mixie man naxa kata a suxude, kɔnɔ a naxa mini e bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And he went again to the other side of the Jordan, to the place where John first gave baptism; and he was there for a time.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa gbilen Yurudɛn naakiri ma, a lu mɛnni, Yaya mixie xunxa ye xɔɔra fɔlɔ dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And a great number of people came to him, saying, John did no sign: but everything John said of this man was true.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe naxa siga a yire, e nu a fala e bore bɛ, «Annabi Yaya tan mu tɔnxuma makaabaxi yo raba, kɔnɔ a naxan birin masen yi xɛmɛ xa fe ra, a birin findixi nɔndi nan na.»

sentences.english: And a number came to have faith in him there.
sentences.susu: Mɛnnika gbegbe naxa danxaniya Isa ma.

sentences.english: Now a certain man named Lazarus was ill; he was of Bethany, the town of Mary and her sister Martha.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ nde nu furaxi Betani naxan xili Lasaru. A maaginɛe fan nu sabatixi naa, Mariyama nun Marata.

sentences.english: (The Mary whose brother Lazarus was ill, was the Mary who put perfumed oil on the Lord and made his feet dry with her hair.)
sentences.susu: Mariyama nan labundɛ ture sa Marigi sanyie ma, a fa e mafuruku a xunsɛxɛ ra. A tan nan maaxɛmɛ findi Lasaru ra, naxan nu furaxi.

sentences.english: So the sisters sent to him, saying, Lord, your dear friend is ill.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Lasaru maaginɛe naxa xɛɛra xɛɛ Isa ma, a xa sa a fala a bɛ, «Marigi, i xanuntenyi furaxi.»

sentences.english: When this came to his ears, Jesus said, The end of this disease is not death, but the glory of God, so that the Son of God may have glory because of it.
sentences.susu: Isa to a mɛ, a naxa a masen, «Yi fure mu sa raɲɔnma faxɛ xa ma, a fama Ala xa nɔrɛ nan makɛnɛnde, alako Ala xa Di fan xa matɔxɔɛ sɔtɔ a saabui ra.»

sentences.english: Now Jesus had love in his heart for Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
sentences.susu: Isa nu Marata nun Mariyama nun e maaxɛmɛ Lasaru xanuxi ki fanyi.

sentences.english: So when the news came to him that Lazarus was ill, he did not go from the place where he was for two days.
sentences.susu: A to Lasaru furafe mɛ, a mu siga dɛdɛ, a naxa lu naa xi firin man.

sentences.english: Then after that time he said to his disciples, Let us go into Judaea again.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, a naxa a fala a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, «Won xa gbilen Yudaya bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: The disciples said to him, Master, the Jews were attempting only the other day to have you stoned, and are you going back there again?
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛe naxa a fala, «Karamɔxɔ, Yuwifie kataxi i faxade dɛnnaxɛ ya, i tan gbilenfe mɛnni nɛ?»

sentences.english: Then Jesus said in answer, Are there not twelve hours in the day? A man may go about in the day without falling, because he sees the light of this world.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Waxati fu nun firin xa mu na fɛɛɲɛn keren kui? Xa naxan yo a ɲɛrɛma yanyi ra, a mu a sanyi radinma barima yi duniɲa naiyalanyi yanbama a bɛ.

sentences.english: But if a man goes about in the night, he may have a fall because the light is not in him.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa naxan yo a ɲɛrɛma kɔɛ ra, a a sanyi radinma nɛ, barima naiyalanyi yo mu a bɛ.»

sentences.english: These things said he: and after that he said to them, Lazarus our friend is at rest; but I go so that I may make him come out of his sleep.
sentences.susu: A na fala xanbi, Isa man naxa a masen, «Won xanuntenyi Lasaru bara xi, kɔnɔ n sigafe a raxunude.»

sentences.english: Then his disciples said to him, Lord, if he is resting he will get well.
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛe naxa a fala a bɛ, «Marigi, xa a na xife, a yalanma nɛ.»

sentences.english: Jesus, however, was talking of his death: but they had the idea that he was talking about taking rest in sleep.
sentences.susu: Isa to Lasaru xife fala, a nu a faxafe nan ma, kɔnɔ a fɔxirabirɛe tan ɲɔxɔ a ma, a a nu malabui xi xɔli nan ma.

sentences.english: Then Jesus said to them clearly, Lazarus is dead.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa naxa wɔyɛn e bɛ a fiixɛ ra, «Lasaru bara laaxira

sentences.english: And because of you I am glad I was not there, so that you may have faith; but let us go to him.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ na rabafe n xanbi, a bara findi sɛɛwɛ ra n bɛ, barima a xɔli n ma wo xa danxaniya sɔtɔ yi fe kui. Yakɔsi, won xa siga a yire.»

sentences.english: Then Thomas, who was named Didymus, said to the other disciples, Let us go so that we may be with him in death.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Tomasi, a nu falama naxan bɛ «Guli», a naxa a fala Isa fɔxirabirɛ booree bɛ, «Won birin xɛɛ, won nun karamɔxɔ birin xa faxa!»

sentences.english: Now when Jesus came, he made the discovery that Lazarus had been put into the earth four days before.
sentences.susu: Isa to so naa, a naxa a li Lasaru fure bara xi naani raba gaburi kui.

sentences.english: Now Bethany was near to Jerusalem, about two miles away;
sentences.susu: Kilo saxan ɲɔndɔn nan nu na Betani nun Darisalamu tagi. E to makɔrɛ,

sentences.english: And a number of Jews had come to Martha and Mary to give them comfort about their brother.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi gbegbe nu bara fa Marata nun Mariyama xɔnyi, e maaxɛmɛ ɲɔnfe kunfa bade.

sentences.english: When Martha had the news that Jesus was on the way, she went out to him, but Mary did not go from the house.
sentences.susu: Marata to Isa fafe mɛ, a naxa sa a ralan, kɔnɔ Mariyama tan dɔxɔxi naxa lu banxi.

sentences.english: Then Martha said to Jesus, Lord, if you had been here my brother would not be dead.
sentences.susu: Marata naxa a fala Isa bɛ, «Marigi, xa i nu na be nu, n maaxɛmɛ mu faxama nu.

sentences.english: But I am certain that, even now, whatever request you make to God, God will give it to you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ hali yakɔsi, n a kolon a i na fefe maxɔrin Ala ma, a a rabama nɛ i bɛ.»

sentences.english: Jesus said to her, Your brother will come to life again.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «I xunya kelima nɛ faxɛ ma.»

sentences.english: Martha said to him, I am certain that he will come to life again when all come back from the dead at the last day.
sentences.susu: Marata naxa a yaabi, «N a kolon tan, a kelima nɛ faxɛ ma duniɲa raɲɔnyi, faxamixie kelima tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Jesus said to her, I am myself that day and that life; he who has faith in me will have life even if he is dead;
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen a bɛ, «N tan nan na marakeli nun kisi ra. Naxan na danxaniya n ma, a kisima nɛ, hali a faxa.

sentences.english: And no one who is living and has faith in me will ever see death. Is this your faith?
sentences.susu: Naxan yo baloxi, a danxaniyaxi n ma, na kanyi mu lɔɛma abadan. I laxi na ra?»

sentences.english: She said to him, Yes, Lord: my faith is that you are the Christ, the Son of God, who was to come into the world.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «Iyo, Marigi! N laxi a ra a i tan nan na Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra, Ala xa Di, naxan lan a xa fa duniɲa ma.»

sentences.english: And having said this, she went away and said secretly to her sister Mary, The Master is here and has sent for you.
sentences.susu: Marata na fala xanbi, a naxa siga a xunya Mariyama fɔxɔ ra, a a fala a bɛ e doro ma, «Karamɔxɔ bara fa, a na i xilife.»

sentences.english: And Mary, hearing this, got up quickly and went to him.
sentences.susu: Mariyama to a mɛ, a naxa keli keren na, a siga Isa ralande.

sentences.english: Now Jesus had not at this time come into the town, but was still in the place where Martha had seen him.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Isa mu nu soxi taa kui. Marata a li dɛnnaxɛ, a nu na mɛnni nɛ sinden.

sentences.english: Then the Jews who were with her in the house, comforting her, when they saw Mary get up quickly and go out, went after her in the belief that she was going to the place of the dead and would be weeping there.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi naxee faxi kunfa bade, naxee nu na Mariyama fɛ ma banxi kui, e to a to keli ra mafuren na, e naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra tande. E ɲɔxɔ a ma a a na sigafe gaburi yire nɛ, a xa sa wa naa.

sentences.english: When Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she went down at his feet, saying, Lord, if you had been here my brother would not be dead.
sentences.susu: Mariyama to Isa yire li, a fɛfɛ a to, a naxa suyidi a bɛ, a a fala, «Marigi, xa i nu na be nu, n maaxɛmɛ mu faxama nu!»

sentences.english: And when Jesus saw her weeping, and saw the Jews weeping who came with her, his spirit was moved and he was troubled,
sentences.susu: Isa to Mariyama to, a na wafe, Yuwifi naxee nu na a fɔxɔ ra, nee fan wafe, a naxa sunnun, a bɔɲɛ naxa raɲaaxu a ma.

sentences.english: And said, Where have you put him? They said, Come and see, Lord.
sentences.susu: A naxa maxɔrinyi ti, «Wo a ragataxi minden?» E naxa a yaabi, «Marigi, fa, muxu xa na masen i bɛ.»

sentences.english: And Jesus himself was weeping.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa wa.

sentences.english: So the Jews said, See how dear he was to him!
sentences.susu: Na kui, Yuwifie naxa a fala, «A mato, Lasaru nu rafanxi a ma ki naxɛ!»

sentences.english: But some of them said, This man, who made open the eyes of the blind man, was he not able to keep his friend from death?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ ndee e ya ma, e naxa a fala, «Pe, yi naxan dɔnxui ya rabɔɔ, a mu nu nɔma Lasaru ratangade faxɛ ma xɛ?»

sentences.english: So Jesus, deeply troubled in heart, came to the place of the dead. It was a hole in the rock, and a stone was over the opening.
sentences.susu: Isa bɔɲɛ man naxa raɲaaxu a ma. A naxa siga gaburi yire. Fɔnmɛ nde nan nu a ra, gɛmɛ belebele dɔxɔxi na dɛ ra.

sentences.english: Jesus said, Take away the stone. Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said, Lord, by this time the body will be smelling, for he has been dead four days.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala, «Wo gɛmɛ ba naa.» Marata, faxamixi maaginɛ, a naxa a fala, «Marigi, a xa maragatɛ xi naani nan to! A a lima a fure xiri bara mini yi waxati ma.»

sentences.english: Jesus said to her, Did I not say to you that if you had faith you would see the glory of God?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «N mu a fala xɛ i bɛ, a xa i danxaniya, i Ala sɛnbɛ makaabaxi toma nɛ?»

sentences.english: So they took away the stone. And Jesus, looking up to heaven, said, Father, I give praise to you for hearing me.
sentences.susu: Na kui, e naxa gɛmɛ ba fɔnmɛ gaburi dɛ ma. Isa naxa a ya rate koore, a a fala, «N Baba Ala, n bara i tantu i to n xui ramɛxi.

sentences.english: I was certain that your ears are at all times open to me, but I said it because of these who are here, so that they may see that you sent me.
sentences.susu: N tan ɲan a kolon, i n xui ramɛma tɛmui birin, kɔnɔ n na falaxi ɲama nan ma fe ra naxee tixi be, e xa la a ra a i tan nan n xɛɛxi.»

sentences.english: Then he said in a loud voice, Lazarus, come out!
sentences.susu: A na fala xanbi, Isa naxa a xui ite sɛnbɛ ra, a a fala, «Lasaru, mini!»

sentences.english: And he who was dead came out, with linen bands folded tightly about his hands and feet, and a cloth about his face. Jesus said to them, Make him free and let him go.
sentences.susu: A tan faxamixi naxa mini a sanyie nun a bɛlɛxɛe maxirixi kasange kui, a yatagi man makunfukunfuxi dugi gbɛtɛ fan na. Isa naxa a fala mixie bɛ, «Wo kasange ba a ma, wo a mafulun, a xa nɔ a ɲɛrɛde.»

sentences.english: Then a number of the Jews who had come to Mary and had seen the things which Jesus did had belief in him.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi naxee nu bara fa Mariyama yire, e Isa xa kaabanako to, e gbegbe naxa danxaniya a ma.

sentences.english: But some of them went to the Pharisees with the news of what Jesus had done.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ ndee naxa sa dɛntɛgɛ sa Farisɛnie bɛ, Isa fe naxan nabaxi.

sentences.english: Then the high priests and the Pharisees had a meeting and said, What are we doing? This man is doing a number of signs.
sentences.susu: Na kui, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun Farisɛnie naxa Yuwifie xa kiitisa xungbee malan. E naxa a fala, «Won munse rabama? Yi xɛmɛ na kaabanako gbegbe nan nabafe.

sentences.english: If we let him go on in this way, everybody will have belief in him and the Romans will come and take away our place and our nation.
sentences.susu: Xa won a lu a yɛtɛ yi, birin danxaniyama nɛ a ma, Rɔmakae fan fama won ma hɔrɔmɔbanxi kanade, e won si sɔntɔ!»

sentences.english: But one of them, Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, You have no knowledge of anything;
sentences.susu: E xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi Kayafa, naxan nu na e xunyi ra na waxati, a naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo tan mu sese kolon yi fe kui.

sentences.english: You do not see that it is in your interest for one man to be put to death for the people, so that all the nation may not come to destruction.
sentences.susu: Ka wo mu a fahaamuxi a mixi keren faxafe ɲama bɛ, na nan fan wo bɛ, dinɛ won si birin xa sɔntɔ?»

sentences.english: He did not say this of himself, but being the high priest that year he said, as a prophet, that Jesus would be put to death for the nation;
sentences.susu: Kayafa xa na wɔyɛnyi mu fatan a tan yɛtɛ xa ra. A to nu findixi na waxati sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie xunyi ra, Ala nan na masenyi fi a ma, a Isa nu fafe faxade Isirayila ɲama bɛ.

sentences.english: And not for that nation only, but for the purpose of uniting in one body the children of God all over the world.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na man mu raba Isirayilakae gbansan xa bɛ. Isa nu fafe faxade nɛ alako Ala xa a xa die fan malan, naxee rayensenxi yire birin, a xa e birin findi ɲama keren na.

sentences.english: And from that day they took thought together how to put him to death.
sentences.susu: Na kui, kabi na malanyi lɔxɔɛ, Yuwifi kuntigie naxa natɛ tongo Isa faxafe ra.

sentences.english: So Jesus no longer went about publicly among the Jews, but went from there into the country near to the waste land, to a town named Ephraim, where he was for some time with the disciples.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra Isa mu nɔ minide kɛnɛ ma sɔnɔn. A tan nun a fɔxirabirɛe naxa keli naa, e siga Efirami taa kui gbengberenyi fɛ ma.

sentences.english: Now the Passover of the Jews was near, and numbers of people went up from the country to Jerusalem to make themselves clean before the Passover.
sentences.susu: Yuwifie xa Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali to nu bara makɔrɛ, mixi gbegbe naxa keli daaxae tefe ra Darisalamu, e xa e yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛn beenun sali xa a li.

sentences.english: They were looking for Jesus and saying to one another while they were in the Temple, What is your opinion? Will he not come to the feast?
sentences.susu: E nu na Isa fenfe. E naxa e bore maxɔrin hɔrɔmɔbanxi tɛtɛ kui, «Wo xa maɲɔxunyi ma, Isa fama salide, ka a mu fama?»

sentences.english: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that if anyone had knowledge where he was, he was to give them word, so that they might take him.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun Farisɛnie nu bara yaamari fi, a mixi yo naxan na Isa to, na kanyi xa a fala e bɛ alako e xa a suxu.

sentences.english: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany where Lazarus was, whom Jesus had made to come back from the dead.
sentences.susu: Xi senni beenun Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali xa a li, Isa naxa siga Betani, Lasaru xɔnyi, a nu bara naxan nakeli faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: So they made him a meal there, and he was waited on by Martha, and Lazarus was among those who were seated with him at table.
sentences.susu: E naxa donse fanyi yailan, e fa ɲama xili, e xa e dɛge yire keren Isa xa binyɛ bun ma. Marata nu donse itaxunma mixie ma, Lasaru nun Isa naxa lu teebili ra.

sentences.english: Then Mary, taking a pound of perfumed oil of great value, put it on the feet of Jesus and made them dry with her hair: and the house became full of the smell of the perfume.
sentences.susu: Mariyama naxa sa narada labundɛ ture litiri tagi tongo. Narada tinsexi nan nu a ra, naxan sare xɔrɔxɔ ki fanyi. A naxa a maso Isa sanyie ma, a e mafuruku a xunsɛxɛ ra. Labundɛ ture xiri naxa din banxi birin na.

sentences.english: But one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot (who was to give him up), said,
sentences.susu: Yudasi Isikariyoti, Isa fɔxirabirɛ naxan nu fama a yanfade, a naxa a fala,

sentences.english: Why was not this perfume traded for three hundred pence, and the money given to the poor?
sentences.susu: «A nu lanma yi labundɛ xa mati kɔbiri kole kɛmɛ saxan na, a fi setaree ma.»

sentences.english: (He said this, not because he had any love for the poor; but because he was a thief, and, having the money-bag, took for himself what was put into it.)
sentences.susu: A yi fala nɛ barima a tan nan nu Isa fɔxirabirɛe xa kɔbiri ragatama, a nu fa nde muɲa. Setaree xa fe mu nu na a bɔɲɛ kui feo!

sentences.english: Then Jesus said, Let her be. Let her keep what she has for the day of my death.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa naxa a fala, «Gbilen Mariyama fɔxɔ ra. Yi nu ragataxi a yi ra nɛ, n ma maragatɛ nan ma fe ra.

sentences.english: The poor you have ever with you, but me you have not for ever.
sentences.susu: Setaree luma nɛ wo ya ma tɛmui birin, kɔnɔ n tan mu luma wo ya ma abadan xɛ.»

sentences.english: Then a great number of the Jews had news that he was there: and they came, not only because of Jesus, but so that they might see Lazarus who had been dead and to whom he had given life.
sentences.susu: E to a mɛ a Isa bara fa Betani, Yuwifie ɲama gbegbe fan naxa siga. E mu siga Isa xa fe gbansan xa ma. E nu wama Lasaru fan tofe, Isa naxan nakeli faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: Now there was talk among the chief priests of putting Lazarus to death;
sentences.susu: Na kui, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie naxa natɛ tongo e xa Lasaru fan faxa,

sentences.english: For because of him a great number of the Jews went away and had belief in Jesus.
sentences.susu: barima Yuwifi gbegbe nu gbilenfe e fɔxɔ ra a tan nan ma fe ra, e nu fa danxaniya Isa ma.

sentences.english: The day after, a great number of people who were there for the feast, when they had the news that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, ɲama gbegbe naxan nu faxi Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali rabade, e naxa a mɛ a Isa na fafe Darisalamu.

sentences.english: Took branches of palm-trees and went out to him, crying, A blessing on him who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!
sentences.susu: E naxa tugi fɛnsɛe tongo, e siga a ralande e xui ite ra, «Tantui na won Nakisima bɛ! Baraka na a bɛ naxan fafe Marigi xili ra, Isirayila mangɛ!»

sentences.english: And Jesus saw a young ass and took his seat on it; as the Writings say,
sentences.susu: Isa naxa sofale lanma nde sɔtɔ, a dɔxɔ a fari, alɔ a sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui ki naxɛ,

sentences.english: Have no fear, daughter of Zion: see your King is coming, seated on a young ass.
sentences.susu: «Siyonikae, wo naxa gaaxu. Wo xa mangɛ na fafe, a dɔxɔxi sofale fari.»

sentences.english: (These things were not clear to his disciples at first: but when Jesus had been lifted up into his glory, then it came to their minds that these things in the Writings were about him and that they had been done to him.)
sentences.susu: Na waxati Isa fɔxirabirɛe mu fahaamui sɔtɔ na fe ma, kɔnɔ Isa to keli faxɛ ma, e naxa ratu Kitaabui sɛbɛli ma naxan nu bara kamali na fe kui.

sentences.english: Now the people who were with him when his voice came to Lazarus in the place of the dead, and gave him life again, had been talking about it.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxan Lasaru to keli ra faxɛ ma, e naxa seede ba Isa bɛ.

sentences.english: And that was the reason the people went out to him, because it had come to their ears that he had done this sign.
sentences.susu: Na nan a niya, ɲama naxa siga a ralande, barima e nu bara na tɔnxuma makaabaxi xa fe mɛ.

sentences.english: Then the Pharisees said one to another, You see, you are unable to do anything: the world has gone after him.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Farisɛnie naxa a fala e bore bɛ, «Wo bara a to, won mu nɔma sese ra. Duniɲa birin bara bira a fɔxɔ ra!»

sentences.english: Now there were some Greeks among the people who had come up to give worship at the feast:
sentences.susu: Girɛki mixi ndee fan nu bara te sali rabade Darisalamu, e xa sa Ala batu.

sentences.english: They came to Philip, who was of Beth-saida in Galilee, and made a request, saying, Sir, we have a desire to see Jesus.
sentences.susu: E naxa fa Filipu xɔn, naxan keli Betesayida, Galile bɔxi ma, e a fala a bɛ, «N ba, muxu wama Isa tofe.»

sentences.english: Philip went and gave word of it to Andrew; and Andrew went with Philip to Jesus.
sentences.susu: Filipu naxa sa a fala Andire bɛ, e firin birin naxa siga e sa a fala Isa bɛ.

sentences.english: And Jesus said to them in answer, The hour of the glory of the Son of man has come.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Waxati bara a li Adama xa Di xa xunnakeli xa makɛnɛn.

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, If a seed of grain does not go into the earth and come to an end, it is still a seed and no more; but through its death it gives much fruit.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, xa maale xɔri mu si, a mu diɲɛ a yɛtɛ ma bɔxi bun, a luma na ki, a keren gbansan. Kɔnɔ xa a sa diɲɛ a yɛtɛ ma bɔxi bun, a a bogi gbegbe nan naminima.

sentences.english: He who is in love with life will have it taken from him; and he who has no care for his life in this world will keep it for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: Naxan gbakuma a yɛtɛ xa duniɲa fe ra, a lɔɛma nɛ. Naxan mu kankanma a yɛtɛ xa fe ma yi duniɲɛigiri kui, a abadan kisi nan sɔtɔma.

sentences.english: If any man is my servant, let him come after me; and where I am, there will my servant be. If any man becomes my servant, my Father will give him honour.
sentences.susu: Xa naxan yo wama n ma wali suxufe, a xa bira n fɔxɔ ra nɛ, n tan na lu dɛdɛ, n ma walikɛ fan na naa. Xa naxan yo n ma wali suxu, Baba Ala a kanyi binyama nɛ.»

sentences.english: Now is my soul troubled; and what am I to say? Father, keep me from this hour. No: for this purpose have I come to this hour.
sentences.susu: «N bɔɲɛ tɔɔrɔxi nɛ yi ki, kɔnɔ n fa munse falama? N xa a fala Baba Ala bɛ a xa n natanga yi ɲaxankatɛ waxati ma? Ade, yi ɲaxankatɛ naxan fafe n lide, n faxi na nan yati ma.

sentences.english: Father, give glory to your name. Then there came a voice out of heaven, saying, I have given it glory, and I will give it glory again.
sentences.susu: N Baba Ala, a niya i xili xa ite.» Isa to na fala, xui nde naxa keli koore ma, a a fala, «N bara a ite, n man gbilenma nɛ a ite ra.»

sentences.english: Hearing the sound, a number of people who were there said that it was thunder: others said, An angel was talking to him.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxee nu tixi naa, e to a mɛ, ndee naxa a fala a galanyi nan xui a ra, kɔnɔ gbɛtɛ naxa a fala, «Malekɛ nan wɔyɛnxi a bɛ!»

sentences.english: Jesus said in answer, This voice came not for me but for you.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen e bɛ, «Na xui mu minixi n tan n ma fe xa ma, a minixi wo tan nan ma fe ma.

sentences.english: Now is this world to be judged: now will the ruler of this world be sent out.
sentences.susu: Yi duniɲa makiiti waxati bara a li. Mangɛya fafe bade yi duniɲa nɔla yi ra.

sentences.english: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will make all men come to me.
sentences.susu: Mixie na n nate wuri magalanbuxi kɔn na n faxafe ra, n mixi birin nafama nɛ n ma.»

sentences.english: (This he said, pointing to the sort of death he would have.)
sentences.susu: Isa a faxa ki masen na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Then the people in answer said to him, The law says that the Christ will have life without end: how say you then that it is necessary for the Son of man to be lifted up? Who is this Son of man?
sentences.susu: Na kui, ɲama naxa a fala Isa bɛ, «Muxu tan bara a mɛ sɛriyɛ Kitaabui kui, a Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi buma abadan. Munfe ra i tan a falama a fo Adama xa Di xa rate? Nde findixi yi Adama xa Di ra?»

sentences.english: Jesus said to them, For a little time longer the light will be among you; while you have the light go on walking in it, so that the dark may not overtake you: one walking in the dark has no knowledge of where he is going.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Ala xa naiyalanyi man luma nɛ wo ya ma dondoronti. Wo xa ɲɛrɛ na naiyalanyi kui, alako dimi naxa wo tɛrɛnna. Naxan ɲɛrɛma dimi kui a mu a sigade toma.

sentences.english: In so far as you have the light, put your faith in the light so that you may become sons of light. With these words Jesus went away and for a time was not seen again by them.
sentences.susu: Naiyalanyi to yanbama wo bɛ yi ki, wo xa la a ra nɛ, alako wo xa findi naiyalanyi xa die nan na.» Isa to gɛ na falade, a naxa siga, a sa a nɔxun e ma.

sentences.english: But though he had done such a number of signs before them, they still had no belief in him:
sentences.susu: A nu bara tɔnxuma makaabaxi gbegbe raba e ya xɔri, kɔnɔ na birin kui, e mu danxaniya a ma.

sentences.english: So that the words of the prophet Isaiah might come true, when he said, Lord, who has any belief in our preaching? and the arm of the Lord, to whom has it been unveiled?
sentences.susu: Na raba nɛ alako Annabi Esayi xui xa kamali, a to a masen, «Marigi, nde laxi masenyi ra, e bara naxan mɛ muxu ra? Ala sɛnbɛ bara makɛnɛn nde bɛ?»

sentences.english: For this reason they were unable to have belief, because Isaiah said again,
sentences.susu: Na kui, e mu nɔ danxaniyade Isa ma, barima Esayi a masen nɛ,

sentences.english: He has made their eyes blind, and their hearts hard; for fear that they might see with their eyes and get knowledge with their hearts, and be changed, and I might make them well.
sentences.susu: «Ala bara e ya dɔnxu, a e xaxili balan, alako e ya naxa fa se igbɛ, e xaxili naxa fa fe kolon, e naxa fa e bɔɲɛ rafindi n ma, n xa e rayalan.»

sentences.english: (Isaiah said these words because he saw his glory. His words were about him.)
sentences.susu: Annabi Esayi na fala nɛ a to nu bara Isa xa nɔrɛ to. Na kui, a nu Isa xa fe nan falafe.

sentences.english: However, a number even of the rulers had belief in him, but because of the Pharisees they did not say so openly for fear that they might be shut out from the Synagogue:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na birin kui, hali kuntigie ya ma, e gbegbe naxa la Isa ra. Kɔnɔ e mu nu suusama a falade kɛnɛ ma barima e nu gaaxuxi Farisɛnie ya ra, nee naxa fa tɔnyi dɔxɔ e ma, sofe ra salide kui.

sentences.english: For the praise of men was dearer to them than the approval of God.
sentences.susu: Adamadie xa matɔxɔɛ sɔtɔfe nan nu rafan e ma dangi Ala xa matɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Then Jesus said with a loud voice, He who has faith in me, has faith not in me, but in him who sent me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a xui ite, a a fala, «Naxan na danxaniya n ma, a mu danxaniyaxi n tan xa ma, a danxaniyaxi n Xɛɛma nan ma.

sentences.english: And he who sees me, sees him who sent me.
sentences.susu: Naxan na n tan to, a bara n Xɛɛma to.

sentences.english: I have come as a light into the world, so that no one who has faith in me will go on living in the dark.
sentences.susu: N to faxi duniɲa, naiyalanyi nan n na, alako naxan yo na danxaniya n ma, na kanyi naxa lu dimi kui sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And if any man gives ear to my words and does not keep them, I am not his judge: I did not come to be judge of the world but to give salvation to the world.
sentences.susu: Xa naxan yo n xui mɛ, kɔnɔ a mu a rabatu, n tan mu na kanyi makiitima, barima n mu faxi duniɲa makiitide xɛ. N faxi duniɲa rakiside nɛ.

sentences.english: He who puts me on one side and does not take my words to heart, is not without a judge: the word which I have said will be his judge on the last day.
sentences.susu: Naxan na tondi n na, a mu tin n ma masenyi ra, na kanyi makiitima na na. N masenyi naxan tima, na nan findima a makiitima ra lɔxɔ dɔnxɔɛ.

sentences.english: For I have not said it on my authority, but the Father who sent me gave me orders what to say and how to say it.
sentences.susu: Barima n ma masenyi mu fatanxi n tan xa ra. A fatanxi Baba Ala nan na, naxan n xɛɛxi yaamari ra, a lanma n xa naxan fala, n xa naxan masen.

sentences.english: And I have knowledge that his order is eternal life: so that the things which I say, I say them even as the Father says them to me.
sentences.susu: N a kolon a xa sɛriyɛ findima kisi nan na, naxan mu ɲɔnma abadan. Na nan a ra, n fe masenma wo bɛ alɔ Baba Ala a masenxi ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Now before the feast of the Passover, it was clear to Jesus that the time had come for him to go away from this world to the Father. Having once had love for those in the world who were his, his love for them went on to the end.
sentences.susu: Beenun Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali xa a li, Isa naxa a kolon a gbe mu nu luxi a xa keli duniɲa ma gbilenfe ra Baba Ala ma. A fɔxirabirɛe a naxee sɔtɔ duniɲa ma, nee nu rafan a ma. Han a faxa tɛmui naxɛ, e xa xanunteya nu na a bɛ.

sentences.english: So while a meal was going on, the Evil One having now put it into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to be false to him,
sentences.susu: Nunmare, e birin nu e dɛgefe. Ibulisa ɲan nu bara so Simɔn Isikariyoti xa di Yudasi xaxili kui, a xa Isa yanfa.

sentences.english: Jesus, being conscious that the Father had put everything into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,
sentences.susu: Isa to nu a kolon a Baba Ala bara fe birin sa a sagoe, a man to a kolon a a kelixi Ala nan ma, a man gbilenfe a tan nan ma,

sentences.english: Got up from table, put off his robe and took a cloth and put it round him.
sentences.susu: a naxa keli e dɛgede, a a xa donma fari igoroe ba a ma, a fa dugi nde xiri a tagi.

sentences.english: Then he put water into a basin and was washing the feet of the disciples and drying them with the cloth which was round him.
sentences.susu: A naxa ye sa paani kui, a fa so a fɔxirabirɛe sanyie maxafe, a nu e mafuruku na dugi ra.

sentences.english: So he came to Simon Peter. Peter said, Lord, are my feet to be washed by you?
sentences.susu: A to Simɔn Piyɛri li, na naxa a fala a bɛ, «Marigi, i waxi nɛ i xa n tan sanyie maxa?»

sentences.english: And Jesus, answering, said to him, What I do is not clear to you now, but it will be clear to you in time to come.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «N naxan nabafe yi ki, i mu a fahaamuma yi waxati tan ma, kɔnɔ i fama nɛ a kui kolonde yare.»

sentences.english: Peter said, I will never let my feet be washed by you, never. Jesus said in answer, If I do not make you clean you have no part with me.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a fala a bɛ, «Ade, i tan mu n sanyi maxama feo!» Isa naxa a yaabi, «Xa n mu i sanyie maxa, won mu luma fe keren sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: Simon Peter said to him, Lord, not my feet only, but my hands and my head.
sentences.susu: Simɔn Piyɛri naxa a fala a bɛ, «N Marigi, xa a na na ki nɛ, i naxa n sanyi gbansan xa maxa. I xa n bɛlɛxɛe nun n xunyi birin maxa.»

sentences.english: Jesus said to him, He who is bathed has need only to have his feet washed and then he is clean all over: and you, my disciples, are clean, but not all of you.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «Mixi naxan bara a maxa, a hayi mu na a fate maxafe ma bafe a sanyi ra. A ɲan bara sɛniyɛn feo! Wo sɛniyɛnxi, kɔnɔ wo birin mu a ra.»

sentences.english: (He had knowledge who was false to him; that is why he said, You are not all clean.)
sentences.susu: A a fala nɛ a e birin mu sɛniyɛnxi, barima a a fɔxirabirɛ kolon naxan fama a yanfade.

sentences.english: Then, after washing their feet and putting on his robe again, he took his seat and said to them, Do you see what I have done to you?
sentences.susu: Isa to gɛ e sanyie maxade, a man naxa a xa donma fari igoroe ragoro a ma, a man a magoro e dɛgede, a a fala e bɛ, «N naxan nabaxi wo bɛ yi ki, wo a fahaamuxi?

sentences.english: You give me the name of Master and Lord: and you are right; that is what I am.
sentences.susu: Wo to a falama n bɛ ‹Karamɔxɔ›, xa na mu a ra ‹Marigi›, wo nɔndi nan a ra, barima na nan yati n na.

sentences.english: If then I, the Lord and the Master, have made your feet clean, it is right for you to make one another's feet clean.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n tan naxan findixi wo Marigi nun wo Karamɔxɔ ra, xa n tan bara wo sanyie maxa, wo fan lan nɛ wo xa wo bore sanyie maxa.

sentences.english: I have given you an example, so that you may do what I have done to you.
sentences.susu: N naxan nabaxi wo bɛ, a xa findi misaali nan na, alako wo fan xa na mɔɔli nan naba wo bore tagi.

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, A servant is not greater than his lord; and he who is sent is not greater than the one who sent him.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, konyi mu dangi a marigi ra, xɛɛra fan mu dangi a xɛɛma ra.

sentences.english: If these things are clear to you, happy are you if you do them.
sentences.susu: Wo to bara fahaamui sɔtɔ yi fee ma, hɛɛri na wo bɛ xa wo e raba.»

sentences.english: I am not talking of you all: I have knowledge of my true disciples, but things are as they are, so that the Writings may come true, The foot of him who takes bread with me is lifted up against me.
sentences.susu: «N mu wo birin xa ma. N tan naxan wo sugandixi, n wo kolon. Kɔnɔ naxan na Kitaabui kui, fo a xa kamali nɛ, a to sɛbɛxi, ‹Muxu nun naxan bɛlɛxɛ na lenge keren kui, na bara a kobe so n na.›

sentences.english: From this time forward, I give you knowledge of things before they come about, so that when they come about you may have belief that I am he.
sentences.susu: N na fe falaxi nɛ wo bɛ beenun a xa raba, alako a raba tɛmui wo xa a kolon a n tan nan na naxan na abadan.

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, He who takes to his heart anyone whom I send, takes me to his heart; and he who so takes me, takes him who sent me.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, naxan yo na n ma xɛɛra rasɛnɛ, a n tan nan nasɛnɛxi. Naxan yo na n fan nasɛnɛ, na kanyi n Xɛɛma nan nasɛnɛxi.»

sentences.english: When Jesus had said this he was troubled in spirit, and gave witness, saying, Truly I say to you, that one of you will be false to me.
sentences.susu: A na fala xanbi, Isa bɔɲɛ naxa sunnun, a fa a fala, «N xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, mixi keren na wo ya ma, a n yanfama nɛ, a n sa kuntigie bɛlɛxɛ.»

sentences.english: Then the eyes of the disciples were turned on one another, in doubt as to whom he had in mind.
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛe naxa e bore mato, e mu a kolon Isa nu mixi yo xa fe falafe.

sentences.english: There was at table one of his disciples, the one dear to Jesus, resting his head on Jesus' breast.
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛ, a naxan xanuxi, a nu na a fɛ ma teebili ra.

sentences.english: Making a sign to him, Simon Peter said, Who is it he is talking about?
sentences.susu: Na kui, Simɔn Piyɛri naxa a bɛlɛxɛ magira na bɛ, a xa Isa maxɔrin a kanyi ma, Isa nu baxi naxan ma fe falade.

sentences.english: He, then, resting his head on Jesus' breast, said to him, Lord, who is it?
sentences.susu: Na fɔxirabirɛ naxa a maso Isa ra, a a maxɔrin, «Marigi, nde a ra?»

sentences.english: This was the answer Jesus gave: It is the one to whom I will give this bit of bread after I have put it in the vessel. Then he took the bit of bread, put it into the vessel, and gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «N nu taami ragoro bɔrɛ xɔɔra, n a so mixi naxan yi ra, a tan nan na ki.» Isa to gɛ na falade, a naxa taami rasin bɔrɛ xɔɔra, a a so Simɔn Isikariyoti xa di Yudasi yi ra.

sentences.english: And when Judas took the bread Satan went into him. Then Jesus said to him, Do quickly what you have to do.
sentences.susu: Yudasi to na taami rasuxu, Sentanɛ naxa a bɔɲɛ masara keren na. Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «I wama naxan nabafe, a raba mafuren mafuren.»

sentences.english: Now it was not clear to anyone at table why he said this to him.
sentences.susu: Naxee nu magoroxi e dɛgede, e sese mu a kolon Isa na falafe a bɛ fe naxan ma.

sentences.english: Some were of the opinion that because Judas kept the money-bag Jesus said to him, Get the things we have need of for the feast; or, that he was to give something to the poor.
sentences.susu: Yudasi to findi e xa kɔbiri ragatɛ ra, ndee naxa a maɲɔxun a Isa nu a xɛɛfe sare nde sode sali xa fe ra, xa na mu a ra a xa sa misikiinɛe ki.

sentences.english: So Judas, having taken the bit of bread, straight away went out: and it was night.
sentences.susu: Yudasi to na taami xuntunyi rasuxu, a naxa mini keren na. Kɔɛ nu bara so.

sentences.english: Then when he had gone out, Jesus said, Now is glory given to the Son of man, and God is given glory in him.
sentences.susu: Yudasi to mini, Isa naxa a masen, «Waxati bara a li fa, Adama xa Di xa xunnakeli xa makɛnɛn, Ala fan xa nɔrɛ xa makɛnɛn a saabui ra.

sentences.english: If God is given glory in him, God will give him glory in himself, and will give him glory even now.
sentences.susu: Ala xa nɔrɛ to makɛnɛnma a saabui ra, Ala yɛtɛ fan Adama xa Di xa xunnakeli makɛnɛnma nɛ. A fafe na nan nabade yakɔsi.

sentences.english: My dear children, I am only to be with you a little longer. Then you will be looking for me: and as I said to the Jews, so now I say to you, Where I am going you may not come.
sentences.susu: N ma die, a gbe mu luxi n xa keli wo xun ma. Wo n fenma nɛ, kɔnɔ n naxan fala Yuwifi kuntigie bɛ, n fa na nan falama wo fan bɛ, ‹N sigama dɛnnaxɛ, wo tan mu nɔma sigade naa.›»

sentences.english: I give you a new law: Have love one for another; even as I have had love for you, so are you to have love one for another.
sentences.susu: «N xa yaamari nɛɛnɛ fi wo ma: Wo xa wo bore xanu nɛ. N tan wo xanuxi ki naxɛ, wo fan xa wo bore xanu na ki.

sentences.english: By this it will be clear to all men that you are my disciples, if you have love one for another.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa birin wo kolonma n fɔxirabirɛe ra na fe nan ma, xa wo wo bore xanu.»

sentences.english: Simon Peter said to him, Lord, where are you going? Jesus said in answer, Where I am going you may not come with me now, but you will come later.
sentences.susu: Simɔn Piyɛri naxa a maxɔrin, «Marigi, i sigama minden?» Isa naxa a yaabi, «N sigafe dɛnnaxɛ, i mu nɔma birade n fɔxɔ ra sinden, kɔnɔ i fan fama birade n fɔxɔ ra han naa.»

sentences.english: Peter said to him, Why may I not come with you even now? I will give up my life for you.
sentences.susu: Simɔn Piyɛri man naxa a maxɔrin, «Marigi, munfe ra n mu nɔma birade i fɔxɔ ra yakɔsi? N tinxi n xa faxa i xa fe ra!»

sentences.english: Jesus said in answer, Will you give up your life for me? Truly I say to you, Before the cry of the cock you will have said three times that you are not my disciple.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «I tinxi i xa faxa n ma fe ra? N xa nɔndi yati nan fala i bɛ, beenun konkore xa a rate, i i yɛtɛ rasanma nɛ n ma sanmaya saxan.»

sentences.english: Let not your heart be troubled: have faith in God and have faith in me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, «Wo naxa kɔntɔfili. Wo wo xaxili ti Ala ra, wo xa wo xaxili ti n fan na.

sentences.english: In my Father's house are rooms enough; if it was not so, would I have said that I am going to make ready a place for you?
sentences.susu: Lingira gbegbe nan na n Baba xɔnyi, xa na mu a ra n mu a falama wo bɛ nu, a n sigafe yigiya yailande wo bɛ.

sentences.english: And if I go and make ready a place for you, I will come back again and will take you to be with me, so that you may be where I am.
sentences.susu: Xa n siga, n naxa sa na yailan wo bɛ, n man fama nɛ wo fɔxɔ ra, alako won birin xa sa lu yire keren.

sentences.english: And you all have knowledge of where I am going, and of the way to it.
sentences.susu: N sigafe dɛnnaxɛ, wo na kira kolon.»

sentences.english: Thomas said, Lord, we have no knowledge of where you are going; how may we have knowledge of the way?
sentences.susu: Tomasi naxa a fala a bɛ, «Marigi, muxu mu i sigade kolon. Muxu fa na kira kolonma di?»

sentences.english: Jesus said to him, I am the true and living way: no one comes to the Father but by me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «N tan nan na kira ra, nɔndi ra, nun kisi ra. Mixi yo mu soma Baba Ala xɔnyi xa n tan saabui xa mu a ra.

sentences.english: If you had knowledge of me, you would have knowledge of my Father: you have knowledge of him now and have seen him.
sentences.susu: Xa wo bara n tan kolon, wo n Baba fan kolonma nɛ. Keli yi waxati ma, wo bara a kolon, wo man bara a to.»

sentences.english: Philip said to him, Lord, let us see the Father, and we have need of nothing more.
sentences.susu: Filipu naxa a fala a bɛ, «Marigi, Baba Ala masen muxu bɛ. A lima na bara muxu wasa.»

sentences.english: Jesus said to him, Philip, have I been with you all this time, and still you have no knowledge of me? He who has seen me has seen the Father. Why do you say, Let us see the Father?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «Filipu, n bara bu wo tagi ki fanyi, kɔnɔ han ya i mu n kolon? Naxan na n tan to, a bara Baba Ala to. I tan fa a falama di, a n xa Baba Ala masen wo bɛ?

sentences.english: Have you not faith that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The words which I say to you, I say not from myself: but the Father who is in me all the time does his works.
sentences.susu: I mu laxi a ra a Baba Ala nun n tan nan a ra, n fan nun Baba Ala nan a ra? N tan masenyi naxee tima wo bɛ, e mu fatan n tan yɛtɛ xa ra. E fatanma Baba Ala nan na. N tan nun Baba Ala naxan a ra tɛmui birin, a tan nan yɛtɛ na a xa wali rabafe.

sentences.english: Have faith that I am in the Father and that the Father is in me: at least, have faith in me because of what I do.
sentences.susu: Wo xa la n na, a Baba Ala nun n tan nan a ra, n fan nun Baba Ala nan a ra. Xa wo siikɛxi na ma, wo xa la a ra n ma walie tan xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, He who puts his faith in me will do the very works which I do, and he will do greater things than these, because I am going to my Father.
sentences.susu: «N xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, n tan wali naxee rabama, xa naxan danxaniya n ma, na kanyi fan na wali mɔɔlie rabama nɛ. A ɲan a rabama nɛ naxee dangi n tan gbe ra, barima n tan sigafe Baba Ala nan yire.

sentences.english: And whatever request you make in my name, that I will do, so that the Father may have glory in the Son.
sentences.susu: Wo naxan birin maxandima n xili ra, n a rabama nɛ wo bɛ alako Baba Ala xa matɔxɔɛ sɔtɔ a xa Di saabui ra.

sentences.english: If you make any request to me in my name, I will do it.
sentences.susu: Xa wo n maxandi fefe naxan ma n xili ra, n a rabama nɛ.»

sentences.english: If you have love for me, you will keep my laws.
sentences.susu: «Xa wo n xanu, wo n ma yaamarie rabatuma nɛ.

sentences.english: And I will make prayer to the Father and he will give you another Helper to be with you for ever,
sentences.susu: N tan fan, n Baba Ala maxandima nɛ a xa Saabui Fanyi gbɛtɛ xɛɛ wo ma, naxan luma wo fɛ ma abadan.

sentences.english: Even the Spirit of true knowledge. That Spirit the world is not able to take to its heart because it sees him not and has no knowledge of him: but you have knowledge of him, because he is ever with you and will be in you.
sentences.susu: Na nan findixi Ala Xaxili ra, naxan nɔndi makɛnɛnma. Duniɲa tan mu nɔma a sɔtɔde, barima e mu a toma, e man mu a kolon. Kɔnɔ wo tan a kolon, barima a sabatima wo i.»

sentences.english: I will not let you be without a friend: I am coming to you.
sentences.susu: «N mu wo raboloma xɛ de, wo xa lu alɔ kiridie. N man fama nɛ wo yire.

sentences.english: A little time longer, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me; and you will be living because I am living.
sentences.susu: A gbe mu luxi n xa lɔɛ duniɲa ma, kɔnɔ wo tan fama nɛ n tode. N tan to baloxi, wo fan baloma nɛ.

sentences.english: At that time it will be clear to you that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I in you.
sentences.susu: Wo a kolonma nɛ na lɔxɔɛ, a n tan nun n Baba nan a ra, wo fan nun n tan nan a ra, n fan nun wo tan nan a ra.

sentences.english: He who has my laws and keeps them, he it is who has love for me: and he who has love for me will be loved by my Father, and I will have love for him and will let myself be seen clearly by him.
sentences.susu: Naxan n ma yaamarie suxuxi, a e rabatu, na kanyi nan n xanuxi. Anun, naxan na n tan xanuxi, n Baba a kanyi xanuma nɛ, n fan a xanu, n nan n yɛtɛ makɛnɛn a bɛ.»

sentences.english: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, How is it that you will let yourself be seen clearly by us and not by the world?
sentences.susu: Yudasi, naxan mu findi Isikariyoti ra, a naxa Isa maxɔrin, «Marigi, munfe rabaxi i to fafe i yɛtɛ makɛnɛnde muxu tan bɛ, i mu i yɛtɛ makɛnɛn duniɲa tan bɛ?»

sentences.english: Jesus said to him in answer, If anyone has love for me, he will keep my words: and he will be dear to my Father; and we will come to him and make our living-place with him.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «Xa naxan yo n xanu, a n xui suxuma nɛ. N Baba a kanyi xanuma nɛ, muxu nun n Baba fa a yire, muxu sabati a i.

sentences.english: He who has no love for me does not keep my words; and the word which you are hearing is not my word but the Father's who sent me.
sentences.susu: Naxan mu n xanuxi, a mu n xui suxuma. Wo masenyi naxan mɛfe n na, n gbe xa mu a ra. A fatanxi Baba Ala nan na, naxan n xɛɛxi.»

sentences.english: I have said all this to you while I am still with you.
sentences.susu: «N to wo ya ma, n bara na birin masen wo bɛ,

sentences.english: But the Helper, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will be your teacher in all things and will put you in mind of everything I have said to you.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Baba Ala fama nɛ Saabui Fanyi xɛɛde wo yire n xili ra. Na saabui lanxi Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nan ma. Na nan fama wo ratude n ma masenyi birin na, a fa wo xaran na ra.»

sentences.english: May peace be with you; my peace I give to you: I give it not as the world gives. Let not your heart be troubled; let it be without fear.
sentences.susu: «N bɔɲɛsa fima wo ma naxan fatanxi n tan na, naxan mu kelixi duniɲa ma. Wo naxa kɔntɔfili, wo naxa gaaxu.

sentences.english: Keep in mind how I said to you, I go away and come to you again. If you had love for me you would be glad, because I am going to the Father: for the Father is greater than I.
sentences.susu: Wo bara n xui mɛ, ‹N na sigafe, kɔnɔ n man fama wo yire›. Xa wo n xanu, a lanma wo xa sɛɛwa n ma sigɛ ra Baba Ala yire, barima a dangi n tan na.

sentences.english: And now I have given you word of it before it comes, so that, when it comes, you may have faith.
sentences.susu: N a falaxi nɛ wo bɛ, beenun a xa raba, alako a na raba, wo xa danxaniya n ma.»

sentences.english: After this I will not say much to you, because the ruler of this world comes: and he has no power over me;
sentences.susu: «N mu wɔyɛn gbegbe falama wo bɛ sɔnɔn, barima yi duniɲa na nɔla naxan yi, a na fafe. A mu nɔma n tan na a mɔɔli yo ra,

sentences.english: But he comes so that the world may see that I have love for the Father, and that I am doing as I am ordered by the Father. Get up, and let us go.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ alako duniɲa xa a kolon a n tan Baba Ala xanuxi nɛ, Baba Ala n yamarixi naxan na, n a rabama nɛ. Wo keli, won xɛɛ.»

sentences.english: I am the true vine and my Father is the gardener.
sentences.susu: «N misaalixi wuri bili nan na, n Baba Ala nan findixi a mɛɛnima ra.

sentences.english: He takes away every branch in me which has no fruit, and every branch which has fruit he makes clean, so that it may have more fruit.
sentences.susu: Wuri bili salonyi naxee mu bogi raminima n bɛ, Ala e sɛgɛma nɛ. Salonyi naxee bogima, Ala xa e magbaran, alako e bogi xa gbo.

sentences.english: You are clean, even now, through the teaching which I have given you.
sentences.susu: Wo tan naxee findixi na salonyie ra, wo ɲan bara rasɛniyɛn n ma masenyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: Be in me at all times as I am in you. As the branch is not able to give fruit of itself, if it is not still on the vine, so you are not able to do so if you are not in me.
sentences.susu: Wo lu n ma fe nɛ, alɔ n fan luma wo xa fe ki naxɛ. Sansi salonyi mu nɔma bogide a yɛtɛ ra xa a mu fatuxi sansi bili xa ma. Wo fan luma na ki nɛ, xa wo mu lu n ma fe.

sentences.english: I am the vine, you are the branches: he who is in me at all times as I am in him, gives much fruit, because without me you are able to do nothing.
sentences.susu: N tan nan na Ala xa sansi bili ra, wo fan findixi na sansi salonyie nan na. Naxan na lu n ma fe, n fan lu a xa fe, a lu nɛ alɔ sansi salonyi naxan a bogi gbegbe raminima. Xa wo nun n tan xa mu a ra, wo tan mu nɔma fefe ra.

sentences.english: If a man does not keep himself in me, he becomes dead and is cut off like a dry branch; such branches are taken up and put in the fire and burned.
sentences.susu: Xa naxan mu lu n ma fe, a luma nɛ alɔ sansi salonyi masɛgɛxi naxan wɔlɛma, a xara. Walikɛe nee malanma nɛ, e e wɔlɛ tɛ xɔɔra, e gan.

sentences.english: If you are in me at all times, and my words are in you, then anything for which you make a request will be done for you.
sentences.susu: Xa wo lu n ma fe, n ma masenyie fan lu wo bɔɲɛ ma, wo na wa fefe xɔn, wo a maxandi. A rabama nɛ wo bɛ.

sentences.english: Here is my Father's glory, in that you give much fruit and so are my true disciples.
sentences.susu: N Baba matɔxɔɛ sɔtɔma, wo tan na lu alɔ sansi salonyi naxee bogima a fanyi ra, wo a masen na wali fanyie kui, a wo findixi n fɔxirabirɛe nan na.

sentences.english: Even as the Father has given me his love, so I have given my love to you: be ever in my love.
sentences.susu: N Baba Ala n tan xanuxi ki naxɛ, n fan wo xanuxi na ki nɛ. Wo lu n ma xanunteya kui.

sentences.english: If you keep my laws, you will be ever in my love, even as I have kept my Father's laws, and am ever in his love.
sentences.susu: Xa wo n ma yaamarie rabatu, wo luma n ma xanunteya kui, alɔ n fan luxi n Baba xa xanunteya kui ki naxɛ, n to a xa yaamarie rabatuxi.»

sentences.english: I have said these things to you so that I may have joy in you and so that your joy may be complete.
sentences.susu: «N yi fee masenxi nɛ wo bɛ, alako n ma sɛɛwɛ xa lu wo bɛ, wo xa sɛɛwɛ xa kamali.»

sentences.english: This is the law I give you: Have love one for another, even as I have love for you.
sentences.susu: «N ma yaamari findixi yi nan na: Wo wo bore xanu alɔ n wo xanuxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Greater love has no man than this, that a man gives up his life for his friends.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi a nii fi a xanuntenyie xa fe ra, xanunteya yo mu na naxan dangi na tan na.

sentences.english: You are my friends, if you do what I give you orders to do.
sentences.susu: Wo tan findixi n xanuntenyie nan na, xa wo n ma yaamarie rabatu.

sentences.english: No longer do I give you the name of servants; because a servant is without knowledge of what his master is doing: I give you the name of friends, because I have given you knowledge of all the things which my Father has said to me.
sentences.susu: N mu fa nɔma a falade wo bɛ ‹konyie›, barima konyi mu a kolon a marigi naxan yo rabafe. N tan bara a fala wo bɛ ‹n xanuntenyie›, barima n naxan birin mɛxi n Baba ra, n bara wo rakolon a birin na.

sentences.english: You did not take me for yourselves, but I took you for myself; and I gave you the work of going about and producing fruit which will be for ever; so that whatever request you make to the Father in my name he may give it to you.
sentences.susu: Wo tan xa mu n sugandi. N tan nan wo sugandi, n wo findi n ma xɛɛrae ra, wo xa sa lu alɔ sansi salonyie naxee bogima, wo sa wali fanyie raba naxee mu kanama. Na kui, wo na fefe maxɔrin Baba Ala ma n tan xili ra, a a soma nɛ wo yi.

sentences.english: So this is my law for you: Have love one for another.
sentences.susu: N wo yamarixi nɛ yi fee ma, alako wo xa wo bore xanu.»

sentences.english: If you are hated by the world, keep in mind that I was hated by the world before you.
sentences.susu: «Xa duniɲa wo xɔn, wo xa a kolon a n tan nan singe xɔn.

sentences.english: If you were of the world, you would be loved by the world: but because you are not of the world, but I have taken you out of the world, you are hated by the world.
sentences.susu: Xa wo findi duniɲa mixie nan na nu, wo rafanma nɛ duniɲa ma nu, alɔ a gbe mixie. Kɔnɔ duniɲa mixie mu wo ra, barima n tan bara wo sugandi e ya ma. Na nan a toxi, duniɲa wo xɔnxi.

sentences.english: Keep in mind the words I said to you, A servant is not greater than his lord. If they were cruel to me, they will be cruel to you; if they kept my words, they will keep yours.
sentences.susu: Wo xa ratu wɔyɛnyi ma n naxan masen wo bɛ, ‹Konyi mu dangima a marigi ra.› Xa e bara n tan ɲaxankata, e wo fan ɲaxankatama nɛ. Xa e n tan xui suxu, e wo fan gbe suxuma.

sentences.english: They will do all this to you because of my name — because they have no knowledge of him who sent me.
sentences.susu: E yi fe birin niyama nɛ wo ra n tan xili xa fe ra, barima e mu n Xɛɛma kolon.

sentences.english: If I had not come and been their teacher they would have had no sin: but now they have no reason to give for their sin.
sentences.susu: Xa n mu sa fa wɔyɛnde e bɛ nu, e mu yunubi sɔtɔma nu. Kɔnɔ yakɔsi, e mu fa nɔma sese falade naxan kiiti fanma e ra.

sentences.english: He who has hate for me has hate for my Father.
sentences.susu: Naxan na n tan xɔn, a bara n Baba fan xɔn.

sentences.english: If I had not done among them the works which no other man ever did, they would have had no sin: but now they have seen, and they have had hate in their hearts for me and my Father.
sentences.susu: Xa n mu kaabanakoe raba e tagi nu naxee singe mu nu raba, e mu yunubi sɔtɔma nu. Kɔnɔ yakɔsi, e bara na birin to, e man fa n tan nun n Baba xɔn.

sentences.english: This comes about so that the writing in their law may be made true, Their hate for me was without cause.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ naxan sɛbɛxi e xa sɛriyɛ Kitaabui kui, fo a xa kamali, a to a masenxi, ‹E n xɔnxi nɛ tun.›»

sentences.english: When the Helper comes, whom I will send to you from the Father even the Spirit of true knowledge who comes from the Father — he will give witness about me;
sentences.susu: «N Saabui Fanyi naxan xɛɛma wo ma kelife Baba Ala yire, naxan findixi Baba Ala Xaxili ra, naxan nɔndi makɛnɛnma, a tan na fa, a seede bama nɛ n ma fe ra.

sentences.english: And you, in addition, will give witness because you have been with me from the first.
sentences.susu: Wo fan seede bama nɛ, barima wo na n fɔxɔ ra kabi a fɔlɛ.»

sentences.english: I have said these things to you so that you may not be in doubt.
sentences.susu: «N yi fe birin masenxi nɛ wo bɛ, alako wo naxa fa bira tantanyi kui.

sentences.english: They will put you out of the Synagogues: yes, the time is coming when whoever puts you to death will have the belief that he is doing God's pleasure.
sentences.susu: E fama nɛ tɔnyi dɔxɔde wo ma, sofe ra salidee kui. Waxati ɲan fafe, naxan na wo faxa, a na faxɛ maɲɔxunma kɛwali fanyi nan na Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: They will do these things to you because they have not had knowledge of the Father or of me.
sentences.susu: E na fee rabama nɛ, barima e mu Baba Ala kolon, e mu n fan kolon.

sentences.english: I have said these things to you so that when the time comes, what I have said may come to your mind. I did not say them to you at the first, because then I was still with you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n yi fee birin masenxi nɛ wo bɛ, alako e waxati na a li, wo xa ratu, a n e xa fe fala nɛ wo bɛ.» «N mu yi fe birin masen wo bɛ a fɔlɛ ra, barima n nu na wo fɛ ma.

sentences.english: But now I am going to him who sent me; and not one of you says to me, Where are you going?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi, n fa sigafe n Xɛɛma yire, wo mu n maxɔrinma, ‹I na sigafe minden?›

sentences.english: But your hearts are full of sorrow because I have said these things.
sentences.susu: N to yi fee masenxi wo bɛ, na nan wo bɔɲɛ sunnunxi.

sentences.english: But what I am saying is true: my going is for your good: for if I do not go away, the Helper will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, n ma sigɛ nan munafanyi gbo wo bɛ, barima xa n mu siga, Saabui Fanyi mu fama wo ma. Kɔnɔ xa n siga, n a xɛɛma nɛ wo ma.

sentences.english: And he, when he comes, will make the world conscious of sin, and of righteousness, and of being judged:
sentences.susu: A na fa, a mixie rakolonma nɛ yunubi xa fe ra, tinxinyi xa fe ra, nun kiiti xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Of sin, because they have not faith in me;
sentences.susu: A e rakolonma nɛ yunubi xa fe ra, barima e mu danxaniyaxi n ma.

sentences.english: Of righteousness, because I go to the Father and you will see me no more;
sentences.susu: A e rakolonma nɛ tinxinyi xa fe ra, barima n na sigafe Baba Ala yire, wo mu n toma fa.

sentences.english: Of being judged, because the ruler of this world has been judged.
sentences.susu: A e rakolonma nɛ kiiti xa fe ra, barima yi duniɲa na nɔla kobi naxan yi ra, a ɲan bara makiiti.»

sentences.english: I have still much to say to you, but you are not strong enough for it now.
sentences.susu: «Masenyi gbɛtɛe man na, kɔnɔ wo mu nɔma e birin fahaamude yakɔsi.

sentences.english: However, when he, the Spirit of true knowledge, has come, he will be your guide into all true knowledge: for his words will not come from himself, but whatever has come to his hearing, that he will say: and he will make clear to you the things to come.
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili na fa wo ma, a na nɔndi birin ya mabɔɔma wo bɛ. A xa masenyi mu fatanxi a yɛtɛ kan na. A naxan mɛma n Baba ra, a na nan masenma wo bɛ. Fe naxee fama rabade, a nee nan masenma wo bɛ.

sentences.english: He will give me glory, because he will take of what is mine, and make it clear to you.
sentences.susu: A fama n ma xunnakeli makɛnɛnde, barima a naxan sɔtɔma n tan na, a na nan kawandima wo bɛ.

sentences.english: Everything which the Father has is mine: that is why I say, He will take of what is mine and will make it clear to you.
sentences.susu: Naxan birin na Baba Ala yi, a findixi n fan gbe nan na. N a fala na nan ma, ‹A naxan sɔtɔma n tan na, a na nan kawandima wo bɛ.›»

sentences.english: After a little time you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a fala e bɛ, «Waxati di nan luxi beenun n xa lɔɛ wo ma, kɔnɔ waxati di man na dangi, wo man n toma nɛ.»

sentences.english: So some of the disciples said one to another, What is this he is saying, After a little time, you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me? and, I am going to the Father?
sentences.susu: A fɔxirabirɛe naxa e bore maxɔrin, «Isa wama munse falafe yi ki, ‹A gbe mu luxi n xa lɔɛ wo ma dondoronti, kɔnɔ wo man fama n tode.› A xa wɔyɛnyi na di a to a falaxi, ‹N na sigafe Baba Ala yire?›»

sentences.english: So they said again and again, What is this he is saying, A little time? His words are not clear to us.
sentences.susu: E man nu e bore maxɔrinfe, «A munse ma, a ‹waxati di›? Won tan mu a kolon a sese falafe yi ki.»

sentences.english: Jesus saw that they had a desire to put the question to him, so he said to them, Is this what you are questioning one with another, why I said, After a little time, you will see me no longer; and then again, after a little time, you will see me?
sentences.susu: Isa to a kolon a e nu wama a maxɔrinfe, a naxa a masen e bɛ, «N to a falaxi, ‹Waxati di nan luxi beenun n xa lɔɛ wo ma, kɔnɔ waxati di man na dangi, wo man n toma nɛ,› wo wo bore maxɔrinfe na nan ma?

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, You will be weeping and sorrowing, but the world will be glad: you will be sad, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, wo wama nɛ, wo gbelegbele, kɔnɔ duniɲa tan ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ. Wo sunnunma nɛ na fe ma, kɔnɔ wo xa sunnunyi fama masarade sɛɛwɛ ra.

sentences.english: When a woman is about to give birth she has sorrow, because her hour is come; but when she has given birth to the child, the pain is put out of her mind by the joy that a man has come into the world.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxan na ditinyi ra, a tɔɔrɔma nɛ ki fanyi a xa waxati to bara a li. Kɔnɔ xa a gɛ di baride, a ɲan mu ratuma na tɔɔrɛ ma, a to sɛɛwaxi di nɛɛnɛ barife ra duniɲa.

sentences.english: So you have sorrow now: but I will see you again, and your hearts will be glad, and no one will take away your joy.
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo fan na sunnunyi nan kui yi waxati ma. Kɔnɔ n gbilenma nɛ wo to ra, wo bɔɲɛ sɛɛwa, mixi yo mu na sɛɛwɛ bama wo yi.

sentences.english: And on that day you will put no questions to me. Truly I say to you, Whatever request you make to the Father, he will give it to you in my name.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ na a li, wo mu n maxɔrinma sese ma sɔnɔn. N xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, wo na Baba Ala maxandi fefe ma n xili ra, a a soma nɛ wo yi.

sentences.english: Up to now you have made no request in my name: do so, and it will be answered, so that your hearts may be full of joy.
sentences.susu: Han ya, wo singe mu nu Ala maxandi fefe ma n tan xili ra. Wo maxandi ti. Wo a sɔtɔma nɛ, alako wo xa sɛɛwa a kamalixi ra.»

sentences.english: All this I have said to you in veiled language: but the time is coming when I will no longer say things in veiled language but will give you knowledge of the Father clearly.
sentences.susu: «N yi fe birin masenxi wo bɛ taali wɔyɛnyi nan na, kɔnɔ waxati na fafe, n mu wɔyɛnma wo bɛ taali wɔyɛnyi ra sɔnɔn, n Baba Ala xa fe masen wo bɛ a fiixɛ ra.

sentences.english: In that day you will make requests in my name: and I do not say that I will make prayer to the Father for you,
