sentences.susu: Na waxati ma, wo Baba Ala maxandima n xili nan na. N mu a falafe xɛ de, a n tan nan Baba Ala maxandima wo bɛ,

sentences.english: For the Father himself gives his love to you, because you have given your love to me and have had faith that I came from God.
sentences.susu: barima Baba Ala yɛtɛ yati wo xanuxi nɛ. A wo xanuxi nɛ n to rafan wo ma, wo man to laxi a ra a n kelixi a tan Ala nan ma.

sentences.english: I came out from the Father and have come into the world: again, I go away from the world and go to the Father.
sentences.susu: N kelixi Baba Ala nan ma, n fa duniɲa ma. N man fa kelife nɛ duniɲa ma, sigafe ra Baba Ala yire.»

sentences.english: His disciples said, Now you are talking clearly and not in veiled language.
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa a fala a bɛ, «A mato, i mu wɔyɛnfe taali wɔyɛnyi xa ra sɔnɔn, i fa na wɔyɛnfe a fiixɛ nan na!

sentences.english: Now we are certain that you have knowledge of all things and have no need for anyone to put questions to you: through this we have faith that you came from God.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara a kolon fa, a i fe birin kolon, hali mixi yo mu i maxɔrin. Na kui, muxu laxi a ra a i kelixi Ala nan ma.»

sentences.english: Jesus made answer, Have you faith now?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Wo bara danxaniya yakɔsi?

sentences.english: See, a time is coming, yes, it is now here, when you will go away in all directions, every man to his house, and I will be by myself: but I am not by myself, because the Father is with me.
sentences.susu: Waxati na fafe, a ɲan bara a li, wo yensenma nɛ, wo fa n nabolo. Kɔnɔ Baba Ala tan mu n naboloma. A luma nɛ n sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: I have said all these things to you so that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble: but take heart! I have overcome the world.
sentences.susu: N yi fe birin masenxi nɛ wo bɛ, alako bɔɲɛsa xa lu wo yi ra n saabui ra. Wo mantɔɔrɔli sɔtɔma nɛ duniɲa ma, kɔnɔ wo xa limaniya, n tan bara nɔ duniɲa ra.»

sentences.english: Jesus said these things; then, lifting his eyes to heaven, he said, Father, the time has now come; give glory to your Son, so that the Son may give glory to you:
sentences.susu: Isa to gɛ na fee falade, a naxa a ya rate koore, a a fala, «N Baba Ala, waxati bara a li. I xa i xa Di xa xunnakeli makɛnɛn, alako i xa Di fan xa i xa nɔrɛ makɛnɛn.

sentences.english: Even as you gave him authority over all flesh, to give eternal life to all those whom you have given to him.
sentences.susu: I bara mangɛya fi a ma duniɲa mixie birin xun na, alako a xa abadan kisi fi mixi birin ma, i naxee fixi a ma.

sentences.english: And this is eternal life: to have knowledge of you, the only true God, and of him whom you have sent, even Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Abadan kisi findixi yi nan na: E xa i kolon, i tan keren naxan findixi Ala yɛtɛ ra, e man xa i xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa kolon i xa xɛɛra ra.

sentences.english: I have given you glory on the earth, having done all the work which you gave me to do.
sentences.susu: N bara i xa nɔrɛ makɛnɛn duniɲa ma, n gɛ wali ra i n ti naxan na.

sentences.english: And now, Father, let me have glory with you, even that glory which I had with you before the world was.
sentences.susu: N Baba Ala, yakɔsi, n nɔrɔ i fɛ ma, alɔ n nu nɔrɔxi i fɛ ma ki naxɛ, beenun duniɲa xa daa.»

sentences.english: I have given knowledge of your name to the men whom you gave me out of the world: yours they were, and you gave them to me, and they have kept your words.
sentences.susu: «N bara i xa fe masen mixie bɛ, i naxee fixi n ma duniɲa. I xa mixie nan e ra i naxee taxuxi n na. E bara i xui ratinmɛ.

sentences.english: Now it is clear to them that whatever you have given to me comes from you:
sentences.susu: E bara a kolon fa, a i naxan birin soxi n yi ra, a fatanxi i tan nan na,

sentences.english: Because I have given them the words which you gave to me; and they have taken them to heart, and have certain knowledge that I came from you, and they have faith that you sent me.
sentences.susu: barima n bara i xui radangi e ma, e fan bara la a ra. E bara a kolon yati, a n kelixi i tan nan ma, e la a ra, a i tan nan n xɛɛxi.

sentences.english: My prayer is for them: my prayer is not for the world, but for those whom you have given to me, because they are yours
sentences.susu: N mu dubama duniɲa bɛ. N dubama i xa mixie nan bɛ, i naxee taxuxi n na.

sentences.english: (All mine are yours, and yours are mine) and I have glory in them.
sentences.susu: Naxee birin findixi n gbe ra, i gbe na e ra. Naxee birin findixi i gbe ra, n gbe na e ra. N ma fe itema nɛ e tan saabui ra.

sentences.english: And now I will be no longer in the world, but they are in the world and I come to you. Holy Father, keep them in your name which you have given to me, so that they may be one even as we are one.
sentences.susu: N mu fa luma duniɲa sɔnɔn. N fafe i yire nɛ yi ki, kɔnɔ e tan luma be nɛ. N Baba Sɛniyɛnxi, e makanta i xili sɛnbɛ ra, i naxan fixi n ma, alako e fan xa findi keren na alɔ won tan findixi keren na ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: While I was with them I kept them safe in your name which you have given to me: I took care of them and not one of them has come to destruction, but only the son of destruction, so that the Writings might come true.
sentences.susu: N to nu e ya ma, n bara e kanta i xili sɛnbɛ ra, i naxan fixi n ma. N to e makanta, mixi keren mu lɔɛ e ya ma fo gbaloe ragataxi naxan keren bɛ, alako Kitaabui sɛbɛli xa kamali.

sentences.english: And now I come to you; and these things I say in the world so that they may have my joy complete in them.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n to fafe i yire nɛ yi ki, n yi fee falama duniɲa ma, alako n ma sɛɛwɛ xa lu e bɛ, a xa lu e bɔɲɛ ma a kamalixi ra.

sentences.english: I have given your word to them; and they are hated by the world, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
sentences.susu: N to i xa masenyi fala e bɛ, duniɲa bara e xɔn, barima e tondixi birade duniɲa fe fɔxɔ ra alɔ n fan to mu tinxi birade duniɲa fe fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: My prayer is not that you will take them out of the world, but that you will keep them from the Evil One.
sentences.susu: N mu i maxandima xɛ i xa e tongo duniɲa ma. N i maxandife nɛ i xa e ratanga Sentanɛ ma.

sentences.english: They are not of the world any more than I am of the world.
sentences.susu: E mu birama duniɲa fe fɔxɔ ra, alɔ n fan to mu luma na fe mɔɔli kui.

sentences.english: Make them holy by the true word: your word is the true word.
sentences.susu: I xa e sa i yɛtɛ nan sagoe nɔndi kui. I xui nan findixi nɔndi ra.

sentences.english: Even as you have sent me into the world, so I have sent them into the world.
sentences.susu: N bara e xɛɛ duniɲa, alɔ i fan n xɛɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And for them I make myself holy, so that they may be made truly holy.
sentences.susu: N bara n yɛtɛ sa i sagoe e bɛ, alako e tan fan, e xa sa i sagoe nɔndi kui.»

sentences.english: My prayer is not for them only, but for all who will have faith in me through their word;
sentences.susu: «N mu dubama na mixie gbansan xa bɛ. N man dubama mixie bɛ naxee fama danxaniyade n ma e saabui ra.

sentences.english: May they all be one! Even as you, Father, are in me and I am in you, so let them be in us, so that all men may come to have faith that you sent me.
sentences.susu: N dubama nɛ e bɛ alako e xa findi keren na, alɔ n nun i tan n Baba Ala findixi keren na ki naxɛ. N man dubama e bɛ alako e xa findi keren na won fɔxɔ ra, won birin xa findi keren na. Na kui, duniɲa nɔma a kolonde a i tan nan n xɛɛxi.

sentences.english: And the glory which you have given to me I have given to them, so that they may be one even as we are one;
sentences.susu: I bara xunnakeli naxan fi n ma, n fan bara a fi e ma, alako e fan xa findi keren na, alɔ won tan findixi keren na ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: I in them, and you in me, so that they may be made completely one, and so that it may become clear to all men that you have sent me and that they are loved by you as I am loved by you.
sentences.susu: N tan na e i, i fan na n i, alako e xa kerenɲa xa kamali. Na kui, duniɲa a kolonma nɛ a i tan nan n xɛɛxi, a i man e tan xanuxi alɔ i n fan xanuxi ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Father, it is my desire that these whom you have given to me may be by my side where I am, so that they may see my glory which you have given to me, because you had love for me before the world came into being.
sentences.susu: «N Baba Ala, beenun duniɲa xa daa, i nu bara nɔrɛ fi n ma i xa xanunteya xa fe ra. A xɔli n ma n ma mixie, i naxee fixi n ma, nee fan xa lu n sɛɛti ma ariyanna, e xa n ma nɔrɛ to.

sentences.english: Father of righteousness, I have knowledge of you, though the world has not; and to these it is clear that you sent me;
sentences.susu: N Baba, i tinxin. N i kolon. Duniɲa tan mu i kolon, kɔnɔ e a kolon a i tan nan n xɛɛxi.

sentences.english: And I have given to them knowledge of your name, and will give it, so that the love which you have for me may be in them and I in them.
sentences.susu: N bara e rakolon i xa fe ra, n man nde sama nɛ a fari, alako xanunteya xa lu e bɔɲɛ ma i n xanuxi naxan na, alɔ n fan na e bɔɲɛ i ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: When Jesus had said these words he went out with his disciples over the stream Kedron to a garden, into which he went with his disciples.
sentences.susu: Isa to gɛ Ala maxandide, a tan nun a fɔxirabirɛe naxa siga Sediron xure naakiri ma sansi yire.

sentences.english: And Judas, who was false to him, had knowledge of the place because Jesus went there frequently with his disciples.
sentences.susu: Yudasi, naxan findi Isa yanfama ra, a fan nu na kolon, barima Isa nun a fɔxirabirɛe nu darixi e malan na mɛnni nɛ.

sentences.english: So Judas, getting a band of armed men and police from the chief priests and Pharisees, went there with lights and with arms.
sentences.susu: Yudasi naxa Rɔmakae, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie, nun Farisɛnie xa sɔɔri gali xanin naa, lanpuie nun geresosee na e yi ra. E man naxa sɛxɛ maxiri wuri ma, e a radɛxɛ alako e xa kira to.

sentences.english: Then Jesus, having knowledge of everything which was coming on him, went forward and said to them, Who are you looking for?
sentences.susu: Isa to nu fe birin kolon naxan nu fafe a lide, a naxa e ralan, a e maxɔrin, «Wo nde fenfe?»

sentences.english: Their answer was, Jesus the Nazarene. Jesus said, I am he. And Judas, who was false to him, was there at their side.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Muxu Isa Nasarɛtika nan fenfe.» Isa naxa a fala, «N tan nan na a ra.» Yudasi, naxan findi a yanfama ra, a fan nu tixi na gali ya ma.

sentences.english: And when he said to them, I am he, they went back, falling to the earth.
sentences.susu: Isa to a fala e bɛ, «N tan nan na a ra», e naxa gbilen xanbi, e bira bɔxi.

sentences.english: So again he put the question to them, Who are you looking for? And they said, Jesus the Nazarene.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo nde fenfe?» E man naxa a yaabi, «Isa Nasarɛtika.»

sentences.english: Jesus made answer, I have said that I am he; if you are looking for me, let these men go away.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «N bara a fala wo bɛ, n tan nan a ra. Xa wo n tan nan fenfe, wo a lu yi booree tan xa siga.»

sentences.english: (He said this so that his words might come true, I have kept safe all those whom you gave to me.)
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa xa masenyi nan nu fafe kamalide, a to nu bara a fala, «I mixi naxee fi n ma, keren mu lɔɛ e ya ma.»

sentences.english: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, took it out and gave the high priest's servant a blow, cutting off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.
sentences.susu: Simɔn Piyɛri naxa a xa santidɛgɛma ramini, a sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xa konyi Maliku yirefanyi tuli bolon.

sentences.english: Then Jesus said to Peter, Put back your sword: am I not to take the cup which my Father has given to me?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala Simɔn Piyɛri bɛ, «Santidɛgɛma raso a tɛɛ i. Fo n xa tin tɔɔrɛ ra Baba Ala naxan nagiri n ma.»

sentences.english: Then the band and the chief captain and the police took Jesus and put cords round him.
sentences.susu: Rɔma sɔɔri mangɛ nun a xa sɔɔrie, a nun Yuwifie xa sɔɔrie naxa Isa suxu, e a xiri,

sentences.english: They took him first to Annas, because Annas was the father-in-law of Caiaphas who was the high priest that year.
sentences.susu: e a xanin Anani xɔn ma. Anani xa di ginɛ nan dɔxɔ Kayafa xɔn. Kayafa nu bara findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi ra na ɲɛ ra.

sentences.english: It was Caiaphas who had said to the Jews that it was in their interest for one man to be put to death for the people.
sentences.susu: Kayafa nan nu bara Yuwifi kuntigie rasi, a a fan e bɛ, mixi keren nan xa faxa ɲama bɛ.

sentences.english: And Simon Peter went after Jesus with another disciple. Now that disciple was a friend of the high priest and he went in with Jesus into the house of the high priest;
sentences.susu: Simɔn Piyɛri naxa bira Isa fɔxɔ ra, a nun Isa fɔxirabirɛ gbɛtɛ nde. Na fɔxirabirɛ to nu findixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi kolon mixi ra, a naxa nɔ sode sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xa tɛtɛ kui, e Isa xanin dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: But Peter was kept outside at the door. Then this other disciple, who was a friend of the high priest, came out and had a word with the girl who kept the door, and took Peter in.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa lu tande naadɛ dɛ ra, han a boore, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi kolonma, a naxa wɔyɛn naadɛ kantama ra a xa tin Piyɛri fan xa so.

sentences.english: Then the girl who was the door-keeper said to Peter, Are you not one of this man's disciples? In answer he said, I am not.
sentences.susu: Konyi ginɛ naxan nu naadɛ kantafe, a naxa Piyɛri maxɔrin, «Na xɛmɛ Isa fɔxirabirɛ nde xa mu i fan na?» A naxa a yaabi, «Ade, n tan mu a ra!»

sentences.english: Now the servants and the police had made a fire of coals because it was cold; they were warming themselves in front of it and Peter was there with them, warming himself.
sentences.susu: Xinbeli to mini, konyie nun kɔsibilie naxa tɛ xuru, e fa lu na fɛ ma. Piyɛri fan naxa a maso e ra.

sentences.english: Then the high priest put questions to Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi naxa Isa maxɔrin a fɔxirabirɛe xa fe ma, a nun a xa kawandie.

sentences.english: Jesus made answer, I said things openly to the world at all times; I have given my teaching in the Synagogues and in the Temple to which all the Jews come; and I have said nothing secretly.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «N tan masenyie tixi kɛnɛ nan ma, duniɲa birin bɛ. N nan n ma kawandi birin tixi salidee nan kui, xa na mu hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, Yuwifie birin e luma malan na dɛnnaxɛ. N mu sese fala dunxui ra.

sentences.english: Why are you questioning me? put questions to my hearers about what I have said to them: they have knowledge of what I said.
sentences.susu: I n tan maxɔrinma munfe ra? Naxee n xui ramɛ, nee nan maxɔrin. E tan nan a kolon n bara fee naxee fala.»

sentences.english: When he said this, one of the police by his side gave him a blow with his open hand, saying, Do you give such an answer to the high priest?
sentences.susu: Isa to na fala, kɔsibili nde naxan nu tixi naa, a naxa a dɛ ragarin, a a fala, «Pe, I sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi yaabima na ki nɛ?»

sentences.english: Jesus said in answer, If I have said anything evil, give witness to the evil: but if I said what is true, why do you give me blows?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «Xa n wɔyɛn kobi nan falaxi, a masen. Kɔnɔ xa n mu wɔyɛn kobi xa falaxi, i n dɛ ragarinxi munfe ra?»

sentences.english: Then Annas sent him chained to Caiaphas, the high priest.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Anani naxa a xirixi rasanba Kayafa ma, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie xunyi.

sentences.english: But Simon Peter was still there warming himself by the fire. They said to him, Are you not one of his disciples? He said, No, I am not.
sentences.susu: Simɔn Piyɛri nu dɔxɔxi tɛ ra, a na a maxarafe. Na tɛmui e naxa a maxɔrin, «Isa fɔxirabirɛ xa mu i fan na?» Piyɛri naxa e yaabi, «Ade, a fɔxirabirɛ mu na n tan na.»

sentences.english: One of the servants of the high priest, a relation of him whose ear had been cut off by Peter, said, Did I not see you with him in the garden?
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xa konyi nde nu na naa, Piyɛri nu bara naxan barenyi tuli bolon. A naxa Piyɛri maxɔrin, «N mu i to xɛ na sansi yire, wo nun Isa?»

sentences.english: Then again Peter said, No. And straight away a cock gave its cry.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri man naxa na matandi, konkore fan naxa a rate keren na.

sentences.english: So they took Jesus from the house of Caiaphas to the Praetorium. It was early. They themselves did not go into the Praetorium, so that they might not become unclean, but might take the Passover.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, e naxa Isa tongo Kayafa xɔnyi, e a xanin gomina xɔnyi. Kuye nu baxi ibade. Yuwifi kuntigie tan mu tin sode gomina xɔnyi, alako e xa sɛniyɛnyi naxa fa kana, e mu fa nɔ Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali donyi donde.

sentences.english: So Pilate came out to them and put the question: What have you to say against this man?
sentences.susu: Na kui, gomina Pilati naxa mini e yire tande, a e maxɔrin, «Wo yi xɛmɛ kalamufe munse ma?»

sentences.english: They said to him in answer, If the man was not a wrongdoer we would not have given him up to you.
sentences.susu: E naxa a yaabi, «Xa yi xɛmɛ mu findi fe kobi raba xa ra, muxu mu fama a ra i xɔn ma nu.»

sentences.english: Then Pilate said to them, Take him yourselves and let him be judged by your law. But the Jews said to him, We have no right to put any man to death.
sentences.susu: Pilati naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo a xanin, wo xa sa a makiiti wo xa sɛriyɛ ki ma.» Yuwifie naxa a fala, «Wo xa sɛriyɛ mu tinma muxu xa mixi faxa muxu yɛtɛ ra.»

sentences.english: (That the word of Jesus might come true, pointing to the sort of death he would have.)
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa xa wɔyɛnyi nan nu fafe kamalide, a to nu bara a yɛtɛ faxa ki masen.

sentences.english: Then Pilate went back into the Praetorium and sent for Jesus and said to him, Are you the King of the Jews?
sentences.susu: Pilati man naxa so a xɔnyi, a Isa xili, a a maxɔrin, «I tan nan findixi Yuwifie xa mangɛ ra?»

sentences.english: Jesus made answer, Do you say this of yourself, or did others say it about me?
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «I wɔyɛnfe i yɛtɛ xaxili nan ma ba, ka mixie nan n ma fe fala i bɛ?»

sentences.english: Pilate said, Am I a Jew? Your nation and the chief priests have given you into my hands: what have you done?
sentences.susu: Pilati naxa a yaabi, «Pe, Yuwifi nan na n fan na? I boore Yuwifie nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nan i saxi n bɛlɛxɛ. I munse rabaxi?»

sentences.english: Jesus said in answer, My kingdom is not of this world: if my kingdom was of this world, my disciples would have made a good fight to keep me out of the hands of the Jews: but my kingdom is not here.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «N ma mangɛya mu findixi duniɲa daaxi xa ra, xa na mu a ra n ma mixie gere soma nɛ nu, e tondi n xa lu Yuwifie sago. N ma mangɛya mu findixi duniɲa daaxi ra.»

sentences.english: Then Pilate said to him, Are you then a king? Jesus made answer, You say that I am a king. For this purpose was I given birth, and for this purpose I came into the world, that I might give witness to what is true. Every lover of what is true gives ear to my voice.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Pilati naxa a maxɔrin, «I tan nan na Yuwifie xa mangɛ ra?» Isa naxa a yaabi, «I tan nan a falaxi. N barixi nɛ duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari, alako n xa nɔndi masen a birin bɛ. Mixi naxan wama nɔndi xɔn, a n xui suxuma nɛ.»

sentences.english: Pilate said to him, True? what is true? Having said this he went out again to the Jews and said to them, I see no wrong in him.
sentences.susu: Pilati man naxa a maxɔrin, «Nɔndi na di?» Pilati to na fala, a naxa mini tande Yuwifie yire, a a fala e bɛ, «N mu fe ɲaaxi yo toxi yi xɛmɛ lan a xa ɲaxankata naxan ma.

sentences.english: But every year you make a request to me to let a prisoner go free at the Passover. Is it your desire that I let the King of the Jews go free?
sentences.susu: Wo to darixi a ra n xa geelimani keren bɛɲin wo bɛ Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali lɔxɔɛ, wo wama n xa Yuwifie xa mangɛ bɛɲin wo bɛ?»

sentences.english: Then again they gave a loud cry, Not this man, but Barabbas. Now Barabbas was an outlaw.
sentences.susu: E naxa sɔnxɔɛ rate, «Ade, na mu a ra! Barabasi nan xa rabolo.» Suute nan nu Barabasi ra.

sentences.english: Then Pilate took Jesus and had him whipped with cords.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Pilati naxa yaamari fi a sɔɔrie xa Isa bulan sɛbɛrɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the men of the army made a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and they put a purple robe on him.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔrie naxa mangɛ katanyi maniyɛ yailan tunbee ra, e a sa a xun ma, e fa mangɛ donma gbeeli ragoro a ma.

sentences.english: And they kept coming and saying, Long life to the King of the Jews! And they gave him blows with their hands.
sentences.susu: E nu e masoma a ra, e nu a fala, «I kɛna, Yuwifie xa mangɛ,» e nu fa a madin.

sentences.english: And Pilate went out again and said to them, See, I let him come out to you to make it clear to you that I see no wrong in him.
sentences.susu: Pilati man naxa mini tande, a a fala Yuwifi ɲama bɛ, «N bara yi xɛmɛ masen wo bɛ, alako wo xa a kolon a n mu fefe toxi a ma a ɲaxankatama naxan ma.»

sentences.english: Then Jesus came out with the crown of thorns and the purple robe. And Pilate said to them, Here is the man!
sentences.susu: Na kui, sɔɔrie naxa Isa ramini tande, na tunbe mangɛ katanyi saxi a xun ma, burumusi gbeeli ragoroxi a ma. Pilati naxa a fala e bɛ, «A tan nan yi ki!»

sentences.english: So when the chief priests and the police saw him they gave a loud cry, To the cross! to the cross! Pilate said to them, Take him yourselves and put him on the cross: I see no crime in him.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun hɔrɔmɔbanxi kɔsibilie to a to, e naxa sɔnxɔ, «A faxa! A banban wuri magalanbuxi ma!» Pilati naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo a tongo, wo tan nan xa sa a banban wuri magalanbuxi ma, barima n tan mu fefe toxi a lan a xa faxa naxan ma.»

sentences.english: And the Jews made answer, We have a law, and by that law it is right for him to be put to death because he said he was the Son of God.
sentences.susu: Yuwifie naxa a yaabi, «Sɛriyɛ na muxu fan yi. Na sɛriyɛ ki ma, a lan a xa faxa, barima a bara a yɛtɛ findi Ala xa Di ra.»

sentences.english: When this saying came to Pilate's ears his fear became greater;
sentences.susu: Pilati to na mɛ, a naxa gaaxu ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And he went again into the Praetorium and said to Jesus, Where do you come from? But Jesus gave him no answer.
sentences.susu: A man naxa so a xɔnyi, a Isa maxɔrin, «I tan, i kelixi minden?» Kɔnɔ Isa mu yaabi yo fi.

sentences.english: Then Pilate said to him, You say nothing to me? is it not clear to you that I have power to let you go free and power to put you to death on the cross?
sentences.susu: Pilati naxa fa a fala a bɛ, «I tondixi n tan nan yaabide? I mu a kolon a nɔɛ naxan na n tan bɛ, n nɔma i rabolode, n man nɔma i faxade wuri magalanbuxi ma?»

sentences.english: Jesus gave this answer: You would have no power at all over me if it was not given to you by God; so that he who gave me up to you has the greater sin.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «Nɔɛ yo mu i bɛ n tan xun ma fo Ala naxan fixi i ma. Na nan a ra, naxan n saxi i bɛlɛxɛ, na nan xa yunubi gbo.»

sentences.english: Hearing this, Pilate had a desire to let him go free, but the Jews said in a loud voice, If you let this man go, you are not Caesar's friend: everyone who makes himself a king goes against Caesar.
sentences.susu: Pilati to na mɛ, a naxa so katafe a xa Isa rabɛɲin, kɔnɔ Yuwifie naxa sɔnxɔ, «Xa i yi xɛmɛ bɛɲin, i bara gere giri Rɔma mangɛ xungbe ma. Naxan yo a yɛtɛ findi mangɛ ra, a bara ti Rɔma mangɛ xungbe kanke.»

sentences.english: So when these words came to Pilate's ear, he took Jesus out, seating himself in the judge's seat in a place named in Hebrew, Gabbatha, or the Stone Floor.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Pilati to e xui mɛ, a naxa Isa ramini tande. Pilati naxa dɔxɔ buntunyi ra, kiitisa kibanyi kui, dɛnnaxɛ xili falama Eburu xui «Gabata».

sentences.english: (It was the day when they made ready for the Passover; and it was about the sixth hour.) And he said to the Jews, There is your King!
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Yuwifie nu na fee yailanfe Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali xa fe ra. Yanyi tagi Pilati naxa a fala Yuwifie bɛ, «Wo xa mangɛ nan ya!»

sentences.english: Then they gave a loud cry, Away with him! away with him! to the cross! Pilate said to them, Am I to put your King to death on the cross? The chief priests said in answer, We have no king but Caesar.
sentences.susu: E man naxa sɔnxɔ, «A faxa! A faxa! A banban wuri magalanbuxi ma!» Pilati naxa a fala, «N xa wo xa mangɛ faxa wuri magalanbuxi ma?» Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie naxa a yaabi, «Mangɛ yo mu na muxu tan bɛ bafe Rɔma mangɛ xungbe ra!»

sentences.english: So then he gave him up to them to be put to death on the cross. And they took Jesus away;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a naxa Isa sa e sagoe, a yaamari fi Isa xa banban wuri magalanbuxi ma. Sɔɔrie to Isa suxu,

sentences.english: And he went out with his cross on him to the place which is named Dead Man's Head (in Hebrew, Golgotha):
sentences.susu: e naxa a ramini taa kui sigafe ra «xun konkota yire,» naxan xili falama Eburu xui «Gologota.» Isa naxa siga naa, a wuri magalanbuxi ratexi a ma.

sentences.english: Where they put him on the cross with two others, one on this side and one on that, and Jesus in the middle.
sentences.susu: E Isa banban wuri magalanbuxi ma mɛnni nɛ. E naxa mixi firin gbɛtɛ fan banban, e keren ti yirefanyi ma, e boore ti kɔɔla ma, e Isa ti e tagi.

sentences.english: And Pilate put on the cross a statement in writing. The writing was: JESUS THE NAZARENE, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
sentences.susu: Pilati naxa yaamari fi a yi sɛbɛli xa gbaku Isa xun ma wuri magalanbuxi ma, «Isa Nasarɛtika, Yuwifie xa mangɛ».

sentences.english: The writing was seen by a number of the Jews, for the place where Jesus was put to death on the cross was near the town; and the writing was in Hebrew and Latin and Greek.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi gbegbe naxa na sɛbɛli xaran, barima Isa nu banbanxi dɛnnaxɛ, na makɔrɛ taa ra. Na sɛbɛli fan nu sɛbɛxi Eburu xui, Latɛni xui, a nun Girɛki xui.

sentences.english: Then the chief priests of the Jews said to Pilate, Do not put, The King of the Jews, but, He said, I am the King of the Jews.
sentences.susu: Na kui, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie naxa a fala Pilati bɛ, «I naxa a sɛbɛ ‹Yuwifie xa mangɛ›. I xa a sɛbɛ nɛ, ‹Yi xɛmɛ a fala nɛ, a Yuwifie xa mangɛ nan a ra.›»

sentences.english: But Pilate made answer, What I have put in writing will not be changed.
sentences.susu: Pilati naxa e yaabi, «N naxan sɛbɛxi, n bara gɛ na sɛbɛde.»

sentences.english: And when Jesus was nailed to the cross, the men of the army took his clothing, and made a division of it into four parts, to every man a part, and they took his coat: now the coat was without a join, made out of one bit of cloth.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔrie to gɛ Isa banbande, e naxa a xa dugie tongo, e e itaxun na sɔɔri naani ma. E naxa a xa donma fari igoroe fan tongo. Na donma to mu nu dɛgɛxi,

sentences.english: So they said among themselves, Let this not be cut up, but let us put it to the decision of chance and see who gets it. (They did this so that the Writings might come true, which say, They made a distribution of my clothing among them, and my coat they put to the decision of chance.) This was what the men of the army did.
sentences.susu: e naxa a fala e bore bɛ, «Won naxa a ibɔɔ. Won xa a tongoma sugandi bere nde ra.» Na birin naba nɛ, alako naxan sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, na xa rakamali: «E bara n ma dugie itaxun e bore ma, e n ma donma tongoma sugandi bere ra.» Sɔɔrie a raba na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Now by the side of the cross of Jesus were his mother, and his mother's sister Mary, the wife of Cleopas, and Mary Magdalene.
sentences.susu: Isa nga fan nu na a xa wuri magalanbuxi fɛ ma, a nun a nga xunya. Kolopa xa ginɛ Mariyama, nun Mariyama Magidalaka fan nu na mɛnni.

sentences.english: So when Jesus saw his mother and the disciple who was dear to him, he said to his mother, Mother, there is your son!
sentences.susu: Isa to a nga to a fɔxirabirɛ maxanuxi fɛ ma, a naxa a fala a nga bɛ, «N nga, yi bara findi i xa di ra.»

sentences.english: Then he said to the disciple, There is your mother! And from that hour the disciple took her to his house.
sentences.susu: A naxa fa a fala a fɔxirabirɛ fan bɛ, «A mato, i nga nan ya.» Keli na waxati ma, na fɔxirabirɛ naxa Isa nga xanin a xɔnyi.

sentences.english: After this, being conscious that all things had now been done so that the Writings might come true, Jesus said, Give me water.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Isa to nu a kolon a fe birin bara kamali, a naxa a fala, «Ye xɔli na n ma.» A na fala nɛ alako Kitaabui xa masenyi xa kamali.

sentences.english: Now there was a vessel ready, full of bitter wine, and they put a sponge full of it on a stick and put it to his mouth.
sentences.susu: Se sase nde nu na mɛnni, naxan nu rafexi wɛni muluxunxi ra. E naxa se nde rasin na wɛni i, e a xiri hisopi wuri kuye ra, e a maso Isa dɛ ra.

sentences.english: So when Jesus had taken the wine he said, All is done. And with his head bent he gave up his spirit.
sentences.susu: A to nde min, a naxa a fala, «A birin bara kamali!» A naxa a xun sin, a fa laaxira.

sentences.english: Now it was the day of getting ready for the Passover, and so that the bodies might not be on the cross on the Sabbath (because the day of that Sabbath was a great day), the Jews made a request to Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Yuwifie nu see rafalama Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali xa fe ra. E mu tin furee xa lu wuri magalanbuxi ma na malabu lɔxɔɛ, barima sali xungbe nan nu a ra. Na kui, e naxa Pilati mayandi a xa na mixi banbanxie sanyie gira, alako e xa faxa mafuren, e xa ba na.

sentences.english: So the men of the army came, and the legs of the first were broken and then of the other who was put to death on the cross with Jesus:
sentences.susu: Sɔɔrie naxa fa, e fa na mixi firinyi sanyie gira, naxee nu banbanxi Isa yirefanyi ma, a nun a kɔɔla ma.

sentences.english: But when they came to Jesus, they saw that he was dead by this time, and so his legs were not broken;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e to Isa li, e naxa a to a ɲan bara faxa. Na kui, e mu a tan sanyie gira,

sentences.english: But one of the men made a wound in his side with a spear, and straight away there came out blood and water.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ sɔɔri nde naxa a sɛɛti sɔxɔ tanbɛ ra, ye nun wuli naxa mini keren na.

sentences.english: And he who saw it has given witness (and his witness is true; he is certain that what he says is true) so that you may have belief.
sentences.susu: Naxan na fe toxi, a bara na fe seede ba. A xa seedeɲɔxɔya findixi nɔndi nan na. A tan yɛtɛ a kolon, a a na nɔndi nan falafe wo bɛ, alako wo fan xa danxaniya.

sentences.english: These things came about so that the Writings might be true, No bone of his body will be broken.
sentences.susu: Na fee raba nɛ alako Kitaabui xa masenyi xa kamali, naxan a masenxi, «A xɔri keren mu girama.»

sentences.english: And again another verse says, They will see him who was wounded by their spears.
sentences.susu: A man sɛbɛxi yire gbɛtɛ, «E e ya tima nɛ mixi ra, e bara naxan sɔxɔ.»

sentences.english: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, who was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, made a request to Pilate to let him take away the body of Jesus: and Pilate said he might do so. So he went and took away his body.
sentences.susu: Na fe birin xanbi, Yusufu Arimateka naxa sa Isa fure maxandi Pilati ma. Isa fɔxirabirɛ nde nan nu a ra, kɔnɔ a mu nu a masenma kɛnɛ ma, a to nu gaaxuxi Yuwifi kuntigie ya ra. Pilati to tin, Yusufu naxa sa Isa fure tongo.

sentences.english: And Nicodemus came (he who had first come to Jesus by night) with a roll of myrrh and aloes mixed, about a hundred pounds.
sentences.susu: Nikodemu, naxan nu bara siga Isa yire gundo kui kɔɛ ra tɛmui dangixi, na fan naxa labundɛ kilo tongo saxan miri nun alowe daaxi xanin Isa fure yire.

sentences.english: Then they took the body of Jesus, folding linen about it with the spices, as is the way of the Jews when they put the dead to rest.
sentences.susu: E naxa Isa fure mafilin dugie ra, e labundɛ sa a ma, alɔ Yuwifie darixi a ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Now there was a garden near the cross, and in the garden a new place for the dead in which no man had ever been put.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi nde nu makɔrɛ Isa faxade ra, gaburi nɛɛnɛ nu bara yailan dɛnnaxɛ. Fure yo mu nu ragataxi a kui sinden.

sentences.english: So they put Jesus there, because it was the Jews' day of getting ready for the Passover, and the place was near.
sentences.susu: E naxa Isa ragata na yire makɔrɛxi, barima e gbataxi Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali xa fe ra. A nu lan nɛ Yuwifie xa gɛ fe birin yailande beenun kɔɛ xa so na lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: Now on the first day of the week, very early, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene came to the place and saw that the stone had been taken away from it.
sentences.susu: Sande lɔxɔɛ Mariyama Magidalaka naxa siga gaburi yire subaxɛ ma beenun kuye xa mayalan. A to mɛnni li, a naxa a to na gɛmɛ xungbe nu bara ba gaburi dɛ ma.

sentences.english: Then she went running to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple who was loved by Jesus, and said to them, They have taken away the Lord out of the place of the dead and we have no knowledge where they have put him.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a naxa siga a gi ra Simɔn Piyɛri nun Isa fɔxirabirɛ boore yire, Isa nu naxan xanuxi, a a fala e bɛ, «E bara Marigi fure tongo gaburi kui, muxu fan mu a kolon e a saxi dɛdɛ.»

sentences.english: So Peter and the other disciple went out to the place of the dead.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Piyɛri nun Isa na fɔxirabirɛ boore fan naxa mini sigafe ra gaburi yire.

sentences.english: They went running together, and the other disciple got in front of Peter and came first to the hole in the rock;
sentences.susu: E firinyi naxa siga e gi ra, kɔnɔ Isa fɔxirabirɛ maxanuxi naxa gaburi li beenun Piyɛri singe xa naa li.

sentences.english: And looking in, he saw the linen bands on the earth; but he did not go in,
sentences.susu: A to a felen alako a xa gaburi kui mato, a naxa kasange dugie to, kɔnɔ a mu so na kui.

sentences.english: Then Simon Peter came after him and went into the hole in the rock; and he saw the linen bands on the earth,
sentences.susu: Simɔn Piyɛri to mɛnni li, a naxa so fɔnmɛ kui keren na, a fa dugi bentenyi to naxan nu saxi Isa fure ma,

sentences.english: And the cloth, which had been round his head, not with the linen bands but rolled up in a place by itself.
sentences.susu: a nun dugi naxan nu makunfukunfuxi Isa yatagi ma. Na dugi nu saxi a xati ma, a sa ki yailanxi a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Then the other disciple who came there first went in; and he saw and belief came to him.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Isa fɔxirabirɛ boore, naxan singe gaburi yire li, a fan naxa so na kui. A naxa a birin to, a danxaniya.

sentences.english: For at that time they had no knowledge that the Writings said that he would have to come again from the dead.
sentences.susu: E mu nu fahaamui sɔtɔxi Kitaabui xa masenyi ma sinden, fa fala a fo Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa keli faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: So then the disciples went away again to their houses.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi na fɔxirabirɛ firinyie naxa gbilen e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: But Mary was still there outside the hole in the rock, weeping; and while she was weeping and looking into the hole,
sentences.susu: Mariyama to nu tixi gaburi sode dɛ ra, a nu na wafe. A to a felen a xa gaburi kui mato,

sentences.english: She saw two angels in white seated where the body of Jesus had been, one at the head and the other at the feet.
sentences.susu: a naxa malekɛ firin to. E maxirixi dugi fiixɛ ra, e dɔxɔxi Isa fure nu saxi dɛnnaxɛ. Keren nu na a xunsade ra, boore nu na a sanlaabe ra.

sentences.english: They said to her, Woman, why are you weeping? She said to them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I have no knowledge where they have put him.
sentences.susu: E naxa Mariyama maxɔrin, «N ma di, i wafe munfe ma?» A naxa e yaabi, «E bara n Marigi fure tongo, n mu a kolon e a saxi dɛdɛ.»

sentences.english: And then looking round, she saw Jesus there, but had no idea that it was Jesus.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ na falade, a naxa a kobe rato, a fa mixi nde to, a tixi naa. A mu a kolon a Isa nan a ra.

sentences.english: Jesus said to her, Woman, why are you weeping? who are you looking for? She, taking him for the gardener, said to him, Sir, if you have taken him away from here, say where you have put him and I will take him away.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a maxɔrin, «N ma di, i wama munfe ra? I na nde fenfe?» Mariyama ɲɔxɔ a ma, sansi mɛɛnima nan nu a ra. Na kui, a naxa a yaabi, «N ba, xa i tan nan na fure tongoxi, i xa na yire masen n bɛ alako n xa siga a tongode.»

sentences.english: Jesus said to her, Mary! Turning, she said to him in Hebrew, Rabboni! (which is to say, Master).
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «Mariyama.» Mariyama to a mafindi, a naxa a ratin, «Rabuni!» Na nan falaxi Eburu xui, «Karamɔxɔ».

sentences.english: Jesus said to her, Do not put your hand on me, for I have not gone up to the Father: but go to my brothers and say to them, I go up to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «I naxa i bɛlɛxɛ din n na, barima n mu nu te Baba Ala yire sinden. Siga n ngaxakerenyie yire, i a fala e bɛ, a n fafe tede n Baba xɔnyi, n Marigi Ala naxan findixi wo fan Baba ra, wo fan Marigi Ala.»

sentences.english: Mary Magdalene went with the news to the disciples, and said she had seen the Lord and that he had said these things to her.
sentences.susu: Mariyama Magidalaka naxa siga xibaaru ra Isa fɔxirabirɛe yire, a a fala e bɛ, «N bara Marigi to!» A man naxa Isa xa xɛɛra iba e bɛ.

sentences.english: At evening on that day, the first day of the week, when, for fear of the Jews, the doors were shut where the disciples were, Jesus came among them and said to them, May peace be with you!
sentences.susu: Na sande lɔxɔɛ kerenyi, Isa fɔxirabirɛe nu malanxi banxi kui nunmare ra, naadɛ birin mabalanxi Yuwifi kuntigie xa yaragaaxui ma. Isa naxa mini e ma, a ti e tagi, a a fala, «Ala xa wo bɔɲɛ sa.»

sentences.english: And when he had said this, he let them see his hands and his side. Then the disciples were glad when they saw the Lord.
sentences.susu: A to na fala e bɛ, a naxa a bɛlɛxɛe nun a sɛɛti masen e bɛ. E naxa sɛɛwa Marigi tofe ra.

sentences.english: And Jesus said to them again, May peace be with you! As the Father sent me, even so I now send you.
sentences.susu: Isa man naxa a masen e bɛ, «Bɔɲɛsa xa lu wo bɛ. N bara wo xɛɛ alɔ Baba Ala n xɛɛxi ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And when he had said this, breathing on them, he said to them, Let the Holy Spirit come on you:
sentences.susu: A to gɛ na falade, a naxa foye felun e ma, a a fala, «Wo xa lu Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa goro wo ma.

sentences.english: Any to whom you give forgiveness, will be made free from their sins; and any from whom you keep back forgiveness, will still be in their sins.
sentences.susu: Xa wo diɲɛ mixi haakɛ ma, na haakɛ bara ɲɔn, kɔnɔ xa wo mu diɲɛ, na haakɛ luma a ma.»

sentences.english: Now Thomas, one of the twelve, named Didymus, was not with them when Jesus came.
sentences.susu: Isa mini a xa xɛɛra fu nun firinyie ma tɛmui naxɛ, Tomasi, e naxan xilima «guli», a mu nu na e ya ma mɛnni.

sentences.english: So the other disciples said to him, We have seen the Lord. But he said to them, If I do not see in his hands the print of the nails and put my finger into the print of the nails, and if I do not put my hand into his side, I will never have belief.
sentences.susu: Na kui, booree naxa a fala a bɛ, «Muxu bara Marigi to!» Kɔnɔ a tan naxa e yaabi, «Xa n tan mu lantuma fɔxi to a bɛlɛxɛ kui, n nan n bɛlɛxɛsole raso naa, xa n man mu n bɛlɛxɛ sa a sɛɛti ma e dɛnnaxɛ sɔxɔ, n tan mu lama a ra feo!»

sentences.english: And after eight days, his disciples were again in the house and Thomas was with them. Though the doors were shut, Jesus came, and taking his place in the middle of them, he said, May peace be with you!
sentences.susu: Xi solomasaxan dangi xanbi, Isa fɔxirabirɛe man to nu malanxi banxi kui, Tomasi nu na e ya ma. Hali naadɛ birin to nu mabalanxi, Isa naxa mini e ma mɛnni, a ti e tagi, a e xɛɛbu, «Bɔɲɛsa xa lu wo bɛ.»

sentences.english: Then he said to Thomas, Put out your finger, and see my hands; and put your hand here into my side: and be no longer in doubt but have belief.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «N bɛlɛxɛ mato. I xa i bɛlɛxɛsole sa n sɛɛti ma e dɛnnaxɛ sɔxɔ. I naxa tɛgɛ n i. I xa danxaniya.»

sentences.english: And Thomas said in answer, My Lord and my God!
sentences.susu: Tomasi naxa a fala a bɛ, «N Marigi Ala!»

sentences.english: Jesus said to him, Because you have seen me you have belief: a blessing will be on those who have belief though they have not seen me!
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen a bɛ, «I danxaniyaxi nɛ, i to bara n to? Hɛɛri na mixie bɛ naxee bara danxaniya, hali e mu n toxi.»

sentences.english: A number of other signs Jesus did before his disciples which are not recorded in this book:
sentences.susu: Isa kaabanako gbegbe raba nɛ a fɔxirabirɛe ya xɔri, naxee mu sɛbɛxi yi Kitaabui kui.

sentences.english: But these are recorded, so that you may have faith that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and so that, having this faith you may have life in his name.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ naxee xa fe tan sɛbɛxi yi ki, e sɛbɛxi nɛ alako wo xa la a ra, a Isa nan na Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra, Ala xa Di. Na kui, wo na danxaniya a ma, wo kisi sɔtɔma nɛ a saabui ra.

sentences.english: After these things Jesus let himself be seen again by the disciples at the sea of Tiberias; and it came about in this way.
sentences.susu: Na fee dangi xanbi, Isa man naxa mini a fɔxirabirɛe ma Tiberiyasi baa dɛ ra. A a yɛtɛ makɛnɛn e bɛ yi ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Simon Peter, Thomas named Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were all together.
sentences.susu: Simɔn Piyɛri, Tomasi e naxan xilima «guli,» Natanayɛli naxan keli Kaana taa Galile bɔxi ma, Sebede xa die, nun Isa fɔxirabirɛ firin gbɛtɛe, nee birin nu na yire keren.

sentences.english: Simon Peter said to them, I am going fishing. They said to him, And we will come with you. They went out and got into the boat; but that night they took no fish.
sentences.susu: Simɔn Piyɛri naxa a fala e bɛ, «N tan sigafe yɛxɛ suxude.» E naxa a fala a bɛ, «Won birin na a ra.» Na kui, e naxa mini, e baki kunkui kui, kɔnɔ na kɔɛ birin na, e mu sese suxu.

sentences.english: Now very early in the morning Jesus was there by the edge of the sea (though the disciples were not conscious that it was Jesus).
sentences.susu: Kuye to nu ibafe, Isa nu tixi baa dɛ ra, kɔnɔ a fɔxirabirɛe mu nu a kolon a a tan nan a ra.

sentences.english: So Jesus said to them, Children, have you taken any fish? They made answer, No.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e maxɔrin, «N ma die, wo bara yɛxɛ nde sɔtɔ?» E naxa a yaabi, «Ade, muxu mu sese suxuxi.»

sentences.english: And he said to them, Let down the net on the right side of the boat and you will get some. So they put it in the water and now they were not able to get it up again because of the great number of fish.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo yɛlɛ woli kunkui yirefanyi ma, wo a nde sɔtɔma nɛ.» E to a woli, e mu nu nɔma yɛlɛ ratede, barima yɛxɛ gbo a kui.

sentences.english: So the disciple who was dear to Jesus said to Peter, It is the Lord! Hearing that it was the Lord, Peter put his coat round him (because he was not clothed) and went into the sea.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isa fɔxirabirɛ, a naxan xanuxi, a naxa a fala Piyɛri bɛ, «Won Marigi na a ra.» Simɔn Piyɛri to na mɛ, a naxa donma ragoro a ma, a bagan ye ma sigafe ra Isa yire.

sentences.english: And the other disciples came in the little boat (they were not far from land, only about two hundred cubits off) pulling the net full of fish.
sentences.susu: Booree fan naxa a li kunkui kui, yɛlɛ naxan nafexi yɛxɛe ra, a xirixi kunkui ra. E mu nu makuya xare dɛ ra, fo nɔngɔn kɛmɛ firin ɲɔndɔn.

sentences.english: When they got to land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish cooking on it, and bread.
sentences.susu: E to te xare dɛ ra, e naxa tɛ xuruxi to, yɛxɛ saxi a tɛ wole ra, taami fan na na.

sentences.english: Jesus said to them, Get some of the fish which you have now taken.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo fa yɛxɛ nde ra wo baxi naxan suxude.»

sentences.english: So Peter went to the boat and came back pulling the net to land, full of great fish, a hundred and fifty-three; and though there was such a number the net was not broken.
sentences.susu: Na kui Simɔn Piyɛri naxa te kunkui kui, a yɛlɛ bɛndun xare ma. A nu rafexi yɛxɛ xungbee nan na, a gundi kɛmɛ tongo suuli nun saxan. Kɔnɔ hali yɛxɛ to nu gboxi yɛlɛ kui na ki, yɛlɛ mu ibɔɔ.

sentences.english: Jesus said to them, Come and take some food. And all the disciples were in fear of putting the question, Who are you? being conscious that it was the Lord.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo fa wo dɛge.» A fɔxirabirɛe mu suusa a maxɔrinde nde a ra, barima birin nu a kolon Marigi nan a ra.

sentences.english: Then Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and the fish in the same way.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa fa taami tongo, a a itaxun e ma, a man naxa yɛxɛ so e yi ra.

sentences.english: Now this was the third time that Jesus let himself be seen by the disciples after he had come back from the dead.
sentences.susu: A saxan nde nan nu na ki, Isa a yɛtɛ masenma a fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, kabi a keli faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: Then when they had taken food, Jesus said to Simon Peter, Simon, son of John, is your love for me greater than the love of these others? He said to him, Yes, Lord; you are certain of my love for you. He said to him, Then give my lambs food.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ e dɛ ibade, Isa naxa Simɔn Piyɛri maxɔrin, «Simɔn, Yaya xa di, i n xanuxi dangi yee birin na?» A naxa a yaabi, «Iyo, Marigi. I tan a kolon n i xanuxi ki naxɛ.» Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «Mɛɛni n ma yɛxɛɛ yɔrɛe ma.»

sentences.english: Again, a second time, he said to him, Simon, son of John, have you any love for me? Yes, Lord, he said, you are certain of my love for you. Then take care of my sheep, said Jesus.
sentences.susu: A man naxa gbilen a maxɔrin na a firin nde, «Simɔn, Yaya xa di, i n xanuxi?» A naxa a yaabi, «Iyo, Marigi. I tan a kolon n i xanuxi ki naxɛ.» Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «Mɛɛni n ma yɛxɛɛe ma.»

sentences.english: He said to him a third time, Simon, son of John, am I dear to you? Now Peter was troubled in his heart because he put the question a third time, Am I dear to you? And he said to him, Lord, you have knowledge of all things; you see that you are dear to me. Jesus said to him, Then give my sheep food.
sentences.susu: A man naxa gbilen a maxɔrin na a saxan nde, «Simɔn, Yaya xa di, i n xanuxi?» Piyɛri naxa sunnun Isa to a maxɔrin sanmaya saxan nde, «I n xanuxi?» A naxa a yaabi, «Marigi, i tan fe birin kolon. I tan a kolon n i xanuxi ki naxɛ.» Isa naxa a fala a bɛ, «Mɛɛni n ma yɛxɛɛe ma.

sentences.english: Truly I say to you, When you were young, you made yourself ready and went wherever you had a desire to go: but when you are old, you will put out your hands and another will make you ready, and you will be taken where you have no desire to go.
sentences.susu: N xa nɔndi yati nan fala i bɛ, i fonike tɛmui, i tan nan nu i yɛtɛ tagi ixirima, i wa sigafe dɛdɛ, i siga. Kɔnɔ i na fori, i i bɛlɛxɛ italama nɛ, mixi gbɛtɛ i tagi xiri, a i xanin yire i mu wama sigafe dɛnnaxɛ.»

sentences.english: Now this he said, pointing out the sort of death by which he would give God glory. And after saying this, he said to him, Come after me.
sentences.susu: Isa na fala nɛ alako a xa Piyɛri faxa ki nan masen, Piyɛri fama Ala matɔxɔde naxan saabui ra. A na fala xanbi, a naxa a fala Piyɛri bɛ, «Bira n fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: Then Peter, turning round, saw the disciple who was dear to Jesus coming after them — the disciple who was resting on his breast at the last meal, and said, Lord, who is it who will be false to you?
sentences.susu: Piyɛri to a kobe rato, a naxa Isa fɔxirabirɛ to e fɔxɔ ra, Isa nu naxan maxanuxi. Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali, a tan nan a maso Isa ra e dɛge tɛmui, a a maxɔrin, «Marigi, nde fama i yanfade?»

sentences.english: Seeing him, Peter said to Jesus, What about this man?
sentences.susu: Piyɛri to a to, a naxa Isa maxɔrin, «Marigi, na tan go?»

sentences.english: Jesus said to him, If it is my desire for him to be here till I come back, what is that to you? come yourself after me.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yaabi, «Xa n wama a xa simaya xa bu han n gbilen tɛmui, na munse fanma i tan ma? I tan xa bira n fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: So this saying went about among the brothers that this disciple would not undergo death: Jesus, however, did not say that he would not undergo death, but, If it is my desire for him to be here till I come back, what is that to you?
sentences.susu: Na kui, danxaniyatɔɛ ndee ɲɔxɔ naxa lu a ma a na fɔxirabirɛ tan mu faxama, kɔnɔ Isa mu na fala. A a fala nɛ, «Xa n wama a xa simaya xa bu han n gbilen tɛmui, na munse fanma i tan ma?»

sentences.english: This is the disciple who gives witness about these things and who put them in writing: and we have knowledge that his witness is true.
sentences.susu: Na fɔxirabirɛ yati nan yi fe birin sɛbɛ, a findi seede fanyi ra. Muxu a kolon a xa seedeɲɔxɔya findixi nɔndi nan na.

sentences.english: And Jesus did such a number of other things that, if every one was recorded, it is my opinion that even the world itself is not great enough for the books there would be.
sentences.susu: Isa fe gbegbe raba nɛ naxee mu sɛbɛxi yi Kitaabui kui. Xa na birin sɛbɛ nɛ nu, n laxi a ra a na Kitaabuie birin sade mu sɔtɔma duniɲa ma nu.

sentences.english: I have given an earlier account, O Theophilus, of all the things which Jesus did, and of his teaching from the first,
sentences.susu: Teyofilo, n bara a masen n ma Kitaabui singe kui Isa naxan birin falaxi nun a naxan nabaxi kabi a fɔlɛ

sentences.english: Till the day when he was taken up to heaven after he had given his orders, through the Holy Spirit, to the Apostles of whom he had made selection:
sentences.susu: han a te lɔxɔɛ koore ma. Beenun a xa te koore ma, a naxa yaamari fi a xa xɛɛra sugandixie ma, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra.

sentences.english: And to whom he gave clear and certain signs that he was living, after his death; for he was seen by them for forty days, and gave them teaching about the kingdom of God:
sentences.susu: A xa ɲaxankatɛ xanbi, a naxa mini e ma xi tongo naani bun ma, a a yɛtɛ masenma e bɛ kiraya wuyaxi a a ɲiɲɛ na a ra. A nu fa Ala xa mangɛya niini fe fala e bɛ.

sentences.english: And when they were all together, with him, he gave them orders not to go away from Jerusalem, but to keep there, waiting till the word of the Father was put into effect, of which, he said, I have given you knowledge:
sentences.susu: A nu e ya ma tɛmui naxɛ, a naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo naxa wo makuya Darisalamu ra. Wo xa lu be han Baba Ala a xa laayidi rakamalima tɛmui naxɛ, alɔ n na masenxi wo bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For the baptism of John was with water, but you will have baptism with the Holy Spirit, after a little time.
sentences.susu: Yaya wo xunxa ye nan xɔɔra, kɔnɔ Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nan fama gorode wo ma yi saxanyi.»

sentences.english: So, when they were together, they said to him, Lord, will you at this time give back the kingdom to Israel?
sentences.susu: Awa, xɛɛrae to e malan, e naxa Isa maxɔrin, «Marigi, i Isirayila mangɛya ragbilenma a ra yi tɛmui nɛ?»

sentences.english: And he said to them, It is not for you to have knowledge of the time and the order of events which the Father has kept in his control.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa e yaabi, «Na waxati kolonfe mu na wo tan xa ma. Na natɛ na Baba Ala keren peti nan yi ra.

sentences.english: But you will have power, when the Holy Spirit has come on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem and all Judaea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ, wo sɛnbɛ sɔtɔma Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi na fa wo ma tɛmui naxɛ. Wo findima n ma seedee nan na Darisalamu nun Yudaya birin, Samari, han duniɲa dande.»

sentences.english: And when he had said these things, while they were looking, he was taken up, and went from their view into a cloud.
sentences.susu: A to gɛ na masenyi tide, Ala naxa a rate koore ma e ya xɔri, nuxui fa a nɔxun e ya tode ra.

sentences.english: And while they were looking up to heaven with great attention, two men came to them, in white clothing,
sentences.susu: E to nu a matoma a tefe koore ma, xɛmɛ firin naxa mini e ma, sose fiixɛ ragoroxi e ma.

sentences.english: And said, O men of Galilee, why are you looking up into heaven? This Jesus, who was taken from you into heaven, will come again, in the same way as you saw him go into heaven.
sentences.susu: E naxa a masen Isa fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, «Wo tan Galilekae, munfe ra wo tixi be wo nu fa koore mato? Yi Isa naxan tongoxi wo tagi tefe koore ma, a man fama nɛ alɔ wo a toxi siga ra ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Then they went back to Jerusalem from the mountain named Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day's journey away.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi e naxa gbilen Darisalamu, kelife geya ma naxan xili Oliwi geya. Kelife na geya ma han Darisalamu, yaamilɛ keren na a ra.

sentences.english: And when they came in, they went up into the room where they were living; Peter and John and James and Andrew, Philip and Thomas, Bartholomew and Matthew, James, the son of Alphaeus, and Simon the Zealot, and Judas, the son of James.
sentences.susu: E naxa so koore banxi kui, e nu darixi e malan na dɛnnaxɛ. Naxee nu na na: Piyɛri, Yaya, Yaki, Andire, Filipu, Tomasi, Barotolome, Matiyu, Yaki Alifa xa di, Simɔn naxan findi Seloti ra, nun Yudasi, Yaki xa di.

sentences.english: And they all with one mind gave themselves up to prayer, with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and his brothers.
sentences.susu: E birin nu Ala maxandima ɲanige keren na, e nun ginɛe, a nun Mariyama, Isa nga, a nun Isa xunyae.

sentences.english: And in those days Peter got up among the brothers (there were about one hundred and twenty of them), and said,
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ nde Piyɛri naxa keli, a ti a ngaxakerenyie tagi. Mixi kɛmɛ mixi mɔxɔɲɛn ɲɔndɔn nu malanxi naa. A naxa a fala e bɛ,

sentences.english: My brothers, the word of God had to be put into effect, which the Holy Spirit had said before, by the mouth of David, about Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus,
sentences.susu: «N ngaxakerenyie, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxan masenxi Kitaabui kui Dawuda saabui ra, Yudasi xa fe ra, naxan ti mixie ya ra Isa suxufe ma, na birin bara kamali.

sentences.english: For he was numbered among us, and had his part in our work.
sentences.susu: A nu na muxu tan xɛɛrae nan ya ma. Muxu birin nan nu xɛɛra wali rabama.

sentences.english: (Now this man, with the reward of his evil-doing, got for himself a field, and falling head first, came to a sudden and violent end there.
sentences.susu: E naxa bɔxi sara yi xɛmɛ xa fe kobi rabaxi sare ra. Yudasi naxa faxa mɛnni, a bira, a furi bula, a furingɛe naxa mini a ra.

sentences.english: And this came to the knowledge of all those who were living in Jerusalem, so that the field was named in their language, Akel-dama, or, The field of blood.)
sentences.susu: Darisalamukae birin naxa yi fe kolon. E naxa na bɔxi xili fala Akeledama, na nan falaxi e xa xui ‹Wuli Bɔxi›.»

sentences.english: For in the book of Psalms it says, Let his house be waste, and let no man be living in it: and, Let his position be taken by another.
sentences.susu: «A sɛbɛxi Yabura Dawuda kui, ‹A xa banxi xa balan, mixi yo naxa sabati naa.› A man sɛbɛxi, ‹Xɛɛra gbɛtɛ xa ti a ɲɔxɔɛ ra.›

sentences.english: For this reason, of the men who have been with us all the time, while the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,
sentences.susu: Awa na kui, a lanma xɛmɛ keren xa sugandi naxan nɔma muxu malide seedeya rabade Isa xa marakeli xa fe ra. A lanma won xa mixi sugandi naxan nu na won ya ma, won nun Marigi Isa to nu a ra, kelife Yaya Isa xunxa ye xɔɔra tɛmui naxɛ, han Isa te koore ma tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: Starting from the baptism of John till he went up from us, one will have to be a witness with us of his coming back from death.
sentences.susu: <range>

sentences.english: And they made selection of two, Joseph, named Barsabbas, whose other name was Justus, and Matthias.
sentences.susu: E naxa mixi firin masen: Yusufu naxan nu xili Barasaba, e man nu naxan xili falama Yusutu, a nun Matiyasi.

sentences.english: And they made prayers and said, Lord, having knowledge of the hearts of all men, make clear which of these two has been marked out by you,
sentences.susu: Na xanbi e naxa Ala maxandi, «Marigi, i tan naxan birin bɔɲɛ ma fe kolon, a masen muxu bɛ i mixi naxan sugandixi yi firinyie tagi.

sentences.english: To take that position as a servant and Apostle, from which Judas by his sin was shut out, so that he might go to his place.
sentences.susu: Na xa findi Yudasi ɲɔxɔɛ ra xɛɛraya nun wali rabafe ra, barima Yudasi bara siga a sigade.»

sentences.english: And they put it to the decision of chance, and the decision was given for Matthias, and he was numbered with the eleven Apostles.
sentences.susu: E naxa Matiyasi sugandi Ala xa mali ra. A naxa sa yi xɛɛra fu nun kerenyie xun ma.

sentences.english: And when the day of Pentecost was come, they were all together in one place.
sentences.susu: Xɛ Xabɛ Sali to a li, Isa fɔxirabirɛe birin nu malanxi yire keren.

sentences.english: And suddenly there came from heaven a sound like the rushing of a violent wind, and all the house where they were was full of it.
sentences.susu: Xui nde naxa mini koore ma keren na alɔ foye xungbe xui. A naxa banxi kui birin nafe e nu dɔxɔxi dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And they saw tongues, like flames of fire, coming to rest on every one of them.
sentences.susu: E naxa se ndee to naxee maniya nɛnyie ra, tɛ na e ma. Na see naxa itaxun, keren keren naxa dɔxɔ kankan xunyi ma.

sentences.english: And they were all full of the Holy Spirit, and were talking in different languages, as the Spirit gave them power.
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa goro fɔxirabirɛe birin ma, e naxa so xui gbɛtɛe falafe Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra.

sentences.english: Now there were living at Jerusalem, Jews, God-fearing men, from every nation under heaven.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi diinɛlae kelife ɲamanɛ birin ma, e nu malanxi Darisalamu na saxanyi.

sentences.english: And when this sound came to their ears, they all came together, and were greatly surprised because every man was hearing the words of the disciples in his special language.
sentences.susu: Ɲama to yi xui mɛ, e naxa fa e gi ra. E naxa kaaba barima kankan nu Isa fɔxirabirɛe xui mɛma e bari xui yati nan na.

sentences.english: And they were full of wonder and said, Are not all these men Galilaeans?
sentences.susu: E dɛ naxa ixara, e fa a fala, «Pe, yi mixie naxee wɔyɛnma yi ki, Galilekae xa mu e birin na?

sentences.english: And how is it that every one of us is hearing their words in the language which was ours from our birth?
sentences.susu: Won fa won bari xui mɛfe e ra di?

sentences.english: Men of Parthia, Media, and Elam, and those living in Mesopotamia, in Judaea and Cappadocia, in Pontus and Asia,
sentences.susu: Paratokae, Medekae, Elamakae, naxee sabatixi Mesopotamiya, Yudaya, Kapadose, Pontu, Asi,

sentences.english: In Phrygia and Pamphylia, in Egypt and the parts of Libya about Cyrene, and those who have come from Rome, Jews by birth and others who have become Jews,
sentences.susu: Firigiya, Panfiliya, Misira, Libiya, Sireni bɔxi fɛ ma, a nun naxee keli Rɔma, Yuwifie a nun mixi naxee soxi e xa diinɛ ya ma, Kirɛtikae a nun Arabue,

sentences.english: Men of Crete and Arabia, to all of us they are talking in our different languages, of the great works of God.
sentences.susu: won birin na e xui mɛfe won bari xui yati nan na. E na Ala xa kaabanako fee falafe won ma xuie. Na rabaxi di?»

sentences.english: And they were all surprised and in doubt saying to one another, What is the reason of this?
sentences.susu: E birin dɛ naxa ixara, e naxa ifu. E nu a fala e bore bɛ, «Munfe yi ki?»

sentences.english: But others, making sport of them, said, They are full of new wine.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ ndee naxa e mayele, e nu fa a fala, «E siisixi nɛ yi ki.»

sentences.english: But Peter, getting up, with the eleven, said in a loud voice, O men of Judaea, and all you who are living in Jerusalem, take note of this and give ear to my words.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi Piyɛri nun yi xɛɛra fu nun kerenyie naxa keli. Piyɛri naxa a masen ɲama bɛ a xui itexi ra, «Yuwifie, a nun wo tan naxan birin na Darisalamu, wo xa wo tuli mati n na. Wo xa a kolon,

sentences.english: For these men are not overcome with wine, as it seems to you, for it is only the third hour of the day;
sentences.susu: yi mixie mu siisixi xɛ de alɔ wo a maɲɔxunxi ki naxɛ, barima gɛɛsɛgɛ na a ra yi ki.»

sentences.english: But this is the thing which was said by the prophet Joel;
sentences.susu: «Annabi Yoweli yi masenyi nan ti.

sentences.english: And it will come about, in the last days, says God, that I will send out my Spirit on all flesh; and your sons and your daughters will be prophets, and your young men will see visions, and your old men will have dreams:
sentences.susu: ‹Ala naxɛ, n fama n Xaxili taxunde mixi birin na lɔxɔɛ dɔnxɔɛe. Wo xa di xɛmɛe nun wo xa di ginɛe wɔyɛnma nɛ n tan Ala xili ra. Wo xa sɛgɛtalae to tima nɛ fee ra, wo xa forie fan xiyee sa.

sentences.english: And on my men-servants and my women-servants I will send my Spirit, and they will be prophets.
sentences.susu: Na waxati, n fama n Xaxili ragorode n ma konyi xɛmɛe nun n ma konyi ginɛe ma. E wɔyɛnma nɛ n tan Ala xili ra.

sentences.english: And wonders will be seen in heaven, and signs on the earth, blood and fire and smoke:
sentences.susu: N kaabanakoee rabama nɛ koore ma, n tɔnxumae masenma nɛ bɔxi fari, naxee findima wuli, tɛ, nun tuuri ra.

sentences.english: The sun will become dark and the moon will be turned to blood, before that great day of the Lord comes in glory:
sentences.susu: Soge dimima nɛ, kike gbeelima nɛ alɔ wuli beenun Marigi xa lɔxɔɛ xa a li, na dariyɛ lɔxɔɛ xungbe.

sentences.english: And whoever makes his prayer to the Lord will have salvation.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo naxan Marigi xili maxandima, na kanyi kisima nɛ.›»

sentences.english: Men of Israel, give ear to these words: Jesus of Nazareth, a man who had the approval of God, as was made clear to you by the great works and signs and wonders which God did by him among you, as you yourselves have knowledge,
sentences.susu: «Isirayilakae, wo wo tuli mati yi masenyi ra. Isa Nasarɛtika Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan nu a ra. Ala naxa na masen kaabanakoee, fe magaaxuxie, nun tɔnxumae ra, Isa naxan nabaxi wo tagi. Wo birin na fee kolon.

sentences.english: Him, when he was given up, by the decision and knowledge of God, you put to death on the cross, by the hands of evil men:
sentences.susu: Ala bara a ragiri kaafirie xa kafu wo ma, alako wo xa yi xɛmɛ faxa, wo a banban wuri magalanbuxi ma, alɔ Ala nu a ɲanigexi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But God gave him back to life, having made him free from the pains of death because it was not possible for him to be overcome by it.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na xanbi, Ala bara a rakeli, a faxɛ luuti ba a ma, barima faxɛ mu nu nɔma kankande a ma.»

sentences.english: For David said of him, I saw the Lord before my face at all times, for he is at my right hand, so that I may not be moved:
sentences.susu: «Dawuda nu Isa xa fe nan falafe yi masenyi ra. ‹N Marigi toma tɛmui birin n ya i. A to na n sɛɛti ma, n mu nɔma birade.

sentences.english: And for this cause my heart was glad and my tongue full of joy, and my flesh will be resting in hope:
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi n bɔɲɛ na sɛɛwɛ kui, n dɛ fan a xa fe masenma ɲɛlɛxinyi ra. N fate fan malabuma nɛ bɔɲɛsa kui,

sentences.english: For you will not let my soul be in hell and you will not give up your Holy One to destruction.
sentences.susu: barima i mu n nii bɛɲinma aligiyama, i mu i xa sɛniyɛntɔɛ luma gaburi kui, a xa bɔrɔ.

sentences.english: You have made me see the ways of life; I will be full of joy when I see your face.
sentences.susu: I bara a niya n xa kisi kira kolon. I sɛɛwɛ fima nɛ n ma i yire.›»

sentences.english: My brothers, I may say to you openly that David came to his death, and was put in the earth, and his resting-place is with us today.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri man naxa a fala, «N ngaxakerenyie, wo a lu n xa won benba Dawuda xa fe fala wo bɛ. A faxa nɛ, a naxa ragata, a xa gaburi man na won tagi be han to.

sentences.english: But being a prophet, and having in mind the oath which God had given to him, that of the fruit of his body one would take his place as a king,
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ to nu a ra, a nu a kolon Ala bara laayidi tongo a bɛ. Ala naxa a kali a Dawuda xa mamadi nde dɔxɔma nɛ a xa mangɛ kibanyi.

sentences.english: He, having knowledge of the future, was talking of the coming again of Christ from the dead, that he was not kept in hell and his body did not see destruction.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Dawuda nu a kolon Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi fama nɛ kelide faxɛ ma. Ala mu nɛɛmuma a ma aligiyama, a fate mu bɔrɔma gaburi kui.

sentences.english: This Jesus God has given back to life, of which we all are witnesses.
sentences.susu: Ala nan Isa rakelixi faxɛ ma. Won birin findixi seede ra na fe ma.

sentences.english: And so, being lifted up to the right hand of God, and having the Father's word that the Holy Spirit would come, he has sent this thing, which now you see and have knowledge of.
sentences.susu: A to rate Ala yirefanyi ma, a naxa Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi sɔtɔ Baba Ala ra, alɔ Ala laayidi tongoxi ki naxɛ. A man bara Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi ragoro won ma. Wo na nan tofe, wo na nan mɛfe yi ki.»

sentences.english: For David has not gone up into heaven, but says, himself, The Lord said to my Lord, Be seated at my right hand,
sentences.susu: «Dawuda mu texi koore ma, kɔnɔ a tan nan a fala, ‹Marigi naxa a fala n Marigi bɛ, Dɔxɔ n yirefanyi ma,

sentences.english: Till I put all those who are against you under your feet.
sentences.susu: han n xa i sanyi ti i yaxuie fari.›»

sentences.english: For this reason, let all Israel be certain that this Jesus, whom you put to death on the cross, God has made Lord and Christ.
sentences.susu: «Na kui, Isirayilaka birin xa la a ra, Ala bara Isa findi Marigi ra, nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi ra. Kɔnɔ wo bara a banban wuri magalanbuxi ma.»

sentences.english: Now when these words came to their ears their hearts were troubled, and they said to Peter and the other Apostles, Brothers, what are we to do?
sentences.susu: Yi masenyi naxa ɲama bɔɲɛ tɔɔrɔ ki fanyi ra. E naxa a fala Piyɛri nun xɛɛra booree bɛ, «N ngaxakerenyie, a lanma muxu xa munse raba fa?»

sentences.english: And Peter said, Let your hearts be changed, every one of you, and have baptism in the name of Jesus Christ, for the forgiveness of your sins; and you will have the Holy Spirit given to you.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo xa tuubi, wo birin xa wo xunxa ye xɔɔra Isa xili ra, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, alako wo xa yunubie xa xafari, wo man xa Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: For the word of God is for you and for your children and for all those who are far off, even all those who may be marked out by the Lord our God.
sentences.susu: Ala bara yi laayidi tongo wo bɛ, wo xa die bɛ, nun mixi birin bɛ a naxee xilima, hali naxee na yire makuye.»

sentences.english: And with more such words he gave his witness, offering them salvation and saying, Come out from this evil generation.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri man naxa e rasi, a naxa e ralimaniya masenyi wuyaxi ra. A naxa e maxandi, «Wo wo mɛɛni yi waxati mixi tinxintaree ma.»

sentences.english: Then those who gave hearing to his words had baptism: and about three thousand souls were joined to them that day.
sentences.susu: Naxee tin a xa masenyi ra, e naxa e xunxa ye xɔɔra. Na lɔxɔɛ mixi wulu saxan ɲɔndɔn naxa sa Isa fɔxirabirɛe xun ma.

sentences.english: And they kept their attention fixed on the Apostles' teaching and were united together in the taking of broken bread and in prayer.
sentences.susu: E nu e tunnabɛxima xɛɛrae xa xaranyi ma. E naxa lu ngaxakerenya kui. E man naxa e tunnabɛxi taami itaxunfe nun Ala maxandife ma.

sentences.english: But fear came on every soul: and all sorts of wonders and signs were done by the Apostles.
sentences.susu: Gaaxui naxa e birin suxu. Xɛɛrae naxa kaabanako nun tɔnxuma gbegbe raba.

sentences.english: And all those who were of the faith kept together, and had all things in common;
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛe birin nu malanxi yire keren. Xa mixi keren se sɔtɔ, na bara findi e birin gbe ra.

sentences.english: And exchanging their goods and property for money, they made division of it among them all, as they had need.
sentences.susu: E e xa see matima, e nu e harige itaxun e bore ma, kankan nu a hayi fan na kui.

sentences.english: And day by day, going in agreement together regularly to the Temple and, taking broken bread together in their houses, they took their food with joy and with true hearts,
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ e nu e malanma hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, e nu donse don e xɔnyi sɛɛwɛ nun bɔɲɛsa kui.

sentences.english: Giving praise to God, and having the approval of all the people; and every day the number of those who had salvation was increased by the Lord.
sentences.susu: E nu Ala matɔxɔma. E naxa rafan birin ma. Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ Marigi nu nde sama danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama kɔnti xun ma.

sentences.english: Now Peter and John were going up to the Temple at the ninth hour, the hour of prayer;
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ nde Piyɛri nun Yaya nu tefe hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, sali tɛmui gɛɛsɛgɛ.

sentences.english: And a certain man who from birth had had no power in his legs, was taken there every day, and put down at the door of the Temple which is named Beautiful, requesting money from those who went into the Temple;
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔbanxi naadɛ ra naxan xili «Naadɛ Tofanyi», xɛmɛ nde nu na naxan nu namataxi kabi a bari lɔxɔɛ. E nu a dɔxɔma na lɔxɔɛ birin alako a xa nu kɔbiri makula mixie ma naxee soma hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui.

sentences.english: He then, seeing Peter and John going into the Temple, made a request to them.
sentences.susu: A to Piyɛri nun Yaya to so ra hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, a naxa kɔbiri makula e ma.

sentences.english: And Peter, looking at him, with John, said, Keep your eyes on us.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri nun Yaya naxa e ya ti a ra. Piyɛri naxa a fala a bɛ, «Muxu mato.»

sentences.english: And he gave attention to them, hoping to get something from them.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ naxa e mato, a ɲɔxɔ naxa lu a ma e na kɔbiri nan fife a ma.

sentences.english: But Peter said, I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give to you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up on your feet.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri fa a fala a bɛ, «Gbeti mu na n yi, xɛɛma mu na n yi, kɔnɔ naxan na n yi ra, n a fima i ma. N bara i yaamari Isa Nasarɛtika xili ra, naxan findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra, keli, i i ɲɛrɛ!»

sentences.english: And he took him by his right hand, lifting him up; and straight away his feet and the bones of his legs became strong,
sentences.susu: A naxa a suxu a yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛ ma, a a rakeli. A sanyie nun a sankɔnyie naxa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ keren na.

sentences.english: And, jumping up, he got on to his feet and went into the Temple with them, walking and jumping and giving praise to God.
sentences.susu: Na ikɔrɛxi ra, a naxa keli, a naxa so a ɲɛrɛfe. A naxa so Piyɛri nun Yaya fɔxɔ ra hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui. A ɲɛrɛma, a tuganma, a Ala tantuma.

sentences.english: And all the people saw him walking and praising God:
sentences.susu: Birin naxa a to, a a ɲɛrɛma, a Ala matɔxɔma.

sentences.english: And they saw that it was the man who made requests for money at the door of the Temple, and they were full of wonder and surprise at what had taken place.
sentences.susu: E naxa a kolon a tan nan nu dɔxɔma hɔrɔmɔbanxi «Naadɛ Tofanyi» dɛ ra kulɛ matide. Birin naxa kaaba, e tɛrɛnna yi fe ra naxan bara raba a bɛ.

sentences.english: And while he kept his hands on Peter and John, all the people came running together to the covered way which is named Solomon's, full of wonder.
sentences.susu: A fan naxa bira Piyɛri nun Yaya fɔxɔ ra. Ɲama birin naxa kaaba, e naxa e gi sigafe ra e yire Sulemani xa buntunyi ra.

sentences.english: And when Peter saw it he said to the people, You men of Israel, why are you so greatly surprised at this man? or why are you looking at us as if by our power or virtue we had given him the use of his legs?
sentences.susu: Piyɛri to na to, a naxa ɲama maxɔrin, «Wo tan Isirayilakae, munfe ra wo kaabama yi fe ma? Munfe ra wo wo yae banbanxi muxu ra alɔ muxu yi xɛmɛ raɲɛrɛxi muxu yɛtɛ sɛnbɛ nan na, xa na mu a ra muxu xa tinxinyi ra?

sentences.english: The God of Abraham, of Isaac, and of Jacob, the God of our fathers, has given glory to his servant Jesus; whom you gave up, turning your backs on him, when Pilate had made the decision to let him go free.
sentences.susu: Annabi Iburahima, Annabi Isiyaga, nun Annabi Yaxuba Marigi Ala, won benbae Marigi Ala, a bara a xa dariyɛ fi a xa konyi Isa ma, wo naxan yanfa, wo fa mɛɛ a ra Pilati ya i, naxan nu wama a rabɛɲinfe.

sentences.english: But you would have nothing to do with the Holy and Upright One, and made request for a man of blood to be given to you,
sentences.susu: Wo bara Ala xa sɛniyɛntɔɛ nun a xa tinxintɔɛ yanfa. Wo man fa maxandi ti Pilati xa faxɛti nde rabɛɲin wo bɛ.

sentences.english: And put to death the Lord of life; whom God gave back from the dead; of which fact we are witnesses.
sentences.susu: Wo bara Marakisima faxa, Ala naxa a rakeli faxɛ ma. Muxu na na fe seede ra.

sentences.english: And his name, through faith in his name, has made this man strong, whom you see and have knowledge of: yes, the faith which is through him has made him well, before you all.
sentences.susu: Yi xɛmɛ naxan yi ki, wo naxan kolon, wo naxan toxi, a bara sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ danxaniya kui Isa xili saabui ra. A xa danxaniya Isa ma, na nan a yalanxi wo birin ya xɔri.»

sentences.english: And now, my brothers, I am conscious that you did this, as did your rulers, without knowledge.
sentences.susu: «Yakɔsi, n ngaxakerenyie, n a kolon wo naxan nabaxi Isa ra, wo bara a raba a kolontareya ma, wo nun wo xa mangɛe.

sentences.english: But the things which God had made clear before, by the mouth of all the prophets, that the Christ would have to undergo, he has put into effect in this way.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala nan yi birin nagirixi, alako a xa wɔyɛnyi xa rakamali, a nu bara naxan masen waxati dangixi a xa namiɲɔnmɛe dɛ ra, a falafe a a xa Mixi Sugandixi fama nɛ tɔɔrɔde.

sentences.english: So then, let your hearts be changed and be turned to God, so that your sins may be completely taken away, and times of blessing may come from the Lord;
sentences.susu: Awa, wo tuubi, wo gbilen Ala ma, alako wo xa yunubie xa xafari,

sentences.english: And that he may send the Christ who was marked out for you from the first, even Jesus:
sentences.susu: alako Marigi xa fa bɔɲɛsa waxati ra, a man xa Isa xɛɛ, a bara naxan sugandi wo bɛ.

sentences.english: Who is to be kept in heaven till the time when all things are put right, of which God has given word by the mouth of his holy prophets, who have been from the earliest times.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa lu koore ma sinden, han beenun fe birin xa yailan, alɔ Ala a masen ki naxɛ a xa namiɲɔnmɛ sɛniyɛnxie kɛrɛ ra kafi a xɔnnakuye ra.»

sentences.english: For Moses said, The Lord will give you a prophet from among your people, like me; you will give ear to everything which he will say to you.
sentences.susu: «Annabi Munsa naxa a fala, ‹Wo Marigi Ala namiɲɔnmɛ nde xɛɛma nɛ wo ma alɔ n tan. Won ngaxakerenyi nan lanxi a ma. A naxan birin falama wo bɛ, wo xa a suxu.

sentences.english: And every soul who does not give attention to that prophet, will be cut off from among the people.
sentences.susu: Naxan yo mu na namiɲɔnmɛ xui suxu, na kanyi bama nɛ Ala xa ɲama ya ma, a faxa.›»

sentences.english: And all the prophets from Samuel and those who came after, every one of them, gave word of these days.
sentences.susu: «Namiɲɔnmɛ naxee birin bara wɔyɛn kabi Annabi Samuweli xa tɛmui, e birin bara yi lɔxɔɛe xa fe fala.

sentences.english: You are the sons of the prophets, and of the agreement which God made with your fathers, saying to Abraham, Through your seed a blessing will come on all the families of the earth.
sentences.susu: Saatɛ die nun namiɲɔnmɛ die nan na wo ra. Ala bara saatɛ tongo won babae bɛ. A a fala nɛ Iburahima bɛ, ‹Duniɲa birin fama hɛɛri sɔtɔde i bɔnsɔɛ nan saabui ra.›

sentences.english: To you, first, God sent his servant, blessing you by turning every one of you from his sins.
sentences.susu: Ala to bara a xa konyi rakeli faxɛ ma, a a xɛɛ wo tan nan singe ma, a xa duba wo bɛ, a xa kankan nagbilen fe kobie fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: And while they were talking to the people, the priests and the captain of the Temple and the Sadducees came up to them,
sentences.susu: Yaya nun Piyɛri to nu wɔyɛnma mixie bɛ, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe, hɔrɔmɔbanxi sɔɔri yarerati, nun Sadusenie naxa fa.

sentences.english: Being greatly troubled because they were teaching the people and preaching Jesus as an example of the coming back from the dead.
sentences.susu: E bɔɲɛ naxa te barima Piyɛri nun Yaya nu ɲama xaranfe, a falafe mixi faxaxie fama nɛ rakelide alɔ Isa rakelixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And they took them and put them in prison till the morning, for it was now evening.
sentences.susu: E naxa e suxu, e e sa geeli han na kuye iba, barima kɔɛ nu bara so.

sentences.english: But a number of those who gave hearing to the word had faith; and they were now about five thousand.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi wuyaxi naxee na wɔyɛnyi mɛ, e naxa a suxu. Danxaniyatɔɛe xun naxa masa, han xɛmɛe kɔnti naxa wulu suuli ɲɔndɔn li.

sentences.english: And on the day after, the rulers and those in authority and the scribes came together in Jerusalem;
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Yuwifi yareratie, forie, nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe naxa e malan Darisalamu,

sentences.english: And Annas, the high priest, was there, and Caiaphas and John and Alexander, and all the relations of the high priest.
sentences.susu: a nun Anani sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi, nun Kayafa, Yaya, Alesandire, a nun naxee birin na sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi bɔnsɔɛ.

sentences.english: Then sending for Peter and John, they said, By what power and in whose name have you done this?
sentences.susu: E naxa Piyɛri nun Yaya ti e tagi, e naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo nɔxi yi rayalande di? Wo a rayalanxi saabui mundun na?»

sentences.english: Then Peter, being full of the Holy Spirit, said to them, O you rulers of the people and men of authority,
