sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a masen e bɛ muxu a rayalanxi Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nan saabui ra,

sentences.english: If we are questioned today about a good work done to a man who was ill, as to how he has been made well,
sentences.susu: «Isirayila forie nun kuntigie, wo bara muxu maxɔrin yi namatɛ xa fe fanyi sɔtɔɛ ma, a yalanxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Take note, all of you, and all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you put to death on the cross, whom God gave back from the dead, even through him is this man now before you completely well.
sentences.susu: Wo tan nun Isirayilakae birin xa a kolon yi xɛmɛ yalanxi Isa Nasarɛtika, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, xili saabui nan na. Wo Isa naxan banban wuri magalanbuxi ma, Ala naxan nakeli faxɛ ma, a tan nan xili yi namatɛ rayalanxi.

sentences.english: He is the stone which you builders had no use for, but which has been made the chief stone of the building.
sentences.susu: Isa maniyaxi ‹gɛmɛ nan na naxan tide gbo dangi gɛmɛ birin na, kɔnɔ wo tan banxitie bara mɛɛ na gɛmɛ ra.›

sentences.english: And in no other is there salvation: for there is no other name under heaven, given among men, through which we may have salvation.
sentences.susu: Kisi mu sɔtɔma ndende ra fo a tan, barima xili gbɛtɛ yo mu na duniɲa, won kisima naxan saabui ra.»

sentences.english: Now when they saw that Peter and John were without fear, though they were men of no education or learning, they were greatly surprised; and they took note of them that they had been with Jesus.
sentences.susu: E naxa kaaba Piyɛri nun Yaya xa limaniya ma, barima xarantaree nan nu e ra. E naxa a kolon e nu bara bira Isa fɔxɔ ra a nu na duniɲa ma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And, seeing that the man who had been made well was there with them, they were not able to say anything against it.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xɛmɛ to nu tixi e sɛɛti ma, a yalanxi, e mu nɔ sese falade.

sentences.english: But when they had given them orders to go out of the Sanhedrin, they had a discussion among themselves,
sentences.susu: E naxa Piyɛri, Yaya, nun na xɛmɛ yaamari e xa mini Yuwifi kiitisae ya ma. E nu fa wɔyɛn e bore tagi.

sentences.english: Saying, What are we to do with these men? for certainly it is clear to all who are living in Jerusalem that a most important sign has been done by them, and it is not possible to say that it is not so.
sentences.susu: E naxa e bore maxɔrin, «Won xa munse raba yi mixie ra? Darisalamukae birin bara a kolon e kaabanako xungbe nan nabaxi. Won fan mu nɔma na matandide.

sentences.english: But so that it may not go farther among the people, let us put them in fear of punishment if they say anything in future in this name.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ alako yi fe naxa yensen yɛ mixie ra, won xa e ratɔn a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra, e naxa wɔyɛn Isa xili ra sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: And they sent for them, and gave them orders not to make statements or give teaching in the name of Jesus.
sentences.susu: E naxa Piyɛri, Yaya, nun na xɛmɛ xili. E naxa wɔyɛn e bɛ a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra, a e naxa masenyi yo ti, e naxa mixi yo xaran Isa xili ra sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: But Peter and John in answer said to them, It is for you to say if it is right in the eyes of God to give attention to you more than to God:
sentences.susu: Piyɛri nun Yaya naxa e yaabi, «Wo a mato, a lanma muxu xa bira wo tan nan fɔxɔ ra ba, ka Ala?

sentences.english: For it is not possible for us to keep from saying what we have seen and have knowledge of.
sentences.susu: Muxu mu nɔma dundude fe ma muxu bara naxan to, muxu bara naxan mɛ.»

sentences.english: And when they had said more sharp words to them, they let them go, not seeing what punishment they might give them, because of the people; for all men were giving praise to God for what had taken place.
sentences.susu: E man naxa xaaɲɛ e ma, kɔnɔ ɲama birin to nu Ala matɔxɔma fe ma naxan bara raba, e mu nɔ lande a ma a lanma e xa e ɲaxankata ki naxɛ. E naxa e rabɛɲin.

sentences.english: For the man on whom this act of power was done was more than forty years old.
sentences.susu: Yi xɛmɛ naxan nayalanxi, a xa simaya nu bara dangi ɲɛ tongo naani ra.

sentences.english: And when they had been made free, they came back to their friends, and gave an account of all the things which the chief priests and the authorities had said to them.
sentences.susu: E to e bɛɲin, Piyɛri nun Yaya naxa siga e booree yire. E naxa fe birin yaba e bɛ sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie nun forie naxan fala e bɛ.

sentences.english: And hearing it, they all, with one mind, made prayer to God and said, O Lord, maker of heaven and earth and the sea and all things in them:
sentences.susu: E to na mɛ, e birin naxa e xui ite Ala ma ɲanige keren fari. E naxa a maxandi, «Marigi, i tan naxan koore daa, a nun bɔxi, a nun baa, a nun se naxan birin na duniɲa,

sentences.english: Who has said, by the Holy Spirit, through the mouth of our father David your servant, Why are the nations so violently moved, and why are the thoughts of the people so foolish?
sentences.susu: i tan nan a fala Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra, i xa konyi Dawuda dɛ ra, muxu baba, ‹Munfe ra sie bɔɲɛ texi fufafu? Munfe ra ɲamae matandi tife?

sentences.english: The kings of the earth were lifted up, the rulers came together, against the Lord, and against his Christ:
sentences.susu: Duniɲa mangɛe bara keli, xunmatie bara ti Marigi nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi kanke.›»

sentences.english: For, truly, in this town, against your holy servant, Jesus, who was marked out by you as Christ, Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, came together,
sentences.susu: «Nɔndi na a ra, Herode, Ponsi Pilati, xɔɲɛe, a nun Isirayila bɔnsɔɛe bara ti i xa konyi sɛniyɛnxi Isa kanke, i naxan sugandixi,

sentences.english: To do that which had been fixed before by your hand and your purpose.
sentences.susu: alako e xa fe birin naba i singe nu bara natɛ tongo a nu lan naxan xa raba.

sentences.english: And now, Lord, take note of their cruel words, and give your servants power to be preachers of your word without fear,
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, Marigi, i xa a mato e xaaɲɛxi ki naxɛ. Sɛnbɛ fi i xa konyie ma, alako e xa nɔ i xa wɔyɛnyi masende limaniya ra.

sentences.english: While your hand is stretched out to do works of mercy; so that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy servant Jesus.
sentences.susu: I bɛlɛxɛ itala, alako mixi xa rayalan, kaabanakoee nun tɔnxumae xa raba i xa konyi sɛniyɛnxi Isa xili ra.»

sentences.english: And when their prayer was ended, the place where they were was violently moved, and they all became full of the Holy Spirit, preaching the word of God without fear.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ Ala maxandide, e nu malanxi dɛnnaxɛ, na naxa sɛrɛn. Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa goro e birin ma. E naxa so Ala xa wɔyɛnyi masenfe limaniya ra.

sentences.english: And all those who were of the faith were one in heart and soul: and not one of them said that any of the things which he had was his property only; but they had all things in common.
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama birin bɔɲɛ ma fe naxa lu keren. Mixi yo mu a falama a keren gbe nan na se nde ra, kɔnɔ se birin naxa findi birin gbe ra.

sentences.english: And with great power the Apostles gave witness of the coming back of the Lord Jesus from the dead; and grace was on them all.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛrae naxa Marigi Isa xa marakeli masen mixie bɛ sɛnbɛ ra. Ala naxa hinnɛ e ra a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And no one among them was in need; for everyone who had land or houses, exchanging them for money, took the price of them,
sentences.susu: Setare yo mu nu na e ya ma, barima xɛe nun banxie nu na naxee birin yi ra, e nu e matima nɛ,

sentences.english: And put it at the feet of the Apostles for distribution to everyone as he had need.
sentences.susu: e nu a sare dɛntɛgɛ xɛɛrae bɛ. Nee nu fa a itaxun kankan hayi bɛrɛ ma.

sentences.english: And Joseph, who was given by the Apostles the name of Barnabas (the sense of which is, Son of comfort), a Levite and a man of Cyprus by birth,
sentences.susu: Mixi nde nu na naxan xili Yusufu, Lewi di naxan barixi Sipiri. Xɛɛrae nu a xili falama nɛ Baranabasi, na nan falaxi «mixi ralimaniya».

sentences.english: Having a field, got money for it and put the money at the feet of the Apostles.
sentences.susu: A naxa xɛ mati naxan nu na a yi, a naxa fa a kɔbiri ra, a a dɛntɛgɛ xɛɛrae bɛ.

sentences.english: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, got money for his property,
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ nde naxan xili Ananiyasi, a nun a xa ginɛ Safira, nee fan naxa e xa xɛ mati.

sentences.english: And kept back part of the price, his wife having knowledge of it, and took the rest and put it at the feet of the Apostles.
sentences.susu: Ananiyasi nun a xa ginɛ naxa lan a ma e xa xɛ sare nde ragata e yɛtɛ bɛ. Ananiyasi naxa kɔbiri dɔnxɔɛ xanin, a a dɛntɛgɛ xɛɛrae bɛ.

sentences.english: But Peter said, Ananias, why has the Evil One put it into your heart to be false to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back part of the price of the land?
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a fala a bɛ, «Ananiyasi, munfe ra Sentanɛ i madaxuxi han i bara wule fala Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi bɛ yi xɛ sare nde nɔxunfe ra?

sentences.english: While you had it, was it not your property? and after you had given it in exchange, was it not still in your power? how has this purpose come into your mind? you have been false, not to men, but to God.
sentences.susu: Beenun i xa yi xɛ mati, i gbe xa mu nu na xɛ ra? I kɔbiri naxan sɔtɔxi, i gbe xa mu nu na fan na? Munfe ra i yi fe mɔɔli rabaxi? I mu wule falaxi mixie xa bɛ, i wule falaxi Ala nan bɛ.»

sentences.english: And at these words, Ananias went down on the earth, and his life went from him: and great fear came on all who were present.
sentences.susu: Ananiyasi to na wɔyɛnyi mɛ, a naxa bira keren na, a faxa. Naxee birin na fe mɛ, e naxa gaaxu.

sentences.english: And the young men went and made ready his body, and took it out, and put it in the earth.
sentences.susu: Sɛgɛtalae to keli, e naxa a kasange, e a xanin, e sa a ragata.

sentences.english: And about three hours after, his wife, having no knowledge of what had taken place, came in.
sentences.susu: Waxati saxan to dangi, a xa ginɛ naxa so, a mu nu a kolon fe naxan nabaxi.

sentences.english: And Peter said to her, Give me an answer: was this amount of money the price of the land? And she said, Yes, it was.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a fala a bɛ, «A fala n bɛ, xa wo xɛ matixi yi xasabi nan na, wo naxan dɛntɛgɛxi yi ki?» A naxa a yaabi, «Iyo, muxu a matixi yi kɔbiri nan na.»

sentences.english: But Peter said to her, Why have you made an agreement together to be false to the Spirit of the Lord? See, the feet of the young men who have put the body of your husband in the earth, are at the door, and they will take you out.
sentences.susu: Awa, Piyɛri naxa a fala a bɛ, «Munfe ra wo lanxi a ma wo xa Ala Xaxili madaxu? Naxee i xa mɔri ragataxi, e tan nan tixi naadɛ ra yi ki, e i fan xaninma ya.»

sentences.english: And straight away she went down at his feet, and her life went from her: and the young men came in and saw her dead, and they took her out and put her in the earth with her husband.
sentences.susu: A naxa bira xɛɛra bun ma keren na, a faxa. Sɛgɛtalae to so, e naxa a li a fan bara faxa. E naxa a xanin, e sa a fan nagata a xa mɔri fɛ ma.

sentences.english: Then great fear came on all the church and on all who had knowledge of these things.
sentences.susu: Gaaxui xungbe naxa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama birin suxu, a nun naxee birin yi fe mɛ.

sentences.english: Now a number of signs and wonders were done among the people by the hands of the Apostles; and they were all together in Solomon's covered way.
sentences.susu: Kaabanako wuyaxi nun tɔnxumae nu rabama ɲama tagi xɛɛrae saabui ra. Togondiyatɔɛ birin nu e malanma Sulemani xa buntunyi ra.

sentences.english: The others, in fear, kept back from joining them: but the people made much of them;
sentences.susu: Mixi gbɛtɛ yo mu nu suusama sunbude e ra, kɔnɔ mixie nu e binyama a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And a great number of men and women had faith, and were joined to the Lord;
sentences.susu: Naxee nu danxaniyaxi Marigi ma, xɛmɛe nun ginɛe, e kɔnti xun nu masama tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: And they even took into the streets people who were ill, and put them on beds, so that when Peter went by, some of them might be in his shade.
sentences.susu: Na fee ma, mixie nu fama nɛ furemae ra sade nun dagie ma kira xɔn, alako Piyɛri nɛ dangima tɛmui naxɛ, a niini xa ti e ma.

sentences.english: And numbers of people came together from the towns round about Jerusalem, with those who were ill and those who were troubled with unclean spirits: and they were all made well.
sentences.susu: Ɲama nu kelima Darisalamu rabilinyi, e nu fa furemae ra nun ɲinnɛ fure kanyie. E birin naxa yalan.

sentences.english: But the high priest and those who were with him (the Sadducees) were full of envy,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi, a nun naxee nu na a fɔxɔ ra, naxee findixi Sadusenie ra, e naxa natɛ tongo tɔɔnɛ ma.

sentences.english: And they took the Apostles and put them in the common prison.
sentences.susu: E naxa xɛɛrae suxu, e e woli geeli.

sentences.english: But in the night an angel of the Lord, opening the doors of the prison, took them out and said,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Marigi xa malekɛ naxa fa kɔɛ ra, a naxa geeli naadɛ rabi, a fa e ramini. A naxa a fala e bɛ,

sentences.english: Go, take your place in the Temple and give the people all the teaching about this Life.
sentences.susu: «Wo siga, wo sa ti hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, wo Ala xa kira nɛɛnɛ xa fe birin tagi raba ɲama bɛ.»

sentences.english: And hearing this, they went into the Temple at dawn, and were teaching. But the high priest and those who were with him got together the Sanhedrin and the representatives of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to get them.
sentences.susu: E to na mɛ, e naxa so hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui subaxɛ ma, e kawandi ti fɔlɔ. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi nun naxee nu na a fɔxɔ ra, e to fa, e naxa Yuwifi kiitisae nun Isirayila fori birin malan. E naxa mixie rasiga xɛɛrae tongode geeli kui.

sentences.english: But the men who were sent saw that they were not in the prison, and came back with the news,
sentences.susu: Sɔrie to siga, e mu e li geeli kui. E naxa gbilen, e sa dɛntɛgɛ sa.

sentences.english: Saying, The doors of the prison were safely shut, and the keepers were at the doors, but when they were open, there was nobody inside.
sentences.susu: E naxɛ, «Muxu bara geeli li a balanxi a fanyi ra, geeli kantamae tixi naadɛ ra, kɔnɔ muxu to a rabi, muxu mu mixi yo lixi a kui.»

sentences.english: Now, at these words, the captain of the Temple and the chief priests were greatly troubled about what might be the end of this business.
sentences.susu: Hɔrɔmɔbanxi sɔɔrie xa mangɛ nun sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie to na fe mɛ, e dɛ naxa ixara. E nu fa e bore maxɔrin, «Munfe yi ra?»

sentences.english: And someone came and said to them, The men, whom you put in prison, are in the Temple teaching the people.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde naxa fa a fala e bɛ, «Wo fa a mato, wo xɛmɛ naxee sa geeli, e na hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui e mixie xaranfe.»

sentences.english: Then the captain and some of the police went and took them, but not violently, for fear that they might be stoned by the people.
sentences.susu: Awa, sɔɔri xunmati nun a xa sɔɔrie naxa siga, e sa fa xɛɛrae ra. Kɔnɔ e mu e sɛnbɛ ramini e ma, barima e nu gaaxuxi ɲama fa e magɔnɔfe gɛmɛ ra.

sentences.english: And they took them into the Sanhedrin, and the high priest said to them,
sentences.susu: E to bara e xanin Yuwifi kiitisae yire, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi naxa e maxɔrin,

sentences.english: We gave you very clear orders not to give teaching in this name: and now Jerusalem is full of your teaching, and you are attempting to make us responsible for this man's death.
sentences.susu: «Muxu bara wo ratɔn a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra, wo naxa xaranyi raba yi xɛmɛ xili ra, kɔnɔ wo bara wo xa xaranyi ralantan Darisalamu birin na. Wo wama a xa faxɛ safe muxu tan nan xun!»

sentences.english: But Peter and the Apostles, answering, said, We have to do the orders of God, not of man.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri nun xɛɛrae naxa e yaabi, «A lanma muxu xa Ala xui nan nabatu dangife mixie xui ra.

sentences.english: The God of our fathers gave Jesus back to life, whom you had put to death, hanging him on a tree.
sentences.susu: Won babae Marigi Ala bara Isa rakeli, wo naxan faxa, wo naxan banban wuri ma.

sentences.english: Him God has put on high at his right hand, as a Ruler and a Saviour, to give to Israel a change of heart and forgiveness of sins.
sentences.susu: Ala bara a rate a yirefanyi ma a xa findi Mangɛ nun Marakisima ra, alako Isirayila xa nɔ tuubide, e xa yunubi xa xafari.

sentences.english: And we are witnesses of these things, and so is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who keep his laws.
sentences.susu: Muxu nun Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi na yi fe seedee ra. Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi fima mixi nan ma, naxan na a xui rabatu.»

sentences.english: But when these words came to their ears, they were cut to the heart, and had a mind to put them to death.
sentences.susu: E to yi masenyi mɛ, e naxa xɔnɔ han e naxa wa xɛɛrae faxafe.

sentences.english: But one of the Sanhedrin, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a man of learning in the law, of whom all the people had a high opinion, got up and made a suggestion for the men to be put outside for a little time.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Farisɛni nde naxan xili Gamaliyɛli, sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ kuntigi naxan nu rafan ɲama birin ma, na naxa keli Yuwifi kiitisae tagi. A naxa yaamari fi e xa xɛɛrae ramini sinden.

sentences.english: And he said to them, Men of Israel, take care what you do about these men.
sentences.susu: Awa, a naxa a fala kiitisae bɛ, «Isirayilakae, wo mɛɛni fe ma wo naxan nabama yi mixie ra.

sentences.english: For before this there was Theudas, who said he was someone important, to whom about four hundred men gave their support: he was put to death, and his band was broken up and came to nothing.
sentences.susu: Waxati dangixi xɛmɛ nde naxan xili Tudasi naxa a yɛtɛ igbo. Mixi kɛmɛ naani nan nu biraxi a fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ a to faxa e birin naxa yensen yɛ. A xa fe mu findi fefe ra.»

sentences.english: After this man, there was Judas of Galilee, at the time of the numbering, and some of the people went after him: he was put to death, and all his supporters were put to flight.
sentences.susu: «Na to dangi, Yudasi Galileka naxa mini xili sɛbɛ tɛmui. A naxa mixi wuyaxi bɛndun a ma, kɔnɔ a fan naxa faxa, a fɔxirabirɛe birin naxa yensen yɛ.

sentences.english: And now I say to you, Do nothing to these men, but let them be: for if this teaching or this work is of men, it will come to nothing:
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n a falama wo bɛ, wo naxa fefe raba yi mixie ra. Wo gbilen e fɔxɔ ra. Xa yi fe birin fatanxi mixie nan na, a mu sɔɔnɛyama.

sentences.english: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overcome them, and you are in danger of fighting against God.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ, xa a fatanxi Ala nan na, wo mu nɔma a xun nakanade. Wo wo ɲɛrɛ ki mato a fanyi ra, wo nun Ala naxa fa gere.»

sentences.english: And he seemed to them to be right: and they sent for the Apostles, and, after having them whipped and giving them orders to give no teaching in the name of Jesus, they let them go.
sentences.susu: E to lan fe keren ma, e naxa xɛɛrae xili, e e bɔnbɔ. E naxa e ratɔn wɔyɛnfe ra Isa xili ra, e fa e rabɛɲin.

sentences.english: So they went away from the Sanhedrin, happy to undergo shame for the Name.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛrae to mini Yuwifi kiitisae tagi, e naxa ɲɛlɛxin barima Ala e tan nan sugandixi, e xa tɔɔrɔ Isa xili xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And every day, in the Temple and privately, they went on teaching and preaching Jesus as the Christ.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ, e nu kawandi tima hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, e man mixie xaranma e xɔnyi. E nu Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa xibaaru fanyi masenma nɛ tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was increasing, protests were made by the Greek Jews against the Hebrews, because their widows were not taken care of in the distribution of food every day.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Isa fɔxirabirɛe kɔnti xun to nu masama, Yuwifie naxee Girɛki xui falama, e naxa e mawa Yuwifie xɔn naxee Eburu xui falama, barima lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ donse itaxunma tɛmui naxɛ, e nu nɛɛmuma nɛ kaaɲɛ ginɛe ma naxee Girɛki xui falama.

sentences.english: And the Apostles sent for all the disciples and said, It is not right for us to give up preaching the word of God in order to make distribution of food.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛra fu nun firinyi naxa Isa fɔxirabirɛe malan, e naxa a fala e bɛ, «A mu lan muxu xa Ala xa masenyi kawandife rabolo donse itaxun fe ra.

sentences.english: Take then from among you seven men of good name, full of the Spirit and of wisdom, to whom we may give control of this business.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, n ngaxakerenyie, wo xɛmɛ solofere sugandi wo ya ma, mixi binyee, xaxilimaya nun Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi na naxee bɛ. Muxu xa yi donse itaxunfe so e yi ra,

sentences.english: Then we will give all our time to prayer and the teaching of the word.
sentences.susu: alako muxu tan xa nu lu Ala maxandi ra nun Ala xui kawandi ra.»

sentences.english: And this saying was pleasing to all of them: and they made selection of Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, and Philip and Prochorus and Nicanor and Timon and Parmenas and Nicolas of Antioch, who had become a Jew:
sentences.susu: Na masenyi naxa rafan birin ma. E naxa Etiyɛn sugandi, xɛmɛ naxan xa danxaniya nu gbo, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi man nu goroxi naxan ma. E man naxa Filipu, Pirokoru, Nikanoro, Timon, nun Paramenasi sugandi, a nun Nikolasi Antiyɔkika naxan soxi Yuwifie xa diinɛ ya ma.

sentences.english: These they took to the Apostles, who, after prayer, put their hands on them.
sentences.susu: E naxa e dɛntɛgɛ xɛɛrae bɛ. Xɛɛrae naxa e bɛlɛxɛ sa e xunyie ma, e naxa Ala maxandi e bɛ.

sentences.english: And the word of God was increasing in power; and the number of the disciples in Jerusalem became very great, and a great number of priests were in agreement with the faith.
sentences.susu: Ala xa masenyi naxa yensen yɛ. Isa fɔxirabirɛe xun nu masama a gbegbe ra Darisalamu. Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wuyaxi fan nu danxaniyafe.

sentences.english: And Stephen, full of grace and power, did great wonders and signs among the people.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a xa hinnɛ nun sɛnbɛ fi Etiyɛn ma. A nu tɔnxumae nun kaabanako xungbee rabama ɲama tagi.

sentences.english: But some of those who were of the Synagogue named that of the Libertines, and some of the men of Cyrene and of Alexandria and those from Cilicia and Asia, had arguments with Stephen.
sentences.susu: Sirenikae nun Alesandireka naxee nu salima salide kui, naxan xili «xɔrɛya mixi xa salide», a nun Yuwifie naxee kelixi Silisi nun Asi, e naxa sɔnxɔ Etiyɛn ma.

sentences.english: But they were not able to get the better of him, for his words were full of wisdom and of the Spirit.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e mu nɔ Etiyɛn xa wɔyɛnyi ra, barima Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nan nu xaxilimaya fima a ma.

sentences.english: Then they got men to say, He has said evil against Moses and against God, in our hearing.
sentences.susu: Awa, e naxa xɛmɛ ndee sare fi, e xa a fala, «Muxu bara a xui mɛ a wɔyɛnyi falama naxan mu daxa Annabi Munsa nun Ala mabiri.»

sentences.english: And the people, with the rulers and the scribes, were moved against him, and they came and took him before the Sanhedrin,
sentences.susu: E naxa ɲama, forie, nun sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe kui iso. E naxa bagan a ma, e a suxu, e a xanin Yuwifi kiitisae yire.

sentences.english: And they got false witnesses who said, This man is for ever saying things against this holy place and against the law:
sentences.susu: E naxa tɔɔɲɛgɛlae ramini, naxee a fala, «Yi xɛmɛ mu bama wɔyɛnyi ɲaaxie falafe hɔrɔmɔbanxi nun Ala xa sɛriyɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For he has said in our hearing that this Jesus of Nazareth will put this place to destruction and make changes in the rules which were handed down to us by Moses.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara a xui mɛ, a a falama Isa Nasarɛtika fama yi hɔrɔmɔbanxi kanade, a man naamunyie masarama Annabi Munsa naxee fixi won ma.»

sentences.english: And all those who were in the Sanhedrin, looking at him, saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi kiitisae birin naxa e ya banban Etiyɛn na, a yatagi naxa lu e bɛ alɔ malekɛ.

sentences.english: Then the high priest said, Are these things true?
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi naxa Etiyɛn maxɔrin, «Naxan falaxi i xun ma, nɔndi na a ra?»

sentences.english: And he said, My brothers and fathers, give hearing. The God of glory came to our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he was living in Haran,
sentences.susu: Etiyɛn naxa e yaabi, «N ngaxakerenyie nun n babae, wo wo tuli mati n na. Ala dariyɛ kanyi mini nɛ won baba Iburahima ma a nu na Mesopotamiya bɔxi ma tɛmui naxɛ, beenun a xa sabati Xarani.

sentences.english: And said to him, Go out of your land, and away from your family, and come into the land to which I will be your guide.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a fala a bɛ, ‹Keli i xa bɔxi nun i xabilɛ xun, siga bɔxi ma n dɛnnaxɛ masenma i bɛ.›

sentences.english: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and went into Haran; and from there, when his father was dead, he was guided by God into this land, where you are living now:
sentences.susu: Awa, a naxa mini Kalidi bɔxi ra, a sa sabati Xarani. Mɛnni, a baba faxa xanbi, Ala naxa a radangi yi bɔxi ma wo sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ yi ki to.

sentences.english: And God gave him no heritage in it, not even enough to put his foot on: but he gave him an undertaking that he would give it to him and to his children after him, though he had no child at that time.
sentences.susu: A mu lingira yo fi a ma yi bɔxi kui hali santide. Kɔnɔ a naxa laayidi tongo a bɛ, a fama yi bɔxi fide a tan nun a bɔnsɔɛ nan ma, hali a faxa xanbi. Na waxati di yo mu nu na a bɛ sinden.»

sentences.english: And God said that his seed would be living in a strange land, and that they would make them servants, and be cruel to them for four hundred years.
sentences.susu: «Ala naxa a fala a bɛ, ‹I bɔnsɔɛ sabatima bɔxi gbɛtɛ nan ma. Mɛnni e findima nɛ konyie ra. E e ɲaxankata ɲɛ kɛmɛ naani bun.›

sentences.english: And I will be the judge, said God, of that nation which made them servants: and after that, they will come out and give me worship in this place.
sentences.susu: Ala man naxa a fala, ‹N fama na si makiitide naxan e rasoma konyiya kui. Na dangi xanbi, e kelima nɛ naa, e fa n batu be.›»

sentences.english: And he made with him the agreement of which circumcision was the sign. And so Abraham had a son, Isaac, and gave him circumcision on the eighth day; and Isaac had a son, Jacob, and Jacob was the father of the twelve heads of the families of Israel.
sentences.susu: «Awa, Ala naxa sunna saatɛ fi Iburahima ma. Iburahima to Isiyaga bari, a naxa a sunna a xi solomasaxan nde ma. Isiyaga to Yaxuba bari, a naxa a fan sunna. Yaxuba fan naxa won benba fu nun firinyie sunna.»

sentences.english: And the brothers, moved with envy against Joseph, gave him to the Egyptians for money: but God was with him,
sentences.susu: «Won benbae naxa Yusufu tɔɔnɛ, e naxa a mati, a naxa findi konyi ra Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And made him free from all his troubles, and gave him wisdom and the approval of Pharaoh, king of Egypt, who made him ruler over Egypt and all his house.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala naxa lu a fɔxɔ ra. A naxa a ramini a xa kɔntɔfili birin kui. A naxa hinnɛ nun xaxilimaya fi a ma, alako a xa rafan Misira mangɛ ma, naxan a findi Misira gomina nun a xa banxi birin xunmati ra.»

sentences.english: Now there was no food to be had in all Egypt and Canaan, and there was great trouble: and our fathers were not able to get food.
sentences.susu: «Kaamɛ xungbe naxa so Misira bɔxi ma a nun Kanaan bɔxi. Won babae mu nu baloe sɔtɔma, tɔɔrɛ naxa gbo.

sentences.english: But Jacob, hearing that there was grain in Egypt, sent out our fathers the first time.
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa a mɛ a mɛngi na Misira bɔxi ma. A naxa won babae xɛɛ naa a singe.

sentences.english: And the second time his brothers had a meeting with Joseph, and Pharaoh had knowledge of Joseph's family.
sentences.susu: E xa sigɛ firin nde, Yusufu naxa a yɛtɛ masen a fafaxakerenyie bɛ, Misira mangɛ fan naxa Yusufu xabilɛ rakolon.

sentences.english: Then Joseph sent for Jacob his father and all his family, seventy-five persons.
sentences.susu: Awa, Yusufu naxa e xɛɛ a baba Yaxuba tongode nun a xa denbaya birin. E kɔnti nu sigaxi han mixi tongo solofere a nun suuli.

sentences.english: And Jacob went down to Egypt, and came to his end there, and so did our fathers;
sentences.susu: Yaxuba naxa goro Misira, a faxa dɛnnaxɛ a nun won babae.

sentences.english: And they were taken over to Shechem, and put to rest in the place which Abraham got for a price in silver from the sons of Hamor in Shechem.
sentences.susu: E furee naxa ragbilen Sikemi, e e ragata gaburi nan kui, Iburahima naxan sara kɔbiri ra Xamori xa die ma.»

sentences.english: But when the time was near for putting into effect the undertaking which God had given to Abraham, the people were increasing in Egypt,
sentences.susu: «Ala xa laayidi rakamali waxati to makɔrɛ, laayidi naxan tongoxi Iburahima bɛ, won ma ɲama xun naxa masa Misira bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Till another king came to power, who had no knowledge of Joseph.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na xanbi mangɛ gbɛtɛ naxa ti naxan mu nu Yusufu xa fe kolon.

sentences.english: He, having evil designs against our nation, was cruel to our fathers, and they were forced to put out their young children, so that they might not go on living.
sentences.susu: Na mangɛ naxa won ma ɲama yanfa. A naxa won benbae ɲaxankata, han a naxa e yaamari e xa e xa diyɔrɛe wɔlɛ, alako e xa faxa.

sentences.english: At which time Moses came to birth, and he was very beautiful; and he was kept for three months in his father's house:
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Annabi Munsa naxa bari, Ala hinnɛ naxan na. Kike saxan a rabalofe a baba xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: And when he was put out, Pharaoh's daughter took him and kept him as her son.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi a naxa a bɛlɛxɛ ba a ma. Misira mangɛ xa di ginɛ fa a tongo, a naxa a ramɔ alɔ a xa di.

sentences.english: And Moses was trained in all the wisdom of Egypt, and was great in his words and works.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa naxa kolon sɔtɔ Misira xa fe birin ma. A wɔyɛn ki nun a ɲɛrɛ ki naxa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: But when he was almost forty years old, it came into his heart to go and see his brothers, the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: «A to ɲɛ tongo naani sɔtɔ, a naxa wa a ngaxakerenyie kolonfe. A naxa siga a boore Isirayilakae yire matode.

sentences.english: And seeing one of them being attacked, he went to his help and gave the Egyptian a death-blow:
sentences.susu: A to Misiraka to a fe ɲaaxi niyafe Isirayilaka nde ra, Annabi Munsa naxa a ngaxakerenyi xa gere so, a naxa Misiraka faxa.

sentences.english: And he was hoping that his brothers would see that God had sent him to be their saviour; but they did not see.
sentences.susu: A naxa a maɲɔxun a a ngaxakerenyie a kolonma nɛ Ala xɔrɛya fima e ma a saabui nan na, kɔnɔ e mu kolon sɔtɔ na ma.

sentences.english: And the day after, he came to them, while they were having a fight, and would have made peace between them, saying, Sirs, you are brothers; why do you do wrong to one another?
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, Annabi Munsa naxa Isirayilaka firin to, e na gerefe. A naxa kata e xa lan e bore ma, a naxa a fala e bɛ, ‹Ngaxakerenmae nan na wo ra. Munfe ra wo fe ɲaaxi niyama wo bore ra?›

sentences.english: But the man who was doing wrong to his neighbour, pushing him away, said, Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ naxan nu fe ɲaaxi rabafe a ngaxakerenyi ra, a naxa Annabi Munsa radin yɛ, a a fala a bɛ, ‹Nde i tixi mangɛ nun kiitisa ra muxu xun ma?

sentences.english: Will you put me to death as you did the Egyptian yesterday?
sentences.susu: I waxi n faxafe nɛ alɔ i Misiraka faxaxi ki naxɛ xoro?›

sentences.english: And at these words, Moses went in flight to the land of Midian, and was living there for a time, and had two sons.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa to na wɔyɛnyi mɛ, a naxa a gi. A naxa sabati Madiyan bɔxi ma, a naxa di firin bari mɛnni.»

sentences.english: At the end of forty years, an angel came to him in the waste land of Sinai, in the flame of a burning thorn-tree.
sentences.susu: «Ɲɛ tongo naani dangi xanbi, malekɛ naxa mini a ma tɛ xɔɔra naxan nu sansi bili ganfe gbengberenyi ma, Sinayi geya fari.

sentences.english: And Moses, seeing it, was full of wonder, and when he came up to have a nearer view of it, the voice of the Lord came to him, saying,
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa to na fe to, a naxa kaaba. A to a maso a ra, a xa a igbɛ, a naxa Marigi xui mɛ.

sentences.english: I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham and of Isaac and of Jacob. And Moses, shaking with fear, kept his eyes from looking at it.
sentences.susu: ‹I babae Marigi Ala nan n na, Iburahima, Isiyaga, nun Yaxuba Marigi Ala.› Annabi Munsa naxa sɛrɛn, a naxa gaaxu a igbɛfe ma.

sentences.english: And the Lord said, Take off the shoes from your feet, for the place where you are is holy.
sentences.susu: Marigi naxa a fala a bɛ, ‹Sankiri ba i sanyi, barima i tixi dɛnnaxɛ, bɔxi sɛniyɛnxi na a ra.

sentences.english: Truly, I have seen the sorrows of my people in Egypt, and their cries have come to my ears, and I have come down to make them free: and now, come, I will send you to Egypt.
sentences.susu: N bara n ma ɲama xa tɔɔrɛ to Misira, n bara e kutun xui mɛ. N bara goro n xa xɔrɛya fi e ma. Yakɔsi, n xa i xɛɛ Misira.›

sentences.english: This Moses, whom they would not have, saying, Who made you a ruler and a judge? him God sent to be a ruler and a saviour, by the hand of the angel whom he saw in the thorn-tree.
sentences.susu: Ala Annabi Munsa xɛɛ nɛ, e a fala naxan bɛ, ‹Nde i tixi mangɛ nun kiitisa ra muxu xun ma.› Malekɛ naxan minixi a ma tɛ xɔɔra a naxa a masen a bɛ a xa findi mangɛ nun marakisima ra.»

sentences.english: This man took them out, having done wonders and signs in Egypt and in the Red Sea and in the waste land, for forty years.
sentences.susu: «Annabi Munsa nan Isirayilakae ramini Misira bɔxi ra. Ɲɛ tongo naani bun ma, a naxa tɔnxumae nun kaabanakoee raba Misira, Xulunyumi Baa, nun gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: This is the same Moses, who said to the children of Israel, God will give you a prophet from among your brothers, like me.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa tan naxa a fala Isirayila bɛ, ‹Ala namiɲɔnmɛ raminima wo ngaxakerenyie nan ya ma naxan luma alɔ n tan.›

sentences.english: This is the man who was in the church in the waste land with the angel who was talking to him in Sinai, and with our fathers; and to him were given the living words of God, so that he might give them to you.
sentences.susu: Won benbae ɲama e to nu malanxi gbengberenyi ma, malekɛ naxa wɔyɛn Annabi Munsa bɛ Sinayi geya fari. A sɛriyɛ naxan mɛxi, a naxa na radangi won ma.»

sentences.english: By whom our fathers would not be controlled; but they put him on one side, turning back in their hearts to Egypt,
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ won benbae mu tin a xa yaamari suxude. E naxa a matandi, e e bɔɲɛ ti Misira ra.

sentences.english: And saying to Aaron, Make us gods to go before us: as for this Moses, who took us out of the land of Egypt, we have no idea what has become of him.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala Haruna bɛ, ‹Alae yailan won bɛ, naxee ɲɛrɛma won ya ra, barima yi Munsa naxan won naminixi Misira, won mu a kolon se naxan a sɔtɔxi.›

sentences.english: And they made the image of a young ox in those days, and made an offering to it, and had joy in the work of their hands.
sentences.susu: E naxa kuye yailan ninge misaali ra, e fa sɛrɛxɛ ba a bɛ. E naxa ɲɛlɛxin na ra, e naxan yailanxi e bɛlɛxɛe ra.»

sentences.english: But God was turned from them and let them give worship to the stars of heaven, as it says in the book of the prophets, Did you make offerings to me of sheep and oxen for forty years in the waste land, O house of Israel?
sentences.susu: «Awa, Ala naxa a kobe so e ra, a naxa e rabolo, e xa tunbuie batu, alɔ a sɛbɛxi namiɲɔnmɛ xa Kitaabui kui ki naxɛ. ‹Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ, wo sɛrɛxɛe ba n tan nan bɛ ɲɛ tongo naani bun ma gbengberenyi ma?

sentences.english: And you took up the tent of Moloch and the star of the god Rephan, images which you made to give worship to them: and I will take you away, farther than Babylon.
sentences.susu: Wo bara Mɔlɔkɔ kuye batu, wo bara Remefan tunbui kuye batu, wo kuye naxee yailanxi wo bɛlɛxɛ ra. Na nan a toxi n fan wo xaninma Babilɔn xanbi ra.›»

sentences.english: Our fathers had the Tent of witness in the waste land, as God gave orders to Moses to make it after the design which he had seen.
sentences.susu: «Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira, a xa seedeɲɔxɔya sɛbɛli na dɛnnaxɛ, na nu na won benbae tagi gbengberenyi ma. Ala nu bara a misaali masen Annabi Munsa bɛ, a naxa a yaamari a xa a yailan na ki.

sentences.english: Which our fathers, in their turn, took with them when, with Joshua, they came into the heritage of the nations whom God was driving out before the face of our fathers, till the time of David,
sentences.susu: Won benbae to hɔrɔmɔlingira sɔtɔ, e naxa a xanin bɔxi ma Ala si gbɛtɛe keri dɛnnaxɛ, Yosuwe xa yaamari bun ma. A naxa lu naa han Dawuda xa waxati.»

sentences.english: Who was pleasing to God; and he had a desire to make a holy tent for the God of Jacob.
sentences.susu: «Dawuda naxan nafanxi Ala ma, na naxa a maxɔrin a xa lingira ti a tan Yaxuba Marigi Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: But Solomon was the builder of his house.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Sulemani nan fa na lingira ti Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: But still, the Most High has not his resting-place in houses made with hands, as the prophet says,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi mu sabatima adama xa banxi tixi kui. Namiɲɔnmɛ na nan masenxi,

sentences.english: Heaven is the seat of my power, and earth is a resting-place for my feet: what sort of house will you make for me, says the Lord, or what is my place of rest?
sentences.susu: ‹Wo Marigi naxɛ, koore, n ma kibanyi, bɔxi, n santide. Wo banxi mundun tima n bɛ? Wo yire mundun findima n ma malabude ra?

sentences.english: Did not my hand make all these things?
sentences.susu: N tan xa mu na birin yailanxi?›»

sentences.english: You whose hearts are hard and whose ears are shut to me; you are ever working against the Holy Spirit; as your fathers did, so do you.
sentences.susu: «Wo xaxili nun wo tuli xɔrɔxɔ, wo sondonyi mu fan. Wo Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi matandima tɛmui birin alɔ wo benbae a raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Which of the prophets was not cruelly attacked by your fathers? and they put to death those who gave them the news of the coming of the Upright One; whom you have now given up and put to death;
sentences.susu: Wo benbae namiɲɔnmɛe birin ɲaxankata nɛ. E namiɲɔnmɛe faxa nɛ, naxee nu Ala xa Tinxintɔɛ xa fafe falama. Yakɔsi wo bara na fan faxa.

sentences.english: You, to whom the law was given as it was ordered by angels, and who have not kept it.
sentences.susu: Wo tan naxee bara Ala xa sɛriyɛ sɔtɔ malekɛe saabui ra, wo mu a rabatuxi!»

sentences.english: Hearing these things, they were cut to the heart and moved with wrath against him.
sentences.susu: E to yi masenyi mɛ, e naxa xɔnɔ han e nu e ɲinyie raxin.

sentences.english: But he was full of the Holy Spirit, and looking up to heaven, he saw the glory of God and Jesus at the right hand of God.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa goro Etiyɛn ma. Etiyɛn to a ya banban koore ma, a naxa Ala xa dariyɛ to, a man naxa Isa to a tixi Ala yirefanyi ma.

sentences.english: And he said, Now I see heaven open, and the Son of man at the right hand of God.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen, «N bara koore rabixi to, Adama xa Di tixi Ala yirefanyi ma.»

sentences.english: But with loud cries, and stopping their ears, they made an attack on him all together,
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa sɔnxɔɛ rate, e naxa e tuli dɛsɛ. E birin naxa bagan a ma.

sentences.english: Driving him out of the town and stoning him: and the witnesses put their clothing at the feet of a young man named Saul.
sentences.susu: E naxa mini a bubu ra sigafe ra taa fari ma, e a magɔnɔ han a naxa faxa. Seedee naxa e xa donmae sa sɛgɛtala nde san ma, naxan xili Sɔlu.

sentences.english: And Stephen, while he was being stoned, made prayer to God, saying, Lord Jesus, take my spirit.
sentences.susu: E nu na a magɔnɔfe tɛmui naxɛ, Etiyɛn naxa Ala maxandi, «N Marigi Isa, n nii rasɛnɛ.»

sentences.english: And going down on his knees, he said in a loud voice, Lord, do not make them responsible for this sin. And when he had said this, he went to his rest.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi a naxa a xinbi sin, a naxa a xui ite, «N Marigi, i naxa e suxu yi yunubi ma!» A gɛ na falade tan mu a ra, a naxa taa masara. Sɔlu fan nu na Etiyɛn faxafe kui.

sentences.english: And Saul gave approval to his death. Now at that time a violent attack was started against the church in Jerusalem; and all but the Apostles went away into all parts of Judaea and Samaria.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ, ɲaxankatɛ xungbe naxa Darisalamu danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama suxu. E birin naxa yensen Samari nun Yudaya bɔxi ma fo xɛɛrae, nee nan gbansan lu naa.

sentences.english: And God-fearing men put Stephen's body in its last resting-place, making great weeping over him.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ tinxinxie naxa Etiyɛn nagata. E naxa wa a xa faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: But Saul was burning with hate against the church, going into every house and taking men and women and putting them in prison.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Sɔlu tan naxa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama tɔɔrɔ. A nu soma banxie kui, a nu danxaniyatɔɛ xɛmɛe nun ginɛe ramini, a nu fa e sa geeli.

sentences.english: But those who had gone in flight went everywhere preaching the word.
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛ to yensen yɛ, e naxa xibaaru fanyi kawandi ti yire birin.

sentences.english: And Philip went down to Samaria and was teaching them about Christ.
sentences.susu: Filipu to goro Samari taa nde kui, a naxa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fe masen naakae bɛ.

sentences.english: And all the people gave attention to the words which Philip said, when they saw the signs which he did.
sentences.susu: Ɲama to Filipu xa kaabanakoee to, e naxa e tuli mati a ra a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: For unclean spirits came out from those who had them, crying with a loud voice; and a number of those who were ill and broken in body were made well.
sentences.susu: Ɲinnɛe naxa gbilen furemae fɔxɔ ra, e nu fa gbelegbele. Mabɛnyi nun namatɛ wuyaxi naxa yalan.

sentences.english: And there was much joy in that town.
sentences.susu: Naakae naxa sɛɛwa a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: But there was a certain man named Simon, who in the past had been a wonder-worker and a cause of surprise to the people of Samaria, saying that he himself was a great man:
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ nde nu na na taa kui naxan xili Simɔn. A nu duureya rabama naxan Samarikae birin nakaabama, a nu fa a yɛtɛ igbo.

sentences.english: To whom they all gave attention, from the smallest to the greatest, saying, This man is that power of God which is named Great.
sentences.susu: E birin, dimɛdie nun forie, a xui ramɛxi a fanyi ra. E nu a fala, «Yi xɛmɛ Ala sɛnbɛ na a ra, won naxan xili falama Sɛnbɛ Xungbe.»

sentences.english: And they gave attention to him, because for a long time his wonder-working powers had kept them under his control.
sentences.susu: E nu bara bira a fɔxɔ ra kabi a xɔnnakuye barima a nu e rakaabama a xa duureya ra.

sentences.english: But when they had faith in the good news given by Philip about the kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, a number of men and women had baptism.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e to la Filipu ra, naxan Ala xa mangɛya niini nun Isa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa xibaaru fanyi kawandi rabama, xɛmɛe nun ginɛe naxa e xunxa ye xɔɔra.

sentences.english: And Simon himself had faith and, having had baptism, he went with Philip and, seeing the signs and the great wonders which he did, he was full of surprise.
sentences.susu: Simɔn yati naxa danxaniya, a fan naxa a xunxa ye xɔɔra. A naxa bira Filipu fɔxɔ ra. A naxa kaaba a xa tɔnxumae nun kaabanako xungbee ma.

sentences.english: Now when the Apostles at Jerusalem had news that the people of Samaria had taken the word of God into their hearts, they sent to them Peter and John;
sentences.susu: Xɛɛrae, naxee nu na Darisalamu, e to a mɛ Samarikae bara tin Ala xa masenyi ra, e naxa Piyɛri nun Yaya xɛɛ naa.

sentences.english: Who, when they came there, made prayer for them, that the Holy Spirit might be given to them:
sentences.susu: E to so naa, e naxa Ala maxandi alako Samarikae xa Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi sɔtɔ,

sentences.english: For up to that time he had not come on any of them; only baptism had been given to them in the name of the Lord Jesus.
sentences.susu: barima Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi mu nu goroxi mixi yo ma e ya ma sinden. E nu xunxaxi ye nan gbansan xɔɔra Isa xili xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Then they put their hands on them, and the Holy Spirit came on them.
sentences.susu: Awa, Piyɛri nun Yaya naxa e bɛlɛxɛ sa e ma, e naxa Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the touch of the Apostles' hands, he made them an offering of money, saying,
sentences.susu: Simɔn to a to Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nu sɔtɔma xɛɛrae bɛlɛxɛe nan saabui ra, a naxa kɔbiri masen e bɛ, a fa a fala,

sentences.english: Give me this power, so that when I put my hands on anyone he may get the Holy Spirit.
sentences.susu: «Wo yi sɛnbɛ fi n fan ma, alako n na n bɛlɛxɛe sa naxan ma, a xa Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: But Peter said, May your money come to destruction with you, because you had the idea that what is freely given by God may be got for a price.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a yaabi, «I tan nun i xa kɔbiri xun xa rakana, barima i a maɲɔxunxi nɛ Ala xa ki sɔtɔma kɔbiri nan na.

sentences.english: You have no part in this business, because your heart is not right before God.
sentences.susu: I gbe yo mu na yi fe ya ma, barima i sondonyi mu fiixɛxi Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: Let your heart be changed, and make prayer to God that you may have forgiveness for your evil thoughts.
sentences.susu: Gbilen yi fe ɲaaxi fɔxɔ ra. I man xa Marigi maxandi alako a xa diɲɛ i ma i xa yi maɲɔxunyi xa fe ra, xa a sa tinma.

sentences.english: For I see that you are prisoned in bitter envy and the chains of sin.
sentences.susu: N a toxi nɛ yi ki, i na fe ɲaaxi gbegbe kui. I bara findi Sentanɛ xa konyi ra.»

sentences.english: And Simon, answering, said, Make prayer for me to the Lord, so that these things which you have said may not come on me.
sentences.susu: Simɔn naxa a yaabi, «Wo yɛtɛ xa Marigi maxandi n bɛ alako wo fe naxee birin falaxi a naxa n li.»

sentences.english: So they, having given their witness and made clear the word of the Lord, went back to Jerusalem, giving the good news on their way in a number of the small towns of Samaria.
sentences.susu: E to gɛ seedeɲɔxɔya bade Marigi xa masenyi ra, Piyɛri nun Yaya naxa gbilen Darisalamu. Kira fan na, e naxa xibaaru fanyi kawandi ti Samari taa wuyaxi kui.

sentences.english: But an angel of the Lord said to Philip, Get up, and go to the south, to the road which goes from Jerusalem to Gaza, through the waste land.
sentences.susu: Marigi xa malekɛ naxa a fala Filipu bɛ, «Keli, siga yirefanyi biri ra, gbengberen kira xɔn, naxan goroma Gasa, kelife Darisalamu.»

sentences.english: And he went and there was a man of Ethiopia, a servant of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, and controller of all her property, who had come up to Jerusalem for worship;
sentences.susu: A naxa keli, a naxa Etiyopika nde li kira ra. Xɛmɛ nan nu a ra naxan mu nu nɔma ginɛ fe rabade. A findixi Kandasi, Etiyopi mangɛ ginɛ xunmati nan na. A tan nan nu a xa naafuli birin kantama. A nu faxi salide nɛ Darisalamu.

sentences.english: He was going back, seated in his carriage, and was reading the book of the prophet Isaiah.
sentences.susu: A na gbilenfe a xɔnyi, a dɔxɔxi a xa maɲɛrɛse kui, a na Annabi Esayi xa Kitaabui xaranfe.

sentences.english: And the Spirit said to Philip, Go near, and get on his carriage.
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa a masen Filipu bɛ, «Siga, i i makɔrɛ na maɲɛrɛse ra.»

sentences.english: And Philip, running up to him, saw that he was reading Isaiah the prophet, and said to him, Is the sense of what you are reading clear to you?
sentences.susu: Filipu naxa siga a gi ra. A naxa Etiyopika xui mɛ, a nu Annabi Esayi xa Kitaabui xaranfe. A naxa a maxɔrin, «I naxan xaranfe yi ki, i a fahaamuxi?»

sentences.english: And he said, How is that possible when I have no guide? And he made Philip get up by his side.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yaabi, «N nɔma na ra di, xa mixi yo mu na naxan a tagi rabama n bɛ?» A naxa a fala Filipu bɛ a xa dɔxɔ a sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Now the place in the book where he was reading was this: He was taken, like a sheep, to be put to death; and as a lamb is quiet when its wool is being cut, so he made no sound:
sentences.susu: A nu na yi sɛbɛli nan xaranfe Kitaabui kui: «E a xaninxi tɛmui naxɛ a xa faxa a naxa lu alɔ yɛxɛɛ naxan xaninma faxade. A mu a xui yo ramini, alɔ yɛxɛɛ naxan tima a xabe maxabama ya ra.

sentences.english: Being of low degree, his cause was not given a hearing: who has knowledge of his family? for his life is cut off from the earth.
sentences.susu: A xa marayaagi kui, e naxa a makiiti sɛriyɛ xanbi. Nde nɔma a xa taruxui falade? A xa simaya bara ɲɔn bɔxi fari.»

sentences.english: And the Ethiopian said to Philip, About whom are these words said by the prophet? about himself, or some other?
sentences.susu: Na Etiyopika naxa a fala Filipu bɛ, «Yandi, a masen n bɛ, Annabi Esayi nde xa fe falama yi ki? A yɛtɛ ba, ka mixi gbɛtɛ?»

sentences.english: So Philip, starting from this writing, gave him the good news about Jesus.
sentences.susu: Awa, Filipu naxa a fɔlɔ na sɛbɛli ma, a naxa a kawandi Isa xa xibaaru fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And while they were going on their way, they came to some water, and the Ethiopian said, See, here is water; why may I not have baptism?
sentences.susu: E na sigafe kira xɔn, e naxa ye li. Na Etiyopika naxa a fala Filipu bɛ, «Ye nan ya. Nanse a niyama n mu xunxama ye xɔɔra?»
Filipu naxa a yaabi, «Xa i danxaniya i bɔɲɛ birin na, i nɔma na ra.» Na Etiyopika naxa a yaabi, «N laxi a ra, Ala xa Di nan lanxi Isa ma.»

sentences.english: And he gave orders for the carriage to be stopped, and the two of them went down into the water, and Philip gave him baptism.
sentences.susu: A naxa maɲɛrɛse rati, e firin birin naxa goro ye ma. Filipu naxa na Etiyopika xunxa ye xɔɔra.

sentences.english: And when they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord took Philip away; and the Ethiopian saw him no more, for he went on his way full of joy.
sentences.susu: E to te ye xɔɔra, Marigi Xaxili naxa Filipu tongo, a a xanin. Na Etiyopika mu fa a to sɔnɔn. A naxa siga sɛɛwɛ kui.

sentences.english: But Philip came to Azotus, and went through all the towns, preaching the good news, till he came to Caesarea.
sentences.susu: Filipu naxa mini Asotu taa kui. A man naxa siga Sesare. A naxa xibaaru fanyi kawandi ti taa birin kui a nu dangima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: But Saul, still burning with desire to put to death the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest,
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui birin, Sɔlu nu kɔnkɔxi Marigi fɔxirabirɛe ma, a xa e faxa. A naxa siga sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xɔn

sentences.english: And made a request for letters from him to the Synagogues of Damascus, so that if there were any of the Way there, men or women, he might take them as prisoners to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: kɛɛdi maxɔrinde katarabi Damasi salide yareratie ma, alako xa a naxee li naa, e biraxi Isa xa kira fɔxɔ ra, xɛmɛe nun ginɛe, a xa fa e xirixi ra Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And while he was journeying, he came near Damascus; and suddenly he saw a light from heaven shining round him;
sentences.susu: A na makɔrɛfe Damasi ra, yanbɛ naxa mini a ma keli koore ma, a a rabilin.

sentences.english: And he went down on the earth, and a voice said to him, Saul, Saul, why are you attacking me so cruelly?
sentences.susu: A naxa bira bɔxi ma, a naxa xui nde mɛ, «Sɔlu, Sɔlu, i na n ɲaxankatafe munfe ra?»

sentences.english: And he said, Who are you, Lord? And he said, I am Jesus, whom you are attacking:
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa a yaabi, «Marigi, nde i ra?» A naxa a yaabi, «Isa nan n na, i naxan ɲaxankatafe.

sentences.english: But get up, and go into the town, and it will be made clear to you what you have to do.
sentences.susu: Keli, so taa kui, e fama a falade i bɛ a lanma i xa naxan naba.»

sentences.english: And the men who were with him were not able to say anything; hearing the voice, but seeing no one.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛe naxee nu a fɔxɔ ra, nee dɛ naxa bobo a ra gaaxui bɛ. E nu xui mɛma, kɔnɔ e mu nu mixi yo toma.

sentences.english: And Saul got up from the earth, and when his eyes were open, he saw nothing; and he was guided by the hand into Damascus.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa keli bɔxi ma, a ya rabixi, kɔnɔ a ya mu se toma. E naxa a bɛlɛxɛ suxu, e a mati Damasi.

sentences.english: And for three days he was not able to see, and he took no food or drink.
sentences.susu: A naxa lu xi saxan a mu sese to, a mu sese don, a mu sese min.

sentences.english: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus, named Ananias; and the Lord said to him in a vision, Ananias! and he said, Here I am, Lord.
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛ nde nu na Damasi, naxan xili Ananiyasi. Marigi naxa a xili laamatunyi kui, «Ananiyasi!» Ananiyasi naxa a ratin, «Marigi, n tan nan ya.»

sentences.english: And the Lord said to him, Get up, and go to the street which is named Straight, and make search at the house of Judas for one named Saul of Tarsus: for he is at prayer;
sentences.susu: Marigi naxa a fala a bɛ, «Keli, siga kira ra naxan xili ‹Kira Tinxinxi›, i xa xɛmɛ fen Yudasi xa banxi kui, naxan xili Sɔlu Tariseka. A na Ala maxandife.

sentences.english: And he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and putting his hands on him, so that he may be able to see.
sentences.susu: A bara mixi nde to laamatunyi kui, naxan xili Ananiyasi, a na a bɛlɛxɛ safe a ma alako a man xa se to.»

sentences.english: But Ananias said, Lord, I have had accounts of this man from a number of people, how much evil he has done to your saints at Jerusalem:
sentences.susu: Ananiyasi naxa a yaabi, «Marigi, n bara yi xɛmɛ xa fe mɛ mixi wuyaxi ra, a bara fe kobi naxan naba i xa mixi sɛniyɛnxie ra Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And here he has authority from the chief priests to make prisoners all who give worship to your name.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie bara nɔɛ so a yi ra, a xa birin suxu naxee i xili maxandima.»

sentences.english: But the Lord said, Go without fear: for he is a special vessel for me, to give to the Gentiles and kings and to the children of Israel the knowledge of my name:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Marigi naxa Ananiyasi yaabi, «Siga, barima n bara yi xɛmɛ sugandi xɛɛra ra, a xa n xili masen si birin bɛ, e xa mangɛe bɛ, a nun Isirayila die birin bɛ.

sentences.english: For I will make clear to him what troubles he will have to undergo for me.
sentences.susu: N a masenma nɛ a bɛ, a fama tɔɔrɔde ki naxɛ n xili xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And Ananias went out and came to the house, and putting his hands on him, said, Brother Saul, the Lord Jesus, whom you saw when you were on your journey, has sent me, so that you may be able to see, and be full of the Holy Spirit.
sentences.susu: Ananiyasi naxa siga na banxi. A to so, a naxa a bɛlɛxɛ sa Sɔlu ma. A naxa a fala a bɛ, «N ngaxakerenyi Sɔlu, Marigi Isa naxan mini i ma kira ra, a tan nan n xɛɛxi i ma, alako i xa se to, i man xa Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: And straight away it seemed as if a veil was taken from his eyes, and he was able to see; and he got up, and had baptism;
sentences.susu: Se nde naxa ba a ya ma keren na alɔ xalee, a ya naxa se to. A naxa keli, a fa a xunxa ye xɔɔra.

sentences.english: And when he had taken food his strength came back. And for some days he kept with the disciples who were in Damascus.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi a naxa a dɛge, a fa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ. Sɔlu naxa saxanyi raba Damasi a nun Isa fɔxirabirɛe.

sentences.english: And straight away, in the Synagogues, he was preaching Jesus as the Son of God.
sentences.susu: A naxa bɔnbɔ kawandi tife ra keren na salidee kui a nu a masen a Ala xa Di nan lanxi Isa ma.

sentences.english: And all those hearing him were full of wonder and said, Is not this the man who in Jerusalem was attacking all the worshippers of this name? and he had come here so that he might take them as prisoners before the chief priests.
sentences.susu: Naxee birin a xui mɛ, e dɛ naxa ixara. E naxa a fala, «Yi xɛmɛ xa mu nu mixie ɲaxankatama Darisalamu, naxee nu maxandi tima Isa xili ra? A mu faxi xɛ be, a xa e xanin e xirixi ra sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie xɔn?»

sentences.english: But Saul went on increasing in power, and the Jews in Damascus were not able to give answers to the arguments by which he made it clear that Jesus was the Christ.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ. A xa masenyi naxa Damasi Yuwifie ifu, a falafe a Isa nan lanxi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ma.

sentences.english: Then, after some days, the Jews made an agreement together to put him to death:
sentences.susu: Tɛmui nde to dangi, Yuwifie naxa lan a ma e xa Sɔlu faxa.

sentences.english: But Saul got knowledge of their design. And they kept watch day and night on the roads out of the town, so that they might put him to death:
sentences.susu: Sɔlu naxa e xa gundo kolon. E nu taa sode dɛ kantama kɔɛ nun yanyi alako e xa a faxa.

sentences.english: But his disciples took him by night and let him down from the wall in a basket.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ kɔɛ nde ra, Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa a ragoro tɛtɛ fari ma saga kui.

sentences.english: And when he came to Jerusalem, he made an attempt to be joined to the disciples, but they were all in fear of him, not taking him for a disciple.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu to siga Darisalamu, a naxa wa bonife Isa fɔxirabirɛe ra, kɔnɔ e birin nu gaaxuxi a ya ra. E mu nu laxi a ra xa Isa fɔxirabirɛ nan yati a ra.

sentences.english: But Barnabas took him to the Apostles and gave them an account of how he had seen the Lord on the road, and had given hearing to his words, and how at Damascus he had been preaching in the name of Jesus without fear.
sentences.susu: Awa, Baranabasi naxa a xanin xɛɛrae xɔn. A naxa a tagi raba e bɛ Sɔlu Marigi toxi ki naxɛ, a man a xui mɛxi kira ra ki naxɛ. A naxa a masen e bɛ Sɔlu bara kawandi naxan naba Isa xili ra Damasi taa kui.

sentences.english: And he was with them, going in and out at Jerusalem,
sentences.susu: E birin naxa dɔxɔ yire keren Darisalamu. Sɔlu nu Marigi xili kawandima sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: Preaching in the name of the Lord without fear; and he had discussions with the Greek Jews; but they were working for his death.
sentences.susu: E nun Yuwifie fan naxa wɔyɛn e nu xɔrɔxɔ, Yuwifi naxee Girɛki xui falama, kɔnɔ nee nu katafe e xa Sɔlu faxa.

sentences.english: And when the brothers had knowledge of it, they took him to Caesarea and sent him to Tarsus.
sentences.susu: A ngaxakerenyi Isayankae to na fe mɛ, e naxa a xanin Sesare, e fa a rasiga Tarise.

sentences.english: And so the church through all Judaea and Galilee and Samaria had peace and was made strong; and, living in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit, was increased greatly.
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama naxa lu bɔɲɛsa kui Yudaya, Galile, nun Samari bɔxi birin ma. E nu luma e bore ralimaniya ra, e nu e ɲɛrɛ Marigi xa yaragaaxui kui. E xun nu masama Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra.

sentences.english: And it came about that while Peter was going through all parts of the country he came to the saints who were living at Lydda.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri to nu bɔxi iɲɛrɛma, a naxa goro sɛniyɛntɔɛe yire Lida.

sentences.english: And there was a certain man there, named Aeneas, who for eight years had been in bed, without power of moving.
sentences.susu: A naxa xɛmɛ namataxi nde li naa, naxan xili Ene, a nu saxi sade ma kabi ɲɛ solomasaxan.

sentences.english: And Peter said to him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ makes you well: get up and make your bed. And straight away he got up.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a fala a bɛ, «Ene, Isa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi bara i rayalan. Keli, i i xa sade yailan.» A naxa keli keren na.

sentences.english: And all those living in Lydda and Sharon saw him, and were turned to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Lidakae nun Sarɔnka birin to yi fe to, e naxa tuubi Marigi ma.

sentences.english: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, that is, Dorcas: this woman was given to good works and acts of mercy at all times.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ nde nu na Yafa Isa fɔxirabirɛe ya ma. A nu xili Tabita, naxan falaxi Dɔrakasi. A nu fe fanyi gbegbe rabama, a nu tɔɔrɔmixie ki.

sentences.english: And it came about, in those days, that she got ill and came to her death: and when she had been washed, they put her in a room which was high up.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, fure naxa a suxu, a naxa faxa. E to a maxa, e naxa a sa koore banxi dɛki firin nde.

sentences.english: And because Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, having knowledge that Peter was there, sent two men to him, requesting him to come to them straight away.
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxee nu na Yafa, e naxa a mɛ a Piyɛri na Lida. Lida mu makuya Yafa ra. Awa, e naxa xɛmɛ firin xɛɛ Piyɛri ma, e xa a mayandi a xa fa e xɔnyi mafuren.

sentences.english: And Peter went with them. And when he had come, they took him into the room: and all the widows were there, weeping and putting before him the coats and clothing which Dorcas had made while she was with them.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa keli, e nun na xɛmɛe naxa siga. E to so, e naxa a xanin koore banxi kɔn na. Kaaɲɛ ginɛe naxa a rabilin, e wama. E naxa dugie nun sosee masen a bɛ Dɔrakasi naxee yailan a nu na e ya ma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: But Peter made them all go outside, and went down on his knees in prayer; and turning to the body, he said, Tabitha, get up. And, opening her eyes, she saw Peter and got up.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa e birin namini tande. A naxa a xinbi sin, a Ala maxandi. Na xanbi, a naxa a mafindi fure mabiri ra. A naxa a fala, «Tabita, keli.» Tabita naxa a ya rabi. A to Piyɛri to, a naxa keli.

sentences.english: And he took her hand, lifting her up; and, sending for the saints and widows, he gave her to them, living.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa a bɛlɛxɛ suxu, a a rakeli. A naxa sɛniyɛntɔɛe nun kaaɲɛ ginɛe xili. A naxa a ɲiɲɛ dɛntɛgɛ e bɛ.

sentences.english: And news of it went all through Joppa, and a number of people had faith in the Lord.
sentences.susu: Yafakae birin naxa na fe mɛ. Mixi wuyaxi naxa danxaniya Marigi ma.

sentences.english: And he was living in Joppa for some time with Simon, a leather-worker.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa xi wuyaxi raba Yafa, Simɔn garange xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, named Cornelius, the captain of the Italian band of the army;
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ nde nu na Sesare naxan nu xili Koroneliyo. Sɔɔri kɛmɛ xunmati nan nu a ra Itali sɔɔri gali ya ma.

sentences.english: A serious-minded man, fearing God with all his family; he gave much money to the poor, and made prayer to God at all times.
sentences.susu: Diinɛla nan nu a ra. A tan nun a xa mixi birin nu gaaxuxi Ala ya ra. A nu setaree malima a gbegbe ra, a man nu Ala maxandima tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: He saw in a vision, clearly, at about the ninth hour of the day, an angel of the Lord coming to him and saying to him, Cornelius!
sentences.susu: Nunmare ra, a naxa Ala xa malekɛ nde to laamatunyi ra, a sofe a xɔnyi. Malekɛ naxa a xili, «Koroneliyo.»

sentences.english: And he, looking on him in fear, said, What is it, Lord? And he said to him, Your prayers and your offerings have come up to God, and he has kept them in mind.
sentences.susu: Koroneliyo to a to, a naxa gaaxu. A naxa a fala, «Marigi, munse niyaxi?» Malekɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «Ala bara i xa maxandi suxu. A bara ratu i ma, i bara naxan naba setaree bɛ.

sentences.english: Now send men to Joppa, and get one Simon, named Peter,
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, i xa mixi ndee xɛɛ Yafa e xa fa Simɔn na, naxan xili falama Piyɛri.

sentences.english: Who is living with Simon, a leather-worker, whose house is by the sea.
sentences.susu: A yigiyaxi Simɔn garange xɔnyi baa dɛ ra.»

sentences.english: And when the angel who said these words to him had gone away, he sent for two of his house-servants, and a God-fearing man of the army, one of those who were waiting on him at all times;
sentences.susu: Malekɛ to gɛ wɔyɛnde, a naxa siga. Koroneliyo naxa konyi firin xili, a nun a xa sɔɔri diinɛla, naxan nu walima a bɛ.

sentences.english: And having given them an account of everything, he sent them to Joppa.
sentences.susu: A naxa yi fe birin yaba e bɛ, a fa e xɛɛ Yafa.

sentences.english: Now the day after, when they were on their journey and were near the town, Peter went up to the top of the house for prayer, about the sixth hour:
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba yanyi tagi ɲɔndɔn, e nu na kira xɔn ma tɛmui naxɛ, e makɔrɛ taa ra, Piyɛri naxa te koore banxi fari a xa Ala maxandi.

sentences.english: And he was in need of food: but while they were getting it ready, a deep sleep came on him;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui kaamɛ naxa a suxu, a nu wama a dɛgefe. Beenun donse xa gɛ yailande, a naxa laamatunyi to.

sentences.english: And he saw the heavens opening, and a vessel coming down, like a great cloth let down on the earth,
sentences.susu: A naxa koore to a rabixi, se nde naxa goro bɔxi alɔ dugi, a xirixi a tunxun naanie ma.

sentences.english: In which were all sorts of beasts and birds.
sentences.susu: Subee, bubusee, nun xɔni birin nu na na dugi kui.

sentences.english: And a voice came to him, saying, Come, Peter; take them for food.
sentences.susu: Xui nde naxa a fala, «Piyɛri, keli, i sube nde faxa, i xa a don.»

sentences.english: But Peter said, No, Lord; for I have never taken food which is common or unclean.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Piyɛri naxa a yaabi, «Ade, Marigi. N mu nu se raharamuxi don sinden, xa na mu a ra se sɛniyɛntare.»

sentences.english: And the voice came to him a second time, What God has made clean, do not you make common.
sentences.susu: Xui naxa wɔyɛn a bɛ a firin nde, «Ala bara se naxan nasɛniyɛn i naxa a fala a sɛniyɛntare.»

sentences.english: And this was done three times: and then the vessel was taken back into heaven.
sentences.susu: Na naxa raba sanya saxan. Na xanbi, na dugi man naxa te koore ma.

sentences.english: Now while Peter was in doubt as to the purpose of this vision, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made search for Simon's house, came to the door,
sentences.susu: Piyɛri to nu a maɲɔxunfe na laamatunyi ma, a wama naxan masenfe, Koroneliyo xa xɛɛrae nu bara Simɔn xɔnyi maxɔrin. E naxa ti naadɛ ra.

sentences.english: To see if Simon, named Peter, was living there.
sentences.susu: E naxa maxɔrinyi ti xa Simɔn yigiyaxi naa nɛ, e naxan xili falama Piyɛri.

sentences.english: And, while Peter was turning the vision over in his mind, the Spirit said to him, See, three men are looking for you.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri nu a maɲɔxunfe laamatunyi ma tɛmui naxɛ, Ala Xaxili naxa a masen a bɛ, «Xɛmɛ saxan na i maxɔrinfe.

sentences.english: Go down, then, and go with them, doubting nothing, for I have sent them.
sentences.susu: Keli, i xa goro, wo birin xa siga. I naxa siikɛ, barima n tan nan e xɛɛxi.»

sentences.english: And Peter went down to the men, and said, I am the man you are looking for: why have you come?
sentences.susu: Awa, Piyɛri naxa goro, a naxa a fala na xɛmɛe bɛ, «N tan nan yi ki wo naxan fenfe. Wo faxi munfe ma?»

sentences.english: And they said, Cornelius, a captain, an upright and God-fearing man, respected by all the nation of the Jews, had word from God by an angel to send for you to his house, and to give hearing to your words.
sentences.susu: E naxa dɛntɛgɛ sa, «Koroneliyo, sɔɔri mixi kɛmɛ xunmati, nan muxu xɛɛxi. Xɛmɛ tinxinxi na a ra, naxan gaaxuxi Ala ya ra. Yuwifie birin a xili fanyi falama. Ala xa malekɛ sɛniyɛnxi bara a masen a bɛ a xa i rafa a xɔnyi alako a xa i xa masenyi ramɛ.»

sentences.english: So he took them in for the night. And the day after, he went with them, taking some of the brothers from Joppa with him.
sentences.susu: Awa, Piyɛri naxa e yigiya. Na kuye iba, a naxa keli, e birin naxa siga. Yafaka danxaniyatɔɛ ndee fan naxa e mati.

sentences.english: And the day after that, they came to Caesarea. And Cornelius was waiting for them, having got together his relations and his near friends.
sentences.susu: Na kuye iba, e naxa so Sesare, Koroneliyo nu e mamɛfe dɛnnaxɛ. A nu bara a xa mixie nun a boore fanyie malan.

sentences.english: And when Peter came in, Cornelius came to him and, falling down at his feet, gave him worship.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri to so, Koroneliyo naxa a ralan, a naxa a yɛtɛ magoro a bɛ.

sentences.english: But Peter, lifting him up, said, Get up, for I am a man as you are.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Piyɛri naxa a rakeli, a naxa a fala, «Keli, mixi nan na n fan na.»

sentences.english: And saying these words, he went in, and saw that a great number of people had come together;
sentences.susu: E naxa so banxi e wɔyɛnma e bore ra. Piyɛri naxa mixi gbegbe malanxi li naa.

sentences.english: And he said to them, You yourselves have knowledge that it is against the law for a man who is a Jew to be in the company of one who is of another nation; but God has made it clear to me that no man may be named common or unclean:
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo a kolon tɔnyi dɔxɔxi Yuwifie ma e nun si gbɛtɛ bɔnsɔɛ naxa lu yire keren, xa na mu a ra sofe ra e xɔnyi. Kɔnɔ Ala bara a masen n bɛ a n naxa mixi yo maɲɔxun sɛniyɛntare ra.

sentences.english: And so I came without question, when I was sent for. What then is your purpose in sending for me?
sentences.susu: Na na a ra, wo to n xili, n mu tondi fade. Awa, wo n xilixi munfe ma?»

sentences.english: And Cornelius said, Four days from now I was in my house in prayer at the ninth hour; and I saw before me a man in shining clothing,
sentences.susu: Koroneliyo naxa a masen a bɛ, «Na xi naani nan yi ki, n nu salife n ma banxi kui nunmare tɛmui. Xɛmɛ nde naxa mini n ma, a xa sosee yanbama.

sentences.english: Who said, Cornelius, your prayer has come to the ears of God, and your offerings are kept in his memory.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen n bɛ, ‹Koroneliyo, Ala bara i xa maxandi suxu. A bara ratu a ma i bara naxan naba setaree bɛ.

sentences.english: Send, then, to Joppa, and get Simon, named Peter, to come to you; he is living in the house of Simon, a leather-worker, by the sea.
sentences.susu: Awa, mixie xɛɛ Yafa, e xa fa Simɔn Piyɛri ra be. A yigiyaxi Simɔn garange xa banxi kui, baa dɛ ra.›

sentences.english: So, straight away, I sent for you; and you have done well to come. And now, we are all present before God, ready to give attention to all the things which the Lord has given you to say.
sentences.susu: N naxa mixie xɛɛ keren na. Muxu bara ɲɛlɛxin ki fanyi i fafe ra. Awa, yakɔsi muxu birin na Ala ya i. I xa masenyi ti muxu bɛ, Marigi bara i yamari naxan birin na.»

sentences.english: Then Peter said, Truly, I see clearly that God is no respecter of persons:
sentences.susu: Awa, wɔyɛnyi to so Piyɛri yi, a naxa a masen, «Yakɔsi n bara a kolon nɔndi nan yati a ra, Ala mu mixi yo rafisaxi a boore bɛ.

sentences.english: But in every nation, the man who has fear of him and does righteousness is pleasing to him.
sentences.susu: A wama mixi birin xɔn, sie birin ya ma, naxee gaaxuma a ya ra, naxee tinxin.

sentences.english: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, giving the good news of peace through Jesus Christ (who is Lord of all) —
sentences.susu: Ala bara xibaaru fanyi masen Isirayila ɲama bɛ. A bara a masen e bɛ a bɔɲɛsa sɔtɔma duniɲa Marigi Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan na.

sentences.english: That word you yourselves have knowledge of, which was made public through all Judaea, starting from Galilee, after the baptism of which John was the preacher,
sentences.susu: Wo a kolon naxan nabaxi fɔlɔfe Galile bɔxi ma, dɔxɔfe Yudaya birin na. Yaya nu bara kawandi ti mixie xa e xunxa ye xɔɔra.

sentences.english: About Jesus of Nazareth, how God gave the Holy Spirit to him, with power: and how he went about doing good and making well all who were troubled by evil spirits, for God was with him.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui Ala naxa Isa Nasarɛtika sugandi, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nun sɛnbɛ naxa goro a ma. Isa naxa siga yire birin, a nu fe fanyi raba, a nu mixi birin nayalan naxee nu na Ibulisa xa konyiya bun. Ala nu na a fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: And we are witnesses of all the things which he did in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they put to death, hanging him on a tree.
sentences.susu: «Yi fe birin seede nan muxu ra a naxan naba Yuwifie xa bɔxi ma nun Darisalamu. E naxa a banban wuri ma, a faxa.

sentences.english: On the third day God gave him back to life, and let him be seen,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala naxa a rakeli faxɛ ma xi saxan lɔxɔɛ, duniɲa xa a to.

sentences.english: Not by all the people, but by witnesses marked out before by God, even by us, who took food and drink with him after he came back from the dead.
sentences.susu: A mu tin a makɛnɛnde birin bɛ, kɔnɔ a naxa a yɛtɛ masen muxu bɛ, Ala naxee sugandixi e xa findi seedee ra. Muxu nun Isa bara donse don, muxu bara ye min a keli xanbi faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: And he gave us orders to give news of this to the people, and to give public witness that this is he whom God has made judge of the living and the dead.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa muxu yamari, muxu xa kawandi ti mixie bɛ, e xa a kolon Ala nan Isa tixi kiitisa ra mixi baloxie nun mixi faxaxie xun ma.

sentences.english: To him all the prophets give witness, that through his name everyone who has faith in him will have forgiveness of sins.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ birin nu bara a xa fe fala, naxan na danxaniya a ma na kanyi xa yunubi xafarima nɛ a xili saabui ra.»

sentences.english: While Peter was saying these words, the Holy Spirit came on all those who were hearing the word.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri to nu wɔyɛnma, naxee birin nu yi masenyi ramɛfe, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa goro e ma.

sentences.english: And the Jews of the faith, who had come with Peter, were full of wonder, because the Holy Spirit was given to the Gentiles,
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛ sunnaxie naxee Piyɛri mati naa, e naxa kaaba yi fe ma, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi gorofe sunnataree fan ma,

sentences.english: And they were talking in tongues, and giving glory to God. Then Peter said,
sentences.susu: barima e naxa e xui mɛ e na Ala matɔxɔfe xui gbɛtɛe ra.

sentences.english: Will any man say that these may not have baptism who have been given the Holy Spirit as we have?
sentences.susu: Awa, Piyɛri naxa maxɔrinyi ti, «Mixi nde nɔma tondide yi mixie xa xunxa ye xɔɔra? E fan bara Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi sɔtɔ alɔ won fan a sɔtɔxi ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And he gave orders for them to have baptism in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they kept him with them for some days.
sentences.susu: A naxa yaamari fi fa e xa e xunxa ye xɔɔra Isa xili ra. Na xanbi e naxa Piyɛri mayandi a xa lu e xɔnyi na saxanyi.

sentences.english: Now the Apostles and the brothers who were in Judaea had news that the word of God had been given to the Gentiles.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛrae nun ngaxakerenyie naxee nu na Yudaya, e naxa a mɛ a si gbɛtɛe fan bara tin Ala xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: And when Peter came to Jerusalem, those who kept the rule of circumcision had an argument with him,
sentences.susu: Piyɛri to te Darisalamu, Yuwifi danxaniyatɔɛe naxa a kalamu, «I bara so sunnataree xɔnyi,

sentences.english: Saying, You went to men without circumcision, and took food with them.
sentences.susu: wo birin bara wo dɛge!»

sentences.english: But Peter gave them an account of it all in order, saying to them,
sentences.susu: Awa Piyɛri naxa fe birin tagi raba e bɛ a dangixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: I was in the town of Joppa, at prayer: and falling into a deep sleep, I saw in a vision a vessel like a great cloth let down from heaven, and it came down to me:
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen, «N nu na Yafa taa nan kui. N na Ala maxandife tɛmui naxɛ, n naxa laamatunyi to. Se nde naxan maniyaxi dugi xungbe ra, a xirixi a tunxun naanie ma, na naxa goro keli koore ma han n yire.

sentences.english: And looking on it with attention I saw in it all sorts of beasts and birds.
sentences.susu: N naxa a igbɛ a fanyi ra. N naxa xurusee, wula subee, bubusee, nun xɔni birin to a kui.

sentences.english: And a voice came to my ears saying, Come, Peter; take them for food.
sentences.susu: Xui nde naxa a fala, ‹Piyɛri, keli, i sube nde faxa, i xa a don.›

sentences.english: But I said, No, Lord; for nothing common or unclean has ever come into my mouth.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n naxa a fala, ‹Ade, Marigi. N mu nu se raharamuxi don sinden, xa na mu a ra se sɛniyɛntare.›

sentences.english: But the voice, coming a second time from heaven, said, What God has made clean, do not you make common.
sentences.susu: Xui naxa wɔyɛn n bɛ a firin nde, ‹Ala bara naxan nasɛniyɛn i naxa a fala a sɛniyɛntare.›

sentences.english: And this was done three times, and they were all taken up again into heaven.
sentences.susu: Na naxa raba sanya saxan. Na xanbi, a birin man naxa te koore ma.»

sentences.english: And at that minute, three men, sent from Caesarea, came to the house where we were.
sentences.susu: «Na tɛmui mixi saxan, naxee nu xɛɛxi n yire kelife Sesare, e naxa ti muxu xa banxi naadɛ ra.

sentences.english: And the Spirit gave me orders to go with them, doubting nothing. And these six brothers came with me; and we went into that man's house:
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili naxa a masen n bɛ a muxu birin xa siga, a hali n mu siikɛ. Yi xɛmɛ senni naxee yi ki, e fan naxa n mati naa. Muxu to so Koroneliyo xɔnyi,

sentences.english: And he gave us an account of how he had seen the angel in his house, saying, Send to Joppa, and get Simon, named Peter, to come to you;
sentences.susu: a naxa a yaba muxu bɛ a malekɛ toxi a xa banxi kui ki naxɛ. Malekɛ naxa a masen a bɛ, ‹Mixi xɛɛ Yafa, a xa fa Simɔn na, e naxan xili falama Piyɛri.

sentences.english: Who will say words to you through which you and all your family may get salvation.
sentences.susu: A fama masenyi tide i bɛ, i tan nun i xa mixi birin kisima naxan saabui ra.›»

sentences.english: And, while I was talking to them, the Holy Spirit came on them, as on us at first.
sentences.susu: «N to so wɔyɛnfe, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa goro e ma alɔ a goro won ma ki naxɛ a fɔlɛ.

sentences.english: And the words of the Lord came into my mind, how he said, The baptism of John was with water, but you will have baptism with the Holy Spirit.
sentences.susu: N fa ratu Marigi xa masenyi ma, ‹Yaya bara mixi xunxa ye xɔɔra, kɔnɔ Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi fama gorode wo ma.›
