sentences.english: If then God gave them, when they had faith in the Lord Jesus Christ, the same as he gave to us, who was I to go against God?
sentences.susu: Ala to bara e ki alɔ a won kixi ki naxɛ, won tan naxee danxaniyaxi Isa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ma, a nu lan n xa Ala matandi?»

sentences.english: And hearing these things they said nothing more, but gave glory to God, saying, Then to the Gentiles as to us has God given a change of heart, so that they may have life.
sentences.susu: E to na mɛ, e naxa dundu, e naxa Ala matɔxɔ, «Ala bara tuubi ragiri si gbɛtɛe fan bɛ, alako e fan xa kisi.»

sentences.english: Then those who had gone away at the time of the trouble about Stephen, went as far as Phoenicia and Cyprus, preaching to the Jews only.
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛ naxee yensen Etiyɛn faxa xanbi ɲaxankatɛ saabui ra, e naxa siga han Fenisiya, Sipiri, nun Antiyɔki. E nu Ala xa masenyi kawandima Yuwifie nan bɛ.

sentences.english: But some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, when they came to Antioch, gave the good news about the Lord Jesus to the Greeks.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Sipirikae nun Sirenikae naxee nu na e ya ma, e to siga Antiyɔki, e naxa Marigi Isa xa xibaaru fanyi masen Girɛkikae fan bɛ.

sentences.english: And the power of the Lord was with them, and a great number had faith and were turned to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Marigi xɔnyɛ nu na e ma. Mixi gbegbe naxa danxaniya, e naxa tuubi Marigi ma.

sentences.english: And news of them came to the ears of the church at Jerusalem: and they sent Barnabas as far as Antioch:
sentences.susu: Darisalamu danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama to na fe mɛ, e naxa Baranabasi xɛɛ Antiyɔki.

sentences.english: Who, when he came and saw the grace of God, was glad; and he made clear to them the need of keeping near the Lord with all the strength of their hearts:
sentences.susu: A to so naa, a naxa ɲɛlɛxin Ala xa hinnɛ tofe ra. A naxa e ralimaniya, e xa danxaniya Marigi ma.

sentences.english: For he was a good man and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith: and a great number were joined to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Baranabasi, mixi fanyi nan nu a ra. A nu rafexi danxaniya nun Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi ra. Ɲama gbegbe naxa danxaniya Marigi ma.

sentences.english: Then he went on to Tarsus, looking for Saul;
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Baranabasi naxa siga Tarise Sɔlu fende.

sentences.english: And when he had come across him, he took him to Antioch. And they were with the church there for a year, teaching the people; and the disciples were first given the name of Christians in Antioch.
sentences.susu: A to a to, a naxa fa a ra Antiyɔki. E nun danxaniyatɔɛe nan nu e malanma naa ɲɛ keren birin bun ma. E naxa mixi gbegbe xaran. Isa fɔxirabirɛ naxee nu na Antiyɔki, nee nan singe «Isayanka» xili sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Now in those days prophets came from Jerusalem to Antioch.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, namiɲɔnmɛ ndee naxa goro Antiyɔki, kelife Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And one of them, named Agabus, said publicly through the Spirit that there would be serious need of food all over the earth: which came about in the time of Claudius.
sentences.susu: Naxan nu xili Agabu, na naxa ti, a fa a fala Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra, a kaamɛ xungbe fama sinde duniɲa birin ma. Na fe raba mangɛ Kilɔdi xa waxati nɛ.

sentences.english: And the disciples, everyone as he was able, made a decision to send help to the brothers living in Judaea:
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa lan a ma e xa Yudaya ngaxakerenyie mali harige ra, kankan nɔma naxan na.

sentences.english: Which they did, sending it to the rulers of the church by the hand of Barnabas and Saul.
sentences.susu: E naxa a so Baranabasi nun Sɔlu yi ra katarabi kuntigie ma.

sentences.english: Now, about that time, Herod the king made cruel attacks on the Christians.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui mangɛ Herode naxa so danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama mixi ndee tɔɔrɔfe.

sentences.english: And he put James, the brother of John, to death with the sword.
sentences.susu: A naxa Yaki, Yaya taara, faxa santidɛgɛma ra.

sentences.english: And when he saw that this was pleasing to the Jews he went on to take Peter in addition. This was at the time of the feast of unleavened bread.
sentences.susu: A to a to na nu rafan Yuwifie ma, a man naxa Piyɛri suxu Taami Lɛbinitare Sali.

sentences.english: And having taken him, he put him in prison, with four bands of armed men to keep watch over him; his purpose being to take him out to the people after the Passover.
sentences.susu: A to a suxu, a naxa a sa geeli kui. A naxa sɔɔri naani naani tongo xundɛ naani kui, a nee yamari, e xa a kanta. Herode nu waxi Piyɛri xa makiiti ɲama ya xɔri Sayamalekɛ Dangi Sali na ba a ra.

sentences.english: So Peter was kept in prison: but the church made strong prayer to God for him.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri nu na geeli kui, kɔnɔ danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama nu na Ala maxandife a bɛ.

sentences.english: And when Herod was about to take him out, the same night Peter was sleeping in chains between two armed men, and the watchmen were keeping watch before the door of the prison.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ ra, beenun Herode xa Piyɛri makiiti, a nu xife sɔɔri firin tagi, yɔlɔnxɔnyi balanxi a ma. Sɔɔri gbɛtɛe fan nu geeli naadɛ kantafe.

sentences.english: And a great light was seen shining in the room, and an angel of the Lord came to Peter and, touching him on his side so that he came out of his sleep, said, Get up quickly. And his chains came off his hands.
sentences.susu: Marigi xa malekɛ nde naxa mini a ma tɛrɛnna ra. Yanbɛ naxa geeli kui iyalan. Malekɛ naxa Piyɛri sɛɛti mabɔnbɔ, a xa xunu, a fa a fala a bɛ, «Keli, i xulun!» Yɔlɔnxɔnyie naxa yolon a bɛlɛxɛ ra keren na.

sentences.english: Then the angel said, Put on your shoes and get ready to go. And he did so. And he said, Put your coat round you and come with me.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa a fala a bɛ, «I maxiri, i xa sankirie so.» A to na raba, malekɛ man naxa a fala a bɛ, «Donma felen i ma, bira n fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: And he went out after him; and he was not certain if what was done by the angel was a fact, for it seemed to him that he was seeing a vision.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri naxa mini, a bira malekɛ fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ a mu a kolon xa na fe findixi nɔndi nan na. A nu bara a maɲɔxun, tɛmunde a findixi laamatunyi nan na.

sentences.english: And when they had gone past the first and second watchmen they came to the iron door into the town, which came open by itself: and they went out and down one street; and then the angel went away.
sentences.susu: E to bara dangi sɔɔrie singe e nun a firin ndee ra, e naxa wure naadɛ li naxan dɛ rabixi taa ma, na naxa rabi a yɛtɛ ra. E naxa mini. E mu nu a ikuyaxi kira xɔn ma, malekɛ naxa keli Piyɛri xun.

sentences.english: And when Peter came to his senses he said, Now, truly, I am certain that the Lord has sent his angel and taken me out of the hands of Herod, against all the hopes of the Jews.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri to xaxili sɔtɔ na fe ma, a naxa a fala, «Yakɔsi, n bara a kolon Marigi nan a xa malekɛ xɛɛxi, a xa n ba Herode yi ra. A bara n natanga Yuwifie bɛlɛxɛ.»

sentences.english: And when he became clear about this, he went to the house of Mary, the mother of John named Mark, where a number of them had come together for prayer.
sentences.susu: A to kolon sɔtɔ yi fe ma, a naxa siga Yaya nga Mariyama xɔnyi, Yaya naxan man xili Maraki. Mixi wuyaxi nu malanxi naa, e na Ala maxandife.

sentences.english: And he gave a blow on the door, and a young girl came to it, named Rhoda.
sentences.susu: A to naadɛ kɔnkɔn, konyi ginɛ nde, naxan xili Roda, a naxa fa naadɛ rabide.

sentences.english: And hearing the voice of Peter, in her joy she went running, without opening the door, to say that Peter was outside.
sentences.susu: A to Piyɛri xui mɛ, a naxa ɲɛlɛxin han a naxa nɛɛmu naadɛ rabife ma. A naxa a gi a xa sa a fala booree bɛ Piyɛri na naadɛ ra.

sentences.english: And they said to her, You are off your head. But still she said, with decision, that it was so. And they said, It is his angel.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala a bɛ, «I bara daxu.» Kɔnɔ a to e karaxan, e naxa a fala, «A xa malekɛ na a ra.»

sentences.english: But Peter went on giving blows on the door: and when it was open and they saw him, they were full of wonder.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui birin Piyɛri nu na naadɛ kɔnkɔnfe. E to naadɛ rabi, e naxa kaaba a tofe ma.

sentences.english: But he made a sign to them with his hand to be quiet, and gave them an account of how the Lord had taken him out of prison. And he said, Give the news to James and the brothers. And then he went away.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri to e masabari a bɛlɛxɛ ra, a naxa a yaba e bɛ Marigi a raminixi geeli kui ki naxɛ. A naxa a fala, «Wo yi fe ragbilen Yaki nun ngaxakerenyie ma.» Na xanbi, a naxa mini, a xa siga yire gbɛtɛ.

sentences.english: Now when it was day, the armed men were greatly troubled about what had become of Peter.
sentences.susu: Kuye to iba, sɔɔrie naxa lu maimaxɛ xungbe kui, a kolonfe ra Piyɛri xa fe niyaxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And Herod, when he sent for him, and he was not there, after questioning the watchmen, gave orders that they were to be put to death. Then he went down from Judaea to Caesarea for a time.
sentences.susu: Herode naxa a fen, kɔnɔ a mu a to. A naxa sɔɔrie makiiti, a naxa yaamari fi a e birin xa faxa. Na xanbi, a naxa keli Yudaya, a naxa goro Sesare, a xa saxanyi radangi mɛnni.

sentences.english: Now he was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon: and they came to him, all together, and having made friends with Blastus, the controller of the king's house, they made a request for peace, because their country was dependent on the king's country for its food.
sentences.susu: Tirekae nun Sidɔnkae nu na lantareya kui e nun Herode ra na tɛmui. E naxa lan e bore ma, e xa siga Herode yire, e xa wɔyɛn. E to bara Bilasitu masɔtɔ, mangɛ xa batula kuntigi, e naxa Herode mayandi lanyi xirife ra e tagi, barima e xa bɔxi xaxili nu tixi Herode xa bɔxi baloe nan na.

sentences.english: And on the day which had been fixed, Herod, dressed in his robes and seated in his place, made a public statement to them.
sentences.susu: Malan lɔxɔɛ, Herode nu maxirixi a xa mangɛ sosee kui, a naxa masenyi ti ɲama bɛ, a dɔxɔxi mangɛ kibanyi kui.

sentences.english: And the people, with loud cries, said, It is the voice of a god, not of a man.
sentences.susu: Mixie naxa sɔnxɔɛ rate, «Ala xui nan yi ki, adama xui mu a ra.»

sentences.english: And straight away the angel of the Lord sent a disease on him, because he did not give the glory to God: and his flesh was wasted away by worms, and so he came to his end.
sentences.susu: Marigi xa malekɛ nde naxa a rafura keren na, barima a mu Ala matɔxɔ. Kulie naxa a don, a naxa faxa.

sentences.english: But the word of the Lord went on increasing.
sentences.susu: Na waxati mixi gbegbe naxa Ala xa wɔyɛnyi ramɛ, danxaniyatɔɛe kɔnti xun naxa masa.

sentences.english: And Barnabas and Saul came back from Jerusalem, when their work was ended, taking with them John named Mark.
sentences.susu: Baranabasi nun Sɔlu to gɛ xɛɛra ibade Darisalamu, e naxa gbilen Yaya xanin na e xun ma, e naxan xili falama Maraki.

sentences.english: Now there were at Antioch, in the church there, prophets and teachers, Barnabas, and Symeon who was named Niger, and Lucius of Cyrene, and Manaen, a relation of Herod the king, and Saul.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛe nun karamɔxɔe nu na Antiyɔki danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama tagi: Baranabasi, Simeyɔn naxan xili sa Nigeri, Lususi Sirenika, Manahɛn, nun Sɔlu. Manahɛn nun mangɛ Herode nan xuru yire keren.

sentences.english: And while they were doing the Lord's work, and going without food, the Holy Spirit said, Let Barnabas and Saul be given to me for the special work for which they have been marked out by me.
sentences.susu: E to nu Marigi batufe, e man nu sunfe, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa a fala e bɛ, «Wo Baranabasi nun Sɔlu ti n bɛ e xati ma, wali xa fe ma n e xilixi naxan ma.»

sentences.english: Then, after prayer and going without food they put their hands on them, and sent them away.
sentences.susu: Awa, e to gɛ sunde, nun Ala maxandide, e naxa e bɛlɛxɛ sa Baranabasi nun Sɔlu ma, e xa e taxu Ala ra. Na xanbi, e naxa e bɛɲin, e siga.

sentences.english: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia; and from there they went by ship to Cyprus.
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi to Baranabasi nun Sɔlu xɛɛ, e naxa goro Selusiya, e fa baki kunkui kui sigafe ra Sipiri suri ma.

sentences.english: And at Salamis they were preaching the word of God in the Synagogues of the Jews: and John was with them, helping them.
sentences.susu: E to so Salamin, e naxa so Ala xa masenyi kawandife Yuwifie xa salide kui. Yaya nan nu e malima ra.

sentences.english: And when they had gone through all the island to Paphos, they came across a certain wonder-worker and false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar-Jesus;
sentences.susu: E to bara suri igiri han Pafosi, e naxa duure nde li naa, Yuwifi naxan nu a yɛtɛ findixi namiɲɔnmɛ wule falɛ ra, naxan nu xili Bari Yesu xa di.

sentences.english: Who was with the ruler, Sergius Paulus, an able man. This man sent for Barnabas and Saul, desiring to have knowledge of the word of God.
sentences.susu: A nu na mangɛ Sɛrigu Pɔlu sɛɛti ma, naxan xaxili nu fan. Na tan naxa Baranabasi nun Sɔlu xili, barima a nu wama Ala xa masenyi ramɛfe.

sentences.english: But Elymas, the wonder-worker (for that is the sense of his name), put himself against them, with the purpose of turning the ruler from the faith.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na duure e naxan ma Elimasi, a xili wama a masenfe a duure nan a ra, a naxa e matandi. A nu katafe nɛ alako a xa mangɛ xa ba danxaniya kira xɔn ma.

sentences.english: But Saul, whose other name is Paul, being full of the Holy Spirit, looking hard at him, said,
sentences.susu: Awa Sɔlu, naxan man xili Pɔlu, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi to goro a ma, a naxa a ya banban a ra,

sentences.english: O you, who are full of false tricks and evil ways, a son of the Evil One, hating all righteousness, will you for ever be turning people from the right ways of the Lord?
sentences.susu: a naxa a fala a bɛ, «Kalabante nun yanfante nan i ra. Ibulisa xa di, tinxintare, i mu bama Marigi xa kira tinxinxi dalinfe?

sentences.english: And now, see, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind and not able to see the sun for a time. And straight away a dark mist came down on him; and he went about looking for a guide.
sentences.susu: Awa yakɔsi, Marigi bara a bɛlɛxɛ sa i ma. I fama nɛ dɔnxude. Waxati nde bun ma, i mu soge toma.» Dimi naxa dusu a xun na keren na. A naxa so milimalafe na ma, a nu mixie fen naxee a yi rasuxuma.

sentences.english: Then the ruler, when he saw what was done, had faith, being full of wonder at the teaching of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Awa, mangɛ Sɛrigu Pɔlu to na to, a naxa danxaniya Marigi xa sɛriyɛ ma.

sentences.english: Then Paul and those who were with him went by ship from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia: and there John went away from them and came back to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu nun a booree to baki kunkui kui Pafosi, e naxa siga Pɛriga naxan na Panfiliya bɔxi ma. Yaya naxa a ba e ma, a naxa gbilen Darisalamu.

sentences.english: But they, going through from Perga, came to Antioch in Pisidia; and they went into the Synagogue on the Sabbath and were seated.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni e naxa ti kira xɔn. E naxa so Antiyɔki naxan na Pisidiya bɔxi ma. E to so salide kui malabu lɔxɔɛ, e naxa e magoro.

sentences.english: And after the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the Synagogue sent to them, saying, Brothers, if you have a word of comfort for the people, say on.
sentences.susu: Tawureta Munsa nun namiɲɔnmɛe xa Kitaabui xaranyi to ba a ra, salide xunmatie naxa xɛɛra ti e ma, e nu a fala, «Won ngaxakerenyie, xa marasi nde na wo yi ra ɲama bɛ, wo a fala.»

sentences.english: And Paul, getting up and making a sign with his hand, said, Men of Israel, and you who have the fear of God, give ear.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu to keli, a naxa e masabari, a fa a fala, «Isirayilakae nun wo tan naxee gaaxuxi Ala ya ra, wo wo tuli mati.

sentences.english: The God of this people Israel made selection of our fathers, lifting the people up from their low condition when they were living in the land of Egypt, and with a strong arm took them out of it.
sentences.susu: Isirayila ɲama Marigi Ala bara won babae sugandi. A naxa e rawuya Misira bɔxi ma. Na xanbi a naxa e ramini naa a sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: And for about forty years he put up with their ways in the waste land.
sentences.susu: A naxa e rabalo ɲɛ tongo naani ɲɔndɔn gbengberenyi ma.

sentences.english: And having put to destruction seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them the land for their heritage for about four hundred and fifty years.
sentences.susu: A to si solofere halaki Kanaan bɔxi ma, a naxa na bɔxie fi Isirayilakae ma.

sentences.english: And after these things he gave them judges, till the time of Samuel the prophet.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ kɛmɛ naani ɲɛ tongo suuli bun ma, a naxa mangɛe ti e xun ma han Annabi Samuweli xa tɛmui.

sentences.english: Then at their request for a king, God gave them Saul, the son of Kish, a man of the family of Benjamin, who was their king for forty years.
sentences.susu: Awa, e to wa mangɛ belebele xɔn ma, Ala naxa Kisu xa di, Sɔlu, naxan fatan Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ ra, a naxa na ti e xun ma. A xa mangɛya naxa bu ɲɛ tongo naani.

sentences.english: And having put him on one side, he made David their king, to whom he gave witness, saying, I have taken David, the son of Jesse, a man dear to my heart, who will do all my pleasure.
sentences.susu: A to Sɔlu ba mangɛya ra, a naxa Dawuda findi mangɛ ra e xun. A yi seedeya masen na nan ma, ‹N bara Dawuda to, Yisayi xa di, naxan kɛɲa rafan n ma. A tan nan n sago birin nakamalima.›»

sentences.english: From this man's seed has God given to Israel a Saviour, even Jesus, as he gave his word;
sentences.susu: «Ala Isirayila Rakisima raminixi Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ nan ya ma, naxan lanxi Isa ma, alɔ a laayidi tongoxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For whose coming John made ready the way by preaching to all the people of Israel the baptism which goes with a change of heart.
sentences.susu: Beenun Isa xa fa, Yaya nu bara mixie kawandi e xa tuubi, e xa e xunxa ye xɔɔra.

sentences.english: And when John was completing his work, he said, What do I seem to you to be? I am not he; but one is coming after me, whose shoes I am not good enough to undo.
sentences.susu: A xa wali raɲɔn tɛmui, a naxa a fala, ‹N mu findixi mixi xa ra, wo naxan maɲɔxunxi. Na kanyi fama n xanbi ra. Na binyɛ mu na n yi ra n xa a xa sankiri mafulun.›»

sentences.english: My brothers, children of the family of Abraham, and those among you who have the fear of God, to us the word of this salvation is sent.
sentences.susu: «N ngaxakerenyie, Iburahima bɔnsɔɛ xa die nun wo tan naxee gaaxuma Ala ya ra, yi kisi masenyi rasanbaxi won tan nan ma.

sentences.english: For the men of Jerusalem and their rulers, having no knowledge of him, or of the sayings of the prophets which come to their ears every Sabbath day, gave effect to them by judging him.
sentences.susu: Darisalamukae nun e xunmatie mu tin Isa ra. E mu fahaamui sɔtɔ namiɲɔnmɛe xa masenyi ma, naxan xaranma malabu lɔxɔɛ birin. Kɔnɔ e naxa na masenyi yati rakamali Isa tɔɔɲɛgɛfe ra.

sentences.english: And though no cause of death was seen in him, they made a request to Pilate that he might be put to death.
sentences.susu: Hali e to mu sese to a lanma a xa faxa naxan ma, e naxa Pilati maxandi a xa a faxa.

sentences.english: And when they had done all the things said in the Writings about him, they took him down from the tree, and put him in the place of the dead.
sentences.susu: Na kui, e naxa fe birin nakamali naxee sɛbɛxi a xun. E man naxa a ragoro wuri magalanbuxi ma, e a fure sa gaburi kui.

sentences.english: But God gave him back from the dead:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala naxa a rakeli faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: And for a number of days he was seen by those who came with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are now his witnesses before the people.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe naxee Isa mati kelife Galile sigafe Darisalamu, nee naxa a to xi wuyaxi bun ma. Yakɔsi e bara findi a xa seedee ra ɲama tagi.»

sentences.english: And we are giving you the good news of the undertaking made to the fathers,
sentences.susu: «Awa, muxu tan fan yi xibaaru fanyi masenma nɛ wo bɛ, Ala laayidi naxan tongo won benbae bɛ.

sentences.english: Which God has now put into effect for our children, by sending Jesus; as it says in the second Psalm, You are my Son; this day I have given you being.
sentences.susu: Ala bara a rakamali won tan bɛ, e xa die. A bara Isa rakeli faxɛ ma alɔ a sɛbɛxi Yabura sora firin nde kui ki naxɛ. A naxɛ, ‹N ma di nan i ra. N bara findi i baba ra to.›

sentences.english: And about his coming back from the dead, never again to go to destruction, he has said these words, I will give you the holy and certain mercies of David.
sentences.susu: A bara a rakeli faxɛ ma, alako a naxa bɔrɔ. A na nan masenxi yi ki, ‹Laayidi sɛniyɛnxie, naxee mu kanama, n naxee tongoxi Dawuda bɛ, n nee tongoma nɛ wo fan bɛ.›

sentences.english: Because he says in another Psalm, You will not let your Holy One see destruction.
sentences.susu: Na na a ra, a man na masenyi falaxi yire gbɛtɛ. A naxɛ, ‹I mu i xanuntenyi luma gaburi kui.›

sentences.english: Now David, having done God's work for his generation, went to sleep, and was put with his fathers, and his body came to destruction:
sentences.susu: Dawuda to gɛ Ala sago rabade a xa waxati, a faxa nɛ, a a benbae li gaburi kui, a man bɔrɔ naa.

sentences.english: But he, who was lifted up by God, did not see destruction.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala mixi naxan nakelixi faxɛ ma, na tan mu bɔrɔ.»

sentences.english: And so, let it be clear to you, my brothers, that through this man forgiveness of sins is offered to you:
sentences.susu: «N ngaxakerenyie, naxan kawandixi wo bɛ, wo xa a kolon yunubi xafarima a tan nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: And through him everyone who has faith is made free from all those things, from which the law of Moses was not able to make you free.
sentences.susu: Naxan yo danxaniya, na kanyi bara kisi yunubie ma, Annabi Munsa xa sɛriyɛ mu nɔ wo rakiside naxee ma.

sentences.english: So take care that these words of the prophets do not come true for you;
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo wo mɛɛni naxan falaxi namiɲɔnmɛe xa Kitaabuie kui, a naxa fa wo li. E naxɛ,

sentences.english: See, you doubters, have wonder and come to your end; for I will do a thing in your days to which you will not give belief, even if it is made clear to you.
sentences.susu: ‹Wo a mato, wo tan mixi mayelee, wo dɛ xa ixara, wo bara lɔɛ, barima n fama kɛwali rabade wo xa lɔxɔɛe nan ma, wo mu lama naxan na hali e a yaba wo bɛ.›»

sentences.english: And when they went out, they made a request that these words might be said to them again on the Sabbath after.
sentences.susu: Sɔlu nun Baranabasi to mini, mixie naxa e maxandi e man xa yi masenyi ti malabu lɔxɔɛ naxan man fama kɔrɛ.

sentences.english: Now when the meeting was ended, a number of the Jews and of the God-fearing Gentiles who had become Jews, went after Paul and Barnabas: who put before them how important it was to keep on in the grace of God.
sentences.susu: Awa, ɲama to yensen, Yuwifi wuyaxi nun mixi naxee nu soxi Yuwifi xa diinɛ kui, nee naxa bira Pɔlu nun Baranabasi fɔxɔ ra. Pɔlu nun Baranabasi naxa e rasi e xa lu Ala xa hinnɛ kui.

sentences.english: And on the Sabbath after, almost all the town came together to give hearing to the word of God.
sentences.susu: Na malabu lɔxɔɛ xungbilenyi, taakae birin naxa e malan Ala xa masenyi ramɛde.

sentences.english: But when the Jews saw such a great number of people, they were full of envy and said evil words against Paul's preaching.
sentences.susu: Yuwifie to ɲama to, tɔɔnɛ naxa e suxu. E naxa ti Pɔlu kanke, e nu a xa wɔyɛnyi matandi, e nu a konbi.

sentences.english: Then Paul and Barnabas without fear said, It was necessary for the word of God to be given to you first; but because you will have nothing to do with it, and have no desire for eternal life, it will now be offered to the Gentiles.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu nun Baranabasi naxa a fala e bɛ ɲama tagi, «A lanma Ala xa masenyi xa masen wo tan nan singe bɛ, kɔnɔ wo bara tondi a ra. Na kui, wo yɛtɛ bara a fala a mu daxa wo xa kisi sɔtɔ. Yakɔsi muxu muxu ya rafindima si gbɛtɛe nan ma,

sentences.english: For so the Lord has given us orders, saying, I have given you for a light to the Gentiles so that you may be for salvation to the ends of the earth.
sentences.susu: alɔ Marigi muxu yamarixi ki naxɛ. A naxɛ, ‹N bara i ti i xa findi naiyalanyi ra sie bɛ, kisi xaninfe ra han duniɲa danyi.›»

sentences.english: And the Gentiles, hearing this, were glad and gave glory to the word of God: and those marked out by God for eternal life had faith.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee mu findixi Yuwifi ra, nee to na mɛ, e naxa sɛɛwa. E naxa e Marigi xa wɔyɛnyi matɔxɔ. Naxee birin nu sugandixi kisi fe ra, nee naxa danxaniya.

sentences.english: And the word of the Lord went through all the country.
sentences.susu: Marigi xa masenyi naxa yensen bɔxi birin kui.

sentences.english: But the Jews, working up the feelings of the God-fearing women of high position and of the chief men of the town, got an attack started against Paul and Barnabas, driving them out of those parts.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Yuwifie naxa ginɛ hagigɛe, naxee nu soxi Yuwifie xa diinɛ kui, nun na taa kuntigie, e naxa nee bɔɲɛe rate. E naxa tɔɔrɛ dɔxɔ Pɔlu nun Baranabasi ma han e naxa e keri e xa bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: But they, shaking off the dust of that place from their feet, came to Iconium.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu nun Baranabasi naxa e sanyi rakonkon, na xa findi seede ra a lantareya na e tagi. Na xanbi e naxa siga Ikoniyon.

sentences.english: And the disciples were full of joy and of the Holy Spirit.
sentences.susu: Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa sɛɛwa, e man nu fa Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Now in Iconium they went together to the Synagogue of the Jews and gave such teaching that a great number of Jews and Greeks had faith.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu nun Baranabasi naxa so Yuwifie xa salide kui Ikoniyon. E naxa wɔyɛn a fanyi ra han Yuwifie nun Girɛkika gbegbe naxa danxaniya.

sentences.english: But those Jews who had not the faith, made the minds of the Gentiles bitter against the brothers.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Yuwifie naxee mu danxaniya, nee naxa Girɛkikae kui iso, alako e bɔɲɛ xa te danxaniyatɔɛe xili ma.

sentences.english: So they kept there for a long time, taking heart in the Lord, who gave witness to the word of his grace by causing signs and wonders to be done by their hands.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu nun Baranabasi naxa tɛmui xɔnkuye raba Ikoniyon, e nu wɔyɛn lanlanteya kui. Marigi naxa tɔnxumae nun kaabanakoe raba e saabui ra, e tan naxee findixi seede ra Ala xa masenyi bɛ, a xa hinnɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: But there was a division among the people of the town; some were on the side of the Jews and some on the side of the Apostles.
sentences.susu: Taakae naxa itaxun dɔxɔ firin. Ndee naxa lu Yuwifie xa sɛɛti, ndee fan naxa lu xɛɛrae xa sɛɛti.

sentences.english: And when a violent attempt was made by the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, to make an attack on them and have them stoned,
sentences.susu: Girɛkikae nun Yuwifie nun e xa mangɛe naxa lan e xa fe ɲaaxi dɔxɔ e ma, e man xa e magɔnɔ han e xa faxa.

sentences.english: Having got news of it, they went in flight to the towns of Lycaonia, Lystra, and Derbe, and the country round about:
sentences.susu: Pɔlu nun Baranabasi to na kolon, e naxa e gi, e siga Likayoni taae kui, Lisitire nun Deribe, a nun na rabilinyi.

sentences.english: And went on preaching the good news there.
sentences.susu: E naxa xibaaru fanyi kawandi ti naa.

sentences.english: And at Lystra there was a certain man, who from birth had been without the use of his feet, never having had the power of walking.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde nu dɔxɔxi Lisitire, namatɛ nan nu a ra, a bari na ki nɛ lanyuru kui. A mu nu nɔma a ɲɛrɛde hali keren.

sentences.english: This man was giving ear to the preaching of Paul, who, looking at him, and seeing that he had faith to be made well,
sentences.susu: A nu a tuli matima Pɔlu xa masenyi nan na. Pɔlu naxa a ya ti a ra. A naxa a to a danxaniyaxi a yalan fe ma.

sentences.english: Said in a loud voice, Get up on your feet. And, jumping up, he went walking about.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a xui itexi ra, «Keli, i ti i sanyie xun na. A naxa keli keren na, a ɲɛrɛ.»

sentences.english: And when the people saw what Paul had done, they said in a loud voice, in the language of Lycaonia, The gods have come down to us in the form of men.
sentences.susu: Ɲama to na to, Pɔlu naxan nabaxi, e naxa a fala Likayoni xui, «Alae bara e falin mixie, e goro won tagi.»

sentences.english: And they gave the name of Jupiter to Barnabas, and to Paul that of Mercury, because he was the chief talker.
sentences.susu: E naxa xili nde xabu e xun, e Baranabasi xili naxa sa Seyusi, Pɔlu fan Heremɛsi, barima a tan nan nu wɔyɛnma.

sentences.english: And the priest of the image of Jupiter, which was before the town, took oxen and flowers to the doors of the town, and was about to make an offering with the people.
sentences.susu: Seyusi xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ, naxan xa salide nu na taa sode dɛ ra, na naxa fa tuurae nun fugee ra naadɛe biri ra. A tan nun ɲama naxa wa sɛrɛxɛ bafe e bɛ.

sentences.english: But when this came to the ears of the Apostles, Paul and Barnabas, they went running out among the people, parting their clothing, and crying out,
sentences.susu: Xɛɛrae Baranabasi nun Pɔlu to na kolon, e naxa e xa sosee ibɔɔ, e man fa gbelegbele ɲama ra.

sentences.english: Good people, why are you doing these things? We are men with the same feelings as you, and we give you the good news so that you may be turned away from these foolish things to the living God, who made the heaven and the earth and the sea and all things in them:
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala, «Wo tan, munfe ra wo yi fe mɔɔli rabama? Mixi nan muxu ra, alɔ wo tan. Muxu faxi xibaaru fanyi nan na wo bɛ. Muxu wo rasima wo xa ba yi fufafu fee ma alako wo xa bira Ala xa kira fɔxɔ ra, naxan koore nun bɔxi, baa nun se birin daa.

sentences.english: Who in the past let all nations go in the ways which seemed good to them.
sentences.susu: Tɛmui dangixi Ala a lu nɛ si birin xa bira e yɛtɛ kan xa kirae fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: But he was not without witness, because he did good, and gave you rain from heaven and times of fruit, making your hearts full of food and joy.
sentences.susu: Hali na birin kui, a nu fe fanyi rabama naxan findi seede ra a xa fe ra. Tunɛ ye nu fama keli koore ma. Sansie nu fanma a tɛmui alako wo xa balo, wo man xa sɛɛwa wo bɔɲɛ kui.»

sentences.english: And even with these words, it was hard for them to keep the people from making an offering to them.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu nun Baranabasi naxa kata ki fanyi ra alako e naxa sɛrɛxɛ ba e bɛ.

sentences.english: But some Jews came to that place from Antioch and Iconium, and got control over the people; and after stoning Paul, they had him pulled out of the town, taking him for dead.
sentences.susu: Awa, Yuwifie naxa fa keli Antiyɔki nun Ikoniyon. E naxa ɲama kui iso han e naxa Pɔlu magɔnɔ a xa faxa. E naxa mini a bubu ra taa fari ma barima e tan bɛ a bara gɛ faxade.

sentences.english: But when the disciples came round him, he got up and went into the town: and the day after he went away with Barnabas to Derbe.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa fɔxirabirɛe to a rabilin, a naxa keli, a man naxa gbilen taa kui.

sentences.english: And having made a number of disciples through the preaching of the good news in that town, they went back to Lystra and Iconium and Antioch,
sentences.susu: Kuye to iba, Pɔlu nun Baranabasi naxa siga Deribe. E to gɛ kawandi tide taa kui, mixi gbegbe naxa findi Isa fɔxirabirɛe ra. Na xanbi e naxa gbilen Lisitire, Ikoniyon, nun Antiyɔki.

sentences.english: Making strong the souls of the disciples, saying to them that they were to keep the faith, and that we have to go through troubles of all sorts to come into the kingdom of God.
sentences.susu: E nu Isa fɔxirabirɛe ralimaniya. E man nu e rasi e xa sabati danxaniya kui. E nu a fala, «Won mu soma Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma fo won xa tɔɔrɔ.»

sentences.english: And when they had made selection of some to be rulers in every church, and had given themselves to prayer and kept themselves from food, they put them into the care of the Lord in whom they had faith.
sentences.susu: E naxa kuntigie sugandi danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama keren keren ma bɛ. E to gɛ salide nun sunde, e naxa e taxu Marigi ra, e nu danxaniyaxi naxan ma.

sentences.english: And they went through Pisidia and came to Pamphylia.
sentences.susu: Awa, e to Pisidiya igiri, e naxa fa Panfiliya.

sentences.english: And, after preaching the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia;
sentences.susu: E naxa kawandi ti Pɛriga, e naxa goro Ataleya.

sentences.english: And from there they went by ship to Antioch, where they had been handed over to the grace of God for the work which they had not done.
sentences.susu: E to keli mɛnni, e naxa baki kunkui kui sigafe ra Antiyɔki, e nu taxuxi Ala xa hinnɛ ra dɛnnaxɛ. E nu bara gɛ na wali birin nabade.

sentences.english: And when they came there, and had got the church together, they gave them an account of all the things which God had done through them, and how he had made open a door of faith to the Gentiles.
sentences.susu: E to so, e naxa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama malan. E naxa fe birin dɛntɛgɛ sa e bɛ Ala naxan nabaxi e saabui ra, nun Ala danxaniya naadɛ rabixi si gbɛtɛe bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And they were with the disciples there for a long time.
sentences.susu: E nun Isa fɔxirabirɛe naxa bu e bore ra.

sentences.english: Now certain men came down from Judaea, teaching the brothers and saying that without circumcision, after the rule of Moses, there is no salvation.
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee naxee keli Yudaya, e naxa a fala Isa fɔxirabirɛe bɛ, «Xa wo mu wo sunna Annabi Munsa xa naamunyi ki ma, wo mu nɔma kiside.»

sentences.english: And after Paul and Barnabas had had no little argument and discussion with them, the brothers made a decision to send Paul and Barnabas and certain others of them to the Apostles and the rulers of the church at Jerusalem about this question.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu nun Baranabasi naxa wɔyɛnyi xɔrɔxɔɛ fala e bɛ. E naxa natɛ tongo Pɔlu nun Baranabasi nun mixi ndee xa te Darisalamu xɛɛrae nun kuntigie maxɔrinde yi fe ma.

sentences.english: So they, being sent on their way by the church, went through Phoenicia and Samaria, giving news of the salvation of the Gentiles, to the great joy of all the brothers.
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama naxa e xɛɛ. E dangixi Fenisiya nun Samari ra tɛmui naxɛ, e naxa a masen mɛnnikae bɛ, mixi naxee kelixi si gbɛtɛe ma, nee danxaniyaxi ki naxɛ. Yi masenyi naxa Isa fɔxirabirɛe raɲɛlɛxin.

sentences.english: And when they came to Jerusalem, they had a meeting with the church and the Apostles and the rulers, and they gave an account of all the things which God had done through them.
sentences.susu: E to so Darisalamu, danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama nun xɛɛrae, nun kuntigie naxa e rasɛnɛ. Ala naxan birin naba e saabui ra, e naxa na yaba e bɛ.

sentences.english: But some of the Pharisees, who were of the faith, got up and said, It is necessary for these to have circumcision and to keep the law of Moses.
sentences.susu: Awa, Farisɛni nde naxee nu bara danxaniya, e naxa keli, e nu fa a fala, a lanma nɛ si gbɛtɛ mixie xa sunna, e xa bira Annabi Munsa xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And the Apostles and the rulers of the church came together and gave thought to the question.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛrae nun kuntigie naxa e malan e xa na fe mato.

sentences.english: And when there had been much discussion, Peter got up and said to them, My brothers, you have knowledge that some time back it was God's pleasure that by my mouth the good news might be given to the Gentiles so that they might have faith.
sentences.susu: E to na fe isɔnxɔ sɔnxɔ, Piyɛri naxa keli, a a fala e bɛ, «N ngaxakerenyie, wo a kolon kafi tɛmui xɔnkuye Ala bara n sugandi wo tagi, alako si gbɛtɛ mixie xa xibaaru fanyi mɛ n dɛ ra, e xa danxaniya.

sentences.english: And God, the searcher of hearts, was a witness to them, giving them the Holy Spirit even as he did to us;
sentences.susu: Awa, Ala naxan mixi sondonyi kolon, na bara seedeya raba e bɛ, a a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi fi e ma alɔ won tan.

sentences.english: Making no division between them and us, but making clean their hearts by faith.
sentences.susu: A mu mixi yo rafisa a boore bɛ e tan nun won tan tagi, barima a bara e sondonyi rasɛniyɛn danxaniya ra.

sentences.english: Why then are you testing God, by putting on the neck of the disciples a yoke so hard that not even our fathers or we were strong enough for it?
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, munfe ra wo Ala matoma? Wo na kote dɔxɔfe Isa fɔxirabirɛe xun, won benbae nun won tan mu naxan nɔma.

sentences.english: But we have faith that we will get salvation through the grace of the Lord Jesus in the same way as they.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon a won nakisixi Marigi Isa xa hinnɛ nan na alɔ e tan fan.»

sentences.english: And all the people were quiet while Barnabas and Paul gave an account of the signs and wonders which God had done among the Gentiles by them.
sentences.susu: Ɲama birin naxa dundu, e naxa e tuli mati Pɔlu nun Baranabasi ra. Pɔlu nun Baranabasi naxa a tagi raba booree bɛ Ala kaabanakoe nun tɔnxumae naxee birin naba e saabui ra si gbɛtɛe tagi.

sentences.english: And when they had come to an end, James, answering, said, My brothers, give ear to me:
sentences.susu: E to gɛ wɔyɛnde, Yaki naxa wɔyɛnyi tongo, a naxɛ,

sentences.english: Symeon has given an account of how God was first pleased to take from among the Gentiles a people for himself.
sentences.susu: «N ngaxakerenyie, wo wo tuli mati n na. Simɔn bara a yaba Ala mixie sugandima ki naxɛ sie ya ma, a xili sama naxee xun ma.

sentences.english: And this is in agreement with the words of the prophets, as it is said,
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛe birin xa masenyi lanxi na nan ma. A sɛbɛxi,

sentences.english: After these things I will come back, and will put up the tent of David which has been broken down, building up again its broken parts and making it complete:
sentences.susu: ‹Na xanbi n fama nɛ Dawuda xa banxi biraxi rakelide. N na yire kanaxie rafalama nɛ, n na rakelima nɛ,

sentences.english: So that the rest of men may make search for the Lord, and all the Gentiles on whom my name is named,
sentences.susu: alako mixi naxee luxi e xa nɔ Marigi fende, si gbɛtɛ naxee birin findima n gbe ra.

sentences.english: Says the Lord, who has made these things clear from the earliest times.
sentences.susu: Marigi xa masenyi nan na ki, naxan yi fe kolon kabi a fɔlɛ, naxan yi fe birin nagirima.›»

sentences.english: For this reason my decision is, that we do not put trouble in the way of those who from among the Gentiles are turned to God;
sentences.susu: «Na na a ra, a mu lanma a xa findi fe xɔrɔxɔɛ ra si gbɛtɛe bɛ naxee wama birafe Ala fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: But that we give them orders to keep themselves from things offered to false gods, and from the evil desires of the body, and from the flesh of animals put to death in ways against the law, and from blood.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ won xa bataaxɛ sɛbɛ e ma, e naxa see don naxee baxi sɛrɛxɛ ra kuyee bɛ. E man xa ba yɛnɛ ma, a nun e naxa sube yufaxi don, e man naxa wuli min.

sentences.english: For Moses, from times long past, has his preachers in every town, reading his law in the Synagogues every Sabbath.
sentences.susu: Barima kabi won benbae xa waxati, mixie na taa birin kui, naxee Annabi Munsa xa sɛriyɛ xaranma salidee kui malabu lɔxɔɛ.»

sentences.english: Then it seemed good to the Apostles and the rulers and all the church, to send men from among them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas; Judas, named Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers:
sentences.susu: Awa, xɛɛrae nun kuntigie nun danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama birin naxa lan a ma e xa mixi ndee xɛɛ Antiyɔki, naxee Pɔlu nun Baranabasi matima. E naxa Yudasi naxan xili Barasaba, nun Silasi sugandi, xɛmɛ binyee ngaxakerenyie ya ma.

sentences.english: And they sent a letter by them, saying, The Apostles and the older brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch and Syria and Cilicia, may joy be with you:
sentences.susu: E naxa bataaxɛ keren so e yi ra naxan sɛbɛxi, «Xɛɛrae nun kuntigie, naxee lanxi wo ngaxakerenyie ma, katarabi won ngaxakerenyie ma si gbɛtɛe ya ma, naxee na Antiyɔki, Siriya, nun Silisi, muxu bara wo xɛɛbu.

sentences.english: Because we have knowledge that some who went from us have been troubling you with their words, putting your souls in doubt; to whom we gave no such order;
sentences.susu: Muxu bara a mɛ a mixi ndee naxee kelixi muxu ya ma, muxu mu ɲungui saxi naxee ma, a nee bara wo rakɔntɔfili e xa wɔyɛnyi ra. E bara wo bɔɲɛ ifu.»

sentences.english: It seemed good to us, having come to an agreement together, to send these men to you, with our well loved Barnabas and Paul,
sentences.susu: «Na na a ra, muxu bara lan a ma muxu xa xɛɛrae xɛɛ wo ma, sa Pɔlu nun Baranabasi fari, muxu xanuntenyie,

sentences.english: Men who have given up their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: naxee bara mɛɛ e nii ra won Marigi Isa xa fe ra, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi.

sentences.english: And so we have sent Judas and Silas, who will say the same things to you themselves, by word of mouth.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara Yudasi nun Silasi fan xɛɛ, naxee yi fee tagi rabama wo bɛ.

sentences.english: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit and to us, to put on you nothing more than these necessary things;
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nun muxu tan bara lan a ma muxu naxa kote gbɛtɛ dɔxɔ wo xun fo naxan daxa.

sentences.english: To keep from things offered to false gods, and from blood, and from things put to death in ways which are against the law, and from the evil desires of the body; if you keep yourselves from these, you will do well. May you be happy.
sentences.susu: A tan nan yi ki: Wo naxa sube don naxan baxi sɛrɛxɛ ra kuyee bɛ, nun sube yufaxie, wo naxa wuli fan min. Wo man naxa yɛnɛ fan naba. Wo lan wo xa gbilen yi fe birin fɔxɔ ra. Wo salamu.»

sentences.english: So they, being sent away, came down to Antioch, and having got the people together, they gave them the letter.
sentences.susu: Awa, e to bara e ɲungu ɲama ma, e naxa siga Antiyɔki, e naxa sa bataaxɛ so danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama yi ra.

sentences.english: And after reading it, they were glad of its comfort.
sentences.susu: Ngaxakerenyie to a xaran, e naxa ɲɛlɛxin, e naxa limaniya.

sentences.english: And Judas and Silas, who themselves were prophets, gave teaching to the brothers and made them strong in the faith.
sentences.susu: Yudasi nun Silasi, naxee yati nu findixi namiɲɔnmɛe ra, e naxa e kawandi, e nu e ralimaniya wɔyɛn wuyaxi ra.

sentences.english: And when they had been there for some time, they were sent back in peace by the brothers to those who had sent them.
sentences.susu: Waxati nde to dangi, e ngaxakerenyie naxa e bɛɲin bɔɲɛsa kui gbilenfe e xɛɛmae ma.
Kɔnɔ Silasi tan naxa lu naa.

sentences.english: But Paul and Barnabas kept on in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of God, with a number of others.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu nun Baranabasi naxa lu Antiyɔki, e nun e boore wuyaxi e nu fa mixie xaran, e man nu Marigi xa xibaaru fanyi kawandi ti.

sentences.english: And after some days, Paul said to Barnabas, Let us go back and see the brothers in every town where we have given the word of God, and see how they are.
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔɛ ndee to dangi, Pɔlu naxa a fala Baranabasi bɛ, «Won xa gbilen taa birin kui won Marigi xa masenyi kawandixi dɛnnaxɛ, won xa a mato won ngaxakerenyie danxaniyatɔɛe na ki naxɛ naa.»

sentences.english: And Barnabas had a desire to take with them John, named Mark.
sentences.susu: Baranabasi nu wama Yaya fan xaninfe, naxan xili Maraki.

sentences.english: But Paul was of the opinion that it was not right to take with them one who had gone away from them in Pamphylia, and had not gone on with the work.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Pɔlu naxa a fala a mu lan e xa mixi xanin e xun ma naxan keli e xun ma Panfiliya, a mu tin birade e fɔxɔ ra e xa wali kui.

sentences.english: And there was a sharp argument between them, so that they were parted from one another, and Barnabas took Mark with him and went by ship to Cyprus;
sentences.susu: Na lantareya naxa xɔrɔxɔ han a naxa findi fatanyi ra. Baranabasi naxa Maraki tongo, e naxa baki kunkui kui sigafe ra Sipiri suri ma.

sentences.english: But Paul took Silas and went away with the blessing of the brothers.
sentences.susu: E ngaxakerenyie to e taxu Marigi xa hinnɛ ra, Pɔlu naxa Silasi tongo, e naxa siga

sentences.english: And he went through Syria and Cilicia, making the churches stronger in the faith.
sentences.susu: Siriya nun Silisi bɔxie ma, e danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae ralimaniya.

sentences.english: And he came to Derbe and Lystra: and there was a certain disciple there named Timothy, whose mother was one of the Jews of the faith, but his father was a Greek;
sentences.susu: Pɔlu naxa siga Deribe nun Lisitire. Isa fɔxirabirɛ nde nu na, a xili Timote. Yuwifi ginɛ danxaniyatɔɛ nde xa di nan nu a ra. A baba Girɛkika nan nu a ra.

sentences.english: Of whom the brothers at Lystra and Iconium had a high opinion.
sentences.susu: Lisitire nun Ikoniyon ngaxakerenyie nu a xili fanyi falama.

sentences.english: Paul had a desire for him to go with him, and he gave him circumcision because of the Jews who were in those parts: for they all had knowledge that his father was a Greek.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu to wa a xaninfe a xun, a naxa a sunna Yuwifie xa fe ra naxee nu na mɛnni, barima birin nu a kolon a baba Girɛkika na a ra.

sentences.english: And on their way through the towns, they gave them the rules which had been made by the Apostles and the rulers of the church at Jerusalem, so that they might keep them.
sentences.susu: E naxa xɛɛrae nun Isa fɔxirabirɛe kuntigi naxee nu na Darisalamu, e naxa nee xa natɛ masen danxaniyatɔɛe bɛ na taae kui, e xa a rabatu.

sentences.english: So the churches were made strong in the faith and were increased in number every day.
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae xa danxaniya sɛnbɛ xun nu masama, danxaniyatɔɛ kɔnti fan xun nu masa lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ.

sentences.english: And after they had gone through the land of Phrygia and Galatia, the Holy Spirit did not let them take the word into Asia;
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi to mu tin e xa kawandi ti Asi bɔxi ma, e naxa Firigiya nun Galati bɔxi igiri.

sentences.english: And having come to Mysia, they made an attempt to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit of Jesus did not let them;
sentences.susu: E to makɔrɛ Misi bɔxi ra, e naxa wa sofe Bitiniya, kɔnɔ Isa Xaxili mu tin e xa siga naa.

sentences.english: And going past Mysia, they came down to Troas.
sentences.susu: Awa, e naxa Misi igiri, e naxa goro Tiroyasi.

sentences.english: And Paul had a vision in the night; a man of Macedonia came, requesting him, and saying, Come over into Macedonia and give us help.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ ra, Pɔlu naxa laamatunyi to. Masedonka nde naxa keli, a fa a maxandi, «Fa Masedon bɔxi ma, i xa fa muxu mali.»

sentences.english: And when he had seen the vision, straight away we made the decision to go into Macedonia, for it seemed certain to us that God had sent us to give the good news to them.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu laamatunyi to xanbi, muxu naxa la a ra a Marigi bara muxu xili xibaaru fanyi kawandife ra naa. Muxu naxa kata sigafe ra Masedon keren na.

sentences.english: So, from Troas we went straight by ship to Samothrace and the day after to Neapolis;
sentences.susu: Muxu to keli Tiroyasi, muxu naxa baki kunkui kui, muxu naxa muxu ya rafindi Samotirasi ma keren na. Na kuye iba, muxu naxa ti Neyapoli.

sentences.english: And from there to Philippi, which is the most important town of Macedonia and a Roman colony: and we were there for some days.
sentences.susu: Muxu to keli naa, muxu naxa siga Filipi, Masedon taa singe. E nu na Rɔmakae xa mangɛya nan bun ma. Muxu naxa saxanyi radangi na taa kui.

sentences.english: And on the Sabbath we went outside the town, by the river, where we had an idea that there would be a place of prayer; and, being seated, we had talk with the women who had come together.
sentences.susu: Malabu lɔxɔɛ, muxu naxa siga taa fari ma xure dɛ ra, muxu dɛnnaxɛ maɲɔxun salide ra. Muxu to dɔxɔ, muxu naxa wɔyɛn ginɛe ra naxee nu malanxi naa.

sentences.english: And a certain woman named Lydia, a trader in purple cloth of the town of Thyatira, and a God-fearing woman, gave ear to us: whose heart the Lord made open to give attention to the things which Paul was saying.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ nde nu na e ya ma naxan xili Lidi, garɛ dugi mati. Tiyatireka nan nu a ra. A gaaxu Ala ya ra. A to a tuli mati, Marigi naxa a bɔɲɛ rabi alako Pɔlu naxan falama a xa so a xaxili ma.

sentences.english: And when she and her family had had baptism, she made a request to us, saying, If it seems to you that I am true to the Lord, come into my house and be my guests. And she made us come.
sentences.susu: A to a xunxa ye xɔɔra, a nun a xa denbaya, a naxa muxu mayandi, «Xa wo sa laxi a ra n bara danxaniya Marigi ma, wo fa lu n ma banxi kui yi saxanyi.» A naxa muxu karaxan mayandi ra.

sentences.english: And when we were going to the place of prayer, we came across a girl with a spirit which gave knowledge of the future, whose masters made great profit from her power.
sentences.susu: Muxu to nu sigama salide, konyi ginɛ nde naxa fa muxu ya ra. Ɲinnɛ kanyi nan nu a ra, ɲinnɛ naxan xili Tinɛ, naxan se matoma. Na ginɛ nu naafuli xungbe rasoma a kanyie ma.

sentences.english: She came after Paul and us, crying out and saying, These men are the servants of the Most High God, who are giving you news of the way of salvation.
sentences.susu: A naxa so birafe muxu fɔxɔ ra, Pɔlu nun muxu tan. A nu sɔnxɔɛ rate, «Yi mixie Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi xa konyie nan e ra. E wo tife kisi kira nan xɔn ma.»

sentences.english: And this she did on a number of days. But Paul was greatly troubled and, turning, said to the spirit, I give you orders in the name of Jesus Christ, to come out of her. And it came out that very hour.
sentences.susu: A naxa na raba xi wuyaxi. Pɔlu to xɔnɔ, a naxa a ya rafindi, a naxa a fala ɲinnɛ bɛ, «N bara i yamari Isa xili ra, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, gbilen yi ginɛ fɔxɔ ra.» Ɲinnɛ naxa gbilen a fɔxɔ ra keren na.

sentences.english: But when her masters saw that their hope of profit was gone, they took Paul and Silas, pulling them into the market-place before the rulers;
sentences.susu: Na konyi ginɛ kanyie to a to e xa geeni bara kana, e naxa Pɔlu nun Silasi suxu. E naxa e xanin kiitisae yire.

sentences.english: And when they had taken them before the authorities, they said, These men, who are Jews, are greatly troubling our town;
sentences.susu: E naxa e dɛntɛgɛ kiitisae bɛ, e naxɛ, «Yi mixie nan won ma taa ya isofe.

sentences.english: Teaching rules of living which it is not right for us to have or to keep, being Romans.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi nan e ra naxee naamunyie xa fe masenma won mu tinxi naxee ra, won tan Rɔmakae.»

sentences.english: And the people made an attack on them all together: and the authorities took their clothing off them, and gave orders for them to be whipped.
sentences.susu: Ɲama fan naxa keli e ra, nun kiitisae. E naxa e makoyɛn, e naxa yaamari fi e xa e bɔnbɔ luxusinyi ra.

sentences.english: And when they had given them a great number of blows, they put them in prison, giving orders to the keeper of the prison to keep them safely:
sentences.susu: E to gɛ e bɔnbɔde, e naxa e woli geeli kui. E naxa kɔsibili yamari a xa e kanta a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And he, having such orders, put them into the inner prison with chains on their feet.
sentences.susu: Na kɔsibili to na yaamari sɔtɔ, a naxa Pɔlu nun Silasi sa geeli kui, a yɔlɔnxɔnyie sa e ma.

sentences.english: But about the middle of the night, Paul and Silas were making prayers and songs to God in the hearing of the prisoners;
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ tagi to a li, Pɔlu nun Silasi nu Ala maxandife, e nu Ala matɔxɔfe bɛɛti ra. Geelimanie nu e xui mɛxi.

sentences.english: And suddenly there was an earth-shock, so that the base of the prison was moved: and all the doors came open, and everyone's chains came off.
sentences.susu: Bɔxi naxa sɛrɛn keren na, geeli sanbunyi naxa a ramaxa. Na tɛmui kerenyi kui, naadɛ birin naxa rabi. Geelimanie birin xa yɔlɔnxɔnyie naxa mabolon.

sentences.english: And the keeper, coming out of his sleep, and seeing the prison doors open, took his sword and was about to put himself to death, fearing that the prisoners had got away.
sentences.susu: Kɔsibili naxa xunu. A to geeli naadɛe to e rabixi, a naxa a xa santidɛgɛma bɛndun a tɛɛ a xa a yɛtɛ faxa, a ɲɔxɔ a ma a geelimanie nu bara e gi.

sentences.english: But Paul said in a loud voice, Do yourself no damage, for we are all here.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Pɔlu naxa sɔnxɔ a xui itexi ra, «I naxa fe xɔnɛ niya i yɛtɛ ra, muxu birin na be.»

sentences.english: And he sent for lights and came rushing in and, shaking with fear, went down on his face before Paul and Silas,
sentences.susu: Awa, kɔsibili to tɛ maxili, a naxa so mafuren. A naxa a xinbi sin Pɔlu nun Silasi bun ma, a sɛrɛnma.

sentences.english: And took them out and said, Sirs, what have I to do to get salvation?
sentences.susu: A naxa e ramini, a e maxɔrin, «Marigie, a lanma n xa munse raba alako n xa kisi?»

sentences.english: And they said, Have faith in the Lord Jesus, and you and your family will have salvation.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu nun Silasi naxa a yaabi, «I xa danxaniya Marigi Isa ma. Na nan a toma i kisima, i tan nun i xa denbaya.»

sentences.english: And they gave the word of the Lord to him and to all who were in his house.
sentences.susu: E naxa Marigi xa wɔyɛnyi masen a bɛ a nun a xa mixie.

sentences.english: And that same hour of the night, he took them, and when he had given attention to their wounds, he and all his family had baptism straight away.
sentences.susu: A naxa e xanin a xun ma keren na kɔɛ kui, a naxa e xa fie yae xa. Na waxati yati a naxa xunxa ye xɔɔra, a tan nun a xa mixi birin.

sentences.english: And he took them into his house and gave them food, and he was full of joy, having faith in God with all his family.
sentences.susu: A naxa e yigiya a xa banxi kui, a man fa donse fi e ma. A naxa ɲɛlɛxin a fanyi ra, a nun a xa denbaya birin barima e bara danxaniya Ala ma.

sentences.english: But when it was day, the authorities sent the police, saying, Let these men go.
sentences.susu: Kuye to iba, kiitisae naxa sɔɔrie xɛɛ e xa sa a fala kɔsibili bɛ a xa na mixie rabolo.

sentences.english: And the keeper said to Paul, The authorities have given orders to let you go: come out now, and go in peace.
sentences.susu: Kɔsibili naxa a fala Pɔlu bɛ, «Kiitisae bara xɛɛra ti a wo xa rabɛɲin. Awa, yakɔsi wo mini, wo xa siga bɔɲɛsa kui.»

sentences.english: But Paul said to them, They have given us who are Romans a public whipping without judging us, and have put us in prison. Will they now send us out secretly? no, truly, let them come themselves and take us out.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Pɔlu naxa a fala sɔɔrie bɛ, «Muxu tan naxee findixi Rɔmakae ra, e bara muxu sa geeli e mu muxu makiiti. E naxa muxu sa geeli, yakɔsi e wama muxu raminife gundo ra? Na mu lanma feo! E yɛtɛ yati nan fama muxu rabolode.»

sentences.english: And the police gave an account of these words to the authorities, and they were full of fear on hearing that they were Romans;
sentences.susu: Sɔɔrie naxa yi wɔyɛnyie ragbilen kiitisae ma. E to a mɛ a Rɔmakae nan e ra, e naxa gaaxu.

sentences.english: Then they came and made prayers to them, requesting them, when they had taken them out, to go away from the town.
sentences.susu: E naxa fa e mayandi, e e rabolo. E fan naxa e maxandi a e xa keli na taa.

sentences.english: And they came out of the prison and went to the house of Lydia: and when they had seen the brothers they gave them comfort and went away.
sentences.susu: E to mini geeli kui, e naxa so Lidi xɔnyi. E to bara gɛ e ngaxakerenyie ralimaniyade, e naxa siga.

sentences.english: Now when they had gone through Amphipolis and Apollonia they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Synagogue of the Jews:
sentences.susu: Pɔlu nun Silasi to dangi Anfipoli nun Apoloniya ra, e naxa so Tɛsaloniki taa kui, Yuwifie xa salide nde nu na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And Paul, as he generally did, went in to them, and on three Sabbath days had discussions with them from the holy Writings,
sentences.susu: Pɔlu naxa so naa alɔ a darixi naxan na. Malabu lɔxɔɛ xi saxan bun ma, e nun Pɔlu naxa Kitaabui xa fe fala.

sentences.english: Saying to them clearly and openly that Christ had to be put to death and come back to life again; and that this Jesus, whom, he said, I am preaching to you, is the Christ.
sentences.susu: A nu a tagi raba e bɛ a a lanma Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa tɔɔrɔ ki naxɛ, a man xa keli faxɛ ma. A naxa a fala, «Isa, n naxan ma fe falafe wo bɛ yi ki, a tan nan Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra.»

sentences.english: And some of them had faith, and were joined to Paul and Silas; and a number of the God-fearing Greeks, and some of the chief women.
sentences.susu: Ndee naxa la a ra e ya ma. E naxa bira Pɔlu nun Silasi fɔxɔ ra. Girɛkika gbegbe fan naxee nu gaaxuxi Ala ya ra, nee fan naxa la a ra, e nun ginɛ hagigɛ gbegbe.

sentences.english: But the Jews, being moved with envy, took with them certain low persons from among the common people, and getting together a great number of people, made an outcry in the town, attacking the house of Jason with the purpose of taking them out to the people.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Yuwifi tɔɔnɛxi ndee naxa mixi ɲaaxi ndee tongo e xa ɲama ya iso taa kui. E naxa siga Yason xɔnyi Pɔlu nun Silasi fende alako e xa e xanin kiitisae xɔn ma.

sentences.english: And when they were not able to get them, they took Jason and some of the brothers by force before the rulers of the town, crying, These men, who have made trouble all over the world have now come here;
sentences.susu: E to mu e to, e naxa Yason nun a ngaxakerenyie ndee mabɛndun na taa kiitisae yire. E nu sɔnxɔɛ rate, e naxɛ, «Yi mixie naxee duniɲa ifuma, e bara fa be fan. Yason bara e yigiya.

sentences.english: Whom Jason has taken into his house: and they are acting against the orders of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus.
sentences.susu: E birin Rɔmaka mangɛ xa wɔyɛnyi nan gbesen bama, e man a falama a mangɛ gbɛtɛ nde na naxan xili Isa.»

sentences.english: And hearing these things the people and the rulers of the town were troubled.
sentences.susu: E naxa ɲama nun kiitisae bɔɲɛ rate na wɔyɛnyie ra.

sentences.english: And having made Jason and the others give an undertaking to keep the peace, they let them go.
sentences.susu: Beenun e xa Yason nun a booree bɛɲin, fo e to kɔbiri ba.

sentences.english: And the brothers straight away sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea: and they, when they came there, went to the Synagogue of the Jews.
sentences.susu: Na kɔɛ ra, e ngaxakerenyie naxa Pɔlu nun Silasi rasiga Beere taa. E to so naa, e naxa so Yuwifie xa salide kui.

sentences.english: Now these were more noble than the Jews of Thessalonica, for they gave serious attention to the word, searching in the holy Writings every day, to see if these things were so.
sentences.susu: Na Yuwifie xaxili nu matinse dangi Tɛsalonikikae ra. E ɲan gbata nɛ na masenyi kolonde, e man Kitaabui kui mato lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ alako e xa a kolon e naxan falama e bɛ xa nɔndi yati nan a ra.

sentences.english: And a number of them had faith, and no small number of the Greek women of high position and of the men.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi wuyaxi naxa danxaniya e ya ma, nun Girɛkika ginɛ gorobonɛ wuyaxi, nun xɛmɛ wuyaxi.

sentences.english: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had news that Paul was preaching the word at Beroea, they came there, troubling the people and working them up.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Yuwifie Tɛsalonikikae to a kolon a Pɔlu na Ala xa wɔyɛnyi kawandife Beere taa fan, e naxa fa naa, e fa ɲama ya iso.

sentences.english: So the brothers sent Paul straight away to the sea: but Silas and Timothy kept there still.
sentences.susu: Awa, danxaniyatɔɛe naxa Pɔlu tongo keren na, e naxa siga a ra baa fɛ ma, kɔnɔ Silasi nun Timote naxa lu Beere taa.

sentences.english: But those who went with Paul took him as far as Athens, and then went away, with orders from him to Silas and Timothy to come to him quickly.
sentences.susu: Naxee Pɔlu mati, e naxa siga a ra han Atɛn. Na xanbi e naxa gbilen e ɲungui ra Silasi nun Timote xɔn ma, e xa Pɔlu li sinnanyi ma Atɛn.

sentences.english: Now while Paul was waiting for them at Athens, his spirit was troubled, for he saw all the town full of images of the gods.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu nu Silasi nun Timote mamɛfe Atɛn. A bɔɲɛ naxa maɲaaxu a ra na taa xa kuyee xa fe ra.

sentences.english: So he had discussions in the Synagogue with the Jews and God-fearing Gentiles, and every day in the market-place with those who were there.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a naxa dɛ masara e nun Yuwifie ra, a nun mixie naxee gaaxuxi Ala ya ra salide kui. A man naxa wɔyɛn mixie ra a naralanma naxee ra malan yire taa kui lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ.

sentences.english: And some of those who were supporters of the theories of the Epicureans and the Stoics, had a meeting with him. And some said, What is this talker of foolish words saying? And others, He seems to be a preacher of strange gods: because he was preaching of Jesus and his coming back from the dead.
sentences.susu: Epikuri nun Sitoyisi karamɔxɔe naxa so wɔyɛnfe Pɔlu ra, e nu a fala, «Yi wɔyɛnla munse falafe?» Ndee to Pɔlu xui mɛ a Isa xa xibaaru masenma, a man nu fa marakeli fee falafe, e naxɛ, «A luxi nɛ alɔ a ala gbɛtɛe nan ma fee falama.»

sentences.english: And they took him to Mars' Hill, saying, Will you make clear to us what is this new teaching of yours?
sentences.susu: Awa, e naxa a tongo, e naxa siga a ra Areyopago malan yire, e naxa a maxɔrin, «Yi lɔnni nɛɛnɛ i naxan masenma, muxu nɔma a kolonde di?

sentences.english: For you seem to us to say strange things, and we have a desire to get the sense of them.
sentences.susu: Barima muxu fe nɛɛnɛ nan mɛfe yi ki, muxu wama na fasari nan kolonfe.»

sentences.english: (Now all the Athenians and the men from other lands who come there were giving all their time to talking or hearing of anything new.)
sentences.susu: Atɛnkae nun xɔɲɛe naxee sabatixi Atɛn, e nu darixi e tuli matife ra wɔyɛn nɛɛnɛ ra naxee masenma.

sentences.english: And Paul got to his feet on Mars' Hill and said, O men of Athens, I see that you are overmuch given to fear of the gods.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu naxa ti Areyopago tagi, a naxa a fala, «Atɛnkae, n bara a to diinɛlae yati yati nan wo ra.

sentences.english: For when I came by, I was looking at the things to which you give worship, and I saw an altar with this writing on it, TO THE GOD OF WHOM THERE IS NO KNOWLEDGE. Now, what you, without knowledge, give worship to, I make clear to you.
sentences.susu: N bara see to wo naxee batuma. N man bara sɛrɛxɛbade nde to, a sɛbɛxi naxan ma, ‹Ala naxan mu kolonxi!› Wo naxan batuma, a fa lu wo mu a kolon, n na nan ma fe masenfe wo bɛ.

sentences.english: The God who made the earth and everything in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, is not housed in buildings made with hands;
sentences.susu: Ala naxan duniɲa daaxi, a nun se naxan birin na a kui, a tan naxan koore nun bɔxi Marigi ra, a mu sabatixi banxi kui mixi bɛlɛxɛ naxan nafalaxi.

sentences.english: And he is not dependent on the work of men's hands, as if he had need of anything, for he himself gives to all life and breath and all things;
sentences.susu: A hayi mu na see ma adama naxan xaninma a xɔn ma. A tan nan baloe nun ɲɛngi nun se birin fima mixi ma.

sentences.english: And he has made of one blood all the nations of men living on all the face of the earth, ordering their times and the limits of their lands,
sentences.susu: A tan nan a niya mixi birin xa mini benba keren fate. A naxa e rasabati bɔxi birin ma. A man naxa e xa waxati nun e lude naaninyie sa,

sentences.english: So that they might make search for God, in order, if possible, to get knowledge of him and make discovery of him, though he is not far from every one of us:
sentences.susu: alako e xa Ala fen, e xa kata a kolonde, hali a to mu makuya won na.

sentences.english: For in him we have life and motion and existence; as certain of your verse writers have said, For we are his offspring.
sentences.susu: Wo xa lɔnnilae yati fan bara a fala, ‹Won baloxi a tan nɛ, won fe birin nabama a tan nan saabui ra, nun won minixi a tan nɛ. A bɔnsɔɛ nan won na.›

sentences.english: If then we are the offspring of God, it is not right for us to have the idea that God is like gold or silver or stone, formed by the art or design of man.
sentences.susu: Awa xa won kelixi a bɔnsɔɛ nɛ, a mu lanma won xa a maɲɔxun a Ala maniyaxi xɛɛma, gbeti, xa na mu gɛmɛ nan na, mixi bɛlɛxɛ naxan solixi e xaxili ra.

sentences.english: Those times when men had no knowledge were overlooked by God; but now he gives orders to all men in every place to undergo a change of heart:
sentences.susu: Ala mu nu na fe kolontareya tɛmui matoxi, kɔnɔ yakɔsi a bara a fala mixi birin bɛ, yire birin, e xa tuubi,

sentences.english: Because a day has been fixed in which all the world will be judged in righteousness by the man who has been marked out by him for this work; of which he has given a sign to all men by giving him back from the dead.
sentences.susu: barima a bara lɔxɔɛ keren sugandi, a fama duniɲa makiitide naxan ma tinxinyi ra, mixi nde saabui ra a bara a ragiri naxan ma. A bara na kanyi matɔnxumaxi rakeli faxamixie ya ma.»

sentences.english: Now on hearing about the coming back from death, some of them made sport of it, but others said, Let us go more fully into this another time.
sentences.susu: E to yi fe mɛ, fa a fala mixi kelima faxɛ ma, ndee naxa so a mayelefe. Ndee naxa a fala, «Muxu fama muxu tuli matide i ra lɔxɔɛ gbɛtɛ.»

sentences.english: And so Paul went away from among them.
sentences.susu: Awa, Pɔlu naxa mini e ya ma.

sentences.english: But some men gave him their support: among whom was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
sentences.susu: Ndee naxa lu a mabiri ra, e naxa danxaniya, alɔ Denisiyo, naxan nu na Areyopago mixie ya ma, nun ginɛ nde naxan xili Damarisi, e nun mixi gbɛtɛe ra.

sentences.english: After these things, he went away from Athens, and came to Corinth.
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, Pɔlu naxa keli Atɛn, a naxa siga Korinti.

sentences.english: And there he came across a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by birth, who not long before had come from Italy with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had given orders that all Jews were to go away from Rome: and he came to them;
sentences.susu: A naxa Yuwifi keren li naa, a xili Akila, Pontuka nan a ra. A nu baxi fade keli Itali a nun a xa ginɛ Pirisila, barima Kilɔdi nu bara Yuwifi birin yaamari e xa mini Rɔma. Pɔlu naxa kafu e ma,

sentences.english: And because he was of the same trade, he was living with them, and they did their work together; for by trade they were tent-makers.
sentences.susu: barima e nu wali keren nan nabama, kiri banxi rafalafe. A naxa lu e xɔnyi, e nu wali naa.

sentences.english: And every Sabbath he had discussions in the Synagogue, turning Jews and Greeks to the faith.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu nu wɔyɛnma salide kui malabu lɔxɔɛ birin. A nu Yuwifie nun Girɛkikae radanxaniya.

sentences.english: And when Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was completely given up to the word, preaching to the Jews that the Christ was Jesus.
sentences.susu: Silasi nun Timote to so, keli Masedon, Pɔlu naxa a yɛtɛ fi kawandi rabafe gbansan ma. A nu a fala Yuwifie bɛ a Isa nan Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra.

sentences.english: And when they put themselves against him, and said evil words, he said, shaking his clothing, Your blood be on your heads, I am clean: from now I will go to the Gentiles.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Yuwifie to na matandi konbi ra, Pɔlu naxa a xa donma ikonkon tɔnxuma ra, a naxa a fala e bɛ, «Xa wo lɔɛ, wo tan nan fɔxi na na ra. N tan bara na kote ba n xun. Yakɔsi n sigama nɛ si gbɛtɛe ma.»

sentences.english: And moving from there, he went into the house of a man named Titus Justus, a God-fearing man, whose house was very near the Synagogue.
sentences.susu: A to keli naa, a naxa so mixi nde xɔnyi, a kanyi xili Titi Yusutu, a gaaxu Ala ya ra. A xa banxi nu na salide fɛ ma.

sentences.english: And Crispus, the ruler of the Synagogue, with all his family, had faith in the Lord; and a great number of the people of Corinth, hearing the word, had faith and were given baptism.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Kirisipu salide xunmati naxa danxaniya Marigi ma a nun a xa denbaya birin. Korintikae wuyaxi naxee nu Pɔlu xui mɛxi, e fan naxa danxaniya, e naxa e xunxa ye xɔɔra.

sentences.english: And the Lord said to Paul in the night, in a vision, Have no fear and go on preaching:
sentences.susu: Marigi naxa a fala Pɔlu bɛ laamatunyi ra kɔɛ kui, «I naxa gaaxu muku! Wɔyɛn! I naxa dundu,

sentences.english: For I am with you, and no one will make an attack on you to do you damage: for I have a number of people in this town.
sentences.susu: barima n na i fɔxɔ ra. Mixi yo bɛlɛxɛ mu i lima a xa fe ɲaaxi raba i ra, barima mixi gbegbe na n bɛ yi taa kui.»

sentences.english: And he was there for a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu naxa lu naa ɲɛ keren kike senni. A nu Korintikae xaran Ala xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: But when Gallio was ruler of Achaia, all the Jews together made an attack on Paul, and took him to the judge's seat,
sentences.susu: Galiyon to nu na Akayi mangɛ ra, Yuwifie naxa yanfanteya xiri Pɔlu xun, e naxa a xanin kiitisae yire.

sentences.english: Saying, This man is teaching the people to give worship to God in a way which is against the law.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala, «Yi di nan mixie kui isoma e xa Ala batu ki gbɛtɛ naxan mu sɛriyɛ ki ra.»

sentences.english: But when Paul was about to say something, Gallio said to the Jews, If this was anything to do with wrongdoing or crime, there would be a reason for me to give you a hearing:
sentences.susu: Pɔlu to wɔyɛn fɔlɔ, Galiyon naxa a fala Yuwifie bɛ, «Xa a sa li tinxintareya na a ra, xa na mu a ra wali kobi nde, n n tuli matima nɛ wo ra nu,

sentences.english: But if it is a question of words or names or of your law, see to it yourselves; I will not be a judge of such things.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ xa a sa li boore matandi na a ra wɔyɛnyi ma, xa na mu a ra xilie ma, a nun wo xa sɛriyɛ ma, na na wo tan nan ma. N mu wama findife na fe makiitima ra.»

sentences.english: And he sent them away from the judge's seat.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a naxa e keri kiiti banxi kui.

sentences.english: And they all made an attack on Sosthenes, the ruler of the Synagogue, and gave him blows before the judge's seat; but Gallio gave no attention to these things.
sentences.susu: Ɲama naxa salide xunmati Sositene suxu, e a bɔnbɔ kiiti banxi tande ma, kɔnɔ Galiyon mu e hansa.

sentences.english: And Paul, after waiting some days, went away from the brothers and went by ship to Syria, Priscilla and Aquila being with him; and he had had his hair cut off in Cenchrea, for he had taken an oath.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu to bu Korinti ki fanyi ra, a naxa keli a ngaxakerenyie xun ma. A naxa baki kunkui kui a nun Pirisila nun Akila, e siga Siriya. A naxa a xunyi bi Senxereya, barima a nu bara laayidi tongo Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: And they came down to Ephesus and he left them there: and he himself went into the Synagogue and had a discussion with the Jews.
sentences.susu: E to so Efɛsɛ, Pɔlu naxa a ɲɛrɛbooree lu naa. A naxa so salide kui, e nun Yuwifie naxa sumun.

sentences.english: And being requested by them to be there for a longer time, he said, No;
sentences.susu: E naxa a mayandi a xa bu naa,

sentences.english: And went from them, saying, I will come back to you if God lets me; and he took ship from Ephesus.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ na mu a xunyi suxu. A naxa a ɲungu e ma. A naxɛ, «Fo n xa sa sali Darisalamu nɛ. Xa Ala tin, n man fama wo xɔnyi.»

sentences.english: And when he had come to land at Caesarea, he went to see the church, and then went down to Antioch.
sentences.susu: Awa, a naxa baki kunkui kui, a keli Efɛsɛ, a siga Sesare. A to gɛ danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xɛɛbude, a naxa goro Antiyɔki.

sentences.english: And having been there for some time, he went through the country of Galatia and Phrygia in order, making the disciples strong in the faith.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu to bara saxanyi radangi Antiyɔki, a naxa kira tongo, a naxa Galati nun Firigiya bɔxi birin isa, a nu Isa fɔxirabirɛe ralimaniya.

sentences.english: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by birth, and a man of learning, came to Ephesus; and he had great knowledge of the holy Writings.
sentences.susu: Apolosi, Yuwifi nde naxan barixi Alesandire, a naxa Efɛsɛ li. A nu fata wɔyɛnde, a Kitaabui fan kolon.

sentences.english: This man had been trained in the way of the Lord; and burning in spirit, he gave himself up to teaching the facts about Jesus, though he had knowledge only of John's baptism:
sentences.susu: A nu xaranxi Marigi xa kiraya ra. A naxa Isa xa fe masen a fanyi ra, kɔnɔ a nu Yaya xa xaranyi nan gbansan kolon xunxa tife ye xɔɔra.

sentences.english: And he was preaching in the Synagogue without fear. But Priscilla and Aquila, hearing his words, took him in, and gave him fuller teaching about the way of God.
sentences.susu: A naxa so wɔyɛnfe a rawasaxi ra salide kui. Akila nun Pirisila to a xui mɛ, e naxa kafu a ma alako e xa Ala xa kiraya masen a bɛ a ki ma.

sentences.english: And when he had a desire to go over into Achaia, the brothers gave him help, and sent letters to the disciples requesting them to take him in among them: and when he had come, he gave much help to those who had faith through grace:
sentences.susu: Na xanbi a to nu wama dangife Akayi, a ngaxakerenyie naxa a ralimaniya. E naxa bataaxɛ sɛbɛ Isa fɔxirabirɛe ma a e xa a rasɛnɛ. A xa sigɛ naxa findi fe fanyi ra danxaniyatɔɛe bɛ Akayi bɔxi ma, naxee danxaniya Ala xa hinnɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: For he overcame the Jews in public discussion, making clear from the holy Writings that the Christ was Jesus.
sentences.susu: Apolosi naxa Yuwifie matandi sɛnbɛ ra kɛnɛ ma, a naxa a masen Kitaabui ra a Isa nan Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra.

sentences.english: And it came about that while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having gone through the higher country, came to Ephesus, where there were certain disciples:
sentences.susu: Apolosi nu na Korinti. Pɔlu to bara gɛ Asi fuge biri isade, a naxa fa Efɛsɛ. A to naralan Isa fɔxirabirɛ ndee ra,

sentences.english: And he said to them, Did you get the Holy Spirit when you had faith? And they said to him, No, we have had no knowledge of the Holy Spirit.
sentences.susu: a naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo bara Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi sɔtɔ wo to danxaniya?» E naxa a yaabi, «Muxu ɲan mu nu na mɛ sinden xa Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi na na.»

sentences.english: And he said, What sort of baptism did you have? And they said, The baptism of John.
sentences.susu: A naxa e maxɔrin, «Wo wo xunxa ye xɔɔra munfe ma?» E naxa a yaabi, «Muxu bara muxu xunxa ye xɔɔra alɔ Yaya a masenxi ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And Paul said, John gave a baptism which goes with a change of heart, saying to the people that they were to have faith in him who was coming after him, that is, in Jesus.
sentences.susu: Awa, Pɔlu naxa a fala, «Yaya nu mixi xunxama ye xɔɔra nɛ tuubi xa fe ra. A nu a fala mixie bɛ, e xa danxaniya mixi nde ma naxan fama a tan xanbi ra. Na nan lanxi Isa ma.»

sentences.english: And hearing this, they had baptism in the name of the Lord Jesus.
sentences.susu: Na masenyi ma e naxa e xunxa ye xɔɔra Marigi Isa xili ra.

sentences.english: And when Paul had put his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them; and they had the power of talking in tongues, and acting like prophets.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu to a bɛlɛxɛ sa e ma, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa fa e ma. E naxa so xui gbɛtɛe falafe, e man nu Ala xa masenyi fala.

sentences.english: And there were about twelve of these men.
sentences.susu: E birin nalanxi, xɛmɛ fu nun firin nan nu e ra.

sentences.english: And he went into the Synagogue, and for three months he was preaching there without fear, reasoning and teaching about the kingdom of God.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, Pɔlu naxa so salide kui, a kawandi ti. A nu fe tagi raba e bɛ Ala xa mangɛya niini xa fe ra kike saxan bun ma. A nu kata a xa mixie nɔ naxee tuli nu matixi a ra.

sentences.english: But because some of the people were hard-hearted and would not give hearing, saying evil words about the Way before the people, he went away from them, and kept the disciples separate, reasoning every day in the school of Tyrannus.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ ndee xaxili nu xɔrɔxɔ, e mu la a ra. E naxa Marigi xa kira bɛxu ɲama ya i. Pɔlu naxa mini e ya ma, a naxa Isa fɔxirabirɛe tongo a xun, alako a xa e xaran lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ Tiranusi xa xarande kui.

sentences.english: And this went on for two years, so that all those who were living in Asia had knowledge of the word of the Lord, Greeks as well as Jews.
sentences.susu: Na naxa siga han ɲɛ firin. Yuwifie nun Girɛkika naxee birin nu sabatixi Asi, e Marigi xa masenyi ramɛ na nan kui.

sentences.english: And God did special works of power by the hands of Paul:
sentences.susu: Ala nu kaabanako xungbee rabama Pɔlu bɛlɛxɛe ra

sentences.english: So that bits of linen and clothing from his body were taken to people who were ill, and their diseases went away from them and the evil spirits went out.
sentences.susu: han e nu dugi nun xunxurie sa furemae ma, Pɔlu nu bara din naxee ra. Fure nu ba nɛ e ma, ɲinnɛ nu mini mixie i.

sentences.english: But some of the Jews who went from place to place driving out evil spirits, took it on themselves to make use of the name of the Lord Jesus over those who had evil spirits, saying, I give you orders, by Jesus, whom Paul is preaching.
sentences.susu: Yuwifie ndee naxee ɲinnɛ raminima mixie yire birin, e naxa kata Marigi Isa xili rawalide ɲinnɛ kanyie bɛ. E a fala, «N bara wo yaamari Isa xili ra Pɔlu naxan xa fe kawandima.»

sentences.english: And there were seven sons of a man named Sceva, a Jew and a chief priest, who did this.
sentences.susu: Seba, Yuwifie sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi nde, xa di solofere nan nu na fe rabama.

sentences.english: And the evil spirit, answering, said to them, I have knowledge of Jesus, and of Paul, but who are you?
sentences.susu: Ɲinnɛ naxa e yaabi, «N Isa nun Pɔlu kolon, kɔnɔ n mu wo tan kolon feo!»

sentences.english: And the man in whom the evil spirit was, jumping on them, was stronger than the two of them, and overcame them, so that they went running from that house, wounded and without their clothing.
sentences.susu: Na ɲinnɛ kanyi naxa bagan e ma, a naxa e bɔnbɔ han e naxa e gi banxi kui e rageli nun e maxɔnɔxi ra.

sentences.english: And this came to the ears of all those, Jews and Greeks, who were living at Ephesus; and fear came on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was made great.
