sentences.susu: A bara na ragiri naxee ma, a man bara e xili. A bara naxee xili, a man bara e findi tinxintɔɛe ra a ya i. A bara naxee findi tinxintɔɛe ra, a man bara xunnakeli fi e ma.

sentences.english: What may we say about these things? If God is for us, who is against us?
sentences.susu: Won munse falama na kui fa? Ala to na won bɛ, nde fa nɔma tide won kanke?

sentences.english: He who did not keep back his only Son, but gave him up for us all, will he not with him freely give us all things?
sentences.susu: A tan naxan mu tondi a xa Di yati ma, a a ba sɛrɛxɛ ra won birin bɛ, a mu fama xɛ won kide se birin na safe ra a xa Di xun ma?

sentences.english: Who will say anything against the saints of God? It is God who makes us clear from evil;
sentences.susu: Nde nɔma Ala xa mixi sugandixie kalamude? Ala yɛtɛ nan e findixi tinxintɔɛe ra a ya i.

sentences.english: Who will give a decision against us? It is Christ Jesus who not only was put to death, but came again from the dead, who is now at the right hand of God, taking our part.
sentences.susu: Nde fa kiiti rakanama e ra sɔnɔn? Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa naxan faxa, Ala naxan man nakeli faxɛ ma, a magoroxi Ala yirefanyi ma, a nu a maxandi won bɛ.

sentences.english: Who will come between us and the love of Christ? Will trouble, or pain, or cruel acts, or the need of food or of clothing, or danger, or the sword?
sentences.susu: Nde fa won bama Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa xanunteya yi? Munse nɔma na ra? Tɔɔrɛ, ka xɔrɔxɔɛ, ka ɲaxankatɛ, ka kaamɛ, ka lufe xɛɲɛ ra, ka fitinɛ, ka santidɛgɛma?

sentences.english: As it is said in the holy Writings, Because of you we are put to death every day; we are like sheep ready for destruction.
sentences.susu: Alɔ a sɛbɛxi ki naxɛ, «Fɛɛɲɛn, e muxu faxama i tan nan ma fe ra. E muxu findixi yɛxɛɛe nan na e naxee kɔn naxabama.»

sentences.english: But we are able to overcome all these things and more through his love.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na birin kui, won bara nɔɛ sɔtɔ na fe birin xun ma won xanuntenyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: For I am certain that not death, or life, or angels, or rulers, or things present, or things to come, or powers,
sentences.susu: Barima n laxi a ra, a sese mu nɔma won bade Ala xa xanunteya yi. A findi faxɛ ra ba, gbaloe ba, malekɛ ba, ɲinnɛe ba, yi waxati ba, waxati naxan sa fama ba, sɛnbɛma naxee kuye ma ba,

sentences.english: Or things on high, or things under the earth, or anything which is made, will be able to come between us and the love of God which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
sentences.susu: naxan birin na duniɲa xun ma, naxan birin na bɔxi bun ma, a findi daali yo ra, e sese mu nɔma won nun Ala xa xanunteya rafatande, a bara naxan masen won bɛ won Marigi Isa saabui ra, a xa Mixi Sugandixi!

sentences.english: I say what is true in Christ, and not what is false, my mind giving witness with me in the Holy Spirit,
sentences.susu: N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ. N mu wule falama barima n findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi gbe nan na. N sondonyi nun Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi fan findixi seedee nan na, a nɔndi nan a ra

sentences.english: That I am full of sorrow and pain without end.
sentences.susu: n bɔɲɛ sunnunxi ki fanyi, danyi mu naxan ma,

sentences.english: For I have a desire to take on myself the curse for my brothers, my family in the flesh:
sentences.susu: n ngaxakerenyie xa fe ra. Xa a sa e malima nɛ nu, n tinxi a ra n tan yɛtɛ yati xa dankɛ sɔtɔ, muxu nun Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fatan e tan ma fe ra, n barenyie muxu nun naxee si keren a ra.

sentences.english: Who are Israelites: who have the place of sons, and the glory, and the agreements with God, and the giving of the law, and the worship, and the hope offered by God:
sentences.susu: Yuwifie nan na e ra, Ala naxee sugandi e xa findi a xa die ra, a naxa a xa nɔrɛ masen e bɛ. Ala saatɛe nun laayidie tongo e tan nan bɛ, a a xa sɛriyɛ nun a batu ki fi e ma.

sentences.english: Whose are the fathers, and of whom came Christ in the flesh, who is over all, God, to whom be blessing for ever. So be it.
sentences.susu: E tan nan bɔnsɔɛ benbae na Kitaabuie kui, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi fan kelixi e tan nan bɔnsɔɛ tagi a fate bɛndɛ ki ma. Tantui nun batui xa rasiga Ala ma abadan, a tan naxan na birin xun ma. Amina.

sentences.english: But it is not as if the word of God was without effect. For they are not all Israel, who are of Israel:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a mu luxi xɛ alɔ Ala xa laayidi kanaxi nɛ. Barima naxee keli Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ, e birin xa mu findi Isirayila die yati ra.

sentences.english: And they are not all children because they are the seed of Abraham; but, In Isaac will your seed be named.
sentences.susu: E to barixi Iburahima bɔnsɔɛ, na mu a falaxi xɛ de a e birin nan findixi a xa die yati ra, barima Ala a masen nɛ Iburahima bɛ, «Isiyaga nan fama findide i bɔnsɔɛ ra n naxan laayidi i bɛ.»

sentences.english: That is, it is not the children of the flesh, but the children of God's undertaking, who are named as the seed.
sentences.susu: Yi a masenxi nɛ, a di naxee bari Iburahima bɛ a fate bɛndɛ ki ma, nee xa mu findixi Ala xa die ra. Kɔnɔ di naxee bari Ala xa laayidi saabui ra, nee nan findi Iburahima bɔnsɔɛ ra Ala ya i.

sentences.english: For this is the word of God's undertaking, At this time will I come, and Sarah will have a son.
sentences.susu: Barima Ala yi nan laayidi Iburahima bɛ, «N gbilenma tamuna yi tɛmui ɲɔndɔn, n a lima Sara bara di xɛmɛ sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: And not only so, but Rebecca being about to have a child by our father Isaac —
sentences.susu: Na gbansan fan mu a ra. Won benba Isiyaga nan findixi Rebeka xa di firin birin baba ra.

sentences.english: Before the children had come into existence, or had done anything good or bad, in order that God's purpose and his selection might be effected, not by works, but by him whose purpose it is,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ beenun gulie xa bari e xa fe fanyi xa na mu fe ɲaaxi nde raba, Ala naxa di keren sugandi e firin tagi alako a sagoe xa raba.

sentences.english: It was said to her, The older will be the servant of the younger.
sentences.susu: Yi di mu sugandi kɛwalie yo xa fe ra. Na sugandi findixi Ala xa xili nan na. Na kui, Ala naxa a masen Rebeka bɛ, «Fori nan luma a xunya xa nɔɛ bun ma.»

sentences.english: Even as it is said, I had love for Jacob, but for Esau I had hate.
sentences.susu: Alɔ a sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui ki naxɛ, «N bara Yaxuba xanu, kɔnɔ n bara mɛɛ Esayu tan na.»

sentences.english: What may we say then? is God not upright? let it not be said.
sentences.susu: Won fa na ma di? Won xa a fala a Ala mu tinxin? Astɔfulahi!

sentences.english: For he says to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and pity on whom I will have pity.
sentences.susu: Ala a masen nɛ Munsa bɛ, «N hinnɛma mixi nan na n na wa hinnɛfe naxan na. N kinikinima mixi nan ma n na wa kinikinife naxan ma.»

sentences.english: So then, it is not by the desire or by the attempt of man, but by the mercy of God.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Ala xa sugandi mu kelima mixi waxɔnfe xa ma, xa na mu mixi xa katɛ ma. A kelima Ala xa hinnɛ nɛ.

sentences.english: For the holy Writings say to Pharaoh, For this same purpose did I put you on high, so that I might make my power seen in you, and that there might be knowledge of my name through all the earth.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, Ala naxa a fala Firawuna bɛ, «N i rakelixi nɛ, n mangɛya fi i ma, alako n xa n sɛnbɛ masen i saabui ra, duniɲa birin xa n xili kolon.»

sentences.english: So then, at his pleasure he has mercy on a man, and at his pleasure he makes the heart hard.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a hinnɛma mixi ra a na wa hinnɛfe naxan yo ra, a man mixi sondonyi raxɔrɔxɔma a na wa naxan sondonyi raxɔrɔxɔfe.

sentences.english: But you will say to me, Why does he still make us responsible? who is able to go against his purpose?
sentences.susu: Nde nɔma a falade n bɛ, «Ala fa kote sama mixi xun ma munfe ra? Mixi nɔma tondide a xa maragiri ra yire?»

sentences.english: But, O man, who are you, to make answer against God? May the thing which is made say to him who made it, Why did you make me so?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan adamadi findixi nde ra i to fa Ala matandima? Fɛɲɛ yailanxi xa a fala a yailanma bɛ, «Munfe ra i n yailanxi yi ki?»

sentences.english: Or has not the potter the right to make out of one part of his earth a vessel for honour, and out of another a vessel for shame?
sentences.susu: A di, fɛɲɛ yailanyi na fɛɲɛ firin yailan bɛndɛ keren na, a mu nɔma fɛɲɛ keren yailande wali nde xa fe ra naxan tide gbo, a boore fan yailan wali nde xa fe ra naxan tide mu gbo?

sentences.english: What if God, desiring to let his wrath and his power be seen, for a long time put up with the vessels of wrath which were ready for destruction:
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li Ala wama a xa xɔnɛ nun a sɛnbɛ masenfe, a mu nɔma na rabade xɛ? Kɔnɔ a xa sabari xungbe kui, Ala diɲɛxi mixie ma a xɔnɔxi naxee ma, gbaloe ragataxi naxee bɛ.

sentences.english: And to make clear the wealth of his glory to vessels of mercy, which he had before made ready for glory,
sentences.susu: A yi rabaxi nɛ alako a xa a xa nɔrɛ makaabaxi masen a to hinnɛma mixie ra, a nu bara naxee sugandi kabi a fɔlɛ, e xa nɔrɛ sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Even us, who were marked out by him, not only from the Jews, but from the Gentiles?
sentences.susu: Won tan nan findixi na mixie ra a bara naxee xili keli si birin kui. Yuwifie gbansan mu a ra.

sentences.english: As he says in Hosea, They will be named my people who were not my people, and she will be loved who was not loved.
sentences.susu: A a masenxi Annabi Hose xa Kitaabui kui, «Naxee mu findixi n ma mixie ra, n e xili falama ‹n ma mixie.› Naxan mu findixi n ma ɲama xanuxi ra, n a xili falama ‹n ma ɲama xanuxi.›»

sentences.english: And in the place where it was said to them, You are not my people, there they will be named the sons of the living God.
sentences.susu: «Ala man a fala e bɛ dɛnnaxɛ, ‹N ma ɲama mu wo ra,› a e xili falama nɛ naa, ‹Ala xa die, Ala naxan na na.›»

sentences.english: And Isaiah says about Israel, Even if the number of the children of Israel is as the sand of the sea, only a small part will get salvation:
sentences.susu: Annabi Esayi fan a xui ite nɛ a to nu kawandi tima Isirayila xa fe ra, «Hali Isirayila mixie wuya alɔ mɛyɛn xɔri naxan na baa dɛ, a dɔnxɔɛ di nan tun kisima,

sentences.english: For the Lord will give effect to his word on the earth, putting an end to it and cutting it short.
sentences.susu: barima Ala naxan masenxi, a a rabama nɛ duniɲa ma, a a rakamali kerenyi ra.»

sentences.english: And, as Isaiah had said before, If the Lord of armies had not given us a seed, we would have been like Sodom and Gomorrah.
sentences.susu: Annabi Esayi man a masen nɛ, «Xa Ala Sɛnbɛ Birin Kanyi mu bɔnsɔɛ nde lu won bɛ nu, won luma nɛ nu alɔ Sodoma, won maniyama Gomora nan na nu.»

sentences.english: What then may we say? That the nations who did not go after righteousness have got righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith:
sentences.susu: Won fa na ma di? Si gbɛtɛ naxee mu nu katama e xa tinxinyi sɔtɔ Ala ya i, e tan bara fa a sɔtɔ danxaniya saabui ra,

sentences.english: But Israel, going after a law of righteousness, did not get it.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Isirayila ɲama naxan nu katama e xa sɛriyɛ rabatu alako e xa tinxinyi sɔtɔ Ala ya i, e tan mu nɔ na sɛriyɛ rabatude.

sentences.english: Why? Because they were not searching for it by faith, but by works. They came up against the stone which was in the way;
sentences.susu: Munfe ra? Barima e mu bira tinxinyi fɔxɔ ra danxaniya saabui ra, e ɲɔxɔ a ma a e nɔma a sɔtɔde e xa kɛwalie saabui ra. E bara e sanyi radin gɛmɛ ra naxan xili falama, «mixi rabira gɛmɛ».

sentences.english: As it is said, See, I am putting in Zion a stone causing a fall, and a rock in the way: but he who has faith in him will not be put to shame.
sentences.susu: Alɔ a sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui ki naxɛ, «Wo a mato, n bara gɛmɛ dɔxɔ Siyoni, mixie e san nadinma naxan na, gɛmɛ naxan mixie rabirama. Kɔnɔ naxan yo danxaniya a ma, na kanyi mu yaagima.»

sentences.english: Brothers, my heart's desire and my prayer to God for them is, that they may get salvation.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, n bɔɲɛ waxɔnfe birin na naxan na, Yuwifie xa kisi sɔtɔ. N ma Ala maxandi nan na ki e bɛ.

sentences.english: For I give witness of them that they have a strong desire for God, but not with knowledge.
sentences.susu: N na e seede ra, a e sɛnbɛ saxi Ala xa fee kui, kɔnɔ na mu kelixi lɔnni xa ma.

sentences.english: Because, not having knowledge of God's righteousness, and desiring to give effect to their righteousness, they have not put themselves under the righteousness of God.
sentences.susu: E to mu a kolon Ala mixi matinxinma a ya i ki naxɛ, e naxa kata e xa e yɛtɛ kan matinxin. Na kui, e mu e yɛtɛ magoro Ala bɛ a tan xa tinxinyi fi e ma.

sentences.english: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to everyone who has faith.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi bara gɛ Munsa xa sɛriyɛ rakamalide, alako naxan yo na danxaniya a ma, na kanyi xa tinxinyi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: For Moses says that the man who does the righteousness which is of the law will get life by it.
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa to nu tinxinyi xa fe masenfe naxan sɔtɔma sɛriyɛ rabatufe ma, a yi nan sɛbɛ Kitaabui kui, «Mixi naxan yi sɛriyɛ rabatuma a simaya sɔtɔma nɛ a saabui ra.»

sentences.english: But the righteousness which is of faith says these words, Say not in your heart, Who will go up to heaven? (that is, to make Christ come down:)
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a to nu tinxinyi xa fe masenfe naxan sɔtɔma danxaniya saabui ra, a yi nan sɛbɛ, «I naxa i yɛtɛ maxɔrin, ‹Nde tema koore?›» Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi mu goroxi xɛ keli koore ma?

sentences.english: Or, Who will go down into the deep? (that is, to make Christ come again from the dead:)
sentences.susu: «Xa na mu a ra i i yɛtɛ maxɔrin, ‹Nde goroma bɔxi bun?›» Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi mu kelixi faxamixie xa tagi?

sentences.english: But what does it say? The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart: that is, the word of faith of which we are the preachers:
sentences.susu: Kitaabui munse masenxi? «Ala xa masenyi makɔrɛ i ra. A na i dɛ kiri ma, a na i bɔɲɛ fan ma.» Na masenyi findixi danxaniya masenyi nan na muxu naxan kawandife:

sentences.english: Because, if you say with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and have faith in your heart that God has made him come back from the dead, you will have salvation:
sentences.susu: A i na a fala i dɛ ra a Marigi nan na Isa ra, i man naxa la a ra i bɔɲɛ kui a Ala bara a rakeli faxamixie tagi, i kisima nɛ.

sentences.english: For with the heart man has faith to get righteousness, and with the mouth he says that Jesus is Lord to get salvation.
sentences.susu: Mixi danxaniyama yi masenyi ma a bɔɲɛ nan kui, a tinxinyi sɔtɔ Ala ya i. A na la a ra, a a falama a dɛ nan na, a kisi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Because it is said in the holy Writings, Whoever has faith in him will not be shamed.
sentences.susu: Kitaabui a masenxi, «Mixi yo danxaniya a ma, a kanyi mu yaagima.»

sentences.english: And the Jew is not different from the Greek: for there is the same Lord of all, who is good to all who have hope in his name:
sentences.susu: Tagi rasa yo mu na Yuwifie nun si gbɛtɛe tagi. Marigi keren nan na e birin bɛ, a man mixi birin kima ki fanyi ra naxee na a xili.

sentences.english: Because, Whoever will give worship to the name of the Lord will get salvation.
sentences.susu: Alɔ Kitaabui a masenxi ki naxɛ, «Naxan yo na Alatala xili, na kanyi kisima nɛ.»

sentences.english: But how will they give worship to him in whom they have no faith? and how will they have faith in him of whom they have not had news? and how will they have news without a preacher?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na kui, e nɔma a xilide di xa e mu danxaniyaxi a ma? E fa danxaniyama a ma di xa e mu nu a xa fe mɛ? E fa a xa fe mɛma di xa mixi yo mu e kawandima?

sentences.english: And how will there be preachers if they are not sent? As it is said, How beautiful are the feet of those who give the glad news of good things.
sentences.susu: Na kawandi fan tima e bɛ di xa mixie mu xɛɛxi na fe ma? A sɛbɛxi, «Xɛɛrae, naxee fama xibaaru fanyi ra, e fafe fan ki fanyi!»

sentences.english: But they have not all given ear to the good news. For Isaiah says, Lord, who has had faith in our word?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ birin xa mu yi xibaaru fanyi suxuxi, barima Annabi Esayi a masen nɛ, «Marigi, nde laxi muxu xa masenyi ra?»

sentences.english: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of Christ.
sentences.susu: Na kui, mixie danxaniyama nɛ e to bara Ala xa masenyi ramɛ. E Ala xa masenyi ramɛma a xa Mixi Sugandixi xa masenyi nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: But I say, Did not the word come to their ears? Yes, certainly: Their sound has gone out into all the earth, and their words to the ends of the world.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n xa maxɔrinyi ti, e mu yi masenyi ramɛxi xɛ? Iyo xɛ, barima Kitaabui naxɛ, «E xui bara mini duniɲa birin ma, e xa masenyi bara siga han duniɲa dande.»

sentences.english: But I say, Had Israel no knowledge? First Moses says, You will be moved to envy by that which is not a nation, and by a foolish people I will make you angry.
sentences.susu: N man xa maxɔrinyi ti, Isirayila ɲama mu masenyi fahaamuxi xɛ? Yaabi fɔlɛ ra, Ala yi nan masen Annabi Munsa saabui ra, «N a niyama nɛ wo mixie tɔɔnɛ naxee ɲan mu findixi si yati ra. N a niyama nɛ wo bɔɲɛ xa te si fahaamutare ma.»

sentences.english: And Isaiah says without fear, Those who were not searching for me made discovery of me; and I was seen by those whose hearts were turned away from me.
sentences.susu: Annabi Esayi fan naxa xɛɛra iba limaniya ra Ala to yi masenyi fi a ma, «Mixie bara n to naxee mu nu n fenma. N bara n yɛtɛ masen mixie bɛ naxee mu nu n maxɔrinma sese ma.»

sentences.english: But about Israel he says; All the day my hands have been stretched out to a people whose hearts were turned away, and who put themselves against my word.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isirayila xa fe ra, a naxɛ, «Keli sogetede ma han sogegorode, n bɛlɛxɛe italaxi yi ɲama bɛ, naxan n xui matandima, naxan tondima n bɛ.»

sentences.english: So I say, Has God put his people on one side? Let there be no such thought. For I am of Israel, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n xa maxɔrinyi ti, Ala mɛɛxi nɛ a xa ɲama ra? Astɔfulahi! N tan yɛtɛ findixi Isirayilaka nan na, Iburahima xa mamadi, kelife Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ.

sentences.english: God has not put away the people of his selection. Or have you no knowledge of what is said about Elijah in the holy Writings? how he says words to God against Israel,
sentences.susu: Ala mu mɛɛxi a xa ɲama ra a bara naxan sugandi nu. Wo mu a kolon Kitaabui naxan masenxi Annabi Eliya xa fe ra, a to a xui rasiga Ala ma Isirayila xili ma?

sentences.english: Lord, they have put your prophets to death, and made waste your altars, and now I am the last, and they are searching for me to take away my life.
sentences.susu: A naxɛ, «Marigi, e bara i xa namiɲɔnmɛe faxa, e bara i xa sɛrɛxɛbadee rabira. N keren peti nan fa luxi, e katafe e xa n tan fan faxa.»

sentences.english: But what answer does God make to him? I have still seven thousand men whose knees have not been bent to Baal.
sentences.susu: Ala fa a yaabi di? A naxɛ, «N bara mixi wulu solofere ragata n yɛtɛ bɛ naxee mu nu e xinbi sin Baali kuye bɛ.»

sentences.english: In the same way, there are at this present time some who are marked out by the selection of grace.
sentences.susu: A man na na ki nɛ yakɔsi. Ala xa ɲama dɔnxɔɛ luxi, a bara naxee sugandi a xa hinnɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: But if it is of grace, then it is no longer of works: or grace would not be grace.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa a bara e sugandi hinnɛ saabui ra, kɛwali saabui xa mu a ra sɔnɔn, xa na mu Ala xa hinnɛ mu findima hinnɛ yati yati ra nu.

sentences.english: What then? That which Israel was searching for he did not get, but those of the selection got it and the rest were made hard.
sentences.susu: Won fa na ma di? Isirayila nu naxan fenfe a mu a sɔtɔ, kɔnɔ Ala nu bara naxee sugandi, nee tan bara a sɔtɔ. A dɔnxɔɛe tan bɔɲɛe naxa balan.

sentences.english: As it was said in the holy Writings, God gave them a spirit of sleep, eyes which might not see, and ears which have no hearing, to this day.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi, «Ala naxa e xaxili dɔnxu, a a niya e yae mu se to, e tulie mu fe mɛ, han yi to lɔxɔɛ.»

sentences.english: And David says, Let their table be made a net for taking them, and a stone in their way, and a punishment:
sentences.susu: Annabi Dawuda fan naxa a masen, «E xa xulunyie xa findi gantanyi ra e bɛ, yɛlɛ naxan e suxuma, gɛmɛ naxan e rabirama. Na xa findi e xa wali sare ra.

sentences.english: Let their eyes be made dark so that they may not see, and let their back be bent down at all times.
sentences.susu: E ya xa rafɔɔrɔ, e xa dɔnxu. E xa kunkurun e xa tɔɔrɛ bun ma waxati birin.»

sentences.english: So I say, Were their steps made hard in order that they might have a fall? In no way: but by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, so that they might be moved to envy.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n man xa maxɔrinyi ti, Isirayilakae to bara tantan, e bira, e mu nɔma rakelide sɔnɔn? Astɔfulahi! Kɔnɔ e xa tantanyi bara a niya si gbɛtɛe birin xa nɔ kisi sɔtɔde, alako na kisi xɔli xa Isirayilakae fan suxu.

sentences.english: Now, if their fall is the wealth of the world, and their loss the wealth of the Gentiles, how much greater will be the glory when they are made full?
sentences.susu: A di, xa e xa tantanyi findixi hɛɛri xungbe nan na duniɲa bɛ, a findi barakɛ ra si gbɛtɛe fan bɛ, e xa fe na rakamali, hɛɛri nun barakɛ xun mu masama xɛ ki fanyi?

sentences.english: But I say to you, Gentiles, in so far as I am the Apostle of the Gentiles, I make much of my position:
sentences.susu: N xa fa wɔyɛn wo bɛ, wo tan naxee mu findixi Isirayilakae ra. N to findixi xɛɛra ra wo tan si gbɛtɛe bɛ, n sɛɛwama nɛ n ma wali ra, n a matɔxɔ,

sentences.english: If in any way those who are of my flesh may be moved to envy, so that some of them may get salvation by me.
sentences.susu: alako tɛmunde na xa a niya n boore Yuwifie xa mila n ma masenyi ma, ndee xa nɔ kiside e ya ma.

sentences.english: For, if by their putting away, the rest of men have been made friends with God, what will their coming back again be, but life from the dead?
sentences.susu: Ala a kobe sofe e ra, xa na bara a niya lanyi xa so Ala nun duniɲa tagi, a di, Ala e ragbilenfe a yɛtɛ ma, na mu luma xɛ alɔ mixi na rakeli faxamixie ya ma?

sentences.english: And if the first-fruit is holy, so is the mass: and if the root is holy, so are the branches.
sentences.susu: Xa sansi xɔri xun singe bara fi Ala ma, a dɔnxɔɛ birin bara findi a gbe ra. Xa wuri bili sanke bara fi Ala ma, a salonyie fan bara findi a gbe ra.

sentences.english: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, an olive-tree of the fields, were put in among them, and were given a part with them in the root by which the olive-tree is made fertile,
sentences.susu: A luxi nɛ alɔ oliwi bili salonyi ndee na xaba a bili ma alako wula oliwi salonyie xa dafu na xabade ra. I tan misaalixi na wula oliwi salonyi nan na, naxan baloma na oliwi bili saabui ra, i dafuxi naxan na.

sentences.english: Do not be uplifted in pride over the branches: because it is not you who are the support of the root, but it is by the root that you are supported.
sentences.susu: Na kui, i naxa i yɛtɛ igbo na salonyi xabaxie ma. Beenun i xa i yɛtɛ igbo, i maɲɔxun sinden, a i tan xa mu wuri bili sanke rabaloxi. Wuri bili sanke nan i tan nabaloxi.

sentences.english: You will say, Branches were broken off so that I might be put in.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i fama nɛ a falade, «Wuri salonyie xabaxi nɛ alako n tan xa dafu e xabade ra.»

sentences.english: Truly, because they had no faith they were broken off, and you have your place by reason of your faith. Do not be lifted up in pride, but have fear;
sentences.susu: Nɔndi na a ra. E xaba e xa danxaniyatareɲa nan ma, i fan dafuxi naa i xa danxaniya nan ma fe ra. Kɔnɔ i naxa i yɛtɛ igbo. I ɲan xa gaaxu,

sentences.english: For, if God did not have mercy on the natural branches, he will not have mercy on you.
sentences.susu: barima xa Ala mu oliwi bili fanyi salon singee lu na, a mu i fan luma na de!

sentences.english: See then that God is good but his rules are fixed: to those who were put away he was hard, but to you he has been good, on the condition that you keep in his mercy; if not, you will be cut off as they were.
sentences.susu: Na kui, i ɲɔxɔ sa a xɔn ma a Ala xa fanyi gbo, kɔnɔ a xa fe man maxɔrɔxɔ. A xa fe maxɔrɔxɔ mixie nan ma naxee bara a xa kira bɛɲin, kɔnɔ a xa fanyi gbo i tan bɛ xa i luma a xa fanyi kira xɔn ma. Xa na mu a ra a i fan ma fe rabama nɛ alɔ a na oliwi salonyi xa fe raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And they, if they do not go on without faith, will be united to the tree again, because God is able to put them in again.
sentences.susu: Yuwifie fan, xa e e xa danxaniyatareɲa bɛɲin, e man fama dafude wuri bili ra, e xaba naxan ma, barima Ala sɛnbɛ gbo. A tan nɔma e ragbilende e lude fori.

sentences.english: For if you were cut out of a field olive-tree, and against the natural use were united to a good olive-tree, how much more will these, the natural branches, be united again with the olive-tree which was theirs?
sentences.susu: I tan nu findixi wula oliwi salonyi nan na, naxan xabaxi a dafu oliwi bili gbɛtɛ ma, wo nun naxan keren mu a ra. Xa Ala bara na raba i bɛ, a mu taganma oliwi bili fanyi salonyi ragbilende a lude fori, a a dafu na oliwi bili fanyi ma, e nun naxan keren a ra.

sentences.english: For it is my desire, brothers, that this secret may be clear to you, so that you may not have pride in your knowledge, that Israel has been made hard in part, till all the Gentiles have come in;
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, n waxi nɛ wo xa yi gundo kolon, alako wo naxa wo yɛtɛ maɲɔxun lɔnnilae ra. Isirayilakae bɔɲɛ balanxi nɛ sinden, han beenun si gbɛtɛ danxaniyatɔɛe kɔnti xa kamali.

sentences.english: And so all Israel will get salvation: as it is said in the holy Writings, There will come out of Zion the One who makes free; by him wrongdoing will be taken away from Jacob:
sentences.susu: Na kui, Isirayila birin fama nɛ rakiside, alɔ a sɛbɛxi ki naxɛ: «Mixi xunsarama fama nɛ keli Siyoni, a Yaxuba bɔnsɔɛ ba Ala kolontareya fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And this is my agreement with them, when I will take away their sins.
sentences.susu: Saatɛ nan na ki n naxan tongoma e bɛ, n na e xa yunubie xafari lɔxɔ naxɛ.»

sentences.english: As far as the good news is in question, they are cut off from God on account of you, but as far as the selection is in question, they are loved on account of the fathers.
sentences.susu: Yuwifie to tondixi Ala xa Xibaaru Fanyi ra, e findixi Ala yaxuie ra wo tan nan ma munafanyi xa fe ra. Kɔnɔ Ala to e sugandi a yɛtɛ bɛ, a e xanuxi e benbae nan ma fe ra,

sentences.english: Because God's selection and his mercies may not be changed.
sentences.susu: barima xa Ala bara a ɲanige a xa mixi ndee xili, a xa e baraka, na fe mu kanama feo!

sentences.english: For as you, in time past, were not under the rule of God, but now have got mercy through their turning away,
sentences.susu: Singe ra nu wo nu findixi Ala matandilae nan na, kɔnɔ yakɔsi wo hinnɛ sɔtɔxi Yuwifie nan ma Ala matandi saabui ra.

sentences.english: So in the same way these have gone against the orders of God, so that by the mercy given to you they may now get mercy.
sentences.susu: E tan bara fa findi Ala matandilae ra alako wo tan xa hinnɛ sɔtɔ Ala yi, na xanbi, a man xa hinnɛ e fan na.

sentences.english: For God has let them all go against his orders, so that he might have mercy on them all.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Ala bara adama birin lu tinxintareya xa nɔɛ bun ma alako a xa hinnɛ e birin na.

sentences.english: O how deep is the wealth of the wisdom and knowledge of God! no one is able to make discovery of his decisions, and his ways may not be searched out.
sentences.susu: Ee! Danyi mu na Ala xa munafanyi ma! A xaxili nun a xa fahaamui tilinyi dan mu na! A xa natɛ tongoxi kui mu kolonma, a ɲɛrɛ ki mu fahaamuma!

sentences.english: Who has knowledge of the mind of the Lord? or who has taken part in his purposes?
sentences.susu: Nde Marigi xa maɲɔxunyi kolon? Nde nɔma a raside?

sentences.english: Or who has first given to him, and it will be given back to him again?
sentences.susu: Nde bara a doni, a naxan xa doni ragbilenma a ma?

sentences.english: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things. To him be the glory for ever. So be it.
sentences.susu: Se birin kelixi a tan nan ma, se birin baloxi a tan nan saabui ra, a se birin daaxi a yɛtɛ nan bɛ. Tantui na a bɛ abadan! Amina.

sentences.english: For this reason I make request to you, brothers, by the mercies of God, that you will give your bodies as a living offering, holy, pleasing to God, which is the worship it is right for you to give him.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n ngaxakerenyie, Ala to bara hinnɛ wo ra, n bara wo maxandi wo xa wo yɛtɛ ba sɛrɛxɛ ra Ala bɛ, sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxi naxan bama a ɲiɲɛ ra, naxan nafanxi Ala ma. Na nan findima wo xa batui xɔri ra.

sentences.english: And let not your behaviour be like that of this world, but be changed and made new in mind, so that by experience you may have knowledge of the good and pleasing and complete purpose of God.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo ɲɛrɛ yi duniɲa mixie ɲɛrɛ ki ma. Wo xa a lu Ala xa wo ɲɛrɛ ki fori masara, a bɔɲɛ nɛɛnɛ nun xaxili nɛɛnɛ fi wo ma. Na kui, wo nɔma nɛ Ala waxɔnfe fanyi kolonde, naxan a kɛnɛnxi, naxan kamalixi.

sentences.english: But I say to every one of you, through the grace given to me, not to have an over-high opinion of himself, but to have wise thoughts, as God has given to every one a measure of faith.
sentences.susu: Ala to hinnɛ n na, a n findi a xa xɛɛra ra, n xa wo rasi: Wo naxa wo yɛtɛ sa yire, wo xa fe mu dɛnnaxande lixi. Wo naxa wo yɛtɛ igbo, wo xa wo yɛtɛ mato danxaniya xasabi nan ma, Ala bara naxan fi kankan ma.

sentences.english: For, as we have a number of parts in one body, but all the parts have not the same use,
sentences.susu: Fate keren nan na kankan bɛ, kɔnɔ na fate salonsee wuya. Fate salonse birin nun a gbe wali.

sentences.english: So we, though we are a number of persons, are one body in Christ, and are dependent on one another;
sentences.susu: Won fan na na ki nɛ. Hali won to wuyaxi, won birin bara findi fate keren na Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi saabui ra. Won luxi nɛ alɔ fate salonsee naxee fatuxi Isa fate ra won man fatu won bore ra, won birin findi fate keren na.

sentences.english: And having different qualities by reason of the grace given to us, such as the quality of a prophet, let it be made use of in relation to the measure of our faith;
sentences.susu: Ala won kima kie ra naxee dɔxɔ wuya. A na rabama a xa hinnɛ bɛrɛ nan ma a bara naxan ɲanige kankan bɛ. Xa a mixi nde kixi a xa nɔ wɔyɛnde Ala xili ra, na kanyi xa wɔyɛn Ala xili ra a xa danxaniya xasabi ma.

sentences.english: Or the position of a Deacon of the church, let a man give himself to it; or he who has the power of teaching, let him make use of it;
sentences.susu: Xa a nde kixi mixi mali wali nan na, na kanyi xa mixie mali. Xa a nde kixi mixi kawandife nan na, na kanyi xa kawandi ti.

sentences.english: He who has the power of comforting, let him do so; he who gives, let him give freely; he who has the power of ruling, let him do it with a serious mind; he who has mercy on others, let it be with joy.
sentences.susu: Xa a nde kixi mixi ralimaniyafe nan na, na kanyi xa mixie ralimaniya. Xa a nde findi mixi ra naxan ki tima, na kanyi xa mixie ki a fanyi ra. Xa a nde findi yarerati ra, a kanyi xa na raba a ki ma. Xa a nde findi tɔɔrɔmixie malima ra, a kanyi xa na raba sɛɛwɛ ra.

sentences.english: Let love be without deceit. Be haters of what is evil; keep your minds fixed on what is good.
sentences.susu: Wo xa mixie xanu bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra. Wo xa fe kobi xɔn, wo xa fe fanyi suxu wo sɛnbɛ birin na.

sentences.english: Be kind to one another with a brother's love, putting others before yourselves in honour;
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo bore xanu ngaxakerenya xanunteya nan na. Wo xa wo bore binya dangife wo yɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: Be not slow in your work, but be quick in spirit, as the Lord's servants;
sentences.susu: Wo tun naxa raxɔnɔ, wo xa wo tunnabɛxi. Wo xa wakili wo bɔɲɛ birin na. Wo xa wali wo Marigi bɛ.

sentences.english: Being glad in hope, quiet in trouble, at all times given to prayer,
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɛɛwa fe ma wo xaxili tixi naxan na. Wo xa duluxɔtɔ wo xa tɔɔrɛ kui. Wo naxa tagan Ala maxandide.

sentences.english: Giving to the needs of the saints, ready to take people into your houses.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɛniyɛntɔɛe mali e xa tɔɔrɛ kui. Wo xa xɔɲɛe rasɛnɛ.

sentences.english: Give blessing and not curses to those who are cruel to you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Ala maxandi mixie bɛ naxee wo ɲaxankatama. Wo xa duba e bɛ, wo naxa e danka.

sentences.english: Take part in the joy of those who are glad, and in the grief of those who are sorrowing.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɛɛwa booree xa sɛɛwɛ, wo xa sunnun boore xa sunnunyi.

sentences.english: Be in harmony with one another. Do not have a high opinion of yourselves, but be in agreement with common people. Do not give yourselves an air of wisdom.
sentences.susu: Wo xa lan wo bore ma. Wo naxa wo yɛtɛ igbo, yɛtɛ magore nan xa rafan wo ma. Wo naxa wo yɛtɛ maɲɔxun lɔnnilae ra.

sentences.english: Do not give evil for evil to any man. Let all your business be well ordered in the eyes of all men.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa fe kobi ɲɔxɔ fe kobi ra. Wo xa kata mixie xa wo kolon fe fanyi rabae nan na.

sentences.english: As far as it is possible for you be at peace with all men.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo nɔ fe birin naba alako lanyi xa lu wo nun mixi birin tagi.

sentences.english: Do not give punishment for wrongs done to you, dear brothers, but give way to the wrath of God; for it is said in the holy Writings, Punishment is mine, I will give reward, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie, wo naxa wo gbeɲɔxɔ wo yɛtɛ ra, wo xa na lu Ala ma, barima a sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, «Ala naxɛ, n tan nan wo gbeɲɔxɔma, n tan nan fe kobi ragbilenma a rabama ma.»

sentences.english: But if one who has hate for you is in need of food or of drink, give it to him, for in so doing you will put coals of fire on his head.
sentences.susu: A man sɛbɛxi, «Xa kaamɛ na i yaxui ma, i xa a ki donse ra. Xa ye xɔli na a ma, i xa a ki ye ra. Na kui a luxi nɛ alɔ i na tɛ wolee ibaganfe a xunyi ma.»

sentences.english: Do not let evil overcome you, but overcome evil by good.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa tin fe kobi xa nɔ wo ra, wo tan nan xa fe kobi nɔ, fe fanyi raba ra.

sentences.english: Let everyone put himself under the authority of the higher powers, because there is no power which is not of God, and all powers are ordered by God.
sentences.susu: Birin xa a yɛtɛ magoro a xa mangɛe bɛ, barima mangɛya birin kelima Ala nan ma, a na a ragiri naxan ma.

sentences.english: For which reason everyone who puts himself against the authority puts himself against the order of God: and those who are against it will get punishment for themselves.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, mixi naxan na mangɛ matandi, na kanyi Ala nan xa yaamari matandixi. A fama nɛ a xa na wali kobi sare sɔtɔde.

sentences.english: For rulers are not a cause of fear to the good work but to the evil. If you would have no fear of the authority, do good and you will have praise;
sentences.susu: Wali fanyi rabae mu gaaxuma mangɛe ya ra, wali kobi rabae nan gaaxuma e ya ra. Xa i mu wama i xa gaaxu mangɛ ya ra, i xa lu kira fanyi nan xɔn ma. Na kui, mangɛ fama nɛ i matɔxɔde,

sentences.english: For he is the servant of God to you for good. But if you do evil, have fear; for the sword is not in his hand for nothing: he is God's servant, making God's punishment come on the evil-doer.
sentences.susu: barima mangɛ walima Ala nan bɛ wo xa munafanyi xa fe ra. Kɔnɔ xa i fe kobi raba, a lanma i xa gaaxu, barima santidɛgɛma mu na mangɛ yi fufafu xa ra. A to na Ala xa wali nan na, a Ala xa xɔnɛ nan masenma fe kobi rabae xili ma.

sentences.english: So put yourselves under the authority, not for fear of wrath, but because you have the knowledge of what is right.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, fo wo xa wo yɛtɛ magoro nɛ mangɛe bɛ. Wo na rabama na ɲaxankatɛ xa fe gaaxui ma, a nun man wo bɔɲɛ nan yati wama wo xa a raba na ki.

sentences.english: For the same reason, make payment of taxes; because the authority is God's servant, to take care of such things at all times.
sentences.susu: Wo lan wo xa duuti fi na nan ma, barima duuti maxilie fan na Ala xa yaamari nan na.

sentences.english: Give to all what is their right: taxes to him whose they are, payment to him whose right it is, fear to whom fear, honour to whom honour is to be given.
sentences.susu: Wo kankan gbe so a yi, a lan a xa naxan sɔtɔ. Wo duuti so duuti maxilie yi, wo wo magoro mixie bɛ wo lanma wo xa wo magoro naxee bɛ, wo mixie binya wo lan wo xa naxee binya.

sentences.english: Be in debt for nothing, but to have love for one another: for he who has love for his neighbour has kept all the law.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo xa doni naxa lu wo ma, wo xa xanunteya nan lan a xa lu wo bore bɛ, barima naxan na a boore maxanu, a bara sɛriyɛ rakamali.

sentences.english: And this, Do not be untrue in married life, Do not put to death, Do not take what is another's, Do not have desire for what is another's, and if there is any other order, it is covered by this word, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself.
sentences.susu: Ala xa yaamarie alɔ, «I naxa yɛnɛ raba, i naxa mixi faxa, i naxa muɲɛ ti, i naxa mila,» a nun yaamari gbɛtɛe birin, nee malanxi findixi masenyi keren nan na: I xa i boore xanu alɔ i yɛtɛ yati.

sentences.english: Love does no wrong to his neighbour, so love makes the law complete.
sentences.susu: I na i boore xanu, i mu fefe kobi niyama a ra. Na na a ra, i boore xanufe findixi Ala xa sɛriyɛ birin nabatufe nan na.

sentences.english: See then that the time has come for you to be awake from sleep: for now is your salvation nearer than when you first had faith.
sentences.susu: Na fe birin kui, wo a kolon won na waxati naxɛ. Xunu tɛmui bara a li xi xɔli ma, kisi bara makɔrɛ won na dangi waxati ra won danxaniyaxi tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: The night is far gone, and the day is near: so let us put off the works of the dark, arming ourselves with light,
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ bara masiga, a gbe mu luxi kuye xa iba. Won xa Sentanɛ xa dimi walie bɛɲin, won fa Ala xa naiyalanyi ma, won xa a xa geresosee tongo.

sentences.english: With right behaviour as in the day; not in pleasure-making and drinking, not in bad company and unclean behaviour, not in fighting and envy.
sentences.susu: Won xa ɲɛrɛ tinxinyi kui alɔ a lanma won xa ɲɛrɛ ki naxɛ Ala xa naiyalanyi kui. Won naxa siga xulun ɲaaxi, won naxa siisi, won naxa yɛnɛ nun langoeɲa raba, won xa gere nun tɔɔnɛ lu na.

sentences.english: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and do not give thought to the flesh to do its desires.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa fe nan suxu, wo naxa bira wo fate bɛndɛ waxɔnfe fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Do not put on one side him who is feeble in faith, and do not put him in doubt by your reasonings.
sentences.susu: Wo xa danxaniyatɔɛ rasɛnɛ hali a xa danxaniya mu tilin. Wo naxa a rakiiti a xa maɲɔxunyi birin xa fe ra.

sentences.english: One man has faith to take all things as food: another who is feeble in faith takes only green food.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde nɔma lade a ra, a donse birin radaxaxi a bɛ, kɔnɔ mixi gbɛtɛ naxan xa danxaniya mu tilin, a nɔma lade a ra a sansi bogi gbansan nan nadaxaxi a bɛ.

sentences.english: Let not him who takes food have a low opinion of him who does not: and let not him who does not take food be a judge of him who does; for he has God's approval.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan donse mɔɔli birin donma, na mu lan a xa a boore raɲaaxu naxan tondima donse nde donfe ra. Mixi naxan mu sube donma, na kanyi fan mu lan a xa a boore makiiti naxan sube donma, barima Ala na kanyi fan nasɛnɛma nɛ.

sentences.english: Who are you to make yourself a judge of another man's servant? it is to his master that he is responsible for good or bad. Yes, his place will be safe, because the Lord is able to keep him from falling.
sentences.susu: Nde i findixi kiitisa ra mixi gbɛtɛ xa konyi xun ma? A na ti a marigi ya i a xa wali xa fe ra, a xan ba, a mu xan ba, na na a tan nun a marigi nan tagi. Anun, a xanma nɛ, barima Marigi Ala nɔma a raxande.

sentences.english: This man puts one day before another: to that man they are the same. Let every man be certain in his mind.
sentences.susu: Mixi nde nɔma lade a ra a lɔxɔɛe tide gbo e boore bɛ, kɔnɔ mixi gbɛtɛ tan bɛ, lɔxɔɛ birin lan. Kankan laxi naxan na, a xa la a ra a bɔɲɛ nan yati ma.

sentences.english: He who keeps the day, keeps it to the Lord; and he who takes food, takes it as to the Lord, for he gives praise to God; and he who does not take food, to the Lord he takes it not, and gives praise to God.
sentences.susu: Naxan laxi a ra a lɔxɔɛe tide gbo e boore bɛ, na kanyi laxi a ra Marigi nan bɛ. Naxan donse mɔɔli birin donma, a kanyi a rabama Marigi nan bɛ, barima a tantui rasigama Ala ma a xa baloe xa fe ra. Mixi naxan mu donse nde donma, na kanyi fan na rabama Marigi nan bɛ, barima a fan tantui rasigama Ala ma.

sentences.english: For every man's life and every man's death has a relation to others as well as to himself.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo gbe mu a yɛtɛ ra, keli yi duniɲa, han laaxira.

sentences.english: As long as we have life we are living to the Lord; or if we give up our life it is to the Lord; so if we are living, or if our life comes to an end, we are the Lord's.
sentences.susu: Xa won balo, xa won faxa, na birin nabama Marigi nan bɛ. Xa won baloxi, xa won faxaxi, won findixi Marigi gbe nan na,

sentences.english: And for this purpose Christ went into death and came back again, that he might be the Lord of the dead and of the living.
sentences.susu: barima Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi faxa nɛ, a man keli faxɛ ma, alako a xa findi mixi faxaxie nun a baloxie Marigi ra.

sentences.english: But you, why do you make yourself your brother's judge? or again, why have you no respect for your brother? because we will all have to take our place before God as our judge.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra i tan fa i boore makiitima? Munfe ra i a raɲaaxuma? Won birin mu fama tide xɛ Ala ya i kiiti lɔxɔɛ?

sentences.english: For it is said in the holy Writings, By my life, says the Lord, to me every knee will be bent, and every tongue will give worship to God.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, Marigi naxɛ, «N xa nɔndi masen wo bɛ. Birin fama nɛ e xinbi sinde n bɛ. Adamadi dɛ birin fama a masende, a n tan nan na Ala ra.»

sentences.english: So every one of us will have to give an account of himself to God.
sentences.susu: Kankan fama nɛ a xa wali dɛntɛgɛde Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: Then let us not be judges of one another any longer: but keep this in mind, that no man is to make it hard for his brother, or give him cause for doubting.
sentences.susu: Na kui, won naxa won bore makiiti. Won xa fe birin nan naba alako won naxa won ngaxakerenyi ratantan.

sentences.english: I am conscious of this, and am certain in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean in itself; but for the man in whose opinion it is unclean, for him it is unclean.
sentences.susu: N to danxaniyaxi Marigi Isa ma, n a kolon, n man laxi a ra, a donse yo mu na naxan findixi donse sɛniyɛntare ra. Kɔnɔ xa i xaxili bara siikɛ donse nde xa sɛniyɛntareɲa ma, na bara findi i bɛ se sɛniyɛntare ra.

sentences.english: And if because of food your brother is troubled, then you are no longer going on in the way of love. Do not let your food be destruction to him for whom Christ went into death.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li i donse nde donma naxan i ngaxakerenyi tɔɔrɔma, i mu ɲɛrɛfe xanunteya xa ma. I xa donse xa fe naxa a niya i ngaxakerenyi xa gan kisi ra, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi faxa naxan ma fe ra.

sentences.english: Let it not be possible for men to say evil about your good:
sentences.susu: Na kui, a mu lan mixie xa fe kobi fala se nde xa fe ra, naxan findixi a fanyi ra wo bɛ.

sentences.english: For the kingdom of God is not food and drink, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.
sentences.susu: Ala xa mangɛya niini mu findixi donse nun minse fe xa ra. A findixi tinxinyi nun sɛɛwɛ fe nan na, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra.

sentences.english: And he who in these things is Christ's servant, is pleasing to God and has the approval of men.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan walima Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi bɛ yi mɔɔli ra, a rafanma nɛ Ala ma, a rafan mixie fan ma.

sentences.english: So then, let us go after the things which make peace, and the things by which we may be a help to one another.
sentences.susu: Na kui, won xa fe birin naba alako lanyi xa lu won tagi, won xa won bore xa danxaniya sɛnbɛ so.

sentences.english: Do not let the work of God come to nothing on account of food. All things are certainly clean; but it is evil for that man who by taking food makes it hard for another.
sentences.susu: I naxa Ala xa wali xun nakana donse nde xa fe ra. A nɔndi ki ma, donse birin daxa, kɔnɔ a mu lan mixi yo xa donse nde don naxan a ngaxakerenyi ratantanma.

sentences.english: It is better not to take meat or wine or to do anything which might be a cause of trouble to your brother.
sentences.susu: Hali mixi mu sube yo don, a mu wɛni yo min, a mu fefe yo raba naxan a ngaxakerenyi ratantanma, na nan fan.

sentences.english: The faith which you have, have it to yourself before God. Happy is the man who is not judged by that to which he gives approval.
sentences.susu: Maɲɔxunyi yo na i bɛ yi xa fe ra, i xa a lu i nun Ala tagi. Sɛɛwɛ na mixi bɛ naxan mu a yɛtɛ ratɔnma a xa maɲɔxunyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: But he who is in doubt is judged if he takes food, because he does it not in faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa mixi donse nde donma a siikɛxi naxan ma fe ra, na kanyi bara kiiti kana a yɛtɛ bɛ, barima a bara fe raba a mu laxi naxan na. Mixi mu laxi fe naxan na, na tan bara findi yunubi fe ra a bɛ.

sentences.english: We who are strong have to be a support to the feeble, and not give pleasure to ourselves.
sentences.susu: Won tan naxee xa danxaniya tilin, a lanma won xa diɲɛ mixie bɛ naxee xa danxaniya mu tilin. Won naxa won yɛtɛ waxɔnfe gbansan xa fen.

sentences.english: Let every one of us give pleasure to his neighbour for his good, to make him strong.
sentences.susu: Kankan xa a boore nan xa hɛɛri fen, naxan nɔma a malide a xa danxaniya xun xa masa.

sentences.english: For Christ did not give pleasure to himself, but, as it is said, The bitter words of those who were angry with you came on me.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi mu a yɛtɛ waxɔnfe xa fen. A a fala nɛ alɔ a sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui ki naxɛ, «Konbie naxee ilanxi i ra, nee n tan nan lixi.»

sentences.english: Now those things which were put down in writing before our time were for our learning, so that through quiet waiting and through the comfort of the holy Writings we might have hope.
sentences.susu: Fe naxan birin sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui waxati dangixi, e sɛbɛxi nɛ alako won xa fahaamui sɔtɔ, won xa won tunnabɛxi, won xa limaniya, alako xaxili tide xa lu won bɛ.

sentences.english: Now may the God who gives comfort and strength in waiting make you of the same mind with one another in harmony with Christ Jesus:
sentences.susu: Ala, a tan naxan tunnabɛxiya nun limaniya fima, a xa lanyi raso wo tagi alɔ a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa a masenxi wo bɛ ki naxɛ,

sentences.english: So that with one mouth you may give glory to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: alako wo xa Ala matɔxɔ xaxili nun xui keren na, a tan naxan findixi a xa Mixi Sugandixi nun won Marigi Isa Baba ra.

sentences.english: So then, take one another to your hearts, as Christ took us, to the glory of God.
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo xa wo bore rasɛnɛ alɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi wo rasɛnɛ ki naxɛ, alako Ala xa matɔxɔɛ sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision to give effect to the undertakings given by God to the fathers,
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi wali nɛ Yuwifie bɛ alako a xa a masen a Ala na a xui xanbi ra a to bara a xa laayidie rakamali a naxee tongo e benbae bɛ.

sentences.english: And so that the Gentiles might give glory to God for his mercy; as it is said, For this reason I will give praise to you among the Gentiles, and I will make a song to your name.
sentences.susu: Si gbɛtɛe fan Ala matɔxɔma a xa hinnɛ xa fe ra, alɔ a sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui ki naxɛ, «Na nan a ra n i matɔxɔma si birin tagi, n bɛɛti bama nɛ i xili xa binyɛ bun ma.»

sentences.english: And again he says, Take part, you Gentiles, in the joy of his people.
sentences.susu: A man sɛbɛxi, «Si gbɛtɛe, wo nun Ala xa ɲama xa sɛɛwa.»

sentences.english: And again, Give praise to the Lord, all you Gentiles; and let all the nations give praise to him.
sentences.susu: A man sɛbɛxi, «Wo tan ɲamanɛe birin, wo Marigi matɔxɔ, si birin xa a tantu.»

sentences.english: And again Isaiah says, There will be the root of Jesse, and he who comes to be the ruler over the Gentiles; in him will the Gentiles put their hope.
sentences.susu: Annabi Esayi man naxa a masen, «Yisayi xa di fama nɛ. A findima nɛ mangɛ ra si birin xun ma, e fan e xaxili tima nɛ a ra.»

sentences.english: Now may the God of hope make you full of joy and peace through faith, so that all hope may be yours in the power of the Holy Spirit.
sentences.susu: Ala, a tan naxan xaxili tide fima, a xa wo rafe sɛɛwɛ nun bɔɲɛsa ra danxaniya kui a mɔɔli birin na. Na kui, xaxili tide luma nɛ wo bɛ tɛmui birin, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa sɛnbɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: And I myself am certain of you, brothers, that you are full of what is good, complete in all knowledge, able to give direction to one another.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, n tan a kolon wo bɔɲɛ fan, wo bara lɔnni sɔtɔ a fanyi ra, wo fata wo bore raside.

sentences.english: But I have, in some measure, less fear in writing to you to put these things before you again, because of the grace which was given to me by God,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n to sɛbɛli tixi wo ma, n ma masenyi ndee findixi masenyi xɔrɔxɔɛe nan na alako n xa wo ratu, barima Ala to hinnɛxi n na,

sentences.english: To be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, doing the work of a priest in the good news of God, so that the offering of the Gentiles might be pleasing to God, being made holy by the Holy Spirit.
sentences.susu: a bara n findi a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa walikɛ ra sigafe ra si gbɛtɛe ma. Na kui, n sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali nan nabama n to Ala xa xibaaru fanyi kawandima si gbɛtɛe bɛ, alako Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa e findi sɛrɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxi ra naxan Ala kɛnɛnma.

sentences.english: So I have pride in Christ Jesus in the things which are God's.
sentences.susu: Na birin kui, n nun Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa to a ra, n nɔma sɛɛwade n ma wali ra Ala bɛ,

sentences.english: And I will keep myself from talking of anything but those things which Christ has done by me to put the Gentiles under his rule in word and in act,
sentences.susu: barima n mu suusama fefe xa fe falade fo Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi bara naxan naba n saabui ra, alako si gbɛtɛe xa Ala xui rabatu. A bara na raba n ma masenyie nun n ma kɛwalie saabui ra,

sentences.english: By signs and wonders, in the power of the Holy Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and round about as far as Illyricum I have given all the good news of Christ;
sentences.susu: kaabanakoe nun tɔnxumae xa sɛnbɛ saabui ra, a nun Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi sɛnbɛ saabui ra. Na kui, kelife Darisalamu han a sa dɔxɔ Iliri ra, n bara Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa xibaaru fanyi rayensen yɛ.

sentences.english: Making it my purpose not to take the good news where Christ was named, so that my work might not be resting on that of others;
sentences.susu: Na birin kui, n kataxi nɛ n xa mixie kawandi Isa xa xibaaru fanyi ra naxee mu Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi kolon. N mu wa na rabafe kawandila gbɛtɛ dangi fɔxi.

sentences.english: But as it is said in the holy Writings, They will see, to whom the news of him had not been given, and those to whose ears it had not come will have knowledge.
sentences.susu: Alɔ a sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui ki naxɛ, «A xa fe singe mu nu fala naxee bɛ, e fama nɛ a kolonde. Mixi naxee singe mu nu a xa fe mɛ, e fama nɛ a fahaamude.»

sentences.english: For which reason I was frequently kept from coming to you:
sentences.susu: Yi wali nan a niyaxi n mu nɔxi sigade wo yire.

sentences.english: But now, having no longer any place in these parts and having had for a number of years a great desire to come to you,
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n ma wali bara ɲɔn yi bɔxie ma. N nu bara wa sigafe wo yire kabi ɲɛ wuyaxi.

sentences.english: Whenever I go to Spain (for it is my hope to see you on my way, and to be sent on there by you, if first I may in some measure have been comforted by your company) —
sentences.susu: A xɔli n ma n xa dangi wo yire n na kira suxu sigafe ra Sipanyi bɔxi ma. Won xa lu yire keren waxati nde ma alako n xa ɲɛlɛxin wo tofe ra, a xɔli n ma wo xa n mali sigafe ra Sipanyi.

sentences.english: But now I go to Jerusalem, taking help for the saints.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n na sigafe Darisalamu sɛniyɛntɔɛe malide,

sentences.english: For it has been the good pleasure of those of Macedonia and Achaia to send a certain amount of money for the poor among the saints at Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: barima danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae naxee na Masedon nun Akayi bɔxi ma, e a ɲanige nɛ e xa e harige nde malan, e xa a rasanba Darisalamu misikiinɛe ma naxee na na sɛniyɛntɔɛe ya ma.

sentences.english: Yes, it has been their good pleasure; and they are in their debt. For if the Gentiles have had a part in the things of the Spirit which were theirs, it is right for them, in the same way, to give them help in the things of the flesh.
sentences.susu: E tan nan a ɲanigexi. Anun, a lanma e xa na natɛ tongo barima Yuwifie to findi saabui ra e tan si gbɛtɛe bɛ Ala xa fee kui, a lan nɛ e fan xa Yuwifie mali baloe fe ra.

sentences.english: So when I have done this, and have given them this fruit of love, I will go on by you into Spain.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n na gɛ na wali ra, n yi kɔbiri so e yi danxaniyatɔɛe bara naxan nasanba, n dangima wo yire sigafe ra Sipanyi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And I am certain that when I come, I will be full of the blessing of Christ.
sentences.susu: N a kolon n to sigafe wo yire, na findima Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa barakɛ nan na wo bɛ.

sentences.english: Now I make request to you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that you will be working together with me in your prayers to God for me;
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, n bara wo mayandi won Marigi Isa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fe ra, a nun xanunteya xa fe ra naxan kelima Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi ma, wo xa n mali, wo xa wakili n bɛ Ala maxandi kui.

sentences.english: So that I may be kept safe from those in Judaea who have not put themselves under the rule of God, and that the help which I am taking for Jerusalem may be pleasing to the saints;
sentences.susu: Wo Ala maxandi n bɛ a xa n natanga Yudaya danxaniyataree ma, a nun man, Darisalamu sɛniyɛntɔɛe xa ɲɛlɛxin e malise ra n sigafe naxan na e xɔn.

sentences.english: So that I may come to you in joy by the good pleasure of God, and have rest with you.
sentences.susu: Na kui, xa Ala tin, n wo yire lima sɛɛwɛ kui, won nɔ won bore sɛnbɛ sode.

sentences.english: Now may the God of peace be with you all. So be it.
sentences.susu: Ala, a tan naxan bɔɲɛsa fima, a xa lu wo birin sɛɛti ma. Amina.

sentences.english: It is my desire to say a good word for Phoebe, who is a servant of the church in Cenchreae:
sentences.susu: N bara wa won ngaxakerenyi ginɛma Fowebe masenfe wo bɛ, naxan danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama malima Senxereya taa kui.

sentences.english: That you will take her in kindly, after the way of the saints, as one who is the Lord's, and give her help in anything in which she may have need of you: because she has been a help to a great number and to myself.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a rasɛnɛ Isayanka ki ma, alɔ a lanma sɛniyɛntɔɛe xa a raba ki naxɛ. Xa a hayi na se nde ma, wo xa a mali, barima a fan bara n tan nun mixi gbegbe mali.

sentences.english: Give my love to Prisca and Aquila, workers with me in Christ Jesus,
sentences.susu: Wo xa Pirisila nun Akila xɛɛbu n bɛ, n walibooree Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa fe kui.

sentences.english: Who for my life put their necks in danger; to whom not only I but all the churches of the Gentiles are in debt:
sentences.susu: E fe birin naba nɛ e xa n nii ratanga beenun e xa e yɛtɛ ratanga. Bafe n tan na, si gbɛtɛe danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae birin e tantuma na fe ma.

sentences.english: And say a kind word to the church which is in their house. Give my love to my dear Epaenetus, who is the first fruit of Asia to Christ.
sentences.susu: Wo man xa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xɛɛbu naxan e malanma e xɔnyi. Wo xa n xanuntenyi Epeneto xɛɛbu n bɛ. A tan nan singe danxaniya Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ma Asi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: Give my love to Mary, who gave much care to you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Mariyama xɛɛbu n bɛ, naxan bara wali wo ya ma ki fanyi.

sentences.english: Give my love to Andronicus and Junia, my relations, who were in prison with me, who are noted among the Apostles, and who were in Christ before me.
sentences.susu: Wo xa n boore Yuwifie Andironiku nun Yuniya xɛɛbu, muxu nun naxee bara sa geeli. Ala xa xɛɛrae nan e ra, naxee bara kolon a fanyi ra, naxee singe danxaniya n bɛ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ma.

sentences.english: Give my love to Ampliatus, who is dear to me in the Lord,
sentences.susu: Wo xa Anpiliyatu xɛɛbu n bɛ, n xanuntenyi Marigi fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Give my love to Urbanus, a worker in Christ with us, and to my dear Stachys.
sentences.susu: Wo xa muxu waliboore Urubano nun n xanuntenyi Sitaxusi xɛɛbu.

sentences.english: Give my love to Apelles, who has the approval of Christ. Say a kind word to those who are of the house of Aristobulus.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Apɛlɛsi xɛɛbu, naxan bara a xa danxaniya masen Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ma. Wo xa Arisitobulo xa mixie xɛɛbu n bɛ.

sentences.english: Give my love to Herodion, my relation. Say a kind word to those of the house of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa n boore Yuwifi Herodiyon xɛɛbu n bɛ. Wo xa Narisiso xa mixie xɛɛbu n bɛ, naxee danxaniyaxi Marigi ma.

sentences.english: Give my love to Tryphaena and Tryphosa, workers in the Lord. Give my love to my dear Persis, who did much work in the Lord.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Tirifena nun Tirifosa xɛɛbu n bɛ. Ginɛe naxee e ra, e walima Marigi bɛ. Wo xa n xanuntenyi Peresidi xɛɛbu. A fan bara wali Marigi bɛ ki fanyi.

sentences.english: Give my love to Rufus, one of the Lord's selection, and to his mother and mine.
sentences.susu: Wo Rufu xɛɛbu, naxan sugandixi Marigi xa fe kui. Wo a nga fan xɛɛbu n bɛ, naxan bara lu n bɛ alɔ n fan nga.

sentences.english: Give my love to Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Asinkirito, Felegon, Heremɛsi, Patiroba, nun Heremasi xɛɛbu n bɛ, a nun ngaxakerenyie birin naxee na e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Give my love to Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Filologo, Yuli, Nerewu nun a maaginɛ xɛɛbu, a nun Olimipa nun sɛniyɛntɔɛ birin naxee na e xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Give one another a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ send their love to you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo bore xɛɛbu sunbui sɛniyɛnxi ra. Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae birin wo xɛɛbu.

sentences.english: Now, it is my desire, brothers, that you will take note of those who are causing division and trouble among you, quite against the teaching which was given to you: and keep away from them.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, n xa wo rasi, wo xa wo yɛtɛ ratanga mixie ma, naxee lanyi kanama wo tagi, e nu fa mixi ratantan xaranyi ma wo bara naxan sɔtɔ. Wo xa wo makuya e ra.

sentences.english: For such people are not servants of the Lord Christ, but of their stomachs; and by their smooth and well-said words the hearts of those who have no knowledge of evil are tricked.
sentences.susu: Na mixi mɔɔlie mu walima won Marigi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa bɛ. E birama e yɛtɛ furi nan fɔxɔ ra, e nu fa lɔnnitaree madaxu wɔyɛn ɲɔxunmɛe nun matɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: For all have knowledge of how you do what you are ordered. For this reason I have joy in you, but it is my desire that you may be wise in what is good, and without knowledge of evil.
sentences.susu: Mixi birin a kolon a wo Ala xui rabatuma. N ɲɛlɛxinxi wo ra, kɔnɔ a xɔli n ma wo xa fahaamui sɔtɔ fe fanyi ma, wo naxa wo manɔxɔ fe kobi ra.

sentences.english: And the God of peace will be crushing Satan under your feet before long. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
sentences.susu: Ala, a tan naxan bɔɲɛsa fima, a gbe mu luxi a xa Sentanɛ ibutuxun wo sanyi bun. Won Marigi Isa xa hinnɛ wo ra.

sentences.english: Timothy, who is working with me, sends his love to you, so do Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my relations.
sentences.susu: N waliboore Timote wo xɛɛbu, a nun Lususi, Yason, nun Sosipateri, n boore Yuwifie.

sentences.english: I, Tertius, who have done the writing of this letter, send love in the Lord.
sentences.susu: N tan Teritiyo naxan bara yi bataaxɛ sɛbɛ, n fan bara wo xɛɛbu Marigi xili ra.

sentences.english: Gaius, with whom I am living, whose house is open to all the church, sends his love, so does Erastus, the manager of the accounts of the town, and Quartus, the brother.
sentences.susu: Gayu fan wo xɛɛbu, naxan findixi n tan nun danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama birin yatigi ra. Erasito, naxan findixi taa naafuli ragatama ra, a fan wo xɛɛbu, a nun won ngaxakerenyi Karatusi.
<range>

sentences.english: Now to him who is able to make you strong in agreement with the good news which I gave you and the preaching of Jesus Christ, in the light of the revelation of that secret which has been kept through times eternal,
sentences.susu: Matɔxɔɛ na Ala bɛ, naxan nɔma wo sɛnbɛ sode danxaniya kui, alɔ n Marigi Isa xa xibaaru fanyi naxan kawandima a masenxi ki naxɛ. Na xibaaru fanyi gundo fe nan masenma naxan nu ragataxi kabi tɛmui xɔnnakuye,

sentences.english: But is now made clear; and by the writings of the prophets, by the order of the eternal God, the knowledge of it has been given to all the nations, so that they may come under the rule of the faith;
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ naxan bara fa makɛnɛn alako si birin xa a kolon namiɲɔnmɛe xa sɛbɛlie saabui ra, Ala naxee yamarixi. Na kui, birin xa danxaniya Ala ma, Ala naxan na na, e a xui rabatu.

sentences.english: To the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, be the glory for ever. So be it.
sentences.susu: Ala, a tan keren naxan fe birin kolon, matɔxɔɛ na a bɛ a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa saabui ra abadan. Amina!

sentences.english: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ by the purpose of God, and Sosthenes the brother,
sentences.susu: N tan Pɔlu, Ala naxan ɲanigexi a xa findi a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa xɛɛra ra, a nun Sositene, muxu yi bataaxɛ sɛbɛxi wo tan nan ma,

sentences.english: To the church of God which is in Corinth, to those who have been made holy in Christ Jesus, saints by the selection of God, with all those who in every place give honour to the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, their Lord and ours:
sentences.susu: Ala xa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama, naxan na Korinti. Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa bara wo xili wo xa findi Ala gbe ra, wo xa findi sɛniyɛntɔɛe ra. Muxu bara yi sɛbɛ wo ma, a nun mixi birin ma naxee e xaxili tima Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa ra, naxan findixi e tan nun won tan Marigi ra.

sentences.english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Won Baba Ala nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa, naxan findixi won Marigi ra, e xa hinnɛ nun bɔɲɛsa fi wo ma.

sentences.english: I give praise to my God for you at all times, because of the grace of God which has been given to you in Christ Jesus;
sentences.susu: N Ala tantuma tɛmui birin wo xa fe ra, a to hinnɛ wo ra a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa saabui ra.

sentences.english: So that in him you have wealth in all things, in word and in knowledge of every sort;
sentences.susu: A bara wo xa fe birin nakamali masenyi nun fahaamui kamalixi ra.

sentences.english: Even as the witness of the Christ has been made certain among you:
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa nɔndi to sabatixi wo ya ma,

sentences.english: So that having every grace you are living in the hope of the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ;
sentences.susu: wo bara Ala xa ki birin sɔtɔ, wo hayi mu na fe gbɛtɛ ma sɔnɔn, beemanu won Marigi Isa fa waxati wo naxan mamɛfe.

sentences.english: Who will give you strength to the end, to be free from all sin in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: A sɛnbɛ fima nɛ wo ma han duniɲa raɲɔnyi, alako yunubi yo naxa lu wo ma Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi won Marigi Isa fa tɛmui.

sentences.english: God is true, through whom you have been given a part with his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.
sentences.susu: Ala na a xui xanbi ra, a tan naxan wo xilixi alako lanyi xa lu wo nun a xa Di tagi, won Marigi Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi.

sentences.english: Now I make request to you, my brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you will all say the same thing, and that there may be no divisions among you, so that you may be in complete agreement, in the same mind and in the same opinion.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, n bara wo rasi won Marigi Isa xili ra, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, lanyi xa lu wo tagi. Wo naxa mɛɛ wo bore ra, wo xa lan xaxili nun ɲanige keren ma.

sentences.english: Because it has come to my knowledge, through those of the house of Chloe, that there are divisions among you, my brothers.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, Xolowe xa mixie bara a fala n bɛ, a lantareya na wo tagi.

sentences.english: That is, that some of you say, I am of Paul; some say, I am of Apollos; some say, I am of Cephas; and some say, I am Christ's.
sentences.susu: N bara a mɛ a nde a falama, «N tan biraxi Pɔlu nan fɔxɔ ra,» nde fan a falama, «N tan biraxi Apolosi nan fɔxɔ ra,» nde a falama, «N tan biraxi Kefasi nan fɔxɔ ra,» a nde fan a falama, «N tan biraxi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: Is there a division in Christ? was Paul nailed to the cross for you? or were you given baptism in the name of Paul?
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi keren xa mu a ra? Pɔlu nan banban wuri magalanbuxi ma wo bɛ? Wo wo xunxaxi ye xɔɔra Pɔlu xili nan na?

sentences.english: I give praise to God that not one of you had baptism from me, but Crispus and Gaius;
sentences.susu: N bara Ala tantu n mu mixi yo xunxaxi ye xɔɔra wo ya ma, bafe Kirisipu nun Gayu ra.

sentences.english: So that no one may be able to say that you had baptism in my name.
sentences.susu: Na kui, mixi yo mu nɔma a falade a xunxa ye xɔɔra n xili nan na.

sentences.english: And I gave baptism to the house of Stephanas; but I am not certain that any others had baptism from me.
sentences.susu: N bara Sitefana xa denbaya fan xunxa ye xɔɔra, kɔnɔ na dɔnxɔɛ, n mu laxi a ra xa n bara mixi gbɛtɛ xunxa ye xɔɔra fa.

sentences.english: For Christ sent me, not to give baptism, but to be a preacher of the good news: not with wise words, for fear that the cross of Christ might be made of no value.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi mu n xɛɛ mixi xunxade ye xɔɔra. A n xɛɛxi nɛ n xa a xa xibaaru fanyi kawandi ti. Na mu rabama adamadi xa lɔnni ra de, xa na mu a ra Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa wuri magalanbuxi tide yelebuma nɛ.

sentences.english: For the word of the cross seems foolish to those who are on the way to destruction; but to us who are on the way to salvation it is the power of God.
sentences.susu: Isa faxafe wuri magalanbuxi ma, na masenyi findixi xaxilitareɲa nan na mixi lɔɛxie bɛ, kɔnɔ a findixi Ala xa sɛnbɛ nan na muxu tan kisi mixie bɛ.

sentences.english: As it says in the holy Writings, I will put an end to the wisdom of the wise, and will put on one side the designs of those who have knowledge.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, «N lɔnnilae xa lɔnni xun nakanama nɛ, n xaxilimae xaxili findi fuyan na.»

sentences.english: Where is the wise? where is he who has knowledge of the law? where is the man of this world who has a love of discussion? has not God made foolish the wisdom of this world?
sentences.susu: Lɔnnila go? Sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ go? To xaxilima go? Ala bara yi duniɲa xa lɔnni mafindi xaxilitareɲa ra.

sentences.english: For because, by the purpose of God, the world, with all its wisdom, had not the knowledge of God, it was God's pleasure, by so foolish a thing as preaching, to give salvation to those who had faith in him.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa mixie to mu nɔ Ala xa lɔnni kolonde e yɛtɛ xa lɔnni saabui ra, Ala naxa tin danxaniyatɔɛe rakiside a xa kawandi saabui ra, duniɲa mixie naxan maɲɔxunma xaxilitareɲa ra.

sentences.english: Seeing that the Jews make request for signs, and the Greeks are looking for knowledge:
sentences.susu: Yuwifie wama tɔnxumae tofe, Girɛkikae na lɔnni fenfe,

sentences.english: But we give the good news of Christ on the cross, a hard thing to the Jews, and a foolish thing to the Gentiles;
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ muxu tan Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa faxɛ nan kawandima. Yuwifie birama nɛ barima e mu lama na ra, si gbɛtɛe fan ɲɔxɔ a ma a daxuɲa na a ra.

sentences.english: But to those of God's selection, Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power and the wisdom of God.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala naxee xilixi Yuwifie nun si gbɛtɛe ya ma, e lama nɛ a ra a Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Ala sɛnbɛ nun Ala xa lɔnni nan masenma nɛ.

sentences.english: Because what seems foolish in God is wiser than men; and what seems feeble in God is stronger than men.
sentences.susu: Adamadie e maɲɔxunxi a Ala xa lɔnni findixi xaxilitareɲa nan na, kɔnɔ a nɔndi ki ma a dangi adamadie xa lɔnni ra. E maɲɔxunxi a Ala sɛnbɛ mu gbo, kɔnɔ a sɛnbɛ dangi e gbe ra pon!

sentences.english: For you see God's design for you, my brothers, that he has not taken a great number of the wise after the flesh, not the strong, not the noble:
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, wo xa a mato Ala mixi mɔɔli mundun xilixi wo ya ma. Lɔnnila gbegbe mu na, adamadi ki ma. Sɛnbɛmae fan mu gbo. Bannamixie fan mu wuya.

sentences.english: But God made selection of the foolish things of this world so that he might put the wise to shame; and the feeble things that he might put to shame the strong;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala bara duniɲa lɔnnilae rayaagi. A na raba mixie nan saabui ra, e naxee findixi lɔnnitaree ra. Ala bara duniɲa sɛnbɛmae rayaagi. A na raba mixie nan saabui ra, naxee luxi e bɛ alɔ sɛnbɛtaree.

sentences.english: And the low things of the world, and the things without honour, did God make selection of, yes, even the things which are not, so that he might make as nothing the things which are:
sentences.susu: Ala bara mixi sugandi, naxan tide mu gbo duniɲa mixie bɛ, naxee mu xili xungbe sɔtɔ, naxee mu kolonxi sese ra, alako na xa findi yaagi ra booree bɛ.

sentences.english: So that no flesh might have glory before God.
sentences.susu: Na kui, mixi yo mu nɔma a yɛtɛ matɔxɔde Ala ya i.

sentences.english: But God has given you a place in Christ Jesus, through whom God has given us wisdom and righteousness and salvation, and made us holy:
sentences.susu: Ala nan a niyaxi wo xa lu a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa i. Ala bara Isa findi won ma lɔnni, won ma tinxinyi, won ma marasɛniyɛnyi, nun won xunsare ra.

sentences.english: So that, as it is said in the holy Writings, Whoever has a desire for glory, let his glory be in the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na nan na ki, won xa a raba alɔ a sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui ki naxɛ, «Xa mixi wama a yɛtɛ matɔxɔfe fe nde ma, a xa a yɛtɛ matɔxɔ a Marigi xa fe nan na.»

sentences.english: And when I came to you, my brothers, I did not come with wise words of knowledge, putting before you the secret of God.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, n to fa wo yire, n mu Ala xa seedeɲɔxɔya masenxi wo bɛ wɔyɛnyi xungbee xa ra, xa na mu a ra adamadi xa lɔnni ra.

sentences.english: For I had made the decision to have knowledge of nothing among you but only of Jesus Christ on the cross.
sentences.susu: N nu bara natɛ tongo n xa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa fe nun a xa faxɛ xa fe gbansan nan masen wo bɛ.

sentences.english: And I was with you without strength, in fear and in doubt.
sentences.susu: N naxa ti wo ya i sɛnbɛtareya ra. Na tɛmui n nu na sɛrɛnfe gaaxui ra.

sentences.english: And in my preaching there were no honeyed words of wisdom, but I was dependent on the power of the Spirit to make it clear to you:
sentences.susu: N ma masenyi nun n ma kawandi mu nu fatanxi adamadi xa lɔnni ra. N mu kawandi tixi wɔyɛnyi xungbee ra. N na ti Ala Xaxili sɛnbɛ nan na,

sentences.english: So that your faith might be based not on man's wisdom but on the power of God.
sentences.susu: alako wo naxa danxaniya adamadi xa lɔnni saabui ra, wo xa danxaniya Ala sɛnbɛ nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: But still we have wisdom for those who are complete in knowledge, though not the wisdom of this world, and not of the rulers of this world, who are coming to nothing:
sentences.susu: Muxu lɔnni masenma mixi kamalixie bɛ, kɔnɔ lɔnni naxan mu fatanxi to mixie nun to mangɛe ra. E tan xa fe xun fama nɛ rakanade.

sentences.english: But we give the news of the secret wisdom of God, which he had kept in store before the world came into existence, for our glory;
sentences.susu: Muxu Ala xa lɔnni nan masenma, Ala lɔnni naxan nɔxunxi kabi duniɲa fɔlɛ, naxan findima won bɛ nɔrɛ ra.

sentences.english: Of which not one of the rulers of this world had knowledge: for if they had, they would not have put the Lord of glory on the cross:
sentences.susu: To mangɛe mu nu fahaamui sɔtɔ na xa fe ma, xa na mu a ra e mu Marigi Nɔrɛ Kanyi mabanbanma wuri magalanbuxi ma nu.

sentences.english: But as it says in the holy Writings, Things which the eye saw not, and which had not come to the ears or into the heart of man, such things as God has made ready for those who have love for him.
sentences.susu: Na fe luxi alɔ Kitaabui a masenxi ki naxɛ, «Ala naxan yailanxi a xanuntenyie bɛ, adama ya mu a toma, adama tuli mu a mɛma, adama xaxili mu a kolonma.»

sentences.english: But God has given us the revelation of these things through his Spirit, for the Spirit makes search into all things, even the deep things of God.
sentences.susu: Ala bara na masen won bɛ a yɛtɛ Xaxili saabui ra. Ala Xaxili fe birin kolon, hali Ala yati xa fe tilinxie. A nee birin kolon.

sentences.english: For who has knowledge of the things of a man but the spirit of the man which is in him? in the same way, no one has knowledge of the things of God but the Spirit of God.
sentences.susu: Nde adama xa fe kolon, xa a yɛtɛ xaxili mu a ra? Ala xa fe fan, mixi yo mu a kolon. Ala Xaxili gbansan nan na fe mɔɔli kolon.

sentences.english: But we have not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which comes from God, so that we may have knowledge of the things which are freely given to us by God.
sentences.susu: Won mu nɔma Ala xa hinnɛ fahaamude adamadi xaxili saabui ra. Ala, a Xaxili naxan fixi won ma, na nan nɔma na masende won bɛ.

sentences.english: And these are the things which we say, not in the language of man's wisdom, but in words given to us by the Spirit, judging the things of the spirit by the help of the Spirit.
sentences.susu: Won mu na fe masenma adamadi xa lɔnni ra, won na masenma Ala Xaxili nan ma lɔnni ra. Ala xa fe nan masenma Ala Xaxili saabui ra.

sentences.english: For the natural man is not able to take in the things of the Spirit of God: for they seem foolish to him, and he is not able to have knowledge of them, because such knowledge comes only through the Spirit.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ adama naxan mu Ala Xaxili sɔtɔ, a mu nɔma Ala Xaxili xa fe fahaamude. Na luma nɛ a bɛ alɔ daxuɲa, barima a mu nɔma sode a kui Ala Xaxili xanbi.

sentences.english: But he who has the Spirit, though judging all things, is himself judged by no one.
sentences.susu: Adama naxan Ala Xaxili sɔtɔxi, na kanyi nan nɔma fe birin fahaamude. A booree mu nɔma a makiitide na fee kui.

sentences.english: For who has knowledge of the mind of the Lord, so as to be his teacher? But we have the mind of Christ.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi a sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, «Nde Marigi Xaxili kolon, a xa marasi nde fi a ma?» Kɔnɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Xaxili na won tan bɔɲɛ i.

sentences.english: And the teaching I gave you, my brothers, was such as I was able to give, not to those who have the Spirit, but to those who are still in the flesh, even to children in Christ.
sentences.susu: N mu nu nɔma wɔyɛnde wo bɛ alɔ n nu wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ, barima wo mu luxi alɔ Ala Xaxili kanyie. Wo luxi nɛ alɔ duniɲa mixie, naxee xa danxaniya mu gɛxi kamalide sinden.

sentences.english: I gave you milk and not meat, because you were, then, unable to take it, and even now you are not able;
sentences.susu: N nu bara wo xaran fe singee ra, alɔ dingɛ xiɲɛ fima a xa diyɔrɛ ma ki naxɛ. N mu wo xaran fe xɔrɔxɔɛ ra, barima wo mu nu nɔma na fahaamude. Dingɛ fan mu sube fima diyɔrɛ ma. Han ya wo mu nɔma xaranyi xɔrɔxɔɛ kolonde, barima wo na birafe duniɲa fee nan fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Because you are still in the flesh: for when there is envy and division among you, are you not still walking after the way of the flesh, even as natural men?
sentences.susu: Tɔɔnɛ nun lantareya to gbo wo ya ma, na mu a masenma xɛ a duniɲa mixie nan wo ra, naxee na birafe adamadi waxɔnfe fɔxɔ ra?

sentences.english: For when one says, I am of Paul; and another says, I am of Apollos; are you not talking like natural men?
sentences.susu: Mixi nde to a falama wo ya ma, «N biraxi Pɔlu nan fɔxɔ ra,» mixi gbɛtɛ fan a fala, «N tan biraxi Apolosi nan fɔxɔ ra,» na mu a masenma xɛ a wo luxi nɛ alɔ duniɲa mixie?

sentences.english: What then is Apollos? and what is Paul? They are but servants who gave you the good news as God gave it to them.
sentences.susu: Nde na Apolosi ra? Nde na Pɔlu ra? Muxu findixi Ala xa walikɛe nan tun na Ala naxee xɛɛxi alako wo xa danxaniya. Ala wali naxan soxi muxu yi ra, muxu bara na raba.

sentences.english: I did the planting, Apollos did the watering, but God gave the increase.
sentences.susu: N tan bara sansi xɔri si, Apolosi bara ye sa a ma, kɔnɔ Ala nan a niya a xa bula, a xa mɔ.

sentences.english: So then the planter is nothing, and the waterer is nothing; but God who gives the increase.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan sansi xɔri sima, a nun mixi naxan ye sama a ma, e tide mu gbo. Ala nan tide gbo, barima a tan nan a niya sansi xa mɔ.

sentences.english: Now the planter and the waterer are working for the same end: but they will have their separate rewards in the measure of their work.
sentences.susu: Naxan sansi xɔri sima, nun naxan ye sama a ma, e birin lan, e birin fama nɛ e xa wali sare sɔtɔde.

sentences.english: For we are workers with God: you are God's planting, God's building.
sentences.susu: Muxu tan findixi Ala xa walikɛe nan na. Wo tan luxi nɛ alɔ Ala xa xɛ, xa na mu a ra a xa banxi.

sentences.english: In the measure of the grace given to me, I, as a wise master-builder, have put the base in position, and another goes on building on it. But let every man take care what he puts on it.
