sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, wo naxa wali alɔ dimɛdie, wo xa wali nɛ alɔ kuntigie. Fe ɲaaxi ma, wo xa lu alɔ diyɔrɛ gbeeli. Kɔnɔ xaxili ma, wo xa lu alɔ mixi mɔxi.

sentences.english: In the law it is said, By men of other tongues and by strange lips will my words come to this people; and not even so will they give ear to me, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, «Marigi naxa a masen, ‹N fama wɔyɛnde yi ɲama bɛ xui gbɛtɛ ra naxan fatanxi xɔɲɛe ra, kɔnɔ hali n wɔyɛn na ki, e mu n xui suxuma.›»

sentences.english: For this reason tongues are for a sign, not to those who have faith, but to those who have not: but the prophet's word is for those who have faith, and not for the rest who have not.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, xui gbɛtɛe falafe findixi tɔnxuma ra danxaniyataree nan bɛ, danxaniyatɔɛe xa mu a ra. Kɔnɔ wɔyɛnfe Ala xili ra, na nan findixi tɔnxuma ra danxaniyatɔɛe bɛ, danxaniyataree xa mu a ra.

sentences.english: If, then, the church has come together, and all are using tongues, and there come in men without knowledge or faith, will they not say that you are unbalanced?
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama birin na yire keren xui gbɛtɛe falafe ra, danxaniyatare ndee na so, xa na mu a ra mixi gbɛtɛ naxee wama wo xa fe ramɛfe, e mu a falama xɛ a wo bara daxu?

sentences.english: But if all are teaching as prophets, and a man without faith or knowledge comes in, he is tested by all, he is judged by all;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa wo birin na wɔyɛnfe Ala xili ra, danxaniyatare nde na so, xa na mu a ra mixi gbɛtɛ naxan wama wo xa fe ramɛfe, a a yɛtɛ kolonma nɛ yunubitɔɛ ra, a wo xa masenyi kolon nɔndi ra,

sentences.english: The secrets of his heart are made clear; and he will go down on his face and give worship to God, saying that God is truly among you.
sentences.susu: a gundo birin makɛnɛn. Na kui, a a yɛtɛ igoro bɔxi, a Ala batu, a a fala, «Ala yati na wo ya ma.»

sentences.english: What is it then, my brothers? when you come together everyone has a holy song, or a revelation, or a tongue, or is giving the sense of it. Let everything be done for the common good.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, a lanma won xa munse raba? Wo na wo malan, ndee xa bɛɛti ba, ndee xa mixie xaran, ndee xa laamatunyi masen, ndee xa wɔyɛn xui gbɛtɛ ra, ndee xa na xui gbɛtɛ madangi. Na birin xa raba alako danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xa sabati.

sentences.english: If any man makes use of a tongue, let it not be more than two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let someone give the sense:
sentences.susu: Xa mixie xui gbɛtɛe falama, e naxa dangi mixi firin na, xa na mu a ra mixi saxan. Kankan xa wɔyɛn a wɔyɛn tɛmui, kankan xa mixi sɔtɔ naxan na xui madangima booree bɛ.

sentences.english: But if there is no one to give the sense, let him keep quiet in the church; and let his words be to himself and to God.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi mu na naxan na xui madangima, na kanyi xa a sabari malanyi kui, a xa wɔyɛnyi xa lu a tan nun Ala gbansan tagi.

sentences.english: And let the prophets give their words, but not more than two or three, and let the others be judges of what they say.
sentences.susu: Xa mixie wɔyɛnma Ala xili ra, e fan naxa dangi mixi firin na, xa na mu a ra mixi saxan. Booree xa na masenyie mato a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: But if a revelation is given to another who is seated near, let the first be quiet.
sentences.susu: Xa Ala masenyi fi mixi nde ma a xili ra, boore na wɔyɛnfe tɛmui naxɛ, naxan na wɔyɛnfe a lanma a xa dundu sinden.

sentences.english: For you may all be prophets in turn so that all may get knowledge and comfort;
sentences.susu: Kankan nɔma wɔyɛnde Ala xili ra a xa waxati, alako birin xa xaranyi nun limaniya sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the spirits of the prophets are controlled by the prophets;
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ tan, a masenyi tima a ɲanige nan na.

sentences.english: For God is not a God whose ways are without order, but a God of peace; as in all the churches of the saints.
sentences.susu: Ala mu wama xurutareɲa xɔn, a wama nɛ fe birin xa raba a raba ki ma bɔɲɛsa kui. Sɛniyɛntɔɛ ɲama birin bara lan a ma,

sentences.english: Let women keep quiet in the churches: for it is not right for them to be talking; but let them be under control, as it says in the law.
sentences.susu: a ginɛe xa e sabari malanyie kui. E mu lan e xa wɔyɛn, e xa lu magore kui alɔ Ala xa sɛriyɛ a masenxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And if they have a desire for knowledge about anything, let them put questions to their husbands privately: for talking in the church puts shame on a woman.
sentences.susu: Xa e wama maxɔrinyi tife, e xa e xa mɔri maxɔrin banxi, barima a mu daxa ginɛ xa wɔyɛn malanyi kui.

sentences.english: What? was it from you that the word of God went out? or did it only come in to you?
sentences.susu: Ala xa masenyi fatanxi wo tan nan na? A masenxi wo tan nan gbansan bɛ?

sentences.english: If any man seems to himself to be a prophet or to have the Spirit, let him take note of the things which I am writing to you, as being the word of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde a maɲɔxun a namiɲɔnmɛ na a ra, xa mixi nde a maɲɔxun a Ala bara a ki, a xa n ma sɛbɛli kolon Marigi xa yaamari ra.

sentences.english: But if any man is without knowledge, let him be so.
sentences.susu: Xa a mu na kolon nɔndi ra, Ala fan mu na kanyi kolonma a xa mixi ra.

sentences.english: So then, my brothers, let it be your chief desire to be prophets; but let no one be stopped from using tongues.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n ngaxakerenyie, wɔyɛnfe Ala xili ra a xa rafan wo ma. Wo naxa tɔnyi dɔxɔ xui gbɛtɛe falafe ra,

sentences.english: Let all things be done in the right and ordered way.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ wo xa na raba a raba ki ma sɛriyɛ ra.

sentences.english: Now I am going to make clear to you, my brothers, what the good news was which I gave to you, and which you took, and on which your faith is based,
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, n bara wo ratu Ala xa xibaaru fanyi ra, n naxan masenxi wo bɛ, wo danxaniyaxi naxan ma, wo biraxi naxan fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: By which you have salvation; that is to say, the form in which it was given to you, if it is fixed in your minds, and if your faith in it is not without effect.
sentences.susu: Xa wo lu na fɔxɔ ra alɔ n a masenxi wo bɛ ki naxɛ, wo fama nɛ kiside na saabui ra. Xa wo mu lu na fɔxɔ ra, wo xa danxaniya bara findi fe fufafu ra wo bɛ.

sentences.english: For I gave to you first of all what was handed down to me, how Christ underwent death for our sins, as it says in the Writings;
sentences.susu: N nu bara masenyi hagigɛ ti wo bɛ, n naxan sɔtɔ. A tan nan ya. Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi naxa faxa won ma yunubie xafari fe ra, alɔ a nu sɛbɛxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And he was put in the place of the dead; and on the third day he came back from the dead, as it says in the Writings;
sentences.susu: A naxa ragata gaburi kui, a man naxa keli faxɛ ma a xi saxan nde, alɔ a nu sɛbɛxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And he was seen by Cephas; then by the twelve;
sentences.susu: A naxa mini Kefasi nun Isa xa xɛɛra fu nun firinyie ma.

sentences.english: Then by more than five hundred brothers at the same time, most of whom are still living, but some are sleeping;
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, a naxa mini danxaniyatɔɛ kɛmɛ suuli ma tɛmui keren. Han ya na danxaniyatɔɛ gbegbe baloxi, kɔnɔ ndee bara laaxira.

sentences.english: Then he was seen by James; then by all the Apostles.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, a naxa mini Yaki ma, a man naxa mini a xa xɛɛra birin ma.

sentences.english: And last of all, as by one whose birth was out of the right time, he was seen by me.
sentences.susu: A dɔnxɔɛ ra, a naxa mini n fan ma. N mu nu findixi a xa xɛɛra ra, a booree sugandixi tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: For I am the least of the Apostles, having no right to be named an Apostle, because of my cruel attacks on the church of God.
sentences.susu: N tide mu nu gbo alɔ xɛɛra booree. Xɛɛra xili mu lanma a xa fala n xun, barima n nu bara Ala xa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama ɲaxankata.

sentences.english: But by the grace of God, I am what I am: and his grace which was given to me has not been for nothing; for I did more work than all of them; though not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n bara findi Isa xa xɛɛra ra Ala xa hinnɛ saabui ra. Na hinnɛ mu findixi fe fufafu ra n bɛ. N bara wali dangife xɛɛra birin na, kɔnɔ n tan mu a ra. Ala xa hinnɛ nan walixi n bɛ n ma duniɲɛigiri kui.

sentences.english: If then it is I who am the preacher, or they, this is our word, and to this you have given your faith.
sentences.susu: Xa n tan nan na kawandi tixi ba, xa e tan nan na kawandi tixi ba, na nan kawandixi wo bɛ. Wo bara gɛ danxaniyade na nan ma.

sentences.english: Now if the good news says that Christ came back from the dead, how do some of you say that there is no coming back from the dead?
sentences.susu: Xa kawandi sa tife a Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi bara keli faxɛ ma, munfe ra ndee a falama wo ya ma a mixi mu kelima faxɛ ma?

sentences.english: But if there is no coming back from the dead, then Christ has not come back from the dead:
sentences.susu: Xa mixi mu kelima faxɛ ma nu, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi fan mu kelixi faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: And if Christ did not come again from the dead, then our good news and your faith in it are of no effect.
sentences.susu: Xa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi mu kelixi faxɛ ma nu, muxu xa kawandi nun wo xa danxaniya findixi fe fufafu nan na.

sentences.english: Yes, and we are seen to be false witnesses of God; because we gave witness of God that by his power Christ came again from the dead: which is not true if there is no coming back from the dead.
sentences.susu: Na kui, muxu bara findi seede wule falɛe ra Ala bɛ, barima muxu bara seedeɲɔxɔya raba a Ala bara a xa Mixi Sugandixi rakeli faxɛ ma. Kɔnɔ xa nɔndi na a ra mixie mu kelima faxɛ ma nu, Ala fan mu a rakelima nu.

sentences.english: For if it is not possible for the dead to come to life again, then Christ has not come to life again:
sentences.susu: Xa mixie mu kelima faxɛ ma nu, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi fan mu kelixi faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: And if that is so, your faith is of no effect; you are still in your sins.
sentences.susu: Xa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi mu kelixi faxɛ ma nu, wo xa danxaniya findixi fe fufafu nan na, wo xa yunubie man na wo ma,

sentences.english: And, in addition, the dead in Christ have gone to destruction.
sentences.susu: a nun Isa xa danxaniyatɔɛ laaxiraxie fan bara lɔɛ.

sentences.english: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most unhappy.
sentences.susu: Xa won won xaxili tima Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra yi duniɲɛigiri gbansan nan ma fe ra, a lima nu won ma fe bara makinikini dangi adamadi birin na.

sentences.english: But now Christ has truly come back from the dead, the first-fruits of those who are sleeping.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n xa a fala wo bɛ, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan kelixi faxɛ ma. A bara findi mixi singe ra naxan kelixi faxamixie ya ma.

sentences.english: For as by man came death, so by man there is a coming back from the dead.
sentences.susu: Faxɛ to so duniɲa adama saabui ra, marakeli fan soxi adama nde nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: For as in Adam death comes to all, so in Christ will all come back to life.
sentences.susu: Mixi birin faxama Benba Adama nan xa fe ra. Mixi birin man kelima faxɛ ma Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan ma fe saabui ra.

sentences.english: But every man in his right order: Christ the first-fruits; then those who are Christ's at his coming.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ kankan kelima a waxati nɛ. Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi singe nan keli. A na fa tɛmui naxɛ, a xa mixie fan kelima nɛ.

sentences.english: Then comes the end, when he will give up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he will have put an end to all rule and to all authority and power.
sentences.susu: A na mangɛya ragbilen Baba Ala ma, a na gɛ nɔde mangɛya nun sɛnbɛ birin na, duniɲa ɲɔnma nɛ na waxati.

sentences.english: For his rule will go on till he has put all those who are against him under his feet.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa ti mangɛ ra, han Ala xa a sanyi ti a yaxui birin ma.

sentences.english: The last power to come to an end is death.
sentences.susu: A yaxui dɔnxɔɛ a naxan ibutuxunma, na findixi faxɛ nan na.

sentences.english: For, as it says, He has put all things under his feet. But when he says, All things are put under him, it is clear that it is not said about him who put all things under him.
sentences.susu: Ala nan na birin saxi a xa yaamari bun ma. A to a fala a birin saxi a xa yaamari bun ma, a kolonxi a Ala naxan birin saxi a xa Mixi Sugandixi xa yaamari bun ma, Ala tan mu na na yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: And when all things have been put under him, then will the Son himself be under him who put all things under him, so that God may be all in all.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi na na birin nagbilen Ala ma, a tan fan fama lude Ala xa yaamari nan bun ma, naxan singe nu bara yaamari so a yi ra. Ala fama yaamari rabade na tɛmui fe birin xun ma.

sentences.english: Again, what will they do who are given baptism for the dead? if the dead do not come back at all, why are people given baptism for them?
sentences.susu: Xa marakeli mu na nu, munfe ra ndee fa e xunxama ye xɔɔra faxamixie bɛ? Xa faxamixie mu kelima faxɛ ma nu, munfe ra ndee e xunxama ye xɔɔra e bɛ?

sentences.english: And why are we in danger every hour?
sentences.susu: Munfe ra muxu tan bara tin lude fe xɔrɔxɔɛ kui tɛmui birin?

sentences.english: Yes, truly, by your pride in me, my brothers in Christ Jesus our Lord, my life is one long death.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, n xa a fala wo bɛ a nɔndi ki ma, lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ n na faxɛ nan dɛ ma. N a falama wo tan bɛ, n sɛɛwaxi wo tan naxee xa fe ra, barima wo danxaniyaxi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa nan ma, naxan findixi won Marigi ra.

sentences.english: If, after the way of men, I was fighting with beasts at Ephesus, what profit is it to me? If the dead do not come to life again, let us take our pleasure in feasting, for tomorrow we come to an end.
sentences.susu: Munafanyi mundun na n bɛ adama ki ma, xa n bara sube xaaɲɛxie gere Efɛsɛ? Xa faxamixie mu kelima faxɛ ma nu, «won xa won dɛge, won xa won min, barima tina won faxama nɛ.»

sentences.english: Do not be tricked by false words: evil company does damage to good behaviour.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa tantan. Ɲɛrɛboore kobie nan yuge fanyi masarama.

sentences.english: Be awake to righteousness and keep yourselves from sin; for some have no knowledge of God: I say this to put you to shame.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɔɔbɛ suxu, wo xa yunubi lu na. Ndee wo ya ma e mu Ala kolon. N xa a fala wo bɛ, na bara findi yaagi ra wo bɛ.

sentences.english: But someone will say, How do the dead come back? and with what sort of body do they come?
sentences.susu: Nde nɔma a yɛtɛ maxɔrinde, a naxɛ, «Mixi faxaxie kelima di? Fate mɔɔli mundun luma e ma?»

sentences.english: Foolish man, it is necessary for the seed which you put into the earth to undergo death in order that it may come to life again:
sentences.susu: Xaxilitaree, wo mu a kolon sansi xɔri mu nɔma findide sansi ra, fo a faxa sinden?

sentences.english: And when you put it into the earth, you do not put in the body which it will be, but only the seed, of grain or some other sort of plant;
sentences.susu: Sansi xɔri naxan sima bɔxi, a nun a soli naxan tema, e keren mu a ra. Sansi xɔri tan, a xɔri gbansan na a ra, tɛmunde maale xɛɛta, xa na mu a ra sansi xɔri gbɛtɛ.

sentences.english: But God gives it a body, as it is pleasing to him, and to every seed its special body.
sentences.susu: Ala sansi xɔri birin findima sansi ra alɔ a wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ. Sansi xɔri mɔɔli birin a soli nan naminima.

sentences.english: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one flesh of men, another of beasts, another of birds, and another of fishes.
sentences.susu: Nimase fate birin mu luma ki keren. Mixi fate na ki keren. Sube fate na ki gbɛtɛ. Xɔni fate nun yɛxɛ fate fan na e xati ma.

sentences.english: And there are bodies of heaven and bodies of earth, but the glory of the one is different from that of the other.
sentences.susu: Se naxee na bɔxi ma, a nun se gbɛtɛ naxee na koore ma, e tagi rasa. E birin daaxi e gbe ki nɛ.

sentences.english: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for the glory of one star is different from that of another.
sentences.susu: Soge yanbama ki naxɛ, a nun kike yanbama ki naxɛ, a nun tunbuie yanbama ki naxɛ, e birin keren mu a ra. Hali tunbuie na a ra e mu yanbama ki keren.

sentences.english: So is it with the coming back from the dead. It is planted in death; it comes again in life:
sentences.susu: Faxamixi rakelixie luma na ki nɛ. Mixi na duniɲa tɛmui naxɛ, a fate nɔma kanade, kɔnɔ a na keli faxɛ ma, a fate mu nɔma kanade sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: It is planted in shame; it comes again in glory: feeble when it is planted, it comes again in power:
sentences.susu: Mixi ragataxi gaburi kui tɛmui naxɛ, a bɔrɔma nɛ, a sɛnbɛ ɲɔn, kɔnɔ a kelima faxɛ ma sɛnbɛ nun nɔrɛ nan na.

sentences.english: It is planted a natural body; it comes again as a body of the spirit. If there is a natural body, there is equally a body of the spirit.
sentences.susu: Mixi na ragata a fate na duniɲa ki nan ma, kɔnɔ a kelima a laaxira ki nan ma. Duniɲa fate na na, laaxira fate fan na.

sentences.english: And so it is said, The first man Adam was a living soul. The last Adam is a life-giving spirit.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi a sɛbɛxi, «Adama singe findixi nimase nan na.» Adama dɔnxɔɛ findixi xaxili nan na naxan mixi rakisima.

sentences.english: But that which is natural comes before that which is of the spirit.
sentences.susu: Adama singe findixi duniɲa mixi nan na, koore ma daaxi mu a ra. Koore ma daaxi nan fama duniɲa ma daaxi xanbi ra.

sentences.english: The first man is from the earth, and of the earth: the second man is from heaven.
sentences.susu: Adama singe fatanxi duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi nan na. Adama firin nde fatanxi koore nan na.

sentences.english: Those who are of the earth are like the man who was from the earth: and those who are of heaven are like the one from heaven.
sentences.susu: Adamadie maniyaxi won benba Adama nan na, naxan daaxi bɛndɛ ra. Mixi naxee tema koore, e masarama nɛ, e fa lu alɔ na Adama naxan kelixi koore.

sentences.english: And in the same way as we have taken on us the image of the man from the earth, so we will take on us the image of the one from heaven.
sentences.susu: Won to maniya won benba Adama ra duniɲa, won man fama maniyade na Adama nan na naxan kelixi koore ma.

sentences.english: Now I say this, my brothers, that it is not possible for flesh and blood to have a part in the kingdom of God; and death may not have a part in life.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, n xa a fala wo bɛ, duniɲa fate mu nɔma Ala xa ariyanna sɔtɔde kɛ ra. Nimasee fate mu nɔma ariyanna sɔtɔde kɛ ra. E fate bɔrɔma nɛ, kɔnɔ fate bɔrɔxi mu nɔma sode ariyanna.

sentences.english: See, I am giving you the revelation of a secret: we will not all come to the sleep of death, but we will all be changed.
sentences.susu: N xa gundo fala wo bɛ. Won birin mu faxama, kɔnɔ won birin masarama nɛ

sentences.english: In a second, in the shutting of an eye, at the sound of the last horn: for at that sound the dead will come again, free for ever from the power of death, and we will be changed.
sentences.susu: mafuren mafuren sara dɔnxɔɛ xui ma. Na sara na fe, faxamixie kelima nɛ faxɛ ma fate nɛɛnɛe ra e ma naxee mu bɔrɔma sɔnɔn. Won fama nɛ masarade.

sentences.english: For this body which comes to destruction will be made free from the power of death, and the man who is under the power of death will put on eternal life.
sentences.susu: Naxan lan a xa bɔrɔ, na mu bɔrɔma sɔnɔn. Naxan lan a xa faxa, na mu faxama sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: But when this has taken place, then that which was said in the Writings will come true, Death is overcome by life.
sentences.susu: Fate bɔrɔxi na findi fate bɔrɔtare ra, fate faxaxi na findi fate faxatare ra, yi sɛbɛli fama kamalide na tɛmui nɛ: «Wo bara xunnakeli sɔtɔ faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: O death, where is your power? O death, where are your pains?
sentences.susu: Faxɛ xa xunnakeli na minden? Faxɛ xa tɔɔrɛ na minden?»

sentences.english: The pain of death is sin; and the power of sin is the law:
sentences.susu: Yunubi findixi tɔɔrɛ nan na naxan bara mixi faxa. Yaamari findixi yunubi xa sɛnbɛ nan na.

sentences.english: But praise be to God who gives us strength to overcome through our Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Ala tantu, naxan bara won xun nakeli won Marigi Isa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi saabui ra.

sentences.english: For this cause, my dear brothers, be strong in purpose and unmoved, ever giving yourselves to the work of the Lord, because you are certain that your work is not without effect in the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n ngaxakerenyie, wo xa danxaniya xa sabati. Wo naxa a lu limaniya xa ba wo yi ra. Wo xa wakili Marigi bɛ tɛmui birin, barima wo a kolon a wo naxan nabama a bɛ fe fufafu xa mu a ra.

sentences.english: Now about the giving of money for the saints, as I gave orders to the churches of Galatia, so do you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa kɔbiri malan sɛniyɛntɔɛe bɛ, alɔ n Galati bɔxi danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: On the first day of the week, let every one of you put by him in store, in measure as he has done well in business, so that it may not be necessary to get money together when I come.
sentences.susu: Kankan xa kɔbiri nde sa a xati ma a harige bɛrɛ ra sande lɔxɔɛ birin, alako kɔbiri xa gɛ malande beenun n fa tɛmui.

sentences.english: And when I come, I will send the men of your selection with letters to take the money you have got together to Jerusalem.
sentences.susu: N na fa, n bataaxɛ soma mixie yi ra wo naxee sugandima kɔbiri xaninfe ra Darisalamu.

sentences.english: And if it is possible for me to go there, they will go with me.
sentences.susu: Xa a lanma n fan xa siga, muxu birin na a ra.

sentences.english: But I will come to you after I have gone through Macedonia, for that is my purpose;
sentences.susu: N na dangi Masedon bɔxi ra, alɔ n wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ, n fama nɛ wo yire.

sentences.english: But I may be with you for a time, or even for the winter, so that you may see me on my way, wherever I go.
sentences.susu: Tɛmunde n saxanyi raba wo xɔnyi, xa na mu a ra n ɲɛmɛ radangi naa, alako wo xa nɔ n malide n ma biyaasi kui.

sentences.english: For it is not my desire to see you now, on my way; because it is my hope to be with you for some time, if that is the Lord's pleasure.
sentences.susu: Xa Ala tin, n mu findima dangimixi tun na. A xɔli n ma n xa lu wo yire dondoronti.

sentences.english: But I will be at Ephesus till Pentecost;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n xa lu be Efɛsɛ han Xɛ Xabɛ Sali xa ba a ra,

sentences.english: For a great and important door there is open to me, and there are a number of people against me.
sentences.susu: barima n ma wali na sɔɔnɛyafe, hali n yaxuie to wuyaxi n bɛ.

sentences.english: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear; because he is doing the Lord's work, even as I am:
sentences.susu: Xa Timote fa wo yire, wo a rasɛnɛ alako a naxa fa gaaxu wo ya ra, barima a walima Marigi nan bɛ alɔ n tan.

sentences.english: See then that he has the honour which is right. But send him on his way in peace, so that he may come to me: for I am looking for him with the brothers.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo naxa yo a ma. Wo xa a mali a xa biyaasi kui alako a xa n li bɔɲɛsa kui. N tan nun n ngaxakerenyie na a mamɛfe.

sentences.english: But as for Apollos, the brother, I had a great desire for him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not his pleasure to come now; but he will come when he has a chance.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon n bara won ngaxakerenyi Apolosi karaxan a xa siga wo yire a nun danxaniyatɔɛ ndee. A singe a mu nu tinxi, kɔnɔ yakɔsi a bara natɛ tongo a xa siga a na fɛɛrɛ sɔtɔ tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: Be on the watch, unmoved in the faith, and be strong like men.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo yɛtɛ mato, wo xa wo xa danxaniya rasabati, wo xa limaniya, wo xa wo sɛnbɛ so.

sentences.english: Let all you do be done in love.
sentences.susu: Wo xa fe birin naba xanunteya ra.

sentences.english: Now I make my request to you, my brothers, for you have knowledge that the house of Stephanas is the first-fruits of Achaia, and that they have made themselves the servants of the saints,
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, n xa marasi nde sa na xun ma. Wo a kolon a Sitefana xa denbaya nan singe danxaniya Akayi bɔxi ma. E bara wali sɛniyɛntɔɛe bɛ ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: That you put yourselves under such, and under everyone who is helping the Lord's work.
sentences.susu: Wo xa lu na mixi mɔɔli xa yaamari bun ma, a nun mixi naxan birin Ala xa wali rabama.

sentences.english: And I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for they have done what was needed to make your work complete.
sentences.susu: N bara ɲɛlɛxin Sitefana, Forotunatu, nun Axayikusu fafe ra, barima e bara n mali wo xanbi.

sentences.english: For they gave comfort to my spirit and to yours: for which cause give respect to such people.
sentences.susu: E bara limaniya fi won birin ma. Wo xa na kolon e bɛ.

sentences.english: The churches of Asia send their love to you. So do Aquila and Prisca, with the church which is in their house.
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama naxee na Asi bɔxi ma e bara wo xɛɛbu. Akila, Pirisila, nun danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama naxan e malanma e xɔnyi, e fan bara wo xɛɛbu Marigi xili ra.

sentences.english: All the brothers send their love to you. Give one another a holy kiss.
sentences.susu: Ngaxakerenyi naxee na be, e birin wo xɛɛbu. Wo xa wo bore xɛɛbu danxaniyatɔɛe xa xanunteya kui.

sentences.english: I, Paul, send you these words of love in my writing.
sentences.susu: N tan Pɔlu bara yi xɛɛbui sɛbɛ n yɛtɛ bɛlɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: If any man has not love for the Lord, let him be cursed. Maran atha (our Lord comes).
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ xa lu mixi bɛ naxan mu Marigi xanuma. Won Marigi xa fa.

sentences.english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
sentences.susu: Marigi Isa xa hinnɛ wo ra.

sentences.english: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. So be it.
sentences.susu: N bara wo xanu Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xili ra. Amina.

sentences.english: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ by the purpose of God, and Timothy the brother, to the church of God which is in Corinth, with all the saints who are in all Achaia:
sentences.susu: N tan Pɔlu, Ala bara tin naxan xa findi a xa xɛɛra ra, n nun n ngaxakerenyi Timote, muxu bara wo xɛɛbu, wo tan Ala xa danxaniyatɔɛ naxee na Korinti, a nun sɛniyɛntɔɛ birin naxee na Akayi.

sentences.english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Won Baba Ala nun won Marigi, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa, e xa hinnɛ nun bɔɲɛsa fi wo ma.

sentences.english: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and the God of all comfort;
sentences.susu: Tantui na Ala bɛ, naxan findixi won Marigi Isa Baba ra, a xa Mixi Sugandixi. Baba kinikininte na a ra, naxan mixie ralimaniyama e xa fe birin kui.

sentences.english: Who gives us comfort in all our troubles, so that we may be able to give comfort to others who are in trouble, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.
sentences.susu: Ala won nalimaniyama won ma tɔɔrɛ kui, alako won fan xa nɔ tɔɔrɔmixi gbɛtɛe ralimaniyade na ki.

sentences.english: For as we undergo more of the pain which Christ underwent, so through Christ does our comfort become greater.
sentences.susu: Won ma tɔɔrɛ xun masama Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fe ra ki naxɛ, won ma limaniya fan xun masama a saabui ra na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: But if we are troubled, it is for your comfort and salvation; or if we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which takes effect through your quiet undergoing of the same troubles which we undergo:
sentences.susu: Muxu na tɔɔrɔfe alako wo tan xa limaniya nun kisi sɔtɔ. Muxu xa limaniya a niyama nɛ wo fan xa limaniya sɔtɔ alako wo fan xa nɔ wo xa tɔɔrɛ ra. Won birin na tɔɔrɔfe ki keren.

sentences.english: And our hope for you is certain; in the knowledge that as you take part in the troubles, so you will take part in the comfort.
sentences.susu: Muxu a kolon a fanyi ra wo xa danxaniya sɔɔnɛyama nɛ, barima wo limaniya sɔtɔma wo xa tɔɔrɛ nan kui.

sentences.english: For it is our desire that you may not be without knowledge of our trouble which came on us in Asia, that the weight of it was very great, more than our power, so that it seemed that we had no hope even of life:
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, muxu wama wo xa a kolon muxu ɲaxankatɛ naxan sɔtɔ Asi. A nu gbo dangi muxu sɛnbɛ ra, muxu fa a maɲɔxun muxu na faxafe nɛ.

sentences.english: Yes, we ourselves have had the answer of death in ourselves, so that our hope might not be in ourselves, but in God who is able to give life to the dead:
sentences.susu: Na maɲɔxunyi bara lu muxu xunyi alako muxu naxa muxu xaxili ti muxu yɛtɛ ra, muxu xa muxu xaxili ti Ala nan na naxan faxamixie rakelima.

sentences.english: Who gave us salvation from so great a death: on whom we have put our hope that he will still go on to give us salvation;
sentences.susu: A tan nan gbansan muxu ratangaxi na faxɛ ɲaaxi ma. A man fama na rabade muxu bɛ. Muxu bara la a ra a man fama nɛ muxu ratangade.

sentences.english: You at the same time helping together by your prayer for us; so that for what has been given to us through a number of persons, praise may go up to God for us from all of them.
sentences.susu: Wo fan nɔma muxu malide na kui wo xa Ala maxandi ra. Mixi gbegbe na Ala maxandi muxu bɛ, mixi gbegbe fama nɛ Ala tantude a xa hinnɛ xa fe ra a naxan fima muxu ma.

sentences.english: For our glory is in this, in the knowledge which we have that our way of life in the world, and most of all in relation to you, has been holy and true in the eyes of God; not in the wisdom of the flesh, but in the grace of God.
sentences.susu: Muxu sɛɛwaxi yi nan ma. Muxu a kolon muxu bɔɲɛ kui a muxu bara ɲɛrɛ duniɲa kui wo ya ma sɛniyɛnyi nun bɔɲɛ fiixɛ kui, naxan fatanxi Ala ra. Muxu ɲɛrɛxi na ki nɛ wo ya ma dangife yire birin na. Na ɲɛrɛ mɔɔli mu kelixi adamadi xa lɔnni xa ma. A kelixi Ala xa hinnɛ nan ma.

sentences.english: For in our letters we say no other things to you, but those which you are reading, and to which you give agreement, and, it is my hope, will go on doing so to the end:
sentences.susu: Muxu mu sese sɛbɛ wo ma wo mu nɔma naxan tode nun a kolonde a fiixɛ ra. A xɔli n ma wo xa fahaamui xa kamali na xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Even as you have been ready, in part, to say that we are your glory, in the same way that you are ours, in the day of the Lord Jesus.
sentences.susu: Wo ɲan bara nde kolon, kɔnɔ wo xa fahaamui fama nɛ kamalide a kolonfe ra a won birin binyɛ sɔtɔma nɛ won Marigi Isa fa tɛmui won bore xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And being certain of this, it was my purpose to come to you before, so that you might have a second grace;
sentences.susu: N to na kolon, n naxa wa sigafe wo yire alako wo man xa hinnɛ sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And by way of Corinth to go into Macedonia, and from there to come back again to you, so that you might send me on my way to Judaea.
sentences.susu: N naxa wa dangife wo yire n sigama Masedon tɛmui naxɛ, n man xa dangi wo yire n kelima Masedon tɛmui naxɛ. Na ki wo nɔma n malide n ma biyaasi kui sigafe ra Yudaya.

sentences.english: If then I had such a purpose, did I seem to be changing suddenly? or am I guided in my purposes by the flesh, saying, Yes, today, and, No, tomorrow?
sentences.susu: Wo ɲɔxɔ a ma natɛ tongoxi na a ra adamadi ki ma, naxan wɔyɛn firin falama?

sentences.english: As God is true, our word to you is not Yes and No.
sentences.susu: N bara a fala wo bɛ Ala tinxinxi xili ra, n mu wule falama n ma masenyi kui.

sentences.english: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, whom we were preaching among you, even I and Silvanus and Timothy, was not Yes and No, but in him is Yes.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa, naxan findixi Ala xa Di ra, muxu naxan masenxi wo bɛ, a fan mu a yɛtɛ matandima. N tan, Silasi, nun Timote, muxu naxan kawandixi wo bɛ, na birin findixi nɔndi nan na.

sentences.english: For he is the Yes to all the undertakings of God: and by him all the words of God are made certain and put into effect, to the glory of God through us.
sentences.susu: Ala fama a xa laayidi birin nakamalide Isa saabui ra. Na nan a ra won «Amina» ratinma Isa xili ra Ala xa nɔrɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Now he who makes our faith strong together with you, in Christ, and has given us of his grace, is God;
sentences.susu: Ala nan won birin ma danxaniya rasabatixi a xa Mixi Sugandixi saabui ra. A bara won sugandi,

sentences.english: And it is he who has put his stamp on us, even the Spirit, as the sign in our hearts of the coming glory.
sentences.susu: a fa a xa tɔnxuma sa won ma, naxan a masenxi a won findixi a gbe nan na. A bara a yɛtɛ Xaxili raso won bɔɲɛ i naxan a masenma a fama nɛ won kide ariyanna ra.

sentences.english: But God is my witness that it was in pity for you that I did not come to Corinth at that time.
sentences.susu: Ala na n seede ra. N mu gbilenxi Korinti, alako a naxa findi tɔɔrɛ ra wo bɛ.

sentences.english: Not that we have authority over your faith, but we are helpers of your joy: for it is faith which is your support.
sentences.susu: Muxu mu wama danxaniyatɔɛe yamarife, kɔnɔ muxu wama kafufe nɛ wo ma alako wo xa sɛɛwa barima wo sabatixi danxaniya kui.

sentences.english: But it was my decision for myself, not to come again to you with sorrow.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n nu bara natɛ tongo a mu lanma n xa siga wo yire sunnunyi kui.

sentences.english: For if I give you sorrow, who then will make me glad, but he who is made sad by me?
sentences.susu: Xa n bara wo tan tɔɔrɔ, nde nɔma n nasɛɛwade sɔnɔn? N wo tan naxee rasunnunxi, wo tan nan fa nɔma na ra?

sentences.english: And I said this very thing in my letter, for fear that when I came I might have sorrow from those from whom it was right for me to have joy; being certain of this, that my joy is the joy of you all.
sentences.susu: N nu bara na bataaxɛ sɛbɛ alako wo ɲɛrɛ ki, n naxan lima wo yi ra, a naxa findi sunnunyi ra n bɛ. A lanma wo xa findi sɛɛwɛ nan na n bɛ. N a kolon naxan na findi sɛɛwɛ ra n bɛ, a findima nɛ sɛɛwɛ ra wo fan bɛ.

sentences.english: For out of much trouble and pain of heart and much weeping I sent my letter to you; not to give you sorrow, but so that you might see how great is the love which I have to you.
sentences.susu: N to na bataaxɛ sɛbɛ wo ma, n bɔɲɛ nu n tɔɔrɔxi, n yaye nu minima. N mu na sɛbɛxi xɛ alako n xa wo tɔɔrɔ. N a sɛbɛxi nɛ alako wo xa a kolon n wo xanuxi nɛ yati.

sentences.english: But if anyone has been a cause of sorrow, he has been so, not to me only, but in some measure to all of you (I say this that I may not be over-hard on you).
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ, mixi naxan findixi yi tɔɔrɛ saabui ra, a mu n tan xa tɔɔrɔxi. A wo tan nan tɔɔrɔxi, xa na mu a ra a bara ndee tɔɔrɔ wo ya ma.

sentences.english: Let it be enough for such a man to have undergone the punishment which the church put on him;
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe wo ya ma e ɲan bara na kanyi ɲaxankata. Na bara wasakɛ.

sentences.english: So that now, on the other hand, it is right for him to have forgiveness and comfort from you, for fear that his sorrow may be over-great.
sentences.susu: Wo diɲɛ a ma, wo xa a ralimaniya, alako na tɔɔrɛ naxa gbo yɛ, a fa nɔ a ra.

sentences.english: For which cause my desire is that you will make your love to him clear by your acts.
sentences.susu: Wo naxan nabama, wo xa xanunteya masen a bɛ.

sentences.english: And for the same reason I sent you a letter so that I might be certain of your desire to do my orders in all things.
sentences.susu: N bara na bataaxɛ sɛbɛ wo ma, alako n xa a kolon xa wo tinma n ma yaamari birin suxude.

sentences.english: But if you give forgiveness to anyone, I do the same: for if I have given forgiveness for anything, I have done it because of you, in the person of Christ;
sentences.susu: Xa wo bara diɲɛ mixi nde ma, n fan bara diɲɛ na kanyi ma. Xa fe nde bara lu wo tagi, n bara diɲɛ na birin ma wo xa fe ra Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ya xɔri

sentences.english: So that Satan may not get the better of us: for we are not without knowledge of his designs.
sentences.susu: alako Sentanɛ naxa nɔ won na. Won bara a wali ki kolon.

sentences.english: Now when I came to Troas for the good news of Christ, and there was an open door for me in the Lord,
sentences.susu: N to siga Tiroyasi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa xibaaru fanyi kawandide, n naxa a to Marigi nu bara sɔɔnɛya raba n bɛ.

sentences.english: I had no rest in my spirit because Titus my brother was not there: so I went away from them, and came into Macedonia.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n bɔɲɛ mu nu saxi, barima n mu n ngaxakerenyi Tito lixi naa. Na nan a toxi n naxa ɲungu rabira e ma, n fa siga Masedon.

sentences.english: But praise be to God who makes us strong to overcome in Christ, and makes clear through us in every place the value of the knowledge of him.
sentences.susu: Tantui na Ala bɛ, naxan won xun nakelima a xa Mixi Sugandixi saabui ra. Isa kolonfe fan alɔ labundɛ xiri fanyi. Ala won tan nan xɛɛxi alako yire birin xa rakolon na masenyi ra.

sentences.english: For we are a sweet perfume of Christ to God in those who are getting salvation and in those who are going to destruction;
sentences.susu: Won luxi nɛ alɔ labundɛ xiri fanyi Ala naxan nayensenma kisi mixie nun kisitaree tagi.

sentences.english: To the one it is a perfume of death to death; to the other a perfume of life to life. And who is enough for such things?
sentences.susu: Won findixi mixi xiri ɲaaxi nan na kisitaree bɛ naxee na yahannama kira xɔn ma. Won findixi mixi xiri ɲɔxunmɛ nan na kisi mixie bɛ naxee na ariyanna kira xɔn ma. Kɔnɔ adamadi mundun nɔma na wali mɔɔli rabade?

sentences.english: For we are not like the great number who make use of the word of God for profit: but our words are true, as from God, being said as before God in Christ.
sentences.susu: Muxu tan mu Ala xa masenyi masenma kɔbiri xa fe ra alɔ kawanditi ndee. Muxu kawandi tima bɔɲɛ fiixɛ nan na Ala ya xɔri naxan muxu xɛɛxi. Muxu na rabama Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: Do we seem to be again attempting to put ourselves in the right? or have we need, as some have, of letters of approval to you or from you?
sentences.susu: A lanma muxu man xa muxu yɛtɛ xunmafala? Ade. Muxu hayi na bataaxɛe nan ma naxee muxu xunmafalama wo bɛ? Ade. Muxu hayi na wo xa bataaxɛe nan ma naxee muxu xunmafalama mixi gbɛtɛe bɛ? Ade.

sentences.english: You yourselves are our letter, whose writing is in our heart, open for every man's reading and knowledge;
sentences.susu: Wo naxan nabama wo xa duniɲɛigiri kui a luxi nɛ alɔ bataaxɛ naxan muxu xunmafalama mixi birin bɛ. Na masenyi ragataxi muxu bɔɲɛ kui, alɔ masenyi sɛbɛxi bataaxɛ kui ki naxɛ alako mixi birin xa a kolon.

sentences.english: For you are clearly a letter of Christ, the fruit of our work, recorded not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in stone, but in hearts of flesh.
sentences.susu: Wo tan findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa bataaxɛ nan na. Muxu xa wali bara a niya na bataaxɛ xa sɛbɛ wo bɔɲɛ ma. A mu sɛbɛxi dubɛ xa ra, a sɛbɛxi Ala Xaxili nan na, naxan na na. A mu sɛbɛxi gɛmɛ walaxɛ xa ma, a sɛbɛxi wo bɔɲɛ nan ma.

sentences.english: And this is the certain faith which we have in God through Christ:
sentences.susu: Lanlanteya na muxu bɛ Ala ya i, a xa Mixi Sugandixi saabui ra.

sentences.english: Not as if we were able by ourselves to do anything for which we might take the credit; but our power comes from God;
sentences.susu: Won mu fata fefe ra won yɛtɛ sɛnbɛ ra. Won ma fatɛ fatanxi Ala nan na.

sentences.english: Who has made us able to be servants of a new agreement; not of the letter, but of the Spirit: for the letter gives death, but the Spirit gives life.
sentences.susu: Ala nan a niyaxi won xa nɔ a xa saatɛ nɛɛnɛ kawandide. Na saatɛ mu fatanxi Ala xa yaamarie xa ra naxee sɛbɛxi. A fatanxi Ala Xaxili nan na, naxan mixi rakisima. Ala xa yaamari sɛbɛxie mu mixi rakisima.

sentences.english: For if the operation of the law, giving death, recorded in letters on stone, came with glory, so that the eyes of the children of Israel had to be turned away from the face of Moses because of its glory, a glory which was only for a time:
sentences.susu: Ala xa yaamarie to sɛbɛ gɛmɛ walaxɛe ma, Annabi Munsa yatagi naxa nɔrɔ han Isirayilakae mu nɔ e ya tide a ra. Hali na yaamarie to fa findixi faxɛ nan na mixie bɛ, e xa nɔrɛ nu gbo. Kɔnɔ nde nu luma ba ra na nɔrɛ ra.

sentences.english: Will not the operation of the Spirit have a much greater glory?
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili naxan nabaxi, na wali nɔrɔma dangife na nɔrɛ singe ra naxan fatanxi na yaamari sɛbɛxie ra.

sentences.english: For if the operation of the law, producing punishment, had its glory, how much greater will be the operation of the Spirit causing righteousness?
sentences.susu: Na yaamarie sɛbɛxi gɛmɛ walaxɛe nan ma, naxee nu nɔrɔxi, kɔnɔ e findi faxɛ nan na mixie bɛ. Ala Xaxili naxan nabaxi, naxan a niyama mixie xa tinxinyi sɔtɔ, na nɔrɛ gbo na nɔrɛ singe bɛ.

sentences.english: For the glory of the first no longer seems to be glory, because of the greater glory of that which comes after.
sentences.susu: Naxan singe nu nɔrɔxi, a xa nɔrɛ bara ɲɔn nɔrɛ fisamante sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: For if the order which was for a time had its glory, much more will the eternal order have its glory.
sentences.susu: Na fe singe nu nɔrɔxi, kɔnɔ a mu bu. Ala Xaxili naxan nabaxi, na buma nɛ abadan. Na nɔrɛ gbo na nɔrɛ singe bɛ pon!

sentences.english: Having then such a hope, we keep nothing back,
sentences.susu: Won to won xaxili tixi na ra, won bara limaniya sɔtɔ a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And are not like Moses, who put a veil on his face, so that the children of Israel might not see clearly to the end of the present order of things:
sentences.susu: Won mu luxi alɔ Annabi Munsa naxan a yatagi makoto mafelenyi ra alako Isirayilakae naxa e ya ti na nɔrɛ ra, naxan nu luma ba ra.

sentences.english: But their minds were made hard: for to this very day at the reading of the old agreement the same veil is still unlifted; though it is taken away in Christ.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e xaxili xɔrɔxɔ. Han to e mu fe fahaamuma a fanyi ra, e saatɛ fori xaranma tɛmui naxɛ. A luxi nɛ alɔ na mafelenyi, naxan nu Annabi Munsa yatagi makotoxi, a man na e yatagi ma, e mu fefe igbɛma. Na fahaamutareɲa mu nɔma bade, fo mixi na la Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra.

sentences.english: But to this day, at the reading of the law of Moses, a veil is over their heart.
sentences.susu: Han to e luxi alɔ na mafelenyi na e yatagi makotofe, e mu fahaamui sɔtɔ e bɔɲɛ kui, e Tawureta Munsa xaranma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: But when it is turned to the Lord, the veil will be taken away.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi na a ya rafindi Marigi ma, na luxi nɛ alɔ na mafelenyi bara ba na kanyi yatagi ma, a fa fahaamui sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Now the Lord is the Spirit: and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there the heart is free.
sentences.susu: Won Marigi findixi Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nan na. Marigi Xaxili nan xɔrɛya fima mixi ma.

sentences.english: But we all, with unveiled face giving back as in a glass the glory of the Lord, are changed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord who is the Spirit.
sentences.susu: Xa na mafelenyi baxi won yatagi ma, Marigi xa nɔrɛ naxan yanbama won ma, won fama nɛ na nɔrɛ masende mixi gbɛtɛe bɛ. Won Marigi Xaxili won masarama nɛ a misaali ra, won ma nɔrɛ xun nu masa.

sentences.english: For this reason, because we have been made servants of this new order, through the mercy given to us, we are strong:
sentences.susu: Ala to a xa wali soxi muxu yi ra a xa hinnɛ saabui ra, limaniya mu bama muxu yi ra.

sentences.english: And we have given up the secret things of shame, not walking in false ways, and not making use of the word of God with deceit; but by the revelation of what is true, as before God, we have the approval of every man's sense of right and wrong.
sentences.susu: Muxu wali ki mu nɔxunxi, yaagi yo mu na a kui. Muxu mu mixi madaxuma, muxu mu Ala xa masenyi mafindima. Muxu nɔndi nan masenma mixi birin bɛ, alako e xa la muxu ra Ala ya i.

sentences.english: But if our good news is veiled, it is veiled from those who are on the way to destruction:
sentences.susu: Muxu xa xibaaru fanyi fiixɛ mixi birin bɛ, fo kisitaree,

sentences.english: Because the god of this world has made blind the minds of those who have not faith, so that the light of the good news of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, might not be shining on them.
sentences.susu: barima e mu danxaniyaxi. Yi waxati mixie marigi bara a ragiri e xaxili naxa fahaamui sɔtɔ xibaaru fanyi ma Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nɔrɔxi xa fe ra, naxan findixi Ala misaali ra.

sentences.english: For our preaching is not about ourselves, but about Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants through Jesus.
sentences.susu: Muxu mu muxu yɛtɛ kan xa fe xa kawandima. Muxu xa kawandi a masenma nɛ a Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa nan findixi muxu Marigi ra, a nun muxu fan findixi wo xa konyie nan na Isa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Seeing that it is God who said, Let light be shining out of the dark, who has put in our hearts the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Ala naxan a masenxi, «Naiyalanyi xa yanba dimi kui,» a tan bara a xa nɔrɛ masen muxu bɛ a xa Mixi Sugandixi saabui ra.

sentences.english: But we have this wealth in vessels of earth, so that it may be seen that the power comes not from us but from God;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na nɔrɛ hagigɛ saxi muxu bɔɲɛ ma, bɔɲɛ naxan sɛnbɛ xurun alɔ fɛɲɛ, alako mixie xa a kolon na sɛnbɛ xungbe fatanxi Ala nan na, a mu fatanxi muxu tan xa ra.

sentences.english: Troubles are round us on every side, but we are not shut in; things are hard for us, but we see a way out of them;
sentences.susu: Kɔntɔfili bara muxu xɛtɛn, kɔnɔ muxu mu butuxunxi. A bara muxu xaxili ifu, kɔnɔ limaniya mu baxi muxu yi ra.

sentences.english: We are cruelly attacked, but not without hope; we are made low, but we are not without help;
sentences.susu: Muxu bara ɲaxankatɛ sɔtɔ, kɔnɔ Ala mu muxu raboloxi. Fe xɔrɔxɔɛ bara muxu rabira, kɔnɔ a mu nɔxi muxu ra.

sentences.english: In our bodies there is ever the mark of the death of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may be seen in our bodies.
sentences.susu: Muxu xa tɔɔrɛ muxu xa duniɲɛigiri kui, a maniyaxi Isa gbe nan na naxan faxa wuri magalanbuxi ma. Muxu na tɔɔrɛ sɔtɔxi nɛ alako muxu xa Isa xa xunnakeli fan masen muxu xa duniɲɛigiri kui.

sentences.english: For, while living, we are still being given up to death because of Jesus, so that the life of Jesus may be seen in our flesh, though it is under the power of death.
sentences.susu: Muxu na tɔɔrɔfe Isa xa fe nan na muxu xa duniɲɛigiri kui, alako Isa xa xunnakeli fan xa makɛnɛn muxu xa simaya kui.

sentences.english: So then, death is working in us, but life in you.
sentences.susu: Na nan na ki muxu na saya kira nan xɔn ma, alako wo tan xa kisi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: But having the same spirit of faith, as it is said in the Writings, The words of my mouth came from the faith in my heart; in the same way, our words are the outcome of our faith;
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, «N to danxaniya, na nan a to n naxa wɔyɛn.» Muxu fan to danxaniyaxi, muxu wɔyɛnxi na nan ma.

sentences.english: Because we are certain that he who made the Lord Jesus come back from the dead, will do the same for us, and will give us a place in his glory with you.
sentences.susu: Muxu na rabaxi nɛ, barima muxu bara a kolon naxan Marigi Isa rakelixi faxɛ ma, a fama nɛ muxu fan nakelide faxɛ ma Isa xa fe ra, a won birin xanin a yire.

sentences.english: For we go through all things on account of you, because the greater the number to whom the grace is given, the greater is the praise to the glory of God.
sentences.susu: Muxu tinxi na tɔɔrɛ birin na wo xa fe ra. Muxu tɔɔrɔma nɛ alako mixi gbegbe xa Ala xa hinnɛ kolon, e fa tantui nun matɔxɔɛ rasiga a ma.

sentences.english: For which cause we do not give way to weariness; but though our outer man is getting feebler, our inner man is made new day by day.
sentences.susu: Na kui, limaniya mu bama muxu yi ra. Hali muxu fate to na kanafe, muxu bɔɲɛ na fanfe lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ,

sentences.english: For our present trouble, which is only for a short time, is working out for us a much greater weight of glory;
sentences.susu: barima muxu xa tɔɔrɛ xunxuri naxan mu buma, a na xunnakeli xungbe raminife muxu bɛ, xunnakeli naxan maniyɛ mu na, naxan mu ɲɔnma abadan.

sentences.english: While our minds are not on the things which are seen, but on the things which are not seen: for the things which are seen are for a time; but the things which are not seen are eternal.
sentences.susu: Muxu xaxili mu tixi fe toxi xa ra. Muxu xaxili tixi fe nan na naxan mu toma. Fe toxi mu buma, kɔnɔ fe naxan mu toma na tan buma nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: For we are conscious that if this our tent of flesh is taken down, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in heaven.
sentences.susu: Won a kolon, won fate luxi nɛ alɔ bage, won nii sabatixi dɛnnaxɛ. Na bage na kana, won banxi gbɛtɛ sɔtɔma nɛ ariyanna, won luma dɛnnaxɛ abadan. Ala nan na banxi yailanxi won bɛ, adamadi mu naxan tixi.

sentences.english: For in this we are crying in weariness, greatly desiring to be clothed with our house from heaven:
sentences.susu: Won wa xui minima yi bage kui, barima won sabatide naxan na koore, na xɔli na won ma, taa fanyi naxan na ariyanna.

sentences.english: So that our spirits may not be unclothed.
sentences.susu: Na banxi nɛɛnɛ misaalixi donma nan na. Won wama donma nɛɛnɛ ragorofe won ma, alako won naxa lu won mageli ra.

sentences.english: For truly, we who are in this tent do give out cries of weariness, for the weight of care which is on us; not because we are desiring to be free from the body, but so that we may have our new body, and death may be overcome by life.
sentences.susu: Danmi won na yi bage kui, won wa xui raminima, barima won mu wama donma xa ba won ma. Won wama nɛ donma nɛɛnɛ xa ragoro won ma, alako kisi xa nɔ faxɛ ra.

sentences.english: Now he who has made us for this very thing is God, who has given us the Spirit as a witness of what is to come.
sentences.susu: Ala won daaxi na kisi nan ma fe ra. A bara a yɛtɛ Xaxili ragoro won ma naxan a masenma a fama nɛ won kide ariyanna ra.

sentences.english: So, then, we are ever without fear, and though conscious that while we are in the body we are away from the Lord,
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi won limaniyaxi. Won a kolon, danmi won nii sabatixi yi fate i, won makuya Marigi ra.

sentences.english: (For we are walking by faith, not by seeing,)
sentences.susu: Won ma ɲɛrɛ kui won xaxili tixi fe nan na won mu naxan toxi sinden.

sentences.english: We are without fear, desiring to be free from the body, and to be with the Lord.
sentences.susu: Won ma limaniya xa fe ra, won wama kelife yi fate kui, won xa sabati Marigi xɔnyi.

sentences.english: For this reason we make it our purpose, in the body or away from it, to be well-pleasing to him.
sentences.susu: Na kui, xa won nii na won fate kui, xa na mu a ra won nii bara keli won fate kui, won fe birin nabama Ala sago rakamalife nan na.

sentences.english: For we all have to come before Christ to be judged; so that every one of us may get his reward for the things done in the body, good or bad.
sentences.susu: Won na rabama nɛ barima Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi fama nɛ won birin makiitide, alako kankan xa a sare sɔtɔ a xa fe fanyie nun a xa fe ɲaaxie ma, a naxee rabaxi a xa duniɲɛigiri kui.

sentences.english: Having in mind, then, the fear of the Lord, we put these things before men, but God sees our hearts; and it is my hope that we may seem right in your eyes.
sentences.susu: Muxu to Marigi xa yaragaaxui kolon, muxu katama mixie nan nafade Ala ma. Ala muxu ɲɛrɛ ki kolon. N wama lafe a ra, wo fan muxu ɲɛrɛ ki kolon wo bɔɲɛ kui.

sentences.english: We are not again requesting your approval, but we are giving you the chance of taking pride in us, so that you may be able to give an answer to those whose glory is in seeming, and not in the heart.
sentences.susu: Muxu mu wama gbilenfe muxu xunmafalafe ra wo bɛ. Muxu wama nɛ tun wo xa ɲɛlɛxin muxu xa fe ra, alako wo xa nɔ mixie yaabide naxee e yɛtɛ igboma fee fufafu ra, naxee mu kelima e bɔɲɛ kui.

sentences.english: For if we are foolish, it is to God; or if we are serious, it is for you.
sentences.susu: Xa muxu bara so fe ndee kui naxan luxi alɔ daxuɲa duniɲa mixie bɛ, muxu na rabaxi Ala nan bɛ. Kɔnɔ xa muxu bara ɲɛrɛ xaxili fanyi bɛrɛ ra, muxu na rabaxi wo tan nan bɛ.

sentences.english: For it is the love of Christ which is moving us; because we are of the opinion that if one was put to death for all, then all have undergone death;
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa xanunteya nan muxu tutunma. Muxu bara a kolon mixi keren bara faxa adama birin bɛ. Na kui, mixi birin bara faxa.

sentences.english: And that he underwent death for all, so that the living might no longer be living to themselves, but to him who underwent death for them and came back from the dead.
sentences.susu: A bara faxamixi birin bɛ, alako naxee ɲiɲɛ a ra e xa e yɛtɛ waxɔnfe lu na, e xa wali Isa bɛ naxan faxa e bɛ, naxan man keli faxɛ ma e bɛ.

sentences.english: For this reason, from this time forward we have knowledge of no man after the flesh: even if we have had knowledge of Christ after the flesh, we have no longer any such knowledge.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, kelife yakɔsi, won mu mixi toma alɔ duniɲa mixie e toma ki naxɛ. Singe won nu Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi toma nɛ alɔ duniɲa mixie a toxi ki naxɛ, kɔnɔ yakɔsi won mu a kolonxi na ki sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: So if any man is in Christ, he is in a new world: the old things have come to an end; they have truly become new.
sentences.susu: Mixi nun Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi na lu fe keren kui, a findima mixi nɛɛnɛ nan na. A xa fe fori bara masara fe nɛɛnɛ ra.

sentences.english: But all things are of God, who has made us at peace with himself through Christ, and has given to us the work of making peace;
sentences.susu: Na birin fatanxi Ala nan na, naxan won nagbilenxi a yɛtɛ ma a xa Mixi Sugandixi saabui ra. A man bara wali taxu won na adamadie ragbilenfe ra a ma.

sentences.english: That is, that God was in Christ making peace between the world and himself, not putting their sins to their account, and having given to us the preaching of this news of peace.
sentences.susu: Ala bara duniɲa ragbilen a ma a xa Mixi Sugandixi saabui ra, a diɲɛ adamadie xa yunubie ma. A man bara na masenyi so won yi ra naxan a niyama mixie xa gbilen a ma.

sentences.english: So we are the representatives of Christ, as if God was making a request to you through us: we make our request to you, in the name of Christ, be at peace with God.
sentences.susu: Na kui, won bara findi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa xɛɛrae ra. A luxi nɛ alɔ Ala na kawandi tife won tan nan saabui ra. Muxu bara wo mayandi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xili ra, wo xa gbilen Ala ma.

sentences.english: For him who had no knowledge of sin God made to be sin for us; so that we might become the righteousness of God in him.
sentences.susu: Isa naxan mu yunubi yo rabaxi, Ala bara a findi won ma yunubi sare ra. Na nan a toxi won findixi tinxin mixie ra Ala ya tode ra Isa saabui ra.

sentences.english: We then, working together with God, make our request to you not to take the grace of God to no purpose.
sentences.susu: Muxu tan, Ala xa walikɛe, muxu bara wo rasi wo naxa Ala xa hinnɛ sɔtɔ fu ra.

sentences.english: (For he says, I have given ear to you at a good time, and I have been your helper in a day of salvation: see, now is the good time; now is the day of salvation):
sentences.susu: Ala bara a masen Kitaabui kui, «N bara wo xa duba suxu n ma hinnɛ waxati, n bara wo mali wo xa kisi lɔxɔɛ.» Wo xa a kolon Ala xa hinnɛ waxati bara a li. To nan findixi kisi lɔxɔɛ ra wo bɛ.

sentences.english: Giving no cause for trouble in anything, so that no one may be able to say anything against our work;
sentences.susu: Muxu tan mu sese rabama naxan nɔma mixi ratantande, mixie fa a fala a muxu wali kobi nan nabaxi.

sentences.english: But in everything making it clear that we are the servants of God, in quiet strength, in troubles, in need, in sorrow,
sentences.susu: Muxu bara fe birin naba xili fanyi sɔtɔfe ra Ala xa walikɛ lanma a xa naxan naba. Muxu bara tunnabɛxiya raba ɲaxankatɛ, setareɲa, nun kɔntɔfili kui.

sentences.english: In blows, in prisons, in attacks, in hard work, in watchings, in going without food;
sentences.susu: E bara muxu bɔnbɔ, e muxu raso geeli kui, e gali bɔɲɛ rate muxu xili ma. Muxu bara wali xɔrɔxɔɛ raba, muxu mu xi, muxu bara kaamɛ.

sentences.english: In a clean heart, in knowledge, in long waiting, in being kind, in the Holy Spirit, in true love,
sentences.susu: Muxu bara muxu tunnabɛxi sɛniyɛnyi, fahaamui, diɲɛ, fe fanyi, xaxili sɛniyɛnxi, nun xanunteya fiixɛ kui.

sentences.english: In the true word, in the power of God; with the arms of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,
sentences.susu: Muxu mu ba nɔndi falafe, muxu fe birin nabama Ala sɛnbɛ saabui nan na. Muxu bara Ala xa gere fanyi suxu tinxinyi kui muxu bɛlɛxɛ firin na.

sentences.english: By glory and by shame, by an evil name and a good name; as untrue, and still true;
sentences.susu: Muxu walima binyɛ nun yelebui sɔtɔɛ nan kui. Muxu bara xili fanyi nun xili kanɛ sɔtɔ. Ndee bara muxu findi wule falɛe ra, kɔnɔ muxu nɔndi gbansan nan falama.

sentences.english: Unnoted, but still kept fully in mind; as near to death, but still living; as undergoing punishment, but not put to death;
sentences.susu: Hali e muxu kolon, e fe rabama muxu ra alɔ e mu mixi naxan kolon. Muxu maniyama mixi ra naxan na saya kira xɔn ma, kɔnɔ muxu mu faxaxi. Muxu bara ɲaxankata, kɔnɔ muxu mu faxaxi.

sentences.english: As full of sorrow, but ever glad; as poor, but giving wealth to others; as having nothing, but still having all things.
sentences.susu: Sunnun mixie nan muxu ra, kɔnɔ sɛɛwɛ na muxu bɔɲɛ kui. Setaree nan muxu ra, kɔnɔ bannaya na muxu yi ra. Misikiinɛe nan muxu ra, kɔnɔ fe birin na muxu yi ra.

sentences.english: Our mouth is open to you, O Corinthians, our heart is wide.
sentences.susu: Muxu mu masenyi yo nɔxunxi wo ma. Wo xa fe bara lu muxu sondonyi ma.

sentences.english: It is not our feelings to you which are narrow, but yours to us.
sentences.susu: Muxu bɔɲɛ mu balanxi wo ma, kɔnɔ wo tan bara wo bɔɲɛ balan muxu mabiri.

sentences.english: Now to give me back payment of the same sort (I am talking as to my children), let your hearts be wide open to me.
sentences.susu: N ma die, yandi, wo fan xa xanunteya xun xa masa muxu mabiri.

sentences.english: Do not keep company with those who have not faith: for what is there in common between righteousness and evil, or between light and dark?
sentences.susu: Lanyi naxa lu wo nun danxaniyataree tagi. Munse na tinxinyi nun tinxintareya tagi? Naiyalanyi nun dimi nɔma lude yire keren?

sentences.english: And what agreement is there between Christ and the Evil One? or what part has one who has faith with one who has not?
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nun Sentanɛ lanma fe keren ma? Danxaniyatɔɛ nun danxaniyatare lanma munse ma?

sentences.english: And what agreement has the house of God with images? for we are a house of the living God; even as God has said, I will be living among them, and walking with them; and I will be their God, and they will be my people.
sentences.susu: Kuye toma Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui? Won tan nan findixi Ala Ɲiɲɛ xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi ra. Ala yati a fala nɛ, «N ɲɛrɛma nɛ wo ya ma. Wo Marigi Ala nan n na, wo fan findima nɛ n ma ɲama ra.»

sentences.english: For which cause, Come out from among them, and be separate, says the Lord, and let no unclean thing come near you; and I will take you for myself,
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi Marigi naxa a fala, «Wo xa mini e ya ma, wo xa lu wo xati ma. Wo naxa din fe sɛniyɛntare ra, alako n xa wo rasɛnɛ.»

sentences.english: And will be a Father to you; and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord, the Ruler of all.
sentences.susu: Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi xa masenyi nan ya, «N findima wo baba nan na, wo tan fan findi n ma die ra.»

sentences.english: Because God, then, will give us such rewards, dear brothers, let us make ourselves clean from all evil of flesh and spirit, and become completely holy in the fear of God.
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie, Ala to na laayidi mɔɔlie tongo won bɛ, won fate nun won bɔɲɛ xa lu sɛniyɛnyi kui. Won ma sɛniyɛnyi xa kamali Ala xa yaragaaxui kui.

sentences.english: Let your hearts be open to us: we have done no man wrong, no man has been damaged by us, we have made no profit out of any man,
sentences.susu: Wo xa tin muxu xa fe ra. Muxu mu fe ɲaaxi yo rabaxi wo ra, muxu mu wo xun nakana, muxu mu wo rawali.

sentences.english: It is not with the purpose of judging you that I say this: for I have said before that you are in our hearts for life and death together.
sentences.susu: N mu wama kiiti ɲaaxi safe wo ma. N ɲan bara a fala wo bɛ xanunteya na won tagi han muxu bara tin fe birin nabade wo bɛ, hali na findima faxɛ nan na.

sentences.english: My words to you are without fear, I am full of pride on account of you: I have great comfort and joy in all our troubles.
sentences.susu: Lanlanteya fanyi na won tagi. N bara ɲɛlɛxin wo xa fe ra, na fan bara findi limaniya ra n bɛ. Hali n na tɔɔrɛ kui, wo bara a niya n ma sɛɛwɛ xa kamali.

sentences.english: For even when we had come into Macedonia our flesh had no rest, but we were troubled on every side; there were fightings outside and fears inside.
sentences.susu: Muxu to fa Masedon, muxu mu malabui sɔtɔ, muxu tɔɔrɛ mɔɔli birin nan li naa: Gere na muxu rabilinyi, gaaxui fan na muxu bɔɲɛ ma.

sentences.english: But God who gives comfort to the poor in spirit gave us comfort by the coming of Titus;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala, naxan mixi limaniyatare ralimaniyama, a bara muxu fan nalimaniya Tito fafe saabui ra.

sentences.english: And not by his coming only, but by the comfort which he had in you, while he gave us word of your desire, your sorrow, your care for me; so that I was still more glad.
sentences.susu: A fafe gbansan xa mu a ra. Wo mɛɛnixi a ma ki naxɛ, na fan bara findi limaniya ra muxu bɛ. A bara a fala muxu bɛ n xɔli bara wo suxu, han na bara findi yaye ra wo bɛ. A bara wo xa marafanyi xa fe fala muxu bɛ n tan mabiri. Na bara n nasɛɛwa a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: For though my letter gave you pain, I have no regret for it now, though I had before; for I see that the letter gave you pain, but only for a time.
sentences.susu: N a kolon n ma bataaxɛ bara wo rasunnun, kɔnɔ a mu ɲaaxu n bɛ. Hali n to mu nu wama n ma bataaxɛ xa wo rasunnun, n a kolon na sunnunyi xɔn mu kuya fa.

sentences.english: Now I am glad, not that you had sorrow, but that your sorrow was the cause of a change of heart; for yours was a holy sorrow so that you might undergo no loss by us in anything.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n bara ɲɛlɛxin na xa fe ra. N mu ɲɛlɛxin wo xa sunnunyi xa ra, kɔnɔ n ɲɛlɛxinxi nɛ barima na sunnunyi bara a niya wo xa tuubi. Na kui, n a kolon na sunnunyi fatanxi Ala nan na, a mu fatanxi muxu tan xa ra.

sentences.english: For the sorrow which God gives is the cause of salvation through a change of heart, in which there is no reason for grief: but the sorrow of the world is a cause of death.
sentences.susu: Ala mixie rasunnunma nɛ alako e xa tuubi, e fa kisi. Na sunnunyi mɔɔli mu findima mɔnɛ ra, kɔnɔ sunnunyi naxan fatanxi duniɲa ra, na findima faxɛ nan na.

sentences.english: For you see what care was produced in you by this very sorrow of yours before God, what clearing of yourselves, what wrath against sin, what fear, what desire, what serious purpose, what punishment. In everything you have made it clear that you are free from sin in this business.
sentences.susu: Ala bara na sunnunyi rawali wo xa fe ra, alako wo xa wo tunnabɛxi, wo xa wo yɛtɛ xunmafala, wo xa xɔnɔ fe ɲaaxi ma, wo xa gaaxu Ala ya ra, wo xa fe fanyi suxu sɛnbɛ ra, wo xa fe ɲaaxi makiiti. Wo bara a masen wo bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra fe dangixi kui.

sentences.english: So though I sent you a letter, it was not only because of the man who did the wrong, or because of him to whom the wrong was done, but so that your true care for us might be made clear in the eyes of God.
sentences.susu: N to bataaxɛ sɛbɛ wo ma, n mu a sɛbɛxi na fe ɲaaxi rabae xa fe xa ra, n mu a sɛbɛ na mixi xa fe ra naxan bara fe ɲaaxi sɔtɔ. N a sɛbɛ nɛ alako muxu xa marafanyi naxan na wo bɛ a xa mini kɛnɛ ma Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: So we have been comforted: and we had the greater joy in our comfort because of the joy of Titus, for his spirit had been made glad by you all.
sentences.susu: Na birin bara muxu ralimaniya. Muxu man bara ɲɛlɛxin Tito xa sɛɛwɛ xa fe ra, wo naxan bɔɲɛ ralimaniyaxi a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: For I was not put to shame in anything in which I may have made clear to him my pride in you; but as we said nothing to you but what was true, so the good things which I said to Titus about you were seen by him to be true.
sentences.susu: N nu bara fe fanyi fala a bɛ wo xa fe ra. Wo mu n nayaagixi na kui. Muxu naxan falaxi wo bɛ, a birin findixi nɔndi nan na. Muxu naxan falaxi Tito bɛ wo xa fe ra, na fan birin findixi nɔndi nan na.

sentences.english: And his love to you is the more increased by his memory of you all, how you gave way to his authority, and how you took him to your hearts with fear and honour.
sentences.susu: Wo xa marafanyi a bɛ, a xun bara masa, barima wo to a rasɛnɛ, a bara wo xa batui nun wo xa yaragaaxui to.

sentences.english: It gives me great joy to see you answering to my good opinion of you in every way.
sentences.susu: N bara ɲɛlɛxin na lanlanteya ra naxan na won tagi, a mu kanama fefe ma.

sentences.english: And now we give you news, brothers, about the grace of God which has been given to the churches of Macedonia;
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, n xa a fala wo bɛ Ala hinnɛxi Masedon danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: How while they were undergoing every sort of trouble, and were in the greatest need, they took all the greater joy in being able to give freely to the needs of others.
sentences.susu: Hali e to nu na ɲaxankatɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ kui, e xa sɛɛwɛ xungbe nun e xa setareɲa xɔrɔxɔɛ a niyaxi nɛ e xa ki ti a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: For I give them witness, that as they were able, and even more than they were able, they gave from the impulse of their hearts,
sentences.susu: N bara findi e xa seede ra. E bara mixi ki alɔ e nu nɔma naxan na, e man dangi na ra.

sentences.english: Seriously requesting us that they might have a part in this grace of being servants to the needs of the saints:
sentences.susu: E naxa muxu mayandi e yɛtɛ ɲanige ra, a e fan xa sɛniyɛntɔɛe mali alɔ booree a rabama ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And going even farther than our hope, they first gave themselves to the Lord and to us after the purpose of God.
sentences.susu: Na bara dangi muxu waxɔnfe ra. A singe e naxa e yɛtɛ fi Marigi ma. Na dangi xanbi, e man naxa e yɛtɛ fi muxu ma alɔ Ala nu wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So that we made a request to Titus that, as he had made a start before, so he might make this grace complete in you.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara Tito rasi, a xa na wali fanyi rakamali wo bɛ a naxan fɔlɔxi.

sentences.english: And that as you are full of every good thing, of faith, of the word, of knowledge, of a ready mind, and of love to us, so you may be full of this grace in the same way.
sentences.susu: Wo bara xunnakeli sɔtɔ fe birin kui, alɔ wo xa danxaniya, wo xa masenyie, wo xa lɔnni, wo xa tunnabɛxi, nun wo xa xanunteya muxu xa fe ra. Wo xa xunnakeli sɔtɔ yi wali fanyi fan xa fe ra.

sentences.english: I am not giving you an order, but using the ready mind of others as a test of the quality of your love.
sentences.susu: N mu wo yamarife xɛ. N wama a kolonfe nɛ xa wo xa xanunteya fiixɛ alɔ booree gbe fiixɛxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For you see the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, how though he had wealth, he became poor on your account, so that through his need you might have wealth.
sentences.susu: Wo a kolon won Marigi Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, a hinnɛxi won na ki naxɛ. Fe birin nu na a yi ra, kɔnɔ a naxa diɲɛ na birin ma wo tan bɛ, alako wo xa banna a xa setareɲa saabui ra.

sentences.english: And in this I give my opinion: for it is to your profit, who were the first to make a start a year before, not only to do this, but to make clear that your minds were more than ready to do it.
sentences.susu: N bara wo rasi na ma alako a xa findi fe fanyi ra wo bɛ. Yaala wo tan nan singe na natɛ tongo, wo tan nan singe kɔbiri malan fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: Then make the doing of it complete; so that as you had a ready mind, you may give effect to it as you are able.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi fa, wo xa na raɲɔn, alako wo ɲanige fanyi xa kamali wo xa fɛɛrɛ bɛrɛ ra.

sentences.english: For if there is a ready mind, a man will have God's approval in the measure of what he has, and not of what he has not.
sentences.susu: Xa wo mixie kima ɲanige fanyi ra, wo e mali wo nɔma naxan na, na findima fe fanyi ra. Xa na fɛɛrɛ mu na wo yi ra, fefe mu a ra.

sentences.english: And I am not saying this so that others may get off free, while the weight comes on you:
sentences.susu: Muxu mu wama wo tan xa tɔɔrɔ alako booree xa se sɔtɔ. Wo birin xa lan.

sentences.english: But so that things may be equal; that from those things of which you have more than enough at the present time their need may be helped, and that if you are in any need they may be a help to you in the same way, making things equal.
sentences.susu: Yi waxati, wo harige fanyi nɔma nɛ e malide e xa setareɲa kui. Waxati gbɛtɛ, e tan fan harige fanyi nɔma nɛ wo fan malide wo xa setareɲa kui. Na kui, wo birin bara lan,

sentences.english: As it says in the Writings, He who had taken up much had nothing over and he who had little had enough.
sentences.susu: alɔ a sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui ki naxɛ, «Naxan a gbegbe malanxi, a mu dangi a i. Naxan dondoronti malanxi, a a hayi lixi nɛ.»

sentences.english: But praise be to God, who puts the same care for you into the heart of Titus.
sentences.susu: Ala tantu, barima Ala bara a niya wo xa fe xa lu Tito bɔɲɛ kui, alɔ muxu tan.

sentences.english: For while he gladly gave ear to our request, he was interested enough to go to you from the impulse of his heart.
sentences.susu: A bara muxu xa marasi suxu. A man bara natɛ tongo a yɛtɛ ra ɲɛlɛxinyi kui, a xa siga wo yire.

sentences.english: And with him we have sent a brother whose praise in the good news has gone through all the churches;
sentences.susu: Muxu na muxu ngaxakerenyi nde xɛɛfe a matide, danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama naxan birin matɔxɔma a xa kawandi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And not only so, but he was marked out by the churches to go with us in the grace of this giving which we have undertaken to the glory of the Lord and to make clear that our mind was ready:
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae bara a sugandi a xa muxu fan mati na kɔbiri xaninde. Muxu na birin nabama nɛ alako Ala xa matɔxɔɛ sɔtɔ, a nun man muxu xa ɲanige fanyi xa raba.

sentences.english: And so that no man might be able to say anything against us in the business of this giving which has been put into our hands:
sentences.susu: Muxu mu wama mixi yo xa fe ɲaaxi to muxu wali ki ma, muxu na kɔbiri ya rafanyi rawalima ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For the business has been so ordered by us as to have the approval, not only of the Lord, but of men.
sentences.susu: Muxu fe fanyi nan tun fenma na wali kui Marigi nun adamadie ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And we have sent with them our brother, whose ready spirit has been made clear to us at times and in ways without number, but it is now all the more so because of the certain faith which he has in you.
sentences.susu: Muxu na won ngaxakerenyi gbɛtɛ fan xɛɛfe booree matide. Muxu bara a to sanya wuyaxi, muxu xa fe na a bɔɲɛ ma sɛnbɛ ra. Yakɔsi, nde bara sa na sɛnbɛ fari, barima a man bara la wo tan na.

sentences.english: If any question comes up about Titus, he is my brother-worker, working with me for you; or about the others, they are the representatives of the churches to the glory of Christ.
sentences.susu: N waliboore Tito findixi n tan nan ma xɛɛra ra wo bɛ. A matimae findixi danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae nan ma xɛɛrae ra Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa binyɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Make clear then to them, as representatives of the churches, the quality of your love, and that the things which we have said about you are true.
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo xa wo xa xanunteya masen yi mixie bɛ alako danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama birin xa a kolon muxu fe fanyi naxee falaxi wo xa fe ra, a nɔndi na a ra.

sentences.english: But there is no need for me to say anything in my letter about the giving to the saints:
sentences.susu: Hali n mu bataaxɛ sɛbɛ wo ma sɛniyɛntɔɛe malife xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For I have before made clear to those of Macedonia my pride in your ready mind, saying to them that Achaia has been ready for a year back; and a great number have been moved to do the same by your example.
sentences.susu: N ɲan bara wo ɲanige fanyi kolon. N bara wo matɔxɔ Masedonkae bɛ, a falafe ra wo tan Akayikae rɛdixi na kɔbiri malanfe ra kabi yaala. Wo to na natɛ suxu sɛnbɛ ra, e fan bara wa sofe na kui.

sentences.english: But I have sent the brothers, so that the good things we said about you may be seen to be true, and that, as I said, you may be ready:
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi n na n ngaxakerenyie xɛɛfe wo yire, alako n matɔxɔɛ naxan nabaxi wo xa fe ra, a naxa findi wule ra. Wo xa kɔbiri malan sinnanyi ma, alako e xa a li naa alɔ n wo xa fe fala e bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For fear that, if any from Macedonia come with me, and you are not ready, we (not to say, you) might be put to shame in this thing.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li n nun Masedonkae mu wo xa laayidi tongoxi rakamalixi lima naa, na findima yaagi nan na n bɛ, a findima yaagi belebele nan na wo fan bɛ.

sentences.english: So it seemed to me wise for the brothers to go before, and see that the amount which you had undertaken to give was ready, so that it might be a cause for praise, and not as if we were making profit out of you.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n bara n ngaxakerenyie xɛɛ wo yire sinnanyi ma, alako wo xa laayidi xa kamali. Na ki wo nɔma na rabade wo waxɔnki, alako a naxa findi fe xɔrɔxɔɛ ra wo bɛ.

sentences.english: But in the Writings it says, He who puts in only a small number of seeds, will get in the same; and he who puts them in from a full hand, will have produce in full measure from them.
sentences.susu: Wo xa ratu a ma, a naxan sansi xɔri xuri rawalima, a fan sansi xuri di nan sɔtɔma. Naxan sansi xɔri gbegbe rawalima, a fan sansi gbegbe sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: Let every man do after the purpose of his heart; not giving with grief, or by force: for God takes pleasure in a ready giver.
sentences.susu: Kankan xa mixi ki a yɛtɛ ɲanige ra. Teku mu a ra. A naxa mixi ki nimisɛ kui. Naxan mixi kima sɛɛwɛ kui, na nan nafan Ala ma.

sentences.english: And God is able to give you all grace in full measure; so that ever having enough of all things, you may be full of every good work:
sentences.susu: Ala nɔma barakɛ mɔɔli birin nagorode wo ma. Nee wo hayi lima nɛ, e man dangi a ra, alako wo xa nɔ wali fanyi mɔɔli birin nabade.

sentences.english: As it is said in the Writings, He has sent out far and wide, he has given to the poor; his righteousness is for ever.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, «A bara setaree ki a fanyi ra. A xa tinxinyi buma abadan.»

sentences.english: And he who gives seed for putting into the field and bread for food, will take care of the growth of your seed, at the same time increasing the fruits of your righteousness;
sentences.susu: Ala naxan sansi xɔri fima sansisi ma, a a rabalo taami ra, a man wo tan ma fɛɛrɛ rawuyama nɛ, alako wo xa wali tinxinxie fan xa wuya.

sentences.english: Your wealth being increased in everything, with a simple mind, causing praise to God through us.
sentences.susu: Ala wo kima fɛɛrɛ gbegbe nan na, alako wo fan xa mixie ki a fanyi ra. Mixie fama nɛ Ala tantude wo xa mali xa fe ra, muxu naxan soma e yi ra wo xili ra.

sentences.english: For this work of giving not only takes care of the needs of the saints, but is the cause of much praise to God;
sentences.susu: Wo naxan fima sɛniyɛntɔɛe ma, a e hayi lima nɛ, a man findi tantui gbegbe ra Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: For when, through this work of giving, they see what you are, they give glory to God for the way in which you have given yourselves to the good news of Christ, and for the wealth of your giving to them and to all;
sentences.susu: Mixie na wo xa wali to, e Ala tantuma nɛ, barima wo xa danxaniya Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ma, a bara findi batui ra. E Ala tantuma nɛ wo xa mali xa fe ra, wo hinnɛxi e ra naxan na, a nun mixi birin.

sentences.english: While their hearts go out to you in love and in prayer for you, because of the great grace of God which is in you.
sentences.susu: E fama nɛ Ala maxandide wo bɛ xanunteya ra, barima e a kolon Ala bara hinnɛ wo ra a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Praise be to God for what he has given, which words have no power to say.
sentences.susu: Ala tantu a xa hinnɛ xa fe ra naxan dangi fe birin na.

sentences.english: Now I, Paul, myself make request to you by the quiet and gentle behaviour of Christ, I who am poor in spirit when with you, but who say what is in my mind to you without fear when I am away from you:
sentences.susu: N tan Pɔlu, n wama wo rasife Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa diɲɛ nun a xa fanyi nan saabui ra. Wo naxɛ a n sɛnbɛ mu gbo n na wo ya ma tɛmui naxɛ, fo n na makuya wo ra, n fa wɔyɛn xɔrɔxɔɛ fala wo bɛ.

sentences.english: Yes, I make my request to you, so that when I am with you I may not have to make use of the authority which may be needed against some to whom we seem to be walking after the flesh.
sentences.susu: N bara wo mayandi, wo naxa a niya n ma wɔyɛnyi xa xɔrɔxɔ n fa tɛmui wo yire. Ndee ɲɔxɔ a ma muxu na ɲɛrɛfe adama ki nan tun ma. N wɔyɛnma a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra na mixie nan bɛ.

sentences.english: For though we may be living in the flesh, we are not fighting after the way of the flesh
sentences.susu: Adamadi nan muxu ra, kɔnɔ muxu mu gere soma adama ki xa ma.

sentences.english: (For the arms with which we are fighting are not those of the flesh, but are strong before God for the destruction of high places);
sentences.susu: Muxu mu gere soma adamadi xa geresosee xa ra. Muxu gere soma Ala xa geresosee nan na naxee nɔma Sentanɛ sɛnbɛe kanade. Muxu maɲɔxunyi birin xun nakanama nɛ

sentences.english: Putting an end to reasonings, and every high thing which is lifted up against the knowledge of God, and causing every thought to come under the authority of Christ;
sentences.susu: naxan Ala xa fe kolonyi matandima yɛtɛ igboɲa kui. Maɲɔxunyi birin xa lu Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa yaamari bun ma.
