sentences.english: Being ready to give punishment to whatever is against his authority, after you have made it clear that you are completely under his control.
sentences.susu: Wo na wo xa batui rakamali, naxan na tondi na ra, muxu fama nɛ na kanyi ɲaxankatade.

sentences.english: Give attention to the things which are before you. If any man seems to himself to be Christ's, let him keep in mind that we are as much Christ's as he is.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na fe mato a fanyi ra. Xa mixi la a ra a findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan gbe ra, a xa a kolon muxu tan fan na na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: For though I might take pride in our authority (which the Lord gave for building you up, and not for your destruction), it will not be a cause of shame to me:
sentences.susu: N mu yaagima wɔyɛnyi xungbe falafe ra wo bɛ Marigi xa yaamari xa fe ra, a naxan fixi n ma alako n xa wo mali sɛnbɛ sɔtɔde. A mu n xɛɛxi wo xun nakanade xɛ.

sentences.english: That I may not seem to have the desire of causing you fear by my letters.
sentences.susu: N mu findixi mixi xa ra naxan nɔma wo magaaxude n ma sɛbɛli ra, alɔ wo a maɲɔxunxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For his letters, they say, have weight and are strong; but in body he is feeble, and his way of talking has little force.
sentences.susu: Ndee a falama, «A xa bataaxɛe sɛnbɛ gbo, e xɔrɔxɔ, kɔnɔ a gundi yati na fa, a sɛnbɛ mu gbo, a xa masenyi yusi yo mu na.»

sentences.english: Let those who say this keep in mind that, what we are in word by letters when we are away, so will we be in act when we are present.
sentences.susu: Na kanyie xa a kolon muxu naxan falama muxu xa bataaxɛe kui, muxu fama nɛ na birin nakamalide muxu fa tɛmui.

sentences.english: For we will not make comparison of ourselves with some of those who say good things about themselves: but these, measuring themselves by themselves, and making comparison of themselves with themselves, are not wise.
sentences.susu: Muxu mu suusama muxu yɛtɛ misaalide yɛtɛ igboe ra. Muxu mu wama muxu yɛtɛ maniyafe e ra. E na e yɛtɛ igbo e yɛtɛ xa maɲɔxunyi ra, e bara gɛ e xa lɔnnitareɲa masende.

sentences.english: We will not give glory to ourselves in over-great measure, but after the measure of the rule which God has given us, a measure which comes even to you.
sentences.susu: Muxu mu wama muxu yɛtɛ xa fe falafe han pon! Ala yaamari naxan fixi muxu ma mixie bɛ muxu naxee xaranma, muxu na nan falama wo bɛ.

sentences.english: For we have no need to make ourselves seem more than we are, as if our authority did not come as far as to you: for we came even as far as you with the good news of Christ:
sentences.susu: A mu luxi alɔ muxu mu siga wo yire. Muxu singe nan wo lixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa xibaaru fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Not taking credit to ourselves for what is not our business, that is, for the work of others; but having hope that, with the growth of your faith, we may get the credit for an increase which is the effect of our work,
sentences.susu: Muxu mu matɔxɔɛ fenma han a dangi a i mixi gbɛtɛe xa walie xa fe ra, fo wali naxan soxi muxu tan yi ra. Muxu wama naxan xɔn, wo xa danxaniya xun xa masa, muxu xa wali xa gbo wo ya ma.

sentences.english: So that we may be able to go on and take the good news to countries still farther away than you are, and not take credit for another man's work in making things ready to our hand.
sentences.susu: Na ki muxu nɔma nɛ Ala xa xibaaru fanyi masende yire gbɛtɛ naxee dangi wo ra. Muxu mu matɔxɔɛ fenma mixi gbɛtɛe xa wali fɔxie ra.

sentences.english: But whoever has a desire for glory, let his glory be in the Lord.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi wa a yɛtɛ matɔxɔfe, Marigi wali naxan nabaxi a xa duniɲɛigiri kui, a xa a yɛtɛ matɔxɔ Marigi xa fe nɛ i.

sentences.english: For the Lord's approval of a man is not dependent on his opinion of himself, but on the Lord's opinion of him.
sentences.susu: Barima yɛtɛ matɔxɔɛ xa mu rafan Marigi ma, fo Marigi yɛtɛ naxan matɔxɔma.

sentences.english: Put up with me if I am a little foolish: but, truly, you do put up with me.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo haakɛ to n bɛ, alɔ wo ɲan na a rabafe ki naxɛ, n xa n ma daxuɲa nde fala wo bɛ.

sentences.english: For I have a very great care for you: because you have been married by me to one husband, and it is my desire to give you completely holy to Christ.
sentences.susu: Wo rafan n ma Ala xa xanunteya ra, naxan mu wama a firin nde xɔn. N wo soxi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi gbansan nan yi ra, alɔ ginɛ naxan fixi xɛmɛ ma a dimɛdi.

sentences.english: But I have a fear, that in some way, as Eve was tricked by the deceit of the snake, your minds may be turned away from their simple and holy love for Christ.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n gaaxuxi nɛ mixi ndee fa wo madaxufe, e fa wo xaxili makuya Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fe ra, wo biraxi naxan fɔxɔ ra bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra. Na kui, wo luma nɛ alɔ Nɛɛnɛ Mahawa bɔximase naxan madaxu yunubi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For if anyone comes preaching another Jesus from the one whose preachers we are, or if you have got a different spirit, or a different sort of good news from those which came to you, how well you put up with these things.
sentences.susu: N a falama na fe nan ma, wo wo tuli matima mixi nan na, naxan Isa xa fe masenma wo bɛ ki gbɛtɛ, bafe muxu gbe ki ra. Wo man tinma xaxili gbɛtɛ suxude, bafe Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi ra wo naxan sɔtɔxi. Wo masenyi nde rabatuma naxan mu lanxi muxu xa masenyi ma, wo laxi naxan singe ra.

sentences.english: For in my opinion, I am in no way less than the most important of the Apostles.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n a kolon n mu xurun na mixie bɛ, naxee e yɛtɛ findixi wo bɛ xɛɛra fisamantee ra.

sentences.english: But though I am rough in my way of talking, I am not so in knowledge, as we have made clear to all by our acts among you.
sentences.susu: Hali n wɔyɛn ki mu tofan a gbe ra, kɔnɔ n xaxili tan gbo. Muxu bara na masen wo bɛ a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Or did I do wrong in making myself low so that you might be lifted up, because I gave you the good news of God without reward?
sentences.susu: N to n yɛtɛ magoro Ala xa xibaaru fanyi masenfe ra wo bɛ sare xanbi, alako wo tan xa fe xa mate, na findixi tantanyi nan na wo bɛ?

sentences.english: I took money from other churches as payment for my work, so that I might be your servant;
sentences.susu: N bara danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama gbɛtɛe makula, alako n xa nɔ walide wo bɛ sare xanbi. N mu n ma kɔntɔfili dɔxɔxi mixi yo xun ma wo ya ma.

sentences.english: And when I was present with you, and was in need, I let no man be responsible for me; for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, gave me whatever was needed; and in everything I kept myself from being a trouble to you, and I will go on doing so.
sentences.susu: Masedon danxaniyatɔɛe nan fa n malide n ma tɔɔrɛ kui. N na birin naba nɛ alako n naxa findi kote ra wo bɛ. Han ya na xaxili na n yi ra.

sentences.english: As the true word of Christ is in me, I will let no man take from me this my cause of pride in the country of Achaia.
sentences.susu: N xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xili ra, n walixi wo bɛ sare xanbi ki naxɛ, n man walima na ki nɛ Akayi bɔxi birin ma, barima na findixi xunnakeli nan na n bɛ.

sentences.english: Why? because I have no love for you? let God be judge.
sentences.susu: Munfe ra? N mu na rabaxi wo tan bɛ xanunteya xa ra? Ala a kolon.

sentences.english: But what I do, that I will go on doing, so that I may give no chance to those who are looking for one; so that, in the cause of their pride, they may be seen to be the same as we are.
sentences.susu: N naxan nabaxi, n man gbilenma nɛ na raba ra, alako mixi yo naxa nɔ e misaalide muxu ra. Ndee wama na binyɛ nan xɔn.

sentences.english: For such men are false Apostles, workers of deceit, making themselves seem like Apostles of Christ.
sentences.susu: Na mixie e yɛtɛ findixi wo bɛ xɛɛra fisamantee ra, kɔnɔ wule falɛe nan e ra, naxee mixi madaxuma, a falafe ra e tan nan findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa xɛɛrae ra.

sentences.english: And it is no wonder; for even Satan himself is able to take the form of an angel of light.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na mu findima dɛ ixarɛ ra, barima hali Sentanɛ a mixi madaxuma, a a yɛtɛ kan misaali malekɛ nɔrɔxi ra.

sentences.english: So it is no great thing if his servants make themselves seem to be servants of righteousness; whose end will be the reward of their works.
sentences.susu: Sentanɛ xa walikɛe fan birama na misaali nan fɔxɔ ra, e fa e yɛtɛ masen walikɛ tinxinxie ra. E fama nɛ e sare sɔtɔde.

sentences.english: I say again, Let me not seem foolish to anyone; but if I do, put up with me as such, so that I may take a little glory to myself.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo haakɛ to n bɛ, n fan xa n yɛtɛ matɔxɔ dondoronti, kɔnɔ wo naxa a maɲɔxun daxuɲa ra de! Hali wo a maɲɔxun daxui na n na, wo xa diɲɛ alako n xa n gbe fala wo bɛ.

sentences.english: What I am now saying is not by the order of the Lord, but as a foolish person, taking credit to myself, as it seems.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n mu wɔyɛnma Marigi waxɔnki ma. N wɔyɛnma daxui ki nan ma naxan wama a yɛtɛ matɔxɔfe.

sentences.english: Seeing that there are those who take credit to themselves after the flesh, I will do the same.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe to so yɛtɛ igboɲa kui adamadi ki ma, n fan xa n kan matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: For you put up with the foolish gladly, being wise yourselves.
sentences.susu: Wo tan xaxilimae, wo tinma xaxilitaree ra tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: You put up with a man if he makes servants of you, if he makes profit out of you, if he makes you prisoners, if he puts himself in a high place, if he gives you blows on the face.
sentences.susu: Wo tan tinma wo xa findi konyie ra, mixie xa wo rawali a ɲaaxi ra, e xa se birin ba wo yi ra, e xa e ya ragoro wo ma, e man xa wo dɛ ragarin.

sentences.english: I say this by way of shaming ourselves, as if we had been feeble. But if anyone puts himself forward (I am talking like a foolish person), I will do the same.
sentences.susu: N bara a fala wo bɛ yaagi ra, muxu tan mu na sɛnbɛ mɔɔli masenxi wo bɛ. Kɔnɔ e suusaxi e yɛtɛ kan matɔxɔɛ naxan na, fo n fan xa suusa na ra, hali a findi xaxilitareɲa ra n bɛ.

sentences.english: Are they Hebrews? so am I. Are they of Israel? so am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? so am I.
sentences.susu: Eburu mixie nan e ra? N tan fan findixi Eburu mixi nan na. Isirayilakae nan e ra? N tan fan findixi Isirayilaka nan na. Iburahima bɔnsɔɛ nan e ra? N tan fan Iburahima bɔnsɔɛ nan n na.

sentences.english: Are they servants of Christ? (I am talking foolishly) I am more so; I have had more experience of hard work, of prisons, of blows more than measure, of death.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa walikɛe nan e ra? Wo wo haakɛ to n bɛ de, n tan dangi e ra. N bara wali dangi e ra, n bara sa geeli dangife e ra, n bara bɔnbɔɛ sɔtɔ dangife e ra, n bara makɔrɛ faxɛ dɛ ra dangife e ra.

sentences.english: Five times the Jews gave me forty blows but one.
sentences.susu: Sanmaya suuli Yuwifie n bɔnbɔma sɛbɛrɛ ya tongo saxan nun solomanaani ra.

sentences.english: Three times I was whipped with rods, once I was stoned, three times the ship I was in came to destruction at sea, a night and a day I have been in the water;
sentences.susu: Sanmaya saxan e n bɔnbɔma gbengbeta ra. Sanmaya keren e bara n magɔnɔ gɛmɛe ra. Sanmaya saxan n ma kunkui dulama baa ma. Sanmaya keren n bara xi keren nun kɔɛ keren nadangi ye xɔɔra baa ma.

sentences.english: In frequent travels, in dangers on rivers, in dangers from outlaws, in dangers from my countrymen, in dangers from the Gentiles, in dangers in the town, in dangers in the waste land, in dangers at sea, in dangers among false brothers;
sentences.susu: N ma biyaasi wuyaxi kui, n bara tɔɔrɔ xure igirife ra, n bara tɔɔrɔ muɲɛtie xa fe ra, n yɛtɛ kan bɔnsɔɛ mixie bara n tɔɔrɔ, kaafirie fan nu bara n tɔɔrɔ. N bara tɔɔrɔ taae, gbengberenyi, nun baa ma. Danxaniyatɔɛ wule falɛe fan bara n tɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: In hard work and weariness, in frequent watchings, going without food and drink, cold and in need of clothing.
sentences.susu: N bara tɔɔrɔ wali xɔrɔxɔɛe xa fe ra. Sanmaya wuyaxi n mu xi, n mu baloe sɔtɔ, n mu ye min, n lu kaamɛ ra, n mu sose sɔtɔ ɲɛmɛ ra.

sentences.english: In addition to all the other things, there is that which comes on me every day, the care of all the churches.
sentences.susu: Naxan saxi na birin fari, lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ n kɔntɔfilima danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Who is feeble and I am not feeble? who is in danger of falling, and I am not angry?
sentences.susu: Sɛnbɛ na ba mixi nde, a bara ba n fan na. Danxaniyatɔɛ na yunubi fe raba, a n sondonyi tɔɔrɔma nɛ alɔ tɛ na sa a ma.

sentences.english: If I have to take credit to myself, I will do so in the things in which I am feeble.
sentences.susu: Iyo, xa a lanma n xa n yɛtɛ matɔxɔ fe nde ra, n nan n yɛtɛ matɔxɔma n ma sɛnbɛtareya nan na.

sentences.english: The God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, to whom be praise for ever, is witness that the things which I say are true.
sentences.susu: Ala, naxan findixi Marigi Isa baba ra, naxan matɔxɔma abadan, a a kolon n mu wule falama.

sentences.english: In Damascus, the ruler under Aretas the king kept watch over the town of the people of Damascus, in order to take me:
sentences.susu: Damasi gomina, naxan nu na Mangɛ Aretasi xa yaamari bun ma, a naxa taa naadɛe balan alako a xa n suxu,

sentences.english: And being let down in a basket from the wall through a window, I got free from his hands.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ danxaniyatɔɛe naxa n nagoro taa tɛtɛ wundɛri ra debe kui, n fa n ba a yi ra.

sentences.english: As it is necessary for me to take glory to myself, though it is not a good thing, I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.
sentences.susu: N lanma n xa nde sa na matɔxɔɛ fari? Na yusi mu na, kɔnɔ n man xa laamatunyie nun masenyie xa fe fala wo bɛ Marigi naxee fixi n ma.

sentences.english: I have knowledge of a man in Christ, fourteen years back (if he was in the body, or out of the body, I am not able to say, but God only), who was taken up to the third heaven.
sentences.susu: Isayanka nde nu na, naxan xanin koore walaxɛ saxan nde. Na ɲɛ fu nun naani nan yi ki. N mu a kolon xa a fate yati nan siga, xa na mu a xaxili gbansan. Ala a kolon.

sentences.english: And I have knowledge of such a man (if he was in the body, or out of the body, I am not able to say, but God only),
sentences.susu: Hali Ala gbansan nan to a kolon, xa a fate yati nan siga, xa na mu a ra a xaxili gbansan, n fe keren nan kolon,

sentences.english: How he was taken up into Paradise, and words came to his ears which may not be said, and which man is not able to say.
sentences.susu: na xɛmɛ xaninxi nɛ ariyanna. Mɛnni a naxa fee mɛ, naxee mu daxa adama xa e masen a boore bɛ.

sentences.english: On account of such a one I will have glory: for myself I will take no glory, but only in my feeble body.
sentences.susu: N bara na xɛmɛ matɔxɔ. N tan nan lanxi na xɛmɛ ma, kɔnɔ n mu wama n yɛtɛ matɔxɔfe. N nan n ma sɛnbɛtareya gbansan nan matɔxɔma.

sentences.english: For if I had a desire to take credit to myself, it would not be foolish, for I would be saying what is true: but I will not, for fear that I might seem to any man more than he sees me to be, or has word from me that I am.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa n bara wa n yɛtɛ matɔxɔfe, na mu findima xaxilitareɲa ra, barima n naxan birin falama a findixi nɔndi nan na. N mu na birin falama xɛ, alako mixie naxa n ma fe ite dangife e naxan toma a nun e naxan mɛma n xun ma.

sentences.english: And because the revelations were so very great, in order that I might not be overmuch lifted up, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, one sent from Satan to give me pain.
sentences.susu: Na laamatunyie to magaaxu, n naxa dundu. Ala naxa tɔɔrɛ nde dɔxɔ n ma, naxan fatanxi Sentanɛ xa malekɛ ra, alako n naxa n yɛtɛ igbo na laamatunyi magaaxuxie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And about this thing I made request to the Lord three times that it might be taken away from me.
sentences.susu: N naxa Ala maxandi sanmaya saxan a xa na tɔɔrɛ ba n ma,

sentences.english: And he said to me, My grace is enough for you, for my power is made complete in what is feeble. Most gladly, then, will I take pride in my feeble body, so that the power of Christ may be on me.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ a naxa a masen n bɛ, «N ma hinnɛ bara i rali. I n ma sɛnbɛ kamalixi kolonma i xa sɛnbɛtareya nan kui.» Na nan a toxi n nan n ma sɛnbɛtareya matɔxɔma, alako Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi sɛnbɛ xa lu n bɛ.

sentences.english: So I take pleasure in being feeble, in unkind words, in needs, in cruel attacks, in troubles, on account of Christ: for when I am feeble, then am I strong.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi sɛnbɛtareya rafanxi n ma. Hali na findi konbi ra, hali na findi fe xɔrɔxɔɛ ra, hali na findi ɲaxankatɛ nun tɔɔrɛ ra n bɛ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fe ra, na birin nafan n ma, barima n a kolon n sɛnbɛ sɔtɔma n ma sɛnbɛtareya nan kui.

sentences.english: I have been forced by you to become foolish, though it was right for my praise to have come from you: for in no way was I less than the chief of the Apostles, though I am nothing.
sentences.susu: Wo bara a niya n xa wɔyɛn alɔ daxui. A nu lanma nɛ wo tan yati xa fe fanyi fala n ma fe ra. Hali n ma fe to goroxi, n mu xurun na xɛɛra fisamantee ya i.

sentences.english: Truly the signs of an Apostle were done among you in quiet strength, with wonders and acts of power.
sentences.susu: N bara n ma xɛɛraya fɔxie masen wo bɛ, n to tɔnxumae, fe magaaxuxie, nun kaabanakoe raba wo tagi duluxɔtɔɛ xungbe kui.

sentences.english: For what is there in which you were made less than the other churches, but in the one thing that I was not a trouble to you? Let me have forgiveness for this wrong.
sentences.susu: Fe keren gbansan nan na, n mu naxan nabaxi wo ra alɔ n a raba danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama gbɛtɛe ra ki naxɛ. N mu tin findide kote ra wo tan bɛ. Xa na mu rafan wo ma, wo xa diɲɛ.

sentences.english: This is now the third time that I am ready to come to you; and I will not be a trouble to you: my desire is for you, not for your property: for it is not the children's business to make store for their fathers, but the fathers for the children.
sentences.susu: N rɛdixi n ma biyaasi saxan nde rabafe ra wo xɔnyi. N mu findima kote ra wo bɛ de, barima n mu wama wo harige xɔn ma. N wama wo tan yati nan xɔn ma. A mu lanma die xa fɛɛrɛ fen e barimixie bɛ. A lanma barimixie nan xa fɛɛrɛ fen e xa die bɛ.

sentences.english: And I will gladly give all I have for your souls. If I have the more love for you, am I to be loved the less?
sentences.susu: N tan bara tin fɛɛrɛ fende wo bɛ. N bara tin n yɛtɛ fide wo bɛ. N to wo xanuxi a gbe ra, wo tan nde bama na xanunteya nan na n tan bɛ?

sentences.english: But let it be so, that I was not a trouble to you myself; but (someone may say) being false, I took you with deceit.
sentences.susu: Awa yire, kɔnɔ n mu findixi kote ra wo bɛ. Nde a falama a kɔɔta mixi nan n na, a n bara wo masɔtɔ kɔɔta wali ra.

sentences.english: Did I make a profit out of you by any of those whom I sent to you?
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n xa wo maxɔrin, n bara wo rawali n ma xɛɛrae saabui ra?

sentences.english: I gave orders to Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus make any profit out of you? were we not guided by the same Spirit, in the same ways?
sentences.susu: N naxa Tito mayandi a xa siga wo yire. N man naxa n ngaxakerenyi gbɛtɛ xɛɛ naxan a matima. Tito wo rawali nɛ? N nun Tito mu ɲɛrɛ xaxili keren xa fari? A mu n tan xa fɔxi raba?

sentences.english: It may seem to you that all this time we have been attempting to put ourselves in the right; but we are saying these things before God in Christ. For all things, dear brothers, are for your profit.
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie, kabi tɛmui xɔnnakuye wo ɲɔxɔ a ma muxu na muxu yɛtɛ nan xunmafalafe, kɔnɔ muxu na Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa masenyi nan tife wo bɛ Ala ya xɔri alako wo xa danxaniya xa sabati.

sentences.english: For I have a fear that, when I come, you may not be answering to my desire, and that I may not be answering to yours; that there may be fighting, hate, angry feeling, divisions, evil talk about others, secrets, thoughts of pride, outbursts against authority;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n bara gaaxu n wo ɲɛrɛ ki nde life naa naxan mu rafan n ma. Tɛmunde n fan ɲɛrɛ ki mu fama rafande wo ma. N bara gaaxu n na siga wo xɔnyi n yi fee nan lima naa: lantareya, tɔɔnɛ, xɔnnanteya, boore matandi, wɔyɛn ɲaaxi, naafixiya, yɛtɛ igboɲa, nun ɲaxasi.

sentences.english: And that when I come again, my God may put me to shame among you, and I may have grief for those who have done wrong before and have had no regret for their unclean ways, and for the evil desires of the flesh to which they have given way.
sentences.susu: Yi biyaasi n bara gaaxu Ala fama nɛ n ma fe ragorode wo saabui ra, n fa nimisa wo xa yunubie xa fe ra, mixi ndee mu gbilen naxee fɔxɔ ra, alɔ sɛniyɛntareɲa, yɛnɛ, nun langoeɲa.

sentences.english: This is the third time that I am coming to you. From the mouth of two or three witnesses will every word be made certain.
sentences.susu: N ma biyaasi saxan nde nan yi ki wo xɔnyi. «Fe birin makiitima seede firin, xa na mu, seede saxan nan xui ma.»

sentences.english: I said before, and still say it before I come, as being present for the second time, though I am still away from you, to those who have done wrong before, and to all the others, that if I come again I will not have pity;
sentences.susu: N to n ma biyaasi firin nde raba wo xɔnyi, n naxa a fala wo bɛ, «N na fa, n mu diɲɛma mixi yo ma.» Yakɔsi, hali n na yire makuye, n man bara gbilen na wɔyɛnyi ma mixie bɛ, naxee nu bara yunubi raba, a nun mixi gbɛtɛe.

sentences.english: Seeing that you are looking for a sign of Christ giving out his word in me; who is not feeble in relation to you, but is strong in you:
sentences.susu: Wo wama a kolonfe xa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi na wɔyɛnfe n saabui nan na. Wo fama na kolonde, barima a sɛnbɛ mu xurun wo bɛ. A sɛnbɛ gbo wo ya ma.

sentences.english: For he was feeble in that he was put to death on the cross, but he is living by the power of God. And we are feeble in him, but we will be living with him through the power of God in relation to you.
sentences.susu: Mixie naxa a mabanban wuri magalanbuxi ma a xa sɛnbɛtareya kui, kɔnɔ Ala naxa a rakeli faxɛ ma sɛnbɛ ra. Muxu tan fan, muxu sɛnbɛ mu gbo, kɔnɔ muxu fama nɛ lude a sɛɛti ma wo malife ra Ala sɛnbɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: Make a test of yourselves, if you are in the faith; make certain of yourselves. Or are you not conscious in yourselves that Jesus Christ is in you, if you are truly Christ's?
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo yɛtɛ mato a kolonfe ra xa wo danxaniyaxi. Wo xa na mato a fanyi ra. Wo mu a kolon Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa na wo bɔɲɛ i? Kɔnɔ xa wo bara a to wo mu danxaniyaxi, Isa mu na wo bɔɲɛ i de!

sentences.english: But it is my hope that you will have no doubt that we are truly Christ's.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon muxu tan danxaniyaxi.

sentences.english: Now our prayer to God is that you may do no evil; not in order that it may be put to our credit, but so that you may do what is right, whatever we may seem.
sentences.susu: Muxu Ala maxandima wo bɛ alako wo naxa fe ɲaaxi yo raba. Muxu mu wama wo xa lu tinxinyi kui alako muxu xa xili fanyi sɔtɔ. Muxu wama na nan xɔn wo tan bɛ, alako wo xa lu kira fanyi xɔn, hali mixi nde kiiti ɲaaxi dɔxɔma muxu ma.

sentences.english: Because we are able to do nothing against what is true, but only for it.
sentences.susu: Muxu tan mu nɔma nɔndi matandide, fo muxu xa bira a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: For we are glad when we are feeble and you are strong: and this is our prayer, even that you may be made complete.
sentences.susu: Xa muxu sɛnbɛ xurun, kɔnɔ wo gbe naxa gbo, muxu bara ɲɛlɛxin. Muxu Ala maxandima nɛ alako wo xa danxaniya xa kamali.

sentences.english: For this cause I am writing these things while I am away, so that there may be need for me, when I am present, to make use of sharp measures, by the authority which the Lord has given me for building up and not for destruction.
sentences.susu: N na bataaxɛ sɛbɛfe wo ma yire makuye barima n mu wama fe xɔrɔxɔɛ falafe wo bɛ wo ya xɔri. Marigi bara n xɛɛ a xili ra alako n xa wo mali, wo xun nakanafe mu na naxan na.

sentences.english: Let this be my last word, brothers; be glad; be complete; be comforted; be of the same mind; be at peace with one another: and the God of love and peace will be with you.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, a dɔnxɔɛ ra, Ala, xanunteya nun bɔɲɛsa kanyi xa lu wo sɛɛti ma, wo xa sɛɛwa, wo xa kamali, wo xa wo bore ralimaniya, wo xa lan wo bore ma, wo xa lu bɔɲɛsa kui.

sentences.english: Give one another a holy kiss.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo bore xɛɛbu sunbui sɛniyɛnxi ra. Sɛniyɛntɔɛ birin bara wo xɛɛbu.

sentences.english: All the saints send their love to you.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Marigi Isa xa hinnɛ wo ra, Ala xa wo xanu, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa lu wo bɔɲɛ i.

sentences.english: Paul, an Apostle (not from men, and not through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who made him come back from the dead),
sentences.susu: N tan Pɔlu nun n ngaxakerenyie, muxu bara danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae xɛɛbu naxee na Galati bɔxi ma. Mixi yo mu n xɛɛxi. Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa nun Baba Ala naxan a rakelixi faxɛ ma, e tan nan n xɛɛxi.

sentences.english: And all the brothers who are with me, to the churches of Galatia:
sentences.susu: <range>

sentences.english: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,
sentences.susu: Won Baba Ala nun won Marigi Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, e xa hinnɛ nun bɔɲɛsa fi wo ma.

sentences.english: Who gave himself for our sins, so that he might make us free from this present evil world, after the purpose of our God and Father:
sentences.susu: Isa a yɛtɛ baxi sɛrɛxɛ ra won ma yunubie xafarife nan na, a xa won natanga yi waxati ɲaaxi ma, alɔ won Baba Ala wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: To whom be the glory for ever and ever. So be it.
sentences.susu: Tantui na Ala bɛ abadan. Amina.

sentences.english: I am surprised that you are being so quickly turned away from him whose word came to you in the grace of Christ, to good news of a different sort;
sentences.susu: N dɛ bara ixara wo to gbilenfe wo xilima fɔxɔ ra yi ikɔrɛxi ra, naxan bara wo xili a xa Mixi Sugandixi xa hinnɛ saabui ra. Wo na birafe masenyi gbɛtɛ nan fɔxɔ ra,

sentences.english: Which is not another sort: only there are some who give you trouble, desiring to make changes in the good news of Christ.
sentences.susu: naxan mu findixi masenyi fanyi ra. Mixi ndee wama wo xaxili ifufe, e xa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa xibaaru fanyi mafindi.

sentences.english: But even if we, or an angel from heaven, were to be a preacher to you of good news other than that which we have given you, let there be a curse on him.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa a sa li muxu tan, xa na mu a ra Ala xa malekɛ nde naxa masenyi ti wo bɛ, naxan mu lanxi na masenyi fanyi ma naxan masenxi wo bɛ a singe ra, dankari na na kanyi bɛ.

sentences.english: As we have said before, so say I now again, If any man is a preacher to you of any good news other than that which has been given to you, let there be a curse on him.
sentences.susu: N xa gbilen na ma a firin nde. Xa mixi yo fa masenyi nde tide wo bɛ, naxan mu lanxi na masenyi fanyi ma naxan masenxi wo bɛ a singe ra, dankari na na kanyi bɛ.

sentences.english: Am I now using arguments to men, or God? or is it my desire to give men pleasure? if I was still pleasing men, I would not be a servant of Christ.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n na nde sago rabafe, ibunadama ba ka Ala? Wo ɲɔxɔ a ma a n wama adamadi sago nan nabafe? Xa na na a ra nu, n mu findima Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa konyi ra.

sentences.english: Because I say to you, my brothers, that the good news of which I was the preacher is not man's.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, n xa a fala wo bɛ a n xibaaru fanyi naxan ibama a mu fatanxi adama xaxili xa ra.

sentences.english: For I did not get it from man, and I was not given teaching in it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: N mu a sɔtɔ mixi xa ra. Mixi yo mu n xaranxi a ra. Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa yati nan a masenxi n bɛ.

sentences.english: For news has come to you of my way of life in the past in the Jews' religion, how I was cruel without measure to the church of God, and did great damage to it:
sentences.susu: Wo bara a mɛ a singe n nu biraxi Yuwifie xa diinɛ fɔxɔ ra sɛnbɛ ra ki naxɛ. N nu Ala xa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae ɲaxankatama nɛ a ɲaaxi ra alako n xa e sɔntɔ.

sentences.english: And I went farther in the Jews' religion than a number of my generation among my countrymen, having a more burning interest in the beliefs handed down from my fathers.
sentences.susu: N xaranyi naxan nabaxi Yuwifie xa diinɛ kui, a dangi n booree xa xaranyi ra. N nu birama n benbae xa naamunyie fɔxɔ ra sɛnbɛ nan na.

sentences.english: But when it was the good pleasure of God, by whom I was marked out even from my mother's body, through his grace,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala nu bara n sugandi kafi n bari tɛmui. A naxa n xili a xa hinnɛ ra,

sentences.english: To give the revelation of his Son in me, so that I might give the news of him to the Gentiles; then I did not take the opinion of flesh and blood,
sentences.susu: a fa a xa Di masen n bɛ, alako n xa a xa fe kawandi ti si gbɛtɛe tagi. A to n xili na ma, n mu marasi fen mixi yo ra,

sentences.english: And I went not up to Jerusalem to those who were Apostles before me; but I went away into Arabia, and again I came back to Damascus.
sentences.susu: n mu siga Darisalamu mixie yire naxee singe findi Isa xa xɛɛrae ra n tan bɛ. N naxa siga keren na Arabu bɔxi ma. Na dangi xanbi n naxa gbilen Damasi taa kui.

sentences.english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to see Cephas, and was there with him fifteen days.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ saxan to dangi, n naxa siga Darisalamu, alako n xa Piyɛri kolon. N naxa lu a xɔnyi xi fu nun suuli.

sentences.english: But of the other Apostles I saw only James, the Lord's brother.
sentences.susu: N mu Isa xa xɛɛra gbɛtɛ to na tɛmui, fo Isa xunya Yaki.

sentences.english: Now God is witness that the things which I am writing to you are true.
sentences.susu: N xa a fala wo bɛ Ala ya xɔri, n naxan sɛbɛfe wo ma, wule yo mu na a kui.

sentences.english: Then I came to the parts of Syria and Cilicia.
sentences.susu: Na ɲɛrɛ dangi xanbi, n naxa siga Siriya nun Silisi bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: And the churches of Judaea which were in Christ still had no knowledge of my face or person:
sentences.susu: Isayanka ɲamae naxee nu na Yudaya, nee mu nu n kolonxi na tɛmui,

sentences.english: Only it came to their ears that he who at one time was cruel to us is now preaching the faith which before had been attacked by him;
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ e nu bara a mɛ a mixi naxan nu e tɔɔrɔma, a a bara findi danxaniya kawandila ra. «Singe a nu wama na danxaniya xun nakanafe, kɔnɔ yakɔsi a na a kawandife.»

sentences.english: And they gave glory to God in me.
sentences.susu: Na kui, e naxa Ala matɔxɔ n ma fe ra.

sentences.english: Then after the space of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus with me.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛ fu nun naani to dangi kelife na biyaasi singe ma, n man naxa gbilen Darisalamu. Baranabasi nun Tito nu na n fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And I went up by revelation; and I put before them the good news which I was preaching among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were of good name, so that the work which I was or had been doing might not be without effect.
sentences.susu: Ala nu bara a masen n bɛ n xa siga naa alako n xa dɛntɛgɛ sa e bɛ n xibaaru fanyi naxan ibama si gbɛtɛe tagi. N mu na dɛntɛgɛ sa e birin xa bɛ, fo danxaniyatɔɛ kuntigie, barima n mu nu wama n ma wali xun xa rakana.

sentences.english: But not even Titus who was with me, being a Greek, was made to undergo circumcision:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ hali Tito Girɛkika naxan nu na n fɔxɔ ra, e mu a karaxan a xa sunna.

sentences.english: And that because of the false brothers let in secretly, who came searching out our free condition which we have in Christ Jesus, so that they might make servants of us;
sentences.susu: Mixi sunnafe nu bara findi ɲɔxɔnsɔsɔɛ ra muxu tagi, barima mixi nde naxee mu findixi danxaniyatɔɛe ra, nee naxa so muxu ya ma gundo kui. E nu wama won ma xɔrɛya nan nabɛnfe, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa naxan fixi won ma, alako won man xa gbilen konyiya kui.

sentences.english: To whom we gave way not even for an hour; so that the true words of the good news might still be with you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ muxu mu tin na xaxili ra fefe ma, alako wo naxa ba Isa xa nɔndi kira xɔn ma.

sentences.english: But from those who seemed to be important (whatever they were has no weight with me: God does not take man's person into account): those who seemed to be important gave nothing new to me;
sentences.susu: N mu n xaxili tixi mixie ra ɲama biraxi naxee fɔxɔ ra, barima Ala mu mixi yo rafisama a boore bɛ. E tan mu sese sa n ma masenyi fari.

sentences.english: But, quite the opposite, when they saw that I had been made responsible for preaching the good news to those without circumcision, even as Peter had been for those of the circumcision
sentences.susu: E naxa a to Ala nan na xɛɛraya taxuxi n na, n xa Isa xa xibaaru fanyi iba si gbɛtɛe bɛ, alɔ Piyɛri a rabama Yuwifie bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: (Because he who was working in Peter as the Apostle of the circumcision was working no less in me among the Gentiles);
sentences.susu: Ala naxan Piyɛri xɛɛ a xa wali rabade Yuwifie tagi, a tan nan n fan xɛɛ a xa wali rabade si gbɛtɛe tagi.

sentences.english: When they saw the grace which was given to me, James and Cephas and John, who had the name of being pillars, gave to me and Barnabas their right hands as friends so that we might go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision;
sentences.susu: Yaki, Piyɛri, nun Yaya naxee findixi kuntigi xungbee ra danxaniyatɔɛe tagi, e naxa n nun Baranabasi rasɛnɛ a ngaxakeren ki ma e to a kolon Ala hinnɛxi n na ki naxɛ. E naxa lan a ma a muxu xa xɛɛraya raba si gbɛtɛe tagi, e tan fan xa a raba Yuwifie tagi.

sentences.english: Only it was their desire that we would give thought to the poor; which very thing I had much in mind to do.
sentences.susu: E man naxa muxu mayandi muxu xa setaree mali muxu xa wali kui. Fe nan na ki n nu wama naxan nabafe a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: But when Cephas came to Antioch, I made a protest against him to his face, because he was clearly in the wrong.
sentences.susu: Piyɛri to fa Antiyɔki, n naxa a matandi, barima a nu bara tantan.

sentences.english: For before certain men came from James, he did take food with the Gentiles: but when they came, he went back and made himself separate, fearing those who were of the circumcision.
sentences.susu: Beenun Yaki xa mixi ndee xa siga a yire, a nu a dɛgema a nun si gbɛtɛe. Kɔnɔ e to a xɔnyi li, a naxa gbilen mixie fɔxɔ ra naxee findixi si gbɛtɛe ra. A nu bara gaaxu Yaki xa mixie ya ra, barima e nu laxi a ra a danxaniyatɔɛe lanxi nɛ e xa sunna.

sentences.english: And the rest of the Jews went after him, so that even Barnabas was overcome by their false ways.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi gbɛtɛe naxa bira a xa filankafuiɲa fɔxɔ ra, han e naxa Baranabasi fan natantan.

sentences.english: But when I saw that they were not living uprightly in agreement with the true words of the good news, I said to Cephas before them all, If you, being a Jew, are living like the Gentiles, and not like the Jews, how will you make the Gentiles do the same as the Jews?
sentences.susu: N to e xa tinxintareya to, naxan mu lanxi Ala xa nɔndi ma, n naxa a fala Piyɛri bɛ e birin ya xɔri, «Hali i to findixi Yuwifi ra, i na ɲɛrɛfe si gbɛtɛe xa naamunyi ki nan ma, naxan mu findi Yuwifi xa naamunyi ra. Munfe ra i a falama si gbɛtɛe bɛ e xa ɲɛrɛ Yuwifie ɲɛrɛ ki ma?»

sentences.english: We being Jews by birth, and not sinners of the Gentiles,
sentences.susu: Won tan naxee barixi Yuwifiya kui, naxee mu findixi yunubitɔɛe ra si gbɛtɛe tagi,

sentences.english: Being conscious that a man does not get righteousness by the works of the law, but through faith in Jesus Christ, we had faith in Christ Jesus, so that we might get righteousness by faith in Christ, and not by the works of the law: because by the works of the law will no flesh get righteousness.
sentences.susu: won a kolon mixi yo mu nɔma Ala xa sɛriyɛ birin nabatude, a fa lu a mu tantan na xa a findi tinxintɔɛ ra. A findima tinxintɔɛ ra a to danxaniyaxi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa ma. Na kui, won bara danxaniya Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa ma, alako won xa tinxin na danxaniya saabui ra. Won mu nɔma Ala xa sɛriyɛ birin natinmɛde, han won xa findi tinxintɔɛe ra. Mixi yo mu nɔma Ala xa sɛriyɛ birin natinmɛde, han a fa findi tinxintɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: But if, while we were desiring to get righteousness through Christ, we ourselves were seen to be sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? In no way!
sentences.susu: Xa won na tinxinyi fenfe Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi saabui ra, won fa yunubi nde raba, na a masenma yunubi rafan Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ma? Astɔfulahi.

sentences.english: For if I put up again those things which I gave to destruction, I am seen to be a wrongdoer.
sentences.susu: N mu lama a ra sɔnɔn n nɔma Ala xa yaamari birin natinmɛde, han n xa findi tinxintɔɛ ra. Xa a sa li n bara gbilen na xaxili ma, na mu findi Ala xa sɛriyɛ ra.

sentences.english: For I, through the law, have become dead to the law, so that I might be living to God.
sentences.susu: N to a to n mu nɔma Ala xa sɛriyɛ birin natinmɛde, n naxa na xaxili lu na, alako n ma ɲɛrɛ ki fanyi xa findi tantui ra Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: I have been put to death on the cross with Christ; still I am living; no longer I, but Christ is living in me; and that life which I now am living in the flesh I am living by faith, the faith of the Son of God, who in love for me, gave himself up for me.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi faxa ki naxɛ wuri magalanbuxi ma, n waxɔnfe fan bara faxa na ki. Yakɔsi n mu birama n waxɔnfe fɔxɔ ra. Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan n ma duniɲɛigiri raɲɛrɛma. N n ma duniɲɛigiri raɲɛrɛma danxaniya nan saabui ra. N bara danxaniya Ala xa Di ma naxan a yɛtɛ baxi sɛrɛxɛ ra n bɛ a xa xanunteya xa fe ra.

sentences.english: I do not make the grace of God of no effect: because if righteousness is through the law, then Christ was put to death for nothing.
sentences.susu: N mu tinma Ala xa hinnɛ rabolode. Xa a sa li n nɔma Ala xa yaamarie ratinmɛde han n xa findi tinxintɔɛ ra, a lima Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa faxɛ tide yo mu na won ma kisi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: O foolish Galatians, by what strange powers have you been tricked, to whom it was made clear that Jesus Christ was put to death on the cross?
sentences.susu: Wo tan Galatika xaxilitaree, nde wo madaxuxi? A masenxi nɛ wo bɛ a fiixɛ ra a Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi banban nɛ wuri magalanbuxi ma.

sentences.english: Give me an answer to this one question, Did the Spirit come to you through the works of the law, or by the hearing of faith?
sentences.susu: Wo a fala n bɛ munse a niyaxi wo xa Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi sɔtɔ. Wo a sɔtɔxi Ala xa sɛriyɛ ratinmɛfe nan saabui ra, ka wo a sɔtɔxi nɛ barima wo danxaniyaxi Ala xa masenyi ma wo naxan mɛxi?

sentences.english: Are you so foolish? having made a start in the Spirit, will you now be made complete in the flesh?
sentences.susu: Wo xaxili mu na? Singe wo xaxili nu tixi Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nan na, kɔnɔ yakɔsi wo laxi wo yɛtɛ kan sɛnbɛ nan na. Munfe ra?

sentences.english: Did you undergo such a number of things to no purpose? if it is in fact to no purpose.
sentences.susu: Wo bara tɔɔrɔ Ala Xaxili sɔtɔfe ra, yakɔsi munfe ra wo wama na bɛɲinfe? Na bara findi fe fufafu ra wo bɛ?

sentences.english: He who gives you the Spirit, and does works of power among you, is it by the works of law, or by the hearing of faith?
sentences.susu: Ala a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi fima wo ma, a man kaabanakoe rabama wo tagi. A wo kima nɛ, barima wo bara a xa sɛriyɛe rabatu, ka a wo kima nɛ barima wo bara danxaniya Ala xa masenyi ma wo naxan mɛxi?

sentences.english: Even as Abraham had faith in God, and it was put to his account as righteousness.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Iburahima xa fe mato. A to danxaniya Ala ma, a naxa tinxinyi sɔtɔ Ala mabiri.

sentences.english: Be certain, then, that those who are of faith, the same are sons of Abraham.
sentences.susu: Na nan na ki, mixi naxan danxaniya Ala ma, na bara findi Iburahima xa di ra.

sentences.english: And the holy Writings, seeing before the event that God would give the Gentiles righteousness by faith, gave the good news before to Abraham, saying, In you will all the nations have a blessing.
sentences.susu: Kitaabui na nan yati fala beenun a xa raba, a falafe ra Ala fama si gbɛtɛe ratinxinde e xa danxaniya saabui ra. A naxa na masenyi fanyi masen singe nu, a to a fala Iburahima bɛ, «Si birin fama nɛ duba sɔtɔde i tan saabui ra.»

sentences.english: So then those who are of faith have a part in the blessing of Abraham who was full of faith.
sentences.susu: Na kui, danxaniyatɔɛ birin duba sɔtɔma nɛ alɔ Iburahima danxaniyatɔɛ.

sentences.english: For all who are of the works of the law are under a curse: because it is said in the Writings, A curse is on everyone who does not keep on doing all the things which are ordered in the book of the law.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan katama Ala xa yaamarie ratinmɛde alako a xa kisi sɔtɔ, na findixi mixi dankaxi nan na, barima a sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, «Mixi naxan mu yaamari birin nabama, naxee sɛbɛxi Ala xa sɛriyɛ Kitaabui kui, a dankaxi.»

sentences.english: Now that no man gets righteousness by the law in the eyes of God, is clear; because, The upright will be living by faith.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu nɔma Ala xa yaamarie birin nabatude, na xa a findi tinxintɔɛ ra. A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, «Tinxintɔɛ kisima a xa danxaniya nan saabui ra.»

sentences.english: And the law is not of faith; but, He who does them will have life by them.
sentences.susu: A man sɛbɛxi, «Mixi naxan Ala xa yaamarie birin nabatuma, a kisima nee nan saabui ra.» Xaxili firin nan a ra. Naxan a xaxili tima danxaniya ra, a mu nɔma a xaxili tide yaamarie ratinmɛfe ra.

sentences.english: Christ has made us free from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us: because it is said in the Writings, A curse on everyone who is put to death by hanging on a tree:
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi bara won xunsara dankɛ ma, won naxan sɔtɔ barima won mu a xa yaamari birin natinmɛxi. A won xunsara nɛ, a to won ma dankɛ tongo a xa kote ra. A findi mixi dankaxi ra a faxa ki nan ma, barima a sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, «Dankɛ na mixi bɛ naxan gbakuma wuri ma.»

sentences.english: So that on the Gentiles might come the blessing of Abraham in Christ Jesus; in order that we through faith might have the Spirit which God had undertaken to give.
sentences.susu: A bara won xunsara alako Ala hɛɛri naxan fixi Iburahima ma, a xa dangi si gbɛtɛe ma Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa saabui ra. Na kui, won ma danxaniya saabui ra, won nɔma Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi sɔtɔde naxan laayidixi won bɛ.

sentences.english: Brothers, as men would say, even a man's agreement, when it has been made certain, may not be put on one side, or have additions made to it.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, n xa misaali nde masen wo bɛ. Mixi mu nɔma saatɛ masarade, xa na mu a ra a kanade, saatɛ naxan tongoxi ibunadama xa sɛriyɛ ki ma. Annabi Iburahima xa saatɛ luma na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Now to Abraham were the undertakings given, and to his seed. He says not, And to seeds, as of a great number; but as of one, he says, And to your seed, which is Christ.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa laayidi ndee tongo Iburahima nun a xa di bɛ. Kitaabui mu a falama «die,» wɔyɛnyi naxan wama a falafe «mixi wuyaxi.» Kitaabui a falama «a nun a xa di.» Wɔyɛnyi na a ra naxan wama a falafe «mixi keren.» Na mixi keren findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan na.

sentences.english: Now this I say: The law, which came four hundred and thirty years after, does not put an end to the agreement made before by God, so as to make the undertaking without effect.
sentences.susu: N wama naxan falafe wo bɛ, a Ala xa sɛriyɛ, naxan sɛbɛxi ɲɛ kɛmɛ naani ɲɛ tongo saxan dangi xanbi Ala xa saatɛtongoe Iburahima bɛ, na sɛriyɛ mu nɔma na laayidi singe kanade.

sentences.english: Because if the heritage is by the law, it is no longer dependent on the word of God; but God gave it to Abraham by his word.
sentences.susu: Xa won kisi sɔtɔma kɛ ra, barima won Ala xa yaamarie ratinmɛma, won mu a sɔtɔma sɔnɔn Ala xa laayidi saabui ra. Ala a fi Iburahima ma laayidi nan na a yɛtɛ xa hinnɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: What then is the law? It was an addition made because of sin, till the coming of the seed to whom the undertaking had been given; and it was ordered through angels by the hand of a go-between.
sentences.susu: Xa na nan a ra, munfe ra Ala a niya a xa yaamarie xa sɛbɛ Kitaabui kui? A a xa yaamarie sɛbɛ nɛ yunubie xa fe ra, beenun a xa Di laayidixi xa fa. Malekɛe naxa fa na sɛriyɛ ra, e na so saabui nde yi ra.

sentences.english: Now a go-between is not a go-between of one; but God is one.
sentences.susu: Saabui tan luma mixi firin nan tagi, kɔnɔ Ala tan, keren nan a ra.

sentences.english: Is the law then against the words of God? in no way; because if there had been a law which was able to give life, truly righteousness would have been by the law.
sentences.susu: Ala xa sɛriyɛ nun Ala xa laayidie e boore matandima? Ade de! Xa won nu nɔma kisi sɔtɔde Ala xa yaamarie rabatui nan na nu, na nu nɔma nɛ won findide tinxintɔɛe ra.

sentences.english: However, the holy Writings have put all things under sin, so that that for which God gave the undertaking, based on faith in Jesus Christ, might be given to those who have such faith.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala xa Kitaabui a masenxi nɛ won bɛ a duniɲa mixi birin Ala xa yaamarie matandima, e findi yunubitɔɛe ra. Na kui, Ala naxan laayidixi mixie bɛ, naxee lama a ra, e fa danxaniya Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa ma, e nɔma na sɔtɔde.

sentences.english: But before faith came, we were kept in prison under the law, waiting for the revelation of the faith which was to come.
sentences.susu: Beenun mixi xa nɔ kisi sɔtɔde danxaniya saabui ra, won nu na katafe Ala xa yaamarie ratinmɛde, alako won xa kisi, kɔnɔ won mu nɔ.

sentences.english: So the law has been a servant to take us to Christ, so that we might have righteousness by faith.
sentences.susu: Na kui, sɛriyɛ bara won xuru han beenun Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fa alako won xa tinxinyi sɔtɔ danxaniya saabui ra.

sentences.english: But now that faith is come, we are no longer under a servant.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ danxaniya to bara fa, won mu na sɛriyɛ xa xurui bun ma sɔnɔn,

sentences.english: Because you are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
sentences.susu: barima wo birin bara findi Ala xa die ra, wo to danxaniyaxi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa ma.

sentences.english: For all those of you who were given baptism into Christ did put on Christ.
sentences.susu: Wo tan naxee bara wo xunxa ye xɔɔra Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xili ra, wo nun Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan fa a ra.

sentences.english: There is no Jew or Greek, servant or free, male or female: because you are all one in Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Yuwifi nun Girɛki, konyi nun xɔrɛ, xɛmɛ nun ginɛ, wo birin keren Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa i.

sentences.english: And if you are Christ's, then you are Abraham's seed, and yours is the heritage by the right of God's undertaking given to Abraham.
sentences.susu: Xa wo bara findi Isa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi gbe ra, wo bara findi Iburahima xa die nun kɛtongoe ra alɔ Ala a laayidixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But I say that as long as the son is a child, he is in no way different from a servant, though he is lord of all;
sentences.susu: N wama naxan falafe, kɛ tongoma, a dimɛdi tɛmui, hali a baba kɛ to findixi a gbe ra, a luxi alɔ konyi naxan mu gɛxi a yɛtɛ sɔtɔde.

sentences.english: But is under keepers and managers till the time fixed by the father.
sentences.susu: A luma yatigie nun karamɔxɔe xa yaamari nan bun ma, han a baba na tin tɛmui naxɛ a xa a yɛtɛ sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: So we, when we were young, were kept under the first rules of the world;
sentences.susu: Won tan fan to mu nu Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa kolon, won nu luxi nɛ alɔ dimɛdie. Won nu na duniɲa fe kobie xa konyiya nan bun ma.

sentences.english: But when the time had come, God sent out his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,
sentences.susu: Waxati to kamali, Ala naxa a xa Di xɛɛ duniɲa ma ginɛ nde saabui ra. A naxa bari Ala xa sɛriyɛ bun ma,

sentences.english: That he might make them free who were under the law, and that we might be given the place of sons.
sentences.susu: alako a xa mixie xunsara naxee nu na Ala xa sɛriyɛ xa kiiti bun ma. A naxa won xunsara alako won xa findi Ala xa die ra.

sentences.english: And because you are sons, God has sent out the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, saying, Abba, Father.
sentences.susu: Wo to findi a xa die ra, Ala naxa a xa Di Xaxili raso wo bɔɲɛ i, xaxili naxan xili tima, «n Ba.»

sentences.english: So that you are no longer a servant, but a son; and if a son, then the heritage of God is yours.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra wo bara mini konyiya kui, wo bara findi Ala xa die ra. Wo to findixi a xa die ra, Ala man bara wo findi a kɛtongoe ra.

sentences.english: But at that time, having no knowledge of God, you were servants to those who by right are no gods:
sentences.susu: Singe wo mu nu Ala kolon. Duniɲa fe kobie nan nu findixi wo marigi ra, a fa li nee nun Ala tagi ikuya.

sentences.english: But now that you have come to have knowledge of God, or more truly, God has knowledge of you, how is it that you go back again to the poor and feeble first things, desiring to be servants to them again?
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi wo bara Ala kolon. Ala bara wo fan kolon. Munse fa a niyaxi sɔnɔn wo man gbilenma na duniɲa fee ma naxee sɛnbɛ nun tide mu gbo? Wo man wama lufe e xa konyiya bun ma?

sentences.english: You keep days, and months, and fixed times, and years.
sentences.susu: Wo man bara bira yaamarie fɔxɔ ra, naxee a falama lɔxɔɛ ndee nun kike ndee tide gbo e boore bɛ. Wo waxati ndee nun ɲɛ ndee rafisa e boore bɛ.

sentences.english: I am in fear of you, that I may have been working for you to no purpose.
sentences.susu: N gaaxu nɛ wo naxa n ma xaranyi rabolo, n ma wali xa lu n ma fu.

sentences.english: My desire for you, brothers, is that you may be as I am, because I am as you are. You have done me no wrong;
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, n bara wo mayandi, wo lu alɔ n tan, barima n fan luxi nɛ alɔ wo tan. Wo mu fe kobi yo raba n na.

sentences.english: But you have knowledge that with a feeble body I was preaching the good news to you the first time;
sentences.susu: Wo a kolon a n ma fure nan a niya, a singe singe n xa wo kawandi Isa xa masenyi fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And you did not have a poor opinion of me because of the trouble in my flesh, or put shame on it; but you took me to your hearts as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.
sentences.susu: Na nu xɔrɔxɔ wo bɛ, kɔnɔ n ma fe mu wo bɔɲɛ raɲaaxu wo ma, wo mu wo makuya n na. Wo n nasɛnɛ nɛ alɔ Ala xa malekɛ nde, xa na mu a ra Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa.

sentences.english: Where then is that happy condition of yours? because I give you witness, that, if possible, you would have taken out your eyes and given them to me.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na sɛɛwɛ fori na minden? Singe n ma fe nu rafan wo ma han wo nu nɔma tinde wo yae yati bade n bɛ.

sentences.english: So then am I no longer your friend, because I give you true words?
sentences.susu: N nɔndi falafe wo bɛ, na bara a niya n xa findi wo yaxui ra?

sentences.english: Their interest in you is not good; but their desire is that you may be shut out, so that you may go after them.
sentences.susu: Na mixie wama wo xa bira e fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ na mu findima fe fanyi ra wo bɛ. E wama won tagi isofe, alako wo xa lu e tan mabiri.

sentences.english: But it is good to have an interest in a good cause at all times, and not only when I am present with you.
sentences.susu: Xa wo gbata fe fanyi rabafe ra, na mu ɲaaxu. Wo xa na mɔɔli raba tɛmui birin, hali n mu na wo yire.

sentences.english: My children, of whom I am again in birth-pains till Christ is formed in you,
sentences.susu: N ma die, n man na tɔɔrɔfe wo bɛ alɔ ginɛ xa tɔɔrɛ ditinyi ra, han Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ɲɛrɛ ki sabatima wo i tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: Truly my desire is to be present with you now, using a changed voice; for I am troubled about you.
sentences.susu: A xɔli n ma won birin xa lu yire keren, alako won xa won bore fahaamu, barima yakɔsi n bara hanmɛ wo xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Say, you whose desire it is to be under the law, do you not give ear to the law?
sentences.susu: Wo tan naxee wama kisi sɔtɔfe Ala xa yaamarie ratinmɛfe saabui ra, wo mu a kolon Ala xa sɛriyɛ naxan falaxi?

sentences.english: Because it is in the Writings, that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant-woman, and one by the free woman.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui a di firin nan nu na Iburahima yi ra. Konyi ginɛ naxa keren bari a bɛ, xɔrɛ ginɛ fan naxa di gbɛtɛ bari a bɛ.

sentences.english: Now the son by the servant-woman has his birth after the flesh; but the son by the free woman has his birth through the undertaking of God.
sentences.susu: A naxan sɔtɔ konyi ginɛ saabui ra, na barixi nɛ alɔ ibunadama birin barixi ki naxɛ, kɔnɔ a naxan sɔtɔ xɔrɛ ginɛ saabui ra, a barixi laayidi nan kui.

sentences.english: Which things have a secret sense; because these women are the two agreements; one from the mountain of Sinai, giving birth to servants, which is Hagar.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ firinyi misaalixi saatɛ firin nan na. Saatɛ naxan xirixi Sinayi geya fari nan a niyama mixi xa lu konyiya kui. Hagara misaalixi na saatɛ nan na,

sentences.english: Now this Hagar is the mountain Sinai in Arabia, and is the image of the Jerusalem which now is: which is a servant with her children.
sentences.susu: naxan xirixi Sinayi geya fari Arabu bɔxi ma. A misaalixi Darisalamu fan na, naxan na konyiya kui a nun a xa die.

sentences.english: But the Jerusalem on high is free, which is our mother.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Darisalamu naxan na ariyanna, xɔrɛ taa nan a ra. Won nga nan na ki.

sentences.english: For it is in the Writings, You who have never given birth, be glad; give cries of joy, you who have had no birth-pains; for the children of her who has been given up by her husband are more than those of the woman who has a husband.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, «I tan naxan mu di barima, i xa ɲɛlɛxin. I tan naxan mu di bari tɔɔrɛ kolon, i xui ramini, a ite ɲɛlɛxinyi kui, barima ginɛ naxan xa xɛmɛ bara mɛɛ a ra, a xa di wuyama nɛ, dangi xɛmɛ taa idɔxɔɛ ra.»

sentences.english: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are the children of the undertaking of God.
sentences.susu: Wo tan ngaxakerenyie, wo bara findi laayidi die ra alɔ Isiyaga.

sentences.english: But as in those days he who had birth after the flesh was cruel to him who had birth after the Spirit, even so it is now.
sentences.susu: Na waxati, di naxan barixi ibunadama ki ma, a naxa di boore tɔɔrɔ, naxan barixi Ala Xaxili sɛnbɛ saabui ra. Han ya a na na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: What then do the Writings say? Send away the servant-woman and her son; for the son of the servant-woman will not have a part in the heritage with the son of the free woman.
sentences.susu: Munse sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui? A sɛbɛxi, «I xa konyi ginɛ nun a xa di keri, barima konyi ginɛ xa di nun xɔrɛ ginɛ xa di mu kɛ itaxunma.»

sentences.english: So, brothers, we are not children of the servant-woman, but of the free woman.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, na nan a ra won mu findixi konyi ginɛ xa die xa ra. Won findixi xɔrɛ ginɛ xa die nan na.

sentences.english: Christ has truly made us free: then keep your free condition and let no man put a yoke on you again.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi bara won xunsara, alako won xa xɔrɛya sɔtɔ. Na kui, wo xa ti a fanyi ra. Wo naxa tin konyiya nde yo xa dɔxɔ wo fari sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: See, I Paul say to you, that if you undergo circumcision, Christ will be of no use to you.
sentences.susu: N tan Pɔlu, n xa nɔndi fala wo bɛ, xa wo tin na mixie xa wo sunna, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa wali tide yo mu na wo bɛ sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Yes, I give witness again to every man who undergoes circumcision, that he will have to keep all the law.
sentences.susu: N man xa a fala wo bɛ, xɛmɛ naxan tinma e xa a sunna, a lanma a xa Ala xa yaamari birin natinmɛ.

sentences.english: You are cut off from Christ, you who would have righteousness by the law; you are turned away from grace.
sentences.susu: Wo tan naxee wama tinxinyi sɔtɔfe yaamarie ratinmɛfe saabui ra, wo nun Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi tagi bara ikuya. Ala mu hinnɛma wo ra sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: For we through the Spirit by faith are waiting for the hope of righteousness.
sentences.susu: Won won xaxili tima Ala Xaxili ra won ma danxaniya kui, alako won xa tinxinyi sɔtɔ won xaxili tima naxan na.

sentences.english: Because in Christ Jesus, having circumcision or not having circumcision are equally of no profit; but only faith working through love.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi biraxi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa fɔxɔ ra, sunnɛ nun sunnatareya tide yo mu na a bɛ. Fe keren nan tide gbo: Mixi xa danxaniya Ala ma, a xa mixi xanu.

sentences.english: You were going on well; who was the cause of your not giving ear to what is true?
sentences.susu: Wo nu na ɲɛrɛfe a fanyi ra. Pe, nde a niyaxi wo xa nɔndi rabolo?

sentences.english: This ready belief did not come from him who had made you his.
sentences.susu: Naxan wo bɛndunxi na ki, na mu findixi Ala ra naxan wo xili.

sentences.english: A little leaven makes a change in all the mass.
sentences.susu: Lɛbini dondoronti nɔma farin gbegbe ratede.

sentences.english: I am certain about you in the Lord, that you will be of no other mind; but he who is troubling you will have his punishment, whoever he is.
sentences.susu: N bara la wo ra Ala saabui ra, mixi yo fa a xa fa wo ya iso, wo mu tinma na xaxili mɔɔli ra. Na kanyi fama nɛ a sare sɔtɔde.

sentences.english: But I, brothers, if I am still preaching circumcision, why am I still attacked? then has the shame of the cross been taken away.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, xa a li nu han ya n na kawandi tife mixie xa sunna, munfe ra Yuwifie luma n ɲaxankata ra? Xa a sa li nu n na kawandi mɔɔli tima, Isa xa sɛrɛxɛ wuri magalanbuxi ma, a mu findima wɔyɛn xɔrɔxɔɛ ra mixie bɛ nu.

sentences.english: My desire is that they who give you trouble might even be cut off themselves.
sentences.susu: N wama nɛ naxee na wo ya isofe, hali e mu a dan sunnɛ fe gbansan ma. E xa e xɛmɛya birin ba na.

sentences.english: Because you, brothers, were marked out to be free; only do not make use of your free condition to give the flesh its chance, but through love be servants one to another.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, Ala wama wo xa lu xɔrɛya kui, kɔnɔ wo naxa na xɔrɛya mafindi yunubi ra. Wo wo bore mali xanunteya kui.

sentences.english: For all the law is made complete in one word, even in this, Have love for your neighbour as for yourself.
sentences.susu: Ala xa sɛriyɛ birin na yi yaamari kerenyi nan kui: Wo xa wo boore adamadi xanu alɔ wo yɛtɛ.

sentences.english: But if you are given to fighting with one another, take care that you are not the cause of destruction one to another.
sentences.susu: Xa wo luma wo bore tɔɔrɔ ra, wo nu wo bore ɲaxankata, wo a niya dɔyin, xa na mu a ra wo wo bore xa fe xun nakanama nɛ.

sentences.english: But I say, Go on in the Spirit, and you will not come under the rule of the evil desires of the flesh.
sentences.susu: N wama naxan falafe wo bɛ, wo xa a lu Ala Xaxili xa wo raɲɛrɛ. Wo naxa bira wo yɛtɛ waxɔnfe ɲaaxie fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: For the flesh has desires against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; because these are opposite the one to the other; so that you may not do the things which you have a mind to do.
sentences.susu: Adama waxɔnfe ɲaaxi nun Ala Xaxili sɛniyɛnxi, a keren mu a ra. Na firinyi na e bore gerefe, alako wo naxa wo waxɔnfe raba.

sentences.english: But if you are guided by the Spirit, you are not under the law.
sentences.susu: Xa Ala Xaxili na wo raɲɛrɛfe, wo xaxili mu tima wo xa yaamari ratinmɛxie ra sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Now the works of the flesh are clear, which are these: evil desire, unclean things, wrong use of the senses,
sentences.susu: Yunubitɔɛ waxɔnfee nan ya: langoeɲa, sɛniyɛntareɲa, sɔn kobi,

sentences.english: Worship of images, use of strange powers, hates, fighting, desire for what another has, angry feelings, attempts to get the better of others, divisions, false teachings,
sentences.susu: kuye batufe, duureya, xɔnnanteya, lantareya, tɔɔnɛ, bɔɲɛ tefe, geeni fenfe i yɛtɛ bɛ, sɔnxɔfe, boore rafisafe a boore bɛ,

sentences.english: Envy, uncontrolled drinking and feasting, and such things: of which I give you word clearly, even as I did in the past, that they who do such things will have no part in the kingdom of God.
sentences.susu: milanteya, siisife, xulunyi ɲaaxie, nun na maniyɛe. N man xa a fala wo bɛ, mixi naxee ɲɛrɛma na ki, e mu ariyanna sɔtɔma kɛ ra muku.

sentences.english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, a quiet mind, kind acts, well-doing, faith,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa kɛwalie nan ya: xanunteya, sɛɛwɛ, bɔɲɛsa, diɲɛ, yarawasɛ, fanyi, lanlanteya,

sentences.english: Gentle behaviour, control over desires: against such there is no law.
sentences.susu: bɔɲɛ bɛxiya, nun yɛtɛ suxui. Tɔnyi yo mu na na fe mɔɔlie ma.

sentences.english: And those who are Christ's have put to death on the cross the flesh with its passions and its evil desires.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa fɔxirabirɛe bara yunubitɔɛ waxɔnfe rabɛɲin a nun fe ɲaaxi birin.

sentences.english: If we are living by the Spirit, by the Spirit let us be guided.
sentences.susu: Won to kisi sɔtɔ Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra, won xa bira a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Let us not be full of self-glory, making one another angry, having envy of one another.
sentences.susu: Won naxa won yɛtɛ igbo, won naxa won bore raxɔnɔ, won naxa mila won bore ma.

sentences.english: Brothers, if a man is taken in any wrongdoing, you who are of the Spirit will put such a one right in a spirit of love; keeping watch on yourself, for fear that you yourself may be tested.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, xa wo bara mixi nde suxu yunubi kui, wo tan naxee xa danxaniya tilinxi, wo xa a mafuruku alako a xa gbilen Ala ma. Kɔnɔ wo xa wo ɲɛngi sa wo yɛtɛ xɔn ma, alako wo fan naxa bira na yunubi kui.

sentences.english: Take on yourselves one another's troubles, and so keep the law of Christ.
sentences.susu: Wo wo bore mali wo xa kote xaninde. Na kui, wo Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa sɛriyɛ nan natinmɛma.

sentences.english: For if a man has an idea that he is something when he is nothing, he is tricked by himself.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi a yɛtɛ igboma, a na a yɛtɛ madaxufe.

sentences.english: But let every man make test of his work, and then will his cause for glory be in himself only, and not in his neighbour.
sentences.susu: Kankan xa a yɛtɛ ɲɛrɛ ki mato, xa a fan, xa a mu fan. A naxa a boore ɲɛrɛ ki mato, a fa a fala, «N fan boore bɛ.» Na kui, a xa a yɛtɛ keren gbansan mato,

sentences.english: Because every man is responsible for his part of the work.
sentences.susu: alako kankan xa a yɛtɛ xa kote xanin.

sentences.english: But let him who gets teaching in the word give a part in all good things to his teacher.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan xaranyi sɔtɔma Ala xa masenyi xa fe ra, a lanma a xa a karamɔxɔ ki fe fanyi mɔɔli birin na.

sentences.english: Be not tricked; God is not made sport of: for whatever seed a man puts in, that will he get back as grain.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo naxa wo madaxu. Adamadi mu nɔma Ala madaxude. Kankan fama a yɛtɛ xa wali sare sɔtɔde nɛ.

sentences.english: Because he who puts in the seed of the flesh will of the flesh get the reward of death; but he who puts in the seed of the Spirit will of the Spirit get the reward of eternal life.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan birama a yɛtɛ waxɔnfe ɲaaxi fɔxɔ ra, a fama nɛ sɔntɔde na xaxili kobi xa fe ra. Kɔnɔ mixi naxan birama Ala Xaxili waxɔnfe fɔxɔ ra, a fama kiside Ala Xaxili nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: And let us not get tired of well-doing; for at the right time we will get in the grain, if we do not give way to weariness.
sentences.susu: Won naxa tagan fe fanyi rabafe ra. Xa won mu tagan, won fama nɛ sare fanyi sɔtɔde a waxati.

sentences.english: So then, as we have the chance, let us do good to all men, and specially to those who are of the family of the faith.
sentences.susu: Xa won nɔma fe fanyi nde rabade, won xa a raba mixi birin bɛ. A gbengbenyi won xa a raba won ngaxakerenyi danxaniyatɔɛe bɛ dangife mixi birin na.

sentences.english: See the size of the handwriting which I myself have made use of in writing to you.
sentences.susu: Wo yi sɛbɛli mato, a xɔri xungbo, barima n na a sɛbɛfe n yɛtɛ bɛlɛxɛ nan na.

sentences.english: Those who have the desire to seem important in the flesh, put force on you to undergo circumcision; only that they may not be attacked because of the cross of Christ.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee na wo karaxanfe wo xa sunna, e wama nɛ ɲama xa e matɔxɔ. E na na rabafe nɛ alako e naxa ɲaxankatɛ sɔtɔ kawandi xa fe ra, naxan Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa sɛrɛxɛ masenma.

sentences.english: Because even those who undergo circumcision do not themselves keep the law; but they would have you undergo circumcision, so that they may have glory in your flesh.
sentences.susu: Sunnamixie yati mu Ala xa yaamari birin natinmɛma, kɔnɔ e wama wo tan xa sunna, alako e xa xili fanyi sɔtɔ na xa fe ra.

sentences.english: But far be it from me to have glory in anything, but only in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which this world has come to an end on the cross for me, and I for it.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n tan, n wama xili fanyi sɔtɔfe won Marigi Isa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa sɛrɛxɛ nan ma fe ra, naxan bara a niya n ɲɛrɛ ki nun duniɲa ɲɛrɛ ki, e tagi xa ikuya.

sentences.english: For having circumcision is nothing, and not having circumcision is nothing, but only a new order of existence.
sentences.susu: Sunnɛ nun sunnatareya tide yo mu na na. Findife mixi nɛɛnɛ ra, na nan tide gbo.

sentences.english: And on all who are guided by this rule be peace and mercy, and on the Israel of God.
sentences.susu: Ala xa bɔɲɛsa nun hinnɛ fi mixi birin ma naxee birama na sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra, a nun a xa ɲama Isirayila.

sentences.english: From this time on let no man be a trouble to me; because my body is marked with the marks of Jesus.
sentences.susu: A dɔnxɔɛ ra, mixi yo naxa n tɔɔrɔ, barima Isa xa tɔɔrɛ fɔxi na n fate ma.

sentences.english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. So be it.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, won Marigi Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa hinnɛ wo xaxili ra. Amina.

sentences.english: Paul, an Apostle of Christ Jesus by the purpose of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and those who have faith in Christ Jesus:
sentences.susu: N tan Pɔlu nan yi ki, Ala bara a ragiri naxan xa findi a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa xɛɛra ra. N bara wo tan Efɛsɛ sɛniyɛntɔɛe xɛɛbu, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa danxaniyatɔɛe.

sentences.english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Won Baba Ala nun won Marigi Isa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa hinnɛ nun bɔɲɛsa fi wo ma.

sentences.english: Praise be to the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has given us every blessing of the Spirit in the heavens in Christ:
sentences.susu: Tantui nan Ala bɛ, naxan findixi won Marigi Isa Baba ra. Isa saabui ra, a bara barakɛ birin nagoro won ma, naxan mɔɔli mu kelima yi duniɲa ma, naxan mɔɔli mu toma, naxan won malima ariyanna kira xɔn.

sentences.english: Even as he made selection of us in him from the first, so that we might be holy and free from all evil before him in love:
sentences.susu: Beenun duniɲa gɛmɛ singe ɲan xa dɔxɔ, Ala nu bara won sugandi Isa saabui ra alako won xa sɛniyɛn, won xa tinxin a ya i. A xa xanunteya kui,

sentences.english: As we were designed before by him for the position of sons to himself, through Jesus Christ, in the good pleasure of his purpose,
sentences.susu: a naxa ɲanige tongo won xa findi a xa die ra a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa saabui ra, Ala sago fanyi ma.

sentences.english: To the praise of the glory of his grace, which he freely gave to us in the Loved One:
sentences.susu: Na birin nabaxi nɛ alako won xa a xa hinnɛ xungbe matɔxɔ, a naxan masenxi won bɛ a xanuntenyi Isa saabui ra.

sentences.english: In whom we have salvation through his blood, the forgiveness of our sins, through the wealth of his grace,
sentences.susu: A tan Isa bara won xunsare fi a yɛtɛ wuli ra. Won ma yunubie xafarixi a tan nan saabui ra. Na birin nabaxi Ala xa hinnɛ makaabaxi nan kui,

sentences.english: Which he gave us in full measure in all wisdom and care;
sentences.susu: a bara naxan fi won ma a yiriwaxi ra, lɔnni nun fahaamui ra.

sentences.english: Having made clear to us the secret of his purpose, in agreement with the design which he had in mind, to put into his hands
sentences.susu: A bara a sago gundo makɛnɛn won bɛ, a to wa a xɔn a sago xa raba a xa Mixi Sugandixi saabui ra

sentences.english: The ordering of the times when they are complete, so that all things might come to a head in Christ, the things in heaven and the things on the earth; in him, I say,
sentences.susu: waxati kamali tɛmui. Ala sago findixi yi nan na: A xa se birin malan, naxee na koore a nun naxee na bɔxi, a xa a xa Mixi Sugandixi findi a birin xunyi ra.

sentences.english: In whom we have a heritage, being marked out from the first in his purpose who does all things in agreement with his designs;
sentences.susu: Won fan findixi kɛtongoe ra a tan nan saabui ra, alɔ Ala a ɲanige tongoxi ki naxɛ, naxan fe birin nagirima a yɛtɛ sagoe nun a xa natɛ ma.

sentences.english: So that his glory might have praise through us who first had hope in Christ:
sentences.susu: Na birin nabaxi nɛ alako won tan naxee findi mixi singee ra naxee e xaxili ti Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra, won xa Ala Nɔrɛ Kanyi matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: In whom you, having been given the true word, the good news of your salvation, and through your faith in him, were given the sign of the Holy Spirit of hope,
sentences.susu: Wo fan to nɔndi masenyi ramɛ Isa xa fe ra, xibaaru fanyi naxan kisi fi wo ma, wo naxa danxaniya a ma. Isa saabui ra, Ala naxa wo matɔnxuma a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi ra alɔ a laayidi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Which is the first-fruit of our heritage, till God gets back that which is his, to the praise of his glory.
sentences.susu: A bara a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi fi won ma won kɛ fɔlɛ ra. A fama won kɛ dɔnxɔɛ birin fide won ma a na fa a xa mixie fɔxɔ ra tɛmui naxɛ. Yi birin nabaxi nɛ alako Ala Nɔrɛ Kanyi xa matɔxɔɛ sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: For this cause I, having had news of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and which you make clear to all the saints,
sentences.susu: Na kui, kafi n a mɛ wo danxaniyaxi Marigi Isa ma ki naxɛ, wo man sɛniyɛntɔɛe birin xanuxi ki naxɛ,

sentences.english: Give praise without end for you, keeping you in mind in my prayers;
sentences.susu: danyi yo mu na n ma tantui ma wo xa fe ra n nɛ Ala maxandima wo bɛ.

sentences.english: That the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;
sentences.susu: N ma maxandi sigama Baba Ala Nɔrɛ Kanyi nan ma, won Marigi Isa naxan batuma, a xa a Xaxili ragoro wo ma naxan fahaamui fima, naxan fee makɛnɛnma, alako wo xa Ala kolonyi xun xa masa.

sentences.english: And that having the eyes of your heart full of light, you may have knowledge of what is the hope of his purpose, what is the wealth of the glory of his heritage in the saints,
sentences.susu: N a maxandima wo bɔɲɛ xa fe to a fiixɛ ra alako wo xa kolon sɔtɔ a ma a Ala bara wo xili, fe xa lu wo bɛ wo wo xaxili tima naxan na, alako wo xa kolon sɔtɔ Ala xa kɛ makaabaxi ma naxan findixi a xa sɛniyɛntɔɛ birin gbe ra,

sentences.english: And how unlimited is his power to us who have faith, as is seen in the working of the strength of his power,
sentences.susu: alako wo man xa kolon sɔtɔ Ala xa sɛnbɛ xungbe ma naxan na won tan danxaniyatɔɛe bɛ. Yi sɛnbɛ findixi Ala xa sɛnbɛ magaaxuxi nan na,

sentences.english: By which he made Christ come back from the dead, and gave him a place at his right hand in heaven,
sentences.susu: a naxan namini a to a xa Mixi Sugandixi rakeli faxɛ ma, a a magoro a yirefanyi ma ariyanna.

sentences.english: Far over all rule and authority and power and every name which is named, not only in the present order, but in that which is to come:
sentences.susu: Ala bara mangɛya fi a ma naxan dangi mangɛya, nɔɛ, nun sɛnbɛ birin na. A bara xili fi a ma naxan dangi xili birin na naxan falama yi duniɲa ma a nun aligiyama.

sentences.english: And he has put all things under his feet, and has made him to be head over all things to the church,
sentences.susu: Ala bara fe birin sa a xa yaamari bun, a man fa a findi fe birin xunyi ra danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama bɛ.

sentences.english: Which is his body, the full measure of him in whom all things are made complete.
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama fan luxi nɛ alɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi fate. Naxan fe birin nakamalima a mɔɔli birin na, a xa fe kamalixi birin na danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama tagi.

sentences.english: And to you did he give life, when you were dead through your wrongdoing and sins,
sentences.susu: Wo fan nu findixi mixi faxaxie nan na wo xa fe kobie nun wo xa yunubie xa fe ra

sentences.english: In which you were living in the past, after the ways of this present world, doing the pleasure of the lord of the power of the air, the spirit who is now working in those who go against the purpose of God;
sentences.susu: wo nu ɲɛrɛma naxee ma. Wo nu biraxi yi duniɲa fe kobie nan fɔxɔ ra. Wo nu biraxi Sentanɛ nan fɔxɔ ra, ɲinnɛe xa mangɛ naxan na kuye ma. Wo nu biraxi a xaxili nan fɔxɔ ra naxan na walife Ala yaxuie tagi.

sentences.english: Among whom we all at one time were living in the pleasures of our flesh, giving way to the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and the punishment of God was waiting for us even as for the rest.
sentences.susu: Singe, won birin nu ɲɛrɛma na mɔɔli nan na, won bira won fate waxɔnfe nun won yɛtɛ xaxili fɔxɔ ra. Na kui, a nu lanma won xa Ala xa xɔnɛ nan tun sɔtɔ alɔ booree.

sentences.english: But God, being full of mercy, through the great love which he had for us,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala xa kinikini gbo. A won xanuxi xanunteya tilinxi nan na.

sentences.english: Even when we were dead through our sins, gave us life together with Christ (by grace you have salvation),
sentences.susu: Na kui, hali faxamixie nan to nu won na won ma fe kobi rabaxie xa fe ra, Ala naxa won nakeli na faxɛ ma, won nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi. Wo kisixi Ala xa hinnɛ nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: So that we came back from death with him, and are seated with him in the heavens, in Christ Jesus;
sentences.susu: Ala to bara won nakeli faxɛ ma won nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi ra, a bara won naso ariyanna, a won dɔxɔ a fɛ ma.

sentences.english: That in the time to come he might make clear the full wealth of his grace in his mercy to us in Christ Jesus:
sentences.susu: A xa fonisireya kui, Ala kisi fixi won ma a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa nan saabui ra, alako birin xa a xa hinnɛ makaabaxi to waxati birin naxan sa fama.

sentences.english: Because by grace you have salvation through faith; and that not of yourselves: it is given by God:
sentences.susu: Wo kisixi Ala xa hinnɛ nan saabui ra, wo xa danxaniya xa fe ra. Kisi mu kelima wo tan xa ma, Ala nan a fima mixi ma.

sentences.english: Not by works, so that no man may take glory to himself.
sentences.susu: A mu kelima mixi xa wali fanyie xa ma. Na kui, mixi yo mu nɔma a yɛtɛ matɔxɔde.

sentences.english: For by his act we were given existence in Christ Jesus to do those good works which God before made ready for us so that we might do them.
sentences.susu: Ala xa wali fɔxi nan na won na. Yakɔsi, a bara won daa a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa saabui ra, alako won xa nu wali fanyie raba, a bara naxee ti won ya i won xa nu ɲɛrɛ e ma.

sentences.english: For this reason keep it in mind that in the past you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are looked on as being outside the circumcision by those who have circumcision, in the flesh, made by hands;
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo xa ratu a Yuwifie mu wo ra bari kɛɲa ma. Naxee xili falama «sunnamixie», e wo fan xili falama «sunnataree». Wo xa a kolon a sunnɛ findixi adama xa wali nan na, naxan nabama mixi fate ra.

sentences.english: That you were at that time without Christ, being cut off from any part in Israel's rights as a nation, having no part in God's agreement, having no hope, and without God in the world.
sentences.susu: Wo xa ratu a singe ra wo mu nu Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fe yo kolon. Xɔɲɛe nan nu wo ra Isirayilakae ya ma. Laayidi nun saatɛ yo mu nu xirixi wo nun Ala tagi. Xaxili tide yo mu nu na wo yi ra, Ala kolontaree nan nu wo ra duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: But now in Christ Jesus you who at one time were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi, wo tan naxee danxaniyaxi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa ma, wo tan naxee nu makuyaxi, Ala bara wo maso a ra a xa Mixi Sugandixi wuli saabui ra.

sentences.english: For he is our peace, who has made the two into one, and by whom the middle wall of division has been broken down,
sentences.susu: A tan nan lanyi rasoxi won tagi, ɲama firin xa findi keren na. A to a yɛtɛ fate ba sɛrɛxɛ ra, a bara yaxuya tɛtɛ rabira naxan nu tixi won tagi.

sentences.english: Having in his flesh put an end to that which made the division between us, even the law with its rules and orders, so that he might make in himself, of the two, one new man, so making peace;
sentences.susu: A bara Yuwifie xa sɛriyɛ, e xa yaamarie, nun e xa tɔnyie sɛnbɛ kana. A bara na ɲama firin tongo, a lanyi xiri e tagi, a e findi ɲama nɛɛnɛ keren na a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: And that the two might come into agreement with God in one body through the cross, so putting an end to that division.
sentences.susu: A xa faxɛ saabui ra wuri magalanbuxi ma, a bara e xa yaxuya kana, a e firin birin findi keren na, a lanyi nun bɔɲɛsa lu e tan nun Ala tagi.

sentences.english: And he came preaching peace to you who were far off, and to those who were near;
sentences.susu: A to fa, a naxa wo kawandi lanyi nun bɔɲɛsa ra, wo tan naxee nu makuya. Naxee fan nu makɔrɛ, a naxa nee kawandi lanyi nun bɔɲɛsa ra.

sentences.english: Because through him the two of us are able to come near in one Spirit to the Father.
sentences.susu: A tan nan naadɛ rabixi won firin birin bɛ, won nun Baba Ala xa lu yire keren, a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi kerenyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: So then you are no longer as those who have no part or place in the kingdom of God, but you are numbered among the saints, and of the family of God,
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo tan naxee mu nu na Ala xa mixie ya ma, yakɔsi wo fan bara findi sɛniyɛntɔɛe ra, wo bara so Ala xa mixie ya ma.

sentences.english: Resting on the base of the Apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief keystone,
