sentences.susu: Wo bara lu alɔ banxi tixi naxan bunyi findi xɛɛrae nun namiɲɔnmɛe ra. Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa nan findi na banxi gɛmɛ hagigɛ ra naxan tide gbo a birin bɛ.

sentences.english: In whom all the building, rightly joined together, comes to be a holy house of God in the Lord;
sentences.susu: Banxi yire birin a boore suxuxi a tan nan saabui ra, a ite, a findi hɔrɔmɔbanxi sɛniyɛnxi ra Marigi bɛ.

sentences.english: In whom you, with the rest, are united together as a living-place of God in the Spirit.
sentences.susu: Isa bara a niya wo fan xa nu malan alɔ banxi biriki dɔxɔma a boore ra ki naxɛ. Ala na wo tife alɔ banxi a Xaxili sabatima dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: For this cause I Paul, the prisoner of Christ Jesus for you Gentiles,
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, n Ala maxandima wo bɛ, n tan Pɔlu, naxan bara findi geelimani ra Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa bɛ wo xa fe ra, wo tan naxee mu findixi Isirayilakae ra.

sentences.english: If that ordering of the grace of God has come to your knowledge, which was given to me for you,
sentences.susu: N laxi a ra, wo bara a mɛ Ala naxa a xa hinnɛ taxu n na n xa a masen wo bɛ.

sentences.english: How by revelation the secret was made clear to me, as I said before in a short letter,
sentences.susu: N ɲan bara a nde tagi raba, Ala bara a xa gundo masen n bɛ naxan singe nu nɔxunxi.

sentences.english: By the reading of which you will be clear about my knowledge of the secret of Christ;
sentences.susu: Wo na n ma sɛbɛli xaran, wo nɔma nɛ a kolonde a fahaamui bara fi n ma Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi gundo xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Which in other generations was not given to the sons of men, but the revelation of it has now been made to his holy Apostles and prophets in the Spirit;
sentences.susu: Yi gundo mu nu makɛnɛnxi a singe ra nu adamadie bɛ alɔ a fa makɛnɛnxi Ala xa xɛɛra sɛniyɛnxie nun namiɲɔnmɛe bɛ ki naxɛ to Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra.

sentences.english: Which is that the Gentiles have a part in the heritage, and in the same body, and in the same hope in Christ through the good news,
sentences.susu: A bara makɛnɛn fa, a si gbɛtɛe nun Isirayilakae bara findi ɲama keren na. E bara findi kɛ keren tongomae ra. Ala laayidi keren nan tongoxi e birin nalanxi bɛ, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa xibaaru fanyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: Of which I was made a preacher, through that grace of God which was given to me in the measure of the working of his power.
sentences.susu: Ala to hinnɛxi n na a sɛnbɛ birin na, n fan bara findi yi xibaaru fanyi xa walikɛ ra.

sentences.english: To me, who am less than the least of all the saints, was this grace given, so that I might make clear to the Gentiles the good news of the unending wealth of Christ:
sentences.susu: Hali n to xurunxi dangi sɛniyɛntɔɛ birin na, Ala bara hinnɛ n na. A xa hinnɛ findixi n bɛ yi nan na: N tan xa si birin kawandi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa xibaaru fanyi makaabaxi ra,

sentences.english: And make all men see what is the ordering of the secret which from the first has been kept in God who made all things;
sentences.susu: n xa Ala gundo makɛnɛn adamadie birin bɛ, naxan nu nɔxunxi Ala Daali Mangɛ yi ra. Kafi fe fɔlɔ fɔlɛ yi gundo nu nɔxunxi Ala yi,

sentences.english: So that now to the rulers and the authorities in the heavens might be made clear through the church the wide-shining wisdom of God,
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ yakɔsi, a sago na a ra danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xa a xa lɔnni birin makɛnɛn mangɛe nun nɔlae bɛ naxee na kuye ma.

sentences.english: Which is seen in his eternal purpose in Christ Jesus our Lord:
sentences.susu: Yi birin findixi Ala xa natɛ nan na naxan nu na a yi ra abadan. A a birin nakamalixi won Marigi Isa nan saabui ra, a xa Mixi Sugandixi.

sentences.english: By whom we come near to God without fear through faith in him.
sentences.susu: A tan saabui ra, won to danxaniyaxi a ma, won nɔma won makɔrɛde Ala ra limaniya kui, siikɛ xanbi.

sentences.english: For this reason it is my prayer that you may not become feeble because of my troubles for you, which are your glory.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n bara wo maxandi limaniya naxa ba wo yi n ma tɔɔrɛ kui wo xa fe ra, barima a findima wo bɛ xunnakeli nan na.

sentences.english: For this cause I go down on my knees before the Father,
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, n nan n xinbi sinma Baba Ala ya i,

sentences.english: From whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,
sentences.susu: bɔnsɔɛ birin fatanxi naxan na, naxee na koore nun bɔxi.

sentences.english: That in the wealth of his glory he would make you strong with power through his Spirit in your hearts;
sentences.susu: N a maxandima a xa wo mali a xa nɔrɛ makaabaxi saabui ra, a xa wo bɔɲɛ sɛnbɛ so a Xaxili saabui ra.

sentences.english: So that Christ may have his place in your hearts through faith; and that you, being rooted and based in love,
sentences.susu: N a maxandima a xa Mixi Sugandixi xa sabati wo bɔɲɛ i danxaniya saabui ra, wo man xa sabati xanunteya kui. Wo xa xanunteya suxu alɔ wuri bili sanke bɔxi suxuxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: May have strength to see with all the saints how wide and long and high and deep it is,
sentences.susu: N a maxandima a xa sɛnbɛ fi wo ma, alako wo nun sɛniyɛntɔɛ birin xa nɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa xanunteya gboya, a kuyɛya, a iteya, nun a tilinyi kolonde wo mabiri.

sentences.english: And to have knowledge of the love of Christ which is outside all knowledge, so that you may be made complete as God himself is complete.
sentences.susu: Wo xa kolon sɔtɔ a ma Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi wo xanuxi ki naxɛ, xanunteya naxan mu nɔma fahaamude a gboya xa fe ra, alako Ala xa wo rakamali a xa fe kamalixi birin na.

sentences.english: Now to him who is able to do in full measure more than all our desires or thoughts, through the power which is working in us,
sentences.susu: Matɔxɔɛ na Ala bɛ naxan nɔma fe birin na a sɛnbɛ saabui ra a naxan fixi wo ma, naxan nɔma fe birin na, dangi won ma maxandi nun maɲɔxunyi ra

sentences.english: To him be the glory in the church and in Christ Jesus to all generations for ever and ever. So be it.
sentences.susu: Matɔxɔɛ na a tan nan bɛ danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa saabui ra waxati birin, abadan. Amina.

sentences.english: I then, the prisoner in the Lord, make this request from my heart, that you will see that your behaviour is a credit to the position which God's purpose has given you,
sentences.susu: Na kui, n tan naxan bara findi geelimani ra Marigi xa fe ra, n bara wo mayandi wo ɲɛrɛ ki xa a masen a Ala nan yati wo xilixi.

sentences.english: With all gentle and quiet behaviour, taking whatever comes, putting up with one another in love;
sentences.susu: Wo xa ɲɛrɛ yɛtɛ magore nun bɔɲɛ bɛxi kui, wo nu diɲɛ wo bore bɛ, wo ti wo bore san na xanunteya kui.

sentences.english: Taking care to keep the harmony of the Spirit in the yoke of peace.
sentences.susu: Wo xa fe birin naba alako lanyi naxa kana wo tagi, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxan fixi wo ma bɔɲɛsa ra.

sentences.english: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you have been marked out by God in the one hope of his purpose for you;
sentences.susu: Won findixi fate keren nan na. Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi keren nan a ra. Ala wo fan xilixi nɛ wo xa wo xaxili ti fe keren nan na.

sentences.english: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
sentences.susu: Marigi keren, danxaniya keren, nun xunxa keren nan na won bɛ.

sentences.english: One God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in all.
sentences.susu: Ala keren nan na won bɛ naxan findixi birin Baba ra, naxan na birin xun ma, naxan walima birin saabui ra, naxan na birin i.

sentences.english: But to every one of us has grace been given in the measure of the giving of Christ.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ hinnɛ fixi kankan ma won ya ma alɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi a xasabixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For this reason he says, He went up on high, taking his prisoners with him, and gave freely to men.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi a sɛbɛxi, «A to te koore, a naxa a yaxuie suxu, a naxa adamadie ki.»

sentences.english: (Now this, He went up, what is it but that he first went down into the lower parts of the earth?
sentences.susu: A to sɛbɛxi, «A bara te,» na nan na ki a bara goro han bɔxi ma sinden, beenun a man xa te.

sentences.english: He who went down is the same who went up far over all the heavens so that he might make all things complete.)
sentences.susu: Naxan goro, na nan man texi koore birin xun ma, alako a xa fe birin nakamali.

sentences.english: And he gave some as Apostles, and some, prophets; and some, preachers of the good news; and some to give care and teaching;
sentences.susu: A adamadie ki naxan na, a findi yi nan na: ndee xa findi xɛɛrae ra, ndee xa findi namiɲɔnmɛe ra, ndee xa findi xibaaru fanyi kawandilae ra, ndee xa findi danxaniyatɔɛe xunmatie nun karamɔxɔe ra.

sentences.english: For the training of the saints as servants in the church, for the building up of the body of Christ:
sentences.susu: A won kixi nɛ na birin na alako won xa sɛniyɛntɔɛe mali e xa fata Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama raɲɛrɛde yare.

sentences.english: Till we all come to the harmony of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to full growth, to the full measure of Christ:
sentences.susu: Won xa bira na fɔxɔ ra han won birin xa lu lanyi kui naxan kelima danxaniya nun Ala xa Di kolonfe ma, han won birin xa kamali alɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi kamalixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So that we may be no longer children, sent this way and that, turned about by every wind of teaching, by the twisting and tricks of men, by the deceits of error;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui won mu luma sɔnɔn alɔ diyɔrɛe. Won mu lintanma sɔnɔn alɔ wuri naxan saxi ye fari, mɔrɔnyi nun foye naxan tutunma, e a xanin yire birin. Na kui, mixie mu nɔma won natantande sɔnɔn e xa wule kawandi ra, e xa kɔɔta, nun e xa yanfanteya ra.

sentences.english: But saying true words in love, may come to full growth in him, who is the head, even Christ;
sentences.susu: Won xa nɔndi nan fala xanunteya kui. Fe birin kui, won xa danxaniya Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ma, naxan findixi danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xunyi ra. Won xa mɔ na danxaniya kui.

sentences.english: Through whom all the body, being rightly formed and united together, by the full working of every part, is increased to the building up of itself in love.
sentences.susu: Xunyi nan fate salonse birin naɲɛrɛma. Kankan xirixi a boore ra, kankan a xa wali rabama, alako fate birin xa mɔ, a xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ xanunteya kui.

sentences.english: This I say, then, and give witness in the Lord, that you are to go no longer in the way of the Gentiles whose minds are turned to that which has no profit,
sentences.susu: Na kui, n yi nan falama wo bɛ, n man xa a mabanban Marigi xili ra: Wo naxa ɲɛrɛ sɔnɔn alɔ danxaniyataree ɲɛrɛma ki naxɛ. E xaxilie birama fe fufafu nan tun fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Whose thoughts are dark, to whom the life of God is strange because they are without knowledge, and their hearts have been made hard;
sentences.susu: E xaxilie ifɔɔrɔxi. E xa fe kolontareya nun e xa sondon xɔrɔxɔya bara a niya e xa gan Ala xa kisi ra.

sentences.english: Who having no more power of feeling, have given themselves up to evil passions, to do all unclean things with overmuch desire.
sentences.susu: E mu yaagima fefe ma sɔnɔn. E bara e yɛtɛ rabolo langoeɲa xili ma. E mu wasama fe kobi mɔɔli birin nabafe ra.

sentences.english: For this was not the teaching of Christ which was given to you;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi mu wo tixi na kira xa xɔn!

sentences.english: If in fact you gave ear to him, and were given teaching in him, even as what is true is made clear in Jesus:
sentences.susu: Wo a xa fe mɛxi nɛ, wo man bara xaran a xa fe ra. Wo a kolon yati a nɔndi na Isa nan yi.

sentences.english: That you are to put away, in relation to your earlier way of life, the old man, which has become evil by love of deceit;
sentences.susu: Wo tinkanxi nɛ wo xa wo yi ba wo ɲɛrɛ ki fori ra, naxan wo xun nakanama wo waxɔnfe kobi saabui ra.

sentences.english: And be made new in the spirit of your mind,
sentences.susu: Wo bɔɲɛ nun wo xaxili xa mafindi bɔɲɛ nɛɛnɛ nun xaxili nɛɛnɛ ra.

sentences.english: And put on the new man, to which God has given life, in righteousness and a true and holy way of living.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo lahalɛ fori masara a nɛɛnɛ ra. Wo luma nɛ alɔ wo bara findi mixi nɛɛnɛ ra Ala naxan daaxi a xa ɲɛrɛ a xa tinxinyi nun sɛniyɛnyi yati kui.

sentences.english: And so, putting away false words, let everyone say what is true to his neighbour: for we are parts one of another.
sentences.susu: Na kui, won xa wule lu, won xa nɔndi nan fala won bore bɛ, barima won findixi fate keren salonyie nan na.

sentences.english: Be angry without doing wrong; let not the sun go down on your wrath;
sentences.susu: Xa wo xɔnɔ, wo naxa yunubi raba. Wo naxa a lu soge xa dula xɔnɛ na wo bɔɲɛ kui,

sentences.english: And do not give way to the Evil One.
sentences.susu: alako wo naxa santide lu Ibulisa bɛ.

sentences.english: Let him who was a thief be so no longer, but let him do good work with his hands, so that he may have something to give to him who is in need.
sentences.susu: Muɲɛti xa muɲɛ lu. A xa wali tinxinyi kui alako a xa munafanyi sɔtɔ a naxan fima setaree ma.

sentences.english: Let no evil talk come out of your mouth, but only what is good for giving necessary teaching, and for grace to those who give ear.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa a lu wɔyɛn kobi yo xa mini wo dɛ i. Wo xa wɔyɛn fanyi nan fala naxan nɔma mixi malide a hayi ki ma, alako wo xa wɔyɛnyi xa findi hinnɛ ra e bɛ.

sentences.english: And do not give grief to the Holy Spirit of God, by whom you were marked for the day of salvation.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi tɔɔrɔ, Ala wo matɔnxumaxi naxan na han a fama won fɔxɔ ra lɔxɔ naxɛ.

sentences.english: Let all bitter, sharp and angry feeling, and noise, and evil words, be put away from you, with all unkind acts;
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo yi ba yi fe mɔɔli birin na: xɔnɛ, bɔɲɛte, ɲaaxuɲa, ɲɔxɔnsɔsɔɛ, konbi, a nun fe kobi mɔɔli birin.

sentences.english: And be kind to one another, full of pity, having forgiveness for one another, even as God in Christ had forgiveness for you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa marafanyi nun bɔɲɛ fanyi masen wo bore bɛ. Wo xa diɲɛ wo bore ma alɔ Ala diɲɛxi wo fan ma ki naxɛ a xa Mixi Sugandixi saabui ra.

sentences.english: Let it then be your desire to be like God, as well-loved children;
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo to bara findi Ala xa di xanuxie ra, wo xa a fɔxi nan naba.

sentences.english: And be living in love, even as Christ had love for you, and gave himself up for us, an offering to God for a perfume of a sweet smell.
sentences.susu: Wo xa ɲɛrɛ xanunteya kui alɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi won xanuxi ki naxɛ, a a yɛtɛ fi won ma fe ra, a findi won ma sɛrɛxɛ ra naxan labundɛ xiri rafan Ala ma.

sentences.english: But evil acts of the flesh and all unclean things, or desire for others' property, let it not even be named among you, as is right for saints;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ langoeɲa, milɛ, nun sɛniyɛntareɲa mɔɔli yo naxa lu wo yi ra. E xa fe ɲan naxa fala wo tagi, barima na mu lan sɛniyɛntɔɛe ya ma.

sentences.english: And let there be no low behaviour, or foolish talk, or words said in sport, which are not right, but in place of them the giving of praise.
sentences.susu: Wɔyɛnyi masuturatare, daxuɲa wɔyɛnyi, wɔyɛn ɲaaxi, e sese naxa mɛ wo tagi. Na mu lan. Wo xa nu tantu wɔyɛnyi nan fala wo bore tagi.

sentences.english: Being certain of this, that no man who gives way to the passions of the flesh, no unclean person, or one who has desire for the property of others, or who gives worship to images, has any heritage in the kingdom of Christ and God.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon a fanyi ra, a langoe, sɛniyɛntare, a nun milante (naxan maniya kuye batui ra), e sese mu findixi kɛ tongoma ra Ala nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi xa mangɛya niini bun ma.

sentences.english: Do not be turned from the right way by foolish words; for because of these things the punishment of God comes on those who do not put themselves under him.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa a lu mixi yo xa wo madaxu wɔyɛnyi fufafu ra. Yi yunubi mɔɔlie xa fe ra, Ala xa xɔnɛ goroma nɛ mixie ma naxee mu a xui suxuma.

sentences.english: Have no part with such men;
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo naxa gbaku e ra.

sentences.english: For you at one time were dark, but now are light in the Lord: let your behaviour be that of children of light
sentences.susu: Singe, dimi nan nu wo ra, kɔnɔ yakɔsi, wo bara findi naiyalanyi ra Marigi saabui ra. Wo xa wo ɲɛrɛ alɔ a lan naiyalanyi xa die xa e ɲɛrɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: (Because the fruit of the light is in all righteousness and in everything which is good and true),
sentences.susu: Naiyalanyi xa wali toma fe fanyi birin, tinxinyi birin, nun nɔndi birin kui.

sentences.english: Testing by experience what is well-pleasing to the Lord;
sentences.susu: Wo xa kata wo xa kolon sɔtɔ fee ma naxee Ala kɛnɛnxi.

sentences.english: And have no company with the works of the dark, which give no fruit, but make their true quality clear;
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo gbe raso dimi xa wali kobi ya ma feo! Wo xa na fe mɔɔli ramini kɛnɛ ma.

sentences.english: For the things which are done by them in secret it is shame even to put into words.
sentences.susu: Barima na mixi mɔɔlie fe naxee rabama nɔxunyi kui, hali a ifalafe yɛtɛ mayaagi.

sentences.english: But all things, when their true quality is seen, are made clear by the light: because everything which is made clear is light.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ naiyalanyi fe naxan birin makɛnɛnma, a toma nɛ ya ra.

sentences.english: For this reason he says, Be awake, you who are sleeping, and come up from among the dead, and Christ will be your light.
sentences.susu: Fe naxan birin toma ya ra, a fan bara findi naiyalanyi ra. A falaxi na nan ma, «I tan naxan xife, xunu. Keli faxamixie ya ma, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa yanbɛ xa ti i ma.»

sentences.english: Take care then how you are living, not as unwise, but as wise;
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo mɛɛni wo ɲɛrɛ ki ma. Wo naxa wo ɲɛrɛ alɔ xaxilitaree. Wo xa wo ɲɛrɛ nɛ alɔ xaxilimae.

sentences.english: Making good use of the time, because the days are evil.
sentences.susu: Wo mɛɛni yi tɛmui ma, barima yi tɛmui mu fan.

sentences.english: For this reason, then, do not be foolish, but be conscious of the Lord's pleasure.
sentences.susu: Na na a ra, a mu lan wo xa wo ɲɛrɛ alɔ xaxilitare. Wo xa kolon sɔtɔ Marigi waxɔnfe ma.

sentences.english: And do not take overmuch wine by which one may be overcome, but be full of the Spirit;
sentences.susu: Wɛni naxa wo rasiisi, barima xaxilitareɲa nan na ki. Wo xa kamali Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nan na.

sentences.english: Joining with one another in holy songs of praise and of the Spirit, using your voice in songs and making melody in your heart to the Lord;
sentences.susu: Wo xa wɔyɛn wo bore bɛ suuki nun bɛɛti ra. Wo xa suukie nun bɛɛtie ba Marigi bɛ naxee kelima wo bɔɲɛ yati yati ma.

sentences.english: Giving praise at all times for all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;
sentences.susu: Wo xa tantui rasiga Baba Ala ma fe birin xa fe ra, tɛmui birin. Wo xa na raba Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Marigi Isa xili saabui ra.

sentences.english: Letting yourselves be ruled by one another in the fear of Christ.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo yɛtɛ magoro wo bore bɛ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa yaragaaxui kui.

sentences.english: Wives, be under the authority of your husbands, as of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ginɛe, wo xa wo yɛtɛ magoro wo xa mɔrie bɛ, alɔ wo wo yɛtɛ magoroma Marigi bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ is the head of the church, being himself the saviour of the body.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛ findixi a xa ginɛ xunyi nan na, alɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi findixi danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xunyi ra ki naxɛ. Danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama fan findixi a fate nan na, a bara naxan nakisi.

sentences.english: And as the church is under Christ's authority, so let wives be under the rule of their husbands in all things.
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama a yɛtɛ magoroma Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi bɛ ki naxɛ, ginɛe fan lanma e xa e yɛtɛ magoro e xa mɔrie bɛ na ki nɛ fe birin kui.

sentences.english: Husbands, have love for your wives, even as Christ had love for the church, and gave himself for it;
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛe, wo xa wo xa ginɛe xanu alɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xanuxi ki naxɛ. A a yɛtɛ fi danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xa fe ra

sentences.english: So that he might make it holy, having made it clean with the washing of water by the word,
sentences.susu: alako a xa a rasɛniyɛn, a xa a rafiixɛ ye ra masenyi saabui ra,

sentences.english: And might take it for himself, a church full of glory, not having one mark or fold or any such thing; but that it might be holy and complete.
sentences.susu: a xa a dɛntɛgɛ a yɛtɛ bɛ nɔrɛ kui. Na kui, danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama luma nɛ alɔ dugi tofanyi, xɔsi yo mu na naxan ma, naxan mu matɔrɔɲɔxi. A xa sɛniyɛn, tantanyi yo naxa lu a ma.

sentences.english: Even so it is right for husbands to have love for their wives as for their bodies. He who has love for his wife has love for himself:
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛe lanma e xa e xa ginɛe xanu na mɔɔli nan na. E xa e xanu alɔ e e yɛtɛ fate xanuxi ki naxɛ. Naxan a xa ginɛ xanuma, a a yɛtɛ nan xanuxi.

sentences.english: For no man ever had hate for his flesh; but he gives it food and takes care of it, even as Christ does for the church;
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu na naxan a yɛtɛ fate xɔnma, barima mixi birin a yɛtɛ rabaloma, a mɛɛni a yɛtɛ fate ma. Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi fan mɛɛnima danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama ma na ki nɛ,

sentences.english: Because we are parts of his body.
sentences.susu: barima won findixi a fate salonyie nan na.

sentences.english: For this cause will a man go away from his father and mother and be joined to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.
sentences.susu: «Na kui, xɛmɛ fama nɛ kelide a baba nun a nga xun ma, a a maso a xa ginɛ ra, e findi fate keren na.»

sentences.english: This is a great secret: but my words are about Christ and the church.
sentences.susu: Gundo belebele nan na ki, kɔnɔ n na Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nun danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama nan ma fe falafe.

sentences.english: But do you, everyone, have love for his wife, even as for himself; and let the wife see that she has respect for her husband.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ kankan xa a xa ginɛ xanu alɔ a yɛtɛ yati. Ginɛ fan lanma a xa a xa mɔri binya.

sentences.english: Children, do what is ordered by your fathers and mothers in the Lord: for this is right.
sentences.susu: Die, wo xa wo nga nun wo baba binya Marigi xa fe ra, barima na nan findi fe tinxinxi ra.

sentences.english: Give honour to your father and mother (which is the first rule having a reward),
sentences.susu: Yaamari singe nan ya, barakɛ laayidixi naxan xanbi ra: «I xa i nga nun i baba binya,

sentences.english: So that all may be well for you, and your life may be long on the earth.
sentences.susu: alako fee xa sɔɔnɛya i bɛ, i xa simaya sɔtɔ duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari.»

sentences.english: And, you fathers, do not make your children angry: but give them training in the teaching and fear of the Lord.
sentences.susu: Babae, wo fan naxa wo xa die raxɔnɔ. Wo xa e xuru, wo e rasi alɔ Marigi wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Servants, do what is ordered by those who are your natural masters, having respect and fear for them, with all your heart, as to Christ;
sentences.susu: Konyie, wo xa wo marigie sago raba, naxee na wo xun ma yi duniɲa ma. Wo xa e binya, wo gaaxu e ya ra. Wo xa e sago raba wo nii ra, alɔ wo Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi sago rabama ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Not only under your master's eye, as pleasers of men; but as servants of Christ, doing the pleasure of God from the heart;
sentences.susu: Wo naxa a raba e ya tode gbansan xa ra, alɔ naxee katama e yɛtɛ rafande mixi ma. Wo xa a raba nɛ alɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa konyie naxee Ala sago rabama e bɔɲɛ birin na.

sentences.english: Doing your work readily, as to the Lord, and not to men:
sentences.susu: Wo a raba wo tinxi ra. Wo naxa wali e bɛ alɔ wo na walife e tan gbansan nan ma fe ra. Wo xa wali nɛ alɔ wo na walife Marigi nan bɛ,

sentences.english: In the knowledge that for every good thing anyone does, he will have his reward from the Lord, If he is a servant or if he is free.
sentences.susu: barima wo a kolon, mixi fe fanyi yo raba, xa a findi konyi ra, xa a findi xɔrɛ ra, Marigi a sare fima nɛ.

sentences.english: And, you masters, do the same things to them, not making use of violent words: in the knowledge that their Master and yours is in heaven, and he has no respect for a man's position.
sentences.susu: Konyi marigie, wo fan xa a raba na ki nɛ wo xa konyie bɛ. Wo xa ba xaaɲɛfe e ma, barima wo a kolon Marigi keren nan na wo birin bɛ koore ma, naxan mu mixi yo rafisa a boore bɛ.

sentences.english: Lastly, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his power.
sentences.susu: A dɔnxɔɛ ra, wo xa wo sɛnbɛ so Marigi saabui ra nun a xa sɛnbɛ magaaxuxi saabui ra.

sentences.english: Take up God's instruments of war, so that you may be able to keep your position against all the deceits of the Evil One.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Ala xa geresose birin tongo, alako wo xa nɔ tide Ibulisa xa kɔɔta birin kanke.

sentences.english: For our fight is not against flesh and blood, but against authorities and powers, against the world-rulers of this dark night, against the spirits of evil in the heavens.
sentences.susu: Barima won mu na ibunadama xa gerefe. Mangɛe, nɔlae, yi duniɲa sɛnbɛma ɲaaxie, ɲinnɛ naxee na kuye ma, gere na won nun nee nan birin tagi.

sentences.english: For this reason take up all the arms of God, so that you may be able to be strong in the evil day, and, having done all, to keep your place.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, wo xa Ala xa geresose birin tongo alako na lɔxɔɛ kobi na a li, wo xa nɔ tide. Na gere raɲɔnyi xa wo li wo tixi.

sentences.english: Take your place, then, having your body clothed with the true word, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness;
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo xa ti nɛ. Wo wo tagi ixiri nɔndi ra. Wo tinxinyi findi wo kanke makantase ra.

sentences.english: Be ready with the good news of peace as shoes on your feet;
sentences.susu: Wakilife xibaaru fanyi masende naxan bɔɲɛsa fima mixi ma, wo xa na findi sankiri ra wo sanyie bɛ.

sentences.english: And most of all, using faith as a cover to keep off all the flaming arrows of the Evil One.
sentences.susu: Safe na birin xun ma, wo xa danxaniya suxu wo yi ra alɔ wure lefa. Na nan nɔma Sentanɛ xa tanbɛ radɛxɛxie ratide, a e raxuben.

sentences.english: And take salvation for your head-dress and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God:
sentences.susu: Wo man xa kisi suxu naxan findixi wo xun makantase ra. Wo Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa santidɛgɛma fan suxu naxan findixi Ala xa masenyi ra.

sentences.english: With prayers and deep desires, making requests at all times in the Spirit, and keeping watch, with strong purpose, in prayer for all the saints,
sentences.susu: Wo xa Ala maxandi tɛmui birin a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra, duba nun maxandi mɔɔli birin na. Na kui, wo naxa yanfa. Wo xa wo tunnabɛxi nɛ Ala maxandife ra sɛniyɛntɔɛ birin bɛ.

sentences.english: And for me, that words may be given to me in the opening of my mouth, to make clear without fear the secret of the good news,
sentences.susu: Wo xa Ala maxandi n fan bɛ, alako n na n dɛ ibi, Ala xa n mali a xa xibaaru fanyi gundo makɛnɛnde birin bɛ limaniya ra.

sentences.english: For which I am a representative in chains, and that I may say without fear the things which it is right for me to say.
sentences.susu: N findixi Ala xa santigi nan na yɔlɔnxɔnyi bara balan naxan ma na xibaaru fanyi xa fe ra. Wo xa Ala maxandi n bɛ alako n xa a masen limaniya ra alɔ n lan n xa a masen ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But so that you may have knowledge of my business, and how I am, Tychicus, the well-loved brother and tested servant in the Lord, will give you news of all things:
sentences.susu: Tikike n ma fe nun n ma wali xa fe birin masenma nɛ wo bɛ. Won ngaxakerenyi xanuxi nan a ra danxaniya kui. Tunnabɛxila nan a ra Marigi xa wali kui.

sentences.english: Whom I have sent to you for this very purpose, so that you may have knowledge of our position, and that he may give comfort to your hearts.
sentences.susu: N a xɛɛxi wo ma na nan ma, alako a xa muxu xa fe tagi raba wo bɛ, a man xa wo bɔɲɛ ralimaniya.

sentences.english: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Baba Ala nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi Marigi Isa xa bɔɲɛsa, xanunteya, nun danxaniya fi ngaxakerenyie ma.

sentences.english: Grace be with all those who have true love for our Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Ala xa hinnɛ fi birin ma Marigi Isa xa xanunteya mu ɲɔnma mixi naxee bɛ.

sentences.english: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, with the Bishops and Deacons of the church:
sentences.susu: N tan Pɔlu nun Timote, naxee findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa konyie ra, muxu bara wo xɛɛbu, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa sɛniyɛntɔɛ naxee na Filipi, a nun wo xa yareratie nun wo malimae.

sentences.english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Won Baba Ala nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi Marigi Isa xa hinnɛ nun bɔɲɛsa fi wo ma.

sentences.english: I give praise to my God at every memory of you,
sentences.susu: Tɛmui birin n na ratu wo ma, n Ala tantuma nɛ.

sentences.english: And in all my prayers for you all, making my request with joy,
sentences.susu: N Ala maxandima wo bɛ sɛɛwɛ ra tɛmui birin,

sentences.english: Because of your help in giving the good news from the first day till now;
sentences.susu: barima wo bara n mali Ala xa masenyi kawandife ra kabi a fɔlɛ han yakɔsi.

sentences.english: For I am certain of this very thing, that he by whom the good work was started in you will make it complete till the day of Jesus Christ:
sentences.susu: N a kolon, Ala, naxan wali fanyi fɔlɔxi wo tagi, a fama nɛ a rakamalide a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa fa lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: So it is right for me to take thought for you all in this way, because I have you in my heart; for in my chains, and in my arguments before the judges in support of the good news, making clear that it is true, you all have your part with me in grace.
sentences.susu: A lan nɛ yi xaxili xa lu n bɛ barima wo rafan n ma. Xa n na geeli kui, xa n na Ala xa xibaaru fanyi xunmageresofe kawandi ra, Ala hinnɛma nɛ won birin na.

sentences.english: For God is my witness, how my love goes out to you all in the loving mercies of Christ Jesus.
sentences.susu: Ala a kolon n wo xanuxi alɔ a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa wo xanuxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And my prayer is that you may be increased more and more in knowledge and experience;
sentences.susu: N Ala maxandima nɛ wo bɛ alako wo xa xanunteya xun xa masa fe kolonyi nun fahaamui tilinxi ra,

sentences.english: So that you may give your approval to the best things; that you may be true and without wrongdoing till the day of Christ;
sentences.susu: alako wo xa nɔ a kolonde fe naxan tide gbo. Na kui, wo bɔɲɛ xa fiixɛ, marakɔrɔsi yo naxa lu wo ma Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi fa lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: Being full of the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛ Isa fama nɛ wo matinxinde alako Ala xa matɔxɔ, a sɛnbɛ xa kolon.

sentences.english: Now it is my purpose to make clear to you, brothers, that the cause of the good news has been helped by my experiences;
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, wo xa a kolon, tɔɔrɛ naxan n lixi, na bara Inyila Isa masenyi wali rasɔɔnɛya,

sentences.english: So that it became clear through all the Praetorium, and to all the rest, that I was a prisoner on account of Christ;
sentences.susu: barima mangɛ xa sɔɔrie nun mixie birin bara a kolon n na geeli kui Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fe nan ma.

sentences.english: And most of the brothers in the Lord, taking heart because of my chains, are all the stronger to give the word of God without fear.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie bara limaniya Marigi xa fe ma n ma ɲaxankatɛ saabui ra. Yakɔsi e mu gaaxuma fefe ya ra, e Ala xa masenyi kawandima sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: Though some are preaching Christ out of envy and competition, others do it out of a good heart:
sentences.susu: Nɔndi nan a ra, ndee na Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fe kawandife milɛ nun tɔɔnɛ nan ma, kɔnɔ ndee fan na kawandi tife bɔɲɛ fanyi nan na.

sentences.english: These do it from love, conscious that I am responsible for the cause of the good news:
sentences.susu: Nee a rabafe xanunteya nan na, barima e a kolon a n findixi Xibaaru Fanyi xunmagereso nan na.

sentences.english: But those are preaching Christ in a spirit of competition, not from their hearts, but with the purpose of giving me pain in my prison.
sentences.susu: Booree Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fe kawandima e xa yɛtɛ igboɲa nan na. E bɔɲɛ mu fiixɛ. E ɲɔxɔ a ma a e nɔma n ma geeli ɲaxankatɛ xun masade e xa kawandi ra.

sentences.english: What then? only that in every way, falsely or truly, the preaching of Christ goes on; and in this I am glad, and will be glad.
sentences.susu: Fefe mu a ra. Xa e bɔɲɛ fiixɛ, xa e bɔɲɛ mu fiixɛ, e na Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fe masenfe. Yi findima sɛɛwɛ nan na n bɛ to nun tina,

sentences.english: For I am conscious that this will be for my salvation, through your prayer and the giving out of the stored wealth of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
sentences.susu: barima n a kolon fe naxee bara n li, e findima kisi nan na n bɛ wo xa Ala maxandi saabui ra nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa Xaxili xa mali saabui ra.

sentences.english: In the measure of my strong hope and belief that in nothing will I be put to shame, but that without fear, as at all times, so now will Christ have glory in my body, by life or by death.
sentences.susu: N a kolon n fe birin nabama alako n naxa yaagi fefe ra. N xa limaniya yakɔsi alɔ tɛmui dangixi alako Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa matɔxɔɛ sɔtɔ n ma simaya xa na mu n ma faxɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: For to me life is Christ and death is profit.
sentences.susu: N ma duniɲɛigiri kui, n birama nɛ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi fɔxɔ ra. N ma faxɛ findima fe fanyi nan na n bɛ,

sentences.english: But if I go on living in the flesh — if this is the fruit of my work — then I do not see what decision to make.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ xa n lu duniɲa, n nɔma nɛ wali gbegbe rabade Ala bɛ. Awa, n munse rabama? N mu a kolon.

sentences.english: I am in a hard position between the two, having a desire to go away and be with Christ, which is very much better:
sentences.susu: Na fe na n bɛndunfe yire firin. A xɔli n ma n xa keli be, n xa siga Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi yire. Na fan dangi fe birin na.

sentences.english: Still, to go on in the flesh is more necessary because of you.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a lanma n xa lu duniɲa wo tan ma fe ra.

sentences.english: And being certain of this, I am conscious that I will go on, yes, and go on with you all, for your growth and joy in the faith;
sentences.susu: N bara a kolon n luma nɛ wo ya ma alako wo xa siga yare, wo man xa sɛɛwa danxaniya kui.

sentences.english: So that your pride in me may be increased in Christ Jesus through my being present with you again.
sentences.susu: N na gbilen wo yire, wo xa matɔxɔɛ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa bɛ, na xun fama masade n ma fe ra.

sentences.english: Only let your behaviour do credit to the good news of Christ, so that if I come and see you or if I am away from you, I may have news of you that you are strong in one spirit, working together with one soul for the faith of the good news;
sentences.susu: Wo ɲɛrɛ ki xa lan Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa Xibaaru Fanyi ma tun, alako xa n na wo ya ma ba, xa n mu na ba, n nɔma a kolonde xaxili keren nan na wo bɛ, wo birin walife danxaniya keren nan na, danxaniya naxan fatanxi Ala xa Xibaaru Fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Having no fear of those who are against you; which is a clear sign of their destruction, but of your salvation, and that from God;
sentences.susu: Wo naxa gaaxu wo gerefae ya ra. Wo xa limaniya findixi tɔnxuma nan na e bɛ e lɔɛfe ra, wo fan xa a kolon wo kisima nɛ.

sentences.english: Because to you it has been given in the cause of Christ not only to have faith in him, but to undergo pain on his account:
sentences.susu: Na kisi kelixi Ala nan ma, barima a bara hinnɛ wo ra dɔxɔ firin: Wo danxaniyafe Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ma, a nun wo man tɔɔrɔfe a bɛ,

sentences.english: Fighting the same fight which you saw in me, and now have word of in me.
sentences.susu: alɔ wo n fan to tɔɔrɔ ra ki naxɛ. Alɔ wo man bara a mɛ ki naxɛ, han ya n na na tɔɔrɛ nan kui.

sentences.english: If then there is any comfort in Christ, any help given by love, any uniting of hearts in the Spirit, any loving mercies and pity,
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi to madundui nde fima wo ma, a xa xanunteya to limaniya nde fima wo ma, lanyi to na wo nun Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi tagi, xanunteya nun kinikini nde to na wo yi ra,

sentences.english: Make my joy complete by being of the same mind, having the same love, being in harmony and of one mind;
sentences.susu: wo xa n ma ɲɛlɛxinyi rakamali. Wo lu lanyi kui. Xaxili keren, xanunteya keren, nun ɲɛrɛ ki keren nan xa lu wo tagi.

sentences.english: Doing nothing through envy or through pride, but with low thoughts of self let everyone take others to be better than himself;
sentences.susu: Wo naxa fefe raba tɔɔnɛ kui. Wo naxa wo yɛtɛ rafisa wo booree bɛ. Wo nde ba wo xa fe ra, wo a sa wo boore gbe xun yɛtɛ magore kui.

sentences.english: Not looking everyone to his private good, but keeping in mind the things of others.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo yɛtɛ xa munafanyi fen. Wo wo booree nan ma munafanyi fen.

sentences.english: Let this mind be in you which was in Christ Jesus,
sentences.susu: Wo yuge xa lu alɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa.

sentences.english: To whom, though himself in the form of God, it did not seem that to take for oneself was to be like God;
sentences.susu: Kabi abadan, a nu na Ala kɛɲa nɛ, kɔnɔ a mu tin a xa a yɛtɛ tide sa Ala ilanyi.

sentences.english: But he made himself as nothing, taking the form of a servant, being made like men;
sentences.susu: A naxa diɲɛ a yɛtɛ birin ma, a tin lude konyi kɛɲa ma, a bari duniɲa ma alɔ adamadi, mixie fan naxa a kolon adamadi ra.

sentences.english: And being seen in form as a man, he took the lowest place, and let himself be put to death, even the death of the cross.
sentences.susu: A naxa a yɛtɛ magoro, a xa Ala sago raba, han a naxa tin faxɛ ra wuri magalanbuxi ma.

sentences.english: For this reason God has put him in the highest place and has given to him the name which is greater than every name;
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi Ala naxa a binya, a a xili gbo dangi xili birin na,

sentences.english: So that at the name of Jesus every knee may be bent, of those in heaven and those on earth and those in the underworld,
sentences.susu: alako naxee na koore, naxee na bɔxi, naxee na bɔxi bun ma, e na Isa xili mɛ tɛmui naxɛ, e birin xa e xinbi sin a bun,

sentences.english: And that every tongue may give witness that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.
sentences.susu: e xa a fala, «Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa nan na Marigi ra.» Na xa findi matɔxɔɛ ra Baba Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: So then, my loved ones, as you have at all times done what I say, not only when I am present, but now much more when I am not with you, give yourselves to working out your salvation with fear in your hearts;
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie, wo bara n xui suxu n nu na wo tagi tɛmui naxɛ. Yakɔsi fan, wo xa Ala xa yaamarie rabatu n xanbi dangife a singe ra. Wo xa gaaxu Ala ya ra, wo xa wakili wo xa kisi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For it is God who is the cause of your desires and of your acts, for his good pleasure.
sentences.susu: Ala nan fe ragirima wo ma alako wo ɲanige xa lan a gbe ma, wo xa a waxɔnfe raba.

sentences.english: Do all things without protests and arguments;
sentences.susu: Wo nɛ fefe rabama wo naxa wo yaxaseri masa, wo naxa sɔnxɔ,

sentences.english: So that you may be holy and gentle, children of God without sin in a twisted and foolish generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,
sentences.susu: alako nɔndi nun sɛniyɛnyi xa lu wo bɛ, wo tan Ala xa die naxee yanbama alɔ tɛ dɛxɛ yi duniɲa mixi ɲaaxi tinxintaree ya ma,

sentences.english: Offering the word of life; so that I may have glory in you in the day of Christ, because my running was not for nothing and my work was not without effect.
sentences.susu: wo nɛ kisi masenyi tima tɛmui naxɛ. Na kui, n matɔxɔɛ sɔtɔma Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi fa lɔxɔɛ, barima n mu duniɲa igirixi tɔɔrɛ kui fufafu ra.

sentences.english: And even if I am offered like a drink offering, giving myself for the cause and work of your faith, I am glad and have joy with you all:
sentences.susu: Hali n faxa wo bɛ, n ma duniɲɛigiri fama findide wo bɛ sɛrɛxɛ nan na naxan sama wo xa danxaniya sɛrɛxɛ xun ma. Na n nasɛɛwama nɛ.

sentences.english: And in the same way do you be glad and have a part in my joy.
sentences.susu: Wo fan xa sɛɛwa, won birin xa sɛɛwa.

sentences.english: But I am hoping in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you before long, so that I may be comforted when I have news of you.
sentences.susu: N bara n xaxili ti Marigi Isa ra a xa n mali alako n xa Timote xɛɛ wo ma, alako a xa n nalimaniya wo xa xibaaru ra.

sentences.english: For I have no man of like mind who will truly have care for you.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu na n yi ra, wo xa fe rafan naxan ma alɔ a tan.

sentences.english: For they all go after what is theirs, not after the things of Christ.
sentences.susu: Birin wama e yɛtɛ kan xa geeni nan xɔn ma, e mu na Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa geeni xa fenfe.

sentences.english: But his quality is clear to you; how, as a child is to its father, so he was a help to me in the work of the good news.
sentences.susu: Wo a kolon Timote bara a tunnabɛxi tɔɔrɛ kui Ala xa Xibaaru Fanyi xa fe ra. Kabi a naxa wali fɔlɔ n sɛɛti ma tɛmui naxɛ, a bara lu alɔ di naxan birama a baba fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Him then I am hoping to send as quickly as possible, when I am able to see how things will go for me:
sentences.susu: Na kui, a xɔli n ma n xa a xɛɛ wo yire, n ma fe makɛnɛnma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: But I have faith in the Lord that I myself will come before long.
sentences.susu: N a kolon a gbe mu luxi, Ala xa a ragiri n xa fa wo yire.

sentences.english: But it seemed to me necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, who has taken part with me in the work and in the fight, and your servant, sent by you for help in my need;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n ma maɲɔxunyi ma, fo n xa n ngaxakerenyi Epaforodite xɛɛ wo yire. A bara n mali ki fanyi ra Ala xa fe geremaso kui, alɔ wo a xɛɛxi n ma fe naxan ma.

sentences.english: Because his heart was with you all, and he was greatly troubled because you had news that he was ill:
sentences.susu: Wo to xɔli bara a suxu ki fanyi. A bara kɔntɔfili barima wo bara a xa fure fe mɛ.

sentences.english: For in fact he was ill almost to death: but God had mercy on him; and not only on him but on me, so that I might not have grief on grief.
sentences.susu: A fura nɛ a ɲaaxi ra. A gbe mu nu luxi a xa faxa, kɔnɔ Ala naxa kinikini a ma. Ala naxa kinikini n fan ma, alako na sunnunyi naxa sa n ma tɔɔrɛ xun.

sentences.english: I have sent him, then, the more gladly, so that when you see him again, you may be happy and I may have the less sorrow.
sentences.susu: Na na a ra n bara gbata a xɛɛfe ra wo ma alako wo xa ɲɛlɛxin a tofe ra, n fan bɔɲɛ ndedi xa sa.

sentences.english: So take him to your hearts in the Lord with all joy, and give honour to such as he is:
sentences.susu: Wo xa a rasɛnɛ Marigi xili ra sɛɛwɛ kui. Wo xa yi mixi mɔɔli binya,

sentences.english: Because for the work of Christ he was near to death, putting his life in danger to make your care for me complete.
sentences.susu: barima a mu tondi fefe yo ra Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa wali kui, hali a findi a bɛ faxɛ ra. A bara n mali wo tan mu nu nɔma n malide naxee ra.

sentences.english: For the rest, my brothers, be glad in the Lord. Writing the same things to you is no trouble to me, and for you it is safe.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, n ngaxakerenyie, wo xa sɛɛwa wo Marigi ra. N mu taganma gbilende fee tagi rabade wo bɛ, n naxee sɛbɛxi wo ma tɛmui dangixi, alako na xa wo ratanga.

sentences.english: Be on the watch against dogs, against the workers of evil, against those of the circumcision:
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo yɛtɛ ratanga mixi ɲaaxie ma, wali kobi rabae naxee wama finɛ rawalife tun mixi sunnafe ma.

sentences.english: For we are the circumcision, who give worship to God and have glory in Jesus Christ, and have no faith in the flesh:
sentences.susu: Won tan nan na mixi sunnaxie ra a nɔndi ki ma, won tan naxee Ala batuma a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra, naxee sɛɛwama Isa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fe ra, naxee mu e xaxili tima e yɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: Even though I myself might have faith in the flesh: if any other man has reason to have faith in the flesh, I have more:
sentences.susu: Xa n wa, n fan nɔma n xaxili tide n yɛtɛ ra. Xa mixi nde a maɲɔxunxi nɛ a a nɔma a xaxili tide a yɛtɛ ra, n dangi na kanyi ra pon!

sentences.english: Being given circumcision on the eighth day, of the nation of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; in relation to the law, a Pharisee:
sentences.susu: N sunnaxi a xi solomasaxan lɔxɔɛ nɛ, Isirayilaka nan n na, naxan kelixi Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ, Eburu yati yati nan lanxi n ma n bari ki ma.

sentences.english: In bitter hate I was cruel to the church; I kept all the righteousness of the law to the last detail.
sentences.susu: N nu biraxi Ala xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra a Farisɛni ki nɛ, n nu fa Isa xa danxaniyatɔɛe ɲaxankata. Marakɔrɔsi ɲaaxi yo mu nu na n ma.

sentences.english: But those things which were profit to me, I gave up for Christ.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi, n to bara danxaniya Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ma, n nu se naxan birin maɲɔxunxi fe fanyie ra, e tide yo mu na n bɛ sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Yes truly, and I am ready to give up all things for the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord, which is more than all: for whom I have undergone the loss of all things, and to me they are less than nothing, so that I may have Christ as my reward,
sentences.susu: Marigi Isa kolonfe nan tide gbo nee birin bɛ. Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi sɔtɔfe dangi na fe birin na, n bara naxee lu a xa fe ra. Na fee bara lu n bɛ alɔ fee fufafu alako n xa Isa xa munafanyi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And be seen in him, not having my righteousness which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is of God by faith:
sentences.susu: N xa lu a tan nan ma fe, barima n yɛtɛ sɛnbɛ mu nɔma n findide mixi tinxinxi ra. N mu nɔma Ala xa sɛriyɛ birin nabatude. Kɔnɔ xa n bara danxaniya Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ma, Ala tan nɔma nɛ n matinxinde. Ala nan mixi matinxinma danxaniya saabui ra.

sentences.english: That I may have knowledge of him, and of the power of his coming back from the dead, and a part with him in his pains, becoming like him in his death;
sentences.susu: Na kui, n wama naxan xɔn, n xa Isa kolon. N xa a xa marakeli sɛnbɛ kolon, n man xa tɔɔrɔ alɔ a tɔɔrɔxi ki naxɛ. N wama lufe nɛ alɔ Isa nu na ki naxɛ a faxa tɛmui,

sentences.english: If in any way I may have the reward of life from the dead.
sentences.susu: alako n fan xa keli faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: Not as if I had even now got the reward or been made complete: but I go on in the hope that I may come to the knowledge of that for which I was made the servant of Christ Jesus.
sentences.susu: N a kolon n mu nu gɛ na birin sɔtɔde sinden, n ma fe mu gɛxi kamalide. Kɔnɔ n xa siga yare alako Isa n sugandixi fe naxan ma, n fan xa a xa fe suxu.

sentences.english: Brothers, it is clear to me that I have not come to that knowledge; but one thing I do, letting go those things which are past, and stretching out to the things which are before,
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, n a kolon n mu gɛxi a suxude sinden, kɔnɔ n fe keren nan nabama: N mu n kobe ratoma, n sigama yare nan tun ma.

sentences.english: I go forward to the mark, even the reward of the high purpose of God in Christ Jesus.
sentences.susu: N birama nɛ n ma wali fɔxɔ ra, alako n xa sare sɔtɔ Koore Mangɛ Ala won xilixi naxan ma a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa saabui ra.

sentences.english: Then let us all, who have come to full growth, be of this mind: and if in anything you are of a different mind, even this will God make clear to you:
sentences.susu: Won tan naxee xa danxaniya bara tilin, a lanma na maɲɔxunyi nan xa lu won birin yi ra. Kɔnɔ xa a sa li mixi nde mu lanxi na fe ma, Ala fama na fan fiixɛde na kanyi bɛ.

sentences.english: Only, as far as we have got, let us be guided by the same rule.
sentences.susu: Won xa siga yare alɔ won darixi a ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Brothers, take me as your example, and take note of those who are walking after the example we have given.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, wo xa n fɔxi raba. Mixi naxee ɲɛrɛ ki luxi alɔ muxu gbe, nee nan xa findi misaali ra wo bɛ.

sentences.english: For there are those, of whom I have given you word before, and do so now with sorrow, who are haters of the cross of Christ;
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi yaxuie bara wuya, naxee mu lama a xa sɛrɛxɛ ra wuri magalanbuxi ma. N ɲan bara na fala wo bɛ sanya wuyaxi, kɔnɔ yakɔsi n a masenma nɛ wo bɛ n yaye ra.

sentences.english: Whose end is destruction, whose god is the stomach, and whose glory is in their shame, whose minds are fixed on the things of the earth.
sentences.susu: E bara lɔɛ. E yɛtɛ waxɔnfe bara findi e xa ala ra. E naxan itema, na nan fama e ragorode. E birama yi duniɲa gbansan nan fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: For our country is in heaven; from where the Saviour for whom we are waiting will come, even the Lord Jesus Christ:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ won tan xɔnyi na ariyanna nan na, won nakisima Marigi Isa kelima dɛnnaxɛ fafe ra won fɔxɔ ra. Won na na nan mamɛfe.

sentences.english: By whom this poor body of ours will be changed into the image of the body of his glory, in the measure of the working by which he is able to put all things under himself.
sentences.susu: A fama nɛ won fate makinikinixie masarade, e xa lu nɔrɛ kui alɔ a gbe. A na rabama a sɛnbɛ nan na, naxan dangi sɛnbɛ birin nalanxi ra.

sentences.english: So my brothers, well loved and very dear to me, my joy and crown, be strong in the Lord, my loved ones.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, a xɔli n ma n xa siga wo xɛɛbude. N bara ɲɛlɛxin wo xa fe ra, naxan bara a niya n xa binyɛ sɔtɔ. N xanuntenyie, wo bira Marigi fɔxɔ ra alɔ wo darixi a ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: I make request to Euodias and Syntyche to be of the same mind in the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ewodiye nun Sintike, yandi wo xa lan wo bore ma Marigi xa fe kui.

sentences.english: And I make request to you, true helper in my work, to see to the needs of those women who took part with me in the good news, with Clement and the rest of my brother-workers whose names are in the book of life.
sentences.susu: N malima fanyi, n bara i maxandi, i xa e mali, barima e fan bara n mali n ma kawandi tife geremaso kui. Kilementi fan bara n mali, alɔ n walibooree naxee xilie sɛbɛxi kisi buki kui.

sentences.english: Be glad in the Lord at all times: again I say, Be glad.
sentences.susu: Wo sɛɛwa Marigi ra tɛmui birin. N man xa a fala wo bɛ, wo xa sɛɛwa.

sentences.english: Let your gentle behaviour be clear to all men. The Lord is near.
sentences.susu: Wo xa bɔɲɛ bɛxi xa makɛnɛn birin bɛ. Marigi mu buma fafe ra sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Have no cares; but in everything with prayer and praise put your requests before God.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa kɔntɔfili fefe ra, wo xa Ala maxandi fe birin kui, wo xa a mayandi, wo xa a tantu.

sentences.english: And the peace of God, which is deeper than all knowledge, will keep your hearts and minds in Christ Jesus.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Ala bɔɲɛsa nun xaxilisa fima nɛ wo ma naxan mɔɔli mu toma yi duniɲa fari. A na rabama a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: For the rest, my brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things have honour, whatever things are upright, whatever things are holy, whatever things are beautiful, whatever things are of value, if there is any virtue and if there is any praise, give thought to these things.
sentences.susu: Dɔnxɔɛ ra, wo xa wo xaxili dɔxɔ yi fee nan xɔn ma: fe naxan yo findi nɔndi ra, naxan yo findi sɔɔbɛ ra, naxan yo tinxin, naxan yo sɛniyɛn, naxan yo fan, naxan yo findi sɛriyɛ ra, naxan yo rafan Ala ma. Wo xa wo xaxili dɔxɔ yi fee nan xɔn binyɛ nun tantui na naxee kui.

sentences.english: The things which came to you by my teaching and preaching, and which you saw in me, these things do, and the God of peace will be with you.
sentences.susu: N naxan masenxi wo bɛ, wo naxan toxi n ma misaali kui, wo bira na fɔxɔ ra. Na kui, Bɔɲɛsa Mangɛ luma nɛ wo sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: But I am very glad in the Lord that your care for me has come to life again; though you did in fact take thought for me, but you were not able to give effect to it.
sentences.susu: N bara Marigi tantu wo xa fe ra barima wo man bara wo ɲɔxɔ sa n xɔn. Singe wo nu bara wa n malife, kɔnɔ Ala mu a ragiri.

sentences.english: But I will not say anything about my needs, for I am able, wherever I am, to be dependent on myself.
sentences.susu: N mu yi falaxi xɛ barima n hayi to na se nde ma. N bara n matinkan n xa wasa so se naxan na n yi ra.

sentences.english: It is the same to me if I am looked down on or honoured; everywhere and in all things I have the secret of how to be full and how to go without food; how to have wealth and how to be in need.
sentences.susu: Xa sese yo mu na n yi ra, xa se gbegbe na n yi ra, a birin fan. Xa kaamɛ n suxuxi, xa n lugaxi, n bara wasa a birin na. Xa n bannaxi, xa n tɔɔrɔxi, n bara sɛɛwa a birin na.

sentences.english: I am able to do all things through him who gives me strength.
sentences.susu: N nɔma fe birin na n Marigi saabui ra, naxan sɛnbɛ fima n ma.

sentences.english: But you did well to have care for me in my need.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo fan fe fanyi nan nabaxi n bɛ n malife ra n ma tɔɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: And you have knowledge, Philippians, that when the good news first came to you, when I went away from Macedonia, no church took part with me in the business of giving to the saints, but you only;
sentences.susu: Filipikae, wo a kolon, kabi n naxa keli Masedon bɔxi Inyila Isa kawandi tife ra, danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama yo mu n mali fe nde ra fo wo tan.

sentences.english: Because even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to me in my need.
sentences.susu: Wo tan nan na rabaxi. Wo naxa n mali sanya firin n nu na Tɛsaloniki tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: Not that I am looking for an offering, but for fruit which may be put to your credit.
sentences.susu: N mu na sese fenfe n yɛtɛ bɛ. A xɔli n ma wo tan nan xa fe fanyi sɔtɔ a kui.

sentences.english: I have all things and more than enough: I am made full, having had from Epaphroditus the things which came from you, a perfume of a sweet smell, an offering well pleasing to God.
sentences.susu: N hayi na naxan birin ma, n bara a sɔtɔ. Wo naxan nasanbaxi n ma Epaforodite saabui ra, a bara n wasa han a bara dangi a i. Na sɛrɛxɛ bara rafan Ala ma, a a kɛnɛn.

sentences.english: And my God will give you all you have need of from the wealth of his glory in Christ Jesus.
sentences.susu: N Marigi Ala fama fe birin fide wo ma wo hayi na naxan ma. Fɛɛrɛ birin na a tan nan yi ra, a na birin nabama a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: Now to God our Father be glory for ever and ever. So be it.
sentences.susu: Ala tantu, Ala tantu. Ala naxan findi won Baba ra, won a tantuma nɛ han duniɲa raɲɔnyi.

sentences.english: Give words of love to every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me send you their love.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Isa xa sɛniyɛntɔɛ birin xɛɛbu.

sentences.english: All the saints send their love to you, specially those who are of Caesar's house.
sentences.susu: Sɛniyɛntɔɛ birin naxee na n sɛɛti ma, a gbengbenyi naxee walife Mangɛ Sesare xɔnyi, e bara wo xɛɛbu.

sentences.english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
sentences.susu: Marigi Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, xa hinnɛ wo birin na.

sentences.english: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ, by the purpose of God, and Timothy our brother,
sentences.susu: N tan Pɔlu nan yi ki, Ala a ragirixi naxan xa findi Isa xa xɛɛra ra. Muxu nun Timote nan yi bataaxɛ sɛbɛfe

sentences.english: To the saints and true brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father.
sentences.susu: wo tan ma, Kɔlɔsikae sɛniyɛntɔɛe. Wo bara findi n ngaxakerenyi danxaniyatɔɛ ra barima wo laxi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra. Won Baba Ala xa hinnɛ nun bɔɲɛsa fi wo ma.

sentences.english: We give praise to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, making prayer for you at all times,
sentences.susu: Muxu bara Ala tantu, won Marigi Isa Baba. Muxu Ala maxandima wo bɛ tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: After hearing of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which you have for all the saints,
sentences.susu: Muxu yi nan mɛxi, wo bara danxaniya Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa ma, wo man bara Ala xa sɛniyɛntɔɛ birin xanu.

sentences.english: Through the hope which is in store for you in heaven; knowledge of which was given to you before in the true word of the good news,
sentences.susu: Wo xaxili tixi fe ra Ala naxan nagataxi wo ya ra koore ma. Wo xa danxaniya nun wo xa xanunteya kelima na nan ma. Wo bara na birin mɛ Ala xa nɔndi kui naxan findixi xibaaru fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Which has come to you; and which in all the world is giving fruit and increase, as it has done in you from the day when it came to your ears and you had true knowledge of the grace of God;
sentences.susu: Na xibaaru fanyi bara findi geeni ra duniɲa birin bɛ. A man bara findi geeni ra wo bɛ wo Ala xa hinnɛ yati kolonxi tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: As it was given to you by Epaphras, our well-loved helper, who is a true servant of Christ for us,
sentences.susu: Won ngaxakerenyi, muxu waliboore Epafirasi nan wo xaranxi na nɔndi ra. A bara findi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa walikɛ tinxinxi ra wo bɛ.

sentences.english: And who, himself, made clear to us your love in the Spirit.
sentences.susu: A bara a masen muxu bɛ a wo mixi xanuma Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra.

sentences.english: For this reason, we, from the day when we had word of it, keep on in prayer for you, that you may be full of the knowledge of his purpose, with all wisdom and experience of the Spirit,
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, muxu fan, kafi muxu naxa na kolon, muxu Ala maxandife nɛ wo bɛ tɛmui birin, a xa fahaamui nun xaxili fanyi fi wo ma alako wo xa Ala sago kolon a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Living uprightly in the approval of the Lord, giving fruit in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo ɲɛrɛ alɔ won Marigi wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ. Wo xa fe fanyi mɔɔli birin naba. Wo xa Ala kolon a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Full of strength in the measure of the great power of his glory, so that you may undergo all troubles with joy;
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ a xa sɛnbɛ magaaxuxi saabui ra, alako wo xa wo tunnabɛxi, wo man xa diɲɛ,

sentences.english: Giving praise to the Father who has given us a part in the heritage of the saints in light;
sentences.susu: wo man xa Baba Ala tantu sɛɛwɛ kui. A bara a ragiri wo xa nɔ sɛniyɛntɔɛe kɛ sɔtɔde naiyalanyi kui.

sentences.english: Who has made us free from the power of evil and given us a place in the kingdom of the Son of his love;
sentences.susu: A bara won namini Sentanɛ xa nɔɛ bun ma, naxan findixi dimi ra, a won naso a xa Di xanuxi xa mangɛya niini bun ma.

sentences.english: In whom we have our salvation, the forgiveness of sins:
sentences.susu: Na di bara won xunsara, a bara won ma yunubie xafari.

sentences.english: Who is the image of the unseen God coming into existence before all living things;
sentences.susu: Ala mu toma, kɔnɔ a xa Di findixi a misaali nan na. Daali birin fisamante nan a ra.

sentences.english: For by him all things were made, in heaven and on earth, things seen and things unseen, authorities, lords, rulers, and powers; all things were made by him and for him;
sentences.susu: A tan nan se birin daa, naxan na koore ma, naxan na bɔxi ma, naxan toma, naxan mu toma, mangɛe, yaamaritɔɛe, nɔlae, sɛnbɛmae. Na birin daaxi a saabui nan na, na birin daaxi a yɛtɛ nan bɛ.

sentences.english: He is before all things, and in him all things have being.
sentences.susu: Beenun se keren xa daa, a tan nu na. A birin na na a tan nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: And he is the head of the body, the church: the starting point of all things, the first to come again from the dead; so that in all things he might have the chief place.
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xunyi na a tan nan na. Na luma nɛ alɔ a fate yati yati. A tan nan na fe birin fɔlɛ ra. A tan nan singe rakeli faxɛ ma, alako a xa findi duniɲa fisamante ra.

sentences.english: For God in full measure was pleased to be in him;
sentences.susu: A naxa rafan Ala ma a xa Isa rakamali Ala xa fe birin na.

sentences.english: Through him uniting all things with himself, having made peace through the blood of his cross; through him, I say, uniting all things which are on earth or in heaven.
sentences.susu: A man bara tin fe birin masode a ra a xa Di xa faxɛ saabui ra. Bɔɲɛsa xa lu Ala nun duniɲa birin tagi, naxan na koore nun bɔxi ma. Na lanyi bara lu e tagi Ala xa Di wuli saabui ra, naxan banban wuri magalanbuxi ma.

sentences.english: And you, who in the past were cut off and at war with God in your minds through evil works, he has now made one
sentences.susu: Singe ra, wo tan nun Ala, wo tagi nu ikuya. A yaxuie yati yati nan nu na wo ra, barima wo nu fe ɲaaxie maɲɔxunma, wo man nu e rabama.

sentences.english: In the body of his flesh through death, so that you might be holy and without sin and free from all evil before him:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi, lanyi bara lu wo tagi Ala xa Di xa faxɛ saabui ra, alako wo xa sɛniyɛn, wo xa ti Ala ya i, tantanyi nun marakɔrɔsi yo mu na wo ma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: If you keep yourselves safely based in the faith, not moved from the hope of the good news which came to you, and which was given to every living being under heaven; of which I, Paul, was made a servant.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a lanma nɛ wo xa danxaniya xa sabati, a xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ, alako wo naxa makuya fe fanyi ra naxan nagataxi wo bɛ Ala xa xibaaru fanyi saabui ra. Na xibaaru fanyi wo naxan mɛxi, a masenxi nɛ duniɲa birin bɛ. N tan yati walima na nan ma.

sentences.english: Now I have joy in my pain because of you, and in my flesh I undergo whatever is still needed to make the sorrows of Christ complete, for the salvation of his body, the church;
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi, n bara ɲɛlɛxin n tɔɔrɔfe ma wo xa fe ra. N yɛtɛ yati fama Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa tɔɔrɛ rakamalide danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xa fe ra, naxan luxi alɔ a fate.

sentences.english: Of which I became a servant by the purpose of God which was given to me for you, to give effect to the word of God,
sentences.susu: N bara findi danxaniyatɔɛe ɲama xa walikɛ ra. Ala bara n xɛɛ n xa a xa masenyi birin tagi raba wo bɛ.

sentences.english: The secret which has been kept from all times and generations, but has now been made clear to his saints,
sentences.susu: Na gundo nu nɔxunxi nɛ mixi birin ma, kabi tɛmui xɔnnakuye. Kɔnɔ yakɔsi, Ala bara na masen a fiixɛ ra a xa sɛniyɛntɔɛe birin bɛ.

sentences.english: To whom God was pleased to give knowledge of the wealth of the glory of this secret among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
sentences.susu: A waxi nɛ na gundo xa masen e bɛ si birin tagi, e xa a xa nɔrɛ tofanyi to. Na gundo nan yi ki, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi na wo i, a tan nan nɔxi a niyade wo xa a xa nɔrɛ sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Whom we are preaching; guiding and teaching every man in all wisdom, so that every man may be complete in Christ;
sentences.susu: Muxu Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan ma fe masenma adamadi birin bɛ. Muxu e birin xaranma nɛ lɔnni ra, alako mixi birin xa kamali Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi saabui ra.

sentences.english: And for this purpose I am working, using all my strength by the help of his power which is working in me strongly.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, n na walife Isa sɛnbɛ ra, naxan n malima a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: For it is my desire to give you news of the great fight I am making for you and for those at Laodicea, and for all who have not seen my face in the flesh;
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon n na gere masofe wo bɛ, n na gere masofe Layodiseyakae nun danxaniyatɔɛ birin bɛ, naxee n kolon kɔnɔ e mu n toxi sinden.

sentences.english: So that their hearts may be comforted, and that being joined together in love, they may come to the full wealth of the certain knowledge of the secret of God, even Christ,
sentences.susu: N na gere maso kui alako wo bɔɲɛ xa limaniya, wo xa boni wo bore ra xanunteya kui, wo man xa xaxili fanyi sɔtɔ. Na kui, wo nɔma nɛ Ala xa gundo kolonde. Na gundo findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan na.

sentences.english: In whom are all the secret stores of wisdom and knowledge.
sentences.susu: Lɔnni fanyi nun fe kolonyi nɔxunxi Isa nan ma fe kui.

sentences.english: I say this so that you may not be turned away by any deceit of words.
sentences.susu: N na falaxi nɛ, alako mixi yo naxa nɔ wo madaxude wɔyɛnyi tofanyie ra.

sentences.english: For though I am not present in the flesh, still I am with you in the spirit, seeing with joy your order, and your unchanging faith in Christ.
sentences.susu: N makuya wo ra, kɔnɔ n bɔɲɛ na wo sɛɛti ma. N bara ɲɛlɛxin, barima wo na ɲɛrɛfe a fanyi ra wo xa danxaniya kui. Wo mu Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi bɛɲinma fefe ma.

sentences.english: As, then, you took Christ Jesus the Lord, so go on in him,
sentences.susu: Wo to bara tin wo Marigi Isa xa fe ra, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, wo lan nɛ wo xa bira a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Rooted and based together in him, strong in the faith which the teaching gave you, giving praise to God at all times.
sentences.susu: Isa xa lu wo bɛ alɔ sanke na sansi bɛ ki naxɛ. A xa lu wo bɛ alɔ fanye, banxi tima naxan fari. Wo xa danxaniya xa sabati alɔ muxu wo xaranxi ki naxɛ. Wo xa Ala tantu tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Take care that no one takes you away by force, through man's wisdom and deceit, going after the beliefs of men and the theories of the world, and not after Christ:
sentences.susu: Wo naxa a lu mixi yo xa wo madaxu wɔyɛnyi ɲɔxunmɛ ra. Na wulee findixi adamadi xa maɲɔxunyi nan na. Na fatanxi duniɲa fe nan na. A mu kelixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa ma feo!

sentences.english: For in him all the wealth of God's being has a living form,
sentences.susu: Ala xa fe kɛɲa birin na Isa yi ra.

sentences.english: And you are complete in him, who is the head of all rule and authority:
sentences.susu: Wo fan bara kamali Isa saabui ra, naxan findixi mangɛ ra. Mangɛya birin nun sɛnbɛ mɔɔli birin na a bun ma.

sentences.english: In whom you had a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ;
sentences.susu: Isa bara wo sunna, kɔnɔ a mu a rabaxi a adama ki xa ma. A mu sese ba wo fate ma. A wo sunna ki naxɛ, a wo sondonyi nan kui ixaxi.

sentences.english: Having been put to death with him in baptism, by which you came to life again with him, through faith in the working of God, who made him come back from the dead.
sentences.susu: Wo bara wo xunxa ye xɔɔra. Na bara maniya alɔ wo nun Isa bara ragata gaburi keren kui. Na xanbi wo fan bara keli ye xɔɔra alɔ Isa kelixi gaburi kui ki naxɛ. Na birin nabaxi nɛ barima wo bara la Ala sɛnbɛ ra, naxan Isa rakelixi faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: And you, being dead through your sins and the evil condition of your flesh, to you, I say, he gave life together with him, and forgiveness of all our sins;
sentences.susu: Wo nu luxi nɛ alɔ faxamixie, wo xa yunubie xa fe ra nun wo xa sunnatareya xa fe ra, kɔnɔ Ala bara wo rakisi Isa saabui ra. A bara diɲɛ won ma yunubi birin ma.

sentences.english: Having put an end to the handwriting of the law which was against us, taking it out of the way by nailing it to his cross;
sentences.susu: Kalamui naxan nu sɛbɛxi won xili ma, naxan nu nɔma won ma fe kanade, a bara na ba na a mabanbanfe wuri magalanbuxi ma.

sentences.english: Having made himself free from the rule of authorities and powers, he put them openly to shame, glorying over them in it.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Ala bara nɔ mangɛya nun sɛnbɛ mɔɔli birin na duniɲa birin ya xɔri, naxee fatanxi Sentanɛ ra, a naxa xunnakeli sɔtɔ na wuri magalanbuxi saabui ra.

sentences.english: For this reason let no man be your judge in any question of food or drink or feast days or new moons or Sabbaths:
sentences.susu: Awa, wo naxa tin mixi yo xa kiiti ɲaaxi sa wo ma wo xa donse nun minse xa fe ra, sali xungbee xa fe ra, kike nɛɛnɛ sali xa fe ra, xa na mu malabu lɔxɔɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For these are an image of the things which are to come; but the body is Christ's.
sentences.susu: Na birin findixi fe fanyi tɔnxuma nan na. A nu wama Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fe nan masenfe won bɛ, naxan findixi nɔndi yati ra.

sentences.english: Let no man take your reward from you by consciously making little of himself and giving worship to angels; having his thoughts fixed on the things which he has seen, being foolishly lifted up in his natural mind,
sentences.susu: Wo naxa tin mixi yo xa wo xa xunnakeli ba wo yi ra. Mixi ndee katama nɛ na rabade. A luma alɔ e e yɛtɛ nan magoroma, kɔnɔ wule na a ra. A luma alɔ e tan nun malekɛe Ala nan batuma, kɔnɔ na fan wule nan a ra. E birama laamatunyie fɔxɔ ra, kɔnɔ e e yɛtɛ igboma fe fufafu ma.

sentences.english: And not joined to the Head, from whom all the body, being given strength and kept together through its joins and bands, has its growth with the increase of God.
sentences.susu: E mu fatuxi Isa ma, naxan na xunyi ra. Fate xunyi salonse birin naɲɛrɛma. Kankan xirixi e boore ra, Ala sɛnbɛ fima e birin ma alɔ a wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: If you were made free, by your death with Christ, from the rules of the world, why do you put yourselves under the authority of orders
sentences.susu: Xa wo bara fatan duniɲa fee ma Isa saabui ra, munfe ra wo wo yɛtɛ luma duniɲa fee xa yaamari bun ma?

sentences.english: Which say there may be no touching, tasting, or taking in your hands,
sentences.susu: Na yaamari naxɛ, «A mu lan wo xa yi tongo! A mu lan wo xa yi don! Wo man mu lan wo xa a masuxu!»

sentences.english: (Rules which are all to come to an end with their use) after the orders and teaching of men?
sentences.susu: Na fe birin fama ɲɔnde. Na sɛriyɛ mɔɔli fatanxi adamadi nan na.

sentences.english: These things seem to have a sort of wisdom in self-ordered worship and making little of oneself, and being cruel to the body, not honouring it by giving it its natural use.
sentences.susu: Na fe mɔɔli maniya lɔnni ra, barima batui, yɛtɛ magore, nun fate tɔɔrɔfe na a kui, kɔnɔ e tide yo mu na, barima e mu nɔma yunubi fee bade mixi bɔɲɛ ma.

sentences.english: If then you have a new life with Christ, give your attention to the things of heaven, where Christ is seated at the right hand of God.
sentences.susu: Xa nɔndi na a ra, wo nun Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan birin nakelixi faxɛ ma, wo xa ariyanna fen, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi magoroxi Ala yirefanyi ma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: Keep your mind on the higher things, not on the things of earth.
sentences.susu: Wo xa ariyanna fe fen, duniɲa fe mu a ra.

sentences.english: For your life on earth is done, and you have a secret life with Christ in God.
sentences.susu: Barima wo bara faxa, wo xa simaya fa nɔxunxi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fe i Ala xa fonisireya kui.

sentences.english: At the coming of Christ who is our life, you will be seen with him in glory.
sentences.susu: Wo Rakisima Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi na fa, wo fan luma a xa nɔrɛ nan kui.

sentences.english: Then put to death your bodies which are of the earth; wrong use of the flesh, unclean things, passion, evil desires and envy, which is the worship of strange gods;
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi wo lanma wo xa adamadi xa fe kobi birin nabɛɲin: yɛnɛ fe, langoe fe, fe sɛniyɛntare, korinteɲa naxan maniyaxi kuye batufe ra.

sentences.english: Because of which the wrath of God comes on those who go against his orders;
sentences.susu: Ala xɔnɔma nɛ na fe mɔɔli ma, nun naxee e rabama.

sentences.english: Among whom you were living in the past, when you did such things.
sentences.susu: Singe ra nu, wo yati nu ɲɛrɛma na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: But now it is right for you to put away all these things; wrath, passion, bad feeling, curses, unclean talk;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi, wo xa yi fe birin bɛɲin: bɔɲɛte, geresofe, fe ɲaaxi, mixi xili kanafe, nun konbi.

sentences.english: Do not make false statements to one another; because you have put away the old man with all his doings,
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wule fala wo bore bɛ. Wo bara na ɲɛrɛ ki fori bɛɲin,

sentences.english: And have put on the new man, which has become new in knowledge after the image of his maker;
sentences.susu: alako wo xa ɲɛrɛ ki nɛɛnɛ suxu, naxan lanma Ala ɲɛrɛ ki ma. Na kui, wo fama Ala kolonde a fanyi ra. Na birin luma alɔ mixi naxan dugi fori bama a ma, a dugi nɛɛnɛ ragoro a ma.

sentences.english: Where there is no Greek or Jew, no one with circumcision or without circumcision, no division between nations, no servant or free man: but Christ is all and in all.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Girɛki nun Yuwifi e birin keren. Mixi sunnaxi nun mixi sunnatare e birin keren. Xununtaree, mixi xununxi, konyi, nun lasiri, e birin keren. Isa nan findixi a birin na, a man na a birin i.

sentences.english: As saints of God, then, holy and dearly loved, let your behaviour be marked by pity and mercy, kind feeling, a low opinion of yourselves, gentle ways, and a power of undergoing all things;
sentences.susu: Ala wo tan nan sugandixi, wo bara findi sɛniyɛntɔɛe ra, Ala xanuntenyie. Wo lan nɛ wo xa kinikini mixi ma, wo bɔɲɛ xa fan, wo xa wo yɛtɛ magoro, wo bɔɲɛ xa bɛxi, wo xa diɲɛ.

sentences.english: Being gentle to one another and having forgiveness for one another, if anyone has done wrong to his brother, even as the Lord had forgiveness for you:
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo bore sutura, wo man xa hinnɛ wo bore ra. Xa mixi nde bara fe ɲaaxi raba a bore ra, na kanyi xa diɲɛ alɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi diɲɛxi wo ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And more than all, have love; the only way in which you may be completely joined together.
sentences.susu: Naxan dangi a birin na, wo xa wo bore xanu barima na findima lanyi fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And let the peace of Christ be ruling in your hearts, as it was the purpose of God for you to be one body; and give praise to God at all times.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nu wama lanyi naxan xɔn won bɛ, won bɔɲɛ xa bira na lanyi fɔxɔ ra. Ala bara wo xili wo xa findi fate keren na, lanyi xa lu wo tagi. Wo xa Ala tantu na ma.

sentences.english: Let the word of Christ be in you in all wealth of wisdom; teaching and helping one another with songs of praise and holy words, making melody to God with grace in your hearts.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa masenyi fanyi xa lu wo bɔɲɛ kui. Wo xa wo bore xaran, wo man xa marasi nun lɔnni fi wo bore ma. Wo xa na raba suuki nun bɛɛti ra naxan fatanxi Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi ra. Wo xa Ala tantu na bɛɛtie ra, e xa keli wo bɔɲɛ yati yati nan kui.

sentences.english: And whatever you do, in word or in act, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving praise to God the Father through him.
sentences.susu: Wo fe naxan birin falama, wo fe naxan birin nabama, wo xa na birin naba wo Marigi Isa xili ra. Wo xa Baba Ala tantu Isa saabui ra.

sentences.english: Wives, be under the authority of your husbands, as is right in the Lord.
sentences.susu: Ginɛe, wo xa lu wo xa mɔrie xa yaamari bun ma, alɔ Marigi wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Husbands, have love for your wives, and be not bitter against them.
sentences.susu: Xɛmɛe, wo xa wo xa ginɛe xanu, wo naxa ɲaaxu e ra.

sentences.english: Children, do the orders of your fathers and mothers in all things, for this is pleasing to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Dimɛdie, wo xa wo barimixie xui ratinmɛ fe birin kui, barima na rafan Marigi ma.

sentences.english: Fathers, do not be hard on your children, so that their spirit may not be broken.
sentences.susu: Barimixie, wo naxa wo xa die bɔɲɛ raɲaaxu e ma, alako limaniya naxa ba e yi.

sentences.english: Servants, in all things do the orders of your natural masters; not only when their eyes are on you, as pleasers of men, but with all your heart, fearing the Lord:
sentences.susu: Konyie, wo xa wo marigie xui birin natinmɛ. Wo naxa wali e ya tode xa gbansan na, alako wo xa rafan mixie ma. Wo xa wali e bɛ wo bɔɲɛ fiixɛxi ra, barima wo gaaxuxi wo Marigi Ala ya ra.

sentences.english: Whatever you do, do it readily, as to the Lord and not to men;
sentences.susu: Wo fe naxan birin nabama, wo xa a raba wo bɔɲɛ fiixɛxi nan na, alɔ wo a rabama Marigi bɛ ki naxɛ. Wo mu a rabama mixie xa bɛ.

sentences.english: Being certain that the Lord will give you the reward of the heritage: for you are the servants of the Lord Christ.
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo xa a kolon Marigi na sare ragbilenma nɛ wo ma, naxan findima wo kɛ ra. Wo na walife Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi nan bɛ, wo Marigi yati yati.

sentences.english: For the wrongdoer will have punishment for the wrong he has done, without respect for any man's position.
sentences.susu: Naxan fe kobi rabama, Marigi na fan sare ragbilenma nɛ a ma. Mixi birin a gbe sɔtɔma nɛ, Ala mu mixi yo rafisa a boore bɛ.

sentences.english: Masters, give your servants what is right and equal, conscious that you have a Master in heaven.
sentences.susu: Konyi marigie, wo xa wo xa konyie masuxu tinxinyi ra, barima konyi nan wo fan na. Wo Marigi na koore ma.

sentences.english: Give yourselves to prayer at all times, keeping watch with praise;
sentences.susu: Wo xa Ala maxandi tɛmui birin. Wo xa wo yɛtɛ mato, wo xa Ala tantu.

sentences.english: And making prayer for us, that God may give us an open door for the preaching of the word, the secret of Christ, for which I am now in chains;
sentences.susu: Wo Ala maxandi muxu fan bɛ. Ala xa sɔɔnɛya raba won ma kawandi kui, alako n xa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa gundo masen birin bɛ. N saxi geeli na fe nan ma.

sentences.english: So that I may make it clear, as it is right for me to do.
sentences.susu: Wo Ala maxandi n bɛ alako n xa na fala a fanyi ra, a xa fiixɛ fɔɛn, alɔ a lanma n xa a raba ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Be wise in your behaviour to those who are outside, making good use of the time.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo ɲɛrɛ xaxilimaya ra danxaniyataree ya tode ra. Wo xa na raba sinnanyi ma a raba waxati.

sentences.english: Let your talk be with grace, mixed with salt, so that you may be able to give an answer to everyone.
sentences.susu: Wo xa masenyi fanyi ti mixie bɛ, naxan fan. Kuri so tɛmui, fɔxɛ sama nɛ bande, alako a xa ɲɔxun. Wo fan xa fata mixi birin yaabide wɔyɛnyi ra naxan fan.

sentences.english: Tychicus will give you news of all my business: he is a dear brother and true servant and helper in the word;
