sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyi Tikike findixi n xanuntenyi nan na naxan bara n mali a fanyi ra Marigi xa wali xa fe ra. A fama n ma fe birin tagi rabade wo bɛ.

sentences.english: And I have sent him to you for this very purpose, so that you may have news of how we are, and so that he may give your hearts comfort;
sentences.susu: N a xɛɛxi nɛ wo ma alako a xa muxu xa fe tagi raba wo bɛ, a man xa wo ralimaniya.

sentences.english: And with him I have sent Onesimus, the true and well-loved brother, who is one of you. They will give you word of everything which is taking place here.
sentences.susu: N man bara n ngaxakerenyi tinxinxi, n xanuntenyi Onesimo Kɔlɔsika xɛɛ a xa Tikike mati. E firinyi fama n ma fe birin dɛntɛgɛ sade wo bɛ.

sentences.english: Aristarchus, my brother-prisoner, sends his love to you, and Mark, a relation of Barnabas (about whom you have been given orders: if he comes to you, be kind to him),
sentences.susu: Arisitaraki, muxu nun naxan na geeli, a wo xɛɛbu. Baranabasi dɛɛxɔ Maraki fan wo xɛɛbu. Wo bara marasi sɔtɔ Maraki xa fe ma. Xa a fa wo xɔnyi, wo xa a rasɛnɛ a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And Jesus, whose other name is Justus; these are of the circumcision: they are my only brother-workers for the kingdom of God, who have been a comfort to me.
sentences.susu: Yesu, naxan xili falama Yusutu, a fan wo xɛɛbu. Yuwifi danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama birin ya ma, yi mixi saxanyi gbansan nan n malixi Ala xa mangɛya niini wali rabade. E bara limaniya fi n ma.

sentences.english: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ Jesus, sends you his love, ever taking thought for you in his prayers, that you may be complete and fully certain of all the purpose of God.
sentences.susu: Epafirasi, naxan findixi wo xɔnyika ra, a wo xɛɛbu. Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa walikɛ nan a ra. A Ala maxandima wo bɛ tɛmui birin alako wo xa danxaniya xa sabati, wo xa Ala waxɔnfe kolon, wo man xa a raba.

sentences.english: For I give witness of him that he has undergone much trouble for you and for those in Laodicea and in Hierapolis.
sentences.susu: A wali gbegbe rabama wo bɛ, wo tan danxaniyatɔɛ naxee na Kɔlɔsi, Layodiseya, nun Hiyerapoli. N na a seede ra.

sentences.english: Luke, our well-loved medical friend, and Demas, send you their love.
sentences.susu: Luki seriba, muxu xanuntenyi wo xɛɛbu, a nun Demasi.

sentences.english: Give my love to the brothers in Laodicea and to Nymphas and the church in their house.
sentences.susu: Wo xa won ngaxakerenyi Layodiseya danxaniyatɔɛe xɛɛbu, nun Nimifa, a nun danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama naxan e malanma a xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: And when this letter has been made public among you, let the same be done in the church of Laodicea; and see that you have the letter from Laodicea.
sentences.susu: Wo na gɛ yi bataaxɛ xarande wo xɔnyi, wo xa a so Layodiseya danxaniyatɔɛe fan yi ra, e xa a xaran. Wo tan fan, wo xa bataaxɛ xaran n naxan nasanbaxi Layodiseyakae ma.

sentences.english: Say to Archippus, See that you do the work which the Lord has given you to do.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a fala Arikipe bɛ, «Fɛntɛn i xa wali ma, Marigi naxan soxi i yi ra alako i xa na raba a fanyi ra.»

sentences.english: I, Paul, give you this word of love in my handwriting. Keep in memory that I am a prisoner. Grace be with you.
sentences.susu: Xɛɛbui nan yi ki, n tan Pɔlu naxan sɛbɛxi wo ma n yɛtɛ bɛlɛxɛ ra. Wo xa ratu a ma n na geeli nan kui yi ki. Ala xa hinnɛ wo birin na.

sentences.english: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace.
sentences.susu: Pɔlu, Silifanu, nun Timote nan yi ki, katarabi Baba Ala nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi Marigi Isa xa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama ma naxee na Tɛsaloniki. Ala xa hinnɛ nun bɔɲɛsa fi wo ma.

sentences.english: We give praise to God at all times for you, keeping you in memory in our prayers;
sentences.susu: Waxati birin muxu Ala tantuma wo xa fe ra, muxu man a maxandima wo bɛ. Tɛmui birin

sentences.english: Having ever in mind your work of faith and acts of love and the strength of your hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father;
sentences.susu: muxu wo xa fe falama won Baba Ala bɛ. Muxu a tantuma nɛ wo xa wali ma naxan kelixi wo xa danxaniya nun wo xa xanunteya ma. Muxu a tantuma nɛ barima wo wo tunnabɛxixi wo xaxili tife ra Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Marigi Isa ra.

sentences.english: Being conscious, my brothers, dear to God, that you have been marked out by God's purpose;
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, wo tan Ala xanuntenyie, muxu a kolon a Ala bara wo sugandi.

sentences.english: Because our good news came to you, not in word only, but in power, and in the Holy Spirit, so that you were completely certain of it; even as you saw what our behaviour to you was like from our love to you.
sentences.susu: Muxu to xibaaru fanyi masen wo bɛ, a mu findi muxu dɛ wɔyɛnyi gbansan xa ra. Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa sɛnbɛ fi muxu xa xibaaru fanyi kawandife ma, muxu danxaniyaxi a ma. Wo a kolon yati muxu nu ɲɛrɛma ki naxɛ wo xa fe ra, muxu nu na wo ya ma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And you took us and the Lord as your example, after the word had come to you in much trouble, with joy in the Holy Spirit;
sentences.susu: Wo bara findi muxu nun Marigi fɔxi rabae ra. Hali wo to ɲaxankatɛ gbegbe sɔtɔ, wo Ala xa masenyi suxu nɛ ɲɛlɛxinyi ra, ɲɛlɛxinyi naxan fatan Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi ra.

sentences.english: So that you became an example to all those who have faith in Christ in Macedonia and Achaia.
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo bara findi misaali ra danxaniyatɔɛ birin bɛ naxee na Masedon nun Akayi.

sentences.english: For not only was the word of the Lord sounding out from you in Macedonia and Achaia, but in every place your faith in God is made clear; so that we have no need to say anything.
sentences.susu: Ala xa masenyi bara rayensen yɛ wo saabui ra. A mu rayensenxi Masedon nun Akayi gbansan xa ma. Yire birin bara a kolon wo danxaniyaxi Ala ma ki naxɛ. Na kui, muxu mu sese falama sɔnɔn na xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For they themselves give the news of how we came among you; and how you were turned from images to God, to the worship of a true and living God,
sentences.susu: Na mixi naxee bara wo xa fe mɛ, e tan nan fama wo xa fe falade, wo muxu rasɛnɛ ki naxɛ, wo man gbilen kuyee fɔxɔ ra ki naxɛ, wo fa bira Ala Ɲiɲɛ fɔxɔ ra naxan findixi nɔndi ra.

sentences.english: Waiting for his Son from heaven, who came back from the dead, even Jesus, our Saviour from the wrath to come.
sentences.susu: E man wo xa fe falama, wo Ala xa Di mamɛxi ki naxɛ kelife koore ma. Na nan findixi Isa ra, Ala naxan nakeli faxɛ ma, Isa naxan won natangama xɔnɛ ma naxan na fafe.

sentences.english: For you yourselves, brothers, are conscious that our coming among you was not without effect:
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, wo tan yati a kolon a muxu fafe wo yire na mu findixi fe fufafu ra.

sentences.english: But after we had first undergone much pain and been cruelly attacked as you saw, at Philippi, by the help of God we gave you the good news without fear, though everything was against us.
sentences.susu: Wo a kolon, muxu nu bara ɲaxankatɛ nun tɔɔrɛ sɔtɔ Filipi. Kɔnɔ muxu naxa muxu xaxili ti won Marigi Ala ra, muxu limaniya alako muxu xa wo kawandi Ala xa xibaaru fanyi ra, hali geremasoe gbegbe to nu naa.

sentences.english: For our witness does not come from error or from an unclean heart or from deceit:
sentences.susu: Muxu xa kawandi mu fatanxi wule xa ra, a mu fatanxi ɲanige sɛniyɛntare xa ra, a mu fatanxi yanfanteya xa ra.

sentences.english: But even as the good news was given to us by the approval of God, so we give it out; not as pleasing men, but God by whom our hearts are tested.
sentences.susu: Ala to bara muxu mato, a bara a xa xibaaru fanyi taxu muxu ra. Na kui, muxu mu wɔyɛnma xɛ de alako muxu xa rafan mixie ma. Muxu wɔyɛnma nɛ alako muxu xa Ala nan kɛnɛn naxan won sondonyie matoma.

sentences.english: For it is common knowledge among you that we never made use of smooth-sounding false words, and God is witness that at no time were we secretly desiring profit for ourselves,
sentences.susu: Wo a kolon yati, Ala fan a kolon, muxu mu dɛiɲɔxunyi wɔyɛnyi yo falaxi wo bɛ. Muxu mu kawandi tixi xɛ alako muxu xa se nde sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Or looking for glory from men, from you or from others, when we might have made ourselves a care to you as Apostles of Christ.
sentences.susu: Muxu hayi mu na mixie xa matɔxɔɛ ma, a na findi wo tan na, a na findi mixi gbɛtɛe ra.

sentences.english: But we were gentle among you, like a woman caring for her little ones:
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa xɛɛrae to na muxu ra, muxu nu nɔma muxu xa fe kote dɔxɔde wo xun ma, kɔnɔ muxu mu tin. Muxu naxa mɛɛni wo ma, alɔ dingɛ mɛɛnima a xa die ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Even so, being full of loving desire for you, we took delight in giving you not only God's good news, but even our lives, because you were dear to us.
sentences.susu: Muxu wo xanuxi nɛ han muxu naxa muxu yɛtɛ yati fi wo ma safe Ala xa xibaaru fanyi xun ma muxu wo kawandi naxan na. Wo xa fe nu bara xɔrɔxɔ muxu ma ki fanyi.

sentences.english: For you have the memory, my brothers, of our trouble and care; how, working night and day, so that we might not be a trouble to any of you, we gave you the good news of God.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, wo xa wo maɲɔxun muxu xa wali nun muxu xa tɔɔrɛ ma. Muxu wakili nɛ kɔɛ nun yanyi alako muxu xa kɔntɔfili naxa lu wo sese ma, muxu nu Ala xa xibaaru fanyi kawandife wo bɛ tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: You are witnesses, with God, how holy and upright and free from all evil was our way of life among you who have faith;
sentences.susu: Muxu ɲɛrɛxi sɛniyɛnyi nun tinxinyi nan na wo xa fe ra, marakɔrɔsi yo mu na muxu ma. Wo bara findi na fe seedee ra, wo nun Ala.

sentences.english: Even as you saw how, like a father with his children, we were teaching and comforting you all, and giving witness,
sentences.susu: Wo a kolon yati, a muxu na wo birin bɛ, alɔ babɛ nun a xa die na ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So that your lives might be pleasing to God, who has given you a part in his kingdom and his glory.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara wo ralimaniya, muxu bara wo mafuruku, muxu bara wo mayandi alako wo ɲɛrɛ ki xa Ala kɛnɛn, naxan wo xilixi wo xa lu a xa mangɛya niini bun ma, wo xa a xa nɔrɛ kolon.

sentences.english: And for this cause we still give praise to God, that, when the word came to your ears through us, you took it, not as the word of man, but, as it truly is, the word of God, which has living power in you who have faith.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi muxu Ala nuwali sama tɛmui birin barima muxu to wo kawandi Ala xa masenyi ra, wo mu a suxuxi xɛ alɔ mixi wɔyɛn xui. Wo a kolon nɛ a a findixi Ala xa masenyi nan yati ra naxan sɛnbɛ na walife wo tan danxaniyatɔɛe ya ma.

sentences.english: For you, my brothers, took as your examples the churches of God which are in Judaea in Christ Jesus; because you underwent the same things from your countrymen as they did from the Jews;
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, wo bara maniya Ala xa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae ra naxee danxaniyaxi a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa ma Yudaya bɔxi ma. Wo baribooree wo tɔɔrɔ ki naxɛ, Yuwifie fan Yudaya danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae tɔɔrɔ na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: Who put to death the Lord Jesus and the prophets, violently driving us out; who are unpleasing to God and against all men;
sentences.susu: E tan Yuwifie nan Marigi Isa nun namiɲɔnmɛe faxa, e muxu fan ɲaxankata. E xa fe mu Ala kɛnɛnxi. E to muxu tɔɔrɔma muxu xa kawandi wali kui, e ɲaaxuma mixi birin na.

sentences.english: Who, to make the measure of their sins complete, kept us from giving the word of salvation to the Gentiles: but the wrath of God is about to come on them in the fullest degree.
sentences.susu: E mu wama muxu xa si gbɛtɛe kawandi alako nee xa kisi. Na kui, e na e xa yunubi nan tun xun masafe. Kɔnɔ Ala xa xɔnɛ bara e suxu.

sentences.english: But we, my brothers, being away from you for a short time, in body but not in heart, had all the more desire to see your face;
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, muxu bara makuya wo ya tode ra waxati nde bun, kɔnɔ muxu bɔɲɛ tan mu makuyaxi wo ra. Wo xɔli muxu suxuma ki fanyi ra. Muxu bara fe birin naba alako muxu man xa wo to.

sentences.english: For which reason we made attempts to come to you, even I, Paul, once and again; but Satan kept us from coming.
sentences.susu: Muxu nu bara wa gbilenfe wo yire. N tan Pɔlu wa nɛ n xa wo yire li sanmaya wuyaxi, kɔnɔ Sentanɛ nan muxu matɔɔrɔ.

sentences.english: For what is our hope or joy or crown of glory? Are not even you, before our Lord Jesus, at his coming?
sentences.susu: Marigi Isa gbilen lɔxɔɛ, muxu ɲɔxɔ tima Ala ra nde xa fe ra? Muxu ɲɛlɛxinma nde xa fe ra? Muxu matɔxɔɛ sɔtɔma nde xa fe ra? Wo tan xa mu a ra?

sentences.english: For you are our glory and our joy.
sentences.susu: Iyo, wo tan nan findixi muxu xa xunnakeli nun muxu xa sɛɛwɛ ra.

sentences.english: At last our desire to have news of you was so strong that, while we ourselves were waiting at Athens,
sentences.susu: Na kui, muxu bɔɲɛ to mu nɔxi sade, muxu bara a ɲanige muxu tan xa lu Atɛn,

sentences.english: We sent Timothy, our brother and God's servant in the good news of Christ, to give you strength and comfort in your faith;
sentences.susu: muxu xa won ngaxakerenyi Timote xɛɛ wo ma. Muxu waliboore na a ra Ala xa wali kui naxan findi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa xibaaru fanyi kawandila ra. Muxu a xɛɛxi nɛ alako a xa wo sɛnbɛ so, a xa wo ralimaniya wo xa danxaniya kui,

sentences.english: So that no man might be moved by these troubles; because you see that these things are part of God's purpose for us.
sentences.susu: alako wo xa ɲaxankatɛ naxa wo hanmɛ. Wo fan yati a kolon, na ɲaxankatɛ nan nagirixi won ma.

sentences.english: And when we were with you, we said to you that trouble was before us; and so it came about, as you see.
sentences.susu: Hali muxu nu na wo ya ma tɛmui naxɛ, muxu nu a falama nɛ wo bɛ, a mixie fama won ɲaxankatade. Wo bara a to fa, na nan fa rabaxi.

sentences.english: For this reason, when I was no longer able to keep quiet, I sent to get news of your faith, fearing that you might be tested by the Evil One and that our work might come to nothing.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, n bɔɲɛ to mu nu saxi sɔnɔn, n naxa Timote xɛɛ naa alako a xa a kolon wo xa danxaniya na ki naxɛ. N nu gaaxuxi nɛ wo bɛ Sentanɛ mixi ratantanyi fa wo ratantanfe, muxu xa wali fa findi wali fufafu ra.

sentences.english: But now that Timothy has come to us from you, and has given us good news of your faith and love, and that you have happy memories of us, desiring greatly to see us, even as we do to see you;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Timote to baxi gbilende muxu yire keli wo xɔnyi, a bara xibaaru fanyi fala muxu bɛ wo xa danxaniya nun wo xa xanunteya xa fe ra. A naxɛ, a wo ratuxi muxu xa fe ra sɛɛwɛ kui, a muxu to xɔli na wo ma, alɔ wo fan to xɔli to na muxu fan ma.

sentences.english: For this cause, brothers, in all our trouble and grief we were comforted about you because of your faith;
sentences.susu: Na kui, n ngaxakerenyie, hali muxu to na tɔɔrɛ nun ɲaxankatɛ kui, muxu bara ralimaniya wo xa danxaniya xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For it is life to us if you keep your faith in the Lord unchanged.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi muxu bɔɲɛ bara sa sɔnɔn, barima muxu bara a kolon a wo xa danxaniya xanxi Marigi.

sentences.english: For how great is the praise which we give to God for you, and how great the joy with which we are glad because of you before our God;
sentences.susu: Muxu mu a kolon sɔnɔn muxu nɔma Ala tantude ki naxɛ wo xa fe ra. Danyi yo mu na muxu xa sɛɛwɛ ma wo xa fe ra Ala xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Night and day requesting God again and again that we may see your face and make your faith complete.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ nun yanyi muxu na a maxandife muxu nii birin na, muxu xa nɔ wo tode, alako naxan luxi wo xa danxaniya ra, muxu xa na rakamali.

sentences.english: Now may our God and Father himself and our Lord Jesus make a way for us to come to you;
sentences.susu: Ala yɛtɛ yati, won Baba, a nun won Marigi Isa xa kira bɔɔ muxu bɛ alako muxu xa wo yire masɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And the Lord give you increase of love in fullest measure to one another and to all men, even as our love to you;
sentences.susu: Xanunteya naxan na wo bɛ wo doro tagi, a nun wo nun mixi birin tagi, Ala xa na xun masa ki fanyi ra, alɔ muxu fan wo xanuxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: So that your hearts may be strong and free from all sin before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.
sentences.susu: Ala xa wo sondonyie sɛnbɛ so alako won Marigi Isa na gbilen lɔxɔ naxɛ a nun a xa sɛniyɛntɔɛe ra, wo xa nɔ tide won Baba Ala ya i sɛniyɛnyi nun tinxinyi kui.

sentences.english: And last of all, the prayer which we make to you from our heart and in the name of the Lord Jesus, is this: that as we made clear to you what sort of behaviour is pleasing to God, as in fact you are doing now, so you will go on in these ways, but more and more.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, muxu bara wo tinkan wo lan wo xa wo ɲɛrɛ ki naxɛ Ala waxɔnyi ma. Han ya wo na na nan xun ma. Yakɔsi, muxu wo maxandima, muxu wo mayandi Marigi Isa xili ra, wo xa nu na xun masa.

sentences.english: Because you have in mind the orders we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
sentences.susu: Wo a kolon yati muxu wo xaranxi naxan na Marigi Isa xili ra.

sentences.english: For the purpose of God for you is this: that you may be holy, and may keep yourselves from the desires of the flesh;
sentences.susu: Ala sago na a ra wo xa sɛniyɛn. Wo naxa langoeɲa raba.

sentences.english: So that every one of you may keep his body holy and in honour;
sentences.susu: Kankan xa a yɛtɛ suxu sɛniyɛnyi nun tinxinyi kui.

sentences.english: Not in the passion of evil desires, like the Gentiles, who have no knowledge of God;
sentences.susu: Wo naxa bira langoeɲa fɔxɔ ra, alɔ Ala kolontaree a rabama ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And that no man may make attempts to get the better of his brother in business: for the Lord is the judge in all these things, as we said to you before and gave witness.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo naxa yunubi raba a ngaxakerenyi ra, a fu a ma na fe kui, barima Marigi na fe mɔɔli birin makiitima nɛ. Muxu bara na fala wo bɛ, muxu man gbilen nɛ a fala ra wo bɛ.

sentences.english: Because it is God's purpose that our way of life may be not unclean but holy.
sentences.susu: Ala won xilixi nɛ won xa won ɲɛrɛ sɛniyɛnyi kui, won xa gbilen sɛniyɛntareɲa fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Whoever, then, goes against this word, goes against not man but God, who gives his Holy Spirit to you.
sentences.susu: Na kui, mixi naxan tondima yi fee rabatude, a mu tondixi ibunadama xa bɛ, a tondixi Ala nan bɛ naxan a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi fixi wo ma.

sentences.english: But about loving the brothers, there is no need for me to say anything to you in this letter: for you have the teaching of God that love for one another is right and necessary;
sentences.susu: Hali muxu mu wo rasi ngaxakerenyie xanufe ma, barima Ala nan bara wo tinkan wo xa wo bore xanu.

sentences.english: And, truly, you are lovers of all the brothers in Macedonia; but it is our desire that your love may be increased still more;
sentences.susu: Wo na nan yati rabafe ngaxakerenyie ra naxee na Masedon bɔxi birin kui. Kɔnɔ muxu a falama nɛ wo bɛ, n ngaxakerenyie, wo man xa nu na xun masa.

sentences.english: And that you may take pride in being quiet and doing your business, working with your hands as we gave you orders;
sentences.susu: Wo xa fe birin naba alako wo xa lu bɔɲɛsa kui. Wo xa mɛɛni wo yɛtɛ ma. Wo xa nu wali wo bɛlɛxɛ ra alɔ muxu a masen wo bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: That you may be respected by those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo ɲɛrɛ ki findima a fanyi nan na danxaniyataree tagi, wo man mu wo xa fe kote dɔxɔma mixi gbɛtɛ yo xun ma.

sentences.english: But it is our desire, brothers, that you may be certain about those who are sleeping; so that you may have no need for sorrow, as others have who are without hope.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, muxu mu wama wo xa lu fahaamutareɲa kui mixie xa fe ra naxee bara laaxira. A mu lan wo xa sunnun alɔ mixi naxee mu e xaxili tixi Ala ra.

sentences.english: For if we have faith that Jesus underwent death and came back again, even so those who are sleeping will come again with him by God's power.
sentences.susu: Won laxi a ra a Isa bara faxa, a man fa keli faxɛ ma. Na kui, won man laxi a ra a Ala fama faxamixie fan nakelide naxee nu danxaniyaxi Isa ma, a e rate e nun Isa.

sentences.english: For this we say to you by the word of the Lord, that we who are still living at the coming of the Lord, will not go before those who are sleeping.
sentences.susu: Marigi xa masenyi nan ya, muxu naxan falama wo bɛ: Won tan naxee ɲiɲɛ a ra, Marigi fa tɛmui naxee lima duniɲa ma, won singe xa mu tema mixi faxaxie bɛ.

sentences.english: Because the Lord himself will come down from heaven with a word of authority, with the voice of the chief angel, with the sound of a horn: and the dead in Christ will come to life first;
sentences.susu: Marigi yɛtɛ yati nan fama gorode keli koore ma. Yaamari fima nɛ xui itexi ra. Malekɛ kuntigi fama nɛ a xui itede. Ala xa sara xui minima nɛ. Isa xa danxaniyatɔɛ naxee bara faxa, nee nan singe kelima.

sentences.english: Then we who are still living will be taken up together with them into the clouds to see the Lord in the air: and so will we be for ever with the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, won tan naxee ɲiɲɛ luxi duniɲa, won fan tema nɛ, won nee li nuxui kui, won birin sa naralan Marigi yire kuye ma. Won luma nɛ Marigi sɛɛti ma sɔnɔn abadan.

sentences.english: So then, give comfort to one another with these words.
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo xa wo bore ralimaniya na masenyi ra.

sentences.english: But about the times and their order, my brothers, there is no need for me to say anything to you.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, hali n mu sese fala wo bɛ waxati nun lɔxɔɛe xa fe ra yi fee sa rabama tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: For you yourselves have the knowledge that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.
sentences.susu: Wo fan yati a kolon a fanyi ra, a Marigi xa lɔxɔɛ fama nɛ alɔ muɲɛti fama kɔɛ ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: When they say, There is peace and no danger, then sudden destruction will come on them, as birth-pains on a woman with child; and they will not be able to get away from it.
sentences.susu: Mixie nɛ lanyi nun bɔɲɛsa xa fe falama tɛmui naxɛ, gbaloe dusuma e xun ma na tɛmui nɛ, alɔ furuginɛ difuri na keli a ra. E mu tangama a ma muku.

sentences.english: But you, my brothers, are not in the dark, for that day to overtake you like a thief:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan, ngaxakerenyie, wo mu na dimi xa kui. Na lɔxɔɛ mu lanma a xa wo tɛrɛnna alɔ muɲɛti.

sentences.english: For you are all sons of light and of the day: we are not of the night or of the dark.
sentences.susu: Wo birin findixi naiyalanyi nun yanyi die nan na. Kɔɛ nun dimi die xa mu won na.

sentences.english: So then, let us not take our rest as the others do, but let us be self-controlled and awake.
sentences.susu: Na kui, won naxa xi alɔ booree. Won xa fee rasaxa a fanyi ra, won naxa yanfa.

sentences.english: For those who are sleeping do so in the night; and those who are the worse for drink are so in the night;
sentences.susu: Naxee xima, e xima kɔɛ nan na. Naxee siisima, e siisima kɔɛ nan na.

sentences.english: But let us, who are of the day, be serious, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and on our heads, the hope of salvation.
sentences.susu: Won tan naxee findixi yanyi mixie ra, won xa mɛɛni won yɛtɛ ma. Won xa danxaniya nun xanunteya rasabati, won xa won xaxili ti kisi ra. Nee tide luma nɛ won bɛ alɔ kanke makantase nun xun makantase tide luma geresoe bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For God's purpose for us is not wrath, but salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,
sentences.susu: Ala mu a ragirixi won ma, a xa xɔnɛ xa won li. A a ragirixi nɛ won tan xa kisi nan sɔtɔ Marigi Isa saabui ra, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi

sentences.english: Who was put to death for us, so that, awake or sleeping, we may have a part in his life.
sentences.susu: naxan faxa won ma fe ra. Na nan a toxi, xa muxu ɲiɲɛ nan a ra, xa muxu faxaxi nan a ra, muxu fama nɛ sabatide a i.

sentences.english: So then, go on comforting and building up one another, as you have been doing.
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo xa wo bore ralimaniya, wo xa wo bore sɛnbɛ so alɔ wo darixi a raba ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But we make this request to you, my brothers: give attention to those who are working among you, who are over you in the Lord to keep order among you;
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, muxu bara wo mayandi wo xa mixie binya naxee na walife wo tagi, wo rasife nun wo raɲɛrɛfe ra Marigi xa fe kui.

sentences.english: And have a high opinion of them in love because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.
sentences.susu: Wo xa e binya a fanyi ra xanunteya kui e xa wali xa fe ra. Lanyi nan xa lu wo xa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama tagi.

sentences.english: And our desire is that you will keep control over those whose lives are not well ordered, giving comfort to the feeble-hearted, supporting those with little strength, and putting up with much from all.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, muxu man bara wo maxandi, wo xa tunnaxɔnɛe rasi, wo xa limaniyataree ralimaniya, wo xa sɛnbɛtaree mali, wo diɲɛ mixi birin bɛ.

sentences.english: Let no one give evil for evil; but ever go after what is good, for one another and for all.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a mato a fanyi ra mixi yo naxa fe kobi ɲɔxɔ fe kobi ra. Wo xa nu fe fanyi nan tun naba wo bore bɛ, a nun mixi birin bɛ.

sentences.english: Have joy at all times.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɛɛwa tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: Keep on with your prayers.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Ala maxandi waxati birin.

sentences.english: In everything give praise: for this is the purpose of God in Christ Jesus for you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa Ala tantu fe birin kui. Na findixi Ala sago nan na wo bɛ, wo tan naxee danxaniyaxi a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa ma.

sentences.english: Do not put out the light of the Spirit;
sentences.susu: Wo naxa Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xɔlɔn nagoro.

sentences.english: Do not make little of the words of the prophets;
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo tuli xɔrɔxɔ namiɲɔnmɛe xa masenyie ma,

sentences.english: Let all things be tested; keep to what is good;
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ wo xa fe birin mato a fanyi ra. Xa fefe fan, wo xa na suxu gben.

sentences.english: Keep from every form of evil.
sentences.susu: Xa fefe kobi, wo xa wo makuya na ra pon!

sentences.english: And may the God of peace himself make you holy in every way; and may your spirit and soul and body be free from all sin at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Ala xa wo rasɛniyɛn a ki nun a kɛɲa ma, a tan Ala naxan bɔɲɛsa fima. Ala xa wo xaxili nun wo nii nun wo fate ratanga, marakɔrɔsi yo naxa lu wo ma won Marigi Isa fa tɛmui.

sentences.english: God, by whom you have been marked out in his purpose, is unchanging and will make it complete.
sentences.susu: Naxan wo xilixi, a na a xui xanbi ra, a fama nɛ a rabade.

sentences.english: Brothers, keep us in mind in your prayers.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, wo Ala maxandi muxu bɛ.

sentences.english: Give all the brothers a holy kiss.
sentences.susu: Wo xa ngaxakerenyie birin xɛɛbu sunbui sɛniyɛnxi ra.

sentences.english: I give orders in the name of the Lord that all the brothers are to be present at the reading of this letter.
sentences.susu: N bara wo yamari Marigi xili ra wo xa yi bataaxɛ xaran ngaxakerenyie birin bɛ.

sentences.english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
sentences.susu: Ala xa hinnɛ fi wo ma won Marigi Isa saabui ra, a xa Mixi Sugandixi.

sentences.english: Paul and Silvanus and Timothy, to the church of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:
sentences.susu: Pɔlu, Silifanu, nun Timote nan yi ki, katarabi won Baba Ala nun Marigi Isa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama ma naxee na Tɛsaloniki.

sentences.english: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Won Baba Ala nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi Marigi Isa xa hinnɛ nun bɔɲɛsa fi wo ma.

sentences.english: It is right for us to give praise to God at all times for you, brothers, because of the great increase of your faith, and the wealth of your love for one another;
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, muxu lanma muxu xa Ala tantu wo xa fe ra tɛmui birin. Muxu xa tantui lanxi barima wo xa danxaniya xun masafe ki fanyi, a nun wo xa xanunteya wo bore bɛ.

sentences.english: So that we ourselves take pride in you in the churches of God for your untroubled mind and your faith in all the troubles and sorrows which you are going through;
sentences.susu: Na kui, muxu wo matɔxɔma Ala xa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae bɛ wo xa tunnabɛxiya nun danxaniya xa fe ra wo naxee masenfe wo xa ɲaxankatɛ nun tɔɔrɛ birin kui.

sentences.english: Which is a clear sign of the decision which God in his righteousness has made; to give you a part in his kingdom, for which you have undergone this pain;
sentences.susu: Na bara Ala xa kiiti tinxinxi masen, barima wo na naxan iminife, na nan a masenma a wo daxa wo xa lu Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma, wo tɔɔrɔfe naxan xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For it is an act of righteousness on God's part to give trouble as their reward to those who are troubling you,
sentences.susu: Ala tinxin. Mixi naxee wo ɲaxankatama, a e sare fima ɲaxankatɛ nan na.

sentences.english: And to you who are troubled, rest with us, when the Lord Jesus comes from heaven with the angels of his power in flames of fire,
sentences.susu: Wo tan naxee bara ɲaxankata, a malabui fima nɛ won birin ma Marigi Isa a nun a xa malekɛ sɛnbɛmae fama tɛmui naxɛ kelife koore ma.

sentences.english: To give punishment to those who have no knowledge of God, and to those who do not give ear to the good news of our Lord Jesus:
sentences.susu: E nun tɛ wolenxi nan goroma. Ala kolontaree, naxee mu won Marigi Isa xa masenyi rabatuma, e sare fima ɲaxankatɛ nan na.

sentences.english: Whose reward will be eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his strength,
sentences.susu: Na mixie xa kiiti findima gbaloe nan na dande yo mu naxan ma. Marigi e makuyama nɛ a yɛtɛ ra nun a sɛnbɛ nɔrɔxi ra

sentences.english: At his coming, when he will have glory in his saints, and will be a cause of wonder in all those who had faith (because our witness among you had effect) in that day.
sentences.susu: a na fa tɛmui naxɛ. Na lɔxɔɛ a xa sɛniyɛntɔɛe nun a mantonyie birin a toma nɛ, e kaaba, e a matɔxɔ. Wo fan luma nɛ nee ya ma, barima wo danxaniya nɛ muxu xa seedeɲɔxɔya ma.

sentences.english: For this reason, you are ever in our prayers, that you may seem to our God such as may have a part in his purpose and that by his power he will make all his good purpose, and the work of faith, complete;
sentences.susu: Na kui, muxu Ala maxandima wo bɛ tɛmui birin, alako won Marigi Ala xa wo lu alɔ a mixi naxan xilixi na daxa ki naxɛ. Muxu man a maxandima a xa wo xa ɲanige fanyi birin nakamali a nun wo xa wali fanyi naxee kelima wo xa danxaniya ma. Na rabama a sɛnbɛ nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: So that glory may be given to the name of our Lord Jesus through you, and you may have glory in him, by the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Muxu na maxandi tima alako Marigi Isa xa matɔxɔɛ sɔtɔ wo saabui ra, wo fan xa matɔxɔɛ sɔtɔ Isa ra. Yi birin nabama Ala nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi Marigi Isa xa hinnɛ saabui nan na.

sentences.english: Now as to the coming of the Lord Jesus Christ, and our meeting with him, it is our desire, my brothers,
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, muxu bara wo mayandi wo bɔɲɛ naxa mini wo to fee mɛma won Marigi Isa fa lɔxɔɛ xa fe ra, a nun won fama a ralande ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: That you may not be moved in mind or troubled by a spirit, or by a word, or by a letter as from us, with the suggestion that the day of the Lord is even now come;
sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde a fala wo bɛ a Marigi xa lɔxɔɛ ɲan bara fa, wo xaxili naxa ifu de! Wo naxa la a ra hali na kanyi wɔyɛn wo bɛ alɔ namiɲɔnmɛ na a ra, xa na mu a kawandi ti wo bɛ, xa na mu a fa bataaxɛ ra alɔ a fatanxi muxu tan nan na.

sentences.english: Give no belief to false words: because there will first be a falling away from the faith, and the revelation of the man of sin, the son of destruction,
sentences.susu: Wo naxa a lu mixi yo xa wo madaxu. Na lɔxɔɛ mu a lima fo adamadi gbegbe mɛɛ Ala ra sinden, a nun, Sɛriyɛtare Xungbe, a naxa makɛnɛn, gbaloe ragataxi naxan bɛ.

sentences.english: Who puts himself against all authority, lifting himself up over all which is named God or is given worship; so that he takes his seat in the Temple of God, putting himself forward as God.
sentences.susu: A fama nɛ a yɛtɛ itede dangi adamadie xa batuse birin na. Adamadie sese xili falama «ala», a tan tima nɛ na kanke. Na kui, a fama nɛ dɔxɔde Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kui, a a yɛtɛ findi ala ra.

sentences.english: Have you no memory of what I said when I was with you, giving you word of these things?
sentences.susu: N to yi fee fala wo bɛ n nu na wo yire tɛmui naxɛ, wo nɛɛmuxi nɛ?

sentences.english: And now it is clear to you what is keeping back his revelation till the time comes for him to be seen.
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi wo a kolon naxan makankanxi Sɛriyɛtare Xungbe ma, alako a naxa mini beenun a xa waxati xa a li.

sentences.english: For the secret of evil is even now at work: but there is one who is keeping back the evil till he is taken out of the way.
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛtareya ɲan na walife nɔxunyi kui. A luma na ki nɛ han naxan a makankanxi a a bama naa tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And then will come the revelation of that evil one, whom the Lord Jesus will put to death with the breath of his mouth, and give to destruction by the revelation of his coming;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, Sɛriyɛtare Xungbe makɛnɛnma nɛ. Marigi na fa tɛmui naxɛ, a yi xɛmɛ halakima nɛ a dɛ foye ra, a xa fa nɔrɛ a sɔntɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: Even the one whose coming is marked by the working of Satan, with all power and signs and false wonders,
sentences.susu: Yi Sɛriyɛtare Xungbe minima Sentanɛ sɛnbɛ nan saabui ra, a fa kaabanakoe, tɔnxumae, nun fe magaaxuxie raba naxee mu findixi nɔndi ra.

sentences.english: And with every deceit of wrongdoing among those whose fate is destruction; because they were quite without that love of the true faith by which they might have salvation.
sentences.susu: A fama nɛ mixi kisitaree mayendende fe ɲaaxi mɔɔli birin na, barima nɔndi mu rafan nee ma. Na na a ra e mu kisima.

sentences.english: And for this cause, God will give them up to the power of deceit and they will put their faith in what is false:
sentences.susu: Na kui, Ala e xaxili ifuma nɛ sɛnbɛ ra, alako e xa la wule ra.

sentences.english: So that they all may be judged, who had no faith in what is true, but took pleasure in evil.
sentences.susu: A rabama na ki nɛ alako mixi birin xa gbaloe sɔtɔ naxee mu danxaniyaxi nɔndi ma, tinxintareya rafanxi naxee ma.

sentences.english: But it is right for us to give praise to God at all times for you, brothers, loved by the Lord, because it was the purpose of God from the first that you might have salvation, being made holy by the Spirit and by faith in what is true:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n ngaxakerenyie, fo muxu xa Ala tantu wo xa fe ra tɛmui birin. Marigi wo xanuxi nɛ. Kabi fe fɔlɔ fɔlɛ, Ala bara wo sugandi alako wo xa kisi. A wo rakisima a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa wali nan saabui ra naxan wo rasɛniyɛnma, a nun wo xa danxaniya saabui ra wo to danxaniyaxi nɔndi ma.

sentences.english: And in this purpose he gave you a part through the good news of which we were the preachers, even that you might have part in the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: A wo xilixi na nan ma. A wo xilixi muxu xa xibaaru fanyi xa kawandi nan saabui ra alako wo xa xunnakeli sɔtɔ naxan kelima Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ma, won Marigi Isa.

sentences.english: So then, brothers, be strong in purpose, and keep the teaching which has been given to you by word or by letter from us.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n ngaxakerenyie, wo sanyie xa xan danxaniya kui. Muxu wo xaran naxan na muxu xa kawandi nun bataaxɛ saabui ra, wo xa na suxu gben.

sentences.english: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father who had love for us and has given us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,
sentences.susu: Won Marigi Isa yɛtɛ yati, naxan findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra, nun won Baba Ala, naxan bara won xanu, naxan hinnɛma won na alako limaniya nun xaxili tide naxa ba won yi ra abadan,

sentences.english: Give you comfort and strength in every good work and word.
sentences.susu: e xa wo sondonyie ralimaniya. E man xa sɛnbɛ fi wo ma, wo xa wali nun wɔyɛnyi birin xa findi a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: For the rest, my brothers, let there be prayer for us that the word of the Lord may go forward with increasing glory, even as it does with you;
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, a dɔnxɔɛ ra, wo Ala maxandi muxu bɛ alako Marigi xa masenyi xa yensen yɛ mafuren na, a man xa binya yire birin alɔ a binyaxi wo xɔnyi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And that we may be made free from foolish and evil men; for not all have faith.
sentences.susu: Wo Ala maxandi muxu man xa ba mixi kobie nun mixi ɲaaxie bɛlɛxɛ, barima mixi birin xa mu danxaniyaxi.

sentences.english: But the Lord is true, who will give you strength and keep you safe from evil.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala na a xui xanbi ra. A sɛnbɛ fima nɛ wo ma, a wo ratanga Sentanɛ ma.

sentences.english: And we have faith in the Lord about you, that you are doing and will do the things about which we give you orders.
sentences.susu: Muxu laxi a ra Marigi saabui ra, a muxu yaamari naxee fixi wo ma, wo e rabatuma nɛ alɔ wo ɲan na rabafe ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And may your hearts be guided by the Lord into the love of God and quiet waiting for Christ.
sentences.susu: Marigi xa wo sondonyie xun ti kira fanyi xɔn alako wo xa Ala xanu, wo man xa wo tunnabɛxi alɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi a rabaxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Now we give you orders, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to keep away from all those whose behaviour is not well ordered and in harmony with the teaching which they had from us.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, muxu bara wo yamari won Marigi Isa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xili ra wo xa wo makuya danxaniyatɔɛe ra naxee findixi tunnaxɔnɛe ra. Na kui, e mu ɲɛrɛfe muxu xa masenyi ma muxu fa naxan na wo xɔn.

sentences.english: For you yourselves are used to taking us as your example, because our life among you was ruled by order,
sentences.susu: Wo a kolon yati wo lanma wo xa muxu fɔxi raba ki naxɛ. Muxu to nu na wo ya ma muxu mu findi tunnaxɔnɛe xa ra,

sentences.english: And we did not take food from any man for nothing, but were working hard night and day not to be a trouble to any of you:
sentences.susu: muxu man mu mixi yo xa bande don a fa lu muxu mu a sare fi. Muxu wakili nɛ kɔɛ nun yanyi ra, alako muxu xa fe naxa findi kote ra wo sese bɛ.

sentences.english: Not because we have not the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, so that you might do the same.
sentences.susu: Muxu nu nɔma muxu xa kɔntɔfili sade wo ya i, kɔnɔ muxu mu tin na ra alako muxu xa findi misaali ra wo bɛ, wo fan xa muxu fɔxi raba.

sentences.english: For even when we were with you we gave you orders, saying, If any man does no work, let him not have food.
sentences.susu: Muxu nu na wo ya ma tɛmui naxɛ, muxu yi yaamari nan fi wo ma: «Naxan yo mu tinma walide, hali wo mu na kanyi ki bande.»

sentences.english: For it has come to our ears that there are some among you whose behaviour is uncontrolled, who do no work at all, but are over-interested in the business of others.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara a mɛ a mixi ndee wo ya ma e bara e yɛtɛ findi tunnaxɔnɛe ra. E mu wali yo suxuma bafe naafixiya ra.

sentences.english: Now to such we give orders and make request in the Lord Jesus, that, working quietly, they get their living.
sentences.susu: Muxu bara na mixie yamari, muxu e rasi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi won Marigi Isa xili ra, e xa wali bɔɲɛsa kui alako e xa nɔ e yɛtɛ balode.

sentences.english: And you, my brothers, do not get tired of well-doing.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, wo naxa tagan fe fanyi rabafe ma.

sentences.english: And if any man does not give attention to what we have said in this letter, take note of that man, and keep away from him, so that he may be shamed.
sentences.susu: Wo a mato a fanyi ra, xa mixi nde mu tin muxu xa masenyi danxunde muxu naxan sɛbɛxi yi bataaxɛ kui, dɛfanyi naxa lu wo nun na kanyi tagi alako a xa yaagi.

sentences.english: Have no feeling of hate for him, but take him in hand seriously as a brother.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa a findi wo yaxui ra de, kɔnɔ wo xa a rasi alɔ wo ngaxakerenyi.

sentences.english: Now the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times and in every way. May the Lord be with you all.
sentences.susu: N bara Marigi maxandi naxan findixi bɔɲɛsa kanyi ra, a tan yɛtɛ yati xa bɔɲɛsa fi wo ma tɛmui birin nun a mɔɔli birin na. Marigi xa lu wo birin sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: These words of love to you at the end are in my writing, Paul's writing, and this is the mark of every letter from me.
sentences.susu: N tan Pɔlu nan yi xɛɛbui sɛbɛfe n yɛtɛ bɛlɛxɛ ra. N ma bataaxɛ birin matɔnxumaxi yi ki nɛ. N bɛlɛxɛ fɔxi nan ya.

sentences.english: May the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all.
sentences.susu: Won Marigi Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, a xa hinnɛ xa lu wo birin bɛ.

sentences.english: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ, by the order of God our Saviour and Christ Jesus our hope;
sentences.susu: Won Nakisima Ala nun Isa, won xaxili tima naxan na, e n tan Pɔlu tixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa xɛɛra nan na.

sentences.english: To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
sentences.susu: N na yi bataaxɛ sɛbɛfe Timote nan ma, naxan findixi n ma di yati ra a danxaniya ki ma. Baba Ala nun won Marigi Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, e xa hinnɛ nun bɔɲɛsa fi i ma, e xa kinikini i ma.

sentences.english: It was my desire, when I went on into Macedonia, that you might make a stop at Ephesus, to give orders to certain men not to put forward a different teaching,
sentences.susu: N to keli sigade Masedon, n naxa i rasi i xa lu Efɛsɛ alako i xa mixi ndee yamari e naxa xaranyi gbɛtɛe masen mixie bɛ,

sentences.english: Or to give attention to stories and long lists of generations, from which come questionings and doubts, in place of God's ordered way of life which is in faith;
sentences.susu: e naxa kiinie madɔxɔ, e man naxa bu e benbae xilie matɛngɛfe ra. Na fe mɔɔli wɔyɛnyi rawuyama nɛ, a mu Ala xa wali rasigama yare ma danxaniya kui.

sentences.english: But the effect of the order is love coming from a clean heart, and a knowledge of what is right, and true faith:
sentences.susu: N na yaamari fi nɛ alako xanunteya xa gbo, xanunteya naxan fatanxi bɔɲɛ sɛniyɛnxi ra, a nun ɲanige tinxinxi, nun danxaniya fiixɛ ra.

sentences.english: From which some have been turned away, giving themselves to foolish talking;
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee bara gbilen danxaniya fɔxɔ ra, e fa lɔɛ, na wɔyɛnyi fufafu saabui ra.

sentences.english: Desiring to be teachers of the law, though they have no knowledge of what they say or of the statements which they make so certainly.
sentences.susu: E wama findife sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔe nan na, kɔnɔ e wɔyɛnma fahaamutareɲa nan kui. E mu soxi fee kui e naxee masenma sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: We are conscious that the law is good, if a man makes a right use of it,
sentences.susu: Won a kolon Ala xa sɛriyɛ fan, xa a rawalima a sɛriyɛ ki ma.

sentences.english: With the knowledge that the law is made, not for the upright man, but for those who have no respect for law and order, for evil men and sinners, for the unholy and those who have no religion, for those who put their fathers or mothers to death, for takers of life,
sentences.susu: Won man a kolon Ala mu a xa sɛriyɛ fixi tinxintɔɛe xa fe xa ra. A a fixi tinxintaree nan ma fe ra, a nun Ala matandilae. A a fixi kaafirie, yunubitɔɛe, diinɛtaree, Ala maberelae nan ma fe ra. A a fixi mixie nan ma fe ra naxee e baba nun e ngae faxama. Faxatie,

sentences.english: For those who go after loose women, for those with unnatural desires, for those who take men prisoners, who make false statements and false oaths, and those who do any other things against the right teaching,
sentences.susu: yɛnɛlae, xɛmɛ naxee nun xɛmɛe kafuma, mixi suxuie, wule falɛe, mixi naxee kali tima wule xun, a nun mixi birin naxee Ala xa sɛriyɛ matandima, a a fixi nee nan ma fe ra.

sentences.english: Which may be seen in the good news of the glory of the great God, which was given into my care.
sentences.susu: Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi xa sɛriyɛ lanxi a xa xibaaru fanyi nɔrɔxi nan ma, a naxan taxuxi n na.

sentences.english: I give praise to him who gave me power, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he took me to be true, making me his servant,
sentences.susu: N bara won Marigi Isa tantu, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi naxan bara sɛnbɛ fi n ma, a bara la n na han a naxa n naso a xa wali kui.

sentences.english: Though I had said violent words against God, and done cruel acts, causing great trouble: but I was given mercy, because I did it without knowledge, not having faith;
sentences.susu: Singe n nu a rasɔtɔma nɛ, n a tɔɔrɔ, n a konbi. Kɔnɔ a naxa kinikini n ma, barima a a kolon n nu na birin nabama kolontareya nun danxaniyatareɲa nan kui.

sentences.english: And the grace of our Lord was very great, with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
sentences.susu: Marigi xa hinnɛ bara gbo yɛ. A danxaniya nun xanunteya fixi n ma Isa nan saabui ra, a xa Mixi Sugandixi.

sentences.english: It is a true saying, in which all may put their faith, that Christ Jesus came into the world to give salvation to sinners, of whom I am the chief:
sentences.susu: Nɔndi masenyi nan ya won birin lan won xa la naxan na: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa faxi duniɲa ma yunubitɔɛe nan nakiside. N tan Pɔlu nu findixi yunubitɔɛ nan na naxan dangi mixi birin na,

sentences.english: But for this reason I was given mercy, so that in me, the chief of sinners, Jesus Christ might make clear all his mercy, as an example to those who in the future would have faith in him to eternal life.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Ala naxa kinikini n ma hali n findixi yunubitɔɛ ra naxan dangi birin na, alako Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa diɲɛ gbegbe xa findi misaali ra mixie bɛ naxee danxaniyama a ma alako e xa kisi sɔtɔ naxan mu ɲɔnma abadan.

sentences.english: Now to the King eternal, ever-living, unseen, the only God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. So be it.
sentences.susu: Mangɛ Ala Kerenyi, naxan mu faxama, naxan mu toma, binyɛ nun nɔrɛ xa lu a bɛ abadan. Amina.

sentences.english: This order I give to you, Timothy my son, in harmony with the words of the prophets about you, so that by them you may be strong, fighting the good fight,
sentences.susu: N ma di Timote, n bara yi marasi fi i ma, naxan lanxi na namiɲɔnmɛ masenyie ma naxee nu falaxi i xa fe ra. I xa na masenyi rakamali, i xa gere fanyi so

sentences.english: Keeping faith, and being conscious of well-doing; for some, by not doing these things, have gone wrong in relation to the faith:
sentences.susu: danxaniya nun ɲanige tinxinxi ra. Ndee bara na rabolo, e xa danxaniya fa kana.

sentences.english: Such are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have given up to Satan, so that they may say no more evil words against God.
sentences.susu: Humeneyo nun Alesandire na na mixie nan ya ma. N nee soxi nɛ Sentanɛ yi ra, alako e xa a tinkan a mu lan e xa Ala rasɔtɔ.

sentences.english: My desire is, first of all, that you will make requests and prayers and give praise for all men;
sentences.susu: N ma marasi singe na yi nan na: Wo xa Ala makula, wo xa Ala maxandi, wo xa mixie xa kɔntɔfili masen Ala bɛ, wo xa Ala tantu mixi birin xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For kings and all those in authority; so that we may have a calm and quiet life in all fear of God and serious behaviour.
sentences.susu: Wo xa na raba mangɛe nun yarerati birin bɛ, alako won xa lu bɔɲɛsa kui, won ma duniɲɛigiri xa raxara, won xa lu Ala xa kira xɔn ma, won xa xili fanyi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: This is good and pleasing in the eyes of God our Saviour;
sentences.susu: Na nan fan, na nan lanxi won Nakisima Ala waxɔnfe ma.

sentences.english: Whose desire is that all men may have salvation and come to the knowledge of what is true.
sentences.susu: Ala wama adamadie birin xa kisi, e xa nɔndi kolon.

sentences.english: For there is one God and one peacemaker between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
sentences.susu: Ala keren na a ra. Xarisa fan keren nan a ra, Ala nun adamadie tagi. Na xarisa findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa nan na, naxan findi adamadi ra,

sentences.english: Who gave himself as an offering for all; witness of which was to be given at the right time;
sentences.susu: a fa a yɛtɛ fi xunsare ra mixi birin bɛ. Na nu findixi seedeɲɔxɔya nan na Ala nu wama a xɔn ma tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And of this I became a preacher and an Apostle (what I say is true, not false,) and a teacher of the Gentiles in the true faith.
sentences.susu: A n tan nan tixi kawandila, xɛɛra, nun karamɔxɔ ra si gbɛtɛe bɛ danxaniya nun nɔndi xa fe ra. N na na nɔndi nan falafe, wule mu a ra.

sentences.english: It is my desire, then, that in every place men may give themselves to prayer, lifting up holy hands, without wrath or argument.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, a xɔli n ma adamadie xa e bɛlɛxɛ sɛniyɛnxie itala Ala maxandi kui yire birin xɔnɛ nun sɔnxɔ mu naxan na.

sentences.english: And that women may be dressed in simple clothing, with a quiet and serious air; not with twisted hair and gold or jewels or robes of great price;
sentences.susu: N man wama nɛ ginɛe xa dugie nan so naxee e suturama. E naxa e yɛtɛ raxunma xunsɛxɛ dɛnbɛxi ra, xɛɛma ra, gɛmɛ tofanyie ra, xa na mu a ra dugie ra, naxee sare xɔrɔxɔ.

sentences.english: But clothed with good works, as is right for women who are living in the fear of God.
sentences.susu: A lanma e xa e yɛtɛ raxunma kɛwali fanyi nan na, naxan lanma ginɛe ma naxee birama Ala fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Let a woman quietly take the place of a learner and be under authority.
sentences.susu: Ginɛe xa nu fe xaran sabari nun magore kui.

sentences.english: In my opinion it is right for a woman not to be a teacher, or to have rule over a man, but to be quiet.
sentences.susu: N mu a luma ginɛe xa xɛmɛe xaran, xa na mu a ra e xa e yamari. Ginɛe xa lu sabari kui,

sentences.english: For Adam was first formed, then Eve;
sentences.susu: barima Adama nan singe daa, beenun Mahawa xa daa.

sentences.english: And Adam was not taken by deceit, but the woman, being tricked, became a wrongdoer.
sentences.susu: Adama xa mu madaxu. Ginɛ nan madaxu, a fa findi yunubitɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: But if they go on in faith and love and holy self-control, she will be kept safe at the time of childbirth.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala ginɛ rakisima a xa di bari nan kui, xa a luma danxaniya, xanunteya, nun sɛniyɛnyi kui, alɔ a lanma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: This is a true saying, A man desiring the position of a Bishop has a desire for a good work.
sentences.susu: Nɔndi nan ya: Mixi naxan wama findife danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xunmati ra, a wama wali fanyi xɔn.

sentences.english: The Bishop, then, is to be a man of good name, the husband of one wife, self-controlled, serious-minded, having respect for order, opening his house freely to guests, a ready teacher;
sentences.susu: A lanma danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xunmati xa findi mixi ra mixie mu nɔma fe ɲaaxi nde yo falade naxan xun ma. A xa a li a ginɛ keren gbansan nan dɔxɔxi, a findi taxasi mixi ra, naxan a yɛtɛ xaninma xaxilimaya ra, binyɛ na naxan ma, naxan fata xɔɲɛ masuxude, naxan fata mixi xarande.

sentences.english: Not quickly moved to wrath or blows, but gentle; no fighter, no lover of money;
sentences.susu: A mu lanma a xa findi siisila ra, a mu lanma a xa mawolen. A lanma nɛ a xa findi mixi ra naxan lanyi fenma, naxan bɔɲɛ xinbeli, naxan mu mila.

sentences.english: Ruling his house well, having his children under control with all serious behaviour;
sentences.susu: A xa fata a yɛtɛ xa denbaya raɲɛrɛde, a xa die xa lu a xa yaamari bun ma xurui kui,

sentences.english: (For if a man has not the art of ruling his house, how will he take care of the church of God?)
sentences.susu: barima xa mixi mu fata a yɛtɛ xa denbaya raɲɛrɛde, a fa mɛɛnima Ala xa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama ma di?

sentences.english: Not one newly taken into the church, for fear that, through his high opinion of himself, he may come into the same sin as the Evil One.
sentences.susu: A naxa findi danxaniyatɔɛ nɛɛnɛ ra de, alako a naxa a yɛtɛ igbo, a fa ɲaxankatɛ sɔtɔ alɔ Ibulisa a sɔtɔxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And he is to have a good name among those outside the church, so that nothing may be said against him and he may not be taken by the designs of the Evil One.
sentences.susu: A man xa findi xili fanyi kanyi nan na danxaniyataree tagi, alako mixie naxa yo a ma, a naxa suxu Ibulisa xa gantanyi ra.

sentences.english: Deacons, in the same way, are to be serious in their behaviour, not false in word, not given to taking much wine or greatly desiring the wealth of this world;
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee findixi danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama malie ra, e fan xa findi xili fanyi kanyie nan na. E xa e makuya filankafuiɲa ra, e naxa siisi, e naxa bira kɔbiri fɔxɔ ra yaagitareya kui.

sentences.english: Keeping the secret of the faith in a heart free from sin.
sentences.susu: E xa Ala xa danxaniya masenyi ragata e xaxili fanyi kui.

sentences.english: And let these first be put to the test; then let them become Deacons if there is nothing against them.
sentences.susu: E xa mato sinden. Xa e tinxin, e nɔma findide danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama malie ra.

sentences.english: Women are to be serious in behaviour, saying no evil of others, controlling themselves, true in all things.
sentences.susu: Ginɛe fan xa findi xili fanyi kanyie ra. E naxa findi naafixie ra, e xa findi taxasi mixi ra, e xa tinxin fe birin kui.

sentences.english: Let Deacons be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their houses well.
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama malie xa ginɛ keren gbansan nan dɔxɔ, e xa e xa die nun e xa fɔxɔɛ raɲɛrɛ a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: For those who have done good work as Deacons get for themselves a good position and become free from fear in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama malima a fanyi ra, e binyɛ nun limaniya nan sɔtɔma e xa danxaniya kui Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa ma.

sentences.english: I am writing these things to you, though I am hoping to come to you before long;
sentences.susu: N na yi bataaxɛ sɛbɛfe nɛ i ma, hali n to laxi a ra a gbe mu luxi n xa i yire li.

sentences.english: But if I am long in coming, this will make clear to you what behaviour is right for men in the house of God, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and base of what is true.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li n naxa dugundi, i xa Ala xa mixie ɲɛrɛ ki fanyi kolon. Ala naxan na na, a xa mixie lanxi a xa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama nan ma, naxan na nɔndi xa kinki ra.

sentences.english: And without argument, great is the secret of religion: He who was seen in the flesh, who was given God's approval in the spirit, was seen by the angels, of whom the good news was given among the nations, in whom the world had faith, who was taken up in glory.
sentences.susu: Fo won xa a kolon nɛ a Ala ɲɛrɛ ki sɛnbɛ gbo. A gundo makɛnɛnxi nan ya: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi masenxi adama fate nan na, a xaxili nan tinxin. A mini nɛ malekɛe ma, a kawandixi ɲamanɛe nan tagi. Duniɲa danxaniyaxi a tan nan ma, a texi nɔrɛ nan kui.

sentences.english: But the Spirit says clearly that in later times some will be turned away from the faith, giving their minds to spirits of deceit, and the teachings of evil spirits,
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili a masenma nɛ won bɛ a fiixɛ ra, a ndee fama nɛ danxaniya rabolode waxati dɔnxɔɛ kui, e fa bira ɲinnɛ wule falɛe nun e xa xaranyie fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Through the false ways of men whose words are untrue, whose hearts are burned as with a heated iron;
sentences.susu: Wule falɛ filankafuie mixie madaxuma. E xaxili balanxi gben.

sentences.english: Who keep men from being married and from taking food which God made to be taken with praise by those who have faith and true knowledge.
sentences.susu: E tɔnyi dɔxɔma futi xirife ra, a nun donse ndee donfe ra, Ala naxee daaxi alako danxaniyatɔɛe nun nɔndi falɛe xa e don tantui ra.

sentences.english: Because everything which God has made is good, and nothing is evil, if it is taken with praise:
sentences.susu: Ala se naxan birin daaxi, a fan. A mu raharamuxi mixie bɛ naxee a donma tantui ra,

sentences.english: For it is made holy by the word of God and by prayer.
sentences.susu: barima Ala xa masenyi nun Ala maxandi na rasɛniyɛnma.

sentences.english: If you keep these things before the minds of the brothers, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, trained in the words of the faith and of the right teaching which has been your guide:
sentences.susu: Xa i na nɔndi masen i ngaxakerenyie bɛ, i bara findi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa walikɛ fanyi ra, naxan i baloma danxaniya masenyi nun xaranyi fanyi ra, i birama naxan fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: But have nothing to do with unclean and foolish stories. Give yourself training in religion:
sentences.susu: I naxa fe fufafu madɔxɔ kiini ra danxaniya mu naxan kui. I xa Ala fe suxu sɔɔbɛ ra.

sentences.english: For the training of the body is of profit for a little, but religion is of profit in every way, giving hope for the life which now is, and for that which is to come.
sentences.susu: Mixie mɛɛnife e fate ma, na tide mu gbo alɔ e na e xaxili yaka ba. Na xaxili yaka ba nan fama findide mixie bɛ munafanyi ra duniɲa nun aligiyama.

sentences.english: This is a true saying, in which all may put their faith.
sentences.susu: Nɔndi masenyi nan ya won birin lan won xa la naxan na:

sentences.english: And this is the purpose of all our work and our fighting, because our hope is in the living God, who is the Saviour of all men, and specially of those who have faith.
sentences.susu: Won walima tunnabɛxi nan na, barima won xaxili tixi Ala Ɲiɲɛ ra, naxan findixi adamadi birin Nakisima ra, a gbengbenyi danxaniyatɔɛe.

sentences.english: Let these be your orders and your teaching.
sentences.susu: Na nan na ki, i xa na yaamari birin masen mixie bɛ, i xa e xaran na sɛriyɛe ra.

sentences.english: Let no one make little of you because you are young, but be an example to the church in word, in behaviour, in love, in faith, in holy living.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo naxa yo i xa fonikeya ma. I naxan nabama, i xa findi misaali ra danxaniyatɔɛe bɛ a lanma e xa wɔyɛn ki naxɛ, e xa ɲɛrɛ ki naxɛ, e xa e bore xanu ki naxɛ, e xa danxaniya nun e xa sɛniyɛnyi xa lu ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Till I come, give attention to the reading of the holy Writings, to comforting the saints, and to teaching.
sentences.susu: Han n sa fama tɛmui naxɛ, i xa Kitaabui xaran mixie bɛ, i xa e ralimaniya, i xa e xaran.

sentences.english: Make use of that grace in you, which was given to you by the word of the prophets, when the rulers of the church put their hands on you.
sentences.susu: I naxa wali bɛɲin naxan soxi i yi ra, masenyi tixi Ala xili ra i xa fe ra naxan ma, forie to e bɛlɛxɛ sa i xunyi ma.

sentences.english: Have a care for these things; give yourself to them with all your heart, so that all may see how you go forward.
sentences.susu: I xa na rabatu sɛnbɛ ra, alako mixi birin xa i ɲɛrɛ ki to i sigama yare ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Give attention to yourself and your teaching. Go on in these things; for in doing so you will get salvation for yourself and for those who give hearing to you.
sentences.susu: Mɛɛni i yɛtɛ ma, nun na xaranyi ma i naxan tima tunnabɛxi ra. Xa i na raba i kisima nɛ, i tan nun naxee i xui ramɛma.

sentences.english: Do not say sharp words to one who has authority in the church, but let your talk be as to a father, and to the younger men as to brothers:
sentences.susu: I naxa wɔyɛn xɔrɔxɔɛ fala forie bɛ. I xa e ralimaniya alɔ i baba. I xa xɛmɛ fonikee ralimaniya alɔ i xunya xɛmɛmae.

sentences.english: To the older women as to mothers, to the younger as to sisters, with a clean heart.
sentences.susu: I xa ɲɛlɛxɛforie ralimaniya alɔ i nga. I xa fonike ginɛmae ralimaniya alɔ i maaginɛe sɛniyɛnyi kui.

sentences.english: Give honour to widows who are truly widows.
sentences.susu: I xa kaaɲɛ ginɛe binya, naxee na e kerenyi ma.

sentences.english: But if any widow has children or children's children, let these see that it is right to take care of their family and their fathers and mothers: for this is pleasing in the eyes of God.
sentences.susu: Xa kaaɲɛ ginɛ xa die na na, xa na mu a ra a xa mamadie, e tan xa Ala waxɔnfe matinkan e xa denbaya bɛ. Die barimixie naxan nabaxi e bɛ, e xa na sare ragbilen e ma. Ala wama na nan xɔn.

sentences.english: Now she who is truly a widow and without family puts her hope in God, giving herself to prayer day and night.
sentences.susu: Kaaɲɛ ginɛ yati yati, naxan luxi a keren, a a xaxili tima Ala nan na. A salima, a Ala maxandima tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she is living.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ kaaɲɛ ginɛ naxan birama a yɛtɛ waxɔnfe fɔxɔ ra, a tan bara faxa hali a ɲiɲɛ to a ra.

sentences.english: Give orders to this effect, so that no evil may be said of anyone.
sentences.susu: I xa yi yaamarie masen mixie bɛ, alako e xa lu tinxinyi kui.

sentences.english: If anyone has no care for his family and those in his house, he is false to the faith, and is worse than one who has no faith.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan mu mɛɛnima a xa mixie ma, a gbengbenyi a xa denbaya ma, na kanyi bara danxaniya bɛɲin. A ɲaaxu dangife kaafiri ra.

sentences.english: Let no woman be numbered among the widows who is under sixty years old, and only if she has been the wife of one man,
sentences.susu: Kaaɲɛ ginɛ naxan xili lanma a xa sɛbɛ kaaɲɛ ginɛe xilie ya ma, a lanma a xa simaya xa dangi ɲɛ tongo senni ra. A xa a li a nu dɔxɔxi xɛmɛ keren gbansan nan xɔn ma,

sentences.english: And if witness is given of her good works; if she has had the care of children, if she has been kind to travellers, washing the feet of the saints, helping those who are in trouble, giving herself to good works.
sentences.susu: a nun man a kolonxi tinxintɔɛ ra a xa wali fanyie xa fe ra, alɔ di xurufe, xɔɲɛ rasɛnɛfe, sɛniyɛntɔɛe sanyi maxafe, tɔɔrɔmixie malife, a nun birafe fe fanyi mɔɔli birin fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: But to the younger widows say No: for when their love is turned away from Christ, they have a desire to be married;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ kaaɲɛ ginɛ naxee findixi sungbutunyie ra, e xili naxa sɛbɛ, barima xa a sa li e waxɔnfee e ragbilenma nɛ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi fɔxɔ ra, e fa dɔxɔ xɛmɛ taa,

sentences.english: And they are judged because they have been false to their first faith;
sentences.susu: na tɛmui e bara yunubi sɔtɔ, barima e bara e xa laayidi singe kana.

sentences.english: And they get into the way of doing no work, going about from house to house; and not only doing no work, but talking foolishly, being over-interested in the business of others, saying things which they have no right to say.
sentences.susu: Bafe na ra, e man findima tunnaxɔnɛe nan na, e nu fa lu e maɲɛrɛ ra naafixiya rabade, e mixi mafalama, e fe fala naxan mu lanma a xa fala.

sentences.english: So it is my desire that the younger widows may be married and have children, controlling their families, and giving the Evil One no chance to say anything against them,
sentences.susu: Na kui, a xɔli n ma kaaɲɛ ginɛ sungbutunyie xa dɔxɔ xɛmɛ taa, e fa die bari, e mɛɛni e xa denbaya ma, alako won yaxuie naxa nɔ fe ɲaaxi falade e xun ma.

sentences.english: For even now some are turned away to Satan.
sentences.susu: Ndee ɲan bara e kobe raso, e bira Sentanɛ fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: If any woman of the faith has relations who are widows, let her give them help, so that the care of them does not come on the church, and so it may give help to those who are truly widowed.
sentences.susu: Xa danxaniyatɔɛ ginɛ bara kaaɲɛ ginɛ ndee sɔtɔ a xa mixie ya ma, a xa a yigiya alako a naxa findi kote ra danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama bɛ. Na kui, danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama nɔma nɛ kaaɲɛ ginɛe malide naxee na e kerenyi ma.

sentences.english: Let rulers whose rule is good be honoured twice over, specially those whose work is preaching and teaching.
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xa forie, naxee fee raɲɛrɛma a fanyi ra, e xa binyɛ xungbe sɔtɔ, a gbengbenyi naxee kawandi nun xaranyi tima.

sentences.english: For the Writings say, It is not right to keep the ox from taking the grain when he is crushing it. And, The worker has a right to his reward.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, «Ninge nɛ mɛngi turuxunma, wo mu lan wo xa a dɛ xiri.» A man sɛbɛxi, «Walikɛ xa a wali sare sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: Do not take as true any statement made against one in authority, but only if two or three give witness to it.
sentences.susu: I naxa kalamui ramɛ danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xa fori nde xa fe ra, xa seede firin, xa na mu a ra saxan, mu na fe toxi.

sentences.english: Say sharp words to sinners when all are present, so that the rest may be in fear.
sentences.susu: Naxee bara yunubi raba, i xa i yaxaseri masa e xa fe ra, birin ya xɔri, alako booree fan xa gaaxu.

sentences.english: I give you orders before God and Christ Jesus and the angels of God's selection, to keep these orders without giving thought to one side more than another.
sentences.susu: N bara yi yaamarie fi i ma, Ala, a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa, nun malekɛ sugandixie ya xɔri. I xa yi yaamarie rabatu tinxinyi kui. I naxa mixi yo rafisa a boore bɛ.

sentences.english: Do not put hands on any man without thought, and have no part in other men's sins: keep yourself clean.
sentences.susu: I naxa gbata mixie sugandide, i fa i bɛlɛxɛ sa e ma, xa na mu a ra i fan luma nɛ e xa yunubie kui. I xa lu sɛniyɛnyi kui.

sentences.english: Do not take only water as your drink, but take a little wine for the good of your stomach, and because you are frequently ill.
sentences.susu: I naxa ye gbansan xa min. I xa wɛni nde min seri ra i furi xa fe ra, barima i luma fura ra.

sentences.english: The sins of some men are clearly seen, going before them to be judged; but with others, their sins go after them.
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee xa yunubie makɛnɛnxi beenun e xa makiitide li, kɔnɔ boore gbee mu toma fo yare.

sentences.english: In the same way, there are good works which are clearly seen; and those which are not so, may not be kept secret.
sentences.susu: Wali fanyi fan makɛnɛnma na ki nɛ, wali ɲaaxi mu nɔxunma.

sentences.english: Let all who are servants under the yoke give all honour to their masters, so that no evil may be said against the name of God and his teaching.
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛ naxee na konyiya kui, e xa e marigie binya, alako binyɛ yo naxa ba Ala xili ra, a nun a xa sɛriyɛ ra.

sentences.english: And let those whose masters are of the faith have respect for them because they are brothers, working for them the more readily, because those who take part in the good work are of the faith and are dear. Give orders and teaching about these things.
sentences.susu: Konyi naxee marigi findixi danxaniyatɔɛe ra, na konyie naxa yo e marigi ma, a falafe ra a e ngaxakerenyie nan e ra. A lanma e xa e xa yaamari rabatu a fanyi ra dangife a singe ra, barima e na walife e ngaxakerenyi xanuxie nan bɛ. I xa mixie xaran yi yaamarie ra.

sentences.english: If any man gives different teaching, not in agreement with the true words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and with the teaching which is in agreement with true religion,
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li mixi nde xaranyi gbɛtɛ nan tima, a mu bira won Marigi Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa masenyi tinxinxi fɔxɔ ra, nun xaranyi naxan findixi Ala gbe ra,

sentences.english: He has an over-high opinion of himself; being without knowledge, having only an unhealthy love of questionings and wars of words, from which come envy, fighting, cruel words, evil thoughts,
sentences.susu: na kanyi bara a yɛtɛ igbo, a mu sese kolon. A xaxili mu fan. A xa wɔyɛnyi gbo, sɔnxɔɛ rafan a ma. Na findima tɔɔnɛ, lantareya, tɔɔɲɛgɛ, siikɛ,

sentences.english: Bitter talk of men who, being evil in mind and dead to what is true, take the faith to be a way of making profit.
sentences.susu: tinxintaree xa sɔnxɔ sɔnxɔɛ, nun nɔndi kolontareya. E diinɛ rawalima kɔbiri fe nan na.

sentences.english: But true faith, with peace of mind, is of great profit:
sentences.susu: Diinɛ nan findima geeni ra mixie bɛ, naxee e wasasoma e sɔtɔse.

sentences.english: For we came into the world with nothing, and we are not able to take anything out;
sentences.susu: Won faxi duniɲa ma won bɛlɛxɛe igeli nan na, won man sigama na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: But if we have food and a roof over us, let that be enough.
sentences.susu: Xa baloe nun sose na won yi ra, won xa won wasaso na ra.

sentences.english: But those who have a desire for wealth are falling into danger, and are taken as in a net by a number of foolish and damaging desires, through which men are overtaken by death and destruction.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi naxan wama bannafe, na kanyi tantanma nɛ, a suxu gantanyi ra, a fa mila a waxɔnfe ɲaaxie ma. Na waxɔnfe ɲaaxie nan mixie xun nakanama, e fa lɔɛ.

sentences.english: For the love of money is a root of all evil: and some whose hearts were fixed on it have been turned away from the faith, and been wounded with unnumbered sorrows.
sentences.susu: Kɔbiri xɔli findixi fe kobi birin sanke nan na. Ndee to mila kɔbiri ma, e naxa danxaniya bɛɲin, e fa tɔɔrɔ a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: But you, O man of God, keep yourself from these things, and go after righteousness, religion, faith, love, a quiet mind, gentle behaviour.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan naxan findixi Ala xa mixi ra, i xa gbilen na fe mɔɔlie fɔxɔ ra. I xa bira tinxinyi, Ala fe, danxaniya, xanunteya, diɲɛ, nun bɔɲɛ bɛxiya fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Be fighting the good fight of the faith; take for yourself the life eternal, for which you were marked out, and of which you gave witness in the eyes of all.
sentences.susu: Danxaniya gere fanyi so. Kisi suxu, i xilixi naxan ma, i seedeɲɔxɔya tixi naxan ma fe ra seede wuyaxi ya xɔri.

sentences.english: I give you orders before God, the giver of life, and Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate gave witness to the faith,
sentences.susu: N bara i yamari Ala ya xɔri, naxan nimase birin nabaloma, n bara i yamari Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa ya xɔri, naxan bara seedeɲɔxɔya fanyi ti Ponsi Pilati bɛ,

sentences.english: To keep the word untouched by evil, clear from all shame, till the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ:
sentences.susu: i xa Ala xa sɛriyɛ rabatu tinxinyi sɛniyɛnxi ra han won Marigi Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi fa tɛmui.

sentences.english: Which at the right time he will make clear, who is the eternal and only Ruler, King of kings, and Lord of lords;
sentences.susu: Ala nan fama Isa raminide a wama a xɔn ma waxati naxɛ. Tantui Kanyi, Mangɛ Sɛnbɛma, firin mu kafuxi naxan ma, Mangɛe xa Mangɛ, Marigie Marigi Ala,

sentences.english: Who only has life for ever, living in light to which no man may come near; whom no man has seen or is able to see: to whom be honour and power for ever. So be it.
sentences.susu: naxan keren mu faxɛ kolon, naxan xɔnyi na naiyalanyi ra, adamadie mu naxan toxi, adama mu nɔma naxan tode. Binyɛ nun sɛnbɛ na a bɛ abadan. Amina.

sentences.english: Give orders to those who have money and goods in this life, not to be lifted up in their minds, or to put their hope in the uncertain chances of wealth, but in God who gives us in full measure all things for our use;
sentences.susu: I xa to bannamixie yamari a e naxa e yɛtɛ igbo, e man naxa e xaxili ti naafuli ra, barima naafuli mu buma. E xa e xaxili ti Ala nan na, naxan won kima se birin na alako won xa sɛɛwa.

sentences.english: And to do good, having wealth in good works, being quick to give, taking part with one another;
sentences.susu: E xa fe fanyi raba. E xa kɛwali fanyi nan xa findi e xa bannaya ra. E xa mixi ki e harige ra e xa fonisireya xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Making ready for themselves a safe place for the time to come, so that the true life may be theirs.
sentences.susu: Na birin kui e harige sɔtɔma nɛ yare naxan findima kisi yati yati ra e bɛ.

sentences.english: O Timothy, take good care of that which is given to you, turning away from the wrong and foolish talk and arguments of that knowledge which is falsely so named;
sentences.susu: Timote, i xa mɛɛni fe ma naxan taxuxi i ra. I xa wɔyɛnyi fufafu nun wule matanga.

sentences.english: Through which some, who gave their minds to it, have been turned away from the faith. Grace be with you.
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee na falama a lɔnni, kɔnɔ lɔnni mu a ra. Na bara a niya e xa e kobe so danxaniya ra. Ala xa hinnɛ wo ra.

sentences.english: Paul, an Apostle of Jesus Christ by the purpose of God, in the hope of the life which is in Christ Jesus,
sentences.susu: N tan Pɔlu nan yi ki, naxan findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa xɛɛra ra Ala waxɔnki. Laayidi tongoxi won bɛ kisi xa fe ra Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa saabui nan na.

sentences.english: To Timothy, my well-loved child: Grace, mercy, peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
sentences.susu: N na yi bataaxɛ sɛbɛfe Timote nan ma, naxan findixi n ma di maxanuxi ra. Baba Ala nun won Marigi Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, e xa hinnɛ, kinikini, nun bɔɲɛsa fi i ma.

sentences.english: I give praise to God, whose servant I have been, with a heart free from sin, from the time of my fathers, because in my prayers at all times the thought of you is with me, night and day
sentences.susu: N bara Ala tantu, n naxan batuma ɲanige fiixɛ ra alɔ n benbae a rabaxi ki naxɛ. N Ala maxandima nɛ i bɛ kɔɛ nun yanyi ra,

sentences.english: Desiring to see you, keeping in my memory your weeping, so that I may be full of joy;
sentences.susu: barima n nan n natuxi i yaye nan ma. N man nu wama i tofe han, alako n xa sɛɛwa a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Having in mind your true faith, which first was in your mother's mother Lois, and in your mother Eunice, and, I am certain, is now in you.
sentences.susu: N man n natuxi i xa danxaniya nan ma, filankafuiɲa mu na naxan kui, naxan nu na i mama Lowisi fan yi ra, a nun i nga Ewunise. N a kolon i fan danxaniyaxi na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: For this reason I say to you, Let that grace of God which is in you, given to you by my hands, have living power.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n bara i ralimaniya i xa Ala sɛnbɛ rawali, a naxan fixi i ma n to n bɛlɛxɛ sa i xunyi ma.

sentences.english: For God did not give us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of self-control.
sentences.susu: Ala mu gaaxu xaxili xa soxi won yi ra. A bara xaxili fi won ma naxan findixi sɛnbɛ, xanunteya, nun yɛtɛ suxui ra.

sentences.english: Have no feeling of shame, then, for the witness of our Lord or for me, his prisoner: but undergo all things for the good news in the measure of the power of God;
sentences.susu: I naxa yaagi won Marigi xa seedeɲɔxɔya bade. I man naxa yaagi n na, n tan naxan na geeli kui won Marigi xa fe ra. A lanma won birin xa tɔɔrɔ Isa xa xibaaru fanyi xa fe ra Ala sɛnbɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: Who gave us salvation, marking us out for his purpose, not on account of our works, but in the measure of his purpose and his grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,
sentences.susu: A tan nan won nakisixi, a tan nan won xilixi a xa sɛniyɛnyi ma. A mu na rabaxi won ma kɛwali saabui xa ra, a na ɲanigexi a yɛtɛ nan na. A hinnɛxi won na a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa fe nan na kafi duniɲa fɔlɛ.

sentences.english: But has now been made clear by the revelation of our Saviour Christ Jesus, who put an end to death and made life unending come to light through the good news,
sentences.susu: Yakɔsi won bara na hinnɛ to won Nakisima Isa xa fa kui, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi. A bara faxɛ sɛnbɛ kana, a kisi fe ramini a xa xibaaru fanyi saabui ra, alako adama naxa faxa sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Of which I was made a preacher and an Apostle and a teacher;
sentences.susu: Ala n findixi kawandila, xɛɛra, nun karamɔxɔ nan na na xibaaru fanyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And for which I undergo these things: but I have no feeling of shame. For I have knowledge of him in whom I have faith, and I am certain that he is able to keep that which I have given into his care till that day.
sentences.susu: N na tɔɔrɔfe na wali nan xa fe ra, kɔnɔ n mu yaagima na ra, barima n a kolon n danxaniyaxi naxan ma. N bara la a ra a nɔma n ma kisi ragatade han na lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: Keep the form of those true words which you had from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
sentences.susu: N nɔndi naxan masenxi i bɛ, na xa findi i xa misaali ra, i birama naxan fɔxɔ ra danxaniya nun xanunteya ra, alɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: That good thing which was given to you keep safe, through the Holy Spirit which is in us.
sentences.susu: Ala naxan taxuxi i ra, i xa mɛɛni na ma Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra, naxan sabatixi won i.

sentences.english: You have had news that all those in Asia went away from me; among whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes:
sentences.susu: I a kolon Asikae birin bara n nabolo, alɔ Figelo nun Heremogene.

sentences.english: May the Lord give mercy to the house of Onesiphorus because he frequently gave me help, and had no feeling of shame because I was in chains;
sentences.susu: Ala xa kinikini Onesiforo nun a xa denbaya ma, barima a nu luma n nalimaniya ra. A mu yaagi n na n to na geeli kui.

sentences.english: But when he was in Rome, he went in search of me everywhere, and came to me
sentences.susu: A to fa Rɔma, a naxa n fen han a naxa n to.

sentences.english: (May he have the Lord's mercy in that day); and of all he did for me at Ephesus you have full knowledge.
sentences.susu: Marigi xa kinikini a ma na kiiti lɔxɔɛ. I a kolon dangi birin na a n malixi ki naxɛ Efɛsɛ.

sentences.english: So then, my child, be strong in the grace which is in Christ Jesus.
sentences.susu: N ma di, i xa i sɛnbɛ so Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa hinnɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And the things which I have said to you before a number of witnesses, give to those of the faith, so that they may be teachers of others.
sentences.susu: I naxan mɛxi n na seede gbegbe ya xɔri, i xa na masenyi taxu i dugutɛgɛe ra, naxee fan nɔma mixi gbɛtɛe raxarande na ra.

sentences.english: Be ready to do without the comforts of life, as one of the army of Christ Jesus.
sentences.susu: Won birin xa wakili tɔɔrɛ kui, barima Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa sɔɔri fanyie nan won na.

sentences.english: A fighting man, when he is with the army, keeps himself free from the business of this life so that he may be pleasing to him who has taken him into his army.
sentences.susu: Sɔɔri naxan na gere kui, a mu birama duniɲa fe fɔxɔ ra, a birama a xa mangɛ waxɔnfe nan fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And if a man takes part in a competition he does not get the crown if he has not kept the rules.
