sentences.susu: Mixi naxan sigaxi gi gbata rabade, xa a mu a gi a sɛriyɛ ki ma, a mu geenima.

sentences.english: It is right for the worker in the fields to be the first to take of the fruit.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan xɛ rawalima, a tan nan lanma a xa bogi singee sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Give thought to what I say; for the Lord will give you wisdom in all things.
sentences.susu: I ɲɔxɔ sa n ma masenyi birin xɔn ma, Marigi fahaamui fima nɛ i ma na fee ma.

sentences.english: Keep in mind Jesus Christ, of the seed of David, who came back from the dead, as my good news gives witness:
sentences.susu: I xa ratu Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa ma, naxan kelixi faxɛ ma, naxan fatanxi Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ ra, alɔ Isa xa xibaaru fanyi a masenxi ki naxɛ, n naxan kawandife.

sentences.english: In which I put up with the hardest conditions, even prison chains, like one who has done a crime; but the word of God is not in chains.
sentences.susu: Na xibaaru fanyi nan ma fe a niyaxi, n na tɔɔrɔfe geeli kui alɔ fe kobi rabama, kɔnɔ Ala xa masenyi tan mu balanxi.

sentences.english: But I undergo all things for the saints, so that they may have salvation in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra n tɔɔrɛ mɔɔli birin xaninma, alako mixi sugandixie xa kisi sɔtɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa saabui ra, e lu a xa nɔrɛ kui abadan.

sentences.english: This is a true saying: If we undergo death with him, then will we be living with him:
sentences.susu: Masenyi hagigɛ nan ya: Xa won nun Isa bara faxa, won nun Isa man kelima nɛ faxɛ ma.

sentences.english: If we go on to the end, then we will be ruling with him: if we say we have no knowledge of him, then he will say he has no knowledge of us:
sentences.susu: Xa won tunnabɛxi, won luma nɛ Isa xa mangɛya kui. Xa won na a rabolo, a fan won naboloma nɛ.

sentences.english: If we are without faith, still he keeps faith, for he will never be untrue to himself.
sentences.susu: Xa won mu lu won xui xanbi ra, a tan luma nɛ a xui xanbi ra, barima a mu nɔma a yɛtɛ rabolode.

sentences.english: Put these things before them, giving them orders in the name of the Lord to keep themselves from fighting about words, which is of no profit, only causing error in their hearers.
sentences.susu: I xa mixi birin natu Ala ya i, a a lanma e xa gere lu na masenyi ndee xa fe ra. Na wɔyɛnyi mɔɔli tide yo mu na. A a ramɛmae nan xun nakanama tun.

sentences.english: Let it be your care to get the approval of God, as a workman who has no cause for shame, giving the true word in the right way.
sentences.susu: I xa i yɛtɛ masen Ala bɛ, alɔ mixi naxan wali fɔxi mu mayaagi, a fata nɔndi masende mixie bɛ a masen ki ma.

sentences.english: But take no part in wrong and foolish talk, for those who do so will go farther into evil,
sentences.susu: Wɔyɛn ɲaaxi fufafu lu na, barima naxee na mɔɔli falama, e xa kaafiriɲa xun nan tun masama.

sentences.english: And their words will be like poisoned wounds in the flesh: such are Hymenaeus and Philetus;
sentences.susu: E xa wɔyɛnyi gboma nɛ alɔ fure ɲaaxi, naxan mixi faxama. Humeneyo nun Fileto na nee nan ya ma.

sentences.english: Men whose ideas are all false, who say that the coming back from the dead has even now taken place, overturning the faith of some.
sentences.susu: E bara makuya nɔndi ra, e fa a fala mixie ɲan bara keli faxɛ ma. E bara mixi ndee xa danxaniya kana na wɔyɛnyi mɔɔli ra.

sentences.english: But God's strong base is unchanging, having this sign, The Lord has knowledge of those who are his: and, Let everyone by whom the name of the Lord is named be turned away from evil.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala xa banxi tixi yi masenyi nan fari: «Ala a kolon, mixi naxan findixi a gbe ra.» A man a masenxi: «Adamadi naxan Marigi xili falama, a xa tinxintareya rabɛɲin.»

sentences.english: Now in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and silver, but others of wood and earth, and some which are honoured and some without honour.
sentences.susu: Se sase mɔɔli gbegbe nan na banxi xungbe kui. Nde fan yailanxi xɛɛma nan na, xa na mu a ra gbeti. Nde yailanxi wuri nan na, xa na mu a ra bɛndɛ. Nde binyɛ wali rabama, nde fan binyɛtare wali rabama.

sentences.english: If a man makes himself clean from these, he will be a vessel for honour, made holy, ready for the master's use, ready for every good work.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan a yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛnma, a luma nɛ alɔ wali binyɛ rabama se sase naxan kui. A to sɛniyɛn, a marigi nɔma a rawalide wali fanyi birin kui.

sentences.english: But keep yourself from those desires of the flesh which are strong when the body is young, and go after righteousness, faith, love, peace, with those whose prayers go up to the Lord from a clean heart.
sentences.susu: Fonike waxɔnfe lu na. Wo nun mixi naxee Marigi xilima bɔɲɛ sɛniyɛnxi ra, wo xa nu tinxinyi, danxaniya, xanunteya, nun bɔɲɛsa fen.

sentences.english: And put away foolish and uncontrolled questionings, seeing that they are a cause of trouble.
sentences.susu: Wɔyɛnyi tidetare fufafu lu na, barima i a kolon na mɔɔli findima gere nan na.

sentences.english: For it is not right for the Lord's servant to make trouble, but he is to be gentle to all, ready in teaching, putting up with wrong,
sentences.susu: A mu lanma Marigi xa walikɛ xa sɔnxɔ. A lanma a xa findi mixi diɲɛxi ra naxan fata mixi xarande, a man wakili tɔɔrɛ ra.

sentences.english: Gently guiding those who go against the teaching; if by chance God may give them a change of heart and true knowledge,
sentences.susu: A lanma a xa matandilae matinxin wɔyɛnyi ɲɔxunmɛ ra, alako Ala xa a niya e xa tuubi, e xa nɔndi kolon,

sentences.english: And so they may get themselves free from the net of the Evil One, being made the prisoners of the Lord's servant, for the purpose of God.
sentences.susu: e xa xaxili sɔtɔ, e xa e ba Ibulisa xa gantanyi ra. Ibulisa bara e suxu gantanyi ra, alako e xa lu a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: But be certain of this, that in the last days times of trouble will come.
sentences.susu: I xa a kolon, fe xɔrɔxɔɛe fama nɛ duniɲa lide waxati dɔnxɔɛ,

sentences.english: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, uplifted in pride, given to bitter words, going against the authority of their fathers, never giving praise, having no religion,
sentences.susu: barima adamadie birama e yɛtɛ waxɔnfe nan fɔxɔ ra, kɔbiri rafanma nɛ e ma, e e yɛtɛ igboma, e lama e yɛtɛ ra, e Ala rasɔtɔma, e e barimae matandima, e finsiriwaliya rabama, e mu Ala xa fe binyama,

sentences.english: Without natural love, bitter haters, saying evil of others, violent and uncontrolled, hating all good,
sentences.susu: e mu kinikinima, e mu diɲɛma, e mixi mafalama, e xurutareɲa rabama, e e boore tɔɔrɔma, e mixi fanyi xɔnma,

sentences.english: False to their friends, acting without thought, lifted up in mind, loving pleasure more than God;
sentences.susu: e mixi yanfama, e bogonma fee ma, e bɔɲɛ gbo, e waxɔnfe rafan e ma dangi Ala xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Having a form of religion, but turning their backs on the power of it: go not with these.
sentences.susu: A luxi nɛ alɔ e diinɛ nan nabatuma, kɔnɔ e bara e kobe raso a sɛnbɛ ra. I xa i makuya na mixi mɔɔlie ra.

sentences.english: For these are they who go secretly into houses, making prisoners of foolish women, weighted down with sin, turned from the way by their evil desires,
sentences.susu: E soma denbayae kui, e fa ginɛ sɛnbɛtaree mabɛndun, naxee findixi yunubitɔɛe ra, naxee birama fe ɲaaxi mɔɔli birin fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Ever learning, and never coming to the knowledge of what is true.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ mɔɔli xaranma tɛmui birin, kɔnɔ e mu fahaamui sɔtɔma nɔndi ma.

sentences.english: And as James and Jambres went against Moses, so do these go against what is true: men of evil minds, who, tested by faith, are seen to be false.
sentences.susu: Na mixi naxee soma denbayae kui, e luma nɛ alɔ Yannɛsi nun Yanbɛrɛsi naxee Annabi Munsa matandi. Na mixie nɔndi fan matandima nɛ, e xaxili bara kana. E xa danxaniya xɔn mu kuyama.

sentences.english: But they will go no farther: for their foolish behaviour will be clear to all men, as theirs was in the end.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ e mu sigama yare sɔnɔn, barima mixi birin fama nɛ e xa daxuɲa kolonde, alɔ Yannɛsi nun Yanbɛrɛsi xa fe nu kolonxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: But you took as your example my teaching, behaviour, purpose, and faith; my long waiting, my love, my quiet undergoing of trouble;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan, i bara n ma xaranyi kolon, n ɲɛrɛ ki, n ɲanige, n ma danxaniya, n ma diɲɛ, n ma xanunteya, n ma tunnabɛxi,

sentences.english: My punishments and pain; the things which came to me at Antioch, at Iconium, at Lystra; the cruel attacks made on me: and the Lord made me free from them all.
sentences.susu: n ma ɲaxankatɛ, a nun n ma tɔɔrɛ. Tɔɔrɛ mɔɔli mundun na, n mu naxan sɔtɔ Antiyɔki, Ikoniyon, nun Lisitire? Ɲaxankatɛ mundun mu n lixi naa? Marigi bara n nakisi na birin kui.

sentences.english: Yes, and all whose purpose is to be living in the knowledge of God in Christ Jesus, will be cruelly attacked.
sentences.susu: Nɔndi na a ra a mixi naxan birin wama birafe Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra, a na kanyi tɔɔrɛ sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: Evil and false men will become worse and worse, using deceit and themselves overcome by deceit.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi ɲaaxie nun filankafuie xa fe kobie xun nan tun luma masa ra, e fa booree madaxu, e e yɛtɛ madaxu.

sentences.english: But see that you keep to the teaching you have been given and the things of which you are certain, conscious of who has been your teacher;
sentences.susu: I xa i xiri sɛriyɛ ra i naxan xaranxi, i danxaniyaxi naxan ma. I a kolon i na sɔtɔxi naxan na.

sentences.english: And that from the time when you were a child, you have had knowledge of the holy Writings, which are able to make you wise to salvation, through faith in Christ Jesus.
sentences.susu: Kabi i dimɛdi tɛmui, i Kitaabui sɛniyɛnxie kolon, naxee nɔma lɔnni fide i ma. Na lɔnni findima kisi nan na mixie bɛ, naxee danxaniyaxi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa ma.

sentences.english: Every holy Writing which comes from God is of profit for teaching, for training, for guiding, for education in righteousness:
sentences.susu: Kitaabui sɛniyɛnxi birin fatanxi Ala nan na. A fan xaranyi ra, a fan yaabi ra, a fan matinxinse ra, a fan tinxinyi masenfe ra,

sentences.english: So that the man of God may be complete, trained and made ready for every good work.
sentences.susu: alako Ala xa mixi xa nɔ wali fanyi birin nabade.

sentences.english: I give you orders, before God and Christ Jesus, who will be the judge of the living and the dead, and by his revelation and his kingdom;
sentences.susu: N bara i yamari Ala ya xɔri, n bara i yamari Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa ya xɔri, naxan fama mixi ɲiɲɛe nun mixi faxaxie makiitide, naxan fama a xa mangɛya niini raminide,

sentences.english: Be preaching the word at all times, in every place; make protests, say sharp words, give comfort, with long waiting and teaching;
sentences.susu: i xa Ala xa masenyi kawandi, i xa wakili tɛmui birin, i xa mixie matinxin, i xa mixie xa yunubie masen e bɛ, i xa e ralimaniya, i xa e xaran. I xa na birin naba diɲɛ kui.

sentences.english: For the time will come when they will not take the true teaching; but, moved by their desires, they will get for themselves a great number of teachers for the pleasure of hearing them;
sentences.susu: Waxati na fafe mixie mu tinma xaranyi tinxinxi ra tɛmui naxɛ. E karamɔxɔ wuyaxi fenma nɛ, naxee masenyi mɔɔli nde tima naxan nafan e tuli ma.

sentences.english: And shutting their ears to what is true, will be turned away to belief in foolish stories.
sentences.susu: E gbilenma nɛ nɔndi fɔxɔ ra, e fa e tuli mati kiinie ra.

sentences.english: But be self-controlled in all things, do without comfort, go on preaching the good news, completing the work which has been given you to do.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan, i xa i yɛtɛ mataxasi fe birin kui, i xa i tunnabɛxi tɔɔrɛ kui, i xa Ala xa xibaaru fanyi rayensen, i xa i xa wali rakamali.

sentences.english: For I am even now being offered, and my end is near.
sentences.susu: N tan ɲan bara findi sɛrɛxɛ ra Ala bɛ. A gbe mu luxi n xa taa masara.

sentences.english: I have made a good fight, I have come to the end of my journey, I have kept the faith:
sentences.susu: N bara n ma gere fanyi so, n bara n ma ɲɛrɛ raɲɔn, n bara lu danxaniya kui.

sentences.english: From now on, the crown of righteousness is made ready for me, which the Lord, the upright judge, Will give to me at that day: and not only to me, but to all those who have had love for his revelation.
sentences.susu: Xunnakeli sare ragataxi n bɛ, naxan findixi tinxinyi ra Marigi kiitisa tinxinxi naxan fima n ma na lɔxɔɛ. N keren xa mu a ra, a na fima mixi birin nan ma, a fafe rafan naxee ma.

sentences.english: Do your best to come to me before long:
sentences.susu: I xa kata fafe ra n yire mafuren mafuren,

sentences.english: For Demas has gone away from me, for love of this present life, and has gone to Thessalonica: Crescens has gone to Galatia, Titus to Dalmatia.
sentences.susu: barima Demasi bara n nabɛɲin duniɲa fe xa fe ra, a siga Tɛsaloniki. Kiresen bara siga Galati, Tito bara siga Dalamatiya.

sentences.english: Only Luke is with me. Get Mark and take him with you; for he is of use to me in the work.
sentences.susu: Luki gbansan nan na n sɛɛti ma. I xa fa Maraki ra, barima a nɔma n malide n ma wali kui a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: Tychicus I sent to Ephesus.
sentences.susu: N bara Tikike xɛɛ Efɛsɛ.

sentences.english: The coat which I did not take from Troas and which is with Carpus, get when you come, and the books, specially the papers.
sentences.susu: I nɛ fama, i xa fa na xinbeli donma ra, n naxan luxi Tiroyasi, Karapo xɔnyi, a nun n ma bukie. Na sɛbɛli naxee tixi xuruse kiri ma, e tide gbo dangi birin na, i xa fa e fan na.

sentences.english: Alexander the copper-worker did me much wrong: the Lord will give him the reward of his works:
sentences.susu: Alesandire xabui bara fe ɲaaxi gbegbe raba n na. Marigi fama a sare ragbilende a ma.

sentences.english: But be on the watch for him, for he was violent in his attacks on our teaching.
sentences.susu: I xa i yɛtɛ ratanga a ma, barima a muxu xa kawandi matandi nɛ a ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: At my first meeting with my judges, no one took my part, but all went away from me. May it not be put to their account.
sentences.susu: N to n yɛtɛ xunmafala kiiti banxi kui a singe, n malima yo mu nu na. Birin n nabolo nɛ. Ala xa diɲɛ e ma e fe naxan nabaxi.

sentences.english: But the Lord was by my side and gave me strength; so that through me the news might be given out in full measure, and all the Gentiles might give ear: and I was taken out of the mouth of the lion.
sentences.susu: Ala nan n malixi, a sɛnbɛ so n yi ra, alako n xa kawandi ti a fanyi ra si birin bɛ. Ala naxa n natanga yɛtɛ magaaxuxi ma.

sentences.english: The Lord will keep me safe from every evil work and will give me salvation in his kingdom in heaven: to whom be glory for ever and ever. So be it.
sentences.susu: Marigi man fama n natangade mixie xa wali kobi birin ma, a fa n nakisi, n xa so a xa mangɛya niini bun ma ariyanna. Matɔxɔɛ na Ala bɛ abadan.

sentences.english: Give my love to Prisca and Aquila and those of the house of Onesiphorus.
sentences.susu: Pirisila nun Akila xɛɛbu n bɛ, a nun Onesiforo xa denbaya.

sentences.english: Erastus was stopping at Corinth; but Trophimus, when I last saw him was at Miletus, ill.
sentences.susu: Erasito bara lu Korinti. N bara Tirofimo lu Mileto, barima a mu nu yalanxi.

sentences.english: Do your best to come before the winter. Eubulus sends you his love, and Pudens and Linus and Claudia, and all the brothers.
sentences.susu: I xa kata fafe ra beenun ɲɛmɛ xa so. Ewubulo, Pudɛn, Linosi, Kelodiya, nun won ngaxakerenyi birin bara i xɛɛbu.

sentences.english: The Lord be with your spirit. Grace be with you.
sentences.susu: Marigi xa sabati i bɔɲɛ i, Ala xa hinnɛ wo birin na.

sentences.english: Paul, a servant of God, and an Apostle of Jesus Christ, in agreement with the faith of the saints of God and the full knowledge of what is true in harmony with religion,
sentences.susu: N tan Pɔlu nan yi ki, Ala xa konyi nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa xɛɛra. N na walife alako Ala xa ɲama sugandixi xa danxaniya, e man xa nɔndi kolon naxan e raɲɛrɛma Ala xa fe kui.

sentences.english: In the hope of eternal life, which was made certain before eternal time, by the word of God who is ever true;
sentences.susu: Yi danxaniya nun yi nɔndi a niyama nɛ mixi xa a xaxili ti Ala xa kisi ra. Ala, naxan xa laayidi mu kanama, a tan nan yi abadan kisi laayidi won bɛ beenun duniɲa xa daa.

sentences.english: Who, in his time, made clear his word in the good news, of which, by the order of God our Saviour, I became a preacher;
sentences.susu: Waxati to kamali, a naxa a xa xibaaru fanyi makɛnɛn kawandi saabui ra, naxan bara taxu n na Ala won Nakisima xa yaamari ma.

sentences.english: To Titus, my true child in our common faith: Grace and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Saviour.
sentences.susu: N bara i tan Tito xɛɛbu, naxan bara findi n ma di yati yati ra won ma danxaniya kui. Baba Ala nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa, won Nakisima xa hinnɛ nun bɔɲɛsa fi i ma.

sentences.english: I did not take you with me when I went away from Crete, so that you might do what was necessary to put things in order there, placing men in authority over the churches in every town, as I said to you;
sentences.susu: N bara i lu Kirɛti alako i xa fee yailan naxee yailan daaxi luxi na, i xa mixie sugandi taae birin kui, e xa findi na danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae xa kuntigie ra. Alɔ n i yamari ki naxɛ,

sentences.english: Men having a good record, husbands of one wife, whose children are of the faith, children of whom it may not be said that they are given to loose living or are uncontrolled.
sentences.susu: danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama kuntigi lanma nɛ a xa findi tinxintɔɛ ra xili fanyi na naxan xun, ginɛ keren kanyi, naxan xa die danxaniyaxi, mixie mu naxee kolon kalabante xurutaree ra.

sentences.english: For it is necessary for a Bishop to be a man of virtue, as God's servant; not pushing himself forward, not quickly moved to wrath or blows, not desiring profit for himself;
sentences.susu: Fo yi xunmatie xa findi xɛmɛ tinxinxie nan na barima Ala xa wali nan taxuxi e ra. E naxa findi mixie ra naxee e yɛtɛ igboma, naxee bɔɲɛ tema mafuren, naxee siisima, naxee mawolen, naxee biraxi geeni tinxintare fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: But opening his house freely to guests; a lover of what is good, serious-minded, upright, holy, self-controlled;
sentences.susu: Fo e xa findi xɛmɛe ra naxee fata xɔɲɛ rasɛnɛde, fe fanyi rafan naxee ma, naxee e yɛtɛ xaninma xaxilimaya ra, naxee tinxin, naxee sɛniyɛn, naxee nɔxi e yɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: Keeping to the true word of the teaching, so that he may be able to give comfort by right teaching and overcome the arguments of the doubters.
sentences.susu: Fo nɔndi masenyi xa lu e yi ra alɔ e xaranxi a ra ki naxɛ. Na nan a toma e fan nɔma kawandi tide a nɔndi ki ma, e man nɔ na nɔndi matandie ra.

sentences.english: For there are men who are not ruled by law; foolish talkers, false teachers, specially those of the circumcision,
sentences.susu: Na matanditi mɔɔli gbegbe na na, a gbengbenyi sunna mixie ya ma. E dɛ wuya, mixi yanfafe rafan e ma.

sentences.english: By whom some families have been completely overturned; who take money for teaching things which are not right; these will have to be stopped.
sentences.susu: Fo won xa e dɛ balan. E bara denbaya ndee kana, barima e na e xaranfe fee nan na naxee mu daxa. E na birin nabama e yɛtɛ xa geeni tinxintareya nan ma fe ra.

sentences.english: One of their prophets has said, The men of Crete are ever false, evil beasts, lovers of food, hating work.
sentences.susu: E xa namiɲɔnmɛ nde nan yati a fala, «Kirɛtikae wule nun e furi nan tun kolon. E tunnaxɔnɔ, e man ɲaaxu alɔ bɔximase.»

sentences.english: This witness is true. So say sharp words to them so that they may come to the right faith,
sentences.susu: Nɔndi nan yati na a ra. N na a falafe na nan ma, i xa wɔyɛn e ma a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra alako e xa danxaniya a fiixɛ ra,

sentences.english: Giving no attention to the fictions of the Jews and the rules of men who have no true knowledge.
sentences.susu: e xa ba Yuwifi xa kuye taalie danxunfe. E xa ba mixie xa yaamarie danxunfe naxee bara mɛɛ nɔndi ra.

sentences.english: To the clean in heart all things are clean: but to those who are unclean and without faith nothing is clean; they become unclean in mind and in thought.
sentences.susu: Se birin sɛniyɛn sɛniyɛntɔɛe bɛ, kɔnɔ sese mu sɛniyɛn sɛniyɛntaree nun danxaniyataree tan bɛ. E xaxili nun e sondonyi birin bara manɔxɔ.

sentences.english: They say that they have knowledge of God, while by their acts they are turning their backs on him; they are hated by all, hard-hearted, and judged to be without value for any good work.
sentences.susu: E Ala kolonfe falama e dɛ ra, kɔnɔ e xa wali a masenma a e mu a kolon feo! E xa fefe mu fan. Sɛriyɛ matandie nan e ra, naxee mu nɔma wali fanyi yo rabade.

sentences.english: But let your words be in agreement with true and right teaching:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i tan xa nu danxaniyatɔɛe xaran nɔndi masenyi nan na.

sentences.english: That old men are to be simple in their tastes, serious, wise, true in faith, in love, and of a quiet mind.
sentences.susu: I xa a masen xɛmɔxie bɛ e xa taxasi, e xa ɲɛrɛ a binyamixi ki ma, e xa e yɛtɛ xanin xaxilimaya ra, e xa bira nɔndi nan fɔxɔ ra e xa danxaniya kui, xanunteya kui, a nun tunnabɛxiya kui.

sentences.english: That old women are to be self-respecting in behaviour, not saying evil of others, not given to taking much wine, teachers of that which is good,
sentences.susu: Na kui, i man xa a masen ginɛ mɔxie bɛ, e xa ɲɛrɛ sɛniyɛnyi kui, e naxa findi mixi mafalɛe ra, e naxa siisi. E xa nu marasi fanyi fi

sentences.english: Training the younger women to have love for their husbands and children,
sentences.susu: sungbutunyie ma alako e xa e xa mɔrie nun e xa die xanu.

sentences.english: To be wise in mind, clean in heart, kind; working in their houses, living under the authority of their husbands; so that no evil may be said of the word of God.
sentences.susu: E man xa e rasi e xa e yɛtɛ xanin xaxilimaya ra, e xa sɛniyɛn, e xa banxi walie suxu, e yuge xa fan, e xa e yɛtɛ magoro e xa mɔrie bɛ, alako Ala xa masenyi naxa bɛxu.

sentences.english: To the young men give orders to be wise and serious-minded:
sentences.susu: I man xa sɛgɛtalae fan nasi e xa e yɛtɛ xanin xaxilimaya ra

sentences.english: In all things see that you are an example of good works; holy in your teaching, serious in behaviour,
sentences.susu: fe birin kui. I tan yɛtɛ xa findi misaali ra e bɛ i xa wali fanyie saabui ra. I xa kawandi xa findi nɔndi nun sɔɔbɛ ra.

sentences.english: Saying true and right words, against which no protest may be made, so that he who is not on our side may be put to shame, unable to say any evil of us.
sentences.susu: I xa masenyi xa tinxin, alako i matandimae xa yaagi, barima e mu fefe kobi kolon e naxan falama won ma fe ra.

sentences.english: Servants are to be under the authority of their masters, pleasing them in all things, without argument;
sentences.susu: I xa a masen konyie bɛ, e xa e yɛtɛ magoro e marigie bɛ fe birin kui. E xa e raɲɛlɛxin, e naxa e matandi,

sentences.english: Not taking what is not theirs, but giving clear signs of their good faith, in all things doing credit to the teaching of God our Saviour.
sentences.susu: e naxa sese muɲa, e xa a masen a e marigie nɔma lade e ra ki fanyi. Na konyi mɔɔli binyɛ fima nɛ won Nakisima Ala xa masenyi ma fe birin kui.

sentences.english: For the grace of God has come, giving salvation to all men,
sentences.susu: A lanma won xa ɲɛrɛ yi mɔɔli ra barima Ala xa hinnɛ bara makɛnɛn, naxan nɔma findide kisi ra mixi birin bɛ.

sentences.english: Training us so that, turning away from evil and the desires of this world, we may be living wisely and uprightly in the knowledge of God in this present life;
sentences.susu: A xa hinnɛ won xaranma alako won xa gbilen tinxintareya nun duniɲa fee fɔxɔ ra, won xa won yɛtɛ xanin xaxilimaya ra, won xa won ma duniɲɛigiri raɲɛrɛ tinxinyi nun Ala yaragaaxui kui.

sentences.english: Looking for the glad hope, the revelation of the glory of our great God and Saviour Jesus Christ;
sentences.susu: Won to na yi duniɲa ma, won na fe fanyi nan mamɛfe won xaxili tixi naxan na. Won na Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa nɔrɛ nan mamɛfe, won Nakisima Marigi Ala.

sentences.english: Who gave himself for us, so that he might make us free from all wrongdoing, and make for himself a people clean in heart and on fire with good works.
sentences.susu: A tan nan a yɛtɛ fi won bɛ, alako a xa won xunsara won ma yunubie xa fe ra, a xa ɲama nde rasɛniyɛn e xa findi a yɛtɛ gbe ra, naxee sɛnbɛ soxi wali fanyie rabafe ma.

sentences.english: On all these points give teaching and help, and make clear what is right with all authority. Let all men give you honour.
sentences.susu: I xa mixie kawandi yi fee ra. I xa mixie ralimaniya. I xa e rasi. I xa nɔndi makɛnɛn e bɛ i sɛnbɛ birin na. Mixi yo naxa yo i ma.

sentences.english: Make clear to them that they are to put themselves under rulers and authorities, to do what they are ordered, to be ready for every good work,
sentences.susu: I xa e ratu, e xa e yɛtɛ magoro mangɛe nun mangasanyi bɛ, e xa e xa yaamarie suxu. E xa gbata wali fanyi mɔɔli birin nabafe ra,

sentences.english: To say no evil of any man, not to be fighters, to give way to others, to be gentle in behaviour to all men.
sentences.susu: e naxa mixi yo mafala, e naxa gere so, e xa marafanyi nun bɔɲɛ fanyi masen birin bɛ.

sentences.english: For in the past we were foolish, hard in heart, turned from the true way, servants of evil desires and pleasures, living in bad feeling and envy, hated and hating one another.
sentences.susu: A singe won fan nu daxuɲa nan nabama. Yaamari matandimae nan nu won na. Won nu bara lɔɛ kira xɔn. Won nu bara bira won yɛtɛ waxɔnfe fɔxɔ ra a nun duniɲa fe mɔɔli birin fɔxɔ ra, han na nu bara won findi konyie ra. Won nu won ma duniɲa xaninma ɲaaxuɲa, tɔɔnɛ, gbɛsɛnxɔnnanteya, nun maraɲaaxuɲa nan kui. Won fan mu nu rafan mixie ma.

sentences.english: But when the mercy of God our Saviour, and his love to man was seen,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ won Nakisima Ala to a xa bɔɲɛ fanyi nun a xa xanunteya makɛnɛn, a naxa kisi fi won ma.

sentences.english: Not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but in the measure of his mercy, he gave us salvation, through the washing of the new birth and the giving of new life in the Holy Spirit,
sentences.susu: A mu won nakisixi won ma wali fanyie xa fe xa ma, a won nakisixi a xa kinikini nan ma, won xunxafe ye xɔɔra a nun a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra. Na bara a niya won xa bari a nɛɛnɛ ra, won ma duniɲɛigiri birin xa masara.

sentences.english: Which he gave us freely through Jesus Christ our Saviour;
sentences.susu: Ala bara won ki! A bara a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi ragoro won ma won Nakisima Isa saabui ra.

sentences.english: So that, having been given righteousness through grace, we might have a part in the heritage, the hope of eternal life.
sentences.susu: Na kui, won ma yunubie to bara xafari a xa hinnɛ saabui ra, won bara nɔ findide kɛtongoe ra, won bara won xaxili ti abadan kisi ra.

sentences.english: This is a true saying; and it is my desire that you may give certain witness about these things, so that those who have had faith in God may give attention to good works. These things are good and of profit to men;
sentences.susu: Nɔndi masenxi nan na ki. A xɔli n ma i xa na fee masen a fanyi ra, alako naxee bara danxaniya Ala ma, e xa fe birin naba alako e xa bira fe fanyi raba fɔxɔ ra. Na fee findixi fe hagigɛ fanyie nan na mixi birin bɛ.

sentences.english: But have nothing to do with foolish questionings, and lists of generations, and fights and arguments about the law; for they are of no profit and foolish.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i naxa i gbe raso mixie xa wɔyɛn fufafu ya ma. E naxan falama benbae xa fe ra, e xa gbɛsɛnxɔnnɛya, e xa gere wɔyɛnyi Ala xa sɛriyɛ xa fe ra, e sese tide mu na.

sentences.english: A man whose opinions are not those of the church, after a first and second protest, is to be kept out of your society;
sentences.susu: Naxan yo mixie tagi isoma, i xa a rasi keren, i xa a rasi firin. Xa na birin kui a mu i xui mɛ, i xa a rabolo,

sentences.english: Clearly he is in error and a sinner, being self-judged.
sentences.susu: barima i a kolon a na mixi mɔɔli mu fan. A bara a yɛtɛ danka a xa tinxintareya ra.

sentences.english: When I send Artemas or Tychicus to you, do your best to come to me at Nicopolis: for it is my purpose to be there for the winter.
sentences.susu: N na Aritema xa na mu Tikike xɛɛ i ma, i xa fe birin naba alako i xa n li Nikopoli, barima n bara a ɲanige n xa ɲɛmɛ radangi naa.

sentences.english: Send Zenas, the man of law, and Apollos on their journey with all care, so that they may be in need of nothing.
sentences.susu: Fe birin naba alako i xa sɛriyɛ karamɔxɔ Senasi nun Apolosi mali e xa biyaasi kui. E mali, e hayi na se naxan birin ma, e xa a sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: And let our people go on with good works for necessary purposes, so that they may not be without fruit.
sentences.susu: A lanma danxaniyatɔɛ naxee na won ma kɔnti ma, e xa e matinkan tunnabɛxi ra wali fanyie ma, alako e xa mixie hayi xɔrɔxɔɛe fan, e naxa fa lu na ki fufafu.

sentences.english: All who are with me send you their love. Give our love to our friends in the faith. Grace be with you all.
sentences.susu: Naxee na n fɛ ma be, e birin i xɛɛbu. I xa won xanuntenyie danxaniyatɔɛe birin xɛɛbu muxu bɛ. Ala xa hinnɛ wo birin na.

sentences.english: Paul, a prisoner of Jesus Christ, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our dear helper in the faith,
sentences.susu: N tan Pɔlu nan yi ki, naxan bara findi geelimani ra Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi bɛ. Muxu nun won ngaxakerenyi Timote nan yi bataaxɛ sɛbɛfe, katarabi Filemon ma muxu xanuntenyi nun muxu waliboore,

sentences.english: And to Apphia, our sister, and to Archippus, our brother in God's army, and to the church in your house:
sentences.susu: a nun Apiya muxu maaginɛ, a nun Arikipe muxu gereso boore Ala xa gere xa fe ra, a nun danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama naxan e malanma i tan Filemon xɔnyi.

sentences.english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Won Baba Ala nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi, won Marigi Isa xa hinnɛ nun bɔɲɛsa fi wo ma.

sentences.english: I give praise to God at all times and make prayer for you,
sentences.susu: Tɛmui birin, n nɛ n Marigi Ala maxandima i bɛ, n a tantuma nɛ i xa fe ra,

sentences.english: Hearing of the love and the faith which you have to the Lord Jesus and to all the saints;
sentences.susu: barima n bara a mɛ i danxaniyaxi Marigi Isa ma ki naxɛ, i man sɛniyɛntɔɛe birin xanuxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: That the faith which you have in common with them may be working with power, in the knowledge of every good thing in you, for Christ.
sentences.susu: N Ala maxandife i bɛ alako ngaxakerenya naxan kelima i xa danxaniya ma, a xa a niya i xa fahaamui xa gbo, i xa nɔ fe fanyi birin kolonde naxan na won yi ra Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi saabui ra.

sentences.english: For I had great joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been made strong again through you, brother.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyi Filemon, i xa xanunteya bara n nasɛɛwa ki fanyi, a man bara limaniya fi n ma, barima sɛniyɛntɔɛe bɔɲɛ fan bara sɛɛwa i saabui ra.

sentences.english: And so, though I might, in the name of Christ, give you orders to do what is right,
sentences.susu: Na kui, hali n to nɔma i yamaride Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xili ra, i xa fe raba i lanma i xa naxan naba, n mu na rabama.

sentences.english: Still, because of love, in place of an order, I make a request to you, I, Paul, an old man and now a prisoner of Christ Jesus:
sentences.susu: N i mayandima won ma xanunteya nan ma fe ra. N tan Pɔlu nan wɔyɛnfe i bɛ yi ki, xɛmɔxi naxan na geeli Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: My request is for my child Onesimus, the child of my chains,
sentences.susu: N i mayandife n ma di Onesimo nan ma fe ra, n bara findi naxan baba ra n ma geelimaniya kui.

sentences.english: Who in the past was of no profit to you, but now is of profit to you and to me:
sentences.susu: Singe, a tide yo mu nu na i bɛ, kɔnɔ yakɔsi, a tide bara gbo i bɛ ki fanyi, alɔ a gboxi n fan bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Whom I have sent back to you, him who is my very heart:
sentences.susu: Hali a to rafan n ma alɔ n ya firinyi, n na a ragbilenfe i ma.

sentences.english: Though my desire was to keep him with me, to be my servant in the chains of the good news, in your place:
sentences.susu: N bara wa a xɔn a xa lu n yi ra, alako a xa n mali i tan ɲɔxɔɛ ra n ma geelimaniya kui, n bara naxan sɔtɔ Ala xa xibaaru fanyi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: But without your approval I would do nothing; so that your good works might not be forced, but done freely from your heart.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n mu waxi fefe rabafe n mu i maxɔrin. Na kui, i xa fe fanyi raba kelima nɛ i ɲanige nan ma, beenun n tan xa i yamari.

sentences.english: For it is possible that for this reason he was parted from you for a time, so that you might have him for ever;
sentences.susu: Tɛmunde, Onesimo bara ba i yi ra waxati nde bun ma, alako a man xa gbilen i ma abadan.

sentences.english: No longer as a servant, but more than a servant, a brother, very dear to me specially, but much more to you, in the flesh as well as in the Lord.
sentences.susu: I tan bɛ yakɔsi, a tide bara dangi konyi ra. A bara findi i ngaxakerenyi yɛtɛ yati ra. N tan bara a xanu ki fanyi, kɔnɔ a lan i tan nan xa a xanu dangi n na a xa mixiɲa nun a xa danxaniya xa fe ra.

sentences.english: If then you take me to be your friend and brother, take him in as myself.
sentences.susu: Na kui, xa i n kolonxi i ngaxakerenyi ra, i xa a fan nasɛnɛ alɔ n tan yɛtɛ nan faxi i ma.

sentences.english: If he has done you any wrong or is in debt to you for anything, put it to my account.
sentences.susu: Xa a fefe ɲaaxi niyaxi i ra, xa i xa doni yo a ma, na kote birin xa findi n tan gbe ra.

sentences.english: I, Paul, writing this myself, say, I will make payment to you: and I do not say to you that you are in debt to me even for your life.
sentences.susu: N tan Pɔlu nan yi sɛbɛfe n yɛtɛ bɛlɛxɛ ra, i xa a kolon n a birin nagbilenma nɛ i ma. Kɔnɔ hali n mu i ratu, i danxaniyaxi n tan nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: So brother, let me have joy of you in the Lord: give new life to my heart in Christ.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyi, i fan xa yi fe raba n bɛ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fe ra. I fan xa n bɔɲɛ rasɛɛwa, Marigi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Being certain that you will do my desire, I am writing to you, in the knowledge that you will do even more than I say.
sentences.susu: N to yi sɛbɛfe, n a kolon i mu tondima n waxɔnfe rabade, i ɲan nde sama nɛ a xun.

sentences.english: And make a room ready for me; for I am hoping that through your prayers I will be given to you.
sentences.susu: Fe keren luxi: I xa nu n yigiyade yailan, barima n laxi a ra, n fama nɛ gbilende wo yire wo xa Ala maxandi saabui ra.

sentences.english: Epaphras, my brother-prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you his love;
sentences.susu: Epafirasi i xɛɛbu, muxu nun naxan bara findi geelimani ra Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And so do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my brother-workers.
sentences.susu: N walibooree Maraki, Arisitaraki, Demasi, nun Luki, e fan i xɛɛbu.

sentences.english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. So be it.
sentences.susu: Marigi Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, xa hinnɛ wo birin na.

sentences.english: In times past the word of God came to our fathers through the prophets, in different parts and in different ways;
sentences.susu: Tɛmui dangixi Ala naxa masenyi ti won benbae bɛ namiɲɔnmɛe saabui ra. A na raba nɛ sanmaya wuyaxi, a na raba nɛ ki wuyaxi ra.

sentences.english: But now, at the end of these days, it has come to us through his Son, to whom he has given all things for a heritage, and through whom he made the order of the generations;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi, naxan findixi waxati dɔnxɔɛ ra, Ala a xa masenyi ti won bɛ a xa Di saabui ra. A bara a xa Di findi duniɲa kɛ tongoma ra, a duniɲa daa a xa Di nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: Who, being the outshining of his glory, the true image of his substance, supporting all things by the word of his power, having given himself as an offering making clean from sins, took his seat at the right hand of God in heaven;
sentences.susu: Yi Di findixi Ala xa nɔrɛ tofanyi nan na, a findixi Ala misaali yati nan na. A duniɲa bun tima a xa masenyi sɛnbɛma nan na. A to gɛ yunubie xafaride, a naxa a magoro Ala Nɔrɛ Kanyi yirefanyi ma ariyanna kui.

sentences.english: Having become by so much better than the angels, as the name which is his heritage is more noble than theirs.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a tide dangi malekɛe ra, a xili fisamante nan sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: To which of the angels did God say at any time, You are my Son, this day I have given you being? or, I will be his Father, and he will be my Son?
sentences.susu: Ala mu a masenxi malekɛ yo bɛ, «N ma di nan i ra, to n bara findi i Baba ra.» A mu a masenxi malekɛ yo bɛ, «N tan findima a Baba ra, a tan findima n ma di ra.»

sentences.english: And again, when he is sending his only Son into the world, he says, Let all the angels of God give him worship.
sentences.susu: Ala to a xa Di fisamante ramini duniɲa, a naxa a fala, «Ala xa malekɛe xa a batu.»

sentences.english: And of the angels he says, Who makes his angels winds, and his servants flames of fire:
sentences.susu: A a masenxi malekɛe xa fe ra, «Ala xa malekɛe luma nɛ alɔ foye, a xa walikɛe luma nɛ alɔ tɛ.»

sentences.english: But of the Son he says, Your seat of power, O God, is for ever and ever; and the rod of your kingdom is a rod of righteousness.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a a masenxi nɛ a xa Di xa fe ra, «Ala, i xa mangɛ kibanyi buma nɛ abadan. Tinxinyi nan findixi i xa mangɛya tɔnxuma ra.

sentences.english: You have been a lover of righteousness and a hater of evil; and so God, your God, has put the oil of joy on your head more than on the heads of those who are with you.
sentences.susu: Tinxinyi nan nafan i ma. Ɲaaxuɲa mu rafan i ma fefe ma. Na nan a toxi, Marigi, i Marigi Ala bara i sugandi sɛɛwɛ kui. I findixi fisamante nan na dangife i booree ra.»

sentences.english: You, Lord, at the first did put the earth on its base, and the heavens are the works of your hands:
sentences.susu: A man a masenxi nɛ, «Marigi, i bara duniɲa ti a fɔlɛ ra, i tan nan koore daaxi.

sentences.english: They will come to their end; but you are for ever; they will become old as a robe;
sentences.susu: Koore nun bɔxi fama kanade, kɔnɔ i tan buma nɛ abadan. E forima nɛ alɔ dugi.

sentences.english: They will be rolled up like a cloth, even like a robe, and they will be changed: but you are the same and your years will have no end.
sentences.susu: I koore nun bɔxi mafindima nɛ alɔ donma mafindima ki naxɛ. E fama nɛ masarade alɔ sose masarama ki naxɛ. Kɔnɔ i tan mu masarama, i xa fe mu ɲɔnma abadan.»

sentences.english: But of which of the angels has he said at any time, Take your seat at my right hand till I put all those who are against you under your feet?
sentences.susu: Ala mu a masenxi malekɛ yo bɛ, «I xa dɔxɔ n yirefanyi ma, han n xa gɛ i yaxuie ragorode i sanyi bun ma.»

sentences.english: Are they not all helping spirits, who are sent out as servants to those whose heritage will be salvation?
sentences.susu: Malekɛe tan findixi Ala xa walikɛe nan na, fate mu na naxee bɛ, a naxee xɛɛma kisi kɛtongoe malide.

sentences.english: For this reason there is the more need for us to give attention to the things which have come to our ears, for fear that by chance we might be slipping away.
sentences.susu: Won xa won ɲɛngi sa na masenyi xɔn ma a fanyi ra, won naxan mɛxi, alako won naxa kira bɛɲin.

sentences.english: Because if the word which came through the angels was fixed, and in the past every evil act against God's orders was given its full punishment;
sentences.susu: Ala xa masenyi sɛnbɛ nu gbo, a nu bara naxan so malekɛe yi ra. Adamadi naxee na matandi, e naxa sare xɔrɔxɔɛ sɔtɔ. Xa nee sa sare xɔrɔxɔɛ sɔtɔ,

sentences.english: What will come on us, if we do not give our minds to such a great salvation? a salvation of which our fathers first had knowledge through the words of the Lord, and which was made certain to us by those to whom his words came;
sentences.susu: won tan go? Xa won kisi xungbe rabolo, won ma fe fa luma di? Won Marigi yati nan singe a masenxi won bɛ, mixi naxee a xui mɛxi e fan bara findi na seedee ra.

sentences.english: And God was a witness with them, by signs and wonders, and by more than natural powers, and by his distribution of the Holy Spirit at his pleasure.
sentences.susu: Ala bara e xa seedeɲɔxɔya fari isa tɔnxumae ra, fe magaaxuxie, kaabanako mɔɔli birin, nun buɲae ra Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxee fixi e ma a waxɔnki.

sentences.english: For he did not make the angels rulers over the world to come, of which I am writing.
sentences.susu: Ala mu mangɛya fima malekɛe ma tina e xa duniɲa yamari, muxu duniɲa naxan xa fe falafe wo bɛ yi ki.

sentences.english: But a certain writer has given his witness, saying, What is man, that you keep him in mind? what is the son of man, that you take him into account?
sentences.susu: Yi seedeɲɔxɔya sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui: «Munse lanxi adama ma, i to i maɲɔxunma a xa fe ma? Munse lanxi adama xa di ma, i to i ɲɛngi sama a xa fe xɔn ma?

sentences.english: You made him a little lower than the angels; you gave him a crown of glory and honour, and made him ruler over all the works of your hands:
sentences.susu: I bara a ragoro malekɛe bun ma waxati dondoronti kui. I bara dariyɛ nun binyɛ fi a ma,

sentences.english: You put all things under his feet. For in making man the ruler over all things, God did not put anything outside his authority; though we do not see everything under him now.
sentences.susu: i bara se birin lu a sanyi bun ma.» Na kui, Ala to se birin sa a xa mangɛya bun ma, sese mu na a mu naxan yamarima. Kɔnɔ won mu se birin toma a xa mangɛya bun ma sinden.

sentences.english: But we see him who was made a little lower than the angels, even Jesus, crowned with glory and honour, because he let himself be put to death so that by the grace of God he might undergo death for all men.
sentences.susu: Won munse toma? Ala naxa Isa ragoro malekɛe bun ma waxati dondoronti kui, kɔnɔ Isa xa faxɛ naxa findi xunnakeli nun binyɛ ra a bɛ. Na kui, Ala naxa hinnɛ won na, a Isa faxa adamadi birin ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Because it was right for him, for whom and through whom all things have being, in guiding his sons to glory, to make the captain of their salvation complete through pain.
sentences.susu: Ala nan se birin daaxi, se birin na a tan nan bɛ. A man wama adamadi gbegbe xa so a xa nɔrɛ kui. Na kui, a nu lanma a xa e Rakisima xa fe rakamali tɔɔrɛ ra.

sentences.english: For he who makes holy and those who are made holy are all of one family; and for this reason it is no shame for him to give them the name of brothers,
sentences.susu: Naxan adamadie rasɛniyɛnma, nun naxee rasɛniyɛnxi, e birin fatanxi Baba keren nan na. Na kui, a mu yaagi e xilide a ngaxakerenyie.

sentences.english: Saying, I will give the knowledge of your name to my brothers, I will make a song of praise to you before the church.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen, «N i xili masenma nɛ n ngaxakerenyie bɛ, n i matɔxɔma nɛ ɲama tagi.»

sentences.english: And again he says, I will put my faith in him. And again, See, I am here, and the children which God has given to me.
sentences.susu: A man naxa a masen, «N nan n ma lanlanteya sama Ala nan ma.» A man naxa a masen, «N na be, muxu nun die Ala naxee fixi n ma.»

sentences.english: And because the children are flesh and blood, he took a body himself and became like them; so that by his death he might put an end to him who had the power of death, that is to say, the Evil One;
sentences.susu: Na die to findi fate nun fasɛ ra, Isa fan naxa a yɛtɛ misaali e ra, alako a xa nɔ Ibulisa xun nakanade a yɛtɛ xa faxɛ saabui ra. Faxɛ sɛnbɛ nu na Ibulisa nan yi ra.

sentences.english: And let those who all their lives were in chains because of their fear of death, go free.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a yɛtɛ misaali a ngaxakerenyie ra alako a xa e ratanga faxɛ xa gaaxui ma e xa duniɲɛigiri kui, naxan luxi alɔ konyiya.

sentences.english: For, truly, he does not take on the life of angels, but that of the seed of Abraham.
sentences.susu: A na birin naba Iburahima bɔnsɔɛ nan malife ra, a mu a raba malekɛe xa bɛ.

sentences.english: Because of this it was necessary for him to be made like his brothers in every way, so that he might be a high priest full of mercy and keeping faith in everything to do with God, making offerings for the sins of the people.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi a naxa a yɛtɛ maniya a ngaxakerenyie ra, alako a xa nɔ sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi wali rabade kinikini nun tinxinyi ra Ala bɛ, a fa findi ɲama xa yunubie xafarima ra.

sentences.english: For having been put to the test himself, he is able to give help to others when they are tested.
sentences.susu: Isa fata mixie malide e xa maratantanyi kui, barima a fan maratantanyi nun tɔɔrɛ kolon nɛ.

sentences.english: For this reason, holy brothers, marked out to have a part in heaven, give thought to Jesus the representative and high priest of our faith;
sentences.susu: Na kui, n ngaxakerenyi sɛniyɛnxie, wo tan naxee xilixi ariyanna ma, wo xaxili xa ti Isa ra, Ala xa xɛɛra nun a xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi, won danxaniyaxi naxan ma.

sentences.english: Who kept faith with God who gave him his place, even as Moses did in all his house.
sentences.susu: A tinxin nɛ Ala bɛ, naxan nu bara a ti na wali ra, alɔ Annabi Munsa fan a rabaxi ki naxɛ Ala xa banxi kui.

sentences.english: And it was right for this man to have more honour than Moses, even as the builder of a house has more honour than the house.
sentences.susu: Isa xa binyɛ dangi Munsa gbe ra, alɔ banxiti xa binyɛ dangixi a xa banxi ra ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For every house has a builder; but the builder of all things is God.
sentences.susu: Banxi birin tixi mixi nde nan saabui ra, kɔnɔ Ala nan duniɲa birin daaxi.

sentences.english: And Moses certainly kept faith as a servant, in all his house, and as a witness of those things which were to be said later;
sentences.susu: Annabi Munsa findixi konyi dugutɛgɛ nan na Ala xa banxi kui, alako a xa seedeɲɔxɔya ba masenyi xa fe ra naxan fama tide.

sentences.english: But Christ as a son, over his house; whose house are we, if we keep our hearts fixed in the glad and certain hope till the end.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi findixi Ala xa Di dugutɛgɛ nan na, naxan Ala xa banxi yamarima. Won tan fan findixi na banxi nan na, xa won lama Isa ra, xa won won xaxili tima a ra, na nan findixi won ma matɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: And so, as the Holy Spirit says, Today if you let his voice come to your ears,
sentences.susu: Na na a ra, wo xa wo ɲɛngi sa Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa masenyi xɔn ma. A sɛbɛxi, «Xa wo bara a xui ramɛ to,

sentences.english: Be not hard of heart, as when you made me angry, on the day of testing in the waste land,
sentences.susu: wo naxa wo kobe raso a ra, alɔ wo a rabaxi ki naxɛ gbengberenyi ma. Na tɛmui a nu wo matofe nɛ, kɔnɔ wo naxa a matandi.

sentences.english: When your fathers put me to the test, and saw my works for forty years.
sentences.susu: Mɛnni wo benbae bara kata e xa n mato. E naxa n ma wali to ɲɛ tongo naani bun ma.

sentences.english: So that I was angry with this generation, and I said, Their hearts are in error at all times, and they have no knowledge of my ways;
sentences.susu: Na kui, n naxa xɔnɔ na waxati mixie ma. N naxa a fala, ‹E bɔɲɛ makuya n na tɛmui birin, e mu n ma sɛriyɛ kolon.›

sentences.english: And being angry I made an oath, saying, They may not come into my rest.
sentences.susu: Na na a ra n naxa n kali xɔnɛ kui, ‹E mu soma n ma malabui kui feo!›»

sentences.english: My brothers, take care that there is not by chance in any one of you an evil heart without belief, turning away from the living God:
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, wo xa mɛɛni wo yɛtɛ ma a fanyi ra alako wo bɔɲɛ naxa lu ɲaaxuɲa nun danxaniyatareɲa kui, wo fa gbilen Ala fɔxɔ ra, Ala naxan na na.

sentences.english: But give comfort to one another every day as long as it is still Today; so that no one among you may be made hard by the deceit of sin:
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ wo xa wo bore ralimaniya. Wo xa gbilen na ma lɔxɔɛ birin alako yunubi naxa fa wo nɔ, wo bɔɲɛ fa balan Ala mabiri.

sentences.english: For if we keep the substance of the faith which we had at the start, even till the end, we have a part with Christ;
sentences.susu: Xa won sa won xaxili tima Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra alɔ won a fɔlɔxi ki naxɛ, lanyi bara lu won nun Isa tagi.

sentences.english: As it is said, Today if you will let his voice come to your ears, be not hard of heart, as when you made him angry.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, «Xa wo bara a xui ramɛ to, wo naxa wo kobe raso a ra, alɔ wo a rabaxi ki naxɛ wo to a matandi.»

sentences.english: Who made him angry when his voice came to them? was it not all those who came out of Egypt with Moses?
sentences.susu: Nde Ala matandi, e to gɛ a xui ramɛde? Mixie xa mu a ra naxee mini Misira bɔxi ra Annabi Munsa saabui ra?

sentences.english: And with whom was he angry for forty years? was it not with those who did evil, who came to their deaths in the waste land?
sentences.susu: Ala xɔnɔ nɛ ndee ma ɲɛ tongo naani bun ma? Mixie xa mu a ra naxee yunubi rabaxi, e fa sɔntɔ gbengberenyi ma?

sentences.english: And to whom did he make an oath that they might not come into his rest? was it not to those who went against his orders?
sentences.susu: Ala a kali nde bɛ a e mu soma a xa malabui yire? Mixie xa mu a ra naxee a matandixi?

sentences.english: So we see that they were not able to go in because they had no belief.
sentences.susu: Na kui, won bara a fahaamu a e xa danxaniyatareɲa nan a niya e mu so.

sentences.english: Let us then, though we still have God's word that we may come into his rest, go in fear that some of you may be unable to do so.
sentences.susu: Ala xa laayidi, a naxan tongo won bɛ sofe a xa malabude, na mu kanaxi. Wo xa fe birin naba alako sofe na malabude kui a naxa kana wo bɛ.

sentences.english: And, truly, the good news came to us, even as it did to them; but the hearing of the word did them no good, because they were not united in faith with the true hearers.
sentences.susu: Won bara na xibaaru fanyi mɛ alɔ booree a mɛxi ki naxɛ, kɔnɔ a mu sese fanxi e ma e xa danxaniyatareɲa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For those of us who have belief come into his rest; even as he has said, As I said in my oath when I was angry, They may not come into my rest: though the works were done from the time of the making of the world.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ won tan naxee bara la a ra, won fama nɛ sode na malabude kui. A sɛbɛxi na xa fe ra, «N to xɔnɔ e ma, n naxa n kali, e mu soma n ma malabude.» Kɔnɔ Ala xa wali bara ɲɔn kabi duniɲa fɔlɛ,

sentences.english: For in one place he has said of the seventh day, And God had rest from all his works on the seventh day;
sentences.susu: barima a sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui na lɔxɔɛ solofere nde xa fe ra, «Lɔxɔɛ solofere nde Ala xa wali naxa kamali. A naxa a malabu.»

sentences.english: And in the same place he says again, They will not come into my rest.
sentences.susu: A man sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, «E mu soma n ma malabude.»

sentences.english: So that as it is clear that some have to go in, and that the first hearers of the good news were not able to go in because they went against God's orders,
sentences.susu: Ala nu bara a ɲanige mixi ndee xa so a xa malabude kui, kɔnɔ na mixi singe naxee na xibaaru mɛxi, e mu so e xa danxaniyatareɲa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: After a long time, again naming a certain day, he says in David, Today (as he had said before), Today if you will let his voice come to your ears, be not hard of heart,
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi Ala bara lɔxɔɛ gbɛtɛ sugandi naxan findixi to ra. Na fe singe to bara dangi a xɔnnakuye ra, Ala man naxa a masen Dawuda saabui ra, «Xa wo bara a xui ramɛ to, wo naxa wo kobe raso a ra.»

sentences.english: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have said anything about another day.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li Yosuwe nu bara malabui fi e ma nu, Ala man mu nu lɔxɔɛ gbɛtɛ xa fe falama nu.

sentences.english: So that there is still a Sabbath-keeping for the people of God.
sentences.susu: Han ya malabui luxi Ala xa ɲama bɛ e mu naxan sɔtɔxi sinden.

sentences.english: For the man who comes into his rest has had rest from his works, as God did from his.
sentences.susu: Naxan soma Ala xa malabui kui, a a malabuma nɛ a xa wali birin ma, alɔ Ala malabuxi a xa wali kui ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Because of this, let us have a strong desire to come into that rest, and let no one go after the example of those who went against God's orders.
sentences.susu: Won xa fe birin naba sofe ra na malabui kui, alako mixi yo naxa bira tantanyi kui alɔ Isirayilakae a rabaxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For the word of God is living and full of power, and is sharper than any two-edged sword, cutting through and making a division even of the soul and the spirit, the bones and the muscles, and quick to see the thoughts and purposes of the heart.
sentences.susu: Ala xa masenyi sɛnbɛ gbo, a walima mixi bɔɲɛ ma. A xaaɲɛn dangife santidɛgɛma dɛ firinyi ra. A soma won bɔɲɛ nun won sondonyi nan kui, a so won sɔɔra nun won nadɔxɔdee xɔn. A won sondonyi waxɔnfe nun maɲɔxunyi birin makiiti.

sentences.english: And there is nothing made which is not completely clear to him; there is nothing covered, but all things are open to the eyes of him with whom we have to do.
sentences.susu: Nimase yo mu nɔma a nɔxunde Ala ma. Ala fe birin toma nɛ, fe birin dɛntɛgɛ fama sade a tan nan bɛ.

sentences.english: Having then a great high priest, who has made his way through the heavens, even Jesus the Son of God, let us be strong in our faith.
sentences.susu: Isa, won ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi xungbe, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, a to so ariyanna kui, won fan xa bira won ma danxaniya fɔxɔ ra won bara naxan makɛnɛn.

sentences.english: For we have not a high priest who is not able to be touched by the feelings of our feeble flesh; but we have one who has been tested in all points as we ourselves are tested, but without sin.
sentences.susu: Won ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi won ma sɛnbɛtareya kolon, a kinikinixi won ma na nan ma. Sentanɛ naxa kata a ratantande mɔɔli birin na alɔ won tan, kɔnɔ a mu a nɔ.

sentences.english: Then let us come near to the seat of grace without fear, so that mercy may be given to us, and we may get grace for our help in time of need.
sentences.susu: Na na a ra, won xa won maso a xa hinnɛ kibanyi ra lanlanteya ra, alako won xa kinikini nun hinnɛ sɔtɔ a tɛmui.

sentences.english: Every high priest who is taken from among men is given his position to take care of the interests of men in those things which have to do with God, so that he may make offerings for sins.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi birin tongoxi adamadie nan ya ma, a fa ti Ala xa wali ra adamadie bɛ, alako a xa hadiya nun sɛrɛxɛ mɔɔli birin ba yunubie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: He is able to have feeling for those who have no knowledge and for those who are wandering from the true way, because he himself is feeble;
sentences.susu: A mixie xa fe kolon naxee na dimi kui, e lɔɛxi, barima a fan na e ya ma, a tantanma.

sentences.english: And being feeble, he has to make sin-offerings for himself as well as for the people.
sentences.susu: A xa sɛnbɛtareya a niyama nɛ a xa sɛrɛxɛ ba a yɛtɛ xa yunubie bɛ, a nun ɲama xa yunubie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And no man who is not given authority by God, as Aaron was, takes this honour for himself.
sentences.susu: Mixi mu nɔma yi binyɛ sɔtɔde a yɛtɛ ra, fo Ala a xili alɔ a Haruna xili ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: In the same way Christ did not take for himself the glory of being made a high priest, but was given it by him who said, You are my Son, this day I have given you being:
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi fan mu sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi binyɛ sɔtɔ a yɛtɛ xa ra. Ala nan a fixi a ma, a falafe ra, «To i bara findi n ma di ra. N tan fan bara findi i Baba ra.»

sentences.english: As he says in another place, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
sentences.susu: A man sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, «I bara findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra abadan, Melekisedeki mɔɔli.»

sentences.english: Who in the days of his flesh, having sent up prayers and requests with strong crying and weeping to him who was able to give him salvation from death, had his prayer answered because of his fear of God.
sentences.susu: Isa bara a xui ite Ala maxandi ra a xa duniɲɛigiri kui, a bara a makula, a na wafe. A na raba nɛ barima a a kolon a Ala nan nu nɔma a ratangade faxɛ ma. Ala bara a xa duba suxu, barima a nu bara tin lufe a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: And though he was a Son, through the pain which he underwent, the knowledge came to him of what it was to be under God's orders;
sentences.susu: Isa findixi Ala xa Di nan na, kɔnɔ na kui a naxa a matinkan fo a xa Ala rabatu hali na findixi tɔɔrɛ nan na a bɛ.

sentences.english: And when he had been made complete, he became the giver of eternal salvation to all those who are under his orders;
sentences.susu: Isa xa fe to kamali, a naxa findi saabui ra a mantonyie birin xa abadan kisi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Being named by God a high priest of the order of Melchizedek.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a ti sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi ra Melekisedeki daaxi.

sentences.english: Of whom we have much to say which it is hard to make clear, because you are slow of hearing.
sentences.susu: Fe gbegbe na na kui muxu wama naxan masenfe wo bɛ, kɔnɔ na tagi rabafe xɔrɔxɔ, barima wo mu soma fee kui mafurenyi ra.

sentences.english: And though by this time it would be right for you to be teachers, you still have need of someone to give you teaching about the first simple rules of God's revelation; you have become like babies who have need of milk, and not of solid food.
sentences.susu: A nu lanma wo xa findi karamɔxɔ ra yi waxati, kɔnɔ han yakɔsi wo hayi na karamɔxɔ nde ma naxan wo xaranma Ala xa masenyi singee ra. Wo mu fata fe tilinxi fahaamude sinden, alɔ diyɔrɛ naxan mu fata sube donde, fo a xa xiɲɛ min sinden.

sentences.english: For everyone who takes milk is without experience of the word of righteousness: he is a child.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan hayi na Ala xa na masenyi singee ma, a mu gɛxi tinxinyi kolonde, a mu mɔxi a xa danxaniya kui. A luxi alɔ diyɔrɛ naxan xiɲɛ gbansan minma.

sentences.english: But solid food is for men of full growth, even for those whose senses are trained by use to see what is good and what is evil.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi naxan mɔxi a xa danxaniya kui, naxan bara gɛ tinxinyi nun tinxintareya tagi raba kolonde, a nɔma nɛ xaranyi tilinxi fan kolonde. A tan luxi alɔ xɛmɔxi naxan baloma sube fanyi ra.

sentences.english: For this reason let us go on from the first things about Christ to full growth; not building again that on which it is based, that is, the turning of the heart from dead works, and faith in God,
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi won lanma won xa siga yare ma Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa xaranyi kui. Won xa dangi na masenyi singee ra, won xa so fe tilinxie kui. Na masenyi singee nan ya: wali ɲaaxi bɛɲinfe naxan mixi xaninma yahannama,

sentences.english: The teaching of baptisms, and of the putting on of hands, and of the future life of the dead, and of the judging on the last day.
sentences.susu: danxaniyafe Ala ma, xunxafe ye xɔɔra, bɛlɛxɛ safe mixie ma, kelife faxɛ ma, nun Ala xa kiiti dɔnxɔɛ.

sentences.english: Now we will do this, if God lets us.
sentences.susu: Xa Ala tin, won xa siga yare ma won ma xaranyi kui.

sentences.english: As for those who at one time saw the light, tasting the good things from heaven, and having their part in the Holy Spirit,
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan bara gɛ Ala xa naiyalanyi tode, naxan bara Ala xa ki nɛmunnɛmun, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi bara lu naxan bɛ,

sentences.english: With knowledge of the good word of God, and of the powers of the coming time,
sentences.susu: naxan bara a kolon a Ala xa masenyi fan, naxan bara Ala sɛnbɛ kolon naxan fama rawalide waxati naxan sa fama,

sentences.english: And then let themselves be turned away, it is not possible for their hearts to be made new a second time; because they themselves put the Son of God on the cross again, openly shaming him.
sentences.susu: xa a sa li na mixi mɔɔli bara danxaniya bɛɲin, a mu nɔma tuubide sɔnɔn. A luxi alɔ a man bara Ala xa Di mabanban wuri magalanbuxi ma, a fa a rayaagi ɲama ya xɔri.

sentences.english: For a land, drinking in the frequent rain and producing good plants for those for whom it is worked, has a blessing from God:
sentences.susu: Bɔxi naxan bara tunɛ ye sɔtɔ a fanyi ra, a fa sansi ramini a kanyi bɛ, Ala baraka ragoroma nɛ a ma.

sentences.english: But if it sends up thorns and evil plants, it is of no use and is ready to be cursed; its only end is to be burned.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ bɔxi naxan tunbe nun ɲooge tun naminima, na bɔxi mu fan. A gbe mu luxi a xa danka, a raɲɔnyi a fa gan.

sentences.english: But, my loved ones, though we say this, we are certain that you have better things in you, things which go with salvation;
sentences.susu: Muxu xanuntenyie, hali muxu xa wɔyɛnyi xɔrɔxɔ, muxu bara la a ra wo na kira fanyi nan xɔn, naxan findi kisi kira ra.

sentences.english: For God is true, and will not put away from him the memory of your work and of your love for his name, in the help which you gave and still give to the saints.
sentences.susu: Ala tinxin, a mu nɛɛmuma wo xa wali ma. A wo xa xanunteya kolon, wo naxan masenxi wo xa wali kui a xili ra, a nun wo naxan masenxi sɛniyɛntɔɛe bɛ. Han ya wo na na wali nan kui.

sentences.english: And it is our desire that you may all keep the same high purpose in certain hope to the end:
sentences.susu: Muxu wama nɛ wo xa wo tunnabɛxi na birin kui han a raɲɔnyi, alako wo xa fe sɔtɔ wo wo xaxili tixi naxan na.

sentences.english: So that you may not be slow in heart, but may take as your example those to whom God has given their heritage, because of their faith and their long waiting.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa wo tunnaxɔnɔ. Wo xa bira danxaniyatɔɛe xa misaali fɔxɔ ra, naxee kɛ sɔtɔma Ala naxan laayidixi e bɛ. E na sɔtɔma e xa danxaniya nun e xa tunnabɛxi nan saabui ra.

sentences.english: For when God made his oath to Abraham, because there was no greater oath, he made it by himself,
sentences.susu: Ala to laayidi tongo Iburahima bɛ, a mu nɔ a kalide fe nde ra naxan gbo a bɛ. Na na a ra, a naxa a kali a yɛtɛ ra,

sentences.english: Saying, Be certain that I will give you my blessing, and make your numbers very great.
sentences.susu: a falafe ra, «N baraka sama nɛ i xa fe. I bɔnsɔɛ wuyama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And so, when he had been waiting calmly for a long time, God's word to him was put into effect.
sentences.susu: Iburahima to gɛ mamɛ tide, Ala naxa a xa laayidi rakamali a bɛ.

sentences.english: For men at all times make their oaths by what is greater; and any argument is ended by the decision of the oath.
sentences.susu: Adama a kalima fe nde ra naxan gbo a bɛ. Na marakali sɛnbɛ fima nɛ a xa wɔyɛnyi ma, alako mixi naxa nɔ na matandide.

sentences.english: So that when it was God's desire to make it specially clear to those who by his word were to have the heritage, that his purpose was fixed, he made it more certain with an oath;
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi, Ala fan naxa a rakali alako mixie, na laayidi tongoxi naxee bɛ, e xa a kolon Ala xa natɛ mu masarama.

sentences.english: So that we, who have gone in flight from danger to the hope which has been put before us, may have a strong comfort in two unchanging things, in which it is not possible for God to be false;
sentences.susu: Ala naxa na laayidi tongo, a man naxa a rakali, alako won xa nɔ limaniya xungbe sɔtɔde. Wule yo mu na na fe firinyi kui. Won bara fe birin nabolo a xa fe ra, won fa won xaxili ti a ra.

sentences.english: And this hope is like a strong band for our souls, fixed and certain, and going in to that which is inside the veil;
sentences.susu: Mixi xaxili tife Ala ra, a luma nɛ alɔ hanga naxan banbanxi ye bun ma. Won fan won xaxili tima Ala ra na ki nɛ naxan na a xa hɔrɔmɔlingira kui dugi gbakuxi xanbi ra,

sentences.english: Where Jesus has gone before us, as a high priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
sentences.susu: Isa soxi dɛnnaxɛ won ya ra, a xa findi won ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi ra abadan, alɔ Melekisedeki.

sentences.english: For this Melchizedek, the king of Salem, a priest of the Most High God, who gave Abraham his blessing, meeting him when he came back after putting the kings to death,
sentences.susu: Melekisedeki nan nu na Salamu mangɛ ra, a man nu findixi Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nan na. Iburahima to gɛ mangɛ ndee xun nakanade, Melekisedeki naxa sa naralan a ra, a duba a bɛ.

sentences.english: And to whom Abraham gave a tenth part of everything which he had, being first named King of righteousness, and then in addition, King of Salem, that is to say, King of peace;
sentences.susu: Iburahima naxa farilɛ fi a ma. Melekisedeki xili fasarixi yi ki «mangɛ tinxinxi.» A man nu findixi Salamu mangɛ nan na, naxan xili fasarima yi ki «bɔɲɛsa mangɛ.»

sentences.english: Being without father or mother, or family, having no birth or end to his life, being made like the Son of God, is a priest for ever.
sentences.susu: A baba mu kolon, a nga mu kolon, a xa taruxui mu kolon. A xa simaya fɔlɔxi tɛmui naxɛ, a nun a ɲɔn tɛmui, na fan mu kolon. Na kui, a luxi nɛ alɔ Ala xa Di, naxan findixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra abadan.

sentences.english: Now see how great this man was, to whom our father Abraham gave a tenth part of what he had got in the fight.
sentences.susu: Wo a mato Melekisedeki tide nu gboxi ki naxɛ. Hali won baba Iburahima, a naxan sɔtɔ a wasaso se ra, a naxa na farilɛ fi a ma.

sentences.english: And it is true that by the law, those of the sons of Levi who have the position of priests may take a tenth part of the people's goods; that is to say, they take it from their brothers though these are the sons of Abraham.
sentences.susu: Ala xa sɛriyɛ a falama ɲama xa farilɛ so Lewi bɔnsɔɛ yi ra, naxan findixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra. Na ɲama fan kelixi Iburahima bɔnsɔɛ nɛ, e findi Lewi ngaxakerenyie nan na.

sentences.english: But this man, who was not of their family, took the tenth from Abraham, and gave a blessing to him to whom God had given his undertaking.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Melekisedeki tan, hali a to mu nu na Lewi bɔnsɔɛ xa taruxui kui, Iburahima naxa farilɛ so a yi ra. Melekisedeki naxa duba Iburahima laayidi kanyi bɛ.

sentences.english: But there is no doubt that the less gets his blessing from the greater.
sentences.susu: Birin a kolon mixi naxan dubama a boore bɛ, a tide gbo na kanyi bɛ.

sentences.english: Now at the present time, men over whom death has power take the tenth; but then it was taken by one of whom it is witnessed that he is living.
sentences.susu: Lewi xa mixi naxee farilɛ rasuxuma, e faxama nɛ, kɔnɔ Melekisedeki tan mu faxaxi.

sentences.english: And we may say that in Abraham, even Levi, who has a right to take the tenth part, gave it;
sentences.susu: Na kui, a luxi nɛ alɔ Lewi, naxan luma farilɛ rasuxu ra, a nu bara farilɛ fi Melekisedeki ma Iburahima saabui ra,

sentences.english: Because he was still in his father's body when Melchizedek came to him.
sentences.susu: barima Lewi bɔnsɔɛ nu na a benba Iburahima fate i, a naralan Melekisedeki ra tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: Now if it was possible for things to be made complete through the priests of the house of Levi (for the law was given to the people in connection with them), what need was there for another priest who was of the order of Melchizedek and not of the order of Aaron?
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li fe birin nu nɔma kamalide Lewi bɔnsɔɛ xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛɲa saabui ra nu, ɲama Ala xa sɛriyɛ sɔtɔxi naxan na, e hayi mu nu na Melekisedeki xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛɲa ma nu, naxan mu fatanxi Haruna bɔnsɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: Because if the priests are changed, it is necessary to make a change in the law.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛɲa na masara, yaamari fan xa masara.

sentences.english: For he of whom these things are said comes of another tribe, of which no man has ever made offerings at the altar.
sentences.susu: Yi masenyi birin falaxi mixi naxan ma fe ra, a kelixi bɔnsɔɛ nɛ sɛrɛxɛdubɛ mu na bɔnsɔɛ naxɛ.

sentences.english: Because it is clear that our Lord comes out of Judah, and Moses said nothing about priests from that tribe.
sentences.susu: Birin a kolon a won Marigi kelixi Yuda bɔnsɔɛ nɛ. Annabi Munsa mu yaamari yo fi na bɔnsɔɛ mixie ma e xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛ wali raba.

sentences.english: And this is even more clear if a second priest has come up who is like Melchizedek,
sentences.susu: Muxu naxan masenxi, a fiixɛ, barima sɛrɛxɛdubɛ gbɛtɛ bara mini, naxan maniya Melekisedeki ra,

sentences.english: That is to say, not made by a law based on the flesh, but by the power of a life without end:
sentences.susu: naxan mu findixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra a bɔnsɔɛ xa fe ra. Na kanyi findixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra, barima faxɛ mu nɔ a ra.

sentences.english: For it has been witnessed of him, You are a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
sentences.susu: Yi seedeɲɔxɔya bara raba a xa fe ra, «I findixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ nan na abadan, Melekisedeki daaxi.»

sentences.english: So the law which went before is put on one side, because it was feeble and without profit.
sentences.susu: Yaamari singe bara ba na a xa sɛnbɛtareya xa fe ra, a mu nu nɔma a xa wali rabade.

sentences.english: (Because the law made nothing complete), and in its place there is a better hope, through which we come near to God.
sentences.susu: Na yaamari mu nɔ fefe rakamalide, kɔnɔ fe nɛɛnɛ bara mini won xaxili tima naxan na, naxan nɔma won malide won makɔrɛde Ala ra.

sentences.english: And as this is not without the taking of an oath
sentences.susu: Na fe nɛɛnɛ mu tixi marakali xanbi.

sentences.english: (For those were made priests without an oath, but this one was made a priest with an oath by him who says of him, The Lord gave his oath, which he will not take back, that you are a priest for ever);
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ singee bara wali suxu marakali xanbi, kɔnɔ Isa nan findixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra yi marakali ra Ala naxan masenxi, «Marigi bara a kali, a mu a xa natɛ masarama: I tan nan findixi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra abadan.»

sentences.english: By so much is it a better agreement which we have through Jesus.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Ala bara saatɛ tongo won bɛ Isa saabui ra, naxan fan boore bɛ.

sentences.english: And it is true that there have been a great number of those priests, because death does not let them go on for ever;
sentences.susu: Na xanbi, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ singee nu wuya, barima e to faxa, mixi gbɛtɛe nu tima e ɲɔxɔɛ ra.

sentences.english: But this priest, because his life goes on for ever, is unchanging.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Isa tan mu faxama, a buma nɛ abadan. A xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛɲa mu radangima mixi gbɛtɛe ma.

sentences.english: So that he is fully able to be the saviour of all who come to God through him, because he is ever living to make prayer to God for them.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi a nɔma mixi rakiside naxan a makɔrɛma Ala ra a tan saabui ra. A ɲiɲɛ to a ra, a nɔma findide e xa saabui fanyi ra Ala yire abadan.

sentences.english: It was right for us to have such a high priest, one who is holy and without evil, doing no wrong, having no part with sinners, and made higher than the heavens:
sentences.susu: Won hayi na na sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi mɔɔli nan ma naxan sɛniyɛn, yunubi mu na naxan ma, naxan mu fe ɲaaxi yo kolon, naxan mu luma yunubitɔɛe ya ma, naxan xa fe itexi dangife koore ra.

sentences.english: Who has no need to make offerings for sins every day, like those high priests, first for himself, and then for the people; because he did this once and for ever when he made an offering of himself.
sentences.susu: Isa mu luma alɔ boore sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie, naxee lanma e xa sɛrɛxɛ ba lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ e xa yunubie xa fe ra, a nun ɲama xa yunubie xa fe ra. A tan bara a yɛtɛ ba sɛrɛxɛ ra kerenyi ra.

sentences.english: The law makes high priests of men who are feeble; but the word of the oath, which was made after the law, gives that position to a Son, in whom all good is for ever complete.
sentences.susu: Yaamari singe nu mixi sɛnbɛtaree nan tima sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigie ra, kɔnɔ na marakali nɛɛnɛ naxan faxi na yaamari singe dangi xanbi, a bara Ala xa Di ti sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi ra, naxan bara gɛ kamalide abadan.

sentences.english: Now of the things we are saying this is the chief point: We have such a high priest, who has taken his place at the right hand of God's high seat of glory in heaven,
sentences.susu: Masenyi xunyi nan ya: Won ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi magoroxi Ala Xili Xungbe Kanyi xa kibanyi yirefanyi ma ariyanna kui.

sentences.english: As a servant of the holy things and of the true Tent, which was put up by God, not by man.
sentences.susu: A walima Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira yati yati nan kui, Marigi naxan tixi, adamadie bɛlɛxɛ fɔxi mu naxan na.

sentences.english: Now every high priest is given authority to take to God the things which are given and to make offerings; so that it is necessary for this man, like them, to have something for an offering.
sentences.susu: Sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi birin lanma a xa sɛrɛxɛ mɔɔli birin ba Ala bɛ. Na kui a nu lanma se nde xa lu yi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ fan yi ra a naxan bama sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: If he had been on earth he would not have been a priest at all, because there are other priests who make the offerings ordered by the law;
sentences.susu: Xa won ma sɛrɛxɛdubɛ kuntigi nu na duniɲa nu, a mu nu findima sɛrɛxɛdubɛ ra nu, barima Ala xa yaamari ɲan bara mixi gbɛtɛe ti na sɛrɛxɛ wali ra.

sentences.english: Being servants of that which is a copy and an image of the things in heaven, as Moses, when he was about to make the Tent, had special orders from God: for, See, he said, that you make everything like the design which you saw in the mountain.
sentences.susu: Na mixie Ala batuma hɔrɔmɔlingira nan kui, naxan misaalixi hɔrɔmɔlingira ra naxan na ariyanna. Na nan a toxi Ala naxa Annabi Munsa yamari hɔrɔmɔlingira tife ra, a falafe ra, «A mato a fanyi ra, i xa hɔrɔmɔlingira ti alɔ a masenxi i bɛ geya fari ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: But now his position as priest is higher. because through him God has made a better agreement with man, based on the giving of better things.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ yakɔsi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi bara wali sɔtɔ naxan tide gbo boore sɛrɛxɛdubɛe xa wali bɛ tife ra Ala nun adamadie tagi. A tide gbo barima a faxi saatɛ naxan na, na fan saatɛ fori bɛ. A xa saatɛ mabanbanxi laayidie nan na, naxee fan dangi laayidi forie ra.

sentences.english: For if that first agreement had been as good as possible, there would have been no place for a second.
sentences.susu: Xa na saatɛ singe nu nɔma a xa wali rabade nu, Ala mu fama a firin nde ra nu.

sentences.english: For, protesting against them, he says, See, the days are coming when I will make a new agreement with the house of Israel, and with the house of Judah;
sentences.susu: Ala naxa yi marakɔrɔsi raba ɲama ra, «Marigi xa masenyi nan ya: Waxati na fafe, n saatɛ nɛɛnɛ tongoma Isirayila nun Yudaya ɲama bɛ tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: Not like the agreement which I made with their fathers when I took them by the hand, to be their guide out of the land of Egypt; for they did not keep the agreement with me, and I gave them up, says the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na mu luma alɔ na saatɛ singe n naxan tongo e benbae bɛ, n e ramini Misira bɔxi ra tɛmui naxɛ. E to n ma saatɛ bɛɲin, n fan naxa e bɛɲin. Marigi xa masenyi nan na ki.

sentences.english: For this is the agreement which I will make with the people of Israel after those days: I will put my laws into their minds, writing them in their hearts: and I will be their God, and they will be my people:
sentences.susu: Saatɛ nan ya n naxan tongoma Isirayila ɲama bɛ, na waxati dangi xanbi. Marigi xa masenyi nan ya: N nan n ma sɛriyɛ rasoma nɛ e xaxili kui, n a sɛbɛ e sondonyi ma. N findima e Marigi Ala nan na, e fan findi n ma ɲama ra.

sentences.english: And there will be no need for every man to be teaching his brother, or his neighbour, saying, This is the knowledge of the Lord: for they will all have knowledge of me, great and small.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu a boore matinkanma, mixi yo mu a falama a ngaxakerenyi bɛ, ‹I xa Ala kolon,› barima na waxati e birin n kolonma nɛ, kelife mixi xuri ma han mixi xungbe.

sentences.english: And I will have mercy on their evil-doing, and I will not keep their sins in mind.
sentences.susu: N diɲɛma nɛ e xa tinxintareya ma, n e xa yunubie xafarima nɛ.»

sentences.english: When he says, A new agreement, he has made the first agreement old. But anything which is getting old and past use will not be seen much longer.
sentences.susu: A to yi saatɛ xili fala saatɛ nɛɛnɛ, a bara boore findi saatɛ fori ra. Saatɛ fori tan lanma a xa ba na, a tide mu na sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: Now the first agreement had its rules of worship, and a holy order.
sentences.susu: Saatɛ singe bun ma, yaamari ndee nu na batui xa fe ra, nun Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira xa fe ra, naxan nu na duniɲa.

sentences.english: For the first Tent was made ready, having in it the vessels for the lights and the table and the ordering of the bread; and this is named the holy place.
sentences.susu: Na hɔrɔmɔlingira to ti, yire nde nu na naxan nu xili yire sɛniyɛnxi. Lanpui nu na a kui, a nun teebili sɛrɛxɛ taami nu saxi naxan ma.

sentences.english: And inside the second veil was the place which is named the Holy of holies;
sentences.susu: Yire sɛniyɛnxi firin nde nu na dugi gbakuxi xanbi ra, naxan nu sɛniyɛn dangife boore ra.

sentences.english: Having a vessel of gold in it for burning perfumes, and the ark of the agreement, which was covered with gold and which had in it a pot made of gold for the manna, and Aaron's rod which put out buds, and the stones with the writing of the agreement;
sentences.susu: Surayi ganse xɛɛma daaxi nun saatɛ kankira nu na na yire kui. Xɛɛma nu saxi saatɛ kankira birin ma. Tɔnbili xɛɛma daaxi mana nu ragataxi naxan kui, Haruna xa xuli naxan fuga, a nun walaxɛe, saatɛ sɛbɛxi naxee ma, e birin nu na na saatɛ kankira kui.

sentences.english: And over it were the winged ones of glory with their wings covering the mercy-seat; about which it is not possible now to say anything in detail.
sentences.susu: Ala xa malekɛ nɔrɔxi masolixi firinyi nu tixi saatɛ kankira fari, e yunubi xafari yire makoto. A mu lanma won xa so na wɔyɛnyi birin kui yakɔsi.

sentences.english: Now while these things were in existence, the priests went into the first Tent at all times, for prayer and the making of offerings.
sentences.susu: Na yire to gɛ yailande na ki, sɛrɛxɛdubɛe nu luma so ra na yire sɛniyɛnxi singe nan kui, e e xa wali raba naa.
