sentences.english: For the prophets who gave the news of the grace which would come to you, made search with all care for knowledge of this salvation;
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛe yati nu katama ki fanyi ra na kisi xa fe kolonfe wo naxan sɔtɔxi Ala xa hinnɛ saabui ra.

sentences.english: Attempting to see what sort of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them was pointing to, when it gave witness to the pains which Christ would undergo and the glories which would come after them.
sentences.susu: E nu wama na kisi fa tɛmui nun a fa ki kolonfe Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Xaxili naxan xa fee masen e bɛ. Na Xaxili naxan nu sabatixi e i, a naxa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa tɔɔrɛ nun a xa xunnakeli masen e bɛ beenun nee xa raba.

sentences.english: And it was made clear to those prophets that they were God's servants not for themselves but for you, to give you word of the things which have now come to your ears from the preachers of the good news through the Holy Spirit sent down from heaven; things which even angels have a desire to see.
sentences.susu: Ala a masen nɛ namiɲɔnmɛe bɛ, a e mu nu na xɛɛra ibafe e xa waxati mixie xa bɛ. E nu na a ibafe wo tan nan bɛ. E xɛɛra naxan ibaxi, mixi gbɛtɛe bara na xibaaru fanyi ti wo bɛ Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra, naxan kelixi koore ma. Hali malekɛe yati wama na masenyi kolonfe.

sentences.english: So make your minds ready, and keep on the watch, hoping with all your power for the grace which is to come to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ;
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, a lan wo xa wo xaxili yailan fe ma wo naxan nabama, wo xa wo ɲɔxɔ sa wo yɛtɛ xɔn ma, wo xa wo xaxili birin ti Ala xa hinnɛ ra, a naxan fima wo ma Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa fa lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: Like children ruled by God, do not go back to the old desires of the time when you were without knowledge:
sentences.susu: Wo naxa bira wo waxɔnfe ɲaaxi fɔxɔ ra alɔ wo nu a rabama ki naxɛ beenun wo xa Isa kolon. Wo xa wo Baba Ala xui rabatu.

sentences.english: But be holy in every detail of your lives, as he, whose servants you are, is holy;
sentences.susu: Wo ɲɛrɛ ki xa sɛniyɛn alɔ Ala naxan wo xilixi a sɛniyɛnxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Because it has been said in the Writings, You are to be holy, for I am holy.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, «Wo xa sɛniyɛn, barima n tan sɛniyɛn.»

sentences.english: And if you give the name of Father to him who, judging every man by his acts, has no respect for a man's position, then go in fear while you are on this earth:
sentences.susu: Wo nɛ Ala maxandima, wo a falama a bɛ a wo Baba, Ala naxan mixi birin makiitima a wali ra tinxinyi ra. Na kui, waxati dɔnxɔɛ naxan luxi wo bɛ yi duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari, wo a masen wo ɲɛrɛ ki ma a wo a binyaxi.

sentences.english: Being conscious that you have been made free from that foolish way of life which was your heritage from your fathers, not through a payment of things like silver or gold which come to destruction,
sentences.susu: Wo xun mu saraxi se ra naxan kanama alɔ xɛɛma nun gbeti. Ala bara wo ratanga wo babae ɲɛrɛ ki kobi ma.

sentences.english: But through holy blood, like that of a clean and unmarked lamb, even the blood of Christ:
sentences.susu: Wo xunsaraxi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi wuli nan na, naxan baxi sɛrɛxɛ ra, alɔ yɛxɛɛ fanyi lanyuru yo mu na naxan ma.

sentences.english: Who was marked out by God before the making of the world, but was caused to be seen in these last times for you,
sentences.susu: Ala nu bara a sugandi beenun duniɲa xa daa, kɔnɔ a naxa a masen duniɲa bɛ yi waxati dɔnxɔɛ wo tan nan xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Who through him have faith in God who took him up again from the dead into glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.
sentences.susu: Wo danxaniyaxi Ala ma a tan nan saabui ra, Ala naxan nakeli faxɛ ma, a fa a xun nakeli. Na kui, wo la Ala ra, wo xa wo xaxili ti a ra.

sentences.english: And as you have made your souls clean, being ruled by what is true, and loving one another without deceit, see that your love is warm and from the heart:
sentences.susu: Wo to bira nɔndi fɔxɔ ra, wo bara sɛniyɛn, xanunteya fiixɛ bara lu wo bɔɲɛ ma wo ngaxakerenyie bɛ. Na na a ra wo xa wo bore xanu wo bɔɲɛ birin na.

sentences.english: Because you have had a new birth, not from the seed of man, but from eternal seed, through the word of a living and unchanging God.
sentences.susu: Wo bara bari a nɛɛnɛ ra Ala xa masenyi saabui ra. Na masenyi misaalixi sansi xɔri nan na, naxan mu kanama abadan. A mu kanama alɔ sansi xɔri boore naxan sama bɔxi ma.

sentences.english: For it is said, All flesh is like grass, and all its glory like the flower of the grass. The grass becomes dry and the flower dead:
sentences.susu: Ibunadama misaalixi sansi nan na. A xa nɔrɛ luxi alɔ sansi fugaxi. Sansi tan lisima nɛ, a fuge fa bira,

sentences.english: But the word of the Lord is eternal. And this is the word of the good news which was given to you.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ Marigi xa masenyi tan buma abadan. Na masenyi nan findixi xibaaru fanyi ra naxan ibaxi wo bɛ.

sentences.english: So putting away all wrongdoing, and all tricks and deceits and envies and evil talk,
sentences.susu: Wo xa fe ɲaaxi, wule, filankafuiɲa, milanteya, nun xili kanɛ bɛɲin.

sentences.english: Be full of desire for the true milk of the word, as babies at their mothers' breasts, so that you may go on to salvation;
sentences.susu: Wo xa bira Ala xa masenyi fɔxɔ ra alɔ diyɔrɛ wama xiɲɛ xɔn ki naxɛ. Na nɔma a niyade wo xa kisi xa sabati,

sentences.english: If you have had a taste of the grace of the Lord:
sentences.susu: barima wo bara Ala xa hinnɛ kolon.

sentences.english: To whom you come, as to a living stone, not honoured by men, but of great and special value to God;
sentences.susu: Wo wo makɔrɛ Isa ra naxan misaalixi gɛmɛ kɛndɛ ra banxi tima naxan fari. Adamadie bara mɛɛ a ra, kɔnɔ Ala tan na gɛmɛ nan sugandixi barima a rafan a ma ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: You, as living stones, are being made into a house of the spirit, a holy order of priests, making those offerings of the spirit which are pleasing to God through Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Wo fan misaalixi gɛmɛ kɛndɛe nan na naxee tixi Ala Xaxili xa banxi ra. Wo bara findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛ sɛniyɛnxie ra alako wo xa wo bɔɲɛ ba sɛrɛxɛ ra Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa saabui ra. Na nan nafan Ala ma.

sentences.english: Because it is said in the Writings, See, I am placing a keystone in Zion, of great and special value; and the man who has faith in him will not be put to shame.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui, «N bara gɛmɛ nde sugandi, naxan tide gbo. N a dɔxɔma Siyoni nɛ, a findi tuxui gɛmɛ nan na. Naxan lama a ra, na kanyi mu yaagima.»

sentences.english: And the value is for you who have faith; but it is said for those without faith, The very stone which the builders put on one side, was made the chief stone of the building;
sentences.susu: Wo tan naxee danxaniyaxi, naxee lama a ra a na gɛmɛ sugandixi tide gbo, xunnakeli na wo bɛ. Kɔnɔ yi masenyi sɛbɛxi danxaniyataree nan bɛ, «Banxitie mɛɛ gɛmɛ naxan na, na nan findixi gɛmɛ kɛndɛ ra banxi tuxui ma.»

sentences.english: And, A stone of falling, a rock of trouble; the word is the cause of their fall, because they go against it, and this was the purpose of God.
sentences.susu: A man masenxi, «Mixie e sanyi radinma na gɛmɛ ra, e fa bira.» E birama nɛ barima e mu tinma Ala xa masenyi ratinmɛde. Ala bara na ragiri e ma.

sentences.english: But you are a special people, a holy nation, priests and kings, a people given up completely to God, so that you may make clear the virtues of him who took you out of the dark into the light of heaven.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ Ala wo bɔnsɔɛ nan sugandixi, a xa findi mangɛ xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra. A wo si rasɛniyɛn, a wo xunsara. A naxa wo ramini dimi kui, wo xa lu a xa nɔrɛ bun ma. A na birin naba nɛ alako wo xa a matɔxɔ duniɲa ma.

sentences.english: In the past you were not a people, but now you are the people of God; then there was no mercy for you, but now mercy has been given to you.
sentences.susu: Singe wo mu nu findixi si ra, kɔnɔ yakɔsi wo bara findi Ala xa ɲama ra. Singe Ala mu nu kinikinixi wo ma, kɔnɔ yakɔsi a xa kinikini bara kamali wo bɛ.

sentences.english: My loved ones, I make this request with all my heart, that, as those for whom this world is a strange country, you will keep yourselves from the desires of the flesh which make war against the soul;
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie, wo xa limaniya. Wo naxa bira duniɲa fee fɔxɔ ra, barima nee wo bama Ala xa kira nan xɔn ma. Bekae mu na wo ra. Wo xɔnyi mu na yi duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari xa ra.

sentences.english: Being of good behaviour among the Gentiles; so that though they say now that you are evil-doers, they may see your good works and give glory to God when he comes to be their judge.
sentences.susu: Wo xa duniɲa mixie xa tɔɔɲɛgɛ xun nakana wo xa wali fanyi saabui ra, alako e fan xa Ala matɔxɔ lɔxɔɛ dɔnxɔɛ ma.

sentences.english: Keep all the laws of men because of the Lord; those of the king, who is over all,
sentences.susu: Wo wo yɛtɛ magoro duniɲa mangɛ birin bɛ Marigi xa fe ra. Yaamari soxi e tan nan yi, a findi mangɛ xungbe ra,

sentences.english: And those of the rulers who are sent by him for the punishment of evil-doers and for the praise of those who do well.
sentences.susu: a findi mangɛ xa xɛɛrae ra, alɔ gomina. E fe kobi rabae makiitima, e fe fanyi rabae matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: Because it is God's pleasure that foolish and narrow-minded men may be put to shame by your good behaviour:
sentences.susu: Ala wama nɛ wo xa xaxilitaree dɛ balan wo xa wali fanyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: As those who are free, not using your free position as a cover for wrongdoing, but living as the servants of God;
sentences.susu: Wo xa ɲɛrɛ alɔ mixi naxee bara xɔrɛya sɔtɔ, kɔnɔ na xɔrɛya naxa a niya wo xa lu fe ɲaaxi kui. Wo xa findi Ala xa konyie ra.

sentences.english: Have respect for all, loving the brothers, fearing God, honouring the king.
sentences.susu: Wo xa mixi birin binya. Wo xa wo ngaxakerenyie xanu. Wo xa gaaxu Ala ya ra. Wo xa mangɛ xungbe binya.

sentences.english: Servants, take orders from your masters with all respect; not only if they are good and gentle, but even if they are bad-humoured.
sentences.susu: Konyie, wo xa wo yɛtɛ magoro wo marigie bɛ binyɛ kui, hali e findi mixi xa fe maxɔrɔxɔxi ra. Wo naxa mixi fanyie xa gbansan xui ratinmɛ,

sentences.english: For it is a sign of grace if a man, desiring to do right in the eyes of God, undergoes pain as punishment for something which he has not done.
sentences.susu: barima fe fanyi nan a ra tinfe e xa i tɔɔrɔ tinxintareya ra Ala xa fe ra.

sentences.english: What credit is it if, when you have done evil, you take your punishment quietly? but if you are given punishment for doing right, and take it quietly, this is pleasing to God.
sentences.susu: Xa wo tɔɔrɛ nde sɔtɔ wo xa wali kobi xa fe ra, fe fanyi mu a ra. Kɔnɔ xa wo tɔɔrɛ nde sɔtɔ wo xa fe fanyi xa fe ra, Ala na kolonma nɛ wo bɛ.

sentences.english: This is God's purpose for you: because Jesus himself underwent punishment for you, giving you an example, so that you might go in his footsteps:
sentences.susu: Wo xilixi na nan ma, barima Isa fan tɔɔrɔ nɛ wo bɛ, na fa findi misaali ra wo bɛ wo birama naxan fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Who did no evil, and there was no deceit in his mouth:
sentences.susu: «A mu yunubi raba, a mu wule fala.»

sentences.english: To sharp words he gave no sharp answer; when he was undergoing pain, no angry word came from his lips; but he put himself into the hands of the judge of righteousness:
sentences.susu: E to a konbi, a mu a gbeɲɔxɔ. E to a tɔɔrɔ, a mu wɔyɛn xɔrɔxɔɛ fala. A naxa kiiti so kiitisa tinxinxi yi ra.

sentences.english: He took our sins on himself, giving his body to be nailed on the tree, so that we, being dead to sin, might have a new life in righteousness, and by his wounds we have been made well.
sentences.susu: A naxa faxa wuri magalanbuxi ma won ma yunubie xa fe ra, alako won xa fe ɲaaxi lu na, won xa ɲɛrɛ tinxinyi kui. A xa fie nan wo rayalanxi.

sentences.english: Because, like sheep, you had gone out of the way; but now you have come back to him who keeps watch over your souls.
sentences.susu: Wo nu luxi nɛ alɔ xuruse rabɛɲinxie, kɔnɔ yakɔsi wo bara gbilen wo kantama ma, naxan a ɲɔxɔ saxi wo nii xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Wives, be ruled by your husbands; so that even if some of them give no attention to the word, their hearts may be changed by the behaviour of their wives,
sentences.susu: Wo tan ginɛe, wo fan xa wo yɛtɛ magoro wo xa mɔrie bɛ, alako wo xa mɔri danxaniyataree xa nɔ danxaniyade wo tan e xa ginɛe wali ki saabui ra, hali wo mu sese fala e bɛ,

sentences.english: When they see your holy behaviour in the fear of God.
sentences.susu: e xa wo xa marasɛniyɛnyi nun yaragaaxui gbansan to.

sentences.english: Do not let your ornaments be those of the body such as dressing of the hair, or putting on of jewels of gold or fair clothing;
sentences.susu: Ginɛe, wo naxa kata wo yɛtɛ rayabude xunmasee ra, alɔ xun dɛnbɛ, tulirasoe xɛɛma daaxi, xa na mu dugi tofanyie.

sentences.english: But let them be those of the unseen man of the heart, the ever-shining ornament of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is of great price in the eyes of God.
sentences.susu: Ginɛe xa tofanyi xa findi bɔɲɛ fanyi nan na. Tofanyi nan na ki naxan mu kanama. Na nan tide gbo Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: And these were the ornaments of the holy women of the past, whose hope was in God, being ruled by their husbands:
sentences.susu: Singe ra ginɛ sɛniyɛnxie nu na ki nɛ. E xaxili nu tixi Ala ra, e e yɛtɛ magoroxi e xa mɔrie bɛ,

sentences.english: As Sarah was ruled by Abraham, naming him lord; whose children you are if you do well, and are not put in fear by any danger.
sentences.susu: alɔ Sara naxan nu Iburahima xui rabatuma, a nu fa a xili «n marigi». Wo findixi a tan nan bɔnsɔɛ ra, xa wo fe fanyi raba, wo mu tin gaaxui yo xa wo xaxili ya iso.

sentences.english: And you husbands, give thought to your way of life with your wives, giving honour to the woman who is the feebler vessel, but who has an equal part in the heritage of the grace of life; so that you may not be kept from prayer.
sentences.susu: Wo tan fan, xɛmɛe, wo nun wo xa ginɛe, wo xa lu lanyi kui. Wo xa wo bore fahaamu. Xɛmɛ xa a kolon a a sɛnbɛ gbo a xa ginɛ bɛ. Xɛmɛe xa ginɛe binya barima wo birin nan kɛ keren tongoma, naxan findi kisi ra, Ala naxan fima a xa fonisireya kui. Wo xa wo xa ginɛe binya, alako Ala xa wo xa maxandi suxu.

sentences.english: Last of all, see that you are all in agreement; feeling for one another, loving one another like brothers, full of pity, without pride:
sentences.susu: Wo xa lan wo bore ma, wo xa wo bore fahaamu. Ngaxakerenya xanunteya xa lu wo tagi. Wo kinikini wo bore ma, wo man xa wo yɛtɛ magoro wo bore bɛ.

sentences.english: Not giving back evil for evil, or curse for curse, but in place of cursing, blessing; because this is the purpose of God for you that you may have a heritage of blessing.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa fe ɲaaxi ɲɔxɔ fe ɲaaxi ra, wo naxa konbi ɲɔxɔ konbi ra. Wo lan nɛ wo xa duba wo bore bɛ, barima wo xilixi na nan ma, alako wo xa dubɛ sɔtɔ kɛ ra. A sɛbɛxi Kitaabui kui,

sentences.english: For it is said, Let the man who has a love of life, desiring to see good days, keep his tongue from evil and his lips from words of deceit:
sentences.susu: «Naxan wama simaya ɲɔxunmɛ xɔn ma, hɛɛri gbo naxan kui, na kanyi naxa fe kobi fala, wule naxa mini a dɛ kui.

sentences.english: And let him be turned from evil and do good; searching for peace and going after it with all his heart.
sentences.susu: A xa gbilen fe ɲaaxi fɔxɔ ra. A ɲɛrɛ ki xa fan. A xa bira bɔɲɛsa fɔxɔ ra tunnabɛxi kui,

sentences.english: For the eyes of the Lord are on the upright, and his ears are open to their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.
sentences.susu: barima Marigi ya tixi tinxintɔɛe nan na, a tuli matixi e xa maxandi ra. Kɔnɔ, a a kobe rasoxi nɛ fe kobi rabae tan na.»

sentences.english: Who will do you any damage if you keep your minds fixed on what is good?
sentences.susu: Nde nɔma wo tɔɔrɔde xa fe fanyi rabafe bara wo bɔɲɛ suxu?

sentences.english: But you are happy if you undergo pain because of righteousness; have no part in their fear and do not be troubled;
sentences.susu: Hali wo tɔɔrɔ tinxinyi xa fe ra, wo hɛɛri nan sɔtɔma. Wo naxa gaaxu fe ya ra duniɲa mixie gaaxuma naxan ya ra, wo bɔɲɛ naxa ifu.

sentences.english: But give honour to Christ in your hearts as your Lord; and be ready at any time when you are questioned about the hope which is in you, to give an answer in the fear of the Lord and without pride;
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo xa Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi findi wo Marigi ra wo bɔɲɛ kui. Wo xa fata a xa fe tagi rabade mixie bɛ wo laxi wo xa kisi ra fe naxan ma,

sentences.english: Being conscious that you have done no wrong; so that those who say evil things about your good way of life as Christians may be put to shame.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ wo xa na masenyi ti dɔyindɔyin binyɛ kui. Wo xa na raba bɔɲɛ fiixɛ ra alako wo yaxui naxee wo tɔɔɲɛgɛma Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa fe ra, e xa lu yaagi kui.

sentences.english: Because if it is God's purpose for you to undergo pain, it is better to do so for well-doing than for evil-doing.
sentences.susu: Xa Ala a ragirima, a fisa i xa tɔɔrɔ fe fanyi xa fe ra, dinɛ i xa tɔɔrɔ fe ɲaaxi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: Because Christ once went through pain for sins, the upright one taking the place of sinners, so that through him we might come back to God; being put to death in the flesh, but given life in the Spirit;
sentences.susu: Isa tinxintɔɛ fan faxa nɛ kerenyi ra tinxintaree xa yunubie xa fe ra, alako a xa wo maso Ala ra. E naxa a fate faxa, kɔnɔ Ala Xaxili naxa a nii ragbilen a ma.

sentences.english: By whom he went to the spirits in prison, preaching to those
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili siga nɛ kawandi tide mixie bɛ naxee nu na geeli kui laaxira, naxee singe nu bara tondi Ala xui ratinmɛde.

sentences.english: Who, in the days of Noah, went against God's orders; but God in his mercy kept back the punishment, while Noah got ready the ark, in which a small number, that is to say eight persons, got salvation through water:
sentences.susu: Ala nu na e mamɛfe Annabi Nuha nu kunkui banbanma tɛmui naxɛ. Mixi solomasaxan gbansan nan kisi kunkui kui ye ma.

sentences.english: And baptism, of which this is an image, now gives you salvation, not by washing clean the flesh, but by making you free from the sense of sin before God, through the coming again of Jesus Christ from the dead;
sentences.susu: Na fe bara findi misaali ra danxaniyatɔɛ xunxa fe ra, naxan mixi rakisima yi waxati Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa marakeli saabui ra. Na xunxafe ye xɔɔra, a mu nɔxɔɛ bama mixi fate, kɔnɔ a findima natɛ tongoe nan na Ala mabiri.

sentences.english: Who has gone into heaven, and is at the right hand of God, angels and authorities and powers having been put under his rule.
sentences.susu: Isa bara te Ala yirefanyi ma ariyanna. Malekɛe, ɲinnɛe, nun sɛnbɛmae birin na a xa yaamari bun ma.

sentences.english: So that as Jesus was put to death in the flesh, do you yourselves be of the same mind; for the death of the flesh puts an end to sin;
sentences.susu: Isa xa tɔɔrɛ duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari, a xa findi misaali ra wo bɛ, naxan a niyama wo xa limaniya. Danxaniyatɔɛ naxan fate ɲaxankatama, na bara yunubi fe lu na.

sentences.english: So that you may give the rest of your lives in the flesh, not to the desires of men, but to the purpose of God.
sentences.susu: Na kui, a bara duniɲa waxɔnfe lu na, a xa bira Ala waxɔnfe fɔxɔ ra a xa simaya kui naxan luxi.

sentences.english: Because for long enough, in times past, we have been living after the way of the Gentiles, given up to the desires of the flesh, to drinking and feasting and loose behaviour and unclean worship of images;
sentences.susu: Wo tɛmui naxan nabaxi duniɲa waxɔnfe fɔxɔ ra, na bara wasakɛ. Wo bara bu duniɲa fe kobi kui alɔ yɛnɛ rabafe, siisife, xulunyi ɲaaxi, beere minfe, nun kuye batufe, naxan findixi fe ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: And they are wondering that you no longer go with them in this violent wasting of life, and are saying evil things of you:
sentences.susu: Duniɲa mixie dɛ bara ixara, barima wo mu birama e fɔxɔ ra sɔnɔn na duniɲa fee rabade. Na kui, e wo xili kanama,

sentences.english: But they will have to give an account of themselves to him who is ready to be the judge of the living and the dead.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ e dɛntɛgɛ sama nɛ kiitisa bɛ, naxan fama mixi baloxie nun faxamixie makiitide.

sentences.english: For this was the reason why the good news of Jesus was given even to the dead, so that they might be judged as men in the flesh, but might be living before God in the spirit.
sentences.susu: Na nan a ra, Ala xa xibaaru fanyi naxa iba faxamixie fan bɛ, alako Ala xa e nii rakisi, hali mixie to bara gɛ e fate tan makiitide.

sentences.english: But the end of all things is near: so be serious in your behaviour and keep on the watch with prayer;
sentences.susu: Lɔxɔ dɔnxɔɛ bara makɔrɛ. Wo xa wo xaxili raxara, wo xa wo yɛtɛ suxu, alako wo xa nɔ Ala maxandide.

sentences.english: And most of all be warm in your love for one another; because in love there is forgiveness for sins without number:
sentences.susu: A gbengbenyi wo xa wo bore xanu a fanyi ra, barima xanunteya yunubi gbegbe nan makotoma.

sentences.english: Keep open house for all with a glad heart;
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo bore rasɛnɛ bɔɲɛ fanyi ra, hali wo mu a findi wɔyɛn xunxuri ra.

sentences.english: Making distribution among one another of whatever has been given to you, like true servants of the unmeasured grace of God;
sentences.susu: Ala hinnɛxi wo ra ki naxɛ, wo fan xa hinnɛ wo bore ra na ki nɛ, alako wo xa findi Ala xa walikɛ fanyie ra, naxee a xa hinnɛ itaxunma.

sentences.english: If anyone has anything to say, let it be as the words of God; if anyone has the desire to be the servant of others, let him do it in the strength which is given by God; so that in all things God may have the glory through Jesus Christ, whose are the glory and the power for ever.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi wama masenyi nde tife, a xa Ala xa masenyi ti. Xa mixi wama a boore malife, a xa na raba Ala sɛnbɛ ra, alako Ala xa matɔxɔɛ sɔtɔ a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa saabui ra. Matɔxɔɛ nun sɛnbɛ na a bɛ abadan. Amina.

sentences.english: Dear brothers, do not be surprised, as if it was something strange, if your faith is tested as by fire:
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie, na ɲaxankatɛ naxa wo tɛrɛnna, wo naxan tofe. Fe nɛɛnɛ mu a ra.

sentences.english: But be glad that you are given a part in the pains of Christ; so that at the revelation of his glory you may have great joy.
sentences.susu: Tɔɔrɔfe alɔ Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi tɔɔrɔ ki naxɛ, na xa findi sɛɛwɛ ra wo bɛ, alako wo man xa ɲɛlɛxin a xa nɔrɛ masen lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: If men say evil things of you because of the name of Christ, happy are you; for the Spirit of glory and of God is resting on you.
sentences.susu: Xa e wo konbi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xili xa fe ra, hɛɛri na wo bɛ, barima Ala Xaxili nɔrɔxi na wo ma.

sentences.english: Let no one among you undergo punishment as a taker of life, or as a thief, or as an evil-doer, or as one who is over-interested in other men's business;
sentences.susu: Wo naxa ɲaxankatɛ sɔtɔ nii bafe ma, muɲɛ tife ma, fe kobi rabafe ma, xa na mu a ra naafixiya ma.

sentences.english: But if he undergoes punishment as a Christian, that is no shame to him; let him give glory to God in this name.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa wo ɲaxankatɛ sɔtɔ barima Isayankae nan wo ra, wo naxa yaagi, wo xa Ala matɔxɔ Isayanka xili xa fe ra.

sentences.english: For the time has come for the judging, starting with the church of God; but if it makes a start with us, what will be the end of those who are not under the rule of God?
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ waxati bara wa fɔlɔfe Ala xa ɲama ma. Xa a fɔlɔ won tan ma, a raɲɔnma danxaniyataree ma di?

sentences.english: And if it is hard for even the good man to get salvation, what chance has the man without religion or the sinner?
sentences.susu: «Xa tinxintɔɛ kisife xɔrɔxɔ, Ala kolontare nun yunubitɔɛ tan luma di?»

sentences.english: For this reason let those who by the purpose of God undergo punishment, keep on in well-doing and put their souls into the safe hands of their Maker.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee ɲaxankatama, barima e na Ala waxɔnfe rabafe, e xa e xaxili ti e Daali Mangɛ ra naxan xa lanlanteya mu kanama.

sentences.english: I who am myself one of the rulers of the church, and a witness of the death of Christ, having my part in the coming glory, send this serious request to the chief men among you:
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛ kuntigie, n bara wo ralimaniya. Kuntigi nan n fan na alɔ wo tan. N seedeɲɔxɔya bama Isa xa tɔɔrɛ xa fe ra. Isa na fa a xa nɔrɛ masende duniɲa bɛ, n fan a sɔtɔma nɛ.

sentences.english: Keep watch over the flock of God which is in your care, using your authority, not as forced to do so, but gladly; and not for unclean profit but with a ready mind;
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo ɲɛngi sa Ala xa ɲama xɔn ma naxan na wo xa kantari bun ma, alɔ xuruse kantɛ mɛɛnima a xa gɔɔrɛ ma ki naxɛ. Wo xa danxaniyatɔɛe danxun wo ɲanige ra alɔ Ala wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ. Wo naxa na raba alɔ e na wo karaxan. Wo naxa a raba kɔbiri geeni xa fe ra, wo xa a raba wo bɔɲɛ birin na.

sentences.english: Not as lords over God's heritage, but making yourselves examples to the flock.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa danxaniyatɔɛe yamari a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra, naxee bara taxu wo ra. Wo xa findi misaali ra e bɛ.

sentences.english: And at the coming of the chief Keeper of the sheep, you will be given the eternal crown of glory.
sentences.susu: Xuruse kantama xungbe na fa, a wo binyama nɔrɛ ra naxan mu masarama.

sentences.english: And in the same way, let the younger men be ruled by the older ones. Let all of you put away pride and make yourselves ready to be servants: for God is a hater of pride, but he gives grace to those who make themselves low.
sentences.susu: Fonikee, wo fan xa wo yɛtɛ magoro forie bɛ. Wo xa wo yɛtɛ magoro wo bore bɛ, barima a sɛbɛxi, «Ala yɛtɛ igboe gerema nɛ, kɔnɔ a hinnɛma yɛtɛ magoree ra.»

sentences.english: For this cause make yourselves low under the strong hand of God, so that when the time comes you may be lifted up;
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo yɛtɛ magoro Ala sɛnbɛ bun ma, alako a xa wo xa fe ite a waxati.

sentences.english: Putting all your troubles on him, for he takes care of you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo xa kɔntɔfili birin so a yi ra, barima a ɲɛngi sama wo xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Be serious and keep watch; the Evil One, who is against you, goes about like a lion with open mouth in search of food;
sentences.susu: Wo wo ɲɔxɔ sa wo yɛtɛ xɔn ma. Wo naxa yanfa. Wo yaxui Ibulisa na fe birin nabafe alako a xa wo xa fe kana. A luxi alɔ yɛtɛ naxan mixi fenfe a xa a don.

sentences.english: Do not give way to him but be strong in your faith, in the knowledge that your brothers who are in the world undergo the same troubles.
sentences.susu: Wo ti a kanke i wo sabatixi ra wo xa danxaniya kui. Wo a kolon a Sentanɛ danxaniyatɔɛ birin tɔɔrɔfe na ki nɛ duniɲa kui.

sentences.english: And after you have undergone pain for a little time, the God of all grace who has given you a part in his eternal glory through Christ Jesus, will himself give you strength and support, and make you complete in every good thing;
sentences.susu: Wo na gɛ tɔɔrɔde dondoronti, Ala hinnɛnte fama wo xa fe yailande, a wo ralimaniya, a sɛnbɛ so wo yi naxan mu kanama. Ala wo xilixi nɛ a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa saabui ra wo xa lu a xa nɔrɛ bun ma abadan.

sentences.english: His is the power for ever. So be it.
sentences.susu: Sɛnbɛ na Ala nan bɛ abadan. Amina.

sentences.english: I have sent you this short letter by Silvanus, a true brother, in my opinion; comforting you and witnessing that this is the true grace of God; keep to it.
sentences.susu: N bara yi bataaxɛ sɛbɛ wo ma, n ngaxakerenyi duluxɔtɔxi Silasi saabui ra, alako n xa wo ralimaniya, n xa seedeɲɔxɔya ba a wo na Ala xa hinnɛ yati nan bun ma.

sentences.english: She who is in Babylon, who has a part with you in the purpose of God, sends you her love; and so does my son Mark.
sentences.susu: Isayanka naxee na Babilɔn, Ala naxee sugandixi alɔ wo tan, nee bara wo xɛɛbu, a nun n ma di Maraki.

sentences.english: Give one another the kiss of love. Peace be to you all in Christ.
sentences.susu: Wo wo bore xɛɛbu xanunteya sunbui ra. Ala xa wo bɔɲɛ sa, wo tan naxee na Isa fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Simon Peter, a servant and Apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who with us have a part in the same holy faith in the righteousness of our God and Saviour Jesus Christ:
sentences.susu: N tan, Simon Piyɛri, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa konyi nun a xa xɛɛra, n bara yi bataaxɛ sɛbɛ wo ma. Won tan naxee bara danxaniya Isa ma, won birin bara danxaniya keren sɔtɔ won Marigi Ala nun won Nakisima Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa tinxinyi saabui ra.

sentences.english: May grace and peace ever be increasing in you, in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord;
sentences.susu: Ala xa hinnɛ nun bɔɲɛsa gbegbe fi wo ma Ala nun won Marigi Isa kolonfe saabui ra.

sentences.english: Because by his power he has given us everything necessary for life and righteousness, through the knowledge of him who has been our guide by his glory and virtue;
sentences.susu: Won to bara Ala kolon, naxan won xilixi a xa nɔrɛ nun a xa fanyi saabui ra, a bara fe birin so won yi a sɛnbɛ ra, won hayi na naxan ma ɲɛrɛfe ra a waxɔnki.

sentences.english: And through this he has given us the hope of great rewards highly to be valued; so that by them we might have our part in God's being, and be made free from the destruction which is in the world through the desires of the flesh.
sentences.susu: Ala xa nɔrɛ nun a xa fanyi bara a niya won xa fe laayidixi sɔtɔ naxan maniyɛ mu na, a falafe ra a won xa won gi fe ɲaaxie ma duniɲa ma, naxee fatanxi mixi waxɔnfe kobi ra, won fa lu Ala xa nɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: So, for this very cause, take every care; joining virtue to faith, and knowledge to virtue,
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo xa katɛ birin naba ɲɛrɛ ki fanyi xa sa wo xa danxaniya xun ma, Ala kolonfe xa sa wo ɲɛrɛ ki fanyi xun ma,

sentences.english: And self-control to knowledge, and a quiet mind to self-control, and fear of God to a quiet mind,
sentences.susu: wo xa yɛtɛ suxui xa sa Ala kolonfe xun ma, wo xa tunnabɛxi xa sa wo xa yɛtɛ suxui xun ma, wo xa Ala yaragaaxui xa sa wo xa tunnabɛxi xun ma,

sentences.english: And love of the brothers to fear of God, and to love of the brothers, love itself.
sentences.susu: ngaxakerenya xa sa wo xa Ala yaragaaxui xun ma, xanunteya fan xa sa wo xa ngaxakerenya xun ma.

sentences.english: For if you have these things in good measure, they will make you fertile and full of fruit in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Xa na fe mɔɔli xun luma masa ra wo bɛ, na a niyama nɛ wo xa nɔ walide Marigi Isa bɛ, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, na man a niya wo xa nɔ a kolonde a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: For the man who has not these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having no memory of how he was made clean from his old sins.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xa na mu a ra, wo bara nɛɛmu Ala wo xa yunubi dangixie xafarixi ki naxɛ. Na kui, wo bara lu alɔ dɔnxui naxan mu se igbɛma a fanyi ra.

sentences.english: For this reason, my brothers, take all the more care to make your selection and approval certain; for if you do these things you will never have a fall:
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, Ala bara wo xili, a bara wo sugandi. Wo katɛ birin naba alako wo xa danxaniya xa sabati. Xa wo na raba, wo mu birama abadan.

sentences.english: For so the way will be open to you into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Na kui, Ala wo rasɛnɛma nɛ a fanyi ra a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa mangɛya niini bun ma, naxan findixi won Marigi nun won Nakisima ra.

sentences.english: For this reason I will be ready at all times to keep your memory of these things awake, though you have the knowledge of them now and are well based in your present faith.
sentences.susu: N mu taganma wo ratufe ra na fe ma, hali wo to nɔndi kolon, a man sabatixi wo bɔɲɛ i.

sentences.english: And it seems right to me, as long as I am in this tent of flesh, to keep your minds awake by working on your memory;
sentences.susu: Fanni n na duniɲa, a lanma n xa nu wo ratu na fee ra,

sentences.english: For I am conscious that in a short time I will have to put off this tent of flesh, as our Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me.
sentences.susu: barima won Marigi Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi bara a masen n bɛ n mu buma duniɲa ma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And I will take every care so that you may have a clear memory of these things after my death.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ n katɛ birin nabama nɛ, alako n na keli wo xun ma lɔxɔ naxɛ, wo xa nɔ ratude na fee ma tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: For when we gave you news of the power and the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, our teaching was not based on stories put together by art, but we were eye-witnesses of his glory.
sentences.susu: Muxu to won Marigi Isa sɛnbɛ nun a fa ki masen wo bɛ, a mu findixi kiini madɔxɔxi xa ra. Muxu naxan masen wo bɛ Isa xa nɔrɛ xa fe ra, a findixi nɔndi yati yati nan na, muxu naxan toxi muxu ya ra.

sentences.english: For God the Father gave him honour and glory, when such a voice came to him out of the great glory, saying, This is my dearly loved Son, with whom I am well pleased.
sentences.susu: Baba Ala Nɔrɛ Xungbe Kanyi bara a binya, a xunnakeli fi a ma yi masenyi ra, «N ma Di xanuxi nan yi ki, n sɛɛwaxi naxan na.»

sentences.english: And this voice came from heaven even to our ears, when we were with him on the holy mountain.
sentences.susu: Muxu na xui mɛ nɛ, naxan keli koore ma, muxu to nu na a sɛɛti ma geya sɛniyɛnxi fari.

sentences.english: And so the words of the prophets are made more certain; and it is well for you to give attention to them as to a light shining in a dark place, till the dawn comes and the morning star is seen in your hearts;
sentences.susu: Muxu a kolon namiɲɔnmɛe xa masenyie findixi nɔndi yati nan na. Wo lan wo xa wo ɲɔxɔ sa na xɔn ma a fanyi ra, alɔ mixi a ɲɔxɔ sama lanpui xa yanbɛ xɔn ma ki naxɛ kɔɛ ra han subaxɛ. Wo na na masenyi fahaamu wo bɔɲɛ kui, na luma nɛ alɔ looloe xa naiyalanyi naxan makɛnɛnma subaxɛ ma.

sentences.english: Being conscious in the first place that no man by himself may give a special sense to the words of the prophets.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon a fanyi ra a namiɲɔnmɛ yo xa sɛbɛli mu fatanxi a yɛtɛ ra.

sentences.english: For these words did not ever come through the impulse of men: but the prophets had them from God, being moved by the Holy Spirit.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛ xa masenyi mu fatanxi adamadi ɲanige xa ra, a fatanxi Ala Xaxili yati nan na, naxan na masen namiɲɔnmɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: But there were false prophets among the people, as there will be false teachers among you, who will secretly put forward wrong teachings for your destruction, even turning away from the Lord who gave himself for them; whose destruction will come quickly, and they themselves will be the cause of it.
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee nu na Isirayila ɲama ya ma, naxee nu a falama e yɛtɛ bɛ, a namiɲɔnmɛe, kɔnɔ wule falɛe nan nu nee ra. Karamɔxɔ wule falɛe fama lude wo fan ya ma, naxee xa xaranyi mixi ralɔɛma. Na kui, na wule falɛe bara e Marigi rabolo, naxan e xunsaraxi. Na fe bara e xun nakana.

sentences.english: And a great number will go with them in their evil ways, through whom the true way will have a bad name.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe birama nɛ e fɔxɔ ra e xa fe ɲaaxi kui. Ala xa nɔndi maberema nɛ e tan xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And in their desire for profit they will come to you with words of deceit, like traders doing business in souls: whose punishment has been ready for a long time and their destruction is watching for them.
sentences.susu: E wo madaxuma wulee ra e xa milanteya xa fe ra, kɔnɔ kiiti dɔxɔxi e ya ra a rakuya. E xa xunnakanɛ mu kanama.

sentences.english: For if God did not have pity for the angels who did evil, but sent them down into hell, to be kept in chains of eternal night till they were judged;
sentences.susu: Malekɛe to yunubi raba, Ala mu diɲɛ e ma de! A naxa e woli yahannama, a yɔlɔnxɔnyie sa e ma na dimi kui beenun kiiti lɔxɔɛ xa a li.

sentences.english: And did not have mercy on the world which then was, but only kept safe Noah, a preacher of righteousness, with seven others, when he let loose the waters over the world of the evil-doers;
sentences.susu: Ala mu diɲɛ duniɲa ma Annabi Nuha xa waxati, a kaafirie sɔntɔ nɛ banbaranyi ra. Kɔnɔ a naxa Nuha rakisi, naxan nu tinxinyi kawandima, a nun a xa mixi solofere.

sentences.english: And sent destruction on Sodom and Gomorrah, burning them up with fire as an example to those whose way of life might in the future be unpleasing to him;
sentences.susu: Ala Sodoma nun Gomora ratɔn nɛ, a e birin gan, e xa findi misaali ra mixi kobie bɛ.

sentences.english: And kept safe Lot, the upright man, who was deeply troubled by the unclean life of the evil-doers
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a naxa Loti ratanga na gbaloe ma. Loti findixi tinxintɔɛ nan na, naxan bɔɲɛ nu bara raɲaaxu a ma na mixi ɲaaxie xa wali kobie xa fe ra.

sentences.english: (Because the soul of that upright man living among them was pained from day to day by seeing and hearing their crimes):
sentences.susu: Yi mixi tinxinxi nu sabatixi e tagi, a bɔɲɛ raɲaaxuxi a ma tɛmui birin e xa ɲaaxuɲa xa fe ra.

sentences.english: The Lord is able to keep the upright safe in the time of testing, and to keep evil-doers under punishment till the day of judging;
sentences.susu: Na nan a masenxi, a won Marigi fata mixi fanyi fulunde fe xɔrɔxɔɛ kui, a man fata tinxintaree ragatade han kiiti lɔxɔɛ na fa tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: But specially those who go after the unclean desires of the flesh, and make sport of authority. Ready to take chances, uncontrolled, they have no fear of saying evil of those in high places:
sentences.susu: A gbengbenyi, a yi rabama mixie nan na naxee biraxi e waxɔnfe ɲaaxi tun fɔxɔ ra, e fa Marigi xa mangɛya matandi. Nee e yɛtɛ igboma. E suusa ariyannakae rasɔtɔde.

sentences.english: Though the angels, who are greater in strength and power, do not make use of violent language against them before the Lord.
sentences.susu: Hali malekɛe, naxee sɛnbɛ gbo e bɛ, nee mu suusa adamadie rasɔtɔde Marigi ya xɔri.

sentences.english: But these men, like beasts without reason, whose natural use is to be taken and put to death, crying out against things of which they have no knowledge, will undergo that same destruction which they are designing for others;
sentences.susu: Na xurutaree luxi alɔ wula sube naxee xaxili mu na, naxee suxuma, e faxa. E konbi tima fee ma, e mu naxee kolon. E xa fe raɲɔnma nɛ alɔ na wula sube naxee xaxili mu na.

sentences.english: For the evil which overtakes them is the reward of their evil-doing: such men take their pleasure in the delights of the flesh even in the daytime; they are like the marks of a disease, like poisoned wounds among you, feasting together with you in joy;
sentences.susu: E tinxintareya sare nan sɔtɔma. E ɲɛlɛxinma wanduya rabafe ra yanyi xare ra. E luma nɛ wo xa xulunyie ya ma alɔ nɔxɔɛ na sa se sɛniyɛnxi ma. E ɲɛlɛxinma nɛ wo ratantanfe ra.

sentences.english: Having eyes full of evil desire, never having enough of sin; turning feeble souls out of the true way; they are children of cursing, whose hearts are well used to bitter envy;
sentences.susu: E yɛnɛ rabama tɛmui birin. E mu taganma yunubi rabade. E mixie madaxuma naxee xa danxaniya mu sabatixi. Milanteya na e bɔɲɛ kui. E birin dankaxi.

sentences.english: Turning out of the true way, they have gone wandering in error, after the way of Balaam, the son of Beor, who was pleased to take payment for wrongdoing;
sentences.susu: E bara kira tinxinxi bɛɲin, e fa bira Beyori xa di Balami xa kira fɔxɔ ra, naxan nu wama wali tinxintare sare xɔn ma.

sentences.english: But his wrongdoing was pointed out to him: an ass, talking with a man's voice, put a stop to the error of the prophet.
sentences.susu: Ala naxa a xa yunubi masen a bɛ a xa sofale saabui ra naxan wɔyɛn adamadi xui ra, a fa Annabi Balami xa daxuɲa iti.

sentences.english: These are fountains without water, and mists before a driving storm; for whom the eternal night is kept in store.
sentences.susu: Na mixie luxi nɛ alɔ tigie ye mu na naxee kui. E luxi nɛ alɔ nuxuie, turunnaadɛ naxee tutunma. Dimi nan dɔxɔxi e ya ra.

sentences.english: For with high-sounding false words, making use of the attraction of unclean desires of the flesh, they get into their power those newly made free from those who are living in error;
sentences.susu: E wɔyɛn xungbe nan falama naxan tide yo mu na, e e yɛtɛ igboma, e mixie madaxuma fe sɛniyɛntaree ra, mixi naxee baxi bade yunubitɔɛe ya ma.

sentences.english: Saying that they will be free, while they themselves are the servants of destruction; because whatever gets the better of a man makes a servant of him.
sentences.susu: E xɔrɛya laayidi mixie bɛ, kɔnɔ e yɛtɛ kan findixi duniɲa xa konyie ra, barima e mu nɔma e yɛtɛ bade e waxɔnfe ɲaaxie yi ra naxee fama e xun nakanade. Mixi naxan birin luma a waxɔnfe ɲaaxi xa nɔɛ bun ma, a bara findi a waxɔnfe ɲaaxi xa konyi ra.

sentences.english: For if, after they have got free from the unclean things of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ, they are again taken in the net and overcome, their last condition is worse than their first.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi bara ba duniɲa fe kobie ya ma Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa kolonfe saabui ra, won Nakisima nun won Marigi, e man gbilen na fee ma, han nee man nɔ e ra, awa e xa tɔɔrɛ dangima a singe ra.

sentences.english: For it would have been better for them to have had no knowledge of the way of righteousness, than to go back again from the holy law which was given to them, after having knowledge of it.
sentences.susu: E lufe e mu tinxinyi kira kolon, na fisa e bɛ, dinɛ e xa na kira kolon, e fa e kobe so sɛriyɛ sɛniyɛnxi ra, naxan nu bara fi e ma.

sentences.english: They are an example of that true saying, The dog has gone back to the food it had put out, and the pig which had been washed to its rolling in the dirty earth.
sentences.susu: Yi taali e xa fe masenma a fanyi ra: «Bare bara a xa bɔxunyi don. Xɔsɛ maxaxi, a man bara a yɛtɛ manɔxɔ.»

sentences.english: My loved ones, this is now my second letter to you, and in this as in the first, I am attempting to keep your true minds awake;
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie, n ma bataaxɛ firin nde nan yi ki, n naxan sɛbɛ wo ma. N bara wa xaxili fanyi fife wo ma yi bataaxɛe saabui ra, naxee wo ratuma na xaranyi ra wo naxan sɔtɔxi tɛmui dangixi.

sentences.english: So that you may keep in mind the words of the holy prophets in the past, and the law of the Lord and Saviour which was given to you by his Apostles.
sentences.susu: N man bara wa wo ratufe namiɲɔnmɛ sɛniyɛnxi singee xa masenyi ma, a nun won Marigi nun won Nakisima xa yaamari ma, a xa xɛɛrae naxan nadangixi wo ma.

sentences.english: Having first of all the knowledge that in the last days there will be men who, ruled by their evil desires, will make sport of holy things,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a gbengbenyi, wo xa a kolon a mixie fama nɛ duniɲa raɲɔnyi, naxee yoma mixie ma, e bira e yɛtɛ waxɔnfe fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: Saying, Where is the hope of his coming? From the death of the fathers till now everything has gone on as it was from the making of the world.
sentences.susu: E a falama nɛ, «Isa bara a xa laayidi kana, barima han ya a mu gbilen duniɲa ma alɔ a a fala ki naxɛ. Kafi won benbae faxa, duniɲa luxi alɔ a fɔlɛ.»

sentences.english: But in taking this view they put out of their minds the memory that in the old days there was a heaven, and an earth lifted out of the water and circled by water, by the word of God;
sentences.susu: Na mixie bara nɛɛmu a Ala koore nun bɔxi daaxi a xa masenyi nan na. A fɔlɛ ra, Ala xa masenyi nan a ragiri bɔxi xa maba ye xɔɔra.

sentences.english: And that the world which then was came to an end through the overflowing of the waters.
sentences.susu: Ala xa masenyi man naxa a ragiri ye xa din duniɲa ma Annabi Nuha xa waxati.

sentences.english: But the present heaven and the present earth have been kept for destruction by fire, which is waiting for them on the day of the judging and destruction of evil men.
sentences.susu: Na masenyi kerenyi man fama nɛ a ragiride koore nun bɔxi xa gan kiiti lɔxɔɛ, tinxintaree ɲaxankatama tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: But, my loved ones, keep in mind this one thing, that with the Lord one day is the same as a thousand years, and a thousand years are no more than one day.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ, n xanuntenyie, wo naxa nɛɛmu fe keren ma: Won Marigi tan bɛ, lɔxɔɛ keren luxi nɛ alɔ ɲɛ wulu keren, ɲɛ wulu keren fan luxi nɛ alɔ lɔxɔɛ keren.

sentences.english: The Lord is not slow in keeping his word, as he seems to some, but he is waiting in mercy for you, not desiring the destruction of any, but that all may be turned from their evil ways.
sentences.susu: Marigi mu dugundima a xa laayidi rakamalide, alɔ mixi ndee a maɲɔxunma ki naxɛ. A xa diɲɛ gbo wo mabiri, barima a mu wama mixi keren xa lɔɛ. A wama nɛ duniɲa mixi birin xa tuubi.

sentences.english: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief; and in that day the heavens will be rolled up with a great noise, and the substance of the earth will be changed by violent heat, and the world and everything in it will be burned up.
sentences.susu: Marigi fa lɔxɔɛ findima tɛrɛnna nan na mixie bɛ. Na lɔxɔɛ koore lɔɛma nɛ xui magaaxuxi ra, duniɲa birin ganma nɛ, adamadie xa wali nan tun luma Ala ya i.

sentences.english: Seeing then that all these things are coming to such an end, what sort of persons is it right for you to be, in all holy behaviour and righteousness,
sentences.susu: Wo to a kolon duniɲa ɲɔnma na ki nɛ, a lanma wo xa ɲɛrɛ Ala waxɔnyi ra sɛniyɛnyi kui.

sentences.english: Looking for and truly desiring the coming of the day of God, when the heavens will come to an end through fire, and the substance of the earth will be changed by the great heat?
sentences.susu: Wo mamɛ tima ki naxɛ, a xa a niya na lɔxɔɛ xa fa sinnanyi ma. Na lɔxɔɛ koore nun bɔxi ganma nɛ tɛ ra, e fa xunu.

sentences.english: But having faith in his word, we are looking for a new heaven and a new earth, which will be the resting-place of righteousness.
sentences.susu: Won koore nɛɛnɛ nun bɔxi nɛɛnɛ nan mamɛfe, tinxinyi sabatima dɛnnaxɛ, alɔ a laayidixi won bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For this reason, my loved ones, as you are looking for these things, take great care that when he comes you may be in peace before him, free from sin and every evil thing.
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie, wo xa katɛ birin naba na mamɛ ti kui, alako na lɔxɔɛ xa wo li bɔɲɛsa kui, a naxa wo li fe ɲaaxi kui.

sentences.english: And be certain that the long waiting of the Lord is for salvation; even as our brother Paul has said in his letters to you, from the wisdom which was given to him;
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon a won Marigi xa diɲɛ findixi kisi nan na wo bɛ, alɔ won xanuntenyi Pɔlu fan a sɛbɛxi wo ma ki naxɛ. Ala yati nan na lɔnni fixi a ma.

sentences.english: And as he said in all his letters, which had to do with these things; in which are some hard sayings, so that, like the rest of the holy Writings, they are twisted by those who are uncertain and without knowledge, to the destruction of their souls.
sentences.susu: A na nan masenma a xa bataaxɛ birin kui. A xa sɛbɛli ndee fahaamu xɔnɔ. Xaxilitaree, naxee xa danxaniya mu raxaraxi, e na sɛbɛlie mafindima e waxɔnki. E na mɔɔli rabama Kitaabui gbɛtɛe ra, kɔnɔ na fe fama e ralɔɛde.

sentences.english: For this reason, my loved ones, having knowledge of these things before they take place, take care that you are not turned away by the error of the uncontrolled, so falling from your true faith.
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie, wo to bara na birin kolon, wo xa wo ɲɔxɔ sa wo yɛtɛ xɔn ma, alako kaafirie naxa wo ba wo xa danxaniya sabatixi kui.

sentences.english: But be increased in grace and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ. May he have glory now and for ever. So be it.
sentences.susu: Wo xa sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ won Marigi nun won Nakisima Isa xa hinnɛ nun a kolonfe saabui ra. Tantui na Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa bɛ abadan. Amina.

sentences.english: That which was from the first, which has come to our ears, and which we have seen with our eyes, looking on it and touching it with our hands, about the Word of life
sentences.susu: Kisi masenyi, naxan nu na kabi a fɔlɛ, muxu tuli naxan mɛxi, muxu ya naxan toxi, muxu bɛlɛxɛ naxan masuxuxi, muxu bara na seede ba.

sentences.english: (And the life was made clear to us, and we have seen it and are witnessing to it and giving you word of that eternal life which was with the Father and was seen by us);
sentences.susu: Naxan na kisi ra, na bara a yɛtɛ masen. Muxu bara a to, muxu bara na kisi xa fe kawandi ti, naxan mu ɲɔnma abadan, naxan nu na Baba Ala fɛ ma, beenun a xa a yɛtɛ masen muxu bɛ.

sentences.english: We give you word of all we have seen and everything which has come to our ears, so that you may be united with us; and we are united with the Father and with his Son Jesus Christ:
sentences.susu: Muxu naxan toxi, muxu naxan mɛxi, muxu wo fan kawandife na nan na, alako won birin xa lu lanyi kui, won nun Baba Ala nun a xa Di Isa, a xa Mixi Sugandixi.

sentences.english: And we are writing these things to you so that our joy may be made complete.
sentences.susu: Muxu yi fe sɛbɛfe nɛ wo ma, alako muxu xa sɛɛwɛ xa kamali.

sentences.english: This is the word which came to us from him and which we give to you, that God is light and in him there is nothing dark.
sentences.susu: Muxu naxan mɛxi Isa ra, muxu xa na dɛntɛgɛ sa wo bɛ. Ala findixi naiyalanyi nan na. Dimi yo mu na a i.

sentences.english: If we say we are joined to him, and are walking still in the dark, our words are false and our acts are untrue:
sentences.susu: Xa won a fala won nun Ala na a ra, kɔnɔ won ɲɛrɛma dimi kui, won bara wule fala, won mu ɲɛrɛfe nɔndi kira xɔn ma.

sentences.english: But if we are walking in the light, as he is in the light, we are all united with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son makes us clean from all sin.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ, xa won ɲɛrɛma naiyalanyi kui Ala xa kira xɔn, won nun danxaniyatɔɛe nan luma lanyi kui. Ala xa Di Isa wuli nan won nasɛniyɛnma yunubi birin ma.

sentences.english: If we say that we have no sin, we are false to ourselves and there is nothing true in us.
sentences.susu: Xa won a fala yunubi yo mu na won ma, won bara won yɛtɛ madaxu, nɔndi yo mu na won bɛ.

sentences.english: If we say openly that we have done wrong, he is upright and true to his word, giving us forgiveness of sins and making us clean from all evil.
sentences.susu: Xa won na won ti won ma yunubie ra, Ala e xafarima nɛ, a won nasɛniyɛn won ma tinxintareya ma. Ala tinxin, won nɔma won xaxili tide a ra.

sentences.english: If we say that we have no sin, we make him false and his word is not in us.
sentences.susu: Xa won a fala yunubi yo mu na won ma, won bara Ala findi wule falɛ ra, a xa masenyi mu na won bɔɲɛ kui.

sentences.english: My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you may be without sin. And if any man is a sinner, we have a friend and helper with the Father, Jesus Christ, the upright one:
sentences.susu: N ma die, n bara na birin sɛbɛ wo ma, alako wo naxa yunubi raba, kɔnɔ xa a sa li mixi nde naxa bira na kui, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa fama won xunmafalade Baba Ala bɛ. Isa tinxin.

sentences.english: He is the offering for our sins; and not for ours only, but for all the world.
sentences.susu: A tan nan findixi sɛrɛxɛ ra won ma yunubie xafarife ra. A mu won ma yunubie gbansan xafarixi, a na nan nabaxi duniɲa mixi birin bɛ.

sentences.english: And by this we may be certain that we have knowledge of him, if we keep his laws.
sentences.susu: Xa won sa Ala xa yaamarie rabatu, na nan a masenma a won Ala kolon.

sentences.english: The man who says, I have knowledge of him, and does not keep his laws, is false, and there is nothing true in him:
sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde a fala, «N tan Ala kolon», kɔnɔ a mu a xa yaamarie rabatuma, wule falɛ nan a ra, nɔndi mu na a bɛ.

sentences.english: But in every man who keeps his word, the love of God is made complete. By this we may be certain that we are in him:
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi naxan Ala xui suxuma, Ala xa xanunteya bara gɛ kamalide na kanyi bɛ. Na kui, won nɔma a kolonde won na Ala fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: He who says that he is living in him, will do as he did.
sentences.susu: Naxan yo a falama a nun Ala nan a ra, a lanma a xa a ɲɛrɛ Isa xa kira xɔn.

sentences.english: My loved ones, I do not give you a new law, but an old law which you had from the first; this old law is the word which came to your ears.
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie, n yaamari naxan masenma wo bɛ, fe nɛɛnɛ mu a ra. Wo a kolon kabi a fɔlɛ. Yaamari fori nan a ra, wo naxan singe mɛ nu.

sentences.english: Again, I give you a new law, which is true in him and in you; for the night is near its end and the true light is even now shining out.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ i man na mato n yaamari nɛɛnɛ nan sɛbɛfe wo ma. Nɔndi nan a ra naxan makɛnɛnxi Isa ɲɛrɛ ki kui a nun wo tan fan ɲɛrɛ ki kui, barima dimi na ɲɔnfe, Ala xa naiyalanyi laxixɛ bara mini fɔlɔ.

sentences.english: He who says that he is in the light, and has hate in his heart for his brother, is still in the dark.
sentences.susu: Naxan a falama a a na Ala xa naiyalanyi kui, kɔnɔ a a ngaxakerenyi xɔnxi, na kanyi man na dimi nan kui.

sentences.english: He who has love for his brother is in the light, and there is no cause of error in him.
sentences.susu: Naxan a ngaxakerenyi xanuma, na kanyi sabatixi Ala xa naiyalanyi nan kui, fefe mu na naxan a rabirama.

sentences.english: But he who has hate for his brother is in the dark, walking in the dark with no knowledge of where he is going, unable to see because of the dark.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ naxan a ngaxakerenyi xɔnma, na kanyi na dimi nan kui. A ɲɛrɛma dimi nan kui, a mu a sigade yati toma, barima dimi bara a ya dɔnxu.

sentences.english: I am writing to you, my children, because you have forgiveness of sins through his name.
sentences.susu: N ma die, n xa a masen wo bɛ yi sɛbɛli ra: Wo xa yunubie bara xafari Isa xili saabui ra.

sentences.english: I am writing to you, fathers, because you have knowledge of him who was from the first. I am writing to you, young men, because you have overcome the Evil One. I have sent a letter to you, children, because you have knowledge of the Father.
sentences.susu: Forie, n xa a masen wo bɛ yi sɛbɛli ra: Wo bara a kolon a tan naxan nu na kabi a fɔlɛ. Fonikee, n xa a masen wo bɛ yi sɛbɛli ra: Wo bara nɔ Sentanɛ ra.

sentences.english: I have sent a letter to you, fathers, because you have knowledge of him who was from the first. I have sent a letter to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God is in you, and because you have overcome the Evil One.
sentences.susu: N ma die, n bara na masen wo bɛ yi sɛbɛli ra, barima wo bara Baba Ala kolon. Forie, n bara na masen wo bɛ yi sɛbɛli ra, barima wo a kolon naxan na na kabi a fɔlɛ. Fonikee, n bara na masen wo bɛ yi sɛbɛli ra: barima wo sɛnbɛ gbo. Ala xa masenyi sabatixi wo bɔɲɛ kui. Wo bara nɔɛ sɔtɔ Sentanɛ xun ma.

sentences.english: Have no love for the world or for the things which are in the world. If any man has love for the world, the love of the Father is not in him.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa duniɲa fe xanu, xa na mu a ra wo mu nɔma Baba Ala xanude.

sentences.english: Because everything in the world, the desire of the flesh, the desire of the eyes, and the pride of life, is not of the Father but of the world.
sentences.susu: Naxan findixi duniɲa fe ra, alɔ ibunadama waxɔnfe kobi, milɛ, nun yɛtɛ igboɲa naxan kelixi see sɔtɔfe ma, na sese mu kelixi Baba Ala ma. A kelixi yi duniɲa nan ma.

sentences.english: And the world and its desires is coming to an end: but he who does God's pleasure is living for ever.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa nun a waxɔnfe ɲɔnma nɛ, kɔnɔ naxee Ala waxɔnfe rabama, e kisima nɛ abadan.

sentences.english: Little children, it is the last hour; and as you were given word that the Antichrist would come, so now a number of Antichrists have come to you; and by this we are certain that it is the last hour.
sentences.susu: N ma die, won na waxati dɔnxɔɛ nɛ yi ki. Wo bara a mɛ, a Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi yaxui nde na fafe. Wo bara a kolon a yaxui gbegbe bara fa. Won a kolon na nan ma a won na waxati dɔnxɔɛ nɛ yi ki.

sentences.english: They went out from us but they were not of us; if they had been of us they would still be with us: but they went out from us so that it might be made clear that they were not of us.
sentences.susu: Na mixie kelixi won tan nan xun ma, kɔnɔ won ngaxakerenyi mu nu e ra, xa na mu a ra e mu nu kelima won xun ma nu. Kɔnɔ e to mu tin lude won ya ma, e bara a masen a won ngaxakerenyie mu nu e ra.

sentences.english: And you have the Spirit from the Holy One and you all have knowledge.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Sɛniyɛntɔɛ bara wo sugandi, a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi fi wo ma. Na nan a toxi wo birin nɔndi kolonxi.

sentences.english: I have not sent you this letter because you have no knowledge of what is true, but because you have knowledge, and because that which is false has nothing in common with that which is true.
sentences.susu: N mu yi bataaxɛ sɛbɛxi wo ma wo xa nɔndi kolontareya xa ma. N a sɛbɛxi wo xa nɔndi kolonyi xa fe nan ma, wule yo mu na naxan kui.

sentences.english: Who is false but he who says that Jesus is not the Christ? He is the Antichrist who has no belief in the Father or the Son.
sentences.susu: Wule falɛ na nde ra? Naxan a falama a Isa mu findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra. Na kanyi bara findi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi yaxui ra. A bara tondi Baba Ala nun a xa Di ra.

sentences.english: He who has no belief in the Son has not the Father: he who makes clear his belief in the Son has the Father.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan tondima Ala xa Di ra, a bara tondi Baba Ala fan na. Naxan bara tin Ala xa Di ra, a bara tin Baba Ala fan na.

sentences.english: But as for you, keep in your hearts the things which were made clear to you from the first. If you keep these things in your hearts you will be kept in the Father and the Son.
sentences.susu: Wo masenyi naxan mɛ a fɔlɛ, wo xa na ragata wo bɔɲɛ ma. Xa a na na ki nɛ, a lima wo bara sabati Baba Ala xa Di nun Baba Ala i.

sentences.english: And this is the hope which he gave you, even eternal life.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi bara kisi laayidi tongo won bɛ, kisi naxan mu ɲɔnma abadan.

sentences.english: I am writing these things to you about those whose purpose is that you may be turned out of the true way.
sentences.susu: N bara yi bataaxɛ sɛbɛ wo ma mixi ndee nan ma fe ra naxee wama wo madaxufe.

sentences.english: As for you, the Spirit which he gave you is still in you, and you have no need of any teacher; but as his Spirit gives you teaching about all things, and is true and not false, so keep your hearts in him, through the teaching which he has given you.
sentences.susu: Ala bara a Xaxili fi wo ma, a na wo bɔɲɛ i. Wo hayi mu na karamɔxɔ gbɛtɛ ma. Ala Xaxili nan wo matinkanma nɔndi birin na. Wule yo mu na a xa masenyi kui. Wo xa bira a fɔxɔ ra tun.

sentences.english: And now, my children, keep your hearts in him; so that at his revelation, we may have no fear or shame before him at his coming.
sentences.susu: N ma die, wo nun Isa xa lu a ra, alako a na gbilen tɛmui naxɛ yaagi yo naxa won makuya a ra. Won xa la a ra tɛmui birin.

sentences.english: If you have knowledge that he is upright, it is clear to you that everyone who does righteousness is his offspring.
sentences.susu: Wo to a kolon a tinxin, wo xa a kolon fan a tinxintɔɛ birin fatanxi a tan nan na.

sentences.english: See what great love the Father has given us in naming us the children of God; and such we are. For this reason the world does not see who we are, because it did not see who he was.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a kolon, Baba Ala won xanuxi nɛ han a won xili «a xa die». Won findixi a xa die yati yati nan na. Duniɲa mu nɔma won kolonde na ra, barima e mu Ala kolon.

sentences.english: My loved ones, now we are children of God, and at present it is not clear what we are to be. We are certain that at his revelation we will be like him; for we will see him as he is.
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie, yakɔsi Ala xa die nan won na. A mu masenxi sinden won luma ki naxɛ, kɔnɔ won a kolon, a Isa na fa, won masarama nɛ, won fa lu alɔ a tan, barima won a toma nɛ a na ki naxɛ yati.

sentences.english: And everyone who has this hope in him makes himself holy, even as he is holy.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan a yigi tixi Isa ra, a a yɛtɛ rasɛniyɛnma, alɔ Isa sɛniyɛnxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: Everyone who is a sinner goes against the law, for sin is going against the law.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan yunubi rabama, a findixi sɛriyɛ matandila nan na, barima yunubi, sɛriyɛ matandi nan a ra.

sentences.english: And you have knowledge that he came to take away sin: and in him there is no sin.
sentences.susu: Wo a kolon a Isa fa won ma yunubi nan xafaride. Yunubi yo mu nu na a tan ma.

sentences.english: Anyone who is in him does no sin; anyone who is a sinner has not seen him and has no knowledge of him.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan sabatixi Isa i, na kanyi mu luma yunubi raba ra sɔnɔn. Naxan luma yunubi raba ra, na kanyi mu Isa toxi, a man mu a kolon.

sentences.english: My little children, let no man take you out of the true way: he who does righteousness is upright, even as he is upright;
sentences.susu: N ma die, mixi yo naxa wo madaxu. Mixi naxan tinxinyi rabama, a tinxin alɔ Marigi tinxinxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: The sinner is a child of the Evil One; for the Evil One has been a sinner from the first. And the Son of God was seen on earth so that he might put an end to the works of the Evil One.
sentences.susu: Yunubitɔɛ tan fatanxi Ibulisa nan na, barima Ibulisa nan yunubi raba kabi duniɲa fɔlɛ. Ala xa Di fa nɛ alako a xa Ibulisa xa wali kana.

sentences.english: Anyone who is a child of God does no sin, because he still has God's seed in him; he is not able to be a sinner, because God is his Father.
sentences.susu: Mixi yo findi Ala xa di ra, a mu luma yunubi raba ra, barima Ala bara wali nde fɔlɔ a bɔɲɛ kui. A mu nɔma lude yunubi kui, barima a fatanxi Ala nan na.

sentences.english: In this way it is clear who are the children of God and who are the children of the Evil One; anyone who does not do righteousness or who has no love for his brother, is not a child of God.
sentences.susu: Ala xa die nun Ibulisa xa die tagi rasama yi ki nɛ: Naxan mu tinxin, Ala xa di mu a ra. Naxan mu a boore adamadie xanuma, a mu Ala kolon.

sentences.english: Because this is the word which was given to you from the first, that we are to have love for one another;
sentences.susu: Masenyi nan ya wo naxan mɛxi kabi a fɔlɛ: Won xa won bore xanu.

sentences.english: Not being of the Evil One like Cain, who put his brother to death. And why did he put him to death? Because his works were evil and his brother's works were good.
sentences.susu: Won naxa lu alɔ Kabila, naxan fatan Sentanɛ ra, a fa a xunya yati faxa. A na raba munfe ra? A na raba nɛ barima a ɲɛrɛ ki mu nu gɛxi tinxinde alɔ a xunya ɲɛrɛ ki.

sentences.english: Do not be surprised, my brothers, if the world has no love for you.
sentences.susu: N ngaxakerenyie, wo naxa wo maɲin duniɲa xa xɔnnanteya xa fe ra wo mabiri.

sentences.english: We are conscious that we have come out of death into life because of our love for the brothers. He who has no love is still in death.
sentences.susu: Xanunteya naxan luma won bɔɲɛ kui won boore adamadie bɛ, a a masenma a won bara faxɛ kira lu na, won ti kisi kira xɔn ma. Xanunteyatare tan tixi faxɛ kira nan xɔn ma.

sentences.english: Anyone who has hate for his brother is a taker of life, and you may be certain that no taker of life has eternal life in him.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan a boore adamadi xɔnma, na kanyi luxi nɛ alɔ faxɛti. Wo a kolon a kisi mu na faxɛti bɛ.

sentences.english: In this we see what love is, because he gave his life for us; and it is right for us to give our lives for the brothers.
sentences.susu: Won xanunteya kolonma Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa misaali nan saabui ra, naxan tinxi a nii fide won bɛ. Won fan lan nɛ won xa tin na rabade won boore adamadie bɛ.

sentences.english: But if a man has this world's goods, and sees that his brother is in need, and keeps his heart shut against his brother, how is it possible for the love of God to be in him?
sentences.susu: Se kanyi naxan a bɔɲɛ balanma tɔɔrɔmixi ya ra, a mu Ala xa xanunteya kolon.

sentences.english: My little children, do not let our love be in word and in tongue, but let it be in act and in good faith.
sentences.susu: N ma die, won ma xanunteya naxa findi wɔyɛnyi tun na, a xa findi maraba nan na, xa na mu a ra nɔndi yo mu na a kui.

sentences.english: In this way we may be certain that we are true, and may give our heart comfort before him,
sentences.susu: Na kui, won nɔma a kolonde a nɔndi na won yi, won bɔɲɛ fa sa Ala mabiri.

sentences.english: When our heart says that we have done wrong; because God is greater than our heart, and has knowledge of all things.
sentences.susu: Hali won bɔɲɛ sa won makiiti, Ala gbo won bɔɲɛ bɛ, a fe birin kolon.

sentences.english: My loved ones, if our heart does not say that we have done wrong, we have no fear before him;
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie, xa won bɔɲɛ mu won makiiti, won bara xaxilisa sɔtɔ Ala ya i.

sentences.english: And he gives us all our requests, because we keep his laws and do the things which are pleasing in his eyes.
sentences.susu: Ala won ma duba birin suxuma nɛ, barima won birama a xa sɛriyɛe nun a waxɔnfe nan fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And this is his law, that we have faith in the name of his Son Jesus Christ, and love for one another, even as he said to us.
sentences.susu: A xa sɛriyɛ nan ya: Won xa danxaniya a xa Di ma, a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa. Won man xa won bore xanu, alɔ Ala won yamarixi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: He who keeps his laws is in God and God is in him. And the Spirit which he gave us is our witness that he is in us.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan Ala xa sɛriyɛ rabatuma, na kanyi nun Ala na a ra. A a kolonma Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nan ma, Ala naxan fixi won ma.

sentences.english: My loved ones, do not put your faith in every spirit, but put them to the test, to see if they are from God: because a great number of false prophets have gone out into the world.
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie, wo naxa la xaxili birin na. Wo xa a mato a fanyi ra xa na xaxili fatanxi Ala nan na, barima wule falɛe bara gbo duniɲa naxee e yɛtɛ findixi namiɲɔnmɛe ra.

sentences.english: By this you may have knowledge of the Spirit of God: every spirit which says that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God:
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan birin laxi a ra a Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa bara fa duniɲa ma a adama ki ma, wo nɔma nɛ a kolonde a na kanyi tan xaxili fatanxi Ala nan na.

sentences.english: And every spirit which does not say this is not from God: this is the spirit of Antichrist, of which you have had word; and it is in the world even now.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi naxan birin mu laxi Isa ra, na gbe xaxili mu fatanxi Ala ra, a fatanxi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi yaxui nan na, wo bara naxan ma fe mɛ, a a na fafe duniɲa ma. N xa a fala wo bɛ, a ɲan bara fa.

sentences.english: You are of God, my little children, and you have overcome them because he who is in you is greater than he who is in the world.
sentences.susu: N ma die, wo tan, Ala nan gbe wo ra. Wo bara nɔ na namiɲɔnmɛ wule falɛe ra, barima Ala Xaxili naxan na wo fɔxɔ ra, na sɛnbɛ gbo Sentanɛ xaxili bɛ naxan na duniɲa mixie fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: They are of the world, so their talk is the world's talk, and the world gives ear to them.
sentences.susu: E tan duniɲa nan gbe e ra. Na nan a ra e wɔyɛnma duniɲa ki ma, duniɲa fa e xui suxu.

sentences.english: We are of God: he who has the knowledge of God gives ear to us; he who is not of God does not give ear to us. By this we may see which is the true spirit, and which is the spirit of error.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ won tan, Ala nan gbe won na. Na nan a ra Ala kolonyie won xui suxuma. Ala kolontaree tan mu won xui suxuma. Nɔndi xaxili nun wule xaxili tagi rasama na ki nɛ.

sentences.english: My loved ones, let us have love for one another: because love is of God, and everyone who has love is a child of God and has knowledge of God.
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie, won xa won bore xanu, barima xanunteya fatanxi Ala nan na. Mixi naxan a boore adamadi xanuma, na bara findi Ala xa di ra, a Ala kolon.

sentences.english: He who has no love has no knowledge of God, because God is love.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan mu a boore adamadi xanuma, na kanyi mu Ala kolon, barima Ala, xanunteya nan a ra.

sentences.english: And the love of God was made clear to us when he sent his only Son into the world so that we might have life through him.
sentences.susu: Ala xa xanunteya kolonma yi nan ma: Ala naxa a xa Di kerenyi xɛɛ duniɲa, alako won xa kisi a tan saabui ra.

sentences.english: And this is love, not that we had love for God, but that he had love for us, and sent his Son to be an offering for our sins.
sentences.susu: Xanunteya yati yati nan ya: Won tan xa mu Ala xanuxi, a tan nan won xanuxi, a fa a xa Di kerenyi xɛɛ a xa findi won ma yunubi xafari sɛrɛxɛ ra.

sentences.english: My loved ones, if God had such love for us, it is right for us to have love for one another.
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie, Ala to bara won xanu na ki, won fan lan nɛ won xa won bore xanu.

sentences.english: No man has ever seen God: if we have love for one another, God is in us and his love is made complete in us:
sentences.susu: Mixi yo mu na naxan Ala toxi, kɔnɔ xa won won bore xanu, Ala luma nɛ won i. A xa xanunteya kamalima nɛ won i.

sentences.english: And his Spirit which he has given us is the witness that we are in him and he is in us.
sentences.susu: Won a kolon won nun Ala na a ra, barima a bara a Xaxili fi won ma.

sentences.english: And we have seen and give witness that the Father sent the Son to be the Saviour of the world.
sentences.susu: Muxu tan bara a to, muxu bara findi seede ra, a Baba Ala a xa Di xɛɛ nɛ duniɲa ma adamadie rakiside.

sentences.english: Everyone who says openly that Jesus is the Son of God, has God in him and is in God.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan a falama a Isa findixi Ala xa Di nan na, na kanyi nun Ala na a ra.

sentences.english: And we have seen and had faith in the love which God has for us. God is love, and everyone who has love is in God, and God is in him.
sentences.susu: Won bara Ala xa xanunteya kolon, won bara la a ra. Ala findixi xanunteya nan na. Mixi naxan ɲɛrɛma xanunteya kui, na kanyi nun Ala na a ra.

sentences.english: In this way love is made complete in us, so that we may be without fear on the day of judging, because as he is, so are we in this world.
sentences.susu: Na kui, xanunteya bara kamali won tagi, alako gaaxui naxa lu won yi ra kiitisa lɔxɔɛ, barima won birama Isa xa misaali fɔxɔ ra yi duniɲa bɛndɛ fuɲi fari.

sentences.english: There is no fear in love: true love has no room for fear, because where fear is, there is pain; and he who is not free from fear is not complete in love.
sentences.susu: Gaaxui mu luma xanuntenyie tagi xa e xa xanunteya bara kamali. Mixi gaaxuma ɲaxankatɛ nan xa fe ra, kɔnɔ xanunteya kamalixi kanyi mu gaaxuma.

sentences.english: We have the power of loving, because he first had love for us.
sentences.susu: Won nɔma mixi xanude, barima Ala singe nan bara won xanu.

sentences.english: If a man says, I have love for God, and has hate for his brother, his words are false: for how is the man who has no love for his brother whom he has seen, able to have love for God whom he has not seen?
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan a falama a Ala xanuxi, kɔnɔ a luma mixi xɔn na, na kanyi bara findi wule falɛ ra. Mixi naxan mu fata a boore adamadi xanude a naxan toma, na mu nɔma Ala xanude a mu naxan toxi.

sentences.english: And this is the word which we have from him, that he who has love for God is to have the same love for his brother.
sentences.susu: Ala won yamarixi yi nan na: Naxan Ala xanuxi, a xa nu a boore adamadi fan xanu.

sentences.english: Everyone who has faith that Jesus is the Christ is a child of God: and everyone who has love for the Father has love for his child.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan lama a ra a Isa nan findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi ra, na kanyi bara findi Ala xa di ra. Naxan babɛ nde xanuma, a na babɛ xa di fan xanuma nɛ.

sentences.english: In this way, we are certain that we have love for the children of God, when we have love for God and keep his laws.
sentences.susu: Won na Ala xanu, won fa a xa yaamari birin nabatu, na nan a masenma a won Ala xa die fan xanuma.

sentences.english: For loving God is keeping his laws: and his laws are not hard.
sentences.susu: Ala xanufe a niyama won xa a xa yaamarie fan nabatu. Na mu findima kote xɔrɔxɔɛ ra,

sentences.english: Anything which comes from God is able to overcome the world: and the power by which we have overcome the world is our faith.
sentences.susu: barima Ala xa die nɔma duniɲa birin na e xa danxaniya saabui ra.

sentences.english: Who is able to overcome the world but the man who has faith that Jesus is the Son of God?
sentences.susu: Nde xunnakeli sɔtɔma duniɲa xun na, xa danxaniyatɔɛ mu a ra, naxan lama a ra a Ala xa Di nan Isa ra?

sentences.english: This is he who came by water and by blood, Jesus Christ; not by water only but by water and by blood.
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa nan fa ye nun wuli ra. A mu faxi ye gbansan xa ra, a faxi ye nun wuli nan na. Ala Xaxili nan na seede baxi, barima Ala Xaxili nɔndi nan a ra.

sentences.english: And the Spirit is the witness, because the Spirit is true.
sentences.susu: Seede saxan nan na:

sentences.english: There are three witnesses, the Spirit, the water, and the blood: and all three are in agreement.
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi, ye, nun wuli. Na saxanyi birin seedeɲɔxɔya keren nan bama.

sentences.english: If we take the witness of men to be true, the witness of God is greater: because this is the witness which God has given about his Son.
sentences.susu: Won tinma mixie xa seedeɲɔxɔya ra, kɔnɔ Ala xa seedeɲɔxɔya dangi na birin na. Ala nan seede bama a xa Di xa fe ra.

sentences.english: He who has faith in the Son of God has the witness in himself: he who has not faith in God makes him false, because he has not faith in the witness which God has given about his Son.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan lama Ala xa seedeɲɔxɔya ra, na kanyi danxaniyama Ala xa Di ma, kɔnɔ mixi naxan mu lama Ala ra, na kanyi bara Ala findi wule falɛ ra, barima a mu laxi Ala xa seedeɲɔxɔya ra, a naxan baxi a xa Di xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And his witness is this, that God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
sentences.susu: Na seedeɲɔxɔya a masenma a Ala kisi fixi won ma a xa Di nan saabui ra. Na kisi mu ɲɔnma abadan.

sentences.english: He who has the Son has the life; he who has not the Son of God has not the life.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan birama Ala xa Di fɔxɔ ra, na kanyi bara kisi, kɔnɔ mixi naxan mu birama Ala xa Di fɔxɔ ra, na kanyi mu kisima.

sentences.english: I have put these things in writing for you who have faith in the name of the Son of God, so that you may be certain that you have eternal life.
sentences.susu: N bara yi fe birin sɛbɛ wo ma, wo tan naxee danxaniyaxi Ala xa Di ma, alako wo xa a kolon a wo bara kisi sɔtɔ, naxan mu ɲɔnma abadan.

sentences.english: And we are certain that if we make any request to him which is right in his eyes, he will give ear to us:
sentences.susu: Won ma lanlanteya na a ma ki naxɛ, won bara a kolon a won ma duba birin suxuma nɛ naxan findixi a waxɔnfe ra.

sentences.english: And if we are certain that he gives ear to all our requests, we are equally certain that we will get our requests.
sentences.susu: Won to a kolon a won ma maxandi birin mɛma, won man a kolon a Ala won ma duba birin suxuma nɛ.

sentences.english: If a man sees his brother doing a sin which is not bad enough for death, let him make a prayer to God, and God will give life to him whose sin was not bad enough for death. There is a sin whose punishment is death: I do not say that he may make such a request then.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan a boore nde toma yunubi raba ra, yunubi naxan mu mixi bɔnɔma abadan, a xa Ala maxandi a bɛ. Ala a rakisima nɛ xa yunubi na a ra naxan mu mixi bɔnɔma abadan. Yunubi nde na naxan mixi bɔnɔma abadan. N mu a fala wo xa Ala maxandi na mɔɔli xa fe ra.

sentences.english: All evil-doing is sin: but death is not the punishment for every sort of sin.
sentences.susu: Sɛriyɛ matandife birin findixi yunubi nan na, kɔnɔ yunubi birin xa mu mixi bɔnɔma.

sentences.english: We are certain that one who is a child of God will do no sin, but the Son of God keeps him so that he is not touched by the Evil One.
sentences.susu: Won a kolon mixi naxan findixi Ala xa di ra, a mu luma yunubi raba ra, barima Ala xa Di, a a kantama. Sentanɛ mu nɔma a ra.

sentences.english: We are certain that we are of God, but all the world is in the power of the Evil One.
sentences.susu: Won a kolon a Ala xa die nan won na, kɔnɔ duniɲa mixi dɔnxɔɛ birin na Sentanɛ sago nan bun ma.

sentences.english: And we are certain that the Son of God has come, and has given us a clear vision, so that we may see him who is true, and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
sentences.susu: Won man a kolon a Ala xa Di bara fa. A xaxili fanyi nan fixi won ma, alako won xa Ala Nɔndi Kanyi kolon. Won nun Ala Nɔndi Kanyi nan a ra a xa Di Isa saabui ra, a xa Mixi Sugandixi. A tan nan na Ala Nɔndi Kanyi ra, naxan kisi fixi won ma abadan.

sentences.english: My little children, keep yourselves from false gods.
sentences.susu: N ma die, wo wo yɛtɛ ratanga kuyee ma.

sentences.english: I, a ruler in the church, send word to the noble sister who is of God's selection, and to her children, for whom I have true love; and not only I, but all who have knowledge of what is true;
sentences.susu: N tan wo xa kuntigi bara wo xɛɛbu, wo tan naxee findixi danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama sugandixi ra, a nun wo boore naxee bara nɔndi kolon. Wo rafan n tan nun nɔndi kolonyi birin ma,

sentences.english: Because of this true knowledge which is in us, and will be with us for ever:
sentences.susu: barima nɔndi luma won bɔɲɛ ma abadan.

sentences.english: May grace, mercy, and peace be with us from God the Father, and from Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in all true love.
sentences.susu: Baba Ala nun a xa Di Isa, a xa Mixi Sugandixi, e xa hinnɛ won na, e xa kinikini won ma, e xa bɔɲɛsa fi won ma nɔndi nun xanunteya kui.

sentences.english: It gave me great joy to see some of your children walking in the true way, even as we were ordered to do by the Father.
sentences.susu: N bara sɛɛwa ki fanyi, barima ndee na wo ya ma naxee ɲɛrɛfe Baba Ala xa nɔndi kira xɔn ma a xa sɛriyɛ ki ma.
