sentences.english: And now, my sister, I make a request to you, not sending you a new law, but the law which we had from the first, that we have love for one another.
sentences.susu: Danxaniyatɔɛ fanyie, n bara wo mayandi, won xa won bore xanu. N na naxan sɛbɛfe yi ki, yaamari nɛɛnɛ mu a ra. Won bara na sɛriyɛ kolon kabi a fɔlɛ.

sentences.english: And love is the keeping of his laws. This is the law which was given to you from the first, so that you might keep it.
sentences.susu: Xanunteya nan ya, wo xa bira Ala xa sɛriyɛ fɔxɔ ra. Wo lan nɛ wo xa Ala xa yaamarie rabatu, alɔ wo a mɛxi ki naxɛ kabi a fɔlɛ.

sentences.english: Because a number of false teachers have gone out into the world, who do not give witness that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. Such a one is a false teacher and Antichrist.
sentences.susu: Mixi gbegbe wama wo madaxufe, a falafe ra a Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa mu faxi duniɲa adama ki ma. Na mixi madaxui mɔɔli findixi Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi yaxui nan na.

sentences.english: Keep watch over yourselves, so that you do not make our work of no effect, but may get your full reward.
sentences.susu: Wo xa fe birin naba alako wo naxa gan wo xa wali munafanyi ra. Wo xa kata wo xa sare kamalixi sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: Anyone who goes on and does not keep to the teaching of Christ, has not God: he who keeps to the teaching has the Father and the Son.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan fe gbɛtɛ suxuma, a mu bira Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa xaranyi fɔxɔ ra, na kanyi mu Ala kolon. Naxan birama a fɔxɔ ra, a bara Baba Ala nun a xa Di kolon.

sentences.english: If anyone comes to you not having this teaching, do not take him into your house or give him words of love:
sentences.susu: Xa karamɔxɔ nde sa fa wo yire yi xaranyi xanbi, wo naxa a rasɛnɛ, wo naxa a xɛɛbu,

sentences.english: For he who gives him words of love has a part in his evil works.
sentences.susu: xa na mu a ra wo fan bara lu a xa wali ɲaaxi kui.

sentences.english: Having much to say to you, it is not my purpose to put it all down with paper and ink: but I am hoping to come to you, and to have talk with you face to face, so that your joy may be full.
sentences.susu: N wama fe gbegbe falafe wo bɛ, kɔnɔ n mu wama na rabafe sɛbɛli ra, fo won xa lu yire keren, won xa dɛ masara, alako won ma sɛɛwɛ xa kamali.

sentences.english: The children of your noble sister, who is of God's selection, send you their love.
sentences.susu: Wo boore danxaniyatɔɛe bara wo xɛɛbu.

sentences.english: I, a ruler in the church, send word to the well loved Gaius, for whom I have true love.
sentences.susu: N tan danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xa kuntigi, n bara i xɛɛbu, n xanuntenyi Gayu, n naxan xanuxi nɔndi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: My loved one, it is my prayer that you may do well in all things, and be healthy in body, even as your soul does well.
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyi, Ala xa fe birin sɔɔnɛya i bɛ. I fate xa lu yalanyi kui alɔ i xa danxaniya yalanxi ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For it gave me great joy when some of the brothers came and gave witness that you had the true faith and were walking in the true way.
sentences.susu: Won boore danxaniyatɔɛ ndee to fa n yire, e naxa a fala n bɛ i ɲɛrɛma nɔndi kui. N naxa sɛɛwa ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: I have no greater joy than to have news that my children are walking in the true way.
sentences.susu: Sɛɛwɛ yo mu dangima na mɔɔli ra, a kolonfe ra a n ma die na nɔndi kira nan xɔn ma.

sentences.english: My loved one, you are doing a good work in being kind to those brothers who come from other places;
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyi, i mɛɛnima xɔɲɛ danxaniyatɔɛe ma hali wo mu wo bore kolon.

sentences.english: Who have given witness to the church of your love for them: and you will do well to send them on their way well cared for, as is right for servants of God:
sentences.susu: Ndee bara i xa xanunteya xa fe dɛntɛgɛ sa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama bɛ. Danxaniyatɔɛ naxan yo dangima i xɔnyi, i xa e mali e xa biyaasi kui, alɔ Ala wama a xɔn ma ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: For they went out for love of the Name, taking nothing from the Gentiles.
sentences.susu: E na Ala xa wali nan kui, danxaniyataree tan mu e kima.

sentences.english: So it is right for us to take in such men as guests, so that we may take our part in the work of the true faith.
sentences.susu: Won lan won xa kafu na mixi mɔɔli ma, alako won fan xa won gbe raba Ala xa nɔndi xa fe ra.

sentences.english: I sent a letter to the church, but Diotrephes, whose desire is ever to have the first place among them, will not have us there.
sentences.susu: N bara bataaxɛ nde sɛbɛ danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama ma, kɔnɔ Diyoterefi mu tinxi muxu rasɛnɛde barima a wama findife xunyi ra.

sentences.english: So if I come, I will keep in mind the things he does, talking against us with evil words: and as if this was not enough, he does not take the brothers into his house, and those who are ready to take them in, he keeps from doing so, putting them out of the church if they do.
sentences.susu: N na fa wo yire, n dɛntɛgɛ sama nɛ wo bɛ a xa kɛwali xa fe ra. A muxu xili kanama, a man mu tinma danxaniyatɔɛe yigiyade. Hali naxee wama e yigiyafe, a tɔnyi dɔxɔma nee fan ma, a e keri danxaniyatɔɛe ya ma.

sentences.english: My loved one, do not be copying what is evil, but what is good. He who does good is of God: he who does evil has not seen God.
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyi, i fe ɲaaxi naxan toma, i naxa bira na mɔɔli fɔxɔ ra. I fe fanyi naxan toma, i xa bira na nan fɔxɔ ra. Fe fanyi rabae na Ala nan bɛ, kɔnɔ fe ɲaaxi rabae tan mu Ala kolon.

sentences.english: Demetrius has the approval of all men and of what is true: and we give the same witness, and you are certain that our witness is true.
sentences.susu: Birin fe fanyi falama Demetiri xa fe ra. Nɔndi yati a yɛtɛ kan seede baxi. Hali muxu tan muxu nɔma a xa fe seede bade. I a kolon muxu mu wule falama.

sentences.english: I had much to say to you, but it is not my purpose to put it all down with ink and pen:
sentences.susu: N wama fe gbegbe falafe i bɛ, kɔnɔ n mu wama na rabafe sɛbɛli ra.

sentences.english: But I am hoping to see you in a short time, and to have talk with you face to face. May you have peace. Your friends here send you their love. Give my love to our friends by name.
sentences.susu: A gbe mu luxi won xa lu yire keren, won xa sumun.

sentences.english: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ and the brother of James, to those of God's selection who have been made holy by God the Father and are kept safe for Jesus Christ:
sentences.susu: N tan Yude nan yi ki, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa konyi, nun Yaki ngaxakerenma. N na yi bataaxɛ sɛbɛfe mixie nan ma, Baba Ala naxee xilixi, a naxee xanuxi, nun Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa naxee makantaxi.

sentences.english: May mercy and peace and love be increased in you.
sentences.susu: Ala xa kinikini, bɔɲɛsa, nun xanunteya gbo wo yi.

sentences.english: My loved ones, while my thoughts were full of a letter which I was going to send you about our common salvation, it was necessary for me to send you one requesting you with all my heart to go on fighting strongly for the faith which has been given to the saints once and for ever.
sentences.susu: N xanuntenyie, n bara wa bataaxɛ sɛbɛfe wo ma won ma kisi xa fe ra. N bara wa na rabafe alako n xa wo ralimaniya, wo xa gere so won ma danxaniya xa fe ra, naxan ɲan bara gɛ masende kerenyi ra sɛniyɛntɔɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: For certain men have come among you secretly, marked out before in the holy Writings for this evil fate, men without the fear of God, turning his grace into an unclean thing, and false to our only Master and Lord, Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Mixi ndee bara so wo tagi, naxee xa ɲaxankatɛ ɲan bara sɛbɛ a rakuya. Kaafirie nan e ra, naxee won Marigi Ala xa hinnɛ mafindima, alako e xa lu fe ɲaaxie kui, e xa e kobe raso won Karamɔxɔ kerenyi ra, won Marigi Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi.

sentences.english: Now it is my purpose to put you in mind, though you once had knowledge of all these things, of how the Lord, having taken a people safely out of Egypt, later sent destruction on those who had no faith;
sentences.susu: Hali wo a kolon, n wama wo ratufe fe dangixi ndee nan ma. Marigi to gɛ Isirayila ɲama raminide Misira bɔxi ma, a naxa Isirayilaka danxaniyataree sɔntɔ.

sentences.english: And the angels who did not keep to their kingdom but went out from the place which was theirs, he has put in eternal chains and in dark night till the great day of the judging.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ ndee fan to e yɛtɛ lu binyɛtareɲa kui, e e xɔnyi bɛɲin, Ala naxa e raso geeli kui, e xa lu dimi kui han kiiti xungbe sa lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the towns near them, having like these, given themselves up to unclean desires and gone after strange flesh, have been made an example, undergoing the punishment of eternal fire.
sentences.susu: Sodoma nun Gomora, a nun e rabilinyi, e to e yɛtɛ rafi fe ɲaaxie ma, e nun e boore nu kafu mɔɔli nde ra naxan mu lanma adamadie tagi, Ala naxa e findi misaali ra, a e raso tɛ xɔɔra naxan mu xubenma abadan.

sentences.english: In the same way these dreamers make the flesh unclean, having no respect for authorities, and say evil of rulers.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na mixi naxee bara so wo tagi, e laamatunyi ndee toma naxee a niya e xa sɛniyɛntareɲa raba, e Marigi xa yaamari matandi, e malekɛe konbi.

sentences.english: Now when Michael, one of the chief angels, was fighting against the Evil One for the body of Moses, fearing to make use of violent words against him, he only said, May the Lord be your judge.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ mangɛ Minkayilu to wɔyɛn Ibulisa bɛ Annabi Munsa fure xa fe ra, Minkayilu mu suusa Ibulisa xa wɔyɛnyi yaabide konbi ra. A a fala nɛ gbansan, «Ala xa i makiiti.»

sentences.english: But these men say evil about such things as they have no knowledge of; and the things of which they have natural knowledge, like beasts without reason, are the cause of their destruction.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ na mixie konbi tima fe nde xa fe ra, e mu naxan kolon. E naxan kolon e yɛtɛ ra, a wula sube xaxilitaree daaxi, na fan mu findi sese ra fo e kanase.

sentences.english: A curse on them! They have gone in the way of Cain, running uncontrolled into the error of Balaam for reward, and have come to destruction by saying evil against the Lord, like Korah.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ na e bɛ. E bara bira Kabila xa misaali fɔxɔ ra. E bara bira kɔbiri fɔxɔ ra alɔ Balami, e fa lɔɛ. E bara matandi ti alɔ Kora, e xun fa rakana.

sentences.english: These men are unseen rocks at your love-feasts, when they take part in them with you, keepers of sheep who without fear take the food of the sheep; clouds without water rushing before the wind, wasted trees without fruit, twice dead, pulled up by the roots,
sentences.susu: Na mixie bara wo xa ngaxakerenya malanyie manɔxɔ. E e dɛgema wo ya ma, e mɛɛnima e yɛtɛ nan gbansan ma, e mu yaagima. E luxi alɔ nuxuie, foye naxee raɲɛrɛma, kɔnɔ e mu fama tunɛ ra. E luxi alɔ sansi naxee mu bogi raminima e bogi tɛmui. E to tala, e bara faxa sanmaya firin.

sentences.english: Violent waves of the sea, streaming with their shame, wandering stars for whom the darkest night is kept in store for ever.
sentences.susu: E luxi alɔ baa mɔrɔnyie naxee xunfɛ raminima. Na xunfɛ misaalixi na mixie xa fe ɲaaxie nan na. E luxi alɔ tunbui naxee ragataxi koore ma, e nu lintan dimi kui abadan.

sentences.english: The prophet Enoch, who was the seventh after Adam, said of these men, The Lord came with tens of thousands of his saints,
sentences.susu: Enoki, Adama tolobitɛ solofere nde, naxa yi masenyi fala Ala xili ra e xa fe ra, «Marigi na fafe, a nun a xa sɛniyɛntɔɛ wulu wulu,

sentences.english: To be the judge of all, and to give a decision against all those whose lives are unpleasing to him, because of the evil acts which they have done, and because of all the hard things which sinners without fear of God have said against him.
sentences.susu: alako a xa adamadi birin makiiti. Kaafirie xa makiiti e xa fe ɲaaxi rabaxie ma. Kaafirie xa makiiti e xa konbie xa fe ra, e naxan falama Marigi xun ma.»

sentences.english: These are the men who make trouble, ever desiring change, going after evil pleasures, using high-sounding words, respecting men's position in the hope of reward.
sentences.susu: Na mixi mɔɔlie luma nɛ sɔnxɔ ra, e mu ɲɛlɛxinma, e birama e yɛtɛ waxɔnfe nan tun fɔxɔ ra, e dɛ igbo, e mixi madaxuma wɔyɛnyi ɲɔxunmɛ ra alako e xa se sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: But you, my loved ones, keep in memory the words which were said before by the Apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan, n xanuntenyie, wo xa ratu won Marigi Isa xa xɛɛrae xa masenyie ma.

sentences.english: How they said to you, In the last days there will be men who, guided by their evil desires, will make sport of holy things.
sentences.susu: E nu bara a fala wo bɛ, «Waxati dɔnxɔɛ, mixie fama nɛ yode Ala ma, e bira e waxɔnfe tinxintaree fɔxɔ ra.»

sentences.english: These are the men who make divisions, natural men, not having the Spirit.
sentences.susu: Na mixi mɔɔlie na wo tagi. E wo xa lanyi kanama nɛ. E birama e yɛtɛ xaxili nan fɔxɔ ra. Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi mu na e bɔɲɛ i.

sentences.english: But you, my loved ones, building yourselves up on your most holy faith, and making prayers in the Holy Spirit,
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ wo tan, n xanuntenyie, wo xa wo xa danxaniya sɛniyɛnxi rasabati. Wo xa Ala maxandi a Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi saabui ra.

sentences.english: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for life eternal through the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ.
sentences.susu: Wo xa lu Ala xa xanunteya bun ma, alako wo Marigi Isa, Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi, xa kinikini wo ma, a xa wo rakisi.

sentences.english: And have pity on those who are in doubt;
sentences.susu: Wo xa kinikini mixie ma naxee siikɛxi,

sentences.english: And to some give salvation, pulling them out of the fire; and on some have mercy with fear, hating even the clothing which is made unclean by the flesh.
sentences.susu: wo xa e ratanga tɛ ma. Wo man xa kinikini booree fan ma gaaxui kui, kɔnɔ wo xa mɛɛni wo yɛtɛ ma e ya ma, alako wo fan naxa fa wo yɛtɛ findi sɛniyɛntaree ra.

sentences.english: Now to him who is able to keep you from falling, and to give you a place in his glory, free from all evil, with great joy,
sentences.susu: Ala tantu, naxan nɔma won nakiside won ma yunubi birin ma, naxan nɔma won masende sɛniyɛnyi nun sɛɛwɛ ra a xa nɔrɛ kui.

sentences.english: To the only God our Saviour, through Jesus Christ our Lord, let us give glory and honour and authority and power, before all time and now and for ever. So be it.
sentences.susu: Ala tantu, naxan firin nde mu na, naxan bara won nakisi a xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa saabui ra. Nɔrɛ, xunnakeli, sɛnbɛ, nun nɔɛ na a bɛ beenun duniɲa xa fɔlɔ, yakɔsi, nun waxati naxan sa fama abadan. Amina.

sentences.english: The Revelation of Jesus Christ which God gave him so that his servants might have knowledge of the things which will quickly take place: and he sent and made it clear by his angel to his servant John;
sentences.susu: Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa laamatunyi nan ya, Ala naxan fixi a ma. A xa malekɛ naxa na rasanba a xa konyi Yaya ma, alako Ala xa konyi di birin xa a kolon fe naxan fama rabade yi waxati.

sentences.english: Who gave witness of the word of God, and of the witness of Jesus Christ, even of all the things which he saw.
sentences.susu: Yaya findixi seede nan na Ala xa masenyi xa fe ra a nun Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa xa seedeɲɔxɔya xa fe ra. A naxan to, a naxa na birin masen.

sentences.english: A blessing be on the reader, and on those who give ear to the prophet's words, and keep the things which he has put in the book: for the time is near.
sentences.susu: Hɛɛri na a xaran mixi bɛ, a nun naxee e tuli matima yi masenyi ra naxan tixi Ala xili ra, e man fa yi sɛbɛli ratinmɛ, barima waxati bara makɔrɛ.

sentences.english: John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace to you and peace, from him who is and was and is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his high seat;
sentences.susu: N tan Yaya, n bara yi sɛbɛli ti Isa xa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama dɔxɔ solofere ma, naxee na Asi bɔxi ma. Ala xa hinnɛ nun bɔɲɛsa fi wo ma, Ala naxan na xoro, to, a nun tina. Xaxili solofere naxee na a xa mangɛ kibanyi ya i, nee fan bara hinnɛ wo ra,

sentences.english: And from Jesus Christ, the true witness, the first to come back from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who had love for us and has made us clean from our sins by his blood;
sentences.susu: a nun Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi Isa, naxan findixi seede tinxinxi ra, naxan singe keli mixi faxaxie tagi, naxan dangi bɔxi mangɛ birin na. Matɔxɔɛ na Isa nan bɛ, naxan won xanuxi, naxan won nakisixi won ma yunubie ma a wuli saabui ra.

sentences.english: And has made us to be a kingdom and priests to his God and Father; to him let glory and power be given for ever and ever. So be it.
sentences.susu: A bara won naso Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma, a bara won findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra a Baba Ala bɛ. Nɔrɛ nun sɛnbɛ na a bɛ abadan! Amina.

sentences.english: See, he comes with the clouds, and every eye will see him, and those by whom he was wounded; and all the tribes of the earth will be sorrowing because of him. Yes, so be it.
sentences.susu: Wo wo ya rate koore ma, a na fafe nuxuie kui. Adamadi birin a toma nɛ, hali naxee a masɔxɔ. Duniɲa si birin fama sunnunde a xa fe ra. Iyo, a na na ki nɛ. Amina!

sentences.english: I am the First and the Last, says the Lord God who is and was and is to come, the Ruler of all.
sentences.susu: Marigi Ala xa masenyi nan ya: «N tan nan na a fɔlɛ ra, n tan nan na a raɲɔnyi ra, n tan naxan na xoro, to, nun tina, Sɛnbɛ Birin Kanyi.»

sentences.english: I, John, your brother, who have a part with you in the trouble and the kingdom and the quiet strength of Jesus, was in the island which is named Patmos, for the word of God and the witness of Jesus.
sentences.susu: N tan Yaya, wo ngaxakerenyi, won birin na tɔɔrɔfe, won birin na Ala xa mangɛya niini nan bun ma, won birin tunnabɛxixi Isa xa fe i. N nu na Patimosi suri nan ma Ala xa masenyi nun Isa xa seedeɲɔxɔya xa fe ra.

sentences.english: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and a great voice at my back, as of a horn, came to my ears,
sentences.susu: Ala xa lɔxɔɛ, Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi to n suxu, n naxa xui nde mɛ n xanbi ra. A sɛnbɛ gbo alɔ sara xui.

sentences.english: Saying, What you see, put in a book, and send it to the seven churches; to Ephesus and to Smyrna and to Pergamos and to Thyatira and to Sardis and to Philadelphia and to Laodicea.
sentences.susu: A naxa a masen n bɛ, «I naxan toxi, a sɛbɛ Kitaabui kui, i xa a rasanba danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama dɔxɔ solofere ma, naxee na Efɛsɛ, Simirina, Peregamo, Tiyatire, Saradesi, Filadelifiya, nun Layodiseya.»

sentences.english: And turning to see the voice which said these words to me, I saw seven gold vessels with lights burning in them;
sentences.susu: N naxa n mafindi alako n xa a to naxan wɔyɛnxi n na. N to n mafindi, n naxa lanpui xɛɛma daaxi solofere to.

sentences.english: And in the middle of them one like a son of man, clothed with a robe down to his feet, and with a band of gold round his breasts.
sentences.susu: N naxa adamadi maniyɛ to na lanpuie tagi, donma kuye ragoroxi a ma, bɛlɛti xɛɛma daaxi balanxi a kanke ra.

sentences.english: And his head and his hair were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
sentences.susu: A xunyi nun a xunsɛxɛ nu fiixɛ alɔ yɛxɛɛ xabe fiixɛ, xa na mu a ra balabalanyi. A yae nu yanbama alɔ tɛ.

sentences.english: And his feet like polished brass, as if it had been burned in a fire; and his voice was as the sound of great waters.
sentences.susu: A sanyie nu gbeelixi alɔ wure gbeeli raxunuxi, a xui nu gbo alɔ baa mɔrɔnyi xui.

sentences.english: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth came a sharp two-edged sword: and his face was like the sun shining in its strength.
sentences.susu: Tunbui solofere nu na a yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛ, santidɛgɛma dɛ firin daaxi xɛɲɛnxi nu na a dɛ i, a yatagi mayanbama alɔ soge xɔnɛ.

sentences.english: And when I saw him, I went down on my face at his feet as one dead. And he put his right hand on me, saying, Have no fear; I am the first and the last and the Living one;
sentences.susu: N to a to n naxa bira a bun ma, n fa lu alɔ mixi faxaxi. A naxa a yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛ sa n ma, a fa a fala, «Hali i mu gaaxu. N tan nan na a fɔlɛ nun a raɲɔnyi ra.

sentences.english: And I was dead, and see, I am living for ever, and I have the keys of death and of Hell.
sentences.susu: N ɲiɲɛ na a ra. N nu bara faxa, kɔnɔ yakɔsi n ɲiɲɛ na a ra abadan. Faxɛ nun aligiyama saabi kanyi na n tan nan na.

sentences.english: Put in writing, then, the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will be after these;
sentences.susu: I xa fe nan sɛbɛ i naxan toxi, naxan na rabafe, a nun naxan fama rabade.

sentences.english: The secret of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and of the seven gold vessels with burning lights. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven lights are the seven churches.
sentences.susu: Yi tunbui solofere i naxee toxi n yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛ kui, e misaalixi Isa xa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama dɔxɔ solofere xa malekɛe nan na. Yi lanpui xɛɛma daaxi solofere, e misaalixi Isa xa danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama dɔxɔ solofere nan na.»

sentences.english: To the angel of the church in Ephesus say: These things says he who has the seven stars in his right hand, who is walking in the middle of the seven gold lights:
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛ Efɛsɛ danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xa malekɛ ma, masenyi nan ya naxan fatanxi Isa ra tunbui solofere suxuxi naxan yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛ kui, naxan ɲɛrɛma lanpui xɛɛma daaxi solofere tagi:

sentences.english: I have knowledge of your doings, and of your hard work and long waiting, and that you will not put up with evil men, and have put to the test those who say they are Apostles and are not, and have seen that they are false;
sentences.susu: «N wo xa fe rabaxi kolon, n wo xa wali kolon, n wo xa tunnabɛxi kolon. N a kolon mixi ɲaaxie mu rafan wo ma. N a kolon wo bara mixie makiiti naxee e yɛtɛ findixi Ala xa xɛɛrae ra, han wo fan fa e kolon wule falɛe ra.

sentences.english: And you have the power of waiting, and have undergone trouble because of my name, without weariness.
sentences.susu: Wo bara wo tunnabɛxi, wo bara tɔɔrɔ n xili xa fe ra, kɔnɔ limaniya mu baxi wo yi ra.»

sentences.english: But I have this against you, that you are turned away from your first love.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ fe keren na na naxan mu rafanxi n ma wo xa fe ra. Wo mu n xanuxi a fanyi ra yakɔsi alɔ wo nu n xanuxi ki naxɛ singe ra.

sentences.english: So keep in mind where you were at first, and be changed in heart and do the first works; or I will come to you, and will take away your light from its place, if your hearts are not changed.
sentences.susu: Wo xa wo ratu a ma, wo nu na ki naxɛ beenun wo xa wo san nadin. Wo xa tuubi, wo man xa wali suxu alɔ wo nu a rabama singe ra ki naxɛ. Xa wo mu tuubi n fama nɛ wo xɔnyi, n fa wo xa lanpui bade a yire.»

sentences.english: But at least you have the credit of hating the works of the Nicolaitans, as I do.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ wo bara fe nde raba naxan fan. Wo bara Nikolasi xa ɲama xa fe xɔn, alɔ n fan a xɔnxi ki naxɛ.»

sentences.english: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes I will give of the fruit of the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of God.
sentences.susu: «Tuli na naxan bɛ, a xa a tuli mati Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa masenyi ra danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae bɛ. Naxan na geeni, n na nan luma a xa simaya wuri bogi don, naxan tixi Ala xa ariyanna kui.»

sentences.english: And to the angel of the church in Smyrna say: These things says the first and the last, who was dead and is living:
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛ Simirina danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xa malekɛ ma, masenyi nan ya naxan fatanxi Isa ra, Isa naxan na a fɔlɛ nun a raɲɔnyi ra, naxan nu faxaxi a man fa keli faxɛ ma:

sentences.english: I have knowledge of your troubles and how poor you are (but you have true wealth), and the evil words of those who say they are Jews, and are not, but are a Synagogue of Satan.
sentences.susu: «N wo xa ɲaxankatɛ nun setareɲa kolon, hali bannaya nde to na wo yi ra. N Yuwifie xa tɔɔɲɛgɛ kolon wo mabiri. E a falama e yɛtɛ bɛ a Yuwifie, a fa li Yuwifie mu e ra. E findixi Sentanɛ xa mixie nan na.

sentences.english: Have no fear of the things which you will have to undergo: see, the Evil One will send some of you into prison, so that you may be put to the test; and you will have great trouble for ten days. Be true till death, and I will give you the crown of life.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa gaaxu ɲaxankatɛ ya ra, wo fama naxan sɔtɔde. Ibulisa a niyama nɛ wo xa mixi ndee xa sa geeli, alako a xa wo mato. Wo fama nɛ ɲaxankatade xi fu bun ma. Kɔnɔ wo xa lu danxaniya kui han wo faxɛ lɔxɔɛ. Na tɛmui n kisi fima nɛ wo ma wo sare ra.»

sentences.english: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches. He who overcomes will not come under the power of the second death.
sentences.susu: «Tuli na naxan bɛ, a xa a tuli mati Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa masenyi ra danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae bɛ. Naxan na geeni, a mu faxɛ firin nde kolonma.»

sentences.english: And to the angel of the church in Pergamos say: These things says he who has the sharp two-edged sword:
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛ Peregamo danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xa malekɛ ma, masenyi nan ya naxan fatanxi Isa ra, santidɛgɛma dɛ firin xɛɲɛnxi kanyi:

sentences.english: I have knowledge that your living-place is where Satan has his seat: and you are true to my name, and were not turned away from your faith in me, even in the days of Antipas, my true witness, who was put to death among you, where Satan has his place.
sentences.susu: «N a kolon wo xa taa findixi Sentanɛ sɛnbɛ yire nan na, kɔnɔ wo xirixi n xili ra, wo mu danxaniya raboloxi. Hali waxati ma, n dugutɛgɛ seede Antipasi faxa tɛmui naxɛ wo xɔnyi Sentanɛ yire, wo mu n ma kira rabɛɲin.»

sentences.english: But I have some things against you, because you have with you those who keep the teaching of Balaam, by whose suggestion Balak made the children of Israel go out of the right way, taking food which was offered to false gods, and going after the desires of the flesh.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ fe ndee na na naxee mu rafanxi n ma wo xa fe ra. Wo xa mixi ndee birama Balami xa misaali nan fɔxɔ ra, naxan nu bara Balaki rasi a xa gantanyi te Isirayilakae bɛ, e xa subee don naxee baxi sɛrɛxɛ ra kuyee bɛ, e xa yɛnɛ fan naba.

sentences.english: And you have those who keep the teaching of the Nicolaitans.
sentences.susu: Wo xa mixi ndee fan biraxi Nikolasi xa ɲama xa xaranyi fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: See, then, that you have a change of heart; or I will come to you quickly, and will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.
sentences.susu: Na kui, wo xa tuubi, xa na mu a ra n fama nɛ gere tide na mixie bɛ n ma santidɛgɛma ra, naxan na n dɛ i.»

sentences.english: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes I will give of the secret manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name, of which no one has knowledge but he to whom it is given.
sentences.susu: «Tuli na naxan bɛ, a xa a tuli mati Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa masenyi ra danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae bɛ. N ‹mana› donse nɔxunxi fima nɛ geeni mixi ma, a nun gɛmɛ fiixɛ, xili nɛɛnɛ sɛbɛxi naxan ma. Mixi yo mu na xili kolon, bafe na gɛmɛ kanyi ra.»

sentences.english: And to the angel of the church in Thyatira say: These things says the Son of God, whose eyes are like a flame of fire, and his feet like polished brass:
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛ Tiyatire danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xa malekɛ ma, masenyi nan ya naxan fatanxi Ala xa Di ra, naxan yae yanbama alɔ tɛ, a sanyie luxi alɔ wure gbeeli raxunuxi:

sentences.english: I have knowledge of your works, and your love and faith and help and strength in trouble, and that your last works are more than the first.
sentences.susu: «N wo xa fe rabaxi kolon, wo xa xanunteya, wo xa danxaniya, wo xa wali fanyi, wo xa tunnabɛxi, a nun wo naxan birin nabaxi a dɔnxɔɛ ra naxan gbo dangi wo xa wali singee ra.»

sentences.english: But I have this against you, that you let the woman Jezebel say she is a prophet and give false teaching, making my servants go after the desires of the flesh and take food offered to false gods.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ fe keren na na naxan mu rafanxi n ma wo xa fe ra. Wo bara a lu Yesabela, ginɛ naxan a yɛtɛ findixi namiɲɔnmɛ ra, a xa xaranyi ti naxan n ma konyie ratantanma, alako e xa fe kobi raba, e xa subee don naxee baxi sɛrɛxɛ ra kuyee bɛ.

sentences.english: And I gave her time for a change of heart, but she has no mind to give up her unclean ways.
sentences.susu: N bara diɲɛ alako a xa tuubi, kɔnɔ a mu tinxi a yuge ɲaaxi masarade.

sentences.english: See, I will put her into a bed, and those who make themselves unclean with her, into great trouble, if they go on with her works.
sentences.susu: Na na a ra, n a rasoma nɛ ɲaxankatɛ kui, a tan nun a yɛnɛ raba booree, xa e mu tuubi.

sentences.english: And I will put her children to death; and all the churches will see that I am he who makes search into the secret thoughts and hearts of men: and I will give to every one of you the reward of your works.
sentences.susu: N fama nɛ a xa die fan faxade. Na kui, danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama birin a kolonma nɛ a n tan nan mixi bɔɲɛ nun a sondonyi matoma, n tan nan e xa fe rabaxi sare ragbilenma e ma.»

sentences.english: But to you I say, to the rest in Thyatira, even to those who have not this teaching, and have no knowledge of the secrets of Satan, as they say; I put on you no other weight.
sentences.susu: «Kɔnɔ wo tan, Tiyatireka mixi dɔnxɔɛ naxee mu na yi fe kui, naxee mu soxi Sentanɛ xa gundo kui, n mu kote gbɛtɛ dɔxɔma wo xun ma kɔrɛ.

sentences.english: But what you have, keep safe till I come.
sentences.susu: Wo naxan sɔtɔxi, wo na suxu gben, han n fama tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: He who overcomes, and keeps my works to the end, to him I will give rule over the nations,
sentences.susu: Naxan na geeni, naxan n ma wali suxuma han a raɲɔnyi, n mangɛya fima na kanyi nan ma, a xa sie yamari.

sentences.english: And he will be ruling them with a rod of iron; as the vessels of the potter they will be broken, even as I have power from my Father:
sentences.susu: ‹A e yamarima sawuri wure daaxi nan na, a e kanama nɛ alɔ fɛɲɛ ibɔɔma ki naxɛ›,

sentences.english: And I will give him the morning star.
sentences.susu: alɔ n sɛnbɛ sɔtɔxi ki naxɛ n Baba Ala ra. N man subaxa looloe fima nɛ na kanyi ma.»

sentences.english: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches.
sentences.susu: «Tuli na naxan bɛ, a xa a tuli mati Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa masenyi ra danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae bɛ.»

sentences.english: And to the angel of the church in Sardis say: These things says he who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars: I have knowledge of your works, that you seem to be living but are dead.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛ Saradesi danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xa malekɛ ma, masenyi nan ya naxan fatanxi Isa ra, naxan Xaxili solofere yamarima, tunbui solofere suxuxi naxan yi ra: «N wo xa wali kolon. Mixi ɲɔxɔ a ma a wo ɲiɲɛ na a ra, kɔnɔ wo bara faxa.

sentences.english: Be on the watch, and make strong the rest of the things which are near to death; because as judged by me your works have not come up to God's measure.
sentences.susu: Wo naxa yanfa, wo xa wo bore ralimaniya, naxee na faxɛ kira xɔn, barima nde luxi wo xa wali ra n Marigi Ala bɛ.

sentences.english: Keep in mind, then, the teaching which was given to you, and be ruled by it and have a change of heart. If then you do not keep watch, I will come like a thief, and you will have no knowledge of the hour when I will come on you.
sentences.susu: Wo xa ratu na masenyi ma, wo naxan masɔtɔxi, wo naxan mɛxi. Wo xa a ragata wo bɔɲɛ kui, wo xa tuubi. Xa wo mu wo ɲɛngi sa yi xɔn, n fama nɛ waxati nde kui wo mu naxan kolon, na fa findi tɛrɛnna ra wo bɛ alɔ muɲɛti fa tɛmui.

sentences.english: But you have some names in Sardis who have kept clean their robes; and as a reward they will go in white with me.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi ndee na Saradesi naxee mu nɔxɔxi fe ɲaaxi ra. Nee fama nɛ ɲɛrɛde n sɛɛti ma, donma fiixɛ ragoroxi e ma, barima na nan findixi e xa wali sare ra.»

sentences.english: He who overcomes will be dressed in white, and I will not take his name from the book of life, and I will give witness to his name before my Father, and before his angels.
sentences.susu: «Naxan na geeni, donma fiixɛ ragoroma a ma. N mu a xili bama simaya buki kui, n a xa fe falama nɛ n Baba Ala bɛ a xa malekɛe ya xɔri.

sentences.english: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches.
sentences.susu: Tuli na naxan bɛ, a xa a tuli mati Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa masenyi ra danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae bɛ.»

sentences.english: And to the angel of the church in Philadelphia say: These things says he who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, opening the door so that it may be shut by no one, and shutting it so that it may be open to no one.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛ Filadelifiya danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xa malekɛ ma, masenyi nan ya naxan fatanxi Sɛniyɛntɔɛ nɔndi falɛ ra, Dawuda xa saabi na naxan yi ra, naxan naadɛ rabima mixi mu nɔ a balande, naxan naadɛ balanma mixi mu nɔ a rabide:

sentences.english: I have knowledge of your works (see, I have put before you an open door which may be shut by no one), and that you have a little strength, and have kept my word, and have been true to my name.
sentences.susu: «N wo xa wali kolon. N a kolon wo sɛnbɛ mu gbo, kɔnɔ wo bara n ma masenyi rabatu, wo mu n yanfa. Na kui, n bara naadɛ nde rabi wo ya ra, mixi mu nɔma naxan balande.

sentences.english: See, I will make those of the Synagogue of Satan who say they are Jews, and are not, but say what is false; I will make them come and give worship before your feet, and see my love for you.
sentences.susu: N fama nɛ mixie sade wo bɛlɛxɛ naxee a falama e yɛtɛ bɛ a Yuwifie, kɔnɔ e findixi Sentanɛ xa ɲama nan na. E na wule nan falafe. N fama nɛ e ra, e xa e magoro wo bɛ, e xa a kolon wo rafan n ma.

sentences.english: Because you have kept my word in quiet strength, I will keep you from the hour of testing which is coming on all the world, to put to the test those who are on earth.
sentences.susu: Wo to n ma masenyi rabatu tunnabɛxi kui, n fan wo ratangama nɛ na waxati xɔrɔxɔɛ ma naxan fama duniɲa lide, a fa duniɲa mixi birin mato.

sentences.english: I come quickly: keep that which you have, so that no one may take your crown.
sentences.susu: A gbe mu luxi n xa fa. Wo naxa wo xa danxaniya bɛɲin, alako mixi yo naxa wo sare fanyi ba wo yi ra.»

sentences.english: Him who overcomes I will make a pillar in the house of my God, and he will go out no more: and I will put on him the name of my God, and the name of the town of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my new name.
sentences.susu: «Naxan na geeni, n a findima n Marigi Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi kinki ra, a xa lu mɛnni abadan. N nan n Marigi Ala xili nun n Marigi Ala xa taa xili sɛbɛma nɛ a ma. Na taa findixi Darisalamu nɛɛnɛ nan na, Ala naxan nagoroma kelife koore ma. N nan n xili nɛɛnɛ fan sɛbɛma nɛ a ma.

sentences.english: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches.
sentences.susu: Tuli na naxan bɛ, a xa a tuli mati Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa masenyi ra danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae bɛ.»

sentences.english: And to the angel of the church in Laodicea say: These things says the true and certain witness, the head of God's new order:
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛ Layodiseya danxaniyatɔɛ ɲama xa malekɛ ma, masenyi nan ya naxan fatanxi Isa ra, naxan findixi Ala sago rakamali ra, a xa seede laxixɛ, Ala xa daalie daaxi naxan saabui ra:

sentences.english: I have knowledge of your works, that you are not cold or warm: it would be better if you were cold or warm.
sentences.susu: «N wo xa wali kolon. Wo mu xinbeli, wo mu wolen. A xɔli n ma wo xa natɛ tongo, wo xa xinbeli, xa na mu a ra wo xa wolen.

sentences.english: So because you are not one thing or the other, I will have no more to do with you.
sentences.susu: Wo to fa luxi a tagi, wo mu wolen, wo mu xinbeli, n wo raboloma nɛ.

sentences.english: For you say, I have wealth, and have got together goods and land, and have need of nothing; and you are not conscious of your sad and unhappy condition, that you are poor and blind and without clothing.
sentences.susu: Wo bara a fala, ‹Bannamixie nan muxu ra, muxu hayi mu na fefe ma.› Wo mu a kolon a wo findixi tɔɔrɔmixie nan na, a nun misikiinɛe, setaree, dɔnxuie, nun mixi mageli.

sentences.english: If you are wise you will get from me gold tested by fire, so that you may have true wealth; and white robes to put on, so that your shame may not be seen; and oil for your eyes, so that you may see.
sentences.susu: N marasi naxan fima wo ma, wo xa xɛɛma fanyi sara n ma, xɛɛma naxan gbi baxi tɛ ra, alako wo xa findi bannamixie yati ra. Wo xa donma fiixɛ sara n ma, wo xa na ragoro wo ma, alako wo xa ba tixi wo mageli ra, yaagi xa ba wo ma. Wo man xa ya seri sara n ma, alako wo xa fe igbɛ.

sentences.english: To all those who are dear to me, I give sharp words and punishment: then with all your heart have sorrow for your evil ways.
sentences.susu: N nan n xanuntenyie nan xuruma, n e matinxin. Wo xa wakili, wo xa tuubi.

sentences.english: See, I am waiting at the door and giving the sign; if my voice comes to any man's ears and he makes the door open, I will come in to him, and will take food with him and he with me.
sentences.susu: N tixi naadɛ ra, n na a kɔnkɔnfe. Xa mixi nde n xui mɛ, a naadɛ rabi n bɛ, n soma nɛ a xɔnyi, muxu fa muxu dɛge yire keren.»

sentences.english: To him who overcomes I will give a place with me on my high seat, even as I overcame, and am seated with my Father on his high seat.
sentences.susu: «Naxan na geeni, a luma n sɛɛti ma n ma kibanyi kui, alɔ n tan fan to geeni, n fa n magoro n Baba Ala sɛɛti ma a xa kibanyi kui.

sentences.english: He who has ears, let him give ear to what the Spirit says to the churches.
sentences.susu: Tuli na naxan bɛ, a xa a tuli mati Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi xa masenyi ra danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae bɛ.»

sentences.english: After these things I saw a door open in heaven, and the first voice came to my ears, like the sound of a horn, saying, Come up here, and I will make clear to you the things which are to come.
sentences.susu: Na birin to dangi, n naxa ariyanna naadɛ rabixi to koore ma. N man naxa xui nde mɛ, n nu bara naxan singe mɛ. A sɛnbɛ nu gbo alɔ sara. A naxa a masen n bɛ, «I xa te bebiri, n xa fe masen i bɛ naxan fama rabade.»

sentences.english: Straight away I was in the Spirit: and I saw a high seat in heaven, and one was seated on it;
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa n suxu keren na. N naxa kibanyi nde to ariyanna, mangɛ magoroxi a kui.

sentences.english: And to my eyes he was like a jasper and a sardius stone: and there was an arch of light round the high seat, like an emerald.
sentences.susu: A nɔrɛ nu yanbama alɔ gɛmɛ tofanyi mayilenxie, senkui tofanyi nu na a xa kibanyi rabilinyi.

sentences.english: And round about the high seat were four and twenty seats: and on them I saw four and twenty rulers seated, clothed in white robes; and on their heads crowns of gold.
sentences.susu: Kibanyi mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani nu na Ala xa kibanyi rabilinyi, fori mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani magoroxi e kui. Donma fiixɛ nu ragoroxi e ma, mangɛ katanyi xɛɛma daaxi nu saxi e xun na.

sentences.english: And out of the high seat came flames and voices and thunders. And seven lights of fire were burning before the high seat, which are the seven Spirits of God;
sentences.susu: Seyamakɔnyi nun galanyi xuie nu minima kibanyi kui. Lanpui solofere nu dɛxɛma kibanyi ya i. Nee misaalixi Ala Xaxili kamalixi nan na.

sentences.english: And before the high seat there was, as it seemed, a clear sea of glass; and in the middle of the high seat, and round about it, four beasts full of eyes round about.
sentences.susu: Baa tinse fan nu na kibanyi ya i. Nimase naani nu na Ala xa kibanyi rabilinyi, yae nu na e yatagi nun e kobe ma.

sentences.english: And the first beast was like a lion, and the second like an ox, and the third had a face like a man, and the fourth was like an eagle in flight.
sentences.susu: Nimase singe nu maniyaxi yɛtɛ nan na, a firin nde nu maniyaxi ningeyɔrɛ nan na, a saxan nde nu maniyaxi adamadi nan na, a naani nde nu maniyaxi xaruma nan na, naxan ɲɛrɛma koore ma.

sentences.english: And the four beasts, having every one of them six wings, are full of eyes round about and inside: and without resting day and night, they say, Holy, holy, holy, Lord God, Ruler of all, who was and is and is to come.
sentences.susu: Na nimase naani birin, gabutenyi senni nu na e ma. Yae fan nu na e bɛ yire birin, e gabutenyie fari nun e bun ma. Kɔɛ nun yanyi e nu luma a fala ra, «Marigi Ala sɛniyɛn, Marigi Ala sɛniyɛn, Marigi Ala sɛniyɛn. A findixi Sɛnbɛ Kanyi nan na naxan na xoro, to, nun tina.»

sentences.english: And when the beasts give glory and honour to him who is seated on the high seat, to him who is living for ever and ever,
sentences.susu: Na nimase naani nu fa Mangɛ matɔxɔ, e mangɛ binya naxan magoroxi kibanyi kui, e mangɛ tantu, naxan ɲiɲɛ a ra abadan,

sentences.english: The four and twenty rulers go down on their faces before him who is seated on the high seat, and give worship to him who is living for ever and ever, and take off their crowns before the high seat, saying,
sentences.susu: na fori mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani, e felenma bɔxi ma Mangɛ ya i, naxan magoroxi kibanyi kui, e fa a batu naxan ɲiɲɛ a ra abadan. E nu e xa mangɛ katanyi ba e xun na, e nu e sa kibanyi san na, e nu fa a fala,

sentences.english: It is right, our Lord and our God, for you to have glory and honour and power: because by you were all things made, and by your desire they came into being.
sentences.susu: «Muxu Marigi Ala, matɔxɔɛ, binyɛ, nun sɛnbɛ na i tan nan bɛ, barima i tan nan se birin daaxi, i tan nan na birin ɲanigexi, i tan nan na birin nagirixi.»

sentences.english: And I saw in the right hand of him who was seated on the high seat, a book with writing inside it and on the back, shut with seven stamps of wax.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, n naxa Ala to a xa kibanyi kui, buki nde nu na a xɔnyɛ, sɛbɛli tixi a kui nun a fari, a mabalanxi a balanse solofere ra.

sentences.english: And I saw a strong angel saying in a loud voice, Who is able to make the book open, and to undo its stamps?
sentences.susu: N naxa malekɛ sɛnbɛma nde to, a a falama a xui itexi ra, «Nde nɔma yi buki rabide, nde nɔma a balansee bade a ma?»

sentences.english: And no one in heaven, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to get the book open, or to see what was in it.
sentences.susu: Nimase yo mu nu na koore ma, bɔxi ma, xa na mu a ra bɔxi bun ma, naxan nu nɔma na buki rabide, a a kui mato.

sentences.english: And I was very sad, because there was no one able to get the book open or to see what was in it.
sentences.susu: Na kui, n naxa wa a gbegbe ra, barima nimase yo mu nu na, naxan nu nɔma na buki rabide, a a kui mato.

sentences.english: And one of the rulers said to me, Do not be sad: see, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome, and has power to undo the book and its seven stamps.
sentences.susu: Fori nde naxa a fala n bɛ, «I naxa wa, Yuda bɔnsɔɛ xa yɛtɛ, naxan findixi Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ ra, a bara geeni. A tan nan nɔma na buki nun a balanse solofere rabide.»

sentences.english: And I saw in the middle of the high seat and of the four beasts, and in the middle of the rulers, a Lamb in his place, which seemed as if it had been put to death, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n naxa Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ to a tixi kibanyi nun na nimase naani nun na forie tagi. Na Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ nu luxi nɛ alɔ a kɔn naxabaxi. Feri solofere nun ya solofere nu na a bɛ, naxee misaalixi Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi kamalixi ra, naxan nu bara xɛɛ duniɲa yire birin ma.

sentences.english: And he came and took it out of the right hand of him who was seated on the high seat.
sentences.susu: Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ naxa a maso Ala ra, naxan nu magoroxi kibanyi kui, a fa buki rasuxu Ala yirefanyi xɔnyɛ.

sentences.english: And when he had taken the book, the four beasts and the four and twenty rulers went down on their faces before the Lamb, having every one an instrument of music, and gold vessels full of perfumes, which are the prayers of the saints.
sentences.susu: A to buki masɔtɔ, na nimase naani nun na fori mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani, e naxa suyidi Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ bɛ. Kɔra nu na e birin yi ra, a nun surayi sase xɛɛma daaxi naxee rafexi surayi ra, naxan misaalixi sɛniyɛntɔɛe xa Ala maxandie ra.

sentences.english: And their voices are sounding in a new song, saying, It is right for you to take the book and to make it open: for you were put to death and have made an offering to God of your blood for men of every tribe, and language, and people, and nation,
sentences.susu: E naxa bɛɛti nɛɛnɛ nde ba, e nu a fala, «I tan nan daxa yi buki tongode, i tan nan daxa a balansee rabide, barima i bara i yɛtɛ ba sɛrɛxɛ ra, i bara adamadie xunsara Ala bɛ i wuli saabui ra, adamadi naxee kelixi bɔnsɔɛ birin, naxee xui birin falama, naxee fatanxi ɲamanɛ nun si birin na.

sentences.english: And have made them a kingdom and priests to our God, and they are ruling on the earth.
sentences.susu: I bara na adamadie findi sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra muxu Marigi Ala bɛ. I bara e raso Ala xa mangɛya niini bun ma. E fama nɛ duniɲa yamaride.»

sentences.english: And I saw, and there came to my ears the sound of a great number of angels round about the high seat and the beasts and the rulers; and the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n naxa malekɛ wulu wulu wuyaxi to, n naxa e xui mɛ Ala xa kibanyi, na forie, nun na nimasee rabilinyi.

sentences.english: Saying with a great voice, It is right to give to the Lamb who was put to death, power and wealth and wisdom and strength and honour and glory and blessing.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala e xui itexi ra, «Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ naxan baxi sɛrɛxɛ ra, a daxa a xa sɛnbɛ, bannaya, lɔnni, nɔɛ, binyɛ, matɔxɔɛ, nun tantui sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: And to my ears came the voice of everything in heaven and on earth and under the earth and in the sea, and of all things which are in them, saying, To him who is seated on the high seat, and to the Lamb, may blessing and honour and glory and power be given for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: Nimase naxan birin na koore ma, bɔxi fari, bɔxi bun ma, baa ma, a nun daalise birin, n nee birin xui mɛ nɛ, e nu fa a fala, «Matɔxɔɛ, binyɛ, tantui, nun sɛnbɛ na Ala bɛ naxan magoroxi kibanyi kui, a nun Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ bɛ abadan.»

sentences.english: And the four beasts said, So be it. And the rulers went down on their faces and gave worship.
sentences.susu: Na nimase naani naxa a ratin, «Amina.» Forie naxa e felen bɔxi ma, e Ala nun Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ batu.

sentences.english: And I saw when the Lamb undid one of the stamps, and the voice of one of the four beasts came to my ears, saying as with a voice of thunder, Come and see.
sentences.susu: N naxa Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ to buki balanse singe rabi ra. N naxa nimase nde xui mɛ kelife na nimase naani tagi. A xui sɛnbɛ nu gbo alɔ galanyi. A naxa a fala, «Fa.»

sentences.english: And I saw a white horse, and he who was seated on it had a bow; and there was given to him a crown: and he went out with power to overcome.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, n naxa soe fiixɛ nde to, xali suxuxi a ragima yi, mangɛ katanyi saxi a xun ma, a fa siga xunnakeli kui, a man xa sa geeni.

sentences.english: And when the second stamp was undone, the voice of the second beast came to my ears, saying, Come and see.
sentences.susu: A to buki balanse firin nde rabi, n naxa nimase firin nde xui mɛ. A naxa a fala, «Fa.»

sentences.english: And another horse came out, a red horse; and it was given to him who was seated on it to take peace from the earth, so that people might put one another to death: and there was given to him a great sword.
sentences.susu: Soe gbeeli naxa mini. E naxa a ragima yamari a xa bɔɲɛsa ba duniɲa kui, alako adamadie xa nu e bore kɔn naxaba. Santidɛgɛma belebele naxa so a yi ra.

sentences.english: And when the third stamp was undone, the voice of the third beast came to my ears, saying, Come and see. And I saw a black horse; and he who was seated on it had scales in his hand.
sentences.susu: A to buki balanse saxan nde rabi, n naxa nimase saxan nde xui mɛ. A naxa a fala, «Fa.» N naxa soe fɔɔrɛ to. Sikeeli nu suxuxi a ragima yi ra.

sentences.english: And a voice came to my ears, from the middle of the four beasts, saying, A measure of grain for a penny, and three measures of barley for a penny: and see that you do no damage to the oil and the wine.
sentences.susu: N naxa xui nde mɛ na nimase naani tagi, «Mɛngi kilo keren sare lanma lɔxɔɛ keren wali sare nan ma. Fundenyi maniyɛ kilo saxan lanma lɔxɔɛ keren wali sare nan ma. I naxa ture nun wɛni xun nakana.»

sentences.english: And when the fourth stamp was undone, the voice of the fourth beast came to my ears, saying, Come and see.
sentences.susu: A to buki balanse naani nde rabi, n naxa na nimase naani nde xui mɛ. A naxa a fala, «Fa.»

sentences.english: And I saw a grey horse, and the name of him who was seated on it was Death; and Hell came after him. And there was given to them authority over the fourth part of the earth, to put to destruction by the sword, and by taking away their food, and by death, and by the beasts of the earth.
sentences.susu: N naxa soe burɛxɛ xinde daaxi to. A ragima xili nɛ «Faxɛ,» laaxira nu biraxi a fɔxɔ ra. Nɔɛ naxa so e yi ra duniɲa sɛɛti keren xun ma a sɛɛti naani ya ma, alako e xa mixie faxa santidɛgɛma ra, kaamɛ ra, wuganyi ra, a nun sube xaaɲɛxie ra, naxee na wula i.

sentences.english: And when the fifth stamp was undone, I saw under the altar the souls of those who had been put to death for the word of God, and for the witness which they kept.
sentences.susu: A to buki balanse suuli nde rabi, n naxa mixie nii to sɛrɛxɛbade bun ma, mixi naxee kɔn nu bara raxaba barima e nu birama Ala xa masenyi nan fɔxɔ ra, e findi a xa seedee ra.

sentences.english: And they gave a great cry, saying, How long will it be, O Ruler, holy and true, before you take your place as judge and give punishment for our blood to those on the earth?
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala e xui itexi ra, «Marigi sɛniyɛnxi nɔndi falɛ, i buma han tɛmui mundun fafe ra kiiti sade, alako muxu gbe xa ɲɔxɔ duniɲa mixie ma naxee bara muxu faxa?»

sentences.english: And there was given to every one a white robe, and they were ordered to take their rest for a little time, till the number was complete of the other servants, their brothers, who would be put to death, even as they had been.
sentences.susu: Donma kuye fiixɛ naxa so e birin yi ra. Mixi nde naxa a fala e bɛ e xa mamɛ ti sinden, han e walibooree nun e ngaxakerenyie xasabi xa kamali naxee lanma e xa faxa alɔ e tan.

sentences.english: And I saw when the sixth stamp was undone, and there was a great earth-shock; and the sun became black as haircloth, and all the moon became as blood;
sentences.susu: A to buki balanse senni nde rabi, bɔxi naxa sɛrɛn sɛnbɛ ra, soge naxa ifɔɔrɔ alɔ sunnun donma fɔɔrɛ, kike naxa lu alɔ wuli,

sentences.english: And the stars of heaven were falling to the earth, like green fruit from a tree before the force of a great wind.
sentences.susu: tunbuie naxa bira bɔxi ma, alɔ foye belebele xɔrɛ bogi rabirama ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the heaven was taken away like the roll of a book when it is rolled up; and all the mountains and islands were moved out of their places.
sentences.susu: Koore naxa ba na, alɔ kɛɛdi makuntanma ki naxɛ a xa ragata. Geyae nun surie fan naxa keli e yire.

sentences.english: And the kings of the earth, and the rulers, and the chief captains, and the men of wealth, and the strong, and every servant and free man, took cover in the holes and the rocks of the mountains;
sentences.susu: Duniɲa mangɛe, kuntigie, sɔɔri yareratie, bannae, sɛnbɛmae, konyie, nun lasirie, e birin naxa e nɔxun yilie kui a nun geya gɛmɛe longori ra.

sentences.english: And they say to the mountains and to the rocks, Come down on us, covering us from the face of him who is seated on the high seat, and from the wrath of the Lamb:
sentences.susu: E nu fa a fala geyae nun fanyee bɛ, «Wo bira muxu ma, wo xa muxu nɔxun Ala ma, naxan magoroxi mangɛ kibanyi kui, a nun Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ xa xɔnɛ ma.»

sentences.english: For the great day of their wrath is come, and who may keep his place?
sentences.susu: E xa xɔnɛ lɔxɔɛ xungbe bara a li. Nde nɔma a yɛtɛ ratangade na ma?

sentences.english: After this I saw four angels in their places at the four points of the earth, keeping back the four winds in their hands, so that there might be no moving of the wind on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, n naxa malekɛ naani to, e tixi duniɲa tunxui naani ra. E nu duniɲa foye naani ratima, alako foye naxa mini bɔxi ma, baa ma, xa na mu sansie ma.

sentences.english: And I saw another angel coming up from the east, having the mark of the living God: and he said with a great voice to the four angels, to whom it was given to do damage to the earth and the sea,
sentences.susu: N naxa malekɛ gbɛtɛ fan to a kelife sogetede mabiri, Ala Ɲiɲɛ xa tɔnxuma suxuxi a yi ra. A naxa a masen a xui itexi ra, na malekɛ naanie bɛ, naxee nu yamarixi fe xɔnɛ rabade bɔxi nun baa ra,

sentences.english: Do no damage to the earth, or the sea, or the trees, till we have put a mark on the servants of our God.
sentences.susu: «Wo naxa wo bɛlɛxɛ din bɔxi nun baa nun wuri bilie ra sinden, han muxu xa gɛ tɔxunma sade Ala xa walikɛe tigi ma.

sentences.english: And there came to my ears the number of those who had the mark on their brows, a hundred and forty-four thousand, who were marked out of every tribe of the people of Israel.
sentences.susu: N naxa na walikɛe kɔnti xasabi mɛ, Ala xa tɔnxuma saxi naxee ma. E findi mixi wulu kɛmɛ wulu tongo naani nun wulu naani nan na, kelife Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ birin ya ma.

sentences.english: Of the tribe of Judah were marked twelve thousand: of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand: of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand:
sentences.susu: Mixi wulu fu nun firin Yuda bɔnsɔɛ ya ma naxee matɔnxumaxi, mixi wulu fu nun firin Ruben bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, mixi wulu fu nun firin Gadi bɔnsɔɛ ya ma,

sentences.english: Of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand: of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand: of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand:
sentences.susu: mixi wulu fu nun firin Aseri bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, mixi wulu fu nun firin Nafatali bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, mixi wulu fu nun firin Manasi bɔnsɔɛ ya ma,

sentences.english: Of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand: of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand: of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand:
sentences.susu: mixi wulu fu nun firin Simeyɔn bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, mixi wulu fu nun firin Lewi bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, mixi wulu fu nun firin Isakari bɔnsɔɛ ya ma,

sentences.english: Of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand: of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand: of the tribe of Benjamin were marked twelve thousand.
sentences.susu: mixi wulu fu nun firin Sabulon bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, mixi wulu fu nun firin Yusufu bɔnsɔɛ ya ma, mixi wulu fu nun firin Bunyamin bɔnsɔɛ ya ma naxee matɔnxumaxi.»

sentences.english: After these things I saw a great army of people more than might be numbered, out of every nation and of all tribes and peoples and languages, taking their places before the high seat and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, and with branches in their hands,
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, n naxa ɲama gbegbe to, naxan mu nu nɔma kɔntide, kelife si birin, bɔnsɔɛ birin, xabilɛ birin, nun xui birin. E nu tixi Ala xa kibanyi nun Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ ya i, donma kuye fiixɛ ragoroxi e ma, tugi fɛnsɛ suxuxi e yi.

sentences.english: Saying with a loud voice, Salvation to our God who is seated on the high seat, and to the Lamb.
sentences.susu: E naxa a masen e xui itexi ra, «Kisi na muxu Marigi Ala bɛ naxan magoroxi kibanyi kui, nun Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ bɛ.»

sentences.english: And all the angels were round about the high seat, and about the rulers and the four beasts; and they went down on their faces before the high seat, and gave worship to God, saying,
sentences.susu: Malekɛe nu tixi kibanyi, forie nun nimase naanie rabilinyi, e naxa e yatagi rafelen bɔxi ma, e Ala batu

sentences.english: So be it. Let blessing and glory and wisdom and praise and honour and power and strength be given to our God for ever and ever. So be it.
sentences.susu: yi fe falɛ ra, «Amina. Matɔxɔɛ, nɔrɛ, lɔnni, tantui, binyɛ, nɔɛ fanyi, nun sɛnbɛ na muxu Marigi Ala nan bɛ abadan. Amina.»

sentences.english: And one of the rulers made answer, saying to me, These who have on white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui fori nde naxa n maxɔrin, «Nde na na mixie ra donma fiixɛ ragoroxi naxee ma? E kelixi minden?»

sentences.english: And I said to him, My lord, you have knowledge. And he said to me, These are they who came through the great testing, and their robes have been washed and made white in the blood of the Lamb.
sentences.susu: N naxa a yaabi, «N Marigi, i tan nan a kolon.» A naxa a masen n bɛ, «Mixie nan e ra, naxee kelixi na ɲaxankatɛ xungbe kui. E bara e xa donmae xa Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ wuli ra, na nan a toxi e xa donmae fiixɛxi.

sentences.english: This is why they are before the high seat of God; and they are his servants day and night in his house: and he who is seated on the high seat will be a tent over them.
sentences.susu: Na nan a toxi e tixi Ala xa kibanyi ya i, e fa a batu kɔɛ nun yanyi a xa hɔrɔmɔlingira kui. E na Ala xa niini bun ma, naxan magoroxi kibanyi kui.

sentences.english: They will never be in need of food or drink: and they will never again be troubled by the burning heat of the sun:
sentences.susu: Kaamɛ nun ye xɔli mu e suxuma sɔnɔn, soge nun kuye fure mu e tɔɔrɔma sɔnɔn,

sentences.english: For the Lamb who is on the high seat will be their keeper and their guide to fountains of living water: and God will make glad their eyes for ever.
sentences.susu: barima Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ naxan na kibanyi sɛɛti ma, na nan fama e dɛgede, a e xun ti kisi ye yire ra. Ala fama nɛ e yaye birin nafurukude.»

sentences.english: And when the seventh stamp was undone there was quiet in heaven for about half an hour.
sentences.susu: A to buki balanse solofere nde rabi, kuye naxa lu yen waxati tagi ɲɔndɔn bun ma.

sentences.english: And I saw the seven angels who had their place before God; and seven horns were given to them.
sentences.susu: N naxa malekɛ solofere to, naxee nu tixi Ala ya i, sara solofere naxa so e yi ra.

sentences.english: And another angel came and took his place at the altar, having a gold vessel for burning perfume; and there was given to him much perfume, so that he might put it with the prayers of all the saints on the gold altar which was before the high seat.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ gbɛtɛ naxa fa, a ti sɛrɛxɛbade fari, surayi sase xɛɛma daaxi nu na a yi ra. E naxa surayi gbegbe so a yi ra, a nun sɛniyɛntɔɛ birin xa Ala maxandie ra. A naxa na surayi gan sɛrɛxɛbade xɛɛma daaxi ma Ala xa kibanyi ya i.

sentences.english: And the smoke of the perfume, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel's hand.
sentences.susu: Surayi tuuri naxa te Ala ya i, a nun sɛniyɛntɔɛ xa Ala maxandie, kelife malekɛ bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And the angel took the vessel; and he made it full of the fire of the altar, and sent it down on the earth: and there came thunders and voices and flames and a shaking of the earth.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa surayi ganse tongo, a naxa sɛrɛxɛbade tɛ sa a kui, a fa a woli duniɲa ma. Galanyie naxa bula, xuie naxa mɛ, seyamakɔnyie naxa mini, bɔxi naxa sɛrɛn.

sentences.english: And the seven angels who had the seven horns made ready for sounding them.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ solofere, sarae nu na naxee yi ra, nee naxa keli, e xa sarae fe.

sentences.english: And at the sounding of the first, a rain of ice and fire, mixed with blood, was sent on the earth: and a third part of the earth, and of the trees, and all green grass was burned up.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ singe to a xa sara fe, balabalanyi nun tɛ naxa goro duniɲa ma, e masunbuxi wuli ra. Bɔxi itaxunxi saxan na, na dɔxɔde saxan nde naxa gan. Wuri bilie itaxunxi saxan na, na dɔxɔde saxan nde naxa gan. Ɲooge xinde birin naxa gan.

sentences.english: And at the sounding of the second angel, it was as if a great mountain burning with fire was sent into the sea: and a third part of the sea became blood,
sentences.susu: Malekɛ firin nde to sara fe, geya xungbe, tɛ naxan ganfe, a naxa sin baa ma. Baa itaxunxi saxan na, na dɔxɔde keren naxa findi wuli ra.

sentences.english: And destruction came on a third part of the living things which were in the sea, and on a third part of the ships.
sentences.susu: Baa nimasee itaxunxi saxan na, na dɔxɔde saxan nde naxa faxa. Kunkuie itaxunxi saxan na, na dɔxɔde saxan nde fan naxa kana.

sentences.english: And at the sounding of the third angel, there went down from heaven a great star, burning like a flame, and it came on a third part of the rivers, and on the fountains of water.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ saxan nde to sara fe, tunbui dɛxɛxi belebele naxa bira. Xuree itaxunxi saxan na, na tunbui naxa bira na saxan nde ma a nun dulonyie ma.

sentences.english: And the name of the star is Wormwood: and a third part of the waters became bitter; and a number of men came to their end because of the waters, for they were made bitter.
sentences.susu: Na tunbui xili nɛ «Xɔnɛ.» Duniɲa ye itaxunxi saxan na, na dɔxɔde saxan nde to findi xɔnɛ ra, adamadi gbegbe naxa faxa na ma.

sentences.english: And at the sounding of the fourth angel, a third part of the sun, and of the moon, and of the stars was made dark, so that there was no light for a third part of the day and of the night.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naani nde to sara fe, soge, kike, nun tunbui itaxunxi saxan na, na dɔxɔde saxan nde naxa findi dimi ra. Nde naxa ba yanyi nun kɔɛ xa naiyalanyi ra.

sentences.english: And there came to my ears the cry of an eagle in flight in the middle of heaven, saying with a great voice, Trouble, trouble, trouble, to all on the earth, because of the other voices of the horns of the three angels, whose sounding is still to come.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui n naxa xaruma nde xui mɛ koore ma, a naxa a fala a xui itexi ra, «Ɲaxankatɛ na duniɲa mixie bɛ, ɲaxankatɛ na e bɛ sara fe tɛmui, malekɛ saxanyie fama naxee fede.»

sentences.english: And at the sounding of the fifth angel I saw a star falling from heaven to the earth: and there was given to him the key of the great deep.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ suuli nde to sara fe, n naxa tunbui to bira ra bɔxi kelife koore ma. E naxa yili tilinxi naadɛ saabi so a yi ra.

sentences.english: And he made the great deep open and a smoke went up from it, like the smoke of a great oven; and the sun and the air were made dark because of the smoke.
sentences.susu: A naxa na yili naadɛ rabi, tuuri gbegbe naxa mini a kui alɔ tɛ belebele tuuri han soge naxa makoto, kuye naxa idimi.

sentences.english: And from the smoke locusts came out on the earth; and power was given them, like the power of scorpions.
sentences.susu: Tugumie naxa mini tuuri kui, e fa goro bɔxi ma. E nu bara sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ alɔ tali.

sentences.english: And they were ordered to do no damage to the grass of the earth, or any green thing, or any tree, but only to such men as have not the mark of God on their brows.
sentences.susu: E nu bara yaamari sɔtɔ a falafe ra e naxa din bɔxi ɲooge ra, nun se xinde, a nun wuri bili yo ra. A nu lanma e xa adamadie gbansan nan tɔɔrɔ Ala xa tɔnxuma mu saxi naxee tigi ma.

sentences.english: And orders were given them not to put them to death, but to give them great pain for five months: and their pain was as the pain from the wound of a scorpion.
sentences.susu: E nu bara yaamari sɔtɔ a falafe ra e naxa adamadie faxa, e xa e tɔɔrɔ tun kike suuli bun ma. E nu mixi bunma nɛ alɔ tali.

sentences.english: And in those days men will be hoping for death, and it will not come to them; and they will have a great desire for death, and death will go in flight from them.
sentences.susu: Na lɔxɔɛe, mixie faxɛ xɔli mawama nɛ na tɔɔrɛ xa fe ra, kɔnɔ e mu nɔma faxade. Faxɛ xɔli e suxuma nɛ, kɔnɔ faxɛ a makuyama nɛ e ra.

sentences.english: And the forms of the locusts were like horses made ready for war; and on their heads they had crowns like gold, and their faces were as the faces of men.
sentences.susu: Na tugumie maniyaxi soe nan na, naxee rawalima gere kui. Mangɛ katanyi xɛɛma daaxi nu dusuxi e xun na, e yatagie nu luxi nɛ alɔ mixie.

sentences.english: And they had hair like the hair of women, and their teeth were as the teeth of lions.
sentences.susu: E xunsɛxɛ nu luxi nɛ alɔ ginɛe xunsɛxɛ. E ɲinyie nu luxi nɛ alɔ yɛtɛ ɲinyie.

sentences.english: And they had breastplates like iron, and the sound of their wings was as the sound of carriages, like an army of horses rushing to the fight.
sentences.susu: Wure makantase nu na e kanke ma, e gabutenyie nu xui raminima alɔ sɔɔri ragise xui, soe gbegbe naxan bɛndunma.

sentences.english: And they have pointed tails like scorpions; and in their tails is their power to give men wounds for five months.
sentences.susu: E xuli nu mixi bunma alɔ tali, na xɔnɛ nu fa mixi tɔɔrɔ kike suuli bun ma.

sentences.english: They have over them as king the angel of the great deep: his name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in the Greek language Apollyon.
sentences.susu: E xa yarerati nu findixi na yili tilinxi xa malekɛ nan na, naxan xili nu falaxi Eburu xui «Abadon,» a nu falaxi Girɛki xui «Apoliyon,» na nan na ki «Yire Kanɛ.»

sentences.english: The first Trouble is past: see, there are still two Troubles to come.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ singe bara dangi, firin nan luxi.

sentences.english: And at the sounding of the sixth angel a voice came to my ears from the horns of the gold altar which is before God,
sentences.susu: Malekɛ senni nde to sara fe, n naxa xui nde mɛ kelife sɛrɛxɛbade xɛɛma daaxi feri tunxun naanie ma, naxan na Ala ya i.

sentences.english: Saying to the sixth angel who had the horn, Make free the four angels who are chained at the great river Euphrates.
sentences.susu: Na xui naxa a fala malekɛ senni nde bɛ, sara nu suxuxi naxan yi, «Na malekɛ naani rabɛɲin, naxee xirixi Efirati xure ma.»

sentences.english: And the four angels were made free, who were ready for the hour and day and month and year, that they might put to death a third part of men.
sentences.susu: Na malekɛ naanie nu na waxati yati nan mamɛma, alako e xa adamadi ndee faxa. Adamadie itaxunxi saxan na, e xa na dɔxɔde saxan nde faxa. E naxa fulun na wali xili ma.

sentences.english: And the number of the armies of the horsemen was twice ten thousand times ten thousand: the number of them came to my ears.
sentences.susu: Na soe ragi gali xasabi nu dangi miliyɔn kɛmɛ firin na. N naxa na kɔnti mɛ.

sentences.english: And so I saw the horses in the vision, and those who were seated on them, having breastplates of fire and glass and of burning stone: and the heads of the horses were as the heads of lions; and out of their mouths came fire and smoke and a smell of burning.
sentences.susu: Na laamatunyi kui n naxa na soee nun e ragie to. E kanke makantase nu maɲingixi nɛ a gbeeli, a fɔɔrɛ, nun a nerefunyi daaxi. Soe xunyie nu luxi alɔ yɛtɛe xunyi. Tɛ, tuuri, nun soda nu minima e dɛ kui.

sentences.english: By these evils a third part of men was put to death, by the fire, and the smoke, and the burning smell which came out of their mouths.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa mixi itaxunxi saxan na, na dɔxɔde saxan nde naxa faxa na gbaloe saxanyi mɔɔli ra: tɛ, tuuri, nun soda naxan nu minima e dɛ kui.

sentences.english: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails: because their tails are like snakes, and have heads, and with them they give wounds.
sentences.susu: Na soee sɛnbɛ nu na e dɛ nun e xuli nan kui. E xuli nu maniyaxi bɔximase nan na, xunyi nu na a bɛ naxan mixi tɔɔrɔma.

sentences.english: And the rest of the people, who were not put to death by these evils, were not turned from the works of their hands, but went on giving worship to evil spirits, and images of gold and silver and brass and stone and wood which have no power of seeing or hearing or walking:
sentences.susu: Mixi naxee mu faxa na gbaloe saabui ra, e mu gbilen e xa wali kobie fɔxɔ ra. E nu ɲinnɛe nan batuma, a nun kuyee xɛɛma daaxi, gbeti daaxi, wure gbeeli daaxi, gɛmɛ daaxi, nun wuri daaxi, naxee mu nɔma se tode, naxee mu nɔma fe mɛde, naxee mu nɔma ɲɛrɛde.

sentences.english: And they had no regret for putting men to death, or for their use of secret arts, or for the evil desires of the flesh, or for taking the property of others.
sentences.susu: Na mixie mu gbilen e xa faxa tife fɔxɔ ra, e xa manduru walie, e xa fe ɲaaxie, nun e xa muɲɛe xa fe fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And I saw another strong angel coming down out of heaven, clothed with a cloud; and an arch of coloured light was round his head, and his face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire;
sentences.susu: N naxa malekɛ sɛnbɛma gbɛtɛ to goro ra kelife koore nuxui kui. Senkui nu na a xunyi rabilinyi, a yatagi nu yanbama alɔ soge, a sanyie nu maniyaxi tɛ nan na.

sentences.english: And he had in his hand a little open book: and he put his right foot on the sea, and his left on the earth;
sentences.susu: Buki lanmadi nu na a bɛlɛxɛ, a rabixi. Malekɛ yirefanyi sanyi nu tixi baa fari, boore fan nu tixi xare ma.

sentences.english: And he gave a loud cry, like the angry voice of a lion: and at his cry the voices of the seven thunders were sounding.
sentences.susu: A naxa a xui ramini sɛnbɛ ra, naxan maniya yɛtɛ xui ra. Galanyi solofere naxa a xui ratin.

sentences.english: And when the seven thunders had given out their voices, I was about to put their words down: and a voice from heaven came to my ears, saying, Keep secret the things which the seven thunders said, and do not put them in writing.
sentences.susu: Na galanyi solofere xui to mini, n nu wama na sɛbɛfe, kɔnɔ xui nde naxa keli koore ma, a a fala n bɛ, «Galanyi solofere xa masenyi nɔxun, i naxa a sɛbɛ.»

sentences.english: And the angel which I saw taking his position on the sea and on the earth, put up his right hand to heaven,
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxan sanyi nu tixi baa nun xare fari, a naxa a yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛ itala koore ma,

sentences.english: And took his oath by him who is living for ever and ever, who made the heaven and the things in it, and the earth and the things in it, and the sea and the things in it, that there would be no more waiting:
sentences.susu: a fa a kali Ala ra naxan ɲiɲɛ a ra abadan, naxan koore, bɔxi, nun baa daa, a nun e kui se birin. A naxa a masen a waxati mu fa dugundife sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: But in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when the sound of his horn is about to come, then will the secret of God be complete, of which he gave the good news to his servants the prophets.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ solofere nde na a xa sara fe tɛmui naxɛ, Ala gundo fama nɛ kamalide alɔ a nu bara a masen a xa konyi namiɲɔnmɛe bɛ ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the voice came to me again from heaven, saying, Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who has his place on the sea and on the earth.
sentences.susu: Na xui naxan nu bara wɔyɛn n bɛ kelife koore ma, na man naxa a masen n bɛ, «Siga, i sa buki lanmadi rabixi tongo naxan na malekɛ bɛlɛxɛ, malekɛ naxan sanyi tixi baa nun xare fari.»

sentences.english: And I went to the angel, and said to him, Give me the little book. And he said to me: Put it in your mouth; and it will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be sweet as honey.
sentences.susu: N naxa siga na malekɛ yire, n fa a maxandi a xa na buki lanmadi so n yi ra. A naxa a fala n bɛ, «I xa a tongo, a don. A xɔnɛ rasoma nɛ i furi, kɔnɔ a ɲɔxunma nɛ i dɛ kui alɔ kumi.»

sentences.english: And I took the little book out of the angel's hand and did as he said; and it was sweet as honey in my mouth: and when I had taken it, my stomach was made bitter.
sentences.susu: N naxa na buki lanmadi tongo malekɛ bɛlɛxɛ, n naxa a don. A nu ɲɔxun n dɛ kui alɔ kumi, kɔnɔ a to n furi kui li, a naxa findi xɔnɛ ra.

sentences.english: And they said to me, You are to give word again of what is coming in the future to the peoples and nations and languages and kings.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui a naxa a fala n bɛ, «A lanma i man xa wɔyɛn Ala xili ra ɲamanɛe xa fe ra, sie xa fe ra, xui gbɛtɛ falɛe xa fe ra, nun mangɛ gbegbe xa fe ra.»

sentences.english: And there was given to me a measuring rod: and one said, Go up and take the measure of the house of God, and the altar, and the worshippers in it.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ nde naxa se maniyase wuri daaxi so n yi ra, a nu fa a fala, «Keli, i xa Ala xa hɔrɔmɔbanxi nun sɛrɛxɛbade maniya, i man xa batulae kɔnti.

sentences.english: But do not take the measure of the space outside the house; because it has been given to the nations: and the holy town will be under their feet for forty-two months.
sentences.susu: I naxa yire maniya naxan na tande, barima si gbɛtɛe fama mɛnni nan tongode, e fa taa sɛniyɛnxi kana kike tongo naani nun firin bun ma.

sentences.english: And I will give orders to my two witnesses, and they will be prophets for a thousand, two hundred and sixty days, clothed with haircloth.
sentences.susu: N masenyi soma n ma seede firinyie nan yi ra, e naxan tima n xili ra xi wulu keren xi kɛmɛ firin nun xi tongo senni bun ma, sunnun donma ragoroxi e ma.

sentences.english: These are the two olive-trees and the two lights, which are before the Lord of the earth.
sentences.susu: Na seede firinyie misaalixi oliwi wuri firin nan na, a nun lanpui firin naxee tixi Daali Marigi ya i.

sentences.english: And if any man would do them damage, fire comes out of their mouth and puts an end to those who are working against them: and if any man has a desire to do them damage, in this way will he be put to death.
sentences.susu: Xa mixi nde fa wa fe ɲaaxi rabafe e ra, tɛ nan minima e dɛ kui, a e yaxuie xa fe kana. Iyo, xa mixi nde wama e tɔɔrɔfe, na kanyi faxama na mɔɔli nan na.

sentences.english: These have the power to keep the heaven shut, so that there may be no rain in the days when they are prophets: and they have power over the waters to make them into blood, and to send every sort of disease on the earth as their pleasure is.
sentences.susu: Sɛnbɛ na e bɛ koore balanfe ra, alako tunɛ naxa fa e xa namiɲɔnmɛ wali raba tɛmui. Sɛnbɛ na e bɛ ye masarafe wuli ra, a nun fure ɲaaxi mɔɔli wuyaxi raminife duniɲa ma e wama a xɔn ma tɛmui naxɛ.»

sentences.english: And when they have come to the end of their witness, the beast which comes up out of the great deep will make war on them and overcome them and put them to death.
sentences.susu: Na seede firinyie na gɛ e xa seedeɲɔxɔya ra, na sube naxan minixi yili tilinxi kui, na nan e gerema, a nɔ e ra, a e faxa.

sentences.english: And their dead bodies will be in the open street of the great town, which in the spirit is named Sodom and Egypt, where their Lord was put to death on the cross.
sentences.susu: E furee sama nɛ taa belebele malande, e Marigi banban wuri magalanbuxi ma dɛnnaxɛ. Na taa maniyaxi Sodoma nan na, xa na mu a ra Misira.

sentences.english: And the peoples and tribes and languages and nations will be looking on their dead bodies three days and a half, and will not let their dead bodies be put in the earth.
sentences.susu: Mixie kelima si, bɔnsɔɛ, xui, nun ɲamanɛ birin nan ma, e fa e fure matode xi saxan nun a tagi bun ma. E mu tinma mixi xa e ragata.

sentences.english: And those who are on the earth will have pleasure and delight over them; and they will send offerings one to another because these two prophets gave great trouble to all on the earth.
sentences.susu: Mixie fama sɛɛwade duniɲa ma na mixi firinyie nan faxafe ra, barima na namiɲɔnmɛ firinyie nu bara mixie tɔɔrɔ. E se ndee fi e booree ma na sɛɛwɛ xa fe ra.

sentences.english: And after three days and a half the breath of life from God went into them, and they got up on their feet; and great fear came on those who saw them.
sentences.susu: Na xi saxan nun a tagi to dangi, Ala naxa nii raso e fate, e man xa ti e sanyie xun na. Naxan birin e to, e naxa gaaxu ki fanyi ra.

sentences.english: And a great voice from heaven came to their ears, saying to them, Come up here. And they went up into heaven in the cloud, and were seen by those desiring their death.
sentences.susu: Na seedee naxa xui sɛnbɛma nde mɛ kelife koore ma a falafe ra, «Wo xa te han be.» E naxa te koore ma nuxui kui e yaxuie ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And in that hour there was a great earth-shock and a tenth part of the town came to destruction; and in the earth-shock seven thousand persons came to their end: and the rest were in fear, and gave glory to the God of heaven.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, bɔxi naxa sɛrɛn. Taa itaxunxi fu ra, na dɔxɔde fu nde naxa bira. Na bɔxi xa sɛrɛnyi naxa mixi wulu solofere faxa, mixi dɔnxɔɛe naxa kaaba, e fa Ala matɔxɔ, naxan na koore ma.

sentences.english: The second Trouble is past: see, the third Trouble comes quickly.
sentences.susu: Ɲaxankatɛ firin nde bara dangi, a gbe mu luxi a saxan nde fan xa fa.

sentences.english: And at the sounding of the seventh angel there were great voices in heaven, saying, The kingdom of the world has become the kingdom of our Lord, and of his Christ, and he will have rule for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ solofere nde to sara fe, xui itexie naxa mini koore ma a falafe ra, «Mangɛya naxan nu na duniɲa ma, na bara findi muxu Marigi nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi gbe ra. A xa mangɛya buma nɛ abadan.»

sentences.english: And the four and twenty rulers, who are seated before God on their high seats, went down on their faces and gave worship to God, saying,
sentences.susu: Na fori mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani, naxee nu magoroxi kibanyie kui Ala ya i, e naxa e felen bɔxi ma, e Ala batu.

sentences.english: We give you praise, O Lord God, Ruler of all, who is and who was; because you have taken up your great power and are ruling your kingdom.
sentences.susu: E naxa a fala, «Muxu bara muxu Marigi Ala Sɛnbɛ Kanyi tantu, naxan nu na singe han to, barima i bara i sɛnbɛ magaaxuxi ramini, i xa mangɛya xa ti duniɲa.

sentences.english: And the nations were angry, and your wrath has come, and the time for the dead to be judged, and the time of reward for your servants, the prophets, and for the saints, and for those in whom is the fear of your name, small and great, and the time of destruction for those who made the earth unclean.
sentences.susu: Ɲamanɛe nu bara xɔnɔ, kɔnɔ i xa xɔnɛ bara e li, kiiti waxati bara fa. Na kui, mixi faxaxie makiitima nɛ, i xa konyi namiɲɔnmɛe e sare sɔtɔma nɛ, a nun sɛniyɛntɔɛe, nun naxee gaaxuma i xili ya ra, dimɛdie nun forie. Naxee bara duniɲa kana, e fan xun nakanama nɛ.»

sentences.english: And the house of God which is in heaven was open; and the ark of his agreement was seen in his house, and there were flames and voices and thunders and an earth-shock and a rain of ice.
