sentences.susu: Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira naxan na koore ma, a naxa rabi, birin naxa Ala xa saatɛ kankira to naxan na hɔrɔmɔlingira kui. Na tɛmui seyamakɔnyie, galanyi xuie, bɔxi sɛrɛnyi, nun balabalanyi belebele naxa mini sɛnbɛ ra.

sentences.english: And a great sign was seen in heaven: a A woman clothed with the sun, and with the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.
sentences.susu: Tɔnxuma belebele naxa mini koore ma. Soge nu na na ginɛ nde rabilinyi, kike nu na a sanyi bun ma, tunbui fu nun firin nu na a xun na alɔ mangɛ katanyi.

sentences.english: And she was with child; and she gave a cry, in the pains of childbirth.
sentences.susu: A nu na gbelegbelefe tɔɔrɛ kui, barima a nu na di barife a tɛɛgɛxi naxan ma.

sentences.english: And there was seen another sign in heaven; a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.
sentences.susu: Tɔnxuma gbɛtɛ fan naxa mini koore ma. Sube magaaxuxi xungbe nde nu na, a gbeelixi alɔ tɛ, xunyi solofere nu na a bɛ, a nun feri fu. Mangɛ katanyie nu na a xunyi solofere birin fari.

sentences.english: And his tail was pulling a third part of the stars of heaven down to the earth, and the dragon took his place before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when the birth had taken place he might put an end to her child.
sentences.susu: Tunbui itaxunxi saxan na, a xuli naxa din na dɔxɔde saxan nde ra, a e woli bɔxi ma. Sube magaaxuxi naxa keli, a fa ti ginɛ ya i naxan nu na di barife, alako a xa na diyɔrɛ don.

sentences.english: And she gave birth to a son, a male child, who was to have rule over all the nations with a rod of iron: and her child was taken up to God and to his high seat.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa di xɛmɛ bari, naxan fama si birin yamaride a xɔrɔxɔɛ ra. Ginɛ to di bari, na di naxa te Ala yire, a xa mangɛ kibanyi na dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And the woman went in flight to the waste land, where she has a place made ready by God, so that there they may give her food a thousand, two hundred and sixty days.
sentences.susu: Ginɛ naxa a gi, a siga yire nde gbengberenyi ma Ala nu bara naxan yailan a bɛ, alako a xa balo mɛnni xi wulu keren xi kɛmɛ firin nun tongo senni bun ma.

sentences.english: And there was war in heaven: Michael and his angels going out to the fight with the dragon; and the dragon and his angels made war,
sentences.susu: Gere naxa mini koore ma. Minkayilu nun a xa malekɛe naxa na sube magaaxuxi nun a xa malekɛe gere,

sentences.english: And they were overcome, and there was no more place for them in heaven.
sentences.susu: kɔnɔ na sube mu nɔ Minkayilu nun a xa malekɛe ra. Na kui, sube magaaxuxi nun a xa malekɛe mu nɔ sabatide koore ma sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And the great dragon was forced down, the old snake, who is named the Evil One and Satan, by whom all the earth is turned from the right way; he was forced down to the earth, and his angels were forced down with him.
sentences.susu: E naxa na sube magaaxuxi xungbe woli bɔxi ma, a nun a xa malekɛe. A tan nan findixi na bɔximase fori ra, naxan xili Ibulisa, xa na mu a ra Sentanɛ. A bara duniɲa birin madaxu.

sentences.english: And a great voice in heaven came to my ears, saying, Now is come the salvation, and the power, and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ: because he who says evil against our brothers before our God day and night is forced down.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui, n naxa xui itexi mɛ koore ma, a a falama, «Yakɔsi, kisi tɛmui bara a li, muxu Marigi Ala sɛnbɛ nun a xa mangɛya, nun a xa Mixi Sugandixi xa mangɛya bara fa, barima naxan nu muxu ngaxakerenyie kalamuma muxu Marigi Ala ya i kɔɛ nun yanyi ra, na bara bira.

sentences.english: And they overcame him through the blood of the Lamb and the word of their witness; and loving not their lives they freely gave themselves up to death.
sentences.susu: Muxu ngaxakerenyie xutu sɔtɔxi a ma Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ wuli nun e xa seedeɲɔxɔya nan saabui ra. E mu kankan e xa simaya ma, e mu gaaxu faxɛ ya ra.

sentences.english: Be glad then, O heavens, and you who are in them. But there is trouble for the earth and the sea: because the Evil One has come down to you, being very angry, having the knowledge that he has but a short time.
sentences.susu: Na kui, koore nun naxee sabatixi naa, e xa ɲɛlɛxin. Kɔnɔ ɲaxankatɛ bara lu bɔxi nun baa ma, barima Ibulisa bara bira wo mabiri. A xɔnɔxi barima a bara a kolon a tɛmui gbegbe mu luxi a bɛ kɔrɛ.»

sentences.english: And when the dragon saw that he was forced down to the earth, he made cruel attacks on the woman who gave birth to the male child.
sentences.susu: Sube magaaxuxi to a kolon, e bara a woli bɔxi ma, a naxa bira na ginɛ fɔxɔ ra, naxan na di xɛmɛ bari.

sentences.english: And there were given to the woman two wings of a great eagle, so that she might go in flight into the waste land, to her place, where she is given food for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the snake.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ xaruma gabutenyi naxa lu na ginɛ bɛ, alako a xa tugan sigafe ra gbengberenyi ma, a luma balo ra dɛnnaxɛ waxati saxan nun a tagi bun ma. Mɛnni a nu bara makuya na bɔximase ra.

sentences.english: And the snake sent out of his mouth after the woman a river of water, so that she might be taken away by the stream.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ bɔximase naxa xure ramini a dɛ kui, a xa ginɛ madula.

sentences.english: And the earth gave help to the woman, and with open mouth took up the river which the dragon sent out of his mouth.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui bɔxi naxa na xure ye min, sube magaaxuxi nu bara naxan namini a dɛ kui, alako a xa na ginɛ rakisi.

sentences.english: And the dragon was angry with the woman and went away to make war on the rest of her seed, who keep the orders of God, and the witness of Jesus:
sentences.susu: Sube magaaxuxi to xɔnɔ na ginɛ ma, a naxa siga na ginɛ bɔnsɔɛ dɔnxɔɛe gerede, naxee Ala xa sɛriyɛ rabatuma, e man la Isa xa seedeɲɔxɔya ra.

sentences.english: And he took his place on the sand of the sea. And I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads, and on his horns ten crowns, and on his heads unholy names.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi n naxa sube magaaxuxi nde to te ra ye xɔɔra, feri fu na a xunyi solofere ma, mangɛ katanyie dɔxɔxi na feri fu fari. Marasɔtɔ xilie fan nu sɛbɛxi a xunyie ma.

sentences.english: And the beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were as the feet of a bear, and his mouth as the mouth of a lion: and the dragon gave him his power and his seat and great authority.
sentences.susu: Na sube magaaxuxi nu maniyaxi baratɛ nan na, a sanyie sɛnbɛ nu gbo, a dɛ nu luxi nɛ alɔ yɛtɛ dɛ. Na sube magaaxuxi naxa a sɛnbɛ, a xa nɔɛ, nun a xa kibanyi lu sube boore yi ra.

sentences.english: And I saw one of his heads as if it had been given a death-wound; and his death-wound was made well: and all the earth was wondering at the beast.
sentences.susu: Fi ɲaaxi to lu a xunyi keren ma, a naxa yalan. Na fi to mu a faxa, duniɲa naxa kaaba, e birin naxa bira a fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And they gave worship to the dragon, because he gave authority to the beast; and worshipping the beast, they said, Who is like the beast? and who is able to go to war with him?
sentences.susu: Duniɲa mixie naxa tuubi sube magaaxuxi bɛ, barima a tan nan nu bara nɔɛ so sube boore yi ra. E man naxa tuubi sube boore bɛ, e nu a fala, «Nde maniya yi sube ra, nde nɔma a gerede?»

sentences.english: And there was given to him a mouth to say words of pride against God; and there was given to him authority to go on for forty-two months.
sentences.susu: Na sube naxa nɔɛ sɔtɔ a xa yɛtɛ igboe masenyi nun marasɔtɔɛ falɛ ra. A naxa nɔɛ sɔtɔ, a xa wali kike tongo naani nun firin bun ma.

sentences.english: And his mouth was open to say evil against God, and against his name and his Tent, even against those who are in heaven.
sentences.susu: A naxa Ala rasɔtɔ, a Ala xili kana, a Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira rasɔtɔ, a nun naxee sabatixi koore ma.

sentences.english: And it was given to him to make war on the saints and to overcome them: and there was given to him authority over every tribe and people and language and nation.
sentences.susu: A naxa nɔɛ sɔtɔ alako a xa sɛniyɛntɔɛe gere, a xa nɔ e ra. A naxa nɔɛ sɔtɔ bɔnsɔɛ, si, xui, nun ɲamanɛ birin xun ma.

sentences.english: And all who are on the earth will give him worship, everyone whose name has not been from the first in the book of life of the Lamb who was put to death.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa mixi birin fama tuubide a tan nan bɛ, naxee xili mu sɛbɛxi Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ kɔn naxabaxi xa kisi buki kui kabi duniɲa fɔlɛ.

sentences.english: If any man has ears, let him give ear.
sentences.susu: Tuli na naxan bɛ, a xa a tuli mati yi masenyi ra.

sentences.english: If any man sends others into prison, into prison he will go: if any man puts to death with the sword, with the sword will he be put to death. Here is the quiet strength and the faith of the saints.
sentences.susu: Konyiya ragirixi mixi naxan ma, a sigama nɛ konyiya kui. Santidɛgɛma faxɛ ragirixi mixi naxan ma, na kanyi fan faxama nɛ santidɛgɛma ra. Sɛniyɛntɔɛe xa tunnabɛxi nun danxaniya kolonma na nan kui.

sentences.english: And I saw another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb, and his voice was like that of a dragon.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi n man naxa sube magaaxuxi gbɛtɛ to a tefe bɔxi bun ma, feri firin nu na a bɛ alɔ yɛxɛɛ, a nu wɔyɛnma alɔ sube magaaxuxi.

sentences.english: And he makes use of all the authority of the first beast before his eyes. And he makes the earth and those who are in it give worship to the first beast, whose death-wound was made well.
sentences.susu: A nu na sube magaaxuxi singe sɛnbɛ nan nawalife na ya xɔri, a a niya duniɲa mixi birin xa tuubi na sube magaaxuxi singe bɛ, naxan xa fi ɲaaxi nu bara yalan.

sentences.english: And he does great signs, even making fire come down from heaven on the earth before the eyes of men.
sentences.susu: A nu luma kaabanakoe belebele raba ra, han a tɛ ragoro bɔxi ma kelife koore ma mixie ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And those who are on the earth are turned from the true way by him through the signs which he was given power to do before the beast; giving orders to those who are on the earth to make an image to the beast, who was wounded by the sword, and came to life.
sentences.susu: A to na sɛnbɛ sɔtɔ, a naxa duniɲa mixie madaxu a xa kaabanakoe ra na sube magaaxuxi singe ya xɔri. A naxa a fala duniɲa mixie bɛ e xa kuye yailan naxan maniya na sube magaaxuxi singe ra, naxan nu bara maxɔnɔ santidɛgɛma ra, kɔnɔ a mu faxa.

sentences.english: And he had power to give breath to the image of the beast, so that words might come from the image of the beast, and that he might have all those who did not give worship to the image of the beast put to death.
sentences.susu: E to na kuye yailan, a naxa nɔɛ sɔtɔ a xa a niya na kuye xa wɔyɛn, mixi birin xa faxa naxan mu tuubima na kuye bɛ.

sentences.english: And he gives to all, small and great, the poor and those who have wealth, the free and those who are not free, a mark on their right hand or on their brows;
sentences.susu: A naxa yaamari fi, dimɛdie nun forie, bannae nun setaree, lasirie nun konyie, tɔnxuma xa sa e birin yirefanyi bɛlɛxɛ ma, xa na mu e tigi ma,

sentences.english: So that no man might be able to do trade but he who has the mark, even the name of the beast or the number of his name.
sentences.susu: alako mixi matɔnxumataree naxa sare so, e naxa sare mati. Na tɔnxuma findixi sube xili nan na, xa na mu a ra yi kɔnti nan findixi xili ra.

sentences.english: Here is wisdom. He who has knowledge let him get the number of the beast; because it is the number of a man: and his number is Six hundred and sixty-six.
sentences.susu: Lɔnni na naxan bɛ, a xa na kɔnti kolon, barima a adamadi xa fe masenma. Na kɔnti naxan findixi xili ra a findixi kɛmɛ senni, tongo senni nun senni nan na.

sentences.english: And I saw the Lamb on the mountain of Zion, and with him a hundred and forty-four thousand, marked on their brows with his name and the name of his Father.
sentences.susu: N to n ya rage, n naxa Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ to a tixi Siyoni geya fari. Mixi wulu kɛmɛ wulu tongo naani nun naani nu na a sɛɛti ma, Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ xili nun a Baba xili sɛbɛxi e tigie ma.

sentences.english: And a voice from heaven came to my ears, like the sound of great waters, and the sound of loud thunder: and the voice which came to me was like the sound of players, playing on instruments of music.
sentences.susu: N naxa xui nde mɛ koore ma, alɔ xure xungbe, xa na mu a ra alɔ galanyi. A nu luxi nɛ alɔ mixie nan nu kɔra bɔnbɔfe.

sentences.english: And they made as it seemed a new song before the high seat, and before the four beasts and the rulers: and no man might have knowledge of the song but the hundred and forty-four thousand, even those from the earth whom God has made his for a price.
sentences.susu: E nu na bɛɛti nɛɛnɛ bafe mangɛ kibanyi ya i, a nun na nimase naani nun na forie. Mixi yo mu nu nɔma na bɛɛti matinkande, fo na duniɲa mixi wulu kɛmɛ wulu tongo naani nun naani naxee xun nu bara sara.

sentences.english: These are they who have not made themselves unclean with women; for they are virgins. These are they who go after the Lamb wherever he goes. These were taken from among men to be the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.
sentences.susu: E mu nu yɛnɛ rabaxi ginɛ ra, e nu sɛniyɛn. E birama na Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ fɔxɔ ra yire birin. E xun nu bara sara mixie tagi, alako e xa findi Ala gbe nun Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ gbe ra, alɔ sɛrɛxɛ singe naxan bama Ala bɛ xɛ xaba tɛmui.

sentences.english: And in their mouth there was no false word, for they are untouched by evil.
sentences.susu: E dɛ mu nu wule falaxi, marakɔrɔsi yo mu nu e ma.

sentences.english: And I saw another angel in flight between heaven and earth, having eternal good news to give to those who are on the earth, and to every nation and tribe and language and people,
sentences.susu: N naxa malekɛ gbɛtɛ to a ɲɛrɛ ra koore ma. Xibaaru fanyi nu na a yi ra duniɲa mixie bɛ, si, bɔnsɔɛ, xui, nun ɲamanɛ birin bɛ abadan.

sentences.english: Saying with a loud voice, Have fear of God and give him glory; because the hour of his judging is come; and give worship to him who made heaven and earth and the sea and the fountains of water.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a xui itexi ra, «Wo xa gaaxu Ala ya ra, wo xa a matɔxɔ, barima a xa kiiti waxati bara a li. Wo xa wo igoro a bɛ, naxan koore, bɔxi, baa, nun dulonyie daaxi.»

sentences.english: And a second angel came after, saying, Destruction has come to Babylon the great, which gave to all the nations the wine of the wrath of her evil ways.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ firin nde nu biraxi a fɔxɔ ra, a nu fa a fala, «Babilɔn belebele bara bira. Babilɔn bara bira, naxan ɲamanɛe rasiisixi a xa fe ɲaaxie ra.»

sentences.english: And a third angel came after them, saying with a loud voice, If any man gives worship to the beast and his image, and has his mark on his brow or on his hand,
sentences.susu: Malekɛ saxan nde nu biraxi e fɔxɔ ra, a nu fa a fala a xui itexi ra, «Xa mixi nde a igoroma na sube bɛ, xa na mu a ra na kuye bɛ naxan yailanxi a misaali ra, a fa sa li tɔnxuma na a tigi ma, xa na mu a bɛlɛxɛ ma,

sentences.english: To him will be given of the wine of God's wrath which is ready unmixed in the cup of his wrath and he will have cruel pain, burning with fire before the holy angels and before the Lamb:
sentences.susu: na kanyi fan Ala xa xɔnɛ kolonma nɛ, a fa lu alɔ siisila naxan beere xɔrɔxɔɛ minxi. A fama tɔɔrɔde tɛ nun soda xɔɔra, malekɛ sɛniyɛnxie nun Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ ya xɔri.

sentences.english: And the smoke of their pain goes up for ever and ever; and they have no rest day and night, who give worship to the beast and his image, and have on them the mark of his name.
sentences.susu: Tuuri naxan tema na tɛ xɔɔra a mu ɲɔnma abadan. Na mixie, naxee e igoroma na sube bɛ, xa na mu a ra na kuye bɛ naxan yailanxi a misaali ra, a fa sa li na sube xili tɔnxuma saxi e ma, na kanyie mu malabui sɔtɔma kɔɛ nun yanyi.

sentences.english: Here is the quiet strength of the saints, who keep the orders of God, and the faith of Jesus.
sentences.susu: Sɛniyɛntɔɛ xa tunnabɛxi nan na ki, naxee Ala xa sɛriyɛ rabatuma, naxee danxaniyaxi Isa ma.»

sentences.english: And a voice from heaven came to my ears, saying, Put in writing, There is a blessing on the dead who from now on come to their end in the Lord: yes, says the Spirit, that they may have rest from their troubles; for their works go with them.
sentences.susu: N naxa xui nde mɛ koore ma a falafe ra, «I xa a sɛbɛ a sɛɛwɛ na mixie bɛ, naxee faxama Ala xa fe kui yakɔsi han duniɲa raɲɔnyi.» Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi naxa a masen, «Iyo, nɔndi na a ra. E lan e xa e malabu e xa wali xɔrɔxɔɛ ma, e xa na wali sare sɔtɔ.»

sentences.english: And I saw a white cloud, and on the cloud I saw one seated, like a son of man, having on his head a crown of gold, and in his hand a sharp curved blade.
sentences.susu: N naxa nuxui fiixɛ to. Daali nde nu magoroxi a fari, naxan maniya adamadi ra. Mangɛ katanyi xɛɛma daaxi nu saxi a xun ma, waratɛ xɛɲɛnxi nu na a bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And another angel came out from the house of God, crying with a loud voice to him who was seated on the cloud, Put in your blade, and let the grain be cut: because the hour for cutting it is come; for the grain of the earth is over-ready.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ gbɛtɛ naxa mini hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, a a fala a bɛ a xui itexi ra, «I xa waratɛ rawali, xɛ xaba, barima na waxati bara a li, duniɲa xɛ xa xaba.

sentences.english: And he who was seated on the cloud sent in his blade on the earth; and the grain of the earth was cut.
sentences.susu: Naxan nu magoroxi nuxui fari, a naxa waratɛ rawali duniɲa ma, duniɲa xɛ naxa xaba.»

sentences.english: And another angel came out from the house of God which is in heaven, having a sharp curved blade.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ gbɛtɛ naxa mini koore hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, waratɛ xɛɲɛnxi nu na a bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And another angel came out from the altar, who has power over fire; and he gave a loud cry to him who had the sharp curved blade, saying, Put in your sharp blade, and let the grapes of the vine of the earth be cut; for her grapes are fully ready.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ gbɛtɛ, naxan nu tɛ yamarima, a naxa keli sɛrɛxɛbade yire, a a fala a xui itexi ra waratɛ xɛɲɛnxi kanyi bɛ, «Waratɛ xɛɲɛnxi rawali, wɛni bogie xaba duniɲa, barima e bara mɔ.»

sentences.english: And the angel sent his blade into the earth, and the vine of the earth was cut, and he put it into the great wine-crusher of the wrath of God.
sentences.susu: Na malekɛ naxa waratɛ rawali, a fa duniɲa wɛni bogi birin ba, a e sa a sase kui Ala xa xɔnɛ e maboronma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: And the grapes were crushed under foot outside the town, and blood came out from them, even to the head-bands of the horses, two hundred miles.
sentences.susu: Na wali naxa raba taa fari ma. Mixi wuli naxa na se sase rafe, a fili a ma han na wuli naxa ikuya kilo kɛmɛ saxan na, a xa tilinyi fan soe dɛ suxuma.

sentences.english: And I saw another sign in heaven, great and strange; seven angels having the seven last punishments, for in them the wrath of God is complete.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, n man naxa tɔnxuma xungbe to naxan bara n dɛ ixara. Malekɛ solofere naxa mini gbaloe dɔnxɔɛ solofere ra, Ala xa xɔnɛ kamalima naxee ra.

sentences.english: And I saw a sea which seemed like glass mixed with fire; and those who had overcome the beast and his image and the number of his name, were in their places by the sea of glass, with God's instruments of music in their hands.
sentences.susu: N naxa baa nde to, a luxi alɔ diyaman, a sunbuxi tɛ ra. Mixi naxee nu bara nɔ na sube ra, a nun na kuye naxan yailanxi a misaali ra, a nun a xili xa kɔnti ra, e nu tixi baa fari, Ala xa kɔrae nu na e bɛlɛxɛ.

sentences.english: And they give the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and full of wonder are your works, O Lord God, Ruler of all; true and full of righteousness are your ways, eternal King.
sentences.susu: E nu Ala xa konyi Munsa xa bɛɛti nan bama, a nun Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ xa bɛɛti, a falafe ra, «Muxu Marigi Ala Sɛnbɛ Kanyi, i xa walie sɛnbɛ gbo! E makaaba! Duniɲa Mangɛ, i xa kira nɔndi na a ra, a man tinxin.

sentences.english: What man is there who will not have fear before you, O Lord, and give glory to your name? because you only are holy; for all the nations will come and give worship before you; for your righteousness has been made clear.
sentences.susu: Marigi, nde mu gaaxuma i ya ra? Nde mu i xili matɔxɔma? I keren peti nan sɛniyɛn. Ɲamanɛ birin fama nɛ e magorode i bɛ, barima i bara i xa tinxinyi makɛnɛn.»

sentences.english: And after these things I saw, and the house of the Tent of witness in heaven was open:
sentences.susu: Na to dangi, n naxa Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira rabixi to koore ma, saatɛ kankira na naxan kui.

sentences.english: And the seven angels who had the seven punishments came out from the house of God, clothed with linen, clean and bright and with bands of gold about their breasts.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ solofere, tɔɔrɛ dɔnxɔɛ solofere nu na naxee yi ra, e naxa mini hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, sɛrɛxɛdubɛ dugi fiixɛ mayanbaxie ragoroxi e ma, bɛlɛti xɛɛma daaxi balanxi e kanke ma.

sentences.english: And one of the four beasts gave to the seven angels seven gold vessels full of the wrath of God, who is living for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: Nimase keren na nimase naani ya ma, a naxa tɔnbili xɛɛma daaxi solofere so na malekɛ solofere yi ra. Na tɔnbilie nu rafexi Ala xa xɔnɛ nan na, Ala naxan ɲiɲɛ a ra abadan.

sentences.english: And the house of God was full of smoke from the glory of God, and from his power, and no one was able to go into the house of God, till the seven punishments of the seven angels were ended.
sentences.susu: Tuuri naxa hɔrɔmɔlingira rafe Ala xa nɔrɛ nun a sɛnbɛ xa fe ra. Mixi yo mu nu nɔma sode hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, fo tɔɔrɛ solofere xa wali xa kamali naxee nu na malekɛ soloferee yi ra.

sentences.english: And a great voice out of the house of God came to my ears, saying to the seven angels, Go, and let that which is in the seven vessels of the wrath of God come down on the earth.
sentences.susu: N naxa xui xungbe nde mɛ, naxan kelixi hɔrɔmɔlingira kui, a a falama malekɛe bɛ, «Wo siga, wo xa Ala xa xɔnɛ tɔnbili soloferee ifili duniɲa ma.»

sentences.english: And the first went, and let what was in his vessel come down on the earth; and it became an evil poisoning wound on the men who had the mark of the beast, and who gave worship to his image.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ singe naxa siga, a sa a xa tɔnbili ifili duniɲa ma. Na kui, fi ɲaaxi naxa mini mixie ma, na sube xa tɔnxuma nu saxi naxee ma, naxee nu tuubima kuye bɛ naxan yailanxi a misaali ra.

sentences.english: And the second let what was in his vessel come out into the sea; and it became blood as of a dead man; and every living thing in the sea came to an end.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ firin nde naxa a xa tɔnbili ifili baa ma. Baa naxa lu alɔ mixi faxaxi wuli. Nimase birin naxa faxa, naxee nu na baa ma.

sentences.english: And the third let what was in his vessel come out into the rivers and the fountains of water; and they became blood.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ saxan nde naxa a xa tɔnbili ifili xuree nun dulonyie ma. E fan naxa findi wuli ra.

sentences.english: And the voice of the angel of the waters came to my ears, saying, True and upright is your judging, O Holy One, who is and was from all time:
sentences.susu: N naxa malekɛ xui mɛ, naxan nu ye yamarima. A naxa a fala, «I tan naxan na to, i tan naxan na xoro, i tan naxan sɛniyɛn, i bara kiiti tinxinxi sa,

sentences.english: For they made the blood of saints and prophets come out like a stream, and blood have you given them for drink; which is their right reward.
sentences.susu: barima e nu bara sɛniyɛntɔɛe nun namiɲɔnmɛe wuli ramini. I fan bara wuli so e yi ra, e naxan minma. A lanxi na ki nɛ.»

sentences.english: And a voice came from the altar, saying, Even so, O Lord God, Ruler of all, true and full of righteousness is your judging.
sentences.susu: N naxa sɛrɛxɛbade fan xui mɛ. A naxa a fala, «Iyo, Ala Sɛnbɛ Kanyi, i xa kiiti birin tinxin, e findixi nɔndi nan na.»

sentences.english: And the fourth let what was in his vessel come out on the sun; and power was given to it that men might be burned with fire.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naani nde naxa a xa tɔnbili ifili soge ma. Soge naxa yaamari sɔtɔ a xa adamadie gan a tɛ ra.

sentences.english: And men were burned with great heat: and they said evil things against the name of the God who has authority over these punishments; and they were not turned from their evil ways to give him glory.
sentences.susu: Wuyenyi ɲaaxi naxa mixie gan. E naxa Ala xili rasɔtɔ, naxan na tɔɔrɛ birin nasanbaxi. E mu tuubi, e tondi Ala matɔxɔde.

sentences.english: And the fifth let what was in his vessel come out on the high seat of the beast; and his kingdom was made dark; and they were biting their tongues for pain.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ suuli nde naxa a xa tɔnbili ifili na sube xa kibanyi ma. A xa mangɛya naxa lu dimi kui, mixie naxa e nɛnyie xin ɲaxankatɛ ma,

sentences.english: And they said evil things against the God of heaven because of their pain and their wounds; and they were not turned from their evil works.
sentences.susu: e fa Ala xili rasɔtɔ, naxan na koore ma, e xa tɔɔrɛ nun e xa fie xa fe ra. E tondi gbilende e xa wali kobie fɔxɔ ra.

sentences.english: And the sixth let what was in his vessel come out on the great river Euphrates; and it became dry, so that the way might be made ready for the kings from the east.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ senni nde naxa a xa tɔnbili ifili Efirati xure xungbe ma. Na xure naxa xara, alako a xa findi kira ra mangɛe bɛ, naxee fama kelife sogetede.

sentences.english: And I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, like frogs.
sentences.susu: N naxa ɲinnɛ sɛniyɛntare saxan to mini ra na sube magaaxuxi dɛ kui, na sube boore dɛ kui, a nun na namiɲɔnmɛ wule falɛ dɛ kui. Na ɲinnɛe nu maniyaxi xuuɲɛe nan na.

sentences.english: For they are evil spirits, working signs; who go out even to the kings of all the earth, to get them together to the war of the great day of God, the Ruler of all.
sentences.susu: Sentanɛ xa ɲinnɛe nan nu e ra, naxee tɔnxumae rabama, e man sigama duniɲa mangɛe maxilide, alako e xa e malan, e xa gere so Ala Sɛnbɛ Kanyi xa lɔxɔɛ xungbe ma.

sentences.english: (See, I come as a thief. Happy is he who is watching and keeps his robes, so that he may not go unclothed, and his shame be seen.)
sentences.susu: «Wo bara a to, n fama tɛrɛnna nan na, alɔ muɲɛti a gbe wali rabama ki naxɛ. Sɛɛwɛ na mixi bɛ naxan mu xima, naxan mu a xa dugi bama. Na kanyi naxa lu a mageli ra, alako a naxa yaagi.»

sentences.english: And they got them together into the place which is named in Hebrew Armageddon.
sentences.susu: Ɲinnɛe naxa duniɲa mangɛe malan yire nde naxan xili falama Eburu xui ra «Aramagedon.»

sentences.english: And the seventh let what was in his vessel come out on the air; and there came out a great voice from the house of God, from the high seat, saying, It is done.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ solofere nde naxa a xa tɔnbili ifili kuye ma. Xui xungbe nde naxa mini hɔrɔmɔlingira kui Ala xa kibanyi mabiri, a a masen, «A bara ɲɔn.»

sentences.english: And there were flames and voices and thunders; and there was a great earth-shock so that never, from the time when men were on the earth, had there been so great an earth-shock, so full of power.
sentences.susu: Galanyi naxa bula, xuie naxa mini, seyamakɔnyie naxa mini, bɔxi naxa sɛrɛn, naxan maniyɛ mu nu raba sinden kafi duniɲa fɔlɛ.

sentences.english: And the great town was cut into three parts, and the towns of the nations came to destruction: and Babylon the great came into mind before God, to be given the cup of the wine of his wrath.
sentences.susu: Na taa xungbe naxa kana alɔ se naxan giraxi dɔxɔ saxan. Duniɲa taae birin naxa bira. Ala naxa ratu Babilɔn taa gbe ma, a wɛni tɔnbili fi a ma a xa Ala xa xɔnɛ mankanɛ min.

sentences.english: And every island went in flight, and the mountains were seen no longer.
sentences.susu: Surie nun geyae naxa lɔɛ.

sentences.english: And great drops of ice, every one about the weight of a talent, came down out of heaven on men: and men said evil things against God because of the punishment of the ice-drops; for it is very great.
sentences.susu: Balabalanyi belebelee naxa keli koore ma, e bira mixie ma. A xɔri keren binya kilo tongo saxan nun naani ɲɔndɔn. Mixie naxa Ala xili rasɔtɔ na balabalanyi xa fe ra, barima na tɔɔrɛ nu gbo a gbe ra.

sentences.english: And one of the seven angels who had the seven vessels came and said to me, Come here, so that you may see the judging of the evil woman who is seated on the great waters;
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, malekɛ keren naxan nu na na malekɛ tɔnbili kanyi solofere ya ma, a naxa a fala n bɛ, «Fa be, alako n xa langoe xungbe xa kiiti masen i bɛ, na langoe naxan dɔxɔxi xure xungbee dɛ ra.»

sentences.english: With whom the kings of the earth made themselves unclean, and those who are on the earth were full of the wine of her evil desires.
sentences.susu: Duniɲa mangɛe nun na langoe ginɛ naxa fe kobi raba. E xa mixie fan naxa bira fe ɲaaxie fɔxɔ ra han e naxa lu alɔ siisilae.

sentences.english: And he took me away in the Spirit into a waste land: and I saw a woman seated on a bright red beast, full of evil names, having seven heads and ten horns,
sentences.susu: Na malekɛ naxa laamatunyi nde masen n bɛ. N naxa ginɛ nde to gbengberenyi ma, a dɔxɔxi sube gbeeli fari, marasɔtɔ xilie nu sɛbɛxi naxan ma. Xunyi solofere nu na a ma, feri fu tixi a xun ma.

sentences.english: And the woman was clothed in purple and bright red, with ornaments of gold and stones of great price and jewels; and in her hand was a gold cup full of evil things and her unclean desires;
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ nu maxirixi donma gbeeli tofanyi nan na, kɔnmagore, bɛlɛxɛrasoe, nun xurundɛ tofanyie nu na a yi ra naxee yailanxi xɛɛma nun gɛmɛ tofanyie ra. Pɔɔti xɛɛma daaxi suxuxi a yi ra, fe xɔnxi sɛniyɛntaree nu na a kui, naxee misaalixi a xa wali ɲaaxi ra.

sentences.english: And on her brow was a name, SECRET, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE EVIL WOMEN AND OF THE UNCLEAN THINGS OF THE EARTH.
sentences.susu: Xili nde sɛbɛxi a tigi ma gundo daaxi: «Babilɔn xungbe, yɛnɛlae nun fe ɲaaxie nga.»

sentences.english: And I saw the woman overcome as with the wine of the blood of the saints, and the blood of those put to death because of Jesus. And when I saw her, I was overcome with a great wonder.
sentences.susu: N naxa na ginɛ to, a siisixi sɛniyɛntɔɛe wuli ra, naxee nu findixi Isa xa seedee ra. N to a to, n dɛ naxa ixara ki fanyi.

sentences.english: And the angel said to me, Why were you surprised? I will make clear to you the secret of the woman, and of the beast on which she is seated, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.
sentences.susu: Na malekɛ naxa a fala n bɛ, «Munfe ra i dɛ ixaraxi? N fama nɛ yi gundo tagi rabade i bɛ, yi ginɛ xa fe ra nun yi sube xunyi solofere nun feri fu kanyi xa fe ra a dɔxɔxi naxan fari.

sentences.english: The beast which you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the great deep, and to go into destruction. And those who are on the earth, whose names have not been put in the book of life from the first, will be full of wonder when they see the beast, that he was, and is not, and still will be.
sentences.susu: I sube naxan to, a nu na na, kɔnɔ a mu na yakɔsi. A fama nɛ tede yili tilinxi kui, a fa bɔnɔ. Adamadi naxee xili mu sɛbɛxi kisi buki kui, kabi duniɲa fɔlɛ, e kaabama nɛ yi sube xa fe ra, barima singe a nu na, yakɔsi a mu na, kɔnɔ tɛmui naxan sa fama, a man minima nɛ.»

sentences.english: Here is the mind which has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman is seated:
sentences.susu: Xaxilima nɔma yi fahaamude: Na xunyi solofere misaalixi geya solofere nan na, ginɛ dɔxɔxi naxee fari.

sentences.english: And they are seven kings; the five have come to an end, the one is, the other has not come; and when he comes, he will have to go on for a little time.
sentences.susu: Nee man misaalixi mangɛ solofere nan na. Suuli bara bira, keren na na, boore mu nu fa sinden. A na fa, a buma nɛ dondoronti.

sentences.english: And the beast which was, and is not, is himself the eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes into destruction.
sentences.susu: Sube naxan nu na na, kɔnɔ a mu na yakɔsi, na misaalixi mangɛ solomasaxan nde nan na. A fan na na na mangɛ solofere nan ya ma naxan fama bɔnɔde.

sentences.english: And the ten horns which you saw are ten kings, which still have been given no kingdom; but they are given authority as kings, with the beast, for one hour.
sentences.susu: Na feri fu i naxee toxi, nee fan misaalixi mangɛ fu nan na, naxee mu nu mangɛya sɔtɔ sinden. E tan nun na sube, e fama mangɛ nɔɛ nan sɔtɔde waxati keren bun ma.

sentences.english: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.
sentences.susu: E waxɔnfe birin lan. E e xa sɛnbɛ nun e xa mangɛya ragbilenma nɛ na sube ma.

sentences.english: These will make war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, because he is the Lord of lords and King of kings; and those who are with him are named, marked out, and true.
sentences.susu: E Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ gerema nɛ, kɔnɔ Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ nan geenima, barima a tan nan findixi marigie Marigi ra, mangɛe xa Mangɛ. A xa mixi sugandixie, a xa danxaniyatɔɛe na a sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: And he said to me, The waters which you saw, where the evil woman is seated, are peoples, and armies, and nations and languages.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala n bɛ, «Na xuree i naxee toxi, na langoe ginɛ dɔxɔxi xure naxee dɛ ra, e misaalixi ɲamanɛe, bɔnsɔɛe, sie, nun xuie nan na.

sentences.english: And the ten horns which you saw, and the beast, these will be turned against the evil woman, and will make her waste and uncovered, and will take her flesh for food, and will have her burned with fire.
sentences.susu: Na feri fu nun na sube, i naxee toxi, e na langoe ginɛ xɔnma nɛ. E fama nɛ se birin bade a yi ra, e fa a ti a mageli ra, e a sube don, e a dɔnxɔɛ woli tɛ xɔɔra,

sentences.english: Because God has put it in their hearts to do his purpose, and to be of one mind, giving their kingdom to the beast, till the words of God have effect and are complete.
sentences.susu: barima Ala nan a ragirixi e xa a waxɔnfe raba. E xa e xa mangɛya ragbilen na sube ma, han Ala xa masenyi kamalima tɛmui naxɛ.

sentences.english: And the woman whom you saw is the great town, which is ruling over the kings of the earth.
sentences.susu: Na ginɛ i naxan toxi, a misaalixi duniɲa mangɛe xa mangataa xungbe nan na.»

sentences.english: After these things I saw another angel coming down out of heaven, having great authority; and the earth was bright with his glory.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, n naxa malekɛ gbɛtɛ to goro ra keli koore ma. Nɔɛ xungbe nu na a yi, a xa nɔrɛ naxa duniɲa iyalan.

sentences.english: And he gave a loud cry, saying, Babylon the great has come down from her high place, she has come to destruction and has become a place of evil spirits, and of every unclean spirit, and a hole for every unclean and hated bird.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala a xui itexi ra, «Babilɔn xungbe bara bira. Babilɔn bara bira, a bara findi ɲinnɛe xɔnyi ra, ɲinnɛ sɛniyɛntaree nun xɔni raharamuxie luma dɛnnaxɛ.

sentences.english: For through the wine of the wrath of her evil desires all the nations have come to destruction; and the kings of the earth made themselves unclean with her, and the traders of the earth had their wealth increased by the power of her evil ways.
sentences.susu: A kanaxi nɛ barima si birin bara bira a xa fe ɲaaxie fɔxɔ ra. Duniɲa mangɛe bara lu a sɛɛti ma a xa wali kobi kui. Duniɲa yulɛe fan bara banna a waxɔnfe saabui ra. E birin luxi nɛ alɔ siisilae.»

sentences.english: And another voice from heaven came to my ears, saying, Come out of her, my people, so that you may have no part in her sins and in her punishments.
sentences.susu: N naxa xui gbɛtɛ mɛ keli koore ma a falafe ra, «N ma ɲama, wo xa mini a ya ma, alako wo fan naxa lu a xa yunubie kui, wo xa a xa tɔɔrɛ fan sɔtɔ.

sentences.english: For her sins have gone up even to heaven, and God has taken note of her evil-doing.
sentences.susu: A xa yunubie bara gbo a gbegbe ra. Ala bara ratu a xa tinxintareya birin ma.

sentences.english: Give to her as she gave, even an increased reward for her works; in the cup which was mixed by her, let there be mixed as much again for herself.
sentences.susu: Wo xa a xa wali sare ragbilen a ma dɔxɔ firin. A naxan nabaxi wo ra, wo xa na raba a tan fan na dɔxɔ firin.

sentences.english: As she gave glory to herself, and became more evil in her ways, in the same measure give her pain and weeping: for she says in her heart, I am seated here a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see sorrow.
sentences.susu: A waxɔnfe xun to nu masaxi tɛmui birin, wo fan xa a xa tɔɔrɛ xun masa na ki, a xa sunnun, barima a a fala nɛ a bɔɲɛ kui, ‹Mangɛ ginɛ nan n na. Kaaɲɛ ginɛ mu na n na, n mu luma sunnunyi kui abadan.›

sentences.english: For this reason in one day will her troubles come, death and sorrow and need of food; and she will be completely burned with fire; for strong is the Lord God who is her judge.
sentences.susu: Na masenyi xa fe ra, a fama yi gbaloe tode lɔxɔɛ keren: faxɛ, sunnunyi, nun kaamɛ. A ganma nɛ tɛ ra, barima Marigi Ala Sɛnbɛma nan a makiitixi.»

sentences.english: And the kings of the earth, who made themselves unclean with her, and in her company gave themselves up to evil, will be weeping and crying over her, when they see the smoke of her burning,
sentences.susu: Duniɲa mangɛ birin naxee bara bira a xa fe ɲaaxie nun a waxɔnfee fɔxɔ ra, e fama nɛ wade. E na a to a xa taa na ganfe, e sunnunma nɛ.

sentences.english: Watching from far away, for fear of her punishment, saying, Sorrow, sorrow for Babylon, the great town, the strong town! for in one hour you have been judged.
sentences.susu: E lu yire makuye barima e gaaxuxi a xa tɔɔrɛ ya ra. E nu fa a fala, «Ɲaxankatɛ na Babilɔn bɛ. Ɲaxankatɛ na na taa xungbe sɛnbɛma bɛ. A bara makiiti lɛɛri keren bun ma.»

sentences.english: And the traders of the earth are weeping and crying over her, because no man has any more desire for their goods,
sentences.susu: Duniɲa yulɛe wama nɛ a xa fe ra, e sunnunma nɛ, barima mixi mu na naxan e xa kotee sarama sɔnɔn,

sentences.english: Gold, and silver, and stones of great price, and jewels, and delicate linen, and robes of purple and silk and red; and perfumed wood, and every vessel of ivory, and every vessel made of fair wood, and of brass, and iron, and stone;
sentences.susu: kote naxan findixi xɛɛma ra, gbeti, gɛmɛ tofanyie, dugi gɛsɛ daaxi, dugi gbeeli, wuri fanyi, sili ɲinyi masolixi, wuri fanyi masolixi, yɔxui, wure, gɛmɛ xɔrɔxɔɛ,

sentences.english: And sweet-smelling plants, and perfumes, and wine, and oil, and well crushed grain, and cattle and sheep; and horses and carriages and servants; and souls of men.
sentences.susu: donse ɲɔxunmɛ, surayi mɔɔli birin, labundɛ, wɛni, ture, farin fanyi, ningee, yɛxɛɛe, soee, sɔɔri ragisee, nun konyie.

sentences.english: And the fruit of your soul's desire has gone from you, and all things delicate and shining have come to an end and will never again be seen.
sentences.susu: «I waxɔnfe birin bara makuya i ra, na se fanyie bara lɔɛ i ma. I mu nee sɔtɔma sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: The traders in these things, by which their wealth was increased, will be watching far off for fear of her punishment, weeping and crying;
sentences.susu: Yulɛ naxee bannaxi a saabui ra, e fan luma nɛ yire makuye, barima e gaaxuxi a xa tɔɔrɛ ya ra. E wama nɛ, e lu sunnunyi kui.

sentences.english: Saying, Sorrow, sorrow for the great town, she who was clothed in delicate linen, and purple, and red; with ornaments of gold and stones of great price and jewels!
sentences.susu: E nu a fala, «Ɲaxankatɛ na na taa xungbe bɛ, ɲaxankatɛ na a bɛ, naxan nu wama dugi fiixɛ, dugi gbeeli, xɛɛma, nun gɛmɛ tofanyie xɔn.»

sentences.english: For in one hour such great wealth has come to nothing. And every shipmaster, and all who are sailing on the sea, and sailors and all who get their living by the sea, were watching from far away,
sentences.susu: A xa naafuli birin bara kana na waxati kerenyi kui. Kunkui raɲɛrɛe nun mixi naxan birin kunkui wali nde rabama, e luma nɛ yire makuye,

sentences.english: And crying out when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What town is like the great town?
sentences.susu: e fa a fala e xui itexi ra na taa xungbe ganxi ya ra, «Yi taa, a maniyɛ mu na.»

sentences.english: And they put dust on their heads, and were sad, weeping and crying, and saying, Sorrow, sorrow for the great town, in which was increased the wealth of all who had their ships on the sea because of her great stores! for in one hour she is made waste.
sentences.susu: E fama nɛ xube masode e xunyi ma, e wa, e lu sunnunyi kui, e a fala, «Ɲaxankatɛ na na taa xungbe bɛ, ɲaxankatɛ na na taa bɛ kunkui kanyie bannaxi dɛnnaxɛ. Na taa bara findi gbengberenyi ra na waxati kerenyi kui.»

sentences.english: Be glad over her, heaven, and you saints, and Apostles, and prophets; because she has been judged by God on your account.
sentences.susu: «Naxee na koore, wo xa ɲɛlɛxin na taa xa ɲaxankatɛ xa fe ra. Sɛniyɛntɔɛe, Ala xa xɛɛrae, nun namiɲɔnmɛe, wo tan xa ɲɛlɛxin, barima Ala bara wo gbeɲɔxɔ.»

sentences.english: And a strong angel took up a stone like the great stone with which grain is crushed, and sent it into the sea, saying, So, with a great fall, will Babylon, the great town, come to destruction, and will not be seen any more at all.
sentences.susu: Na tɛmui malekɛ sɛnbɛma nde naxa gɛmɛ xungbe tongo naxan nu luxi alɔ se luxutase, a naxa a woli baa ma a falafe ra, «Babilɔn taa xungbe birama nɛ a ɲaaxi ra alɔ yi gɛmɛ. Mixi mu a toma sɔnɔn.»

sentences.english: And the voice of players and makers of music will never again be sounding in you: and no worker, expert in art, will ever again be living in you; and there will be no sound of the crushing of grain any more at all in you;
sentences.susu: «I xa sigie mu mɛma sɔnɔn, naxee sama kɔra, xule, nun sara xui ra. Wali xui mu minima i xɔnyi sɔnɔn, maale din xui fan mu luma i xɔnyi sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And never again will the shining of lights be seen in you; and the voice of the newly-married man and the bride will never again be sounding in you: for your traders were the lords of the earth, and by your evil powers were all the nations turned out of the right way.
sentences.susu: Lanpui xa naiyalanyi mu toma i xɔnyi sɔnɔn. Futi xirimae xa ɲɛlɛxin xui mu mɛma i xɔnyi sɔnɔn, barima i xa yulɛe nu bara findi mixi xungbee ra duniɲa, i bara si birin natantan i xa fe ɲaaxie saabui ra.

sentences.english: And in her was seen the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been put to death on the earth.
sentences.susu: Namiɲɔnmɛe nun sɛniyɛntɔɛe wuli bara mini i xɔnyi, a nun naxee kɔn bara raxaba bɔxi ma.»

sentences.english: After these things there came to my ears a sound like the voice of a great band of people in heaven, saying, Praise to the Lord; salvation and glory and power be to our God:
sentences.susu: Na to dangi, n naxa ɲama xungbe xui mɛ koore ma a fala ra, «Ala tantu. Kisi, xunnakeli, nun sɛnbɛ na muxu Marigi Ala bɛ,

sentences.english: For true and upright are his decisions; for by him has the evil woman been judged, who made the earth unclean with the sins of her body; and he has given her punishment for the blood of his servants.
sentences.susu: barima a xa kiiti tinxin, a findixi nɔndi nan na. A bara langoe ginɛ makiiti, naxan nu bara duniɲa ratantan a xa fe ɲaaxie ra. Ala bara a xa konyie wuli gbeɲɔxɔ a ma.»

sentences.english: And again they said, Praise to the Lord. And her smoke went up for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: Ɲama man naxa a fala a firin nde, «Ala tantu. Babilɔn tuuri tema nɛ abadan.»

sentences.english: And the four and twenty rulers and the four beasts went down on their faces and gave worship to God who was seated on the high seat, saying, Even so, praise to the Lord.
sentences.susu: Na fori mɔxɔɲɛn nun naani, nun na nimase naani naxa e felen bɔxi, e Ala batu naxan nu magoroxi kibanyi kui, a falafe ra, «Amina, Ala tantu.»

sentences.english: And a voice came from the high seat, saying, Give praise to our God, all you his servants, small and great, in whom is the fear of him.
sentences.susu: Xui nde naxa mini kibanyi, a falafe ra, «Ala xa konyie, wo xa won Marigi Ala matɔxɔ, wo tan naxee gaaxu a ya ra, wo tan dimɛe nun forie.»

sentences.english: And there came to my ears the voice of a great army, like the sound of waters, and the sound of loud thunders, saying, Praise to the Lord: for the Lord our God, Ruler of all, is King.
sentences.susu: N naxa ɲama xungbe xui mɛ naxan sɛnbɛ gbo alɔ xure wundu xui, xa na mu a ra galanyi xui. E naxa a fala, «Ala tantu, barima Ala Sɛnbɛ Kanyi, won Marigi Ala bara so a xa mangɛya kui.

sentences.english: Let us be glad with delight, and let us give glory to him: because the time is come for the Lamb to be married, and his wife has made herself ready.
sentences.susu: Won xa sɛɛwa, won xa ɲɛlɛxin, won xa a binya, barima Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ xa futi xiri tɛmui bara a li. A naxan dɔxɔma, a bara gɛ a yɛtɛ yailande.

sentences.english: And to her it was given to be clothed in delicate linen, clean and shining: for the clean linen is the righteousness of the saints.
sentences.susu: A naxan dɔxɔma a bara dugi fiixɛ tofanyi ragoro a ma, naxan misaalixi sɛniyɛntɔɛe xa kɛwali tinxinxie ra.»

sentences.english: And he said to me, Put in the book, Happy are the guests at the bride-feast of the Lamb. And he said to me, These are the true words of God.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa a fala n bɛ, «I xa a sɛbɛ, ‹Ɲɛlɛxinyi na mixie bɛ naxee maxilixi Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ xa futi xiri malanyi.›» A naxa a fala n bɛ, «Ala xa nɔndi nan na ki.»

sentences.english: And I went on my face before his feet to give him worship. And he said to me, See you do it not: I am a brother-servant with you and with your brothers who keep the witness of Jesus: give worship to God: for the witness of Jesus is the spirit of the prophet's word.
sentences.susu: N naxa n xinbi sin a bun ma n xa a batu, kɔnɔ a naxa a fala n bɛ, «Ade, i naxa na raba. N fan findixi Ala xa konyi nan na alɔ i tan nun i ngaxakerenyi naxee bara la Isa xa seedeɲɔxɔya ra. I xa Ala nan batu. Isa xa seedeɲɔxɔya findixi namiɲɔnmɛ xa masenyi xɔri nan na.»

sentences.english: And the heaven was open; and I saw a white horse, and he who was seated on it was named Certain and True; and he is judging and making war in righteousness.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi n naxa koore to rabi ra, soe fiixɛ tixi na, a ragima xili Dugutɛgɛ nun Nɔndi falɛ. A gere soma tinxinyi nan na, a kiiti sa tinxinyi kui.

sentences.english: And his eyes are a flame of fire, and crowns are on his head; and he has a name in writing, of which no man has knowledge but himself.
sentences.susu: A yae nu luxi nɛ alɔ tɛ, mangɛ katanyi naxan yailanxi gɛmɛ tofanyi ra nu dusuxi a xun na. A xili sɛbɛxi a ma, xili mixi yo mu naxan kolon bafe a tan na.

sentences.english: And he is clothed in a robe washed with blood: and his name is The Word of God.
sentences.susu: A xa dugi bundaxi wuli ra. A xili nɛ Ala xa Masenyi.

sentences.english: And the armies which are in heaven went after him on white horses, clothed in delicate linen, white and clean.
sentences.susu: Koore sɔɔri gali nu biraxi a fɔxɔ ra e xa soe fiixɛe fari, dugi fiixɛ tofanyie fan nagoroxi e ma.

sentences.english: And out of his mouth comes a sharp sword, with which he overcomes the nations: and he has rule over them with a rod of iron: and he is crushing with his feet the grapes of the strong wrath of God the Ruler of all.
sentences.susu: Santidɛgɛma xɛɲɛnxi nu minixi a dɛ i, alako a xa ɲamanɛe gere, a xa e yamari sawuri sɛnbɛma ra, Ala Sɛnbɛ Kanyi xa xɔnɛ xa kamali.

sentences.english: And on his robe and on his leg is a name, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.
sentences.susu: A sɛbɛxi a xa dugi xungbe ma, a nun a tabe ma, «Mangɛe xa Mangɛ, marigie Marigi.»

sentences.english: And I saw an angel taking his place in the sun; and he was crying with a loud voice, saying to all the birds in flight in the heavens, Come together to the great feast of God;
sentences.susu: N naxa malekɛ to, a tixi soge fari. A naxa a fala a xui itexi ra xɔni birin bɛ naxee nu na koore ma, «Wo fa Ala xa xunnakeli yire,

sentences.english: So that you may take for your food the flesh of kings, and of captains, and of strong men, and of horses and of those who are seated on them, and the flesh of all men, free and unfree, small and great.
sentences.susu: wo xa mangɛe sube don, a nun sɔɔri mangɛe sube, sɛnbɛmae sube, soee sube, soe ragie sube, lasiri nun konyie sube, dimɛe nun forie sube.»

sentences.english: And I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, come together to make war against him who was seated on the horse and against his army.
sentences.susu: N naxa na sube to, a nun duniɲa mangɛe nun e xa sɔɔrie. E birin nu malanxi alako e xa na soe fiixɛ ragima nun a xa sɔɔri gali gere.

sentences.english: And the beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who did the signs before him, by which they were turned from the true way who had the mark of the beast, and who gave worship to his image: these two were put living into the sea of ever-burning fire.
sentences.susu: Soe fiixɛ ragima naxa na sube ɲaaxi suxu, a nun na namiɲɔnmɛ wule falɛ, naxan nu bara mixie madaxu tɔnxumae ra, sube xa tɔnxuma nu saxi mixi naxee ma, a nun naxee nu bara na sube xa kuye batu. Na firinyie birin naxa woli tɛ nun soda xɔɔra.

sentences.english: And the rest were put to death with the sword of him who was on the horse, even the sword which came out of his mouth: and all the birds were made full with their flesh.
sentences.susu: Santidɛgɛma naxan nu minima soe fiixɛ ragima dɛ kui, a naxa booree faxa, xɔnie fa e sube don.

sentences.english: And I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the great deep and a great chain in his hand.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, n naxa malekɛ to goro ra kelife koore ma, yili tilinxi naadɛ saabi nun yɔlɔnxɔnyi belebele nu na a yi ra.

sentences.english: And he took the dragon, the old snake, which is the Evil One and Satan, and put chains on him for a thousand years,
sentences.susu: A naxa na sube magaaxuxi suxu, na bɔximase fori, naxan findixi Ibulisa ra, na nan na ki Sentanɛ. A naxa a xiri, a xa lu na ki ɲɛ wulu keren bun ma.

sentences.english: And put him into the great deep, and it was shut and locked over him, so that he might put the nations in error no longer, till the thousand years were ended: after this he will be let loose for a little time.
sentences.susu: A naxa a woli yili tilinxi kui, a naadɛ balan, a tɔnxuma sa naadɛ ma, alako a naxa mini sie madaxude han na ɲɛ wulu keren xa kamali. Na xanbi a lanma a xa fulun waxati dunkedi bun ma.

sentences.english: And I saw high seats, and they were seated on them, and the right of judging was given to them: and I saw the souls of those who were put to death for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and those who did not give worship to the beast, or to his image, and had not his mark on their brows or on their hands; and they were living and ruling with Christ a thousand years.
sentences.susu: N naxa kibanyi ndee to. Mixi naxee magoroxi e kui, nee nu bara yaamari sɔtɔ e xa kiiti sa. N naxa mixie to naxee xunyie nu bara ba e dɛ i Isa xa seedeɲɔxɔya nun Ala xa masenyi xa fe ra. N man naxa mixie to naxee mu nu tuubi na sube nun a xa kuye bɛ, na sube xili mu nu sɛbɛxi e tigi ma, xa na mu a ra e bɛlɛxɛ ma. E nu bara keli faxɛ ma, e ɲiɲɛ, e yaamari raba Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi sɛɛti ma ɲɛ wulu keren bun ma.

sentences.english: The rest of the dead did not come to life again till the thousand years were ended. This is the first coming back from the dead.
sentences.susu: Boore mixi faxaxie mu nu kelixi faxɛ ma sinden, fo na ɲɛ wulu keren xa kamali. Marakeli singe nan na ki.

sentences.english: Happy and holy is he who has a part in this first coming: over these the second death has no authority, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will be ruling with him a thousand years.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛlɛxinyi nun sɛniyɛnyi na mixie bɛ naxee bara lu na marakeli singe kui. Saya firin nde mu nɔma e lide sɔnɔn. E findima nɛ Ala nun Ala xa Mixi Sugandixi xa sɛrɛxɛdubɛe ra, e fa yaamari ti a sɛɛti ma ɲɛ wulu keren bun ma.

sentences.english: And when the thousand years are ended, Satan will be let loose out of his prison,
sentences.susu: Na ɲɛ wulu keren na kamali tɛmui naxɛ, Sentanɛ minima nɛ a xa geeli kui,

sentences.english: And will go out to put in error the nations which are in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, to get them together to the war, the number of whom is like the sands of the sea.
sentences.susu: a siga duniɲa birin sie madaxude, alɔ Gogo nun Magogo, a e malan gere xili ma. E xasabi luma nɛ alɔ mɛyɛnyi naxan na baa dɛ ra.

sentences.english: And they went up over the face of the earth, and made a circle about the tents of the saints, and the well loved town: and fire came down out of heaven for their destruction.
sentences.susu: Sie kelima nɛ duniɲa yire birin, e fa Ala xa ɲama rabilin a xa taa xanuxi kui. Kɔnɔ na tɛmui tɛ goroma nɛ kelife koore ma, a fa e sɔntɔ.

sentences.english: And the Evil One who put them in error was sent down into the sea of ever-burning fire, where the beast and the false prophet are, and their punishment will go on day and night for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: Ibulisa naxan nu sie madaxuma, a tan bara woli tɛ nun soda xɔɔra, na sube nun na namiɲɔnmɛ wule falɛ na dɛnnaxɛ. E ɲaxankatama nɛ naa kɔɛ nun yanyi ra abadan.

sentences.english: And I saw a great white seat, and him who was seated on it, before whose face the earth and the heaven went in flight; and there was no place for them.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi, n naxa kibanyi xungbe fiixɛ to, Ala magoroxi a kui. Bɔxi nun koore naxa e gi a ya ra, e lɔɛ.

sentences.english: And I saw the dead, great and small, taking their places before the high seat; and the books were open, and another book was open, which is the book of life; and the dead were judged by the things which were in the books, even by their works.
sentences.susu: N naxa mixi faxaxie to, forie nun dimɛe, e birin tixi kibanyi ya i. Bukie naxa rabi, boore buki fan naxa rabi naxan findixi kisi buki ra. Mixi faxaxie naxa makiiti e kɛwali ra naxan nu sɛbɛxi na bukie kui.

sentences.english: And the sea gave up the dead which were in it; and death and Hell gave up the dead which were in them; and they were judged every man by his works.
sentences.susu: Mixi faxaxie naxee nu na baa ma, nee naxa keli. Mixi faxaxie naxee nu na aligiyama, nee fan naxa keli, e birin naxa makiiti e kɛwali ma.

sentences.english: And death and Hell were put into the sea of fire. This is the second death, even the sea of fire.
sentences.susu: Faxɛ nun aligiyama naxa woli tɛ xɔɔra, naxan findixi faxɛ firin nde ra.

sentences.english: And if anyone's name was not in the book of life, he went down into the sea of fire.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan birin xili mu nu sɛbɛxi kisi buki kui, e naxa woli tɛ xɔɔra.

sentences.english: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were gone; and there was no more sea.
sentences.susu: N naxa koore nun bɔxi nɛɛnɛ to, barima koore nun bɔxi singe nu bara lɔɛ, baa fan mu nu na sɔnɔn.

sentences.english: And I saw the holy town, new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, like a bride made beautiful for her husband.
sentences.susu: N naxa taa sɛniyɛnxi to, Darisalamu nɛɛnɛ, naxan nu na gorofe keli koore ma Ala sɛɛti ma. A nu rafalaxi a fanyi ra alɔ ginɛ naxan sigama a xa mɔri ralande a xa futi xiri lɔxɔɛ.

sentences.english: And there came to my ears a great voice out of the high seat, saying, See, the Tent of God is with men, and he will make his living-place with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them, and be their God.
sentences.susu: N naxa xui sɛnbɛma nde mɛ kelife kibanyi yire, a falafe ra, «Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira nan ya naxan tixi adamadie ya ma. Ala sabatima nɛ adamadie tagi, e findi a xa ɲama ra, a fan findi e Marigi Ala ra, a lu e tagi.

sentences.english: And he will put an end to all their weeping; and there will be no more death, or sorrow, or crying, or pain; for the first things have come to an end.
sentences.susu: A e yaye birin bama nɛ. Faxɛ, sunnunyi, wa xui, nun tɔɔrɛ mu luma naa sɔnɔn, barima na fe mɔɔli naxee nu na singe ra, nee birin bara ɲɔn.»

sentences.english: And he who is seated on the high seat said, See, I make all things new. And he said, Put it in the book; for these words are certain and true.
sentences.susu: Naxan magoroxi kibanyi kui a naxa a fala, «Yakɔsi, n bara fe birin masara.» A man naxa a fala, «A sɛbɛ, barima masenyi na a ra naxan findixi nɔndi ra, a mu kanama abadan.»

sentences.english: And he said to me, It is done. I am the First and the Last, the start and the end. I will freely give of the fountain of the water of life to him who is in need.
sentences.susu: A naxa a fala n bɛ, «A bara ɲɔn. N tan nan na fe singe nun fe dɔnxɔɛ ra, a fɔlɛ nun a raɲɔnyi. Ye xɔli na naxan ma, n kisi ye fima nɛ a ma, a mu sarama. Na ye misaalixi kisi nan na.

sentences.english: He who overcomes will have these things for his heritage; and I will be his God, and he will be my son.
sentences.susu: Mixi naxan geenima, a kɛ nan na ki. N bara findi a Marigi Ala ra, a fan bara findi n ma di ra.

sentences.english: But those who are full of fear and without faith, the unclean and takers of life, those who do the sins of the flesh, and those who make use of evil powers or who give worship to images, and all those who are false, will have their part in the sea of ever-burning fire which is the second death.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ mixi gaaxuxie, danxaniyataree, mixi ɲaaxie, faxɛtie, yɛnɛlae, mandurulae, kuye batuie, wule falɛe, e birin luma nɛ tɛ nun soda xɔɔra. Na findima faxɛ firin nde nan na.»

sentences.english: And one of the seven angels who had the seven vessels in which were the seven last punishments, came and said to me, Come here, and see the bride, the Lamb's wife.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ nde naxan nu na na malekɛ solofere ya ma, tɔnbili solofere nu na naxee yi ra, mankanɛ solofere saxi e kui, a naxa fa n yire, a a fala n bɛ, «Fa be, n xa Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ xa ginɛ masen i bɛ, naxan xa futi fama xiride.»

sentences.english: And he took me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and let me see the holy town Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,
sentences.susu: A naxa n xaxili xanin geya xungbe itexi ma. Mɛnni a naxa na taa sɛniyɛnxi masen n bɛ, naxan findixi na Darisalamu ra, naxan nu bara goro kelife koore ma Ala sɛɛti ma.

sentences.english: Having the glory of God: and her light was like a stone of great price, a jasper stone, clear as glass:
sentences.susu: Ala xa nɔrɛ nu na a ma, a nu yanbama alɔ gɛmɛ tofanyi naxan maniyaxi diyaman na.

sentences.english: She had a wall great and high, with twelve doors, and at the doors twelve angels; and names on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.
sentences.susu: A xa tɛtɛ nu ite, naadɛ fu nu firin nu na a ma, malekɛ fu nun firin nu tixi na naadɛe ra e makantafe ma. Isirayila bɔnsɔɛ fu nun firin xili nu sɛbɛxi na naadɛe ma.

sentences.english: And on the east were three doors; and on the north three doors; and on the south three doors; and on the west three doors.
sentences.susu: Naadɛ saxan nu na sogetede mabiri, naadɛ saxan nu na kɔɔla mabiri, naadɛ saxan nu na yirefanyi mabiri, naadɛ saxan nu na sogegorode mabiri.

sentences.english: And the wall of the town had twelve bases, and on them the twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.
sentences.susu: Taa tɛtɛ nu tixi na gɛmɛ safɛ fu nun firin nan fari, Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ xa xɛɛra fu nun firin xilie nu sɛbɛxi e ma.

sentences.english: And he who was talking with me had a gold measuring-rod to take the measure of the town, and of its doors, and its wall.
sentences.susu: Maniyase xɛɛma daaxi nu na na malekɛ yi ra, naxan nu wɔyɛnma n bɛ, alako a xa nɔ taa, a naadɛe, nun a tɛtɛ maniyade.

sentences.english: And the town is square, as wide as it is long; and he took the measure of the town with the rod, one thousand and five hundred miles: it is equally long and wide and high.
sentences.susu: Taa kuyɛ, taa igboɲa, nun taa iteya, a birin nu lanxi kilo wulu firin, kilo kɛmɛ firin, kilo mɔxɔɲɛn nan ma.

sentences.english: And he took the measure of its wall, one hundred and forty-four cubits, after the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa tɛtɛ fan maniya adama ki ma. Na naxa lan kanke ya tongo saxan nun senni ma.

sentences.english: And the building of its wall was of jasper, and the town was clear gold, clear as glass.
sentences.susu: Tɛtɛ nu yailanxi gɛmɛ tofanyi nan na naxan maniya diyaman na. Taa tan nu yailanxi xɛɛma xɔri fanyi nan na naxan tinse alɔ ye.

sentences.english: The bases of the wall of the town had ornaments of all sorts of beautiful stones. The first base was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;
sentences.susu: Taa tɛtɛ nu tixi gɛmɛ xungbee nan fari. Gɛmɛ tofanyi mɔɔli birin nan nu na gɛmɛ xungbee raxunmaxi. Gɛmɛ xungbe singe raxunmaxi gɛmɛ tofanyi nde nan na naxan xili falama yasipe, a firin nde raxunmaxi gɛmɛ tofanyi nde nan na naxan xili falama safiri, a saxan nde kalisedone, a naani nde emerode,

sentences.english: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, topaz; the tenth, chrysoprase; the eleventh, jacinth; the twelfth, amethyst.
sentences.susu: a suuli nde sarodonixi, a senni nde sarodone, a solofere nde kirosolite, a solomasaxan nde berili, a solomanaani nde topasi, a fu nde kirisopirase, a fu nun keren nde hiyasinti, a fu nun firin nde ametisite.

sentences.english: And the twelve doors were twelve pearls; every door was made of one pearl; and the street of the town was clear gold, as clear as glass.
sentences.susu: Tɛtɛ naadɛ fu nun firin nu yailanxi gɛmɛ tofanyie nan na naxee na baa ma. Naadɛ birin findixi gɛmɛ keren nan na. Taa malande nu yailanxi xɛɛma xɔri fanyi nan na naxan tinse alɔ ye.

sentences.english: And I saw no Temple there; because the Lord God, the Ruler of all, and the Lamb are its Temple.
sentences.susu: N mu Ala xa hɔrɔmɔlingira toxi taa kui, barima Marigi Ala Sɛnbɛ Kanyi nun Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ nan na hɔrɔmɔbanxi ra.

sentences.english: And the town has no need of the sun, or of the moon, to give it light: for the glory of God did make it light, and the light of it is the Lamb.
sentences.susu: Na taa hayi mu nu na soge ma, xa na mu a ra kike ma, alako a xa naiyalanyi sɔtɔ. Ala xa nɔrɛ nan findima a xa naiyalanyi ra, Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ findima a xa lanpui nan na.

sentences.english: And the nations will go in its light: and the kings of the earth will take their glory into it.
sentences.susu: Sie ɲɛrɛma a xa naiyalanyi nan kui, duniɲa mangɛe fama nɛ a binyade.

sentences.english: And the doors of it will never be shut by day (for there is no night there):
sentences.susu: Na taa naadɛe mu balanma, barima kɔɛ mu soma naa.

sentences.english: And the glory and honour of the nations will come into it:
sentences.susu: Sie fama nɛ Ala binyade naa, e a matɔxɔ.

sentences.english: And nothing unclean may come into it, or anyone whose works are cursed or false; but only those whose names are in the Lamb's book of life.
sentences.susu: Se sɛniyɛntare yo mu soma naa, mixi naxan fe xɔnxi rabama nun mixi naxan wule falama, e fan mu soma naa. Mixi naxee xili sɛbɛxi Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ xa kisi buki kui, e gbansan nan soma na.

sentences.english: And I saw a river of water of life, clear as glass, coming out of the high seat of God and of the Lamb,
sentences.susu: Na malekɛ naxa kisi xure masen n bɛ. A nu tinse alɔ diyaman, a nu minima Ala nun Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ xa kibanyi nan kui,

sentences.english: In the middle of its street. And on this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, having twelve sorts of fruits, giving its fruit every month; and the leaves of the tree give life to the nations.
sentences.susu: a fa findi xure ra taa tagi. Kisi sansie nu tixi a dɛ firin na, e nu bogi kike yo kike, sanmaya fu nun firin ɲɛ kui. E burɛxɛ findixi seri nan na ɲamanɛe bɛ.

sentences.english: And there will be no more curse: and the high seat of God and of the Lamb will be there; and his servants will be worshipping him;
sentences.susu: Dankɛ yo mu na sɔnɔn. Ala nun Yɛxɛɛyɔrɛ xa kibanyi na taa kui. Ala xa konyie a xui rabatuma,

sentences.english: And they will see his face; and his name will be on their brows.
sentences.susu: e a yatagi to, a xili sɛbɛxi e tigi ma.

sentences.english: And there will be no more night; and they have no need of a light or of the shining of the sun; for the Lord God will give them light: and they will be ruling for ever and ever.
sentences.susu: Kɔɛ mu soma naa, e hayi mu na lanpui nun soge naiyalanyi ma sɔnɔn, barima Marigi Ala nan findixi e xa naiyalanyi ra. Ala xa konyie yaamari tima nɛ naa abadan.

sentences.english: And he said to me, These words are certain and true: and the Lord, the God of the spirits of the prophets, sent his angel to make clear to his servants the things which are now to come about.
sentences.susu: Malekɛ naxa a fala n bɛ, «Yi masenyi nɔndi nan a ra, a mu kanama. Marigi Ala, naxan namiɲɔnmɛ xaxili raɲɛrɛma, a naxa a xa malekɛ xɛɛ alako a xa a masen a xa konyie bɛ naxan fama rabade waxati makɔrɛxi ra.»

sentences.english: See, I come quickly. A blessing on him who keeps the words of this book of the prophet.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen, «I xa a kolon, a gbe mu luxi n xa fa. Ɲɛlɛxinyi na mixi bɛ naxan yi masenyi rabatuma, naxan sɛbɛxi yi Kitaabui kui Ala xili ra.»

sentences.english: And I, John, am he who saw these things and to whose ears they came. And when I had seen and given ear, I went down on my face to give worship at the feet of the angel who made these things clear to me.
sentences.susu: N tan Yaya, n bara na fe birin mɛ, n bara na fe birin to. N to na mɛ, n to na to, n naxa bira na malekɛ bun ma naxan nu bara na fee masen n bɛ, alako n xa a batu.

sentences.english: And he said to me, See you do it not; I am a brother-servant with you and with your brothers the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book: give worship to God.
sentences.susu: Kɔnɔ a naxa a fala n bɛ, «Ade, i naxa na raba. N fan findixi Ala xa konyi nan na alɔ i tan nun i ngaxakerenyi naxee findixi namiɲɔnmɛe ra, a nun mixi naxee yi Kitaabui xa masenyi rabatuma. I xa Ala batu.»

sentences.english: And he said to me, Let not the words of this prophet's book be kept secret, because the time is near.
sentences.susu: Na dangi xanbi na malekɛ naxa a fala n bɛ, «I naxa yi masenyi balan tɔnxuma ra sinden, naxan sɛbɛxi yi Kitaabui kui Ala xili ra, barima waxati bara makɔrɛ.

sentences.english: Let the evil man go on in his evil: and let the unclean be still unclean: and let the upright go on in his righteousness: and let the holy be holy still.
sentences.susu: Tinxintare xa lu tinxintareya kui, sɛniyɛntare xa lu sɛniyɛntareɲa kui, tinxintɔɛ xa lu tinxinyi kui, sɛniyɛntɔɛ xa lu sɛniyɛnyi kui.»

sentences.english: See, I come quickly; and my reward is with me, to give to every man the outcome of his works.
sentences.susu: Isa naxa a masen, «I xa a kolon, a gbe mu luxi n xa fa, n man fama nɛ mixi birin xa kɛwali sare ra.

sentences.english: I am the First and the Last, the start and the end.
sentences.susu: N tan nan findixi fe singe nun fe dɔnxɔɛ ra, a fɔlɛ nun a raɲɔnyi ra.

sentences.english: A blessing on those whose robes are washed, so that they may have a right to the tree of life, and may go in by the doors into the town.
sentences.susu: Ɲɛlɛxinyi na mixi bɛ naxee e yɛtɛ sɛniyɛnma, alako e xa kisi sansi bogi don, e man xa nɔ sode na taa kui naadɛ ra.

sentences.english: Outside are the dogs, and those who make use of evil powers, those who make themselves unclean, and the takers of life, and those who give worship to images, and everyone whose delight is in what is false.
sentences.susu: Fe ɲaaxi rabae na taa fari ma, mandurulae, yɛnɛlae, faxɛtie, kuye batuie, nun wule falɛ birin wule rafan naxee ma.

sentences.english: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to give witness to you of these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, the bright and morning star.
sentences.susu: N tan Isa, n bara n ma malekɛ xɛɛ seedeɲɔxɔya ra danxaniyatɔɛ ɲamae ma. N tan findixi Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ sanke nan na, n tan findixi Dawuda bɔnsɔɛ nan na. N luma nɛ alɔ subaxɛ looloe.»

sentences.english: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him who gives ear, say, Come. And let him who is in need come; and let everyone desiring it take of the water of life freely.
sentences.susu: Ala Xaxili Sɛniyɛnxi nun ginɛ naxan xa futi xirima, e birin a falama, «Fa.» Naxan na a mɛ, na fan xa a fala, «Fa! Ye xɔli na naxan ma, a xa fa. Naxan wama a minfe, a xa kisi ye tongo, a xa a min, a mu sarama!»

sentences.english: For I say to every man to whose ears have come the words of this prophet's book, If any man makes an addition to them, God will put on him the punishments which are in this book:
sentences.susu: N tan Yaya bara findi seede ra mixi birin bɛ naxee bara yi masenyi mɛ naxan sɛbɛxi yi Kitaabui kui Ala xili ra. Xa a sa li mixi nde fama fe gbɛtɛ nde sade yi masenyi fari, Ala nan fama tɔɔrɛ sade na kanyi ma, alɔ tɔɔrɛ naxan ma fe sɛbɛxi yi Kitaabui kui.

sentences.english: And if any man takes away from the words of this book, God will take away from him his part in the tree of life and the holy town, even the things which are in this book.
sentences.susu: Xa a sa li mixi nde naxa wɔyɛnyi nde ba yi namiɲɔnmɛ xa masenyi ra naxan sɛbɛxi yi Kitaabui kui, Ala nan fama kisi sansi kɛ bade a yi ra, a fa lu taa sɛniyɛnxi fari ma, alɔ a sɛbɛxi yi Kitaabui kui ki naxɛ.

sentences.english: He who gives witness to these things says, Truly, I come quickly. Even so come, Lord Jesus.
sentences.susu: Yi seede naxan seedeɲɔxɔya baxi, a xa masenyi nan ya, a naxɛ, «Iyo, a gbe mu luxi n xa fa.» Amina. Marigi Isa, i xa fa!

sentences.english: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with the saints. So be it.
sentences.susu: Marigi Isa xa hinnɛ birin na.
